title: EPISODE 9 - DO THESE FOUR THINGS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF This is our MONTH OF MEDITATION And our Year of BEHOLDING THE KINGDOM GLORY AND POWER. Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday, 31st January, 2023 DO THESE FOUR THINGSToday is the climax of the first month of this new year. You don't need to wait till the ending of the year before you make the most of every opportunity. You must be intentional with your decisions and choices. This is why I am sharing these four crucial items with you today. DO THESE FOUR THINGS: 1. Write down your plans plainly "And the LORD answered me: "Write the vision; make it plain on tablets, so he may run who reads it." Habbakuk 2:2 Yes, its good to keep Divine inspirations to heart. However, you should also write them plainly. Write plainly the things the Lord has inspired you to do in His Kingdom and Ministry, Business and Finance, Academics or Education and Family. Don't assume you will remember all the the inspirations of the Spirit. Whiles you pray or fellowship with the Spirit keep your notes by you. As you read, study and meditate on the scriptures, keep a writing material. 2. Get into Prayer. "Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established". Proverbs 16:3 (NASB) Prayer is not just to be done in January. Prayer must be your daily habit. It must be part of your life and living. Don't just have one good day of prayer. "Men always ought to pray" (Luke 18:1), "Pray without ceasing" (1 Thess. 5:17). Understand that Prayer is not just to have God to answer your requests; through Prayer you are supplied with grace and ability to do. "We plan the way we want to live, but only God makes us able to live it" Proverbs 16:9 (MSG) Through prayer you receive clarity of purpose and also submit the totality of God's inspirations and ideas to you, back to Him. You put God in charge. (Read Proverbs 16:3 Message Translation). 3. Get into Action. "Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action! ” Ezra 10:4 (Berean Study Bible) Those ideas and plans were not to be locked up in your notes as prayer topics. Plans are to be executed. You have to act on the plans as the Lord has given you grace and ability to do. You must act with a sense of urgency. "Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.” John 13:17 (NIV) 4. Maintain Consistency. "And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up" Galatians 6:9 Consistently plan, write the ideas, pray and move into action. It takes discipline and diligence to be consistent. This year is a great year for you. Remain Blessed. Shalom. DIG DEEPER: (Deut. 1:6-8; Psalm 119:60; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAY That the Lord will guide our steps as we execute all that He has inspired us to do. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 2: Genesis 4-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I put God's plans and ideas to work. - I have fresh ability to do what God inspires me to do. - I act diligently and consistently. Shalom!

title: Episode 10 - God's Love Language
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Glory to God! Thanks be to God for this New Month of February, in our year of Beholding The Kingdom Glory and Power. To behold the Kingdom Glory and Power, is essentially to behold the Lord. Author GOD'S LOVE LANGUAGE"So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory. Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You." Psalm 63:2-3 (Berean Study Bible)By beholding the Lord, you are launched into realms of knowledge and understanding of God.You grow into deeper knowledge of His Love, His Righteousness, His Grace, His Wisdom, His Dominion, His Sovereignty, His Economy, His Will, His Power and His Glory.You grow into the understanding of these dimensions of God through the ministry of the Word.
The Holy Spirit gives you illumination, as you read, study and meditate on the Word of God.
And He also trains you through the ministry of the Men He has sent to teach and shepherd you. Through the avenues the Lord has established for you to be nurtured, you are also overwhelmed by the knowledge of His Love.It's great to know the extent God loves you. The knowledge of God's love casts out fear and doubt. It brings you into full assurance of joy and hope in Him.However, in your journey of faith and service to God, you must also demonstrate love towards God.Until you love the Lord, you cannot serve Him.“No one can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other..." (Matthew 6:24, New American Standard Bible)Beloved, God doesn't only love you, He also wants you to love Him.God is a Person. He made man to have a relationship with Him. This relationship is intrinsically a Father-child relationship. God designed you to have an organic relationship of love with Him. He didn't make you to be a robot.
He made you to receive His love and to express love.
Thus, just as you are loved by God, you are also to love the Lord.Now to love the Lord you must understand His love language.Everyone has a "love language"; this refers to how a person prefers to receive love from a partner.It is how one proves the love of the other.God has shown us in the scriptures, the things we can do to prove our love towards Him.See this:"If ye love me, keep my commandments... He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me." John 14:15;24 (KJV).Wow!!Keeping the Lord's commandment is the prove of your love to Him.
Beloved, do you love the Lord?
Keep His commandment. Thus, as you make time to fellowship with the scriptures (as you read, study, listen to and meditate His Word), you will understand His commandment and will be enabled to keep it.Understand also that, the commandments of the Lord are not burdensome. Through Christ Jesus, the restfulness of God's commandment is revealed."For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome" 1 John 5:3 (NKJV).Walk in the restfulness of the Word.ShalomDIG DEEPER:(Read and meditate on these: John 14:21-24; John 15:10-14; 1 John 2:3; 2 John 1:6)WE PRAYThat we walk fully in the love of God which is already at work in us. And we enjoy grace to keep and act on the Word of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 2: Genesis 8-11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I receive divine ability and deep understanding to act rightly on God's Word.  - I function daily according to God's commandment, which is revealed in Christ Jesus. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 11 - God's Love Language 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Thursday 2nd February, 2023GOD'S LOVE LANGUAGE 2 "For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome" 1 John 5:3 (NKJV).  From yesterday's episode, I explained briefly that, God has a love language. And that, you are to love the Lord just as He has loved you.Understanding God's love language, is so essential for your manifestation. Beloved, do you love the Lord?The answer is here: "If ye love me, keep my commandments... He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me." John 14:15;24 (KJV). 
To keep God's commandment is to walk in obedience of His Word. It is to fulfill an authoritative prescription.
 This means, the Lord's commandments are not burdensome. As we have seen in the opening verse (1 John 5:3). The word "burdensome" is the Greek word, " barus" which means, burdensome grave, or grievous, heavy weightier. God's commandment does not lead to burdensome grave. God's commandment as revealed in Christ, is Life. It is an authorised prescription of liberty. Remember Jesus is the Truth and the Life. (John 14:6; John 1:14; John 1:4). The Lord's commandments are not some lists of rules and regulations you need to follow. He is not speaking of the Law given to Israel through Moses. 
The Lord's commandments are the revelation of Himself.
 He is the complete revelation of God.He is the truth of God that brings freedom (John 8:32) Now, for Jesus to say, "If" you love me, doesn't necessarily mean, its possible a born again, may lack His love. When you become born again, the Love of God is dispensed into you, through, the Holy Spirit. (Romans 5:5). Thus, you already have the capacity to Love the Lord. This means that, to keep Jesus' commandments is a product of your love for Him.Doing what Jesus says, or obeying His Word, is an outflow of the love of God at work in you. This love is deeply rich and cannot be exhausted nor be quenched by any level of selfish desire. It is beyond any strong affection, and it is set on doing what Jesus wants. That means the love is an empowering ability within you to respond right to the Words of Jesus and to act on it. 
The more you act on the Word of the Lord, the more you demonstrate His rich love, which is at work in you.
 You train yourself to demonstrate His Love and to bear fruits of His love in you. Shalom Dig deeper:(Read and meditate on these: Deuteronomy 6:5;10:12; Mark 12:30; Jon 8:29;55) WE PRAY1. That your love will grow and increase beyond measure, bringing you into the rich revelation of spiritual insight in all things. And that you will be enabled to choose the most excellent way of all —becoming pure and without offense until the unveiling of Christ.  2. And you will be filled completely with the fruits of righteousness that are found in Jesus, the Anointed One—bringing great praise and glory to God! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 4: Job 1-5 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am empowered by the Love of Christ to act on His Word. - I grow in the love of God . And I function in the knowledge of God's Word. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 12 - God's Love Language 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Friday 3rd February, 2023 GOD'S LOVE LANGUAGE 3 "For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome"  1 John 5:3 (NKJV).  There is more to glean from this verse.  Beloved, don't quickly jump into an idea that, keeping some regulations and laws is equated to the Love of God. 
Yes, the prove or evidence of Love is doing what Jesus says.
 Nevertheless, you are not the manufacturer of this Love. You don't have the responsibility to design this Love. Which means, the Lord Jesus is not demanding love from you. He only wants you to express His Love which He has dispensed into you through the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5). This is why it is not burdensome, because He is the supply of the love at work in you. And Jesus is not saying, if you don't keep my commandments I will not love you. John 14:15"If ye love me, keep my commandments..." Here, Jesus is not issuing out a threat to you. It is a call to demonstrate the deep intimacy of love He has with you. 
Keeping His word is a fruit of His love. 
 Please don't get our discussion twisted, keeping the commandments of Jesus is not your negotation for His love. Neither is it His negotiation to love you. 
Jesus' love for you is boundless.
He wants you to remain in His love. "As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love."* (John 15:9)  DIG DEEPER:(Read and meditate on these: John 17:23, 24,26; Ephesians 3:18; 1 John 4:10,19) WE PRAY That we grow to understand the Love of God which is at work in us more and more. And that we will be an expression of His true love in all situations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 4: Job 6-9  DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I increase in the understanding of the love of God.  -I am loved by God. I walk in His love without any burden.  -No situation can frustrate my love for the Lord and for others.  -I walk in love, because I have the capacity of God's love at work in me.  -I love as God loves me. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 13 - God's Love Language 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Saturday 4th February, 2023 GOD'S LOVE LANGUAGE 4 "For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome" 1 John 5:3 (NKJV).  The commandments of our Lord Jesus, are within the parameters of His Love. The focus of God's commandments in Christ Jesus, is our growth and expression of His Eternal Life. 
His commandments in Christ are not to produce condemnation in us.
 Remember in previous episode, I mentioned that, the commandments we are to keep are not the Law of Moses. Peter, the apostle, puts it this way:  "So why on earth would you now limit God’s grace by placing a yoke of religious duties on the shoulders of the believers that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?" Acts 15:10 (TPT) He calls the Mosaic Laws, "a yoke...our fathers couldn't bear". The Mosaic Law was more mechanic and not organic. 
The commands of Jesus are organic realities which are within us for His expression.
 They are infused into you as spirit and life. He said, "The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life". John 6:63 Anything the Lord says, is backed with His Love, Spirit and Life. Jesus said, "For My yoke is easy [to bear] and My burden is light.” Matthew 11:30 (Amp). God doesn't come putting a burdensome rules for you to keep. He is love!And according to the workings of His love , the Holy Spirit has poured out the love of God in our hearts, and has produced in us the ability of God's grace to work His word. This means His commandments are not troubling task for us to keep.They are the truth of His life at work in us. 
Beloved, have you thought of this amazing love?
 The Lord loves us so much that, the outflow of His love towards us, is what we express towards Him. Selah DIG DEEPER:(Read and meditate on these:  John 14:15-17; John 5:39; 1 John 3:1; Isaiah 34:16) WE PRAY That our choices, decisions, thoughts, expressions and our engagements in all things around us, shall be influenced by the love of God already in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 6: Job 10-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -Many see the manifold expressions of God's love in me.  -I have the ability of God's grace and love to keep His words.  -I enjoy the spirit and life of the Lord's speaking.  -My life is full of love and the sweet presence of the Holy Spirit. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 14 - God's Love Language 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Sunday 5th February, 2023 GOD'S LOVE LANGUAGE 5 (The Root of the Matter)  'Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him' John 14:23 (NKJV)  In this discussion I revealed that, God, made you to receive His love and to express His love. Thus, just as you are loved by God, you are also to love the Lord.Nevertheless, your love for God is not as unconditional as His love for you. This is because, God's love is the condition of your love.  And there is no way your love for God will be unconditional, because God has no imperfection. He is all perfect and glorious. So your understanding of God's love language, must be on the premise of His love expressed towards you. 
"To Keep His commandments" is an expression or a product of the love of God in you.
 Four times in the same Chapter Jesus mentioned "Keeping His commandment or Word" as His love language. Verse 15: “If you love me, you will keep my commandments.” Verse 21: “Whoever has my commandments and keeps them, he it is who loves me.” Verse 23: “If anyone loves me, he will keep my word.” Verse 24: “Whoever does not love me does not keep my words.” Again, from these four verses, you see that, the commandments you are to keep, are not some lists of rules and regulations. Neither are they the Ten Commandments. 
The commandments you are to keep are the Words of Jesus to you (who is loved by Him).
 And we have seen that His commandments are not burdensome (we will look more into His commandments). Now all through the four verses above, you find the word LOVE (You love me; who loves me; anyone loves me; and love me...) 
Understand that the root of your love is the Lord.
 For whoever, or anyone that loves the Lord is first LOVED BY HIM. (See 1 John 4:19) In other words, God's love is the harbinger and the enablement of your Love. Therefore, those outside Christ cannot love the Lord. They cannot keep His commandments or words. Because to keep His Word is a unique, personal, intimate, affectionate, caring, and committed responds of God's love, that belongs only to those who are loved specially by Jesus. Beloved, this is an exciting journey, stay glued as we answer the questions: How do I Keep His Commandments? What are the details of His commandments in the scriptures? Are there people Specially Loved by God? DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:10; Luke 7:47; Romans 5:8; John 13:34) WE PRAY That our hearts will be set more and more on the love of God within us and to express this love towards Him and all who are loved by Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 6: Job 14-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -The Lord is the root of my love.  -I grow deeper into His love.  -Nothing can shake the foundation of my love.  -I grow more and more in my understanding of God's love. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 15- Loving Jesus(God's Love Language 6)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Monday 6th February, 2023 LOVING JESUS (God's Love Language 6) 'Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him' John 14:23 (NKJV)  From John chapter 13 all through to chapter 17, marks Jesus' last conversation with His disciples before His arrest. The things He shared with them were deep heartfelt thoughts. These conversations and teachings of Jesus were so crucial because, they were full of rich realities which will sustain them and usher them into a deeper walk with Him. 
Our walk with Jesus is a walk of intimacy.
 When Jesus said, "If you love me you will keep my commandments" (John 14:16) He wasn't placing an exhaustive burdensome demand on us. He was actually sharing how those who love Him will respond to Him. Period! And take note: Those who love Him, are those who are loved by Him. Keeping His commandments is not what brings you into His love. Instead, because you love Him, you keep His commandments. That is why I shared with you previously that, to keep the commandment of Jesus is a product or result of His love in you. 
And again, your love for Jesus is not as unconditional as His love for you; because His love is the condition of your love.
 Your love for Jesus is programmed by His love. Jesus has no imperfections. He has no weakness, He has no sin and makes no mistakes. He is the meaning of excellence and beauty. When you behold Him, you see the true meaning of holiness, perfection, love, power, honor and glory. You will only love Him and enjoy Him as you behold Him. When you see Him, you will only see His love for you and for all men. You will not see burdensome rules and regulations. You will see His outstretched arm of love. When John the Baptist saw Jesus, He beheld the greatest act of love in the universe.He said, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!" "...God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us" Romans 5:8 (NKJV) Oh glory to God! Jesus' death is the demonstration of God's greatest love. (See also John 3:16).  So how do you love Jesus? 
Now get this, you keep (do or obey) His words or commandments, by delighting in Him.
 The scriptures reveal that the Father loves the Son (John 3:35) Now look at how the Father explains His love for the Son: Two times in scriptures (both at the baptism of Jesus and His Transfiguration experience), we see the Father revealing how He loves His Son: "And the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him, and a voice came from heaven which said, “ You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.” Luke 3:22 (NKJV) "While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, " This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!" Matthew 17:5 This is the way to love the Son; He is so perfect you only delight or be pleased in Him. Beloved, as you delight and enjoy the Lord Jesus, His words will only be a treasure of life and hope for your living. Selah  DIG DEEPER(John 15:13-14; Romans 8:32; 1 John 3:16;) WE PRAY -That our hearts will behold the overwhelming richness of the love of Christ. -That our delight of Him will increase greatly that He will be all that we desire and our complete satisfaction. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 7: Job 17-19 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -The Lord is my delight and my satisfaction.  -I behold the perfection of the Love of Christ. -I walk in the manifestation of the love of Christ.  -The overwhelming power of the love of Christ is the influence of my love. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 16 - LOVING JESUS 2 (God's Love Language 7)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday 7th February, 2023 LOVING JESUS 2 (God's Love Language 7) 'Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him' John 14:23 (NKJV)  Jesus reveals in the opening verse the results of loving Him. Keeping (obeying or doing) His word is a product or the results of the love of Christ in you. 
You cannot keep His word without His love.
 And the Lord Jesus is all perfect and glorious that you love Him by taking delight in Him. We saw how the Father loved His Son by delighting in Him. Even the Father loved Him by being well pleased in Him. (Luke 3:22; Matthew 17:5). Essentially, to love Jesus is to delight in Him. As I said previously, Jesus is so perfect you can only love Him by delighting or being pleased in Him. As you delight and enjoy the Lord Jesus, His words will only be a treasure of life and hope for your living. Keeping His Words will not be a list of rules to anxiously obey. It will be Life to you. Himself said, "It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are lif* " John 6:63 (NKJV) 
Whatever Jesus said to those He specially loved, are to produce life and joy in them.
Speaking to His disciples, at the eve of His departure He affirmed, "These things I have spoken to you, that My joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be full" John 15:11 (NKJV). Now this was also said after He spoke again about, "If you keep my commandments..." (John 15:10). Now the Lord must be your delight as His love is in You. For the Lord to be your delight means, He must be your craving and pleasure. Your satisfaction must be the Lord. To love the Lord is to value, be awe-struck, overwhelmed, enjoy and highly esteem Him above all things.  
To love the Lord is for Him to be your desire.
 When you love the Lord, you will not desire the world.You will not crave for the praise of men. Your emotions will gravitate towards the Lord and what He loves. "I write these things to you, dear children, because you truly have a relationship with the Father. I write these things, fathers and mothers, because you have had a true relationship with him who is from the beginning. And I write these things, young people, because you are strong, the Word of God is treasured in your hearts, and you have defeated the Evil One. Don’t set the affections of your heart on this world or in loving the things of the world. The love of the Father and the love of the world are incompatible. For all that the world can offer us—the gratification of our flesh, the allurement of the things of the world, and the obsession with status and importance—none of these things come from the Father but from the world. This world and its desires are in the process of passing away, but those who love to do the will of God live forever. " 1 John 2:14-17  Selah  DIG DEEPER(1 John 2:3-17; John15:9-11; ) WE PRAY We pray that the desire of the Lord shall increase in our hearts, and our affections shall gravitate towards the Lord more and more. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 8: Job 20-22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I take pleasure in the Lord. My heart craves after the Lord.  -The Lord is my enjoyment, and my admiration.  -My desires are set on the Lord. -I refuse to crave for the praise of men.  -My emotions gravitate towards the Lord and what He loves. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 17 - THE COMMANDMENTS OF JESUS (God’s Love Language 8)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday 8th February, 2023The "Commandments" of Jesus (God's Love Language 8) "The one having My commandments and keeping them, he is the one loving Me. Now the one loving Me will be loved by My Father. And I will love him, and will show Myself to him." John 14:21 (Berean Literal Bible)  John chapter 13 all through to chapter 17; have heartfelt thoughts of Jesus.He gave them household instructions, to guide them. He explained things that will bring them into deep intimacy with Him. He affirmed at different times, the promise of the Holy Spirit and the work of the Spirit. We saw from previous teaching that, the commandments of Jesus are: -authoritative prescription; thus, whatever He tells you to do, helps and provides you with a specific enablement and solution. Now get this, the authority of Jesus, is not to issue demanding orders. The authority of Jesus is to supply you with ability and directives, unto a designed purpose of God. (Matthew 28:18-20; Mark 1:22)-the commandments of Jesus are not burdensome. (1John 5:3).-His commandments which are His words are spirit and life. (John 6:63). His commandments infused into you the ability of the spirit-life.-His commandments or words are designed to produce joy in you (John 15:11).-the commandments of the Lord are His household instructions. They are not for the world; they are for those who belong to Him. Those who are part of the special household.
And the truth is, the commandments of the Lord cannot be received and kept by the world. They are kept by those who are loved by Him.
Remember, to keep His commandments is a product of His love in you. His love empowers you to keep His commandments. Thus, those who have not received Him, don't have His love and cannot keep His commandments. Jesus replied, “Loving me empowers you to obey my word. And my Father will love you so deeply that we will come to you and make you our dwelling place." John 14:23 (The Passion Translation) Now, all through the Gospel of John, we see Jesus giving out certain commandments.He commanded the disciples; He commanded the sick and even the dead.
Jesus commanded His disciples to "receive", to "ask", to "believe", to "abide" and even commanded them not to let their heart be troubled.
He also commanded Peter to "Feed His flock".Understand that Jesus' commandments are His words. I have already established this with you.Interestingly, He commanded Lazarus to come out.He commanded the cripple to rise.He commanded the offender to go and sin no more.He commanded, His disciples to do the works that He they saw Him do and even greater.He commanded them to love as He has loved.For the things Jesus said, His audience never saw it as impossible things to do. This was because His words were the empowering ability they needed to do.The cripple couldn't walk, but when He asked the cripple to walk, those words generated fresh power and strength in his limps.Lazarus (who was dead) came back to life, by the words of Jesus.
This clearly drives the reality home; that the commandments of Jesus are designed skillfully by Him, to empower you and not to burden you with a yoke of bondage.
His commandments makes you become.Selah,DIG DEEPER(John 1:12; 8:11; John 11:8; 12:36; John 14:1; 14:11; John 15:4;7; John 20:22 ) WE PRAY- We pray that we will walk in the ability supplied to us through the Words of Jesus, to be consistent doers of the Word. -We pray that many will look at us and see the manifestation and the fulfillment of the Word of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 9: Job 23-28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-The ability of the Words of Jesus are at work in me.  -I am a doer of the Word. Many see the results and productivity of the Word of God in me.  -I am quickened and enabled by the words of Jesus.  -The commandments of the Lord are my enablement.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 18 - THE INTIMACY OF JESUS’ LOVE (God’s Love Language 9)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 9th February, 2023The Intimacy of Jesus' Love (God's Love Language 9) "Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him." John 14:23  Understand that, your love for Jesus is an outflow of His love for you. We have looked more into this by establishing that, your love for Jesus is not an unconditional love. However, your love for Jesus is according to the condition of His love. 
To love Jesus is to delight in Him (Read Loving Jesus 2).
To love Jesus is for Him to be your craving, your desire and pleasure.This is how you keep His commandments or words; by essentially desiring the Lord.The one who craves, desires, highly esteems, treasures, values and is awe-struck by the Lord is the one who believes in the Lord. To believe the Lord is to totally trust or entrust and commit yourself unto Him. It is to accept and receive Him as who He says He is.Jesus used the word "believe" about 85 times in the Gospel of John. And about 5 times in only John chapter 14.John 14:12, He said "Verily, Verily, I say to you, he who believes in Me..."The expression verily, verily denotes "Most Assuredly" or a strong certainty.
Your believe in the Lord Jesus is an important response of your love to Him.
 Contextually, to believe in the Lord is also essential in keeping His commandments or His words.This makes you have a special relationship with the Lord. Yes, "for God so loved the world..." however, it is only those who BELIEVE IN HIM, "SHOULD HAVE EVERLASTING LIFE". (See John 3:16).
To believe in the Lord is also to RECEIVE the Lord.
 Those who did not receive Him were "unbelievers". (John 1:11-12).Though the Lord loves all men, He only has a special intimate relationship with those who have believed or received Him. And three times in John 14, Jesus affirmed the results of keeping (treasuring, valuing, esteeming, believing, receiving, craving and desiring) His words:a. "If you love Me, keep My commandments. And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever". John 14:15-16b. He who has My commandments and keeps them, it is he who loves Me. And he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him.” John 14:21c. "Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and *My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him." John 14:23 Now there are three key expressions in these points:- He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever. -Will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him. - My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him. Now these three key expressions are not separated in reality; they all point to the same matter - DEEP INTIMACY OF LOVE.
See this, to receive the Helper who will abide with you forever is to receive the person of the Holy Spirit.
 To be loved by the Father and the Lord even more, whereas they manifest themselves to you, is the work of the Holy Spirit. And they being in you to make their home in you, is the inward family relationship with the Holy Spirit. Each of these three expressions, which are the Lord's promise to keeping or delighting in His word, points us to a DEEP INTIMACY WITH GOD through the Holy Spirit.
For God to manifest Himself, is to demystify Himself or to strip Himself naked before us.
 One strips his heart, deep thoughts, emotions and even body naked only in a deep intimate relationship with the other. The Holy Spirit indwells in the one who has received the Lord. Now through your new birth experience you received the Holy Spirit, however, the more you delight yourself in the Lord, the deeper you become intimate with Him.The more you set your affection on the Lord, the more He manifests Himself to you. Beloved, grow in the intimacy of the Love of Christ.DIG DEEPER(John 16:7-15; Romans 8:15-16; John 7:37-39) WE PRAY-Thanking the Lord for indwelling us through the Holy Spirit. -We shall behold the manifestation of the Lord in a deeper way as we will grow more intimately in our relationship with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 10: Job 23-25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-The Lord is my greatest delight. My heart is set on Him day by day.  -The Holy Spirit is present in my heart in the fullness of His love.  -My relationship with the Lord through the Holy Spirit is getting deeper by the day. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 19-The Intimacy of Jesus' Love 2 (God's Love Language 10)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Friday 10th February, 2023 The Intimacy of Jesus' Love 2 (God's Love Language 10) "Jesus answered and said to him, "If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him." John 14:23  God made us to have a relationship with us. God didn't create us because He wants someone to control. He made us, for Him to have a FAMILY. This is why God didn't make us to be robots. He gave us a mind so we can have the ability to think, a will to have the power to make choices, and emotions to have the ability to be affectionate. By this, man can make the choice to be dependent or independent of God. 
God's original design and intention, His relationship with man was to be governed by His love-life.
 God is Spirit (John 4:24), therefore, He gave man spirit (Zechariah 12:1), so that man can connect and can have deep relationship with Him. Beloved, God's relationship with you is not just an outward show.Your deepest relationship with God begins from your inner man.  Therefore, God's goal of intimacy begins with working Himself into your heart. God's love affair with you, begins with having a mingled life with you. 
God's deepest expression of love doesn't work in isolation. God's deepest expression of love works by indwelling you.
 This why He sent the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is God being processed into us. God, as big as He is, could not indwell us, until He was processed into us through His Spirit. See Titus 3:5 (The Passion Translation) "When the extraordinary compassion of God our Savior and his overpowering love suddenly appeared in person, as the brightness of a dawning day, He came to save us.Not because of any virtuous deed that we have done, but only because of his extravagant mercy.He saved us, resurrecting us through the washing of rebirth.We are made completely new by the Holy Spirit" This briefly explains how God worked Himself into us. By Christ's death we were cleansed, justified and made Holy. Now the Holy Spirit indwelt us to bring us into the newness of life, where we are now able to relate with God in a deeper way. 
Jesus is the embodiment or the appearance and experience of the extraordinary compassion of God our Savior and his overpowering love.
 Your believe and delight in the Lord Jesus is a response of your love to Him. This response of love to Jesus made you become the gravitational focus for the indwelling of God. And the more you continue in delighting in the Lord, the richer your relationship with Him becomes as He now dwells in your heart through the Spirit. Let this mind be in you, from the day you believed and received Jesus, you became the dwelling place of the Father through the Holy Spirit. 
When you received the Holy Spirit, God came to make His home in you.
 Make the most of this intimate relationship by continuously keeping His Word or delighting in the Lord Jesus.   "Those who truly love me are those who obey my commands. Whoever passionately loves me will be passionately loved by my Father. And I will passionately love you in return and will manifest my life within you.”John 14:21 (TPT)  DIG DEEPER(Zechariah 12:1; Hebrews 12:9; Ecclesiates 12:7; 2 Corinthians 13:14; Acts 2:38; Acts 5:32) WE PRAY-that by the wisdom of God's Word we shall nake the most of our relationship with the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 11: Job 28-33 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I have a deep relationship with God.  -I am deeply connected to God. -The Lord dwells me through the Holy Spirit.  -I have an intimate relationship with God.  -I am the Lord's favourite. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 20 - THE SEAL OF GOD’S INTIMACY WITH YOU (God’s Love Language 11)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Saturday, 11th February, 2023 The Seal of God's Intimacy With You (God's Love Language 11) "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever; that is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him, but you know Him because He abides with you and will be in you." John 14:15-17 (NASB1995)  Beloved, God's heartbeat wasn't just for Jesus to die for your sins; His heartbeat is to be mingled with you. God intentionally made man, that He will have His Family, which vibrates at His frequency of love. His desire is to indwell you and to become one with you.God, through the Holy Spirit indwells anyone who desires and delights in Him. This is not to suggest that, the Holy Spirit is received according to our works. This only means that those who believe in the Lord, are those who love the Lord, delight in His words and receive the Holy Spirit. As you can see in the opening scripture. "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever;" John 14:15-16. 
There is no need to be wondering who the "Another Helper" is.
 Just in the next verse the Lord provides the answer:"that is the Spirit of truth..." (John 14:17) This clearly is the Holy Spirit and not any other person. However, the promise of the Holy Spirit, is not to be fulfilled in all men automatically. The promise of the Holy Spirit is to be fulfilled in those who believe and receive the Lord Jesus. "Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me" Revelation 3:20. (NKJV) 
Have you received the Lord, as He knocked at the door of your heart?
 There is the invitation of the Lord to have a deeper relationship of love with you. The day you received the Lord, the Holy Spirit came to indwell you. When you received the Holy Spirit, God came to make His home in you.What was God's goal for indwelling you? INTIMACY! 
The Holy Spirit in you is the seal of God's Intimacy with you.
 Your ability to commune or have intimacy with God in a deeper way is by the Holy Spirit. He supplies you with the love of God (Romans 5:5), and empowers you with the truth of God's Word, the life of God and leads you in your walk with God. "In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and believed in him, were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit" Ephesians 1:13 (ESV) DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 1:21-22; John 6:67; Isaiah 42:1;61:1; 2 Corinthians 5:5) WE PRAY- Thanking the Lord for the seal of the Spirit upon us. - And that we grow in the understanding of God's Spirit to enjoy His communion. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 12: Job 31-34 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I have the seal of the Lord upon me.  -I am set apart by the Lord to have intimate relationship with Him.  -The Holy Spirit is strongly at work in Him.  -I have the ability to fellowship with God.  -I am not ordinary. God lives in me through the Holy Spirit.  Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 21 - THE SEAL OF GOD’S INTIMACY WITH YOU 2 (God’s Love Language 12)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Sunday 12th February, 2023 The Seal of God's Intimacy With You 2 (God's Love Language 12) "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever; that is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him, but you know Him because He abides with you and will be in you." John 14:15-17 (NASB1995)  The Holy Spirit in you is the seal of God's Intimacy with you. God didn't just want to have an outward relationship with you. God wanted have a deeper inward relationship with you. This is why He comes to   indwell you through the Holy Spirit. The thing is, God didn't come to dwell in you, with a plan or a condition to exit. He came to make His Home in you forever. Which means you are God's residential address through the Holy Spirit.  
God didn't just indwell you, He made it possible legally.
 Through the death of Jesus, the old sin nature was terminated or crucified, so that you can receive the new life, which is Christ. (Galatians 2:20). Through Christ's death and resurrection, you were justified, sanctified and made Holy. Your body now became the temple of the Holy Spirit.You were made pure in Christ, that now God can dwell in you. This was not just achieved by God through Christ, so that you will practice a "religious worship". This was achieved by God with the goal of intimacy. God didn't want you to know Him by mental assent. He wants you to be in Him and He shall also be in you, to bring you into full experience of His love beyond utterance. Through Christ's death, God demonstrated His greatest love towards you. Now, by indwelling you through the Spirit, He seals His love for you. 
The Holy Spirit in you is the consummate expression of all that God began in Christ.
 Your recognition and engagement of the presence of the Holy Spirit in you, is the most beautiful way to enjoy all that Christ has achieved for you. Through the Holy Spirit, God daily makes His love real to you. The Holy Spirit in you is the evidence that God didn't come to show you one time love through Jesus' earth walk. He is in you now as the evidence that you can receive, enjoy, experience and share in His love forever. 
The Holy Spirit in you is also the continuous supply of the ability of God's love in your heart.
 Which means, He is in you not only for you to enjoy God's love, but to make you a dispenser of the Love of God. Now you have the ability to love, to walk with God intimately, and to share the unfathomable unconditional love with others. True intimacy with God doesn't end when you stand in a "Church auditorium", with your hands lifted, having tears in your eyes and crying out how you love the Lord. That experience may be real as His love overwhelms your heart. Nevertheless, true intimacy with God is a daily walk.  
The Holy Spirit is not dwelling in you seasonally. He is in you FOREVER!
 "...He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever..." John 14:16  You don't enjoy the love of God annually, nor weekly. The Holy Spirit in you, means you have daily avalanche of the Love of God flowing in your heart forever. Now, to commune with God through prayer should be a restful flow. To fellowship with the Lord and to delight in Him, should be expressed by you organically. To have deep moments of ministering to the Lord and receiving the ministrations of the Lord should be unforceful. Beloved, the Holy Spirit is in you now. You have the living spring of life within you by which you can fellowship and worship the Lord in spirit and in truth. Worship no longer becomes an act of religious demand. Worship becomes a response to the revelation of God in your heart through the administration of the Holy Spirit. To have the Holy Spirit in you, means you have the source of God's loving ability. You have what it takes to daily demonstrate the love of God and the inward evidence to daily trust the Lord. You have the seal of God's love and supply in you.  Glory to God. DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:18-19; Ephesians 5:2; Jeremiah 31:3; Isaiah 49:15; Zephaniah 3:17; John 4:10-25) WE PRAY-that by the wisdom of God, we shall take advantage of the Holy Spirit in our heart, to demonstrate total trust in the Lord and to share His unfathomable unconditional love with others. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 13: Job 35-37 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I have the seal of the Lord upon me.  -The love of God is in my heart, therefore, I have the ability to love.  -I have an intimate relationship with God.  -I enjoy and demonstrate the avalanche of God's love. -I have a daily communion with God. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 22 - A New Commandment
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Monday 13th February, 2023A New Commandment"If you love Me, you will keep My commandments." John 14:15 (NASB1995)   During the last conversation with His disciples, Jesus shared some deep essential matters with them. These were things that will sustain them in the fellowship He has established with them. And He even gave them the promise of the Holy Spirit as their Helper, who is also going to bring the clarity of the things He has shared and also reveal more truth to them.In John 17, we also see Jesus praying for His disciples. You will realise that, the last few hours Jesus had with His disciples were imbued with great truth. He didn't just speak words, He enriched them with a kingdom treasure chest of verities.  This was why He had to admonish them to keep (delight, value, highly esteem, preserve, guard) His commandments. As we have established earlier, the commandments of Jesus are not lists of burdensome rules and regulations; they are life. Take note: the things Jesus shared with His disciples in His last hours, were not things only meant for them. He was also speaking to those who shall believe in Him even after. Beloved, this includes you and I. Look at what He said in His prayer for His disciples within the same period:  “I pray for them. I do not pray for the world but for those whom You have given Me, for they are Yours. *I do not pray for these alone, but also for those who will believe in Me through their word" John 17:9;20 
Do you believe in the Lord through the Word ministered?
 If you your answer is "yes", then Jesus prayed for you and His commandments are also to you. Hallelujah. Now in the commandments Jesus gave His disciples, He specifically, spoke of a "New Commandment". Which is: " A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.* By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34-35 Why did Jesus refer to this as a New Commandment? Before the last hours of Jesus' conversation with His disciples, the Pharisees and the Sadducees, attempted several times to entangle Him with their questions. After they had failed at different attempts, they decided to ask another question, "But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying, Master, *which is the great commandment in the law*? Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.This is the first and great commandment.And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets." Matthew 22:34-40 (NKJV) The law mentioned here, is clearly the law of Moses. One thing you should know is that, there is a difference between the Law of Moses and the Commandments of Jesus.The law of Moses is not necessarily bad or evil (Romans 7:7). However, the law of Moses is the knowledge of sin (Romans 3:20) and exposes man's weakness. It did not make anything perfect. (Hebrews 7:19). This is because the Law demanded obedience but did not supply the ability of obedience. This was why the law was burdensome. Peter called it unbearable yoke (Acts 15:10). However, the commandments of Jesus are the speaking of His life. Jesus' commandments are first a supply of life and ability. From our previous episodes, we see that, we are not the source of love. The love which we have towards God, is dependent on God's love for us. Which means God's love is the ability of our love. Meanwhile, the Old covenant (which was a shadow of things to come through Christ (Hebrews 8:5; Hebrews 10:1), couldn't make supply of love because of its terms. You will understand this by comparing these two: 1. The second great commandments of the law says: 
"Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself"
 2. The new commandment of Jesus says: "A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; *as I have loved you, that you also love one another. " Do you see the premise of each commandment? The commandment of the law of Moses is dependent on *YOURSELF Effort* . 
However, the New commandment of Jesus is dependent on HIS LOVE.
 Beloved, understand that, you cannot walk in the richness of His love towards others until you BEHOLD AND ENJOY THE LOVE OF CHRIST. Live by the new commandments of Jesus and not by the commandments of the law.  Glory to GodDIG DEEPER(1 John 2:8-10; Ephesians 5:2; John 15:12,13,17) WE PRAYThat we shall increase in the knowledge of the love of Christ, so we may love others as He has loved us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 14: Job 38-39 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-Thank you Lord for your unconditional love.  -I enjoy the unconditional love more and more. By this love, I am enabled to love all I cannot be intimidated by any condition.  -I walk in the love of God according as the Lord has loved me. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 23 - LOVE ONE ANOTHER 1 (A New Commandment 2)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday 14th February, 2023A New Commandment 2" A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34-35  From yesterday, we have seen that there is a difference between the commandments of Jesus and the Law of Moses. Jesus did not leave His disciples without clear instructions. The instructions of Jesus are life.  He didn't come to die for us, resurrect and ascend to Heaven without giving us clear commandments. Beloved, He gave us the Holy Spirit (of whom we will be discussing much about later) and He also gave us His commandments. Most at times we hear people say, we are not "UNDER A LAW..."Then we begin to think we have no Law and commandments. That is not entirely true. Because the Bible never said that. 
Of course we are not "UNDER THE LAW OF MOSES"
 Whenever the Bible says, we are not under the law, it is referring to the LAW OF MOSES. That law couldn't bring us into the full expression of God. In Christ, we have A NEW LAW OF LIFE (Romans 8:2). This law is also the law of Christ (Galatians 6:2). 
The commandments of Jesus are not the Commandments of Moses.
 As we have seen previously, the commandments of Jesus are not merely demands. The commandments of Jesus also supply us with life and ability.  The truth is, His commandments are the dispensing of Himself. Let me talk to You: Whatever, Jesus tells you to do is what He has become to you and what He has made you. He doesn't just demonstrate what He tells you to do. He becomes what He tells you to do in you.Our Lord Jesus doesn't show you how to live His life externally. He has indwelt you through the Holy Spirit to do what He tells you to do, with you. 
You don't walk in the obedience of His commandments alone. You walk in obedience of His commandments with Him.
 Paul said, "Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God" 2 Corinthians 3:5 See The Passion Translation: "Yet we don’t see ourselves as capable enough to do anything in our own strength, for our true competence flows from God’s empowering presence" This is what it is when I say, "The commandments of Jesus are Life". He says, "without me you can do nothing" (John 15:5). The golden rule of the commandments of Moses is, "Love your neighbour as yourself" This is demanding and limited. It means the ability to love is issuing out of your love for yourself. And you can only love as far as you love yourself. How far can you love with this limited ability of love in you. And even until Jesus came, we had not seen the full expression of love. Through Jesus, we saw a whole new civilization of love.  Paul says, "to know the love of Christ which surpasses all knowledge..." Ephesians 3:19. Which means Moses' commandment of love cannot bring you into full expression of the love of God. And till today, many are still living by "love your neighbour as yourself". But Jesus is inviting us to a higher dimension of love. He said, a "New" Commandment I give. It means from now onwards you don't operate by the Mosaic law.  The Lord is saying, I bring you something new. The word for new is "Kainos", it means freshness, recently made, unused, unworn, unprecedented, uncommon, unheard of.It is not “new” in terms of time, but “new” as to form or quality, of different nature from what is contrasted as old. It relates to being not previously present; as set over against that which is outworn, the effete or burnt-out through age. Beloved, this New Commandment of love Jesus gave was beyond any human comprehension and experience. It is a supernatural commandment. The new commandment of Jesus says: " ...as I have loved you, that you also love one another. " This love is beyond the domain of men. It is beyond the standard of men. This is a higher standard of love. And no man can meet its demand. This is why God designed it to only be supplied to you by Himself. This love doesn't work just by utterance. It works by life. And you cannot wake up one day to just start loving as He has loved you. Unless you have received Him into you.The greatest mind couldn't imagine this love. He Himself has to be the picture of this love. 
To walk in this love, you must know more and more the extent by which He has loved you.
 "All this is proceeding along lines planned all along by God and then executed in Christ Jesus. When we trust in him, we’re free to say whatever needs to be said, bold to go wherever we need to go. So don’t let my present trouble on your behalf get you down. Be proud!My response is to get down on my knees before the Father, this magnificent Father who parcels out all heaven and earth. I ask him to strengthen you by his Spirit—not a brute strength but a glorious inner strength—that Christ will live in you as you open the door and invite him in. And I ask him that with both feet planted firmly on love, you’ll be able to take in with all followers of Jesus the extravagant dimensions of Christ’s love. Reach out and experience the breadth! Test its length! Plumb the depths! Rise to the heights! Live full lives, full in the fullness of God." Ephesians 3:11-19 (The Message) Glory to God!  DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:9-10; John 15:12,13,17) WE PRAYThat we will comprehend the love of Christ which surpasses knowledge. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 15: Job 40-42 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-The love of Christ floods my heart.  -I have Christ's ability to love. I walk in love.  -I grow in the incomprehensible love of Christ.  -I experience the fullness of God's love in all matters.  -My understanding is deepened in the love of Christ. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 24 - LOVE ONE ANOTHER 2; JESUS OUR PATTERN 1 (A New Commandment 3)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday 15th February, 2023LOVE ONE ANOTHER 2: JESUS OUR PATTERN 1 (A New Commandment 3)" A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another. By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34-35  About 13 times in the New Testament of the Bible, we see the phrase "love one another". And that reveals the importance of this commandment. How we love one another is what makes others know we are disciples of Jesus. (Johm 13:35) The newness of this commandment of Jesus, is Himself. Jesus didn't just give us His command to love one another. He made Himself the pattern and supply of that commandment. We are not to love one another by how we love ourselves. We love one another according to the portrait of Jesus. "This is my commandment: that you love one another as I have loved you" John 15:12 (ISV) What is the extent of Jesus's love for us? How has he loved us? 
Love is not just an utterance, love is a walk.
 "Dear children, let’s not merely say that we love each other; let us show the truth by our actions." 1 John 3:18 (NLT)  Love is a life-lived or an action. Love is not suppositious or conjectured. Love is demonstrated and experienced. Understand that love is more than a feeling. To love is to serve. Today lets begin to look at some practical ways Jesus demonstrated His love of service for us: Before Jesus gave the new commandment in John 13:34, look at what happened in the earlier verses: "Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end... Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded...So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet. For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him. If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them."(John 13:1,3-5;12-17) From these verses, we realise, there is no room to guess what Jesus meant by "as I have loved you" in John 13:34. He has showed us the clear example of what we should do in verse 15;  
 For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
 What did Jesus really do? He served His disciples by washing their feet. Feet washing is an art of hospitality among the Israelites. Most oriental people, which includes the Israelites, wore sandals instead of shoes, in the past times, and as they usually went barefoot in the house, frequent washing of the feet was a necessity. Hence among the Israelites, it was the first duty of the host to give his guest water for the washing of his feet. To omit this was a mark of unfriendliness. This was done either by the wife or the servants. Mostly, its done before meals. (See Genesis 18:4; Genesis 19:2, Genesis 24:32; Genesis 43:24).  This is a symbol of honour, service and humility for one another. 
We love one another by serving one another with that which God has given us. And that was what Jesus showed His disciples.
 "Just as each one of you has received a special gift [a spiritual talent, an ability graciously given by God], employ it in serving one another as [is appropriate for] good stewards of God’s multi-faceted grace [faithfully using the diverse, varied gifts and abilities granted to Christians by God’s unmerited favor]" 1 Peter 4:10 (Amplified Bible). Beloved, are you in pursuit of your own interest?Or you are in pursuit of serving the brethren?   As Christ has loved you, serve one another. ShalomDIG DEEPER(1 John 4:20; 1 Peter 4:10-11; Romans 12:10; Philippians 2:1-11) WE PRAYThat we enjoy abundance of grace to relentlessly love the saints by serving them in humility and honour. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 16: Genesis 12-15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I serve the saints in love. I am an example of the love of Christ to others.  -I love with ease because Christ is the supply of my love.  -I refuse to be selfish. I am committed to serving others in humility. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 25 - LOVE ONE ANOTHER 3; JESUS OUR PATTERN 2 (A New Commandment 4)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Thursday 16th February, 2023LOVE ONE ANOTHER: JESUS OUR PATTERN 2 (A New Commandment 4)" A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another. By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34-35  This commandment of Jesus, is specifically for the people of His household.He didn't give this commandment to the multitudes. He gave this commandment during His final moments with His disciples before His death.The importance of loving one another is the testimony of our oneness to the world.God truly loves the world, however, it is His desire that we share His special love, with one another. The only way we can reach out to the world is when we are one and love one another. "By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another." John 13:34 Jesus had to include the need for the oneness of the saints in His heartfelt prayer in John 17  "I pray that they will all be one, just as you and I are one—as you are in me, Father, and I am in you. And may they be in us so that the world will believe you sent me" John 17:21 (NLT). 
Beloved, the need for all the saints to be one and to love one another is imperative.
From yesterday's Machaira, I began to show you the practical examples or pattern of the love of Christ. Love is an action and not just an utterance. (1 John 3:18). Jesus demonstrated His love of service to us, by how He washed the feet of His disciples. " If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet. For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.(John 13:14-15)  I ask the question again, how are you serving your fellow brother in Christ?Today we look at another example of the love of Jesus. Paul the apostle, puts it this way:"But *God clearly shows and proves His own love for us*, by the fact that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us." Romans 5:8 (Amplified Bible) Jesus' death was God patiently showing and demonstrating His love to us. This wasn't Apostle Paul trying to make it up. See what Jesus said, " This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you. Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you." John 15:12-14 
Jesus demonstrated His greater love through His sacrificial service.
We also love one another through our sacrificial service. Apostle Paul admonished the brethren in Philippi with this ardent instruction: " If you've gotten anything at all out of following Christ, if his love has made any difference in your life,if being in a community of the Spirit means anything to you, if you have a heart, if you care - then do me a favor: Agree with each other, love each other, be deep-spirited friends. Don't push your way to the front; don't sweet-talk your way to the top. Put yourself aside, and help others get ahead. Don't be obsessed with getting your own advantage. Forget yourselves long enough to lend a helping hand. Think of yourselves the way Christ Jesus thought of himself. He had equal status with God but didn't think so much of himself that he had to cling to the advantages of that status no matter what. Not at all. When the time came, he set aside the privileges of deity and took on the status of a slave, became human! Having become human, he stayed human. It was an incredibly humbling process. He didn't claim special privileges. Instead, he lived a selfless, obedient life and then died a selfless, obedient death - and the worst kind of death at that: a crucifixion. Because of that obedience, God lifted him high and honored him far beyond anyone or anything, ever, (Philippians 2:1-9, MESSAGE) This is how you follow the example of Jesus; to love others is to serve them. You love others when you do things for them without expecting anything in return. You do things you may not like to do, and that will cost or inconvenience you. (NB: Not things that make you live contrary to God's word).
There is no love without service. Jesus said He came to serve others:
 "For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve others and to give his life as a ransom for many.” Matthew 20:28 Beloved, we know what real love is because Jesus gave up his life for us. So we also ought to give up our lives for our brothers and sisters. ( 1John 3:16) Hatred towards one another is not an option. You walk in darkness if you hate a brother or a sister. (1 John 2:9) 
The greatest among you shall be your servant. (Matthew 23:11).
 Have a blessed day. Let me know how this blessed you in the comment session.DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:9-11; Philippians 2:17; 1 Corinthians 13 ) WE PRAYThat the Lord grants us more opportunities to demonstrate His sacrificial love towards the brethren as Christ Jesus loved us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 17: Genesis 16-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I make great sacrifices for the brethren.  -I refuse to walk in hatred.  -Through me the brethren see the reality of the love of Christ.  -I go the extra mile to help the brethren.  -I am a great lover of the saints.  -I refuse to be selfish.  -I refuse to esteem myself above the brethren.  -I serve the brethren with all humility. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 26 - THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Friday 17th February, 2023THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 1"Beloved, let us [unselfishly] love and seek the best for one another, for love is from God; and everyone who loves [others] is born of God and knows God [through personal experience]" 1 John 4:7 (Amplified Bible)  Love is to be practiced. You don't love only by utterance, you love by action. Demonstrating love towards one another establishes our oneness.
Division is the fruit of selfishness.
Wherever there is oneness there is love. To walk in love is according to the supply of God's love in us. Even our Lord Jesus demonstrated His love according as He is loved by the Father. "As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love" John 15:9 (KJV).You continue or remain in His love by enjoying His love in a personal way and expressing that love to others.
Until you understand how love works, you cannot practice this love.
We work out God's love exactly as He has worked His love into us. In 1 Corinthians 16, we see about fifteen (15) workings of God's love."Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails...." 1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV) Paul the apostle, wasn't trying to give definitions of love in these verses; he was laying bare the application of love. He was not speaking of romantic or sentimental relationship. These things Paul listed are more radical and not mere squishy feelings. Love is how the saints live out our empowered relationship with Jesus, through the Holy Spirit. The love we speak of here, is the Greek word "agape". It is different from "Eros" romantic or intimate love. It is deeper than the romantic love partners professes to each other. Neither is it, "Phileo" the strong love towards a relative.
Agape is the highest dimension of the love of God demonstrated through Christ.
When you study 1 Corinthians 13, it must be from chapter 12; these points out the focus of the gifts of the Spirit. Gifts of the Spirit are to be exercised with love. He listed the things which love does and things love doesn't do. These are not emotional depictions of love. Beloved, without the life of Christ in you, 1 Corinthians 13 is meaningless and inapplicable. 1. Love suffers longThis is not suggesting that you are in endless trouble. This is basically a matter of patience. To say love is patient, means love is persistent and purposeful. Patience is the foundational expression of love. It endures without quitting no matter the frustration.This is essentially rooted in the eternal patience of Christ's love, which He demonstrated towards us. 2. Love is kindThis is to image the kindness of the love of Christ, towards others.This is to act benevolently or to show oneself useful or helpful to others.
To be kind is to be gentle or courteous and polite.
This is seen in how you speak and benevolent deeds. It is not acting and speaking harshly, sharply, bitterly and disagreeably. To be kind is to be mild and tender towards others. Beloved, this is the truth about you, because the love of God is poured out into you. Don't function contrary. Reach a brother or a sister today and demonstrate these acts of patience and kindness. This the real you. Go and right the wrongs. Have a blessed day. Let me know how this blessed you in the comment session.DIG DEEPER(Nehemiah 9:17; Galatians 5:22; Colossians 3:12; 2 Corinthians 6:6; Proverbs 19:22;) WE PRAYThat we shall exercise the wisdom of God in demonstrating His love which is in us, through patience and kindness towards one another. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 18: Genesis 19-22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-The Love of God is at work in me.  -I walk in patience.  -I demonstrate love persistently and purposefully.  -I am benevolently useful to others. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 27 - THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Saturday 18th February, 2023THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 2"...love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails...." 1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV)  From yesterday we delved more into the things which love does and things love doesn't do. These are not some definitions of love but practical applications of the radical love of God. We've already looked at "Love suffers long and Love is Kind".We move on to others things the Apostle Paul mentioned. 3. Love does not envy.To envy means to zealously burn or boil with a desire of jealousy. It's a burning desire to covet or have the attainment of the other.To love is not to be depressed or desperately dispirited about someone's joy. Love celebrates the achievements of others with a genuine open heart. There is no explanation to justify envy. As the love of God is at work in you, choose to ignore envy. It is the choke-off experience, which results in depression and disappointment.
The more you compare yourself with others and think of how you should have what they have; the more you incubate envy.
Think beyond yourself. Acknowledge and celebrate the workings of God's grace in others. Envy makes the success of others the focus instead of the Lord Jesus. It leaves you in sorrow and makes you not to even acknowledge and be content with what Christ has given you. 4. Love does not parade itselfLove does not force itself to gain recognition. When you begin to feel insecure, you will do everything to be to have the center of attention. You want to be the one to take the stage and be seen by all. That is not love.Jesus said, “The Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life a ransom for many.” (Mt 20: 28) This love is not looking for the attention and the center stage. This love is demonstrating great level of humility. We saw previously how Jesus, washed the feet of His disciples. The word used in king James is, "Vaunteth", its from the Greek word "perpereuomai"; which means a lot of self-talk. In other words, it describes a person who endlessly promotes himself and exaggerates his own virtues.
Love is not braggadocious.
Allow Christ to increase in you. Grow beyond self-occupation and walk in the reality of your love-life. There is so much rest in this love. I hope this blessed you. Let me know how this blessed you in the comment session.DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:26; James 3:16; Romans 12:15-16; Proverbs 10:12; Acts 7:9) WE PRAYThat our hearts will be directed into the love of Christ, that we may not yield ourselves to envy and attention seeking. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 19: Genesis 23-26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I refuse to walk in envy. I am content with what I have.  -I rejoice in the success of others.  -I refuse to be boastful. I walk in the humility of Christ. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 28 - THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Saturday 19th February, 2023THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 3"...love... is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails...." 1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV)  These items Apostle Paul spoke of, were not rules to obey. They are the inward workings of the love of God. Paul (the apostle) provides practical details of how to work the love of God. A careful study of 1 Corinthians chapters 12 and 13 will give you the essential life and focus of the gifts of the Spirit. Many focus on the gifts of the Spirit and not the love of God, which is supplied by the Spirit. The Apostle Paul made some strong statement in 1 Corinthians 13:2"And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing."It is crucial to practice the love of God, towards one another and towards all men. From the previous episodes we looked closely at love being slow to lose patience - it looks for a way of being constructive.We realised that love is never envious nor boils over with jealousy; Love does not brag, it is not ostentatious. In this episode we will concisely discuss the other items Apostle Paul mentioned. 5. Love is not puffed up.To be puffed up, is to be proud. The Greek word is "phusio", which means to be swollen, or to be inflated. This word paints the picture of a person who is filled or blown up with arrogance, haughtiness, superiority. It shows how one behaves snooty, or clannish manner.
When you truly behold the love of Christ, you will be humble.
No pride stands at the foot of the cross of our Lord Jesus. At the cross you see God humbling Himself even unto a shameful death, for the benefit of others which includes you. This doesn't only make us feel loved, it crashes our pride and brings us to our knees. True humility is a product of the revelation of the love of Christ. 6. Love does not behave rudelyTo be rude is to behave unseemingly. It is to be thoughtless, careless and inconsiderate of others. A rude person's actions and words tend to be discourteous, and exhibits bad manners towards others. Beloved, this is not the practice of love.
To behave rudely reveals one is uncaring, insensitive, and unkind.
7. Love does not seek its ownBeloved as you practice the love of Christ, you will not insist on your own way. The scriptures instructs us to serve one another (Galatians 5:15). Those who seek their own cleverly control and influence to steer things in their self interest. They esteem how they feel above how others feel.They are selfish and only think of how others should relate with them. Love considers attentively, gives careful consideration of, perceives clearly, and intensely thinks of others not just oneself. Beloved, these show us how the Holy Spirit directs our hearts daily.
How do you fare when you look into the mirror of God’s Word today?
Do you pass the love test, or have you come up short again? God wants you to exhibit the richness of His love in your life. Remain a blessing to others. Show love to someone today. ShalomDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:26; James 3:16; Romans 12:15-16; Proverbs 10:12; Acts 7:9) WE PRAYThat our hearts will be directed into the love of Christ, that we may not yield ourselves to envy and attention seeking. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 20: Genesis 23-26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I refuse to walk in envy.  -I am content with what I have.  -I rejoice in the success of others.  -I refuse to be boastful.  -I walk in the humility of Christ. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 29 - THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Monday 20th February, 2023THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 4"...love... is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil;" 1 Corinthians 13:5 (NKJV)  It's been an interesting journey as we look more into the practice of love. Note that these things we are discussing from 1 Corinthians 13, are not external laws you are to keep. They are not mere dos and don'ts. They are things you do or don't do, as the love of God captivates your heart.
When the love of God unseats any idol of the heart, His love becomes the focus of your gifts.
Now lets delve more into the items Apostle Paul listed in concerning the practice of love. We've looked at seven (7) points so far. 8. Love is not provokedIt means to not exasperate or not easily stirred with or aroused to anger “ or “a sudden outburst. Love is not easily goaded, because of its virtue of patience. As long as you interact with people, there will be times when someone's speech or attitude may seem to irritate or provoke you to anger. But you have to cultivate the love of God at work in you. Deploy the virtue of patience. Exercise control over the situations; for that is your defence "Like a city that is broken into and without walls is a man who has no control over his spirit" (Proverbs 25:28) James the apostle shows us the way out of situations where we will be provoked. "This you know, my beloved brethren.
