But everyone must be quick to hear, slow to speak and slow to anger" (James 1:19). We see Christ showing us this example of handling, controlling and dissolving such exasperating situations.Isaiah in his prophecy, declared concerning Christ:"He was oppressed and He was afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth; like a lamb that is led to slaughter, and like a sheep that is silent before its shearers, so He did not open His mouth." (Isaiah 53:7; See the fulfilment in John 19:8-10)
Beloved, let's be like Christ as His love is poured in our hearts.
9. Love thinks no evilThe greek word the writer used here is, "Logizomai", which means, To reckon, compute, calculate, count over.to take into account, or make an account of something. To deliberately take recordsby reckoning up all the reasons, to meditate onto suppose, deem, or judge.Love takes no record,compute, calculate, nor judge wrongs. "In other words, it was through the Anointed One that God was shepherding the world, not even keeping records of their transgressions , and he has entrusted to us the ministry of opening the door of reconciliation to God." 2 Corinthians 5:19 (The Passion Translation). This is how God demonstrated His love towards us. He doesn't reckon our wrongs. You emulate this by not keeping records of the wrongs others do. The more you act this way the more you grow in the practice of the love of God in you.
The love of God is like an ocean, no amount of wrongs can dry it up.
This week and this day, demonstrate the unconditional love of Christ to any one that comes in contact with you. Remain a blessing to others. ShalomDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 14:29; Proverba 16:32; Eccclesiastes 7:9;Psalm 32:1; 2 Timothy 4:16) WE PRAYThat we shall demonstrate the love of Christ to others in every situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 21: Genesis 31-34 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-The love of God is at work in me.  -I excercise the quality of Christ's love.  -I keep no records of wrong.  -I maintain an undisturbed composure.  -No matter the matter I refuse to be easily provoked to anger.  -My tongues is seasoned.  -I know when to speak.  -I speak with love and act without being judgemental. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 30 - THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday 21st February, 2023THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 5"Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails..." 1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV)  We have already looked at nine (9) items Paul mentioned in the opening verses above.We touched on:1. Love suffers long.2. Love is Kind.3. Love does not envy.4. Love does not parade itself.5. Love is not puffed up.6. Love does not behave rudely.7. Love does not seek its own.8. Love is not provoked.9. Love thinks no evil. Remember, these things are not laws listed to demand our obedience. These are things we demonstrate because the love of Christ is poured in our hearts. These are expressions of "Agape". We often talk about love as a choice, however, these are more than choices. These are fruits of love at work in us. There are times you have to make a decision or a choice. However, there are situations you may not have the luxury of time to choose. This is why you allow the love of Christ to fully dominate your heart through continuous delight in the Lord. When you set your delight and affection on the Lord, you are easily compelled by the Lord to practice and demonstrate His love in every situation. You do it according to the capacity of His love poured into you. Beloved, the love of God is more than a choice or decision.
The love of God is a strong force within you.
The next point makes it more intense as well. 10. Love does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in truth. Just as love keeps no record of wrong; love does not rejoice in the iniquity of others. It means love takes no delight in wrong, whether it is found in others or in us. As you are induced with the love of God, yours is to continually foster the victory of truth in a world full of malignant pleasure.Beloved, it is in apposition of the truth of God in us, to rejoice over a trouble or negative situation which happens to someone you don't like.  Firstly, why should there be someone you don't like? You may not like what people do wrongly, but there hould be no one you don't like. You may not keep company with the wicked, but don't create any space in your heart where there is someone you don't like. Love and like all men.
Nevertheless, rejoice only over what is honest.
Don't seek for evil to happen to others.  If there should be anything you rejoice over, rejoice over what is true, good and honest. Don't rejoice when people who hurt you or wrong you are also wronged.  Our Lord Jesus never sought for evil to happen to those who acted wickedly towards Him.  11. Love bears all things."To bear" means, to roof over, the Greek word is stegō; it also means to cover silently and endure patience. It means to protect.
Love is a safe place of shelter.
You must be a haven of rest to anyone that comes in contact with you. You carry the burdens of others without giving up. Love doesn't say I have done enough. It endures patiently to remain as a shelter and to provide protection to others.  “Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of sins” 1 Peter 4:8 (ESV). Love does not promulgate the imperfections, mistakes, wrongs, faults, and negativity of others. Love conceals the wrongs of others and provides needed help of change without making noise.  12. Love believes all things Greek word for believe is, pisteuō, which means to trust in something. This is a practice of love. The usage of believe is not a one time thing. To believe is a continous entrusting of one's faith or confidence in the other.It's like you never stop believing in the best of others and in every situation. Even when people give up on themselves, you maintain a strong believe in them and you supply relentless encouragement. This is the love of Christ.
The love of God is not to be blind, ignorant and stupid.
The love of God sees all the wrongs and the negativity in situations. However, it sees a better way to terminate the wrongs and to bring to life, the beauty and the glory in others. 13. Love hope all things Hope is the backbone of our believe, the Greek word is, elpizō, it depicts the expectation of good things.It is to maintain the anticipation that glorious things are going to happen. This is the God kind of love. This is the stretch of love. Someone asked, didn't God know that man may betray and disobey Him? God knew, yet He trusted man with His dominion. Look at Jesus (who is God made flesh), ate with Judas even though He knew he was going to betray Him. Jesus knew Peter was going to deny Him as well, yet He never gave up on Him. Interestingly, a lot of people think Jesus was going to give up on Judas. NO PLEASE! If Judas was alive, Jesus would have gone to show Himself to Him and touched Him with His love. Jesus reached out to Peter specifically, and touched Him with His love. (Mark 16:7). These things I write to you are not things I have not experienced. To some degree both as a born again, and as a servant of my Lord Jesus, called into this ministry of the Lord, I have been stretched and tested on this path of love several times. I write these with tears of joy. Hallelujah. Knowing that, by the empowering ability of the love of Christ, I have become a shelter of love to many, refused to rejoice in the defeats of those who wronged me, believed and had great hope in those I lead despite their faults.  Love people even as they speak evil of you. Be like Jesus, for His love is poured out into you. There were times I was accused of contributing to "evil" by trusting in some leaders who made some mistakes. Meanwhile, those making accusations also had their wrongs and were still roofed in the ministry. Even our Lord was accused of eating with sinners. (Matthew 9:10-17; Mark 2:15-22; Luke 5:29-39). Beloved, Jesus showed us how to love no matter the wrongs. This, you should continue to do as you have also been loved by the Lord. Glory to GodShalomDIG DEEPER( Hebrews 1:9; Psalm 45:7; Galatians 6:1-10; Acts 20:35; John 21:20-25) WE PRAY- That that Lord supplies with great help that our hearts will not rejoice in the failures of others who wrong us.   - That we will relentlessly believe in others, see beyond their errors and continue to be a haven of hope irrespective of their faults. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 22: Genesis 35-38 DECLARE THESE WORDS: The love of God is relentlessly at work in me. I am a home of love to many. I expect good things in people. I believe and encourage people no matter their mistakes. I don't promulgate bad news of others. I am empowered by the love of Christ daily. I am an example of hope to many. Thank you Lord for making me and expression of love to all men. Hallelujah.

title: EPISODE 31 - THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday 22nd February, 2023THE PRACTICE OF LOVE 6"Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails..." 1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV)  The knowledge of Christ is the communication of the truth of God. Anything in God you want to experience and enjoy is packaged in Christ.The only way to demonstrate God, is to receive Christ. Christ in you, is all of God's essence dispensed into you.
You cannot demonstrate the love of God outside Christ.
Christ is the embodiment and the revelation of the love of God. The love of God which is fully revealed through Christ is poured into our hearts, by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5). Now with the love of Christ in your heart, you have the endless stream of love within you, to nourish others.You don't have to try to be patient, kind, bear all things, believe all things and hope all things. You don't have to attempt not to envy, not to parade yourself, not to behave rudely, not to think evil, not to be easily provoked and not to behave rudely.You practically demonstrate these things because the love of God is already in your heart. Now let's look at the remaining practical items of love mentioned in the opening scripture. 14. Love endures all thingsHave you ever been in a place and felt or thought to yourself: "This is where I know God wants me to be. I have done all I could, I have not been appreciated, I am overburdened and there are too much more expectations for me, therefore, I quit or want to quit." You are not alone. There are many more people who might have had that thought or made such decisions before. But there is something that makes the difference in other instances, THE LOVE OF GOD. To ENDURE is from the Greek word, hupomenō, this is a compound word, hupo (means under) and menō (means stay). Thus, hupomenō, means to stay under. It also means to remain even as you bear great trials; to have fortitude and to persevere. Interestingly, it also has the characteristic to endure patiently and to tarry behind. It depicts steadfastness and constancy; It is a quality that makes progress against a trial, rather than merely waiting for a moment to jump out of a difficult challenge.
To endure all things means you don't and cannot be swerved from a definite accurate purpose.
This is what the Love of God is. Concerning our Lord Jesus, it was not just in Gethsemane, he endured the decision of His death on the cross, for all men. All through His lifetime on earth, He had to persevere and remain steadfast even unto His death. It was a battle of Love.
Love does not quit.
From the revelation thoughts in 1 Corinthians chapter 12 into 13, I can ask you this question, will you remain in your service to the Lord and to the brethren, even when you have not had the opportunity to "showcase" your gift? Most people fail even in the season of their ministerial training just by not exercising the STAYING POWER of the Love of Christ. You quit because it has always been about you and not truly the Love of Christ at work in you. You quit because of what you seek to gain, (the fame, the praise of men, the self pleasure, etc). Beloved, the secret to having the ability to remain steadfast in your walk with God and fellowship with the brethren, is not merely to have a strong mind.
The secret is the GOD KIND OF LOVE.
Do you now see how God doesn't give up on you? His love is steadfast, it endures forever!Oh glory to God. As you practice the love of God, you don't quit nor throw in the towel even when you are under a heavy load. You refuse to move regardless of the pressure or inconvenience.Beloved, remain steadfast in your love towards the saints. 15. Love never failsAs this statement is true, it is not speaking of your self-generated love. Any kind of love apart from the Love of God fails. The only kind of love which cannot fail is the GOD-KIND OF LOVE. To say love never fails, means, it cannot be inefficient and it is endless.After all things have ended, the greatest thing, which will remain is LOVE. (1 Corinthians 13:13). This God-kind of Love exists as perpetual as God is; for God is LOVE (1 John 4:8)This is why all through our discussion I have emphasized on the truth that, you can only love by the empowering ability of the God-kind of love poured into you. Your self-generated love is imperfect. It's just like that of Peter, who denied Jesus. He boasted in his love for Jesus. He said, "Lord I will lay down my life for your sake". But that love was not an outflow of the love of Christ. It was his "selfish-love" which couldn't stand the test of time. Yep! He denied Jesus three times. (John 13:30-38; John 18:25-27).This was even after Jesus had spoken of the new commandment, "...as I have loved you, love one another" (John 13:34). Right there in John 13, we see the difference between the Love of God revealed in Christ and the love of man revealed in Peter. But after the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, on the day of Pentecost; Peter stood before the multitudes who were mocking their experience of the Spirit, ministered to them and got 3000 people saved. He declared the love and the power of Jesus to these multitudes, yet before the death of Jesus, he denied the Lord Jesus, three times.
This is the compelling force of love of God in Christ.
The only love which cannot fail is the love of God in Christ. Thanks be to God that now we have the ability to love as Christ loves us. God has poured His love into us through the Spirit, that, He can spill-out His love through us unto others. The question is, are you loving others as you love yourself?That will fail...!!!
What cannot fail is, LOVING OTHERS AS CHRIST HAS LOVED YOU.
You don't love people by what you like or don't like. You don't love people according to your own preference.You love others according to the LOVE OF CHRIST IN YOU. This is the love which cannot and never fails. The most significant thing, dear one in the Lord, is not your talent, your gift nor skill.The most significant thing in your life in Christ is THE LOVE OF GOD. How do you receive and enjoy His love? How do you love the Lord? And how are you demonstrating His love towards others? This love of God in Christ is supernatural, high-level love which never fails.This divine love is already in you as a life-changing river of love; allow it to flow forth from you to others. Glory to God. "Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain" (1 Corinthians 15:58) Shalom DIG DEEPER (John 13:30-38; John 18:25-27; Psalm 118:1-29; Psalm 136; Lamentations 3:22-24; ) WE PRAY - Lord thank you that your love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things, and that your love never fails in us. -That we may be steadfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord and the expression of His love in us towards others. - Our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God, even our Father, which has loved us, and given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace, comfort our hearts, and establish us in the consistency of demonstrating His love towards one another no matter the burdens. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 23: Genesis 39-41 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-This love of God that has been shed abroad in my heart never quits, never surrenders, and never gives up on other people. -I bear all things, believe all things, hope all things, and endure all things! -The love of God in my heart compels me to strain forward with all the might of Christ in me, to believe the very best in every situation and the best about every person. Hallelujah!!

title: EPISODE 32 - REMAIN STEADFAST IN LOVE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Thursday 23rd February, 2023 REMAIN STEADFAST IN LOVE 1“May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the steadfastness of Christ.” 2 Thessalonians 3:5 (ESV)  It is one thing to come into awareness of a matter, it is another thing to grow in the knowledge of truth. To come into knowledge is to become one with a reality. In the spirit, knowledge is richer and deeper than mental assent. Knowledge is a participation in truth. We have seen some details of the Love of God, from Episode 10 to Episode 31.We have seen God's Love Language, how you are loved by Jesus, how to love Jesus, Jesus as our pattern of love, the new commandments of Jesus, how and what it means to keep His commandments, the intimacy of the love of Jesus, some further details on how to love one another, and then we even looked at some practical items of love. These things we have discussed are not abstract at all. These are hardcore realities in God. It is the truth of God which harmonizes and upholds everything in the universe. At the end of all things, we shall see His love as the conceptual force, the onrush and the acme of God's eternal purpose. "And above all these put on love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony" Colossians 3:14
The highest demonstration and mark of maturity of all things is LOVE, and that we experience true HARMONY.
See how its put in The Passion Translation: "For love is supreme and must flow through each of these virtues. Love becomes the mark of true maturity." (Colossians 3:14). Jesus showed us this love.After all things had come to its peak, what still remains and stands as the greatest is LOVE.(1 Corinthians 13:13). Beloved, our Lord Jesus is the embodiment of the greatest love. The greatest demonstration of the Love of God in the universe, the Kingdom and all eternity is Jesus. No dominion, no power, no entity has measured up to show the great magnitude, of the astonishment of God's love in all its extravagant dimensions.
Our Lord Jesus brought to light the endless love, beyond measurement (the breadth, length, depths and the heights) which transcends all understanding.
Listen, when John the Apostle, Prophetically saw into the spirit, he beheld an intriguing activity of eternity.One of the chapters of the Bible which reveals what delights and thrills the heart of the whole universe. Patiently Look at this: "And I saw that the one seated on the throne was holding in his right hand an unopened scroll with writing on the inside and on the outside, and it was sealed with seven seals. Then I saw an incredibly powerful angel proclaiming with a great, loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seven seals?” But no person could be found, living or dead, in all of creation—no one was worthy to open the scroll and read its contents."So I broke down weeping with intense sorrow, because there was found no one worthy to break open the scroll and read its contents.(Revelation 5:1-4, TPT) From the above scripture we see the brokeness of heart in all of the universe. None could open the seals. There was none to enable all creation to access the scrolls. See the GOODNEWS:"Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop weeping. Look! The mighty Lion of Judah’s tribe, the root of David—he has conquered! He is the worthy one who can open the scroll and its seven seals.”(Revelation 5:5). This clearly speaks of Our Lord Jesus. However, Jesus did not demonstrate the immeasurable, endless fullness of the Love of God only as the Lion of Judah. To demonstrate the extravagant dimensions of God's Love, He has to be the young Lamb of God. John the baptist saw Him and said," Here is the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world " (John 1:29). Jesus was not only recognized as the lamb of God when He entered time. He is also the Lamb of God in all eternity. See what John the apostle, saw:" Then I saw a young Lamb standing in the middle of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders. He appeared to have been slaughtered but was now alive! He had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out to the ends of the earth." (Revelation 5:6) You see here that, the death of Jesus, as a slaughtered lamb, is a real matter in eternity. This is why an attempt to oppose the truth of His death in time, is to steal your eternal essence and joy. The death and resurrection of Jesus, is not just goodnews for us in time. This is the greatest news in the universe.If one thinks, John the apostle wasn't speaking of Jesus, see, chapters 1 into 2 of the book of Revelation. Alright let's move on to the glorious news of Love: " I saw the young Lamb approach the throne and receive the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat there. And when the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures saw the Lamb had taken the scroll, they fell facedown at the feet of the Lamb and worshiped him. Each of them had a harp and golden bowls brimming full of sweet fragrant incense—which are the prayers of God’s holy lovers. And they were all singing this new song of praise to the Lamb: “Because you were slaughtered for us, you are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals. Your blood was the price paid to redeem us.You purchased us to bring us to God out of every tribe, language, people group, and nation. You have chosen us to serve our God and formed us into a kingdom of priests who reign on the earth.” (Revelation 5:7-9)  Now we see the premise of being worthy to unlock the prophetic seals; HIS DEATH FOR US.
The death of Jesus is the highest sacrifice of love.
We understood the extent of God's Love through the death of Jesus. " I demand that you love each other as much as I love you. And here is how to measure it—the greatest love is shown when a person lays down his life for his friends" (John 15:12-13 TLB). Beloved, this is it, this is the love the Lord directs our hearts into, as mentioned in the opening verse. This is the steadfastness of Christ's Love.
To remain in His love is to stand firm in the consciousness of this love demonstrated.
And to persevere to walk in the power of this love (which is the GREATEST FORCE OF THE UNIVERSE AND ALL ETERNITY). I believe your heart has been enlightened to see the power of the love of Christ.I call you blessed. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(John 10:11,15; Romans 5:6-8; Ephesians 5:2; Revelation 6:1; 1 Thessalonians 1:3; Galatians 5:6; 1 Corinthians 13:11-13) WE PRAY- That we will grow in the knowledge of the immeasurability, and endlessness of the Love of Christ. - That we shall remain in the fullness of the Love of christ which is poured into is, that through us many will share in this glorious love which is the greatest news of the universe. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 23: Genesis 42-44 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I demonstrate the greatest force of the universe which is love. -All things harmonizes through me wherever I go, because I walk in love. -I have seen the greatness of the death of Jesus, and many are satisfied through me, as I share this love with them. -I walk and remain in the love of Christ. -My heart is directed towards the love of Christ more and more. -I am an agent of the love of Christ. Hallelujah!!

title: EPISODE 33 - REMAIN STEADFAST IN LOVE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author  Friday 24th February, 2023REMAIN STEADFAST IN LOVE 2"As the Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love." John 15:9 (NKJV)  We have seen the extensiveness and the intensity of the Love of Christ, through all eternity; from the previous episode.(Yet, there is more to behold in the love of Christ). Christ is the embodiment of the fullness of the Love of God. He is inseparable of the Love of God. When you come into Christ, you have come into the beautiful multi-dimensional realm of His love. This immeasurable and incomprehensible love of Christ is poured into us by the Holy Spirit.Thus, we are mingled with His love. This is not designed only for our enjoyment. This love is to become our expression.Nevertheless, your continuous expression of the love of Christ, is dependent on how you abide in Him. The word abide, is from the Greek word, menō, which means, to continue, dwell, remain or stand steadfastly, to endure, to be present and tarry.We have the unforceful responsibility to actively remain steadfast in Him.
To abide in Christ, is to essentially receive and trust all that the Father is for Christ.
It is to steadfastly delight in Christ's love and joy towards the Father and His family.You don't turn away from the love of Christ. You are intrinsically satisfied only in Christ. This is crucial for your fruit-bearing in Christ.The goal of our Lord Jesus (to have you remain steadfast in Him) is that, you will become fruitful as He is. " I am the true Vine, and My Father is the vinedresser...Remain in Me, and I [will remain] in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself without remaining in the vine, neither can you [bear fruit, producing evidence of your faith] unless you remain in Me " John 15:1,4 (Amplified Bible)
To remain in His love, is to stand firm in the consciousness of His love. And to persevere to walk in the power of His love.
This is how faith finds meaning and validation.The more you remain and behold the love of Christ, the more you are supplied with the richness of God's grace.This produces in you an unwavering faith of God. Faith is our response to the supply of God's love in us.Faith works through love. (Galatians 5:6)Faith is having full confidence in who God is, what He has said and the might of His power. You please the Lord when Faith finds expression through love.No wonder Paul had to pray for the brethren in Ephesus concerning this: "And I pray that he would unveil within you the unlimited riches of his glory and favor until supernatural strength floods your innermost being with his divine might and explosive power.Then, by constantly using your faith, the life of Christ will be released deep inside you, and the resting place of his love will become the very source and root of your life." Ephesians 3:16-17 (TPT). See the verses 17-18 in Amplified version: "May Christ through your faith [actually] dwell (settle down, abide, make His permanent home) in your hearts! May you be rooted deep in love and founded securely on love.That you may have the power and be strong to apprehend and grasp with all the saints [God’s devoted people, the experience of that love] what is the breadth and length and height and depth [of it]"
Being rooted in Christ, empowers you strongly to apprehend and handle the multifaceted dimensions of love.
You are rooted and grounded in love, by these:1. By filling your heart and head with the truth of Christ and the demonstration of His love. 2. By the strengthening of the Spirit in your inner man so that Christ dwells (manifestly) in your heart by faith. I call you blessed. ShalomDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:21-22; Colossians 1:23; Luke 6:48) WE PRAY- That Christ would unveil within us the unlimited riches of His glory and favor until supernatural strength floods our innermost being with His divine might and explosive power. - That Christ will be more and more at home in our hearts, living within us as our trust in him. May our roots go down deep into the soil of God’s marvelous love. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 24: Genesis 45-47 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I grow deep in the marvelous love of Christ. -I remain and abide in His love. -My heart is set on the the glory of His love as, I demonstrate His love to many -I am mingled with Christ in love. -I bear much fruits by the effective workings of His love and faith in me. Hallelujah!!

title: EPISODE 34 - ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Saturday 25th February, 2023 ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 1"My Father is glorified and honored by this, when you bear much fruit, and prove yourselves to be My [true] disciples." John 15:8 (NKJV)  At the eve of the arrest and death of Our Lord Jesus, He shared some heartfelt realities with His disciples. These things unveiled, the core of His intentions, His desire or burden, His tack and divine probity. We have touched on some few of them in previous episodes.In "Remain Steadfast In Love 2", I stated explicitly that, the love of God, is not designed only for your enjoyment. This love is to become your expression. And the goal of our Lord Jesus (to have you remain steadfast in Him) is that, you will become fruitful as He is.Before our Lord Jesus addressed the virtue of keeping His commandments, He made this profound statement: " Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me, the works that I do he will do also; and greater works than these he will do, because I go to My Father." John 14:12 (NKJV). 
Those who delight and trust in the Lord, are to do as He did and even do much more.
The immeasurable supply of the love of God and the ability of the Spirit within us, are intended to enable us bear much fruits.This was the hope of the death of Jesus: " Jesus replied that the time had come for him to return to his glory in heaven, and that “I must fall and die like a kernel of wheat that falls into the furrows of the earth. Unless I die I will be alone—a single seed. But my death will produce many new wheat kernels—a plentiful harvest of new lives." John 12:23-24 (The Living Bible) The way for Jesus to multiply Himself was not to continue to live as "the Word made flesh". He has to die to achieve a plentiful harvest of new lives. His death was as a seed sown into the ground. Thus, in His death, He did not just resurrect as an individual person. Our Lord in resurrection, became a corporate being. In His walk on earth, He was the "only begotten Son" (John 3:16); and when He resurrected, He brought many sons to glory (Hebrews 2:10; Romans 8:29). Which means, you are THE FRUIT OF JESUS' death. And He did not just make you His fruit, you are also A FRUIT-BEARER IN CHRIST. Hallelujah!!DIG DEEPER(John 15; John 5:20; Psalm 92:12-15; Isaiah 43:21) WE PRAYThat we may function daily as the fruits and the fruit-bearers of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 25: Genesis 48-50 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I am not ordinary.  -I am a fruit of Jesus' death. -In His death and resurrection, I was harvested in the spirit by the Lord. -I am a fruit of Christ.He laboured in His death to harvest me, in His resurrection. -I am fruitful as He is. Hallelujah.

title: EPISODE 35 - ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Sunday 26th February, 2023ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 2"My Father is glorified and honored by this, when you bear much fruit, and prove yourselves to be My [true] disciples." John 15:8 (NKJV) Within every fruit, there is a seed. And as fruits of Christ, we have the ability or the seed to also bear fruits and to multiply. Unfruitfulness is not a quality in God. God designed every organism to be fruitful.We see this even in Eden after God has made man. "Then God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth and govern it..." Genesis 1:28 (NLT). Again, after the flood in the days of Noah,"Then God blessed Noah and his sons and told them, “Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth." Genesis 9:1 (NLT).
Fruit-bearing is preeminent in God's eternal plan and purposes.
After Jacob encountered God, and He changed his name from Jacob to Israel, the Lord God, blessed Jacob with the ability to be fruitful. "And God said to him, “I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations shall come from you, and kings shall come from your own body." Genesis 35:11 (ESV). God in the structure of His economy, has designed a system for fruitfulness and multiplication. Now understand that, to be blessed, also means to be enabled, empowered, to invoke or make one achieve a glorious intention.Which means, God doesn't demand fruitfulness, He supplies you with the ability and the needed resources to be fruitful. "I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless" John 15:5 (TPT)
The blessing we need to bear fruits is the Lord Himself.
As we are in union with Christ, we have the source and endless supply of ability to bear fruits. The Lord wants us to bear fruits, for in that, the Father is glorified. Nevertheless, we don't generate the ability to bear-fruits. We don't look for our own means to bear-fruits. He is our source, and means of fruit-bearing. As disciples of Jesus, we are also His branches, as He is the vine.Branches are supplied with nutrients (dissolved minerals) and water from the soil, by the Vine. In fruit-bearing, you reproduce what has been produced in you, by your source. A mango tree is not designed to produce pomegranate fruit. Neither will you expect to have an olive fruit, from a fig tree.
The fruits we bear, are the fruits He bore, that the Father will be glorified.
This is refreshing; we are not to be bear fruits for our own glory, we are to bear fruits unto the glory of the Father.  Since your fruit-bearing is unto the glory of the Father, He works in partnership with you to bear abundant fruits. Hallelujah!!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 60:21; Isaiah 61:3; John 5:20;) WE PRAYThat the ability of God will increase in us more and more as we bear fruits abundantly. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 26: Exodus 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I am connected to Christ. -I don't lack divine supply and ability. -I bear much more fruits unto the glory of God. -I am blessed by the Lord to be fruitful. -My fruits glorify the Father. -I am a true disciple of Jesus because I bear much fruits. Hallelujah.

title: EPISODE 36 - ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 3
content:
By Benjamin Nana Amissah Ansah Download PDF MACHAIRA(Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Scriptures for your daily meditation.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Monday 27th February, 2023 ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 3 "My Father is glorified and honored by this, when you bear much fruit, and prove yourselves to be My [true] disciples." John 15:8 (NKJV) Beloved, Christ is our Vine, we are His branches. As His branches, He has entrusted us with the responsibility to bear much fruits. Fruit-bearing is essential in God's program.
God's eternal purpose is fulfilled by the fruits we bear.
And God has not just left us to ourselves to bear our own fruits. He worked Himself through Christ to become our Life and Supply. He is now our source, supplying us with all that is needed to make us fruitful.  We have the responsibility to reproduce what He has produced in us, according to His power within us. Take note:
Bearing much fruits corroborates us as disciples of Jesus.
To bear much fruits, means to bring forth plenteous, large and abundant fruits (the Greek word is, polus/polos). Fruit-bearing is our call and design. It is unto this purpose our Lord and Saviour Jesus chose us. " You didn’t choose me. I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit... " John 15:16 (NLT). What is the core essence of a BRANCH if not to bear much fruits? This is our ordination by God, that we bear much fruits. " For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us]. " Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified Bible). The Lord made us, and programmed us with the right system to make us fruitful. This is your set time to be fruitful. And you are not to just bear fruits, you must bear much fruits. Make a decision today to bring forth much fruits, to the glory of God the Father. HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 27:6; Ezekiel 36:8,10; Isaiah 4:2; Isaiah 35:1-2;) WE PRAYThat we will unceasingly grow to understand the extent by which the Lord chose us and to fulfill the mandate of bearing much fruit.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 26: Exodus 4-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I am chosen by God to bear fruits. -I have the divine ordination and enablement, therefore I have what it takes to be fruitful. -I bring forth much more fruit every where I go. -My roots grow deep in Christ, and I bring forth Christ-centred fruits. Hallelujah.

title: EPISODE 37 - ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday 28th February, 2023ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 4"My Father is glorified and honored by this, when you bear much fruit, and prove yourselves to be My [true] disciples." John 15:8 (NKJV) From our previous discussion, we realised, bearing much fruits is the ordination of every disciple of Jesus. We don't bear fruits to become disciples of Jesus. As disciples of Jesus, we are fruit bearers. From the opening verse, we noticed, fruit-bearing is an essential part of Kingdom discipleship. A critical factor to consider: " My Father is glorified and honored by this, when you bear much fruit..." John 15:8
You don't bear-fruits for your fame. When you bear much fruits, the Father is glorified and honored in you.
The vital goal of man is to glorify God. In my teachings and writings, I keep emphasing on this: That God has given us His life and become our inward supply for our enjoyment. And we are His expression. Beloved, as we express God and His Life, many see His glory and honor. See what Jesus said in His prayer: " I have glorified You on the earth by completing the work You gave Me to do." John 17:4 (Holman Bible). Our Lord Jesus lived to glorify the Father. He showed us what should be the preeminent essence of our actions.
Whatever we do in the Kingdom, they are chiefly to bring glory and honor to God.
" Whoever speaks [to the congregation], is to do so as one who speaks the oracles (utterances, the very words) of God. Whoever serves [the congregation] is to do so as one who serves by the strength which God [abundantly] supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified [honored and magnified] through Jesus Christ, to whom belongs the glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen. 1 Peter 4:11 (Amplified Bible). Whatever we do (including what we eat and drink), must be done unto God's glory. (1 Corinthians 10:31). It shouldn't just be about our benefits. Our motive of service to God and bearing of fruits should be rooted in bringing Glory to God alone (not to make any man famous, or to satisfy our selfish desires or ambitions).  This was what the Reformers called, Soli Deo Gloria. The phrase Soli Deo Gloria (is a latin phrase) originated out of Protestant Reformation that took place in Europe (in 16th and 17th century). They sought to reform or correct some perceived doctrinal corruption against the gospel of our Lord Jesus, within the Church.  Soli Deo Gloria is part of the five phrases of beliefs the Reformers clung to, called the Five Solas (Sola means "Alone"). These five statements became the slogans of the Reformation. Which are:Sola Scriptura (“Scripture alone”), Sola Fide (“faith alone”), Sola Gratia (“grace alone”), Solus Christus (“Christ alone”), and Soli Deo Gloria (“to the glory of God alone”). Together, they state that we are saved by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone, with God’s Word alone as the highest authority, for the glory of God alone.
All things in Christ are for God's glory alone.
Through our fruits bearing, many develop God-admiring thoughts, appreciate, adore, develop deep affection towards Him and become totally devoted to God. This does not deny the truth that we have advantages in our service to God. It is to establish our hearts and direct the motive of our deeds toward the GLORY OF THE FATHER. " Every detail works to your advantage and to God's glory: more and more grace, more and more people, more and more praise!" 2 Corinthians 4:15 (MSG). ShalomDIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; Matthew 5:16; John 12:28; John 13:31-32) WE PRAY We pray that in our pursuit to bear much more fruits and service to the Lord shall be by the strength which God [abundantly] supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified [honored and magnified] in us, through Jesus Christ BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 28 Exodus 8-10  DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I am designed to bear much fruits unto the Glory of the Father. -Many adore the Lord and admire the Lord through me. -I am a much more fruit-bearer the Father delights in. -I do nothing for fame. -I serve the Lord unto his glory. -The Lord is glorified in me and through me. -I accomplish all that the Lord tells me to do unto His glory. Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 38 - BEARING THE RIGHT FRUITS 1 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 5)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday 1st March, 2023BEARING THE RIGHT FRUITS 1 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 5)" Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me. I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing." John 15:4-5 (NKJV)  Beloved, anything that is unto God's glory has to be determined and designed by God. Whatever you do, as one called of God, must be according to His pattern and design.  You don't squeeze to create a system of impact which is not programmed by God.It is God who called us to bear much fruit. And our fruit-bearing is unto His glory.Your impact and fruits become mondaine when it is not by God's design and unto God's glory. The fruits you bear must be the fruits our Lord has determined that we bear.
The kind of fruits you bear is according to the kind of Vine; not according to the kind of branch.
One branch of a vine does not bear fig fruits, whiles the other branch of the same vine bears olive fruits. When the Vine is an Olive Tree, it will bear Olive fruits.Therefore, we don't assume the kind of fruit to bear. We must bear the fruits, Christ bore. As we continue in this discussion, we will see: a. exactly the kind of fruits we bear as disciples of Jesus.b. How we can bear much more fruits.c. The quality and longevity of our fruits through Christ. In the opening verses of today's Machaira, we see the Lord instructing His disciples to:Abide In Him... and He who abides in Him, bears much fruits. This reveals how we bear much fruits and also the kind of fruits we are to bear.According to John 15:5, we are the branches.
To be a branch means you are an off-shoot of the Vine. And the Father prunes us to bear much fruits.
The fruits we bear are the out-forming of what the Vine has supplied to us (the branches). The question is, what has the Lord supplied to Us?(Take note, the scriptures are not written in chapters and verses. They were put in chapters and verses for easy reference.) All through John 13 to John 15 we see the Lord, addressing similar things with different expressions. However, each of them transmits new dimension of divine light. To know what the Lord has supplied to us, we must know what it means to abide in the Vine.The Lord Himself tells us what it means to abide in Him in the same chapter of John 15.            See verse 9:" As the Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love "
To abide in the Lord, as the Vine, is also to abide in His love.
This reveals what the Lord has supplied to us, yes, His LOVE. Therefore, the Love of Christ is part of the fruits we bear.The fruits we bear are broad and extensive. Remain in the Vine as we show forth the riches of His love to others. ShalomDIG DEEPER (Galatians 5:22-23; 1 Corinthians 13; 2 Thessalonians 3:5; Matthew 14:14) WE PRAY We pray that as the Lord's branches, our hearts will be touched and fully dominated by His love and compassion, that we will show forth the expressions of His love towards others. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 28 Exodus 11-13  DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I bear the right fruits of Christ. -I am a fruitful Vine in Christ. -I don't bear worldly fruits. -My life is an off-shoot of the love of Christ. -I abide in the love of Christ, and I bear the fruits of love. Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 39 -BEARING THE RIGHT FRUITS 2 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 6)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Thursday 2nd March, 2023BEARING THE RIGHT FRUITS 2 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 6)" Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me. I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing." John 15:4-5 (NKJV) Now we have seen that to abide in Jesus (who is the Vine); means to abide in His love (John 15:9). We've also had some extensive discussion on the Love of Christ and the Practice of Love.
The fruits we bear are the off-shoot of all that Christ has supplied to His branches (the saved ones).
Christ supplied His love to us for our expression. You cannot demonstrate what you have not received. See John 15:10 also; "If you keep my commandments, you will abide in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commandments and abide in his love." What is this commandments in John 15? See verse 12: "This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you." (ESV). As you love one another as Christ has loved you, you are keeping, delighting and esteeming the commandments of the Lord. This then means you are abiding (remaining) in the Lord, when you are loving as Christ has loved you.
To love as Christ, is your fruit bearing. Allow His unconditional love to flow through you to others.
The Love of Christ is an essential part of the fruits we bear. You don't see people as channels to satisfy your selfish desire. You see people as the focus of the love of Christ which is at work in you. This love is the complete reality of our living and walk of the newness of life.Our daily living is a fruit of love. Which fruit of the love of Christ have you bore today? (Read all the previous episodes on God's Love Language, for rich understanding on this matter - God's Love Language 1 -   God's Love Language 12 ) The more you focus and delight in the Lord, the more you are pruned by the Father, to show forth His perfect love to others. Let the Father be glorified in you as you bear much more fruits. Shalom.DIG DEEPER (John 15:10-12; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 1:5-8) WE PRAY We pray that we shall bountifully bear fruits of love in our daily walk. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 29 Exodus 14-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I will not grow weary in the understanding of the love of Christ. -I bear the fruits of love greatly. -I am the embodiment of the love of Christ. -I take delight in the Lord more and more as I bear fruits to the glory of the Father. -I am an example of the love of Christ. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 40 - BEARING THE RIGHT FRUITS 3 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 7)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Friday 3rd March, 2023BEARING THE RIGHT FRUITS 3 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 7) "I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing." John 15:5 (NKJV)  From the Abundant Fruit-Bearers 1, we realized the death of Jesus was not just to terminate sin. It was also for the germination of FRUIT-BEARERS. The love-life of Christ in us, is also an empowerment of ability and extravagant resources to be fruitful. The Lord has given us Himself as the blessing we need to be fruitful. (See ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 2).The fruits we bear are the fruits Christ bore and must be unto God's glory. (See Part 3 and 4). Our Lord Jesus did not just demonstrate love. He also bore the fruits of Salvation, through His love. The fruits Christ bore includes, His love for others and Saving the lost. As disciples of Jesus, fruit-bearing is essential in our walk with Him.If truly we are bearing the fruits of His love; it must move us to also reproduce salvation in others.
Reaching out to the lost and getting them saved is great fruitfulness.
To save the lost also means, to harvest lost souls or to turn many unto righteousness. It takes an intense compassion to see and to reach out to the unsaved.Look at what Jesus said, "When he saw the vast crowds of people, Jesus’ heart was deeply moved with compassion,because they seemed weary and helpless, like wandering sheep without a shepherd. He turned to his disciples and said, “The harvest is huge and ripe! But there are not enough harvesters to bring it all in" Matthew 9:36-37 (TPT). When Jesus saw the crowd, He didn't just see mere people, He saw them to be fruits which can be harvested for the Lord. See also in John's Gospel chapter 4:35-36: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to completely finish His work. Do you not say, ‘It is still four months until the harvest comes?’ Look, I say to you, raise your eyes and look at the fields and see, they are white for harvest. Already the reaper is receiving his wages and he is gathering fruit for eternal life; so that he who plants and he who reaps may rejoice together." (Amplified Bible) Our Lord speaks of the gathering of fruit for eternal life.Compare the verse 36 of Amplified and The Passion Translation: " And everyone who reaps these souls for eternal..." Instead of fruits for eternal, we see souls for eternal life in other translations.Let's read it from The Living Bible: " Do you think the work of harvesting will not begin until the summer ends four months from now? Look around you! Vast fields of human souls are ripening all around us, and are ready now for reaping. The reapers will be paid good wages and will be gathering eternal souls into the granaries of heaven! What joys await the sower and the reaper, both together!" John 4:35-36. This is even explicit.
The fruits we are to bear are also the harvest (or salvation) of souls for eternal life.
Jesus found His nourishment in doing and accomplishing the work of the Father who sent Him (John 4:35).  Now as the Father sent Him, He has also sent us (John 20:21). He chose us and ordained us to go forth to bear much fruits (John 15:16). Beloved, be a FRUIT-BEARER today.DIG DEEPER (Mark 6:34; Matthew 10:6; 15:24; Romans 1:13; Proverbs 11:30) WE PRAY That this day, our hearts shall open to see the distress of the lost souls within our sphere (workplaces, schools, neighborhood) and that we shall passionately reach out and gather them as eternal souls for the Kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 31: Exodus 17-19 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I am a passionate soul winner. -I am a great harvester of souls for eternal life. -I am moved with compassion as I see the lost. -I bear much fruits as Christ. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 41 - COMPELLED BY HIS LOVE TO BE FRUITFUL (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 8)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Saturday 4th March, 2023COMPELLED BY HIS LOVE TO BE FRUITFUL (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 8)"I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing." John 15:5 (NKJV)  As part of bearing the fruits of love, we reproduce Salvation in others. When Jesus saw the multitudes, He was not moved with the desire to take advantage of them to be popular or to make money. When He saw the multitudes He was deeply moved with compassion, to see them saved as eternal fruits. As we have seen in the previous episode; the salvation of souls, is included in the fruits we bear and harvest unto the Lord. "Do you think the work of harvesting will not begin until the summer ends four months from now? Look around you! Vast fields of human souls are ripening all around us, and are ready now for reaping. The reapers will be paid good wages and will be gathering eternal souls into the granaries of heaven! What joys await the sower and the reaper, both together!" John 4:35-36.(TLB)
We bear much more fruits by getting more and more people saved.
The fruits we are to bear are also the harvest (or salvation) of souls for eternal life. Jesus ultimately demonstrated His love and saving grace, through His death and resurrection. This was how He bore more fruits (see fruit-bearers Part 1). " In this is love, not that we have loved God but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins." 1 John 4:10 (ESV) This was the work of the Father through Jesus. " For God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself no longer counting people’s sins against them. And he gave us this wonderful message of reconciliation."  2 Corinthians 5:19(NLT)
We also bear more fruits of salvation by preaching this same love of Christ and His saving grace.
This is the wonderful message the Lord has given to us, to the lost and the world.It is the good news of Jesus. We are ordained by God for this purpose (John 15:16). When we deeply come to know the love of God, we will not refrain from sharing His message of love (both in words and in action). The reality of the endless extravagant love of Christ within us, is what governs our hearts to win people to Christ. " For the love of Christ controls and compels us..." Which means, when you are not involved in winning people to Christ, you have not yielded to the compelling force of Christ.
Christ’s radical love expression on the cross was a loving volcano.
This flame of Christ’s compassion for the world has never exhausted itself.  What exploded at the cross is a stream of fire to this day. Let the flame of Christ's love that took Him to the cross burn in your heart today.  Let it take you to the unreached.DIG DEEPER(Romans 9:1-3; Job 32: 17-19; Jeremiah 20:9; Acts 20:24; Romans 10:1) WE PRAYThat we yield and submit to the controlling and compelling force of the love of Christ, to win many more others to Christ.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 31: Exodus 20-24  DECLARE THESE WORDS: -Christ’s radical loving volcano that took Him to the cross is burning in me today. -I am the embodiment of flame of Christ's love. -Christ’s compassion for the world remains inexhaustible in my heart. -Wherever I go, many shall experience what exploded at the cross as a stream of fire. -The love of Christ controls and compels me. -I share the wonderful message of reconciliation with my world. -I finish my course. -I don't count my life, I allow the life of Christ to count in me. -I expand myself for the salvation of others. -This is how I demonstrate love. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 42 - HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED 1 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 9)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Sunday 5th March, 2023HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED 1 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 9)"But a life lived loving God bears lasting fruit, for the one who is truly wise wins souls." Proverbs 11:30 (The Passion Translation). Jesus is God made flesh to dwell among men, as fully man and fully God. He humbled Himself to the cross and died a painful and shameful death. This was essentially by the purpose of His love.Jesus' resurrection, brought forth the newness of life. This life is now the life received and lived by many who believe and receive Him.Which means the newness of life is the product or the fruit of His love. This life also carries His seed of love. And now those who have the newness of life, have the supplied ability of Christ to also bear fruits of love. His love influences you to demonstrate God's wisdom in winning souls.See how the Amplified Bible puts it. "The fruit of the [consistently] righteous is a tree of life, And he who is wise captures and wins souls [for God—he gathers them for eternity" Proverbs 11:30. Soul winning is a demonstration of God's wisdom.Every where you go, you must have the intention to win a soul. That was what Jesus demonstrated. Whenever and wherever He saw the multitudes, He saw the need to win a soul. He had genuine compassion for the lost. (Matthew 9:36-38).In every place you find yourself, the knowledge of Christ must be announced. See what Paul the apostle said, "But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him." 2 Corinthians 2:14 (Berean Standard Bible) We are to diffuse the savour of His knowledge in every place.Let this be your daily experience. You may ask, how do I win a soul? Or How do I get a soul saved? What i will share is not to put you in a box. The Holy Spirit is the Lord of the harvest (Matthew 9:38). His operations through you must not be caged, though we can be guided with some scriptural examples.There are different mediums the Lord can lead and inspire you to reachout to a soul.Moreover, you don't win a soul only by reading. When you read or listen to a teaching, you maybe stirred up to reachout. You only become an effective soul winner by experience. Until you start winning a soul you will not master the skill to get others saved.Now In John 4:5-42We see two examples and approach in Soulwinning.The first was demonstrated through Jesus, Our Master Soulwinner.The second, was by the Samaritan lady. Let's start with the second. 1. Share Your Experience with the People You know. After Jesus got the Samaritan to believe in Him; she left into the city to announce to the men.She said, "Come, see a Man..." (John 4:29). Take Note:1a. She went to her city (Samaria). She didn't start by going to Judea.Go to your immediate sphere. Go to your friends, office colleagues, course mates etc. Go to your relatives. 1b. She went to speak to the men. (John 4:28) From my observation, I suppose she's had more interaction with the men. She's already had five husbands. (John 4:16-18)Start with those you easily interact with or can influence 1c. Be mentally occupied, enthusiastic and hyper or joyful about what the Lord has done for you and in you. Don't be shy or ashamed. For you have the goodnewsShe didn't just leave into the city, she was enthusiastic to the extent that, she left her waterpot. All that was on her mind was her experience with Jesus. (John 4:28) 1d. Convincingly share your deepest testimony or heartfelt experience with as many as you can. Yet keep it simpleShe was so convincing that, many of the Samaritans believed in Jesus, because of the words of her testimony. (John 4:39).1e. Don't only share or get them to believe. Invite them or get them to Church meetings where they can hear more truth and have their personal experience of Jesus. " So when the Samaritans had come to Him, they urged Him to stay with them; and He stayed there two days. And many more believed because of His own word. Then they said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard Him and we know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.” Beloved, reproduce what Christ has produced in you. We are not sent forth by Christ to be sophisticated. We are to only diffuse the very fragrance of Christ.Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Song of Solomon 1:3; Acts 1:8; John 15:27; Matthew 28:19; Romans 1:16) WE PRAYThat we shall skillfully proclaim the testimony of the Lord in our hearts, and many will believe and rejoice in the power of the Lord revealed through us.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 32: Exodus 25-27  DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I diffuse the fragrance of Christ in every place. -I am hyper about Jesus. -I shout His testimony to all men. -Many believe in Jesus through me. -Many respond to the gospel on my lips. -I turn my world upside down with the testimony of Jesus. -I cannot be ashamed of the Gospel of Jesus. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 43 - HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED 2 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 10)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED 2 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 10) "But a life lived loving God bears lasting fruit, for the one who is truly wise wins souls." Proverbs 11:30 (The Passion Translation). Soul winning is a demonstration of God's wisdom and love.It is our duty to bear much fruits (win souls) through the sharing of the gospel. "...for necessity is laid upon me; yes, woe is me if I do not preach the gospel!" (1 Corinthians 9:16) What a sense of responsibility!When you receive the good news of Jesus, don't just keep it to yourself. See it as a responsibility to get others to also receive.The Samaritan at the well (in John 4), did not keep the truth to herself. She went into the city to get many to receive.From episode 42, I began to answer the question:How to win a soul? Or How to get a soul saved? Understand that you don't win a soul only by reading on soul-winning. You must practice soul-winning to gain mastery.From John 4:5-42, there are two main examples of soul-winning.All these examples involved Jesus. Though we see one directly demonstrated by Jesus, and the other through the Samaritan lady.And we've already gleaned some few practical steps from the Samaritan lady.Today, we look at the example of Jesus, our master soul-winner. Jesus did not only see the urgency to win a soul by seeing the multitudes.He preached both to the crowds and also to individuals. Apart from the Samaritan lady, we see Jesus ministering to other individuals throughout the gospels.A. When it comes to soul-winning, you must always have a ready mind. Paul the apostle told Timothy, " preach the word [as an official messenger]; be ready when the time is right and even when it is not [keep your sense of urgency, whether the opportunity seems favorable or unfavorable, whether convenient or inconvenient, whether welcome or unwelcome]..." 2 Timothy 4:2 (Amplified Bible). Our Lord was always ready, irrespective of the condition.B. Have a sense of urgency."But He needed to go through Samaria." John 4:2. It must be done today and now. No room to procrastinate when prompted by the Lord.C. Where you find yourself is the right place.Jesus sat by the well being wearied of His journey. (John 4:6).D. Break down Barriers to win a soul.Jesus broke down existing barriers and the ones she put up.He broke down the barrier of traditional culture, religious differences, race, status and social barrier. (vv 9, 27).Don't allow anything to be a barrier. Break down every barrier by the wisdom of God. Everyone deserves the gospel (Romans 3:22-23).E. Promptly, boldly and warmly initiate a conversation. Don't be reserved and distant. (vv 7).F. Creatively start a conversation with present happenings and circumstance to provide opportunities for soul-winning conversations. (vv 7).Jesus started the conversation by asking a drink and used that to minister to her.You see someone with a beautiful watch, "You have a beautiful watch there". "I know someone who always watch over you, I wish you have a good relationship with Him". You've started a conversation.You see someone with a load of groceries. You quickly help the person out. And you start a conversation leading to the gospel. E.g, "You can also have someone to help you carry the burdens of your heart".G. Keep the message simple, with the focus of your mission. To bring change. The message is the satisfaction of God's love and not condemnation. (vv 10 and 14; 2 Corinthians 5:18-19)H. Avoid arguments. Your goal is to minister life and not to win religious argument. One way you can avoid arguments is to focus on the individual. Administer to his/her need. Be passionate to see the person experience truth and love (vv 23-24).The Holy Spirit speaks through you when your motive is love. He shows you the need to meet in the person. (John 4:16-18; 28-29)DIG DEEPER(John 4; Acts 2:14-39; Acts 8:26-40) WE PRAYThat we will be prompt and bold to skillfully and in all wisdom utilize every opportunity to minister the goodnews of Jesus to all those we meet. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 33: Exodus 28-30 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - The wisdom of God is at work in me.-I take advantage of every opportunity or situation to minister Christ-Many are saved through me.-I have the wisdom to overcome and break all barriers to preach Christ.-I refuse to be timid and intimidated.--I minister with the motive of love.-I speak the right words inspired by the Holy Spirit to get people saved.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 44 - HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED 3 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 11)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED 3 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 11)" Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest..." Matthew 9:38 (Legacy Standard Bible). After Jesus had seen the riped harvest, He asked His disciples to pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest.The prayer maybe focused on the Lord of sending more labourers. Nevertheless, the benefits of prayer goes beyond the answers of prayer. The benefits of prayer includes:- the impartation and impact of prayer in your spirit.- the intensification of your communion with the Lord.Praying to the Lord is also an evidence of trust in the Lord's supply. It proves that you have the willing mind and heart to work with the Lord. Jesus said, "for without me you can do nothing..." (John 15:5) As we pray to the Lord of the harvest; to send more labourers or workers, we are indirectly praying that the Lord will also send us.The first person the Lord wants to send is you. Therefore through prayer, you avail yourself more and more.You are sent forth to the field through prayer. See this:"And while they were ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.” Acts 13:2 (LSB). You cannot be involved in getting souls saved without first being committed to prayer.You must make prayer your daily habit.Set intentional prayer times and you can have spontaneous times to pray as the Lord prompts you.Pray consistently everyday and unceasingly. (1 Thessalonians 5:16).You are able to do that when you set consistent prayer times.Our Lord Jesus, at several occasions in the scriptures prayed all through the night. "And it came to pass in those days, He went out to the mountain to pray, and He was spending the night in prayer to God. Luke 6:12 (Berean Literal Bible) See the following:Mark 6:46"After bidding them farewell, He left for the mountain to pray"Mark 1:35 "In the early morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house, and went away to a secluded place, and was praying there."Matthew 14:23 "After He had sent the crowds away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray; and when it was evening, He was there alone."Luke 5:16 "But Jesus Himself would often slip away to the wilderness and pray." From these scriptures we see the Lord's praying habit.Remember, we are sent to this world as the Father sent Jesus. (John 20:21). What He did we are to do and even greater. (John 14:12).Therefore we cannot pray less. We have to pray more to see much more results.The gospel doesn't just spread because you preach. People don't honour and receive the gospel, just because its powerful. It is through consistent earnest prayers, we cause the gospel to spread and to be honoured. "Finally, brothers and sisters, pray continually for us that the word of the Lord will spread rapidly and be honored [triumphantly celebrated and glorified], just as it was with you;" 2 Thessalonians 3:1 (Amplified Bible) There are also those who persecute and oppose the gospel. They set themselves up not to allow the gospel to spread. The plot wickedly to prevent many to receive the good news of Jesus.We don't wage war through physical means. We win and overcome such opposition through prayer. "and [pray] that we will be rescued from perverse and evil men; for not everyone has the faith. But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you [setting you on a firm foundation] and will protect and guard you from the evil one." 2 Thessalonians 3:2-3 (Amplified Bible). It is not the many words you speak that transforms hearts. It is how your words are saturated with power. (1 Thessalonians 1:5)."...The heartfelt and persistent prayer of a righteous man (believer) can accomplish much [when put into action and made effective by God—it is dynamic and can have tremendous power]." James 5:16 (Amplified Bible) Beloved, PRAY!DIG DEEPER (Luke 18:1; Romans 12:12; Ephesians 6:18; 1 Thessalonians 5:23; ) WE PRAY That we will walk in the discipline of prayer to produce tremendous power for the increase and multiplication of souls. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 34: Exodus 31-33 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am committed to prayer.- I wage war through prayer.- I walk in the discipline of prayer.- I cause the gospel to spread through prayers.- I produce tremendous power for the increase and multiplication of souls through prayer.- Through prayer, I condition the heart of souls.- Though prayer, I saturate my words with power.- My heart is aligned to the perfect will of the Father through prayer.- My heart deeply yearns and pants for the salvation of souls through prayer.- Through prayer, I set myself as a passionate soul winner.- I PRAY persistently, unceasingly and consistently everyday. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 45 - YOU BEAR FRUITS WITH JESUS (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 12)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. YOU BEAR FRUITS WITH JESUS (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 12) " I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing" John 15:5 (NKJV) Jesus did not send into this world to operate without Him.He works within in and through us, just as the Father works in Him and through Him. "So Jesus explained, “I tell you the truth, the Son can do nothing by himself. He does only what he sees the Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son also does." John 5:19 (NLT). This is the reality in the Godhead and the Kingdom.Nothing is done in isolation.All that you see in the universe were made by the harmony of the Godhead. You see that God brought forth the physical world through the operative ability of the Spirit and the Word. (John 1:3; Colossians 1:16; Psalm 104:30; Job 26:13; Genesis 1:2).As the Father sent Him, even so He sent us. Just as the Son does nothing of Himself, even so are we designed by God to do nothing of ourselves.You cannot operate in isolation from our Lord Jesus, if you want to have the God kind of results.You cannot bear fruits as of the Lord, unless you are in vital union with Him.Through the new birth, we are begotten into Christ and made one with Him. "But the one being joined to the Lord is one spirit" (1 Corinthians 6:19) Through the Salvation experience the Lord has become our Vine and we are His branches.This must not just be our doctrine. This must be our life and living. It must be our consciousness.And if we are to bear much fruits, we must intentionally operate in this reality.To have Christ as our Vine, is to have Him as our source. Without Him we cannot bear any fruit.Read John 15:5 again: " I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless." (Passion Translation). By essence we are one with Christ through our new birth in Him. Now by experience we must live and practice our union and absolute dependence in Christ.This is a quality of the matured life in Christ. The more grow deep in the Lord, the more you become dependent on the Lord.This is why we pray, commune with the Holy Spirit and submit to Him.Praying to the Lord is also an evidence of trust in the Lord's supply. It proves that you have the willing mind and heart to work with the Lord.Through prayer, you take hold of Grace to do more (Hebrews 4:16).We don't bear much fruits or achieve great results by our own works and self-efforts. We work and achieve results by the grace of God.Look at work what one of the great apostles of Jesus had to say: "But whatever I am now, it is all because God poured out his special favor on me—and not without results. For I have worked harder than any of the other apostles; yet it was not I but God who was working through me by his grace. 1 Corinthians 15:10 (NLT). Again he said, " We carry this confidence in our hearts because of our union with Christ before God. Yet we don’t see ourselves as capable enough to do anything in our own strength, for our true competence flows from God’s empowering presence " 2 Corinthians 3:4-5 (TPT) The secret and confidence to bear much fruits is not in our own strength, but in our union with Christ and sufficient supply of the Spirit.Beloved, let this be your confidence.You are bearing more fruits.HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Genesis 41:16; Romans 15:18; 2 Corinthians 4:7; 12:9; Exodus 4:10-16; Jeremiah 1:6-10). WE PRAYThat we will enjoy the sufficient supply of God's Spirit and grace to bear and multiply our fruits. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 35: Exodus 34-37 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I bear fruits by the ability of the Supply of Christ.- I am made competent by the empowering presence of God.- I don't operate by my own strength.- I am strengthened by the grace of God to do more.- I refuse to be separated from the Lord.- I live in the union of Christ.- Fruitfulness streams from within me because the Lord is my source.- Every weakness in me is perfected by the Grace of God.-I am greatly helped and resourced by the Lord.Hallelujah!!!

title: Episode 46 - YOUR FRUIT SHOULD REMAIN (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 12)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY (The Love-Life Agency) By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. YOUR FRUIT SHOULD REMAIN (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 12) " You have not chosen Me, but I have chosen you and I have appointed and placed and purposefully planted you, so that you would go and bear fruit and keep on bearing, and that your fruit will remain and be lasting, so that whatever you ask of the Father in My name [as My representative] He may give to you." (John 15:16 Amplified Bible)  The Lord didn't just send us out there to bear fruits. God purposefully planted us to bear much more fruits that will remain and be lasting. We have seen that to bear much fruit includes, loving others and sharing Christ with the lost to get them saved. We are not to just scatter the seeds of Christ's love with others. There is no fruitfulness until the fruits remain on the branches. When a tree bears fruits, the fruits remain on the branches. Fruits are not kept elsewhere apart from the branches. We have seen the importance and the strategies to get a soul saved. All these are not for us to produce scattered results. For saved souls (fruits) to remain in the Vine (the Lord), there is an organic system to engage. To remain in the vine doesn't suggest that a saved soul can be unsaved. To remain in the vine is to continue steadfastly , abide,  dwell, and enjoy the refreshing supply of the vine. Discipleship in the Church is a crucial factor for saved souls to experience growth. True discipleship takes place within the Church. Every soul won must be put under a shepherd for effective and consistent nurturing. We are not designed to operate in isolation from the Lord. We practice our communion with the Lord by how we also commune with the saints. Through the scriptures, we see that anytime souls are won, they are added to the Church. God takes interest in souls being added to the Church. He gets involved in this work as well. "...The whole city was favorable to them, and each day God added to them all who were being saved." Acts 2:47 (TLB). Those who were being saved were not just added as members of the Church and left alone. In the verse 41 to 42 of Acts chapter 2, we see how the  saved souls were involved in discipleship. "And those who believed Peter were baptized—about three thousand in all! They joined with the other believers in regular attendance at the apostles’ teaching sessions and at the Communion services and prayer meetings." Acts 2:41-42 (TLB). Now we see that: 1. They joined with other believers in regular attendance at apostles' teaching meetings. 2. Communion services 3. Prayer meetings. One cannot be a lasting fruit in Christ until he or she is consistent in these meetings. It is not just about attending services on Sundays, but being actively involved in the community of the saints. This determines and influences your growth. See some additional thoughts in the same chapter. "And all the believers met together constantly and shared everything with each other, selling their possessions and dividing with those in need. They worshiped together regularly at the Temple each day, met in small groups in homes for Communion, and shared their meals with great joy and thankfulness" Acts 2:44-46 (TLB).  4. We also see that they shared everything with each other; which is a true expression of love and proof of discipleship. (John 13:14-15). 5. They met in big meetings (gatherings) and also met in small groups. In Christ Commonwealth -Community, we call the small group meetings, Life Connect.  Your souls don't remain as effective fruits just by how they attend main gatherings.
