Their fellowship with Christ is deepened at the small group meetings. Beloved, don't win a soul and ask them to attend a "Bible Believing Church". How can a new soul tell or know a Bible Believing Church? When you win a soul, follow them up to bring them to the Church where you are nurtured and equipped for ministry. Selah  DIG DEEPER (Acts 5:12 ; 14,Acts 1:13-14;Acts 20:7) WE PRAYThe grace to follow up on  new souls to establish them in the Church we are nurtured in .   BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 36: Exodus 38-40 DECLARE THESE WORDS: I bear lasting fruits.My fruits (new souls) remain committed to Christ. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 47 - DISCIPLESHIP, ESSENTIAL IN BEARING FRUITS (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 13)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY (The Love-Life Agency) By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.DISCIPLESHIP, ESSENTIAL IN BEARING FRUITS (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 13)" You have not chosen Me, but I have chosen you and I have appointed and placed and purposefully planted you, so that you would go and bear fruit and keep on bearing, and that your fruit will remain and be lasting, so that whatever you ask of the Father in My name [as My representative] He may give to you." (John 15:16 Amplified Bible) From the previous discussion, we have seen that bearing fruits include establishing the souls in the community of the saints. To establish the newly saved in the community of the saints is not to leave them with the responsibility to choose a "Bible Believing Church". When you get people saved, direct them to a specific Church in their locality where they will be nurtured and raised. It is best to get them to where you are being taught and raised in the consistent knowledge of Christ. Jesus’ command to us in Matthew 28:19-20 says:“ Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” You see here that Jesus didn't only command us to go and get others to believe in Him and accept or receive His life. Jesus' command was focused on making disciples. The people you reach out to must be taught. This is the only way your fruits will remain and last.You first make disciples by getting others saved, andthen you culture and raise them into the full knowledge of Christ.  The purpose of discipleship is so that others can fully function in the body of Christ. A disciple is a person under training. To make disciples is to make students (bringing them up in the Knowledge of Christ). A disciple is a person trained or cultured to be a presentation of the Lord. It is the lifelongprocess of accepting God’s invitation to grow up andmature to the full stature of Christ through a spiritual leader in the Faith, who is sound in the doctrine of Christ.  A disciple is willing and open to be raised, guided, or trained in a specific direction. Unequivocally stating, this is an intentional commitment.  God desires that allmen should be saved and come to the Knowledge of the truth, through consistent discipleship (See 1 Timothy 2:4). Also, it is essential that if Christ Jesus has saved you, you must submit yourself unto training. You don’t grow in isolation. You don’t stay in your closet thinking you are having fellowship with God. It is great to spend time with God in your closet. However, you don’t grow effectively in isolation. You can’t be more spiritual than God, who has commanded us to be disciples. The revelation of His Word opens our hearts to the necessity of submitting one to another. And through consistent discipleship, we multiply our fruits. For as you raise a saved soul, he or she will also be equipped to bear more fruits unto God's glory. Don't break the cycle of multiplication. If you have saved a soul, get them to Church, where they will be trained through Christ-centered discipleship. Are you also saved? Submit to Christ-centered discipleship in the Church where the Lord has planted you. DIG DEEPER( 2 Timothy 2:2; 1 Timothy 2:4;Acts 5:12 ; 14, Acts 2;41-47) WE PRAYThat every soul we have saved, will be planted in the Church and submit to the discipleship designed by the Lord.   BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 37: Leviticus 1 -3  DECLARE THESE WORDS:-I bear much fruits for the Lord. -My fruits remain. -My fruits are cultured and raised. -The souls I win submit to training and they reproduce themselves. - I multiply my fruits through discipleship. -I make students of Christ in all nations.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 48 - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 14)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ABOUND IN THESE THINGS (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 14) "For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 1:8 (NKJV). Fruitfulness is an essential matter in God. He designed all organisms to be productive or to reproduce themselves. "Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food" Genesis 1:29 (Berean Standard Bible) "God made all sorts of wild animals, livestock, and small animals, each able to produce offspring of the same kind. And God saw that it was good." Genesis 1:25 (NLT) These are testimonies or witnesses of God to us, concerning fruit-bearing. (See episode 35 and 36 you will have clarity on this).Unfruitfulness has not been God's desire for man; much more the saints in Christ?God being determined to help us become fruitful, He has supplied us with all that we need to bear fruits. " For His divine power has bestowed on us [absolutely] everything necessary for [a dynamic spiritual] life and godliness, through true and personal knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence" 2 Peter 1:3 Beloved, understand that you lack nothing to be fruitful. God has given unto you all things that pertain to life and godliness (the expression of divinity).All that is in God unto fruit-bearing has been dispensed into us by Him through Christ.We have what it takes to bear the God-kind of fruits, because by the supply of His divine power, He has made us partakers of His nature and character.Just as the vine and the branches share the same kind of life and nature; we also share the same life and nature with God. "as His divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who called us by glory and virtue, by which have been given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, *that through these you may be partakers of the divine nature*, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust." God has cascaded His essence into us, to make us the expression of His life to the world.(2 Peter 1 points us to some other key items God has supplied into us, to make useful and fruitful).We will look more into these in the next episode.Remain blessedDIG DEEPER ( Titus 3:14; 2 Peter 1:1-8; Matthew 13:18-23; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY That we will graciously engage the character and the nature of God we have partaken; to be useful demonstrate fruitfulness in our walk of faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 38: Leviticus 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I refuse to be barren.- I am fruitful in all things.- I have the nature of God in me.- I share in God's character and power.-I have all that I need to bear the God-kind of fruits.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 49 - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 2 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 15)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 2 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 15) "For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 1:8 (NKJV). There are things God has dispensed into the saints, to make us bear much fruits.In 2 Peter 1:3, we behold this beautiful reality that, God has given unto us all things (not somethings) that pertain to life and godliness.Which means, you have all that is required to bear fruits.Are there some believers in Christ who are not bearing fruits?Certainly, there are.Some believers in Christ, are not being fruitful because of their ignorance or unconsciousness. Until you come to the consciousness (which includes knowledge and understanding) of all that Christ has produced in you; bearing fruits may seem impossible.Christ being the Vine has supplied rich items to us (His branches); to bear fruits unto the glory of the Father. " as His divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who called us by glory and virtue, by which have been given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, that through these you may be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust." 2 Peter 1:3-4. When you become born again:a. You are called by glory and virtue.b. God's divine power has supplied you with all things that pertain to life and godliness (and this is made real to you through the Knowledge of Christ, plus nothing).c. You have been given exceedingly great and precious promisesd. You are a partaker of the divine nature.To be a partaker of God's nature is to share in His character.c. You have escaped the corruption of this world, because of the incorruptible quality of God's life dispensed into you.Beloved, you will never be fruitless living in the consciousness and conviction of these.Now, Peter (apostle of our Lord Jesus), went on to list some additional items we need to deploy. " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV). The phrase, "add" doesn't suggest we should strive to pray to God for any of the items listed there. It doesn't mean we are to search out these things to have them.He had already said in vrs3 " His divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness..." For example; "...the love of God is shared abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit" (Romans 5:5) That should suggest that, to "add... love" in 2 Peter 1:5-7, doesn't suggest you go looking for love to become fruitful. We already know that the love of God is poured into our hearts. We already have love. We already have faith. For how can "the just live by faith", without having faith?Christ had already authored our faith.(Hebrews 12:2).The Greek word used for "add" is epichorēgeō; it means to lavishly supply or furnish. Epichorēgeō is a compound word, from epi (upon) and choregeo (supply) which means to furnish upon. To furnish besides or in addition. To supply further. To add more unto.Epichoregeo then conveys the thought of a generous and lavish provision - give lavishly, give generously and not to equip sparingly.We may see it as a simple expression in this modern day, but it denotes a magnanimous or munificent acts in Ancient Greek.Let me help you have a picture of the word, add ( Epichorēgeō), when Peter was inspired to write this second epistle. Epichorēgeō is derived from choregós the name of the wealthy patron who would lavishly pay the wages for singers in his chorus, as well as pay the expenses of grand productions that were put on in cooperation with a poet and the state. The practice in Greece was for the state to establish a chorus but a choirmaster (choregus = director) paid the expenses for training and was responsible for supplying everything needed for choir.Thus, the word means “to supply in copious measure, to provide beyond the need, to supply more than generously or more than is barely demanded. ( Wuest's Word Studies from the Greek New Testament: Eerdmans or Logos)The life you live now, is as a grand global production and you are the director and the producer.Beloved, the grand show is on and you are fully resourced by God with all virtues and power to make it successful.You have beyond what is needed as a wealthy patron, to bountifully supply in all matters for the production of great fruits.Now, "ADD", bountifully supply to your faith. Remain blessedDIG DEEPER ( Psalm 84:11; 1 Corinthians 3:21-23; Romans 8:32; 1 Corinthians 1:9; colossians 2:19; 2 Corinthians 9:10) WE PRAYWe will grow and increase in the knowledge of God's bountiful grace and virtues dispensed into us, that we will munificently make supply of these virtues and grace in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 39: Leviticus 7-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I grow in the understanding of how much resources I carry.- I am resourceful in all things.- I have more than enough to supply.- I make bountiful supply, beyond what is required on my daily living.- I walk in the consciousness and conviction of all that the Lord has supplied to me.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 50-SUPPLY VIRTUE TO YOUR FAITH - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 3 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 16)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. SUPPLY VIRTUE TO YOUR FAITH - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 3 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 16) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV). From yesterday's episode, I explained how the word ADD (epichorēgeō) was used.You don't have to picture "addition" as a mathematical term in your mind.To add to your faith, means to lavishly supply divine resources to your faith.God has resourced you to have more than enough to supply or distribute. He has made you like a "choregós" (the name of the wealthy patron who would lavishly pay the wages for singers in his chorus, as well as pay the expenses of grand productions). To ADD also depicts a picture of a choirmaster (choregus = director) who was responsible for supplying everything needed for a choir. Which means during the performance of the choir, they don't now have to look for anything they need, they are fully furnished with all that is needed. They only make use of what they are supplied with.This is your state dearly beloved in Christ.Whatever you are to add (lavishly supply), has already been given to you. " His divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness..." 2 Peter 1:3 (NKJV). Now you have to diligently (in all earnestness, or business care) supply to your faith virtue. SUPPLY VIRTUE TO YOUR FAITH. Faith is the reality of our life lived. It is the currency given to us in Christ to make transactions through life; in and from the spirit into this physical realm and the Kingdom of God at large. "...the life that I live now in the flesh, I live by the faith of the Son of God who loved me and gave Himself for me" (Galatians 2:20 ) The just shall live by faith. (Hebrews 10:38; Galatians 3:11; Romans 1:17).Faith is essentially supplied to us by God, through His Word.And God by His own power has given us all we need to bear fruits. He has now given us the responsibility to make supply to our faith all that is needed. "...giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue... VIRTUE is from the greek word, aretē which means, Moral excellence refers to any preeminence (moral, intellectual, military power).”It speaks of whatever procures preeminent estimation for a person or thing; hence, “intrinsic eminence, moral goodness, virtue, (see Vine, W E: Vine's Complete Expository Dictionary of Old and New Testament Words. 1996. Nelson). To add VIRTUE means to: 1. Show forth Excellence. To be excellent is to demonstrate eminence or superiority of achievement and mastery in a sphere. It denotes consummate quality.The world is in the dark (spiritually), and does not know the “excellencies of God.However, God has called us to be His chosen generation, royal priests and peculiar people, to display His marvelous light or glory in this dark and chaotic world. (See 1 Peter 2:9) 2. It means to emit MORAL QUALITY.True virtue in Christ is not merely the modification of human qualities. It is producing divine qualities that make the person more like Jesus Christ. It is to exhibit the purity of Christ in your thoughts, speech, and conduct.We exhibit the character of Christ because we are "partakers of the divine nature" (2 Peter 1:4) We have the nature of Christ as our actual disposition within. 3. To exude COURAGE and MANLINESS.The word virtue depicts Valour or spiritual might.Areté often means courage.Plutarch (a Greek historian and biographer) says that "God is a hope of aretē, not an excuse for cowardice". Moral uprightness is real manliness. It is true courage. It is the boldness to stand up for what is true and excellent.The three Hebrew boys stood up for the only true God. They said, to King Nebuchadnezzar, our God will deliver us from your hands, if not we will still not bow. (Daniel 3)Such audacity of virtue!Joseph said to Potipher's wife, I will not sin against God and your husband. (Study Genesis 39). "Virtue issues in the courage to show whose it is and whom it serves."How firm do you stand in Faith and truth in the face of corruption? 4. Virtue, Aretē, means To be Purposeful. To the Greek philosophers, Virtue meant, the fulfillment of a thing.It is what we might call operative or efficient, excellence.An example of its usage can be seen in a land that is fertile.When anything in nature properly fulfills its purpose, that fulfillment was referred to as “virtue'. Land that produces crops is “excellent” because it is fulfilling its purpose.God has designed us as His workmanship (creative masterpiece) for a specific purpose. "We have become his poetry, a re-created people that will fulfill the destiny he has given each of us, for we are joined to Jesus, the Anointed One. Even before we were born, God planned in advance our destiny and the good works we would do to fulfill it!" Ephesians 2:10 (TPT) When you walk in the fulfillment of God's eternal purpose for your life, you demonstrate VIRTUE (Excellence).Is your life radiating or repressing the excellencies of God?DIG DEEPER (Philippians 4:8; 1 Peter 4:11; 1 Peter 2:9; 12; Isaiah 43:21; Isaiah 60:1-3; Philippians 1:27 ) WE PRAYThat we will show forth the excellencies of our Lord Jesus according to His life and nature at work in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 40: Leviticus 11-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I demonstrate virtue and honor.- I am an example of God's excellence and glory.- I emit courage and moral excellence in the face of opposition.- I walk in the fulfillment of my purpose.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 51 - THE SUPPLY OF KNOWLEDGE - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 4 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 17)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE SUPPLY OF KNOWLEDGE - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 4 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 17) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV). Now we have seen that, the word, "add" in the opening verses, is not in terms of mathematics. To "add" means to supply lavishly.The Greek word is "epichorēgeō. The root verb is choregeo; it gives us our English word choreography which is defined as the sequence of steps and movements in dance. It is the arrangement of movements that the audience sees on the stage.Beloved, all the needed sequence of steps and movements in a dance has been arranged, we just supply or demonstrate it on this great stage of life.One of the sequence of the divine dance we are to lavishly supply to faith and virtue is knowledge. THE SUPPLY OF KNOWLEDGE In 2 Peter, the apostle used different words for knowledge. Though each of these words may have some similarity, they have their unique rich meanings.Though he used the word, knowledge about five (5) or more times, he chose a specific word in the Greek.See these: 2 Peter: a. 1:2 "... through the knowledge (epignōsis) of God and of Jesus our Lord." b. 1:3 "... through our knowledge (epignōsis) of him...." c. 1:5-6 "For this very reason, make every effort to add ... to goodness, knowledge (gnōsis)..." d. 1:8 "... keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge (epignōsis) of our Lord Jesus Christ." e. 1:12 "... even though you know (oida) them and are firmly established in the truth you now have." f. 1:14 "because I know (oida) that I will soon put [my body] aside...." You will see that, the word knowledge, gnōsis, used in the opening verse (1 Peter 1:5-6, ) is different from the word knowledge, epignōsis, used in 1 Peter 1:8.Few people have some subtle resentment towards the word "gnosis", more because of the "Gnostic movement" (which considered material existence flawed or evil, and held the principal element of salvation to be direct knowledge of the hidden divinity, attained via mystical or esoteric insight. Many Gnostic texts deal not in concepts of sin and repentance, but with illusion and enlightenment.) Peter, the apostle, in his epistle was speaking of knowledge, gnōsis, as , "experientially know"; functional ("working") knowledge gleaned from first-hand (personal) experience, connecting theory to application; "application-knowledge," gained in (by) a direct relationship. (Strong's Bible dictionary)This knowledge, gnosis, is the possession of information of what is known. Gnosis describes the comprehension or intellectual grasp of something. It refers to knowledge gained by experience. Gnosis is an “experiential knowledge".It speaks of an intellectual possession of scriptures, both by study of the Bible and scriptural experience through situations.This is more of knowing God's word and His ways. God wants us to supply this knowledge to faith and virtue, so that we can mature and be productive fruit bearers.Grasp the knowledge of the scriptures on daily basis. Knowledge is an indispensable element in your fruit bearing.Apply the scriptures in every situation, and don't assume there are situations, you don't need the word of God.Put God's word to work in your daily life.SelahDIG DEEPER (2 Peter 3:18; Colossians 3:16; 2 Timothy 2:15; Titus 2:10; Ephesians 5:8) WE PRAY That we will grow richly and demonstrate the experiential knowledge of Christ in all situations, according as God has produced in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 41: Leviticus 14-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I walk in the the experiential knowledge of the word of God.- I give no room for ignorance.- I function as a man of knowledge.-I have great insight into the ways of the Lord.- I am full of divine light.- I supply the experiential knowledge of Christ in all matters.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 52 - SELF-CONTROL IS ESSENTIAL - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 6 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 18)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. SELF-CONTROL IS ESSENTIAL - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 6 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 18) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV). Unfruitfulness is not God's intention for you. And doesn't just demand fruitfulness from you. He has supplied you with all that you need to be more fruitful.Your responsibility in fruit-bearing is to supply or distribute the items God has cascaded into you. We have seen that God has given unto us (in Christ) all things that pertain to life and godliness (2 Peter 1:3).When you came into Christ you received faith. Faith is the foundation of your living in Christ. (Galatians 2:20). And to faith, you supply virtue, to virtue you supply knowledge.In the previous episode we saw Knowledge as one of the indispensable element in your fruits bearing.Today we look further into the next item for fruit-bearing, SELF-CONTROL. SUPPLY SELF-CONTROL When we hear of self-control we first think of we subjecting our thoughts and emotions under our own control.However, it doesn't work that way.To bring things under your control will still lose control.It is always difficult to bear burdens on our own.To exercise SELF-CONTROL according to the scriptures, is to subject your emotions, thoughts, and desires or cravings to our Lord Jesus.The greek word is (egkrateia/enkrateia) from the word, enkratos ("en" means in and "kratos" means dominion, mastery, power to rule).It also stems from the word "krat" which speaks of power or lordship.It literally means dominion within.It is the ability or idea to take a grip on oneself or hold oneself. For you in Christ, self-control proceeds out from within you, but not by yourself. This is because it is only possible by depending on the power of the indwelling Spirit.With self-control, you hold your passions and desires in hand, as you are enabled by the Lord.You cause God's word to master your desires and passions, especially your sensual appetites.The Greeks used "self-control" of the one who had his sex passions under control.It speaks of the ability to make the will of God get a grip on yourself.Egkrateia has reference to restraining passions and appetites. It points to the inner power of God, to control one's own desires and appetites.To have self-control, you function like Jesus. He never became a victim of the tricks of the adversary. (Matthew 4:1-11). He was never found doing or saying anything that was not consistent with His Father’s will and divine nature. Jesus said, "...I seek not mine own will, but the will (or desires) of the Father which hath sent me." John 5:30. This is the simplicity of self-control. It is not just about having a restraining force, it is God's will becoming your restraining force.Get this, you are not a machine, God has made you an organism or a free moral agent. Thus, you exercise self-control by a free act of will.Until you make a personal decision to submit to God's restraining ability within you, God wouldn't force His will on you.When you yield your cravings to God, you exercise self-control in the energy which the Holy Spirit supplies.This is a glorious interworking of your will and the grace of God.There is a price of fruitfulness, therefore live as an athlete who disciplines and restrains himself; beating his body into submission ( 1Co 9:27).A good top level athlete will abstain from rich foods, wine, and sexual activities in order to focus all his strength and attention on training to be more efficient.Beloved, practice self-control by yielding your thoughts, emotions, desires to the instructions of the Word and the Spirit.Do you want to bear more fruits?Don't sleep when you are to be praying. Be diligent to pray and fast and not to be controlled by your appetite for food. Be disciplined and diligent to share the gospel of Christ with others no matter how you feel. Refrain from sexual immorality. Don't frustrate the grace of God. Take advantage of the strength of the Holy Spirit to do more.SelahDIG DEEPER (Galatians 5:22-23; Acts 24:25; 2Peter 1:3; 1 Corinthians 9:25;) WE PRAY -That we shall increase in the strength of the Spirit to exercise self-control or temperance in all things.- That all our cravings and desires are governed by the will of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 42: Leviticus 17-20 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am disciplined by the word of God.- I don't do as I desire. I exercise the strength of God in my dealings.- I do the will of God.- Christ is my strength.- My longings, cravings, pleasures are submitted to the good pleasure of the Father's will.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 53 - PERSEVERE - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 7 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 19)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. PERSEVERE - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 7 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 19) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV). Before the season to bearing fruits, there maybe a season of storm. As a branch, you need to hang on to the vine.You may see other branches bearing fruits, whiles you are also receiving the same amount of nutrients from the vine. And this may stir some level of frustration and anxiety, especially when there is no understanding of how things work.The experiential knowledge of God's work, enables you to supply God's restraining force. This then makes it possible for you to exercise perseverance in the face of adversity.You will not be in haste to prove yourself or to bear fruits.Understand that fruit bearing is a matter of expression. And when you grow deep in this knowledge of God's work, you demonstrate "patience-endurance".Your desires and appetites are already under the influence of God's power. Therefore you easily remain resolute and maintain an undisturbed composure.Jesus didn't just exercise self-control to the end, He also persevered. The heart of endurance is the focus of glory.Our Lord Jesus pressed on to the end because He kept His eyes on the goal.Having self control is great, yet you must persevere, till you manifest the results.Perseverance is a product of tested faith.Don't throw in the towel when you are confronted by huge challenges. The more challenges persist, the more you also persist. "Tough times never last, tough people do" Robert Schuller. You are built more and more into maturity as you practice perseverance in the face of challenges. "Knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience. But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing" James 1:3-4 (NKJV). You practice perseverance through the joy of the Spirit (James 1:2)In Acts 5, we see how the apostles, led by Peter were bearing great Kingdom fruits. They worked great signs and wonders, sick people and those tormented by unclean spirits were healed in the streets and believers were increasingly added to the Lord in their multitudes. ( see verses, 12-16).These were glorious times. There was so much supply of the Power of the Holy Spirit.Then the high priest and his council, laid their hands on the apostles, put them into prison.These apostles were taken out by an angel of the Lord. And yet they continued to preach in the temple as they were instructed.They could have decided to leave for the sake of their lives. But because they are yielded to the restraining force of the Spirit, their desire is what the Lord wants them to do.They were arrested again, beaten and warned or commanded not to preach the name of the Lord.Beloved see the reaction of the apostles? "So they brought the apostles back in and had them severely beaten. They ordered them never again to speak in the name of Jesus and then let them go.The apostles left there rejoicing, thrilled that God had considered them worthy to suffer disgrace for the name of Jesus. And nothing stopped them! They kept preaching every day in the temple courts and went from house to house, preaching the gospel of Jesus, God’s Anointed One!" Acts 5:40-42 (TPT). This is the meaning of PERSEVERANCE!!!This is the meaning of UNDISTURBED COMPOSURE.Beloved we are not of they that draw back. God is pleased with us, as we persevere and refuse to draw back. (Hebrews 10:38)No persecution should be enough to stop you. Don't allow the success of others make you think you have failed. Continue in doing what the Lord has instructed you to do.Don't stop here, neither should you turn to the left nor to the right; KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE GOAL.Let these words of Paul (the apostle) to Timothy, be your words to yourself:"The confidence of my calling enables me to overcome every difficulty without shame, for I have an intimate revelation of this God. And my faith in him convinces me that he is more than able to keep all that I’ve placed in his hands safe and secure until the fullness of his appearing" 2 Timothy 1:12 (TPT).SelahDIG DEEPER (Acts 5:12-42; 1 Peter 4:12-19; James 1:2-4; Romans 5:3-5) WE PRAY That the Lord shall strengthen us more and more that we may remain resolute to boldly endure the pressures of this world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 43: Leviticus 21-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have divine capacity.-I refuse to stagger.-I endure to the end.-I don't fret nor faint.-I maintain an undisturbed composure.-I have the grace to persevere in the midst of opposition.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 54 - THE MATTER OF GODLINESS - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 8 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 20)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE MATTER OF GODLINESS - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 8 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 20) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV). From the previous discussion, we have realized that, to be fruitful, there is the need to supply lavishly some crucial items.We don't automatically bear fruits; fruit-bearing is a result of well-processed nutrients and the development of a tree.The foundational reality of our fruitfulness is faith. Faith is the collective share in the blessings of the newness of life.Peter calls it the like precious faith apportioned to us by God (2 Peter 1:1).Here, the like precious faith is a seed sown into us.This seed is developed by the lavish supply of virtue, which is the valiant action of God's excellence.And then in virtue, we bountifully supply the knowledge of God and of our Lord Jesus.This is an experiential knowledge of God, and the Lord Jesus; the knowledge of God's eternal plan and purpose, His power, glory, nature, and all that pertains to life and godliness.For proper growth in the newness of life, we need to graciously exercise restraint by submitting our emotions, desires, passions and habits to the power and control of the Lord.Understand that, to exercise self-control is to deal with ourselves according to the influence of the Holy Spirit and the Word. However, through "patience endurance" (or perseverance) we bear with others and circumstances.The supply of perseverance to our living causes us to rightly deal with hostile environments and people around us.THE MATTER OF GODLINESSGodliness is the expression of divinity.Godliness (eusebeia from eú which means well and sébomai also means worship, venerate, pay homage); literally "well worship".This reflects an attitude of one's life to live with a sense of God's presence.Godliness is sacred reverence exhibited especially in actions.The consecrating presence of God is conveyed into all the experiences of life by godliness.We see the picture of godliness through Christ; how that, He made all behold the inexplicable reality of the divine life. " No one has seen God [His essence, His divine nature] at any time; the [One and] only begotten God [that is, the unique Son] who is in the intimate presence of the Father, He has explained Him [and interpreted and revealed the awesome wonder of the Father]." John 1:18 (Amplified) How did Jesus demonstrate, interpret and reveal the awesome wonder of the Father?See what Brother Luke said here in Acts 1v1: "To Theophilus, the lover of God.I write to you again, my dear friend, to give you further details about the life of our Lord Jesus and all the things that he did and taught." Through all the things that our Lord and Saviour Jesus did and taught, many beheld the glory of God.Godliness is basically the demonstration of God's nature, love, glory, joy and power to others. By this, we live a life pleasant to the Lord.You speak like God and act as God. This is basically living as Christ in your sphere.Do many see Christ in you?Godliness is not living out your life. It is living out the quality of God's life. It is the outflow of the increased life of God in you.Until you decrease for Christ to increase in you; many will not see Christ.Godliness is seen when you lay down your life for Christ to only spring forth and blossom in you.You cannot fake true godliness.It is not a religious practice because it transcends religion. Neither is it an application of an outward list of rules and regulations.True godliness is lived by the power of the transfused life of Christ.Many ostensibly very "religious" people have an appearance of godliness, going through the motions of religion, but they don't have the power to truly lay down their lives for Christ to blossom in them (See 2 Timothy 3:5). By the human standards, (just as the pharisees and the sadducees), there is a boxed up interpretation of God and His expressions.However, in Christ Jesus we see that, the revelation of God is beyond our human imagination. Thus, you can truly see God and express Him only by the power and revelation of Jesus Christ in you.Until you behold and handle Christ Jesus, you cannot declare or express His life. "We saw him with our very own eyes. We gazed upon him and heard him speak. Our hands actually touched him, the one who was from the beginning, the Living Expression of God. This Life-Giver was made visible and we have seen him. We testify to this truth:the eternal Life-Giver lived face-to-face with the Father and has now dawned upon us.So we proclaim to you what we have seen and heard about this Life-Giver so that we may share and enjoy this life together. For truly our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus, the Anointed One." 1 John 1:1-3 (TPT).Glory to God. DIG DEEPER (2 Peter 3:11; Genesis 5:24; 1 Timothy 4:8; 2 Timothy 3:12; Psalm 1:1-3; Micah 6:8; Titus 2:11-14) WE PRAY We pray that by the empowering ability of God's Spirit we shall live and walk as godly on this earth, bearing Godly fruits unto God's glory BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 43: Leviticus 24-27 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I decrease that Christ will increase in me.- I am empowered to demonstrate the God kind of life in every situation.- I carry the presence of God in all places.- I don't just have the form of Godliness, I have the power to express God in all things.- I walk with God according as He has designed.-Many see God in my speech and conducts.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 55 - PRACTICE BROTHERLY LOVE - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 8 ( ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 21 )
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. PRACTICE BROTHERLY LOVE - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 8 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 21) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 1:5-8 (NKJV).  From the verse 7 of 2 Peter 1, the apostle Peter, crowns the items for fruitfulness with two transcending verities: 1. Brotherly Kindness (or Brotherly Love) and 2. LOVE.Let's have a quick look at these two beautiful and refreshing verities. BROTHERLY KINDNESS (Love):It's from the Greek word, "philadelphia" composed of phílos or phileo and adelphos.Philos or phileo means beloved, dear, friendly or to have affection.Whiles Adelphos means brother.Thus, philadelphia means "fraternal love", brotherly love (kindness), love of the brethren or to have affection for a brother.Brotherly love refers to the love members of a family held for each other and would not usually be used to describe the love between members of different families.Jesus in His commandments to His disciples, revealed the essence of philadelphia (brotherly love). (Read more of LOVING ONE ANOTHER here episodes 24 and 25 of the ) "By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another" John 13:35 (KJV) Brotherly love is our testimony of discipleship to the world.The love we demonstrate, one to another enables us to bear much fruits (see John 15:16-17).The Church cultivated practical kindness towards one another. This radically depleted their differences in culture, status and diverse backgrounds.They hewn a bond of love in Christ wherein believing Greeks and Jews, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarians, Scythians, slaves and freemen, men and women were now all one in their Lord Jesus.They willingly stood for one another, supplied help to each others shortcomings, and they loved unselfishly.These brethren distributed all they had equally among themselves.The extent you love a brother or a sister in the Lord, is the extent you demonstrate the Love of God in you. " If someone says, “I love God,” but hates a fellow believer, that person is a liar; for if we don’t love people we can see, how can we love God, whom we cannot see?And he has given us this command: Those who love God must also love their fellow believers." 1 John 4:20-21 (NLT). One may ask, what is the connection with being kind or loving a brother Lord to my FRUIT-BEARING?Okay, read Galatians 6:7-10 (TPT): "Make no mistake about it, God will never be mocked! For what you plant will always be the very thing you harvest.The harvest you reap reveals the seed that was planted. If you plant the corrupt seeds of self - life into this natural realm, you can expect to experience a harvest of corruption.If you plant the good seeds of Spirit-life you will reap the beautiful fruits that grow from the everlasting life of the Spirit."And don’t allow yourselves to be weary or disheartened in planting good seeds, for the season of reaping the wonderful harvest you’ve planted is coming!Take advantage of every opportunity to be a blessing to others, especially to our brothers and sisters in the family of faith!"(NB: Read these verses also from the Message and Amplified Bible). Being a blessing to others is how you plant seeds, and harvests great fruits.And beloved, be a blessing most especially, to the brothers and sisters who are of the eternal family of Christ (these are the born-again believers.DIG DEEPER: ( 1 John 4:7-21; Romans 12;10; 1 Thessalonians 3:12; Acts 2:44-45; Acts 4:32)  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 44: Numbers 1-3  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in the Love of Christ.- I genuinely love the brethren.- I go all out of the brethren in the faith.-I affectionately serve the saints with genuine heart of love.- I demonstrate my love for God and my discipleship by loving the saints.- I don't get tired in doing good.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 56 - THE VERTEX - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 9 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 22)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE VERTEX - ABOUND IN THESE THINGS 9 (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 22) " But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 1:5-8 (NKJV). To crown the items for fruitfulness, we began to look into the two transcending verities: 1. Brotherly Kindness (or Brotherly Love) and 2. LOVE. We understood that "Brotherly Love", philadelphia, means "fraternal love", to have affection for a brother.It refers to the love members of a family held for each other and would not usually be used to describe the love between members of different families.The practice of brotherly love is essential in our fruit-bearing (see previous episode). This is more because, it is our testimony of being disciples of Jesus (John 13:35). (Read LOVING ONE ANOTHER Part 1 and 2).This brotherly love, philadelphia, is different from Agape.Agape is the vertex of divine expression. This love doesn't only gravitate towards the brethren in the faith. This spreads to all men and all things.Agape is unconditional, sacrificial love.This is not just the love God demonstrates (John 3:16; 1 John 4:9), that is what God is (1Jn 4:8,16), and He supplies and enables us to walk in this love also. This love of God (Agape) is stronger and greater in ability and capacity, respectively.Agape is not based on pleasant emotions or good feelings that might result from a physical attraction or a familial bond. Agape is a choice which impels you to sacrifice for others or serve them without conditions.This love is beyond the domain of men. It is beyond the standard of men. This is a higher standard of love. And no man can meet its demand. This is why God designed it to only be supplied to you by Himself.This love doesn’t work just by utterance. It works by life. And you cannot wake up one day to just start loving as He has loved you. Unless you have received Him into you.(See also from Episodes 23 to 33) Agape is distributed into us in Christ by the Holy Spirit. The day we received the Holy Spirit at our new birth, is cascaded the very love of Christ into us.We therefore, have all that is needed to lavishly supply the love of Christ in all situations.Beloved when these things (faith, virtue, knowledge, self-control, perseverance, godliness, brotherly kindness and love) be in you and abound you shall not be barren."These things", are part of the all things granted us by the divine power of God.The abounding or the multiplying of these eternal verities, shall constitute us into fruitfulness in the fullness of the knowledge of Christ.These things are not necessarily a matter of correcting our behaviour or improving ourselves. They are in reality the elements of our constitution.Engage these ingredients to bear much more fruits in faith. " Since these virtues are already planted deep within, and you possess them in abundant supply, they will keep you from being inactive or fruitless in your pursuit of knowing Jesus Christ more intimately." 2 Peter 1:8 (TPT). BE FRUITFUL AND MULTIPLY.ShalomDIG DEEPER: (Matthew 5:44-47; 1 Corinthians 13:1-8; Colossians 1:10; 3:14; Philippians 3:8) BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 45: Numbers 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I walk in love and demonstrates His life.- I bear fruits in the fullness of knowledge.- I please the Lord in every way as I bear more fruits.- I count all things but lost for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ.-Grace is multiplied unto me to be fruitful.- I cannot be barren for i have the qualities that bear much more fruits.Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 57 - THE GLORY CALL RESOUND (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 22)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE GLORY CALL RESOUND (ABUNDANT FRUIT-BEARERS 22) "I won’t hesitate to continually remind you of these truths, even though you are aware of them and are well established in the present measure of truth you have already embraced. And as long as I live I will continue to awaken you with this reminder... Indeed, I’m passionate to share these things with you so that you will always remember..." 2 Peter 1:12-13;15 (TPT). I have consistently shared with you from episode 34, our ordination of fruit-bearing. I explained to you the relation between our fruits bearing and discipleship of Jesus.We have been digging more into this matter of fruit-bearing and all that you need to know.From the opening verse, you can see how Peter the apostle, did not hesitate to keep reminding the saints of these rich truths.See what Paul the apostle, also said: " Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you ." Philippians 3:1 (Berean Standard Bible). We recently looked at some of the ingredients we need, to bear much fruits.Bearing much fruits is the ordination of every disciple of Jesus.Get this, we don’t bear fruits to become disciples of Jesus. As disciples of Jesus, we are fruit bearers.Now today I want to remind you of a critical item we discussed previously.A critical factor to consider: ” My Father is glorified and honored by this when you bear much fruit…” John 15:8 Remember that you don’t bear fruits for your fame. When you bear many fruits, the Father is glorified and honored in you.This is the vital goal of man; TO GLORIFY GOD!In my teachings and writings, I keep emphasizing on this:That God has given us His life and become our inward supply for our enjoyment. And we are His expression.Beloved, as we express God and His Life, many see His glory and honor.See what Jesus said in His prayer: ” I have glorified You on the earth by completing the work You gave Me to do.” John 17:4 (Holman Bible). Our Lord Jesus lived to glorify the Father. He showed us what should be the preeminent essence of our actions.Whatever we do in the Kingdom, they are chiefly to bring glory and honor to God. ” Whoever speaks [to the congregation], is to do so as one who speaks the oracles (utterances, the very words) of God. Whoever serves [the congregation] is to do so as one who serves by the strength which God [abundantly] supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified [honored and magnified] through Jesus Christ, to whom belongs the glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen. 1 Peter 4:11 (Amplified Bible). Whatever we do (including what we eat and drink), must be done unto God’s glory. (1 Corinthians 10:31).It shouldn’t just be about our benefits. Our motive of service to God and bearing of fruits should be rooted in bringing Glory to God alone (not to make any man famous, or to satisfy our selfish desires or ambitions).All things in Christ are for God’s glory alone. (Read more here Episode 37) ShalomDIG DEEPER: (Colossians 3:17; Matthew 5:16; John 12:28; John 13:31-32) WE PRAY: We pray that in our pursuit to bear much more fruits and service to the Lord shall be by the strength which God [abundantly] supplies, so that in all things God may be glorified [honored and magnified] in us, through Jesus Christ BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 46: Numbers 7-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS: I am designed to bear much fruits unto the Glory of the Father.Many adore the Lord and admire the Lord through me.I am a much more fruit-bearer the Father delights in.I do nothing for fame.I serve the Lord unto his glory.The Lord is glorified in me and through me.I accomplish all that the Lord tells me to do unto His glory.Hallelujah.

title: EPISODE 58 - ARE YOU A DOER OF THE WORD OR A DECEIVER OF SELF
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ARE YOU A DOER OF THE WORD OR A DECEIVER OF SELF? "But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed."James 1:25 (KJV). From the past weeks, the Lord through me has served you with insights and realities.How committed are you in doing the word?Do you just read to wait for the next day?Whatever God teaches you becomes your responsibility.When you receive a word from God, you must run with it.Read these writings, is God's vision revealed to you. You must run with it.I shared on this platform, practical steps on HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED; when are you going to put it to work.Those who make a difference in the Kingdom, are those who act on the Word of God.Have you read the PRACTICE OF LOVE?How are you putting those teachings to work?Don't just be a hearer only, be a doer as well.There are people who boast of things the Holy Spirit has told them. And for about 6 months they keep contemplating on whether to do it or not. These people try to sound deep and highly spiritual.But, it is unfortunate how they hear the Holy Spirit and decide when to take a step.Many are puffed up by the things they have learnt but lack the discipline to do.It is one thing to learn and another thing to handle or understand the revelation.When you handle the truth of God's word, it will move you into action.After Peter (the apostle of our Lord), had preached on the day of Pentecost, there was the conviction of the Holy Spirit in the hearts of the people listening.However, they didn't sit hoping for someone to do something for them. They didn't procrastinate at all.As the word came to them, they were ready to do something.See this: "Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brethren, what shall we do?" Acts 2:37 They didn't argue with the message or to wait for another day to take action.These men heard the message and were ready to put it to work.There are so many prophecies, instructions and inspiring ideas the Lord has breathe into your heart.You grow in manifestation by taking the right steps.God's Word comes to you to correct, govern your thinking and to supply you with the wisdom for action.Until you become a doer of the Word, you cannot experience the glorious manifestation you have envisioned.Don't just be a talker, always locked up in your room praying and hoping that a miracle or something big will happen automatically.We pray to receive grace and direction for action.Which means after prayer, you must have definite accurate "to do-list".After Paul encountered Jesus on the road to Damascus, see the instruction the Lord gave him: "And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest. And they that were with me saw indeed the light and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me. And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do". This was the beginning of God's great move of Salvation and the expansion of the gospel among the Gentiles.After that encounter with Jesus, Paul was told what to do.Your manifestation is not just by revelation, it is by the revelation you act on.Many who hear the Word only and refuse to be DOERS, are referred to as "deceivers of selves". (James 1:22)You may be thinking you are making progress but without actions, you will just be as a man swinging in a lazy chair.Beloved, it is time for action. Take a step today and the Lord shall prosper your way.DIG DEEPER: (Matthew 21:28-32; James 1:21-25; Matthew 23:3; Joshua 1:8) WE PRAY That the grace of God will abound towards us, that we will not relent in taking steps and being doers of the Word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 47: Numbers 11-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS: I do the word.I exercise the wisdom of God to act on the word.I refuse to procrastinate. I take steps as I am inspired by the Lord.NB: Continue declaring specific things you are going to do this month and this year. Declare how you are putting all the words and ideas to work in the name of Jesus.Shalom

title: EPISODE 59 - ARE YOU INCREASING IN LOVE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ARE YOU INCREASING IN LOVE? "And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you" 1 Thessalonians 3:12 (KJV) Beloved, the condition of your heart is what makes the difference in your walk with God.You can go as far as the intensity of your love for the Lord.We already have the Love of God dispensed in our hearts by the Holy Spirit. (Romans 5:5)However, what is the extent of the love of God in your heart?How has the love abounded?The love of God burning in your heart will precede the great commission.How far you can go in your journey with God, is dependent on how much His love has overflowed in your heart.Your desire and affection; your intentional actions and your level of diligence will gravitate towards what you Love.Your love FOR God is first influenced by the love OF God burning in your heart.Your love for God is an outflow of His love for you.So how much do you love God? You can judge your love for God by: 1. The time you make to pray to commune with Him and to take grace for His work.And also how you make time for the study of the Word.You make time for who and what you genuinely love. 2. How easily are you distracted by situations? The overflowing love of God cannot be distracted.No power or situation is strong enough to move you away from what you must do for God. 3. How do you love the brethren? The extent you keep malice, find issues with people, take offense, hold grudge, envy and become bitter exposes the measure of the love of God at work in you. 4. The secret thoughts of your mind and heart are the inward measure of your love.That is where true love is measured.The secret thoughts of your heart are the motives or genuineness of your heart.So, do you give in Church and yet complain in your mind or secretly to others?Are you a cheerful giver, Do you share in the Father's love?Why do you serve in Church and also win souls? 5. How far do you go with the gospel of Jesus? How compassionate are you to see men saved? Are you just wishing to preach Christ to others or you are taking steps to get others saved?When you truly have the overflowing love of Christ, you will be compelled to share and shout out the love of Christ.You will look and create the opportunities to preach the gospel.You will not feel pressured when you are involved in the Lord's work.Love is not merely about your feelings and emotions. Love is effective according to your growth in knowledge and understanding.This is why your personal fellowship with God's Word is important; and submitting to sound teaching of the Word of God is a necessity. "So this is my prayer: that your love will flourish and that you will not only love much but well. Learn to love appropriately. You need to use your head and test your feelings so that your love is sincere and intelligent, not sentimental gush. Live a lover's life, circumspect and exemplary, a life Jesus will be proud of: bountiful in fruits from the soul, making Jesus Christ attractive to all, getting everyone involved in the glory and praise of God"Philippians 1:9-11 (Message Translation)DIG DEEPER: (John 14:15; 1 Corinthians 13:1-13; Matthew 6:24; Galatians 5:13;1 Thessalonians 2:8; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAY: That our hearts will abound or overflow with the love of God and that we will be unstoppable fulfilling the assignment of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 48: Numbers 14-15; Psalm 90 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - The love of Christ shall flourish more and more in me.- I don't act by feelings and sentiments.- I function by love which is according to knowledge.- I live out the divine love of Christ.- The love of God is burning in my heart more and more.- My desires and affections are pure and genuine.- The love of Christ influences my thoughts.-My heart is set on the Lord.- I grow in the knowledge and understanding of God's love for me.- I walk in supernatural love.- There is no place for distractions.-There is no place for malice, envy, negative thoughts and offense.-I walk in the absolute love of Christ.- I love the brethren more and more.-I am the embodiment of the love of Christ.- I don't feel pressured because I serve the Lord in love.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 60 - CULTIVATE DILIGENCE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. CULTIVATE DILIGENCE " The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance and advantage, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty.” Proverbs 21:5 (AMP) It's amazing to have great potentials and ideas, but they do not automatically make you successful.Fruit-bearing also requires another key ingredient - DILIGENCE!It is essential to be a person of diligence and prompt to follow the Lord's plans and instructions.One of the core differences between those who prosper and those who don't are diligence and promptness.It is important to take a step towards a goal. However, taking a "one time" step and being inconsistent will not put you at the end of the goal.Diligence is a consistent working habit one should cultivate.God's grace to produce increase must be concurrent with your diligence.Until then the grace to increase will not manifest.To be diligent is to be consistent and committed with a working plan or to an instruction of the Lord. It is doing what has been entrusted to you exactly as you were instructed to do and at the expected time.A diligent person does not procrastinate and does not entertain slothfulness. " The lazy person craves, yet receives nothing, but the desires of the diligent are satisfied". Proverbs 13:4 (ISV). You can have all the desire to be a great man of God, to win millions of souls, to establish a great company to support the spread of the gospel, and etc. But without diligence they will grow into mere wish.Until you take a diligent step nothing will happen.This is the secret to many unsatisfied living.The spiritually lazy man can never move forward in the things of the spirit.The same in all phases of our living.Diligence is going the extra mile, to do things consistently and beyond the limit of others to increase results.At this level, when the blessings of the Lord's increase come upon what you do, people see an exponential increase.God rewards diligence. "Now without faith it is impossible to please God, for whoever comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who diligently seek him". Hebrews 11:6.. How diligent are you in your Bible reading?How diligent are you in prayer and acting the Word?Are you diligently listening to the teachings of the word?Sometimes, you don't even share in the grace of the ministry you are established; because you are not consistent with the instructions of the Word.A man of diligence brings growth in the ministry of the Lord.The more diligent you are in devouring and meditating on the teachings, the more fresh ability is released. "I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find me." Proverbs 8:17 There is an anointing that backs every message and when you diligently meditate, you come into the experience of the messageAre you praying at the time, you are asked to pray? (1 Thessalonians 5:16-18).The Lord doesn't just instruct us to pray, He sees far and knows the capacity we need to build before time.How diligent are you with your soul winning activity, your business and academics?People who are slothful are always stagnant. No amount of complain can move you forward. You must be diligent to do.All these years of laziness, complaining, making excuses not being prompt and consistent are the root of your stagnation and failure.Dare to be diligent.Be determined to move from the place of complaining, inconsistency, making excuses, being distracted, laziness and cultivate the habit of diligence.Be diligent to do things differently this year and see the difference you will make.Remain diligent in all things irrespective of opposition.ShalomDIG DEEPER: (Proverbs 12:24; 11:27; Romans 12:11; 1 Corinthians 15:58; Hebrews 6:11 WE PRAY: Day 49: That the Lord shall empower us to be diligent in all we do for the Kingdom, in our relationship with Him, in business, at the workplace and in our academics. BIBLE READING DAY 49: Numbers 16-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am diligent in all things.- I diligently do what the Lord has entrusted into my hands.- I move forward because I am spiritually diligent.- I diligently go the extra mile to achieve greater results.- I am committed to do that which the Lord has set before me to do.- As a diligent person, my plans surely lead to abundance.- I refuse to lag behind.- I fervently and diligently serve.- I don't stop halfway, I am diligent to the end.- As remain diligent, I rule and my desires are satisfied.- I am the favored of the Lord.- I am diligent in prayer and in my fellowship with the Lord.- I am diligent in meditating on God's Word.- I am empowered by God to demonstrate diligence in all I do.- I am outstanding in my service to God.- I am diligent in doing what my Man of God instructs me to do.- I see prosperity in all I do. In the name of Jesus.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 61 - BE IMMOVABLE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. BE IMMOVABLE "So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless" 1 Corinthians 15:58 (NLT) I will sincerely not deny the challenges which may confront you, just because of your stand in Christ.Our Lord declared this: " for you get enough hate from the world! But then, it hated me before it hated you.The world would love you if you belonged to it; but you don’t—for I chose you to come out of the world, and so it hates you. Do you remember what I told you? ‘A slave isn’t greater than his master!’ So since they persecuted me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to me, they would listen to you! The people of the world will persecute you because you belong to me, for they don’t know God who sent me." John 15:18-21 (TLB) The events and activities of this world are not designed to favour your faith walk.They are skillfully and subtly designed to oppose, crush and cripple your faith in Christ.The systems of this world were structured by men, to redirect your desire, distract your focus, impair your emotions, thoughts and conviction in Christ.And many fellow saints have become victims of the strategy of the systems of this world.Many make excuses in their service to God and become dull.Instead of serving or laboring with much enthusiasm and steadfastness, they become complacent and make the pursuit of their own interest their focus.Don't be like them.Don't be a slave to this world.Many are being used by their institutions as slaves and they waste their call on perishable things.We are to work but not to be wasted by the world.Through the building up of the Word of Grace, you become impregnable and immunized to the strategies of this world.Beloved, as long as you are in Christ and have set your focus to intensively serve His course, you will face opposition and tribulation.But tribulation should not break you.You are designed and built by Christ, to glory in Tribulation. "By whom (Jesus Christ) also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;(Romans 5:2-3 KJV emphasis added) Greek word used for Tribulation in this verse is _Thlipsis_, which means a pressing or pressing together pressure, oppression, affliction, distress.To be afflicted or face tribulation, or to be oppressed or distressed is to be pressed.However, when you are pressed what issues out is your content.When you are pressured the divine virtues within, must issue out.God has filled you with Himself. Hence, when you are pressed, the best of God will come out of you.Get your inward substances well built, refuse to be broken no matter the afflictions that come your way.The word of His Grace builds us up. (Acts 20:32).It dispelled fear. Jesus said, " I have told you these things, so that in Me you may have [perfect] peace and confidence. In the world you have tribulation and trials and distress and frustration; but be of good cheer [take courage; be confident, certain, undaunted]! For I have overcome the world. [I have deprived it of power to harm you and have conquered it for you.]" (John 16:33 AMPC) Be undaunted! Be a confident! Be certain! Have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. They may push you, press you together yet they are deprived of the power to harm you.Maintain an undisturbed composure. Through the knowledge of Christ, take on courage. Be toughened, develop hard skin through building up of the Word.To do big things for God, you must have tough skin.Be God-occupied. Don't yield to challenges. Nothing has the capacity to work against you. Anything that comes in contact with you must work for your good. You were designed that way.You were not designed to be broken.Don't coil in at the sight of challenges, accusations, mockery and afflictions.Take advantage of the situations and challenges to resound the goodness of the Lord.Nothing should stop you from standing in the Truth, which is Christ.Don't think the people of the world are ahead of you. Remember the adversary is the father of lies. He is always playing catch up.Focus on the mandate the Lord has entrusted to you.Even if the whole world comes against you, YOU ARE BIGGER THAN THE WORLD. " But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world." 1 John 4:4 REMAIN IMMOVABLE, UNABASHED AND DEADLY COMMITTED TO THE VISION OF THE LORD!!! DIG DEEPER: (Romans 15:13; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Galatians 6:9; Philippians 2:30; Proverbs 21:21; Colossians 2:7; Psalm 43; John 16:33; 2 Corinthians 4:8-17; Romans 8:31-39) WE PRAY: - We pray, that in the midst of persecution, distress and challenge "the God of hope fill all the saints with all joy and peace as we trust in Him, so that we shall overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.- We pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, (for not everyone has faith But the Lord is faithful) and the Lord should strengthen us and protect us from the evil one. BIBLE READING DAY 50: Numbers 19-21 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am undaunted and confident!- I have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. Therefore I have overcome the world.-I may be push and pressed together yet they are deprived of the power to harm me.- I maintain an undisturbed composure.- Through the knowledge of Christ, I take on courage.I am toughened and I have hard skin through the building up of the Word and prayer.- I do big things for God.-I am God-occupied.-I don't yield to challenges.-Nothing has the capacity to work against me.- Anything that comes in contact with me must work for my good.

title: EPISODE 62 - COMPLACENCY IS NOT AN OPTION
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. COMPLACENCY IS NOT AN OPTION "Woe to you who are complacent in Zion..." Amos 6:1 (NIV) As part of being diligent, and immovable you must intentionally continue in what the Lord has tasked you to do.God didn't design you to have one time success.It is not enough to be diligent yesterday and complacent today.Complacency is self-satisfaction, which will make you assume you have arrived.It leads to luke-warm and sluggishness.Most people become complacent and think they have arrived by how they compare themselves with others.Being ahead of others in spirituality and results doesn't mean you have reached the finished line. " For we dare not class ourselves or compare ourselves with those who commend themselves. But they, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise." 2 Corinthians 10:12 (NKJV) Don't stop half-way to boast about yesterday's results.There are people who only dwell and boast with their past glory.It is important to acknowledge every good thing you've achieved.However, when all you have to show to the world tomorrow is what you achieved yesterday, then you wasted today.Yesterday's success is to inspire you to do more today, and that becomes your testimony and inspiration for tomorrow.Your relevance today is not in the things you used do and achieve.How have you built on what you've done and achieved?What more have you done since yesterday?Apostle Paul did not press on because of past glory. He pressed on towards the goal.Goals are not in your past. Goals are ahead of you.If you reached yesterday's goal, then set new goals and start working towards them today.How you succeeded yesterday, is not enough for your success today.You must grow deeper in knowledge and understanding. You must understand the things you have to put aside from yesterday and the things you must carry along today. You must know the new things you need to add to what you already have, to achieve more today.It is not how many hours you used to pray. It's how many hours you pray now.It is not how you used to reach out to win souls. It's how many souls you are winning now.It is not how many days you used to fast and pray. It's how you do them better now.It is not how many Churches you have planted and helped. It's how many new churches you're planting today.It is not how many people you used to raise for the Lord. It's how many people you are raising now.It's not how you used to give into kingdom assignment. It's how much more grace you have received to give today.It is not how you used to be consistent with ministerial instructions. It's how consistent you are today in ministry.Not the testimonies you used to see in your life. However, the more testimonies you are seeing now.Beloved, you must be committed to make progress today. PRESS ON! BE THE BEST GOD WANTS YOU TO BE TODAY!DON'T EVER STOP! " No, dear brothers and sisters, I have not achieved it, but I focus on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead, I press on to reach the end of the race and receive the heavenly prize for which God, through Christ Jesus, is calling us." Philippians 3:13-14 NLT SHALOMDIG DEEPER: (1 Corinthians 9:24-27; Revelation 2:4; Revelation 3:1-22; Hebrews 6:12; Joshua 14:6-15) WE PRAY: We pray that we won’t trade our fervency to do more for the Lord with anything. We take grace to press on to the finished line as the Lord has determined. BIBLE READING DAY 51: Numbers 22-25 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I don't boast in the past.- I press on towards the goal.- I achieve new goals set before me by the Lord.- I celebrate yesterday's success but i don't dwell there.- I press on to produce more fruits today.- Everyday is a new season to achieve new goals.- I don't stop here.

title: EPISODE 63 - THIS IS WAR 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.  THIS IS WAR 1  “ This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you're not on my side, you're the enemy; if you're not helping, you're making things worse." Matthew 12:30 (Message Bible) When you became born again, you were translated or conveyed from the power of darkness into the Kingdom of the Son of His love (Colossians 1:13).This mandate of the Kingdom did not end with you.The Lord is still in the business of conveying many from the power of darkness into His Kingdom.This is the business of the Kingdom and you were brought into the Kingdom to be a Steward of this business.Get this, God did not make you a King and a Priest (Revelation 1:6), just for you to enjoy the luxury and extravagance of divine royalty and Christ's love.We are made Kings and Priests in Christ to be involved in the assignment of the Kingdom. "But you are God’s chosen treasure— priests who are kings, a spiritual “nation” set apart as God’s devoted ones. He called you out of darkness to experience his marvelous light, and now he claims you as his very own. He did this so that you would broadcast his glorious wonders throughout the world" 1 Peter 2:9 (TPT) We have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel.There are forces of darkness working to gather and oppress men and turn men against God's glorious agenda of the Kingdom. "For they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty".
