Revelation 16:14 (NKJV) The forces of darkness are in serious business day and night, to turn the people of this world against God and to wage war with the Lord.The adversary is not waiting for the future to strike against God and his Kingdom. He is in business today. Nothing just happens; there are many things turning people away from God and His love in our day, which are part of the plottings of darkness.God's mandate has never been unopposed. The adversary has always been on the go to distract, oppose, weary and to contend with God's people.Many have set themselves up to be enemies of the gospel.They use every single medium to achieve their evil intentions.Yes, the devil and his cohorts have no chance against the Kingdom of light.But the question is, HOW ARE YOU INVOLVED?Did you see what Jesus said in the opening scripture above?Where do you belong?Take note, there is no middle (neutral) ground.If you are doing nothing, you are not helping and you are making things worse.At the end of all things each man's work in this war shall be judged. (2 Corinthians 5:9-10)Are you sitting on the fence or you are relentlessly involved in the mandate of the Kingdom?Look at what Mordecai told Esther, when she gave what seem to be genuine excuse not to fight for the people of God: "Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews. For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"Esther 4:13-14 (KJV) God has brought you into His kingdom and placed you in that school or institution, office or organization, political space, community or neighbourhood, hospital, firm at such a time as this, to make the light of the Kingdom shine.When you fail to be involved in God's business, He will raise someone else for the assignment and hold you accountable.As Saul failed in the assignment God gave him, God raised David who will do His will.(1 Samuel 15; 16:1; Acts 13:21-22).The expansion of the Kingdom, is now our business and mandate.God has made us Saviours from Zion, and that includes you. (Obadiah 1:21)As we have been made sons of God, we must take up the mandate of the Kingdom.In the kingdom of God there are no civilians; though we are all citizens.We are made kings and priests (that is responsibility).And as Kings, we don't sit in the palace to have fun.We are trained by God to be good soldiers.Refuse to be at ease. (Amos 6:1)Be part of the war. Be involved in what God is doing.You are God's agent of transformation.Take up your responsibility today.DIG DEEPER: (Matthew 16:18-19; Psalm 144:1; Jeremiah 1:3-9; 17-19; 2 Corinthians 10:3-5;) WE PRAY: That the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps which will make us get ministerial results. BIBLE READING DAY 52: Numbers 26-27 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - We are sharpened by the Lord for His great work this year.- I am a helper of the war.- I conquer and win territories for the Lord.- We shall be immovable as steel post.- By the relentless power of God we are enabled to subdue kingdoms.- We are as solid as concrete block.‐We stand together as a team, no matter the opposition.- We topple and crush systems of this world.- The Lord is with us, we fear no evil- We don't sit on the fence.- We labour through faith.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 64 - THIS IS WAR 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.THIS IS WAR 2  “ This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you're not on my side, you're the enemy; if you're not helping, you're making things worse." Matthew 12:30 (Message Bible) From yesterday's discussion, we established the matter that there is a war, and as long as you are in the Kingdom, you must be involved.When you became born again, you were not only conveyed into the Kingdom of the Son of His love (Colossians 1:13); you were also made a king and a priest (Revelation 1:6), through Christ Jesus.You have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel.And you must do this with a mindset of a soldier.God made you a king-priest and enlisted you to be a soldier in His army. This assignment is war, and you cannot approach it with the mindset of a civilian.Observe Paul's statement to Timothy: "Thou, therefore, endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier." 2 Timothy 2:3-4 (KJV). There are some few items to outline from these two verses: i. You are chosen by God as a good (Victorious) soldier of Jesus Christ.ii. As a soldier you must endure hardships.The Passion translation puts it this way:" Overcome every form of evil as a victorious soldier of Jesus the Anointed One".Which means we overcome or endure because we already have the victory in Christ Jesus. We are waging war from the victory we have received in Christ Jesus.iii. As a man of war, you don't live as a civilian."No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life" And that is how you will please the Lord who enlisted you.As you are called to active duty of a soldier, you have to divorce yourself from the distractions and ordinary business of this life.Concentrate on carrying out divine orders.Your first priority is the mandate of the kingdom as a soldier of Christ.You are a kinging soldier and God's weapon of war against the kingdoms and the systems which set themselves against the Lord.These are the Lord's words to you dearly beloved; "You are my battle-ax and sword,” says the LORD. “With you I will shatter nations and destroy many kingdoms. With you I will shatter armies— destroying the horse and rider, the chariot and charioteer" Jeremiah 51:20-21 (NLT). As God's soldier and weapon of war, you don't function by your selfish cravings; submit yourself to His will.He works in you both to will and to do.You don't operate by your strength in the flesh. The Lord supplies you with His strength unto His ordained good works. Therefore, live your life empowered by God’s free-flowing grace, which is your true strength, found in the anointing of Jesus and your union with Him! (2 Timothy 2:1)ShalomDIG DEEPER (2 Samuel 23:8-39; Judges 7; 1 Corinthians 9:19-27; 2 Timothy 4:5; 1 Timothy 1:18).  BIBLE READING Day 53: Numbers 28-30  DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I am God's weapon of war- I am enlisted in His army. Therefore, I don't function as a civilian- I am committed to the mandate of the kingdom.-I discipline myself to live as a victorious soldier of Christ.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 65 - THIS IS WAR 3 [GIVE YOURSELF TO TRAINING]
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.THIS IS WAR 3GIVE YOURSELF TO TRAINING “ A Psalm of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, Who trains my hands for war, And my fingers for battle" Psalm 144:1 (NKJV) As an enlisted soldier in God's army, you have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel.As a royal priest, you are to show forth the glory of Him, who called you out of darkness into His light. (1 Peter 2:9).This war is between light and darkness.This war is about the salvation of souls.It is about subduing kingdoms and taking unreached territories for the Lord and unto His glory.You must have this strong mindset that God has made you a soldier.And as a soldier you must submit to a certain kind of training and mindset.It is through the training of the Lord that you are strengthened.From the opening verse you see David declaring how he won battles and war."the Lord trains my hands for war, and my fingers for battles"Through training you are taught, equipped, empowered, instructed and tried through tasks.You maybe in Christ and be thinking like a civilian, instead of a soldier. You don't get invovled in the training and the sending of the Lord.You only want to be served and pampered in Church.However, the Church of our Lord Jesus is an army.You see the Church only as a "hospital". You just attend meetings for your needs and well-being.That is not totally wrong, but the Church is more than a "hospital".The Church is both a family and an army.Jesus said, " ...I will build my church, and all the powers of hell[b] will not conquer it" Matthew 16:18 (NLT). When you come for Church meetings, you are equipped for the work of the ministry. "And he has appointed some with grace to be apostles, and some with grace to be prophets, and some with grace to be evangelists, and some with grace to be pastors, and some with grace to be teachers. And their calling is to nurture and prepare all the holy believers to do their own works of ministry, and as they do this they will enlarge and build up the body of Christ" Ephesians 4:11-12 (TPT). This is how Jesus is building His Church.You are trained to serve as a victorious (good) soldier.Before Paul asked Timothy to "...endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ..." He told him, "...the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also." 2 Timothy 2:2 (NKJV) You can see that, Timothy was a soldier who submitted to training and teaching. And he has the responsibility as a leading soldier to also train others also. But those who will be trained must be proven faithful that they will continue in that process as well.Timothy did not just function as a good soldier, he was responsive to instructions. And instructions are designed to help you wage a good warfare. " Timothy, my son, here are my instructions for you, based on the prophetic words spoken about you earlier. May they help you fight well in the Lord’s battles" 1 Timothy 1:18 ( NLT). He was instructed by Paul the apostle that;No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier." 2 Timothy 2:3-4 (KJV). You don't just go out there to wage war, you are trained and equipped through God's word daily and weekly. This is the purpose of Church meetings.Your absence from Church meetings, is your absence from training.How do you wage good warfare without training and instructions?As God's weapon of war or battle axe (Jeremiah 51:20-21), you must be sharpened.See Ecclesiastes 10:10: " Using a dull ax requires great strength, so sharpen the blade. That’s the value of wisdom; it helps you succeed" (NLT) " If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do." ( CEV) This is why Jesus didn't ask us to go forth to just win souls, He commissioned us to make disciples (students) — Matthew 28:19.The principle Jesus demonstrated to us was, win, build and send. That is how we expand God's kingdom and army (workforce).The Lord told Jeremiah;“ Stand at attention while I prepare you for your work. I’m making you as impregnable as a castle, Immovable as a steel post, solid as a concrete block wall. You’re a one-man defense system against this culture, Against Judah’s kings and princes, against the priests and local leaders.They’ll fight you, but they won’t even scratch you. I’ll back you up every inch of the way.” God’s Decree. Jeremiah 1:18-19 (MSG). Beloved, as a soldier in the Kingdom, submit to a ministry where you will be trained to function triumphantly.SelahDIG DEEPER( Deuteronomy 32:41;1 Corinthians 4:17; 1 Timothy 1:5; Ephesians 6:12-18; 2 Samuel 22:35; Psalm 18:2,31,34; Psalm 44:3,4; Psalm 60:12) PRAYER:Dear Lord, teach me to humbly submit to your nurturing and training, through my local Church, that I may be good soldier. BIBLE READINGDay 54: Numbers 31-34 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I humbly submit to training.- The Lord teaches my hands for war and my fingers for battle.- the Lord is my strength.- I am equipped.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 66 - BE VALIANT 1 (THIS IS WAR 4)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.BE VALIANT 1 (THIS IS WAR 4)" Through God we will do valiantly, For it is He who shall tread down our enemies"Psalm 60:12 (NKJV) What you  are determines what you do.You must walk in the consciousness of who you are in Christ.As you are born of God, you are an overcomer (1 John 5:4).Until this becomes your consciousness, it will not reflect in what you do.Yes, we are at war; nevertheless we are not in this war with the hope that we will win.We are in this war with the confidence that we have won.Thus you are enlisted by God in a victorious battle. You came into this war as more than a conqueror. "Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors and gain an overwhelming victory through Him who loved us [so much that He died for us]." Romans 8:37 (Amplified Bible). This is our joy and boldness. We are not in this war thinking we will fail.This war is about the salvation of souls.It is about subduing kingdoms and taking unreached territories for the Lord and unto His glory.This is not for the faint-hearted. Neither is it for the one who loves himself and the pleasures of this world.The faint-hearted is focused on himself or herself and occupied with his strength and weaknesses.You must have this strong mindset that God is with you; therefore you fight valiantly.When you make the Lord and His supply your consciousness, you will see yourself as the Lord sees you.The word Valiant is the same word as Valor ( the Hebrew word is, chayil or hāyil); which is a force of an army or resources (and wealth). It also speaks of the strength of a great company; the might of a great army in a war or the power of riches.To do valiantly (in Psalm 60:12) means to work, act with effect, to perform and accomplish with the force of a great and mighty army using all the power of resources of wealth supplied.This gives an idea of how you are to function as a good (victorious) Soldier of Christ.You are not in a weak army to act cowardly.You have enormous supply of resources at your disposal.You don't have an excuse not to accomplish mighty things through God.You have all the weapons, and the equipment needed for every battle and the war at large.You don't have to see yourself as a grasshopper as the ten spies of Israel did. "And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight" Numbers 13:33 (KJV))  Listen to the teaching Prevailing Mentality by .(See video below)https://youtu.be/UFoDqxWmkqcCaleb and Joshua were different, they had the consciousness of God's presence (that is the consciousness of their advantage and might).The other ten (10) spies saw giants and were afraid. Caleb and Joshua saw the sons of Anak as:bread and defenseless. (Numbers 14:9)Caleb and Joshua were fearless because they had the consciousness that the Lord is with them. (Numbers 14:9).Now look at God's testimony of Caleb:" But as for My servant Caleb, because he has had a different spirit and has followed Me fully, I will bring him into the land which he entered, and his descendants shall take possession of it." Numbers 14:24 (NASB).This should be God's testimony about you.To have a different spirit also means a different attitude. This is an attitude of a mighty man of valor.To be a mighty man valor or to do valiantly, is not to have huge physical muscles.To accomplish valiantly is to have strong confidence in God's word and to diligently follow God fully or consistently remain committed to God without turning away to create room for doubts.This is what great faith is!Doubters are cowards and cannot do anything big through God.Take hold of God's word to act in faith. This is another level of training in God's army. You are built and equipped on the battle field as you put God's word to work. And as you continue in this you will wax valiantly." And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions. Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in the fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens." Hebrews 11:32-34 (KJV).HallelujahDIG DEEPER( 2 Corinthians 10:3-5; Ephesians 6:12-18; Numbers 13:21-33; Numbers 14:1-9; Hebrews 11; Acts 4:8-14,29-31 ) PRAYER:- Dear Lord, open the eyes of my understanding to see the immeasurable resources, that my heart may be strengthened in you.- I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READINGDay 55: Numbers 35-36 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't walk in fear.-I refuse to doubt God no matter the challenge.- I walk in boldness.- I accomplish great things by the strength of God.- I am a valiant soldier.- The Lord teaches my hands for war and my fingers for battle.- The Lord is my strength.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 67 - A QUICK CHARGE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. A QUICK CHARGE There is so much I have shared with you on this platform, don't hesitate to share your thoughts and how you have been blessed in the comment section.You can as well send an email to me via apostlebennie@christcommonwealth.org.Today I want you to patiently think on these:Are you committed to the course of Christ? And if yes, why?Are you pushing beyond your comfort and self interest, just to see lives saved and transformed, no matter the cost involved?Do you think going all out for the Lord is a waste of time?Certainly Not!!!Do you think it is unnecessary to give financially into kingdom assignment?Do you think those who give bountifully don't have anything else to use money for?What more is worth your money than the Lord's assignment?What more is worth your time than the Lord's mandate?What more is worth your skill, intelligence, and resources? " With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don't hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort."1Corinthians 15:57 (The Message) Beloved, this kingdom business has been God's business all this while. (2 Corinthians 5:19)He desires that all men will be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth (1 Timothy 2:4).Our Lord first made a great sacrifice: "Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: [And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross." Philippians 2:6-8 (Amplified Bible). Jesus being fully God, He lowered Himself to become man and humbled Himself to suffer the death of the cross.It wasn't for nothing!!He sacrificed all He is and all that He's got just to die this death of shame for mankind.There must be something more important about His death for Him to leave all that glory to become man and to die for man.It is this same thing that moved Jesus to the cross, which is moving us to do all we have to do according to the grace given us.The strategy of adversary is to sow seeds of doubts in your heart to distract you. Don't give space for the adversary to corrupt your desire for the Lord and His work.There is a cry in the soul of this generation and beyond for hope and salvation.How beautiful it is that in this crooked and dark generation, you become the light to many?In a generation where people are departing from the faith, becoming lovers of self and money; you have made a choice to stand up for the course of Christ.Don't make excuses. Don't be part of those who seek their own gain.Make a decision to stand out and shine forth. " Get out of bed, Jerusalem! Wake up. Put your face in the sunlight. God’s bright glory has risen for you. The whole earth is wrapped in darkness, all people sunk in deep darkness, But God rises on you, his sunrise glory breaks over you. Nations will come to your light, kings to your sunburst brightness" Isaiah 60:1-3 (MSG) Jesus said, as long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world. (John 9:5)This same ministry of God in Christ Jesus is your ministry today. (2 Corinthians 5:17-18)Every single contribution is important and needful unto satisfying God's dream.Leave no stone unturned. Take advantage of the Holy Spirit inspired and directed ability within you to turn on the divine course in many.There are certain people who wouldn't be reached out to until you step out to reach them. The Lord will demand their blood from you. (Ezekiel 3:18; Acts 20:26)Don't sit to watch a generation destroyed.Until YOU get involved, a particular soul will not be reached.They can only hear to receive the Lord, only when you go to preach. "For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?" (Romans 10:13-14) There are many more depending on your sacrifices, bold steps, relentless decisions, uncompromising choices, and unconditional Love of Christ.Be compelled by the Love of Christ.Don't only preach, put your money into GOD'S AGENDA. God's AGENDA will be financed through GOD'S OWN PEOPLE.Be a faithful steward of God and partner with the spreading of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.Pray also for the salvation of souls in your community, in your city, in your town, in your school, in your work place, in your family, in your country, your continent and the whole world.Don't go on your knees in prayer only for your personal needs. You are a royal priest in Christ. Fulfill that priestly mandate.Decide to be a CONDUIT FOR THE SPREAD OF THE GOSPEL BY TAKING PRACTICAL STEPS.HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Matthew 4:16; Isaiah 9:6;Philippians 2:30; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Galatians 6:17; Acts 20:24; 2 Corinthians 12:15) WE PRAY:That our hearts shall not grow weary in doing good. And we shall see many come into the light as we shine the light of the glory of God in our generation to see many transformed in all wisdom and power. BIBLE READINGDay 56: Deuteronomy 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't grow weary.- I refuse to be distracted.- I shine the light of God in my generation.- I stand up for the course of Christ in my generation.- I reachout to souls and give into the spread of the gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 68 - TO ADVANCE THE KINGDOM; YOU MUST BE PERSUASIVE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. TO ADVANCE THE KINGDOM; YOU MUST BE PERSUASIVE "Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences" 2 Corinthians 5:11 (NKJV) To PERSUADE ( Peitho) signifies "to apply persuasion, to prevail upon or win over, to persuade," bringing about a change of mind by the influence of reason or moral considerations. It is to induce one by words to cause belief in a thing (which one sets forth), to make friends of, win one's favor, gain one's good-will, or to seek or strive to win one. (See Vine Expository and Strong's Dictionary). In a parable Jesus shared in Luke 14 a certain man invited many to join him in a great feast. But one by one they all made excuses, on the day of the feast. Yet see what the master said to his servant: "And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled" Luke 14:23 After the previous excuses the master changed his approach or instruction. It was no longer about invitation, it is now a matter of COMPELLING/PERSUADING ( Anagkazó). This is how we have to think towards God's work. Until we compel men we will not see God's work done as He wants it done. Anagkazó means to put constraint upon whether by threat, entreaty, force or persuasion. Men will always choose the "self" or their own selfish desires. Men will struggle to choose Christ and the things of Christ. They already see themselves as enemies of God in their minds. (Colossians 1:21) But we have the duty to make many turn to the Lord and to see His Love. We have a duty to snatch men from darkness. "and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh" Jude 1:23 (American Standard Version) Will you stand to watch a friend or another man to commit suicide whiles you can help? When you see someone walking by a road side and doesn't see an oncoming vehicle, you will find a way to save that fellow if you truly care. This is how it is. There are many who are heading towards destruction. Some knowingly and others unknowingly. To reject Christ is as committing eternal suicide. For one to reject Christ means he or she has denied his or her eternal security. Are you going to look on for others to perish? Certainly not! Have you heard this before?"Being born again is not a necessity, everyone has the right to choose his or her own path of religion and salvation". What did you think about it? And this:"If they will not attend the Church meeting it is not by force." Interesting... Listen, apart from Jesus, " Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved" Acts 4:12. Salvation is only in JESUS. And when they reject Jesus they perish. (John 3:16) Men who have not received the Lord, don't know they need salvation and how to get saved. The God of this world has blinded their minds (2 Corinthians 4:4) Others have their lives controlled by demons. Therefore, until they are persuaded through God's Spirit and our relentless pursuit, they cannot decide to receive Jesus nor be involved in ministry. Most excuses people make are by selfish, demonic, ungodly influences. There are people who may want to attend a Church meeting but the forces controlling them prevents them from deciding. So they find excuses to make. Though those excuses are not true, they will try to stand by them. Thus, we must be relentless, since we know what they need. Understand that we are not wrestling just with their choices but the forces governing their thoughts. Therefore, we PERSUADE THEM. We also don't take "NO" as an answer, no matter how polite or hostile they sound. SNATCH THEM OUT OF THE FIRE. SNATCH THEM OUT OF DARKNESS. The Lord has given you power through the Spirit to do this. Do it at all cost! Because the LOVE of CHRIST IS AT WORK IN YOU, you will take steps to see others saved and to come to knowledge of the truth. This is God's desire (1 Timothy 2:4) GO OUT THERE TO SAVE MEN AND DON'T TAKE "NO" AS AN ANSWER. COMPEL THEM, SNATCH THEM, AND PERSUADE THEM TO COME IN, SO THE LORD'S HOUSE MAY BE FULL. YOU ARE THE MAN FOR THE JOB. HallelujahDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:1-2; Luke 14:15-24; Romans 1:16; 1 Corinthians 9:12; 2 Corinthians 5:11-21) WE PRAY:That we increase in the wisdom to strategically get men saved no matter the hostility and hindrances. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READINGDay 58: Deuteronomy 4-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I relentlessly persuade men to be saved. - I have a strong heart and genuine passion of love for the unreached souls. - I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ. - As a light bearer I cannot be intimidated by darkness. - I get many saved at all cost.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 69 - EXCITED TO TELL YOU THIS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. EXCITED TO TELL YOU THIS"God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord" 1 Corinthians 1:9 (NKJV). HURRRAAAAAY!!! It's a new month and a new day.Whiles writing this I see the Lord ushering you faithful reader into a new season of love and testimonies.The Lord has blessed this month with His refreshing presence.He wants to take your hand and take you on a walk.Trust Him!!!Yield to the overwhelming beauty of His immeasurable love.The Lord wants to take you on a journey of love, faith and excellence.He wants the world to see Him in you.He didn't just come to save you from destruction and eternal condemnation through Christ.He gave you His life and brought you into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.Glory to God. Did you read the opening verse?Look at it: "God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord" 1 Corinthians 1:9 (NKJV). Beloved, this is a great news: GOD HAS CALLED US INTO THE FELLOWSHIP OF HIS SON, JESUS OUR LORD! I can't stop thinking and rejoicing over this.The word for FELLOWSHIP is koinōnia, which means:partnership.This speaks of our participation in God's life and purpose.It also means intercourse, communication, communion, contribution and distribution.God proved His faithfulness to all His promises, by calling us into fellowship with Jesus.This is beautiful and marvels the heart. Considering who Jesus is in all of His glory, Lordship and preeminence; yet we are called by God into fellowship with Him.We are called to be contributors in the expression of the life of Christ.We are called to have participation in His life and vision.God didn't bring us into Himself to demand worship from us.Is it to say we don't have to worship God?Not at all!Worship is our response to God and His glory. When you see God in the beauty of His presence you will worship Him.This reveals the core of His mandate, which is for Him to have eternal communion with us.We are to have a deeper communication and union with Him. This is an eternal intercourse where you drink of Him and you become the satisfaction of His pleasure.This is a call which transcends the struggle of the flesh, and the management of sin.This is a call where only God and His life matters.Our fellowship in Christ is not an informal social gathering.Our fellowship in Christ is a matter of His life in us and we being His organic living.Our fellowship in Christ is a matter of partnership in His life and expressions.It is not a weekly activity. It is a share in His essence.Through fellowship you feel as the Lord feels. You see as the Lord sees and walk in the fullness of His reality.Beloved in this communion, you are the object of His love; therefore He also must be the object of your love.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 7:9; Romans 8:28, 30; John 15:4-5; 1 Corinthians 1:1-9) WE PRAY:- Thanking the Lord for calling us into the fellowship of His son Jesus.That our hearts will be set on the understanding of the beauty of this great call of fellowship with Jesus our Lord, by God. BIBLE READINGDay 59: Deuteronomy 8-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I thank the Lord for the opportunity to share in His life.- I am conscious of my communion with the Father through Christ.- I am a distributor of the Love of Christ.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 70 - CHRIST YOUR TRUE PASSOVER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.CHRIST YOUR TRUE PASSOVERGleanings From The Passover WeekThe Triumphal Entry 1"Rejoice, O people of Zion! Shout in triumph, O people of Jerusalem! Look, your king is coming to you. He is righteous and victorious, yet he is humble, riding on a donkey— riding on a donkey’s colt."Zechariah 9:9 (NLT) This Sunday, some Churches may celebrate the Triumphant entry of Jesus. Some call it the "Palm Sunday". Interestingly, only few people understand the significance of this event.The whole week is set in memorial of the death, burial and resurrection of Jesus.Sadly, some churches reserve the teachings of Christ and His finished work only for the Easter Celebration. Afterwards they go about teaching their own doctrines. "I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ. But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.As we said before, so say I now again, if any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ."Galatians 1:6-10 (KJV) There is only one message we have which is CHRIST. The gospel and revelation of our Lord Jesus is the centricity of the message of the Church.In the Gospel of Jesus:- The victory of the New Creation is unveiled.-You will behold your success.-You will embrace the love of God and His eternal forgiveness.-You will become conscious of the higher life God has called you to live.- Believers will enjoy the life God has intended for them and be relevant in the Kingdom business.It's important to comprehend the truth of God about you in Christ.For the truth about you is Christ.Only few people have got into serious study of the Word. And have made it their intention to commit themselves to the ministration of the Word through the Spirit.Even some Teachers and Pastors are finding it difficult to rightly divide the word because, they have not given themselves to the Spirit of the Word. The Church meetings ought to be times where believers are trained into maturity in the knowledge of Christ.It is not the sharing of the knowledge of human idealism and philosophies. "See to it that no one takes you captive by philosophy and empty deceit, according to human tradition, according to the elemental spirits of the world, and not according to Christ" Colossians 2:8 (ESV) "And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God. For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified." 1 Corinthians 2:1 ( KJV). Teachers of the Word are not to fix their interests in the peddling of the truth (2 Corinthians 2:17) but should administer the mind of God. Those whom Christ died for deserve to receive and enjoy the treasures of the Lord.Believers shouldn't engage themselves in activities and celebrations without understanding. Whatsoever is written in the Word has its purpose and should be understood.Every year in the month of Nisan, the Jews had their Passover Celebration. This Celebration is focused on God's powerful message to the world. This was when God delivered the children of Israel from Egypt through the BLOOD OF THE PASSOVER LAMB.Now we have Jesus, who is the substance of the sacrifices and the Jewish festivals. "Therefore let no one judge you in regard to food and drink or in regard to [the observance of] a festival or a new moon or a Sabbath day. Such things are only a shadow of what is to come and they have only symbolic value; but the substance [the reality of what is foreshadowed] belongs to Christ." Colossians 2:16-17 (Amplified) The Passover lamb in Exodus 12 foreshadowed Jesus who is the PERFECT PASSOVER.The triumphal entry was a preparation for the Passover Week and for the death and resurrection of Jesus.The very day that Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the colt of a donkey was the 10th day of Nisan (See both Exodus 12 and John 12).That day is known among Jews as the "Lamb Selection Day".Wow!It was on this day that the lamb that were going to be used in the Temple for the Passover were brought into Jerusalem. At the first passover which took place in Egypt, God instructed the Israelites to take each lamb into each home to be inspected or scrutinized. The lamb was scrutinized for 4 days. This was to check if the lamb is suitable for the sacrifice. It should be blameless and also be a male of the first year. (See Exodus 12:1-5). The lamb with no blemish will be slained on the 14th day of Nisan.This is beautiful!Beloved, Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the Lamb Selection Day, which is the 10th Day of Nisan. He rode into His household. He was scrutinized by them even unto the 14th day.In Exodus 12 it was stated that the passover lamb had to be examined. Jesus who is the lamb of God that takes away the sin of the world (John 1:29) was scrutinized or examined by the highest authorities in the land.Herod (the king) scrutinized Him, Caiaphas (the High Priest), and even Pontius Pilate. Pontius Pilate represented the entire body of Gentiles and the whole world. Remember Rome was ruling the world by then. Jesus was without blemish at all levels of laws, regulations and scrutiny.Jesus really died for all sins. He satisfied all laws. He was even judged beyond the law of Moses and was still blameless.Oh what a perfect lamb the Father prepared for us to satisfy all the demands of Justice.Yet on the 14th day of Nisan, at exactly 9am in the morning, Jesus was nailed to the cross. As the animals were taken into the temple to be sacrificed. Exactly the time set for the last lamb to be killed by the High Priest, at 3pm, Jesus cried out "IT IS FINISHED" and He gave up His Spirit. Nobody took His Spirit from Him. You see just as the High Priest was the one to kill the last lamb, the same happened with Jesus. It was Caiaphas who initiated His death; and on the cross, Jesus who is also our High Priest, gave up His Spirit.Hallelujah!Jesus is the Perfect lamb that was CONDEMNED ONCE and for ALL.My dear in Christ, you should know that as the lamb of God was judged for you; God CANNOT CONDEMN You.SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(Exodus 12; John 12; Luke 24:27; hebrews 8:5; Hebrews 9:9; 1 Corinthians 5:6-8) WE PRAY:Thanking the Lord for our Lord Jesus who bore all our iniquities and justified us through His blood. BIBLE READINGDay 60: Deuteronomy 11 -13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am perfected by the blood of the perfect lamb of God.- I focus on Christ who is the substance of truth.- Christ is God's perfect sacrifice for me, therefore I am justified.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 71 - THE LORD HAS NEED OF IT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE LORD HAS NEED OF IT "And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you loosing it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Lord has need of it." Luke 19:31 (NKJV). There is so much to discuss this week. As I have already began to look into "Jesus' Triumphant entry" into Jerusalem. And also the details of the passover celebration.Luke 19:31, is also worth our attention.There is a general thought that the Lord being self-sufficient has no needs.However, we see here that, the Lord needed to use the donkey.Let's see some more details of the story: "As he came to the towns of Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two disciples ahead. “Go into that village over there,” he told them. “As you enter it, you will see a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here. If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying that colt?’ just say, ‘The Lord needs it.’"So they went and found the colt, just as Jesus had said. And sure enough, as they were untying it, the owners asked them, “Why are you untying that colt?” And the disciples simply replied, “The Lord needs it.” So they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it for him to ride on. As he rode along, the crowds spread out their garments on the road ahead of him. When he reached the place where the road started down the Mount of Olives, all of his followers began to shout and sing as they walked along, praising God for all the wonderful miracles they had seen." Luke 19:29-36I have this question to ask you? WHAT MORE SHOULD CHRIST SAY TO CONVINCE YOU BEFORE YOU CAN GIVE YOUR VALUABLE TREASURE? This is one of the verses of the Bible the Holy Spirit shone in my heart to make me a giver and also to avail myself for the Lord's use.The promptness of the owners of the donkey amazes me.Of course "the earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein" (Psalm 24:1). This includes the young donkey, the Lord requested.Nevertheless, the scriptures referred to unknown owners, who didn't hesitate to give the donkey for the Master's use.Though they were owners of the donkey the Master needed, they saw themselves as stewards.This makes it easy for you to give to the Lord what you possess.David (the King of Israel) said:*"But who am I, and who are my people, that we could give anything to you? Everything we have has come from you, and we give you only what you first gave us!"* 1 Chronicles 29:14 (NLT) Whatever you have was first given to you by the Lord. Which means your giving to the Lord is an honour to the Lord.In the days of Jesus, a donkey was one of the treasured possessions an average Jew may have. Moreover the donkey Jesus requested for had not even been used before.Yet, the only explanation the disciples were to give to the owners was that “The Lord has need of it.”They didn't give the motive or reason behind the request.The owners offered the animal without delay, no matter how precious it was to them.It wasn't a donkey they had used and benefited from.It was young, new and valuable.Learn to give God your best. It is not just about giving to the Lord, it's how you give and the value of what you give.Understand that whatever, Christ will ask from you shall be for the purpose of His Kingdom.What do you have that Christ is asking for?How difficult is it for you to give towards the Lord?Do you see Him as the Lord of all?See how the Passion Translation puts it: "And if anyone stops you and asks, ‘What are you doing?’ just tell them this: ‘It is needed for the Lord of All.'" Luke 19:31 (TPT) Beloved, the Lord will need your money, time, house, yourself and even your family (it may be your sons and daughters), for the expansion of His kingdom.What will be your response?The truth is, whiles reading this message, the Lord is speaking to your heart. He is making a request and telling you of what to give.Don't hold back, be prompt.There are times you may feel what you have is not the best.Cheer up...What you have is enough. As long as the Lord has need of it, He will turn it into a treasure and a tool for His glory and kingdom advancement.The donkey which was tied became an instrument of the Kingdom and Honour.Jesus has always been a specialist of making the best out of the ordinary.A little boy's lunch in the hands of Jesus, fed more than 5000 people. (Take note: the men alone numbered 5000).Remember how a fisherman's boat, became an item for the kingdom advancement.What about how Jesus trained and turned his disciples (who were fishermen and not scholars), into learned fishers of men who shook the whole world.These men yielded themselves for to the Lord for His use.From Luke 19, you will see how a donkey, became a Kingdom celebrity just because He became useful to the Lord.Whatever we give unto the Lord is multiplied by the Lord with glory.You cannot give what you have to the Lord until you have first given yourself to Him.See what Paul the apostle said concerning the Macedonians: "For I testify that according to their ability, and beyond their ability, they gave voluntarily, begging us insistently for the privilege of participating in the service for [the support of] the saints [in Jerusalem]. Not only [did they give materially] as we had hoped, but first they gave themselves to the Lord and to us [as His representatives] by the will of God [disregarding their personal interests and giving as much as they possibly could]." 2 Corinthians 8:3-5 (Amplified Bible). Beloved the LORD HAS NEED OF YOU.DIG DEEPER(John 6:5-13; 1 Chronicles 29:9; Luke 5:1-11; ) WE PRAY:That the Lord will teach our hearts to honour Him with our lives and all that He has blessed us with for the advancement of the Kingdom. BIBLE READINGDay 61 Deuteronomy 14-17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I honour the Lord with my best.- I don't make excuses as the Lord deserves to have my possessions for His kingdom work.- The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement.- I am excited to give unto the Lord, because its the greatest privilege.- Whenever the Lord is in need of me, I avail myself with promptness- Whatever the Lord will request from me, I give with joy.- I am a prompt to do it giver.- All that I have is the Lord's and for His kingdom advancement.-My family, my house, money, intelligence, time, all resources and life are for the Lord's use.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 72 - THE LORD HAS NEED OF IT 2 (Motive of Service)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE LORD HAS NEED OF IT 2 (Motive of Service) "And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you loosing it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Lord has need of it." Luke 19:31 (NKJV). Before we finally proceed, there is a quick thought I want you to consider.Yesterday we looked at how the Lord has need of you and your possession, for the Kingdom expansion.From Luke 19, we saw how a donkey became a Kingdom celebrity, because He was useful to the Lord. WHAT SHOULD BE YOUR MOTIVE IN GIVING YOURSELF TO THE LORD? Motives make a lot of difference. They determine the extent you go for the Lord. The right motives dispel any idea of disappointment.There are people who make themselves available and useful to the Lord because of what they will gain.You may be easily discouraged when your motives are centered on fame, power, social standing and financial gain.Yesterday, we realised the owners of the donkey didn't need to be convinced with many words.As they heard that the Master is in need of it, they didn't argue nor ask further questions.Which means, their motive for giving out the young donkey was the LORD.The only reason you must give your resources or even yourself to the Lord, must be the LORD!Doubtlessly there is honour in serving the Lord.But we must not serve the Lord because we want to be honoured or have an elevated social standing.Your joy should be that through your service to the Lord, many lives have been blessed and the Lord has been glorified.Our service to the Lord blesses people. It is not to use people as crosspieces on a ladder for your personal levitation to a towering applauds, validation, and prosperity.There has been times the emphasis moves to how the lonely donkey became honourable.However, what we must know is that, the motive of the owners was not their personal honour and fame nor that of the donkey. " ...Because the Lord..." Luke 19:31 (NKJV) Nobody celebrated the donkey, it was the Lord who was celebrated. "So they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it for him to ride on.As he rode along, the crowds spread out their garments on the road ahead of him.When he reached the place where the road started down the Mount of Olives, all of his followers began to shout and sing as they walked along, praising God for all the wonderful miracles they had seen." Luke 19:35-37 Nobody thought of the donkey, it was all about the Lord.Your joy of service to the Lord should be that, He is seen, celebrated, praised and honoured.John the baptist said, " He must increase in importance, while I must decrease in importance. " John 3:30 (Names of God Bible) I ask you the same question I asked yesterday: WHAT MORE SHOULD CHRIST SAY TO CONVINCE YOU BEFORE YOU CAN GIVE YOUR VALUABLE TREASURE? We saw the little boy, who selflessly gave his lunch out to Jesus and it fed more than 5000 people.(John 6:1-15)The young boy didn't consider Himself. His motive was this: Jesus needs it, I will trust Him with it. The joy of our service and giving to the Lord is for the impact of the Lord in the lives of others.In 2 Corinthians 12:15, Paul said, " And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself.If I love you more, will you love me less?" (Berean Standard Bible) From the Message Bible:" I’d be most happy to empty my pockets, even mortgage my life, for your good. So how does it happen that the more I love you, the less I’m loved?" Amplified:" But I will very gladly spend [my own resources] and be utterly spent for your souls. If I love you greatly, am I to be loved less [by you]?" And then The Passion Translation:" I am glad to give you myself and all I have for your spiritual good, even though it seems that the more I love you, the less you love me." Beloved the Lord has need of you; avail yourself for His use, not because of your selfish gains. Be motivated and inspired by His Lordship, His love and the impact of others. " People may be pure in their own eyes, but the LORD examines their motives" Proverbs 16:2 (NLT)DIG DEEPER(John 6:5-13; 2 Corinthians 1:6,14; James 4:3; 1 Samuel 2:3; 16:7; Proverbs 21:2; Philippians 2:20-22; Colossians 3:23 ) WE PRAY:That we shall increase in the understanding of the intention of the Lord and to rightly correct our motives so that our service may not be of our selfish interests. ONE YEAR BIBLE READINGDay 62: Deuteronomy 18-20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- i serve the Lord with all of my heart.- Whatever I do, I do as unto the Lord.-I decrease that Christ may increase in me.- I serve the Lord with the right motive; not for fame nor any personal interest.- Many glorify God in me.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 73 - PRAISE JESUS; THE KING AND THE LORD WHO IS GOD 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. PRAISE JESUS; THE KING AND THE LORD WHO IS GOD 1 “ ‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” Luke 19:38 (NKJV) There's been discussions of soul winning, giving money or resources into the expansion of the Kingdom and etc.However, the thought of Praising the Lord, is not considered by some saints as an essential matter in our walk with Him.Jesus' entry into Jerusalem has a lot of prophetic details. It was the fulfillment of a Messianic prophecy.In His triumphal entry into Jerusalem, He wasn't only announcing Himself as the Passover lamb. He also announced Himself as the true Messiah.In His entry, they beheld Him in His glory and celebrated His eternal royalty. "Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen, saying:“ ‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” Luke 19:37-38 (NKJV) This is beautiful!!!They couldn't keep quiet and be calm.This also happened that the scriptures maybe fulfilled. (Matthew 21:4; John 12:16).When they saw Jesus, they saw the Messiah; they saw their King who is God.They didn't see Him as an ordinary man. They didn't see just a prophet. They saw God.That was why they shouted and declared the Prophetic Psalm (which is a Praise to God for His everlasting Mercy).Psalm 118 is parallel to Jesus' Triumphal entry. a. vv 20 speaks of the Righteous King entering the gate of the LORD. b. vv 24 speaks of the people rejoicing and being glad. When Jesus entered Jerusalem the people rejoiced and praised God with a loud voice. (Luke 19:37). c. vv 25 speaks of how the Psalmist shouted "Save now". This is similar to the expression "Hosanna" which also means "Oh save" (Matthew 21:9). d. The Psalmist declared "Save now... send now prosperity" and he blessed the Lord with these words: Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’ vv 25-26 The multitudes also declared "Hosanna" and also blessed the Lord with the same words.You can see from these verses that, the triumphal entry of Jesus was declared in detail beforehand.No wonder after His resurrection, He taught His disciples who were on the road to Emmaus, all the things written concerning Himself. "Then Jesus quoted them passage after passage from the writings of the prophets, beginning with the book of Genesis and going right on through the Scriptures, explaining what the passages meant and what they said about himself" Luke 24:27 (TLB) There were other key things you will find in Psalm 118; which may help you know why the Pharisees were offended with the Praise, shouts and the joy of the people.In Psalm 118, we see the Prophetic declarations concerning Jesus: 1. The Psalmist declared the Lord as his Salvation (vv 14 and vv 21). Jesus is our Salvation. (Matthew 1:21; Acts 4:12). Thus, He is the LORD. 2. The rejected stone becoming the chief corner stone (vv 22); Jesus is the rejected stone, who is now the chief cornerstone.(Luke 20:17; Acts 4:11; 1 Peter 2:7). Which again means He is the central focus of the Psalm. 3. The Psalmist specified that, the LORD he is speaking of is GOD.vv. 27 " *God is the LORD, And He has given us light;*"Which means the LORD the Psalmist was praising and giving thanks to, is GOD. Beloved "Jesus is the true Light, which gives light to every man that comes into this world." (John 1:9, see also John 1:4-5; John 9:5).Understand this, JESUS IS GOD according to the scriptures.No one fulfilled the Messianic prophecies except Jesus. No man demonstrated and expressed all that God is in fullness like Jesus did. "No one has seen God [His essence, His divine nature] at any time; the [One and] only begotten God [that is, the unique Son] who is in the intimate presence of the Father, He has explained Him [and interpreted and revealed the awesome wonder of the Father]."John 1:18 (Amplified Bible). No wonder the Pharisees were troubled, when the people rejoiced and spoke the Psalm.They knew the content of the Psalm, alludes to the true Messiah who is God.Now, here is Jesus living out the details of that prophetic Psalm.Right before their eyes the Prophetic Psalm was being played out.And it was too hard for them to accept it.Beloved, Jesus is the King and the LORD who is God; PRAISE HIM WITH THE GLADNESS OF HEART!HallelujahDIG DEEPER (Psalm 118; Exodus 15:1-2; Luke 19: 28-40; John; Matthew 21:1-9;13-16) WE PRAY: That our eyes of understanding shall be enlightened that we may see the Lord in His fullness of royal glory and praise Him daily. ONE YEAR BIBLE READINGDay 63: Deuteronomy 21-23 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - Jesus is my Lord and my salvation.-Jesus is the strength of my life.- My lips shall bless the Lord at all times.- My heart rejoices over Him.-OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 74 - PRAISE JESUS; THE KING AND THE LORD WHO IS GOD 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. PRAISE JESUS; THE KING AND THE LORD WHO IS GOD 2 “ " Jesus replied, “I tell you, if these [people] keep silent, the stones will cry out [in praise]!” Luke 19:40 (Amplified Bible) In Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem, He wasn't only announcing Himself as the Passover lamb. He also announced Himself as the true Messiah and as the Eternal King.It was not by a mere excitement the people began to rejoice.There was something they saw at the coming of the Lord.They saw their expected Messiah, and their Saviour in His glorious royalty.When they saw Jesus drawing near, they began to rejoice and to praise God.They praised God because of the mighty miracles of Jesus.However, they also knew that He did those miracles because of who He is.At that moment their tongue couldn't only declare Him as a miracle worker.They declared who He is. For He is the King who comes in the name of the Lord. "Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen, saying:“ ‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” Luke 19:37-38 (NKJV) It was not by mistake they quoted, Psalm 118:26; it was by prophecy.Read more here to understand how Jesus fulfilled the scripture.And as they praised Jesus, and declared Him as the Messiah and the King, the Pharisees were troubled. "But some of the Pharisees among the crowd said, “ Sir, rebuke your followers for saying things like that!” Luke 19:39 (TLB) They didn't just ask Jesus to silence the crowd because they were making noise; but because of the things the crowd were saying.The Amplified Bible brings out the clarity: "Some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to Him, “ Teacher, rebuke Your disciples [for shouting these Messianic praises].” Luke 19:39 (Amplified). Jesus' response to the Pharisees revealed His divine preeminence over all things." He replied, “If they keep quiet, the stones along the road will burst into cheers!” Luke 19:40 Beloved, even if many may deny His Lordship, His creation will ever celebrate Him. " All the earth worships you and sings praises to you; they sing praises to your name." Psalm 66:4 (ESV) " The heavens declare the glory of God, and the sky above proclaims his handiwork." Psalm 19:1 (ESV) Our Lord Jesus, must be the focus and the object of your praise.Praise Him for who He is, for the greatness of His power and His mighty works.Praise Him every moment of your life. "...I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth." Psalm 34:1 (ESV) Praise the Lord and thank Him as you wake up from bed, walk around the house, as you step out of the house, and whiles you drive.As you praise the Lord, you sharpen your perception of Him and increases your consciousness of His presence in your life. (Psalm 103:2) "Why am I discouraged? Why is my heart so sad? I will put my hope in God! I will praise him again—my Savior and my God!...” (NLT). There is no room for sorrow, when you continually praise the Lord.Whiles Paul was in prison with Silas, they decided to praise the Lord in the middle of the night. As they praised God, the Bible says, “The prison was shaken to its foundations. All the doors immediately flew open, and the chains of every prisoner fell off!” (Acts 16:26 NLT). Oh glory to God...There is the activation and the working of God's power when we praise the Lord.Beloved, Jesus is the King and the LORD who is God; PRAISE HIM WITH THE GLADNESS OF HEART!HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Psalm 71:8; Colossians 3:16; Psalm 28:7; Psalm 24:8-10; Exodus 15:2; Psalm 100:1-3; Daniel 2:23) WE PRAY:Father we thank you for who you are to us, your manifested presence and mighty workings of Grace in our lives. ONE YEAR BIBLE READINGDay 64: Deuteronomy 24-26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is full of thanksgiving.- I cannot be discouraged- The Lord is my King and i rejoice over Him daily.- My tongue is full of praise in all I do.- Oh thank you Jesus, Thank you Jesus.- I praise the Lord for His loving kindness.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 75 - FREE BUT NOT CHEAP
EPISODE 76 - CHRIST YOUR TRUE PASSOVER 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. CHRIST YOUR TRUE PASSOVER 1 " ...For indeed Christ, our Passover, was sacrificed for us..." The first time the Passover was instituted (in Exodus 12) God's people (Israel) were delivered from Egypt. In the verses, 50-51: "All the people of Israel did just as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron. And on that very day the Lord brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their hosts." (ESV) Amidst all the ten (10) plagues which took place in Egypt — water turning to blood, frogs, lice, flies, livestock pestilence, boils, hail, locusts, darkness, and the killing of firstborn children. It was the killing of the firstborn which was the masterstroke. And God's strategy to deliver the people of Israel from the jugdement which was coming upon the land of Egypt, was the Passover. The passover represent God's people being delivered. And for them to be delivered, there has to be a sacrifice in their place. Killing the lambs for each household and putting their blood on their post, declares that someone has already died in this house, therefore no one has to die. Jesus also delivered us from the power of darkness, through His blood. " He has delivered us from the power of darkness and conveyed us into the kingdom of the Son of His love, in whom we have redemption [through His blood, the forgiveness of sins". Colossians 1:13-14 (ESV). The passover foreshadowed, Christ who is the substance of the scriptures. " You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me." John 5:39 (WEB) All that were written from Moses all through to the Prophets, testifies of Jesus. This passover became a yearly festival. It was not a festival just for the remembrance and celebration of what happened in Egypt. It was essentially about their yearly sacrifices for their sins. And yet they were not perfected. (Hebrews 10:1-4) But Jesus' one time sacrifice for us perfected us. " But when Christ had offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God, For by a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are being sanctified." Hebrews 10:12,14 (ESV) Interestingly there are some even in this age, looking forward to the coming of the Messiah to bring deliverance to Israel and mankind. But our Lord Jesus came about 2000 years ago. Yes He shall return, not to die for us again but to reign with His saints in everlasting glory. During His last entry into Jerusalem, He fulfilled all the prophecies concerning His death (see Episode 70), which shall bring deliverance to God's people and make them partakers of the divine life. Jesus is the Perfect lamb that was CONDEMNED ONCE and for ALL. My dear in Christ, you should know that as the lamb of God was judged for you; God CANNOT CONDEMN You. SHALOM DIG DEEPER(Exodus 12; Hebrews 10: 118; Hebrews 9:16-28) WE PRAY:That we will grow in the understanding of Christ's perfect sacrifice by which we have been perfected forever. BIBLE READINGDay 66: Deuteronomy 31-32 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am perfected by the blood of the perfect lamb of God. - I focus on Christ who is the substance of truth. - Christ is God's perfect sacrifice for me, therefore I am justified. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 77 - FELLOWSHIP OF SONS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. FELLOWSHIP OF SONS"God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord." 1 Corinthians 1:9 (NKJV) When you believed and received Jesus, you did not merely escape hell. The Lord brought you into sonship. (John 1:12-13).In your new birth, you were called into the fellowship of Jesus, by God.The word, fellowship is from the Greek word, Koinonia. Which means partnership, participation,communication, communion, distribution and intercourse.By God's own faithfulness, not by your self effort, God called you into the participation, communion and partnership of His Son Jesus.To come into fellowship or participation of His Son also means you share in the reality of the Sonship of Jesus.In the fellowship of sonship, you are no longer an alien but also a son. "Beloved, now are we the sons of God..." 1 John 3:2 (KJV) In that call unto fellowship with Jesus the Lord also justified you.This was not an after-thought, it was God's age long plan and intention to bring you into sonship.It was His predestined plan to call you, justify you and bring you into His glory. (Romans 8:30).Justification is a crucial reality for your calling into sonship.The term justification, is a legal term. To be justified is to be declared not guilty or declared righteous.You were not justified cheaply. God did not overlook your wrongs to justify you.Jesus died as penalty for your wrongs and trespasses. " He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification" Romans 4:25(BSB) Now from the above verse you can see the essence of the resurrection of Jesus.By the resurrection of Jesus, you were justified.The born again in Christ, is the justified. As He has called you, He has justified you. The justification came with His resurrection and by that God legally called you into the fellowship of sonship.God purposed this before the foundation of the earth. The Lord's desire is that all will experience salvation and become His very expression and manifestation. God didn’t want to be hidden. He wanted to be touched and experienced. He wanted His love to be seen by all.God predestined that man will be His expression before the foundation of the world and come into adoption as sons.Sonship is for expression. The son expresses the father. Great is the mystery of Godliness; God manifested in the flesh [see 1st Timothy 3:16].  No man has ever seen God but the son who is in the bosom of the father has expressed Him [John 1:18]. The Son expressed the Father by becoming flesh. God becoming man through Jesus, was His manifestation. Godliness is the expression of divinity.The essence of man is that he will be the expression of life which is God. Man is to be the very expression of God.God has predestined that you will be hewn out of Him possessing His LIFE.It is His plan for all.God made it available for all men to experience adoption of sonship. Yet not all have come into this sonship.Those who receive Him are brought into sonship.The saddest thing is not receiving eternal life and the gladdest thing is to receive eternal life by believing (John 1 : 11-12).Whosoever has the son has life. This means the son is the life (1John 5:11-12)Beloved let this settle within you, you participation in sonship is not dependent on your faithfulness. It is dependent on the faithfulness of God.Not that we first loved him but that he first loved us [1st John 4:10]. By this you came into a participation, a fellowship, and equal sharing in Christ.You don't have a 'part share' you have a full share as son. Wherefore are we partakers of the divine nature (2 Peter 1:4). You share in all of that which is in God.Anytime you feel discouraged and it seem the vicissitudes of life kicks you about, remember you are a son of God.Anytime you feel like all hope is lost, remember you have a living hope which is incorruptible. (1 Peter 1:3).We are not of this world. We are not in agreement with this world.You are not a sinner. You are a son of God. You are in fellowship of His Son Jesus Christ our Lord.GLORY TO GOD!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:3-6; 2 Timothy 1:9-10; Romans 8:14-17;28-30 )WE PRAY:That as sons we shall demonstrate and express the reality of God in our world. BIBLE READINGDay 67: Deuteronomy 33-34DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Now I am a son of God and I have His very life.- I share in the inheritance of the sons of God in the light.- I express God to my world, through the supply of God's Spirit.- I am born with the life of God, therefore I have His nature.- I don't live as a slave of this world, for I am a son of God.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 78 - THERE ARE NO TWO GOSPELS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THERE ARE NO TWO GOSPELS " For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God to salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first and also for the Greek." Romans 1:16 (NKJV) When Paul the apostle, wrote about not being ashamed of the gospel he wasn't just talking about the "act of preaching"; he was basically talking about the content of the message.There are people who preach, but are ashamed to preach the gospel of our Lord.Some think when they preach the gospel, people will continue in error. But from the opening verse, Paul said, the gospel of Christ is the power of God unto Salvation. (Romans 1:16).Which means, people can only experience Salvation only by the preaching of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.Preaching the gospel is not necessarily a message with the name of God. When someone is reading and talking about verses from the Bible, it doesn't mean he is preaching the gospel.Beloved, there are no two gospels. The Gospel is ONE, and it's the GOODNEWS of Our Lord Jesus.The content and the essence of the Gospel is CHRIST.This is the ONLY message entrusted to us.This Gospel is completely balanced. It does not need any supplement.It is the foundation of all teachings, prophecies and the manner of life or conducts of the saints in Christ.Paul (the apostle of Jesus) in his epistle to the Galatians was not sentimental about this reality. He sharply and clearly established the divine thought on this matter of the gospel, when he noticed how the brethren were drifting away. They were beginning to take heed to other teachings apart from this Gospel of Christ: "I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel— not that there is another one, but there are some who trouble you and want to distort the gospel of Christ. But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed. As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed." Galatians 1:6-9 (ESV) To preach another gospel is not just the message that says; "Jesus is not God", not just the beliefs that "There's no God".To preach another gospel, is to preach and teach: -Anything with the impression that the finished work of Christ is incomplete. -Any message that takes the focus of the brethren away from Christ. And promotes "the self", is not the Gospel. -Any message that promotes dead works. -A message that makes people feel they have to "do something to earn something" from God including His love, is not the Gospel. -Any message like, "Heaven help those who help themselves" is not the gospel. Christ came for the helpless. -The Gospel is not "do good for good". Through the Gospel we received and enjoy God's goodness. - Any message which does not point you to, Righteousness by Faith in Christ, is not the gospel -Any message that makes you feel you have to work hard to maintain, manage, preserve and keep your Salvation is not the gospel. Your salvation is eternal. Beloved, the preaching of the gospel is not that Jesus, justified fornication, envy, adultery, robbery, killing and any evil acts.Well, He didn't even come to justify the good things you do. Jesus came to JUSTIFY YOU. To be justified is to be declared not guilty! It's the declaration that in Him you are righteous.This is the GOSPEL!ShalomDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 15:1-11, 2 Corinthians 5:17-19, 2 Corinthians 11:1-4, Galatians 3:1-14) WE PRAY:That we will grow in the knowledge of the gospel and demonstrate the boldness of the Spirit in preaching the gospel. BIBLE READINGDay 68: Joshua 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ.- I am righteous by faith in Christ.- My salvation is eternal.- I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus. - I preach the gospel of Christ with boldness.- I give no room for any other gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 79 - TESTIFY OF THE GOSPEL
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. TESTIFY OF THE GOSPEL "But I do not account my life of any value nor as precious to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God." Acts 20:24 (ESV) Paul, the apostle, was clear on his mission and ministry entrusted to him by the Lord:TO TESTIFY TO THE GOSPEL OF THE GRACE OF GOD.From yesterday's with , we realised there are no two gospels; thus, we all (as saints in Christ) have the mandate to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.The gospel is not a religious declaration. The term “gospel” itself has become a common usage in the Church and the world at large. Some see it as an “act of preaching”. In that sense, when one makes any statement or writes a song with “Jesus, or God”, most refer to it as “Gospel”.However, the term “gospel” is not just to preach but essentially the content preached. A message preached is not necessarily the gospel.“Gospel” in Greek is “euangelion”, originally denoted as a reward for good tidings.Later, the idea of reward dropped, and the word stood for “THE GOOD NEWS”.Thus, gospel means “good tidings” or “good message”.The Gospel of Grace is good news, which unfolds God’s eternal plan of becoming one with man, in life and nature. And man becoming His very expression without any limitation.It is the complete package of God’s grand design to dispense Himself into all things, fill all in all and gather all things into Himself through Christ.This gospel is not an afterthought, it was the original plan of God, which was concealed in Him before time began.Now it has been revealed or unfolded to us.This Gospel of Grace is the mystery of God demystified, which is Christ in You.Having access to this unfolded glorious message of grace, we have to testify, shout it, announce it, share it, preach it and sing it.We have the responsibility to make all men hear about this Goodnews. God wants all people to know this truth, which is Christ Jesus.This is what Paul the apostle has to say here too: “This is the very reason I’ve been made a minister by the authority of God and a servant to his body, so that in his detailed plan I would fully equip you with the Word of God. There is a divine mystery—a secret surprise that has been concealed from the world for generations, but now it’s being revealed, unfolded and manifested for every holy believer to experience.Living within you is the Christ who floods you with the expectation of glory! This mystery of Christ, embedded within us, becomes a heavenly treasure chest of hope filled with the riches of glory for his people, and God wants everyone to know it! Christ is our message! We preach to awaken hearts and bring every person into the full understanding of truth.It has become my inspiration and passion in ministry to labor with a tireless intensity, with his power flowing through me, to present to every believer the revelation of being his perfect one in Jesus Christ”. Colossians 1:26-29 (The Passion Translation) REJOICE IN THIS TRUTH!DIG DEEPER: (Ephesians 2:8-9; Romans 1:16-17; Galatians 1:6-9; Galatians 2:16; 2 Timothy 1:7-10; Colossians 1:21-29; Ephesians 1:1- 12) BIBLE READING Day 69: Joshua 3-4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I grow in the overflowing understanding of the gospel.- I tell everyone about this glorious gospel.- I testify of the gospel.- My life is a glorious testimony of the gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 80 - THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 1 " And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain." 1 Corinthians 15:14 (KJV) Jesus did not only prophesy His death; He consistently prophesied His resurrection.The cross though is a key element in preaching the gospel, it is not the foundation of the gospel. The foundation of the gospel is the death and the resurrection of Jesus our Lord.Apart from the unique birth of Jesus and the reality that He is God; another truth which is feared and greatly opposed is the RESURRECTION OF JESUS.There are many who will easily agree that Jesus died, but are agitated and filled with indignation when they hear of the Resurrection of Jesus.The glorious news and the crux of preaching of the Gospel is the resurrection of Jesus.Jesus did not only speak concerning His death, because speaking of His death wasn't a surprise to the religious leaders. After all that was what they were plotting. It was the kind of death, the purpose of His death and His resurrection from the dead which shook the hearts of the religious leaders.His disciples seemed to be only worried about His death.You must intentionally uphold the goodnews of His resurrection.When Jesus resurrected, He said, ALL HAIL, which also means REJOICE! "And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified. He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him." Matthew 28:5-9 (KJV) Which means His resurrection is a great news for us.The resurrection of Jesus is the crux of the gospel because:1. Without His resurrection there would have been no evidence of our Justification.
