"who was betrayed and crucified because of our sins, and was raised [from the dead] because of our justification [our acquittal—absolving us of all sin before God]" Romans 4:25 ( Amplified Bible) " Jesus was handed over to be crucified for the forgiveness of our sins and was raised back to life to prove that he had made us right with God!" Romans 4:25 (TPT) We can now see the purpose and essence of His death and resurrection respectively.He died because of our transgressions or sins.And He resurrected as the evidence that we are declared not guilty.Oh hallelujah!!!2. The resurrection of Jesus made it possible for us to partake of the Newness of Life. "...through his death the power of your sinful nature was shattered. Your old sin-loving nature was buried with him by baptism when he died; and when God the Father, with glorious power, brought him back to life again, you were given his wonderful new life to enjoy." Romans 6:3-4 (TLB) This is another glorious news concerning the resurrection of Jesus.We see that in His death the nature of sin was terminated. But in His resurrection we received the Life of Christ.Now you are partakers of His divine nature. (2 Peter 1:4). When you become born again, you share in the quality of life Christ has because of His resurrection.It was by His resurrection we received eternal life. " What a God we have! And how fortunate we are to have him, this Father of our Master Jesus! Because Jesus was raised from the dead, we’ve been given a brand-new life" 1 Peter 3-4 (MSG) Beloved, imagine if Christ just died and did not resurrect, what would have been the basis of our good news that we are justified, and have the newness of life?Whenever you see or hear someone aggressively or subtly opposing the resurrection of Jesus, then you should know the adversary is working through such, to cripple your faith.He wants to make you doubt the reality that you are justified and have the eternal life of Christ.The resurrection of Jesus is the foundation of our faith.REJOICE IN THIS TRUTH!DIG DEEPER:(Romans 5:18; 1 Corinthians 15:17; Hebrews 4:14-16; 1 Timothy 3:16; Galatians 3:20; Colossians 2:12-13; 2 Timothy 2:11; John 11:25) WE PRAYThat we shall manifest the reality of the resurrection power of our Lord Jesus in every sphere of our living. BIBLE READINGDay 70: Joshua 5-7DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Thank you Lord for your resurrection power.- I am justified because Jesus was raised from the dead.- I have the life of Christ through his resurrection.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 81 - THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 2 " And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain."1 Corinthians 15:14 (KJV) The death of Jesus is a crucial matter, however, it would have been a mere death without His resurrection.The resurrection of Jesus brought to light the full testimony of the gospel. The goodnews of Jesus would have been void of power without His resurrection.One of the things you should constantly be excited about is the Resurrection of Jesus!Gloreeey!!!Beloved, the resurrection is a great news for us.We already looked at two items which explains the essence of the resurrection of Jesus.We have seen that, the resurrection of Jesus is the evidence of our justification (Romans 4:25). And through the resurrection we have the Newness of life.There are more reasons the resurrection of Jesus is the crux of the gospel; 3. The evidence and demonstration and the release of the Power of God.Preaching the gospel of Jesus without the demonstration of power is just a mere story.The difference between the Good News of Jesus and other news is the power of God.The greatness of God's power was demonstrated in these three instances. a. Creation (See Psalm 104).God demonstrated His power through creation. The thought of God's creation marvels the heart and leaves one in awe (Psalm 33:6-9)Creation was God's creativity fueled by His mighty power." Oh, Sovereign Lord, you did indeed make heaven and earth by your mighty power and great strength. Nothing is too hard for you!" Jeremiah 32:17 (NET). b. The deliverance of Israel out of Egypt. " You used your mighty power and your great strength to perform miracles and amazing deeds and to bring great terror on the Egyptians. By this means you brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt." Jeremiah 32:21 (NET) In the story of Israel coming out of Egypt, we see God deploying His might and showing forth His strength.c. The resurrection of Jesus.God fully demonstrates the greatness of His power by the resurrection of Jesus towards us who believe.See what Paul the apostle, said in his prayer to the brethren in Ephesus:" I pray that you will continually experience the immeasurable greatness of God’s power made available to you through faith. Then your lives will be an advertisement of this immense power as it works through you! This is the mighty power that was released when God raised Christ from the dead and exalted him to the place of highest honor and supreme authority in the heavenly realm!" In the resurrection of Jesus, God exerted His power.We have seen through scriptures how Jesus cast out devils, raised the dead and healed all sickness and diseases. However, all these were not the full demonstration of His power until resurrection.By this power, death was defeated, swallowed, crushed and destroyed in Christ.And this power was released into us through the Spirit.Now those who believe in Jesus have access to experience the immeasurable greatness of God's power. We have the power over death which is the power to live through Christ Jesus.Beloved in Christ, it is by this immeasurable, limitless resurrection power which is now at work in you, that God is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that you can think nor ask. (Ephesians 3:20)Jesus resurrected, He is alive and the exceeding greatness of God's power is at work in you.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER:(Philippians 3:10; Isaiah 25:8; Ephesians 1:18-20; John 11:25-26) WE PRAYThat we shall experience the exceeding greatness of His power. BIBLE READINGDay 71: Joshua 8-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The exceeding immeasurable greatness of His resurrection power is at work in me.- I have power over sickness and diseases.- I have power over death and power to live.- By the power of resurrection at work in me, God is able to do exceedingly abundantly, above all that I can think or ask.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 82 - THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 3
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 3" And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain." 1 Corinthians 15:14 (KJV) One of the greatest news of the universe is that, Jesus died for the sin of the world, and rose up again by the glory of the Father for the justification of many who receive Him.The resurrection of Jesus is the unmatched peak in the annals of eternity.In His resurrection, our Lord Jesus, didn't tiptoe His way out of death as a coward looking for an escape. He defeated the cohorts of death, broke the claws of darkness and walked out of the tomb as the Victorious LORD OF ALL.By His resurrection, we are justified, we partook of the newness of life and experienced the immeasurable greatness of the power of God in us.There is more His resurrection achieved for us and demonstrated.We have already looked at some three (3) items concerning the resurrection of Jesus.Now we can go on further: 4. The Resurrection of Jesus Authenticated the Word of GodIt was evidential that, whatever God says is true.Peter the apostle, explained a Psalm of David to the Jews concerning the resurrection of Jesus. When he unveiled the reality of the scriptures to his audience, they were cut to the heart and got saved. (Acts 2:37)Now let the Bible speak to you directly, read patiently, and in-breath the spirit and life of these words as your heart burns with light: “Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a Man attested by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs which God did through Him in your midst, as you yourselves also know—Him, being delivered by the determined purpose and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by lawless hands, have crucified, and put to death; whom God raised up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible that He should be held by it. For David says concerning Him:‘I foresaw the Lord always before my face,For He is at my right hand, that I may not be shaken. Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue was glad;Moreover my flesh also will rest in hope. For You will not leave my soul in Hades, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.You have made known to me the ways of life;You will make me full of joy in Your presence.’“Men and brethren, let me speak freely to you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us to this day. Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, He would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne, he, foreseeing this, spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that His soul was not left in Hades, nor did His flesh see corruption. This Jesus God has raised up, of which we are all witnesses. Therefore being exalted to the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, He poured out this which you now see and hear. “For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he says himself:‘The Lord said to my Lord,“Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool.” ’“ Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ.”Acts 2:22-36 (NKJV)(See also Psalm 16:8-11; Psalm 132:11;Psalm 68:18; 110:1) Now, one of the most detailed Prophecies of the crucifixion and death of our Lord Jesus, the Messiah, couldn't end without articulating His resurrection. The Prophet Isaiah prophesied of Jesus' divinity, birth, life, death, resurrection and His eternal reign.He said in his prophecy concerning Jesus' death and resurrection: "Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise Him; He has put Him to grief. When You make His soul an offering for sin, He shall see His seed, He shall prolong His days,And the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in His hand. He shall see the labor of His soul, and be satisfied.By His knowledge My righteous Servant shall justify many,For He shall bear their iniquities." Isaiah 53:10-11 There are some few items to take note of concerning the resurrection of Jesus:- Though His soul was made an offering for sin, He shall see His seed and prolong His days. "To prolong" also speaks of long life. How can you be an offering for sin and still have long life? The only way to have life after being offered or killed as a sin offering, is to resurrect.-You can only see the labor of your soul when you are still alive. Again the Prophet is speaking of resurrection.- "My righteous Servant shall JUSTIFY MANY"Remember from the epistles of Paul to the Romans, we realised our Lord Jesus was raised for our justification (Read more here).Without Jesus' resurrection there wouldn't have been the validation of our Justification.Now what Paul said to the brethren in Corinth should make more sense; "For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures; And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures" 1 Corinthians 15:3-4 (KJV) Beloved, this must be a great joy to you that we have not believed empty fables. The resurrection of Jesus affirms the surety of both the scriptures and the words of Jesus."...He said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of his enemies. He will be killed, but three days later he will rise from the dead.” Mark 9:31 (NLT) Whatever the scriptures has said concerning your life in Christ is true.Live in this consciousness that God's word does not fall to the ground.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER: (Psalm 22:14-31;Hosea 6:1-3; Genesis 3:15; John 2:13-22; Matthew 16:21; Acts 26:22;) WE PRAY That the word of God concerning our lives shall have its full expression and fulfillment. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READINGDay 72: Joshua 11-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am not a disadvantage.- I live according to the scriptures.- My daily life is an evidence of the word of God.- Every word of God concerning my life comes to pass.- The glory of the resurrection of Jesus is revealed in my life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 83 - THIS IS OUR CULTURE
EPISODE 84 - A WORTHY COURSE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.A WORTHY COURSE"With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don't hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort."1 Corinthians 15:58 (The Message) Why are we so committed to the course of Christ? Why are we pushing beyond our comfort and self interest, just to see lives saved and transformed, no matter the cost involved? Are we wasting our time?Certainly Not!!!Don't we have anything else to use our money for?What more is worth our money than this?What more is worth our time than this?What more is worth our skill, intelligence, and resources than this?Read the opening verse again: "With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don't hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort."1 Corinthians 15:58 (The Message) God has been about this business since.He desires that all men will be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth (1 Timothy 2:4).Our Lord first made a great sacrifice to get this to unfold.  "Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: [And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross." Philippians 2:6-8 (Amplified Bible). Beloved, Jesus being fully God, He lowered Himself to become man and humbled Himself to suffer the death of the cross.It wasn't for nothing!!He sacrificed all He is and all that He's got, just to die this death of shame for mankind.There must be something more important about His death for Him to leave all that glory to become man and to die for man.It is this same thing that moved Jesus to the cross, which is moving us to do all we have to do according to the grace given us.We are not giving space for the adversary.This generation and beyond deserves our sacrifices.How beautiful it is that young people like us will stand up for the course of Christ.This same ministry of God is our ministry today. (2 Corinthians 5:17-18)Every single contribution is important and needful unto satisfying God's dream.We leave no stone unturned. We take advantage of this Holy Spirit inspired and directed ability within us, to turn on the divine course in many.There are certain people if we don't step out, they wouldn't be reached out to and the Lord will demand their blood from us."If I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, in order to save his life, that wicked person shall die for his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand." Ezekiel 3:18 (ESV) We will not sit to watch a generation to be destroyed.Until YOU get involved, a particular soul will not be reached.They can only hear to receive the Lord, only when you preach. "For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and *how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?*" (Romans 10:13-14) There are many more depending on our sacrifices, bold steps, relentless decisions, uncompromising choices, and unconditional Love of Christ.The LOVE that moved Jesus to the cross is COMPELLING US TO REACH MANY UNSAVED. (Read COMPELLED BY HIS LOVE)The Love of Christ is compelling us!!!...Don't only preach, put your money into GOD'S AGENDA. God's AGENDA will be financed through GOD'S OWN PEOPLE.Be a faithful steward of God and partner with the spreading of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.Pray also for the salvation of souls in your community, in your city, in your town, in your school, in your work place, in your family, in your country and in your continent and the whole world. Don't go on your knees in prayer only for your personal needs. You are a royal priest in Christ. Fulfill that priestly mandate.We get the job done unto the Glory of God.There is a great company publishing the gospel, are you part of it?Read these topics as well:Cultivate DiligenceBe ImmovableComplacency is not an OptionThis is War 1The LORD has NEED OF ITFRUIT-BEARERSDIG DEEPER:(1 Peter 1:4-9; Ruth 1:18; Psalm 78:8,37; Col. 2:7; Acts 20:24; Hebrews 12:1; 1 Corinthians 9:24-27) WE PRAYThat our hands will not relenting in the service of the Lord. And that we will labour to the end, knowing the value of what God has entrusted to us. BIBLE READINGDay 74: Joshua 17-19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I finish my race.- I value this kingdom mandate more than my necessary needs.- I am fully persuaded about the call of God.- My service to God is unto a glorious end.- I am involved in God's great work. And this is a worthy course.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![AWL-BlogFilter blog_image="yes" blog_image_quality="medium" blog_image_hover_effect="hover1" blog_title="yes" blog_title_color="#000" blog_desc="yes" blog_desc_words="100" blog_read_more="yes" blog_read_more_text="Read More" blog_date="yes" blog_pagination="yes" blog_filters="yes" blog_all_text="All" blog_buttons_color="#58BBEE" blog_filtering="blog_tag" selected_tags="317,314" custom-css=" " ]

title: EPISODE 85 - THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 4
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE CRUX OF THE GOSPEL 4" And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain." 1 Corinthians 15:14 (KJV) When you talk to others about Jesus, and you present Him as a prophet or a good man or even the greatest teacher, you wouldn't have problem with a lot of people.One of the things which will agitate or irritate people is the resurrection of Jesus.From the day Jesus resurrected till today the adversary has not relented in opposing this reality with lies.The goal of the adversary is to cast doubt into your heart.However, the goal of the adversary is not to destroy the victory of Jesus. For the victory of Jesus over death is irreversible.The goal of the adversary is to destroy the evidence of your victory over him in your heart.We've looked at some few items concerning the resurrection of Jesus.From previous discussions we realised by the Resurrection of Jesus: 1. We are Justified. The testimony of our justification is the resurrection of Jesus. 2. We share in the newness of life. 3. We have received and experienced the immeasurable greatness of God's power in us. 4. The Word of God is Authenticated.These four items we have looked at are enough evidence that we must uphold the reality of the resurrection of Jesus.These also proves that Jesus did not resurrect for Himself. We are the benefactors of His resurrection. Let's look at these other items as well. 5. The Resurrection of Jesus is the foundation of our Present FAITH in Christ Jesus. Look at the opening verse again: "and if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is vain [useless, amounting to nothing], and your faith is also vain [imaginary, unfounded, devoid of value and benefit—not based on truth]." 1 Corinthians 15:14 (Amplified). Your faith is founded on the Resurrection of Jesus.Without His resurrection, your faith which is the absolute confidence and trust in God is empty, worthless and hopeless.Whenever you hear a teaching or thought which opposes the resurrection of Jesus, then the you must know the goal is to shipwreck your faith in Christ Jesus.The resurrection of Jesus is the masterstroke in God's eternal plan. It distinguished the testimony of Jesus from all other men who had walked on the face of the earth, all principalities from eternal past to eternal future.His death and resurrection shook the heavens. And in His resurrection hades and death trembles at His presence and at His name.Now we know that our faith has a solid and sure foundation. Our faith is not established on myths and fables. 6. The Resurrection of Jesus is the Living Hope of our Future and the Experience of Immortality "Celebrate with praises the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has shown us his extravagant mercy. For his fountain of mercy has given us a new life—we are reborn to experience a living, energetic hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead" 1 Peter 1:3 (TPT). This hope is not far from us. It is an experience we have today, because its living and we shall experience its fullness in eternal future.By His resurrection we have received His eternal life and we have the assurance that this life we have received comes with an inheritance which is indestructible, imperishable, undefiled and unfading. (1 Peter 1:4).We have this living, energetic assurance and certainty that, what we have received in Christ cannot be imperiled.Our salvation is secured unto eternity. We have a glorious life to live beyond time. We know that the things in Christ we benefit cannot be limited to time and even this material world." And if Christ is not alive, you are still lost in your sins and your faith is a fantasy. It would also mean that those believers in Christ who have passed away have simply perished. If the only benefit of our hope in Christ is limited to this life on earth, we deserve to be pitied more than all others! But the truth is, Christ is risen from the dead, as the first-fruit of a great resurrection harvest of those who have died."1 Corinthians 15:17-20 (TPT) Oh glory to God.Beloved in this living, energetic hope, we have the assurance also of the glorification of our body.This living hope is not only about the reality that we shall not lose our salvation. It is also about the reality that we shall live forever, (including all who were in Christ that tasted physical death) and our bodies will take on immortality. " For we will discard our mortal “clothes” and slip into a body that is imperishable. What is mortal now will be exchanged for immortality. And when that which is mortal puts on immortality, and what now decays is exchanged for what will never decay, then the Scripture will be fulfilled that says: Death is swallowed up by a triumphant victory!" This is the glorious testimony of the resurrection of Jesus.This is why I said previously, that the resurrection of Jesus is the unmatched peak in the annals of eternity.And that in His resurrection, our Lord Jesus, didn't tiptoe His way out of death as a coward looking for an escape. He defeated the cohorts of death, broke the claws of darkness and walked out of the tomb as the Victorious LORD OF ALL.Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER:(Philippians 2:5-11; 1 Corinthians 15; Romans 2:7; 2 Corinthians 5:1-9) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the glory and beauty of His resurrection and making us the benefactors of this great feat of victory. BIBLE READINGDay 75: Joshua 20-22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My faith is founded on a living hope.- I have an imperishable, incorruptible inheritance by the resurrection of Jesus- My faith is not worthless neither is it in vain, because Jesus rose from the dead.- I am fully persuaded that Jesus died and was raised by the glory of the Father.- I am also made alive through the resurrection of Jesus.- I have the capacity to experience immortality through the resurrection of Jesus.- My faith is on a firm foundation.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 86 -THE FATHER’S JOY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE FATHER’S JOY “ And it was a happy day for him when he gave us our new lives through the truth of his Word, and we became, as it were, the first children in his new family.” James 1:18 (The Living Bible) The greatest thing God achieved was not when He created the heavens, the stars, the moon, the sun. The greatest thing God accomplished was not when He made Adam. The greatest thing He achieved was when He INDWELT MAN, through Christ, and this is how he gained Sons. Beloved, your sonship is the evidence of His Fatherhood. The matter of God having sons was for the satisfaction of His Fatherhood. It has been the Father’s heartbeat even before Sin entered the world.He intended to indwell us through the Spirit, to be- come one with us that we might be His sons. The matter of sonship is unto expression.Fatherhood is for birthing. He is our Father to reproduce Himself in Us, and we are His sons to express (and reveal) Him. The focus of our Lord Jesus was forthe birthing of the Corporate (many) Sons. The desire of God as a Father was not to have Jesus as the only begotten Son, but that through Him, He will have many sons. Jesus came as the seed of the Father to be sown that through Him there will be the germination of many sons. The Lord Himself said, “ Verily, verily, I say unto you, except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it dies, it bringeth forth much fruit.”John 12:24 (KJV) As many that have received Him are legally Sons of God. We are God-begotten. “But whoever did want him, who believed he was who he claimed and would do what he said, He made to be their true selves, their child-of-God selves. These are the God-begotten, not blood-begotten, not flesh-begotten, not sex-begotten.” John 1:12-13 (The MessageBible) Now, we are the sons of God by Faith (See 1 John 3:1-2; Galatians 3:26). Jesus is no longer the only begotten; He is the firstborn among many brethren, and He seesus as His brothers. “ For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.” Romans 8:29 (KJV) “ Jesus, the Holy One, makes us holy. And as sons and daughters, we now belong to his same Father, so he is not ashamed or embarrassed to introduce us as his brothers and sisters!” Hebrews 2:11 (The Passion Translation) It is the joy of the Father to bring us into sonship, and this was His predestined plan before time began. “ For He foreordained us (destined us, planned in love for us) to be adopted (revealed) as His own children through Jesus Christ, in accordance with the purpose of His will [because it pleased Him and was His kind intent]” Ephesians 1:5 Glory to God! This is amazing!He didn’t just reveal us as His children through Jesus Christ, He gave us the Holy Spirit to be a seal and a witness that we are His forever.We have the Holy Spirit as the testimony within us that God is not only God to us. He is not just a Judge unto us, but He is also our Eternal Father. We call Him Daddy! Daddy! (Abba Father) with joy. “ For you have not received a spirit of slavery leading again to fear [of God’s judgment], but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons [the Spirit producing sonship] by which we [joyfully] cry, “Abba Father! The Spirit Himself testifies and confirms together with our spirit [assuring us] that we [believers] are children of God” Romans 8:15-16 (Amplified Bible) " And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba,Father.” (Galatians4:6) The essence of the Gospel of our Lord Jesus is to point you to YOUR SONSHIP IN CHRIST, and this reality delights the Father’s heart.DIG DEEPER:(1John 3:1-2; Romans 8:15-16; John 1:12; Galatians 3:26) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship in Christ Jesus. And by the ability of God's Spirit within us, we shall express the nature of the Father as he has intended. BIBLE READINGDay 76: Joshua 23-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the joy of the Father. -I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. - I am born of God. -As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. - I express the quality of God's life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 87 - THE MINGLED LIFE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.THE MINGLED LIFE" And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.” Acts 9:4-5 (KJV) Glory! What a mystery revealed!Saul (now Paul) thought he was persecuting just the saints; little did he know he was dealing with Jesus Himself.You see, Jesus didn’t ask, “Saul, Saul why are you persecuting my disciples or even my Church”.Instead, He asked,“ why are you persecuting me?”This was enough to reveal the New Creation reality to Paul. Jesus didn’t ask that because the New Creation (or theChurch) belongs to Him.NO!Jesus asked in that manner because He is in “Oneness with the Church”.The Church is His body- The Corporate New Man (the New Creation). Hallelujah.Let me be very specific “WE” (the born-again- the New Creation) are the Church (the body of Christ) Corporately and as Individuals. Now WE are not just an extension of Christ on Earth. We are the expression of Christ.We were made one with Christ Jesus and not separated from Him. We are the visible expression of Him. His very substance!God never sees Us as different from Christ; instead, He sees Us together with Him. He loves Us just as He loves Jesus, we are victorious just as Jesus is, and we are in right standing with God just as Jesus is.God never looks at Jesus with anger. (He never looks on Us with anger, we are the Substance of Jesus).When the world touches Us, they have touchedJesus, and we are His substance as He is our element.Anytime the world sees Us, they have seen Jesus. He talks through Us and lives through Us.As a New Creation, you are the talking and the walking Christ. He lovesand comforts others through you, so live with confidence every day because you are the revelation of Jesus!Bear this mind:Now even though the Lord is with you, He is also in you."even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees him nor knows him. You know him, for he dwells with you and will be in you." John 14:17 (ESV) The one in Christ (the new creation) has a mingled spirit, joined to the Lord. The truth is, the Lord in you is your authentic self.Galatians 2:20:“ I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.” The real you within is Christ, and you are insoluble in nature and essence. Therefore, live daily in the consciousness of your true self.SelahDIG DEEPER:(John 15:1-11; John 17:20-23; Ephesians 2:13-16; Romans 8:10-11; 1 Corinthians 12:13; 1 Corinthians 6:17) WE PRAYThat our experience of our oneness with God will be deepened. BIBLE READINGDay 77: Judges 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am one with Christ, His substance and expression.- God sees me as He sees Christ.- When you touch me you've touched Christ.- When men see me, they have seen Christ.- I am eternally one with Christ and inseparable from Him.- He walks through me and talks through me.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 88 - THE GOSPEL BRINGS TRANSFORMATION￼
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.THE GOSPEL BRINGS TRANSFORMATION" For I am not ashamed of this Good News about Christ. It is the power of God at work, saving everyone who believes—the Jew first and also the Gentile. Romans 1:16 (NLT) It is not any message at all that brings salvation.Salvation is in the gospel of Jesus.When you see and hear the evil and the wrongs going on with people in this generation, you may be tempted to think it is the preaching of condemnation, which will get people saved from their evil ways.Telling people how wrong and evil they are is not what brings salvation.This is not to say, you may not have to help people realise their wrongs and their need for salvation.There are people whose eyes have been blinded and they easily justify and defend their wrongs and evil ways.Truly, Jesus did not justify any wrongs. Jesus made justification available for all men who believe.However, you need to get this, the message which bring salvation is not the declaration of the wrongs of people.The message which brings true Salvation is not telling people about the horror of hell. Nobody has to receive Jesus on the grounds of fear.He came to bring Salvation on the grounds of love (John 3:16).The gospel is not the declaration of the wrongs you see.The gospel (goodnews) is what God has done for us through Christ Jesus.I heard someone tell another fellow concerning the preaching of the gospel.And was like, "it is not about the message you preach, it is how you get someone saved by all means."Beloved in Christ, the Lord did not just give us the ministry of reconciliation, He also gave the message of reconciliation. " Now all things are of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given us the ministry of reconciliation, that is, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and has committed to us the word of reconciliation ". 2 Corinthians 5:18-19 (NKJV) Alright, see how 2 Corinthians 5:18-19 is presented in the Living Bible:" All these new things are from God who brought us back to himself through what Christ Jesus did. And God has given us the privilege of urging everyone to come into his favor and be reconciled to him. For God was in Christ, restoring the world to himself, no longer counting men’s sins against them but blotting them out. This is the wonderful message he has given us to tell others." You didn't come into relationship with God or experience Sonship in Christ, by your self efforts. You were not saved by your self efforts or what you did by the works of legalism.It was what Jesus did in His death and resurrection that got you saved. He died as the lamb of God for the forgiveness of your sins.The message is Christ and His work through His death and resurrection.There are no TWO GOSPELS. We must only TESTIFY OF THE GOOD NEWS OF JESUS. (Read more by clicking on the links).The gospel is the light of the knowledge of God in the face of Jesus.Why then do you proclaim darkness if menare yearning and are in need for LIGHT?The gospel is the reality of Jesus whom we preach. Preaching and teaching the goodnews of Jesus is the ministry of Righteousness. It points men to JESUS and not to their defeated and beaten past and corruptibility.The ministry of condemnation points men to their weaknesses.It is more revealing and life-transforming, to preach Christ than to preach the crisis of the now.When you come to the true knowledge of the gospel of Christ and your mind is saturated with the grace of God, you will live right.Right living is the product of the reality of Christ's goodnews in your heart.HallelujahDIG DEEPER:(Romans 2:3-4; Romans 1:15-17; Luke 2:10-11; 1 Corinthians 2:1-2;) WE PRAYThat doors shall be opened for the teaching and preaching of the transforming power of the gospel in all places. BIBLE READINGDay 78: Judges 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I experience the transforming power of the gospel.- I walk in the consciousness of all that Christ achieved for me.- I boast in the finished work of Christ on the cross and not in my self-efforts.- The gospel of Jesus spreads through me.- I make the goodnews of Jesus my focus.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 89 - WITNESSES BY THE SPIRIT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.WITNESSES BY THE SPIRIT"But *you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you: and you shall be witnesses of me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in all Samaria, and into the uttermost part of the earth" Acts 1:8 (NKJV) The Holy Spirit did not come to indwell us for our self gratification. He came to indwell us that we shall be witnesses of Christ.When the Holy Spirit came into us at new birth, He dispensed His power into us.The Holy Spirit Himself is the embodiment of God's power. The Holy Spirit is in you with the immeasurable power of God.Understand that, you do not fast and pray to receive power. You rather fast and pray to engage and express what you carry.When you became born again, God was processed into you through the Holy Spirit. You received the Holy Spirit to be a witness.You received the responsibility to bear witness of Christ when you received the Holy Spirit; this is because the Holy Spirit Himself is a witness of what God has achieved and produced through Christ (Romans 8:16).We are not witnesses of weakness, defeat, failure or fear. We are witnesses of Christ. We are witnesses of the Supernatural, and we became this testimony because we have received the Holy Spirit.A witness of Christ is one who has received God into Him. A witness of Christ is not a stranger to the Truth. A witness is a partaker of the Divine Life and of Christ's death and His resurrection. "That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon and our hands have handled, of the Word of Life." - 1 John 1:1 (NKJV) A witness of Christ witnesses what he has received. Hence, to be able to bear witness in the full capacity of the testimony of Christ; we must fully come to a place of understanding. We must understand what Christ did for us and achieved in us. We are to go out there and bear witness of the life we have fully comprehended.The Holy Spirit is not a thing; He is a person. And as witnesses of Christ we have the Holy Spirit as a companion. In like manner, we are His companion. We are in fellowship with Him.What makes that fellowship strong is a continual communication with Him.This is how we stir up the passion of the Lord in our hearts.As companions of the Holy Spirit we must deeply engage Him. The more we have fellowship with Him, the more we allow Him to flow through us.We must commune with Him through consistent intense prayers. We must talk with Him.He is our companion.As witnesses we must always walk in the consciousness that the Holy Spirit is always with us. "And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;" John 14:16 (KJV)  He will never leave you nor forsake you. He has never thought or dreamt of it. He is WITH YOU always and He is IN YOU always even till the end of the ages.DIG DEEPER:(1 John 4:2-3; Acts 5:32; 1 Corinthians 12;3; John 16:13-14) WE PRAYFor the wisdom to utilise the enabling and quickening force of the Holy Spirit to bear witness of our Lord Jesus in all places. BIBLE READINGDay 79: Judges 7-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the Holy Spirit in me to bear witness of Christ.- I am empowered to demonstrate Christ.- I am a witness of Christ's love, prosperity, goodness and peace.- Many know and see the Lord through me by the power of the Holy Spirit.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 90 - THE PERFECT PICTURE OF LOVE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. Saturday 22ndApril, 2023 THE PERFECT PICTURE OF LOVE " Christ is the visible image of the invisible God.He existed before anything was created and is supreme over all creation" Colossians 1:15 (NLT) Until the appearing of Jesus, God was a mystery. Many people didn't have rich understanding of God, who He is and how He loves to relate with us.And even now there are people who lack the understanding of who God truly is.You don't have to travel to the moon to understand God.You don't have to wait till you depart from this earth to see God.God has revealed Himself explicitly to us.God came to man in the form of man (Jesus, yet He was fully God) to make Himself visible to us. "And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Preached among the Gentiles, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory." 1 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV). Through Christ Jesus, God is revealed in a clear and detailed manner, without any ambiguity, or leaving no room for confusion or doubt.When you focus on Jesus you see God in His full reality in life and nature.Jesus is the perfect picture of God.When you truly behold Jesus, you don't need to ask of the Father.Look at what Jesus Himself told Philip: " Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you so long, and yet you have not known Me, Philip? He who has seen Me has seen the Father; so how can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?" John 14:9 Why?The author of Hebrews explains:" His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance..." Hebrews 1:3 (WEB) When you see Jesus, you have seen God's express image.To understand God's character, glory, love, nature, plans, intentions and thought patterns, look at Jesus.Our Lord Jesus brings us the perfect picture of God's love.Man lost the true picture of God and failed to see God in His true essence and expression.Jesus came to change or correct man's wrong picture of God. He did not come to change God's picture of man.God has the original picture of us.He always had a perfect picture of Love. Man created a wrong picture about God.They thought of a condemning God but God saw a people He can make righteous in Christ.He saw a people He has to make perfect despite their imperfection.God was not looking for a people He will condemn. He saw a people He must save.While men were yet sinners Christ saved them. (Romans 5:8). For God so loved the world that He gave Himself. (John 3:16). God has no hatred towards man. He never condemns man. He always makes His salvation available.It's the nature of sin and consciousness of sin that leaves man in condemnation, NOT GOD!Any man that believes in God's provision of Grace is not condemned but JUSTIFIED.GOD WANTS YOU TO RECEIVE HIS GIFT WITHOUT YOUR SELF-EFFORT.Your labour (Self-effort) to please God is as a result of your "condemnation consciousness"; but His Grace-received is as a result of His Perfect Love you've beheld. (John 3:16-18).ShalomDIG DEEPER:(Colossians 1:14-16; John 1:1-18; 2 Corinthians 4:4; 1 John 5:20; John 8:19; 12:45; John 10:30). WE PRAYThat we may grow more and more in the knowledge of Christ, that we may understand the perfect love of Christ BIBLE READINGDay 80: Judges 11-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- God loves me.- I see His love in Christ.- I grow in the perfect understanding of God through Christ.- I enjoy the love of God in Christ.- God sees me in His love.- I am not hated by God, I am not condemn by God. I am not an enemy of God. I am loved by God.- Jesus showed me how God loves me.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 91 - IS CHRIST CONTESTING FOR YOUR REVERENCE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.IS CHRIST CONTESTING FOR YOUR REVERENCE?"For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but in order that the world might be saved through him" John 3:17 (ESV) You don't define God's relationship with man with your head.Your understanding of God's relationship with man must be according to the heart of God.God doesn't define situations by how we feel, but according to His purpose and grace.Since a lot of people have not experienced the truth of God's love, they interpret the things of God with their selfish lenses.For example, some people think that the death of Jesus is in contest for their reverence.Jesus didn't die for you because He wants you to revere Him by trembling before Him.Listen, you cannot stand before God in the fullness of His glory and not revere Him.His goal is not for your reverence, His goal is that you shall have His life and become His expression.The idea that Jesus died for God to have many worshippers, is not really God's goal.Yes, when one beholds God's love and glory, you can't than to respond in worship. Worship is our response to who God is. It is not the demand of God.Also God wants to have many sons. However, to be a son of God is essentially for the benefit of those who are adopted into sonship. You become an heir of God and enjoy God's eternal inheritance. This is God rather sharing His life and glory with you.Jesus didn't die as sin on the cross to demand for your reverence. Though He deserves your reverence, He doesn't demand for it.His love is not saying "My dear if you don't reverence me, I will strike you with sickness and diseases. Or I will take My Holy Spirit away from you."The loving expression of Christ is not in competition with and for your works and efforts. All you've got to do is to acknowledge and believe in His finished work, which was achieved through His death and resurrection.Am I attempting to say, "it is not necessary to revere God?"Far from it.I want you to see the motive of God concerning you.You are the focus of His love.God esteems His plans and purposes because they are designed to benefit you in all eternity.God is not looking for the opportunity to condemn you. He wants you to experience His love and saving grace. In truth, when you come to appreciate His love, you will unforcefully and restfully reverence and express His Love.SHALOMDIG DEEPER:(John 6:40; Ephesians 1:3-12; Luke 1:74-75; Philippians 2:12-13). WE PRAYThat our motive of service and relationship with God will be according to His love and not the fear of condemnation. BIBLE READINGDay 81: Judges 14-15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- God loves me.- I relate with God in the light of His love.- I don't relate with God in fear.- My reverence to God is not in fear and forcefulness but in the purity of His love and grace.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 92 - DEAD TO SIN
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. DEAD TO SIN What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound? Romans 6:1 (NKJV) The question in the opening verse, is one of the most asked questions concerning the gospel of the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. Most people ask this question because they doubt the power of the gospel. Some also ask such questions because they think people will take advantage of the goodness of the gospel to sin. This is it, anyone who decides to use the liberty of the gospel as an occasion to sin did not truly hear the gospel neither did such person receive the love of Christ. The gospel of our Lord Jesus is the revelation of the love of God. Sin is influenced by selfishness. Sin is anything that is not of faith. "But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because he does not eat from faith; for whatever is not from faith is sin." Romans 14:23 (NKJV) And faith works in love. "For when we place our faith in Christ Jesus, there is no benefit in being circumcised or being uncircumcised. What is important is faith expressing itself in love." Galatians 5:6 (NLT). Nowhere did the gospel suggest that we shall continue to sin because of the grace of God. We see Paul the apostle, instructing the brethren in Galatia not to use their liberty to do whatever they want. Look at it:  " It is absolutely clear that God has called you to a free life. Just make sure that you don’t use this freedom as an excuse to do whatever you want to do and destroy your freedom. Rather, use your freedom to serve one another in love; that’s how freedom grows." Galatians 5:13 (MSG) I hope you got the message clear? In Paul's epistle to the Romans, he took his time to explain the glorious work of the grace of God in us. He revealed how the grace of our Lord Jesus, is superior to the law of sin and death. (Romans 5). After establishing this reality of grace, he made a rhetoric statement: "What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?" (Romans 6:1) From verses 2 - 4 of Romans 6, He provided a clear answer with no ambiguity. Certainly not! (verse 1) The apostle Paul, didn't end there, he explained further by asking more rhetoric questions: How shall we who died to sin live any longer in it? (verse 2) Do you get it? Okay, just relax he makes it more clearer: " Or do you not know that as many of us as were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death? Therefore we were buried with Him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life. (Romans 6:3-4). This is amazing. You don't continue to sin, not because of the rules and regulations you disobey. Neither do you refuse to continue in sin because of the rules and regulations you obey. You don't continue in sin because YOU ARE DEAD TO SIN. When Jesus died, He died as the lamb of God for the whole world. Therefore as many that accept Jesus as the lamb of God (who died for them) and believe in Him; they become partakers of His death through the baptism of the spirit. " For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and have all been made to drink into one Spirit" 1 Corinthians 12:13 (NKJV) So then, when you came into Christ, your testimony wasn't only that Jesus died for you. Your testimony now is, you died with Christ. Now because you died with Christ (who became sin), you are DEAD TO SIN. "Likewise you also, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord." Romans 6:11 (NKJV). Instead of asking, "shall I continue in sin that grace may abound?" Or telling yourself, "I will continue in sin because grace may abound." Say to yourself: I CAN'T CONTINUE IN SIN BECAUSE I AM DEAD TO SIN AND ALIVE TO GOD IN CHRIST JESUS. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER:(Galatians 5:1; Romans 7:8; Romans 8:2; Romans 6:15; Galatians 2:19-21) BIBLE READINGDay 82: Judges 16-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am crucified with Christ. - The life of Christ is at work in me. - I am dead to sin and its power. - I can't continue in sin because I am dead to sin and alive to God in Christ. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 93 - ALIVE TO GOD IN CHRIST
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ALIVE TO GOD IN CHRIST "Likewise you also, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord. Romans 6:11" (NKJV) Most people who ask the question, "Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?" seek for reason to accuse the gospel.However, Paul asked the question rhetorically to bring to his readers the hardcore truth of the gospel.After explaining the participation of those who are saved, in the death, burial and resurrection of Jesus; he established the reality that as you are saved, you should reckon yourself dead to sin.You don't reckon yourself dead to sin because you first lived right. You don't reckon yourself dead to sin according to your good works.You reckon yourself dead to sin on the grounds of how Christ died to sin and defeated sin once and for all.I explained yesterday that Jesus did not only die FOR you. He died also WITH you.This is the testimony for all men, that Christ died for them. Therefore salvation is available for all men.However, when one comes to believe in Jesus and received salvation, he or she is identified with Christ.The testimony of the saved is that, his or her old man and nature died with Christ. And now in Christ he or she is a new creation.Now see these two verses:2 Corinthians 5:17 and Galatians 2:20.2 Corinthians 5:17 (Amplified). " Therefore if anyone is in Christ [that is, grafted in, joined to Him by faith in Him as Savior], he is a new creature [reborn and renewed by the Holy Spirit]; the old things [the previous moral and spiritual condition] have passed away. Behold, new things have come [because spiritual awakening brings a new life]."See Galatians 2:20 (TPT): " My old identity has been co-crucified with Messiah and no longer lives; for the nails of his cross crucified me with him. And now the essence of this new life is no longer mine, for the Anointed One lives his life through me— *we live in union as one! My new life is empowered by the faith of the Son of God who loves me so much that he gave himself for me, and dispenses his life into mine" So when you got saved you were united with Christ. And the old man was crucified with Christ on the cross. The old wretched nature of sin, died with Christ.Let's also take a look at Romans 6:5-13 " For if we have been united together in the likeness of His death, certainly we also shall be in the likeness of His resurrection, knowing this, that our old man was crucified with Him, that the body of sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves of sin." (vv 5-6) You can see here again, that as you were united together in the death of Jesus, your old man, who was the embodiment of sin was crucified with Christ.Now if you are in Christ you don't have the nature of sin in your spirit. You are a new creation, and you share in the likeness of the resurrection of Jesus. You have the new life of Christ. This life is not a slave controlled by sin. " For he who has died has been freed from sin. Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him, knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over Him. For the death that He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life that He lives, He lives to God. Likewise you also, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord. (vv 7-11) Now from the revelation of scriptures, you understand that Jesus died to sin once and for all and lives unto God forever.Therefore, because you are identified with Christ in His death, you are also alive to God in Christ once and for all.When you were made alive in God in Christ, it was not with the nature of sin. The nature of sin was terminated in the death of Jesus. Therefore you are dead to sin and alive to God in Christ Jesus, with the nature of righteousness.You did not become alive to yourself and the legalism of Moses.You were made alive to God in Christ with the nature of righteousness.It means now you must live according to the dominion of righteousness in you. You are no longer under the influence of sin, because the power of His resurrection has produced the righteousness of God in Christ in you.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 5:16-17,21; Romans 6:1-15; Galatians 2:17-21; Ephesians 2:1-6) WE PRAYThat we will live according to the dominion of righteousness in us. BIBLE READINGDay 83: Judges 19-21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am now quickened unto life.- The life of Christ is at work in me.- I am dead to sin and alive unto God.- Sin has no dominion over me. I am the righteousness of God in Christ.- I live above every negative addiction.- I cannot be influenced by the lust of sin, because I am a slave of righteousness.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!

title: EPISODE 94 - THE GIFT OF ETERNAL LIFE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.THE GIFT OF ETERNAL LIFE " For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord" Romans 6:23 (NKJV) How many times have you heard this at crusades? How many times have you heard this at "Easter Conventions"? I suppose you might have heard this over and over again even before you got saved. And most often the focus of this beautiful verse has been the first part, "For the wages of sin is death". It's often quoted with much fearsome tone. of course, the penalty or payment of sin is death. Eternal death is the product of the nature of sin.  God said to Adam, "...for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die" That was the spiritual death. "In the past you were spiritually dead because of your disobedience and sins." Ephesians 2:1 (GNT) Death was and is the present state of those who had not received Jesus; or those who had rejected Jesus and those who reject Him. However, the focus of this verse is not sin and its wages. The focus of the verse is THE GIFT OF ETERNAL LIFE. Paul the apostle was revealing the glorious and overwhelming gift of God to believers in Christ. Previously I explained how salvation is FREE BUT NOT CHEAP. And through salvation we received the GIFT OF ETERNAL LIFE. It is a gift and not a reward of our good works. " For it is by grace [God’s remarkable compassion and favor drawing you to Christ] that you have been saved [actually delivered from judgment and given eternal life] through faith. And this [salvation] is not of yourselves [not through your own effort], but it is the [undeserved, gracious] gift of God; not as a result of [your] works [nor your attempts to keep the Law], so that no one will [be able to] boast or take credit in any way [for his salvation]." Ephesians 2:8-9 (Amplfied). This was the focus of the love of God, that you will receive eternal life only by believing in Jesus. (John 3:16). Jesus declared that as His mandate as well. " ...I came that they may have life, and have it in abundance [to the full, till it overflows].*" John 10:10 (Amplified) This mandate of Jesus is not to be fulfilled in the future. It is not like you are going to receive the gift of eternal life after you have gone to heaven someday. When you received Jesus, you received Eternal life as a gift. Eternal life is not a life you will have in the future. It is a NOW LIFE. It is the life of God which you have received now. " And what is it that God has said? That he has given us eternal life and that this life is in his Son. So whoever has God’s Son has life; whoever does not have his Son, does not have life. I have written this to you who believe in the Son of God so that you may know you have eternal life." 1 John 5:11-13 (TLB) This is refreshing! Beloved, walk in this consciousness that you have Eternal life and you have it as a gift through Christ Jesus. You are not going to work for eternal life. It is yours now! DIG DEEPER: (Romans 3:21-28; John5:39-40; Hebrews 5:8; John 3:36; 5:24; John 6:40; 20:31) WE PRAY Father we thank you for the gift of eternal life we have received through Christ Jesus. BIBLE READINGDay 84: Ruth 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am now quickened unto life.- The life of Christ is at work in me.- I have eternal life as a gift. -I am not working hard to receive eternal life. I have it now.- I walk in the reality of the eternal life of God in me.- I don't have an ordinary life. I have the very life of God.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 95 - NO CONDEMNATION FOR YOU IN CHRIST
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers. NO CONDEMNATION FOR YOU IN CHRIST Therefore there is now no condemnation [no guilty verdict, no punishment] for those who are in Christ Jesus [who believe in Him as personal Lord and Savior]. Romans 8:1 There are many beautiful and refreshing realities in Christ. One of them is the reality of NO CONDEMNATION IN CHRIST. When you hear of condemnation what do you think about? Sense of guilt?Feeling of being wrong? Do you think that is all Jesus came to die for? Condemnation is more strong than a wrong feeling or a sense of guilt. The word Condemnation (in greek is Katakrima) is a judicial word, which means to be adjudged guilty, unfit for use, or forfeited; it is the act of dooming to punishment or forfeiture. It is punishment following sentence. It is a guilt verdict which is the bondage of sin. You will have a better understanding of condemnation when you closely look at Romans 8:1-2. " Therefore there is now no condemnation [no guilty verdict, no punishment] for those who are in Christ Jesus [who believe in Him as personal Lord and Savior]. For the law of the Spirit of life [which is] in Christ Jesus [the law of our new being] has set you free from the law of sin and of death. (Amplified). To have NO CONDEMNATION, is to be made free from the law of sin and death. Which means before Christ came, man was already condemned not only because of the act of sin but also because of the law of sin and death. But NOW and not THE FUTURE, there is no condemnation for those in Christ. Sometimes when people hear of having no condemnation in Christ, they think of a future experience. The reality of no condemnation in Christ is a now reality. Which means anyone outside Christ is already condemned. This is not just a future experience, it is a present state of anyone who has not received Jesus or has rejected Jesus. “God did not send his Son into the world to judge and condemn the world, but to be its Savior and rescue it! So now there is no longer any condemnation for those who believe in him, but the unbeliever already lives under condemnation because they do not believe in the name of God’s beloved Son" John 3:17-18 (TPT) Which means the unbeliever is already declared guilty and is living in the bondage of that verdict. Beloved Christ has made you free in Himself. He has justified you through His blood. No condemnation is a no condemnation! It is not something which can be reversed. It is an eternal verdict and reality. Just as the verdict of condemnation was a legal effect, even so is the verdict of no condemnation. The verdict of no condemnation is also the verdict of Justification! This verdict of justification was legally done in Christ. To be justified is to be declared not guilty. Because God is righteous, all that He does is done in righteousness. God legally declared us not guilty. In Romans 3:23-26 "since all have sinned and continually fall short of the glory of God, and are being justified [declared free of the guilt of sin, made acceptable to God, and granted eternal life] as a gift by His [precious, undeserved] [c]grace, through the redemption [the payment for our sin] which is [provided] in Christ Jesus, whom God displayed publicly [before the eyes of the world] as a [life-giving] sacrifice of atonement and reconciliation (propitiation) by His blood [to be received] through faith. This was to demonstrate His righteousness [which demands punishment for sin], because in His forbearance [His deliberate restraint] He passed over the sins previously committed [before Jesus’ crucifixion]. It was to demonstrate His righteousness at the present time, so that He would be just and the One who justifies those who have faith in Jesus [and rely confidently on Him as Savior]." (Amplified) The punishment or the condemnation of sin is death (Romans 6:23). Therefore Jesus died to satisfy the demand of justice for you, in other to be legally declared not guilty and to enjoy the gift of NO CONDEMNATION in Him. This is your reality in Christ  You are declared not guilty (Justified) therefore you cannot come under condemnation. HallelujahDIG DEEPER:(Romans 3; Romans 8:1-4; Romans 8:34; 2 Corinthians 5:17-19; Hebrews 8:12;) WE PRAY Thanking the Lord that He has declared us not guilty in Christ Jesus and that we shall walk in the consciousness of this reality in Christ.  BIBLE READINGDay 85: Ruth 3-4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am justified in Christ - There is now no condemnation for me. - I am made perfect in Christ Jesus. - I walk in the consciousness of my justification. - I refuse to live in the guilt of sin. - I am legally not guilty because of Christ OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 96 - INSEPARABLE FROM THE LOVE OF GOD IN CHRIST
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. INSEPARABLE FROM THE LOVE GOD IN CHRIST " Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?" Romans 8:35 (NKJV) Our salvation is first by the love of Christ. It was the love of Christ that moved Jesus to the cross not our works.By His saving grace and loving kindness God saved us and brought us into eternal fellowship with Jesus our Lord.It's interesting to hear some brethren talk about losing their salvation and God turning His back on them. And they allude that to God judging them according to their works.Most people judge their relationship with God by the standards of human relations.God made it possible for you to have a family relationship with Him. You can grow your personal relationship with God (through your participation in church meetings, personal prayers, fellowship with the word and the spirit etc).Nevertheless, you are not the sustainer of the relationship you have with God.The love of God is the foundation of God's relationship with you. And it's kept by the faithfulness of God. By God's faithfulness we are brought into fellowship with His Son, Jesus (1 Corinthians 1:9).He forgives you from all wrongs by His faithfulness (1 John 1:9). God, who called you into Himself is faithful to keep you blameless to the end. (1 Thessalonians 5:24). God is faithful to keep you from falling away by His own ability. (Jude 1:24). He didn't just bring you into Himself, He established you in His life. He emptied His life into you and mingled you with Himself.You were joined unto the Lord through the baptism of the Spirit (1 Corinthians 12:13; Romans 6:3-4;) " But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit with Him." 1 Corinthians 6:17 (NKJV). Do you get it?!You were not just justified in Christ, you were not just brought into fellowship with the Lord, in that fellowship you were joined or mingled with the Lord.Now you cannot be separated from His love. You are not just a son of God, you are ONE SPIRIT WITH THE LORD.Oh glory!No wonder Jesus said "I am the vine and you are the branches." (John 15:5). Listen, you are one with Christ and nothing can separate you from Christ.This must be your persuasion.Look what Paul the apostle wrote in the latter part of Romans 8: " For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor principalities nor powers, nor things present nor things to come, nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord."Romans 8:38-39 (NKJV) Beloved, you must also have this persuasion that nothing can separate you from the love of Christ.HallelujahDIG DEEPER:(Romans 8:33-39; Psalm 103:17; Jeremiah 31:3; Songs of Solomon 3:4;) WE PRAY- That our faith is established stronger in the Lord and His word that we shall stand firm in the reality of what He has achieved for us in Christ Jesus.-That no challenge, no cosmic force nor thought can make us doubt the reality that we are eternally inseparable from Christ and His love. BIBLE READINGDay 86: 1 Samuel 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am mingled with the Lord- I am in eternal fellowship with the Lord.- No cosmic force can separate us from the love of Christ.- We are persuaded of the love of Christ.- We are deeply rooted in the Lord that nothing can uproot us from Him.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 97 - JUSTIFIED BY FAITH
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.JUSTIFIED BY FAITH" Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith apart from the deeds of the law."  Romans 3:28 (NKJV) It's interesting how one may think he or she is made righteous by his/her own deeds.Get this, from Genesis to Revelation, no single person was declared righteous by the deeds of the law (the law here is the law of Moses).The law of Moses, couldn't make any one righteous. The purpose of the law is to reveal or unmask sin. " For by the merit of observing the law no one earns the status of being declared righteous before God, for it is the law that fully exposes and unmasks the reality of sin." Romans 3:21 (TPT). The law reveals your imperfection and inability to be righteous.You are made righteous or you are justified only through Jesus. It is your believe in Jesus, that made you righteous.You may try your best to follow the law of Moses, however the law is designed to bring you to the end of yourself by exposing your weaknesses.The law points you to the need of a saviour.Both the law and the prophets bear witness of this reality, that you are justified or made righteous without the law of Moses. " But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being testified by the law and the prophets" Romans 3:21 (Webster's Bible Translation). So then you must know that your justification is by faith in Jesus only. It is good to live right, but you are not justified by your good deeds.However, because you are made righteous you live right.Look at how Paul the apostle concluded his teaching concerning Jesus, in the synagogue at Antioch in Pisidia; "Therefore let it be known to you, brethren, that through this Man is preached to you the forgiveness of sins; and by Him everyone who believes is justified from all things from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses." Acts 13:38-39 (NKJV) Now Paul said this when he was to give an exhortation in Antioch by the Jewish leaders. He said these things after they had read the law and the prophets. " And after the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Men and brethren, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.”Then Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen:" Acts 13:15-16 (NKJV). Now what I want you to take note of is that, those Jews read the law and the prophets and thought they are made righteous by the deeds of the law. They didn't understand the purpose of the law. They read the law and the prophets, yet they couldn't see the testimony of those scriptures they read.The Jews read the law and the prophets and couldn't see the true testimony of the scriptures. They never saw that the scriptures (the law and the prophets) pointed to Jesus. " You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me" John 5:39 (BSB) AND THIS IS THE TESTIMONY OF JESUS, YOU ARE JUSTIFIED BY FAITH IN HIM!You cannot pay for the penalty of sin by your good deeds or works of the law.When you attempt to be justified by your works, it shall be reckon as debts!(Romans 4:4).Beloved, you are justified only through faith in Jesus and not by the works or the deeds of the law of Moses. " For we conclude that a person is put right with God only through faith, and not by doing what the Law commands" Romans 3:28 (GNT) Hallelujah DIG DEEPER:(Acts 13:13-52; Romans 3; Romans 4:1-25) WE PRAY- That our minds will be stayed on the gospel of our Lord Jesus that we will not depend on our works but continue in the glory of the gospel. BIBLE READINGDay 86: 1 Samuel 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified by faith- The life of Christ is my life.- I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds.- My boast is in the Lord’s finished work of Christ.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!

title: EPISODE 98 - CONTINUE IN THE FAITH
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. CONTINUE IN THE FAITH " As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him. Colossians 2:6 (NKJV) Do you think how you received Christ or got born again, is different from how you live in Him?How did you receive the Lord?How did you become born again?How did you receive the gift of eternal life?How were you justified?Clearly from our previous discussions, you should be able to answer these with ease.You did not come to Christ by your good deeds, neither are you sustained in Christ by it.It is by Grace and through faith you received Jesus, therefore you continue your living in Christ by grace through faith. " For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast"Ephesians 2:8-9 (NKJV) You are justified only through faith in Jesus and not by the works or the deeds of the law of Moses. " For we conclude that a person is put right with God only through faith, and not by doing what the Law commands" Romans 3:28 (GNT) Anything we received in Christ is by faith.We got saved and came into Christ by faith.We were justified and received the gift of eternal life by faith.We received the Spirit not by the works of the law, but by faith. " This only I want to learn from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?Therefore He who supplies the Spirit to you and works miracles among you, does He do it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?" Galatians 3:2,5 (NKJV) Beloved, receiving Christ and our experience of all that is in Christ is by faith.Now in Paul's epistle to the brethren in Colosse, he instructed them on how they are to continue their walk in Christ. " As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him, rooted and built up in Him and established in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving." Colossians 2:6-7 (NKJV) After he instructed them to continue in Christ as they have received Him, he then showed them how in the verse 7: a. Be rooted in the faith b. Built up in the faith c. Established in the faith. These all point to the work of the gospel in you. The reality of the gospel is that, you were justified by faith. (Romans 5:1)Therefore as you are justified you live by faith.(Romans 1:17).The gospel of Jesus is the word of His grace which produces faith.The more you hear the gospel of Jesus, you are rooted, built up and established in faith. " So now, brethren, I commend you to God and to the word of His grace, which is able to build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified." Acts 20:32 (NKJV). You will definitely meet people whose teachings and thoughts will make you think faith in Jesus is not enough. They will preach "another gospel"; which will make you think though you got saved by faith in Christ, your salvation is now sustained and kept by the works of the law of Moses.Some may have good intentions, and for others they are envious of the glorious life you have in Christ.Some will make you think what you have received in Christ is not enough.Don't give your mind to such thoughts. YOU ARE COMPLETE IN CHRISTLook at the further instruction Paul gave to the brethren in Colosse after he had told them to continue in the faith from verse 6 and 7 of Colossians 2: " Beware lest anyone cheat you through philosophy and empty deceit, according to the tradition of men, according to the basic principles of the world, and not according to Christ. For in Him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily; and you are complete in Him, who is the head of all principality and power." Colossians 2:8-10 (NKJV). You came into Christ through faith, walk in Him by faith.When you turn away from the gospel of grace which produces faith, you will frustrate the grace of God in your life. It means you are moving away from the Spirit-life to now walk in the flesh.And the scriptures call it "foolishness" (Galatians 3:1-5) As you are in Christ, He is now your life. Therefore the life you live now in the flesh, LIVE BY THE FAITH OF THE SON OF GOD WHO LOVED YOU AND GAVE HIMSELF FOR YOU. (Galatians 2:20)HallelujahDIG DEEPER:( Galatians 3:1-9; Colossians 1:10,19-29; Micah 4:2; 1 Thessalonians 2:13) WE PRAY-That we shall not be given to another gospel which is not Christ's but continue in the faith of Christ being rooted, built up and established in the faith. BIBLE READINGDay 86: 1 Samuel 7-8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified by faith- The life of Christ is my life.- I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds.- My boast is in the Lord’s finished work of Christ. - I am rooted, built up and established in the knowledge of Christ. - I continue in the reality of faith and shall give not room to the traditions of men.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 99 - CONTINUE STEADFASTLY IN PRAYER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.CONTINUE STEADFASTLY IN PRAYER" Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving" Colossians 4:2 (ESV) There is so much talk on prayer and few pray consistently or diligently.Those who also pray, only pray because of their interests or pray only when they are confronted by troubles.It is not wrong to pray in the day of adversity.
