Neither is it wrong to pray when you have a prayer topic or an issue to address.The idea of prayer transcends making requests or asking God for something.Prayer is not designed by God to aid the satisfaction of your cravings and self-centered appetites.Prayer is more than running to God in time of trouble.Prayer is a medium of communing with God in the richness of His heart and Spirit.There is a dimension of prayer where you speak to God beyond the assent of your mind and emotions.When you consistently commune with God through prayer, you enjoy the infusion of His life in a unique way.Through prayer you journey with God into depths and heights which cannot be fathom by the senses.This is why the Lord gave us the gift of praying in the Spirit. " For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful" 1 Corinthians 14:14 (KJV). Praying in the Spirit always, helps you to articulate hidden realities in the Spirit. You make supply of spiritual verities beyond what your mind could have carved.There are spiritual things which may seem too coded to the natural mind. But as you constantly pray in the Spirit you decode these things unto manifestations.To the mind, they may be mysteries and unfruitful. However, in the Spirit those words are great lights of answers. " For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries." 1 Corinthians 14:2 (KJV). You are able to travel deep into the wells of God's Spirit, to fetch out untapped light and graces to perform His duty in the physical realm.Nothing can be done with God in the fullness of His Spirit without prayer.Pray with your Spirit and prophesy with your understanding.By this you release intense spiritual energies for greater works.The Holy Spirit is able to hammer out spiritual channels in you, so that there will be the outflow of immeasurable power and blessings.There are restraining forces in the world, in your school, at your work place, in your neighbourhood, etc which are determined to prevent you from fulfilling God's predetermined purpose and counsel.And it is a war for supremacy over the hearts of men.We can only conquer the hearts of men not just by mere words.It is only by words cooked in intense steadfast prayers.  " Be faithful to pray as intercessors who are fully alert and giving thanks to God. And please pray for me, that God will open a door of opportunity for us to preach the revelation of the mystery of Christ, for whose sake I am imprisoned. Pray that I would unfold and reveal fully this mystery, for that is my delightful assignment" Colossians 4:2-4 (TPT) Apart from preaching the word to get people saved, giving financially towards the gospel and serving every way in the work of the Lord; CONTINUE STEADFASTLY IN PRAYER! The prayers of the early saints, were not merely centered on their needs.They prayed interceding for the salvation of souls and for the spread of the gospel of Jesus. Anything they prayed for, which even was about themselves, had the goal of the prosperity of the gospel.See what the scriptures said concerning Epaphras: "Epaphras, who is one of you, a bondservant of Christ, greets you, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God" Colossians 4:12 (NKJV) Starting from today, PRAY EARNESTLY AND CONSISTENTLY EVERYDAY.Don't be too busy for prayer. Don't be lazy. Don't procrastinate prayer times. Make prayer your utmost priority.Make supply of divine ability into the day and the assignment the Lord has given you.PRAY!Hallelujah NB: A SPECIAL REQUEST...DON'T SKIP ANY OF THE VERSES IN THE DIG DEEPER. READ THEM AND PRAY!DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 6:18; Luke 18:1; Acts 1:14; Philippians 4:6; Colossians 1:3-4, 9-11; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; 1 Kings 9:3; 1 Samuel 12:23; Romans 12:12; Luke 21:36; Luke 22:44) WE PRAYNB: Please pray with:Colossians 4:2-4;12Colossians 1:9-11 BIBLE READINGDay 86: 1 Samuel 9-11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Instead of being anxious, I pray.- I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers.- I am given to prayer.- I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 100 - REJOICE IN THE LORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. REJOICE IN THE LORD " Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice Philippians 4:4 (NKJV) What do you think the adversary is after?Your money?Your beauty?Your children?Your business?Your academic success?Your salvation?Your marriage?Beloved, the adversary has always been after your eternal fulfillment of JOY!To REJOICE is a high degree expression and experience of joy.It is the demonstration of a triumphant elation.Many people rejoice at the end of their journey or after they had accomplished something.But for you in Christ, the Lord is charging you to a daily life of Joy!This is because your life in Christ began in great rejoicing. " And it was a happy day for him when he gave us our new lives through the truth of his Word, and we became, as it were, the first children in his new family." James 1:18 (TLB) This happy day is beyond the "happiness' men experience in seasons. This is an eternal palpable expression of joy.No wonder Jesus spoke of the joy in Heaven and they rejoice when a soul is saved. " I tell you that in the same way there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one repentant sinner. Luke 15:10 (Weymouth New Testament). " That’s the way God responds every time one lost sinner repents and turns to him. He says to all his angels, ‘Let’s have a joyous celebration, for that one who was lost I have found!*” Luke 15:10 (TPT). This is a heavenly party because of the salvation experience.Beloved, when you were born again into Christ, THE WHOLE OF THE HEAVENS were thrilled with this nonpareil achievement of Christ.And that is the reality of the Kingdom of God. " for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit" Romans 14:17 (NKJV) WHAT A LIFE?!You have been brought forth into this joy of life unto all eternity.This is your realm. You don't have to entertain sorrow around you no matter the situation. You have to maintain your joy. It is your daily charge to keep.If you think there is nothing to rejoice in or to be joyful about, then you have to reconsider your mindset about Salvation.Your salvation is the greatest thing that has ever happened to you. REJOICE IN IT. Look at the Psalmist: " But I have trusted in Your lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation." Psalm 13:5 To rejoice in the Lord is not a suggestion, its a COMMAND!Paul wrote his epistle to the Philippians from prison, and there was nothing sorrowful about him. From prison he charged the brethren to rejoice in the Lord. He never saw himself as a prisoner of Rome. He always saw himself instead as a prisoner of Christ.What a mindset?!When Jesus rose from the dead, one of the first things He said was:" Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping?..." It is a wonder to be sorrowfully in our Kingdom!Our strength is the JOY OF THE LORD! Do not be sorrowful. (Nehemiah 8:10).Practice JOY!!! DIG DEEPER:(Philippians 3:1; 2 Corinthians 6:10; Habbakuk 3:18; Psalm 33:1;Romans 12:12; Psalm 118:24) WE PRAY- Thanking God for bringing us forth into this glorious joy of life.- That we will continue in this joy in all seasons of life no matter the situation.BIBLE READINGDay 100: 1 Samuel 12-14*DECLARE THESE WORDS:*- I have been brought forth into a life of joy, this is my realm.- I am full of joy.- I give no room for sorrow.- I refuse to entertain any sorrowful thought. - My strength is the joy of the Lord.- I practice joy daily.- I rejoice at every count.- I start my day in joy, I continue through the day in joy and end in joy.- I rejoice always.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 101 - THE ETHEREAL TRANQUIL
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE ETHEREAL TRANQUIL " Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid. John 14:27 (NKJV) The Kingdom of God is revealed as Righteousness, Peace and Joy in the Holy Spirit.I have previously explained the crucial essence of JOY.Today, we look into another climacteric reality in our walk with God.There were rich things the Lord disclosed in the period between His resurrection and ascension.One of them is PEACE!There are two key words which denotes PEACE in the scriptures; a. SHALOM in Hebrew b. EIRĒNĒ (pronounced eye-RAH-nay) in Greek. There is some difference between these two shalom and eirene.The word SHALOM is extensive and intense than EIRĒNĒ.In most cases if not all, the word EIRĒNĒ (PEACE) in the new testament was used with the Jewish understanding of PEACE (SHALOM). EIRĒNĒ in Greek/Septuagint is from a primary verb eirō which means to join (see Strongs Bible Concordance). It speaks of the harmonious relationships between men, nations and friendliness. It also denotes, freedom from molestation, law and order which brings blessings, living quietly, the sense of contentment and the harmonized relationship between God and man accomplished through the gospel. (See Vine's expository Dictionary).However, as I have aforementioned, SHALOM is intense and extensive.Shalom primarily signifies WHOLENESS. It also means to be unhewn, full, fully furnished and made perfect. It is also rendered as "sōtēria, which means salvation.Shalom is a state with total well-being, prosperity, flourishing, inward and outward tranquility as its fringes.This is why most expressions as PEACE by the Jesus and the New Testament saints was with the JEWISH Concept of PEACETherefore when a Jew greets you, SHALOM, it is not "Hello", it is a BLESSING of wholeness, peace, and complete prosperity in your day.When you truly come to understand the meaning of SHALOM, you will not take any speaking of SHALOM as a mere declaration. It is a rich prophetic blessing which must be embraced in great faith and joy.There is a Peace the world attempts to give, yet its boundary is another man's selfish desire.However, in Christ Jesus we have access to enjoy the full manifestation of peace SHALOM.From the Amplified Bible, John 14:17, is well presented. "Peace I leave with you; My [perfect] peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Do not let your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid. [Let My perfect peace calm you in every circumstance and give you courage and strength for every challenge.]" Jesus left you peace. He gave you HIS PEACE. This peace is the ethereal quality and a state of transcendent tranquility.It epitomizes all perfection in essence and expression.He is the only one that dispenses this peace because He is the PRINCE OF PEACE (Isaiah 9:6). He doesn't outsource it, He is the source of it.The Prophet Isaiah revealed how we tap and drink of this SHALOM: " You will keep him in perfect peace, Whose mind is stayed on You, Because he trusts in You." Isaiah 26:3 (NKJV) The expression, PERFECT PEACE denotes SHALOM SHALOM.You have abundant and immeasurable satisfaction of wholeness, perfection, prosperity, ethereal tranquility when your frame of imagination, conception, and thoughts are fastened on the Lord.Beloved set your mind and affection on the Lord.For His Perfect Peace will calm you in every circumstance and give you courage and strength for every challenge.SHALOM!DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 119:165; Isaiah 26:12; Philippians 4:7; John 20:21; Colossians 3:15; John 16:33; Numbers 6:26 ) WE PRAY- That we will set our minds and affections on the Lord to receive courage and strength for every obstacle. BIBLE READINGDay 91: 1 Samuel 15-17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have inward and outward tranquility.- I flourish in all things.- Whatever I do, prospers.- The perfect peace of God calms me in every circumstance.- I refuse to be agitated no matter the challenge because I enjoy perfect peace.- I am sound all round.- I enjoy the blessing of wholeness everyday.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 102 - THE RULE AND GARRISON OF PEACE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and tohelp you grow in deep spiritual understanding andknowledge.Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-propheticprayers.THE RULE AND GARRISON OF PEACEAnd let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful. Colossians 3:15 (NKJV) The epistles were written to establish us in the consciousness of who Christ is, the reality of what He has done for us, our responsibilities in Christ and how we are to conduct ourselves in the world and among the saints.Understand that God did not produce a bunch of lazy sons in the Kingdom. With all that Christ achieved for us and supplied to us through His Spirit, there things we are entrusted to do by the Lord.From Episode 90, I explained the things Christ has achieved and given to us in Himself, by His grace for our enjoyment.And I began to share with you things you must continue to do to continue in the enjoyment of our New Life in Christ.How you take these things serious and continue in them will determine how rich your walk with God will be. Take Note: These responsibilities are not to preserve and keep your salvation. For it is God who keeps you from falling.The Salvation which you have received is the responsibility of God. Your growth in the newness of life is your responsibility.This explains why many people have been saved in Christ, yet they are not enjoying the richness of their inheritance in Christ.From Episode 98-Continue in the FaithFrom Episode 99-Continue Steadfastly In Prayer.From Episode 100 -Rejoice in the Lord. When you take hold of these things I have shared with you, you shall not stumble in your walk with God.In Episode 101— THE ETHEREAL TRANQUIL, I shared some insight on the transcendency of the peace we have in Christ.This is a rich matter which should set you on a journey where you will not be moved by any storm of this world.These things sustained the faith of the saints who began this race. There is a reason they were not moved by the persecution, the rejection, and the troubling times they faced.They continued to shine forth the light of God in the darkest places. They died with joy and peace whiles they were burnt at stake, given to wild beasts, crucified and experienced cruel executions.Nothing moved even the saints who witnessed such cruelty towards their fellow brethren in the Lord.They were deeply entrenched in this truth I am sharing with you.We looked at the extensiveness and intensity of Peace we have received in Christ in the previous episode.Now again look at what you are to do with this PEACE of Christ: "Peace I leave with you; My [perfect] peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you.Do not let your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid. [Let My perfect peace calm you in every circumstance and give you courage and strength for every challenge.]" John 14:17 (Amplified)Oh glory! We know we did not receive the PEACE the world gives. We have the PEACE OF CHRIST.However, when we are confronted by challenges the Perfect peace of Christ doesn't just find expression automatically. Our Lord Jesus instructed,LET MY PERFECT PEACE calm you in every circumstance. He is not going to let it calm you. You have to let His perfect peace calm you. He has already given you that PEACE, what do you now do with it?Definitely you may be confronted by challenges, however, you have to make this PEACE OF CHRIST rule in your heart.Submit yourself to the controlling force, the government, or the hegemony of the PEACE of Christ. Let the peace of Christ [the inner calm of one who walks daily with Him] be the controlling factor in your hearts [deciding and settling questions that arise]. To this peace indeed you were called as members in one body [of believers]. And be thankful [to God always].Colossians 3:15 (Amplified) The Perfect Peace of Christ has to influence your relationship with the saints as well.Beloved, don't choose fear, anxiety, doubts and worry. Let the peace of God have it full dominance in your heart.To engage and supply the PERFECT PEACE of Christ, you have to PRAY and make SUPPLICATION with THANKSGIVING in the midst of every storm.It means you don't bear the burden of the storm or the challenge. Through prayer and supplication, you put God's strength to work. And you go about your day with thanksgiving.Hallelujah! " Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything; tell God your needs, and don’t forget to thank him for his answers. If you do this, you will experience God’s peace, which is far more wonderful than the human mind can understand. His peace will keep your thoughts and your hearts quiet and at rest as you trust in Christ Jesus." Philippians 4:6-7 (TLB). Do you see why you must continue steadfastly in prayer?The PEACE of God will keep or garrison your heart as you pray.The peace of God can be as regiment or squadron or battalion, which will defend, fortify and occupy your mind and heart from the vicissitudes of this worldIt has what it takes to displace worry at the center and borders of your life.Let the PERFECT PEACE OF CHRIST RULE IN YOUR HEART.SHALOM!DIG DEEPER:(Isaiah 26:3; 2 Corinthians 10:5; Philippians 4:9; Job 22:21;Romans 8:6; Romans 5:1; Isaiah 27:5; ) WE PRAY- That as we pray we bring every imagination, every high thing and every thought to the obedience of Christ and that our hearts will be garrisoned with the perfect peace of God BIBLE READINGDay 92: 1 Samuel 18-20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I allow the perfect peace of Christ to calm my heart in every situation.- Through prayer and supplication I put the strength of God to work.- I do all things with peace.- My living is in the restfulness of peace.- I am a man of peace.- I have the strength and courage for every situation. - I fix my heart and focus on the Lord today.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 103 - BE ENRICHED WITH CHRIST'S WORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. BE ENRICHED WITH CHRIST'S WORD " Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom..." Colossians 3:16 (NLT) In the previous episode, I also explained the importance of taking responsibility of your spiritual growth.No one matures in the Spirit automatically. You must make some commitments to grow spiritually.The epistles were written to establish you in: 1. The consciousness of who Christ is. 2. The reality of what He has done for you. 3. Your responsibilities in Christ. 4. And how you are to conduct yourself in the world and among the saints. We have looked at how you should:Continue in the Faith —Episode 98Continue Steadfastly In Prayer — Episode 99Rejoice in the Lord — Episode 100The Rule and Garrison of Peace — Episode 102 These are items which are crucial for your living in the newness of life.However, they are all founded and fueled by the word of Christ.Your understanding of joy, consistency in prayer, and enjoyment of the perfect peace of God are by the RICHNESS OF THE WORD OF CHRIST IN YOU.How will you not live in fear?How will you not walk in the sense of condemnation?How will you not think you are an enemy of God?It's by how you have been enriched with the Message of Christ.The word of Christ is the Word of faith. It is the same as the Word of His Grace. It is the gospel of our Lord Jesus.You cannot live the fullness of your faith life until you are fully enriched with the gospel.The word must dwell in you in all wisdom.Now in the opening verse , you have to pay attention to the instructional verb used: " Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom..." Colossians 3:16 (NLT). This instruction is necessary because the Word will not automatically dwell in you in all wisdom, without your intention.You must first of all understand that your life in Christ began by the WORD OF CHRIST.The Word of Christ is the seed of God sown into you to produce divine life in you.Now let’s look at this in 1 Peter 1:23. It will be great to see this beautiful verse of scripture in 5 different translations of the Bible: " having been born again, not of corruptible seed but incorruptible, through the word of God which lives and abides [forever" (NKJV) "for you have been born again [that is, reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, and set apart for His purpose] not of seed which is perishable but [from that which is] imperishable and immortal, that is, through the living and everlasting word of God." (AMPLIFIED) " For through the eternal and living Word of God you have been born again. And this “seed” that he planted within you can never be destroyed but will live and grow inside of you forever" (TPT) "Your new life is not like your old life. Your old birth came from mortal sperm; your new birth comes from God’s living Word. Just think: a life conceived by God himself!" (MSG) "For you have a new life. It was not passed on to you from your parents, for the life they gave you will fade away. This new one will last forever, for it comes from Christ, God’s ever-living Message to men." (TLB) These should refresh your heart.Now you can see exquisitely that your new birth in Christ is by the Word of Christ.Therefore, you can only grow by the Word of Christ. "as newborn babes, desire the pure milk of the word, that you may grow thereby" 1 Peter 2:2 (NKJV). You can only grow by the Word which brought you forth.The Word of Christ must become your diet, for you were hewn in God by the Word.Your living depends on it. You cannot live the purpose of God outside His Word.You have to feed on it, masticate and absorb it until your are nourished and enriched by it.Read Your Bible everyday and memorize the scriptures.(This is why I provide you with daily Bible-reading and dig deeper scriptures) Listen to Christ-centered teachings ( YOU WILL FIND INSPIRING AUDIO TEACHINGS HERE) YOU CAN ALSO WATCH VIDEOS FROM HERE AND HERE (Remember to Subscribe).Read Christ-Centered writings daily (THE WITH is one of the best nutritional-pack for you).As you daily fellowship with the scriptures through these mediums, your mindset will be corrected and transformed.The word of Christ must be your wisdom in all things.LET THE WORD OF CHRIST DWELL IN YOU RICHLY.Shalom DIG DEEPER:(Romans 10:17; Ephesians 5:26; Jihn 5:39; 2 Timothy 3:15; Hebrews 4:12-13; Job 23:12; Deut. 11:18-20; Deut. 6:6). WE PRAY- Thanking God for the gift of His word which has the potency to correct our heart, mind and body for a purposeful living. BIBLE READINGDay 92: 1 Samuel 21-23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I grow by the word.- I live by the word.- I esteem the word above everything, therefore I make time for the word daily.- I am nourished by the word.- I am enriched by the word.- I feed on the word, for it is my diet.- My mind is sanctified by the word.- The word is my wisdom in all things.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 104 - THE CENTRICITY OF THE SCRIPTURES
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE CENTRICITY OF THE SCRIPTURES "You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and these are they which testify of Me" John 5:39 (NKJV) We have looked at the necessity of being enriched by the Word of Christ. I have emphasized how we are to make the gospel of our Lord Jesus the focus of our thoughts. Now, this doesn't suggest that we only read the New Testament portion of the Bible. The entire books of the Bible are scriptures given us for our inward growth. The Scriptures are the sacred or holy writ of God, documented to bring us into fellowship with the deep thoughts of God. The Bible is the Word of God, designed to make you wise. All scriptures are the outbreathings of God, for our inward breathings. "Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness" 2 Timothy 3:16 (BLB) All the books of the Bible are scriptures. Let me establish this: The apostles referred to the books in the Old Testament portion of the Bible (the books of the Prophets, the Laws, the Psalms, the Historical books and the Poetic books) as Scriptures. They mostly made references to these scriptures in their teachings and in the epistles. You will find these in the Gospels, the Epistles, and the Acts of the Apostles. " For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that we through the patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope." Romans 15:4 (NKJV). Now, the above verse explains how they saw the scriptures (Old Testament portion of the Bible). The entire New Testament, including the manifestation of Christ, were rooted in the Old Testament portion of the Bible. Some argue that the books in the New Testament portion of the Bible are not scriptures. But the apostles didn't see it that way. Their writings were seen as scriptures as well and also as commands of God. "And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you; As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction" 2 Peter 3:15-16 (KJV) Peter refers to the epistles of Paul as one of the other scriptures. See what Paul the apostle has to say: " If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord." 1 Corinthians 14:37 (KJV) There you have it! This is how the brethren received the messages of the apostles: "For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, *when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe." 1 Thessalonians 2:13 (KJV) From these scriptures, acknowledge that, the entire books of the Bible, (starting from Genesis to Revelation), are inspired by God. ● Do you want to understand The Canonization of the New Testament? ● Do you desire to KNOW HOW TO RIGHTLY DIVIDE THE WORD OF GOD? ● Do you sometimes Wonder if the Bible is truly the Word of God? ● Do you think the Bible contradicts itself? ● Are you troubled or confused in understanding the scriptures? ● Do you want to know the MIND OF GOD through the Scriptures? GET READY TO JOIN THE SPECIAL ONLINE MINISTRY SCHOOL THIS MAY/JUNE What then is the focus of the scriptures? The central theme of the scriptures (from Genesis to Malachi) is Christ. These Scriptures are testimonies of His Person, His Gospel Plan, Kingdom Purpose and the Pursuit of His Economy of Grace. He is the centricity of the Scriptures. Every event, festival, instruction, life of any individual, precept and ordinance testify of Christ. " You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; *and these are they which testify of Me." John 5:39 (NKJV) When you patiently study the scriptures and don't find Christ; His Purpose, Plans and Economy of Grace as the central theme, then you didn't study with the Spirit. The Holy Spirit will bring to your heart, the Knowledge of Christ as you study the scriptures. He is craftily concealed in the books of Moses, the Psalms, the Prophets and the other historical books. When you behold His knowledge, the scriptures will come to life. Later that Sunday when Jesus resurrected, two of His disciples were walking from Jerusalem to Emmaus, a journey of about seventeen miles (which could be about 6 hours walk). And whiles having a deep discussion about the events of the last few days, Jesus joined them in their walk to Emmaus (Luke 24: 13-15) " Then he carefully unveiled to them the revelation of himself throughout the Scripture. He started from the beginning and explained the writings of Moses and all the prophets, showing how they wrote of him and revealed the truth about himself." Luke 24:27 (TPT) After their eyes opened, look at what they said: " Stunned, they looked at each other and said, “Why didn’t we recognize it was him? Didn’t our hearts burn with the flames of holy passion while we walked beside him? He unveiled for us such profound revelation from the Scriptures!” Luke 24:32 (TPT) Oh glory to God. When you come to the revelation of the Scriptures, your heart will burn with holy passion and flames. A veil is taken off from the scriptures anytime Christ is revealed. As you study the scriptures, even the Old Testament portion of the Bible, desire to meet Christ. See the Holy writings from the perspective of Jesus and not by your head knowledge. The heart of the scriptures is Christ. Selah!DIG DEEPER:(2 Peter 1:20-21; John 20:31; John 1:45; Luke 24:44; Matthew 1:22) WE PRAYThat as we study and read the scriptures everyday, we shall behold the revelation of our Lord Jesus, who is the heart of God. BIBLE READINGDay 94: 1 Samuel 24-26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I study the scriptures, Christ is unfolded to me. - By the Spirit, I see Christ in every book of the Bible.- My heart is opened wild to see Christ from the scriptures.- As I study the scriptures, I increase in the revelation of Christ.- As I study the scriptures, every veil of misconception and contradiction is taken off.- I behold only Christ in the scriptures. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 105 - THE WORD OF GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE WORD OF GOD " In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." John 1:1 (NKJV) There is nothing which is of God, that first didn't happen by the Word.The Word of God is the immaterial material by which all things were made.One may ask, 1. How old is the Word of God? 2. Is the Bible the Word of God? 3. Why do we talk about the Word of God as though it's a person? 4. What are the Characteristics of the Word? 5. What is the efficacy of the Word of God? Let me start with question 2: Understand that there is no question related to the FAITH in Christ, which is answered with YES or NO without first providing detailed explanations.Every question must be answered with a TEACHING.An outright YES or NO is not enough answer to questions pertaining to the Faith.Truth always has an evidence.Join the Crystallization Confluence this MAY.Through the CRYSTALLIZATION CONFLUENCE (which is the Special ONLINE MINISTRY SCHOOL this May/June), we will be having an exhaustive teaching on the BIBLE and THE CANONIZATION OF THE NEW TESTAMENT.NB: Your participation in such class is crucial for the strengthening of your Faith. Make it priority to be a part of it.Questions 4 and 5 will be answered in the subsequent episodes of . ANSWERING QUESTION 1 AND 3 The opening verse addresses these two questions: " In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." John 1:1 From this verse we see the IDENTITY and the IMMEASURABLE ANTIQUITY OF THE WORD.The beginning referred here is not the beginning of time, but before the beginning of time.It is the beginnings in the eternal past before time began.Lets look at it in the Amplified Bible: " In the beginning [before all time] was the Word (Christ), and the Word was with God, and the Word was God Himself." John 1:1 The Word of God did not come into existence when the books of the Bible were written.The Word of God preexisted before the conception of time.This will make sense when you understand that, the Word of God is God.The identity of the Word is God Himself.Why?The Word of God is the Living Thought, Living Motive or Intention and the Living expression of God.(Anything which is in God and of God is Living. If it is of God then it will exude LIFE.)The Greek word used in John 1:1 for "WORD" is Logos.It denotes the expression of thoughts, not a mere name of an object. Logos embodies conception or idea, saying or statement. (See Vine's Expository Dictionary).A man's personality is his thoughts. A man is inseparable from his word.John 1:1, substantiates this truth concerning God.The Word of God is God. Before there was existence, God preexisted.In God's preexistence His WORD was with Him. Before all things He was with His Word and His Word was Him.In all eternity, the effect of His Word was seen only when He speaks. Yet the hosts of the Heavens could not see the PERSON of His Word.The prophets received the prophetic words of God (which are manifold glimpses of God's expression), yet they could not behold His person.The Person of the Word of God was seen when the WORD took on the form of man. " And the Word (Christ) became flesh, and lived among us; and we [actually] saw His glory, glory as belongs to the [One and] only begotten Son of the Father, [the Son who is truly unique, the only One of His kind, who is] full of grace and truth (absolutely free of deception)" John 1:14 (AMPLIFIED). Jesus Christ, is the Word of God made flesh.He is the Person of the Word.When He became flesh, we saw the explanation and the revelation of God.God's full revelation was seen when HIS LIVING WORD took on flesh. See John 1:18: " No one has seen God [His essence, His divine nature] at any time; the [One and] only begotten God [that is, the unique Son] who is in the intimate presence of the Father, He has explained Him [and interpreted and revealed the awesome wonder of the Father]." When time consummates (remember time is a spot conceptualized in eternity, and will come to an end or mature), there will only be ETERNITY; in this ETERNITY we shall see Him even more clearly as the WORD OF GOD. "Then I saw heaven opened, and suddenly a white horse appeared. The name of the one riding it was Faithful and True, and with pure righteousness he judges and rides to battle. He wore many regal crowns, and his eyes were flashing like flames of fire. He had a secret name inscribed on him that’s known only to himself. He wore a robe dipped in blood, and his title is called the Word of God" Revelation 19:11-13 (TPT) OH GLORY TO GOD!This now makes sense why Christ is the CENTRICITY OF THE SCRIPTURES.He is the absolute substance of the WORD OF GOD. There is no WORD of God without JESUS.HallelujahSHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(1 John 1:1; John 1:1-18; 1 John 5:20; John 17:5) WE PRAYThat we will continually behold Jesus in the scriptures as we increase in the understanding of the full revelation of Christ. BIBLE READINGDay 95: 1 Samuel 27-28*DECLARE THESE WORDS:*- My life finds it full expression in the understanding of the reality of Christ.- I was born by the word, thereby I live by the word. - I have received the fullness of God.- I exude life to all things.- In everything I do, I prosper because I’m full of life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 106 - GOD'S CREATIVE MATERIAL
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. The Love-Life Agency GOD'S CREATIVE MATERIAL " And with this Word, God created all things. Nothing was made without the Word. Everything that was created John 1:3 (CEV) In all of the Heavens, in all of the universe and in all eternity, nothing was created out of nothing.All creation came out of something.In the Genesis of all things we see God as the Creator. " In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth" Genesis 1:1 (NKJV) Though God created out of nothing (physical), He did create with something.One may quote from the Amplified Bible: "In the beginning God (Elohim) created [by forming from nothing] the heavens and the earth" Genesis 1:1 (Amplified) This is to help you know that the material God used in His creative work wasn't by a physical matter.Let see this clearly from the book of Hebrews; "By faith [that is, with an inherent trust and enduring confidence in the power, wisdom and goodness of God] we understand that the worlds (universe, ages) were framed and created [formed, put in order, and equipped for their intended purpose] by the word of God, so that what is seen was not made out of things which are visible." Hebrews 11:3 (Amplified Bible). The universe and the ages, were framed and created BY THE WORD OF GOD.Since they were framed and created by the Word of God, we can tell that what is seen was made out of the UNSEEN or INVISIBLE.There is nothing which is of God, that first didn't happen by the Word.The Word of God is the immaterial material by which all things were made.The WORD is God's supernatural creative material. Read the opening verse again: " And with this Word, God created all things. Nothing was made without the Word. Everything that was created" John 1:3 (CEV) Read it from The Passion Translation: " And through his creative inspiration this Living Expression made all things, for nothing has existence apart from him!" From the previous discussion on the WORD OF GOD, we saw from scriptures that CHRIST is the Person of the Word.Thus, CHRIST as the Word is the supernatural creative material of God. " Christ is the visible image of the invisible God. He existed before anything was created and is supreme over all creation, for through him God created everything in the heavenly realms and on earth. He made the things we can see and the things we can’t see— such as thrones, kingdoms, rulers, and authorities in the unseen world. Everything was created through him and for him." Colossians 1:15-16 (NLT) Christ as the Word of God is not only your Saviour and the lamb of God.He is God's creative material. Whatever God made, was made by tbe WORD and as He spoke. "Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters. And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light." Genesis 1:2-3 (BSB) In the formless and empty state of the earth, God SPOKE!God's SPEAKING was His creative work.All through Genesis 1, we see God creating with words. Even before God formed man's body from the dust of the earth, He first spoke of the idea to make man. (See Genesis 1:26).Beloved Christ as the Word of God is our language and culture.No matter the challenge which confronts you, declare the reality of Christ.Understand that by your speaking you create. Therefore, you have to intentionally vocalize the WORD OF GOD.The WORD OF GOD in you, is God's creative material given to you.By the WORD you can establish and create a glorious future.SPEAK THE WORD!HallelujahSHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(John 1:10; Romans 11:36; 1 Corinthians 8:6; Hebrews 1:1-3) WE PRAYThanking God for the gift of His word which is His creative material. BIBLE READINGDay 96: 1 Samuel 29-31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I declare wisdom over my finances.- I speak health to my body. Every disorder in my blood, organs, tissues or bones be corrected now in the name of Jesus. (Go ahead to address that specific health issues you may have)- I declare peace and order over my household. (Address any challenge in your family).- I declare fruitfulness in my mind.- My mind is anointed therefore I have a sound mind.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: Episode 107 - THE CONSTITUTION OF WISDOM
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE CONSTITUTION OF WISDOM " Before I was humbled I used to always wander astray, but now I see the wisdom of your words." Psalm 119:67 (TPT) From the previous episode we looked at the Word of God as God's Creative Material.The Word of God is the expression of God's thoughts or intrinsic ideas.When God spoke in creation, He exhibited the depths of His Wisdom.You cannot touch the Wisdom of God, except through His Word. In God's creative work, there was the demonstration of His Wisdom. Wisdom is seen in a person's expression.In God's creation work, He spoke forth what He has conceived. His wise connate design of the universe was unravelled.Therefore, the speaking of God (His Word) is the package or the substantiation of His Wisdom.A little inquiry or observation of the universe will leave you awestruck. A stare of how the constants and laws of physics ally to make the universe extraordinarily habitable. The maxim "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth" is teeming with the empyrean artistry of God.Look at Earth's position in the universe. Why is the Earth's distance from the sun averages to about 93million miles?The surface temperature of the sun is about 6000 degree celsius.Imagine walking close to this temperature even by 100,000 miles?You may think in His creation work, God was just speaking WORDS.But beloved, God was parading His Wisdom.The creation of the universe is the product of God's creative power and not the falsehood of theistic evolution. It is unrealistic to think the universe began some aeons ago from a glob of froth, when you intelligently behold the universe.The creation of the universe is a choreography of the wisdom of God (which is embodied by His Word). " The Lord’s wisdom founded the earth; his understanding established all the universe and space. The deep fountains of the earth were broken open by his knowledge, and the skies poured down rain." Proverbs 3:19-20 (TLB). In the verses above, you will find three components of the Word of God: 1. WISDOM 2. UNDERSTANDING 3. KNOWLEDGE The Word of God constitutes these three verities.To which extent do you esteem God's WORD?The immeasurable depths of God's Wisdom can be experienced by His Word.We previously saw Christ as the person of the Word.And He is the person of wisdom. " ...Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God" 1 Corinthians 1:24. The scriptures testify of Jesus. (John 5:39) Who is He? HE IS THE WORD OF GOD and He is THE WISDOM OF GOD. The scriptures (as the written Word of God), are the effulgence of the Wisdom of God. They bring God's Wisdom to light.The inaccessible wisdom of God has now been on display in the scriptures. " You have been taught the holy Scriptures from childhood, and they have given you the wisdom to receive the salvation that comes by trusting in Christ Jesus." 2 Timothy 3:15 (NLT). Precious one, GO FOR THE WORD OF GOD AND LIVE BY ITS WISDOM.SelahSHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(Proverbs 1:1-9; Proverbs 8:1-36; 1 Corinthians 1:21; Deuteronomy 4:6; Psalm 119:98) WE PRAYThat we will be filled with the knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding. BIBLE READINGDay 97: 2 Samuel 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Through the scriptures, I increase in wisdom.- I feast on the word daily.- I handle the depths of God’s wisdom through the word.- I am so wise, because I delight and act on the word.- I am many years ahead of this world.- I have the wisdom to persuade men.- I have wisdom for my finances.- I have wisdom for my education.- I have wisdom for my business.- I have wisdom for all things.- I am a man of wisdom.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 108- THE CONSTITUTION OF WISDOM 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE CONSTITUTION OF WISDOM 2 " Before I was humbled I used to always wander astray, but now I see the wisdom of your words. Psalm 119:67 (TPT) From our previous discussions, we have seen: ● The Person of the Word ● The Word of God as God's Creative Material ● The Word of God as the Constitution of Wisdom. We have seen that, the productive workings of God's WORD in creation was a parade of His Wisdom. An example of the positioning of the Earth and the sun evinced that, God's creative design of the universe was far above satisfactory.Now again, by the revelation of scriptures, we see CHRIST as the WORD OF GOD and the WISDOM OF God.He is God's RAW MATERIAL for His creation. " All things were made and came into existence through Him; and without Him not even one thing was made that has come into being" John 1:3 (Amplified) NB: In John 1 the scriptures, testify of Christ as the Word of God (and also reveals Him (the Word) as God's creative material).The scriptures affirm this testimony of Christ as God's creative material here also: " All things were made and came into existence through Him; and without Him not even one thing was made that has come into being." Colossians 1:16 (Amplified) Christ as the WORD of God, is the proceeding of Wisdom.The Wisdom of God is an inward body and force of God's thoughts, cryptic idea, or esoteric counsel. Whereas the WORD OF GOD is the articulation or the composition of the Wisdom of God.The Word of God is the Kingdom revelation of wisdom. " These kingdom revelations will break open your understanding to unveil the deeper meaning of parables, poetic riddles, and epigrams, and to unravel the words and enigmas of the wise." Proverb 1:6 (TPT). You cannot access God's Wisdom without the WORD of God.The Word of God is the demystification of Wisdom.It is the Constitution of Wisdom.To despise the Word of God is to reject wisdom.The present society is crafted to subtly make God's Word repugnant to you.However it's a trap to make you wander astray.You have to see the Word of God as God's Wisdom for your living.When you study the scriptures, don't see the words of men. See the scriptures as the Word of God for your daily living.For all scriptures are the outbreathings of God (2 Timothy 3:16), for your inward breathings.All the writings from Genesis to Revelation are God's unique way to imprint His truth in your heart. " Here are kingdom revelations, words to live by, and words of wisdom given to empower you to reign in life, written as proverbs by Israel’s King Solomon, David’s son. Within these sayings will be found the revelation of wisdom and the impartation of spiritual understanding. Use them as keys to unlock the treasures of true knowledge. Those who cling to these words will receive discipline to demonstrate wisdom in every relationship and to choose what is right and just and fair." Proverbs 1:1-3 (TPT) To read and study the scriptures, is to be saturated and soaked with the Word. This is how you activate the Wisdom of God in you.The Word of God programs your mind and makes you see life from the perspective of God. You are able to reason solutions according to the counsel of God. " Oh, how I love them. I think about them all day long.They make me wiser than my enemies because they are my constant guide. Yes, wiser than my teachers, for I am ever thinking of your rules.They make me even wiser than the aged. I have refused to walk the paths of evil, for I will remain obedient to your Word. No, I haven’t turned away from what you taught me; your words are sweeter than honey. And since only your rules can give me wisdom and understanding, no wonder I hate every false teaching." Psalm 119:97-104 (TLB) SelahSHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 1:1-3; Proverbs 8:1-36; 1 Corinthians 1:21; Deuteronomy 4:6; Psalm 119:98) WE PRAY- That we will demonstrate the wisdom of God in every facets of life regardless of any opposition(s). BIBLE READINGDay 98: 2 Samuel 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The word of God is God’s wisdom for my daily living.- I see life from the perspective of God through His word.- I am full of the wisdom of God.- I don’t walk in foolishness.- I have the wisdom for every situation.- I am plugged into the deep current of God’s wisdom.- I don’t wander astray. Thank you Lord.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 109 - ESTEEM THE WORD IN YOUR LIFE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ESTEEM THE WORD IN YOUR LIFE " Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food. Job 23:12 (KJV) Imagine living for an hour without breathe?The scriptures (as the Word of God) are the outbreathings of God for our inward breathings.They are not the suggestions of God but the precepts of His wisdom.The Word embodies God's thoughts.All things were made by the Word of God. There is nothing God will do with you or for you outside His Word.The Word is the foundation of your faith.Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. (Romans 10:17).You cannot demonstrate God's wisdom, grow in knowledge, receive understanding and walk in obedience without the Word of God.Food is good for the body, but the Word of God is good for your entire being.The real you, which is your spirit can only be built and furnished by the Word of God.You must esteem God's Word in your life than your necessary food.As you fellowship with the scriptures (the Bible), you are fellowshipping with the Word of God.Don't make the reading of your Bible a leisure activity. Reading, studying, meditating on the Word of God and your prayer times must be the essential part of your day.They shouldn't be sidelined. " When I discovered your words, I devoured them. They are my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, O LORD God of Heaven’s Armies" Jeremiah 15:16 (NLT). This is the attitude you must have towards the Word of God. Devour, or eat or consume the Word.How do you step into the day without feasting on the scriptures?They are God's speaking to us. Through the scriptures your life is governed or directed to the right direction.Be ebullient with the scriptures burning on your heart. " O how I love and treasure the revelation of your word; throughout the day I fill my heart with its light!" Psalm 119:97 (TPT) The more you read, study and meditate on the Word of God, your heart is flooded with light.Until you love and treasure the revelation of the Lord, you will not make it your meditation throughout the day.This is why by the inspiration of the Lord, I included A ONE YEAR BIBLE READING PLAN. You are provided with two or three chapters of the Bible to read. And also extra Dig Deeper scriptures.As you read these scriptures you will access understanding of God.When you love the Lord you will take interest in understanding and knowing Him. " I need more revelation from your word to know more about you, for I’m in love with you!" Psalm 119:125 (TPT). The question is are you really involved in the reading of the Bible,since you claim you love the Lord ? You have to ESTEEM THE WORD in your life.You have to set a time for the reading of the Word of God. It will shape your thinking and refresh your heart. You realize you can make the right life choices, and also live with clarity because you have activated Wisdom. " Truth’s shining light guides me in my choices and decisions; the revelation of your word makes my pathway clear." Psalm 119:105 (TPT) Don't esteem your pursuit for money, academic success etc above the Word of God. " The words you speak to me are worth more than all the riches and wealth in the whole world!" Psalm 119:72 (TPT). SHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 1:1-3; Psalm 119:48; Deut 6:6; Ezekiel 3:3; Psalm 119:103; Revelation 10:9; Job 22:22; Psalm 119:98) WE PRAY- That we will not esteem any pursuit or ambition in life more than the word of God, which is the whole counsel of God’s wisdom. BIBLE READINGDay 99: 2 Samuel 7-9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I love and treasure the revelation of God because the word is the embodiment of God’s thoughts and wisdom.- I esteem the word more than all my life’s pursuits. - I make time to fellowship with the word daily.- I meditate on the word at all times.- I keep the word burning in my heart at all times.- I live by the word.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 110 - THE WORD EMITS LIGHT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. ***THE WORD EMITS LIGHT*" *Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.* Psalm 119:105 (NKJV)To treat the Word of God as an option or allow unproductive activities to compete with the Word of God in your life is an evidence of ignorance and a distracted life.One of things the adversary has to do to leave you in darkness and spiritual penury is to make you disparage the scriptures in your day to day living.The whole world lies in darkness and under the sway of the adversary. (See 1 John 5:19). And the Lord has translated us from the power of darkness to the Kingdom of His son. (See Col. 1:13).We see in Isaiah 60:2:" *For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.*" (KJV)Though we are not of this world, (we are not governed by its value system and forces), we are in the world (physically present). (See John 17:15-16).We can only navigate our paths by the light of the Word of God within us.The scriptures are not some list of rules and regulations which bid for our obedience. They are the emission of divine light into our hearts." *The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple*" Psalm 119:130 (ESV).When you have fellowship with the Word, it infuses your heart with light. When the Word of God illuminates you, it shapes your thinking.Even gullible or untrained men receive understanding and insight by the entrance of the Word.It directs you on the way to go, the decision to take, and the wisdom to demonstrate in all wisdom.Most young people seem to struggle with mental health, depression, suicidal thoughts, and fear. This is because they have either not received the light of the Word or have turned away from it." *When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness*" Job 29:3The infusion of the light of God's Word, cultures your mind and brings you into higher realm of civilization and hope.No matter the godawful state of the darkness in this world, we shine forth by the Word.Beloved allow the ENTRANCE OF THE WORD OF GOD on daily basis.As you read your Bible, as you consistently listen to Christ-Centred teachings and songs, your heart shall be flooded with the revelation-light.Selah.SHALOM!DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 19:8; Psalm 43:3; Proverbs 6:23; 2 Peter 1:19) WE PRAY- That the light of the Word will shine through our hearts and enlighten our eyes that we shall walk in perfect understanding.-That the revelation-light of God will shine in all dark places of the earth, as the waters cover the earth, that His glory shall be revealed. BIBLE READINGDay 100: 2 Samuel 10-12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am devoted to the word.- The word of God directs my path.- I demonstrate wisdom in all things.- With the light of the word, each day of my life is glorious.- I will never be defeated in my life.- I will never walk in confusion, depression or fear because I have received the light of the word.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 111 - THE ELIXIR FOR YOUR HEALTH 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency By (Pronounced makh'-ahee-rah) Daily revelatory thoughts to sharpen you and to help you grow in deep spiritual understanding and knowledge. Daily Christ-centered and apostolic-prophetic prayers. THE ELIXIR FOR YOUR HEALTH 1 " Then, as you unwrap my words, they will impart true life and radiant health into the very core of your being." Proverbs 4:22 (TPT) It's interesting how living out God's word is seen as an aberrant behaviour by the society. Understand that, the current systems and structures of this world are deviation from God's original idea.God didn't design man to live outside His word.By the Word of God, the universe, the systems and ages were framed and created [formed, put in order, and equipped for God's intended purpose]. (See Hebrews 11:3) Everything God made for man depends on His Word. And the fulfillment of every man's life and destiny must be according to God's Word.All things are sustained and upheld by the Word of His power. (See Hebrews 1:3)Some see the Word of God as a mere religious code of conducts. The word of God is not a trifling regulatory manuscript of a religion. We have already seen the primal essence of the Word of God, in previous discussions.The sovran quality of the Word transcends a checklist of conducts. To have fellowship with the Word, is to have fellowship with God's creative material and wisdom .The word of God is God's elixir for life and health.Jesus said, "the Words that I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life." (See John 6:63). The scriptures are the holy writ of God's voice. They carry power to transform lives. That same power by which God made the universe has been woven into these words of the scriptures.There are people who trust in "science" than the Word. Scientist only discover what has been made by God through His Word.For more than 3000 years, physicians or scientists used bloodletting as a method to cure sickness. For many centuries scientist believed draining blood out of patients will drain diseases from the patients. This got more sick people killed. It was until 1682 that William Harvey disapproved or discredited this method, after an extensive research work.It took another 200 years for scientist to finally accept the claims of William Harvey.In some places in the Middle East, bloodletting is still practiced.Meanwhile, the solution to bloodletting was stated in the scriptures about 3400 years ago. " For the life of the flesh is in the blood:..." Leviticus 17:11 (NKJV, see also v 14). God inspired Moses to inscribe this rich knowledge.If the surgeons and the physicians had given attention to the scriptures, they would have understood many things long ago.The Word of God is God's prescription of health.Beyond the physical methods the scriptures address (from healthy living to proceedings that leads to healing); there is an unfathomable power, which is wrought through the Word of God. " My son, do not forget my teaching, But let your heart keep my commandments; For length of days and years of life [worth living] and tranquility and prosperity [the wholeness of life’s blessings] they will add to you." Proverbs 3:1-2 (Amplified Bible) Also see the verse 8:" It will be health to your body [your marrow, your nerves, your sinews, your muscles—all your inner parts] And refreshment (physical well-being) to your bones." (Amplified Bible). The light which oozes out of the Word supplies ability to your mind and heart which transmits health and wellbeing to your immune system.Just as sorrow can weaken a man's body and even the bones, the WORD OF GOD supplies life and strength to the body and even the bones. " A glad heart promotes health; but the bones of a sorrowful man dry up." Proverbs 17:22 (BrentonSeptuagint Translation) " Your words were found and I ate them, And Your words became a joy to me and the delight of my heart; For I have been called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts" Jeremiah 15:16 (Amplified Bible) The word of God sparks joy and refreshes your heart.Take delight in fellowshipping with the Word of God.Selah.ANYONE READING THIS, RECEIVE HEALING ON YOUR BODY, in the name of Jesus!.SHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(Proverbs 16:24; Proverbs 4:4,10, 20-22; Psalm 147:3; Isaiah 66:14; Jeremiah 33:6; Isaiah 55:3;Proverbs 7:2 ) WE PRAY- That we will increase in the understanding of God’s word concerning our health. BIBLE READINGDay 101: 2 Samuel 13-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I receive healing now into my body.- I delight in fellowshipping with the word therefore sickness and diseases have no place in my body.- With the revelation light of God’s word, every disorder in my body is corrected.- I enjoy divine health daily.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 112 - THE ELIXIR FOR YOUR HEALTH 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE ELIXIR FOR YOUR HEALTH 2" Then, as you unwrap my words, they will impart true life and radiant health into the very core of your being." Proverbs 4:22 (TPT) The healing ability of God's word cannot be overemphasized.Words basically influence the state of a personThe power of a word is its meaning. Ones perception is crystallized when the meaning of a word is unveiled. And then it generates a feed back through our emotions. Many lives are emotionally hurt, crushed and broken physically by words than thrusting a sword into their chest.Wounds caused by words hurt deeper than anything else.Most mental health and depression issues are caused by negative words.The word of God doesn't share the same terra firma with either positive or negative words.You may speak positive words and not be speaking the Word of God.The Word of God is the edible form of God's Wisdom and counsel. Its emanation is with life and spirit. When God's word infuses your heart, dead cells can be quickened to life.It dissolves any form of darkness within the brain, because it enters you as light.If negative words can create unwelcomed conditions in a body, much more THE POWER OF THE WORD OF GOD. " He sent His word and healed them, And delivered them from their destructions." Psalm 102:20 (NKJV) Wherever the Word of God is, there are answers. When there is sickness, it will produce healing. When there is weakness it will produce vitality. True liberty is born out of the Word. God does nothing except by His word.The Roman centurion had this understanding about the power and authority of words. " The centurion answered, Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed" Matthew 8:8. Make meditation of the Word of God your priority. That is how you can flood your entire being with its essence. " My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings. Do not let them depart from your eyes; Keep them in the midst of your heart; For they are life to those who find them, And health to all their flesh."Proverbs 4:20-22 (NKJV). The word "health" in this verse, is from the Hebrew, marpê' (see strong's concordance H4832).It means medicine or a curative. It also means a remedy that yields wholesome healing or health.This means the WORD is a MEDICINE to heal your spiritual brokenness, emotional wounds, mental condition, and physical infirmities.A medicine or a remedy may be good .....but until you apply it, it wouldn't work automatically.You need to use or apply it according to the prescription to get the expected results. “ Please receive instruction from His mouth And establish His words in your heart" Job 22:22 (NASB 1995) To receive the Word is to read, study and meditate on the Word.This is how you can achieve the expected results.Have you fellowshipped with the Word?SHALOM! DIG DEEPER:(Job 23:12; Proverbs 16:24; Psalm 147:3; Ezekiel 3:10; Psalm 119:11; Isaiah 66:14; Deut. 4:1-2) WE PRAY- That we will give ourselves wholly to the influence of the word which is whole wisdom and counsel of God. BIBLE READINGDay 102: 2 Samuel 17-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make time daily to study the word.- I give my mind to the meditation on the scriptures. - I take heed to every instruction in the scriptures.- I am nourished by the word.- As I fellowship with the word daily, I experience the healing power thereof.- I have a sound mind.- I am healed from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet, through every fibre in my being, every blood in my cells and every bone of my body.- I am made whole in my entire being by the power of God’s word. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 113 - HOW TO UTILIZE THE WORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HOW TO UTILIZE THE WORD " My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings. Proverbs 4:20 (NKJV) Proverbs chapter 4, unveils the benefits of wisdom and how wisdom should be esteemed. We see also that, the many counsels and words articulated are expressions of wisdom.Now before the word was unveiled as God's MEDICINE or God's prerequisite for our enjoyment of life and health; there were key prescribed items worth noting.See: " My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings. Do not let them depart from your eyes; Keep them in the midst of your heart; For they are life to those who find them, And health to all their flesh.*"Proverbs 4:20-22 (NKJV). The focus of these verses isn't just what the Word can do, but what you should do with the WORD.The focus is the instruction. It's about how you can benefit from the Word.The WORD of God is LIFE to those who find them and MEDICINE to their flesh or body; however there are things to do to wield the WORD.A medicine or a remedy may be good but until you effectively apply it, it wouldn't work automatically.You need to use or apply it according to the prescription to get the expected results.These are the FOUR THINGS THE LORD wants you to do: 1. Give attention to MY Words. You attend to anything of value. You turn away from anything else to take heed to the Words. You don't treat the Word casually, you prick your ears to intentionally hear or receive the details.When you have to attend to the Word of God, you pause all the activities to give it the valued time. 2. Incline your ear to MY Sayings. As you pause to attend to the Word, you don't only listen attentively; you create the atmosphere and take up the posture for you to effectively attend to the Word.To incline the ear also means to bow the ear.It is like a disciple sitting at the feet of a teacher to glean knowledge.It means you give attention with humility. 3. Do not let THEM depart from your eyes; What is the focus of your eyes? How consistent are you setting your sight on the Word?Don't only hear the Word, you must see and set your gaze on the Word. " That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, concerning the Word of life" 1 John 1:1 (NKJV). There are people who set their eyes and also the eyes of their mind on the challenges which confront them than what God have said.Just like the spies Moses sent out to the promise land. They saw the beauty of the land, but ten (10) of them saw themselves as grasshoppers. And they practically forgot about the promise of God's Word to them. They forgot the great things the Lord has wrought through them, even the parting of the red sea.Unlike Caleb and Joshua, they had their eyes on the reality that God is with them. They saw the giants as bread. ( See Numbers 13:25-33; Numbers 14:1-9).Set the Word of God before you and make it your focus.*4. Keep them in the midst of your heart*The heart is the center of your life. Your entire living evolves around your heart. The heart is the seat of your life. The heart here is not the physical organ which pumps blood (of course there is a connection as well between the physical heart, the hidden heart and the Word).The heart mentioned includes, the spirit, the mind, the will, the emotions and the conscience.To keep the Word is to esteem the Word. Whatever you esteem is kept in the heart. The word of God is the most inestimable treasure you must keep in your heart.It is the life spring and essence of your spirit. Therefore you ponder, meditate or masticate on it. You uphold it as the guide of your will and overwhelms your affection and desires.When you make the Word your "gravitational focus" it will infuse you with Life. Anything God's Word dispenses becomes your reality.As Paul, the Apostle, spoke and taught the Word of Christ, there was a man that was impotent in his feet, (a cripple from his mother's womb) listening attentively to his teaching. Whiles the Apostle preached, he perceived that the man had faith (remember faith comes by hearing the Word of Christ, Romans 10:17) to be healed and spoke out, "Stand upright on your feet." And the man that was a cripple leaped and walked just by hearing the word.Oh glory!Now you will be wondering how it happened.Get this:The Word of God is a seed, your heart is the field. When a word of healing is sown into your heart, it will germinate healing in your body. (Luke 8:15)Whiles, the man was listening to Paul, the word of faith was sown into his heart, and then produced the healing miracle.Is your heart a fertile ground for the Word to germinate? When you pay attention to the Word (and prayer), it fertilizes your heart to have enough nutrients, to experience the workings of the Word.The more you meditate on (ponder, mutter, masticate and speak) the Word, the more you bear the fruits of the Word. Have you fellowshipped with the Word? SHALOM!DIG DEEPER:(Proverbs 5:1; 7:1-2; Psalm 119:111-112; Proverbs 3:3,21; Psalm 40:8) WE PRAY- That we will diligently give heed to every instruction in the word. BIBLE READINGDay 103: 2 Samuel 19-21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make the word of God my priority.- I give attention to the word.- I invest the word into my heart daily.- I keep my gaze focused on the word.- I rejoice in the word.- I apply the word in all circumstances of life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 114 - BE A STUDENT OF THE WORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE A STUDENT OF THE WORD "These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.” Acts 17:11 (NKJV) Are you making time to search the scriptures?Or you take anything you hear in?Like the Bereans referred in the opening verse, every Born-Again in Christ should have the same attitude towards the teaching of the Word. • We need first to have the readiness of mind to receive illumination through the Word. • Secondly, have reverence and confidence that the Word possesses a transforming ability. • Third, we need to have genuine respect for theteachers of the Word. However, we cannot just take in every piece of information without proving the teaching with God’s Word. We all have access to God’s Word that we may grow in the accurate, correct and precise knowledge of Christ.These Bereans, though, had respect for Paul (the Apostle), considering how they readily received the message he preached. They went ahead to search and examine the scriptures (the scriptures here refer to the ones in the Old Testament portion of the Bible); to see whether the things they heard were so. They didn’t assume! When it comes to studying, we must maintain open-mindedness. It was how they believed the truth; they saw the teachings for themselves. They didn’t have to struggle to believe. Some people find it difficult to believe and receive the word of Grace because of their religious bigotry.The attitude of the Bereans shows the proclivity of the wise. They grow in what they hear or receive through continuous learning. “ A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:” Proverbs 1:5 (NKJV) Beloved, you must have the genuine desire to grow in understanding. It is not merely what you have heard that brings you into accurate Knowledge. It is the truth of God’s Word that gets you into perfect Knowledge and understanding.Therefore, precious saints receive the Word with an open mind and search the scriptures for growth in the rightness of truth. DIG DEEPER:(Proverbs 9:9; Psalm1:2,3; Romans 15:4; Psalms 119:15-16; 2Timothy 3:14-15; 2Timothy 2:15) WE PRAY- That we will diligently continue in the study of the word to grow thereby in the knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READINGDay 104: 2 Samuel 22-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- With an open mind and heart, I search the scriptures diligently.- I grow by the word.- I continue daily in the study of the word.- I prove every teaching I hear with God’s word.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 115 - HOMOLOGIA 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HOMOLOGIA 1 "Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.” Hebrews 10:23 (NKJV) From our study on the Word of God, we have seen the transformative power of the Word of God and how to utilize the Word of God.We saw the Word of God as God's medicine or elixir for good health.Beloved, with the Word of God in your spirit, you cannot fail. The discussion we are having on the Word are to bring you into realms of possibility.God does nothing without His Word. Having the Word of God is having God's creative material.The Word of God brings you insight and teaches you what to do. The Word in you is the light of God in you (Psalm 119:130). There is no room for darkness and foolishness at the presence of the Word. Anyone who thinks in the light of the Word operates in Wisdom (2 Timothy 3:15); for the Word of God is the constitution of Wisdom.You shouldn't treat your relationship with the Word as a secondary importance.We see from the scriptures how God esteems His Word. (Psalm 138:2).God created by His Word.He upholds all things by the Word of His power (Hebrews 1:3).To bring healing, He sends His Word (Psalm 107:20).To produce faith in you, He sends His Word (Romans 10:17).To direct your future, He sends His Word (Psalm 119:105).To instruct you in righteousness, it is by His Word (2 Timothy 3:16).You received Salvation by His Word (Romans 10:14-15)First the Word became flesh and dwelt among us. (John 1:14). And the Word which became flesh, was also the lamb of God, which takes away the sin of the world (John 1:29).Second, by the preaching of the Word, men receive salvation (Acts 4:4).You were born again in Christ, by the seed of the Word (1 Peter 1:23).How then do you think you can achieve success in the Kingdom of God without His Word.Whatever God has said is truth (John 17:17), because His Word is truth. The Word of God is the articulation of God's thought, principle, prophecy or promise and the core of His person.The author of Hebrews knowing this, charged the saints:" *Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.*" Hebrews 10:23 (NKJV).He is charging You to: 1. BE RESOLUTE 2. CONFESS WITHOUT WAVERING 3. HAVE THE CONVICTION OF WHAT GOD HAS SAID BECAUSE OF WHO HE IS. Let's delve into this beautiful verse of scripture. In some translations instead of "confess", they chose the word "profess". Though "confess" is a better expression of the original word in Greek, the word "profess" also has its place in the usage. (And we will look at that in the course of our study). The Greek word used is " HOMOLOGIA" this is a compound word of homoú , which means "the same, together" and légō, which means "speak to a conclusion or agreement or lay to rest" – Thus, homologia is to speak the same conclusion or agreement. In a classical Greek, homologia is an agreement, assent, compact of a contract.(See Strong's Concordance and Vine's Expository Dictionary)This is a picture of affirmation to a thought of a person. It means you speak the same thing. This doesn't suggest a picture of parroting words.Homologia means to declare or confess by first admitting a fact or reality. Thus, it is an avowal with unflinching inward conviction.This is the peak of meditation.You don't practice homologia, by admitting and speaking your pain, defeat, struggle, failure, problems and challenges.What you should affirm and articulate is the WORD OF GOD!!!Be resolute about what God has said, knowing that whatever God says is true.Homologia is not just agreeing with a word, it is also an agreement with the person who said it.The Word of God is the thoughts of God expressed. To come into the same agreement with the Word to a point of declaring it with conviction, is to come into agreement with GOD.We see a practical example here: " Let your conduct be without covetousness; be content with such things as you have. For He Himself has said, “I will never leave you nor forsake you. So we may boldly say: “The LORD is my helper; I will not fear. What can man do to me?” Hebrews 13:5-6 (NKJV) Homologia is not just positive talk, it is admitting and declaring the Word of God with boldness knowing that GOD IS FAITHFUL and His WORD IS TRUE.What God has said is what you say!Beloved, admit and declare the Word of God instead of your challenges.This is why we provide you with daily declarations.Go ahead to declare what God has said concerning you. DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 4:13; Joshua 1:8; 2 Corinthians 9:13; Hebrews 3:1) WE PRAY- That we will boldly declare all that God has said concerning us irrespective of circumstances. BIBLE READINGDay 105: 1 Kings 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I speak what God has said concerning me.- I believe therefore I speak.- I speak in agreement with God.- The Lord is my helper, and I don’t fear what man can do unto me.- I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus.- I am as bold as a lion.- I have the spirit of boldness.- I have lost all my fears.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 116 - HOMOLOGIA 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HOMOLOGIA 2 " We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;” 2 Corinthians 4:13 (KJV) To confess God's word is not a mere mimicking act. As it’s clearly stated in the opening verse, we speak because we believe. We don't speak because we are parroting words that sound good.As I explained yesterday, Homologia is not just speaking. It begins with you coming to an agreement of what has been said and then you speak with unflinching conviction.The faith life is lived at the level of your confession and action.From the beginning of your salvation, to your health and to the enjoyment of your inheritance in Christ, you must confess the Word of God.Speaking God's word is God's working. Remember I mentioned that God does nothing without His Word. He works His Word by speaking.From the scriptures we see that our God is a SPEAKING GOD. All through Genesis 1, we see God speaking forth His creation.As God speaks you must also speak.Some folks think it is better to meditate than to speak. What they really don't know is, meditation in Christ begins with thinking the Word of God and consummates with roaring out the Word.God outlined His formula for Joshua's success in Joshua 1:5-9.However, in Joshua 1:8 He highlighted the foundational element to prosper and have good success.
