" This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate in it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success" Joshua 1:8 (NKJV). This is how some people read this verse:The Book of the Law shall not depart from your MOUTH (be silent about the word). But, meditate (THINK) in it day and night.That is a basic misunderstanding of the words which were chosen.The expression "shall not depart from your mouth", doesn't mean be quiet about the Word or don't speak the Word.The word DEPART is from the Hebrew word, mûsh which basically means to cease, to go back, to remove or take away.Now when we look at the meaning of MEDITATE you will understand clearly.But first let's read the verse (Joshua 1:8) from The VOICE translation: " Let the words from the book of the law be always on your lips. Meditate on them day and night so that you may be careful to live by all that is written in it. If you do, as you make your way through this world, you will prosper and always find success." Do you see it?Do not let the word depart from your lips simply means, LET THE WORD ALWAYS BE ON YOUR LIPS.Then the Lord gives Joshua the rich principle he must engage to get the Word to work effectively: MEDITATE The Hebrew word for "MEDITATE" is “hāgāh” the , which means to meditate, moan, growl, utter, speak. (See Vines Expository Dictionary).It means to study, ponder, to imagine, mourn, mutter, roar, speak, talk, or utter.It was an ancient practice of sighing and making low sounds or muttering while musing. Then as their thoughts settle in, they make declaration of those thoughts.Hāgāh expresses the growl and roaring of a lion.When you receive the Word of God as you read the scriptures, you pause to hāgāh!!!HeyaaYou ponder upon the words, imagine and begin to growl like a hungry lion. You mutter the words to yourself, and then you begin to imagine the word taking form in your life. Focus your mind, your heart and your tongue on the Word.The just shall live by faith, and our faith life is a matter of the word in your heart and mouth. " But what does it say? "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart" (that is, the word of faith that we proclaim)" Romans 10:8 (ESV) As you receive the Word in your heart, you confess it.As it is written, "I believed and therefore spoke, we also believe and therefore speak" (2 Cor. 4:13).So for example you read the:Proverbs 11:25 —" The generous man [is a source of blessing and] shall be prosperous and enriched, And he who waters will himself be watered [reaping the generosity he has sown]." (Amplified). You don't quickly "parrot" the word.You set your mind and heart on the Word. You ponder over it, you think through to understand the reality of the word. You cause the eyes of your spirit to see what the Word is saying, and then you imagine the word by creating mental pictures.You start muttering the word to yourself, like a lion growling. You will realise your heart will begin to burn with the light of the word.Whiles you do this, it begins to settle deeply in your heart.You don't allow the WORD to leave your lips. You begin to speak it to yourself, as your spirit draws out the life of the Word you have received.Now you have reached the peak of meditation.Now it's time to hāgāh or to practice homologia.You avow with dogged conviction. YOU SPEAK THE SCRIPTURES TO YOURSELF LOUD. At this time, they are more than alphabets put together.The sentences are no longer mere grammar. They are life to you. They have become part of the governing force of your spirit.You declare:The LORD has said: "The generous man [is a source of blessing and] shall be prosperous and enriched, And he who waters will himself be watered [reaping the generosity he has sown]." Therefore I also SAY: The Lord is causing His grace to abound towards me to be more generous and to be a blessing to others.I refuse to be selfish.I am a blessing to others.The Lord is making me rich, prospering me and watering my life. I am a cheerful giver. I am a blessing to many.Beloved you don't wait for the Holy Spirit to stir you up before you begin to make this a practice.According to the scriptures, you delightfully do this day and night (Psalm 1:2). This doesn't mean morning and evening. It is a Hebrew expression which means do this during your full day activity. As you sleep, you mediate, whiles you wake up and as you go about your daily activity you hāgāh!It is your full day activity!The scripture reveals what you will become when you do this: You shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also shall not wither; and whatever you do shall prosper. (See Psalm 1:3). Understand that whether you do this or not, you are speaking a word over your life. You will always speak what is in your heart.Jesus said, the mouth will speak the abundance of the heart (See Matthew 12:34).Therefore put God's Word in your heart.This is an intentional life. GO AHEAD TO DECLARE YOUR INHERITANCE IN CHRIST. Hallelujah! LISTEN TO THE AUDIO MESSAGE: OBTAIN GOOD REPORT by DIG DEEPER:(Romans 10:9; Psalm 71:8; Philippians 4:8; Deut 11:18-19; Psalm 19:14) WE PRAY- That we will continue in the practice of the word of truth which we have received. BIBLE READINGDay 106: 1 Kings 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord is causing His grace to abound towards me to be more generous and to be a blessing to others.- I refuse to be selfish.- I am a blessing to others.- The Lord is making me rich, prospering me and watering my life.- I am a cheerful giver.- I am a blessing to many.- I am like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth fruits in its season whose leaves also shall not whither.- Whatsoever I do shall prosper. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 117 - ESTEEM THE WORD IN YOUR LIFE 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ESTEEM THE WORD IN YOUR LIFE 2 " Your words were found and I ate them, And Your words became a joy to me and the delight of my heart; For I have been called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts." Jeremiah 15:16 (Amplified) From the first part of this topic (Esteeming the Word in Your Life); I established that, the real you, which is your spirit can only be built and furnished by the Word of God.You must esteem God’s Word in your life than your necessary food.Why?The Word of God is the life and the spirit of God breathed into you. Your life is held up together by the Word.To walk in the authority given to you, and the inheritance you have in Christ, you must receive understanding from the Word.Living by bread alone is becoming a prey to the adversary. You must live by the Word that comes from the mouth of God (see Matthew 4:4).This is how you find direction or bearing in life.In the previous part of this topic, I asked an intriguing question: How do you step into the day without breathing? It is the same as asking, how do you step into the day without feasting and meditating on the scriptures?They are God’s speaking to you. Through the scriptures your life is governed or directed to the right places.As you fellowship with the scriptures (the Bible), you are fellowshipping with the deep thoughts of God.Don’t make the reading of your Bible a leisure activity. Reading, studying, meditating on the Word of God and your prayer times must be the essential part of your day.They shouldn’t be sidelined.Did you read the opening verse?Read it again and memorize it. Add it to your meditation till it becomes your reality.I believe you've scrolled up to read it...Great!This is the attitude you must have towards the Word of God. Devour, or eat or consume the Word.It must be your joy and delight above anything else.For every situation which may confront you, the answers are in the scriptures.The scriptures have addressed issues which you may encounter in the future, the ones you are confronting now and the others which have already happened.When you walk in the light of the Word, there are no surprises.Whatever is happening in our generation has been addressed in the scriptures. Through the understanding of the scriptures, you can live 10, 30, or 50 years ahead of your generation.To have the Word is to have the bank of answers.However, you will not experience the solutions provided in the scriptures by keeping the Bible under your pillow or on your book shelf.You have to devour it.It is God's elixir of health, wisdom, love, joy, excellence, power and glory. The scriptures unlock the treasures of knowledge. Devour by reading, studying and meditation.Go to the Word to find the answers you seek. Anything which disagrees with the word of God, will bring you to a muddling or confusing state and to a dead-end of your living!PAY ATTENTION HERE: " People might tell you to ask the fortune-tellers, consult the babbling astrologers, conjure the dead to tell the living what’s to come, but shouldn’t they ask their God? Go to God’s teaching and His testimony to guide your thoughts and behavior! If any response disagrees with the word of God, then it’s muddling and wrong and not the least bit illuminating" Isaiah 8:19-21 (The Voice) This is refreshing!Don't seek for answers from fortune-tellers, nor babbling astrologers.Let's read the above verse from the Message Translation: "When people tell you, “Try out the fortunetellers. Consult the spiritualists. Why not tap into the spirit-world, get in touch with the dead?”Tell them, “No, we’re going to study the Scriptures.”People who try the other ways get nowhere—a dead end! Frustrated and famished, they try one thing after another." Isaiah 8:19-21. When the people of the world are in need for answers they consult fortune-tellers to fortify themselves.But for us in Christ, our fortification is the Word of God. Go for the WORD!Clearly we see the contrast between the people who depend and trust in the ways of the world and those who delight in the Word.Those who reject the Word of God, are muddled, frustrated, famished and only arrive at a dead-end.The story of the one who is nurtured into maturity by the Word of God is different.Here we go: " But you can tell who are the blameless and spiritually mature. What a different story with them!The godly ones will have a peaceful, prosperous future with a happy ending." Psalm 37:37 (TPT). Did you see that?Oh glory to God!Now look at this also: " But the lovers of God walk on the highway of light, and their way shines brighter and brighter until they bring forth the perfect day." Proverbs 4:18 (TPT). Oh Hallelujah!What is your delight?Selah DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 119:103; Ezekiel 3:3; Job 23:12; Psalm 119:111; Psalm 119:92; 119:144; Psalm 112:1) WE PRAY- That we will delight ourselves more in the word of God than any pleasure of life. BIBLE READINGDay 107: 1 Kings 7-9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make time with the word daily.- I give myself continually to the study and meditation of the word.- I value the word in my life more than anything else.- I give no more for any pleasure of life to sway my attention.- Through the scriptures, I live ahead of my generation.- The word of God is my fortification.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 118- THE SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH 1 " And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (NKJV) Of all the many things we have looked at concerning the Word of God, the opening verse gives another perspective of the Word.Most of the discussions here, we have seen what the Word of God does in us. However, to know the Word of God as a sword, is in reference to how we operate with the Word of God as a weapon. The Word of God in your mouth is sharper than a double-edged dagger or sword in the hands of a skillful Roman soldier.The the word SWORD is from the Greek word "". Thus simply means sword. However it is not just any sword.Of the arsenal of swords a Roman soldier would use, this sword was the most unpredictably brutal, deadly and indispensable weapon of them all. This sword was more like a dagger used for close range combat.With razor sharp blades on both sides and the tip of the sword often turned upward; the edge or point becomes sharper. This sword would be thrust in an enemy and then turn to cause more damage, pulling the enemy's viscera out as the blade was removed.This certainly was a violent weapon during a fight.Understand that as saints we are at war, and as good soldiers we must utilise the weapons of war given us.We have the SWORD OF THE SPIRIT, which is THE WORD OF GOD! It is an offensive weapon.The Word of God is not offensive as you read. The Word becomes your weapon offensive as you speak!The Word of God is a burning reality in your heart unto transformation. And also a brutal dagger in your mouth which terrorizes darkness and the adversary.Listen,to hāgāh God's word and to practice homologia are not some religious activities, but offensive warfare strategy. We are not only to be in a defensive position, guarding our hearts and minds from the arrows of darkness. We have the Word of God as a sharp dagger in our mouth.Look at the verse in The Passion Translation: "Embrace the power of salvation’s full deliverance, like a helmet to protect your thoughts from lies. And take the mighty razor-sharp Spirit-sword of the spoken Word of God." Ephesians 6:17 (TPT). Do you see it?The Word of God spoken is a mighty spirit-word with a sharp razor!You have to take it up and put it to work.The forces of darkness are at war with you everyday. A fellow saint in Christ, who knows his or her Bible and uses it each day is dangerous to the enemy. You can only rebuke the attacks of the devil by the Word in your mouth.Roman soldiers don't go into battle without their sharp dagger or . And as a good soldier in Christ, take hold of your every day.The more you use your (spirit-sword), the more you learn how to use it in order to exercise your victory through each battle and challenging times.Have you taken up your today?OH GLORY TO GOD! DIG DEEPER:(Hebrews 4:12; Isaiah 49:2; Hosea 6:5; Revelation 1:16) WE PRAY- Thanking God for the gift of His word which is the sword of the spirit. BIBLE READINGDay 108: 1 Kings 10-12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The word of God is sharp in my mouth.- With the word in my mouth, I wage war with every thoughts that opposes the knowledge of Christ in my life.- With the word in my mouth, I live in victory everyday over the schemes of the adversary.- I enjoy daily success in all that concerns me because I put the word to work.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 119 - THE SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH 2 " And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (NKJV) In our earlier discussion we looked at the Word of God as the Logos of God.I explained that, LOGOS (which is a Greek word for WORD) denotes, the expression of thoughts, not a mere name of an object. Logos embodies conception or idea, saying or statement. Logos depicts the person of the Word as well.There are two key words in the Bible translated as Word — Logos and Rhema.There are times people think LOGOS is just the written Word and refer to RHĒMA as the SPOKEN WORD.Understand that, Logos as the expression of divine thoughts, could be both a written word or a spoken word.Thoughts are not only expressed through writings, but also through speech.Thus, Logos is both the written and the spoken word.On the other hand, Rhēma is simply the utterance of a specific personal Word of God in the now to an individual or a collective group of people addressing a present situation.Whiles Logos is the objective word of God, Rhēma is the subjective Word for the now.It is through the logos one can access the specific personal word of God for the now.Without the Logos of God, one cannot receive the Rhēma word.Rhēma is hewn out of your spirit through the meditation of the logos of God.What you hāgāh is the Rhēma. Rhēma is not merely articulating a scripture you have memorized. It is declaring the revelation of the Word.It is that vocalized word (rhēma) Paul, the apostle, referred to as the SWORD OF THE SPIRIT! " ...And take the mighty razor-sharp Spirit-sword of the spoken Word of God." Ephesians 6:17 (TPT). Until you meditate on the scriptures to handle divine revelation to avow, the scriptures will not be useful weapons.The sword of the Word is activated when spoken or declared. Therefore the Word of God is only seen as a sword, when it issues out of your MOUTH!Look at this closely: " For the word of God is living and active and full of power [making it operative, energizing, and effective]. It is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating as far as the division of the soul and spirit [the completeness of a person], and of both joints and marrow [the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and judging the very thoughts and intentions of the heart." Hebrews 4:12 (Amplified Bible) This portrait of God's word truly enlightens the heart.We see here that the Word of God is not merely a historical writing which has no relevance in our day.Peter, the apostle, says it abides forever. (1 Peter 1:23).The Word of God is living, active and fully of power. It's effectively operative with fresh energy. It has the ability to quicken you unto an effective living.And then it gives another heart piercing illustration of the Word:The Word of God is not only sharp; IT IS SHARPER than any two-edged sword. The expression any two-edged sword, is from the Greek "DISTOMOS " The Greek word distomos , has a greater meaning than just two-edged sword.In the original Greek, Di means two and stomo meaning mouth. So, in other words, distomos means a two-mouthed sword.God declaring the Word out of His mouth is as a cutting edge of a weapon in operation.Mouth, in Greek is, STOMA, which means the front or edge of a weapon.Beloved your mouth is also a weapon.The Word in your mouth is as a razor of a deadly dagger which cuts deep into every matter.God’s Word spoken by Him and written down is one sharp side of the dagger, and the other sharp side of the deadly dagger is the speaking of His Word! "He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came from his mouth.And his face was like the sun in all its brilliance." Revelation 1:16 (NLT)God's word spoken out of your mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine energy! " He made my words of judgment as sharp as a sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. I am like a sharp arrow in his quiver." Isaiah 49:2 (NLT) OH GLORY TO GOD...Read this also from the MESSAGE BIBLE: " He gave me speech that would cut and penetrate. He kept his hand on me to protect me. He made me his straight arrow and hid me in his quiver." Isaiah 49:2 (MSG). Have you now seen why you don't have to keep quiet?God wants you to be saturated and soaked with His Word, and that you can handle the personal Word for warfare.Don't keep quiet!Declare the RHĒMA OF GOD IN THAT SITUATION!!THE WORD OF GOD IS A SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH SPEAK THE WORD AND NOT YOUR FEARS!Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER:(Hebrews 4:12; Ephesians 6:17; Isaiah 49:2; Hosea 6:5; Revelation 1:16). WE PRAY:- That we will take hold of every rhema word we will receive. BIBLE READINGDay 109: 1 Kings 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- God's word spoken out of my mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine energy.- I speak the word at all times.- I don’t walk in confusion or fear because I have rhema for every situation.- The word of God spoken out of my mouth is sharper than any two edged word.- When I speak the word (rhema) things happen.- I am seasoned by the word.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: Episode 120 - THE SURGEON'S SCALPEL -THE WORD OF GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency   THE SURGEON'S SCALPEL -THE WORD OF GOD " For God's Message is full of life and power, and is keener than the sharpest two-edged sword. It pierces even to the severance of soul from spirit, and penetrates between the joints and the marrow, and it can discern the secret thoughts and purposes of the heart."Hebrews 4:12 (Weymouth New Testament). God takes great interest in His purpose and plan.Though Christ is the center of God's purpose and plan, man has been mingled into Christ through the regeneration of life.As man (specifically, the regenerated man in Christ) plays a key role in the fulfillment of God's eternal purpose and plan, God has taken interest in the well-being of man.God didn't place man into time to suffer. God placed man into time for the manifestation of His glory.From the revelation of scriptures, we see that all things began through God's creative work. And all that God made was good. He made all things by His creative material (The Word), backed by His creative force (the Spirit). In Genesis 3, we saw the corruptible attempt of the adversary. The adversary's initiative was focused on corrupting God's purpose and plan, by corrupting man.However, God has always worked through these two proceeding agents to fulfilling His plan and purpose through man:The Word and The SpiritWithout these two divine elements, no one can fulfill purpose.You need to understand that the Word of God is indispensable in the fulfillment of God's intention for you.The Word brings you into the realm of manifestation.From previous episode, we saw the Word of God as the Sword in our mouth.Hence, the Word of God is also a brutal offensive weapon given to you by God. There are situations orchestrated by the adversary to prevent you from advancing in purpose.You don't sit to wait for that situation to overwhelm and cripple you. Engage the sword of the Spirit - which is the Word in your mouth.Beloved this is WAR!We also have the Word as God's elixir for our health.Get this, in the field of medicine, there are other special methods in dealing with certain health obstruction.Some conditions require intense surgical procedure.This is to remove an obstruction or repair diseased tissues. Surgical procedures reposition structures to their normal position.Beloved, God is not just a creator, He is also the original surgeon.Just as the Word is His creative material; He also has the Word as the surgical scalpel.The Word of God as a sword of the spirit, is not only effective in the hands of a skillful soldier of Christ.It is also operative in the hands of God and His trained teachers of the Word. " God means what he says. What he says goes. His powerful Word is sharp as a surgeon's scalpel, cutting through everything, whether doubt or defense, laying us open to listen and obey." Hebrews 4:12 (MSG). When God speaks His word to you, it cuts deep as a skillful surgeon using the surgical scalpel in an operating theatre.The Word has the ability to cut through you to remove every "doubtful tissues" in your imagination and thoughts. It removes all obstructions of the adversary in your heart.Surgeons only use the scalpel to heal or mend what is broken. That is what the Word of God does in you. It heals your diseases, mends what is broken, removes cancerous cells in your system.It is so sharp that when it pierce through you it will cut off pride, selfishness and divide thoughts which are of God (spirit) from your intellect (soul:mind, emotions and will).God as the great surgeon desires to heal us through His word.He corrects our thought patterns and give us the right mindset to fulfill His purpose and plan.Oh Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 10:4; Jeremiah 1:10; 2 Timothy 2:15; 3:15-17). WE PRAY:- That we will continually give ourselves to the operative influence of God’s word. BIBLE READINGDay 110: 1 Kings 14-15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Every obstruction of the adversary in my heart is removed as I fellowship with God’s word.- I commit myself daily to the study of the word.- The word has power over my body- With the revelation light of God’s word, every disorder in my body is corrected.- As I fellowship with the word daily, I experience the healing power thereof.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 121- THE WORD OF GOD AS A MIRROR 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE WORD OF GOD AS A MIRROR 1 " And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit. 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) There are a lot of people living the lie about themselves. God didn't just throw us into time without identity.There is an identity and intention of man and specifically the man in Christ.Christ came not only to give us the true revelation of God; He also came to unveil to us, God's true picture about us.There is an imagery of us in God's mind.We have created in our minds pictures of enmity towards God. And assume God has the same picture about us.Most people in Christ look at themselves according to the false imagery created by religion.Some born agains see themselves as sinners in Christ.They sing songs of God's unfailing love, yet think God has hatred for them.We have seen the Word of God as a sword in the hands of a skillful soldier. We have seen it as a surgeon's scalpel, an elixir for your health, God's creative material, and a shining, penetrative light.Beloved the Word of God is also the MIRROR of God.We look into mirrors to have a view of our outlook.Mirrors allow us to see ourselves. They show us what we look like, they let us examine our true selves, and make us espy our unique heritage. Sometimes a mirror will show you a beautiful part of you which you did not notice before.Interestingly, a mirror doesn't add nor change who we are or what we are.A mirror brings to our realization and consciousness how we really look.This is how the MIRROR OF THE WORD OF GOD WORKS:It reveals our true essence and quality.Look at the opening verse again: " And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit" 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP)From the King James Bible, you will see the word "CHANGE" instead of transformation.The original word in Greek, is " metamorphoō" which means to be transfigured or transformed. It is a change in state and form or structure.We can understand this transformation by observing the butterfly metamorphosis:The butterfly's life cycle begins with an egg and progresses to caterpillar, chrysalis, adult, and then finally ends with the natural transformation of the butterfly.These stages were not mere changes they were transformations. However, the transformation or metamorphosis is as a result of the inherent quality of the butterfly.At the egg stage, no one sees a butterfly, however it has the quality of a butterfly.A hen lays egg, however, this egg doesn't metamorphose into a butterfly, because it doesn't have the genetic code of a butterfly.This is the principle i am establishing concerning the principle of the Word of God as a mirror.The transformation you experience by the Word is as a result of the seed of the word in you at new birth in Christ." *Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God,* which liveth and abideth for ever." 1 Peter 1:23 (KJV)Do you see it? YOU ARE BORN AGAIN BY THE WORD, which is THE SEED OF THE DIVINE LIFE. Since you are born of the Word, you have the Word of God in you as your seed.Therefore, as you look into the mirror of the Word, you are transformed more and more as the EXPRESSION OF THE WORD OF GOD.How does it happen, the transformation begins by the RENEWING OF YOUR MIND. " And do not be conformed to this world [any longer with its superficial values and customs], but be transformed and progressively changed [as you mature spiritually] by the renewing of your mind [focusing on godly values and ethical attitudes], so that you may prove [for yourselves] what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect [in His plan and purpose for you]."Romans 12:2 (AMP). As you behold the Word of God it corrects your old thought patterns, renovates your mind with the riches of divine revelation.Selah DIG DEEPER:(James 1:22-25; 1 Corinthians 13:12; Psalm 84:7; John 17:24; 2 Corinthians 4:4,6; Romans 8:29). WE PRAY:- That we will grow more in the consciousness of what Christ has already done for us. BIBLE READINGDay 111: 1 Kings 15-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I look into the word daily, I am transformed into the image I see.- I increase in strength as I fellowship with the word daily.- I increase in glory daily by the word.- As I look at Christ daily in the scriptures, the more like him I become in consciousness.- I renew my mind daily with the word.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 122 - THE WORD OF GOD AS A MIRROR 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE WORD OF GOD AS A MIRROR 2 " And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit. 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) Beloved, you are metamorphosed or transformed into (one degree of glory to another degree of) the image of the glory of the Lord as you meditate on the scriptures.As you behold or meditate on the revelation of the glory of the Lord in the scriptures, you are transformed into a greater dimension of glory.This explains the meaning of this scriptures to some degree: " But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day." Proverbs 4:18 (KJV) And we have seen also how the path of the righteous shines: " Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path" Psalm 119:105 (KJV). The more you meditate or behold the glory of the Word of God, the more you brightly shine forth.The Word of God as a mirror, brings us to the consciousness of who we are in Christ.As a new creation in Christ, you didn't receive the Life of Christ as you behold the Word of God. When you received Christ, you received His life. " He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life. These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God." 1 John 5:12-13 (KJV) Now you can clearly see that, though you are born by the seed of the Word of God (I explained this in the first part of this discussion); the Word of God as a mirror doesn't introduce a new life into you.The mirror principle of the Word of God is that:As you look, you come to the true consciousness of who you are in Christ Jesus.If you defined yourself as a sinner or by any false image created by religion, you begin to experience the renewal of mind as you behold the glory of God in the Word.As you are born of the Word, you can only see your true picture, your God begotten self as you look into the Word.As I explained in yesterday's with :A mirror doesn't add nor change who you are or what you are.A mirror brings you to the realization and consciousness of who you are.Anytime you behold yourself in the mirror of the Word, it reveals your true essence and quality.You can only live in the capacity of that revelation, as you continue in the consciousness of that revelation through meditation.James the apostle, explains how the mirror principle works:James 1:21-25 (TPT)"So this is why we abandon everything morally impure and all forms of wicked conduct. Instead, with a sensitive spirit we absorb God’s Word, which has been implanted within our nature, for the Word of Life has power to continually deliver us. James 1:21 (TPT) Now you can see that, the verse 21 reveals that though one with a sensitive spirit absorbs the Word of God, the Word of God has already been implanted to our new nature in Christ.And it has continuous work to deliver by its power.In some other translations it uses the phrase, " which is able to save your souls".This could mean the saving of ones soul through the new birth experience and the saving of your soul (will, mind, emotions) from the affections of the world, through the renewal of the mind.He then brings the mirror principle of the Word to light in these subsequent verses: " Don’t just listen to the Word of Truth and not respond to it, for that is the essence of self-deception.* So always let his Word become like poetry written and fulfilled by your life! If you listen to the Word and don’t live out the message you hear, you become like the person who looks in the mirror of the Word to discover the reflection of his face in the beginning. You perceive how God sees you in the mirror of the Word, but then you go out and forget your divine origin. But those who set their gaze deeply into the perfecting law of liberty are fascinated by and respond to the truth they hear and are strengthened by it—they experience God’s blessing in all that they do!" James 1:22-25 (TPT). - Not responding to the Word is a self-deception, because it is the unfolding of your originality. - Let the word be like a poetry written and fulfilled by your life. It means your life has to be the reflection and expression of the Word. - As you hear the Word, live out the message. Keep it in your heart, meditate on it until it soaks your consciousness. - When you look into the mirror of the Word you will discover the reflection of your face, you will have the right perception of how God sees you and your divine origin. - You will not forget it when you set your gaze deeply into the perfecting law of liberty (which is the revelation of Jesus in the Word). - The consciousness of the word produces fresh strength in you as an unshakable edifice and causes you to experience God’s blessing in all that you do! Look into the Word daily to see your true-self and enjoy your true inheritance in Christ.Selah DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 13:12; Psalm 84:7; John 17:24; 2 Corinthians 4:4,6; Romans 8:29) WE PRAY:- That we will give ourselves wholly to the influence of the word. BIBLE READINGDay 12: 1 Kings 17-19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I look into the mirror of the word, I see my true essence and quality.- I continue in the consciousness of what I see in the mirror of the word through meditation.- I increase the more in strength and grace, the more I look into the mirror of the word.- My mind is transformed daily as I look into the mirror of the word.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 123 -  THE INOCULATION OF THE WORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE INOCULATION OF THE WORD " How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping watch [on himself] according to Your word [conforming his life to Your precepts]. Psalm 119:9 (Amplified Bible) Though at new birth we became citizens of Heaven, and were translated into the Kingdom of light, we are not taken out of the world.The Lord placed us in this world for the fulfillment of His eternal purpose. There is a mandate of the Kingdom in this world, and we are co-labourers with God in fulfilling His eternal assignment.We have a mandate to show forth the glory of the Lord, who called us out of darkness (1 Peter 2:9).Whiles we are in this world, our minds are still exposed to the corruptibility of the world and its systems.We are instructed through the epistles, not to be conformed to this world (Romans 12:2).As we are in this world, we may be confronted by thoughts and imaginations which can corrupt our hearts.However, the Lord did not only begat us anew by His Word, He also gave us His Word to inoculate us from the negative influences of the world.The Lord has complete provisions to keep us from failing and falling.Just because you are born again doesn't mean the adversary wouldn't throw arrows of doubts and lies towards you.You have to grow in the knowledge of Christ and be conformed to His image.Therefore, just as you have the Word as a: MirrorSword in our mouth Elixir for your Health The word of God is a detoxifier.It inoculates and detoxifies your mind from error.At new birth you were made clean by the Word and the Spirit.However, there is a continuous work of cleansing by the Word." ...For he died for us, sacrificing himself to make us holy and pure, cleansing us through the showering of the pure water of the Word of God. All that he does in us is designed to make us a mature church for his pleasure, until we become a source of praise to him—glorious and radiant, beautiful and holy, without fault or flaw. Ephesians 5:25-27 (TPT). The cleansing of the Word is not a one time thing. It is a daily work of cleansing by the word of God.There are things you hear and see from different family settings, interaction with friends at school, work colleagues, and even your communities; which subtly cultivates your mind with toxic thought patterns and concept of life.Instead of thinking in conformity with the Word of Christ, you develop contradicting imagination.This is why you must intentionally give your mind to the Word.The Word in you, cleanses your heart and mind from poisonous utterances which may shipwreck your faith.The Word can build an automatic rejection mechanism in your heart, preventing any thought of darkness.And also before you got born again, your mind was exposed to different concepts of life, teachings and diverse culturing which contradicts the reality of the Kingdom. Thus, you must give yourself to the Word to continuously purify your mind. How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping watch [on himself] according to Your word [conforming his life to Your precepts]. Psalm 119:9 (Amplified). The Word of God purifies your mind and inoculates your heart from thoughts which cultivates fear, pride, sinfulness, selfishness, envy and doubts.Sit under the waterfall of the Word everyday.Have you fellowshipped with the WORD TODAY?Selah DIG DEEPER:( John 17:17-19; John 15:3; Psalm 19:7-11; Psalm 119:11; Psalm 17:4;) WE PRAY:- That we will take heed and continue in the rich verities and virtues of the word. BIBLE READINGDay 113: 1 Kings 20-22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I sanctify and purify my mind daily by the word.- I am immune from the negative influences of the world.- I enjoy a worry-free life.- Satan has nothing in me.- My heart is free from any thoughts which cultivates fear, pride, sinfulness, selfishness, envy and doubts.- I am in this world but I am not of this world.- I live my life with the revelation of a greater light.- I live from a higher realm of life.- I live above this world.- I live above sickness disease, fear, anxiety, depression, pain, sorrow and any weakness of this world.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 124 - THE SCRIPTURES TRAIN YOU
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE SCRIPTURES TRAIN YOU" All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness" 2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV) At new birth, you received the life of God, and full capacity.Jesus said, "...I came that they may have life, and have it in abundance [to the full, till it overflows]." John 10:10 (Amplified) However, for the life to have full expression in you, it is dependent on how you have been cultivated.The life of God is in your spirit. God does not live in your mind; He lives in your spirit. And your mind has to be cultured to become conscious with the reality of God in your spirit-man.This is what spiritual maturity is in a certain degree. Spiritual maturity is basically your growth in consciousness. It is your mind, your will and emotions being cultivated to operate according to the reality of God in your spirit.For example: "God has not given you the spirit of fear" This is the reality of your spirit.However, you may find yourself living in fear.Why?Your mind, emotions and will have not be trained to practice the reality of fearlessness.The more you give yourself to the training of the Word, the more you live according to God's reality in your spirit.You have to consciously submit your consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word.When you don't submit yourself to the teachings of the Word, you must know you are being cultivated by another thought patterns.Whether you are intentional about it or not, you are cultivated or trained to live by some thought patterns.If your life is not influenced by the Word of God, you will be influenced by some other information.It is just like having a bare land, with no intentional vegetation.The land will not remain bare forever, because weeds will germinate on that land.Weeds grow anywhere there is room.As long as no activity is happening on a land doesn't mean nothing is growing on that land.Our Lord Jesus likened the heart to a field and the word to a seed. (Mark 4:16-20).When you don't intentionally cultivate or train your heart with the Word, weeds will germinate.Even whiles you are cultivating your heart with the word (as the seed), you have to consistently use the word to uproot wrong seeds which will germinate on the field.Usually when you are cultivating a soil and weeds also begin to germinate on that field, they compete with the plants over nutrients.The word of God as a seed is profitable for:" *...doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness*" 2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV)The scriptures are God's course for your living. They are designed to culture your heart and also to uproot or correct any wrong teachings of the world.To word instruct is the Greek word, "paideia"; which means to educate or train and to correct or discipline and chastise.The word of God trains you, to live according to God's design and thought.It sharpens your mind, emotions and will to live in conformity to God's will publicly and privately.Don't allow weeds of thoughts from the news, the society, friends, school, workplace etc germinate in your heart. Guard your heart with the Word of God.Be intentional about what grows in your heart.Envy, pride, hatred, fear, pain, bitterness, etc can geminate in your heart without your permission, if you don't intentionally give yourself to the training of the Word.As you study the Word, it corrects negative imaginations and thoughts which are not in conformity to the mind of God.ARE YOU A STUDENT OF THE WORD?This is how you can be equipped for every good work. DIG DEEPER:(Romans 15:4; Zephaniah 3:4; Psalm 119:11; Proverbs 6:23; Proverbs 15:10,31) WE PRAY:That we will consciously submit our consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. BIBLE READINGDay 114: 2 Kings 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I intentionally give myself to the training of the word.- I guard my heart with the word of God.- I don’t permit negative thoughts.- I allow the word of God to cultivate my heart.- As I fellowship with the word of God daily, it sharpens my mind, will and emotions to live in conformity to God’s will.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 125 - THE WORD ENDURES FOREVER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE WORD ENDURES FOREVER" BUT THE WORD OF THE LORD ENDURES FOREVER.” And this is the word [the good news of salvation] which was preached to you" 1Peter 1:25 (Amplified). The word of God is not as a research theory which may be updated.Situations come and go. People come and go. Even the sun does not shine all through a day. But the word of God abides forever.It is eternal, immovable and indestructible. "Your eternal word, O LORD, stands firm in heaven." PSALM 119:89 (NLT). Don't treat the Word as another opinion from your mere thoughts.The word of God is not one of the philosophical thoughts.From John 1, we see the word preexisting before time and the world began.The Word was with God and the Word was God.All things were made by the Word.The worlds (universe, ages) were framed and created [formed, put in order, and equipped for their intended purpose] by the Word of God. The Word carries, maintains and propels the universe (both spiritual and physical) to the predetermined goal. (See Hebrews 1:2-3; 11:3, Amplified)The Word of God is the best counsel of God to man.There are some who trust men than what God's Word has revealed. They trust the news from the various media outlets than the goodnews of the Lord proclaimed as the Word of God.Others believe in ancient mythologies, traditional proverbs and historical accounts of men which have no infallible proofs.They trust theories and godless conspiracies which has no certainty about the future than the Word of God. " Human beings are frail and temporary, like grass, and the glory of man fleeting like blossoms of the field. The grass dries and withers and the flowers fall off, but the Word of the Lord endures forever! And this is the Word that was announced to you!" 1 Peter 1:24-25 (TPT). OH HALLELUJAH.Another glorious thing about the born again is that, YOUR NEW BIRTH IN CHRIST is by THE SEED OF THE WORD WHICH LIVES AND ABIDES FOREVER. (1 Peter 1:23).The Word of God cannot be corrupted!Beloved this sure word of God is the foundation of your life.ATTEND TO THE WORD!Do you read your Bible?Are you part of the ONE YEAR BIBLE READING PLAN?Do you know we are now in 2 Kings?ARE YOU PROCRASTINATING?OR You have other important things either than reading the Bible?Selah *DIG DEEPER:*(Isaiah 40:8; Numbers 23:19; Isaiah 55:11; Isaiah 46:10-11)*WE PRAY:*- That we will be diligent in taking heed to every instruction of the infallible word of God.*BIBLE READING*Day 115: 2 Kings 3-5*DECLARE THESE WORDS:*- The word of God is God’s eternal will and counsel for my living.- I esteem the immovable and indestructible word of God more than any necessity in life.- This sure word of God is the foundation of my life.- I make time daily with the infallible word of God.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 126 - WHOSE REPORT DO YOU BELIEVE?
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency WHOSE REPORT DO YOU BELIEVE?" Who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?" Isaiah 53:1 (NKJV) The Hebrew word for REPORT is shemû‛âh, which means something heard, that is an announcement. It is also a doctrine or a news, tidings and bruit.There are several reports especially in this technological age.These reports create a believe system in your heart. They compete with the glorious message of Christ in your heart.The core or central message of the scriptures is Christ.All the reports you find in this world and from your imaginations which are contrary to the word of God, don't have any perpetual foundation.They only tickle your mind to live a shadow of your true essence.The revelation of God declared, is the only news which reveals your true essence.To believe in the report of the Lord is a choice you have to make.You have to channel your desires and imaginations or thoughts towards the Lord. Until you decide to see or accept God's Word as TRUTH, and the focus of your believe or persuasion, you will be shadow boxing.The word of grace is the Lord's report to you.Do you believe it?Or you think they are mere stories and unfounded theories?Beloved the reality of God's word is unmatched.Believe in it wholeheartedly for it is LIFE!There is nothing God had said in His word which shall not come to pass.Selah DIG DEEPER:(Isaiah 40:5; Matthew 11:25; Luke 18:31; John 12:38) WE PRAY:- That we will walk in the understanding of the realities of virtues we have received. BIBLE READINGDay 116: 2 Kings 6-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am founded on the word of God.- I don’t give my hearing to the reports of this world.- I am not moved by sentimental words and thoughts.- I hold fast to the word of truth.- I am fully persuaded by the scriptures.- My confidence is not in this world.- I am what God’s word says I am.- I believe in the report on the Lord.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 127 - THE TOME OF YOUR INHERITANCE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE TOME OF YOUR INHERITANCE " In Him also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestined according to the purpose of Him who works all things according to the counsel of His will" Ephesians 1:11 (NKJV) I read a story of young two Chinese Christians who were on their way to an evening Church meeting. A Police stopped them for questioning. When they were asked where they were going, they answered saying: "Our big brother is dead, and we are going to read his will."Wow...!Isn't it amazing.You may think they were telling some lies or making some excuses to find their way out of trouble.Yes, that kept them from some trouble because the communist state doesn't support "True Christianity".However, what they said, was not far from the truth.The Bible is also a Holy writ which reveals the will or bequest given to us in Christ.Our Lord Jesus is our big brother. "For he knew all about us before we were born and he destined us from the beginning to share the likeness of his Son. This means the Son is the oldest among a vast family of brothers and sisters who will become just like him." Romans 8:29 (TPT) Look at this as well: "Jesus, the Holy One, makes us holy. And as sons and daughters, we now belong to his same Father, so he is not ashamed or embarrassed to introduce us as his brothers and sisters!" Hebrews 2:11 (TPT). And as our Big Brother, we had access to His inheritance through His death and resurrection.Jesus came to do the WILL OF GOD according as it has been written in the volumes of the scriptures. (See Hebrews 10:7). All that He fulfilled in the scriptures; achieved and attained according to the will of God are now our inheritance.And in His death this bequest was activated to be ours. That is the principle of a will of a testament.The testator has to die.See how the author of Hebrews put it: " Now a person’s last will and testament can only take effect after one has been proven to have died; otherwise the will cannot be in force while the person who made it is still alive." Hebrews 9:16-17 (TPT). Do you see that?Now we can see also here in the verse 15 of the same chapter, how we are destined by God to receive the inheritance. "For this reason He is the Mediator and Negotiator of a new covenant [that is, an entirely new agreement uniting God and man], so that those who have been called [by God] may receive [the fulfillment of] the promised eternal inheritance, since a death has taken place [as the payment]*which redeems them from the sins committed under the obsolete first covenant. Hebrews 9:15 (Amplified Bible). Oh hallelujah.Beloved, in Christ we have an eternal glorious inheritance and He has made us joint heirs with Him.How do you access the rich content of this bequest bequeathed unto us?See what Paul the apostle told the Elders in Ephesus: " And now I commend you to God [placing you in His protective, loving care] and [I commend you] to the word of His grace [the counsel and promises of His unmerited favor]. His grace is able to build you up and to give you the [rightful] inheritance among all those who are sanctified [that is, among those who are set apart for God’s purpose—all believers." Acts 20:32 (Amplified Bible). The WORD OF HIS GRACE, administers the inheritance of God we have in Christ.The Bible is the tome of our inheritance in Christ. It is the only authentic material by which you can access the details of all that Christ has bequeathed to us.Until you study the scriptures, you cannot access the glorious eternal inheritance you have. You will be living in ignorance and not enjoy what has been dispensed unto you.HAVE YOU READ YOUR BIBLE TODAY? DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 1:5,9; Isaiah 46:10,11; Deuteronomy 4:20) WE PRAY:That the eyes of our understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints. BIBLE READINGDay 117: 2 Kings 8-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I’m joint heirs with Christ.- I take advantage of the bequest bequeathed to me by Christ in the scriptures.- I have access now to my inheritance in Christ.- I have been fully resourced by God with everything that pertains to life and godlinessOh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 128 - DO YOU UNDERSTAND IT 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DO YOU UNDERSTAND IT? 1 " And Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?" Acts 8:30 (KJV) There are a lot of people who think they have the Bible, and read the Bible therefore they will grow by themselves.Let me say this emphatically, no one can grow properly in the kingdom without being in a Christ-centered Church. And being trained by a good teacher of the Word.You cannot sit on your own to grow in the understanding of the scriptures. One of the most dangerous threat to the maturity of the body of Christ is FALSE TEACHING!False teaching doesn't always begin with a false spirit. One may have a genuine heart to grow in knowledge, but wrong understanding of the scriptures will cultivate false interpretation of the scriptures.Teachers of the Word are crucial determinant of the mind and attitude set of the saints in Christ.If you are in Christ, you must submit yourself to consistent Christ centered teachers of the Word, who will bring you into the accurate precise knowledge of the Word of His grace.You don't isolate yourself from the brethren and decide to study God's word for yourself. In as much as it is good to have a personal study of the Word, you must first submit your thoughts to the established module for Biblical knowledge.You can't have your personal understanding or personal interpretation of the scriptures.Look at this, 2 Peter 1:20" Above all, you must realize that no prophecy in Scripture ever came from the prophet’s own understanding," (NLT) " But understand this first of all, that no prophecy of Scripture is a matter of or comes from one’s own [personal or special] interpretation" (Amplified). " The main thing to keep in mind here is that no prophecy of Scripture is a matter of private opinion," (MESSAGE) There is no different meaning to what has been written which is unique to you.People having their private interpretation of the scriptures is the beginning of falsehood.Every truth you are exposed to must be in agreement with the original meaning of the text.There are no contemporary interpretation of the Biblical text.The meaning of the scriptures, the gospels and the epistles have not changed, updated or compromised. The scriptures mean the same thing today as they meant when the authors were inspired by God.You have to understand the fundamental matters in the scriptures and the wisdom to rightly divide the word of God.Without Philip the Ethiopian Eunuch was reading the book of Isaiah, yet he needed Philip to explain the meaning of the prophetic text.Any one who thinks he doesn't need a teacher to understand the Bible has not understood the Bible or has not read the Bible at all.When you read the Bible or the Holy Scriptures, you will know the importance of a teacher of the Word in your life." And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding." Jeremiah 3:15 (KJV) This is the Lord's arrangement.Look at what Jesus said;" Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me. Therefore go and make disciples of all nations,baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age." Matthew 28: 18-20 (Berean Standard Bible) Imagine the nations also say, we have the scriptures and we don't need teachers.Have you submitted to a teacher yet? DIG DEEPER:(Acts 8:26-30; Acts 20:28; Ephesians 4:11; Jeremiah 23:4; 2 Timothy 2:2; Acts 18:18-28)WE PRAY:Dear Lord, teach me to humbly submit to my pastor/teacher, who will bring me into the accurate precise knowledge of the Word of grace.BIBLE READINGDay 118: 2 Kings 11-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit myself to the solid teachings of my Pastor.- I don’t heap myself with many teachers.- I am not one who has an itching ear.- I submit my thoughts to the established module for Biblical knowledge in my local church.- I have no personal interpretation of the word.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 129 - DO YOU UNDERSTAND IT? 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DO YOU UNDERSTAND IT? 2 " And Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?" Acts 8:30 (KJV) Any one who thinks he doesn't need a teacher to understand the Bible has not understood the Bible or has not read the Bible at all.When you truly study the Bible or the Holy Scriptures, you will know the importance of a teacher of the Word in your life.You will have questions and you will need a teacher to help you build proper foundation of spiritual understanding.The Ethiopian Eunuch was reading the book of Isaiah, yet he didn't understand. He was humble enough to allow Philip to teach him. "So Philip ran to him, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”And he said, “How can I, unless someone guides me?”And he asked Philip to come up and sit with him. The place in the Scripture which he read was this:“He was led as a sheep to the slaughter;And as a lamb before its shearer is silent,So He opened not His mouth.In His humiliation His justice was taken away,And who will declare His generation?For His life is taken from the earth.”So the eunuch answered Philip and said, “I ask you, of whom does the prophet say this, of himself or of some other man?”Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning at this Scripture, preached Jesus to him. Now as they went down the road, they came to some water. And the eunuch said, “See, here is water. What hinders me from being baptized?”Then Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.”And he answered and said, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.”Acts 8:30-37 (NKJV). There is no student of the Word who was self-made.Anyone who has great understanding of the scriptures was first guided.Imagine reading the scriptures consistently without understanding what you read.It will be frustrating and discouraging. You may think it is not relatable, and doesn't have the answers for your now life. Or you may force yourself to create your own interpretation, which will lead to falsehood.This is why when you become born again, you have to be consistent in the community of the saints, where the revelation of Jesus is exalted. The goal of the scriptures is to reveal Christ. (See Christ the Centricity of the Scriptures). From the story of Philip and the Ethiopian Eunuch, you can see the message Philip preached was Jesus. He is the central theme of the scriptures.It is great to have a personal experience of Christ. Nevertheless, this experience must be grounded on sound doctrine.No one becomes born again, and automatically, has sound doctrine without being part of the community of Christ, where the word of God is rightly divided.In the book of Acts, after Peter and the apostles had preached, all those who got saved were added to the Church.For which purpose, they were to be taught the true revelation of Jesus and be built in the new and living way. "Then those who gladly received his word were baptized; and that day about three thousand souls were added to them. And they continued steadfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and in prayers." Acts 2:41-42 (NKJV). What are the apostles’ doctrine (teaching)?The focus of the message or teachings of the apostles is the revelation of Jesus and the expression of His life.You don't understand the scriptures alone. As you have personal study, you also submit yourself to be taught in a Christ-centred church community.This is how you begin to grow in the knowledge of Christ.So we are charged through the scriptures, esteem they who labour in teaching you the word (1 Thessalonians 5:12-13)Selah DIG DEEPER:(Acts 8:26-30; Acts 20:28; Ephesians 4:11; Jeremiah 23:4; 2 Timothy 2:2; Acts 18:18-28) WE PRAY:Dear Lord, please teach me more on how to esteem my Pastor/Teacher. BIBLE READINGDay 119: 2 Kings 14-15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I remain submissive to the teachings of my Pastor/ Teacher.- I don’t bring my personal opinion into the word.- I submit myself in my local church, to be trained and taught rightly God’s word.- I don’t take the teachings of my Pastor/Teacher lightly.- I grow in the understanding of the teachings I receive from my Pastor/ Teacher.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 130 - BE PART OF GOD'S MOVE, GREAT QUANTITY WITH HIGH QUALITY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE PART OF GOD'S MOVE: GREAT QUANTITY WITH HIGH QUALITY " who desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth" 1 Timothy 2:4 (ESV) HURRAAAAAY!! THIS IS A NEW GLORIOUS MONTH TO DO GREAT THINGS WITH THE LORD. ARE YOU PART OF THE EXPANSION OF THE KINGDOM? There are some saints who have been in Christ for 10 years, 20 years, 5 years or 8 years and have never thought being involved in the growth and expansion of the Kingdom. There are some who think that ministry is not about quantity but quality. However this is not what the scriptures teach. Ministry has to be "GREAT QUANTITY with HIGH QUALITY." Look at the opening verse: 1 Timothy 2:4 God " who desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth" (ESV). Do you see that? This is the desire of God that ALL PEOPLE (GREAT QUANTITY) be saved and Come to the knowledge of the truth (HIGH QUALITY). It is estimated that the current world population is over 8 Billion. According to: https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/ As I am typing now the numbers are increasing by 10 or more every second. And more people are dying. The last time I checked about 28 Million people are dead this year alone, and it is increasing by the tens of thousands daily and every micro second. The question is how many are saved? It is estimated by Pew Research that there are about 2.4 Billion Christians as at 2021. Who should reach out to the remaining 5.6 Billion or more people? Yes, it's believed the number of "Christians" keep increasing but its at a slow pace as compared to the previous years. How many of these population of Christians have actually come to the knowledge of the truth? We are not to joke with discipleship and we are not to say, we are okay with one (1) disciple by each active Christian. It is great but that is not what we should be dreaming of. We must dream of being involved in the fulfillment of God's dream in a large extent. It is possible for each saint to disciple about 20 to 50 people with HIGH QUALITY. It is possible!!! It is possible to dream of reaching out to thousands of people as a Church in a locality. We are not to permit anyone to perish.We may not reach the world at the same time as individuals but we can do it as a team. If every saint is taking on his or her immediate sphere with much passion and diligence; and he or she dominates it with the gospel of our LORD JESUS, we will have GREAT QUANTITY being saved. And also bring them to the knowledge of the truth (that is HIGH QUALITY). Evangelizing and Discipleship is the way forward. Each person must be involved. According to Bible.org: Ninety-five percent of all Christians have never won a soul to Christ.Eighty percent of all Christians do not consistently witness for Christ.Less than two percent are involved in the ministry of evangelism.Seventy-one percent do not give toward the financing of the great Commission. One particular denomination did a survey on its leadership ministries. The results are as follows: 63% of the leadership in this denomination, including deacons and elders, have not led one stranger to Jesus in the last two years through the method of “Go Ye” evangelism. 49% of the leadership ministries spend zero time in an average week ministering outside of the church. 89% of the leadership ministries have zero time reserved on their list of weekly priorities for going out to evangelize. 99% of the leadership ministries believe that every Christian, including leadership, has been commanded to preach the gospel to a lost world. 97% believe that if the leadership had a greater conviction and involvement in evangelism, that would be an example for the church to follow. 96% of the leadership believe their churches would have grown faster if they would have been more involved in evangelism. That leadership survey is true in most Churches across the globe. The world population is increasing right from the immediate communities we live in. We shouldn't be careful to dream! The Holy Spirit is our advantage in this labour. By the Spirit of the LORD we can cover the earth with the gospel as the waters cover the sea. We don't have to leave evangelism and discipleship in the hands of only few people.We must all be involved. The ministry of reconciliation is not in the hands of few people. It's committed to every new creation. Don't sit on the fence. Get to work, set goals now. YOU ARE THE MAN FOR THE JOB! Shalom *DIG DEEPER:*( Acts 8:1-4; Matthew 28:19; Mark16:15; Acts 19:20; 1 Corinthians 9:16) *WE PRAY:*That we will be compelled by the love of Christ to reach out to more souls. *BIBLE READING*Day 120: 2 Kings 16-18 *DECLARE THESE WORDS:*- I go all out for the salvation of souls.- I don’t sit on the fence, I am actively involved.- I win the last soul at all cost.- I go everywhere to bring in everyone.- I am a soul winner to the core.- This is the way I was born to live.- I don’t make excuses, I get the job done. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 131 - ESTEEM DIVINE ASSIGNMENTS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ESTEEM DIVINE ASSIGNMENTS " Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God." 1 Chronicles 29:1 (KJV). There are some saints in Christ who esteem their education, their job, their self-centered interests than the assignment of the Lord.How do you see what the Lord tells you to do?Anything God tells you to do, is great!The assignments of the Lord benefit generations.You have to see the Lord's work with the eyes of your spirit and look into generations ahead.David the king said, "the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God." What makes the assignment great is who the work is for.You don't value or esteem what you do for man than what what you do for the Lord.Imagine being invited and tasked to represent a President of a country you esteem. You will definitely see it as a great task.Whatever the Lord tells you to do, is a representation of Him.The task given to you by God are things He had desired to do, and He is entrusting you with it.Don't belittle His assignment for you or the dreams He has put in your heart.Your Heavenly Father's joy is to see you do something great for Him.I remember one time, during my teens, I woke up excited about a Church excursion. Whiles getting ready the Holy Spirit spoke to me not to be too excited about the excursion and the funfair. He was like He is calling me to do great things for the Kingdom. And that is also the call of every saint. He has not called us to do what the people of the world can do. (This is not to deny the importance of social or societal responsibilities or engagements).However, I realised the Lord was redirecting my desires and how I perceive my walk with Him.That morning, the Lord prompted me to read the book of Isaiah. Interestingly, I started with Isaiah 49.I don't think it was coincidence: See what I found: " The LORD said to me, "I have a greater task for you, my servant. Not only will you restore to greatness the people of Israel who have survived, but I will also make you a light to the nations so that all the world may be saved.*" Isaiah 49:6 (GNT) Oh dear Lord.This scripture opened my heart.The moment I saw "I HAVE A GREATER TASK FOR YOU", I was moved into prayer. My heart began to burn with fresh passion and my mindset about God's Kingdom assignment was stretched or expanded.All through the scriptures, anyone God called was made great. They were made great because the Lord did great things with or through them.Beloved, you are called by the Lord into His greatness. Think greatness and take great steps.Whatever the Lord tells you to do is great!Esteem the Lord's assignment for you.It is a great thing to serve the LordHallelujah DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 2:10; 1 Thessalonians 1:3; Hebrews 11:6; Psalm 108:13 (BBE); Genesis 26:13) WE PRAY:We are praying and declaring that with God we do great things. BIBLE READINGDay 121: 2 Kings 19-20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the workmanship of God created in Christ Jesus unto good works.- Through God, I do valiantly.- I increase in capacity and grace as I labour with the Lord.- I esteem the Lord’s assignment for me than any self-centered desires.- I take bold steps towards my kingdom assignment.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 132 - DOING GREAT THINGS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS "Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:" 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV). The Lord’s assignment has never been small. Even the things which seem little are embodiment of great seeds.When Jesus was speaking to His disciples to go ye into all the nations, he didn't consider the ratio of His disciples and the population of the world.It is estimated that the world's population at the time of Jesus, was around 300 million.And Jesus asked that they take the gospel of the Kingdom to all nations. The assignment was unto generations yet unborn.He wanted to see all men saved, as He worked through His disciples.It was a great task and that was why the Lord asked them to tarry until they are imbued with power.For God to call you into fellowship or partnership with Him (1 Corinthians 1:9), it means He has also invited you to share in His great burdens.He made you and created you for His foreordained good works (Ephesians 2:10).And He doesn't leave you to yourself, He works with you to do great things. " With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot." Psalm 108:13 (BBE) To do great things with God, you must first learn to channel your desires right.What is your desire?What takes the attention of your heart?Until you set your affection towards the Lord you will not be able to do great things with God.David the king, showed us how he was able to give his best towards the building of the Lord's house: " Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:" 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV). To set your affection on something means, you have made it your delight or it has overwhelmed your mind and pleasure.This is the first thing to consider in doing great things for God; SET YOUR AFFECTION ON THE LORD AND HIS VISION. Whatever overwhelms your affection or desire has your attention and resources.Desire is the primary fuel that causes you to do great things for the Lord.To increase in desire for the Lord; 1. Spend time to meditate on the Word of God and to behold great things others have done for the Lord. 2. See God's heartbeat. See how the Lord wants to give hope to a hopeless clueless generation. 3. Understand the meaning and purpose of life. See that the meaning of life transcends the portrait of the world. The life of Christ is the picture of the true meaning of life. 4. Make it your meditation, think about it, talk about it and train your heart to rejoice in it. 5. Spend time with people who share in the new desires you cultivate. Be in the right company of people sharing in your burdens and desires. 6. Attempt something great for the Lord and be determined to do more. 7. Make time to pray and fellowship with the Holy Spirit. The more you follow these things, the more you intensify your affection towards the Lord's assignment. Where is your desire? DIG DEEPER:(Colossians 3:1-2; 1 Chronicles 22:19; 1 Chronicles 28:9) WE PRAY:That we yield and submit to the controlling and compelling force of Christ, to increase in the desire of the Lord in doing great things. BIBLE READINGDay 121: 2 Kings 21-23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I set my affection on the Lord and His vision.- I dare to do great things for the Lord.- I give my mind to the meditation of the word.- I delight in the word of God.- I yield my heart and mind to the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.- Many believe in Jesus through me.- Many respond to the gospel on my lips.- I speak the right words inspired by the Holy Spirit to get people saved.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 133 - DOING GREAT THINGS 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS 2 " With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot." Psalm 108:13 (BBE) There are many who are always expecting God to do something great for them.They look forward to one miracle after the other.If your walk with God has always been about what God will do for you or what God is doing for you, you have not yet began life.The beauty of life is the expression of God.God is not expressed just for your enjoyment. Your expression of God impart others with God.From the first part of this discussion, I explained that to do great things for God, you must first set your affection on the Lord.Until the interest of God becomes your interest you cannot attempt great things.What is your desire? What is your self-interest?Until your "self-interest" matures to you becoming a blessing to others, you have not yet channeled your desires right.Your desires should not gravitate towards your needs. Desire to be part of God's great work.Desire to be a massive blessing to others.Apart from making the Lord and His great work the focus of your affection, understand that God called you to do great works. GOD CALLED YOU TO DO GREAT THINGS You will attempt great things when you see yourself as one called by God into Christ to do great things. " Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me, the works that I do he will do also; and greater works than these he will do, because I go to My Father." John 14:12 (NKJV). This is the design of God for all those who believe in Jesus.God is not with you just for you. God is with you to achieve great things for the Kingdom.'God with you', is your advantage to do or achieve great things. " With God we will do great things..." Psalm 108:13 (BBE) When you look into a mirror, what do you see?Do you see one who cannot attempt something great?Or you see that fellow ordained by God to do great things.Look at the Prophetic word: "...I will make you as a light for the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth." Isaiah 46:9 (ESV). And Jesus affirmed this prophecy concerning you: “ You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden." Matthew 5:14 (NKJV). The prophetic word doesn't say, you are the light of your bedroom. You are not made to shine in a corner or a small place.You are made to be a light that shines in the world.This is a call to be a great light.Beloved, you are to made to do GREAT THINGS. DIG DEEPER:(Philippians 2:15; Proverbs 4:18; Isaiah 42:6) WE PRAY:- We are praying and declaring that as lights of the world, we will shine forth brightly in doing great things with God in our communities, schools, cities and in the nations of the world. BIBLE READINGDay 122: 2 Kings 24-25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don’t seek my own interest.- I have a higher calling.- With God and through God, I do great things.- I have been ordained by God specially to do great things.- I don’t settle for less.- I win the lost in their numbers.- I disciple many unto righteousness.- I am a terror to the powers and cohorts of darkness.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 134-DOING GREAT THINGS (According to God's Order) 3
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS (According to God's Order) 3 " With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot." Psalm 108:13 (BBE) We have seen how we are mandated by God to do great things. We have this calling to do great things because, God does great things.You may have the desire to do great things in this world. However, you are not called to do great things according to the standard of the world.There are many things people may do, which the world will applaud as great feat, and will not be reckoned as Kingdom relevance.Or you may attempt to do something great with your strength which may seem relevant in the kingdom, but will not be recognized as such by God.What you do must be according to the Lord's due order of greatness.Don't just do things for God and call them great. It is the things which God has designed you to do that must be done.Whatever God has called you to do, the intention and purposes has been foreordained. " For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us]." Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified) There are paths which the Lord has set. He has shown us through scriptures the level impact we must make.Becoming a great athlete, accountant, mathematician, etc may seem great before men in this world, but there is a greatness of impact you are ordained by God to make.Jesus showed us the pattern of greatness. " I assure you and most solemnly say to you, anyone who believes in Me [as Savior] will also do the things that I do; and he will do even greater things than these [in extent and outreach], because I am going to the Father." John 14:12 (Amplified). There are great things the Lord did and now He has empowered us to step out there to do even greater.Anything great you envision to do, it must be that which will contribute to the expansion of the Kingdom.People shouldn't just applaud you for what you do.They shouldn't just applaud you as an outstanding student. Or an excellent business man. Those avenues must be used to influence the multitudes with the light of the Kingdom.Don't just be a celebrated philanthropist, be a Kingdom financier. Be a part of the sponsors of the spread of the gospel. Be a mighty soul winner. Take daring steps to draw many to Christ.You can be a lawyer and still demonstrate great healing power, win thousands of souls, give into the spread of the gospel across the nations of the world.Hallelujah!!DIG DEEPER:(Philippians 2:15; Proverbs 4:18; Isaiah 42:6) WE PRAY:That we shall increase in the understanding of the intention of the Lord and to rightly correct our motives so that our exploits will be according to God’s due order of greatness.
