BIBLE READINGDay 123: 1 Chronicles 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I decrease that Christ may increase in me.- Whatever I do, I do according to God’s due order of greatness.- Whatever the Lord will request from me, I give with joy.- All that I have is the Lord's and for His kingdom advancement.- My family, my house, money, intelligence, time, all resources and life are for the Lord's use.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 135 - DOING GREAT THINGS (GOD IS WITH YOU) 4
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS (GOD IS WITH YOU) 4 " With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot." Psalm 108:13 (BBE) God has not called some special people in His Kingdom to do great things.In Christ, we have all been called by God to do great things.The only criteria, our Lord Jesus gave for one to do the works which He did and to even do greater works is to BELIEVE IN HIM!This qualifies you to do great things in the Kingdom.From the previous with in this month of June 2023, we looked at: 1. You being part of God's great move. He desires that all men will be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. God wants us to be a part of His GREAT DREAM to reach and transform ALL MEN. He doesn't just want to reach great quantity of people; He also wants to produce high quality of life in them. This is His desire! (1 Timothy 2:4). Therefore, don't be careful to dream. This is the time to make great impact. 2. Esteem God's Assignment for you. Anything for God is a great work. How you see God's work will influence the extent you will go for Him. God's call for you is great, give more than your best. 3. Set your affection on the Lord. Until you set your desire on the Lord you will not esteem His work. Let the zeal of the Lord consume your heart. 4. Be convinced that God has called you into greatness. He made you and mandated you to do great things. 5. You are to do the great things the Lord has designed not according to the standards of the world. Christ is the pattern and the standard measure of your greatness. He has defined the scope of impact you have to make in this world. (John 14:12) GOD IS WITH YOU TO DO GREAT THINGS Beloved, you cannot do greater things in the Kingdom with your strength.Unless the Lord is with you, you cannot do what the Lord has called you to do.Read the opening verse again: " With God we will do great things..." Psalm 108:13 (BBE) Did you see that?You don't attempt to do the great things God has called you to do without God. You can only do what God has called you to do with God.Anything your strength can do is not A GREAT THING; if it is going to be great then you have to do it with God.Look at what Nicodemus, said to Jesus. " There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews. This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him.” John 3:1-2 (NKJV). Whatever you attempt to do without God cannot produce God-centered impact.Are you dreaming to do great things for God?You have to do it with the LORD!Hallelujah!! DIG DEEPER:(1 Samuel 16:18; 1 Samuel 18:14; 2 Samuel 5:10; Deuteronomy 31:23) WE PRAY:- That we will walk in the consciousness of the reality that God is with us to do great things. BIBLE READINGDay 124: 1 Chronicles 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- With God, I go beyond my strength.- The Lord is with me therefore I do great things.- I take bold steps towards my kingdom assignment.- It doesn’t matter the size of the assignment given me, with God I handle it with ease to produce the expected results.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 136 - DOING GREAT THINGS (GOD IS WITH YOU 2) 5
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS (GOD IS WITH YOU 2) 5 " And David had great success in all his ways; and the LORD was with him" 1 Samuel 18:14 (JPS Tanakh 1917) One common trait of all those who did great things, all through scriptures and the history of the Church, is that, THE LORD WAS WITH THEM. As I said yesterday, you cannot do anything great for God without God. You will need God to do what He inspires you to do. Just as Nicodemus, a member of the Jewish ruling council, clearly stated: " ...for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him." John 3:2 (NKJV) Jesus did great works because God was with Him. (Remember even though He is God, He was fully man at the incarnation. Or as God let’s say, He was with Himself or in the fullness of His divine essence). Now, as the Lord has instructed us to do greater works, you will need to work with the consciousness that GOD IS WITH you. It is your advantage for God to be with you. As you can see in the opening verse, because the Lord was with David, he had great success in all his ways. Joseph enjoyed great kindness and prosperity because the Lord was with him. The Lord told Joshua: " No man shall be able to stand before you all the days of your life. Just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not leave you or forsake you." Joshua 1:5 (ESV). God confirms to us by his words to Joshua; the importance of He being with us. Remember, He was also with Moses. "...as I was with Moses..." Now there is good news for you. GOD IS WITH YOU TO DO GREAT THINGS "teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen." Matthew 28:20 (NKJV). God is now with you through the Person of the Holy Spirit: " And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you." John 14:16-17 (KJV) This is glorious. For you, God is in you and with you through the Holy Spirit. Look at what the Lord said in Hebrews: " ...For He Himself has said, “I will never leave you nor forsake you.” Hebrews 13:5 (NKJV). You don't need to do something spectacular for God to be with you. God is with you now! The moment you came into Christ, God indwelt you and is now with you. You have the inward capacity and the Heavenly accompaniment to do great things for God. DARE TO DO SOMETHING GREAT FOR GOD today, this week, this month and this year. This is the TIME. Hallelujah DIG DEEPER:(1 Samuel 16:18; 2 Samuel 5:10; Deuteronomy 31:23, Genesis 39:2,3,23; Acts 18:10;) WE PRAY:Oh Lord, empower us to do great things through your Spirit within us as we remain conscious of the reality that you are with us. BIBLE READINGDay 125: 1 Chronicles 7-8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I do great and mighty things because the Lord is with me.- I prosper in all that I do because the Lord is with me.- Nothing dies in my hands.- The gospel propers in my hands.- Many see and testify that the Lord is with me.- I manifest the wonders of the Lord being with me in all that I do. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 137 - DOING GREAT THINGS (SERVING IS GREATNESS) 6
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS (SERVING IS GREATNESS) 6 " But he who is greatest among you shall be your servant" Matthew 23:11 (NKJV). Sincerely everyone wants to experience greatness or manifest greatness.Though each person would want to be great for his or her unique reason. It could be for selfless reasons or selfish reasons.You don't judge your greatness by the standards of the world.To be great is not how you control or lord yourself over others.It is not how others bow to you.Greatness in the kingdom is essentially service.You don't serve to be great.Because you serve you are great!Those who do great things for God, serve selflessly. If it is not selfless, then it is not service.God is not with you to do great things for yourself. God is with you to accomplish great things to bless others.The extent of your greatness is measured by the extent of your service. The more people you stretch yourself through the sufficient ability of God to bless or serve, the more you demonstrate the greatness of God in you.Look at what Jesus said to his disciples: "Hearing this, the [other] ten became indignant with James and John. Calling them to Himself, Jesus said to them, “You know that those who are recognized as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them; and their powerful men exercise authority over them [tyrannizing them]. But this is not how it is among you; instead, whoever wishes to become great among you must be your servant, and whoever wishes to be first and most important among you must be slave of all. For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a [f]ransom for many.” Mark 10:41-45 (Amplified). From previous discussion we realized that God has called unto greatness and He is with us to do great things.Now if you are thinking of where to start from, our Lord Jesus has given the obvious answer: SERVE!From Mark 10:42-45, you can see the contrast between the greatness of this world and the greatness of the Kingdom.To serve in the Kingdom is to selflessly make sacrifices which will bless others. This doesn't deny the idea that the Lord exalts those who serve in the Kingdom. He surely rewards those who labour in the Kingdom.Yet, the motive of our service is to be a satisfaction unto others.Beloved, attempt to do something great for your generation through service.And it takes humility and genuine heart for God, to serve others.David didn't become great because he wanted to "lord over others". He became great because he saw an opportunity to serve his nation Israel.Who else will you find in the Kingdom who did great things without service?Even our Lord came to serve and not to be serve. This is the reality of greatness.Selah DIG DEEPER:(Luke 22:26-27; Matthew 20:26-27; Acts 13:22,36; Hebrews 6:10; John 12:26) WE PRAY:That we will selflessly serve our generation in doing great things for the Lord. BIBLE READINGDay 126: 1 Chronicles 9-11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a satisfaction unto others.- I am a blessing unto others.- When people encounter me, they encounter love unfeigned.- In which ever capacity the Lord has given me, I still serve my generation.- I serve in and out of season.- I am not proud.- I don’t lord over others.- I serve!- I love to serve.- I am a man of service.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 138 - DOING GREAT THINGS (with Audacity of faith) 7
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DOING GREAT THINGS (with Audacity of faith) 7 " Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go" Joshua 1:9 (NKJV) Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith.It is by faith we live and walk with God.Faith is our reality.The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them.Anything that has to bring glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith).Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said. It is knowing without any tittle of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do.Faith is audacious in its dealing.When you act in faith courage is seen.This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life.And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness.Serving others is greatness, however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation.A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss.Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father's house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh.He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites, but felt enervated.Maybe you are reading this and feels you don't have what it takes to do great things.When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community you can't do anything great for the Lord.Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!!God specialises in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations.That is God. He will always use what it seem depleted to reveal His glory.He used, a young man who is least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory in Israel.He made mighty men out of men that were distresses, indebted, and discontented (1Samuel 22:2).Why must God use young 17 years old David, with no military experience to defeat Goliath with just a sling and stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53).To feed five thousand people, He used a little boys lunch pack of five bread and two fishes.This is audacity!!!God doesn't choose the easy paths, He creates greatness out of what seem impossible.To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord. " Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus."Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward.You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room.You will look for places to show forth His glory and power.Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you.Until you take a step to do something great you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord.God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary!Selah DIG DEEPER:(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAY:Lord, I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READINGDay 127: 1 Chronicles 12-14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work.- I am strong and courageous.- I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary.- I live above this world.- I do the unimaginable.- I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me.- I am audacious.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 139 - RESOUNDING: YOU ARE MORE THAN A CONQUEROR ‐ DEAR VALIANT ONE!
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE MORE THAN A CONQUEROR ‐ DEAR VALIANT ONE! "Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors and gain an overwhelming victory through Him who loved us [so much that He died for us].” Romans 8:37 (Amplified Bible). What you are determines what you do. You must walk in the consciousness of who you are in Christ. As you are born of God, you are an overcomer (1 John 5:4). Until this becomes your consciousness, it will not reflect in what you do. We are at war; nevertheless we are not in this war with the hope that we will win. We are in this war with the confidence that we have won. Thus you are enlisted by God in a victorious battle. You came into this war as more than a conqueror. This is our joy and boldness. We are not in this war thinking we will fail. THIS WAR IS ABOUT THE SALVATION OF SOULS It is about subduing kingdoms and taking unreached territories for the Lord and unto His glory. This is not for the faint-hearted. Neither is it for the one who loves himself and the pleasures of this world. The faint-hearted is focused on himself or herself and occupied with his strength and weaknesses. You must have this strong mindset that God is with you; therefore you fight valiantly. When you make the Lord and His supply your consciousness, you will see yourself as the Lord sees you. When God looks at you, He sees a Valiant one. Like He saw Gideon. " And the Angel of the LORD appeared to him, and said to him, “The LORD is with you, you mighty man of valor!” Judges 6:12 (NKJV). To be Valiant is the same as Valor ( the Hebrew word is, chayil or hāyil); which is a force of an army or resources (and wealth). It also speaks of the strength of a great company; the might of a great army in a war or the power of riches. To do valiantly (in Psalm 60:12) means to work, act with effect, to perform and accomplish with the force of a great and mighty army using all the power of resources of wealth supplied. This gives an idea of how you are to function as a good (victorious) Soldier of Christ. You are not in a weak army to act cowardly. You have enormous supply of resources at your disposal. You don’t have an excuse not to accomplish mighty things through God. You have all the weapons, and the equipment needed for every battle and the war at large. You don’t have to see yourself as a grasshopper as the ten spies of Israel did. “And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight” Numbers 13:33 (KJV)) Caleb and Joshua were different, they had the consciousness of God’s presence (that is the consciousness of their advantage and might). The other ten (10) spies saw giants and were afraid. Caleb and Joshua saw the sons of Anak as: bread and defenseless. (Numbers 14:9) They were fearless because they had the consciousness that the Lord is with them. (Numbers 14:9). Now look at God’s testimony of Caleb: ” But as for My servant Caleb, because he has had a different spirit and has followed Me fully, I will bring him into the land which he entered, and his descendants shall take possession of it.” Numbers 14:24 (NASB). This should be God’s testimony about you. To have a different spirit also means a different attitude. This is an attitude of a mighty man of valor. To be a mighty man of valor or to do valiantly, is not to have huge physical muscles. To accomplish valiantly is to have strong confidence in God’s word and to diligently follow God fully or consistently remain committed to God without turning away to create room for doubts. This is what great faith is! Doubters are cowards and cannot do anything big through God. Take hold of God’s word to act in faith. Don't think about your selfish interests. Living a life beyond your needs or personal interest is the beginning of greatness. The steps you are willing to take today shows whether you will do valiantly or not. Shalom! DIG DEEPER:(Numbers 13:21-33; Numbers 14:1-9; Hebrews 11; Acts 4:8-14,29-31 ) WE PRAY:That the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps which will make us get ministerial results. BIBLE READING:DAY 128: 1 Chronicles 15-17 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I don't walk in fear.- I refuse to doubt God no matter the challenge.- I walk in boldness.- I accomplish great things by the strength of God.- I am a valiant soldier.- The Lord teaches my hands for war and my fingers for battle.- The Lord is my strength.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 140 - BE A GREAT PARTNER OF THE GOSPEL
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE A GREAT PARTNER OF THE GOSPEL"Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver" 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV) A United Nations publication of 1998 "Economic and Social Consequences of Drug Abuse and Illicit drugs states that: a total estimation of $400 billion is spent on illicit drugs per annum in the world.According to Statista Research Department, the total costs from terrorism in the world amounted to 115.8 billion US dollars in 2014.In 2016, the economic cost of terrorism in Africa was US$15.5 billion.These terrorism activities are funded by some institutions and even some individuals.And interestingly most of these terrorism activities are with religious intentions.Do you have an idea how much people spend to attend night clubs and entertainment events?Beloved, what more is too much to spend on the spread of the glorious gospel of our Lord Jesus. David said, " because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver" The spread of the gospel is a great work.Remember anything that is of God is great.No amount of money is too big for the gospel.Though the preaching of the gospel is free, it is not cheap.Just as the salvation which our Lord brought is free, but was not cheap. It took the sacrifice of the eternal blood of God (Our Lord Jesus) to make salvation available.To go forth with the gospel to get many saved; will cost you time, attention, energy, passion and MONEY. The Holy Spirit is the greatest help for the salvation of souls. However, there are things you will need to use for the spread of the gospel. And it will take money to make such possible.Where are you putting your money?Don't you think it is a glorious thing to be involved in the financing of the gospel?Don't you think it is more blessing to see thousands and millions of people transformed, just because you gave into a gospel mission?If others take delight in sponsoring terrorism, then you shouldn't sit back when there is a need to finance the gospel. Join the shining forth of the light of the gospel through your giving.Your money can make more impact in the lives of others through the gospel.What you have in your hand can bless thousands of people, don't just spend on yourself. You learn to live for others when you partner into the gospel. That is how your life begins to find meaning and expression.Do you remember the little boy whose five loaves and two fishes fed the multitudes?The gospel must spread and your money should be involved.SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 9:6-11; Genesis 8:22; Matthew 14:15-21) WE PRAY:- That we will be empowered with the blessings of the Lord to create wealth in every single opportunity to give bountifully into the spread of the gospel.- That we will be empowered to financially multiply all that the Lord has entrusted into our hands to finance the gospel. BIBLE READING:DAY 129: 1 Chronicles 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS- The gospel prospers in my hands.- I am a prompt to do it giver.- Through my finance, the gospel reaches the far ends of the world.- The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement.- I am excited to give unto the Lord, because it is the greatest privilege.- Whatever the Lord will request from me, I give with joy.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 141 - BE A STEWARD OF GOD'S FINANCES
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE A STEWARD OF GOD'S FINANCES"The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine,’ says the LORD of hosts" Haggai 2:8 (NKJV) It is an opportunity or privilege to be a financial partner of the gospel.Giving towards the advancement of the gospel and the Kingdom, isn't for everyone. And that is why you don't listen nor pay attention to anyone who vehemently speaks against giving into the gospel.Giving into the Kingdom is for those who have:1. Set their affection on the Lord and have given themselves to the Lord2. Consciously increased in the giving grace, and give with joy and willingness.3. Recognized themselves as stewards of God's finances.As a steward of God's finances you acknowledge that, whatever you give is not from you but of God.You acknowledge God as your supply.That was exactly the mindset of Abraham.When God asked Abraham to offer his son Isaac; Abraham didn't see himself as the provider of the sacrifice.When Isaac asked where the lamb for the sacrifice was, Abraham told him, God will provide for Himself a lamb for the sacrifice.Now the question is did God really made provision of the lamb for the sacrifice?Of course! (See Genesis 22:1-18)This is for you to understand that, whatever God tells you to do, He supplies you with the resources to do.When God tells you to go out there to preach, teach and heal the sick, He supplies you with the grace to do.God doesn't place demands on you. He supplies you with the grace and resources you need to do what He wants you to do.When it comes to financing Kingdom assignment, the first thing to do is to look to God, not your pocket nor bank account.Your bank balance will always be too small for the great things God wants you to do.David said, "...I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver: 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV) Which means he gave beyond what he has saved (prepared).At this level of giving you are operating on the frequency of God's supply.Giving by faith is giving with the mindset that the Lord is your supply; and that is stewardship.On the matter of stewardship you acknowledge that, all that you have is from God and it belongs to Him.When that becomes your consciousness you don't struggle to give greatly towards the advancement of His Kingdom.Remember whatever we do for God must be great.It was this mindset David had. He saw himself as a steward of God's resources. And that was how he trained his people to think." Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might;In Your hand it is to make great. And to give strength to all. “Now therefore, our God,We thank YouAnd praise Your glorious name.But who am I, and who are my people,That we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You. For we are aliens and pilgrims before You, As were all our fathers; Our days on earth are as a shadow,And without hope. “O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name is from Your hand, and is all Your own." 1 Chronicles 29:12-16 (NKJV). David and His people gave greatly towards the Lord's work because they recognised that the work of God is great and must be greatly financed. And above all they gave cheerfully and willingly because they knew all that they had was from God. And also it was God who enabled them to give.They saw their walk with God greater than their earthly engagements.Beloved whatever you have is of God, therefore you are only a steward of God's resources. Your giving into God's work is God sponsoring and advancing His Kingdom mandate through you.What can you give into God's assignment that He didn't give to you?Refusing to be a radical giver is failing to be a faithful steward. This is the secret of giving willingly.ARE YOU A FAITHFUL KINGDOM FINANCIAL STEWARD?SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 50:8-11; Haggai 2:7-9; 1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10) WE PRAY:That we will be obedient to the promptings of the Lord each time in giving to His work. BIBLE READING:DAY 131: 1 Chronicles 19-21 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I have set my affection on the Lord- I am a faithful steward.- I give with joy.- I don’t withhold whatever the Lord asks me to give.- I give willingly and bountifully.- My finances are for the gospel.- I give in and out of necessity.- I don’t only give according to my ability, I give beyond.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 142 - INCREASE IN THE GIVING-GRACE TO ADVANCE THE KINGDOM
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency INCREASE IN THE GIVING-GRACE TO ADVANCE THE KINGDOM" But just as you excel in everything, [and lead the way] in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in genuine concern, and in your love for us, see that you excel in this gracious work [of giving] also 2 Corinthians 8:7 (Amplified Bible) As a saint in Christ you are made a steward of God. Your living is not unto yourself, but Christ.Whatever you do, do as unto the Lord's glory.And there is nothing God tells you to do without supplying you with grace.He makes His grace available for you, yours is to take hold of grace and increase in it.There is nothing done in the Kingdom without the supply of God's grace.One may have a lot of resources at his or her disposal and will not be a cheerful bountiful giver.It takes grace to be a giver!!It is one thing to know that whatever you have to give is from God, and it's another thing to have the grace to give big.Therefore, Paul, the apostle speaking to the Church in Corinth, he mentioned that they should excel or increase in the giving grace as well.Read the opening verse above again.I hope you just did that, right?If not please go up to read again.You see, in as much as the Church in Corinth:- excelled in the grace to exercise and lead in faith- excelled in utterance or speech.- excelled in knowledge- excelled in genuine passion- excelled in love for the apostles and even in every giftHe admonished them to excel in the GIVING GRACE. (2 Corinthians 8:7).Which means the brethren in Corinth didn't lack grace for the various items mentioned; yet they did not excel in the grace to be great givers.And for the apostle to get them to excel in this grace he has to teach them.We grow in grace through the knowledge of our Lord Jesus (2 Peter 1:2). This knowledge is not just awareness, it is the acknowledgement and oneness into reality through the participation of that reality.Which means as you acknowledge the wisdom of God in Christ concerning giving and you become a doer of this knowledge, you increase in giving-grace.You don't excel in the giving grace by "wishing to give". You increase in this grace by giving consistently with joy. And as you continue to give, you stretch your faith to give beyond your ability. That is how you increase your capacity of grace.Look at the testimony of the Churches in Macedonia: " Beloved ones, we must tell you about the grace God poured out upon the churches of Macedonia. For even during a season of severe difficulty and tremendous suffering, they became even more filled with joy. From the depths of their extreme poverty, super-abundant joy overflowed into an act of extravagant generosity. For I can verify that they spontaneously gave, not only according to their means but far beyond what they could afford." 2 Corinthians 8:1-3 (TPT). You could see that, they didn't give their surplus to support God's work (which includes ministering to the saints), they extravagantly gave beyond their ability. This is fully the work of grace.However, they didn't just give extravagantly by grace, they first gave themselves to the Lord.Just as David said,  "...because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared..."This is the kind of environment giving grace finds true expression. You have to first set your affection on the Lord and give yourself to Him; where you don't live according to your self interest. "Not only [did they give materially] as we had hoped, but first they gave themselves to the Lord and to us [as His representatives] by the will of God [disregarding their personal interests and giving as much as they possibly could]" 2 Corinthians 8:5 (Amplified Bible). Until you set your affection on the Lord you cannot give towards His work. And the giving grace will not find full expression to excel.Where you put your money or your treasure (which includes your time, attention and valuable resources) is where your heart is.Our Lord made it clear: " Wherever your treasure is, there the desires of your heart will also be." Matthew 6:21 (NLT) And when your heart gravitates towards the Kingdom, you activate the grace of God to do more in the Kingdom.The time to increase in this giving grace is now. How do you see the Lord's assignment?How do you esteem the Lord's work?What is the direction of your desire, affection or interests?God doesn't just supply grace. More grace is given to the doers of the word.How true?Look at this: " And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity." You know, people often shout "I receive it" and "Amen" when there is the declaration of the above gracious blessing.However, most people don't pay attention to the verse 7, before the verse 8.In the verse 7, Paul gave an instruction to the brethren in Corinth: " Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving]." 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). Is your heart in your giving?Are you a cheerful giver?Do you purpose in your heart to give according to the desires God has put in your heart?Grace is supplied abundantly to a cheerful prompt to do it giver.And God:- takes pleasure in,- prizes above other things- and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].BE AN EXTRAVAGANT, CHEERFUL, JOYOUS - PROMPT TO DO IT GIVER TODAY!Shalom.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11) WE PRAY:- That as our desires have been stirred towards giving, we shall be cheerful prompt to do it givers.- And that we shall increase in superabounding grace to extravagantly give ourselves and our resources to the expansion of the kingdom. BIBLE READING:DAY 132: 1 Chronicles 22-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am an extravagant giver.- I don't give grudgingly, I give cheerfully.- I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving.- I give greatly into the Lord's work.- I am a son of consolation.- Because of me the work of God is done with ease.- I increase in the grace to give day by day.- I don't withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me.- I have the heart and the mind of a giver.- This week I give greatly into the Lord's assignment.- The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more.- I increase and abound in this giving grace massively.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 143 - THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 1" [Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings." 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) Giving into the Lord's assignment cannot be over-emphasised.And there are great blessings of giving.Your giving in the Lord is also a labour of love. And there is nothing done in the Lord, for the Lord and with the Lord which is in vain. " Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain." 1 Cori thians 15:58 (ESV).See also: " For God is not unjust to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name, in that you have ministered to the saints, and do minister." Hebrews 6:10 (NKJV). It will be unjust for God to forget your labor of love.Which means whatever we do unto the Lord there is a blessedness of the Lord that comes upon it.Your soul winning is not in vain.Your service to the saints is not in vain.Your giving  is not in vain.For every giving, there is a blessing or a harvest you will reap.I don't disagree with the statement that, "We don't give to be blessed, we give because we are blessed and a blessing." This is so true. Nevertheless, there is blessing in giving.Take a look at the opening verse again: " [Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings." 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). Clearly we see that, for every giving we will REAP or HARVEST its kind.Thus, giving is as seed-sowing and will attract a kind of harvest.As we discuss the blessing of giving, it will be expedient to look into this:THERE IS A WAY NOT TO GIVE!"That is why I thought it necessary to urge these brethren to go to you before I do and make arrangements in advance for this bountiful, promised gift of yours, so that it may be ready, not as an extortion [wrung out of you] but as a generous and willing gift.[Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings. Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving]." 2 Corinthians 9:5-7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). - You don't give as an extortion [wrung out of you].- You don't give sparingly and grudgingly.- You don't give reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion.The similitude in all these kind of giving is the unwillingness to give. To give sparingly, is basically to hold back your giving. You don't give with the mindset of how much you want to keep for yourself. To give this way means you have developed the beautiful giving heart of God.Look at this:Romans 8:32 (KJV) " He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?" God did not spare (hold back), he did not give grudgingly, or reluctantly, under compulsion or sorrowfully.Such giving will not attract bountiful harvest.The first blessing you attract is:GOD IS ABLE TO MAKE ALL GRACE (every favor and earthly blessing) COME TO YOU IN ABUNDANCEHallelujah!Shalom.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18) WE PRAY:That no matter what confronts or happens around us, we shall not withhold our giving neither shall we become reluctant or sorrowful in our giving. BIBLE READING:DAY 133: 1 Chronicles 25 -27 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am an extravagant giver.- I don't give grudgingly, I give cheerfully.- I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving.- I give greatly into the Lord's work.- I am a son of consolation.- Because of me the work of God is done with ease.- I increase in the grace to give day by day.- I don't withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me.- I have the heart and the mind of a giver.- This week I give greatly into the Lord's assignment.- The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more.- I increase and abound in this giving grace massively.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 144 - THE BLESSINGS OF  GIVING 2 - ALL GRACE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 2 - ALL GRACE " [Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings." 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) There are evidences all through scriptures to the benefits and blessings of giving. Though whatever you give is first from God, He blesses you for giving. Yes, we give because we are blessed; nevertheless, when we give, the Lord blesses us. Never assume there is no blessing in giving. I mentioned one of the blessings of Giving in the previous post, which is: God causing all grace (every favor and earthly blessing) come to you in abundance. (See 2 Corinthians 9:8) A cheerful prompt to do it giver is blessed with ALL GRACE IN ABUNDANCE. And this All GRACE includes, favor and earthly blessing. This blessing transcends material things. However, this blessing is a force which can attract material things. There are people who first look out for material things when they give. But what God gives to you is an essential conditioning which causes the material world to respond rightly to you. Consider the story of Jacob and Esau. We see Jacob receiving the blessing of the covenant. Isaac spoke words to Jacob, but those words are the impartation of the blessing. When Esau came and realised Jacob has received the blessing, he asked if there is any more blessing for him: "...he has taken away my blessing. Haven't you saved a blessing for me?" Isaac answered, “I have already made him master over you, and I have made all his relatives his slaves. I have given him grain and wine. Now there is nothing that I can do for you, son!” Genesis 27: 36-37 (GNT). When you read the scriptures you will realised the blessing of Isaac were impartation of words. They were physical items he gave to Jacob. Jacob didn't leave his father's house with material properties his father had. He left with the blessing (See more in Genesis 27:1-45). We are all blessed with spiritual blessing in heavenly places in Christ. (Ephesians 1:3). These spiritual blessings are not dependent on your self effort, but the finished work of Christ. However, there is an impartation of blessing which abounds towards every cheerful prompt to do it giver. As a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver, have this expectation and mentality or consciousness that you are specially blessed with ALL GRACE to enjoy favor and earthly blessing in abundance. What is the goal of this blessing? It is not fore mere luxury. We see the essence of this abounding grace: "...so that you may always and under all circumstances and whatever the need be self-sufficient [possessing enough to require no aid or support and furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation]. 2 Corinthians 9:8 ( Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) Oh dear LORD JESUS... Beloved, this is what this blessing of all abounding grace (of favor and earthly blessing) produces in you: - You may always (at any given time give) - under all circumstances (or no matter the situation) - whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work) - You will be self-sufficient [to be self-sufficient means to possess enough to require no aid or support and furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation]. What a limitless BLESSING? It’s a blessing that makes you a GREAT GIVING. Are you a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver? Shalom. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18) WE PRAY:We enjoy the super abounding blessings of grace as we give cheerfully. BIBLE READING:DAY 133: 1 Chronicles 28-29 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am an extravagant giver.- I don't give grudgingly, I give cheerfully.- I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving.- I give greatly into the Lord's work.- I am a son of consolation.- Because of me the work of God is done with ease.- I increase in the grace to give day by day.- I don't withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me.- I have the heart and the mind of a giver.- This week I give greatly into the Lord's assignment.- The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more.- I increase and abound in this giving grace massively.-I always at any given time give.- I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation) - I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work)- I am self-sufficient giver by the grace of God. - I possess enough and require no aid or support to give.- I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 145 - THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 3 - ESTEEMED BY GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 3 - ESTEEMED BY GOD"Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving]. 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) There is something special about giving into God's agenda. A cheerful prompt to do it giver has a genuine heart for God.Having huge amount of money in your bank account or as in income doesn't make you a giver automatically.Until you passionately love the Lord, you will not give into His agenda.There is always something to do with money at a personal level. The more income you make, it's likely your bills will also go up.The demands and needs keep increasing whether you make more money or not.This is why giving into the spread of the gospel means a lot to God.This brings me to another benefit of giving  into the gospel. Take a look at the opening verse again: "Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving]." 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). A cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving], is LOVED BY GOD.We see a detailed explanation about this dimension of love.God, esteems a cheerful (joyous prompt to do it) giver (whose heart is in his giving).Such a person is always on God's mind for the next assignment. For God to love or esteem you in this light means, He is always creating opportunities for you to give.Have you ever been in a place where you feel you are the only one giving big?Or you feel you are always the one called upon by your Pastor or leader to give?That is a blessing!Though the saints in the Church must be inspired to give, make up your mind and purpose in your heart to be a giver. You don't give because others are giving or not giving. You give because your heart is in your giving.This is not to propound the concept that "give till you are hurt". That is why you must give as you have made up your mind and purposed in your own heart.The scripture says, God is unwilling to do without or abandon a cheerful prompt to do it giver." I know also, my God, that You test the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here to offer willingly to You." 1 Chronicles 29:17 (NKJV)The Lord doesn't just receive our giving, He proves the heart of your giving, whether it is of faith or not.This giving is not just money, but in any form of valuable donation.Cheerful (joyous prompt to do it) giver, is one who gives in faith.And the Lord takes pleasure in such giver.The word PLEASURE, is from the Hebrew word, “râtsâh”. It means to be pleased with; specifically be acceptable, be affectionate, delight in, be the favourable, liked the most.Awesome!God loves the world, and has an intimate relationship with those who are in Him. However, He takes special delight in those who give towards His work.You know the lady who anointed Jesus at Bethany, became an eternal delight. Jesus declared her as a memorial in the spread of the gospel. That is God taking special delight not just in your giving but in you. He prizes you above other things!Look at what she did:"Then Jesus went to Bethany, to the home of Simon, a man Jesus had healed of leprosy. A woman came into the house, holding an alabaster flask filled with fragrant and expensive oil. She walked right up to Jesus, and in a lavish gesture of devotion, she poured out the costly oil, and it cascaded over his head as he was at the table. When the disciples saw this, they were offended. “What a total waste!” they grumbled. “We could have sold it for a great deal of money and given it to the poor.” Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, “Why are you critical of this woman? She has done a beautiful act of kindness for me. You will always have someone poor whom you can help, but you will not always have me. When she poured the fragrant oil over me, she was preparing my body for burial. I promise you that as this wonderful gospel spreads all over the world, the story of her lavish devotion to me will also be mentioned in memory of her.” Now we are talking about this great act of giving this lady did today, just as Jesus declared.Also you will observe that, the scriptures we clear what she gave:It was not just any cheap oil or perfume.The scripture says, what she gave was an EXPENSIVE AND COSTLY OIL.The disciples thought it was a waste of money, but Jesus called it a LAVISH DEVOTION.Beloved, have you broken your alabaster box?THE LORD DELIGHTS IN SUCH GIVERS.Shalom.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; ; 2 Corinthians 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18; Matthew 26:6-13 ) WE PRAY:We pray that as we increase in grace, we give lavishly into the gospel of our Lord Jesus more and more. BIBLE READING:DAY 134: 2 Chronicles 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am an extravagant giver.- I don't give grudgingly, I give cheerfully.- I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving.- I give greatly into the Lord's work.- I am a son of consolation.- Because of me the work of God is done with ease.- I increase in the grace to give day by day.- I don't withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me.- I have the heart and the mind of a giver.- This week I give greatly into the Lord's assignment.- The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more.- I increase and abound in this giving grace massively.- I always at any given time give.- I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation) - I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work)- I am a self-sufficient giver by the grace of God. - I possess enough and require no aid or support to give.- I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 146 - THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 4 - MULTIPLIED RESOURCES
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 4 - MULTIPLIED RESOURCES" And [God] Who provides seed for the sower and bread for eating will also provide and multiply your [resources for] sowing and increase the fruits of your righteousness [[e]which manifests itself in active goodness, kindness, and charity]. 2 Corinthians 9:10 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) In as much as we give because we love the Lord, there are fruits of our giving.We have seen from previous discussions that, every cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver:1. Is supplied with more abundance of grace to give.It takes grace to give not not only huge bank balance. Just as we saw from 2 Corinthians 8, how the Macedonians gave willingly beyond their ability.Paul, the apostle admonished the brethren in Corinth to also increase in this grace of giving.Basically, it takes grace to give. When you set your affection on the Lord and make a decision to give, you stir up the grace to give.Now the moment you start giving, the Lord causes more grace to abound towards you, to make you sufficient enough to give more by grace. 2. Is ESTEEMED BY GOD. God delights in you and He is unwilling to do without you.Today we look at the THIRD benefit or fruits of CHEERFUL or JOYOUS PROMPT GIVING: 3. GOD PROVIDES AND MULTIPLIES YOUR RESOURCES.This is not to be confused with God supplying you with grace. For God to make all grace (every favor and earthly blessing) abound towards you, is to supply you with an inward quality which makes you live a blessed life or a life of blessing.Favor and earthly blessing can be experienced but not be seen with our physical eyes.Just as Jacob left His Father's house with a special blessing of the covenant, yet he didn't look like it. David was anointed King of Israel and yet he didn't look like a King (see 1 Samuel 16 -17). The super abounding grace (every favor and earthly blessing) God supplies is inherent.However, for God to provide and multiply your resources is a material increase. Have this expectation of faith that as you give, the Lord causes more resources to gravitate towards you." And [God] Who provides seed for the sower and bread for eating will also provide and multiply your [resources for] sowing and increase the fruits of your righteousness [which manifests itself in active goodness, kindness, and charity].Thus you will be enriched in all things and in every way, so that you can be generous, and [your generosity as it is] administered by us will bring forth thanksgiving to God." 2 Corinthians 9:10-11 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). Again, I have to emphasis this, God's goal of providing and multiplying your resources is to make you A MORE GENEROUS PERSON.The secret to attract or to be entrusted by God with more resources is to be a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it GIVER.As you are in business, the Lord favors you with more partners and clients.You enjoy special help and magnetize glorious things. This doesn't mean you may not be confronted by challenges, the point is you sail above it through faith.Beloved are you a CHEERFUL PROMPT TO DO IT GIVER?Shalom!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; ; 2 Corinthians 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18; Matthew 26:6-13 ) WE PRAY:That as we give we shall see the multiplication and increase of God in all we do. In the Name of Jesus! BIBLE READING:DAY 135: 2 Chronicles 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am an extravagant giver.- I don't give grudgingly, I give cheerfully.- I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving.- I give greatly into the Lord's work.- I am a son of consolation.- Because of me the work of God is done with ease.- I increase in the grace to give day by day.- I don't withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me.- I have the heart and the mind of a giver.- This week I give greatly into the Lord's assignment.- The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more.- I increase and abound in this giving grace massively.- The Lord is my provider and multiplies my resources.- I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation) - I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work)- I am a self-sufficient giver by the grace of God. - I possess enough and require no aid or support to give.- I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 147 - THE BLESSING OF GIVING 5
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 5" For the service that the ministering of this fund renders does not only fully supply what is lacking to the saints (God’s people), but it also overflows in many [cries of] thanksgiving to God. 2 Corinthians 9:12 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) Your trust in God and love for His assignment and the saints are demonstrated through your giving.Also, giving is a ministration in the Church. It renders a service which benefits the entire saints.We have previously discussed some benefits of giving such as:1. The Lord causes all grace to abound towards every cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver. 2. The Lord esteems, prizes above and is unwilling to do without a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver. 3. God provides and multiplies the resources of every cheerful giver. There are some more blessings in giving, however I will include some of these blessings to the ones we have already discussed: 4. YOUR GIVING SUPPLY WHAT IS LACKING TO THE SAINTS. This is refreshing!Your giving doesn't only cause you to increase in grace and also multiply your resources to give, it is a blessing to the saints.It doesn't just bless the saints in terms of their daily needs and necessities, but makes ministry possible.There are people who thought that, the giving which was administered to the saints in the other Churches (which includes the saints in Jerusalem), was just a giving to the poor for the sake of they being poor. But the goal was to help meet the needs of the saints, so that they can do the work of the ministry with ease.In those times, the brethren in Jerusalem for example were faced with persecutions etc, and they couldn't do ministry, participate in the fellowship of the Lord and even do business peacefully. So those who had supplied resources to the saints.There are some who even complain about Churches in this century using resources for Church buildings, and other materials.The sincere fact is that, the needs of today's Churches has increased beyond the needs of the Churches in the first century. Today's Church (the community of the saints) is not only faced with the challenge to: - Support the needy.- Contribute to the spread of the gospel by financing people who have dedicated their lives for the spread of the gospel.Today's church is also faced with the challenge:- To pay for meeting venue. And if they don't want to spend more on rent, they have to build according to the standard as expected by the government (for safety reasons)- There are so many other things done for the building up of the saints which come at a cost.Now the goal for the various projects of the Church, is to make it possible to equip and establish the saints and also to expand God's Kingdom mandate.This is to establish that, what the saints need is not just what to eat, drink, wear, where to sleep and work to do.The saints also need a place to meet and be built without any distraction.A cheerful prompt to do it giver doesn't complain when resources are used for other projects apart from giving to the poor.Remember when the woman broke the alabaster box to pour the oil on Jesus, the disciples saw it as waste. Nevertheless what she did was to prepare the Lord's body and this was to the benefit of the whole world. Giving to the poor is great but that is not the ultimate of our giving.The ultimate focus of our giving is:5. IT OVERFLOWS IN MANY (CRIES OF) THANKSGIVING TO GOD People are flooded with thanksgiving not just when they have food to eat. But also when there is real transformation of the gospel in their lives.See the thousands of souls giving thanks to God for their experience of transformation, because you support a Kingdom assignment.Each thanksgiving to God is reckoned in your account. " For because of the experience of this service, they glorify God that you submitted to the confession of The Gospel of The Messiah, and you became partners in your right of heirship with them and with every person" 2 Corinthians 9:13 (Aramaic Bible in Plain English) Oh hallelujah...Beloved celebrate every opportunity to give into the gospel.Because many lives will thank and glorify God because of you.Beloved are you a CHEERFUL PROMPT TO DO IT, GIVER?Selah.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; ; 2 Corinthians 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18; Matthew 26:6-13 ) WE PRAY:That through our giving many lives will be transformed unto the glory of God the Father. title: EPISODE 148 - THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 6 - THE LORD SUPPLIES ALL YOUR NEED
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE BLESSINGS OF GIVING 6 - THE LORD SUPPLIES ALL YOUR NEED " And my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Philippians 4:19 (NKJV) We have seen some few blessings of giving from the previous episodes. We have seen that: 1. The Lord causes all grace to abound towards every cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver. 2. The Lord esteems, prizes above and is unwilling to do without a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver. 3. God provides and multiplies the resources of every cheerful giver. 4. Your giving is a supply of what is lacking to the saints. 5. It overflows in many (cries of) thanksgiving to God and His glorification. The next blessing of giving I want us to look at, is that: THE LORD SHALL SUPPLY ALL YOUR NEED Oh hallelujah! I believe if you've been in Church meetings for a while, you might have heard this blessed utterance several times or at least twice if not once. This blessed utterance wasn't an automatic blessing to the saints. Paul, the apostle, made this declaration to the saints in Philippi because of how they have been a blessing to him, through their giving. Don't get me wrong, I don't mean to say God doesn't provide for His children. Or God waits for you to give before He provides for you. In as much as we are all blessed there is blessing in giving. Just as God loves us all, yet He loves (prizes above and is unwilling to do without) a prompt to do it giver. This is a unique expression of God's love. This love reveals how God takes interest in working with such givers. Though the Lord has blessed us with all spiritual blessings, there is such a thing as ALL GRACE (every favor and earthly blessing) which abounds towards you for being a giver. In this same light, God who provides for us all, makes unique supply for all the needs of those who give towards those who labour in the gospel. Let see the context of this blessing: " My heart overflows with joy when I think of how you showed your love to me by your financial support of my ministry. For even though you have so little, you still continue to help me at every opportunity. I’m not telling you this because I’m in need, for I have learned to be satisfied in any circumstance. I know what it means to lack, and I know what it means to experience overwhelming abundance. For I’m trained in the secret of overcoming all things, whether in fullness or in hunger. And I find that the strength of Christ’s explosive power infuses me to conquer every difficulty. You’ve so graciously provided for my essential needs during this season of difficulty. For I want you to know that the Philippian church was the only church that supported me in the beginning as I went out to preach the gospel. You were the only church that sowed into me financially, and when I was in Thessalonica, you supported me for well over a year. I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward. I now have all I need—more than enough—I’m abundantly satisfied! For I’ve received the gift you sent by Epaphroditus and viewed it as a sweet sacrifice, perfumed with the fragrance of your faithfulness, which is so pleasing to God! I am convinced that my God will fully satisfy every need you have, for I have seen the abundant riches of glory revealed to me through the Anointed One, Jesus Christ! And God our Father will receive all the glory and the honor throughout the eternity of eternities! Amen! Philippians 4:10-20 (TPT) From the above verses of the epistles to the Philippians, you will see why Paul spoke the blessings of divine supply. He blessed them because, they supported His ministry work of the gospel financially. Your financial support of the gospel is never in vain. There is always an abundant reward through the fruits of your giving. Sow financially into the gospel. Don't hold back whenever you get the opportunity to give. From the verses 10, Paul was excited to receive their giving through Epaphroditus. " My heart overflows with joy when I think of how you showed your love to me by your financial support of my ministry" And their giving was a great satisfaction to Paul (see verse 18). Your giving creates an overwhelming joy in the service of the Lord. And the Lord shall cause you to experience and enjoy the supply of your needs according to His riches in glory. Beloved are you a CHEERFUL PROMPT TO DO IT GIVER? Selah. In the name of Jesus.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 149 - FAITH HAS NO REVERSE GEAR
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency FAITH HAS NO REVERSE GEAR " But we are not those who draw back and are destroyed, but those who have faith and obtain life." Hebrews 10:39 (Holman Christian Standard Bible) The man of God Reinhard Bonnke made this profound statement, "A man of faith has no reverse gear."There is nothing we do in Christ without Faith.The scriptures are clear, "THE JUST SHALL LIVE BY FAITH" (Habakkuk 2:4; Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11; Hebrews 10:38). Who is the just?It is the new man in Christ.Are you born again in Christ?Then you are JUSTIFIED!Beloved, you did not just get saved by grace through faith in Christ Jesus.You live by faith.Whatever God wants you to do can be done by faith. Faith is the absolute confidence and total trust in God.Faith takes hold of what God has said in His word and runs with it.Faith does not look back and has no reverse gear.When Moses and the Israelites got to the red sea, they were troubled and began to complain. Especially when they saw the Egyptians army charging towards them.They sincerely didn't know what to do. They were scared of what shall befall them by the Egyptians.Yet God has a direction for them. In the midst of the chaos and impossible situation, look at God's response: " And the LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to Me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward." Exodus 14:15 (NKJV). Oh dear Lord Jesus!He then instructed Moses as to what to do. " But lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. And the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea." Exodus 14:16 (NKJV). This is an explicit example of "Faith without works is dead".God told Moses to move forward yet He instructed him on what to do as they move forward.Don't just sit in your room and be saying 'God will do it'.Great things don't happen that way.You have to take Holy Spirit inspired step. You need to act towards your miracle. Faith is forward! Faith doesn't look back. Faith doesn't reverse. Faith is taking inspired steps of God, for glorious manifestation. Look at David, when he confronted Goliath. " When Goliath started forward, David ran toward him." 1 Samuel 17:48 (Contemporary English Version). David didn't run backwards, He charged towards Goliath.He didn't try to step back to watch what Goliath was going to do. He took a step in the boldness and confidence in the Lord.Step forward to do whatever the Lord inspires you to do.Refuse to be careful. Refuse to be afraid. Refuse to be intimidated.Refuse to quit.When you quit, you cannot see what the Lord has said He will do through you.The three Hebrew boys did not change their minds. They stood on the grounds of their convictions.And thought, even if God doesn't come to save them, they will not bow! (Daniel 3:18).The woman with the issue of blood, did not stand afar to assume her healing will happen. She kept saying to herself if only I will touch His garment, I will be healed.As she was saying to herself she moved through the crowd, touched Jesus' garment and received her healing.Don't sit back to assume things will fall in place. Move in faith.Selah.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:( Mark 5:27-34; Daniel 3:17-18; 1 Samuel 17:40-58) WE PRAY:Declaring the victory of the Lord in every assignment He has entrusted to our care. And the courage in His Word to do great things unto the glory of the Lord. BIBLE READING:DAY 138: 2 Chronicles 12-15 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am justified by faith.- I live also by faith.- I refuse to quit.- I refuse to imitated.- I refuse to be careful.- I refuse to be afraid.- I act on the word.- I go all out on the word.- I am daring in faith.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 150 - IMBUE FOCUS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency IMBUE FOCUS " And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise. Philippians 4:8 (NLT) In this present age, mental health has become one of the common troubling conditions. And this is not only with the aged. Most young people are struggling with mental health issues. Most people seem to go through a lot of mental torture and struggle. This includes people who are born again in Christ. People who should put on the shield of faith, have been dominated or swamped by fear and troubles. These things are caused by little distractions and then they grow into unbearable conditions. Some steer off from their faith in Christ and the good works the Lord has ordained for them to walk in; by some seeds of uncertainty and distractions. In this present age of avalanche information and pluralistic worldviews. People are easily distracted and lack the stamina to maintain a strong composure. Most people don't know which the right way to think. They have become students of social media and not ardent disciples of Christ. Instead of being raised in the school of the Word and the Spirit, people are schooled by comedians and content creators who are interested in creating traffic on their platforms. You cannot function in faith beyond what you think, see with your mind, hear and speak. The adversary is after your faith. One of the things to do to maintain great faith is to imbue focus. The greatest strategy of the adversary is to distract your faith. The adversary distracts the focus of your faith with thoughts which are contrary to the word of God. This is why it is essential to fix your mind on the word of God and not what happens around you or how you feel. For the adversary to attack the faith of Job, he went after the things which he loved or are connected to him (his family, his livestock etc) For the adversary to attack you, he can even use the negative comments from family relatives, lecturers or teachers. Past negative and hurtful experiences, including social media trends, can sweep you off your joy. Until you intentionally imbue focus you will be a slave to the peripherals. You have a mandate to fulfill. Don't give room for any distractions, IMBUE FOCUS! Set your mind or heart, your thoughts and imaginations on: - what is true and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. - Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise. Where else can you access these beautiful things except the GOSPEL OF JESUS. Apart from the WORD OF GOD, you cannot access TRUTH. Don't start looking for bad reports and negative experiences in your life. Don't allow the experiences of some public figures define your life. None of their experiences qualifies to be an example for you. You are of God. If it is not praise worthy don't give your mind to it. There are more glorious things Christ has done for you, make them your meditation. Remember: that the sharing of your faith may become effective by the acknowledgment of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus. Philemon 1:6 (NKJV) Selah. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 3:18; 10:4-5; 1 Peter 1:13; 5:8; Proverbs 4:25; Hebrews 3:1; 12:1-2; Colossians 3:1; Philippians 3:12-14;) WE PRAY:In the name of Jesus, that nothing shall be strong enough to distract us. That by the supply of grace, we imbue divine focus in the midst of all distractions in this present age. BIBLE READING:DAY 139: 2 Chronicles 16-17 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I fix my mind on the word of God.- I don’t give room for any distraction, I imbue focus.- I don’t allow the experiences of others to define my life, my life is defined by the word of God.- I don’t pay attention to the peripherals.- I maintain my heart and mind on my mandate irrespective of staggering oppositions.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 151 - FAITH IS COURAGEOUS - (A RESOUND)
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency FAITH IS COURAGEOUS - (A RESOUND) ” Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go” Joshua 1:9 (NKJV) Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith. It is by faith we live and walk with God. Faith is our reality. The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them. Anything that has to bring glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith). Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said. It is knowing without any tittle of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do. Faith is audacious in its dealing. When you act in faith courage is seen. This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life. And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness. Serving others is greatness, however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation. A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss. Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father’s house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh. He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites, but felt enervated. Maybe you are reading this and feels you don’t have what it takes to do great things. When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community you can’t do anything great for the Lord. Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!! God specialises in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations. That is God. He will always use what it seem depleted to reveal His glory. He used, a young man who is least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory in Israel. He made mighty men out of men that were distresses, indebted, and discontented (1Samuel 22:2). Why must God use young 17 years old David, with no military experience to defeat Goliath with just a sling and stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53). To feed five thousand people, He used a little boys lunch pack of five bread and two fishes. This is audacity!!! God doesn’t choose the easy paths, He creates greatness out of what seem impossible. To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord. ” Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus.” Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward. You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room. You will look for places to show forth His glory and power. Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you. Until you take a step to do something great you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord. God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary! Selah To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAY:- THAT OUR HEARTS SHALL BE INFUSED WITH DIVINE COURAGE TO DO THAT WHICH HE HAS CALLED US TO DO.- THAT WE WILL BE STRENGTHENED TO THE END AND NOT LOOK BACK IN FEAR NO MATTER THE SITUATION. BIBLE READING:DAY 140: 2 Chronicles 18-20 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work. - I am strong and courageous.- I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary.- I live above this world.- I do the unimaginable.- I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me.- I am audacious.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!

title: EPISODE 152 - A HEART OF FAITH; HAS A MOUTH FULL OF THANKSGIVING
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency A HEART OF FAITH; HAS A MOUTH FULL OF THANKSGIVING ” having been rooted and being built up in Him, and being strengthened in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding with thanksgiving." Colossians 2:7 (Berean Literal Bible) When people want to see change in circumstances they pray.They declare the word of God. And exercises themselves in faith.But very few people know THANKSGIVING is a demonstration of faith.Beloved, you don't only thank God after a miracle. You practice thanksgiving even whiles you make supplication in prayer.To pray is a step of faith. It is confidence in God answering you as a loving Father.However, your prayer of faith will always be done with thanksgiving. " Do not be anxious or worried about anything, but in everything [every circumstance and situation] by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, continue to make your [specific] requests known to God." Philippians 4:6 (Amplified Bible). Wherever there is faith, thanksgiving abounds.Thanksgiving is the evidence which reveals the certainty of your faith.Let thanksgiving abound in your daily living.Thanksgiving does these things in you: 1. Through thanksgiving you acknowledge the Lord in your life and recognizes His blessing in everything you do. 2. Your faith and confidence in God becomes effective; thus, you build an irrevocable confidence that you will experience or see the manifestation of what the Lord has said. 3. Thanksgiving causes you to live in the glorious realm of joy, far above anxiety and sorrow. It has a way of establishing and overwhelming you with restfulness in the midst of chaos. See how Jesus demonstrated power through thanksgiving: " Then Jesus said, “Make the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand. And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted. So when they were filled, He said to His disciples, “Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost.” Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten. Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said, “This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world.” John 6:10-14 (NKJV) Jesus blessing the loaves and fish with thanksgiving, was able to fed the multitudes and had an overflow.Concerning Lazarus' resurrection, Jesus didn't have to utter prayer of supplication or petition. He said, " Father, I thank You that You have heard Me." John 11:41 (NKJV). That is faith!!!Before He got to Bethany, Jesus had already made the pronouncement of faith. At the tomb, He didn't have to speak many words and pray for a miracle to happen.
