He gave thanks, as an affirmation that the Father has heard Him.This was God showing us how to act in faith.Thanksgiving is the highest demonstration of faith.As you pray, as you declare the word, and as you take inspired steps of faith towards that goal, BE THANKFUL.Beloved, always abound in thanksgiving, for it is FAITH.ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 5:20; Colossians 3:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:18; Psalm 95:1-3) WE PRAY:Thanking the Lord for the abundance of His grace supplied unto us and the great miracles He has worked in our midst and the glorious things we are going to see this month and this year. BIBLE READING:DAY 141: 2 Chronicles 21-23 DECLARE THESE WORDS- With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.- In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.- I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.- I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.- My mouth is full of thanksgiving.- Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 153 - DON'T TREMOR AT OPPOSITION 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DON'T TREMOR AT OPPOSITION 1” For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries" 1 Corinthians 16:9 (KJV) From the conception of God's greatest revelation (Christ) till today, the expression of the Kingdom mandate in this world has not been a walk in the park.The workings of God's eternal will have always been opposed by the forces of darkness.God hid the seed of the gospel in the generations of Israel.When He called them, He separated them unto Himself and entrusted His oracle to them, it became obvious that God had something up His sleeves among the Israelites. For that matter, the adversary set the nations up against Israel. Why do you think there were several attempts by Kings, and even some noble men in authority to wipe out the Israelites or the Jews to be precise?God narrowed His plan to fulfill the purpose of the Kingdom through Abraham (Genesis 12), Isaac, Jacob, Israelites and then Jews.His plan was fully rooted through the physical conception of Christ, His birth and earth walk.In the resurrection of Jesus, God's plan germinated and began to bear fruits when the Church was born.The adversary attempted to destroy God's plan and purpose at each stage.This is why the Church the Lord established was also mandated to confront and prevail against the gates of hades (see Matthew 16:18).He again admonished His disciples saying: "...you will be hated by everyone because of my name..." (Matthew 10:22). Which means you should not be surprised when you are confronted by challenges because of the gospel.Men will always oppose God's Kingdom plan. " What fools the nations are to rage against the Lord! How strange that men should try to outwit God! For a summit conference of the nations has been called to plot against the Lord and his Messiah, Christ the King. “Come, let us break his chains,” they say, “and free ourselves from all this slavery to God.” Psalm 2:1-3 (TLB) However there is a glorious news: DARKNESS CANNOT PUT OUT THE BLAZING LIFE-LIGHT! (John 1:5, Message Bible). See also the posture of God in Psalm 2: " But God in heaven merely laughs! He is amused by all their puny plans. And then in fierce fury he rebukes them and fills them with fear." Psalm 2:4-5 (TLB) Oh Hallelujah.As you take a step to spread the gospel, you will have confrontations, but don't tremor.Maintain your bold confidence in God because He is with you.Take advantage of every opportunity to spread the gospel.ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Isaiah 66:5; Luke 6:22; John 15:21; Acts 19:8; 1 Corinthians 15:2; 2 Corinthians 1:8-10) WE PRAY:That no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us. BIBLE READING:DAY 142: 2 Chronicles 24-26 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am a terror to the forces of darkness.- I conquer and win more territories for the Lord.- The Lord is with me therefore I fear no evil.- I don’t walk in fear.- No matter the oppositions I face, I refuse to give in.- I remain strong in the Lord.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 154 - DON'T TREMOR AT OPPOSITION 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DON'T TREMOR AT OPPOSITION 2” For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries" 1 Corinthians 16:9 (KJV) Yesterday, we established the main intent of the opposition of the gospel.Therefore beloved, you should not be surprised when you are confronted by challenges because of the gospel.Men whose eyes have been blinded by the adversary will always oppose God's Kingdom plan.The more you see darkness in a place, there more there is the need for the spread of the gospel. Wherever you go or move to, identify opportunities to share the gospel.This was something Jesus, and the early saints utilized a lot. And even in our day, those who are doing well with the gospel, have sharpened their skills to identify doors of opportunities, to spread the gospel. Look at this:" And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people. But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd. Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few" Matthew 9:35-37 (KJV) Do you see it, the moment our Lord Jesus saw the multitudes He saw the opportunity or the need to get souls saved.When you see people you must identify the need and the opportunity to spread the gospel. Wherever you go or find yourself there are opportunities to get many saved.Don't be threatened by an impending opposition when you identify a door of opportunity. Be determined to make the most of such opportunities, as the Holy Spirit inspires you.You will see from the opening verse that, Paul did not fret, he was ready to stay in other to utilize the great door which was opened unto him. " Regardless, I will remain in Ephesus until the feast of Pentecost. There’s an amazing door of opportunity standing wide open for me to minister here, even though there are many who oppose and stand against me." 1 Corinthians 16:8-9 (TPT). He decided to stay for more days in Ephesus, to minister there, even though there were many who opposed and stood against him.We will later find out that, the gospel so much grew in the city of Ephesus and prevailed. (See Acts 19:1-20)Always have this in mind: DARKNESS CANNOT PUT OUT THE BLAZING LIFE-LIGHT! (John 1:5, Message Bible).Light doesn't automatically shine in dark places; you must intentionally cause it to shine.Jesus said, "Let your light so shine" (Matthew 5:16). The purpose of light is to shine in darkness. Greater lights are needed to shine in the darkest places.The dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty, thus, we must invade and saturate such places with the blazing life-light.We don't crawl backwards just because of the violence of darkness. The life-light is the love-light and it is the greatest force of victory.Beloved, take advantage of every opportunity to spread the gospel without fear of opposition; for the Lord is with you!ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Isaiah 66:5; Luke 6:22; John 15:21; Acts 19:8; 1 Corinthians 15:2; 2 Corinthians 1:8-10) WE PRAY:That no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us. BIBLE READING:DAY 144: 2 Chronicles 27-28 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I am a terror to the forces of darkness.- I conquer and win more territories for the Lord.- The Lord is with me therefore I fear no evil.- I don’t walk in fear.- No matter the oppositions I face, I refuse to give in.- I remain strong in the Lord.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 155 - LEARN TO MINISTER UNTO THE LORD 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LEARN TO MINISTER UNTO THE LORD 1 ”As they ministered to the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Now separate to Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them." Acts 13:2 (NKJV) Our Heavenly Father, has brought us into an intimate relationship with Him through Christ. Our relationship with the Father is not just centered on our needs. There are people who commune with God when they are in need of help. They relate with God as though He is their butler. Without doubt, our Heavenly Father is our provider and great help but not our butler. One truth is that when you physically see God, you will be astonished and humbled in godly reverence. God doesn't demand worship from us, He made us for fellowship, however, the revelation of Him will lead you into worship. You minister to the Lord through worship, praise or exaltation. It is your response to who God is. In Christ, you are made a PRIEST (Revelation 1:6). As a Priest in Christ, you have a responsibility to serve the Lord or administer unto the Lord and then minister God unto people. As you minister to the Lord you are infused with God's richness, for you to express Him unto others (we will look more into this later). All through the scriptures, you will find out that, the men who were greatly used by God, had a practice of ministering unto the Lord. Don't be a person who is in a hurry to minister unto others, when you have not first ministered unto the Lord. Develop the habit of always lifting your hands in praise and worship to the Lord. Thank the Lord for who He is and the specific things He has done and other greater things He is going to do for you, with you and through you. Hallelujah To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Samuel 3:1; Deuteronomy 10:8; Ezekiel 44:15-16)WE PRAY:With our hands lifted unto the Lord declaring His loving kindness, and praising Him for who He is. BIBLE READING:DAY 145: 2 Chronicles 29-31 DECLARE THESE WORDS- As a priest in Christ I minister first unto the Lord.- As I minister unto the Lord I am empowered.- My strength is in ministering unto the Lord.- I permit nothing to distract me from ministering unto the Lord daily,- Whether in prayer, worship or praise, I minister unto the Lord with my hands lifted up.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 156 - INCREASE IN STRENGTH AMIDST PRESSURE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency INCREASE IN STRENGTH AMIDST PRESSUREFor they all were trying to make us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done.” Now therefore, O God, strengthen my handsNehemiah 6:9 (NKJV) Some few days ago, I shared with you NOT TO TREMOR AT OPPOSITION.In that discussion, I established that, as long as you are involved in God's agenda you will be opposed.We see in the above verse how those who opposed the building of the walls of Jerusalem attempted to make Nehemiah and his team afraid.One of the greatest cause of weakness in the pursuit of God's purpose is fear.The moment you become afraid that you will fail or will not be able to complete the task, you weaken yourself from doing what God wants you to do.The more you exercise confidence that with God you shall do valiantly, the more you increase in strength.When you consider the seemingly pressure or the oppositions you face or may face in the pursuit of purpose, you will stagger in faith.There will be times you may not have support from your best friends or the people you trust.But that shouldn't derail you.Look at Paul (the apostle's) testimony: " At my first defense no one stood with me, but all forsook me. May it not be charged against them. But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that the message might be preached fully through me, and that all the Gentiles might hear. Also I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion." 2 Timothy 4:16-17 (NKJV) Glory to God!!!This is the certainty of our faith!!!No matter the pressure or opposition, beloved, we turn to God.It is by the strength of God you will prevail not your human strength nor intelligence.When you turn away from the pressure and you turn to God you increase in strength.Just as Nehemiah did: "For they all were trying to make us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done.”Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands"Nehemiah 6:9 (NKJV) Nehemiah chose to pray to God for strength. That was all he needed to complete the work.Now look at what happened: " So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days. And it happened, when all our enemies heard of it, and all the nations around us saw these things, that they were very disheartened in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was done by our God"Nehemiah 6:15-16 (NKJV) When the strength of God is supplied to you can only have the God kind of results.Increase in strength!!!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 138:3; Psalm 28:7; Psalm 46:1; Daniel 10:19) WE PRAY:Oh Lord, strengthen our hands for this work you have committed to us that we will not stagger no matter the opposition or pressure that will confront us. BIBLE READING:DAY 146: 2 Chronicles 32-34 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I don’t stagger in faith.- By the strength of God, I prevail.- With God I do valiantly.- I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day.- I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 157 - PRAYER IS YOUR FIRST STRATEGY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency PRAYER IS YOUR FIRST STRATEGY" Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church." Acts 12:5 (NKJV) What is your first response to challenges or pressure from opposition?Time and time again in scriptures, you will find God's people responding to challenging situations with prayer.Don't give anyone room to underestimate the effectual workings of prayer.One of the evidence that you have confidence in God's ability, is how you respond to situations through prayer.I believe you took time to pay attention to the opening verse?Look at the full story: " Now about that time Herod the king stretched out his hand to harass some from the church. Then he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to seize Peter also. Now it was during the Days of Unleavened Bread. So when he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of soldiers to keep him, intending to bring him before the people after Passover.Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church. And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were [keeping the prison. Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, “Arise quickly!” And his chains fell off his hands. Then the angel said to him, “Gird yourself and tie on your sandals”; and so he did. And he said to him, “Put on your garment and follow me.” So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision. When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.And when Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.” Acts 12:1-11 (NKJV) — Herod decided to harass the Church, so he killed James the brother of John.— He saw the people were pleased so he arrested Peter, and purposed to kill him after Passover.— Nevertheless the Church responded to this situation differently.We didn't see the response of the Church when James was arrested. It was likely they reacted in fear and only went to hide.But when Peter was arrested, the Church responded with earnest, constant PRAYERS.The earnest prayers of the brethren dispatched an angel to release Peter from the prison. Considering the soldiers assigned to guard Peter in the prison and even outside the prison, it will only take a supernatural hand to deliver him.No matter the challenge, get into prayers.In the place of prayer:— you will receive strength.— your faith will be strengthened.— you will receive direction as to what to do.— you will see visions— the great help and answers of God will be released.Paul said to the Philippians:" Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus” Philippians 4: 6-7 (NKJV). Don't cry, don't be anxious, don't worry, don't fret, ONLY PRAY!Nehemiah, when he was opposed, he prayed to God.Daniel, when himself and his friends' life were under threat, they prayed to receive understanding of the King's dream.David prayed when he was under threat.Jesus prayed when He was overwhelmed by the burden of his crucifixion and He received strength.It took prayer for Esther, Modecai and the Jews to reverse Haman's plot against them.Beloved, refuse to be troubled, get into prayer.The saints were together praying until they saw Peter at home. " And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying" Acts 12:12 Pray earnestly until you have really prayed. Pray until you are fully convinced in your spirit that it is settled. Pray until you see the victory not until you feel tired.It means you may feel tired but you have to continue earnestly in prayer. GET INTO PRAY! To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(Matthew 18:19; Isaiah 62:6-7; Esther 4:16; Daniel 2:15-18; Luke 22:39-46) WE PRAY:That by the mighty hand of the Lord we shall see great victory in all situations, no matter the pressure and opposition. BIBLE READING:DAY 147: 2 Chronicles 35-36 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I don’t stagger in faith.- By the strength of God, I prevail.- With God I do valiantly.- I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day.- I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 158 - PRAY IN THE SPIRIT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency PRAY IN THE SPIRIT" But you, my delightfully loved friends, constantly and progressively build yourselves up on the foundation of your most holy faith by praying every moment in the Spirit." Jude 1:20 (TPT). If you have been following the for sometime now, you will find this statement very common:We do what God tells us to do by faith!You will stagger, give up or maintain a strong confidence in God according to your faith.We win and exercise our victory in Christ amidst opposition by Faith.  (1 John 5:4)We grow and increase in faith through the ministry of the word. (Romans 10:17). And faith operates by the word of God not by vim or some philosophy. Without the word of God, there is no potent faith. To act in faith is to act on the Word. " And since we have the same spirit of faith, according to what is written, “I believed and therefore I spoke,” we also believe and therefore speak," 2 Corinthians 4:13 (NKJV). What you have believed is what God have said, and what God have said is His WORD. Faith only speaks what God have said.However, from Jude 20, we see how you have to build yourself up on your most holy faith: " But you, my delightfully loved friends, constantly and progressively build yourselves up on the foundation of your most holy faith by praying every moment in the Spirit" Jude 1:20 (TPT). There are moments and situations where you may feel weak, discouraged, and even dull in faith.However, you can constantly and progressively build yourself up:PRAY IN THE SPIRIT!To pray in the spirit is also to pray in other tongues.It's interesting how people who don't pray in tongues mock the effectual workings of praying in the spirit.Beloved, it builds you up in faith, when you pray in tongues every moment.As you pray in tongues you pray to God and speak mysteries. You decode spiritual things in the spirit as you pray in the spirit.When there is a moment where you feel so much pressure, and it seem you don't have the right words to speak; BELOVED, don't cry nor complain.Don't feel helpless when you are overwhelmed by situations. There is a way forward: PRAY IN THE SPIRIT.As you pray you make supply of spiritual strength and you stir up the anointing of the Holy Spirit in you. You also charge up yourself in faith.Your spirit rises higher and higher in faith, like an edifice.The more you pray in the spirit, the more the Spirit of the Lord supplies your spirit with the right words to declare.As you pray in the spirit, the Holy Spirit through your spirit broods over your mind, will and emotions.Therefore, the more you pray, the more you take hold of the present word of God. And as the present word or the rhema of God, wells up in your spirit, it saturates your mind, aligns your will to God, and channels your emotions and desires.Because the rhema has soaked your entire being, it comes forth without doubt.At this point, the present word or the rhema of God, will gush forth with a force and the ability of God to produce effectual results. COME ON!WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?SEIZE THIS MOMENT TO PRAY IN TONGUES NOW.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 14:2,414-15,18; Ephesians 6:18; Acts 10:44-46) WE PRAY:That our hearts will catch the very present word of God concerning every situation as we pray in the spirit. BIBLE READING:DAY 147: Ezra 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I don’t complain nor cry, I pray.- I give no place to the adversary.- As I pray in the spirit, I catch the very present word of God for my situation.- I don’t walk in doubt, fear or anxiety because through praying in the spirit I receive rhema.- Through praying in the spirit, I align my heart, will, mind, emotions and desires to the Will of God for me.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 159 - MAINTAIN AN ABSOLUTE CONFIDENCE IN GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MAINTAIN AN ABSOLUTE CONFIDENCE IN GOD" Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?" John 11:40 (TPT). There is a reason the Lord keep reminding you of things pertaining to your faith walk with Him.Anytime the Lord bring admonishments your way, He is establishing a certain consciousness in you.If you have been reading with , you must know that your time of harvest is here.When the children of Israel were in slavery, the only message they needed was "DELIVERANCE". But that wasn't the message they needed when they were entering the promise land. At that point they needed to be Conscious of the presence of the Lord and be strong and courageous. And that was the message the Lord was administering to Joshua.Whenever the adversary sees you stepping into greater heights, he attempts to weaken your confidence in God.Understand that God doesn't bring challenges your way to prove your faith. God only inspires you to do great things. The adversary uses challenges or negative situations to distract or stop you from doing the things God wants you to do.This is why you must maintain absolute confidence in God. No challenge should be big enough to move you away from God. No challenge should be big enough to make you doubt God. Hold on strongly to what God have said.In the story of Jesus raising Lazarus from dead, you will see two instances of faith.Remember faith is your response to God's Word.We are going to look at how two sisters (Martha and Mary) responded to Jesus.One day Lazarus (a brother of Martha and Mary, and a loving friend to Jesus) became very sick to the point of death. "So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, our brother Lazarus, the one you love, is very sick. Please come!”When He (Jesus) heard this, he said, “ This sickness will not end in death for Lazarus, but will bring glory and praise to God. This will reveal the greatness of the Son of God by what takes place.” (See John 11:3-4) This was the foundational word which got Lazarus raised from the dead.Jesus said this sickness is not unto death but unto the glory and praise of God.Again, it doesn't mean God afflicts people with sickness and diseases to show His glory, but rather, when the adversary strikes people with any infirmities, because of God's healing power, many sees God's glory and give praise to Him.Now Mary and Martha were to hold on to that message and allow it to define their composure.Nevertheless, Martha for example argued and doubted the decision of Jesus to roll away Lazarus' tomb.Look at this, John 11:38-40 (TPT):" Then Jesus, with intense emotions, came to the tomb—a cave with a stone placed over its entrance. Jesus told them, “Roll away the stone.”Then Martha said, “But Lord, it’s been four days since he died—by now his body is already decomposing!”Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?”I believe Jesus had to look at her with astonishment, because prior to this time He had said a lot to Martha and Mary about He being the resurrection and the life.Martha was not holding on to the Words of Jesus. Until you hold on to Word of God, you will not demonstrate absolute confidence in God."So they rolled away the heavy stone. Jesus gazed into heaven and said, “Father, thank you that you have heard my prayer, for you listen to every word I speak. Now, so that these who stand here with me will believe that you have sent me to the earth as your messenger, I will use the power you have given me.” Then with a loud voice Jesus shouted with authority: “Lazarus! Come out of the tomb!”Then in front of everyone, Lazarus, who had died four days earlier, slowly hobbled out—he still had grave clothes tightly wrapped around his hands and feet and covering his face! Jesus said to them, “Unwrap him and let him loose.” From that day forward many of those who had come to visit Mary believed in him, for they had seen with their own eyes this amazing miracle! John 11:41-45 (TPT).Oh hallelujah.Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. Don't look at the challenges to doubt God. Make the Word of the Lord your focus and you will see the manifestation of His glory.ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(John 11; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY:That no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us. BIBLE READING:DAY 148: Ezra 3-4 DECLARE THESE WORDS- My time of harvest is here and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary.- I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said.- No challenge is big enough to move me away from God.- I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God.- I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God.- Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God.- I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 160 - MAINTAIN AN ABSOLUTE CONFIDENCE IN GOD 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MAINTAIN AN ABSOLUTE CONFIDENCE IN GOD 2" Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?" John 11:40 (TPT). Until you learn to esteem God's Word in your life, your focus towards God may be impaired.There are times, because you may feel disappointed that God didn't do things as you expected, you begin to doubt His word.God always has a bigger picture for your life, therefore, you don't put Him in a box or set boundaries for Him.No challenge should be big enough to move you away from God. No challenge should be big enough to make you doubt God.From yesterday, we took a look at the story of Jesus raising Lazarus from the dead.From the beginning of John 11, we can see that Jesus, received a message concerning Lazarus' health condition. And knowing how Jesus loved Mary, Martha and Lazarus, they were expecting a different response from Jesus, than what happened. "One day Lazarus became very sick to the point of death. So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, our brother Lazarus, the one you love, is very sick. Please come!”When he heard this, he said, “This sickness will not end in death for Lazarus, but will bring glory and praise to God. This will reveal the greatness of the Son of God by what takes place.” Now even though Jesus loved Mary, Martha, and Lazarus, he remained where he was for two more days. Finally, on the third day, he said to his disciples, “Come. It’s time to go to Bethany. John 11:2-7 (TPT). Now when Jesus arrived, His friend Lazarus was dead and buried for four days.Now, clearly Mary and Martha were disappointed Jesus didn't come early. And they all expressed their disappointment uniquely.But let me draw your attention to a similar situation.The story of the Roman Centurion, he had a servant who was sick and requested Jesus to speak a word instead of visiting him. (See Matthew 8:5-13).Mary and Martha could have demonstrated similar faith, to see their brother healed.Well, they were disappointed instead, and we see Martha, responding wrongly to Jesus.Don't allow your experiences (which may also include your disappointments) assumptions, and limited knowledge, define your response to God's word.To exercise an absolute confidence in God's Word, take God's word as it is. Don't read your preconceived motive into His word.Martha went to meet Jesus when He was approaching their village: " Martha said to Jesus, “My Lord, if only you had come sooner, my brother wouldn’t have died. But I know that if you were to ask God for anything, he would do it for you.” Jesus told her, “Your brother will rise and live.” She replied, “Yes, I know he will rise with everyone else on resurrection day.” John 11:21-24 (TPT). Martha, believed in Jesus at the level of what she has experienced not according to the Word of the Lord.She has seen and heard Jesus healed the sick. However, she didn't know Jesus as the resurrection and the life.When Jesus said, your brother shall rise, she responded with head knowledge: "Yes, I know he will rise with everyone else on resurrection day.". However, to walk in absolute confidence in God's word, you must respond to God, with your heart.This was why even after Jesus had explained that He is the resurrection and the life, Martha had to make an argument about the decomposition of Lazarus' body.She was still responding to Jesus according to her head knowledge. Faith is responding to God according to His word and not by how you feel.Stand and act consistently according to the WORD and not your mere experience.SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org DIG DEEPER:(John 11; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY:That we will not allow our experiences, assumptions, and limited knowledge, define our response to God's word and the manifestation of God’s word in our lives. BIBLE READING:DAY 148: Ezra 5-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS- My time of harvest is here and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary.- I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said.- No challenge is big enough to move me away fromGod.- I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God.- I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God.- Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God.- I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focusOh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: Episode 161 - CALLED TO LEAD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency CALLED TO LEADLet no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity. 1 Timothy 4:12 (NKJV) One of the major challenges you find in our society today is true leadership. Leaders define the state and direction of the society. The lack of godly leadership even from the family level, determines the state of the society. Leaders help the community or the society to find the right strategic compass. In Jesus, we saw the true meaning and essence of Kingdom Leadership. And Kingdom-centred leadership was what our Lord knew the society needed. It was part of His heartbeat."And seeing the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and downcast like sheep without a shepherd" Matthew 9:36 (Legacy Standard Bible). When Jesus saw the multitudes He knew their challenge was the lack of Kingdom leaders, who will truly care for their state. Ultimately, Jesus came not just as the Life-giver, but also as the true and great Kingdom shepherd (leader) who will bring us into fulfillment of the eternal purpose of God. And before His ascension, He mandated the saints to make disciples of all the nation (Matthew 28:19). This was a call to leadership. As the true meaning of Kingdom leadership, He made disciples (students) and now, He mandated His disciples to go forth to also demonstrate true Kingdom leadership; by making disciples. He sent His disciples to go into the world to lead the nations. When you come into Christ, you have a CALL TO LEAD YOUR GENERATION. Very few people are conscious and determined to fulfill this great call to leadership.I love what the author of Hebrews has to say:"You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again..." Hebrews 5:12 (NLT). As believers we have to mature and take up the responsibility to LEAD. This was what Paul said to Timothy:"Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity." 1 Timothy 4:12 (KJV). The key word is EXAMPLE, it's from the greek word, TUPOS, which means, style or resemblance; specifically a sampler (type) that is a model (for imitation), a fashion, figure, form, or a pattern. (See Strong's Bible Dictionary). This point us to the function of true Kingdom Leadership. Thus, to be an example is to be a kingdom leader. You don't have to allow anyone to despise you as a youth. Instead, be their leader, be the one everyone will look up to. Be a leading example in word, in manner of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.No wonder Jesus said, you are the light of the world and the salt of the earth. You have a call of God on your life to LEAD YOUR GENERATION, take a STEP TO MAKE IT HAPPEN.YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON... Selah To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org  DIG DEEPER:(Matthew 5:13-16;Ezra 7:10; 1 Peter 2:9; Psalm 78:72; Romans 12:3-8;)WE PRAY:- Thanking the Lord for the privilege to lead our generation unto His Kingdom agenda.- That we will yield ourselves to the training that will make us effective and productive Kingdom leaders. BIBLE READING:DAY 149: Ezra 8DECLARE THESE WORDS- I have been called to lead my generation.- I am conscious of this calling.- I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call.- I refuse to be distracted.- I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth.- Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement.- I am the centre of attraction in my generation.- I am a satisfaction to many.- I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world.- I AM A GLOBAL ICON. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!    [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 162 - YOU ARE SENT BY THE LORD TO LEAD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE SENT BY THE LORD TO LEAD"Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest" Matthew 9:38 (Legacy Standard Bible) As New Creation in Christ, you have the mandate to lead your generation. You are called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose.This call to leadership is an answered prayer.Let's take a look what Jesus said: "And seeing the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and downcast like sheep without a shepherd. Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest." Matthew 9:36-38 (LSB) When Jesus saw the multitudes, He saw the deep challenge of divine leadership.They were as sheep without a shepherd.And asked that prayers should be made to the Lord of the harvest to send more workers or labourers. These workers are going to serve as shepherds to give direction and purpose to the multitudes.However, they have to be sent by the Lord of the harvest.Now as many of us in Christ, have been appointed by the Lord to be Kingdom ministers or kingdom leaders to lead the nations unto God's agenda.That is why in Christ:1. You have been made a king and a Priest (Revelation 1:6).2. A light bearer (Matthew 5:15, MSG).3. You are made righteous. To be made the righteousness of God in Christ, is not only for you to have right standing with God. To be made righteous is for you to reign as a king. Righteousness is the scepter of the Kingdom. (Hebrews 1:8).As many that receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life as Kings (Romans 5:17).Leadership is a core element of your newness of life. You are not called to live for yourself and to satisfy your own desires. You are called into Christ, given authority, to function as a Kingdom Leader, where you influence many unto divine purpose.Beloved you didn't choose the Lord, He chose you and appointed you to go forth and bear fruit.Live as one sent by God to lead His generation.Shalom YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON...SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.orgDIG DEEPER:(Matthew 5:13-16;Ezra 7:10; 1 Peter 2:9; Psalm 78:72; Romans 12:3-8;) WE PRAY:- That we will give ourselves wholly to whichever assignment or task the Lord has assigned unto us to lead our generation. BIBLE READING:DAY 150: Ezra 9-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I have been called to lead my generation.- I am conscious of this calling.- I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call.- I refuse to be distracted.- I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth.- Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement.- I am the centre of attraction in my generation.- I am a satisfaction to many.- I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world.- I AM A GLOBAL ICON.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 163 - REAL LEADERS INTERCEDE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency REAL LEADERS INTERCEDE" The people then cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD..." Numbers 11:2 (New American Standard Bible) As the light of the world, the Lord has called you and sent you to give direction and meaning to lives.As New Creation in Christ, you have the mandate to lead your generation. You are called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose.The first step in fulfilling the assignment of leadership, is to entrust the assignment to God.The core element of every leader’s assignment is people. Every leader is sent out by God to provide answers to the people, irrespective of their condition or needs.However, kingdom leaders are sent men, and are not to be GOD to the people. Leaders must therefore see themselves as intercessors.You shape the destinies of people by first praying to the One who hasFOREORDAINED THEIR DESTINIES.Whenever the people of Israel turned away from God, or blamed Moses for their condition (instead of taking responsibility for their fears and anxiety); Moses' reaction was to intercede for the people.Moses didn't lead the people of Israel by his own strength. He led Israel through the power of Intercession.To intercede is to commit the burdens of your community, or the institution of people you are leading to God.The adversary sought to destroy lives and destinies, and your strategy is to go into prayer of intercession and also take up intercessory projects which shall help shape the lives entrusted to you.Jesus said: " And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren" Luke 22:31-32 (KJV). As a leader, instead of complaining, you stand in the gap for the people entrusted to you by the Lord.To lead your generation, is not to lord yourself over them, but to serve. And the first step you have to take in the service of others is to intercede for them BE AN INTERCESSOR TODAY.YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON...SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.orgDIG DEEPER:(Matthew 5:13-16; Numbers 21:7; Numbers 11:1-2; Romans 1:8-10; 1 Thessalonians 1:2-3; Philippians 1:3-4) WE PRAY:- That we will continually stand in the gap for the people the Lord has entrusted to us. BIBLE READING:DAY 151: Nehemiah 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I have been called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose.- I don’t complain about the people the Lord has entrusted to me, rather I intercede for them.- I serve my generation first through intercession.- I don’t lead by my own strength, I lead by the strength of the Lord.- Through my intercession for the people the Lord has entrusted to me, their lives are directed and shaped unto purpose.- I am an intercessor.- I AM A GLOBAL ICON.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 164 - GO FOR THE TARGET
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GO FOR THE TARGET" I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus" Philippians 3:14 (KJV) Do you know why very few people are doing great things for God?Most people easily settle for less and also choose the easy path. Most people are not willing to share in the desire of the Lord.They live with the mantra: "Whatever will be, will be" , therefore there is no need to press on when things seem impossible.But that is not faith-living.Have you ever failed to do what you are instructed to do in Church and you think God understands that you failed ?Or you failed to act on the Word of God and you think He still understands?Sometimes even before you make that mistake or decide not to honour that instruction, you yield to the idea that God will understand your choice.Is it to comfort yourself for that wrong or use that to affirm your excuses?How do you think God understands?And what do you mean by "God understands"?As in, God is ready to go against His Word and the governing light of His economy?There is nothing you can do in God without your bold step of faith.David didn't automatically defeat Goliath. He has to take a bold step. Complacency has no space in the Kingdom. You have to press on to the price of high calling.Whenever God entrust a target into your heart, you have to invest prayer without excusesWhen you fail to pray, don't make the excuse that, "oh though I have failed to pray, God understands my situation"."Oh God understands if I don't preach in the bus, or don't win a soul in the school.""God understands if i don't excel in the workplace.""There is always another time, if I failed today, I will get it right tomorrow and God understands".The more you think this way, the more you keep procrastinating.Yes, God understands right?So you justify your failure and laziness with:"Don't try too hard to complete the task you are expected to do, after all you can't do everything till you depart from Earth.""Take it easy, God understands your situation. It is not by force to wake up early to pray or start your day with prayer.""If you miss Church meetings, there is no harm, God understands""Just live your life and do what you feel you can do. God understands and He will not kill you for not doing it.""God knows your heart. What you are able to do and not able to do doesn't really matter to God, but the condition of your heart."Does God truly understand things the way we claim He understands?Does God water down His plans and assignment for us because of our situations or challenges?Does God even have standards and does He uphold His standards?Some of these thoughts may seem justifiable but understand that in as much as GOD LOVES YOU, HE ESTEEMS HIS WORD, HIS PLANS AND PURPOSES.God will not change His plans because of your excuses, challenges and situations.God will not pause His eternal plan to wait for you to resolve your challenges.Though our walk with God is not mechanical but essentially organic, it is not without a well established system.Don't be quick to quote this: "This High Priest of ours understands our weaknesses..." Hebrews 4:15 (NLT) "For we do not have a high priest incapable of sympathizing with our weaknesses..." (NET Bible) And then arrive at this conclusion:"You see there it goes, Our High Priest sympathizes with our weaknesses. Don't trouble yourself, if you can you can, if you can't you can't.""Every one has a weakness and God understands."Really? Is that the implication of this verse?Don't be too quick to end there. Get this, the LORD TRULY understands our weaknesses! Glory to God.However get it in perspective."Inasmuch then as we [believers] have a great High Priest who has [already ascended and] passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession [of faith and cling tenaciously to our absolute trust in Him as Savior]. For we do not have a High Priest who is unable to sympathize and understand our weaknesses and temptations, but One who has been tempted [knowing exactly how it feels to be human] in every respect as we are, yet without [committing any] sin.Therefore let us [with privilege] approach the throne of grace [that is, the throne of God’s gracious favor] with confidence and without fear, so that we may receive mercy [for our failures] and find [His amazing] grace to help in time of need [an appropriate blessing, coming just at the right moment]. for he faced all of the same testings we do, yet he did not sin." Hebrews 4:14-16 (AMP) SURE contextually, this chapter has an extensive matter discussed than what we are looking into here.Nevertheless, the above verses provides the answer that puts our thoughts in the right perspective.Jesus being our High Priest: a. Sympathizes and understands our weaknesses and temptations.b. He is able to sympathize and understand because He faced what we face as men.c. And He did not fail when He faced these temptations or challenges.d. He doesn't just understand your weaknesses and failures, He also doesn't want you to remain in that failure. He wants you to advance beyond the realm of that failure and weakness.c. He wants us to also enjoy the victory He had over all the things He faced.d. He didn't just "correct" your failures, but supplies you with the richness of Himself for your living.e. He has made a provision for you to have limitless access to the rich supplies He had. He has given you limitless access to the throne of Grace. Not just GRACE but to the source and governing realm of Grace for your continues supply and enjoyment of GRACE as much as you need or will take.f. Therefore hold fast, cling tenaciously to Him in an absolute trust.Beloved, because God understands your weaknesses and incapabilities, He has provided or supplied you with all the grace and help you need for exercising yourself unto godliness.Don't settle for less with many excuses.The LORD'S DELIGHT IS THAT YOU LIVE THE FULLNESS OF THE LIFE HE HAS GIVEN YOU NOW.When it feels like you just can't do it, don't give up and don't settle for less.PRESS ON!Be tenacious in the Lord for He is YOUR STRENGTH. DON'T DO WHAT YOU CAN, DO WHAT GOD WANTS YOU TO DO BY TAKING ADVANTAGE OF GRACE. Press on! Enlarge the scope of your vision and desire.The extra mile is for those who dare to be EXTRA.YOU ARE SUPPLIED WITH ALL YOU NEED BY THE LORD.You have the Holy Spirit in you for the EXTRAORDINARY don't make excuses.Have the mindset of a KINGDOM CHAMPION.SelahYOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON...To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.orgDIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 9:24; Hebrews 3:1; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18; 1 Thessalonians 2:12) WE PRAY:- That we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing to remain resolute in pressing on with any target or assignment He has committed to our trust. BIBLE READING:DAY 152: Nehemiah 3-4 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling.- I don’t give excuses, I get the job done.- Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on.- I don’t stop halfway, I press on.- I go the extra mile.- I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord.- I do the extraordinary.- I am a Champion.- I am a GLOBAL ICON.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 165 - LET GOD'S WORK PROSPER IN YOUR HANDS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LET GOD'S WORK PROSPER IN YOUR HANDS"...Yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants. He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD’s good plan will prosper in his hands." Isaiah 53:10 (NLT) God has great plans for His Kingdom, mankind, for you specifically and for all His creation.God's great intention or plan is that His glory will be expressed in fullness.To achieve this, God has ordained you to be the conduit for the fulfillment of His glorious plan.As a conduit or a steward of God's great plan, you can determine the extent to which the work of God will be done.The things you desire to do were put in your heart by God. " For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases Him" Philippians 2:13 (NLT) Yours is to nurture the Lord's desire in your heart; through prayer, meditation and the steps you take.The more you take steps to act out God's desire in your heart, the greater it becomes. God sees the need to entrust more to you, as you become faithful with the little He entrusts to you.The Lord enables you to do more, however, when you are not determined to work out what the Lord had purposed in your heart, you may fail. " The sons of Ephraim were armed as archers and carrying bows, Yet they turned back in the day of battle." Psalm 78:9 (Amplified). These sons of Ephraim were armed, and well equipped, yet turned back in the day of battle. You can be resourced and still turn away from the pursuit of purpose.Make it your determination that the purpose and plan of the Lord shall prosper in your hands.This was what the Prophet Isaiah declared concerning Jesus; " ...He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD ’s good plan will prosper in his hands." Isaiah 53:10 (NLT). Beloved, God has called you for this reason; that His purpose and good plan will prosper in your hands.Don't settle for less, go for the ultimate plan of God. You are enabled for this purpose.ShalomYOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON...To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.orgDIG DEEPER:(2 Chronicles 30:12; 1 Corinthians 12:6; I Corinthians 15:10; Ephesians 1:5) WE PRAY:That we will faithfully work on that which the Lord has entrusted to us for the good plan of the Lord to prosper in our hands. BIBLE READING:DAY 153: Nehemiah 5-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS- I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling.- I don’t give excuses, I get the job done.- Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on.- I don’t stop halfway, I press on.- I go the extra mile.- I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord.- I do the extraordinary.- I am a Champion.- I am a GLOBAL ICON.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 166 - SEE THE BEST IN PEOPLE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency SEE THE BEST IN PEOPLE "Finally, be ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded 1 Peter 3:8 (ERV) As long as God has called you into Kingdom leadership, you must function as He does. Your heavenly father is the first leader of the universe. Therefore, He gives as the true pattern of leadership. Jesus, who was God made flesh, revealed the complete character of God. And in Christ you will find this beautiful leadership trait: SEEING THE BEST IN OTHERS. It takes a genuine heart to see the best in others when they could only see their weakness. To lead your generation you must see the best of Hope in people. To lead people, is to influence and to bring them into the fulfillment of God's purpose for their lives. They may not see what God has deposited inside them, however, you must see what God has put in them, when you look for the best in others. When God saw Gideon, He saw a mighty man of valor. When He saw David, He didn't just see a shepherd boy, He saw a king. When He saw the young fishermen, who were untrained or unskilled in matters of the Kingdom, He saw fishers of men, who were going to expand the Kingdom. Don't see weakness and mistakes in people. See the beauty of God in others. How did David turn men who were distressed or in debt or discontented, to mighty men? He saw people who will be loyal to him and also be his team members. It was when these people came to David that, he became a captain. When you start seeing the best of God in others, you will go every extent to bring out the beauty you see in them. When you look at the people in your work place, school, or community, see what God wants them to be and not what the systems of this world has produced in them. You cannot impact your sphere, when you don't see the people as God sees them. You will deal with people based on your assumptions and history with them when you don't see the best in them. Deal with people based on what the Holy Spirit wants to produce in them. Selah YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON... To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.orgDIG DEEPER:(Philippians 2:3; 1 Corinthians 13:7; Romans 12:10) WE PRAY:Lord, help me to see the best in people beyond their weaknesses and mistakes. Help me to see what you see in them and how to bring out that beauty. BIBLE READING:DAY 154: Nehemiah 7-9 DECLARE THESE WORDS- When I see people, I see emblems of the future.- When I see people, I see light bearers.- When I see people, I see world changers.- I see people through the eyes of Jesus.- I see faithfulness, hope and love in the people the Lord has entrusted unto me.- I don’t give up on anyone.- My goal in encountering people, is to bring out the beauty that I see.- By the strength of the Lord, I bring many unto purpose.- I AM A GLOBAL ICON.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 167 - BE A LEADING EXAMPLE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE A LEADING EXAMPLE Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity. 1 Timothy 4:12 (NKJV) One of the major challenges you find in our society today is true leadership. Leaders define the state and direction of the society. The lack of godly leadership even from the family level, determines the state of the society. Leaders help the community or the society to find the right strategic compass. In Jesus, we saw the true meaning and essence of Kingdom Leadership. And Kingdom-centred leadership was what our Lord knew the society needed. It was part of His heartbeat."And seeing the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and downcast like sheep without a shepherd" Matthew 9:36 (Legacy Standard Bible). When Jesus saw the multitudes He knew their challenge was the lack of Kingdom leaders, who will truly care for their state. Ultimately, Jesus came not just as the Life-giver, but also as the true and great Kingdom shepherd (leader) who will bring us into fulfillment of the eternal purpose of God. And before His ascension, He mandated the saints to make disciples of all the nation (Matthew 28:19). This was a call to leadership. As the true meaning of Kingdom leadership, He made disciples (students) and now, He mandated His disciples to go forth to also demonstrate true Kingdom leadership; by making disciples. He sent His disciples to go into the world to lead the nations. When you come into Christ, you have a CALL TO LEAD YOUR GENERATION. Very few people are conscious and determined to fulfill this great call to leadership.I love what the author of Hebrews has to say:"You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again..." Hebrews 5:12 (NLT). As believers we have to mature and take up the responsibility to LEAD. This was what Paul said to Timothy:"Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity." 1 Timothy 4:12 (KJV). The key word is EXAMPLE, it's from the greek word, TUPOS, which means, style or resemblance; specifically a sampler (type) that is a model (for imitation), a fashion, figure, form, or a pattern. (See Strong's Bible Dictionary). This point us to the function of true Kingdom Leadership. Thus, to be an example is to be a kingdom leader. You don't have to allow anyone to despise you as a youth. Instead, be their leader, be the one everyone will look up to. Be a leading example in word, in manner of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.No wonder Jesus said, you are the light of the world and the salt of the earth. You have a call of God on your life to LEAD YOUR GENERATION, take a STEP TO MAKE IT HAPPEN.YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON... Selah To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org  DIG DEEPER:(Matthew 5:13-16;Ezra 7:10; 1 Peter 2:9; Psalm 78:72; Romans 12:3-8;)WE PRAY:- Thanking the Lord for the privilege to lead our generation unto His Kingdom agenda.- That we will yield ourselves to the training that will make us effective and productive Kingdom leaders. BIBLE READING:DAY 155: Nehemiah 10-13DECLARE THESE WORDS- I have been called to lead my generation.- I am conscious of this calling.- I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call.- I refuse to be distracted.- I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth.- Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement.- I am the centre of attraction in my generation.- I am a satisfaction to many.- I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world.- I AM A GLOBAL ICON. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 168 - ALWAYS BE STEADFAST IN PRAYER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ALWAYS BE STEADFAST IN PRAYER" Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving" Colossians 4:2 (ESV) There is so much talk on prayer and few pray consistently or diligently.Those who also pray, only pray because of their interests or pray only when they are confronted by troubles.It is not wrong to pray in the day of adversity. Neither is it wrong to pray when you have a prayer topic or an issue to address.The idea of prayer transcends making requests or asking God for something.Prayer is not designed by God to aid the satisfaction of your cravings and self-centered appetites.Prayer is more than running to God in time of trouble.Prayer is a medium of communing with God in the richness of His heart and Spirit.There is a dimension of prayer where you speak to God beyond the assent of your mind and emotions.When you consistently commune with God through prayer, you enjoy the infusion of His life in a unique way.Through prayer you journey with God into depths and heights which cannot be fathom by the senses.This is why the Lord gave us the gift of praying in the Spirit. " For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful" 1 Corinthians 14:14 (KJV). Praying in the Spirit always, helps you to articulate hidden realities in the Spirit. You make supply of spiritual verities beyond what your mind could have carved.There are spiritual things which may seem too coded to the natural mind. But as you constantly pray in the Spirit you decode these things unto manifestations.To the mind, they may be mysteries and unfruitful. However, in the Spirit those words are great lights of answers. " For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries." 1 Corinthians 14:2 (KJV). You are able to travel deep into the wells of God's Spirit, to fetch out untapped light and graces to perform His duty in the physical realm.Nothing can be done with God in the fullness of His Spirit without prayer.Pray with your Spirit and prophesy with your understanding.By this you release intense spiritual energies for greater works.The Holy Spirit is able to hammer out spiritual channels in you, so that there will be the outflow of immeasurable power and blessings.There are restraining forces in the world, in your school, at your work place, in your neighbourhood, etc which are determined to prevent you from fulfilling God's predetermined purpose and counsel.And it is a war for supremacy over the hearts of men.We can only conquer the hearts of men not just by mere words.It is only by words cooked in intense steadfast prayers.  " Be faithful to pray as intercessors who are fully alert and giving thanks to God. And please pray for me, that God will open a door of opportunity for us to preach the revelation of the mystery of Christ, for whose sake I am imprisoned. Pray that I would unfold and reveal fully this mystery, for that is my delightful assignment" Colossians 4:2-4 (TPT) Apart from preaching the word to get people saved, giving financially towards the gospel and serving every way in the work of the Lord; CONTINUE STEADFASTLY IN PRAYER! The prayers of the early saints, were not merely centered on their needs.They prayed interceding for the salvation of souls and for the spread of the gospel of Jesus. Anything they prayed for, which even was about themselves, had the goal of the prosperity of the gospel.See what the scriptures said concerning Epaphras: "Epaphras, who is one of you, a bondservant of Christ, greets you, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God" Colossians 4:12 (NKJV) Starting from today, PRAY EARNESTLY AND CONSISTENTLY EVERYDAY.Don't be too busy for prayer. Don't be lazy. Don't procrastinate prayer times. Make prayer your utmost priority.Make supply of divine ability into the day and the assignment the Lord has given you.PRAY!Hallelujah YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON..NB: A SPECIAL REQUEST...DON'T SKIP ANY OF THE VERSES IN THE DIG DEEPER. READ THEM AND PRAY!DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 6:18; Luke 18:1; Acts 1:14; Philippians 4:6; Colossians 1:3-4, 9-11; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; 1 Kings 9:3; 1 Samuel 12:23; Romans 12:12; Luke 21:36; Luke 22:44) WE PRAYNB: Please pray with:Colossians 4:2-4;12Colossians 1:9-11 BIBLE READINGDay 156: Esther 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Instead of being anxious, I pray.- I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers.- I am given to prayer.- I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 169 - DISCIPLESHIP IS A CRUCIAL MATTER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DISCIPLESHIP IS A CRUCIAL MATTER " You have not chosen Me, but I have chosen you and I have appointed and placed and purposefully planted you, so that you would go and bear fruit and keep on bearing, and that your fruit will remain and be lasting, so that whatever you ask of the Father in My name [as My representative] He may give to you." (John 15:16 Amplified Bible) The Lord didn't just send us out there to bear fruits. God purposeful planted us to bear much more fruits which will remain and be lasting. We are not to just scatter the seeds of Christ's love with others. There is no fruitfulness until the fruits remain on the branches. When a tree bear fruits, the fruits remain on the branches. Fruits are not kept elsewhere apart from the branches. For souls or fruits to remain in the Vine (the Lord), there are organic systems to engage. Discipleship in the Church is a crucial factor for souls to remain and last. Discipleship takes place within the Church. Every soul won must be put under a shepherd for effective and consistent nurturng. Just as we are not designed to operate in isolation from the Lord, we are also to practice our communion with the Lord by how we commune with the saints. All through scriptures we see that, anytime souls are won, they are added to the Church. God takes interest in souls being added to the Church. God gets involved in this work as well. "...The whole city was favorable to them, and each day God added to them all who were being saved." Acts 2:47 (TLB). Those who were being saved were not just added as members to the Church and left alone. From the subsequent verses we see how the souls saved were involved in discipleship. "And those who believed Peter were baptized—about three thousand in all! They joined with the other believers in regular attendance at the apostles’ teaching sessions and at the Communion services and prayer meetings." Acts 2:41-42 (TLB). Now we see that: 1. They joined with other believers in regular attendance at the apostles’ teaching meetings. 2. They joined in communion services. 3. They joined in prayer meetings. You one cannot be a lasting fruit in Christ, until he or she is consistent in these meetings. It is not just about attending services on Sundays, but being involved in the community of the saints. That determines and influences your growth. See some additional thoughts in the same chapter. "And all the believers met together constantly and shared everything with each other, selling their possessions and dividing with those in need. They worshiped together regularly at the Temple each day, met in small groups in homes for Communion, and shared their meals with great joy and thankfulness" Acts 2:44-46 (TLB). 4. We also see that, they shared everything with each other. A true expression of love and prove of discipleship. (John 13:14-15). 5. They met in the big meetings and also met in small groups. In Christ Commonwealth -Community, we call the small group meetings, Life Connect. Your souls don't remain as effective fruits just by how they attend main gatherings. Their fellowship with Christ is deepened at the small group meetings. Beloved, don't win a soul and ask them to attend a "Bible Believing Church". How can a new soul tell or know a Bible Believing Church? When you win a soul, follow them up to bring them to the Church where you are nurtured. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org SelahDIG DEEPER (Acts 5:12 ; 14, Acts 1:13-14; Acts 20:7) WE PRAYWe are praying for the grace to follow up on new souls to establish them in the Church we are nurtured in. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 157: Esther 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I bear lasting fruits. - My fruits (new souls) remain committed to Christ. - I establish many in the Lord. - I take the discipleship of souls serious. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 170 - LIVE YOUR PRAYERS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LIVE YOUR PRAYERS "being a double-minded man, unstable and restless in all his ways [in everything he thinks, feels, or decides]." James 1:8 (Amplified) The focus of your spirit and action influences the consistency of your results.Double-mindedness is one of the causes of instability in the lives of people.Your choices and actions must not contradict your prayers and the prophetic words declared over you. Sometimes people assume as they've prayed greatness, they can live average and will turn up great automatically.Your faith is not just demonstrated in your prayers. It is demonstrated in the consistency of your words and deeds.As you pray for great success, what kind of goals do you set?You can't set small targets and expect great results. You can't shy away from doing great things and expect to be great.What are your expectations?What are you praying for?How are you living at the level of your prayers?Don't make your prayers useless by your actions and decisions. You can't be praying for success and be speaking failure.For example, you pray for the salvation of 5000 souls, yet you invite 1000 people and take a meeting space for only 500 people. Your plans shouldn't contradict your prayers.Sometimes after you have received a word from the Lord or made a declaration or a prophetic utterance by the influence of the spirit, you may find yourself among certain friends who may share their own opinions and fears.Always uphold the word of the Lord and make it your focus. The adversary is always looking for an opportunity to sow seeds of doubt and make you live as a mediocre.Whether in business, family or ministry, maintain the consistency of thoughts and singleness of mind. Don't give room to double-mindedness. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org Selah DIG DEEPER (Psalm 119:113; 1 Kings 18:21; James 1:6-8) WE PRAYIn the name of Jesus, that nothing shall be strong enough to distract us. That by the supply of grace, we imbue divine focus in the midst of all distractions in this present age. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 158: Esther 7-8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be a double-minded person.- I don’t act contrary to the word of the Lord in my mouth.- My speakings, actions and choices are always in agreement.- I don’t give room for any distraction, I maintain focus.- Through the mediation of God’s word and prayer, I maintain a consistent thought and single mind.Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 171 - YOU ARE GOD'S BELOVED
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE GOD'S BELOVEDto all who are beloved of God in Rome, called as saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Romans 1:7 (Legacy Standard Bible) When was the last time you thought of your relationship with God?And how do you think God sees you?The reality is this God doesn't see you as His enemy. And this is not a reformed or changed mindset of God about you. He has never seen you as His enemy even before you got born again.The thought that you are nobody, and worthless before God is not consistent with God's word.Don't define yourself according to your feelings nor circumstances. If you want to know who you truly are, find out what God says about you. God's original thought of you is seen or revealed through Christ.In Paul's epistle to Rome, he addressed the brethren, according to who they truly are in Christ: "[I am writing] to all who are beloved of God in Rome, called to be saints (God’s people) and set apart for a sanctified life, [that is, set apart for God and His purpose]: Grace to you and peace [inner calm and spiritual well-being] from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ" Romans 1:7 (Amplified) Now, though he mentioned that the epistle was to all who are the Beloved of God in Rome, it doesn't suggest Rome is the only place to find those who are God's beloved.Anyone in Christ is the beloved of God.To be the Lord's beloved means to be specially, intimately and greatly loved by God.This reveals God's special relationship with His chosen people, who are set apart unto Him. " See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are...” 1 John 3:1 You are not and shall never be hated by God. You are God's beloved and He has loved you with an everlasting (unending) love.Walk in this confidence all the days of your life.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org Selah DIG DEEPER (Jeremiah 31:3; Romans 8:39; Deuteronomy 33:12;) WE PRAYThanking God for His unfeigned love and unchangeable thought about us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 159: Esther 9-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the beloved of God.- God loves me with an everlasting love.- I am the thought that fills God’s mind all the time.- God’s mind about me can never change.- I am confident of this very thing, that irrespective of my circumstances or feeling, I know that I am loved by God.- I walk daily in the consciousness of this reality.Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 172 - COMMUNE WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency COMMUNE WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper, to be with you forever John 14:16 (ESV) Isn't it sad to find out that, saints in Christ, think that they don't have anyone to help them?Beloved, when you became born again, you received the Holy Spirit. The Lord gave us the Holy Spirit to be our eternal companion. He is your greatest helper and partner.The Holy Spirit is not a thing; He is a person.There are people when they think of the Holy Spirit, they imagine a bird, or a wind or fire. He is not a wind, He is not a bird neither is He fire.These items are used as descriptions of His function. They don't define His person. The Holy Spirit is the Spirit of God. To imagine how He is, you must imagine How God is, for He is God. The picture of Jesus, is the picture of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the person of the Godhead who dwells in you and is also with you at the same time.He is the embodiment and the supply of divine ability, which is the anointing and the power of God. All that is in God is supplied to you by the Holy Spirit. There is nothing you receive of God without the Holy Spirit. Without the Holy Spirit you cannot experience the abiding and manifested presence of God.He makes your companionship with God a palpable reality.The thing is, without Him you can do nothing.Engage Him, fellowship with Him and make Him your best companion. Don't go a day without having intense fellowship with Him.The Holy Spirit will make something beautiful out of your life; be conscious of His presence in your life. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org Shalom DIG DEEPER(John 7:39; John 14:26; John 15:26; John 16:7; John 4:14; Romans 8:26) WE PRAY- Thanking the Lord for indwelling us through the Holy Spirit.- That by the wisdom of God's Word we shall make the most of our relationship with the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 160: Job 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have a deep relationship with God. I am deeply connected to God.- The Lord indwells me through the Holy Spirit.- I have an intimate relationship with God. I am the Lord's favorite.- My relationship with the Lord through the Holy Spirit is getting deeper by the day.- The Holy Spirit is strongly at work in Him. I have the ability to fellowship with God.- I am not ordinary. God lives in me through the Holy Spirit.Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 173 - BLOSSOM AS A FOREST BY THE SPIRIT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BLOSSOM AS A FOREST BY THE SPIRIT " Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is valued as a forest." Isaiah 32:15 (Amplified Bible) Working hard to be fruitful is great. However, there is no fruitfulness without the Spirit.Wherever the Spirit of the Lord is there is blossoming.God's desire is that you become fruitful. However your fruitfulness is by the Spirit. The scriptures liken the fruitfulness or flourishing of one who has experienced the outpouring of the Spirit to a forest. This reveals the extent by which a spirit-life can flourish.Without the outflow of the Spirit you may experience dryness. When there is the overflowing of the Spirit in your life, you shall not experience dryness. " I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water." Isaiah 41:18 This is why you have to commune with the Holy Spirit. You cannot have a consistent communion with the Holy Spirit and remain dry. When the spirit is poured out to you, your 'dry life', becomes a fruitful life and then grows to become a forest. The Holy Spirit supplies your life with rivers of living waters, which causes you to blossom in all things.Do you want to flourish beyond measure?Let the Holy Spirit take over your soul. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org Shalom DIG DEEPER(Psalm 107:35; Isaiah 44:3; Isaiah 29:17) WE PRAYThat we will enjoy the sufficient supply of God'sSpirit and grace to bear and multiply our fruits. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 161: Job 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I bear fruits by the ability of the Supply of Christ.- I am made competent by the empowering presence of God.- I don't operate by my own strength.- I am strengthened by the grace of God to do more. - I refuse to be separated from the Lord.- I live in the union of Christ.- Fruitfulness streams from within me because the Lord is my source.- Every weakness in me is perfected by the Grace of God.- I am greatly helped and resourced by the Lord.- I blossom as a forest.Hallelujah!!!
