title: EPISODE 174 - STOP THINKING POOR
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency STOP THINKING POOR " There must be no poor people among you because God is going to bless you lavishly in this land..." Deuteronomy 15:4 (MSG) Do you really have the desire to do great things for God?Do you want to be part of the spread of the gospel in all places?Do you want to see the transformation of people?I believe your answer is "YES!"; then you don't have to think poor or be poor or remain poor!The gospel is free but not cheap. It takes a lot of resources to spread the gospel to the nations of the world.Understand that being poor will limit you from achieving the dreams of God in your heart. You cannot spread the gospel and become a giant in the expansion of the Kingdom with poverty.This is not to demean any poor person, but to establish you in the consciousness that GOD DOESN'T WANT YOU TO BE POOR, therefore STOP THINKING POOR!Did you read the opening verse? " There must be no poor people among you because God is going to bless you lavishly in this land..." Deuteronomy 15:4 (MSG) Why must there not be poor people among them?Because poverty is an error!Poverty is not of God!Poverty is not a blessing from God!Anything that is not of God must not be part of your life.The blessing of the Lord makes rich. (Proverbs 10:22).You may ask, "Why then am I poor because I know I am blessed of the Lord, through Christ Jesus?" Get this, you can carry the Lord's blessing and still live poor. The reality is that anyone blessed of the Lord is not poor but can live poor.Poverty is not first the absence of money. However, when you live poor, you will walk in lack.Poverty is essentially a mindset problem. Until you correct your mindset, you may have all the resources in the universe and still live poor. Your thought is what defines how you demonstrate abundance.You have to stop thinking poor because you are not poor. Not having physical currency note, or a good bank balance doesn't mean you are poor.You are blessed of the Lord, therefore you are rich!Don't think poor, don't live poor, don't respond to life situations as a poor person. Don't speak the language of the poor. Refuse to declare lack.The poor thinks, he or she doesn't have enough. But the blessed of the Lord knows whatever he or she has can be multiplied.One with a poverty mindset thinks impossibilities, sees and speaks lack. One with a poverty mindset, cannot imagine a life lavished with abundance. Such people are quick to declare how they don't have money. To even think and say, "My money is finished" is poverty mentality.Why will you think your money is finished? Why will you think you don't have money?Beloved, as the blessed of the Lord, you are lavished by the Lord with super-abundance. You have the capacity and ability to generate resources.Refuse to think POOR!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.Shalom DIG DEEPER(Psalm 35:27; 2 Chronicles 25:9; Genesis 12:2; Deuteronomy 8:18; Proverbs 10:22) WE PRAYThat we will increase in the wisdom to maximize the resources that the Lord has given to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 162: Job 7-8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the blessed of the Lord.- I have super- abundance.- I am blessed in all things.- All grace abounds towards me in all that I do.- I am so rich.- I give bountifully and joyously into the spread of the gospel.- The gospel prospers in my hands through my finances.- I refuse to think poor no matter what.- I refuse to be defined by what I have in my pocket or bank account at any time.- I am defined by the riches in Christ Jesus and I walk in this consciousness everyday.Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 175 - GOD DELIGHTS IN YOUR PROSPERITY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GOD DELIGHTS IN YOUR PROSPERITY " Let them shout for joy and be glad, Who favor my righteous cause; And let them say continually, “Let the Lord be magnified, Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant.” Psalm 35:27 (NKJV) It's interesting how some people assume God loves them but doesn't get involved in their prosperity.God is not only involved in your prosperity of purpose and spiritual growth.God is involved in the prosperity of your health and finances.It is the Father's delight that you prosper financially. Your financial prosperity is a great gain to the expansion and spread of the gospel.The Lord's desire is that all men shall be saved and come to knowledge of the truth. God's course is that the earth will be filled with the knowledge of His glory, as the waters cover the sea. (Habakkuk 2:14).When you get involved in the preaching of the gospel in all nations, you will know money plays an important role in taking the gospel to the ends of the world.Poverty is not an option at all, if you want to reach many with the gospel.God doesn't want anyone to perish (2 Peter 3:9), and beloved, it is costly to reach out to the multitudes in all nations.Paul was able to preach the gospel in many cities and nations because he was financed. (Philippians 4:16-18).Your prosperity is for the advancement of the gospel, and that is the more reason God is interested in your prosperity.Again, I admonish you to make prosperity your consciousness. Don't accept thoughts of poverty.A man that thinks poor cannot do more for the Lord. Be conscious of your prosperity.SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. title: EPISODE 176 - KEEP YOUR SENSE OF URGENCY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency KEEP YOUR SENSE OF URGENCY " Herald and preach the Word! Keep your sense of urgency [stand by, be at hand and ready], whether the opportunity seems to be favorable or unfavorable... 2 Timothy 4:2 (AMPC) Beloved, you can't be a world changer or a global icon by mouth. In as much as what you confess is important to your success, you must understand your choice of action will determine the extent you may lead your generation.Every great leader has a sense of urgency everyday. Consistent impact is birth through a consistent routine.It is not the Father's will that you experience one time success. He wants you to have daily success. To make a difference in your generation, take daily steps which will make the dream of God in your heart a reality.You can't be one who procrastinates, waste or spend time on none essentials or things which don't directly contribute to your target and vision. You have to be disciplined to work towards your goal.Until you maintain a strong sense of urgency concerning your goals, you may not be discipline, diligent and consistent.This is one of the great secrets to prosperity and greatness.Be prompt to do!Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste.Procrastination is a destroyer of destiny and fulfillment. Laziness is the act of the poor. And being lazy and wasting time, doesn't mean you are doing nothing. You can spend time doing something which doesn't contribute to your action plan.You have no sense of urgency when you spend time surfing the internet, watching funny clips when you should be praying.Anything you do with your time must be an intentional step to contribute to your progress.Refuse to be lazy. The lazy has no sense of urgency. They do things at their own time and not according to the standard of the assignment. Your routine must represent the level of greatness. " The soul of a lazy man desires and has nothing, but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich." Proverbs 13:4 Don't just desire or wish to be successful and great. Be diligent to work towards your greatness. " Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor." Proverbs 12:24. Diligence with sense of urgency, is a characteristic of all prosperous leaders who lead and transform their generation.The Bible says, and David rose early in the morning and went to the camp as his father has commanded. (1 Samuel 17:20).And Abraham got up early in the morning to do what the Lord has instructed (Genesis 22:3-4).You will find this sense of urgency, promptness and diligence with these great men in the scriptures.They knew their success is in how they urgently acted on the instructions they received.There is no success in procrastination.How urgent are you working towards your goals for today, for the week, for the month and for the year?You can reach your target, maintain a sense of urgency!!!SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. title: EPISODE 177 - GOD DOESN'T BLESS LAZINESS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GOD DOESN'T BLESS LAZINESS " ...because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you will be altogether joyful" Deuteronomy 16:15b (ESV) Why do you see people who are blessed of the Lord, yet are not manifesting that blessing?Beloved, laziness is one of the reasons people don't see the manifestation of their blessing.The Lord does not bless your laziness; the Lord blesses the work of your hands and your produce. There is nothing the lazy produces. And that is one of the major causes of failure.People fail, live poor and struggle to make any advancement because they are lazy.You can have great potentials and not manifest any greatness.To be lazy is to be slothful, sluggish or indolence. A lazy person avoids exertion or productive activity. Unproductive activity is no activity when it comes diligence.The lazy is not diligent and cannot rule." Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends on forced labor." Proverbs 12:24 A disciple of Jesus cannot be relevant in the kingdom when you remain lazy. Our Lord rewards faithfulness. And laziness cannot make you faithful.God ordained work, and expects you to be diligent with the work or the task He inspires or instructs you to do.The lazy person can desire greatness and still not experience it. " A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied" Proverbs 13:4 Greatness may begin with your desire, however, your desire must translate into consistent action which will birth the greatness. " The soul of the lazy man desires and has nothing; but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich” (Proverbs 13:4 KJV). Having desire is one thing, and being diligent to work towards it, is what makes the desire a reality.Such person will speak of great ideas or plans yet, will not take any action. And even when they begin to take a step towards their plans, they lack the discipline to complete the task.The lazy or sluggish person makes excuses and amplifies challenges, because he or she hates to work. A lazy person will give exaggerated reasons they couldn't start nor complete a task. " The lazy one [manufactures excuses and] says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets [if I go out to work]!” Proverbs 22:13 (Amplified Bible). A sluggard person wastes time and destroys great plans or success. (Proverbs 18:9) God designed you for productivity." For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them." Ephesians 2:10 (ESV). Through your diligence you bring honor to God and fulfill divine purpose.Get up and get to work.Don't waste time on sleep. Don't waste time on things which don't contribute to your success. Set daily goals and targets, so that you can measure your success and impact.Don't sit thinking of why you were not blessed, whiles you know clearly what to do to manifest blessings.The LORD BLESSES THE INCREASE OF YOUR PRODUCE AND THE WORK OF YOUR HANDS.Avoid any reason or anything that leads to idleness or unproductivity.SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER(Luke 16:10; Proverbs 10:4-5; Proverbs 6:6-12; 12:11; Proverbs 14:23; 19:15; 20:4; 24:30-34; Matthew 25:24-29; 2 Thessalonians 3:6-10) WE PRAYOh Lord, grant me the grace to be diligent in whatever my hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 165: Job 17-20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make each day count.- I make daily progress and success.- Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof.- I win everyday.- I am not a waster of resources,- Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me.- I am a diligent man.Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 178 - DON'T MAKE POVERTY A GUEST
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DON'T MAKE POVERTY A GUEST" ...Just this: You can look forward to a dirt-poor life, poverty your permanent houseguest!" Proverbs 6:11 (MSG) Are you wondering why people with great potentials and opportunities live poor?Do you know why people don't achieve great things?There are people who start out life with great ideas and inspirations but never see their day light.Mostly:THEY ARE LAZY!THEY MAKE EXCUSES! " A slacker always has an excuse for not working—like “I can’t go to work. There’s a lion outside!And murderers too!" Proverbs 22:13 (TPT) A fellow who makes excuses from working will not be counted among the greats in his or her sphere of assignment.Giving an excuse that you are living poor because of your calling is a shame to the Lord who called you.Whatever the Lord has called you to do and wherever He has called you to be, you can prosper.What you should understand is, you were not designed by God to be poor. Therefore when you see yourself living poor, then you have consistently chosen to be poor.Take note: I understand the times and season of sowing and harvest. I understand there is a season you will enjoy your harvest of prosperity and greatness. And during the seed time of your living it may look like you don't have abundance.The concept of poverty and prosperity transcends what you have accumulated.From the previous discussion, I explained that poverty is a mindset problem. And this mindset translates into habit or routine.Though you are blessed of the Lord and have been supplied with all that you need for your greatness, you can live poor by making poverty your permanent house guest.And the scriptures give clarity on this matter.See Proverbs 6:9-11 (The Voice): " How long do you plan to lounge your life away, you lazy fool? Will you ever get out of bed? You say, “A little sleep, a little rest, a few more minutes, a nice little nap.” But soon poverty will be on top of you like a robber; need will assault you like a well-armed warrior." I believe you can relate with this, right?You sleep intermittently during the day, after you have slept for 10 hours at night, and also use more than 5 hours surfing or "procrastiscrolling" your phone.And you expect to manifest greatness?Did you notice the scriptures, called such person "Lazy fool"?You can sprawl or slouch your beautiful-great life away. The time to prepare and invest value, you sleep and waste it. This means the outcome of your life is your choice.Instead of work, you decide to take a little nap?Precious one, you are inviting poverty as your permanent room mate. And when it comes, it attacks and assaults you like an armed robber or bandit. It breaks you and weakens you completely.See how the Message Translation puts it: " So how long are you going to laze around doing nothing? How long before you get out of bed? A nap here, a nap there, a day off here, a day off there, sit back, take it easy—do you know what comes next? Just this: You can look forward to a dirt-poor life,poverty your permanent houseguest! You have heard much about the great things you are going to do for the Lord and in your generation. You have seen how your life will be full of blessings and nations will respond to your greatness. You have been told prophetically, that you will bring transformation to your nation.However, being lazy and spending time sleeping will not make it happen.Are you working in the ministry full-time?Are you working in the ministry and doing business?Are you a missionary?Have you been given an assignment by the Lord?Have you been inspired to run a company?Have you been told you are going to feed the nations?Are you desiring to be the greatest fashion designer?Are you looking forward to be named among the greats in I.T etc?Wherever the Lord has placed you and whatever the Lord has said concerning your life shall come to pass, BUT NOT WHEN YOU ARE LAZY!Isaac received a word from the Lord when there was famine in the land he was: " Then the Lord appeared to him and said: “Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land of which I shall tell you. Dwell in this land, and I will be with you and bless you; for to you and your descendants I give all these lands, and I will perform the oath which I swore to Abraham your father." Genesis 26:2-3 (NKJV). This is a beautiful word of the Lord. Hallelujah!Now, did this word of the Lord automatically happen?See from the verse 12:" Then Isaac sowed in that land..." Did you see that?Isaac didn't go to sleep. Anyone who has done farming will know, how much diligence it required to succeed at it.When he got to know the land God wants him to dwell, he got into business. He began to work.Which field has God called you to?Get to work!Now look at what happened:" ...and reaped in the same year a hundredfold; and the Lord blessed him. The man began to prosper, and continued prospering until he became very prosperous"Oh glory to God! Beloved, God doesn't bless laziness. Until you become discipline, diligent, effective and efficient you cannot see the expression of God's blessing in what you do.Get this:The lazy is not a doer of the Word. Why?The Word of the Lord frowns at laziness. When you are lazy you cannot even make time to read or study the word, how much more meditation. A lazy person cannot continue in the Word. So how can the word of God even be effective in your life?You want to have enviable success? You don't want poverty to even think or identify the door to your house?REFUSE TO BE LAZY!SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER(Genesis 26:1-14; Luke 16:10; Proverbs 10:4-5; Proverbs 6:6-12; 12:11; Proverbs 14:23; 19:15; 20:4; 24:30-34; Matthew 25:24-29; 2 Thessalonians 3:6-10) WE PRAY- That we will be diligent, discipline, effective and efficient in working on whichever assignment the Lord has entrusted to us.- That we will walk in the fullness of our calling with discipline and diligence to see the expression of God’s blessing. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 166: Job 21-25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be lazy.- I don’t make excuses.- I take steps now.- I walk in diligent everyday.- In all that I do, I do with diligent.- I work towards the dreams and visions the Lord has placed in my heart.- I don’t jeopardize my beautiful-great life.- I am a diligent man.- I discipline my body and mind to achieve my goals for today.- I refuse to give in or get distracted halfway.- I maintain an undisturbed composure everyday.- I make progress everyday.- I win everyday.- I refuse to procrastinate.- I do everything with diligence and a strong sense of urgency.- I don’t give my attention and time to things which doesn’t add value to my life.Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 179 - DEALING WITH LAZINESS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DEALING WITH LAZINESS" abundance shall be in each good work/in every good work. Soothly where full many words be, there neediness is oft (Truly, where there be a great many words, there often is neediness, or lack, or want)" Proverbs 14:23 (Wycliffe Bible) We have looked at the matter of laziness   and how it leads to poverty.Though there seem to be more causes of a man's poverty, laziness is doubtlessly a core reason many are poor.To be lazy is suicidal to destiny. Many great people lost their relevance and the "best" they became was average because of laziness.Make a decision to be the best God wants you to be. Greatness doesn't just happen, you have to be diligent with what God has entrusted to you.Your prosperity is in what God has given to you, work diligently with it.There is profit in labour and not empty talk.You have to intentionally deal with laziness.To deal with laziness you must take note of the following (they are not according to any order).1. To deal with laziness you need to be conscious or mindful of your vision.Some conclude that laziness is a physical thing. I don't disagree but it is first a mindset problem. If you can change your mindset you can change your laziness problem.How has your vision (which is God-driven) saturated your mind. When you set your mind on your vision and become passionate about it, you will be diligent to work towards it. It will define and influence your attitude-set. Where there is no vision, there is no reason to live.Our Lord Jesus always worked because he was conscious and mindful of His vision here on Earth. Every vision also has a time line. Though we have eternal life and God's vision for us to make an eternal impact, we live in time and the completeness of our vision is time bound.Jesus said, " All of us must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent me, for there is little time left before the night falls and all work comes to an end." John 9:4 (TLB). This is why you must have a sense of urgency. There is no time for laziness as long the vision of God in our heart is concern.2. Be conscious of your IdentityThis is similar to the first point, since they all have some thing to do with MINDSET.Your vision influences your mindset and your identity also influences your mindset. Your identity is who you are. Your vision is where you are going. I first addressed vision because there are people who know they are Kings, yet have no vision. Nevertheless, your identity-crisis can affect how you work towards your vision. You were not created to be lazy. God made you to be productive. God made you unto good works and fruitfulness (Ephesians 2:10). Don't accept any negative thought that you are lazy and you can't do anything about it. " For as he thinks in his heart, so is he." Proverbs 23:7 (NKJV) You might have cultivated lazy habit, but God did not create you to be lazy. You were designed by God to be a blessing. Cultivate that mindset of who you truly are until it dominates your emotions. Say it to yourself, "I am not lazy!"; "I am productive and diligent".3. Set daily targets.You measure your effectiveness on daily basis. Daily targets or goals help you know how you are working towards your vision. It also helps you develop consistent routine and productive habits.How many chapters of the Bible will you read daily?How many chapters of a book will you read?How many hours will you pray daily?What are you going to do everyday towards your vision or business or ministry or assignment?Breaking your vision into daily goals and targets will help you, make the right choices within the day.4. Commit your plans to the Lord in prayer and remain diligent." Commit your works to the Lord, and your thoughts will be established." Proverbs 16:3 (NKJV) With the direction and help of the Lord, you can achieve your goals. Always have this in mind that, without the Lord you can do nothing. And as the Lord inspires you, on how to work towards your goals, BE DILIGENT!When you plan to pray at a particular time of the day, be diligent to pray at that time. Don't use that time to watch a funny clip or engage in an unprofitable conversation with your friends. Don't decide to sleep when you should be reading. Be determined and diligent to complete your daily target.5. Take care of yourself.The body is not a machine. Even when you over use or misuse a machine, it will breakdown." It is senseless for you to work so hard from early morning until late at night, fearing you will starve to death; for God wants his loved ones to get their proper rest." Psalm 127:2 (TLB). It will surprise you to know that, people who have lazy habits don't even rest. A diligent person makes time to rest. When a lazy person should be resting, he or she will be surfing the internet (moving from one app to the next social app). And will end up having a limited time to rest. Plan your sleep, so that you can be up at the right time. Having a good sleep as you have planned will help you physically, mentally and emotionally. Have enough sleep (not oversleeping) will help your mind and body function effectively. Be a good steward of your body. Make time to exercise (make time to run, walk, skip etc). And also eat right. Plan your diet, or eat with moderation. Beloved, Dear friend, I pray that you are prospering in every way and are in good health, just as your whole life is going well. 3 John 2 (CSB) SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER(John 9:4; Proverbs 28:19; Ecclesiastes 5:3; Proverbs 12:11; Ecclesiastes 9:10; John 4:34) WE PRAY- That we will walk in the consciousness of our vision and identity with discipline and diligence to see the manifestation of God’s blessing. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 167: Job 26-28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I stay on course.- I achieve my goals for today.- I remain conscious of my vision.- I refuse to be lazy.- I don’t make excuses.- I take steps now.- I walk in diligent everyday.- I do everything with diligence and a strong sense of urgency.- I don’t give my attention and time to things which doesn’t add value to my life.- I AM DILIGENT.Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 180 - THE LORD IS WITH YOU FOREVER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 22nd July, 2023 THE LORD IS WITH YOU FOREVER "Teach these new disciples to obey all the commands I have given you. And be sure of this: I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Matthew 28:20 (NLT) The adversary rejoices when you are not conscious of the Lord's presence in your life. The presence of the Lord with you makes the difference through your journey in time.
The presence of the Lord in your life means you have all of the Kingdom of God backing you.
Don't allow the adversary to use circumstances or situations to make you feel you are alone. The challenges you face in this world doesn't mean the Lord is not with you. The Lord being with you doesn't suggest you have a challenge-free life. Challenges gives you the opportunity to see the mighty hand of the Lord in your life. Your consciousness of the Lord's presence in your life is a great threat to the adversary. This is the promise of our Lord Jesus: "...I am with you always..." How did that happen?This was fulfilled through the indwelling of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the personal or the embodiment of the presence of God.
When the Holy Spirit came, the promise of our Lord was fulfilled.
Now get this, the birth of our Lord Jesus, is God coming to tabernacle with man. He is Immanuel,“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and bear a Son, and they shall call His name Immanuel,” which is translated, “God with us.” Matthew 1:23 (NKJV). And was the fulfillment of Prophet Isaiah's prophecy:"Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel." Isaiah 7:14 Which means our Lord Jesus was the tangible presentation of God to man. He was the manifestation of God. And said, He will be with us always, through the Comforter — The Holy Spirit. "And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper (Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor—Counselor, Strengthener, Standby), to be with you forever" John 14:16 (Amplified).
Beloved, have this confidence that the Lord is always with you. You are never alone, and this has to be your consciousness.
The Lord said to Joshua,"There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee." Joshua 1:5 This was David's conviction:"Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me." Psalm 23:4 (KJV).The Lord is with you, and that must be your joy, your consciousness and confidence!!! Selah. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 23; John 3:1-2; Genesis 39:1-4) WE PRAY- That we will walk in the consciousness of the reality that God is with us irrespective of what we face. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 168: Job 29-32 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Holy Ghost is my helper. - I remain conscious of the Lord’s presence daily. - All that I do prospers because the Lord is with me. - I cannot have a bad day because the Lord is with me. - I have all of the Kingdom of God backing me. - I am never alone. - I walk daily in the manifestation of the Lord’s presence. - I am joyful. Hallelujah!!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 181 - YOUR FUTURE IS SECURED
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOUR FUTURE IS SECURED " For I know the plans and thoughts that I have for you,’ says the Lord, ‘plans for peace and well-being and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope" Jeremiah 29:11 (Amplified) Sometimes when you look at your past, family, and challenges confronting you, the future seems to be gloomy. The thing is, if you are of God and moving in the direction of God's word, you don't have to be afraid.The gloomy pictures of your future are not real. You don't have to make it your meditation. Give your mind and heart to the meditation of the word of God.It is what God has said, not how you feel.The Jews found themselves in a situation where they were afraid of the outcome of their lives. Their future seem scary and unpleasant in their minds.And the Lord had to comfort them with these words: " For I know the plans and thoughts that I have for you,’ says the Lord, ‘plans for peace and well-being and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope." Jeremiah 29:11 (Amplified Bible). Now these are not just words to the Jews only. The Lord has good plans for His people.Only good and perfect gifts comes from God. (See James 1:17).His thoughts of you and your future are great and glorious.You don't have to trust the systems of this world than God.Whatever God says is true and forever.Today, I want you to know that your future is already blessed because God is the designer of your life.Yours is to trust the process of His eternal counsel for your life. " The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generation" Psalm 33:11 The word of the Lord is the counsel of the Lord. Your future is secured by the counsel of the Lord, stand on it!!!SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER(Lamentations 3:26; Psalm 40:5; Isaiah 55:12) WE PRAY- Thanking God for His eternal counsel and thought concerning us.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 169: Job 33-35 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My future is secured by the counsel of the Lord.- I trust the process of God’s eternal counsel for my life.- God is the designer of my life.- I have set my gaze on the word of God so I don’t spend time worrying.- My life is as a shinning light that shines brighter and brighter unto a perfect day.- My life is for the glory of God.Hallelujah !!! title: EPISODE 182 - THE GOSPEL OF CHRIST
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE GOSPEL OF CHRIST " For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God to salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first and also for the Greek."Romans 1:16 (NKJV) When Paul the apostle, wrote about not being ashamed of the gospel he wasn't just talking about the "act of preaching"; he was basically talking about the content of the message.There are people who preach, but are ashamed to preach the gospel of our Lord.Some think when they preach the gospel, people will continue in error. But from the opening verse, Paul said, the gospel of Christ is the power of God unto Salvation. (Romans 1:16).Which means, people can only experience Salvation only by the preaching of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.Preaching the gospel is not necessarily a message with the name of God. When someone is reading and talking about verses from the Bible, it doesn't mean he is preaching the gospel.Beloved, there are no two gospels. The Gospel is ONE, and it's the GOODNEWS of Our Lord Jesus.The content and the essence of the Gospel is CHRIST.This is the ONLY message entrusted to us.This Gospel is completely balanced. It does not need any supplement.It is the foundation of all teachings, prophecies and the manner of life or conducts of the saints in Christ. Paul (the apostle of Jesus) in his epistle to the Galatians was not sentimental about this reality. He sharply and clearly established the divine thought on this matter of the gospel, when he noticed how the brethren were drifting away. They were beginning to take heed to other teachings apart from this Gospel of Christ: "I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel— *not that there is another one*, but there are some who trouble you and want to distort the gospel of Christ. But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed. As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed." Galatians 1:6-9 (ESV) To preach another gospel is not just the message that says; "Jesus is not God", not just the beliefs that "There's no God".To preach another gospel, is to preach and teach: - anything with the impression that the finished work of Christ is incomplete. - Any message that takes the focus of the brethren away from Christ. And promotes "the self", is not the Gospel. - Any message that promotes dead works. A message that makes people feel they have to "do something to earn something" from God including His love, is not the Gospel. - Any message like, "Heaven help those who help themselves" is not the gospel. Christ came for the helpless. - The Gospel is not "do good for good". Through the Gospel we received and enjoy God's goodness. - Any message which does not point you to, Righteousness by Faith in Christ, is not the gospel - Any message that makes you feel you have to work hard to maintain, manage, preserve and keep your Salvation is not the gospel. Your salvation is eternal. Beloved, the preaching of the gospel is not that Jesus, justified fornication, envy, adultery, robbery, killing and any evil acts.Well, He didn't even come to justify the good things you do. Jesus came to JUSTIFY YOU. To be justified is to be declared not guilty! It's the declaration that in Him you are righteous. This is the GOSPEL OF CHRIST!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.Shalom DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 15:1-11, 2 Corinthians 5:17-19, 2 Corinthians 11:1-4, Galatians 3:1-14) WE PRAY:That we will grow in the knowledge of the gospel and demonstrate the boldness of the Spirit in preaching the gospel. BIBLE READINGDay 169: Job 36-38 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ.- I am righteous by faith in Christ.- My salvation is eternal.- I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus. - I preach the gospel of Christ with boldness.- I give no room for any other gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! title: EPISODE 183 - TESTIFY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency TESTIFY "But I do not account my life of any value nor as precious to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God." Acts 20:24 (ESV) Paul, the apostle, was clear on his mission and ministry entrusted to him by the Lord: TO TESTIFY TO THE GOSPEL OF THE GRACE OF GOD. From yesterday's with , we learnt about the gospel of Christ; thus, we all (as saints in Christ) have the mandate to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.The gospel is not a religious declaration. The term “gospel” itself has become a common usage in the Church and the world at large. Some see it as an “act of preaching”. In that sense, when one makes any statement or writes a song with “Jesus, or God”, most refer to it as “Gospel”.However, the term “gospel” is not just to preach but essentially the content preached. A message preached is not necessarily the gospel.“Gospel” in Greek is “euangelion”, originally denoted as a reward for good tidings.Later, the idea of reward dropped, and the word stood for “THE GOOD NEWS”.Thus, gospel means “good tidings” or “good message”.The Gospel of Grace is good news, which unfolds God’s eternal plan of becoming one with man, in life and nature. And man becoming His very expression without any limitation.It is the complete package of God’s grand design to dispense Himself into all things, fill all in all and gather all things into Himself through Christ.This gospel is not an after-thought, it was the original plan of God, which was concealed in Him before time began.Now it revealed or unfolded to us.This Gospel of Grace is the mystery of God demystified, which is Christ in You.Having access to this unfolded glorious message of grace, we have to testify, shout it, announce it, share it, preach it and sing it.We have the responsibility to make all men hear about this goodnews. God wants all people to know this truth, which is Christ Jesus.This is what Paul the apostle has to say here too: “This is the very reason I’ve been made a minister by the authority of God and a servant to his body, so that in his detailed plan I would fully equip you with the Word of God. There is a divine mystery—a secret surprise that has been concealed from the world for generations, but now it’s being revealed, unfolded and manifested for every holy believer to experience.Living within you is the Christ who floods you with the expectation of glory! This mystery of Christ, embedded within us, becomes a heavenly treasure chest of hope filled with the riches of glory for his people, and God wants everyone to know it! Christ is our message! We preach to awaken hearts and bring every person into the full understanding of truth. It has become my inspiration and passion in ministry to labor with a tireless intensity, with his power flowing through me, to present to every believer the revelation of being his perfect one in Jesus Christ”. Colossians 1:26-29 (The Passion Translation) REJOICE IN THIS TRUTH!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. title: EPISODE 184 - GOD IS BIGGER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GOD IS BIGGER... " Even if we feel guilty, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything." 1 John 3:20 (NLT) Considering this current society where everything seem to be happening fast; you are likely to be overwhelmed by many things. And sometimes you may be thinking if you can handle the growing pressures around you. Your struggle with addiction keeps rising with no enough time to recalibrate. Your sense of guilt and condemnation keep increasing. You pick your handset to make a call and you are pursued by an ad, luring you away from your plan or intention for the day. You just can't lay your hands on the wheel towards your destiny. You look into the mirror and you really feel you are growing. Sometimes it seems your colleagues had made better choices in life than you. It seems you are behind time and far from catching up. Now you feel helpless and it seems everything is over. You can't stop the tears, the sense of guilt and condemnation. Your mind is dominated by thoughts of defeat and hopelessness. Precious one, pause for a moment and stop looking at your fears, guilt, defeats, addictions and trouble. DO YOU KNOW WHO YOUR HEAVENLY FATHER IS? He is BIGGER THAN your pain, your failure, your guilt, your defeat, your losses, weakness and addictions. Don't allow your feelings to control you. GOD IS BIGGER THAN YOUR FEELINGS. Move your attention away from your struggle and look at the LORD. "Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell God what you need, and thank him for all he has done. Then you will experience God’s peace, which exceeds anything we can understand. His peace will guard your hearts and minds as you live in Christ Jesus." Philippians 4:6-7 (NLT) You can trust the Lord with your decisions and plans. For He has greater and more glorious plans for you. He will lead you into a beautiful future and fulfilled destiny. "Trust in the Lord completely, and do not rely on your own opinions. With all your heart rely on him to guide you, and he will lead you in every decision you make. Become intimate with him in whatever you do, and he will lead you wherever you go. Don’t think for a moment that you know it all," Proverbs 3:5-6 (TPT) Don't trust your feelings than the LORD. He is more than enough for you. No matter the situation, it is a simple matter before the Lord. Trust and live by His counsel. The challenges that seem to overwhelm you are not real. They are traps of the adversary to keep you discouraged. Take your mind off them and focus on the glory and greatness of the Lord. At the appointed time of the Lord, you shall see His mighty hand. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(Jeremiah 32:17,27; Matthew 19:26; 2 Kings 3:18; Genesis 18:14) WE PRAY- Thanking God for the gift of His word which is a sure word for all situations.- Lord, thank you for being an ever present helper in time of trouble. Please help me to rely on you with all my heart in every decision and situation. BIBLE READINGDay 171: Psalm 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to allow to allow what I feel or see around me to control me.- GOD is bigger than my feelings.- GOD is bigger than my pain, my failure, my guilt, my defeat, my losses, weakness and addictions.- I trust in the LORD completely and I do not rely on my own opinions.- I have no fear of tomorrow because greater is HE that is in me than he that is in the world.- The LORD is my gaze.- I don’t spend to worry about anything, rather I talk to GOD about everything. title: EPISODE 185 - LIVE IN THE CERTAINTY OF FAITH
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LIVE IN THE CERTAINTY OF FAITH But as it is written: “Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, Nor have entered into the heart of man The things which God has prepared for those who love Him.” 1 Corinthians 2:9 How many times have you heard this verse of scripture?I am sure maybe more than once or twice.Usually the above verse of scripture is used as encouragement for those who have doubts about their future and what the Lord wants to do to help them.Well, there is nothing wrong to encourage and inspire others about their future. Nevertheless, this sometimes leave people in the uncertainty of their future and lives subtly. A future you cannot see gives room for doubt.This verse of scripture is not a statement to the men in faith. It is the declaration of the doubts people have concerning the word of the Lord. There are no uncertainties in faith. Faith is certain with no space for doubts.Now take a look at this scripture contextual: "We, of course, have plenty of wisdom to pass on to you once you get your feet on firm spiritual ground, but it’s not popular wisdom, the fashionable wisdom of high-priced experts that will be out-of-date in a year or so. God’s wisdom is something mysterious that goes deep into the interior of his purposes. You don’t find it lying around on the surface. It’s not the latest message, but more like the oldest—what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene. The experts of our day haven’t a clue about what this eternal plan is. If they had, they wouldn’t have killed the Master of the God-designed life on a cross. That’s why we have this Scripture text:No one’s ever seen or heard anything like this,Never so much as imagined anything quite like it—What God has arranged for those who love him.But you’ve seen and heard it because God by his Spirit has brought it all out into the open before you" 1 Corinthians 2:6-10 (The Message). The scripture text, "eye has not seen, nor ear heard..." in 1 Corinthians 2:9 was a reference to a prophetic statement made by Prophet Isaiah (See 64:4) to defend the reality that the rulers of this world are ignorant of God and the workings of His wisdom.You cannot bank your life on the systems of this world. Because there is so much uncertainty in this world. However you can trust and depend on the Wisdom of God.With " what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene. The experts of our day haven’t a clue about what this eternal plan is." The Apostle Paul was making his audience understand: 1. The state of the rulers and the religious leaders in their day. They acted as though they knew what was best, yet they had no idea how God's wisdom works. So he continue to say:" If they had, they wouldn’t have killed the Master of the God-designed life on a cross." That’s why we have this Scripture text:No one’s ever seen or heard anything like this,Never so much as imagined anything quite like it— What God has arranged for those who love him.Does it make sense now?The above text is not for those who are in the faith. Because those who are in the faith have the Holy Spirit who has brought them into the understanding of all that the Lord has established through His Wisdom.Again, look at what he says about the brethren: 2. " But you’ve seen and heard it because God by his Spirit has brought it all out into the open before you 1 Corinthians 2:10 (MSG). Oh glory to God.Do you see that?For you in the faith there are no uncertainties. By the revelation of God's word, your eyes have been enlightened to see. You have heard, imagined and fully received all that God has arranged for you.Now it is more clearer what Paul says:" And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose" Romans 8:28 Say this loudly to yourself: AND I KNOW HeyaaaBeloved, you are not ignorant, you are not uncertain nor doubtful of the best things God has planned and deposited inside of you.They are stamped and sealed in your spirit. You are not wishing for anything, you have them in all certainty through the Wisdom of Faith.Whiles the people of this world live in doubt and uncertainty, walk in the SURETY OF THE REALITY OF GOD'S PLAN AND WISDOM IN YOUR SPIRIT.Hallelujah.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(Psalm 31:19; Romans 8:28, 30; Romans 5:5; Joshua 23:14; Mark 5:28; Deuteronomy 7:9) WE PRAY:That we will walk in the surety of the reality of God’s plan and wisdom in our spirit. BIBLE READINGDay 172: Psalm 4-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I know that all things work together for my good.- I have heard, seen, imagined and received all that the Lord has arranged for me.- I refuse to be in doubt.- I have received the best of God.- I live in the certainty of faith.- I am full of faith. HALLELUJAH!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 186 - YOU ARE COMPLETELY FREE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE COMPLETELY FREE " Let me be clear, the Anointed One has set us free—not partially, but completely and wonderfully free! We must always cherish this truth and stubbornly refuse to go back into the bondage of our past" Galatians 5:1 (TPT) Within this period of hustle and bustle, many people become too focus on what they have attained by their own efforts.They translate their efforts to make money, into their relationship with God. They use the same method of worldly market sense to judge how God relates with them.They feel they are not righteous until they do something for God or pay for their sins. To them the fairness of life is to make sure you buy or pay for what you owe and what you want to own. There are some people who received Jesus when they heard the gospel concerning His death for the salvation of men. Yet, they still think they owe God.Some people feel their wrongs and debts are so huge the blood of Jesus is not enough to justify them.Others also think the blood of Jesus played a role in their salvation, however, their good works makes the salvation complete.Well, this is no news, that is how men have always thought and lived. It seems to be woven into the natural genes of men to hardly accept the beautiful glorious news of their salvation through Christ Jesus.Paul says, " for their minds have been blinded by the god of this age, leaving them in unbelief. Their blindness keeps them from seeing the dayspring light of the wonderful news of the glory of Jesus Christ, who is the divine image of God." 2 Corinthians 4:4 (TPT) The god of this world has a way of using certain religious concepts to keep people in bondage.There are many others who still don't believe the blood of Jesus was enough to satisfy the penalty of sin.They still believe in animals sacrifices and their good works to be saved.For animal sacrifices, they are obsolete; they are insufficient to make anyone righteous. (See Hebrews 10:1-14).And concerning your good works, or obedience to religious regulations, they cannot make you righteous or free." For by grace you have been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God; not as a result of works, so that no one may boast." Ephesians 2:8-9 However, your good works are fruits of your salvation and the love of God in your heart.Living under the bondage of religious regulations, makes you think anything free is not complete until you do something to make you feel you really earned it or worked for it.This makes you doubt the finished work of Christ and keeps you in bondage.Look, the salvation we have received in Christ is free but it is not cheap.Precious one, you have been made free from the regulations of religion and the demands of the law, through Christ Jesus." And you who were dead in trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your flesh (your sensuality, your sinful carnal nature), [God] brought to life together with [Christ], having [freely] forgiven us all our transgressions, Having cancelled and blotted out and wiped away the handwriting of the note (bond) with its legal decrees and demands which was in force and stood against us (hostile to us). This [note with its regulations, decrees, and demands] He set aside and cleared [j]completely out of our way by nailing it to [His] cross." Colossians 2:13-14 (Amplified Bible). Let no one use religious systems and regulations to steal your freedom in Christ. He nailed it to the cross, and wiped the records of your wrongs, slate clean.Give no one chance to squander Christ's hard-won freedom for you. " I am emphatic about this. The moment any one of you submits to circumcision or any other rule-keeping system, at that same moment Christ’s hard-won gift of freedom is squandered. I repeat my warning: The person who accepts the ways of circumcision trades all the advantages of the free life in Christ for the obligations of the slave life of the law." Galatians 5:2-3 (The Message) Christ's hard-won freedom wasn't partial. It doesn't need your self-effort to make it complete. For it is completely wonderful and eternally established.SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER:(Galatians 5:1-10; John 8:36; 1 Corinthians 16:13; 2 Corinthians 3:17; Galatians 3:25) WE PRAY:- That our minds will be stayed on the gospel of our Lord Jesus that we will not depend on our works but continue in the glory and liberty of the gospel. BIBLE READINGDay 173: Psalm 8-11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified by faith.- The life of Christ is my life.- I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds.- My boast is in the Lord finished work of Christ.- I am priceless.- My cost price is God Himself.- God purchased me with His blood, therefore I am valuable to God.- I don't live cheap.- I don't live as a slave.- I am bought with a price, therefore I glorify the Lord in my body.OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 187 - CALLED INTO FELLOWSHIP
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency CALLED INTO FELLOWSHIP "God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord." 1 Corinthians 1:9 (NKJV) When you believed and received Jesus, you did not merely escape hell. The Lord brought you into sonship. (John 1:12-13).In your new birth, you were called into the fellowship of Jesus, by God.The word, fellowship is from the Greek word, Koinonia. Which means partnership, participation,communication, communion, distribution and intercourse.By God's own faithfulness, not by your self effort, God called you into the participation, communion and partnership of His Son Jesus.To come into fellowship or participation of His Son also means you share in the reality of the Sonship of Jesus.In the fellowship of sonship, you are no longer an alien but also a son. "Beloved, now are we the sons of God..." 1 John 3:2 (KJV) In that call unto fellowship with Jesus the Lord also justified you.This was not an after-thought, it was God's age long plan and intention to bring you into sonship.It was His predestined plan to call you, justify you and bring you into His glory. (Romans 8:30).Justification is a crucial reality for your calling into sonship.The term justification, is a legal term. To be justified is to be declared not guilty or declared righteous.You were not justified cheaply. God did not overlook your wrongs to justify you.Jesus died as penalty for your wrongs and trespasses. " He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification" Romans 4:25(BSB) Now from the above verse you can see the essence of the resurrection of Jesus.By the resurrection of Jesus, you were justified.The born again in Christ, is the justified. As He has called you, He has justified you. The justification came with His resurrection and by that God legally called you into the fellowship of sonship.God purposed this before the foundation of the earth. The Lord's desire is that all will experience salvation and become His very expression and manifestation. God didn’t want to be hidden. He wanted to be touched and experienced. He wanted His love to be seen by all.God predestined that man will be His expression before the foundation of the world and come into adoption as sons.Sonship is for expression. The son expresses the father. Great is the mystery of Godliness; God manifested in the flesh [see 1st Timothy 3:16]. No man has ever seen God but the son who is in the bosom of the father has expressed Him [John 1:18].The Son expressed the Father by becoming flesh. God becoming man through Jesus, was His manifestation. Godliness is the expression of divinity.The essence of man is that he will be the expression of life which is God. Man is to be the very expression of God.God has predestined that you will be hewn out of Him possessing His LIFE.It is His plan for all.God made it available for all men to experience adoption of sonship. Yet not all have come into this sonship.Those who receive Him are brought into sonship.The saddest thing is not receiving eternal life and the gladdest thing is to receive eternal life by believing (John 1 : 11-12).Whosoever has the son has life. This means the son is the life (1John 5:11-12)Beloved let this settle within you, you participation in sonship is not dependent on your faithfulness. It is dependent on the faithfulness of God.Not that we first loved him but that he first loved us [1st John 4:10]. By this you came into a participation, a fellowship, and equal sharing in Christ.You don't have a 'part share' you have a full share as son. Wherefore are we partakers of the divine nature (2 Peter 1:4). You share in all of that which is in God.Anytime you feel discouraged and it seems the vicissitudes of life kicks you about, remember you are a son of God.Anytime you feel like all hope is lost, remember you have a living hope which is incorruptible. (1 Peter 1:3).We are not of this world. We are not in agreement with this world.You are not a sinner. You are a son of God. You are in fellowship of His Son Jesus Christ our Lord.GLORY TO GOD! To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:3-6; 2 Timothy 1:9-10; Romans 8:14-17;28-30 ) WE PRAY:That as sons we shall demonstrate and express the reality of God in our world. BIBLE READINGDay 174: Psalm 12-15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Now I am a son of God and I have His very life.- I share in the inheritance of the sons of God in the light.- I express God to my world, through the supply of God's Spirit.- I am born with the life of God, therefore I have His nature.- I don't live as a slave of this world, for I am a son of God.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! title: EPISODE 188 - SONSHIP IN CHRIST
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 30th July, 2023 SONSHIP IN CHRIST “ And it was a happy day for him when he gave us our new lives through the truth of his Word, and we became, as it were, the first children in his new family.” James 1:18 (The Living Bible) The greatest thing God achieved was not when He created the heavens, the stars, the moon, the sun. The greatest thing God accomplished was not when He made Adam. The greatest thing He achieved was when He INDWELT MAN, through Christ, and this is how he gained Sons. Beloved, your sonship is the evidence of His Fatherhood. The matter of God having sons was for the satisfaction of His Fatherhood. It has been the Father’s heartbeat even before Sin entered the world.He intended to indwell us through the Spirit, to be- come one with us that we might be His sons. The matter of sonship is unto expression.Fatherhood is for birthing. He is our Father to reproduce Himself in Us, and we are His sons to express (and reveal) Him. The focus of our Lord Jesus was forthe birthing of the Corporate (many) Sons. The desire of God as a Father was not to have Jesus as the only begotten Son, but that through Him, He will have many sons. Jesus came as the seed of the Father to be sown that through Him there will be the germination of many sons. The Lord Himself said, “ Verily, verily, I say unto you, except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it dies, it bringeth forth much fruit.”John 12:24 (KJV) As many that have received Him are legally Sons of God. We are God-begotten. “But whoever did want him, who believed he was who he claimed and would do what he said, He made to be their true selves, their child-of-God selves. These are the God-begotten, not blood-begotten, not flesh-begotten, not sex-begotten.” John 1:12-13 (The MessageBible) Now, we are the sons of God by Faith (See 1 John 3:1-2; Galatians 3:26). Jesus is no longer the only begotten; He is the firstborn among many brethren, and He seesus as His brothers. “ For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.” Romans 8:29 (KJV) “ Jesus, the Holy One, makes us holy. And as sons and daughters, we now belong to his same Father, so he is not ashamed or embarrassed to introduce us as his brothers and sisters!” Hebrews 2:11 (The Passion Translation) It is the joy of the Father to bring us into sonship, and this was His predestined plan before time began. “ For He foreordained us (destined us, planned in love for us) to be adopted (revealed) as His own children through Jesus Christ, in accordance with the purpose of His will [because it pleased Him and was His kind intent]” Ephesians 1:5 Glory to God! This is amazing!He didn’t just reveal us as His children through Jesus Christ, and He gave us the Holy Spirit to be a seal and a witness that we are His forever.We have the Holy Spirit as the testimony within us that God is not only God to us. He is not just a Judge unto us, but He is also our Eternal Father. We call Him Daddy! Daddy! (Abba Father) with joy. “ For you have not received a spirit of slavery leading again to fear [of God’s judgment], but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons [the Spirit producing sonship] by which we [joyfully] cry, “Abba Father! The Spirit Himself testifies and confirms together with our spirit [assuring us] that we [believers] are children of God” Romans 8:15-16 (Amplified Bible) " And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba,Father.” (Galatians4:6) The essence of the Gospel of our Lord Jesus is to point you to YOUR SONSHIP IN CHRIST, and this reality delights the Father’s heart. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(1John 3:1-2; Romans 8:15-16; John 1:12; Galatians 3:26) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship in Christ Jesus. And by the ability of God's Spirit within us, we shall express the nature of the Father as he has intended. BIBLE READINGDay 175: Psalms 15-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the joy of the Father. -I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. - I am born of God. -As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. - I express the quality of God's life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!
