title: EPISODE 189 - YOU ARE QUALIFIED
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 31st July, 2023 YOU ARE QUALIFIED " giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share in the inheritance of the saints (God’s people) in the Light. Colossians 1:12 (Amplified Bible) A young man who is born again said to me, "I don't feel righteous, my efforts are not enough and that is why I think I am not seeing the blessings of God. I don't deserve happiness and cannot match up with the standards of this world"He was saying these things with tears in his eyes. I looked at him in the eye and asked him if he is born again?He was like, "I am really born again. Please, I also know the scriptures very well. I have received Jesus into my heart. I believe and know the blood of Jesus has cleansed all my sins. However, I still don't feel qualified looking at my continuous mistakes"I was moved with compassion for the young man. And I also thought, there could be many more people in this condition.The challenge is not how you feel, the challenge is your level of understanding.Understanding of what Christ has done for you and in you will translate into how you confront daily life situations. Don't just be aware of what the Lord has done for you, make a decision to walk in understanding.You are not who you are in Christ by how you feel. You are who are in Christ by what He has done. Therefore, you don't judge the reality of your life in Christ by how you feel or by what you do but what Christ has done.You don't try to do good to be qualified. You are qualified to be a partaker of the inheritance of the saints in the light, by the goodness of Christ. You don't get yourself qualified by your deeds and neither are you disqualified by your deeds. You are qualified by the Father through Christ.Just as you are not delivered from the power of darkness by your self-effort, in that same light you are not qualified to enjoy your inheritance in Christ by your self-efforts. " giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share in the inheritance of the saints (God’s people) in the Light. For He has rescued us and has drawn us to Himself from the dominion of darkness, and has transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son, in whom we have redemption [because of His sacrifice, resulting in] the forgiveness of our sins [and the cancellation of sins’ penalty]." Colossians 1:12-14 (Amplified Bible) What is the basis of your qualification to be a partaker of the inheritance of the saints? 1. For He has rescued us and has drawn us to Himself from the dominion of darkness, and has transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son. 2. In His Son we have redemption [because of His sacrifice, resulting in] the forgiveness of our sins [and the cancellation of sins’ penalty]. So to walk in the reality of your qualification in Christ, you don't have to look and live by the standards of this world. You don't also have to look at your mistakes. " It is not that we think we are qualified to do anything on our own. Our qualification comes from God." 2 Corinthians 3:5 (NLT) Did you see what Paul had to say about themselves?The moment you begin to think your qualification is according to your self-effort, you are thinking outside God's design of provision for you.Your enjoyment of the glorious inheritance in Christ, is dependent on Christ and your position in Him.You belong to the Kingdom of His Son, therefore you are qualified to enjoy the inheritance of the Kingdom.ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. *DIG DEEPER:*(Ephesians 1:18; Acts 20:32; Acts 26:18; Romans 15:18; 2 Corinthians 3:4-6)*WE PRAY*- Thank you Father for qualifying me to share in the inheritance of the saints.- That we will walk continually in the understanding and consciousness of this reality.*BIBLE READING*Day 176: Psalms 17-20*DECLARE THESE WORDS:*- I have been qualified.- I belong to the kingdom of God’s dear son.- I walk daily in the consciousness of this reality.- I share in the inheritance of the Kingdom.OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 190 - SUBMIT YOURSELF TO GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 1st August, 2023SUBMIT YOURSELF TO GOD"So submit to [the authority of] God. Resist the devil [stand firm against him] and he will flee from you." James 4:7 (Amplified Bible) The word 'submission' has been a "No...No" word for most people today. There are some of these people who grew in homes where love wasn't expressed. They saw their frustrated parents as tyrants. Some were forced to submit under strict ungodly rules and authorities in their schools or work places.
Others became victims of bullies who forced them to do things against their own will.
The wicked structure of the world has given people wrong impression about submission. They think submission is preached in Church, just to control people and force them to do things against their will. They have equated submission to fear and oppression. The adversary has succeeded in making people feel God has no good plans for them. Thus, submitting to God is never going to bring them to an expected glorious end.  This has always been the strategy of the enemy. These were the same seeds he sowed in the hearts of Adam, and generated unbelief. Read about YOUR SECURED FUTURE.
God has a beautiful plan for your life. And submitting to God, is submitting to a loving father.
If you can submit yourself to a pilot in a plane, then you should submit to God who made the universe.Submission to God, is bringing yourself under His influence and authority. It is yielding to His will for your life. Someone will say, "I said it, he wants me to submit to God against my will. Apostle is writing this to tell me to put my will aside and accept the will of God". Interesting, what is your will? Your will wasn't conditioned to function without God. A man's will is cultivated by his environment. Which means your will is always submitted to something.  And here, I am helping you find a better expression of your will.
Until you submit your will to the Lord, you cannot live according to God's original glorious design for you.
Submission to God is a sign of a matured life in Christ. A man who is submissive to God, walks in the obedience of God's word. The word of God becomes the light and arrangement of his thoughts and actions. A man who is submitted to God, cannot be controlled by the flesh and the world. Such a person exercises authority over the devil. So submit to [the authority of] God. Resist the devil [stand firm against him] and he will flee from you. James 4:7. To submit to God is the enjoyment of grace, direction and divine elevation. Shalom. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(James 4:1-7,10,13-15; 1 Peter 5:5-6; Job 36:22) WE PRAY- That our walk of faith will be in submission to God and His infallible word. - That we will commit ourselves to the instructions of the word of God. BIBLE READINGDay 177: Psalms 21-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit my will, emotions, thoughts and body to the Lord. - I am committed and devoted to the word of God. - The word of God directs my life. - I am not controlled by the flesh. - The word of God is a lamb unto my feet and a light unto my path. - The will of the Lord concerning my life prevails. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 191 - JUST THE SIMPLE THINGS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 2nd August, 2023 JUST THE SIMPLE THINGS " Look at the ships also: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are guided by a very small rudder wherever the will of the pilot directs." James 3:4 (ESV) I know you want to make a difference in your world and be the best that God has called you to be.However what do you think it entails?When most people look at those who are doing well in their field of ministry or vision, they assume it took a volume of many things for that to happen. Nevertheless what you should know is that, it doesn't take a volume of things to make a difference. It is instead the same little things you may be aware of that is needed for great success.Most of the big things you see are controlled by little but powerful elements.It only takes a small rudder to direct a whole huge or large ship. Success doesn't come by doing many things. It is simply giving attention to the basic instructions you are given and running with them consistently. Simple instructions such as, read your Bible daily , pray without ceasing , meditate on the Word, rejoice in the Holy Spirit, and act on the inspirations of the Lord can revolutionize your entire world.Such instructions can move you from being a low class, unrecognized and defeated fellow to a trangenerational leader.It will only take your dedication and consistency with the little instructions you are given, to make a difference in your world.Be faithful with the little things.Shalom!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 1:26-29; Galatians 5:9; Matthew 25:21; Matthew 17:20; Zechariah 4:10) WE PRAY- That we will take heed to every instruction and prompting of the Spirit to us, whether through the word, our man of God or to us personally. BIBLE READINGDay 178: Psalms 25-28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make time daily for the study of the word.- I make time daily for prayer and the meditation of the word.- I don’t trivialize my spirituality.- I take heed to the instructions of the Spirit of God through his word, my man of God and to me personally.- I am faithful in all things.OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 192 - BEGIN WITH GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 3rd August, 2023 BEGIN WITH GOD " In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. Genesis 1:1 (KJV) One of the beautiful things we will find in scriptures is how God has brought us into fellowship with Himself, through Jesus (1 Corinthians 1:9).To be in fellowship with God, is to be in communion and partnership with Him.God has brought us into this beautiful partnership for the fulfillment of His eternal purpose. He has the grand plan for our lives and we can only walk in the fulfillment of this plan as we walk with Him.In our walk with God, one is sometimes tempted to take a leap ahead of Him. This is because people assume there are a lot of delays in God's timing.Thus, they plan and take initiatives without God's direction. " Before you do anything, put your trust totally in God and not in yourself. Then every plan you make will succeed." Proverbs 16:3 (TPT) As one who has been translated into the Kingdom, you can only function effectively when you operate by the principle of the Kingdom you belong.As people of the Kingdom we function by faith, and there is no faith without God. Faith is acting with God's word. To act with God's word is to act with God.In the beginning GOD... (Genesis 1:1) Get this, the whole universe began with God.There is nothing done in the Kingdom without beginning first with God. You don't do anything without beginning with God.Begin everything with God and don't begin anything before God.SelahTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER:(Proverbs 16:1-3; Proverbs 3:5-7; Matthew 6:33) WE PRAY- That no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God but rather give God the preeminence in all things. BIBLE READINGDay 179:Psalms 29-31Matthew 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- In all my ways I acknowledge God.- I maintain absolute confidence in God.- I refuse to allow my feelings and decisions get in the way of God’s plan for my life.- I consult God first in my every decision.- I begin all things with God.OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 193 - WHAT IS IN YOUR HEART
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 4th August, 2023 WHAT IS IN YOUR HEART? " Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart Job 22:22 (NKJV) What you have in your heart is what distinct you. The difference between those who are bringing change to their world and those who are struggling to make an impact is what they have in their heart.Your heart is the governing seat of the Spirit. God cannot do anything through you beyond the condition of your heart.The state of your heart defines the extent you go with God.A wicked heart will produce wickedness. A merry heart will produce joy in his or her sphere.Whatever we see happen in our world is essentially the product of the condition of the hearts of men who have influence in the society.One cannot manifest what he has not conceived in his heart. When you conceive evil you will produce evil. When you conceive blessings and beauty you will produce blessings and beauty. " Peter asked Him, “Explain this parable [about what defiles a person] to us.” And He said, “Are you still so dull [and unable to put things together]? Do you not understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is eliminated? But whatever [word] comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what defiles and dishonors the man. For out of the heart come evil thoughts and plans, murders, adulteries, sexual immoralities, thefts, false testimonies, slanders (verbal abuse, irreverent speech, blaspheming)." Matthew 15:16-19 (Amplified Bible) See this also: "For the godless are barren: they can produce nothing truly good. God’s fire consumes them with all their possessions. The only thing they can ‘conceive’ is sin, and their hearts give birth only to wickedness.” Job 15:34-35 (TLB) When you conceive failure, defeats, poverty, wickedness, hatred, envy and afflictions in your heart that is what you will manifest or express.Men by their nature and their culturing without the word of God, are selfish at heart. And a selfish heart breeds, envy, hatred, anger, wicked thoughts etc. "The human heart is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked. Who really knows how bad it is?" Jeremiah 17:9 (NLT). See also: Genesis 6:5; 8:21; Ephesians 4:22.This is why at your new birth in Christ, God took away the stony heart to give you the new heart of grace.The Lord declared this through the Prophet Ezekiel, "Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. Your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols. And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a7 tender, responsive heart." Ezekiel 36:25-26 (NLT). See also 2 Corinthians 3:3; Jeremiah 24:7; Psalm 51:10.Now in as much as at new birth the Lord gave you a responsive heart, your heart must be cultivated and nurtured with the Word of God.The Word of God is the revelation of God's wisdom, His goodness and character.To demonstrate and express the character of God you need the Word in your heart. " How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word. With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments! I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you." Psalm 119:9-11 (ESV) When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualize God's goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART! To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(Deuteronomy 6:6;11:18; Psalm 37:31; Matthew 13:15; Colossians 3:16; 1 Timothy 4:15; Psalm 1:1-3) WE PRAY- That we will give heed to the instructions of the word of God. BIBLE READINGDay 180:Psalms 32-33Matthew 3-4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have invested the word of God in my heart, therefore none of my steps will slide.- I stay my mind and heart on God’s word.- My heart is a fertile and fruitful land for the word of God.- I give my mind daily to the mediation of the word.- I am cultured daily by the word of God..OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 194 - THE WORD CLEANSES YOU
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE WORD CLEANSES YOU " How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping watch [on himself] according to Your word [conforming his life to Your precepts]. Psalm 119:9 (Amplified Bible) Though at new birth we became citizens of Heaven, and were translated into the Kingdom of light, we are not taken out of the world.The Lord placed us in this world for the fulfillment of His eternal purpose. There is a mandate of the Kingdom in this world, and we are co-labourers with God in fulfilling His eternal assignment.We have a mandate to show forth the glory of the Lord, who called us out of darkness (1 Peter 2:9).Whiles we are in this world, our minds are still exposed to the corruptibility of the world and its systems.We are instructed through the epistles, not to be conformed to this world (Romans 12:2).As we are in this world, we may be confronted by thoughts and imaginations which can corrupt our hearts.However, the Lord did not only begat us anew by His Word, He also gave us His Word to inoculate us from the negative influences of the world.The Lord has complete provisions to keep us from failing and falling.Just because you are born again doesn't mean the adversary wouldn't throw arrows of doubts and lies towards you.You have to grow in the knowledge of Christ and be conformed to His image.Therefore, just as you have the Word as a:MirrorSword in our mouth Elixir for your Health The word of God is a detoxifier.It inoculates and detoxifies your mind from error.At new birth you were made clean by the Word and the Spirit.However, there is a continuous work of cleansing by the Word. " ...For he died for us, sacrificing himself to make us holy and pure, cleansing us through the showering of the pure water of the Word of God. All that he does in us is designed to make us a mature church for his pleasure, until we become a source of praise to him—glorious and radiant, beautiful and holy, without fault or flaw. Ephesians 5:25-27 (TPT). The cleansing of the Word is not a one time thing. It is a daily work of cleansing by the word of God.There are things you hear and see from different family settings, interaction with friends at school, work colleagues, and even your communities; which subtly cultivates your mind with toxic thought patterns and concept of life.Instead of thinking in conformity with the Word of Christ, you develop contradicting imagination.This is why you must intentionally give your mind to the Word.The Word in you, cleanses your heart and mind from poisonous utterances which may shipwreck your faith.The Word can build an automatic rejection mechanism in your heart, preventing any thought of darkness.And also before you got born again, your mind was exposed to different concepts of life, teachings and diverse culturing which contradicts the reality of the Kingdom. Thus, you must give yourself to the Word to continuously purify your mind. How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping watch [on himself] according to Your word [conforming his life to Your precepts]. Psalm 119:9 (Amplified). The Word of God purifies your mind and inoculates your heart from thoughts that cultivate fear, pride, sinfulness, selfishness, envy, and doubts.Sit under the waterfall of the Word every day.Have you fellowshipped with the WORD TODAY?Selah To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER:(John 17:17-19; John 15:3; Psalm 19:7-11; Psalm 119:11; Psalm 17:4;) WE PRAY:- That we will take heed and continue in the rich verities and virtues of the word. BIBLE READINGDay 181: Psalms 34-35Matthew 5-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I sanctify and purify my mind daily by the word.- I am immune from the negative influences of the world.- I enjoy a worry-free life.- Satan has nothing in me.- My heart is free from any thoughts which cultivates fear, pride, sinfulness, selfishness, envy and doubts.- I am in this world but I am not of this world.- I live my life with the revelation of a greater light.- I live from a higher realm of life.- I live above this world.- I live above sickness disease, fear, anxiety, depression, pain, sorrow and any weakness of this world.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! title: EPISODE 195 - AGREE WITH GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency AGREE WITH GOD " Quit quarreling with God! Agree with him and you will have peace at last!..." Job 22:21 (TLB) Your future and purpose in this world is not a mystery to God. He made and designed you as His workmanship unto good works which He has foreordained that you walk in them (Ephesians 2:10).When God is taking you through the process of greatness, you may easily be tempted to make your own decision and choose your own path.The process of God towards your greatness doesn't always look smooth, however, it has a beautiful end.God has not designed you to function in isolation. God wants to partner with you to achieve greatness.The thing is, God has structured His economy in such a way that, He does nothing on earth except through man.He has made man to be the conduit of His expression and glory on earth.For God to fully express Himself, He came as Man (John 1:18).He didn't appear as the greatest bird, the toughest four-legged animal, nor the most beautiful planet.Though these various creations of God points to His glory and reveal an element of God.Now for the Lord to fully walk with you and to function through you unto the express of Himself and the fulfillment of His purpose. There is a need for your decision.God did not make man to be a robot which functions without a will. He gave man a will to make choices or decisions.This is why God doesn't automatically share and work His Kingdom vision through every one.Though the Lord is with you always as born again, you must make a decision to agree with Him. " Can two walk together, unless they are agreed?" Amos 3:3 (NLJV). God wants to work with you as His partner, but He cannot work greatly with you, when you are not in agreement with His word. The first evidence of Partnership With God, is AGREEMENT WITH HIM. " Now yield and submit yourself to Him [agree with God and be conformed to His will] and be at peace; In this way [you will prosper and great] good will come to you. Job 22:21 (Amplified Bible) ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER:(Genesis 6:9; Genesis 17:1; Exodus 32:26; Joshua 24:15; Micah 4:5) WE PRAY:- That we will walk in agreement with God concerning His plans and purposes for our lives. BIBLE READINGDay 182:Psalms 36-37Matthew 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My life has already been preordained by God.- I walk in agreement with God daily.- I have burnt my bridges.- I cleave unto the will of God concerning my life.- I don’t doubt God, I fully agree with His will.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 196 - ARE YOU GOD'S PARTNER
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ARE YOU GOD'S PARTNER? "For we are partners working together for God, and you are God's field. You are also God's building" 1 Corinthians 3:9 (GNT) It is a beautiful and glorious thing to be saved.However, there is another great thing that you should experience in your new life in Christ. Which is to PARTNER WITH GOD.To Partner with God, is to work together with God for the fulfillment of His eternal purpose.God didn't just get you saved for you to live your own ambition. He gave you His life and brought you into His family so that He can partner with you to achieve His eternal purpose.To partner with God to achieve His eternal purpose is not automatic. You can be born again and not directly be involved in His work. There are times people think, they become partners or co-labourers with God the moment they become born again.To be a partner with God requires an intentional decision. You have to be intentional about being involved in God's work.You have to come to the place where you esteem the vision of God above your own personal interest.Look at the testimony of Paul concerning Timothy : " But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so that I may also be encouraged by learning news about you. For I have no one else [like him who is] so kindred a spirit who will be genuinely concerned for your [spiritual] welfare. For the others [who deserted me after my arrest] all seek [to advance] their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ. But you know of Timothy’s tested worth and his proven character, that he has served with me to advance the gospel like a son serving with his father. Therefore, I hope [that it is His will] to send him immediately, just as soon as I see how my case turns out; and I trust [confidently] in the Lord that soon I also will be coming to you." Philippians 2:19-24 (Amplified Bible). Even in the first century Church there were people who pursued the advancement of their own interest and not the things of Christ. However, Timothy, served with Paul to advance the gospel. This is his tested worth and proven character as a son to Paul.Timothy and Paul intentionally made it their interest to work with God. It was not automatic that they made the things of our Lord Jesus their genuine interest and passion. They have to make a personal decision to be about the business of the Lord.The Lord doesn't just work with you. You have to first make a decision to step out there to do His work. Our Father doesn't force Himself on you, He works with you as you decide to make His work your priority. "And they went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word through the accompanying signs. Amen." Mark 16:20 (NKJV) Oh Hallelujah.1. They went out and preached everywhere. They decided to go out there to do the things of our Lord Jesus Christ.2. Then the Lord worked with them.Our Lord wouldn't force Himself on you to work with you, just because you are born again. He will stir up those desires in your heart to partner with you. However, the Lord will partner with you as long as you are willing to partner with Him to advance His course. ARE YOU A PARTNER WITH GOD? ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(Matthew 9:37; 1 Corinthians 3:6-11; 2 Corinthians 6:1) WE PRAY:- That we will yield ourselves to the desires of God in our hearts, in other to partner with God to advance His course. BIBLE READINGDay 183:Psalms 38-40Matthew 8-9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a partner with God.- I get busy with the Lord’s work.- I work together with God in the salvation of souls.- The Lord’s business is my business.- I don’t sit on the fence, I get to work.- I go all out in my partnership with God.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! title: EPISODE 197 - PARTAKERS OF THE DIVINE NATURE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 8th August, 2023 PARTAKERS OF THE DIVINE NATURE "by which have been given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, that through these you may be partakers of the divine nature..." 2 Peter 1:4 (NKJV) Whenever there is a discussion on "CO-LABOURING WITH GOD" or "PARTNERING WITH GOD"; this question often comes up:How can frail man partner or co-labour with God?And some people conclude that, man cannot be at the level to partner with God. God is enough to do what He wants to do. He doesn't need any man to do what He wants to do. Well, these may sound like a humble thought, but it is not consistent with scriptures. All through scriptures and at different times, we see God working together with His chosen men to achieve His plan. God worked with David to bring great victory to Israel. Consider Gideon and Sampson; how about the building of an ark?God didn't come down to build the ark, He worked through Noah. I believe you know God had to work through Moses to bring Israel out of Egypt. Now in the New Testament (I am not talking about the new testament portion of the Bible, but the New Testament economy), God is not just working through willing men. He has made it possible that all who shall receive the Life of Christ, may be partakers of His nature. At new birth, you received the life and the nature of God. Which means you are not some frail man, you are a new man with the divine life and nature. The new creation in Christ is not a mere man. The new creation in Christ is the righteousness of God in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21). And also God has given unto you, all things that pertain to life and godliness. You have the ability to express God. All that you need to walk with God has been given you. You have the divine life of God in you, His righteousness, His holiness, His wisdom and the inward capacity to carry God on your inside (for greater is He that is in you). As a new creation you are not ordinary. You have the capacity to be mingled with God and to function with Him.Hallelujah!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 4:24; 2 Peter 1:1-4; John 1:12; John 17:20-23; Galatians 2:20) WE PRAY:- That we will walk daily in the consciousness of this rich reality as we express the divine life in Christ. BIBLE READINGDay 184:Psalms 41-43Matthew 10-11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a partaker of the divine nature.- I am not ordinary.- I have all things that pertains to life and godliness.- I have a mingled life.- I walk daily in this consciousness.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! title: EPISODE 198 - STRENGTHENED FOR HIS WORK
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 9th August, 2023 STRENGTHENED FOR HIS WORK " And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord who has enabled me, because He counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry," 1 Timothy 1:12 (NKJV) God desires that you partner with Him for the fulfillment of His purpose.However, most people are threatened by the immensity of God's assignment and begin to shy away from getting involved.But you don't have to shy away from getting involved in God's work. God doesn't just put you in the ministry, He supplies you with all that you need to do what He wants you to do. " I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has granted me [the needed] strength and made me able for this, because He considered me faithful and trustworthy, putting me into service [for this ministry]," 1 Timothy 1:12 (Amplified Bible). The Lord gives you strength and ability; yours is to be counted faithful for His good work.As partners with God, you don't labour by your strength. " ...For by strength no man shall prevail." 1 Samuel 2:9 And you don't do what you can do, you do what God has strengthened you to do.No human strength can succeed at God's work. It will take the supply of His grace.Paul said here also; " Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God" 1 Corinthians 3:5 This is why you must pray!This is why you commune with the Holy Spirit.This is why you must depend on the Lord fully to do what He inspires you to do.Don't trust in your own strength; receive more and more strength from the Lord.Don't look at yourself and your skills. They are not enough for the Lord's work. The Holy Spirit is in you as the unending supply of the strength of God. Take advantage of your relationship with Him.ShalomTo be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 15:10; 2 Corinthians 4:1; Acts 9:22; Philippians 4:13)WE PRAY:- That we will take advantage of the sufficient ability of God within us.BIBLE READINGDay 185:Psalms 44-46Matthew 12-13DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My sufficiency is of the Lord.- The Holy Spirit is my strengthener.- I don’t lack strength.- I do all things by the enabling ability of God within me.- I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit.- Through prayer and the study of God’s word, I increase daily in strength.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! title: EPISODE 199 - IS GOD YOUR NUMBER ONE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 10th August, 2023IS GOD YOUR NUMBER ONE?" But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you Matthew 6:33 (KJV) When you read the above verse of the Bible what comes to mind?Interestingly, there are some who only see "and all these things shall be added".It is not God they seek first, it is the all things which shall be added they seek.Which is wrong!The focus of Matthew 6:33 is God and not the other things. Make Him your focus and motive. Don't pretend to be serving God, yet deep within your motive of action is the desire for things to be added to you and not God and His Kingdom.Another group of people have a different understanding of the phrase, "SEEK YE FIRST".To them, it means start your life with God, so that when a time comes you are too busy to be available for His Kingdom assignment He will understand.So at the beginning of their lives they pursue God. You will find them in Church; serving and participating in Kingdom activities. They are involved in personal prayers and Bible studies. As they grow in business, grow in their finances, get married, start having children etc, then they shift their attention to the family, business etc. Their sincere idea is that, they now have to focus on what God has given them, because they have made the necessary contribution in God's Kingdom or the Church.That is ignorance or misconception of our relationship with God.Others also have a list of priorities. To them God first means, "Make God number one". Thus, on their priority list they have:1. God (His Kingdom and Righteousness) first.2. Academics (if they are students)3. Family4. Work etcOthers have1. God first2. Marriage/Spouse3. Family4. Work etc...Which ever way they will outline their priority list, I want you to know that God doesn't need to be there as Number One.As a born-again, God has to be involved in every aspect of your life. He is not merely part of your list, He is your life and essence, that is the reality.For God to be the first, means He has to be the Chief of your life. He must be the first in every aspect of your life.This verse of scripture below should change your entire world view:  “In everything you do, put God first, and He will direct you and crown your efforts with success" Proverbs 3:6 (TLB) God must be the first in your ministry. People can do ministry for themselves and not for the Lord. He must be the first in your family and marriage. He must be the first in your academics, career or profession and work. In everything you do, God has to be the center of it all. For God to be the first means, He is the reason you do what you do. Don't just make Him Number 1 on your list. Nothing comes before Him and nothing comes after Him. He is the essence of all you do.Hallelujah!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER:(1 Chronicles 28:9; Provers 16:3,9; 1 Kings 8:61)WE PRAY:- Lord, I commit all [mention them] that concerns me into your hands, please direct my steps.BIBLE READINGDay 186:Psalms 47-49Matthew 14-15DECLARE THESE WORDS:- God is the essence of all that I do.- I involve God in everything I do.- I am in partnership with God.- The Lord directs my steps.- None of my steps will ever slide, because I have committed all that concerns me to the Lord.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 200 - HAVE YOU HEARD THIS GOOD NEWS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 11th August, 2023HAVE YOU HEARD THIS GOOD NEWS?!! Hurraaay" Jesus told him, “I am the Way—yes, and the Truth and the Life. No one can get to the Father except by means of me." John 14:6 (TLB) The opening scripture for today's with , is a package of glorious news to mankind and the saints in Christ.It doesn't just answer the question of Jesus' divinity, as in Jesus being God; it also reveals the answer to man's greatest challenge!!!When you see Jesus you have seen the Father, for He is one with the Father. Beloved Jesus is not a god, He is God (we will look more into this in other episodes).Jesus is not just showing you the way to the Father, He is not some sort of sign post.He is the means and the destination.This is not some mere religious clichè, it is the REALITY. You cannot access the Life of God without Jesus.And you know this reality is not just an information, it is a PERSON, and He is Jesus.Why the need for all mankind to be excited?After the fall of man (this also will be discussed in detailed later), God moved Adam from the garden of Eden. We see from scriptures, that when God moved man from the garden, He specifically denied man access to the Tree of Life. This is not necessarily punishment from God, but His plan to preserve man.When man committed the sin of unbelief (by rejecting God's instruction and believing in the lies of the adversary), corruption germinated in him. (Genesis 2:15-16; Genesis 3:1-11). Therefore for man to partake of the tree of life means, the corruption problem of man may be forever. The only way to solve the corruption of man is by means of death. "Then the Lord God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever”— therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken. He drove out the man; and at the east of the garden of Eden he placed the cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life" Genesis 3:22-24 (RSV) Now man can only access the Tree of life only by means of sacrificial death. The Tree of Life is the symbol of GOD'S ETERNAL LIFE.Man now doesn't have access to LIFE. There is the flaming sword of judgement. Who is qualified to suffer the punishment of death?There is a need for a saviour.Beloved, Jesus came that in Him we can have LIFE.How?He went through the way ahead of us, to suffer the death for mankind.He was slained by the sword of judgement. And in resurrection He became the ONLY WAY TO ACCESS ETERNAL LIFE.In the fall of man, you will find these items:tree, nakedness, shame, curse, thorns, sweat, death and sword (See Genesis 3).Our Lord Jesus came to write a better story of our lives.Jesus' sweat greatly for us; He was crowned with thorns; He was pierced by a sword; He died a naked and shameful death on a tree and became a curse for us.Man's relationship with God was broken in a garden (the garden of Eden). In a garden, Jesus announced the new beautiful relationship we have with God.You know, He was buried in a tomb in a garden (See John 19:41-42); and in His resurrection He said to Mary Magdalene: " ...go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God" John 20:17 (KJV). This is a glorious news.You are no more to be ashamed of God, as Adam and Eve were. In Christ Jesus, God has been made your Father.The way to the tree of Life in the garden is no longer guarded by cherubims and flaming sword.  JESUS IS THE WAY!!!HE IS THE TRUTH!!!HE IS THE LIFE!!!Now you have ACCESS to the Tree of LIFE in Christ!!! " And this is what God has testified: He has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life." 1 John 5:11-12 (NLT) Hallelujah!To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER: (John 3:15,36; John 10:9; John 1:4; Romans 5:2; Acts 4:12) WE PRAY: - Thanking God for the gift of His eternal life that we have received in Him. BIBLE READING Day 187: Psalms 50-52 Matthew 16-17 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I have access to eternal life now. - The eternal life of God is at work in me. - I share in the life and nature of God. - I am not ordinary. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 201 - THE BASTION OF TRUTH 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 12th August, 2023 THE BASTION OF TRUTH 1 “but if I am delayed, I write so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth”. 1 Timothy 3:15 (NKJV) You are likely to get more confused in this present pluralistic world. This is a world where everyone seems to have an opportunity to create their own contents. Even people who are living astray or struggling to get their lives together are pretending to be online coaches. In a world where we have people embittered by the wounds of broken homes, deceived by atheism, disdained by the society, blinded by the fables of traditions and religion; you will definitely be confronted by contradictory opinions. You may meet people with weird thoughts about how one has to live and relate with God. The world clearly without God is confused!!! God is not the author of confusion. (1 Corinthians 14:33) Confusion is not normal. Truth is not subjective. Truth is not determined by how one feels or think. People make their opinions and define their living by how they feel or think within a particular period. Feelings change and experiences differ. Truth is absolute! Truth is changeless! The systems and structures of this world are not built on Truth. They are mainly built on individual interests or greed. You can only find truth in God’s Kingdom. Jesus said, “I am the Way, the Truth and the Life.” (John 14:6). All the systems or structures of this world shall crumble (Psalm 46:6). They don’t carry eternal value. Therefore, don’t be conformed to this world though you are in the world (Romans 12:2; John 17:16). The most secured place is the Kingdom of God. And through Christ we are translated into this unshakable kingdom (Colossians 1:13; Hebrews 11:28). Jesus established His Church to be the organic expression of God’s Kingdom. The best place to consistently access Truth is Christ’s Church. Let not the world distract you. The Church is the only Pillar and ground of the Truth. It is the haven and bastion of divine reality. Through the Church, you are nurtured, equipped and deeply rooted in truth.” Then we will no longer be like children, forever changing our minds about what we believe because someone has told us something different or has cleverly lied to us and made the lie sound like the truth.” Ephesians 4:14 (TLB). Hallelujah! To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER: (Ephesians 4:11-20; Matthew 16:18-19; Acts 2:42,46) WE PRAY: That we may be deeply rooted in the truth of God, which is Christ. BIBLE READING Day 188: Psalms 53-56 Matthew 18-19 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am secured in the Kingdom of God. - I am deeply rooted in the truth of God, which is Christ. - I continue in this truth I have received. - I don’t give my hearing do any other voice aside Christ. - I refuse to conform to this world. - I belong to the unshakable Kingdom. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 202 - THE BASTION OF TRUTH 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 13th August, 2023 THE BASTION OF TRUTH 2 “ but if I am delayed, I write so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth”. 1 Timothy 3:15 (NKJV) From “ with ” Episode 201, we realized the best place to run to, amidst the uncertainties of this world, is the Church. For the Church is the organic expression of the unshakable Kingdom of God. The people of the world who see the Church as a threat would definitely have a different opinion about this. Nevertheless, the essence and the impact of the Church in the world cannot be denied. From the revelation of the scriptures, there is the affirmation of this truth of the Church and its purpose in this world. The Church is the herald of the glorious news of the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus. Apart from the Church, there is no other community of people anywhere in this world which presents and represents God’s Kingdom. You might have experienced some people within the Church who act contrary to the reality of the Kingdom of our Lord. But that doesn’t deny what the Church is – THE PILLAR OF TRUTH! Selfish men will always look for ways to creep into places and then attempt to make waste of gullible people. However, the light of the truth cannot be comprehended by any dimension of darkness. Don’t allow your experiences of some people within the Church to corrupt your love for the Lord, and then move you away from the community of the Church. Don’t allow your heart to be steered away from the glorious essence of the Church. The people within the True Church of our Lord Jesus, are being nurtured and built-up unto the measure and the stature of the fullness of Christ (Ephesians 4:13). Because of the truth of our Lord Jesus and the work of the Holy Spirit within the Church (the Body of Christ), it is without doubt that in the consummation of all things, the Church will be a spotless community. “ Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her, that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word, so that he might present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing, that she might be holy and without blemish.” Ephesians 5:25-27 (ESV) There is no single institution in this world, which is built on the foundation of the cravings of men that will not sink. Christ is the foundation of the Church, and He is the Truth. This means the Church is built on Truth and remains solidly strong beyond the end of time. “For no one can lay a foundation other than the one which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.” 1 Corinthians 3:11 (Legacy Standard Bible) Jesus Christ is the chief cornerstone of the Church (Ephesians 2:20). Knowing that Jesus Christ is the foundation and the chief cornerstone of the Church, we must have this unwavering assurance that to be built in the Church, is to be built in the bastion of truth. Talking about the Church, I am not speaking of your denomination. I am speaking of the community of Christ, the corporate body of all the saints who stand and walk in the sound doctrine and unadulterated gospel of our Lord Jesus. I am not talking about denominations where the gospel of our Lord Jesus is peddled and don’t esteem sound doctrine. Go for what the Word of God says, enjoy the revelation of Jesus. Don’t give your mind to empty traditions and human philosophies which end up in endless arguments. “ My counsel for you is simple and straightforward: Just go ahead with what you’ve been given. You received Christ Jesus, the Master; now live him. You’re deeply rooted in him. You’re well constructed upon him. You know your way around the faith. Now do what you’ve been taught. School’s out; quit studying the subject and start living it! And let your living spill over into thanksgiving. Watch out for people who try to dazzle you with big words and intellectual double-talk. They want to drag you off into endless arguments that never amount to anything. They spread their ideas through the empty traditions of human beings and the empty superstitions of spirit beings. But that’s not the way of Christ. Everything of God gets expressed in him, so you can see and hear him clearly. You don’t need a telescope, a microscope, or a horoscope to realize the fullness of Christ, and the emptiness of the universe without him. When you come to him, that fullness comes together for you, too. His power extends over everything.” Colossians 2:6-9 (Message Bible) The fullness of Christ is revealed through His Body which is the Church. The Church remains the only Bastion of Truth in this world; therefore, let nothing move you away from the Church! Be unwavering involved or part of what God is doing in His Church. Hallelujah! To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER: (Isaiah 28:16; Acts 4:11-12; Ephesians 5:6; Colossians 2:20; Romans 1:21,22; Hebrews 10:25) WE PRAY: That nothing shall sway us of the course of Christ established for us in the Church. title: EPISODE 203 - YOUR SPIRITUAL ROOT
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 14th August, 2023 YOUR SPIRITUAL ROOT “rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding in thanksgiving." Colossians 2:7 (ESV) Though man lives in a physical world, he is a spiritual being. When God made man, he formed the spirit of man. "The oracle of the word of the LORD concerning Israel: Thus declares the LORD, who stretched out the heavens and founded the earth and formed the spirit of man within him." Zechariah 12:1 (ESV). And God is a Spirit (John 4:24), therefore you can only contact Him by your spirit. This is the purpose of the spirit of man. It was designed and formed by God so that man can contact Him. After the fall of man in Eden, instead of his spirit being cultivated to have intimate relationship with God, man's spirit was corrupted and he became subjected to the flesh. The spirit of man was now yielded to darkness, instead of the light of God. Man couldn't have deep relationship with God. Man's spirituality was influenced by corruption and darkness. But now, when you became born again, the old spiritual self was terminated or died on the cross with Jesus (Galatians 2:20). Your spiritual root is no longer in the corruption of Adam. Your spirituality is rooted in the incorruptibility of Christ. In Christ, you have escaped the corruption of the world. And have a share in the divine nature of God. "And because of his glory and excellence, he has given us great and precious promises. These are the promises that enable you to share his divine nature and escape the world’s corruption caused by human desires." 2 Peter 1:4 (NLT) You are now a New Creation in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:17). Your spiritual root is now in the life of Christ Jesus. "Your spiritual roots go deeply into his life as you are continually infused with strength, encouraged in every way. For you are established in the faith you have absorbed and enriched by your devotion to him!" Colossians 2:7 (TPT). Your spiritual root is no longer in some traditions of men, Mosaic law, Jewish religion, ancient mystisicms, new age movement theories and your ungodly imaginations. Your spirituality is now deeply rooted in Christ. Knowing and understanding your spiritual root will define how you walk in dominion on earth. You are in Christ; who is your spiritual root. Draw inspiration and nourishment only from Him. Selah. DIG DEEPER: (Colossians 2:6-8; Ephesians 3:7; Colossians 1:23;Psalm 92:13; Psalm 1:3; John 15:4-5; Luke 6:48) WE PRAY: That we will grow and increase in the consciousness of this rich reality in exercising dominion on earth. BIBLE READING Day 190: Psalms 59-61 Matthew 21-22 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am deeply rooted in Christ. - I am nourished and enriched by Christ. - I am continually infused with strength in every way by my deep rootedness in Christ. - My spirituality is deeply rooted in the incorruptibility of Christ. - I share in the divine nature of God Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! title: EPISODE 204 - YOU ARE COUNTED IN THE FATHER'S FAMILY
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 15th August, 2023 YOU ARE COUNTED IN THE FATHER'S FAMILY “See how very much our Father loves us, for he calls us his children, and that is what we are! But the people who belong to this world don’t recognize that we are God’s children because they don’t know him." I John 3:1 (NLT) Many know God as: - the creator of the universe. - immutable and transcendent - omniscient and omnipresent -Judge of all, all-merciful and loving. Of all the revelations you may have about God, His greatest desire is for you to know Him as THE FATHER. God didn't create the universe just to be known as the all-powerful creator. He made the universe to create an envious haven for His family. God made man to have a family of love. Knowing and understanding God as your Father, is the most beautiful thing that will happen to you. God didn't create man because He is in pursuit of worshippers. God created man to bring man into the participation of His life where man will share in His life and nature. God wanted man's true spiritual nature to be rooted in His Family. He wants you to be identified in His family and not some mere biological family. "Long before he laid down earth’s foundations, he had us in mind, had settled on us as the focus of his love, to be made whole and holy by his love. Long, long ago he decided to adopt us into his family through Jesus Christ. (What pleasure he took in planning this!) He wanted us to enter into the celebration of his lavish gift-giving by the hand of his beloved Son." Ephesians 1:4-6 (MSG) This was the heartbeat of His Salvation plan. To establish His eternal family. His Salvation plan was to have sons. As I said in the previous episode: Man couldn't have deep relationship with God because of the fall; and His spirituality was now corrupted through unbelief. So at new birth, the power of God terminates the old corrupted spiritual self, for the new life of Christ to germinate in you. This is what qualified you to be in the family of God. Look at what Paul the apostle says here: "And now, because we are united to Christ, we both have equal and direct access in the realm of the Holy Spirit to come before the Father! So, you are not foreigners or guests, but rather you are the children of the city of the holy ones, with all the rights as family members of the household of God." Ephesians 2:18-19 (TPT) Your true Family root is not in this world. Your true Family root is in God. You are part of God's eternal incorruptible Family. Let this be your consciousness. Selah. DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 1:4-11; 1 John 3:1-2; Ephesians 3:14-19; Galatians 3:26-28) WE PRAY:- Thank you Father qualifying me to be part of your eternal incorruptible Family. - That we will mature in the consciousness of this rich reality. BIBLE READINGDay 191Psalms 62-64Matthew 23-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I belong to the eternal incorruptible Family of God.- I am deeply rooted in Christ.- I am nourished and enriched by Christ.- I am the focus of the love of God.- I am made whole and holy by His love.- I am a partner together with God. title: EPISODE 205 - THE WOMB FOR DIVINE CIVILISATION
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 16th August 2023 THE WOMB FOR DIVINE CIVILISATION “God decided in advance to adopt us into his own family by bringing us to himself through Jesus Christ. This is what he wanted to do, and it gave him great pleasure.” Ephesians 1:5 (MSG) God’s salvation plan is to bring man into His family. The essence of our sonship is to reveal the Fatherhood of God. God takes delight in His Fatherhood. His desire to have a family wasn’t because He was lonely; it was because He wanted to share His love and inheritance of glory with others. A family is a group of people related by blood, birth, marriage, or adoption. It is also a group of things related by common characteristics and nature or a group of people united by a unique conviction. Interestingly, a family also functions as a womb, where lives and destinies are nurtured, cultured, nourished, preserved, and equipped until one is ready to be delivered. A person’s civilization is deeply rooted in the family system. A family has a key role to play in shaping the mindset of people. And that is why the adversary takes an interest in destroying families, just to destroy society. The prosperity of every society and civilization can be traced to the success of families as one of the key ingredients. It is a bedrock of future excellence or failures. Most children who grew up in broken or disintegrated homes or families are most likely to experience rejection, anxiety, depression lack of confidence, and develop hatred. The family unit is God’s strategic wisdom for effective discipleship. It is a development center for every member of the kingdom. Through the family unit, children get to experience true love, care and discipline. God said to Abraham: “In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.” Genesis 22:18 (NKJV) Now we can see also how God had confidence in Abraham: “For I have chosen him, that he may command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing righteousness and justice, so that the LORD may bring to Abraham what he has promised him.” Gensis 18:19 (ESV) What God said concerning Abraham and how he will command his household reveals God’s intention about every household or family. Each household or family is a womb or bedrock of a certain civilization. A divine family will produce a divine civilization. God brought us into His family so that He will bring us into His civilization. It is only in the family of God we are raised and nurtured to think according to the divine light. Every level of civilization is defined by the degree of light at work. God’s family is a household of light. It is also the household of faith. As sons of God, we are not to function according to the systems of this world. We are to operate in the light of divine revelation. The civilization of God’s Kingdom can only be manifested on earth through the family of God. The Church of our Lord Jesus is not only the body of Christ, the Church is also the family of God. It is the bedrock of divine civilization. As a new creation you are not an Island, you are born into God’s family to be cultured with the light of God, through the Church. True civilization is in the Family of God, identified on earth as the Church. Selah. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org. DIG DEEPER: (Ephesians 1:11; Romans 8:29; John 1:12; Psalm 145:4 ) WE PRAY: That we will yield ourselves to the true civilization of God’s Family on earth which is the Church. BIBLE READING Day 192 Psalms 65-67 Matthew 25-26 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I belong to the eternal incorruptible Family of God. – I am deeply rooted in Christ. – I am nourished and enriched by Christ. – I am the focus of the love of God. – I am made whole and holy by His love. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 206 - THE HOUSEHOLD OF FAITH
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 17th August, 2023THE HOUSEHOLD OF FAITH “Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all, especially to those who are of the household of faith” Galatians 6:10 (NKJV) Your socialization can be influenced by the kind of family or household you belong to. The way you think and act is influenced by your family. A family is a fundamental institution or agency where a person is introduced to his/her culture, identity and develops certain behavioral patterns.When you become born again, you are brought into the family of God. God’s family has an identity, culture, and pattern of behaviour or character. Every family’s identity is connected to the head of the family. God is by Himself the identity of His family.One of the key items God dispenses into those who receive His life is FAITH. You become born again by the Word of God.“for you have been born again… through the living and enduring word of God” 1Peter 1;23 (NASB)The Word of God produces faith in your heart (Romans 10:17).This means anyone who is born again has FAITH. Faith is the character and currency by which the life of God is lived. The people of the household (family) of God live by Faith.“For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”  Romans 1:17(Bereans Study Bible).As a new creation or born again you were begotten into God’s family by faith, therefore you are to live by faith.To live by faith is not a suggestion; it is the identity of those born into God’s household. The Church which is the embodiment of God’s family, is a household of faith. It is the aggregation of men who are cultured, live, think, speak, and function by faith. The family or household of God is not a household of cowards. Anyone who belongs to this household must live, think and act by faith.In the household of God faith is our language, we don’t speak doubts nor do we think impossibilities.Hebrews 11 reveals the faith of the patriarchs and how their faith is completed in the New Testament.“These were the true heroes, commended for their faith, yet they lived in hope without receiving the fullness of what was promised them. But now God has invited us to live in something better than what they had—faith’s fullness! This is so that they could be brought to finished perfection alongside of us.” Hebrews 11:39-40 (TPT)In the New Testament, we have the fullness of Faith. This is because in Christ we are not just hoping for a reality to manifest. In Christ, we have the substance and reality of faith. Our walk is not because of fear or because we may fail. Our walk and communication are rooted in the victory of Christ. We don’t live as people who are in search of victory. In every situation, we live as Overcomers!“For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world — our faith.” 1 John 5:4 (NKJV) Whatever or whoever is born of God, into the household of God has overcome the world through Faith!Are you of God’s household?Then you are part of men who function by faith. You don’t have to permit defeat and failure in your sphere because you are born of God. You don’t speak failure and defeat. You have the faith of God in you, function in that capacity.Selah.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mailon partnerwithus@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER:(Hebrews 11; Ephesians 2:19; Galatians 3:9) WE PRAY:That we will walk daily in the consciousness of the capacity of the faith of God at work in us. BIBLE READINGDay 193Psalms 68-70Matthew 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I belong to the eternal incorruptible Family of God.– I am deeply rooted in Christ.– I am nourished and enriched by Christ.– I am the focus of the love of God.– I am made whole and holy by His love.– I am a partner together with God.– I am born of God.– I don’t permit defeat or failure in my sphere. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 207 - WHO IS YOUR FRIEND
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 18th August, 2023 WHO IS YOUR FRIEND? "Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good morals.” 1 Corinthians 15:33 (NASB) Friendship is not evil nor wrong. Friendship can help you in many ways as you journey into greatness. However, the company of friends you keep will determine if you will arrive at that greatness you have envisioned or not.Many great destinies have been crushed because of the associations they kept. The thing is, whether you want it or not, your friends will influence you in a particular way. You cannot be prayerful when your friends are not prayerful. It doesn't matter how prayerful you are, when you keep those friends for long, and you don't see them becoming prayerful, you must know that your prayerlessness has become worse than theirs. Your burning desire of love for the Lord can be watered down by wrong association. Imagine being in a company of gossips? Precious one, your days will be flooded with negativity, conflicts and emotional disturbance.You may even develop hatred for people God has sent to strengthen you, and you will avoid them because of a gossip. Instead of discerning the integrity of the hearts of people, you will discredit them; because a gossip you call a friend couldn't keep his or her mouth shut. Do you have a friend who is always or often talking about the weakness of others? Some friends will even use the excuse of "let’s pray for someone" to talk about people in a way that will sow seeds of bitterness and pain in your heart. And instead of praying for others you will be embittered. Be careful of such friends. Friends who cannot keep secrets of others are dangerous. They will soon announce your weakness and wrongs to the world. "A gossip goes around spreading rumors, while a trustworthy man tries to quiet them." Proverbs 11:13 (TLB) Such gossips are also judgmental and legalistic. They are always wise in their eyes and act as though they are fighting evil. Yet whiles they are busily denigrating, condemning and spreading rumours of others, God is patiently working on and building those same people they are denigrating. “Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs, that it may benefit those who listen."Ephesians 4:29 These two verses above really saved me from a lot of damage. When you are in a company of an angry friend, you will soon be influenced or affected by their approach to life. " Make no friendship with an angry man, and with a furious man do not go, Lest you learn his ways and set a snare for your soul". Proverbs 22:24-25 (NKJV) See the same verses in the The Passion Translation: "Walk away from an angry man or you’ll embrace a snare in your soul by becoming bad-tempered just like him”. Now you shouldn't assume you are too strong and cannot be corrupted by the wrong companions. "Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good morals.” 1 Corinthians 15:33 Now in this verse of scripture, Paul was specifically speaking to the saints to avoid those who speak against the resurrection of Jesus. Having a company of friends who don't believe in Jesus, and you are always spending time together with them all in the name of soul-winning, will corrupt your faith. Seek counsel immediately from your Church leader. This doesn't suggest you should live like an island. God didn't create us to be isolated from every one. He shows us the importance of having good friends "And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works, not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another." Hebrews 10:24-25 You wouldn't always have friends who don't have any weakness. Definitely people may have their own weaknesses. However, do they see it as weakness? Are they making efforts to seek help? Or they don't even think it is a weakness and feel they are right to behave that way? "A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity." Proverbs 17:17 A true friend doesn't take pride in the failure of others. A true friend is a shield of strength. Maintain a company of friends who inspire you with the vision of God and direct your passion towards the Lord. "Sweet friendships refresh the soul and awaken our hearts with joy, for good friends are like the anointing oil that yields the fragrant incense of God’s presence." Proverbs 27:9 (TPT) Friends who overwhelm you with wise counsel of the Lord are treasures. Who is your friend? Selah. DIG DEEPER:(Proverbs 13:20; 27:17; Psalm 1:1; Psalm 101:5-6; Proverbs 16:28-29; John 15:14; James 4:4; Proverbs 22:11; 1 Thessalonians 5:11) WE PRAY:That through wisdom, we will discern and demonstrate the righteousness of God in every relationship. BIBLE READINGDay 194Psalms 71 - 73 Mark 1- 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am mindful of my association.- I demonstrate wisdom in all my relationships.- Through the wisdom of the scriptures, I guide my heart with all diligence.- I make the right judgment in all things.- I don’t glory in the weaknesses of others.- Through love I strengthen others.- I am full of wisdom.- I am full of love. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 208 - UPON ALL FLESH
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 19th August, 2023 UPON ALL FLESH "In the last days,’ God says, ‘I will pour out my Spirit upon all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams." Acts 2:17 (NLT) It was always the desire of God to see people walk in the power of the Holy Spirit. God didn't intend that just few people will be anointed with the Holy Spirit.   There is no effective Kingdom or spiritual leadership without the Holy Spirit.  No one can do anything great with God without the help of the Spirit of God. Therefore God pouring out His Spirit upon all flesh, was a global ordination of people into greater works. And most people disqualify themselves from the idea that they are anointed by God to work with Him. They even think they don't have "enough" of the Holy Spirit. Some others also esteem themselves to have more of the Holy Spirit than others. Such thoughts are hewn out of the old covenant experiences. Before the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, it was just some few people who experienced the power of the Spirit upon them. These people didn't even have a personal relationship with the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit upon them was an empowerment for service. The Spirit came upon individuals; thus, it wasn't a universal outpouring. See this for example: "When the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer for the children of Israel, who delivered them: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother. The Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel. He went out to war, and the Lord delivered Cushan-Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed over Cushan-Rishathaim." Judges 3:9-10 (NKJV). You will find similar experiences all through the Old Testament portion of the Bible. And it was just few individuals who had this experience. However, in the New Testament, God fulfilled His own heart desire. God, through the Prophet Joel, announced the outpouring of His Spirit upon all flesh, hundreds years before it was fulfilled in Acts 2. See the prophecy: "And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions." Joel 2:28. Our Lord Jesus also gave the promise of the Holy Spirit: "And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever" John 14:16 (NKJV). During one of the great feast, Jesus openly announced the experience of the outpouring of the Holy Spirit. "Believe in me so that rivers of living water will burst out from within you, flowing from your innermost being, just like the Scripture says!” Jesus was prophesying about the Holy Spirit that believers were being prepared to receive. But the Holy Spirit had not yet been poured out upon them, because Jesus had not yet been unveiled in his full splendor" On the 50th day (called Pentecost) after the death of Jesus (Passover); the promise of the Holy Spirit was fulfilled. "But this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel: ‘And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, that I will pour out of My Spirit on all flesh; your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your young men shall see visions, your old men shall dream dreams." Acts 2:16-17 (NKJV). All who believed in the Lord Jesus, received the Holy Spirit and utterance to prophesy. Now as many people who will believe in Jesus will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.  It doesn't matter your background, age, race, tribe, nationality and social status, you have access to the Holy Spirit just as those called into the five-fold ministry. There is no discrimination!  THE SPIRIT IS POURED UPON ALL FLESH! He is not for some few people. All flesh (people) can receive the Holy Spirit, as they believe and receive Jesus. Anyone who has believed in the Lord Jesus, has the gift of the Holy Spirit. You have the ability of God in you. You only grow in the anointing of the Holy Spirit as you maintain an intense intimate relationship with Him. You have the Holy Spirit in you, just as it was within the Apostles. You have the ability of God for greater works. Selah.  DIG DEEPER:(Acts 1:18; 2:1-21, 32-33; John 4:14; Isaiah 44:3;35:6; Psam 72:6; Acts 10:45) WE PRAY:That we will mature and maintain an intense intimate relationship with Him. BIBLE READINGDay 195Psalms 74 -76Mark 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the ability of God at work in me.- I am enabled daily by the Holy Spirit.- I am anointed with the Holy Spirit.- I walk in the power of the Holy Spirit. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 209 - EVERYTHING YOU TOUCH CAN BE GOLD
content: The Love-Life Agency CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY EVERYTHING YOU TOUCH CAN BE GOLD "The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands" Deuteronomy 28:12 (NIV) It's easy to feel less blessed when you're overwhelmed with challenges. Sometimes when it looks like nothing seem to work, you will begin to feel like God's promises aren't for you. You look at others and really feel they are blessed and everything is working successfully in their lives. You may also wonder if it is possible for a person to have: - Beautiful marriage and blessed children.- Prosperous careers or profession and business.- Outstanding Ministry.- A dignified and peaceful life Beloved, this is God's design for your life. You can enjoy a life more beautiful and glorious than it was in "Eden". Let this sink deep in your heart, the outcome of your life is what you believe with your heart. Do you believe that you can have a life full of glory and beauty? Hear this, all things are possible to them that believe (Mark 9: 23). “All things” here means all things. Whether you read it in Hebrew, Greek, Latin, French, English, etc. ALL THINGS MEANS ALL THINGS! Whatever you believe will gravitate towards you. Do not accept the idea that your life is full of struggle. Hold on to the word of God. As you act in complete obedience of faith to the word of God, you will see the manifested glory of the word. The blessing of the word of God is not for some limited people. It is for those who believe! Maintain this strong mentality of faith, that you are a blessed man. Let it be your consciousness that your hands are so blessed that everything you touch will turn to gold. Wherever you go and whatever you do is prosperous because God is with you. No matter the challenge you will emerge strong, with mighty testimonies "When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; And through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you will not be scorched, Nor will the flame burn you." Isaiah 43:2 (AMP) No challenge is bigger than you. Whatever comes in contact with you will become a the center of attraction. Always see yourself as the one with the blessed hands. The more you think this way, the more all things align for your good. DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 28:1-14; Job 23:10; Deuteronomy 30:9; Genesis 39:3) WE PRAYThat we will grow deep in the consciousness that whatsoever our hands touch will turn into gold. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 196:Psalms 77-78Mark 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Whatever I touch turns to Gold.- I am a blessed man.- Wherever I go and whatever I do is prosperous because God is with me.- No matter the challenge, I will emerge strong with mighty testimonies.- No challenge is bigger than me.- Whatever comes in contact with me will become the center of attraction.- I have blessed hands. Oh Hallelujah, glory!   [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 210 - SEE POSSIBILITY WITH GOD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, August 21 2023 SEE POSSIBILITY WITH GOD "But Jesus looked at them and said, "With men it is impossible, but not with God; for with God all things are possible." Mark 10:27 (NKJV) Whatever God is involved in, life comes out of it. The earth was without form and was void; yet the moment the Lord's presence and Word went forth, light was generated. "In the beginning God (Elohim) created [by forming from nothing] the heavens and the earth. The earth was formless and void or a waste and emptiness, and darkness was upon the face of the deep [primeval ocean that covered the unformed earth]. The Spirit of God was moving (hovering, brooding) over the face of the waters. And God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light." Genesis 1:1-3 (AMP). Nothing plus God is everything. Darkness plus God is light. Impossible situations plus God is possibilities. By all standards of human intelligence there was no way:- Israel could have passed through the red sea and to defeat Pharoah with his army.- David could have defeated Goliath. Yet with God he defeated Goliath. He said "You come to me carrying a sword and spear and javelin as your weapons, but I come armed with the name of the Eternal One, the Commander of heavenly armies, the True God of the armies of Israel, the One you have insulted" 1 Samuel 17:45 (Voice) - there was no way Nehemiah could have built the walls of Jerusalem in the face of such fierce opposition.- there was no way the four Hebrew boys could have survived such burning furnace.Look at what Nicodemus said to Jesus? " This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him.” John 3:2 (NKJV). One of the most impossible things in the entirety of the universe was for God to indwell man. The reality of salvation seem impossible. Yet Jesus, said WITH GOD ALL THINGS ARE POSSIBLE! If only you can see it, you will experience it. The thing is, most people are not conscious of the presence of the Lord in their lives.Others also don't consciously allow God's ability to find expression in their situation. Stop having confidence in men, their systems and their intelligence more than GOD. Have confidence in what GOD have said in His word. No matter the size of the situation maintain absolute confidence in the Word of God.  Listen, "God is not man, that he should lie, or a son of man, that he should change his mind. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not fulfill it?" Numbers 23:19 (NLT) With God all things are possible. Stop seeing impossibility! Shalom  DIG DEEPER:(2 Kings 3:18; Jeremiah 23:17; Matthew 19:26; Job 42:2; Luke 1:37;) WE PRAY:That we will be strengthened by God to see possibilities in all things even in hopeless situations. BIBLE READING:Day 196:Psalms 79-81Mark 6-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I believe that with GOD all things are possible.- I refuse to see impossibilities.- In all things and through all things, I believe in the GOD who calls forth things which don’t exist to appear as though they exist.- Nothing is strong enough to make me doubt GOD.- No challenge is bigger than me. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 211 - ...BUT YOUR WILL... 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, August 22, 2023...BUT YOUR WILL... 1“Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.” Luke 22:42 (Berean Standard Bible). Every inventor has an intention for his or her invention. Nobody creates or invents a product without a purpose.
