The inventor programs his or her invention to function according to the intended purpose. For example, different types of vehicles help us to facilitate varieties of daily tasks. Imagine using four to six wheelers for water communication. For water communication, we use boats and vessels. Unless there is an improvement of the programming of wheelers. God is the creator of the universe. He made man and designed Him for the good pleasure of His will. (Genesis 1:1; 27) The difference between man and all other created things is the components which make man. And one crucial item within man's being that gives him a sense or ability of independence is THE WILL. Man is not an outgrowth of an existing creature. Man is a grand designed work of the Creator. God was intentional about how He wanted man to be. God made man to be the crown of all His creation. He didn't make man to be chained or locked up in a mechanical design and pattern of living. He made man to have the ability to decide and to choose.  Of all of His creation, God said to Himself (at the Divine Council): "Then God said, “Let Us (Father, Son, Holy Spirit) make man in Our image, according to Our likeness [not physical, but a spiritual personality and moral likeness]; and let them have complete authority over the fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the cattle, and over the entire earth, and over everything that creeps and crawls on the earth." Genesis 1:26 (AMP). For man to have the moral likeness of God, it was necessary for man to share in the ability or power to make a choice. This is the power of the Will of Man. God gave man a will that by that will, man can decide for himself how he wants his life to be lived. This reveals the kind of relationship God wanted to have with man. God didn't want His relationship with man to be based on chain-of commands. He wanted to have a fellowship of love and life with man. Which means man will not obey the commands and will of God mechanically but organically. Man has to choose to walk in the will of God or to walk in His own will. This makes the relationship God wants to have with man to be authentic and organic. It has to be an authentic interdependence. God is love and doesn't want to impose His will on any man.  Ultimately, the essence of the universe and all creation is according to the good pleasure of God's Will. Therefore, in as much as man has the power to function according to his own will and to make his own choices, His true fulfillment of life finds absolute expression in the GOOD PLEASURE OF GOD'S WILL. God wants man to willingly accept to walk in His ultimate WILL. Even when God became man (Jesus), He has to decide between His Will in time or His eternal WILL. And by the grand design of God's eternal will, He has to become sin to terminate the nature and power of sin. (John 1:29; 2 Corinthians 5:21). This was going to separate Him from His eternal nature and reality for a moment. The question is: - Was God going to go by His will in time (not to yield to the burden of becoming sin and the momentary separation from His nature)? - Or He is going to yield to His eternal plan and will which was established from the foundation of the earth? (See Acts 2:23; Revelation 13:8) Though God gave man the will to make his or her individual choices and decisions; in the heart of every man, God has woven the desire of His plan. He has put a longing for eternal fulfillment in every man's heart.  "He has made everything beautiful and appropriate in its time. He has also planted eternity [a sense of divine purpose] in the human heart [a mysterious longing which nothing under the sun can satisfy, except God]—yet man cannot find out (comprehend, grasp) what God has done (His overall plan) from the beginning to the end." Ecclesiastes 3:11 (AMP) So man also at every point, may have to choose between fulfilling their own desires and will or God's eternal desire and will. You have to make a decision whether the life you have will be lived according to your will or God's Will. You have to come to a point to say, YES I HAVE THE POWER TO CHOOSE WHAT I WANT, YET NOT MY WILL BUT THE WILL OF GOD. Selah DIG DEEPER(Matthew 26:39; Matthew 6:10; Psalm 40:8; John 4:34; John 5:30; Proverbs 19:20-22) WE PRAYThat in all things we will yield ourselves to walk in the ultimate WILL of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 197:Psalms 82-84Mark 8-9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I choose to walk in the will of God everyday. - I refuse to yield to my will.- Through prayer and the study of the word, I am strengthened to walk in the ultimate Will of God for my life.- I walk in agreement with God in all things.- I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, glory! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 212 - ...BUT YOUR WILL... 2
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, August 23 2023...BUT YOUR WILL... 2“Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.” Luke 22:42 (Berean Standard Bible). Beloved, by the revelation of scriptures, and from previous discussions we had in other episodes of with , we will realize that man has a crucial role to enact in the fulfillment of God's eternal plan and purpose. Just as I mentioned in the first part of this discussion; God as the creator has an intention for His creation. Just as every inventor has an intention for his or her invention. God made us to be His workmanship unto good works (Ephesians 2:10). He also designed man to have an organic partnership with Him. God didn't make man just to exhibit His creative ability.  When He made man: - He gave man a spirit (Zechariah 12:1; Ecclesiastes 12:7; Isaiah 42:5; Numbers 26:22), so that man will be able to relate with Him. Remember, God is a Spirit (John 4:24). - He made man a living soul. Genesis 2:7 (which includes the mind, the will and the emotions). God gave man a mind (Psalm 139:13-16) to be able to reason.  - He gave man a will to make decisions and choices (Genesis 2:16-17; John 1:12-13). - He gave man emotions to feel and interpret his or her experiences and He also gave man a body to function in this physical world. (See also 1 Thessalonians 5:23) These items reveal how God designed man in other to have a well structured partnership with him. By these items it becomes possible for God to work together with man to achieve His eternal purpose through time. These also reveal how man can choose to live independent of God. Though man can only achieve God's intention when He has an interdependence with Him. Surely, God made you to partner with Him to achieve His purpose.  "For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them." Ephesians 2:10 (NKJV) God doesn't force you to live and function according to His will. To work with God and experience true fulfillment, you must willingly make a decision to function according to His WILL. Noah has to make a choice to believe in God's word to build an ark before the flood. Others had the opportunity to join him, but they refused. Abraham had to willingly leave his father's house to a land God will show him. And through that step of faith, all nations were blessed through him. Joseph had to make a decision to honor God and to reject Potipher's wife. David had to make a choice to stand with the Lord and to stand up for His people. Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah decided to stand with God and not to bow to any other God, irrespective of the threat and danger. Despite the persecutions, the apostles and disciples of Jesus did not turn away, but continued to preach and spread the gospel of our Lord. You can decide to do things according to your will or according to the will of God. The choice is with you. It is time to say, LORD not my will BUT YOUR WILL! Selah DIG DEEPER(Matthew 26:39; Matthew 6:10; Psalm 40:8; John 4:34; John 5:30; Proverbs 19:20-22) WE PRAYThat in all things we will yield ourselves to walk in the ultimate WILL of God.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 198: Psalms 85-88Mark 10-11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I choose to walk in the will of God. - I refuse to yield to my will.- Through prayer and the study of the word, I am strengthened to walk in the ultimate Will of God for my life.- I walk in agreement with God in all things.- I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 213 - LIVE BY REVELATION
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, August 24 2023LIVE BY REVELATION“Jesus answered by quoting Deuteronomy: “It takes more than bread to stay alive. It takes a steady stream of words from God’s mouth." Matthew 4:4 (MSG)  The challenges or situations which confront you are not the determinants of your failure. It is your level of revelation that determines the outcome of your life. You cannot live a glorious life above your revelation. The greatest source of accurate and true revelation of life is THE WORD OF GOD. The reality is, God made the universe and invested principles to govern the universe. You can best understand God's design for your life through the Word of God. It is through God's word that you can access true revelation. And the revelation you receive ushers you into a dimension of understanding. "Here are kingdom revelations, words to live by, and words of wisdom given to empower you to reign in life, written as proverbs by Israel’s King Solomon, David’s son. Within these sayings will be found the revelation of wisdom and the impartation of spiritual understanding. Use them as keys to unlock the treasures of true knowledge. Those who cling to these words will receive discipline to demonstrate wisdom in every relationship and to choose what is right and just and fair." Proverbs 1:1-3 (TPT) The word of God will impart you with divine revelation and understanding for your victorious living. This is why you must esteem the Word. Until you esteem the Word of God you will not be able to glean the revelation of your living. This can affect how you pray. There are people who spend time praying a lot and don't see results of their prayers. And then they begin to wonder why they don't see answers.  The question you need to answer is the basis of your prayer.  Do you pray by frustration or you pray by revelation? How do you relate with things and handle situations? You can only reign in life or exercise dominion by your revelation. It doesn't matter the complexity of life and situations, when you catch the right revelation of the word, you will dissolve hard situations and challenges. Every problem you face, is a revelation or wisdom problem. "These kingdom revelations will break open your understanding to unveil the deeper meaning of parables, poetic riddles, and epigrams, and to unravel the words and enigmas of the wise." Proverbs 1:6 (TPT). Glory to God. Beloved, live and depend on the Word of God for by it you are illuminated with the right revelation of life. Selah DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 2:8-12; Deuteronomy 8:3; Romans 15:4; Daniel 2:19-23) WE PRAYThat through the revelation of the word we will demonstrate the wisdom of God in all facets of our lives.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 199:Psalms 89-91Mark 12-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am in this world but I am not of this world.- I live my life with the revelation of a greater light.- I live from a higher realm of life.- I live above this world.- I live above sickness disease, fear, anxiety, depression, pain, sorrow and any weakness of this world.- I guard my heart with the word of God.- I don’t permit negative thoughts.- I allow the word of God to cultivate my heart.- As I fellowship with the word of God daily, it  sharpens my mind, will and emotions to live in conformity to God’s will.Oh Hallelujah, glory! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 214 - THE REVELATION-LIGHT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 25th August, 2023THE REVELATION-LIGHT"Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path. Psalm 119:105 (NKJV)To treat the Word of God as an option or allow unproductive activities to compete with the Word of God in your life is an evidence of ignorance and a distracted life. One of things the adversary has to do to leave you in darkness and spiritual penury is to make you disparage the scriptures in your day to day living. The whole world lies in darkness and under the sway of the adversary. (See 1 John 5:19).
And the Lord has translated us from the power of darkness to the Kingdom of His son. (See Col. 1:13).
We see in Isaiah 60:2:"For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee." (KJV)Though we are not of this world, (we are not governed by its value system and forces), we are in the world (physically present). (See John 17:15-16). We can only navigate our paths by the light of the Word of God within us. The scriptures are not some list of rules and regulations which bid for our obedience. They are the emission of divine light into our hearts."The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple" Psalm 119:130 (ESV).
When you have fellowship with the Word, it infuses your heart with light. When the Word of God illuminates you, it shapes your thinking.
Even gullible or untrained men receive understanding and insight by the entrance of the Word.It directs you on the way to go, the decision to take, and the wisdom to demonstrate in all wisdom. Most young people seem to struggle with mental health, depression, suicidal thoughts, and fear. This is because they have either not received the light of the Word or have turned away from it."When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness" Job 29:3The infusion of the light of God's Word, cultures your mind and brings you into higher realm of civilization and hope. No matter the godawful state of the darkness in this world, we shine forth by the Word.Beloved, allow the ENTRANCE OF THE WORD OF GOD on a daily basis. As you read your Bible, as you consistently listen to Christ-Centred teachings and songs, your heart shall be flooded with the revelation-light.Selah.SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 19:8; Psalm 43:3; Proverbs 6:23; 2 Peter 1:19) WE PRAY- That the light of the Word will shine through our hearts and enlighten our eyes that we shall walk in perfect understanding.- That the revelation-light of God will shine in all dark places of the earth, as the waters covers the earth, that His glory shall be revealed. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 200:Psalms 92-94Mark 14-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am devoted to the word.- The word of God directs my path.- I demonstrate wisdom in all things.- With the light of the word, each day of my life is glorious.- I will never be defeated in my life.- I will never walk in confusion, depression or fear because I have received the light of the word.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 215 - ESTEEM THE REVELATION-LIGHT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 26th August, 2023ESTEEM THE REVELATION-LIGHT"Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food. Job 23:12 (KJV)Imagine living for an hour without breathing?The scriptures (as the Word of God) are the outbreathings of God for our inward breathings. They are not the suggestions of God but the  precepts of His wisdom. The Word embodies God's thoughts. All things were made by the Word of God. There is nothing God will do with you or for you outside His Word. The Word is the foundation of your faith. Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. (Romans 10:17). You cannot demonstrate God's wisdom, grow in knowledge, receive understanding and walk in obedience without the Word of God. Food is good for the body, but the Word of God is good for your entire being.
The real you, which is your spirit can only be built and furnished by the Word of God. 
You must esteem God's Word in your life than your necessary food. As you fellowship with the scriptures (the Bible), you are fellowshipping with the Word of God. Don't make the reading of your Bible a leisure activity.Reading, studying, meditating on the Word of God and your prayer times must be the essential part of your day. They shouldn't be sidelined."When I discovered your words, I devoured them. They are my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, O LORD God of Heaven’s Armies" Jeremiah 15:16 (NLT).This is the attitude you must have towards the Word of God. Devour, or eat or consume the Word.
How do you step into the day without feasting on the scriptures?
They are God's speaking to us. Through the scriptures your life is governed or directed to the right direction. Be ebullient with the scriptures burning on your heart."O how I love and treasure the revelation of your word; throughout the day I fill my heart with its light!" Psalm 119:97 (TPT)The more you read, study and meditate on the Word of God, your heart is flooded with light.Until you love and treasure the revelation of the Lord, you will not make it your meditation throughout the day. This is why by the inspiration of the Lord, I included A ONE YEAR BIBLE READING PLAN. You are provided with two or three chapters of the Bible to read. And also extra Dig Deeper scriptures. As you read these scriptures you will access the understanding of God. When you love the Lord you will take interest in understanding and knowing Him."I need more revelation from your word to know more about you, for I’m in love with you!" Psalm 119:125 (TPT).The question is are you really involved in the reading of the Bible, since you claim you love the Lord ?You have to ESTEEM THE WORD in your life. You have to set a time for the reading of the Word of God. It will shape your thinking and refresh your heart. You will realize that you can make the right life choices, and also live with clarity because you have activated Wisdom."Truth’s shining light guides me in my choices and decisions; the revelation of your word makes my pathway clear." Psalm 119:105 (TPT)
Don't esteem your pursuit for money, academic success etc above the Word of God.
"The words you speak to me are worth more than all the riches and wealth in the whole world!" Psalm 119:72 (TPT).SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 1:1-3; Psalm 119:48; Deut 6:6; Ezekiel 3:3; Psalm 119:103; Revelation 10:9; Job 22:22; Psalm 119:98) WE PRAYThat we will not esteem any pursuit or ambition in life more than the word of God, which is the whole counsel of God’s wisdom.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 201:Psalms 95 -97Luke 1-2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I love and treasure the revelation of God because the word is the embodiment of God’s thoughts and wisdom.- I esteem the word more than all my life’s pursuits.- I make time to fellowship with the word daily.- I meditate on the word at all times.- I keep the word burning in my heart at all times.- I live by the word.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 216 - BE FIRM IN LOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 27th August, 2023 BE FIRM IN LOVE "As the Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love." John 15:9 (NKJV) Christ is the embodiment of the fullness of the Love of God. He is inseparable of the Love of God. When you come into Christ, you have come into the beautiful multi-dimensional realm of His love. This immeasurable and incomprehensible love of Christ is poured into us by the Holy Spirit. Thus, we are mingled with His love. This is not designed only for our enjoyment. This love is to become our expression. Nevertheless, your continuous expression of the love of Christ, is dependent on how you abide in Him. The word abide, is from the Greek word, menō, which means, to continue, dwell, remain or stand steadfastly, to endure, to be present and tarry.
We have the unforceful responsibility to actively remain steadfast in Him.
To abide in Christ, is to essentially receive and trust all that the Father is for Christ. It is to steadfastly delight in Christ's love and joy towards the Father and His family. You don't turn away from the love of Christ. You are intrinsically satisfied only in Christ. This is crucial for your fruit-bearing in Christ.
The goal of our Lord Jesus (to have you remain steadfast in Him) is that, you will become fruitful as He is.
" I am the true Vine, and My Father is the vinedresser...Remain in Me, and I [will remain] in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself without remaining in the vine, neither can you [bear fruit, producing evidence of your faith] unless you remain in Me" John 15:1,4 (Amplified Bible) To remain in His love, is to stand firm in the consciousness of His love. And to persevere to walk in the power of His love. This is how faith finds meaning and validation. The more you remain and behold the love of Christ, the more you are supplied with the richness of God's grace. This produces in you an unwavering faith of God. Faith is our response to the supply of God's love in us. Faith works through love. (Galatians 5:6)
Faith is having full confidence in who God is, what He has said and the might of His power.
You please the Lord when Faith finds expression through love. No wonder Paul had to pray for the brethren in Ephesus concerning this: "And I pray that he would unveil within you the unlimited riches of his glory and favor until supernatural strength floods your innermost being with his divine might and explosive power. Then, by constantly using your faith, the life of Christ will be released deep inside you, and the resting place of his love will become the very source and root of your life." Ephesians 3:16-17 (TPT). See the verses 17-18 in Amplified version: "May Christ through your faith [actually] dwell (settle down, abide, make His permanent home) in your hearts! May you be rooted deep in love and founded securely on love. That you may have the power and be strong to apprehend and grasp with all the saints [God’s devoted people, the experience of that love] what is the breadth and length and height and depth [of it]" Being rooted in Christ, empowers you strongly to apprehend and handle the multifaceted dimensions of love. You are rooted and grounded in love, by these: By filling your heart and head with the truth of Christ and the demonstration of His love. By the strengthening of the Spirit in your inner man so that Christ dwells (manifestly) in your heart by faith. I call you blessed. Shalom! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:21-22; Colossians 1:23; Luke 6:48) WE PRAY - That Christ would unveil within us the unlimited riches of His glory and favor until supernatural strength floods our innermost being with His divine might and explosive power. - That Christ will be more and more at home in our hearts, living within us as our trust in him. May our roots go down deep into the soil of God’s marvelous love. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023 Day 202: Psalms 98 - 99 Luke 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS: I grow deep in the marvelous love of Christ. I remain and abide in His love. My heart is set on the the glory of His love as I demonstrate His love to many. I am mingled with Christ in love. I bear much fruits by the effective workings of His love and faith in me. Hallelujah!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 217 - HOW TO EXPERIENCE THE WORKINGS OF THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 28th August 2023HOW TO EXPERIENCE THE WORKINGS OF THE WORD"My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings. Proverbs 4:20 (NKJV)Proverbs chapter 4, unveils the benefits of wisdom and how wisdom should be esteemed. We see also that, the many counsels and words articulated are expressions of wisdom.Now before the word was unveiled as God's MEDICINE or God's prerequisite for our enjoyment of life and health; there were key prescribed items worth noting.See:"My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings. Do not let them depart from your eyes; Keep them in the midst of your heart; For they are life to those who find them, And health to all their flesh."Proverbs 4:20-22 (NKJV).The focus of these verses isn't just what the Word can do, but what you should do with the WORD. The focus is the instruction. It's about how you can benefit from the Word. The WORD of God  is LIFE to those who find them and MEDICINE to their flesh or body; however there are things to do to wield the WORD. A medicine or a remedy may be good but until you effectively apply it, it wouldn't work automatically. You need to use or apply it according to the prescription to get the expected results.These are the FOUR THINGS THE LORD wants you to do:1. Give attention to MY Words.You attend to anything of value. You turn away from anything else to take heed to the Words. You don't treat the Word casually, you prick your ears to intentionally hear or receive the details.
When you have to attend to the Word of God, you pause all other activities to give it the valued time. 
2. Incline your ear to MY Sayings.As you pause to attend to the Word, you don't only listen attentively; you create the atmosphere and take up the posture for you to effectively attend to the Word. To incline the ear also means to bow the ear. It is like a disciple sitting at the feet of a teacher to glean knowledge.
It means you give attention with humility.
3. Do not let THEM depart from your eyes;What is the focus of your eyes? How consistent are you setting your sight on the Word? Don't only hear the Word, you must see and set your gaze on the Word."That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, concerning the Word of life" 1 John 1:1 (NKJV).There are people who set their eyes and also the eyes of their mind on the challenges which confront them than what God have said. Just like the spies Moses sent out to the promise land. They saw the beauty of the land, but ten (10) of them saw themselves as grasshoppers. And they practically forgot about the promise of God's Word to them. They forgot the great things the Lord has wrought through them, even the parting of the red sea.Unlike Caleb and Joshua, they had their eyes on the reality that God is with them.  They saw the giants as bread. ( See Numbers 13:25-33; Numbers 14:1-9).
Set the Word of God before you and make it your focus.
4. Keep them in the midst of your heartThe heart is the center of your life. Your entire living evolves around your heart. The heart is the seat of your life. The heart here is not the physical organ which pumps blood (of course there is a connection as well between the physical heart, the hidden heart and the Word). 
The heart mentioned includes, the spirit, the mind, the will, the emotions and the conscience.
To keep the Word is to esteem the Word. Whatever you esteem is kept in the heart. The word of God is the most inestimable treasure you must keep in your heart. It is the life spring and essence of your spirit. Therefore you ponder, meditate or masticate on it. You uphold it as the guide of your will and overwhelms your affection and desires.When you make the Word your "gravitational focus" it will infuse you with Life. Anything God's Word dispenses becomes your reality. As Paul, the Apostle, spoke and taught the Word of Christ, there was a man that was impotent in his feet, (a cripple from his mother's womb) listening attentively to his teaching. Whiles the Apostle preached, he perceived that the man had faith (remember faith comes by hearing the Word of Christ, Romans 10:17) to be healed and spoke out, "Stand upright on your feet." And the man that was a cripple leaped and walked just by hearing the word.Oh glory!Now you will be wondering how it happened.Get this:
The Word of God is a seed, your heart is the field.
When a word of healing is sown into your heart, it will germinate healing in your body (Luke 8:15). Whiles, the man was listening to Paul, the word of faith was sown into his heart, and then produced the healing miracle. 
Is your heart a fertile ground for the Word to germinate?
When you pay attention to the Word (and prayer), it fertilizes your heart to have enough nutrients, to experience the workings of the Word. The more you meditate on (ponder, mutter, masticate and speak) the Word, the more you bear the fruits of the Word.Have you fellowshipped with the Word?SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 5:1; 7:1-2; Psalm 119:111-112; Proverbs 3:3,21; Psalm 40:8) WE PRAY- That we will diligently give heed to every instruction in the word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 203:Psalms 100 - 102Luke 4 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make the word of God my priority.- I give attention to the word.- I invest the word into my heart daily.- I keep my gaze focused on the word.- I rejoice in the word.- I apply the word in all circumstances of life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 218 - THE HAVEN OF ALL CONCEPTIONS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE HAVEN OF ALL CONCEPTIONS"Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life" Proverbs 4:23 (NLT)The instruction of the Lord is always to our advantage. God knows your constitution and how you can best walk in the consummation of your divine call. And the interesting thing is, whatever God instructs man on, the adversary goes after it. So in Eden, when God instructed man concerning the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, the adversary went after it. Whatever God is interested in concerning your life, the adversary develops interest for it.  Don't give him access! One of the crucial things the adversary takes interest in, is the heart of man. 
The heart of man is the seat of all thoughts and all feelings.
 The complexity of man's constitution is intriguing beyond what has been accumulated. Man's entire being is as a universe. And that is how God sees man. If eternity can be assimilated into man who lives in time, that should let you know the extent of man’s wonder.  The Bible says, “….He has set eternity in the heart of man…..” Ecclesiastes 3:11 It means man has the capacity to travel into “eternal future and eternal past.” So you can consider the Prophet Moses, he was inspired by God to write the book of Genesis. He articulated the creative work of God, as though he was walking with God side by side, whiles He was creating the universe. How was it possible? It was through the influence of God's vision in his heart. 
In all of man's constitution, the center of his being is THE HEART!
 A man's heart is as a womb or a haven of conception. Nothing happens in a man's life or world without first beginning as a seed in the heart of man. Thoughts are first cultivated in the heart of man. 
Life is predictable.
 There is nothing like unpredictable event in life. Anything that happens within time is as a result of a man's thought and action.  Whatever you want to see manifest in your life, you must take conceptualized and predictable steps. That is the role of the heart. The difference between those that make great impact and those that struggle to make an impact is the condition of their heart. "Listen carefully, my dear child, to everything that I teach you, and pay attention to all that I have to say. Fill your thoughts with my words until they penetrate deep into your spirit. Then, as you unwrap my words, they will impart true life and radiant health into the very core of your being. So above all, guard the affections of your heart, for they affect all that you are. Pay attention to the welfare of your innermost being, for from there flows the wellspring of life.  Avoid dishonest speech and pretentious words. Be free from using perverse words no matter what!"Proverbs 4:20-24(TPT) 
Beloved, the entire construction of your life is in your heart. 
 You must give attention to the things you construct in your heart. So what then is in your heart? Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 6:45; Deuteronomy 4:9; Matthew 15:18-19) WE PRAYThat we will keep our hearts and minds stayed on the word God as we delight deeply in it.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 204:Psalms 103 -105Luke 6 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-  I guard my heart with all diligence.- I don’t give room for toxic thoughts.- I delight my heart in the word of God.- I keep my heart and mind stayed on the word of God.- I am cultured daily by the word of God.- I am a doer of the word.- I don’t entertain the company of mockers. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 219 - ARE YOU PLEASING GOD OR MEN?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 30th August, 2023ARE YOU PLEASING GOD OR MEN?"For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ." Galatians 1:10 (KJV)Let me first make this clear, men are important in everyone's success. Nobody rises or does something great without committed and loyal people. There are people who act as though they don't need any man to help them. That is a mere assumption. Everyone will need help from a man. Have genuine love and respect for people. However, in the fulfillment of God's plans and purposes, you don't run your race to please men. You don't labour to prove others wrong. Labour with the Lord to fulfill the purpose of His will. 
Pleasing the Lord should be the focus of your heart.
 "But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts" 1 Thessalonians 2:4 (KJV) Your life and ministry should not be directed by what others are doing. Do what God has called you to do. You can be inspired by what others do. However, you must do what you do not to impress anyone. You do what you do because God has inspired and affirmed that you do it. What has God called you to do? Where has God called you to be? Beloved take heed! "Tell Archippus, "Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it." Colossians 4:17 
What is the Lord inspiring you to do?
 Are those ideas derived from your sense of competition with the brethren or what God is telling you to do? Or you are taking steps simply because your colleague ministers and friends are doing the same? Let no man force you or threaten you into doing things the Lord has not instructed you to do.  
Let no man lure you to go where God has not called you to go.
 I remember, two years ago, I received some invitations to minister in some cities outside Africa, and this minister inviting me was part of a certain ministerial circle where they invite each other to programs and travel all around, sharing platforms. I asked why I should join his circle of friends, why I should host him. He only spoke of the importance of traveling as a minister and places he has travelled to. Sent me pictures, and even asked me to visit his Facebook page. Which I did, but didn't experience ministry. I only saw his pictures with 'great' men of God. He was ready to send me the invite, afterwards, I will also host him. Thank God I have a strong word and instruction within me: It is not how far you travel around the world.It is how deep you grow in the Lord. At a point, it looked like I wasn't daring enough. It looked like I was missing out on an open door and I was not ambitious enough. "Cease ye from man, whose breath [is] in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?"Isaiah 2:22 Yes it's good to run... It's good to do big things, YET WE RUN IN PATIENCE! The fear of men shouldn't influence your decisions in life. The fear of men is a snare. Put your trust in the Lord. (Proverbs 29:25) You can be encouraged by the good works of other brethren.Be provoked unto good works ordained by God not selfish desires. 
Be inspired and directed by the Spirit!
 Spend time in prayer... Handle instructions from the Lord.  Don't be influenced merely by social media influencers.Don't try to be like everybody. Don't try to fit into the society.  
Obey the Lord not the trends.
 "Then Peter and the [other] apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men" Acts 5:29 Don't be scared of the outcome of your commitment to what the Lord has instructed you to do. "Faithful is he who has called you; it is he who shall perform it" 1 Thessalonians 5:24 Don't compromise! BE INSPIRED BY THE LORD! Selah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:6; Acts 4:19-20; Acts 5:29; 2 Corinthians 5:9-11; Colossians 3:23) WE PRAYThat we will take heed to the ministry we have received in the Lord and to fulfill it. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 205:Psalms 106 -108Luke 8-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am not moved by the trends.- I refuse to compromise my ministry.- I take heed to my ministry.- I am what God says I am and I do what God has called me to do.- I run my race in patience.- I am inspired and directed by the Holy Spirit always.- I don’t run with the mindset of pleasing men.- The focus of my heart is pleasing the Lord. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 220 - BEAR YOUR YOKE NOW
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BEAR YOUR YOKE NOW“It is good for a man that he should bear the yoke [of divine disciplinary dealings] in his youth ” ‭‭Lamentations‬ ‭3:27‬ (‭AMPC) Most people fail to prepare, invest and get themselves built up during their youth season.They invest their youth in pleasures. Instead of living by divine convictions, they prefer convenience. However, it is clear that a man will certainly BEAR A YOKE in his lifetime.  Yet, it is assuredly said “IT IS GOOD” that he BEARS it in HIS YOUTH. At whichever stage you are, this is the best time to bear your yoke now. Take up the responsibilities, get yourself under training, give yourself to the burdens of your vision now.  
You are not too old to start. Neither is it too early for you to start if you are young.
 Invest time and great effort into the building up of the Word. Don't make excuses! Create time and be fully committed to the culturing of the word. The guarantee for a good successful life and living is God’s word.Investing your time in God, is operating in the realm of wisdom. 
DON’T TAKE LIFE CASUAL.
 Now is the time to make great investments in God.The investment of the word.The investment of prayers.The investment of giving.The investment of love.The investment of knowledge.The investment of faithfulness. The investment of diligence.The investment of loyalty and commitment in positive relationships.  MAKE THE SACRIFICES NOW. BURN YOUR BRIDGES NOW! Note that, whatever you are now is mostly likely what you will be for the rest of your life. 
So, make a choice now before someone misguide you.
 You remain a blessing! Shalom! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12; Proverbs 2:2-6; Job 36:11; Job 22:21; Psalm 16:11) WE PRAYThat we will not prioritize and entertain interruptions rather we will diligently focus and invest our time and efforts into the building up of the word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 206:Psalms 109 -1011Luke 11-12  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to entertain interruptions.- I make the most use of my today.- I invest my time in God.- I refuse to make excuses.- I refuse to procrastinate.- I make the sacrifices now.- I burn the bridges now.-  I make the investments now. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 221 - WHO ARE YOU TO YOUR PASTOR?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency WHO ARE YOU TO YOUR PASTOR?“Then God who cheers those who are discouraged refreshed us by the arrival of Titus." 2 Corinthians 7:6 (TLB) There are some people who don't make it their priority to be a blessing. And don't even think they have to make it their priority to support their Leaders or Pastors (Shepherds) in the Church. There are people who are dedicated and committed to their "bosses" or employers and even their office supervisors because they esteem their job.
Our participation in the Church will bring us to the fulfillment of God's eternal purpose.
Your Kingdom relevance is first measured by your relevance in your Local Church. The Holy Spirit will first share the burden of God's vision and assignment for your Local Church with your Pastor or Shepherd. In the same way, when the adversary wants to attack the vision of the ministry he will first attack your Pastor or Shepherd. If there should be any discouragement, pain, burden, attacks, persecutions, and threats; your Pastor is the first to take the shots.
Leading and raising the saints could be burdensome.
There are a lot of Pastors who are daily overwhelmed by the task of pastoral care. While some members refuse to be consistent in adhering to instructions and practicing the word. Others are busily seeking their interests. Some are also holding grudges and creating conflicts with lies within the Church.  Pastors don't only deal with the spiritual and numerical growth of the Church. They are also dealing with external confrontations and distractions. Handling every single individual member of the Church with their challenges and also ensuring each of them experiences their victories in Christ. These things don't just happen weekly or monthly. These are things he is bearing up every day.
What is your role in all these?
Are you the one that makes ministry easy? Or you are the one that adds to the "pressure". This is not to say you don't have to share challenges with your shepherd. However, what difference are you making in your Pastor’s life? Are you the reason he is encouraged and joyful or you are the reason he has more load of tasks? Or are you making his efforts and labor worthless? Are his visitations, counseling, and prayers for you becoming a waste?  He invests all this time and effort and then you just decide to leave the ministry not for any divine reason? BE LIKE TITUS! "For even when we arrived in Macedonia our bodies had no rest, but we were oppressed at every turn—conflicts and disputes without, fears and dread within. But God, who comforts and encourages the depressed and the disquieted, comforted us by the arrival of Titus." 2 Corinthians 7:5-6 (TLB)
Your presence and participation in the Church should be an encouragement to your Pastor.
You have to decide to be a burden bearer and supply of the Lord's encouragement to your setman.  Choose to make ministry smooth for your Man of God. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 16:17; 2 Corinthians 7:13; 1 Thessalonians 3:2) WE PRAYThat through the grace of God we will be God’s supply of encouragement to our pastor. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 207:Psalms 112-114Luke 13-14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a burden bearer.- I am a son of consolation.- I refuse to make it difficult for my Pastor to lead me.- I choose to be the Lord’s supply of encouragement to my Pastor.- I give heed to every instruction given by my man of God. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!   [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 222 - BE FULL OF THANKSGIVING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE FULL OF THANKSGIVING“having been rooted and being built up in Him, and being strengthened in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding with thanksgiving.” Colossians 2:7 (Berean Literal Bible)When people want to see change in circumstances they pray. They declare the word of God. And exercises themselves in faith. But very few people know THANKSGIVING is a demonstration of faith. Beloved, you don't only thank God after a miracle. You practice thanksgiving even whiles you make supplication in prayer. To pray is a step of faith. It is confidence in God answering you as a loving Father. However, your prayer of faith will always be done with thanksgiving."Do not be anxious or worried about anything, but in everything [every circumstance and situation] by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, continue to make your [specific] requests known to God." Philippians 4:6 (Amplified Bible).Wherever there is faith, thanksgiving abounds. 
Thanksgiving is the evidence which reveals the certainty of your faith. 
Let thanksgiving abound in your daily living. Thanksgiving does these things in you:1. Through thanksgiving you acknowledge the Lord in your life and recognizes His blessing in everything you do.2. Your faith and confidence in God becomes effective; thus, you build an irrevocable confidence that you will experience or see the manifestation of what the Lord has said.3. Thanksgiving causes you to live in the glorious realm of joy, far above anxiety and sorrow. It has a way of establishing and overwhelming you with restfulness in the midst of chaos.See how Jesus demonstrated power through thanksgiving:"Then Jesus said, “Make the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand. And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted. So when they were filled, He said to His disciples,“Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost.”  Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten. Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said,“This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world.” John 6:10-14 (NKJV)Jesus blessing the loaves and fish with thanksgiving, was able to fed the multitudes and had an overflow.Concerning Lazarus' resurrection, Jesus didn't have to utter prayer of supplication or petition. He said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me." John 11:41 (NKJV).That is faith!!!Before He got to Bethany, Jesus had already made the pronouncement of faith. At the tomb, He didn't have to speak many words and pray for a miracle to happen. He gave thanks, as an affirmation that the Father has heard Him. This was God showing us how to act in faith. 
Thanksgiving is the highest demonstration of faith. 
As you pray, as you declare the word, and as you take inspired steps of faith towards that goal, BE THANKFUL. Beloved, always abound in thanksgiving, for it is FAITH.Shalom.To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail on info@christcommonwealth.org.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 5:20; Colossians 3:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:18; Psalm 95:1-3) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the abundance of His grace supplied unto us and the great miracles He has worked in our midst and the glorious things we are going to see this month and this year. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 209:Psalm 115 -  116Luke 15-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.- In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.- I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.- I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.- My mouth is full of thanksgiving.- Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 223 - COMMUNING WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency COMMUNING WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT“The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the THE communion of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen!”2 Corinthians 13:14  (KJV) One of the beautiful things Christ achieved for us is the ability to commune or fellowship with the Holy Spirit. In every communion communication is key. Communication is not only speaking and listening.  It also includes the ability to understand. However, understanding begins with the ability to hear.
Hearing the voice of God is a great gain and treasure.
It is one of the burdens most people have. Over the years, many have been taught on steps in hearing or listening to the voice of God (Holy Spirit), others have even numbered and standardized these list. But beloved, to follow, to hear or recognize the voice of your Heavenly Father is not in an external list of steps.
Hearing the voice of God is not as complex as it has been made.
Let’s be basic, how did you know the voice of a close relative or friend? Or how do you differentiate the voice of your father from your uncle?  You will most likely find it easy to recognise the voice of the one you commune with the most. Recognizing the voice of someone you know, spend time with and listen to more will always be easy. You know the voice of a person because you talk or commune with such fellow often. You could even recognize their voice from a distance and amidst other voices speaking at the same time. The same principle is true about God (Holy Spirit).  Now you don't need to be confused about whose voice you are hearing.
The more you commune with the Holy Spirit, the more you will recognize His voice.
It is impossible to live a confused life when you commune with Him daily. The Holy Spirit is your friend. Talk to Him about everything and He will direct your path. How then do you commune with Him?First by fellowshipping with the Scriptures through study. Decide to be a student of the word.You must know the word of God.
When the word of God has not gained mastery in your heart, your communion with Him will not be rich.
Let the word dwell in you richly (Colossians 3:16). The Holy Spirit will lead you by the word. Through the word, you will learn to sing and worship Him. 
You will learn not to trust in your own understanding. 
You will learn to pray more effectively when you study the word. He lives in you.He is also with you.He knows all things.He will help you in all your endeavors.He takes interest in everything you do.He wants to help you. Now beloved, take a moment after reading this post to commune with Him.Talk to Him. Say things like;“thank you Holy Spirit for your love”“thank you for being there for me at all times”“I love you Holy Spirit” and etc You remain a blessing!DIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 3:16-17; John 10:27; Hebrews 1:1-2; John 8:47; Revelation 3:22; Psalms 85:8) WE PRAY- Thanking the Lord for the gift of the Holy Spirit. - That we will grow in a deeper consciousness of our fellowship with the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 209:Psalm 117 - 118Luke 17-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Thank you Holy Spirit for your love.- Thank you for being there for me at all times.- I love you Holy Spirit.- I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit.- I walk daily in the consciousness of the Holy Spirit.- The Holy Ghost is my helper. Oh Gloreeeey!!!!! Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 224 - RESPOND TO THE LORD'S VOICE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 4th, September, 2023RESPOND TO THE LORD'S VOICE“Behold, I’m standing at the door, knocking. If your heart is open to hear my voice and you open the door within, I will come in to you and feast with you, and you will feast with me.”‭‭Revelation‬ ‭3:20‬ ‭(TPT‬‬)There’s a higher level God has designed for you to operate; but your greatest limitation is your mind. Your mind has to be cultivated.  When God made man, He first placed man in a garden, meaning man must be cultivated.
You are cultivated by the communion with the Lord.
And the more you commune or dine with the Lord, the more you grow to contact deeper realms in GOD. The greatest invitation is the invitation to dine with the LORD in a particular realm. When for example, you have the promptings to pray or read the word don’t take it for granted because it is an invitation to dine with the LORD. It is the LORD calling you to higher and deeper realms. He’s calling you to “come up hither”. Anytime GOD invites you, He invites you to His voice. His voice is not static, it is mobile.
Did you know that GOD is always speaking? 
Yes He is. GOD is NEVER silent. Even when it seem He is silent, that silence is still a communication. He speaks to you of His plans for you and the specific steps you ought to take at every time. He’s always speaking.However, the challenge is the consistent practice of your communion with the Lord. The LORD speaks to you when you commune with Him. [Please read more on “Communing with the Holy Spirit” here] Most at times it is not what is happening to you that matters, rather it is the VOICE you are hearing that matters. The voice you hear and respond to is what influences your life. Do you hear the voice of your fears, worry, pain and struggle or you hear the voice of the Lord? Jesus said, "My sheep hear My voice" John 10:27
Beloved, You must HEAR AND RESPOND to the Voice of the LORD always and in all things.
The instructions of the Lord will lead you to prosperity. Don't choose your emotions and assumptions over the Voice of the Lord. "Remember what it says: “Today when you hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts as Israel did when they rebelled.” Hebrews 3:15 (NLT)
Have you heard from the LORD concerning the steps you want to take?
Hear His voice now. He’s still speaking. Shalom Aleichem!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 55:3; Hebrews 3:7-15; Hebrews 4:7; Psalm 95:7) WE PRAYThat we will take to the instructions and counsel of the Lord either through the written word, our man of God or to us directly. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 210:Psalm 119:1-50Luke 18-19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I hear the voice of the Lord at all times.- I don’t lean on my own understanding.- In all things, I decide to hear from the Lord first.- The path of my life like a shining light that shines brighter and brighter unto a perfect day.- Whatever God instructs me to do, I do with all urgency.- I walk in partnership with the Holy Spirit. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 225 - UNDERSTANDING SPIRITUAL GROWTH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 5th, September, 2023UNDERSTANDING SPIRITUAL GROWTH“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head.” Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) Imagine seeing a 20-year-old lady crying for the mother’s breast milk like a 3-month-old baby. Clearly, you will know there is a big problem.
Each kind of life has its own designed growth system.
Every organism is expected to grow. Every plant or crop has an expected season to grow. A yam farmer expects to harvest his crop between 4 to 6 months. It becomes a challenge when it is not ready for harvest within a year or more. If you have been born again for a while, you may have heard the term "Spiritual Growth". People have some strange understanding of Spiritual growth. They perceive spiritual growth as the completeness of your spirit.
There is no incomplete spirit in Christ.
For you have been made complete in Him (Colossians 2:10). Some assume Spiritual growth means you receive more righteousness, salvation, the life of Christ, holiness, power, and qualification to be a son of God and a citizen of heaven. Others conclude that you are not a king and a priest until you grow spiritually. When you come into Christ you are made righteous (2 Corinthians 5:21). You don't grow your righteousness neither can it be improved.  You can receive more grace, but you cannot receive more righteousness. You receive righteousness as a gift (Romans 5:17).  It is the same with your salvation. You are made Holy in Christ, no saint in Christ is more holy than the other. We all have the holiness of Christ. You only have the responsibility to express that Holiness.  By the obedience of Christ we have been made royal priests (1 Peter 2:9). Now are we the sons of God (1 John 3:2). And as sons, we have equal citizenship in God's Kingdom and equal access to the Father.
Beloved, your spiritual growth is about your growth in the understanding and consciousness of Christ and who you are in Him. 
"Spiritual growth" is not the growth OF your spirit, it is your growth IN THE SPIRIT. It is your growth into Christ in all things, by which you become the complete expression of Him in this world. It includes the renewal of your mind (Romans 12:2).
To grow in the Spirit is to mature and develop mastery in the expressions of love.
This is when your heart is enriched with the knowledge of Christ and is deeply rooted in His love. ARE YOU GROWING IN THE SPIRIT? Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Proverbs 4:18; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAYThat we will grow in the consciousness of Christ and who he has made us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 211:Psalm 119:51- 90Luke 20-21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I feast on the word daily, I grow deeper in the consciousness of Christ and my identity in Him.- I don’t take my spirituality for granted.- As I feast daily on the word,  I mature and develop mastery in the expressions of love.- I demonstrate Christ in all that I do.- I am complete in Christ.- I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeeey!!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 226 - ARE YOU GROWING? 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 6th, September, 2023ARE YOU GROWING? 1“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)Your growth determines your manifestation. You are able to handle situations and impact your world according to your inward growth.
Your growth in your understanding of Christ and consciousness of who you are in Him is your growth in the Spirit.
It is your growth into Christ (in all things, mainly His love) by which you become the complete expression of Him in this world.  You cannot express Christ beyond your level of maturity of growth in the spirit. The highest proof of your growth or maturity in the Spirit is how you walk in Love. Your love towards God and towards others reveal how you are deeply rooted in Christ. The more your roots grow deep into the love of Christ, the more you mature or grow in the Spirit. You can be born again for 10 years and not be matured.
Growing in the Spirit is not automatic, it is intentional.
Organisms don't just grow healthy. It takes the right nutrients and the supply of other needful elements. Your mind and heart must be cultivated in the love of God.One who is growing in the spirit has his/her affection set on the Lord and not on his/her own interests. The love of God dominates your heart and influences your action.
Are you growing in the Spirit?
How consistent do you fellowship with the Spirit and the Word? Or you must be convinced to have a consistent fellowship with the Spirit and the Word? How excited are you in your heart concerning the things of God? How do you love the brethren?Are you bitter, envious, angry and holding on to an offense? When you are deeply rooted in the love of God,  bitterness, envy and offenses cannot have any place in your heart (because they are fruits or expressions of the self).
The more you grow or mature in the Lord, the more the self is subdued by the love of Christ.
ARE YOU GROWING IN THE SPIRIT? SelahDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Proverbs 4:18; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAY- That we will increase in the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding. - That we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, increasing in the knowledge of God, and demonstrating the love of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 212:Psalm 119:91-150Luke 22-24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart and mind is cultivated in the love of God daily as I feast on the word.- I set my affection on the Lord. - The love of God dominates my heart and influences my actions.- I am directed and instructed daily by the word of God.- Envy, bitterness and offenses have no place in my heart because I am deeply rooted in the love of Christ. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 227 - ARE YOU GROWING? 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 7th, September, 2023 ARE YOU GROWING? 2 “Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) Your growth in Christ is not an ACCIDENT it is an intentional process. Your individual growth contributes to the building up of Christ's body.This makes your growth essential in the increase of the body of Christ. Doubtlessly your personal growth in Christ is your responsibility, however, it is essentially dependent on the Lord's supply. Which means your growth in Christ shouldn't be in isolation, though you have crucial role to play in it. Remember, you can do nothing without the Lord. (John 15:5). This should be the underlining reality of your growth in Christ. Take responsibility of your growth, by taking advantage of your partnership with the Lord in the Holy Spirit.
There is a point you have to genuinely look at yourself through the Word of Grace; to see if you are a true expression of your true self in Christ.
There is a point in your walk in Christ, where you should know you have to manifest or express Christ in a greater measure. There is a point you have to emit greater light and exude far exceeding glory by the power of God which is at work in you. There is a point you have to be an example of great faith which works in love. "You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again the basic things about God’s word. You are like babies who need milk and cannot eat solid food." Hebrews 5:12 (NLT) Are you growing?Are you being an example of faith?Are you an example of the love of Christ?
Your growth in Christ is predictable.
There are specific things which contributes to your growth. These are intentional habits of grace or spiritual disciplines. Cultivate the habits of: 1. fellowshipping with the Word. This trains you to hear the Lord's voice. 2. consistent and spontaneous prayer. You develop your spiritual ear and sharpens your ability to see right visions in the Lord. 3. being an effective member or belonging to the body of Christ (through a local church) 4. becoming an expression of love everyday and in all things. 5. uniquely sharing Christ with others.
Christ Jesus should be the central focus of these habits not our self efforts and self gratification.
You practice them without stress when you make the goodness and the enjoyment of Christ the goal. As you practice these habits, you may not really feel you are growing; however, as you repeat them over a period of time, you will realise you have matured and become fruitful. You begin to see transformation in your thoughts, speech, conduct and manner of life. When you are growing, you become an example of Christ to the saints and the world.
The focus is not you becoming superior to the other saints.
The focus must always be as Paul said, "THAT I MAY KNOW HIM" (Philippians 3:10) How have you cultivated the habits of growth? Are you intentional about your growth in the Lord? Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Proverbs 4:18; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAY- That we will increase in the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding. - That we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, increasing in the knowledge of God, and demonstrating the love of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 212:Psalm 119:151- 176John 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am an example of faith.- I demonstrate the love of Christ in all that I do.- I make time daily to fellowship with the Lord.- I don’t settle for less, I press deeper daily to manifest Christ in a greater measure.- My heart and mind is cultivated in the love of God daily as I feast on the word.- I set my affection on the Lord. - The love of God dominates my heart and influences my actions.- I am directed and instructed daily by the word of God.- Envy, bitterness and offenses have no place in my heart because I am deeply rooted in the love of Christ. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 228 - TROUBLED ABOUT YOUR PRESENT SITUATION?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 8th, September, 2023 TROUBLED ABOUT YOUR PRESENT SITUATION? “For I hold you by your right hand— I, the LORD your God. And I say to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I am here to help you" Isaiah 41:13 (NLT) Anyone called by God to do great things for the Kingdom is greatly opposed by the adversary. As long as you are a child of God, the devil will not go on picnic with you. As a child of God, you are a get threat to the works of darkness. If the devil can stop you from shinning, he can oppress more people. This is because every child of God is a savior. He knows the success of your business is to the advantage of the Kingdom of God. He knows the stability of your family and the peace you enjoy is a threat to him. The more you enjoy peace, the more focus you become to do what God has called you to do.
The more joyful you are, the more you engage the anointing of the Holy Spirit.
The adversary wants you to doubt your future, walk in fear, live in confusion and be distressed. Don't be troubled by your present condition; for it is a mere mirage. Don't give in to it. Stand firm on the Word of the Lord. Hear the Word of the Lord to you this day: "Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be discouraged, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you. I will hold you up with my victorious right hand." Isaiah 41:10 (NLT)
The moment you begin to feel discouraged, remember that the LORD IS WITH YOU.
He will strengthen you and help you! In the Berean Standard Bible, it says: ...I WILL SURELY HELP YOU... (Isaiah 41:10). Beloved it is a surety deal with God. See the verse 13 of Isaiah 41: "For I hold you by your right hand— I, the LORD your God. And I say to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I am here to help you." No matter what the challenge is, the Lord will not only strengthen you, He holds you by His right hand, directs you and assures you that HE IS HERE TO HELP YOU. Refuse to cry!Refuse to be broken.Refuse to be discouraged.Don't give up.
THE LORD IS HERE TO HELP YOU.
Make this your meditation. Selah DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 41:8-20; Genesis 15:1; Deuteronomy 20:1; Genesis 31:4-5; Romans 8:31) WE PRAYTHANKING THE LORD FOR HIS MIGHTY HELP, STRENGTH AND DIRECTION AS WE WALK IN VICTORY IN THE MIDST OF OPPOSITION. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 213:Psalm 120-122John 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to give up.- I refuse to be broken.- I refuse to be discouraged.- I refuse to cry.- I maintain an undisturbed composure.- The Lord is my helper.- I choose to be joyful always.- I refuse to look at my current situation.- I stand firm on the word of God. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 229 - ARE YOU GROWING? 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 9th, September, 2023 ARE YOU GROWING? 3 “Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) You must take interest in your growth in Christ. Take responsibility of your growth; make practical and effective use of the gracious things the Lord has supplied to you. You have the Holy Spirit as your HELPER. You are given shepherds to train, build and equip you through God's Word in your 'Local Church'.
How are you taking advantage of the sound teachings and trainings to grow?
If you are struggling to pray, you are not growing in the Lord. Your consistency in prayer contributes to your spiritual maturity. Are you dull of hearing the Word of God? Do you need to be reminded every time to read and study the Bible daily? You have interest in surfing social media pages and entertainment than making time to listen to the teaching of the Word. You easily feel lazy and procrastinate when it comes to your spiritual development in Christ? When these things persist you must know you are gradually having growth deficiency. It will then become difficult for you to make tangible impact in your world. Your level of impact is dependent on your level of maturity.
The greatest evidence of your growth in Christ is how you practice and express the love of Christ (1 Corinthians 13:13).
Understand this, you were given the ability to love, the moment you received the Holy Spirit. For the Love of God is shared abroad in your heart by the Holy Spirit. (Romans 5:5). You grow more and more in the practice and expression of love as you grow in the knowledge of Christ.
The more you see Christ, the more you behold His love and get rooted and grounded in His love.
The burning flames of His love becomes the intention and the administration of your study of the word and the consistency of your prayers. You begin to relate or commune with the saints and become gracious to others because of the workings of the love of Christ within you. Selah DIG DEEPER:(Ephesians 3:16-18; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAY:- That we will grow more and more in the practice of the expression of love as we grow in the knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READING:Day 214:Psalm 123-125John 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to every instruction and training.- I am not dull in hearing the word of God.- I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures.- I don’t lazy about my spiritual development.- I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit.- I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 230 - ARE YOU GROWING? 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 10th, September, 2023 ARE YOU GROWING? 4 “Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) There are some fellow saints in Christ, who are interested in growing their finances, their businesses, their families, and their relationships. They feed their minds with information which helps them in their career pursuits. However, you must know that, a person is sustained by how he has built his inner man. "The spirit of a man sustains him in sickness, But as for a broken spirit, who can bear it?" Proverbs 18:14 (Amplified) If you are not well built in your spiritual life, you don't carry any weight. When your life is hit by a raging storm, your spiritual weight and foundation will determine whether you will be shaken, moved or immovable.
The strength of your life is dependent on how rooted you are in God.
How deep are you growing in Christ? You don't have to live a shallow life in Christ. Grow deeper in Him, for He is the strength of your life. In the previous episode, I mentioned that, the greatest evidence of your growth into Christ in everyway is how you practice and express the love of Christ.
The expressions of the love of Christ are the fruits of love.
A plant which doesn't grow, cannot bear good fruits. The good fruits you bear are the evidence of your maturity. There are people who measure their spiritual growth by the gifts of the spirit they demonstrate. Meanwhile the gifts of the spirit are gifts. You can have the gift of word of knowledge or the gift of prophecy and not necessarily be matured in Christ.
A gift of the spirit does not determine your growth in Christ.
Your growth in Christ is determined by the Fruits of the Spirit you bear. Look at what Paul said about gifts of the Spirit and love: "If I were to speak with eloquence in earth’s many languages, and in the heavenly tongues of angels, yet I didn’t express myself with love, my words would be reduced to the hollow sound of nothing more than a clanging cymbal. And if I were to have the gift of prophecy with a profound understanding of God’s hidden secrets, and if I possessed unending supernatural knowledge, and if I had the greatest gift of faith that could move mountains, but have never learned to love, then I am nothing. And if I were to be so generous as to give away everything I owned to feed the poor, and to offer my body to be burned as a martyr, without the pure motive of love, I would gain nothing of value." 1 Corinthians 13:1-3 (TPT) The Lord does not measure your maturity by the mighty gifts of the spirit you demonstrate. Your maturity or growth in Christ is measured ultimately by LOVE.
Your love-life in Christ makes all the difference.
I ask you again, are you growing in Christ? SelahDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAYTHAT WE WILL GROW MORE INTO THE LOVE OF CHRIST WHICH SURPASSES KNOWLEDGE. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 215:Psalm 126-129John 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to every instruction and training.- I am not dull in hearing the word of God.- I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures.- I don’t lazy about my spiritual development.- I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit.- I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 231 - ARE YOU GROWING? 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 10th, September, 2023 ARE YOU GROWING? 5 GOD HAS MADE PROVISIONS FOR YOUR GROWTH “Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) For some days now, we have been looking into the matter of your growth or maturity in Christ. It is imperative to give attention to this subject because it makes all the difference in your fulfilment of purpose. There are things you cannot achieve in Christ until you grow.
Our heavenly Father is interested in your growth and maturity, thus, He has made every provision for you to grow spiritually.
He didn't just give you His word, He granted you access (Ephesians 2:18) for you to commune with Him (through prayer and fellowship with the Holy Spirit). He planted you in His Church for you to be nurtured and gave you gifted men to equip you. See how the apostle puts it: "And [His gifts to the church were varied and] He Himself appointed some as apostles [special messengers, representatives], some as prophets [who speak a new message from God to the people], some as evangelists [who spread the good news of salvation], and some as pastors and teachers [to shepherd and guide and instruct], [and He did this] to fully equip and perfect the saints (God’s people) for works of service, to build up the body of Christ [the church]; until we all reach oneness in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, [growing spiritually] to become a mature believer, reaching to the measure of the fullness of Christ [manifesting His spiritual completeness and exercising our spiritual gifts in unity]. So that we are no longer children [spiritually immature], tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine, by the cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men, by the deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit]. But speaking the truth in love [in all things—both our speech and our lives expressing His truth], let us grow up in all things into Him [following His example] who is the Head—Christ."Ephesians 4:11-15 (Amplified) From the above verses we see the organic assignment of the gifted men. God's intention for these gifted men (apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers) is to: 1. Fully equip and perfect the saints for service (or the work of the ministry). To equip and perfect the saints, furnishes them with the necessary spiritual tools and dexterous skills and mastery for service. 2. To build up the body of Christ [the church]. Your growth and maturity contributes to the building up of the body of Christ. Which means, your immaturity can be a deficiency in the body. These gifted men equip and perfect the saints to build up the body until: 3. We all reach oneness in the faith. 4. We all reach oneness in the knowledge of the Son of God. 5. Growing spiritually to become a mature believer. 6. Reaching to the measure of the fullness of Christ [manifesting His spiritual completeness] 7. Exercising our spiritual gifts in unity. 8. As we step into these above reality of our growth in the spirit or maturity; WE ARE NO LONGER CHILDREN [SPIRITUALLY IMMATURE].
The spiritually immature are tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine.
When you are not maturing or growing spiritually you become a victim of: - every cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men. - deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit]. However from these verses we see again the the matter of LOVE. Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) We grow up into Christ by LOVE. And the reality is, apart from love there is no other way you can genuinely grow up into Christ.
Your growth is not into your self or personal desires. Your growth is into Christ; who is the ultimate example of love.
Our Heavenly Father has made these provisions of gifted men to bring us to the place of MATURING INTO CHRIST in the perfection of His Love. Submitting to the training of the gifted men God has given you in your "local Church" is your reception and enjoyment of God's provision for your growth in the spirit. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 3:14-16; 23:3-4; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2) WE PRAYDear Lord, please teach me how to humbly submit to the nurturing and training of my man of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 216Psalm 130-134John 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I humbly submit to training.- I take heed to every instruction given by my man of God.- I am not dull in hearing the word of God.- I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures.- I don’t lazy about my spiritual development.- I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit.- I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 232 - ARE YOU GROWING? 6 (THE FRUIT OF YOUR MATURITY 1)
content:
/*! elementor - v3.16.0 - 12-09-2023 */ .elementor-heading-title{padding:0;margin:0;line-height:1}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title[class*=elementor-size-]>a{color:inherit;font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-small{font-size:15px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-medium{font-size:19px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-large{font-size:29px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-xl{font-size:39px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-xxl{font-size:59px}CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 12th, September, 2023ARE YOU GROWING? 6(THE FRUIT OF YOUR MATURITY)“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) You can determine the maturity of a plant by the fruit it bears. If you want to differentiate mango tree from an apple tree just recognize their fruits. And if you want to know how healthy a tree is, look at the quality of fruit it produces.
When you are growing properly you will bear good and healthy fruit.
One may think, it is only God who can determine whether a person is growing or not. Beloved, from the scriptures we can identify the fruit of a matured healthy life in Christ. Jesus said:"But you will recognize them by their fruits. You don’t find sweet, delicious grapes growing on thorny bushes, do you? You don’t find delectable figs growing in the midst of prickly thistles. People and their lives are like trees.
