Good trees bear beautiful, tasty fruit, but bad trees bear ugly, bitter fruit. A good tree cannot bear ugly, bitter fruit; nor can a bad tree bear fruit that is beautiful and tasty." Matthew 7:16-18 (NET) Which fruit are you bearing? Are you bearing good fruit or bad fruit? Let me establish this with you; though your life is likened to a tree, you must know you are planted in the Lord (Psalm 92:12-13). And also the Lord sees you as a branch of Himself. He is the vine and you are the branches (John 15:5) This is refreshing! Though you must be intentional about your growth in Christ and take responsibility, the Lord doesn't want you to see it as a burden. He has not left the responsibility of your fruit bearing in your hands only. He wants you to know that He is your supply of healthy nutrients to help you bear good fruit. You bear fruit according to what you have received of the Lord. For without Him you can do nothing.
A fruit is the expression of the quality of a plant or a tree.
As you grow spiritually, you will bear spiritual fruit (which is the expression of the Spirit).
The greatest expression of the spirit is LOVE.
This, I have established with you in previous post. That the GREATEST EVIDENCE of your growth in Christ, is determined by the Fruit of the Spirit you bear not the gifts of the spirit you demonstrate. (1 Corinthians 13:1-3).
As your growth is in the spirit, there is a specific fruit you have to bear.
Again, Paul helps us with it: "But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law." Galatians 5:22-23 (ESV) The above fruit of the spirit is as a result of how you are supplied with nutrients and nourishment of the Lord. Until you bear this fruit, you are not really growing. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2) WE PRAYThat our love will grow and increase beyond measure, bringing us into the rich revelation of spiritual insight in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 217Psalm 135-136John 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. - As I receive daily nourishment and supply from the Lord, I increase in the expression of love. - I am not dull in hearing the word of God. - I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. - I don’t lazy about my spiritual development. - I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 233 - ARE YOU GROWING? 7 (THE FRUIT OF YOUR MATURITY 2)
content:
/*! elementor - v3.16.0 - 12-09-2023 */ .elementor-heading-title{padding:0;margin:0;line-height:1}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title[class*=elementor-size-]>a{color:inherit;font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-small{font-size:15px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-medium{font-size:19px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-large{font-size:29px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-xl{font-size:39px}.elementor-widget-heading .elementor-heading-title.elementor-size-xxl{font-size:59px} CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 13th, September, 2023 ARE YOU GROWING? 7 (THE FRUIT OF YOUR MATURITY 2) “Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) In as much as your growth in the Lord or maturity in the spirit is your responsibility, you don't do it alone. You don't create the things you need for your growth. It is the Lord who supplies you with what you need and you put them to work.
The greatest evidence of your growth in Christ is how you walk in the LOVE OF GOD.
The difference between the mature and immature is not just in the tongues they speak, the scriptures they quote and the gifts of the spirit they demonstrate. The difference between the mature and immature is in the level of love they demonstrate. Meanwhile the Love of God is shared abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5). Which means, you did not generate the Love of God, it was worked into you by the Lord Himself.
LOVE IS THE GREATEST FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT! (1 Corinthians 13:13)
We see the FRUIT of the spirit in Galatians 5:22-23 : "But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law." (ESV) From the above verses we see nine graces of the Spirit. However the verse says FRUIT and not FRUITS. There is the same Greek word, "KARPOS" for both singular FRUIT (Galatians 5:22; James 3:18) and the plural FRUITS (Matthew 7:16,20 and Philippians 1:11). We see nine graces mentioned, so why are they referred to as FRUIT? This is because these nine graces are collective singular. They can all be put into one great expression of the Spirit, which is LOVE.
"BUT THE FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT IS LOVE..."
The amplitude of love is demonstrated through the eight other graces. No tree produces different kinds of fruits. Each tree produces a specific kind of fruit. An apple tree only produces apple fruit. Though it may have more than one of its kind on the same tree. Love is that unique fruit of the Spirit, though it may have different expressions. The Passion Translation reveals it clearly: "But the fruit produced by the Holy Spirit within you is divine love in all its varied expressions: joy that overflows, peace that subdues, patience that endures, kindness in action, a life full of virtue, faith that prevails, gentleness of heart, and strength of spirit. Never set the law above these qualities, for they are meant to be limitless."
When you begin to walk in the fullness of the Love of God, the self doesn't have expression.
Which means the eight other graces are tangible realities of LOVE AT WORK. When the LOVE of God finds expression, there is no need for the demand of the law of Moses (Romans 13:8-10). WALK IN THE PERFECTION OF LOVE, FOR IT IS THE PROOF OF YOUR MATURITY. Are you Growing? Selah.DIG DEEPER(Romans 13:8-10; Matthew 22:37-40; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2) WE PRAYThat this divine love of God will find its full expression in and through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 218Psalm 139-144John 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I demonstrate love in all things. - The love of God gains full expression through me by the day. - I commit myself daily to the study of scriptures. - I fellowship with the Holy Spirit daily. - The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 234 - SIGNS OF SPIRITUAL IMMATURITY 1 (ARE YOU GROWING? 8)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 14th, September, 2023SIGNS OF SPIRITUAL IMMATURITY 1 (ARE YOU GROWING? 8) Just as we have FRUIT of a matured life in Christ, there are SIGNS of spiritual immaturity. Being born again for many years doesn't make you spiritually matured. You can be attending Church meetings and be serving in a ministry or stewardship department for many years and still not be growing spiritually.
To grow spiritually is a personal decision.
There are certain spiritual habits and mindsets you may cultivate just by being present in an environment of the Word of grace. Because environments or some atmospheres are contagious.  To grow effectively, you don't have to only depend on the influence of the environment of your local Church. You have to be intentional about your growth in the spirit. In previous episodes we realised that, your demonstration of the LOVE of GOD is the greatest evidence of your growth in the spirit.
The Love of God does not satisfy the desires of the flesh.
The true motive or intention of the love of God at work in you, is to bless or nourish others without personal interest. This brings all glory to God and not you.
The greatest sign of an immatured life is the INFLUENCE OF THE FLESH.
From the opening verse: "Brothers and sisters, when I was with you I found it impossible to speak to you as those who are spiritually mature people, for you are still dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. And because you are immature infants in Christ,” 1 Corinthians 3:1 (TPT)  Paul, was speaking to fellow saints (believers in Christ) and not unbelievers. And some of these (if not all) were as babes or infants in Christ.  The evidence of their spiritual immaturity was how they were DOMINATED BY THE MIND-SET OF THE FLESH.
The more you grow in the spirit, the less you are influenced or dominated by the flesh.
Are you growing? To which extent are you dominated by the flesh? Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 3:1-3; Romans 13:8-10; Matthew 22:37-40; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18) WE PRAYThat our love will grow and increase beyond measure, bringing us into the rich revelation of spiritual insight in all things.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 219Psalm 145 - 150John 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be dominated by the mindset of the flesh. - My actions and decisions are not influenced by the flesh. - I am a nourishment to others. - I am intentional about my growth in the spirit. - I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. - As I receive daily nourishment and supply from the Lord, I increase in the expression of love. - I am not dull in hearing the word of God. - I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 235 - THE HOLY SPIRIT STRENGTHENS YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 15th September, 2023THE HOLY SPIRIT STRENGTHENS YOU"And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord who has enabled me, because He counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry," 1 Timothy 1:12 (NKJV) 
God desires that you partner with Him for the fulfillment of His purpose.
 However, most people are threatened by the immensity of God's assignment, and begin to shy away from getting involved. But you don't have to shy away from getting involved in God's work. God doesn't just put you in the ministry, He supplies you with all that you need to do what He wants you to do. "I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has granted me [the needed] strength and made me able for this, because He considered me faithful and trustworthy, putting me into service [for this ministry],"  1 Timothy 1:12 (Amplified Bible). The Lord gives you strength and ability; yours is to be counted faithful for His good work.
As partners with God, you don't labour by your strength.
"...For by strength no man shall prevail." 1 Samuel 2:9 And you don't do what you can do, you do what God has strengthened you to do.
No human strength can succeed at God's work. It will take the supply of His grace.
Paul said here also; "Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God" 1 Corinthians 3:5  This is why you must pray!This is why you commune with the Holy Spirit.This is why you must depend on the Lord fully to do what He inspires you to do.
Don't trust in your own strength; receive more and more strength from the Lord.
Don't look at yourself and your skills. They are not enough for the Lord's work. The Holy Spirit is in you as the unending supply of the strength of God. Take advantage of your relationship with Him. Shalom.DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 15:10; 2 Corinthians 4:1; Acts 9:22; Philippians 4:13) WE PRAY:- That we will take advantage of the sufficient ability of God within us. BIBLE READINGDay 220Proverbs 1-3John 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My sufficiency is of the Lord. - The Holy Spirit is my strengthener. - I don’t lack strength. - I do all things by the enabling ability of God within me. - I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit. - Through prayer and the study of God’s word, I increase daily in strength. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 236 - SIGNS OF SPIRITUAL IMMATURITY 2 (ARE YOU GROWING? 9)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 16th, September, 2023SIGNS OF SPIRITUAL IMMATURITY 2 (ARE YOU GROWING? 9)“Brothers and sisters, when I was with you I found it impossible to speak to you as those who are spiritually mature people, for you are still dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. And because you are immature infants in Christ,”1 Corinthians 3:1 (TPT) God is interested in your growth in the spirit. In as much as God doesn't wait for you to be fully matured in the spirit to trust you with a gift of the spirit, or to put you in the ministry, He expects you to grow. He doesn't want you to remain a babe in Christ. "as newborn babes, desire the pure milk of the word, that you may grow thereby" 1 Peter 2:2 (NKJV)
The purpose of the Word of God, and the teachers of the word is to nurture and culture you unto maturity.
We have seen that the greatest fruit of a matured life in Christ is LOVE. And the greatest sign of an immatured life is the influence of the flesh. The more you grow in the spirit, the less you are influenced or dominated by the flesh. The flesh is a limitation to your growth in Christ. It has expressions and these expressions of the flesh are as weeds in a crop farm. Weeds are basically unwanted plants. They compete with crops for nutrients and resources which harness growth. They can interfere with harvesting operations and increase risk of spoilage. As you are planted in Christ don't permit any effect of the flesh to germinate in your heart. Your heart is a field for the cultivation of the word of God (Mark 4:14-15).
It is important you identify whether you are growing or not by knowing the deeds of the flesh.
To live by the flesh is to live by your self-interest. It is to choose your own way than the way of the Spirit. The flesh does not depend on the graciousness of the spirit but the self. It is contrary to the spirit. " I advise you to obey only the Holy Spirit’s instructions. He will tell you where to go and what to do, and then you won’t always be doing the wrong things your evil nature wants you to. For we naturally love to do evil things that are just the opposite from the things that the Holy Spirit tells us to do; and the good things we want to do when the Spirit has his way with us are just the opposite of our natural desires. These two forces within us are constantly fighting each other to win control over us, and our wishes are never free from their pressures. When you are guided by the Holy Spirit, you need no longer force yourself to obey Jewish laws. But when you follow your own wrong inclinations, your lives will produce these evil results: impure thoughts, eagerness for lustful pleasure, idolatry, spiritism (that is, encouraging the activity of demons), hatred and fighting, jealousy and anger, constant effort to get the best for yourself, complaints and criticisms, the feeling that everyone else is wrong except those in your own little group—and there will be wrong doctrine, envy, murder, drunkenness, wild parties, and all that sort of thing. Let me tell you again, as I have before, that anyone living that sort of life will not inherit the Kingdom of God." Galatians 5:16-21 (TLB) The activities of the flesh always compete with the Spirit in your heart, just as weeds compete with crops in a farm. They oppose and affect your growth in the spirit.
Don't give room for any of these things to germinate in your heart.
Live by the influence of the Holy Spirit.  ShalomDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16-25; Matthew 15:19; James 1:15; 1 Corinthians 3:1-3; Romans 13:8-10; Matthew 22:37-40; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; 2 Peter 3:18) WE PRAYWe are praying and declaring that the flesh should not have a loud voice. And that we will not permit any effect of the flesh to germinate in our hearts. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 221Proverbs 4 - 7John 11 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am not dominated by the flesh. - My actions and decisions are not influenced by the desires of my flesh. - I don’t permit any effect of the flesh to germinate in my heart. - My heart is for the growth of the word of God. - The Spirit has mastery in my life. - I am dominated by the word of God. - The word of God has a free course in my heart. - The word of God has power over me. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 237 - GOD TRUSTS YOU GREATLY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 17th, September, 2023GOD TRUSTS YOU GREATLY“According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust" 1 Timothy 1:11 (KJV) The glorious gospel of our Lord Jesus is the greatest treasure in the universe. Though there were glimpses of the gospel declared by the prophets, the unique detail was a mystery.
The gospel is the wisdom of God, the package of God's richest revelation and the secret eternal plan.
To the saints in Christ, the gospel is a revelation; but it was and is a mystery to those who are not in Christ. "Instead, we continually speak of this wonderful wisdom that comes from God, hidden before now in a mystery. It is his secret plan, destined before the ages, to bring us into glory. None of the rulers of this present world order understood it, for if they had, they never would have crucified the Lord of shining glory. This is why the Scriptures say: Things never discovered or heard of before, things beyond our ability to imagine— these are the many things God has in store for all his lovers." 1 Corinthians 2:7-9 This great mystery of God which is embodied in the gospel was not entrusted to the most learned men of the Jewish law, irrespective of their status. God could not share nor trust them with this great treasure. To be in Christ and to have access to this glorious gospel is a great thing. And even more to be entrusted with the opportunity to know and preach the gospel is a GREAT TRUST! When you came into Christ, the gospel was committed to your trust (1 Timothy 1:11).
Anyone who sees the responsibility of preaching the gospel as a burden does not understand the extent God treasures this gospel.
This is a gospel angels desire to look into (1 Peter 1:12). To be trusted with the Gospel is to be brought into partnership with God. What a privilege.  Look at what Paul said: "My heart spills over with thanks to God for the way he continually empowers me, and to our Lord Jesus, the Anointed One, who found me trustworthy and who authorized me to be his partner in this ministry." 1 Timothy 1:12 (TPT). Beloved to be commissioned with the gospel in Christ is more than a responsibility, it is God TRUSTING YOU GREATLY.
He trusts you so much that He has entrusted you with the glorious gospel.
Make the most of this GREAT TRUST OF THE LORD. Shalom DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 1:11-17 Corinthians 2:6-16; Isaiah 64:4; 1 Peter 1:12) WE PRAYThanking the Father for entrusting us with this glorious gospel of Jesus Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 222Proverbs 8 - 10John 13 - 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have access to the glorious gospel of Jesus Christ. - I don’t keep this glorious gospel to myself. - I turn on the divine course in many. - I don’t spare none. - I am in partnership with God. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 238 - THERE IS AN  END TO THIS WORK
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 18th September, 2023THERE IS AN END TO THIS WORK“And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a witness to all the nations, and then the end will come." Matthew 24:14 (NKJV) God has committed the work of the ministry to every believer. We all have the responsibility to spread the gospel of Jesus. This glorious gospel is the treasure of God's intent and He has entrusted it to the saints in Christ. Which means the call or the commission to spread the gospel is a high calling (Philippians 3:14). By this great call many are reconciled to God (2 Corinthians 5:18). The preaching and the spread of the gospel of our Lord Jesus, is the only way: - we can get the unsaved saved. - they that are estranged from the promise of God, can become partakers with the saints. - they that are without God will receive God and enjoy His life. - they that are hopeless will find hope in God through the gospel. - those who are in darkness will experience the greater light of the Lord. Beloved, many generations depend on this assignment given to you by the Lord. Understand that this season of the Church, is the season of the great harvest.
You must be committed to this work because a time will come when no work shall be done.
"We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work." John 9:4 (NLT) The season of harvest will come to an end, and you shall make an account to the one who called you (Romans 14:12).
Don't treat the work of the ministry as an assignment which will go on forever.
There is an end to this work. There is a time where the work shall end and be completed. "Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to completely finish His work." John 4:34 (Amplified).
In God's calendar the end of all things is at hand. We are close to the finish line of the work more than ever.
Run that you will finish. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 3:13-14; 2 Timothy 4:7-8; John 4:34-36; 1 Peter 4:7; Romans 13:11-12; 1 John 2:18) WE PRAYThat we will enabled with the grace to be diligent in the work the Lord has entrusted into our hands. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 223Proverbs 11 - 14John 17-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to procrastinate what the Lord has instructed me to do. - I don’t give excuses. - I get the job done on time. - Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. - I am a faithful laborer. - I labour in and out season. - I get myself busy with the Lord’s assignment. - I don’t waste the grace of God bestowed unto me. - I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. - I go every length to get the job done. - I keep a sense of urgency in all things. Ohh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey!   [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 239 - QUICKLY AND ENERGETICALLY CARRY OUT YOUR TASK
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 19th, September, 2023 QUICKLY AND ENERGETICALLY CARRY OUT YOUR TASK "We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work." John 9:4 (NLT) Beloved God has trusted you with His glorious gospel. To carry out the assignment to spread the gospel, is to carry out God's great plan. Though God's plan is eternal it is to be accomplished in time. God's eternal plan of salvation has been programmed to be accomplished in time. God who has been in all eternity, entered time (which is a spot in eternity), and was revealed (as Jesus) to fulfill the eternal purpose and plan. Our Lord Jesus said: "We need to be energetically at work for the One who sent me here, working while the sun shines. When night falls, the workday is over." John 9:4 (MSG)
Every saint must have this mind-attitude set of Jesus.
There is a time bound to this work. It is not going to continue forever. A day is going to come where soul winning will end.
There is an expected time in God's eternal calendar where the gospel must reach all men then the end shall come.
And day by day the end to this work draws close. You can't afford to procrastinate. You have to get up and be about the Father's business. We are in the harvest season for souls. This season will be over soon. The question at the end will be: HOW MANY SOULS DID YOU GATHER FOR THE LORD? This is why you are here, beloved, to accomplish the task of saving men. This is the harvest time, ACT QUICKLY AND ENERGETICALLY. During our Bible reading plan, Proverbs 10:5 caught my attention again. "A wise youth harvests in the summer, but one who sleeps during harvest is a disgrace" Proverbs 10:5 (NLT) Are you wise or you are a disgrace? You must know the season you are in and get serious with this ministry task. Make the most of this opportunity, for the time comes when there will be no such opportunity. Look at the same verse in the Passion Translation: "Know the importance of the season you’re in and a wise son you will be. But what a waste when an incompetent son sleeps through his day of opportunity!" Proverbs 10:5 (TPT)
Act quickly on the ideas the Lord is putting in your heart.
The things the Lord is inspiring you to do are the things He wants to do. Be the body and the person the Lord will use to quickly accomplish His task. Don't hesitate! Don't make excuses! Don't think it is not yet time! The time is now.
You are in the body of Christ at such a time to accomplish purpose.
Get to work quickly and energetically. Don't delay with that giving. Don't delay with the outreach plan. Don't delay with those great ideas. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 3:13-14; 2 Timothy 4:7-8; John 4:34-36; Romans 13:11-12; 1 John 2:18) WE PRAY- The grace to be diligent in work the Lord has entrusted unto us. - That we will not cast away our confidence in the work of ministry, rather hold on steadfastly till the end working diligently with a strong sense of urgency. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 224Proverbs 15 - 17John 19 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to procrastinate what the Lord has instructed me to do. - I don’t give excuses. - I don’t hesitate. - I act now. - I get the job done on time. - Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. - I am a faithful laborer. - I labour in and out season. - I get myself busy with the Lord’s assignment. - I don’t waste the grace of God bestowed unto me. - I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. - I go every length to get the job done. - I keep a sense of urgency in all things. Ohh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 240 - SEE THE RESULTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 20th, September, 2023 SEE THE RESULTS "And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor." Joshua 6:2 (NKJV) To fulfill ministry and accomplish great things, may seem to be challenging. Others are sometimes discouraged by the magnitude of the task. God doesn't just want you to move into action. Accomplishing great things for the Lord doesn't just come by trying to do something. You must have the right vision if you want to accomplish your task or hit your target.
Your ability to do more begins with what you see and how you see what you see.
Oftentimes the Lord charges His people to see. This is because you cannot experience what you have not seen with your heart or the spirit of your mind. To take over a city or win a town for Jesus through the gospel, you must first SEE! You cannot transform lives and bless your school, institution, or workplace until you see with the spirit of your mind. You must see your healing testimony. You must see the growth of your business. You must see your new level of impact. Look at what God said to Joshua: "And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor." Joshua 6:2 (NKJV). This was a charge to Joshua to activate the power of his imagination.
Your imagination influences your possession.
This was the same thing God said to Abraham and Moses: "I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession." Genesis 13:15 (NLT). Oh, glory! Abraham's possession was dependent on His vision. If Abraham had seen just a small portion, that was what he was going to have. If Abraham had seen the whole world, that was what He was going to have. "See, I have set the land before you; go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—to give to them and their descendants after them." Deuteronomy 1:8 (NKJV)
Beloved, what do you SEE?
Which results are you seeing now? These are not some words of encouragement. I am talking to you about a divine principle that works. You cannot accomplish beyond what you have SEEN. Jesus said, "...lift up your eyes, and see that the fields are white for harvest." John 4:35
Train your mind to see the right results.
When you begin to see images you don't want, shift your mind from them and redirect your imagination to the glorious pictures and results the Lord has deposited in your spirit. This is why you must study the Word and pray in tongues. When you pray, the Lord shows you visions. He unveils to your heart great and mighty things (Jeremiah 33:3) Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER: (Jeremiah 1:10-12; Isaiah 28:16; Joshua 8:1; Deut. 1:6-8) WE PRAY: That we will not be overwhelmed by the challenges that confront us but rather we will be strengthened with the grace to see the right results with our hearts at all times. BIBLE READING: DAY 225 Proverbs 18 - 21 John 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I refuse to see the challenges, I see possibilities. - I see my new level. - I refuse to look away from what I have seen with my heart. - That which I have seen my hands will handle. - I keep my gaze on the right pictures in my heart. - I see a way out of that challenge (specify the challenge confronting you). - Through the study of the word of God and prayer, I train my mind to see the right results. - I refuse to see failure and defeat, I see possibilities. Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeey!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 241 - GOD SET YOU IN THE CHURCH 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  GOD SET YOU IN THE CHURCH 1"And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues." 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)The Church which is the body of Christ, is the agency or the conduit established by God to fulfill His mandate or agenda.
The building of the Church is essentially the work of our Lord Jesus.
However, for the Lord to build His Church (which is His body), He has to set functional members into the body. There is no well-built and healthy body without effective and healthy members.When you look at the human body, it has many parts, which are members that make the body function effectively according to God's design.Imagine a body without hands, or legs, lungs, kidneys, and heart. The body will not be a healthy one.
God set or placed each of the various body parts to make the body function effectively.
Each member or part of the body has a unique duty. And God dexterously designed it to be so."For the body does not consist of one limb or organ but of many. If the foot should say, Because I am not the hand, I do not belong to the body, would it be therefore not [a part] of the body?If the ear should say, Because I am not the eye, I do not belong to the body, would it be therefore not [a part] of the body?If the whole body were an eye, where [would be the sense of] hearing? If the whole body were an ear, where [would be the sense of] smell?But as it is, God has placed and arranged the limbs and organs in the body, each [particular one] of them, just as He wished and saw fit and with the best adaptation. But if [the whole] were all a single organ, where would the body be?" 1 Corinthians 12:14-19 (AMPC)Beloved, the Body of Christ (the Church) is as well designed to function just as the human body is. The Body of Christ (the Church) has many parts or members. These members have unique functions in the body according to God's design, desire, and purpose.
 When you became born again, God set you in the body of Christ as a member with a unique function.
You have a special assignment in the body of Christ; take your place and be a blessing.Shalom.DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 12:12-30; Romans 12:3-8; 1 Peter 4:10-11; 1 Timothy 4:12-14; Colossians 3:17)WE PRAY:-  Thanking the Lord for this precious opportunity to be set in the church with a unique function.- That we will walk in the revelation and consciousness of this placement.BIBLE READING:DAY 226Proverbs 22 - 24Acts 1-2DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am an effective member of the body of Christ. - I have a unique function and a special assignment in the body. - I am a nourishment to the entire body. - I have been set in the church, therefore I take advantage of my place to be a blessing to many.  Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 242 - GOD SET YOU IN THE CHURCH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 22nd September, 2023GOD SET YOU IN THE CHURCH 2"And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues." 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)In the Church (or the Body of Christ), God has designed each member or part of the body with a unique function.
There is no unwanted part of the body of Christ according to God's setup or creative design.
Just as there is no unwanted part in the human body.It doesn't matter your ethnicity, race, or background; when you became born again, you were spontaneously baptized into the one body of Christ."For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and have all been made to drink into one Spirit." 1 Corinthians 12:13 (NKJV)The body of Christ, which is the Church is spiritual and universal. It is also the aggregation of all the saints. (As we have seen previously, that it takes the whole body parts or members of the body, to make one whole body).All the saints together are the universal Church. And the universal Church finds expression through the Churches within a locality.As a born again in Christ, you are a member with a special function or assignment in the body of Christ.
The relevance of your special function in the body is seen through your "local Church".
It is God who sets you in the Church with that special grace for your relevance in His Kingdom."And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues." 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)Whatever gift or ability God has given you is for the benefit of the Body of Christ, through the assembly He has placed you.You don't have to think you are in the Church by mistake. He placed you in a unique assembly for the growth of the entire body. You are positioned in that specific place in the Body for you to be useful as God has intended.There is a reason God did not place the toes on the shoulders. How will the toes on the shoulder be useful to the body?God placed each unique part of the body at its right place for effective use and relevance.
God has set you up in your "Local Church" or within a unique "Ministry Assembly" for your effective function.
All that God has made you and given you, are for His use within the Church.There are some God made them to be apostles or prophets or teachers in the Church. Others are also set up by the Lord to be helpers, administrators, and gift of healings.These are expressions of graces, and must be for the glory of God."For everything comes from God and exists by His power and is intended for his glory..." Romans 11:36 (NLT).
The whole body depends on that gift or grace given  to you to function effectively.
Don't complain and be tired about the needs which gravitate towards you. You are set up in the body at such a time to be an answer to those needs.It is by God's design you always have the desire to HELP. You are an answer to the financial needs of the Church. Keep giving!Your special grace for administration is to create an organized systems for the growth of the Church. Be diligent with it.God did not set everyone in the Church to be an apostle or prophet or special teacher (though everyone must teach, every teacher needs one with a special teaching grace).You are in the body of Christ at such a time as this, to serve through your "local Church" or "Ministry Assembly". Your various service or unique function contributes to the growth and expansion of the Kingdom of God.
Don't get tired nor stop. You are at the right place at the right time.
Use all that God has given you for His glory.Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER:(1 Corinthians 12:12-30; Romans 12:3-8; 1 Peter 4:10-11; 1 Timothy 4:12-14; Colossians 3:17)WE PRAY:That we will walk in the revelation and consciousness of the gift or grace given to us  in other to function effectively in the local church He has placed us into.BIBLE READING:Day 227Proverbs 25 - 28Acts 3 - 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an effective member of the body of Christ. – I have a unique function and a special assignment in the body. – I am a nourishment to the entire body. – I have been set in the church, therefore I take advantage of my place to be a blessing to many.  Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 243 - ARE YOU A HELPER OF THE WAR?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 23rd September, 2023 ARE YOU A HELPER OF THE WAR? "Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war." 1 Chronicles 12:1 (KJV) Jesus is not building His Church for funfair. Jesus established the Church to prevail against the gates of hades. The Church is the light of God in this world. "And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it." Matthew 16:18 (ESV). Our Lord communicates how the gates of hell will wage war against the Church. The good news is that the gates of hades SHALL NOT PREVAIL AGAINST THE CHURCH. Darkness cannot subdue the light of God. Which means the Church is a formidable force. It is an army with good armed soldiers (2 Timothy 2:3; Ephesians 6:11-13). As a Church, we have the responsibility to tear down and subdue anything that exalts itself above the knowledge of Christ (2 Corinthians 10:5). This is a war over the salvation of souls. The Church has the mandate to bring deliverance to the nations.
This is WAR! And you must be involved.
PLEASE READ THE VERSE BELOW PATIENTLY: "This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you’re not on my side, you’re the enemy; if you’re not helping, you’re making things worse" Matthew 12:30 (MSG). Okay, just read the verse above again. And give it a deep thought. With this war between the Church (light) and darkness, there is no neutral grounds. If you are born again, you are part of the Victorious Church. God has set you in the Church at such a time as this; to make enviable contributions for the advancement of the course of Christ. "And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues." 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)
He has set you in the Church for you to be a HELPER OF THE WAR.
Just as certain men came to David to Ziklag, and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war. These helpers of the war, were they who fought side by side with David. Beloved, God has set you in the local Church or Ministry Assembly for you to labour side by side with your Pastor or Setman to spread the gospel of Jesus. This is the time to take many hearts for Jesus. You must finance the gospel to villages, cities schools, institutions and nations. You must be a helper of the War. The Lord has put desires in your heart for greater works. Don't relent nor sit back. Do something now! Be a HELPER OF THE WAR through; - Your radical giving of your resources or financial partnership. - Your involvement in evangelism and soul-winning. - Your service in the local Church.
When you are not helping in this war, you are making things worse.
BE A HELPER of the War today. Shalom. DIG DEEPER:(Matthew 12:29-30; Luke 11:23; Matthew 6:24; Joshua 5:13; Joshua 24:15; 1 Chronicles 12:1-40) WE PRAY: That the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps in our local churches which will make us get ministerial results. BIBLE READING: DAY 228 Proverbs 29 - 31 Acts 5 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I am sharpened by the Lord for His great work this year. – I am a helper of the war. – I conquer and win territories for the Lord. – I shall be immovable as steel post. – By the relentless power of God I am enabled to subdue kingdoms. – I topple and crush the systems of this world. – The Lord is with me, therefore I fear no evil. – I don’t sit on the fence. – I labour through faith. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 244 - SERVING WITH THE RIGHT MOTIVE (DO AS UNTO THE LORD)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 24th September, 2023 SERVING WITH THE RIGHT MOTIVE (DO AS UNTO THE LORD) “And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you loosing it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Lord has need of it.” Luke 19:31 (NKJV). From Luke 19, we see how a donkey becomes a Kingdom celebrity because He was useful to the Lord. Motives make a lot of difference. They determine the extent you go for the Lord.
The right motives dispel any idea of disappointment.
There are people who make themselves available and useful to the Lord because of what they will gain. You may be easily discouraged when your motives are centered on fame, power, social standing, and financial gain. The owners of the donkey didn’t need to be convinced with many words. As they heard that the Master was in need of it, they didn’t argue nor ask further questions. Which means, their motive for giving out the young donkey was the LORD.
The only reason you must give your resources or even yourself to the Lord must be the LORD!
Doubtlessly there is honour in serving the Lord. But we must not serve the Lord because we want to be honoured or have an elevated social standing. Your joy should be that through your service to the Lord, many lives have been blessed and the Lord has been glorified.
Our service to the Lord blesses people.
It is not to use people as crosspieces on a ladder for your personal levitation to towering applause, validation, and prosperity. There have been times when the emphasis moves to how the lonely donkey became honourable. However, we must know that the owners' motive was not their personal honour and fame nor that of the donkey. ”…Because the Lord…” Luke 19:31 (NKJV) Nobody celebrated the donkey, it was the Lord who was celebrated. “So they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it for him to ride on. As he rode along, the crowds spread out their garments on the road ahead of him. When he reached the place where the road started down the Mount of Olives, all of his followers began to shout and sing as they walked along, praising God for all the wonderful miracles they had seen.” Luke 19:35-37 Nobody thought of the donkey, it was all about the Lord.
Your joy of service to the Lord should be that, He is seen, celebrated, praised, and honoured.
John the Baptist said, ” He must increase in importance, while I must decrease in importance. “ John 3:30 (Names of God Bible) In John 6:1-15, we see a little boy, who selflessly gave his lunch out to Jesus and it fed more than 5,000 people. The young boy didn’t consider Himself. His motive was this: Jesus needs it, and I will trust Him with it.
The joy of our service and giving to the Lord is for the impact of the Lord in the lives of others.
In 2 Corinthians 12:15, Paul said, ” And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?” (Berean Standard Bible) From the Message Bible: ” I’d be most happy to empty my pockets, even mortgage my life, for your good. So how does it happen that the more I love you, the less I’m loved?” Amplified: "But I will very gladly spend [my own resources] and be utterly spent for your souls. If I love you greatly, am I to be loved less [by you]?” And then The Passion Translation: “ I am glad to give you myself and all I have for your spiritual good, even though it seems that the more I love you, the less you love me.”
Beloved the Lord has need of you; avail yourself for His use, not because of your selfish gains.
Be motivated and inspired by His Lordship, His love, and the impact of others. ” People may be pure in their own eyes, but the LORD examines their motives” Proverbs 16:2 (NLT) Selah. DIG DEEPER (John 6:5-13; 2 Corinthians 1:6,14; James 4:3; 1 Samuel 2:3; 16:7; Proverbs 21:2; Philippians 2:20-22; Colossians 3:23) WE PRAY: That we shall increase in the understanding of the Lord's intention to rightly correct our motives so that our service may not be of our selfish interests. ONE YEAR BIBLE READING Day 229: Ecclesiastes 1-2 Acts 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I serve the Lord with all of my heart. – Whatever I do, I do as unto the Lord. – I decrease that Christ may increase in me. – I serve the Lord with the right motive; not for fame nor any personal interest. – Many glorify God in me. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 245 - TAKE A STAND!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency TAKE A STAND! "And when it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under an oath, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul." Acts 23:12 Our call to carry out the mandate of Christ is a matter of war. If you have been following this with for a while, this wouldn't be new to you. We must have a sense of urgency and be intentional about this mandate of Christ.
The work of the ministry is not some mere philanthropic engagement.
The Church is not some social club. The Church is God's strategy to dispossess the work of the devil in every city and nation. As members of the Church we are not sent out for funfair we are in serious business. You are a helper of the war and you must take A STAND having the Lord as your witness to spread the gospel of Jesus, no matter the cost. After Paul's arrest (See Acts 21:27-40), he continued to use every opportunity he had before the council to preach. And certain Jews swore an oath, with the intention to kill Paul. They swore an oath putting themselves under a curse. This is how serious the people of the world are to execute their plans. In our day, there are many who have sworn to subdue Europe, Africa, Asia, and the whole world with their religion. Many terrorist groups have sworn an oath to destroy lives for their religion. Some have made an oath, to sponsor the course of such religious and wicked plottings no matter the cost. What are you doing for the gospel?
What STAND HAVE YOU TAKEN?
What pledge have you made to the LORD? And what step are you taking? "Look at how the power brokers of the world rise up to hold their summit as the rulers scheme and confer together against Yahweh and his Anointed King..." Psalm 2:2 (TPT)
Beloved where is your allegiance?
Are you serving the course of this world (which includes your selfish ambition) or relentlessly standing and supporting the course of Christ? It wasn't just the Jews who had sworn an oath. Paul also had his strong stand and conviction: "If I proclaim the Message, it’s not to get something out of it for myself. I’m compelled to do it, and doomed if I don’t!" 1 Corinthians 9:16 (MSG) Today as you are reading this MAKE A DECISION TO SPONSOR THE COURSE OF CHRIST AND THE SPREAD OF THE GOSPEL NO MATTER THE COST.
How far do you want to see the spread of the gospel?
God will do more through you AS YOU TAKE A STAND with Him. Shalom. DIG DEEPER: (Acts 23; 1 Corinthians 15:1; 1 Corinthians 16:13; 1 Corinthians 2:2; 1 Chronicles 12:38; 29:24) WE PRAY: That we will determine in our hearts that the vision of the Lord will not fail in any sphere (town, city, community, school or workplace) we find ourselves. BIBLE READING: DAY 230 Ecclesiastes 3 - 5 Acts 8 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - My commitment and allegiance is to the spread of the gospel - I am a sponsor of the gospel. - I stand for the course of Christ. - I don't serve my interest; I serve the purpose of Christ. - As long as I am in this world, my dedication is to the work of the ministry. - I will shine forth the light of God, and darkness will have no space. - I commit my money, my time, my attention, and all assets to the GOSPEL OF CHRIST. - I AM DETERMINED IN MY HEART THAT THE VISION OF THE LORD WILL NOT FAIL IN MY TOWN, CITY, COMMUNITY, SCHOOL AND WORKPLACE. Oh Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 246 - YOU ARE NOT EMPTY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 26th September, 2023 YOU ARE NOT EMPTY "But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us" 2 Corinthians 4:7 (NKJV) There are some thoughts which control our mindsets and how we think about our lives. For example: You might have heard people make statements like: "We came to this world empty, and we will all leave empty"
How can this be true?
There are people who have really made this thought pattern their consciousness. They think they came to this world empty and for that reason their lives are empty. These thoughts even control the mindsets of certain saints in Christ.
A man in Christ cannot be empty. A man without God has an empty life.
When you become born again, you receive the treasure of God into you. This treasure is the fullness of the life of God in you. You can't carry this life and be empty. The thoughts of emptiness are not of God. "For His divine power has bestowed on us [absolutely] everything necessary for [a dynamic spiritual] life and godliness, through true and personal knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence." 1 Peter 1:3 (Amplified) In your relationship with God, you are supplied with EVERYTHING pertaining to life and godliness (the expression of divinity). Some feel empty because they don't feel satisfied, nor complete.
If you are not feeling satisfied, then you are looking at the wrong places.
Beloved, you are made complete in Christ. Stop looking at things you think you lack or don't have. Look inside, you have God's greatest treasure. DIG DEEPER: (2 Peter 1:2-4; Matthew 13:44-46; Colossians 2:9-10) WE PRAY: That we will grow and increase in the knowledge of the fullness of this rich reality. BIBLE READING: DAY 231 Ecclesiastes 6 - 9 Acts 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am not empty. - I carry the fullness of the life of God in me. - I am made complete in Christ. - I carry God’s greatest treasure in me. - My life is not empty. - I am supplied with EVERYTHING pertaining to life and godliness. Oh Gloreeey! Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 247 - YOU ARE HEALED BY HIS STRIPES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE HEALED BY HIS STRIPES "But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities; The chastisement for our peace was upon Him, And by His stripes we are healed." Isaiah 53:5 (NKJV) The death of Jesus and the punishment He went through, dealt with the spiritual problem, which is sin. However, sin did not only enter the world, it came with with its consequences. One of the consequences or effects of sin is SICKNESS. There are some who think it is wrong to use the phrase "By his stripes we are healed" to address physical healing. According to them, this phrase is only addressing spiritual healing. The Hebrew word used in Isaiah 53:5, râphâh means to mend (by stitching that is (figuratively) to cure; it means to cause to heal {by physician} or repair {thoroughly} to make whole. The Prophet Isaiah was not only referring to the spiritual condition of sin which Jesus dealt with through His death, he was also speaking of how the scourging of Jesus' body dealt with the infirmities of the body (which are consequences of sin).
The legal testimony of your physical healing is the stripes of Jesus and the authority of His name.
The disciples of Jesus did not only see the phrase, "By His stripes we are healed" as spiritual healing. They also saw it as the provision of our physical healing through Jesus. "When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick. This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases" Matthew 8:16-17 (BSB) Matthews Gospel was reasonably written between AD 55 and AD 60, this was either 22years or 27 years after the death of Jesus. Therefore his testimony of the fulfillment of Isaiah 53:5 in Matthew 8:17, is to help his readers understand also the physical impact of Jesus' death. Our Lord was beaten and scourged with a Roman whip also called the "flagellum". It is made of two or three leather (ox-hide) thongs or ropes knotted with a number of small pieces of metal, usually zinc and iron, attached at various intervals. To be scourged by this flagellum would quickly remove the skin and tear the flesh.
Our Lord Jesus suffered this not only for your spiritual sin, but also to bear and take away your physical infirmities.
This means because He has suffered for your sins, He will not deny you healing because of your wrongs and sinful deeds.
As He has suffered for your sins, He has also suffered for your infirmities.
This should let you know that, God will not use sickness and diseases to correct you of your wrongs. He has borne your (spiritual and physical) infirmities. What is the challenge in your body? Which infirmity has afflicted your flesh? Take God's word concerning your health! Stand on it to exercise your faith.
By His stripes you are healed!
If you have any challenge in your body, RECEIVE YOUR HEALING NOW! Be it infirmity in your kidney, lungs, intestines, stomach, eyes, bones and joints, heart, head, brain, or any other part of your body, YOU ARE HEALED whiles reading. Celebrate your testimony NOW. Hallelujah DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 53: 4 -5; 1 Peter 2:24; Luke 4:40; Mark 1:31-32) WE PRAY– Thanking the Lord for bearing and taking away all our physical infirmities. – We will walk in the daily consciousness an manifestation of our divine health. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 231Ecclesiastes 10 - 12Acts 13 - 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I receive healing now into my body. – I am healed from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet, through every fibre in my being, every blood in my cells and every bone of my body. – I am made whole in my entire being by the power of God’s word – Jesus has already suffered, therefore I refuse to suffer again. – I am free from any infirmity. – With the revelation light of God’s word in me, every disorder in my body is corrected. – I enjoy divine health daily. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 248 - ARE YOU STRUGGLING WITH DEPRESSION? 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ARE YOU STRUGGLING WITH DEPRESSION? 1"Heaviness in the heart of man depresseth it: but a good word maketh it glad." Proverbs 12:25 (Webster's Bible Translation)Most of the things you experience around you begins from your heart.For out of the heart are the issues of life (Proverbs 4:23)Depression germinates and finds it root in the heart.It is a crucial matter which requires intentional attention.
God is not silent on the issue of depression.
And because it is a great concern to Him, He's made provision of remedies through His word.Depression is a condition which may affect those who are in Christ and those who have not received Christ.
Are you feeling depressed at this moment?
Or you often find yourself struggling with it?Sincerely depression is an active experience which could depict your thoughts.There are quite some causatives to depression. These things may not always be loud and obvious, but silently work deeply in ones heart, till they become a stronghold.Smothered bitterness or envy or hatred, sense of guilt, self-condemnation, shame, anxiety, fear, disappointments, death of a love one, negative family history, loss of job or opportunities, continues failures, divorce, sense of loneliness or rejection, low self esteem, delays, feeling stagnant in life, abuse, debts, and other negative circumstances (which maybe physiological or psychological) trigger depression.These can make one begin to feel useless and suicidal.
A person struggling with depression frowns at the things and people they enjoy.
He or she begins to lose interest in almost everything.The adversary takes advantage of such situation to steal your joy and to crush your faith.This situation can be overwhelming and you may begin to have intense feelings of helplessness, hopelessness, sadness, fatigue and anger.
Beloved, don't give in to such feeling and don't think it is not possible.
The plot of the adversary is for you to feel you can't do anything about it.You may even begin to feel the word of God is not true or good enough to help you. You lose appetite for the Word and become prayerless.This is when you must know you need the Word of God the most.The first thing to do is to quickly turn to God and speak out to Him!!!"Call upon Me in the day of distress; I shall rescue you, and you will glorify Me.” Psalm 50:15 (LSB)
Depression is a distress or affliction of the soul.
And because the Lord is interested in your total well-being or wholeness, He will not hesitate to make provision of strength to you.One may ask, why wouldn't God just help me in my distress?Do you think reading this at this time is coincidental? Because God wants to help you out of this struggle, He inspired me to write specifically to you. To show you how!
God doesn't automatically step into the affairs of men.
Learn to permit God into your situation by turning to Him.We relate with God by FAITH.Looking unto God, also means you are looking away from all the many things troubling your heart and making you anxious. That is FAITH.The example of Peter:"About three o’clock in the morning[a] Jesus came toward them, walking on the water. When the disciples saw him walking on the water, they were terrified. In their fear, they cried out, “It’s a ghost!” But Jesus spoke to them at once. “Don’t be afraid,” he said. “Take courage. I am here!” Then Peter called to him, “Lord, if it’s really you, tell me to come to you, walking on the water.” “Yes, come,” Jesus said. So Peter went over the side of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus. But when he saw the strong wind and the waves, he was terrified and began to sink. “Save me, Lord!” he shouted. Jesus immediately reached out and grabbed him. “You have so little faith,” Jesus said. “Why did you doubt me?” When they climbed back into the boat, the wind stopped" Luke 14:25-32 (NLT).As long as Peter was looking at Jesus, he walked on the water; until he turned away from the Lord to look at the wind and the waves.To sink could also mean be weighed down or depressed.Peter didn't hesitate to call on the Lord for help.
No matter how you seem drowned or overwhelmed by that depression, Jesus is ready to help you.
Turn away from those thoughts and turn to God.HallelujahDIG DEEPER: (Matthew 14:22-33; Psalm 107:5-7,13; Job 5:8; Psalm 18:6; Psalm 20:1; James 5:13)WE PRAY:That we will not lean on our own understanding and strength but cast all our cares and concerns unto the Lord to direct us.BIBLE READING:DAY 232Songs of Solomon 1 - 4Acts 16 - 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I look unto the Lord in all matters of my life.- In all things and through all things, I turn to the Lord- I don’t lean on my own understanding and strength.- The Lord is the strength of my life.- I have absolute confidence in the word of God.- I stay my mind and heart on the word of God.- I refuse to look away from the word.- Rather than being sad, I choose to rejoice in the Lord.- I do the word.Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 249 - ARE YOU STRUGGLING WITH DEPRESSION? 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ARE YOU STRUGGLING WITH DEPRESSION? 2"Heaviness in the heart of man depresseth it: but a good word maketh it glad." Proverbs 12:25 (Webster's Bible Translation)Depression is the heaviness of a man's heart. And yesterday I took time to mention some of the few causes of depression. These things first lead to the heaviness of the heart and then result in depression.They silently work deeply in one's heart, till they become a stronghold.As I have mentioned, the things you experience around you begin from your heart. (Proverbs 4:23).
No matter how you are overwhelmed by the causes of depression, you must know there is a way out of that condition.
Remember, the plot of the adversary is to make you feel you can't do anything about the depression.The Lord has shown us the way out of depression through the scriptures. The scriptures provide answers to subdue every cause and form of depression.
Understand this, all things were made by the Word of God (John 1:1-3), and uphold all things by the Word of His power (Hebrews 1:3).
Which means, in all things go for the Word.This is why you shouldn't accept the feeling that the word of God is not true or good enough to help you. Always get yourself to go for the Word and to give yourself to prayer.In the previous episode, we looked at the first thing to do when you are sinking into depression according to the scriptures."Call upon Me in the day of distress; I shall rescue you, and you will glorify Me.” Psalm 50:15 (LSB)How does the Lord rescue you from depression?1. He floods your heart with light, through His Word."Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and incomprehensible things you do not know." Jeremiah 33:3 (CSB)You may experience depression, however, the things that cause depression are not founded on REALITY.The light (or revelation and illumination) of the word is truth or reality.For example:A born-again who is depressed because of some sense of guilt or thoughts of being lonely; is not yielding his or her heart to reality.The revelation of the Word will establish you in the consciousness of your righteousness or justification in Christ. (Romans 5:1; 2 Corinthians 5:21; Romans 8:1).
To be righteous is to have right standing with God without any sense of guilt.
By the revelation of the Word you will know that the Lord is with you always (Matthew 28:20) and will never leave you nor forsake you (Hebrews 13:5). The word teaches you how to make the most of every relationship. You exercise the wisdom to enjoy the favor or commitment of men (Isaiah 43:4)
Beloved, the more you turn to the Lord in prayer and behold Him through the Word, the more your heart is flooded with light.
This dispels every form of heaviness that leads to depression. It takes a good word to make a heavy heart glad (Proverbs 12:25).Go for the Word!Selah.DIG DEEPER(Matthew 14:22-33; Psalm 107:5-7,13; Job5:8; Psalm 18:6; Psalm 20:1; James 5:13) WE PRAYThat we will not lean on our own understanding and strength but cast all our cares and concerns unto the Lord to direct us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 234Songs of Solomon 5 - 8Acts 18 - 20  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I go for the word.– I don’t yield to the external forces and influences.– I look unto the Lord in all matters of my life.– In all things and through all things, I turn to the Lord– I don’t lean on my own understanding and strength.– I have absolute confidence in the word of God.– I stay my mind and heart on the word of God.– I refuse to look away from the word.–  I do the word.Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 250 - REFUSE TO BE DEPRESSED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency REFUSE TO BE DEPRESSED"Let not your heart be troubled; you believe in God, believe also in Me" John 14:1 (NKJV)There is nothing about depression which is of God.Don't entertain it!Don't pamper it!Don't justify it!It's amazing how some people esteem and talk about depression as though it is an accomplishment.Especially within these times, more young people seem to eulogize and normalise depression.
IT IS NOT NORMAL TO BE DEPRESSED AS A CHILD OF GOD!
If in case you feel depressed or you are struggling with depression, DECIDE NOT TO STRUGGLE WITH IT.JUST WALK OUT OF THAT DEPRESSION.It is a mindset problem.Don't give room for your heart to be troubled.There is no reward or honor for being depressed. Feeling depressed is not an accomplishment, it is brokenness and an evidence that you are not guarding your heart.
Depression is also an evidence that you are not acting on the Word of God.
There is no part of scripture, the Lord inspires depression.Our Lord Jesus asked a simple question:“And who of you by being worried can add a single hour to his life?" Matthew 6:27 (NASB 1995)Depression, anxiety, worry, or sorrow doesn't add anything to your life. It doesn't make you rich; it doesn't make you walk in blessings; it doesn't increase your height, it doesn't add any more years to your life and doesn't make you strong.When you are already feeling overwhelmed by depression, turn to God. Yes, look away from any reason you have given yourself to remain worried. Give yourself to intense prayers. When you call on the Lord (or get into prayer), He doesn't only flood your heart with light through His word.He also;2. The Lord gives you TRANSCENDENT PEACE."Do not be anxious or worried about anything, but in everything [every circumstance and situation] by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, continue to make your [specific] requests known to God. And the peace of God [that peace which reassures the heart, that peace] which transcends all understanding, [that peace which] stands guard over your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus [is yours]." Philippians 4:6-7 (AMP)Shake yourself out of that depression. This is not just showing you how to come out of depression; it is also helping you know how not to get depressed.
Depression is demonic. You entertain it, you lose.
It is a time and destiny waster. It distracts you from fulfilling your purpose and destroys your beautiful life and calling.No matter your excuse or reason or justification, DON'T BE ANXIOUS OR WORRIED OVER ANYTHING.
Nothing is more precious than WHAT GOD HAS PUT INSIDE OF YOU.
Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Luke 12:22-31; Matthew 6:25-34; John 14:27-28; John 16:33; Psalm 42:5) WE PRAYThat in the name of Jesus, I am free from every cause of depression and my heart is guarded and overwhelmed by the peace of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 235Isaiah 1 - 5Acts 21 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be depressed. - From today, I walk out of any depression in my life. -  I have absolute confidence in the word of God.- I stay my mind and heart on the word of God.- I refuse to look away from the word.Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 251 - DON'T GIVE ROOM FOR DISTRACTIONS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 1st October, 2023 DON'T GIVE ROOM FOR DISTRACTIONS ”And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise.” Philippians 4:8 (NLT) In this present age, mental health has become one of the common troubling conditions. And this is not only with the aged. Most young people are struggling with mental health issues. Most people seem to go through a lot of mental torture and struggle. This includes people who are born again in Christ. People who should put on the shield of faith, have been dominated or swamped by fear and troubles. These things are caused by little distractions and then they grow into unbearable conditions. Some steer off from their faith in Christ and the good works the Lord has ordained for them to walk in; by some seeds of uncertainty and distractions. In this present age of avalanche information and pluralistic worldviews. People are easily distracted and lack the stamina to maintain a strong composure.
Most people don’t know which is the right way to think.
They have become students of social media and not ardent disciples of Christ. Instead of being raised in the school of the Word and the Spirit, people are schooled by comedians and content creators who are interested in creating traffic on their platforms.
You cannot function in faith beyond what you think, see with your mind, hear and speak.
The adversary is after your faith. One of the things to do to maintain great faith is to imbue focus. The greatest strategy of the adversary is to distract your faith. The adversary distracts the focus of your faith with thoughts which are contrary to the word of God. This is why it is essential to fix your mind on the word of God and not what happens around you or how you feel. For the adversary to attack the faith of Job, he went after the things which he loved or are connected to him (his family, his livestock etc) For the adversary to attack you, he can even use the negative comments from family relatives, lecturers or teachers. Past negative and hurtful experiences, including social media trends, can sweep you off your joy.
Until you intentionally imbue focus you will be a slave to the peripherals.
You have a mandate to fulfill. Don’t give room for any distractions, IMBUE FOCUS! Set your mind or heart, your thoughts and imaginations on: – what is true and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. – Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise. Where else can you access these beautiful things except the GOSPEL OF JESUS. Apart from the WORD OF GOD, you cannot access TRUTH.
Don’t start looking for bad reports and negative experiences in your life.
Don’t allow the experiences of some public figures define your life. None of their experiences qualifies to be an example for you.You are of God. If it is not praise worthy don’t give your mind to it.There are more glorious things Christ has done for you, make them your meditation. Remember:that the sharing of your faith may become effective by the acknowledgment of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus. Philemon 1:6 (NKJV) Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 3:18; 10:4-5; 1 Peter 1:13; 5:8; Proverbs 4:25; Hebrews 3:1; 12:1-2; Colossians 3:1; Philippians 3:12-14) WE PRAYIn the name of Jesus, that nothing shall be strong enough to distract us. That by the supply of grace, we imbue divine focus in the midst of all distractions in this present age. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 236Isaiah 6 -8Acts 25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I fix my mind on the word of God. – I don’t give room for any distraction, I imbue focus. – I don’t allow the experiences of others to define my life, my life is defined by the word of God. – I don’t pay attention to the peripherals. – I maintain my heart and mind on my mandate irrespective of staggering oppositions. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 252 -  HIS PRESENCE MAKES THE DIFFERENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 2nd October, 2023 HIS PRESENCE MAKES THE DIFFERENCE “Teach these new disciples to obey all the commands I have given you. And be sure of this: I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Matthew 28:20 (NLT) The adversary rejoices when you are not conscious of the Lord’s presence in your life.
The presence of the Lord with you makes the difference through your journey in time.
The presence of the Lord in your life means you have all of the Kingdom of God backing you.
Don’t allow the adversary to use circumstances or situations to make you feel you are alone.
The challenges you face in this world doesn’t mean the Lord is not with you. The Lord being with you doesn’t suggest you have a challenge-free life. Challenges gives you the opportunity to see the mighty hand of the Lord in your life.
Your consciousness of the Lord’s presence in your life is a great threat to the adversary.
This is the promise of our Lord Jesus: “…I am with you always…” How did that happen? This was fulfilled through the indwelling of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the personal or the embodiment of the presence of God.
When the Holy Spirit came, the promise of our Lord was fulfilled.
Now get this, the birth of our Lord Jesus, is God coming to tabernacle with man. He is Immanuel,“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and bear a Son, and they shall call His name Immanuel,” which is translated, “God with us.” Matthew 1:23 (NKJV). And was the fulfillment of Prophet Isaiah’s prophecy:“Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel.” Isaiah 7:14 Which means our Lord Jesus was the tangible presentation of God to man. He was the manifestation of God. And said, He will be with us always, through the Comforter — The Holy Spirit. “And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper (Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor—Counselor, Strengthener, Standby), to be with you forever” John 14:16 (Amplified).
Beloved, have this confidence that the Lord is always with you. You are never alone, and this has to be your consciousness.
The Lord said to Joshua,“There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.” Joshua 1:5 This was David’s conviction:“Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.” Psalm 23:4 (KJV). The Lord is with you, and that must be your joy, your consciousness and confidence!!! Selah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 23; John 3:1-2; Genesis 39:1-4) WE PRAY– That we will walk in the consciousness of the reality that God is with us irrespective of what we face. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 237Isaiah 9-11Acts 26-27 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Holy Ghost is my helper. – I remain conscious of the Lord’s presence daily. – All that I do prospers because the Lord is with me. – I cannot have a bad day because the Lord is with me. – I have all of the Kingdom of God backing me. – I am never alone. – I walk daily in the manifestation of the Lord’s presence. – I am joyful. Hallelujah!!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 253-THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD 1 - WHO IS THE LORD?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD 1 - WHO IS THE LORD? " The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want." Psalm 23:1 (KJV) Within these few days, I want us to fellowship and masticate and absorb this beautiful Psalm of David (Psalm 23). This is one of the most memorized Psalm and chapters of the Bible. It reveals David's understanding of the relationship he had with God. This is not a Psalm which is just for comfort in times of trials. It is not a Psalm which is to be read just at funerals. It is a Psalm which interpretes our organic relationship with God. We mostly focus on the things the Lord does for us, instead of who the Lord is to us.
Knowing who the Lord is to you makes your walk with Him effective and nourishing.
The reality of the LORD being a Shepherd is deeply rooted in the heart of every man of Faith. It wasn't just David who saw the Lord as His Shepherd, Jacob in Genesis, called the LORD, the Shepherd and stone of Israel (Genesis 49:24) By revelation of scriptures, we also see that it was the LORD, who is the Shepherd of Israel, led Joseph as a flock (Psalm 80:1). David didn't just refer to the Lord as the Shepherd of others or the Shepherd of his fathers. David personalised this reality of the Lord. He said "THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD!". What a consciousness and bold statement! David knew what it means for the Lord to be his Shepherd. Remember he was a shepherd of his father's flock (1 Samuel 17:34) And the Lord also made him shepherd of Israel as a king ( 2 Samuel 5:2-4). As a shepherd he cared and protected his father's flock. How much more when he has the LORD as his Shepherd? As a Shepherd the Lord doesn't just sit on His throne to rule from a distance. He has an intimate and personal relationship with His sheep. He is always in the midst of His flock leading them in the way they should go. He leads them to a place where they will enjoy and not lack provision. "The Lord is my best friend and my shepherd. I always have more than enough." Psalm 23:1 (TPT) "God, my shepherd! I don’t need a thing." (Message Translation).
To have the Lord as your Shepherd means you don't have to be need conscious. Yours is to be conscious of the LORD who is your Shepherd.
Pause for a moment and give a thought to this: "Who is the LORD?" David was referring to the Lord God of Israel, not any other god. Now Jesus is the LORD God of Israel made flesh (John 1:14; 1 Timothy 3:16). This Jesus who is God is our GOOD SHEPHERD. Jesus is not just the lamb of God, He is also the Good Shepherd and Overseer of your soul ( 1 Peter 2:25). Jesus clearly spoke of Himself as the Good Shepherd: " I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep...I am the good shepherd. I know my own and my own know me" John 10:11,14 (ESV) Beloved your Shepherd is the best Shepherd, He is the LORD JESUS. Let Him be your consciousness and not your needs. Selah DIG DEEPER: ( Isaiah 40:11; Micah 7:14; Hebrews 13:20; 1 Peter 5:4; Revelation 7:17) We PRAY: That we shall behold and enjoy the Lord Jesus as our good shepherd. BIBLE READING: DAY 238 Isaiah 12 - 18 Acts 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -The Lord is my shepherd therefore I am abundantly supplied . -He daily loads me with benefits -I am not need conscious ,I am supply conscious -The Lord leads me to a place of abundance and fruitfulness. -I am lavishly cared for by the Lord Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 254 - THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD 2 - I LACK NOTHING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD 2 -I LACK NOTHING "The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want." Psalm 23:1 (KJV) You can only have the audacity to make such utterance when you know who your Shepherd is. The boldness or confidence of David the King, is not because he said, "I SHALL NOT WANT" or "I LACK NOTHING". His boldness or confidence is His Shepherd. The Psalm 23:1 summarizes the whole message in the chapter. The "I SHALL NOT WANT" is as a result of His confidence in the LORD who is His Shepherd and His submission to Him. It is not only about knowing that the Lord is the Shepherd. It is your confidence in and submission to the LORD that matters. The Lord shouldn't just be seen as the Shepherd in a generic or theoretical sense. You have to personalise the reality that: THE LORD IS YOUR SHEPHERD.
David the King didn't just say the Lord is the Shepherd of Israel in this text. He didn't say the Lord is the Shepherd of the nations or the world. He said, "THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD."
This is where you find both the audacious conviction and sweet consciousness: MY Shepherd! Oh glory to God! Is that your personal conviction? Is that how you consciously see the Lord?
Until your heart is subdued with the revelation that the Lord is YOUR SHEPHERD, you will not be able to comprehend the reality that YOU SHALL NOT WANT.
When you see the Lord by revelation that He is "MY SHEPHERD", you just can't be need conscious. To say I shall not want means YOU LACK NOTHING. Nothing means Nothing!
