As long as a sheep submits to the authority, love and the leadership of its SHEPHERD, there is abundant provision for it. So you must know within you that you are a SHEEP. Think like a sheep. As a sheep you must have absolute dependence on your Shepherd. There is no sense of dissatisfied need in a sheep. A sheep knows that by the leading of his good shepherd, all his needs are supplied. A sheep also has no sense of discontentment with the shepherd. A sheep enjoys and is satisfied with what the shepherd supplies to him. A sheep does not desire satisfaction beyond what his shepherd has provided. See what Isaiah says about the Lord: "Like a shepherd, he will care for his flock, gathering the lambs in his arms, Hugging them as he carries them, leading the nursing ewes to good pasture" Isaiah 40:11 (MSG)
This is the beautiful heart of the GOOD SHEPHERD. All that is essential to life is abundantly supplied by God’s shepherding care.
Beloved, the Lord is all that you need. Selah. DIG DEEPER: (Isaiah 40:11; Micah 7:14; Hebrews 13:20; 1 Peter 5:4; Revelation 7:17) WE PRAY: That our heart shall be established and saturated in the comfort and provision of our Good Shepherd. BIBLE READING: DAY 239 Isaiah 19 - 23 Romans 1- 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - The Lord is my shepherd therefore I am abundantly supplied. - He daily loads me with benefits. - I am not need conscious, I am supply conscious. - The Lord leads me to a place of abundance and fruitfulness. - I am lavishly cared for by the Lord. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 255 - THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD 3 - I ENJOY REST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD 3 - I ENJOY REST "He makes me to lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still waters." Psalm 23:2 (NKJV) A lonely sheep (which is outside the fold) wanders around, with uncertainty of green pastures. However, that is not the case of a sheep under the loving care and protection of a good shepherd. From the verse 2 of Psalm 23, the Psalmist begins to illustrate and breakdown the tender care of the Shepherd.
The abundant-supply conciousness of David (the King) was by the revelation of WHO his Shepherd is and also HOW the Shepherd demonstrates his care.
The Sheep LACKS NOTHING because the Shepherd brings him into His perfect place of supply and transcendent tranquil of rest. He practically makes His sheep to couch or settle to feast. The Shepherd doesn't assume the sheep will automatically settle down; He intentionally makes (arranges, plots, strategizes, organizes, or programs) the sheep to couch in green pastures. And leads the sheep by the restful brooks of bliss. The sheep doesn't determine the green pastures or the waters to drink from. The burden and responsibility to identify the green pasture and peaceful waters, is the Shepherd's.
All the sheep does is to follow and to enjoy. The sheep enjoys rest because the shepherd deals with fear, fight and famine.
The beautiful thing is, the LORD who is our Shepherd is all-sufficient in Himself. He doesn't look for the green pastures; nor does He search for the still waters. Our Shepherd is not only a person, He is also our place of satisfaction and enjoyment. "He offers a resting place for me in his luxurious love. His tracks take me to an oasis of peace, the quiet brook of bliss." Psalm 23:2 (TPT)
The green pastures are the resting place which is of the Shepherd Himself. This is not an external place He goes to search; It is in His luxurious love.
Our Lord Jesus (who is the Good Shepherd) is Himself our diet for feasting (John 6:35) and the life-giving Spirit who flows into us as living waters (John 7:37). And as a good Shepherd He leads us to the oasis of peace through His tracks. These tracks are His voice. "He walks ahead of them; and they follow him, for they recognize his voice." John 10:4 (TLB)
Beloved, the good Shepherd leads you with His voice (His Word) which brings you into His comfort, care and love.
Just trust and enjoy the VOICE OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:11; Micah 7:14; John 7:37-39; Hebrews 13:20; 1 Peter 5:4; Revelation 7:17) PRAYER We pray that: - We shall not hastily choose our own paths and be led astray. - Our hearts will not faint in following and trusting the leadership of the Lord, our Good Shepherd. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 240 Isaiah 24 - 27 Romans 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am at rest. - I have seized from all my struggles and works. - I am not anxious about the future. - I have absolute dependence in the supply of the Lord. - I trust and enjoy the voice of God. - The Lord leads me daily in the oasis of peace by His voice. - The Lord is my satisfaction and enjoyment. - I am not need conscious. Oh Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 256 - REFRESHED BY HIS TENDER CARE AND RIGHTEOUSNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency REFRESHED BY HIS TENDER CARE AND RIGHTEOUSNESS " He refreshes and restores my soul (life); He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name’s sake.Psalm 23:3 (Amplified) Most sheep easily go astray when they are without a shepherd. They live scattered, wearied, cast away and hopeless. That is the state of the world today. " When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd." Matthew 9:36 (CEV)
Our Lord Jesus is the true shepherd who gives direction, comfort and total refreshment to His sheep.
There are those who don't stay in the fold or submit to the voice or pathways of the Shepherd. They look away from the Lord and begin to wander in the wilderness of this world. They become prey to wild beasts and are destroyed. " They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts" (Ezekiel 34:5) Now if you can be a sheep, understand also that there are certain people out there in the world, who are as wild beasts looking for strayed sheep to prey on. Some sheep also turn away from the Voice of the Good Shepherd to yield to other shepherds who lead them astray, and make them feel helpless. "My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray, causing them to roam the mountains. They have wandered from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place" (Jeremiah 50:6). The first phrase in the chapter 23 of Psalms: " THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD..." is also a matter of decision or choice. Our Lord is the Good Shepherd who will not abuse His Royal Sovereignty. He wants you to make an intentional decision to submit to Him as your Shepherd.
When you acknoweledge the Lord as the Good Shepherd of your life, you will hear His Voice.
His beautiful and tender caring Voice will lead you into His luxurious love, rest and oasis of peace. This rejuvinates, refreshes and restores the heart of the sheep.
The Lord restores your soul, your entire being and life because He is the GOOD SHEPHERD OF YOUR SOUL.
" For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls." 1 Peter 2:25 (BSB) Look at how He does it again: "He offers a resting place for me in his luxurious love. His tracks take me to an oasis of peace, the quiet brook of bliss.That’s where he restores and revives my life. He opens before me pathways to God’s pleasure... Psalm 23:2-3 (TPT) The "RESTORE" in verse 3, is from the Hebrew word, SHÛB, which means to refresh, revive, strengthen, quicken, make to rejoice, to return home, to re-treat, to relieve, retrieve, compensate and to rescue or deliver. This is not necessarily with the idea to return to your starting point. It is to experience the organic design of comfort by the Good shepherd. It is to live the real life the Lord has intended for you. The Shepherd brings you into a life above distress, helplessness and insecurity. Again let me ask you, is the LORD YOUR SHEPHERD? Trust in the comfort of the GOOD SHEPHERD! SELAHDIG DEEPER: ( Isaiah 40:11; Isaiah 53:6; John 10:11,16; Micah 7:14; Hebrews 13:20; Revelation 7:17) PRAYER: We pray that: WE SHALL EXPERIENCE TOTAL STRENGTH AND RESTORATION IN ALL ASPECTS OF OUR LIVES THROUGH THE CARE AND COMFORT OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD. BIBLE READING:DAY 241 Isaiah 28 - 31 Romans 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS: -I submit to the voice of the shepherd -I do not live scattered ,wearied ,cast away and hopeless -I acknowledge the Lord as the good shepherd of my life. -My soul,entire being is restored because the Lord is my good shepherd [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 257 - REMAIN IN THE LORD'S FOLD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency REMAIN IN THE LORD'S FOLD " Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture." Psalm 100:3 (BSB) From the previous episodes, we have seen: - The Lord as our Good Shepherd. - Because He is our Shepherd we shall lack nothing. - He brings us into the enjoyment of Rest. - And we are refreshed by His tender care. As we progress on this matter of the LORD'S SHEPHERDING; your consciousness on this matter cannot be over emphasised - REMAINING IN THE LORD'S FOLD!
It is one thing to know who the Shepherd is and the enjoyment of His Sheepfold. It is another thing to continue to remain in the fold.
Whenever we speak of the Lord as your shepherd, there are some who limit it to the people of Israel. Get this, the Israelites were once the only sheepfold of the Lord. Yes, Jesus came as the Shepherd of the household of Israel. However, He didn't see the Israelites or Jews only as His fold. He established that as the good shepherd, He has other sheep who will join the sheepfold. Who are they? These are the gentiles who will come to the Lord through Faith. " And I have other sheep that I will gather which are not of this Jewish flock. And I, their shepherd, must lead them too, and they will follow me and listen to my voice. And I will join them all into one flock with one shepherd." John 10:16 (TPT)
In Christ's Fold we are one in Him. There is neither Jew nor Gentile (Non-Jews).
" In Christ’s family there can be no division into Jew and non-Jew, slave and free, male and female. Among us you are all equal. That is, we are all in a common relationship with Jesus Christ. Also, since you are Christ’s family, then you are Abraham’s famous “descendant,” heirs according to the covenant promises." Galatians 3:28-29 (MSG) As a born again, the Lord has brought you into His fold. You are a part of His sheep. There are times the adversary will make you feel the Lord's sheepfold is not enough. He makes you think there are more opportunities beyond the sheepfold of the Lord. THAT IS A LIE!
Remember the adversary is the father of lies. Lies is the native language of the devil (John 8:44).
There are sheep who go astray because they have no Shepherd. That is not your case. You have the LORD as your good shepherd. When you become born again, you belong to the Lord and you are part of His sheepfold. The Lord's sheepfold is the Church. The community of the saints (Christ's family) is the fold of His sheep. He leads His sheep directly as the Chief Shepherd (1 Peter 5:4) and also gives the Sheep some trained-gifted men (who are after the Lord's heart) to be Shepherds of His fold (1 Peter 5:2-3). These Shepherds are the leaders in the Church (Apostles, Pastors, and Prophets); who are responsible to teach you knowledge and understanding (Jeremiah 3:15). It is a dangerous thing to live outside Christ's fold. The adversary wants you outside the sheepfold of Christ (which is the Church in your locality). The moment you stay out of the Lord's fold, you become vulnerable to the enemy and he begins to make your faith stagger. There are people who stay out of the Lord's fold and soon forget or loose touch of the rich relationship they had with God (Jeremiah 50:6). They live scattered, wearied, cast away and hopeless. " They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts" (Ezekiel 34:5) Now if you can be a sheep, understand also that there are certain people out there in the world, who are as wild beasts looking for strayed sheep to prey on.
Refuse to stay out of the Lord's fold.
"Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour" 1 Peter 5:8 (BSB) Remain in the fold, where you have the security of the good Shepherd. Where you will enjoy His luxurious love, rest and oasis of peace. SELAH DIG DEEPER: ( Ezekiel 34:31; Psalm 27:4; Psalm 23:6; Psalm 61:4; John 10:11,16; Micah 7:14; Hebrews 13:20; Revelation 7:17) PRAYER: We pray that: We shall not be moved nor lured out of the Lord's sheepfold. BIBLE READING:DAY 242 Isaiah 32 - 35 Romans 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I refuse to stay out of the Lord's fold -I belong to the Lord and I am part of His sheepfold - I am loved and well cared for in the sheepfold -I have the security of the good shepherd. -I enjoy His luxurious love rest and oasis of peace [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 258 - GOD PUTS YOU UNDER A SHEPHERD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GOD PUTS YOU UNDER A SHEPHERD "And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will guide you with knowledge and understanding." Jeremiah 3:15 (NLT) To delve more into the gleanings from Psalm 23, we need to understand these few things. Yesterday, we looked into why you must remain in the fold. And it was also established that: - the Lord's sheepfold is the Church. (The community of the saints). - as the Chief Shepherd (1 Peter 5:4); he has also given His sheep trained-gifted men (who are after His heart) to be Shepherds of His fold (1 Peter 5:2).
There are some within the Church who don't see their Pastors as the visible shepherds, our Lord Jesus has given them.
They go like, "THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD, therefore I don't need any man to be my physical shepherd." That is ignorance; total ignorance. Those with such mentality don't know how the system of God works. The Lord God, was the Shepherd of Israel (Genesis 49:24; Psalm 80:1; Psalm 23:1). Yet the Lord gave them shepherds. "And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will guide you with knowledge and understanding." Jeremiah 3:15 (NLT)
Through Moses (as Shepherd) the Lord God (who is the chief Shepherd), led Israel out of Egypt (Hosea 12:13).
The Lord chose David to be a shepherd of Israel. "He also chose David His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds; From following the ewes that had young He brought him, To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance. So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skillfulness of his hands." Psalm 78:70-72 (NKJV) The word Pastor is from the Greek word "Poimēn", which means shepherd. Our Lord Jesus is the "Chief Shepherd" (from the Greek word "Archipoimēn).
The Lord Himself gave some to be Pastors (Ephesians 4:11).
The Lord has put the saints (as flocks) under each shepherd. There is no fellow in Christ who is not entrusted to a shepherd (Pastor). "Care for the flock that God has entrusted to you..." 1 Peter 5:2 (NLT) He has given to the Church Pastors who are to Shepherd the saints. They have the authority and responsibility to: - watch over you and to care for you with Christ as their example. - feed you and teach you with knowledge and understanding. - lead you by their own good example of faith and love. - instruct, direct and build you through the word. And this is your responsibility: "In the same way, you must accept the authority of the leaders set over you. And all of you, dress yourselves in humility as you relate to one another. “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.” (1 Peter 5:5).
You are not to be isolated from the fold the Lord has placed you.
Enjoy the Leadership of the Good Shepherd (through the personal relationship with the Lord Jesus) and submit to the authority the Lord has entrusted you to, as you are nurtured and equipped for the work of the ministry. Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Acts 20:28; Jeremiah 23:4; Ezekiel 34:2,23; 1 Samuel 13:14) WE PRAYWe engage the Wisdom of God to rightly submit with humility to the authority of the Shepherds He has set over us. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 243 Isaiah 36 - 38 Romans 7 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I remain in the fold (Christ Commonwealth - Community) the Lord has placed me. - I have found my place and I refuse to isolate myself from the fold. - Through humility, I submit to the authority of my shepherd (). - I take heed to the leadings of my shepherd (). - I enjoy rest and joy through the guidance of the Spheperd the Lord has given me. - I don't wander around like one without a Shepherd. - I follow diligently to every instruction. Oh Gloreey! Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 259 - SUBMITTING TO TRAINING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  9th October, 2023SUBMITTING TO TRAINING“A Psalm of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, Who trains my hands for war, And my fingers for battle” Psalm 144:1 (NKJV) As an enlisted soldier in God’s army, you have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel. As a royal priest, you are to show forth the glory of Him, who called you out of darkness into His light. (1 Peter 2:9). This war is between light and darkness.
This war is about the salvation of souls.
It is about subduing kingdoms and taking unreached territories for the Lord and unto His glory. You must have this strong mindset that God has made you a soldier. And as a soldier you must submit to a certain kind of training and mindset.
It is through the training of the Lord that you are strengthened.
From the opening verse you see David declaring how he won battles and war.“the Lord trains my hands for war, and my fingers for battles” Through training you are taught, equipped, empowered, instructed and tried through tasks.You maybe in Christ and be thinking like a civilian, instead of a soldier. You don’t get involved in the training and the sending of the Lord. You only want to be served and pampered in Church.
However, the Church of our Lord Jesus is an army.
You see the Church only as a “hospital”. You just attend meetings for your needs and well-being. That is not totally wrong, but the Church is more than a “hospital”. The Church is both a family and an army.Jesus said, ” …I will build my church, and all the powers of hell[b] will not conquer it” Matthew 16:18 (NLT).
When you come for Church meetings, you are equipped for the work of the ministry.
“And he has appointed some with grace to be apostles, and some with grace to be prophets, and some with grace to be evangelists, and some with grace to be pastors, and some with grace to be teachers. And their calling is to nurture and prepare all the holy believers to do their own works of ministry, and as they do this they will enlarge and build up the body of Christ“ Ephesians 4:11-12 (TPT). This is how Jesus is building His Church.You are trained to serve as a victorious (good) soldier. Before Paul asked Timothy to “…endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ…” He told him, “…the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.” 2 Timothy 2:2 (NKJV) You can see that, Timothy was a soldier who submitted to training and teaching. And he has the responsibility as a leading soldier to also train others also. But those who will be trained must be proven faithful that they will continue in that process as well.
Timothy did not just function as a good soldier, he was responsive to instructions.
And instructions are designed to help you wage a good warfare. “Timothy, my son, here are my instructions for you, based on the prophetic words spoken about you earlier. May they help you fight well in the Lord’s battles” 1 Timothy 1:18 ( NLT). He was instructed by Paul the apostle that;“No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” 2 Timothy 2:3-4 (KJV). You don’t just go out there to wage war, you are trained and equipped through God’s word daily and weekly. This is the purpose of Church meetings.
Your absence from Church meetings, is your absence from training.
How do you wage good warfare without training and instructions? As God’s weapon of war or battle axe (Jeremiah 51:20-21), you must be sharpened.See Ecclesiastes 10:10:“Using a dull ax requires great strength, so sharpen the blade. That’s the value of wisdom; it helps you succeed” (NLT) “If you don’t sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you’ll know what to do.” ( CEV)
This is why Jesus didn’t ask us to go forth to just win souls, He commissioned us to make disciples (students) — Matthew 28:19.
The principle Jesus demonstrated to us was, win, build and send. That is how we expand God’s kingdom and army (workforce). The Lord told Jeremiah;“Stand at attention while I prepare you for your work. I’m making you as impregnable as a castle, Immovable as a steel post, solid as a concrete block wall. You’re a one-man defense system against this culture, Against Judah’s kings and princes, against the priests and local leaders. They’ll fight you, but they won’t even scratch you. I’ll back you up every inch of the way.” God’s Decree. Jeremiah 1:18-19 (MSG). Beloved, as a soldier in the Kingdom, submit to a ministry where you will be trained to function triumphantly. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 32:41;1 Corinthians 4:17; 1 Timothy 1:5; Ephesians 6:12-18; 2 Samuel 22:35; Psalm 18:2,31,34; Psalm 44:3,4; Psalm 60:12) WE PRAYDear Lord, teach me to humbly submit to your nurturing and training, through my local Church, that I may be good soldier. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 244Isaiah 39 - 41Romans 9 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I humbly submit to training. – The Lord teaches my hands for war and my fingers for battle. – the Lord is my strength. – I am equipped. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 260 - HE LEADS YOU IN HIS RIGHTEOUSNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HE LEADS YOU IN HIS RIGHTEOUSNESS "He refreshes and restores my soul (life); He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name’s sake." Psalm 23:3 (Amplified) Most saints are conscious of their self-efforts than the supply of the Lord. Psalm 23, focuses on the supply and nourishment of the GOOD SHEPHERD. It reveals to us how we have to enjoy the tender care of the Shepherd.
Your work is to have the consciousness and confidence that the LORD IS YOUR SHEPHERD.
Whatever the LORD supplies as the GOOD SHEPHERD is an expression of His Person.Anything the Lord gives you is of Himself. Which means the LORD doesn't go round looking for green pastures. Neither does He search for still waters. When you come to Him and receive Him as your SHEPHERD, He becomes to you all that you need to be nourished and preserved as a SHEEP.
When you see the LORD as your Shepherd, you have MORE THAN ENOUGH; because the LORD is YOUR SUPER IMMEASURABLE, LIMITLESS, ABUNDANCE of SUPPLY.
Read the verses in Psalm 23, with this MINDSET. So now what comes to mind when you think of the verse 3: "...He leads me in paths of righteousness for his name’s sake." This leading of the Lord is not an external work, but an inward organic work of His life. "...and leads me along in his footsteps of righteousness so that I can bring honor to his name." Psalm 23:3b (TPT) The LORD Jesus, who is our GOOD SHEPHERD is also our Life (Colossians 3:4).Which means He doesn't lead us by giving us external instructions or rules to obey. He leads us through our organic living. And by this leading we don't try to create out own paths. He is the Way, the Truth and the Life (John 14:6). We don't look for our own righteousness. All the paths of righteousness are embodied in Him. He is our righteousness. Now since we have Him as our life, our living is unto His glory.
What really brings glory and honor to God is the Lord's grace, not our own works of righteousness.
Your own (self) righteous steps will not be unto the glory of the Lord. Your righteous steps are only in the footsteps of the Lord. The right standing of the Lord Jesus, is your right standing. Your right living is by the supply of the Lord's grace within you. This means you don't have to struggle to love right. You don't struggle to walk in righteousness. He is your righteousness, (He has made you righteous) and supplies you with the inward organic ability for you to walk or live right. Again let me ask you, is the LORD YOUR SHEPHERD? SELAH.DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 5:17; Psalm 5:8; Ephesians 1:6; Psalm 119:105; Isaiah 40:11; Isaiah 53:6; Hebrews 13:20; Revelation 7:17) PRAYER:We pray that we shall express the LORD'S RIGHTEOUSNESS by the organic supply of His life in us. BIBLE READING:DAY 245Isaiah 42 - 45Romans 11 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't create my own path, the LORD is the Way. - The LORD leads me daily in the path of His righteousness. - The LORD is my supply. (Say this again, again and again until your spirit aligns with it). - The LORD is my Shepherd therefore I have no consciousness of need. - The LORD Jesus is my Life and nourishment. - I don't struggle to walk in love because I am supplied by the Lord's grace within me. - I don't struggle to walk in righteousness because He is my righteousness. Oh Hallelujah! Gloreeeey! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 261 - FEAR NO EVIL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency FEAR NO EVIL "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me." Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) As much as we enjoy the leadings of the Good Shepherd, it does not suggest we will not be confronted by challenges. This is the reason the Shepherd is also the protector and defense of the flock. To walk in the valley of the shadow of death, is to be overwhelmed or hedged in and surrounded by some dark experience intended to create fear of destruction. This "valley of the shadow of death" is not the dwelling or destination of the sheep. When you find yourself in such situations, know that you are not dwelling there. You walk through it!
The "shadow of death" speaks of the "grave" (figuratively calamity). Well, in the midst of such situations, you have a greater assurance.
You are under the care of the Good Shepherd. His presence with you is your confidence and audacity.
Don't get troubled and feel threatened because you are confronted by a difficult situation. Yours is to trust the GOOD SHEPHERD.
In your most difficult moments, who do you speak to? From the first verses of Psalm 23, the Psalmist was addressing his readers, and referred to the Shepherd as the third person - "HE". But from verse 4, David begins to refer to the Shepherd in the second person - "YOU". He was no longer addressing his readers, he was now addressing his Shepherd.This reveals how David turned to his Shepherd in his most difficult times.
He makes the Lord his consciousness.
The Lord's presence does not necessarily eradicate the challenges and the dangers of the adversary. However, the Lord's presence is the haven of care and defense for you in the midst of the most evil situation. You may definitely be faced with some challenges and situations which seem difficult, DON'T FEAR ANY EVIL. The adversary may even attempt to cast thoughts of a worse scenario on your mind; but refuse to accept those thoughts. Refuse to be discouraged. Refuse to be afraid for the LORD IS WITH YOU.
Maybe the Lord leads you into a marriage, or to start a business or ministry, and suddenly everything seems to go bad. Refuse to fear evil.
In your family, marriage, business, finances, ministry, career pursuit and journey of success, REMAIN RESOLUTE WITH THIS CERTAINTY THAT THE LORD IS WITH YOU. You cannot end up as a failure. Don't accept those thoughts of fear. You will come out of that valley of the shadow of death as a victor! Remember the RESURRECTION ABILITY OF CHRIST is at WORK IN YOU. Jesus defeated death for you to enjoy the fullness of His life.
You have conquered all powers of death.
Walk in victory! FEAR NO EVIL. Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER:(Deuteronomy 20:1; 2 Samuel 22:19; Psalm 3:6; Psalm 27:1) PRAYER:I pray declaring the victory of the Lord and the manifestation of the power of His presence in the midst of every evil situation. I overcome every challenge by the power of the Lord's presence. IN THE NAME OF JESUS. BIBLE READING:DAY 246Isaiah 46 - 50Romans 13 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be discouraged. - I refuse to be afraid for the LORD IS WITH ME. - I trust in the GOOD SHEPHERD therefore I fear no evil. - I walk through everyday of my life with this consciousness. - I have conquered all powers of death. - I remain absolute in this certainty. - I walk in victory everyday. Oh Glory to God! Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 262 - HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 1 "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me. Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) The Psalmist reveals how he will fear no evil no matter how he will be hedged in difficulty or threats. Because the Good Shepherd (who is the Lord) is with him. You can read more on HOW TO FEAR NO EVIL, when you walk through the valley of the shadow of death here.
Beloved, you are under the care of the Good Shepherd. His presence with you is your confidence and audacity.
Remember I explained that, from the first verses of Psalm 23, the Psalmist was addressing his readers, and referred to the Shepherd as the third person - "HE". But from the verse 4, David begins to refer to the Shepherd in the second person - "YOU". He was no longer addressing his readers, he was now addressing his Shepherd. David revealed how he looked to the Lord in the midst of adversity. "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me." Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) The assurance of David wasn't just the consciousness that the Lord was with Him; it was also the comfort the Lord gives Him. The thing is, the Lord doesn't just want you to assume that He is with you. He makes your faith tangible. You see tangible manifestation or demonstration of His help, as you maintain confidence that He is with you. When you really see and submit to the Lord as your Shepherd, you will trust His leadings and His voice. You will not esteem the challenges above the guard and guidance of the LORD. The expression "YOUR ROD AND YOUR STAFF THEY COMFORT ME" is one of the most exquisite picturesque of our spiritual and practical relationship with the LORD (the Good Shepherd) in the scriptures. David as a Shepherd used these items and the practice of Shepherds in his day, to paint a picture of how the LORD defends and directs him through his life's journey.
A sheep is one of the most defenceless animals in God's creation. Thus, a sheep depends absolutely on the shepherd for care, provision and protection.
Which means, the Shepherd must find a way to defend and guide the sheep. The Shepherd doesn't only have a STAFF or crook, the shepherd also has a ROD. The Rod is a thick stick with a knob at the end of it (it is like a policeman's club) used defensively or offensively against predators. Look at David's testimony as a shepherd: "But David persisted. “When I am taking care of my father’s sheep,” he said, “and a lion or a bear comes and grabs a lamb from the flock, I go after it with a club and take the lamb from its mouth. If it turns on me, I catch it by the jaw and club it to death." 1 Samuel 17:34-35 (TLB). Now imagine the confidence and comfort the lamb will always have as it follows David. This is a picture of the protection David had when he thought of the Lord as his Shepherd. If David could defend and protect his sheep much more the LORD?
The LORD is the Good Shepherd who wields His rod (which is His power and authority) to protect us from every evil plot and adversity.
PRECIOUS ONE, THE LORD IS YOUR DEFENCE!!! Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 20:1; Psalm 27:1; Psalm 46:1,7; Isaiah 31:5; Zechariah 12:8; Psalm 18:2; Psalm 118:14-18) WE PRAYThat in the midst of adversity in this world, we shall enjoy the defense of the Lord and nothing of us shall be afflicted by the enemy. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Day 247Isaiah 51 - 56Romans 15-16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am under the care of the GOOD SHEPHERD. - His presence with me is my confidence and audacity. - I trust the voice and leadings of the LORD. - I esteem the guard and guidance of the LORD above any challenge in my life. - The LORD is my defense. Oh Hallelujah. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 263 - HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 2 " Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me. Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) One of the profound picturesque of our spiritual and practical relationship with the LORD is portrayed in this: "YOUR ROD AND YOUR STAFF THEY COMFORT ME" This reveals how as a sheep you experience comfort; which is to dispel grief and fear even when you walk through the valley of the shadow of death. The Lord who is the Good Shepherd is the God of all comfort. He is the one who comforts you (Isaiah 51:12).
He is the Lord who proclaims comfort to His people in the face of adversity.
"Comfort, comfort My people," says your God." (Isaiah 40:2). It is not really about the challenge which confronts you. The question is:
WHO IS YOUR SHEPHERD?
Though the Rod is an important tool to the Shepherd, its relevance and impact is dependent on the HEART OF THE SHEPHERD. A shepherd who doesn't care or is even scared and unskilled wouldn't know how to wield the rod. He will run for his life when the wild animals attack.
But with the LORD (Your Good Shepherd), even when you doubt His defence, HE REMAINS FAITHFUL. He is the STRONG AND MIGHTY ONE!
The LORD is Himself the spring of comfort. His comfort spurts through His ROD AND STAFF. Some assume that the Rod and the Staff are of the same Hebrew word and have the same meaning. They may be similar in meaning but have their uniqueness. The Rod (is from the Hebrew word shêbeţ) doesn't only mean a thick stick with a knob (like a club). It is the same word for SCEPTER.
A king uses a scepter to imbue power and authority. Kings are also seen as shepherds.
Thus, the Rod is an instrument which depicts the power and authority the LORD exudes over all dominions and powers. This is why you cannot be afraid. His STAFF ( which is mish‛ênâh in Hebrew) means a walking or support stick. It is commonly referred to as the Shepherds Staff/Hook. It is for sustenance and rest. His staff also provides guidance and direction. This so beautiful, the Lord doesn't just protect you from danger by how He destroys the predators. He also comforts you through His direction.
As you go through challenging times, He leads you in the way you should go.
ENJOY THE POWER, AUTHORITY AND DIRECTION OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD. Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 51:11-12; 2 Corinthians 1:4; Isaiah 49:13; Psalm 46:1,7) WE PRAYDeclaring that we daily enjoy divine protection, comfort and direction according to His authority and wisdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 248Isaiah 57 - 601 Corinthians 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The LORD is my comfort. - It doesn't matter the challenge I face, the LORD leads me in the way I should go. - I trust the voice and leadings of the GOOD SHEPHERD. - I refuse to be afraid. - I am sustained by the GOOD SHEPHERD. Oh Hallelujah. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 264 - HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 3 "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me. Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) We have already discussed some key realities of Psalm 23:4. And in this verse we see two key ultimate things we enjoy or happens to us (as the sheep of the Lord): - We fear no evil - We are comforted. Fear is dispelled even when we walk through the valley of the shadow of death; because of the presence of the Good Shepherd. We are also defended and given rest by His Rod and Staff. However, there are some additional items we have to look into concerning the Lord's Rod and Staff. Understanding all that the Rod and the Staff represents will help you appreciate the verse 4 more. The Rod is not only for protecting the sheep from predators, the Rod also: - Reveals how the Shepherd ACKNOWLEDGES every sheep. Mostly when the shepherd wants to count the sheep, he makes them pass under the rod. Some mistaken this phrase "pass under the rod" to mean punishment. Meanwhile, that is not what it really represents. “I will make you pass under the rod [as the shepherd does with his sheep when he counts them, and I will count you as Mine and constrain you] and bring you into the bond of the covenant [to which you are permanently bound]. Ezekiel 20:37 (Amplified)
The Rod is also the Shepherd's instrument to identify or acknowledge you as His.
Just as the Lord designated Israel to Himself as His own flock and people, even so has He designated, distinguished and separated the Church (and you are a member of the Church) unto Himself as His own people.
The Lord is not a hireling, He is the GOOD SHEPHERD who owns His flock.
He marked you as His and knows you intimately, because you have passed under His rod and hands. You are permanantly bound to Him as His. He is your eternal Shepherd and you are His sheep eternally. You are perpetually consecrated unto the Lord. "and because the gatekeeper knows who he is, he opens the gate to let him in. And the sheep recognize the voice of the true Shepherd, for he calls his own by name and leads them out, for they belong to him" John 10:3 (TPT) The rod of the Shepherd is not only for defending His flock, neither is it only for counting; it is also a symbol of intimacy. You are not just a number in His flock. You are a member and He identifies you by your name. - The rod is also used by the Shepherd to SELECT His sheep. "And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD" Leviticus 27:32
The Shepherd uses the Rod to select or choose the tithe of His sheep to be given unto the Lord. Listen, the Lord sees you as his choicest.
"Even before he made the world, God loved us and chose us in Christ to be holy and without fault in his eyes." Ephesians 1:4 (NLT) Dear beloved, you are selected and chosen in Christ as His holy and faultless sheep, according to His loving kindness and grace. Be comforted for the Lord knows and care for those who are His. Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 33:13; John 10:3-4;1 Peter 2:9; Ephesians 5:27; Ezekiel 34:12; Proverbs 27:23; Isaiah 51:11-12) WE PRAYThat we enjoy daily the benefits of the Lord's selection and walk in the consciousness of our consecration to Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 250Isaiah 61 - 661 Corinthians 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The GOOD SHEPHERD has designated, distinguished, and separated me as His own. - The Lord has marked me as His own and He knows me intimately. - I am perpetually consecrated unto the Lord. - I am the choicest of the Lord. - I am selected and chosen in Christ as His holy and faultless sheep, according to His loving kindness and grace. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!Hallelujah!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 265 - HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HIS ROD AND HIS STAFF 4 "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me". Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) To know the extent of comfort David enjoyed, you must understand the efficacy of the Shepherd's ROD AND His STAFF. I have already shared some few verities on the ROD and the STAFF. According to the verse 4 of Psalm 23, the goal of the Shepherd's Rod and Staff is to bring COMFORT to the sheep. The Rod and the Staff are sometimes used interchangeably in the scriptures. The Hebrew word "shêbeţ" means rod, and could also mean scepter or staff. This is why in some verses of the scriptures, you will find the word Rod in one translation and in another translation they use Staff or Scepter. (However, in Psalm 23:4 they used two different Hebrew words for Rod and Staff as I explained in the Part 2 of this topic "His Rod and His Staff"). "Shepherd Your people with Your scepter, The flock of Your possession Which lives by itself in the woodland, In the midst of a fruitful field. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead As in the days of old." Micah 7:14 (NASB). The word scepter is the word shêbeţ; a scepter is used by kings as symbol of authority and power. The King exudes the righteousness of His Kingdom by His scepter. (Psalm 45:6).
The Shepherd is the leader of His flock. His authority and power is not in how He uses the sheep to His advantage. His leadership is seen in how He tends the sheep.
We have already learnt that by His ROD (authority and power, which He exerts through the Word of His Power): - He defends and protects you. - He acknoweldges, identifies, designates, distinguishes or separates you to Himself as His. - He has chosen you unto Himself according to His lovingkindness. By His Rod and Staff: - The Lord LEADS/GUIDES / DIRECTS you in the way you should go. He guides you from dangerous circumstances. All you have to do (as the Lord's sheep) is to hear His voice and follow Him. (John 10:3,27). - The Lord RESTRAINS you from falling or going astray. The Shepherd uses the staff hook to draw a sheep close when it seems to wander away. He is the good Shepherd who will keep you from falling (Jude 1:24). He keeps you from falling into sin, error, darkness evil paths and plots of the enemy. The more you pay attention and heed to His voice, the more you are restrained from error and evil.
The GOOD SHEPHERD takes delight in you and cares for you according to His loving kindness.
FOLLOW HIS VOICE! Shalom. DIG DEEPER: (Psalm 95:6-7; Psalm 100:3; Psalm 28:9; Psalm 79:13; Isaiah 9:6-7) WE PRAY: That we shall be prompt to take heed to the voice of the Lord. BIBLE READING: DAY 250 Jeremiah 1- 2 1 Corinthians 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I am under the care of the GOOD SHEPHERD. – His presence with me is my confidence and audacity. – I trust the voice and leadings of the LORD. – I esteem the guard and guidance of the LORD above any challenge in my life. – The LORD is my defense. – The LORD is my comfort. – It doesn’t matter the challenge I face, the LORD leads me in the way I should go. – I trust the voice and leadings of the GOOD SHEPHERD. – I refuse to be afraid. – I am sustained by the GOOD SHEPHERD. – The GOOD SHEPHERD has designated, distinguished, and separated me as His own. – The Lord has marked me as His own and He knows me intimately. – I am perpetually consecrated unto the Lord. – I am the choicest of the Lord. – I am selected and chosen in Christ as His holy and faultless sheep, according to His loving kindness and grace. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!Hallelujah!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 266 - MY SHEPHERD AND MY HOST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MY SHEPHERD AND MY HOST "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over" Psalm 23:5 (NKJV) Our discussion on this Psalm has revealed the tender care and protective heart of our Shepherd (who is the Lord). - We saw Jesus as the good shepherd, who supplies your needs bountifully. - He causes you to enjoy Him as your diet and rest through His luxurious love. - He refreshes your heart and brings you to a life above distress. - As the good shepherd, He is your righteousness; thus, leads you not by rules and regulations. You live right by His organic life within you. - He is the Shepherd who lives in you and with you irrespective of the chaotic conditions which may confront you. - He is not just with you, He defends and protects you. He selected and separated you unto Himself to be His forever. - He also guides and restrains you in the way you should go. Let me just draw your attention to this interesting thought. I believe some who don't want to submit to God will make an assertion that: 'The shepherds, tend, feed and protect their sheep for the interest of their own business.' However, Psalm 23:5 reveals the beautiful character of the Good Shepherd (the Lord Jesus) which is contrary to the shepherds of this world. They protect their sheep from the prey, so that they will comfortably feast on their own sheep or trade them.
Instead of the sheep to be prepared as meal for the table, the Good shepherd prepares a table for the sheep.
There is a shift in the metaphor used by David in this Psalm. In the verse 5, you will see that, the Shepherd has now become a Host whiles the sheep has become His guest. However, the feast is hosted in the presence of the sheep's enemies. As you are designated, selected and separated unto the Lord, you will have enemies. Having enemies is also an evidence that you are on the Lord's side. As a sheep you will always attract the enemies of your Shepherd. Usually a person may eat fast before his enemies and quickly get into defensive or attacking position. But that is not the case of the Good Shepherd's guest. The shepherd creates an environment for His guest to have a quietude in the face of his adversity.
The calm bravery of the guest is dependent on the consciousness of who his host is and the quality of security he enjoys.
David already said, "...though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil for you are with me..." verse 4, Psalm 23. And then points out the bravest act of feasting, even when he has his enemies before him or around him. Right through verses 4 and 5, David illustrated the unwavering confidence he has in the Lord; who is his Shepherd and Host.
The Lord is not just guiding and guarding you, He is also your HOST.
And as your HOST, He is not interested in wiping out your enemies. He rather takes delight to make you enjoy His comfort and be abundantly satisfied even when you are faced with opposition. Such an AUDACITY of life can only be experienced when the Lord is truly your SHEPHERD and HOST. Selah. DIG DEEPER: (Psalm 31:19; Psalm 78:18-20; Psalm 22:26-27) WE PRAY: That by the spirit of revelation of the Lord upon our heart, we shall enjoy with quietude the provision of the Lord in the face of opposition. BIBLE READING: DAY 251 Jeremiah 4 - 6 1 Corinthians 5 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - The Lord is my Shepherd and Host. - I am the delight of the Lord. - In the face of opposition, the Lord makes me to enjoy His comfort to be abundantly satisfied. - I remain at rest even in the face of oppositions. - I am secured in the care of the GOOD SHEPHERD. - The GOOD SHEPHERD daily loads me with benefits Ohh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 267 - MY SHEPHERD AND MY HOST 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MY SHEPHERD AND MY HOST 2 "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over" Psalm 23:5 (NKJV) The Lord (who is your Shepherd) is the Creator of the universe. By Him all things were made; and nothing was made without Him. The entire universe revolves around Him, for He is the center of all things. (Colossians 1:16-17). And you know, the LORD is your Shepherd and your Host.
Can you imagine having the creator of the universe being your Shepherd and your Host?
No wonder David said, "The Lord is my Shepherd, I shall not want". Your relationship with the LORD doesn't end only as Shepherd and sheep. The Lord (who is the Shepherd) is also your Host. As I mentioned previously, instead of the sheep to be prepared as meal for the table, the Good shepherd prepares a table for the sheep.
As a sheep, you are also the Shepherd's guest. And He is the best Host you can ever have. Your welfare and comfort is the interest of your Host.
These ancient people esteemed the concept of hospitality. It was an obligation to receive and be hospitable to peaceful and harmless guests. The host makes provision of food and any other thing the guest needs to be comfortable.
In Christ Jesus, we are invited to dine with Him.
Jesus says to them, “Come, dine”; and none of the disciples were venturing to inquire of Him, “Who are You?” Knowing that it is the LORD;" John 21:12 (LSV) The disciples were convinced it was the Lord because that is His norm. Whenever He shows up He provides for His people and dines with them. "HE PREPARES A TABLE BEFORE ME IN THE PRESENCE OF MY ENEMIES..." hints at the responsibility of the Host to provide and protect His guest. Here is an example of providing and protecting the guest. "So he brought him into his house and fed the donkeys; and they washed their feet and ate and drank. While they were celebrating, behold, men of the city, certain worthless and evil men, surrounded the house, pounding on the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came to your house so that we may have relations with him.” Then the man, the master of the house, went out and said to them, “No, my fellow citizens, please do not act so wickedly. Since this man has come to my house [as my guest], do not commit this sacrilege". Judges 19:21-23 (Amplified Bible) When you read on, you will realise the host chose to sacrifice his concubine, in other to protect his guest. The Lord has hosted you in an eternal feast. Right in the presence of your enemies, the Lord makes provision for you. He has given you everything you need according to His power and glory (2 Peter 1:3). And there is no need to be afraid, since your safety is the responsibility of your Host. ENJOY THE SUPPLY OF THE LORD. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Psalm 31:19; Psalm 78:18-20; Isaiah 25:5-6; John 10:9; 2 Peter 1:3) WE PRAY: That we enjoy divine provisions without fear of evil attacks. BIBLE READING: DAY 252 Jeremiah 7 - 10 1 Corinthians 7 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I enjoy the daily provisions of the Lord without fear of any attack. - I refuse to fear in the face of staggering oppositions. - The Lord prepares a feast for me in the presence of oppositions. - My safety is the responsibility of my Host who is the LORD, therefore I cannot be afraid. - I enjoy all that the Lord supplies without fear. - I am at rest in Him. Oh Hallelujah. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 268 - YOUR PRICELESS PRIVILEGE AND SUPREME ADVANTAGE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOUR PRICELESS PRIVILEGE AND SUPREME ADVANTAGE 1 "Yet indeed I also count all things loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them as rubbish, that I may gain Christ." Philippians 3:8 (NKJV) Lives and destinies are sustained by knowledge. And the relevance, advancement and influence of men are determined by their level of knowledge.
Who you are, is not a great threat as compared to when you know who you are.
When you are born to be a king and you have zero knowledge of it, you cannot function as a king. What you know is what makes the difference. This is not just a phenomenon among men. This is a reality in God and in the spirit. Your greatest limitation is your ignorance. The dimension of knowledge you operate in, defines your manifestation of purpose.
The greatest thing to happen to you, is to grow in the rich knowledge of Christ.
Until the appearing of Christ, it was the Jews who were referred to as the people of God (Deuteronomy 7:6-8). They had a covenant with God through the circumcision of the flesh, the oracles and the law of God were committed to them. They were reckoned as the worshippers of God. The prophetic word of the Lord concerning the Messiah was entrusted to them. Now the law which was given them, was their greatest revelation of God. And they esteemed their attempts to keep the law, as means unto righteousness. Now in Philippians chapter 3, Paul (the apostle) outlined these credentials and reckoned them as nothing as compared to the REVELATION OF JESUS.
No matter how the Jews boasted in their relationship with God through the laws and their circumcision, they never experienced the complete fullness of the knowledge of God.
To the Jews it was a mystery they couldn't decode. Though the oracles of God were first entrusted to them, they saw them as an unsearchable riches of wisdom. Therefore when Paul encountered Jesus, he beheld the glory which transcends the one distributed through the law of Moses. For the glory of the law fades away (2 Corinthians 3:7-18). The light of the knowledge of the glory of God shines in the face of Jesus. Until you behold and know the Lord Jesus, you cannot experience the transcending glory of God.
In Christ Jesus, we have the priceless privilege and access to the deepest revelation of God.
"But whatever former things were gains to me [as I thought then], these things [once regarded as advancements in merit] I have come to consider as loss [absolutely worthless] for the sake of Christ [and the purpose which He has given my life]. But more than that, I count everything as loss compared to the priceless privilege and supreme advantage of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord [and of growing more deeply and thoroughly acquainted with Him—a joy unequaled]. For His sake I have lost everything, and I consider it all garbage, so that I may gain Christ" Philippians 3:7-8 (Amplified Bible). The things considered as advancement by Jews are worthless and to be counted as loss, in comparison to the excellency or priceless privilege and supreme advantage of knowing Christ Jesus our Lord.
The knowledge of Christ is the summit of God revealed.
Look, the more you know Jesus, the more you assimilate the reality of the highest power and authority of the entire universe (of things in Heaven, on earth and under the earth. The authority which supersedes all principalities and powers). No wonder the epistle reckons your growth in the knowledge of Christ as priceless privilege and supreme advantage. Make it your daily desire to grow in the knowledge of Jesus. Shalom. DIG DEEPER(John 17:3; Philippians 3:3-10; Isaiah 53:11; 1 Corinthians 2) WE PRAYThat we may increase in the desire and know how to harness the opportunities and access given us by the Lord to grow in the deep rich knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 253 Jeremiah 11 - 13 1 Corinthians 9 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the priceless privilege and access to the deepest revelation of God. - I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of Christ. - I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. - As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. - I am full of the knowledge of Christ. Oh Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 269 - YOUR PRICELESS PRIVILEGE AND SUPREME ADVANTAGE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOUR PRICELESS PRIVILEGE AND SUPREME ADVANTAGE 2 "But more than that, I count everything as loss compared to the priceless privilege and supreme advantage of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord [and of growing more deeply and thoroughly acquainted with Him — a joy unequaled]." Philippians 3:8 (Amplified Bible) How is it a priceless privilege and supreme advantage to know Christ Jesus and to grow more deeply into your fellowship with Him? You will find some answers in Colossians 2: 9 - 12; 1. Verse 9: "For in Him all the fullness of Deity (the Godhead) dwells in bodily form [completely expressing the divine essence of God]." You can access the fullness of God only in Christ Jesus. The word "fullness" is from the Greek word, plērōma which means the totality of divine powers, presence and riches in glory. 2. Verse 10: "And in Him you have been made complete [achieving spiritual stature through Christ], and He is the head over all rule and authority [of every angelic and earthly power]." Jesus is the head of all rule and authority. Thus, knowing Him brings you into the participation of His authority. The knowledge of Christ gives you spiritual stature to exercise His authority. 3. Verse 11: "In Him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, but by the [spiritual] circumcision of Christ in the stripping off of the body of the flesh [the sinful carnal nature]" The Knowledge of Christ establishes you in the consciousness of the circumcision of the controlling carnal nature which hinders you from living the fullness of the divine life at work in you. 4. Verse 12 "having been buried with Him in baptism and raised with Him [to a new life] through [your] faith in the working of God, [as displayed] when He raised Christ from the dead." There is a new life which you live through Christ. You can walk in the complete reality of this transcendent new life by the knowledge of Christ.
Get this, the more you grow in the knowledge of Christ, the more you see what God has dispensed into you through Him.
The knowledge of Christ makes your spiritual root go deeply into His life. You no longer become enslaved or made captive through philosophy and empty deception or pseudo-intellectualism. You begin to progress further into your union with Him and live above the traditions and musings of mere men.
When you get so absorbed in His knowledge you live a life enriched with His glory.
What more is priceless and of supreme advantage than this? Selah. DIG DEEPER(John 17:3; Philippians 3:3-10; Isaiah 53:11; 1 Corinthians 2) WE PRAYWe pray that the Holy Spirit will lead us into deeper revelation and fellowship with Jesus, so that our hearts and living may be absorbed richly with His fullness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 254 Jeremiah 14 - 17 1 Corinthians 11 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in the complete reality of the transcendent new life by the knowledge of Christ. - I am not enslaved by the systems of this world. - I live a glory enriched life. - I have a priceless and supreme advantage, Oh Hallelujah, I'm not ordinary. - I live above the traditions of this world. - I live a higher life. Oh glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 270 - YOU ARE VALUED BY THE GOOD SHEPHERD - YOUR GRACIOUS HOST 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE VALUED BY THE GOOD SHEPHERD - YOUR GRACIOUS HOST 1 "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over." Psalm 23:5 (NKJV) We have been drinking from the rich wells of the Psalm of David (Psalm 23), for some days now. From the first part of the verse 5, we realised the Psalmist focused on the Shepherd as his Host. This establishes the graciousness of our Shepherd. It is obvious that, most shepherds tend their sheep either for trade or to prepare them for slaughter and feast. However, it is a different narrative with our Good Shepherd. He sees His sheep as companions. Therefore, instead of preparing His sheep as meal for the table, He prepares a table for the sheep.
He makes the sheep His guest. For you to have the Lord as your Shepherd-Host, is the best thing ever.
As your Shepherd-Host, He will give you the best treat and comfort. Just as we have seen that the Host is responsible for the security of His guest, our the Lord who is the ALMIGHTY, shall protect, preserve and defend you with all of His might and resources. He is also the GRACIOUS HOST! This is because, He doesn't only prepare a table before you in the presence of your enemies; He also ANOINTS YOUR HEAD WITH OIL. This is an ancient practice of Jewish hosts and even among the Oriental nations. They anoint the head or the body (feet) of their special guests with oil as an act of graciousness, respect or honour to them. It is also reckoned as an act of courtesy towards an important and valuable guest. Mostly, the host uses a special anointing oil to freshen up a guest he highly esteems or loves. Jesus gives us a vivid example: "One of the Pharisees asked Jesus to come to his home for lunch and Jesus accepted the invitation. As they sat down to eat, a woman of the streets—a prostitute—heard he was there and brought an exquisite flask filled with expensive perfume. Going in, she knelt behind him at his feet, weeping, with her tears falling down upon his feet; and she wiped them off with her hair and kissed them and poured the perfume on them. When Jesus’ host, a Pharisee, saw what was happening and who the woman was, he said to himself, “This proves that Jesus is no prophet, for if God had really sent him, he would know what kind of woman this one is!” Luke 7:36-39 (TLB). Jesus replied his host by turning to the lady: "Then he turned to the woman and said to Simon, “Look! See this woman kneeling here! When I entered your home, you didn’t bother to offer me water to wash the dust from my feet, but she has washed them with her tears and wiped them with her hair. You refused me the customary kiss of greeting, but she has kissed my feet again and again from the time I first came in. You neglected the usual courtesy of olive oil to anoint my head, but she has covered my feet with rare perfume. Therefore her sins—and they are many—are forgiven, for she loved me much; but one who is forgiven little, shows little love.” Luke 9:44-46 (TLB) This is parallel to Psalm 23:5. First, Jesus sat at the table set by his host (read Luke 9:46 in TPT). Just as the Good Shepherd prepares a table before His guest (Psalm 23:5).
The pharisees opposed Jesus. Yet, He ate before them, just as you feast at the Lord's table in the presence of your enemies.
Jesus goes on to outline how a host must treat a valuable guest.. 1. "You didn’t bother to offer me water to wash the dust from my feet," Which means, the Host washes the feet of His guest. 2. "You refused me the customary kiss of greeting." Your Host greets you with a kiss. 3. "You neglected the usual courtesy of olive oil to anoint my head." The Host has to anoint the head of the guest with an expensive oil. When these things are done, they depict the graciousness of the Host. Your Shepherd-Host, provided you with all that you need at His love banquet table and graciously anointed you with the most precious oil. This reveals how valuable you are to Him. Oh hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Luke 9:36-50; Psalm 104:15; Psalm 45:7; Psalm 92:10; Amos 6:6) WE PRAYTHANKING THE LORD FOR THE VALUE HE PLACED ON US AND HIS GRACIOUS CARE. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 256 Jeremiah 18 - 21 1 Corinthians 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am graciously cared and loved by my Host who is the Lord. - I am the delight of the Lord. - The GOOD SHEPHERD daily loads me with benefits. - I am secured in the care of my Host. Ohh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 271 - YOU ARE VALUED BY THE GOOD SHEPHERD - YOUR GRACIOUS HOST 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE VALUED BY THE GOOD SHEPHERD - YOUR GRACIOUS HOST 2 "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over." Psalm 23:5 (NKJV) When the Psalmist said; "You anoint my head with oil" he was revealing the absolute graciousness of the Shepherd-Host. In our previous discussion we understood the custom of every host anointing the head or body (feet) of their most valued guests.
To be anointed by the Lord (who is your Host) is to demonstrate how much He values you. The Lord doesn't see you as His ordinary guest. YOU ARE SPECIAL AND VALUED.
In as much as the anointing oil was used to welcome and respect most honoured guests; it was also a medium the guest was refreshed. The oil has another purpose in the hands of a Shepherd. It is also used to treat wounds of the sheep and to keep insects away from their heads.
The anointing oil symbolises the outpouring of the Spirit-Life within and upon the believer.
"And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing" Isaiah 10:27 (KJV) The LORD anoints your head with Himself, to bring healing and comfort to your wounds and pain. He protects you from the turbulance of this world by His anointing within and upon you.
To be anointed with oil was a sign to set one apart or consecrate him for a divine or sacred purpose.
By anointing a person’s head with oil, God is symbolically setting them apart, consecrating them for His divine purposes and protection. You don't have to cry to God for the anointing. The Lord wants you to be concious of the anointed impartation of the Holy Spirit. "But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all know" (1 John 2:20).
As a believer in Christ, you are anointed with the Holy Spirit.
The anointing of the Holy Spirit is an immeasurable quality of the Spirit dispensed into you. By the anointing of the Holy Spirit upon you and within you, you are set apart unto the Lord. He has chosen you to be special and consecrated for the good purpose of His will. Your life is now a rich anointed life, separated unto the deep intimate relationship with your GRACIOUS HOST. Enjoy! Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Luke 9:36-50; Psalm 104:15; Psalm 45:7; Psalm 92:10; Psalm 105:15; Luke 4:18) WE PRAYThat we shall be comforted and refreshed more and more by the anointing of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023DAY 257 Jeremiah 22 - 25 1 Corinthians 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am special and valued by the Lord. - The anointing of the Holy Spirit is upon and within me. - I am anointed. - The Lord has chosen me to be special and consecrated, for the good purpose of His will. - I live is a rich anointed life. - I have been separated unto deep intimate relationship with the Lord who is my GRACIOUS HOST. - I enjoy this life to the fullest. Oh Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 272 - TRANSFORMATION THROUGH THE GOSPEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 22nd October, 2023 TRANSFORMATION THROUGH THE GOSPEL "For I am not ashamed of this Good News about Christ. It is the power of God at work, saving everyone who believes—the Jew first and also the Gentile". Romans 1:16 (NLT) It is not any message at all that brings salvation.Salvation is in the gospel of Jesus. When you see and hear the evil and the wrongs going on with people in this generation, you may be tempted to think it is the preaching of condemnation, which will get people saved from their evil ways.
Telling people how wrong and evil they are is not what brings salvation.
This is not to say, you may not have to help people realise their wrongs and their need for salvation. There are people whose eyes have been blinded and they easily justify and defend their wrongs and evil ways. Truly, Jesus did not justify any wrongs. Jesus made justification available for all men who believe. However, you need to get this, the message which bring salvation is not the declaration of the wrongs of people. The message which brings true Salvation is not telling people about the horror of hell. Nobody has to receive Jesus on the grounds of fear.
He came to bring Salvation on the grounds of love (John 3:16). The gospel is not the declaration of the wrongs you see.
The gospel (goodnews) is what God has done for us through Christ Jesus.I heard someone tell another fellow concerning the preaching of the gospel.And was like, “it is not about the message you preach, it is how you get someone saved by all means.” Beloved in Christ, the Lord did not just give us the ministry of reconciliation, He also gave the message of reconciliation. "Now all things are of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given us the ministry of reconciliation, that is, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and has committed to us the word of reconciliation". 2 Corinthians 5:18-19 (NKJV) Alright, see how 2 Corinthians 5:18-19 is presented in the Living Bible:"All these new things are from God who brought us back to himself through what Christ Jesus did. And God has given us the privilege of urging everyone to come into his favor and be reconciled to him. For God was in Christ, restoring the world to himself, no longer counting men’s sins against them but blotting them out. This is the wonderful message he has given us to tell others."
You didn’t come into relationship with God or experience Sonship in Christ, by your self efforts.
You were not saved by your self efforts or what you did by the works of legalism.It was what Jesus did in His death and resurrection that got you saved. He died as the lamb of God for the forgiveness of your sins. The message is Christ and His work through His death and resurrection.There are no TWO GOSPELS. We must only TESTIFY OF THE GOOD NEWS OF JESUS.
The gospel is the light of the knowledge of God in the face of Jesus.
Why then do you proclaim darkness if menare yearning and are in need for LIGHT? The gospel is the reality of Jesus whom we preach. Preaching and teaching the goodnews of Jesus is the ministry of Righteousness. It points men to JESUS and not to their defeated and beaten past and corruptibility. The ministry of condemnation points men to their weaknesses. It is more revealing and life-transforming, to preach Christ than to preach the crisis of the now.
When you come to the true knowledge of the gospel of Christ and your mind is saturated with the grace of God, you will live right.
Right living is the product of the reality of Christ’s goodnews in your heart. Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Romans 2:3-4; Romans 1:15-17; Luke 2:10-11; 1 Corinthians 2:1-2) WE PRAYThat doors shall be opened for the teaching and preaching of the transforming power of the gospel in all places BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 26 - 271 Corinthians 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I experience the transforming power of the gospel. – I walk in the consciousness of all that Christ achieved for me. – I boast in the finished work of Christ on the cross and not in my self-efforts. – The gospel of Jesus spreads through me. – I make the goodnews of Jesus my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 273 - CHRIST'S WON FREEDOM WASN'T PARTIAL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 23rd October, 2023 CHRIST'S WON FREEDOM WASN'T PARTIAL "Let me be clear, the Anointed One has set us free—not partially, but completely and wonderfully free! We must always cherish this truth and stubbornly refuse to go back into the bondage of our past" Galatians 5:1 (TPT) Within this period of hustle and bustle, many people become too focus on what they have attained by their own efforts. They translate their efforts to make money, into their relationship with God. They use the same method of worldly market sense to judge how God relates with them. They feel they are not righteous until they do something for God or pay for their sins. To them the fairness of life is to make sure you buy or pay for what you owe and what you want to own. There are some people who received Jesus when they heard the gospel concerning His death for the salvation of men. Yet, they still think they owe God.
Some people feel their wrongs and debts are so huge the blood of Jesus is not enough to justify them.
Others also think the blood of Jesus played a role in their salvation, however, their good works makes the salvation complete. Well, this is no news, that is how men have always thought and lived. It seems to be woven into the natural genes of men to hardly accept the beautiful glorious news of their salvation through Christ Jesus. Paul says, "for their minds have been blinded by the god of this age, leaving them in unbelief. Their blindness keeps them from seeing the dayspring light of the wonderful news of the glory of Jesus Christ, who is the divine image of God." 2 Corinthians 4:4 (TPT) The god of this world has a way of using certain religious concepts to keep people in bondage.There are many others who still don’t believe the blood of Jesus was enough to satisfy the penalty of sin.They still believe in animals sacrifices and their good works to be saved. For animal sacrifices, they are obsolete; they are insufficient to make anyone righteous. (See Hebrews 10:1-14). And concerning your good works, or obedience to religious regulations, they cannot make you righteous or free. "For by grace you have been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God; not as a result of works, so that no one may boast." Ephesians 2:8-9
However, your good works are fruits of your salvation and the love of God in your heart.
Living under the bondage of religious regulations, makes you think anything free is not complete until you do something to make you feel you really earned it or worked for it. This makes you doubt the finished work of Christ and keeps you in bondage.Look, the salvation we have received in Christ is free but it is not cheap.
Precious one, you have been made free from the regulations of religion and the demands of the law, through Christ Jesus.
“And you who were dead in trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your flesh (your sensuality, your sinful carnal nature), [God] brought to life together with [Christ], having [freely] forgiven us all our transgressions, Having cancelled and blotted out and wiped away the handwriting of the note (bond) with its legal decrees and demands which was in force and stood against us (hostile to us). This [note with its regulations, decrees, and demands] He set aside and cleared [j]completely out of our way by nailing it to [His] cross.” Colossians 2:13-14 (Amplified Bible). Let no one use religious systems and regulations to steal your freedom in Christ. He nailed it to the cross, and wiped the records of your wrongs, slate clean. Give no one chance to squander Christ’s hard-won freedom for you. "I am emphatic about this. The moment any one of you submits to circumcision or any other rule-keeping system, at that same moment Christ’s hard-won gift of freedom is squandered. I repeat my warning: The person who accepts the ways of circumcision trades all the advantages of the free life in Christ for the obligations of the slave life of the law." Galatians 5:2-3 (The Message)
Christ’s hard-won freedom wasn’t partial.
It doesn’t need your self-effort to make it complete. For it is completely wonderful and eternally established. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:1-10; John 8:36; 1 Corinthians 16:13; 2 Corinthians 3:17; Galatians 3:25) WE PRAYThat our minds will be stayed on the gospel of our Lord Jesus that we will not depend on our works but continue in the glory and liberty of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 28 - 301 Corinthians 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified by faith. – The life of Christ is my life. – I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds. – My boast is in the Lord finished work of Christ. – I am priceless. – My cost price is God Himself. – God purchased me with His blood, therefore I am valuable to God. – I don’t live cheap. – I don’t live as a slave. – I am bought with a price, therefore I glorify the Lord in my body. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 274 - WHAT IS THE EXTENT OF THE LOVE OF GOD IN YOUR HEART?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 24th October, 2023 WHAT IS THE EXTENT OF THE LOVE OF GOD IN YOUR HEART? “And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you” 1 Thessalonians 3:12 (KJV) Beloved, the condition of your heart is what makes the difference in your walk with God. You can go as far as the intensity of your love for the Lord. We already have the Love of God dispensed in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5).
However, what is the extent of the love of God in your heart?
How has the love abounded? The love of God burning in your heart will precede the great commission. How far you can go in your journey with God, is dependent on how much His love has overflowed in your heart. Your desire and affection; your intentional actions and your level of diligence will gravitate towards what you Love. Your love FOR God is first influenced by the love OF God burning in your heart. Your love for God is an outflow of His love for you.So how much do you love God? You can judge your love for God by: 1. The time you make to pray to commune with Him and to take grace for His work. And also how you make time for the study of the Word.You make time for who and what you genuinely love. 2. How easily are you distracted by situations? The overflowing love of God cannot be distracted. No power or situation is strong enough to move you away from what you must do for God. 3. How do you love the brethren? The extent you keep malice, find issues with people, take offense, hold grudge, envy and become bitter exposes the measure of the love of God at work in you. 4. The secret thoughts of your mind and heart are the inward measure of your love.That is where true love is measured. The secret thoughts of your heart are the motives or genuineness of your heart. So, do you give in Church and yet complain in your mind or secretly to others? Are you a cheerful giver, Do you share in the Father’s love? Why do you serve in Church and also win souls? 5. How far do you go with the gospel of Jesus? How compassionate are you to see men saved? Are you just wishing to preach Christ to others or you are taking steps to get others saved? When you truly have the overflowing love of Christ, you will be compelled to share and shout out the love of Christ. You will look and create the opportunities to preach the gospel. You will not feel pressured when you are involved in the Lord’s work.Love is not merely about your feelings and emotions.
Love is effective according to your growth in knowledge and understanding.
This is why your personal fellowship with God’s Word is important; and submitting to sound teaching of the Word of God is a necessity. “So this is my prayer: that your love will flourish and that you will not only love much but well. Learn to love appropriately. You need to use your head and test your feelings so that your love is sincere and intelligent, not sentimental gush. Live a lover’s life, circumspect and exemplary, a life Jesus will be proud of: bountiful in fruits from the soul, making Jesus Christ attractive to all, getting everyone involved in the glory and praise of God”Philippians 1:9-11 (Message Translation) Shalom.DIG DEEPER(John 14:15; 1 Corinthians 13:1-13; Matthew 6:24; Galatians 5:13;1 Thessalonians 2:8; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAYThat our hearts will abound or overflow with the love of God and that we will be unstoppable fulfilling the assignment of the Lord.
