BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 31 - 332 Corinthians 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The love of Christ shall flourish more and more in me. – I don’t act by feelings and sentiments. – I function by love which is according to knowledge. – I live out the divine love of Christ. – The love of God is burning in my heart more and more. – My desires and affections are pure and genuine. – The love of Christ influences my thoughts. – My heart is set on the Lord. – I grow in the knowledge and understanding of God’s love for me. – I walk in supernatural love. – There is no place for distractions. – There is no place for malice, envy, negative thoughts and offense. – I walk in the absolute love of Christ. – I love the brethren more and more. – I am the embodiment of the love of Christ. – I don’t feel pressured because I serve the Lord in love. Oh Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 275 - MY CUP OVERFLOWS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MY CUP OVERFLOWS 1 "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over." Psalm 23:5 (NKJV) In the verse 5 of Psalm 23, we see the Psalmist unveiling the absolute graciousness of the Lord and the value He places on His SHEEP. Our Lord Jesus is the good shepherd who gives you a royal treat. Christ brought you into Himself to supply you with all that you need for life and godliness (2 Peter 1:3). The anointing brings healing and comfort to your wounds. To be anointed is to be consecrated by God for His divine purposes and protection.
The anointing of the Lord upon you is a demonstration of how much He values and honours you.
The quality of oil your host pours on you reveals the degree of value he places on you. Our Lord anointed you with His Spirit. The anointing of the Holy Spirit is the immeasurable quality of the Spirit dispensed into you. The anointing is not only poured on you; it is also transfused into you as a divine quality.
This makes your life a rich anointed life for the glory of the Lord.
This means at His table the Lord doesn't just satisfy you with material blessings. Most people only think of the Lord supplying them with wine, food and other material blessings at His table. The greatest feast at His table is the feast of the Lord. Our Lord Jesus who is the embodied substance and true revelation of who the GOOD SHEPHERD IS, serves you with Himself. He dishes out His life and Spirit at His table. He says, "I am the true bread of life." You partake of Him you will never go hungry. (See John 6:32-35;41,48,50-51,58).
No one partakes of His water and becomes thirsty.
"but if anyone drinks the living water I give them, they will never thirst again and will be forever satisfied! For when you drink the water I give you it becomes a gushing fountain of the Holy Spirit, springing up and flooding you with endless life!” John 4:14 (TPT) This is not your usual HOST. Whatever He serves you with dispenses the life (which has an eternal value) into you. He gives water and it becomes a gushing fountain of the Holy Spirit, springing up and flooding you with endless life! Oh glory to God. I don't know how you see yourself precious one in Christ. However, from the day you believed in Jesus and received the Holy Spirit into you, you received a gushing fountain, which springs up as life. It is not only designed to nourish you, but to make you a fountain to nourish others.
Your cup is too small to contain all that the Lord has poured into you. And you know what?
He is not stopping, THE LORD KEEPS POURING MORE! It is a gushing fountain overflowing into every aspect of your life and to nourish the multitudes Hallelujah. DIG DEEPERJeremiah 34 - 37 2 Corinthians 3 - 4 WE PRAYWe shall be conscious of the anointing within us as the gushing fountain of the Holy Spirit, springing up and flooding us and our sphere with endless life. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 34 - 37 2 Corinthians 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I have the quality of God's life in me as a fountain. - I am not dry, I have the anointing of the Holy Spirit. - The anointing of the Holy Spirit gushes forth in me as a fountain. - The anointing in me springs up as life. - Many lives are blessed by the overflowing of the Lord's anointing in me. - I enjoy the overflow of God's Spirit. - I don't limit the flow of the anointing in my life. - I walk in the consciousness of the anointing. Oh Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 276 - MY CUP OVERFLOWS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MY CUP OVERFLOWS 2 "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over." Psalm 23:5 (NKJV) Precious one, the cup which our Shepherd-Host serves us with is an overflowing cup. "You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows." Psalm 23:5 (ESV). The reality is that whatever the Lord (who is our Shepherd-Host) serves you with, He serves it superabundantly. One may think it is wrong to say Our Lord serves. He is King and we must serve Him. That is the irony here. Our Lord is not the King who demands service. He serves you and any service you may render to Him, He does it with you. For without Him you can do nothing. (John 15:5). "For even the Son of Man did not come expecting to be served by everyone, but to serve everyone, and to give his life as the ransom price in exchange for the salvation of many.” Mark 10:45 (TPT).
The Lord serves you with His best.
The term or word "Cup" in Psalm 23:5, has been given several meanings. Considering the various figurative meanings of "Cup" in all through scriptures. This word is used in scriptures in both figurative sense and literally. Literally, it is a usual cup (either of horn or some precious metal); it is used for drinking during meals or ceremonies. It is used during a family or a solemn sacred meal. At such sacramental meals, the head or father of the family pronounced certain blessings over the cup. That makes the cup, a cup of blessing. Depending on the pronouncement made over the cup. (These cups are mostly filled with wine). After tasting it, the head or father passes it around to the company and his whole family, who will also partake of it. (Just as it happened during the "Lord's supper"). All through the scriptures, you will find expressions such as: The "cup of salvation" (Psalm 116:13) The "cup of consolation" (Jeremiah 16:7) There is the cup of death, the cup of trembling, and the cup of wrath. These are figurative expressions. In ancient East and even Egypt, there was also an art of divining by means of a cup (Genesis 44:2-17)
The concept of the cup in a figurative or metaphoric sense depicts an individual's fate, destiny, and satisfaction of time and life.
For example, In Psalm 16, the Psalmist said, "O Lord, You are the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You maintain my lot." Psalm 16:5 (NKJV). Read it in The Passion Translation: "Lord, I have chosen you alone as my inheritance. You are my prize, my pleasure, and my portion. I leave my destiny and its timing in your hands." However, Psalm 23:5 gives emphasis to an abundant life with an overflowing cup (portion of blessings and satisfaction). In an arid or semiarid topography, this is an overwhelming or mighty picturesque. Now from the above point, I want you to know that YOUR CUP which runs over is not merely an object you have in your hand.
It is your LIFE.
The Psalmist said, "MY CUP". This points to "HIS LIFE AND LIVING". The Shepherd-Host doesn't put an object or cup into your hand, just for you to receive His precious wine. His LIFE becomes your LIFE (John 10:10; Colossians 3:4). And this LIFE is the CUP which overflows with HIS RICH ABUNDANT SUPPLY of His drink. "Now on the last and most important day of the feast, Jesus stood and called out [in a loud voice], “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink! He who believes in Me [who adheres to, trusts in, and relies on Me], as the Scripture has said, ‘From his innermost being will flow continually rivers of living water.” John 7:37-38 (Amplified Bible). ENJOY THE OVERFLOWING GRACIOUS BLESSINGS OF THE LORD. Selah. DIG DEEPERJohn 7:38-39; Isaiah 58:11; Isaiah 12:3; Isaiah 35:6; Psalm 16 (TPT) WE PRAYThat every aspect of our lives and destinies shall overflow with the gracious blessing of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 38 - 41 2 Corinthians 5 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I have the quality of God's life in me as a fountain. - My destiny is flooded with the Lord's gracious blessings. - My cup overflows with the good pleasures of God. - I am not dry, I have the anointing of the Holy Spirit. - The anointing in me springs up as life. - Many lives are blessed by the overflowing of the Lord's blessings in me. - There is no limitation in my life. I am graciously blessed with abundance. -I walk in the consciousness of the anointing and the overflowing blessings of the Lord Oh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 277 - PURSUED BY GOODNESS AND MERCY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency PURSUED BY GOODNESS AND MERCY 1 "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever" Psalm 23:6 (NKJV) The most quoted phrase of the Psalm 23 is the verse 6. Mostly (not sure of the early days of the Church, but from the past few centuries ago) used as a closing benediction during Church meetings. Sometimes the popularity of a chapter or verse makes it seem to be a cliché. Notwithstanding, the gleanings we've had all through Psalm 23, it is obvious this Psalm is rich in the revelation of divine comfort and peace.
Within the heart of the first part of verse 6, is the word "FOLLOW".
"Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life..." One may think it should rather be "Goodness and Mercy". However, the focus is on the function and operative mode of "Goodness and Mercy". The word "FOLLOW" doesn't bring out the complete picture from the original Hebrew word. To follow in English means to go, come after, or proceed. This is not strong enough to depict the original meaning. As you will understand what Goodness and Mercy represent, you will realise the irony of having these nouns as the subject of the verb "FOLLOW".
The original Hebrew word is "râdaph", which means to run after (usually with hostile intent); to chase; put to flight; follow after on a hunt as a lion hunts its prey; be under persecution; pursue; or pursuer.
This verb usually describes the hostility of an enemy. This was used by the Psalmist to create a word picture of the aggressiveness of the Good Shepherd; showing how His loving kindness pursues you even when you seem to be avoiding it and going off course. There are moments when the adversary floods your heart with doubtful and undeserving thoughts. You begin to look down on yourself and feel all the kindness and warmth of the Shepherd-Host shouldn't be for you. You look back on your life and feel you have made so many mistakes and all you deserve is punishments.
Nevertheless, the Lord has set up or programmed His Goodness and Mercy in your life to pursue and hunt you into His comfort haven.
No matter which direction you go in life, you can't hide from the aggressive and overwhelming pursuit of the Lord's Goodness and Mercy. No wonder He said: "And I give them eternal life, and they will never, ever [by any means] perish; and no one will ever snatch them out of My hand" John 10:28 (Amplified Bible).
Beloved, have this assurance and unbending certainty that you cannot be part of the sheepfold of the Lord Jesus and be a disadvantage.
It is impossible to be His sheep and not be overwhelmed by His Goodness and Mercy. Your life is in the focus of the hunting gears of His Goodness and Mercy. Hallelujah! Shalom Aleichem. DIG DEEPER(Psalm 36:7-10; Psalm 103:17; Psalm 145:9; Lamentations 3:22-23) WE PRAYThat in all aspects of your life, you shall experience the overwhelming pursuit and comfort of the goodness and mercy of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 42 - 45 2 Corinthians 7 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I experience the overwhelming pursuit and comfort of the goodness and mercy of the Lord. - I am part of the Lord's sheepfold and I cannot be a disadvantage. - My life is in the focus of the hunting gears of His Goodness and mercy. - I refuse to allow any situation, challenge, past mistakes or even past failures to make me feel underserving of the kindness and warmth of my Shepherd-Host. Oh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 278 - PURSUED BY GOODNESS AND MERCY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 28th October, 2023PURSUED BY GOODNESS AND MERCY 2"Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever" Psalm 23:6 (NKJV)Imagine spending all your life begging God for His Goodness and Mercy and then finally you come to the light of this verse of the Bible:"Surely your goodness and unfailing love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will live in the house of the LORD forever." Psalm 23:6 (NLT)
What?
Goodness and Mercy shall pursue me?What did I do right to deserve that?It's interesting men always want to earn their way through. It is that pride in men, that makes them think everything they experience must be by their "Self-effort". They always want to talk about how they worked hard for it.
Psalm 23, is a prophetic Psalm which taps into God's love for us in His eternal economy.
The verse 6, specifically reveals the character of God towards His own. It unveils the relentlessness and aggression of the Good Shepherd in tenderly caring for His sheep.
The question is are you His sheep?
This verse is not a request or a beggarly plea. It begins with the word "SURELY" which emphasizes the bold certainty or confident declaration of the Lord's immovable and unwavering love towards His sheep. The protection and supply of blessings of the Lord is an undisputable guarantee."Goodness and Mercy" are expressions of the unending pleasant supply of God's provision and lovingkindness.God is good and merciful; He hunts, hounds, overtakes and overwhelms you with His lovingkindness."O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever." 1 Chronicles 16:34 (KJV)
God doesn't run out of GOODNESS and MERCY; because that is who He is!
To enjoy the goodness of God, is to enjoy God and His abundant provision of joy, prosperity and pleasure. His MERCY points to His unwavering faithfulness.
The goodness of God is God supplying you with what you don't have.
It is His favour abounding towards you. Whiles His MERCY is His lovingkindess towards you. When you think you deserve punishment for some wrong you did or for going astray; His mercy (lovingkindness) guards you from the punishment you deserve. The mercy of God endures for ever.Beloved, live everyday of your life in the same confidence and comfortthat, in every step of life’s journey the LORD'S GOODNESS (abundant supply) and MERCY (lovingkindness) will hound and saturate you.Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 100:5; 2 Chronicles 20:21; 2 Chronicles 7:3; Ezra 3:11) WE PRAYThat in all aspects of your life, you shall experience the overwhelming pursuit and comfort of the goodness and mercy of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 46- 492 Corinthians 9 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I experience the overwhelming pursuit and comfort of the goodness and mercy of the Lord. – I am part of the Lord’s sheepfold and I cannot be a disadvantage. – My life is in the focus of the hunting gears of His Goodness and mercy. – I  refuse to allow any situation, challenge, past mistakes or even past failures to make me feel underserving of the kindness and warmth of my Shepherd-Host. - God's favor abounds towards me. - I live daily in the confidence and comfort that in every step of my life's journey the LORD'S GOODNESS (abundant supply) and MERCY (lovingkindness) will hound and saturate me. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 279 - TAKE DISCIPLESHIP SERIOUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 29th October, 2023 TAKE DISCIPLESHIP SERIOUS “And those who believed Peter were baptized—about three thousand in all! They joined with the other believers in regular attendance at the apostles’ teaching sessions and at the Communion services and prayer meetings.” Acts 2:41-42 (TLB). The Lord didn’t just send us out there to bear fruits. God purposeful planted us to bear much more fruits which will remain and be lasting. We are not to just scatter the seeds of Christ’s love with others. There is no fruitfulness until the fruits remain on the branches. When a tree bear fruits, the fruits remain on the branches. Fruits are not kept elsewhere apart from the branches. For souls or fruits to remain in the Vine (the Lord), there are organic systems to engage.
Discipleship in the Church is a crucial factor for souls to remain and last.
Discipleship takes place within the Church. Every soul won must be put under a shepherd for effective and consistent nurturing. Just as we are not designed to operate in isolation from the Lord, we are also to practice our communion with the Lord by how we commune with the saints. All through scriptures we see that, anytime souls are won, they are added to the Church.
God takes interest in souls being added to the Church. God gets involved in this work as well.
“…The whole city was favorable to them, and each day God added to them all who were being saved.” Acts 2:47 (TLB). Those who were being saved were not just added as members to the Church and left alone. From the subsequent verses we see how the souls saved were involved in discipleship. “And those who believed Peter were baptized—about three thousand in all! They joined with the other believers in regular attendance at the apostles’ teaching sessions and at the Communion services and prayer meetings.” Acts 2:41-42 (TLB). Now we see that: 1. They joined with other believers in regular attendance at the apostles’ teaching meetings. 2. They joined in communion services. 3. They joined in prayer meetings.
One cannot bear a lasting fruit in Christ, until he or she is consistent in these meetings.
It is not just about attending services on Sundays, but being involved in the community of the saints. That determines and influences your growth. See some additional thoughts in the same chapter. “And all the believers met together constantly and shared everything with each other, selling their possessions and dividing with those in need. They worshiped together regularly at the Temple each day, met in small groups in homes for Communion, and shared their meals with great joy and thankfulness” Acts 2:44-46 (TLB). 4. We also see that, they shared everything with each other. A true expression of love and prove of discipleship. (John 13:14-15). 5. They met in the big meetings and also met in small groups. In Christ Commonwealth -Community, we call the small group meetings, Life Connect. Your souls don’t remain as effective fruits just by how they attend main gatherings. Their fellowship with Christ is deepened at the small group meetings.
Beloved, don’t win a soul and ask them to attend a “Bible Believing Church“.
How can a new soul tell or know a Bible Believing Church? When you win a soul, follow them up to bring them to the Church where you are nurtured. SelahDIG DEEPER(Acts 5:12 ; 14, Acts 1:13-14; Acts 20:7) WE PRAYThat we will receive the grace to nurture, culture and establish souls in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 502 Corinthians 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take the discipleship of souls serious. – I establish many in the Lord. – I ensure that my souls remain committed to the Lord. – I produce effective, dedicated and committed souls. - I am a diligent soul winner. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 280 - ETERNAL DWELLING WITH THE LORD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ETERNAL DWELLING WITH THE LORD 1 "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever Psalm 23:6 (NKJV) The last sentence in Psalm 23: "... And I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever." launches one of the greatest revelation of God. From this Psalm, David: Didn't just expressed his conviction of who his Shepherd is and how He supplies to him. He pointed out the reality that: - He is the sheep loved by the Lord. - He is directed, protected and preserved by the Good Shepherd - He is not just a sheep to the Shepherd; he is also a valued and honoured guest to the Shepherd. - The sheep is separated unto the Lord, and designated for the enjoyment of the abundant overflowing supply of the divine life. - The Shepherd causes His Goodness and lovingkindness to pursue and overwhelm you. As though all these aren't enough, the Psalmist now points out the sonship of the sheep.
He is not just hosted by the Lord. He was brought into the Lord's house to become part of His household forever.
That is SONSHIP! How is it sonship? There was an analogy used by Jesus to explain the concept of dwelling in a house forever: In John 8, Jesus was addressing the freedom He gives to those who believe in Him. It is the freedom that makes them (who believe in Him) become a part of the family of God. Now because they thought they were biological descendants of Abraham, they already share in this freedom and therefore don't need Jesus. But Jesus brings them to the realization that, if they are of Abraham, they will have the faith to believe in the one whom God has sent. And because they don't believe in Him, they are not of God. (John 8:31-59). Now take note of one of the statements Jesus made during his discussion with the Jews: "And a slave does not abide in the house forever, but a son abides forever." John 8:35 (NKJV) Awesome! Now because the Jews don't believe in Jesus (or reckon Him as their Shepherd) , they don't share in the eternal freedom which He gives. They are slaves of sin and have no eternal dwelling in the Lord's house.
However, to those who see the Lord Jesus Christ, as their Shepherd have an eternal dwelling in the house of the Lord.
To dwell in the Lord's house is to be part of His family. A slave cannot be of the family forever. A slave does not share in the inheritance of the family. The servant or slave is not the heir, and may at any time be expelled from the master's house. But a son is the heir. He cannot in any way be sold or cast off from the family. "But what does the Scripture say? "Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman's son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman's son." Galatians 4:30 When David, said "...And I dwell in the house of the Lord forever", He was referring to a deeper relationship with the Lord. He was saying that: - the Lord is not just my Shepherd. -the Lord is not just my defense and supply. - the Lord is not just my Shepherd-Host. He was saying: The Lord is my Father. If the Lord is not your Father you cannot dwell in His house forever. If you are slave to the Lord (master); you don't have the right to dwell in His house forever.
The greatest revelation the Lord wants you to have is the revelation of YOUR SONSHIP!
Your dwelling place is in His family. Yours is to enjoy every beautiful thing He has in His household. Isn't it a beautiful thing to know that the LORD who is the GOOD SHEPHERD, IS YOUR FATHER? Oh glory to God... Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Genesis 21:10; Romans 8:15; Psalm 27:4; Psalm 16:11 NLT; Psalm 90:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship and enjoy every benefits of the Father's family. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jeremiah 51 - 52 2 Corinthians 12 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I am a son and the God Shepherd is my Father. - I enjoy the privilege of sonship in my Father's family. - I shall not be expelled from my Father's house. - I walk in the consciousness of my dwelling place - I belong to my Father's house. Glory to God. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 281 - ETERNAL DWELLING WITH THE LORD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ETERNAL DWELLING WITH THE LORD 2 "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever" Psalm 23:6 (NKJV) The beautiful thing we see about this Psalm is the revelation of the Father and His family. The sheep was not just hosted by the Lord; he was brought into the Lord's house to become part of His household forever. Yesterday we saw that, one must be a son to dwell in a house forever (as in eternally). (John 8:35)
As many who believe in Jesus and receive Him, are given the right to become sons of God (John 1:12).
To dwell is from the Hebrew word, yâshab which means to sit down; to remain; to settle to marry; make to abide continually; to be established; make to inhabit; to remain; to settle or tarry. The word "house", bayith depict the concept of family. It doesn't just mean a building structure. It means a home you were born in; a household. Bayith also has the idea of a steward. It also means a temple or tabernacle; a palace; a court; an inner chamber or the presence of a King. Now, how do you settle, abide, or settle down in the inner chamber of a King forever when you are not a true son?
To dwell in the house of the Lord is to have a deeper relationship with the Lord. This must be the dream and desire of every man.
To dwell in the Lord's presence is to be established in your true home, where you can commune with the Lord. Look at David's deepest longing: "Here’s the one thing I crave from God, the one thing I seek above all else: I want the privilege of living with him every moment in his house, finding the sweet loveliness of his face, filled with awe, delighting in his glory and grace. I want to live my life so close to him that he takes pleasure in my every prayer." Psalm 27:4 (TPT).
Deep within the heart of every man is the silent cry to experience the Lord's presence or to dwell in the court of our God.
God designed man to abide with Him. And it has always been His dream to bring man into that intimate relationship with Him. All through time man couldn't fully have access to dwell and enjoy the Lord's presence in its fullness. So He decided to tabernacle among men that He will assimilate as many that believe in Him, into Himself.
This is why God came to dwell among us through the WORD (who is Jesus the Word made flesh).
"The Word became flesh and dwelt among us..." John 1:14. To dwell among us means, the Word made His HOME among us. It also means He TABERNACLED among us. This is for us to have access to the Lord. "How greatly to be envied are those you have chosen to come and live with you within the holy tabernacle courts! What joys await us among all the good things there." Psalm 65:4 (TLB)
Now we have access to the Lord's presence or inner chamber through Christ Jesus.
What a joy! BELOVED, don't permit anything to distract you from enjoying the glorious things in the Lord's presence. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 84:1-4,10; Psalm 42:1-4; Psalm 122:1; isaiah 25:6-9; Psalm 43:3) WE PRAYThat our delight and passionate longings will always be that we will continue to enjoy our place in the house of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Lamentations 1 - 2 Galatians 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I am a son and the God Shepherd is my Father. – I enjoy the privilege of sonship in my Father’s family. – I shall not be expelled from my Father’s house. – I walk in the consciousness of my dwelling place – I belong to my Father’s house. Glory to God!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 282 - GOD'S STRATEGIC WISDOM FOR EFFECTIVE DISCIPLESHIP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 1st November, 2023 TRUE CIVILISATION IS IN THE CHURCH “God decided in advance to adopt us into his own family by bringing us to himself through Jesus Christ. This is what he wanted to do, and it gave him great pleasure.” Ephesians 1:5 (MSG) God’s salvation plan is to bring man into His family. The essence of our sonship is to reveal the Fatherhood of God. God takes delight in His Fatherhood.
His desire to have a family wasn’t because He was lonely; it was because He wanted to share His love and inheritance of glory with others.
A family is a group of people related by blood, birth, marriage, or adoption. It is also a group of things related by common characteristics and nature or a group of people united by a unique conviction. Interestingly, a family also functions as a womb, where lives and destinies are nurtured, cultured, nourished, preserved, and equipped until one is ready to be delivered.
A person’s civilization is deeply rooted in the family system. A family has a key role to play in shaping the mindset of people.
And that is why the adversary takes an interest in destroying families, just to destroy society. The prosperity of every society and civilization can be traced to the success of families as one of the key ingredients.
It is a bedrock of future excellence or failures.
Most children who grew up in broken or disintegrated homes or families are most likely to experience rejection, anxiety, depression lack of confidence, and develop hatred. The family unit is God’s strategic wisdom for effective discipleship. It is a development center for every member of the kingdom. Through the family unit, children get to experience true love, care and discipline. God said to Abraham: “In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.” Genesis 22:18 (NKJV) Now we can see also how God had confidence in Abraham: “For I have chosen him, that he may command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing righteousness and justice, so that the LORD may bring to Abraham what he has promised him.” Genesis 18:19 (ESV) What God said concerning Abraham and how he will command his household reveals God’s intention about every household or family. Each household or family is a womb or bedrock of a certain civilization. A divine family will produce a divine civilization.
God brought us into His family so that He will bring us into His civilization. It is only in the family of God we are raised and nurtured to think according to the divine light.
Every level of civilization is defined by the degree of light at work. God’s family is a household of light. It is also the household of faith. As sons of God, we are not to function according to the systems of this world. We are to operate in the light of divine revelation. The civilization of God’s Kingdom can only be manifested on earth through the family of God.
The Church of our Lord Jesus is not only the body of Christ, the Church is also the family of God. It is the bedrock of divine civilization.
As a new creation you are not an Island, you are born into God’s family to be cultured with the light of God, through the Church. True civilization is in the Family of God, identified on earth as the Church. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:11; Romans 8:29; John 1:12; Psalm 145:4) WE PRAYThat we will yield ourselves to the true civilization of God’s Family on earth which is the Church. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Lamentations 3Galatians 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I belong to the eternal incorruptible Family of God. – I am deeply rooted in Christ. – I am nourished and enriched by Christ. – I am the focus of the love of God. – I am made whole and holy by His love. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 283- THE SUPERIOR TEMPLATE; THE HEAVENLY PATTERN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE SUPERIOR TEMPLATE; THE HEAVENLY PATTERN"If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ"1 John 2:6 (CEV)When you become born again, you become a child of God. The choice to be a child (or son) of God is not dependent on your choice. The only choice you had was to receive or reject Jesus.
Take note: Whether you receive or reject Jesus, doesn't change who He is in any way. To receive Jesus is to your advantage.
This Jesus is the express image of God's substance. (Hebrews 1:3). To see Jesus is to see God.You cannot live the true life of God without following and functioning according to the example of Jesus.You didn't become born again to live according to your imaginations and assumptions. The life of God is not intangible, yet it is spiritual. This life of God is tangible and practical."From the very first day, we were there, taking it all in—we heard it with our own ears, saw it with our own eyes, verified it with our own hands. The Word of Life appeared right before our eyes; we saw it happen! And now we’re telling you in most sober prose that what we witnessed was, incredibly, this: The infinite Life of God himself took shape before us." 1 John 1:1-2 (MSG)Did you see that?
Jesus came to express (demonstrate, reveal, show, and declare) God to us. He made the life of God visible and tangible.
Now the life of God is no longer an imagination; this life has been expressed. When you became born again (as you believed in and received Jesus), you received the life of God. (1 John 5:12).Now that you have the life of God, you must live and function by His life.Though the scriptures speak of us learning from the examples of the Prophets, Kings, and Patriarchs, our SUPERIOR EXAMPLE OR TEMPLATE IS JESUS!Listen, you did not receive the life of Abraham, Isaac Jacob, Moses, David, Elijah, Elisha, Daniel, etc.
You received the life of God through Christ.And our Lord Jesus Christ is the EXPRESSION OF THIS LIFE.
Therefore to live this life, you must FOLLOW THE EXAMPLE OF JESUS.Jesus is not one of the options you choose when you want to live the true life of God.He is THE ONLY WAY to the LIFE of God.He is the REALITY of this LIFE of God.And He is the SUBSTANCE AND PERSON of the Life of God.
He is the Superior template. Without Him, you cannot understand the reality of this life.
Look unto Jesus and live as He has lived and continues to live in you through the Spirit.SelahDIG DEEPER(1 Peter 2:21; 1 John 4:17; Matthew 11:29; John 15:20; Jeremiah 10:1) WE PRAYThat we will set our hearts on the Lord and live according as He has lived and continues to live in Us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Lamentation 4 - 5Galatians 5 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I behold Jesus, the express image of God.- I walk in the consciousness of His life in me.- I refuse to live as the world.- Christ is my example- He is my heavenly pattern. And my life is lived according to His pattern.- I don't assume, I live according to the example and excellence of Jesus.Oh Hallelujah!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 284 - THE SUPERIOR TEMPLATE; THE HEAVENLY PATTERN 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE SUPERIOR TEMPLATE; THE HEAVENLY PATTERN 2"If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ" 1 John 2:6 (CEV) Our Lord Jesus is the true example or model of our Faith. As I mentioned earlier, our ultimate pattern of life is Jesus.  
We don't have to follow the examples of the world. They have no substance in life, they are godless and have no hope.
 This is the word the Lord gave to the Israelites: "Listen to the Message that God is sending your way, House of Israel. Listen most carefully:“Don’t take the godless nations as your models. Don’t be impressed by their glamour and glitz," Jeremiah 10:1 (MSG) 
You don't have to look up to the world; since you are seated with our Lord Jesus Christ far above this world, look unto Him.
 When you came into Christ, He gave you new terms which are of life. The world operates on different terms, which are not designed for your benefit. Everything this godless world has designed is to oppose the gracious transformative course of Christ.  “If you find the godless world is hating you, remember it got its start hating me. If you lived on the world’s terms, the world would love you as one of its own. But since I picked you to live on God’s terms and no longer on the world’s terms, the world is going to hate you" John 15:18-19 (MSG)
When you are in Christ, know that the godless world hates you. Therefore don't model your life after their systems and structures.
The people of the world cannot teach you the love of God. The world cannot teach you how to give and serve in the Kingdom of God. They lack understanding and are blinded by the god of this world (2 Corinthians 4:4). 
How can you make a blinded generation who is not of your Kingdom teach you how to operate in the Kingdom you belong to?
 You have the mandate "to open their [spiritual] eyes so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness and release from their sins and enjoy an inheritance in Christ" (Acts 26:18). The reality is that as Jesus is, so are we in this world. (1 John 4:17). And so when you are confused about your true identity, DON'T LOOK AT THE WORLD. Your true identity is CHRIST.Therefore you must look unto Jesus who is the author of our Faith. (Hebrews 12:2) The New American Standard Bible says: "looking only at Jesus..." (Hebrews 12:2).
Don't look at others or the world. Look only at Jesus. Whoever leads you must express or reveal Christ to you. 
He is the Heavenly Pattern; the express image of the Father. The more you behold Him, the more you metamorphose into who He is in your daily living. (2 Corinthians 3:18). Now you don't struggle to love because as you see and understand His love, you replicate it. As he has forgiven, we forgive. As He healed and went about doing good, even so, we heal others and go about doing good. He is our ultimate example; our superior template. SelahDIG DEEPER(John 17:20; 1 Peter 2:21; John 13:15; Matthew 11:29) WE PRAYThat our hearts will move away from all distractions and focus on the Lord only who is the ultimate pattern of our faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 1 - 4Ephesians 1- 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I behold Jesus, the express image of God.– I walk in the consciousness of His life in me.– I refuse to live as the world.– Christ is my example– He is my heavenly pattern. And my life is lived according to His pattern.– I don’t assume, I live according to the example and excellence of Jesus.Oh Hallelujah!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 285 - HE KNOWS YOU BY NAME
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HE KNOWS YOU BY NAME"To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out"  John 10:3-5 (NKJV)Have you ever walked in a community new to you and suddenly you meet someone you don't recognize, calls you by your own name?
How was the feeling?
It's likely you will be surprised or feel accepted.You step into a new beautiful office with a lot of respected people seated and some standing around. Then the boss walks in, calls you by name and ask you to follow him.You can tell that special feeling right?Look, currently there are more than 8 billion people on Earth. There are innumerable company of angels and many more spirits of just men. Each of these people have their own name.Of all these multitudinous people, the Lord walks to you and calls you by name. The Lord knows you personally and intimately.In ancient times, names were not given to people by impulse. Names were given to people according to their destiny or how they are destined to achieve. Thus, to know someone's name is to understand the person's mandate.
God knows your name; He knows you personally and your unique identity. You are not just a number in the midst of the multitudes.
When the Lord comes to His sheepfold, He calls each of His own sheep by name (John 10:3).In several occasions, the LORD GOD called people by name. He also gives names to people or change their names to suit the destiny He has foreordained for them. Interestingly, you will find other instances where the Lord did not just call the names of the people, but called their names twice.
That is an affirmation to the reality that, He doesn't call you by chance. It is by a personal knowledge of you.
On his way to Damascus,  our Lord Jesus, called Saul twice. He didn't just call Saul by his name, he also spoke in his dialect. "And when we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew dialect, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads." Acts 26:14 (NASB). See also Acts 9:4.The Lord also called Abraham by name (Genesis 22:11-13), Jacob (Genesis 46:1-4); Moses (Exodus 3:1-10); Samuel (1 Samuel 3:1-10) Martha (Luke 10:38-42) and many others.
Irrespective of what you think of yourself or your history, the Lord knows you by name precious one. You matter to Him and He values you.
"But now thus says the Lord, he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: “Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine." Isaiah 43:1 (ESV)The Lord has engraved you in the palm of His hand. And takes delight in your personal matters. You are not ordinary.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER:(Isaiah 49:1; Isaiah 41:9;  Genesis 17:5; Isaiah 43:1-2) WE PRAYThank you Lord for the privilege to be known and valued by you. Thank you for placing your identity on me and establishing a personal relationship with me. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 5 - 8Ephesians 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am known and valued by the Lord.- I am not ordinary.- I matter to the Lord.- The Lord takes delight in my matters.- I walk daily in the consciousness of this blessed reality.Thank you Lord Jesus!Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 286 - ARE YOU A DISCIPLE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 5th November, 2023 ARE YOU A DISCIPLE? "Jesus said to the people who believed in him, “You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teachings." John 8:31 (NLT) We are in a generation where there is abundance of information and pluralism of thoughts, concepts of life and teachings.
There has been more teachers in our time than ever.
This is because of the several media platforms available now. This wasn't the case in some years back. There are people who lack the integrity and skill to be teachers. Yet now, with an internet data, and a smart phone, everyone wants to create a content and to share their opinions or assumptions as authentic knowledge. And you will have some gullible people running after those thoughts.
It is imperative for every disciple of Jesus, to give attention to only the teachings of Christ.
Your mark of discipleship is TO CONTINUALLY REMAIN FAITHFUL TO THE WORD (or teaching of Christ). It is not how long you have been a disciple of Jesus, it is how long you will continue to be a disciple of Jesus. You must intentionally imbue focus in the teachings of Christ. It is interesting how some believers turn to the myths and old fables of this world.
The people of the world cannot teach you the reality of the Kingdom.
For example, your unbelieving lecturer doesn't have the spiritual understanding of the kingdom life. Therefore, he/she doesn't have the authority to teach you how to fellowship with God. He is not the one to tell how you should be attending Church meetings. The people of this world have their terms and as you are in Christ you function by different set of rules.
You cannot be in Christ and think like the world.
You must uphold and esteem the teachings of Christ in your heart. A true disciple of Jesus, is a deviation to the systems of this world. He/she doesn't live by the thought patterns of this world; but delights in the Word of Christ. He/she doesn't interpret love as the people of this world do. A true disciple of Jesus walks in the unconditional love of Christ. A true disciple is a doer of the word of Christ and not a hearer only. He/she follows and continues in Christ no matter the storm, suffering or persecution. The persuasion of a true disciple is that, nothing can separate him/her from the love of Christ.
Dear Disciple of Jesus, do what the Lord tells you to do through His word, not what the world informs.
ARE YOU A TRUE DISCIPLE OF JESUS? SelahDIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:16; John 15:8; John 13:35; Romans 8:37-39; Colossians 1:28-29; 2 John 1:9; John 15:7-8) WE PRAY- That the delight and persuasion of the word of God shall be intensified in our hearts more and more; to make us doers of the word and not hearers. - That he word of Christ shall deeply dwell in our hearts and we shall not yield our minds to the old fables and false teachings of this world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 9 - 11Ephesians 5 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don’t patten my life according to the standards of this world. - I walk in the unconditional love of Christ. - I delight myself daily with the word of Christ. - Nothing can separate me from the love of Christ. - I continue in Christ no matter the storm, sufferings and persecutions. - I am a true disciple of Christ. Hallelujah!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 287 - ADVANCE IN GLORY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ADVANCE IN GLORY 1 "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified) Most people look forward to a life of glory. Such desire and expectation, move some people to eagerly pray for the glory of God. - Should the born again pray for the glory of God? - Will God share His glory with another? - What is glory? These are three interesting questions we need to look into this week.
The glory of God has a multi-faceted meaning through the scriptures.
The Hebrew word "kâbôd" is derived from the word "kâbêd". Kâbêd is a verb that means being heavy or weighty. It also means having importance, being prestigious, being honored, and being glorious. As a noun, kâbôd has two sides, which means: a. Ability, power, weight, and strength. b. Splendor, dignity, honour, glory, magnificence. In Greek, the word for GLORY is "doxa". Its meaning is not too far from the Hebrew, with just some little differences. "Doxa" interestingly, means opinion, judgment, and view or estimate. It also means: - splendour, brightness (of creation) - magnificence, excellence, preeminence, dignity, gracious and kingly majesty of God. - the absolute perfection and excellence of Christ; - it is the outward or exterior brightness or expression of grace. - it is the revelation of the most exalted state of Christ in His resurrection. - Doxa also points to the blessedness of the excellence of God which every believer must experience in the now and that which shall be revealed at the appearing of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. From these two main words, "kabod" and "doxa", we see that Glory is basically the honor, majesty, and excellence of God revealed or showcased.
Glory is the visible consummation of the inward work of God's grace.
From the explanations above, it is obvious you just can't jump to the conclusion that God doesn't share His glory with anyone. From the meanings of the word GLORY, you will realise it is not used in a straitjacket. There is the glory which we bring to God only. This is not to make God better but for us to demonstrate our honour for who He is to us. And there is a glory, the Lord has brought us into and shared with us. Look at one of the things Jesus said in His prayer: "And the glory which You gave Me I have given them, that they may be one just as We are one" John 17:22 (NKJV) In our Lord Jesus, there is the revelation of the glory of God's wonder, goodness, intimate and abiding presence.
Christ revealed the indwelling of the Father's presence.
See the verse 21 of John 17: "I pray that they will all be one, just as you and I are one—as you are in me, Father, and I am in you. And may they be in us so that the world will believe you sent me." (NLT). Until Christ came no one knew the possibility that the LORD GOD could indwell a man. Yet Jesus who is God made flesh, said "THE FATHER IS IN ME". (John 14:11) He said, " I and My Father are One". (John 10:30). This was beyond every human imagination. The religious experts couldn't comprehend the weight of this matter. Amazingly, our Lord Jesus points out the result of the glory, He prayed to the Father to give us: That we may be one as He is one with the Father! (See again John 27:22). The peak of our experience of divine glory is to SHARE IN THE ONENESS OF FELLOWSHIP WITH THE FATHER AS SONS OF GOD.
The Lord didn't just bring us salvation, He made us partakers of His glorious life and nature.
Beloved you share in the Father's glory which is in Christ Jesus. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(John 1:14; John 17:24; Romans 8:29-30; 2 Corinthians 4:4; Psalm 84:7; Proverbs 4:18) WE PRAYThat we shall walk in the understanding and consciousness of the glory of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 12 - 15 Philippians 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in the glory of God. - I experience the blessedness of the excellence of God. - I share in the oneness of fellowship with the Father. - I am a partaker of His glorious life and nature. - Oh I live a glorious life. Hallelujah! Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 288 - ADVANCE IN GLORY 2  - CHRIST IS THE GLORY OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ADVANCE IN GLORY 2 - CHRIST IS THE GLORY OF GOD. "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified) From yesterday's discussion we understood that, the glory of God is the beauty and excellence of God. It is the expression of His divine splendor. It is the aggregate expression of God's nature, mighty power, and His character.
The glory of God is the visibility of God's presence and power.
People saw God by seeing the glimpses of His power and splendor. A dimension or degree of God's glory is revealed in creation and all His mighty works. "The heavens are telling the glory of God; they are a marvelous display of his craftsmanship." Psalm 19:1 (TLB) Though the created things declare the glory of God; Christ is the very substance of God's glory.
He is the embodiment and complete expression of the glory of God.
Moses was recognised as one who spoke to God "face to face." (Exodus 33:11). He requested to see the glory of God; he had a glimpse of God's glory and couldn't stand on his feet, but bowed and worshipped the Lord. ( Exodus 33:18-23; 34:5-10) When Moses requested to see the glory of the LORD GOD; God spoke of His face, All of His goodness, His name, His grace and His mercy: "And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy." Exodus 33:18-19 (KJV). Moses had a personal deeper encounter with God than anyone. Yet he only saw the back of God. According to the scriptures, the Lord covered Moses' face (so that Moses will not see God's face).
All of God's goodness, God's grace and mercy are demonstrated through Christ.
Our Lord Jesus, doesn't have to speak to God "face to face"; He is the face of God. It is in the face of Jesus, you behold the knowledge of the glory of God. (2 Corinthians 4:6). When you see Jesus, you have seen the Father. (John 14:9).
He is the express image of the Father.
"God, having spoken to the fathers long ago in [the voices and writings of] the prophets in many separate revelations [each of which set forth a portion of the truth], and in many ways, has in these last days spoken [with finality] to us in [the person of One who is by His character and nature] His Son [namely Jesus], whom He appointed heir and lawful owner of all things, through whom also He created the universe [that is, the universe as a space-time-matter continuum]. The Son is the radiance and only expression of the glory of [our awesome] God [reflecting God’s Shekinah glory, the Light-being, the brilliant light of the divine], and the exact representation and perfect imprint of His [Father’s] essence, and upholding and maintaining and propelling all things [the entire physical and spiritual universe] by His powerful word [carrying the universe along to its predetermined goal]..." Hebrews 1:1-3 (Amplified Bible) Now we are not in search for the beautiful splendor of God; for Christ is the embodiment of all of God's splendor and glory.
To receive Jesus into your heart, is to receive
the glory of God into your heart. Which means you have in your heart: - the splendour of God, - the magnificence brightness of God. - the excellence and absolute perfection of God. - the preeminent dignity of God. - the gracious and kingly majesty. - the blessedness of God's beauty. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 1:15-18; 2 Corinthians 4:4-6; John 1:18) WE PRAYThat the reality of Christ as the glory of God, will flood our hearts and minds. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 16 - 18Colossians 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in the glory of God. - I experience the blessedness of the excellence of God. - I share in the oneness of fellowship with the Father. - I am a partaker of His glorious life and nature. - I live a glorious life. Hallelujah! Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 289 - ADVANCE IN GLORY 3 - PARTAKERS OF GLORY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ADVANCE IN GLORY 3 - PARTAKERS OF GLORY "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified) Understanding the reality of the glory of God is fundamental for you to live a higher life.
God made man for His glory.
"Everyone who is called by My name, And whom I have created for My glory, Whom I have formed, even whom I have made.” Isaiah 43:7 (NASB) And through the fall, man was unable to express God's glory according to God's design. "For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;" Romans 3:23 (KJV). The corruption of man's heart through unbelief, couldn't make him partake and also become the expression of God's glory. Because of this corruptibility, many who have even been saved don't feel qualified to share or be partakers of the glorious life in Christ.
You don't have to struggle to enter into God's glory.
The goodnews is that, in Christ Jesus you are now liberated from the corruption, consequences and power of sin.
In Christ, we have been born with an incorruptible seed.
The intention of Jesus is to bring us into God's glorious Kingdom and Family. And to achieve that, He must legally solve the sin problem through His suffering on the cross. We don't have to stay on Romans 3:23. The focus of the discussion is what Christ has achieved and not the consequence of sin. Read the verse 24: "Yet through his powerful declaration of acquittal, God freely gives away his righteousness. His gift of love and favor now cascades over us, all because Jesus, the Anointed One, has liberated us from the guilt, punishment, and power of sin" Romans 3:24 (TPT).
You are now justified in Christ and have the legal right to be conformed to His image (Romans 8:29).
Remember, Christ is the express image of the Father and the brightness of His glory. Therefore, you are not only justified in Christ, He has glorified you as well. He has brought you into the realm of the fellowship of His glory. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Romans 8:29-30; John 17:22; Romans 9:23; Hebrews 1:2-3; 1 Corinthians 1:9; 15:49) WE PRAYThat we shall function fully in the glory which have received and share in or with Christ Jesus. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 19 - 21 1 Thessalonians 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My life is for the glory of God. - I have an incorruptible life because I was born with an incorruptible seed. - I am justified in Christ. - I am a partaker of His glory. - I live in the realm of the fellowship of His glory. Oh glory to God!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 290 - ADVANCE IN GLORY 4 - Manifest the Glory of God
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 9th November, 2023 ADVANCE IN GLORY 4 - Manifest the Glory of God "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified) When you became born again, the Lord made you a partaker of His glory.
The glory of God is in you.
The glory of God is the beauty and excellence of God revealed in your life. The manifestation of God's glory is to be seen in every aspect of your life. Wherever Jesus went and whatever He did, there was the manifestation of the glory of God. John said, "...we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth." John 1:14 (NKJV) Whatever you share with Christ, becomes the reality of who you are. As you share in the glory of God in Christ Jesus, you also become the glory of God.
As a partaker of the glory of God, you are also designed to show forth or make known His glory in all things.
"But you are God’s chosen treasure—priests who are kings, a spiritual “nation” set apart as God’s devoted ones. He called you out of darkness to experience his marvelous light, and now he claims you as his very own. He did this so that you would broadcast his glorious wonders throughout the world." 1 Peter 2:9 (TPT). As a partaker of the glory of God you are mandated to broadcast or announce or showcase the glory which you have received. This is the purpose of your calling.
He called you out of darkness, corruption, defeat, failure and brought you into His marvelous light (to make you a light being) that His glory will be seen in you.
You have a duty bring many to the knowledge of the classic grandeur of God. The wisdom of God is ab expression of God's glory. The love of God, His goodness, prosperity, peace, healing virtues and power are all expressions of God's glory.
Remember, the glory of God is the expression of God.
God's glory or excellence and beauty must be seen in how you love, speak, and handle situations or responsibilities. God who is Spirit and invisible can be seen and experienced through you. As the embodiment of the glory of God, anyone who interacts with you must behold the majestic excellence of God. Your words must be full of wisdom and grace. Your work ethic at the office must be a reflection of God's creativity and excellence.
Anyone that sees you must see the effulgence of Christ.
Get this: You don't manifest the glory of God just by shouting "Gloryyyyyy!!!" It's great to celebrate the glory of God and rejoice in it. However, you manifest the glory of God by showcasing the beautiful heart of God to your world. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(1 Peter 4:11; Isaiah 43:21; Isaiah 60:1 -3; Romans 11:36; Psalm 33:3) WE PRAY- That we shall have the mindset and consciousness that our lives are showcase of the glory of God to all men. - That in everything we do and everywhere we go, the tangible manifestation of God's glory will be seen. - And that every aspect of our lives will be saturated in the beauty and excellence of God. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 22 - 24 1 Thessalonians 4 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The glory of God is seen in me. - I have been called out of darkness, failure, corruption and brought you into God's marvelous light. - As men interacts with me, they behold the majestic excellence of God. - My words are full of wisdom and grace. - Anyone who sees me, sees the effulgence of Christ. - I manifest the glory of God. - I am a blessing to my world. Oh glory to God!!! Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 291 - ADVANCE IN GLORY 5 - Beholding Jesus
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ADVANCE IN GLORY 5 - Beholding Jesus "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified) As partakers of His glory, we have a mandate to express Him in all things. The Lord chose you and brought you into Himself for this purpose. "But you are God’s chosen treasure—priests who are kings, a spiritual “nation” set apart as God’s devoted ones. He called you out of darkness to experience his marvelous light, and now he claims you as his very own. He did this so that you would broadcast his glorious wonders throughout the world." 1 Peter 2:9 (TPT).
However, you cannot express the glory of God beyond the intensity of His light in your heart.
The level or degree at which you show forth the glory of God will always be according to your inward growth. For as glory is an outward expression, it begins by inward transformation. This transformation is not a one-time event. It is a continuous experience. There are three levels of the Salvation experience. The first level is the TRANSFUSION of the Life of God. This is when you receive the divine life into your spirit at your new birth. God infuses you with Himself and His light. The second is TRANSFORMATION. Transformation is not the condition of your spirit. It is the conditioning of your heart. This is not a one-time experience. It is different from the transfusion of the life of God into you. "And do not be conformed to this world [any longer with its superficial values and customs], but be transformed and progressively changed [as you mature spiritually] by the renewing of your mind [focusing on godly values and ethical attitudes], so that you may prove [for yourselves] what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect [in His plan and purpose for you]." Romans 12:2 (Amplified Bible). This progressive transformation is what we call spiritual maturity. Spiritual maturity is not when your spirit grows. It is when you grow in the spirit. Your growth in the spirit is when your mind is renewed through the culturing and understanding of the word of God.
It is your growth in consciousness that brings you into transformation.
The third level is TRANSFIGURATION, some interchange the use of transformation and tranfiguration. But beloved, to be transfigured is to be physically elevated in glory and beauty. This is what we may experience at the appearance of Jesus. It is the resurrection of our decaying bodies into glorious incorruptible heavenly bodies. (Philippians 3:21).
The transformation of our minds is essential in our walk with God here on Earth.
We have already seen the transformation of our lives through the renewal of our minds. This renewal of mind is according to what you behold. The opening verse affirms the secret to being transformed from one glory to a higher degree of glory. And it is: BEHOLDING THE GLORY OF GOD! We have already established that Christ Jesus is the express image of the glory of God. And Jesus is the revelation of the Word of God. Therefore the more you behold the Word of God the more you behold the glory of God. And the more you behold the glory of God, the more you are transformed into the image of the glory you have beheld.
When you pray for a higher dimension of glory, God directs you to His word.
For the entrance of the Word of God in your heart, is the entrance of a dimension of the light of the glory of God. Keep beholding the revelation of Jesus through His Word. Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 4:23-24; 2 Corinthians 4:4-6; Psalm 84:7; James 1:23) WE PRAY- We shall access the right revelation of Jesus which shall cause to be transformed into the perfect image of Him. - And that we shall daily experience the renewal of hearts through the revelation of the glory of God. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 25-282 Thessalonians 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As I feast on the word daily, I grow deeper in the consciousness of Christ and my identity in Him. – I don’t take my spirituality for granted. – As I behold the word of God daily, I am transformed into the image of the glory of the word. – I keep my gaze daily on the word of God. Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeeey!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 292 - ADVANCE IN GLORY - Beholding Jesus 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ADVANCE IN GLORY 6 - Beholding Jesus 2 "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified) Until Jesus came, no man partook of the reality of God's glory. The glory which Moses emit was that which passed away. There was a glory of the law or of the Old Covenant. However, it is no where near the glory which we have in Christ Jesus.
In comparison to the glory we have in Christ, the glory of the Old Covenant is no glory at all.
Have a good read to grasp what I'm saying: "He is the one who has helped us tell others about his new agreement to save them. We do not tell them that they must obey every law of God or die; but we tell them there is life for them from the Holy Spirit. The old way, trying to be saved by keeping the Ten Commandments, ends in death; in the new way, the Holy Spirit gives them life.Yet that old system of law that led to death began with such glory that people could not bear to look at Moses’ face. For as he gave them God’s law to obey, his face shone out with the very glory of God—though the brightness was already fading away. Shall we not expect far greater glory in these days when the Holy Spirit is giving life? If the plan that leads to doom was glorious, much more glorious is the plan that makes men right with God. In fact, that first glory as it shone from Moses’ face is worth nothing at all in comparison with the overwhelming glory of the new agreement. So if the old system that faded into nothing was full of heavenly glory, the glory of God’s new plan for our salvation is certainly far greater, for it is eternal. 2 Corinthians 3:6-11 (TLB)
As you are in Christ, you don't pray for glory. This is because you have been brought into the overwhelming glory of the New Testament.
By your new nature in Christ you don't only have the overwhelming glory of God. You have now become the glory of God. You are now the expression of God. However, you have to nurture the nature of glory in you.
You nurture the nature of glory by continously beholding Jesus.
The more you behold the Lord, the more you advance in the glory of God. As you advance you don't first look out for things around you to be beautified. Pursue the increase of divine glory and beauty within you. You must have an intense relationship with God. Focus on the Word of His grace and fellowship with the Spirit. Don't just live normal as everyone. Don't be satisfied with the level you are in your relationship with Jesus. Avoid double-mindedness! Set your eyes on Jesus and crave more for the sweet intimacy with Jesus. You will soon begin to reflect and reveal God in all you do.
Don't stay at the level you are.
Beloved, you advance in growing by growing deeply in your relationship with Jesus. Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 4:23-24; 2 Corinthians 4:4-6; Psalm 84:7; James 1:23) WE PRAY- For the wisdom of the Spirit to nurture the nature of God's overwhelming glory in us. - That we will not be double-minded but maintain our focus on the Lord Jesus. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 29-321 Timothy 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the glory of God. - I am the very expression of God. - I reflect and reveal God in all that I do. - I maintain my focus on the Lord Jesus. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 293 - KEEP YOUR GAZE ON THE WORD OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 12th November, 2023 KEEP YOUR GAZE ON THE WORD OF GOD "And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit." 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) There are a lot of people living the lie about themselves. Beloved, God didn’t just throw us into time without identity.
There is an identity and intention for man, specifically the man in Christ.
Christ came not only to give us the true revelation of God; He also came to unveil to us, God’s true picture about us. There is an imagery of us in God’s mind.We have created in our minds pictures of enmity towards God. And assume God has the same picture of us.
Most people in Christ look at themselves according to the false imagery created by religion.
Some born-agains see themselves as sinners in Christ. They sing songs of God’s unfailing love, yet think God has hatred for them. We have seen the Word of God as a sword in the hands of a skillful soldier. We have seen it as a surgeon’s scalpel, an elixir for your health, God’s creative material, and a shining, penetrative light. Beloved the Word of God is also the MIRROR of God.We look into mirrors to have a view of our outlook. Mirrors allow us to see ourselves. They show us what we look like, they let us examine our true selves, and make us espy our unique heritage. Sometimes a mirror will show you a beautiful part of yourself that you did not notice before.
Interestingly, a mirror doesn’t add nor change who we are or what we are.
A mirror brings to our realization and consciousness how we really look. This is how the MIRROR OF THE WORD OF GOD WORKS:It reveals our true essence and quality. Look at the opening verse again:"And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit" 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) From the King James Bible, you will see the word “CHANGE” instead of transformation. The original word in Greek is "metamorphoō" which means to be transfigured or transformed. It is a change in state and form or structure. We can understand this transformation by observing the butterfly metamorphosis: The butterfly’s life cycle begins with an egg and progresses to a caterpillar, chrysalis, and adult, and then finally ends with the natural transformation of the butterfly. These stages were not mere changes they were transformations. However, the transformation or metamorphosis is a result of the inherent quality of the butterfly. At the egg stage, no one sees a butterfly, however, it has the quality of a butterfly. A hen lays an egg, however, this egg doesn’t metamorphose into a butterfly, because it doesn’t have the genetic code of a butterfly. This is the principle I am establishing concerning the principle of the Word of God as a mirror.
The transformation you experience by the Word is a result of the seed of the Word in you at your new birth in Christ.
"Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth forever.” 1 Peter 1:23 (KJV) Do you see it? YOU ARE BORN AGAIN BY THE WORD, which is THE SEED OF THE DIVINE LIFE. Since you are born of the Word, you have the Word of God in you as your seed.
Therefore, as you look into the mirror of the Word, you are transformed more and more as the EXPRESSION OF THE WORD OF GOD.
How does it happen, the transformation begins with the RENEWING OF YOUR MIND. "And do not be conformed to this world [any longer with its superficial values and customs], but be transformed and progressively changed [as you mature spiritually] by the renewing of your mind [focusing on godly values and ethical attitudes], so that you may prove [for yourselves] what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect [in His plan and purpose for you]."Romans 12:2 (AMP). As you behold the Word of God it corrects your old thought patterns and renovates your mind with the riches of divine revelation. Selah.DIG DEEPER(James 1:22-25; 1 Corinthians 13:12; Psalm 84:7; John 17:24; 2 Corinthians 4:4,6; Romans 8:29) WE PRAYThat we will grow more in the consciousness of what Christ has already done for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 33 - 341 Timothy 4 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As I look into the word daily, I am transformed into the image I see. – I increase in strength as I fellowship with the word daily. – I increase in glory daily by the word. – As I look at Christ daily in the scriptures, the more like him I become in consciousness. – I renew my mind daily with the word. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 294 - LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 1 - JESUS LIVED UNTO GOD'S GLORY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 1 - JESUS LIVED UNTO GOD'S GLORY "Whether you eat or drink, live your life in a way that glorifies and honors God." 1 Corinthians 10:31 (TPT) I am not sure you can count the number of times you have sang and said to God, "I glorify your name". How do you truly understand that phrase? How is it important to God, for Him to be glorified?
God esteems His glory; He does all things unto His glory.
For God to do things unto His own glory is for Him to make everyone and everything know who He is, to acknowledge His Power and His name.
We have been given this calling by God to glorify Him.
All through the Life of Jesus in His earth walk, He lived to honor or glorify the Father. Interestingly, Jesus as the GOD-MAN did not live for His glory. His life pursuit was that the glory of God will be fully revealed in Him.
What else is the ultimate goal of all the works of God?
The end of all things is that God will be glorified. Right from the birth of Jesus, God was glorified: "Then all at once, a vast number of glorious angels appeared, the very armies of heaven! And they all praised God, singing: “Glory to God in the highest realms of heaven! For there is peace and a good hope given to the sons of men.” Luke 2:13-14 (TPT). Jesus made it clear in His earth walk, that He seeks not His own glory. (John 8:50). He said, "Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say, ‘He is our God" John 8:54 (ESV). Though by His teachings and miracles, His fame spread abroad, He did all the things He did unto the glory of God. Even when people were suffering with infirmity, He knew by their healing the glory of God will be seen. It was when God is glorified that His glory was seen. (John 11:4). The death of Jesus was for the glory of God: "Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again" John 12:27-28 (KJV) Is that not what the Prophet Isaiah prophesied: "Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill made low; the uneven ground will become smooth, and the rugged land a plain. And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all humanity together will see it. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken." Isaiah 40:4-5 (Berean Standard Bible)
To glorify God is to honor, laud and celebrate or acknowledge the greatness of His might and majestic splendor of His person and His works.
We glorify God by reflecting on His person, excellence and power; just as Jesus showed us.
Everything you do must be unto the glory of God.
It was not just in songs and words that Jesus glorified and honored the Lord. Jesus did all things to bring glory to God. Is your life bringing glory and honor to God?DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; 1 Peter 4:11; Psalm 97:6; Isaiah 35:2; John 7:18; Isaiah 43:1,7) WE PRAYThat we shall not seek our own glory but that our lives shall be unto God's glory just as Jesus lived. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 35 - 381 Timothy 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My life is for the glory of God. - I live unto the glory of God. - I don’t live unto myself. - I don’t seek my own glory. - In all that I do, I glorify the Lord. Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 295 - LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 2 - Follow The Example Of Jesus
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 14th November, 2023 LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 2 - Follow The Example Of Jesus "Whether you eat or drink, live your life in a way that glorifies and honors God." 1 Corinthians 10:31 (TPT) Our Lord Jesus is the ultimate model and pattern of our Faith. Our true identity is in Christ. Jesus came to unveil the mystery of godliness (1 Timothy 3:16). The mystery of godliness is the expression of the GOD-MAN (Jesus was revealed as fully God and fully man). Thus the mystery of godliness is not just the revelation of God to man; it is also the revelation of man's originality to man.
Man's renaissance of identity and purpose can only be found in Christ Jesus.
That is why we are charged through the scriptures to continue to behold Jesus.As you behold Jesus you begin to live and function like Him. "...As He is, so are we in this world" (1 John 4:17). To function like Jesus is to live the life God has predestined you to be conformed to His image and live like He did (Romans 8:29). When you became born again, you received His life and nature. His purpose also became your purpose.
In Salvation, we were created to be in the likeness and image of Jesus.
"...Nevertheless I live yet not I but it is Christ that lives in me. The life that I live now in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God..." (Galatians 2:20). All that Jesus did was unto the glory of God. What else must be the purpose of your living and what you do?
It must be unto the glory of God just as Jesus lived.
Jesus lived to honor the Father above Himself. We also have to live to honor the Father above ourselves. We don't honor God just to win favor from Him. We honor the Father for who He is.
We don't live like ordinary men, for they have no thoughts of God and don't live to acknowledge Him nor glorify Him.
"For since the creation of the world, His invisible attributes are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even His eternal power and Godhead, so that they are without excuse, because, although they knew God, they did not glorify Him as God, nor were thankful, but became futile in their thoughts, and their foolish hearts were darkened." Romans 1:20-21 (NKJV).
However, as you are in Christ, the Prophecy of Isaiah is your reality.
"For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee." The hearts of men are darkened and they walk in the futility of their thoughts because they have not acknowledged and glorified God; even though they see His attributes through creation.
