But for us, our reality is different, when we beheld and received Jesus, the glorious light of the knowledge of God shone in our hearts. Therefore, we live daily to glorify and honor God.
Whatever you do, look beyond yourself interest, or satisfaction. Whatever you do must not be according to your will or desire but unto God's glory and honor.
You don't do things just to please yourself. You don't do things just because it is a sin or not. The question is: How does it GLORIFY GOD?
How is your daily life, your speech, your conduct bringing glory to God and honoring Him?
This is how you emulate the example of Jesus. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; 1 Peter 4:11; Psalm 97:6; Isaiah 35:2; John 7:18; Isaiah 43:1,7) WE PRAYThat we shall not live according to the futile thoughts and darkened hearts of men. But we will live everyday emulating Jesus (who glorified the Father in everything). In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 39 - 412 Timothy 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don’t live unto my own interest. - I live unto God’s glory and honour. - My life honours the Lord. - I live to glorify the Lord. Oh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 296 - HOW TO LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 15th November, 2023 HOW TO LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 1 "Whether you eat or drink, live your life in a way that glorifies and honors God." 1 Corinthians 10:31 (TPT)For some days now I have been drumming this instruction of faith into your heart (that is, if you have been consistent with the with ).
As you are in Christ, it is imperative for you to live beyond your interest or satisfaction. Whatever you do must not be according to your will or desire but unto God's glory and honor.
 The question is:How does what you do GLORIFY GOD?As you are in Christ you must emulate Him.Your daily life, your speech, and your conduct must bring glory to God and honor to Him, just as Jesus did.How do you Honor or bring Glory to God?1. SET YOUR HEART ON GODWhatever you do for the Lord must be inspired by your inward devotion, and accompanied by purity of heart. True honor and glory begin from within. Jesus addressing the hypocritical Jews said:"You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you, for he wrote: "‘These people honor me with their lips, but their heart is far from me;" Matthew 15:7-8 (NLT).Don't attempt to just honor the Lord with your lips and deep in your heart, you are far from Him. This means genuine honor to God begins with your personal relationship with God.
Until you set your heart right towards the Lord anything you do will be of the flesh and will not be reckoned as honor to the Lord.
Whatever you do must be hewn out of your love for the Lord. Your love for the Lord must be with all of your heart."And he said to him, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest rule" (Matthew 22:37-38)2.  THROUGH OBEDIENCE TO GOD'S COMMANDJesus honored and glorified God by obeying the Lord.Through Christ Jesus, we have the ability to walk in obedience. You don't obey God by your efforts. You walk in obedience to God's word and command according to His ability which is in you.
God is in you to work through you unto His glory.
"For it is [not your strength, but it is] God who is effectively at work in you, both to will and to work [that is, strengthening, energizing, and creating in you the longing and the ability to fulfill your purpose] for His good pleasure." Philippians 2:13 (AMP)This is why you must understand the will of God. The will of God is encapsulated in the scriptures. The word of God embodies His will.To obey God is to act according to His word. This is not a difficult task; for you are born of the word in Christ (1 Peter 1:23).
Your obedience to God is also a product of God's worth in your heart. And this demonstrates how you glorify Him.
One of the key commandments Jesus gave to every believer is in Mark 16:15:"And then he told them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to everyone" (NLT)This is not a suggestion, but a command from Jesus.To obey this commandment of Jesus is to honor and glorify God. That was how Jesus demonstrated the glory of the Father. He preached and got many saved. Jesus called it the work of the Father (John 9:4).
It is the desire of God to get many saved (1 Timothy 2:4). And as you participate in this great desire of the Father, you honor and glorify Him.
Beloved, Jesus said, "If you love me, you will keep my commandment" (John 14:15). This brings glory and honor to the Father.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; 1 Peter 4:11; Hebrews 13:21; 1 Samuel 15:22; Psalm 19:14; Psalm 119:60) WE PRAY- That we shall glorify and honor the Lord through our obedience to His word and will with the integrity of our hearts.- That by the wisdom of God we shall know how to honor the Lord through our obedience to the command of the Lord to preach the gospel to many and get them saved.In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 42 - 452 Timothy 3 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I live beyond my interest and satisfaction. - Whatever I do, I do unto the glory and honor of God. - My life is for the glory of God. - I do all things with the love for God. -  I walk in obedience to God's word. Oh Hallelujah!!!   [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 297 - HOW TO LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 6th November, 2023 HOW TO LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 2 "Whether you eat or drink, live your life in a way that glorifies and honors God." 1 Corinthians 10:31 (TPT) We started answering the question: "How does what you do GLORIFY GOD?" Or How do you practically honor and glorify God? You don't have to struggle for answers. Just pay attention to the examples and teachings of Jesus. Our Lord Jesus came to show us how to relate with the Father. He showed the things which matter to God and are according to His will.
To honor and glorify God, you must live as Jesus lived. You must also do what He has said.
From the previous discussion, we looked at two things to do to HONOR THE LORD. We looked at the need to be inspired by your inward devotion and purity of heart. The Lord expects that you honor Him with your heart and with your lips (Matthew 15:8).
Your honor to God is built from your personal relationship with Him.
When you love the Lord with all of your heart, your soul, and your mind, you will live to please Him and for His glory. Until you genuinely love the Lord you cannot keep His commandments. Secondly, we have the command of the Lord to: "...Go into all the world and preach the Good News to everyone" Mark 16:15 (NLT) It is the desire of God to get many saved (1 Timothy 2:4). And as you participate in this great desire of the Father, you honor and glorify Him. 3. YOU CAN ALSO HONOR THE LORD WITH YOUR LIFE AND LOVE FOR OTHERS. It is not everyone who has access to God through the scriptures. Though the created things declare the glory of God (Psalm 19:1-2), you are the perfect poetry of God to the world. You are the WORKMANSHIP OF GOD (Ephesians 2:10). The word WORKMANSHIP is from the Greek word, "POIEMA", which is also the root word for POEMS. To be His workmanship is to be the POEM of God. You are God's deepest expression revealing His good works. Your life is designed to be the revelation of the good works of God.
By the good works of Jesus through His death and resurrection, you were justified (declared righteous) and given the newness of life.
The people of the world may not understand the good works which Christ has wrought in you unto righteousness. However, as they see the good works of righteousness based on how you live, the Lord will be glorified through you.
You got saved by the good works of Christ. And you glorify the Lord through your good works of righteousness.
Jesus said, "Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father in heaven." Matthew 5:16 (NKJV). The life of God in you is the light of men (John 1:4). As you live out this life, they see your good works, which showcase the God color and beautification to many. And this impact on your life will cause men to glorify God. Hallelujah! Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; John 15:8; 1 Corinthians 14:24-25; Isaiah 61:3; 2 Corinthians 3:2) WE PRAYThat we may be able to know how to function according to the good works which the Lord has ordained for us, to bring glory unto Him. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Ezekiel 46 - 48 Titus 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live beyond my interest and satisfaction. – Whatever I do, I do unto the glory and honor of God. – My life is for the glory of God. – I do all things with the love for God. – I walk in obedience to God’s word. Oh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 298 - HOW TO LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HOW TO LIVE UNTO HIS GLORY 3 "Let your light shine before men in such a way that they may see your good deeds and moral excellence, and [recognize and honor and] glorify your Father who is in heaven" Matthew 5:16 We continue answering the question: "How can you live unto God's glory?": We have already seen three items: 1. You honor the Lord by setting your heart on Him. 2. You honor the Lord through obedience to God's command. 3. You honor the Lord with your Life and love for others. These items cannot be overemphasized. You are placed here on earth by the Father, for you to be an expression of Him; just as Jesus was an example of the Father. When you became born again, God made you His workmanship in Christ Jesus unto good works; which He has foreordained that you walk in them (Ephesians 2:10).
You are not living for yourself. He gave you His life and designed how you have to live it unto His glory.
The people of the world are blinded by the god of this world and their traditions (2 Corinthians 4:4). They lack the true understanding and picture of God.
The life of the Father in you gives you the capacity to shine and show forth His glory.
When the people of the world argue they cannot see God, and doubt the truth about His love and excellence; your life is the tangible epistle of the love-life and the kindness of God. "The only letter of recommendation we need is you yourselves. Your lives are a letter written in our hearts; everyone can read it and recognize our good work among you." 2 Corinthians 3:2 (NLT) When people refuse to read the scriptures to know God, they read your life. The way you live must be a reflection of the reality of God. You cannot be born again and be unforgiving and unloving. Why must you be an embodiment of God's love and be envious and jealous of others?
How can you carry the light and the glory of God in you and struggle to demonstrate excellence in what you do?
When the people of the world feel God is too far away, the way you live and love must be the magnification of God. Look at Paul's bold utterance: "For I fully expect and hope that I will never be ashamed, but that I will continue to be bold for Christ, as I have been in the past. And I trust that my life will bring honor to Christ, whether I live or die" Philippians 1:20 (NLT) His confidence is that, irrespective of the persecutions, he will not be ashamed of his stand in the Lord; but will continue to make his life bring honor to God whether he is alive or dead. The sincere truth is that, to this day, Paul's life always brings honor to God.
His life honored and glorified God when he was alive and even now that he is dead. Just as the life lived by the other apostles of Jesus.
What a mindset! The word used for "HONOR" in Philippians 1:20, is from the Greek word, " megalunō". Which means to make (or declare) great that is increase or enlarge, magnify, and show that something is great. It is to extol. This is how your life must be lived. Your life is like a telescope or a microscope. Through their eyes, as a telescope, your life makes many who think God is far see Him as a Father who sticks closer than a friend. For those who assume God is small, your life serves as a microscope by which they can behold the greatness of God.
Make a decision today to make the people around you see and understand God by how you live and love others.
Practice the love of God. (Read more about the practice of love here and here). Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; John 15:8; 1 Corinthians 14:24-25; Isaiah 61:3; Isaiah 58:8) WE PRAYThat our lives shall be a testament of the love, the excellence, and the goodness of God unto many and that they will glorify God by how we live and love. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Daniel 1 - 5 Philemon 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My life is a testament of the love of God unto many. - My life is a testament of the goodness of God unto many. - My life brings honor to God. - God is glorified through me. - I demonstrate the excellence of God in all that I do. Oh Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 299 - CONCERNING HONOR AND HUMILITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 18th November, 2023 CONCERNING HUMILITY AND HONOR "Recognize the value of every person and continually show love to every believer. Live your lives with great reverence and in holy awe of God. Honor your rulers." 1 Peter 2:17 (TPT) Day by day as each generation grows deep into "postmodernism", people become more interested in pleasing themselves and satisfying their ego. Men are drifting away from the very concept that helps bridge one generation to the other. Blessings of one generation are distributed through a system of honour and humility.
There is no generation that can accurately and fully reach its potential without the impartations of the previous generation.
In the Kingdom of God, to walk in honor and humility is a code of greatness. To honor is to have great value and respect for others and to highly esteem those who have authority over you. Though the younger generation may seem to gradually lose the true sense of honor, it doesn't change its authentic essence among the great. As you saw in the opening verse (1 Peter 2:17): To honor is to: 1. Recognize the value of every person. 2. Continually show love to every believer. 3. Live with great reverence and in holy awe of God. 4. Acknowledge the authority of your rulers.
Let's quickly look at those you must honor, according to the counsel of God's wisdom:
1. Honor God "the twenty-four Elders fell down before him and worshiped him, the Eternal Living One, and cast their crowns before the throne, singing, “O Lord, you are worthy to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for you have created all things. They were created and called into being by your act of will." Revelation 4:10-11 (TLB) I have previously explained how you can honor and glorify God. And to add a few thoughts to it: Understand that you can also honor the Lord with: a. Your treasure and time. Time is one of the most precious treasures and assets we have. Invest your time and anything you value into your relationship with God and His vision. “Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also” (Matthew 6:21). b. Honor God with your body. You were bought with a price by God, therefore honor Him in your body, which is His temple. (1 Corinthians 6:18-20). c. Honor God with your finances, wealth, or possessions. “Honor the Lord with your possessions, and with the firstfruits of all your increase” Proverbs 3:9 (NKJV).The Message translation says, “...give Him the first and the best.” d. With your hands and heart lifted in worship and thanksgiving. (Psalm 34:1-3) Interestingly as you honor the Lord, you enjoy honor from Him (1 Samuel 2:30). And He also shares secrets with those who revere Him. "Friendship with God is reserved for those who reverence him. With them alone, he shares the secrets of his promises” Psalm 25:14 (TLB)
Beloved, understand that you can fully honor the Lord through Christ Jesus.
2. Honor Your Leaders in the Church (1 Thessalonians 5:12). 3. Honor your Parents (Ephesians 6:2). 4. Honor Your Spouse (1 Peter 3:7; Ephesians 5:33). 5. Honor the Elderly (Leviticus 19:32). 6. Honor Rulers or Government officials (Romans 13:1-2; 7). 7. Honor Your senior Colleagues at work or employers (1 Peter 2:18). 8. Honor one another above yourselves. (Romans 12:10). This includes parents also honoring their children. Ephesians 6:4 (nevertheless children must not use that against their parents. Yours is to honor your parents). I will take time to explain the above points.
Where there is honor and humility, there is abundance release of grace, and peace. (James 4:6; 1 Peter 5:5-6).
When you truly love the Lord you will honor others with the humility and integrity of heart. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Revelation 5:13; Psalm 22:23; John 5:23; 1 Peter 1:22) WE PRAYThat we shall take hold of the counsel of the word of the Lord and walk in honor towards God and men according to the wisdom of God. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Daniel 6 - 9Hebrews 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in honor and humility. - I walk in honor towards God and all men according to the wisdom of God. - I don't dishonor the authorities set over me. - I honor the Lord with my body. - I honor the Lord with my treasure, time and finances. - I demonstrate honor in all things. Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 300 - HAVE A PERSONAL REVELATION...
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 19th November, 2023 HAVE A PERSONAL REVELATION..."Look at the proud one, His soul is not right within him, But the righteous will live by his faith [in the true God].” Habakkuk 2:4 (Amplified) The goal of the word of God is to make you fruitful in your walk with Him. This begins with the infusion of faith. Anytime God's word comes to you, it produces faith in you. Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. (Romans 10:17).
Faith is the absolute confidence in God and what He says. It is the substance of the reality which is beyond the optics.
When the word of God comes to you concerning a matter, it opens your heart to God's revelation on that matter or situation; and reprograms your mind on how to deal with that matter or situation according to God's wisdom. This is how faith works! Four times in the Bible, you can see the phrase:"The just shall live by faith" or "The righteous shall live by faith" (Habakkuk 2:4; Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38;) It is mentioned three times in the New Testament portion of the Bible and once in the Old Testament portion of the Bible. The opening verse, Habakkuk 2:4, is the original or the first time that phrase was used.  What makes Habakkuk 2:4, unique is the expression, "...HIS FAITH". This focuses on how we appropriate or engage the revelation of Jesus in our personal lives. That is the subjective Faith.In the New Testament, the focus of the other three verses is on the OBJECT of Faith (which is the revelation of Jesus). 
Jesus is the object and substance of our confidence in God.
Which means Faith is Jesus and all that He has done for us. Jesus is the substance or embodiment of our confidence and assurance in God unto salvation. Now to continue to live by faith and manifest the fullness of the life which you have in Christ, you must have a personal revelation of the Word of God.
To have a personal revelation of the word of God is not to have your personal interpretation of the word of God. (2 Peter 1:20)
The word of God (or every scripture) is prophetic and there is a complete interpretation of every scripture in the Bible. There are three methods the Word of God was given: 1. The Word of God or the scriptures were given by revelation; which is from God to His holy men. (See Amos 3:7; Hebrews 1:1-2; Daniel 2:22,28; Galatians 1:11-12). 2. And by inspiration these holy men wrote the scriptures. Which is from heart to "paper". (See 2 Peter 1:21; 2 Timothy 3:16).  3. The third method is illumination. This is from "Paper" to heart (See Psalm 119:18,130; Ephesians 1:18). This happens through the teaching and the study of the Word. (To understand this more JOIN THE ONLINE MINISTRY SCHOOL OF THE WORD). As all scripture is inspired by God, we should understand that we are not inspired to rewrite the scriptures. The dimension of inspiration we enjoy now, involves how God has revealed spiritual truth to us through His word (which is already inspired by God). It happens through accurate interpretation which is your study of spiritual truth, in God's word. This is what it means to, "RIGHTLY DIVIDE THE WORD OF GOD". (2 Timothy 2:15). It is by this you can handle the truth of the word of God for yourself. All that God has said in His word is the revelation of His life and eternal counsel to mankind. Your revelation of God must be according to the word of God. For the Word of God to be useful to you, you need to know and own the Word. You must personalise it. 
The knowledge of the word of God must not just be another increase in information but increased revelation.
Your faith is governed by your personal revelation.  To have a personal revelation is not to have a new revelation (which has never been before). The revelation of the word of God in the scriptures is complete. Christ is the completeness of God's revelation (Hebrews 1:1-2).
To have a personal revelation is to have an absolute and accurate understanding of what God has said through the scriptures.
It is to personally behold and capture the light or the reality of God through His Word. Personal revelation is the illumination of the word of God in your heart. The illumination of the Word involves your understanding of spiritual truth which is in the Word, by the administration of the Holy Spirit (through a sound teacher of the Word, and Bible study materials). This is what "The with " does to you. It makes you an illumined believer.
You are trained to personally recognize the truthfulness of what you read in the Bible and to apprehend its beauty. 
Illumination of the scriptures enlightens you to recognize the authority and significance of what is said in the word, for your daily victories. It means you are not merely living by what someone says he or she has found in the Scriptures. But you live by what you have personally seen and handled in the Scriptures. This makes your faith effective and you live the reality of your overcoming life. "For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God]" 1 John 5:4 (Amplified) When you have a personal revelation of the Word, you can have personal daily victories of faith. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 2; 1 John 1:1-3; Job 42:5; Acts 26:18; 2 Corinthians 4:6; Isaiah 6:10; Philippians 3:10; Luke 1:1-4) WE PRAYLord, open our eyes and hearts to your word that we will be enlightened and built in our Faith for personal daily victories which will bring glory to your name. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Daniel 10 - 12Hebrews 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I grow in my personal faith in Jesus. - My heart and mind are illuminated by the Word of God. - I don't live by assumptions. I live by revelation. - I walk in the reality of the Word of God. - I see truth in the word of God. - I recognise the authority of the word of God in every situation of my life. - I am richly enlightened by the word for the increase of my faith. Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 301 - COVER THE EARTH 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 20th November, 2023 COVER THE EARTH 1 "For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea." Habakkuk 2:14 (NKJV) The Lord through His Prophet Habakkuk makes an irrevocable utterance that sends chills to the spine of darkness. FOR THE EARTH WILL BE... not the earth may be or shall be, BUT WILL BE! That is a certainty! There may be several worldviews or schools of thought, yet we have to look forward to this prophetic utterance; "...the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea." According to this prophecy, the earth will not be filled with human arguments, assumptions, doubts, myths, old fables, and unbelief; but the knowledge of the glory of God. This is specific and a surety. The earth will not be filled with the knowledge of science, religion, entertainment, pornography, sex, drugs, political greediness, wars, sickness, and diseases.
According to God's eternal counsel, He wants the knowledge of His glory to cover the earth.
This is not to happen 1,000 years in the future. According to God's plan, the filling of the earth with His knowledge as the waters cover the sea began long ago.
To fill the earth is to fill every heart.
" For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory displayed in the face of Christ." 2 Corinthians 4:6 (NIV) God has been in the business of shining forth His light on earth right from creation. (Genesis 1:3). And now just as He commanded light out of darkness, He has shone His light in our hearts through the radiant display of the knowledge of His glory in Jesus Christ. Jesus as the Word made flesh is the light of the world. When He came into this world, the fullness of the knowledge of the glory of God was made manifest. Jesus is the express image of God and the brightness of His glory. His life is the light of men. He lights up every man that comes into this world. (John 1:4,9)
To fill the earth with the knowledge of the glory of God is to cover it with the revelation of Jesus. Also in the revelation of Jesus, is the display of the purpose of God.
Daniel spoke about this same prophecy; "But as for you, Daniel, conceal these words and seal up the scroll until the end of time. Many will go back and forth and search anxiously [through the scroll], and knowledge [of the purpose of God as revealed by His prophets] will [greatly] increase.” Daniel 12:4 (Amplified) The Amplified Bible brings out the right picture. Many have thought and taught that the increase of knowledge is as the increase of technology and science. Well, spiritual truth has its parallel in the physical dimension. Nevertheless, it doesn't change the originality of the truth in the spirit. The great increase of knowledge is the great increase of the knowledge of God's purpose. And we know that the fullness of God's purpose is revealed in Christ. Now the Lord is filling the whole earth (and the hearts of men) with the knowledge of His glory (the revelation of Jesus) as the waters cover the sea. Jesus commissioned His disciples with this same prophetic mandate: "And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation" Mark 16:15 (Amplified).
As we preach the gospel in all the world, we cover their hearts with the knowledge of God's glory.
Have you seen how the waters cover the sea? It is inseparable. You can't fetch the waters of the sea and not have the sea. To cover the earth is to invade, permeate, saturate, and soak the entire earth (which includes the hearts of all men) with the revelation and glorious gospel of Jesus.
This is what God is doing now, and you must be at the center of it.
Beloved, COVER THE EARTH! Hallelujah!!!DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 4:4; 2 Peter 1:19; Numbers 14:21; Psalm 22:27; Isaiah 11:9; Isaiah 40:5) WE PRAY:That we shall not sit on the fence, but will be at the center of God's prophetic agenda to fill the earth with the Knowledge of His glory as the waters cover the sea. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING:Hosea 1 - 3Hebrews 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I increase in the knowledge of the glory of God (which is the revelation of Jesus). - I share in the prophetic vision of God to cover the earth, with His glory. - I am involved preaching the gospel everywhere I go. - I don't keep quiet. I don't allow darkness and ignorance to prevail. - I shine the glory of God upon every heart. - I cover the earth! I cover the earth! I cover the earth! Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 302 - COVER THE EARTH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  COVER THE EARTH 2"For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea." Habakkuk 2:14 (NKJV) This Prophetic word of the Lord in the opening verse was not a suggestion nor a mere wish. It was the Lord declaring what was going to happen. The intensity of this prophecy is in the certainty of its tone; that it shall fully come to pass no matter the resistance. God's word or what He says is prophetic! His prophetic word is living, active, and full of power; which makes it operative, energizing, and effective. This means the Lord's prophetic word (what He says) comes to pass in its full force. The prophetic word is sharper than any two-edged and cuts deep on every side. (See Hebrews 4:12 - Amplified Bible and Message Translation). Certain prophetic words in the Old Testament portion of the Bible were not only fulfilled within a historical context or by historical events but were fully fulfilled in the Gospel or revelation of Jesus. For example: Historically, God's prophetic word of the promised land to Abraham was Canaan (Genesis 12; 15:18-21). In Genesis 15:18-21, you will find the determined borders of the physical promised land. However, by revelation of scriptures, the true promised land is Christ and the Kingdom of God. When Abraham got to the promised land, He looked forward to an eternal city. (Hebrews 11:10,16). Again, God didn't only promise Abraham a land. He also promised Abraham a seed (Genesis 12:7). This seed is both physical and spiritual. The Jews were the fulfilment of the promised seed through Isaac and Jacob. (John 8:33). And by the revelation of the gospel, we have the absolute fulfilment of the prophetic word; the true Seed of Abraham is Christ and all who belong to Christ are Abraham's seed through Faith (Galatians 3:16; 29) Not just in these examples, but Christ is the goal of all prophecies. Though it may seem the prophetic word by Prophet Habakkuk was concerning the Lord's judgement against the Chaldeans or Babylon, the fulfilment of this prophecy unveils God's transcending and universal plan.
The plan is to fill the whole Earth with the knowledge of His glory as the waters cover the sea.
This prophecy and plan cannot fail; for the Word of the Lord does not return to Him empty until it has fulfilled its purpose (Isaiah 55:11). Through Christ Jesus, God has given forth the light of the Knowledge of His glory. (2 Corinthians 4:6). This light of the knowledge of His glory is burning within our hearts; just as our Lord made a bold utterance concerning Himself that: "As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world" John 9:5. He said this also: "The people who dwell in darkness have seen a great light..." Matthew 4:16. This is the fulfillment of the prophecy by the Prophet Isaiah: "The people who walk in darkness will see a great light. For those who live in a land of deep darkness, a light will shine." Isaiah 9:2 (ESV). Now we are made the light of the world to show forth God's glory (1 Peter 2:9). We have the mandate to reach out to many who are in darkness and fill or saturate them with the knowledge of the glory of God. Look at how this prophecy is repeated in Isaiah (the New Living Translation provides vivid detail): "...for as the waters fill the sea, so the earth will be filled with people who know the LORD" Isaiah 11:9 (NLT).
To cover the earth is to reach all men and fill them with the knowledge of the glory of God.
Wherever there are people we must take the glorious gospel of light there. We must take it to the offices, to the companies, the schools, the streets, families, the communities, cities, villages, towns, and the internet (including all social media platforms). You must get involved and be part of this glorious work of God. Be the reason and the medium by which the work of God will be accomplished.
Don't sit on the fence!
Beloved, COVER THE EARTH! Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER:(2 Corinthians 4:4; 2 Peter 1:19; Numbers 14:21; Psalm 22:27; Isaiah 40:5) WE PRAY:1. We pray for the opening of doors and opportunities in places where there are people who will be granted us and we will exercise the wisdom to saturate every person with the glorious gospel of Jesus. 2. We pray that we shall maintain the focus, diligence, and discipline to spread the goodnews of Jesus and train many men for the move to cover the earth with God's glorious knowledge. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING:Hosea 4 - 7Hebrews 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I increase in the knowledge of the glory of God (which is the revelation of Jesus). - I share in the prophetic vision of God to cover the earth, with His glory. - I am involved in preaching the gospel everywhere I go. - I don't keep quiet. I don't allow darkness and ignorance to prevail. I shine the glory of God upon every heart. - I cover the earth! I cover the earth! I cover the earth! - I refuse to procrastinate!!! Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 303 - THE GOSPEL SATURATION BY A BEACON LIGHT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE GOSPEL SATURATION BY A BEACON LIGHT "And the word of the Lord was spreading throughout the whole region." Acts 13:49 It was clearly established from the previous discussion, "COVER THE EARTH", that we have the mandate to reach out to and fill or saturate many who are in darkness, with the knowledge of the glory of God. "...for as the waters fill the sea, so the earth will be filled with people who know the LORD" Isaiah 11:9 (NLT). We cover the earth, through GOSPEL SATURATION.
Gospel saturation is the radical transformation of lives with the goodnews of our Lord Jesus.
It is the spreading of the goodnews of Jesus by those who have been transformed by the same message. Just as I mentioned in the previous discussion; we must take the goodnews of Jesus to the offices, the companies, the schools, the streets, families, the communities, cities, villages, towns, and the internet (including all social media platforms) As long as you have been blessed by the gospel, you must bless others with it. From city to city, the apostles and disciples of Jesus preached the gospel to all men. To take the gospel to your city or your region or your sphere, understand that the Lord has made you a light to the people within that sphere. As a light, you cannot be hidden. You have the responsibility to shine forth in power and glory!
To saturate your city with the gospel is your prophetic mandate or destiny. It is not just an instruction.
Are you fufilling that destiny?
God has set you as a beacon light and hope to your world
When Paul and his party or companions went to Antioch, they boldly preached Christ and persuaded the Jews and the Gentiles (devout proselytes) who followed them to continue in the grace of God. Many believed and the word of the Lord spread in the whole region. Some Jews opposed their message, however, they made reference to their prophetic mandate as apostles and disciples of Jesus: "Yet Paul and Barnabas did not back down. Filled with courage, they boldly replied, “We were compelled to bring God’s message first to you Jews. But seeing you’ve rejected this message and refuse to embrace eternal life, we will focus instead on the nations and offer it to them. This will fulfill what the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have destined you to become a beacon light for the nations and release salvation to the ends of the earth!’” When the non-Jewish people in the crowd heard these words, they were thrilled and they honored the word of the Lord. All who believed that they were destined to experience eternal life received the message. God’s word spread like wildfire throughout the entire region." Acts 13:46-49 (TPT). Oh, glory to God.
Beloved, until you see yourself as a Beacon LIGHT, you will not saturate your city with the gospel.
A beacon light draws attention and then gives a message or direction to a people or ships. As a beacon light you are a lighthouse, a pharos, or a tower of light to give warning, a signal, direction, or guidance to sailors of life. As a beacon, you burn with divine flames in every place causing the message of Christ to spread like wildfire. RISE, SHINE FORTH! FULFILL YOUR PROPHETIC DESTINY! Hallelujah DIG DEEPER(Acts 6:7; Acts 12:24; Matthew 9:30-31; John 4) WE PRAY1. That we shall exercise courage and the boldness of the Spirit to carry the gospel of Jesus into all places 2. That through us, who are beacon lights, will cause the gospel to spread like wildfire in our cities, towns, schools, offices, and in all places. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Hosea 8 - 10 Hebrews 10 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a beacon light! I am a lighthouse to my city. - Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfire - Through me, many are coming to believe in Jesus. - I glow with fire - Multitudes are coming to the faith through me - I saturate my world with the goodnews of Jesus. - I have mighty testimonies and set records of cities I have saturated with the gospel. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 304 - TAKE YOUR CITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency TAKE YOUR CITY "And the seventh time it happened, when the priests blew the trumpets, that Joshua said to the people: “Shout, for the LORD has given you the city!" Joshua 6:16 (NKJV) As a beacon light, God wants you to saturate your world or sphere with the Gospel. Wherever God has placed you, He wants you to cover that place with the knowledge of His glory. There are some who think taking a city is an unnecessary ambition. How is it an unnecessary ambition when it is the will of God to saturate your sphere with the knowledge of Christ? The issue is, are the people within your city not to be brought to the knowledge of Christ?
The prophetic vision of God is that the whole earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of God as the waters cover the sea.
Gospel Saturation is not an ambition but a prophetic destiny. Jesus said you are the salt of the earth and the light of the world. (Matthew 5:13-14) You are designed by God to shine forth your light in the world. As you are made the light of the world, you must shine your light before men so that they may glorify your Father, who is in heaven.
Let the light of God in you shine in your city and your sphere. This is what we mean by taking your city.
They said concerning the apostles, "...These who have turned the world upside down have come here too." (Acts 17:6). To turn the world upside down, you start from your family, your sphere, your community and then your city. As you reach out from one city to the other, you fill many more hearts with the knowledge of God's glory.
To take a city is a warfare term. No city is taken without a fight.
The Lord said to Joshua, He has handed over the city of Jericho into his hand. (Joshua 6:2). Joshua didn't just walk into the city; he had to fight to take hold of the city. However, Joshua first took hold over the city by the spirit. The Israelites did not just possess the lands with their swords but by the mighty hand of the Lord. The taking of a city or sphere is not by strategy of the mind. Though strategy is important, you must know that whatever happens in the physical must first happen in the spirit. God said to Joshua, "SEE! I have given Jericho into your hands" (Joshua 6:2). This is the first thing God helps you to do. When you see with your spirit, your hands can be laid on it! Read more here, episode 240.
The next thing, which is so important, is PRAYER.
Prayer is not necessarily making requests; it is also engaging divine resources in the spirit unto victory. Through prayer, you release your faith and deploy spiritual arsenals by which you break down strongholds. Get this: you take cities on your KNEES! (Read more on your first strategy, is Prayer). Look at what the Psalmist said: "They did not conquer the land with their swords; it was not their own strong arm that gave them victory. It was your right hand and strong arm and the blinding light from your face that helped them, for you loved them" Psalm 44:3
Beloved, you don't take a city by your sword nor merely by your strategy, but by the shining forth of God's radiant presence.
A man of prayer is a man of faith. A man who prays demonstrates absolute confidence in God's mighty power. We saturate our cities by giving ourselves to prayer and intercession. Do you want to take your city? GET TO YOUR KNEES IN PRAYER. Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Joshua 6:2-16; Psalm 44:2-3; 2 Chronicles 14:11; 2 Chronicles 13:13-15; Matthew 24:14; Acts 13:44; Acts 14:21) WE PRAY- That by the mighty help of God, we shall possess the hearts of the multitudes with the knowledge of Christ (no matter how huge their numbers are) in the city or the spheres we find ourselves. - That we shall not be afraid nor discouraged, but we shall increase in the great strength of the Lord to patiently and consistently saturate every sphere with the gospel of Jesus In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Hosea 11 - 14 Hebrews 12 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfire -Through me, many are coming to believe in Jesus. - Multitudes are coming to the faith through me - I saturate my sphere and city with the goodnews of Jesus. - I have mighty testimonies and set records of cities I have saturated with the gospel. - I take my city with the gospel Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 305 - ARE YOU INVOLVED?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ARE YOU INVOLVED? “But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout all that land.” Matthew 9:31 (Legacy Standard Bible) We have been looking at you, "Taking Your City", through an intense gospel saturation. I have also explained what it means to be a beacon light. In as much as I have already given thoughts on some practical things to do to take a city, it is important for you to also take an intentional decision to be part or involved in what God is doing.
It is not just about knowing how to take a city; YOU HAVE TO GET YOURSELF INTO THE MANDATE.
It is not just about you staying in your closet and shouting, "I take my city!". You have to step out there to spread the news about Jesus throughout your sphere (Matthew 9:31). Those who got their eyes opened in Matthew 9 didn't keep quiet; they spread the wonderful news of the Lord.
You have to step out there to talk about Jesus from person to person and also in the virtual space.
Take note of this: gospel saturation begins with your personal transformation. You don't need to have any strange information about Jesus. Your personal revelation of Jesus is enough. The transformation of the gospel in your heart is what you share with others. As part of your prophetic destiny, you must fill the earth as the waters cover the sea.
Where is this knowledge of God proceeding from?
It is not from the skies. Look at the answer Jesus gave to such question: "Believe in me so that rivers of living water will burst out from within you, flowing from your innermost being, just like the Scripture says!” John 7:38 (TPT).
As believer, you are saturated by the knowledge of the glory of God; therefore out of you the knowledge of the glory of God will proceed as rivers of living waters to cover your sphere.
Most ministries have created beautiful Church environments and use attractional methods to get people to come to their Churches. There is nothing wrong with creating an exciting Church environment and having beautiful Church auditoriums. Those are good for effective and comfortable Church meetings. However, the people who attend Church meetings are they true disciples of Jesus?
Jesus didn't send us to just sit on our pews and attract people to our services. The mandate to cover the earth is not "COME YE"; the mandate to cover the earth is in "GO YE".
It doesn't matter your busy schedules, you must see yourself as a missionary and be part of those reaching out and making disciples. You know your friends, loved ones, neighbours, work colleagues, and coursemates need to know Jesus. Why are you not seeing that God has placed you in that office, family or community for the purpose of saturating their hearts with the knowledge of God's glory? Jesus said to His disciples, "GO YE, MAKE DISCIPLES OF ALL NATIONS... TEACHING THEM..." (Matthew 28:19). This was something Jesus did as well: "Jesus walked throughout the region with the joyful message of God’s kingdom realm. He taught in their meeting houses, and wherever he went, he demonstrated God’s power by healing every kind of disease and illness." Matthew 9:35. The apostles also did not sit; they got involved in reaching out to others and making disciples for Jesus: "...Paul left them, taking the disciples with him, and went on holding daily discussions in the lecture hall of Tyrannus [instead of in the synagogue]. This continued for two years, so that all the inhabitants of [the west coast province of] Asia [Minor], Jews as well as Greeks, heard the word of the Lord [concerning eternal salvation through faith in Christ]." Acts 19:9-10 (AMP).
We don't just reach people, we have to disciple them. It is about filling every heart with the knowledge of Christ. This a daily task given to us by the Lord.
GET INVOLVED IN MAKING DISCIPLES FOR JESUS. GET INVOLVED IN SATURATING HEARTS WITH THE KNOWLEDGE OF THE GLORY OF GOD. Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Acts 13:13; Acts 12:24; Acts 9:42; Mark 1:28; Mark 7:36; Psalm 67:2-4 (TLB); Zechariah 8:20-23) WE PRAY- That by the mighty help of God, we shall possess the hearts of the multitudes with the knowledge of Christ (no matter how huge their numbers are) in the city or the spheres we find ourselves. - That we shall not be afraid nor discouraged but we shall increase in the great strength of the Lord to patiently and consistently saturate every sphere with the gospel of Jesus In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Joel 1 - 3James 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like wildfire. - I don't sit on the fence. I am involved in the spread of the gospel. - I saturate my sphere and city with the goodnews of Jesus. - I have the wisdom and grace to make faithful disciples of Jesus, every day. - I take my city with the gospel Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 306 - GLOW WITH FIRE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GLOW WITH FIRE "Those who repent I baptize with water, but there is coming a Man after me who is more powerful than I am. In fact, I’m not even worthy enough to pick up his sandals.He will submerge you into union with the Spirit of Holiness and with a raging fire." Matthew 3:11 (TPT) Our Lord Jesus didn't only come to die for your sins; He also brought you His life. He translates you from darkness into the Kingdom of light and transfuses His life into you through the administrative force of the Holy Spirit. As part of transfusing His life into you, the Lord baptizes you with the Holy Spirit and with fire. To be baptized with the Holy Spirit is to be immersed or submerged into union with the Holy Spirit and with His fire. You come under the influence of the person of the Holy Spirit and His operative ability.
The impact and influence of the Holy Spirit in your heart is as fire.
Get this: the Holy Spirit is not fire; fire only depicts the character of His influence and operation. Fire is a universal language; everything responds to fire, and nothing denies its impact. No one rejects the benefits of fire. That also gives a picture of the operative influence of the Holy Spirit. At your new birth, the Lord ignited the kingdom life within you, a fire within you, the Holy Spirit within you, changing you from the inside out. (See Matthew 3:11, Message Translation). This was what happened to the disciples of Jesus on the day of Pentecost. As they obeyed the instruction of Jesus to tarry: "On the day Pentecost was being fulfilled, all the disciples were gathered in one place. Suddenly, they heard the sound of a violent blast of wind rushing into the house from out of the heavenly realm. The roar of the wind was so overpowering it was all anyone could bear! Then all at once a pillar of fire appeared before their eyes. It separated into tongues of fire that engulfed each one of them. They were all filled and equipped with the Holy Spirit and were inspired to speak in tongues—empowered by the Spirit to speak in languages they had never learned!" Acts 2:1-3 (TPT) The impartation of the Holy Spirit happened to them as of the experience of fire. The influence of the Holy Spirit in your heart will always be as of fire. This is how one can articulate the burning influence of the Spirit. IT IS AS OF FIRE!
This fire of the Holy Spirit must burn in you if you want to saturate your sphere with the gospel.
It takes the Holy Spirit and fire to be a witness of Jesus. "But you will receive power and ability when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses [to tell people about Me] both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and Samaria, and even to the ends of the earth.” Acts 1:8 (AMP). When the Holy Spirit came upon you, you received: 1. Power and ability. 2. You were made a witness of Jesus. God doesn't send anyone out without His fire burning in him/her. For Moses to bring deliverance to Israel from Egypt, he encountered the fire of God (Exodus 3). As part of the Priest's ministry to God, He has to keep the fire of God's presence burning on the altar. (Leviticus 6:12) The fire of God in you is an eternal fire; however, its glow must be intense.
To continue to bless lives and spread the gospel, you must continue to burn.
"Don’t burn out; keep yourselves fueled and aflame..." Romans 12:11 (MSG) You have to continue glowing with fire, and everyone will respond to you. It takes the fire of the Spirit burning in you to ignite the Kingdom life within others.
A man of fire is the one who can boldly saturate His sphere with the power of the gospel.
As a beacon of light, you must burn like wildfire! You glow as you continue to: - Pray in the Holy Spirit. Your prayers burn as an incense (Psalm 141:2; Revelation 8:4). - Meditate on the word of God. "...HIS WORD was in my heart like a BURNING FIRE shut up in my bones; I was weary of holding it back, and I could not... " (Jeremiah 20:9) When this truly happens, you just can't keep quiet or stop speaking what you have beheld of the Lord. (Acts 4:20) If you want hearts to burn for Jesus, your heart must always burn for and with Him! Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:19; Ephesians 5:18; Luke 4:14; Micah 3:8; Acts 4:31; Acts 11:23-24) WE PRAYThat our hearts shall glow with the unquenchable fire of the Holy Spirit and with power so that we can saturate many hearts with the power of the gospel. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Amos 1 - 3 James 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is soaked and saturated with the fire of the word. - I can't keep quiet; I burn and glow more and more with fire. - I have the fire of the Holy Spirit burning in me - I don't grow cold. God's fire cannot be quenched in me. - Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfire Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 307 - DO SOMETHING NOW!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 26th November, 2023 DO SOMETHING NOW! “Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.” 1 Chronicles 12:1 (KJV) Jesus is not building His Church for funfair. Jesus established the Church to prevail against the gates of hades. The Church is the light of God in this world. “And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.” Matthew 16:18 (ESV). Our Lord communicates how the gates of hell will wage war against the Church. The good news is that the gates of hades SHALL NOT PREVAIL AGAINST THE CHURCH. Darkness cannot subdue the light of God. Which means the Church is a formidable force. It is an army with good armed soldiers (2 Timothy 2:3; Ephesians 6:11-13). As a Church, we have the responsibility to tear down and subdue anything that exalts itself above the knowledge of Christ (2 Corinthians 10:5). This is a war over the salvation of souls. The Church has the mandate to bring deliverance to the nations.
This is WAR! And you must be involved.
PLEASE READ THE VERSE BELOW PATIENTLY: “This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you’re not on my side, you’re the enemy; if you’re not helping, you’re making things worse” Matthew 12:30 (MSG). Okay, just read the verse above again. And give it a deep thought. With this war between the Church (light) and darkness, there is no neutral grounds. If you are born again, you are part of the Victorious Church. God has set you in the Church at such a time as this; to make enviable contributions for the advancement of the course of Christ. “And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.” 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)
He has set you in the Church for you to be a HELPER OF THE WAR.
Just as certain men came to David to Ziklag, and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war. These helpers of the war, were they who fought side by side with David. Beloved, God has set you in the local Church or Ministry Assembly for you to labour side by side with your Pastor or Setman to spread the gospel of Jesus. This is the time to take many hearts for Jesus. You must finance the gospel to villages, cities schools, institutions and nations. You must be a helper of the War. The Lord has put desires in your heart for greater works. Don’t relent nor sit back. Do something now! Be a HELPER OF THE WAR through; – Your radical giving of your resources or financial partnership. – Your involvement in evangelism and soul-winning. – Your service in the local Church.
When you are not helping in this war, you are making things worse.
BE A HELPER of the War today. Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Matthew 12:29-30; Luke 11:23; Matthew 6:24; Joshua 5:13; Joshua 24:15; 1 Chronicles 12:1-40) WE PRAYThat the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps in our local churches which will make us get ministerial results BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Amos 4 - 51 Peter 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am sharpened by the Lord for His great work this year. – I am a helper of the war. – I conquer and win territories for the Lord. – I shall be immovable as steel post. – By the relentless power of God I am enabled to subdue kingdoms. – I topple and crush the systems of this world. – The Lord is with me, therefore I fear no evil. – I don’t sit on the fence. – I labour through faith. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 308 - YOU HAVE THE FAITH OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU HAVE THE FAITH OF GOD "For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed, both springing from faith and leading to faith [disclosed in a way that awakens more faith]. As it is written and forever remains written, “THE JUST and UPRIGHT SHALL LIVE BY FAITH.” Romans 1:17 (Amplified) How many times have people felt faithless because they didn't achieve one result or the other? Most people in Christ find it difficult to accept that they have faith. They always think they need to pray to God for faith. When they pray for healing, and they don't see it, they sadly conclude: "I don't think I have faith". The above thought is one of the deceptive thoughts the adversary sows in the hearts of certain brethren. The adversary is always interested in making you feel you don't have the right mindset about yourself.
No one originates faith; faith is supplied to you. The faith of God is supplied by God.
Even some preachers make such utterances about some saints. When they pray for people and they don't see the results, they begin to blame the saints, saying: "It didn't happen because you didn't have faith". That is not what it really is. And mostly, this verse of scripture is referenced: "So Jesus said to them, “Because of your unbelief; for assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith as a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you." Matthew 17:20 (NKJV) Jesus wasn't blaming his disciples here. He was helping them understand their state in God. Even though His disciples were with Him, they had not yet received the life of God. And clearly, they had not experienced the germination of faith in their hearts.
Get this: there is a difference between the state of the disciples before the resurrection of Jesus and after the resurrection of Jesus. In resurrection, the divine things germinated in the hearts of the disciples.
Are you born again? Are you in Christ? Then Jesus wouldn't tell you, "If you have faith as a mustard seed..." This is what Jesus says when He looks at you: "Live by faith because you are just". Anyone who is just or righteous before God has faith. Because you can only be just by faith. (Genesis 15:6; Romans 4:3). As a born-again, you must know that you are Just. To be Just is to be righteous. And you are the righteousness of God in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21) Others may also make reference to this verse of scripture below: "And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith." 2 Thessalonians 3:2 (KJV). When Paul made this statement, he wasn't referring to the brethren. He was conscientizing the brethren on why they have to take his prayer request seriously. Not all the men in the world are like the brethren. Those who are not in Christ don't have faith and are not of the faith of Jesus.
Faith begins with the infusion of the word of God. The day you fully received the word of God, faith came into your heart. (Romans 10:17).
At new birth, no one received more faith than the other. We all received the same measure of faith. "For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you." Romans 12:3 (Berean Study Bible).
God has given each of the saints the measure of faith. This measure of faith is the faith of Jesus.
You are not devoid of faith. You have the faith of Jesus. Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Romans 10:12-17; Habakkuk 2:4) WE PRAY That we shall walk in the consciousness of the faith of Jesus in our hearts every day. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Amos 6 - 9 1 Peter 3-4 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - My heart is infused with faith. - I have the faith of Jesus! - I walk in the consciousness of faith every day. - I have faith! I have faith! Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 309 - LIVE IN THE CERTAINTY OF FAITH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LIVE IN THE CERTAINTY OF FAITH 2 "Now it is evident that no one is justified before God by the law, for “The righteous shall live by faith.” Galatians 3:11 (ESV) To grasp this discussion, take some time also to read LIVE IN THE CERTAINTY OF FAITH.
One of the key things you must understand about faith is that faith operates according to KNOWLEDGE.
We have learnt that everyone born of God in Christ has the Faith of God. We all (in Christ) have the measure of faith. The measure of faith is the faith of Jesus. At new birth, faith germinated in you. This was not automatic, though spontaneous. However, it is one thing to have faith and another to function by faith. And the effectiveness of your faith is connected to your KNOWLEDGE. Faith is produced by the knowledge of the word of God. Thus, the word of God is the object of faith. Faith is not human vigor or strength. Faith does not operate out of nothing. The foundation of faith is the word of God.
No one can have the faith of God without the word of God.
This is why faith is not automatic. It is intentionally produced by the organic work of God. While dealing with the subject, "YOU HAVE THE FAITH OF GOD", I pointed out how the disciples of Jesus were with Jesus yet didn't experience the germination of faith in their hearts. Faith germinates in your heart not only by association but by revelation.
The knowledge which births faith is a revelational knowledge.
Faith is not born out of mere information, awareness or sense knowledge. This was the state of the disciples in most of the instances before the resurrection of Jesus.Faith fully germinated in them in the resurrection of Jesus. Remember, the newness of life began through the resurrection of Jesus. Nevertheless, it is important to note that others lived by Faith before the resurrection of Jesus, though the person and the fullness of God's revelation (the Word) were made manifest in Christ Jesus. God, in divers manners at sundry times, spoke and revealed dimensions of His wisdom to different people.
Hebrews 11 revealed a lot about those who, through faith, rejected the pleasures of this world and pleased God, received strength to conceive and to give birth, shut the mouth of lions and subdued kingdoms!
What was their secret? They exercised faith according to the revelation of God they personally handled. (Read on HAVE A PERSONAL REVELATION). By the revelation of the word, you don't walk in the uncertainty of life. You live in total confidence of who God is and according to His power. Knowing that you also have the faith of God, live in the certainty of faith.
To live in the certainty of faith is to live by the revelation of the word of God.
It means you make decisions, act and take steps by faith. Your life decisions are influenced by the word of God. Just as it is said in 1 Corinthians 2: "None of the rulers of this present world order understood it, for if they had, they never would have crucified the Lord of shining glory. This is why the Scriptures say: Things never discovered or heard of before, things beyond our ability to imagine— these are the many things God has in store for all his lovers." 1 Corinthians 2:8-9 (TPT) The Jewish rulers didn't have the right revelation and understanding of the scriptures so they couldn't act in faith. They were blind to see Jesus as their Savior. They made the worst-ever decision by rejecting their God and plotted His crucifixion. This was because of their ignorance. Through the ministry of the word, you got saved by faith. As you have faith, continue to live in the certainty of faith through the revelation of the Word of God. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Romans 10:12-17; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAYThat the LORD will bring to our heart the right revelation of His word concerning every situation, and to cause us to live in the certainty of faith. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Obadiah 11 Peter 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is infused with faith. - I have the faith of Jesus! - I walk in the revelation of the word of God every day. - I live in the certainty of faith through the revelation of the word. Oh Hallelujah!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 310 - YOU CAN HAVE GREAT FAITH 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU CAN HAVE GREAT FAITH 1 "When Jesus heard it, he marvelled and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel. Matthew 8:10 (KJV) Having understood that each new creation in Christ has faith, every new creation has the capacity to achieve faith results.
There is no God-kind of results without faith.
Also, the faith of God within you is not just for seasonal showmanship. The faith of God is not just for moments when you need urgent results or a testimony. Your entire life is lived by faith. Faith is the law of life at work in you as you have come into the new living way in Christ.
The faith of God within you can be nurtured. You grow in faith as you continue to practice, function and act according to the revelation of Jesus.
Let me explain this to you: Jesus is the object or the embodiment of our Faith. Faith is authored and completed in Him. (Hebrews 12:2). This is called the "Objective faith". As we have discussed, faith was infused and sown into your heart through the ministry of the Word. (Romans 10:17). The faith sown into you creates an inward response that becomes a personal faith. This is also referred to as "Subjective faith". This subjective or personal faith is built by the consistent revelation of the word of God in your heart. You don't grow the objective faith; instead, you grow and increase in the objective faith. Your growth and increase in the objective faith is called growing your faith. As you grow in faith, your personal faith increases. All through the scriptures, there are only two places (specifically in the New Testament portion of the Bible) where God MARVELLED. Both were connected to FAITH. Interestingly, there are only two scenarios where Jesus referred to the faith of certain persons as GREAT. Exercising yourself in FAITH is so essential to God. If Jesus, by whom this beautiful, jaw-dropping and astonishing universe was made, could still MARVEL at something, then that matter is worth our interest and meditation. Jesus didn't marvel at the great miracles He did. Though, all the people marvelled and were astonished by His great miraculous deeds and depths of wisdom in His utterances. Jesus was not marvelled once by this complex universe and constellations. Instead, the great faith of the Roman centurion (Matthew 8:10) and the faithlessness of His own people in Nazareth marvelled Him (Mark 6:6). It was matters concerning FAITH that made Jesus marvel.
Faith is not an option in God. It is the REAL DEAL. Live by faith!
No wonder the scripture says without faith, it is impossible to please God. (Hebrews 11:6). This is how GREAT FAITH works: "And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.When Jesus heard it, He marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel." Matthew 8:5-10 (KJV Sincerely, it is amazing to know that Jesus was not marvelled positively by the great Jewish scholars or Rabbi and leaders. He was marvelled by a Gentile, who also is a Roman centurion. There are a few key items that will help you understand how to exercise GREAT FAITH. Firstly, The great level of reverence and humility demonstrated by the Centurion. During classical antiquity, a centurion in the Roman army was a commander of 100 legionary military units. They defended and exercised control in Roman territories. They uphold the authority of Rome and don't bow to anyone except Rome. Yet, He called Jesus Lord, which means MASTER. Do you know what it means for a Roman Centurion to call a Jew MASTER? It means this Centurion had caught a great revelation of who Jesus is. Great faith is not confidence in the self or what you know. It is not found in who you think you are without God. It is not your confidence in the position or rank in government or a great organization. Neither is it found in the money in your account nor the number of hours you pray in tongues (though it is worth it).
The greatest limitation of faith is pride.
Exercising great faith always begins with having reverence for God and submitting to Him. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Luke 7:9; Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY- That any form of pride and ego will be subdued and crushed by the revelation of Jesus. - We will exercise the wisdom to submit completely to the Lord in all humility and godly reverence. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Jonah 1 - 42 Peter 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I recognise the Lordship of Jesus in my life and every situation. - I walk in the revelation of who Jesus is daily. - I exercise great faith according to the revelation of Jesus and not according to any efforts of mine. - I refuse to be proud and egoistic. I walk in the humility to the Lord Jesus and His commandments. - I take steps according to the ability of God. Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 311 - YOU CAN HAVE GREAT FAITH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU CAN HAVE GREAT FAITH 2 "When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.” Matthew 8:10 (KJV) Though there are different levels or dimensions of faith, there are also different kinds of faith. One of them is to have "GREAT FAITH".
To have great faith is determined by how you act and function in the revelation of Jesus.
There are only two instances where FAITH was described as GREAT by Jesus. They were seen in two none Jews: A Roman centurion and a Canaanite.(Matthew 8:10, Luke 7:9 and Matthew 15:28). In all the two scenarios, the people involved broke certain walls of limitation to demonstrate great faith. In places where Jesus may not have expected faith, He found great faith. From the opening verse, you will see how Jesus marvelled at the Faith of the Roman Centurion. That wasn't the only time Jesus marvelled; He also marvelled at how He found no faith in His own people of Nazareth. To marvel is from the Greek word "thaumazō". Which means to admire, to be astonished or to stand amazed. It also means to step back and say “Wow!". In a situation or place where Jesus thought there should be great faith, He witnessed a great level of faithlessness. He stepped back and was negatively "wowed" or dumbfounded.
Faith is of great concern to the Lord. Wherever great faith is found, there is the manifestation of great power.
From the previous discussion, I began to outline a few items needed to exercise great faith. The first item is to demonstrate a great level of reverence and humility towards GOD. Sometimes, we are tempted to subtly boast more of our rights in Christ instead of the Lord who gave us those rights. We enjoy great results of faith not only because of who we are but mainly because of who He is.
Our faith shouldn't be in who we are but first who He is. We are what we are because of Jesus. And at all times, we have to submit to Him first.
Look at how the Roman Centurion demonstrated great faith. "And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.When Jesus heard it, He marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel." Matthew 8:5-10 (KJV Despite the credentials of this Roman centurion, His humility before the Lord was overwhelming. Beloved, to be counted worthy of the Lord's presence in your life, or to have right standing with God without any sense of guilt by Christ Jesus, is a great privilege.
Learn to acknowledge the sure mercies and grace of God.
Just because you are now a son of God, a brother of Jesus, and have a mingled life with Christ doesn't mean you are also a master on your own. He says, "Without Me you can do nothing" (John 15:5). Jesus is your MASTER. The more you see Him as your Master, the more you submit to Him, and your faith finds genuine expressions through Him.
Remember, pride is the greatest limitation of Faith.
Secondly, the Roman Centurion ACKNOWLEDGED THE AUTHORITY OF JESUS Not only did he humble himself and show how he revered the Lord, but He also acknowledged the greatness of Jesus' power and authority. Beloved, understanding is everything!
Your life will always be governed by your level of light.
His understanding of authority made him know how he can get results. He knew the health condition of his servant was caused by a great spiritual force, and to deal with that condition, he needed greater authority and force.The centurion couldn't think there was any authority greater than that of Jesus. All Jesus had to do for him was to speak a word.
Great faith acknowledges the power and authority of Jesus.
Are you sure there is a situation in your life which is above the authority of Jesus? Great faith cannot doubt the power and authority of Jesus, no matter the situation. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 7:9; Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY- That our minds will be established in the consciousness of the universal power and the authority of Jesus. - That in all matters we will acknowledge and esteem the authority of Jesus.In the name of Jesus. - Pray to address any challenge, by declaring the solution you want to see as you stand in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus and His name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Micah 1 - 32 Peter 2 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I recognise the Lordship of Jesus in my life and every situation. - I walk in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus. - I exercise great faith according to the revelation of Jesus and not according to any efforts of mine. - I refuse to be proud and egoistic. I walk in the humility to the Lord Jesus and His commandments. I take steps according to the ability of God. - I am conscious of the universal Lordship, power and authority of Jesus. - I declare that my Jesus is the Lord of all. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 312 - YOU CAN HAVE GREAT FAITH 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU CAN HAVE GREAT FAITH 3 "When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel." Matthew 8:10 (KJV) If you have read the previous episode of this subject matter, you will realise Jesus, on two different occasions, MARVELLED! Jesus, at some point in His earth, walked, jad moments where He stepped back and said “Wow!". If you are wondering, was it the incident when He walked on water or the moment when He resurrected Lazarus that got Him amazed? Relax! It was Jesus finding great faith in a man (the Roman Centurion), He never expected to such faith. And also a scenario where He couldn't access or find any faith at all in a place where He thought there should have been great faith. "And Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his hometown and among his relatives and in his own household.” And he could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them. And He marveled because of their unbelief." Mark 6:4-6 (ESV) Now in this situation, Jesus marvelled at the faithlessness of the people of Nazareth. These people didn't know they were demonstrating great ignorance and dishonor towards the Lord.
Every man of faith walks in honor and understanding of Jesus.
These people of Nazareth dishonoured Jesus so much: "But in the next breath they were cutting him down: “He’s just a carpenter—Mary’s boy. We’ve known him since he was a kid. We know his brothers, James, Justus, Jude, and Simon, and his sisters. Who does he think he is?” They tripped over what little they knew about him and fell, sprawling. And they never got any further." Mark 6:3 (MSG). Instead of esteeming the authority of Jesus, they rather undermined Him. No wonder Jesus couldn't work any great miracle among them. The first item needed to exercise great faith in your life is to demonstrate great level of reverence and humility towards GOD. Secondly, acknowledge the authority of Jesus. Let's read through the scripture again to identify the third item needed to walk in Great Faith: "And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.When Jesus heard it, He marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel." Matthew 8:5-10 (KJV
Great faith is not only seen as you walk in honor and also esteem the authority of Jesus.
Great faith is also demonstrated when you walk in absolute obedience to the Word of God. It is having that unwavering confidence that whatever God says happens as He has said it. The Roman centurion knew when Jesus spoke to that sickness; it would obey immediately as a command. That is how faith works! It is an absolute confidence in the Word of God.
It is time to act in great faith.
It doesn't matter what the challenge or ministry project is, make a decision to honor the Lord, recognize His power and authority and be confident that the word works; thus, it will do as it says. If you are reading this, know that the Lord has released you into a season of daring faith. Don't take no for an answer, nor settle for less.
Hold on to the Word of God, knowing that you walk in answers.
The three items we have gleaned from the experience of the Roman centurion may seem simple but are rich in results. Enjoy great testimonies. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 7:9; Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAYThat by the power of the Word of God, every negative situation, challenge, infirmity, or limitation is settled and corrected completely in Jesus' name! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Micah 4 - 71 John 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I recognise the Lordship of Jesus in my life and every situation. - I walk in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus. - I exercise great faith according to the revelation of Jesus and not according to any efforts of mine. - I refuse to be proud and egoistic. I walk in the humility to the Lord Jesus and His commandments.
