I take steps according to the ability of God. - I am conscious of the universal Lordship, power and authority of Jesus. - I command transformation in my life according to the word of faith. - I am a prophetic child, and I walk in the manifestation of the word. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 313 - THE GREATEST ACCOMPLISHMENT OF FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE GREATEST ACCOMPLISHMENT OF FAITH "Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions" Hebrews 11:33 (KJV) Have you thought of the greatest achievement of faith? Through scriptures, we see people experience great healings and miracles by faith. These personal miracles and healings are not necessarily the greatest accomplishments of faith. Am I saying this to undermine these results of faith? Not at all. The scriptures are clear: "The just shall live by faith!"
Which means the entirety of our lives must be an expression of faith.
Nevertheless, the accomplishment of our lives (which is by faith) shouldn't be limited to our personal needs and experiences. The accomplishment of our faith must be the great things the Lord wants us to achieve. Your faith shouldn't just be reduced towards your excellence in exams, acquiring a job, acquisition of things, and other personal interests. Your faith must be focused on achieving great things for the Lord.
The greatest thing you can do with your faith is to serve the Lord's great purpose.
At the end of all things, this shall be the greatest day in the history of the universe and all eternities: "Then the seventh angel sounded [his trumpet]; and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, “The kingdom (dominion, rule) of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ; and He will reign forever and ever" Revelation 11:15 (Amplified Bible). Though Christ has been made the head of all things in essence (Ephesians 1:22), in the dispensation of the consummation of time, all things, all nations and Kingdoms shall be fully subdued and engrafted into the GLORIOUS REIGN OF CHRIST. This is the great agenda of the Lord. And you must be involved. This must be the ultimate engagement of your faith. Even the heroes of faith made it their mandate to subdue Kingdoms by faith. "Through faith they subdued Kingdoms, wrought righteousness and shut the mouth of lions.."
What are you doing with your faith?
GET INTO THE BUSINESS OF SUBDUING KINGDOMS! Understand that all kingdoms are aggregated and governed by the hearts of men.
To fully subdue Kingdoms is to subdue every heart for Christ. And this requires GREAT FAITH.
Unleash your faith to conquer hearts in your immediate sphere for Jesus. Many more hearts must be taken for Jesus. And God wants to work with you. Start now!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 2:1-12;Joshua 14:6-15; Daniel 2:44; Daniel 7:14,27; Exodus 15:18; Psalm 146:10; Psalm 82:8) WE PRAYThat the Lord shall help us take the nations and Kingdoms for Him and unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Nahum 1 - 31 John 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS: –I am involved in the great agenda of the Lord. – Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfire. - I invest my life in serving the Lord's purpose. – Through me, many are coming to believe in Jesus. – Multitudes are coming to the faith through me. – I saturate and dominate my sphere and city with the goodnews of Jesus. – I take my city with the gospel Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 314 - GOD DESIGNED YOU FOR PRODUCTIVITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 3rd December, 2023 GOD DESIGNED YOU FOR PRODUCTIVITY " …because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you will be altogether joyful" Deuteronomy 16:15b (ESV) Why do you see people who are blessed of the Lord, yet are not manifesting that blessing?
Beloved, laziness is one of the reasons people don’t see the manifestation of their blessing.
The Lord does not bless your laziness; the Lord blesses the work of your hands and your produce. There is nothing the lazy produces. And that is one of the major causes of failure. People fail, live poor and struggle to make any advancement because they are lazy.
You can have great potentials and not manifest any greatness.
To be lazy is to be slothful, sluggish or indolence. A lazy person avoids exertion or productive activity. Unproductive activity is no activity when it comes diligence. The lazy is not diligent and cannot rule."Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends on forced labor." Proverbs 12:24 A disciple of Jesus cannot be relevant in the kingdom when you remain lazy. Our Lord rewards faithfulness. And laziness cannot make you faithful.
God ordained work, and expects you to be diligent with the work or the task He inspires or instructs you to do.
The lazy person can desire greatness and still not experience it. "A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied" Proverbs 13:4 Greatness may begin with your desire, however, your desire must translate into consistent action which will birth the greatness. "The soul of the lazy man desires and has nothing; but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich" (Proverbs 13:4 KJV). Having desire is one thing, and being diligent to work towards it, is what makes the desire a reality. Such person will speak of great ideas or plans yet, will not take any action. And even when they begin to take a step towards their plans, they lack the discipline to complete the task. The lazy or sluggish person makes excuses and amplifies challenges, because he or she hates to work. A lazy person will give exaggerated reasons they couldn’t start nor complete a task. "The lazy one [manufactures excuses and] says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets [if I go out to work]!” Proverbs 22:13 (Amplified Bible). A sluggard person wastes time and destroys great plans or success. (Proverbs 18:9) God designed you for productivity."For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them." Ephesians 2:10 (ESV). Through your diligence you bring honor to God and fulfill divine purpose.
Get up and get to work.
Don’t waste time on sleep. Don’t waste time on things which don’t contribute to your success. Set daily goals and targets, so that you can measure your success and impact. Don’t sit thinking of why you were not blessed, whiles you know clearly what to do to manifest blessings. The LORD BLESSES THE INCREASE OF YOUR PRODUCE AND THE WORK OF YOUR HANDS. Avoid any reason or anything that leads to idleness or unproductivity. Selah!DIG DEEPER(Luke 16:10; Proverbs 10:4-5; Proverbs 6:6-12; 12:11; Proverbs 14:23; 19:15; 20:4; 24:30-34; Matthew 25:24-29; 2 Thessalonians 3:6-10) WE PRAYOh Lord, grant me the grace to be diligent in whatever my hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Habakkuk 12 John 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I make each day count. – I make daily progress and success. – Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof. – I win everyday. – I am not a waster of resources. – Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me. – I am a diligent man. Hallelujah!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 315 - IMMENSE IN MERCY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency IMMENSE IN MERCY "So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who shows mercy" Romans 9:16 (NKJV) Are you already beating yourself up for your failures? You seem to think you have tried all you can, and nothing beautiful seems to happen? Are you already discouraged about the outcome of the year? Are you thinking the year will end with you as a failure? Do you think your mistakes are too huge for God to help you? Or do you think all that God is plotting is how to destroy you? Before you throw in the towel. Before you give up. Before you think there is no help for you and it is all over. PAUSE TO PONDER on this:
GOD IS MERCIFUL!
It is not how good or smart you think you are. It is not how well you are connected. It is not your effort or your plans. It is not the size of your offense. Turn to God to RECEIVE HIS MERCY! The concept of God's mercy has not really been understood and esteemed by most brethren in Christ. Others even think since they are now in Christ, they don't need the mercy of God. Some also think the Grace of God is greater than the Mercy of God. The concept of God's Mercy is not limited to the Old Testament.
The concept of God's Mercy is a picture of His heart.
GOD IS MERCIFUL! "But the Lord our God is merciful and forgiving..." Daniel 9:9 (NLT). All that God is, is Eternal or forever and ever. Therefore, God's Mercy is not temporal. God's Mercy is the attitude of His heart. His MERCY IS FOREVER (Jeremiah 33:11). Understand that the entire work of Salvation began with the Mercy of God. The eternal work of salvation is not only by grace. It is also according to the richness of God's Mercy. Even though your new birth in Christ is by grace through faith, it is according to the great Mercy of God. "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead" 1 Peter 1:3 (ESV) The Mercy of God is the game changer; it showed up for man to make the difference (when by corruptibility, all hope was lost for man). In the most hopeless situation, God's Mercy brings new hope to you. In the New Testament, we see the fullness of God's Mercy.
He is IMMENSE IN MERCY. For God to be immense in Mercy means He is full and rich in Mercy.
"But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us, even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;) And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus" Ephesians 2:4-6 (KJV) The opening verses of Ephesians 2 (see verse 1 - 3) points out the hopeless state of Man before Salvation, BUT God's richness in Mercy made the difference: - Dead in trespasses and sins. BUT GOD... - Walked according to or controlled by the course of this world, the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience. BUT GOD!... - Lived in the lusts of their flesh. BUT GOD!... - Fulfilling the desires of the flesh and the mind. BUT GOD! - Were by nature the children of wrath and destined for eternal condemnation and punishment. BUT GOD!
You may currently look at yourself and feel your faith has become weak. BUT GOD!
No matter your present state and how worse things are, the answer has always been in Ephesians 2:4... "BUT GOD, WHO IS RICH IN MERCY..." It is not "but your hard work and strength".
IT IS BUT GOD WHO IS IMMENSE IN MERCY.
The blind man, when he heard of Jesus passing by, cried out, saying, "Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me". (Luke 18:38). Precious one, it is not how high you always think your faith is. Maybe you may think you have not increased much in faith, so there is no hope for you. Cheer up! JESUS IS MERCIFUL. Praise and thank Him for HIS SURE MERCIES on your life. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 80:14; Psalm 136; Lamentations 3:22-24; Hebrews 4:16; 1 Peter 5:10; Psalm 30:10) WE PRAYThat we shall experience the rich mercies of God every day of our lives and in all matters. In Jesus' glorious name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Habakkuk 2 - 33 John 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be proud in my efforts. - I receive the mercies of God in all I do. - God is merciful to me at all times. - I humbly rejoice in the richness of God's Mercy. Thank you Lord Jesus for your SURE MERCIES! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 316 - UNDERSTANDING MERCY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency UNDERSTANDING MERCY "So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who shows mercy" Romans 9:16 (NKJV) As I mentioned in yesterday's discussion, most people have not really understood and esteemed the concept or matter of God's mercy. Others even think since they are now in Christ, they don't need the mercy of God. Some also think the Grace of God is greater than the Mercy of God.
Both the Mercy and Grace of God are the expression of God's benevolence.
The concept of God's Mercy is not a temporal reaction of God towards your rebellion. Mercy is a picture of God's heart. The Greek word for Mercy is "ELEEO", which means kindness or goodwill towards the miserable and afflicted. It also means to have compassion for someone.
Mercy is not just related to sin. Mercy is God's benevolence towards all failure.
During the GREAT FAITH episodes, I explained that the man in Christ does or achieves all things by (his or her personal (subjective) Faith. Faith is your receptive ability to God's grace. However, at a point when it seems you have not increased in the understanding of God's word concerning a particular situation, where it seems your personal revelation is limited, and you have not increased in the faith for results, GOD'S MERCY WILL MAKE THE DIFFERENCE. The Mercy of God completes your obedience of Faith.
God's Mercy steps in when it seems your faith cannot conduct your miracle.
In Matthew 8, we saw the Great faith of the Roman Centurion. He had a rich understanding of the authority and power of Jesus. By this understanding, even Jesus marvelled at his. Bartimaeus (who was blind) turned to Jesus and cried out, "Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me!". Jesus reckoned this also as faith. Bartimaeus may not have declared the authority of the Word of God with boldness, just like the Roman Centurion. Turning to God's Mercy completes your faith. In the most hopeless situation, God's Mercy brings new hope to you. Mercy and Grace are used interchangeably. Though there are some similarities between Mercy and Grace, these are unique concepts of God's heart. There are a few distinctions between Mercy and Grace. God abounds in Grace and is rich in Mercy. He is the God of all grace and all mercies. Grace is the embodiment of God's truth and goodness. While Mercy is the embodiment of God's compassion. These two items go before the Lord's face. "Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; Mercy and truth go before Your face." Psalm 89:14 (NKJV). They both express God's benevolence. Mercy is often seen as God not giving you what you deserve. While Grace speaks of God giving you what you don't deserve.
Grace is bringing the undeserving to the realm where he can legally deserve. Mercy is the compassion of God towards us when we fall short.
The Grace of God was dispensed through the death and resurrection of Jesus. However, this work of salvation was wrought by God according to His Mercy. What man really deserved was eternal condemnation. However, God's mercy (compassion) withheld the judgement of condemnation. For God to give you what you don't deserve (which is Grace), He must first NOT give you what you deserve (that is Mercy). As grace gives you freedom from the power of sin and the law. Mercy deals with the consequences or negative effects of your sins and transgressions of the law.
Grace is also God's activity within you to nourish you with His life. God's Mercy delivers you from judgement.
By grace, we enjoy all that Christ has done. By Mercy, we don't drink of the cup of wrath and destruction of our disobedience. Mercy is not receiving the outcome of your wrong choices. It is God giving you fresh or new chances every day. Mercy works like a Presidential pardon. This is a constitutional clause which effectively allows the president of a country to say, on behalf of this country, ‘We forgive you.’ It means that the person can’t be prosecuted, or even if they’ve already been prosecuted and convicted, that conviction will be set aside. This is when a rule is bent in your favor, by a legal power. The president chooses who he wants to pardon.
Beloved, this is how Mercy works. Mercy is God bending the rule in your favor.
It is legal and just for God to apply Mercy. Mercy is not necessarily God strengthening your weakness; rather, it is Grace. Mercy is God making up for the failures or effects and negative consequences of your weakness. It may seem you have had many shortcomings and your life has not been up to the standards or your best. Everyone may expect the worst to happen to you, but God, who is merciful, will be merciful to you. Which means by His Mercy, you don’t get the bad things you deserve. You don't get the condemnation, poverty, failure, loss and even death. It takes great humility to turn to God's mercy. Receive God's mercy today! Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 80:14; Psalm 136; Lamentations 3:22-24; Hebrews 4:16; 1 Peter 5:10; Psalm 30:10) WE PRAYWe pray, thanking the Lord for His rich mercy in our lives. We thank Him for His help and sustainability from the consequences of our mistakes. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zephaniah 1 - 3 Jude 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to be proud in my efforts. - I receive the mercies of God in all do. - God is merciful to me at all times. - I humbly rejoice in the richness of God's Mercy. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 317 - IMMENSE IN MERCY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 6th December, 2023 IMMENSE IN MERCY 2 "But God, who is rich in mercy, because of His great love with which He loved us" Ephesians 2:4 (NKJV) We now have a clear idea and understanding of what God's Mercy is. We have seen the distinctions between Mercy and Grace. With the understanding we have now, it is important to know that, the abuse of God's Mercy is disadvantageous to your heart. This is why God is not only rich in Mercy; He also abounds in Grace. By God's Mercy, you are forgiven and by His Grace, you are transformed. As you are richly helped by the Mercy of God, allow His Grace to abound in you to live the transformational life of glory.
The goal of God's Mercy is for you to fully experience grace and glory.
For God to be rich in Mercy means He is immense in Mercy. Mercy is an exclusive quality in God. For the point when you think God's Mercy has been exhausted, it is over with you and you shall be destroyed; know that God's Mercy is forever. "For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not leave you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers that he swore to them." Deuteronomy 4:31 (ESV) The adversary through divination may act out some kind of power. However, the adversary cannot be MERCIFUL. It is only God who is MERCIFUL.
God's mercy is immense and cannot be squandered. He is rich in mercy and lavishly supplies to you. He is not stingy in mercy. 
In one of our discussions on PURSUED BY GOODNESS AND MERCY, we learnt that, Mercy is an expression of the unending pleasant supply of God’s provision and lovingkindness. God's Mercy doesn't take a step back because of your wrongs. His mercy pursues and hounds you. His Mercy cannot "run out of stock", therefore God does not withdraw neither does He calculate its measure. He supplies more than enough.
God delights in His steadfast love and not your condemnation.
Therefore, He spent Himself in Christ on the transgression of the sins of men, to bring eternal overflowing forgiveness to all men according to His Mercy.  This is why your error and brokenness cannot be disastrous enough to outspend God's richness in Mercy.
This rich Mercies of God is to be shared with the unreached and the nations of the world.
Receive and announce His Mercy today, for they are new every morning. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Exodus 34:6; Lamentations 3:22-24; Hebrews 4:16; 1 Peter 5:10; Psalm 30:10) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the richness of His Mercies towards the unreached souls and the nations. We thank the Lord that by His mercies the wayward souls shall find their way to the transforming power of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Haggai 1 - 2Revelation 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I experience the overwhelming pursuit and comfort of the  mercy of the Lord.– God is merciful to me at all times.– I humbly rejoice in the richness of God’s Mercy.- Through me, the unreached souls get to know the richness of God's mercy towards them. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 318 - GOD'S GOT YOUR BACK
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GOD'S GOT YOUR BACK “Simon, Simon, look out. Satan has asked to sift you like wheat. But I have prayed for you that your faith may not fail. And you, when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.” Luke 22:31- 32 (CSB) Whether consciously or unconsciously, you enjoy the Mercy of God. The Mercy of God works or speaks in your favor even when you are ignorant of it. There are several situations where you have been preserved by God's Mercy.
God's Mercy endures forever!
Do you know the number of times the adversary has plotted against your life and destiny? Yet God's Mercy has always protected and sustained you. From the opening verse, you will see the example of Peter. While he was living his life faithfully as Jesus' disciple (as far as he can be), the adversary sought to sift him. The adversary had diligently orchestrated the fall of Peter. But Peter had the backing of God's mercy.Jesus prayed a prayer of petition for Peter.Peter had no idea the sequence of events happening behind him.
This means it wasn't by the faith of Peter that the adversary couldn't sift him. It was by the Mercy of God.
God's Mercy endures forever! You may not know the many plottings of the enemy, but God's Mercy got your back. Your faith cannot fail, because the Mercy of God is sustaining you. That is why your boast must not be in anything of your effort. Your boast and confidence should be in God who is rich in Mercy. Have you heard of the phrase "I've got your six"? It is a military term, which means, I've got your back. It means there maybe an unforeseen attack behind you, but I have got you. I will defend you and help you.
The Mercy of God in your life is the backing of God.
Just as in times past you were condemned eternally because of the sin of unbelief and trespasses; But God who is rich in mercy demonstrated His greatest love through the saving Grace of Jesus. (Ephesians 2:4-6)
You mean so much to God, than you can ever imagine. You are engraved on the palms of his hands.
"Can a woman forget her nursing child, And not have compassion on the son of her womb Surely they may forget, Yet I will not forget you.See, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; Your walls are continually before Me." God's Mercy is behind and before you in what may seem to be your darkest moments. Even when your mother and father forsake you, the Lord will take care of you. (Psalm 27:10). He has got your back, for His Mercies endure forever! Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Psalm 62:11-12; Ephesians 2:2-6; John 17:9-11,16-21) WE PRAYThat every orchestration of the devil to sift us, shall not prevail and we shall be sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 1 - 3Revelation 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. - God has got my back. - My boast and confidence is in God who is rich in Mercy. - The mercy of God is the backing of my life. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 319 - GOD'S GOT YOUR BACK 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GOD'S GOT YOUR BACK 2 "It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not" Lamentations 3:22 (KJV) The Mercy of God shows up for you when you are caught or to be caught unawares by a challenge. No matter how you try to anticipate evil or not to be surprised by anything negative, there may be some unexpected situations which will overwhelm you. However, you shall not be consumed by the mercy of God.
Mercy is God's unique quality which is exclusive to Him; it does not allow Him to overlook the weak and helpless. He provides a hand of protection and preservation to the helpless.
The adversary plots and unleashes his evil attacks at unexpected times. GOD'S MERCIES ENDURES FOREVER! After the Israelites left Egypt, Pharaoh made a decision to pursue them. (See Exodus 14: 1-31). Before the Egyptians caught up with them, God's Mercy showed up. Pharaoh pursued the Israelites with all of his best chariots. (Exodus 14:7). "But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon. And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the Lord. And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt? Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness" Exodus 14:9-12 (KJV). You will notice the Israelites were not ready for a fight. And also they weren't a people with great faith in God. Which means their faith wasn't enough to give them victory over the Egyptians. They had the mindset of slaves. Most of them were born and raised into slavery. Which means by their own intelligence, mindset and military strength they had no chance of victory against the Egyptians. They demonstrated so much faithlessness and murmured against God. Pharoah's pursuit was also intense. He was after them all morning and all night. He was not ready to give up, neither was he going to give them rest. "And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night." Exodus 14:19-20 (KJV).
God didn't turn away from the Israelites. By His Mercy, He defended them all night.
No matter how persistent the devil or your enemies will be in their evil intentions. God has your back. If God stood behind over 2 million Israelites and helped them to cross the Red Sea, is it you He cannot defend?
God's strategic plan for you cannot fail.
Lazarus was raised from the dead by Jesus according to His mercy and compassion. (John 11:30-36). There was no hope. And where was even the faith of Lazarus? He was raised according to the Mercy of God. No matter your weaknesses, and overwhelming challenge, trust in God's unfailing mercies. At a point when your faith seems to fail, turn to God's mercies. His MERCIES ENDURES FOREVER! Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Psalm 62:11-12; Ephesians 2:2-6; Psalm 40:11; Psalm 69:13,16; Psalm 23:6) WE PRAYWe pray that by the mighty hand of God, we shall experience the miraculous power of God according to His mercies. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 4 - 5 Revelation 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. – God has got my back. – My boast and confidence is in God who is rich in Mercy. – The mercy of God is the backing of my life. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 320 - "IT IS NOT OVER YET!" SAYS MERCY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency "IT IS NOT OVER YET!" SAYS MERCY"Therefore know that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations with those who love Him and keep His commandments" Deuteronomy 7:9 (NKJV)God's Mercy is not temporal. The MERCY of God is everlasting.From Psalm 136 we see the phrase "His Mercy endures forever" about 26 times. This is more than a strong affirmation.
God's Mercy is perpetual or without end.
It can never be over with Mercy. Mercy will always come through, as long as you turn to the Lord.Have you come to a point in your life where you feel you have failed completely and it is over with you?The Lord's Mercy endures forever.There are times you think all you deserve is punishment and disgrace. You may find yourself in that state where nothing glorious might happen. Cheer up! And turn to God one more time, for His Mercy endures forever!At that time when the Philistines were in control of the Israelites for about 40 years; the Lord raised Samson to deliver Israel from the hands of their enemies. Sampson was the greatest threat to the Philistines at the time.The birth of Samson was the demonstration of God's Mercy to the Israelites.They had done so much evil in the sight of God, that they turned away from Him and were greatly oppressed by the Philistines. The only help God gave them was the birth of Samson. (Judges 13:1-5).Samson's mandate was to begin to deliver Israel out of the hands of the Philistines.Most teachers of the word refer to Samson as "a physically strong man but morally weak".They often conclude that Samson failed.Was that really the case?Did Samson fail?No please!Samson fulfilled His purpose. And his life was a beautiful picture of God's Mercy!Samson had a glorious beginning with so much hope for the Israelites. However, he made many mistakes and made some huge mistakes. The latter part of Samson's story was filled with hopeless scenes.Samson slayed a lion with his bare hands (Judges 14:5-9), and with only a jawbone of an ass, he defeated and massacred an entire Philistines (they were about 1000 in number).The Philistines had been fighting Samson for 20 years and not once did they defeat him. They couldn't defeat him when they tied him up, they couldn't defeat him when they surrounded him at night in Gaza. Yet this man, Samson was finally arrested after they got his hair shaved completely. In his weakest moment, they quickly bound him and gouged out his eyes. He was thrown into prison where they bound him in shackles and made him grind grain.This was not just a hopeless situation for Samson, but the entire nation of Israel. No matter how you find yourself at the lowest state of life, don't feel despised by God. Don't assume God has left you. Even when it was obvious your mistakes and disobedience contributed to your downfall, trust in God's mercy to give you a hand.You may be mocked or become an object of amusement, but continue to trust in God's mercy. Be rest assured that you will not fail, according to His mercy.The Philistines thought it was over with Samson.
But Mercy said, "IT IS NOT OVER YET!"
They didn't know his hair was growing and there is such a thing as the Mercy of God.Sometimes it may seem you have lost all your strength, dexterity and grace. You just need to trust in God, who is the source of all grace and strength.The most beautiful and inspiring scene in the entire story of Samson was this:"Then Samson prayed to the Lord, “Sovereign Lord, remember me again. O God, please strengthen me just one more time. With one blow let me pay back the Philistines for the loss of my two eyes.” Then Samson put his hands on the two center pillars that held up the temple. Pushing against them with both hands, he prayed, “Let me die with the Philistines.” And the temple crashed down on the Philistine rulers and all the people. So he killed more people when he died than he had during his entire lifetime." Judges 16:28-30 (NLT).
Samson knew the Lord was with him. He understood the perpetuity of God's Mercy. And also understood the need to fulfill his purpose.
The scriptures says, Samson achieved more in his death than his entire life. When God's mercy showed up, Samson achieved more in a day than what he did in 20 years.Beloved, "IT IS NOT OVER YET!!"Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Psalm 62:11-12; Ephesians 2:2-6; Psalm 40:11; Psalm 69:13,16; Psalm 23:6 ) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be rejuvenated and strengthened by God according to His rich Mercy so that we shall accomplish or complete His plans and purpose for our lives.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 6 - 7Revelation 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. – God has got my back. – My boast and confidence is in God who is rich in Mercy. – The mercy of God is the backing of my life. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 321 - HE IS MORE THAN ENOUGH FOR YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 10th December, 2023 HE IS MORE THAN ENOUGH FOR YOU "Even if we feel guilty, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything." 1 John 3:20 (NLT) Considering this current society where everything seem to be happening fast; you are likely to be overwhelmed by many things. And sometimes you may be thinking if you can handle the growing pressures around you. Your struggle with addiction keeps rising with no enough time to recalibrate. Your sense of guilt and condemnation keep increasing. You pick your handset to make a call and you are pursued by an ad, luring you away from your plan or intention for the day. You just can’t lay your hands on the wheel towards your destiny. You look into the mirror and you really feel you are growing.
Sometimes it seems your colleagues had made better choices in life than you. It seems you are behind time and far from catching up.
Now you feel helpless and it seems everything is over. You can’t stop the tears, the sense of guilt and condemnation. Your mind is dominated by thoughts of defeat and hopelessness. Precious one, pause for a moment and stop looking at your fears, guilt, defeats, addictions and trouble. DO YOU KNOW WHO YOUR HEAVENLY FATHER IS?
He is BIGGER THAN your pain, your failure, your guilt, your defeat, your losses, weakness and addictions.
Don’t allow your feelings to control you. GOD IS BIGGER THAN YOUR FEELINGS. Move your attention away from your struggle and look at the LORD. “Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell God what you need, and thank him for all he has done. Then you will experience God’s peace, which exceeds anything we can understand. His peace will guard your hearts and minds as you live in Christ Jesus.” Philippians 4:6-7 (NLT) You can trust the Lord with your decisions and plans. For He has greater and more glorious plans for you. He will lead you into a beautiful future and fulfilled destiny. “Trust in the Lord completely, and do not rely on your own opinions. With all your heart rely on him to guide you, and he will lead you in every decision you make. Become intimate with him in whatever you do, and he will lead you wherever you go. Don’t think for a moment that you know it all,” Proverbs 3:5-6 (TPT) Don’t trust your feelings than the LORD. He is more than enough for you. No matter the situation, it is a simple matter before the Lord. Trust and live by His counsel. The challenges that seem to overwhelm you are not real. They are traps of the adversary to keep you discouraged.
Take your mind off them and focus on the glory and greatness of the Lord.
At the appointed time of the Lord, you shall see His mighty hand. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 32:17,27; Matthew 19:26; 2 Kings 3:18; Genesis 18:14) WE PRAY– Thanking God for the gift of His word which is a sure word for all situations. – Lord, thank you for being an ever present helper in time of trouble. Please help me to rely on you with all my heart in every decision and situation. In Jesus' glorious name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 8Revelation 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow to allow what I feel or see around me to control me. – GOD is bigger than my feelings. – GOD is bigger than my pain, my failure, my guilt, my defeat, my losses, weakness and addictions. – I trust in the LORD completely and I do not rely on my own opinions. – I have no fear of tomorrow because greater is HE that is in me than he that is in the world. – The LORD is my gaze. – I don’t spend to worry about anything, rather I talk to GOD about everything. HALLELUJAH!!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 322 - SEE DIFFERENTLY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency SEE DIFFERENTLY “Finally, be ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded 1 Peter 3:8 (ERV) As long as God has called you into Kingdom leadership, you must function as He does. Your heavenly father is the first leader of the universe. Therefore, He gives us the true pattern of leadership. Jesus, who was God made flesh, revealed the complete character of God. And in Christ, you will find this beautiful leadership trait: SEEING THE BEST IN OTHERS. It takes a genuine heart to see the best in others when they can only see their weakness. To lead your generation you must see the best of Hope in people.
To lead people is to influence and bring them into the fulfillment of God’s purpose for their lives.
They may not see what God has deposited inside them, however, you must see what God has put in them, when you look for the best in others. When God saw Gideon, He saw a mighty man of valor. When He saw David, He didn’t just see a shepherd boy, He saw a king. When He saw the young fishermen, who were untrained or unskilled in matters of the Kingdom, He saw fishers of men, who would expand the Kingdom.
Don’t see weaknesses and mistakes in people. See the beauty of God in others.
How did David turn men who were distressed, in debt, or discontented, to mighty men? He saw people who would be loyal to him and also be his team members. It was when these people came to David that, he became a captain.
When you start seeing the best of God in others, you will go to every extent to bring out the beauty you see in them.
When you look at the people in your workplace, school, or community, see what God wants them to be and not what the systems of this world have produced in them. You cannot impact your sphere, when you don’t see the people as God sees them. You will deal with people based on your assumptions and history with them when you don’t see the best in them. Deal with people based on what the Holy Spirit wants to produce in them. Selah! YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON... DIG DEEPER(Philippians 2:3; 1 Corinthians 13:7; Romans 12:10) WE PRAYLord, help me to see the best in people beyond their weaknesses and mistakes. Help me to see what you see in them and how to bring out that beauty. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 9 - 11Revelation 7 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– When I see people, I see emblems of the future. – When I see people, I see light bearers. – When I see people, I see world changers. – I see people through the eyes of Jesus. – I see faithfulness, hope and love in the people the Lord has entrusted unto me. – I don’t give up on anyone. – My goal in encountering people, is to bring out the beauty that I see. – By the strength of the Lord, I bring many unto purpose. – I AM A GLOBAL ICON. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 323 - INCREASE IN CAPACITY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  INCREASE IN CAPACITY 1 "There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God".2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT) As born again, you are the workmanship of God, created in Christ Jesus unto good works which He has foreordained that we walk in them. (Ephesians 2:10). The good works we are called to do are according to the design of God's will. If it's according to the design of God's will, then it will take His capacity to do His good work. There is nothing you do in God, with God, through God and for God without His capacity.
God's call upon your life is to make a great impact on the lives of many.
It is a call to the nations. It is a call to bless the world. There is nothing God has deposited inside you and assigned you to do which is limited in impact. If you will give attention to the things God has called you to do, you will surely bless the nations. There is no one called in God, whose impact is limited. God has put in you an unlimited mandate to make an unlimited impact, irrespective of your background and present location. God wants the knowledge of His Glory to cover the earth as the waters cover the sea (Habakkuk 2:14). He wants the kingdoms of this world to become saturated by His Kingdom and Life (Revelation 11:15). For God to achieve this, He has to produce His unlimited and immeasurable life in you. You then become the expression of God's glory to the world by His unlimited and immeasurable life in you. Jesus said, "You are the salt of the earth.. and ... you are the light of the world, a city set on a hill, which cannot be hidden" (Matthew 5:13-14). He said, "Ask of Me and I will give you the nations" Psalm 2:8. This means by your design, you have a mandate to illuminate the world and to preserve lives on earth, unto the glory of God.  This mandate requires something more than your natural capacity and strength. This requires divine capacity! To cover the earth with the knowledge of the glory of God...To Take your city for Christ...To saturate your sphere with the Gospel...To Go forth to make disciples of all nations...... WILL INVOLVE INCREASED CAPACITY. Capacity is the ability to contain and to produce. Through the new birth, you have the divine capacity for Christ to indwell you.  Now to achieve great things with and for the Lord, you have to nurture and increase the divine capacity in you. To have Christ in you means you don't have the excuse to do less. This is the time to do more or achieve great things unto God's glory.  You may ask "How can I increase in capacity?" It begins with Your submission to FOLLOW THE LORD. Jesus said to his disciples, "FOLLOW ME AND I WILL MAKE YOU..." (Matthew 4:19). As you follow and submit to the Lord, He will teach, train and infuse your spirit with His ability to produce great impact. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]; Luke 16:10 [NLT]) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will teach us to increase in capacity as we do His will and His gracious Spirit will lead us forward, as we advance to make impact. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 12Revelation 9 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With God, I go beyond my strength. – The Lord is with me therefore I do great things. – Through the study of the word and Prayer, I increase in capacity to take on my city. - By the strength of the Spirit at work in me, I increase in capacity to do great things. Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 324 - INCREASE IN CAPACITY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency INCREASE IN CAPACITY 2"There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God".2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)There is no divine assignment which doesn't require divine capacity, no matter how little it may seem.
If it is of God, then it is great!
See what David said, when he was preparing materials for building the temple."And King David said to all the assembly, “My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is still young and inexperienced and the work is great; for the temple is not for man but for the Lord God." 1 Chronicles 29:1 (Amplified)Now after all the materials needed were supplied for the building David now unveiled how:"Now therefore, our God, we thank You, and praise Your glorious name. “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to offer as generously as this? For all things come from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You... O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy Name, it is from Your hand, and is all Your own." 1 Chronicles 29:13-14,16. (Amplified).It will always take God Himself to partner with you to do what He inspires or assigns you to do.To have Christ in you is to have God's partnership for any good work.The spiritual capacity of God in you transcends your physical abilities.
The spiritual capacity is not only the ability to contain; it is also God's supply of ability within you to produce.
The Apostles acknowledged that all that they did was according to certain capacities. However, those capacities were supplied by God. (2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT).The Greek word for Capacity is "hikanotés", it also means sufficiency, competence, ability, power, qualification, or fitness.Though the capacity to do great things for God is supplied by the unlimited power of God, we have the responsibility to consistently increase in the capacity of God supplied.Until you decide to take advantage of the unlimited supply of God within you to increase your spiritual capacity you will not see unlimited results.Every Kingdom's achievement is greatly backed by divine capacity.
Greatness responds to great capacity.
Your level of capacity will determine the size of the city or sphere you can take.To increase in Spiritual capacity is to be a consistent follower of Jesus.The Lord teaches and trains you through certain men He has set in the Church. These men equip the saints for the work of the ministry. (Ephesians 4:11-12)You also build capacity through intense focus on God's work and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.Focus gives direction to divine energies. Whatever has your attention, attracts the resources of God within you.
Don't scatter divine resources, FOCUS!
And the more you fellowship with the Lord, the more you submit to Him for great help and supply.You must also have the habit of praying in the Holy Spirit. As you pray in the spirit and meditate on the Word, you also build up yourself in faith and increase your inner capacity (Jude 1:20).God has made you for big things; don't settle for less, therefore, increase in capacity.Are you imbuing focus?Are you meditating on the word?Are you fellowshipping with the Holy Spirit?How consistently do you speak in tongues?Beloved, enlarge your tents, lengthen your chords and strengthen your stakes. For the season of great results and harvest is here!Hallelujah!!!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]; Luke 16:10 [NLT]) WE PRAYThat our inner capacity will be enlarged by the Supply of the Spirit for greater works.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 13Revelation 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I imbue focus. – With God, I go beyond my strength. – The Lord is with me therefore I do great things. – Through the study of the word and Prayer, I increase in capacity to take on my city. – By the strength of the Spirit at work in me, I increase in capacity to do great things. Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 325 - INCREASE IN CAPACITY 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency INCREASE IN CAPACITY 3"There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God."2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)All that God has put in you are not for you; they are to be a blessing to nations. The impartation of God's blessings in you is to cause you to make IMPACT in others.
Whenever God wants to bless a people He sends a man.
While Joseph was living a challenging life from slavery to prison, God was preparing him to be the escape for Jacob in the days of famine (Genesis 45:7). When Israel agonised with pain in Egypt, God raised Moses and sent him as their deliverer. However, God gave a word that He will go down to Egypt to save His people Israel. Which means God sending Moses to Egypt was God Himself going to Egypt to save Israel. (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10; Acts 7:33-35).There are men whom God raised to be channels or conduits of blessings to their generation.  And you (reading this with today) are one of the blessings God has sent to bless this generation.The grace and abilities of God within you are part of the answers God is sending to this generation at such a time as this.Nevertheless, you cannot fulfill this great mandate without God. To affect many lives positively you have to enlarge your capacity. "Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited." Isaiah 54:2-3 (KJV)To enlarge your capacity, you have to stretch your inner man through consistent and persistent long intense prayers.To begin with, I want you to know it is wrong to think short quick prayers are not prayers. Every prayer is prayer. The quality of prayer is not really how long you've prayed. The quality of prayer is how well it is founded on the word of God.
Every prayer rooted in the word is effective!
 THEREFORE NO MATTER WHAT PRAY!So then, if even short quick prayers can be effective, much more when you give yourself to consistent long intense prayers?The idea of consistent long intense prayers is not about God expecting you to beg Him for long before He does something for you. Consistent long intense prayers are about having quality time with the Spirit.
The longer you spend time with the Spirit of the Lord in prayer, the stronger His influence on you becomes.
The Spirit of God enlarges your Spirit and strengthens your inner man. The anointing of the Holy Spirit on you becomes stronger.
Are you wondering what to say or pray about?
Cheer up!There is the gift of praying in the Spirit. To pray in the spirit includes praying other tongues. Get this:"The one who speaks in tongues advances his own spiritual progress..." 1 Corinthians 14:4 (TPT)Since tongues speaking will cause you to advance your spiritual progress, or edify (embolden, build or construct your inner man), then do it more to make more spiritual progress!Beloved, even ten minutes of tongues speaking will build your spirit. Therefore make time to pray in tongues for 30 or 60 minutes; then grow it to 2 hours, and then 6 hours.
The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God.
What are you waiting for?Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:30-31; Luke 18:1; Genesis 26:2; Isaiah 26:15; Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]) WE PRAYWe pray that against all odds and hindrances, we shall break forth in our spirit and maintain intense consistency in prayer.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Zechariah 14Revelation 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Rather than worrying about the size of the assignment, I pray. – I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.  – Through my effective prayers, I increase in capacity to do more. – I don't settle for less, I persist long in prayers. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 326 - EXPECT DIVINE EXALTATION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency EXPECT DIVINE EXALTATION 1"Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.” 1 Peter 5:6 - 7 (NKJV)With just some few days for the year to end, you may probably be taking records of your life already. You may be feeling distressed or discouraged about how things have not gone in the direction you expected. You may even be quick to think this year has so far been your most disappointing year. You really don't think there is something great you can achieve, and you are losing your confidence in God.In fact, you are even beginning to feel or think God is not caring and the promises of the scriptures are not true.VOILA!
This is where the adversary wants you to be. His goal is to force or push you to a level where you become angry with God.
He wants you to deny the reality of God's kindness in your heart. He keeps reminding you of your failures and the negative experiences you've had, though you have been serving the Lord.He keeps sowing thoughts of doubts or posing doubtful questions in your mind.For example:"After you gave that amount to the Kingdom gospel, has your life become better?""You had hoped to see your dad or mum healed of that infirmity, what has happened?" "And you think the healing power of God is real?""Do you even think the Gospel message of Jesus is real?""Don't you think these things are mere lies or fables?""Look at your family, your siblings; do you remember your friend who also lost the parents?", "How about your uncle who served God but has lost everything?" "Don't you think the stories of the Bible are mere friction?""You don't need God to be better, take your own life into your own hands. And forget about this God"Listen, when the adversary comes after your faith and exaltation, he tries to hit you hard at your weakest state. He will shamelessly and persistently inject more questions and thoughts to break you down.Have you had questions like these also:"Where was God when you failed your exams?" "Where was God when you got raped?" "Where was God when you were robbed?" "Where was God when you lost that money?" "Where was God when everyone left you?" "Where was God when you were abused, maltreated, cheated, scammed?" "Where was God when the lady or gentleman you loved left you or abandoned you?" etcThese questions are targeted by the adversary at you to establish enmity between you and God.All of a sudden you forget the goodness of God. You forget your testimonies and you continue to brood over these thoughts of the devil.
You even begin to forget that, the very air you breathe is a gift from God.
You suddenly become so arrogant and proud before the Lord.Get this, such thoughts are attacks of the devil, to build strongholds of pride in your heart. Such thoughts are programmed by the adversary to make you doubt God's help and to shipwreck your faith.
Such thoughts become stronger when you are really close to your season of exaltation.
The adversary knows the more you humble yourself before the Lord, the more you increase in faith to receive of the Lord.He knows the more you submit to the power of the word of God, the stronger your expectation for your miracle and exaltation."Surely there is a future [and a reward], And your hope and expectation will not be cut off" Proverbs 23:18 (Amplified Bible).He doesn't want you to have any expectation or hope in the Lord. He makes you think you can't predict or expect anything glorious.That is a lie!
Beloved, you have to maintain your expectation in God. Your season of exaltation is here. Don't allow your past to distract you.
"Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward" Hebrews 10:35A life lived by the word of God is predictable. When you live by the word you can have expectations of glory.There is nothing like uncertainty in the word of God. This doesn't mean you will not face opposition. You may face the worst of challenges. But the counsel of the Lord for your life shall stand.Joseph, who was a promised child, was sold into slavery by his own brothers and he was taken to prison by his master Potipher (whose house prospered because of Joseph, Genesis 39:2-5). He chose to honor God, and he was imprisonedWhat?Where was God?Listen, the Lord was with Joseph all through. Though those seasons were challenging times for Joseph, everything was playing out perfectly for him. The slave who became a prisoner rose to become the Prime Minister.
Beloved, don't give up, refuse the doubts and remain humble before the Lord, for the season of your exaltation is here!
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 24:14; Psalm 37:37; Jeremiah 29:11; James 4:10; Job 36:22) WE PRAYThat our confidence expectation in God shall not be cast away, no matter the opposition.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Malachi 1Revelation 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– This is my time of exaltation and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary. – I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 327 - EXPECT DIVINE EXALTATION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  EXPECT DIVINE EXALTATION 2 "Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.” 1 Peter 5:6 - 7 (NKJV) The Lord does not forsake His own. The scriptures are divine scripts which outline your beautiful future. There is nothing about your destiny which is not prophetically illustrated in the scriptures.
Your life may seem to be a mystery in the natural, but scripturally it is decoded.
Don't allow the limitations of your senses and experiences define your life. Sink your thoughts in the word of God. The more you pay attention to your challenges, the more you distract yourself from what God is doing with you.  "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end" Jeremiah 29:11 (KJV). There is an expected end the Lord has for you. And you must make that your focus. 
One of the expectations you must have as you humble yourself to make the Lord your focus, is EXALTATION.
Don't spend time feeding your mind with doubts. When the doubts come, cast it off. Learn to doubt your doubts. If you have questions similar to the ones I listed in the previous post, know that the adversary is sowing in your heart seeds of enmity and pride towards God. Which is a big trap of the devil. Your humility before the Lord is the secret to enjoy divine exaltation. It is not that God demands your humility before He exalts you. It is because, humility is a principle of faith which produces exaltation. To humble yourself before the Lord is explained in the opening verse. "...casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.” I Peter 5: 7 (NKJV)
To humble yourself under the mighty hand of God is basically to cast all your cares upon Him; with the conviction of heart that He cares for you.
When you don't humble yourself under the mighty hand of God, you have exalted yourself above the mighty hand of God. What you are saying is, you don't need the mighty hand of God to lift you and sustain you. You rather want to trust in your own strength. You don't need God's supernatural help. You trust in your own ability than the ability of God. It is as simple as that! But come to think of it, what more can your strength achieve? Begin to train your heart to exercise absolute confidence in God by acknowledging the glorious things He has done. "Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us--none can compare to You--if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count." (Psalm 40:5) Instead of counting your failures which will make you turn away from God, consider His goodness according to His power. It will cause you to humble yourself patiently under His mighty hand for your exaltation. Beloved, what are the things troubling your heart?
Cast all your cares unto the Lord and patiently stay under His mighty hand with humility. For the Lord shall exalt you in due season.
Do you know the goodnews? The due season is already here! That is why you are reading today's with .  REMAIN EXPECTANT FOR YOUR TESTIMONY Shalom Aleichem. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 24:14; Psalm 37:37; Jeremiah 29:11; James 4:10; Job 36:22) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the wisdom to stay humble under the mighty hand of the Lord and for this glorious new season of exaltation. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Malachi 2Revelation 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– This is my time of exaltation and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary. – I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 328 - JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE 1 "and told him, "Everyone serves the best wine first, and the cheap kind when people are drunk. But you have kept the best wine until now!" John 2:10 (ISV) Wine has a great meaning among the ancient Jews. The relevance of wine is not just what it represents or is used for during events or occasions. Wine also had symbolic meaning in the lives of the Jews. "People prepare a meal for enjoyment, wine makes life joyful, and money is the answer to everything." Ecclesiastes 10:11 (New American Standard Bible). From this verse, you will notice one of the symbolic relevance of wine.
Wine is a symbol of gladness or a joyful life. 
During the wedding at Cana, there was a point where they had no wine. Meanwhile, Jesus, his mother and his disciples were present. This was becoming an embarrassment.  How can there be a wedding without wine? Weddings were recognised as one of the best ceremonies in the Jewish culture. And such a ceremony without wine will be a huge dishonor to the guests and a disgrace to the host or the couples as they fail to provide basic hospitality.
Having no wine at a wedding is like having a life without fulfilment of joy. 
This is the summary of the story: "And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage. And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come. His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him." John 2:1-11 (KJV). Until Jesus' mother got Him into the situation, it seemed there was not going to be any solution. The situation at this Jewish wedding depicts the state of many lives. You may be born again, with the presence of God in your life and still not experience joy and happiness. You look into the mirror and you find no wine (joy or happiness). You may look into your year and still not recount any outstanding testimony or moment of joy and happiness from the beginning of the year till now. This might have been the situation for the last, 5 years, 10 years or even 20 years of your life. You simply can't recall any season of joy. If you have received Jesus into your life, CHEER UP!
As a born again you have the best winemaker, He is JESUS!
Make a decision that as you have Jesus in your life you will experience answers and joyous news. Mary the mother of Jesus, showed how one can experience continuous miracles. 1. She first turned to Jesus to make intercession. (John 2:3) She didn't deny the challenge, however, she recognised the greater solution. Her focus was the reality that Jesus shall supply fresh wine, not the absence of wine at the wedding.
Is Jesus bigger than your challenge?
Or do you still think your challenge is bigger than Jesus? 2. She told the servants, "Whatever He tells you to do, DO IT". (John 2:5). This is one of the most powerful secrets to the miraculous. OBEDIENCE TO THE WORD OF THE LORD.
No matter the situation, just obey the words of Jesus.
He will turn that dry season into a celebration. He will transform your sorrow into gladness. It only requires your obedience to His word. Sometimes it may seem you have endured a lot of bad seasons and days, beloved, Jesus has prepared the BEST WINE FOR THE LAST.
Don't be discouraged, don't compare yourself with those who have gone ahead of you. You are about to enjoy the best wine.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 104:14-15; Psalm 34:8; Judges 9:13; Luke 11:28) WE PRAYThat the Lord shall supply into our lives beautiful testimonies of gladness. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Malachi 3Revelation 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord supplies into my life beautiful testimonies of gladness. - My life is full of joy. - I experience the joy and gladness every day of my life. - I remain obedient to the word of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!! ![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 329 - JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE 2"and told him, "Everyone serves the best wine first, and the cheap kind when people are drunk. But you have kept the best wine until now!" John 2:10 (ISV)The process of making a good and quality wine in ancient Israel takes about 20 to 30 years.To produce the wine, grapes were pressed in the winepress and left in a collection keg for some days, as it goes through a fermentation process.Yet at the wedding in Cana, Jesus produces the best quality wine just within a few minutes. This was a compression of time.Consider the season of planting and harvesting grapes, all through the process of extracting wine from the grapes to the fermentation process. And it wasn't a burden for the Lord Jesus.Just instructing the servants to fill the water jars, He made the best wine."And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine. Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come. His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it. And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim. And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it. When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom, And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now."John 2:3-10 (KJV)The text tells us the tradition at Jewish weddings: they’d first serve their guests with the best wine, then when that wine is gone, the inferior wine is served.This means, at this particular wedding, the best wine was already served. This was the best wine which has been produced through the labour of men over the years. And yet after Jesus had produced His wine (through the miraculous compression of time and space), even the master or governor of the banquet affirmed that the latter wine he was served, was better than the best wine earlier served.
The best of man will always not be at the level of what comes out of God through faith.
 Does it look like you are at the end of yourself and you think there is no way out of the situation you are in?It doesn't matter how bad your condition is, JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE.In the previous episode, I explained that one of the significance of wine is to depict gladness or a joyful life. For Mary to say "They have no wine" also means, "They have no joy".Which situation has taken out joy in your home or family?Which situation has taken away joy in your academics or work?Which situation has taken out your joy in serving the Lord?
Jesus serves the best wine without stress, TRUST HIM.
In the first part of this discussion, I shared two basic items you need, to experience the miraculous.Always acknowledge the presence of Jesus in your life. The Lord is in your life to bring divine satisfaction. Don't allow your challenges to break you. Don't allow certain delays in your life to distract you. Remain focused on the Lord.
Jesus will turn that situation around unto the glory of God.
When Jesus turned the water into wine, His glory was seen.The Lord is causing His glory to be seen in your Life. He is going to satisfy you with the best of Himself.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 104:14-15; Psalm 34:8; Judges 9:13; Luke 11:28) WE PRAYThat through His favor and supply of grace we shall experience great results, even with limited time and resources.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Malachi 4Revelation 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I achieve great results with limited resources and time. – The Lord supplies into my life beautiful testimonies of gladness. – My life is full of joy. – I experience the joy and gladness every day of my life. – I remain obedient to the word of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!! ![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 330 - JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE (With Imperfect Vessels 1) 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE (With Imperfect Vessels 1) 3 "And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim." John 2:6-7 (KJV)The Book of John is a rich book with refreshing revelatory symbolism.A Theologian once said, "John writes like Picasso Paints". His writings are as the work of a skillful painter. He creates mental images for in-depth assimilation.
All through the scriptures, symbols are used to whisper rich realities of the Spirit to the readers.
We see John the Baptist first referring to Jesus as "the lamb of God which takes away the sin of the world" (John 1:29).Even before that, just in the first few verses of the first Chapter of John, he writes as a master poet, using light to describe the function and impact of the divine life.In addressing the Samaritan at the well (John 4) and the people at the last great feast (John 7), John takes interest in how Jesus used water to communicate the refreshing flow of the unendling Spirit-life.Jesus was revealed as the bread of life, the vine, the good shepherd etc.The book of John doesn't just provide historical details of Jesus. It is a book that focuses on the revelation of Jesus beyond time and space. These symbolisms beat the book into a unique distinctive shape of illumination for the reader.You don't read the book of John looking for what happened in history, but to behold the glory of God manifested in the flesh.The miracles outlined in the book of John are not to only showcase the power of Jesus. They represent the variegated richness of His PERSON. They are prophetic-revelatory tokens which give us the forensic understanding of Jesus' DIVINITY.
In John, each miracle is a sign that points to the divinity of Jesus. 
"This miraculous sign at Cana in Galilee was the first time Jesus revealed his glory. And his disciples believed in him." John 2:11 (NLT)Feeding the multitudes affirms the image He's painted as the bread of life. The raising of Lazarus affirms the reality that He is the resurrection and the life.We can't just walk away from this miraculous sign at the wedding event. I have previously explained how Jesus turning water into wine, was a demonstration of the reality that, He is the Lord of time and space.
He serves the best wine!
Before we get into the revelatory distinction of the old and new covenants in that miracle, I want us to appreciate another truth of Christ. Each miracle of Jesus in the gospel of John is pregnant with refreshing verities.
Whenever you pick your Bible to read, know that God doesn't waste words.
He is economical with His words. Every thought in scripture has its unique meaning. Appreciating each word will bring you into a better understanding of God's message.John could have said, "...there were waterpots, and Jesus asked them to fill it.". In a literal sense, you may think there was no need to mention six waterpots. Because it doesn't make any difference. But because John was a detailed prophetic-revelatory writer, he was inspired to serve his readers with every reality. In the scriptures, people, figures, places, objects, numbers and shapes have their unique meanings.According to the revelation of scriptures, the number six is the number of man and also means imperfection. (There are some who downplay such facts, however a consistent look at these usage of numbers, names, places and symbols in scriptures, strips bare the facts that they have deeper meanings than what they are literally).I will give a few examples in the next post.Now the waterpots are vessels for keeping water used for the Jewish rites of purification.For Jesus to work the miracle, He asked the servants to fill the waterpots to the brim. He didn't ask them to pour out the already used water. He also asked them to fill waterpots (or vessels) with the same water available in the house (and seen as common). He made them draw out the water from the six water pots (which also represent imperfect vessels.)
The best wine Jesus produced didn't come out of golden vessels with extraordinary water. He used the imperfect vessels and the ordinary common water.
To think that you are imperfect and ordinary doesn't change the reality that, Jesus will produce an extraordinary impact out of you when He comes in contact with you.The things which seem common will be used by the Lord to achieve great uncommon results.Jesus being God, brings the best out of the formless and void. Just as He did in creation. (Genesis 1:2-3; John 1:1-4).Whiles everyone saw imperfect water pots and ordinary water for Jewish rites; Jesus saw perfect vessels for the best wine.He commanded light out of darkness.
Allow the Lord through His word to bless the world with His best wine in you. Yours is to walk in the obedience of His word.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:6; 1 Corinthians 1:28; Psalm 104:14-15; Psalm 34:8; Judges 9:13; Luke 11:28) WE PRAYThat from what seems to be our imperfection and ordinary, the Lord will cause His best to gush forth to bless and satisfy the nations.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Revelation 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in obedience to the word of God. - I dish out the best of God in me to bless and satisfy the nations. - It doesn't matter what may seem to be an imperfection or ordinary in my life, I remain conscious of this certainty that out of me flows the best wine. - The best of God is seen and experienced through me. - I am a blessing to my world. - I shine the light of God in dark places. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 331 - JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE (With Imperfect Vessels 2) 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency JESUS SERVES THE BEST WINE (With Imperfect Vessels 2) 4"And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim." John 2:6-7 (KJV)From the previous discussion, we realised the book of John doesn't just provide historical details of Jesus.You are to read and study the book to behold the glory of God manifested in the flesh. The miracles outlined in the book of John represent the variegated richness of the PERSON of Jesus. In the first chapter of John's Gospel, he revealed Jesus as the one who has come to reveal the fullness of God.He said, "No one has ever gazed upon the fullness of God’s splendor except the uniquely beloved Son,who is cherished by the Father and held close to his heart. Now he has unfolded to us the full explanation of who God truly is!" John 1:18 (TPT)Though it is said, that God spoke to Moses face to face or mouth to mouth, it was still in shadows. God was fully revealed in Christ.
The law was given through Moses, but Christ came as the embodiment of grace and truth. He came to show us God's true person.
Jesus came to express the glory of the Father. Now look at what happened when He turned water into wine."And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him." John 2:10 -11 (KJV).
The miracle of turning water into wine was to reveal His glory (which is the GLORY and REVELATION OF GOD).
Every miracle Jesus did was a sign to show us the Person of God.There are some who are of the opinion that God doesn't take an interest in everything that happens in our lives. But that is not the case. Jesus at the wedding ceremony reveals that God attends weddings.In everything you do, don't be shy to let God in. He is interested in your affairs.The interest of God is not to just sit on His throne as the MIGHTY, ALL-POWERFUL GOD, who controls men and weighs their worship and sacrifices.
The interest of God is to love you, to be in you, live through you and be part of all you do.
You cannot explain the fullness of God through Moses.In Moses, we see water turned into blood, but in Christ, water is turned into wine.For water to be turned into blood points to death. However, Jesus showed us the essence of life, by turning water into wine. He came not to produce death. He came to produce life, gladness and eternal satisfaction.
The goodness of God was seen through Jesus.
The goodness of God always abound. Mary came to Jesus saying, "There is no wine".Jesus made them fill the six waterpots to the brim.  Each water pot takes 30 gallons. Thus, Jesus produced 150 more gallons for the wedding. They had more than enough, because of Jesus.I mentioned in the previous post that the number six is the number of Man and also the number of imperfection (seven is also the number of perfection).Man was made on the sixth day (he will always have something to do with the number 6). And also man who was good became imperfect. This is not to force an interpretation to churn "deeper" revelation. This is a basic symbolism to help appreciate the poetic whispers of the scriptures.The waterpots are also vessels which can be imperfect because they are breakable.
The best wine Jesus produced didn't come out of golden vessels with extraordinary water.
