Out of this imperfect religious jar came a new fine wine."We are like common clay jars that carry this glorious treasure within, so that the extraordinary overflow of power will be seen as God’s, not ours." 2 Corinthians 4:7 (TPT)Now, the waterpots were not for the main event. They were used by strict Jewish religious leaders for their religious cleansing as they got on to the main event (Read Mark 7:3-4).Because of how these waterpots have been used for religious activities, they needed to be refilled with fresh water. And it was filled to the brim. Water is mainly used by John as the symbol of the Spirit-life (John 4, John 7).For the Lord to bring a perfect wine out of your imperfection, He has to transfuse His overflowing life into you. As a new creation in Christ, the Lord has filled you with His Spirit-Life. That is an eternal treasure in you.
There is a treasure of God in you. Stop judging yourself by the imperfections. Look inside.
Within you is God's refreshing answer to the world.Don't live as an imperfect vessel. Live according to the treasure of the Spirit within you.For out of you the Lord is brewing a perfect wine to satisfy the world.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:6-7; 1 Corinthians 1:28; Psalm 104:14-15; Psalm 34:8; Judges 9:13) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the treasure of the Spirit within us and making us vessels of the overflowing Spirit-Life in our worldIn the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Revelation 19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in obedience to the word of God. – I dish out the best of God in me to bless and satisfy the nations. – It doesn’t matter what may seem to be an imperfection or ordinary in my life, I remain conscious of this certainty that out of me flows the best wine. – The best of God is seen and experienced through me. – I am a blessing to my world. – I shine the light of God in dark places. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 332 - THANKSGIVING IS ESSENTIAL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THANKSGIVING IS ESSENTIAL "Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ" Ephesians 5:20 (Webster's Bible Translation). There are times when people think thanksgiving benefits God.
There is nothing we do towards the Lord which benefits God. Whatever God tells you to do, helps you.
God is self-sufficient and self-complete. He doesn't depend on you to be satisfied. He has created an interdependence for us, to bring us into partnership with Him. This is mainly to help us get into the place of relevance. There are people who think prayer is only about presenting a long list of requests. They give themselves to constant prayer demands. They don't even think that thanksgiving is an essential part of Spiritual warfare. That was how Jehoshaphat went to war! "After consulting the people, the king appointed singers to walk ahead of the army, singing to the LORD and praising him for his holy splendor. This is what they sang: “Give thanks to the LORD; his faithful love endures forever!” 2 Chronicles 20:21 (NLT). Who goes into such a fierce battle with singers ahead of the army? And they weren't even singing for help. Their song was full of thanksgiving for the Lord's faithfulness and mercies. If you think there is nothing to thank God for, just know He has been MERCIFUL.  Thank Him for His ever-enduring MERCIES. (Read more about the Lord's mercies). When people begin to feel anxious, they act on the instruction of the word to pray; yet they forget that thanksgiving is essential.
Your prayer of supplication must be soaked in thanksgiving.
"Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God." Philippians 4:6 (Berean Standard Bible). Learn to spend more hours to thank the Lord, than the hours you use in making a petition to the Lord.
Thanksgiving is not an option. It is a great demonstration of faith.
A thankful heart is able to acknowledge every good thing. And that is how faith finds full expression. David said, "I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth" Psalm 34:1 (ESV). You have to learn to thank the Lord at all times. As you wake up and get out of bed, thank the Lord. As you walk out of your room, thank the Lord. As you are served or serve yourself with food, thank the Lord. For every opportunity and at all times, GIVE THANKS! This is God's will for you. "In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you." 1 Thessalonians 5:18 (KJV). Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Daniel 6:10; Colossians 3:17; 2 Thessalonians 1:3; Psalm 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the abundance of His grace, His kindness through the year and His providence. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Revelation 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.– In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.– I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.– I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.– My mouth is full of thanksgiving.– Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 333 - THANKSGIVING IS ESSENTIAL 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THANKSGIVING IS ESSENTIAL 2 "Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ" Ephesians 5:20 (Webster's Bible Translation) From yesterday, we realised Thanksgiving is essential in our walk of faith.
A thankful heart is a faithful heart.
Thanksgiving is not just our response to what God has done. Thanksgiving is also part of honoring God. There are some who have no clue of the details of giving thanks to God. The thing is, as simple as thanksgiving or gratitude seems to be, it doesn't come to people naturally.  One has to be intentional to live a life of gratitude.
To show gratitude is an attitude of gratefulness.
An attitude of gratefulness towards God is dependent on how valuable God is to you. It is not first about what God has done for you, but who He is to you and how you honor Him. The knowledge of who God is will definitely bring to light the reality of His lovingkindness. "Throughout human history the fingerprints of God were upon them, yet they refused to honor him as God or even be thankful for his kindness..." Romans 1:21 (TPT). The more you fail to recognize who God is and be thankful for His lovingkindness, the more you expose your mind to corrupt thoughts.
When you fail to see God's goodness in your life, you will only entertain thoughts of defeat, discontentment, failure and disappointment.
See the latter part of Romans 1:21, "...Instead, they entertained corrupt and foolish thoughts about what God was like. This left them with nothing but misguided hearts, steeped in moral darkness." (TPT).
Thanksgiving or showing gratitude to God supplies guidance and light to your heart.
"Sincere gratitude is said to be the healthiest of all human emotions" Dr. Hans Selye (1907-82), Hungarian-Canadian endocrinologist. Learn to practice thanksgiving. We find our Lord Jesus showing us the way of thanksgiving. At different times we see the Lord being thankful for many things. Even before a miracle happens Jesus is already full of thanks and gratitude. Jesus was full of praise or thanksgiving before He fed the 4000 (Mt 15:36) and the 5000 (Jn 6:11). At the tomb of Lazarus, He gave thanks before raising him from the dead (Jn 11:41). Even at the Passover meal, our Lord Jesus gave thanks before sharing wine and breaking bread (Lk 22:17-19). 
Learn to express gratitude to God and the people around you. A grateful heart is attractive and peaceful. 
The adversary doesn't want you in that state. He wants you to look all stressed and troubled. And you know what, miracles don't abound in that state. David said, in Psalm 107,  "Let everyone give all their praise and thanks to the Lord! Here’s why—he’s better than anyone could ever imagine.Yes, he’s always loving and kind, and his faithful love never ends." (TPT). The King James makes it simple: “Give thanks to the Lord for He is good and His mercy endureth forever." How many times have you given thanks to God already? Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Daniel 6:10; Colossians 3:17; 2 Thessalonians 1:3; Psalm 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13; Psalm 103:2) WE PRAYThank the Lord for who He is, and His benefits to you and all men (including your family and your local Church). In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Revelation 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.– In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.– I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.– I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.– My mouth is full of thanksgiving.– Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 334 - PRACTICAL WAYS TO BE THANKFUL TO GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency PRACTICAL WAYS TO BE THANKFUL TO GOD"Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness." 1 Chronicles 16:29 (KJV)Being thankful or showing gratitude to God is a practical thing.And you must be intentional with it.You spend hours praying for a miracle and not be thankful at all. Most people are not able to maintain a consistent habit of Thanksgiving because they don't know how.
Thanksgiving also brings you into the consciousness of God's presence.
Through the Word of God, we are not only instructed to be thankful; we are also instructed on how to give thanks to God.There are three major things I will share with you in your practice of Thanksgiving. These are practical things that will help you develop the habit of Thanksgiving.1. Sing songs of Praise to the Lord. “Sing out your thanks to Him; sing praises to our God” Psalm 147:7 (TLB)
Singing spiritual songs of thanksgiving is also a practice of the Spirit.
It doesn't matter how you feel or the lack of words, just start your day with songs of praise. As you sing praises to the Lord, you speak in tongues and rejoice in the Holy Spirit. You can take some time to write down a list of songs focused only on thanksgiving or praise. And minister those songs to the Lord. There are times when you have to take a posture of gratitude. You can either be on your knees, lift your hands or prostrate yourself before the Lord.This will tune your heart and mind to the thoughts of divine wonders.2. Offer the Sacrifice of Praise by the fruit of your lips."Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name." Hebrews 13:15 (NKJV)The fruit of your lips are the words you speak. And your words must be full of thanksgiving.Just in case you cannot spontaneously remember the right words of praise to speak, go through the scriptures and write out the thanksgiving verses which resonate with your heart. (You can find a lot through the Psalms).And then read them out or vocalize them with a genuine heart of gratitude. While you are engaged in this, the anointing of the Holy Spirit will begin to increase in your life.3. Give a gift or money to support the Lord's work.Reread the opening verse:"Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness." 1 Chronicles 16:29 (KJV)  This offering is different from the fruit of your lips. This is the fruit of your heart.Our Lord Jesus said,"For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also,” (Matthew 6:21).
Your money is your treasure. To give your money sacrificially to the Lord's work is great evidence that you value the Lord.
How you spend your money reveals your priorities. And your money is a symbol of your desire. Therefore, to say you are greatly thankful to God, you must follow it up with a financial gift towards His work.This is a sacrificial giving of gratitude to the Lord.It is a demonstration of honor. The scripture says, "Honor the Lord with your substance" (Proverbs 3:9).
This month give a sacrificial gift to the Lord's work.
GO AHEAD TO PRACTICE YOUR GRATITUDE TOWARDS THE LORD.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Daniel 6:10; Colossians 3:17; 1 Chronicles 29:10-20; Psalm 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13; Psalm 103:2) WE PRAYThank the Lord for the glorious graces He has released unto you and the opportunity to be relevant in the Kingdom, through your local Church.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Revelation 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.– In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.– I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.– I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.– My mouth is full of thanksgiving.– Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 335 - CARTWHEELS OF JOY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency CARTWHEELS OF JOY 1"I'm singing joyful praise to God. I'm turning cartwheels of joy to my Savior God." Habakkuk 3:18 (MSG)You just can't live the higher life of faith when you are dependent on situations or circumstances.
Your life is not defined by what happens to you. Your life is defined by your SOURCE.
The question is, who or what is your source?Who do you depend on?Through whom do you find the true meaning of your life?The life of the born again is defined by the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.You don't define your life by the circumstances surrounding you. The challenges you face are not to determine the state of your heart.Your joy and peace must not be dependent on your present situation. Your joy and peace is in Christ. Which means, they have eternal value. That is not the value and longevity of your present challenges or situation.
Your circumstances don't have eternal value. It doesn't matter how they come, they will pass away.
Just this book title by Robert Shuller reprogrammed my mindset:"Tough Times Never Last, But Tough People Do!"I said to myself, "If tough times never last, then I don't have to be controlled by these times."No wonder Paul never saw himself as a Prisoner in Rome. He always referred to himself as a Prisoner of Christ. He was never limited by those chains and the walls of the prison."Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel." Philippians 1:12 (Bereans Standard Bible)So he said to the Philippians, "Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice" (Philippians 4:4).
What a mindset!
Habakkuk the Prophet found himself in a dilemma, which made him misunderstand God at a point. When he saw the cruelty of the Chaldeans against the Israelites, he felt God had refused to help. (Habakkuk 1:2-4;  2:1)You may find yourself in a situation and begin to feel God has left you and your family. You may seem to be angry with God or doubt his word. The adversary takes delight in such thoughts of doubt towards God.
The adversary sees and capitalizes on your misunderstanding of God to lock you up in your lowest ebb.
Habakkuk was troubled by the sufferings of his people. But being troubled wasn't the solution. When Habakkuk turned away from his dilemma to focus on the Saving grace of the Lord, an atmosphere of joy sprung up.He said in his Faith Hymn:"Though the fig tree does not blossomAnd there is no fruit on the vines,Though the yield of the olive failsAnd the fields produce no food,Though the flock is cut off from the foldAnd there are no cattle in the stalls,Yet I will [choose to] rejoice in the Lord;I will [choose to] shout in exultation in the [victorious] God of my salvation!" Habakkuk 3:17-18 (Amplified).Oh, glory to God!What is your composure amidst your failures?
You are not sorrowful or joyful because of your situation. You are sorrowful or joyful by choice.
Don't turn to God with complaints.By faith behold the saving grace of the Lord and turn cartwheels of joy and praise to your Savior. Your true tranquillity and rest are in God. Therefore rejoice in the Lord!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 12:12; Psalm 34:1-2; 2 Corinthians 6:10; Isaiah 54:1; Acts 5:41; Colossians 1:24) WE PRAYThank the Lord for the manifestation of His glory in your most challenging times.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 107 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have inward and outward tranquility. – I am full of joy. – I give no room for sorrow. – I refuse to entertain any sorrowful thought.  – The perfect peace of God calms me in every circumstance. – I refuse to be agitated no matter the challenge because I enjoy perfect peace. – I am sound all round. – I enjoy the blessing of wholeness everyday. – I practice joy daily. – I rejoice at every count. – I start my day in joy, I continue through the day in joy and end in joy. – I rejoice always. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 336 - CARTWHEELS OF JOY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency CARTWHEELS OF JOY 2"I'm singing joyful praise to God. I'm turning cartwheels of joy to my Savior God." Habakkuk 3:18 (MSG)Get this, you are not sorrowful or joyful because of your situation. You are sorrowful or joyful by choice.I have explained the above statement in the previous episode.A Spirit-filled life is a life full of joy.
To be in Christ and to live without joy, means you are living without the consciousness of the presence of Jesus.
As I have explained, don't allow your life to be defined by your circumstances. Your true life is defined by Jesus.Look away from the challenges and behold the Lord.You can't continue to fix your gaze on Jesus and remain in sorrow. Joy gushes forth from within you. Your atmosphere will be saturated with peace.When Jesus was conceived in Mary's womb, Mary visited Elizabeth who was also carrying a baby (who would be later called John the Baptist).When the baby in Elizabeth's womb heard the voice of Mary, he leapt and kicked in the womb. (Luke 1:41).The baby in the womb heard the voice of the one carrying the Saviour.
To leap is a posture of joy. You see joy is expressive and explosive. You cannot say you are joyful and then remain still.
The atmosphere of joy is always contagious. It is an atmosphere of heartfelt laughter, shouts, singing, rejoicing, dancing and jumping. This is what we call the cartwheel of joy. A cartwheel of joy is a spinning joy. A cartwheel is a fast physical movement in which you turn in a circle sideways; you put one hand and then the other on the ground, flip your legs straight up into the air and then land your feet one at a time as you stand up straight."Though the cherry trees don’t blossom and the strawberries don’t ripen,Though the apples are worm-eaten and the wheat fields stunted,Though the sheep pens are sheepless and the cattle barns empty, I’m singing joyful praise to God. I’m turning cartwheels of joy to my Savior God.Counting on God’s Rule to prevail, I take heart and gain strength.I run like a deer. I feel like I’m king of the mountain!" Habakkuk 3:17-19 (Message)This is about taking a joyous posture amidst challenges and defeats. When it seems all things are crumbling around you and you are failing and not being fruitful in all you do, DON'T CRY nor COMPLAIN.Turn to God. He is the LORD of your SALVATION. As you rejoice in the Lord, you are celebrating the transformation of your situation and declaring your victory over adversity.
Let the joy of the Lord flood your environment.
If there is nothing to rejoice about, YOU HAVE JESUS IN YOUR LIFE. There is no more glorious news to the world than the good news of Jesus.Beloved, rejoice always in the Lord, again I say rejoice!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 12:12; Psalm 34:1-2; 2 Corinthians 6:10; Isaiah 54:1; Acts 5:41; Colossians 1:24) WE PRAYThanking the Lord:- for the gift of eternal life through His power of salvation.- for the supply of strength, the victories and making us kings of the mountains.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 108 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have inward and outward tranquility. – I am full of joy. – I give no room for sorrow. – I refuse to entertain any sorrowful thought. – The perfect peace of God calms me in every circumstance. – I refuse to be agitated no matter the challenge because I enjoy perfect peace. – I am sound all round. – I enjoy the blessing of wholeness everyday. – I practice joy daily. – I rejoice at every count. – I start my day in joy, I continue through the day in joy and end in joy. – I rejoice always. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 337 - DEMONSTRATE THE LOVE OF GOD IN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DEMONSTRATE THE LOVE OF GOD IN YOU "But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ“ 2 Peter 1:5-8 (NKJV). It’s from the Greek word, “philadelphia” composed of phílos or phileo and adelphos. Philos or phileo means beloved, dear, friendly or to have affection.While Adelphos means brother. Thus, Philadelphia means “fraternal love”, brotherly love (kindness), love of the brethren or to have affection for a brother. Brotherly love refers to the love members of a family hold for each other and would not usually be used to describe the love between members of different families.Jesus in His commandments to His disciples, revealed the essence of philadelphia (brotherly love).  “By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another” John 13:35 (KJV)
Brotherly love is our testimony of discipleship to the world.
The love we demonstrate, one to another enables us to bear much fruit (see John 15:16-17). The Church cultivated practical kindness towards one another. This radically depleted their differences in culture, status and diverse backgrounds. They hewn a bond of love in Christ wherein believing Greeks and Jews, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarians, Scythians, slaves and freemen, men and women were now all one in their Lord Jesus. They willingly stood for one another, supplied help to each other's shortcomings, and they loved unselfishly.  These brethren distributed all they had equally among themselves.
The extent you love a brother or a sister in the Lord is the extent you demonstrate the Love of God in you.
”If someone says, “I love God,” but hates a fellow believer, that person is a liar; for if we don’t love people we can see, how can we love God, whom we cannot see?And he has given us this command: Those who love God must also love their fellow believers.” 1 John 4:20-21 (NLT). “Make no mistake about it, God will never be mocked! For what you plant will always be the very thing you harvest. The harvest you reap reveals the seed that was planted. If you plant the corrupt seeds of self–life into this natural realm, you can expect to experience a harvest of corruption.If you plant the good seeds of Spirit-life you will reap the beautiful fruits that grow from the everlasting life of the Spirit.” And don’t allow yourselves to be weary or disheartened in planting good seeds, for the season of reaping the wonderful harvest you’ve planted is coming!Take advantage of every opportunity to be a blessing to others, especially to our brothers and sisters in the family of faith!” Galatians 6:7-10 (TPT):(NB: Read these verses also from the Message and Amplified Bible).
Being a blessing to others is how you plant seeds and harvest great fruits.
Beloved, be a blessing most especially, to the brothers and sisters who are of the eternal family of Christ (these are the born-again believers).
Decide to be a blessing to someone today with a special gift. 
Demonstrate your love for God by loving the saints. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:7-21; Romans 12;10; 1 Thessalonians 3:12; Acts 2:44-45; Acts 4:32) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the consummated understanding of this rich reality.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 109 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the Love of Christ. – I genuinely love the brethren. – I go all out of the brethren in the faith. -I affectionately serve the saints with genuine heart of love. – I demonstrate my love for God by loving the saints. – I don’t get tired in doing good. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 338 - YOU ARE PART OF THE LORD'S ARMY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU ARE PART OF THE LORD'S ARMY “This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you’re not on my side, you’re the enemy; if you’re not helping, you’re making things worse.” Matthew 12:30 (Message Bible) When you became born again, you were not only conveyed into the Kingdom of the Son of His love (Colossians 1:13); you were also made a king and a priest (Revelation 1:6), through Christ Jesus.
You have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel.
And you must do this with a mindset of a soldier. God made you a king-priest and enlisted you to be a soldier in His army. This assignment is war, and you cannot approach it with the mindset of a civilian. Observe Paul’s statement to Timothy:“Thou, therefore, endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” 2 Timothy 2:3-4 (KJV). There are some few items to outline from these two verses:i. You are chosen by God as a good (Victorious) soldier of Jesus Christ.ii. As a soldier you must endure hardships.The Passion translation puts it this way:” Overcome every form of evil as a victorious soldier of Jesus the Anointed One“.Which means we overcome or endure because we already have the victory in Christ Jesus. We are waging war from the victory we have received in Christ Jesus.iii. As a man of war, you don’t live as a civilian.“No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life” And that is how you will please the Lord who enlisted you.As you are called to active duty of a soldier, you have to divorce yourself from the distractions and ordinary business of this life.Concentrate on carrying out divine orders.
As a soldier of Christ in the Lord's army, your first priority is the mandate of the kingdom.
You are a kinging soldier and God’s weapon of war against the kingdoms and the systems which set themselves against the Lord. Beloved, you are part of the Lord's army. These are the Lord’s words to you dearly beloved; “You are my battle-ax and sword,” says the LORD. “With you I will shatter nations and destroy many kingdoms. With you I will shatter armies— destroying the horse and rider, the chariot and charioteer” Jeremiah 51:20-21 (NLT).
As a soldier in the Lord's army and weapon of war, you don’t function by your selfish cravings; submit yourself to His will.
He works in you both to will and to do. You don’t operate by your strength in the flesh. The Lord supplies you with His strength unto His ordained good works. Therefore, live your life empowered by God’s free-flowing grace, which is your true strength, found in the anointing of Jesus and your union with Him! (2 Timothy 2:1) Live daily with this ultimate consciousness that you are part of the Lord's army as you enjoy the supply of His strength in doing great things. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:8-39; Judges 7; 1 Corinthians 9:19-27; 2 Timothy 4:5; 1 Timothy 1:18) WE PRAYThat the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps which will make us get ministerial results. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 110 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am enlisted in the Lord's army. Therefore, I don’t function as a civilian. – I am God’s weapon of war. – I am committed to the mandate of the kingdom. – I discipline myself to live as a victorious soldier of Christ. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 339 - BE THE BEST GOD WANTS YOU TO BE TODAY!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE THE BEST GOD WANTS YOU TO BE TODAY!“Woe to you who are complacent in Zion…” Amos 6:1 (NIV)As part of being diligent, and immovable you must intentionally continue in what the Lord has tasked you to do.
God didn’t design you to have one-time success.
It is not enough to be diligent yesterday and complacent today.Complacency is self-satisfaction, which will make you assume you have arrived.
It leads to lukewarm and sluggishness.
Most people become complacent and think they have arrived by how they compare themselves with others. Being ahead of others in spirituality and results doesn’t mean you have reached the finish line. ”For we dare not class ourselves or compare ourselves with those who commend themselves. But they, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.” 2 Corinthians 10:12 (NKJV) Don’t stop halfway to boast about yesterday’s results.There are people who only dwell and boast about their past glory.
It is important to acknowledge every good thing you’ve achieved.
However, when all you have to show to the world tomorrow is what you achieved yesterday, then you wasted today. Yesterday’s success is to inspire you to do more today, and that becomes your testimony and inspiration for tomorrow.
Your relevance today is not in the things you used to do and achieve.
How have you built on what you’ve done and achieved?What more have you done since yesterday? Apostle Paul did not press on because of past glory. He pressed on towards the goal. Goals are not in your past. Goals are ahead of you.If you reached yesterday’s goal, then set new goals and start working towards them today.
How you succeeded yesterday, is not enough for your success today.
You must grow deeper in knowledge and understanding. You must understand the things you have to put aside from yesterday and the things you must carry along today.  You must know the new things you need to add to what you already have, to achieve more today. It is not how many hours you used to pray. It’s how many hours you pray now. It is not how you used to reach out to win souls. It’s how many souls you are winning now. It is not how many days you used to fast and pray. It’s how you do them better now. It is not how many Churches you have planted and helped. It’s how many new churches you’re planting today.
It is not how many people you used to raise for the Lord. It’s how many people you are raising now.
It’s not how you used to give into kingdom assignments. It’s how much more grace you have received to give today. It is not how you used to be consistent with ministerial instructions. It’s how consistent you are today in ministry. Not the testimonies you used to see in your life. However, the more testimonies you are seeing now.
Beloved, you must be committed to making progress today.
PRESS ON! BE THE BEST GOD WANTS YOU TO BE TODAY!DON’T EVER STOP! "No, dear brothers and sisters, I have not achieved it, but I focus on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead, I press on to reach the end of the race and receive the heavenly prize for which God, through Christ Jesus, is calling us." Philippians 3:13-14 NLT SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 9:24-27; Revelation 2:4; Revelation 3:1-22; Hebrews 6:12; Joshua 14:6-15) WE PRAYWe pray that we won’t trade our fervency to do more for the Lord with anything. We take grace to press on to the finished line as the Lord has determined. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 111 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t boast in the past. – I press on towards the goal. – I achieve new goals set before me by the Lord. – I celebrate yesterday’s success but i don’t dwell there. – I press on to produce more fruits today. – Everyday is a new season to achieve new goals. – I don’t stop here. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 340- THERE IS NO TIME TO WASTE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 29th December, 2023THERE IS NO TIME TO WASTE"Herald and preach the Word! Keep your sense of urgency [stand by, be at hand and ready], whether the opportunity seems to be favorable or unfavorable…" 2 Timothy 4:2 (AMPC) Beloved, you can’t be a world changer or a global icon by mouth. In as much as what you confess is important to your success, you must understand your choice of action will determine the extent to which you may lead your generation. Every great leader has a sense of urgency every day.
Consistent impact is birth through a consistent routine.
It is not the Father’s will that you experience one-time success. He wants you to have daily success. To make a difference in your generation, take daily steps which will make the dream of God in your heart a reality. You can’t be one who procrastinates, wastes or spends time on none non-essentials or things which don’t directly contribute to your target and vision.
You have to be disciplined to work towards your goal.
Until you maintain a strong sense of urgency concerning your goals, you may not be disciplined, diligent and consistent.
This is one of the great secrets to prosperity and greatness.
Be prompt to do it! Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste. Procrastination is a destroyer of destiny and fulfillment. Laziness is the act of the poor. And being lazy and wasting time doesn’t mean you are doing nothing. You can spend time doing something which doesn’t contribute to your action plan. You have no sense of urgency when you spend time surfing the internet, and watching funny clips when you should be praying.
Anything you do with your time must be an intentional step to contribute to your progress.
Refuse to be lazy. The lazy has no sense of urgency. They do things on their own time and not according to the standard of the assignment. Your routine must represent the level of greatness. ”The soul of a lazy man desires and has nothing, but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.” Proverbs 13:4
Don’t just desire or wish to be successful and great. Be diligent in working towards your greatness.
”Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.” Proverbs 12:24. Diligence with a sense of urgency, is a characteristic of all prosperous leaders who lead and transform their generation.The Bible says, that David rose early in the morning and went to the camp as his father had commanded. (1 Samuel 17:20).And Abraham got up early in the morning to do what the Lord has instructed (Genesis 22:3-4). You will find this sense of urgency, promptness and diligence with these great men in the scriptures. They knew their success was in how they urgently acted on the instructions they received.
There is no success in procrastination.
How urgent are you working towards your goals for today, for the week, for the month and the upcoming year? You can reach your target, and maintain a sense of urgency!!! SelahDIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 2:6-7; Romans 12:11-12;Ecclesiastes 10:18; Proverbs 12:11; Proverbs 10:4-5; Deuteronomy 24:19) WE PRAY– That we will be enabled with the grace to be diligent in all that our hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 113 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Whatever the Lord requires me to do, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In giving, I give with a sense of urgency. – In soul winning, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In prayer and the study of the word, I do it with a sense of urgency. – I refuse to procrastinate. – I get the job done on time. – I get the results. – I diligently act on the word of God. – I make each day count. – I make daily progress and success. – Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof. – I win everyday. – I am not a waster of resources. – Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me. – I am a success. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 341 - LET THE PERFECT PEACE OF CHRIST RULE IN YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LET THE PERFECT PEACE OF CHRIST RULE IN YOUR HEART"And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful". Colossians 3:15 (NKJV) The epistles were written to establish us in the consciousness of who Christ is, the reality of what He has done for us, our responsibilities in Christ and how we are to conduct ourselves in the world and among the saints. Understand that God did not produce a bunch of lazy sons in the Kingdom. With all that Christ achieved for us and supplied to us through His Spirit, there are things we are entrusted to do by the Lord. In Episode 90, I explained the things Christ has achieved and given to us in Himself, by His grace for our enjoyment. And I began to share with you things you must continue to do to continue in the enjoyment of our New Life in Christ.
How serious you take these things and continue in them will determine how rich your walk with God will be.
Take Note: These responsibilities are not to preserve and keep your salvation. For it is God who keeps you from falling. The Salvation which you have received is the responsibility of God. Your growth in the newness of life is your responsibility. This explains why many people have been saved in Christ, yet they are not enjoying the richness of their inheritance in Christ. These episodes will enrich you;- Continue in the Faith- Continue Steadfastly In Prayer.- Rejoice in the Lord. When you take hold of these things I have shared with you, you shall not stumble in your walk with God. In Episode 101— THE ETHEREAL TRANQUIL, I shared some insight on the transcendency of the peace we have in Christ.This is a rich matter which should set you on a journey where you will not be moved by any storm of this world. These things sustained the faith of the saints who began this race. There is a reason they were not moved by the persecution, the rejection, and the troubling times they faced. They continued to shine forth the light of God in the darkest places. They died with joy and peace while they were burnt at stake, given to wild beasts, crucified and experienced cruel executions. Nothing moved even the saints who witnessed such cruelty towards their fellow brethren in the Lord. They were deeply entrenched in this truth I am sharing with you. Now again look at what you are to do with this PEACE of Christ:“Peace I leave with you; My [perfect] peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Do not let your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid. [Let My perfect peace calm you in every circumstance and give you courage and strength for every challenge.]“ John 14:17 (Amplified)Oh glory! We know we did not receive the PEACE the world gives. We have the PEACE OF CHRIST. However, when we are confronted by challenges the Perfect peace of Christ doesn’t just find expression automatically. Our Lord Jesus instructed,LET MY PERFECT PEACE calm you in every circumstance.
He is not going to let it calm you. You have to let His perfect peace calm you. He has already given you that PEACE, what do you now do with it?
Definitely, you may be confronted by challenges, however, you have to make this PEACE OF CHRIST rule in your heart.Submit yourself to the controlling force, the government, or the hegemony of the PEACE of Christ. Let the peace of Christ [the inner calm of one who walks daily with Him] be the controlling factor in your hearts [deciding and settling questions that arise]. To this peace indeed you were called as members in one body [of believers]. And be thankful [to God always].Colossians 3:15 (Amplified)
The Perfect Peace of Christ has to influence your relationship with the saints as well.
Beloved, don’t choose fear, anxiety, doubts and worry. Let the peace of God have its full dominance in your heart. To engage and supply the PERFECT PEACE of Christ, you have to PRAY and make SUPPLICATION with THANKSGIVING amid every storm. It means you don’t bear the burden of the storm or the challenge. Through prayer and supplication, you put God’s strength to work. And you go about your day with thanksgiving.Hallelujah! "Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything; tell God your needs, and don’t forget to thank him for his answers. If you do this, you will experience God’s peace, which is far more wonderful than the human mind can understand. His peace will keep your thoughts and your hearts quiet and at rest as you trust in Christ Jesus.” Philippians 4:6-7 (TLB). Do you see why you must continue steadfastly in prayer? The PEACE of God will keep or garrison your heart as you pray.The peace of God can be as regiment or squadron or battalion, which will defend, fortify and occupy your mind and heart from the vicissitudes of this world.
It has what it takes to displace worry at the center and borders of your life.
Let the PERFECT PEACE OF CHRIST RULE IN YOUR HEART. SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 26:3; 2 Corinthians 10:5; Philippians 4:9; Job 22:21;Romans 8:6; Romans 5:1; Isaiah 27:5; ) WE PRAY– That as we pray we bring every imagination, every high thing and every thought to the obedience of Christ and that our hearts will be garrisoned with the perfect peace of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 114 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I allow the perfect peace of Christ to calm my heart in every situation. – Through prayer and supplication I put the strength of God to work. – I do all things with peace. – My living is in the restfulness of peace. – I am a man of peace. – I have the strength and courage for every situation.  – I fix my heart and focus on the Lord today. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 342 - WHAT SHALL SEPARATE YOU?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency WHAT SHALL SEPARATE YOU?"Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?" Romans 8:35 (NKJV) Our salvation is first by the love of Christ. It was the love of Christ that moved Jesus to the cross, not our works.
By His saving grace and loving-kindness, God saved us and brought us into eternal fellowship with Jesus our Lord.
Hearing some brethren talk about losing their salvation and God turning His back on them is interesting. And they allude to God judging them according to their works. Most people judge their relationship with God by the standards of human relations. God made it possible for you to have a family relationship with Him. You can grow your personal relationship with God (through your participation in church meetings, personal prayers, fellowship with the Word and the Spirit etc).
Nevertheless, you are not the sustainer of your relationship with God.
The love of God is the foundation of God’s relationship with you. And it’s kept by the faithfulness of God. By God’s faithfulness, we are brought into fellowship with His Son, Jesus (1 Corinthians 1:9). He forgives you from all wrongs by His faithfulness (1 John 1:9). God, who called you into Himself is faithful to keep you blameless to the end. (1 Thessalonians 5:24). God is faithful to keep you from falling away by His own ability. (Jude 1:24). He didn’t just bring you into Himself, He established you in His life. He emptied His life into you and mingled you with Himself.You were joined unto the Lord through the baptism of the Spirit (1 Corinthians 12:13; Romans 6:3-4;) "But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit with Him." 1 Corinthians 6:17 (NKJV).
Do you get it?
You were not just justified in Christ, you were not just brought into fellowship with the Lord, in that fellowship, you were joined or mingled with the Lord. Now you cannot be separated from His love. You are not just a son of God, you are ONE SPIRIT WITH THE LORD. Oh glory! No wonder Jesus said“I am the vine and you are the branches.” (John 15:5). Listen, you are one with Christ and nothing can separate you from Christ.This must be your persuasion. Look what Paul the apostle wrote in the latter part of Romans 8:"For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor principalities nor powers, nor things present nor things to come, nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.” Romans 8:38-39 (NKJV)
Beloved, you must also have this persuasion that nothing can separate you from the love of Christ.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 8:33-39; Psalm 103:17; Jeremiah 31:3; Songs of Solomon 3:4) WE PRAY- That our faith is established stronger in the Lord and His word that we shall stand firm in the reality of what He has achieved for us in Christ Jesus. - That no challenge, no cosmic force nor thought can make us doubt the reality that we are eternally inseparable from Christ and His love. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Psalm 115 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am mingled with the Lord. – I am in eternal fellowship with the Lord. – No cosmic force can separate us from the love of Christ. – We are persuaded of the love of Christ. – We are deeply rooted in the Lord that nothing can uproot us from Him. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 343 - FOUR CRUCIAL ITEMS FOR A VICTORIOUS YEAR
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Gloreeey!Blessed new year to you beloved reader.This is our year of KINGDOM REFULGENCEAnd our month of IMMERSION.Monday, 1st January, 2024FOUR CRUCIAL ITEMS FOR A VICTORIOUS YEARToday is the first day of this great new year. And you don’t need to wait till the ending of the year before you make the most of every opportunity. You must be intentional with your decisions andchoices. This is why I am sharing these four crucial items with you today:1. Write down your plans plainly“And the LORD answered me: “Write the vision; make it plain on tablets, so he may run who reads it.” Habbakuk 2:2Yes, it's good to keep Divine inspirations to heart. However, you should also write them plainly. Write plainly the things the Lord has inspired you todo in His Kingdom and Ministry, Business and Finance, Academics or Education and Family. Don’t assume you will remember all theinspirations of the Spirit. Whiles you pray or fellowship with the Spirit keep your notes by you. As you read, study and meditate on the scriptures, keep a writing material.2. Get into Prayer.“Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established”. Proverbs 16:3 (NASB)Prayer is not just to be done in January. Prayer must be your daily habit. It must be part of your life and living. Don’t just have one good day of prayer.“Men always ought to pray” (Luke 18:1), “Pray without ceasing” (1 Thess. 5:17).Understand that Prayer is not just to have God to answer your requests; through Prayer you are supplied with grace and ability to do.“We plan the way we want to live, but only Godmakes us able to live it” Proverbs 16:9 (MSG)Through prayer you receive clarity of purpose and also submit the totality of God’s inspirations and ideas to you, back to Him. You put God in charge.(Read Proverbs 16:3 Message Translation).3. Get into Action.“Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action! ” Ezra 10:4 (Berean Study Bible)Those ideas and plans were not to be locked up in your notes as prayer topics. Plans are to be executed. You have to act on the plans as the Lord has given you grace and ability to do. You must act with a sense of urgency. “Now that you know these things, you will beblessed if you do them.” John 13:17 (NIV)4. Maintain Consistency.“And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up” Galatians 6:9Consistently plan, write the ideas, pray and move into action. It takes discipline and diligence to be consistent. This year is a great year for you.Remain Blessed.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 1:6-8; Psalm 119:60; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYThat the Lord will guide our steps as we execute allthat He has inspired us to do. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I put God’s plans and ideas to work.– I have freshability to do what God inspires me to do.– I actdiligently and consistently.Shalom![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 344 - RUN IN HIS COMMAND
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  RUN IN HIS COMMAND "I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart." Psalm 119:32 (Berean Standard Bible). At the beginning of this New Year, the word of the Lord came to you. This word of the Lord to you is God's direction for your life and instructions for your future.
It is important to give it your focus and commit your mind to it.
Within the Christ Commonwealth Community, Global (Love-Life Agency), the Lord has given us a word which is the focus of our Personal lives and Corporate expression. Our year 2024 is the year of: KINGDOM REFULGENCE - It is our year of Kingdom SHINING and SPREADING. - The year of Kingdom raptness, ambience and expressions. This is the commandment of the Lord to you. It is one thing to receive the Word of the Lord, it is another thing to run with the Word of the Lord. Every Word of the Lord to you has its established path. The more you walk in the direction or path of the Word, the more your understanding is deepened and enlarged.
The path of the Word includes the instruction of the Word.
The path of the Word is what brings you into the fulfilment of the Word. By the Word of the Lord to you for the year, you know you have to change your prayer habit, establish better associations and avoid wrong ones. The instruction of the Word also came with an inspiration to give yourself to reading some materials and work towards some daily ministry targets.
You have to esteem those instructions and run by them.
This is a blessed new year and great grace abounds towards you. Shalom! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:31-33; Hebrews 12:1; Psalm 18:36) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow and increase in understanding the paths of the Lord's command. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to the instructions of God for the year. - I focus and run in the path of the Lord's command. - I consecrate my heart and mind to the word of the Lord for the year. - I don't turn away from the instructions no matter the matter. - I stand firmly by the Word and lay aside every weight. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 345 - SERVE GOD'S PURPOSE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 3rd January, 2024SERVE GOD'S PURPOSE"For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay" Acts 13:36 (Majority Standard Bible)Have you ever sat to think of why you came to earth at such a time as this?
Or do you think your birth was a coincidence?
No please!God has an agenda on Earth; and in His agenda or purpose, He has determined to fulfill it through men.All the created things in the heavens were made for earth and the earth was made for the benefit of man.Now what was man made for?
Man was made for God's glory.
"Everyone who is called by My name, Whom I have created for My glory; I have formed him, yes, I have made him.” Isaiah 43:7 (NKJV)God's glory is revealed in the fulfilment of His purpose.
God brought you here in time to fulfill His purpose. Your life is to be lived for God's purpose.
This was the testimony of David.He fulfilled God's purpose in His generation!What will be your testimony at the climax of your days here on earth?What will be said of you in that city, institution, or nation?
Will it be said that you served the purpose of God in your time in that school, that company, that institution and that city?
David knew he was raised to fulfill God's purpose and not His own interests.And God raised David for His purpose. "After removing Saul, He raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart; he will carry out My will in its entirety." Acts 13:22 (Berean Standard Bible)When God raised David, He had a clear testimony of him, that David will carry out ALL OF HIS WILL.
What is God's testimony of you?
God is not raising you for yourself and your family. God is raising you for His WILL.You can't also serve God and at the same time serve your own purpose and the purposes of the world.You can't have two masters.
Let this sink deep into your heart:GOD HAS BEEN RAISING YOU TO SERVE HIS PURPOSE AND WILL IN YOUR GENERATION.
If you have not been living solely to fulfill God's purpose in your generation or time here, sit back and know that He has given you the gift of this New Year or the gift of time or this new day to serve His purpose.Do you spend long hours in prayer because of your needs or because you are taking spiritual steps to win your nation for the Lord or align yourself to increase in capacity for the fulfilment of purpose?This year make a decision to SERVE GOD'S PURPOSE ONLY.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 89:20; Matthew 6:24; John 12:26; Philippians 2:19-22; Matthew 26:39; Hebrews 10:7; Psalm 40:8) WE PRAYThat our hearts and hands will be set to do all of God's will and purpose in our generation unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I set my focus on God's will and set my mind on things above.- I esteem the will and purpose of God- I don't serve my interests. I serve all of God's purposes for me in my generation- I don't give my mind to the things of this world.- I have no other master apart from God.- God's testimony of me is that I am a man after his heart and will serve all His will. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 346 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 4th January, 2024BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 1"The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the deep waters. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters." Genesis 1:2 (NLT).The first time the Holy Spirit was introduced in the scriptures was not in Acts (in the upper room).The first time the Holy Spirit was introduced was in Genesis.However, both incidents reveal how the Lord brings out the best out of nothing.We see in Genesis 1:2, that before God's six days of creation work, the Holy Spirit has to first incubate and saturate the waters for God to bring out light and continue the other creations.
The commands or instructions of the Lord work in an atmosphere soaked by His Spirit.
It doesn't matter how bad the condition is; or the level of weakness within you, the moment the Holy Spirit saturates you, God's best will gush forth.Jesus had ascended; the early Church had the command to go into all the world and make disciples of all the nations. They had the commandment of the Lord to walk in love. Nevertheless, the Lord Jesus knew there was no way His glorious Church would be born without the Holy Spirit.There is no way they can have the ability and boldness to preach the gospel and walk in love without the Holy Spirit. The reality was that, when Jesus ascended, His disciples had zeal but lacked ability. Jesus in their midst was their ability and boldness. Hence, the need for the Holy Spirit."And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance." Acts 2:1-4 (KJV)This seems similar to the impact of the Holy Spirit in creation.Just as the Holy Spirit was hovering over the waters in Genesis; we see the Holy Spirit fill and saturate the house where the disciples were.
This means the disciples were immersed in the glorious presence of the Holy Spirit.
God didn't start His creation work without the overwhelming presence of the Holy Spirit. The Church didn't reach out to their world, until they were filled or immersed in the Holy Spirit.If you are born again in Christ, you have the Holy Spirit in you. However, you must live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit.
Don't start your day without being soaked by the Spirit.
You may have big dreams and great plans for the year; however, without being immersed in the Spirit, you can do nothing.Get intimate with the Holy Spirit and enjoy His overwhelming presence.ShalomDIG DEEPER(Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4) WE PRAY- That our plans and desires will be immersed and soaked in the Spirit.- That nothing we do will be of the flesh but by the influence of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 11-13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. - I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. - I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. - I am not ordinary. - I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 347 - ENGAGE THE PRESENCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 5th January, 2024 ENGAGE THE PRESENCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT “If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever; that is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him, but you know Him because He abides with you and will be in you.”John 14:15-17 (NASB1995)  God didn’t just want to have an outward relationship with you. God wanted to have a deeper inward relationship with you. This is why He comes to indwell you through the Holy Spirit. The thing is, God didn’t come to dwell in you, with a plan or a condition to exit. He came to make His Home in you forever. Which means you are God’s residential address through the Holy Spirit.  God didn’t just indwell you, He made it possible legally. Through the death of Jesus, the old sin nature was terminated or crucified, so that you can receive the new life, which is Christ. (Galatians 2:20). Through Christ’s death and resurrection, you were justified, sanctified and made Holy.
Your body now became the temple of the Holy Spirit.
You were made pure in Christ, that now God can dwell in you. This was not just achieved by God through Christ so that you will practice “religious worship”. God achieved this with the goal of intimacy.
God didn’t want you to know Him by mental assent. He wants you to be in Him and He shall also be in you, to bring you into full experience of His love beyond utterance.
Through Christ’s death, God demonstrated His greatest love towards you. Now, by indwelling you through the Spirit, He seals His love for you.
The Holy Spirit in you is the consummate expression of all that God began in Christ.
Your recognition and engagement of the presence of the Holy Spirit in you is the most beautiful way to enjoy all that Christ has achieved for you. Through the Holy Spirit, God daily makes His love real to you. The Holy Spirit in you is the evidence that God didn’t come to show you one time love through Jesus’ earth walk. He is in you now as the evidence that you can receive, enjoy, experience and share in His love forever.
The Holy Spirit in you is also the continuous supply of the ability of God’s love in your heart.
This means He is in you not only for you to enjoy God’s love, but to make you a dispenser of the Love of God. Now you have the ability to love, to walk with God intimately, and to share the unfathomable unconditional love with others. True intimacy with God doesn’t end when you stand in a “Church auditorium“, with your hands lifted, having tears in your eyes and crying out how you love the Lord. That experience may be real as His love overwhelms your heart. Nevertheless, true intimacy with God is a daily walk. 
The Holy Spirit is not dwelling in you seasonally. He is in you FOREVER!
“…He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever…” John 14:16  You don’t enjoy the love of God annually, or weekly. The Holy Spirit in you, means you have a daily avalanche of the Love of God flowing in your heart forever. Now, to commune with God through prayer should be a restful flow. To fellowship with the Lord and to delight in Him, should be expressed by you organically. To have deep moments of ministering to the Lord and receiving the ministrations of the Lord should be unforceful.
Beloved, the Holy Spirit is in you now. You have the living spring of life within you by which you can fellowship and worship the Lord in spirit and truth.
Worship no longer becomes an act of religious demand. Worship becomes a response to the revelation of God in your heart through the administration of the Holy Spirit. To have the Holy Spirit in you, means you have the source of God’s loving ability. You have what it takes to demonstrate the love of God and the inward evidence to trust the Lord daily.  You have the seal of God’s love and supply in you.  Glory to God!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:18-19; Ephesians 5:2; Jeremiah 31:3; Isaiah 49:15; Zephaniah 3:17; John 4:10-25) WE PRAY- That by the wisdom of God, we shall take advantage of the Holy Spirit in our heart, to demonstrate total trust in the Lord and to share His unfathomable unconditional love with others. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 14 -16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the seal of the Lord upon me. - The love of God is in my heart, therefore, I have the ability to love.  - I have an intimate relationship with God.  - I enjoy and demonstrate the avalanche of God’s love.  - I have a daily communion with God. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 348 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 6th January, 2024BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 2 "I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance, but He who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire." Matthew 3:11 (NKJV) To be BAPTIZED is from the Greek word, "baptizo" which means to be immersed or dipped into. Most people are familiar with water baptism. So whenever they hear of baptism, they think of being dipped into water. Others argue that unless you are baptized into water you are not saved. So what happens to the young lady who believed and received Jesus on a sick bed and "died" the following day? Is that person saved or not? John 3:16 does not demand water baptism. And the scriptures are clear, whoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. (Read Romans 10).
Being baptized into water is not what leads one to salvation. Water baptism is an ordinance which is just the outward declaration of your new birth experience.
When you believed and received Jesus, you were baptized into Christ's body. "For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body..." 1 Corinthians 12:13 (NKJV).
This means that when you got born again, you were baptized into the body of Christ.
There is a further explanation here in Romans 6, where the Apostle Paul, gives a detailed explanation of what happened in baptism : "Or are you ignorant of the fact that all of us who have been baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death? We have therefore been buried with Him through baptism into death, so that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory and power of the Father, we too might walk habitually in newness of life [abandoning our old ways]." Romans 6:3-4 (Amplified Bible) At new birth, you were immersed into Christ. The significance of this immersion is that, when you became born again, your testimony is not only that Jesus died for you. His death wasn't just a substitutionary sacrifice. Your testimony is that, when Jesus died you died with Him, you were buried with Him and now you share in His newness of life. This is the matter of identification. You were completely immersed into Him to live like Him. This means the old you died and now it is the new you that lives. This new you that lives is Christ (Read Galatians 2:20) All of these became our experience by the Spirit of the Lord.
The newness of life which we have is not an isolated life. It is an organic life which is constituted in the Body of Christ by the Spirit of Christ.
To be immersed in the Spirit can be seen in these folds: 1. It is to be baptized or immersed into Christ. This immersion is into Christ's body (which is also the Church) and extensively immersed into His Kingdom. 2. It is also to be filled with the Holy Spirit. Now these two points I have given above don't necessarily happen one after the other. They happen simultaneously. The day you were baptized into the body, you were also baptized with the Spirit. Which is the infilling of the Holy Spirit.  3. The third point is not a one-time experience but a continuous experience. This is the CONTINOUS INFILLING OF THE HOLY SPIRIT. As mentioned in Ephesians 5:18; "Do not get drunk with wine, for that is wickedness (corruption, stupidity), but be filled with the [Holy] Spirit and constantly guided by Him."
Understand that, to be filled with the Holy Spirit here, means to be overflowed, soaked and saturated with the Spirit.
Though everyone in Christ has the Holy Spirit, the degree to which you express or manifest the power of the Spirit is according to the degree by which you are immersed and soaked daily in and with the Spirit. This doesn't suggest that one who is born again, maybe in the Spirit or not.  This is it, at new birth you were born of the Spirit (John 3:6) into the Spirit. Which means you are in the Spirit as you are in Christ. However, since you are in the Spirit continue to be immersed and soaked with the Spirit.
Let the life in the Spirit soak and saturate your heart and mind.
Immerse your thoughts, desires and actions in the Spirit. Hallelujah! ShalomDIG DEEPER(Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19) WE PRAYREPEAT THIS PRAYER WITH MORE PASSION -That our plans and desires will be immersed and soaked in Spirit. - That nothing we do will be of the flesh but by the influence of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 17 - 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. – I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 349 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 3
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 7th January, 2024BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 3"I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance, but He who is coming after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire." Matthew 3:11 (NKJV)We have seen previously that to be BAPTIZED is to be immersed or dipped into.We also looked at the three-fold or aspects of immersion in Christ.1. It is to be baptized or immersed into Christ. This immersion is into Christ's body (which is also the Church) and extensively immersed into His Kingdom.2. It is also to be filled with the Holy Spirit.3. The third point is not a one-time experience but a continuous experience. This is the CONTINOUS INFILLING OF THE HOLY SPIRIT.One may wonder how INFILLING OF THE HOLY SPIRIT relates to immersion.Take a close look at these verses:John the baptist said this about Jesus; "He who is coming after me is mightier than I...He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire." Matthew 3:11 (NKJV)Now Jesus confirmed the words of John the baptist:"And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me. For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence" Acts 1:4-5 (KJV).Now pay attention to the fulfillment of this experience of the Spirit."And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance." Acts 2:1-4 (KJV)Jesus clearly instructed them to assemble and tarry for the baptism of the Holy Spirit. And on the day of Pentecost when the disciples were assembled at the Upper Room they were baptized.Now you will clearly notice that:a. the entire house in which they were sitting was filled.If the house was filled, what happened to the people in the house?Definitely, they will be immersed in that atmosphere of the Spirit.b. As long as the house was filled and they were immersed in it, they also will be filled.Wait a minute...Both John the baptist and our Lord Jesus used the phrase "BAPTIZED WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT". Yet on the day when the Holy Spirit came, Luke (the writer of the book of Acts) used the word "FILLED".Which means to be BAPTIZED also includes the INFILLING of the Holy Spirit.This is an absolute saturation and permeation of the presence of the Holy Spirit.This is not a one-time experience. This has to be your daily life. Just as your expression of the life of Christ is not a one-time moment but a continuous living of the newness of life; even so are we to be continually enriched and soaked by the presence of the Holy Spirit.You have to be drenched and overtaken by the Spirit.A man who is immersed in the Spirit doesn't live by his own might. Such a man does things by the anointing of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit becomes his might and capacity. His results are Holy Spirit directed. An immersed life in the Spirit lived, will cause greater works to abound.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19; Ezekiel 47:1-10) WE PRAYThat the Spirit of the Lord shall fully possess our hearts, saturate our being and will cause our capacity to be enlarged for greater works. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 22 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. – I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 350 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 8th January, 2024 BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 4 "Stop getting drunk with wine, which leads to wild living, but keep on being filled with the Spirit." Ephesians 5:18 (International Standard Version)This year is a glorious year with great visions. There are mighty things the Lord is inspiring you to do. If you have not yet received the inspiration of what to do, definitely you are going to have to set a moment to capture fresh inspirations of the Lord.There is nothing God tells you to do (no matter how little), that is not great. Anything God tells you to do is great.This is why whatever God tells you to do, He works in partnership with you to achieve it. He doesn't instruct you to do something and then He leaves you on your own. He is the only King who sends His messengers and still goes with them to accomplish their duty.This is the work of the Holy Spirit in your life. The Holy Spirit in you, is God indwelling you to walk and work with you.It is up to you to be intentional about your partnership with the Holy Spirit.Don't just wake up to embark on your divine assignment without Him; you must work with the Holy Spirit.Jesus said, "without me you can do nothing" (John 15:5) and this is why He decided to send another Helper (John 14:16). The Holy Spirit is here to help you.In the previous discussion, I established that to be baptized with the Holy Spirit is also to be filled with the Holy Spirit.However, from the opening verse, we see that the infilling of the Holy Spirit is not a one-time event or experience, but a continuous experience."Stop getting drunk with wine, which leads to wild living, but keep on being filled with the Spirit." Ephesians 5:18 (ISV)
Also being filled with the Spirit as a continuous experience is hinted by the phrase "KEEP ON".
Did you notice the two parallel experiences of influence?If you want to know how you should be continuously immersed in the Spirit, see what one looks like when he is immersed in drunkenness.When you KEEP ON being filled with the Spirit your being is influenced and soaked with the Spirit, like how one is influenced and gets drunk by wine.When one gets drunk by wine, his movements, thoughts and speech are influenced by the drunkenness. The same is true with a man immersed in the Spirit.
When you keep on being filled with or immersed in the Spirit, you come under the influence of the Spirit. The Spirit influences your movements, thoughts and speech.
There is a way a man who is immersed in the Spirit daily, thinks and lives.You live according to the power of God. You demonstrate love according to the influence of the Spirit.The love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5).You are not controlled by the lust of the flesh. The power of the love of Christ gains preeminence over the man who is saturated by the Spirit.
Are you immersed in the Spirit or you are immersed in this world?
SelahDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16; 1John 2:6; Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19; Ezekiel 47:1-10) WE PRAYThat we shall continue to live under the influence of the Holy Spirit who is our great HELPER. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 24 - 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. – I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 351 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 9th January, 2024BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 5 "He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk just as He walked." 1 John 2:6 (NKJV)Are you born again?If your answer is yes, then you are in Christ.When you received Jesus, you became born again. The born again is also the new creation.The new creation is the man in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:17)
To be in Christ is to be in the Spirit.
Thus, if you are in Christ, you must live as Christ.When you are thinking of being immersed in the Spirit, don't adopt human techniques and religious methods. As you are in Christ you follow the example of Christ.
The matter of being immersed in the Spirit is not a matter of methods but a new living way.
To be immersed in the Spirit is an organic experience and not mechanical.That is why you follow the example of Christ. Christ brought to light the reality of being soaked and saturated by the Spirit.During Jesus' Earth Walk, the Pharisees or the religious leaders were demonstrating spirituality according to their self-gratification, man-made rules, religious traditions and legalism.Everyone saw them as men who were enriched with divine understanding and had high-level experience in the Spirit.But Jesus said to them, "Making the word of God of no effect through your tradition which you have handed down. And many such things you do" Mark 7:13 (NKJV)
The word of God is organic and cannot find its full expression when mixed with mechanical methods.
To have a real organic experience of the Spirit, you don't follow religious methods.Indisputably, one of the crucial items to make one continuously experience the saturation of the Spirit is PRAYER.However, your understanding and interpretation of prayer really matter.When prayer is only to prove how spiritual one is, the motives become wrong.
The principle of prayer is the principle of intimate communication. Your understanding of this will help you remain consistent in PRAYER.
The Pharisees and the religious leaders prayed to prove their superiority over others. Prayer was showmanship to them.However, Jesus showed us that prayer is basically a communion with God.In most of the recorded prayers of Jesus, you will notice He often referred to God as Father. That was to establish the kind of relationship we are to have with God.God is your Father and you must commune with Him as such. This is the example of Jesus to us. He showed us to walk consistently in the Spirit by maintaining a consistent relationship and communion with God as our Father.
Until you begin to recognise, understand and become conscious that God is your Father, you will always attempt to use mechanisms to connect to God.
Prayer will become a mechanic method and not an organic expression of your relationship with God.You will spend more time with your loving Father, and freely share your burdens with Him. The more you spend time with the Father through prayer (intimate communication), the more the Father's love and presence overwhelm, saturate and soak your heart.
The more you spend time with Him, the more you are immersed into His person and mindset.
Pray to the Father as Jesus did.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16; Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts and minds will be set on the example of Jesus, and that our walk in the Spirit will be according to His light and not religious methods. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 27 - 29 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart and mind is set on the example of Jesus. – My walk in the spirit is according to His light and not any religious methods. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 352 - THE SUPERNATURAL COMMANDMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 10th January, 2024 THE SUPERNATURAL COMMANDMENT "A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another." John 13:34-35 Jesus did not leave His disciples without clear instructions. The instructions of Jesus are life.  He didn’t come to die for us, resurrect and ascend to Heaven without giving us clear commandments. 
Beloved, He gave us the Holy Spirit and He also gave us His commandments.
Most times, we hear people say, we are not “UNDER A LAW…”Then we begin to think we have no Law and commandments. That is not entirely true. Because the Bible never said that. Of course, we are not “UNDER THE LAW OF MOSES” Whenever the Bible says, we are not under the law, it is referring to the LAW OF MOSES.
That law couldn’t bring us into the full expression of God.
In Christ, we have A NEW LAW OF LIFE (Romans 8:2). This law is also the law of Christ (Galatians 6:2). The commandments of Jesus are not the Commandments of Moses.
The commandments of Jesus are not merely demands. The commandments of Jesus also supply us with life and ability.
