The truth is that His commandments are the dispensing of Himself. Let me talk to You: Whatever, Jesus tells you to do is what He has become to you and what He has made you. He doesn’t just demonstrate what He tells you to do. He becomes what He tells you to do in you.Our Lord Jesus doesn’t show you how to live His life externally. He has indwelt you through the Holy Spirit to do what He tells you to do, with you.
You don’t walk in the obedience of His commandments alone. You walk in obedience to His commandments with Him.
Paul said, “Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think anything as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God” 2 Corinthians 3:5 See The Passion Translation: “Yet we don’t see ourselves as capable enough to do anything in our own strength, for our true competence flows from God’s empowering presence”
This is what it is when I say, “The commandments of Jesus are Life”.
He says, “Without me, you can do nothing” (John 15:5). The golden rule of the commandments of Moses is, “Love your neighbour as yourself” This is demanding and limited.
It means the ability to love is issuing out of your love for yourself. And you can only love as far as you love yourself.
How far can you love with this limited ability of love in you? And even until Jesus came, we had not seen the full expression of love. Through Jesus, we saw a whole new civilization of love.  Paul says, “to know the love of Christ which surpasses all knowledge…” Ephesians 3:19.
This means Moses’ commandment of love cannot bring you into full expression of the love of God.
And till today, many are still living by “love your neighbour as yourself”. But Jesus is inviting us to a higher dimension of love. He said,  “ a New” Commandment I give. It means from now onwards you don’t operate by the Mosaic law.  The Lord is saying, I bring you something new. The word for new is “Kainos”, it means freshness, recently made, unused, unworn, unprecedented, uncommon, unheard of.It is not “new” in terms of time, but “new” as to form or quality, of a different nature from what is contrasted as old. It relates to being not previously present; as set over against that which is outworn, the effete or burnt-out through age. Beloved, this New Commandment of love Jesus gave was beyond any human comprehension and experience.
It is a supernatural commandment.
The new commandment of Jesus says: "…as I have loved you, that you also love one another." This love is beyond the domain of men. It is beyond the standard of men. This is a higher standard of love. And no man can meet its demand. This is why God designed it to only be supplied to you by Himself.
This love doesn’t work just by utterance. It works by life. And you cannot wake up one day to just start loving as He has loved you unless you have received Him into you.
The greatest mind couldn’t imagine this love. He Himself has to be the picture of this love.
To walk in this love, you must know more and more the extent to which He has loved you.
“All this is proceeding along lines planned all along by God and then executed in Christ Jesus. When we trust in him, we’re free to say whatever needs to be said, bold to go wherever we need to go. So don’t let my present trouble on your behalf get you down. Be proud! My response is to get down on my knees before the Father, this magnificent Father who parcels out all heaven and earth. I ask him to strengthen you by his Spirit—not a brute strength but a glorious inner strength—that Christ will live in you as you open the door and invite him in. And I ask him that with both feet planted firmly on love, you’ll be able to take in with all followers of Jesus the extravagant dimensions of Christ’s love. Reach out and experience the breadth! Test its length! Plumb the depths! Rise to the heights! Live full lives, full in the fullness of God.” Ephesians 3:11-19 (The Message) Glory to God!DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:9-10; John 15:12,13,17) WE PRAYThat we will comprehend the love of Christ which surpasses knowledge. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Genesis 30 - 32 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The love of Christ floods my heart.  - I have Christ’s ability to love.  - I walk in love.  - I grow in the incomprehensible love of Christ.  - I experience the fullness of God’s love in all matters.  - My understanding is deepened in the love of Christ. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 353 - STAY LONG WITH GOD - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 11th January, 2024STAY LONG WITH GOD - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 6"Now at this time Jesus went off to the mountain to pray, and He spent the whole night in prayer to God." Luke 6:12 (Amplified) Have you given attention to the beauty of Jesus' ministry? Do you think the miracles just happened because He walked on earth as fully God.His Divinity is undeniable, yet Jesus was also fully Man and showed us how men should commune with God to express divine glory.Previously we saw this scripture: "He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk just as He walked." 1 John 2:6 (NKJV) Glory to God.
As you are in Christ, don't just admire His glory and wish to manifest that glory; walk as He did.
This means the things Jesus did are the things you must do to have the Jesus kind of results. I explained previously that; the matter of being immersed in the Spirit is not a matter of methods but the new living way.To be immersed in the Spirit is an organic experience and not mechanical.That is why you must follow the example of Christ. 
Jesus didn't manifest glory just because He was divine, He manifested glory because He engaged organic items which enabled Him to unleash glory.
The scriptures make you see things others don't see. For example, when one thinks of Jesus walking on water, one may think that the miracle just happened because it was Jesus. Not really... The miracle of Jesus happened when He was returning from the place of prayer. Am I saying without coming from the place of prayer you cannot work the miraculous?
Pay attention closely, NO ONE WORKED GREAT MIRACLES IN THE KINGDOM WITHOUT BEING PRAYERFUL, NOT ONE!
And through the scriptures, we see the behind-the-scenes of Jesus' life. When people looked at Jesus, they saw; a miracle worker, a great healer and began to wonder how He did those things. But through the scriptures, we see a PRAYERFUL Jesus. We see that He was one who stayed long hours in the Lord's presence. Jesus did nothing without prayer. And Jesus spake a parable unto them to this end, that "men ought always to pray, and not to faint". (Luke 18:1) (Take time to read the whole chapter of Luke 18, where Jesus explained, persistence in prayer).
Jesus demonstrated great faith and power because He knew how to stay in the place of prayer. He didn't just teach about prayer, He was given to long prayers.
From the opening verse of this episode, you will see how Jesus spent the whole night in prayer. He didn't just pray, He spent long hours in prayer. And as I have told you before, the principle of prayer is the principle of intimate communication. 
Prayer is not just a moment of making demands. Prayer is a matter of communing with God.
You don't pray only because you have something to tell God. You create time to pray mainly because you want to spend time with God.
The more you stay long with God, the more you are immersed in His presence. 
Great strength is dispensed when you stay long with God in deep fellowship. "Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter." Matthew 26:40 (Berean Standard Bible). The disciples couldn't continue with Jesus even for an hour. Don't join those who make excuses that "it is not how long you pray but how well you pray". What about how well you pray long?
I tell you this, those who spend more time with God in prayer access the depths of God's plans and purposes.
Starting from today select times to continue long hours in prayer. Also, make plans not only to pray 3 hours or 4 hours. Plan times when you will pray 6 hours, 12 hours or even 16 hours. Yes, you can continue in prayer for even 24 hours. Jesus prayed the whole night.
How long have you stayed with God today in prayer?
Don't say you don't have time, MAKE THE TIME TO PRAY! This will lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29) WE PRAYWe pray that we exercise wisdom and discipline to avoid every hindrance which leads to prayerlessness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2023Genesis 33 - 35 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. - I don't compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. - I am given to prayer.  - I stay long in prayers. - I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 354 - STAY LONG WITH GOD 2 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 12th January, 2024 STAY LONG WITH GOD 2 - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 7 "Now at this time Jesus went off to the mountain to pray, and He spent the whole night in prayer to God." Luke 6:12 (Amplified)Whatever God has put in your heart to achieve will be done according to His own ability.Your human strength is not enough for what God has called you to do.The Angel said to Mary, "For with God nothing is ever impossible and no word from God shall be without power or impossible of fulfillment." Luke 1:37 (AMPC)The projects ahead of you which seem impossible, become possible when God is with you.
As a man in Christ, God is with you, however, you must intentionally be with God as well in all you do.
Make intentional decisions to pray and to minister unto the Lord.Though God loves you and wants to partner with you to achieve His dreams for you, He wouldn't force His partnership on you. You have to intentionally engage the Lord. He may put desires in your heart to draw you close to Himself, and He will put subtle longings of fellowship into your heart. This is to lead you into times of fellowship with Him. And when you become prompt to respond and to be consistent with it, your inward capacity and abilities expand for big things.
Develop the habit of spending time with God patiently. Don't rush out of the place of prayer and fellowship with the Spirit.
 You can only have the best of each relationship when you are willing to invest time.Jesus our Lord, showed us the need for consistent communion with the Father, as I mentioned in the previous episode.Jesus started His ministry by first staying in fellowship with the Father, for 40 days and 40 nights.What was He doing?Praying and communing with the Father.
Jesus didn't start His ministry without first having a long session of communion with the Father.
How are you starting your year?Don't leave things to chance, spend long hours of fellowship with the Spirit. He has the master plan for the year and each month. He knows the steps you have to take and the people you have to meet. He knows the resources you need to do what He has destined you to do. Stay long with Him.The vision of God was made clear and also intensified in the heart of Moses after he separated himself to be with the Lord for 40 days and 40 nights.When Moses returned He was soaked with a dimension of God's glory to the extent that the skin of his face changed."But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and whenever he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded, the sons of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone. So Moses would replace the veil over his face until he went in to speak with Him.” (Exo 34:34-35 NAS)
The more you stay long with God, the more you are immersed in His presence and His word shines in your heart.
It is great to have quality time with the Lord. However, to have a long quantity and quality of time with the Lord is the most treasured moment in your life.In this present age of speed, everyone is in haste. They want to get into prayer, blast in 5-minute tongues and expect to receive or download immeasurable eternal virtues.In a world of fast food, fast internet, video reels, shorts, recaps, quick rise to fame, highly fast vehicles, fast computers, and swift money transfer mediums, people have become more impatient.People easily get offended and displeased, when they are not seeing answers to prayers as fast as they want. They become agitated and tensed easily. Frowns at God and the spiritual principles, just as they frown and hit on their mobile devices when an app doesn't open between a microsecond to 2 seconds.Everyone is interested in fast-charging cables for their batteries.Thus, to stay 5 hours or 16 hours in prayers and communion with the Lord, seems to be a waste of time to most people of this generation. Everyone seems to be in a hurry.People are in haste to please the world and not in haste to please the Father.Beloved, take your time, and patiently stay in communion with the Holy Spirit.This is how you can mount up high with wings as an Eagle.  
If you don't want to faint in the journey of your destiny, learn to stay long in fellowship with the Lord.
Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29) WE PRAYWe pray to increase in patience to stay and enjoy divine virtues and verities in the Lord's presence, as we commune with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 36 - 38 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 355 - GROW DEEPER - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 8
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 13th January, 2024GROW DEEPER - BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 8"It was the Lord’s Day, and I was worshiping in the Spirit. Suddenly, I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet blast." Revelation 1:10 (NLT)Beloved, understand that, there are deep rich things in God. To access these things you must grow deep into God.Have you heard the phrase, "Go deeper" while one is preaching?They usually mean"say something strange we have not heard before."
Interestingly, the deep things of God are the simple things in God people don't esteem.
For example, Jesus in His earth walk, was the full revelation of God. Yet, some of the Jews just saw a carpenter's son.Until God opens your heart and eyes to see the riches of His wisdom in the simple things, you will see them as foolishness.Essentially one doesn't "go deeper" whiles preaching. Rather, you grow deeper in your relationship and communion with God.The matter of depths is a matter of intimacy with the Spirit. It is a matter of being immersed in the Spirit. To be immersed in the Spirit is to be immersed in the revelation of His person and the richness of His wisdom.
The more you are immersed in God's Spirit, the more you are able to see through Him.
The expression "in the Spirit" in this context is used about four times by John in the book of Revelation alone (1:10; 4:2; 17:3; 21:10). And at each time, you will realize John's eyes were opened to see or to catch a revelation.
The realm of the Spirit is the realm of visions.
This is it, the Spirit knows all the deep things of God. (1 Corinthians 2:10). The more you commune with Him, the more He brings insight and revelations to your heart.Jesus said, "But when the truth-giving Spirit comes, He will unveil the reality of every truth within you. He won’t speak His own message, but only what He hears from the Father, and He will reveal prophetically to you what is to come." John 16:13 (TPT)When John said, "I was in the Spirit", what he meant wasn't what Jesus meant in John 4:23;"But the hour is coming, and is now here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father is seeking such people to worship him." John 4:23 (ESV).In John 4:23, Jesus was addressing the New Testament worship. In the New Testament worship, the revelation is Jesus and not a Jewish location. To worship in spirit and in truth, is to worship according to the faith and knowledge of Jesus Christ and not according to Jewish customs.Paul, the apostle, explains it clearly here:"For we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God and glory in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh" Philippians 3:3 (ESV).This means, you don't worship God by going to Mount Gerizim or the Temple of Jerusalem, but by faith in Christ Jesus.That is the new and living way.
When you become born again, you worship the Lord by faith in Christ Jesus. The day you got born again, and came into Christ, you became a true worshipper.
Which means, every new creation in Christ worships the Father in Spirit.And as I have also mentioned before, to be in Christ is to be in the Spirit.The new man in Christ is already in the Spirit. Yours is to have the consciousness that you are already in the Spirit. You are there 24/7 (24hours, 7days). And you don't come out of the  spirit, to re-enter. The spirit realm, is your realm and dwelling.
As you are in the spirit already, you can be intentional with the things of the spirit which causes you to ascend in the spirit.
The deeper you grow in the spirit, the more you ascend. There are intentional things that bring you into a higher captivated realm of the Spirit.That was John's experience as he wrote the book of Revelation.John wasn't just sitting or sleeping or lying down. There was an inward engagement or communion with the Spirit.
In moments of deep intimacy with the Spirit your heart ascends into Him.
One of the things which brings you into deep communion with the Holy Spirit is ministering to the Lord. Ministering to the Lord is a dimension of deep spiritual meditation and honor of God. It is the revere of God and His glory.Make it a daily practice to minister unto the Lord. As you pray in the Spirit, meditate on His person according to the revelation of the Word of His Grace and sing spiritual songs to Him with your hands lifted up.
Enjoy the beauty of His presence as He overwhelms you with His light. At such moments, you will find yourself awed by His sobering ambience and you may sob with an unusual joy by His loving gaze upon your heart.
As you are reading this, just lift your hands, speak in the Spirit, meditate on the love of Christ and minister unto the Lord.Enjoy the depths of the Holy Spirit right nowShalom!Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29; Ezekiel 8:2-3) WE PRAYThat our hearts will not be soaked by the flesh, but that we shall grow deeper in our communion with Holy Spirit as He opens our eyes to great visions of our destiny in the Kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 39 - 42 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow deeper in my communication with the Holy Spirit. – I minister to the Lord daily. – As I minister unto the Lord I am empowered. – My strength is in ministering unto the Lord. – I permit nothing to distract me from ministering unto the Lord daily. – Whether in prayer, worship or praise, I minister unto the Lord with my hands lifted up. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 356 - YOU HAVE A COURSE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 14th January, 2024YOU HAVE A COURSE“Then they left the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the name. And every_day, in the temple and from house to house, they did not cease teaching and preaching that the Christ is Jesus” Acts 5:41-42 As we are discussing the matter on BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT, I would want to remind you of this as well.
How do you take persecution and mockery for being a disciple of Jesus?
How do you take the challenges that confront you just because you are born again? “If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you. If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.” John 15:18-21 (KJV)
Beloved as long as you are in Christ and you stand for the name of the Lord, you will be opposed.
You will not be loved by this world. You will be mocked and be told the Church has taken all your time or you’re wasting your time with this Jesus thing.
It is not new.
Isn’t it funny that people don’t complain bitterly when you are engaged in things that don’t build your life? When you spend all your time under the control of this “unemployment-driven schooling system”, they would clap for you. Being in Church is being in a school as well because you are raised to understand the purpose, the plan and the pursuit of life as designed by God.
And as a fellow in Christ, you should as well make time for your education in Christ.
Through the Church, you are trained to go out there to influence your world and also teach others.
You have a course and it’s CHRIST!
Therefore, learn and teach Christ. The world wouldn’t understand this, and you are not to allow yourself to be a victim of their ignorance. What is your reaction when you feel dishonoured because of the gospel of our Lord Jesus? Do you rejoice or regret serving the Lord? Beloved, the true disciples of Jesus, take delight in serving Him and announcing Him irrespective of the opposition. ”So they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for His name.” Acts 5:41 (NKJV)
Understand this, there is nothing in this world designed for your advantage as a Member of the Body of Christ.
Everything is designed to oppose your faith in Christ. “Do not be surprised, brothers, that the world hates you.” 1 John 3:13 (ESV). Until you make a decision to create an important space of time in your 24 hours for the LORD’S AGENDA, you will end up doing nothing for the Lord.
Be driven by the desire of the LORD.
Anything apart from the LORD will be shaken and passed away.Stand up for JESUS and His Kingdom, for it cannot be shaken and it's forever more. “whose voice shook the earth at that time; but now He has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also heaven.” And this, “Yet once more,” signifies the removing of the things being shaken, as having been created, so that the things not being shaken should remain. Therefore, receiving a kingdom not to be shaken, we may have grace, by which we may serve God well pleasingly, with fear and reverence.For also, our God is a consuming fire.” Hebrews 12:26-29 (Berean Literal Bible). Be involved in the business of the Kingdom every day of your life.Be vocal about Jesus. Teach Him and Preach Him everywhere.Don’t say, “I am shy”.Don’t say “I am busy”.Don’t say “If I preach they will laugh at me.”Don’t say, “I will preach next week”.Don’t say, “I will preach tomorrow.”Don’t say, “I will preach when I am free and I feel like it”.Don’t say, “Here, they don’t want to hear the gospel so I wouldn’t preach”."Preach the word of God. Be prepared, whether the time is favorable or not." 2 Timothy 4:2 (NLT)Don’t say, “My work is to finance the gospel, not to preach.”Don’t say, “I will wait for a special day of outreach.”Don’t say, “I came here to this office for money, so let me make my money and go.”
Precious one, wherever you find yourself, it is the Lord who has sent you there for His purpose.
“But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and through us spreads and makes evident everywhere the sweet fragrance of the knowledge of Him.” 2 Corinthians 2:14 (Amplified Bible) Make Him known. Announce Jesus. Tell all about His wondrous works. "But you should keep a clear mind in every situation. Don’t be afraid of suffering for the Lord. Work at telling others the Good News, and fully carry out the ministry God has given you" 2 Timothy 4:5 (NLT) Be driven by His love and be intentional to bear kingdom fruits. Declare the power of His resurrection, and make men know how they are justified and how they are loved by the Lord. Let them see the beauty of the gospel. This is how you expand the kingdom. The “early Church” preached and taught the name of Jesus, EVERYDAY! I am not talking about you inviting people to church, or preaching to someone who already attends another Church. Win a soul for JESUS. Talk to someone who is not born again.Get someone saved for God desires that all men shall be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. (1 Timothy 2:4)
Have you preached Jesus, today?
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 28:19; Ezekiel 20:41; 1 Corinthians 9:15-17; Romans 1:14; Matthew 5:11;10:39;1 Peter 4:14, 16) WE PRAYThat the Lord will give us boldness, patience and utterance that we may spread the news of Jesus to get many saved. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 43 - 44 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not moved by persecution. – I preach the gospel and declare the power of the resurrection of Jesus. – Because my gospel is not in vain by Jesus’ resurrection, I preach with joy and boldness. – I am relentless soul winner. – I minister Christ and fulfill the ministry He has entrusted into my hand. – I don’t live as a victim of the world.  – I belong to an unshakable kingdom. – I am not afraid of persecution. – I do the work of an evangelist. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 357 - GROW DEEPER 2- BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 9
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 15th January, 2024 GROW DEEPER 2- BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 9"God’s wisdom is something mysterious that goes deep into the interior of his purposes. You don’t find it lying around on the surface. It’s not the latest message, but more like the oldest—what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene." 1 Corinthians 2:8 (MSG)A man who communes with the Holy Spirit has access to the riches of the Wisdom of God.
No one immersed in God and His wisdom struggles to make the right decisions at any point in life.
There is no confusion in a man who has handled the depths of divine wisdom. Deep understanding is granted to a man who continues to behold the Lord.You will never find God's wisdom by surfing around. You access God's wisdom in the depths of His heart.
You must develop the habit of staying long in your communion with God.
The more you continue to stay longer, the more you are enriched with the influences of the Spirit.STAY LONG! DON'T RUSH.To some, staying long in the place of prayer and communion with the Lord is tedious work.Whatever and whoever you love takes your time and attention effortlessly.As you are struggling to stay in the place of prayer and ministering to the Lord, are you sure the Love of God is kindled in your heart?
Communing with God is an unforceful rhythm when it is centered on the love of God.
The Holy Spirit is the best partner for the fulfilment of your destiny.And even "the Spirit of God, not content to flit around on the surface, dives into the depths of God, and brings out what God planned all along" 1 Corinthians 2:10 (MSG).He searches all things diligently, even the profound depths of God.This means, having the Holy Spirit in you doesn't mean you automatically handle the depths of God. You must also dive and search deeply into the heart of the Spirit, to glean the riches of His wisdom.There are things concerning your life which God has set in Himself long before you arrived on the scene. And as you commune with the Spirit, He grants you access and mastery into things God has already designed for you.
Stop being satisfied with the sand bathing. Go beyond the shores of the Spirit, and dive deep into the ocean of the Spirit to experience and enjoy the wisdom of God.
No king can rule and exercise dominion without a dimension of wisdom."God conceals the revelation of his word in the hiding place of his glory. But the honor of kings is revealed by how they thoroughly search out the deeper meaning of all that God says. The heart of a king is full of understanding, like the heavens are high and the ocean is deep." Proverbs 25:2-3 (TPT)You are called to lead your generation and, therefore increase in understanding."Like the horizons for breadth and the ocean for depth, the understanding of a good leader is broad and deep." Proverbs 25:3 (MSG).There are divine depths of wisdom which may not be understood by books. You only come to the understanding of it by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit."We don’t have to rely on the world’s guesses and opinions. We didn’t learn this by reading books or going to school; we learned it from God, who taught us person-to-person through Jesus, and we’re passing it on to you in the same firsthand, personal way." 1 Corinthians 2:13 (MSG).
There is an understanding that comes to you only in communion with the Lord.
Dive deeper into the Lord through fellowship with the Holy Spirit.Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29; Ezekiel 8:2-3; Daniel 2:16-30) WE PRAYThat our hearts will delve deep into God and access the depths of wisdom and understanding concerning all that is needed for the fulfilment of purpose and the refulgence of His kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 45 - 47 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow deeper in my communication with the Holy Spirit. – I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 358 - GROW DEEPER 3- BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 10
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 16th January, 2024 GROW DEEPER 3- BE IMMERSED IN THE SPIRIT 10"God’s wisdom is something mysterious that goes deep into the interior of his purposes. You don’t find it lying around on the surface. It’s not the latest message, but more like the oldest—what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene." 1 Corinthians 2:8 (MSG)Are you here for the first time?There are a lot I have shared on this platform; make time to read other episodes and meditate on them.If you have been following this teaching (Be Immersed in the Spirit), then make time to meditate on them. Move into action, and make these virtues shared here your habit.
Making time to pray and ministering unto the Lord cannot be overemphasised.
As l mentioned earlier, there are divine depths of wisdom which may not be understood by reading books. You only come to the understanding of it by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit.Am I denying the relevance of books? Certainly not.Daniel understood by books (Daniel 9:2).Jesus read, and the apostles also did.We behold the Wisdom of God through the scriptures and the epistles as well.
However, through your communion with the Holy Spirit, you contact the life and the Spirit of the words spoken.
Through communion with the Spirit, the Lord speaks to you person to person.There are secrets and insights the Lord brings to you by revelation.Daniel the Prophet, understood by books, however, when he had to tell and interpret the dream of King Nebuchadnezzar, he and his companions decided to pray to God."Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation. Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon. Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven." Daniel 2:16-19 (KJV)
When you make time to speak to God, He will show you things you do not know (Jeremiah 33:3).
And also concerning Moses who spent 40 days and 40 nights with God; he returned with a heavenly pattern of the Tabernacle, priesthood designs and ordinances.Beyond the introduction of the "Old Covenant", Moses received instructions on healthy living, health methods, food management, etc. No wonder, he saw the commandments of the Lord as life and not legalistic codes. (Deuteronomy 32:44-47)He received insight into the beginning of time. It will only take divine revelation and inspiration to have such hindsight into God's creation work.The events in the book of Genesis took place many centuries before Moses was born. The details of Genesis transcend his exposure to historical materials in Egypt and Oral history from learned men (as others claim).Certain details in Genesis will only be by revelation.Elihu said, “I thought age should speak, and a multitude of years should teach wisdom. “But there is [a vital force and] a spirit [of intelligence] in man,And the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding." Job 32:7-8 (Amplified)
Beloved you have the Holy Spirit in you and with you, be immersed in Him through prayer and fellowship; your heart will be inspired with understanding into unsearchable verities.
Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29; Ezekiel 8:2-3; Daniel 2:16-30) WE PRAYThat the Lord will breathe His rich verities of wisdom and understanding into our hearts this day. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 48 - 50 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I immerse in the Holy Spirit through prayer and fellowship, my heart is inspired with understanding into unsearchable verities. - I grow deeper in my communication with the Holy Spirit. - I have special insight and wisdom because I daily immerse myself in the Spirit. - I make time daily to immerse myself deep in the Spirit through prayer. - I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. - I have the patience to stay long in prayers. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 359 - IMMERSE YOUR DESIRES INTO GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 17th January, 2024 IMMERSE YOUR DESIRES INTO GOD"Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart". Psalm 37:4 (NKJV)Mostly when it comes to our relationship with God, the focus has always been on the "spirit of a man". You hear people make statements like "To connect deeply to God, it is not about your emotions..."
Our relationship with God involves our entire being.
God wants you to be soaked and saturated in all of your being.
God didn't design your emotions for earthly activities; He gave you emotions as tools to express His impressions.
The focus of your emotion or desire exposes the pleasure of your heart.God is interested in the focus of your emotions or the delight of your heart. And you have to train your emotions or desires to be focused on the Lord. 
Don't isolate your emotions or desires from the Lord.
Delight yourself in the Lord!David said, "Here’s the one thing I crave from God, the one thing I seek above all else: I want the privilege of living with him every moment in his house, finding the sweet loveliness of his face, filled with awe, delighting in his glory and grace. I want to live my life so close to him that he takes pleasure in my every prayer."We have looked at staying long and growing deeper in fellowship with the Lord; understand that until you also set your desire on the Lord, your fellowship will not be organic.What you crave after is a deep-seated impression of your emotions.
Don't disconnect your emotions or desires from the Lord. In your communion with the Lord carry your emotions along.
Until your emotions consistently gravitate towards the Lord, you will not be wholly addicted to the fellowship of the Spirit.There is no absolute immersion in the Spirit when the treasures of your desires are focused on the pleasures of this world.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Mark 12:30; Job 22:26; Job 27:10; Psalm 69:9; John 2:17; Psalm 73:25; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYThat our desires shall be saturated with the intense desire of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't isolate my emotions from the Lord. - My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. - My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. - My delight is in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 360 - IMMERSE YOUR DESIRES INTO GOD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 18th January, 2024 IMMERSE YOUR DESIRES INTO GOD 2"Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart". Psalm 37:4 (NKJV)The Lord did not give you your emotions to guide you. Your emotions are measuring instruments of your soul. It helps you ascertain the frequency of your impressions of a matter.
Don't allow your emotions to lead you.
Your emotion or the deep seat of your desire has been exposed to the corruptibility of the flesh before you got born again.The flesh has always had its way of governing or influencing the soul of a man. A man's soul includes the will, the mind and the emotions. For you to express God, your mind must be renewed by the word, your will must submit to God's will and your emotions must be immersed and trained with the deep desires of God.This is the work of the Holy Spirit and the Word of God."For the Word that God speaks is alive and full of power [making it active, operative, energizing, and effective]; it is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating to the dividing line of the breath of life (soul) and [the immortal] spirit, and of joints and marrow [of the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and sifting and analyzing and judging the very thoughts and purposes of the heart." Hebrews 4:12 (AMPC)Every part of your being has its own intelligence. From your spirit, through to your soul, to the physical parts of your body and even to the smallest cell within you has its own intelligence.
When the word of God permeates your entire being as you continuously meditate on it, it nourishes and also cultivates the intelligence of your entire being.
This is why meditation is important. Meditation is not just a matter of thinking about something. Through meditation, you are immersed into a particular thought pattern. Meditation creates within you a deep and lasting impression.
Through meditation, you are able to repeat a certain line of thought in your heart.
"Repetition is the law of deep and lasting impressions."
Every single person is involved in meditation one way or the other.
There is always a line of thought you are repeatedly exposing your mind, your will and emotions to.And the more you expose your heart to these thoughts, the more they become the impressions of your emotions. And the more you exercise or give yourself to certain passions the more they rule and drive your reactions.This is why God is interested in the focus of your emotions or your heart's delight.
The more you meditate on the love of God and cultivate your heart to express that love, the more it dominates your passions.
The reason most people are quick to spend time watching a Hollywood movie, Bollywood movie or an African movie is how they have trained the desires of their heart.The more you give your time and attention to something the more you create deep cravings for it in your heart.This is why when you have to pray, there is always a fight within your entire being. Deep within your spirit, there is the prompting to pray. Your mind is aware of the benefits of prayer, yet your will is struggling between the craving of your flesh and the prompting of your spirit.
It will amaze you to know that the craving of your flesh travels through the impressions of your emotions. Your flesh uses the force of the desires hewn from your emotions to influence your actions.
Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Mark 12:30; Job 22:26; Job 27:10; Psalm 69:9; John 2:17; Psalm 73:25; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYWe pray declaring our emotions to be expressed according to the light of the word of God. And not by the passions of the flesh. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t isolate my emotions from the Lord. – My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – I am not led by my emotions. – My delight is in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 361 - BE IMMERSED IN THE ZEAL OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 19th January, 2024 BE IMMERSED IN THE ZEAL OF GOD"For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me." Psalm 69:9 (KJV)How far do you want to see the work of God prosper?The fulfilment of God's vision is not by how you wish to see it happen but by how you are determined to see its accomplishment.
Most people think zeal is just a religious posture. However, the great visions of God are not worked out without zeal.
There are some who think zeal is not needed. They conclude that zeal does not bring salvation. Salvation is in believing and receiving Jesus. Thus, one can have zeal and not be saved.Nevertheless, everyone saved in Christ needs the zeal of God to execute divine assignments.
The Lord performs His plans according to His zeal.
"For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.Of the increase of his government and peace, there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even forever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this." Isaiah 9:6-7 (KJV)Zeal basically means a strong burning passion. It is the agreed energy of the emotions, the will and the mind to accomplish a task. In Greek, zeal is derived from the word "zelos", which is to be zealous. This means to have an “ardor or fervor of spirit.” it is an energy and enthusiasm about one’s conviction.It is the same word for fervency. The word fervent is from the Latin word, "fervens", which means to BOIL.This was the difference between Paul the apostle and some other believers. A man with a strong zeal will accomplish more than the one lagging.No wonder he said to the brethren in Rome:"Do not be slothful in zeal, be fervent in spirit, serve the Lord" Romans 12:11 (ESV)Read it in the The Passion Translation:"Be enthusiastic to serve the Lord, keeping your passion toward Him boiling hot! Radiate with the glow of the Holy Spirit and let Him fill you with excitement as you serve Him".
 To have the zeal or to be fervent is to be quickened with a burning passion or to boil for something.
What are you boiling for?Don't be boiling for fornication.Don't be boiling to steal that jewel which doesn't belong to you.Don't be boiling for the nude video.Channel that passion or strong desire towards the LORD'S WORK.Have that burning desire to please the Lord. Channel your passionate ardor towards the pursuit of the expansion of the Kingdom of God.Beloved, to have zeal is to have an eagerness or desire to accomplish or obtain something.
Don't use that zeal to please your selfish interest. Use it to accomplish that task which brings glory to God.
What are you burning for?What has consumed your boiling desire?When you make Jesus and His Kingdom the focus of your boiling desire, you will do extraordinary things for the Lord.You may not be doing great things for the Lord because your boiling desire is not towards the Lord.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 18:25; Colossians 4:12-13; John 2:17; Psalm 119:139; 2 Corinthians 8:16; 2 Corinthians 7:7,12; Acts 22:3; Acts 20:24) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that our hearts and actions will be consumed by the boiling passion or earnest zeal of the Lord to accomplish our assignment in Christ BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. - My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. - I set my affection on the Lord and His vision. - I dare to do great things for the Lord. - I give my mind to the meditation of the word. - I am not led by my emotions. - I am zealous about doing great things for the Lord. - I am zealous about my divine mandate. - I am zealous about the salvation of others. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 362 - BE IMMERSED IN THE ZEAL OF GOD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 20th January, 2024 BE IMMERSED IN THE ZEAL OF GOD 2"For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me." Psalm 69:9 (KJV)Beloved, your zeal defines the intensity by which you handle Kingdom responsibilities.From yesterday, we noticed that the Lord Himself performs His plans according to His zeal.I also gave a more detailed explanation of what Zeal is; however, zeal is basically a strong burning or boiling passion. Your zeal towards God's work is intensified when you train yourself to commune with the Lord and to immerse your emotions, will and mind in the Lord.
You cannot be effective in your service of the Kingdom without the zeal of the Lord.
"Be enthusiastic to serve the Lord, keeping your passion toward Him boiling hot! Radiate with the glow of the Holy Spirit and let Him fill you with excitement as you serve Him". Romans 12:11 (TPT)
The level at which you are immersed in the zeal of the Lord will determine how you pursue the excellence of God's will.
There is a way God wants His work to be done. When your heart is boiling with the passion to see Kingdom success, you cannot entertain complacency.There are some who think they don't have burning passion or zeal for anything at all.That's not really true.Everyone has a zeal for something.There is no one without zeal.Some have zeal towards someone they want to marry. Others have a zeal towards drugs. Some have an unquenchable zeal towards the football club they support.Some have zeal towards the religious group they belong.People can zealously kill for something.Zeal is the boiling passion within a man's heart. Zeal in itself doesn't know what is right or wrong.
Zeal gravitates towards the interest or focus of your heart.
Paul persecuted the Church because of his assumed zeal for God and the Jewish traditions. He didn't know he was using his zeal to persecute God's people. (Philippians 3:6).There are people who are zealous towards their family interests, academic interests, and the interests of their company and care little about the Kingdom of God. Is it wrong to genuinely care for your family, academic and company interests?Certainly not.However, as one who is in the Kingdom, the interest of the Kingdom must come first.  Your zeal must gravitate towards the refulgence and spreading of the Kingdom.
What can you sacrifice for the Kingdom of God?
When your zeal burns towards the growth and excellence of the Kingdom, you will not be complacent in any way. You will not procrastinate, neither will you sit on the fence. You will take initiatives. The zeal of the Lord will drive you not to only have a sense of responsibility, but to take responsibility.When the Jews had lost their sense of zeal towards the purpose of the temple, they allowed the temple to become a religious shopping mall instead of what it was meant for."As he went into the temple courtyard, he noticed it was filled with merchants selling oxen, lambs, and doves for exorbitant prices, while others were overcharging as they exchanged currency behind their counters. So Jesus found some rope and made it into a whip. Then he drove out every one of them and their animals from the courtyard of the temple, and he kicked over their tables filled with money, scattering it everywhere! And he shouted at the merchants, “Get these things out of here! Don’t you dare make my Father’s house into a center for merchandise!” That’s when his disciples remembered the Scripture: “I am consumed with a fiery passion to keep your house pure!” John 2:14-17 (TPT).The Jewish leaders didn't care what was done with the temple. They were complacent to see to the fulfilment of the purpose of God. However, Jesus felt otherwise.He couldn't stand to watch the corruption of the purpose of the temple.He had a burning passion for God's house. He was ready to put His life on the line just to enforce the will of God.
Culture your heart to burn with zeal towards God's assignment. 
You remain blessed.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 18:25; Colossians 4:12-13; John 2:17; Psalm 119:139; 2 Corinthians 8:16; 2 Corinthians 7:7,12; Acts 22:3; Acts 20:24)  WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall cultivate His earnest care for His kingdom in our hearts. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – I set my affection on the Lord and His vision. – I dare to do great things for the Lord. – I give my mind to the meditation of the word. – I am not led by my emotions. – I am zealous about doing great things for the Lord. – I am zealous about my divine mandate. – I am zealous about the salvation of others. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 363 - BE IMMERSED IN THE ZEAL OF GOD 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 21st January, 2024 BE IMMERSED IN THE ZEAL OF GOD 3"For I can testify on their behalf that they have a zeal for God, but it is not in keeping with full knowledge." Romans 10:2 (ISV)We have seen the need for the zeal of God and have observed some examples of zeal in the previous episodes.However, one of the crucial things to understand is that zeal by itself doesn't know what is right or wrong.
To have zeal or to be fervent, is to be quickened with burning passion or to boil for something.
Everyone has a zeal for something, whether good or bad. It is up to you to understand what is attracting the investment of your zeal.Paul the apostle, was burning with so much zeal for the Jewish traditions and aggressively persecuted the Church.He sincerely thought he was doing the right thing for God; he later got to know he was persecuting God Himself (Acts 9:4).He made a bold decision to destroy God's work through the Church.You can be ignorantly zealous. And that wouldn't help you achieve any great results. Zeal without knowledge is chaotic.
To have zeal without knowledge is to have a misguided zeal. The right knowledge provides the right direction to zeal.
That is why you have to consistently submit to proper training. It is not just about being immersed in the zeal of God. It is intrinsically about being immersed in zeal with the right knowledge of God.See the story of Apollos:"Meanwhile, there was a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, who came to Ephesus. He was a cultured and eloquent man, well-versed and mighty in the Scriptures. He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and burning with spiritual zeal, he spoke and taught diligently and accurately the things concerning Jesus, though he was acquainted only with the baptism of John. He began to speak freely (fearlessly and boldly) in the synagogue; but when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him with them and expounded to him the way of God more definitely and accurately." Acts 18:24-26 (AMPC)Apollos had received the Lord Jesus and was burning with spiritual zeal or fierce enthusiasm. He preached with so much boldness and was attempting to do more for the Lord. Yet, there was the need for the accurate knowledge of Christ and guidance.Thank God for Priscilla and Aquila who have to help him by expounding the truth of God to him.
Don't just be enthused about fulfiling the purpose of God, do it according to the right knowledge.
This doesn't suggest that you don't need zeal when you have knowledge. Until you intentionally cultivate your heart to boil with the passion or zeal of the Lord, your knowledge will not be aggressively directed into action.However, when you receive the right knowledge of Christ, it will burn in your heart. The true revelation of Jesus will cause your heart to boil with flaming passions and zeal.
Beloved, let your zeal continue to burn into action with the right knowledge of God in Christ.
A man with zeal and the accurate Knowledge of  Christ is an unstoppable chariot.This is why the Lord has blessed us with the scriptures and this daily treasure chest, to guide our hearts into accurate knowledge and the fulfilment of purpose.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 18:25; Colossians 4:12-13; John 2:17; Psalm 119:139; 2 Corinthians 8:16; 2 Corinthians 7:7,12; Acts 22:3; Acts 20:24) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will continue to expose our hearts to the accurate knowledge of Christ so that our zeal will be guided right. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 13 - 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My zeal is guided right. - I expose my heart daily to the accurate knowledge of Christ. -  I am zealous about doing great things for the Lord. -  I am zealous about my divine mandate. - I am zealous about the salvation of others. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 364 - BE EMPOWERED BY GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 22nd January, 2024BE EMPOWERED BY GRACE"But God’s amazing grace has made me who I am! And his grace to me was not fruitless. In fact, I worked harder than all the rest, yet not in my own strength but God’s, for his empowering grace is poured out upon me" 1 Corinthians 15:10 (TPT)You may feel overwhelmed by the vision or assignment God has given you.Or you may desire to do more for the Lord, however you may think you don't have what it takes. In the realm of God, there are no impossibilities. This is why as a believer in Christ, you are not to think impossibilities, because nothing is impossible to you in the first place.You are with God therefore all things are possible!
Anything God tells you to do, He makes the provisions for you.
You don't lack what it takes to do what God tells you to do. You must therefore learn to trust God and know the things He has supplied to you.
God doesn't entrust a responsibility into your hands without giving you what you need.
This is why He sent His Holy Spirit to you to partner with you, gave you His word to build you, planted you in an assembly of the saints and placed you under a shepherd to train you.Of the many things the Lord supplies to you, there is also another crucial item for your advantage - it is GRACE. You might have heard a lot about the grace of God, right?To some, the grace of God is just the means by which we are saved (Ephesians 2:8).And all they think of grace is God's provision for the sins of men. (There is more to discuss on this later).
The grace of God is not just an unmerited favor; the grace of God is also a divine ability.
In the opening verse, you will see two things the grace of God does.1. YOU ARE MADE BY GRACE. "...God’s amazing grace has made me who I am..." Other translations put it this way, "...I am who I am by the grace of God"So the apostle of Jesus acknowledges that whatever He has become was by the grace of God not by any other means.This means the grace of God saves and makes you a new man (2 Corinthians 5:17).The grace of God changes and transforms your being.Grace translates you from a corruptible state to an incorruptible state.2. Second thing is, GRACE EMPOWERS YOU. To be empowered by grace also shows how grace doesn't promote laziness.Paul says, "... and his grace to me was not fruitless..."Waow...
There is no unfruitfulness in grace. When you receive grace, and you are made by grace you must not be unfruitful.
This is why GRACE EMPOWERS YOU to work harder or to labour more.It is possible for one to be born again and not take advantage of Grace in His labour.
Grace is for your BEING and it is also for your DOING.
You don't just have to celebrate the reality of who are by Grace. You must also take advantage of the empowerment of Grace to do more for the Lord.ShalomDIG DEEPER(Philippians 2:12-13; 2 Corinthians 3:5, 6:1; 1 Corinthians 3:10; Romans 12:3; 1 Timothy 1:12; Acts 9:22) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be empowered more and more by the grace of God to labour more. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 16 - 19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have grace to do what God has entrusted to me. - I am empowered more and more by the grace of God to labour more. - I do more by the empowering grace of God which is poured out upon me. - I am fully resourced and equipped for every good work the Lord has entrusted to me. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 365 - DEPENDENCE ON GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DEPENDENCE ON GOD"For I am Yahweh your God, who strongly takes hold of your right hand, Who says to you, ‘Do not fear, I will help you." Isaiah 41:13 (Legacy Standard Bible)One of the greatest signs of maturity is dependence on God.In the society we find ourselves today, most people see dependence as weakness and others also see it as immaturity.But that is not the situation in God.The more you grow in your relationship with God or as you mature in Him, the more you realise you have to depend on Him.The immatured ones don't depend on God.
Dependence on God is not a sign of weakness. Dependence on God is a quality of wisdom and humility.
It takes a lot of pride to think you don't need God.Such people don't pray.They do everything with their own strength and understanding.The wise in Christ trust in God's strength. They don't try to use their own strength. They depend and utilize the strength of God's resources.Just think about it, trying to use your limited resources to accomplish an assignment of the Limitless God?A man who has accomplished great things with God and made an impact which has shaped culture, is a man who has absolute dependence on God.Like we read yesterday, Paul the apostle showed us the secret to His great accomplishments."...by the grace of God I have laboured more than they all..." (1 Corinthians 15:10).The Lord who made you, knows the weight of the assignment He has entrusted to you; therefore He has made abundance of resources and grace available for your benefits. Yours is to take advantage of these resources.David said to Goliath,  “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied" 1 Samuel 17:45 (NKJV)
Don't confront any assignment or task or life situation by your strength.
Deploy the tools of God.Let your confidence be in the Lord. As you spend time in prayer and the meditation of the word, He will show you what to do.
Where is your strength?
Just as the Lord spoke through the Prophet Isaiah (as quoted in the opening verse), He is still speaking to you today;"For I am Yahweh your God, who strongly takes hold of your right hand,Who says to you, ‘Do not fear, I will help you."
Beloved, don't be afraid. The Lord knows what is at stake. He will not leave you. He is strongly holding your hand and is with you as your helper. Depend on Him at all times.
Don't be like the people of the world.Let this be your testimony:"Some find their strength in their weapons and wisdom, but my miracle deliverance can never be won by men. Our boast is in the Lord our God, who makes us strong and gives us victory!" Psalm 20:7 (TPT)Praise the Lord.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Psalm 20:1-9; Isaiah 42:6; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 27:1; 121:1-2; John 15:5) WE PRAYWe pray that the Help and supply of divine strength will abound towards us to accomplish great things unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 20 - 23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have absolute dependence on God. - My strength is in the Lord. - I depend on God in all things. - I don't confront any assignment or task by my our strength but by the enabling strength of God which is at work in me. - By the supply of the divine strength of God, I accomplish great things unto His glory. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 366 - THE CASE IS CLOSED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 24th January, 2024 THE CASE IS CLOSED"So now the case is closed. There remains no accusing voice of condemnation against those who are joined in life-union with Jesus, the Anointed One" Romans 8:1 (TPT)I suppose you have heard of Judgement Day and you are looking forward to it right?And you may be asking yourself "What will be my fate on that day"?You may be asking yourself, "Will I be condemned to eternal damnation or be declared not guilty?"Considering your wrongs, you may currently be thinking you don't have a chance when you stand before the supreme judge.Maybe you imagine yourself standing in the accused box in a courtroom in Heaven. You hear the thundering voice of an Archangel, "COURT RISE!".Suddenly your heart quake and your feet tremble. You fall to the ground in shock, and then the Supreme being, God, the Judge, clothed in an unapproachable light, takes His giant seat.You try to look around, and here is the devil, the accuser of the brethren. He is looking so shameless and confident. He has in his hands a huge - long document bearing your name and your wrongs.You begin to feel that your eternal damnation is here. PAUSE!
STOP WASTING THE POWER OF YOUR IMAGINATION!
None of these will happen. They are imaginations built on old deceptive tales.Is there any Judgement day arranged by God to announce your condemnation or justification?Yes.But it is not in the future; it was in the past!The judgement day which awaits you as a believer in Christ is not about condemnation or justification. The judgement day for those in Christ is a day of rewards for the labour of faith. (We will discuss this more later).When you came into Christ, the case against you has been closed forever. The adversary or accuser has no case against you. He has no voice and nothing to say against you. There is no condemnation against the man in Christ. (Romans 8:1).How?The answer is here:"and blotted out the charges proved against you, the list of his commandments which you had not obeyed. He took this list of sins and destroyed it by nailing it to Christ’s cross. In this way God took away Satan’s power to accuse you of sin, and God openly displayed to the whole world Christ’s triumph at the cross where your sins were all taken away" Colossians 2:14-15 (TLB).The adversary has no case against you.
All of his evidence against you was erased, deleted and destroyed on the cross. They cannot be retrieved.
To even take it further, understand that, the punishment of sin is death (Romans 6:23).And this is the good news, the bloody death of Jesus on the cross did not only take away sin; His death was the punishment of sin.This means our Lord did not only blot out the accusations against you; in Christ, your sins have fully or completely been paid. "He gave himself as ransom-payment for everyone..." 1 Timothy 2:6 (TPT).
Now there is no evidence of sin against you. And if there could have still been any evidence, the death of Jesus is the punishment of sin for you.
Therefore at the eternal courtroom, the judgement has already been made; you were declared not guilty. You are eternally free and sin has no dominion over you.When you are established in this certainty you serve the Lord in confidence.Praise the Lord. DIG DEEPER(Galatians 1:4; Revelation 12:11; John 3:15-18; Romans 8:33-34; Romans 3:23-26) WE PRAY- We pray thanking the Lord for His grace by which we are eternally declared not guilty.- We thank the Lord for building our confidence through the consciousness of our justification BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 24 - 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified by faith – The life of Christ is my life. – I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds. – My boast is in the Lord’s finished work of Christ. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. – I have a right standing with God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 367 - YOUR FREEDOM IS YOUR CONFIDENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 25th January, 2024YOUR FREEDOM IS YOUR CONFIDENCE"So now the case is closed. There remains no accusing voice of condemnation against those who are joined in life-union with Jesus, the Anointed One" Romans 8:1 (TPT)Why is it important you know that the case of your condemnation is closed?
Beloved, the confidence to live your new life in Christ is in the consciousness of your freedom.
What keeps you enslaved by the adversary is the voice of condemnation.Condemnation is as a prison gate and lock which keeps you imprisoned. It is as the chain which binds and keeps you away from your true liberty.The adversary knows the more he makes you feel condemned, the more he keeps you away from enjoying your liberty in Christ.
Condemnation is the root or the fundamental cause of your enslaved living. Anyone who lives under condemnation is living as a slave to sin.
One sure thing the Lord wants you to know is that you are not just free from sin, you are free from the voice of condemnation.Most believers in Christ, are aware or have heard that Jesus has overly paid for their sins, by His death on the cross. And also through His resurrection, they were declared righteous.Yet, they look at their self-efforts and feel condemned. That sense of condemnation makes them feel guilty and then they even think the death of Jesus is not enough to make them righteous.You will hear a believer, saying, "The blood of Jesus is not enough to make you righteous. Your good works determine your righteousness and salvation".This is an insult to the Spirit of grace and trampling the blood of Jesus as nothing.It is the greatest sense of unbelief.Sincerely what kind of bible do they read?"For God made the only one who did not know sin to become sin for us, so that we who did not know righteousness might become the righteousness of God through our union with him." 2 Corinthians 5:21 (TPT)
You don't become righteous because of your good works. You are made righteous by the goodness of Christ. Righteousness is imparted to you because of Jesus, not because of how you keep any laws or rules.
If you are trying to determine your righteousness by your works, know that your works shall be reckoned as debt."Now to him who works, the wages are not counted as grace but as debt. But to him who does not work but believes on Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness" Romans 4:4-5 (NKJV)The adversary knows that legally, there is no condemnation to them that are in Christ (Romans 8:1).However, the only way to accuse the brethren and to steal their confidence is to judge or make them feel condemned through their self-efforts.
Why do you believe in Jesus and still think you will perish?
Don't you know what the Lord has said?"God did not send his Son into the world to judge and condemn the world, but to be its Savior and rescue it! So now there is no longer any condemnation for those who believe in him, but the unbeliever already lives under condemnation because they do not believe in the name of God’s beloved Son." John 3:17-18 (TPT).The day you fully accept, Romans 8:1, is the day you will experience true freedom. There are no chains on your hands and feet, there are no prison gates.You have been made free in Christ Jesus.
Stay free in the freedom Christ has given you (Galatians 5:1), for that is where your confidence is rooted.
Don't give your mind to any deceptive voice of condemnation (it is not real and has no legal grounds).Remember, the case is closed!Defend your freedom in Christ by continuing in the truth of the gospel of Jesus. This is the greatest warfare of your faith. When the deception of the adversary succeeds in making you feel condemned, it will affect your confidence.
Guard your freedom in Christ.
You are in union with Christ Jesus, therefore, live confidently in the freedom which you have in Him.Praise the Lord. DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:1; John 8:32,36; Galatians 3:25; Galatians 2:3-5; Romans 8:1-2; Revelation 12:11) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for the eternal freedom which we have in Christ and also pray that we shall increase in the consciousness of the reality of our "No condemnation". BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 27 - 30 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified by faith.– The life of Christ is my life. – I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds. – My boast is in the Lord’s finished work of Christ. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. – I have a right standing with God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 368 - JUSTIFICATION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 26th January, 2024 JUSTIFICATION"Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ," Romans 5:1 (NKJV)Justification is God's own action to make you righteous.
Justification is not your performance of righteousness by grace.
Justification is not what you do to be righteous.It is not how you try to be righteous or morally upright.You cannot be righteous by your own effort. Your own righteousness cannot be good enough.
Every form of righteousness must be measured by a standard.
You can determine your righteousness by your own laws. But is that not enough to determine the righteousness which God requires?The Jewish leaders felt righteous in their own eyes. They justified themselves by their own moral standards.Jesus gave a parable (an allegorical narrative) to explain how Justification works."He also told this parable to some people who trusted in themselves and were confident that they were righteous [posing outwardly as upright and in right standing with God], and who viewed others with contempt: “Two men went up into the temple [enclosure] to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector. The Pharisee stood [ostentatiously] and began praying to himself [in a self-righteous way, saying]: ‘God, I thank You that I am not like the rest of men—swindlers, unjust (dishonest), adulterers—or even like this tax collector. I fast twice a week; I pay tithes of all that I get.’ But the tax collector, standing at a distance, would not even raise his eyes toward heaven, but was striking his chest [in humility and repentance], saying, ‘God, be merciful and gracious to me, the [especially wicked] sinner [that I am]!’ I tell you, this man went to his home justified [forgiven of the guilt of sin and placed in right standing with God] rather than the other man; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself [forsaking self-righteous pride] will be exalted.” Luke 18:9-14 (AMP)We still have these two groups of people. There are some who still think they are righteous or justified by their works or self-efforts.And others who acknowledge that they cannot be righteous by their works. They look to God for the supply of His mercy. This is true faith.Faith is not trusting in your effort. Faith is confidence in God's ability. It is the confidence in God's endless ability to love, to care, to be merciful, and to preserve.Therefore, justification is only by faith in Christ Jesus.
God's requirement of righteousness is perfect righteousness without any stain.
This means, no man by his effort can have this "perfect righteousness".That is why God made His provision of righteousness in Christ Jesus. You can only be justified by faith in Christ Jesus.Justification is not worked for; Justification is imputing righteousness.
To be justified is to be declared not guilty. It means you are acquitted and discharged in the account of what Jesus has done. It is to be declared righteous.
This is not according to what you did, it is according to what Jesus did.You are not justified by your own perfection. You are justified by the perfection of Jesus. Your boast is in who Jesus is, this is your faith.Praise the Lord.DIG DEEPER(Luke 18:18-27; Romans 1:16-17; Romans 4:1-25; Ephesians 2:8-9) WE PRAYWe pray that in nothing shall we boast in our own efforts but will always rejoice in God's free gift of righteousness through faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 31 - 33 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified by faith.– I rejoice in God’s free gift of Righteousness through faith.– The life of Christ is my life. – I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds. – My boast is in the Lord’s finished work of Christ. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. – I have a right standing with God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 369 - RHYTHMS OF THE JUST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 27th January, 2024RHYTHMS OF THE JUST"Then I heard what seemed to be the thunderous voice of a great multitude, like the sound of a massive waterfall and mighty peals of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!" Revelation 19:6 (TPT).The idea of "song minister" has been reduced to those who have good voices or those who lead in songs.There are some "Christian musicians" who think they are the ones who lead saints INTO the presence of God.Apart from Jesus, nobody leads God's people INTO the presence of God; though in our communion in the Lord, He has given us shepherds who lead us IN Him.Take note:- Every believer in Christ has the responsibility to lead the unreached TO Christ, through the Gospel.- However, by the blood of Jesus we all have access INTO God. And we all come to the Father through Christ.- And then God has trained men who are to lead His saints IN Him, to fulfill purpose.I hope it is clear. Now, let this be settled in your heart:
Through the work of Christ in His death and resurrection, He gave access to all men into the presence of the Lord.
We have access into God's presence not because someone leads us in songs. We have access into God's presence because of the goodness of Christ."for through Him, we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father." Ephesians 2:18 (NASB).
Ministering to the Lord in songs is not the responsibility of few others. It is the responsibility of all the saints.
All the saints in Christ are true worshippers. "For we [who are born-again have been reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, set apart for His purpose and] are the true circumcision, who worship in the Spirit of God and glory and take pride and exult in Christ Jesus and place no confidence [in what we have or who we are] in the flesh" Philippians 3:3 (AMP)
The born again is the justified (the just man) who stands in the presence of God without any sense of guilt, because of the goodness of Christ.
As just men who have access to God, we have the privilege to minister to the Lord in spiritual songs. We are to minister to the Lord in songs, during our personal time with the Lord and also while we are amidst the congregation of the saints.We shouldn't think singing together as a congregation is a religious cliché or an activity to while away time. We don't use times of ministering in songs to wait for the preacher. Neither is it to tickle the emotions of the congregation.Ministering in songs is a rhythm of a life immersed with the Spirit. When you are saturated by the Spirit and soaked by the Word, you will burst forth in spiritual songs. Rhythms of His presence will gush forth from your Spirit.The hymns, the spiritual songs and various melodies we chant in today's Church are rhythms of just men who were caught up in divine revelation.When we gather as saints, the Lord inspires deep spiritual rhythms in the heart of the congregation and we minister unto Him and also to one another.
The most important instrument which resounds the transcendent rhythms of Christ is the thousands of voices of the saints soaked with the Spirit of Grace.
"Then I looked, and I heard around the throne and the living creatures and the elders the voice of many angels, numbering myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands, saying with a loud voice,“Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!" Revelation 5:11-12 (ESV).All beings in Heaven, on earth, in the seas and under the earth, make harmonious rhythm of glory to the Lord. (Revelation 5:13)
No concert held by men transcends such experience.
This is the portrait of fellowship in eternity. Beyond the best musical instruments, God is interested in the rhythms of the revelation of Jesus, dispensed through the voices of the saints in oneness of heart. (Romans 15:5-6)Don't miss any moment to join a gathering where all saints are ministering in the oneness of heart to the Lord. Let your voice be heard in the rhythms of the just men.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 100; Colossians 3:16; 1 Peter 2:5; Matthew 26:30; Acts 16:25; 1 Corinthians 14:15; James 5:13) WE PRAY- We pray thanking the Lord for the privilege and access to commune with Him.- We pray declaring that our hearts will be flooded with the right revelation as we minister unto Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 34 - 37 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have access into the presence of the Father through the goodness of Christ. - I am a true worshipper and I minister unto the Lord. - I minister unto the Lord with the right revelation of Him. - As I am being saturated by the Spirit and soaked by the word, rhythms of His presence gush forth out of my spirit. - I dwell in the presence of the Father forever. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 370 - JUSTIFICATION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 28th January, 2024JUSTIFICATION 2"Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ," Romans 5:1 (NKJV)From our previous study, we realised justification is God's own action to make you righteous.It is not what you do to be righteous, neither is it how you try to be righteous or morally upright. Justification is God declaring you righteous by faith.
You cannot be righteous by your own effort. Your own righteousness cannot be good enough.
Jesus, shared a parable in Luke 18:9-14, to explain the concept of justification, which we discussed in the previous post.Now, there was another scenario between a wealthy Jewish leader and Jesus:"One day a wealthy Jewish nobleman of high standing posed this question to Jesus: “Wonderful Teacher, what must I do to be saved and receive eternal life?”Jesus answered, “Why would you call me wonderful when there is only one who is wonderful—and that is God alone?
