You already know what is right and what the commandments teach: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not lie, and respectfully honor your father and your mother.”The wealthy leader replied, “These are the very things I’ve been doing for as long as I can remember.”“Ah,” Jesus said. “But there’s still one thing you’re missing in your life.”“What is that?” asked the man.“You must go and sell everything you own and give all the proceeds to the poor so you will have eternal treasures. Then come and follow me.” When the rich leader heard these words, he was devastated, for he was extremely wealthy." Luke 18:18-23 (TPT)At first glance, you may think the wealthy Jew's question was a harmless question.However, Jesus knew his question was works-oriented or boastful-centered. This was not with the same intention as the disciples of Jesus were asked during Pentecost in Acts 2:37."Now when they heard this they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?” (ESV).For those who heard the message in Acts 2, they were pierced to the heart.When he asked:"what must I do to be saved and receive eternal life?”He asked the question on the grounds of his self-effort. What he can do and not how Jesus can help him.
This is the mindset of the religious. Religious or legalistic folks judge their lives based on their works.
They believe whatever they enjoy in the Lord, is according to their own self-efforts. They are proud and boastful.They think they are forgiven by God because they forgive others. They assume they are righteous because they worked for it, or they are perfect because they keep the law of Moses.However, that is not what it is.
Your self-efforts cannot make you righteous. The law cannot make you perfect or righteous, because you cannot fully keep the law.
You cannot be justified by your work or attempt to keep the whole law.When Jesus saw that the wealthy Jewish leader was works conscious than grace conscious, He showed him the demands of the law.And you can see how he was boasting of his adherence to the law.The response he gave to Jesus meant, "If it's about keeping the law of Moses, I have lived and kept the law completely".Yet, God justifies by faith, so that no man will boast or take credit in any way.
There is no place for your self-efforts or works when it comes to  justification or salvation. It solely depends on the finished work of Christ in His death and resurrection.
The wealthy Jewish leader couldn't even keep the first commandment:"Thou shalt have no other gods before me." Exodus 20:3 (KJV)He had esteemed his wealth so much he couldn't sacrifice it to follow God. (Luke 18:22-23).Jesus shut the mouth of this Jewish leader and made him swallow his boasting.That is the purpose of the law, to expose your weakness and imperfection.His wealth has become his god.
You are not saved or justified by your works. You are saved or justified by believing in Jesus.
There is no place for your self-effort, ego and boasting. It is the work of God in Christ.
At Salvation you were declared not guilty on the account of what Jesus has done; not according to what you did or what you are trying to do.
Don't be like the rich Jewish leader. I repeat, you are not justified by your own perfection. You are justified by the perfection of Jesus. Your boast is in who Jesus is, not your own efforts.Praise the Lord.DIG DEEPER(Romans 1:16-17; Romans 4:1-25; Ephesians 2:8-9) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for making us righteous through Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Exodus 38 - 40 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified by the finished work of Christ. - My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. - I am justified by faith.- I rejoice in God’s free gift of Righteousness through faith.- The life of Christ is my life. - I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds. - I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. - I have a right standing with God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 371 - JUSTIFICATION 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 29th January, 2024JUSTIFICATION 3"Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ," Romans 5:1 (NKJV)To be justified is to be declared not guilty or to be declared righteous in Christ.In justification, you were made right with God.This declaration happened not just by divine sovereignty, but by the satisfaction of the demands of justice.
Beloved in Christ, your justification was processed legally. You were freely justified but it was not cheap.
Your justification cost God. Thus, He alone deserves the glory.Your justification was fully complete. God doesn't need your self-effort to complete your justification.
Your justification was completed when Jesus rose from the dead.
"who was betrayed and crucified because of our sins, and was raised [from the dead] because of our justification [our acquittal—absolving us of all sin before God]." Romans 4:25 (AMP)Therefore you must stand confidently in Christ as one who cannot be condemned.The price has been paid!You can only be condemned when the effect or impact of the death and resurrection of Jesus can be reversed.But the question is, can it be reversed?Certainly not!Whatever the Lord does is eternal and it is forever."I know that whatever God does, it endures forever; nothing can be added to it nor can anything be taken from it, for God does it so that men will fear and worship Him [with awe-filled reverence, knowing that He is God]." Ecclesiastes 3:14 (AMP)Say this to yourself loudly:I am justified in Christ, and it is irreversible!
It is the resurrection of Jesus which authenticated and continues to authenticate your justification; it is not how you try to keep the laws of Moses.
Whenever you find people pointing fingers at your weaknesses and wrongs just to make you feel condemned, remind yourself of this reality:FOR MY JUSTIFICATION HE WAS RAISED!Heyaaa...One time as a teenager, I found myself meditating on Romans 8. And when I got to verse 34, I imagined Paul the Apostle standing in the middle of a huge crowd in a stadium who were waiting to accuse and condemn him. And then he shouted with a loud voice saying:"Who is the one who condemns us? Christ Jesus is the One who died [to pay our penalty], and more than that, who was raised [from the dead]..." Romans 8:34 (AMP).Oh Hallelujah!This is something to rejoice about.
You are fully justified by the work of God in Christ's death and resurrection.
Now, nobody should intimidate you with stories about their strange sacrifices which gave them access to God. We all have access to God through Christ Jesus.If you are in Christ, you are justified and you have peace with God.You don't need a strange regalia to walk in the corridors of the Spirit. As you have been justified, you have the right standing with God. You can walk in the corridors of Heaven as Jesus, for you have His righteousness.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 50:8; Romans 5:10, 18; Isaiah 53:5; Romans 3:25; Romans 1:16-17; Romans 4:1-25; Ephesians 2:8-9) WE PRAYThat our hearts will be established in this certainty that for our justification Jesus was raised, therefore we shall not give in to any intimidation or condemning voice. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My cost price is God. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith.– I rejoice in God’s free gift of Righteousness through faith.– The life of Christ is my life. – I am perfected by faith in Christ not by my deeds. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. – I have a right standing with God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 372 - TAKE OFF THE ILL-FITTING LOADS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 30th January, 2024TAKE OFF THE ILL-FITTING LOADS 1"See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception [pseudo-intellectual babble], according to the tradition [and musings] of mere men, following the elementary principles of this world, rather than following [the truth—the teachings of] Christ." Colossians 2:8 (Amplified)Oftentimes, we assume the greatest opposition to the gospel is "materialism" and "secularism". But that isn't what deeply opposes the divine intention. The greatest oppositions of our Faith are religion, philosophy and culture (founded mostly on narcissism). It's not just the members of Christ who are not hooked to material things, most religious groupings frown at "materialism". Yet their philosophy hewn out of their religious groundings, makes them radically oppose the knowledge of Christ.These traditions, cultures and philosophies are not founded on Christ.Please note, this isn't some sort of anti-intellectualism propaganda.
In God's plan and purpose, we are to enjoy and function only in the economy (arrangements or administration) of Grace.
This economy serves us only with an un-forceful rhythm. It doesn't enslave us and put a yoke on our necks.But that is not the situation with the law of Moses and even the traditions of men.When the Church leaders met in Jerusalem to discuss the reality of the gospel.Peter's response to those who were trying to enforce Jewish laws upon the believers is still refreshing."So why on earth would you now limit God’s grace by placing a yoke of religious duties on the shoulders of the believers that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?  Don’t you believe that we are introduced to eternal life through the grace of our Lord Jesus—the same grace that has brought these people new life?”Acts 15:10-11 (TPT).Look at what Jesus also said Himself,“Are you tired? Worn out? Burned out on religion? Come to me. Get away with me and you’ll recover your life. I’ll show you how to take a real rest. Walk with me and work with me—watch how I do it. Learn the unforced rhythms of grace. I won’t lay anything heavy or ill-fitting on you. Keep company with me and you’ll learn to live freely and lightly.” Matthew 11:28-30 (Message)This is what religion does, it puts an overload weight of rules and regulations upon your neck and demands perfection.
The religious traditions of men only demand perfection and righteousness, they don't supply life.
Jesus didn't say I have religious traditions, rules and regulations which will keep you righteous.Jesus invites you to an organic fellowship of love and rest. He wants to share in your weakness, as He supplies strength to you through His grace.There are some who teach that "Grace places demands of responsibility on us. Grace doesn't want us to be irresponsible".
Grace doesn't promote laziness, however, the idea that God demands or Grace places demands on us is not consistent with God's mindset.
Sincerely, I will humbly point out that Grace doesn't place demands of responsibility on us. God doesn't place demands on us. There's no way we can meet God's demands.That's why Jesus came!He came to SUPPLY. Grace supplies us with the ability to produce results.Not that we a sufficient of ourselves but our sufficiency is of God. (2 Corinthians 3:5)
That's the difference between the Covenant of Promise (which was fulfilled as the New Covenant and given to us as a Testament) and the Old Covenant.
The OLD COVENANT wasn't part of God's eternal plan at all. It was never his intention to DEMAND ANYTHING FROM US.His plan was to SUPPLY US WITH LIFE so that we would BE HIS EXPRESSION.
God's intentional and eternal plan is for you to live a life of rest daily and not to be caged in stress.
Christ came that we will have Life; to be our true selves. The God-begotten selves.  (John 1:13, Message)"I commend you to God, and to the word of His Grace, which is able to build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified" Acts 20:32Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BHCzbBk5nyc&t=630sDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:1; Acts 15: 6-11; Matthew 23:4; Galatians 4:1-5,9; Galatians 2:3-5) WE PRAYWe pray that we will continuously increase in the knowledge of Christ and that our hearts will be fully liberated from the yoke of religion. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am free from any yoke of religion.  - I walk daily in the liberty that Christ has given me. - I live a life of rest daily. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 373 - TAKE OFF THE ILL-FITTING LOADS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 31st January, 2024 TAKE OFF THE ILL-FITTING LOADS 2"But now, after that, ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?" Galatians 4:9  (KJV)One of the key things you must understand is that, when you came into Christ, you were brought into a life of Rest and not under another yoke of religion.Jesus is not a religious leader. He is God who became flesh to bring us into the reality of life. (1 Timothy 3:16)
God's intention for man has always been to make His Life germinate in man, that man will be His expression.
When you cultivate the Life of God in you, you will live in REST. The REST I am talking about here is not how you cease from work or movement in order to relax or sleep.
When you come into Christ, you are brought into Rest.
This rest is living according to the divine essence in you. It is living above the anxiety, burden, fear and condemnation of the Old Covenant law and the demands you place upon yourself through other worthless religious principles and philosophies.In the opening verse, Galatians 4:9, Paul spoke of weak and beggarly elements; the question is what are these weak and beggarly elements Paul was speaking of?These weak and beggarly elements are the worthless principles of religion and philosophies.These include paganism, the bondage of Jewish rituals and ordinances, and also baseless or empty scientific philosophies designed by men to oppose the reality of God.If you are reading this and you are not born again, understand Jesus came not to introduce you to a new religion called "Christianity". This is how most people see Christianity. They assume it's one of the religious groups. They are not to be blamed, some ecclesiastical caucus have made religion out of what should be the dispensing of life.
Jesus came to translate you into the reality of the Kingdom life of God.
Read what He said and He is saying the same thing to you now:“Are you tired? Worn out? Burned out on religion? Come to me. Get away with me and you’ll recover your life. I’ll show you how to take a real rest. Walk with me and work with me—watch how I do it. Learn the unforced rhythms of grace. I won’t lay anything heavy or ill-fitting on you. Keep company with me and you’ll learn to live freely and lightly.” Matthew 11:28-30 (Message)Jesus came to bring you rest from all your efforts to be righteous or justified. He came to take off the burdens or entrapments of superstitions, taboos and regulations of religion.
Jesus came to usher you into a new - living way of peace and fulfilment of life.
If you are reading this and you are born again, rejoice and remain confident in the reality of Jesus. He has brought you into true rest.
Don't be lured to think living by grace is not enough. Don't place any yoke of religious duties upon yourself.
Just as Paul said to the brethren in Colosse:"See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception [pseudo-intellectual babble], according to the tradition [and musings] of mere men, following the elementary principles of this world, rather than following [the truth—the teachings of] Christ." Colossians 2:8 (Amplified)
Remain resolute in the teachings of Christ. Set your mind and affection on the revelation of Jesus. Refused to be swayed by some pseudo-intellectual babble.
Enjoy your true and intimate relationship with the Father, which is founded on His unconditional love and not religious regulations and deceptive philosophies. DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:1; Acts 15: 6-11; Matthew 23:4; Galatians 4:1-5,9; Galatians 2:3-5) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be given to any pseudo-intellectual babble, but will remain established in the revelation of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 9 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am free from any yoke of religion.  – I walk daily in the liberty that Christ has given me. – I live a life of rest daily. – I have been translated into the reality of the Kingdom life of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 374 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 1st February, 2024 DEALING WITH DECEPTION"bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)The greatest weapon of the adversary is deception.Deception is the seed and mother of doubts and unbelief. The adversary leads people astray and makes them rebel against the Lord by systematically and patiently exposing their minds and imaginations to corruptible ideas.
The adversary never comes to directly and forcefully impose his deceptive ideas and thoughts in the imaginations of men; he cunningly evades your thoughts.
When the adversary wants to set up a generation (or yourself or your family) against God, he consistently, patiently and subtly devices deceptive schemes to corrupt their imaginations.The adversary is not all-knowing, yet poses himself as such. He only knows the power of the mind and the force of human imagination. The hard-core deceptive thoughts of the adversary begin with questions.The more questions he introduces to your mind, the more he triggers your imagination.
People are able to imagine vain things through the deceptive thoughts of the adversary.
And the goal of such imagination is to set people against God."Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying, Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us." Psalm 2:1-3 (KJV)The adversary knows your advantage is your intimate relationship with God. Thus, if he can set you up against the Lord, it will be to your disadvantage.The Lord is your source; therefore when you are cut off from your source, where is your fulfilment?
The goal of his deception is to bring you to the point of unbelief and to finally turn you against God.
It is this deceptive method the adversary deployed in Eden, to corrupt the nature of man."But now I’m afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s clever lies, your thoughts may be corrupted and you may lose your single-hearted devotion and pure love for Christ." 2 Corinthians 11:3 (TPT)In Eden, the adversary asked, "Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Has God indeed said, ‘You shall not eat of every tree of the garden’?” Genesis 3:1 (NKJV).You see, he didn't start by attacking God directly or attacking man. Also, he didn't have a clear idea of God's instructions to man in Eden. He always begins his deception by indulging your imagination. He also makes you feel he is concerned about you and knows something you don't know.
Beloved, the adversary knows nothing! He only knows his weapon, which is, deception. He is the father of lies and deceit (John 8:44; Acts 13:10).
The adversary takes advantage of your ignorance to lead you astray.Anytime you realise you are asking yourself questions which make you doubt the reality of Christ, you must know the adversary is stimulating and steering your imaginations away from God.
This is why you must give your heart to the word of God. Until you esteem the word of God in your heart, you will not increase in Knowledge.
You must increase in the knowledge of Christ so that you can wage war and make captive of any thought which exalts itself above the knowledge of Christ. Selah. DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; John 8:44; Ephesians 4:14; Hosea 14:9; Ecclesiastes 9:3; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not become victims of the deceptive schemes of the adversary in our generation. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 13 -16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I give my mind and heart to the word of God. - I refuse to be a victim of the deceptive schemes of the adversary. - I increase in the knowledge of Christ. - I esteem the word of God in my heart therefore I cannot be given to deception. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you, Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 375 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 2nd February, 2024 DEALING WITH DECEPTION 2"bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)Though the adversary has always been against God, the focus of his deceptive scheme has been man. This is because of the role and the value of man in God's eternal purpose and plan.
The greatest mystery of God in the universe is God's intimate relationship with man.
Jesus' death for man, is God's immeasurable investment in man.No wonder all through the universe this question was asked:"Compared to all this cosmic glory, why would you bother with puny, mortal man...?" Psalm 8:4 (TPT).The adversary is envious of man.He wonders, how God has made man a focus of His creation.Seeing how God values man, the adversary wants to get back at God, by setting man against God.
And to him it is war and the weapon is deception.
He knows his days are numbered, yet, he has decided not to go down without a fight.The deceptive schemes of the adversary are his weaponry of war.To the adversary, he is at war with the Kingdom of God. The goal of his war is to bring you to the point of unbelief, turn you against God and just draw you to himself through deception. His goal is to go down with all men. While God's desire is to bring salvation to all men.There is a clear prophetic word as to how deception will increase in these last days."The Holy Spirit has explicitly revealed: At the end of this age, many will depart from the true faith one after another, devoting themselves to spirits of deception and following demon-inspired revelations and theories." 1 Timothy 4:1 (TPT).The adversary is busily using cunning means to deceive God's people.
Anytime you realise you are asking yourself questions which make you doubt the reality of Christ, you must know the adversary is stimulating and steering your imaginations away from God.
The adversary is not interested in your well-being at all. Thus, you shouldn't fall for his deception.As I mentioned in the previous episode, the adversary always begins his deception by indulging your imagination through questions or vain opinions.  He also makes you feel he is concerned about you and knows something you don't know.The moment you fail an exam, he comes subtly, "Can't you see you have to put a hold on your 1 hour daily Bible reading and 1 hour daily prayers, to focus on your books? You need to pass your exams. What do you think?"He poses questions like:"If God truly loves you why did he watch your family member die?" "Look at how your whole family serves the Lord, yet there is no prosperity. Are you sure the teachings of the word are true?""Can you see the evil going on in this world? Where is the all-powerful and loving God you believe in?""Do you know there is a footballer called Jesus, so what if the Jesus you believe in is also an average person?""Don't make it a matter of faith, sickness is normal. Everyone will be sick and everyone will die one day, so just accept your fate. What can quoting scriptures do?""Since you have been absent from Church, has anyone visited you? The church family is a scam. Just live your life the way you want.""Why are you labouring to win souls and giving your resources? What if there is no heaven and all the scriptures you believe in are lies?"
Beloved, don't normalize thoughts as these which creep into your mind or heart. They are arrows of deception shot at you.
When such thoughts are coming to your heart, quickly search the scriptures for answers. Don't also keep your thoughts to yourself, seek Christ-centered answers from the Pastor the Lord has set over you.Take note: You are not the first to experience such arrows. Even Jesus, the adversary attempted to deceive Him.Take hold and meditate on the Word of Grace, as a good soldier.Selah DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; John 8:44; Ephesians 4:14; Hosea 14:9; Ecclesiastes 9:3; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall set our thoughts on the teaching of the word and not the vain imaginations of the flesh. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 17 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I give my mind and heart to the word of God. – I don't allow any deceptive thought in my mind and heart. – I don't doubt the reality of Christ. – I refuse to be a victim of the deceptive schemes of the adversary. – I increase in the knowledge of Christ. – I esteem the word of God in my heart therefore I cannot be given to deception. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you, Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 376 - REJOICE FOR HE HAS QUALIFIED YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 3rd February, 2024 REJOICE FOR HE HAS QUALIFIED YOU "giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share in the inheritance of the saints (God’s people) in the Light". Colossians 1:12 (Amplified Bible) A born again young man once said to me, “I don’t feel righteous, my efforts are not enough and that is why I think I am not seeing the blessings of God. I don’t deserve happiness and cannot match up with the standards of this world”. He was saying these things with tears in his eyes. I looked at him in the eye and asked whether he is born again.He was like, “I am really born again. Please, I also know the scriptures very well. I have received Jesus into my heart. I believe and know the blood of Jesus has cleansed all my sins. However, I still don’t feel qualified looking at my continuous mistakes”.I was moved with compassion for the young man. And I also thought, there could be many more people in this condition.
The challenge is not how you feel, the challenge is your level of understanding.
The understanding of what Christ has done for you and in you will translate into how you confront daily life situations.  Don’t just be aware of what the Lord has done for you, make a decision to walk in understanding.
You are not who you are in Christ by how you feel. You are who you are in Christ by what He has done.
 Therefore, you don’t judge the reality of your life in Christ by how you feel or by what you do but by what Christ has done. You don’t try to do good to be qualified. You are qualified to be a partaker of the inheritance of the saints in the light, by the goodness of Christ. 
You don’t get yourself qualified by your deeds and neither are you disqualified by your deeds. You are qualified by the Father through Christ.
Just as you were not delivered from the power of darkness by your self-effort, in that same light you were not qualified to enjoy your inheritance in Christ by your self-efforts. "giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share in the inheritance of the saints (God’s people) in the Light. For He has rescued us and has drawn us to Himself from the dominion of darkness, and has transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son, in whom we have redemption [because of His sacrifice, resulting in] the forgiveness of our sins [and the cancellation of sins’ penalty].” Colossians 1:12-14 (Amplified Bible) What is the basis of your qualification to be a partaker of the inheritance of the saints?1. For He has rescued us and has drawn us to Himself from the dominion of darkness, and has transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son.2. In His Son we have redemption [because of His sacrifice, resulting in] the forgiveness of our sins [and the cancellation of sins’ penalty].So to walk in the reality of your qualification in Christ, you don’t have to look and live by the standards of this world. You don’t also have to look at your mistakes. "It is not that we think we are qualified to do anything on our own. Our qualification comes from God.” 2 Corinthians 3:5 (NLT) Did you see what Paul had to say about themselves?
The moment you begin to think your qualification is according to your self-effort, you are thinking outside God’s design of provision for you.
Your enjoyment of the glorious inheritance in Christ, is dependent on Christ and your position in Him. You belong to the Kingdom of His Son, therefore you are qualified to enjoy the inheritance of the Kingdom. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:18; Acts 20:32; Acts 26:18; Romans 15:18; 2 Corinthians 3:4-6) WE PRAY– Thank you Father for qualifying me to share in the inheritance of the saints. – That we will walk continually in the understanding and consciousness of this reality. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 21 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been qualified. – I belong to the kingdom of God’s dear son. – I walk daily in the consciousness of this reality. – I share in the inheritance of the Kingdom. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 377 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 4th February, 2024 DEALING WITH DECEPTION 3"bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)We have previously looked at deception as the greatest weapon of the adversary. And in the second part, I took time to explain the focus of the adversary's deceptive weapon.Beloved understand that. the adversary sees his deceptive methods as a warfare strategy.Don't see those thoughts which cause you to doubt God's faithfulness, His love and supply of grace as a normal thing. Any seed of doubt, condemnation and fear sown into you is an attack launched at you. Take up the shield of faith and the Word of God as the sword of the Spirit, to also wage warfare against those thoughts.
In these last days, the adversary aggressively throws more arrows of deceit and doubts at men. (You know the last days began from the beginning of the Church until now).
Many are finding reasons not to believe and receive Jesus because of the deception of the devil. The adversary doesn't come as the scariest being with two horns.The scripture says,"But I am not surprised! Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light." 2 Corinthians 11:14 (NLT).There are many who fall for the deception of the adversary and rather consider it as enlightenment.For example:How can one call their traditional religion or idol worship true enlightenment? God, after He made man, gave him dominion."And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth" Genesis 1:26-28 (KJV).Now, isn't it the blindness of deception for men to rather think it is better to worship and bow to the created things instead of having dominion and subduing them?They call idol worship their true heritage. Really?This is nothing but an identity crisis."Throughout human history the fingerprints of God were upon them, yet they refused to honor him as God or even be thankful for his kindness. Instead, they entertained corrupt and foolish thoughts about what God was like. This left them with nothing but misguided hearts, steeped in moral darkness. Although claiming to be super-intelligent, they were in fact shallow fools. For only a fool would trade the unfading splendor of the immortal God to worship the fading image of other humans, idols made to look like people, animals, birds, and even creeping reptiles!" Romans 1:21-23 (TPT).
Listen, there is no true light which is of the devil. He only masquerades himself as an angel of light, but he is not an angel of light. There is no light in him!
Don't be ignorant of his deceptive devices. To identify the deceptive schemes of the adversary, look out for any thought which attempts to exalt itself above the knowledge of Christ.There is a thin line between the revelation of Jesus and the deception of the adversary. The adversary presents his deceptive thoughts as a deeper revelation. Beware, they are no revelation at all."We can demolish every deceptive fantasy that opposes God and break through every arrogant attitude that is raised up in defiance of the true knowledge of God. We capture, like prisoners of war, every thought and insist that it bow in obedience to the Anointed One" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (TPT).
Don't entertain any deceptive fantasy which opposes God and the gospel of Jesus.
Let the gospel of Jesus be the only message which prevails in your heart. Don't give your mind to another gospel. There is only one gospel of Jesus.
Any thought pattern which paints a different picture of God in your heart, apart from what Jesus has brought to us is a deceptive arrow.
Confront that deception with the true revelation of Jesus.Don't accept any thought which makes you think there are more alternatives to express God apart from Jesus.
Don't accept any thought which amplifies selfishness and so-called "self-love", apart from the true revelation of the love of God.
Any thought pattern which focuses on you and does not consummate into bringing glory to God is a hidden ice to shipwreck your faith.Stay alert in the reality of Jesus.Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timithy 4:3-4; John 8:44; Ephesians 4:14; Hosea 14:9; Ecclesiastes 9:3; Acts 20:28-32; Ephesians 6:10-18) WE PRAYWe pray that our spiritual intelligence in Christ will increase so that we shall discern and know how to cast down imaginations and deceptive thoughts which lift themselves against the knowledge of God in Christ Jesus. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 25 - 27 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I stay alert and alive in the reality of God. - I don't give my hearing to any other gospel. - I don't entertain any deceptive fantasy which opposes God and the gospel of Jesus. - I hold unto the integrity of God's word. - I esteem the word of God in my heart always. - The gospel of Jesus prevails in my heart. Oh Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 378 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 5th February, 2024DEALING WITH DECEPTION 4"bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)A person's thoughts control his or her decisions and choices; which then affects his or her pursuit of purpose.
The adversary knowing this also spreads demonic thoughts through different mediums.
You find unnecessary or godless questions arising in your heart. You then begin to brood over them and subtly they create uncertainties which grow deep in your heart to become strongholds.There are certain questions you shouldn't entertain in your heart.Quickly address such questions which stir doubts and fear in your heart with the knowledge of Christ.
This is why you must pay attention to the teaching of the word of grace and commit your heart to it.
Some of the disciples of Jesus found themselves in such a position at a point.Jesus for a period of three years taught His disciples about the need for His death and how He will be raised.Yet when the news went forth concerning His resurrection, some of His disciples still had doubt. And Jesus was amazed at the level of their imaginations."And as they spake these things, he himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you. But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they beheld a spirit. And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and wherefore do questionings arise in your heart?" Luke 24:36-38 (American Standard Version)
There are some questions, or imaginations or thoughts which shouldn't arise in your heart.
There are certain thoughts which can lead you into the path of foolishness.Can you imagine how a lady disrespected her family and got into a toxic marriage, just because for a long time she held on to the thought that Adam didn't meet any family member of Eve before they got married?Meanwhile, we see such orderliness in getting families or the right authorities involved in the marriage process, throughout the scriptures.Even with Adam and Eve, God was involved (Genesis 3:12). God established an orderly system for generations to come.
Have you seen how the adversary can lead people astray?
How could a male decide to marry a fellow male?It is by their vain imaginations to reject the knowledge of God."Worse followed. Refusing to know God, they soon didn’t know how to be human either—women didn’t know how to be women, men didn’t know how to be men. Sexually confused, they abused and defiled one another, women with women, men with men—all lust, no love. And then they paid for it, oh, how they paid for it—emptied of God and love, godless and loveless wretches." Romans 1:26-27 (MSG)
There is the wisdom of the just (Luke 1:17). There is the established way the just should think.
This is why submitting yourself to the training of the Word of Grace is important.One of the dangerous paths to great deception is when you decide to do things that seem right in your own eyes.
Refuse to choose your own path which is not consistent with the knowledge of Christ. Give yourself to the Word of God and to sound teachers of the Word.
The purpose of the gifted men given to the Church by Christ (in Ephesians 4:11) includes this also:"...that we are no longer children [spiritually immature], tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine, by the cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men, by the deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit]." Ephesians 4:14 (Amplified)When you submit to the training of the Word and the culturing of a good teacher of the Word, you will have a stable heart in Christ and not be tossed by deceptive thoughts.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Romans 1: 18-32; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32; Ephesians 6:10-18) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall submit our thoughts to the word of God and to the sound teachers given to oversee our growth in Christ. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit my thoughts to the word of God and to the sound teacher He has given me. - I give my hearing continually to the word of His grace. - I am not tossed about by deceptive thoughts. - I don't entertain deceptive thoughts and questions in my heart. - My heart is fertile and fruitful ground for the cultivation of the word of His grace. - I have a stable heart in Christ. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 380 - GUARD YOUR HEART - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 6th February, 2024 GUARD YOUR HEART - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 5"bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)The effect of deception is stronger when it's from within.In the same way, the impact of truth is stronger when it's established within you.
The heart is the seat of unbelief or belief.
"But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart” (that is, the word of faith which we preach): that if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation." Romans 10:8-10 (NKJV)
No matter how the gospel is preached to you until you believe in your heart, you cannot be saved. The heart is the core of your being.
Whatever happens to man must first germinate in his heart.Whatever goes on in your journey of destiny, has its root in the belief system of your heart.This is why your heart is the target of the adversary.
To deal with deception, you must guard your heart.
"Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life." Proverbs 4:24 (NLT).The author of Hebrews warned the saints concerning this same matter:"Take care, brothers and sisters, that there not be in any one of you a wicked, unbelieving heart [which refuses to trust and rely on the Lord, a heart] that turns away from the living God. But continually encourage one another every day, as long as it is called “Today” [and there is an opportunity], so that none of you will be hardened [into settled rebellion] by the deceitfulness of sin [its cleverness, delusive glamour, and sophistication]." Hebrews 3:12-13 (Amplified Bible)The moment deception creeps into your heart, unbelief will germinate in you. You will begin to doubt the promise of God's word. You will even turn away from the way of the Spirit to trust in the might of the flesh. This is how the adversary crushes the confidence of many saints.And sometimes for the adversary to sow deceptive thoughts into your heart, he uses many methods to isolate you from the brethren. Or he lures you into a wrong association.
He could use offenses, bitterness or fleshy pleasures to draw you away from the saints.
When you are among the saints, your heart will be encouraged and guarded through the ministry of the word of grace. Your thoughts and passions are directed toward the Lord when you fellowship with the Word and also the saints.You are cultivated in the truth of the word and enabled to cast down imaginations which are not consistent with the knowledge of Christ.SelahDIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Mark 16:14; Deut. 4:9; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32; Ephesians 6:10-18) WE PRAYWe pray that we will exercise the wisdom to guard our hearts from all deception and seeds of unbelief. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:–  I guard my heart with all diligence. – I don’t give room for toxic thoughts. – I delight my heart in the word of God. – I keep my heart and mind stayed on the word of God. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. – I am a doer of the word. – I don’t entertain the wrong association. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 381 - BEWARE OF FALSEHOOD IN YOUR MIDST - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 7th February, 2024 BEWARE OF FALSEHOOD IN YOUR MIDST - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 6"bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)
Deception is falsehood packaged as revelation.
You don't just take in every message or teaching as divine revelation.Judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus."God, having spoken to the fathers long ago in [the voices and writings of] the prophets in many separate revelations [each of which set forth a portion of the truth], and in many ways, has in these last days spoken [with finality] to us in [the person of One who is by His character and nature] His Son [namely Jesus], whom He appointed heir and lawful owner of all things, through whom also He created the universe [that is, the universe as a space-time-matter continuum]." Hebrews 1:1-2 (Amplified)
The revelation of Jesus is the final complete revelation of God. Any thought which is not consistent with the knowledge of Christ must be cast down.
Don't be gentle about it. Treat it as an attack against your faith. See it as warfare!I mentioned in the previous episode that, the effect of deception is stronger when it's from within.I did focus on how the adversary sows wrong thoughts in your heart. However, before the adversary will make his thoughts appealing to you, he has to creep into a circle you can trust.This is why False Prophets and False Teachers are mostly not outside the Church.They creep their way into the Church, impress the brethren, everyone accepts them and then it becomes easy for them to spread their falsehood.Paul the apostle in his farewell message to the elders in Ephesus, mentioned how false teachers will rise among them and gave them the solution:"I know that after I am gone, [false teachers like] ferocious wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock; even from among your own selves men will arise, speaking perverse and distorted things, to draw away the disciples after themselves [as their followers]." Acts 20:29-30 (Amplified).Don't assume anyone mentioning the name of Jesus is teaching the accurate revelation of Jesus. Have an open-mind to learn, yet don't easily buy into everything you hear. Be like the Bereans, search the scriptures to confirm every teaching. (Acts 17:11).Paul the apostle gave the elders in Ephesus the solution:"Therefore be continually alert, remembering that for three years, night or day, I did not stop admonishing and advising each one [of you] with tears. And now I commend you to God [placing you in His protective, loving care] and [I commend you] to the word of His grace [the counsel and promises of His unmerited favor]. His grace is able to build you up and to give you the [rightful] inheritance among all those who are sanctified [that is, among those who are set apart for God’s purpose--all believers]." Acts 20:31-32 (Amplified).
Give your heart and mind to the understanding of the Word of His grace. For grace and truth came through Jesus (John 1:17).
When you are well rooted and built by the word of His grace you will not become a victim of falsehood.Selah. DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Mark 16:14; Deut. 4:9; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32; Ephesians 6:10-18) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow in the understanding of the Word of His grace, so that we will be established and walk in the fullness of truth and not be lured into any falsehood In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 9 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus. - I give my heart and mind to the understanding of the word of His grace. - I delight my heart in the word of God. -  I keep my heart and mind stayed on the word of God. 0h Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 381 - BEWARE OF FALSEHOOD IN YOUR MIDST 2 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BEWARE OF FALSEHOOD IN YOUR MIDST 2 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 7 "But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ" 2 Corinthians 11: 3 (NKJV) What do you think was Paul's greatest concern for the Churches he planted and the people he raised?
It is that they will not be moved away from the gospel of Jesus.
And that is the same concern of all the Apostles of Jesus. Today's Church has a different understanding of who a False Teacher, False Prophet and False Apostle is in their midst. Most Teachers, Prophets and Apostles who will be called false are now celebrated by "Christians" as True teachers. The Church doesn't know the difference between another gospel and the true gospel of Jesus. In the previous episode, I mentioned how Paul instructed the leaders in Ephesus to be watchful of false teachers and prophets. He called these false teachers, ferocious wolves. And he said they will speak perverse and distorted things (Acts 20:29-30). These things they speak are contrary to the gospel of Jesus. Remember, there are no two gospels. The gospel of Jesus is the gospel of Grace. See Paul's commendation: "And now I commend you to God [placing you in His protective, loving care] and [I commend you] to the word of His grace [the counsel and promises of His unmerited favor]. His grace is able to build you up and to give you the [rightful] inheritance among all those who are sanctified [that is, among those who are set apart for God’s purpose--all believers]." Acts 20:32 (Amplified). Falsehood has always been in contrast to the revelation or the gospel (the goodnews) of Jesus. Look at the opening verse in context: "I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all."  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)
The simplicity of Jesus is the gospel of Jesus. Your commitment to the gospel is your pure and simple devotion to Jesus.
Stand strong in the glorious revelation of Jesus. Also, note that not all false gospel is preached by fake Pastors or Teachers or Apostles. There are people who are genuinely called of God and sent by Christ, yet may find themselves teaching another gospel. It doesn't mean the people are false, but their message or aspects of their teachings may be false. For example: One will teach that, "You are saved only by grace through faith in Christ Jesus and not by works". That is the true gospel. However, after this person gets people saved, he begins to teach the saints another gospel saying, "Though you are now saved, you can lose your salvation. Your salvation is not forever, it depends on your good works". Beloved, this is a clear example of false teaching. To say one will lose his salvation is to say that, the blood of Jesus is not enough to satisfy the demand of Justice. (I gave over 50 reasons you cannot lose your Salvation, click here to watch). To understand Justification read the following: - Justification 1 - 3 - Justified by Faith - Christ's won freedom wasn't partial - The Case is closed - What shall separate you?
Your salvation only depends on the good works of Jesus. It is not dependent on your works. (Ephesians 2:9).
Now, because you have been made righteous by Jesus, you live right unto God's glory. This is the gospel. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Galatians 1:6-12; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAY We pray that we will not be given to another gospel but will consciously remain strong in the simplicity of the gospel and not swallow any other teaching at all. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 14 - 16  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ. - I am righteous by faith in Christ. - My salvation is eternal. - I give no room for any other gospel. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 382 - BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 1 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 8
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 9th February, 2024BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 1 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 8"But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ" 2 Corinthians 11: 3 (NKJV)Persecution from religious leaders and oppressive political leaders wasn't the only challenge in the first century. False doctrines or heresies which led to schism, were part of the things the Church contended with. False doctrine is not a new thing in the Church within this century.The Church has always contended with false doctrines by false Apostles, Prophets and Teachers.
The epistles were written to the Churches to strongly establish the saints in the sound doctrine of Christ and to uproot heretical teachings.
Even from the context of the opening verse Paul the Apostle, pointed out some deceptive teachings in the Church during the first century:"I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all."  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)These false doctrines which crept into the Church are still lingering.The same concern the apostles had and their warnings still stand.And remember, the target of these deceptive teachings is your faith.
The deception of the adversary focuses on the foundational matters of your faith.
When these heretics are able to deceive you with a teaching of another Jesus, they have destroyed the foundation of your faith.1. Some sects teach that the Jesus who came to die for sin and your sins is not God. These religious sects have to establish publishing firms just to spread their falsehood.
Any doctrine which declares that Jesus is not God is a great deception.
Many religious groups also uphold such stand that Jesus is not God because God cannot become a man.Meanwhile, Jesus was persecuted mainly because He referred to Himself several times as God. He only did things God will do and said things only God will say."He was justifying the importance of His work on the Sabbath, claiming God as His Father in ways that suggested He was equal to God. These pious religious leaders sought an opportunity to kill Jesus, and these words fueled their hatred." John 5:18 (Voice)
To the Jews, for Jesus to call God Father means He is God expressed. To be a Son of God is to be God manifested.
Some deceptively proclaimed that if Jesus was God why did He die?See what happened:"When the Centurion and soldiers who had been charged with guarding Jesus felt the earthquake and saw the rocks splitting and the tombs opening, they were, of course, terrified. Soldiers: He really was God’s Son." Matthew 27:54 (Voice).
Even the soldiers guarding Jesus' body on the cross beheld the power of His divinity.
"And without controversy great is the [a]mystery of godliness:God was manifested in the flesh,Justified in the Spirit,Seen by angels,Preached among the Gentiles,Believed on in the world,Received up in glory." 1 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV)
You see when such doctrines succeed, it doesn't change the divinity of Jesus. It rather affects your confidence in your salvation.
Don't look away from the reality of Jesus.He is God!He is Eternal and His saving Grace is everlasting!His blood which purchased you is a divine blood. It is an eternal blood.JESUS IS GOD!This is the gospel.HallelujahDIG DEEPER(John 1:14; Isaiah 7:14; Isaiah 9:6; 1 John 3:5; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow more and more in the understanding of the divinity of Jesus.In the name of Jesus!  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 17 - 21  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I behold the reality of Jesus in the scriptures. - Jesus is God!- He is Eternal and His saving Grace is everlasting! - I refuse to look away from the reality of Jesus.– I give no room for any other gospel. – I judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus. OhHallelujah!    [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 384 - BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 2 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 9
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 10th February, 2024BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 2 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 9"But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ" 2 Corinthians 11: 3 (NKJV)
One of the core things deception does to you is to make you have a contrary opinion.
It makes you seek other means of fulfilment.The adversary lures you into falsehood by subjecting your thoughts to vain imaginations.Apart from the false propaganda that Jesus is not God, there is another dangerous false doctrine that says, JESUS IS NOT THE ONLY WAY TO THE FATHER!Like Paul the apostle mentioned to the brethren in Corinth:"I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all."  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)It is a seed of unbelief to think that there are different ways to be saved apart from Jesus.God manifested in the flesh as Jesus (John 1:1, 14) to give access to all men unto Himself. Thus, your relationship with God is dependent only on Jesus.Jesus did not come to this world only as a Prophet and a great Teacher. Neither was Jesus a religious leader who came to establish another religion.
Jesus is God who became man to bring men into eternal life and divine living.
He said, "... I am come that you will have life and have it more abundantly." (John 10:10)"And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son." 1 John 5:11 (Berean Study Bible).
Religion promotes man's medium and tradition to access God.
And all of the efforts of men to access God and experience God have been futile.
The truth is that until God reaches out to man, man cannot reach or access Him.
Right from Eden when corruption was found in man, it was man who hid himself from God.It wasn't man who found God, it was God who found man."And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself." Genesis 3:8-10And all through Genesis to the appearance of Jesus, God's plan has been to fully bring man unto Himself to have a deep relationship with Him.
Man has never found a way to fully access and enjoy God, until Jesus came.
The concept of Justification is not to make you go to Heaven after death. The concept of justification is to bring you into an intimate Father-Son relationship with God.And that was established in Christ Jesus."But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us. Much more then, having now been justified by His blood, we shall be saved from wrath through Him. For if when we were enemies we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we shall be saved by His life." Romans 5:8-10 (NKJV)No religion can bring you into this reality.No religion can boast of your justification or eternal salvation.
Salvation is only in Jesus.
"Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?” Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me" John 14:5-6 (Berean Standard Bible).This is the audacity of God!None has made such utterance except Jesus.He brought you complete salvation.
As you have believed and received Jesus, know that you are SAVED!
This is the gospel.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 3:16; Romans 5:5-11; John 14:1 -10; Matthew 1:21; Acts 4:11-12) WE PRAYWe pray that:- our hearts will be established in this reality that Jesus is the way only by which men can be saved.- we shall exercise the boldness and joy to proclaim Jesus as the only way by which men can be saved, without political correctness.In the name of Jesus!  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 22 - 25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is established in the reality that Salvation is only in Jesus. -  I behold the reality of Jesus in the scriptures. - I exercise the boldness and joy to proclaim Jesus as the only way by which men can be saved. - I give no room for any other gospel. - I judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus.Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 384 - BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 3 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 10
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 11th February, 2024 BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 3 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 10"Nor is there salvation in any other, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.” Acts 4:12 (NKJV)Jesus came to bring you into full salvation.If you are born again already, you don't need to think of how you will get saved again. For you are already saved.However, don't believe any doctrine which teaches or even mentions other options for salvation.
Salvation is only in Jesus!
This must settle in your heart.No religion promises or boasts of Salvation. Not to even mention Eternal Salvation.
Don't be gullible; don't accept any false doctrine of men and don't fall for their godless imaginations.
Let's look again at Paul's concern for the Church in Corinth:"I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all."  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)
Don't swallow any doctrine which points to another Jesus and a different way to be saved.
After Peter and John were arrested for getting the lame healed, they were brought before the Jewish leaders. Peter gave one of the most beautiful responses to their questions:"And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole. This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner. Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved." Acts 4:9-12 (KJV).Did you notice the audacity and conviction in the words of Peter?This is more than a religious utterance. It is the declaration of the reality of Jesus. The matter of salvation is a matter of life.
It is only Christ Jesus you receive the impartation of the divine life.
Beloved in Christ let no one sway you off this truth. Walk in this glorious reality of Jesus: HE IS THE ONLY WAY, THE TRUTH AND THE LIFE!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 3:16; Romans 5:5-11; John 14:1 -10; Matthew 1:21; Acts 4:11-12) WE PRAYWe pray that many will behold Jesus as the only way they can receive and experience true salvation.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 26 - 27 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is established in the reality that Salvation is only in Jesus. -  I behold the reality of Jesus in the scriptures. - I exercise the boldness and joy to proclaim Jesus as the only way by which men can be saved. - I give no room for any other gospel. - I judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 385 - BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 3 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 10
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 11th February, 2024 BEHOLD THE REALITY OF JESUS 3 - DEALING WITH DECEPTION 10"Nor is there salvation in any other, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.” Acts 4:12 (NKJV)Jesus came to bring you into full salvation.If you are born again already, you don't need to think of how you will get saved again. For you are already saved.However, don't believe any doctrine which teaches or even mentions other options for salvation.
Salvation is only in Jesus!
This must settle in your heart.No religion promises or boasts of Salvation. Not to even mention Eternal Salvation.
Don't be gullible; don't accept any false doctrine of men and don't fall for their godless imaginations.
Let's look again at Paul's concern for the Church in Corinth:"I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all."  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)
Don't swallow any doctrine which points to another Jesus and a different way to be saved.
After Peter and John were arrested for getting the lame healed, they were brought before the Jewish leaders. Peter gave one of the most beautiful responses to their questions:"And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole. This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner. Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved." Acts 4:9-12 (KJV).Did you notice the audacity and conviction in the words of Peter?This is more than a religious utterance. It is the declaration of the reality of Jesus. The matter of salvation is a matter of life.
It is only Christ Jesus you receive the impartation of the divine life.
Beloved in Christ let no one sway you off this truth. Walk in this glorious reality of Jesus: HE IS THE ONLY WAY, THE TRUTH AND THE LIFE!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 3:16; Romans 5:5-11; John 14:1 -10; Matthew 1:21; Acts 4:11-12) WE PRAYWe pray that many will behold Jesus as the only way they can receive and experience true salvation.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 26 - 27 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is established in the reality that Salvation is only in Jesus. -  I behold the reality of Jesus in the scriptures. - I exercise the boldness and joy to proclaim Jesus as the only way by which men can be saved. - I give no room for any other gospel. - I judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 385 - WORKING THE WORD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 12th February, 2024WORKING THE WORD 1“So everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them, will be like a wise man [a far-sighted, practical, and sensible man] who built his house on the rock" Matthew 7:24 (Amplified)
The Word of God is God's constitution of wisdom and His creative material.
You will find in the scriptures that, God founded and made the universe by His wisdom (Proverbs 3:19; Psalm 104:24). And you will find in other places in the scriptures that by the Word of God He formed the universe (Hebrews 11:3).Now this is not a contradiction at all.(Remember there is no contradiction in the entire Bible, if a concept seems contradictory, just make time to search through the scriptures patiently. You will find understanding and proper interpretation).
The Wisdom of God is embodied by the articulation of God. God's Word is the expression of His thought or the articulation of His intent.
Thus, the Word of God is the expression or articulation of the Wisdom of God.There is nothing God has built without His word.
To know the Word of God is to handle Wisdom.
Everything works by the Word of God.When one thinks the Word doesn't work, such a person has not trained himself to be a practitioner of the Word.When you hear the Word, you must put it to work. The word by itself doesn't work. The word works on a receptive heart which focuses on acting it.
You must have this understanding, THE WORD OF GOD WORKS!
And that is how God sees His word."And as the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and return no more thither, but soak the earth, and water it, and make it to spring, and give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater: So shall my word be, which shall go forth from my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall do whatsoever I please, and shall prosper in the things for which I sent it." Isaiah 55:11 (Douay-Rheims Bible)Any word which proceeds from God has a purpose designed for it. It also has the in-built ability to achieve its destined intent.When you decide to act it out, it will bring you the results.The Word of God does not fail.Though this analogy is limited, it should help you grasp this Wisdom:Imagine you were stranded in a place and suddenly your good friend parks his car by you, and tells you "Get in, I had a call to pick you up to your destination".Will you still be standing there hoping to arrive at your destination?I don't think so.You have to trust your friend, and then get into his car before you will arrive at your destination.That is how the word works.
No matter the ability of the Word, it will need your decision to respond rightly to it before you will experience the expected results.
You must trust the Word, enough to do what it says.Don't assume it doesn't work.
The results of the Word will manifest when you act it!
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 46:10; Matthew 4:4; Deuteronomy 17:18-19; Isaiah 55:8-13; James 1:22) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall develop confidence in the power of the Word and walk in the established assurance that it does not fail.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 28 - 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I work the word. - I am a practitioner of the Word of God. - I have confidence in the power of the Word - The walk daily in this certainty that the Word of God does not fail. - The Word of God works! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for the gift of your unfailing Word.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 386 - WORKING THE WORD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 13th February, 2024 WORKING THE WORD 2"So shall my word be, which shall go forth from my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall do whatsoever I please, and shall prosper in the things for which I sent it." Isaiah 55:11 (Douay-Rheims Bible)Beloved, the Word of God does not fail. Whatever God teaches through His Word is TRUTH.
The Word carries the potency of results and answers.
Someone may ask, "But why is the word not working for me?"The Word works, however, the working ability of the Word is expressed through those who trust it and act it out.The electrical power in your home works, but it wouldn't automatically power your gadgets without connectivity.Until you switch the power on, you won't enjoy the effect of its power.To see the working ability of the Word, you must have it activated.
You have to take the promises, the instructions and the revelation of the Word of God as life.
The Word of God is as a seed (Luke 8:11).Every seed has the potential to become a forest.It needs the right environment to germinate, grow and bear much fruit.Your heart is the environment for the planting and germination of the Word.
Anything that will manifest in your life must first germinate in your heart.
"Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life." Proverbs 4:23 (NLT)
Until the blessing of God's Word saturates your heart, you will not see its manifestation in your life.
This is why the condition of your heart is a crucial matter in the manifestation of the Word of God."And the seeds that fell on the good soil represent honest, good-hearted people who hear God’s word, cling to it, and patiently produce a huge harvest." Luke 8:15 (NLT)The Word of God will definitely produce the results, just train your heart to cling to the Word and patiently engage the Word to produce a great harvest.HallelujahSelahDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 46:10; Luke 6:45; Matthew 4:4; Isaiah 55:8-13; James 1:22) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall intentionally cling to the Word of God and engage it with patience.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 32 - 35 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I put the Word of God to work in my life. – My heart is clinged to the Word of God. – I have confidence in the power of the Word. – The walk daily in this certainty that the Word of God does not fail. – The Word of God works! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for the gift of your unfailing Word.

title: EPISODE 387 - WORKING THE WORD 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 14th February, 2024 WORKING THE WORD 3"So shall my word be, which shall go forth from my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall do whatsoever I please, and shall prosper in the things for which I sent it." Isaiah 55:11 (Douay-Rheims Bible)The impact of the Word of God in your life requires these three (3) key items:1. Trust the the WordTo trust the Word is to see and receive the Word with meekness."... receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls." James 1:21 (ESV)How do you see the Word of God? Do you have confidence in the Word of God? Do you believe beyond every doubt that the Word of God is true? Can you stake your life on the Word?2. Conceive and Cultivate The Word"How I love to do your will, my God! I keep your teaching in my heart" Psalm 40:8 (GNT)The Environment you create for the Word is your heart. The Word is a seed (Luke 8:11) and must be cultivated in the right environment.
To cultivate the Word is to allow the Word to work in your heart.
3. Act the Word (James 1:22)Until you work out the Word of God, which has been worked into you, it will not manifest.However, the most crucial part is to allow the Word to work in you.
When the Word of God grows in your heart, it will definitely influence your action.
This then makes it necessary for us to look into the Cultivation of the Word. The decision or conviction to cultivate the Word in your heart is the evidence that you trust it.
Until you trust the Word or have the right picture of the Word, you will not invest proper efforts to cultivate it.
Why is it then necessary to cultivate the Word?This is because the WORD IS A SEED.Yes, I have to repeat it till you understand it.The word "SEED" is mostly translated from the Greek word, "SPERMA", this is also the root for the English word, SPERM.
Consistent miraculous life doesn't just happen. People don't just have results. Results are born!
You may pray and be expecting a miracle, but until the Word is conceived and cultivated, you may get disappointed and feel frustrated.Every seed has the potential to become a forest.  However, you have to conceptualize it.It has to go through incubation in your heart.Just so you know, the heart mentioned here doesn't refer to your physical organ which pumps blood through the circulatory system by rhythmic contraction and dilation.
The heart discussed here comprises; your mind, will, emotions and spiritual consciousness. It is the core of your being.
 Every word of God sent to you is to produce a result or achieve a purpose in your life. However, you have to conceptualize it in your heart. 
The word of God is powerful, yet it doesn't work automatically. Miracles or results of the Word don't just happen as the explosion of a dynamite.
When people find themselves in challenges, they expect sudden miracles and find it difficult to receive the Word. They see the Word to be lifeless and powerless. They assume the word cannot solve or it's not enough to solve their problems.That is how a seed is, when you look at a seed, it may seem tiny, lifeless and powerless. Nevertheless, every seed contains LIFE and the ABILITY TO MULTIPLY.To prove that a seed has power and life, you have to plant it.
Until you plant the word of God in your heart it will seem to be lifeless and powerless.
Look away from your challenges. Receive the engrafted word of God into your heart. Allow the revelation of the Word to be planted in your heart.Your heart is like the womb of a woman. If a lady wants to get pregnant and give birth to a baby, she must get the male sperm into her womb.
Until the sperm or seed  (the Word) gets into your womb (heart), it will not bear much fruit.
Hallelujah!Selah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:11; Isaiah 46:10; Luke 6:45; Matthew 4:4; Isaiah 55:8-13; James 1:22) WE PRAYWe pray that the right seed of the word to birth a specific miracle will be conceived in our hearts.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 36 - Deuteronomy 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I always have the right posture of meekness in receiving the Word of God. - I have great confidence in the Word of God. - I allow the Word to work in my heart. - The Word of God has power over me. - I am a doer of the word. - I invest the Word of God into my heart daily and diligently. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 388 - WORKING THE WORD 4
content:
