CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 15th February, 2024 WORKING THE WORD 4"So shall my word be, which shall go forth from my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall do whatsoever I please, and shall prosper in the things for which I sent it." Isaiah 55:11 (Douay-Rheims Bible)Until the Word of God is sown in your heart, it will not produce any results in your life.How well have you conceived the Word in your heart?
Before you become a doer of the Word, your heart must be saturated with the Word.
When the Word of God grows in your heart, it will definitely influence your actions.The growth of the Word in your heart is the germination and increase of faith in you.This then makes it necessary to look into the cultivation of the Word. The decision or conviction to cultivate the Word in your heart is the evidence that you trust it."Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock." Matthew 7:24 (BSB)
Before you can act on the Word to see results, you have to first receive the Word.
This begins with the hearing of the Word, before action."How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching?" Romans 10:14 (ESV)Cultivation is the process of working the word in your heart. This period of cultivation is between the time you heard or received the Word into your heart and the time the Word manifested in your life.This is the most crucial period of your faith walk.Most believers don't pay attention to the season of cultivating the word. You don't have to be in a hurry to manifest the Word. You have to patiently incubate the word of God in your heart till it matures.
The one who has a strong expectation of a miracle is the one who has patiently cultivated the Word.
Look at the one who produces a huge harvest or great results by the Word:"And the seeds that fell on the good soil represent honest, good-hearted people who hear God’s word, cling to it, and patiently produce a huge harvest." Luke 8:15 (NLT)Here is the process of cultivating the Word:1. Hear the Word2. Cling to it3. And patiently produce the harvest.You don't hear a Word from God, go to bed and expect a miracle to happen. You must lay hold of that miracle by laying hold on the Spirit and Life of the Word in your heart.This process of cultivating the Word is also known as MEDITATION!
It is through meditation of the Word you develop ownership of that Word.
The words you read in the Bible are powerful but don't produce anything until they germinate in your heart through meditation.
For the Word to transcend from being a text to a life-changing force, there has to be intense meditation.
There are people who know so many verses of the Bible but have little results. You may have the awareness of the scriptures and not walk in the manifestation of what it says.Psalm 23:1 "The Lord is my Shepherd I shall not want", is one of the most popular verses in the Bible, but how many people are walking in the full manifestation of that word?They quote it without allowing the life of the Word to be transmitted into their consciousness.
Don't only be aware of the scriptures, walk in the light of it through meditation.
Hallelujah!Selah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 1:2; Psalm 119:11, 15; Isaiah 46:10; Luke 6:45; Isaiah 55:8-13; James 1:22) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall patiently give our hearts to the vigorous work of meditation on the Word of God. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 3 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I mediate daily on the word of God. - I always have the right posture of meekness in receiving the Word of God. - I have great confidence in the Word of God. - I allow the Word to work in my heart. - The Word of God has power over me. - I am a doer of the word. - I invest the Word of God into my heart daily and diligently. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 389 - WORKING THE WORD 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  WORKING THE WORD 5"So shall my word be, which shall go forth from my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall do whatsoever I please, and shall prosper in the things for which I sent it." Isaiah 55:11 (Douay-Rheims Bible)Every word of God to you is true.
The Word of God doesn't fail.
You can have the testimony you are expecting. You can walk in that total health. You can experience prosperity in all you do.You can walk in multiplication and increase in superabundance of grace.
You can turn everything that comes in contact with you into gold.
You can have a glorious marriage. You can see the mighty hand of God in your business. You can live a life of favor.
Don't allow your present condition to define you. It doesn't matter how bad your situation is or has been. There is hope for you.
Every problem you see around you is a wisdom problem. The wisdom of God is all you need to manifest the glory of God in your life. The word of God is the magnum of God's wisdom. You must be rapt in the Word if you want to walk in God's will for your life and enjoy good health, abundance of grace, limitless success and prosperity at every phase of your life.I have already explained the need to create the right environment in your heart for the Word.
You can have a consistent life of glory; this is by the MEDITATION OF THE WORD.
Look at what God said to Joshua after Moses' death:"This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success." Joshua 1:8 (ESV).The above verse or scripture is the elixir for good success.Many want to see good success or the accomplishment of the Word, yet are not willing to work the Word.
You cannot be a doer of the Word if you have not given yourself to MEDITATION or the CULTIVATION of the WORD.
The outline is clear:1. GOOD SUCCESS is the goal or target of the Word in your heart.2. The milestones towards your goal: MAKE YOUR WAY PROSPEROUS (which means you experience prosperity at every stage and in all you do until you experience God's design of total success).How?MEDITATION or CULTIVATION of the Word.
Meditation is the fanning of God's truth in your heart until it becomes a strong burning flame.
It is the process of internalizing a specific word of God to you by continuously and consistently regurgitating that very Word in your thoughts and on your lips until you become a visible representation of that Word.Until you patiently handle the Word of God this way, you will not see its manifestation.Have you received a word from God concerning your finances, job, vision, family, relationship, ministry etc?If yes, what are you waiting for?
Switch into MEDITATION MODE.
If you have not received a word then, study the scriptures in the Dig Deeper section or search on other topics related to your burdens on this platform and you will receive a word.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 1:2; Psalm 119:11, 15; Deuteronomy 6:5-6; 29:9; Isaiah 46:10; Luke 6:45; Isaiah 55:8-13; James 1:22) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not be drifted away from the meditation of the Word no matter the pressure from the vicissitudes of this world.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a doer of the word. - I mediate daily on the word of God. -  Through the meditation, I invest the Word of God into my heart daily and diligently. - I allow the Word to work in my heart. - I am a man fully given to the meditation of the Word. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 390 - WORKING THE WORD 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 17th February, 2024 WORKING THE WORD 6"I will meditate on Your precepts, And contemplate Your ways." Psalm 119:15 (NKJV)Throughout this week we have patiently been looking into How to Work the Word of God.I have explained that for the Word to manifest in your life:- you must first trust the Word and have the conviction that the Word Works.- you must create an environment for the Word to be sown, this is the environment of your heart.- you must intentionally see the word of God as a seed.- you must understand how to cultivate the word of God in your heart.- and you must understand that through the cultivation or meditation of the Word you can create good success.Again, let's see what God said to Joshua after Moses' death:"This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success." Joshua 1:8 (ESV).I mentioned previously that the above scripture is the elixir for good success.
Meditation is not a mere religious cliché. It is a proven divine method for good success.
This statement to Joshua is repeatedly affirmed in the scriptures.Take a look at another verse:"But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in His law he meditates day and night. He shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also shall not wither; and whatever he does shall prosper." Psalm 1:2-3 (NKJV)This is exciting.
There is so much the meditation of the Word does to you, it brings the richness of the Word of God unto fruition in your life.
Some struggle to be diligent in meditating on the Word of God because they have not made it their delight.This is the point:Whether you are conscious of it or not, you are always involved in some level of meditation. The issue has always been what you are meditating on daily. If you want to see the results of the Word of God, you must meditate on the Word. 
Until the Word of God becomes your delight, you will not make it your object of meditation.
Therefore delight in the Word.These are basic steps for effective meditation.1. Read the Word (and also listen to the teachings of the Word of Grace).You have access to the Word of God through the reading of the Bible. The Bible addresses every situation. Be an avid reader of the Bible to know what God has said about your situation. The Word of God also comes to you through sound teachings (therefore listen to tapes and be present at Church meetings. God always has a word for you).2. Intentionally memorize the scriptures. Don't be forgetful.Previously, I mentioned that the word doesn't manifest just because you are aware of the scriptures. This doesn't suggest you don't have to be aware of the scriptures. What it means is that memorizing or being aware of the scriptures is not the end in itself. Memorizing the scriptures is useful for meditation. When you memorize a specific scripture, it becomes easy to regurgitate.3. Continue daily, at every given time to think upon or mull over the Word in your heart over and over again. And then mutter, speak those words to yourself, till it becomes your bold and loud joyful confessions.This brings you to the state where you are not only aware of the Word, but you personalize and exercise ownership of the revelation of the Word for your manifestation.Selah.DIG DEEPER(James 1:22-25; Psalm 119:11, Deuteronomy 6:5-6; 29:9; Isaiah 46:10; Luke 6:45; Isaiah 55:8-13) WE PRAYWe pray that:We will have the discipline and diligence to continuously set our hearts on the meditation of the Word.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am given to the meditation of the Word - Through meditation, I set my heart and mind on the Word of God. - I have the discipline and diligence to continuously meditate on the Word. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 391 - WORKING THE WORD 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency WORKING THE WORD 7"But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart” (that is, the word of faith which we preach)" Romans 10:8 (NKJV)The Word of God works and does not fail.And the unfailing potency of the Word is demonstrated by UTTERANCE.You don't work the Word by being silent, you work the Word by speaking.That is the purpose of the Word in your heart.
God's word doesn't produce results until it is spoken.
At every given time when God wanted to bring His Word to pass, He had to speak what He wanted to produce.There was nothing God created in Genesis, without first speaking into being. Your mouth is mainly an instrument in your body for speaking things into being.
The vocalizing or speaking of the Word is the highest point of meditation. At the point of the speech, the seed of the Word has blossomed.
The Word you vocalize at the peak of your meditation is not the same as when it was sown in your heart as a seed.The words you utter at the peak of your meditation of the Word are saturated with deep and lasting impressions. They are words which go forth with faith and the strong certainty of manifestation.
These vocalized Words are called Rhema!
In the New Testament, there are two basic Greek words for "The Word of God", these are "LOGOS" and "RHEMA".Logos refers to the person of the Word; Jesus the living Word (John 1:1) and also the aggregate inspired word or thoughts of God. (2 Timothy 3:16). Logos is the expression of the thoughts of God in speech or written form.Whereas "Rhema" is that definite, specific and accurate word of God to you in the now. It is the present Word of God which has germinated in your heart and is burning on your lips.When you read or study the scriptures, memorize a specific verse for regurgitation and internalization. As you continue thinking about the verse, mutter it to yourself till you begin to vocalize and shout it with joy.At this point, the power of the Word has been activated through meditation. It is now more than a seed, it becomes a weapon of faith (the Rhema word is both a shield and a sword). When you speak forth the Word as Rhema, it becomes a farmer's sickle or a reaping-hook.
The Word goes into your heart as a seed, and through meditation, it comes out as the rhema word for harvesting.
Which area of your life are you seeing challenges and problems?Get the Word of God into your heart as a seed.
Meditate on it until you take hold of the Rhema in your heart.
And then speak it out with boldness to harvest your answers."For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm." Psalm 33:9 (ESV)Oh glory to God, there is a shout in my spirit.
Beloved, until you speak forth the Word, you shall not see a performance.
No matter the matter, don't speak your fears, don't speak your challenges, SPEAK THE RHEMA OF GOD IN YOUR HEART!This is how you see the working ability of the Word of God.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 107:20,25; Psalm145:15; Psalm 147:18; James 1:22-25; Psalm 119:11, Deuteronomy 6:5-6; 29:9; Isaiah 46:10) WE PRAYWe pray that through the meditation of the Word, we will take hold of the definite Rhema for the now.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 15-18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am given to the meditation of the Word – Through meditation, I set my heart and mind on the Word of God. – I have the discipline and diligence to continuously meditate on the Word. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 392 - ACT THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 19th February, 2024ACT THE WORD"Therefore whoever hears these sayings of Mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock" Matthew 7:24 (NKJV) The final phase of working the Word (before experiencing manifestation) is taking steps. When people read their Bibles, they assume as they have read they will just act on it and experience results. They feel disappointed when they don't see themselves acting the word consistently and also not seeing results. This is why I used a week to explain to you the process of internalizing the Word through meditation. The Word of God is not supposed to be an external law which demands your obedience. Your true obedience of the Word must be an organic expression of the Word.
The Word must be transfused into your heart as an inward law or disposition.And this is achieved through effective meditation of the Word.
Just as you will see in Joshua 1:8 — "And the book of this law shall not depart out of thy mouth, and thou shalt meditate in it day and night, that thou mayest know how to do all the things that are written in it; then shalt thou prosper, and make thy ways prosperous, and then shalt thou be wise" (Brenton Septuagint Translation). And also see Deuteronomy 17:19 — "And it shall be with him and he shall read it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear [and worship] the LORD his God [with awe-filled reverence and profound respect], by carefully obeying (keeping foremost in his thoughts and actively doing) all the words of this law and these statutes."(Amplified Bible)
Meditation of the Word activates in you the ability to do the Word.
When you keep meditating on the Word, you are establishing your heart to be conscious of what the Word says. 
The more conscious you are, the more you develop the capacity to do the Word.
It is like a man who looks into a mirror and clings to or keeps the reality of the image he sees and doesn't forget. Such a person does not struggle to act out the Word. "And remember, it is a message to obey, not just to listen to. So don’t fool yourselves. For if a person just listens and doesn’t obey, he is like a man looking at his face in a mirror; as soon as he walks away, he can’t see himself anymore or remember what he looks like. But if anyone keeps looking steadily into God’s law for free men, he will not only remember it but he will do what it says, and God will greatly bless him in everything he does." James 1:22-25 (TLB)  When you receive a word that "The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want". You meditate on it, until your thoughts are saturated and soaked by it. It becomes your conviction, consciousness, confession, confidence and capacity. You then take decisions and steps according to the Word. No matter the situation you find yourself, or the project you have to undertake, you will not be afraid. You know you will enjoy divine supply and divine help, because the Lord is your Shepherd. Beloved, as you spend time to meditate on the Word, take steps as you are inspired by the Lord.
Be a doer of the Word.
Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:8; John 8:31-32; James 2:14-26 Psalm 107:20,25; Psalm 119:11, Deuteronomy 6:5-6; 29:9; Isaiah 46:10) WE PRAYWe pray that through the meditation of the Word, we will receive the ability and wisdom to know how to act on the Word of God. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 19 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a doer of the Word. – I am given to the meditation of the Word – Through meditation, I set my heart and mind on the Word of God. – I have the discipline and diligence to continuously meditate on the Word. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 393- LOVE WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim_Trim.mp4Tuesday, 20th February, 2024 LOVE WISDOM"Say to wisdom, “I love you,” and to understanding, “You’re my sweetheart.” Proverbs 7:4 (TPT)The glorious function of your life is according to the dimension of your wisdom.Every great thing revolves around wisdom.In the same way, every problem is a wisdom problem.
The absence of wisdom is not only the manifestation of foolishness but also the very collapse of a life system.
The very substance of living is hewn out of Wisdom.Nothing finds meaning without Wisdom.By faith we know that the world was framed by the Word of God (Hebrews 11:3), however, the Word of God is the package of Wisdom. Wisdom is embodied by the Word of God.
Thus, the universe came forth by the Wisdom of God. God created all things by Wisdom.
"O LORD, how many and varied are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; The earth is full of Your riches and Your creatures." Psalm 104:24 (Amplified)God laid the foundation of the Earth by Wisdom."By wisdom the LORD laid the earth's foundations, and by understanding he set the heavens in place." Proverbs 3:19 (ISV).No wonder the scriptures reveal Wisdom as the PRINCIPAL THING."Wisdom is the principal thing; Therefore get wisdom. And in all your getting, get understanding." Proverbs 4:7 (NKJV)
To say Wisdom is the principal thing is not an overstatement; for Wisdom is the key which unlocks all treasures.
When you ascend into the Summit or Peak of God, what you will find is the highest dimension of Wisdom. Wisdom is Supreme and the bedrock of life. Light is great yet, the greatest light you will behold is still an offspring of Wisdom.Therefore, LOVE WISDOM!Whatever you love has your attention and desire. Whatever you love you honor.Until you set your mind and desire on Wisdom, the intention to become her expression will not gravitate towards you.
When Wisdom is activated in you, you will know how to build your life and destiny.
For by Wisdom a house is built (Proverbs 24:3). Anyone that builds, does it by Wisdom.As we have seen already, even God created and built the universe by Wisdom.
 Everything that has to do with you, every aspect of your life can only be built gloriously by Wisdom.
Therefore say to Wisdom, "I LOVE YOU" and to Understanding, "YOU ARE MY SWEET HEART".Beloved, Love Wisdom!Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 4:5; Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 8:18-19; Proverbs 3:3:14-24) WE PRAYWe pray that:- the desires or affection of our hearts will be glued to wisdom.- we will develop a strong love for Wisdom and understandingIn the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 23 - 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I love wisdom. - I function by wisdom. - Through wisdom, I build every aspect of my life. - The desires of my heart is glued to wisdom. - As I fellowship daily with the Word of God, I develop a develop a strong love for wisdom and understanding. - I am full of wisdom. - I act in wisdom. - I do all things in wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 394 - KINGS REIGN BY WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  KINGS REIGN BY WISDOM"I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just." Proverbs 8:15 (TPT)The born again in Christ is translated from the power of darkness into the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus.
In His Kingdom, we are all made Kings and Priests.
"and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler over the kings of the earth.To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood, and has made us kings and priests to His God and Father, to Him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen." Revelation 1:5-6 (NKJV)Our reign as kings in Christ doesn't begin after this present world has come to an end. Our reign as kings in Christ is not for the future. It is a NOW responsibility.The scripture says "He has made us...", which means He is not now trying or planning to make us kings and priests.Concerning the saved ones, God says:"But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light" 1 Peter 2:9 (NKJV)You are part of the Lord's nation of kinging-priests. You have the mandate to reign or rule in your sphere; and how you reign, is a display of God's glory.
As kings in Christ, we are to lead our generation with WISDOM.
If in case you are still wondering why you must love Wisdom, this is it:Wisdom empowers Kings to reign.Hear what Wisdom says:"I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just. I empower princes to rise and take dominion, and generous ones to govern the earth." Proverbs 8:15-16 (TPT)How well do you want to influence your world?How do you want to manifest God's glory?How do you want to lead your generation?
Wisdom is the principal thing!
Be intentional about walking in Wisdom.Remember, the Word of God is the constitution of Wisdom."Here are kingdom revelations, words to live by, and words of wisdom given to empower you to reign in life..." Proverbs 1:1 (TPT)
The impartation of the Word of God is the impartation of the revelation of Wisdom and spiritual understanding.
The more you fellowship with the Word of God, the more your thoughts are cultivated and shaped to be consistent with the Wisdom of God.Beloved, Love Wisdom; for by her you are empowered to reign as a King.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 1:1-7; 1 Kings 3:9-14;16-28; Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 8:18-19; Proverbs 3:3:14-24) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be imparted with the rich Secrets of Wisdom and understanding so that we will be able to acquire brilliant strategies for leadership in our generation.In the name of Jesus!BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 27 - 30 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I love wisdom. – I function by wisdom. – Through wisdom, I build every aspect of my life. – The desires of my heart is glued to wisdom. – As I fellowship daily with the Word of God, I develop a develop a strong love for wisdom and understanding. – I am full of wisdom. – I act in wisdom. – I do all things in wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 395 - KINGS REIGN BY WISDOM 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 22nd February, 2024 KINGS REIGN BY WISDOM 2"I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just." Proverbs 8:15 (TPT)It will only take Wisdom to curb the overwhelming burdens of leadership.
Great leadership is not demonstrated when everything is convenient. Great leaders emerge when there is opposition or a challenge.
You are not a great leader just because you command people to serve you. You are a great leader when you provide answers or solutions.
People will be loyal to those who solve problems and inspire them to also become problem-solvers.
Leaders are light-bearers who shine in the darkest situations. You influence your world greatly by shining forth the light of Wisdom in the darkest places.Be the light of the world (John 5:14).
To be the light of the world is to be a dispenser of wisdom.
As born again, you must shine the light of God in your world.Make a decision to increase in Wisdom.As Kings and Priests in Christ, you can only lead by wisdom.This was why Solomon requested for Wisdom and understanding.
No matter how genuine you are, you cannot lead people with great vision without Wisdom and understanding.
"And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of David my father, although I am but a little child. I do not know how to go out or come in. And your servant is in the midst of your people whom you have chosen, a great people, too many to be numbered or counted for multitude. Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, that I may discern between good and evil, for who is able to govern this your great people?” 1 Kings 3:7-9 (ESV)
The capacity of a king to lead great people is not in the size of his muscles or his age. The capacity of a king is in his level of wisdom and understanding.
A man of Wisdom is a man of influence."Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your radiance." Isaiah 60:3 (Holman Christian Standard Bible)Wisdom is radiant and attracts the great.Kings travelled to meet Solomon because of His Wisdom."And people of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom." 1 Kings 4:34 (ESV)The results of Wisdom are its splendour.
When you love and esteem wisdom you shall be honored.
 "If you exalt wisdom, she will exalt you. Hold her fast, and she will lead you to great honor; she will place a beautiful crown upon your head." Proverbs 4:8-9 (TLB)Beloved, increase in Wisdom to reign in life and to influence your world.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 9:23; Isaiah 2:2; Ecclesiastes 8:1; 1 Kings 3:9-14;16-28; Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 8:18-19; Proverbs 3:3:14-24 ) WE PRAYWe pray that the radiance of the Wisdom of God in us shall spread greatly and attract great kings without fading.In the name of Jesus!BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Deuteronomy 30 - 34 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I reign and rule in life by wisdom. – I love and esteem wisdom. – Through wisdom, I build every aspect of my life. – The desires of my heart is glued to wisdom. – As I fellowship daily with the Word of God, I increase in wisdom. – I am full of wisdom. – I do all things in wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 396 - THE FELLOWSHIP AND SOURCE OF TRUE WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 23rd February, 2024 THE FELLOWSHIP AND SOURCE OF TRUE WISDOM"And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding beyond measure, and breadth of mind like the sand on the seashore" 1 Kings 4:29 (ESV)There have been different opinions on what really is the source of Wisdom.And the challenge has been the kinds of Wisdom.(We will take a look into this later).Some have defined wisdom as the application of knowledge.Others also consider Wisdom as "the body of knowledge and experience that develops within a specified society or period."These make others think the source of TRUE WISDOM is the acquisition of knowledge either through books or any medium of knowledge and information among men.
TRUE WISDOM transcends the application of accumulated knowledge.
If Wisdom is the accumulation of knowledge, then the learned men with the highest degrees or doctorates from the highest universities of the world should be the wisest men on earth.But that is not the case.
TRUE WISDOM IS IMPARTED.
WISDOM IS SPIRITUAL.Spirituality is a practice of Wisdom. The higher your spirituality, the higher you exude Wisdom.
The highest peak of Wisdom is accessed at the highest point of intimacy with God.
This is why becoming a "Bible Scholar" doesn't guarantee that, you have handled the Wisdom of God through the Scriptures. A doctorate in Theology is good, but it doesn't guarantee the IMPARTATION OF TRUE WISDOM.
TRUE WISDOM, is the RICHEST and PUREST WISDOM. And this Wisdom is only from God.
Until God imparts you with His Wisdom, you cannot have access to the fellowship of His Wisdom.This is because God is His Wisdom. You cannot separate God from His Wisdom.David raised and taught Solomon, mainly to relate with God (1 Kings 2). Definitely, Solomon had some exposure to some information around him. Yet, he had to pray to God for Wisdom and understanding.The scriptures are clear that the Wisdom of Solomon didn't come from men nor the information he gathered while growing up.Solomon prayed for Wisdom."And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of David my father, although I am but a little child. I do not know how to go out or come in. And your servant is in the midst of your people whom you have chosen, a great people, too many to be numbered or counted for multitude. Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, that I may discern between good and evil, for who is able to govern this your great people?” 1 Kings 3:7-9 (ESV)And God responded:"Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee." 1 Kings 3:12 (KJV)
No amount of information you gather will bring you into the fellowship of God's Wisdom.
"For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding." Proverbs 2:6 (KJV)You can only come into the fellowship of God's Wisdom by GOD Himself.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(James 1:5-6; Proverbs 1:7; Ecclesiastes 2:26; 1 Corinthians 1:25; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall impart our hearts with His Wisdom.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the true wisdom of God at work in me. - As I daily fellowship with the word, I increase in this wisdom. - I am full of wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 397 - THE FELLOWSHIP AND SOURCE OF TRUE WISDOM 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 24th February, 2024THE FELLOWSHIP AND SOURCE OF TRUE WISDOM 2"For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding." Proverbs 2:6 (KJV)It is interesting how most people think they can access True Wisdom in the strangest places on earth.Some sought for Wisdom from the biggest library in the world. Others travel to the far East to search for Wisdom among the orientals.The question is, what kind of Wisdom are you looking for?Oh, is it the Wisdom of men or demonic wisdom?Among men and demonic cults, there are bodies of knowledge and experiences which are developed and aggregated as wisdom.Though this body of knowledge and experiences are referred to as wisdom, they are nothing close to the PURE AND TRUE WISDOM OF GOD.They are not transcendent and have no timeless preeminence."But the wisdom from above is always pure, filled with peace, considerate and teachable. It is filled with love and never displays prejudice or hypocrisy in any form" James 3:17 (TPT)So there is a Wisdom from above and there is a wisdom of men. The wisdom from men is  earthly, unspiritual and devilish or demonic. (See James 3:15).
The Wisdom from above is the Heavenly Wisdom or the Divine Wisdom. It is God's kind of Wisdom.
This Wisdom can only be accessed in God.Those who have given themselves to their own imaginations and turned away from God, pursue wisdom from the created things or creation instead of the Creator. Do I deny the intelligent  design in creation?Not at all. There is a display of excellence within creation which marvels every observer. Yet, no man should make the created things their ultimate source of Wisdom.Men bow and submit their minds and will to the intelligence of creation. They idolise the created things and make them their source and confidence of wisdom. They turn away from the eternal Wisdom of God; and then depend on the lies and fables constructed through demonic deceptive thoughts. They then establish these deceptive demonic thoughts as their Wisdom.They observe and experiment with the stars, the seas or the ocean, water bodies, beasts of the field, climatic occurrences, strange plants and even some man-made objects to obtain certain knowledge which resonates with their imagined belief system; they then establish those body of knowledge and experiences as their Wisdom. This is passed  on from one generation to the other as their traditions. Some of these traditions are ordained by men as  ancient landmarks.
Precious one, any landmark which doesn't have the knowledge of Christ as its essence and expression, is a mere tradition built with deception as the core of its foundation. 
Why make the finite and temporal entities your source of Wisdom, instead of the DESIGNER OF ALL CREATION — GOD?The created things are articulations and display of a dimensional glory of  Wisdom's handiwork. They are not the crust or embodiment of Wisdom.You may even think true and pure wisdom comes with age. Age is not necessarily the accumulation of wisdom.  Age is an accumulation of experiences. Experiences are limited by a persons level of exposure. This is why experience is not the best teacher.Pay attention to what Elihu said," I said, 'Age should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.’But there is a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty gives him understanding. Great men are not always wise,Nor do the aged always understand justice." Job 32:7-9 (NKJV).Pure and true Wisdom emanates from the Almighty God.Selah!DIG DEEPER(James 1:5-6; Proverbs 1:7; Ecclesiastes 2:26; 1 Corinthians 1:25; James 3:17)  WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be decieved into esteeming the created things above God who is the source of pure and true Wisdom.In  the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to esteem any created thing above God who is the source of true wisdom. - I esteem the Word of God in my life. - I walk in wisdom. - I cease to be ordinary. - My understanding is opened as I fellowship daily with the Word of God. - I am wise. Oh Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 398 - THE FELLOWSHIP AND SOURCE OF TRUE WISDOM 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim_Trim.mp4 THE FELLOWSHIP AND SOURCE OF TRUE WISDOM 3"For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding." Proverbs 2:6 (KJV)
Until you understand the value of Pure Wisdom you may not know how impossible it is to access it outside God.
You are being reminded and concientized through these episodes, that you will fully understand this truth that Pure Wisdom can only be accessed in God.There are times when people hear or read things like this and only see it as a mere form of religious fanatism.As I mentioned previously, the created things depict the creative handiwork of Wisdom but not the embodiment of Wisdom.Just as all things have their original source, God is the originality of True Wisdom.
The Wisdom of God is transfused into you when you fully set your heart on God.
Because men have cultured their minds toward religious mysticism, they don't embrace the simplicity of divine things. They will rather prefer complex rituals through complex means to attain great Wisdom. Yet God through His Word has revealed the root and embodiment of His Wisdom.Take a look at how Job establishes the reality that, you can enjoy the fellowship of Wisdom only in God, for He alone is the source of Wisdom.See Job 28 (NKJV):"Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place where gold is refined." v 1"That path no bird knows, nor has the falcon’s eye seen it. The proud lions have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed over it." v 7-8"Man does not know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.The deep says, ‘It is not in me’; and the sea says, ‘It is not with me.’It cannot be purchased for gold, nor can silver be weighed for its price.It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.Neither gold nor crystal can equal it, nor can it be exchanged for jewelry of fine gold.No mention shall be made of coral or quartz,For the price of wisdom is above rubies.The topaz of Ethiopia cannot equal it, nor can it be valued in pure gold." v 13 - 19"It is hidden from the eyes of all living, and concealed from the birds of the air.Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a report about it with our ears.’" v. 21 - 22So now we see that all the created things men would boast of as sources of Wisdom have never had a grip on what Wisdom is at all.Now twice in Job 28 (verses 12 and 20), Job asks:“But where can wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?" v. 12“From where then does wisdom come? And where is the place of understanding?" v. 20The point Job kept making is this:
The most complex and mysterious places of men are not the embodiment of True Wisdom.
Jobs answer to his rhetoric question was this:"God understands its way, and He knows its place." v. 23" Then He saw wisdom and declared it;He prepared it, indeed, He searched it out." v 27.Now after Job brings his readers to the realization of God as the source of Wisdom, he gives man the code by which he can fellowship with Wisdom:"And to man He said,‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom..." v. 28
Wisdom is the fear of the Lord. The same thing is also said in Proverbs 9:10:
"Fear of the LORD is the foundation of wisdom. Knowledge of the Holy One results in good judgment." (NLT).
The fear of the Lord is the acknowledgement, submission and honor of God's authority. It is a deep godly reverence which determines how God's counsel influences the way you live.
This is the beginning of Wisdom.Selah! DIG DEEPER(Job 28; James 1:5-6; Proverbs 1:7; Ecclesiastes 2:26; 1 Corinthians 1:25; James 3:17) WE PRAY- our hearts will be trained to deeply and highly revere the authority and person of God.- the counsel of God will strongly influence our lives and affect the way we live unto His purpose and glory.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 9 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to esteem any created thing above God who is the source of true wisdom. – I esteem the Word of God in my life. – I walk in wisdom. – I cease to be ordinary. – My understanding is opened as I fellowship daily with the Word of God. – I am wise. Oh Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 399 - THE PREEMINENCE OF WISDOM 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE PREEMINENCE OF WISDOM 1"As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her." Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)The more you grow and increase in God, the more you will continue to behold True Wisdom in the highest peak of God.
It is a great error to assume that the wisdom and intelligence of men are in the same league as the Wisdom of God.
True Wisdom is God's unfathomable essence and has no limitation.The people of the world have built their lives on their own wisdom. But the wisdom of the wise (in this world) is foolishness unto God."Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, let him become a fool [discarding his worldly pretensions and acknowledging his lack of wisdom], so that he may become [truly] wise. For the wisdom of this world is foolishness (absurdity, stupidity) before God; for it is written [in Scripture], “[He is] The one who catches the wise and clever in their craftiness;” and again, “The Lord knows the thoughts of the [humanly] wise, that they are useless.”  1 Corinthians 3:18-21Some do acknowledge God's Wisdom as a superior Wisdom. However, assume that the measure of God's Wisdom begins from the highest Wisdom of men. That is a mere assumption. 
The foundation and beginning of the Wisdom of God is godly reverence and devotion of love to God.
The highest wisdom of the world or men is foolishness to God. God reckon the Wisdom of men as useless. There is no way God's wisdom will begin from foolishness.In Daniel 2, King Nebuchadnezzar demanded that the wisest men in Babylon should tell his dream before he could trust their interpretation (Daniel 2:1-9).These wise men in Babylon were considered the wisest men on earth then, yet couldn't demonstrate Wisdom.The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on earth who can tell the king this matter, for no king, lord or ruler has ever asked such a thing as this of any magician or enchanter or Chaldean." Daniel 2:10 (Amplified)Their response was a shred of evidence of the limitation of the wisdom of men.These wise men of Babylon also demonstrate their intelligence and wisdom through accumulated information or knowledge. However, through Daniel, we will see that True Wisdom is imparted from above by God.
One of the key preeminence of the Wisdom of God is that it cannot be accessed or accumulated through human intelligence.
Daniel accessed the solution to the king's demand through the Wisdom imparted by God.For Daniel to pray to God for an answer means he reveres and acknowledges God as his source.Observe his prayer after God revealed the secret of the king to him."Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night, and Daniel blessed the God of heaven. Daniel answered,“Blessed be the name of God forever and ever,For wisdom and power belong to Him.“It is He who changes the times and the seasons;He removes kings and establishes kings.He gives wisdom to the wise and [greater] knowledge to those who have understanding!“It is He who reveals the profound and hidden things; He knows what is in the darkness,And the light dwells with Him.“I thank You and praise You, O God of my fathers,For You have given me wisdom and power;Even now You have made known to me what we requested of You,For You have made known to us [the solution to] the king’s matter.” Daniel 2:19-23 (Amplified).Daniel was not wise in his own eyes (Proverbs 3:7). He did not lean on his own understanding but trusted the Wisdom of God.No matter the challenge which confronts you, don't turn to the wisdom of men; for it is not wisdom at all. Trust in the superior or preeminent wisdom of God through His Word.Selah! DIG DEEPER(Job 28; Daniel 2:1-49; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; 1 Corinthians 1:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that through us the preeminence or superiority of the Wisdom of God shall be made manifest. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to esteem any created thing above God who is the source of true wisdom. – I esteem the Word of God in my life. – I walk in wisdom. – I cease to be ordinary. – My understanding is opened as I fellowship daily with the Word of God. – I am wise. Oh Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 400 - THE PREEMINENCE OF WISDOM 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE PREEMINENCE OF WISDOM 2"As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her." Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)We have previously discussed the source of True Wisdom. And in that discussion, we also saw that the Wisdom which is from above is embodied in the Word of God.When you decide to turn away from the Word of God and also devalue your relationship with God, you are turning away from True and Pure Wisdom. In the previous episode, we saw the limitations of the wise men in Babylon. Daniel demonstrated the preeminence of the Wisdom of God because he turned to God.
When you set your heart to walk in the Wisdom of God, she will honor and exalt you.
Daniel was honored by Wisdom. (Daniel 2:48-49). Look at Joseph who became a Prime Minister in Egypt because of the workings of God's wisdom.This is the preeminence of God's Wisdom.
Nothing compares to God's Wisdom.
The Wisdom of God is preeminent because:1. Wisdom was in existence before all things were made.“In the beginning I was there, for God possessed me even before he created the universe. From eternity past I was set in place, before the world began. I was anointed from the beginning." Proverbs 8:22-23 (TPT).2. God made the earth by His Wisdom."The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens" Proverbs 3:19 (ESV).There is nothing which shall emerge from the earth that is more greater than Wisdom. Wisdom is the principal thing, by which you unlock all treasuries.3. Wisdom is greater than the might of men.Wisdom is the strength of the wise and her strength exceeds the strongest of men."Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city." Ecclesiastes 7:19 (KJV).4. The Wisdom of God is greater than money and more precious than gold.Is money valuable? Yes, but not more valuable than Wisdom.Wisdom is a defence and money is a defence, however, the transcending reality is that Wisdom gives life. (Ecclesiastes 7:12).There was a point when money failed in Egypt, it was the Wisdom of God in Joseph, that sustained the economy of Egypt. (Genesis 47:15).
It is great to make money, but first, pursue the expression of Wisdom. A man of True Wisdom and understanding is a man of great wealth.
Take another look at the opening verse:"As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her." Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)It is worthless to go after the wisdom of men. What is more precious than Wisdom?What will you ever desire that can be compared to God's Wisdom?
The Wisdom which is from above is above all.
Get Wisdom and get understanding.Selah! DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 8; Job 28; Daniel 2:1-49; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall maintain our focus on Wisdom and not esteem the highest intelligence of men above True Wisdom.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 15 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the wisdom which is from above therefore I am above all. - I esteem the true wisdom of God beyond every highest intelligence of men.  - I cease to be ordinary. - I walk in wisdom. - I am so wise. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 401 - THE PERSON OF WISDOM 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 28th February, 2024 THE PERSON OF WISDOM 1"but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block and to the Greeks foolishness, but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God." 1 Corinthians 1:23-24 (NKJV)Wisdom is transcendent and greatly profitable; even more profitable than the profits of gold and silver. (Proverbs 3:14 - 17)
Wisdom is eternal and better than money.
Wisdom is greater than the might of men and more superior to the weapons of war (Ecclesiastes 9:18).The value of True Wisdom cannot be procured.You cannot get into the most valuable treasury of ornaments, richest library of knowledge and the wealthiest shop of the world to obtain True Wisdom.Am I attempting to overvalue wisdom?"It cannot be purchased for gold, Nor can silver be weighed for its price. It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, In precious onyx or sapphire. Neither gold nor crystal can equal it, Nor can it be exchanged for jewelry of fine gold. No mention shall be made of coral or quartz, For the price of wisdom is above rubies." Job 28:15-18 (NKJV).True Wisdom is unfathomable; and incomprehensible by the natural mind. Wisdom cannot be found even in the arena of the wisest of men. The most learned man cannot even imagine the tiniest piece of wisdom.All the greatest discoveries of science and technology have not even apprehended a teensy of the measureless features of the universe, which came forth by Wisdom."Oh, the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments and His ways past finding out!” Romans 11:33 (ESV)
True Wisdom is deeper and vast than this measureless universe.
Wisdom is deeper than the deepest. The deep says "It is not with me". The eagle with its sharpest eyes cannot see nor rise to the summit of Wisdom. (See Job 28:14,21).Does this make True Wisdom a mere fiction or a hypothetical concept?
True Wisdom is of God and cannot be separated from Him. You cannot find True wisdom outside God.
Wisdom is not just in God; God is Wisdom. Wisdom is a divine person.
Christ is the Person of Wisdom. All divine treasures are embodied in Christ and as Christ.
You can now experience all of God only in Christ. “For it pleased the Father that in Him all the fullness should dwell.” Col. 1:19 (NKJV)The Wisdom of God is not a thing. The Wisdom of God is more than an idea. The Wisdom of God is a person. He is Christ."but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block and to the Greeks foolishness, but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God." 1 Corinthians 1:23-24 (NKJV).
Christ is not now becoming Wisdom, Christ is the Wisdom of God even before the foundation of time.
Therefore, as you have received the life of Christ, you are in the fellowship of the Wisdom of GodHallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 1:1-19; Proverbs 8; Job 28; 1 Corinthians 1: 18-21 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for His Wisdom within our spirit as the life of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 19 - 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I highly esteem the Word of God in my life.  – I cease to be ordinary. – I walk in wisdom. – I am so wise. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 402 - THE PERSON OF WISDOM 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 29th February, 2024 THE PERSON OF WISDOM 2"but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block and to the Greeks foolishness, but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God." 1 Corinthians 1:23-24 (NKJV)Though the Wisdom of God preexisted time and was with God before the universe came forth, no one tangibly saw Wisdom. (See Proverbs 8:22-31)People experienced the handiwork, the impartations and the impressions of Wisdom.Wisdom was experienced through the Word. However, no one had the exact knowledge of the Person of Wisdom.As I mentioned previously, the Wisdom of God is not a thing. The Wisdom of God is more than an idea. The Wisdom of God is a person, He is Christ.
Christ is the Person of Wisdom. He is the expression of God's fullness.
“For it pleased the Father that in Him all the fullness should dwell.” Col. 1:19 (NKJV)Christ brought to light the Perfect Picture of God; for He is the express image of the Father (Hebrews 1:2-3).Christ is the complete and absolute expression of God's fullness (John 1:18).As the expression of God's fullness, He is also the expression of the fullness of God's Wisdom.Of all the expressions of God's Wisdom we will find in the scriptures, it was in Christ Jesus we see the ultimate manifestation of Wisdom.The wisest man that ever lived among men was Solomon.No man demonstrated the level of Wisdom Solomon exuded."And God gave Solomon wisdom and exceedingly great understanding, and largeness of heart like the sand on the seashore. Thus Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the men of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt. For he was wiser than all men—than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the surrounding nations." 1 Kings 4:29-31 (NKJV).He was so wise that he had to try to have a taste of foolishness intentionally. (Ecclesiastes 2:3)The Jews esteemed the Wisdom of Solomon. The kings of the earth travelled from afar to admire, enjoy and glean the Wisdom of Solomon.Yet, Jesus' Wisdom is greater and exceeds all."The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here." Matthew 12:42 (Berean Standard Bible)
The Wisdom of Christ is the grandeur of all Wisdom because He is the Person and the fullness of Wisdom.
No wonder He said, whoever acts on His words is as a wise man that builds his house on a rock. (Matthew 7:24).
Esteem the Wisdom of our Lord Jesus.
Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 1:1-19; Proverbs 8; Job 28; 1 Corinthians 1: 18-21 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall esteem the Wisdom and Words of our Lord Jesus in all we do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joshua 21 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I esteem the wisdom of our Lord Jesus in all that I do. – I cease to be ordinary. – I walk in wisdom. – I am so wise. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 403 - THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 1st March, 2024 THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 1"So be careful how you live. Don’t live like fools, but like those who are wise." Ephesians 5:15 (NLT)You can have the impartation of Wisdom and not walk in Wisdom.A perfect example is Solomon. Solomon, who was well known as the wisest man walked in foolishness at a point in his life.To live by Wisdom is an intentional thing, though Wisdom is imparted. You have to make a decision that you are going to function in Wisdom.Since Christ is the Wisdom of God, anyone who has received Christ has the Wisdom of God mingled in his or her spirit.
The born again in Christ has the Wisdom of God.
When Jesus came, He exuded a dimension of Wisdom no man had ever seen. His words and deeds were the demonstration of True Wisdom.To walk in True Wisdom, follow the example or pattern of Jesus.Any expression of Wisdom which doesn't depict Christ is not complete. Christ is the only complete manifestation of Wisdom.The more you live as Christ, the more you function in Wisdom.
Don't esteem the wisdom of men above the wisdom of Christ. For the wisdom of men always have a limitation.
There was a poor wise man who used his wisdom to save a city and was not remembered. (Ecclesiastes 9:14-16)The question I know you may ask is, "How can a wise man be poor?"The issue is not whether he was remembered or not. The issue is why was he poor?It is the limitation of his wisdom. The wise man had the wisdom to save a city and might not know how to save himself from poverty.But also being rich does not mean you cannot be seen as a fool before God. Having riches doesn't mean you are wise (Luke 12:20)
The Wisdom of God is able to help you make the right decisions in all things.
This is why you should behold Jesus, who is the embodiment of True Wisdom.Our Lord Jesus exudes the mastery of Wisdom in all things. He lacked nothing because, by His Wisdom, He knew how to make things respond to Him.The more the life of Christ finds expression through you, the more great Wisdom is seen in you.To practice True Wisdom is to live as Christ.HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 5:1; Proverbs 9:10; Colossians 1:1-19; Proverbs 8; Proverbs 15:21; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that through the abundant supply of God's grace, we increase in capacity to function as Christ who is the Wisdom of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Judges 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The true wisdom of God is mingled in my spirit. - I am full of the wisdom of God. - I function by wisdom. - I increase in capacity to function as Christ daily. - I make the right decisions in all things at all times. - I refuse to walk in foolishness. - I don't entertain the company of fools. - I am so wise. - I walk in wisdom every day of my life. - By the wisdom of God, I am preserved. Oh Hallelujah!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 404 - THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday. 2nd March, 2024 THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 2"So be careful how you live. Don’t live like fools, but like those who are wise." Ephesians 5:15 (NLT)To walk or live in wisdom is to make wisdom visible to your world.Many don't experience the Wisdom of God in you, just because you spoke of yourself as wise. Wisdom is proven by the way you live.The testament of Wisdom is in how you think, act and articulate your thoughts.This is why the example of Jesus is the perfect presentation of Wisdom.He didn't just declare that He is greater than Solomon, He made it known through His words and deeds also.
Many marveled at Him; not only because He had power. Many marveled at Him because He had the Wisdom to administrate the power of God.
Jesus never flinched at the most intense provocation by the theological scholars of His day. He always had the right answers in the toughest moments. The best way to practice wisdom is to imitate Jesus; for He is the epitome of Wisdom.Even Jesus expects that the works that He did we will do and do greater.“Truly, truly, I say to you, whoever believes in me will also do the works that I do; and greater works than these will he do, because I am going to the Father." John 14:12 (ESV)No wonder He gave the Holy Spirit to those who believed and received Him. The Holy Spirit supplies all who believe in Jesus with the depths of God.The Holy Spirit serves the saints with the riches of God's Wisdom."For God has unveiled them and revealed them to us through the [Holy] Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things [diligently], even [sounding and measuring] the [profound] depths of God [the divine counsels and things far beyond human understanding]. For what person knows the thoughts and motives of a man except the man’s spirit within him? So also no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God. Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the [Holy] Spirit who is from God, so that we may know and understand the [wonderful] things freely given to us by God." 1 Corinthians 2:10-12 (Amplified).
By the Holy Spirit within you, you have the capacity to function as Jesus did.
The following is how Jesus demonstrated Wisdom and you should practice:1. He SPOKE differently and with wisdom; You must also SPEAK differently and with wisdom.Whenever Jesus spoke, there was abundance of wisdom."And all spoke well of him and marveled at the gracious words that were coming from his mouth. And they said, “Is not this Joseph’s son?”Luke 4:22 (ESV)Beloved, you also have capacity to speak Wisdom.The apostles demonstrated this wisdom as well:"We continually speak of this wonderful wisdom that comes from God..." 1 Corinthians 2:7 (TPT).Be intentional about this also that, because you carry the Wisdom of God, your words are saturated with grace and life.SPEAK WISDOM.HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Luke 20:19-40;1 Corinthians 2; Ephesians 5:1; Proverbs 9:10; Colossians 1:1-19) WE PRAYWe pray that will grow in understanding and that grace will be poured on our lips, so that we will always speak life and wisdom at all times and in all situation BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Judges 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The true wisdom of God is mingled in my spirit. – I am full of the wisdom of God. – I function by wisdom. – I increase in capacity to function as Christ daily. – I make the right decisions in all things at all times. – I refuse to walk in foolishness. – I don’t entertain the company of fools. – I am so wise. – I walk in wisdom every day of my life. – By the wisdom of God, I am preserved. Oh Hallelujah!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 405 - THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 3rd March, 2024 THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 3"Imitate God, therefore, in everything you do, because you are his dear children." Ephesians 5:1 (NLT)
The more you live as Christ, the more you walk in practical Wisdom.
Jesus is God made flesh (1 Timothy 3:16). He came as the expression of the fullness of God and as the embodiment of Wisdom.In His earth walk, He showed us how to function and walk in Wisdom. His life was the practical demonstration of the True and Pure Wisdom which is from above.
Anyone who wants to walk or live in Wisdom must practice or imitate Christ.
Previously we looked at how Jesus spoke Wisdom at all times. The depths of your wisdom are not through your communication. However, you must know how to speak the right words in season."The tongue of the wise speaks knowledge that is pleasing and acceptable, But the [babbling] mouth of fools spouts folly." Proverbs 15:2 (Amplified)The communication of the wise is not only in speech but how he or she carries himself or herself. Your posture, your looks, how you move, how you act around those in authority or even the ordinary, how you keep relationships and how you speak.2. The second thing to look at is that wisdom dispenses life."For whoever finds me (Wisdom) finds life And obtains favor and grace from the LORD." Proverbs 8:35 (Amplified)Jesus being the Wisdom of God, came as a dispenser of divine life (John 10:10). He is not just the dispenser of life, He is LIFE. When you have Jesus you have life (1 John 5:11-12; John 10:27-28).Now as born again, you are made one with Christ (1 Corinthians 6:17); therefore, just as Christ is a life-giving spirit (1 Corinthians 15:45), you are also a life-giver.
As the Father sent Jesus to give life to men, you are also sent by God through Christ, to be a dispenser of life.
Jesus said, "As the Father has sent me I also send you..." (John 20:21).You are sent forth by the Lord to go into your world to dispense and bring many into the participation of the life of Christ.
This is your purpose and the practice of Wisdom.
HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 15:4; 11:30; John 17:3; Proverbs 3:17-18; Proverbs 14:25; ) WE PRAYWe pray that will increase in grace and capacity to demonstrate True Wisdom by dispensing the life of God unto many and turning them unto righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Judges 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I feast on the word daily, I increase in grace and capacity to demonstrate the true wisdom of God. - I am a dispenser of life unto many. - Through wisdom, I turn many unto righteousness. - I am full of wisdom. - I function by wisdom. - I am so wise. -  I walk in wisdom every day of my life. Oh Hallelujah!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 406 - THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 4th March, 2024 THE PRACTICE OF WISDOM 4 "The fruit of the [consistently] righteous is a tree of life, And he who is wise captures and wins souls [for God—he gathers them for eternity]. Proverbs 11:30 (Amplified)
Just as Christ came to give life to men, you are also sent by God through Christ, to be a dispenser of life.
Jesus said, "as the Father has sent me I also send you..." (John 20:21).Before the ascension of Jesus, the Lord gave a charge to His disciples to go into the world and make disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:19).Even at the beginning stages of leading His disciples, Jesus was clear on His goal for training them; He said:  "Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men" (Matthew 4:19)To become a fisher of men is to be one who captures men or souls for the Lord.It is also the same as making disciples of all nations unto the Lord. This is how you dispense the life of God and bring many into divine participation.Jesus said,"Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock" Matthew 7:24 (NIV)Which means to win souls (or dispense life or make disciples or become a fisher of men) is a practice of Wisdom.
Winning souls or making disciples is a command or instruction of Jesus. And every instruction of Jesus is the expression of Wisdom; acting on it is a practice of Wisdom.
Now look at it in Proverbs (the wise sayings of Wisdom):"...And he who is wise captures and wins souls [for God—he gathers them for eternity]". Proverbs 11:30 (Amplified)
The salvation of souls is God's strategy of Wisdom to bring many into His eternal fellowship.
Are you a soul winner?Are you involved in soul winning?
To be a soul winner is an opportunity to be involved God's eternal wisdom plan.
Soul winning is a great practice of Wisdom.Demonstrate Wisdom by winning souls for the Kingdom.Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Matthew 18:11; John 17:3; Daniel 12:3; Matthew 13:43; Matthew 19:28; Luke 5:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we will receive abundance of grace to utilize every opportunity given to us by the Lord, to demonstrate True Wisdom by winning many souls unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Judges 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I demonstrate true wisdom by turning many unto righteousness. – I am a dispenser of life unto many. – I am full of wisdom. – I function by wisdom. – I am a soul winner therefore I am so wise. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 407 - SHINE ETERNALLY AS THE STARS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim_Trim.mp4Tuesday, 5th March, 2024 SHINE ETERNALLY AS THE STARS"Those who manifest wisdom will shine like the brightness of the expanse of heaven, and those who turn many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever." Daniel 12:3 (ISV)
A true shining star in the Kingdom is the one who turns many unto righteousness.
From the opening verse, you will realize there is no ending to the shining and brightness of those who turn many unto righteousness.The verse points to what shall be when all things have been consummated. It is a prophetic scripture which brings us to the realization of events at the end of things."And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book. And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt. And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars forever and ever." Daniel 12:1-3 (KJV)The wise are those who will receive the Lord. And those who will shine eternally as stars have not only turned to righteousness or received the Lord, but have also laboured to turn many to righteousness.
The assignment is clearly defined: TURN MANY UNTO RIGHTEOUSNESS.
This is what Jesus came to do, to get many saved (to turn them unto righteousness); and now He has entrusted this assignment unto our care."Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new. And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation; To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation." 2 Corinthians 5:17-19 (KJV).We have been given the mandate and the message to reconcile many unto God.
It doesn't matter your profession or social responsibility, you have a kingdom mandate to turn many unto righteousness.
This is the role of the wise in the Kingdom (Proverbs 11:30).God desires that all men may be saved and come to the knowledge of Christ ( 1 Timothy 2:4).
You are the light of the world, let your light shine; get many saved unto the glory of God.
Are you an eternal shining star in the Kingdom?How are you involved in turning many unto righteousness?Step out of your comfort zone and get someone saved today.Selah. DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 53:11; Luke 1:77; Luke 24:47; Habakkuk 2:14; Isaiah 49:6; Matthew 18:11; John 17:3; Matthew 13:43; Matthew 19:28; Luke 5:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be diligent in the business of our Lord, which is to turn many to righteousness and shine eternally as stars of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Judges 15 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am an eternal shining star in the Kingdom. - I turn many unto righteousness. - It doesn't matter where I find myself, I shine brightly as the light of the world. - Many coming to the knowledge of Christ because of me. - I step out , I don't sit on the fence.  - I spare none. - I am bold and confident about this. - I shine eternally! Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 408 - PORTRAIT OF GRACE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4Wednesday, 6th March, 2024 PORTRAIT OF GRACE"For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ" John 1:17 (ESV)The grace of God is not one of the teachings or doctrines of our faith. The grace of God is the very core of our faith. For many, grace is only a doctrine; and to others, grace is only a person.
Grace is a doctrine, a person and an economy (or arrangements) of God's Kingdom.
The grace of God is the reality of God. The grace of God is also the person of God and He's Jesus.We have seen Jesus as the embodiment of the Wisdom of God. However, He is also the person of the Grace of God.Jesus as the Grace of God is the visible expression of how God dispenses Himself into man and the essence of the administration or economy of God's Kingdom. 
Thus, the grace of God is a quality of the Wisdom of God.
The fullness of God's grace was revealed as Jesus."And the Word (Christ) became flesh, and lived among us; and we [actually] saw His glory, glory as belongs to the [One and] only begotten Son of the Father, [the Son who is truly unique, the only One of His kind, who is] full of grace and truth (absolutely free of deception)." John 1:14 (Amplified).The glory of Jesus is the fullness of grace and truth.This is why no one should think there is the message of Grace and there is the message of Jesus. The gospel of Grace is the revelation of Jesus.
You cannot separate the grace of God from Jesus. You cannot experience the grace of God without Jesus.
As many that receive Christ have received the fullness of Grace and Truth (John 1:12).The grace of God is not a list or a body of rules God is demanding that you obey. The grace of God is the supply of God's life into you for your living.Grace is God dispensing Himself into you as your life and inward disposition.Moses descended from Mount Sinai with the law given to him. The law had demands that which man couldn't keep.
God now came in the flesh through Jesus as the grace of God to become our life.
Now by the grace of God in you through Christ, you have the supply of God to walk in obedience as an expression of God's life.Beloved Jesus is the portrait of God's grace.Glory to God. DIG DEEPER(Romans 5:17,21; Titus 2:11-14; John 1:16-18; Acts 20:24; 2 Thessalonians 1:8) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for bringing Salvation according to His purpose and grace and the supply of His life into us through Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Judges 19 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Thank you Lord for this so great salvation which is according to your purpose and grace. - Thank you Lord for the supply of your life into me through Christ Jesus. - I have the supply of God to walk in obedience as an expression of God's life. Ohh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 409 - PORTRAIT OF GRACE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4Thursday 7th, March 2024 PORTRAIT OF GRACE 2"For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ" John 1:17 (ESV)The Grace of God is not a mere concept, neither is it one of God's character. Grace is the Reality of God.
The Grace of God is Jesus.
Who brought Salvation to all men?"She will give birth to a Son, and you shall name Him Jesus (The LORD is salvation), for He will save His people from their sins.” Matthew 1:21 (Amplified)The child was given the name Jesus, because of who He is and His mandate. He is the Lord who is Salvation."For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world through Him might be saved." John 3:17 (NKJV).From the above verses, we can see that Salvation is a person and His work.Let's also take a look at Titus 2:11:"For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men" (NKJV)Does this suggest that there is another means by which we are saved apart from Jesus?Not at all.
Salvation is only of Jesus. Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved. (Acts 4:12).
At the Jerusalem council, some believers were Pharisees and wanted to mix the gospel with Jewish traditions; precisely the circumcision ritual before the Gentiles can be saved.Peter then rose to address the situation and also said:"Now therefore, why do you test God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear? But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved in the same manner as they.” Acts 15:10-11 (NKJV)
Salvation is through the grace of the Lord Jesus.
What this unveils is that the Grace of God is Jesus Himself.
The Grace of God is not only a doctrine or teaching; the Grace of God is a person and He is Jesus.
Our Lord Jesus is the embodiment and portrait or substance of the Grace of God.Until you see Jesus as the person of Grace, you will think the Gospel of Grace is another message.
Jesus as the emodiment of Grace came to demonstrate or portray the Grace of God to all men.
The teachings of Peter, Paul and the apostles of Jesus were the revelation of Jesus and what He has achieved for all men. This message they preached or taught was the revelation of Grace. This revelation is an extensive expression of the life and reality of God in Christ.
Thus, the gospel of grace is not a different message of Jesus. The gospel of grace is the reality of Jesus.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. (1 Corinthians 16:23) DIG DEEPER(John 1:16-18; Acts 20:24; 2 Thessalonians 1:8; 2 Timothy 1:9-11; 2 Timothy 3:4-5; 2 Corinthians 13:14) WE PRAYWe pray that many will come to experience and enjoy the grace of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ruth 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for this so great salvation which is according to your purpose and grace. – Thank you Lord for the supply of your life into me through Christ Jesus. – I have the supply of God to walk in obedience as an expression of God’s life. Ohh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 410 - PORTRAIT OF GRACE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-3.mp4Friday 8th, March 2024 PORTRAIT OF GRACE 3"For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ" John 1:17 (ESV)The gospel of Grace was not preached after Jesus ascended.Some assume that Jesus did not preach the Gospel of Grace, but preached the Kingdom of God. They claim it was Paul who preached the gospel of Grace.This claim is an issue of misunderstanding.
The Grace of God is the life-essence of God which flows through His Kingdom.
The Grace of God is the disposition and economy (arrangement of the things) of the Kingdom of God.
Fundamentally, there is no distinction between the Gospel of Grace and the Gospel of the Kingdom. The Gospel of Grace is the reality of the Kingdom.
Jesus in His earth walk lived and presented the gospel of Grace through His teachings and His deeds."For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world through Him might be saved." John 3:17 (NKJV).This verse reveals the life mission and the living of Jesus.The law of Moses was different; it demanded, exposed the weaknesses of man and condemned man. The law made it obvious that all men need the Grace of God to receive righteousness.
Salvation to all men did not come by the law of Moses; Salvation came by the appearance of the Grace of God (Titus 2:11).
"Now therefore, why do you test God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear? But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved in the same manner as they.” Acts 15:10-11 (NKJV)Jesus demonstrated this when the Pharisees brought an adulterous lady to Him.“Teacher,” they said to Jesus, “this woman was caught in the act of adultery. The law of Moses says to stone her.  What do you say?” They were trying to trap him into saying something they could use against him, but Jesus stooped down and wrote in the dust with his finger.
