They kept demanding an answer, so he stood up again and said, “All right, but let the one who has never sinned throw the first stone!” Then he stooped down again and wrote in the dust.When the accusers heard this, they slipped away one by one, beginning with the oldest, until only Jesus was left in the middle of the crowd with the woman. Then Jesus stood up again and said to the woman, “Where are your accusers? Didn’t even one of them condemn you?”“No, Lord,” she said. And Jesus said, “Neither do I. Go and sin no more.” John 8:4-11 (NLT).There are a few things to learn from this verse concerning Jesus, who is the Person and Portrait of the Grace of God.1. Unlike the law of Moses which condemns, the Grace of God (Jesus) doesn't condemn.2. The law of Moses condemns and punishes you. The grace of God (Jesus) forgives.3. The accusers themselves who think they uphold the law cannot live by the law nor bear its yoke. Grace (Jesus) helps you and brings you into rest.4. The accusers used the law as a yoke to oppress and to put the sinner to death. However, Grace (Jesus) doesn't only forgive, Grace also defends, preserves, and supplies you with fresh hope, life and the ability to sin no more.
This is the true portrait of the Grace of God and the life of the Kingdom. This is the perfect picture or expression of God.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. (1 Corinthians 16:23)Enjoy His rest.Amen. DIG DEEPER(Romans 8:1-2;31-34; 2 Thessalonians 1:8; 2 Timothy 1:9-11; 2 Timothy 3:4-5; 2 Corinthians 13:14) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall walk in the consciousness of the grace of God and not live under the yoke and oppression of the law. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in the consciousness of the grace of God. - I do not live under the yoke and oppression of the law. - I have been brought into rest in Christ. - The grace of God has supplied me with the ability to sin no more. Ohh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 411 - PORTRAIT OF GRACE 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 9th March, 2024 PORTRAIT OF GRACE 4"For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ" John 1:17 (ESV)The Grace of God is a person. The more you see Jesus, the more you see the Grace of God. He is full of Grace and Truth (John 1:14)
Salvation came by the Grace of God. The Grace of God is the supply of God Himself into you.
Grace came to reveal God's original character. Until Grace came, the picture many had of God was a Supreme Judge with mood swings. And people assume the conduct of men controlled God's mood.They think God is loving and blessing when man makes Him happy, and then He becomes condemning and hateful when man goes wrong. Some even assume that God sees man as His enemy.By the revelation of God's Grace, we see that God's love towards man is not dependent on man but on Himself. God has never seen man as His enemy. Though God hates and frowns at sin, God loves and saves the sinner. This is the Grace of God.
The Grace of God doesn't come to accuse and condemn you. The Grace of God forgives and empowers you to live above sin.
The law of Moses outlines things you should do to become right with God. The law of Moses places unbearable demands on you.  However, the Grace of God dispenses the life of God into you, brings you into the right standing with God and then teaches and helps you to say "No" to ungodliness.Don't run away from God, just because you are struggling with any form of ungodliness. Run to God instead!
The Grace of God is a teacher and your present help; because Jesus is the greatest teacher and helper.
"God’s marvelous grace has manifested in person, bringing salvation for everyone. This same grace teaches us how to live each day as we turn our backs on ungodliness and indulgent lifestyles, and it equips us to live self-controlled, upright, godly lives in this present age." Titus 2:11-12 (TPT)The person of Grace and Truth (Jesus), dispenses Himself into you as life. And then also by the impartation of His life, you live right.
Grace doesn't just tell you what to do, Grace supplies and equips you with the help to express God (to live a self-controlled, upright, godly life).
Grace teaches you to focus on the life of God in you and by that, you turn away from (or say "No" to) ungodliness.The law of Moses demands that you live right to become righteous. Grace teaches you to live right and to say "no" to ungodliness because you have been made righteous in Christ.This is exactly what we saw in the previous episode. Jesus did not accuse nor condemn the adulterer. He forgave her and enabled her not to sin any more.Just in case you are struggling with any addiction, turn to Jesus and receive the supply of Grace to live free from every lawless deed. He is not against you, He is your teacher and helper.
Beloved, grow in this grace and the knowledge of Christ.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. (1 Corinthians 16:23)Enjoy His rest. Amen.https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(Romans 8:1-2;31-34; 2 Thessalonians 1:8; 2 Corinthians 5:17; 2 Timothy 1:9-11; Titus 2:13) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall take advantage of the grace of God to live free from any form of addiction or bondage or ungodliness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 4 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the consciousness of the grace of God. – I do not live under the yoke and oppression of any form of addiction or ungodliness. – I live a bondage free life. – I am at rest in Christ. – The grace of God has supplied me with the ability to sin no more. – I receive the grace to live above any form ungodliness. Ohh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 412 - ARE YOU RUNNING TO GOD OR FROM GOD 1?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-6_Trim.mp4Sunday 10th, March 2024 ARE YOU RUNNING TO GOD OR FROM GOD?"Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other." Isaiah 45:22 (ESV)
One of the biggest lies most people have believed is that "Man is God's enemy".
This has never been the case. God has never seen man as His enemy.On the day when the sin of unbelief entered man's heart, it was man who turned away from God.And this is what happens always. Men always turn away and run from God because of their sense of guilt and condemnation. And that is what the adversary wants.He paints a picture of an angry and unforgiving God to people; that governs how they relate or respond to God.Many are struggling to commune with God or even pray because of their sense of guilt and condemnation.They stay away from taking any responsibility in Church or even avoid Church meetings completely because of their thoughts of imperfection.
Listen, God is not your accuser, He is your Saviour!
After man had turned from God's word to believe in the lies of the adversary, sin entered his heart. Corruption entered man's soul and he began to feel guilty and condemned.And from that scene in the scriptures, most people assume God was angry with man and rejected man.The adversary has always been interested in giving you negative pictures and impressions of God's character."Then the eyes of both were opened, and they knew that they were naked. And they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves loincloths.And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden. But the Lord God called to the man and said to him, “Where are you?” And he said, “I heard the sound of you in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked, and I hid myself.” He said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten of the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?” Genesis 3:8-11 (ESV)From the above verse, you will realize it wasn't God who rejected man; it was man who hid himself from God. Though God knew what had happened to them, He still wanted to connect to man. He came to man, to reach out to them in the garden; and wanted to supply help to them.In Genesis 3, God unveiled His salvation plan to man (we will look into it later).No matter your wrongs or mistakes, don't hide from God. God did not create you to destroy you. No matter the condition of your life, God desires that you will experience Salvation (1 Timothy 2:4).
If you are born again, you are already in God's hands or arms. Stop looking for ways to flee from God because of your wrongs.
"And I give them eternal life, and they will never, ever [by any means] perish; and no one will ever snatch them out of My hand." John 10:28 (Amplified).Maintain the consciousness that nothing shall take you out of God's hands. Enjoy His loving warmth and the supply of His grace.Also, if you are not yet born again and you are reading this today, please don't turn away from God. The best place to run to, with all your imperfections and mistakes, is God's arms.In John 8:4-11, Jesus did not accuse nor condemn the adulterer. He forgave her and enabled her not to sin any more.
God is not "after your head". He is not looking for ways to punish you.
 God wants to have a Fatherly relationship with you. He wants to commune with your heart in a deeper way.Stay in His arms!Selah.DIG DEEPER(Genesis 3:1- 15; Isaiah 59:1; Isaiah 65:24; Proverbs 18:10; Psalm 91:2; Psalm 18:2; Isaiah 30:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the confidence of God's love and saving grace towards us; so we will always remain in His arms. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 8 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Nothing shall take me out of God's hands. - I enjoy the Lord's loving warmth and the supply of His grace daily. - I walk in the consciousness of the grace of God. Oh thank you Lord! Jesus[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 413 - ARE YOU RUNNING TO GOD OR FROM GOD 2?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-7.mp4Monday 11th, March 2024 ARE YOU RUNNING TO GOD OR FROM GOD 2?"Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other." Isaiah 45:22 (ESV)To think that God is your enemy is absurd.God sent His only begotten son to die for you (John 3:16). He didn't send His son to a perfect world."But God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners." Romans 5:8 (NLT)
You are the focus of God's love and kindness. 
You turn away from God because you are looking for love in the wrong places.GOD IS LOVE!Do you think you have badly dishonored God, wickedly lived and opposed God's purpose or doubted God's power and love?Well, God's arms are still open to receive you.
He is your greatest help, don't turn away from Him.
There is a lot to learn from what happened between Jesus and Peter in Matthew 14: "And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It is a ghost!” And they cried out for fear. But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid.” And Peter answered Him and said, “Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water.” So He said, “Come.” And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus. But when he saw that the wind was boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!” And immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and caught him, and said to him, “O you of little faith, why did you doubt?” And when they got into the boat, the wind ceased." Matthew 14:26-32 (NKJV)This is one of the most inspiring stories in the scriptures.From the above verses, Jesus gave us the root of Peter's state; he doubted the Word of the Lord.The issue was not really about the storm, the issue was how Peter doubted.Yet Jesus didn't hold it against him; He helped Peter from sinking.Peter walked on water because he was walking on the words of Jesus until he turned away from Jesus to the boisterous wind which made him afraid.Peter didn't curse, he didn't murmur, he didn't assume Jesus was angry with him. He still trusted the saving grace of the Lord.He shouted, "Lord, save me!".
Beloved, no matter the situation or your failures, run to the Lord. Trust the Lord to help you.
It doesn't matter what you think you are, or the wrongs you think you have done; if you will genuinely turn to the Lord for help, He will help you.”For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved" Romans 10:13 (NKJV)Esteem God's HELP above your challenges. No matter how deep you have sunk into negative addictions, the defeats, the pains, the failures, debts and the ocean of troubles the hand of the Lord is not too short to save you. (Isaiah 59:1).Hallelujah. DIG DEEPER(Joel 2:32; Isaiah 65:24; Proverbs 18:10; Psalm 91:2; Psalm 18:2; Isaiah 30:15) WE PRAYWe pray declaring the abundance of God's help to live above all our weaknesses, our challenges, our failures and fears. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I esteem the help of God above my challenges. - I live above weaknesses, failures and fears. - The Lord is my greatest help. - I run to the Lord at all times. Oh Thank you Lord![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 414 - THE GOSPEL REVEALS THE RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-9_Trim.mp4Tuesday 12th, March 2024 THE GOSPEL REVEALS THE RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GODFor the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start top finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.” Romans 1:17 (Berean Standard Bible)When corruption entered man's heart, man lost the confidence to stand in the presence of God without any sense of guilt."And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden." Genesis 3:8 (KJV)Because of their unbelief, corruption entered them and they felt condemned and imperfect to stand in God's presence.He asked, "Adam, where are you?" (Genesis 3:9).
God is interested in where you are. He wants you to be in His presence.
He made man to commune with him. God is expecting you in the place of deep fellowship with Him.And you can only stand in God's presence by the supply of His righteousness. To reject God is to reject His righteousness. Unbelief doesn't make you receive what God supplies.
To have fellowship or intimacy with God is according to the dispensing of His life and your faith in Him.
From the corruption of man, until Jesus came, man's challenge has mainly been "how to attain the righteousness of God".When the law of Moses was given, the Jews thought the righteousness of God would come by the law.Rather, the law unmasked their weaknesses, imperfections and sins.They were only righteous in their own sight but had a sense of guilt before God."Now do you see it? No one can ever be made right in God’s sight by doing what the law commands. For the more we know of God’s laws, the clearer it becomes that we aren’t obeying them; his laws serve only to make us see that we are sinners." Romans 3:21 (TLB)
The righteousness which is of God can only come by faith through Christ Jesus.
This is why the reality of the Gospel is the greatest gift of God to mankind.The Gospel simply means GOOD NEWS; there are no two Gospels.
The Gospel reveals the righteousness of God which comes by faith. Which means, it unveils or declares how God makes you right in His sight.
The Gospel doesn't declare the list of things you have to do to become righteous. It doesn't point you to your works, it points you to Christ's finished work in terms of your justification.
There is nothing you can do outside what Christ has done which will make you righteous.
The righteousness of God is not revealed by the law, the righteousness of God is revealed by the Gospel of Grace.The more you give attention to the Gospel of Jesus, the more your heart is empowered with the confidence of what God has done for and made you.
When you received Jesus into your heart by faith, you received God's righteousness. You are now the righteous of God in Christ.
Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Romans 3:1-31; Romans 3:21; 2 Corinthians 5:17; Habakkuk 2:4; Romana 9:30; Romans 10:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we grow in the understanding of what God has done for us through Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 15 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ.– My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 415 - THE GOSPEL AWAKENS MORE FAITH 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Wednesday 13th, March 2024  THE GOSPEL AWAKENS MORE FAITH"For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed, both springing from faith and leading to faith [disclosed in a way that awakens more faith]. As it is written and forever remains written, “The just and upright shall live by faith.” Romans 1:17 (Amplified)Salvation is by grace through faith. Faith is your response to any matter on the basis of God's revelation. It is the absolute confidence in God and His Word.
Faith is not automatic; but intentional. Faith is released or generated by the Word of God.
"How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard?... So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God." Romans 10:14, 17 (KJV)
You cannot have the God-kind of faith without the knowledge of the Word of God.
The lady with the issue of blood knew that she will be healed when she touches the garment of Jesus. (Mark 5:25-34). The knowledge of Jesus' healing virtue birthed such faith in her heart.
The kind of message you receive will determine your faith walk.
You cannot manifest God's glory beyond your level of faith. And your faith is rooted in the knowledge of God's Word. Even the faith of Abraham was according to the Word He received from God. "And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, proclaimed the gospel beforehand to Abraham, saying, “All the nations will be blessed in you.” So then those who are of faith are blessed with Abraham, the believer." Galatians 3:8-9 (LSB) Abraham's faith was by the glorious gospel he received beforehand. The Gospel is the revelation of Jesus. For you to walk in the reality of God by faith, you must behold the good news of Jesus. The report or news you hear or give your mind to, will influence your faith.
Which message are you meditating on today?
Is it the negative report of the world, the hospital, the radio station, or the trending news on social media?
Any news which isn't consistent with the gospel of Jesus shall shipwreck your faith.
Hallelujah DIG DEEPER(Romans 3:21; 2 Corinthians 5:17; Habakkuk 2:4; Ephesians 4:21; Colossians 2:7; 1:23; Hebrews 13:9)  WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not drift away from the Gospel of Jesus so that we will be established in greater faith.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 19 - 22  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the God-kind of faith. - My faith is rooted in the knowledge of God's word. - I don't give my mind and heart to the negative report of the world. - I meditate daily on the report of the Lord concerning me. - My heart is infused with faith. - I walk in the consciousness of faith every day. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 416 - THE GOSPEL AWAKENS MORE FAITH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-11.mp4Thursday 14th, March 2024 THE GOSPEL AWAKENS MORE FAITH 2"For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed, both springing from faith and leading to faith [disclosed in a way that awakens more faith]. As it is written and forever remains written, “The just and upright shall live by faith.” Romans 1:17 (Amplified)Faith is only imparted through the knowledge of God.
Any other body of knowledge which contradicts the knowledge of God does not produce faith.
Every word of God to you is to dispense faith into your heart.Precisely, the complete knowledge of God was revealed through Jesus.Thus, the Gospel of our Lord Jesus awakens and imparts great faith into your heart.
The Gospel or the Goodnews of Jesus is the revelation of the rich knowledge and unsearchable wisdom of God.
For example:One of the glorious realities of Christ the Gospel announces is that: You are the righteousness of God in Christ."For God made the only one who did not know sin to become sin for us, so that we who did not know righteousness might become the righteousness of God through our union with him." 2 Corinthians 5:21 (TPT).The Goodnews concerning you, being made the righteousness of God in Christ establishes you in the fullness of faith. The knowledge of the righteousness of Christ in you, dismantles and disables every thought of fear and condemnation.As we have seen in the opening verse, the Goodnews of Jesus dispensed faith into you to believe and receive His life. This also brings you into the participation of the righteousness of God in Christ. The more you behold this Goodnews of being made the righteousness of God in Christ, the more you awaken and advance in faith.So, whiles the law of Moses unveils your weakness and unrighteousness, the Gospel unveils how God has made you righteous in Christ.The law of Moses brings you to the consciousness of how you cannot become righteous. It makes you see the emptiness of your self effort.
Through the Gospel, you become conscious of what God has done for you in Christ; and this causes you to increase and advance in faith.
"if indeed you continue to advance in faith, assured of a firm foundation to grow upon. Never be shaken from the hope of the gospel you have believed in. And this is the glorious news I preach all over the world." Colossians 1:23 (TPT)Your faith is as a result of what you keep hearing. Your faith in Christ is dependent on the hearing of the Gospel; and you continue to increase and advance in faith when you remain resolute on the hope of the Gospel. The moment you turn away from the hope of the Gospel you create space for doubt.
Set your heart and mind on the revelation of Jesus, and you will walk in great faith.
HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Romans 3:21; 2 Corinthians 5:17; Habakkuk 2:4; Ephesians 4:21; Colossians 2:7; Hebrews 13:9) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will continue to remain resolute on the hope of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 23 - 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:-  My faith is rooted in the knowledge of God’s word. - I am the righteousness of God in Christ. - My mind and heart is set on the revelation of Jesus. - I walk in great faith. - I walk daily in the consciousness of this reality. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 417 - TRUE CHRISTIANITY - CHRIST LIVES IN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 15th, March 2024 TRUE CHRISTIANITY - CHRIST LIVES IN YOU"so that it is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me. This life that I live now, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me" Galatians 2:20 (GNT) Undoubtedly, there are many religions or religious groups in the world. However, true Christianity is not one of these religions; though over a period of time some have created a religion out of the true Christian faith. Those who believed in Jesus were referred to as Christians in Antioch, because of the life they exuded. They were not called Christians because of their religious activities. "...It was in Antioch that the followers of Jesus were first revealed as “anointed ones". Acts 11:26 (TPT) From the King James Bible, the word used was "called" instead of "revealed".
The word "called" is from the Greek word, "Chrematizo" which means to utter an oracle or to divinely intimate; it is to reveal and to constitute a certain reality.
In Antioch, the believers in Christ were not just called "Christians" as a term. They spoke of them as Christians, by supernatural revelation.  Christ, (Christos in Greek) means the anointed. True Christians are:- followers of Christ- a people who are in oneness of fellowship with Christ - and also the anointed ones by supernatural revelation.
True Christianity is not following Christ by trying to obey some external rules. It is living an organic life.
It is great to know that Jesus rose from the dead and ascended into Heaven. (Acts 1:9-12); yet you may not experience the reality of His life. The glorious mystery of God revealed is that, Christ is in you (Colossians 1:27). To know True Christianity is to know that the Christ who ascended, now lives in you through the Spirit. This is not religion. This is life!
True Christianity is the expression of God's life in you.
Please take a look at the opening verse in the Passion Translation: "My old identity has been co-crucified with Messiah and no longer lives; for the nails of his cross crucified me with him. And now the essence of this new life is no longer mine, for the Anointed One lives his life through me—we live in union as one! My new life is empowered by the faith of the Son of God who loves me so much that he gave himself for me, and dispenses his life into mine" Galatians 2:20 (TPT)
Beloved, True Christianity is Christ living in you. It is functioning by faith in Christ. This transcends religion. 
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:17; 2 Thessalonians 1:10; Colossians 3:4; Romans 8:10; Galatians 4:19) WE PRAYWe pray that we will live out our true life which is Christ and not function merely according to religious systems. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Samuel 27 - 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the life of God at work in me. - I function by faith in Christ and not by religious systems. - Christ is in me.  Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 418 - LET THE HOLY SPIRIT TAKE OVER YOUR SOUL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 16th March, 2024 LET THE HOLY SPIRIT TAKE OVER YOUR SOUL "Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is valued as a forest." Isaiah 32:15 (Amplified Bible) Working hard to be fruitful is great. However, there is no fruitfulness without the Spirit.
Wherever the Spirit of the Lord is there is blossoming.
God desires that you become fruitful. However, your fruitfulness is by the Spirit. The scriptures liken the fruitfulness or flourishing of one who has experienced the outpouring of the Spirit to a forest. This reveals the extent to which a spirit-life can flourish.
Without the outflow of the Spirit, you may experience dryness.
When the Spirit is overflowing in your life, you shall not experience dryness. "I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.” Isaiah 41:18 This is why you have to commune with the Holy Spirit. You cannot have a consistent communion with the Holy Spirit and remain dry. When the spirit is poured out to you, your ‘dry life’, becomes a fruitful life and then grows to become a forest. 
The Holy Spirit supplies your life with rivers of living waters, which causes you to blossom in all things.
Do you want to flourish beyond measure? Let the Holy Spirit take over your soul. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 107:35; Isaiah 44:3; Isaiah 29:17) WE PRAYThat we will enjoy the sufficient supply of God’sSpirit and grace to bear and multiply our fruits. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 1 -4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I bear fruits by the ability of the Supply of Christ. – I am made competent by the empowering presence of God. – I don’t operate by my own strength. – I am strengthened by the grace of God to do more.  – I refuse to be separated from the Lord. – I live in the union of Christ. – Fruitfulness streams from within me because the Lord is my source. – Every weakness in me is perfected by the Grace of God. – I am greatly helped and resourced by the Lord. – I blossom as a forest. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 419 - ARE WE WASTING OUR TIME?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 17th March, 2024ARE WE WASTING OUR TIME?"With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don't hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort."1 Corinthians 15:58 (The Message) Why are we so committed to the course of Christ? Why are we pushing beyond our comfort and self-interest, just to see lives saved and transformed, no matter the cost involved? Are we wasting our time?
Certainly Not!!!
Don't we have anything else to use our money for?What more is worth our money than this?What more is worth our time than this?What more is worth our skill, intelligence, and resources than this? Read the opening verse again: "With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don't hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort."1 Corinthians 15:58 (The Message) God has been about this business since.He desires that all men will be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth (1 Timothy 2:4). Our Lord first made a great sacrifice to get this to unfold.  "Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: [And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross." Philippians 2:6-8 (Amplified Bible).
Beloved, Jesus being fully God, He lowered Himself to become man and humbled Himself to suffer the death of the cross.
It wasn't for nothing! He sacrificed all He is and all that He's got, just to die this death of shame for mankind. There must be something more important about His death for Him to leave all that glory to become man and to die for man. It is this same thing that moved Jesus to the cross, which is moving us to do all we have to do according to the grace given us.
We are not giving space for the adversary. This generation and beyond deserve our sacrifices.
How beautiful it is that young people like us will stand up for the course of Christ. This same ministry of God is our ministry today. (2 Corinthians 5:17-18). Every single contribution is important and needful unto satisfying God's dream.We leave no stone unturned. We take advantage of this Holy Spirit inspired and directed ability within us, to turn on the divine course in many. There are certain people if we don't step out, they won't be reached out to and the Lord will demand their blood from us. "If I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, in order to save his life, that wicked person shall die for his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand." Ezekiel 3:18 (ESV)
We will not sit to watch a generation be destroyed.
Until YOU get involved, a particular soul will not be reached.They can only hear to receive the Lord, only when you preach. "For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and *how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?*" (Romans 10:13-14) There are many more depending on our sacrifices, bold steps, relentless decisions, uncompromising choices, and unconditional Love of Christ. The LOVE that moved Jesus to the cross is COMPELLING US TO REACH MANY UNSAVED.  The Love of Christ is compelling us!!!... Don't only preach, put your money into GOD'S AGENDA. God's AGENDA will be financed through GOD'S OWN PEOPLE. Be a faithful steward of God and partner with the spreading of the gospel of our Lord Jesus. Pray also for the salvation of souls in your community, in your city, in your town, in your school, in your workplace, in your family, in your country and your continent and the whole world.  Don't go on your knees in prayer only for your personal needs. You are a royal priest in Christ. Fulfill that priestly mandate. We get the job done unto the Glory of God. There is a great company publishing the gospel, are you part of it? Read these topics as well:Cultivate DiligenceBe ImmovableComplacency is not an OptionThis is War 1The LORD has NEED OF ITFRUIT-BEARERS Shalom Alechiem!DIG DEEPER(1 Peter 1:4-9; Ruth 1:18; Psalm 78:8,37; Col. 2:7; Acts 20:24; Hebrews 12:1; 1 Corinthians 9:24-27) WE PRAYThat our hands will not relenting in the service of the Lord. And that we will labour to the end, knowing the value of what God has entrusted to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 5 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I finish my race. – I value this kingdom mandate more than my necessary needs. – I am fully persuaded about the call of God. – My service to God is unto a glorious end. – I am involved in God’s great work. And this is a worthy course. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 420 - PUT IT TO WORK NOW!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 18th March, 2024 PUT IT TO WORK NOW!“But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.”James 1:25 (KJV) For over a year now, the Lord through me has served you with insights and realities on this platform. How committed are you in doing the word? Do you just read to wait for the next day? Listen, whatever God teaches you becomes your responsibility.When you receive a word from God, you must run with it. Beloved, make the time to daily read these writings because it is God’s vision revealed to you. And you must run with it. I shared on this platform about a year ago practical steps on HOW TO GET A SOUL SAVED. When are you going to put it to work?
Those who make a difference in the Kingdom, are those who act on the Word of God.
Have you read the PRACTICE OF LOVE? How are you putting those teachings to work?Don’t just be a hearer only, be a doer as well. There are people who boast of things the Holy Spirit has told them. And for about 6 months they keep contemplating on whether to do it or not.These people try to sound deep and highly spiritual. But, it is unfortunate how they hear the Holy Spirit and decide when to take a step. Many are puffed up by the things they have learnt but lack the discipline to do.
It is one thing to learn and another thing to handle or understand the revelation.
When you handle the truth of God’s word, it will move you into action. After Peter (the apostle of our Lord), had preached on the day of Pentecost, there was the conviction of the Holy Spirit in the hearts of the people listening. However, they didn’t sit hoping for someone to do something for them. They didn’t procrastinate at all. As the word came to them, they were ready to do something.See this: “Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brethren, what shall we do?” Acts 2:37 They didn’t argue with the message or wait for another day to take action. These men heard the message and were ready to put it to work. There are so many prophecies, instructions and inspiring ideas the Lord has breathed into your heart. You grow in manifestation by taking the right steps. God’s Word comes to you to correct, and govern your thinking and to supply you with the wisdom for action.Until you become a doer of the Word, you cannot experience the glorious manifestation you have envisioned. Don’t just be a talker, always locked up in your room praying and hoping that a miracle or something big will happen automatically.We pray to receive grace and direction for action. This means after prayer, you must have a definite accurate “to-do-list”.After Paul encountered Jesus on the road to Damascus, see the instruction the Lord gave him: “And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest. And they that were with me saw indeed the light and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me. And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do“. This was the beginning of God’s great move of Salvation and the expansion of the gospel among the Gentiles. After that encounter with Jesus, Paul was told what to do. Your manifestation is not just by revelation, it is by the revelation you act on. Many who hear the Word only and refuse to be DOERS, are referred to as “deceivers of selves”. (James 1:22) You may be thinking you are making progress but without actions, you will just be as a man swinging in a lazy chair. Beloved, it is time for action. Take a step today and the Lord shall prosper your way.  DIG DEEPER(Matthew 21:28-32; James 1:21-25; Matthew 23:3; Joshua 1:8) WE PRAYThat the grace of God will abound towards us, that we will not relent in taking steps and being doers of the Word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 8 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I do the word. - I exercise the wisdom of God to act on the word. I refuse to procrastinate. I take steps as I am inspired by the Lord. NB: Continue declaring specific things you are going to do this month and this year. Declare how you are putting all the words and ideas to work in the name of Jesus. Shalom[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 421 - WITNESSES OF CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4WITNESSES OF CHRIST“But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you: and you shall be witnesses of me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in all Samaria, and into the uttermost part of the earth” Acts 1:8 (NKJV) The Holy Spirit did not come to indwell us for our self-gratification. He came to indwell us that we shall be witnesses of Christ. When the Holy Spirit came into us at the new birth, He dispensed His power into us. The Holy Spirit Himself is the embodiment of God’s power. The Holy Spirit is in you with the immeasurable power of God. Understand that, you do not fast and pray to receive power. You rather fast and pray to engage and express what you carry. When you became born again, God was processed into you through the Holy Spirit. 
You received the Holy Spirit to be a witness.
You received the responsibility to bear witness of Christ the very day you received the Holy Spirit into you. And this is because the Holy Spirit Himself is a witness of what God has achieved and produced through Christ (Romans 8:16). We are not witnesses of weakness, defeat, failure or fear. We are witnesses of Christ. We are witnesses of the Supernatural and we became this testimony because we have received the Holy Spirit. A witness of Christ is one who has received God into himself. A witness of Christ is not a stranger to the Truth. 
A witness is a partaker of the Divine Life, Christ’s death, and His resurrection.
“That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon and our hands have handled, of the Word of Life.” – 1 John 1:1 (NKJV) A witness of Christ witnesses what he has received. Hence, to be able to bear witness in the full capacity of the testimony of Christ. We must fully come to a place of understanding what Christ did for us and achieved in us. So that we can go out there and bear witness to the life we have fully comprehended.
The Holy Spirit is not a thing; He is a person. And as witnesses of Christ, we have the Holy Spirit as a companion. 
In like manner, we are His companion. We are in fellowship with Him. What makes that fellowship strong is continual communication with Him. This is how we stir up the passion of the Lord in our hearts.Also, as companions of the Holy Spirit, we must deeply engage Him. The more we have fellowship with Him, the more we allow Him to flow through us. We must commune with Him through consistent intense prayers. We must talk with Him. He is our companion.
As witnesses, we must always walk in the consciousness that the Holy Spirit is always with us.
“And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;” John 14:16 (KJV)  He will never leave you nor forsake you. He has never thought or dreamt of it. He is WITH YOU always and He is IN YOU always even till the end of the ages. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:2-3; Acts 5:32; 1 Corinthians 12;3; John 16:13-14) WE PRAYFor the wisdom to utilise the enabling and quickening force of the Holy Spirit to bear witness of our Lord Jesus in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 11 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the Holy Spirit in me to bear witness of Christ. – I am empowered to demonstrate Christ. – I am a witness of Christ’s love, prosperity, goodness and peace. – Many know and see the Lord through me by the power of the Holy Spirit. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 422 - GO FOR THE ULTIMATE PLAN OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-8.mp4Wednesday, 20th March, 2024 GO FOR THE ULTIMATE PLAN OF GOD“…Yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants. He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD’s good plan will prosper in his hands.“ Isaiah 53:10 (NLT)
God has great plans for His Kingdom, mankind, you, and all His creation.
God’s great intention or plan is that His glory will be expressed in fullness.To achieve this, God has ordained you to be the conduit for fulfilling His glorious plan. As a conduit or a steward of God’s great plan, you can determine the extent to which the work of God will be done. The things you desire to do were put in your heart by God. "For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases Him” Philippians 2:13 (NLT) Yours is to nurture the Lord’s desire in your heart; through prayer, meditation and the steps you take.
The more you take steps to act out God’s desire in your heart, the greater it becomes. 
God sees the need to entrust more to you, as you become faithful with the little He entrusts to you. The Lord enables you to do more, however, when you are not determined to work out what the Lord had purposed in your heart, you may fail. "The sons of Ephraim were armed as archers and carrying bows, Yet they turned back in the day of battle.” Psalm 78:9 (Amplified). These sons of Ephraim were armed and well equipped, yet turned back in the day of battle. You can be resourced and still turn away from the pursuit of purpose.
Make it your determination that the purpose and plan of the Lord shall prosper in your hands.
This was what the Prophet Isaiah declared concerning Jesus; "…He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD ’s good plan will prosper in his hands.” Isaiah 53:10 (NLT).
Beloved, God has called you for this reason; that His purpose and good plan will prosper in your hands.
Don’t settle for less, go for the ultimate plan of God. You are enabled for this purpose. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 30:12; 1 Corinthians 12:6; I Corinthians 15:10; Ephesians 1:5) WE PRAYThat we will faithfully work on that which the Lord has entrusted to us for the good plan of the Lord to prosper in our hands. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 14 - 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling. – I don’t give excuses, I get the job done. – Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on. – I don’t stop halfway, I press on. – I go the extra mile. – I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord. – I do the extraordinary. – I am a Champion. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 423 - DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 1 — The Spiritual Rules the Physical
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 21st, March 2024 DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 1— The Spiritual Rules the Physical"For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places" Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)Basically, there are two realms of life. There is the spiritual realm and also the physical realm. The spiritual realm is the root of life's essence and the physical is for the expression of life. The physical realm is the "seen realm", while the spiritual realm is the "unseen realm".By forensic observation of the material world, one may find the fingerprint of an unseen creator — God. Such fingerprint gives an idea of a realm which transcends this physical or material realm."Opposition to truth cannot be excused on the basis of ignorance, because from the creation of the world, the invisible qualities of God’s nature have been made visible, such as his eternal power and transcendence. He has made his wonderful attributes easily perceived, for seeing the visible makes us understand the invisible. So then, this leaves everyone without excuse." Romans 1:20 (TPT).This physical world came out of the Spiritual realm.
There is nothing you see in this world which doesn't have its roots in the spirit.
"By faith we understand that the entire universe was formed at God’s command, that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen."  Hebrews 11:3 (NLT)Therefore you must understand that things don't just happen in this physical realm. There are spiritual forces which govern the affairs of men. And that explains why God didn't make man to only be a physical being without spiritual essence. God designed man to have the ability to function both in the spirit and in this physical realm."...Thus says the LORD, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him". Zechariah 12:1 (NKJV)See this also:"Now, may the God of peace and harmony set you apart, making you completely holy. And may your entire being—spirit, soul, and body—be kept completely flawless in the appearing." 1 Thessalonians 5:23 (TPT)
The spirit of man is the innermost or deepest part of man. It is designed for divine contact and divine consciousness.
It is mainly to have rich intimacy with God, for God is Spirit (John 4:24).Man has a body which serves as the vessel by which he can contact the material or tangible realm and also commune in it. It contains the outward organs of man's being.However, God gave man a SOUL for man to effectively function in the spirit and in the physical realm.The Greek word for soul is "psuche", from it, we have the English word psychology.
It is the conduit for our psychological perception. It is within your soul that you have your self-consciousness.
It contains your will, intellect (mind) and emotions. It serves as the intermediary between the spirit (which is for contacting God) and the body (which communicates with the outside world).Your spirit is for Divine or God consciousness, your soul possesses your self-consciousness and the body is for the physical consciousness.However, the spirit, the soul and the body have their roots and influences in the spirit; because all things issued out of the spirit. As physical as the body is, it also has a level of spiritual intelligence.
Also, you have to know that, anything that will find expression in your body must first take root in your spirit and soul.
Since all created things issued out of the spirit realm, whatever you contact in the physical realm through your body doesn't just exist in the physical, they have their roots also in the spirit.For example:You watched a video clip; which may seem like a mere physical activity. But the video clip has a spiritual influence. Thus, before what you watched in the video will impact your life, it first travels into you to take root in your soul and spirit.The moment it takes root in your spirit and your soul, it will begin to have a strong influence in you and begin to bear its kind of fruits through you.Until you understand these, you will not be able to determine how to operate effectively in this physical world.Be conscious of what influences your life.
Beloved, LIFE IS SPIRITUAL!
Selah.https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-4.mp4DIG DEEPER(Genesis 1:2; Matthew 16:17; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; John 3:6; Mark 9:25; John 4:19-26 WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in the understanding of the function of our spiritual essence in this physical world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 17 - 19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I live my life from the realm of the spirit. - I am conscious of the my spiritual essence. - I am a spirit led man. - I live an extraordinary life. - I increase daily in the understanding of the function of my spirituality. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 424 - DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 22nd, March 2024DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 2"For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places" Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)Things don't just happen in the physical. Whatever happens around you is governed and influenced by an unseen realm.Even in your daily living, things don't just happen to you. The things that happen to you are influenced by your innermost being.Do you know why you are not able to have some results?
You can or cannot have certain results according to the condition of your heart.
Your limitations in life are not external; they are first internal. What you have not conquered in your mind and your spirit, cannot be conquered in the physical."Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it." Proverbs 4:23 (NIV).We have already looked into the existence of the unseen realm and how the unseen realm influences the physical.In explaining the function of our spirit, soul and body; I established that your spirit is designed to contact God.
However, it is not only the Spirit of God one can contact in the unseen realm.
From the opening verse (Ephesians 6:12), you can see that, there are evil spiritual entities which have established themselves as rulers and strive to exercise their authority from the unseen realm.These spiritual rulers and authorities are not only interested in ruling in the unseen realm. They are also interested in expressing their dominion in the physical realm.For these evil spiritual rulers to enforce the dominion of darkness, they operate through their devised schemes or strategies. The focus of these schemes is your innermost being. The moment their deceptive schemes take root in your heart, you will walk in the expression of it.This is why you should stay on guard to cast out thoughts and imaginations that are not consistent with God's wisdom. 
Thoughts which are not consistent with the word of God are arrows of darkness.
To you, those are mere thoughts, to the adversary, they are his blazing arrows shot at you.Therefore, take a stand to wrestle and extinguish every thought which is not of God.Selah!https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-10.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Matthew 16:17; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Mark 9:25; Romans 13:12; Ephesians 4:14; James 4:7) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall always at all times remain vigilant to guard our hearts and extinguish every evil or negative thought shot at us by the devil. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 20 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live my life from the realm of the spirit. – I guard my heart my heart with all diligence against every evil or negative thought of the adversary. – I am conscious of the my spiritual essence. – I am a spirit led man. – I live an extraordinary life. – I increase daily in the understanding of the function of my spirituality. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 425 - DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 23rd, March 2024 DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 3"For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places" Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)The things which dominate the affairs of men are spiritual.
 No one exercises dominion among men without first building spiritual mastery.
The quest for supremacy is more spiritual than physical. Fulfilling your divine purpose and impacting your generation will involve more than physical activities.There are unseen forces which will oppose your vision and your plans.
See your pursuit of purpose as war!
People don't just walk in manifestations of glory. Every glory you see first begins as grace. The disposition of grace on your innermost being will determine the manifestation of glory.As I previously mentioned that the adversary distracts your disposition through deceptive thoughts (2 Corinthians 11:3). The Lord also builds you up through the revelation of His Word (Acts 20:32).After Jesus had asked the disciples, "Who do men say I am?", and also asked His disciples to share who they believe He is; look at Jesus' response to Peter:"Simon Peter answered and said, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”Jesus answered and said to him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but My Father who is in heaven" Matthew 16:16-17 (NKJV)Jesus acknowledged how the unseen realm can influence our thoughts and what we do.None of the people around understood how Peter was able to rightly utter the revelation of Jesus. But Jesus having the understanding of how things happen behind the scenes was able to tell the supernatural involvement in Peter's revelation.It was not by flesh and blood!
It was by the supernatural influence of God.
Precious one, there are unseen influences in this world. Stop trying to deal with matters only by how you see things in the physical. Allow your heart to be cultured and to develop mastery in dealing with issues from the unseen.This is the work of the Word of God in your life. 
The word of God cultures and empowers you to exercise dominion in the unseen realm according to the knowledge of Christ.
Selah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Matthew 16:16-17, 21 - 23; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Mark 9:25; Romans 13:12; Ephesians 4:14; Acts 5:3; John 13:2; James 4:7; Philippians 2:13) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be prompt to the supernatural influence of the Holy Spirit in our hearts. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Samuel 23 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live my life from the realm of the spirit. – I guard my heart my heart with all diligence against every evil or negative thought of the adversary. – I am conscious of the my spiritual essence. – I am a spirit led man. – I don't my spirituality for granted. – I live an extraordinary life. – I increase daily in the understanding of the function of my spirituality. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 426 - DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 24th, March 2024 DEALING WITH UNSEEN INFLUENCES 4"For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places" Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)
The greatest weapon of the adversary against men is deception.
To wrestle or fight against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world and evil spirits is not a fight with physical strength or abilities.
It doesn't require human strategies. To wrestle or fight with these unseen forces is a matter of words and thoughts.
The attacks of the adversary is always focused on your inner man. This is why you must always guard your heart.Don't treat thoughts as mere thoughts or imaginations. Thoughts which are not consistent with the knowledge of Christ, are negative transmissions of the adversary into your spirit and soul. These transmissions provide pathways for demons to travel into your life to afflict and oppress you.
Where do you think depression, stress, anxiety, fear and doubts emanates from?
They are intrinsically not from the situations you find yourself. They are not first by the people who offend you. Those situations and people are mere conduits or channels for the adversary to attack you with his evil blazing arrows.
You must be on guard to engage the armour of the Lord.
As I explained to you yesterday, Jesus decoded the source of Peter's revelation. He knew it was not by flesh and blood, but through the supernatural influence of the Father. (See Matthew 16:16-17)Jesus affirmed how the spiritual influences your life when you are availed.In that same chapter, there was another instance similar to what we discussed previously."From that time Jesus began to show to His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day.Then Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, “Far be it from You, Lord; this shall not happen to You!” But He turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you are not mindful of the things of God, but the things of men.” Matthew 16:21-23 (NKJV) Did Jesus call Peter Satan?Was Peter not the one Jesus was praising not long ago?Peter who spoke by divine revelation was now an agency for the voice of Satan.The adversary knowing the influence of  Peter, was speaking through Peter to discourage Jesus from going to the cross.Jesus knew the force or influence by which Peter spoke. He knew it wasn't a wrestling with Peter, it was a fight with the devil. He rebuked the negative voice of the adversary.Which negative voice or thought are you amplifying or vocalizing?Set your mind on the knowledge of Christ. Don't submit to any thoughts which are contradictory to the knowledge of Christ.
Submit your thoughts to the thoughts of God through the study of the scriptures.
Refuse to yield to wrong thoughts and emotions. Stand firm and set your gaze on the Lord.Selah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Matthew 16:16-17; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Mark 9:25; Romans 13:12; Ephesians 4:14; Acts 5:3; John 13:2; James 4:7; Philippians 2:13) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall walk in the wisdom and understanding to rightly perceive the source of every thought and utterance. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My mind is set on the knowledge of Christ. - Through the study of the word, I daily submit my thoughts to the thoughts of God. - I refuse to yield myself to wrong emotions and thoughts. - My gaze is set on the Lord. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 427 - BE FAITHFUL TO THE LITTLE THINGS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE FAITHFUL TO THE LITTLE THINGS"Look at the ships also: though they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are guided by a very small rudder wherever the will of the pilot directs." James 3:4 (ESV) I know you want to make a difference in your world and be the best God has called you to be.
However, what do you think it entails?
When most people look at those doing well in their ministry or vision, they assume it took a volume of many things for that to happen. Nevertheless, you should know that it doesn’t take a volume of things to make a difference. It is instead the same little things you may be aware of that are needed for great success. Most of the big things you see are controlled by little but powerful elements.It only takes a small rudder to direct a whole huge ship.
Success doesn’t come by doing many things. It is simply giving attention to the basic instructions you are given and running with them consistently.
Simple instructions such as;- reading your Bible daily, - praying without ceasing, - meditating on the Word, - rejoicing in the Holy Spirit, and - acting on the inspirations of the Lord. These instructions can revolutionize your entire world. Such instructions can move you from being a low-class, unrecognized, defeated fellow to a transgenerational leader.
It will only take your dedication and consistency with the little instructions you are given, to make a difference in your world.
Beloved, be faithful to the little things. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 1:26-29; Galatians 5:9; Matthew 25:21; Matthew 17:20; Zechariah 4:10) WE PRAYThat we will take heed to every instruction and prompting of the Spirit to us, whether through the word, our man of God or to us personally. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I make time daily for the study of the word. – I make time daily for prayer and the meditation of the word. – I don’t trivialize my spirituality. – I take heed to the instructions of the Spirit of God through his word, my man of God and to me personally. – I am faithful in all things. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 428 - LOOK INSIDE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency LOOK INSIDE“But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us” 2 Corinthians 4:7 (NKJV)There are some thoughts which control our mindsets and how we think about our lives.For example: You might have heard people make statements like:“We came to this world empty, and we will all leave empty”
How can this be true?
There are people who have really made this thought pattern their consciousness. They think they came to this world empty and for that reason their lives are empty.These thoughts even control the mindsets of certain saints in Christ.
A man in Christ cannot be empty.
A man without God has an empty life.When you become born again, you receive the treasure of God into you.This treasure is the fullness of the life of God in you.You can’t carry this life and be empty.
You can't carry this life and have an empty life. 
Not Possible!Those thoughts of emptiness are not of God.“For His divine power has bestowed on us [absolutely] everything necessary for [a dynamic spiritual] life and godliness, through true and personal knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.” 1 Peter 1:3 (Amplified)In your relationship with God, you are supplied with EVERYTHING pertaining to life and godliness (the expression of divinity).Some feel empty because they don’t feel satisfied, nor complete.
If you are not feeling satisfied, then you are looking at the wrong places.
Beloved, you are made complete in Christ. Stop looking at the things that you think you lack or don’t have. Look inside, you have God’s greatest treasure.Your life is not empty.Hallelujah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-3.mp4DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:2-4; Matthew 13:44-46; Colossians 2:9-10) WE PRAYThat we will grow and increase in the knowledge of the fullness of this rich reality. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My life is not empty.– I carry the fullness of the life of God in me.– I am made complete in Christ.– I carry God’s greatest treasure in me.– My life is not empty.–  I am supplied with EVERYTHING pertaining to life and godliness.Oh Gloreeey! Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 429 - PUT ON THE COMPLETE ARMOR OF GOD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 27th, March 2024 PUT ON THE COMPLETE ARMOR OF GOD 1"Put on the full armor of God [for His precepts are like the splendid armor of a heavily-armed soldier], so that you may be able to [successfully] stand up against all the schemes and the strategies and the deceits of the devil" Ephesians 6:11 (AMPC)Still on our discussion: "Dealing With Unseen Influences"We have looked at the following:- The existence of the unseen realm- How the physical realm is governed and influenced by the unseen realm- The supernatural influence of God- How the adversary uses deceptive thoughts and demonic activities to control or influence people and activities in the physical realm
The supernatural influence of God in the affairs of men is palpable and cannot be denied.
Also, anyone who doubts the workings of spirit forces of wickedness in this physical world is either naïve or a liar.There are demon-gods and evil spirits that are possessors of this dark world and hold it in bondage. These wicked spirits, control men to stand against the glorious gospel of Jesus.Any thought which opposes the knowledge of Christ or the spread of the gospel of Jesus, is not a mere thought. These are demonic impartations which are focused on keeping men in bondage. Wherever the gospel of our Lord Jesus saturates, men experience complete freedom.
Therefore, the dark forces which keep men in bondage will oppose the gospel and the bearers of the gospel.
This is war!It is not a war merely against men. It is war against highest evil principalities and dark authorities operating in rebellion. These evil forces operates in this physical world through men who have yielded to them.But wait a minute...These things I am sharing with you are not to put fear in you nor to make you esteem the devil in any way.I am writing this to you, so that you may not be exploited by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes. (2 Corinthians 2:11).
Yes, we wrestle against high class forces of darkness as we  function to show forth God's glory. Nevertheless, we are sure of our victory in Christ Jesus.
"For every child of God defeats this evil world, and we achieve this victory through our faith" 1 John 5:4 (NLT)No matter what, we must be settled on this reality that we are more than conquerors through Christ who loved us (Romans 8:37).
Our wrestle or fight against the evil strategies of the accuser is from the victory stand. 
We are not trying to now attain victory. Christ has already defeated these evil forces.He disarmed and stripped all the spiritual tyrants (those supernatural forces of evil operating against us), in the universe of their sham authority at the Cross and marched them naked through the streets. (Colossians 2:15)
This is why deceptive schemes are the adversary's weapon against God's people.
To daily enforce and stand in our victory in Christ Jesus, God has given us a complete set of armor. Our role now is to put them on as we walk in our victory daily.Hallelujah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-9_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Romans 13:12; 2 Corinthians 6:7; Colossians 3:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be victims of the evil schemes of the devil but will consciously walk in our victory which is in Christ Jesus as we put on the complete armor of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 10 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I live daily in the consciousness of my victory. - I war from a place of victory. - I refuse to be a victim of any evil scheme of the devil. - I am more than a conqueror. - I am victorious. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 430 - PUT ON THE COMPLETE ARMOR OF GOD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 28th, March 2024 PUT ON THE COMPLETE ARMOR OF GOD 2"Put on the full armor of God [for His precepts are like the splendid armor of a heavily-armed soldier], so that you may be able to [successfully] stand up against all the schemes and the strategies and the deceits of the devil" Ephesians 6:11 (AMPC)Beloved, the only weapon of the adversary is deception. Through his deceptive schemes, the adversary lures men even believers into his web of darkness and defeat. Through his deceptive schemes, he causes believers to live in fear and defeat instead of functioning with great authority and in the victory of Christ.  Our Lord Jesus didn't only give us His victory, He also provided us with all the complete armor we need to withstand the wiles of the devil. 
Our role now is to know and put them on as we walk in our victory daily.
The believer is not only a citizen of Heaven (Philippians 3:20) and a son of God (1 John 3:2).The believer is also a soldier in Christ (2 Timothy 2:3-4).
And as soldiers of Christ we have our special armor by which we withstand the adversary.
"Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. Stand therefore, having girded your waist with truth, having put on the breastplate of righteousness, and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace; above all, taking the shield of faith with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one.  And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God; praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints." Ephesians 6:13-18 (NKJV).From these verses, Paul the apostle listed the whole armor of God, and instructed the brethren to put them on:1. Truth to gird your waist.2. Righteousness as your breastplate.3. Preparation of the gospel of peace to shod your feet.4. Faith as a shield to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one.5. Salvation as a helmet.6. The word of God as the sword of the Spirit.7. Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit.With these armor, you are fully fortified against the devil's attacks and resourced enough to terrorize the forces of darkness.You are not an unprotected soldier. All that is required for you to be a prevailing soldier has been provided by the Lord.
The complete armor is yours, you don't have to look for them nor beg God for it.
Yours is to put them on and function in them.Selah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-7.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18;  2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Romans 13:12; 2 Corinthians 6:7; Colossians 3:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in the understanding of the whole armor of God and efficiently utilize them unto God's glory. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 15 - 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live daily in the consciousness of my victory. – I war from a place of victory. – I refuse to be a victim of any evil scheme of the devil. – I am more than a conqueror. – I am victorious. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 431 - JESUS IS THE PERFECT LAMB
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 29th March, 2024 JESUS IS THE PERFECT LAMB"And he made clear to them all the things in the Writings, from Moses and from all the prophets, which had to do with himself". Luke 24:27 (BBE) There is only one message we have which is CHRIST.
The gospel and revelation of our Lord Jesus is the centricity of the message of the Church.
In the Gospel of Jesus:- The victory of the New Creation is unveiled.- You will behold your success.- You will embrace the love of God and His eternal forgiveness.- You will become conscious of the higher life God has called you to live.- Believers will enjoy the life God has intended for them and be relevant in the Kingdom business.It’s important to comprehend the truth of God about you in Christ.For the truth about you is Christ.Only a few people have got into serious study of the Word. And have made it their intention to commit themselves to the ministration of the Word through the Spirit. Even some Teachers and Pastors are finding it difficult to rightly divide the word because, they have not given themselves to the Spirit of the Word.
The Church meetings ought to be times where believers are trained into maturity in the knowledge of Christ.
It is not the sharing of the knowledge of human idealism and philosophies. “See to it that no one takes you captive by philosophy and empty deceit, according to human tradition, according to the elemental spirits of the world, and not according to Christ” Colossians 2:8 (ESV) “And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God. For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.” 1 Corinthians 2:1 ( KJV). Teachers of the Word are not to fix their interests in the peddling of the truth (2 Corinthians 2:17) but should administer the mind of God. Those whom Christ died for deserve to receive and enjoy the treasures of the Lord.
Believers shouldn’t engage themselves in activities and celebrations without understanding.
Whatsoever is written in the Word has its purpose and should be understood. Every year in the month of Nisan, the Jews had their Passover Celebration. This Celebration is focused on God’s powerful message to the world. This was when God delivered the children of Israel from Egypt through the BLOOD OF THE PASSOVER LAMB. Now we have Jesus, who is the substance of the sacrifices and the Jewish festivals. “Therefore let no one judge you in regard to food and drink or in regard to [the observance of] a festival or a new moon or a Sabbath day. Such things are only a shadow of what is to come and they have only symbolic value; but the substance [the reality of what is foreshadowed] belongs to Christ.” Colossians 2:16-17 (Amplified) The Passover lamb in Exodus 12 foreshadowed Jesus who is the PERFECT PASSOVER. The triumphal entry was a preparation for Passover Week and for the death and resurrection of Jesus. The very day that Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the colt of a donkey was the 10th day of Nisan (See both Exodus 12 and John 12).That day is known among Jews as the “Lamb Selection Day”. Wow! It was on this day that the lamb that was going to be used in the Temple for the Passover were brought into Jerusalem. At the first Passover which took place in Egypt, God instructed the Israelites to take each lamb into each home to be inspected or scrutinized. The lamb was scrutinized for 4 days. This was to check if the lamb is suitable for the sacrifice. It should be blameless and also be a male in the first year. (See Exodus 12:1-5). The lamb with no blemish will be slain on the 14th day of Nisan. This is beautiful! Beloved, Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the Lamb Selection Day, which is the 10th Day of Nisan. He rode into His household. He was scrutinized by them even unto the 14th day. In Exodus 12 it was stated that the Passover lamb had to be examined.
Jesus who is the Perfect lamb of God that takes away the sin of the world (John 1:29) was scrutinized or examined by the highest authorities in the land.
Herod (the king) scrutinized Him, Caiaphas (the High Priest), and even Pontius Pilate. Pontius Pilate represented the entire body of Gentiles and the whole world. Remember Rome was ruling the world by then. Jesus was without blemish at all levels of laws, regulations and scrutiny.
Jesus really died for all sins.
He satisfied all laws. He was even judged beyond the law of Moses and was still blameless. Oh, what a perfect lamb the Father prepared for us to satisfy all the demands of Justice. Yet on the 14th day of Nisan, at exactly 9 am, Jesus was nailed to the cross. As the animals were taken into the temple to be sacrificed. Exactly the time set for the last lamb to be killed by the High Priest, at 3pm, Jesus cried out “IT IS FINISHED” and He gave up His Spirit.  Nobody took His Spirit from Him. You see just as the High Priest was the one to kill the last lamb, the same happened with Jesus. It was Caiaphas who initiated His death; and on the cross, Jesus who is also our High Priest, gave up His Spirit. Hallelujah!
Jesus is the Perfect lamb that was CONDEMNED ONCE and for ALL.
My dear in Christ, you should know that as the lamb of God was judged for you; God CANNOT CONDEMN You. SHALOM!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-6_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(Exodus 12; John 12; Luke 24:27; Hebrews 8:5; Hebrews 9:9; 1 Corinthians 5:6-8) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for our Lord Jesus who bore all our iniquities and justified us through His blood. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 18 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am perfected by the blood of the perfect lamb of God. – I focus on Christ who is the substance of truth. – Christ is God’s perfect sacrifice for me, therefore I am justified. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 432 - BE FULLY COMMITTED TO THIS COURSE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  BE FULLY COMMITTED TO THIS COURSE  "But I put no value on my life, if only at the end of it I may see the work complete which was given to me by the Lord Jesus, to be a witness of the good news of the grace of God". Acts 20:24 (BBE) There is so much I have shared with you on this platform, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and how you have been blessed in the comment section.You can also send an email to me via apostlebennie@christcommonwealth.org. Today I want you to patiently think about these: Are you committed to the course of Christ? And if yes, why? Are you pushing beyond your comfort and self-interest, just to see lives saved and transformed, no matter the cost involved? Do you think going all out for the Lord is a waste of time? Certainly Not!!! Do you think it is unnecessary to give financially into kingdom assignment? Do you think those who give bountifully don’t have anything else to use the money for? What more is worth your money than the Lord’s assignment? What more is worth your time than the Lord’s mandate? What more is worth your skill, intelligence, and resources? "With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don’t hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort" 1 Corinthians 15:57 (The Message)
Beloved, this kingdom business has been God’s business all this while. (2 Corinthians 5:19)
He desires that all men will be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth (1 Timothy 2:4). Our Lord first made a great sacrifice: “Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: [And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.” Philippians 2:6-8 (Amplified Bible).
