Jesus being fully God, He lowered Himself to become man and humbled Himself to suffer the death of the cross.
It wasn’t for nothing!! He sacrificed all He is and all that He’s got just to die this death of shame for mankind. There must be something more important about His death for Him to leave all that glory to become man and to die for man. It is this same thing that moved Jesus to the cross, which is moving us to do all we have to do according to the grace given us.
The adversary's strategy is to sow seeds of doubt in your heart to distract you.
Don’t give space for the adversary to corrupt your desire for the Lord and His work.There is a cry in the soul of this generation and beyond for hope and salvation. How beautiful it is that in this crooked and dark generation, you become the light to many. In a generation where people are departing from the faith, becoming lovers of self and money; you have chosen to stand up for the course of Christ.
Don’t make excuses. Don’t be part of those who seek their own gain.
Decide to stand out and shine forth. "Get out of bed, Jerusalem! Wake up. Put your face in the sunlight. God’s bright glory has risen for you. The whole earth is wrapped in darkness, all people sunk in deep darkness, But God rises on you, his sunrise glory breaks over you. Nations will come to your light, kings to your sunburst brightness" Isaiah 60:1-3 (MSG) Jesus said, as long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world. (John 9:5)This same ministry of God in Christ Jesus is your ministry today. (2 Corinthians 5:17-18) Every single contribution is important and needful unto satisfying God’s dream.Leave no stone unturned. Take advantage of the Holy Spirit inspired and directed ability within you to turn on the divine course in many. Certain people wouldn’t be reached out to until you step out to reach them. The Lord will demand their blood from you. (Ezekiel 3:18; Acts 20:26)
Don’t sit to watch a generation destroyed.
Until YOU get involved, a particular soul will not be reached.They can only hear to receive the Lord, only when you go to preach. “For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?” (Romans 10:13-14) Many more are depending on your sacrifices, bold steps, relentless decisions, uncompromising choices, and unconditional Love of Christ. Be compelled by the Love of Christ.
Don’t only preach, put your money into GOD’S AGENDA. God’s AGENDA will be financed through GOD’S OWN PEOPLE.
Be a faithful steward of God and partner with spreading the gospel of our Lord Jesus. Pray also for the salvation of souls in your community, in your city, in your town, in your school, in your workplace, in your family, in your country, your continent and the whole world.
Don’t go on your knees in prayer only for your personal needs. You are a royal priest in Christ. Fulfill that priestly mandate.
Decide to be a CONDUIT FOR THE SPREAD OF THE GOSPEL BY TAKING PRACTICAL STEPS. Hallelujah!!!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-8.mp4DIG DEEPER(Matthew 4:16; Isaiah 9:6; Philippians 2:30; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Galatians 6:17; Acts 20:24; 2 Corinthians 12:15) WE PRAYThat our hearts shall not grow weary in doing good. And we shall see many come into the light as we shine the light of the glory of God in our generation to see many transformed in all wisdom and power. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 21 - 222 Kings 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t grow weary. – I refuse to be distracted. – I shine the light of God in my generation. – I stand up for the course of Christ in my generation. – I reach out to souls and give into the spread of the gospel. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 433 - THE GLORIOUS MYSTERY REVEALED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE GLORIOUS MYSTERY REVEALED"And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks." Acts 9:4-5 (KJV) Glory! What a mystery revealed! Saul (now Paul) thought he was persecuting just the saints; little did he know he was dealing with Jesus Himself. You see, Jesus didn’t ask, “Saul, Saul why are you persecuting my disciples or even my Church”. Instead, He asked, "Why are you persecuting me?" This was enough to reveal the New Creation reality to Paul. Jesus didn’t ask that because the New Creation (or the Church) belongs to Him. NO! Jesus asked in that manner because He is in “Oneness with the Church”. The Church is His body- The Corporate New Man (the New Creation). Hallelujah. Let me be very specific “WE” (the born-again- the New Creation) are the Church (the body of Christ) Corporately and as Individuals. Now WE are not just an extension of Christ on Earth. We are the expression of Christ.
We were made one with Christ Jesus and not separated from Him. We are the visible expression of Him. His very substance!
God never sees Us as different from Christ; instead, He sees Us together with Him. He loves Us just as He loves Jesus, we are victorious just as Jesus is, and we are in right standing with God just as Jesus is.
God never looks at Jesus with anger. (He never looks on Us with anger, we are the Substance of Jesus).
When the world touches Us, they have touched Jesus and we are His substance as He is our element. Anytime the world sees Us, they have seen Jesus. He talks through Us and lives through Us.
As a New Creation, you are the talking and the walking Christ. 
He loves and comforts others through you, so live with confidence every day because you are the revelation of Jesus! Bear this in mind: Now even though the Lord is with you, He is also in you. “even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees him nor knows him. You know him, for he dwells with you and will be in you.“ John 14:17 (ESV)
The one in Christ (the new creation) has a mingled spirit, joined to the Lord. The truth is, the Lord in you is your authentic self.
Galatians 2:20:“I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.” The real you within is Christ, and you are insoluble in nature and essence. Therefore, live daily in the consciousness of your true self. Selah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-3.mp4DIG DEEPER(John 15:1-11; John 17:20-23; Ephesians 2:13-16; Romans 8:10-11; 1 Corinthians 12:13; 1 Corinthians 6:17) WE PRAYThat our experience of our oneness with God will be deepened. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 2 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am one with Christ, His substance and expression. – God sees me as He sees Christ. – When you touch me you’ve touched Christ. – When men see me, they have seen Christ. – I am eternally one with Christ and inseparable from Him. – He walks through me and talks through me. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 434 - BELIEVE IN THE REPORT OF THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BELIEVE IN THE REPORT OF THE LORD"Who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?" Isaiah 53:1 (NKJV) The Hebrew word for REPORT is shemû‛âh, which means something heard, that is an announcement. It is also a doctrine or a news, tidings and bruit. There are several reports, especially in this technological age.These reports create a belief system in your heart. They compete with the glorious message of Christ in your heart.
The core or central message of the scriptures is Christ.
All the reports you find in this world and from your imaginations which are contrary to the word of God, don’t have any perpetual foundation. They only tickle your mind to live a shadow of your true essence.
The revelation of God declared, is the only news which reveals your true essence.
To believe in the report of the Lord is a choice you have to make.You have to channel your desires and imaginations or thoughts towards the Lord.  Until you decide to see or accept God’s Word as TRUTH, and the focus of your believe or persuasion, you will be shadow boxing.
The word of grace is the Lord’s report to you.
Do you believe it? Or do you think they are mere stories and unfounded theories? Beloved the reality of God’s word is unmatched. Believe in it wholeheartedly for it is LIFE!There is nothing God had said in His word which shall not come to pass. Selah DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:5; Matthew 11:25; Luke 18:31; John 12:38) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the understanding of the realities of virtues we have received. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 5 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am founded on the word of God. – I don’t give my hearing to the reports of this world. – I am not moved by sentimental words and thoughts. – I hold fast to the word of truth. – I am fully persuaded by the scriptures. – My confidence is not in this world. – I am what God’s word says I am. – I believe in the report on the Lord. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 435 - THE HIGHEST DEMONSTRATION OF FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE HIGHEST DEMONSTRATION OF FAITH "having been rooted and being built up in Him, and being strengthened in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding with thanksgiving." Colossians 2:7 (Berean Literal Bible)When people want to see a change in circumstances they pray.They declare the word of God. And exercise themselves in faith. But very few people know THANKSGIVING is a demonstration of faith.
Beloved, you don’t only thank God after a miracle. You practice thanksgiving even while you make supplication in prayer.
To pray is a step of faith. It is confidence in God answering you as a loving Father. However, your prayer of faith will always be done with thanksgiving. ”Do not be anxious or worried about anything, but in everything [every circumstance and situation] by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, continue to make your [specific] requests known to God.“ Philippians 4:6 (Amplified Bible).
Wherever there is faith, thanksgiving abounds.
Thanksgiving is the evidence which reveals the certainty of your faith.Let thanksgiving abound in your daily living. Thanksgiving does these things in you:1. Through thanksgiving you acknowledge the Lord in your life and recognize His blessing in everything you do.2. Your faith and confidence in God becomes effective; thus, you build an irrevocable confidence that you will experience or see the manifestation of what the Lord has said.3. Thanksgiving causes you to live in the glorious realm of joy, far above anxiety and sorrow. It has a way of establishing and overwhelming you with restfulness amid chaos.See how Jesus demonstrated power through thanksgiving:"Then Jesus said, “Make the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand. And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted. So when they were filled, He said to His disciples, “Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost.” Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten. Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said, “This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world." John 6:10-14 (NKJV) Jesus blessed the loaves and fishes with thanksgiving and was able to feed the multitudes with an overflow of food. Concerning Lazarus’ resurrection, Jesus didn’t have to utter a prayer of supplication or petition. He said, "Father, I thank You that You have heard Me." John 11:41 (NKJV). That is faith!!! Before He got to Bethany, Jesus had already made the pronouncement of faith. At the tomb of Lazarus, He didn’t have to speak many words and pray for a miracle to happen. He gave thanks, as an affirmation that the Father has heard Him. This was God showing us how to act in faith.
Thanksgiving is the highest demonstration of faith.
As you pray, as you declare the word, and as you take inspired steps of faith towards that goal, BE THANKFUL. Beloved, always abound in thanksgiving, for it is FAITH. Shalom!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-7.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 5:20; Colossians 3:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:18; Psalm 95:1-3) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the abundance of His grace supplied unto us and the great miracles He has worked in our midst and the glorious things we are going to see this month and this year. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 8 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks. – In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks. – I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance. – I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance. – My mouth is full of thanksgiving. – Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 436 - THE TREE OF LIFE IN CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THE TREE OF LIFE IN CHRIST "Jesus told him, “I am the Way—yes, and the Truth and the Life. No one can get to the Father except by means of me." John 14:6 (TLB) Today's opening verse is a package of glorious news to mankind and the saints in Christ. It doesn’t just answer the question of Jesus’ divinity, as in Jesus being God; it also reveals the answer to man’s greatest challenge! When you see Jesus you have seen the Father, for He is one with the Father.
Beloved Jesus is not a god, He is God.
Jesus is not just showing you the way to the Father, He is not some sort of signpost.He is the means and the destination.This is not some mere religious clichè, it is the REALITY.
You cannot access the Life of God without Jesus.
And you know this reality is not just information, it is a PERSON, and He is Jesus. Why the need for all mankind to be excited? After the fall of man, God moved Adam from the Garden of Eden. We see from scriptures, that when God moved man from the garden, He specifically denied man access to the Tree of Life. This is not necessarily punishment from God, but His plan to preserve man. When man committed the sin of unbelief (by rejecting God’s instruction and believing in the lies of the adversary), corruption germinated in him. (Genesis 2:15-16; Genesis 3:1-11).  Therefore for man to partake of the tree of life means, the corruption problem of man may be forever. The only way to solve the corruption of man is through death. “Then the Lord God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever”— therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken. He drove out the man; and at the east of the garden of Eden he placed the cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life“ Genesis 3:22-24 (RSV) Now man can only access the Tree of Life only through sacrificial death. 
The Tree of Life is the symbol of GOD’S ETERNAL LIFE.
Man now doesn’t have access to LIFE. There is the flaming sword of judgement. Who is qualified to suffer the punishment of death? There is a need for a saviour.
Beloved, Jesus came so that in Him we can have LIFE.
How? He went through the way ahead of us, to suffer the death for mankind. He was slain by the sword of judgement. And in His resurrection, He became the ONLY WAY TO ACCESS ETERNAL LIFE. In the fall of man, you will find these items: 1. tree, 2. nakedness, 3. shame, 4. curse, 5. thorns, 6. sweat, 7. death and 8. sword (See Genesis 3).
Our Lord Jesus came to write a better story of our lives.
Jesus sweat greatly for us; He was crowned with thorns; He was pierced by a sword; He died a naked and shameful death on a tree and became a curse for us. Man’s relationship with God was broken in a garden (the Garden of Eden). In a garden, Jesus announced the new beautiful relationship we have with God. You know, He was buried in a tomb in a garden (See John 19:41-42); and in His resurrection, He said to Mary Magdalene: "…go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God" John 20:17 (KJV). This is glorious news. You are no more to be ashamed of God, as Adam and Eve were.
In Christ Jesus, God has been made your Father.
The way to the Tree of Life in the garden is no longer guarded by cherubims and flaming swords.JESUS IS THE WAY!HE IS THE TRUTH!HE IS THE LIFE!
Now you have ACCESS to the Tree of LIFE in Christ!
"And this is what God has testified: He has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life." 1 John 5:11-12 (NLT) Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(John 3:15,36; John 10:9; John 1:4; Romans 5:2; Acts 4:12) WE PRAYThanking God for the gift of His eternal life that we have received in Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 11 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have access to eternal life now. – The eternal life of God is at work in me. – I share in the life and nature of God. – I am not ordinary. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 437 - THE BELT OF TRUTH 1 - The Complete Armor Of God 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 4th, April 2024 THE BELT OF TRUTH 1 - The Complete Armor Of God 3"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)In the Kingdom of God, there are no civilians. Every believer in Christ, is not only a citizen but also a soldier. The born again is also part of the Lord's army.And as soldiers, we are at war! We are soldiers who wage war with the sense of victory, knowing that Christ has made us more than conquerors.
We are not at war with mere flesh and blood, but against principalities and rulers of darkness.
Our Lord Jesus, who is the army commander, has provided us with all the complete armor we need to withstand the wiles of the devil.Paul the apostle writing to the Church in Ephesus, listed the whole armor of God and admonished that they put them on."Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. Stand therefore, having girded your waist with truth, having put on the breastplate of righteousness, and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace; above all, taking the shield of faith with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one.  And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God; praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints."Ephesians 6:13-18 (NKJV).
With these armor, you are fully fortified against the attacks of the devil and also resourced enough to terrorize the forces of darkness.
Paul the apostle used the armor of a Roman soldier to depict how a Soldier in Christ must dress for war against the unseen forces.Interestingly, the first item Paul (the apostle), mentioned wasn't a sword, or even a shield but the belt to gird your loins.Some may think the last thing a soldier must put on is the belt. The first armor a Roman Soldier puts on is the belt after the usual Roman tunic.Paul the apostle wasn't listing the armor randomly, neither was he assuming. Remember, he was a prisoner in Rome and had a close up view of how the soldiers guarding him geared up.Now, there is a clear meaning for what the Roman soldiers belt represent.
The belt of a Roman soldier stands for TRUTH.
We don't have to create another meaning for it.The belt is an essential gear in a Roman outfit. Without the belt of Truth the Roman soldier may not be balance in strength.The Roman soldier's belt girds his loins. It is called "cingulum militare". It was a decorated piece of ancient Roman military gear in the form of a belt.The loins is one of the strongest part of your body. One generates strength to move from the loins.
The whole body frame is held up at the loins or lumbus.
Even during weight or power lifting, one has to put on the weightlifting belt as the body's extra layer of armor around the loins or lower back.The belt provides power or strength support to the body. To the Roman soldier the belt (which is about six-inch wide leather belt) doesn't only provide body balance support, it also holds up the other armor.The belt of Truth is the foundational or essential armor for a Roman Soldier.It depicts how the Truth of Christ is the anchor on which your thoughts and imaginations are held.
Our Lord Jesus is the Truth (John 14:6).
The Roman soldiers belt plays a central role among the other armor. It keeps every armor in place. This is the function of the TRUTH.Jesus is not only full of truth; He doesn't only speak the truth. The things He did and does are true, but Jesus is the TRUTH.Truth is a person and He is Jesus. He is the anchor of our being.
The revelation of Jesus is the truth of your faith.
Everything about your faith and life must be founded or anchored on Jesus.Any message, thought or concept which contradicts the knowledge or revelation of Jesus is not the truth.The strategy and strength of the devil is DECEPTION. Therefore you stand in the evil day by holding yourself up with the revelation of Jesus.
Esteem the revelation of Jesus in your heart.
Let nothing take it away from you or sway you off it.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Romans 13:12; John 1:14,17 1 John 5:29; Ephesians 4:15) WE PRAYWe pray that:- we shall grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus.- we shall by no means by swayed of by any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Kings 14 - 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don't give my hearing to any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. – I grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus. – I esteem the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – Nothing can take away or sway me off from the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – My life is guided by the truth of God which is the word of God. – I maintain my balance by the belt of truth. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 438 - THE BELT OF TRUTH 2 - The Complete Armor Of God 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 5th, April 2024 THE BELT OF TRUTH 2 - The Complete Armor Of God 4"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth,and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)Paul the Apostle wasn't the first to use a military equipment to describe how we are to gear up for spiritual warfare.The Prophet Isaiah gave a prophetic word concerning our Lord Jesus, the Kingdom Army Commander in Chief:"For He put on righteousness as a breastplate, And a helmet of salvation on His head; He put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, And was clad with zeal as a cloak." Isaiah 59:17 (NKJV)This reveals the consistency of the concept that the things which the Lord has supplied to us are spiritual gears we must uphold for spiritual warfare.This is not surprising that the adversary attacks your conviction of the truth in Christ; your understanding of righteousness and salvation.He knows they are equipment which protects you from his attacks.
Put on the Belt of Truth.
A Roman soldier's loins is girt about with a belt called "Cingulum millitaire". This belt is an essential gear in a Roman soldier's outfit, as we looked at it in previous post.Without the belt, a Roman soldier may not be balanced in strength.
The belt of Truth is the foundational or essential armor for a Roman Soldier.
As I mentioned previously, the Belt of Truth depicts how the Truth of Christ is the anchor on which your thoughts and imaginations are held.Let's take another look at the function of a soldier's belt:Most ancient battles were fought in close combat. It was mainly hand- to- hand, therefore, the usual draped loose Roman tunic worn by a soldier will endanger him during a fight.In these ancient times, men wore tunics or skirts that came down to the knees, or even to their ankles. For their readiness, swiftness and flexibility, they roll up the skirt or the tunic, set it up and tucked it into the belt.Which means the belt doesn't only give support to the body due to the weight of the breastplate. It also helps the soldier to be ready for battle.When God was preparing the Israelites to leave Egypt, He instructed them to gird their loins. (Exodus 12:11)The Israelites ate with their loose outfits tucked up into their belts.Apostle Peter in his first epistle also admonished that we gird up the loins of our minds for action (1 Peter 1:13).
To gird up your loins is a symbol of readiness for action.
You are prepared and made ready for action by the revelation of Jesus. The truth of Christ gets you ready to live the divine life of God.Anyone who is not fully established in Truth will be tossed by every wind of doctrine. Such a person lacks the readiness of mind to function according to divine purpose.
Get rooted and established in Truth (which is the revelation of Jesus).
Selah! DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Exodus 12:11; 1 Peter 1:13; Luke 12:35 Romans 13:12; John 1:14,17 1 John 5:21; Ephesians 4:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we will receive with meekness the revelation of Jesus (which is the Truth of God) as we are prepared and perfected for His appearing. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024I Kings 17 - 19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With meekness of heart, I receive the revelation of Jesus. – My life is guided by the truth of God which is the word of God. – I maintain my balance by the belt of truth. – I don’t give my hearing to any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. – I grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus. – I esteem the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – Nothing can take away or sway me off from the revelation of Jesus in my heart. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 439 - THE BELT OF TRUTH 3 - The Complete Armor Of God 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 6th, April 2024 THE BELT OF TRUTH 3 - The Complete Armor Of God 5"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)The Belt of Truth as the foundational or essential armor for a Kingdom Soldier:- Provides support to the believer. A Roman Soldier carries more gear, and he can remain stable, strong and upright with the aid of the belt.- Secondly, the belt of truth also provides ease of movement. When a soldier tucks his tunic into the belt it makes him ready and prepared to function. Every Believer must fasten their minds with the Belt of Truth which is the revelation of the Word.Another interesting function of the Belt of Truth is how it serves as the carrier of a soldier's equipment or gear. This is why the soldier's belt is a primary gear.With the belt, the soldier finds a place to sheath his sword.Even contemporary soldiers place a lot of value on their belts, which bear their pistols, knives etc.
When a Roman soldier's loin belt is not in place it will have a negative effect on his preparedness for battle.
The Roman soldier’s sword hangs in a scabbard attached to the side of the belt. The breastplate is attached to the belt to put it in the right position. Even the shield hangs on a special clip on the other side of his belt, mostly when the soldier is marching to war and the shield is not in use.
The belt of truth is foundational because everything we do is founded on the dimension of truth we have received.
Truth is absolute.And every believer must delve into knowing the truth, which is Christ Jesus.The knowledge of the truth is your freedom (John 8:32)Let your mind be established in  Truth.
You are not well equipped and ready for war when you don't know the Truth.
The adversary will seek to deceive you into fear, doubt, unbelief, worry, depression and failure.However the more you are established in truth, the more you express the glory of God.
Truth is the revelation of Jesus. Grow in the knowledge of Christ daily.
Hallelujah.https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-6_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Exodus 12:11; 1 Peter 1:13; Luke 12:35 Romans 13:12; John 1:14,17 1 John 5:21; Ephesians 4:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall continue steadfastly in the knowledge of the absolute truth of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024I Kings 20 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I continue steadfastly in the knowledge of the absolute truth of Christ. – With meekness of heart, I receive the revelation of Jesus. – My life is guided by the truth of God which is the word of God. – I maintain my balance by the belt of truth. – I don’t give my hearing to any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. – I grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus. – I esteem the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – Nothing can take away or sway me off from the revelation of Jesus in my heart. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 440 - THE BELT OF TRUTH 4 - The Complete Armor Of God 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 7th, April 2024 THE BELT OF TRUTH 4 - The Complete Armor Of God 6"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)We have looked closely into the meaning of a soldier's belt; from the previous episodes we have understood that:- The belt of Truth is the foundational or essential armor- It provides support to the soldier, which of course is what truth does to you. Truth brings stability to the life of a believer.- Truth makes you ready and prepared for every storm of the adversary.- Everything concerning our faith is founded in Truth. Truth is a person and He is Jesus."Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me." John 14:6 (Berean Standard Bible)Truth is also the counsel of God. This TRUTH we are talking about is not subjective.
The Truth which is in God is absolute.
In our generation where people are governed and controlled by their own opinions and emotions, they find it difficult to accept that, Truth is absolute.There are people who even claim that there is nothing absolute.That is interesting!To argue or boldly say Truth is not absolute or there is nothing absolute, you have still made an absolute statement.Christ is Truth.He is complete, absolute and does not diminish.
The Word of God (Logos) is the Truth of God.
Jesus is the Word of God and you cannot separate God from His Word. God's Word is not just true, God's Word is Truth.As I have explained before, the Word of God is the articulation, expression and explanation of God's thought.
There is no lie nor darkness in God, therefore His Word is TRUTH AND LIGHT.
"The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth" (John 1:14)
Jesus is the Word made flesh. The only core thing you see in Jesus is the fullness of Grace and Truth!
When Jesus came in the flesh, Truth came."For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ" (John 1:17).
Truth is who God is and what He has said.
This is what the adversary wants to swear you off. When He can get you not to accept the absoluteness of who God is and what He has said, He will collapse the strength and foundation of your life.When the adversary can get you to believe that the Word of God is not True and optional, He has crushed the foundation of your faith.
Your faith is built on the Word of God, which is absolute and infallible.
When you fail to see and take what God has said and revealed about you as the only absolute Truth, you can easily become prey to falsehood.
Your hope, peace, joy and glory are hewn out of the Word of God.
The Word of God is True because men who wrote were inspired by God. Every thought in the Word has survived every form of dispute and trial.No writ has unveiled the intent of hearts, answered the toughest questions of life, expressed indispensable riches of wisdom and established peace and unending streams of joy than the Word of God.Others may wrongly misinterpret the rich truth of the Word of God. However, the misinterpretation of Truth does not make Truth a lie.Truth is truth irrespective of your opinions, sentiments, religious affiliations, political correctness or incorrectness and displeasure.
The greatest threat of the adversary is the logos (the Word of God).
The Word (Logos) of God is your belt of Truth.Let your mind be established in  Truth.Hallelujah.https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-3.mp4DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Exodus 12:11; 1 Peter 1:13; Luke 12:35 Romans 13:12; Hebrews 4:12; 1 John 5:29; Ephesians 4:15) WE PRAYWe pray that no matter the attacks on the Word of God in our generation, we shall remain confidently resolute and boldly esteem and declare the reality of the Word, in every place. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Irrespective of the opposition and attacks on the infallible of word, I remain resolute. – I highly esteem the word of God. – I continue steadfastly in the knowledge of the absolute truth of Christ. – With meekness of heart, I receive the revelation of Jesus. – My life is guided by the truth of God which is the word of God. – I maintain my balance by the belt of truth. – I don’t give my hearing to any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. – I grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus. – I esteem the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – Nothing can take away or sway me off from the revelation of Jesus in my heart. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 441 - THE BELT OF TRUTH 5 - The Complete Armor Of God 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 8th, April 2024 THE BELT OF TRUTH 5 - The Complete Armor Of God 7"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)Do you know the three major areas the adversary attacks?1. Your relationship with God2. Your relationship with His Word3. Your involvement in the ChurchThese are major threats to the adversary because they are the source, embodiment and conduits of Truth.
The adversary sees his opposition of truth as war.
In this present generation, truth is subjected to sentiments and emotions of individuals. Each person has his or her perspective of Truth.Which is according to to the deceptive workings of the adversary.Though it seems people ask questions, they are not interested in the genuine answers. People are looking for what will satisfy their assumptions, motives and opinions. They are not comfortable to be engaged in holistic discourse which will lead them into reality.Some of them have exchanged the truth of God for a lie (Romans 1:25).When the adversary succeeds at making people doubt and erase God from their convictions, he has erased Truth from their living.
Without God, you will define the purpose and essence of life wrongly.
There are those who believe in the existence of God but doubt the authenticity of the Word of God (precisely the Bible).When the adversary can set you up against what God has said, he is moving you away from Truth.Just as he asked in Eden:"Now the serpent was more crafty (subtle, skilled in deceit) than any living creature of the field which the LORD God had made. And the serpent (Satan) said to the woman, “Can it really be that God has said, ‘You shall not eat from any tree of the garden’?” Genesis 3:1 (Amplified)
He is still asking such seemingly harmless but deceptive questions.
The question the adversary asked in Genesis 3:1 and the conversation he had with the female man, was the beginning of disrupting and corrupting man's relationship with God.This was the beginning of man turning away from God and doubting His word.
God never gave up on man, at sundry times and many different ways, He continued to speak and to reach out to mankind.
Finally, in these last days, He stepped into time, spoke and revealed the fullness of Himself through Christ Jesus. (See Hebrews 1:1-2)As we have discussed in previous episodes, Jesus is Truth.The revelation of Jesus is the truth of God.This revelation of Jesus is upheld by His Church.
- The Church is established and built on the revelation of Jesus.
"But you—who do you say that I am?” Jesus asked.Simon Peter spoke up and said, “You are the Anointed One, the Son of the living God!” Jesus replied, “You are favored and privileged Simeon, son of Jonah! For you didn’t discover this on your own, but my Father in heaven has supernaturally revealed it to you. I give you the name Peter, a stone. And this truth of who I am will be the bedrock foundation on which I will build my church—my legislative assembly, and the power of death will not be able to overpower it!" Matthew 16:15-18 (TPT)Jesus declared that, the revelation of Himself is the bedrock foundation on which He will build His Church.- Since the Church is built on and by the revelation of Jesus, the Church is the only institution on earth which presents and represents the Truth of God."...the church of the living God, his very household and the supporting pillar and firm foundation of the truth." 1 Timothy 3:15 (TPT)
Without God, His Word and His Church, you cannot access the belt of Truth.
The adversary will use divers means to sow deceptive seeds into your heart to make you turn away from God, doubt His word and be discouraged not to get involved in the Church.Do not be deceived, uphold God, His Word and the Church, so that you can rightly put on the belt of Truth.Selah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-7.mp4DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Exodus 12:11; Jeremiah 13:25; 1 Thessalonians 1:9; John 3:33; John 17:17; Jeremiah 10:10;  Hebrews 4:12; 1 John 5:29) WE PRAYWe pray that no matter the attacks on the Word of God in our generation, we shall remain confidently resolute and boldly esteem and declare the reality of the Word, in every place. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 3 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Irrespective of the opposition and attacks on the infallible of word, I remain resolute. – I highly esteem the word of God. – I continue steadfastly in the knowledge of the absolute truth of Christ. – With meekness of heart, I receive the revelation of Jesus. – My life is guided by the truth of God which is the word of God. – I maintain my balance by the belt of truth. – I don’t give my hearing to any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. – I grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus. – I esteem the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – Nothing can take away or sway me off from the revelation of Jesus in my heart. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 442 - THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 1 - The Complete Armor Of God 8
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 9th, April 2024 THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 1 - The Complete Armor Of God 8"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth,and having on the breastplate of righteousness"Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)What kind of damage do you think will be caused when an arrow is shot directly at a soldier's chest or rib area?Such an attack may lead to death or serious injury. This is why the soldier's breastplate is essential.
The breastplate is a defensive armor.
We are in a warfare against principalities and evil rulers of darkness; and at every given time, these evil forces would want to attack you in areas where they will cause you a lot of damage.
The adversary is interested in destroying the core of your being.
And this is why apart from the belt of truth you also need the breastplate of righteousness.A good soldier armed and ready for battle will put on his breastplate.The breastplate is an armor gear which covers the soldier from the neck to the waist. It also covers both the front and the back of a soldier.
The breastplate protects the vital areas of a soldier's body, like the heart, lungs etc.
You have to understand that this warfare is not physical but spiritual. Though the adversary may afflict a person's physical body with sicknesses and diseases, such afflictions or infirmities begin in the spirit.
It is not a fight against flesh and blood, but unseen forces.
The list of God's armor we are looking into is not physical armor. This is a spiritual armor given to us by the Lord.This is not an armor created by believers. It is the Lord who has provided us with this armor. Our role is to put it on intentionally.
This warfare mainly takes place in the spirit and the soul.
The wiles and schemes of the devil are deceptive thoughts.The belt of truth girds your mind against every deceptive thought of the devil against the reality and revelation of Christ.
The breastplate of righteousness also defends your heart against every arrow of condemnation.
One of the strong deceptive arrows of the adversary is condemnation. Condemnation is the root of most believers' challenges.Condemnation makes you walk in fear. It makes you feel undeserving and worthless. Condemnation makes you lose confidence to commune with the Lord.Most believers are not able to exercise the authority given to them in Christ because of condemnation and guilt.Most believers are conscious of their sins or wrongs and imperfections.When you commune with most believers, and ask them about their righteousness, they will boldly tell you, "I am not righteous, no man is righteous and no man can be righteous".
The truth is that no man can be righteous by his or her efforts. Therefore Jesus legally gave us His righteousness.
The righteousness which we have in Christ is not our self-made righteousness. The righteousness which we have in Christ is the righteousness of God."For God made the only one who did not know sin to become sin for us, so that we who did not know righteousness might become the righteousness of God through our union with him." 2 Corinthians 5:21 (TPT)
You are not made righteous by your own works or efforts. You are made righteous in Christ through your union with Christ.
To put on the breastplate of righteousness is not to put on your righteousness. Remember, the armor is called the armor of God."Put on God’s complete set of armor provided for us..." Ephesians 6:11 (TPT).
The armor is not your self-generated armor. The breastplate of righteousness is the righteousness of God.
When the adversary comes at you with thoughts of condemnation and guilt, refuse to see your weakness and wrongs. Instead, acknowledge how Christ has made you the righteousness of God in Him through His obedience.To put on the breastplate of righteousness is to walk daily in the consciousness of how Christ has made you righteous through your union with Him.Hallelujah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Isaiah 59:12-17; Jeremiah 23:6; 1 Corinthians 1:30 ) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall always behold and walk in the consciousness of our righteousness in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 443 - THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 2 - The Complete Armor Of God 9
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 10th, April 2024 THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 2 - The Complete Armor Of God 9"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness"Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)The armor of God is the core item the Lord has supplied or provided for our living.The Belt of Truth which is the Word (Logos) of God and the revelation of God in Christ Jesus, is the foundational armor as we have already seen.The belt of truth girds your mind against every deceptive thought of the devil against the reality and revelation of God in Christ.We have also begun a discussion on the Breastplate of Righteousness.
The breastplate of righteousness defends your heart against every arrow of condemnation.
This Breastplate of Righteousness is not our self-generated righteousness. This Breastplate of Righteousness is not about your works but the Righteousness imputed to us by God through Christ Jesus.No arrow of accusation, condemnation, or doubt is sharp and strong enough to penetrate nor cut through this armor.This is not an armor made of human hands and effort. It is not an armor made of our obedience. The Breastplate of Righteousness is an armor made of God through the obedience of Christ."One man’s disobedience opened the door for all humanity to become sinners. So also one man’s obedience opened the door for many to be made perfectly right with God and acceptable to him." Romans 5:19 (TPT)
By the obedience of Jesus, we have been made righteous.
Let your mind be flooded with this truth.To be made righteous in Christ is to be imparted with the nature of God and to have the right standing with God.
To be righteous in Christ is to stand in the presence of God without any sense of guilt or condemnation.
"Our faith in Jesus transfers God’s righteousness to us and he now declares us flawless in his eyes. This means we can now enjoy true and lasting peace with God, all because of what our Lord Jesus, the Anointed One, has done for us." Romans 5:1 (TPT)Now through Christ, we have a perfect relationship with God because we are made righteous in Him.
Beloved, the adversary will seek every opportunity to make you feel condemned and unrighteous.
When he succeeds in attacking your conviction and consciousness of righteousness in Christ, he will break and crush the confidence of your heart.Don't doubt your righteousness in Christ. When the adversary attempts to make you doubt your righteousness in Christ, DOUBT that DOUBT.
Put on the breastplate of righteousness!
Your consciousness of the righteousness of Christ in you is an armor which defends you from the arrows of darkness.Always declare this "I am the righteousness of God in Christ  The righteousness of Jesus is my righteousness today"Hallelujah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-4.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Isaiah 59:12-17; Jeremiah 23:6; 1 Corinthians 1:30; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; ) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be settled in the certainty of the righteousness we have received through the obedience of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 431 - JESUS IS THE PERFECT LAMB
EPISODE 444 - THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 3 - The Complete Armor Of God 10
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 11th, April 2024THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 3 - The Complete Armor Of God 10"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)To put on the breastplate of righteousness is essential in your daily living as a believer in Christ.
The breastplate of righteousness defends you against one of the most deadly arrows or weapons of the devil — which is Condemnation.
Even our Lord, who is the Commander in Chief of His great army, adorned Himself with the breastplate of righteousness.This was how He was qualified to bring salvation to us.Did the adversary attempt to find faults or wrongdoings in Christ Jesus?Certainly!Through the Jewish leaders, the adversary always tried to ensnare our Lord Jesus. Through their questions, misinterpretation or misrepresentation of the Mosaic laws, and legalistic demands.Even when they did not find fault with Him after His arrest, they took Him to Herod Antipas and even Pontius Pilate (the governor of the Roman province of Judea). And none of these authorities found fault with and in Jesus.For the Lord to bring Salvation to us, He must be perfectly righteous and holy.
It was by the perfection of His righteousness that they found no sin or guilt in Him.
The Prophet Isaiah spoke of it:"For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities: rebellion and treachery against the Lord, turning our backs on our God, inciting revolt and oppression, uttering lies our hearts have conceived. So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter. Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The Lord looked and was displeased that there was no justice." Isaiah 59:12-15 (NKJV)Now from verses 12 to 15, we see the Prophet describing the state of those who have not received the salvation of the Lord. This prophecy doesn't only point to the situation in Israel but extensively describes the state of man without Christ.The offenses of man without Christ are many and sin testified against men.There was a need for a solution; and because there was no one qualified to intervene, the Lord's own arm (Christ Jesus) had to achieve the Salvation plan."He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him. He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak" Isaiah 59: 16 - 17All through the trial of Jesus, He was sustained by His own righteousness. And this was because He put on His righteousness as His breastplate.In your daily walk, the adversary seeks ways to attack you with guilt and condemnation. Yours is to continually stand in the confidence of the righteousness of Jesus.
Jesus was sustained by His righteousness. Your self-righteousness cannot sustain you.
When you received the Lord unto salvation, you didn't only receive Him as life. You also received Him as your righteousness. Your righteousness is no longer your deeds.
Your righteousness is a person and He is Jesus.
"You are partners with Christ Jesus because of God. Jesus has become our wisdom sent from God, our righteousness, our holiness, and our ransom from sin." 1 Corinthians 1:30 (God's Word Translation)The Lord Himself has been given to us who believe in Him as our righteousness. To put on the Lord's breastplate of righteousness is to walk in the consciousness of Christ as your righteousness.
Stand in the consciousness of the righteousness of Christ.
Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Jeremiah 23:6; Jeremiah 23:5; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; Romans 8:1) WE PRAYWe pray our minds will not drift away from the Lord who is our righteousness to our self-righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 15 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 445 - THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 4 - The Complete Armor Of God 11
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 12th, April 2024 THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS 4 - The Complete Armor Of God 11"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)
To put on the breastplate of righteousness is to put on the Lord Jesus who is your righteousness.
Previously we saw how the Lord sustained Himself by His own righteousness. However, you cannot sustain yourself against the arrow of condemnation of the adversary with your self-righteousness.If many had been taught this, they wouldn't have committed suicide.Many have given up the call of God upon their lives because they think they are not worthy or righteous.They judged themselves by their weaknesses and mistakes. They also couldn't stand the legalistic fingers pointing at them.
When you know you are sustained by the righteousness of Jesus and not by your self-righteousness, you will rise to set the record straight, live above condemnation and not become a slave to any addiction.
No matter the awareness you have of Christ's righteousness in you, when you remain a slave to sin, then you are not conscious of the righteousness of God in you.You have to live conscious of Christ as your righteousness. That is how you put on the breastplate of righteousness.
The breastplate of righteousness is dependent on the obedience of Christ not your deeds.
No man's works or deeds will make him or her righteous."We are all infected and impure with sin. When we display our righteous deeds, they are nothing but filthy rags. Like autumn leaves, we wither and fall, and our sins sweep us away like the wind" Isaiah 64:6 (NLT)The righteous deeds of man without Christ's righteousness are as filthy rags or polluted garments. It is not reliable and dependent enough for the attacks of the adversary.The righteousness which you have in Christ is a gift."For if, because of one man’s trespass, death reigned through that one man, much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the free gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man Jesus Christ." Romans 5:17 (ESV)As I previously mentioned, when you received the Lord unto salvation, you didn't only receive Him as life. You also received Him as your righteousness. Your righteousness is no longer your deeds. Your righteousness is a person and He is Jesus."You are partners with Christ Jesus because of God. Jesus has become our wisdom sent from God, our righteousness, our holiness, and our ransom from sin." 1 Corinthians 1:30 (God's Word Translation)The Lord Himself has been given to you who believe in Him as your righteousness. This is the fulfilment of the prophetic word:"And this will be his name: ‘The LORD Is Our Righteousness.’ In that day Judah will be saved, and Israel will live in safety" Jeremiah 23:6 (NLT)
The righteousness of God in you is not first what you do but who Christ is, what He has done and who He is in you.
This is not according to your works, this is the Lord giving Himself to you as a gift.Until you see your righteousness as a gift because you've received Christ, you will be depending on your self-efforts.If your works and self-efforts are the determinant of your righteousness, then they are counted as debt. (Romans 4:4).
You don't live right to become righteous; you live right because you have been made the righteousness of God in Christ.
This consciousness is your breastplate!Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Jeremiah 33:16; Jeremiah 23:5; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; Romans 8:1) WE PRAYWe pray that our boast of righteousness will only be who the LORD IS TO US AND IN US. Our boast and confidence will not be our deeds. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 19 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 446 - THE BREASTPLATE OF LOVE AND FAITH VERSUS THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS - The Complete Armor Of God 13
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 13th, April 2024 THE BREASTPLATE OF LOVE AND FAITH VERSUS THE BREASTPLATE OF RIGHTEOUSNESS - The Complete Armor Of God 13"Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness" Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)We have patiently looked at:- What the breastplate of righteousness is, how to put on the breastplate of righteousness and how it works.- The need for the breastplate of righteousness amidst the attacks of the adversary.- How you cannot depend on your self-righteousness.- How the LORD, Christ Jesus, sustained Himself in His work of salvation by putting on the breastplate of righteousness; and how He has become our righteousness.However, there is a way Paul the Apostle explained the breastplate in his epistle to the Thessalonians:"But let us who are of the day be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (NKJV)One may quickly assume there is a contradiction between 1 Thessalonians 5:8 and what he mentioned in Ephesians 6:14, "having on the breastplate of righteousness".Remember, the Bible does not contradict itself.The books of the Bible progressively unveil the absolute revelation of God.Concerning the gears or equipment in the Lord's armor, there are no contradictions. The absolute meanings of the armor of God are clearly given.
The soldier's belt consistently represents truth in the believer's gears.
Salvation consistently serves as the believer's helmet in Christ (we will be looking into that closely in the next episodes).
Righteousness consistently serves as the believer's breastplate.
It wasn't just Paul the apostle who referred to righteousness as a breastplate.The Prophet Isaiah also recognized righteousness as a breastplate:"...so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him. He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head..." Isaiah 59:16-17 (NKJV)In all three verses of the Bible (Isaiah 59:17; Ephesians 6:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8) Salvation serves as a helmet in the armor of God.
This means that the breastplate of faith and love (in 1 Thessalonians 5:8) also points to righteousness.
In interpreting a Biblical concept, you must also observe how the author consistently interprets symbols and items or objects.For example, in the Gospels, John consistently used water as a symbol of the life-dispensing flow of the Spirit. This means you must maintain that perspective whenever you are reading John's writings.You must have the same understanding as to the writings of the other Biblical authors (except in some exceptional contexts).There are two key items which produced the righteousness of God in you.1. Love2. FaithGod legally supplied His righteousness to us by giving us His son. The entire process of Christ's death and resurrection is the workings of the wisdom and the love of God.Until Jesus died and was raised, His righteousness wouldn't have been made available and dispensed to us.
The death of Jesus is the evidence of the love of God.
"But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us." Romans 5:8 (NKJV)The Lord has demonstrated His love by making it possible for us to receive His righteousness. We cannot receive His righteousness by our good deeds. We receive His righteousness through faith in Him."For no person will be justified [freed of guilt and declared righteous] in His sight by [trying to do] the works of the Law. For through the Law we become conscious of sin [and the recognition of sin directs us toward repentance, but provides no remedy for sin]... This righteousness of God comes through faith in Jesus Christ for all those [Jew or Gentile] who believe [and trust in Him and acknowledge Him as God’s Son]. There is no distinction" Romans 3:20,22 (Amplified Bible)Beloved the love of God and His faith within our hearts are the items that caused the righteousness of God to germinate within our hearts.
Thus, the breastplate of Love and Faith = the breastplate of righteousness.
I believe this blessed you.Glory to God!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-9_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Jeremiah 33:16; Jeremiah 23:5; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; John 3:16) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for His work of love and supply of faith which has brought us into His righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Kings 23 - 25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Thank you Lord for your work of love and the supply of faith which has brought me into your righteousness. - The Lord is my righteousness. - My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. - I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 447 - THE BREASTPLATE OF LOVE AND FAITH - The Complete Armor Of God 14
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 14th, April 2024 THE BREASTPLATE OF LOVE AND FAITH - The Complete Armor Of God 14"But let us who are of the day be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (NKJV)The adversary is busily seeking for whom he will devour with his arrows of condemnation, fear and doubt.
The adversary is not a lion, he goes about as a roaring lion. He is toothless and powerless. All he has is his deceptive gear.
“Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.” (1 Peter 5:8)As believers, we are daily in a spiritual warfare. This warfare is not physical and the weapons of engagement are spiritual.However, you don’t have to be scared.Things about warfare shouldn't put fear in you. They are to bring you to the realization or recognition of things going on in the unseen realm.The issue is, what do you think amidst this warfare? 
Do you think you are alone?
This is what the Lord is saying to you:“Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God, I will strengthen you, yes, I will help you, I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.” (Isaiah 41:10)Oh glory to God.In the context of 1 Thessalonians 5:1- 11, Paul the apostle was dealing with the posture we should have concerning the times and seasons.For example, the Church instead of becoming hopeful and joyful about the appearing of the Lord, lived scared of that day.He explained that the believers are not in darkness but in the light, therefore the day will not be to their disadvantage (1 Thessalonians 5:4-5). As part of his admonishment, Paul the apostle instructed the Church saying:"But let us who are of the day be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet the hope of salvation." (1 Thessalonians 5:8)To be sober is to be well-balanced, always alert and clear-headed. And in that state of mind, we must put on the breastplate of love and faith, the hope of salvation as a helmet.
Get this, the only reason the born again has to be afraid of the appearing or "second coming" of Jesus is when he or she has a sense of guilt and feels condemned.
This is why you need the breastplate of righteousness and helmet of salvation.I have explained previously that, the breastplate of Love and Faith is the same as the breastplate of righteousness.
The breastplate is to guard your thoughts, your mind and your heart from the arrows of fear of condemnation.
Beloved, rejoice! For you are the righteousness of God in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21). You shall not be condemned at the appearing of Jesus. Put on the breastplate of righteousness and helmet of Salvation now. So that when thoughts of how you will be "left behind" and not qualify to be in Heaven, attempt to pierce your heart and crush your head,  you remain heavily defended, impenetrable and immovable.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; 1 Thessalonians 8:1-11; Romans 8:1,31-39) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be swayed off by any doctrine of fear concerning the rapture and the end times but shall continuously remain sober, as we put on the breastplate of love and faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't give my hearing to any doctrine that creates fear of the rapture and the end times. - I refuse to be swayed off by an doctrine of fear concerning the rapture and the end times. - I continuously remain sober as I put on the breastplate of love and faith. - I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 448 - DISARMED ENEMY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 15th, April 2024 DISARMED ENEMY"Having disarmed principalities and powers, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them in it." Colossians 2:15 (NKJV)The weapons of warfare given to us by the Lord, or the whole armor of God are not geared towards attaining victory.They are for the enforcement and enjoyment of the victory we have received in Christ Jesus.
Beloved in Christ, be established in this certainty that the Lord has made you more than a conqueror.
"Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us." Romans 8:37 (KJV).You are not now trying to conquer the adversary; the Lord conquered for you so that you will be overwhelmed by His conquest.And this wasn't as though the adversary was directly in a fight against the Lord. He can't stand a chance.The adversary has always used the legalistic rules, the wrong deeds or sins and the imperfection of man to oppress and keep man under condemnation.But the Lord through His death on the cross and His resurrection, disarmed the adversary completely of any legal document he used against man."He canceled out every legal violation we had on our record and the old arrest warrant that stood to indict us. He erased it all—our sins, our stained soul—he deleted it all and they cannot be retrieved! Everything we once were in Adam has been placed onto his cross and nailed permanently there as a public display of cancellation. Then Jesus made a public spectacle of all the powers and principalities of darkness, stripping away from them every weapon and all their spiritual authority and power to accuse us. And by the power of the cross, Jesus led them around as prisoners in a procession of triumph. He was not their prisoner; they were his!" Colossians 2:14-15 (TPT)The adversary has no legal right to accuse or condemn you. Don't give space for any of his deceptive schemes. He is eternally disarmed and powerless.
He has no power or authority to condemn and to accuse you.
Remain conscious of the triumph of our Lord Jesus through the cross.Hallelujah!https://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-11.mp4DIG DEEPER(John 12:32; John 19:30; Romans 8:1,31-39; 2 Corinthians 2:14; Colossians 2:10) WE PRAYWe pray that as Christ has conquered and made us victorious, we shall experience and celebrate the triumph of the Lord in all that we do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 3 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am more than a conqueror. - The adversary has no power or authority to condemn and accuse me. - I am seated far all principalities and powers in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus. - I cannot be defeated. - I remain conscious of the triumph of our Lord Jesus through the cross. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 449 - HIS VICTORY IS YOUR VICTORY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 16th, April 2024 HIS VICTORY IS YOUR VICTORY"For you were included in the death of Christ and have died with him to the religious system and powers of this world. Don’t retreat back to being bullied by the standards and opinions of religion" Colossians 2:20 (TPT)The death and resurrection of Jesus stripped away from the adversary and his cohorts every power and authority or legal right to accuse or condemn you.
The adversary has no legal right to condemn you.
Now, since he has no right to accuse you, he still tries to find a voice through the religious standards and rules kept by men to bully you.You have to make a personal decision to walk in the victory of Christ. Don't subject the glorious life you have in Christ to religious opinions.The victory of Jesus over the powers and principalities of darkness is your victory as well.The death of Jesus was and is a corporate death. He didn't die for Himself, He died for all men. As many that received Jesus are partakers of His death. When you receive Christ, you become part of Him through baptism in the Spirit."But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name" John 1:12 (KJV)"For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and have all been made to drink into one Spirit." 1 Corinthians 12:13 (NKJV)"For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus. For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ" Galatians 3:26-27 (KJV)We can see from the above verses that, all who believe in Christ are made the sons of God through faith, And all who have received Christ are baptized into Christ through the Spirit.
As you are baptized into Christ, you are also partakers of His death and resurrection.
So though Jesus died for you, He also died with you. You were included in the death of Christ and have died with him to the religious system and powers of this world.
Legally, the conquest of Jesus is your conquest because you died with Him.
It is not only Christ Jesus who has defeated the adversary and also subdued the systems of the world. You have also defeated the adversary and cannot be a slave to the religious systems of this world.Live constantly in the victory of Christ. Don't allow yourself to be bullied by religious standards, rituals, and myths.Hallelujah!https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-12.mp4DIG DEEPER(Romans 6:3-8; Colossians 2:16-23; Galatians 4:1-10; Colosianss 1:27; Colossians 2:6-7) WE PRAYThat we shall not succumb to being bullied by any religious standards and opinions but rather live in the full revelation of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a partaker of the death and resurrection of Jesus. - I live in constant victory every day of my life. - I have overcome the world and its systems. - I refuse to be a slave to the religious systems of this world. - I live above all religious standards, rituals and myths. - I am seated far above all principalities and powers therefore I above all.  - I AM ABOVE ALL. Thank you Lord Jesus for this glorious victory.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 450 - GOD IS FOR YOU
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 17th, April 2024 GOD IS FOR YOU"What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?" Romans 8:31 (NKJV)The opening verse of today's with , has one of the most profound questions you will find in the Bible."If God be for us who can be against us?"Have you found yourself in a situation where it feels like there is no help for you, and you are all alone?Such moments seem to be real. But if you are born again in Christ, that cannot be your reality.One of the assurances the Lord wants you to have is that HE IS FOR YOU and HE IS ON YOUR SIDE!God doesn't only want you to know that you are His; He also wants you to know that He is FOR YOU.It doesn't matter which area of your life the adversary will scheme to make you feel helpless; let your heart be settled on this certainty that the Lord is with you, on your side and for you.When you feel accused and guilty, know that the Lord is your mediator and the Judge who is on your side.When you seem to be opposed by men, let not your heart be troubled.When his servant felt helpless because he saw that they were surrounded by an army of horses and chariots; the Man of God Elisha said to him:"Do not be afraid," Elisha answered, "for those who are with us are more than those who are with them." (2 Kings 6:16)What a mindset!Physical there were no other people with them. But when the eyes of the man of God's servant opened, he saw chariots of fire.The Psalmist said, "The LORD is for me, so I will have no fear. What can mere people do to me?" (Psalm 118:6)This is the consciousness the Lord wants you to have as you go through your day.He says, "Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be discouraged, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you. I will hold you up with my victorious right hand" (Isaiah 41:10)God is for you, therefore you are not condemned.God is for you, therefore you cannot be helpless.God is for you, therefore you are not weak.In all the challenges you will face, remember, that you are more than a conqueror; because the Lord is your Victory.DIG DEEPER(Romans 8:31 - 39; Psalm 27:1-3; Isaiah 8:10; Psalm 56:9; Genesis 15:1; Psalm 46:1; Deuteronomy 20:1) WE PRAYWe pray that in nothing shall we be afraid because the Lord is on our side and for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am not alone. - The Lord is for me. - The Lord is on my side therefore I have no fear. - I am more than a conqueror because the Lord is for me. - The Lord is my victory. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 451 - BE GRACIOUS TO OTHERS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 18th, April 2024 BE GRACIOUS TO OTHERS"And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God in Christ forgave you" Ephesians 4:32 (NKJV)It is easy for people to receive the gospel and be overwhelmed with joy when it is ministered to them.Some people find it easy to accept the reality of God's forgiveness and to appropriate it even in other areas of their lives and living.These people are only gracious to themselves but become voices of condemnation to others. They mark and keep records of the wrongs others do.Apostle Paul admonished the Church in his epistle that they get rid of bitterness, rage, anger and every form of malice (Ephesians 4:31). He then continued with how every believer should be towards one another, as mentioned in the opening verse:"...be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God in Christ forgave you." (Ephesians 4:32 NKJV)You don't have to be an accuser, but be kind and tenderhearted.You don't have to be seeking revenge, but instead be forgiving.And he clearly showed the standard of forgiveness."...forgiving one another, even as God in Christ forgave you."
The forgiveness you demonstrate must be founded on Christ's unconditional love and His unending waterfall of forgiveness.
Please note: You don't forgive others so that God will forgive you. God has already forgiven you. God's forgiveness is according to Christ's love, not your self-effort.
The reality and inheritance of the gospel is not only applicable to you but to all the saints in Christ.
Just as Christ died for you and gave you His forgiveness, He also died and has forgiven the worst of all sinners.This is to say that, as you have received the grace of our Lord Jesus, be gracious to one another as He is gracious unto you.
You don't deal with people based on how you feel and how wrong you think they are but according to how Christ has loved you.
Your graciousness to others is not according to your temper, likes and dislikes. It has to be according to the patience and lovingkindness of Jesus.This is the true evidence that Christ lives in you.Shalomhttps://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim-4.mp4DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 13:4; Psalm 145:9; Ephesians 5:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow in the understanding of the lovingkindness of God towards us, so that we may fully demonstrate His love and grace towards others. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 15 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am gracious unto others. - I don't deal with people based on how I feel and how wrong I think they are but according to the lovingkindness of God towards me. - I am slow to judge people. - I demonstrate the unconditional love of Christ towards all men. - I don't entertain the company of mockers and gossips. - My measure of love towards others is according to God's measure of love towards me. - I grow daily in the understanding of the lovingkindness of God towards me. - I am full of love. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 452 - PERSONALIZE THE LOVE OF CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 19th, April 2024 PERSONALIZE THE LOVE OF CHRIST"Lying back on Jesus’ chest was one of His disciples, whom Jesus loved." John 13:23 (New American Standard Bible)One glorious identity you can have is not the job you do, the title you bear, the things you have accomplished; but the reality that you are loved by Jesus.The love of Christ is not limited to one person or a group of people. 
The love of Christ reaches all and is available for all. His love is unconditional, unquenchable, unfailing, intense, extensive, expansive and unending.
Jesus in His earthly walk loved everyone, and that was why He died for all men.John (the apostle of Jesus), the author of the "Gospel of John" personalized Christ's love for him.The Gospel of John is known as the revelation of the divinity of Jesus. However, it is also the Book focused on the revelation of the Love of God.John the apostle wrote about the love of God for the world (see John 3:16). And how Christ also has a special love for His own who are in the world (John 13:1).He unveiled the fellowship of love in the Godhead, as in the Father's love for the Son. The Lord shares this same love with His disciples (John 15:9).
Jesus loves the world, yet He loves His disciples and has a deeper fellowship with them.
John wrote how Jesus loved Lazarus and his sisters (Mary and Martha). He even wept when Lazarus died, and the people who saw him said, "See how He loves him". (John 11:5, 35-36).So clearly, John the apostle knew the scope and extensiveness of the love of Christ.
