However, he personalized the love Christ has for him.For about five times in his Gospel account of Jesus, he identified himself as the disciple whom Jesus loved.(See the following verses, John 13:23; 19:26; 20:2; 21:7, 20).John didn't only write about how Jesus loved him, he also wrote about how he related to Jesus.In the Gospel of John, we see that he related to Jesus as his Father. John didn't connect to Jesus only as his master. He exudes the confidence of one who is loved.While all the disciples were dining with Jesus, John writes how he was lying on Jesus' chest.Wow...John lying on the chest or bosom of the King of Glory?Let me ask you:Do you have the same level of confidence in the love of Christ?How do you see yourself when you think about Jesus?Do you think you are among all the innumerable company of saints?Or do you think you are the one Jesus loves?This is not about esteeming yourself above others. This is not about being loved because of your deeds.
The confidence in Christ's love for you must be dependent on who Christ is and the richness of His love.
He loves you personally. Among the multitudes, He still loves you as though you are the only one He sees.Personalize the love of Christ."I AM THE DISCIPLE WHOM JESUS LOVES"Glory to God!!!Shalomhttps://christcommonwealth.org/commonwealthlive/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 13:4-7; Jeremiah 31:3; 1 John 4:18; Romana 8:35, 37-39; Psalm 5:11-12; Romans 5:8; Psalm 36:5-7) WE PRAYWe pray that we will know and be confident in the fullness of the love of Christ for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 19 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the disciple whom Jesus loves. - I am specially loved by the Lord. - I walk daily in the consciousness of this love. - I am confident in His love for me. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 453 - BOAST IN HIS LOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 20th, April 2024 BOAST IN HIS LOVE"We love, because He first loved us"  1 John 4:19 (New American Standard Bible)Have you ever felt you have to prove your love to God before you are accepted by Him?As you have seen in the opening verse, you didn't first love the Lord; He first loved you.Your love for the Lord is dependent on His love for you. It was when He demonstrated His love to you that love was dispensed into your heart.Your confidence should always be in God's love for you, not your love.
The Love of God is unconditional, unquenchable, unfailing and unending.
"Long ago the LORD said to Israel: “I have loved you, my people, with an everlasting love. With unfailing love I have drawn you to myself" Jeremiah 31:3 (NLT)You don't define or determine God's love for you by how you live towards Him. God is love, and His love is determined by Himself.His love towards you governs your love towards Him and others. This is why you must increase in the understanding of His love.God doesn't need your righteousness to love you. He doesn't need your works to love you. He doesn't need your effective prayers to love you. When you had no thought of Him  He was there thinking of you."But God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners." Romans 5:8 (NLT)You have always been the focus of His love.
Whatever you do in the Lord, with the Lord and for the glory of God must be founded on His love for you.
No matter how you think or know you love the Lord, let His love for you be your boast.Shalomhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXXfkBuNfgsDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 13:4-7; 1 John 4:18; Romana 8:35, 37-39; Psalm 5:11-12; Romans 5:8; Psalm 36:5-7) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be established in the certainty of God's love for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 23 - 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am confident in His love for me. – I am the disciple whom Jesus loves. – I am specially loved by the Lord. – I walk daily in the consciousness of this love. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 454 - HE'S GOT YOUR SIX
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 21st April, 2024HE'S GOT YOUR SIX“Simon, Simon, look out. Satan has asked to sift you like wheat. But I have prayed for you that your faith may not fail. And you, when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”Luke 22:31- 32 (CSB) Whether consciously or unconsciously, you enjoy the Mercy of God. The Mercy of God works or speaks in your favor even when you are ignorant. There are several situations where God’s Mercy has preserved you.
God’s Mercy endures forever!
Do you know the number of times the adversary has plotted against your life and destiny? Yet God’s Mercy has always protected and sustained you. From the opening verse, you will see the example of Peter. While he was living faithfully as Jesus’ disciple (as far as he can be), the adversary sought to sift him. The adversary had diligently orchestrated the fall of Peter. But Peter had the backing of God’s mercy. Jesus prayed a prayer of petition for Peter.Peter had no idea the sequence of events happening behind him. This means it wasn’t by the faith of Peter that the adversary couldn’t sift him. It was by the Mercy of God. God’s Mercy endures forever! You may not know the many plottings of the enemy, but God’s Mercy got your back. 
Your faith cannot fail, because the Mercy of God is sustaining you.
That is why your boast must not be in anything of your effort. Your boast and confidence should be in God who is rich in Mercy. Have you heard of the phrase “I’ve got your six“? It is a military term, meaning I’ve got your back. It means there may be an unforeseen attack behind you, but I have got you. I will defend you and help you.
The Mercy of God in your life is the backing of God.
Just as in times past you were condemned eternally because of the sin of unbelief and trespasses; But God who is rich in mercy demonstrated His greatest love through the saving Grace of Jesus. (Ephesians 2:4-6)
You mean so much to God, than you can ever imagine. You are engraved on the palms of his hands.
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, And not have compassion on the son of her womb Surely they may forget, Yet I will not forget you.See, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; Your walls are continually before Me.” God’s Mercy is behind and before you in what may seem to be your darkest moments.
Even when your mother and father forsake you, the Lord will take care of you. (Psalm 27:10).
He has got your back, for His Mercies endure forever! Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_--SnHZsxbQDIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Psalm 62:11-12; Ephesians 2:2-6; John 17:9-11,16-21) WE PRAYThat every orchestration of the devil to sift us, shall not prevail and we shall be sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 27 - 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. – God has got my back. – My boast and confidence is in God who is rich in Mercy. – The mercy of God is the backing of my life. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 455 - BURN LIKE WILDFIRE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BURN LIKE WILDFIRE"Do not quench the Spirit"1 Thessalonians 5:19Our Lord Jesus didn’t only come to die for your sins; He also brought you His life. He translates you from darkness into the Kingdom of light and transfuses His life into you through the administrative force of the Holy Spirit.As part of transfusing His life into you, the Lord baptizes you with the Holy Spirit and with fire. To be baptized with the Holy Spirit is to be immersed or submerged into union with the Holy Spirit and with His fire.You come under the influence of the person of the Holy Spirit and His operative ability.
The impact and influence of the Holy Spirit in your heart is as fire.
Get this: the Holy Spirit is not fire; fire only depicts the character of His influence and operation. Fire is a universal language; everything responds to fire, and nothing denies its impact. No one rejects the benefits of fire. That also gives a picture of the operative influence of the Holy Spirit.At your new birth, the Lord ignited the kingdom life within you, a fire within you, the Holy Spirit within you, changing you from the inside out. (See Matthew 3:11, Message Translation).This was what happened to the disciples of Jesus on the day of Pentecost. As they obeyed the instruction of Jesus to tarry:“On the day Pentecost was being fulfilled, all the disciples were gathered in one place. Suddenly, they heard the sound of a violent blast of wind rushing into the house from out of the heavenly realm. The roar of the wind was so overpowering it was all anyone could bear!  Then all at once a pillar of fire appeared before their eyes. It separated into tongues of fire that engulfed each one of them. They were all filled and equipped with the Holy Spirit and were inspired to speak in tongues—empowered by the Spirit to speak in languages they had never learned!” Acts 2:1-3 (TPT)The impartation of the Holy Spirit happened to them as of the experience of fire. The influence of the Holy Spirit in your heart will always be as of fire. This is how one can articulate the burning influence of the Spirit.IT IS AS OF FIRE!
This fire of the Holy Spirit must burn in you if you want to saturate your sphere with the gospel.
It takes the Holy Spirit and fire to be a witness of Jesus.“But you will receive power and ability when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses [to tell people about Me] both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and Samaria, and even to the ends of the earth.” Acts 1:8 (AMP).When the Holy Spirit came upon you, you received:1. Power and ability.2. You were made a witness of Jesus.God doesn’t send anyone out without His fire burning in him/her.For Moses to bring deliverance to Israel from Egypt, he encountered the fire of God (Exodus 3).As part of the Priest’s ministry to God, He has to keep the fire of God’s presence burning on the altar. (Leviticus 6:12)The fire of God in you is an eternal fire; however, its glow must be intense.
To continue to bless lives and spread the gospel, you must continue to burn.
“Don’t burn out; keep yourselves fueled and aflame…” Romans 12:11 (MSG)You have to continue glowing with fire, and everyone will respond to you.It takes the fire of the Spirit burning in you to ignite the Kingdom life within others.
A man of fire is the one who can boldly saturate His sphere with the power of the gospel.
As a beacon of light, you must burn like wildfire!You glow as you continue to:–  Pray in the Holy Spirit. Your prayers burn as an incense (Psalm 141:2; Revelation 8:4).– Meditate on the word of God.“…HIS WORD was in my heart like a BURNING FIRE shut up in my bones; I was weary of holding it back, and I could not… ”   (Jeremiah 20:9)When this truly happens, you just can’t keep quiet or stop speaking what you have beheld of the Lord. (Acts 4:20)If you want hearts to burn for Jesus, your heart must always burn for and with Him!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fuYRudnGK8DIG DEEPER(Matthew 3:11; Ephesians 5:18; Luke 4:14; Micah 3:8; Acts 4:31; Acts 11:23-24) WE PRAYThat our hearts shall glow with the unquenchable fire of the Holy Spirit and with power so that we can saturate many hearts with the power of the gospel. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Chronicles 292 Chronicles 1 -2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is soaked and saturated with the fire of the word.– I can’t keep quiet; I burn and glow more and more with fire.– I have the fire of the Holy Spirit burning in me– I don’t grow cold. God’s fire cannot be quenched in me.– Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfireHallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 456 - SHOD YOUR FEET WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 23rd, April 2024 SHOD YOUR FEET WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL 1It's been an exciting journey of growing in the knowledge of Christ through this Treasure chest — with .Today we get back to studying the armor of God. In case you are now joining the discussion on the armor of God, you can read previous rich verities from here. (Just a click and you are opened to a world of deep revelations).Now let's get into today's discussion."And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace" Ephesians 6:15To have this verse start with an end means something was being discussed before what we have here. Do well to read previous episodes on the armor of God to understand our journey so far.The above verse reveals one of the two items in the armor which focuses on the readiness of a soldier.1. The Belt of Truth2. Shoding your feet.However, to go into the readiness of a soldier, we have to look at the instrument involved, which is the Gospel of Peace.In the armor there is:The belt of Truth — it focuses on the Word of God, which is the Logos of God. The Logos of God is the expression of God's thought. It is both the generic sense of the written and spoken word of God. It is the Word of God given to us as Truth.The Gospel of Peace may also be seen as the Word of God or the Word of Truth. However, there is a precise view of the Word Paul the apostle is referring to in this chapter.The Gospel of Peace is not necessarily pointing to the Word of God as Truth.
The Gospel of Peace unveils the achievement of the Word of Truth. It is about what Truth has accomplished.
The Gospel of Peace means the Goodnews of Peace. The Goodnews of Peace is not the same as the peace which men seem to find in this world. The true peace which men long for cannot be found in the world. The true peace which men seek can only be found in Christ and as Christ.Jesus came to bring us Peace.
The Peace which we received in Christ is Christ Himself.
"For He Himself is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of separation." Ephesians 2:14 (NKJV)This peace transcends life without opposition. The peace which we have in Christ and as Christ is the reality of our oneness with God. It is Christ in us as LIFE.This Goodnews says, there is no enmity with God. There is no distance nor is there a dividing wall between us and God. There are no divided classes of people in God. We have all been brought into oneness with God as one family.This is the glorious news you must carry to the nations of the world.
To get your feet shod with the preparation of the Gospel of peace, includes your going forth with the testimony of our oneness with God in Christ.
This is how you also enforce your victory in Christ amidst the opposition or deceptive schemes of the rulers of darkness.Shalom!https://youtu.be/NgF67AF7Z9MDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20; Isaiah 52:7; Romans 10:15; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15; Psalm 68:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow more and more in the consciousness of our Peace in Christ, which is the access and Oneness of fellowship we have in and with God through Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 3 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I grow daily in the consciousness of my peace in Christ. - Christ is my peace. - I have access and oneness of fellowship in and with God through Christ. - I carry this glorious news of the oneness with God in Christ to my world. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 457 - SHOD YOUR FEET WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 24th April, 2024SHOD YOUR FEET WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL 2"And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace" Ephesians 6:15We ended yesterday's discussion on the note that, to get your feet shod with the preparation of the Gospel of peace, includes your going forth with the testimony of our oneness with God in Christ.Biblically, the usage of "feet" has different intriguing meanings.The feet could be a symbol of exerting strength and authority, a walk or relationship with God, a believer's pilgrimage, a demonstration of character, the journey of a messenger, readiness of mind, taking a responsibility or an assignment and a person's mission.
To "shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace" is mainly to get ready for action in the light of the gospel of peace.
It is to take a stand against the rulers of darkness in the knowledge of the peace or oneness we have with God.Let's look at the verse in the Amplified:"and having strapped on your feet the gospel of peace in preparation [to face the enemy with firm-footed stability and the readiness produced by the good news]." Ephesians 6:15 (Amplified Bible)Here, you see that, the Goodnews of the Gospel produces firm-footed stability and readiness to face the enemy.The Gospel also denotes a good news which is too good to be true. The reality of being at peace and in oneness with God transcends every imagination.The feet in this context don't speak of your physical feet but the readiness of your mind, the character of your heart and your poise to stand up and take action with the gospel.It speaks of how you journey through life ready in and out of season to demonstrate and enforce the goodnews of peace in your sphere.
When people see you, they must know you as a bearer of the gospel of peace; or as one who is always poised with the gospel of peace.
How you live must be a practical evidence and announcement of our oneness with God.Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhW1NhFqGLI&t=46sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20; Isaiah 52:7; Romans 10:15; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15; Psalm 68:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be more saturated with the revelation of gospel of peace and shall have firm-footed stability to confront the adversary and his deceptive schemes. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I carry this glorious news of the oneness with God in Christ to my world. – I am a bearer of the gospel of peace. – My life is a practical evidence and announcement of the oneness with God. – I grow daily in the consciousness of my peace in Christ. – I have access and oneness of fellowship in and with God through Christ. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 458 - BEAUTIFUL FEET
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 25th, April 2024 BEAUTIFUL FEET"And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!" Romans 10:15 (KJV)We have been looking at the armor of God, and one of the gears Paul the apostle mentioned was to shod the feet with readiness (or preparation) for the gospel of peace.The apostle was not only speaking of the gospel of peace but the posture and action every believer must take with the gospel of peace. The readiness or preparation for the gospel of peace is also to stand on your feet alert to share the blessings of peace.This brings home the idea of every believer being a messenger or preacher of the gospel of peace.As part of our spiritual warfare, you must not downplay the role of proclaiming the gospel of peace. When the believers in Christ take a stand to announce the gospel of peace, the deceptive schemes of the adversary are destroyed.
Wherever the gospel of peace is preached, men experience true liberty from fear, anxiety and depression.
As I have mentioned before we are not civilians in the Kingdom. Though we are citizens of the Kingdom we are also soldiers. And as soldiers, we are sent forth by the Lord to enforce His victory in every place. Wherever we go, people must find a reason to rejoice because we go forth with the blessings of the gospel.In Romans 10, Paul the apostle spoke of how many who have not been reached with the gospel can receive the gospel. He explained that the gospel can be heard only when bearers of the gospel are sent.
Every born-again must live as a bearer of the gospel of peace. People must hear the goodnews of Jesus through you.
That is what it means to have beautiful feet. To have beautiful feet is to appear in every place with the goodnews of peace. Have you taken a stand today to announce the goodnews of Jesus with your family and friends?Don't hide any more, the bloggers, television stations, and radio stations are not hiding their content and news.Why must you be quiet?
You are the bearer of the most glorious and greatest news in the universe, SHOUT IT OUT!
"The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it." Psalm 68:11 (KJV)Through the shedding of the blood of Jesus, we have peace with God. We are eternally in union with God in life and nature.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=thHz609A2wg&t=26sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20; Isaiah 52:7; Romans 10:15; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be bold to declare the goodnews of Jesus in every place. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 11 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Many are hearing the goodnews of Jesus through me. – I am a bearer of the gospel of the most glorious and greatest news in the universe. –I am bold and daring about this glorious gospel of peace. – I announce the goodnews of Jesus to my world. – I refuse to sit on the fence, I take a stand today. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 459 - BEAUTIFUL FEET 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 26th, April 2024 BEAUTIFUL FEET 2"And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!" Romans 10:15 (KJV)The opening verse is a continuation of a discussion on how everyone (both Jews and Gentiles) can receive Salvation. Paul the apostle asked systematic rhetorical questions which were to explain the steps to salvation.1. Salvation is for all —both Jews and Gentiles. (Romans 10:12)2. Anyone who shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. (Romans 10:13).3. To call upon the name of the Lord you must first believe in the Lord. (Romans 10:14)4. You can only believe in the Lord when you have the good news of the Lord. (Romans 10:14)5. To hear the good news of the Lord there must be a preacher. (Romans 10:14)6. Therefore a preacher is sent to a people with the goodnews of Jesus so that many can believe. (Romans 10:15).When Paul the apostle said, "it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!", he was referring to Isaiah 52:7.He established the reality that the prophecy of Isaiah was fulfilled in Christ and His disciples (take note, the disciples of Jesus are not only the early apostles. The disciples of Jesus include every saved one in Christ).
The glorious Salvation plan of God was fulfilled in Christ, and we (who are in Christ) are now the publishers of this good news of Salvation.
"How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!” Isaiah 52:7 (NKJV)The Prophet Isaiah used the imagery of a messenger running from a distant city or even a battlefield bearing either good news from a king to a people, or good news from a king to another king or his people or good news from an army to their king.Mostly when there is a battle, the fate of the people depends on the outcome of the battle. It is either the king and his people will lose their kingdom and lands or they will expand their territory or remain unconquered.Definitely, a messenger running from a distant field will come with dirty and tattered feet. But that isn't what matters to the people. What the people are interested in is the news the messenger is bearing.
The beauty of a messenger's feet is in the message he bears.
When Jesus died, he didn't slightly escape from the claws of death in the grave, He defeated death! He rose from the grave as the Lord of all."Then Jesus made a public spectacle of all the powers and principalities of darkness, stripping away from them every weapon and all their spiritual authority and power to accuse us. And by the power of the cross, Jesus led them around as prisoners in a procession of triumph. He was not their prisoner; they were his!" Colossians 2:15 (TPT).
He has sent us to go forth into all the world to herald this glorious news of conquest.
The Lord has made you a bearer of good news. This is what it means to have beautiful feet. In every place, people must hear and experience the victory of Jesus.There is the goodnews of how Jesus has defeated the accuser of the brethren and destroyed all the handwritings of condemnation against you. By the resurrection of Jesus, the Lord has brought justification to all who believe in Him. There is the provision for healing, perfect reconciliation and peace with God.This is good news!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPB64uq5QO4&t=188sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20-23; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15) WE PRAYWe pray that in every place we go, many shall see us as heralds of good tidings (messengers with beautiful feet). BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 15 -18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a publisher of the glorious goodnews of salvation. – Many are hearing the goodnews of Jesus through me. – I am a bearer of the gospel of the most glorious and greatest news in the universe. – I am bold and daring about this glorious gospel of peace. – I announce the goodnews of Jesus to my world. – I refuse to sit on the fence, I take a stand today. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 460 - SHOD YOUR FEET WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 27th, April 2024 SHOD YOUR FEET WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL 3"And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace" Ephesians 6:15 (KJV)There is no doubt that the believer in Christ is at war. And I have explained the spirituality and nature of this warfare from the beginning of this discussion.This discussion on the armor of God is for you to understand the armor given to you by God and how to enforce the victory that Christ has obtained for you.
The armor of God is not just a gear for war but also God's strategy for every believer to exercise and walk continuously in the victory of Jesus.
"Put on the full armor of God [for His precepts are like the splendid armor of a heavily-armed soldier], so that you may be able to [successfully] stand up against all the schemes and the strategies and the deceits of the devil" Ephesians 6:11 (Amplified bible)The deceptive wiles of the devil are his schemes and strategies to subdue the saints in Christ. But God is the extraordinary strategist. He didn't only bring us eternal life, He has given us all the rich realities of Christ as weapons and strategies of war. These weapons and strategies of war are not to bring us into victory but to cause us to enjoy our victory in Christ continuously. We have gleaned from the rich realities of the Lord's armor; from girding your waist with truth to putting on the breastplate of righteousness and having your feet shod with the readiness of the gospel.
To have your feet shod with the readiness of the Gospel also points to the coming and attitude of a messenger with a goodnews.
To shod your feet with the readiness of the gospel is to go forth as a herald of the glad tidings of Christ in your generation.To shod your feet with the readiness of the gospel is also to have the readiness of mind and the urgent sense of responsibility to go forth with joy with the news of Christ's saving power.
Gird your loins and run with the goodnews of Jesus.
This is God's strategy to saturate the world with the overwhelming victory of Jesus. The more we flood our sphere and the earth with the good news of Jesus, the more we destroy the schemes of the devil in every place.
Don't sit on the fence; go forth with the news of Jesus' victory.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ifWIKbUIZgM&t=24sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20-23; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall function as heralds of Christ and be involved in God's strategy to saturate our spheres with the good news of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 19 - 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I function daily as a herald of the glad tidings of Christ in my generation. - I am involved in God's strategy to saturate my sphere with the good news of Jesus. - I refuse to sit on the fence, I go forth with the goodnews of Jesus' victory. - I am bold and daring about this glorious goodnews. Thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 461 - THE MARATHON RUN — BEAUTIFUL FEET 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 28th, April 2024 THE MARATHON RUN — BEAUTIFUL FEET 3"How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!” Isaiah 52:7 (NKJV)During a time of war or a significant intense battle, the fate and history of a people depend on the outcome of the war or the battle. And this was prevalent in antiquity. It was either a king and his people would lose their kingdom and lands or they would expand their territory or remain unconquered.These people will look forward to a messenger to bring them updates from the battlefield. Since there was no advanced technology (such as radio and television) to broadcast the news from the battlefield.As we have looked at this previously, the phrase BEAUTIFUL FEET is an imagery of a messenger running from a distant city or even a battlefield bearing good news.
When the messenger from a battlefield comes with bad news, he is not seen as one with beautiful feet even when he's wearing sandals made of gold.
An example of news being carried from the battlefield to the city will be foundIn 2 Samuel 18; we see the story of how David's army defeated Absalom.A Cushite was sent by Joab (one of the commanders of David's troops) to deliver the message to the King. And also Ahimaz son of Zadok joined the race to take the news to the King. David hearing of how the runners or messengers were approaching the city, knew they were bearing good news.
There is a posture of one who bears good news.
Also around 490 B.C. the Persian army under the reign of King Darius I, arrived at the plain of Marathon (a Greek name for fennel plant) intending to invade Greece; precisely Athens. A soldier and a messenger (named Pheidippides, according to the Greek historian Herodotus) run from Marathon to Athens with the news of the arrival of the Persians (there may be other sides to the marathon story) However, the Persians were defeated at the Battle of Marathon, and definitely the Marathon runner played a role.This marathon runner's feat became the origin of the Marathon race during the Olympic games. He had to run many kilometres of rugged terrain to publish a news. The "marathon runner" was determined to reach his destination. An effective runner must have the mindset of a finisher. A runner must run as fast as he could yet with patience and much endurance.The author of Hebrews stated that we must "...run with patience the race set before us." Hebrews 12:1 (KJV)
Our walk of faith is seen as a race or a marathon.
"As for us, we have all of these great witnesses who encircle us like clouds. So we must let go of every wound that has pierced us and the sin we so easily fall into. Then we will be able to run life’s marathon race with passion and determination, for the path has been already marked out before us." Hebrews 12:1 (TPT)The goal of this marathon is to complete the task of publishing and saturating the earth with the news of Jesus at every cost.You are a bearer of the glorious news of Jesus. Don't quit. 
Strip off every distraction and run with perseverance; for your generation depends on you.
Gird your loins and run with the good news of Jesus.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20-23; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15; 2 Samuel 18) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not grow weary and not be anxious as we run with the glorious news of Jesus in every sphere. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 23 - 25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Many are hearing the goodnews of Jesus through me. – I am a bearer of the gospel of the most glorious and greatest news in the universe. – I am bold and daring about this glorious gospel of peace. – I announce the goodnews of Jesus to my world. – I refuse to sit on the fence, I take a stand today. – I have beautiful feet. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 462 - A HIGH CALLING — BEAUTIFUL FEET 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 29th, April 2024 A HIGH CALLING — BEAUTIFUL FEET 4"How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!” Isaiah 52:7 (NKJV)
The assignment to proclaim or herald the good news of Jesus is a high calling.
We have seen already that, during a time of war, the only news the people in the city look forward to is good news. The people esteem the coming of the messengers.Just as David the king, was waiting for the news from the pursuit of Absalom. (2 Samuel 18). David positioned the watchman of the tower, to look forward to the coming of a messenger.The people of antiquity eagerly looked forward to the messengers from the battlefield. The news from a messenger can determine the stability and instability of a people, which made the responsibility of a messenger during those times, a high calling."Look, a messenger is coming over the mountains with good news! He is on his way to announce the victory! People of Judah, celebrate your festivals and give God what you solemnly promised him. The wicked will never invade your land again. They have been totally destroyed!" Nahum 1:15 (Good News Translation)How a messenger is seen running gives the impression of victory or goodnews from the battlefield.  
As heralds of the gospel, you must have an attitude of victory. You must proclaim the goodnews of Jesus with joy.
Another prophetic item we see in all these prophetic scriptures about the coming of the messenger is the MOUNTAINS.There is the feet, which we have looked at briefly; and precisely "Beautiful Feet". There is also the Gospel or Good Tidings heralded by the messengers; and the mountains.Though the mountains in these verses give an idea of the landscape of Jerusalem, they also provide imagery of the coming of the messenger.Jerusalem is situated on a mountain. "… Solomon began to build the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David..." 2 (Chronicles 3:1)And Jerusalem is also surrounded by mountains.  “Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abides forever. As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people from this time forth and forever.” (Psalm 125:1-2)Thus, as the messengers come to Jerusalem with their good news, they will be seen coming upon the mountains. Nevertheless, mountains also have deeper meanings in the scriptures. Mountains depict exaltation, greatness and higher experience.Get this, though Jerusalem is surrounded by mountains, there are plains in between Jerusalem and the mountains, since Jerusalem is also on a mountain.So why didn't the prophet speak of the messengers running in the valley?The Prophet used the mountains not to show the landscape around Jerusalem but used the landscape around Jerusalem to show the HIGH CALLING of the messenger with beautiful feet.
Your calling and commission to publish or herald the good news of Jesus is as one with beautiful feet upon the mountains; because it is a high calling.
Don't belittle the responsibility of heralding or preaching the glorious gospel of Jesus. Esteem it above any other calling.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRlrvecLgeMDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:9; Isaiah 41:27; Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20-23; Songs of Solomon 2:8) WE PRAYWe pray that all believers shall see and highly esteem the assignment to preach and teach the gospel of Jesus as the High Calling of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 26 - 30 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have a high calling to herald the good news of Jesus. - I herald this good news of Jesus with joy. - Many are hearing the good news of Jesus through me. - I refuse to sit on the fence, I preach Christ everywhere. - I am bold and daring about this glorious good news. - I have beautiful feet. Oh thank you Lord!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 463 - PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 30th, April 2024PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 1It has been an exciting discussion and there are rich depths we are gleaning from the scriptures, concerning the Armor of GodDo you know this: Some few weeks from now, there is going to be Episode 500?We have done more than 400 Episodes of inspiring and transformational writings. If this is your first time here, click here to feast on numerous topics I have treated. And you can click here as well to read on the Armor of God.We have already looked at the Belt of Truth, The Breastplate of Righteousness and The Feet Shod with the Preparation of the Gospel.Today, we look into the fourth item or military gear Apostle Paul mentioned — THE SHIELD OF FAITH."Wherefore take unto you the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness; And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:13-16 (KJV)Through the death and resurrection of Jesus, the Lord defeated the devil and made a public spectacle of him (Colossians 2:15). This victory of the Lord is available for men. Yet not all men have a share in this victory. It is only those who have received the Lord Jesus, shares in His victory legally. Those who have not received the Lord are under the deception and control of demonic forces, principalities and powers who rule in darkness. The devil and his cohorts have no legal aid to condemn, oppress or subdue those who are saved in Christ. However, through the deceptive schemes of the devil, many believers are oppressed by darkness.
Though the adversary was defeated, he still wages war with the saints.
The adversary is at war to:1. Prevent the saints from labouring through the gospel to save the people of the world from darkness to light.2. Distract the believers or the saints from living and enjoying their inheritance in Christ Jesus.3. Prevent the believers or saints from being part of the accomplishment of the ultimate plan and purpose of God.No believer must give room for the schemes of the adversary to prevail. This is why the Lord has supplied every believer with His armor. The armor we are to put on as believers in Christ, is not our self-generated armor. It is God's own armor!In this Spiritual warfare, the cohorts of the devil, are busily and relentlessly throwing missiles at the saints. But as a saint or believer in Christ, you have the SHIELD OF FAITH as your defensive armor.
These flaming missiles or fiery darts of the wicked, are things which are not consistent with the knowledge and character of Christ.
They are things which distract you, oppress you, depress you and weaken you.The adversary is called the wicked one, he has nothing for you which is good.Take a stand as a good soldier in Christ and take up the shield of faith to quench every attack of the wicked one.
It is not the Lord who will take up the shield of faith for you.
The Lord has made provision of His own armor for your use. It is now your responsibility to take the shield of faith.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AmdpjoDOaWwDIG DEEPER(Genesis 15:1; Psalm 91:7-16; Psalm 94:22; Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall have the courage to stand strong in the Lord and take up the shield of faith to extinguish every flaming arrows of the evil one. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 31 – 33 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take up the shield of faith. - I stand strong in the Lord. - By the shield of faith, today I extinguish every flaming arrow of the evil one and his cohorts against my life. - I walk in the consciousness of faith every day. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 464 - PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 1st, May 2024 PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 2"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)There is a spiritual warfare and we are not fighting to obtain the victory; we put on the whole armor of God to enforce the victory Christ has obtained for us.
Though the adversary is completely defeated, he continues to scheme and throw deceptive burning arrows at the saints.
Thank God, He has given us His armor so that we may be able to withstand the evil day. It is therefore your responsibility to put on the whole armor of God.After Paul the apostle mentioned the first three gears, he went on to talk about the SHIELD OF FAITH.
Understand that, there is no armor which is more important than the other. For example, some assume that the SHIELD OF FAITH is more important than the others.
The argument is mainly because Paul the apostle used the phrase "ABOVE ALL" when introducing the SHIELD OF FAITH.The "Above all" doesn't necessarily suggest that the SHIELD OF FAITH is above the belt of Truth, The Breastplate of Righteousness and The Feet Shod with the Preparation of the Gospel.
Faith is not more important than the Word of God (belt of truth); neither is it more important than the righteousness of God.
Faith is supplied by the Word of God.The phrase "Above all" is from the Greek words, "epi" and "pas". The word "epi" means over, in addition, towards upon, covering and out in front. While the word "pas" means "all, whole, always, daily or everything".
Therefore the phrase "above all" doesn't mean the shield of faith is above the other armor pieces in terms of importance or value.
The phrase "above all" means, "in addition" to the other armor pieces, take up the SHIELD OF FAITH. It also depicts the position of the SHIELD OF FAITH."Above all" can also be replaced with "Covering all", "Out in front of all", "Holding it in front of all daily"
So verse 16, can be put this way, "In addition, daily cover all or hold in front of all the armor pieces the shield of faith, to extinguish or quench all the fiery darts".
You will appreciate this more when you understand the size of the shield.There are two kinds of shields. The kind or type of shield used at that time varied from the type of people or tribe or even the type of combat. There is one for close combat; which is a small rounded shield made of wood or metal.Paul the apostle wasn't referring to a circular verge shield which can protect the upper torso of a human body.He was referring to the large rectangular metal shield Roman soldiers carry.The Greek word for shield in Ephesians 6:16 is "thureos" which is a large shield, as door shaped. The shield is wide and long as the shape of a house-door.With that shield size, they are able to cover their whole body from flaming arrows shot at them. In those times, there were arrows as huge as javelins and were first dipped in fire before shooting at their enemies. The idea is not to only pierce the heart or body but to set the enemy on fire and to utterly burn them.The shield is strong and covers the whole body to prevent the damage intended to be caused by the flaming darts.
This is the function of the SHIELD OF FAITH. It covers you from every arrow of the enemy.
The shield of faith is the automatic rejection or extinguishing mechanism given by the Lord to reject, dispel and extinguish every attack of the enemy.
Don't give the adversary any chance to oppress, crush, depress and weaken you.
You must daily shield up with faith as you go about your daily activities. Stand firm and confidently act with the word of God.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fk1d7-sHLJc&t=39sDIG DEEPER(Genesis 15:1; Psalm 91:7-16; Psalm 94:22; Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that we will continually take up the shield of faith by standing firm and confidently with what God has said in His word and not how or what we feel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Chronicles 34 – 36 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take up the shield of faith. – I stand strong in the Lord. – By the shield of faith, today I extinguish every flaming arrow of the evil one and his cohorts against my life. – I walk in the consciousness of faith every day. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 465 - PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 2nd, May 2024 PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 3"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)Beloved, don't leave your life in Christ to chance. Just because you are born again and have the victory of Christ, doesn't mean the adversary will not oppose you.God gave you His armor so that you will be able to withstand the evil day. The adversary is always going to look for the opportunity to oppress you.
Don't permit him! He is always scheming to distract your victory and peace in Christ.
This is the spiritual battle waging around you daily. Don't let down your guard.It is great to have your loins girt about with truth, put on the breastplate of righteousness and shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel. However, those are not the only armor pieces. To have a strong defense mechanism, you have to SHIELD UP!FAITH is your SHIELD!Faith is your absolute confidence in the word of God.Faith is generated and built through the Word of God.Faith comes by hearing and hearing by the Word of God (Romans 10:17). No one can have faith without the Word of God.We will later see that the word of God is the sword. And the shield of faith is the confidence in God through His word.
When the adversary throws fiery darts at you, you must exercise your confidence in what God has said.
Your persuasion and conviction of the word of God is what extinguishes the flaming arrows of the devil.You must take up the shield of faith with aggression.The word "take" is from the Greek word, "analambanō". The word "analambanō", means to take up a thing to use. It is also from two Greek words, "ana" and "lambanō".The word "lambanō" is to actively take to one's self, lay hold upon or take possession of something and not let go.
This shows the attitude you must have with the SHIELD of Faith. You have to actively take possession of it and not let go.
When you daily take possession of the word, and confidently remain grounded in the persuasion of what He has said, no evil oppressive or depressive arrows or thoughts or imagination can have any impact on you.SHIELD UP! GIVE NO CHANCE TO THE DEVIL AND HIS SCHEMES!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g4M88bC9VxMDIG DEEPER(Genesis 15:1; Psalm 91:7-16; Psalm 94:22; Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall firmly have and aggressively hold up the shield of faith so that no scheme and fiery darts of the enemy can prevail. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezra 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS: - I give no place to the devil and his schemes. - I am always on guard. - My confidence is in what God has said. - I take active possession of the shield of faith and I refuse to let go of it. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 466 - YOU MUST BE PERSUASIVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  YOU MUST BE PERSUASIVE“Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences” 2 Corinthians 5:11 (NKJV) To PERSUADE (Peitho) signifies “to apply persuasion, to prevail upon or win over, to persuade,” bringing about a change of mind by the influence of reason or moral considerations. It is to induce one by words to cause belief in a thing (which one sets forth), to make friends of, win one’s favor, gain one’s goodwill, or to seek or strive to win one. (See Vine Expository and Strong’s Dictionary). In a parable, Jesus shared in Luke 14 a certain man invited many to join him in a great feast. But one by one they all made excuses, on the day of the feast. Yet see what the master said to his servant: “And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled” Luke 14:23 After the previous excuses, the master changed his approach or instruction. It was no longer about invitation, it is now a matter of COMPELLING/PERSUADING (Anagkazó). This is how we have to think towards God’s work. Until we compel men we will not see God’s work done as He wants it done. 
Anagkazó means to put constraint upon whether by threat, entreaty, force or persuasion.
 Men will always choose the “self” or their own selfish desires. Men will struggle to choose Christ and the things of Christ. They already see themselves as enemies of God in their minds. (Colossians 1:21) But we have the duty to make many turn to the Lord and to see His Love. We have a duty to snatch men from darkness. “and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh” Jude 1:23 (American Standard Version) Will you stand to watch a friend or another man commit suicide while you can help? When you see someone walking by a roadside and don’t see an oncoming vehicle, you will find a way to save that fellow if you truly care. This is how it is. Many are heading towards destruction. Some knowingly and others unknowingly. To reject Christ is to commit eternal suicide. 
For one to reject Christ means he or she has denied his or her eternal security.
 Are you going to look on for others to perish? Certainly not! Have you heard this before?“Being born again is not a necessity, everyone has the right to choose his or her own path of religion and salvation”. What did you think about it? And this:“If they will not attend the Church meeting it is not by force.” Interesting… Listen, apart from Jesus, “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved” Acts 4:12. Salvation is only in JESUS. And when they reject Jesus they perish. (John 3:16)
Men who have not received the Lord, don’t know they need salvation and how to get saved. The God of this world has blinded their minds (2 Corinthians 4:4)
 Others have their lives controlled by demons. Therefore, until they are persuaded through God’s Spirit and our relentless pursuit, they cannot decide to receive Jesus nor be involved in ministry. Most excuses people make are by selfish, demonic, ungodly influences. Some people may want to attend a Church meeting but the forces controlling them prevent them from deciding. So they find excuses to make. Though those excuses are not true, they will try to stand by them. Thus, we must be relentless, since we know what they need. Understand that we are not wrestling just with their choices but the forces governing their thoughts. Therefore, we PERSUADE THEM. We also don’t take “NO” as an answer, no matter how polite or hostile they sound. SNATCH THEM OUT OF THE FIRE. SNATCH THEM OUT OF DARKNESS.
The Lord has given you power through the Spirit to do this.
 Do it at all cost! Because the LOVE of CHRIST IS AT WORK IN YOU, you will take steps to see others saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth. This is God’s desire (1 Timothy 2:4) GO OUT THERE TO SAVE MEN AND DON’T TAKE “NO” AS AN ANSWER. COMPEL THEM, SNATCH THEM, AND PERSUADE THEM TO COME IN, SO THE LORD’S HOUSE MAY BE FULL. YOU ARE THE MAN FOR THE JOB. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhW1NhFqGLI&t=46sDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:1-2; Luke 14:15-24; Romans 1:16; 1 Corinthians 9:12; 2 Corinthians 5:11-21) WE PRAYThat we increase in the wisdom to strategically get men saved no matter the hostility and hindrances. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezra 4-6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I relentlessly persuade men to be saved. – I have a strong heart and genuine passion of love for the unreached souls. – I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ. – As a light bearer I cannot be intimidated by darkness. – I get many saved at all cost. – I am the man for the job. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 467 - DON'T BELITTLE HIS ASSIGNMENTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  DON'T BELITTLE HIS ASSIGNMENTS "Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.” 1 Chronicles 29:1 (KJV). Some saints in Christ esteem their education, job, and self-centered interests more than the assignment of the Lord. How do you see what the Lord tells you to do?
Anything God tells you to do is great!
The assignments of the Lord benefit generations.You have to see the Lord’s work with the eyes of your spirit and look into generations ahead. David the king said, “the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.” What makes the assignment great is who the work is for.
You don’t value or esteem what you do for man than what you do for the Lord.
Imagine being invited and tasked to represent the President of a country you esteem. You will see it as a great task.
Whatever the Lord tells you to do, is a representation of Him.
The tasks given to you by God are things He had desired to do, and He is entrusting you with them.
Don’t belittle His assignment for you or the dreams He has put in your heart.
Your Heavenly Father’s joy is to see you do something great for Him. I remember one time, during my teens, I woke up excited about a Church excursion. While getting ready the Holy Spirit told me not to be too excited about the excursion and the funfair. He told me that He is calling me to do great things for the Kingdom. And that is also the call of every saint.  He has not called us to do what the people of the world can do. (This is not to deny the importance of social or societal responsibilities or engagements). However, I realised the Lord was redirecting my desires and how I perceive my walk with Him. That morning, the Lord prompted me to read the book of Isaiah. Interestingly, I started with Isaiah 49. I don’t think it was a coincidence: See what I found: ”The LORD said to me, “I have a greater task for you, my servant. Not only will you restore to greatness the people of Israel who have survived, but I will also make you a light to the nations so that all the world may be saved.” Isaiah 49:6 (GNT) Oh, dear Lord. This scripture opened my heart.The moment I saw "I HAVE A GREATER TASK FOR YOU", I was moved into prayer.  My heart began to burn with fresh passion and my mindset about God’s Kingdom assignment was stretched or expanded.
All through the scriptures, anyone God called was made great. 
They were made great because the Lord did great things with or through them. Beloved, you are called by the Lord into His greatness. Think greatness and take great steps. Whatever the Lord tells you to do is great!
Esteem the Lord’s assignment for you.
It is a great thing to serve the Lord. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vHClFwY_F6YDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:10; 1 Thessalonians 1:3; Hebrews 11:6; Psalm 108:13 (BBE); Genesis 26:13) WE PRAYWe are praying and declaring that with God we do great things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezra 7-10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the workmanship of God created in Christ Jesus unto good works. – Through God, I do valiantly. – I increase in capacity and grace as I labour with the Lord. – I esteem the Lord’s assignment for me than any self-centered desires. – I take bold steps towards my kingdom assignment. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 468 - THE ROMAN TESTUDO SHIELD FORMATION — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 5th, May 2024 THE ROMAN TESTUDO SHIELD FORMATION — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 4"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)The armor pieces the Lord (through Paul the apostle) admonished the believers to wear for battle are military gears for defensive and attacking strategies.During ancient times, military gears contributed to battle strategies. New types of military gears were made to suit the strategy for a specific battle. There were times when new strategies or tactics were mapped during a battle, incorporating the number of soldiers, the landscape (the hills or mountains, the valleys, the water bodies, rocks and type of soil) the weather conditions, and even the military strength or strategies of the enemy.They don't go to war without military tactics or strategies. The military formations are carefully chosen by the military leaders. The Lord inspired Paul the apostle, to write about the believers' warfare and the armor pieces to use. These armor pieces also unveil the warfare tactics or strategies the Lord has given to his army.
The armor pieces of the Lord were not given to believers for fashion but for function.
Let me reemphasis this:We are at war with darkness over the salvation of souls and the continuous exercising of our victory in Christ.The day you stop thinking, seeing and living as a soldier of the Lord is the day you expose yourself to the attacks of the enemy.Live vigilantly as a soldier of Christ. Take up the whole armor of God. This means don't leave any armor behind.We have seen the use of:- The Belt of Truth- The Breastplate of Righteousness- The feet shod with the Preparation of the Gospel- And the Shield of Faith.There is more to the Shield of Faith. The Shield of Faith is an armor piece which has a direct contribution to the battle strategy the Lord has given us. Paul the apostle used the imagery of a Roman soldier and army to explain the set-up and the tactics of the Lord's army.During antiquity, the Greeks and Romans did not emphasize the strength of an individual soldier but won battles through strategic formations.The Greeks had the phalanx shield formation, while the Romans also introduced the Testudo shield formation. Both shield formations were defensive tactics formation.The Romans used the Testudo formation (which is like the shape of a shelled turtle) to defend and protect themselves against enemy arrows or archer fire.In the Testudo formation, the Roman soldiers work and stand together as they create a defensive cover on all sides. The soldiers would come together in a tight group or compact rectangular shape. Those on the first line of the formation would hold their shields vertically in front of them. Those on the other sides of the formation would use their shield to also form a shield wall to cover the whole unit (on the left and right sides and even from behind depending on the anticipation of the attack).Even those inside the lines held their shields horizontally above to cover the spaces between their lines and most importantly their heads and that of those around them. No soldier leaves the shield wall or breaks the lines. This Testudo formation allowed the soldiers to defend each other and to work together to stand their ground against attacks of the enemy.They then march forward towards the enemy to attack amidst fiery darts thrown at them.For the Church, the Lord's army to put on the shield of faith is crucial as we daily advance against the gates of Hades.As we see the Roman Testudo shield formation, we must jointly take up the shield of faith.We must function in the uniformity of love through the diversity of abilities we possess as individuals.
The unity of faith is not a slogan, but a functional strategy of the Lord for His Church.
Though every believer must learn to stand alone, we must not be isolated no matter the challenge which confronts us. You must be within the lines or the formation holding up your shield of faith depending on where you are positioned.
Your failure to hold on to your shield of faith will also affect the defensive strength or tactics of the Lord's army.
The adversary takes delight when the brethren are not functioning in oneness of heart, mind and faith. This is because he can attack when we are individualistic.
God is an extraordinary strategist, and He has given us the shield of faith for our corporate function.
Take a stand with the saints in the word and prayer as we enforce our victory in Christ. Don't stay out of Church, build strength in faith with the brethren to extinguish every fiery dart of the enemy.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUUw65cgGRgDIG DEEPER(Philippians 1:27-28; Philippians 4:1-9; Philippians 2:1-5; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall stand together in the oneness of heart as conquerors in the faith of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Nehemiah 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I stand together in the oneness of heart with the brethren as conquerors in the faith of the gospel. - I build strength in faith together with the brethren to extinguish every fiery dart of the enemy. - I don't fail to hold on to my shield of faith. - I take a stand with the saints in the word and prayer as we enforce our victory in Christ. - I don't isolate myself from the brethren no matter the challenge which confronts me. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your victory.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 469 - THE ROMAN TESTUDO SHIELD FORMATION 2 — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 6th, May 2024 THE ROMAN TESTUDO SHIELD FORMATION 2 — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 5"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)Jesus said, "...I will build my Church and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it." (Matthew 16:18)
The Church is the Lord's legislative assembly and victorious army to establish the order of the Kingdom and confront the helm of darkness.
The Church is not called to hide in the pews hoping that the habitations of darkness will automatically be saturated with light. The Church is mandated to march on towards the dark places of the earth. And every believer must be involved.Though the adversary is defeated and rendered powerless, he utilizes his deceptive schemes to wage war against the Church. He keeps plotting and strategizing to prevent the invasion of the Church in dark places. Part of his schemes is to attack the saints with demonic projectiles.These projectiles target the faith of the saints.
The adversary uses flammable arrows or spears which are deceptive thoughts, to crush the confidence of the saints in who God is, His love and what He has accomplished for the saints in Christ Jesus.
But God who is a master strategist has given the Church, the SHIELD OF FAITH. And as we looked at it yesterday, the Church has to march forward towards the gates of darkness, with the testudo shield formation.We must march forward in the unity of faith which is built on the revelation of Jesus."Meanwhile, live in such a way that you are a credit to the Message of Christ. Let nothing in your conduct hang on whether I come or not. Your conduct must be the same whether I show up to see things for myself or hear of it from a distance. Stand united, singular in vision, contending for people's trust in the Message, the good news, not flinching or dodging in the slightest before the opposition. Your courage and unity will show them what they're up against: defeat for them, victory for you - and both because of God." Philippians 1:27-28 (Message).
The unity of the spirit and faith are not slogans but functional strategies of the Lord for His Church.
We must stand together with oneness of vision and purpose for the Lord's Kingdom. The more the saints live by a singular vision, the more we stand united to contend for the faith of others. The courage to shield up together in faith is a great threat to the schemes of the enemy.Don't weigh in on things that bring division among the saints. Don't set your gaze on your self-gratification or interests. 
The adversary will use your self-interests or self-centered pleasures and displeasure as weapons against the harmony of the Church. 
Uphold the revelation of Jesus (above your opinions and interests), for it is the foundation upon which the Church is built.Selahhttps://youtu.be/FkgGB6V9Q9EDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:1-9; Philippians 2:1-5; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that anything which amplifies the self above the revelation of Jesus shall be quenched. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Nehemiah  4 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I stand together in the oneness of heart with the brethren as conquerors in the faith of the gospel. – I build strength in faith together with the brethren to extinguish every fiery dart of the enemy. – I don’t fail to hold on to my shield of faith. – I take a stand with the saints in the word and prayer as we enforce our victory in Christ. – I don’t isolate myself from the brethren no matter the challenge which confronts me. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your victory.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 470 - THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 1— PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 7th, May 2024 THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 1— PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 6"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV) The adversary takes delight in the ignorance of the saints. Ignorance is basically the lack of knowledge.And God's word is clear on this:"My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge..." (Hosea 4:6)
As many who lack the true knowledge of God, His character and the things He has achieved for us in Christ, can easily become victims of the devices of the enemy.
This is why you must take a stand putting on the whole armor of God."so that we would not be exploited by the adversary, Satan, for we know his clever schemes." (2 Corinthians 2:11)The schemes of the adversary are his weapons designed to shipwreck the faith of the saints, to distract them from their communion with the Lord and to cause them to live as mere men and not according to the purpose of God."so that we would not be exploited by the adversary, Satan, for we know his clever schemes." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (TPT)You must have the intelligence and understanding of how the enemy operates. This will guide and guard you from living in continuous defeat. He will not relent from attempting to exploit you. He will always come at you till you believe he is more powerful, the victory of the Lord is not true and you are powerless.
Meanwhile, his goal is to use you as an instrument against the Lord and His purpose.
Don't fall for it!The adversary will always aim at areas or points in your life where you are most vulnerable. The fiery darts of the enemy are poisonous and distractive.None of it is harmless.The Greek word for the "fiery darts" is belos. It is a specially made arrow with a tiny drilled hole, containing flammable fluids. When the arrows are projected, they seem harmless but upon impact on their target, they explode into raging flames; to burn their enemies.These flammable arrows may be subtle, such as bitterness, little offences, unforgiveness, displeasure, disappointment, genuine fears, lies, mistakes, failures, absence of testimonies, self-esteem, jealousy, etc.These may start through harmless situations or incidents, but when they are not intentionally or promptly and explosively extinguished, they will gradually creep into your heart and start by causing a systematic emotional breakdown. The attacks of the adversary are poisonous.But thank God for the shield of faith! With the shield of faith, "you shall be able" to quench the fiery darts.The word "able" is from the Greek word "dunamai" which means the might of power. Dunamai has its root in the word, "dunamis"; it means a dynamic ability to cause changes. It also denotes the explosion or explosiveness of power.With the SHIELD OF FAITH, you are empowered to explode.
The SHIELD OF FAITH speaks of your spiritual and mental disposition by the word of God, our formation or strategy, and our explosive attitude towards the fiery darts of the enemy.
The fiery darts are assaults of the enemy, and the shield of faith makes you fortified and impregnable.This is what the Prophet meant:No weapon formed or forged or fashioned against you shall hurt you, prosper or succeed. This is your heritage in the Lord. (Isaiah 54:17)
Be always alert with your shield of faith to defend yourself against the attacks of the enemy.
Selahhttps://youtu.be/P0i_UvjC1ME?si=GjtY-s6mRxeO_N-xDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that no weapon of the enemy fashioned or rage against us, under any circumstance shall prosper. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Nehemiah  8 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to become a victim of the devices of the enemy. - With the shield of faith, I extinguish any fiery dart of the adversary shot at me. - I am always alert with my shield of faith to defend myself against any attack of the enemy. - No weapon formed or fashioned against me under any circumstance prospers. - I live by faith. - I walk daily in the consciousness of faith. - I am a man of faith. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 471 - THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 2 — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 8th, May 2024 THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 2 — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 7"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)The schemes of the adversary are his weapons designed to shipwreck the faith of the saints. His schemes are mainly to exploit the weaknesses or the inconsistencies of the brethren. He also takes advantage of the voice of every individual's flesh to manipulate their thoughts and actions.As I have already mentioned, the fiery darts of the enemy include unforgiveness, bitterness, offences, displeasure, disappointment, fear, lies, mistakes, failures, absence of testimonies, self-esteem, jealousy, etc. These flammable arrows may be subtle and may start as harmless thoughts or through a harmless incidence, but when they are not intentionally or promptly and explosively extinguished, they will gradually creep into your heart and cause an emotional breakdown.
Sometimes things you will laugh about in the heat of a moment will later become the reason you feel hurt and offended.
How does it happen? The adversary subtly begins to whisper and induce a perspective you didn't consider. Suddenly, you begin to feel angry and offended over something you initially laughed over. He draws your attention and causes the new negative perspective to become your meditation. The more you meditate on it, the more you become offended and bitter.You may think you are doing the right thing by giving a forensic look at the situation. But that is not what is really happening. The adversary is attacking your heart using the situation.
Such attacks from the adversary are poisonous and can even crush your bones physically.
Sometimes you may think it is your right not to forgive. You may even say "I have forgiven" but you know deep within you haven't forgiven. Or will even tell yourself, "How many times should I forgive?; Am I the only one to forgive?".
Unforgiveness or holding on to an offence is a destructive weapon of the enemy.
Look at what Paul the apostle had to say to the Church in Corinth:"So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow. Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him. To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ; Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices."2 Corinthians 2:9-11 (KJV)From the above verses, we see Paul asking the brethren to forgive a fellow who had done some wrong. He then explained the reason for forgiving:
One of the devices of Satan is to use or take advantage of unforgiveness.
Read the verse 11 from the Living Bible:"A further reason for forgiveness is to keep from being outsmarted by Satan, for we know what he is trying to do."(2 Corinthians 2:11).When you are unforgiving, the adversary will outsmart you with his devices. He finds an opportunity to attack the saints when they are offended, bitter and unforgiving.
Don't see any of these reactions or emotional trouble you keep having as natural consequences. They are arrows of the adversary shot at you.
Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Even when He hanged naked on the cross, before His death (while the soldiers gambled for His clothes); He said, "Father forgive them..." (Luke 23:34)Faith works through love (Galatians 5:6)As you forgive others as Christ has forgiven you, you learn to SHIELD UP BY FAITH against the arrows of bitterness, offences, anger and sorrow.
SHIELD UP!
Selahhttps://youtu.be/P0i_UvjC1MEDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 4:32; Proverbs 19:11; Matthew 18:33; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we will not hold on to offences and bitterness but will continue to forgive and love one another.In the Merciful name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Nehemiah  12 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to hold on to offences and bitterness. - I demonstrate the love of God towards all men in all things. - Nothing can offend me. - The love of God gains full expression through me by the day - I am full of love. - The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 472 - THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 3 — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 8
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 9th, May 2024 THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 3— PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 8"Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)There are things and situations the adversary uses as means for his demonic projectiles.For example, a person maltreats you and cruelly relates with you. He or she oppresses you and tortures you mentally, emotionally and even spiritually. This makes you vow that you will never forgive him or her. It even makes you bitter because of the pain you feel and sometimes wish he or she should suffer the same or worse throes.At this point, you should know the adversary has invaded your emotions with his fiery venom. When you come to the point where you strongly crave the destruction of other lives irrespective of their crime and offence, you should know you have become a guest on the table of the devil.
The adversary takes delight in your pain, offences, bitterness, and anger.
When someone hurts you, you may hold a grudge but deal with the situation quickly. It may grow into bitterness, and bitterness is a poison.Bitterness doesn't only affect those who hurt you. Bitterness first destroys you and those around you. "Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good." (Job 21:25)
Bitterness gives you a reason to attack God.
One can be so bitter and even blame God, saying, "If God loves me so much, why did He watch me become a victim or go through that situation? Why didn't He protect me?"When you ask such questions, the devil dances to his "bingo" tune.I am not asking you to just blame the devil for your pain. All I want you to know is, the devil will take advantage or exploit the situation to collapse your defenses and fully crush you. Don't be like Job, who became bitter towards God (Job 10:1,3)
Fight bitterness with the word of God.
Don't give place to bitterness.Sometimes when the adversary wants bitterness to thrive, he isolates you from the Church and your relationship with the Lord.Let me tell you:
Don't allow anything or anyone who did not die for you on the cross, to separate you from the Lord who died for you.
Don't allow the evil, people do to you to change you!This world is an evil world, the only refuge is the Lord Jesus. Some people become the means and instruments for which the devil uses to creep into the Church to attack the faith of innocent ones. Don't allow such to win in the Church.
Stand your ground together with the faithful saints and let truth prevail over evil.
SHIELD UP!Give no place to bitterness.Don't be quickly or easily provoked or angered. Anger is in the bosom of fools (Ecclesiastes 7:9), and you are not one of them. Don't brood or continuously meditate on your pain; it will rather fuel it. Don't keep talking to yourself or others about the pain. Remember, "repetition is the law of deep and lasting impression".See the Wisdom here: "Whoever covers an offence seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates close friends.” (Proverbs 17:9)Talk about the solutions, talk and focus on the Love of God towards you."Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ" Ephesians 4:31-32 (Contemporary English Version)
Rehearse the virtue of being gracious to others!
This is how you SHIELD UP against the blazing arrow of bitterness.Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gxujvTsIX6EDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 14:10; Proverbs 19:11; Matthew 18:33; Colossians 3:8,13; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11) WE PRAYWe pray that the word of God and the love of God shall saturate our hearts and minds to flush out every form of bitterness within us.In the Merciful name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Esther 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to hold on to offences and bitterness. – I demonstrate the love of God towards all men in all things. – Nothing can offend me. – The love of God gains full expression through me by the day – I am full of love. – The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 473 - THE FIERY DARTS OF THE WICKED 4 — PUT ON THE SHIELD OF FAITH 9
content:
