Matthew 28:18 (Berean Literal Bible)"That in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven and things on earth and things under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father." Philippians 2:10-11 (ESV)This means as a saint (born again in Christ), your present life is a continuous expression of the victory of Jesus.
This doesn't mean the adversary is going to take a nap for you to continue in your victory parade.
He is busy with his deceptive schemes to make you doubt your victory in Christ, and feel discouraged, depressed, and distracted from fulfilling your God-given purpose.This is why you are admonished through the epistle (to the Ephesians) that you put on the whole armor of God.The Helmet of Salvation is an important armor piece for the believer.
The Salvation which you have in Christ protects you from every mental assault of the devil.
This armor does not suggest that you have to fight to earn your salvation. It is to establish you in the consciousness of your salvation in Christ. To put on the helmet of salvation is to walk in the understanding of the revelation that, Jesus paid the price of your salvation in full and you now don't have to try to earn it.This is the good fight of faith.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 59:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8; 2 Samuel 22:36; Acts 4:12; Ephesians 2:8-9) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that we shall consciously walk in the victory that we have in Christ Jesus at all times and not fall victims to the deceptive schemes of the devil. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Job 35 - 38 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk daily in the consciousness of my victory in Christ Jesus. - I refuse to fall victim to the deceptive schemes of the adversary. - I fight the good fight of faith from the place of victory. - I increase in the understanding of the revelation of the finished works of Christ. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 485 - HELMET OF SALVATION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 22nd, May 2024 HELMET OF SALVATION 2"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)The helmet of a Roman soldier has two functions:1. Identification2. Protection of the head.The second function of the helmet is the most crucial and essential.The idea that Paul linked helmet to Salvation, gives a clue to the role of the Salvation we have received in Christ, how we have to engage this salvation, how the adversary or the enemy attacks the believer and how salvation protects the believer from such attacks.
To put on the helmet of salvation doesn't suggest a list of things you must do to be saved.
Neither does it suggest that the believer will slide in and out of salvation.To put on the helmet of salvation is not about receiving salvation.Until you are saved, you have no fellowship with the Father.The armor pieces are not for the unsaved. The wiles and fiery darts of the devil are targeted at the saints or the saved.
Putting on the helmet does not produce your salvation. You put it on because you are saved.
I summarized the essence of the Helmet of Salvation in the previous post:The helmet of salvation is not about how you have to fight to earn your salvation."Because of his kindness, you have been saved through trusting Christ. And even trusting is not of yourselves;[a] it too is a gift from God. Salvation is not a reward for the good we have done, so none of us can take any credit for it." Ephesians 2:8-9 (TLB)
If Salvation is not dependent on your self-effort, why are you asked to put it on as the helmet?
You are saved through faith in Christ. However, the adversary attacks you, by projecting arrows of doubt. Doubt is the adversary's strategy to assault you mentally and to break your confidence in God.Though you are saved, the adversary schemes to make you doubt your salvation. And that affects the confidence you have in your relationship with God. When you begin to doubt your salvation through Christ, you will live in uncertainty.
The adversary makes you doubt your salvation and also makes you feel discouraged by amplifying your wrongs and imperfections.
When you should be enjoying the reality of your salvation you will be struggling with the feeling of not being saved.Salvation is not dependent on how you feel about yourself; Salvation is dependent on what Christ achieved for you through His death and resurrection.
The salvation which you received in Christ, is irreversible. It can only be reversed when Jesus' finished work on the cross and His resurrection can be reversed.
But that can't be possible.To put on the helmet of salvation is to have your mind established in the consciousness of your salvation in Christ.It is to walk in the understanding of the revelation that, Jesus paid the price of your salvation in full and you now don't have to try to earn it.
The salvation which you have received in Christ is the basis of your relationship with God.
And because the adversary is interested in disrupting your relationship with God, he goes all out to attack the conviction of your salvation.Let your mind be settled on this truth:"Because of God’s oath, Christ can guarantee forever the success of this new and better arrangement. Under the old arrangement there had to be many priests so that when the older ones died off, the system could still be carried on by others who took their places.But Jesus lives forever and continues to be a Priest so that no one else is needed. He is able to save completely all who come to God through him. Since he will live forever, he will always be there to remind God that he has paid for their sins with his blood." Hebrews 7:22-25 (TLB)PUT ON THE HELMET OF SALVATION; WALK IN THE CONSCIOUSNESS, CONVICTION AND CONFIDENCE OF THE SALVATION YOU HAVE RECEIVED IN CHRIST.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EAzrGUwLgLUDIG DEEPER(1 John 5:11-13; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8; 2 Samuel 22:36; Acts 4:12) WE PRAYWe pray that our mind will be established in the conviction, consciousness and confidence of the salvation we have received in Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Job 39 - 42 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk daily in the consciousness of my victory in Christ Jesus. – I refuse to fall victim to the deceptive schemes of the adversary. – I fight the good fight of faith from the place of victory. – I increase in the understanding of the revelation of the finished works of Christ. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 486 - HELMET OF SALVATION 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 23rd, May 2024 HELMET OF SALVATION 3"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)Previously, I mentioned two functions of the helmet to a Roman soldier:1. Identification2. Protection of the head.I went on further to explain how the helmet of salvation is a protective gear.
To put on the helmet of salvation is to live in the conviction, consciousness and confidence of the salvation which you have received in Christ.
Legionaries and centurions usually wore helmets (typically called galea) and these were topped with cristas or crests (made of horsehair which were sometimes dyed red).The patent model of their helmets made identification of these soldiers during a battle easy.The identification indicates whose side you belong to.The helmet of salvation is also your identification of whose you are.The only reason you are a soldier of Christ is that you are saved.
If you are saved you are Christ's.
Through faith in Christ Jesus, you are saved by grace (Ephesians 2:8).To be saved by grace, through faith in Christ, is not merely to escape hell or damnation. To be saved is essentially to be born of God, which means you become a child of God."For you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus. And all who have been united with Christ in baptism have put on Christ, like putting on new clothes. There is no longer Jew or Gentile, slave or free, male and female. For you are all one in Christ Jesus. And now that you belong to Christ, you are the true children of Abraham. You are his heirs, and God’s promise to Abraham belongs to you" Galatians 3:26-29 (NLT)
Your identity now is that you are a child of God.
And that is one of the works of the Holy Spirit in your heart. He is in you to bear witness and to testify with your spirit that you are God's child. (Romans 8:16).
Your identity as a child of God is the reality of your testimony that you have overcome the world.
"Every God-born person conquers the world’s ways. The conquering power that brings the world to its knees is our faith. The person who wins out over the world’s ways is simply the one who believes Jesus is the Son of God." 1 John 5:4-5 (The Message).Do you now see why the adversary is after your conviction and consciousness of the Salvation you have received in Christ?He wants you to doubt your identity.
Your identity as a child of God is his threat.
He has always been after your identity. You cannot be a slave to the devil and his worldly systems when you are fully conscious of your identity in Christ through salvation.
Put on the helmet of salvation and walk in the confidence of who you are in Christ Jesus.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 John 5:11-13; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8; 2 Samuel 22:36; Acts 4:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall always maintain the focus of our identity in Christ and rejoice in the reality of the eternal salvation which we have freely received in Christ Jesus. Amen! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalms 1 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I belong to Christ. - I walk daily in the consciousness, conviction and confidence of the salvation which I have received in Christ. - I am a child of God. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 487 - THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 24th, May 2024 THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 1"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)If you have been following this discussion on the armor of God, I believe your understanding of the various armor pieces and their function is taking shape and getting richer.
The believer in Christ is both a citizen and a soldier of the Kingdom. In the Kingdom of God, there are no civilians.
And the adversary, though he is defeated and disarmed, consistently strategies and attempts to deceive the saints in Christ.Yes, the believer has the victory over the devil because of what Jesus achieved in His resurrection. However, it is important for the believer to daily walk in that victory.
As deceptive as the devil has always been, he makes believers doubt their identity and victory in Christ Jesus.
This is why you have to intentionally put on the whole armor of God. You put on the whole armor of God to wrestle against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places. You don't wrestle with these forces for victory. You wrestle with these forces from the place of victory.You will be able to withstand in the evil day with the following:* Belt of truth* Breastplate of Righteousness. *  Shoding of your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace* Shield of faith (with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one)* Helmet of salvation
God has given believers more than enough armor pieces that in every way the believer shall walk in victory.
As part of the list of the believer's armor, there is also the SWORD OF THE SPIRIT."Take...the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (NKJV)Paul the apostle, didn't hesitate to be direct with what the Sword of the Spirit represents.
It is the WORD OF GOD!
In every battle, there are weapons used offensively and others used defensively.Interestingly, the Sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God is used both defensively and offensively.The Sword of the Spirit is the revelation of the knowledge of God in your heart. By the revelation of the knowledge of God, you wage war and exercise your victory in Christ.
With the word of God, you are able to stand and also advance offensively against the rulers of darkness.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAY That we will increase in the revelation of the knowledge of God to wage and exercise our victory in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalms 7 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- As I feast daily on the word, I increase in the revelation of God.- I esteem the word of God in my life. - By the revelation of the knowledge of God, I wage war and exercise my victory in Christ. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 488 - ACT QUICKLY ON THOSE DIVINE IDEAS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency ACT QUICKLY ON THOSE DIVINE IDEAS“We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work.” John 9:4 (NLT)Beloved God has trusted you with His glorious gospel.To carry out the assignment to spread the gospel is to carry out God’s great plan. Though God’s plan is eternal it is to be accomplished in time. God’s eternal plan of salvation has been programmed to be accomplished in time. God who has been in all eternity, entered time (which is a spot in eternity) and was revealed (as Jesus) to fulfil the eternal purpose and plan. Our Lord Jesus said: “We need to be energetically at work for the One who sent me here, working while the sun shines. When night falls, the workday is over.” John 9:4 (MSG)
Every saint must have this mind-attitude set of Jesus.
There is a time bound to this work. It is not going to continue forever.  A day is going to come when soul-winning will end.
There is an expected time in God’s eternal calendar when the gospel must reach all men then the end shall come.
And day by day the end of this work draws close. You can’t afford to procrastinate. You have to get up and be about the Father’s business. We are in the harvest season for souls. This season will be over soon. The question at the end will be: HOW MANY SOULS DID YOU GATHER FOR THE LORD? This is why you are here, beloved, to accomplish the task of saving men. This is the harvest time, ACT QUICKLY AND ENERGETICALLY. During our Bible reading plan last year, Proverbs 10:5 caught my attention again. “A wise youth harvests in the summer, but one who sleeps during harvest is a disgrace” Proverbs 10:5 (NLT)
Are you wise or you are a disgrace?
You must know the season you are in and get serious with this ministry task. Make the most of this opportunity, for the time comes when there will be no such opportunity. Look at the same verse in the Passion Translation: “Know the importance of the season you’re in and a wise son you will be. But what a waste when an incompetent son sleeps through his day of opportunity!” Proverbs 10:5 (TPT)
Act quickly on the ideas the Lord is putting in your heart.
The things the Lord is inspiring you to do are the things He wants to do. Be the body and the person the Lord will use to accomplish His task quickly. Don’t hesitate! Don’t make excuses! Don’t think it is not yet time! The time is now.
You are in the body of Christ at such a time to accomplish your purpose.
Get to work quickly and energetically. Don’t delay with that giving. Don’t delay with the outreach plan. Don’t delay with those great ideas. Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=69NS5kfPaVc&t=47sDIG DEEPER(Philippians 3:13-14; 2 Timothy 4:7-8; John 4:34-36; Romans 13:11-12; 1 John 2:18) WE PRAY– The grace to be diligent in work the Lord has entrusted unto us.  – That we will not cast away our confidence in the work of ministry, rather hold on steadfastly till the end working diligently with a strong sense of urgency. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalms 12 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to procrastinate what the Lord has instructed me to do. – I don’t give excuses. – I don’t hesitate. – I act now. – I get the job done on time. – Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. – I am a faithful laborer. – I labour in and out season. – I get myself busy with the Lord’s assignment. – I don’t waste the grace of God bestowed unto me. – I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. – I go every length to get the job done. – I keep a sense of urgency in all things. Ohh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 489 - THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 26th, May 2024 THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 2"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)This is not the first time a sword was used in connection to the Word of God.Words generally were often used in connection to a sword.Scriptures don't only use positive words in connection to a sword. Even negative words were also used in connection to a sword."Look how they belch out [insults] with their mouths; Swords [of sarcasm, ridicule, slander, and lies] are in their lips, For they say, “Who hears us?” Psalm 59:7 (Amplified)See this as well:"There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health" Proverbs 12:18 (KJV)The Prophet Isaiah also used the mouth in connection to a sword."He has made My mouth like a sharp sword, In the shadow of His hand He has concealed Me; And He has also made Me a sharpened arrow, He has hidden Me in His quiver."As you know, the mouth is an organ for utterance.Words have the ability to cut through hearts; it has the ability to influence the state of a person's mind and determine a person's entire being or living.
The word of God is not an ordinary sword or ordinary . The word of God is the S-word; it is the sword of the Spirit. It is the of the Spirit.
What you must know is that the word of God is not the Sword of the Spirit when it is read in the Bible. When you read and study the word of God (which is in the Bible), it refreshes your heart, nourishes you, admonishes you, builds you, and brings you into rich understanding.However, it doesn't make the word of God a sword yet. To use the word of God as the Sword of Spirit, it must be in your mouth.The word mouth in Greek is  "stoma", which means the face or edge of a weapon.
Your mouth is the face or the edge of the sword of the Spirit.
To offensively use the word of God, you must speak it forth!You have the Word of God as a sharp dagger in your mouth.Look at the verse in The Passion Translation:“Embrace the power of salvation’s full deliverance, like a helmet to protect your thoughts from lies. And take the mighty razor-sharp Spirit-sword of the spoken Word of God.“ Ephesians 6:17 (TPT). Do you see it?
The Word of God spoken is a mighty spirit-word with a sharp razor!
You have to take it up and put it to work.The forces of darkness are at war with you every day.A fellow saint in Christ, who knows the word and uses it each day is dangerous to the enemy. You can only rebuke the attacks of the devil by the Word in your mouth.
SPEAK THE WORD!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GUEIhNhyy-IDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray thanking God for the gift of His word which is the sword of the spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 15 - 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I speak the word at all times. – The word of God is sharp in my mouth. – With the word in my mouth, I wage war with every thoughts that opposes the knowledge of Christ in my life. – With the word in my mouth, I live in victory everyday over the schemes of the adversary. – I enjoy daily success in all that concerns me because I put the word to work. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 490 - THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 27th, May 2024 THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 3"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)After a soldier has geared up for battle, he finally picks up his sword for war.We have seen from the previous post that, the sword of the Spirit, is the Word of God in your mouth. Until the word is declared or vocalized it is not yet used as a sword.
The belt of truth is not the same as the Sword of the Spirit.
Though they are both in direct connection to the Word of God these two words reveal two different aspects and functions of the Word of God.The Belt of Truth points directly to the person and personality of the Word. It addresses the reality substance of the Word of God.The Sword of the Spirit doesn't necessarily point to the substance and essence of the Word; it focuses on the active workings of the Word. The Sword of the Spirit, reveals the word as an instrument and not as a person.There are two key words in the Bible translated as "Word":1. Logos2. RhemaLOGOS is the expression of divine thoughts, and thoughts are expressed by writing or speaking. So both the written word and the spoken word can be referred to as Logos. On the other hand, Rhēma is simply the utterance of a specific personal Word of God to an individual or a collective group of people addressing a present situation, to cause an effective change or transformation.
While Logos is the objective word of God; Rhēma is the subjective Word for the now.
It is through the Logos one can access the Rhēma (the specific personal word of God for the now).Without the Logos of God, one cannot receive the Rhēma word.Rhēma is hewn out of your spirit through the meditation of the Logos of God.What you declare or vocalize (the Greek word is hāgāh) is the Rhēma.
Rhēma is not merely articulating a scripture you have memorized. It is declaring the revelation of the Word.
It is that vocalized word (rhēma) Paul, the apostle, referred to as the SWORD OF THE SPIRIT! "…And take the mighty razor-sharp Spirit-sword of the spoken Word of God." Ephesians 6:17 (TPT).
Until you meditate on the scriptures to handle divine revelation to avow, the scriptures will not be useful weapons.
Look at this closely: "For the word of God is living and active and full of power [making it operative, energizing, and effective]. It is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating as far as the division of the soul and spirit [the completeness of a person], and of both joints and marrow [the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and judging the very thoughts and intentions of the heart." Hebrews 4:12 (Amplified Bible) Get this, the Word of God is not merely a historical writing which has no relevance in our day.Peter, the apostle, says it abides forever. (1 Peter 1:23).The Word of God is living, active and full of power. It’s effectively operative with fresh energy. It has the ability to quicken you unto an effective living.The Word of God is not only sharp; IT IS SHARPER than any two-edged sword.The expression any two-edged sword is from the Greek;“DISTOMOS ”The Greek word distomos, has a greater meaning than just a two-edged sword.In the original Greek, Di means two and stomo means mouth. So, in other words, distomos means a two-mouthed sword.
God declaring the Word out of His mouth is as a cutting-edge of a weapon in operation.
I have already explained that mouth, in Greek, is "stoma", which means the front or edge of a weapon.Beloved your mouth is also a weapon.
The Word in your mouth is as a razor of a deadly dagger which cuts deep into every matter.
God’s Word spoken by Him and written down is one sharp side of the dagger, and the other sharp side of the deadly dagger is when you speak the revelation of His Word in your situation. “He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came from his mouth. And his face was like the sun in all its brilliance.” Revelation 1:16 (NLT)
God’s word spoken out of your mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine light and energy!
 "He made my words of judgment as sharp as a sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. I am like a sharp arrow in his quiver.” Isaiah 49:2 (NLT)A word soaked and saturated by divine understanding is sharper than a double-edged dagger which has the ability to cause changes.OH, GLORY TO GOD!Read this also from the MESSAGE BIBLE: "He gave me a speech that would cut and penetrate. He kept his hand on me to protect me. He made me his straight arrow and hid me in his quiver.” Isaiah 49:2 (MSG).
Have you now seen why you don’t have to keep quiet?
God wants you to be saturated and soaked with His Word, and that you can handle the personal Word for warfare.This is why you must make it a priority to read and meditate on both the "Dig Deeper scriptures" and the "BIBLE READING PLAN".Don’t keep quiet!Declare the RHĒMA OF GOD IN THAT SITUATION!!
THE WORD OF GOD IS A SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH SPEAK THE WORD AND NOT YOUR FEARS!
It doesn't matter the arrows or attacks of the enemy, with the Spirit-word in your mouth, you can cause double-edged damage to his demonic operations.
Take hold of the Word of God through meditation and wage war with it!
Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JnEfb_bTNzADIG DEEPER(Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYThat we will take hold of every rhema word we will receive. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 18 - 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God’s word spoken out of my mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine energy. – I speak the word at all times. – I don’t walk in confusion or fear because I have rhema for every situation. – The word of God spoken out of my mouth is sharper than any two edged word. – When I speak the word (rhema) things happen. – I am seasoned by the word. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 491 - THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 28th, May 2024 THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 4"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)The weapons used in spiritual warfare, are not physical materials.
Spiritual warfare requires spiritual weapons.
"For although we live in the natural realm, we don’t wage a military campaign employing human weapons, using manipulation to achieve our aims. Instead, our spiritual weapons are energized with divine power to effectively dismantle the defenses behind which people hide. We can demolish every deceptive fantasy that opposes God and break through every arrogant attitude that is raised up in defiance of the true knowledge of God. We capture, like prisoners of war, every thought and insist that it bow in obedience to the Anointed One. Since we are armed with such dynamic weaponry, we stand ready to punish any trace of rebellion, as soon as you choose complete obedience." 2 Corinthians 10:3-6 (TPT)The devil's weaponry is mainly deployed through thoughts. Thoughts are a set of inward impressions, ideas or presumptions which are conceptualized in the heart of man.
Deception which is the adversary's greatest weapon against the people of God, is conveyed through thoughts.
The armor of God given us are not the physical items we put on. They are not carnal gears but spiritual. These dynamic armor pieces we have looked at function as spiritual realities and virtues in the hearts of the saints.The realm of the heart (the innerward parts of man, which includes: the spirit, the mind, the will, the emotions and the conscience of man) serves as the arena of spiritual warfare.For the adversary to succeed with his deceptive weapon, he must project his arrows as thoughts and impressions into the heart of man through his mind and emotions. When these deceptive thoughts overwhelm the mind, the emotions and the conscience of the man, they then become the governing setpiece of the will. When these thoughts finally get to be set over the will, they determine the choices and decisions of the man.
A man's ability and choice or decision to act and remain resolute in faith or fear is influenced by the truth or the deception which has overtaken his or her will.
Sickness, diseases, afflictions of the soul, depression, and discouragement, are effects of such projectiles of the devil.However, when you put on the whole armor of God, you are ready to withstand the devil no matter the angle or area he attempts to deploy his deceptive and evil projectiles.
Just as in a battle, the enemy will be looking for areas and means to attack the opponent.
When the adversary attempts to make you doubt the reality of who Jesus is, and what the word says, the belt of truth, which is your conviction of the word (logos) of God will keep you secured.If he is looking for means to make you feel condemned and guilty, you have the breastplate of righteousness and the helmet of salvation.With your feet shod with the good news of Jesus, you multiply your impact. As you take up the shield of faith, you are able to encourage one another through the testudo shield formation. You are also able to walk daily in the confidence of who God is to quench every flaming arrow of the devil.
And having the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God in your mouth, you subdue every deceptive and evil imagination of darkness.
The battle between David and Goliath was first fought and completed spiritually by words before the physical manifestation. When Goliath saw David, he first attacked him with words, invoking the spiritual forces of the Philistines. But David, having spiritual understanding, did not keep quiet. He deployed the confidence or faith he had in the ability and power of the name of the Lord and established the victory of the Lord. (See I Samuel 17)
The boldness of David increased even more when he spoke the words of faith and unleashed rhēma.
As Goliath was aroused and made a move forward, David did not run backwards. He knew he had stirred up the Heavens. He was not there to fight alone. He took off from the frontline and charged forward, running towards Goliath.David did have faith, however, the was the need for him to vocalize his faith and confidence in God unto victory.
Beloved, don't be quiet.
Speak the word of God. Declare your victory in Christ at all times.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U2mTggSIEqsDIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17:41-51; Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be saturated with the spirit-word, and that at all times and in every circumstance, we will have the right words to speak to enforce our victory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 22 - 25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God’s word spoken out of my mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine energy. – I speak the word at all times. – I don’t walk in confusion or fear because I have rhema for every situation. – The word of God spoken out of my mouth is sharper than any two edged word. – When I speak the word (rhema) things happen. – I am seasoned by the word. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 492 - THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 29th, May 2024 THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 5"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)As I have already explained to you, thoughts and words are crucial items in spiritual warfare.
Even the thoughts that run through your mind and the words you speak will always affect your living.
The kind of thoughts you entertain will shape your words, and your words will define your world.When the adversary wants to attack your world, he exposes your mind to wrong thoughts. If he wants you to live defeated, he invades your mind with thoughts of weakness, failure, doubt, and negativity.This is why you must become intentional with the meditation of the word of God.You are not like a tree planted by the rivers of water simply because you are born again. It is not that automatic.You can only be like a tree planted by the rivers of water when you make the word of God your delight and meditation (Psalm 1:1-3)
You cannot wage good warfare when you are not full of the word of God.
Imagine a soldier going to war without a sword.How is he going to have an offensive advantage?And the Word of God in your mouth is the Sword of the Spirit. Until you are full of the Word in all situations, you will not be sharp enough to address every opposing thought.Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly. (Colossians 3:16)The greatest deceptive strategy of the adversary against you (as a believer in Christ) is to attack your thoughts by casting shadows on your mind, using the scriptures.
He cast shadows by misquoting or misrepresenting the true meaning of the word.
 He mainly attacks your identity in Christ.That was how he attacked Adam and Eve in Eden. He attacked their identity."Of course we may eat it,” the woman told him. “It’s only the fruit from the tree at the center of the garden that we are not to eat. God says we mustn’t eat it or even touch it, or we will die.” “That’s a lie!” the serpent hissed. “You’ll not die! God knows very well that the instant you eat it you will become like him, for your eyes will be opened—you will be able to distinguish good from evil." Genesis 3:3-4 (TLB)Meanwhile, God made man in His image and after His likeness (Genesis 1:26).Again, after the Father had declared these words during the baptism of Jesus "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!” (Matthew 3:17)The devil came to tempt Jesus saying, “ If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become loaves of bread.” (Matthew 4:3)Do you see it?He came attacking what the voice said concerning Jesus.The moment he used the phrase "If you are the Son of God", he is subtly creating uncertainty in the mind of Jesus.He now wants Jesus to think he is not yet the son of God but will only become by doing what he tells him to do. And if Jesus had done what the adversary was deceptively asking for, he might have lived in doubt of who He is and be ruled by the thoughts of the devil.Beloved do not be ignorant of the devices of the enemy.
The adversary will always attack what God says about you!
Jesus knew the devil's devices and deployed the word of God."But Jesus told him, “No! The Scriptures say, ‘People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.” (Matthew 4:4)Did the devil stop there?Not at all. He kept using various means in an attempt to make Jesus act contrary to his reality. Yet, Jesus consistently addressed the situation with the word, till He finally and sternly cast the devil out using the word as a weapon. Jesus didn't just quote the scripture, He had to use it as a weapon.This time Jesus didn't just say it is written, He said:“Get out of here, Satan,” Jesus told him. “For the Scriptures say, ‘You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ (Matthew 4:10)This was similar to what David did when he confronted Goliath.
Beloved, what is the challenge confronting you? Take hold of the word of God concerning that situation and use the word as a weapon to enforce your victory.
Get hold of the word, be full of the word of God, that you may be ready in all season; with your mouth full of the right words to be used to wage war.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ckyH_wy9VYDIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17:41-51; Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow in the revelation of the Word, to know how to rightly use the word in the relevant situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 26 - 30 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am full of the word. - I am established in the certainty of my identity in Christ. - I speak forth the word of God at all times. - I have the right word for every season and circumstance of my life. - I wage war with the word of God given to me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 493 - THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 30th, May 2024 THE SWORD OF THE SPIRIT 6"And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God" Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)Of all the armor pieces mentioned, it takes a lot of skill and mastery for a soldier to use the (the sword or sharp-razor dagger).Before the introduction of the Chinese fire-spurting lances (around the 9th century, which later led to the invention of the hand cannon in the 15th century and then the matchlock guns), one of the most lethal weapons for close combat was the or a sword.From antiquity, all through to the medieval era, there were different kinds of swords which were invented. Some of these swords were believed to possess ancient powers or supernatural forces and the swordsmen who wielded them were considered legendary.Right from the First World War, the usage of swords declined drastically. It became a ceremonial weapon. Most people born in the 20th and 21st centuries don't know the prestige of being known as a skillful swordsman.This is the point, a few weeks or months of training at a military camp, will turn lower-class soldiers into a capable gunner. But that is different from becoming a highly skilled swordsman or archer. To become one who wields a sword, required lifelong devotion.To become an exceptional swordsman in battle requires absolute dedication to training.You cannot become one who effectively wields the sword of the Spirit, without a consistent daily devotion with the Spirit and the word.The sword of the Spirit is crafted from the Holy Spirit and not with a metal.As I mentioned, the word of God is used as a sword when you speak them forth. The speaking forth of the word is not only when you quote verses of scriptures.It must be scriptures, spoken by the spirit of revelation, understanding, spiritual conviction, consciousness and confidence of faith.Jesus said, "The words that I speak to you are spirit and they are life" (John 6:63).When you are saturated by the Holy Spirit and the knowledge of the word, you don't merely quote the scriptures, you speak them forth as life.
It takes intentional devotion to the Holy Spirit and the study of the scriptures to skillfully wield the word of God.
When you are trained to wield the word skillfully, you will know what to say in the face of opposition or adversity.An evil day may come, but you can withstand all pressures, evil schemes and the wiles of the devil when you have submitted yourself to the training of the word.This is why the adversary doesn't launch attacks on you until he succeeds in moving you away from reading the word. In effect, the adversary begins his attacks by making you feel too busy to commune with the Holy Spirit and takes your attention away from meditating on the scriptures.
The adversary will subtly work to move you far away from Bible study meetings, Church meetings, special word conferences, sound teachers of the word etc.
These things the adversary prevents you from, are the things which will make you skillful to wield the word of God.Though Jesus was the word of God made flesh, He also gave Himself to the studying of the scriptures. (Luke 2:47).
You don't submit to the training of the word just to win arguments; the training of the word builds you up for victorious living.
Be committed to a lifelong devotion to the Spirit-word.Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UUGMOiS6T0DIG DEEPER( 2 Timothy 3:14-17; 2 Timothy 2:15; 1 Samuel 17:41-51; Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray that we will develop the discipline and diligence to be committed to a lifelong devotion to the study, meditation and training of the Word and the communion of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 31 - 35 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am full of the word. – I am established in the certainty of my identity in Christ. – I speak forth the word of God at all times. – I have the right word for every season and circumstance of my life. – I wage war with the word of God given to me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 494 - PRAYER - A WARFARE TRANSCEIVER 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 31st, May 2024 PRAYER - A WARFARE TRANSCEIVER 1"With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people" Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified)There cannot be a discussion on spiritual warfare without prayer.The scriptures emphasize the need for prayer. We see the importance of prayer through the life and testimonies of the Biblical patriarchs, prophets, priests, kings, servants, soldiers, wives, husbands, widows, the rich, the poor, the distressed, the victorious, farmers, physicians, craftsmen, builders, fishermen, prime ministers, scribes, prisoners, eunuchs, sinners, apostles, the youths and the adults or the old.
Prayer is not for some specific people. Both the small and the great are all called to prayer.
From the scriptures and the epistles, we are charged to pray at all times, in every place or everywhere and without ceasing.Jesus shared a parable to this end, "men ought always to pray and not faint" (Luke 18:1).Prayer is a demonstration of faith and confidence in God.Prayer is essential in this spiritual warfare. It is an advanced technology given to us by God, to stay in touch with the military command post or control center.
Unceasing prayer gives access to unceasing mission plans and strategies.
This was David's main battle strategy. He was always in touch with God at every battle. Therefore, he always knew what to do on the battlefield. While the enemies were strategizing, David was in touch with God who knows and sees all things.You don't fight against unseen evil forces, principalities, powers, or rulers of dark places and not be consistent in prayer at all times.It is a dangerous thing to be a soldier and not be in touch with your military headquarters.In ancient times, Roman soldiers were always in communication with their command base.Orders were given via horns, drums, movement of flags and riders on horseback.Not staying in touch with military orders can be disastrous for a soldier.
How are you waging spiritual warfare without praying at all times?
You must also understand that prayer is one of the mediums we prove that we are submitted to God.Anything you are not praying about is not under God's rule and dominion.When you pray, you bring everything or situation under God's rule.
You must pray all prayers and pray always in the Spirit.
Have you prayed today?Are you in touch with your military command base?Have you received an instruction from God through prayer?Or you are running by your own strength, strategy and plan.
Get into prayer; get God involved.
This is how you walk in possibilities!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EiwNLXcVlRsDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:6; Psalm 116:2; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will give us direction this day so that we will know what to do and the steps to take to accomplish His assignment for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 36 - 41 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. - I pray always in the spirit. - Through prayer I see possibilities. - I am given to prayer. - I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 495 - PRAYER - A WARFARE TRANSCEIVER 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 1st, June 2024 PRAYER - A WARFARE TRANSCEIVER 2 "Praying at all times in the Spirit, with all prayer and supplication. To that end, keep alert with all perseverance, making supplication for all the saints." Ephesians 6:18 (ESV)As part of discussing the armor of God, Paul moves on to talk about PRAYER.As I began to explain in yesterday's episode, prayer is an advanced technology God gave us to stay in touch with the military command post or control center.
The believer is on a mission to manifest and establish the glory of the Kingdom of God in the darkest places on earth.
These dark places are ruled and governed by the highest principalities and authorities operating in rebellion under the heavenly realms.Though they were defeated through Christ's death and resurrection, they still hold this dark world in bandage through deception.As believers in Christ, we are soldiers and light-bearers of the Kingdom, of God, to enforce His victory in our lives and every place. This is the basis of our spiritual warfare, fight of faith or hand-to-hand combat with the evil forces of darkness.Paul the apostle, gives a deeper meaning to prayer as he mentioned it within the context of the spiritual armor.
Prayer is not like a call of a waiter by a restaurant  guest.
Prayer is communion with your Heavenly Father. It is also as a war transceiver. With this battlefield transceiver, we transmit our burdens to the Lord and receive ability and insight from the Lord. Our Lord Jesus gave us prayer to help us complete our Kingdom duty.To be given prayer (as a warlike transceiver) is evidence that the Lord wants each believer to have access to Him unceasingly and receive daily strategic battle plans.It means we are not alone on this battlefield. This transceiver is not an external armor, it is a connection device installed into us by the Lord.Through prayer, we are able to personally stay in touch with the Lord, who is the chief captain of the Kingdom army.
You will not esteem prayer until you are involved in the mission of the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus.
When you understand the intensity of this spiritual warfare, and the need to enforce the victory of Christ, you will always appreciate prayer as a battlefield transceiver.You are at war, stay alert and in touch with the Lord, through PRAYER.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChTdJpkoi54DIG DEEPER(Philipians 4:6; Psalm 116:2; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will teach our hands for war and our fingers for battle, and that we will enforce His victory in our lives and every dark place. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 42 - 46 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. - I pray always in the spirit. - Through prayer I see possibilities. - I am given to prayer. - I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 496 - PRAYER - THE EMPOWERING FORCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 2nd, June 2024 PRAYER - THE EMPOWERING FORCE"praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints" Ephesians 6:18 (NKJV)When you read through Ephesians 6:17-18, especially in the New King James Version (NKJV), you will notice that verse 17 ends with a semi-column (;) and then verse 18 starts with a lower key alphabet, "praying always.."This implies that verse 18 of Ephesians 6, is not the beginning of a new sentence.This implication is not only based on the NKJV but also on what it is in the original Greek.Paul, the apostle, wasn't introducing a discussion which was different from the armor of God.The moment a Roman soldier puts on the various armor pieces, he puts on the helmet and then takes his sword for action.The interesting thing is that it also takes an empowering force or ability for one to efficiently and effectively wield a sword.To wield the sword of the Spirit,  which is the Word of God, is not only by how you understand the word. It is not only how skillful you are in using the word. The impact of the "Rhema word" is according to the power which backs it.
Through prayer, you activate the empowering force of the Spirit to wield the "rhema word".
So you can read what Paul wrote in Ephesians 6:17-18  this way:"And take... the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God...praying..."When the wielding of the word is backed by prayer, it works more effectively.Prayer gives the "rhema word", the force to prevail against every limitation.The word of God is powerful, however, you cannot exude the power in the word without prayer.
Prayer is the means by which you saturate the word you have received from God with God.
Get it, God's word spoken to you is full of God. However, the word should not proceed from you as your word. It must proceed from you as God's word. This is why you pray.Through prayer, you submit the administration of the word through you to God. The mighty hand of God backs your utterance (declaration of the revelation of the word) so that it will produce the God-kind and God-intended results.Paul the apostle knowing this made this request:"Finally, dear brothers and sisters, pray for us that the Lord’s message will continue to spread rapidly and its glory be recognized everywhere, just as it was with you" 2 Thessalonians 3:1 (TPT)The rapid spreading of the message of Christ will be by prayer.
It is not how skillful or intelligent one is with the reality of the word. It is the ability of God which backs the administration of the word.
To even have utterance of the word, one must be soaked with prayer. (Ephesians 6:19).This should give you a picture of wielding the word through God."For by their own sword they did not possess the land, And their own arm did not save them, But Your right hand and Your arm and the light of Your presence, For You favored them." Psalm 44:3 (Legacy Standard Bible)Take note the above verse is only used here, to give you a pictorial view of wielding the word through prayer.So just as the Spirit- word is the sword of the Spirit, you wield it to triumph by prayer or the release of the Lord's presence.
Don't just speak or act the word. Use the word as a weapon of war through prayer.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9eCOoswdTVoDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:6; 1 Thessalonians 1:5; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAYWe pray that the word of God in us will be saturated by the force of God's presence and will produce the God-kind of results. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 47 - 51 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: King's Gate -Wisdom For Leaders
EPISODE 497 - PRAYING ALWAYS WITH ALL PRAYER 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 3rd, June 2024 PRAYING ALWAYS WITH ALL PRAYER"praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints" Ephesians 6:18 (NKJV)When you understand that there are deceptive forces opposing your victory and rest in Christ, you will appreciate the need to take up the whole armor of God and stay in communication with God.
Every believer in Christ is not a soldier on retreat, but a soldier on the battlefield enforcing the victory of Christ daily.
As we have already seen, prayer is a battlefield transceiver. And must not be neglected at any given time.
You are actively in touch with the Heavenly throne through prayer.
Prayer is the posture of every good soldier. To enforce your victory in Christ and to establish the light of the glory of God in dark places, you need both the armor pieces and prayer.To exercise the victory we have in Christ, Paul the apostle, instructed that the believer must go all out in prayer. "pray always with all prayer..." This means:1. There are different aspects or kinds of prayer.2. And you must deploy all these aspects or kinds of prayer to get results.
Believers must treat prayer with all seriousness.
You have to pray always with all prayer. By implication, to pray "with all" prayer is an intense concentrated mixture of the various kinds of prayer.Thus, though prayer is a general conversation and deep communion with God, it has different aspects.
There is a prayer of thanksgiving and praise, confession or declarative prayer or prayer of faith, petition or supplication and intercession.
All these aspects or kinds of prayer are done in the Spirit.The praying in the Spirit mentioned in the verse above doesn't suggest that you pray all prayers in tongues only or silently in your heart.
Praying in the Spirit is not limited to "praying in tongues".
It doesn't also mean it is wrong to "pray in tongues" as you pray always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit. To pray always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit is to pray according to or under the power and influence of the Holy Spirit.In this spiritual warfare, pray with thanksgiving in your heart knowing that, you have the victory. Pray declaring all that the Lord has accomplished for you and all the saints. Pray making specific requests from the Lord.
Don't hesitate to pray, and don't think that the Lord wouldn't answer your prayer.
He has given you this battlefield transceiver because He is always ready to answer and direct you.You don't also have to struggle and be wondering what kind of prayer to pray at a time. Your prayer must be by the influence of the Holy Spirit and the knowledge of the Word.As the Spirit of the Lord inspires, prompts and urges you to pray, He will lead you to know the kind of prayer posture to deploy.
Have you prayed today?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3Bp8juzjokDIG DEEPER(1 Kings 9:3; Philippians 4:6; 1 Thessalonians 1:5; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12) WE PRAYWe pray to thank the Lord for the opportunity and access He has given us to commune with Him and His impartation of grace and ability to accomplish  His task. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 52 - 58 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I pray always with all prayer. – I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 498 - PRAYING ALWAYS WITH ALL PRAYER 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 4th, June 2024 PRAYING ALWAYS WITH ALL PRAYER 2"praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints" Ephesians 6:18 (NKJV)As we have already taken a look at the need for prayer in this spiritual warfare, you must become intentional with prayer.
Every believer must go all out in prayer day and night, praying always with all prayer in the Spirit.
As part of praying all prayer; the prayer of worship and thanksgiving is important.This kind of prayer helps you to acknowledge who God is and the glorious things He has done for you.There are some who limit the prayer of thanksgiving to, before and after other kinds of prayers. But that is not what it is.You must pray all prayers in the Spirit and with thanksgiving in your heart."do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God" Philippians 4:6 (ESV).The reality that you are in touch with the Lord through prayer is enough for you to be grateful. Prayer as a battlefield transceiver is an assurance that the Lord, who is the Chief Captain of the Kingdom Army is with you.More than 50 times, Paul mentions "thanks" or "thanksgiving" in his epistles.He thanked the Lord:- for His eternal plans and purpose.- for the workings of His grace.- for His love towards the saints- for the spread of the gospel.- for the faith of the saints- for the accomplishments of His death and resurrection.
Prayer of thanksgiving is a great demonstration of faith.
Jehoshaphat for example, led Judah and Jerusalem to battle against Moab, thanking and praising the Lord even before they got to the battlefield.  (2 Chronicles 20:21-22)With such prayer, the Lord may put psalms, hymns and spiritual songs of praise on your lips.You celebrate the victory of the Lord daily.Glory to God!There is also the prayer of faith or declarative prayer.With this, you articulate the word of God with the conviction, consciousness and confidence of faith.
It is not a prayer of request; it is the speaking forth of what God has said. It is a prayer of decree.
"You will also declare a thing, And it will be established for you; So light will shine on your ways" Job 22:28 (NKJV).The decree here is not only about speaking or making a proclamation. It is also making a decision. So, what you speak forth is also a strong decision of faith in your heart.Pray with thanksgiving in your heart. And declare the wondrous things the Lord has done for you.
When you pray this way, you increase in boldness, and joy in the Holy Spirit and confuse the forces of darkness.
It is a warfare strategy given to us by the Lord; make good use of it.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uaqdtZuFsRwDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:3; 2 Corinthians 2:14; 2 Thessalonians 2:13-14; Psalm 136:1; Psalm 103:1-2; Job 22:22-29) WE PRAY We pray thanking the Lord for the glorious things He has accomplished for us through His death, burial and resurrection.And we pray declaring our victory in Christ Jesus.(NB: PRAY using the  DIG DEEPER scriptures) BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 59 - 64 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Thank you Lord Jesus for your eternal plans and purpose for all mankind. - Thank you for the workings for your grace in my life. - Thank you Lord for your love towards me. - Thank you for all the glorious things you accomplished for me through your death and resurrection. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for all that you have done for me![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 499 - "I WILL GIVE YOU REST" Says, JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 5th, June 2024 "I WILL GIVE YOU REST" Says, JESUS"Then Jesus said, “Come to me, all of you who are weary and carry heavy burdens, and I will give you rest." Matthew 11:28 (NLT)For some weeks now we've been discussing the Lord's armor.Which has been a refreshing daily feast.However, I want your heart to be fully settled on this:
Yes, we are at war with the evil forces of darkness. However, we are not fighting for victory. We are fighting from and in victory.
Though we wrestle against principalities, powers and rulers of dark places, we are not to be threatened or burdened.The victory which Christ has brought us is rich with HIS REST!You don't have to feel pressured and overwhelmed because you are instructed to put on the whole armor of God and to persevere in prayer.
The armor pieces given to us by the Lord, are evidence of His provision and care for us.
Glory to God!Whenever people get to think about their relationship with God, they first think of what they have to do for the Lord, or what they think the Lord has to do for them.
Most believers are work-oriented and self-oriented.
Jesus who is God manifested in the flesh, came to show us the delight of God.God is not essentially interested in what you want to do for Him or what you want. Through Christ Jesus, we see that God wants you to ENJOY HIM!To enjoy God is to focus on what He SUPPLIES to you.Read the opening verse again:Jesus said, "... I will GIVE you REST".
Jesus didn't invite you to Himself primarily because of what you will do for Him, but what He will give to you.
"Are you weary, carrying a heavy burden? Then come to me. I will refresh your life, for I am your oasis. Simply join your life with mine. Learn my ways and you’ll discover that I’m gentle, humble, easy to please. You will find refreshment and rest in me. For all that I require of you will be pleasant and easy to bear" Matthew 11:28-30 (TPT)
You cannot genuinely share in the delight of the Father when you have not enjoyed what He SUPPLIES to you.
His glory is expressed through you when you enjoy His gifts.When Jesus said, "I WILL GIVE YOU REST". He meant it!The reality is this, as you have already come to Christ, HE HAS GIVEN YOU REST.
When you came into Christ, He didn't only give you rest; YOU ENTERED HIS REST.
"For the one who has once entered His rest has also rested from [the weariness and pain of] his [human] labors, just as God rested from [those labors uniquely] His own." Hebrews 4:10 (Amplified)Whatever you do with the Lord and how you daily live must be rooted and established in the reality of the REST which CHRIST has given to you.Are you running or waging war in anxiety or in the REST OF JESUS?We are in the rest of Jesus, therefore enjoy His rest!
His yoke is easy and His burden is light. He is not difficult to please.
Whatever He tells you to do, He is in it with you. He is the loving Father who bears your burdens.Hallelujah!https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/The-Experience--with-Apostle-Bennie_Trim.mp4DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 1:3; Hebrews 10:12; Luke 15:20-22; 1 John 5:3; Proverbs 3:17; John 16:33) WE PRAY We pray thanking the Lord for the rest that He has given us in Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 65 - 68  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have entered into His rest.– I have seized from all my struggles and works.– I am not anxious about the future.– I have absolute dependence in the supply of the Lord.– I trust and enjoy the voice of God.– The Lord leads me daily in the oasis of peace by His voice.– The Lord is my satisfaction and enjoyment.– I am not need conscious.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 500 - THE FATHER'S LOVE 1
content:
"... So the father raced out to meet him. He swept him up in his arms, hugged him dearly, and kissed him over and over with tender love." Luke 15:20 (TPT) The Holy Bible is flooded with countless refreshing scriptures. And they convey the character, the essence and the wisdom of God.
The goal of the word of God is that all men may be fully satisfied in God, through the knowledge and understanding of Him.
Jesus (who is God made flesh) came to bring us into that eternal experience. The people who have been abused by religion and controlled by the rulers of darkness have a wrong mindset and doubts about the Bible. Some also have the wrong picture of God. And even think that Jesus came to change God's mind about us. The image which has been painted over the period is that an angry hot-tempered God, wanted to destroy mankind and Jesus came to make Him change His mind.
This picture which has been painted over the centuries is not consistent with the word of God.
Get this: - God is good. (Nahum 1:7) - God is unchanging! (Malachi 3:6) - God is Love. (1 John 4:8)
Jesus didn't come to change God's mind about us, He came to change our mindset about God.
Jesus is God made flesh. He came to show mankind the true picture of God. "For God so loved the world..." (John 3:16). "God spared not His son, but gave Him up for us all..." (Romans 8:32) Glory to God... WAIT A MINUTE: DID YOU KNOW with is already Episode 500? 500 episodes of rich verities, dissolving hard sentences and establishing you in the consciousness of the glorious life and tender love in Christ. Hurray! It's been 500 days of an unceasing flow of divine revelations and experiences of the Father's love. Until Jesus came, no one related to God as Father.
He came to show us the Fatherhood of God.
"I have revealed to them who you are and I will continue to make you even more real to them, so that they may experience the same endless love that you have for me, for your love will now live in them, even as I live in them!” John 17:26 (TPT) Through Jesus, the Fatherhood of God is revealed and the experience of His love is made real. Without Him, you cannot perfectly know the Father in a real way and may not experience His endless love for you. He said, "You are my righteous Father, but the unbelieving world has never known you in the perfect way that I know you!..." John 17:25 (TPT)
You will have a perfect knowledge of God when you behold Jesus.
One time as the disciples of Jesus were asking him about the Father: "Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father, and we will be satisfied.” John 14:8 (NLT) Wow!  Don't mistake this satisfaction as the "satisfaction of their curiosity". There is a longing for a deep relationship with God. There is no relationship with God which transcends, His Father-son relationship with us. You experience an immeasurable satisfaction when you come into the reality that, God is your Father. There is nothing more you need, nothing more satisfying, nothing that is enough for you, than the revelation of the Father.
The revelation of the Father is what makes you have a real experience of His love.
Jesus replied, “Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and yet you still don’t know who I am? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father! So why are you asking me to show him to you?" John 14:9 (NLT)
You don't need to look too far to see the Father; Jesus is the Father!
To see the heart, care, kindness, sacrifice, mercy, forgiveness and graciousness of Jesus, is to see the heart and character of the Father. Just as the Father is unchanging, Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, and today and forever. (Hebrews 13:8), He is unchanging!
He brought to light the fullness of the Father's goodness and love.
When the Father looks at you, He doesn't see a prodigal son. He doesn't want you to focus on yourself and your weakness. He wants you to focus on His love; for that is how you are most satisfied. The Father rejoices over you, He wants you to experience the warmth of His tender love, each day. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 1:1-3; Colossians 1:15; John 1:14,18; John 10:30-38; Psalm 103:13; 1 John 3:1; Matthew 7:11-12) WE PRAY That we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship in Christ Jesus. And by the ability of God’s Spirit within us, we shall express the nature of the Father as he has intended. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 69 - 72 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the joy of the Father. -I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. – I am born of God. -As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. – I express the quality of God’s life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 501 - THE FATHER'S LOVE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 7th, June 2024THE FATHER'S LOVE 2"... So the father raced out to meet him. He swept him up in his arms, hugged him dearly, and kissed him over and over with tender love." Luke 15:20 (TPT)Jesus who is God made flesh, came to us to show us the God-life.Jesus demonstrated to mankind the true and perfect character of God.Man had always had a wrong picture of God.
However, Jesus brought to light the fullness of the goodness of God and His loveliness as the Father.
He showed how God, will always attend to the details of our lives and be our great comfort. He healed the sick, the lame, the lepers and the blind.Those who were condemned to death according to the law, were brought to Him, He showed them forgiveness.Jesus didn't only demonstrate the love of God, He taught on God's love using parables and stories. There are about 52 recorded parables of Jesus in the Gospels. Most of these artistic parables are authentic to only Jesus; they are depiction of Himself. Which of course most rabbinic parables are not focused on the rabbi. But Jesus' were different.In Luke 15, Jesus shared three beautiful parables which explained how God's love works.Just in Luke chapter 15 and 16, Jesus shared, five (5) amazing parables.Two of the parables were in Luke 16, and Jesus was talking to His disciples, to have better understanding of how the economy of God works in contrast to how the religious Jewish leaders think.However, the three (3) parables  in Luke 15 were direct responses to the religious and self righteous Jewish leaders.
They assumed they knew God and His character, but never knew anytime they spoke to Jesus, they were speaking to God made flesh.
"By this time a lot of men and women of questionable reputation were hanging around Jesus, listening intently. The Pharisees and religion scholars were not pleased, not at all pleased. They growled, “He takes in sinners and eats meals with them, treating them like old friends.” Their grumbling triggered this story" Luke 15:1-3 (The Message)Parables (the Greek word is Parabole) are stories or illustrations, or a general term for figurative saying. Parables are not to be taken literal but must be examined closely to draw out the meaning from the perspective of the narrator.It is in parallel to the Hebrew word, "mashal". Which means to speak or use a proverb, speak or make parables and speak in sentences of poetry.You find this a lot in the Old Testament portion of the Bible. The prophets, psalmist, leaders and kings spoke in these manner.
The parables Jesus spoke are of Jewish concept and background than the Greeks.
This will help you not to submit your thoughts to the several misconceptions around the parables of Jesus.In Luke 15 you will find a parable of:1. The Lost sheep.2. The Lost coin and3. The Loving FatherMost people have got the third parable all wrong.The focus of these three parables is Jesus and not the sheep, the coin or the son.
The parable does not depict a prodigal son, but instead, the LOVING FATHER.
Interestingly, those who heard the parable didn't see a prodigal son. They heard and saw the heart of Jesus through this parable.Jesus illustrated:- How He loves sinners and how He is eagerly ready to receive those who are called sinners.- The warmth and love He gives and shows "sinners" no matter how dirty they look in the eyes of the religious folks.- How He transforms the hearts of the condemned, when they come to Him.
The Father never called His son prodigal.
When the young son set off for home. His father saw him coming from a long distance away. Which means the father has always been looking forward for the return of his son. Though the son was dressed as a beggar. The father didn't start by complaining and reminding him of how foolish he was. Instead the father had great compassion swelled up in his heart for his son who was returning home.And the father raced out to meet him. He swept him up in his arms, hugged him dearly, and kissed him over and over with tender love. The Father didn't care about his son's dirty state.Look at the son's response:“Then the son said, ‘Father, I was wrong. I have sinned against you. I could never deserve to be called your son. Just let me be—’“The father interrupted and said, ‘Son, you’re home now!’ Luke 15:21 (TPT)The father wasn't listening to the son but was focused on loving him..When we feel imperfect and unworthy before the Lord, He doesn't see our imperfections. He sees us worthy of His love and saving grace.The Father wasn't ready to listen to his son's sense of guilt . He interrupted and said, "Son, you are home now!"Wow!The warmth of the loving Father .The father reminded him of his place, by calling him "Son..."
This is how God sees you; no matter your guilt and shame; you are His son and He loves you with an everlasting love.
"The LORD appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee." Jeremiah 31:3 (ESV)Focus on the Love of the Father and not your imperfection.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Hosea 11:4; Isaiah 45:17; Songs of Solomon 1:4; Romans 5:8; 1 John 4:10) WE PRAY We pray declaring that:1. our eyes will see and our hearts will comprehend the depths and richness of the love of the Father for us. 2. we will be satisfied with the love of God, that His joy will be expressed through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 73 - 77 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the joy of the Father. – I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. – I am born of God. – As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. – I express the quality of God’s life.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 502 - THE FOUNDATION OF OUR FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE FOUNDATION OF OUR FAITH "And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.”1 Corinthians 15:14 (KJV) Jesus did not only prophesy His death; He consistently prophesied His resurrection. The cross though is a key element in preaching the gospel, it is not the foundation of the gospel.
The foundation of the gospel is the death and the resurrection of Jesus our Lord.
Apart from the unique birth of Jesus and the reality that He is God; another truth which is feared and greatly opposed is the RESURRECTION OF JESUS. There are many who will easily agree that Jesus died, but are agitated and filled with indignation when they hear of the Resurrection of Jesus.
The glorious news and the crux of the Gospel is the resurrection of Jesus.
Jesus did not only speak concerning His death, because speaking of His death wasn’t a surprise to the religious leaders. After all, that was what they were plotting.  It was the kind of death, the purpose of His death and His resurrection from the dead which shook the hearts of the religious leaders. His disciples seemed to be only worried about His death.
You must intentionally uphold the good news of His resurrection.
When Jesus resurrected, He said, ALL HAIL, which also means REJOICE! “And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified. He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay. And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word. And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.” Matthew 28:5-9 (KJV) Which means His resurrection is a great news for us. The resurrection of Jesus is the very crux of the gospel because: 1. Without His resurrection there would have been no evidence of our Justification. “who was betrayed and crucified because of our sins, and was raised [from the dead] because of our justification [our acquittal—absolving us of all sin before God]” Romans 4:25 ( Amplified Bible) "Jesus was handed over to be crucified for the forgiveness of our sins and was raised back to life to prove that he had made us right with God!" Romans 4:25 (TPT) We can now see the purpose and essence of His death and resurrection respectively. He died because of our transgressions or sins.And He resurrected as the evidence that we are declared not guilty.Oh hallelujah!!! 2. The resurrection of Jesus made it possible for us to partake of the Newness of Life. “…through his death the power of your sinful nature was shattered. Your old sin-loving nature was buried with him by baptism when he died; and when God the Father, with glorious power, brought him back to life again, you were given his wonderful new life to enjoy.” Romans 6:3-4 (TLB) This is another glorious news concerning the resurrection of Jesus.We see that in His death the nature of sin was terminated. But in His resurrection we received the Life of Christ. Now you are partakers of His divine nature. (2 Peter 1:4). When you become born again, you share in the quality of life Christ has because of His resurrection.
It was by His resurrection we received eternal life.
"What a God we have! And how fortunate we are to have him, this Father of our Master Jesus! Because Jesus was raised from the dead, we’ve been given a brand-new life" 1 Peter 3-4 (MSG) Beloved, imagine if Christ just died and did not resurrect, what would have been the basis of our good news that we are justified, and have the newness of life? Whenever you see or hear someone aggressively or subtly opposing the resurrection of Jesus, then you should know the adversary is working through such, to cripple your faith.
He wants to make you doubt the reality that you are justified and have the eternal life of Christ.
The resurrection of Jesus is the foundation of our faith. REJOICE IN THIS TRUTH! Gloreeeyy!!!https://youtu.be/qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Romans 5:18; 1 Corinthians 15:17; Hebrews 4:14-16; 1 Timothy 3:16; Galatians 3:20; Colossians 2:12-13; 2 Timothy 2:11; John 11:25) WE PRAY That we shall manifest the reality of the resurrection power of our Lord Jesus in every sphere of our living. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 77 – 79 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for your resurrection power. – I am justified because Jesus was raised from the dead. – I have the life of Christ through his resurrection. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 503 - FOCUS ON GOD'S BIGGER PURPOSE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 9th, June 2024FOCUS ON GOD'S BIGGER PURPOSE"But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you." Matthew 6:33 (KJV)In previous episodes, we looked into the various armor pieces as crucial items to withstand the wiles of the devil.Further into the discussion, we realized Paul introduced the matter of prayer as a battlefield transceiver.Let me put our spiritual warfare in perspective:In the present Church, many have relegated the core mandate of the Church and made the additional benefits of our relationship with God their priority.
Churches today in their bid to help society, have become need-centered rather than Christ-centered.
This has made the present-age, average believer in Christ, become focused on his or her individual needs than the purpose of Christ.God is more interested in our individual needs than we are. However, God has a bigger picture and wants us to uphold that picture than our personal needs or interests.Some people go to Church meetings today, not with the same goal as the first-century Church.
The gathering of the saints is not primarily to meet the self-centred needs of the saints. The gathering of the saints is primarily to equip the saints for the work of the ministry.
"Now these are the gifts Christ gave to the church: the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, and the pastors and teachers. Their responsibility is to equip God’s people to do his work and build up the church, the body of Christ." Ephesians 4:11-12 (NLT)
To do the work of the ministry is to reconcile many to Christ and to disciple them to become the expression of Christ.
As this is achieved, the Kingdom of God expands in the hearts of many.The goal of the adversary transcends you. The goal of the adversary is to attack your accomplishments in the Kingdom.He knows when he could get you depressed, afraid, troubled, and wearied, you will not be able to do the things God wants you to do. When you are not able to stand against his evil schemes and to enforce your victory in Christ, you will not be able to shine the glorious light of the Kingdom in the dark places.The adversary knows when he could make you live occupied with your personal needs, you will not have the focus of the Kingdom.
When the satisfaction of your personal needs becomes your goal and cravings, Christ will not be at the center of your heart.
