Let God (who is your loving Father) take care of your needs, as you set your affection and focus on His assignment for your life.This was one of the key secrets of King Solomon. He set his focus on his assignment as Israel's king. He didn't request for personal things but the wisdom to rule God's people; and God blessed him with wealth and riches."Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal." 1 Kings 3:13 (Berean Standard Bible).Pay attention to what Jesus said:“So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require?“So above all, constantly chase after the realm of God’s kingdom and the righteousness that proceeds from him. Then all these less important things will be given to you abundantly." Matthew 6:31-33 (TPT)
We are at war with the forces of darkness to enforce our victory in Christ and to fulfill God's kingdom plan.
Have a bigger perspective of this spiritual warfare.You are not wrestling against the evil strategies of the accuser (including all his highest evil principalities and authorities operating in rebellion under the heavenly realms) because of your personal needs.
You are wrestling against powerful class of demon-gods and evil spirits that hold this dark world in bondage, because of the mandate of the Kingdom.
The expansion of God's Kingdom in the hearts of men and the dark places of the earth should be your focus.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Matthew 6:19-33; 1 Kings 3:7-14; Matthew 19:27-29; 2 Corinthians 10:3-5) WE PRAY We pray that the expansion of the Kingdom of God will be the burning desire and imbued focus of every believer at all times and in all they do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 80 - 82 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I set my focus on God’s will and set my mind on things above.– I esteem the will and purpose of God– I don’t serve my interests. I serve all of God’s purposes for me in my generation– I don’t give my mind to the things of this world.– I have no other master apart from God.– God’s testimony of me is that I am a man after his heart and will serve all His will. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 504 - PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 3 — SUPPLICATION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday 10th, June 2024PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 3 — SUPPLICATION 1"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)The previous episode, "Focus on God's Bigger Picture", gives us an in-depth understanding of God's intention for all His provision.It will help expand your understanding of this spiritual warfare beyond your personal gain. And to shape your motives for taking up the armor pieces of God.
In as much as God is interested in our well-being, He wants us to focus on His Kingdom's vision and mission.
To spread the light of the Kingdom and enforce our victory in Christ, we must know that we cannot effectively wield the sword of the Spirit and engage all the armor pieces without prayer.Prayer is crucial in this spiritual warfare. And to enforce our victory, we are not only charged to take up the whole armor of God, but we are also charged to PRAY ALL PRAYERS IN THE SPIRIT.We have briefly examined the various kinds of prayer; prayer of thanksgiving and adoration, prayer of faith or confession.Even though the expression, "...all prayer..." gives an idea of different kinds of prayer, Paul the apostle sets SUPPLICATION as the linchpin in this verse. Thus, in verse 18, he mentions supplication twice.
Supplication simply means prayer of request or petition.
It is to humbly and earnestly make a specific request from the Lord."With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people." Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified Bible)
Praying the prayer of request or supplication at all times is consistent with the knowledge of Christ.
And the beautiful thing about prayer is that God, who is our heavenly Father is a prayer-answering God.It doesn't matter the details of your request, you must have faith in your heart that, when you pray He hears you and has abundant provisions for you.You pray about everything and for everything you need, focusing on Christ's purpose in your heart.
No matter the need you have, it must not be the ultimate focus of your heart.
However, with confidence in who your heavenly Father is, and the humility of heart, make your request.When you seem to be feeling anxious about anything, pray!Are there some specific burdens or worries on your heart, about any issue at all?Here is your answer:"Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell God what you need, and thank Him for all He has done." Philippians 4:6 (NLT)And this will be the outcome:"Then you will experience God’s peace, which exceeds anything we can understand. His peace will guard your hearts and minds as you live in Christ Jesus." Philippians 4:7 (NLT)Beloved, what are you waiting for?Get up or get on your knees or get into a humble heartfelt prayer posture and make supplication, now.
Pray about that situation and enjoy divine answers.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=1sDIG DEEPER(Mark 11:24; 1 Kings 3:7-14; Proverbs 3:6; 1 Kings 8:28; Daniel 6:10; Hebrews 4:16) WE PRAY We pray making supplication and asking that the Lord will supply us with all that we need to fulfill His purpose.NB: Pray address specific areas where you seem to experience lack. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 83 - 88 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I pray always with all prayer. – I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 505 - PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 4 — SUPPLICATION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 11th, June 2024 PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 4 — SUPPLICATION 2"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)As we have seen already, supplication simply means prayer of request or petition.It is to humbly and earnestly make a specific request concerning something you want or need.
Asking the Lord for your needs or wants doesn't mean those needs are the center of your life.
 When the Lord becomes the focus of your life, your requests or needs are influenced by His will.This is important because God is not a "genie", who does as you wish. He is your Father, who has a perfect plan for your life."For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the LORD, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future." Jeremiah 29:11 (NIV)Therefore, you have to make requests according to His will or purpose and plans.
Any request made according to the will of God is not of the flesh. Any request made according to the will of God glorifies Him.
Never make requests according to jealousy, envy or desire to live above others.Whatever you do must be unto the Lord's glory."And if you ask, you won’t receive it for you’re asking with corrupt motives, seeking only to fulfill your own selfish desires." James 4:3 (TPT)Beloved, make supplication to the Lord about everything you need."You jealously want what others have so you begin to see yourself as better than others. You scheme with envy and harm others to selfishly obtain what you crave—that’s why you quarrel and fight. And all the time you don’t obtain what you want because you won’t ask God for it!" James 4:2 (TPT)You can make specific requests about your finances, academics, family, health, career or business without esteeming those needs above the Lord. When you esteem the Lord above all things, you will acknowledge the things you need as means to the end and not the end itself.
Instead of being anxious, take your needs to God in prayer.
It doesn't matter what it is, talk to God about it and His peace shall garrison your heart.Take what God has said in His word and use it as a basis to make your request to Him."Now this is the confidence that we have in Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us." 1 John 5:14 (NKJV)Don't surrender to anxiety and fear; instead, practice the prayer of supplication.Release all your burdens, care, and worries from your heart and mind. Cast them unto the Lord.
Do you find yourself troubled or afflicted, pray!
"Are there any believers in your fellowship suffering great hardship and distress? Encourage them to pray!..." James 5:13 (TPT)This is a warfare strategy. It doesn't matter which challenge confronts you, call for help through the battlefield transceiver.Yes, you have all the armor pieces to withstand the enemy. And even more, the Lord has also given you the opportunity to make supplication."Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.” (Jeremiah 33:3).Wow!Do you see it?
There is no way the Lord wouldn't answer when you call.
God doesn't miss your calls and doesn't have network issues. Just call and He will answer. Stay in touch with the Lord at all times through prayer. Make supplication, and communicate your burdens to the Lord.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Mark 11:24; Matthew 7:7-11; Psalm 145:19; John 14:13) WE PRAY We pray forth the burdens on our hearts, declaring the great help of the Lord for each day and for the tasks He has given us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 89 - 93 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don't surrender to anxiety and fear. – I pray in all things and about everything. – I refuse to worry about anything. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 506 - PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 5 — SUPPLICATION 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 12th, June 2024 PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 5 — SUPPLICATION 3"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)The need for prayer in our spiritual warfare cannot be overemphasized.How do you enforce your victory in Christ without staying in touch with your command source?
And as you pray, you must deploy the various kinds of prayer, to achieve the needed results.
The Lord has given us various kinds of prayer, to serve as strategic codes for unique results. We pray all prayer in the Spirit. The Spirit of God is the evidence of the Lord's presence.As a new creation in Christ, we are of the Spirit, in the Spirit and with the Spirit. Thus, whatever we do must be done in Spirit.
Prayer of supplication is not exempted. It must be done with humility of heart and in the Spirit of Christ.
Prayer of supplication must be done with humility of heart because it is a specific formal request made to a higher power and authority.And must be done in Spirit because that is our domain of operation.To make supplication you must know exactly what you want and be intentional about what you say in accordance with God's word.
Your request must be consistent with the wisdom and counsel of God. That is how you find yourself praying according to His will.
Just because it's a prayer of request doesn't mean you ask anything without confirming how to make that request.There are people who make supplication, wrongly. Though we ought to pray, we must pray right when we want to have the right results."You ask and do not receive, because you ask amiss..." James 4:3 (NKJV)
People sometimes get tired of praying because they often don't get the answers.
There are a few factors that make it seem some prayers are unanswered. (We will later have a detailed discussion on, why it seems prayers are not answered, since God is a prayer answering God.)When you want to make supplication, it is important to keep in mind the good news of the gospel.Consider:* how does the cross (as in the death of Jesus) affect your situation?* the difference that the resurrection of Jesus has made and its impact on your challenge.* whether the Lord has already given you what you are going to ask in your prayer of supplication.There are people who spend days and months making requests for things the Lord has already achieved for or given to them.Beloved in Christ, why must you go on a mountain to fast and pray to receive eternal salvation, while you are eternally saved?Why spend hours praying that the Lord should make you righteous? Have you not read 2 Corinthians 5:21?Imagine a born again praying to become a son of God; while, the scriptures are clear, "Now are we the sons of God..." (1 John 3:2).
When you have the right revelation of the word, your prayers will mostly be full of thanksgiving and praise.
Even your prayer of supplication will be saturated with thanksgiving.No matter what you are facing, find out what God has done and said despite that situation.You don't have to be sentimental and pressured by the situation. Always take a stand in the word of God as you pray.
You must search the scriptures to know exactly what God has said, done or will do about that condition.
God has made provisions of answers to all your conditions; even if it concerns your finances, health, purpose, direction, marriage, childbirth, ministry, salvation of souls, national issues, persecution, etc.As part of the adversary's strategies, he casts shadows of doubt and deception in your mind as you pray.
You must make a strong petition with the revelation of Jesus.
“Present your case,” says the LORD. “Bring forth your strong reasons,” says the King of Jacob" Isaiah 42:21 (NKJV)This is why you must know and fully understand the testimony of Jesus.What Christ accomplished for you through His death and resurrection is your ultimate ticket to your answered prayers.
Don't just make requests. Your requests or supplications and petitions must be consistent with the outcome of the death, resurrection and ascension of Jesus.
Don't pray for what the Lord has already accomplished for you.Whatever you want the Lord to do for you, pray in the light of the revelation of Jesus and you will cause tremendous changes in your world.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(John 16:23-24; Mark 11:24; Matthew 7:7-11; John 14:13) WE PRAY We pray thanking the Lord, for the privilege of prayer and the abundance of answers He supplies. We pray that we will grow in the light of the revelation of Jesus and the wisdom of His word will guide our hearts and rule our minds even as we make daily supplication. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 94 - 100 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I pray with the humility of heart and in the Spirit of Christ. – I pray with thanksgiving in the revelation of Jesus.– When I pray I receive answers because I pray according to His will. – I don’t surrender to anxiety and fear. – I pray in all things and about everything. – I refuse to worry about anything. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 507 - PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 6 — SUPPLICATION 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 13th, June 2024 PRAYING...ALL PRAYERS 6 — SUPPLICATION 4"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)To make supplication is to pray according to the will of God. God answers our prayers and He is the good Father who gives good things to His children. However, you neither make supplication to God nor make demands while you are full of self-will
Though prayer of supplication is basically to make a request, it must be done with humility of heart and surrendering of your will to God's ultimate will.
Let's look at the example of Daniel:In Daniel chapter 9, we see the prophet making supplication for the people of Israel.However, what you must understand is that Daniel had always desired that Israel would return from exile to Jerusalem.Yet, he did not make supplication just according to his desire. He submitted his will or desire to the will and plan of God. He had to make supplication with humility of heart. "Now therefore, our God, hear the prayer of Your servant, and his supplications, and for the Lord’s sake cause Your face to shine on Your sanctuary, which is desolate. O my God, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by Your name; for we do not present our supplications before You because of our righteous deeds, but because of Your great mercies." Daniel 9:17-18 (NKJV)Daniel in his supplication, did not stand in his own righteous deeds; instead, he surrendered and submitted to God's mercies. Just as I explained in the previous episode, you don't make supplication according to your will. You make supplication according to the word of the Lord.That was exactly what Daniel did. Daniel the Prophet, set his face upon the Lord according to the understanding of the word of the Lord."in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years specified by the word of the Lord through Jeremiah the prophet, that He would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.Then I set my face toward the Lord God to make request by prayer and supplications, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes." Daniel 9:2-3 (NKJV)Daniel understood the times he was in and knew what to do by understanding the Prophetic letters or books written by the Prophet Jeremiah and also by reading the Chronicles (2 Chronicles 36:17-21).Jeremiah wrote that the people of God will be going to serve Nebuchadnezzar, the King of Babylon for 70 years. (Jeremiah 25:1-11). Again, while the people of God were in captivity, the Prophet Jeremiah sent a Prophetic word (a letter) from Jerusalem to them in Babylon.This Prophetic letter was to comfort the Jews in captivity and to make them know what God had in mind for them, how they were to conduct themselves in Babylon (Jeremiah 25:5-9) and how they had to respond to God's plan.This was how Daniel knew what to do when he noticed the  word of the Lord concerning the seventy (70) years in captivity:"For thus says the Lord: After seventy years are completed at Babylon, I will visit you and perform My good word toward you, and cause you to return to this place. For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope. Then you will call upon Me and go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you." Jeremiah 29:10-12 (NKJV)There you have it!Daniel the Prophet clearly made supplication to God according to the instruction of the word and the revelation or understanding of the thoughts of God concerning the Jews (as he had read in the Prophetic books or letters).He prayed according to what God said through the Prophet and not just according to their condition in Babylon.
It is important to know the word of God as a man of prayer. You don't have to only be given to prayer without understanding what God has said in His word.
There is a word of the Lord concerning your situation, get hold of it and wage war with it through prayer or supplication.Know the word, understand what God has said, and humbly go into prayer surrendering to the glorious will of God concerning that situation.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=228sDIG DEEPER(Acts 16:25; Habakkuk 3; 2 Kings 19:14-19; John 16:23-24; Mark 11:24; John 14:13) WE PRAY We thank the Lord, for the prophetic word He has given us this year. We pray that according to his lovingkindness, He will stretch forth His faithful hands towards us, that by His will, we shall be enabled and also enjoy the fulfillment of His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 101 - 104 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I pray with the humility of heart and in the Spirit of Christ.– I pray with thanksgiving in the revelation of Jesus.– When I pray I receive answers because I pray according to His will.– I don’t surrender to anxiety and fear. – I pray in all things and about everything. – I refuse to worry about anything. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 508 - WATCHING IN PERSEVERANCE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 14th, June 2024WATCHING IN PERSEVERANCE 1"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)While looking at praying all prayer and supplication, Paul pauses momentarily to address the attitude every believer should have as we pray.Remember, Paul was still talking about the items needed to withstand the schemes of the rulers of darkness.
To enforce your victory in Christ, you must not seek for a holiday. Though we entered our rest in Christ, we fight the fight of faith in rest.
There is a designated time for a holiday. We confront the forces of darkness while we are at rest.The adversary though defeated and rendered powerless, is still deploying and projecting his deceptive scheme. Believers must have the attitude that puts them ahead of the strategies of the evil one.
We must be WATCHFUL and exercise PERSEVERANCE.
You cannot enforce your victory when you go into slumber. You must remain alert with your eyes open. Don't be ignorant of the schemes of the enemy.To be watchful enables you to persevere. The more you are alert to see the plots of the enemy the more you remain firm and constant in prayer.Most believers go on vacation because they are ignorant of the schemes of the devil.He is a defeated enemy who never accepts defeat (though he knows he cannot win). You must be watchful to put him in his place.
It takes perseverance to do anything or accomplish any great feat in life.
Jesus instructed His disciples to "watch and pray..."You are a good soldier on the battlefield, therefore, stay alert in prayer.You don't also have to get tired to pray. You may have many genuine reasons to be lackadaisical or reasons not to pray, but you must persevere.This is war! And you cannot stay out of touch with the Lord. You must earnestly stay in prayer.
To be sincere, prayer isn't always easy. But the secret is that, the more you stay consistent in prayer, the easier it gets.
When you stay out of prayer for a while, it will always be a struggle to get into the habit of prayer. You must be determined to be prayerful. You have to make a choice that you shall press on in prayer. You don't become effective in prayer by only reading on prayer. You can be reading this episode of with , and still not be praying. You may know the benefits of prayer and still not be praying.
The only way to be prayerful is to continue in prayer daily.
And also don't make prayer the last option of what to do to get results. Prayer must always be your first strategy.You also don't have to rush through prayer. To get the best of prayer, stay long in prayer and be consistent with it daily.PERSEVERE IN PRAYER!Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=228sDIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:17; Acts 1:4; Colossians 4:2,12; Mark 13:33; Luke 18:1; Colossians 1:9; Colossians 2:7) WE PRAY We pray that we shall not lack the ability and discipline to stay resolute, watchful and devoted in prayer. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 105 - 108 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the grace to persevere in prayer in the midst of opposition.- I refuse to stagger, I pray. - I endure to the end, I pray. - I don’t fret nor faint, I pray. - Through perseverance in prayer, I maintain an undisturbed composure.Thank you Lord Jesus!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 509 - DISPENSE HIS RICH LOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  DISPENSE HIS RICH LOVE“For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome” 1 John 5:3 (NKJV).
Understanding God’s love is so essential for your manifestation.
 Beloved, do you love the Lord?The answer is here: “If ye love me, keep my commandments… He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.” John 14:15;24 (KJV). To keep God’s commandment is to walk in obedience to His Word. It is to fulfill an authoritative prescription. This means the Lord’s commandments are not burdensome. As we have seen in the opening verse (1 John 5:3). The word “burdensome” is the Greek word, "barus" which means, burdensome grave, or grievous, heavy weightier.
God’s commandment does not lead to a burdensome grave. God’s commandment as revealed in Christ, is Life.
 It is an authorized prescription of liberty. Remember Jesus is the Truth and the Life. (John 14:6; John 1:14; John 1:4). The Lord’s commandments are not lists of rules and regulations you must follow. He is not speaking of the Law given to Israel through Moses. The Lord’s commandments are the revelation of Himself. He is the complete revelation of God.He is the truth of God that brings freedom (John 8:32) For Jesus to say, “If” you love me, doesn’t necessarily mean, it's possible a born-again, may lack His love. When you become born again, the Love of God is dispensed into you, through, the Holy Spirit. (Romans 5:5). Thus, you already have the capacity to Love the Lord. This means that keeping Jesus’ commandments is a product of your love for Him.
Doing what Jesus says, or obeying His Word, is an outflow of the love of God at work in you.
 This love is deeply rich and cannot be exhausted nor be quenched by any level of selfish desire. It is beyond any strong affection and set on doing what Jesus wants. That means love is an empowering ability within you to respond right to the Words of Jesus and act on them.
The more you act on the Word of the Lord, the more you demonstrate His rich love, which is at work in you.
 You train yourself to demonstrate His Love and to bear the fruits of His love in you. Shalomhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=236sDIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:5;10:12; Mark 12:30; John 8:29;55) WE PRAY1. That your love will grow and increase beyond measure, bringing you into the rich revelation of spiritual insight in all things. And that you will be enabled to choose the most excellent way of all —becoming pure and without offense until the unveiling of Christ.  2. And you will be filled completely with the fruits of righteousness that are found in Jesus, the Anointed One—bringing great praise and glory to God! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 109 - 111 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am empowered by the Love of Christ to act on His Word.  - I dispense the rich love of God. - I grow in the love of God .  I function in the knowledge of God’s Word. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 510 - JESUS OUR PATTERN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  JESUS OUR PATTERN "A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another. By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34-35 About 13 times in the New Testament, we see the phrase “love one another”. And that reveals the importance of this commandment. How we love one another makes others know we are disciples of Jesus. (John 13:35) The newness of this commandment of Jesus is Himself. Jesus didn’t just give us His command to love one another. He made Himself the pattern and supply of that commandment.
We are not to love one another by how we love ourselves. We love one another according to the portrait of Jesus.
 “This is my commandment: that you love one another as I have loved you” John 15:12 (ISV) What is the extent of Jesus’s love for us? How has he loved us? Love is not just an utterance, love is a walk. “Dear children, let’s not merely say that we love each other; let us show the truth by our actions.” 1 John 3:18 (NLT)  Love is a life lived or an action. Love is not suppositious or conjectured. Love is demonstrated and experienced.
Understand that love is more than a feeling. To love is to serve.
 Today let us begin to look at some practical ways Jesus demonstrated His love of service for us: Before Jesus gave the new commandment in John 13:34, look at what happened in the earlier verses: “Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end… Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded…So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet. For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him. If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.”(John 13:1,3-5;12-17) From these verses, we realize, there is no room to guess what Jesus meant by “as I have loved you” in John 13:34. He has shown us a clear example of what we should do in verse 15;   For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you. What did Jesus really do? He served His disciples by washing their feet. Feet washing is an art of hospitality among the Israelites. Most oriental people, including the Israelites, wore sandals instead of shoes in the past, and as they usually went barefoot in the house, frequent washing of the feet was a necessity. Hence among the Israelites, it was the first duty of the host to give his guest water to wash his feet. To omit this was a mark of unfriendliness. This was done either by the wife or the servants. Mostly, it's done before meals. (See Genesis 18:4; Genesis 19:2, Genesis 24:32; Genesis 43:24). This is a symbol of honour, service and humility for one another.
We love one another by serving one another with that which God has given us. And that was what Jesus showed His disciples.
 “Just as each one of you has received a special gift [a spiritual talent, an ability graciously given by God], employ it in serving one another as [is appropriate for] good stewards of God’s multi-faceted grace [faithfully using the diverse, varied gifts and abilities granted to Christians by God’s unmerited favor]” 1 Peter 4:10 (Amplified Bible). Beloved, are you in pursuit of your own interest?Or are you in pursuit of serving the brethren?   As Christ has loved you, serve one another. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=236sDIG DEEPER(1 John 4:20; 1 Peter 4:10-11; Romans 12:10; Philippians 2:1-11) WE PRAY That we enjoy the abundance of grace to relentlessly love the saints by serving them in humility and honour. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 111 - 113 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I serve the saints in love.  - I am an example of the love of Christ to others.  - I love with ease because Christ is the supply of my love.  - I refuse to be selfish.  - I am committed to serving others in humility. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 511 - DEEP INTIMACY OF LOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  DEEP INTIMACY OF LOVE “Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.” John 14:23 Understand that, your love for Jesus is an outflow of His love for you.Your love for Jesus is not unconditional. 
However, your love for Jesus is according to the condition of His love.
Delighting in Jesus is to love Him (Read Loving Jesus 2). To love Jesus is for Him to be your craving, desire, and pleasure.This is how you keep His commandments or words; by desiring the Lord. The one who craves, desires, highly esteems, treasures, values and is awe-struck by the Lord is the one who believes in the Lord. Believing in the Lord is to trust or entrust and commit yourself unto Him. It is to accept and receive Him as who He says He is. Jesus used the word “believe” about 85 times in the Gospel of John. And about 5 times in only John chapter 14. John 14:12, He said, “Verily, Verily, I say to you, he who believes in Me…”The expression verily denotes “Most Assuredly” or a strong certainty.Your believe in the Lord Jesus is an important response of your love to Him.Contextually, believing in the Lord is also essential in keeping His commandments or words. This makes you have a special relationship with the Lord.Yes, “for God so loved the world…” however, it is only those who BELIEVE IN HIM, “SHOULD HAVE EVERLASTING LIFE”. (See John 3:16).To believe in the Lord is also to RECEIVE the Lord. Those who did not receive Him were “unbelievers”. (John 1:11-12).
Though the Lord loves all men, He only has a special intimate relationship with those who have believed or received Him.
Three times in John 14, Jesus affirmed the results of keeping (treasuring, valuing, esteeming, believing, receiving, craving and desiring) His words:“If you love Me, keep My commandments. And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever“. John 14:15-16He who has My commandments and keeps them, it is he who loves Me. And he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him.” John 14:21“Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and *My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.” John 14:23 Now there are three key expressions in these points: – He will give you another Helper, who may abide with you forever. – Will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and manifest Myself to him. – My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him. Now these three key expressions are not separated in reality; they all point to the same matter – DEEP INTIMACY OF LOVE. See this, to receive the Helper who will abide with you forever is to receive the person of the Holy Spirit.
To be loved by the Father and the Lord even more, whereas they manifest themselves to you, is the work of the Holy Spirit.
And they bring in you to make their home in you, is the inward family relationship with the Holy Spirit. Each of these three expressions, which are the Lord’s promise to keep or delight in His word, points us to a DEEP INTIMACY WITH GOD through the Holy Spirit. For God to manifest Himself, is to demystify Himself or to strip Himself naked before us. One strip his heart, deep thoughts, emotions and even body naked only in a deep intimate relationship with the other.
The Holy Spirit indwells in the one who has received the Lord.
Now through your new birth experience, you received the Holy Spirit, however, the more you delight yourself in the Lord, the deeper you become intimate with Him. The more you set your affection on the Lord, the more He manifests Himself to you.
Beloved, grow in the intimacy of the Love of Christ.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4814hk6ceqwDIG DEEPER(John 16:7-15; Romans 8:15-16; John 7:37-39) WE PRAY- Thanking the Lord for indwelling us through the Holy Spirit. - We shall behold the manifestation of the Lord in a deeper way as we will grow more intimately in our relationship with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 114 - 116 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord is my greatest delight.  - My heart is set on Him day by day.  - The Holy Spirit is present in my heart in the fullness of His love.  - My relationship with the Lord through the Holy Spirit is getting deeper by the day. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 512 - ANOTHER HELPER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  ANOTHER HELPER“If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever; that is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him, but you know Him because He abides with you and will be in you.”John 14:15-17 (NASB1995) Beloved, God’s heartbeat wasn’t just for Jesus to die for your sins; His heartbeat is to be mingled with you. God intentionally made man, so that He will have His Family, which vibrates His frequency of love.  He desires to indwell you and to become one with you.God, through the Holy Spirit, indwells anyone who desires and delights in Him.
This is not to suggest that, the Holy Spirit is received according to our works.
 This only means that those who believe in the Lord, are those who love the Lord, delight in His words and receive the Holy Spirit. As you can see in the opening scripture. “If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever;” John 14:15-16. There is no need to be wondering who the “Another Helper” is. Just in the next verse, the Lord provides the answer:“that is the Spirit of truth…” (John 14:17) This is clearly the Holy Spirit and not any other person. However, the promise of the Holy Spirit is not to be fulfilled in all men automatically. The promise of the Holy Spirit is to be fulfilled in those who believe and receive the Lord Jesus. “Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come into him and dine with him, and he with Me” Revelation 3:20. (NKJV) Have you received the Lord, as He knocked at the door of your heart? There is the invitation of the Lord to have a deeper relationship of love with you. The day you received the Lord, the Holy Spirit came to indwell you. When you received the Holy Spirit, God came to make His home in you.What was God’s goal for indwelling you?
INTIMACY!
 The Holy Spirit in you is the seal of God’s Intimacy with you. Your ability to commune or have intimacy with God in a deeper way is by the Holy Spirit. He supplies you with the love of God (Romans 5:5), empowers you with the truth of God’s Word, the life of God and leads you in your walk with God. “In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and believed in him, were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit” Ephesians 1:13 (ESV) The Holy Spirit is your HELPER, commune with Him today.Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVZ7ah7OTEw&t=25sDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 1:21-22; John 6:67; Isaiah 42:1;61:1; 2 Corinthians 5:5) WE PRAYThat we grow in the understanding of God’s Spirit to enjoy His communion. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 117 - 119 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the seal of the Lord upon me.  - I am set apart by the Lord to have intimate relationship with Him.  - The Holy Spirit is strongly at work in Him.  - I have the ability to fellowship with God. I am not ordinary.  - God lives in me through the Holy Spirit.  Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 513 - WATCHING IN PERSEVERANCE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 19th, June 2024 WATCHING IN PERSEVERANCE 2"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)Are you persevering in prayer?Or do you already seem to be tired of prayer?Apart from the reality that we pray for God's answers, the benefits of prayer are not limited to God answering our requests.
One of the most transcending benefits of prayer is that it changes you.
The more you persevere in prayer, the more you develop and intensify your connection with God. The more your connection with God strengthens, the more you are changed and transformed."About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James up on a mountain to pray. And as he was praying, the appearance of his face was transformed, and his clothes became dazzling white. Suddenly, two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared and began talking with Jesus. They were glorious to see. And they were speaking about his exodus from this world, which was about to be fulfilled in Jerusalem." Luke 9:28-31 (NLT) Precious one, PRAYER CHANGES YOU!
The glory of God in you is revealed as you spend time in prayer.
Your consistent prayer life is a threat to the devil. The devil is more scared of what prayer will do to you than the answers you will receive.Sometimes you get discouraged when it seems the answers are delayed. But that discouragement is an arrow of the adversary.
When you feel discouraged to pray, that is when you must persevere more in prayer!
To persevere in prayer is to endure patiently in prayer. You don't have to rush out of the place of prayer; neither do you have to become impatient through the process of prayer. As you endure patiently in prayer and the transforming process of prayer, you increase in spiritual capacity.
The best answer to prayer is the impartation you receive from the place of prayer. The longer you stay in prayer, the stronger the impartation of the Holy Spirit.
Perseverance enables you to build character."And endurance develops strength of character, and character strengthens our confident hope of salvation." Romans 5:4 (NLT)The only way to be prayerful is to continue in prayer daily.PERSEVERE IN PRAYER!SelahDIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:17; Acts 1:4; Colossians 4:2,12; Mark 13:33; Luke 18:1; Colossians 1:9; Colossians 2:7) WE PRAY We pray that we shall be strengthened by the Holy Spirit to remain steadfast in prayer. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 120 - 124 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am steadfast in prayer.- I daily give my mind and my heart to prayer.- I maintain focus in prayer.- As I pray, I transformed from glory to glory.- I develop attention through prayer.- I am addicted to prayer. Thank you, Sweet Holy Ghost![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 514 - SUPPLICATION AND INTERCESSION FOR ALL SAINTS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 20th, June 2024 SUPPLICATION AND INTERCESSION FOR ALL SAINTS"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)No believer or saint in Christ is an Island. Every individual is part of the community of the saints.As part of the discussion on the Lord's armor pieces, we looked at the Roman shield formation known as the Testudo shield formation. The emphasis of the Roman army battle strategy is not on individual strength but on the effectiveness of the formation of the whole army.Though individual skill and strength were important, they won battles by their battle formations. The Testudo shield formation was one of their exceptional strategies to withstand the attacks of the enemy and advance towards the enemy's gates. Paul instructed that as soldiers in Christ, we must take up the shield of faith. And when each believer takes up their shield, they fight individually and corporately. We are strong as saints when we stand together in this fight of faith. We defend, support and strengthen one another to enforce our victory in Christ and prevail over every situation.The Lord knows the believer is not called to stand alone, thus, He incorporates everyone who becomes born again into Himself."For by [means of the personal agency of] one [Holy] Spirit we were all, whether Jews or Greeks, slaves or free, baptized [and by baptism united together] into one body, and all made to drink of one [Holy] Spirit." 1 Corinthians 12:13 (AMPC)In Christ Jesus, there is no individualism. Your well-being is not enough when the well-being of other saints is compromised.This is why you don't only pray for yourself but you must also become an intercessor.
You must be intentional about making prayers and supplication for other saints.
All believers or saints in Christ Jesus are of one body. When the hand is in pain, the whole body is in pain. You can't have pain in your leg, and have the lungs rejoice. The discomfort of one body part is the discomfort of the whole body.This is why you must pray for one another. You must pray for the saints.To make supplication simply means, to humbly make a request or petition.
To make supplication for the saints is to humbly and earnestly make a request for the saints.
Praying for the saints must be done with all perseverance. Don't quietly watch your fellow saints go through pain and challenges. Instead of sitting back to complain about the failures of others, you can make supplication for them.Read Ephesians 6:18 in the Amplified:"With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people.” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified Bible)
This is one of the signs of spiritual maturity: Praying for God's people!
Selflessness is a sign of maturity. The "babe" in Christ doesn't pray for others. He or she is only concerned about himself (or herself).The more you pray for others, the less you get troubled or anxious about your challenges. Praying for others also means looking away from your situation and entrusting it to the hands of Jesus.When you spend time to make supplication for others, all you are saying is, "Lord, please take care of my situation, as I stand in the gap for others".
Let God handle your business as you make supplication for others.
Think about fellow saints in your community or city. Pray for their growth, their effectiveness in serving the Lord, and their strength and focus in the gospel of Jesus.Set a time aside today and pray for the brethren.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Acts 12:5-14; 2 Thessalonians 3:1; 1 Timothy 2:1; 2 Corinthians 9:14) WE PRAY We pray for all saints that amidst all the distractions and pressures of this postmodern society, they shall not grow weary in faith, love and in doing the Lord's work. We pray that all the saints shall grow in the consciousness of our oneness in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Psalm 119NB: Patiently read Psalm 119 again today. DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to live isolated and selfish.- I seek for the well-being of all the saints.- I grow in love for the saints.- I make supplication for the saints as my habit.- I see every believer as a brother and I make supplication for them. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 515 - SUPPLICATION AND INTERCESSION FOR ALL SAINTS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 21st, June 2024 SUPPLICATION AND INTERCESSION FOR ALL SAINTS 2"Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints" Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)To make supplication for all the saints is an essential contribution to the growth of the whole body of Christ.Prayer in itself makes tremendous power available to cause changes.Thus, through your prayer of supplication for the saints, the Holy Spirit supplies divine energies for change.
God will always step into situations when men submit that situation to Him in prayer.
There was a point when Herod arrested and executed James the brother of John with a sword. When he noticed it pleased the people, he proceeded to arrest Peter. When Peter was imprisoned, the Church decided to change the situation.This time, the saints didn't sit to look on, assuming that God would automatically step into the situation. They made a decision to pray."Thus Peter was kept in the prison, but prayer was fervently being made to God by the church for him." Acts 12:5 (Lexham English Bible).The Church continued earnestly in prayer until Peter returned to them.Through the prayers of the saints, an angel was deployed to bring deliverance to Peter.Sometimes some saints may have a challenge and become helpless not knowing what to do. As you consistently and earnestly pray for the saints, you deliver them from helpless situations.
The adversary is looking for every opportunity to ensnare and destroy the people of God, therefore, we must make supplications for one another.
Jesus said to Peter:"Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has demanded to sift you like wheat, but I have prayed for you, that your faith may not fail. And you, when once you have turned back, strengthen your brothers" Luke 22:31-32 (Lexham English Bible).Satan has not refrained from finding an opportunity to sift the brethren like wheat.Don't join the world to criticize and condemn the Church and weak saints.Pray for your Pastor or Church leader and all the other saints that their faith will not faint.
Please get into prayer now.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Acts 12:5-14; 2 Thessalonians 3:1; 1 Timothy 2:1; 2 Corinthians 9:14) WE PRAY We pray for all saints that they will not faint in their faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 125 - 131 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I seek for the well-being of all the saints. - I grow in love for the saints.- I make supplications for the saints my habit.- I see every believer as a brother and I make supplication for them.- None of the saints shall fail nor faint in their faith.- We are a people of prayer. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 516 - MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR YOUR LEADER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 22nd, June 2024 MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR YOUR LEADER"and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel" Ephesians 6:19 (NKJV)To exercise and enforce your victory in Christ depends on these four key areas:1. The whole armor of God.2. Your sense of responsibility.3. The company of saints.4. And a strong Kingdom leader.These four areas are not written in any order. They are crucial items for your spiritual warfare against all the forces of darkness.
The whole armor of God are the provisions of God to you. They encapsulate all the things God achieved for you through Christ Jesus.
These whole armor were given to you by God to help you withstand the schemes of the adversary. However, the armor of God given to you will not produce the intended results until you personally take responsibility to use them.Paul the apostle in outlining the usage of the various armor pieces, included the responsibility of the believer. He didn't suggest in any way that the armor pieces would automatically work.
You must have a sense of responsibility. For the armor pieces to work, you should learn to be responsible.
And Paul was clear on that. He didn't mention any armor piece without addressing your role in its usage.Though we have already looked at these verses, take another look at the role of the believer in relation to the armor pieces in Ephesians chapter 6:1. Put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil (verse 11).2. Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. (verse 13).3. Stand therefore, having girded your... having put on... having shod your (verses 14-15).4. above all, taking the shield of faith with which you will be able to ... And take the helmet  ... (verses 16-17).5. praying always (verse 18).The whole armor of God is supplied by God, however, the functions of each armor piece is your responsibility.And then in the usage of this armor, you don't stand alone as a good soldier, but with the other saints. When you stand with the other saints, you are an army. No matter how good you are, you cannot accomplish great things for God in your generation alone. All the saints must stand together to fulfill their purpose and to enforce the victory of Christ in your generation.In every army, there are commanders and captains. And Christ is the Chief Commander and Captain of His army.  Nonetheless, the Lord has set men over the various groupings of His army. These men have the assignment to equip, nurture and build up the saints to function effectively.Just as no believer can exercise or enforce victory without the armor pieces, a believer may not be effective in the Kingdom by being isolated from the saints and without a Kingdom leader.
God has set leaders in the church to tend his flock. These leaders or shepherds (Pastors) and teachers are responsible for the growth of each saint.
These bring the saints to the place of knowledge and understanding.How do you think the Church would know the function of the armor pieces without the teaching of Paul?How were the brethren going to be equipped without the labour of Paul the apostle?Pastors and Teachers determine the growth of the saints in Christ. Therefore, the adversary makes them a target. When men who opposed the gospel wanted to stop the spread of the gospel, they persecuted the leaders of the church.When leaders faint in their faith, many other brethren will faint in their faith. The Church leaders are ambassadors who determine how effectively every Church within a locality will operate.
The mindset of the spiritual leaders will affect the mindset of the people.
This was why Paul in almost all his epistles requested that prayers will be made for him.Paul didn't only instruct that prayers will be made for all the saints, he also requested that prayers will be made for him also. He was specific and precise. Though he is also one of the saints or the brethren, he had to be sure that they would focus on prayer for him.His request unveiled the objective of this spiritual warfare.
This spiritual warfare against the forces of darkness is mainly to ensure that the gospel of Jesus shall prevail in all places.
Who are those leading the spread of the gospel if not your Pastors or Shepherds and Teachers?"And [pray] also for me, that [freedom of] utterance may be given me, that I may open my mouth to proclaim boldly the mystery of the good news (the Gospel), For which I am an ambassador in a coupling chain [in prison. Pray] that I may declare it boldly and courageously, as I ought to do." Ephesians 6:19-20 (AMPC)If the knowledge of the glory of God shall cover the earth as the waters cover the sea, our leaders must be bold about the gospel of Jesus.
If all the saints will also be inspired to be bold about Jesus, then the leaders must be examples of great boldness of speech.
You have to pray for your leader to be bold in articulating the good news of Jesus.Selah! DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:3; Romans 15:30; 2 Corinthians 1:11; Philippians 1:19) WE PRAY Pray for your leader, Pastor or shepherd and Teacher of the gospel, that he or she will be given the message to speak and that he or she may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news of Jesus, at all times and in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 132 - 138 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel - The Lord is making them increase in boldness. - They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord. - They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power. - They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil. - The faith of the Leaders shall grow cold. They will increase in the Lord's zeal and in great faith. In the name of Jesus!Thank you Lord![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 517 - DON'T SIT ON THE FENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  DON'T SIT ON THE FENCE“For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea.” Habakkuk 2:14 (NKJV) This Prophetic word of the Lord in the opening verse was not a suggestion nor a mere wish. It was the Lord declaring what was going to happen. The intensity of this prophecy is in the certainty of its tone; that it shall fully come to pass no matter the resistance. God’s word or what He says is prophetic! His prophetic word is living, active, and full of power; which makes it operative, energizing, and effective. This means the Lord’s prophetic word (what He says) comes to pass in its full force. The prophetic word is sharper than any two-edged and cuts deep on every side. (See Hebrews 4:12 – Amplified Bible and Message Translation). Certain prophetic words in the Old Testament portion of the Bible were not only fulfilled within a historical context or by historical events but were fully fulfilled in the Gospel or revelation of Jesus. For example: Historically, God’s prophetic word of the promised land to Abraham was Canaan (Genesis 12; 15:18-21). In Genesis 15:18-21, you will find the determined borders of the physical promised land. However, by revelation of scriptures, the true promised land is Christ and the Kingdom of God. When Abraham got to the promised land, He looked forward to an eternal city. (Hebrews 11:10,16). Again, God didn’t only promise Abraham a land. He also promised Abraham a seed (Genesis 12:7). This seed is both physical and spiritual. The Jews were the fulfilment of the promised seed through Isaac and Jacob. (John 8:33). And by the revelation of the gospel, we have the absolute fulfilment of the prophetic word; the true Seed of Abraham is Christ and all who belong to Christ are Abraham’s seed through Faith (Galatians 3:16; 29) Not just in these examples, but Christ is the goal of all prophecies. Though it may seem the prophetic word by Prophet Habakkuk was concerning the Lord’s judgement against the Chaldeans or Babylon, the fulfilment of this prophecy unveils God’s transcending and universal plan.
The plan is to fill the whole Earth with the knowledge of His glory as the waters cover the sea.
This prophecy and plan cannot fail; for the Word of the Lord does not return to Him empty until it has fulfilled its purpose (Isaiah 55:11). Through Christ Jesus, God has given forth the light of the Knowledge of His glory. (2 Corinthians 4:6). This light of the knowledge of His glory is burning within our hearts; just as our Lord made a bold utterance concerning Himself that: “As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world” John 9:5. He said this also: “The people who dwell in darkness have seen a great light…” Matthew 4:16. This is the fulfillment of the prophecy by the Prophet Isaiah: “The people who walk in darkness will see a great light. For those who live in a land of deep darkness, a light will shine.” Isaiah 9:2 (ESV). Now we are made the light of the world to show forth God’s glory (1 Peter 2:9). We have the mandate to reach out to many who are in darkness and fill or saturate them with the knowledge of the glory of God. Look at how this prophecy is repeated in Isaiah (the New Living Translation provides vivid detail): “…for as the waters fill the sea, so the earth will be filled with people who know the LORD” Isaiah 11:9 (NLT).
To cover the earth is to reach all men and fill them with the knowledge of the glory of God.
Wherever there are people we must take the glorious gospel of light there. We must take it to the offices, to the companies, the schools, the streets, families, the communities, cities, villages, towns, and the internet (including all social media platforms). You must get involved and be part of this glorious work of God. Be the reason and the medium by which the work of God will be accomplished.
Don’t sit on the fence!
Beloved, COVER THE EARTH! DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:4; 2 Peter 1:19; Numbers 14:21; Psalm 22:27; Isaiah 40:5) WE PRAY1. We pray for the opening of doors and opportunities in places where there are people who will be granted us and we will exercise the wisdom to saturate every person with the glorious gospel of Jesus. 2. We pray that we shall maintain the focus, diligence, and discipline to spread the goodnews of Jesus and train many men for the move to cover the earth with God’s glorious knowledge. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 139 - 142 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase in the knowledge of the glory of God (which is the revelation of Jesus). – I share in the prophetic vision of God to cover the earth, with His glory. – I am involved in preaching the gospel everywhere I go. – I don’t keep quiet. I don’t allow darkness and ignorance to prevail. I shine the glory of God upon every heart. – I cover the earth! I cover the earth! I cover the earth! – I refuse to procrastinate!!! – I don't sit on the fence. Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 518 - YOU MUST BE TRAINED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  YOU MUST BE TRAINED “A Psalm of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, Who trains my hands for war, And my fingers for battle” Psalm 144:1 (NKJV) As an enlisted soldier in God’s army, you have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel. As a royal priest, you are to show forth the glory of Him, who called you out of darkness into His light. (1 Peter 2:9).
This war is between light and darkness.
 This war is about the salvation of souls. It is about subduing kingdoms and taking unreached territories for the Lord and unto His glory. You must have this strong mindset that God has made you a soldier.
And as a soldier, you must submit to a certain kind of training and mindset.
 It is through the training of the Lord that you are strengthened. From the opening verse, you see David declaring how he won battles and war.“the Lord trains my hands for war, and my fingers for battles” Through training, you are taught, equipped, empowered, instructed and tried through tasks. You may be in Christ and think like a civilian, instead of a soldier. You don’t get involved in the training and the sending of the Lord. You only want to be served and pampered in Church. However, the Church of our Lord Jesus is an army.You see the Church only as a “hospital”. You just attend meetings for your needs and well-being. That is not totally wrong, but the Church is more than a “hospital”.The Church is both a family and an army. Jesus said, "…I will build my church, and all the powers of hell[b] will not conquer it" Matthew 16:18 (NLT).
When you come for Church meetings, you are equipped for the work of the ministry.
 “And he has appointed some with grace to be apostles, and some with grace to be prophets, and some with grace to be evangelists, and some with grace to be pastors, and some with grace to be teachers. And their calling is to nurture and prepare all the holy believers to do their own works of ministry, and as they do this they will enlarge and build up the body of Christ“ Ephesians 4:11-12 (TPT). This is how Jesus is building His Church.
You are trained to serve as a victorious (good) soldier.
Before Paul asked Timothy to;“…endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ…” He told him, “…the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit these to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.” 2 Timothy 2:2 (NKJV) You can see that Timothy was a soldier who submitted to training and teaching. He has the responsibility as a leading soldier to also train others. But those who will be trained must be proven faithful that they will continue in that process as well. Timothy did not just function as a good soldier, he was responsive to instructions. Instructions are designed to help you wage good warfare. "Timothy, my son, here are my instructions for you, based on the prophetic words spoken about you earlier. May they help you fight well in the Lord’s battles" 1 Timothy 1:18 ( NLT). He was instructed by Paul the apostle that;"No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier." 2 Timothy 2:3-4 (KJV). You don’t just go out there to wage war, you must be trained and equipped through God’s word daily and weekly. This is the purpose of Church meetings.Your absence from Church meetings is your absence from training.
How do you wage good warfare without training and instructions?
 As God’s weapon of war or battle axe (Jeremiah 51:20-21), you must be sharpened. See Ecclesiastes 10:10: "Using a dull ax requires great strength, so sharpen the blade. That’s the value of wisdom; it helps you succeed" (NLT) "If you don’t sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you’ll know what to do." ( CEV) This is why Jesus didn’t ask us to go forth to just win souls, He commissioned us to make disciples (students) — Matthew 28:19. The principle Jesus demonstrated to us was, win, build and send. That is how we expand God’s kingdom and army (workforce). The Lord told Jeremiah;“Stand at attention while I prepare you for your work. I’m making you as impregnable as a castle, Immovable as a steel post, solid as a concrete block wall. You’re a one-man defense system against this culture, Against Judah’s kings and princes, against the priests and local leaders.They’ll fight you, but they won’t even scratch you. I’ll back you up every inch of the way.” God’s Decree. Jeremiah 1:18-19 (MSG).
Beloved, as a soldier in the Kingdom, submit to a ministry where you will be trained to function triumphantly.
 Selah. DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 32:41;1 Corinthians 4:17; 1 Timothy 1:5; Ephesians 6:12-18; 2 Samuel 22:35; Psalm 18:2,31,34; Psalm 44:3,4; Psalm 60:12) WE PRAY Dear Lord, teach me to humbly submit to your nurturing and training, through my local Church, that I may be good soldier. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalms 143 - 146 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I humbly submit to training. – The Lord teaches my hands for war and my fingers for battle. – The Lord is my strength. – I am equipped. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 519 - MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR YOUR LEADER 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday 25th, June 2024 MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR YOUR LEADER 2"and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel" Ephesians 6:19 (NKJV)The gap between God's plan and the fulfilment of that plan is God's people.
Anything God has accomplished on Earth, He did it through His people.
God will always appoint a man among His people to become a voice, a leader and a lighthouse. This is not to create an impression that, others are better. This is by the workings of God's grace.Those leaders God appoints become conduits of His greater works.As we discussed previously, God has set leaders in the church to be responsible for the growth of each saint and to equip the saints for the spread of the gospel according to the power of the Holy Spirit.
The mindset of the spiritual leaders, will affect the mindset of the people and influence the climate of the Church within a locality.
These leaders in the Church mostly labour for the spread of the gospel. Sometimes most believers assume their leaders are strong in faith and don't need prayers.It is important you understand that, through prayers, you make the abundant supply of divine grace, strength and provisions in the spirit to your leader. There are many ways the adversary wants to destroy and distract their focus and pursuit of God's plan.
In the labour of the gospel, people risk their lives and come close to death.
To do the work of the ministry and to spread the gospel is true warfare. And the adversary seeks every opportunity to attack and destroy not only the saints, but mainly the shepherds or those who lead the saints."...Strike the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered..." (Zechariah 13:7)Epaphroditus was a leader who was assisting Paul on behalf of the saints in Philippi, at the frontline of the ministry, even as Paul was in prison.Paul in his epistles referred to Epaphroditus as "fellow soldier" (Philippians 2:25).This characterizes the nature of the work they were doing. They worked or laboured as fellow soldiers because the work of the ministry is a spiritual warfare."However, I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, [who has been] my brother and companion and fellow soldier, who was also sent as your messenger to take care of my needs. For he has been longing for all of you and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick. He certainly was sick and close to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow. So I have sent him all the more eagerly so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned about you. Welcome him home in the Lord with great joy, and appreciate and honor men like him; because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me [which distance prevented you from rendering personally]." Phillipians 2:25-3 (Amplified Bible)This is the reason Paul's prayer request in Ephesians 6:19-20, unveils the objective of spiritual warfare.
This spiritual warfare against the forces of darkness is mainly to ensure that the gospel of Jesus shall prevail in all places.
This is war.The adversary is plotting against the Church and the leaders.And for your Church leaders to firmly stand to continue in the labour of the gospel, you must make supplication for them daily.This is to your advantage.Has this with blessed you in any way?Then you must pray for me as well.
There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy.
Beloved pray and honor those who labour in the gospel of Jesus.Glory to God. DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:3; Romans 15:30; 2 Corinthians 1:11; Philippians 1:19) WE PRAY Pray for your leader, Pastor or shepherd and Teacher of the gospel, that he or she will stand strong in the faith and remain focus in labour of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Psalm 147 -150 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel.- The Lord is making them increase in boldness.- They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord.- They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power.- They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil.- The faith of the Leaders shall not grow cold. They will increase in the Lord's zeal and in great faith. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 520 - MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR YOUR LEADER 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday 26th, June 2024 MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR YOUR LEADER 3"and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel" Ephesians 6:19 (NKJV)There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy.
When the love of the Lord is in your heart, you will pray for the spread of the gospel and those who are leading such course.
The reason for the spiritual warfare is because of the gospel of Jesus. It is the most opposed mission on Earth. There are countries where they may permit anything at all except the gospel of Jesus. The gospel of Jesus is the greatest threat to politics, religion, and the traditions of men.Certain men who are not of the faith make themselves enemies of the gospel and wickedly plot for the destruction of those who preach Christ."Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:  And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith" 2 Thessalonians 3:1-2 (KJV)
There are many places where ministers of the gospel are not given access to preach. There are people who have hardened their hearts from receiving the gospel.
"Devote yourselves to prayer, keeping alert in it with an attitude of thanksgiving; praying at the same time for us as well, that God will open up to us a door for the word, so that we may speak forth the mystery of Christ, for which I have also been imprisoned; that I may make it clear in the way I ought to speak." Colossians 4:2-4 (NASB) If you want to see the gospel prevail in such places, then you must pray. This is part of your kingdom responsibility. It is part of your role in the spread of the gospel.
You become a partner with those who lead in the spread of the gospel, when you pray for them.
“…strive together with me in your prayers to God on my behalf…” Romans 15:30This is the time to fill the earth with the knowledge of Christ as the waters cover the sea.Don't sit on the fence. Strive with your leader through prayers to God for the spread of the gospel.Glory to God. DIG DEEPER(1 Thesalonians 5:25; Philemon 1:22; Hebrews 13:18-19) WE PRAY Pray for all leaders laboring in the spread of the gospel, that: - they will be delivered from wicked men.- doors will be opened to them for the spread of the gospel of Jesus.- they will be given utterance to speak the wisdom of God.- they will remain focused in the work of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Proverbs 1-3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel.– The Lord is making them increase in boldness.– They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord.– They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power.– They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil.– The faith of the Leaders shall not grow cold. They will increase in the Lord’s zeal and in great faith. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 521 - FINALLY BE STRONG
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 27th, June 2024 FINALLY BE STRONG"Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might." Ephesians 6:10 (KJV)One of the most beautiful and detailed epistles of Paul the apostle, is the Epistle to the Believers in Ephesus.Remember though these epistles in the New Testament were written to believers in specific locations, they are also epistles to us in this century for our benefit and growth in the Lord.The Epistle to the Church in Ephesus has two parts.1. Paul the apostle took his time to explain all the spiritual blessings we have in Christ. He explained God's predestined plan, the believer's inheritance and position in Christ. He also unveiled details of the glorious union we have in Christ Jesus. The book of Ephesians is strong on "In Christ realities".2. The second part of the book (chapters 4 - 6) focuses on the believer's function and responsibilities. Eg: Ephesians 4:1 begins with:     "As a prisoner of the Lord, I plead with you to walk holy, in a way that is suitable to your high rank, given to you in your divine calling." (Amplified)The emphasis in the second part of Ephesians establishes the necessity that God's life dispensed into us must be expressed.As part of the instructions to the believer, Paul the apostle finally admonished every believer"To be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might."
The whole armor of God and prayers for the saints have one result, to help you to be strong in the Lord and in the power of His might.
The word strong in the verse is from the Greek word "endunamoō" which means to be enabled or to increase in strength.Paul wasn't asking the believers to increase in their own strength but to increase in the strength of the Lord.He didn't end there, he also admonished the brethren to increase in the power of the Lord's might.This is not really about you trying to conquer the enemy but enforcing the dominion of Christ.Take a look at the meaning of  "Power of His might".The phrase has two keywords:Power and Might!The word "power" used here isn't "dunamis"; he chose the word "kratos" which means "great vigor" or "dominion" or "mighty" deed. It also means "force".The word "Might" is from the Greek word "ischus", which also means "forcefulness and inherent strength". Ischus is not necessarily the accomplishment of might but the power as an enduement. It is the fact or record that there is ability.While "ischus" has to do with the possessiveness of might, "kratos" has to do with the supremacy of might.Through your union with Christ, there is the presence of the might of Christ within you. Thus you have the might of Christ as your possession because the presence of Christ's might is in you.By this might (ischus) you can now be explosive or enforce superiority of power (kratos).
By the might and power of the Lord in you, there is no way you shouldn't walk in victory.
As you engage the whole armor pieces of the Lord, stay alert to persevere in prayer and supplication for all the saints and those who lead in the mandate of the Lord, and you increase in strength.There will be attempts of the adversary to oppose you as long as you labor to advance the spread of the gospel. The rulers of dark places will make you the focus of their attacks as you shine forth the light of the gospel.
However, you must continually stand victorious with the force of his explosive power flowing in and through you.
There is nothing you need to remain strong in the Lord and the power of His might which the Lord has not given to you. Don't break down, and don't live as one who is defenseless.You have God's whole battle strategy and weapons for your victory.
By the wisdom of His word, you are not ignorant of the devices and wiles of the devil.
You increase in strength and take advantage of the Lord's armor as you:- put on the belt of truth, and the breastplate of righteousness.- shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace.- take the shield of faith, and position yourself properly in the testudo shield formation then you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.- take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit.- pray always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watch with all perseverance.- make supplication for all saints and for the leaders to make known the mystery of the gospel.
No matter the situation, remain strong and resolute. You have the whole armor of God to exercise your victory.
Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:19-20; Haggai 2:4; 1 Corinthians 16:13; 2 Timothy 2:1; 1 Peter 4:11) WE PRAY We pray that all the saints will stand firm in their faith and be strong and courageous. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 4 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am strong in the Lord and in the power of His might. - I don't break down. - I live daily in victory. - I take advantage of the whole armor of God, I remain strong in the Lord. - With this whole armor of God, I exercise victory at every count. Ohh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 522 - YOU ARE SEATED IN GLORY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday 28th, June 2024 YOU ARE SEATED IN GLORY 1And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus Ephesians 2:6 (KJV)As you may know, after sin entered man and he became corrupt, man was often referred to as "Fallen".You can find this as the conclusion Paul the apostle also made after he argued why everyone needs the salvation of Jesus.
