From Romans chapter 1:18 to chapter 3:31, Paul argued that regardless of what all men are; their beliefs, religion, tradition, race or status, all men are in the same boat.The boat of corruption, defeat of sin or unbelief and eternal condemnation.
Therefore everyone needs the salvation of Jesus through faith.
"God treats everyone alike. He accepts people only because they have faith in Jesus Christ" Romans 3:22 (CEV)He finally concluded by saying:"All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory" Romans 3:23 (Contemporary English Version).
He emphasized that no one can be saved by circumcision, the law of Moses and the law of the flesh but salvation is only by faith through Christ Jesus.
Without Christ, all men have fallen short of God's glory. This means all men lost their place in the Lord's presence because of their unbelief.For anyone to experience God’s glory and presence, he or she must believe and receive Jesus."But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins." Romans 3:24 (CEV)
So when the fallen man receives Jesus, he is made free from sin through Him.
However, this doesn't end there. Jesus delivered all who believe in Him from sin and its bondage and brought them into Himself.This is what Jesus did, He became sin for man (John 1:29, 2 Corinthians 5:21), He died for our offences and for our justification He was raised (Romans 4:25) and after He was raised He ascended into glory so that all who will believe in Him will share in His glory."After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God." (Mark 16:19).
Jesus' ascension was into His transcending glory.
"And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Preached among the Gentiles, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory"  1 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV)The believer in Christ has come into union with Christ. By the testimony of the scriptures, the believer or the saint in Christ is not only identified in the life and nature of Christ but also is Identified in and with Christ in His position and function.
This means that, the believer is identified in the death, burial, resurrection and present position of Jesus.
The believer or the saint is now seated with Christ Jesus in glory.Observe how it was translated in the Amplified Bible:"And He raised us up together with Him [when we believed], and seated us with Him in the heavenly places, [because we are] in Christ Jesus" Ephesians  2:6When you believed, you ceased to be a fallen man. You now became an ascended man who is seated with Christ in the heavenly places.
Your location is not beneath, your present location is far above in glory.
Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:20; Ephesians 2:13; Colossians 2:12; Romans 6:4-5) WE PRAY We pray that we shall not live as fallen men but live in the consciousness of our seated position of glory in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 9 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am seated in glory. - I don't live as a fallen man. - I live daily in the consciousness of my seated position of glory in Christ. - My present location is far above in glory. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 523 - YOU ARE SEATED IN GLORY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday 29th, June 2024YOU ARE SEATED IN GLORY 2And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus Ephesians 2:6 (KJV)The new man in Christ is not a fallen man. The new man in Christ is risen with Christ.
The consequence of sin is death.
"but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die." Genesis 2:17 (NKJV)Again we see this affirmed in Romans 6:23:"For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord." (KJV)Jesus death was a payment of the penalty of sin. And this is the twofold reality of the death of Jesus:- Jesus DIED FOR all men (Substitutionary sacrifice). Jesus didn't only die for those who believed in Him. He died for both those who reject Him and those who receive Him.- Jesus DIED WITH all those who received Him (Identification). The thing is, until you receive Christ you don't share in the benefits of His death; even though He died for you. When you receive Jesus, you become a participant of the reality of His death, burial and resurrection.The climax of Jesus' death and resurrection was in His exaltation. Jesus who is God became flesh and humbled Himself even unto the death of shame. By this demonstration of obedience, He multiplied His authority and greatness in resurrection and ascension. (Philippians 2:6-10).
To be seated with Christ simply means to be alive with Christ and to share in His authority.
The believer is seated in Christ through faith in Christ. This faith is dependent on all that which Christ achieved through His work and resurrection. Through Christ's work, the believer is legally qualified to share in the authority of Jesus.The believer in Christ has come into union with Christ. All believers or saints in Christ are members of His body of His flesh and His bones. (Ephesians 5:30)As members of His body, we also exude His authority. Jesus is seated far above all rule and authority and power and dominion [whether angelic or human], and eternally [far above] every name that is named [above every title that can be conferred]. Since we are seated with Christ, we share with Him in this greatness of authority, for Christ demonstrate His rule through His Church (Ephesians 1:19-23).You are seated with Christ, refuse to be intimidated by any dominion or rule which is under the feet of Christ. As members of His body, anything under His feet is under our feet.
Walk in this consciousness of authority.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:19-23; Ephesians 2:13; Colossians 2:12; Romans 6:4-5) WE PRAY We pray that the authority of Jesus will be demonstrated in this generation through His Church according to the boldness of the Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 13 - 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am seated in glory. – I don’t live as a fallen man. – I live daily in the consciousness of my seated position of glory in Christ. – My present location is far above in glory. Oh thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 524 - YOU ARE SEATED IN GLORY 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 30th, June 2024 YOU ARE SEATED IN GLORY 3And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus Ephesians 2:6 (KJV)When God made man, the first day man saw was His rest.The final work of God in His creation was man on the sixth day. (Genesis 1:24-31).The beginning of man's day after He was made was the seventh day.God finished all His work on the seventh day and rested.
Man didn't meet God working. Man met God in rest.
"Thus the heavens and the earth, and all the host of them, were finished. And on the seventh day God ended His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done. Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He rested from all His work which God had created and made." Genesis 2:1-3 (NKJV)Man's work is what God has done. Which means whatever man was designed for must be done in REST. Man was to live his days in rest.Yes, God made man to be fruitful and multiply, to fill the earth and to subdue it, to have dominion and to till the ground and tend the earth. However, all these were to be done in REST.
To come into rest is to work from what God has finished. For God to rest means He is satisfied. Thus to be in the rest of God is to dwell in God's satisfaction.
God's glory is seen in you when you enjoy His satisfaction.To come into rest is to come to the place of communion, intimacy and a deep relationship with God.God didn't intend that His relationship with man would be based on works and religious efforts unto righteousness.
God made man to have a relationship with him (man) based on who He (God) is and not based on man's self-generated effort.
God made man and brought him into the abundance of His provision. Man was to enjoy, care and express all that the Lord supplied.When man fell from glory (Romans 3:23), man also fell from rest.Man who was to enjoy communion with God in rest must now attempt to use self-effort to connect to God.
God is so loving, beloved. Even after man's fall, God began to work His saving plan to bring man into His complete rest. (Genesis 3:15,21)
All through the scriptures, you will find God walking man through His plan.The idea of the animal sacrifices in the Tabernacle and the temple was to teach man how He (the Lord) is ushering man into His rest.In the old covenant, worshippers of God found peace and felt whole after they had offered a sacrifice. And most of all when the High Priest had presented the blood of an unblemished lamb on the mercy seat in the Most Holy Place.They had to offer regular daily sacrifices (Numbers 28:1-8), weekly sacrifices during the sabbath (Numbers 28:9-10), monthly sacrifices every first day of the month (Numbers 28:11-15), then the yearly Passover celebration sacrifices, the thin bread and annual harvest sacrifices (Numbers 28:16-31).These sacrifices were to bring them into daily, weekly, monthly and yearly rest and peace with God.You can imagine how the High Priest and the Priests have to work daily. This isn't a one-time thing. They offer sacrifices every day of the whole year, morning and evening.The High Priest is daily standing to offer sacrifices.However, that is not our testimony in the New Testament. In Christ, our High Priest is seated once and for all. To be seated means He has finished His work and has entered His rest."Under the old covenant, the priest stands and ministers before the altar day after day, offering the same sacrifices again and again, which can never take away sins. But our High Priest offered himself to God as a single sacrifice for sins, good for all time. Then he sat down in the place of honor at God’s right hand. There he waits until his enemies are humbled and made a footstool under his feet. For by that one offering he forever made perfect those who are being made holy." Hebrews 10:11-14 (NLT)As we have seen previously, when Jesus sat in glory, we sat with Him in glory. Just as in the Old Covenant, the offeror stands with the Priests every day, we also who are in Christ, are seated with Him forever.Jesus sat in honor. To be seated in honor is to be seated in glory. Furthermore, to be seated is to be at rest. The High Priest kept standing in the Old Covenant, which means they have not entered the rest. They must work daily to feel at peace with God.But for us, we are seated in rest with Christ. To be seated in honor or glory is to be seated in rest forever in Christ.
The believer in Christ is not trying to enter rest. The man in Christ is seated in rest.
This is not the restoration of Adam experiencing rest on God's sabbath.This is the tangible transcendent manifestation of God's sabbath in wholeness.Beloved, your relationship with God is not a strive to enter rest. Your relationship with God is the eternal enjoyment of God's rest.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 110:1; Mark 16:19; Hebrews 1:3; Hebrews 7:27; Hebrews 8:1; Ephesians 2:13) WE PRAY We pray that the restfulness we have experienced in Christ will be preeminent in our daily living. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 17 - 19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am seated in glory. – I am at rest in Christ. – I live daily in the consciousness of my seated position of rest in Christ. – I do all things from the position of rest. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 525 - GOD — YOUR PLACE OF REFUGE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  GOD — YOUR PLACE OF REFUGE"God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea" Psalm 46:1-2 (KJV)
BLESSED NEW MONTH!
This month of July is the beginning of the second half of the year 2024. Glory to God!You may be reading this and today is the beginning of your time at a new workspace, and you have a sense of fear. Today may also mark the beginning of restructuring your plans for the year. You are reading this now and are also faced with a new challenge and unexpected news that has troubled you.Your world may seem to be collapsing and you don't know what to do.Are you currently overwhelmed by your challenges and you feel suicide is your only escape from the vicissitude circumstance?It's too early to give up.
There is a greater option for you beloved of God in Christ.
Men might have failed you.You may feel rejected by your family at this moment.It looks like whichever direction you turn to, doesn't favor you.You have stopped praying, you have stopped reading the word, and you are currently planning to stay away from Church.That is not the way.
GOD IS YOUR REFUGE!
Learn to trust in Him as your refuge and strength.Can you imagine the confidence of a man living in a fortified castle on a hill during heavy rainfall?He will not be troubled nor moved by the outcome of the rain.You will find this man enjoying and thanking the Lord for the blessings of rain.Unlike the homeless or the man who lives in a kiosk.Both don't deny the presence of the rain. However, they will both have different reactions towards the rain.
The consciousness of your location defines your attitude towards the storm.
In your time of trouble, don't run away from God. In your time of trouble, run to God.Most people see God as the source of their trouble and pain. Some think God leads them into trouble to test their faith. No!That is not God. He is not the source of evil, trouble, pain, and chaos. Only good and perfect gift comes from God (James 1:17).
God is not your prison of pain. God is your refuge and strength.
He is not one who helps you today and will fail to help you tomorrow. God is your very present help in times of trouble. He is always present to help you in the now.The storms may come, the waters may roar, the mountains may be carried into the sea, don't be afraid nor shaken.Remain resolute in the Lord.
Remain confident in who God is and His ability.
Look away from the trouble and look to God, who is your refuge and strength.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 46; Psalm 91:1-9; Deuteronomy 4:7; Psalm 23:4) WE PRAY We pray that we will not cast our gaze on the storm happening around us rather we will remain conscious of our present location in Christ while looking to God who is our refuge and strength. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 20 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- God is my refuge and strength. -  God is my very present help in times of trouble. - I remain resolute in the Lord no matter the storm because I keep my gaze daily on Him. - I am unmovable and unshakeable. - I am firmly rooted in Him. - I am always conscious of my present location in Christ. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 526 - WALK IN HONOR
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency WALK IN HONOR “Recognize the value of every person and continually show love to every believer. Live your lives with great reverence and in holy awe of God. Honor your rulers.”1 Peter 2:17 (TPT) Day by day as each generation grows deep into “postmodernism“, people become more interested in pleasing themselves and satisfying their ego.  Men are drifting away from the very concept that helps bridge one generation to another. Blessings of one generation are distributed through a system of honour and humility.
No generation can accurately and fully reach its potential without the impartations of the previous generation.
In the Kingdom of God, to walk in honor and humility is a code of greatness. To honor is to have great value and respect for others and highly esteem those who have authority over you. Though the younger generation may seem to lose the true sense of honor gradually, it doesn’t change its authentic essence among the great. As you saw in the opening verse (1 Peter 2:17): To honor is to: 1. Recognize the value of every person. 2. Continually show love to every believer.  3. Live with great reverence and in holy awe of God.  4. Acknowledge the authority of your rulers.
Let’s quickly look at those you must honor, according to the counsel of God’s wisdom:
1. Honor God  “the twenty-four Elders fell down before him and worshiped him, the Eternal Living One, and cast their crowns before the throne, singing, “O Lord, you are worthy to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for you have created all things. They were created and called into being by your act of will.” Revelation 4:10-11 (TLB) Understand that you can also honor the Lord with:  a. Your treasure and time. Time is one of the most precious treasures and assets we have.  Invest your time and anything you value into your relationship with God and His vision.  “Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also” (Matthew 6:21).  b. Honor God with your body. You were bought with a price by God, therefore honor Him in your body, which is His temple. (1 Corinthians 6:18-20). c. Honor God with your finances, wealth, or possessions. “Honor the Lord with your possessions, and with the firstfruits of all your increase” Proverbs 3:9 (NKJV).The Message translation says, “…give Him the first and the best.” d. With your hands and heart lifted in worship and thanksgiving. (Psalm 34:1-3) Interestingly as you honor the Lord, you enjoy honor from Him (1 Samuel 2:30). And He also shares secrets with those who revere Him. “Friendship with God is reserved for those who reverence him. With them alone, he shares the secrets of his promises” Psalm 25:14 (TLB)
Beloved, understand that you can fully honor the Lord through Christ Jesus.
2. Honor Your Leaders in the Church (1 Thessalonians 5:12). 3. Honor your Parents (Ephesians 6:2). 4. Honor Your Spouse (1 Peter 3:7; Ephesians 5:33). 5. Honor the Elderly (Leviticus 19:32). 6. Honor Rulers or Government officials (Romans 13:1-2; 7). 7. Honor Your senior Colleagues at work or employers (1 Peter 2:18). 8. Honor one another above yourselves. (Romans 12:10). This includes parents also honoring their children. Ephesians 6:4 (nevertheless children must not use that against their parents. Yours is to honor your parents).
Where there is honor and humility, there is abundance release of grace, and peace. (James 4:6; 1 Peter 5:5-6).
When you truly love the Lord you will honor others with the humility and integrity of heart. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Revelation 5:13; Psalm 22:23; John 5:23; 1 Peter 1:22) WE PRAYThat we shall take hold of the counsel of the word of the Lord and walk in honor towards God and men according to the wisdom of God. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 25 - 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in honor and humility. – I walk in honor towards God and all men according to the wisdom of God. – I  don’t dishonor the authorities set over me. – I honor the Lord with my body. – I honor the Lord with my treasure, time and finances. – I demonstrate honor in all things. Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 527 - GOD IS UNFAILING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  GOD IS UNFAILING"I cried out, “I am slipping!” but your unfailing love, O Lord, supported me." Psalm 94:18 (NLT)In ancient times, men trusted in the strong walls they built as a defence to their cities.Their walls remain strong until an enemy troop breach the defences of the cities.In our days, many have built different defence systems around their lives. One thing which must be clear to you is that, there is no defence system built outside God that is eternally sustainable.
Anything which issues out of God is everlasting (Ecclesiastes 3:14), it does not expire.
God's Word endures forever (Isaiah 40:6-8). His faithfulness endures through all the ages (Psalm 119:90). And His love never fails.God's relationship with you is not built on the condition of your love or goodness. God's relationship with you is built on His unconditional love.You have access to God in Christ through His saving grace which was worked into you by the unfailing love of God."This is real love—not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as a sacrifice to take away our sins." 1 John 4:10 (NLT)
The love of God cannot be breached or crushed. There is nothing in all of the universe potent enough to make God's love for you fail.
There are many who find it difficult to turn to God during crises because they feel God has turned away from them. Most of these people got into trouble because they disobeyed an instruction of God, and then concluded that, God wouldn't hear their "cry" for help.That is a wrong misconception of who God is and the nature of His love.
To think God wouldn't hear your call for help because He is angry is not consistent with the revelation of Jesus.
Relate with God, on the grounds of his unfailing love towards you.God's love was demonstrated towards you through Christ when you were dead in sin. Much more now that you are one with Him.No matter how you think you have offended or disappointed God, He will not withhold His love from you when you call.
No matter how deep you have drowned in defeat, God's unfailing love will sustain you.
Trust in the love of God for you, it never fails!Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 33:18; Psalm 143:8; Psalm 13:5-6; Psalm 136:26; Romans 8:39) WE PRAY Thank you, Lord, for your love which never fails. Thank you for the preserving ability of your love you daily demonstrate towards us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Proverbs 29 - 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I trust in the love of God for me. - His love for me never fails. - I am the delight of God.- God will never be angry with me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 528 - MOVE IN FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency MOVE IN FAITH"But we are not those who draw back and are destroyed, but those who have faith and obtain life." Hebrews 10:39 (Holman Christian Standard Bible) The man of God Reinhard Bonnke made this profound statement, “A man of faith has no reverse gear.”
There is nothing we do in Christ without Faith.
The scriptures are clear, “THE JUST SHALL LIVE BY FAITH” (Habakkuk 2:4; Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11; Hebrews 10:38). Who is the just?It is the new man in Christ.Are you born again in Christ? Then you are JUSTIFIED! Beloved, you did not just get saved by grace through faith in Christ Jesus.You live by faith. Whatever God wants you to do can be done by faith. Faith is absolute confidence and total trust in God.Faith takes hold of what God has said in His word and runs with it.
Faith does not look back and has no reverse gear.
When Moses and the Israelites got to the Red Sea, they were troubled and began complaining. Especially when they saw the Egyptian army charging towards them. They sincerely didn’t know what to do. They were scared of what would befall them by the Egyptians.Yet God has a direction for them. Amid the chaos and impossible situation, look at God’s response: "And the LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to Me? Tell the children of Israel to go forward." Exodus 14:15 (NKJV). Oh dear Lord Jesus! He then instructed Moses as to what to do. ”But lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. And the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.” Exodus 14:16 (NKJV). This is an explicit example of “Faith without works is dead”.God told Moses to move forward yet He instructed him on what to do as they move forward. Don’t just sit in your room and say ‘God will do it’.Great things don’t happen that way.
You have to take Holy Spirit inspired steps. You need to act towards your miracle.
Faith is forward!Faith doesn’t look back.Faith doesn’t reverse.Faith is taking inspired steps of God, for glorious manifestation.Look at David, when he confronted Goliath. ”When Goliath started forward, David ran toward him.” 1 Samuel 17:48 (Contemporary English Version). David didn’t run backwards, He charged towards Goliath.He didn’t try to step back to watch what Goliath was going to do. He took a step in the boldness and confidence in the Lord.
Step forward to do whatever the Lord inspires you to do.
Refuse to be careful. Refuse to be afraid. Refuse to be intimidated.Refuse to quit. When you quit, you cannot see what the Lord has said He will do through you.The three Hebrew boys did not change their minds. They stood on the grounds of their convictions. And thought, even if God doesn’t come to save them, they will not bow! (Daniel 3:18). The woman with the issue of blood, did not stand afar to assume her healing would happen. She kept saying to herself if only I will touch His garment, I will be healed. As she was saying to herself she moved through the crowd, touched Jesus’ garment and received her healing.
Don’t sit back to assume things will fall in place. Move in faith.
Selah. DIG DEEPER(Mark 5:27-34; Daniel 3:17-18; 1 Samuel 17:40-58) WE PRAYDeclaring the victory of the Lord in every assignment He has entrusted to our care. And the courage in His Word to do great things unto the glory of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ecclesiastes 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified by faith. – I live also by faith. – I refuse to quit. – I refuse to be careful. – I refuse to be afraid. – I act on the word. – I go all out on the word. – I am daring in faith. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 529 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 1"A small rudder on a huge ship in the hands of a skilled captain sets a course in the face of the strongest winds" James 3:4 (Amplified Bible)Though Jesus is the captain of your Salvation, the manifestation of His life in you is your responsibility.There are many who keep making such mistakes. They sit to watch how God will direct their lives.There are believers who want God to make them prayerful without their efforts. They want to automatically become word addicts as they spend their time watching online comedy.
The finished work of Christ through His death, burial and resurrection did not nullify the necessity of your work of faith.
By His finished work, you have come into the enjoyment of the divine blessings and life. By your work of faith, you bear fruits and show forth His glory.God through Christ has predestined your life. However, the direction of your life is not automatically steered towards the destination determined by God.The direction of your life is determined by the choices you make.God works in you both to will and to do (Philippians 2:13), yet, you have the responsibility to first and daily submit your will to God's will.
Why do you think two believers may not make the same level of impact?
It is not only because of how God designed their lives. It is also because of how they both take advantage of the resources of the Lord. It takes grace to accomplish great things. Nevertheless, God doesn't just supply the ability of grace to people. It's the responsibility of every believer to grow or increase in grace (2 Peter 3:18).While discussing the Lord's armor, we noticed the emphasis of Paul (the apostle) on how each believer is responsible for the usage of the various armorpieces. Though God supplied the whole armor to the believer, it is the believer who has to "put on" and "take up" each armorpiece.No matter how you cry or sing, "Jesus take the wheel", He will only teach you how to steer the wheel. He wouldn't steer the wheel without you.The beautiful thing about your life is that God through Christ, has supplied all that you need to live the life He has designed for you. You have to take advantage of what He has supplied to you. This is what it means to live in rest.To live and function in rest is to operate in faith.
Don't assume your life will move towards the right direction. Divine direction will always require your obedience of faith.
God doesn't direct your life without your involvement. God only shows you which way to go and how to steer the rudder.No matter how huge boats, ships or aeroplanes are, their direction will be determined by their rudder.The captain must be skillful to know how to steer the rudder. AGAIN:
The direction of your life is not automatically steered towards the destination determined by God.
You must make a decision that you are going to be a skillful captain to move your life in the way of the Lord.A skillful captain or helmsman knows how to submit to the word of God and utilize the knowledge of the word to steer his life towards God's direction.Don't leave your life to chance, partner with the Lord to take hold of the rudder of your life.Selah. DIG DEEPER(Galatians 6:5-10; Proverbs 9:12; Romans 14:12) WE PRAY We pray that we will partner with the Holy Spirit to direct the course of our lives in the way of the Lord and not towards our selfish destination. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ecclesiastes 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am in partnership with the Holy Spirit.  - The direction of my life is in the way of the Lord. - I make the right choices that are in line with the plan of God concerning me. - I don't leave my life to chance. - I take hold of the rudder of my life. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 530 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 2"A small rudder on a huge ship in the hands of a skilled captain sets a course in the face of the strongest winds" James 3:4 (Amplified Bible)Until a captain skillfully steers his boat, the boat will be directed by the waves and the current of the sea.There are many, who rise and sleep each day, yet don't take charge of their lives. They sit to watch things happen without intentionally determining the course of their lives. They allow circumstances or occurrences to control the direction of their lives.They keep saying "I am trusting the Lord for an intervention." No!It doesn't work like that.The Lord doesn't expect you to fold your arms and wait till He does a miracle for you.
God has programmed life in a way that, He will partner with you to produce a miracle.
When the Israelites got to the Red Sea, Moses said "Fear ye not. Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which He will show to you today..."God's response was different. God said, "...Moses, tell the people to move forward". (Exodus 14:13-15).Moses had to partner with God to see the miracle of the Lord:"Then Moses raised his hand over the sea, and the LORD opened up a path through the water with a strong east wind." Exodus 14:21 (NLT).When Moses raised His hand, the Lord opened up a path in the direction which Moses's hand faced. Definitely, when Moses raised his hand, he imagined the Lord making a way for them. Maybe he didn't see the extent to which God was going to deliver them. But he yielded himself to God's partnership.The direction of your life is not automatically steered towards the destination determined by God.
You must take responsibility for how you walk in God's purpose.
You must take charge! The Lord wouldn't take the wheel without your involvement.To direct the course of your life you must partner with God with your spirit; for God is Spirit.Anything God will do with you, cannot be done without the involvement of your spirit. Your advancement first begins from your spirit before you see the manifestation in the physical. Anything made by God began in the Spirit.In the Spirit, there are two crucial rudders you must steer to advance in the right direction of glory.
The first crucial rudder you must steer is your MIND!
Your life will steer towards the direction of your mind.No matter the anointing upon your life and the great resources at your disposal, you cannot advance beyond the direction of your mind.There are people with great resources yet have not made great advancements.The limitation of your life is not the absence of resources.
The limitation of your life is in the limitation of your mind.
You cannot go where your mind has not reached."Never doubt God’s mighty power to work in you and accomplish all this. He will achieve infinitely more than your greatest request, your most unbelievable dream, and exceed your wildest imagination! He will outdo them all, for his miraculous power constantly energizes you." Ephesians 3:20 (TPT)
Don't be limited in your thoughts. God is able to outdo your wildest imagination.
To think is to see with your mind.Whichever direction your mind sees according to the power of God, will define your manifestation.God said to Abraham, “... Look as far as you can see in every direction—north and south, east and west. I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession." Genesis 13:14-15 (NLT)Which direction of success are you seeing now?Lift up your eyes and see! Don't limit the imagination of your mind. See and grasp the vision as the Lord inspires your mind with pictures of advancement.Selah.https://youtu.be/ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:10-12; Philippians 4:4-9; Isaiah 26:3; James 1:6-8) WE PRAY We pray that our minds will be directed towards the inspired and determined plans of the Lord for our lives. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ecclesiastes 8 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don't leave my life chance, I take charge. – I choose to walk in the will of God everyday.  – I refuse to yield to my will. – Through prayer and the study of the word, I am strengthened to walk in the ultimate Will of God for my life. – I don't limit the imagination of my mind. – I walk in agreement with God in all things. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 531 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 3"A small rudder on a huge ship in the hands of a skilled captain sets a course in the face of the strongest winds" James 3:4 (Amplified Bible)There are times when people sincerely don't know what to do to experience advancement. People look at the accomplishments of others and begin to think, they are not as privileged as them.What you should understand is that we all have equal privileges in Christ, though our moments of manifestation may differ. Also, the resources available to you will not automatically determine your advancement.As I have mentioned in the previous episode, the first crucial rudder you must steer is your MIND!Some people look to God for provision but don't give attention to shaping and renewing their minds to think as God wants them to think.
When you steer your thoughts, to align with the thoughts of God, you will have the God-kind of results.
You can have a God-kind of life and not produce the God-kind of results because of your thoughts.To have the God-kind of results you must have the God-kind of thoughts."For My thoughts are not your thoughts, nor are your ways My ways,” says the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, So are My ways higher than your ways, And My thoughts than your thoughts." Isaiah 55:8-9 (NKJV)The thoughts of God are higher than the thoughts of men. The more you meditate on the word of God, the more your mind is aligned with God's thoughts.
God's thoughts of you are to bring you to a glorious end.
"I say this because I know the plans that I have for you.” This message is from the Lord. “I have good plans for you. I don’t plan to hurt you. I plan to give you hope and a good future." Jeremiah 29:11 (ERV)The word of God contains God's plans and purposes for your life. Steer your mind with the revelation of His Word.You may think that because God can do exceedingly abundantly above all that you can ask or think, you don't have to steer your mind or thoughts towards any direction. You may assume that whichever way you direct your mind, God will still do the unimaginable.It is that same reason people don't pray or ask (or make supplication to) God for anything. They think whatever will be, will be.Such thoughts have made many believers walk in defeat. Since God will exceed your wildest imagination, doesn't mean you shouldn't have a wild imagination.
A greatly wild imagination which will bring glory to God, is evidence that you don't doubt the power of God in you.
Take a look at the PassionTranslation:"Never doubt God’s mighty power to work in you and accomplish all this. He will achieve infinitely more than your greatest request, your most unbelievable dream, and exceed your wildest imagination! He will outdo them all, for his miraculous power constantly energizes you." Ephesians 3:20 (TPT)Did you notice the first phrase?Never doubt God's mighty power...To doubt God is to move your mind away from what God can do through you. To doubt God is also the limitation of the ability of God.
You may not experience the unlimited results of God's power in you when you have doubts in your thoughts.
Even though God will outdo your wildest imagination, He wants you to still steer your mind towards exceedingly great dreams, which are inspired by His word.Don't be limited in your thoughts. Whatever you want to experience or achieve, see it with your mind. Direct or steer your mind towards it, even as you pray.Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:10-12; Philippians 4:4-9; Isaiah 26:3; James 1:6-8) WE PRAY Pray that the Lord will open your mind to conceptualize the unimaginable things He wants to achieve through you today, this week, this month, this year and even in your time here on Earth. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Song of Solomon 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My mind is opened to conceptualize unimaginable things that God wants to achieve through me today.  - I don't doubt the power of God in me.- I have no doubt in my thoughts. - Through the meditation of the word of God, I align my mind to the thoughts of God. - I have absolute confidence in God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 532 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDER 4"A small rudder on a huge ship in the hands of a skilled captain sets a course in the face of the strongest winds" James 3:4 (Amplified Bible)If you have been following this discussion, then I know you are already inspired to give attention to how you think.This is not necessarily about positive thinking. This is basically about bringing your thoughts in conformity to the thoughts of God.
As born again, your thoughts must be at the level which God has brought you in Christ.
You are seated in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus. Therefore you must think about that position and level of authority."Since you were brought back to life with Christ, focus on the things that are above-where Christ holds the highest position." Colossians 3:1 (GOD'S WORD Translation)Don't think like a fallen man because you are risen with Christ and seated in glory. You are seated and designed to function in the realm of limitless grace and possibilities.Whenever the focus of your mind seems to be distracted, drive or steer it on the path set by the Word.
The Word of God is the light and compass you need to navigate your way through life.
"Truth’s shining light guides me in my choices and decisions; the revelation of your word makes my pathway clear." Psalm 119:105 (TPT)The revelation of the Word of God illuminates your mind with the thoughts of God. You are able to see as God sees concerning every situation.The revelation of the word of God in you steers your mind towards the things that are authentic, real, honorable, pure, beautiful and glorious. (Philippians 4:8).To be anxious or worried is basically to be pulled towards different uncertain directions. This may cause your faith-ship to strike a rock or suffer shipwreck.To steer your mind towards the God-designed destination, you don't only need the revelation of the Word of God, you also need to commit yourself to consistent prayer.However, this is what you should know when you want to steer your mind or heart (which includes your emotions, will, mind and spirit):Your mind being a rudder is a useful instrument in the Spirit for the effectual workings of God's power. Therefore while you pray, don't just allow your mind to be distracted by unprofitable thoughts. Steer your mind towards the visions and ideas of God.
You must fasten your thoughts on the glorious work and strategies of the Lord.
Direct your thoughts towards the next destination the Lord has set before you. Direct your thoughts towards the next big thing or plan the Lord has set before you.When thoughts of failure come to mind, steer your mind away to the right path of glory.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:10-12; Philippians 4:4-9; Isaiah 26:3; James 1:6-8) WE PRAY Pray that you will not walk in doubt but the revelation light of the word will steer your mind towards the glorious purpose of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Song of Solomon 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The word of God is my light and my compass. - I have no doubt in my thoughts. - Through the meditation of the word of God, I align my mind to the thoughts of God. - The revelation light of the word steers my mind towards the glorious purpose of the Lord. - I don't walk in darkness. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 533 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 5"A small rudder on a huge ship in the hands of a skilled captain sets a course in the face of the strongest winds" James 3:4 (Amplified Bible)One of the core things you should understand from our previous discussion is that:THE DIRECTION OF YOUR LIFE IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY STEERED TOWARDS THE DESTINATION DETERMINED BY GOD.To steer your life towards God's designed or determined destination you must intentionally take charge of the rudder of your life.
Just as a ship wouldn't automatically move towards its destination, but must be skillfully steered, so is your life.
When you don't take charge of the rudder to skillfully steer your life, you may move in the wrong direction and also may shipwreck your life-ship.Everyone's life is steered by these Two Crucial Rudders:1. THE MIND and Heart (I have explained how the mind functions as a rudder, and how you have to direct it)2. The second crucial rudder we have to take a look at is the TONGUE."Horses have bits and bridles in their mouths so that we can control and guide their large body. And the same with mighty ships, though they are massive and driven by fierce winds, yet they are steered by a tiny rudder at the direction of the person at the helm.And so the tongue is a small part of the body yet it carries great power! Just think of how a small flame can set a huge forest ablaze. And the tongue is a fire! It can be compared to the sum total of wickedness and is the most dangerous part of our human body. It corrupts the entire body and is a hellish flame! It releases a fire that can burn throughout the course of human existence." James 3:3-7 (TPT)
The direction of your life is not only steered by your mind but also by your tongue.
The words you speak determine how glorious your life becomes. Don't just talk; let your words be consistent with the Word of God.Since you now know the tongue is also a rudder, you must understand that, whenever you speak, you are steering your life towards success or defeat."If those who claim devotion to God don’t control what they say, they mislead themselves. Their devotion is worthless" James 1:26 (CEB).You may have the right mindset, and a good heart, however, if your words are not consistent with the genuineness of your thoughts, then your thoughts are not your conviction and consciousness. The World English Bible says, "...your mouth exposes your heart..." (James 1:26).
Your words must be consistent with the direction of your mind.
Beloved bridle your tongue!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 17:27; Proverbs 15:28; Proverbs 23:15-16; Zephaniah 3:9) WE PRAY We pray that we will have mastery over our tongue to communicate the thoughts of God at all times, no matter the situation at hand. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I exercise mastery over my tongue. - By my tongue, I communicate the thoughts of God at all times no matter the situation at hand. - My tongue is seasoned with the word of His grace, - I only speak forth blessings. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 534 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 6"In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, yet it can boast of great achievements. A huge forest can be set on fire by a little flame" James 3:5 (International Standard Version)The evidence of your thoughts is in your words. No one knew what was on the mind of God until He gave His word. The word of God brings us into the understanding of His thoughts.
The mouth will speak "out of" the abundance of the heart. When you want your thoughts to be understood, you must exercise the maturity of speaking.
How you speak is also proof of your maturity. Anyone who has mastery of the tongue and knows how to speak or tame the tongue will excel in every place.Many destinies have been crushed because of the tongue. The utterances of the tongue can cause you to advance or to become stagnant.The tongue is like a little spark of flame which can set a huge forest on fire. It is like the rudder which directs a huge ship towards a destination.
You must become intentional about your words. To speak the mind of God you must learn to speak His word.
God said to Joshua, "Let the words from the book of the law be always on your lips..." Joshua 1:8 (VOICE)This is not merely about "Talking Positive", this is mainly about Speaking the Word of God. The Word of God is more than being positive. The Word of God is being creative.The Word of God creates. The universe was created, framed, repaired, properly and perfectly joined together by the Word of God.Your life will only head towards God's designed destination when you master the wisdom to speak God's inspired Word.Don't speak your fear, worry or anxiety, doubt, limitation, failures and disappointments.
Speak that which is pure, true, honorable, worthy of note and glorious.
When you learn to meditate on the Word of God you will definitely speak forth the Word.The meditation of your heart and the words of your mouth must be consistent with the mind of God."Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer" (Psalm 19:14)
Words that are consistent with the thoughts of God and are acceptable by God, cause the Lord's blessings to increase in your life.
"You are the most handsome of all. Gracious words stream from your lips. God himself has blessed you forever" Psalm 45:2 (NLT)This is a poetic Psalm written to celebrate David the King. This Psalm unveils the skillfulness of David through words.The King's gracious words contribute to how he was endued with blessings.He always knew what to say to the Lord and the people he led.
To speak graciously also means to speak kindly and politely.
 This is not about making a faith declaration but knowing how to address situations and people through wisdom.Some people are always overwhelmed by conflicts because of the utterances they make.Such must practice the habit of speaking graciously. This means to speak an attractive speech that is impressively articulated and fitting for the occasion.
Until you consistently have a genuine testimony that your words at every given time are full of grace and excellence, you have not yet matured.
Let grace be poured on your lips.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 50:4; Proverbs 17:27; Proverbs 15:28; Proverbs 23:15-16; Zephaniah 3:9) WE PRAY We pray that we shall have the tongue of the learned and that our tongue or lips will be saturated with grace so that we will excel in speech with the right words in season and out of season no matter the situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the tongue of the learned. - My tongue is saturated with grace, therefore I only speak gracious words. - I excel in speech with the right words in and out of season. - It doesn't matter the challenge at a particular time, I speak right.- I speak that which is pure, true honorable, worthy of note and glorious.Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 535 - TWO CRUCIAL RUDDERS 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  TWO CRUCIAL RUDDER 7"He who loves purity of heart, and whose speech is gracious, will have the king as his friend" Proverbs 22:11 (ESV)This is the code to walk in greatness.To steer your life to the highest level of greatness, you must be conscious of how you steer these two crucial rudder:- THE MIND or HEART- AND THE TONGUE
It takes a man who loves the purity of heart and is gracious in speech to have the king as his friend.
The king will associate himself with the mature. And it is the direction of your thoughts and the dexterity of speech which defines your maturity."For we all stumble in many ways. And if anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a perfect man, able also to bridle his whole body." James 3:2 (ESV)To be a perfect man in this context means to be a matured man. Anyone who has mastery of the tongue and knows how to speak or tame the tongue will excel in every place.
You must be intentional about how you think and also your words.  Let the Word (Wisdom) of God saturate your mind or heart and your speech.
Don't speak as you feel, speak what is right.Truth is not how you think, truth is how God wants you to think.There are people whose speeches are full of ungraciousness, impolite, arrogance, pride, and dishonor, and will claim they are being truthful. Truth is always spoken in humility of heart and speech.If you are truly humble at heart, you will speak with humility. If you are gracious at heart your speech will be gracious.
Your words are the description of your mindset. The mouth will speak what is in the heart.
As we looked at the Psalm 45:2: "You are the most handsome of all. Gracious words stream from your lips. God himself has blessed you forever" (NLT)David as a king did not use his royalty to become rude and boastful in his speech. He was gracious.I explained previously that, to speak graciously, also means to speak kindly and politely. It means to speak an attractive speech that is impressively articulated and fitting for the occasion.This is not about making a faith declaration but knowing how to address situations and people through wisdom.When you learn to speak right, you avoid unnecessary conflicts and even stagnation. Some people have lost great opportunities because of how they think and how impolite they are in speech.
Let grace be poured on your lips.
Even our Lord, Jesus was gracious in His speech."Everyone spoke well of him and was amazed by the gracious words that came from his lips. “How can this be?” they asked. “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?” Luke 4:22 (NLT)Jesus at every given time had the right answers to the most difficult questions.
Beloved, let gracious words proceed out of your mouth. Let your tongue be soaked with wisdom.
"The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with a word him who is weary. Morning by morning he awakens; he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught." Isaiah 50:4 (ESV)It is not only your mind which must be given to training. Your tongue must be taught to be skilled at speech.The Lord through His Word and the voice of the Holy Spirit teaches you to speak before kings.The Lord said to Moses, "Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say" (Exodus 4:12)
Your communication (speech or writing) skills will enable you to harness relationships and accomplish success.
You can attract kings and greatness when you master these two crucial rudders.Think right, and speak graciously.This is how you steer your life to glorious accomplishments.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(Matthew 10:19; Proverbs 22:12; Ecclesiastes 10:12; Proverbs 16:13; Luke 21:15; Zephaniah 3:9) WE PRAY We pray that the Lord shall train our hearts to reason his thoughts and our lips shall be equipped with wisdom to know what to say at any given point of time. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 9 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My tongue is saturated with grace, therefore I only speak gracious words. - I excel in speech with the right words in and out of season. - It doesn’t matter the challenge at a particular time, I speak right. - My tongue is soaked with wisdom. - Only gracious words proceed out of my mouth.- I think right and I speak graciously. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 536 - STOP SEEING IMPOSSIBILITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  STOP SEEING IMPOSSIBILITY“But Jesus looked at them and said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God; for with God all things are possible.” Mark 10:27 (NKJV) Whatever God is involved in, life comes out of it. The earth was without form and was void; yet the moment the Lord’s presence and Word went forth, light was generated. “In the beginning God (Elohim) created [by forming from nothing] the heavens and the earth. The earth was formless and void or a waste and emptiness, and darkness was upon the face of the deep [primeval ocean that covered the unformed earth]. The Spirit of God was moving (hovering, brooding) over the face of the waters. And God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light.” Genesis 1:1-3 (AMP). Nothing plus God is everything. Darkness plus God is light.
Impossible situations plus God is possibilities.
 By all standards of human intelligence, there was no way:– Israel could have passed through the Red Sea and defeated Pharoah with his army.– David could have defeated Goliath. Yet with God, he defeated Goliath.He said “You come to me carrying a sword and spear and javelin as your weapons, but I come armed with the name of the Eternal One, the Commander of heavenly armies, the True God of the armies of Israel, the One you have insulted” 1 Samuel 17:45 (Voice Translation )– there was no way Nehemiah could have built the walls of Jerusalem in the face of such fierce opposition.– there was no way the four Hebrew boys could have survived such burning furnace.Look at what Nicodemus said to Jesus; "This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him." John 3:2 (NKJV). One of the most impossible things in the entirety of the universe was for God to indwell man. The reality of salvation seems impossible. Yet Jesus, said WITH GOD ALL THINGS ARE POSSIBLE! If only you can see it, you will experience it. The thing is, most people are not conscious of the presence of the Lord in their lives. Others also don’t consciously allow God’s ability to find expression in their situation.
Stop having confidence in men, their systems and intelligence more than GOD.
 Have confidence in what GOD have said in His word. No matter the size of the situation maintain absolute confidence in the Word of God.  Listen, “God is not man, that he should lie, or a son of man, that he should change his mind. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not fulfill it?” Numbers 23:19 (NLT)
With God all things are possible. Stop seeing impossibility!
 Shalom!https://youtu.be/ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(2 Kings 3:18; Jeremiah 23:17; Matthew 19:26; Job 42:2; Luke 1:37) WE PRAY That we will be strengthened by God to see possibilities in all things even in hopeless situations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 13 - 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I believe that with GOD all things are possible. – I refuse to see impossibilities. – In all things and through all things, I believe in the GOD who calls forth things which don’t exist to appear as though they exist. – Nothing is strong enough to make me doubt GOD. – No challenge is bigger than me. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 537 - UNFEIGNED LOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  UNFEIGNED LOVE"A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another. By this, all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another." John 13:34-35 This commandment of Jesus is specifically for the people of His household.He didn’t give this commandment to the multitudes.  He gave this commandment during His final moments with His disciples before His death. The importance of loving one another is the testimony of our oneness to the world. God truly loves the world, however, it is His desire that we share His special love, with one another.
The only way we can reach out to the world is when we are one and love one another.
 “By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34 Jesus had to include the need for the oneness of the saints in His heartfelt prayer in John 17  “I pray that they will all be one, just as you and I are one—as you are in me, Father, and I am in you. And may they be in us so that the world will believe you sent me” John 17:21 (NLT).
Beloved, the need for all the saints to be one and to love one another is imperative.
 Love is an action and not just an utterance. (1 John 3:18). Jesus demonstrated His love of service to us, by how He washed the feet of His disciples. "If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet. For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you." (John 13:14-15) How are you serving your fellow brother in Christ? Paul the apostle, puts it this way:“But God clearly shows and proves His own love for us, by the fact that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” Romans 5:8 (Amplified Bible) Jesus’ death was God patiently showing and demonstrating His love to us. This wasn’t Apostle Paul trying to make it up. See what Jesus said, "This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you. Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you." John 15:12-14
Jesus demonstrated His greater love through His sacrificial service. We also ought to love one another through our sacrificial service.
 Apostle Paul admonished the brethren in Philippi with this ardent instruction: "If you’ve gotten anything at all out of following Christ, if his love has made any difference in your life, if being in a community of the Spirit means anything to you, if you have a heart, if you care – then do me a favor: Agree with each other, love each other, be deep-spirited friends. Don’t push your way to the front; don’t sweet-talk your way to the top. Put yourself aside, and help others get ahead. Don’t be obsessed with getting your own advantage. Forget yourselves long enough to lend a helping hand. Think of yourselves the way Christ Jesus thought of himself. He had equal status with God but didn’t think so much of himself that he had to cling to the advantages of that status no matter what. Not at all. When the time came, he set aside the privileges of deity and took on the status of a slave, became human! Having become human, he stayed human. It was an incredibly humbling process. He didn’t claim special privileges. Instead, he lived a selfless, obedient life and then died a selfless, obedient death – and the worst kind of death at that: a crucifixion. Because of that obedience, God lifted him high and honored him far beyond anyone or anything, ever", (Philippians 2:1-9, MSG) This is how you follow the example of Jesus; to love others is to serve them. You love others when you do things for them without expecting anything in return. You do things you may not like to do, and that will cost or inconvenience you. (NB: Not things that make you live contrary to God’s word).
There is no love without service. Jesus said He came to serve others:
 “For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve others and to give his life as a ransom for many.” Matthew 20:28 Beloved, we know what real love is because Jesus gave up his life for us. So we also ought to give up our lives for our brothers and sisters. (1 John 3:16) Hatred towards one another is not an option. You walk in darkness if you hate a brother or a sister. (1 John 2:9)
"The greatest among you shall be your servant". (Matthew 23:11).
 Have a blessed day. Let me know how this blessed you in the comment session.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(1 John 4:9-11; Philippians 2:17; 1 Corinthians 13) WE PRAYThat the Lord grants us more opportunities to demonstrate His sacrificial love towards the brethren as Christ Jesus loved us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 17 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make great sacrifices for others. - I refuse to walk in hatred. - Through me,  the brethren see the reality of the love of Christ.  - I go the extra mile to help the brethren.  - I am a great lover of the saints.  - I refuse to be selfish.  - I refuse to esteem myself above the brethren.  - I serve the brethren with all humility. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 538 - WHAT DO YOU SEE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency WHAT DO YOU SEE?“And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.” Joshua 6:2 (NKJV)To fulfill ministry and accomplish great things, may seem to be challenging. Others are sometimes discouraged by the magnitude of the task.God doesn’t just want you to move into action.Accomplishing great things for the Lord doesn’t just come by trying to do something.You must have the right vision if you want to accomplish your task or hit your target.
Your ability to do more begins with what you see and how you see what you see.
Oftentimes the Lord charges His people to see.This is because you cannot experience what you have not seen with your heart or the spirit of your mind.To take over a city or win a town for Jesus through the gospel, you must first SEE!You cannot transform lives and bless your school, institution, or workplace until you see with the spirit of your mind.You must see your healing testimony. You must see the growth of your business. You must see your new level of impact.Look at what God said to Joshua:“And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.” Joshua 6:2 (NKJV).This was a charge to Joshua to activate the power of his imagination.  
Your imagination influences your possession.
This was the same thing God said to Abraham and Moses:“I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession.” Genesis 13:15 (NLT).Oh, glory!Abraham’s possession was dependent on His vision. If Abraham had seen just a small portion, that was what he would have had. If Abraham had seen the whole world, that was what He was going to have.“See, I have set the land before you; go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—to give to them and their descendants after them.” Deuteronomy 1:8 (NKJV)
Beloved, what do you SEE?
Which results are you seeing now?These are not some words of encouragement. I am talking to you about a divine principle that works. You cannot accomplish anything beyond what you have SEEN.Jesus said, “…lift up your eyes, and see that the fields are white for harvest.” John 4:35
 Train your mind to see the right results.
When you begin to see images you don’t want, shift your mind from them and redirect your imagination to the glorious pictures and results the Lord has deposited in your spirit.This is why you must study the Word and pray in tongues. When you pray, the Lord shows you visions. He unveils to your heart great and mighty things (Jeremiah 33:3)Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:10-12; Isaiah 28:16; Joshua 8:1; Deut. 1:6-8) WE PRAYThat we will not be overwhelmed by the challenges that confront us but rather we will be strengthened with the grace to see the right results with our hearts at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Isaiah 21 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to see the challenges, I see possibilities. –  I see my new level. – I refuse to look away from what I have seen with my heart. – That which I have seen my hands will handle. – I keep my gaze on the right pictures in my heart. – I see a way out of that challenge (specify the challenge confronting you). – Through the study of the word of God and prayer, I train my mind to see the right results. – I refuse to see failure and defeat, I see possibilities. Oh Hallelujah!!  Gloreeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 539 - GOD GIVES GRACE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 15th July, 2024 GOD GIVES GRACE 1"But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” James 4:6 (Berean Standard Bible)God doesn't just give things. God first gives Himself and supplies His grace to you.
Most people have not yet understood God's operational system.
They sometimes feel disappointed and assume God doesn't answer their prayers.When they pray to God for money, they even expect money to rain down from Heaven on them. They want to miraculously find a bag of money falling from the sky on their way.
When you pray to God for a house, He will not literally command a house to emerge from the land.
Some people think whenever they ask God for things, they must literally see the things presented to them as the "manna" fell from Heaven and the Lord blew quail into the Israelite's camp.Such experiences don't necessarily produce faith or a strong belief in God. Strong faith is rooted in your understanding of who God is and not just His acts.Seeing the acts of God is great, however, understanding God's character is exceedingly glorious.
Understanding God's character or His ways establishes you and gives you the right posture for living.
God doesn't want you just to experience miracles, He wants you to understand the machinery or system behind the miracles. He wants you to master the intelligence and ability to make you live in the miraculous.God replicates His works through systems. When you lay hold on those systems, you can always reproduce and multiply a miracle.
This was the difference between Moses and the Israelites. The Israelites saw the great deeds of God and still doubted God.
"He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel" Psalm 103:7 (NASB)The Israelites didn't know that God was showing them His deeds so that He would usher them into faith. And the thing is, when one steps into faith, the person receives GRACE.God shows you what He can do so that you will seek to understand His person and submit to Him. When you submit or humble yourself to the Lord He imparts you with His grace.
As a believer in Christ, God doesn't want you to pursue things, He wants to be at the centre of your thoughts so that He will impart you with His grace.
It doesn't matter the target, the projects, assignments or tasks you must undertake, God will first give you grace.Whatever you attract is a result of the grace you carry.
Things respond to grace and not necessarily your needs.
Many needy people have not experienced abundant supply. There are times when believers think some people receive more help than others. The secret is not the help which gravitates towards men, the secret is the level of grace these men have.
This is what God wants to do for you every day; He wants to give you more grace at every given time.
Does it look like you are overwhelmed by a task and you don't have what it takes to accomplish an assignment?Refuse to worry and to look down on yourself. Refuse to accept that it cannot be done.
Make a decision to increase in Grace. Turn to God for more grace!
Beloved, GOD GIVES GRACE!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 4:16; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19; Psalm 18:32-33) WE PRAY We pray that we shall increase in the conviction, consciousness and confidence of the Lord's ability within us for greater accomplishments. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 25 - 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the consciousness of the grace of God. – God is at the centre of my thoughts therefore I don't pursue things. – I receive more grace today. – I increase in grace today. – I refuse to accept that the assignment given to me cannot be done, I turn to God for more grace to do.  Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 540 - GOD GIVES GRACE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 16th July, 2024 GOD GIVES GRACE 2"But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” James 4:6 (Berean Standard Bible)The Grace of God is mostly known as unmerited favor. It is the quality of God or a divine inclination by which He dispenses His gift of eternal life. It is the gift of God unto salvation."For everyone has sinned; we all fall short of God’s glorious standard. Yet God, in His grace, freely makes us right in his sight. He did this through Christ Jesus when he freed us from the penalty for our sins." Romans 3:23-24 (NLT)As a born again, you are saved by the grace of God through faith (Ephesians 2:8).
You are saved not because you worked for it. You are saved because the Grace of God is an undeserving favor.
However, this is not all there is concerning the grace of God.The Grace which God gives is also an inward ability or influence and power."And God is able to make every grace abound to you, so that in everything at every time having every sufficiency, you may have an abundance for every good deed" 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Legacy Standard Bible)The Grace of God mentioned in 2 Corinthians 9:8, is not the unmerited favor which just produces salvation, but a divine influence or ability which will cause you to have the capacity to accomplish every task.When you see someone consistently achieving great results in everything and at every time, you must recognize that there is sufficient abounding grace.
What makes people accomplish extraordinary tasks, is this dimension of grace.
By God's operational system, He imparts men with grace, and by that impartation of grace, they attract all that is needed to do great deeds. This grace is an influence or force of the Spirit within you, which enlarges your capacity for greater works.It is not by some sudden means or occurrence that people get things done but by grace.
The things you manifest are as a result of the influence and force of the Spirit working within you.
Paul said, "By the grace of God I am what I am..." (1 Corinthians 15:10).It doesn't matter how huge the target is, yours is to receive more and more grace to get it done.Glory to God.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 12:9; Hebrews 4:16; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19; Psalm 18:32-33) WE PRAY We pray that we shall receive grace for the target the Lord has set before us this day this week and this month. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 29 - 33 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take more grace to do more for the Lord today.- It doesn't matter the size of the assignment entrusted to me, by this dimension of grace I get it done.- I receive grace  to manifest.- I receive grace to do greater works.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 541 - GOD GIVES GRACE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 17th July, 2024 GOD GIVES GRACE 3"And God is able to make every grace abound to you, so that in everything at every time having every sufficiency, you may have an abundance for every good deed" 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Legacy Standard Bible)There are times you set targets, and desire to accomplish certain goals or feet; however, the more you attempt to work towards that goal or target, the more you feel limitation within. You truly have good plans and desires, but you are not able to carry out those plans. You don't have to be discouraged. You just need to increase in Grace.
Nothing works in God without the enabling ability of God.
The Grace which God gives is the inward ability, influence and power which makes you work towards your targets."For I know that nothing good dwells in me, that is, in my flesh. For I have the desire to do what is right, but not the ability to carry it out." Romans 7:18 (ESV)No matter the desire on your heart, without God's grace you are limited. The grace of God is God's ability which empowers you to carry out His desires in your heart.Don't just see the grace of God as God's means and supply of Salvation. The Grace of God is also the abundance of God's influence and ability in your inner man which fuels you to express the greatness and glory of His life.Nearly 2000 years after Paul's death we still celebrate the impact of his ministry, and are inspired by his relentless passion to preach the gospel of our Lord Jesus.This was because he took advantage of the supply of God's grace.
The Grace of God is all you need to do what God has called you to do. God's grace is not your last option. It is all you need to fulfill purpose.
Understand this, God's grace is not limited; His grace is immeasurable. The supply of God's grace to you is not a one time event. You cannot exhaust His grace. There is abundance of grace for every phase of your life journey. There is abundance of grace for every task.The Grace of God is not just definite, it is also infinite. Therefore the question you should be asking is not "how much of grace, has God made available for me?"The question to you rather is:HOW MUCH GRACE CAN YOU TAKE? " [and He did this] so that in the ages to come He might [clearly] show the immeasurable and unsurpassed riches of His grace in [His] kindness toward us in Christ Jesus [by providing for our redemption]." Ephesians 2:7 (Amplified Bible)Which means there is no assignment which is so huge that the supply of God's grace to get it done will not be enough.
God's grace is limitless!
He is able to make every grace abound to you so that you may always, under all circumstances, regardless of the challenge or task have complete sufficiency in everything and have an abundance for every good work.Beloved, you can accomplish great things by the immeasurable grace of God. Take more and more grace! Glory to GodDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 12:9; Hebrews 4:16; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19; Psalm 18:32-33) WE PRAY We pray that there shall be no task or circumstance where we shall not have grace abound towards us to produce the good works of God in excellence or exceptionally. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 34 - 37 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take more grace to do more for the Lord today.– It doesn’t matter the size of the assignment entrusted to me, by this dimension of grace I get it done.– I receive grace  to manifest.– I receive grace to do greater works.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 542 - GOD GIVES GRACE 4 - Take Grace by Faith
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 18th July, 2024 GOD GIVES GRACE 4 — Take Grace by Faith"And God is able to make every grace abound to you, so that in everything at every time having every sufficiency, you may have an abundance for every good deed" 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Legacy Standard Bible)
Grace is the ability and influence of God within your spirit, to carry out divine assignment.
"Through him a joy-producing grace cascaded into us, empowering us with the gift of apostleship, so that we can win people from every nation into a faithful commitment to Jesus, to bring honor to his name." Romans 1:5 (TPT) Paul the apostle unveils the secret to their impact all around the world. It was a joy producing grace cascaded into them and empowered them with the apostolic mandate of winning the nations to Christ.
God abundantly supplies His grace. Thus, the grace of God is immeasurable, infinite, unlimited and inexhaustible.
"[and He did this] so that in the ages to come He might [clearly] show the immeasurable and unsurpassed riches of His grace in [His] kindness toward us in Christ Jesus [by providing for our redemption]." Ephesians 2:7 (Amplified Bible) This Grace which the Lord supplies is super-abundant and overly sufficient for every good work. As I mentioned previously, it is not essentially about how much grace God has available for you. Rather, it is about
HOW MUCH GRACE YOU CAN TAKE!
There is more than enough grace available to be supplied to you. One may ask, how then do I enjoy super abundance of Grace? Whiles Grace is God’s ability supplied to you, faith is your ability to receive Grace. Thus, faith is the present possession of Grace.
YOU ENJOY THE SUPPLY OF GRACE BY FAITH!
Faith brings you into the enjoyment of Grace. "Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace..." Romans 4:16 (KJV)
Faith is as a hand which collects or receives and takes hold on the immeasurable supply of God's ability to carry out a great task.
Whiles Grace is God’s righteous right hand stretched to you, faith is your hand stretched to receive from God.- Faith is the confident trust in the unseen God and His immeasurable kindness and power.- Faith has the conviction, the consciousness and the confidence that God supplies Grace abundantly for greater works.- Faith has the conviction, consciousness and confidence that whatever God tells you to do He supplies you with the blessed ability to get it done.- Faith has absolute unbending believe that God makes all provision for His vision, therefore you can make claim.- Faith is the strong believe that God gives grace (which includes favor and earthly blessings), therefore, you can take much more grace.I know beyond every doubt what this teaching is doing to you. It is generating faith in your heart, that you will go on to take hold of grace for that assignment ahead of you. As you are reading this series, your Faith must be stirred to turn to God to receive more and more grace.
Faith doesn't doubt God’s supply. Faith instead rests on God's supply. Faith is God centered, Grace is God dispensed.
