Through faith you assimilate and appropriate the distribution of God's grace.Faith is the action of God in your heart, to manifest God's word through Grace.Beloved, you can accomplish great things by the immeasurable grace of God. Have the Faith that God has supplied you with abundance of grace (ability, favor and earthly blessings) to do what He has ordained you to do. Glory to God DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 12:9; Hebrews 4:16; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19; Psalm 18:32-33) WE PRAY We pray that we shall increase in faith and boldly take possession of the supply of grace (God's immeasurable ability, favor and earthly blessings) to do what God has instructed and inspired us to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 38 - 41 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the faith of God in me.  - I take hold of grace by faith. - No matter the assignment, I have abundance of grace to get the job done. - The Lord is my present help and strength. - I have divine provision for His vision committed to me. - I do much more by the abundance of Grace. Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 543 - GOD GIVES GRACE 5 -Remain Humble
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 19th July, 2024 GOD GIVES GRACE 5 — Remain Humble "But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” James 4:6 (Berean Standard Bible) We have looked at the reality that, God gives grace abundant. As part of the previous discussions we also noticed; The Grace of God is not only God's means of bringing us into Himself, however, Grace also is God supplying Himself as our inward ability and influence. It takes more and more grace to accomplish the Lord's assignment. Grace is immeasurable and unlimited. It is basically how much you can take that matters. While grace is God's ability supplied to you, IT TAKES FAITH TO RECEIVE GRACE. Faith brings you into the enjoyment of Grace. Faith is mostly associated with boldness. However, Faith is also a matter of being humble. It takes humility to acknowledge God. It takes humility to receive God's word and to act on it.
One of the things which causes limitation and creates resistance to progress in the believer's pursuit of purpose is PRIDE.
Pride is a limitation. A proud man is always resisted. Anytime you act with pride, what you are saying is you are good without God. To be proud towards God means you deny or reject God's resources. The proud don't esteem God's word and despise the wisdom of God. Such a stand makes you become one who is in opposition to God. Such a position makes you attract God's resistance. Without God, you can do nothing. Your boast must not be in yourself but in God's grace. Thus, to refuse to be humble or to submit to God is to do without God.
God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble. (James 4:6)
God doesn't resist the proud because He wants to be in control. This is how God resists the proud: "For though you are lofty and exalted, you stoop to embrace the lowly. Yet you keep your distance from those filled with pride." Psalm 138:6 (TPT). In as much as God loves everyone, He doesn't force His grace into places where His supply is not accepted. God doesn't automatically dispense Himself to people. The strength of God is given to those who acknowledge Him.
To be humble is to realize that by your own strength, you cannot prevail. It is in this state that faith in God finds pure expression.
Imagine attempting to jump from the ground floor to the 50th floor of a skyscraper without any aid. You need to submit yourself to know that you don't have enough capacity to get to that floor without aid. To climb to the highest floor of such a building you will need an elevator or a staircase. To deny the provisions made is to remain on the down floor. You cannot be lifted by your strength. Technically, it is not the elevator which has limited you. Your limitation is your refusal to accept that you need the elevator. Technically it is not God who resists the proud. It is his pride which serves as a resistance. "A man's pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honour." (Proverbs 29:23) Just in case you keep realizing you are not making progress or any great thing you attempt to do, you experience resistance, check your pride. Humble yourself before the Lord and He will exalt you. Be humble also towards those the Lord has set over you.
Through humility, Jesus obtained all dominion and authority over all things (Philippians 2:5-7).
God doesn't give authority to the proud. God gives authority to the humble. Through humility, you receive more and more grace. And the Lord elevates you to the highest peak of glory. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER( Isaiah 2:15-22; 1 Peter 5:5; Psalm 40:4; Luke 1:48; Exodus 18:11; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19) WE PRAY We pray that we shall exercise the wisdom to walk in humility and to acknowledge the Lord's supply unto us for greater works. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Isaiah 42 - 45 DECLARE THESE WORDS: — I submit to the Lord and His word. — I refuse to be proud. —  I acknowledge and boast in the ability of God. — My confidence is in God's supply and not in my own wisdom. — I don't reject God's grace and goodness towards me. — I esteem the strength of God supplied to me, above my own abilities. — I have absolute dependence on God and not my efforts.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 544 - GOD GIVES GRACE 6 — Take Grace through Prayer
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 20th July, 2024GOD GIVES GRACE 6 — Take Grace through Prayer"So now we come freely and boldly to where love is enthroned, to receive mercy’s kiss and discover the grace we urgently need to strengthen us in our time of weakness." Hebrews 4:16 (TPT)You will always need God in all situations, for any assignment He will give you.The assignments of the Lord will require more than your human intelligence, strength and resources.
The Heavenly mandate or vision will require Heavenly provision.
This is why God gives more Grace.To receive more and more of the grace which God supplies you must:1. Exercise faith. It takes faith to receive the Grace of our Lord Jesus.2. Be Humble. God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble. Until you submit to the Lord, you have not permitted His supply to flow to you.3. Draw near to God through Prayer.This is the third item I would like to bring to your attention.Before you conclude that we are already in God as believers in Christ and don't need to draw near to Him, take your time to glean from this perspective.Indeed, we have already been drawn into God through Christ, however, we can continue to journey deeper and deeper into God.
By Christ's finished work through His death and resurrection, all who were afar off are now brought near to God.
"But now [at this very moment] in Christ Jesus you who once were [so very] far away [from God] have been brought near by the blood of Christ." Ephesians 2:13 (Amplified Bible)This is glorious news.We are not strangers to God. We belong to God and are part of Him. Through the blood of Jesus, we have free access to God. Now we have fellowship with the Father. We are no longer as they who were of the Old Covenant, for through Christ's obedience, we have been drawn into God. We can confidently enjoy communion with the Lord without any sense of condemnation.
Irrespective of this access the believer has in God, it doesn't automatically translate into MORE AND MORE GRACE.
For example:Having access to a free restaurant doesn't mean you will be satisfied automatically. You can enter the restaurant, take your seat, gist with the Chief restaurant and still not be full.You must intentionally place your order, and then eat your meal before you will be satisfied.
The Lord has brought us into Himself, where grace is enthroned. Yet you must intentionally take grace.
This is why most believers in Christ still remain helpless and weak. They think being born again grants them automatic enjoyment of Grace. Being born again, gives you free access to grace, however, to enjoy the grace you must receive it.Prayer is a means of Grace.
Prayer is the confident enjoyment of your access to God, through communion and communication with God.
You have been drawn into God, however, until you draw near in prayer to take grace you will not receive more and more grace.The more you exercise confidence of faith through prayer, the more grace you receive.
Prayer is both the means of asking and the means of creating.
In time of need, what you must receive is more grace for that specific need.Take note of what the Psalmist said:"Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; listen to my plea for grace." Psalm 86:6 (ESV).See the verse 5 of this Psalm in the Passion Translation:"Lord, you are so good to me, so kind in every way and ready to forgive, for your grace-fountain keeps overflowing, drenching all your lovers who pray to you." Psalm 86:5 (TPT)Oh, glory to God.
The Grace of God shall drench, wet thoroughly, or soak and saturate those who pray.
When you seem to be limited in Grace, observe not only your faith and humility. Observe your consistency in prayer.
Little prayer, little grace; more prayer, more grace
It is through prayer you cast all your cares to the Lord for He cares for you (1 Peter 5:7).And to even be consistent in prayer is the evidence of humility. When God's people humble themselves they pray to Him (2 Chronicles 7:14)."You do not have because you do not ask God." (James 4:2) Beloved stay up long in prayer!Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 7:7,11;  Habakkuk 3:19; Philippians 4:13,19; Psalm 84:11; Psalm 34:9-10) WE PRAY We pray that:1. We shall increase in desire to pray and be obedient to the prompting of the Holy Spirit to pray consistently irrespective of the hindrances.2. The Lord shall send us a great abundance of grace (the favor, and all resources needed) to achieve His plans and purpose in our generation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 46 - 50 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I submit to the Lord in prayer.— I am consistent in prayer—  I take more and more grace through prayer.— MORE grace is supplied to me as I pray.— I have the discipline to pray consistently— I esteem the place of prayer in my daily life. Oh glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 545 - GOD GIVES GRACE 7 - Multiply Grace 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 21st July, 2024GOD GIVES GRACE 7 — Multiply Grace 1"May God give you more and more grace and peace as you grow in your knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord." 2 Peter 1:2 (NLT) The Grace of God brings rest and acceleration to you. The more you enjoy and walk in an abundant supply of grace, the more rest you enjoy.
The Lord makes His burdens light and His yoke easy through His supply of grace. Anything the Lord has put in our hearts to do can be carried out through grace.
As I have mentioned in the previous episode, you receive more grace through: 1. Faith2. Your humility of heart3. Prayer Another core item which causes you to enjoy more and more grace is YOUR GROWTH IN THE KNOWLEDGE OF GOD AND OF JESUS OUR LORD.
The more you grow in the knowledge of God and of our Lord Jesus, the more superabundance of grace gravitates towards you.
As you can see in the opening verse: "May God give you more and more grace and peace as you grow in your knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord." Most translations used the phrase: "Grace and peace be MULTIPLIED..." Others also put it this way: "Grace and peace be yours in ABUNDANCE..." Or "Grace and peace be lavished on you..." All translations connect such lavish, multiplication or abundance of grace to the Knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
To have more and more grace simply means grace is lavishly multiplied in abundance to you.
And this is in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord. You cannot have less flow of grace when you have the true intimate knowledge of God and of Jesus. The knowledge of God in you is the transfusion of the light of God in your heart and the transformation of your mind. The knowledge of Jesus brings a mind shift and establishes you in the consciousness and the realm of endless possibilities.
The knowledge of Jesus exposes you to the endless resources of God at your disposal.
Take note: Grace is the impartation of God's blessings which provokes favor and magnetizes resources. The measure of grace you carry determines the resources which gravitate to you and the resources which you can utilize. When you got born again you were ushered into the realm of possibilities. However, your ignorance of this realm means you cannot take advantage of the possibilities of this glorious realm.
Grace is not only what God has given you, it is also the inward influence, ability and capacity to use what God has given to you.
How can you use what you don't know? This is where the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord becomes essential. The moment you come into this perfect knowledge you can recognize and understand how to enjoy all that God has given you in Christ.
Don't underestimate the need to increase in knowledge.
Have faith in God's supply.Remain Humble.Be consistent in prayer.Grow in the knowledge of God and of our Lord Jesus. These will cause you to experience the immeasurable supply of God's grace. Shalom! DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:2-3; Philippians 3:8; 1 Peter 1:2; 2 Peter 3:18) WE PRAY We pray that the eyes of our understanding will be enlightened so that we shall have the accurate, precise and perfect knowledge of God in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Isaiah 51 - 53 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I have access to the accurate and perfect knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord. — I grow in the knowledge of GOD in Christ. — I shall not be ignorant — Attract abundance of grace through the knowledge of Christ — I daily enjoy the increase or multiplication of grace in all I do. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 546 - GOD GIVES GRACE 8 — Multiply Grace 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 22nd July, 2024 GOD GIVES GRACE 8 — Multiply Grace 2"May God give you more and more grace and peace as you grow in your knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord." 2 Peter 1:2 (NLT)For every level you get to, you need to increase in grace.There are things you cannot do without greater grace. The greater the assignment, the greater the grace you need.As part of the things I mentioned earlier, you must also grow in the knowledge of God and our Lord Jesus.
The more you grow in the knowledge of God and of our Lord Jesus, the more superabundance of grace gravitates towards you.
To grow in knowledge in this context is not just to come into awareness of God.It is not to have your assumption of God or your interpretation of God based on your personal experiences.The word translated knowledge in 2 Peter 1:2 is EPIGNOSIS (pronounced e-pē’-gnō-sēs). It is a Greek word which basically means precise and correct knowledge.Apostle Peter used it approximately four times in his epistles. Generally, you will find it used in the New Testament twenty times; Paul the Apostle also used it fifteen times and you will find it used once in Hebrews.This means not every word translated as "knowledge" in the New Testament has the same meaning as Epignosis.Here are a few other Greek words:Eido (to know), to know by a perception of sight.Ginosko, (to know),  to acquire information through some sense perception (hearing).It is also to know by observation.Gnosis (knowledge), is an intellectual possession or grasp of information of what is known. It is the comprehension of facts.Epiginosko (to know), which means to recognize something to be what it is to be, to understand, to know fully, to ascertain or to find out with certainty.  It is more than experience gained through sense perception. It is intensification of ginosko. It is to have a higher or spiritual knowledge.
Epignosis is also an intensified form of gnosis. It is an advanced and full knowledge.
It is not just abstract, intellectual or head knowledge that occurs. It is more transcendent than even facts about Him.Epígnosis refers to the exact, complete, thorough, accurate, experiential knowledge of God. God is Spirit, thus, to have experiential knowledge of Him, you must be or share in His essence. This makes this experiential knowledge a reality which is above facts gained through experiments. It is a reality possessed through intimate relationships.Until you share in (or have) His life you can't have the epignosis of God and of Jesus.
Your knowledge of God and of Jesus must be built on the divine life you have received.
This is more than the knowledge which brings you to Salvation. This is the knowledge you possess in the newness of life. It is not a hope of what you will experience. It is not what you have in anticipation before you are born again. It is what you have handled as you are born again.For example, you may believe the truth concerning Jesus that He has made salvation available for you. But that is not the same dimension as receiving and enjoying the reality that His life is in you.
It is not experimental, this knowledge is hewn out of your participation in Him.
It is this knowledge that Apostle Peter is referring to in 2 Peter 1:2.This knowledge is not just an exposure of resources or intellectual acquaintance but spiritual possession and participation of the divine resources.Epignosis brings you to a place where you are not only aware of who God is and what He has done; but rather makes you share in His life and nature.
Every revelation light you receive, you must demonstrate.
By this, you become one with the truth of God in Christ.So, when you come to the knowledge (epignosis) of God's love, you have come into oneness with that truth. You will not just be walking about with the mental assertion that God is Love. This knowledge (epignosis) makes you demonstrate or walk in the love of God. As you grow in this kind of knowledge, you enjoy a continuous supply of the spiritual energy or ability that will cause you to demonstrate God's quality.Grace is not multiplied when you are only aware or when you have gone to Bible studies and have heard a certain truth.
Grace is multiplied when you take time to meditate on the reality of the revelation of Jesus, and it drenches or soaks you.
Every revelation of Jesus is pregnant with grace.Jesus is full of grace and reality. (John 1:14).No wonder Paul the apostle said to the elders in Ephesians: "And so now, I entrust you into God's hands and the message of His grace, which is all that you need to become strong. All of God's blessings are imparted through the message of His grace, which He provides as the spiritual inheritance given to all of his holy ones." Acts 20:32 (TPT).The revelation of Jesus which is the message of grace is inherently full of God's grace, ability and influence of the Holy Spirit.
When the message soaks you, through meditation, it becomes your "epignosis" and it will produce the ability (of grace) to live that reality.
Grow in the accurate knowledge of God which in Christ, through continuous meditation on the word of His grace.Don't just walk in the awareness or intellectual perception of the Word; be drenched or participate or become one with the reality of Jesus.SelahDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:2-3; Philippians 3:8; 1 Peter 1:2; 2 Peter 3:18) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall be drenched in the reality of God which is in Christ Jesus, so that we will fully have possession of the knowledge (epignosis) of His word and become demonstrators of divine truth. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 54 - 57 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I have access to the accurate and perfect knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.— I grow in the knowledge of GOD in Christ.—  I have the possession of the revelation of Jesus.— Attract an abundance of grace through the knowledge of Christ— I daily enjoy the increase or multiplication of grace in all I do. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 547 - DON'T LIMIT GOD'S ABILITY IN YOU 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 23rd July, 2024 DON'T LIMIT GOD'S ABILITY IN YOU 1"But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do."Numbers 11:23 (ERV)The greatest limitation of God's power and grace is unbelief.
Whatever God will do will first be by His word. When you doubt God's word, His power and grace won't find expression.
We know God's grace is immeasurable, unlimited and infinite. You can manifest an abundance of God's grace and ability as much as you can exercise faith. Faith acts according to the immeasurable ability of God's power and grace.Faith acts on what God has said.There are things the Lord has determined to do in your life and through you, yet you can limit the extent God will work His word through unbelief.Though God is all-powerful, He doesn't force the manifestation of His power in the affairs of men (no matter how much he loves to help them). Therefore the extent to which you can see the flow of God's power is dependent on your Faith in His Word.Unbelief, though it has a spiritual root, it finds expression in your mind. Your mind can see or imagine what you believe. 
Until your mind can see or imagine the manifestation of what God has said, the hands cannot handle it.
While the Israelites were in the wilderness they incontinently cried out to God for meat. That was probably to either mock God, prove their doubt or establish their argument that being in Egypt was better than leaving Egypt (Psalm 78:18).God accepted the challenge and asked Moses to tell them He would send them meat in the wilderness.Moses for a moment couldn't imagine how it was going to be possible for God to supply the Israelites with meat. He even gave a logical concern about how impossible it was. See what Moses said to God:"Moses said, “There are 600,000 soldiers here, and you say, ‘I will give them enough meat to eat for a whole month!’ If we were to kill all the sheep and cattle, that would still not be enough to feed this many people for a month. And if we caught all the fish in the sea, it would not be enough for them!”Numbers 11:21-22 (ERV)By human wisdom, Moses was right and had his facts correctly stated. Moses by human wisdom made more sense in his assertion.However, "God's nonsense is wiser than human wisdom, and God's weakness is stronger than human strength." (1 Corinthians 1:25 - ISV)The Amplified Bible gives further clarity:"This is because the foolishness of God [is not foolishness at all and] is wiser than men [far beyond human comprehension], and the weakness of God is stronger than men [far beyond the limits of human effort]." 1 Corinthians 1:25.
The limit or boundary of man's highest strength is the beginning of God's strength.
You don't use your limitations to define God. God's capacity transcends man's wisest calculations.God's priceless response to Moses is all you need to hear or read today:"But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.” Numbers 11:23 (ERV)Beloved what has God said to you?Don't doubt Him.
Don't limit the workings of His power in your life through unbelief.
Sometimes when you look at the money in your hand and all the savings or investments you have made or going to make for the next ten (10) years, you will still not have enough for the task ahead. But cheer up!The supply of the Lord is not dependent on your bank balance. The supply of the Loed is according to His own riches and grace. Oh, glory to God.That project is possible if only you can trust and obey the Lord's word.
Nothing is impossible with God. Stop doubting Him. Stop acting according to your strength.
Take a hold of faith and stand in God. The time when it seems impossible is the time you must rather increase in boldness. Don't turn back! Don't run from the battle. Don't drop your weapons. Faith has no reverse gear. March forward and don't settle for less.You can get the job done.
Have and maintain your strong confidence in the power of God's Word, that He will do what He says He will do.
Don't allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week.The grace of God is sufficient for you.Don't give room to any limitation in your mind.
You can have exceptional results as you exercise boldness in the Lord.
HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Genesis 18:14; Psalm 78:41; Numbers 23:19; Daniel 6:16-23) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall not faint, but we shall remain resolute and continue to trust in the limitless immeasurable ability of God and His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 58 - 61 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I don't define God's capacity by my limitations— I don't reduce God's grace to my human calculation.—  I have confidence in God's limitless supply.— I believe without any iota of doubt, that God will always do what He says He will do.—  I don't limit God's power in my thoughts and imagination. I have strong faith in seeing the mighty workings of God in all things. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 548 - DON'T LIMIT GOD'S ABILITY IN YOU 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 24th July, 2024 DON'T LIMIT GOD'S ABILITY IN YOU 2"But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do." Numbers 11:23 (ERV)The limitation of your mind is determined by your understanding or exposure. Your imagination cannot be expanded beyond what you see.
You can conceive the unimaginable in your mind according to the insights you have had.
For example, the car toys of yesterday are now on today's streets and some are in the showrooms to be sold.The first car which was designed, contributed to the imagination of the designer of today's Rolls-Royce. The examples of yesterday are for our learning today.This is what the Bible does for your faith. The stories you read in the scriptures are not mere historical accounts. They are to expose your heart to things you have not imagined and to dispense faith into you.It is to your own disadvantage when you don't read and study the Bible. The things written in the scriptures are for your learning."For whatever was written in earlier times was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope and overflow with confidence in His promises." Romans 15:4 (Amplified Bible)
You cannot access the riches of God's wisdom when you don't give yourself to personal Bible study.
The absence of personal Bible study will make you live by fantasies.The faith of some people doesn't yield results because they are not built on the understanding of God through His word. They build their faith on fantasies and assumptions.The reading and studying of the word of God brings you into proper understanding. When you study the word of God, you will not only find examples of faith but will have a proper contextual and background understanding of how that example of faith was exuded.The study of the word gives you a personal grasp of the thoughts of God. This is why through the  With , you are given DIG DEEPER scriptures and also a ONE-YEAR BIBLE READING PLAN.No matter how you can imagine a technology, you must as well understand the physics to make it work.The study of the word of God doesn't only expose you to what God can do but how to position yourself to rightly experience the effectual workings of God through His word.
When you don't know God through His word, you may easily doubt Him and His word. God does nothing outside His word.
When you take God's word and act on it, you partner with God in faith to see the manifestation of His word in your life.The manifestation of God's word in your life is according to your faith in Him. Your faith in God is your partnership and agreement with the Word.All those who limited God's power did not partner with God in faith. They did not exercise confidence in God. Your partnership with God is a partnership unto unlimited living.
You must stand strong in agreement with God that His word is true and will not fail, no matter the challenge.
Daniel the Prophet, found himself in a situation where he should be broken, discouraged and afraid. But he chose to remain confident in God. He chose to stand in partnership with God's word; that the Lord is his protection and defence.He was accused of breaking a law and was thrown into a lions' den. The king's confidence was that the God of Daniel would bring deliverance to Daniel (see Daniel 6:16-22).However, the last sentence in verse 23 (of Daniel chapter 6) caught my attention:"Then the king was exceedingly glad and commanded that Daniel be taken up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him because he had trusted in his God"Did you see that?Daniel the Prophet was not delivered because the king sent soldiers to defend him. No kind of harm was found on him because HE HAD TRUSTED IN HIS GOD.That trust in God was Prophet Daniel's secret.The moment you stop trusting the Lord, you limit the supply of His power. And there is no expiration for your trust in God. You must trust the Lord at all times, in all things and irrespective of the situation.
No matter how little or how big the matter is, trust the Lord.
The Lord will always deliver, protect, defend, preserve, provide, and prosper you.Refuse to limit His ability in you.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUUw65cgGRgDIG DEEPER(Genesis 18:14; Psalm 78:41; Numbers 23:19; Daniel 6:16-23) WE PRAY We pray that today and this week we shall see and receive glorious testimonies of impact according to the limitless ability of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Isaiah 62 - 66 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I don't define God's capacity by my limitations— I don't reduce God's grace to my human calculation.—  I have confidence in God's limitless supply.— I believe without any iota of doubt, that God will always do what He says He will do.—  I don't limit God's power in my thoughts and imagination. I have strong faith in seeing the mighty workings of God in all things. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 549 - GOD'S LOVE NEVER FAILS AND NEVER RUNS OUT 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 25th July, 2024 GOD'S LOVE NEVER FAILS AND NEVER RUNS OUT 1"Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails. Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails. Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails." Psalm 136:1-3 (CEV)The immeasurable and unending flow of God's grace supplied to you is intrinsically by His lovingkindness.The lovingkindness of the Lord is what was referred to as the mercies of God in the Old Testament portion of the Bible.
God's mercies never run out. His love never runs out.
Psalm 136 is one of the most special Psalms. It is believed to have been written by David the King. After the Ark of the Covenant was brought back to Jerusalem, the King appointed worship leaders to lead the congregation in praise. They sang this Psalm, for The Lord's never ending love (1 Chronicles 16:41).King Solomon also sang the Psalm when the temple was dedicated (2 Chronicles 7:3). The same with Jehoshaphat the King of Judah, he made the musicians lead the soldiers, as they were going to war. And they kept singing this Psalm:"Give thanks to the LORD, for his love endures forever.” (2 Chronicles 20:21).There is something about setting your heart on the lovingkindness of the Lord and knowing that His love is everlasting.
You will not envy, and you will not feel disappointed because the knowledge of His unfailing love, will make you exercise absolute trust in Him.
Moses knew the love of God. He knew that God's lovingkindness will never allow His people to be drowned. This is the secret to having a strong faith or complete trust in the Lord. When God said to him, "Moses, tell the people to move forward", He trusted the word of the Lord because God's love never fails.There is nothing powerful enough to quench the love of God.
You cannot spend off His love for you. There is much more of God's love for you that it cannot go bankrupt.
Look at what God has said, concerning His love for His people:"Long ago the LORD said to Israel: “I have loved you, my people, with an everlasting love. With unfailing love I have drawn you to myself." Jeremiah  31:3 (NLT).God has never changed. He has loved you with great love. It is by His love you got saved. By this same love, He shall forever keep you from falling. Only trust in His love for you.Read Jeremiah 31:3 from the Message Translation:"God told them, “I’ve never quit loving you and never will. Expect love, love, and more love!"Oh, glory!Do you know something?
You cannot exhaust God's love for you.
You can expect more and more of His love for you.Let this be your meditation today.God loves me more!Be like King Jehoshaphat, go to war with confidence in God's unfailing love. Don't doubt His love for you.
Take those steps the Lord is asking you to take. Trust His love for you.
You can commit your future to God because His lovingkindness endures forever!You can trust the Lord daily because His lovingkindness endures forever.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Hosea 11:4; Deuteronomy 7:8) WE PRAY We pray that we may understand and continuously live on the love of God in Christ which surpasses every human understanding. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 1 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I grow in the understanding of the Love of God— I live in the confidence of the love of God.—  I step out every day knowing that God's lovingkindness abounds towards me— I walk in the consciousness of the unlimited and inexhaustible flow of God's love in my life and all ai do. Thank you, Father for your love![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 550 - GOD'S LOVE NEVER FAILS AND NEVER RUNS OUT 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 26th July, 2024 GOD'S LOVE NEVER FAILS AND NEVER RUNS OUT 2"Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails. Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails. Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails." Psalm 136:1-3 (CEV)You cannot live insecure when you understand God's love for you.Everything God has done for you is first according to his love. His love is unconditional, it is not dependent on what you do. Your faith only helps you position yourself to enjoy the unlimited flow of His love.This is it, no matter how you are loved, you must receive that love to experience its full manifestation.
No matter how God loves you unconditionally, His love wouldn't have great transformational impact on you when you don't receive it.
God's lovingkindness enforces the wielding of His power. Just as I mentioned yesterday, Jehoshaphat went to war with the army of Judah, led by the musicians. And all they kept declaring through singing was that "His love endures forever!".No storm, no limitation, and no evil can withstand the love of God. And that is the light Psalm 136 brings to us.The chapter outlines some examples of things we enjoy because of His love. The Psalmist used God's dealings with Israel as the case study."Praise the Lord! He is good.God's love never fails.Praise the God of all gods.God's love never fails.Praise the Lord of lords.God's love never fails." Verses 1-3 provides description of who God is, His authority and the Supremacy of his love above all other gods and lords.These verses are to establish the incomparable status of God and the lifeless gods. As His love never fails and endures forever, the gods have no capacity to love at all.Which means it makes zero sense to be of God and still have confidence in other gods.From the subsequent verses ( 4 — 26) we see the mighty workings of His love."Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails." (verse 4)Did you notice the first two words in this verse? ONLY GOD...You cannot find mighty or great miracles else where. It is ONLY God who does great miracles. And it is according to His steadfast love which cannot fail.Now the Psalmist zooms in on the detailed examples of God's creative or mighty workings. Psalm 136 reveals that God's creative work was not only by His wisdom. It was by the partnership of His wisdom and unfailing love.
The goal is for you to see that, God's steadfast and unfailing love cannot be separated. All of  God's essential qualities find expression through His love.
"With wisdom He made the sky. God's love never fails. The Lord stretched the earthover the ocean. God's love never fails. He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails. He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails. He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails." (Verses 5 - 9)No other god has the capacity to function in the wisdom which God exudes in His creation. God's steadfast and unfailing love is in the center of His creative power.The steadfast love of God doesn't only partner with God's wisdom to demonstrate His creative power. The steadfast love of God also partners with God's power to preserve, protect or defend His people (those who receive His love). See the verses 10 – 24:"God struck down the first-bornin every Egyptian family. God's love never fails. He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails. God used his great strength and his powerful arm.God's love never fails. He split the Red Sea[b] apart. God's love never fails. The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea.God's love never fails. He destroyed the Egyptian kingand his army there. God's love never fails. The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails. Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails. And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails. One of them was Sihon,king of the Amorites. God's love never fails. Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails. God took away their land. God's love never fails. He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails. God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails. He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails."There are some who assume God's love is defenseless. That is never true. God can go any extent by His righteousness to preserve His people against wickedness."He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails." (Verse 25)
God's unfailing and steadfast love partners with God's wisdom to create. It partners with God's power to preserve, protect and also to provide.
"Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails." (Verse 26).When you acknowledge and focus on God's unfailing and steadfast love of God, your heart will be full of praise. His unconditional love remains steadfast on earth, in heaven and in all eternity.God's steadfast and unfailing love is proclaimed twenty-six (26) times in Psalm 136.The consistent repetition of "God's love never fails", works the truth deeply into our hearts and makes it our conviction, consciousness and confidence.When you make the testimony of God's steadfast love your meditation, it will always echo in your heart when there is a storm or any form of uproar or challenge around your life.
Beloved let this be woven in your heart that in all things at all times, GOD'S LOVE NEVER FAILS!
He satisfies you with His love each morning.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Hosea 11:4; Deuteronomy 7:8;   Psalm 36:7; Psalm 90:14; Lamentation 3:22; 1 John 4:16; Hosea 14:4; Psalm 103:8) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall be established in God's unfailing love and we shall walk in the confidence that God's love shall never fail no matter the challenge. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 5 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I enjoy God's love every morning.— I grow in the understanding of the Love of God— I live in the confidence of the love of God .—  I step out every day knowing that God's lovingkindness abounds towards me— I walk in the consciousness of the unlimited and inexhaustible flow of God's love in my life and all ai do. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 551 - THE LORD KNOWS YOU PERSONALLY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE LORD KNOWS YOU PERSONALLY"To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out"  John 10:3-5 (NKJV)Have you ever walked into a new community and suddenly met someone you didn't recognize, calling you by your own name?
How was the feeling?
You will likely be surprised or feel accepted.You step into a new beautiful office with many respected people seated and some standing around. Then the boss walks in, calls you by name and asks you to follow him.You can tell that special feeling, right?Look, currently, there are more than 8 billion people on Earth. There are innumerable company of angels and many more spirits of just men. Each of these people has their own name.Of all these multitudinous people, the Lord walks to you and calls you by name. The Lord knows you personally and intimately.In ancient times, names were not given to people by impulse. Names were given to people according to their destiny or how they were destined to achieve. Thus, to know someone's name is to understand the person's mandate.
God knows your name; He knows you personally and your unique identity. You are not just a number amid the multitudes.
When the Lord comes to His sheepfold, He calls each of His own sheep by name (John 10:3).On several occasions, the LORD GOD called people by name. He also gives names to people or changes their names to suit the destiny He has foreordained for them. Interestingly, you will find other instances where the Lord did not just call the names of the people but called their names twice.
That is an affirmation of the reality that, He doesn't call you by chance. It is based on your personal knowledge.
On his way to Damascus,  our Lord Jesus, called Saul twice. He didn't just call Saul by his name, he also spoke in his dialect. "And when we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew dialect, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads." Acts 26:14 (NASB). See also Acts 9:4.The Lord also called Abraham by name (Genesis 22:11-13), Jacob (Genesis 46:1-4); Moses (Exodus 3:1-10); Samuel (1 Samuel 3:1-10) Martha (Luke 10:38-42) and many others.
Irrespective of what you think of yourself or your history, the Lord knows you by name precious one. You matter to Him and He values you.
"But now thus says the Lord, he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: “Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine." Isaiah 43:1 (ESV)The Lord has engraved you in the palm of His hand. And takes delight in your personal matters. You are not ordinary.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 49:1; Isaiah 41:9;  Genesis 17:5; Isaiah 43:1-2) WE PRAY Thank you Lord for the privilege to be known and valued by you. Thank you for placing your identity on me and establishing a personal relationship with me. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Jeremiah 9 - 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am known and valued by the Lord.- I am not ordinary.- I matter to the Lord.- The Lord takes delight in my matters.- I walk daily in the consciousness of this blessed reality.Thank you Lord Jesus!Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 552 - EXERCISE THE AUDACITY OF FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency EXERCISE THE AUDACITY OF FAITH"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go" Joshua 1:9 (NKJV) Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith.It is by faith we live and walk with God.Faith is our reality. The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them.Anything that has to bring glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith). Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said. It is knowing without any title of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do.
Faith is audacious in its dealing.
When you act in faith courage is seen. This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life.And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness. Serving others is greatness, however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation.A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss. Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father’s house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh.He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites but felt enervated. Maybe you are reading this and feel you don’t have what it takes to do great things.When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community you can’t do anything great for the Lord.
Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!!
God specializes in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations. That is God. He will always use what seems depleted to reveal His glory.He used a young man who was the least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory to Israel. He made mighty men out of men who were distressed, indebted, and discontented (1 Samuel 22:2). Why must God use young 17-year-old David, with no military experience to defeat Goliath with just a sling and stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53)? To feed five thousand people, He used a little boy's lunch pack of five loaves of bread and two fishes. This is audacity!!!God doesn’t choose the easy paths, He creates greatness out of what seems impossible.
To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord.
"Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus."Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain a consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward. You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room. You will look for places to show forth His glory and power.Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you.
Until you take a step to do something great you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord.
God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary!Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAYLord, I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Jeremiah 13 - 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work. – I am strong and courageous. – I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary. – I live above this world. – I do the unimaginable. – I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me. – I am audacious. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 553 - SUBMIT TO HIS WILL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency SUBMIT TO HIS WILL“Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.” Luke 22:42 (Berean Standard Bible). Every inventor has an intention for his or her invention. Nobody creates or invents a product without a purpose. The inventor programs his or her invention to function according to the intended purpose. For example, different types of vehicles help us facilitate various daily tasks. Imagine using four to six-wheelers for water transportation. For water transportation, we use boats and vessels unless there is an improvement in the programming of wheelers. God is the creator of the universe. He made man and designed Him for the good pleasure of His will. (Genesis 1:1; 27) The difference between man and all other created things is the components which make man.
One crucial item within man’s being that gives him a sense of independence is the WILL.
Man is not an outgrowth of an existing creature. Man is a grand designed work of the Creator. God was intentional about how He wanted man to be. God made man to be the crown of all His creation. He didn’t make man to be chained or locked up in a mechanical design and pattern of living. He gave man the ability to decide and to choose.  Of all of His creation, God said to Himself (at the Divine Council): “Then God said, “Let Us (Father, Son, Holy Spirit) make man in Our image, according to Our likeness [not physical, but a spiritual personality and moral likeness]; and let them have complete authority over the fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the cattle, and over the entire earth, and over everything that creeps and crawls on the earth.” Genesis 1:26 (AMP). For man to have the moral likeness of God, man needed to share in the ability or power to make a choice. This is the power of the Will of Man. God gave man a will that by that will, man can decide for himself how he wants his life to be lived. This reveals the kind of relationship God wanted to have with man. God didn’t want His relationship with man to be based on a chain-of-commands. He wanted to have a fellowship of love and life with man. This means man will not obey the commands and will of God mechanically but organically. Man has to choose to walk in the will of God or to walk in His own will. This makes the relationship God wants to have with man authentic and organic. It has to be an authentic interdependence.
God is love and doesn’t want to impose His will on any man. 
Ultimately, the essence of the universe and all creation is according to the good pleasure of God’s Will. Therefore, in as much as man has the power to function according to his own will and to make his own choices, His true fulfillment of life finds absolute expression in the GOOD PLEASURE OF GOD’S WILL.
God wants man to willingly accept to walk in His ultimate WILL.
Even when God became man (Jesus), He has to decide between His Will in time or His eternal WILL. And by the grand design of God’s eternal will, He has to become sin to terminate the nature and power of sin. (John 1:29; 2 Corinthians 5:21). This was going to separate Him from His eternal nature and reality for a moment. The question is: – Was God going to go by His will in time (not to yield to the burden of becoming sin and the momentary separation from His nature)? – Or is He going to yield to His eternal plan and will, which was established from the foundation of the earth? (See Acts 2:23; Revelation 13:8) Though God gave man the will to make his or her individual choices and decisions; in the heart of every man, God has woven the desire of His plan. He has put a longing for eternal fulfillment in every man’s heart.  “He has made everything beautiful and appropriate in its time. He has also planted eternity [a sense of divine purpose] in the human heart [a mysterious longing which nothing under the sun can satisfy, except God]—yet man cannot find out (comprehend, grasp) what God has done (His overall plan) from the beginning to the end.” Ecclesiastes 3:11 (AMP) So man also at every point, may have to choose between fulfilling their own desires and will or God’s eternal desire and will.
You have to decide whether the life you have will be lived according to your will or God’s Will.
You have to come to a point to say, YES I HAVE THE POWER TO CHOOSE WHAT I WANT, YET NOT MY WILL BUT THE WILL OF GOD. Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Matthew 26:39; Matthew 6:10; Psalm 40:8; John 4:34; John 5:30; Proverbs 19:20-22) WE PRAYThat in all things we will yield ourselves to walk in the ultimate WILL of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 16 - 19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I choose to walk in the will of God everyday.  – I refuse to yield to my will. – Through prayer and the study of the word, I am strengthened to walk in the ultimate Will of God for my life. – I walk in agreement with God in all things. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 554 - THE GIVING-GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency THE GIVING-GRACE ”But just as you excel in everything, [and lead the way] in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in genuine concern, and in your love for us, see that you excel in this gracious work [of giving] also" 2 Corinthians 8:7 (Amplified Bible) As a saint in Christ, you are made a steward of God. Your living is not unto yourself, but Christ.
Whatever you do, do as unto the Lord’s glory.
And there is nothing God tells you to do without supplying you with grace. He makes His grace available for you, yours is to take hold of grace and increase in it.
There is nothing done in the Kingdom without the supply of God’s grace.
One may have a lot of resources at his or her disposal and will not be a cheerful bountiful giver.It takes grace to be a giver!! It is one thing to know that whatever you have to give is from God, and it’s another thing to have the grace to give big. Therefore, Paul, the apostle speaking to the Church in Corinth mentioned that they should excel or increase in the giving-grace as well. Read the opening verse above again.I hope you just did that, right?If not please go up to read again. You see, in as much as the Church in Corinth:– excelled in the grace to exercise and lead in faith– excelled in utterance or speech.– excelled in knowledge– excelled in genuine passion– excelled in love for the apostles and even in every giftHe admonished them to excel in the GIVING-GRACE. (2 Corinthians 8:7).This means the brethren in Corinth didn’t lack grace for the various items mentioned, yet they did not excel in the grace to be great givers. And for the apostle to get them to excel in this grace he has to teach them. We grow in grace through the knowledge of our Lord Jesus (2 Peter 1:2).  This knowledge is not just awareness, it is the acknowledgement and oneness into reality through the participation of that reality.This means as you acknowledge the wisdom of God in Christ concerning giving and you become a doer of this knowledge, you increase in the giving-grace.
You don’t excel in the giving grace by “wishing to give”. You increase in this grace by giving consistently with joy. 
And as you continue to give, you stretch your faith to give beyond your ability. That is how you increase your capacity of grace.Look at the testimony of the Churches in Macedonia: ”Beloved ones, we must tell you about the grace God poured out upon the churches of Macedonia. For even during a season of severe difficulty and tremendous suffering, they became even more filled with joy. From the depths of their extreme poverty, super-abundant joy overflowed into an act of extravagant generosity. For I can verify that they spontaneously gave, not only according to their means but far beyond what they could afford.” 2 Corinthians 8:1-3 (TPT). You could see that, they didn’t give their surplus to support God’s work (which includes ministering to the saints), they extravagantly gave beyond their ability. This is fully the work of grace.
However, they didn’t just give extravagantly by grace, they first gave themselves to the Lord.
Just as David said, “…because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared…” This is the kind of environment giving-grace finds true expression. You have to first set your affection on the Lord and give yourself to Him; where you don’t live according to your self-interest. “Not only [did they give materially] as we had hoped, but first they gave themselves to the Lord and to us [as His representatives] by the will of God [disregarding their personal interests and giving as much as they possibly could]“ 2 Corinthians 8:5 (Amplified Bible).
Until you set your affection on the Lord you cannot give towards His work. 
And the giving-grace will not find full expression to excel.Where you put your money or your treasure (which includes your time, attention and valuable resources) is where your heart is.Our Lord made it clear: ”Wherever your treasure is, there the desires of your heart will also be.” Matthew 6:21 (NLT) And when your heart gravitates towards the Kingdom, you activate the grace of God to do more in the Kingdom.
The time to increase in this giving grace is now. 
How do you see the Lord’s assignment?How do you esteem the Lord’s work?What is the direction of your desire, affection or interests? God doesn’t just supply grace. More grace is given to the doers of the word. How true? Look at this: ”And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.” You know, people often shout “I receive it” and “Amen” when there is the declaration of the above gracious blessing.However, most people don’t pay attention to verse 7, before verse 8.In verse 7, Paul instructed the brethren in Corinth: ”Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].” 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). Is your heart in your giving?Are you a cheerful giver?Do you purpose in your heart to give according to the desires God has put in your heart? Grace is supplied abundantly to a cheerful prompt to do it giver.And God:– takes pleasure in,– prizes above other things– and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].BE AN EXTRAVAGANT, CHEERFUL, JOYOUS – PROMPT TO DO IT GIVER TODAY!Shalom. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail at machairawithapostlebennie@gmail.com. DIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11) WE PRAY– That as our desires have been stirred towards giving, we shall be cheerful prompt to do it givers. – And that we shall increase in superabounding grace to extravagantly give ourselves and our resources to the expansion of the kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 20 - 23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 555 - ALL GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  ALL GRACE"[Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings." 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) There are evidences all through the scriptures of the benefits and blessings of giving. Though whatever you give is first from God, He blesses you for giving. Yes, we give because we are blessed; nevertheless, when we give, the Lord blesses us.
Never assume there is no blessing in giving.
A cheerful prompt to do it giver is blessed with ALL GRACE IN ABUNDANCE. And this All GRACE includes favor and earthly blessing.This blessing transcends material things. However, this blessing is a force which can attract material things. Some people first look out for material things when they give. But what God gives to you is an essential conditioning which causes the material world to respond rightly to you. Consider the story of Jacob and Esau. We see Jacob receiving the blessing of the covenant. Isaac spoke words to Jacob, but those words were the impartation of the blessing.When Esau came and realised Jacob had received the blessing, he asked if there were any more blessings for him: “…he has taken away my blessing. Haven’t you saved a blessing for me?”Isaac answered, “I have already made him master over you, and I have made all his relatives his slaves. I have given him grain and wine. Now there is nothing that I can do for you, son!” Genesis 27: 36-37 (GNT). When you read the scriptures you will realise that the blessing of Isaac was an impartation of words. They were not physical items he gave to Jacob. Jacob didn’t leave his father’s house with material properties his father had. He left with the blessing (See more in Genesis 27:1-45). We are all blessed with spiritual blessing in heavenly places in Christ. (Ephesians 1:3). These spiritual blessings are not dependent on your self-effort, but the finished work of Christ. However, there is an impartation of blessing which abounds towards every cheerful prompt to do it giver. As a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it, giver, have this expectation and mentality or consciousness that you are specially blessed with ALL GRACE to enjoy favor and earthly blessing in abundance.
What is the goal of this blessing?
It is not for mere luxury. We see the essence of this abounding grace: “…so that you may always and under all circumstances and whatever the need be self-sufficient [possessing enough to require no aid or support and furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation]. 2 Corinthians 9:8 ( Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) Oh, dear LORD JESUS… Beloved, this is what this blessing of all abounding grace (of favor and earthly blessing) produces in you:– You may always (at any given time give)– under all circumstances (or no matter the situation) – whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work)– You will be self-sufficient [to be self-sufficient means to possess enough to require no aid or support and furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation].
What a limitless BLESSING!
It’s a blessing that makes you a GREAT GIVER. Are you a cheerful, joyous prompt to do it giver? Shalom. To be a part of the gospel financiers, send us a mail at withapostlebennie@gmail.comDIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18) WE PRAYWe enjoy the super abounding blessings of grace as we give cheerfully. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 24 - 27 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. -I always at any given time give. – I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation)  – I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work). – I am self-sufficient giver by the grace of God.  – I possess enough and require no aid or support to give. – I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 556 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 1st August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 1"The earth is the LORD’s, and everything in it. The world and all its people belong to Him." Psalm 24:1 (NLT)To think the earth exists without a creator is not the wisest thing to do. A careful or forensic observation of the universe leads us to the work of a creative being. The first verse of the Bible reveals God as the Creator."In the beginning, God created the heaven and the earth." Genesis 1:1 (KJV)From the revelation of the scriptures, we see that the universe did not just happen.
As part of creating the universe, God formed the Earth to be the habitation of man.
"For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens (He is God!), who formed the earth and made it (He established it; He did not create it empty, He formed it to be inhabited!): “I am the LORD, and there is no other." Isaiah 45:18 (ESV)When God made the universe, He deposited rich resources into it. Because God had a glorious plan for man, He didn't place man in an empty space. God looked at man, all that He wanted to accomplish with him, all that He will ever need to live to fulfill His purpose, and then He invested all the resources man will ever need into the Earth.
God's investment into the Earth and man was to help man achieve God's Kingdom mission in the physical sphere.
The resources of the Lord are for Him. God doesn't invest for nothing, though His lovingkindness is unconditional. All that God made was for His purpose or Will."Worthy are you, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they existed and were created.” Revelation 4:11 (ESV)All the raw materials, minerals, such as; precious stones, metals and common minerals (such as salt, sulfur and water), the seas, lands, forests, mountains and animals were made by God according to His Will. As these things belong to God, they are to serve His purpose.God as the source of all creation and King, made man a spiritual and intelligent creature (with a physical body) who can relate with Him. He blessed man with the capacity to utilize all the created things to serve the purpose of His Kingdom.
God's design for man was for man to serve Him.
The physical world was not made by God just for funfair. God's mission was to saturate the physical sphere with Himself and the dominion of His Kingdom. And to accomplish that mandate He made man."And God blessed them; and God said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it; and rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the sky and over every living thing that moves on the earth.” Genesis 1:28 (NASB)
The dominion which God gave man was for man to harness God's creation on Earth and to use all of God's resources to execute His goal.
The Lord has entrusted the Earth to man, thus, man is a steward of God's resources. "The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind." (Psalm 115:16)As stewards, we must be faithful and committed to ensure that we don't use God's resources only for our interests but to accomplish God's Kingdom purpose.Be a faithful Steward. Shalom! DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 44:24; Isaiah 42:5; 1 Corinthians 4:2; 1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that we shall increase in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God's resources to fulfill His purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 28 - 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a faithful steward. - I live to fulfill God's divine purpose. - I don't use God's resources for my interest. - I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God's resources to fulfill His purpose. - I live to serve God's purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 557 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 2nd August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 2"The earth is the LORD’s, and everything in it. The world and all its people belong to Him." Psalm 24:1 (NLT)You cannot be relevant in God's kingdom without being a faithful Steward of God's resources.
A faithful Steward of God's resources will always acknowledge that all things are of God and for His glory.
All those who served their generation unto God's glory in the scriptures had one common trait:They acknowledged God as their source and saw themselves as His stewards.Take note of David's prayer after he and the people of Israel had given into the building of the temple:"Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the victory and the majesty, indeed everything that is in the heavens and on the earth; Yours is the dominion and kingdom, O LORD, and You exalt Yourself as head over all. Both riches and honor come from You, and You rule over all. In Your hand is power and might; and it is in Your hands to make great and to give strength to everyone. Now therefore, our God, we thank You, and praise Your glorious name. But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to offer as generously as this? For all things come from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You." 1 Chronicles 29:11 - 15"O LORD our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy Name, it is from Your hand, and is all Your own." 1 Chronicles 29:16You may be wondering why David would have such a posture. But that was his reality. No matter your generosity towards God's Kingdom, you must first honor God who supplies to you to give.That is the beginning of true stewardship.
Whatever God has entrusted to your hands is for His glory and praise.
Learn to acknowledge God as your source and be determined to remain a faithful Steward of the Lord's resources.Shalom! DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 44:24; Isaiah 42:5; 1 Corinthians 4:2; 1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that we shall become sensitive and discerning to acknowledge the supply of the Lord to us for His purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 32 – 34 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 558 - DELIGHT IN HIM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  DELIGHT IN HIM"Jesus answered and said to him, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him"John 14:23 (NKJV) From John chapter 13 to chapter 17, Jesus’ last conversation with His disciples before His arrest. The things He shared with them were deep heartfelt thoughts. These conversations and teachings of Jesus were so crucial because they were full of rich realities which would sustain them and usher them into a deeper walk with Him.
Our walk with Jesus is a walk of intimacy.
 When Jesus said, “If you love me you will keep my commandments” (John 14:16) He wasn’t placing an exhaustive burdensome demand on us. He was sharing how those who love Him will respond to Him. Period! And take note: Those who love Him, are those who are loved by Him. Keeping His commandments is not what brings you into His love. Instead, because you love Him, you keep His commandments. That is why I shared with you previously that, to keep the commandment of Jesus is a product or result of His love in you. And again, your love for Jesus is not as unconditional as His love for you; because His love is the condition of your love.
Your love for Jesus is programmed by His love.
 Jesus has no imperfections. He has no weakness, He has no sin and makes no mistakes. He is the meaning of excellence and beauty. When you behold Him, you see the true meaning of holiness, perfection, love, power, honor and glory. You will only love Him and enjoy Him as you behold Him. When you see Him, you will only see His love for you and all men. You will not see burdensome rules and regulations. You will see His outstretched arm of love. When John the Baptist saw Jesus, He beheld the greatest act of love in the universe.He said, “Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!” “…God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us” Romans 5:8 (NKJV) Oh glory to God!
Jesus’ death is the demonstration of God’s greatest love. (See also John 3:16).
 So how do you love Jesus? Now get this, you keep (do or obey) His words or commandments, by delighting in Him. The scriptures reveal that the Father loves the Son (John 3:35) Now look at how the Father explains His love for the Son: Two times in the scriptures (both at the baptism of Jesus and His Transfiguration experience), we see the Father revealing how He loves His Son: “And the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him, and a voice came from heaven which said, “ You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.” Luke 3:22 (NKJV) “While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, ” This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!” Matthew 17:5
This is the way to love the Son; He is so perfect you only delight or be pleased in Him.
 Beloved, as you delight and enjoy the Lord Jesus, His words will only be a treasure of life and hope for your living. Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(John 15:13-14; Romans 8:32; 1 John 3:16) WE PRAY- That our hearts will behold the overwhelming richness of the love of Christ. - That our delight of Him will increase greatly that He will be all that we desire and our complete satisfaction. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Jeremiah 35 - 37 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord is my delight and my satisfaction.  - I behold the perfection of the Love of Christ. - I walk in the manifestation of the love of Christ.  - The overwhelming power of the love of Christ is the influence of my love. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 559 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 4th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 3"The earth is the LORD’s, and everything in it. The world and all its people belong to Him." Psalm 24:1 (NLT)It is important to understand that God is the source of all creation. And the created things on Earth are His investments for His Kingdom mission.
To be trusted by God with His kingdom vision you must be one who acknowledges that all that you have is His and for His Kingdom glory.
Your effective stewardship begins when you acknowledge that all things belong to God and are for God.God made all men stewards of His resources on Earth. Nevertheless, when unbelief which led to corruption germinated in the hearts of men, they chose to serve their selfish interests rather than God's purpose for their lives.These men even ignored the revelation of God's existence as their source. They saw the testimony of God revealed through all the created things yet denied all the truth about Him.However, all those who believed in God through Christ and acknowledged that all things are of God and for God are recognized as stewards of God.
Right at the integral core of God's instruction to Man was the concept of stewardship.
God said to Man to be fruitful, subdue the earth and rule over all that has been made.This brings out the idea of stewardship; it is to have oversight or to oversee God's resources.There is a description of a steward's responsibility in Isaiah 22:15:"Furthermore, the same Lord God of the armies of heaven has told me this: Go and say to Shebna, the palace administrator" (TLB)Read also from the Message Translation:"The Master, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, spoke: “Come. Go to this steward, Shebna, who is in charge of all the king’s affairs"Shebna as a steward was responsible for the administration of all the king's resources and that of the city. He had the authority to use these resources for the management of the whole city.
To be a steward of God is to be entrusted with the resources and the authority to administrate these resources for the purpose determined by God.
"Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful." 1 Corinthians 4:2 (KJV)The Greek word for Steward in this verse is, oikonomos which literally means a house distributor (that is manager) or overseer; by extension, it means fiscal agent (or treasurer); it is also the word for chamberlain governor.As a steward, you have the responsibility to oversee, manage, administrate, direct, organize, and diligently use all of God's resources which come to your care for His own purpose.
Are you making good use of all of God's resources for His Kingdom mission or your selfish ambition?
This is the set time to become a faithful Steward.Can God trust you with His resources for His mission?Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4814hk6ceqwDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 44:24; Isaiah 42:5; 1 Corinthians 4:2; 1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall become sensitive and discerning to acknowledge the supply of the Lord to us for His purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 38 - 40 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 560 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 5th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 4"Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful." 1 Corinthians 4:2 (KJV)Holman Bible Dictionary explains that a Steward is one who has the responsibility "to utilize and manage all resources God provides for His glory and the betterment of His creation.”We have already seen in previous episodes that:- God is the source of all creation.- The created things are God's investments for His Kingdom mission.- To acknowledge God as the source of all resources you have, is the beginning of good stewardship.
A steward is one trusted with the resources of his Master.
Joseph in the house of Potiphar was a steward over his master's resources and affairs. The success of Joseph wasn't his personal gains. His success was the prosperity of Potiphar's household.The moment you are trusted with God's resources, your success is not in your personal gains. Your success is in how faithful you utilize God's resources for His glory.When God blessed man, He practically entrusted His resources to man. However, men began to use God's resources for their own pleasures, instead of using them to bring glory to God.The new creation in Christ is to live as Christ. To live as Christ is to bring glory to God and not to satisfy your own interests.A faithful Steward doesn't use God's resources for His personal gains. A faithful Steward uses God's resources for God's glory. Your true success is not in what you possess. Your true success is how you use the possessions given to you by God to serve God's Kingdom mission.
