Which means to be faithful is crucial, for stewards of God.
To be faithful is to be trustworthy. The Greek word is "pistos"; which means "trustful, true and sure".A faithful person is disciplined and diligent with tasks entrusted to him or her. A faithful Steward doesn't only fulfill responsibility when it is convenient. A faithful person remains diligent even when it is inconvenient. He or she is driven by conviction.To be a faithful steward of God's resources is also to be committed and loyal to God. It is to remain firm and consistent with your commitment or promise to God."When you make a vow or a pledge to God, do not put off paying it; for God takes no pleasure in fools [who thoughtlessly mock Him]. Pay what you vow" Ecclesiastes 5:4 (Amplified Bible)
A faithful Steward doesn't break promises or commitments made to God.
God channels resources to you based on the commitment you make to Him.The vision of God never lacks provision. Thus, God entrusts His kingdom business and resources to anyone who makes a decision or a vow or commitment to make the vision of God their focus.As a Steward of God, you must be faithful and committed to utilizing God's blessings or resources to bring honor and glory to Him.Don't just be a steward of God's resources, be a faithful steward of God's resources.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVZ7ah7OTEw&t=38sDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 4:17; 2 kings 12:18;22:7; 1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that by the continuous supply of God's grace, we shall remain faithful stewards of God's resources no matter the inconvenience; that God's kingdom mission will be fulfilled and He will be glorified through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 41- 44 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 561 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 6th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 5"Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful." 1 Corinthians 4:2 (KJV)Everyone is expected to be a steward of God's resources. And you cannot be a faithful steward of God if you are not born again and not submitted to God's supply of grace.Mostly when people begin to hear about stewardship and faithfulness, they begin to turn to look at themselves. They assume their faithfulness is dependent only on their efforts.
However, no one can accomplish anything for the Kingdom of God through Christ, without Christ.
"I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing." John 15:5 (KJV)To be a faithful steward is also to be fruitful. Your success or fruitfulness is in your faithfulness in utilizing God's resources for His glory.And there is nothing God tells you to do without His supply.Which means it will take God's grace for you to become faithful.It is important you understand this matter as we get deeper into the discussion of STEWARDSHIP.Whatever God tells you to do He gives you the ability to do. You don't have to be under any pressure in your attempt to become a faithful Steward. We do nothing in the Kingdom of God without the Lord's help.Jesus said "My yoke is easy and my burden is light" (Matthew 11:30)Does that mean God's assignments are not great?Not at all.See what David said even about the building of God's temple:"Then King David said to the whole assembly: “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great, because this palatial structure is not for man but for the Lord God." 1 Chronicles 29:1 (NIV)And because God's tasks are great, it is important to depend on God's help to get it done.David the King understood this; he knew it would only take God to have the necessary resources for His work. He knew the greatness of the assignment would not only require the diligence and integrity of his heart and that of his people but also the help of God."Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name. “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand." 1 Chronicles 29:13-14 (NIV)Though it's important you decide to work diligently and remain faithful, you can only do anything for the Lord according to His immeasurable power."For the Kingdom of God is not just a lot of talk; it is living by God’s power" 1 Corinthians 4:20 (NLT)
You don't become a faithful and fruitful steward by having confidence in yourself. You become an effective steward by having confidence in God's ability dispensed into you.
God will not entrust any responsibility to you beyond your ability.In as much as we have to cultivate and increase the ability of God in us, God patiently entrusts us with His resources to manage.God is not interested in your failure. Therefore He wouldn't overload you with tasks which are beyond you. He makes His superabundance of grace available for you to receive and to succeed.
You don't become a faithful Steward by your own might. You become faithful by the Lord's help.
Your duty is to make a decision that you are going to become a faithful steward and you are going to submit to God's help to implement that decision.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRlrvecLgeMDIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:10-19; 1 Corinthians 4:17; 2 kings 12:18;22:7; 1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that:1.  This desire and thought to be faithful stewards will be kept in our hearts forever, and our hearts will remain loyal to the Lord and the Kingdom mission.2. We shall not in any way depend on our might but will daily serve the Lord's purpose as faithful stewards according to the ability of the Lord in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 45 - 48 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I serve as a faithful steward of God by the ability of the Lord. - I am a faithful steward. - I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. - I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. - I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. - I live to serve God’s purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 562 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 7th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 6"Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful." 1 Corinthians 4:2 (KJV)God's concept of stewardship as revealed in the scriptures is not centered on your possession and hoarding of things.
God's Kingdom concept of stewardship is how you take care of things and also utilize these things for the purpose of His glory.
God has made us stewards of all things. He wants His people to look after His resources. There are some believers in Christ who assume that being a steward is a degradation of identity. They prefer to be referred to as sons of God, than stewards of God's resources.Every believer in Christ is adopted into sonship. We share in God's inheritance; however, we must understand as believers in Christ that, we are also appointed by God to be His stewards.As sons of God everything that belongs to our Heavenly Father is ours as well. And the Father has also appointed us to be His stewards. As stewards of God, we are custodians who manage God's possessions.Jesus demonstrated how we must function both as sons of God and also as stewards of God.He said, "All things that the Father has are mine..." (John 16:15)See this also as Jesus prays to the Father:"All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified." (John 17:10).In the verse 10 of John 17, you can see both sonship and stewardship:First, Jesus acknowledges that as fully man, everything He has belongs to God. (We carefully looked into this in the previous episodes). In this sense, Jesus is declaring Himself as a steward. Then secondly, He pointed out His divine right; all that God has also belongs to Him. In as much as Jesus is God manifested in the flesh, He also submitted Himself to function as a steward of God's resources.
To be a faithful steward is not only about having confidence in God's ability but also submitting yourself as a steward to God because He owns all things.
Take a look at these two expressions to have a better understanding."I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me." (John 10:14)Jesus called the people He was raising, "MY SHEEP". That is ownership.Jesus in His final weeks with His disciples made an account of them to the Father:“I have manifested your name to the people whom you gave me out of the world. Yours they were, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word. Now they know that everything that you have given me is from you. For I have given them the words that you gave me, and they have received them and have come to know in truth that I came from you; and they have believed that you sent me. I am praying for them. I am not praying for the world but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours. All mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them." John 17:6-10 (ESV)From these verses, you can now tell that the same flock which Jesus declared as His, belongs to God instead.Jesus as the embodiment of the God-head owns all things. Yet as a Steward, He has to care for God's possession unto His glory.As sons of God through Christ, we must emulate His concept of stewardship.
No matter the revelation of your identity in Christ, you must submit yourself to God as a faithful steward.
You have to see yourself as one God has entrusted with all of His resources. He has also entrusted some specific resources for you to manage.God has put you in charge of His resources not for self-pleasure, but to manage for His glory.
You have to get down from your high horse and serve as a faithful steward.
Just as Jesus had accounted for His stewardship, you are also going to account for your stewardship.Will you be called a good and faithful steward?Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=thHz609A2wg&t=26sDIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:10-19; 1 Corinthians 4:17;  1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that:We shall not live with a sense of entitlement and pride but will submit or humble ourselves as sons of God, to take charge and serve with God's resources as faithful stewards unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jeremiah 49 - 52 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit myself to the Lord as a faithful steward. - I serve as a faithful steward. - I am a faithful steward. - I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. - I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. - I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. - I live to serve God’s purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 563 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 8th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 7"Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful." 1 Corinthians 4:2 (KJV)How you take care of things and utilize these things for the purpose of God explains the concept of God's Stewardship.All the things God made during creation and all that He achieved through Christ's death and resurrection are to serve His Kingdom mission.
God's intention is that His Kingdom glory will saturate this physical world. He made this physical world to be an extension of His Kingdom.
God established the Church through Christ to satisfy the need for an administrative, operative and legislative system to ensure His resources are properly used for the mission of His Kingdom.All the saints (or believers) in Christ are members of the Church (1 Cor. 12:13). Thus, all the saints are to be involved in God's administrative, legislative and operative system here on Earth.As saints in Christ, we are not only brought into Christ to have fellowship with the Father (1 John 1:3); we are brought into Christ to be part of the execution of God's Kingdom assignment (Ephesians 2:10).We are not using our own resources to accomplish or execute God's vision and mission. We are to faithfully manage God's resources for the purposes of His vision and mission.Everything within the universe is an investment of God. And they will all find meaning when they are used to serve God's Kingdom mission and to express His glory.
God owns it all and has graciously made you a steward.
One may ask, "I don't have access to all the resources of God, so how do I use them to serve His purpose?"Now, you are also a creation and a product of God's work. It is not just the precious stones, metals and common minerals which are God's resources. All the people created by God including the new creation (or born again) in Christ are also God's investments.The new creation in Christ is bought with a price. It took God's priceless precious blood to make salvation available. (1 Corinthians 6:19). As I have addressed in another episode, Salvation is free but not cheap!Therefore, you don't need to have access to all the resources of God on Earth before you become a faithful steward. You don't need to become the richest man on Earth to be a faithful steward.
Whatever you have access to, no matter how little, is enough for you to prove your faithfulness as a steward.
That is how God measures your stewardship:"One who is faithful in a very little is also faithful in much, and one who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much." Luke 16:10 (ESV)Instead of praying to God for more resources in order for you to prove how faithful you can be as a steward, be faithful with "the little" in your hand and God will trust you with more.The most important investment of God is not silver and gold.
The most important investment of God is man. This was why God gave Himself for the Salvation of man (1 John 3:16).
Your stewardship begins first with how you manage yourself and the salvation which you have received in Christ.Even though God made you, He has made you custodians of your life and how you live. He has given you the power of choice, which is the mind, the will and the emotions to determine how you want to live.How do you manage your mind and thoughts?How do you guard your heart?How do you manage your emotions?How do you manage your spirituality?How do you manage your body?Do you pay attention to your life choices?
Do you do things which satisfy you or do you do things which bring glory to God?
Just as Jesus gave an account of how He managed the disciples God gave Him (John 17:6-10), you are also going to make an account of how you manage yourself."So then each of us shall give account of himself to God." Romans 14:16 (NKJV)When you stand before God to make an account of your life, can you boldly say you have faithfully served the Lord with all your with all your heart and with all your soul [your choices, your thoughts, your whole being]? Beloved as a faithful steward, live each day in all His ways to love Him, and to serve the LORD your God.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 10:12; Matthew 22:37; Romans 12:1; Colossians 3:23; 1 Corinthians 4:17;  1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that by divine understanding we shall know how to faithfully manage our lives to serve the purpose of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Lamentation 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit myself to the Lord as a faithful steward. - I serve as a faithful steward. - I am a faithful steward. - I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. - I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. - I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. - I live to serve God’s purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 564 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 8
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 9th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 8"So then each of us shall give account of himself to God." Romans 14:16 (NKJV)There are many who want to be known as faithful stewards by how they manage other resources of God. They don't consider themselves as God's resource to be managed.If you are reading this and you still think that way, I will recommend you to read the previous episode of with .
You have to know that your life is an investment of God for the expansion of His Kingdom.
You will find true meaning in life when you use your life to serve God's Kingdom mission and to express His glory.The concept of God's stewardship is not only how you take care of things and also utilize these things for the purpose of God; the concept of God's Stewardship first begins with how you take care of yourself and also live to serve His purpose.You belong to God and He has graciously made you a steward of your life.Your entire being is the first and the most important investment of God for His Kingdom. And as a steward, you will one day make an account to God, as to how you lived your life to serve His purpose. "For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us]." Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified Bible)As a steward of the life God has given you, it is important to walk according to the path God has set for you. You can't live contrary to what God has ordained for you and be counted as a faithful steward.Just as God's resources must be used for His purpose as He has prearranged, even so must you live according to what the Lord has prearranged.The arrangement of God for your life is to bring you to a successful end. God has designed your life for His glory.
Whatever you do must bring glory to Him. He made your entire being for His service.
After God brought Israel out of Egypt and led them further to possess the promised land (through the investment of His power or enormous strength and wisdom), Moses stood before the assembly of Israel and addressed them saying:"So now Israel, what do you think God expects from you? Just this: Live in his presence in holy reverence, follow the road he sets out for you, love him, serve God, your God, with everything you have in you" Deuteronomy 10:12 (The Message)To serve God with everything you have in you is also to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul. It is to serve Him with every potential the Lord has deposited inside you.Moses the Prophet of God, went on to explain to the congregation of Israel why they have to serve the LORD with everything in them:"Look around you: Everything you see is God’s—the heavens above and beyond, the Earth, and everything on it." Deuteronomy 10:14 (The Message)As we have been discussing in previous episodes:
Whatever you have belongs to God, including your life and must be used for God's glory.
Never be part of those who make claims like; "My life is mine and can decide to do whatever I want to do with it".Some also go like, "My money is mine and can spend it how I want".Whether you live diligently as a steward or not, a time will come when you will definitely give an account of yourself to God.Will you be reckoned as a good and faithful steward?Selah.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 22:37; Romans 12:1; Colossians 3:23; 1 Corinthians 4:17;  1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that we shall apply our hearts to wisdom and live according to the Lord's prearranged path set before us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Lamentations 4 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I apply my heart to wisdom to live according to the Lord's prearranged path set before me. - I serve as a faithful steward.- I am a faithful steward. - I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. - I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. - I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. - I live to serve God’s purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 565 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 9
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 10th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 9"So then each of us shall give account of himself to God." Romans 14:16 (NKJV)If you have been following with and this topic (Stewards of God's Resources), you will understand that God made all things to fulfill His purpose. There cannot be purpose without a space or place for its pursuits.God's goal for this physical world or earth is for the expression of Himself and His Kingdom. 
One of the most important assets given to man for the fulfillment of God's purpose and vision is TIME.
Though God is eternal and has also set eternity in our hearts, He has set a determined time for each person to accomplish His assignment on Earth.With the things God has entrusted to us to accomplish we don't have eternity to fulfill it; though we have eternity to enjoy all that we will accomplish. Our operation on earth is time-bound.Jesus said, "We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work." John 9:4 (NLT)The time you have, is to carry out God's task assigned to you.Time is an asset available for every person whether born again or not. However, what each person will achieve within time will be with the person for eternity.This is what makes time a sensitive asset or resource for man. It must not be wasted or misused since whatever you do with time will be an impression of you all through eternity. As I have explained before, time is a spot in eternity. However, whatever is done in time has a lot of impact in eternity.Jesus stepped into time and all that which He accomplished within the space of about 33 years, produced and established a nonpareil impact in eternity.There are two crucial things which define your relevance in the Kingdom:1. How you serve God's purpose with your entire being.2. What you use the time you have for.
These are two resources which are freely available for all men: Your being and Time.
All men are by themselves God's investment and all men also have the gift of time. Both your being and time are great assets. What you do with yourself and time determines your relevance in the Kingdom of God.I have already explained the need to serve the LORD with all your being. Now also, as you may know, no single person has more time than the other. Everyone has the same quantity of 60 seconds, 60 minutes and 24 hours each day. No one has 26 hours a dayThe quality of your time or the day is by the investment you make with it.
How are you using your time to serve God and fulfill His purpose?
Your stewardship in God's Kingdom includes:- how you take care of things and utilize them for the purpose of God.- how you take care of yourself and also live to serve His purpose.- how you used time for God's purpose.Your entire being is the first and the most important investment of God for His Kingdom. And the time you have is a resource given to you by God to carry out your mission.When the time to carry out God's purpose is consummated, you will one day make an account to God, as to how you lived your life and how you used the time given you to serve His purpose. Sometimes people assume that the days to work will not come to an end.The Psalmist knowing this asked of the Lord:"Help us to remember that our days are numbered, and help us to interpret our lives correctly. Set your wisdom deeply in our hearts so that we may accept your correction." Psalm 90:12 (TPT)Let me resound this to you; YOU DON'T HAVE ETERNITY TO CARRY OUT GOD'S ASSIGNMENT. You have eternity to enjoy the reward of what you did in time.You must always remember that the time you have will not be forever. Can't you see how each day of the week doesn't exist forever?If you patiently participate in the Bible reading plan and even fellowship with each episode of with , you will observe that the days are not waiting.Read Psalm 90:12 from the Contemporary English Version:"Teach us to use wisely all the time we have."What are you doing with all the time you have?How is God glorified in each day of your life?How are you urgently carrying out God's assignment in your life?When all of time has consummated will God celebrate you as a good and faithful steward?Will you be reckoned as good and faithful steward?Beloved, make the most of your time!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NgF67AF7Z9MDIG DEEPER(Psalm 39:4-5; Ecclesiastes 3:11; Ephesians 5:15-16; Proverbs 12:11; Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that asking that the Lord will teach us to use wisely all the time we have. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord's purpose. - Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. - I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. - I keep a sense of urgency in all things.- I am a faithful steward.- I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. - I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. - I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. - I live to serve God’s purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 566 - WALK IN HIS WILL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 11th August, 2023WALK IN HIS WILL“Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.” Luke 22:42 (Berean Standard Bible). Beloved, by the revelation of scriptures, we realize that man has a crucial role to enact in the fulfillment of God’s eternal plan and purpose. God as the creator has an intention for His creation. Just as every inventor has an intention for his or her invention.
God made us to be His workmanship unto good works. (Ephesians 2:10).
He also designed man to have an organic partnership with Him. God didn’t make man just to exhibit His creative ability.  When He made man: – He gave man a spirit (Zechariah 12:1; Ecclesiastes 12:7; Isaiah 42:5; Numbers 26:22), so that man will be able to relate with Him. Remember, God is a Spirit (John 4:24). – He made man a living soul. Genesis 2:7 (which includes the mind, the will and the emotions). God gave man a mind (Psalm 139:13-16) to be able to reason.  – He gave man a will to make decisions and choices (Genesis 2:16-17; John 1:12-13). – He gave man emotions to feel and interpret his or her experiences and He also gave man a body to function in this physical world. (See also 1 Thessalonians 5:23) These items reveal how God designed man in other to have a well-structured partnership with him. By these items, it becomes possible for God to work together with man to achieve His eternal purpose through time. These also reveal how man can choose to live independently of God. Though man can only achieve God’s intention when He has an interdependence with Him.
Surely, God made you to partner with Him to achieve His purpose. 
“For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.” Ephesians 2:10 (NKJV) God doesn’t force you to live and function according to His will. To work with God and experience true fulfillment, you must willingly make a decision to function according to His WILL. Noah had to choose to believe in God’s word to build an ark before the flood. Others had the opportunity to join him, but they refused. Abraham had to willingly leave his father’s house for a land God would show him. And through that step of faith, all nations were blessed through him. Joseph had to decide to honor God and reject Potiphar’s wife. David had to choose to stand with the Lord and to stand up for His people. Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah decided to stand with God and not bow to any other God, irrespective of the threat and danger. Despite the persecutions, the apostles and disciples of Jesus did not turn away but continued to preach and spread the gospel of our Lord.
You can decide to do things according to your will or according to the will of God.
The choice is with you. It is time to say, LORD not my will BUT YOUR WILL! Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fk1d7-sHLJc&t=39sDIG DEEPER(Matthew 26:39; Matthew 6:10; Psalm 40:8; John 4:34; John 5:30; Proverbs 19:20-22) WE PRAYThat in all things we will yield ourselves to walk in the ultimate WILL of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezekiel 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I choose to walk in the will of God.  – I refuse to yield to my will. – Through prayer and the study of the word, I am strengthened to walk in the ultimate Will of God for my life. – I walk in agreement with God in all things. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 567 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 10
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 12th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 10"So then each of us shall give account of himself to God." Romans 14:16 (NKJV)Time is a spot in eternity, however, whatever is done in time has a lot of impact in eternity.It is one of the resources of God given to each person.Nobody has more done 24 hours or less than 24 hours.Every single individual has the same quantity of time each day. The quality of time each person will have is dependent on their diligence as faithful stewards.
Whatever you will accomplish on Earth is also determined by how you effectively use time.
In as much as it may seem there is not enough time, time is really enough for each day. It is God who determined the day and the night. He knew we can make the most of the time we have if only we are not going to be wasteful. When it comes to the pursuit of purpose, we must always have a sense of urgency and a consciousness to utilize time wisely. Time is not to be wasted; it has to be managed properly. So the Psalmist said:"Teach us to use wisely all the time we have" Psalm 90:12 (Contemporary English Version)As stewards of God's resources, we must also know that all the time we have is also given to us by God. Time is part of God's possession and He has graciously given it to us to manage as stewards. Your faithful management of time will also determine whether you are a faithful steward or not.When people talk about time management they don't think of it in the light of stewardship. They think of using time to accomplish personal goals.
Time management is not proper management until it is seen in the light of stewardship.
To manage time is not just how you use time to satisfy your personal goals which doesn't bring glory to God.To manage time is to first know that you don't own time and you are only a steward of the original owner – God.He has given you the gift of time to carry out His task assigned to you.
When all you use your time for is what pleases you, you are not managing time faithfully.
Your walk must be pleasing to the Lord, including how you use time."So as to walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him: bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God" Colossians 1:10 (ESV)To manage time is still time wastage when it is not seen as time stewardship."Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, making the best use of the time, because the days are evil. Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is" Ephesians 5:15-17 (ESV)
The understanding of the will of God will cause you to wisely make the best use of your time.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5H5q-UaYoh4&t=2sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 39:4-5; Ecclesiastes 3:11;  Proverbs 12:11; Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAYWe pray that asking that the Lord will teach us to use wisely all the time we have. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezekiel 7 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. – I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. – I keep a sense of urgency in all things.– I am a faithful steward.– I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 568 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 11
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 13th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 11"As each one has received a gift, minister it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God." 1 Peter 4:10 (NKJV)As sons of God, we must be determined to be faithful stewards. To be faithful stewards is to become responsible sons in the Kingdom.As sons and stewards of God, we express the life of God and manage or administrate His resources respectively.
At the end of all things you are not going to account for your sonship, you are going to account for your stewardship.
Our sonship in Christ grants us access to God's inheritance and resources. Nevertheless, we must learn to use these resources to serve the Lord's purpose. We are not sons who live as civilians in the Kingdom. Understand that, there are no civilians in the Kingdom of God, though we are all citizens. All of us are citizens, sons, soldiers and stewards in the Kingdom of God. No one is expected to sit on the fence with their arms folded in the Kingdom.  Everyone has a duty to perform. God made us to function here on Earth for the benefit of His Kingdom. Whatever God has made you to be, deposited into you and provided for you is to make you relevant in His Kingdom mission and to express His glory. You must be intentional with how you take care of yourself and how you live for God's glory.We have already seen how God has made each of us stewards of our lives. The true meaning of your life is revealed when you use your life to serve God's Kingdom.The second resource we have discussed is TIME. Whatever you will accomplish on Earth is also determined by how you effectively use time. You must be a faithful steward of the time God has given to you. At the end of all things, you shall make account of what you did in your body within every time frame, as a Steward. Your stewardship on Earth is time-bound. Though your fellowship with the Lord transcends time.God's Kingdom mission and vision require so much resources. Apart from the investment of your entire being and stewardship of time, you must also be an effective steward of the gifts and abilities God has given you.
It is easy to serve the LORD with all of your time and gifts when you have submitted all of your heart to Him.
Every person is given a special ability or gift (which is also known as talent in some instances) for the service of the Lord. Some of these abilities are natural gifts (or talents) and supernatural gifts. To take this further, you must remain conscious of one of the key points I emphasized at the beginning of this discussion;GOD IS THE SOURCE AND CREATOR OF EVERY MATTER AND LIFE.This means that whether a gift is a natural talent or a supernatural gift, it comes from God."Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow of turning." James 1:17 (NKJV)All that is of God must be used to serve God's purpose.Some people think they possess their natural gifts or talents and can decide whether to honor God with them or not.
It is not only supernatural gifts which are given by God. Natural talents are also of God and must be used for His glory.
To be a faithful steward of the talents and gifts you possess, you must know that they are of God and must be used to serve others and to advance God's Kingdom course. What is your natural talent, and what spiritual or supernatural gift do you possess?Are you a faithful steward of these gifts?
Are you using your gift or talent to serve others and to advance God's kingdom?
Or you are using your natural and supernatural gifts to serve your own interests?Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ifWIKbUIZgM&t=24sDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 4:7; Luke 19:13; Matthew 20:28; Romans 12:6;Exodus 31:3-5; Exodus 35:10) WE PRAY We pray that we will always continue to humbly see each gift or special skill or talent we possess as a gift or talent which is of God and must be used to honor God and to advance His Kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 11 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I use all my gifts and talents to honor God and advance His Kingdom.- All of my gifts and talents are of God and they are for His glory. - I am a faithful steward. - I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use my gifts and talents for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize my gifts and talents to fulfill the Lord's purpose. - I live to serve God’s purpose. - My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 569 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 12
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 14th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 12"As each one has received a gift, minister it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God." 1 Peter 4:10 (NKJV)You don't only serve God with supernatural gifts or what is known as Spiritual Gifts.
Every talent and gift or abilities come from God, therefore it must be used to serve His purpose.
There are times people assume the skills they develop are by their own diligence thus, those talents and skills are self-generated and cannot be God centered.All of these are of God:- Natural Talents. These are inherent or innate talents and abilities which people possess through the genetic material of their families. These are passed down from one generation to the next generation. Some families are mostly athletic, others are good at playing musical instruments, and some have a voice for singing but are not good at playing musical instruments. Some are good with artisanship and also technical skills because they inherited the genetic code which brings the skills naturally to them.- Nurtured or developed Interest. If one has to become exceptional with their natural or innate talent, he or she has to nurture it through hard work, discipline and consistent training. No matter how talented you are, you have to develop it to the highest level of dexterity.      Now there are people with certain skills which weren't innate. They just developed an interest in those skills through association or the kind of environment they found themselves. For example, there are people who developed an interest in playing musical instruments simply because they found themselves among instrumentalists. They then begin to nurture their interests, through constant training till they become skillful at it. By the latent power of the mind, anyone can develop any skill he or she sets his or her mind on, whether it's innate talent or not. Though the nurtured interest in a skill, may seem not to be directly from God, the latent power of the mind, is of God. And also remember, as a believer, it is God who works in you both to will and to do (Philippians 2:13).
Both the unsaved and the saved have natural talents and nurtured interests. Yet know that those abilities are to be used to glorify God.
- Supernatural gifts or Spiritual Gifts. These are the gifts distributed to the saved in Christ by the Holy Spirit. These gifts are given according to the will of God. And as people mature in their relationship with God, they are imparted by the Holy Spirit with special spiritual gifts. These gifts enable the believer to serve the Lord, His Kingdom and the saints."Now there are [distinctive] varieties of spiritual gifts [special abilities given by the grace and extraordinary power of the Holy Spirit operating in believers], but it is the same Spirit [who grants them and empowers believers]. And there are [distinctive] varieties of ministries and service, but it is the same Lord [who is served]. And there are [distinctive] ways of working [to accomplish things], but it is the same God who produces all things in all believers [inspiring, energizing, and empowering them]. But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit [the spiritual illumination and the enabling of the Holy Spirit] for the common good. To one is given through the [Holy] Spirit [the power to speak] the message of wisdom, and to another [the power to express] the word of knowledge and understanding according to the same Spirit; to another [wonder-working] faith [is given] by the same [Holy] Spirit, and to another the [extraordinary] gifts of healings by the one Spirit; and to another the working of miracles, and to another prophecy [foretelling the future, speaking a new message from God to the people], and to another discernment of spirits [the ability to distinguish sound, godly doctrine from the deceptive doctrine of man-made religions and cults], to another various kinds of [unknown] tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues. All these things [the gifts, the achievements, the abilities, the empowering] are brought about by one and the same [Holy] Spirit, distributing to each one individually just as He chooses." 1 Corinthians 12: 4 -11 (Amplified Bible)Through verses 8 to 10, Paul the Apostle outlined different spiritual gifts. But that is not all that there is, He also mentioned other Spiritual Gifts in Romans 12:The gift of serving others, the gift of teaching, the gift of preaching, the gift of being generous, the gift of administration or special administrative ability and the gift of comfort or encouragement. ( See Romans 12:7-8).When for example someone is exceptional in administration or has a special ability in comforting others, you may think it's just natural. But there is a supernatural ability which is supplied even for administration. You can develop administrative skills through education or may have administrative skills through an innate ability.  However, when the special grace of God comes upon you, it amplifies the administrative ability you possess. 
No matter the ability you have, when you become born again, the anointing of the Holy Spirit finds expression through it to serve the Lord's purpose.
"God has given each of us the ability to do certain things well..." Romans 12:6 (TLB)You are a steward of the talents and the gifts in you. Your stewardship is demonstrated when you use every ability in you to advance the Lord's Kingdom, honor the Lord and serve others. 
Don't limit the usefulness of your gifts and talents to satisfy self-gratification.
Are you a faithful steward?Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vHClFwY_F6YDIG DEEPER(Romans 12:6-8; 1 Corinthians 12: 4-31; Exodus 31:3-5; Exodus 35:10) WE PRAY We pray that we shall exercise the wisdom to serve our generation with every ability of God in us to bring glory to His name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 14 - 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I use all my gifts and talents to honor God and advance His Kingdom.– All of my gifts and talents are of God and they are for His glory. – I am a faithful steward. – I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use my gifts and talents for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize my gifts and talents to fulfill the Lord’s purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 570 - REDEMPTION OF TIME AND EARLY SUCCESS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 15th August, 2024 REDEMPTION OF TIME AND EARLY SUCCESS 1"Surprise us with love at daybreak; then we’ll skip and dance all the day long. Make up for the bad times with some good times; we’ve seen enough evil to last a lifetime" Psalm 90:14-15 (The Message)God has never designed life to be full of defeats and failures. God has never designed life to be backward. Life is to be lived forward. God never designed your life to be stagnant.It's His joy that you advance and increase as you become fruitful by the day.
There is no glory in stagnation. The glory of God is manifested in your progress.
Everything about God and things made by Him are designed to become fruitful, advance lives, and express His glory.You don't have to accept stagnation in any way. Don't ever assume that God makes anyone's life stagnant for any reason.Stagnation is not of God. Therefore, don't live every day waiting or watching on without taking determined steps towards advancement.Time doesn't stop or wait. You may think the seconds or hour ahead may not yet come, but suddenly you look back and ask or wonder, "Where did those seconds go?"As much as you don't have to live a rushed life or allow delay to create anxiety, you shouldn't live any day without taking steps towards your progress or advancement.
God has never intended that anyone's life should be wasted, delayed, stagnant, slow and fruitless.
Though Abraham indeed experienced some delays, and David became relevant as early as 17, why must you not have early success?God doesn't endorse delay. Delay and stagnation have their cause. When those factors that cause delays are properly addressed, there can be tangible progress.God desires that you redeem the times (Ephesians 5:16). To redeem the times is to make the most of every opportunity or to improve every opportunity. Read it in the Amplified:"making the very most of your time [on earth, recognizing and taking advantage of each opportunity and using it with wisdom and diligence], because the days are [filled with] evil."
God wants you to experience restoration from wasted years.
"So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten..." Joel 2:25God wants you to live your days and years in prosperity and glory. (Job 36:11)He wants you to have early success and satisfaction. The Psalmist having this understanding prayed to the Lord saying:  "Surprise or satisfy us early with your mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days" (Psalm 90:14).This means it is possible for one not to be satisfied early in his days. And it is also possible for one not to be glad all his days.It is not normal to keep having "ups" and "downs". You can have your whole life flooded with peace and prosperity. You can have a life full of progress and fruitfulness.What you accept as your revelation becomes the definition of your estate. Refuse stagnation, refuse failure, refuse unfruitfulness.
Make a decision today that you are redeeming the times.
Make the most of every opportunity now, to experience early success.Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12-17; Romans 13:11; Psalm 37:18-19; Ecclesiastes 9:12; Job 36:11) WE PRAY We pray that we shall incline our hearts to the wisdom of God, and that we improve every opportunity and have early success. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 18 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I incline my heart to the wisdom of God. - Through the wisdom of God, I make the most of every opportunity to have early success. - I make daily progress and success. - I make each day count. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 571 - GROW IN THE RICH KNOWLEDGE OF CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency GROW IN THE RICH KNOWLEDGE OF CHRIST“Yet indeed I also count all things loss for the excellence of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them as rubbish, that I may gain Christ.”Philippians 3:8 (NKJV)Lives and destinies are sustained by knowledge. And the relevance, advancement and influence of men are determined by their level of knowledge.
Who you are, is not a great threat as compared to when you know who you are.
When you are born to be a king and you have zero knowledge of it, you cannot function as a king.What you know is what makes the difference. This is not just a phenomenon among men. This is a reality in God and in the spirit. Your greatest limitation is your ignorance. The dimension of knowledge you operate in defines your manifestation of purpose.
The greatest thing to happen to you, is to grow in the rich knowledge of Christ.
Until the appearing of Christ, it was the Jews who were referred to as the people of God (Deuteronomy 7:6-8). They had a covenant with God through the circumcision of the flesh, the oracles and the law of God were committed to them. They were reckoned as the worshippers of God. The prophetic word of the Lord concerning the Messiah was entrusted to them.Now the law which was given them was their greatest revelation of God. And they esteemed their attempts to keep the law, as a means unto righteousness.Now in Philippians chapter 3, Paul (the apostle) outlined these credentials and reckoned them as nothing as compared to the REVELATION OF JESUS.
No matter how the Jews boasted about their relationship with God through the laws and their circumcision, they never experienced the complete fullness of the knowledge of God.
To the Jews, it was a mystery they couldn’t decode. Though the oracles of God were first entrusted to them, they saw them as unsearchable riches of wisdom.Therefore when Paul encountered Jesus, he beheld the glory which transcends the one distributed through the law of Moses. For the glory of the law fades away (2 Corinthians 3:7-18). The light of the knowledge of the glory of God shines in the face of Jesus. Until you behold and know the Lord Jesus, you cannot experience the transcending glory of God.
In Christ Jesus, we have the priceless privilege and access to the deepest revelation of God.
“But whatever former things were gains to me [as I thought then], these things [once regarded as advancements in merit] I have come to consider as loss [absolutely worthless] for the sake of Christ [and the purpose which He has given my life]. But more than that, I count everything as loss compared to the priceless privilege and supreme advantage of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord [and of growing more deeply and thoroughly acquainted with Him—a joy unequaled]. For His sake I have lost everything, and I consider it all garbage, so that I may gain Christ” Philippians 3:7-8 (Amplified Bible).The things considered as advancement by Jews are worthless and to be counted as loss, in comparison to the excellency or priceless privilege and supreme advantage of knowing Christ Jesus our Lord.
The knowledge of Christ is the summit of God revealed.
Look, the more you know Jesus, the more you assimilate the reality of the highest power and authority of the entire universe (of things in Heaven, on Earth and under the Earth. The authority which supersedes all principalities and powers).No wonder the epistle reckons your growth in the knowledge of Christ a priceless privilege and supreme advantage.Make it your daily desire to grow in the knowledge of Jesus.Shalom. DIG DEEPER(John 17:3; Philippians 3:3-10; Isaiah 53:11; 1 Corinthians 2) WE PRAYThat we may increase in the desire and know how to harness the opportunities and access given us by the Lord to grow in the deep rich knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 21 - 24 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the priceless privilege and access to the deepest revelation of God. – I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of Christ. – I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. – As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. – I am full of the knowledge of Christ.  Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 572 - REDEMPTION OF TIME AND EARLY SUCCESS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  REDEMPTION OF TIME AND EARLY SUCCESS 2"Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!" Psalm 90:14 (NKJV)You can be satisfied in your labour at the dawn or morning of your life.You don't have to struggle through life till old age before you experience success. You can have the God-kind of success early.Take note, God centered success or God kind of success, is not necessarily about the possession of material things. It is not the car you drive, the house you've bought, or the amount of money in your bank account. The God-kind of success is basically achieving God's plan for you within a particular season.To have early success is to step into the fullness of your calling or purpose. It is making tangible impact in the lives of people through the mandate the Lord has given you.Most people who don't experience early success in the Kingdom, are often people who were busy with the pursuit of their own desires until they finally find the need to turn to God and follow His direction.
If you want to experience God early then you must seek Him early.
"O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary. Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name. My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips" Psalm 63:1-5 (KJV)Your early season to seek God is now. It takes a lot of steadfastness to grow into the assignment of God for your life. There are no "short cuts", you can't jump process. There is no sudden success.Jesus didn't just wake up to use the last three (3) years of His life to accomplish these great results. He spent the first 30 years of His life to be prepared and built up into His purpose.There are about 11 years between Paul's conversion (in Acts 9:1-9) and when he and Barnabas were separated by the Holy Spirit to their unique assignment the Lord has set for them.Paul the apostle didn't just step into the scene to accomplish the things which he did.David didn't just receive boldness overnight to defeat Goliath. According to the testimony of David to Saul, just as Goliath has been trained for war since childhood, he (David) was also prepared by God through several experiences as a shepherd boy. David's learnt early in his life to deliver any of his lamb from a lion or bear as a shepherd. Therefore He had that same confidence that the Lord will help him deliver Israel out of the hands of Goliath and the army of the Philistines. (1 Samuel 17:34-36).Before these moment, David had learnt to defend what has been entrusted to him. He was always ready for the victory against Goliath.
You cannot have early success when you don't know how to make the most of every opportunity the Lord bring your way.
Don't waste time!Set your affection on the Lord.Set your focus on the Lord and His assignment for your life. Stay committed to it now. Continue to serve the Lord's purpose for your life. Be determined and diligent to accomplish the targets or goals given to you by the Lord.And you will begin to see the satisfaction of success.Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12-17; Romans 13:11; Psalm 37:18-19; Ecclesiastes 9:12; Job 36:11) WE PRAY We pray that we shall make the Lord our focus and pursue His purpose now, so that we shall experience early success. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezekiel 25 - 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I incline my heart to the wisdom of God. – Through the wisdom of God, I make the most of every opportunity to have early success. – I make daily progress and success. – I make each day count. Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 573 - REDEMPTION OF TIME AND EARLY SUCCESS 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 18th August, 2024 REDEMPTION OF TIME AND EARLY SUCCESS 3"See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools but as wise, redeeming the time, because the days are evil." Ephesians 5:15-16 (NKJV)Beloved, you might have had some wasted years or a time where you could have accomplished certain tasks, which you failed to do. You don't have to beat yourself up in sorrow and disappointment.As we have seen in the previous post, God doesn't want you to have wasted years, so He is interested in restoring those years."I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the hopper, the destroyer, and the cutter, my great army, which I sent among you." Joel 2:25 (ESV)
You don't experience the restoration of wasted years by thinking about the past.
Paul the apostle taught us what to do:"Of course, my friends, I really do not think that I have already won it; the one thing I do, however, is to forget what is behind me and do my best to reach what is ahead." Philippians 3:13 (GNT)Maybe there was a big assignment the Lord previously entrusted to you and you failed at it; don't worry. Reach out to another opportunity, step up and accomplish it as the Lord has intended.There are two major things you should take note of:1. To have early success, you must start early.     When is your early time?Well, stop thinking your early time is in the past. No matter the delays you have had your "EARLY TIME" is now!2. The concept of redeeming the time is basically to make the most of every opportunity you have."making the very most of your time [on earth, recognizing and taking advantage of each opportunity and using it with wisdom and diligence], because the days are [filled with] evil." Ephesians 5:16 (Amplified Bible).You have to be prompt to harness every time available to you. No matter how you patiently endure seasons, you must make sure you are still running (Hebrews 12:1).
You don't experience restoration by being sluggish. There is nothing done with God which must be slow.
"Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord" Romans 12:11 (KJV)Read also in the Amplified Bible:"never lagging behind in diligence; aglow in the Spirit, enthusiastically serving the Lord" (Romans 12:11)Your life and your living on earth must be seen as business. Whatever you do with your time is a trade of purpose. You can't afford to be sluggish and wasteful thinking that great things will manifest through you. Until you decide and begin to work, nothing works for you.If you are going to make the most of the time or opportunity you have, you will need to give yourself to consistent PRAYER.You intensify your relationship with God, when you give yourself consistently to prayers. The more you spend time praying, the more your heart is open to seeing the things God wants you to do.
All through the scriptures, there is no single person who had early success without prayer.
In the place of prayer, you receive divine counsel and also access the abundance of grace for every time of need.Whenever you observe some delay in any area of your life, first check your consistency in prayer.Give yourself to prayer, take inspired steps now and don't be sluggish.Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12-17; Romans 13:11; Psalm 37:18-19; Ecclesiastes 9:12; Job 36:11) WE PRAY We pray that we shall be prompt to exceptionally do that which the Lord has called us to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 29 - 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am prompt in doing that which the Lord called me to do.– Through the wisdom of God, I make the most of every opportunity to have early success.– I am committed to prayer.– I make daily progress and success through prayer. – I make each day count. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 574 - BE SOAKED BY THE HOLY SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BE SOAKED BY THE HOLY SPIRIT “The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the deep waters. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.” Genesis 1:2 (NLT).The first time the Holy Spirit was introduced in the scriptures was not in Acts (in the upper room).The first time the Holy Spirit was introduced was in Genesis.However, both incidents reveal how the Lord brings out the best out of nothing.We see in Genesis 1:2, that before God’s six days of creation work, the Holy Spirit has to first incubate and saturate the waters for God to bring out light and continue the other creations.
The commands or instructions of the Lord work in an atmosphere soaked by His Spirit.
It doesn’t matter how bad the condition is; or the level of weakness within you, the moment the Holy Spirit saturates you, God’s best will gush forth.Jesus had ascended; the early Church had the command to go into all the world and make disciples of all the nations. They had the commandment of the Lord to walk in love. Nevertheless, the Lord Jesus knew there was no way His glorious Church would be born without the Holy Spirit.There is no way they can have the ability and boldness to preach the gospel and walk in love without the Holy Spirit. The reality was that, when Jesus ascended, His disciples had zeal but lacked ability. Jesus in their midst was their ability and boldness. Hence, the need for the Holy Spirit.“And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.” Acts 2:1-4 (KJV)This seems similar to the impact of the Holy Spirit in creation.Just as the Holy Spirit was hovering over the waters in Genesis; we see the Holy Spirit fill and saturate the house where the disciples were.
This means the disciples were immersed in the glorious presence of the Holy Spirit.
God didn’t start His creation work without the overwhelming presence of the Holy Spirit. The Church didn’t reach out to their world until they were filled or immersed in the Holy Spirit.If you are born again in Christ, you have the Holy Spirit in you. However, you must live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit.
Don’t start your day without being soaked by the Spirit.
You may have big dreams and great plans for the day, month or year; however, without being immersed in the Spirit, you can do nothing.Get intimate with the Holy Spirit and enjoy His overwhelming presence.Shalomhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8&t=10sDIG DEEPER(Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4) WE PRAY– That our plans and desires will be immersed and soaked in the Spirit.– That nothing we do will be of the flesh but by the influence of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 32 - 35 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. – I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 575 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 13
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 20th August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 13"Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand it is to make great And to give strength to all. “Now therefore, our God, We thank You And praise Your glorious name. But who am I, and who are my people, That we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You." 2 Chronicles 29:12‐14 (NKJV)The matter of stewardship is a crucial matter of our walk with God.
Your commitment to God, loyalty to His purpose and integrity of heart are demonstrated through your stewardship.
As I have mentioned in previous posts:Your stewardship begins by first acknowledging that God is the creator of all things; thus, He is the source of all things.Anyone who made a great Kingdom impact (all through the scriptures) walked in this consciousness.Until you acknowledge God as the Creator and the source of all resources, you cannot serve Him with the resources available to you. God, the source of all things, determines the true meaning of things. Therefore whatever finds meaning must be submitted and be useful to God.We have also addressed that, every steward will make account of how he used God's resources to serve God's Kingdom mandate.As faithful stewards, we serve the Lord with all of our being, our time and our abilities.You must recognize that these things are valuable resources and must be committed to God.Your time and abilities are not the only resources committed to us by God. The expansion of God's Kingdom also requires proper use of silver and gold (precisely money).
The stewardship of money has been the major emphasis of our stewardship in the Church.
We shouldn't think the stewardship of money is an exaggeration. This is because money has become one of the mediums by which people appreciate the value of things.Your stewardship of money also begins from first recognizing God as the source of every money you have.When you recognize God as the source of your wealth or the money that comes to your hand you will honor and serve Him with it.Our stewardship of money or finances is not only demonstrated in how we generously give towards God's Kingdom mission. It is also seen or demonstrated in how we manage or make prudent decisions about money, the wise investments we make and the recognition and acknowledgement of God's generosity towards us.To recognize God's generosity towards you, will not make you see your generous giving as a donation. Your giving becomes a medium of honor."Honor the Lord with your wealth And with the first fruits of all your crops (income)" Proverbs 3:9 (Amplified Bible)
As a steward, you must see your giving to God as a means of showing honor to God.
David the King understood this; so after himself and his people had given to the building of the Lord's Temple, they didn't see it as helping God or as donation to God. To them, it was a means of honoring God.As we have seen in the opening verse, let's have another read:"Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand it is to make great And to give strength to all. “Now therefore, our God, We thank You And praise Your glorious name. But who am I, and who are my people, That we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You." 1 Chronicles 29:12-14 (Amplified Bible)See the verse 16 as well:“O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name is from Your hand, and is all Your own" 1 Chronicles 29:16 (Amplified Bible).Faithful stewards understand the privilege of serving the Lord with their wealth or money, through giving.
Don't be a steward who goes all out to serve the Lord with all of their being, time, ideas, and abilities but wouldn't see the need to serve the Lord with their money.
As long you have been able to serve the Lord with your being, be diligent to commit your money or wealth to the mission of the Kingdom.Be a faithful steward of God's resources.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=18sDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 4:7; Matthew 25:14-30; Matthew 6:19-21; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:6, 9-11) WE PRAY We pray that we shall recognize the generosity of God's abundance towards us and be faithful to serve His purpose with the substances He entrusts to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezekiel 36 - 39 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I honor the Lord with my best. – The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement. – I am always excited to give unto the Lord, because its the greatest privilege. – I am a prompt to do it giver. – All that I have is the Lord’s and for His kingdom advancement including my money. – I am a faithful steward. – I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use my gifts and talents for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize my gifts and talents to fulfill the Lord’s purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 576 - STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 14
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 21st August, 2024 STEWARDS OF GOD'S RESOURCES 14"Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand it is to make great And to give strength to all. “Now therefore, our God, We thank You And praise Your glorious name. But who am I, and who are my people, That we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You." 2 Chronicles 29:12‐14 (NKJV)Until you use the things made by God to serve God's purpose, such things will not find meaning.The silver, the gold and money as a whole will only find meaning when used to serve God's purpose.You don't have to assume that the money you make is only by your sweat and hard work, thus, you will use it just for your interest.
As people of God, we must acknowledge God as the source of our wealth.
What do you have that you did not receive? (1 Corinthians 4:7)For all things come from God (see the opening verse again)."If you start thinking to yourselves, “I did all this. And all by myself. I’m rich. It’s all mine!”—well, think again. Remember that God, your God, gave you the strength to produce all this wealth so as to confirm the covenant that he promised to your ancestors—as it is today." Deuteronomy 8:18 (MSG)
As people of God all that you have is not all yours. Your life is for God's glory, and all that you have must be used for God's glory.
Others also think they don't have enough money to give towards the Lord's vision. But when your heart is towards the Lord you will always love to give towards His course.The believers in Macedonia gave generously towards the Lord's work among the saints. Even with their limited resources."Now, friends, I want to report on the surprising and generous ways in which God is working in the churches in Macedonia province. Fierce troubles came down on the people of those churches, pushing them to the very limit. The trial exposed their true colors: They were incredibly happy, though desperately poor. The pressure triggered something totally unexpected: an outpouring of pure and generous gifts. I was there and saw it for myself. They gave offerings of whatever they could—far more than they could afford! —pleading for the privilege of helping out in the relief of poor Christians.This was totally spontaneous, entirely their own idea, and caught us completely off guard. What explains it was that they had first given themselves unreservedly to God and to us. The other giving simply flowed out of the purposes of God working in their lives. That’s what prompted us to ask Titus to bring the relief offering to your attention, so that what was so well begun could be finished up. You do so well in so many things—you trust God, you’re articulate, you’re insightful, you’re passionate, you love us—now, do your best in this, too." 2 Corinthians 8:1-7 (MSG)
As long as you have not given yourself to the Lord you wouldn't even see the need to commit your other resources to his course.
And the more you commit your resources, money or treasure to the Lord, the more your heart is set on Him."for where your treasure is, there your heart [your wishes, your desires; that on which your life centers] will be also" Matthew 6:21 (Amplified Bible)If you want to know where your heart and desires gravitate to, see where you commit the resources at your disposal.Be a faithful steward of money. Don't just use money only for your interests and the satisfaction of personal needs, which doesn't benefit God's kingdom plan. Use money and other resources to serve God's Kingdom mandate within your sphere.At the end of all things, you are going to make an account of how you serve God's purpose with the resources He entrusted to you.
Do Kingdom business with God's resources.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1ME&t=1515sDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 4:7; Matthew 25:14-30; Matthew 6:19-21; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:6, 9-11) WE PRAY We pray that we shall become more diligent in serving the purpose of God with our wealth or every financial blessing and that His name shall be glorified in our sphere. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 40 - 43 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement. – I am always excited to give unto the Lord, because it's the greatest privilege. – I am a prompt to do it giver. – All that I have is the Lord’s and for His kingdom advancement including my money. – I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 577 - WORK IT — DON'T BEG! 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 22nd August, 2024 WORK IT — DON'T BEG!"Don’t just listen to the Word of Truth and not respond to it, for that is the essence of self-deception. So always let His Word become like poetry written and fulfilled by your life!" James 1:22 (TPT)All things were made by the word of God (Hebrews 11:3). The universe was created and beautifully coordinated by the power of God’s words.
The word of God is the constitution and the Wisdom of  God. It is actively full of energy.
The word of God is designed to accomplish its purpose when God sends it forth. However, the word of God in your life will not work automatically. The word of God will not be fulfilled or manifest in your life without your participation.The word of God is a seed of God which is sown in your heart as you read or hear it preached and taught.You have a responsibility to guard that seed, nurture it, water it, and prune it for better growth till the season of great harvest.
When you find yourself in a tough situation where everything seems not to work, you must go for God's word.
Understand that, everything in God works by the word. And though nothing works without the word of God, the word of God doesn't work by itself. You have to put the word to work.There are certain tough situations which may press you so hard that you begin to doubt whether you can have solutions. Sometimes you may think you have tried all that you can to get out of it, and nothing seems to work. It may even leave you in a state where you begin to beg for a solution.The word of God always works when you work it out. Becoming beggarly wouldn't bring you out of your challenges.
You stand tall above challenges when you persistently stand on the word and act it out.
Be determined to become a doer of the word.The word is given to you to become your action. You don't just have to be a good hearer. The word doesn't work for you when you don't do it.That is what it means to live by faith. You must have confidence in the word and act on it without doubt.
Let your life become the fulfillment of what God has said.
After Jesus had taught the people from Peter's boat. The Lord asked Peter and his friends to row out their boat to deep waters to cast their nets and they will have a great catch. (See Luke 5:4-7)Not long before the Lord Jesus used their boat, Peter and his friends returned from all night fishing and they didn't catch a thing. But this time, Peter and his friends decided to still go out again to let down their nets only because of the WORD OF THE LORD.According to the facts based on Peter's experience, it will be another waste of time to roll out his boat for fishing again.But this time, he was not acting based on his professional experience in fishing. He was acting on the word of the Lord.Look at what Peter said himself:"But Simon answered and said to Him, “Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net.” Luke 5:5 (NKJV)Peter let down his net according to the WORD OF JESUS!And see what happened:"When they pulled up their nets, they were shocked to see a huge catch of fish, so much that their nets were ready to burst!" Luke 5:6 (TPT).The word of God always works when you act on it.
Don't live begging. Live acting out the Word of God!
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Matthew 7:24; Matthew 12:50; Jeremiah 11:6) WE PRAY We pray that we shall have the promptness of heart to confidently carry out or act out God’s word irrespective of the challenge. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ezekiel 44 - 46 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't beg, I act on the word.- I act out the word of God irrespective of challenges. - My life is a fulfillment of the word of God. - I am a doer of the word. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 578 - WORK IT — DON'T BEG! 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  WORK IT — DON'T BEG! 2"Don’t just listen to the Word of Truth and not respond to it, for that is the essence of self-deception. So always let His Word become like poetry written and fulfilled by your life!" James 1:22 (TPT)To work the word is basically to live by faith. Faith is confidently acting out the word of God.The word of God does not fail. To manifest the unfailing and incorruptible word in your life, you must respond to it in faith and act it out.Until you stop responding to your fear and start acting the Word, you will not see the results of the Word. No amount of complaining can make you a champion.As we saw yesterday, though Peter and his colleagues had toiled all night, he chose to act out the Word of the Lord.
Every word spoken to you by God is to bring you into greater accomplishments.
As long as you will continue in the word, you will see the mighty hand of God.You don't have great testimonies because you begged God. You have great testimonies because you acted out the word.The word of God is God's material for His creative working. He does nothing outside His word. This means you can only have God's kind of results if you operate according to His word. The word is as a seed (Luke 8:11) and within every seed there are fruits. However, you cannot access the fruit, until you sow the seed.You are not seeing the productivity of the word in you because it has not been sown in you. No matter how effective a seed is, it must be sown and cultivated before it will reproduce.The word of God is a seed of God that is sown in your heart (likened to a field).
Whatever you want to see in your life, you must take hold of what God has said about that in His word.
