There is a word of the Lord for your health, finances, work, ministry, academics, purpose, eternal salvation, seasons of persecution, the present world, relationships, marriage and family.As you study and search through the scriptures with the help of the Holy Spirit and sound teachers, you will receive the present word for your situation.Don't allow your challenges to control your life. Don't allow your challenges to move you away from the Word. No matter the overwhelming challenges, continue to set your desire and delight on what God is saying to you."Even though my troubles overwhelm me with anguish, I still delight and cherish every message you speak to me." Psalm 119:143 (TPT).
The more you set your delight on the Word, the more you are saturated by its power. The power within the word in your heart will cause you to manifest what it says.
This is why you must let the Word of God dwell in you richly.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(Matthew 7:24; Matthew 12:50; Jeremiah 11:6; Psalm 119:162) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall have the promptness of heart to confidently carry out or act out God’s word irrespective of the challenge. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Ezekiel 47 - 49 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t beg, I act on the word.– I act out the word of God irrespective of challenges. – My life is a fulfillment of the word of God. – I am a doer of the word. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 579 - PREACH THE GOSPEL DAILY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 24th August, 2024 PREACH THE GOSPEL DAILY"Don’t stop! Keep on singing! Make his name famous! Tell everyone every day how wonderful he is. Give them the good news of our great Savior." Psalm 96:2 (TPT)The preaching of the gospel of Jesus is not just the responsibility of Apostles, Prophets, Evangelists, teachers and Pastors.
The preaching of the gospel is the responsibility of every believer.
"And God has made all things new, and reconciled us to himself, and given us the ministry of reconciling others to God. In other words, it was through the Anointed One that God was shepherding the world, not even keeping records of their transgressions, and he has entrusted to us the ministry of opening the door of reconciliation to God. We are ambassadors of the Anointed One who carry the message of Christ to the world..." 2 Corinthians 5:18-20 (TPT)As we have all been made ambassadors or representatives of Christ, we have the responsibility to tell everyone about His glorious work.Most believers enjoy the privileges of being sons of God, heirs of God, Justified in Christ, eternally forgiven, blessed with all spiritual blessings, supplied with an abundance of grace and filled with the Holy Spirit.However, they don't take delight in announcing the glorious news of Jesus to their world and getting many saved.Jesus said, "But you will receive power and ability when the Holy Spirit comes upon you; and you will be My witnesses [to tell people about Me] both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and Samaria, and even to the ends of the earth.” Acts 1:8 (Amplified Bible)
The Holy Spirit in you is to give you ability and power and to also make you a witness of Jesus. 
You have the responsibility to tell others about Jesus and the glorious things He has achieved through His death, burial and resurrection.This is not done only when there is a special event. This responsibility is not to be carried out once in a year. It is a daily task. As you can see in the opening verse:"Don’t stop! Keep on singing! Make his name famous! Tell everyone every day how wonderful He is. Give them the good news of our great Savior." Psalm 96:2 (TPT)You have to tell everyone about Jesus every day. It is not a once-a-week thing. Wherever you find yourself at any time, you must announce the glorious news of Jesus.Paul said to Timothy "preach the Word of God urgently at all times, whenever you get the chance, in season and out, when it is convenient and when it is not..."Don't just sit waiting for a convenient time. Whether is in season or out of season. Whether you feel like preaching or you don't feel like preaching, you must preach. 
Preach the gospel whether you are happy or not.
It is a necessity. Lives are in need of the gospel. You can't wait till tomorrow. The time to announce the glorious news of Jesus is today and now.Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Peter 3:15; Matthew 5:16;  Mark 16:15; Matthew 28:19-20; Romans 10:14-15; Acts 20:24; 1 Corinthians 9:16; Acts 4:20) WE PRAY We pray that we shall receive more and more grace to remain focused, and consistently diligent in the preaching of the gospel of Jesus to all men at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Daniel 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I preach the gospel. - Irrespective of how I feel, I still preach the gospel. - I increase in grace daily to be consistently diligent in the preaching of the gospel of Jesus. - I don't spare none, I preach the gospel to all. - I am a joyful witness of Jesus.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 580 - THIS IS A NECESSITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  THIS IS A NECESSITY"For if I preach the gospel, that gives me no ground for boasting. For necessity is laid upon me. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!" 1 Corinthians 9:16 (ESV)Did you read yesterday's with ?Did you preach the gospel yesterday?How did the Episode — PREACH THE GOSPEL DAILY inspire you?Share your experience here. [wpdiscuz-feedback id="1zlwr1ygw5" question="Please leave a feedback on this" opened="1"]Click on the button.[/wpdiscuz-feedback]I will be glad to know how it has blessed you.
Beloved, preaching the gospel is not an option. It is a command of the Lord!
This is what our Lord and Savior Jesus commanded:"And He said to them, “As you go into all the world, preach openly the wonderful news of the gospel to the entire human race! Whoever believes the good news and is baptized will be saved, and whoever does not believe the good news will be condemned" Mark 16:15-16 (TPT)By this command, every believer is constrained with the responsibility to preach the gospel.Whether there is a reward for you or not, you must preach the gospel. It is part of your stewardship.The moment you become born again, God entrusts you with the task to ensure others also become saved. You are not reconciled to ignore the unsaved and the unreached. You are reconciled to bring others also to God.When Paul encountered the Lord on his way to Damascus, the Lord gave him an assignment to preach the gospel."While so engaged as I was journeying to Damascus with the authority and commission of the chief priests, at midday, O King, I saw on the way a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining all around me and those who were journeying with me. And when we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’ And I said, ‘Who are You, Lord?’ And the Lord said, ‘I am Jesus whom you are persecuting. But rise up and stand on your feet; for this purpose I have appeared to you, to appoint you a servant and a witness not only to the things which you have seen, but also to the things in which I will appear to you; rescuing you from the Jewish people and from the Gentiles, to whom I am sending you, to open their eyes so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me.’ Acts 26:12-18 (Legacy Standard Bible)The purpose of Jesus in your life is not to satisfy your own desires and selfish goals. You cannot truly experience Jesus and live only for yourself. He gave Himself to you so that you will live for Him. Whenever Jesus brings you into the revelation-light of Himself, He exposes you to a greater assignment. He gives you a calling which is bigger than yourself.
The love of Jesus will always compel you to have compassion towards the unsaved and the afflicted.
Don't treat the assignment of preaching the gospel as a common thing. It is God's medium of announcing His love to the world.The assignment of preaching the gospel is an ambassadorial role of God's Kingdom.No matter the professional career you pursue, always remember you are first a missionary. Your first profession as a new creation in Christ is to preach the gospel of Jesus and to get men saved.Paul said, "Oh King Agrippa, I did not forsake the Heavenly vision".No wonder he said, it's a necessity laid on him. You don't carry out the assignment of preaching Christ only when it is convenient or welcoming.Just as the Lord said to Paul, "...I am sending you to open their eyes so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me"; He is also saying the same to you.This is not an option, neither is it a suggestion. It is a command!You have a compelling duty to open the eyes of many so that:- they may turn from darkness to light.- from the authority of Satan to God.- they may receive forgiveness of sins.- And receive an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me.
This is a great call and privilege given to us by the Lord.
Therefore you must carry it out with joy and honor to the Lord.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EAzrGUwLgLUDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 6:8; Isaiah 50:5; Jeremiah 20:9; 1 Timothy 1:12; 2 Timothy 4:5; 1 Peter 3:15; Matthew 5:16; Romans 10:14-15; Acts 20:24; Acts 4:20) WE PRAY We pray that we shall remain obedient to the assignment given to us by the Lord to preach the gospel in every place. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Daniel 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – Necessity is laid on me, I preach the gospel. – Irrespective of how I feel, I still preach the gospel. – I increase in grace daily to be consistently diligent in the preaching of the gospel of Jesus. – I don’t spare none, I preach the gospel to all. – I am a joyful witness of Jesus.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 581 - BE ON GUARD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 24th, March 2024 BE ON GUARD“For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places” Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)
The greatest weapon of the adversary against men is deception.
Wrestling or fighting against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world and evil spirits is not a fight with physical strength or abilities.
It doesn’t require human strategies. To wrestle or fight with these unseen forces is a matter of words and thoughts.
The attacks of the adversary are always focused on your inner man. This is why you must always guard your heart.Don’t treat thoughts as mere thoughts or imaginations. Thoughts that are inconsistent with the knowledge of Christ, are negative transmissions of the adversary into your spirit and soul. These transmissions provide pathways for demons to travel into your life to afflict and oppress you.
Where do you think depression, stress, anxiety, fear and doubts emanates from?
They are intrinsically not from the situations you find yourself in. They are not first by the people who offend you. Those situations and people are mere conduits or channels for the adversary to attack you with his evil blazing arrows.
You must be on guard to engage the armor of the Lord.
Jesus decoded the source of Peter’s revelation. He knew it was not by flesh and blood but through the supernatural influence of the Father. (See Matthew 16:16-17)Jesus affirmed how the spiritual influences your life when you are availed.In that same chapter, there was another instance similar to what we discussed previously.“From that time Jesus began to show to His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day.Then Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him, saying, “Far be it from You, Lord; this shall not happen to You!” But He turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are an offense to Me, for you are not mindful of the things of God, but the things of men.” Matthew 16:21-23 (NKJV) Did Jesus call Peter Satan?Was Peter, not the one Jesus was praising not long ago?Peter who spoke by divine revelation was now an agency for the voice of Satan.The adversary knowing the influence of  Peter, was speaking through Peter to discourage Jesus from going to the cross.Jesus knew the force or influence by which Peter spoke. He knew it wasn’t a wrestling with Peter, it was a fight with the devil. He rebuked the negative voice of the adversary.Which negative voice or thought are you amplifying or vocalizing?Set your mind on the knowledge of Christ. Don’t submit to any thoughts which are contradictory to the knowledge of Christ.
Submit your thoughts to the thoughts of God through the study of the scriptures.
Refuse to yield to wrong thoughts and emotions. Stand firm and set your gaze on the Lord.Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8&t=10sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Matthew 16:16-17; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Mark 9:25; Romans 13:12; Ephesians 4:14; Acts 5:3; John 13:2; James 4:7; Philippians 2:13)  WE PRAYWe pray that we shall walk in the wisdom and understanding to rightly perceive the source of every thought and utterance. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Daniel 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My mind is set on the knowledge of Christ. – Through the study of the word, I daily submit my thoughts to the thoughts of God. – I refuse to yield myself to wrong emotions and thoughts. – My gaze is set on the Lord. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 582 - UPHOLD AND ESTEEM THE TEACHINGS OF CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 27th August, 2024 UPHOLD AND ESTEEM THE TEACHINGS OF CHRIST“Jesus said to the people who believed in him, “You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teachings.” John 8:31 (NLT) We are in a generation where there is an abundance of information and pluralism of thoughts, concepts of life and teachings.
There have been more teachers in our time than ever.
This is because of the several media platforms available now. This wasn’t the case some years back. Some people lack the integrity and skills to be teachers. Yet now, with internet data, and a smartphone, everyone wants to create content and to share their opinions or assumptions as authentic knowledge. And you will have some gullible people running after those thoughts.
It is imperative for every disciple of Jesus, to give attention to only the teachings of Christ.
Your mark of discipleship is TO CONTINUALLY REMAIN FAITHFUL TO THE WORD (or teaching of Christ). It is not how long you have been a disciple of Jesus, it is how long you will continue to be a disciple of Jesus. You must intentionally imbue focus in the teachings of Christ. It is interesting how some believers turn to the myths and old fables of this world.
The people of the world cannot teach you the reality of the Kingdom.
For example, your unbelieving lecturer doesn’t have the spiritual understanding of the kingdom life. Therefore, he/she doesn’t have the authority to teach you how to fellowship with God. He is not the one to tell you how you should be attending Church meetings. The people of this world have their terms and as you are in Christ you function by a different set of rules.  
You cannot be in Christ and think like the world. 
You must uphold and esteem the teachings of Christ in your heart. A true disciple of Jesus, is a deviation to the systems of this world. He/she doesn’t live by the thought patterns of this world; but delights in the Word of Christ. He/she doesn’t interpret love as the people of this world do. A true disciple of Jesus walks in the unconditional love of Christ. A true disciple is a doer of the word of Christ and not a hearer only. He/she follows and continues in Christ no matter the storm, suffering or persecution. The persuasion of a true disciple is that nothing can separate him/her from the love of Christ.
Dear Disciple of Jesus, do what the Lord tells you to do through His word, not what the world informs.
ARE YOU A TRUE DISCIPLE OF JESUS? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=18sDIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:16; John 15:8; John 13:35; Romans 8:37-39; Colossians 1:28-29; 2 John 1:9; John 15:7-8) WE PRAY– That the delight and persuasion of the word of God shall be intensified in our hearts more and more; to make us doers of the word and not hearers. – That he word of Christ shall deeply dwell in our hearts and we shall not yield our minds to the old fables and false teachings of this world.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Daniel 10-12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t pattern my life according to the standards of this world. – I walk in the unconditional love of Christ. – I delight myself daily with the word of Christ. – Nothing can separate me from the love of Christ. – I continue in Christ no matter the storm, sufferings and persecutions. – I am a true disciple of Christ. Hallelujah!!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 583 - GRACE EMPOWERS YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 28th August, 2024GRACE EMPOWERS YOU“But God’s amazing grace has made me who I am! And his grace to me was not fruitless. In fact, I worked harder than all the rest, yet not in my own strength but God’s, for his empowering grace is poured out upon me”1 Corinthians 15:10 (TPT)You may feel overwhelmed by the vision or assignment God has given you.Or you may desire to do more for the Lord, however you may think you don’t have what it takes.In the realm of God, there are no impossibilities. This is why as a believer in Christ, you are not to think impossibilities, because nothing is impossible to you in the first place.You are with God therefore all things are possible!
Anything God tells you to do, He makes the provisions for you.
You don’t lack what it takes to do what God tells you to do.You must therefore learn to trust God and know the things He has supplied to you.
God doesn’t entrust a responsibility into your hands without giving you what you need.
This is why He sent His Holy Spirit to partner with you, gave you His word to build you, planted you in an assembly of the saints and placed you under a shepherd to train you.Of the many things the Lord supplies you, there is another crucial item for your advantage – GRACE. You might have heard a lot about the grace of God, right?To some, the grace of God is just the means by which we are saved (Ephesians 2:8).And all they think of grace is God’s provision for the sins of men. (There is more to discuss on this later).
The grace of God is not just an unmerited favor; the grace of God is also a divine ability.
In the opening verse, you will see two things the grace of God does.1. YOU ARE MADE BY GRACE. “…God’s amazing grace has made me who I am…”Other translations put it this way, “…I am who I am by the grace of God”So the apostle of Jesus acknowledges that whatever He has become was by the grace of God not by any other means.This means the grace of God saves and makes you a new man (2 Corinthians 5:17).The grace of God changes and transforms your being.Grace translates you from a corruptible state to an incorruptible state.2. Second thing is, GRACE EMPOWERS YOU.To be empowered by grace also shows how grace doesn’t promote laziness.Paul says, “… and his grace to me was not fruitless…”Waow…
There is no unfruitfulness in grace. When you receive grace, and you are made by grace you must not be unfruitful.
This is why GRACE EMPOWERS YOU to work harder or to labour more.It is possible for one to be born again and not take advantage of Grace in His labour.
Grace is for your BEING and it is also for your DOING.
You don’t just have to celebrate the reality of who are by Grace. You must also take advantage of the empowerment of Grace to do more for the Lord.ShalomDIG DEEPER(Philippians 2:12-13; 2 Corinthians 3:5, 6:1; 1 Corinthians 3:10; Romans 12:3; 1 Timothy 1:12; Acts 9:22) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be empowered more and more by the grace of God to labour more. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hosea 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have grace to do what God has entrusted to me. – I am empowered more and more by the grace of God to labour more. – I do more by the empowering grace of God which is poured out upon me. – I am fully resourced and equipped for every good work the Lord has entrusted to me. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 584 - CHANNEL YOUR EMOTIONS TOWARDS THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency CHANNEL YOUR EMOTIONS TOWARDS THE LORD“Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart”.Psalm 37:4 (NKJV)The Lord did not give you your emotions to guide you. Your emotions are measuring instruments of your soul. It helps you ascertain the frequency of your impressions of a matter.
Don’t allow your emotions to lead you.
Your emotion or the deep seat of your desire has been exposed to the corruptibility of the flesh before you got born again.The flesh has always had its way of governing or influencing the soul of a man. A man’s soul includes the will, the mind and the emotions. For you to express God, your mind must be renewed by the word, your will must submit to God’s will and your emotions must be immersed and trained with the deep desires of God.This is the work of the Holy Spirit and the Word of God.“For the Word that God speaks is alive and full of power [making it active, operative, energizing, and effective]; it is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating to the dividing line of the breath of life (soul) and [the immortal] spirit, and of joints and marrow [of the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and sifting and analyzing and judging the very thoughts and purposes of the heart.” Hebrews 4:12 (AMPC)Every part of your being has its own intelligence. From your spirit, through to your soul, to the physical parts of your body and even to the smallest cell within you has its own intelligence.
When the word of God permeates your entire being as you continuously meditate on it, it nourishes and also cultivates the intelligence of your entire being.
This is why meditation is important. Meditation is not just a matter of thinking about something. Through meditation, you are immersed in a particular thought pattern. Meditation creates within you a deep and lasting impression.Through meditation, you are able to repeat a certain line of thought in your heart.“Repetition is the law of deep and lasting impressions.”Every single person is involved in meditation in one way or the other.There is always a line of thought you are repeatedly exposing your mind, your will and emotions to.And the more you expose your heart to these thoughts, the more they become the impressions of your emotions. And the more you exercise or give yourself to certain passions the more they rule and drive your reactions.This is why God is interested in the focus of your emotions or your heart’s delight.
The more you meditate on the love of God and cultivate your heart to express that love, the more it dominates your passions.
The reason most people are quick to spend time watching a Hollywood movie, Bollywood movie or an African movie is how they have trained the desires of their heart.The more you give your time and attention to something the more you create deep cravings for it in your heart.This is why when you have to pray, there is always a fight within your entire being. Deep within your spirit, there is the prompting to pray. Your mind is aware of the benefits of prayer, yet your will is struggling between the craving of your flesh and the prompting of your spirit.It will amaze you to know that the craving of your flesh travels through the impressions of your emotions. 
Your flesh uses the force of the desires hewn from your emotions to influence your actions.
Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8&t=1255sDIG DEEPER(Mark 12:30; Job 22:26; Job 27:10; Psalm 69:9; John 2:17; Psalm 73:25; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYWe pray declaring our emotions to be expressed according to the light of the word of God. And not by the passions of the flesh. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hosea 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t isolate my emotions from the Lord. – My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – I am not led by my emotions. – My delight is in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 585 - YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 30th August, 2024 YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 1"I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me." Philippians 4:13 (KJV)This opening verse is one of the most quoted scriptures by Christians worldwide. The truth is that it gives much hope and confidence to the saints.It has supplied motivation to many believers in different fields or spheres, such as, those in sports, academia or students embarking on an academic pursuit, medical personnel entering the surgical ward, the nurse assigned to a difficult patient, a pregnant lady in labour, the inexperienced young man or lady assigned to a new top leadership role in an organization, the software developer who is feeling overwhelmed with just three days to complete a complex project.
Many sincerely can testify how they felt rejuvenated by this verse of scripture to complete a task given to them.
Bible teachers and scholars have debated the misuse of this scripture verse.Some are of the opinion that when Paul the apostle said, "I can do all things..." he wasn't talking about the ability to run in a race, play football, or basketball, perform gymnastics or even win a boxing fight. Neither was he talking about the ability to study and pass exams, or to lead a business organization.Clearly, the Apostle Paul listed the things he was referring to as the All THINGS he can do.Take a look at the verse in context:"But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly that now at last your care for me has flourished again; though you surely did care, but you lacked opportunity. Not that I speak in regard to need, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content: I know how to be abased, and I know how to abound. Everywhere and in all things I have learned both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. Nevertheless, you have done well that you shared in my distress." Philippians 4:10-14 (NKJV)From the context of this verse, Paul the apostle was sharing with the saints in Philippi, how he has been enabled by the Lord to live in contentment as he preaches the gospel. He was expressing how he had learnt not to be greedy but to continue in the ministry of the Lord even when he has abundance or when he lacks.Some people are only able to do what God has called them to do, only when they have all their needs met. You will not find these people involved in the ministry of the Lord when they are in need. They will rather abandon their ministerial duty to pursue the satisfaction of their personal needs than to continue to labor in lack. These people only serve the Lord when things seem to be convenient.But Paul the apostle had a different testimony. His service to God is not only when it's convenient. He doesn't get busy with the gospel only when he has everything he needs. He is strengthened to continue in the business of the gospel even in hunger.
Christ supplies His strength to you to accomplish all the assignments He has given to you no matter the situation at hand.
Though you can draw inspiration or motivation from the verse to carry out a project or pursue a career, the focus of Christ's strength is not to satisfy your personal interests or ambitions.Many people will only use this verse to address their interests and neglect the assignment given to them by the Lord.The strength of Christ is not for your selfish desire. Christ supplies you with His strength to carry out His purpose.Whenever you declare that "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me", you must be sure the "all things" you are doing will bring glory to God.
Irrespective of the situation or the challenge you face in your pursuit of God's purpose, you must take advantage of the strength of God to be content.
Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12; Colossians 1:11) WE PRAY We pray that the strength of God will abound towards us even in the toughest moments of our lives, as we carry out God's purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hosea 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. - I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. - I do not lack strength. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 586 - YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 31st August, 2024 YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 2"I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me." Philippians 4:13 (KJV)As we discussed in a previous post, Christ supplies His strength to you to accomplish all the assignments He has given to you no matter the situation. The focus of Christ's strengthening is not to satisfy your interests or ambition.
As a believer, you must understand the scriptures in their right perspective.
For Paul the apostle to say he can do all things, doesn't mean he will go about doing anything at all.Yes, you can do all things through Christ who strengthens you.But this is the question:Is it everything you can do with the strength of Christ?Or is the strength of Christ supplied to you to do anything at all?
The strength of Christ is not supplied to you to do everything you want to do.
You will get this clearer in the Amplified Bible:"I can do all things [which He has called me to do] through Him who strengthens and empowers me [to fulfill His purpose—I am self-sufficient in Christ’s sufficiency; I am ready for anything and equal to anything through Him who infuses me with inner strength and confident peace.]" Philippians 4:13The "all things" Paul talked about in the verse has to do with what the Lord called Him to do. The purpose of Christ's strength to you is for you to do what He has called you to do.
It doesn't matter the assignment the Lord has given you, you have His strength to get it done. You don't have to be intimidated by any task at all.
You don't have to be troubled by the challenges that come with the assignment and shouldn't be wearied or threatened by the discomforts which come with it.The strength of God is more than enough. To have the strength of God means, you have all it takes to fulfill the Lord's purpose.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXXfkBuNfgs&t=1sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12; Colossians 1:11) WE PRAY We pray that we will exercise the wisdom not to waste Christ's strength on things the Lord has not called us to do. But rather invest His empowering ability in what He has called us to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hosea 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. –  I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. – I have the ability to achieve every task the Lord sets on  my heart to achieve. – I don't waste the strength of Christ on things the Lord has not called me to do. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 587 - YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 1st September, 2024 YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 3"I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me." Philippians 4:13 (KJV)HURRAAAY!This month of September is going to be a glorious new month for you!Precious one, Christ strengthens you at all times in all situations to fulfill His purpose.
The purpose of Christ's strength to you is for you to do what He has called you to do.
The assignment of the Lord cannot be accomplished with your own ability. Your natural strength and intelligence are not enough to pursue the purpose of God.Jesus made an absolute statement, "...without me you can do nothing" (John 15:5)You cannot bear Kingdom fruits without Christ. The eternal things of the Lord can be fulfilled by the Lord's supernatural ability.When it comes to doing God's work, your confidence must be in the Lord.The strength of God gives you the edge against all odds. Your strength is not enough to sustain you through persecution, humiliation, hunger, suffering loss and facing some harder things in life. It is the strength of the Lord that makes you confront the hard things and hard times with ease.The assignment of the Lord is not as easy and pleasant as it seems on the outside. It's a war! This is why you must be strengthened at all times by the Lord.There are times you will stand alone without any support from friends, families and even from your co-labourers in the ministry. There are times when you are sent to the field, you will face challenges and the only help you have is the Lord.Read Paul the Apostle's experience:"The first time I was brought before the judge, no one came with me. Everyone abandoned me. May it not be counted against them. But the Lord stood with me and gave me strength so that I might preach the Good News in its entirety for all the Gentiles to hear. And he rescued me from certain death" 2 Timothy 4:16-17 (NLT).Can you continue to serve God's purpose even when people offend you, falsely accuse you, attack your integrity, blackmail you, humiliate you, persecute you, seek your death, criticize you, insult you, gossip about you and hate you?By your strength, you may not be able to fulfill God's purpose amidst such challenges. But by the strengthening of the Lord, you can face and prevail in all challenges.To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace.
Christ's strength in you empowers you to be ready for anything that comes your way as you do what He has called you to do.
His strength makes you self-sufficient in His sufficiency to stand tall and triumph amidst the eye-catching ravages or ruinations.The influx of divine strength is the rich secret to doing all things which Christ has called you to do.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12; Colossians 1:11) WE PRAY We pray that the Lord shall strengthen us more and more to triumph in His assignment amidst all the deepest devastations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hosea 13 - 14Joel 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. – I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. – I have the ability to achieve every task the Lord sets on  my heart to achieve. – I don’t waste the strength of Christ on things the Lord has not called me to do. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 588 - YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 2nd September, 2024 YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS 4"I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me." Philippians 4:13 (KJV)The influx of divine strength is the rich secret to do all things which Christ has called you to do.To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace. It is to be empowered with the ability of God. It is also to become self-sufficient in the sufficiency of Christ for every good work.
The strength of Christ in you enables you to exercise mastery in all things.
When it feels like you cannot pursue or do the assignment of the Lord with limited resources, remember, the secret:THE LORD GIVES YOU STRENGTH.The strength of the Lord in you is not only effective in you when you have abundance.Take a look at this:"I know what it means to lack, and I know what it means to experience overwhelming abundance. For I’m trained in the secret of overcoming all things, whether in fullness or in hunger. And I find that the strength of Christ’s explosive power infuses me to conquer every difficulty." Philippians 4:12-13 (TPT)Did you see that?When you exercise the strength of God to triumph amidst "little -difficult" moments, you train yourself to continuously triumph over huge challenges.
The strength of Christ in you is Christ's explosive power which infuses you to conquer every difficulty.
The more you press on to carry out God's assignment for you, the more the adversary also opposes you. His interest is to prevent you from fulfilling your call. You don't have to feel incapable at any given time.There are times any direction you turn to, you may face opposition or limitations. Sometimes the pressure and the challenges may seem insurmountable.But cheer up!
You can do all things through Christ who strengthens you.
"Since His power is so glorious, may you be strengthened with strength of every kind, and be prepared for cheerfully enduring all things with patience and long-suffering" Colossians 1:11 (Weymouth New Testament)As the Lord invigorates you with His strength, you are empowered by Him to cheerfully endure every form of hardship as you fulfill His purpose.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall strengthen us more and more to triumph in His assignment amidst all the deepest devastations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Joel 2 - 3Amos 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. – I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. – I have the ability to achieve every task the Lord sets on  my heart to achieve. – I don’t waste the strength of Christ on things the Lord has not called me to do. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 589 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 3rd September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 1"And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God...Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours." Mark 11:22, 24 (ESV)Miracles do happen. However, miracles don't just happen. Miracles happen by faith.Whatever is done in God and with God must be done by faith. As long as you are born again, your life must be lived by faith."...The just shall live by faith" (Romans 1:17).To live by faith is to live by the absolute confidence in God. The confidence that you must have in God is not abstract. Your confidence in God must be hinged on the Word of God.
Faith originates from the word. To live by faith is to live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions.
Faith transcends a feeling or emotion. Faith is a strong believe in what God has said.The faith which originates from the Word is the faith which is of God.On one of Jesus' journeys with His disciples, they came by a fig tree Jesus spoke to, and that tree had completely withered from the roots.The disciples were surprised to see the tree all shrivelled up and dead according to the word of the Lord. Definitely it will be surprising to see a tree in that state just by a word spoken.The disciples may have thought that the words Jesus spoke to the fig tree, were mere words. They didn't think what He said was enough to change the condition of the fig tree.Jesus takes advantage of the moment to explain to the disciples how to make things happen and to cause changes."And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God." (Mark 11:22)When Jesus said they should have faith in God, he didn't mean to say they should generate and depend on their own faith. He literally said they should have the faith of God.
What causes changes is not your self-generated faith or confidence in your own efforts. What causes changes is the faith which is of God.
Look at the text in the Passion Translation:"Jesus replied, “Let the faith of God be in you! (Mark 11:22)To have faith in God is to let the faith of God dwell in you.The faith of God indwells you through His word.It is not determined by what you see with the optical eyes. It is dependent on your confidence in God.The faith of God doesn't wait for the change to happen before it accepts that there is change. Jesus explains this:"This is the reason I urge you to boldly believe for whatever you ask for in prayer—believe that you have received it and it will be yours" Mark 11:24 (TPT)Did you see it?When some people pray, they rather want to see it happen before they believe that it has happened.
When you pray, believe that you have received it and it will be yours.
When you reverse the order, you are not acting according to the faith of God.When you pray to God by faith concerning an infirmity, believe and receive the miracle. You may feel the pain at the time when you have the faith that you have received your miracle. Sometimes the situation may seem like it cannot change.Don't change your conviction and confidence of the miracle. Don't give room for doubt in your heart. 
Doubt is denying the evidence of the word of God and believing what you see with your eyes and feel.
At the time when Jesus spoke to the fig tree, there was no evidence that it would be shrivelled up. When He spoke there were no changes on the outside. But by faith, the change happened.Beloved, whatever you ask the Father believe that you have received it and it will happen.
The faith of God cannot fail.
You will have your miracle refuse to doubt!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Psalm 62:8; Psalm 50:15) WE PRAY We pray that we shall let the faith of God have full expression in our lives and confront situations in the confidence of God's word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Amos 2 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have absolute confidence in God. - I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. - I have the faith of God. - I don't doubt the word of God. - The faith I have cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 590 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 4th September, 2024FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 2"And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God...Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours." Mark 11:22, 24 (ESV)Have you ever been in a moment when you felt so much faith but didn't see the results of your prayer?Well, sometimes, during such moments, you may not be acting in faith. You may be acting confidently in your own efforts.There are times people believe in their efforts made in prayer rather than the ability of God. You will always be disappointed if you look at yourself.
To have faith is to have confidence in God and His saving ability. Faith is not vim!
Faith is not how you feel. Faith is not waiting for a change. Faith is believing without a doubt in your heart that the change has happened and you have received it.The faith of God in your heart cannot fail.As we noticed in yesterday's episode, Jesus didn't have any doubt in His heart when He spoke to the fig tree. The fig tree didn't shrivel up simply because Jesus is the Savior of the world or because He is God. If that was the case then there was no need for Jesus to tell His disciples, "let the faith of God be in you."With such a response, Jesus was explaining to the disciples the secret to cause changes.Jesus went on to make the disciples understand that they can speak to anything at all by the faith of God.As He spoke to the fig tree, they can also speak to the mountains.How is it possible to speak to the mountain to move?It is by believing in your heart that whatever you say will happen because you have the faith of God."Jesus replied, “Let the faith of God be in you! Listen to the truth I speak to you: If someone says to this mountain with great faith and having no doubt, ‘Mountain, be lifted up and thrown into the midst of the sea,’ and believes that what he says will happen, it will be done. Mark 11:22-23 (TPT)For Jesus to use this example that the disciples can say to a mountain be lifted and thrown into the sea, it means they can speak to change every situation.If you can have the faith of God in your heart you can speak to that infirmity in your body to be moved and be lifted into the sea.If a mountain will disappear at the word spoken in faith then that kidney condition will disappear from your body; the cancer in the breast will leave; the growth in your brain will disappear, the health condition in your lungs will disappear as you will not doubt in your heart.To doubt is to be uncertain or to be afraid that what you have said will not happen. And mostly people doubt because they esteem the situation rather than the power of God. Others also doubt because they look at themselves and their incapabilities rather than the ability of God.All things were made by the word of God. Therefore, when you speak forth God's word and you believe in your heart, the change will happen!
Don't keep quiet to watch the mountains before you. You can speak to it now according to the word of the Lord.
That heart disease or cancer or tumor of any kind can desiccate completely or wither from the root.Speak forth the word of God in faith without any doubt in your heart!Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1MEDIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Psalm 62:8; Psalm 50:15) WE PRAY We speak to any mountain in our lives to be removed and lifted into the sea. We speak to any unwanted condition in our lives to be uprooted in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Amos 5 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute confidence in God. – I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. – I have the faith of God. – I don’t doubt the word of God. – The faith of God in my heart cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 591 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 3—BE FULL OF THE WORD!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 5th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 3— BE FULL OF THE WORD!"Faith, then, is birthed in a heart that responds to God’s anointed utterance of the Anointed One" Romans 10:17 (TPT) As I have already established, to have the faith of God is to have the word of God in you and to confidently act on His word.
The faith of God is not generated automatically in your heart. It is birthed in your heart through the word of God.
It is not everyone that has faith (2 Thessalonians 3:2).To have the faith of God you must receive His word. Until you hear and respond to the word, faith will not be birthed in your heart.By grace you are saved through faith in Jesus (Ephesians 2:8). This faith comes by the reception of the gospel of Jesus which has been preached.Now just as you received and came to Christ, even so, you must continue your walk in Him. You came to Christ by faith through His word.You can only continue living consistently by faith through His word."In the same way you received Jesus our Lord and Messiah by faith, continue your journey of faith, progressing further into your union with Him!" Colossians 2:6 (TPT).The just shall live by faith. Faith comes by hearing the word. Thus, you live by the word which produces faith.
You cannot have a strong faith-life without being absorbed by the word.
Like the example of Peter the apostle, I gave in other episodes. He was able to catch fish because he acted according to the word of the Lord. That is faith at work.As long as you respond to the word without doubt, you will see faith at work.When you allow the word of God to dominate your thoughts and imagination, it will change your estate. Your domain will always be designed by the thoughts which has dominated your heart and mind.You act in doubt and fear because your mind is dominated by the negative condition. Don't give your mind to negative reports (either from the outside world or from your own body). Believe in the report of the word.
What the word of God says about you and your situation is more real than how you feel.
The word of God is the wisdom of God. All things were made by His word; these include the organs of your body. If they were made according to the word of God, then they can function according to the word of God.Sometimes the adversary uses a situation you are going through to sow seeds of death in your imagination.Beloved, when you are overwhelmed by the fear of death, it means you are meditating on thoughts of death. Such thoughts can only be dealt with by setting your mind on what God has said in His word.For example:When you are struggling with a health condition. The adversary will begin to transmit thoughts of death into your heart.Some believers hurriedly begin to quote scriptures. The quoting of scriptures doesn't make the difference. It is the declaration of the Rhema-word (the revelation of the word in your heart) that makes the difference.Some may be quoting the scriptures or making positive confessions out of fear. People may even say, "He was always quoting or speaking positively that he will not die or he will not be sick. How come this happened to him."To act the word in faith:First, take hold of the word of God. Don't rush to declare the word. Take a moment to meditate on the word. You have to masticate the word in your heart. Mutter and regurgitate it as you create an imagination of life and strength.So you take a scripture like:"I shall not die, but I shall live, and recount the deeds of the LORD" Psalm 118:17 (ESV).As you think about it (which is the first level of meditation), you minister the revelation of the word to yourself.This is how you think and meditate on the word in your heart and on your lips using Psalm 118:17:- "I shall not die but I live. I don't just live, but I live with purpose. The purpose of declaring the great deeds of the Lord".- I am God's workmanship created unto good works (Ephesians 2:10). Therefore I live for the good works of the Lord. I live to show forth the praises of Him who called me out of darkness (1 Peter 2:9).- "For in death and in the grave who shall give God thanks?" (Psalm 6:5). My life is to show forth God's glory and abound in thanksgiving. I am not done with my purpose on earth. "Therefore I shall not die!"Then you begin to shout the word. You begin to declare the word by faith, through the revelation in your heart.As you declare and shout it boldly, you direct your thoughts and imagination towards those glorious words. When the adversary brings up wrong images, you take your mind off that image and paint the right kind of picture you want to see in your life. This is according to the word of God in you.
You cannot be full of the word and not have the right picture in your heart. Every mental picture is created by thoughts.
Let your thoughts be flooded by the word of God.No matter the situation persistently and confidently stick to the word.In this kind of environment of the word, you exercise a dimension of faith which cannot fail.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_--SnHZsxbQDIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Deuteronomy 6:6; Psalm 37:31; Deuteronomy 11:8) WE PRAY We pray that the Holy Spirit shall guide us into the Word and saturate our hearts with the right word we need for our situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Amos 8 - 9Obadiah 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute confidence in God. – I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. – I have the faith of God. – I don’t doubt the word of God. – The faith of God in my heart cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 592 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 4 — SPEAKING FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 6th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 4— SPEAKING FAITH"We have the same Spirit of faith that is described in the Scriptures when it says, “First I believed, then I spoke in faith.” 2 Corinthians 4:13(TPT)One of the important principles you must know about faith is the expressiveness of faith. Faith is the evidence or the proof of what you have received.You cannot say you have faith and be silent. Faith speaks!To act in faith is to act according to God's word, and God is not silent. Even in His silence, there is a message. "For God speaks again and again" Job 33:14 (TLB)
As believers in Christ, we have the life of God and also we are to live His life by imitating Him.
"Imitate God, therefore, in everything you do, because you are his dear children." Ephesians 5:1(NLT)As imitators of God, we also speak as God speaks.Please understand that to say faith is not silent doesn't mean faith speaks unnecessarily. Faith doesn't speak anything at all that comes to mind. To speak in faith is not to be idle chatter. Faith speaks or vocalizes the revelation of the word of God.Faith germinates in your heart, through the meditation of the Word of God spoken or declared to you. The Word of God in you is a seed which grows to be faith.When the word matures as faith in your heart (through meditation) it comes forth also as the "rhema-word" which produces the results or the miracle you have conceptualized. Some people assume to meditate on the word is to be quiet or silent like yoga practitioners.Meditation to the believer in Christ, is not the emptying of the mind. 
God-centred meditation is the filling and saturation of the mind with the truth or word of God. 
And as the mind absorbs the revelation of the word, it begins to mutter the words and then as faith increases, you shout the word with boldness.The first demonstration of faith is in the words you speak. You cannot speak doubt and act in faith. You will consistently act in faith when you think and speak faith.You can only speak the word when you are full of the word of God.In Genesis 1, God spoke light, life and matter into the formless and empty earth. By speaking He created everything that is needed to make existence on earth comfortable.You must not continue to watch on to the discomfort around you. You must not assume that things will change around you automatically. You must be intentional about the speaking of the word.
Create the miracle you want to see by speaking in faith.
Do you believe what God says?Then you must speak forth His word with boldness.He has said, that you may boldly say!Jesus in every circumstance spoke and acted out the word.Jesus said to the disciples, if you have faith you will SAY to the mountain be moved (Mark 11:23)Beloved, find out what God has said in His word concerning your health, your finances, your ministry, your family, your destiny, your work, your marriage and your society.Believe it and boldly declare it.
God is a speaking God, His faith in you is a speaking faith. Don't be quiet.
Glory to God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uI6JK8gO5N4&t=24sDIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Psalm 19:14; Hebrews 13:5-6) WE PRAY We pray that the revelation of God's word shall saturate our minds and tongues with the life of the word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Jonah 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute confidence in God. – I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. – I have the faith of God. – I don’t doubt the word of God. – The faith of God in my heart cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 593 - YOU CARRY HIS FULLNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 7th September, 2024YOU CARRY HIS FULLNESS“But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us” 2 Corinthians 4:7 (NKJV)There are some thoughts which control our mindsets and how we think about our lives.For example: You might have heard people make statements like:“We came to this world empty, and we will all leave empty”
How can this be true?
Some people have really made this thought pattern their consciousness. They think they came to this world empty, so their lives are empty.These thoughts even control the mindsets of certain saints in Christ.
A man in Christ cannot be empty. A man without God has an empty life.
When you become born again, you receive the treasure of God into you.This treasure is the fullness of the life of God in you.You can’t carry this life and be empty.The thoughts of emptiness are not of God.“For His divine power has bestowed on us [absolutely] everything necessary for [a dynamic spiritual] life and godliness, through true and personal knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.” 1 Peter 1:3 (Amplified)In your relationship with God, you are supplied with EVERYTHING about life and godliness (the expression of divinity).Some feel empty because they don’t feel satisfied, or complete.
If you are unsatisfied, you are looking at the wrong places.
Beloved, you are made complete in Christ. Stop looking at things you think you lack or don’t have. Look inside, you have God’s greatest treasure.Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:2-4; Matthew 13:44-46; Colossians 2:9-10) WE PRAYThat we will grow and increase in the knowledge of the fullness of this rich reality. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Jonah 4Micah 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am not empty.- I carry the fullness of the life of God in me.- I am made complete in Christ.- I carry God’s greatest treasure in me.- My life is not empty.-  I am supplied with EVERYTHING pertaining to life and godliness.Oh Gloreeey! Hallelujah[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 594 - GOD RESISTS THE PROUD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday 8th, September 2024 GOD RESISTS THE PROUD“Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.”Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)
Pride is one of the strong weapons of the enemy against your faith and fulfilment of purpose.
The adversary knows that “Pride goes before destruction” (Proverbs 16:18).Therefore to destroy any beautiful destiny, he sows and cultivates pride in the hearts of men.
A proud person is resisted and cannot increase in grace.
Pride makes a person disrespect, disdain, and act arrogantly towards others. It makes one overesteem himself above others.Pride makes you self-centered and unruly. You always want things to go your way and pay no attention to anyone. Pride makes you do what you feel and despises wise counsel.Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. You cannot resist the devil when you are proud. To resist the devil, you must first humble yourself before the Lord. James said, “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you” (James 4:7).David didn’t confront Goliath in the might of the flesh or his strength and intelligence but in the name of the Lord.
Pride will not make you submit your mind, thoughts, and emotions to the Lord.
The adversary was the first in God’s universe to demonstrate pride. He began to exalt himself above the Lord. That was the cause of his fall.God has exalted His word, so when you begin to esteem your opinions above the word of God, you are already on the path of the devil. The end will surely be destruction.“for the day is coming when your proud looks will be brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted. On that day the Lord Almighty will move against the proud and haughty and bring them to the dust. All the tall cedars of Lebanon and all the mighty oaks of Bashan shall bend low, and all the high mountains and hills, and every high tower and wall, and all the proud ocean ships and trim harbor craft—all shall be crushed before the Lord that day. All the glory of mankind will bow low; the pride of men will lie in the dust, and the Lord alone will be exalted.” Isaiah 2:11-17 (TLB)
The adversary sets you up for failure and disgrace through pride. Intentionally deal with pride.
True faith towards God is humble. It takes humility to look away from your challenges and to exercise confidence in what God has said.“God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble.” Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you” (1Peter 5:5-7)It will take the attitude of humility to take up the shield of faith. Don’t trust in your intelligence above the knowledge of God’s word. 
Don’t be big-headed, be humble at all times.
Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Micah 6:8; Isaiah 3:16-26; Colossians 3:12; 2 Chronicles 7:14; Luke 14:11; Proverbs 3:34) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be helped by the Holy Spirit to consciously walk in the humility of heart at all times and in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Micah 3 - 5  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I submit my will, emotions, thoughts and body to the Lord. – The word of God directs my life. – There’s no place for pride in my heart. – By the help of the Holy Spirit, I walk in humble at all times in all things.Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 595 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 5 — FAITH IS DARING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 9th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 5— FAITH IS DARING"Abraham never wavered in believing God’s promise. In fact, his faith grew stronger, and in this he brought glory to God." Romans 4:20 (NLT)To have faith is to have absolute confidence in God. Faith doesn't doubt!This is why faith cannot fail. It is not confidence in things; it is confidence in the source and creator of all things—GOD!
The faith that works is not self-confidence. The faith of God is confidence in God.
It is not merely about being enthusiastic or having vim. It is to be bold or audacious. The confidence in God makes you dare to take steps the normal mind wouldn't dare to take.The word of God is supernatural. Whatever God says is not limited to the optics. The word of God produces extraordinary results. 
To act on the word requires an audacious or daring posture.
Abraham didn't automatically walk in the fulfillment of the word of God. He acted in faith. Abraham dared to believe what God said."We call Abraham “father” not because he got God’s attention by living like a saint, but because God made something out of Abraham when he was a nobody. Isn’t that what we’ve always read in Scripture, God saying to Abraham, “I set you up as father of many peoples”? Abraham was first named “father” and then became a father because he dared to trust God to do what only God could do: raise the dead to life, with a word make something out of nothing. When everything was hopeless, Abraham believed anyway, deciding to live not on the basis of what he saw he couldn’t do but on what God said he would do. And so he was made father of a multitude of peoples. God himself said to him, “You’re going to have a big family, Abraham!” Romans 4:17-18 (Message).Faith has to be daring because it is to act on what God has said against every hopeless situation. Whatever God says contradicts what you may see, experience or feel. God's word contradicts your present situation; thus, you must dare to act on it, so that you can lay hold on the miracle.Against every opposing or contradicting voice, you must remain resolute and confident in what God has said.
Faith dares to stand on God's word no matter the storm.
BE DARING!Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPB64uq5QO4&t=188sDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray that our confidence in God shall increase by the day so that we dare to believe what God says and act it out. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Micah 6 - 7Nahum 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strong and courageous. – My faith works. – I am audacious in faith. – I dare to stand on God's word no matter the storm. – I am daring. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 596 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 6 — FAITH IS DARING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 10th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 6— FAITH IS DARING"Abraham never wavered in believing God’s promise. In fact, his faith grew stronger, and in this he brought glory to God." Romans 4:20 (NLT)To be daring in faith is not to have vim or be enthusiastic. To have a daring faith or to be daring in faith is to act on the word of God.Until you act on God's word, you have no faith. Faith doesn't stand without the word. The reality is that without God's word, there is no faith.The faith which Abraham had was based on God's word. David's audacious decision to confront Goliath was based on the covenant relationship between God and Israel.You cannot be daring in faith without the word of God. Your confidence in the word of God in you is what makes you bold. 
Anyone without the word is defenseless.
When you step out there in faith, you are not afraid to fall because you know the Lord shall help you from falling. When the storm comes you are not threatened because you know you are planted in the Lord and you shall not be moved.When the need arises you are not perturbed because you know the Lord takes care of you.Most people don't think that Abraham had to be daring to accept the name God gave him. To accept the name means he was going about announcing that he is going to have many sons against all odds."We call Abraham “father” not because he got God’s attention by living like a saint, but because God made something out of Abraham when he was a nobody. Isn’t that what we’ve always read in Scripture, God saying to Abraham, “I set you up as father of many peoples”? Abraham was first named “father” and then became a father because he dared to trust God to do what only God could do: raise the dead to life, with a word make something out of nothing. When everything was hopeless, Abraham believed anyway, deciding to live not on the basis of what he saw he couldn’t do but on what God said he would do. And so he was made father of a multitude of peoples. God himself said to him, “You’re going to have a big family, Abraham!” Romans 4:17-18 (Message).
Faith dares to believe that God will do what He says He will do even when everything seems to be hopeless.
Abraham did not doubt God, wasn't skeptical and did not give up even though they had had decades of infertility.Abraham stood on God's word and had confidence that God had all the power to do or fulfill His promises.This is how daring faith acts out the word of God.Daring faith caused mothers to receive back their dead children.Consider the example of the Shunammite; when her son died, she didn't go about announcing. She remains composed in faith. Even when the husband asked about the child, she said "ALL IS WELL".Don't water down that phrase, ALL IS WELL. It wasn't a remark of hopelessness. All is well is a bold remark of faith in the face of adversity.She went to the Prophet Elisha with strong confidence that her child would come back to life. (2 Kings 4:18-37)
Faith is daring and doesn't kowtow to negative news, nor to challenges and situations which contradict God's word.
Be daring in faith, knowing that God will do what He says He will do. Don't doubt the word of God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2fuYRudnGK8DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray that as we boldly act out the Word of God we shall see the fulfillment of all that God has said to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Nahum 3Habakkuk 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strong and courageous. – My faith works. – I am audacious in faith. – I dare to stand on God’s word no matter the storm. – I am daring. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 597 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 7 — FAITH IS OBEDIENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 11th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 7— FAITH IS OBEDIENT"Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God." Hebrews 11:7 (CEV)The matter of faith is not an assumption nor a mere enthusiasm.The faith which cannot fail is:- A faith full of the Word of God. The word of God is the source of faith. Without the word of God, there is no germination of the faith of God. Faith comes with the Word of God.-  A speaking faith. Faith is not silent. Faith vocalizes the word of God.- A daring faith. Faith is not a coward. The faith which cannot fail is audacious or confident. Faith boldly acts on the word against all odds.To have faith is not just to act according to your desire. To have faith is to act in accordance with the word of God.
Faith is obedience to God.
Before the flood, God instructed Noah to build an ark. The period during which God instructed Noah he had no sign of any possible flood. It never made sense to the people that the whole world would be destroyed by flood. The people couldn't imagine the possibility of such news.Noah didn't build the ark because he had physical evidence of the coming flood. What Noah knew was that God has spoken and he must obey Him.Noah could have joined the people in his days to doubt the instruction of the Lord. But his faith or trust in God made him obey the word of the Lord even though it didn't make sense.Moses demonstrated faith when he obeyed God by performing the rite of Passover and sprinkled the lamb's blood, to prevent the destroyer from harming their firstborn.The obedience of faith is not just following some rules and regulations. 
The obedience of faith is submitting to the authority and power of the word of God.
No matter what you see around you, submit your mind to what God says.As you walk in the obedience of the word of God, you are walking in the faith of God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPB64uq5QO4DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall submit to the power of the word so that we will fully walk in obedience to what it says. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Habakkuk 3Zephaniah 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit to the authority and power of the word of God! - I walk in obedience to what God says. - In the face of opposition and adversity, I choose to obey the word - Faith is my evidence. - The word of God has power over me. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 598 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 8 — FAITH IS ABOVE FACTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 12th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 8— FAITH IS ABOVE FACTS"In spite of being nearly one hundred years old when the promise of having a son was made, his faith was so strong that it could not be undermined by the fact that he and Sarah were incapable of conceiving a child." Romans 4:19 (TPT)To be born again is to be born from above. Which means you live a higher life. Every life is governed by a law. The higher life of God or the life from above is lived by faith. Faith is the law that causes you to live in the frequency of God.Thus, without faith, it is impossible to please God (Hebrews 11:6).Though faith is a spiritual law it is lived in the natural. The life of faith lived in the natural is the supernatural life."...the life that I live now in the flesh, I live by the faith of the son of God..." (Galatians 2:20).
The believer in Christ lives by faith in the natural realm.
You should note that the natural realm also has its own laws. These laws rule and determine how things work. When you know and understand these natural laws you can use them to your advantage.It is God who sets these laws in place. The law of thermodynamics, the law of sound and light, the law of motion, electricity and gravity, etc. serve mankind.These laws also come with limitations. Thus, to operate above these laws you must know how to activate a higher law. Sometimes the understanding of laws can cause another law to even work in your favor instead of limiting you.Though there is the law of gravity, the law or force of buoyancy causes hot-air balloons or blimps to float in the air.The law of faith is a higher law which operates above natural laws. It also causes other laws to work together to produce the expected results.The law of faith doesn't deny the facts. The reason faith has to be released is because of the facts. 
A man of faith has an awareness of the facts but doesn't allow the power of the facts to rule over him.
As you can see in the opening verse, Abraham had awareness of their physical condition and limitations but did not allow their condition to undermine the word of God.So you may have a health challenge in your body, don't first assume or pretend the challenge doesn't exist. 
Faith doesn't pretend but rather faces the challenge with the word of God.
You may feel a sudden sharp pain in your leg. Don't say by faith I don't feel any pain.The first thing you have to do is to first release your faith through words. You speak to the challenge or speak to the pain, by commanding its cause to get out of your body.Now speaking to it means, you are aware that the pain is there but the pain and its cause don't have power over you.You must continue to speak the word of God to it till you have the full conviction that the pain is gone by faith. At this level, you may still feel the pain, but because you have first released the word and addressed it you can now say the pain is gone.This was what God did with Abraham and Sarah. God was aware that Abraham and Sarah were childless. He didn't first ignore the situation. He first released His word to Abraham that He shall have a child and be a father of many nations.After the word was released Abraham now settled his heart and mind on the word of the Lord. He made the word his victory note and stood on that word that he is a father of many nations. He continued to live in it daily till the manifestation of the word.Do you feel sick in your body?Identify the situation and then release the word of God to it and begin to walk in the word. As you now walk in the word by faith, you no longer accept the facts. You continue confidently in the word of God.
Beloved, live above the facts by faith.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_--SnHZsxbQDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray and release the word of God into that troubling situation that by the power of God there will be total change in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Zephaniah 3Haggai 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live by faith against all odds. – I refuse to allow the power of any fact to have rule over me, rather I walk in the word of God. – I live by faith. – My confidence is in the word of God. – The word of God has power over me. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 599 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 9 — FAITH IS PERSISTENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 13th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 9— FAITH IS PERSISTENT"But the just shall live by faith [My righteous servant shall live by his conviction respecting man’s relationship to God and divine things, and holy fervor born of faith and conjoined with it]; and if he draws back and shrinks in fear, My soul has no delight or pleasure in him." Hebrews 10:38 (AMPC)Faith is proven even more when there is opposition. No matter the opposition which confronts you, you must continue in faith.As Paul, the apostle wrote concerning Abraham:"Against all odds, when it looked hopeless, Abraham believed the promise and expected God to fulfill it. He took God at his word, and as a result he became the father of many nations. God’s declaration over him came to pass: “Your descendants will be so many that they will be impossible to count!” Romans 4:18 (TPT).There were physical factors which were enough reasons for Abraham to doubt God’s word and to draw back in expectation. But he decided to continue trusting the Lord and do what He said.To have faith doesn't mean you will not be opposed.Faith doesn't necessarily take away challenges. 
Faith supplies you with the ability to withstand every challenge.
Faith doesn't doubt but remains resolute on the word of God.Faith doesn't draw back!Faith presses on until the promise is received.No matter how things may seem to delay, faith doesn't change course. It remains focused on the word of the Lord.Even when everything seems to suggest that you should give up, you still stand strong.The present happenings around your health, finances, etc may seem to distract your focus and erode your conviction in the word. But as you release your faith in the word, you will be able to exercise the victory that Christ has obtained for you.Persevering faith doesn't yield to the storm. It doesn't turn away from the will of God. It doesn't just try to hang on in doubt and fear, it stands firm and confidently in the word.
Persevering faith doesn't blink an eye away from the Word.
Does it look like you have declared the word of the Lord concerning your life and it seems not to manifest?Are you beginning to doubt and to give up?No!It's time to persevere in faith.The goal of the adversary is to make you draw back. He knows you have the victory, but he is determined not to go down without a fight. Don't believe in his deception or lies. Don't accept the lie that you are defeated.To accept defeat is to behave like an athlete leading in a 1500m race in a stadium, and just when he is about to get to the finish line, he sees the last runner who has about 400m more to go and begins to think he still couldn't overtake all the competitors.Listen, the devil lost the battle even before you began. Jesus won it all for you. You are the champion, don't think that challenge is still ahead of you. You have gone past it. 
Finish your race and receive your crown of victory with joy.
Don't give up! Don't doubt! Don't draw back! Maintain your composure of faith.Keep declaring the word of God. Keep shouting the victory you have received concerning your health, your finances, your purpose, your family, and your ministry.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:16-18; James 1:12; Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray that we shall be strengthened more by the word of God to persevere in faith irrespective of the challenge or circumstances. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Zechariah 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live by faith against all odds. – I refuse to allow the power of any fact to have rule over me, rather I walk in the word of God. – I live by faith. – My confidence is in the word of God. – The word of God has power over me. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 600 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 10 — FAITH IS PERSISTENT 2
content:
