CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 14th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 10— FAITH IS PERSISTENT 2"But you need to stick it out, staying with God’s plan so you’ll be there for the promised completion." Hebrews 10:36 (Message) «««««««««««««««««««««««««««««««««««Huraaaay!  Today marks a major milestone - Episode 600!  Oh, Thank you, Lord Jesus!  And to you dear reader, we're grateful for your loyalty and support throughout this journey.»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»»The perseverance of faith is the quality of faith that makes you stay with God's plan and word no matter the difficult circumstance without compromising.It is one thing to say you believe in God when there are no challenges. It is another thing to believe in God's word even amid contrary opinions or challenges.Some people easily give up on God's word and begin to look for other alternatives, when things seem not to go as planned or expected.
To doubt the truth and power of the word of God simply because you didn't see your expectations is evidence that you are not exercising faith or not persevering in faith.
When Jesus heard that Lazarus his friend was sick, He said Lazarus's sickness is not unto death. Yet, Lazarus still died. Did Jesus change His confession? Did Jesus doubt the truth of the word He spoke? Jesus persevered in faith. He held on to that word and believed that, though Lazarus is buried he shall rise and live again! (John 11:23)Oh hallelujah!Faith is audacious and persistent. Faith cannot be silenced. Faith focuses on the expectation and goes for it irrespective of the opposition. Faith doesn't give up. Faith doesn't say, it cannot happen again. Faith says no, there is a way forward, even when all paths are blocked. Faith doesn't think of impossibilities. Faith says with God all things are possible.Did you read how God made a way in the Red Sea for the Israelites?
Faith always has a way forward.
A man of faith doesn't take no for an answer; unless the "no" is from God.When Jesus heard that Lazarus was dead, He didn't quit. Faith doesn't quit. Yes, He wept and had intense emotions. But that wasn't an emotional breakdown. That was a demonstration of love for His friend. They said, "Look how much He loved Lazarus" (John 11:35-36).As Jesus stood before the tomb of Lazarus, what was on His mind? What made Him think Lazarus would rise again?Jesus said, "I am the resurrection and the life" (John 11:25).What an audacity! He didn't beg nor ask in fear. He said to them roll the stone.As Martha was thinking about how impossible it would be for Lazarus to be raised, because of the decomposition of his body, Jesus told her to BELIEVE! (John 11:38-40).Before Jesus commanded Lazarus to come out of the grave, He spoke to the Father saying, "Father thank you that you have heard my prayer".Then He commanded Lazarus to come out of the grave.Did you see that?Beloved, the persistence of faith is demonstrated through:1. Prayer2. Continuous declaration of what God said.3. Taking bold action.Your persistence in prayer is not faithlessness. To persist in prayer is to enforce the word of God and to demand an answer.There are times you have declared the word of the Lord, that you shall not be sick, for example. And then after some time, you start seeing symptoms of some sickness. Don't ignore the situation or the facts all in the name of faith. Faith doesn't fake it nor pretend. Faith acts out the word. And don't also accept the power of the facts over you. As you notice those symptoms take hold of the word.
Even as the situation seems to grow worse, remain resolute on the word of God.
This is where you boldly persist in faith to see the manifestation of your healing.Maybe when you started experiencing the condition you were praying one-hour a day about the situation and it continued. Don't say my prayers didn't work.No! Rather, pray for two more hours. If you don't see a change, cancel all other activities. Spend time on the word of God, listen to messages that will stir and strengthen your faith, and make time to pray more with intensity.  Continue the meditation of the word concerning your healing. Pray more to enforce God's word in your life until you lay hold on the victory note. Don't stop there. You must continue persisting in faith with thanksgiving. Continue by rejoicing in faith till you fully see the manifestation of your health.This is how you walk in answers through the perseverance of faith.
Be persistent.
Selah!Were you blessed by today's episode?Did you know that there are partners who make it possible for us to reach you everyday with this Spirit-Word?WITH A GIFT OF ANY AMOUNT YOU CAN JOIN THESE PARTNERS.SEND US A MAIL TODAY @withapostlebennie@gmail.comJOIN THE SPREAD OF THE GOSPEL.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Luke 11:1-13; 2 Corinthians 4:16-18; James 1:12; Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray standing on the word of God to see the complete manifestation of what God said concerning our situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Zechariah 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My faith is persistent. - Until I see the manifestation of the things that I have spoken, I don't give up. - I refuse to give up, I remain resolute on the word of God. - I live by faith against all odds. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 601 - FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 11— FAITH IS PERSISTENT 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 15th September, 2024 FAITH THAT CANNOT FAIL 11— FAITH IS PERSISTENT 3"But you need to stick it out, staying with God’s plan so you’ll be there for the promised completion." Hebrews 10:36 (Message)Giving up or quitting is not an option. The perseverance of faith has nothing to do with giving up.As I explained yesterday, perseverance of faith is the quality of faith that makes you stay with God's plan and His word no matter the difficult circumstances without compromising.You can read yesterday's episode again to understand perseverance through the example of Jesus.Again, in yesterday's episode, I pointed out three ways you can demonstrate the persistence of faith. These are:1. Prayer2. Continuous declaration of what God said.3. Taking bold action.Faith is not silent; faith speaks! Faith vocalizes what God says. Wherever there is faith, there is also the speaking of what God has said!"Since we have the same spirit of faith according to what has been written, “I believed, and so I spoke,” we also believe, and so we also speak" 2 Corinthians 4:13 (ESV).As you continue to speak boldly in faith, you will also be moved to act the word. Faith is truly living when you take action.Like the woman with the issue of blood, who got healed of her affliction when she touched the garment of Jesus. She kept saying to herself “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.” (Mark 5:28, Berean Standard Bible).
The continuous speaking of the word of God in boldness will move you into action. Don't keep quiet!
No matter how the situation becomes tough, don't change your confession. Continue speaking and acting in faith.Don't doubt your prayers. Don't assume the prayers wouldn't work.Prayer is not one of the options. Prayer is the first strategy of every man of faith. It takes humility to pray (2 Chronicles 7:14). And it takes confidence or total trust in God to pray (Proverbs 3:5-6).You must have the confidence that whatever you ask for in prayer to God you will receive. When you stop praying or refuse to be persistent in prayer, you are demonstrating faithlessness in God.As part of Jesus teaching His disciples on prayer, He also taught them to persist in prayer.
To persist in prayer is to enforce the word of God and to demand an answer no matter the matter.
Like I previously said, when you pray for an hour each day and don't get the expected results, make time to pray for more hours in faith until you fully have the conviction of the answer in your spirit!
Your persistence in prayer is not faithlessness.
This was how the Lord illustrated persistence in faith:"Then Jesus gave this illustration: “Imagine what would happen if you were to go to one of your friends in the middle of the night and pound on his door and shout, ‘Please! Do you have some food you can spare? A friend just arrived at my house unexpectedly and I have nothing to serve him.’ But your friend says, ‘Why are you bothering me? The door’s locked and my family and I are all in bed. Do you expect me to get up and give you our food?’ But listen—because of your shameless impudence, even though it’s the middle of the night, your friend will get up out of his bed and give you all that you need. So it is with your prayers. Ask and you’ll receive. Seek and you’ll discover. Knock on heaven’s door, and it will one day open for you. Every persistent person will get what he asks for. Every persistent seeker will discover what he needs. And everyone who knocks persistently will one day find an open door." Luke 11:5-10 (TPT)This is amazing!From the illustration Jesus gave, you must:1. Know that you can always at all times turn to God. Even in a situation where you need an urgent solution.2. God is the best friend and Father you can run to for help at all times.3. You must have shameless impudence!4. Every persistent person can have what they ask for.For you to be persistent is to be shamelessly impudent. In this sense, it means you must be bold, forward, audacious and presumptuous (as in not observing any form of limitation).
Don't cower or recoil simply because you have not seen any answer yet. Be persistent!
Continue shamelessly in prayer to God, until you see the change you are looking for or the manifestation of the word!Remember being persistent is not faithlessness but rather a consistent attitude of faith.Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Luke 11:1-13; 2 Corinthians 4:16-18; James 1:12; Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAY We pray declaring and taking hold of what God has said in His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Zechariah 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My faith is persistent. – Until I see the manifestation of the things that I have spoken, I don’t give up. – I refuse to give up, I remain resolute on the word of God.– Prayer is my first strategy.– I don't cower or recoil, I am persistent.Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 602 - OUTSOURCE YOUR ANXIETY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 16th September, 2024 OUTSOURCE YOUR ANXIETY"Throw the whole of your anxiety upon Him, because He Himself cares for you." 1 Peter 5:7 (Weymouth New Testament)No matter the level you get to in your walk with God, the adversary won't stop to oppose you with challenges.
The corruption of this world creates waves of anxiety and distress. 
And many believers become victims of such circumstances.Whether you operate from your comfort zone or out of your comfort zone, there is always going to be something which may create anxiety around you.You may be in some form of distress even as you are reading this episode of with . You may be feeling afraid about the future, about your relationship and even about your job.Maybe you are in some debt and are troubled about how things will turn up. The more you find yourself in this state of worry or anxiety, the more you draw back in faith.
The adversary always wants to find the believer in a state of anxiety and worry.
No matter the weight of your challenge or how bad your situation is, do you know God doesn't want you to be anxious?Paul the apostle admonished the Church in Philippi:"Be anxious for nothing..." (Philippians 4:6)Though you may be confronted by challenges or some tough times, it is possible to live without worry, anxiety and distress.The secret is this: amid your challenges, you can outsource your anxiety.When you learn to outsource your anxiety, you walk in peace and joy. Most parents will understand this better. Though children have needs, they don't even know they do have needs. All they think about is, their parents will make provision for them. Have you ever seen a child anxious about what he or she will eat the next day?A child worried about such responsibility is probably born to irresponsible parents. But no baby has such luxury of time to worry.In fact, they don't even have the intelligence to worry about how to meet their needs. They just know they have to demand for what they want. Babies outsource their anxiety. When it comes to your needs be like a child. You have a heavenly Father who cares for you more than you care about yourself.As you can see in the opening verse:"Throw the whole of your anxiety upon Him, because He Himself cares for you."
Stop being anxious and start throwing or casting all your cares and anxiety on the Lord.
This is how the Amplified Bible puts it:"casting all your cares [all your anxieties, all your worries, and all your concerns, once and for all] on Him, for He cares about you [with deepest affection, and watches over you very carefully]" 1 Peter 5:7 (Amplified Bible).Wow!See, your Heavenly Father cares about you [with deepest affection, and watches over you very carefully].Why then do you hold on to your cares? He doesn't even want you to share your worries and concerns. He wants you to cast all to Him. He wants to bear you up. He wants you to outsource it to Him. Let God take care of your worry, as you enjoy His love and satisfaction.
Stop holding on to all your anxieties, all your worries, and all your concerns, once and for all.
Turn to God in prayer. Make all your requests with faith (absolute confidence in God) in your heart that the Lord will answer you completely.This was the posture of David:"The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry." (Psalm 34:15)The cry of the righteous is not a mere emotional breakdown as a result of overwhelming worries and anxiety. This cry is a confident call unto God for help. It is to turn all your worries to God in prayer."The eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer" Psalm 34:15 (Brenton Septuagint Translation)
Stop worrying and start praying. Pray over everything no matter how little it may seem to be.
Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 1:10-18; 1 Samuel 30:6; Psalm 18:6; Matthew 6:25-33) WE PRAY We pray outsourcing every worry, burden and concern to the Lord; that He will supply His help and satisfy our hearts in the midst of the storms. In the Name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Zechariah 10 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I enjoy the Lord's help in every circumstance.- The Lord satisfies my heart in the midst of storms.- I don't hold on to anxiety.- I refuse to be anxious about anything, rather in all situations and at all times through prayer and supplication I cast all my burdens, cares, worries and concerns unto the Lord.Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your great help.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 603 - OUTSOURCE YOUR ANXIETY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 17th September, 2024 OUTSOURCE YOUR ANXIETY 2"Throw the whole of your anxiety upon Him, because He Himself cares for you." 1 Peter 5:7 (Weymouth New Testament)Anxiety is not of God and shouldn't be entertained. Life in Christ is not to be lived in worry or anxiety. Every believer is called to live a life of faith.To live in anxiety is to live out of faith. Thus living by faith is to live a worry-free life.Don't think it's not possible to live a worry-free life. It is highly possible to live a worry-free life. To have a worry-free life doesn't mean you are living a purposeless life or you don't have anything important in your life. 
To live a worry-free life is to live above anxiety.
Worry and anxiety have become the norm of men. Almost everyone (both the poor and the rich) wakes up with anxiety and fear. Even children are now cultured by society to worry.The systems established by men to help men have now become a means of oppression and anxiety: the educational system, family relations, professional space and career pursuit.The society which has to serve as a haven of tranquillity has become like a jungle. Psychologists and counsellors seem not even to have solutions to these situations. Even they are struggling with the anxiety of doing their job well so that the customer will give them high rates.Beloved, God has a permanent solution for anxiety and worry. He passionately cares for you. He has deep affection and interest in all your concerns.He wants you to let Him bear your burdens. He wants you to direct all your concerns to Him.This is how you live a worry-free life.You don't automatically experience a worry-free life. To have a worry-free life you must intentionally outsource your anxiety. As you can see in the opening verse, God would not throw the whole of your anxiety upon Himself. It is your choice to do that. You have to throw the whole of your anxiety upon Him.You have to decide that you are not going to bear it any more. Both the ones you can bear and the ones you cannot bear should be cast onto the Lord.
Don't entertain any form of worry and pain. Don't give anxiety the luxury to thrive around you.
I know you want to know how to outsource your anxiety.Well, Paul the Apostle gives us a clear answer:"Don’t be pulled in different directions or worried about a thing. Be saturated in prayer throughout each day, offering your faith-filled requests before God with overflowing gratitude. Tell him every detail of your life, then God’s wonderful peace that transcends human understanding, will make the answers known to you through Jesus Christ. So keep your thoughts continually fixed on all that is authentic and real, honorable and admirable, beautiful and respectful, pure and holy, merciful and kind. And fasten your thoughts on every glorious work of God, praising him always" Philippians 4:6-8 (TPT)
Do you now see that it's possible to have a worry-free life?
The scripture says: DON'T BE WORRIED ABOUT A THING! Don't be running around in different directions in anxiety not knowing what to do. Don't be confused about your situation. There is a way out of every condition:1. Be saturated in prayer throughout each day, offering your faith-filled requests before God.There should be no day without the saturation of prayer. And your prayers shouldn't be with doubt. Your prayers must be based on the revelation of who God is and what He has said.2. Let your day be saturated with overflowing gratitude.Showing gratitude to God brings you into the consciousness of what God can do. Thanksgiving is the greatest demonstration of faith. Thanksgiving is the confidence and faith that the Lord has already done what He says He will do.3. With the heart of thanksgiving or gratitude you tell God every detail of your life.Take note: Nobody calls upon the Lord in faith and fails. As you talk to God, His wonderful peace that transcends human understanding will make the answers known to you through Jesus Christ. Now did you also notice that your prayers must not be done on some days in a week or even once a day?
You must be saturated in prayer THROUGHOUT EACH DAY.
And as you do that:4. Instead of occupying your mind or thoughts on the matters which create anxiety, you must keep or fasten your thoughts continually on all that is: - authentic and real-  honorable and admirable-  beautiful and respectful-  pure and holy- merciful and kind- every glorious work of God, praising him always.Faith is prompt to outsource every form of worry or anxiety to the Lord. Make a decision today to live a worry-free life.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 1:10-18; 1 Samuel 30:6; Psalm 18:6; Matthew 6:25-33) WE PRAY We pray that we shall enjoy the peace of God and declare that our thoughts will be fastened to that which is glorious and praiseworthy in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Zechariah 12 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I live a worry-free life everyday. - I don't entertain any form of worry and pain.- I refuse to be anxious about anything, rather in all situations and at all times through prayer and supplication I cast all my burdens, cares, worries and concerns unto the Lord.- I give myself to prayer everyday.- I fix my mind and thoughts continually on things which are authentic and real, honorable and admirable, beautiful and respectful, pure and holy, merciful and kind.- With a heart full of gratitude, I praise the Lord always.Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your great help.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 604 - STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 18th September, 2024 STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD"And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God." 1 Samuel 30:6 (English Standard Version)Your first reaction to challenges determines your manifestation.The assumption that you will not face challenges when you become born again is wrong. Challenges will come, but you don't have to allow it to dominate your life. Your duty is to sail through those challenges by the grace of God.
Your level of faith or confidence in God is exposed by the challenges you face.
Challenges though are orchestrations of the adversary and wickedness, none of them has enough ability to break you. If a challenge breaks you then you are weak in strength."If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small" Proverbs 24:10 (NKJV)Beloved God is not expecting you to fall or faint when you are under pressure or confronted by adversity.
He has given you all that you need to live above challenges.
Paul the apostle said, "In every way we're troubled, but we aren't crushed by our troubles. We're frustrated, but we don't give up." 2 Corinthians 4:8 (GOD'S WORD Translation)David, while he was out with his men to join the Philistines in battle, the Amalekites made a raid against Ziklag, the city (where the families of David and his men live). The Amalekites had overcome Ziklag and burned it with fire and taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They killed no one but carried them off and went their way. When David and his men came to the city, they found it burned with fire, and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive. Then David and the people who were with him raised their voices and wept until they had no more strength to weep. (See 1 Samuel 30:1-5)The situation in which David and his men found themselves was discouraging. Now it was so intense that his people thought of stoning him. That was even worse.Because it wasn't just the people who lost their family members. David's wives and children were also taken. Now these people turn to blame David.
That is the burden of leadership. Everyone may blame you.
Beloved, you may feel disappointed or distressed, but pick yourself up in faith. Always remember whom you have believed. In the day of adversity strengthen yourself in the Lord. Don't rely on your strength.That was what David did:"And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God." 1 Samuel 30:6 (ESV).He went on to inquire of the Lord as to what He should do next.
Beloved you gain more strength in the place of prayer.
You must always practice the Pauline prayers."May He grant you out of the riches of His glory, to be strengthened and spiritually energized with power through His Spirit in your inner self, [indwelling your innermost being and personality]" Ephesians 3:16 (Amplified Bible)No matter the situation you find yourself in, strengthen yourself in the Lord. And don't wait for challenges before you strengthen yourself, be ready in the strength of the Lord at all times!Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 12:9; Ephesians 6:10; Psalm 28:8; Psalm 18:2; 1 Samuel 23:16) WE PRAY Pray that the Lord would unveil within you the unlimited riches of His glory and favor until supernatural strength floods your innermost being with His divine might and explosive power. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Malachi 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am strengthened by God in my inner man at all times. - I have the strength to surmount every challenge. - No challenge or situation can dominate my life. - Through the supply of the strength of God, I sail through every challenge victoriously. - I don't loose strength. - Greater is He that is in me, than any challenge that is in the world. - Through prayer, I engage the energies of God within me. - I have strength! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for enabling me with strength in my inner man.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 605 - STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 19th September, 2024 STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD 2"And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God." 1 Samuel 30:6 (English Standard Version)Dear avid reader, I appreciate your consistency in following and fellowshipping with this Christ-centered online devotional.The messages shared here (on with ) are to help you know the application of the word of God in your daily life. You don't just get to know what to do, but you are also taught how to do what to do.It is important for every believer to know and understand the word of God. Your understanding of the word of God helps you live victoriously.The topic I was teaching in yesterday's episode, STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD, has practical details that help you know how to live above distress and challenges.You have to take this teaching to heart and commit everything shared to action. You wouldn't see its potency until you begin to act out the word.
To strengthen yourself in the Lord is not burdensome nor is it legalistic.
To strengthen yourself in the Lord is to take advantage of the resources of the Lord to mount up high above the challenge confronting you.It is turning to the Lord and not turning to oneself. In David's situation, he was already in distress but decided to strengthen himself in the LORD.Sometimes you may feel your situation is worse and you have already sunk deep in discouragement or depression and defeat where nothing could be done.The scripture says, "For “WHOEVER CALLS ON THE NAME OF THE LORD [in prayer] WILL BE SAVED.” Romans 10:13 (Amplified Bible).It is not only those who are yet to be defeated or yet to fall deeply into depression that the Lord saves. It is whosoever or everyone who calls upon the Lord.
It doesn't matter your situation, when you call upon the Lord, you shall be saved.
David was already in distress, yet he made a decision to strengthen Himself in the Lord.Now let me put it right:David was GREATLY DISTRESSED.That's what the scriptures say. David wasn't just distressed. Which means he was utterly shattered. "David was in even worse trouble" (Message Translation).In fact, David and his men burst out in loud wails—wept and wept until they were exhausted with weeping."David was greatly distressed..." (AMPC)."David was in desperation" (CEV)'David wasn't in shallow situation, he "was in deep trouble" (Common English Bible)."David too was in anguish" (VOICE)"David was seriously worried, for in their bitter grief for their children, his men began talking of killing him. But David took strength from the Lord." (TLB)Just in case you find yourself in a worse situation you can still trust the Lord. You can draw strength from the Lord. Don't assume there is no faith in you or you are faithless because you wept or felt distressed.  Not all men have faith, but all those in Christ have faith. There is the faith of God in you. By that faith no matter how small you think it is, you can take hold of God’s hand. All that God is looking for is for you to stretch forth your hand for His help.As Peter noticed he was drowning or sinking, he shouted master save me.
Beloved there is help for you. Strengthen yourself in the Lord.
The word STRENGTHEN as used in 1 Samuel 30:6, is from the Hebrew word "CHÂZAQ" (Pronounced as khaw-zak')The primitive root of this Hebrew word means, "to fasten upon; to bind or restrain". It also means to "cleave, catch or lay hold or take hold and also to seize".Which means to strengthen yourself in the Lord is to bind or fasten yourself to the Lord. Don't allow the flood of your challenge to drown you. Fasten yourself to the Lord who is the solid Rock.
No matter the storm, take hold of the Lord.
The word "châzaq", to be strengthened in Hebrew also means, "to cure, to repair, to amend or mend". This implies that, sometimes the challenge may break you, but when you turn to the Lord, you can repair all the broken pieces. To châzaq also means to have a calker.To be strengthened by the Lord is like a ship which has skilled shipwrights or calkers, who repair or stop the seams of a deck.In the ancient Gebal or Byblos (a city in Phoenicia, located in what is now modern-day Lebanon) they had shipwrights or master shipbuilders, who when employed on a ship, serve as calkers. They are furnished mariners who skilfully service all the various furniture in a vessel. (Ezekiel 27:9). They repair and help damaged ships to sail successfully. These ancients of Gebal are also called "stoppers of chinks" or "strengtheners".Which means the strength of the Lord, serves as a shipwright. It stops all chinks or repairs every form of damage.
To strengthen yourself in the Lord also means to be strong in the Lord, taking advantage of all the mighty power of God. It is to amass the military might of God to your favor.
That was what David did. He was in distress because of the attack by the Amalekites, and he reminded himself that He has God.There is this courage and valiant posture you take on when you know what it means to have help from the Lord.David paused and would have thought to himself: "Why am I in tears? Is the God who helped me defeat Goliath, not my God any more? Why am I dismayed?"David thought of what the torrent flow of God's power can do.He was encouraged. It was these moments that inspired David to sing Psalm 18:1-50.
When you fasten yourself to the Lord you become courageous and fortified.
That is what châzaq also means. To be strengthened in the Lord is to wax mightily, to be programmed to conquer, and to have a restraining force for victory.No matter the pressure you remain firm or obstinate in the Lord. You become too hard to break and maintain an undisturbed composure.
Beloved, strengthen or fortify yourself in the Lord.
Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pY&t=90sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 18;  Ephesians 6:10; Psalm 28:8; Psalm 18:2; 1 Samuel 23:16) WE PRAYPray:1. that every damage or leakage caused by the pressures of life within your emotions and mind will be mended by the strengthening ability of the Lord.2. calling upon the Lord for His mighty help even as you feel distressed. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Malachi 4Matthew 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God in my inner man at all times. – I have the strength to surmount every challenge. – No challenge or situation can dominate my life. – Through the supply of the strength of God, I sail through every challenge victoriously. – I don’t loose strength. – Greater is He that is in me, than any challenge that is in the world. – Through prayer, I engage the energies of God within me. – I have strength! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for enabling me with strength in my inner man.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 606 - STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Dear avid reader, I appreciate your consistency in following and fellowshipping with this Christ-centered online devotional. I have a special prayer for you here. Be Blessed! Author Friday, 20th September, 2024 STRENGTHEN YOURSELF IN THE LORD 3"And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God." 1 Samuel 30:6 (English Standard Version)No matter the distress you find yourself in, understand God has not withdrawn His help from you.As we have previously seen how to respond to challenges and what it really means to be strengthened in the Lord, we will go on today to look at the practical things to do to be strengthened.There are a lot of virtues to glean from the scriptures, concerning the relationship David and other men of faith had with God.Mostly when people are looking for "How factors", they think about some strange list of things. Meanwhile, the secrets of the Lord are the basic things He has written in the word.These things may be things you keep hearing or reading each day, but they are the rich items which make things happen.
No matter how simple or basic these things you keep hearing, you must practice them before seeing the difference they make.
In Psalm 18, you will find David's cogitations on how the Lord delivered him from his enemies and the challenges he faced. As part of the things David addressed in this Psalm, he pointed out that the Lord gave him victory against those who plundered his camp at Ziklag.There is always a way out of trouble or any form of distress.  As long as David had not strengthened himself in the Lord, he was going to remain in his distress.No matter the situation you find yourself in, be determined to act out the word of God.David said, "In my distress, I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry before him came into his ears." Psalm 18:6 (ESV)
To cry to the Lord is to be conscious of the Lord's ability. 
Who is the Lord to you?Is He your helper?Do you have that conviction in your heart that He can help you and will surely help you?Here is what David had to say in the earlier verses of Psalm 18:"The Lord is my fort where I can enter and be safe; no one can follow me in and slay me. He is a rugged mountain where I hide; he is my Savior, a rock where none can reach me, and a tower of safety. He is my shield. He is like the strong horn of a mighty fighting bull. All I need to do is cry to him—oh, praise the Lord—and I am saved from all my enemies!" Psalm 18:2-3 (TLB)If a man has this conviction about God which battle will he lose?"For you have armed me with strong armor for the battle. My enemies quail before me and fall defeated at my feet" Psalm 18:39 (TLB)"You gave me victory in every battle..." Psalm 18:43 (TLB).
There is no way you can have this confidence in God and fail as you follow His leadings.
Your conviction and confidence in God amidst your moments of distress must be intentional.Because one may see and know God's power and yet turn away from him. David was one of those who exceptionally trusted and obeyed the Lord.Look at the Israelites for instance, they had seen God’s power when He invaded Egypt, they saw how He split the Red Sea open. He opened the rock, and water gushed out, and it ran in the dry places like a river. The people asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.He showed them the great power of preservation and provision.Yet, when Moses returned from his meeting with the Lord, he met them worshipping a golden calf. (Exodus 32:1-8).Sadly they even proclaimed among themselves:"...These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt." Exodus 32:8 (NIV)They quickly turned away from the LORD God and denied how He saved them. They even acknowledged another god.They even used the same silver and gold the Lord favored them to receive from the Egyptians to make those idols."He also brought them out with silver and gold,And there was none feeble among His tribes." Psalm 105:37 (See also Exodus 3:21-22; 12:35-36)
This means one wouldn't automatically, walk in the conviction and confidence of God, just because they have seen God’s power.
You must be intentional about who God is to you and you will easily turn to Him for help.Beloved, strengthen or fortify yourself in the Lord.Selah.https://youtu.be/7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Psalm 18; Psalm 46:1; Proverbs 3:5-6; Psalm 28:8; Psalm 18:2; 1 Samuel 23:16) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts will confidently be set on the Lord and receive His help at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Matthew 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God in my inner man at all times. – I have the strength to surmount every challenge. – No challenge or situation can dominate my life. – Through the supply of the strength of God, I sail through every challenge victoriously. – I don’t loose strength. – Greater is He that is in me, than any challenge that is in the world. – Through prayer, I engage the energies of God within me. – I have strength! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for enabling me with strength in my inner man.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 607 - PRACTICE THIS WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Dear avid reader, I appreciate your consistency in following and fellowshipping with this Christ-centered online devotional. I have a special prayer for you here. Be Blessed! Author Saturday, 21st September, 2024 PRACTICE THIS WISDOM"The fruit of the [consistently] righteous is a tree of life, And he who is wise captures and wins souls [for God—he gathers them for eternity]". Proverbs 11:30 (Amplified)
Just as Christ came to give life to men, you are also sent by God through Christ, to be a dispenser of life.
Jesus said, “as the Father has sent me I also send you…” (John 20:21).Before the ascension of Jesus, the Lord gave a charge to His disciples to go into the world and make disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:19).Even at the beginning stages of leading His disciples, Jesus was clear on His goal for training them; He said:  “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men” (Matthew 4:19)To become a fisher of men is to be one who captures men or souls for the Lord.It is also the same as making disciples of all nations unto the Lord. This is how you dispense the life of God and bring many into divine participation.Jesus said,“Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock” Matthew 7:24 (NIV)This means winning souls (dispensing life, making disciples, or becoming a fisher of men) is a practice of wisdom.
Winning souls or making disciples is a command or instruction of Jesus.
 And every instruction of Jesus is the expression of Wisdom; acting on it is a practice of Wisdom.Now look at it in Proverbs (the wise sayings of Wisdom):“…And he who is wise captures and wins souls [for God—he gathers them for eternity]”. Proverbs 11:30 (Amplified)
The salvation of souls is God’s strategy of Wisdom to bring many into His eternal fellowship.
Are you a soul-winner?Are you involved in soul-winning?
To be a soul winner is an opportunity to be involved God’s eternal wisdom plan.
Soul winning is a great practice of Wisdom.Demonstrate Wisdom by winning souls for the Kingdom.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Matthew 18:11; John 17:3; Daniel 12:3; Matthew 13:43; Matthew 19:28; Luke 5:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we will receive abundance of grace to utilize every opportunity given to us by the Lord, to demonstrate True Wisdom by winning many souls unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 6 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I demonstrate true wisdom by turning many unto righteousness. – I am a dispenser of life unto many. – I am full of wisdom. – I function by wisdom. – I am a soul winner therefore I am so wise. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 608 - PRAISE JESUS FOR HE IS THE KING AND LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 22nd September, 2024PRAISE JESUS FOR HE IS THE KING AND LORD “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” Luke 19:38 (NKJV) Some saints do not consider praising the Lord an essential matter in our walk with Him.  Jesus’ entry into Jerusalem has a lot of prophetic details. It was the fulfillment of a Messianic prophecy. In His triumphal entry into Jerusalem, He wasn’t only announcing Himself as the Passover lamb. He also announced Himself as the true Messiah.
In His entry, they beheld Him in His glory and celebrated His eternal royalty.
“Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen, saying:“‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” Luke 19:37-38 (NKJV) This is beautiful!!!They couldn’t keep quiet and be calm. This also happened so that the scriptures may be fulfilled. (Matthew 21:4; John 12:16). When they saw Jesus, they saw the Messiah; they saw their King who is God. They didn’t see Him as an ordinary man. They didn’t see just a prophet. They saw God. That was why they shouted and declared the Prophetic Psalm (which is a Praise to God for His everlasting Mercy).Psalm 118 is parallel to Jesus’ Triumphal entry. a. vv 20 speaks of the Righteous King entering the gate of the LORD.b. vv 24 speaks of the people rejoicing and being glad. When Jesus entered Jerusalem the people rejoiced and praised God with a loud voice. (Luke 19:37).c. vv 25 speaks of how the Psalmist shouted “Save now”. This is similar to the expression “Hosanna” which also means “Oh save” (Matthew 21:9).d. The Psalmist declared “Save now… send now prosperity” and he blessed the Lord with these words:Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’ vv 25-26 The multitudes also declared “Hosanna” and blessed the Lord with the same words. You can see from these verses that, the triumphal entry of Jesus was declared in detail beforehand. No wonder after His resurrection, He taught His disciples who were on the road to Emmaus, all the things written concerning Himself. “Then Jesus quoted them passage after passage from the writings of the prophets, beginning with the book of Genesis  and going right on through the Scriptures, explaining what the passages meant and what they said about himself“ Luke 24:27 (TLB) There were other key things you will find in Psalm 118; which may help you know why the Pharisees were offended with the Praise, shouts and the joy of the people.In Psalm 118, we see the Prophetic declarations concerning Jesus: 1. The Psalmist declared the Lord as his Salvation (vv 14 and vv 21). Jesus is our Salvation. (Matthew 1:21; Acts 4:12). Thus, He is the LORD.2. The rejected stone becomes the chief cornerstone (vv 22); Jesus is the rejected stone, who is now the chief cornerstone.(Luke 20:17; Acts 4:11; 1 Peter 2:7). Which again means He is the central focus of the Psalm.3. The Psalmist specified that, the LORD he is speaking of is GOD.vv. 27 ” God is the LORD, And He has given us light;” Which means the LORD the Psalmist was praising and giving thanks to, is GOD.Beloved “Jesus is the true Light, which gives light to every man that comes into this world.” (John 1:9, see also John 1:4-5; John 9:5).
Understand this, JESUS IS GOD according to the scriptures.
No one fulfilled the Messianic prophecies except Jesus. No man demonstrated and expressed all that God is in fullness like Jesus did. “No one has seen God [His essence, His divine nature] at any time; the [One and] only begotten God [that is, the unique Son] who is in the intimate presence of the Father, He has explained Him [and interpreted and revealed the awesome wonder of the Father].” John 1:18 (Amplified Bible). No wonder the Pharisees were troubled when the people rejoiced and spoke the Psalm. They knew the content of the Psalm, alludes to the true Messiah who is God. Now, here is Jesus living out the details of that prophetic Psalm.Right before their eyes, the Prophetic Psalm was being played out. And it was too hard for them to accept it.
Beloved, Jesus is the King and the LORD who is God; PRAISE HIM WITH THE GLADNESS OF HEART!
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 118; Exodus 15:1-2; Luke 19: 28-40; John; Matthew 21:1-9;13-16) WE PRAYThat our eyes of understanding shall be enlightened that we may see the Lord in His fullness of royal glory and praise Him daily. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 9 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Jesus is my Lord and my salvation. - Jesus is the strength of my life. - My lips shall bless the Lord at all times. - My heart rejoices over Him. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 609 - BE TENDER-HEARTED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Monday, 23rd September, 2024 BE TENDER-HEARTED"Beloved, let us [unselfishly] love and seek the best for one another, for love is from God; and everyone who loves [others] is born of God and knows God [through personal experience]” 1 John 4:7 (Amplified Bible)Love is to be practiced. You don’t love only by utterance, you love by action.Demonstrating love towards one another establishes our oneness. The division is the fruit of selfishness. Wherever there is oneness there is love.
To walk in love is according to the supply of God’s love in us.
Even our Lord Jesus demonstrated His love according to how the Father loves him.“As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love” John 15:9 (KJV).You continue or remain in His love by enjoying His love in a personal way and expressing that love to others.Until you understand how love works, you cannot practice this love. We work out God’s love exactly as He has worked His love into us.In 1 Corinthians 16, we see about fifteen (15) workings of God’s love.“Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails….” 1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV)Paul the apostle, wasn’t trying to define love in these verses; he was laying bare the application of love. He was not speaking of romantic or sentimental relationships.These things Paul listed are more radical and not mere squishy feelings. 
Love is how we live out our empowered relationship with Jesus, through the Holy Spirit.
The love we speak of here is the Greek word “agape”. It is different from “Eros” romantic or intimate love. It is deeper than the romantic love partners profess to each other. Neither is it, “Phileo” the strong love towards a relative.Agape is the highest dimension of the love of God demonstrated through Christ.He listed the things which love does and things love doesn’t do. These are not mere emotional depictions of love.
Beloved, without the life of Christ in you, 1 Corinthians 13 is meaningless and inapplicable.
Let's take a close look at the first two items Paul the apostle mentioned:1. Love suffers longThis is not suggesting that you are in endless trouble. This is basically a matter of patience. To say love is patient means love is persistent and purposeful. Patience is the foundational expression of love. It endures without quitting no matter the frustration. This is essentially rooted in the eternal patience of Christ’s love, which He demonstrated towards us.2. Love is kindThis is to imitate the kindness of the love of Christ, towards others.This is to act benevolently or to show oneself useful or helpful to others. To be kind is to be gentle or courteous and polite. This is seen in your benevolent deeds and in how you speak. It is not acting and speaking harshly, sharply, bitterly and disagreeably.
To be kind is to be mild and tender towards others.
Look at what Paul the apostle said to the brethren in Ephesus:"Be kind and helpful to one another, tender-hearted [compassionate, understanding], forgiving one another [readily and freely], just as God in Christ also forgave you." Ephesians 4:32 (Amplified Bible)You must lay aside bitter words, temper tantrums, revenge, profanity, and insults towards the saints and others. Be an example of Christ's loveliness to your world.
Let humility describe who you are as you dearly love one another.
Beloved, this is the truth about you, because the love of God is poured out into you. Don’t function contrary.Reach out to a brother or a sister today and demonstrate these acts of patience and kindness.This is the real you. Go and right the wrongs. Love tenderly!Have a blessed day.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Nehemiah 9:17; Galatians 5:22; Colossians 3:12; 2 Corinthians 6:6; Proverbs 19:22) WE PRAYThat we shall exercise the wisdom of God in demonstrating His love which is in us, through patience and kindness towards one another. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 9 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Love of God is at work in me. I walk in patience.  - I demonstrate love persistently and purposefully.  - I am benevolently useful to others. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 610 - A CRUCIAL ROOT OF STAGNATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and a bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Tuesday, 24th September, 2024A CRUCIAL ROOT OF STAGNATION“For though you are lofty and exalted, you stoop to embrace the lowly. Yet you keep your distance from those filled with pride.” Psalm 138:6 (TPT). One of the things that causes unfruitfulness, limitation, STAGNATION and resistance to progress in the believer’s pursuit of purpose is PRIDE.
Pride is a limitation.
A proud man is always resisted. Anytime you act with pride, what you are saying is you are good without God. To be proud towards God means you deny or reject God’s resources. The proud don’t esteem God’s word and despise the wisdom of God. Such a stand makes you become one who is in opposition to God.Such a position makes you attract God’s resistance. Without God, you can do nothing. Your boast must not be in yourself but in God’s grace. Thus, to refuse to be humble or to submit to God is to do without God. God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble. (James 4:6) God doesn’t resist the proud because He wants to be in control. This is how God resists the proud: “For though you are lofty and exalted, you stoop to embrace the lowly. Yet you keep your distance from those filled with pride.” Psalm 138:6 (TPT). In as much as God loves everyone, He doesn’t force His grace into places where His supply is not accepted. God doesn’t automatically dispense Himself to people. The strength of God is given to those who acknowledge Him.
To be humble is to realize that by your own strength, you cannot prevail. It is in this state that faith in God finds pure expression.
Imagine attempting to jump from the ground floor to the 50th floor of a skyscraper without any aid. You need to submit yourself to know that you don’t have enough capacity to get to that floor without aid. To climb to the highest floor of such a building you will need an elevator or a staircase. To deny the provisions made is to remain on the down floor. You cannot be lifted by your strength. Technically, it is not the elevator which has limited you. Your limitation is your refusal to accept that you need the elevator. Technically it is not God who resists the proud. It is his pride that serves as resistance. “A man’s pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honour.” (Proverbs 29:23) Just in case you keep realizing you are not making progress or any great thing you attempt to do, you experience resistance, check your pride. Humble yourself before the Lord and He will exalt you. Be humble also towards those the Lord has set over you.
Through humility, Jesus obtained all dominion and authority over all things (Philippians 2:5-7).
God doesn’t give authority to the proud. God gives authority to the humble. Through humility, you receive more and more grace. And the Lord elevates you to the highest peak of glory. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 2:15-22; 1 Peter 5:5; Psalm 40:4; Luke 1:48; Exodus 18:11; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall exercise the wisdom to walk in humility and to acknowledge the Lord’s supply unto us for greater works. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 12 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I submit to the Lord and His word. — I refuse to be proud. —  I acknowledge and boast in the ability of God. — My confidence is in God’s supply and not in my own wisdom. — I don’t reject God’s grace and goodness towards me. — I esteem the strength of God supplied to me, above my own abilities. — I have absolute dependence on God and not my efforts.Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 611 - DO NOT BE DECEIVED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Wednesday, 25th September, 2024 DO NOT BE DECEIVED“Do not be deceived: Bad company corrupts good morals.” 1 Corinthians 15:33 (NASB) Friendship is not evil nor wrong. Friendship can help you in many ways as you journey into greatness. However, the company of friends you keep will determine if you will arrive at that greatness you have envisioned or not.
Many great destinies have been crushed because of the associations they kept.
The thing is, whether you want it or not, your friends will influence you in a particular way. You cannot be prayerful when your friends are not prayerful. It doesn’t matter how prayerful you are, when you keep those friends for long, and you don’t see them becoming prayerful, you must know that your prayerlessness has become worse than theirs. Your burning desire of love for the Lord can be watered down by the wrong association. Imagine being in the company of gossips. Precious one, your days will be flooded with negativity, conflicts and emotional disturbance. You may even develop hatred for people God has sent to strengthen you, and you will avoid them because of gossip.  Instead of discerning the integrity of the hearts of people, you will discredit them; because a gossip you call a friend couldn’t keep his or her mouth shut. Do you have a friend who is always or often talking about the weakness of others? Some friends will even use the excuse of “let’s pray for someone” to talk about people in a way that will sow seeds of bitterness and pain in your heart. And instead of praying for others, you will be embittered. Be careful of such friends.
Friends who cannot keep secrets from others are dangerous. 
They will soon announce your weaknesses and wrongs to the world. “A gossip goes around spreading rumors, while a trustworthy man tries to quiet them.” Proverbs 11:13 (TLB) Such gossips are also judgmental and legalistic. They are always wise in their eyes and act as though they are fighting evil. Yet while they are busily denigrating, condemning and spreading rumours of others, God is patiently working on and building those same people they are denigrating. “Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs, that it may benefit those who listen.” Ephesians 4:29 These two verses above really saved me from a lot of damage.
When you are in the company of an angry friend, you will soon be influenced or affected by their approach to life.
 "Make no friendship with an angry man, and with a furious man do not go, Lest you learn his ways and set a snare for your soul". Proverbs 22:24-25 (NKJV) See the same verses in the The Passion Translation: “Walk away from an angry man or you’ll embrace a snare in your soul by becoming bad-tempered just like him”. Now you shouldn’t assume you are too strong and cannot be corrupted by the wrong companions. “Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good morals.” 1 Corinthians 15:33 Now in this verse of scripture, Paul was specifically speaking to the saints to avoid those who speak against the resurrection of Jesus.  Having a company of friends who don’t believe in Jesus, and you are always spending time together with them all in the name of soul-winning, will corrupt your faith. Seek counsel immediately from your Church leader. This doesn’t suggest you should live like an island.
God didn’t create us to be isolated from everyone.
He shows us the importance of having good friends“And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works, not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another.” Hebrews 10:24-25 You wouldn’t always have friends who don’t have any weaknesses. Definitely, people may have their weaknesses. However, do they see it as a weakness?  Are they making efforts to seek help? Or they don’t even think it is a weakness and feel they are right to behave that way? “A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.” Proverbs 17:17
A true friend doesn’t take pride in the failure of others. A true friend is a shield of strength.
Maintain a company of friends who inspire you with the vision of God and direct your passion towards the Lord.  “Sweet friendships refresh the soul and awaken our hearts with joy, for good friends are like the anointing oil that yields the fragrant incense of God’s presence.” Proverbs 27:9 (TPT) Friends who overwhelm you with wise counsel of the Lord are treasures. Who is your friend? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JL35LOW-LHIDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 13:20; 27:17; Psalm 1:1;  Psalm 101:5-6; Proverbs 16:28-29; John 15:14; James 4:4; Proverbs 22:11; 1 Thessalonians 5:11) WE PRAYThat through wisdom, we will discern and demonstrate the righteousness of God in every relationship.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 15 -17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am mindful of my association. – I demonstrate wisdom in all my relationships. – Through the wisdom of the scriptures, I guide my heart with all diligence. – I make the right judgment in all things. – I don’t glory in the weaknesses of others. – Through love I strengthen others. – I am full of wisdom. – I am full of love. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 612 - LET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bears fruit unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author  LET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK! "Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before" Philippians 3:13 (KJV)The present social media world has broadened the scope of being exposed to things happening around us.The social media space is now the busiest street or broadway, the largest market, and the fastest space for news to travel around the world.Interestingly, even news agencies surf online to tap into the trending news to increase viewership traffic.As long as you have access to these social media platforms you have access to things happening around the world, even the private lives of others.Do you know there are things you wouldn't see on the street but will most likely find on the internet?Some introverts who wouldn't dare to dance in public space, will comfortably dance in their bedrooms and post the video online for the whole world to see.Through the internet, you can easily observe and identify the conceptions and imaginations of hearts. Isn't it amazing how people have become more expressive through the internet?One may say, that social media is a "leveller". People easily rise to popularity and use their popularity gained online to chart a course for their interests.Amidst the countless benefits of this social media space, there are also disadvantages.And it's the more reason believers in Christ must have their hearts and minds drenched in the word of God than being drowned by the happenings around in-person and this social media space.Everyone is trying to tell a story online. Most of these stories are packaged for the views. While some share stories of their marriage, others focus on their academic prowess, material wealth, growth in business, travelling experiences, etc.These contents are sometimes designed to educate, inspire, transform and elevate others. Some create and share these contents to prove a point or to show off.Whether they intend to inspire or to create competition, the adversary can use these online contents to feed your heart wrongly.The adversary takes the success stories of others to amplify what you lack; thus, making you feel stalled as an entrepreneur, a Pastor, a couple or a single person. The more he gets you to focus on the success of others the more he makes you feel or think others are better than you.This even becomes worse when you already feel stuck in a particular area of your life.
This kind of feeling is not a new challenge to humanity but has become rampant in this social media age; mainly because of the exposure it brings.
It is not always a sense of jealousy but a nagging sense of feeling behind. The adversary takes advantage to feed your heart with his lies. He deceptively whispers to your heart:"You are worthless. See how everyone is progressing and you are not achieving anything with your life. You are a nobody and stuck in this place forever. Nobody cared about you and you are a loser. You will keep losing and never become what you have desired. All that you have known or been told were lies. Instead of making more money, you are now broke. Your peers are making better money online and in their various fields. You are slow and cannot catch up. These people started with you, but now they are light-years ahead of you. See how beautiful those couple are with their babies, you can't have that marriage. Stop worrying yourself with that business. It will not succeed. Look at how those younger than you are making more money than you, even though you started with them".A part of you may even think that feeling or thinking this way is you having a genuine retrospect of your life. You may think you are now having a reality check of your life so that you will know how to do things better.Stop it!
If you want to have a reality check of your life, look to Jesus.
He is the reality of your life.To feel that nagging sense of being left behind is the adversary's deceptive strategy to keep you hooked to your past and your heart settled on what you don't have. This is the adversary trying to pin you down to your past mistakes and failures.This is the adversary amplifying your weaknesses and nurturing depression in your heart. This is the adversary working so hard to keep you in the loop of discouragement and defeats so that you cannot take steps to advance further into your glorious future.There are times you feel motivated and begin to think you are going to make progress. And then suddenly you are drawn back into this unsurprising pendulum.You cannot afford to continue oscillating your heart between such states.
GET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK!
Stop looking at the wrong pictures.See as God sees. Don't allow the success of others to make you feel you are failing. You are in the center of God's program as long as you walk in the obedience of the word. Even when it seems you have made mistakes, remember this:GOD IS RICH IN MERCY!When the adversary begins to whisper those discouraging thoughts, don't keep quiet. Fight back with the word of God. You roar the scriptures to yourself and declare:"Though the fig tree should not blossom, nor fruit be on the vines, the produce of the olive fail and the fields yield no food,the flock be cut off from the fold and there be no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in the LORD; I will take joy in the God of my salvation. GOD, the Lord, is my strength; He makes my feet like the deer’s; He makes me tread on my high places." (Habakkuk 3:17-19)Beloved, GET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK TODAY!Step out there and live the life God has called you to live. 
Don't give room for pride, don't allow the adversary to push you away from your blessed life.
Set your eyes on the Lord.Your season of abundance is here!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JL35LOW-LHIDIG DEEPER(Psalm 23; Isaiah 43:1-2; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 121; Psalm 112:4-7) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts will not be overwhelmed by a nagging sense of stagnation but shall acknowledge the goodness of the Lord all our days. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Matthew 18 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to stay in the past.-  I refuse to avail my mind and thoughts to the adversary for his deception. - I look to Jesus because as He is so am I. - My heart will not be overwhelmed by the nagging sense of stagnation. - I let go of every form of pride in my heart.- My boast is in the finished works of Christ.- The Lord has been so good to me.- He daily loads me with benefits. - My life cannot be worse. - The course of my life is as a shining light, that shines brighter and brighter unto a perfect day. - I was born for a glorious life. - My life is for the glory of God. - I go higher and higher every day. - I make each day count. - There is nothing that has what it takes to pin me down. Oh, thank you, Lord Jesus for your goodness in my life.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 613 - LET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author  LET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK 2"Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before" Philippians 3:13 (KJV)Do you know how most online content creators keep you glued to their posts?They pique your curiosity through captivating hooks.These people know that attention is expensive thus, they forensically observe trending data which defines how the people they want to reach think and dig deep into their imaginations to find the right words which can grab their attention and stimulate their emotions.Now this is how it works, the more you stick to their content, the more you become fascinated and perfervid about those contents.
The adversary also understands the value of your attention. He wouldn't just whip your heart with depressive thoughts.
He takes you on a personal retrospection journey and makes you collate your present state with your peers. He hacks into your thoughts by observing your interests or by inducing your craving (just as the internet algorithm operates), then ascertain the data which best fits you, to create an emotional hook.Let me help you understand how the internet algorithm works:The algorithm cumulates internet users' signals to match them with relevant content. So when you subscribe and keep watching the luminary 's YouTube videos or follow with talk shows, the algorithm will identify your interests and continue to suggest content similar to yours. Even when you have not used a platform before it will first suggest a post (to induce interest), the moment you engage those posts, then the system will keep sending you similar data.
That is how things work in the Spirit. When you indulge in any matter your heart will always be magnetized by it for your satisfaction.
The adversary knows this also, thus, he uses a similar system to direct your thoughts. He doesn't know which area he can use to whip your heart. However, he gathers information from your past activities to create a hook suitable enough for you to be ensnared.You have a choice today to continue to remain hooked to the adversary's web of lies or to live free in the will of God for your life.He is not going to stop at any time to induce wrong desires and doubts in your heart. He will keep making discouraging remarks, but you have to make a decision not to fall for it.Just as you have the option to select "not interested" on your social media platform or to even block a post or an account, you can also reject or block the thoughts of the adversary.Nobody is going to do it for you. You have to LET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK.
Don't wait for God to save you, He has given you all the help you need to reject anything that is not of faith.
Paul the apostle said, "... but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before" Philippians 3:13 (KJV)He didn't say, but this one thing the Lord or the Holy Spirit will do for me. It's your personal decision to determine the focus of your mind.Instead of following and allowing the wrong thoughts of the adversary to occupy the screens of your heart, clear the history data.Understand that, no matter how you resist the negative thoughts of the adversary, he will still find other ways to subtly creep into your thoughts to induce desires.
Remain resolute that you are not going to fall for any of his hooks.
Your prayer requests should never be items of worry and anxiety. You pray about such matters so that you will not become anxious but there's a better way. When you pray about your academics, marriage, career, workplace, ministry, family, health, community, etc be confident that the Lord has heard you and you will receive answers. That is faith!I have to tell you this because the adversary is on standby to make you doubt. He is moving about eavesdropping to find a way to hack into your heart and to create a hook which will crush your faith.
Stay on guard and remain resolute in faith.
LET YOURSELF OFF THE HOOK!Reach forth unto those glorious things which are before you.Subscribe to the Word of God and luxuriate in the streaming light of Grace.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Psalm 23; Isaiah 43:1-2; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 121; Psalm 112:4-7) WE PRAY We pray that:- Our hearts shall remain focused on the Word of God and shall not permit any wrong imagination to slip into it.- Nothing shall induce our curiosity and interest except the Word of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 21 - 23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart remains focused on the word of God. - I guard my heart at all times. - I refuse to allow any wrong imagination into my heart. - The word of God is the desire of my heart. - My heart is cleaved to the word of God. - I don't fall for the hooks of the adversary. - I remain resolute in faith. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 614 - THE DEVIL DESIRES TO SIFT YOU 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Saturday, 28th September, 2024 THE DEVIL DESIRES TO SIFT YOU"And the Lord said, “Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you as wheat." Luke 22:31 (NKJV)One of the greatest fears of the adversary is a man who is focused on God and full of great faith.
The devil knows that the purpose of God is worked through men who are full of faith.
This is it, the gap between God's Plan and the fulfilment of His Plan within a generation is His People. God executes His plans and purposes through faithful men.This is why God invests His graces, wisdom, favor and love into men. He designed man to be the expression and execution of His purpose."For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us]." Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified Bible)
When a man is planted in God, He bears the God-kind of fruits.
Thus, to stop you from bearing the God-kind fruits, the devil does everything he can to sift you.For the devil to sift you basically means to separate you from God. He wants to distract your faith and move you away from the Lord.And for your information, those the devil wants to sift are not unbelievers. Those he wants to sift are those planted in Christ.Peter who was a disciple of Jesus was the target of the devil to be sifted. Jesus didn't say that about those who don't believe in Him. So technically those the adversary sorts to sift are not the unbelievers.The devil uses every single strategy at his disposal to test your faith. And you must know that he is relentless. He doesn't assume that you are mature or a babe in Christ. He even tested our Lord Jesus and will also have you as his target.Whether he will fail or not, he sees no harm in trying to sift you. It's his way of resisting you from fulfilling your purpose.This is why you must always be strengthened in the Lord. You must not assume the adversary is not interested in your faith. Refuse to be on a napping spree. You have to stay alert."Keep a cool head. Stay alert. The Devil is poised to pounce, and would like nothing better than to catch you napping." 1 Peter 5:8 (The Message Bible).
Don't stay out of Church. Don't procrastinate and stop making excuses.
The adversary is coming at you with all he's got just to sift you, BEWARE!Set your focus on the Lord and never waver in faith.Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Matthew 13:19; 1 Corinthians 10:13; Ephesians 6:11; James 4:7; Ephesians 4:27) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain deeply rooted and established in the Lord to the end and fulfilment of God's purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew 24 - 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I remain deeply rooted in the Lord to the end. - I don't stay away from the  gathering of the saints. - My focus is set on the Lord daily. - I refuse to procrastinate. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 615 - THE DEVIL DESIRES TO SIFT YOU 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author  THE DEVIL DESIRES TO SIFT YOU 2"And the Lord said, “Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you as wheat." Luke 22:31 (NKJV)Beloved, as you can see in the opening verse, what the Lord Jesus said to Peter wasn't some hoax or a mock alert.Now since it wasn't the interest of the Lord not to divulge such information from Peter, then you should know it was going to happen. But the good news is that the Lord showed us how He intercepted.If not for the Lord’s interception, the devil would have achieved his intention. You will later find out how within some few hours after these words of the Lord, Peter denied being a disciple of Jesus."Then they seized him and led him away, bringing him into the high priest's house, and Peter was following at a distance. And when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them. Then a servant girl, seeing him as he sat in the light and looking closely at him, said, “This man also was with him.” But he denied it, saying, “Woman, I do not know him.” And a little later someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.” And after an interval of about an hour still another insisted, saying, “Certainly this man also was with him, for he too is a Galilean.” But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you are talking about.” And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed. And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the saying of the Lord, how he had said to him, “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny me three times.” And he went out and wept bitterly." Luke 22:54-62 (ESV)Peter denied his association with Jesus in front of a servant girl. Just in case you don't know, it was this same Peter who when Jesus was being arrested by the men from the high priest, drew his sword and cut off the ear of Malchus (a servant of the high priest). Peter was actually trying to prove his loyalty to Jesus. When Jesus told Peter how the adversary had plotted to sift him, he thought it would take the strength of the flesh to withstand against the devil.Even when Jesus had said he had prayed for him, Peter still thought it would take his self-generated ability to stand in the Lord. His confidence was in himself and not the Lord.This was what Peter told the Lord:"Peter said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death.” Jesus said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me.” Luke 22:33-34 (ESV)Peter's confidence failed. He denied the Lord three times and after He realized the words of Jesus, he felt disappointed and wept bitterly.Nevertheless in the resurrection, Jesus sent a message to the disciples specifically to Peter, for him to know that He the Lord wasn't disappointed in him but still took interest in him."And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him. But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you." Mark 16:7 (KJV).You can tell the joy that will be on Peter's face hearing those lovely words.You don't have to assume that the adversary wouldn't attempt to sift you. And you don't have to think you can remain strong in the Lord by the efforts of the flesh.James in his epistles gave a secret to the brethren:"Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you." James 4:7 (KJV).
Until you humble yourself before the Lord, you will not be able to take advantage of His supply to prevail.
And when you humble yourself you will be prayerful at all times. It takes humility to be prayerful (2 Chronicles 7:14).Jesus knew it would take the strength of God received through prayer to resist the plotting of the devil. So He prayed for Peter.Beloved, the adversary desires to sift you, however, you must yield to prayer and not your self-confidence.Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JL35LOW-LHIDIG DEEPER(Matthew 13:19; 1 Corinthians 10:13; Ephesians 6:11; James 4:7; Ephesians 4:27) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain deeply rooted and established in the Lord to the end and fulfilment of God's purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Matthew  27 - 28Mark 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am given to prayer. - I have absolute confidence in the Lord who is able to keep me from falling. - I remain strong in the sufficient ability of God. - I will not fall. - None of my steps will slide. - I remain submitted to the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 616 - PRACTICE JOY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency This week you will exercise the wisdom of God in demonstrating His love to others. Go and bear fruits! Author PRACTICE JOY"Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice" Philippians 4:4 (NKJV) What do you think the adversary is after? Your money?Your beauty?Your children?Your business?Your academic success?Your salvation?Your marriage?
Beloved, the adversary has always been after your eternal fulfillment of JOY!
