To REJOICE is a high degree of expression and experience of joy.It is the demonstration of a triumphant elation. Many people rejoice at the end of their journey or after accomplishing something.But for you in Christ, the Lord is charging you to a daily life of Joy!This is because your life in Christ began in great rejoicing. "And it was a happy day for him when he gave us our new lives through the truth of his Word, and we became, as it were, the first children in his new family." James 1:18 (TLB) This happy day is beyond the "happiness" men experience in seasons. This is an eternal palpable expression of joy.No wonder Jesus spoke of the joy in Heaven when a soul is saved. "I tell you that in the same way there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one repentant sinner". Luke 15:10 (Weymouth New Testament). "That’s the way God responds every time one lost sinner repents and turns to him. He says to all his angels, ‘Let’s have a joyous celebration, for that one who was lost I have found!" Luke 15:10 (TPT). This is a heavenly party because of the salvation experience.
Beloved, when you were born again into Christ, THE WHOLE OF THE HEAVENS were thrilled with this nonpareil achievement of Christ.
And that is the reality of the Kingdom of God. "for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit" Romans 14:17 (NKJV) WHAT A LIFE! You have been brought forth into this joy of life unto all eternity.This is your realm. You don’t have to entertain sorrow around you no matter the situation. You have to maintain your joy. It is your daily charge to keep. If you think there is nothing to rejoice in or be joyful about, then you must reconsider your mindset about Salvation.
Your salvation is the greatest thing that has ever happened to you. 
REJOICE IN IT.  Look at the Psalmist: "But I have trusted in Your lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation." Psalm 13:5 To rejoice in the Lord is not a suggestion, it's a COMMAND! Paul wrote his epistle to the Philippians from prison, and there was nothing sorrowful about him. From prison, he charged the brethren to rejoice in the Lord. He never saw himself as a prisoner of Rome. He always saw himself instead as a prisoner of Christ. What a mindset! When Jesus rose from the dead, one of the first things He said was:"Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping?…”
It is a wonder to be sorrowful in our Kingdom!
Our strength is the JOY OF THE LORD! Do not be sorrowful. (Nehemiah 8:10). Practice JOY!!!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Philippians 3:1; 2 Corinthians 6:10; Habakkuk 3:18; Psalm 33:1;Romans 12:12; Psalm 118:24) WE PRAY– Thanking God for bringing us forth into this glorious joy of life. – That we will continue in this joy in all seasons of life no matter the situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Mark 2 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been brought forth into a life of joy, this is my realm. – I am full of joy. – I give no room for sorrow. – I refuse to entertain any sorrowful thought.  – My strength is the joy of the Lord. – I practice joy daily. – I rejoice at every count. – I start my day in joy, I continue through the day in joy and end in joy. – I rejoice always. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 617 - SEEK AFTER KNOWLEDGE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency This week you will exercise the wisdom of God in demonstrating His love to others. Go and bear fruits! Author Tuesday, 1st October, 2024 SEEK AFTER KNOWLEDGE"The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness." Proverbs 15:14 (KJV)HELLOO!I WELCOME YOU TO THE NEW MONTH OF OCTOBER.This month shall be a special month with glorious blessings for you. Enjoy every grace and favor of God which shall be supplied to you this month.You have to decide that you will live and express the full life of God in you.The greatest challenge of every believer is not first the devil, with his cohorts and deceptive operations. The greatest challenge of the believer is IGNORANCE.
Ignorance simply means lack of knowledge.
And as the Lord said to the leaders of Israel "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge..." Hosea 4:6 (ESV).The nation Israel was called out by God to serve the Lord's purpose as a Priestly nation. Yet these men often turned away from the knowledge of the Lord to kowtow to idols and found themselves afflicted. The knowledge these Isrealites lacked wasn't scientific knowledge or military understanding. The knowledge which they lacked was the true knowledge of God.Let's read it in the Amplified Bible and the New Living Translation to have some clarity:"My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge [of My law, where I reveal My will]. Because you [the priestly nation] have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you from being My priest. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children." (Amplified Bible)Though, the wisdom here can be applied in other areas of living. The scripture is specifically pointing to the knowledge of the revelation of God's will.The Lord is not speaking to the Prophet about some generic knowledge. You can have knowledge in all science and still be destroyed. 
Your salvation and walk in glory is according to the revelation of the knowledge of God which is at work in you.
Take a look at the New Living Translation:"My people are being destroyed because they don’t know me. Since you priests refuse to know me, I refuse to recognize you as my priests. Since you have forgotten the laws of your God, I will forget to bless your children."A practical example was when Goliath came out each morning to challenge and taunt the Israelites and the Lord God Almighty. None of these trained soldiers had the audacity to confront Goliath.These soldiers were skilful and trained for battle. They knew how to wield every weapon in their possessions yet they couldn't dare to confront Goliath. Their military knowledge wasn't enough.It took a young boy David, who understood the covenant and the power of the Name of the LORD.He said to Goliath, “You come to me with sword, spear, and javelin, but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Heaven’s Armies—the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied." (1 Samuel 17:45).The audacity of David was by the knowledge of God which was in him. He was one who passionately longed after God and desired to share in His intimate knowledge.He said, "Lord, I passionately love you and I’m bonded to you! I want to embrace you, for now you’ve become my power!" Psalm 18:1 (TPT).
You don't perish by the lack of knowledge in science. You perish when you lack the knowledge of God.
The knowledge of God in you brings you into the full understanding and possession of the glorious inheritance in Christ Jesus.When you become born again, you don't automatically grow into the full knowledge of God. As I always say, you must be intentional about your growth in the knowledge of God.You have to intentionally seek after the knowledge of God. To know God is not a one-time experience, but a lifetime journey.
The more you grow in knowledge and understanding of God, the more you develop the desire and longing to know Him more. 
Those who don't see the need to pursue the knowledge of God are those who have not yet come to the place of understanding. The opening verse says the mouth of fools pursue foolishness. It takes a heart of understanding to seek after God's knowledge."Lovers of God hunger after truth, but those without understanding feast on foolishness and don’t even realize it." Proverbs 15:14 (TPT).You can see how Paul even in his maturity still desired and remained continued in his pursuit to know God. (Philippians 3:10).
Make it a priority to seek after the knowledge of God in this new month.
Remain blessed.DIG DEEPER(John 8:31-32; Proverbs 18:15; Hosea 6:3,6; Isaiah 5:13; Jeremiah 5:4; Proverbs 20:15) WE PRAYWe pray that our hunger for the knowledge of God shall be kindled at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Mark 5 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of God. – I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. – As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. – I am full of the knowledge of Christ. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 618 - SEEK AFTER KNOWLEDGE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your greatest weakness is ignorance. Beloved, this week go for the knowledge of God. Author  SEEK AFTER KNOWLEDGE 2"The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness." Proverbs 15:14 (KJV)To pursue the knowledge of God is not optional. It is mandatory.
In the Spirit, your mastery and weight are measured by your knowledge.
The root of oppression is ignorance. Your ignorance of the schemes of the adversary is an advantage to the adversary. He is able to inflict pain and multiply its effect knowing that you are ignorant of its cause and course.When you are confronted by a challenge and you lack the understanding of its solution or can't even apprehend the root cause you may be fighting but will only be beating the air.Jesus said the knowledge of the truth shall make you walk in freedom (John 8:32).
Until you come into knowledge you will be living as one enslaved, though you are set free.
Even in spiritual warfare, you don't enforce victory by emotions. You enforce your victory in Christ by the accurate knowledge of Christ in you.When Paul the apostle prayed for the Church in Ephesus, that the eyes of their understanding may be enlightened (Ephesians 1:18), it was so that they may KNOW.Take a look at it:"the eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that you may know what is the hope of His calling, what are the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints" Ephesians 1:18 (NKJV)
To walk in your victory in Christ, you must come into knowledge and understanding.
This reality cannot be overemphasized.You must take up the responsibility to grow in knowledge.You must never get tired of receiving sound doctrine. And for the adversary to attack the believer's faith he makes you dull of hearing the word of God. The more you become dull of hearing, the more you are not able to receive revelation (See Hebrews 5:11).
Your greatest weakness is ignorance.
"The wise are mightier than the strong, and those with knowledge grow stronger and stronger." Proverbs 24:5 (NLT).Make it your desire to seek after knowledge in Christ.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(John 8:31-32; Proverbs 18:15; Hosea 6:3,6; Isaiah 5:13; Jeremiah 5:4; Proverbs 20:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not become dull of hearing the word of God BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Mark 8 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of God. – I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. – As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. – I am full of the knowledge of Christ. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 619 - SEEK AFTER KNOWLEDGE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your greatest weakness is ignorance. Beloved, this week go for the knowledge of God. Author Thursday, 3rd October, 2024  SEEK AFTER KNOWLEDGE 3"The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness." Proverbs 15:14 (KJV)To a carnal mind or a natural man, the pursuit of general or scientific knowledge seems not to be as tedious as pursuing the knowledge of God.
To attempt to seek the knowledge of God through sensual efforts is as attempting to get blood from stone.
When you attempt to use your natural comprehensive ability, the knowledge of God remains mystical. It is like attempting to inject the complex data of the universe with its estimated trillion galaxies of stars and atoms in the cerebrum of a child.No amount of surfing on the internet or even the use of artificial intelligence will bring you into the knowledge of God.In as much as God's wisdom and knowledge are deep and His ways are unfathomable and untraceable (Romans 11:33), He wants to be known and enjoyed by His children.You don't know God by the flesh, for God is Spirit.
To seek after the knowledge of God requires the passionate diligence of the heart.
God wants to be known and to be made known. He doesn't want to remain mystical, thus, He revealed Himself through His Son, Jesus.The knowledge of God is the answer to man's quandary.The true knowledge of God in you is the germination of the Divine LIFE."Eternal life means to know and experience you as the only true God, and to know and experience Jesus Christ, as the Son whom you have sent" John 17:3 (TPT)If there should be anything you will desire in life, it should be that you will intimately know the Lord and behold Him in His splendor. Your personal knowledge of God launches you into the mastery of life.To intimately know the Lord you must first DESIRE to enjoy His presence. It is in your communion with Him that brings you into His unsearchable riches of wisdom and knowledge.
You cannot know God outside His person.
See what the Psalmist said:"One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple." Psalm 27:4 (KJV)Let's look at it in the Message Translation:"I’m asking God for one thing, only one thing:To live with him in his house my whole life long. I’ll contemplate his beauty; I’ll study at his feet." Oh glory to God.Your personal and intimate relationship with God, grants you opportunity to study at His feet. The Lord will show you hidden things. The life of the scriptures will come alive in your heart.
The good news is that, we have access to God through Christ. God now lives in us and we live in Him by Christ Jesus.
Your challenge is not to access God. Your challenge is to intentionally commune with the Lord.This is how you journey into the knowledge of God.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pY&t=90sDIG DEEPER(Luke 10:42; Psalm.27:8; Psalm.24:5-6; 1 Chronicles 16:11; John 8:31-32; Proverbs 18:15) WE PRAYWe pray our hearts shall always burn to dwell and enjoy the Lord's presence. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Mark 11 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of God. – I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. – As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. – I am full of the knowledge of Christ. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 620 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your greatest weakness is ignorance. Beloved, this week go for the knowledge of God. Author Friday, 4th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS"The wise men shall be put to shame; they shall be dismayed and taken; behold, they have rejected the word of the LORD, so what wisdom is in them?" Jeremiah 8:9 (ESV)You cannot pursue the knowledge of God outside His Word.
You may be inexperienced or childlike, but when the Word of God enters you it informs your heart and conditions you with great understanding.
"The unfolding of Your [glorious] words give light; Their unfolding gives understanding to the simple (childlike)" Psalm 119:130 (Amplified Bible)This is why the Psalmist desired the word of God even more than gold. And to him, the word is sweeter than honey, even the honey dripping from the comb. (Psalm 19:10).And the word of God has no expiring date. It abides forever."BUT THE WORD OF THE LORD ENDURES FOREVER.” And this is the word [the good news of salvation] which was preached to you." 1 Peter 1:25 (Amplified Bible)
No trending issue is more current and relevant for your life today than the Word of God.
Whatever God has said in His Word is useful to you today."For whatever was written in former days was written for our instruction, that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope" Romans 15:4 (ESV)Both the failures and the success stories; the unpleasant and pleasant events were written in the scriptures for our learning. The more you esteem and study the word the richer you become in knowledge, wisdom and understanding.The illumination of the Word sets you up ahead of your generation. It gives you an advantage of practical and experiential knowledge. It supplies you with answers to hard puzzles and enigmas of life.The ultimate word of God has come through Christ Jesus. The full revelation of God was spoken through Christ Jesus (Hebrews 1:1-2)
The revelation of the Word of God through Jesus Christ ushers you into the enjoyment of the better things we have in Christ.
In this new series, I want to address the FIVE BETTER NOTS. In the book of Hebrews, the author pointed out BETTER THINGS God has given us through Christ Jesus.However, there are five better nots we must consider in our walk with God. When you decide not to do these five things you will enjoy the better things which we have in Christ.Hallelujah!As simple as these things are, they will help you live the higher life God has destined for you.1. DON'T DISREGARD the Gospel of Christ.When you value the Gospel of Christ, you will give it all the necessary attention and will keep it as the most important treasure. "Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip." Hebrews 2:1 (KJV)Until you have the attitude of not disregarding the Word of Grace, it will not bear much fruit in you. The Word of Grace brings you into the enjoyment of the great salvation Jesus has provided.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 12:25-26; Proverbs 3:21; Hebrews 2:2-4; Deuteronomy 4:9) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not in any way undermine the potency of the Word of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Mark 14 -16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The word of God is my advantage. - I esteem the word more than all my life’s pursuits. - I love and treasure the revelation of God because the word is the embodiment of God’s thoughts and wisdom. - I give myself continually to the study and meditation of the word. - I give no room for any pleasure of life to sway my attention. - Through the scriptures, I live ahead of my generation. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 621 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 2 (GLEANINGS FROM THE BOOK OF HEBREWS)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, don't disregard the Word of Christ. Esteem, absorb and enjoy the riches of His revelation. Have a blessed weekend! Author Saturday, 5th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 2 (GLEANINGS FROM THE BOOK OF HEBREWS)"Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip." Hebrews 2:1 (KJV)The word of God is given to us to build and nourish our lives. You cannot have a beautiful life in Christ without the Word of God.Anything God does is by His word. The universe was made by the Word of God. By His word, He brought forth Abraham and led Him into an inheritance. By His word, the saving Grace of the Lord is made available to all men. And many who have believed and received His Word are saved.
The faith of the believer is not independent of the Word of God. 
Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. The believer shall continue to increase in faith by the Word of God.This is why this "FIVE BETTER NOTS" discussion is crucial. Especially in this period that the adversary has been busy attempting to distract many believers from the Word of God.From yesterday's episode, I began to point out the first of the "FIVE BETTER NOTS", which is:DON'T DISREGARD the Gospel of Christ.
The Gospel of Christ is the same as the Word of Christ.
As you can see from the opening verse, the author of the Book of Hebrews was instructing the brethren to GIVE THE MORE EARNEST HEED TO THE THINGS THAT THEY HAVE HEARD through Christ.This is to have a higher regard for the Word of Christ. It means you set the Word of Christ as the ultimate and most treasured Word which rules and governs your heart.You don't have to take the Word as one of those thoughts.You will also notice that the verse begins with the word, "THEREFORE". This word is an evidence that Hebrews chapter 2 doesn't stand in isolation from the previous chapter. And you will find this a lot through the entire Book of Hebrews.
The entire books of the Bible must be read contextually and not be studied in their separate verses. 
Originally the books of the Bible were not written in chapters and verses. They were altered into chapters and verses just to make references easy.However, the Book of Hebrews is extremely in unison.This is a book which cannot be treated by their individual verses and chapters. They are richly intertwined or knitted.Chapters 2, 3, 4, 6, and 12 begin with the word "THEREFORE". Therefore is a conjunctive adverb. It means, for that reason or consequently.Chapters 5,7 and 10 begin with "FOR". Though it is a preposition, it is sometimes used as a conjunction.Chapters 8 and 11 begin with "NOW". "Now" is sometimes used as a subordinating conjunction.No single chapter stands alone in this epistle. I will leave the discussion of its authorship for another time.Nevertheless, to appreciate the book of Hebrews and our discussion, you must have the understanding that, the book was written to unveil the Superiority of Christ over the Judaic system. It was a book written specifically for Hebrews. The book unveils what Christ accomplished for the believer in ascension and what He is still doing as he is seated in glory. This book points to Christ as the Perfect High Priest.The author takes time in His discussion to help the believer understand why they must not deny what Christ has accomplished for them and not draw back in faith.
The believer in Christ must set their confidence only in Jesus who is the ultimate source of salvation and not in other traditions of the Old Covenant.
The book of Hebrews did not begin with salutations. It was a direct book which went straight to the point. The author began to tackle the core issue from the first few sentences.While Matthew, Mark, Luke and John discussed what Christ did in His earth walk, the book of Hebrews explains what Jesus is now doing in the Heavenly.The goal of Chapters One into Two is to unveil the Superiority of Christ.The Jews believed and esteemed:1. Their Prophets2. The activities of Angels.3. Moses (the one who led them out of Egypt)4. Aaron (their first appointed High Priest)5. Joshua (the one who led them to the Promised Land).6. The Covenant which was initiated at Sinai7. The TabernacleThe author of Hebrews took time to unveil how Christ is superior and better than all.You can even see the connection between Chapter 1:1-2 and Chapter 2:1."God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds" Hebrews 1:1-2 (KJV)The present Word of God to us is what God has said through Christ. He further explains that this Christ Jesus is not an ordinary man.Take a look:"Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high; Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they." Hebrews 1:3-4 (KJV)This Jesus is not an ordinary man neither is He just one of the Prophets. He is different. That:- He is the brightness of God's glory.- He is the express image of God's person.- He upholds all things by the word of His power.- He purged our sins.- He did a complete work once and for all and sat in the highest place of authority.- He is made better than the angels.- He has obtained a more excellent name than all of the names in the universe of God.
Which means in Christ we have access to the complete revelation of God. Jesus is the true and ultimate testimony of God.
Then in chapter 2:1, the author admonishes us that since in chapter 1 we see the Superiority of Christ:"Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard..." Hebrews 2:1 (KJV)
What God has spoken through Christ is the ultimate truth therefore we must not disregard His Glorious Word no matter what.
Beloved, whose report or message do you believe?Don't disregard the Word of Christ. Esteem, absorb and enjoy the riches of His revelation.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(John 1:18; John 3:11,18; 1 John 4:9 Hebrews 12:25-26; Proverbs 3:21; Hebrews 2:2-4) WE PRAY We pray that we shall grow more and more in the revelation of God through Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I esteem the word more than all my life’s pursuits. – I love and treasure the revelation of God because the word is the embodiment of God’s thoughts and wisdom. – I give myself continually to the study and meditation of the word. – I give no room for any pleasure of life to sway my attention. – Through the scriptures, I live ahead of my generation. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 622 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 3 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, don't disregard the Word of Christ. Esteem, absorb and enjoy the riches of His revelation. Have a fruitful week! Author Sunday, 6th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 3 (GLEANINGS FROM THE BOOK OF HEBREWS)"Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip." Hebrews 2:1 (KJV)DON'T DISREGARD the Gospel of Christ.The book of Hebrews emphasises Christ's completed work after offering His blood and His present work after ascension. As we discussed yesterday, the book opens with Christ as God's ultimate and present revelation.
This makes it costly for one to disregard His Word. To disregard is to ignore or disrespect the Message of Christ.
You cannot receive salvation when you disregard the Word of Christ. You cannot also grow in the consciousness of the glorious inheritance of this great Salvation when you disregard the Word of Christ.There were Jews who extremely regarded the words spoken by angels and yet disregarded God's ultimate message manifested in the flesh. They never saw the need to regard the Words of Jesus as Divine Words.The author of the Book of Hebrews makes a profound statement in Chapter 2:5-10:"For God will not place the coming world, of which we speak, under the government of angels. But the Scriptures affirm:What is man that you would even think about him, or care about Adam’s race. You made him lower than the angels for a little while. You placed your glory and honor upon his head as a crown. And you have given him dominion over the works of your hands, For you have placed everything under his authority. This means that God has left nothing outside the control of his Son, even if presently we have yet to see this accomplished. But we see Jesus, who as a man, lived for a short time lower than the angels and has now been crowned with glorious honor because of what he suffered in his death. For it was by God’s grace that he experienced death’s bitterness on behalf of everyone! For now he towers above all creation, for all things exist through him and for him. And that God made him, pioneer of our salvation, perfect through his sufferings, for this is how he brings many sons and daughters to share in his glory." (The Passion Translation)The government of the Kingdom is not under Angels. The government of the Kingdom is under the rule of Christ.
All things exist through Him and for Him.
Just as the author pointed out in chapter 1:"The Son is the dazzling radiance of God’s splendor, the exact expression of God’s true nature—his mirror image! He holds the universe together and expands it by the mighty power of his spoken word. He accomplished for us the complete cleansing of sins, and then took his seat on the highest throne at the right hand of the majestic One." Hebrews 1:3 (TPT)Even the whole universe rests on His word. The day Christ withdraws Himself from the universe it wouldn't hold together. No wonder when He gave up His Spirit on the cross, the earth couldn't hold itself together and the sun couldn't continue to give light (Matthew 27:51-54).Any message given by angels must not contradict the revelation of Jesus. When a message given by angels contradicts the revelation of Jesus or doesn't point you to the need to receive the revelation of Jesus, then it's a message from a Demonic entity.Most of the prevailing false teachings which have drawn many followers began as a message from an angel. These false teachers boast of their angelic encounters and disregard the true message of Christ. Any teaching which has its foundation only on an angelic encounter is not built on truth.Remember, Satan transforms himself into an angel of light. (2 Corinthians 11:14).God now speaks to us openly in the language of His Son Jesus. This language is articulated through the Gospel of Jesus. The only testimony which must be highly esteemed and regarded is the testimony of Jesus. For the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of prophecy (Revelation 19:10).Every believer must pay attention to the first warning from the author of Hebrews:
DON'T DISREGARD THE WORD OF CHRIST.
Read the verses: 1-4 from the Message Bible:"It’s crucial that we keep a firm grip on what we’ve heard so that we don’t drift off. If the old message delivered by the angels was valid and nobody got away with anything, do you think we can risk neglecting this latest message, this magnificent salvation? First of all, it was delivered in person by the Master, then accurately passed on to us by those who heard it from him. All the while God was validating it with gifts through the Holy Spirit, all sorts of signs and miracles, as he saw fit." Hebrews 2:1-4 (Message Bible)Don't risk rejecting or disregarding the glorious gospel of Jesus. Hold it tightly and run with it at all times.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JL35LOW-LHIDIG DEEPER(John 1:18; John 3:11,18; 1 John 4:9 Hebrews 12:25-26; Proverbs 3:21) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not esteem any other message above the revelation of Jesus, administered through the Gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I esteem the word more than all my life’s pursuits. – I love and treasure the revelation of God because the word is the embodiment of God’s thoughts and wisdom. – I give myself continually to the study and meditation of the word. – I give no room for any pleasure of life to sway my attention. – Through the scriptures, I live ahead of my generation. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 623 - FOCUS ON THE MANDATE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be determined and maintain an undisturbed composure this week. Be blessed! Author Monday, 7th October, 2024FOCUS ON THE MANDATE“So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless” 1 Corinthians 15:58 (NLT) I will sincerely not deny the challenges which may confront you, just because of your stand in Christ. Our Lord declared this: ”for you get enough hate from the world! But then, it hated me before it hated you. The world would love you if you belonged to it; but you don’t—for I chose you to come out of the world, and so it hates you. Do you remember what I told you? ‘A slave isn’t greater than his master!’ So since they persecuted me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to me, they would listen to you! The people of the world will persecute you because you belong to me, for they don’t know God who sent me.” John 15:18-21 (TLB)
The events and activities of this world are not designed to favour your faith walk.
They are skillfully and subtly designed to oppose, crush and cripple your faith in Christ. The systems of this world were structured by men, to redirect your desire, distract your focus, and impair your emotions, thoughts and conviction in Christ. And many fellow saints have become victims of the strategy of the systems of this world. Many make excuses in their service to God and become dull. Instead of serving or laboring with much enthusiasm and steadfastness, they become complacent and make the pursuit of their own interest their focus.
Don’t be like them. Don’t be a slave to this world.
Many are being used by their institutions as slaves and they waste their call on perishable things. We are to work but not to be wasted by the world.Through the building up of the Word of Grace, you become impregnable and immunized to the strategies of this world.
Beloved, as long as you are in Christ and have set your focus to intensively serve His course, you will face opposition and tribulation.
But tribulation should not break you.You are designed and built by Christ, to glory in Tribulation. “By whom (Jesus Christ) also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; (Romans 5:2-3 KJV emphasis added)  The Greek word used for Tribulation in this verse is "Thlipsis", which means a pressing or pressing together pressure, oppression, affliction, or distress.
To be afflicted or face tribulation, or to be oppressed or distressed is to be pressed.
However, when you are pressed what issues out is your content? When you are pressured the divine virtues within, must issue out.God has filled you with Himself. Hence, when you are pressed, the best of God will come out of you. Get your inward substances well-built, and refuse to be broken no matter the afflictions that come your way. The word of His Grace builds us up. (Acts 20:32). It dispelled fear. "Jesus said, ” I have told you these things, so that in Me you may have [perfect] peace and confidence. In the world you have tribulation and trials and distress and frustration; but be of good cheer [take courage; be confident, certain, undaunted]! For I have overcome the world. [I have deprived it of power to harm you and have conquered it for you.]” (John 16:33 AMPC) Be undaunted! Be confident! Be certain! Be determined!Have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. They may push you, press you together yet they are deprived of the power to harm you. Maintain an undisturbed composure. Through the knowledge of Christ, take on courage. Be toughened, and develop hard skin through the building up of the Word.
To do big things for God, you must have tough skin.
Be God-occupied. Don’t yield to challenges. Nothing has the capacity to work against you.  Anything that comes in contact with you must work for your good. You were designed that way. You were not designed to be broken. Don’t coil in at the sight of challenges, accusations, mockery and afflictions. Take advantage of the situations and challenges to resound the goodness of the Lord. Nothing should stop you from standing in the Truth, which is Christ. Don’t think the people of the world are ahead of you. Remember the adversary is the father of lies. He is always playing catch-up. 
Focus on the mandate the Lord has entrusted to you.
 Even if the whole world comes against you, YOU ARE BIGGER THAN THE WORLD. ”But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world.“ 1 John 4:4 REMAIN IMMOVABLE, UNABASHED AND DEADLY COMMITTED TO THE VISION OF THE LORD!!! DIG DEEPER(Romans 15:13; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Galatians 6:9; Philippians 2:30; Proverbs 21:21; Colossians 2:7; Psalm 43; John 16:33; 2 Corinthians 4:8-17; Romans 8:31-39) WE PRAY– We pray, that in the midst of persecution, distress and challenge “the God of hope fill all the saints with all joy and peace as we trust in Him, so that we shall overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. – We pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, (for not everyone has faith But the Lord is faithful) and the Lord should strengthen us and protect us from the evil one. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am undaunted and confident! – I have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. Therefore I have overcome the world. – I may be push and pressed together yet they are deprived of the power to harm me. – I maintain an undisturbed composure.– Through the knowledge of Christ, I take on courage. – I am toughened and I have hard skin through the building up of the Word and prayer. – I do big things for God. – I am God-occupied. – I don’t yield to challenges. – Nothing has the capacity to work against me. – Anything that comes in contact with me must work for my good.Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 624 - RUN WITH THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be determined and maintain an undisturbed composure this week. Shalom! Author Tuesday, 8th October, 2024 RUN WITH THE WORD“I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.” Psalm 119:32 (Berean Standard Bible) At the beginning of this New Year, the word of the Lord came to you. To you, this word of the Lord is God’s direction for your life and instruction for your future.
It is important to focus on it and commit your mind to it.
Within the Christ Commonwealth Community, Global (Love-Life Agency), the Lord has given us a word that is the focus of our personal lives and corporate expression. Our year 2024 is the year of: KINGDOM REFULGENCE – It is our year of Kingdom SHINING and SPREADING. – The year of Kingdom raptness, ambience and expressions. This is the commandment of the Lord to you. And this month of October is our month of DETERMINATION. It is one thing to receive the Word of the Lord, it is another thing to run with the Word of the Lord. Every Word of the Lord to you has its established path. The more you walk in the direction or path of the Word, the more your understanding is deepened and enlarged.
The path of the Word includes the instruction of the Word.
The path of the Word is what brings you into the fulfilment of the Word. By the Word of the Lord to you for the year, you know you have to change your prayer habit, establish better associations and avoid wrong ones. The instruction of the Word also came with an inspiration to give yourself to reading some materials and work towards some daily ministry targets.
You have to esteem those instructions and run by them.
This is a blessed new month and great grace abounds towards you.Commit your mind and heart to this prophetic word and run with it. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1ME&t=888sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:31-33; Hebrews 12:1; Psalm 18:36) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow and increase in understanding the paths of the Lord’s command. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take heed to the instructions of God for the year and this month. – I focus and run in the path of the Lord’s command. – I consecrate my heart and mind to the word of the Lord for the year and this month. – I don’t turn away from the instructions no matter the matter. – I stand firmly by the Word and lay aside every weight. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 625 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 4 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be determined and maintain an undisturbed composure this week. Shalom! Author Wednesday, 9th September, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 4 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"This is what the scripture says: "If you hear God's voice today, do not be stubborn, as your ancestors were when they rebelled against God." Hebrews 3:15 (Good News Translation)These gleanings from the book of Hebrews under the subject matter: THE 5 BETTER NOTS, are going to help you get deeply rooted in the revelation of the Lord and also to remain resolute in faith amidst this season of contradictory doctrines.There are many glorious things Christ had accomplished for the saints. And the adversary knows the only way the believer wouldn't enjoy these things or the glorious inheritance which Christ has accomplished and the things Christ is presently doing for the saints is when they disregard the Words of Christ.Thus, the need for the author of  Hebrews to warn the saints.Someone reading this may think "I am a believer in Christ and not a Hebrew. Therefore the message is not written to me and not a crucial matter for me as it may be for the Jews."It is a fact that the Epistle was written with details which will help bring the Jews into the understanding of what Christ has done. However, all scriptures are written for our learning (Romans 15:4).
Everything written in the scriptures is for all who believe in the Lord as Abraham believed.
"So all who put their faith in Christ share the same blessing Abraham received because of his faith." Galatians 3:9 (New Living Translation)Moreover, the "Jews" (there is more to say about the name Jews, but we'll look into it later), are not the only Hebrews. To get into the Second warning the author of Hebrews gave in his epistle, we must understand who a Hebrew is.In truth, the first Hebrew wasn't a Jew. In the scriptures, Abraham was the first to be called a Hebrew."... Abraham the Hebrew..." Genesis 14:14.And this verse was the first time the word "Hebrew"  was used in the BibleThe word Hebrew speaks of one who had come from the other side of the river. To be a Hebrew means to be a river crosser. It means one who has passed over from the other side.In the days of Abraham, he was technically the only one who believed in the only one God. All those who were of his tribe believed in other gods. And these people were beyond the river.When Joshua was helping the new generation of Israel elders and heads of the tribes to understand their roots, he made profound pointers to help them understand what it means to be a Hebrew.Let's look at the summary of what Joshua said:"And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods. And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac...And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat. Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD. And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD."Joshua 24:2-3,13-15 (KJV)From Joshua's Prophetic utterance, you can see that he established the distinction between the Hebrew (Abraham and his descendants) and those who remained on the side of the flood or the river. To be a Hebrew is a symbolic reality of one who has departed from idols to serve the only true God.
To be a Hebrew suggest something more spiritual than ones genetic status. It is more about your spiritual connection than your physical location.
Do you know the believer in Christ can also be referred to as a Hebrew?Has the believer in Christ not passed over from death to life?The believer in Christ has crossed over or transversed or passed over from the power of darkness to the kingdom of the Son?
Precious saints, by the revelation of the scriptures you are also a Hebrew.
This means you must highly esteem the writings in the book of Hebrews as a message of the Lord to you. Every matter addressed must be taken to heart.Which means as the Lord warned the Hebrews through the author of the epistle, the Lord is also warning you.1. DON'T DISREGARD THE WORD OF CHRIST TO YOU.2. Second warning:DON'T DOUBT GOD'S WORD!As you can see in the opening verse:"This is what the scripture says: "If you hear God's voice today, do not be stubborn, as your ancestors were when they rebelled against God." Hebrews 3:15 (Good News Translation)Abraham who is the first Hebrew, didn't  disregard the Word of the Lord that came to him to leave his tribe to a land where the Lord will show him. He didn't also doubt the Lord.To act stubbornly towards the Word of God is to demonstrate a hardened heart. This is what produces doubt. To doubt the Word of the Lord is to deny the potency of His Word.
When you deny the potency of the Word of God in your heart you have automatically submitted your heart to another voice which is not of God.
This was the condition of the Israelites who couldn't enter their inheritance while they were in the wilderness. These Israelites who doubted the Word of the Lord died in the wilderness without witnessing the land God promised them. They couldn't enter and enjoy the rest of God. It wasn't that God was wicked, it was because their DOUBT resisted them.
Your greatest limitation is the doubt in your heart. 
If you will believe the Word of the Lord and not have doubt in your heart, you shall enjoy the fullness of the glorious inheritance given to all the saints in Christ Jesus.Refuse to doubt the Word of the Lord.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(Psalm 95:1-11; Hebrews 4:6-11; Hebrews 3:6-14) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall daily take heed to the word of the Lord in our hearts and not give any place to doubt. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 13 - 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to doubt the word of God. – I take heed to the word of God at all times. – I give no place for doubt in my heart. – I have absolute confidence in the potency of the word of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 626 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 5 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be determined and maintain an undisturbed composure this week. Shalom! Author Thursday, 10th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 5 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"This is what the scripture says: "If you hear God's voice today, do not be stubborn, as your ancestors were when they rebelled against God." Hebrews 3:15 (Good News Translation)DON'T DOUBT GOD'S WORD!Some assume these warnings are legalistic and not grace-centered.There are countless warnings to the saints in the apostolic writings. "All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness" 2 Timothy 3:17 (ESV)The scriptures establish doctrines, provide exhortation, equip, rebuke, correct, give Prophetic warning and beseech.
The Grace of God doesn't watch on for wrongs to prevail. The Grace of God is God's solution to man's weakness and ungodliness.
In the epistle Paul (the apostle of the Grace of God) wrote to Titus, he explained one of the functions of Grace in the lives of the saints:"For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men, teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present age, looking for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ, who gave Himself for us, that He might redeem us from every lawless deed and purify for Himself His own special people, zealous for good works" Titus 2:11-14 (KJV)
Whenever you see a warning in the scriptures, it is important for you to give a careful look at it. You overlook such warnings at your own peril.
Warnings are cautions to keep you away from danger. Warnings are put up because there is the possibility someone may become a victim of those dangers.Don't ever turn away from certain warnings, and most importantly, when the warning signs are prevalent. The warnings become intense when the consequences may be drastic.Especially with the warnings in the epistles. And even the ones we are presently looking into in this series of "5 BETTER NOTS".Just in Hebrews 3, you will see a repetition of the same warning.- Verses 7-8 (NKJV): "Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says:“ Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion, In the day of trial in the wilderness"- Verses 12-13 (NKJV): "Beware, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief in departing from the living God; but exhort one another daily, while it is called “Today,” lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin."- Verse 15, as we have in the opening verse: "while it is said: “Today, if you will hear His voice, Do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion."When you are driving on a highway and in the direction you are heading you see a road sign with an indication, "ROAD CONSTRUCTION AHEAD" it's to help you know what you have ahead. The moment you start seeing "SLOW DOWN", at least twice or thrice, it means you are close to the construction site. You will be driving above the speed limit which may be indicated at your own risk.To save yourself from any form of danger you have to observe and give attention to the warning signs.One of the crucial warning signs we see in Hebrews 3 is "DON'T DOUBT THE WORD OF GOD".
Beloved, to doubt the Word of God is to harden your heart and walk in unbelief.
The word of God cannot germinate or become fruitful in a hardened heart. To harden your heart is to set yourself against what God has said. To walk in unbelief is ruinous. To walk in unbelief is to live contrary to faith. And a life which is not of faith does not please God."But without faith it is impossible to please God. For he that cometh to God, must believe that He is, and is a rewarder to them that seek Him" Hebrews 11:6 (Douay-Rheims Bible)The derelict consequence of unbelief or a hardness of heart is not caused by God. It is caused by the condition of your heart. The adversary knows how much God loves you. But also knows how God’s love cannot legally flourish in your heart when you deny and doubt its working ability.
To have the word of God yield results in your life, you must refuse to doubt what God has said.
Sometimes the challenges may seem to be overwhelming but don't be moved by what you see. Stay GRIT in the Word of God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(Psalm 95:1-11; Hebrews 4:6-11; Hebrews 3:6-14) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall courageously hold on to God's Word and doubt every doubtful thought of the adversary. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 16 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I doubt all contrary doubts against the word of God in my heart. – I take heed to the word of God at all times. – I give no place for doubt in my heart. – I have absolute confidence in the potency of the word of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 627 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 6 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be determined and maintain an undisturbed composure this week. Shalom! Author Friday, 11th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 6 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"It is clear that they could not enter into their inheritance because they wrapped their hearts in unbelief." Hebrews 3:19 (TPT)The Consequence Of Doubting The WORD OF GOD!As I mentioned in yesterday's episode, warnings are cautions to keep you away from danger. You overlook such warnings at your own peril. I further explained that you must not turn away from warnings given in the scriptures. And when they are prevalent, it means the consequences may be drastic.In Hebrews 3, as the author admonished the saints not to harden their hearts (which means not to doubt or have unbelief in their hearts), he proved the consequence of such posture with what happened to the Israelites.God sent Moses to deliver Israel from Egypt so that they would receive their inheritance. This inheritance which was designated for them was first given to Abraham.However, Abraham received this inheritance by faith, which means that all those who will share in it must have faith.The Israelites who came out of Egypt didn't take the character of Egypt out of their heart. They hardened their hearts towards the Lord; just as Pharoah hardened his heart. Just as Pharoah witnessed the demonstrations of God's power and yet doubted or hardened his heart, these Israelites also witnessed the power of God and still doubted Him in the wilderness.Thus, the author of the Book of Hebrews reminded his readers not to repeat the unbelief of their fathers in the wilderness."There your fathers tested me and tried my patience even though they saw my miracles for forty years they still doubted me!" Hebrews 3:9 (TPT).This caused that generation not to enter into the promised inheritance. They wandered in the wilderness, till that entire unbelieving generation died there. Their feet wandered mainly because their hearts were wandering and refused to learn the ways of the Lord."The same people who were delivered from bondage and brought out of Egypt by Moses, were the ones who heard and still rebelled. They grieved God for forty years by sinning in their unbelief, until they dropped dead in the desert. So God swore an oath that they would never enter into his calming place of rest all because they disobeyed him. It is clear that they could not enter into their inheritance because they wrapped their hearts in unbelief." Hebrews 3:16-19 (TPT).The adversary knew the only way to stop them from entering their rest and to enjoy their inheritance was to make them doubt the Lord. 
Where there is doubt there is no faith. Where there is no faith, there cannot be the enjoyment of God's inheritance.
"For the promise to Abraham or to his descendants that he would inherit the world was not through the law, but through the righteousness that comes by faith." Hebrews 4:13 (Holman Christian Standard Bible).As a believer in Christ, you are an heir of God. As long as you continue to walk in faith and not give room for doubt or unbelief you will enjoy the fullness of the Inheritance you have in Christ.
Refuse to doubt the Word of His Grace for it is the legal chronicle of the bequeathed inheritance.
Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(Psalm 95:1-11; Hebrews 4:6-11; Hebrews 3:6-14; Galatians 3:15-29) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the understanding of God so that our faith will not stagger. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 19 - 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to doubt the word of His grace. – I take heed to the word of God at all times. – My faith will not stagger. – I grow in the understanding of God daily. – I have absolute confidence in the potency of the word of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 628 - BE METAMORPHOSED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Refuse to doubt the Word of His Grace for it is the legal chronicle of the bequeathed inheritance. Enjoy a fruitful weekend! Author Saturday, 12th October, 2024BE METAMORPHOSED“And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit.” 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) There are a lot of people who lie about themselves. Beloved, God didn’t just throw us into time without identity.
There is an identity and intention for man, specifically the man in Christ.
Christ came not only to give us the true revelation of God; He also came to unveil to us, God’s true picture about us. There is an imagery of us in God’s mind.We have created pictures of enmity toward God in our minds, and we assume God has the same picture of us.
Most people in Christ look at themselves according to the false imagery created by religion.
Some born-agains see themselves as sinners in Christ. They sing songs of God’s unfailing love, yet think God has hatred for them. Beloved the Word of God is the MIRROR of God.We look into mirrors to have a view of our outlook. Mirrors allow us to see ourselves. They show us what we look like, they let us examine our true selves, and make us espy our unique heritage. Sometimes a mirror will show you a beautiful part of yourself that you did not notice before.
Interestingly, a mirror doesn’t add nor change who we are or what we are.
A mirror brings to our realization and consciousness how we really look. This is how the MIRROR OF THE WORD OF GOD WORKS:It reveals our true essence and quality. Look at the opening verse again:“And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit” 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) From the King James Bible, you will see the word “CHANGE” instead of transformation. The original word in Greek is “metamorphoō” which means to be transfigured or transformed. It is a change in state and form or structure. We can understand this transformation by observing the butterfly metamorphosis: The butterfly’s life cycle begins with an egg and progresses to a caterpillar, chrysalis, and adult, and then finally ends with the natural transformation of the butterfly. These stages were not mere changes they were transformations. However, the transformation or metamorphosis is a result of the inherent quality of the butterfly. At the egg stage, no one sees a butterfly, however, it has the quality of a butterfly. A hen lays an egg, however, this egg doesn’t metamorphose into a butterfly, because it doesn’t have the genetic code of a butterfly. This is the principle I am establishing concerning the principle of the Word of God as a mirror.
The transformation you experience by the Word is a result of the seed of the Word in you at your new birth in Christ.
“Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth forever.” 1 Peter 1:23 (KJV) Do you see it? YOU ARE BORN AGAIN BY THE WORD, which is THE SEED OF THE DIVINE LIFE. Since you are born of the Word, you have the Word of God in you as your seed.
Therefore, as you look into the mirror of the Word, you are transformed more and more as the EXPRESSION OF THE WORD OF GOD. 
How does it happen, the transformation begins with the RENEWING OF YOUR MIND. “And do not be conformed to this world [any longer with its superficial values and customs], but be transformed and progressively changed [as you mature spiritually] by the renewing of your mind [focusing on godly values and ethical attitudes], so that you may prove [for yourselves] what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect [in His plan and purpose for you].”Romans 12:2 (AMP). As you behold the Word of God it corrects your old thought patterns and renovates your mind with the riches of divine revelation. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(James 1:22-25; 1 Corinthians 13:12; Psalm 84:7; John 17:24; 2 Corinthians 4:4,6; Romans 8:29) WE PRAYThat we will grow more in the consciousness of what Christ has already done for us BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Luke 22 - 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As I look into the word daily, I am transformed into the image I see.– I increase in strength as I fellowship with the word daily. – I increase in glory daily by the word. – As I look at Christ daily in the scriptures, the more like him I become in consciousness. – I renew my mind daily with the word. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 629 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 7 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and a bear fruit unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Sunday, 13th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 7 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"It is clear that they could not enter into their inheritance because they wrapped their hearts in unbelief." Hebrews 3:19 (TPT)The Gospel of Christ Is Your Inheritance; Don't Doubt ItFor the Israelites to wrap their hearts in unbelief means they had the opportunity to hear the Word of God but they did not believe and receive it.
The consequence of unbelief is to deny yourself from the rest of God. To come into rest is to receive and enjoy the inheritance in Christ.
For the Israelites, because they doubted the Word of the Lord they didn't enter their rest. They wandered in the wilderness till they died there. Those who entered the promised land were those who believed the Word of the Lord."For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it." Hebrews 4:2 (KJV)The Word was given to the Israelites to usher them into the promised land. But because they didn't mix it with faith, they could not enter.Nevertheless, the promised land was a typology of Christ (we will look more into this in another episode). The promised land wasn't the substance but a shadow of the reality. The rest which the Lord promised them was Christ Himself.No wonder Abraham still looked forward to a more glorious city when he got to this land that God promised him."Faith motivated Abraham to obey God’s call and leave the familiar to discover the territory he was destined to inherit from God. So he left with only a promise and without even knowing ahead of time where he was going, Abraham stepped out in faith. He lived by faith as an immigrant in his promised land as though it belonged to someone else. He journeyed through the land living in tents with Isaac and Jacob who were persuaded that they were also co-heirs of the same promise. His eyes of faith were set on the city with unshakable foundations, whose architect and builder is God himself." Hebrews 11:8-10 (The Passion Translation)This City Abraham looked forward to is Christ.For God to usher His people into the substance of the Inheritance which He promised Abraham. He has to present the complete substance of revelation which will usher His people into their full inheritance.To enjoy the fullness of the Inheritance it will take more than a promise; it will take the full complete original Word.This was why the Book of Hebrews had this direct introduction:"God, having spoken to the fathers long ago in [the voices and writings of] the prophets in many separate revelations [each of which set forth a portion of the truth], and in many ways, has in these last days spoken [with finality] to us in [the person of One who is by His character and nature] His Son [namely Jesus], whom He appointed heir and lawful owner of all things, through whom also He created the universe [that is, the universe as a space-time-matter continuum]." Hebrews 2:1-2 (Amplified Bible)The central theme of the book of Hebrews is the Revelation of Jesus as the FINAL AND COMPLETE SUBSTANCE OF REALITY.It is the book with the Message of The Better Things In Christ (which are far more glorious than the things of the old).
God's full and final message is not just given through Christ; His complete and final revelation is CHRIST HIMSELF.
Christ is the Embodiment of God's Inheritance to His people. When anyone disregards and doubts or disbelieves the message or the gospel of Christ the person has denied His Inheritance. The Gospel of Christ is the revelation of your Inheritance.To doubt the reality of the Gospel is to your own disadvantage.
Remain firmly rooted in the Revelational-Gospel of Jesus our Lord.
Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1ME&t=888sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 95:1-11; Hebrews 4:6-11; Hebrews 3:6-14; Galatians 3:15-29) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall fully embrace and esteem the gospel of our Lord at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 1 - 3  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to doubt the word of His grace. – I take heed to the word of God at all times. – My faith will not stagger. – I grow in the understanding of God daily. – I have absolute confidence in the potency of the word of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 630 - LET CHRIST BE SEEN IN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, it will only take your dedication and consistency with the little instructions you are given, to make a difference in your world. Selah. Author Monday, 14th October, 2024 LET CHRIST BE SEEN IN YOU"For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come". 1 Timothy 4:8 (KJV) The matter of godliness is essential in our faith walk.Godliness is the expression of divinity. Godliness (eusebeia from "eú" means well and "sébomai" also means worship, venerate, pay homage); literally “well worship”. This reflects an attitude of one’s life to live with a sense of God’s presence.
Godliness is a sacred reverence exhibited especially in actions.
The consecrating presence of God is conveyed into all life experiences by godliness. We see the picture of godliness through Christ; how that, He made all behold the inexplicable reality of the divine life. "No one has seen God [His essence, His divine nature] at any time; the [One and] only begotten God [that is, the unique Son] who is in the intimate presence of the Father, He has explained Him [and interpreted and revealed the awesome wonder of the Father]." John 1:18 (Amplified) How did Jesus demonstrate, interpret and reveal the awesome wonder of the Father? See what Brother Luke said here in Acts 1 verse 1: “To Theophilus, the lover of God. I write to you again, my dear friend, to give you further details about the life of our Lord Jesus and all the things that he did and taught.” Through all the things that our Lord and Saviour Jesus did and taught, many beheld the glory of God. Godliness is basically the demonstration of God’s nature, love, glory, joy and power to others. By this, we live a life pleasing to the Lord. You speak like God and act as God. This is living as Christ in your sphere. Do many see Christ in you? Godliness is not about living out your own life in a "god-way". It is rather living out the quality of God’s life dispensed into you.  It is the outflow of the increased life of God in you.
Beloved, until you decrease for Christ to increase in you; many will not see Christ.
Godliness is seen when you lay down your life for Christ only to spring forth and blossom in you.You cannot fake true godliness. It is not a religious practice because it transcends religion. Neither is it an application of an outward list of rules and regulations.
True godliness is lived by the power of the transfused life of Christ.
Many ostensibly very “religious” people have an appearance of godliness, going through the motions of religion, but they don’t have the power to truly lay down their lives for Christ to blossom in them (See 2 Timothy 3:5). By human standards, (just as the Pharisees and the Sadducees), there is a boxed-up interpretation of God and His expressions. However, in Christ Jesus, we see that the revelation of God is beyond our human imagination. Thus, you can truly see God and express Him only by the power and revelation of Jesus Christ in you.
Until you behold and handle Christ Jesus, you cannot declare or express His life.
“We saw him with our very own eyes. We gazed upon him and heard him speak. Our hands actually touched him, the one who was from the beginning, the Living Expression of God. This Life-Giver was made visible and we have seen him. We testify to this truth: the eternal Life-Giver lived face-to-face with the Father and has now dawned upon us. So we proclaim to you what we have seen and heard about this Life-Giver so that we may share and enjoy this life together. For truly our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus, the Anointed One.” 1 John 1:1-3 (TPT). Oh, Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER (2 Peter 3:11; Genesis 5:24;  2 Peter 1:5-8; 2 Timothy 3:12; Psalm 1:1-3; Micah 6:8; Titus 2:11-14) WE PRAYWe pray that by the empowering ability of God’s Spirit we shall live and walk as godly on this earth, bearing Godly fruits unto God’s glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I decrease that Christ will increase in me. – I am empowered to demonstrate the God kind of life in every situation. – I carry the presence of God in all places. – I don’t just have the form of Godliness, I have the power to express God in all things. – I walk with God according as He has designed. – Many see God in my speech and conducts. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 631 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 8 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, laziness is one of the reasons people don’t see the manifestation of their blessing. Avoid any reason or anything that leads to idleness or unproductivity this week. Get up and get to work! Author   THE 5 BETTER NOTS 8 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"It is clear that they could not enter into their inheritance because they wrapped their hearts in unbelief." Hebrews 3:19 (TPT)DON'T BE DECEIVED INTO DOUBT
God's full and final message is not just given through Christ; His complete and final revelation is CHRIST HIMSELF.
To doubt Jesus as God's complete revelation is to doubt God.And for the adversary to sway you into doubt, he has to make you doubt the Person and Revelation of Jesus. The goal of the adversary is to make you stagger in faith and not enjoy your inheritance in Christ. Thus he will do whatever it takes to propagate his deception.You cannot walk in the fullness of the blessings of the Gospel when you allow the deception of the adversary to dominate your thoughts.The adversary spreads his lies mainly through false teachings or doctrines.You must beware of any teaching which makes you doubt that:- Jesus is God- the Bible is the Word of God.- God has given us the Holy Spirit.It doesn't matter how long you have been saved or how long you have been in Church, when you give your mind continuously to false teachings, doubt will creep into your heart unawares.Take some moments to read these previous Episodes on DECEPTION.Some false teachers start drawing your attention to themselves by amplifying mysticism. Some make you think God is mystical and it is impossible for anyone to comprehend His thoughts. They increase their credence in your mind by boasting of their angelic encounters and messages received from angels.
Get this: Any message preached by any being that doesn't agree with or reveal Christ Jesus is not a message from God.
The present message of God to mankind is not a mystery. God had made Himself visible through Christ.God's final revelation is not the word of angels nor the word of the Prophets.It is the Word of God spoken to us in Christ (Hebrews 1:1-2)God ultimately expressed or manifested Himself in only Christ Jesus because Jesus is God in the flesh."And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Preached among the Gentiles, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory." 1 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV)For some to also doubt Christ they attempt to discredit the authenticity of the Bible. They condemn the Bible saying, it is not the Word of God.Meanwhile, these people secretly go into the Bible to glean life lessons, concepts to shape their religious minds, etc.But publicly condemn the Bible with the goal of discrediting Christ.
You cannot genuinely study the Bible without meeting Christ.
He is the centricity of the Bible.The writings of the Prophets, Psalmist and Kings from Genesis to Malachi (known as the Old Testament portion of the Bible) testify of Christ.The New Testament portion declares the fulfillment of the revelation of Christ."You search and keep on searching and examining the Scriptures because you think that in them you have eternal life; and yet it is those [very Scriptures] that testify about Me" John 5:39 (Amplified Bible)Some even have to extend their indoctrination or negative propaganda by creating false Bible translations to distort original texts. They use their wrong translations to deceive innocent people.Be a student of the Word of God. Don't be like the Israelites who were easily deceived by the mixed multitudes (the ungodly people from other nations who joined them as they left Egypt).By the deceptive thoughts of these mixed multitudes, the Israelites saw the power of God, but because they had not studied the ways of the Lord, they still walked in doubt.Get yourself established in the truth of the Gospel of Jesus and do not be swayed by the lies of this generation.Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4; Hebrews 4:6-11; Hebrews 3:6-14; Galatians 3:15-29) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be guarded and fully rooted in the true revelation of Jesus through the scriptures and the epistles. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I behold the reality of Jesus in the scriptures. – Jesus is God!– He is Eternal and His saving Grace is everlasting! – I refuse to look away from the reality of Jesus.– I give no room for any other gospel. – I judge every revelation through the lens of Jesus. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 632 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 9 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency What will be your testimony at the climax of your days here on earth? What will be said of you in that city, institution, or nation? Will it be said that you served the purpose of God or you served your interests? Selah. Author Wednesday, 16th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 9 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?" Hebrews 10:28-29 (KJV)DON'T DESPISE THE WORD OF GOD.This epistle of Hebrews was written to both Jewish believers in Christ to strengthen their faith and to Jews who have not believed in Jesus to help them see Christ as God's final message and His death as God's ultimate sacrifice.The author skillfully used the Jewish understanding of animal sacrifices, offerings, the various Priesthoods, their Patriarchs, the Tabernacle and its items, including the law, to help them understand Christ as the expression of God’s perfection.As we have seen in the previous episodes of this discussion, the author began this epistle with no ambiguity. He directly established the reality that Christ is:- God's final message (See Hebrews 1:1-2).- Superior and better than the Prophets (Hebrews 1:1-2), angels (Hebrews 1:4 — 2:18), Moses (Hebrews 3:1-19), Joshua (Hebrews 4:1-16) Aaron (Hebrews 5:1-10)There are many more of Christ's Superiority addressed in this book of Hebrews.This is the simple message of the author of Hebrews to the Jews (and all who may read this epistle) in the opening verse:Because you esteemed Moses, you were afraid to despise his words and the laws given through him. The punishment that came with disobeying and despising the laws of Moses was severe, thus, people were careful not to despise Moses.Under the Old Covenant, it was not possible for people to despise the need for the various daily, weekly, monthly and yearly offerings and sacrifices.People kept the commandments of the Lord given through Moses because it was the only way they could live and enjoy the Lord's blessings.
Now the Lord Jesus is superior to Moses. His principles and perfection are better.
The sacrifice of Himself on the cross is superior, and better and ultimately surpasses all the sacrifices of the Old. None of the animal sacrifices produced eternal life.Therefore, if despising the Word of the Lord given through Moses will cause you severely, much more when you despise the perfect Word of the Lord unveiled through Christ.
The Word of the Lord unveiled through Christ is the Gospel of Jesus. It is also the Gospel of Grace.
To despise the gospel of Jesus is to despise or insult the Spirit of Grace (this is explained further in the Bible Compendium, PHOTIZO, which will be launched in a few months).To despise the work of Christ on the cross is to reject the eternal salvation which is made available to all who believe and receive Jesus.At every point in your life, you must continue to focus on Jesus and esteem His Glorious testimony of Grace.Within this age, many teachings are focused on esteeming the self-efforts of humanity and works of the flesh, rather than the finished work of Jesus in His death, burial and resurrection.There are many religious groups which make people undermine or despise the death of Jesus for mankind. They ask themselves "How can one man come and die for all humanity"? 
Beloved the work of Christ on the cross is God's ultimate work to make salvation available for all men.
Some still esteem animal sacrifices more than the sacrifice of Christ.Don't be deceived by these false doctrines. No animal sacrifice can produce eternal salvation. Your eternal salvation is in Christ Jesus.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Acts 4:12; Galatians 3:1-13; Hebrews 10:5-12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall beam with confidence as we tell the world the glorious news of Christ's ultimate sacrifice and precious testimony of salvation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I esteem the word of God at all times. - I esteem the work of Christ on the cross as God's ultimate work of salvation for all men.- The work of Christ is superior to all the laws of Moses.- I am eternally saved through the finished work of Christ.- I continue to remain focused on Jesus.- I am a witness of this glorious news of eternal salvation.Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 633 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 10 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beware of people who wish to do more for the Lord and claim to know the Lord. They believe they are serving the Lord but are not willing to go the extra mile for Jesus. Beware of drawing inspiration from such people. Selah.
