Author Thursday, 17th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 10 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"but my righteous one will live by faith, and my whole being won’t be pleased with anyone who shrinks back." Hebrews 10:38 (Common English Bible)I want to congratulate you if you have consistently followed this discussion.Within these times people are interested in teachings which entice them.As Paul the Apostle told his son Timothy:"For the time is coming when [people] will not tolerate (endure) sound and wholesome instruction, but, having ears itching [for something pleasing and gratifying], they will gather to themselves one teacher after another to a considerable number, chosen to satisfy their own liking and to foster the errors they hold" 2 Timothy 4:3 (AMPC).Many believers don't have the patience to study and grow deeply in the knowledge of Christ.To mature in the faith, one must be patient in following systematic teachings. Nobody gains mastery in the word of God by rushing through its teachings. 
The knowledge and understanding of God are built precept upon precept.
"God conceals the revelation of His word in the hiding place of His glory. But the honor of kings is revealed by how they thoroughly search out the deeper meaning of all that God says." Proverbs 25:2 (TPT)As we have been made kings and priests unto our God, we must take delight in the honor of thoroughly searching out the deeper meaning of all that God says.I have been sharing on the FIVE (5) BETTER NOTS. So far I have shared three (3) of the five:1. DON'T DISREGARD THE WORD OF GOD TO YOU.2. DON'T DOUBT GOD'S WORD.3. DON'T DESPISE THE WORD OF GODToday we delve more into this discussion by looking at the fourth BETTER NOT:4. DON'T DRAW AWAY OR DEPART FROM THE WORD.
To draw back from the Word is to act out of fear. It is to take the position of a coward.
This warning is crucial to your enjoyment of the Lord. It's interesting how the author of Hebrews addressed both the warning and its consequence in the same sentence.Take another look at the opening verse:"but my righteous one will live by faith, and my whole being won’t be pleased with anyone who shrinks back." Hebrews 10:38 (CEB)Let's read it from the Living Bible:"And those whose faith has made them good in God’s sight must live by faith, trusting him in everything. Otherwise, if they shrink back, God will have no pleasure in them."What made you righteous or brought you into the fellowship of God is faith in God through Christ Jesus.
The danger of departing from the Word of Christ is to choose to live by your self-efforts and not by faith.
Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. To be precise the Word of Christ.As I previously pointed out, God's final message to mankind is Christ Jesus (Hebrews 1:1-2).This means the fullness of faith germinates in your heart through the revelation of Jesus. The revelation of Jesus produces boldness in your heart. You are made righteous by faith in Christ Jesus, through the glorious message of Christ. This righteousness gives you the boldness to stand in the presence of God without any guilt.It is by the righteousness of Christ in you through faith, that makes God to be pleased with you. God is not pleased with you because of your own works. God is pleased with you because of your faith in Christ.
To trust your self-effort at any time is to refuse to act in faith.
Do you know what the scriptures say about not living by faith in Christ Jesus?"And without faith living within us it would be impossible to please God..." Hebrews 11:6 (TPT).As at the time the book of Hebrews was written, many believers were staggering in their faith because of the opposition to the gospel by the practitioners of Judaism.Before this verse, the author of Hebrews admonished the readers saying:"Don’t you remember those days right after the Light shined in your hearts? You endured a great marathon season of suffering hardships, yet you stood your ground. And at times you were publicly and shamefully mistreated, being persecuted for your faith; then at other times you stood side by side with those who preach the message of hope. You sympathized with those in prison and when all your belongings were confiscated you accepted that violation with joy; convinced that you possess a treasure growing in heaven that could never be taken from you. So don’t lose your bold, courageous faith, for you are destined for a great reward! You need the strength of endurance to reveal the poetry of God’s will and then you receive the promise in full. For soon and very soon, “The One who is appearing will come without delay!” And he also says,“My righteous ones will live from my faith. But if fear holds them back, my soul is not content with them!” But we are certainly not those who are held back by fear and perish; we are among those who have faith and experience true life!" Hebrews 10:32-39 (TPT).Oh, glory to God!
Though there is a warning to not draw back, we have this sure confidence that as we have received the Lord, we shall not draw back.
We are among those who have faith. You will later see in chapter 11 of Hebrews the reference to those who had faith.And you will even see that their faith was not just in an empty promise. Their faith was with the revelation of Jesus in their heart.See the example of Moses:"It was by faith that Moses, when he grew up, refused to be treated as the grandson of the king, but chose to share ill-treatment with God’s people instead of enjoying the fleeting pleasures of sin.  He thought that it was better to suffer for the promised Christ than to own all the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking forward to the great reward that God would give him" Hebrews 11:24-26 (TLB)Beloved no matter the accusation or mockery, have this conviction in your heart that you have found the greatest treasure of faith. Your faith is not built on dead hope. 
Your faith is in Christ Jesus who is the reality of God.
Refuse to draw back!Refuse to be discouraged.Don't turn away from this precious revelation of Jesus.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=69NS5kfPaVcDIG DEEPER(Psalm 85:8; Psalm 44:18; Romans 4:19-21) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be strengthened daily by the word and never cower in faith no matter the contending situations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 13 - 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the greatest treasure of faith.- I refuse to draw back.- My faith is not built on dead Hope.- My faith is in Christ Jesus who is the reality of God. - I refuse to be discouraged. - I keep my gaze focused on the precious reality of Jesus. Thank you, Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 634 - THE 5 BETTER NOTS 11 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and a bear fruit unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Friday, 18th October, 2024 THE 5 BETTER NOTS 11 (Gleanings From the Book of Hebrews)"See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven" Hebrews 12:25 (KJV)Finally, we come to the fifth point of the FIVE (5) BETTER NOTS. 1. DON'T DISREGARD THE WORD OF GOD TO YOU.2. DON'T DOUBT GOD'S WORD.3. DON'T DESPISE THE WORD OF GOD.4. DON'T DRAW AWAY OR DEPART FROM THE WORD.5. DON'T REFUSE OR DENY THE WORD OF THE LORD.These 5 Better Nots are crucial because they all point to more severe consequences.
These 5 Better Nots are to both the saved and the unsaved.
When the unsaved disregard, doubt, despise, draw away, deny or refuse the Word of God in Christ, they will not be saved. When the saved also disregard, doubt, despise, draw away, deny or refuse the Word of God in Christ, they will not ENJOY THE FULLNESS OF THEIR INHERITANCE.It is better not to do these five things because they determine your faith or faithlessness. And without faith it is impossible to please God.Though these Five (5) Better Nots are not the only warnings in the Book of Hebrews (we will be discussing other warnings later), these ones determine the foundation of your faith.From Hebrews 12, what we find is that the Word of God is also referred to as the Voice of the Lord.The author explains that all those who have come to Christ have not come to Mount Sinai as of the Old, but "by contrast, we have already come near to God in a totally different realm, the Zion-realm, for we have entered the city of the Living God, which is the New Jerusalem in heaven! We have joined the festal gathering of myriads of angels in their joyous celebration!" Hebrews 12:22 (TPT).The thing is this, at Mount Sinai people couldn't stand on their feet. They trembled in terror when they were warned by the jarring blast and the thundering voice. When they heard the voice at Sinai they begged that the fearful voice may be silent.At Sinai, the voice spoke condemnation because it was to judge them by the law or the "Sinai" covenant invoked.The voice even commanded that:"If so much as an animal approaches the mountain it is to be stoned to death!” (Hebrews 12:20).It seemed impossible to be approached.This is no longer the condition of the Voice of the Lord. In the Old when God spoke, His Voice was unapproachable, but now in Christ, He has fully spoken and expressed His heart (Hebrews 1:1-2).
Christ who is the speaking of the ultimate revelation of God has brought us into the refreshing presence of God.
Through Christ, God's Voice now speaks forgiveness because the condition is no longer based on the self-efforts of God's people. Let me get this straight to you:This doesn't mean that God's Voice has changed. God's Voice has not changed. It is the covenant or the condition which has changed because of Christ. The covenant or the condition did not change God. The condition and covenants changed our position and how we are able to respond to God.Until Christ, man was to respond to the voice of God by their self-efforts or obedience through the law. But now in Christ, you respond to God through the forgiveness of Christ. 
Your response to God is no longer according to your self-efforts or your position of obedience. Your response to God is according to the obedience of Christ.
"And we have come to Jesus who established a new covenant with his blood sprinkled upon the mercy seat; blood that continues to speak from heaven, “forgiveness,” a better message than Abel’s blood that cries from the earth, “justice.” Hebrews 12: 24 (KJV).This is amazing!This then gives clarity to the fifth warning.By the blood of Jesus, we have been brought to a place in Christ where we can hear the voice of the Lord without being terrified. 
When you reject or deny God's voice or God's speaking in Christ, you have rejected all the legal accomplishments of the blood of Christ.
Which means you have chosen to hear and respond to the Voice of God as it were in Sinai. You shall be terrified.The author of Hebrews further explains this:The change is not the voice but your position to hear the voice. The voice of the Lord is not only shaking the systems of the world, but it is also shaking the unseen powers in the heavenly realm once. (Hebrews 12:26, TPT)Now where you are positioned to hear His voice, will determine whether you will be shaken with terror or be firmly established and unshakeable with purest thanksgiving and purest worship which delight the LORD (Hebrews 12:27-28).
Beloved, to reject the Gospel of Christ Jesus is to reject the final Word of the Lord to you.
Are you hearing the voice of the Lord in Christ or you have rejected Him (the Ultimate Voice or Word of God)?If you do or have rejected His voice in Christ then be ready to hear the Lord as the people did at Sinai.Selah.I believe this series has blessed you.Stay glued for other GLEANINGS FROM THE BOOK OF HEBREWS.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3UUGMOiS6T0DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 8:33; Galatians 3:5-9; Psalm 85:8; Psalm 44:18) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain attentive and continuously take heed to the speaking of the Lord which is Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 16 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to the word of God.- I don't deny the word of God.- I have absolute confidence in the word of God. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 635 - RUN TO THE LORD!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Many have delayed the plan and purpose of God for their lives because they failed to be prompt with an assignment. Beloved, be prompt! Author Saturday, 19th October, 2024 RUN TO THE LORD“Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.” Isaiah 45:22 (ESV)To think that God is your enemy is absurd.God sent His only begotten son to die for you (John 3:16). He didn’t send His son to a perfect world.“But God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners.” Romans 5:8 (NLT)
You are the focus of God’s love and kindness. 
You turn away from God because you seek love in the wrong places.GOD IS LOVE!Do you think you have badly dishonored God, wickedly lived and opposed God’s purpose or doubted God’s power and love?Well, God’s arms are still open to receive you.
He is your greatest help, don’t turn away from Him.
There is a lot to learn from what happened between Jesus and Peter in Matthew 14: “And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It is a ghost!” And they cried out for fear. But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid.” And Peter answered Him and said, “Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water.” So He said, “Come.” And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus. But when he saw that the wind was boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!” And immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and caught him, and said to him, “O you of little faith, why did you doubt?” And when they got into the boat, the wind ceased.” Matthew 14:26-32 (NKJV) Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS...Click here to register. It's for SERIOUS MINDS! This is one of the most inspiring stories in the scriptures.From the above verses, Jesus revealed the root of Peter’s condition: He doubted the Word of the Lord.The issue was not really about the storm, the problem was how Peter doubted.Yet Jesus didn’t hold it against him; He helped Peter from sinking.Peter walked on water because he was walking on the words of Jesus until he turned away from Jesus to the boisterous wind which made him afraid.Peter didn’t curse, he didn’t murmur, he didn’t assume Jesus was angry with him. He still trusted the saving grace of the Lord.He shouted, “Lord, save me!”.
Beloved, no matter the situation or your failures, run to the Lord. Trust the Lord to help you.
It doesn’t matter what you think you are, or the wrongs you think you have done; if you will genuinely turn to the Lord for help, He will help you.”For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved” Romans 10:13 (NKJV)Esteem God’s HELP above your challenges. No matter how deep you have sunk into negative addictions, the defeats, the pains, the failures, debts and the ocean of troubles the hand of the Lord is not too short to save you. (Isaiah 59:1).Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EiwNLXcVlRsDIG DEEPER(Joel 2:32; Isaiah 65:24; Proverbs 18:10; Psalm 91:2; Psalm 18:2; Isaiah 30:15) WE PRAYWe pray declaring the abundance of God’s help to live above all our weaknesses, our challenges, our failures and fears. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024John 19 - 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not helpless. – I esteem the help of God above my challenges. – I live above weaknesses, failures and fears. – The Lord is my greatest help. – I run to the Lord at all times. Oh Thank you Lord![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 636 - GET INTO PRAYER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter your weaknesses, and overwhelming challenge, trust in God’s unfailing mercies. At a point when your faith seems to fail, turn to God’s mercies. His MERCIES ENDURES FOREVER! Author Sunday, 20th October, 2024 GET INTO PRAYER“With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified)The scriptures emphasize the need for prayer. We see the importance of prayer through the life and testimonies of the Biblical patriarchs, prophets, priests, kings, servants, soldiers, wives, husbands, widows, the rich, the poor, the distressed, the victorious, farmers, physicians, craftsmen, builders, fishermen, prime ministers, scribes, prisoners, eunuchs, sinners, apostles, the youths and the adults or the old.
Prayer is not for some specific people. Both the small and the great are all called to prayer.
From the scriptures and the epistles, we are charged to pray at all times, in every place or everywhere and without ceasing.Jesus shared a parable to this end, “men ought always to pray and not faint” (Luke 18:1).Prayer is a demonstration of faith and confidence in God. Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS! Prayer is essential in this spiritual warfare. It is an advanced technology given to us by God, to stay in touch with the military command post or control center.
Unceasing prayer gives access to unceasing mission plans and strategies.
This was David’s main battle strategy. He was always in touch with God at every battle, so he always knew what to do on the battlefield. While the enemies were strategizing, David was in touch with God, who knows and sees all things.You don’t fight against unseen evil forces, principalities, powers, or rulers of dark places and not be consistent in prayer at all times.It is dangerous to be a soldier and not be in touch with your military headquarters.In ancient times, Roman soldiers were always in communication with their command base.Orders were given via horns, drums, movement of flags and riders on horseback.Not staying in touch with military orders can be disastrous for a soldier.
How are you waging spiritual warfare without praying at all times?
You must also understand that prayer is one of the mediums we prove that we are submitted to God.Anything you are not praying about is not under God’s rule and dominion.When you pray, you bring everything or situation under God’s rule.
You must pray all prayers and pray always in the Spirit.
Have you prayed today?Are you in touch with your military command base?Have you received an instruction from God through prayer?Or you are running by your own strength, strategy and plan.
Get into prayer; get God involved.
This is how you walk in possibilities!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3Bp8juzjokDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:6; Psalm 116:2; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will give us the direction this day so that we will know what to do and the steps to take to accomplish His assignment for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 637 - ENGAGE THE ENERGIES OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It is important to know the word of God as a man of prayer. You don’t have to only be given to prayer without understanding what God has said in His word. Selah! Author  ENGAGE THE ENERGIES OF GOD“praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints” Ephesians 6:18 (NKJV)When you read through Ephesians 6:17-18, especially in the New King James Version (NKJV), you will notice that verse 17 ends with a semi-column (;) and then verse 18 starts with a lower key alphabet, “praying always..”This implies that verse 18 of Ephesians 6, is not the beginning of a new sentence.This implication is not only based on the NKJV but also on what it is in the original Greek.Paul, the apostle, wasn’t introducing a discussion which was different from the armor of God.When a Roman soldier puts on the various armor pieces, he puts on the helmet and then takes his sword for action.The interesting thing is that it also takes an empowering force or ability for one to efficiently and effectively wield a sword.To wield the sword of the Spirit,  which is the Word of God, is not only by how you understand the word. It is not only how skillful you are in using the word. The impact of the “Rhema word” is attributed to the power that backs it.
Through prayer, you activate the empowering force of the Spirit to wield the “rhema word”.
So you can read what Paul wrote in Ephesians 6:17-18  this way:“And take… the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God…praying…” Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS! When the wielding of the word is backed by prayer, it works more effectively.Prayer gives the “Rhema word”, the force to prevail against every limitation.The word of God is powerful, however, you cannot exude the power in the word without prayer.
Prayer is the means by which you saturate the word you have received from God with God.
Get it, God’s word spoken to you is full of God. However, the word should not proceed from you as your word. It must proceed from you as God’s word. This is why you pray.Through prayer, you submit the administration of the word through you to God. The mighty hand of God backs your utterance (declaration of the revelation of the word) so that it will produce God-kind and God-intended results.Paul the apostle knowing this made this request:“Finally, dear brothers and sisters, pray for us that the Lord’s message will continue to spread rapidly and its glory be recognized everywhere, just as it was with you” 2 Thessalonians 3:1 (TPT)The rapid spreading of the message of Christ will be by prayer.
It is not how skillful or intelligent one is with the reality of the word. It is the ability of God which backs the administration of the word.
To even have utterance of the word, one must be soaked with prayer. (Ephesians 6:19).This should give you a picture of wielding the word through God.“For by their own sword they did not possess the land, And their own arm did not save them, But Your right hand and Your arm and the light of Your presence, For You favored them.” Psalm 44:3 (Legacy Standard Bible)Take note the above verse is only used here, to give you a pictorial view of wielding the word through prayer.So just as the Spirit- word is the sword of the Spirit, you wield it to triumph by prayer or the release of the Lord’s presence.
Don’t just speak or act the word. Use the word as a weapon of war through prayer.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:6; 1 Thessalonians 1:5; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAYWe pray that the word of God in us will be saturated by the force of God’s presence and will produce the God-kind of results BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 638 - KEEP ON
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Stop worrying and start praying. Pray over everything no matter how little it may seem to be. Author Tuesday, 22nd october, 2024KEEP ON “Stop getting drunk with wine, which leads to wild living, but keep on being filled with the Spirit.” Ephesians 5:18 (International Standard Version)I know the year is about to end but listen this year is a glorious year with great visions. There are mighty things the Lord has been inspiring you to do.If you have not yet received the inspiration of what to do, then you will have to set a moment to capture fresh inspirations of the Lord.Perhaps you received inspirations yet haven't acted out on them. As you set aside some time to fellowship with the Lord, he will bring them to you with fresh grace. 
Beloved, there is nothing God tells you to do (no matter how little), that is not great. Anything God tells you to do is great.
This is why whatever God tells you to do, He works in partnership with you to achieve it. He doesn’t instruct you to do something and then He leaves you on your own. He is the only King who sends His messengers and still goes with them to accomplish their duty.This is the work of the Holy Spirit in your life. The Holy Spirit in you, is God indwelling you to walk and work with you.
It is up to you to be intentional about your partnership with the Holy Spirit.
Don’t just wake up to embark on your divine assignment without Him; you must work with the Holy Spirit.Jesus said, “without me you can do nothing” (John 15:5) and this is why He decided to send another Helper (John 14:16). The Holy Spirit is here to help you.However, from the opening verse, we see that the infilling of the Holy Spirit is not a one-time event or experience, but a continuous experience. Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS!“Stop getting drunk with wine, which leads to wild living, but keep on being filled with the Spirit.” Ephesians 5:18 (ISV)
Also being filled with the Spirit as a continuous experience is hinted by the phrase “KEEP ON”.
Did you notice the two parallel experiences of influence?If you want to know how you should be continuously immersed in the Spirit, see what one looks like when he is immersed in drunkenness.When you KEEP ON being filled with the Spirit your being is influenced and soaked with the Spirit, like how one is influenced and gets drunk by wine.When one gets drunk by wine, his movements, thoughts and speech are influenced by the drunkenness. The same is true with a man immersed in the Spirit.
When you keep on being filled with or immersed in the Spirit, you come under the influence of the Spirit. The Spirit influences your movements, thoughts and speech.
There is a way a man who is immersed in the Spirit daily, thinks and lives.You live according to the power of God. You demonstrate love according to the influence of the Spirit.The love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5).You are not controlled by the lust of the flesh. The power of the love of Christ gains preeminence over the man who is saturated by the Spirit.
Beloved, Keep on being filled with the Spirit.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A3Bp8juzjokDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16; 1John 2:6; Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19; Ezekiel 47:1-10) WE PRAYThat we shall continue to live under the influence of the Holy Spirit who is our great HELPER. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. – I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 639 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you see Jesus you have seen the Father, for He is one with the Father. Beloved Jesus is not a god, He is God. Be convinced in this reality as you journey along the day. Author Wednesday, 23rd October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 1"And falling to the ground, he heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?” Acts 9:4 (ESV)One of the questions I have been asked the most is:
'HOW DO I HEAR THE VOICE OF GOD?'
Well I know you may also have this question in mind.Growing up in the faith, I also had questions. Through intense study and the supply of God's wisdom and grace, I found answers to these questions.Some of the questions I asked in my study of the Word of God includes:- Does God still speak to christians apart from the canonized Bible?- How do I hear the voice of God?- What is the difference between the voice of God and my imagination?- If God speaks to me why do I need a Pastor to teach me the Word?- If God has given me a Pastor why do I need to hear His voice?- How does God speak to men?- Which mediums does God use to speak to His people?- Does God speak to all men (the good people and the evil people)? Does he speak to unbelievers also?- Is there really a voice of God or it's a mere human hypothesis?- What is the texture of the Voice of God if He has a voice?- Are there other voices apart from the voice of God?- How do I distinct God's voice from other voices, if there are?I will be taking you on a journey into the answers and understanding of these questions.Most people are careful to ask questions. But that is not the right thing to do. You must not be careful to ask questions. 
The questions you ask are not as dangerous as the motive in your heart concerning those questions.
Always ask questions with a genuine heart. When your goal of asking questions is to increase your doubt, you will find the wrong answers. If your goal is to increase in faith and to understand God, you will find the right answers.I will take time to systematically answer the questions. However, with this first part, I will get your mind steered towards the direction of the Word and not just what you have felt about these questions.The opening verse of this episode is about the apostle Paul's dramatic encounter with Jesus on his way to Damascus to persecute those who believe in Jesus.He was on a mission similar to "Jihadists", breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of Jesus.It was on such a mission he fell by a sudden bright light which flashed around him. And then a voice spoke to him.Paul (also known as Saul) knew this wasn't a natural voice. He knew clearly that it was a Supernatural being. Nevertheless he didn't know which Superior Spirit was speaking to him. And as intelligent as he was, he asked "Who are you Lord?"And the Lord replied, "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting."This is an amazing experience.There is a lot to learn or glean from this encounter or experience of Paul (Acts 9:1-19)1. God speaks and knows you personally. He knows your motives and your moves. And can speak in a language you will understand.He called Saul by his name. He didn't just mention his name once for him to think it was a mere coincidence. He intentionally mentioned his name twice, as a witness that He knows him personally. He also knew Saul's plan.Someone will ask, "why didn't He call him Paul but Saul?"He was speaking to Paul in Hebrew. And Paul's Hebrew name was Saul. If God was speaking to Him in Greek, He would have used Paul (because Paul was his Greek name). 2. God doesn't just speak, He always has motives behind every speaking. The first time the scripture mentioned God speaking was in creation (Genesis 1:2).  God speaks but not without purpose. Anytime God speaks, He achieves a goal.3. God is a master communicator. He can speak to you and encrypt the message only for you.As He spoke to Saul (the apostle) the people who were with him, didn't hear the voice of the Lord. They only heard a sound. That was divine master-stroke.4. God speaks to everyone. He spoke to Saul with a murderous agenda.Saul was not a disciple of Jesus. 5. Everyone can hear the voice of God. You don't need to be holy to hear the Voice of God. Saul called himself chief of all sinners.   See 1 Timothy 1:15 (KJV):"This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief."6. Your obedience to the voice of God is your choice and not His. Saul could have returned to Jerusalem and not obeyed the voice he heard. But he chose to obey the voice of the Lord.When Paul narrated his experience to King Agrippa, he also addressed his response to the voice and the vision of the Lord."Wherefore, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision" Acts 26:19 (ESV).Precious one, God speaks to you and wants you to hear His voice.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Acts 9:1-19; Psalm 29:1-11; Psalm 62:11) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for His voice and His genuine concern for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Thank you Lord for the gift of your voice. - The Lord knows me personally and speaks to me. - I hear the voice of God and I obey. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 640 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency In the Kingdom of God, to walk in honor and humility is a code of greatness. To honor is to have great value and respect for others and highly esteem those who have authority over you. Beloved, walk in honor and humility today. Author Thursday, 24th October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 2"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)From yesterday's episode, I just cut right to the chase on the fact that God speaks.Some people argue that God does not speak to men or His creation. They claim God is too powerful to speak to mere men. Precious one, God speaks to and through men and His creation (follow patiently, as we exhaust this matter).
Without the speaking of God, the Bible has no relevance.
To think God doesn't speak is a display of ignorance. And for God not to speak then He is just as the idols which were made by men."Why do the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Our God is in heaven. He does what he pleases. Their idols are made of silver and gold, the work of human hands. They have mouths, but they cannot speak. They have eyes, but they cannot see. They have ears, but they cannot hear. They have noses, but they cannot smell. They have hands, but they cannot feel.They have feet, but they cannot walk. No sounds come from their throats." Psalm 115:2-77 (New Century Version).Just by reading the first three verses of the Bible, you will find it clearly written "And GOD SAID.."In the King James Version of the Bible, out of the thirty-one (31) verses in chapter One (1) of Genesis, nine (9) of them begin with "And God said..." (See verses 3, 6, 9,11,14, 20, 24, 26, and 29). Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS!Additionally, there are five (5) other verses in the same chapter proving that God speaks. Three of the 5 verses, begin with " And God called..." (verses 5, 8, 10), which depicts the speaking of God. The other two of the five verses have this:And God blessed them, saying (and said unto them) be fruitful... (See verses 22 and 28)Genesis Chapter One gives enough evidence that God speaks.In the Old Testament portion of the Bible alone, I found about 476 times or more, where it is stated that God or "the Lord spoke" to or "commanded" or "the Word of the Lord came" or "the Lord said".
The Bible proves that God speaks to men.
From the scriptures, you will find that God spoke to Abraham about 12 times in Genesis. He spoke to Moses about 238 times or more. Ezekiel 54 times and Jeremiah 38 times. Now these are the recorded ones in the scriptures.We find some other instances where God spoke to people.Paul's experience or encounter with the Lord is also another evidence that God speaks.You may argue that, "Well, with Paul's encounter it was not God who spoke to him, but Jesus."What are you thinking?Jesus is God! (Read more here)Another thing is, don't assume when God speaks it is not possible to hear Him. From the opening verse of this episode, you can find that it is possible to hear God when He speaks.So it is not only about God speaking. It is also the possibility that you can hear Him when or as He speaks."I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Get this, the Prophets in the Old Testament, the Kings, and the Apostles do not have a better right to hear God than you.
God speaks and all can hear Him.
God speaks to you and wants you to hear His voice.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Acts 9:1-19; Psalm 29:1-11; Psalm 62:11) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for the opportunity and ability given to us to hear Him when He speaks. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 13 - 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for the gift of your voice. – The Lord knows me personally and speaks to me. – I hear the voice of God and I obey. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 641 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 3 – Why God Speaks to You
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter how genuine you are, you cannot lead people with great vision without Wisdom and understanding. Selah! Author Friday, 25th October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 3 – Why God Speaks to You"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)There is much more evidence in the scriptures that God speaks. And yesterday's episode establishes that as well.We have also seen that God speaks to everyone (both unbelievers and believers).There are several examples of God speaking to both believers and unbelievers in the scriptures.Even from the example of Saul's conversion in Acts 9, you will notice God speaking or sending a message to Saul (who was not just an unbeliever, but one who was breathing out threatenings and slaughter at the time, see Acts 9:1-5; 1 Timothy 1:15) and also to Ananias (who was a believer and a leader)."And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord. And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth"  Acts 9:10-11 (KJV)Though God speaks to everyone, it doesn't mean He chit-chats. He gets personal with you but not casual. Every speaking of God is according to purpose. There are no non-consequential speaking of God.
There was no moment where God's speaking didn't chart a course.
He speaks to provide direction towards His purpose, causes you to walk according to His will, to give knowledge and understanding.This is why obeying or disobeying God's voice will have a consequence. One of your greatest advantages as a believer is your ability to respond promptly to what God says. (And we will look into it later).One obedience to God can transform your life for the best. 
One disobedience can lead your life towards a wrong direction and create a distress in your life. It is highly costly to disobey God's voice or word.
Consider all the speaking of God in Genesis 1. When God spoke, creation took place and the cosmic universe became orderly.At a point when the wickedness of men had increased, which was leading to the destruction of the earth, God spoke to Noah. (Genesis 6:13-22) Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS!When God wanted to set forth a called race, He spoke to Abraham. (Genesis 12:1). The records of the scriptures affirm the intention of God's speaking.This is the testimony of the Psalmist about God's word or speaking:"Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.”  (Psalm 119:105)And that is how God wants His people to speak. He doesn't want you to speak without counsel or with no wisdom. He wants every word which proceeds from your mouth to accomplish and express His purpose and goodness respectively."Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers." Ephesians 4:29 (KJV)The intent of what God says to a believer is different from what He says to an unbeliever.
Whenever God speaks to unbelievers, His intention is to direct them to repentance and salvation and to usher them into His purpose.
The example of Paul (Acts 9).And see this as well:"In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him." Acts 17:30 (Contemporary English Version)The Amplified Translation gives a breakdown:"Therefore God overlooked and disregarded the former ages of ignorance, but now He commands all people everywhere to repent [that is, to change their old way of thinking, to regret their past sins, and to seek God’s purpose for their lives]"Sometimes, God speaks to unbelievers to intercede and preserve His people.Laban a spiritualist who served many gods gathered his army to go after Jacob:"And Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled. Then he took his brethren with him and pursued him for seven days’ journey, and he overtook him in the mountains of Gilead. But God had come to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, “Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.” Genesis 31:22-24 (NKJV)Do you also remember the warning God gave to Abimelech the pagan king, when he decided to take in Abraham's wife?"But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, “Indeed you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is a man’s wife" Genesis 20:3 (NKJV)God speaks to believers to train them in knowledge and to get them to fulfill His purpose for their lives. His voice trains you and directs you in the way of prosperity."The LORD says, “I will guide you along the best pathway for your life. I will advise you and watch over you." Psalm 32:8 (NLT)Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Psalm 25:8; Isaiah 48:17-18; Psalm 143:8,10; Psalm.25:9) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be enlightened to daily comprehend and trust the definite intention of the instructions of the Lord to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 16 - 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for the gift of your voice. – The Lord knows me personally and speaks to me. – I hear the voice of God and I obey. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 642 - START EARLY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you want to experience God early then you must seek Him early. Author Saturday, 26th October, 2024 START EARLY“Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!” Psalm 90:14 (NKJV)You can be satisfied in your labour at the dawn or morning of your life.You don’t have to struggle through life till old age before you experience success. You can have the God-kind of success early.Take note, God-centered success or God kind of success, is not necessarily about the possession of material things. It is not the car you drive, the house you’ve bought, or the amount of money in your bank account. The God-kind of success is achieving God’s plan for you within a particular season.To have early success is to step into the fullness of your calling or purpose. It is making a tangible impact in the lives of people through the mandate the Lord has given you.Most people who don’t experience early success in the Kingdom, are often people who were busy with the pursuit of their own desires until they finally find the need to turn to God and follow His direction.
If you want to experience God early then you must seek Him early.
“O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary. Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name. My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips“ Psalm 63:1-5 (KJV)Your early season to seek God is now. It takes a lot of steadfastness to grow into the assignment of God for your life. There are no “shortcuts”, you can’t jump the process. There is no sudden success.Jesus didn’t just wake up to use the last three (3) years of His life to accomplish these great results. He spent the first 30 years of His life preparing and building up to His purpose. Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS!There are about 11 years between Paul’s conversion (in Acts 9:1-9) and when he and Barnabas were separated by the Holy Spirit to their unique assignment the Lord has set for them.Paul the apostle didn’t just step into the scene to accomplish the things which he did.David didn’t just receive boldness overnight to defeat Goliath. According to the testimony of David to Saul, just as Goliath has been trained for war since childhood, he (David) was also prepared by God through several experiences as a shepherd boy. David learnt early in his life to deliver any of his lamb from a lion or bear as a shepherd. Therefore He had that same confidence that the Lord would help him deliver Israel out of the hands of Goliath and the army of the Philistines. (1 Samuel 17:34-36).Before this moment, David had learnt to defend what had been entrusted to him. He was always ready for the victory against Goliath.
You cannot have early success when you don’t know how to make the most of every opportunity the Lord bring your way.
Don’t waste time!Set your affection on the Lord.Set your focus on the Lord and His assignment for your life. Stay committed to it now. Continue to serve the Lord’s purpose for your life. Be determined and diligent to accomplish the targets or goals given to you by the Lord.And you will begin to see the satisfaction of success.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12-17; Romans 13:11; Psalm 37:18-19; Ecclesiastes 9:12; Job 36:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall make the Lord our focus and pursue His purpose now, so that we shall experience early success. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 19 - 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I incline my heart to the wisdom of God. – Through the wisdom of God, I make the most of every opportunity to have early success. – I make daily progress and success. – I make each day count. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 643 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 4 – Does God Speak Today? 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you are made complete in Christ. Stop looking at things you think you lack or don’t have. Look inside, you have God’s greatest treasure. Selah. Author Sunday, 27th October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 4 – Does God Speak Today? 1"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Three questions have been answered in this discussion so far:1. Does God speak? 2. Does He speak to everyone?3. What are the intentions of God's speaking?If God speaks then His voice is not a mere human hypothesis. The scriptures have proven beyond doubt that He speaks and has a voice.Now one relevant question to our today's world is:Does God still speak to Christians/believers apart from the canonized Bible?This is an important question because every genuine, consistent and sound Bible student will affirm that the Bible is not just a collection of books by different authors, but the Word of God.I have taught an entire course on the Authenticity of the Bible as the Word of God and The canonisation of the Bible.(Please click here to sign up for this course).The word canon is from the Greek word "kanōn" which means the "standard" or "rule".The collected books of the Bible which were canonized were taken through a standardized process of testing. The canonization of the books of the Bible went through several processes. It was done not by just an individual but by Jewish Rabbis and scholars around and then later by the early Church fathers in the first century.Jesus our Lord recognized several books of the "Old Testament" portion of the Bible as scriptures or the Word of God. He made references to these books. He acknowledged all the present books of the Old Testament as the scriptures. The Apostles also did the same. They recognized and made references from the various books of the Old Testament. They treated the scriptures as the Word of God.They also did the same with the writings of the other Apostles. Paul's writings were recognized by Peter and the other saints as scriptures (2 Peter 3:15-16).The epistles of the Apostles were read by the Churches as they do read the Old Testament scriptures. (Colossians 4:16; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Nehemiah 8:1-6).
These books of the Bible are scriptures and are all the outbreathing of God.
"All Scripture is God-breathed [given by divine inspiration] and is profitable for instruction, for conviction [of sin], for correction [of error and restoration to obedience], for training in righteousness [learning to live in conformity to God’s will, both publicly and privately—behaving honorably with personal integrity and moral courage]" 2 Timothy 3:16 (Amplified Bible). Make a decision today to participate in this Special Conference.THE EMERGENCE OF KINGDOM MINDS…Click here to register. It’s for SERIOUS MINDS!All the sixty-six (66) books of the Bible are the outbreathings of God. They are the articulation of the wisdom of God for our nourishment. They are the accepted, standardized canonized books which utters the statutes and ordinances of God.These men who authored the scriptures did not do it to seek their own interests; they were moved by the Holy Spirit (2 Peter 1:21).
The Bible is the Word of God.
The book of Hebrews opens with a summary of what the Bible contains:"God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds." Hebrews 1:1-2 (KJV)The entire Bible contains the relevant revelation of God to mankind. And this revelation was progressively comprehended by the Fathers and the Prophets.And God finally made His revelation plain and fully comprehensible through Christ Jesus. Jesus came as God's final Word to mankind. And this final revelation or ultimate message of God to mankind has been given to us in the New Testament. The mysteries of God in the Old Testament have now been revealed in the New Testament.This then makes the question asked valid:God's full complete word to man has been spoken to us through Christ Jesus, and this message has been revealed fully in the Bible. So then does God still speak to Christians/believers?What this should help you understand is that, since God has spoken in these last days through Jesus Christ, then to even hear God, you must hear what He has said through Christ.
You must turn to what God has said in Christ, because, God's final and ultimate means of speaking is Christ.
Jesus is the voice of God into mankind.Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your heartshttps://youtu.be/UFoDqxWmkqcDIG DEEPER(Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; 1 Corinthians 10:11; Habakkuk 2:2; John 5:39; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall continually grow in the understanding of the revelation of God in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 22 - 24  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is not harden to the voice of God. - I grow in the understanding of the revelation of God in Christ Jesus. - I hear the voice of God and I obey. Thank you Lord for the gift of your voice![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 644 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 5 – Does God Speak Today? 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency As a new creation you are not an Island, you are born into God’s family to be cultured with the light of God, through the Church. The church is the home of divine civilization. Don't stay away from the church. Author Monday, 28th October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 5 – Does God Speak Today? 2"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)
Does God still speak to Christians/believers apart from the canonized Bible?
There are some scholastic circles who are of the opinion that, God doesn't speak directly to people except by what has been written in the Bible (which is the Word of God).This is because of Hebrews 1:1-2 :"God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son..." Hebrews 1:1-2 (KJV)
God's full complete word to man has been spoken to us through Christ Jesus, and this message has been revealed fully in the Bible.
So they conclude that apart from the Bible, God doesn't speak directly to Christians/believers.God still spoke to Believers even after the "Old Testament" books were written. Jesus and His disciples made references to the scriptures (Old Testament books) in their teachings. Though those scriptures (Genesis to Malachi) were available, the first disciples of Jesus and members of the first Church experienced God speaking to them directly.However understand that, they had the scriptures as the foundational evidence for the revelations or the spiritual understanding they received.So even in Berea, after Paul had taught them the word of Christ, they went back to examine the scriptures to confirm if the teaching of Paul was true."And the people of Berea were more open-minded than those in Thessalonica, and they listened eagerly to Paul’s message. They searched the Scriptures day after day to see if Paul and Silas were teaching the truth" Acts 17:11 (New Living Translation).These people examined all that Paul taught them from Genesis to Malachi.Jesus did the same, "And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself." Luke 24:27 (NKJV)We see here also that, Jesus didn't just teach the revelation of Himself without the scriptures. He addressed every reality using the scriptures as proof.When God became flesh (as Jesus), He used the scriptures as the witness of His revelation. According to Jesus, the scriptures do not contradict His revelation. Instead, they testify of Him.
Jesus is the centricity and the ultimate revelation of the scriptures. At the peak of all the scriptures is the WORD OF CHRIST.
It is in this same understanding you must also interpret the speaking of God.Whatever God says to you directly will not contradict the revelation of the scriptures.One thing you must take note of is this:As the scriptures (the entire Bible) mentioned how God spoke to people directly, it never in any place mentioned that God has stopped speaking to people directly.The Bible rather provides evidence that God still speaks to men today.However, whatever He says to you will not contradict His revelation as written in the scriptures (the Bible).Look at what Jesus said:"There is so much more I want to tell you, but you can’t bear it now. When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak on his own but will tell you what he has heard. He will tell you about the future. He will bring me glory by telling you whatever he receives from me. All that belongs to the Father is mine; this is why I said, ‘The Spirit will tell you whatever he receives from me."John 16: 12 - 15 (New Living Translation)Every speaking of God is consistent with His Word. Jesus is the person of the Word, thus, whatever God tells you will be consistent with the revelation of Jesus. The Bible is also the written Word of God; which also means, whatever God tells you will be consistent with the written Word. The written word (the Bible) is consummate as the revelation of Jesus.Beloved in Christ, have this conviction that God speaks to you. You don't have to be an Apostle, Prophet, Evangelist, Teacher or Pastor before God will speak to you or before you will hear the voice of the Lord.This is the privilege of every child of God.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ChTdJpkoi54DIG DEEPER(John 10: 3-5, 8, 16, 27; Romans 8:16; Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be attentive to the speaking of God and also grow in the revelation of the word so that we can rightly perceive the voice of the Lord when He speaks. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 25 - 27 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am attentive to the speaking of God to me. - I grow daily in the revelation of the word. - Through the understanding of the word, I rightly perceive the voice of God. Thank you Lord Jesus for the gift of your voice! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 645 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 6 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whether you are conscious of it or not, you are always involved in some level of meditation. The issue has always been what you are meditating on daily. If you want to see the results of the Word of God, you must meditate on the Word. Selah! Author  HEARING GOD'S VOICE 6 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 1"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Through this new devotional series on this with platform, I have answered a number of questions such as:1. Is there really a voice of God or it's a mere human hypothesis?2. Does God speak to all men (the good people and the evil people, believers and unbelievers)?3. Why does God speak to men? What is the drive or intention of His speaking?4. Does God still speak to Christians/believers apart from the canonized Bible?Now we move on to address the most asked question:
How do I hear the Voice of God?
Knowing how to hear the voice of God will help you follow the direction of the Lord, in this noisy pluralistic–postmodern world.To fully know how to hear God's voice, you must understand how God speaks.When you know and understand how God speaks you won't have doubts when you hear Him speak to you. When you also know how God speaks you will know the voice of God when you hear His speaking.Before the revelation of Jesus, God spoke in different ways or mediums to His people and even to all men."God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son..." Hebrews 1:1-2 (KJV)From yesterday's episode, I explained how everything God says to you now must be consistent with the scriptures (the Bible, which is the Word of God).Before Christ was revealed, God spoke to the Fathers mainly through the Prophets. And these Prophets and some of the fathers also received a message from the Lord through:1. His creation."The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork. Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge." Psalms 19:1-2 (KJV) See also: Romans 1:18-20.2. Dreams and Visions (1 Kings 3:5; Matthew 2:13; Genesis 15:1; Acts 9:10; Acts 10:1-6)3. Angels ( Luke 1:19; 26-38)The scriptures reveal that God also spoke audibly or in a loud voice. Such speaking was described as the sound of thunder (Job 37:4-5; ), a trumpet (Revelation 4:1) or even a noise of many waters (Ezekiel 43:2).During Paul's conversion, the people that were with him heard only a sound but Paul heard the Lord's voice (Acts 9:4,7).The Lord also spoke in a still small voice.Then He said, “Go out, and stand on the mountain before the Lord.” And behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind tore into the mountains and broke the rocks in pieces before the Lord, but the Lord was not in the wind; and after the wind an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake; and after the earthquake a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire; and after the fire a still small voice. So it was, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle and went out and stood in the entrance of the cave. Suddenly a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?” 1 Kings 19:11-13 (NKJV)Though God still communicates or speaks through His angels, created things, dreams, and visions in these times, He ultimately speaks through His word.Some people are in search of an angelic encounter, a trance or a mystical prophetic vision before they know the Lord is talking to them. Some look out for signs before they respond to the instructions of the Lord just as Gideon did (Judges 6:33-40).
God's present Word to man is the revelation of Jesus.
It doesn't matter the angelic encounter you have or the vision you receive, if the encounter or vision doesn't give a message consistent with the gospel or revelation of Jesus, then it is not from God."Anyone who comes to you with a different message than the grace gospel that you have received will have the curse of God come upon them! For even if we or an angel appeared before you, to give you a different gospel than what we have already proclaimed, God’s curse will be upon them." Galatians 1:8 (TPT)
This then means that the Word of God (which is the revelation of Jesus) is the texture of the Voice (or speaking or any communication) of God.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9eCOoswdTVoDIG DEEPER(John 10: 3-5, 8, 16, 27; Romans 8:16; Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that the word of God will dwell in us richly and that we can discern the texture of God's voice in what we hear. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Acts 28Romans 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I esteem the word of God above all voices I hear. - I judge every spiritual encounter, vision or voice by the revelation of Jesus. - I don't give room for any deception. - I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your voice.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 646 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 7 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The Word goes into your heart as a seed, and through meditation, it comes out as the rhema word for harvesting. Beloved, meditate on it until you take hold of the Rhema in your heart. Author Wednesday, 30th October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 7 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 2"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)As part of answering these questions:1. Is there really a voice of God or it's a mere human hypothesis?2. Does God speak to all men (the good people and the evil people, believers and unbelievers)?3. Why does God speak to men? What is the drive or intention of His speaking?4. Does God still speak to christians/believers apart from the canonized Bible?I have also answered these questions in yesterday's episode:5. What is the texture of the Voice of God?6. Which mediums does God use to speak to His people? Or How does God speak to men?I answered those questions whiles addressing the issue of how one can hear the Voice of God.Jesus said:"My sheep hear my voice...and they follow me" (John 10:27)Now if you even think He was only referring to the disciples He had at that time He was speaking, then check this one He also said:"And other sheep I have which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they will hear My voice; and there will be one flock and one shepherd" John 10:16 (NKJV)This is similar to what He said in His prayer for His disciples in John 17:20."I do not pray for these alone, but also for those who will believe in Me through their word" (NKJV)Jesus prayed for all believers in the above verse.
The same way Jesus refers to all believers as His sheep, and we will all hear His voice.
Which means Jesus doesn't think any believer of His sheepfold will not be able to hear His voice.One interesting thing Jesus said about the good shepherd was this:"And when he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice" John 17:4 (NKJV).This verse exposes the difference between how a believer and an unbeliever receive God's speaking.When God speaks to an unbeliever he may not immediately know it's the voice of the Lord because he doesn't know the Lord.An example was Paul's conversion experience.When the Lord called his name, he knew it was a Supernatural voice, but didn't know who exactly it was. So he asked: "Who are you Lord?" (Acts 9:5).When a believer hears the voice of the Lord, he must know without doubt that it is the Lord speaking. As long as you are born again, you have what it takes to hear the voice of the Lord and follow His leading.
Any believer who argues in his heart whether a voice he is hearing is the voice of the Lord or not, doesn't fully have the revelation of the word of God abounding in His heart.
Jesus is God's complete revelation of God. He is God's speaking to all men. To know God's voice you must have the revelation of Jesus. You cannot have the revelation of Jesus without the knowledge of the scriptures. The scriptures testify of Him (John 5:39).Jesus said to the Jews, they do not believe Him even though the Father has testified of Him. And it is because they have neither heard the Father's voice, nor seen His form (John 5:37) and they ultimately don’t believe because they don’t have the word of the Father in them (John 5:38).Which means if they should have had the word of the Father in them, they would have known how the scriptures testify of Him as the Christ.
The accurate revelational-knowledge of the Word of God will help you know the true texture of God's voice.
Until you train your heart and mind to know God through the scriptures you will wrongly perceive the voice of the Lord.Before His ascension, the Lord Jesus told the believers about the coming of the Holy Spirit to them as another comforter. The Lord was clear that the Holy Spirit will not say anything which will contradict His word (or the revelation of Him)."Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come. He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you." John 16:13-14 (KJV)
As I have said before in this series, God may speak to you through dreams, visions, angelic encounters, but THE WORD OF GOD is GOD'S PRIMARY means of speaking to you now.
You may ask, "how about the Holy Spirit?";God speaks to you by the Holy Spirit as a witness of what He has said to you through His Word. As to touching divine communication:1. The Holy Spirit leads or guides you through the Word of God (the Bible, which is the aggregation of the revelation of Jesus). And as He guides you, He helps you to receive illumination or understanding of the Word.You see, when you pray to the LORD to enlighten the eyes of your understanding, The Holy Spirit opens your heart and mind that you may be able to see the treasures of truth in the scriptures.2. When the Holy Spirit leads you through the Word, and helps you glean the truth of the Word, He speaks to you from the bank of the scriptures in your heart. The essence of anything the Holy Spirit will say to you is drawn from the wells of the scriptures in your heart.
You cannot miss out on the voice of the Lord when you are full of the word of God.
You cannot be confused about angelic encounters, the dreams you have and the visions you see when your heart is illuminated with the scriptures. As we may discuss in other episodes, the devil also can put words in your heart; to look as though it is the word of God. But you must know this precious one, there is no truth in and of the devil. He is the father of lies and deception.There are people who thought they encountered an angel of God but instead they encountered an agent of the devil. These people begin to operate by the things they heard from this evil or demonic spirit and assume they are operating by some new and superior revelation of Jesus or of God.Paul asked "who are you Lord?", when he heard the voice. And he did not go ahead to just teach any other revelation apart from what was consistent with the scriptures. He did not prove his teaching of the gospel by just his experiences and encounters but with the scriptures.
No matter what you hear from the Lord or how you hear the voice of the Lord, it must be consistent with the accurate revelation of the scriptures.
Don't crave for a voice beyond or above the revelation of His Word.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t2K_CzrmwSoDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 15:16; Job 23:12; Revelation 10:9; Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that our heart shall grow deeply in the love for the scriptures and we shall daily esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Romans 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I stick to the word of God. - I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. - I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. - I don't look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. - I don’t give room for any deception. - I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 647 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 8 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do you want to flourish beyond measure? Let the Holy Spirit take over your soul. Author Thursday, 31st October, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 8 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 3"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)As we have seen, the Bible is the primary medium by which God speaks to every believer and person.One of the lies the adversary has propounded in our generation is that the Bible is not the word of God. I have explained this in previous parts of this series in other episodes, as I briefly explained the canonization of the Bible.Another deception of the adversary that has crept into the heart of men is that the Bible is not relevant in today's world. The goal of the adversary is to destroy the confidence of people in the Bible. There are people who don't think God speaks to them through the Bible today. They only recognize the Bible as a consistent historic manuscript. To them, they are only for our minds to be educated on the happenings or the events of the centuries past.The scriptures or the Bible don't just communicate accurate historical facts. It is more than a history book or a collection of ancient texts. The Bible is the Word of God. 
God speaks clearly to anyone who commits his heart to listen to the words of the Bible.
There are people who read the Bible, close it and wait for God to speak to them miraculously; either by an audible voice, a vision or dream or some strange vibrations.The Bible is the active voice of the living God to you today.This is why not reading and meditating on the words of the Bible, makes you vulnerable to deceptive thoughts of the adversary and defeat.God will not say anything to you which contradicts His word. So instead of looking for God to speak to you from the skies, go to the Bible (which is the Word of God).
God recognized the scriptures as His voice.
During the Bible reading plan of this devotional, with (do well to follow the Bible reading plan), I observed an interesting scene in 2 Kings 18.In the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken and then the king of Assyria carried Israel captive to Assyria.The scripture explained this defeat of Israel:"because they did not obey the voice of the LORD their God but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded. They neither listened nor obeyed" 2 Kings 18:12 (ESV).In this verse, you will notice the Lord's covenant was acknowledged as the Voice of the Lord. The covenant of the Lord was articulated in the commandment of the Lord which was given through Moses. The commandments of Moses to the people of Israel were seen as the Law (Torah, revelation) of God.They kept the commandments also known as the statutes of the Lord, as the Word of the Lord to them. Whenever they read the commandments, they didn't just see historical facts but heard the voice of the Lord. Disobedience to the commandment was disobedience to the voice of the Lord.After Moses' death, God spoke to Joshua (the new leader) to keep and live by the Book of the Law (Joshua 1:18). God didn't command Joshua to look out for the voice of the Lord in the sky. This doesn't mean God didn't speak to Joshua through other means. But then, whatever Joshua did was according to the commandment of the Lord which was given through Moses. And that was what he consistently instructed the people of Israel (Joshua 22:5).David kept the commandment of the Lord and instructed his son Solomon to keep and live by the statutes of the Lord as it was written in the law of Moses."And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself" 1 Kings 2:3 (KJV)Now we see Hezekiah the king of Judah, who kept the commandment of the Lord, which He commanded Moses. And the Lord was with Hezekiah and prospered him everywhere he went (See 2 Kings 18:6-7).But as I have shared earlier Hoshea the king of Israel did not obey the voice of the Lord (which was the Lord's commandment to Moses).Get this: Hoshea was king of Israel in the days of Hezekiah the king of Judah. And this defeat of Israel happened while Hezekiah was in his sixth-year reign.From the time God led Israel through Moses from Egypt to the time of Hezekiah and Hoshea was about 750 or 800 years.This means for about 750 or 800 years the word of the Lord to Moses was relevant. 
The word of the Lord does not expire.
Beloved the scriptures are relevant even in today's post-modern world. Though we must rightly divide it (2 Timothy 2:15) according to the covenants and revelation of Jesus; so that we can make proper application consistent with the New Testament.Someone will argue again that, the epistles written to Corinthians, Ephesians, Galatians, and Thessalonians have nothing to do with those who are not in those cities. That is not logical enough.The scientific, technological and medical solutions provided and written by these intelligent and learned men were solutions to solve problems within their society but benefited all men and many generations.
The epistles which were written were read in all churches (Colossians 4:16) and acknowledged by the early Church fathers as well.
How did Peter acknowledge the writings of Paul to his audience (2 Peter 3:16)?This is what you should know about the voice of the Lord or the speaking of God in the scriptures:"Every Scripture has been written by the Holy Spirit, the breath of God. It will empower you by its instruction and correction, giving you the strength to take the right direction and lead you deeper into the path of godliness. Then you will be God’s servant, fully mature and perfectly prepared to fulfill any assignment God gives you." 2 Timothy 3:16-17 (TPT).The scriptures speak because:1. It instructs you.2. It corrects you.3. It directs you.4. It leads you.
As God speaks to you through the scriptures, beloved, hear His voice and don't harden your heart.
Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqcPg368uY0DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 15:16; Job 23:12; Revelation 10:9; Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that our heart shall grow deeply in the love for the scriptures and we shall daily esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Romans 6 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The word of  God is relevant to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God's voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.– I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 648 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 9 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It doesn’t matter the assignment the Lord has given you, you have His strength to get it done. You don’t have to be intimidated by any task at all. Get into prayer now! Author Friday, 1st November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 9 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 4"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)If you have been following this series from previous episodes you will clearly understand that the Bible is God's primary means of speaking to you. The Bible is not just a collection of ancient texts but contains God's relevant word for you in the present.The author of Hebrews established three active phases of God's speaking:1. God at different times and in divers manners in the past or old eras SPOKE to the fathers through the Prophets. (Hebrews 1:1)These fathers are the biological ancestors of the Jews. Today's believers may refer to some of these fathers as "spiritual ancestors" because of what we share in the household of faith.2. And God has SPOKEN to us in these last days through the Son (Jesus, who is the person of the Word and the full expression of God).3. God is still SPEAKING through the revelation of His Word.In the past or old era, God spoke to the fathers but now in these last days, God has spoken to us. Yes the "us" includes you. God has spoken to you. He has given you His revelation through Christ Jesus. The author of Hebrews wants you to know that God's message in these last days, is not only to the believers in the first century but to you and all who are in these present times.
This message of God through Christ, is God's everlasting message. It is the final Word of God for all generations in all ages.
God in these last days is not primarily speaking in divers manners and in many ways. God has spoken and continues to speak definitely through and in His Son who is the WORD!Now this is not to totally alienate all that God has spoken through the Prophets. What God said through the Prophets was written and preserved as the scriptures. These scriptures were written to bear testimony of Jesus, who is the Person of the Word of God  (John 5:39).
Jesus came as the Word of God made flesh (John 1:14). He is the embodiment of the words God has been speaking from the beginning of time (John 1:1).
