Now this was the testimony of God concerning His Word to us:And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!” (Luke 9:35)The Son is the Word of God to you, HEAR HIM!
He is the present voice of God to you, HEAR HIM!
All that God spoke through the Prophets including God's dealing with them and their testimonies of Christ were recorded and preserved as scriptures. The appearing of Christ who is the Word in the flesh, and His living and manifold expressions were also recorded.  His work through His death, burial and resurrection to make available His saving Grace for all men were written in the gospels for our understanding. The establishment of His Church, which is His corporate Body, the stewardship of the affairs within the Church, and the revelation of His life, the counsel of His will and His eternal inheritance or bequest bequeathed to all His saints, and the prophetic revelation of all that is and shall be when time will consummate were articulated through various epistles or letters. These were recognized by divine leadings as holy writs and were canonized to be preserved as sacred scriptures. This is what we have as the Bible.Having this understanding will establish you in the certainty that the Bible is the active voice of the living God to you today. And the person of this voice is Jesus.This is why all gleanings of the scriptures must bring you into the light of Christ Jesus and His inheritance.Jesus who is the complete revelation of God to you today is not dead. He is alive. (John 11:25; Matthew 28:6)This is why you must know that the Bible is God's active voice. "For the word of God is living and active and full of power [making it operative, energizing, and effective]. It is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating as far as the division of the soul and spirit [the completeness of a person], and of both joints and marrow [the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and judging the very thoughts and intentions of the heart." Hebrews 4:12 (Amplified Bible)When you are reading the Bible don't see yourself reading a another collection of literature or books. The Bible is the aggregation of God's thoughts or wisdom, which consummates as Christ.
When you are reading the Bible, you must know God has a present Word for your present situation. 
Yours is to pay attention to what God will say to you through those written words in the light of Christ. Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cmHPAQu61zYDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 15:16; Job 23:12; Revelation 10:9; Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be enlightened and be able to hear and receive from the Bible God's present Word for us, for our victorious living. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Romans 9 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today.– The word of  God is relevant to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.– I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 649 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 10 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t entertain any form of worry and pain. Don’t give anxiety the luxury to thrive around you. Selah! Author Saturday, 2nd November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 10 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 5"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)The Bible is God's active voice to you.
Nothing God will speak to you contradicts the reality of His Word.
The Word of God which is the Bible is the constitution of God's wisdom. It gives you practical God-centered answers for every life situation.When you begin to argue that God's word (the Bible) is not relevant to you today, you will start missing out on God's refreshing word for you.This is the difference you must know.There are two main Greek words for "The WORD of God":1. Logos2. RhemaLogos refers to the person of the Word; Jesus the living Word (John 1:1) and also the aggregate inspired word or thoughts of God (2 Timothy 3:16).Logos means the expression of thoughts in speech or written form. This means the Bible as the Word of God is also the Logos of God. It is the expression of divine thoughts.Whereas “Rhema” is that definite, specific and accurate word of God to you in the now. It is the present Word of God which germinates and burns in your heart.You can find an example of this in Jeremiah 15:16, precisely the King James Version or New King James Version and Douay-Rheims Bible:"Thy words were found, and I did eat them, and thy word was to me a joy and gladness of my heart: for thy name is called upon me, O Lord God of hosts."Though the Hebrew word used in the verse for "word" is the same as what was used for "words", they provide different implications.
To have access to the scriptures or the words of the Bible is to have access to the Word of God. 
However, in the scriptures, there is a specific word which comes to you as God's voice to address a specific situation.So for example a young lady is struggling with rejection and feels lonely and all alone in this world because she has nobody to care about her and is also forsaken by her parents. She spends time praying to God about her situation and after the prayer, she feels invigorated but has not clearly heard a voice. But suddenly she has the urge to read her Bible, and turns to Psalm 27 and finds verses 1 and 10:"The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?...When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up." Psalms 27:1,10 (KJV)Will you say the verse wouldn't be relevant to her situation?Don't you think it's a personal word for her situation?Now when she has already come across these verses (by diligently reading her Bible) and they are deeply rooted in her heart through meditation, the Holy Spirit will bring those scriptures up in her heart as an affirmation of God's voice in the midst of her discouraged state. And that immediately quickens her with new hope and joy.Are you struggling with fear, depression, infirmities of the body, condemnation or guilt?Are you having a task at hand and have lost confidence?Do you think you are incapable or even feel lazy?God has a word for you. God is speaking in the scriptures. Get to the word and receive your rhema.As the Psalmist said:"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)
Any word of the Lord to you through His scriptures will produce peace in your heart and not confusion.
To neglect and not read the Bible, is to neglect God's primary means of speaking to you about your situation.Beloved, go for the word of God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ckyH_wy9VYDIG DEEPER(Psalms 119:72, 97, 101-103; Job 23:12; Revelation 10:9; Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be enlightened and be able to hear and receive from the Bible God's present Word for us, for our victorious living. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Romans 12 - 15  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – The word of  God is relevant to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.– I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

The knowledge and understanding of the scriptures give you clarity on matters and give you an edge to declare the end of a matter from the beginning.The scriptures ultimately make you wise unto salvation.Paul the apostle said to Timothy: "and that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus." 2 Timothy 3:15 (KJV)We also see Jesus pointing out this to his disciples.After Jesus's resurrection, some of the disciples were confused or had contemplation of doubt."Then He said to them, “O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken! Ought not the Christ to have suffered these things and to enter into His glory?” And beginning at Moses and all the Prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself." Luke 24:25-27 (NKJV)This means that if these disciples had paid attention to what was in the scriptures, they wouldn't have been confused.The things which these disciples were discussing and the questions they were asking had the answers clearly written in the scriptures many centuries ago.

title: EPISODE 651 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 12 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 7 — Means and Moments 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You can decide to do things according to your will or according to the will of God. The choice is with you. It is time to say, LORD not my will BUT YOUR WILL! Author Monday, 4th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 11 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 7 — Means and Moments 1"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)The essence of God's speaking to you is for you to know Him. God speaks to you to commune with you, not to give you mechanical commandments.He wants you to share in His life.If you are reading and following this discussion, it means you sincerely want to master the wisdom of hearing God's voice.However, most people are interested in hearing God's voice just to know what to do and where to go. They are not really interested in knowing and mastering "how to hear God's voice", mainly to know the person of God.
Don't just look forward to hearing God's voice only for direction and answers. Hear God's voice to know Him intimately.
This really is the greatest secret to having mastery in knowing and hearing God's voice.When you have an intimate relationship with a person, you get to know his voice so well that you can tell when he is speaking even amid a noise. Even when your eyes are tied and you hear him speak you will be able to tell who is speaking.In our present age, it's easy to understand this phenomenon. When an unknown number calls you and you hear the person behind the call speak, you will easily tell if it's a friend you know or not. When you are not able to really confirm the voice then you don't often communicate with that voice on the phone.
The consistent communion with God helps you develop mastery in knowing His voice.
Though you must hear God's voice with the goal of knowing His person, you will definitely receive His direction. There are times when people run to fortune tellers and spiritualists for direction. However, they only lead them to a dead-end. The sure and tested means to receive divine direction is the scriptures."When people tell you, "Try out the fortunetellers. Consult the spiritualists. Why not tap into the spirit-world, get in touch with the dead?" Tell them, "No, we're going to study the Scriptures." People who try the other ways get nowhere - a dead end!" Isaiah 8:19-20 (Message Translation)
When you take heed to the instructions of the Word of God, you will not miss your way.
The Bible (or the Word of God) will help you to know the voice of God. As I mentioned in previous episodes, the Word of God helps you to know the texture of God's voice.Now, as we have clearly established from this series, the Bible is God's primary means of speaking to you.Does it negate the concept that there are other means by which God speaks?Not at all!Let me reiterate this to you:There are other means by which God speaks to men, but every speaking must be consistent with the revelation of His Word. Even the means by which people claim God speaks to men must also be consistent with the scriptures.There are certain means to which people think God uses to speak to men, but they are not true.God doesn't use fortune tellers to speak to you. God doesn't use demonic spirits to speak to you or to give you direction. Anything of the devil will lead you into falsehood. There is no truth in the devil and his cohorts, as he is the father of lies or deception.1. Apart from God speaking to you directly through the scriptures, God speaks to you in a Direct Voice or Words.This can happen as an audible voice (in some instances) and as a whisper or still small voice (in most instances). Sometimes it's like you are hearing a voice in your head communicating with peace and light."And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, “This is the way, walk in it,” when you turn to the right or when you turn to the left." Isaiah 30:21 (ESV)
Mostly the texture of this voice will be like the scriptures in your heart.

content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot be in Christ and think like the world. A true disciple of Jesus, is a deviation to the systems of this world. ARE YOU A TRUE DISCIPLE OF JESUS? Author Tuesday, 5th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 13 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 8 — Means and Moments 2"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)God speaks to you primarily through His word (the Bible) and also speaks directly by an "audible voice" in some occasions.However, God speaks to you directly with a still small voice of the Holy Spirit. This is sometimes referred to as inner witness or inward nudging.This is one of the most popular means by which the Lord speaks directly to every believer.(Take note that, in the scriptures, you will rather find more moments where the Lord spoke with a loud voice or sound).While believers are in conversation or during a church meeting, you may hear a brother talk about what the Lord said to him. And you may wonder how they heard the Lord.And be asking yourself why you don't hear the Lord as others.
The thing is, you must have the consciousness that God is always speaking to you.
There are times you find yourself in a situation where you are prompted to make a particular decision. And then you later give a narration that, "something told me" or "I heard some voice". You may even think it was your feeling or mind.It wasn't "something" that told you. It was a person. He is the Holy Spirit."When, however, the Spirit comes, who reveals the truth about God, he will lead you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own authority, but he will speak of what he hears and will tell you of things to come." John 16:15 (Good News Translation)However, it is not every voice you hear or inward nudge which is the Holy Spirit. There are evil spirits which also find their way to speak to people.As you can see in the verse above, the Holy Spirit speaks what is of the Father. The Holy Spirit doesn't speak anything which contradicts the counsel of God's wisdom. 
He is not a freelance entity that operates independently of the Word of God. God does nothing outside His Word.
There are people who claim they have received revelations which are not in the Word. In our time, God has finally spoken through His Son, Jesus (who is the express image of His person, the effulgence of His glory). Jesus is the highest summit of God's revelation. 
This means there is no revelation of God to you which will transcend the revelation of Jesus.
What most people even refer to as revelation, is mostly illumination. Because God's greatest revelation has come, and we are illuminated to have utterance.To understand this more, JOIN OUR ONLINE MINISTRY SCHOOL OF THE WORD. It's well explained in the BIBLIOLOGY COURSE.The nudge and the inner witness you mostly have as a believer, are more than intuitions. The voice of the Lord in your heart is the sense of knowing.

title: EPISODE 653 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 14 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 9 — Means and Moments 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your absence from Church meetings, is your absence from training. How do you wage good warfare without training and instructions? Author Wednesday, 6th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 14 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 9 — Means and Moments 3"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Though God primarily speaks to every believer through His Word (the Bible), He also initiates some special means and moments to communicate His message to the believer.
Every spiritual communication one receives must be proven by God's word.
The word of God will always prove the means or mediums, the moments and the message. According to the revelation of the scriptures, any means or medium by which a person received a spiritual message was initiated by God. However, there are some spiritual groups or cults who don't rely on God intitiating these communication means. Instead, they induce themselves to receive  a message through their preferred means.Some religious groups use certain chants or conclusions to induce themselves to have out-of-body experiences or altered minds. Most of these expose their souls to demonic encounters.The scriptures don't suggest that believers must forcefully generate the voice of God through such means. Unless God initiates His own means to speak to you directly, any other mode to generate spiritual communication can lead to error.
If you have any desire to hear God's voice, go to the Word of God.
As you read the scriptures God will speak to you through a verse of a chapter or character in the Bible. There are times a verse or chapter will stand out differently to you, and have the nudge to memorize. That scripture you memorize will help you in the period of meditation. And as you meditate on the word you will receive a rhema for a specific situation. That is God's clear voice to you.There are other times when you are confronted by a life situation, the Lord will recall a verse or passage in your heart as an answer to a question or situation. That is God's active voice in your heart. This is why it's important to learn to memorize scriptures.Mostly as you study the word of God your mind is shaped with the thoughts of God's wisdom. This shaping of mind makes you think of matters in the light of God. What then happens is, when you are confronted by a situation you will not be waiting for God to give you direction. You just know what to do because God's wisdom will ooze out of you.This was how Jesus answered the Pharisees and other Jewish leaders when He was asked hard questions or accused. (Example – Matthew 9:10-13, Hosea 6:6; John 10:30-35, Psalm 82:5-6).The Apostles and early Church leaders did the same. (Acts 2:14-36, Joel 2:18-32, Psalm 16:8-11, Psalm 110:1)So God speaks to you through:- the scriptures as His active voice.- the recalling of Biblical passages to you.- the implanting of His wisdom in you to shape your mind with the scriptures. We also discussed, how God speaks to you through the inward voice, impressions or nudging of your heart as the Voice of the Holy Spirit.The other scriptural approved means and moments the Lord speaks to people are VISIONS AND DREAMS.One key thing you should notice is that these means of communication are also prophetic languages. These are part of the means by which God spoke His revelation to the Prophets.
Though Christ came as God's final means and message to us, God still speaks to His people through Visions Dreams and Trance.
I will explain the differences in these in the next episode.God spoke to the first Apostles or church leaders through these means and moments.Trance, Visions and Dreams are not erroneous in themselves, neither are they some New Age concepts. These are all over the scriptures. Nevertheless, you don't build your life on Trances, Visions and Dreams.Because evil spirits can induce such experiences.Therefore build your life on the Word of God. And these various means and moments will be placed into the right perspective of Christ.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XL6semeTsm0DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 6:8; Acts 13:2; 1 Corinthians 2:11-12; Matthew 27:19; Acts 9:10-12) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds and innermost beings shall be submitted and be shaped by the Word of God so that we shall rightly judge our experiences according to the will of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Corinthians 9 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – The word of  God is relevant to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.– I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 654 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 15 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 10 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you are unforgiving, the adversary will outsmart you with his devices. He finds an opportunity to attack you when you are offended, bitter and unforgiving. Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Author  HEARING GOD'S VOICE 15 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 9 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCE 1"And he said, “Hear my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream. Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house. With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles, and he beholds the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?” Numbers 12:6-8 (ESV)While discussing God's final and ultimate voice in Hebrews 1, we noticed God spoke in various manners to the fathers through the Prophets.These divers manners or different means of God's speaking to the Prophets include:- Dreams- Visions- Trance- And also mouth-to-mouth (as seen in the opening verse).For God to speak to Moses mouth-to-mouth simply means directly speaking in an audible form or the deep impression of the heart.In Exodus 20, God spoke directly to the Israelites. They heard God speak to them audibly. And they couldn't stand the fierceness of that experience. Until that time, God spoke to the Israelites through His direct communication with Moses. From the Exodus 20 experience, while God was speaking directly to the children of Israel, Moses didn't blink an eye. Moses had a calm composure. Thus, this means of God's speaking wasn't new to him. (Exodus 3, 20:19-22, Exodus 24:16; Numbers 7:89).Several times in the scriptures, we can tell how people heard God's voice as thundering. (See Exodus 20:18, 2 Samuel 22:14; Psalm 18:13; John 12:28-30).To the Israelites there was thundering as God was speaking, but to Moses it was God speaking with clarity. Though he knew the people heard thundering.Nowadays, for God to speak to you mouth-to-mouth, is to speak to you through the revelation of His Son, Jesus. This revelation is aggregated in the Bible. Which means God speaks to you mouth-to-mouth through the Bible.
Though God spoke to Moses mouth to mouth. He still spoke to other Prophets by Dreams and visions. In this same light, God still speaks through dreams and visions, though He speaks to us mouth-to-mouth through His word (the Bible).
Most theologians have thrown out the idea of God speaking to people through Visions and Dreams because of the harm certain false Prophets have caused; all in the name of Dreams and visions they claim to receive from the Lord.It doesn't deny the fact that genuine people receive promptings of the Lord through dreams and visions.God spoke to Peter through a vision (Acts 10:9-16). He spoke to Paul also through a Vision (Acts 16:6-10). God appeared to Joseph in a dream concerning the child Jesus (Matthew 2:13).God is able to speak to people by this means because of how God has designed man to interact with the unseen realm. This system within man did not cease to exist because of the canonization of the books of the Bible. It didn't cease because of the indwelling of the Holy Spirit.Man is still able to interact with the spiritual realm through such means. However, this means of spiritual interaction is not only exclusive to "christians". It is a quality every human being possesses.By the conditioning of a man's inner being, he can interact more through such means.Again, I want you to receive this teaching with the consciousness of you esteeming the Word of God above VISIONS AND DREAMS.Let your heart and mind be cultivated, trained and soaked richly with the Word of God. It will help you to have a proper position of interpretation of these Visions and Dreams.It is necessary to have the Word of God condition your inner man because the unseen realm is not only a realm of light. They are operations or activities of darkness in the unseen realm as well.There are Dreams and visions which are projected by demonic spirits or forces of darkness to lead people into destruction.Some false Prophets even claim to have dreams from God but are imaginary dreams of lies."I have heard these prophets say, ‘Listen to the dream I had from God last night.’ And then they proceed to tell lies in my name. How long will this go on? If they are prophets, they are prophets of deceit, inventing everything they say. By telling these false dreams, they are trying to get my people to forget me, just as their ancestors did by worshiping the idols of Baal.“Let these false prophets tell their dreams, but let my true messengers faithfully proclaim my every word.There is a difference between straw and grain! Does not my word burn like fire?” says the LORD. “Is it not like a mighty hammer that smashes a rock to pieces?" Jeremiah 23:25-29 (NLT).
To save yourself from false or demonic dreams, stay rooted in the word.
Didn't you see the verse 28 of Jeremiah 23:"Let the prophet who has a dream tell the dream, but let him who has my word speak my word faithfully. What has straw in common with wheat? declares the LORD"Let your life be built on the true revelation of the Word of God. Don't let your mouth be full of dreams today and dreams tomorrow. Let your mouth be filled with the speaking or proclamation of the Word of God.
When you are rooted in the word and the light of the Word shines through you, your interactions in the unseen realm will be by the virtue of light of the Word of God.
Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/OQCr54a1arADIG DEEPER(Isaiah 6:8; Acts 13:2; 1 Corinthians 2:11-12; Matthew 27:19; Acts 9:10-12) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds, innermost being and interactions in the spiritual realm shall be influenced and saturated by the light of the Word of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Corinthians 12 - 14  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – The word of  God is relevant to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.– I remain resolute in my conviction of the revelation of Jesus.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 655 - BURST FORTH IN SPIRITUAL SONGS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Friday, 8th November, 2024 BURST FORTH IN SPIRITUAL SONGS“Then I heard what seemed to be the thunderous voice of a great multitude, like the sound of a massive waterfall and mighty peals of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!” Revelation 19:6 (TPT).The idea of “song minister” has been reduced to those who have good voices or those who lead in songs.There are some “Christian musicians” who think they are the ones who lead saints INTO the presence of God.Apart from Jesus, nobody leads God’s people INTO the presence of God; though in our communion in the Lord, He has given us shepherds who lead us IN Him.Take note:– Every believer in Christ has the responsibility to lead the unreached TO Christ, through the Gospel.– However, by the blood of Jesus we all have access INTO God. And we all come to the Father through Christ.– And then God has trained men who are to lead His saints IN Him, to fulfill purpose.I hope it is clear. Now, let this be settled in your heart:
Through the work of Christ in His death and resurrection, He gave access to all men into the presence of the Lord.
We have access into God’s presence not because someone leads us in songs. We have access into God’s presence because of the goodness of Christ.“for through Him, we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.” Ephesians 2:18 (NASB).
Ministering to the Lord in songs is not the responsibility of few others. It is the responsibility of all the saints.
All the saints in Christ are true worshippers.“For we [who are born-again have been reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, set apart for His purpose and] are the true circumcision, who worship in the Spirit of God and glory and take pride and exult in Christ Jesus and place no confidence [in what we have or who we are] in the flesh” Philippians 3:3 (AMP)
The born again is the justified (the just man) who stands in the presence of God without any sense of guilt, because of the goodness of Christ.
As just men who have access to God, we have the privilege to minister to the Lord in spiritual songs. We are to minister to the Lord in songs, during our personal time with the Lord and also while we are amidst the congregation of the saints.We shouldn’t think singing together as a congregation is a religious cliché or an activity to while away time. We don’t use times of ministering in songs to wait for the preacher. Neither is it to tickle the emotions of the congregation.Ministering in songs is a rhythm of a life immersed with the Spirit. When you are saturated by the Spirit and soaked by the Word, you will burst forth in spiritual songs. Rhythms of His presence will gush forth from your Spirit.The hymns, the spiritual songs and various melodies we chant in today’s Church are rhythms of just men who were caught up in divine revelation.When we gather as saints, the Lord inspires deep spiritual rhythms in the heart of the congregation and we minister unto Him and also to one another.
The most important instrument which resounds the transcendent rhythms of Christ is the thousands of voices of the saints soaked with the Spirit of Grace.
“Then I looked, and I heard around the throne and the living creatures and the elders the voice of many angels, numbering myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands, saying with a loud voice,“Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and might and honor and glory and blessing!” Revelation 5:11-12 (ESV).All beings in Heaven, on earth, in the seas and under the earth, make harmonious rhythm of glory to the Lord. (Revelation 5:13)
No concert held by men transcends such experience.
This is the portrait of fellowship in eternity. Beyond the best musical instruments, God is interested in the rhythms of the revelation of Jesus, dispensed through the voices of the saints in the oneness of heart. (Romans 15:5-6)Don’t miss any moment to join a gathering where all saints are ministering in the oneness of heart to the Lord. Let your voice be heard in the rhythms of the just men.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQCr54a1arADIG DEEPER(Psalm 100; Colossians 3:16; 1 Peter 2:5; Matthew 26:30; Acts 16:25; 1 Corinthians 14:15; James 5:13) WE PRAY– We pray thanking the Lord for the privilege and access to commune with Him.– We pray declaring that our hearts will be flooded with the right revelation as we minister unto Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Corinthians 15 - 162 Corinthians 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have access into the presence of the Father through the goodness of Christ. – I am a true worshipper and I minister unto the Lord. – I minister unto the Lord with the right revelation of Him. – As I am being saturated by the Spirit and soaked by the word, rhythms of His presence gush forth out of my spirit. – I dwell in the presence of the Father forever. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 656 - CULTIVATE A CONSISTENT HABIT OF THANKSGIVING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your money is your treasure. To give your money sacrificially to the Lord’s work is great evidence that you value the Lord. Selah! Author CULTIVATE A CONSISTENT HABIT OF THANKSGIVING“Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.”1 Chronicles 16:29 (KJV)Being thankful or showing gratitude to God is a practical thing.And you must be intentional with it.You spend hours praying for a miracle and not be thankful at all. Most people are not able to maintain a consistent habit of Thanksgiving because they don’t know how.
Thanksgiving also brings you into the consciousness of God’s presence.
Through the Word of God, we are not only instructed to be thankful; we are also instructed on how to give thanks to God.There are three major things I will share with you during your Thanksgiving practice. These are practical things that will help you develop the habit of Thanksgiving.1. Sing songs of Praise to the Lord. “Sing out your thanks to Him; sing praises to our God”Psalm 147:7 (TLB)
Singing spiritual songs of thanksgiving is also a practice of the Spirit.
It doesn’t matter how you feel or the lack of words, just start your day with songs of praise. As you praise the Lord, you speak in tongues and rejoice in the Holy Spirit. You can take some time to write down a list of songs focused only on thanksgiving or praise. And minister those songs to the Lord.There are times when you have to take a posture of gratitude. You can either be on your knees, lift your hands or prostrate yourself before the Lord.This will tune your heart and mind to the thoughts of divine wonders.2. Offer the Sacrifice of Praise by the fruit of your lips.“Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.” Hebrews 13:15 (NKJV)The fruit of your lips are the words you speak. And your words must be full of thanksgiving.Just in case you cannot spontaneously remember the right words of praise to speak, go through the scriptures and write out the thanksgiving verses which resonate with your heart. (You can find a lot through the Psalms).And then read them out or vocalize them with a genuine heart of gratitude. While you are engaged in this, the anointing of the Holy Spirit will begin to increase in your life.3. Give a gift or money to support the Lord’s work.Re again the opening verse:“Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.” 1 Chronicles 16:29 (KJV) This offering is different from the fruit of your lips. This is the fruit of your heart.Our Lord Jesus said,“For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also,” (Matthew 6:21).
Your money is your treasure. To give your money sacrificially to the Lord’s work is great evidence that you value the Lord.
How you spend your money reveals your priorities. And your money is a symbol of your desire. Therefore, to say you are greatly thankful to God, you must follow it up with a financial gift towards His work.This is a sacrificial giving of gratitude to the Lord.It is a demonstration of honor.The scripture says, “Honor the Lord with your substance” (Proverbs 3:9).
This month give a sacrificial gift to the Lord’s work.
GO AHEAD TO PRACTICE YOUR GRATITUDE TOWARDS THE LORD.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Daniel 6:10; Colossians 3:17; 1 Chronicles 29:10-20; Psalm 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13; Psalm 103:2) WE PRAYThank the Lord for the glorious graces He has released unto you and the opportunity to be relevant in the Kingdom, through your local Church. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Corinthians 2 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.– In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.– I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.– I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.– My mouth is full of thanksgiving.– Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 657 - THE LAMB SONG - THE NEW SONG 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. You cannot resist the devil when you are proud. To resist the devil, you must first humble yourself before the Lord. Selah! Author Sunday, 10th November, 2024 THE LAMB SONG - THE NEW SONG"Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory."  Psalm 98:1 (Berean Standard Bible)Songs are an integral part of a believer's life. They serve as means of educating, instructing, inspiring, and admonishing the believers. There are carnal songs that only satisfy the soul and the sensual realm of men. But songs of the Kingdom are primarily designed for the adoration of the Lord and the exhortation and education of the believer.The songs of the Kingdom are spiritual songs.These songs are the outflow of a deep spiritual experience and insight. They are born out of the revelational-light of God.
The songs you sing determine the revelation of God in your heart.
A man full of the Spirit and the Word of Christ is a man of deep spiritual songs (Ephesians 5:18-19; Colossians 3:16).The scriptures admonish us throughout the Old Testament to sing unto the Lord as you can see in the opening verse of this episode. Apart from the instruction to sing, there are several examples of the people of God singing.Songs were sung to comfort, to make merry and celebrate, to burst forth in faith, to instruct, to inspire hope and courage, to praise and adore the Lord.One of the key instructions you will find in the Psalms is, "Sing a new song unto the Lord" (Psalm 98:1; Psalm 33:3;  Psalm 149:1).
To sing a new song is to sing the ultimate song of the Lord. Singing a new song is not necessarily having new lyrics and rhythm of songs.
A new song is a body of songs we are instructed to sing. A new song is not just a generic song about God.The new song is also known as the LAMB SONG.It is a song which communicates the victory of the Lord which He wields through His death and resurrection. This song is the eternal song of the Lord. It is a song we will sing in all eternity. It is the foundational song of the Kingdom and the Lord's throne.One may ask "How is this LAMB SONG the new song"?And "Which songs are Old songs"?Well, there is nothing really like an old song to God. But there is a new song.The reason I wouldn't refer to any other song to God as an old song is that, they are not obsolete. They are songs John the apostle heard from the living creatures and the twenty-four elders.These are called the songs of God's Being, His Might and splendor of His Holiness."And the four living creatures, each of them with six wings, are full of eyes all around and within, and day and night they never cease to say, “Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!” Revelation 4:8 (ESV) They can also be called songs of glory and honor in creation."And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to him who is seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever, the twenty-four elders fall down before him who is seated on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying,“Worthy are you, our Lord and God,to receive glory and honor and power,for you created all things,and by your will they existed and were created.” Revelation 4:9-11 (ESV)They are songs which testify of God's being and work in creation.These songs were sung at the foundation of creation."Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?" Job 38:6-7 (KJV)However, the LAMB SONG is the present and priceless song in God's heart. Though the LAMB SONG has been a melody in God's heart before the foundation of the world, it is the New song because it is the trending song for all eternity. John the apostle in his prophetic vision, saw a rolled-up scroll (book) securely sealed with seven seals. This book was extremely important considering how it was sealed. (Historically, under Roman Law, an important legal document which especially pertains to life and death is required to be perfectly sealed. It was mostly sealed seven times).These Heavenly scrolls required one who was worthy to open the scroll. And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book neither to look upon it. (Revelation 5:3).This sealed scroll was like the earth's title deed. Yet none was worthy to open the seals.This even caused despair in John's heart (Revelation 5:4). But glory be to God. Jesus, the Lion-LAMB has prevailed to open the scroll and to lose its seals.Let me just bless you with this:
In Christ Jesus, there are no mysteries. Christ is the demystification of all mysteries!
He is the Lion of the tribe of Judah and the slain LAMB of God who has taken and opened the seal.
"And when he had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each holding a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints. And they sang a new song, saying,“Worthy are you to take the scrolland to open its seals,for you were slain, and by your blood you ransomed people for Godfrom every tribe and language and people and nation,and you have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they shall reign on the earth.” Revelation 5:8-10 (ESV)This is the new song. It's a song which articulates the awe of all creation in the universe and the transcendent realms. It's a song of the heavenly Hero.
It is a song which declares the victory of Christ.
This is a song all the glorious heavenly beings are singing. Even the creatures who are in heaven, on earth under the earth and those in the sea and all that are in the universe are singing the glorious song of the Lamb (Revelation 5:11-13).The Lamb of God is worthy!And every believer must sing this LAMB SONG every day.
Jesus the Lamb of God, is the subject of our songs and worship. He is our NEW SONG.
Oh glory to the Lamb that was slain, forever and ever.Amen!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Revelation 7:9-12; Exodus 15:1-3; Revelation 15:3-4; Revelation 14:1-4) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall behold the glorious victory and wealth of Jesus as the slain Lamb. And He shall remain the song on our lips every day. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Corinthians 5 - 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The glorious victory and wealth of Jesus is the NEW SONG on my lips. - JESUS the Lamb of God who was slain even before the foundations of the world is WORTHY. - He is my NEW SONG and I sing it daily. - I sing daily the glorious song of the Lamb. Thank you Lord Jesus for your glorious victory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 658 - THE LAMB SONG – THE NEW SONG 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are reading this now, then God is talking to you. Yes, You! Don’t live like there is no cause! Don’t spend your time, your thoughts, money, attention, and energy on the things of men like there is no cause. Beloved, be committed to the great course of Christ. Don’t be a hindrance or the reason big things cannot be done. Selah! Author Monday, 11th November, 2024 THE LAMB SONG – THE NEW SONG 2"Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory." Psalm 98:1 (Berean Standard Bible) The Lamb Song is a song of Jesus as our victorious Saviour. As we have seen in previous discussion, it is the ultimate song of the heavenly. It testifies to God's greatest provision in the entire universe and eternity.
The new song is also known as the LAMB SONG.
It is the foundational song of the Kingdom and the Lord's throne. The sweetest melody in the Kingdom which testifies of the LORD’S priceless accomplishment. This song of the LAMB is the song of Salvation. It is a song of God's deliverance and repositioning of the delivered. The Lord declared through the Prophet Isaiah, "I will do a new thing..." (Isaiah 43:19).And through the Prophet Jeremiah, He said: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah" Jeremiah 31:31 (ESV) And through the Psalmist we are admonished to sing a New song. This is a song of all that Christ will accomplish.Christ brought the promise of the new covenant into fulfilment. Through Christ's blood, a New Covenant was enacted (Matthew 26:28).
 Through His death and resurrection, a New Testament was established. 
"For this reason He is the Mediator and Negotiator of a new covenant [that is, an entirely new agreement uniting God and man], so that those who have been called [by God] may receive [the fulfillment of] the promised eternal inheritance, since a death has taken place [as the payment] which redeems them from the sins committed under the obsolete first covenant. For where there is a will and testament involved, the death of the one who made it must be established, for a will and testament takes effect [only] at death, since it is never in force as long as the one who made it is alive. So even the first covenant was not put in force without [the shedding of] blood" Hebrews 9:15-18 (Amplified Bible) As many that received Him, also has entered Him to become one with Him as New Creations (2 Corinthians 5:17). And as New Creations the Lord has qualified us to be able ministers or stewards of the New Covenant which is according to the Spirit (2 Corinthians 3:6). Wherefore, as Christ was raised by the glory of the Father, all who are made one with Him are to live the Newness of life (Romans 6:4) John the Apostle saw the final ultimate city, which is being built through the continuous work of Christ in His Church by the Holy Spirit, the NEW JERUSALEM.
All these are built on the foundation of the redemptive and glorified work of the slain Lamb of God.
This work of God wasn't an afterthought. It was God’s original thought even from the foundation of the world. As God planned it, it happened in His heart before it manifested in our eyes. "...the Lamb that hath been slain from the foundation of the world" Revelation 13:8 (ESV)
The Lamb is the essence of our life and living, the subject of our doctrine, language, songs and worship.
The entire Newness of Life is built on Him, by Him and with Him. This Life is revealed as Him. He is our NEW SONG. "Worthy is the Lamb that was slain!" Oh Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 31:26-40; Hebrews 8:6 -12; Revelation 14:1-4) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall understand the depths and worth of the blood of Jesus shed on the cross so that we shall have illumination in our true worship of the Lord in the Spirit.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Corinthians 8 - 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The glorious victory and wealth of Jesus is the NEW SONG on my lips. – JESUS the Lamb of God who was slain even before the foundations of the world is WORTHY. – He is my NEW SONG and I sing Him daily. – I sing daily the glorious song of the Lamb. Thank you Lord Jesus for your glorious victory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 659 - THE LAMB SONG – THE NEW SONG 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To have faith is to have confidence in God and His saving ability. Faith is not vim! Faith is not how you feel. Faith is not waiting for a change. Faith is believing without a doubt in your heart that the change has happened and you have received it. Author Tuesday, 12th November, 2024 THE LAMB SONG – THE NEW SONG 3"And they sang in a mighty chorus: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered— to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.” Revelation 5:12 (New Living Translation)The reality of the redemptive and glorified work of Christ as the Slain LAMB wasn't manufactured by theologians.It was the intention of God from the foundation of the world."...the Lamb that hath been slain from the foundation of the world" Revelation 13:8 (ESV).The conversation about the Lamb has been from the ancients.Isaac knowing the precept of sacrificial offerings, asked his father, "...Where is the Lamb for the burnt offering?" Genesis 22:7 (RSV)Abraham responded, "God will provide Himself a lamb for a burnt offering..." Genesis 22:8 (RSV)Abraham as a man of faith and a prophet of God, understood the heart of God. He knew the sacrifices of God would only be done with a Lamb provided by God Himself. He knew prophetically that, no man can provide a perfect sacrifice for God's perfect offering.Throughout the scriptures, we see the Israelites sacrificing lambs as burnt offerings. But these animals they offered couldn't accomplish God's original work. They only served as types and shadows of the substance. (Colossians 2:16-17; Hebrews 8:5).
Christ came as the substance of the shadows.
"Since the law has only a shadow of the good things to come and not the true form of these realities, it can never, by the same sacrifices that are continually offered year after year, make perfect those who approach. otherwise, would they not have ceased being offered, since the worshipers, cleansed once for all, would no longer have any consciousness of sin? But in these sacrifices there is a reminder of sin year after year. For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins. Consequently, when Christ came into the world, he said, “Sacrifices and offerings you have not desired, but a body you have prepared for me; in burnt offerings and sin offerings you have taken no pleasure. Then I said, ‘See, God, I have come to do your will, O God’ (in the scroll of the book it is written of me).” Hebrews 10:1-7 (New Revised Standard Version) It's not too late for you to join. Click here to register today. To prove this, look at John the Baptist's response when he saw Jesus the Christ:"Behold the Lamb!" (John 1:29).The question asked by Isaac many centuries ago was answered by John the Baptist.
This is the will of God that Christ should be offered for our sanctification.
"And in accordance with this will [of God] we [who believe in the message of salvation] have been sanctified [that is, set apart as holy for God and His purposes] through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ (the Messiah, the Anointed) once for all." Hebrews 10:10 (Amplified Bible)Now the reaction of men and all creation is no longer, WHERE IS THE LAMB?!All creation now sing the song of the Lamb of God.All creation now sings saying:"Worthy is the Lamb!"The glorious news is this, the more we sing this song of the Lamb, the more we declare and celebrate the victory of the  Lamb. The victory of the Lamb was demonstrated through the shedding of His BLOOD.
The songs of the Blood of Jesus are not songs of old. They are new songs which must be on the lips of the saints in all eternity.
It is a song of GRACE!Now all creation stands before God in worship without any sense of guilt because of the redemptive and glorified work of the LAMB!Hallelujah!"Worthy is the Lamb!"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQCr54a1arADIG DEEPER(Hebrews 8:6 -12; Hebrews 10:1-20; Revelation 14:1-4) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for His priceless sacrifice and shedding of His blood which has sanctified us and given us access into the Heavenly Sanctuary. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Corinthians 11 - 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for your priceless sacrifice and precious blood which you shed for my sanctification. – JESUS the Lamb of God who was slain even before the foundation of the world is WORTHY. – He is my NEW SONG on my lips.  – I sing daily the glorious song of the Lamb. – Oh, Worthy is the Lamb of God! Thank you Lord Jesus for shedding your blood for me![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 660 - THE LAMB SONG – THE NEW SONG 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Great faith is not confidence in the self or what you know. Neither is it found in the money in your account nor the number of hours you pray in tongues (though it is worth it). Exercising great faith always begins with having reverence for God and submitting to Him. Selah! Author Wednesday, 13th November, 2024 THE LAMB SONG – THE NEW SONG 4"And they sang in a mighty chorus: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered— to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.” Revelation 5:12 (New Living Translation)What song are you singing?Songs of sorrow?Songs of how darkness prevails?Songs of defeat?Songs of being delivered one day?No!Sing the songs of the Lamb.The song of the Lamb is the song of what Christ has accomplished through His blood.
No matter how the adversary accuses you, don't change your songs.
Sing the New Song of the Lord. This is the song of your true reality.You don't overcome the adversary by what you try to do.Look at this:"And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death" Revelation 12:1]-11 (KJV).Don't allow the adversary to change your disposition. Don't change your confession. Sing the songs of the glorious accomplishment of the Lamb of God.As we have seen through this series, the songs of the heavenly are the songs of the Lamb of God.The Prophet Isaiah announced this ahead of time:"Pay attention, O Jacob, for you are my servant, O Israel. I, the LORD, made you, and I will not forget you. I have swept away your sins like a cloud. I have scattered your offenses like the morning mist. Oh, return to me, for I have paid the price to set you free.” Sing, O heavens, for the LORD has done this wondrous thing. Shout for joy, O depths of the earth! Break into song, O mountains and forests and every tree! For the LORD has redeemed Jacob and is glorified in Israel." Isaiah 44:21-23 (NLT)It may look like this was about Jerusalem. But these Prophet declared words which transcended the physical Jerusalem. Their prophetic words were glimpses of God's eternal work.These verses are prophecies concerning the price which Christ has paid through His blood. They testify of Christ's redemptive and glorified work.It also articulates how the saints must respond to this redemptive and glorified work with singing. The Prophet was also speaking of the LAMB SONG, which is the New Song of Heaven.In Revelation 15, John the Apostle saw and heard the victorious saints singing the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the Lamb."And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints." Revelation 15:3 (KJV)These are not necessarily two different songs. These are the same songs. Moses the servant of God sang a prophetic song of the Lamb and this song is recognized in the heavenly sanctuary.After God delivered the Israelites out of Egypt and led them to cross the Red Sea, Moses praised the Lord and sang a song of deliverance or a song of Salvation (Exodus 15:1-18).Now there are three (3) recorded songs of Moses:1. What he sang after they crossed the Red Sea.2. The second was recorded in the Psalm. Which is Psalm 90.3. And the third song was recorded at the end of Moses' life. (Deuteronomy 32) It's not too late to join. Click here to register today. [wpdiscuz-feedback id="0qab4b3f38" question="Ps 90:1-17 1 LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place In all generations. 2 Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God. 3 Thou turnest man to destruction; And sayest, Return, ye children of men. 4 For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday When it is past, and as a watch in the night. 5 Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up. 6 In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth. 7 For we are consumed by thine anger, And by thy wrath are we troubled. 8 Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance. 9 For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We spend our years as a tale that is told. 10 The days of our years are threescore years and ten; And if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, Yet is their strength labour and sorrow; For it is soon cut off, and we fly away. 11 Who knoweth the power of thine anger? Even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath. 12 So teach us to number our days, That we may apply our hearts unto wisdom. 13 Return, O LORD, how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants. 14 O satisfy us early with thy mercy; That we may rejoice and be glad all our days. 15 Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil. 16 Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory unto their children. 17 And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it." opened="0"]Psalm 90[/wpdiscuz-feedback] is a prayer and declaration of Moses concerning God's faithfulness and help. The one recorded in Deuteronomy was an instructive song to the children of Israel.However, the one he sang after crossing the Red Sea is a song which testifies to the deliverance and Salvation of the Lord.The deliverance of Israel wasn't founded on the crossing of the Red Sea. The foundation of their deliverance is God and was worked through the Passover Lamb. This means Moses' song of deliverance is ultimately a prophetic song of the Lamb.Israel had been in slavery for many years and couldn't come out of the land of Egypt. Despite the miracles demonstrated by Moses and the several plagues which befell the people of Israel, Pharoah's heart was too hardened to let the people of Israel go.It was the Passover experience that finally triggered the decision for Pharoah to allow the people of Israel to go.
The glorious news is that the Passover Lamb was a foreshadowing of Christ's redemptive work.
Jesus Christ is the True Passover Lamb.He is also the perfect Lamb of God.Thus, the song of Moses is the song of the Lamb.At the deliverance of Israel from Egypt Moses sang a song of the victory of the Lamb of the Lord. He didn't sing of their pain and agony. He sang of the deliverance and Salvation the Lord gave them.Christ redeemed those who were under the curse of the Law, through His blood. He also delivered all the saints from the power of darkness and translated us into His eternal glorious kingdom."He has delivered us from the power of darkness and conveyed us into the kingdom of the Son of His love, in whom we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins." Colossians 1:13-14 (NKJV)This is our NEW SONG!
This glorious victory of the blood is the song of the Lamb which we sing.
Let's all saints sing with joy:"WORTHY IS THE LAMB THAT WAS SLAIN!"Oh Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Revelation 4:11; 5:9; Revelation 14:1-4) WE PRAYWe pray declaring the testimony of the Lord and His victory for all the saints through His blood. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Galatians 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for your priceless sacrifice and precious blood which you shed for my sanctification. – JESUS the Lamb of God who was slain even before the foundation of the world is WORTHY. – He is my NEW SONG on my lips.  – I sing daily the glorious song of the Lamb. – Oh, Worthy is the Lamb of God! Thank you Lord Jesus for shedding your blood for me![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 661 - LOOK INTO THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sometimes you may feel your situation is worse and you have already sunk deep in discouragement or depression and defeat where nothing could be done. It doesn’t matter your situation, when you call upon the Lord, you shall be saved. Author Thursday, 14th November, 2024LOOK INTO THE WORD"And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit."2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP) Beloved, you are metamorphosed or transformed into (one degree of glory to another degree) of the image of the glory of the Lord as you meditate on the scriptures. As you behold or meditate on the revelation of the glory of the Lord in the scriptures, you are transformed into a greater dimension of glory. This explains the meaning of these scriptures to some degree: "But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day." Proverbs 4:18 (KJV) "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path" Psalm 119:105 (KJV).
The more you meditate or behold the glory of the Word of God, the more you shine forth brightly.
The Word of God is a mirror which brings you to the consciousness of who you are in Christ. As a new creation in Christ, you didn’t receive the Life of Christ as you behold the Word of God. When you received Christ, you received His life. "He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life. These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God." 1 John 5:12-13 (KJV) Now you can clearly see that, though you are born by the seed of the Word of God, the Word of God, as a mirror, does not introduce a new life into you. The mirror principle of the Word of God is that:As you look, you come to the true consciousness of who you are in Christ Jesus. If you define yourself as a sinner or by any false image created by religion, you begin to experience the renewal of mind as you behold the glory of God in the Word. As you are born of the Word, you can only see your true picture, your God-begotten self as you look into the Word. Listen;A mirror doesn’t add nor change who you are or what you are.A mirror brings you to the realization and consciousness of who you are.
Anytime you behold yourself in the mirror of the Word, it reveals your true essence and quality.
You can only live in the capacity of that revelation as you continue to be conscious of it through meditation. James the apostle, explains how the mirror principle works:James 1:21-25 (TPT) "So this is why we abandon everything morally impure and all forms of wicked conduct. Instead, with a sensitive spirit we absorb God’s Word, which has been implanted within our nature, for the Word of Life has power to continually deliver us." James 1:21 (TPT) Now you can see that, verse 21 reveals that though one with a sensitive spirit absorbs the Word of God, the Word of God has already been implanted to our new nature in Christ. And it has continuous work to deliver by its power.In some other translations, it uses the phrase, "which is able to save your souls". This could mean the saving of one's soul through the new birth experience and the saving of your soul (will, mind, emotions) from the affections of the world, through the renewal of the mind. He then brings the mirror principle of the Word to light in these subsequent verses: "Don’t just listen to the Word of Truth and not respond to it, for that is the essence of self-deception. So always let his Word become like poetry written and fulfilled by your life! If you listen to the Word and don’t live out the message you hear, you become like the person who looks in the mirror of the Word to discover the reflection of his face in the beginning. You perceive how God sees you in the mirror of the Word, but then you go out and forget your divine origin. But those who set their gaze deeply into the perfecting law of liberty are fascinated by and respond to the truth they hear and are strengthened by it—they experience God’s blessing in all that they do!" James 1:22-25 (TPT).• Not responding to the Word is a self-deception, because it is the unfolding of your originality.• Let the word be like poetry written and fulfilled by your life. It means your life has to be the reflection and expression of the Word.• As you hear the Word, live out the message. Keep it in your heart, and meditate on it until it soaks your consciousness.• When you look into the mirror of the Word you will discover the reflection of your face, you will have the right perception of how God sees you and your divine origin.• You will not forget it when you set your gaze deeply into the perfecting law of liberty (which is the revelation of Jesus in the Word).• The consciousness of the word produces fresh strength in you as an unshakable edifice and causes you to experience God’s blessing in all that you do!
Look into the Word daily to see your true-self and enjoy your true inheritance in Christ.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhAY-KMCcs0DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 13:12; Psalm 84:7; John 17:24; 2 Corinthians 4:4,6; Romans 8:29) WE PRAYThat we will give ourselves wholly to the influence of the word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Galatians 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As I look into the mirror of the word, I see my true essence and quality. – I continue in the consciousness of what I see in the mirror of the word through meditation. – I increase the more in strength and grace, the more I look into the mirror of the word. – My mind is transformed daily as I look into the mirror of the word. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 662 - SPEAK YOUR FAMILY LANGUAGE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To be in Christ and to live without joy, means you are living without the consciousness of the presence of Jesus. Selah! Author Friday, 15th November, 2024SPEAK YOUR FAMILY LANGUAGE"Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all, especially to those who are of the household of faith" Galatians 6:10 (NKJV) Your socialization can be influenced by the kind of family or household you belong to. Your family influences the way you think and act. A family is a fundamental institution or agency where a person is introduced to his/her culture and identity and develops certain behavioral patterns.When you are born again, you are brought into God's family. God’s family has an identity, culture, and pattern of behaviour or character. Every family’s identity is connected to the head of the family. God is the identity of His family by Himself.
One of the key items God dispenses into those who receive His life is FAITH. You become born again by the Word of God.
“for you have been born again… through the living and enduring word of God” 1 Peter 1;23 (NASB)The Word of God produces faith in your heart (Romans 10:17).This means anyone who is born again has FAITH. Faith is the character and currency by which the life of God is lived. The people of the household (family) of God live by Faith.“For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”  Romans 1:17(Bereans Study Bible).As a new creation or born again you were begotten into God’s family by faith, therefore you are to live by faith.Living by faith is not a suggestion; it is the identity of those born into God’s household. The Church, which is the embodiment of God’s family, is a household of faith. It is the aggregation of cultured men who live, think, speak, and function by faith. The family or household of God is not a household of cowards. Anyone who belongs to this household must live, think, and act by faith.
In the household of God faith is our language, we don’t speak doubts nor do we think about impossibilities.
Hebrews 11 reveals the faith of the patriarchs and how their faith is completed in the New Testament.“These were the true heroes, commended for their faith, yet they lived in hope without receiving the fullness of what was promised them. But now God has invited us to live in something better than what they had—faith’s fullness! This is so that they could be brought to finished perfection alongside of us.” Hebrews 11:39-40 (TPT)In the New Testament, we have the fullness of Faith. This is because in Christ we are not just hoping for a reality to manifest. In Christ, we have the substance and reality of faith. Our walk is not because of fear or because we may fail. Our walk and communication are rooted in the victory of Christ. We don’t live as people who are in search of victory. In every situation, we live as Overcomers!“For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world — our faith.” 1 John 5:4 (NKJV)
Whatever or whoever is born of God, into the household of God has overcome the world through Faith!
Are you of God’s household?Then you are part of men who function by faith. You don’t have to permit defeat and failure in your sphere because you are born of God. You don’t speak failure and defeat. You have the faith of God in you, function in that capacity.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; Ephesians 2:19; Galatians 3:9) WE PRAYThat we will walk daily in the consciousness of the capacity of the faith of God at work in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ephesians 1 - 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I belong to the eternal incorruptible Family of God.– I am deeply rooted in Christ.– I am nourished and enriched by Christ.– I am the focus of the love of God.– I am made whole and holy by His love.– I am a partner together with God.– I am born of God.– I don’t permit defeat or failure in my sphere.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 663 - ACCESSING SECRETS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Allow the Lord through His word to bless the world with His best wine in you. Yours is to walk in the obedience of His word. Selah! Author  ACCESSING SECRETS 1"It is the glory of God to conceal things, but the glory of kings is to search things out" Proverbs 25:2 (ESV)Is God mysterious?Does He have mysteries?
God remains a mystery dependent on your position and lens.
It is not the intention of God to remain a mystery. It is not His intention to conceal things and even to conceal Himself. God wants to be known and experienced. He wants men to access His reality and principles.Principles and laws are God’s investment in the cosmic universe. They harmonize the systems within the universe to help sustain its course.The person of God is no longer a mystery because of Christ.
Jesus Christ came to unveil God to mankind.
"No one has ever yet seen God. The only begotten God, the One being in the bosom of the Father, He has made Him known." John 1:18 (Berean Literal Bible)Yet the scriptures state that when Jesus, who is the word, manifested Himself in the flesh, those who thought they knew the word did not know Him and could not receive Him as God (See John 1:11).The Prophet Isaiah declared:"From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him." (Isaiah 64:4)Now Paul the apostle revealed that this scripture has been fulfilled:"No, the wisdom we speak of is the mystery of God—His plan that was previously hidden, even though He made it for our ultimate glory before the world began. But the rulers of this world have not understood it; if they had, they would not have crucified our glorious Lord. That is what the Scriptures mean when they say, “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no mind has imagined what God has prepared for those who love him.” 1 Corinthians 2:7-9 (NLT)God was revealed through Christ yet they couldn't comprehend that reality. They shouted crucify Him. But didn't know it was GOD.Until you put on Christ, you will not know about God and He will still be a mystery to you. God is only demystified in Christ. This is why life and living remain a mystery to many. The true understanding of God, the essence and frame of life is decoded through the lens of Christ.
Your understanding of Christ through His word grants you access to the depths of God's wisdom and the hidden secrets of life.
The word of God is the constitution of the wisdom of God.All that is concealed is revealed in the word of God through the lens of Christ.Get this, secrets are conceptions deployed to harness or manipulate principles and systems to work for one's advantage. These conceptions are developed through a person's measure of understanding.Your measure of understanding determines the secrets you unravel. Every believer accesses secrets in the secret place.The secret place is not just a room, but the active moments of communion with God. You have deep communion with God through:- The process of meditation of the Word (which is the mind of God)- Through prayer and fellowship with the Holy Spirit.The Holy Spirit is the Spirit of God. And He searches all things, even the deep things of God. When you commune with Him, He brings to your heart the deep thoughts of God's word.
He brings to heart the hidden secrets the Jewish rulers couldn't apprehend.
"But it was to us that God revealed these things by his Spirit. For his Spirit searches out everything and shows us God’s deep secrets. No one can know a person’s thoughts except that person’s own spirit, and no one can know God’s thoughts except God’s own Spirit. And we have received God’s Spirit (not the world’s spirit), so we can know the wonderful things God has freely given us." 1 Corinthians 2:10-12 (NLT).Jesus said of the Holy Spirit, He is the Spirit of Truth who will lead the sons of God into all TRUTH (John 16:13).Beloved, the secrets of God are not hidden from you. The secrets of God and His universe are within your heart. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhAY-KMCcs0DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:5; Jeremiah 33:3; Daniel 2:21-23; Job 11:22) WE PRAYWe pray that the Holy Spirit will guide us daily into accessing and comprehending the revealed secrets of God in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ephesians 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The secrets of God are not hidden from you. - The secrets of God and the universe are within my heart. - The Holy Spirit teaches and guides me daily to access and comprehend the revealed secrets of God in Christ. - I have access into the secrets of God now. Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 664 - THE CITADEL OF DIVINE REALITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency As a believer in Christ, God doesn’t want you to pursue things, He wants to be at the centre of your thoughts so that He will impart you with His grace. Author Sunday, 17th November, 2024THE CITADEL OF DIVINE REALITY “but if I am delayed, I write so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth” 1 Timothy 3:15 (NKJV)You are likely to get more confused in this present pluralistic world. This is a world where everyone seems to have an opportunity to create their own contents. Even people who are living astray or struggling to get their lives together are pretending to be online coaches. In a world where we have people embittered by the wounds of broken homes, deceived by atheism, disdained by the society, blinded by the fables of traditions and religion; you will definitely be confronted by contradictory opinions. You may meet people with weird thoughts about how one has to live and relate with God.
The world clearly without God is confused!!!
God is not the author of confusion. (1 Corinthians 14:33) Confusion is not normal. Truth is not subjective. Truth is not determined by how one feels or thinks. People make their opinions and define their living by how they feel or think within a particular period. Feelings change and experiences differ.Truth is absolute!
Truth is changeless!
The systems and structures of this world are not built on Truth. They are mainly built on individual interests or greed. You can only find truth in God’s Kingdom. Jesus said, “I am the Way, the Truth and the Life.” (John 14:6). All the systems or structures of this world shall crumble (Psalm 46:6). They don’t carry eternal value. Therefore, don’t be conformed to this world though you are in the world (Romans 12:2; John 17:16). The most secured place is the Kingdom of God. And through Christ we are translated into this unshakable kingdom (Colossians 1:13; Hebrews 11:28). Jesus established His Church to be the organic expression of God’s Kingdom. The best place to consistently access Truth is Christ’s Church. Let not the world distract you.
The Church is the only Pillar and ground of the Truth. It is the haven and bastion of divine reality. Through the Church, you are nurtured, equipped and deeply rooted in truth.
"Then we will no longer be like children, forever changing our minds about what we believe because someone has told us something different or has cleverly lied to us and made the lie sound like the truth." Ephesians 4:14 (TLB).The people of the world who see the Church as a threat would definitely have a different opinion about this. Nevertheless, the essence and the impact of the Church in the world cannot be denied. From the revelation of the scriptures, there is the affirmation of this truth of the Church and its purpose in this world. The Church is the herald of the glorious news of the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus. Apart from the Church, there is no other community of people anywhere in this world which presents and represents God’s Kingdom.You might have experienced some people within the Church who act contrary to the reality of the Kingdom of our Lord. But that doesn’t deny what the Church is – THE PILLAR OF TRUTH! Selfish men will always look for ways to creep into places and then attempt to make waste of gullible people.
