However, the light of the truth cannot be comprehended by any dimension of darkness. Don’t allow your experiences of some people within the Church to corrupt your love for the Lord, and then move you away from the community of the Church. Don’t allow your heart to be steered away from the glorious essence of the Church.
The fullness of Christ is revealed through His Body which is the Church.
The Church remains the only Bastion of Truth in this world; therefore, let nothing move you away from the Church! Be unwavering involved or part of what God is doing in His Church.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhAY-KMCcs0DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 4:11-20; Matthew 16:18-19; Acts 2:42, 46) WE PRAYThat we may be deeply rooted in the truth of God, which is Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Philippians 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am secured in the Kingdom of God.– I am deeply rooted in the truth of God, which is Christ.– I continue in this truth I have received.– I don’t give my hearing do any other voice aside Christ.– I refuse to conform to this world.– I belong to the unshakable Kingdom.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 665  - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 16 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 11 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you keep on being filled with or immersed in the Spirit, you come under the influence of the Spirit. The Spirit influences your movements, thoughts and speech. There is a way a man who is immersed in the Spirit daily, thinks and lives. Beloved, be immersed in the Spirit. Author Monday, 18th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 16 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 11 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 2"And he said, “Hear my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream. Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house. With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles, and he beholds the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?” Numbers 12:6-8 (ESV)As we have previously discussed, considering the various means by which God speaks to His people, we noticed God still speaks to His people through dreams and visions.Dreams and visions are not obsolete. They are still relevant but are useful to the believer only within the boundaries of the scriptures.Visions, Dreams and Trances are not evil. These are means of prophetic communication.
God did speak to people in the scriptures through these methods and even in our day He still uses such to send prophetic messages.
There are times dreams, visions and trances are used interchangeably. But these have their unique meanings.Dreams are projected images and imaginary transactions or deep thoughts which engage the soul and the mind of a person whiles asleep. They come in different forms. Dreams play out as simple direct messages or simple symbolic thoughts which are interpretative in themselves.Joseph's dreams where the sheaves, sun or moon bowed to him were simple Hebraic symbolic dreams. When he narrated the dreams to his family, they didn't have to inquire of interpretation. The symbols in dream were well understood in their cultural sense (Genesis 37:5-10).In the New Testament we see another dream by Joseph Mary's husband. His dreams (Matthew 2:13-22) were also direct instructive messages which didn't require any interpretation.There is also the multiplex symbolic dreams. These dreams have complex features or elements which require a person with the wisdom to dissolve enigmas and hard sentences.This is just as you can see in the book of Daniel; King Nebuchadnezzar had dreams which were complex (Daniel 2 and Daniel 4).Such sophisticated multiplex dreams either troubles the heart or makes one restless in their sleep.Mostly because of the unfamiliar meanings of the imagery or the manners by which it pricks the dreams emotions.Daniel also had similar type of dream and had to seek for divine interpretation to understand the complexity of the dream (Daniel 7).After communicating the dream, he said, "Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart." Daniel 7:28 (KJV).The complexity of a dream is in it's features and how to challenges your conceptions.As I have mentioned earlier in this series (or in other episodes), God doesn't primarily lead you through dreams. God speaks to you through His Word. Dreams and Visions are secondary mediums by which He communicates with us.Understand that dreams are also projected by demonic forces. The dreams of God will always have substantial character of the knowledge and revelation of God. Demonic dreams will always contradict the revelation of the scriptures.
This means a believer in Christ must not build his life and confidence on dreams.
Sorcerers also dream. But what they don't have is the truth of the Word of God."Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field. For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd." Zechariah 10:1-2 (KJV)There are people who travel to see sorcerers who are also dreamers to predict their future.But that is not the way of the saints in Christ. We search the scriptures. Don't wait for a dream before you walk in the direction of the Lord. God speaks to you plainly in His scriptures."When people tell you, “Try out the fortunetellers. Consult the spiritualists. Why not tap into the spirit-world, get in touch with the dead?” Tell them, “No, we’re going to study the Scriptures.” People who try the other ways get nowhere—a dead end!" Isaiah 8:19-20 (Message Bible)
You may receive a word of the Lord through dreams. But judge every dream with the scriptures.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhAY-KMCcs0DIG DEEPER(Genesis 20:3-6; Judges 7:13; 1 Kings 3:5-14; Matthew 27:19; Matthew 1:20) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall grant us deep understanding to properly interpret the dreams of the Lord. We pray also that our souls and minds will be protected from demonic dreams. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Philippians 4Colossians 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – I judge every dream and vision with the scriptures. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 666 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 17 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 12 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Let this sink deep: Great leadership is not demonstrated when everything is convenient. Great leaders emerge when there is opposition or a challenge. You are not a great leader just because you command people to serve you. You are a great leader when you provide answers or solutions. Selah! Author Tuesday, 19th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 17 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 12 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 3"And he said, “Hear my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream. Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house. With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles, and he beholds the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?” Numbers 12:6-8 (ESV)Dreams are projected images and imaginary transactions or deep thoughts which engage the soul and the mind of a person while asleep. While a vision is an evocative impression.Dreams often happen while a person is in his sleep. However, a vision may happen both in a sleep or while awake.
Vision is a relevational imprint of images in the mind of a person which articulates a hidden event or situation.
There are times when a vision and a dream may happen together."But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these" Daniel 2:28 (KJV).The Prophet Daniel reveals here that Nebuchadnezzar on his bed had both a dream and a vision. There are times when people are not able to tell whether what they've had is a dream or a vision. Mainly because the vision they had happened while they were sleeping. These may be called a NIGHT VISION.A night vision is not necessarily a vision you have at night. A night vision is a prophetic term for the kind of vision which happens between the time one is awake and asleep. This may happen within a second of time but in your mind it might have lasted for hours. Because the unseen realm transcends time.Sometimes while you are coming out of a dream and about to be fully awake, your inner man captures another image or a scene and a spiritual experience. This may also be referred to as a night vision.When you understand these prophetic experiences you will be able to have the right understanding and interpretation.
God uses these means to help you perceive an unseen phenomenon.
"And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream." Numbers 12:6 (KJV)This wasn't just an "Old Testament" experience:Considering who Paul the apostle was before he was converted to Christ, it would have taken nothing less than a vision for Ananias to receive him.God had to speak to Ananias through a vision:"And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord. And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth" Acts 9:10-11 (KJV)God still communicates through visions but ultimately through His word. Every vision must be consistent with the knowledge of His Word. 
When you study the Scriptures, there was no vision received which contradicted the established counsel of the Lord.
What do you see?Its foundation must be the Word.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhAY-KMCcs0DIG DEEPER(Luke 1:5-23; Acts 10:1-6,9-15; Acts 18:9-11; 2 Corinthians 12:1-6) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall perceive the visions of God in the context of His Word. And our confidence shall not be steered towards visions and dreams only but the illumination of the Lord through His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Colossians 3 - 41 Thessalonians 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – I judge every dream and vision with the scriptures. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 667 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 18 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 13 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are confused about your true identity, DON’T LOOK AT THE WORLD. Your true identity is CHRIST. Therefore you must look unto Jesus who is the author of your Faith. Don’t look at others or the world. Look only at Jesus. Selah! Author Wednesday, 20th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 18 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 13 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 4"And he said, “Hear my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream. Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house. With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles, and he beholds the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?” Numbers 12:6-8 (ESV)If you have followed this discussion, you should have clarity about the difference between dreams and visions.A vision is an evocative impression or a revelational imprint of images or pictures in a person's mind that articulates a hidden event or situation. Meanwhile, a dream is a projected image and imaginary transaction or deep thoughts that engage a person's soul and mind while asleep.A vision may sometimes be experienced even with the optical eyes and not just in the mind. There are times when the physical eyes are enabled to see literally into the spirit world to behold hidden things, even as a person still sees natural things.Discussion on these items is important because believers do have such experiences often. And as a believer, you must have a proper understanding of such issues. Some are careful to engage in this kind of conversation and even don't open themselves up to receive visions because of the fear of getting into error.
As long as you submit your mind and thoughts to the revelation of the Word of God, your experiences will be guided by the authority of the Word.
Apart from dreams and visions, there is also what is referred to as Trance.Dreams, Visions and Trances are biblical.Most people confuse these three experiences and use them interchangeably. Especially between a vision and a trance.In Acts 10, you will find how two people had two unique prophetic experiences.Cornelius was an Italian Centurion, who was a devout man and had a vision, which led to his conversion.In that same chapter, Peter also had a prophetic revelation. But the experience of Peter the apostle was different from that of Cornelius. Cornelius had an open vision while Peter had a trance."a devout man of extraordinary character who worshiped God and prayed regularly, together with all his family. He also had a heart for the poor and gave generously to help them. One afternoon about three o’clock, he had an open vision and saw the angel of God appear right in front of him, calling out his name, “Cornelius!” Startled, he was overcome with fear by the sight of the angel. He asked, “What do you want, Lord?” The angel said, “All of your prayers and your generosity to the poor have ascended before God as an eternal offering." Acts 10:2-4 (TPT).This wasn't a dream. He literally saw the angel by way of vision. His eyes were opened to see and to hear.The Greek word for vision in this context is "horama" which means that which is seen. It is to have a view of a spectacular moment.Cornelius' vision wasn't an imagination and not just a mental picture.This means visions cannot be limited to a mental imprint. They are both mental imprints and the capturing of a live event in the spirit realm.People mostly experience these while in prayer. The place of prayer is a place of visions and spectacular prophetic experiences. Whenever you pray or delve into the word of God, your spirit ascends to see far beyond the normal and optics.After this amazing vision of Cornelius, God quickly sent a prophetic message to Peter to help have confirmation and to receive the message from Cornelius."The next day around noon, as Cornelius’ men were approaching Joppa, Peter went up to the flat roof of the house to pray. He was hungry and wanted to eat, but while lunch was being prepared he fell into a trance and entered into another realm. As the heavenly realm opened up, he saw something resembling a large linen tablecloth that descended from above, being let down to the earth by its four corners. As it floated down he saw that it held many kinds of four-footed animals, reptiles, and wild birds. A voice said to him, “Peter, go and prepare them to be eaten.” Peter replied, “There’s no way I could do that, Lord, for I’ve never eaten anything forbidden or impure according to our Jewish laws.” The voice spoke again. “Nothing is unclean if God declares it to be clean.” The vision was repeated three times. Then suddenly the linen sheet was snatched back up into heaven. Peter was so stunned by the vision that he couldn’t stop wondering about what all it meant. Meanwhile, Cornelius’ men had learned where Peter was staying and at that same moment were standing outside the gate. They called out to those in the house, “Is this where Simon, the Rock, is staying?” As Peter was in deep thought, trying to interpret the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Go downstairs now, for three men are looking for you. Don’t hesitate to go with them, because I have sent them.” Acts 10:9-20 (TPT)Peter's experience was not referred to as a dream or a vision. It was referred to as a Trance. The Greek word for Trance is, "ekstasis". Which means the displacement of the mind or bewilderment. It is used to describe a moment of ecstasy. It is a state where a person is caught up into a different realm.John the apostle had this experience several times while writing the book of Revelation. Most of what he referred to as "I was in the spirit" were trances.You transit from one state into a different realm, while you are physically in the same location but your inner man has travelled into a different realm.It is a moment of awe and amazement.During trance, one can also see a vision. Thus trance goes together with a vision. Within every trance, there is a vision.
God is able to communicate with the believer through such means to enforce his message.
Yet all these experiences are subject to the governing rule or constitution of His word. There is no experience of such which transcends the light of the Word of God.I call you blessed.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F2ptPfOwsCA&t=12sDIG DEEPER(Ezekiel 8:1-3; Acts 11:4-18; Acts 22:17-21; Revelation 1:10-13; Revelation 17:3) WE PRAYWe pray that the knowledge of the word of God will guide and guard our hearts so that we will properly appropriate every spiritual experience unto edification. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Thessalonians 2 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – I judge every dream, vision or trance with the scriptures. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 668 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 19 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 14 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t look away from the reality of Jesus. He is God! He is Eternal and His saving Grace is everlasting! His blood which purchased you is a divine blood. It is an eternal blood. JESUS IS GOD! This is the gospel. Walk confidently in this reality today. Shalom! Author Thursday, 21st November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 19 – How Do I Hear God's Voice? 14 — MORE ON VISIONS, DREAMS AND TRANCES 5"And he said, “Hear my words: If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream. Not so with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house. With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles, and he beholds the form of the Lord. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?” Numbers 12:6-8 (ESV)Through the experiences of dreams, visions and trances God communicates and instructs believers.
Yet, every speaking of God through these experiences are judged and interpreted according to the revelation of the scriptures.
From yesterday's episode, I shared the experiences of Cornelius the Italian Centurion and Peter the apostle as examples to help distinct the difference between a vision and a trance.Whiles a vision is the capturing of an image or event or a phenomenon in the spirit realm by means of spiritual sight and hearing; a trance is a state where a person's innerman is caught up or captivated into a different realm beyond the optics. To experience a trance is to transit from one realm into a different dimension, whiles you remain in your physical location.Paul the apostle had such experiences.One of his experiences was mentioned in the second epistle to the Corinthians:"This boasting will do no good, but I must go on. I will reluctantly tell about visions and revelations from the Lord. I was caught up to the third heaven fourteen years ago. Whether I was in my body or out of my body, I don’t know—only God knows. Yes, only God knows whether I was in my body or outside my body. But I do know that I was caught up to paradise and heard things so astounding that they cannot be expressed in words, things no human is allowed to tell." 2 Corinthians 12:1-4 (NLT)These experiences do still happen to believers. Nonetheless there is the wisdom of God through the scriptures, established to govern such experiences.From Paul the Apostle's experience we realize that, it is not all visions that ought to be uttered. God sometimes brings a believer into certain transcendent experience to affirm a reality in his heart.The apostle Peter's experience unveiled some few items on this matter."The next day around noon, as Cornelius’ men were approaching Joppa, Peter went up to the flat roof of the house to pray. He was hungry and wanted to eat, but while lunch was being prepared he fell into a trance and entered into another realm. As the heavenly realm opened up, he saw something resembling a large linen tablecloth that descended from above, being let down to the earth by its four corners. As it floated down he saw that it held many kinds of four-footed animals, reptiles, and wild birds. A voice said to him, “Peter, go and prepare them to be eaten.” Peter replied, “There’s no way I could do that, Lord, for I’ve never eaten anything forbidden or impure according to our Jewish laws.” The voice spoke again. “Nothing is unclean if God declares it to be clean.” The vision was repeated three times. Then suddenly the linen sheet was snatched back up into heaven. Peter was so stunned by the vision that he couldn’t stop wondering about what all it meant. Meanwhile, Cornelius’ men had learned where Peter was staying and at that same moment were standing outside the gate. They called out to those in the house, “Is this where Simon, the Rock, is staying?” As Peter was in deep thought, trying to interpret the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Go downstairs now, for three men are looking for you. Don’t hesitate to go with them, because I have sent them.” Acts 10:9-20 (TPT)Few things to note:⇒ A rich consistent prayer habit creates the atmosphere which aids you to be launched into such captivation. A person of prayer is a person who activates and enlivens the intimacy we have obtained through Christ. The place of prayer is a place of visions and spectacular prophetic experiences. Whenever you pray or delve into the word of God, your spirit ascends to see far beyond the optics.⇒ A trance is an experience that helps you see beyond the norm. A trance is not necessarily a vision. However you are able to capture or see a vision whiles in a trance. The vision is the message delivered to you by the Lord.⇒ The visions of God are not delivered with unrelated elements. The elements of every vision are things you can easily relate with. Peter's state of hunger and expectation for food, became the medium the Lord used to communicate His message to him in the vision.⇒ The visions of God are stunning and transcending and leaves you with a burden and desire for interpretation.⇒ Divine visions cannot be interpreted by human efforts. They are interpreted through the inspiration of the Holy Spirit and the insight of the Word of God in your heart.
Whether there is a vision or not, we have God's greatest revelation given to us through His Word.
I call you blessed!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQCr54a1arADIG DEEPER(Ezekiel 8:1-3; Acts 11:4-18; Acts 22:17-21; Revelation 1:10-13; Revelation 17:3) WE PRAYWe pray that Holy Spirit will guide our hearts and minds through the written word and supply us with the accurate interpretation even as we experience heavenly visions. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Thessalonians 5 2 Thessalonians 1 - 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I judge every dream, vision or trance with the scriptures. – The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t look into the shadows, I rather look into the word. – I don’t give room for any deception.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 669 - PURSUE THE EXPRESSION OF WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The goodness of God is God supplying you with what you don’t have. Beloved, live everyday of your life in this confidence and comfort that, in every step of life’s journey the LORD’S GOODNESS (abundant supply) and MERCY (lovingkindness) will hound and saturate you. Hallelujah! Author  PURSUE THE EXPRESSION OF WISDOM“As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her.” Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)When you decide to turn away from the Word of God and also devalue your relationship with God, you are turning away from True and Pure Wisdom.
When you set your heart to walk in the Wisdom of God, she will honor and exalt you.
Daniel was honored by Wisdom. (Daniel 2:48-49). Look at Joseph who became a Prime Minister in Egypt because of the workings of God’s wisdom.This is the preeminence of God’s Wisdom.
Nothing compares to God’s Wisdom.
The Wisdom of God is preeminent:1. Wisdom was in existence before all things were made.“In the beginning I was there, for God possessed me even before he created the universe. From eternity past I was set in place, before the world began. I was anointed from the beginning.” Proverbs 8:22-23 (TPT).2. God made the earth by His Wisdom.“The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens” Proverbs 3:19 (ESV).There is nothing which shall emerge from the earth that is more greater than Wisdom. Wisdom is the principal thing, by which you unlock all treasuries.3. Wisdom is greater than the might of men.Wisdom is the strength of the wise and her strength exceeds the strongest of men.“Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.” Ecclesiastes 7:19 (KJV).4. The Wisdom of God is greater than money and more precious than gold.Is money valuable? Yes, but not more valuable than Wisdom.Wisdom is a defence and money is a defence, however, the transcending reality is that Wisdom gives life. (Ecclesiastes 7:12).There was a point when money failed in Egypt, it was the Wisdom of God in Joseph, that sustained the economy of Egypt. (Genesis 47:15).
It is great to make money, but first, pursue the expression of Wisdom. A man of True Wisdom and understanding is a man of great wealth.
Take another look at the opening verse:“As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her.” Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)It is worthless to go after the wisdom of men. What is more precious than Wisdom?What will you ever desire that can be compared to God’s Wisdom?
The Wisdom which is from above is above all.
Get Wisdom and get understanding.Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 8; Job 28; Daniel 2:1-49; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall maintain our focus on Wisdom and not esteem the highest intelligence of men above True Wisdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Thessalonians 31 Timothy 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the wisdom which is from above therefore I am above all. – I esteem the true wisdom of God beyond every highest intelligence of men.  – I cease to be ordinary. – I walk in wisdom. – I am so wise. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 670 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 20 - PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You have what it takes to do what God has called you to do. Don’t be afraid to take responsibilities in Church. You are the man for the job! Selah! Author Saturday, 23rd November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 20 - PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 1"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Through this discussion, we have journeyed through some crucial matters to obtain proper understanding of the word.From the beginning of this series, I patiently answered some important questions in previous episodes. Such as:- How do I hear the voice of God?- Does God still speak to Christians apart from the canonized Bible?- How does God speak to men?- Does God speak to all men (the good people and the evil people)? Does he speak to unbelievers also?- Is there really a voice of God or it’s a mere human hypothesis?- Which mediums does God use to speak to His people?- What is the texture of the Voice of God?I believe the journey so far into the answers and understanding of these questions has been a great blessing to you.There are more questions we will be answering from this episode onward. The goal is to give you a balanced understanding concerning this matter of hearing God's voice.To move on further in this, we are going to answer these questions as well:- Are there other voices apart from the voice of God?- How do I distinguish God’s voice from other voices, if there are?- What is the difference between the voice of God and my imagination?- If God has given me a Pastor why do I need to hear His voice? If God speaks to me why do I need a Pastor to teach me the Word?Now these are genuine questions. [wpdiscuz-feedback id="flrg5ybauv" question="Ask your questions here." opened="1"] If you have more questions to ask or follow-up questions concerning hearing God's voice, send it here or post it in the comment space.[/wpdiscuz-feedback]
God speaks to us and expects us to hear His voice.
Jesus said, "My own sheep will hear my voice..." John 10:27 (TPT).Now in the earlier verses of John 10, Jesus made a profound statement in His parable to the Pharisees:"...And the sheep recognize the voice of the true Shepherd, for he calls his own by name and leads them out, for they belong to him. And when he has brought out all his sheep, he walks ahead of them and they will follow him, for they are familiar with his voice. But they will run away from strangers and never follow them because they know it’s the voice of a stranger.” John 10 3-5 (TPT).So from this illustration, there is the voice of a stranger and the voice of the True Shepherd.Clearly, the scriptures affirm that there are other voices which contradict the voice of God.From the first chapter of Genesis to the second chapter, there was mainly the speaking of God. Apart from God man also spoke (Genesis 2:20,23). And in Genesis 3, we noticed a third voice (Genesis 3:1-5). The moment man heeded to that voice, corruption entered the world.In Genesis, chapters 1 to 3, you will find the voice of God, the voice of Man and the voice of the adversary through the serpent.Thus, there are definitely other voices apart from the voice of God.From the time man became corrupt, man's voice became the voice of the self. The voice of the serpent which is the voice of the devil also became the voice of the world.
What sets you up to fulfill your purpose is the voice of God. 
You can only please God when you take heed to His voice.And now God's ultimate voice is Christ and His speaking is constituted as the Word of God.Through your fellowship with the word of God, you are able to perceive and know the voice of God. When you have that rich knowledge and perception of God's voice, you can clearly tell God's voice amidst the crowd or the noise.Give your mind to the revelation of the Word and you will perceive the voice of strangers.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Genesis 1 - 3; John 10:1-17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the knowledge of the word and develop the intelligence to perceive and discern the voice of the Lord amidst the noise around us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Timothy 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t give room for any deception.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 671 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 21 –PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The more you set your delight on the Word, the more you are saturated by its power. The power within the word in your heart will cause you to manifest what it says. Selah! Author Sunday, 24th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 20 -PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 2  "I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)The voice of God is not the only voice there is in the universe. There are other voices apart from the voice of God.
Also understand that anything made by God has a voice. And they only speak of God's glory.
"The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork. Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge. There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard. Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun" Psalm 19:1-4 (KJV)As I mentioned in yesterday's episode, apart from God's speaking, we also heard the voice of Man in Genesis.Man's speaking was also to reveal the glory of God. However, when Man heeded to the voice of the devil through the serpent he became corrupt. That corruption of man's soul affected the intention of His voice. Man's voice became the voice of the self or the voice of the flesh."But be clothed with the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not listen to the flesh, to fulfil its desires." Romans 13:14(Jubilee Bible 2000)The voice of the self or the flesh is man's desires. They speak carnality and hostility towards the voice of the Lord.So there is:- The voice of God- The voice of Man- The voice of creation- The voice of the devil- The voice of the world.The voice of the adversary, the devil is the voice of corruption, deception and condemnation. He is called the accuser of the brethren.Through his deceptive work, he earned himself a place of control in this world. The scriptures refer to him as, "Satan, who is the god of this world..." (1 Corinthians 4:4, NLT).Through his deceptive voice, he was able to control the minds of men with darkness. And it affected the systems and structures designed by men. The voice of the world is the mindset of the world, built on deception."They are the world's children, and so their language is that of the world, and the world listens to them. We are God's children" 1 John 4:5 (Weymouth New Testament).
Now the question is, how can you distinguish the voice of God from the other voices?
Remember, the word of God is the texture of God's voice.To know the voice of God, you must know the word of God. The word of God communicates the character, the mind and the life of God. The Word of God is God explaining Himself.To know God's voice is not a mystery. To know God's voice is to know the word of God.There is no speaking of God which contradicts the character of God. Thus, in all things you must perceive the consistency of God's character.
If what you hear is not consistent with the character and nature of God, then it is not the voice of the Lord.
Instead of running around looking for God's voice, understand God's character and nature through His word.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQCr54a1arADIG DEEPER(John 10:1-17; John 16:13; John 14:26) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the understanding of God's character that we may rightly discern his voice. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Timothy 62 Timothy 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Bible is the active voice of the Living God to me today. – I refuse to neglect the word of God for it is God’s voice to me. – I stick to the word of God. – I grow deeply in the love for the scriptures daily. – I esteem the word of God as the authentic utterance of God to me. – I don’t give room for any deception.Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 672 - PRAISE HIM WITH THE GLADNESS OF HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency One of the core things deception does to you is to make you have a contrary opinion. It makes you seek other means of fulfilment. The adversary lures you into falsehood by subjecting your thoughts to vain imaginations. Beloved, stay sound with THESE RICH REALITIES I share with you daily in . Shalom! Author Monday, 25th November, 2024PRAISE HIM WITH THE GLADNESS OF HEART“Jesus replied, “I tell you, if these [people] keep silent, the stones will cry out [in praise]!” Luke 19:40 (Amplified Bible) In His triumphal entry into Jerusalem, Jesus announced Himself not only as the Passover lamb but also as the true Messiah and the Eternal King. It was not by mere excitement that the people began to rejoice.There was something they saw at the coming of the Lord.They saw their expected Messiah, and their Saviour in His glorious royalty. When they saw Jesus drawing near, they began to rejoice and to praise God.They praised God because of the mighty miracles of Jesus.However, they also knew He did those miracles because of who He is.At that moment their tongue couldn’t only declare Him as a miracle worker.
They declared who He is, for He is the King who comes in the name of the Lord.
“Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen, saying:‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!” Luke 19:37-38 (NKJV) It was not by mistake they quoted, Psalm 118:26; it was by prophecy. And as they praised Jesus, and declared Him as the Messiah and the King, the Pharisees were troubled. “But some of the Pharisees among the crowd said, “ Sir, rebuke your followers for saying things like that!” Luke 19:39 (TLB) They didn’t just ask Jesus to silence the crowd because they were making noise, but because of what the crowd said.The Amplified Bible brings out the clarity: “Some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to Him, “ Teacher, rebuke Your disciples [for shouting these Messianic praises].” Luke 19:39 (Amplified). Jesus’ response to the Pharisees revealed His divine preeminence over all things."He replied, “If they keep quiet, the stones along the road will burst into cheers!” Luke 19:40 Beloved, even if many may deny His Lordship, His creation will forever celebrate Him. "All the earth worships you and sings praises to you; they sing praises to your name." Psalm 66:4 (ESV) "The heavens declare the glory of God, and the sky above proclaims his handiwork." Psalm 19:1 (ESV) Our Lord Jesus must be the focus and the object of your praise.Praise Him for who He is, for the greatness of His power and His mighty works.Praise Him every moment of your life. “…I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.” Psalm 34:1 (ESV) Praise the Lord and thank Him as you wake up from bed, walk around the house, as you step out of the house, and whiles you drive. As you praise the Lord, you sharpen your perception of Him and increase your consciousness of His presence in your life. (Psalm 103:2) “Why am I discouraged? Why is my heart so sad? I will put my hope in God! I will praise him again—my Savior and my God!…” (NLT).
There is no room for sorrow when you continually praise the Lord.
While Paul was in prison with Silas, they decided to praise the Lord in the middle of the night. As they praised God, the Bible says, “The prison was shaken to its foundations. All the doors immediately flew open, and the chains of every prisoner fell off!” (Acts 16:26 NLT). Oh, glory to God…
There is the activation and the working of God’s power when we praise the Lord.
Beloved, Jesus is the King and the LORD who is God; PRAISE HIM WITH THE GLADNESS OF HEART! Hallelujahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F2ptPfOwsCA&t=12sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 71:8; Colossians 3:16; Psalm 28:7; Psalm 24:8-10; Exodus 15:2; Psalm 100:1-3; Daniel 2:23) WE PRAYFather, we thank you for who you are to us, your manifested presence and the mighty workings of Grace in our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Timothy 3 - 4Titus 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is full of thanksgiving. – I cannot be discouraged – The Lord is my King and I rejoice over Him daily. – My tongue is full of praise in all I do. – Oh thank you, Jesus, Thank you, Jesus. – I praise the Lord for His loving kindness. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 673 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 22 – PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you pray for a higher dimension of glory, God directs you to His word. For the entrance of the Word of God in your heart, is the entrance of a dimension of the light of the glory of God. Keep beholding the revelation of Jesus through His Word. Author Tuesday, 26th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 22 – PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 3"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Indisputably, there are many voices in this world. Even the voice of darkness has created multiple channels to reach your heart. To rightly know or perceive the voice of God, you must also understand the voice of the flesh which speaks of self-gratification. And also the voice of the adversary which condemns, deceives and opposes the counsel of the Lord.
To differentiate between God's voice from other voices, you must understand the character and nature of God.
God's character and nature are the key characteristics of His voice and are embedded in His word. Let me ask you a simple question: How did you know the voice of your biological parents? Whiles walking home, you suddenly hear a voice without seeing the person. With excitement you shout your favorite uncle's name. And as you entered, truly he was the one in the house speaking to your parents. Until you know your uncle and have spent time with him, you won't be able to identify his voice. To know or perceive God's voice you must consistently fellowship with the scriptures and also commune with Him in prayer. The speaking of God in your heart is through the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit will only speak what God says. - The voice of the Lord is precise and peaceful.When God speaks to you, it is with the exactitude of His Word to your heart. There is no ambiguity in God's voice. God communicates with clarity and all that He says crystallizes your heart. As you can see from the opening verse: "I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints..." Psalm 85:8 (NKJV). God is not an author of confusion but peace (1 Corinthians 14:33). Most people claim to be "confused" not because they don't know it is God who's speaking to them. What they claim to be their confusion, is mainly about their willingness to respond by obedience of faith or to reject what God is saying.  The struggle is not really if what you are hearing is the voice of the Lord. The struggle is whether you should follow the voice of your desires. What God says wouldn't ever agree with your self-gratification. 
God's voice doesn't affirm your carnality.
And the carnal mind is against God (Romans 8:5-8). The beautiful thing is this, the more you act in the obedience of God's voice, the more you gain mastery in knowing the voice of the Lord. The more you act contrary to what God is saying, the more you live in confusion or struggle to respond to His voice. There are times when the Lord is saying and the direction He is leading you doesn't look peaceful. But as long as it is consistent with His word, continue to trust Him. It will bring you to a prosperous and peaceful destination. - The voice of the Lord is powerfully active and penetrates the heart.Whenever God speaks, His word invades, penetrates and cuts deep in your heart. God's word doesn't massage situations, neither is it sentimental. His words are as double-edged sword which cuts the heart. 
What God says is what His word says.
"For we have the living Word of God, which is full of energy, and it pierces more sharply than a two-edged sword. It will even penetrate to the very core of our being where soul and spirit, bone and marrow meet! It interprets and reveals the true thoughts and secret motives of our hearts" Hebrews 4:12 (TPT) The disciples of Jesus affirmed that when Jesus spoke to them (on the Road to Emmaus) their hearts burned. "Back and forth they talked. “Didn’t we feel on fire as he conversed with us on the road, as he opened up the Scriptures for us?” Luke 24:32 (Message Translation)
The speaking of God causes the heart to burn, and it exposes the deep intents of the heart and the soul.
Oh, glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhAY-KMCcs0DIG DEEPER(John 10:1-17; John 16:13; John 14:26) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall have the right attitude of the obedience of faith as we hear the voice of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Titus 2 - 3Philemon  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am obedient to the voice of God. - I don't follow the desires of the flesh. - I have the right attitude of the obedience of faith. - I am yielded to the will of God. - The word of God is God's active voice to me today. Thank you Lord for the gift of your word! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 674 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 23 – PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Maintain a company of friends who inspire you with the vision of God and direct your passion towards the Lord. Friends who overwhelm you with wise counsel of the Lord are treasures. Beloved, be mindful of the company you keep. Selah. Author Wednesday, 27th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 23 – PERCEIVING GOD'S VOICE 4"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Through our daily communion with God (in prayer and meditation of His Word), we develop the mastery to know or perceive the voice of the Lord.Though the ability to perceive or distinguish the voice of the Lord from the other voices is built through consistent communion or fellowship with God, there are some pointers that will help you grow in the certainty of the Lord's voice.In the previous episode, I mentioned two of these pointers.- The voice of the Lord is precise and peaceful.- The voice of the Lord is powerfully active and penetrates the heart.Now you must also know that:- The voice of the Lord is steadily consistent with the scriptures.This cannot be overemphasized, and I have mentioned it a couple of times in this series.
No revelation trumps the authority, relevance, and authenticity of the scriptures.
- Though the voice of the Lord convicts hearts, it doesn't produce terror, fear and condemnation. It is the adversary who uses fear as a weapon."But the fact of the matter is that it is best for you that I go away, for if I don’t, the Comforter won’t come. If I do, he will—for I will send him to you. “And when he has come he will convince the world of its sin, and of the availability of God’s goodness, and of deliverance from judgment." John 16:7-8 (TLB)
 The Holy Spirit is God's voice in your heart and the word of God is the texture of the Voice.
- The voice of the Lord is not passive but action-oriented."I advise you to obey only the Holy Spirit’s instructions. He will tell you where to go and what to do, and then you won’t always be doing the wrong things your evil nature wants you to." Galatians 5:16 (TLB).Whenever the Holy Spirit speaks, He supplies direction. The voice of the Lord doesn't guess. It is precise and shows you what to do. It doesn't leave you with an option to do wrong. It is emphatic on the right thing. The adversary will not discourage you from going to visit the wrong website. The voice of the Lord is what prompts you to run from sexual sins.Your role is to obey the Lord's voice.
It is the voice of the Lord that prompts you from staying away from a fight or quarrel.
The voice of the Lord directs you in the way to go. It commands you to take the right action."and whenever you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.” Isaiah 30:21 (Holman Christian Standard Bible).Beloved, as men could depend on the global positioning system (GPS) for direction and the route to take, God has introduced us to a rich intimate relationship with Him through Christ.
As you hear the voice of the Lord, harden not your heart.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tctAZHZw6_QDIG DEEPER(John 10:1-17; John 16:13; John 14:26) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the confidence and consciousness of the daily speaking of God to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hebrews 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am obedient to the voice of God. – I don’t give heed to the voice of the flesh. – I grow in the confidence and consciousness of the daily speaking of God to me. – I am yielded to the will of God. – The word of God is God’s active voice to me today. Thank you Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 675 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 24 – THE VOICE OF GOD Versus YOUR IMAGINATION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It will amaze you to know that the craving of your flesh travels through the impressions of your emotions. Your flesh uses the force of the desires hewn from your emotions to influence your actions. Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires. Selah. Author Thursday, 28th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 24 –THE VOICE OF GOD Versus YOUR IMAGINATION 1"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)To grasp the details of this discussion, you have to patiently go through all the parts of this series.I have given some clues to help you perceive God's voice. But you must understand that these are not necessarily formulas or scientific methods for hearing God's voice.The most proven way to know the voice of the Lord is your intimacy with the Lord and the practice of responding to what you hear. One more thing I should add, FAITH. The believer lives and acts by faith. 
Nothing is done outside of faith and faith is cultivated through the administration of the Word of God.
As part of hearing God's Voice, one important question we have to answer is the difference between the voice of God and your imagination.There are times when people hear the Lord and also begin to wonder if it was just their imagination or not.The voice of God in your heart is the voice of the Holy Spirit.The Bible did not replace the voice of God in our lives. The Bible is the revelation and articulation of God's thoughts and intentions to mankind. The scriptures or the Bible is the constitution of divine thoughts. The voice of the Lord does not disagree with the scriptures. I have firmly established this throughout this series.
Whatever, the Holy Spirit will say to you reflects the character and nature of God as revealed in the scriptures.
For example:The Holy Spirit will not tell you to destroy someone's life; because that is not in the character and nature of God. God does not destroy lives, He builds lives.The Holy Spirit will not tell us not to forgive and not to show kindness. God is kind and forgives. He is love.God's voice will always lead you to love and serve others. It doesn't make you self-centered.Clearly, you can tell that, there are times you find yourself imagining evil and destruction. That can't be God speaking to you.Throughout this discussion "Hearing God's Voice", I have clearly explained what the voice of the Lord is; now to have a proper understanding of the answer to this question, we must first answer the question:What is IMAGINATION?In a general sense, it is the ability to form a mental image of something not present to the senses or never before wholly perceived in human development. It is the conception of an idea.
It is the capacity to creatively formulate concepts with unique representations in the mind.
Imagination is a powerful matter in human existence. Whatever mankind had ever experienced from antiquity to the present civilisation came through an imagination.Imagination is not necessarily evil. Imagination is a powerful tool of the mind. A person's imagination is highly influenced by the things, situations, experiences or thoughts which shape the mind.Imagination is an activity of a person's mind. 
God proves and deals with people based on their own imagination.
"And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever". 1 Chronicles 28:9 (KJV)In the verse above you will find three words:Heart, Imagination and Thoughts.These words are related and have a lot to do with IMAGINATION.1. The heart in the verse is "lêb" in Hebrew which speaks of the will and the intellect; the centre or the core of your being and the mind. It speaks of the part of a person's being where imagination finds expressions.2. Imagination in the verse in Hebrew is "yêtser", which means "conception" or "to purpose": "to frame a thing, imagination or mind work".3. Thought in the verse is also, "machăshâbâh", in Hebrew, which means, a "contrivance", it is the same word for a texture machine or intentional plan a plot, to device or a good or evil advice; a cunning work, imagination, means, purpose or thought.These words are similar and related in their meanings. Especially yêtser and machăshâbâh. They all give detailed pictures and an extensive view of the word IMAGINATION.God didn't give man the ability to imagine just to plotting or device evil. 
He gave man the ability of imagination, to re-echo His eternal intention and work through all creation, for the continuous growth and expression of His Life.
The imagination of man was never designed to be a device for evil.Imagination is like a texture machine. It operates to design patterns according to how it has been programmed. When God made man in His own image and after His likeness. The goal was for man to multiply and replenish the earth according to His original patented design.But through the deception of the adversary, man turned away from his originality or identity. He re-oriented himself and lost the touch of the heavenly pattern. Man now developed the ability to conceptualize ideas which are generated by deception.This is why there is a struggle between the voice of God and the imagination of man.  
Man's imagination was to resound the intentions of God.
Selah.DIG DEEPER(John 10:1-17; John 16:13; John 14:26;  Genesis 6:5-6; Ephesians 4:22-24; 2 Corinthians 10:5; Luke 12:12) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds, thoughts, hearts, and intentions will be influenced by the light of God's word so that we shall devise thoughts which are consistent with God's thoughts. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hebrews 4 - 6  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My mind, heart, and intentions are influenced by the light of God's word. - My thoughts are consistent with God's thoughts. - My imaginations resound the thought of God. - I don't struggle to recognize the voice of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 676 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 25 – THE VOICE OF GOD Versus YOUR IMAGINATION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved as long as you are in Christ and you stand for the name of the Lord, you will be opposed. You will not be loved by this world. You will be mocked and be told the Church has taken all your time or you’re wasting your time with this Jesus thing. It is not new. Therefore beloved, be driven by the desire of the LORD. Selah! Author Friday, 29th November, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 23 – THE VOICE OF GOD Versus YOUR IMAGINATION 2"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV) By God's work in man, there shouldn't have been a struggle between the voice of the Lord and man's imagination. "God created mankind in His own image, in the image of God He created them; male and female He created them" (Genesis 1:27). God designed man to become His expression. There is no way man can express God without his inward essence and thoughts, reflecting God's thoughts, intentions and essence.
Man's imagination was to mirror the imprints of God's intentions.
The adversary understood the power of man's imagination. He knew that anything man would do had much to do with his imagination. He could not corrupt God's work in man without first changing man's identity consciousness or image of self. The expansiveness of your imagination is built on the consciousness of your identity. The moment you lose the truth of your identity, you will develop the wrong imagination of yourself and your environment. So he said to the woman through the serpent: "And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil." Genesis 3:4-5 (KJV) Ye shall be as gods...? Why would they fall for this deception? God made them in His image! They were given the ability to replenish, subdue, and rule the earth, thus, they were made to be the kings or governors of the earth. The corruption of man's spirit began with how they allowed their minds to be reshaped through the deception of the adversary. Man was now able to imagine wrongly because of the identity crisis the adversary succeeded in creating in him. When your imagination becomes corrupt your action will be corrupt. The thing is, imagination is a prelude to action. Man's imagination was corrupted and he developed the inclination to do evil and to only fabricate an action for self-gratification.
Until a person becomes born again, his imagination is not able to perfectly transmit divine thoughts. 
His mind rejects the thoughts of God, and he sets himself as an enmity of God. The Psalmist asked: "Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?" Psalms 2:1 (KJV) The Hebrew word translated as "imagine" in the verse is, "hâgâh". We know the word to mean "meditate" or to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication to ponder, (mutter, roar, sore, speak, study, talk, utter). "Hâgâh" explains some key items of imagination. To first create a mental picture, one has to ponder and brood over a thought till it becomes irresistibly tangible in the mind. Then it generates a corresponding action for an expected outcome. From the second Psalm, you will see that the nations imagined or plotted a vain thing because of the corruption of their minds. Their inclined mind influenced their decision and action. Which was a demonstration of the enmity towards God and His Kingdom (Psalm 2:1-3).
However, when a person becomes born again, the Newness of life and the ability of God which is transfused into him begin to create the need to accept and to mirror God's thoughts and intentions.
Now this is God's message to the saints in Christ: "Since you have heard about Jesus and have learned the truth that comes from him, throw off your old sinful nature and your former way of life, which is corrupted by lust and deception. Instead, let the Spirit renew your thoughts and attitudes." Ephesians 4:22-23 (NLT) The born-again must submit his mind and thoughts to be renewed by the Spirit of the Lord and the revelation of the Scriptures. When your mind is renewed by the word of God, your imagination will not become a hindrance to what God is saying to you. A mind shaped by the Word of God becomes a pathway for the voice of the Lord. Selah. DIG DEEPER(John 10:1-17; John 16:13; John 14:26;  Genesis 6:5-6; Romans 12:1-2; 2 Corinthians 10:5; Luke 12:12) WE PRAYWe submit our minds and thoughts to the word of God so that we shall be renewed in the spirits of our minds. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hebrews 7 - 9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My mind, heart, and intentions are influenced by the light of God’s word. – My thoughts are consistent with God’s thoughts. – My imaginations resound the thought of God. – I don’t struggle to recognize the voice of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 677 - TAKE MORE GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t just live normal as everyone. Don’t be satisfied with the level you are in your relationship with Jesus. Avoid double-mindedness! Set your eyes on Jesus and crave more for the sweet intimacy with Jesus. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 20th July, 2024TAKE MORE GRACE“So now we come freely and boldly to where love is enthroned, to receive mercy’s kiss and discover the grace we urgently need to strengthen us in our time of weakness.” Hebrews 4:16 (TPT) You will always need God in all situations, for any assignment He will give you.The assignments of the Lord will require more than your human intelligence, strength and resources.
The Heavenly mandate or vision will require Heavenly provision.
This is why God gives more Grace.To receive more and more of the grace which God supplies you must:1. Exercise faith. It takes faith to receive the Grace of our Lord Jesus.2. Be Humble. God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble. Until you submit to the Lord, you have not permitted His supply to flow to you.3. Draw near to God through Prayer.This is the third item I would like to bring to your attention.Before you conclude that we are already in God as believers in Christ and don’t need to draw near to Him, take your time to glean from this perspective.Indeed, we have already been drawn into God through Christ, however, we can continue to journey deeper and deeper into God.
By Christ’s finished work through His death and resurrection, all who were afar off are now brought near to God.
“But now [at this very moment] in Christ Jesus you who once were [so very] far away [from God] have been brought near by the blood of Christ.” Ephesians 2:13 (Amplified Bible)This is glorious news.We are not strangers to God. We belong to God and are part of Him. Through the blood of Jesus, we have free access to God. Now we have fellowship with the Father. We are no longer as they who were of the Old Covenant, for through Christ’s obedience, we have been drawn into God. We can confidently enjoy communion with the Lord without any sense of condemnation.
Irrespective of this access the believer has in God, it doesn’t automatically translate into MORE AND MORE GRACE.
For example:Having access to a free restaurant doesn’t mean you will be satisfied automatically. You can enter the restaurant, take your seat, gist with the Chief restaurant and still not be full.You must intentionally place your order, and then eat your meal before you will be satisfied.
The Lord has brought us into Himself, where grace is enthroned. Yet you must intentionally take grace.
This is why most believers in Christ still remain helpless and weak. They think being born again grants them automatic enjoyment of Grace. Being born again, gives you free access to grace, however, to enjoy the grace you must receive it.Prayer is a means of Grace.
Prayer is the confident enjoyment of your access to God, through communion and communication with God.
You have been drawn into God, however, until you draw near in prayer to take grace you will not receive more and more grace.The more you exercise confidence of faith through prayer, the more grace you receive.
Prayer is both the means of asking and the means of creating.
In time of need, what you must receive is more grace for that specific need.Take note of what the Psalmist said:“Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; listen to my plea for grace.” Psalm 86:6 (ESV).See the verse 5 of this Psalm in the Passion Translation:“Lord, you are so good to me, so kind in every way and ready to forgive, for your grace-fountain keeps overflowing, drenching all your lovers who pray to you.” Psalm 86:5 (TPT)Oh, glory to God.
The Grace of God shall drench, wet thoroughly, or soak and saturate those who pray.
When you seem to be limited in Grace, observe not only your faith and humility. Observe your consistency in prayer.
Little prayer, little grace; more prayer, more grace
It is through prayer you cast all your cares to the Lord for He cares for you (1 Peter 5:7).And to even be consistent in prayer is the evidence of humility. When God’s people humble themselves they pray to Him (2 Chronicles 7:14).“You do not have because you do not ask God.” (James 4:2)Beloved stay up long in prayer!Shalom! DIG DEEPER(Matthew 7:7,11;  Habakkuk 3:19; Philippians 4:13,19; Psalm 84:11; Psalm 34:9-10) WE PRAYWe pray that:1. We shall increase in desire to pray and be obedient to the prompting of the Holy Spirit to pray consistently irrespective of the hindrances.2. The Lord shall send us a great abundance of grace (the favor, and all resources needed) to achieve His plans and purpose in our generation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hebrews 10 - 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I submit to the Lord in prayer.— I am consistent in prayer—  I take more and more grace through prayer.— MORE grace is supplied to me as I pray.— I have the discipline to pray consistently— I esteem the place of prayer in my daily life.Oh glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 678 - WALK IN THE PERFECTION OF LOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your identity as a child of God is the reality of your testimony that you have overcome the world. Your identity as a child of God is his threat. Beloved walk in the confidence of who you are in Christ Jesus. Author Sunday, 1st, December, 2024WALK IN THE PERFECTION OF LOVE“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) In as much as your growth in the Lord or maturity in the spirit is your responsibility, you don’t do it alone. You don’t create the things you need for your growth. The Lord supplies you with what you need, and you put them to work.
The greatest evidence of your growth in Christ is how you walk in the LOVE OF GOD. 
The difference between the mature and immature is not just in the tongues they speak, the scriptures they quote and the gifts of the spirit they demonstrate. The difference between the mature and immature is in the level of love they demonstrate. Meanwhile, the Love of God is shared abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5). This means you did not generate the Love of God, it was worked into you by the Lord Himself.
LOVE IS THE GREATEST FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT! (1 Corinthians 13:13)
We see the FRUIT of the spirit in Galatians 5:22-23 : “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law.” (ESV) The above verses show nine graces of the Spirit. However, the verse says FRUIT, not FRUITS. The same Greek word, “KARPOS,” is used for both the singular FRUIT (Galatians 5:22; James 3:18) and the plural FRUITS (Matthew 7:16, 20 and Philippians 1:11). We see nine graces mentioned, so why are they referred to as FRUIT? This is because these nine graces are collective singular. They can all be put into one great expression of the Spirit, which is LOVE.
“BUT THE FRUIT OF THE SPIRIT IS LOVE…”
The amplitude of love is demonstrated through the eight other graces. No tree produces different kinds of fruits. Each tree produces a specific kind of fruit. An apple tree only produces apple fruit. Though it may have more than one of its kind on the same tree.  Love is that unique fruit of the Spirit, though it may have different expressions. The Passion Translation reveals it clearly: “But the fruit produced by the Holy Spirit within you is divine love in all its varied expressions: joy that overflows, peace that subdues, patience that endures, kindness in action, a life full of virtue, faith that prevails, gentleness of heart, and strength of spirit. Never set the law above these qualities, for they are meant to be limitless.”
When you begin to walk in the fullness of the Love of God, the self doesn’t have expression. 
This means the eight other graces are tangible realities of LOVE AT WORK. When the LOVE of God finds expression, there is no need for the demand of the law of Moses (Romans 13:8-10). WALK IN THE PERFECTION OF LOVE, FOR IT IS THE PROOF OF YOUR MATURITY. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Romans 13:8-10; Matthew 22:37-40; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2) WE PRAYThat this divine love of God will find its full expression in and through us BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Hebrews 13James 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I demonstrate love in all things. – The love of God gains full expression through me by the day. – I commit myself daily to the study of scriptures. – I fellowship with the Holy Spirit daily. – The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 679 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 26 – THE VOICE OF GOD Versus YOUR IMAGINATION 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It may seem you have had many shortcomings and your life has not been up to the standards or your best. Everyone may expect the worst to happen to you, but God, who is merciful, will be merciful to you. Receive God’s mercy today! Author Monday, 2nd December, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 26 – THE VOICE OF GOD Versus YOUR IMAGINATION 3"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)From the point I have made through this discussion, you will understand that a person's imagination can be a channel or conduit of the Voice of God or it can also be a limitation of the voice of the Lord.When a person is born again, submits his mind to the training of the word of God, and is continuously renewed in the mind, his imagination becomes consistent with God's thoughts.
When your imagination is fully influenced and developed by the word of God, it can perfectly transmit divine thoughts.
Such a mind does not reject the thoughts of God but rather rejects the thoughts of deception."Since you have heard about Jesus and have learned the truth that comes from him, throw off your old sinful nature and your former way of life, which is corrupted by lust and deception. Instead, let the Spirit renew your thoughts and attitudes." Ephesians 4:22-23 (NLT)The more you spend time daily to have intimate communion with the Lord, your mind is cultured and programmed to acknowledge the rhythm of God's speaking. Within the frame of your imagination, you are able to determine which frequency of thoughts or portraits of ideas are of God and the ones that are not of God, because of the richness of the Word of God in you.The point basically is this, God speaks to you through several proven mediums, but primarily through His word. One of these other proven mediums is your shaped mind, which is your imagination.
When your mind is renewed you can rightly discern the voice of the flesh from the voice of the Lord through your imagination.
The voice of the flesh is the communication of your selfish desires or physical feelings. The voice of the flesh makes you do what pleases or fulfill your gratification.Your wrong actions come from the imagination of your heart.God doesn't put any wrong desire in a person's heart."Don’t let anyone under pressure to give in to evil say, “God is trying to trip me up.” God is impervious to evil, and puts evil in no one’s way. The temptation to give in to evil comes from us and only us. We have no one to blame but the leering, seducing flare-up of our own lust. Lust gets pregnant, and has a baby: sin! Sin grows up to adulthood, and becomes a real killer." James 1:13-15 (Message Bible).
Through your thoughts, you conceive evil desires before it manifests as sin.
Read the verse in the Easy English Bible:"It is our own thoughts that make us do bad things. When we want to do something wrong, our thoughts lead us in a bad way. We may agree to do what our bad thoughts tell us to do. When we do that, it becomes a sin. Then, we may not stop doing those bad things. If we continue to live like that, the result of our sins is death" James 1:14-15.Now when your mind is renewed such thoughts can be pulled down by the revelation of the word of God."Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (KJV)The word for imagination in Greek is, "logismos" which means the computation of reason or a conceit. Any reasoning of the mind which is not consistent with the knowledge of God must be cast down or pulled down. This is not done gently but violently. The Greek word is "katheireō", which means to demolish something violently.Your imagination must be the pathway for God's thoughts and communication. Don't give room for any wrong imagery to have a pass in your imagination. You have to crush those thoughts before they take root.
Let your imagination mirror inspirations transmitted to your heart through the speaking of the Holy Spirit in your heart, and the communication of the Word of God.
This is a beautiful thing about your renewed mind through the Word:You are transformed into the image of God in Christ and you are able to discern the perfect will of God. (Romans 12:2)Selah. DIG DEEPER(John 10:1-17; John 16:13; John 14:26;  Genesis 6:5-6;  Luke 12:12; Proverbs 4:23; Psalm.139:23-24; Psalm 19:14; Isaiah 26:4) WE PRAYWe pray that thoughts which are not consistent will not have a place to germinate in our hearts, but our minds will be fully renewed and dominated by the knowledge of God in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024James 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My thoughts are fully dominated by the knowledge of God in Christ. - I think on the word daily. - I don't give room for any wrong imagery to have a pass in your imagination. - Evil has no place in my mind. - My mind is a sacred place. - I think on the right things. - My mind is a haven of divine ideas. Thank you, Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 680 - HEARING GOD'S VOICE 27 – GOD SPEAKS THROUGH MEN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It is not normal to keep having “ups” and “downs”. You can have your whole life flooded with peace and prosperity. You can have a life full of progress and fruitfulness. What you accept as your revelation becomes the definition of your estate. Refuse stagnation, refuse failure, refuse unfruitfulness. Shalom! Author Tuesday, 3rd December, 2024 HEARING GOD'S VOICE 27 – GOD SPEAKS THROUGH MEN"I will hear what God the LORD will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly" Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)Spiritual things are not just practised. One must patiently understand a subject before one can experience the best of it. 
Until you grow in understanding of a matter, the adversary will always use deceptive means to create uncertainty in your heart. 
That is why I thought through some of the questions the adversary poses to believers to distract their conviction on a subject.Sometimes before the adversary leads you into deception, he puts questions in your heart. As he did in Eden, he asked through the serpent, "hath God said, ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?"Now, if the devil can succeed at making you feel or think God doesn't speak to believers today, he can leverage on that to lead you astray. When you start thinking you can't hear the voice of God, or you cannot distinguish God's voice, when God even speaks to you, you will have doubts and won't be able to respond right to it.From the things I have shared with you so far, you must have the conviction and understanding of God's speaking.I have answered questions such as:- How do I hear the voice of God?- Does God still speak to Christians apart from the canonized Bible?- How does God speak to men?- Does God speak to all men (the good people and the evil people)? Does he speak to unbelievers also?- Is there really a voice of God or it’s a mere human hypothesis?- Which mediums does God use to speak to His people?- What is the texture of the Voice of God?- What is the difference between the voice of God and my imagination?- Are there other voices apart from the voice of God?- How do I distinguish God’s voice from other voices, if there are?Now these are genuine questions. Also if you have more questions to ask or follow-up questions concerning hearing God's voice, send a mail or post it in the comment space.Now let me touch on these two questions as well:- If God has given me a Pastor why do I need to hear His voice? - If God speaks to me why do I need a Pastor to teach me the Word?These questions may sound the same but are distinctive. They are like the two sides of the same coin.
God speaks to you to prove His personal relationship with you. And also speaks to you through a spiritual leader or one who has spiritual authority over you to train you.
There are some who ignorantly argue that in this New Testament era, God doesn't speak to people through men. He only spoke to kings and people through prophets.This is far from what the scriptures teach. In Paul's conversion experience on his way to Damascus, Jesus spoke to him directly and later instructed Ananias to speak to him."And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
