And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do." Acts 9:4-6 (KJV)Later the Lord spoke to Ananias to go to Saul:"And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord. And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth, And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight....And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost." Acts 9:10-12,17 (KJV)Let's look at another example:Peter and Cornelius:The Lord spoke to Cornelius to send for Peter, who will tell him things by which he shall be saved.God could have spoken those words to Cornelius directly but chose to communicate the gospel through Peter (Acts 10:1-48)Look at Peter's instruction on his first epistle:"Every believer has received grace gifts, so use them to serve one another as faithful stewards of the many-colored tapestry of God’s grace. For example, if you have a speaking gift, speak as though God were speaking his words through you. If you have the gift of serving, do it passionately with the strength God gives you, so that in everything God alone will be glorified through Jesus Christ. For to him belong the power and the glory forever throughout all ages! Amen." 1 Peter 4:10-11 (TPT).God gives people utterance to speak His words to encourage, instruct, build and equip the saints.There are times when the word of God spoken through others to you serves as a confirmation of the things the Lord is saying to you.God speaks to you directly through the Holy Spirit and speaks to you through your spiritual leaders and also other fellow saints.
Remember there is no speaking of God which is not consistent with the revelation of the word of God.
Selah!DIG DEEPER( 2 Peter 1:21; Acts 2:17; 1 Corinthians 14:29; Luke 12:12; Hebrews 1:1-2; Hebrews 13:17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be humble to hear God's speaking through the people He put in our lives.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Peter 1 - 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I hear God through the men He has sent into my life. – I do not harden my heart to the voice of God through my man of God and fellow saints. – I judge every prophecy or instruction given to me by the word of God. – My mind is focused on the word of God. Thank you, Lord for the gift of your word![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 681 - NAVIGATING FAITH DURING ELECTION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Can you continue to serve God’s purpose even when people offend you, falsely accuse you, attack your integrity, blackmail you, humiliate you, persecute you, seek your death, criticize you, insult you, gossip about you and hate you? By your strength, you may not be able to fulfill God’s purpose amidst such challenges. But by the strengthening of the Lord, you can face and prevail in all challenges. To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace. Shalom! Author Wednesday, 4th December, 2024 NAVIGATING FAITH DURING ELECTION 1"Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you." Deuteronomy 1:13 (KJV)One crucial matter that affects the trajectory of a people and cannot be ignored is leadership. Who leads you can affect how things happen around you.As believers, we are not of this world, yet we are in the world. (John 17:16) Because you are in the world, you must be concerned about what happens in the world. 
Don't become passive about what is happening around you.
It matters who is leading your constituency, province, city, region, state, country or nation.Leadership has a lot to do with the direction of a people. There are some believers who seem to be passive when it comes to the political leadership of their country. They are of the opinion that all politicians are the same. They describe all politicians as selfish, deceptive, corrupt and godless. In as much as this may be factual on some fronts, it is subjective. Not all go into politics to satisfy their selfish interest. No matter how corrupt the world is, God has His people in the world. And you are one of them.Some don't think democracy is needed at all. No matter which political system or ideology you support, think of what better serves the people within a landscape. Not every society will thrive under the same political system, and all political systems have weaknesses.
Democracy is not entirely wrong. It began with the idea of giving a voice to all people.
In ancient Athens, there was a man named Cleisthenes who was from an Aristocratic family and served as a chief archon or magistrate. He initiated a revolutionary idea called "demokratia" to give a voice or ruling power to the people. Though this concept hit the runway or was introduced by Solon (known as the champion of the people in ancient Athens), Cleisthenes developed and enforced it, thus becoming the father of democracy. In ancient times, Greek nations were ruled and controlled by Aristocrats. However, Cleisthenes realized he could amass greater power to serve his people by giving voice to the people. He aligned himself with the population against the nobles to enforce a democratic reformation.Though democracy has evolved into several concepts and different models, the idea remains – power to the people. However, the democratic concept still maintained the need for the appointment of specific people to help in the leadership of the city or the people. Definitely, every human institution may have its weaknesses and disadvantages. One major means by which the people can express their power is through the election of leaders and referendum.The people have the power to appoint who should lead them. And this gives an opportunity for those within such a democratic political system to appreciate what it means for all men to submit one to another.Certainly, God's Kingdom operates by a higher system of government. God's kingdom government operates with no error because it is built on His person, nature and principles. God is Righteous, Love and Just."Your kingdom is founded on righteousness and justice; love and faithfulness are shown in all you do." Psalm 89:14 (GNT)However, the governing systems of men will have weaknesses because they run on the frailty of human wisdom. 
For that reason as a believer, you cannot set your hope on the political systems of this world. We belong to and operate by the kingdom of God.
The beautiful thing about the operation of God's kingdom is that it finds expressions of influence in every political or governmental space. The believer who understands the righteousness of God, the love of God, His wisdom and justice cannot be limited by any political structure, reformation or revolution.As representatives of God's kingdom within a frail political space, we must not sit on the fence but must circumspectly navigate the faith and wisdom of the Kingdom of God in this world.Believers must not be quiet on the appointment of political leaders within a nation. As long as you are constitutionally eligible, exercise your right to determine who leads in your country."In the exultation of the just, there is great glory. When the impious reign, men are brought to ruin." (Proverbs 28:12)It is not evil for a believer to vote for who they believe will help their community, city, region, state or country.
If there is anyone who has the ability to make the right choice which will help others, it should be the believer in Christ.
It is expected that a believer will not make a choice out of selfishness, personal interest, or bitterness. But should make leadership choices and decisions according to the wisdom and love of God at work in him.A believer in Christ has the responsibility to pray for the authorities within his or her country, nation or city so that there will be tranquillity. (1 Timothy 2:1-4).If the scriptures encourage us to pray for political leaders, it will not discourage us from participating in the appointment of political leaders.
In a period of election, believers must pray for the citizens to vote for the right leaders with discernment.
Demonstrate faith for peace in your country or state through prayers and exercising your franchise to vote.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 29:2; Proverbs 11:10; Romans 13:1-8; Titus 3:1-11) WE PRAY We pray the hearts of the people shall be directed right (even more during their season of political election) to choose leaders who will not hinder the gospel of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024I Peter 4 - 52 Peter 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am not passive about the happenings around me. - I refuse to set my hope on any political system. - I belong to and operate by the Kingdom of God. - I demonstrate my faith in peace in this season through prayers. - Thank you Lord Jesus for the peace that you have given to my country (mention it by name).- Thank you Lord for rightly directing the hearts of men to choose leaders who will not hinder the gospel of Jesus.  Oh Gloreeeey!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 682 - NAVIGATING FAITH DURING ELECTION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The assignment of the Lord is not as easy and pleasant as it seems on the outside. It’s a war! This is why you must be strengthened at all times by the Lord. There are times you will stand alone without any support from friends, families and even from your co-labourers in the ministry. There are times when you are sent to the field, you will face challenges and the only help you have is the Lord. To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace. Author Thursday, 5th December, 2024 NAVIGATING FAITH DURING ELECTION 2"Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you." Deuteronomy 1:13 (KJV)The idea that we are not of this world, doesn't mean, we have no citizenship in this physical world.
To not be of this world is not to think and live a life controlled or subdued by the world's ideologies, concepts, cultures and reasoning patterns.
"Stop imitating the ideals and opinions of the culture around you, but be inwardly transformed by the Holy Spirit through a total reformation of how you think. This will empower you to discern God’s will as you live a beautiful life, satisfying and perfect in his eyes." Romans 12:2 (TPT)You are of God (1 John 4:4) and you don't have to adjust to or fit into the ideals and culture around you without even thinking.As a believer, your citizenship is in Heaven (Philippians 3:20), through the new birth in Christ. That is where you belong.However, you also have citizenship in this physical world. Your spiritual identity doesn't nullify the idea that you belong to a physical family, a tribe, a country, or a nation. God has planted you in the family you are or the tribe and nation just so that you will be the representation of His Kingdom.Paul (the apostle of Jesus) knew he was of the household of God (Ephesians 2:19); yet, his Heavenly citizenship didn't make him deny his Earthly citizenship.Though in Philippians 3, Paul emphasized Christ's preeminence above his physical and religious identity, he didn't deny his physical citizenship."I was circumcised when I was eight days old. I am a pure-blooded citizen of Israel and a member of the tribe of Benjamin..." Philippians 3:5 (NLT).The believer in Christ has an automatic dual citizenship. You are both a citizen of Heaven by spiritual birth and a citizen of the country you were physically born into.
You have the right to exercise your citizenship at any given time.
Paul acknowledges that he is a citizen of heaven (Philippians 3:20) and doesn't only boast of his citizenship as an Israelite (Philippians 3:5). He also exercised his Roman citizenship right when he was arrested and beaten."While the crowd was screaming and yelling, removing their outer garments, and throwing handfuls of dust in the air in protest, the commander had Paul brought back into the compound. He ordered that he be whipped with a lash and interrogated to find out what he said that so infuriated the crowd. When the soldiers stretched Paul out with ropes, he said to the captain, who was standing nearby, “Is it legal for you to torture a Roman citizen like this, without a proper trial?”When the officer heard this, he immediately went to his commander and reported it, saying, “This man is a Roman citizen. What should we do now?” The commander came to Paul and asked him, “Tell me the truth, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes I am,” he replied.  The commander said, “I had to purchase my citizenship with a great sum of money.” Paul replied, “I was born as a citizen!”  Acts 22:23-28 (TPT)Did you see that?
Don't give up your citizenship rights just because you are a citizen of Heaven.
Paul knew that a Roman citizen must not be punished without a fair trial because it would have consequences.His Roman citizenship right spared him some additional time to preach the gospel."All of the soldiers who were about to whip Paul backed away, because they were afraid of the consequences for tying up and holding a Roman citizen against his will." Acts 22:29 (TPT).Why didn't Paul say that he is not of this world, therefore they should do whatever they want to him?Because he knew his rights and didn't want to go through that punishment at that time, he exercised his rights as a Roman citizen.For example, many believers with their genuine choice of who to vote for have been quiet and allowed ungodly men to make decisions for them. I am not saying whoever you are going to choose or vote for will be the savior of your country. But whoever you choose to lead must be someone who will help the country with policies which wouldn't affect the kingdom's agenda. 
The decision to choose who to vote for should not be about religious affiliation or political affiliation but a decision based on the wisdom of God in your heart and personal conviction.
Since you are of the faith, your decision to exercise your citizenship right to vote is not carnality. Instead, such decisions and prayers will help the affairs of the country where you belong.Those who are born of God must take a stand to help the countries they belong. The people of the Kingdom are the best people to appoint leaders for their countries.Remain Peaceful in your decisions.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zwTiogewnADIG DEEPER(Proverbs 29:2; Proverbs 11:10; Romans 13:1-8; Titus 3:1-11) WE PRAYWe pray that people will not abuse their citizenship right of exercising their franchise to vote, but will apply the wisdom of God in their citizenship right. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Peter 2 - 31 John 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not passive about the happenings around me. – I refuse to set my hope on any political system. – I belong to and operate by the Kingdom of God. – I demonstrate my faith in peace in this season through prayers. – Thank you Lord Jesus for the peace that you have given to my country (mention it by name).– Thank you Lord for rightly directing the hearts of men to choose leaders who will not hinder the gospel of Jesus. Oh Gloreeeey!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 683 - NAVIGATING FAITH DURING ELECTION 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Just as Christ died for you and gave you His forgiveness, He also died and has forgiven the worst of all sinners. This is to say that, as you have received the grace of our Lord Jesus, be gracious to one another as He is gracious unto you. This is the true evidence that Christ lives in you. Selah! Author Friday, 6th December, 2024 NAVIGATING FAITH DURING ELECTION 3"so that no one can criticize you. Live clean, innocent lives as children of God, shining like bright lights in a world full of crooked and perverse people." Philippians 2:15 (New Living Translation)The life of a believer is a life of faith. Faith is not only a title deed or a substance of things hoped for. It is also a believer's ability to demonstrate the character of God. 
Faith is living the word of God or expressing the wisdom of God.
The present world is morally crooked and spiritually perverse. The ideologies of this world are influenced by the darkness and selfishness in the hearts of men.Jesus came to bring us into His light and to make us light beings so that we shall be examples of glory in this world."For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light" (Ephesians 5:8)As beacons of light in this world and your society or sphere of contact, you can't live, think and behave as the world.Your attitude within a tense political season should be the demonstration of the Spirit of Christ and not the display of this empty world.You must be an example with your conduct and speech.This should be your behaviour before, during and after the election.Don't allow filthy conversation out of your mouth."But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth." Colossians 3:8 (KJV)Don't let yourself be manipulated by any of the parties. Your political candidate preference shouldn't define your attitude. As long as your interest will gravitate towards a particular candidate you may be tempted to take offense when an opposing opinion becomes denigrating.
Don't allow bitterness, anger or malice in your heart. Demonstrate the wisdom of the word of God.
"Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and clamor and slander be put away from you, along with all malice.” (Ephesians 4:31)A man of faith doesn't waste words. Direct your thoughts and genuine opinions or ideas to a like-minded believer. Spending time to engage in discourse with a fool is not profitable."A rebellious fool will despise your wise advice, so don’t even waste your time—save your breath!" Proverbs 23:9 (TPT)When the election draws near, about 50% of the voters have already made up their minds. Don't exert any energy to convince anyone.Again, don't give room for anxiety; whether before the election during or after, remain resolute.Paul the apostle was clear on this:"BE ANXIOUS FOR NOTHING...""Don’t be pulled in different directions or worried about a thing. Be saturated in prayer throughout each day, offering your faith-filled requests before God with overflowing gratitude. Tell him every detail of your life,  then God’s wonderful peace that transcends human understanding, will make the answers known to you through Jesus Christ. So keep your thoughts continually fixed on all that is authentic and real, honorable and admirable, beautiful and respectful, pure and holy, merciful and kind. And fasten your thoughts on every glorious work of God, praising him always" Philippians 4:6-8 (TPT).Instead of anxiety:- Pray over every detailed concern with thanksgiving- Saturate your mind with the right thoughts.
Whoever wins or loses shouldn't define your composure. Let your confidence be deeply rooted in the Lord, not a political party.
Spend time more in prayer for all parties and don't be boastful.Amidst all these set your hope in the glorious city of Christ. When Abraham got to the land the Lord promised him, he didn't see the physical city, he looked forward to the city of God which is beyond. He looked forward to a city with eternal foundations, whose architect and builder is God. (Hebrews 11:9-10).Though we are in this world and shine forth the light of the Lord, we also have this consciousness:"For this world is not our home; we are looking forward to our everlasting home in heaven" Hebrews 13:14 (TLB)Within these times, be the voice of hope joy, comfort and grace. This is the time to direct the hearts of people to the unending glorious kingdom. You don't have to be distracted, remain focused and turn many unto righteousness (Daniel 12:3) This is the wisdom of God.SelahDIG DEEPER(Romans 13:1-8; Titus 3:1-11; 1Peter 2:9; Matthew 10:16; Isaiah 60:1-3) WE PRAYWe pray that within these times of election in every country, the light of God will shine forth in all hearts, His peace will prevail and many will be turned to righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 John 2 - 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to set my hope on any political system. – I belong to and operate by the Kingdom of God. – I demonstrate my faith in peace in this season through prayers. – Thank you Lord Jesus for the peace that you have given to my country (mention it by name).– Thank you Lord for rightly directing the hearts of men to choose leaders who will not hinder the gospel of Jesus. Oh Gloreeeey!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 684 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your emotions to lead you. Your emotion or the deep seat of your desire has been exposed to the corruptibility of the flesh before you got born again. The flesh has always had its way of governing or influencing the soul of a man. Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires and emotions. Selah. Author Saturday, 7th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)As believers, we have been made victorious through Christ Jesus.The scriptures referred to believers in Christ as "More than conquerors" (Romans 8:37). This means to have a decisive victory. The Greek word is "hupernikaō," which also means to vanquish beyond.Through His work on the cross Jesus, "stripped all the spiritual tyrants in the universe of their sham authority and marched them naked through the streets." (Colossians 2:15).When Jesus died, He did not become a prisoner but defeated all the cohorts of darkness and made them His prisoners. This earned victory of Jesus was for our benefit. In Christ and through Christ we have triumphed over the evil one.The adversary knows he has no power over you. Though he is a defeated foe and rendered powerless, he still has his deceptive methods and schemes or designs. And as people of light, we are not to be ignorant of the designs of the devil. 
The devil cannot have any victory over the believer in any close combat, because of the victory of Christ. 
Thus he uses secrets and projectiles which seem harmless yet deadly, to attack and destroy the faith of the saints.In some previous episodes, we discussed the schemes of the devil.In this new series, I want to emphasize some of the deadly missiles within the devil's schemes. He uses these things to shipwreck the faith of the brethren and to disrupt them from fulfilling God's purpose for their lives.Ignorance is the major challenge of most believers. And through this discussion, you shall receive light to continuously exercise your victory. I write these things to keep you reminded of ways to enforce your victory and not become prey to the enemy.1. Disappointments.This seems harmless but can destroy the confidence of a believer. Most disappointments are basically high expectations not met. The adversary takes advantage of this feeling of displeasure to steal and crush your joy.By how God wires the believer's faith through His Word, a believer shouldn't give room for any form of disappointment. By the knowledge of God's word, a believer must never see disadvantage in any situation. Whether an expectation wasn't fulfilled because of your mistake or failure or that of others, you must remain composed. Understand that, sadness is not of God.  Disappointment is a sad feeling. Such feelings may come, but shouldn't be given a seat. As it rises within, you must quickly send it off. To resist the feeling of disappointment is to also resist the devil.
No matter the worst situation that happens, there is a divine appointment which can be activated.
This is not just to motivate or stimulate your mind. This is the reality of God's word. This is how you have to think. And this doesn't suggest you live to allow any wrong or evil thing to happen around you. This is to help you set your heart on the stability of the word.When an unexpected situation happens around you, don't allow its wind to move you. Stay strong on the word of God.Always remember this:"So we are convinced that every detail of our lives is continually woven together to fit into God’s perfect plan of bringing good into our lives, for we are his lovers who have been called to fulfill his  designed purpose" Romans 8:28 (TPT)
As a believer, you should have great expectations, but your confidence should be in the glorious plan of God for your life.
There are people who focus more on their expectations than how God is building them up. When things don't play out as you expect, refuse to be broken. Pay attention to what God is saying to you and set your heart on it.Trust God's training! Focus on God's plan for your life and His goodness, then you will always live above disappointments.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zwTiogewnADIG DEEPER(Proverbs 16:9; Deuteronomy 8:16; Romans 5:3-5; Isaiah 40:28-31; Psalm 42:11; Proverbs 3:5) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be established in the direction and the perfect plan of God for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 John 52 John 1 3 John 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have been made victorious through Christ Jesus. - I give no room for the adversary in my life. - No matter how worse a situation may be, there is a divine appointment which will be activated for my favor. - My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. - I trust God's training. - I live daily above disappointments. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 685 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until your mind can see or imagine the manifestation of what God has said, your hands cannot handle it. Beloved, SEE the results. Selah! Author Sunday, 8th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 2"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)The teaching of God's word is one of His defense systems for the faith of the believer.You are established in God's word and protected from the schemes of the adversary through teaching."Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe." Philippians 3:1 (KJV)Ignorance is the major challenge of most believers. And through this discussion, you shall receive light to continuously exercise your victory. I write these things to keep you reminded of ways to enforce your victory and not become prey to the enemy.
The level of your mindset is a reflection of your knowledge and understanding.
A believer must not be ignorant of the devices or schemes of the devil. These projectiles we are discussing will help you identify the subtle workings of the devil so that you can rightly resist him.The first projectile mentioned in this series is disappointments.The second projectile to intercept is DISCOURAGEMENT.Though these sixteen projectiles of the adversary are not mentioned in any order of preference, discouragement in most situations comes after disappointment.After David and his men returned to Ziklag, they were disappointed to see the place invaded and the women who were there captured by the Amalekites.David and His mighty soldiers wept till they had no power to weep. This disappointment led to discouragement, great distress and grief. As I mentioned in the previous episode, disappointment may seem harmless but can destroy a believer's confidence. No matter the disappointment and discouragement, the solution is still the same — TURN TO THE LORD.Discouragement is the adversary's weapon. It weakens your strength and makes the ability of God at work in you ineffective. Discouragement tames your enthusiasm, momentum, and strength to pursue a great course.Discouragement blinds you from seeing possibility. It makes you give up and leave you to wallow in defeat. This is where the devil wants you.
Refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. Learn to encourage yourself in the Lord.
"And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the Lord his God." 1 Samuel 30:6 (KJV)One way to deal with discouragement is to look away from the challenge or disappointment and look unto the Lord. Set your mind on the reality that the Lord is with you and all things are possible with Him.Now instead of weeping, David enquired of the Lord and had great victory."And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David. And David enquired at the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all" 1 Samuel 30:7-8 (KJV)This word of the Lord stirred up more confidence in David's heart and he had great victory."And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives. And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all. And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil." 1 Samuel 30:18-20 (KJV)Beloved, you have a greater life than those disappointments. Get up, be encouraged and get to work. Enforce the victory you have in the Lord.Selah.https://youtu.be/6zwTiogewnADIG DEEPER(Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10; John 16:32; Psalm 28:8; Romans 15:13; 1 Thessalonians 5:11; 1 Corinthians 15:18) WE PRAYWe pray that our confidence in the Lord shall increase through the ministry of the Word and the impartation of the Holy Spirit. And we shall be encouraged at all times as we journey into purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Jude 1Revelation 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been made victorious through Christ Jesus. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – I refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above discouragements. – I strengthen myself daily in the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 686 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your life and your living on earth must be seen as business. Whatever you do with your time is a trade of purpose. You can’t afford to be sluggish and wasteful, thinking that great things will manifest through you. Until you decide and begin to work, nothing works for you. Selah! Author Monday, 9th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 3"We are afflicted in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not driven to despair" 2 Corinthians 4:8 (ESV)Knowledge and understanding put you a step ahead of the schemes of the adversary. The projectiles in this discussion don't work in isolation of you. These work through the way your thoughts are shaped. You don't resist or intercept these projectiles only by how you shout the name of Jesus or cast out a demon. You intercept these projectiles by how you think. Until your thoughts are consistent with the knowledge of God, you will become prey to the schemes of the adversary.With the right mindset, you can live above these two things:1. Disappointment 2. Discouragement Today we take a look into the third item:3. Despair!This is the peak of disappointment and discouragement. When you allow yourself to be drenched in disappointment and discouragement you get to the phase of being despair.
To be in despair is to be in a state of despondency or to feel utterly hopeless. 
This state crushes you into wretchedness and defeatism or gloominess.This is why you have to address the issue of disappointment and discouragement before they get rooted in your heart.Challenges and situations may come to triggered such state, but don't yield to it. You have to make a choice to take advantage of the power of God that no matter the pressure, you will not be demoralized.David was confronted by a challenge, he did weep but refused to be beaten into a state of despair. He encouraged himself in the Lord.Let me touch on this a little:To encourage yourself amidst such moments of discouragement and disappointment is not merely to give yourself a positive speech or to be self-motivated. As people of the Kingdom of God, we function differently. We operate or do things according to the word of the Lord. You don't encourage yourself in your own strength and ability. You encourage yourself in the Lord. To encourage yourself in the Lord is to turn to the strength of God. It is to exercise confidence in who God is and what He is able to do.
You cannot prevail by your strength.
"He will protect his faithful ones, but the wicked will disappear in darkness. No one will succeed by strength alone" 1 Samuel 2:9 ( NLT)With the strength of the Lord, you will not be demoralized no matter the projectiles of the adversary.Take a look at the opening scripture above again, but in the Passion Translation:"Though we experience every kind of pressure, we’re not crushed. At times we don’t know what to do, but quitting is not an option" 2 Corinthians 4:8 (TPT).To be in despair is to quit.
Beloved, no matter the disappointment and discouragement refuse to quit. 
All that the adversary is looking for is to get you in a position where you will quit. Some quit in life and commit suicide. Others quit by ending a project or ministry the Lord inspired them to execute.Generations depend on you, be inspired to actionSelah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zwTiogewnADIG DEEPER(1 Peter 4:12-13; 2 Timothy 3:12; Psalm 34:19; Psalm 46:1-3; Psalm 43:2; Psalm 23:4; James 1:2-4) WE PRAYWe pray that the strength of the Lord will abound and increase in us that in all things we shall not grow weary and shall not be despaired. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been made victorious through Christ Jesus. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – I refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above discouragements. – I strengthen myself daily in the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 687 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must have the intelligence and understanding of how the enemy operates. This will guide and guard you from living in continuous defeat. He will not relent from attempting to exploit you. He will always come at you till you believe he is more powerful, the victory of the Lord is not true and you are powerless. Beloved, always stay alert. Selah. Author Tuesday, 10th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 4"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)As discussed in previous episodes, ignorance is not an option when dealing with the adversary.There are projectiles of the adversary we have to always be aware of and not be unguarded:1. Disappointment2. Discouragement3. DespairThere is another crucial or most dangerous projectile of the adversary every believer has to beware of at any given time.4. Doubt.This has been discussed in other episodes of with .To remind you continuously of such is to let you know how deadly it could be. The adversary used this projectile in Eden.He made Adam and Eve doubt what God had said to them and also doubt their identity."Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden? And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil." Genesis 3:1-5 (KJV)This was the beginning of man's corruptibility.5. Unbelief or DisbeliefJust as the adversary uses disappointment to produce discouragement and despair, he also uses doubt to produce unbelief.Doubt is unbelief or faithlessness began. And without faith, it is impossible to please God (Hebrews 11:6).
To have unbelief is also referred to as evil-heartedness.
"So search your hearts every day, my brothers and sisters, and make sure that none of you has evil or unbelief hiding within you. For it will lead you astray, and make you unresponsive to the living God." Hebrews 3:12 (TPT)The goal of the adversary's weapon of unbelief is to make you unresponsive to God. When you are not responding to God, His word will not produce results in your life.
Doubt and unbelief cripple faith.
To be disappointed, will lead to discouragement and despair. These also fuel doubt which leads to unbelief. Many people became atheists by such schemes of the devil. Some people have abandoned their call because of such an attack from the adversary.You cannot be a victim of such projectiles of the devil. Anytime you start doubting your identity, you must know it will lead you to unresponsiveness to God.
Stay alert to resist the devil.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zwTiogewnADIG DEEPER(James 1:6; Romans 11:20-21; Psalm 95:8-11; Hebrews 2:1-3) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be fully influenced by the word of God and shall increase in confidence of the word without doubt or disbelief. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 6 - 8 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not a victim of the adversary. – I increase in the confidence of the word of God daily. – I don't doubt my identity. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – I refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above discouragements. – I strengthen myself daily in the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 688 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You have to come to a point to say, YES I HAVE THE POWER TO CHOOSE WHAT I WANT, YET NOT MY WILL BUT THE WILL OF GOD. Selah. Author Wednesday, 11th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 5"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)Though Christ has obtained victory for every believer through His death and resurrection, it is necessary to enforce that victory at all times.
Until you enforce your victory, you will not enjoy its fullness.
This is the summary of what is known as the Spiritual warfare of the Believer.We are not at war with the devil to conquer him — he has already been conquered. We are at war to enforce our victory in Christ Jesus."For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;) Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ" 2 Corinthians 10:3-5 (KJV)This is war on the grounds of knowledge. It is not a fight over power, it is a fight over whether you will enjoy your victory and inheritance in Christ or doubt all that Christ has accomplished for you.And that is the focus of the deadly weapons or projectiles of the devil against the believer.Don't be ignorant of his schemes.We have already looked at:1. Disappointment2. Discouragement3. Despair4. Doubt5. Unbelief or DisbeliefNow we move on to the other projectiles of the devil:6. DISTRACTIONThe adversary knows, that what takes your attention influences your direction. And what you focus on becomes your goal.When he wants to move the direction of your life away from the course of the Lord and the purpose of God for your life, he must redefine your attention. This is one of the most subtle bad deadly weapons of the devil.There are many who have looked back on their lives with regrets because they lost focus. They started off life with great potential and a desire to accomplish so much for the Lord. Yet in their pursuit of purpose, they lost focus and steered their love away from God's intention for them.
The devil doesn't distract you with evil. Knowing the condition of your heart, he will first distract you with what also seems to be good.
What do you think is the enemy of the best?The enemy of the best is the "good" and not the "worst".Genuine family situations or career choices move people away from the pursuit of God's perfect will for their lives. Nobody got distracted by reasons that first appeared foolish. People get distracted from God's purpose for their lives by reasons which seem genuine.A lady who had great potential and was marked as one going to do great things in the Kingdom lost focus because she was asked to spend more time with "Study group" friends in school than friends from Church. That was how her desires were redirected from the matters pertaining to God. Her desires for the Lord were watered down and became wayward. She lost her bearing of hope.Some withdrew from a specific Church Assembly for petty reasons or reasons which were not inspired by the Holy Spirit and could not grow spiritually any more. There are places God plants you, so that He may usher you into greater manifestations. God doesn't want you to be ordinary, so He ushers you into a company of believers, who dare to do extraordinary things. The adversary will do whatever it takes to distract you from such company.There are people who think, all Churches are the same. And you can become what God has called you to be irrespective of where you find yourself. That is not true. Not every company of believers have a tailored system to nurture your greatness."Don’t be fooled by those who say such things, for “bad company corrupts good character.” 1 Corinthians 15:33 (NLT)When Peter decided to look at the storm instead of Jesus, he began to sink (Matthew 14:30). Don't make decisions because of challenges. Make choices which are consistent with the revelation of Jesus.
It is a trap to think you have to withdraw from your engagements with the Lord, so that you can focus on a family challenge, employment situation or a financial concern. 
The adversary is luring you away from your mandate. He doesn't want you to take and be consistent with what the Lord has begun in you. He may even use family members, a fellow believer or a close friend to distract you. Always pay attention to the voice of the Lord.Stay alert, maintain and imbue focus.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:8; Luke 10:41-42; Proverbs 4:25-27; Colossians 3:2; Isaiah 26:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted even by the most beautiful things. Our hearts and minds shall remain focused on the best intentions and perfect will of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 9 - 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not a victim of the adversary. – I maintain and imbue focus on that which the Lord has called me unto. – I pay attention to the voice of God. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – I refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief. – I refuse to let myself get distracted. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 689 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 6
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It will take the attitude of humility to make a difference in the lives of others. Don’t be big-headed, be humble at all times. Shalom! Author Thursday, 12th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 6"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)These projectiles seem subtle but cause great damage to a believer's faith when they get rooted. You have to intentionally take advantage of the word of God to subdue thoughts of :1. Disappointment2. Discouragement3. Despair4. Doubt5. Unbelief or Disbelief6. DistractionThe more distracted you get, the more you erode your relevance in the Kingdom. As I mentioned in the previous episode, you don't get distracted by the worst. You get distracted by what seems good.At one time, Jesus asked one of the people to follow him and become his disciples. But this fellow had other genuine or good plans and used that as an excuse not to respond immediately to the call of Jesus. See Jesus' response:"Jesus then turned to another and said, “Come be my disciple.”He replied, “Someday I will, Lord, but allow me first to fulfill my duty as a good son and wait until my father passes away.” Luke 9:59 (TPT).Some translations had the literal text, which says "Allow me first to go bury my father". This wasn't like, his father was dead. It's an idiom for waiting until his father passed away. He may not get a share of his father's inheritance when he leaves before his father passes away. He wanted his father's inheritance as his security. He didn't know there was a greater inheritance for him. His reason seemed genuine and good but it was a distraction from getting the opportunity to become relevant in the Kingdom of God.
Jesus isn't sentimental when it comes to fulfilling purpose.
Look at his response to the young man:Jesus told him, “Don’t wait for your father’s burial. Let those who are already dead wait for death. But as for you, go and proclaim everywhere that God’s kingdom has arrived.” Luke 9:61 (TPT)The excuses and "good reasons" you have for not being prompt or for staying away from the pursuit of your call, are mere distractions of the adversary to prevent you from fulfilling purpose.
Why do you think you can be useful to the Lord only when you complete your educational program or get married?
These are distractions and methods the adversary deploys to delay you.There is so much the Lord will accomplish through you. Take your mind away from the voices steering your mind away from going all out for the Lord.Someone said, "I came to school to learn and not to change lives... I can't use my time to win souls when I have books to read". Meanwhile this same person has extra time to surf online, watch reels and movies, watch football games, participate in students' politics, and spend hours at various Campus club meetings.Why do you think, you can't attend weekly church meetings because of work, but will find an excuse for a funeral?The issue is your priority and not the availability of time. Everyone has enough time for what is important to them.Did you read what I wrote on "BEWARE OF ELIAB"?David couldn't have become victorious for Israel if he had listened and allowed himself to be distracted by the words of Eliab.
People who get distracted can't do much for and with the Lord.
Now another also said to Jesus "Lord, I want to follow you too. But first let me go home and say good-bye to my entire family.” (Luke 9:61)This sounds good, right? What a loving family-oriented young man!But Jesus thinks differently when it comes to the pursuit of purpose.Jesus responded, “Why do you keep looking backward to your past and have second thoughts about following me? When you turn back you are useless to God’s kingdom realm.” Luke 9:62 (TPT)He doesn't give room for distractions.
This doesn't suggest Jesus, doesn't care about families, He is interested in the focus of your heart.
All through the scriptures, you will find many who couldn't fulfill their purpose because they got distracted. It is subtle but a powerful destructive weapon of the devil.The Living Bible (TLB) gives more clarity to this:"Another said, “Yes, Lord, I will come, but first let me ask permission of those at home.” But Jesus told him, “Anyone who lets himself be distracted from the work I plan for him is not fit for the Kingdom of God.” Luke 9:61-62This young man was first asking to be excused to go and straighten things at home. Jesus saw it as procrastination and backward thinking.
Beloved, you can’t put God’s kingdom assignment off till tomorrow. Seize the day and get to work.
Refuse to be distracted.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(Phlippians 3:13-14; Hebrews 10:38-39; 1 Kings 19:19-21; Isaiah 50:7;  Philippians 4:8; Luke 10:41-42; Proverbs 4:25-27; Colossians 3:2; Genesis 19:26; 2 Peter 2:20-22) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted and be given to excuses, but will set our hearts and minds on the purpose and assignment of the Lord for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 12 - 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The focus of my heart is the Lord. – I maintain and imbue focus on that which the Lord has called me unto. – I refuse to let myself get distracted. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 690 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 7
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency All through the scriptures, there is no single person who had early success without prayer. In the place of prayer, you receive divine counsel and also access the abundance of grace for every time of need. Beloved, pray! Author Friday, 13th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 7"A double minded man is unstable in all his ways." James 1:8 (KJV)One term which also has great significance in the New Testament is "Dipsuchos". This is the Greek word for Double-mindedness.This word "dipsuchos" is generated from the combined words, "di" or "dis" (which means two or twice respectively) and "psuche" (which means soul or mind). It is an adjective which literally describes one who has two minds or one who is two-souled.This is a dangerous projectile that attacks the faith of the believer. Many believers have also had their faith affected by this dangerous virus, which is the cause of spiritual instability.
As James (the apostle) mentioned in his epistle, a double-minded person or two-souled man is unstable in all his ways.
The word unstable is from the Greek word, "akatastatos" which means to be "inconstant", "restless", "unsettled" and "disorderly".This concept of instability can be related to these two Hebrew words:♦ nadad - which means to wander about or to flee from the post.♦ tohu - which also means formlessness and confusion.How can a believer thrive in faith when he is in such a state of mind or soul? To be two-souled is to create two or double will within you. Such a person cannot advance into maturity and cannot be trustworthy.
When you become two-souled, you vacillate in the pursuit of purpose.
Clearly, James (the just apostle) had a poignant tone in this admonishment of double-mindedness.Take a look at the verse in the Passion Translation:"Just make sure you ask empowered by confident faith without doubting that you will receive. For the ambivalent person believes one minute and doubts the next. Being undecided makes you become like the rough seas driven and tossed by the wind. You’re up one minute and tossed down the next. When you are half-hearted and wavering it leaves you unstable. Can you really expect to receive anything from the Lord when you’re in that condition?" James 1:6-8 (TPT)Are you wondering why, you have been a believer for many years and not seeing the growth and stability of life?Wondering why today you are joyful in the Lord, and another time you are overwhelmed in discouragement?Wondering why today you make a decision to go the extra mile for the Lord, and another time you don't feel motivated?Listen beloved, you have allowed yourself to become two-faced minded. You need to train your mind through the teaching of Christ, to be focused and single-minded.
The adversary takes delight in pushing you into that state of "two-souled" through contrary winds of doctrine.
He uses doctrines which oppose the revelation of Jesus, to forge a different opinion within your heart.You have to see this as warfare, and make a decision to:"...demolish every deceptive fantasy that opposes God and break through every arrogant attitude that is raised up in defiance of the true knowledge of God... capture, like prisoners of war, every thought and insist that it bow in obedience to the Anointed One" 2 Corinthians 10:5 (TPT).This is not something you do tomorrow. It's a stand you have to take today and must act out, stand firm on the knowledge of Jesus in your heart."Then we will no longer be like children, forever changing our minds about what we believe because someone has told us something different or has cleverly lied to us and made the lie sound like the truth." Ephesians 4:14 (TLB)
Beloved, refuse every form of disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt, unbelief or disbelief, distraction and double-mindedness.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:13; Matthew 6:24; 1 Kings 18:21; Matthew 7:24-27; Hebrews 10:23; Galatians 5:17; 1 Corinthians 10:21) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall remain stable in the true knowledge of God in Christ and not be tossed or drifted away by any deceptive and contrary wind. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 15 - 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart remains stable in the true knowledge of God in Christ. – I refuse to be tossed or drifted away by any deceptive and contrary wind. – I maintain and imbue focus on that which the Lord has called me unto. – I refuse to let myself get distracted. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 691 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 8
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your identity as a child of God is the reality of your testimony that you have overcome the world. You cannot be a slave to the devil and his worldly systems when you are fully conscious of your identity in Christ through salvation. Selah! Author Saturday, 14th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 8"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11(ESV)The adversary doesn't only attack the faith of the believer through a disappointment, discouragement, a state of despair, doubt, disbelief, distraction and double-mindedness.The adversary's biggest attack on the believer in these last days is DECEPTION. This is a matter I have addressed in some other episodes.The heart of the unsaved is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked (Jeremiah 17:9).This doesn't mean the new creation in Christ cannot be deceived. The adversary deceives the believer through falsehood."For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ" (2 Corinthians 11:13).
One of the greatest deception of the adversary is to make people deny Jesus as God and that He did not come in the flesh.
"For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist." 2 John 1:7 (KJV)Beware of any teaching which is not consistent with the word of God.The ninth projectile of the devil is DULLNESS of heart.Spiritual fervency is needful in the service of the Lord. 
To be spiritually fervent is not only about how active you are in prayer and how enthusiastic you are in performing spiritual duty. It is also about your ability to comprehend deep spiritual thoughts. 
Dullness in spirit in understanding spiritual things is a dangerous virus. No one in such state will be able to grow effectively. To mature in the Lord is to work on your activeness in the spirit. Those who suffer dullness in spirit, are not receptive to the message of the Lord. Their minds become active with carnal things, they are immature.This is what Paul (the apostle) said, "Brothers and sisters, when I was with you I found it impossible to speak to you as those who are spiritually mature people, for you are still dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. And because you are immature infants in Christ, I had to nurse you and feed you with “milk,” not with the solid food of more advanced teachings, because you weren’t ready for it. In fact, you are still not ready to be fed solid food, for you are living your lives dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. Ask yourselves: Is there jealousy among you? Do you compare yourselves with others? Do you quarrel like children and end up taking sides? If so, this proves that you are living your lives centered on yourselves, dominated by the mind-set of the flesh, and behaving like unbelievers. For when you divide yourselves up in groups—a “Paul group” and an “Apollos group”—you’re acting like people without the Spirit’s influence." 1 Corinthians 3:1-4 (TPT)Paul the apostle in the verse above goes on further to address a certain characteristic of a person who is dull in spirit.
Dullness in the spirit makes you live a life dominated by the flesh. You even behave like an unbeliever.
This doesn't only affect you, it also affects the assembly of the saints.When you are spiritually dull, you cannot receive nor draw out from the wells of wisdom."We have much to say about this topic although it is difficult to explain, because you have become too dull and sluggish to understand." Hebrews 5:11 (TPT).Your activeness in the Spirit begins with how your promptly respond to instructions and the training of the word.
The more you humble yourself to be adequately trained the more your spiritual senses are able to perceive and enjoy heavenly matters.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Revelation 22:16-19; 2 Thessalonians 2:8-12; Hebrews 5:11-14) WE PRAYHeavenly Father,I thank you for your word and for the opportunity to be trained and nurtured in truth, that my heart will always be alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. In the Name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 18 - 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am fervent in Spirit. – My heart is always alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. – I refuse to be dominated by the flesh. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 692 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 9
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your emotions to lead you. Your emotion or the deep seat of your desire has been exposed to the corruptibility of the flesh before you got born again. The flesh has always had its way of governing or influencing the soul of a man. A man’s soul includes the will, the mind and the emotions. For you to express God, your mind must be renewed by the word, your will must submit to God’s will and your emotions must be immersed and trained with the deep desires of God. Selah! Author Sunday, 15th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 9"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11(ESV) The adversary doesn't stop until he is resisted. Your resistance to the devil is not what brings you victory.  To resist the devil is to enforce the victory that Christ has obtained for you.
Victory is your inheritance in Christ. Your responsibility is to enjoy that victory and not permit any force of darkness to derail you.
The goal of the devil is to disrupt your enjoyment of Christ's victory for you, by using all his schemes to shipwreck your faith. I have mentioned Nine (9) of the Sixteen (16) Projectiles of the Devil already in previous episodes. These include: 1. Disappointment 2. Discouragement 3. Despair4. Doubt5. Disbelief 6. Distraction7. Double-mindedness 8. Deception9. Dullness The 10th Deadly Projectile of the devil is: DEADLINESS. Most believers don't think it's possible they can find themselves in this state. Which is understandable, considering what Christ has achieved for the new creation. The reality of the Born Again is this: "that even though we were dead because of our sins, he gave us life when he raised Christ from the dead. (It is only by God’s grace that you have been saved!)" Ephesians 2:5 (NLT) The life which the born again received is the New creation life or the Newness of Life. But until the saving grace of Jesus, the man who got saved was dead in sin.  This was also your state. Until you were saved in Christ, you were dead in sin. It was by the grace of God that you have been quickened or made alive in Christ. This was not the quickening of your mind. It was the quickening of your spirit. When you got born again, the life of God was transfused into your spirit. And by the continuous culturing and nurturing of your mind through the Word of God and the intimacy of the Holy Spirit, you experience transformation through the renewal of your mind. "Stop imitating the ideals and opinions of the culture around you, but be inwardly transformed by the Holy Spirit through a total reformation of how you think. This will empower you to discern God’s will as you live a beautiful life, satisfying and perfect in his eyes." Romans 12:2 (TPT)
The more you experience the renewal of mind the more you experience transformation and inwardly become effective in the things of Christ.
When you are not experiencing a renewal of mind, you will start becoming dull in the things pertaining to Christ. Instead of growing in the knowledge of Christ and becoming more fervent in spirit, your mind rather imitates the ideals and opinions of the culture around you.  This leads to the deadness of your mind. The deadness of your mind is to lose interest in the things of Christ. To be dead in the mind is to be saved but think like an unbeliever. These are people who behave like unsaved.  There are some Christians who are not just dull in spirit but dead in their minds. Yes, they are born again; baptised in the Holy Spirit but are carnal. "For to be carnally minded is death, but to be spiritually minded is life and peace." Romans 8:6 (KJV)
Dullness in spirit will always lead to carnality or deadness of mind when not corrected immediately.
When the adversary succeeds at luring you into this phase or state of mind, he doesn't have to suggest thoughts any more to you. You will oppose the things of God by your own imagination and pride.  At this stage, you will esteem your thoughts above the truth of the scriptures. The way out of such a state is to decide to humble yourself before the Lord. 
If you are in this state where you are governed by your flesh and pride, you must turn to Jesus and submit to the authority of the Word.
Are you beginning to act contrary to the word of God? Are you losing interest in the things of Christ? You don't even see the usefulness of Church meetings? Are you esteeming the activities of this world above the study of the Word and staying patiently to be taught in Church? It's time to make a decision to be yielded and submissive to the instructions of Christ. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:2; Galatians 6:8; Galatians 5:16-17; Proverbs 14:12; John 6:63; 1 Corinthians 2:14) WE PRAYHeavenly Father,Thank you for the opportunity to grow in your word and be renewed in my mind unto total transformation. I pray that through the training of your word, I will always live in accordance with the revelation of the Newness of life in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Revelation 21 -  22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am fervent in Spirit. – My heart is always alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. – I refuse to be dominated by the flesh. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness, deception, dullness and deadliness. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 693 - DON'T LEAVE YOUR LIFE TO CHANCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Faith is not an option in God. It is the REAL DEAL. Live by faith! Author  DON'T LEAVE YOUR LIFE TO CHANCE"Have you ever seen a massive ship sailing effortlessly across the water? Despite its immense size and the fact that it is propelled by mighty winds, a small rudder directs the ship in any direction the pilot chooses"James 3:4 (The Voice)Though Jesus is the captain of your Salvation, the manifestation of His life in you is your responsibility.There are many who keep making such mistakes. They sit to watch how God will direct their lives.There are believers who want God to make them prayerful without their efforts. They want to automatically become word addicts as they spend their time watching online comedy.
The finished work of Christ through His death, burial and resurrection did not nullify the necessity of your work of faith.
By His finished work, you have come into the enjoyment of the divine blessings and life. By your work of faith, you bear fruits and show forth His glory.God through Christ has predestined your life. However, the direction of your life is not automatically steered towards the destination determined by God.The direction of your life is determined by the choices you make.God works in you both to will and to do (Philippians 2:13), yet, you have the responsibility to first and daily submit your will to God’s will.
Why do you think two believers may not make the same level of impact?
It is not only because of how God designed their lives. It is also because of how they both take advantage of the resources of the Lord. It takes grace to accomplish great things.Nevertheless, God doesn’t just supply the ability of grace to people. It’s the responsibility of every believer to grow or increase in grace (2 Peter 3:18).While discussing the Lord’s armor some months ago, we noticed the emphasis of Paul (the apostle) on how each believer is responsible for the usage of the various armorpieces. Though God supplied the whole armor to the believer, it is the believer who has to “put on” and “take up” each armorpiece.I have told you this before that, no matter how you cry or sing, “Jesus take the wheel”, he will only teach you how to steer the wheel. He wouldn’t steer the wheel without you.The beautiful thing about your life is that God through Christ, has supplied all that you need to live the life He has designed for you. You have to take advantage of what He has supplied to you. This is what it means to live in rest. To live and function in rest is to operate in faith.
Don’t assume your life will move towards the right direction. Divine direction will always require your obedience of faith.
God doesn’t direct your life without your involvement. God only shows you which way to go and how to steer the rudder of your life.No matter how huge boats, ships or aeroplanes are, their direction will be determined by a small rudder.The captain must be skillful to know how to steer the rudder.AGAIN:
The direction of your life is not automatically steered towards the destination determined by God.
You must make a decision that you are going to be a skillful captain to move your life in the way of the Lord.A skillful captain or helmsman knows how to submit to the word of God and utilize the knowledge of the word to steer his life towards God’s direction.Don’t leave your life to chance, partner with the Lord to take hold of the rudder of your life.In this season of divine direction, you need to take advantage of every element of divine direction that the Lord has introduced you to through with .Go through the discussion on HEARING GOD'S VOICE again.Beloved, God will give you clarity of purpose as you feast along.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(Galatians 6:5-10; Proverbs 9:12; Romans 14:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we will partner with the Holy Spirit to direct the course of our lives in the way of the Lord and not towards our selfish destination. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Galatians 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am in partnership with the Holy Spirit.  – The direction of my life is in the way of the Lord. – I make the right choices that are in line with the plan of God concerning me. – I don’t leave my life to chance. – I take hold of the rudder of my life. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 694 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 10
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, as long as you are in Christ and have set your focus to intensively serve His course, you will face opposition and tribulation. But tribulation should not break you. You are designed and built by Christ, to glory in Tribulation. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 17th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 10"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11(ESV)The strength and strategy of the devil are exuded by his negative projectiles in the mind of a believer. He doesn't have a greater authority than the one born again in Christ. He doesn't have any control until you allow his schemes to invade your mental space.I am sharing these things with you so that you will not be caught unawares by the devil. He thrives through moments when you are in:1. Disappointment 2. Discouragement 3. Despair4. Doubt5. Disbelief 6. Distraction7. Double-mindedness 8. Deception9. Dullness10. DeadlinessThe 11th projectile is DELAY.
He also takes advantage of DELAY or procrastination to disrupt the progress a believer should make.
Delay is mostly caused by distraction.The moment you allow yourself to be distracted, you will procrastinate and delay your response to a divine instruction. As harmless as it may seem, it is another dangerous and deadly projectile of the devil. This can suffocate you from fulfilling purpose.Whatever God tells you to do or whatever you are inspired in your heart to do unto God's glory, don't procrastinate.See Jesus' response to the young men who were making an excuse:"On the road someone asked if he could go along. “I’ll go with you, wherever,” he said. Jesus was curt: “Are you ready to rough it? We’re not staying in the best inns, you know.” Jesus said to another, “Follow me.” He said, “Certainly, but first excuse me for a couple of days, please. I have to make arrangements for my father’s funeral.” Jesus refused. “First things first. Your business is life, not death. And life is urgent: Announce God’s kingdom!” Then another said, “I’m ready to follow you, Master, but first excuse me while I get things straightened out at home.” Jesus said, “No procrastination. No backward looks. You can’t put God’s kingdom off till tomorrow. Seize the day.” Luke 9:57-62 (Message Translation)From the responses of Jesus, you can tell, that delay or procrastination is not an option. 
Don't allow the adversary to make you act with no sense of urgency when it comes to the things of the Kingdom and your spiritual development. 
Attend to these things with promptness of heart.Don't delay!!!The 12th Projectile I want to point out to you is DISHONESTY.To be dishonest is to turn against your true identity and reality. This is a projectile of the adversary that makes most believers live without any sense of responsibility and confidence.
To be dishonest is to imitate the father of all lies, the devil (John 8:44).
"We reject every shameful cover-up and refuse to resort to cunning trickery or distorting the Word of God. Instead, we open up our souls to you by presenting the truth to everyone’s conscience in the sight and presence of God" 2 Corinthians 4:2 (TPT).Paul the apostle refers to DISHONESTY as a shameful cover-up. Remember, the corruption of Man began with the belief they had in the deception of the devil. This deception produced a false identity in the mind of man. And that is what DISHONESTY does to you. 
To be dishonest is to accept a false identity of your true self. 
God has made you righteous and begotten you with an incorruptible seed. Resist every form of incorruptibility.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(Matthew 15:8; Jeremiah 22:17; Exodus 18:21; Isaiah 58:6; Proverbs 13:4; Proverbs 20:4) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that we will walk in the wisdom of the Word and not be limited by delay and dishonesty. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Galatians 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the wisdom of the word of God. – I refuse to be limited by delay and dishonesty. – I refuse to be dominated by the flesh. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness, deception, dullness, deadliness, delay and dishonesty. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 695 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 11
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week. The grace of God is sufficient for you. Don’t give room to any limitation in your mind. Shalom! Author Wednesday, 18th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 11"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)We have outlined twelve (12) deadly projectiles of the adversary.1. Disappointment2. Discouragement3. Despair4. Doubt5. Disbelief or Unbelief6. Distraction7. Double-mindedness8. Deception9. Dullness10. Deadliness11. Delay12. DishonestyWhat makes these projectiles deadly is how they all seem harmless. The adversary doesn't attack you in ways you expect. He uses subtle means which inflict great damage before you become conscious. Sometimes these projectiles are not diagnosed even after they've caused the intended damage.There are many whose destinies and faith have been steered off and shipwrecked respectively without knowing the exact cause.This is why you don't have to be ignorant of the devil's schemes. Knowing how he plots and launches his attacks will help you perceive and intercept his operations.To move on further we will look at:13. Desecration.Most born-agains are not conscious of how sacred they have been made in Christ. To be born again is not only to be justified (declared not guilty or declared righteous). To be born again is to be separated unto God and declared holy. You are holy because God lives in you. As you are made righteous in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21) and holy, you must live out this righteousness and holiness."And to be transformed as you embrace the glorious Christ-within as your new life and live in union with him! For God has re-created you all over again in his perfect righteousness, and you now belong to him in the realm of true holiness." Ephesians 4:24 (TPT)When you became born again, God indwelt you through Christ. Now your body is not just a physical structure which contains the organs and various biological systems. 
Your body is also a vessel which hosts God's presence.
"Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?" 1 Corinthians 3:16 (KJV)To be God’s temple is to be God’s inner sanctuary. In the Old Covenant, the physical temple hard the outer court, the Holy place and the Most Holy Place. The Most Holy Place was the inner court. And was referred to as the Holiest Place on Earth.The presence of God is no longer in the temple made of hands (Acts 7:48). The veil which separates the Most Holy Place from the Holy Place and the rest of the world was torn in twain, as Jesus hanged on the cross (Luke 23:43-47).Now the Holiest Place on Earth is not in Jerusalem. 
The new creation in Christ is God's inner sanctuary and the Holiest Place on Earth.
As your body is now the inner sanctuary of God, don't defile yourself with the activities of this world.You were designed by God to be a vessel of honor. Your operations must be consistent with this reality. Though you are God's temple you can become a vessel unto dishonor by how you function.There should be no fellowship between you and the world. The more you allow the worldly thought patterns, evil desires, and acts of dishonesty to find expressions through you, the adversary also finds it as an occasion to whisper thoughts of condemnation and guilt.
You are a saint in Christ and made Holy. Refuse to be defiled by this world.
As God's temple you are God’s property. Let your life and living become a demonstration of His glory.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(John 14:17; 1 Corinthians 3:16-17; 1 Corinthians 6:19-20; 2 Corinthians 6:16; Ephesians 2:21-22; 1 Peter 2:5; 1 Peter 1:15-16) WE PRAYWe pray that by the empowering ability of the Holy Spirit we will daily live the sacred and Holy life of God within us and not permit our hearts to be defiled by this world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ephesians 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to defile myself with the activities of this world. – I am the temple of God. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness, deception, dullness, deadliness, delay, dishonesty and desecration. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 696 - SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 12
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you want to have a reality check of your life, look to Jesus. He is the reality of your life. Selah! Author Thursday, 19th December, 2024 SIXTEEN PROJECTILES TO INTERCEPT 12"so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs." 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)The adversary has no power over you as a child of God. However, through his projectiles, he subtly afflicts the believer.With all that we have discussed  you have to make a decision that you will not become a victim of these things:1. Disappointment2. Discouragement3. Despair4. Doubt5. Disbelief or Unbelief6. Distraction7. Double-mindedness8. Deception9. Dullness10. Deadliness11. Delay12. Dishonesty13. Desecration  or DefilementThe fourteenth projectile we will look at is DISOBEDIENCE.
Now, this may seem to be the sole responsibility of the believer and have nothing to do with the devil's schemes.
Disobedience to God is not automatic. One demonstrates disobedience when doubt, disbelief and deception have fully germinated.The adversary contributes to your disobedience through deception.
