He knows your disobedience will distract you from manifesting God’s glory.To disobey is to act outside the faith. Obedience is to hear under faith. When one obeys the word of God, it is an act of faith. Obedience to God is proof of honor.
The adversary knows when you walk in disobedience you will walk outside the will of God for your life.
Men always don't attribute their disobedience to God as anything wrong or evil. And even some acts of disobedience to God in some contexts may seem to be a good thing in others. It may be something all men celebrate or will applaud you for, but will be disobedience to God.King Saul's decision to disobey the Lord's instruction on how to handle the battle with the Amalekites, cost him his throne. He was a man after His own desires but not the counsel of the Lord. He decided to keep the animals which were to be destroyed as spoils of war and for sacrificial offerings. He even spared the life of King Agag, as a showcase of his victory. But that wasn't what God wanted. Even though in the natural and religious sense it looks like Saul did the right thing. Because to offer sacrifices to the Lord was like the right thing to do. But God's response through Prophet Samuel wasn't what Saul expected:"But Samuel replied,“What is more pleasing to the LORD: your burnt offerings and sacrifices or your obedience to his voice? Listen! Obedience is better than sacrifice, and submission is better than offering the fat of rams. Rebellion is as sinful as witchcraft, and stubbornness as bad as worshipping idols. So because you have rejected the command of the LORD, he has rejected you as king." 1 Samuel 15:22-23 (NLT)Saul did what he did to satisfy his own interest. But that was a demonstration of ego and arrogance. 
Always see your obedience to God, as an act of faith.
Saul (Paul the Apostle), acted differently with the Lord's instruction. He said, "Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision" Acts 26:19 (KJV).This was his response to the instructions he received from the Lord Jesus as he encountered Him on his way to Damascus to persecute the believers.When you became born again, you came into the obedience of faith. Christ's obedience became your obedience. And you were supplied with the ability of God to continue in the reality of His obedience. To obey the Lord is no longer mechanical but organic because God works in you both to will and to do (Philippians 2:13).As a born-again, you don't live under the rule of the devil. You are not his servant. Therefore you don't yield and obey his voice. You are no longer part of the children of disobedience.
It is the unsaved who is referred to as the son of disobedience.
"in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the sons of disobedience" Ephesians 2:2 (NKJV)You are now an obedient child of God because of Jesus Christ's obedience.Look at what Peter the Apostle  said:"As obedient children, do not be conformed to the passions of your former ignorance" 1 Peter 1:14 (ESV).
Don't believe in the deception of the devil that you are not an obedient child of God.
The spirit of disobedience doesn't have any authority over you. You are an obedient child of God and have the capacity to respond rightly to the Lord's instructions.Selah.DIG DEEPER(John 14:17; 1 Corinthians 3:16-17; 1 Corinthians 6:19-20; 2 Corinthians 6:16; Ephesians 2:21-22; 1 Peter 2:5; 1 Peter 1:15-16) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for making us obedient children and giving us the ability to organically walk according to His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Ephesians 4 - 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in obedience to God. – I am not disobedient to the word of God. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness, deception, dullness, deadliness, delay, dishonesty, desecration and disobedience. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 697 - DEAL WITH UNFORGIVENESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t just live normal as everyone. Don’t be satisfied with the level you are in your relationship with Jesus. Avoid double-mindedness! Set your eyes on Jesus and crave more for the sweet intimacy with Jesus. You will soon begin to reflect and reveal God in all you do. Selah! Author Friday, 20th, December 2024   DEAL WITH UNFORGIVENESS “A further reason for forgiveness is to keep from being outsmarted by Satan, for we know what he is trying to do.”  (2 Corinthians 2:11). The schemes of the adversary are his weapons designed to shipwreck the faith of the saints. His schemes are mainly to exploit the weaknesses or the inconsistencies of the brethren. He also takes advantage of the voice of every individual’s flesh to manipulate their thoughts and actions. The arrows of the adversary may be subtle and may start as harmless thoughts or through a harmless incidence, but when they are not intentionally or promptly and explosively extinguished, they will gradually creep into your heart and cause an emotional breakdown.
Sometimes things you will laugh about in the heat of a moment will later become the reason you feel hurt and offended.
How does it happen? The adversary subtly begins to whisper and induce a perspective you didn’t consider. Suddenly, you begin to feel angry and offended over something you initially laughed over. He draws your attention and causes the new negative perspective to become your meditation. The more you meditate on it, the more you become offended and bitter. You may think you are doing the right thing by giving a forensic look at the situation. But that is not what is really happening. The adversary is attacking your heart using the situation.
Such attacks from the adversary are poisonous and can even crush your bones physically.
Sometimes you may think it is your right not to forgive. You may even say “I have forgiven” but you know deep within you haven’t forgiven. Or will even tell yourself, “How many times should I forgive?; Am I the only one to forgive?”.
Unforgiveness or holding on to an offence is a destructive weapon of the enemy.
Look at what Paul the Apostle had to say to the Church in Corinth: “So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow. Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him. To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ; Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.” 2 Corinthians 2:9-11 (KJV) From the above verses, we see Paul asking the brethren to forgive a fellow who had done some wrong. He then explained the reason for forgiving: One of the devices of Satan is to use or take advantage of unforgiveness. When you are unforgiving, the adversary will outsmart you with his devices. He finds an opportunity to attack the saints when they are offended, bitter and unforgiving.
Don’t see any of these reactions or emotional trouble you keep having as natural consequences. They are arrows of the adversary shot at you.
Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Even when He hanged naked on the cross, before His death (while the soldiers gambled for His clothes); He said, “Father forgive them…” (Luke 23:34) Faith works through love (Galatians 5:6) As you forgive others as Christ has forgiven you, you learn to SHIELD UP BY FAITH against the arrows of bitterness, offences, anger and sorrow.
SHIELD UP!
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER (Ephesians 4:32; Proverbs 19:11; Matthew 18:33; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11)   WE PRAY We pray that we will not hold on to offences and bitterness but will continue to forgive and love one another.   BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 Philippians 1 - 3   DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I refuse to hold on to offences and bitterness.   – I demonstrate the love of God towards all men in all things.   – Nothing can offend me.   – The love of God gains full expression through me by the day   – I am full of love.   – The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God.   Thank you Lord Jesus!  [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 698 - DO YOU HAVE A PERSONAL REVELATION?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It will amaze you to know that the craving of your flesh travels through the impressions of your emotions. Your flesh uses the force of the desires hewn from your emotions to influence your actions. Channel your emotions towards the Lord today. Shalom! Author Saturday, 21st December, 2024 DO YOU HAVE A PERSONAL REVELATION?“Look at the proud one, His soul is not right within him, But the righteous will live by his faith [in the true God].” Habakkuk 2:4 (Amplified) The goal of the word of God is to make you fruitful in your walk with Him. This begins with the infusion of faith. Anytime God’s word comes to you, it produces faith in you. Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. (Romans 10:17).
Faith is absolute confidence in God and what He says. It is the substance of reality that is beyond the optics.
When the word of God comes to you concerning a matter, it opens your heart to God’s revelation on that matter or situation. It reprograms your mind on how to deal with that matter or situation according to God’s wisdom. This is how faith works! Four times in the Bible, you can see the phrase:“The just shall live by faith” or “The righteous shall live by faith” (Habakkuk 2:4; Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38;) It is mentioned three times in the New Testament portion of the Bible and once in the Old Testament portion of the Bible. The opening verse, Habakkuk 2:4, is the original or the first time that phrase was used.  What makes Habakkuk 2:4, unique is the expression, “…HIS FAITH“. This focuses on how we appropriate or engage the revelation of Jesus in our personal lives. That is the subjective Faith.The other three verses in the New Testament focus on the object of Faith (the revelation of Jesus). 
Jesus is the object and substance of our confidence in God.
Which means Faith is Jesus and all that He has done for us. Jesus is the substance or embodiment of our confidence and assurance in God unto salvation. Now to continue to live by faith and manifest the fullness of the life which you have in Christ, you must have a personal revelation of the Word of God.
To have a personal revelation of the word of God is not to have your personal interpretation of the word of God. (2 Peter 1:20)
The word of God (or every scripture) is prophetic and there is a complete interpretation of every scripture in the Bible. There are three methods the Word of God was given: 1. The Word of God or the scriptures were given by revelation; which is from God to His holy men. (See Amos 3:7; Hebrews 1:1-2; Daniel 2:22,28; Galatians 1:11-12). 2. And by inspiration these holy men wrote the scriptures. Which is from heart to “paper”. (See 2 Peter 1:21; 2 Timothy 3:16).  3. The third method is illumination. This is from “Paper” to heart (See Psalm 119:18,130; Ephesians 1:18). This happens through the teaching and the study of the Word. As all scripture is inspired by God, we should understand that we are not inspired to rewrite the scriptures. The dimension of inspiration we enjoy now involves how God has revealed spiritual truth to us through His word (which is already inspired by God). It happens through accurate interpretation which is your study of spiritual truth, in God’s word. This is what it means to, “RIGHTLY DIVIDE THE WORD OF GOD”. (2 Timothy 2:15). It is by this you can handle the truth of the word of God for yourself. All that God has said in His word is the revelation of His life and eternal counsel to mankind. Your revelation of God must be according to the word of God. For the Word of God to be useful to you, you need to know and own the Word. You must personalise it. 
The knowledge of the word of God must not just be another increase in information but increased revelation.
Your faith is governed by your personal revelation.  To have a personal revelation is not to have a new revelation. The revelation of the word of God in the scriptures is complete. Christ is the completeness of God’s revelation (Hebrews 1:1-2).
To have a personal revelation is to have an absolute and accurate understanding of what God has said through the scriptures.
It is to personally behold and capture the light or the reality of God through His Word. Personal revelation is the illumination of the word of God in your heart. The illumination of the Word involves your understanding of spiritual truth which is in the Word, by the administration of the Holy Spirit (through a sound teacher of the Word, and Bible study materials). This is what “The with ” does to you. It makes you an illumined believer.
You are trained to personally recognize the truthfulness of what you read in the Bible and to apprehend its beauty. 
Illumination of the scriptures enlightens you to recognize the authority and significance of what is said in the word, for your daily victories. It means you are not merely living by what someone says he or she has found in the Scriptures. But you live by what you have personally seen and handled in the Scriptures. This makes your faith effective and you live the reality of your overcoming life. “For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God]” 1 John 5:4 (Amplified) When you have a personal revelation of the Word, you can have personal daily victories of faith. Hallelujah! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TVwq3w4Tr_oDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 2; 1 John 1:1-3; Job 42:5; Acts 26:18; 2 Corinthians 4:6; Isaiah 6:10; Philippians 3:10; Luke 1:1-4) WE PRAYLord, open our eyes and hearts to your word that we will be enlightened and built in our Faith for personal daily victories which will bring glory to your name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Philippians 4Colossians 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow in my personal faith in Jesus. – My heart and mind are illuminated by the Word of God. – I don’t live by assumptions. I live by revelation. – I walk in the reality of the Word of God. – I see truth in the word of God. – I recognise the authority of the word of God in every situation of my life. – I am richly enlightened by the word for the increase of my faith. Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 699 - EXERCISE GREAT FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t disconnect your emotions or desires from the Lord. In your communion with the Lord carry your emotions along. Until your emotions consistently gravitate towards the Lord, you will not be wholly addicted to the fellowship of the Spirit. Selah! Author Sunday, 22nd December, 2024 EXERCISE GREAT FAITH“When Jesus heard it, he marvelled and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel. Matthew 8:10 (KJV) There is no God-kind of results without faith. Also, the faith of God within you is not just for seasonal showmanship. The faith of God is not just for moments when you need urgent results or a testimony. Your entire life is lived by faith. Faith is the law of life at work in you as you have come into the new living way in Christ.
The faith of God within you can be nurtured. You grow in faith as you continue to practice, function and act according to the revelation of Jesus. 
Let me explain this to you: Jesus is the object or the embodiment of our Faith. Faith is authored and completed in Him. (Hebrews 12:2). This is called the “Objective faith”.  Faith was infused and sown into your heart through the ministry of the Word. (Romans 10:17). The faith sown into you creates an inward response that becomes a personal faith. This is also referred to as “Subjective faith“. This subjective or personal faith is built by the consistent revelation of the word of God in your heart. You don’t grow the objective faith; instead, you grow and increase in the objective faith. Your growth and increase in the objective faith is called growing your faith. As you grow in faith, your personal faith increases. All through the scriptures, there are only two places (specifically in the New Testament portion of the Bible) where God MARVELLED. Both were connected to FAITH. Interestingly, there are only two scenarios where Jesus referred to the faith of certain persons as GREAT. Exercising yourself in FAITH is so essential to God. If Jesus, by whom this beautiful, jaw-dropping and astonishing universe was made, could still MARVEL at something, then that matter is worth our interest and meditation. Jesus didn’t marvel at the great miracles He did. However, all the people marvelled and were astonished by His great miraculous deeds and depths of wisdom in His utterances. Jesus was not marvelled once by this complex universe and constellations.  Instead, the great faith of the Roman centurion (Matthew 8:10) and the faithlessness of His people in Nazareth marvelled Him (Mark 6:6). It was matters concerning FAITH that made Jesus marvel.
Faith is not an option in God. It is the REAL DEAL. Live by faith!
No wonder the scripture says without faith, it is impossible to please God. (Hebrews 11:6). This is how GREAT FAITH works: “And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.When Jesus heard it, He marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.“ Matthew 8:5-10 (KJV Sincerely, it is amazing to know that Jesus was not marvelled positively by the great Jewish scholars or Rabbi and leaders. He was marvelled by a Gentile, who also is a Roman centurion. There are a few key items that will help you understand how to exercise GREAT FAITH. Firstly, The great level of reverence and humility demonstrated by the Centurion. During classical antiquity, a centurion in the Roman army was a commander of 100 legionary military units. They defended and exercised control in Roman territories. They uphold the authority of Rome and don’t bow to anyone except Rome. Yet, He called Jesus Lord, which means MASTER. Do you know what it means for a Roman Centurion to call a Jew MASTER? It means this Centurion had caught a great revelation of who Jesus is. Great faith is not confidence in the self or what you know. It is not found in who you think you are without God. It is not your confidence in the position or rank in government or a great organization. Neither is it found in the money in your account nor the number of hours you pray in tongues (though it is worth it).
The greatest limitation of faith is pride. 
Exercising great faith always begins with having reverence for God and submitting to Him.   Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(Luke 7:9; Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY– That any form of pride and ego will be subdued and crushed by the revelation of Jesus.– We will exercise the wisdom to submit completely to the Lord in all humility and godly reverence. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Colossians 3 -41 Thessalonians 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I recognise the Lordship of Jesus in my life and every situation. – I walk in the revelation of who Jesus is daily. – I exercise great faith according to the revelation of Jesus and not according to any efforts of mine. – I refuse to be proud and egoistic. I walk in the humility to the Lord Jesus and His commandments.  – I take steps according to the ability of God.  Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 700 - TRUST THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Hurray! This is a great feat and I am so excited about what the Lord is doing in you. Dearly beloved reader, I want to specially thank you for being a part of this great course. I will want to know how this rich platform has impacted and blessed you in the comments. I love you so deeply! Author Monday, 23rd December, 2024 TRUST THE LORD“But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.” Numbers 11:23 (ERV)The limitation of your mind is determined by your understanding or exposure. Your imagination cannot be expanded beyond what you see.
You can conceive the unimaginable in your mind according to the insights you have had.
For example, the car toys of yesterday are now on today’s streets and some are in the showrooms to be sold.The first car which was designed, contributed to the imagination of the designer of today’s Rolls-Royce. The examples of yesterday are for our learning today.This is what the Bible does for your faith. The stories you read in the scriptures are not mere historical accounts. They are to expose your heart to things you have not imagined and to dispense faith into you.It is to your own disadvantage when you don’t read and study the Bible. The things written in the scriptures are for your learning.“For whatever was written in earlier times was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope and overflow with confidence in His promises.” Romans 15:4 (Amplified Bible)
You cannot access the riches of God’s wisdom when you don’t give yourself to personal Bible study.
The absence of personal Bible study will make you live by fantasies.The faith of some people doesn’t yield results because they are not built on the understanding of God through His word. They build their faith on fantasies and assumptions.The reading and studying of the word of God brings you into proper understanding. When you study the word of God, you will not only find examples of faith but will have a proper contextual and background understanding of how that example of faith was exuded.The study of the word gives you a personal grasp of the thoughts of God. This is why through the  With , you are given DIG DEEPER scriptures and also a ONE-YEAR BIBLE READING PLAN.No matter how you can imagine a technology, you must as well understand the physics to make it work.The study of the word of God doesn’t only expose you to what God can do but how to position yourself to rightly experience the effectual workings of God through His word.
When you don’t know God through His word, you may easily doubt Him and His word. God does nothing outside His word.
https://withapostlebennie.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Comp-1_2_1.mp4When you take God’s word and act on it, you partner with God in faith to see the manifestation of His word in your life.The manifestation of God’s word in your life is according to your faith in Him. Your faith in God is your partnership and agreement with the Word.All those who limited God’s power did not partner with God in faith. They did not exercise confidence in God. Your partnership with God is a partnership unto unlimited living.
You must stand strong in agreement with God that His word is true and will not fail, no matter the challenge.
Daniel the Prophet, found himself in a situation where he should be broken, discouraged and afraid. But he chose to remain confident in God. He chose to stand in partnership with God’s word; that the Lord is his protection and defence.He was accused of breaking a law and was thrown into a lions’ den. The king’s confidence was that the God of Daniel would bring deliverance to Daniel (see Daniel 6:16-22).However, the last sentence in verse 23 (of Daniel chapter 6) caught my attention:“Then the king was exceedingly glad and commanded that Daniel be taken up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him because he had trusted in his God“Did you see that?Daniel the Prophet was not delivered because the king sent soldiers to defend him. No kind of harm was found on him because HE HAD TRUSTED IN HIS GOD.That trust in God was Prophet Daniel’s secret.The moment you stop trusting the Lord, you limit the supply of His power. And there is no expiration for your trust in God. You must trust the Lord at all times, in all things and irrespective of the situation.
No matter how little or how big the matter is, trust the Lord.
The Lord will always deliver, protect, defend, preserve, provide, and prosper you.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Genesis 18:14; Psalm 78:41; Numbers 23:19; Daniel 6:16-23) WE PRAYWe pray that today and this week we shall see and receive glorious testimonies of impact according to the limitless ability of God BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Thessalonians 2 - 4  DECLARE THESE WORDS:— I don’t define God’s capacity by my limitations— I don’t reduce God’s grace to my human calculation.—  I have confidence in God’s limitless supply.— I believe without any iota of doubt, that God will always do what He says He will do.—  I don’t limit God’s power in my thoughts and imagination. I have strong faith in seeing the mighty workings of God in all things. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 701 - DON'T BE DOMINATED BY THE FLESH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Even when He hanged naked on the cross, before His death (while the soldiers gambled for His clothes); He said, “Father forgive them…” Selah. Author Tuesday, 24th, December, 2024DON'T BE DOMINATED BY THE FLESH"He must become greater and greater, and I must become less and less" John 3:30 (NLT) Being born again for many years doesn’t make you spiritually mature. You can attend Church meetings, serve in a ministry or stewardship department for many years, and still not grow spiritually.
To grow spiritually is a personal decision.
You may cultivate certain spiritual habits and mindsets just by being present in an environment of the Word of Grace. Because environments or some atmospheres are contagious.  To grow effectively, you don’t have to only depend on the influence of the environment of your local Church. You have to be intentional about your growth in the spirit. In as much as your growth in the Lord or maturity in the spirit is your responsibility, you don’t do it alone. You don’t create the things you need for your growth. It is the Lord who supplies you with what you need and you put them to work. The greatest evidence of your growth in Christ is how you walk in the LOVE OF GOD. The Love of God does not satisfy the desires of the flesh. The true motive or intention of the love of God at work in you is to bless or nourish others without personal interest. This brings all glory to God and not you.
The greatest sign of an immature life is the INFLUENCE OF THE FLESH.
From the opening verse: “Brothers and sisters, when I was with you I found it impossible to speak to you as those who are spiritually mature people, for you are still dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. And because you are immature infants in Christ,” 1 Corinthians 3:1 (TPT) Paul was speaking to fellow saints (believers in Christ), not unbelievers. Some of these (if not all) were babes or infants in Christ.  The evidence of their spiritual immaturity was how they were DOMINATED BY THE MIND-SET OF THE FLESH.
The more you grow in the spirit, the less you are influenced or dominated by the flesh.
To which extent are you dominated by the flesh? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 3:1-3; Romans 13:8-10; Matthew 22:37-40; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18) WE PRAYThat our love will grow and increase beyond measure, bringing us into the rich revelation of spiritual insight in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Thessalonians 52 Thessalonians 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be dominated by the mindset of the flesh. – My actions and decisions are not influenced by the flesh. – I am a nourishment to others. – I am intentional about my growth in the spirit. – I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. – As I receive daily nourishment and supply from the Lord, I increase in the expression of love. – I am not dull in hearing the word of God. – I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 702 - THIS JESUS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter your guilt and shame, always be conscious that you are the Father's beloved and He loves you with an everlasting love. Therefore, focus on the Love of the Father and not your imperfection. Selah! Author Wednesday, 25th December, 2024 THIS JESUS 1"Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ." Acts 17:3 (KJV)As part of the many beautiful revelations of Jesus, the knowledge of Him as CHRIST is the all-encompassing prophetic revelation and fulfilment.The word "Christ" is not a new age thought of as a "chi" or a synonymous expression for a yogic higher force.
Christ is not a figment satisfaction of one's personal imagination.
The word Christ is not Jesus' surname or last name. My surname is "Ansah", thus you can refer to me as Mr. Ansah. And that is how some consider  "Christ". They assume He is Mr. CHRIST.Christ is not necessarily His name. Christ is His title. The proper understanding of the Christ will help you appreciate the passionate tone in Paul's statement, "and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ". He made this statement as a logical conclusion of what the scriptures teach. "Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures " Acts 17:1-2 (KJV)In His preaching, Paul the apostle, systematically reasoned with His audience using the scriptures to make thoughtful arguments to persuade them of the revelation of Jesus as the Christ.This term meant and still means something profound to the Jews. Christ was one they looked forward to for many centuries. Some believe Jesus is Christ, others are still looking forward to a coming Christ.The word Christ is a transliteration of the Greek word Christos, meaning “anointed" or "anointed one". In Hebrew, it is the equivalent of the word Messiah or mashiach (which is from the verb mashach). So, to be the Christ or Messiah is to be “the anointed one”.The anointing or sacred oil was poured on people specially chosen for the Lord's assignment. These are mainly prophets, priests and kings. The phrase "anointed one" or "the Lord anointed" is mostly used for kings. (See 1 Samuel 24:6)See these verses as well:“He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed (mashach) him to consecrate him.” (Lev. 8:12)"So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed (mashach) him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David. Samuel then went to Ramah.” (1 Sam. 16:13)"Also, anoint (mashach) Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint (mashach) Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.” (1 Kings 19:16)Though the expression "anointed" or "Mashiach" is used in several places in the Old Testament portion of the Bible, the anointed one is mainly a term for the Messiah.The Messiah is the prophetic title given to the King who is to come, by the prophets of old.The prophets gave revelatory hints or codes of the coming King who would deliver his people and also rule the whole world.By prophecy, the Messiah shall shoot forth from Israel and amidst the Jewish people.Jacob while blessing his sons, made this prophetic declaration to Judah concerning the Messiah."Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up? The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be". Genesis 49:9-10 (KJV)Balak the king of the Moabites requested that Balaam should curse the people of Israel as they pitched in the plains of Moab. One of the prophetic visions Balaam had was the revelation of the Messiah. "How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel! As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters. He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted. God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows. He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee... He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth." Numbers 24:5-9,16-17 (KJV)When Jesus was born His star appeared in the east and wise men went to bow to Him as the new King."Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem, Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.""When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was. When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy. And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh." Matthew 2:1-2,9-11 (KJV)In ancient times when a King arose, people of stature would go and pay homage to the new king to renew or establish a relationship with the King. Though Jesus was born as a baby, He wasn't an ordinary child. He was the prophetic King or Messiah who was born in Bethlehem. Just as it was declared that a royal star would come out of Jacob, the Wisemen saw the royal star of Jesus and rejoiced.Beloved the birth of Jesus was the beginning of the fulfilment of His Messianic Prophecies. This Jesus whom we preach is the Christ or the Messiah who was spoken of by the prophets and the scriptures.To believe in Jesus is to receive the Christ.We have not believed in empty fables but in a sure word of prophecy.
 Celebrate Jesus who is the King of Kings at all times.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 61:1-7; Luke 4:18,41; Isaiah 9:6-7; Matthew 1:23; Matthew 16:1; Mark 8:29; Luke 9:20; John 11:27) WE PRAYWe pray that our eyes shall open to the full revelation of Jesus as the true Messiah and our hearts shall be established in that certainty. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Thessalonians 3 1 Timothy 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. - Jesus is the CHRIST. - Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 703 - THIS JESUS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, your relationship with God is not a strive to enter rest. Your relationship with God is the eternal enjoyment of God’s rest. Hallelujah!! Author Thursday, 26th November, 2024 THIS JESUS 2"Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ." Acts 17:3 (KJV)The revelation of Jesus is not a fairy tale neither is it an old fable.Peter the apostle of Jesus, was passionate about this he said:"For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty. For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount. We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts" 2 Peter 1:16-19 (KJV)
The revelation of the reality of Jesus is not a cunningly devised fable but a more sure word of prophecy.
The blessing of Jacob upon his son Judah, was a Messianic prophetic utterance which was fulfilled by Jesus.Balaam saw the revelation of Jesus when he saw the people of Israel pitched at the valley of Moab."How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel...  his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted. God brought him forth out of Egypt... I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel" Numbers 24:5,7-8,17 (KJV)The wise men saw the star of Jesus appear in the east and went to bow to Him as the new King. This was the fulfillment of what Balaam saw and also what the Psalmist said concerning the Messiah."Distant kings will surrender and come with their gifts from every continent and coastland; they will offer their tribute to you. O King of kings, they will all bow before you. O King of kings, every nation will one day serve you." Psalm 72:10-11 (TPT)When Matthew was writing the Bethlehem account of Jesus, he had some Messianic Prophecies in mind.To those around the baby Jesus, it was just a child enjoying blessings. But in the mind of Matthew, it was ancient oracles playing out.Yes, to Isaiah the Prophet, he was speaking over Jerusalem.Matthew saw the fulfilment of those words in the lives of Jesus. "Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee. For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee. And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising. Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side. Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee. The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD." Isaiah 60:1-6 (KJV)Oh, glory to God!Beloved, this is not to put words on the lips of the gospel account of Matthew.Before the wise men saw the child, they first went to Herod's palace, thinking the child was born there, since they knew he was the new King.These wise men were asked to return to Herod when they found the child. But the intention was for Herod to kill the child.He later commanded a mass killing of every baby boy two years old and younger, since the wise men did not return with the news of the child's location. Jesus' parents escaped to Egypt with Him. According to Matthew's account, this was for the scriptures to be fulfilled."So that very night he got up and took Jesus and his mother and made their escape to Egypt and remained there until Herod died. All of this fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through his prophet: I summon my Son out of Egypt " Matthew 2:14-15 (TPT)The prophet Hosea prophesied, "When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt." And Jesus came as the fulfilment of this prophecy.No wonder the Lord said,"You are busy analyzing the Scriptures, frantically poring over them in hopes of gaining eternal life. Everything you read points to me" John 5:39 (TPT)When you genuinely study the scriptures, they will bring you to the Person of Jesus.Many read and still look forward to the first coming of the Messiah. Yet they did not know that the Messiah walked among them and now He will be appearing in His full glory. This is the best time to believe in Jesus as LORD. And if you do, this is the best time to express His life and light to the world.This Jesus is not merely another prophet. This Jesus is the CHRIST!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 61:1-7; Luke 4:18,41; Isaiah 9:6-7; Matthew 1:23; Matthew 16:1; Mark 8:29; Luke 9:20; John 11:27) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in the boldness of the Spirit to declare the testimony of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Timothy 3 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 704 - THIS JESUS 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To do big things for God, you must have tough skin. Be toughened, and develop hard skin through the building up of the Word. Selah! Author Friday, 27th December, 2024 THIS JESUS 3"Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ." Acts 17:3 (KJV)Whenever the scriptures are unfolded you must see Jesus. He is the meaning of the scriptures.Jesus Christ is the story told in the Old Testament. When you understand that all that was communicated in the Old Testament is to bring every reader to Christ, you will see the oneness of the entire Bible.Different men, in different historical timeliness and with distinct experiences were inspired by the Holy Spirit to write God's thoughts with their unique styles of expressions, and had one central theme of thought, Jesus Christ.These may not have necessarily grasped the full revelation of what they wrote. They might have thought of writing about the situation around them and the possible things which might come, but every bit of it was part of the beautiful story of this Jesus who is the Christ.
He is the central theme of Genesis as the Creator, the Life and the Promised seed.  
"In the beginning God created..." (Genesis 1:1)."All things were made by Him and without Him was not anything made that was made" (John 1:3).The entire events we witnessed in Genesis through the scriptures, were the unfolding of this utterance of God, "the seed of the woman shall bruise the head of the serpent" (Genesis 3:15).The goal of the adversary was to destroy the coming of this seed. But God encrypted the appearing of the seed. By a careful study of the scriptures, you will realize that all that the devil was doing from the time Adam and Eve were out of the Garden of Eden, even through Abraham and his descendants even to the time Jesus was born (or the Word became flesh), was to destroy the seed before it germinates.God was giving His people, hints of the coming of the Seed. Through the writings of the Prophets, the Priests, the Kings, the Judges, and the Psalmists, the Lord was announcing the manifestation of the Seed. The adversary realized through observation that, the seed was going to come from the descendants of Abraham and Jacob, but was many centuries behind what God was doing.While the devil thought Isaac and his descendants were the Promised Seed, God's original Seed was encrypted.The adversary arrived at this conclusion when he heard this:"And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him." Genesis 12:7 (KJV).What the adversary didn't hear was this:"Now to Abraham and his Seed were the promises made. He does not say, “And to seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “And to your Seed,” who is Christ." Galatians 3:16 (NKJV)All that happened from Genesis to the time Jesus was born were testimonies of Him."Then he carefully unveiled to them the revelation of himself throughout the Scripture. He started from the beginning and explained the writings of Moses and all the prophets, showing how they wrote of him and revealed the truth about himself." Luke 24:27 (TPT)Beloved this is the reason you must rejoice in this season."The shepherds returned to their flock, ecstatic over what had happened. They praised God and glorified him for all they had heard and seen for themselves, just like the angel had said." Luke 2:20 (TPT).When you see Jesus, you must rejoice. And that is what the scriptures help you to do. To have a picture and accurate revelation of Jesus. 
The revelation of Jesus brings you into the reality of God.
 Abraham saw Jesus and rejoiced at His coming."Your father Abraham rejoiced as he looked forward to my coming. He saw it and was glad" John 8:56 (ESV)Look at the testimony of Moses:"By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter; Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward." Hebrews 11:24-26 (KJV)Moses saw the hope of the Messiah, believed in the coming of the Anointed one and treasured it or held it dear than the treasures of Egypt.The birth of Jesus wasn't an event that just happened out of the blue.Like Matthew said:"All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had spoken by the prophet." (Matthew 1:22)The entire life of Jesus was the fulfillment of the Prophecies. The prophetic words were the articulation of the plan and purposes of God.Beloved rejoice at the revelation of Jesus!Two things you should glean:1. Jesus is the Christ and He is the Lord of all.2. The word of God or the Prophecies of the scriptures are true and sure.Jesus as the fulfilment of Prophecies is the evidence that all that the scriptures had said about the saints or the believers in Christ are true and shall fully be manifested.
Your life is the fulfillment of Prophecies as Jesus. For as He is so are you in this world.
And if you are of Christ, then you are also a seed of Abraham!You are a prophetic child.DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 61:1-7; Luke 4:18,41; Jeremiah 31:15; Matthew 2:18;  Micah 5:2; John 7:42) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be established in the certainty of the scriptures as God's prophetic revelation of our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 Timothy 62 Timothy 1 - 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 705 - THIS JESUS 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Just in case you are struggling with any addiction, turn to Jesus and receive the supply of Grace to live free from every lawless deed. He is not against you, He is your teacher and helper. Enjoy His grace today! Author Saturday, 28th December, 2024 THIS JESUS 4"Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ." Acts 17:3 (KJV)The previous episodes outlined some Prophecies which were fulfilled by Jesus at His birth.Though Jesus is the revelation of God's consistent true character and reality, He also lived as the fulfilment of Messianic Prophecies.All believers in Christ acknowledge Jesus as the lamb of God who died for the Salvation of men. Yet few of them are conscious of the Messianic reality of Jesus.Most Jews didn't see Jesus as the Promised Messiah because instead of looking at the scriptures, they were looking at the limited worldview and perception of how they think a Messiah should be.
Jesus’ birth, ministry, death, resurrection, His role in the church and His everlasting reign, are clearly articulated in the scriptures.
In this season as people are celebrating "Christmas" as the celebration of the birth of Jesus, they must have the consciousness that His birth was the fulfillment of the birth of the Messiah.The Jewish people were waiting for a Messiah who would act as a rebel deliverer against the Romans. They didn't know his way of Salvation and establishment of His kingdom was through the dispensing of life through His death and resurrection.
Jesus didn't come to destroy men, He came to destroy the works of the devil.
The first hint of His coming was with a clear mission, to destroy the dominion of the devil."And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel." Genesis 3:15 (KJV)Most people think Jesus is going to achieve that in the future. Not at all. He's done that already."He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil." 1 John 3:8 (KJV)
Jesus came to destroy the sin problem the devil created through his deceptive work.
Look at what was said about Jesus:"Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost. Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily. But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost. And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins." Matthew 1:18-21(KJV)The Salvation of people from their sins was destroying the works of the devil and the crushing of his authority through the cross.Through the deception of the adversary, sin entered man, he became corrupt and dead.
Jesus was born to destroy the works of the devil, deliver man from the corruption of sin and quicken him with life from death.
" And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses; Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross; And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it." Colossians 2:13-15 (KJV)These verses explain how Jesus destroyed the works of the devil.Oh hallelujah!No wonder when Jesus was born, the devil worked through Herod to kill the child. The moment he realized the promised seed was born, he thought of eliminating the child to abort God's eternal plan."Then Herod, when he realized that he had been tricked by the magi, was extremely angry, and he sent [soldiers] and put to death all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that area who were two years old and under, according to the date which he had learned from the magi." Matrew 2:16 (Amplified Bible).However, the Prophets gave a hint of this event and God's escape plan for the Messiah. You know sometimes you assume the devil is omniscient.Do you think he knows everything about you and your future?
Listen, he may have an assumption of a glorious thing God is up to with you but doesn't know how God is going to do it.
Don't give him a lot of credence. He is not ahead of you, he is far behind schedule. Be in tune with God and follow His plan for your life. Act fast when the Lord instructs.The devil didn't know the King was born. But God knew how the devil was going to react and went ahead to work out His escape plan for the child.And the Prophet Jeremiah said:"This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.” (Jeremiah 31:15)The Prophet Hosea saw God's preserving plan:"When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son" (Hosea 11:1)
The preservation of Jesus was the preservation of the promised seed that shall destroy the works of the devil or crush his head.
The goal of the devil was to destroy the seed. All through the life of Jesus and public ministry, people in authority sought to kill him. "Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him" (Matthew 12:14, See also,  Mark 3:6, 11:18; Luke 6:11; John 11:53)What they didn't know was that they were doing the work of the devil. However, as part of God's eternal plan, Jesus must die at a time to destroy the works of the devil.As much as they sought to kill Jesus, His time had not yet come so they couldn't.Finally, when the time was right, Jesus gave Himself up to die. They didn't know the one they were seeking to kill was their Messiah. However, the devil also didn't know that the death of Jesus was for his works to be destroyed and for Salvation to be made available unto all men."but the precious blood of Christ—who like a spotless, unblemished lamb was sacrificed for us. This was part of God’s plan, for he was chosen and destined for this before the foundation of the earth was laid, but he has been made manifest in these last days for you" 1 Peter 1:19-20 (TPT).OH THANK YOU JESUS!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 2:1-3; Acts 4:27-28; Psalm 109:4; Jeremiah 11:19; Isaiah 53:2-5) WE PRAY We pray that we shall enjoy the full reality of Christ's work on the cross which destroyed the works of the devil. And we shall not live as victims of the dominion of the devil. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20242 Timothy 3 - 4Titus 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I enjoy the full reality of Christ's work.- I am not a victim of the devil.- I have dominion over the devil.- My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. - Jesus is the CHRIST. - Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 706 - THIS JESUS 5 — Jesus in the "Tanakh"
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your faith shouldn’t just be reduced towards your excellence in exams, acquiring a job, acquisition of things, and other personal interests. Your faith must be focused on achieving great things for the Lord. The greatest thing you can do with your faith is to serve the Lord’s great purpose. Selah! Author Sunday, 29th December, 2024 THIS JESUS 5 — Jesus in the "Tanakh""Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ." Acts 17:3 (KJV) In the present day Israel, and other Jewish communities around the world, some Jewish leaders have forbidden their fellow Jews from reading the New Testament (Brit Hadashah). Even with the reading of the Tanakh in their synagogues, some exclude certain Messianic scriptures.The Tanakh is the Jewish sacred book, just as we have the Bible as a sacred book. The TaNaKH is an acronym, it refers to the three sections of their shared text. The Tanakh (or TaNaKH) consist of: - Torah (the Law and the Pentateuch) - Nevi'im (the prophets)- Ketuvim (the writings) The Tanakh is what Bible Translators refer to as the "Old Testament" in the Bible. Note: As I have explained, the Old Testament is not Genesis to Malachi. The Old Testament refers to the Covenant which was wrought at Sinai (Exodus 19-20). The Old Testament is not a book of the Bible. The Old Testament is an arrangement of a dispensation at Sinai. The Jewish people must know that the covenant which was initiated at Sinai was not part of God’s promise to Abraham. Thus, that covenant at Sinai was not in God's plan and was a parenthesis. The real deal was what God established with Abraham. God did not deal with Abraham according to the Old Testament or the "Old Covenant". He dealt with Abraham according to the Covenant of Promise (See Galatians 3). It is called "Old" because its effect and function are now obsolete. There is now a New Covenant or Testament. Just as the Prophet Jeremiah declared: "The day is coming,” says the LORD, “when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah. This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and brought them out of the land of Egypt. They broke that covenant, though I loved them as a husband loves his wife,” says the LORD. “But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel after those days,” says the LORD. “I will put my instructions deep within them, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people" Jeremiah 31:31-33 (NLT) These Jews only restrict themselves to the reading of the Tanakh and don't even attempt to open the New Testament. They don't know that the New Testament was written to them as well. The first words in the New Testament portion of the Bible unveil the very core root of the New Testament. The New Testament has its roots in two major covenants: 1. The Covenant of Promise which God established with Abraham.2. And the Everlasting Kingdom Covenant God established with David. "This is the scroll of the lineage and birth of Jesus, the Anointed One, the son of David and descendant of Abraham." Matthew 1:1 (TPT). These covenants were not only limited to Israel or Jews (to be precise) but to all people. 
The Anointed One did not come only for the household of Israel but also as the lamb of God that takes away the sin of the world. 
The New Testament authors were able to comprehend the concealed reality of God in the Tanakh (Old Testament portion of the Bible), by the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit of God gives understanding. It's the Holy Spirit who moved the prophets to write about Jesus Christ (Messiah) even before His days. Which means it will take the Holy Spirit to decrypt the words of the Prophets and the scriptures. The Tanakh (Old Testament) doesn't contradict the New Testament. Neither does the New Testament contradict the "Old Testament".  The New Testament portion of the Bible is the unveiling of the mysteries in the scriptures. Most Jews refuse to open the New Testament and it is also a deceptive strategy of the adversary to keep them blinded and their minds veiled from the true revelation of Jesus.
When one turns to the Lord with an open heart, his or her heart and mind will be flooded with the glorious light of truth.
"We are not like Moses, who used a veil to hide the glory to keep the Israelites from staring at him as it faded away. Their minds were closed and hardened, for even to this day that same veil comes over their minds when they hear the words of the former covenant. The veil has not yet been lifted from them, for it is only eliminated when one is joined to the Messiah. So until now, whenever the Old Testament is being read, the same blinding comes over their hearts. But the moment one turns to the Lord with an open heart, the veil is lifted and they see. Now, the “Lord” I’m referring to is the Holy Spirit, and wherever He is Lord, there is freedom."  2 Corinthians 3:13-17 (TPT) When you genuinely study the scriptures, it will not move you away from Jesus. A study of the scriptures with an open heart will lead you to Jesus Christ. The Lord was not exaggerating when He said, "... But the scriptures point to me" John 5:39 (NLT). The Psalmist said: "I long for Your salvation, O LORD, And Your law is my delight." Psalm 119:174 (NKJV). The law doesn't give Salvation, the law will lead you to Salvation. Those who truly delight in Salvation will be led to the Lord. Because the Lord is Salvation.  
Maintain an open heart to know the Lord through the scriptures. 
The knowledge of the revelation of Jesus is what launches you into the enjoyment of your freedom to participate in the inheritance of the saints in the light. OH THANK YOU JESUS!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 25:5; Psalm 86:11; Psalm 143:10; 2 Chronicles 16:9; Romans 1:20; Isaiah 61:1) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall bring us into the knowledge of Himself into our hearts through His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Titus 2 - 3Philemon DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is opened to the knowledge of Jesus. – My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 707 - BE RENEWED IN STRENGTH 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Refuse to be careful. Refuse to be afraid. Refuse to be intimidated. Refuse to quit. When you quit, you cannot see what the Lord has said He will do through you. Selah! Author Monday, 30th December, 2024 BE RENEWED IN STRENGTH 1"But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint." Isaiah 40:31 (KJV)On a normal day, you know you are healthy, and you have the physical strength or energy to go about your business or daily tasks. But even though you are physically strong, there are certain tasks you realize you are not able to execute because you feel weak inwardly.Though being healthy and physically fit is good, people who accomplish big things don't do it because they have physical strength. It doesn't take men with big muscles to do big things. Mental strength is always powerful than physical strength. 
A man with super mental strength will rule over a man who has more  physical strength.
Take good care of your body, so that it can carry your strong mind. However don't just build muscles, without building your mind.While mental strength is great, there is such a thing as divine strength, which is greater.Have you heard a healthy person saying, "I don't have the strength to conitnue this task", before?Such people do not mean that they are sick or weak. What they mean is that they lack the inner capacity or vigor for the task.Every task or assignment requires a special capacity for execution.
A man is sustained by the inward strength he has built.
"If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small" Proverbs 24:10 (KJV)The strength you have determines what you can withstand and conquer. There are some tasks or challenges, your physical strength wouldn't be able to help you conquer. There are others your mental strength wouldn't be enough to sustain you."He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail." 1 Samuel 2:9 Berean Standard Bible).To prevail is to be great or exceedingly mighty. And there is a certain degree of greatness which your own strength cannot sustain.We find the solution here:"Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts." Zechariah 4:6 (ESV)Beyond the self-generated might or power, there is the might and power of the Spirit.
The strength of the Spirit produces in you an unceasing flow of divine strength to do anything God has called you to do.
As part of the promise of the Holy Spirit, Jesus outlines the function of the Holy Spirit in the believer:"And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper (Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor—Counselor, Strengthener, Standby), to be with you forever" John 14:16 (Amplified Bible)From the above verse, you will find that the function or role of the Holy Spirit in a believer is who He is in you forever.The Holy Spirit is not just in you to comfort and strengthen you. The Holy Spirit is in you forever as the Strengthener and comforter.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strengthen in you.
Whenever people think of the need to receive strength or to have strength they think of the outward activities they can engage.The kind of strength the Prophet Isaiah wrote about in chapter 40 of his prophetic book wasn't about physical strength. He was writing about divine strength.And to have this divine strength is to behold and have the LORD."O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him." Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV)
You don't separate what God supplies or gives to you from Him.
Whatever God gives you and makes you become, that is who He is. Thus, whatever God gives to you, is who He is. God doesn't just give you things He gives you Himself.God gives you wisdom because He is Wisdom. He brings you Salvation because He is Salvation. He brings you righteousness because He is Righteousness. He brings you strength because He is Strength.People try to look for divine strength without God. You cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength you must have God.
As believer in Christ you have the advantage, God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_--SnHZsxbQDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; John 15:5; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for being our strength and also the supply of strength within us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024James 1 - 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord is my strength. - I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. - The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. - I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 708 - BE RENEWED IN STRENGTH 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you begin to see images you don’t want, shift your mind from them and redirect your imagination to the glorious pictures and results the Lord has deposited in your spirit. Selah! Author Tuesday, 31st December, 2024 BE RENEWED IN STRENGTH 2"But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint." Isaiah 40:31 (KJV) To have the strength of God, you must turn to Him and receive Him as life. As I mentioned in the previous episode, whatever God is, He dispenses into you.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strength in you.
The Holy Spirit dispenses and distributes all of the virtues of God into you. "O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him." Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV) The Prophet Isaiah explains the extensiveness and limitlessness of the strength of God (Isaiah 40:12-28). Now you see in verses 29 - 31, the Prophet Isaiah explains how God supplies strength to those who are His. Because God's strength doesn't faint, those who faint are strengthened by Him.  "He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength. Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint." Isaiah 40:29-31 (KJV) The phrase, "even the youth shall faint", is a depiction of how the most strongest shall faint even in their prime. The youthful season is the prime season of every natural thing.  It is normal to faint in old age. It may even seem normal to grow weak after you have been pressed by challenges. It may seem normal to grow tired and become exhausted.
Yet the testimony of those who WAIT upon the Lord is different. Those who WAIT upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
Now the Lord gives power to the faint and causes strength and ability to abound towards those who lack might. It doesn't matter how the vicissitudes have beaten you up and crushed you, the moment you turn and open up to the LORD, strength is dispensed and distributed to you. As I have mentioned, you cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength you must have God.As a believer in Christ, you have the advantage, God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
You can accomplish more with the strength of God when it is RENEWED. To RENEW the strength of God, you must learn to WAIT UPON THE LORD.
To wait upon the Lord is not just an imagery of a "Waiter" in a restaurant. The word WAIT is from the Hebrew word, "qâvâh . The primitive root for "qâvâh" means "TO BIND TOGETHER". To wait upon the Lord means to look patiently to the Lord, to expect and to be tied to the Lord. It means you are knitted and plaited with and to the LORD. Jesus said, “I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless." John 15:5 (TPT) In as much as it is good to be a tree, it is far greater and better to be a branch. The strength and fruitfulness of a branch is dependent on the tree. You must be knitted to the Lord as a fruitful branch is to a great tree. Don't be separated and be distracted or moved away from the Lord.
The more you remain in the Lord, the more you are renewed in strength.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FkgGB6V9Q9EDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 27:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted nor become prideful but will always remain rooted and established in the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024James 4 - 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my strength. – I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. – The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. – I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 709 - THE LORD IS YOUR SPECIAL POSSESSION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency BLESSED NEW YEAR TO YOU DEAREST with SUBSCRIBERS AND READERS. YOU SHALL ENJOY THE PROFIT OF THE LORD IN THIS NEW YEAR. Author Wednesday, 1st January, 2025 THE LORD IS YOUR SPECIAL POSSESSION"The priests will not have any property or possession of land, for I alone am their special possession" Ezekiel 44:28 (NLT)Every born again in Christ has been born to Kingdom Royalty and Kingdom Priesthood.This has always been the dream of God to bring all men into this glorious PRIESTHOOD.When Moses went up to God, the Lord gave him words to speak to the children of Israel. Part of it was God’s intention to have a Kingdom of Priests."while Moses went up to God. The Lord called to him out of the mountain, saying, “Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob, and tell the people of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself. Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, you shall be my treasured possession among all peoples, for all the earth is mine; and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you shall speak to the people of Israel.” Exodus 19:3-6 (ESV)However, because of the enactment of another covenant at Sinai (which is the Old Covenant), for the people to become a Kingdom of Priests, they must fulfill their Covenant responsibilities.The Priesthood mandate among the Israelites was fulfilled by the Levites. All other tribes of Israel did not become priests.Through the obedience of Jesus, God's intention to have a Kingdom of Priests was fulfilled. The Israelites could not obey. They stumbled at the word of the Lord."But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his own possession, that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light" 1 Peter 2:9 (ESV)The beloved in Christ is a King and a Priest."And they sang a new song, saying:“You are worthy to take the scroll, And to open its seals;For You were slain, And have redeemed us to God by Your blood out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation, And have made us kings and priests to our God; And we shall reign on the earth.” Revelation 5:9-10 (NKJV)
As priests of God, we have the mandate to function in that reality and also to enjoy all that comes with the Priesthood.
The New Testament Priest executes the priestly responsibilities in Christ. The "Old Testament" priestly responsibilities foreshadow the responsibilities of the New Testament Priest.Just as the priests were consecrated by the anointing, the believer in Christ is also consecrated into Priesthood through Christ Jesus.The privileges of the Levitical priests in the Old Testament were also a foreshadowing of the privileges of the New Testament priests.
Of all the glorious realities of the Priesthood, the most crucial of them was the inheritance of the Priests.
Before the children of Israel occupied the promised land, instructions were given concerning the division of the land among the tribes of Israel."And you shall divide the land by lot as an inheritance among your families; to the larger you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance; there everyone’s inheritance shall be whatever falls to him by lot. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers." Numbers 35:54 (NKJV)As part of the instructions, Aaron and the Levites were not given any portion of the land.Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites." (Numbers 18:20)What a beautiful privilege of Priesthood!Because the priests were separated unto the Lord, they had the Lord as their portion.
To have the Lord as your portion or special possession is to have Him as your blessing and satisfaction. 
The believer in Christ doesn't first need material blessings as their satisfaction. The believer in Christ has the Lord as their inheritance and satisfaction. To have the Lord is to have all things because all things are His.Beloved you are a ROYAL PRIEST, and you have the LORD AS YOUR SPECIAL POSSESSION.Oh Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rxNjYdf44jIDIG DEEPER(Joshua 13:33; Deuteronomy 18:1-2; Psalm 16:5; Psalm 73:26; 2 Corinthians 3:5) WE PRAY We pray that we shall enjoy the  Lord as our portion and life in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 1 - 32 YEARS PLANGenesis 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a Royal Priest and I have the Lord as my special possession. - I am satisfied in the Lord. - The Lord is my inheritance. - The Lord is my life. - I function daily in the mandate of my Priesthood. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISDOE 710 - WALK IN WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The more you meditate on the love of God and cultivate your heart to express that love, the more it dominates your passions. Author Thursday, 2nd January, 2025 WALK IN WISDOM“I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just.” Proverbs 8:15 (TPT)The born again in Christ is translated from the power of darkness into the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus.
In His Kingdom, we are all made Kings and Priests.
“and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler over the kings of the earth.To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood, and has made us kings and priests to His God and Father, to Him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.” Revelation 1:5-6 (NKJV)Our reign as kings in Christ doesn’t begin after this present world has come to an end. Our reign as kings in Christ is not for the future. It is a NOW responsibility.The scripture says “He has made us…”, which means He is not now trying or planning to make us kings and priests.Concerning the saved ones, God says:“But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light” 1 Peter 2:9 (NKJV)You are part of the Lord’s nation of kinging-priests. You have the mandate to reign or rule in your sphere; and how you reign, is a display of God’s glory.
As kings in Christ, we are to lead our generation with WISDOM.
If in case you are still wondering why you must love Wisdom, this is it:Wisdom empowers Kings to reign.Hear what Wisdom says:“I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just. I empower princes to rise and take dominion, and generous ones to govern the earth.” Proverbs 8:15-16 (TPT)How well do you want to influence your world?How do you want to manifest God’s glory?How do you want to lead your generation?
Wisdom is the principal thing!
Be intentional about walking in Wisdom.Remember, the Word of God is the constitution of Wisdom.“Here are kingdom revelations, words to live by, and words of wisdom given to empower you to reign in life…” Proverbs 1:1 (TPT)
The impartation of the Word of God is the impartation of the revelation of Wisdom and spiritual understanding.
The more you fellowship with the Word of God, the more your thoughts are cultivated and shaped to be consistent with the Wisdom of God.Beloved, Love Wisdom; for by her you are empowered to reign as a King.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 1:1-7; 1 Kings 3:9-14;16-28; Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 8:18-19; Proverbs 3:3:14-24) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be imparted with the rich Secrets of Wisdom and understanding so that we will be able to acquire brilliant strategies for leadership in our generation.In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 4 – 62 YEARS PLANGenesis 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I love wisdom. – I function by wisdom. – Through wisdom, I build every aspect of my life. – The desires of my heart is glued to wisdom. – As I fellowship daily with the Word of God, I develop a strong love for wisdom and understanding. – I am full of wisdom. – I act in wisdom. – I do all things in wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 711 - SPEND TIME WITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Make a decision today to make the people around you see and understand God by how you live and love others. Practice the love of God. Selah!
