Author Friday, 3rd January, 2025SPEND TIME WITH THE LORD “He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk just as He walked.”1 John 2:6 (NKJV)Are you born again?If your answer is yes, then you are in Christ.When you received Jesus, you became born again. The born again is also the new creation.The new creation is the man in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:17)
To be in Christ is to be in the Spirit.
Thus, if you are in Christ, you must live as Christ.When you are thinking of being immersed in the Spirit, don’t adopt human techniques and religious methods. As you are in Christ you follow the example of Christ.
The matter of being immersed in the Spirit is not a matter of methods but a new living way.
To be immersed in the Spirit is an organic experience and not mechanical.That is why you follow the example of Christ.Christ brought to light the reality of being soaked and saturated by the Spirit.During Jesus’ Earth Walk, the Pharisees or the religious leaders were demonstrating spirituality according to their self-gratification, man-made rules, religious traditions and legalism.Everyone saw them as men who were enriched with divine understanding and had high-level experience in the Spirit.But Jesus said to them, “Making the word of God of no effect through your tradition which you have handed down. And many such things you do” Mark 7:13 (NKJV)
The word of God is organic and cannot find its full expression when mixed with mechanical methods.
To have a real organic experience of the Spirit, you don’t follow religious methods.Indisputably, one of the crucial items to make one continuously experience the saturation of the Spirit is PRAYER.However, your understanding and interpretation of prayer really matter.When prayer is only to prove how spiritual one is, the motives become wrong.
The principle of prayer is the principle of intimate communication. Your understanding of this will help you remain consistent in PRAYER.
The Pharisees and the religious leaders prayed to prove their superiority over others. Prayer was showmanship to them.However, Jesus showed us that prayer is basically a communion with God.In most of the recorded prayers of Jesus, you will notice He often referred to God as Father. That was to establish the kind of relationship we are to have with God.God is your Father and you must commune with Him as such. This is the example of Jesus to us. He showed us to walk consistently in the Spirit by maintaining a consistent relationship and communion with God as our Father.
Until you begin to recognise, understand and become conscious that God is your Father, you will always attempt to use mechanisms to connect to God.
Prayer will become a mechanic method and not an organic expression of your relationship with God.You will spend more time with your loving Father, and freely share your burdens with Him. The more you spend time with the Father through prayer (intimate communication), the more the Father’s love and presence overwhelm, saturate and soak your heart.
The more you spend time with Him, the more you are immersed into His person and mindset.
Pray to the Father as Jesus did.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXXfkBuNfgsDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16; Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts and minds will be set on the example of Jesus, and that our walk in the Spirit will be according to His light and not religious methods BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 7 – 92 YEARS PLANGenesis 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart and mind is set on the example of Jesus.– My walk in the spirit is according to His light and not any religious methods. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 712 - PRACTICE LONG FELLOWSHIP TIMES WITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To have the word of God yield results in your life, you must refuse to doubt what God has said. Sometimes the challenges may seem to be overwhelming but don’t be moved by what you see. Stay GRIT in the Word of God. Selah! Author Saturday, 4th January, 2025 PRACTICE LONG FELLOWSHIP TIMES WITH THE LORD“Now at this time Jesus went off to the mountain to pray, and He spent the whole night in prayer to God.” Luke 6:12 (Amplified)Whatever God has put in your heart to achieve will be done according to His own ability.Your human strength is insufficient for what God has called you to do.The Angel said to Mary, “For with God nothing is ever impossible and no word from God shall be without power or impossible of fulfillment.” Luke 1:37 (AMPC)The projects ahead of you which seem impossible, become possible when God is with you.
As a man in Christ, God is with you, however, you must intentionally be with God as well in all you do.
Make intentional decisions to pray and to minister unto the Lord.Though God loves you and wants to partner with you to achieve His dreams for you, He wouldn’t force His partnership on you. You have to intentionally engage the Lord. He may put desires in your heart to draw you close to Himself, and He will put subtle longings of fellowship into your heart. This is to lead you into times of fellowship with Him. And when you become prompt to respond and to be consistent with it, your inward capacity and abilities expand for big things.
Develop the habit of spending time with God patiently. Don’t rush out of the place of prayer and fellowship with the Spirit.
You can only have the best of each relationship when you are willing to invest time.Jesus our Lord, showed us the need for consistent communion with the Father.Jesus started His ministry by first staying in fellowship with the Father, for 40 days and 40 nights.What was He doing?Praying and communing with the Father.
Jesus didn’t start His ministry without first having a long session of communion with the Father.
How are you starting your year?Don’t leave things to chance, spend long hours of fellowship with the Spirit. He has the master plan for the year and each month. He knows the steps you have to take and the people you have to meet. He knows the resources you need to do what He has destined you to do. Stay long with Him.The vision of God was made clear and also intensified in the heart of Moses after he separated himself to be with the Lord for 40 days and 40 nights.When Moses returned He was soaked with a dimension of God’s glory to the extent that the skin of his face changed.“But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and whenever he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded, the sons of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone. So Moses would replace the veil over his face until he went in to speak with Him.” (Exo 34:34-35 NAS)
The more you stay long with God, the more you are immersed in His presence and His word shines in your heart.
It is great to have quality time with the Lord. However, to have a long quantity and quality of time with the Lord is the most treasured moment in your life.In this present age of speed, everyone is in haste. They want to get into prayer, blast in 5-minute tongues and expect to receive or download immeasurable eternal virtues.In a world of fast food, fast internet, video reels, shorts, recaps, quick rise to fame, highly fast vehicles, fast computers, and swift money transfer mediums, people have become more impatient.People easily get offended and displeased, when they are not seeing answers to prayers as fast as they want. They become agitated and tensed easily. Frowns at God and the spiritual principles, just as they frown and hit on their mobile devices when an app doesn’t open between a microsecond to 2 seconds.Everyone is interested in fast-charging cables for their batteries.Thus, to stay 5 hours or 16 hours in prayers and communion with the Lord, seems to be a waste of time to most people of this generation. Everyone seems to be in a hurry.People are in haste to please the world and not in haste to please the Father.Beloved, take your time, and patiently stay in communion with the Holy Spirit.This is how you can mount up high with wings as an Eagle. 
If you don’t want to faint in the journey of your destiny, learn to stay long in fellowship with the Lord.
Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPB64uq5QO4DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29) WE PRAYWe pray to increase in patience to stay and enjoy divine virtues and verities in the Lord’s presence, as we commune with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 10 – 122 YEARS PLANGenesis 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 713 - CHARGE UP YOURSELF IN FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Stop worrying and start praying. Pray over everything no matter how little it may seem to be. Beloved, pray! Author Sunday, 5th January, 2025CHARGE UP YOURSELF IN FAITH"But you, my delightfully loved friends, constantly and progressively build yourselves up on the foundation of your most holy faith by praying every moment in the Spirit.” Jude 1:20 (TPT). We do what God tells us to do by faith!You will stagger, give up or maintain a strong confidence in God according to your faith. We win and exercise our victory in Christ amidst opposition by Faith.  (1 John 5:4) We grow and increase in faith through the ministry of the word. (Romans 10:17). Faith operates by the word of God, not by vim or some philosophy. Without the word of God, there is no potent faith. To act in faith is to act on the Word. ”And since we have the same spirit of faith, according to what is written, “I believed and therefore I spoke,” we also believe and therefore speak,” 2 Corinthians 4:13 (NKJV). You have believed what God has said, and what He has said is His WORD. Faith only speaks what God has said.However, from Jude 20, we see how you have to build yourself up on your most holy faith: ”But you, my delightfully loved friends, constantly and progressively build yourselves up on the foundation of your most holy faith by praying every moment in the Spirit” Jude 1:20 (TPT). There are moments and situations where you may feel weak, discouraged, and even dull in faith.However, you can constantly and progressively build yourself up:PRAY IN THE SPIRIT!
To pray in the spirit is also to pray in other tongues.
It’s interesting how people who don’t pray in tongues mock the effectual workings of praying in the spirit. Beloved, it builds you up in faith, when you pray in tongues every moment. As you pray in tongues you pray to God and speak mysteries. You decode spiritual things in the spirit as you pray in the spirit. When there is a moment when you feel so much pressure, and it seems you don’t have the right words to speak; BELOVED, don’t cry or complain. Don’t feel helpless when you are overwhelmed by situations. There is a way forward:PRAY IN THE SPIRIT.As you pray you make the supply of spiritual strength and you stir up the anointing of the Holy Spirit in you. You also charge up yourself in faith. Your spirit rises higher and higher in faith, like an edifice.
The more you pray in the spirit, the more the Spirit of the Lord supplies your spirit with the right words to declare.
As you pray in the spirit, the Holy Spirit through your spirit broods over your mind, will and emotions. Therefore, the more you pray, the more you take hold of the present word of God. And as the present word or the rhema of God, wells up in your spirit, it saturates your mind, aligns your will to God, and channels your emotions and desires.
Because the rhema has soaked your entire being, it comes forth without doubt.
At this point, the present word or the rhema of God will gush forth with a force and the ability of God to produce effectual results.COME ON!WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?SEIZE THIS MOMENT TO STIR UP THE ANOINTING OF THE HOLY GHOST BY PRAYING IN TONGUES TO CHARGE UP YOURSELF. Become a partner today! DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 14:2; 4:14-15,18; Ephesians 6:18; Acts 10:44-46) WE PRAYThat our hearts will catch the very present word of God concerning every situation as we pray in the spirit BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 13 – 152 YEARS PLANGenesis 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t complain nor cry, I pray. – I give no place to the adversary. – As I pray in the spirit, I catch the very present word of God for my situation. – I don’t walk in doubt, fear or anxiety because through praying in the spirit I receive rhema. – Through praying in the spirit, I align my heart, will, mind, emotions and desires to the Will of God for me. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 714 - THE INFLUENCE OF THE SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you begin to recognise, understand and become conscious that God is your Father, you will always attempt to use mechanisms to connect to God. Selah! Author Monday, 6th January, 2025 THE INFLUENCE OF THE SPIRIT“Stop getting drunk with wine, which leads to wild living, but keep on being filled with the Spirit.” Ephesians 5:18 (International Standard Version)This year is a glorious year with great visions. There are mighty things the Lord is inspiring you to do.If you have not yet received inspiration for what to do, you must set a moment to capture fresh inspirations from the Lord.There is nothing God tells you to do (no matter how little), that is not great. Anything God tells you to do is great.This is why whatever God tells you to do, He works in partnership with you to achieve it. He doesn’t instruct you to do something and then He leaves you on your own. 
He is the only King who sends His messengers and still goes with them to accomplish their duty.
This is the work of the Holy Spirit in your life. The Holy Spirit in you, is God indwelling you to walk and work with you.It is up to you to be intentional about your partnership with the Holy Spirit.Don’t just wake up to embark on your divine assignment without Him; you must work with the Holy Spirit.Jesus said, “without me you can do nothing” (John 15:5) and this is why He decided to send another Helper (John 14:16). The Holy Spirit is here to help you.From the opening verse, we see that the infilling of the Holy Spirit is not a one-time event or experience, but a continuous experience.“Stop getting drunk with wine, which leads to wild living, but keep on being filled with the Spirit.” Ephesians 5:18 (ISV)
Also being filled with the Spirit as a continuous experience is hinted by the phrase “KEEP ON”.
Did you notice the two parallel experiences of influence?If you want to know how you should be continuously immersed in the Spirit, see what one looks like when he is immersed in drunkenness.When you KEEP ON being filled with the Spirit your being is influenced and soaked with the Spirit, like how one is influenced and gets drunk by wine.When one gets drunk by wine, his movements, thoughts and speech are influenced by the drunkenness. The same is true with a man immersed in the Spirit.
When you keep on being filled with or immersed in the Spirit, you come under the influence of the Spirit. The Spirit influences your movements, thoughts and speech.
There is a way a man who is immersed in the Spirit daily, thinks and lives.You live according to the power of God. You demonstrate love according to the influence of the Spirit.The love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5).You are not controlled by the lust of the flesh. The power of the love of Christ gains preeminence over the man who is saturated by the Spirit.
Are you under the influence of the Spirit or you are under the influence of this world?
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQCr54a1arADIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16; 1 John 2:6; Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19; Ezekiel 47:1-10) WE PRAYThat we shall continue to live under the influence of the Holy Spirit who is our great HELPER BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 16 – 182 YEARS PLANGenesis 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My plans, ideas and desires are soaked and immersed in the Holy Spirit. – I am under the influence of the Holy Spirit. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 715 - ENLARGE YOUR CAPACITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t spend your time, your thoughts, money, attention, and energy on the things of men like there is no cause. God is wrapping up His eternal plan. Therefore, the devil is moving faster ahead of his time to sway off many believers and to destroy more destinies. It is now your time to go all out for Jesus! It is your time to finish the course of Christ. Selah! Author Tuesday, 7th January, 2025ENLARGE YOUR CAPACITY“There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God.”2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)All that God has put in you are not for you; they are to bless nations. The impartation of God’s blessings in you is to cause you to make IMPACT in others.
Whenever God wants to bless a people He sends a man.
While Joseph was living a challenging life from slavery to prison, God was preparing him to be the escape for Jacob in the days of famine (Genesis 45:7). When Israel agonised with pain in Egypt, God raised Moses and sent him as their deliverer.However, God gave a word that He would go down to Egypt to save His people Israel. This means God sending Moses to Egypt was Himself going to Egypt to save Israel. (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10; Acts 7:33-35).There are men whom God raised to be channels or conduits of blessings to their generation. And you (reading this with today) are one of the blessings God has sent to bless this generation.The grace and abilities of God within you are part of the answers God is sending to this generation at such a time as this.Nevertheless, you cannot fulfill this great mandate without God. To affect many lives positively you have to enlarge your capacity.“Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.” Isaiah 54:2-3 (KJV)To enlarge your capacity, you have to stretch your inner man through consistent and persistent long intense prayers.To begin with, I want you to know it is wrong to think short quick prayers are not prayers. Every prayer is prayer. The quality of prayer is not really how long you’ve prayed. The quality of prayer is how well it is founded on the word of God.
Every prayer rooted in the word is effective!
 THEREFORE NO MATTER WHAT, PRAY!So then, if even short quick prayers can be effective, much more when you give yourself to consistent long intense prayers?The idea of consistent long intense prayers is not about God expecting you to beg Him for long before He does something for you. Consistent long intense prayers are about having quality time with the Spirit.
The longer you spend time with the Spirit of the Lord in prayer, the stronger His influence on you becomes.
The Spirit of God enlarges your Spirit and strengthens your inner man. The anointing of the Holy Spirit on you becomes stronger.
Are you wondering what to say or pray about?
Cheer up!There is the gift of praying in the Spirit. Praying in the spirit includes praying in other tongues.Get this:“The one who speaks in tongues advances his own spiritual progress…” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (TPT)Since tongues speaking will cause you to advance your spiritual progress, or edify (embolden, build or construct your inner man), then do it more to make more spiritual progress!Beloved, even ten minutes of tongues speaking will build your spirit. Therefore make time to pray in tongues for 30 or 60 minutes; then grow it to 2 hours, and then 6 hours.
The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God.
What are you waiting for?Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:30-31; Luke 18:1; Genesis 26:2; Isaiah 26:15; Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]) WE PRAYWe pray that against all odds and hindrances, we shall break forth in our spirit and maintain intense consistency in prayer.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 19 – 212 YEARS PLANGenesis 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Rather than worrying about the size of the assignment, I pray. – I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.  – Through my effective prayers, I increase in capacity to do more. – I don’t settle for less, I persist long in prayers. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!  [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 716 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t be afraid, the Lord will bring you into success, for He works in you both to will and to do to fulfill His good pleasure and purpose. Selah! Author Wednesday, 8th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you” John 15:16 (ASV)There is no single person who doesn't want specific positive results or outcomes from what they do. Results are basically an outcome of a cause.
To have God's Kingdom results, is to have results or success consistent with God's purpose and will.
Kingdom Results are also fruits produced unto the glory of God.This is the calling of God for every believer in Christ.From the opening verse, Jesus was as clear as a bell with His reason for appointing the disciples. There wasn't any uncertainty or ambiguity.“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide..."To APPOINT is from the Greek word "tithēmi", which means to ordain, to lay down, set in place or to set forth.In appointing His disciples, Jesus set them in place to produce or bear fruits. Discipleship according to Jesus, is for fruit-bearing or Kingdom results. To be a disciple of Jesus is to live to produce God-centered results. It is not about producing self-gratificating results as the people of the world. Your results must reflect and express the goodness and excellence of God's Kingdom.The interesting thing is this, Jesus doesn't produce the results or bear fruits for you as a believer in Christ. He only sets you up with all the resources and nourishment you need to produce consistent kingdom fruits.The grace of God is the nourishment of God supplied to you to make you fruitful. As apostle Paul said, "... and His grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain..." (1 Corinthians 15:10). 
The abundant supply or grace of God makes you responsible.
This means that to have Kingdom results you must be intentional. You don't automatically get Kingdom results.1. You have to make a decision you are going to do much more as a disciple of Jesus. You don't have to wish for results, you have to decide. Your decisions influence your actions.The evidence that the decision is not a wish is in the consistent steps you take towards it. By God's own creative system, nothing works effectively until you make it work.2. Be Consumed with the Success of the Kingdom.As it was noted by the disciples of Jesus, as He entered the temple to set things in order; "That’s when his disciples remembered the Scripture: “I am consumed with a fiery passion to keep your house pure!” John 2:17 (TPT)Jesus didn't allow the temple to remain scattered. The temple was a symbolic representation of God's kingdom system. Jesus didn't allow things to remain as He met them. He didn't just wish for change, He took steps to bring change.
Don't allow the Kingdom to remain as you met it. Be the reason the Kingdom will grow and expand.
Beloved, this new year offers you the opportunities to achieve Kingdom results. Take steps!Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:4-5; 1 Peter 2:9; Colossians 1:10; Matthew 28:19; Philippians 1:11) WE PRAYPray that by the wisdom of God at work in you, you shall be able to take advantage of the resources of God supplied to you to produce Kingdom fruits. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 19 – 212 YEARS PLANGenesis 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I bear much more fruits unto the glory of God. - I am blessed by the Lord to be fruitful. - My fruits glorify the Father. - I am a true disciple of Jesus because I bear much fruits. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 717 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 2 — Contend for the Results 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your ability to do more begins with what you see and how you see what you see. Oftentimes the Lord charges His people to see. This is because you cannot experience what you have not seen with your heart or the spirit of your mind. Selah! Author Thursday, 9th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 2 — Contend for the Results 1“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you” John 15:16 (ASV)No matter how much you wish to achieve great Kingdom results, you may still not produce them until you act or take consistent steps towards them.From the revelation of the scriptures, you will realize fruit-bearing is not an option. The goal of discipleship in God's Kingdom, is for you to produce fruits consistent with the good pleasure of His will.See what Jesus said, "Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples." (John 15:8)In your fruit-bearing or Kingdom results, your Heavenly Father is glorified.This doesn't happen automatically, simply because you are a disciple of Jesus.  You can be a disciple of Jesus and still not bear fruits. To produce results there are specific things to do. A few points were mentioned from part 1 of this series or previous episode:1. You have to make a decision you are going to do much more as a disciple of Jesus. 2. Be Consummed with the Success of the Kingdom.
Until you become interested in and passionate about the kingdom's success, you will not be willing to take steps to make it happen.
God and His Kingdom must become your priority. Until God is your priority you cannot invest in Him. Your heart must be after God.One question you must always ask yourself is this:How deep is my love and jealousy for God?When you don't love the Lord, you will not be willing to go the extra mile for His course. You will always make excuses and seek self-pleasure.Challenges may surface to resist your attempts to produce results. You don't have to give up or drawback. There is something important you need to do:3. Contend for results.Results require a relentless posture of faith. Because of the adversary's resistance, your results will always come with a fight. This is not a fight to obtain victory; it is a fight to unleash and enforce the victory that you have obtained in Christ.You don't have to fake or pretend that you have the results, you must contend for it. To have results is a faith thing. You must contend and release your faith.
IT IS CALLED THE GOOD FIGHT OF FAITH!
Paul the apostle in his last epistle to Timothy made an affectionate heartthrob statement:"I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith." 2 Timothy 4:7 (NKJV)
This fight of faith is a good, worthy and noble fight. It is to contend earnestly the glorious contest to guard the faith.
In Paul's first epistle to Timothy, he instructed him to,"Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you were also called and have confessed the good confession in the presence of many witnesses." 1 Timothy 6:12As we have seen in the second epistle, Paul the apostle was instructing Timothy to do exactly what he was also doing. To have a fruitful experience of the faith, you must fight to express it. You must contend in faith.Again he said, as part of his epistle to the Church in Philippi, "I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus." Philippians 3:14 (NKJV)He has to press toward the goal because there were many things which may serve as limitations.To press on and to contend for the results means you are not holding anything back. You have to fight, run and strive for the results.
In your attempt to achieve results, you may be confronted by trial.
"Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him." (James 1:12).You have to persevere as a good soldier.As you are taking steps, you must remain resolute and daring. You have to press on against all odds to produce consistent Kingdom results.Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:12-13; Colossians 1:29; Galatians 6:9; 1 Corinthians 15:58) WE PRAYPray that as we labour in the faith, we shall strive with all of the Lord's energy working powerfully within us, and be steadfast, immovable and always excel in the work of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 22 – 252 YEARS PLANGenesis 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I produce kingdom Kingdom results. – I am blessed by the Lord to be fruitful. – My fruits glorify the Father. – I am a true disciple of Jesus because I bear much fruits. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 718 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 3 — Contend for the Results 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The storms may come, the waters may roar, the mountains may be carried into the sea, don’t be afraid nor shaken. Remain resolute in the Lord. Remain confident in who God is and His ability. Look away from the trouble and look to God, who is your refuge and strength. Hallelujah! Author Friday, 10th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 3 — Contend for the Results 2“I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus" Philippians 3:14 (NKJV)Jesus did not come to supply grace just to produce irresponsible believers. 
Every disciple has a mandate to fulfill and a fruit to bear.
Being fruitless as a disciple of Jesus is not consistent with the intention of God. To bear fruits and to produce relevant kingdom results is not by chance. You have to make a choice to press on till you manifest the results.Just because Christ is in you doesn't mean the gospel of Jesus will spread in your city automatically. You must contend and wage warfare with the prophetic word to see lives changed.You must take bold and determined steps to multiply the impact of the gospel within your city.There are people who expect to see a word they've received from the Lord come to pass automatically. But it doesn't work like that. 
Every word must be put to work.
God told the Israelites He had given them the land for their possession. Yet for them to physically possess the land they have to fight to enforce the word of the Lord."At that time I gave this command to the tribes that would live east of the Jordan: ‘Although the LORD your God has given you this land as your property, all your fighting men must cross the Jordan ahead of your Israelite relatives, armed and ready to assist them." Deuteronomy 3:18 (NLT)Israel did not just walk into the land and announce to the occupants that this is our land, evacuate so we will peacefully settle down.
It doesn't work like that, and it didn't work like that.
Israel possessed the land promised to them by contending with their enemies. They knew the only way to occupy the land was by a fight to enforce the word of the Lord.Only today's believer thinks the enjoyment of His inheritance is automatic. There are always spiritual forces which will contend with the word of the Lord given to you.
You must not go to sleep, be ready for a fight.
CONTEND FOR THE RESULTS. DON'T SETTLE FOR LESS.Christ's mighty power is at work in you, to enable you to contend strenuously.The goal of Paul the apostle was to present every man perfect in Christ Jesus.To accomplish this, he had to exude God's might. It wasn't going to happen by accident."We proclaim Him, warning and instructing everyone in all wisdom [that is, with comprehensive insight into the word and purposes of God], so that we may present every person complete in Christ [mature, fully trained, and perfect in Him--the Anointed]. For this I labor [often to the point of exhaustion], striving with His power and energy, which so greatly works within me."Paul the apostle of the grace of God, established this reality all through His epistles to the Churches.Impact doesn't just happen. To see the results you must contend. To bear the fruits you must labor with what God has deposited inside you.It is a fight!
It is according to the force of the Spirit and the determination of your heart.
It is great to be content. However, contentment is not the opposite of contending. Contentment is not mediocrity and passivity. You must be content with what God has given you. And you contend to achieve greater results with what you have in you.Don't give up.
Press on until you reach your goal.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:12-13; Colossians 1:29; Galatians 6:9; 1 Corinthians 15:58) WE PRAYPray that we shall have the determination of heart and exercise the wisdom of God to contend with all the resources supplied by God to us to produce great results this year. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 26 – 282 YEARS PLANGenesis 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I contend for results. - I don't settle for less, I go for my goal. - I put every word of God given to me to put. - I produce kingdom Kingdom results. - Until I reach my goal, I refuse to give up. - My hands will handle that which my eyes have seen. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 719 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t break the cycle of multiplication. If you have saved a soul, get them to Church, where they will be trained through Christ-centered discipleship. Submit yourself also to Christ-centered discipleship in the Church where the Lord has planted you. Shalom! Author Saturday, 11th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 4“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you” John 15:16 (ASV)No disciple of Jesus is expected to be fruitless. Jesus called you to Himself that you will bear fruits which will remain. The fruits or results which you are to produce are not temporal results. They are results or fruits which must remain.The word "remain" is the Greek word, "menō" which means "to continually dwell, stand or endure".Your fruits or results must endure the test of time. Such results don't come by chance. They come by choice and genuine intentionality.1. You have to make a decision you are going to do much more as a disciple of Jesus.2. Be consummed with the Success of the Kingdom.3. Contend for results.4. Go all out and think possibilities.
When you think it is not possible you will not be able to activate the grace to get it done.
Most think of impossibility because they are conscious of failure. They think more of failing than succeeding. They set their minds on defeat rather than who God is and what He said.Like the 10 spies of Moses. They failed to think about what God is able to do with them. And rather saw themselves as grasshoppers."But the men who had gone up with him said, “We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.” And they gave the children of Israel a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, “The land through which we have gone as spies is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in it are men of great stature. There we saw the giants (the descendants of Anak came from the giants); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight.” Numbers 13:31-33 (NKJV)There is a way defeat mentality makes you not reason with logic. When you observe the report of these spies of Moses you can notice inconsistencies in their thoughts.How can a land flowing with milk and honey devour its inhabitants?If the land devoured its inhabitants, how did the Amalekites, the Hittites, the Jebusites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites dwell there? These people were able to build fortified cities.When these spies went to the land how were they able to survive? How was the land not able to devour them?Caleb and Joshua had a different report.When these people began to give their report (Numbers 13:2_-29), Caleb felt they were not going to produce the right sound, so he intercepted their report:"Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once and take possession, for we are well able to overcome it.” Numbers 13:30 (NKJV).These people went to the same land to spy on it, yet they came back with two different reports. One group thought they were grasshoppers, while the other saw their ability to overcome the land.
What you are able to do is always connected to your mindset. Beloved, your thoughts define your possessions.
The thoughts of fear will make you hold back and not dare to take a step forward.Instead of the spies communicating the weaknesses of the inhabitants of the land, they were amplifying the things they thought were the strengths of these inhabitants.When the Israelites heard the negative and doubtful news from the 10 spies they began to cry and rebel against the Lord (Numbers 14:1-4)Again we see the mindset of Joshua and Caleb:"But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes; and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying: “The land we passed through to spy out is an exceedingly good land. If the Lord delights in us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us, ‘a land which flows with milk and honey.’ Only do not rebel against the Lord, nor fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and the Lord is with us. Do not fear them.” Numbers 14:6-9 (NKJV)While the 10 spies saw giants,  Joshua and Caleb saw bread.While the 10 saw themselves as grasshoppers, Joshua and Caleb saw themselves as possessors.How do you see yourself?Do you see possibilities?If you do, then don't hold back, it's time to go all out.
There is a lot the Lord wants to accomplish through you this year.
Refuse to fear!Refuse to doubt!Start now and take bold steps!Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(Numbers 14:24; Joshua 14:12; Deuteronomy 31:6-8; Romans 4:20-21; 1 John 5:4-5) WE PRAYPray that we shall daily walk in the consciousness and confidence of God's help and that our eyes of understanding shall be open to see possibilities. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 29 – 312 YEARS PLANGenesis 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I bear much fruits for the Lord. - My fruits and results remain. - I produce kingdom Kingdom results. - I refuse to fear. - I refuse to see impossibilities. - I have the grace to get the job done. - I refuse to doubt the Lord of the Lord to me. - I walk in the consciousness and confidence of God's help. - The eyes of my understanding are opened to see possibilities at all times. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 720 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To doubt the truth and power of the word of God simply because you didn’t see your expectations is evidence that you are not exercising faith or not persevering in faith. Beloved, be persistent in faith. Author Sunday, 12th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 5“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you” John 15:16 (ASV)To produce Kingdom results, I have mentioned in the previous episodes four key things (not according to any special order) you must do, these include:1. You have to make a decision you are going to do much more as a disciple of Jesus.2. Be consumed with the Success of the Kingdom.3. Contend for results.4. Go all out and think of possibilities.The fifth key thing to do or note is that YOU ARE THE MAN FOR THE JOB.Most believers assume they are not qualified to achieve Kingdom results. They even think if they don't achieve the results, there are better people who will work effectively to achieve those results. Some also think the Kingdom will still advance without them, therefore they will live their lives and do what pleases them.When Jesus told His disciples to bear fruit, He was speaking to them not only corporately but also individually.He said, "I chose you, and appointed you."
How Jesus chose and appointed His disciples gives a clear idea that He spoke to them individually.
Jesus appointed His disciples individually.This was why the Bible didn't put the main disciples only in a group tag but clearly mentioned their names."At that time Jesus went to a mountain to pray. He spent the whole night in prayer to God.When it was day, he called his disciples. He chose twelve of them and called them apostles. They were Simon (whom Jesus named Peter) and Simon’s brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon (who was called the Zealot), Judas (son of James), and Judas Iscariot (who became a traitor)." Luke 6:12-16 (GOD'S WORD Translation)This shows that these disciples were not just a number in a crowd. They were individual members with a personal relationship with Jesus. The Lord works with us corporately and also individually.As the Good Shepherd, He said, "But the one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep. The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep recognize his voice and come to him. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out." John 10:2-3 (NLT)He knows and deals with you by name, even though you are within the sheepfold. For God to deal with you individually doesn't also suggest He doesn't deal with you within a fold. He has designed us uniquely to operate in His body, as individual members within a corporate body."For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ" 1 Corinthians 12:12 (ESV)Now as a member of the body of Christ, you must be fruitful for the benefit of the whole body. Imagine your hands or legs refusing to be fruitful in your body. This will affect the effectiveness of your mobility.You have to understand that God has placed you in His body with special responsibility. Your unfruitfulness is the unfruitfulness of the whole body. In the same way, your fruitfulness is the fruitfulness of the whole body.
God has made you special for His assignment.
Again Jesus said, "I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches..." John 15:5 (TPT)You noticed Jesus didn't say to His disciples you are "my branch"?Jesus said, "you're my branches", which means every individual disciple of Jesus is a branch. You are a branch, I am a branch, and the other disciple of Jesus is also a branch. We are all together as the branches of Christ Jesus. Each branch has the responsibility to bear fruits.Don't think producing results or bearing fruits is not your responsibility. Don't hide in the crowd. God has made you special and given you a special grace for the good works which He has foreordained.
Beloved, you are the man for the job!
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:10; John 10:14-16; 27-28; Isaiah 49:1-6; Jeremiah 1:5) WE PRAYPray that I will boldly run with the special mandate of God for me in His kingdom and produce results consistent with His purpose for my life. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 32 – 342 YEARS PLANGenesis 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the man for the job. - I boldly run the special mandate of God for my life. - I produce results which are consistent with the purpose of God for my life. - God has made me special for His assignment. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 721 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 6 – BE PART OF GOD'S MIGHTY MEN IN YOUR GENERATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, understanding is everything! Your life will always be governed by your level of light. Be determined this week to increase also in the understanding of the word of Christ. Shalom! Author Monday, 13th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 6 – BE PART OF GOD'S MIGHTY MEN IN YOUR GENERATION“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you” John 15:16 (ASV)If you have followed this series so far, you should be taking steps towards what God wants to accomplish through you. God didn't bring you Salvation or get you born again to live an ordinary life.
God wants your life to be a demonstration of abundant fruitfulness.
As I have mentioned in previous episodes:1. You have to decide you will do much more as a disciple of Jesus.2. Be consumed with the Success of the Kingdom.3. Contend for results.4. Go all out and think possibility.5. See yourself as the man for the job.Jesus said, "I chose you, and appointed you."God has made you special for His assignment. You were chosen in Him for good works which He has ordained that you walk in them. (Ephesians 2:10).This is why you have to see yourself as the man for the job.6. Be determined to be part of God’s Mighty Men in your generation.It is one thing to see yourself as the man for the job. And another thing altogether to become part of God’s mighty men within a generation. To be a mighty man is to be a person with exceptional and extraordinary results.To be a mighty man is to bear bountiful fruits or produce extra results. It is to dare to do what others run from. When Jesus was ascending, He entrusted His Church mandate into the hands of His disciples. These were young but had the hearts of mighty men.As Peter and John healed the cripple and were preaching about the power of Jesus, the Jewish leaders were angered. And were even left astonished, as they witnessed the bold courage of these disciples of Jesus. (Acts 4:13).As you study the scriptures, you will notice how many people were added to the Church in Jerusalem, Samaria, Antioch, etc. Yet there were people who became outstanding and were noticed. These people became the mighty men who led the course of Christ in their generation.God has not designed for some to bear more fruits or have greater results than others. 
God has given each of us the measure of grace for our unique assignments.
"Yet grace [God’s undeserved favor] was given to each one of us [not indiscriminately, but in different ways] in proportion to the measure of Christ’s [rich and abundant] gift." Ephesians 4:7 (Amplified Bible).God does not discriminate. He doesn't give more grace to one than the other. We all have grace according to the same measure of Christ's gift.
You become a mighty man in the Kingdom by what you accomplish with the grace of God which you received.
Take note of Apostle Paul's testimony:"Yes, I am the most insignificant of all the apostles, unworthy even to be called an apostle, because I hunted down believers and persecuted God’s church. But God’s amazing grace has made me who I am! And his grace to me was not fruitless. In fact, I worked harder than all the rest, yet not in my own strength but God’s, for his empowering grace is poured out upon me." 1 Corinthians 15:9-10 (TPT).According to Paul the Apostle;-  he was the least, the most insignificant among the Apostles.- and also received the same grace which these apostles and leaders of the Church were given.- Yet he decided to be fruitful with the grace of God. He didn't receive this grace to remain fruitless.- to become fruitful or to get results with the grace of God, he worked harder by the empowering grace of God.- he specifically stated that he worked harder than the rest, though they were empowered with the same grace.God sees each of us as His mighty men. Therefore He empowers us with grace to work. What you accomplish is what ushers you into the reality of a mighty man of God in your generation.Are you laboring with the grace of God or you are making excuses?Which steps are you taking?Are you acting out the ideas God has given you?Or do you keep procrastinating?Just as the mighty men of David were recognized by their bold or courageous accomplishments, even so, are you recognized to be part of God's mighty men in your generation by the extraordinary results you produce.The first three elite squads of David's mighty men were not named because of how good-looking they were. These men were named in that elite squad because of their extraordinary accomplishments (See 2 Samuel 23:8-11).- Adino the Eznite, was included because he had killed eight hundred men at one time.- Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, was one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel had retreated. He arose and attacked the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand stuck to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day, and the people returned after him only to plunder.- And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a piece of ground full of lentils. So the people fled from the Philistines. But he stationed himself in the middle of the field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. So the Lord brought about a great victory.These men were not automatically named mighty men of David. They demonstrated courage and went the extra mile to attain a place in David's military set-up.What are you known for in God's Kingdom?What comes to mind when your name is mentioned?In Paul's loving greetings, as he concludes his epistle to the Romans, he mentions some names and you will notice what those people mean in the Kingdom by the things Paul the apostle said about them."Now, let me introduce to you our dear and beloved sister in the faith, Phoebe, a shining minister of the church in Cenchrea. I am sending her with this letter and ask that you shower her with your hospitality when she arrives. Embrace her with honor, as is fitting for one who belongs to the Lord and is set apart for him. I am entrusting her to you, so provide her whatever she may need, for she’s been a great leader and champion for many—I know, for she’s been that for even me!" Romans 16:1-2 (TPT)This is the record of Phoebe in the Kingdom.- She's a shining minister of the Church.- A great leader and champion of many, including Paul the apostle.- One amazing thing is that it was Phoebe who went to deliver this amazing life-transforming epistle to the Romans. What a mighty lady of God. Imagine she was scared to deliver the Epistle to the Romans.Imagine she got distracted, didn't deliver this epistle and misplaced it.We would have lost rich revelations of the Spirit.Take a look at this couple as well:"Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, my partners in ministry serving the Anointed One, Jesus, for they’ve risked their own lives to save mine. I’m so thankful for them, and not just I, but all the congregations among the non-Jewish" Romans 16:3-4 (TPT)Beloved, refuse to be an ordinary member of the body. Make a decision to achieve great things for the Lord. 
Don't hide the grace which the Lord has given you. Go and produce mighty results with the grace which you have received.
Through your courageous results, the Kingdom of God will expand and your sphere will experience great transformation.Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:8-23; Romans 16:5:15; Philippians 2:19-20; Colossians 4:7-18) WE PRAYPray that I will diligently take advantage of the grace of God to produce relevant results in the Kingdom, unto God's glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Genesis 35 – 372 YEARS PLANGenesis 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I diligently take advantage of the grace of God to produce Kingdom relevant results. - I refuse to hide the grace of God given to me. - Through my courageous results, the Kingdom of God will expand. - I am fruitful. - I achieve great things for the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 722 - PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 7 — Remain In Life-Union with the LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The things which seem common will be used by the Lord to achieve great uncommon results. Beloved, allow the Lord through His word to bless the world with His best wine in you. Yours is to walk in the obedience of His word. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 14th January, 2025 PRODUCE KINGDOM RESULTS 7 — Remain In Life-Union with the LORD“So you must remain in life-union with me, for I remain in life-union with you. For as a branch severed from the vine will not bear fruit, so your life will be fruitless unless you live your life intimately joined to mine" John 15:4 (TPT)God doesn't essentially place demands on His people. Before the Lord entrusts a responsibility to your hands, He supplies you with all you need to get the job done.Of all the many things one needs to produce Kingdom results or to bear fruits, the most essential of them all is in the opening verse.
Beloved, your fruitfulness is dependent on the relationship you have with the Lord Jesus.
You may:- Make a decision to do much more as a disciple of Jesus.- Be consumed with the Success of the Kingdom.- Contend for the results.- Go all out and think possibility.- See yourself as the man for the job.- Be determined to be part of God's mighty men in your generation.However, what makes all these possible is the continuous supply of God's ability in you.Jesus didn't just demand His disciples to bear fruits. He first introduced them to the means by which they would become fruitful.As I have said before, it is great to be a tree of righteousness, however, it is always greater to be a branch in the Vine.Jesus was clear in His instructions:REMAIN IN LIFE UNION WITH ME!
You cannot bear kingdom fruits or produce Kingdom results without JESUS.
He wasn't boasting when He said, without me you can do nothing (John 15:5). A life lived independent of Christ will always lead to fruitlessness.How can a branch bear fruit when it is separated from the Vine?The life of the branch is supplied by the tree or the Vine."I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless." John 15:5 (TPT).To abide in the Vine (Jesus) is not just about becoming born again, but living an intimate life with Jesus. This is about you living a life fully dependent on Christ's words. This is living a life of faith in Christ.Galatians 2:20 summarizes the new birth (born again) experience:"My old identity has been co-crucified with Messiah and no longer lives; for the nails of his cross crucified me with him. And now the essence of this new life is no longer mine, for the Anointed One lives his life through me—we live in union as one! My new life is empowered by the faith of the Son of God who loves me so much that he gave himself for me, and dispenses his life into mine" Galatians 2:20 (TPT)When you were born again, you were brought into union with Christ.You became a branch in the Vine. Your life is in Christ.Now you don't have to live isolated from Him. For you cannot bear the fruits of Christ when you are not living in oneness with Him.
As you have come into Christ, you must journey more and more into the growth of your union with Him.
"In the same way you received Jesus our Lord and Messiah by faith, continue your journey of faith, progressing further into your union with him!" Colossians 2:6 (TPT)Though you are in union with Christ, you can progress deeper and deeper into Him. The deeper you go in your intimacy with the Lord, the richer you become in bearing consistent Kingdom fruits.That was the difference between David and Saul's entire army. They had all the skills and wished they had a way to defeat Goliath. But there was something they didn't have, a strong relationship and revelation of God.
Your revelation of God is rooted in your communion with Him.
David was able to confront Goliath because he knew the Lord was with Him."Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied." 1 Samuel 17:45 (NKJV)As disciples of Jesus, we do nothing for the Lord without the Lord. Anything we do for Him is done with Him. He is our sufficient supply.Paul the apostle said:"For this grace has made me a servant of the gospel of God, constantly doing the work of a priest, for I endeavor to present an acceptable offering to God; so that the non-Jewish people of the earth may be set apart and made holy by the Spirit of holiness. Now then, it is through my union with Jesus Christ, that I enjoy an enthusiasm and confidence in my ministry for God." Romans 15:16-17 (The Passion Translation).
In your intimate communion with Jesus, you produce greater results.
In this year of Kingdom Priesthood, maintain a deeper intimate relationship with the Lord Jesus, through the Word and the communion of the Holy Spirit; and your impact will be matchless.Hallelujah!I believe this blessed you.Let me know what you received in the comments.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4814hk6ceqwDIG DEEPER(John 14:20; John 17:21-23; 1 John 2:6; Philippians 1:11; 1 Corinthians 3:6-7; Matthew 7:16-20) WE PRAYPray that we shall grow more and more in our union with Christ, that our fruits may abound. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 38 – 402 YEARS PLANGenesis 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am connected to Christ. - I don’t lack divine supply and ability. -  I bear fruits by the ability of the Supply of Christ. - I am made competent by the empowering presence of God. - I don’t operate by my own strength. - I am strengthened by the grace of God to do more. - I refuse to be separated from the Lord. - I live in the union of Christ. - Fruitfulness streams from within me because the Lord is my source. - Every weakness in me is perfected by the Grace of God. - I am greatly helped and resourced by the Lord. Oh Hallelujah!!!Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 723 - FOLLOW THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You have to decide whether the life you have will be lived according to your will or God’s Will. You have to come to a point to say, YES I HAVE THE POWER TO CHOOSE WHAT I WANT, YET NOT MY WILL BUT THE WILL OF GOD. Selah! Author Wednesday, 15th January, 2025 FOLLOW THE LORD“My own sheep will hear my voice and I know each one, and they will follow me" John 10:27 (TPT)Have you ever looked around and into your future and all you saw was chaos and distress?Have you found yourself in a situation where everything seems to be crushing on you, and there is no way out?Do you feel lost and confused with overwhelming thoughts of uncertainty?Do you feel like a total failure and don't know how to make your way to a successful destination?
There is good news for you. Stop the struggle and turn to the Lord.
You may ask how do I stop the struggle? I am already caught up in the struggle.Let me help you understand this:Challenges or the negative situations you find yourself in are not the struggle. The struggle is your reaction to the challenge or the negative situation.
No challenge has the power to break you until you are weak. Challenges must become stepping stones for your next level of success.
It only takes a few seconds for a person to drown in water. Mostly, these people ignorantly get into struggling mode or fight-and-flight mode when they feel they can't easily inhale or exhale. The flight or struggle mode doesn't give them the opportunity to work on holding their breath for some seconds in the water. Most people who escape from being submerged in water, don't respond to drowning by struggling. They relax the body into a floating position so that they can breathe.When the vicissitudes seem to submerge or suffocate you, don't respond with a struggle, train your mind and heart to trust in the Lord. That is how you refuse to struggle. 
To trust in the Lord is to be in a position of rest. In this position, you float on the challenges of life.
As a child of God, take matters into your hands by first following the Lord. You follow the Lord because you are of His sheepfold. He is your shepherd. The Lord as your shepherd is your greatest advantage in this dark world.In David's poetic praise, he said:"The Lord is my best friend and my shepherd. I always have more than enough. He offers a resting place for me in his luxurious love. His tracks take me to an oasis of peace, the quiet brook of bliss." Psalm 23:1-2 (TPT).Oh, glory to God!It is not possible to follow the Lord and be controlled by challenges. The beautiful thing is that your walk with the Lord makes you bold. To follow the Lord is to be conquered by the presence and power of the Lord. No matter where you find yourself fear will not conquer you. You just know the Lord is with you.
Live each day of your life following the Lord's steps and leading.
You are His workmanship created unto good works which He has foreordained that you walk in them (Ephesians 2:10). Therefore He knows where you should be per time. The script of your life is written in His eternal scrolls. They are His thoughts in expression. Whenever you react with struggle and choose your own path, you act contrary to His original script for your life."For I know the plans I have for you,” says the LORD. “They are plans for good and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope" Jeremiah 29:11 (NLT)As you follow the Lord's leading, you walk and enjoy His perfect plan for your life.Stop the struggle and start following the Lord's leading.Read also on HEARING GOD'S VOICE here.Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVZ7ah7OTEwDIG DEEPER(Psalm 37:23; Proverbs 3:5-6; Romans 8:28; Psalm 119:133; John 8:12; Psalm 128:1) WE PRAYPray that we shall patiently follow the Lord's leading as He directs our steps through His word and bring us to the place of fulfillment. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 41 – 432 YEARS PLANGenesis 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I follow the Lord! - I refuse to struggle, I trust in the Lord! - The Lord is with me. - I am not helpless. - I esteem the help of God above my challenges. - I live above weaknesses, failures and fears. - The Lord is my greatest help. - I run to the Lord at all times. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 724 - DON'T BE QUIET!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, to have zeal is to have an eagerness or desire to accomplish or obtain something. Don’t use that zeal to please your selfish interest. Use it to accomplish that task which brings glory to God. Selah! Author Thursday, 16th January, 2025 DON'T BE QUIET!“We have the same Spirit of faith that is described in the Scriptures when it says, “First I believed, then I spoke in faith.”2 Corinthians 4:13(TPT)One of the important principles you must know about faith is the expressiveness of faith. Faith is the evidence or the proof of what you have received.
You cannot say you have faith and be silent. Faith speaks!
To act in faith is to act according to God’s word, and God is not silent. Even in His silence, there is a message.“For God speaks again and again” Job 33:14 (TLB)
As believers in Christ, we have the life of God and also we are to live His life by imitating Him.
“Imitate God, therefore, in everything you do, because you are his dear children.” Ephesians 5:1(NLT)As imitators of God, we also speak as God speaks.Please understand that to say faith is not silent doesn’t mean faith speaks unnecessarily. Faith doesn’t speak anything at all that comes to mind. To speak in faith is not to be idle chatter. Faith speaks or vocalizes the revelation of the word of God.Faith germinates in your heart, through the meditation of the Word of God spoken or declared to you. The Word of God in you is a seed which grows to be faith.When the word matures as faith in your heart (through meditation) it also comes forth as the “rhema-word” which produces the results or the miracle you have conceptualized.Some people assume to meditate on the word is to be quiet or silent like yoga practitioners.Meditation to the believer in Christ, is not the emptying of the mind. 
God-centred meditation is the filling and saturation of the mind with the truth or word of God. 
And as the mind absorbs the revelation of the word, it begins to mutter the words and then as faith increases, you shout the word with boldness.The first demonstration of faith is in the words you speak. You cannot speak doubt and act in faith. You will consistently act in faith when you think and speak faith.You can only speak the word when you are full of the word of God.In Genesis 1, God spoke light, life and matter into the formless and empty earth. By speaking He created everything that is needed to make existence on earth comfortable.You must not continue to watch on to the discomfort around you. You must not assume that things will change around you automatically. You must be intentional about the speaking of the word.
Create the miracle and result you want to see by speaking in faith.
Do you believe what God says?Then you must speak forth His word with boldness.He has said, that you may boldly say!Jesus in every circumstance spoke and acted out the word.Jesus said to the disciples, if you have faith you will SAY to the mountain be moved (Mark 11:23).Beloved, find out what God has said in His word concerning your health, your finances, your ministry, your family, your destiny, your work, your marriage and your society.Believe it and boldly declare it.
God is a speaking God, His faith in you is a speaking faith. Don’t be quiet.
Glory to God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRlrvecLgeMDIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Psalm 19:14; Hebrews 13:5-6) WE PRAYWe pray that the revelation of God’s word shall saturate our minds and tongues with the life of the word BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 44 - 46 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute confidence in God. – I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. – I have the faith of God. – I don’t doubt the word of God. – The faith of God in my heart cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 725 - MAKE THE LORD FAMOUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is an end to this work. There is a time where the work shall end and be completed. Don’t treat the work of the ministry as an assignment which will go on forever. In God’s calendar the end of all things is at hand. We are close to the finish line of the work more than ever. Beloved, run that you will finish. Selah! Author Friday, 17th January, 2025 MAKE THE LORD FAMOUS“Join me, everyone! Let’s praise the Lord together. Let’s make him famous! Let’s make his name glorious to all." Psalm 34:3 (TPT)Psalm 34 is one of the beautiful Psalms of David the King. David celebrated the goodness of God in this Psalm and encouraged his readers or all who will commune with this Psalm to replicate that posture.The scriptures are saturated with the flood of God's goodness. And this revelation of God's goodness is fully revealed through the glorious gospel of Jesus.
The revelation of God's goodness is not merely to make you "feel good", but to establish you in the reality of God.
Whatever the Lord does for His people is good. It may not look as you expect from the beginning, but while you are being taken through the journey of life and you follow in faith, you will be waving the flag of victory."Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow due to change." James 1:17 (ESV)There are people in today's world who blame God for all their predicaments and assume that God projects evil against mankind."For I know the plans I have for you,” says the LORD. “They are plans for good and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope." Jeremiah 29:11 (NLT).
God's plan for you is not to destroy or usher you into disaster. God's plan also doesn't promise challenge-free. 
However, God holds your hands to go through these challenges until you fully emerge and manifest as victorious.The people of the world, and carnal men keep projecting the wrong image of God into many hearts.They conclude that there is no goodness in God, He afflicts men with ailments, which is not consistent with the revelation of scriptures.When Jesus came He showed us the character of God's goodness. He healed the sick and comforted the brokenhearted.The goodness of God which Jesus unveiled did not end when He ascended.
This Jesus is the same yesterday, today and forever. (Hebrews 13:8).
Psalm 34, begins with David expressing to the Lord how he's bursting with joy over what the Lord has done for him. (Psalm 34:1).This is something many believers don't show to the world. They don't show the world how good God is.The adversary keeps spreading falsehood and deceit all across the internet or digital space.We must boldly boast of the Lord and all His works, to let all who are discouraged take heart. (Psalm 34:2)In this digital age, we don't have to be quiet about the wondrous works of God. We have to announce and make it famous.Yes, God doesn't need us to be famous. He is known by all even the deceptive atheists.Nonetheless, we are publishers of His glorious works. The more we talk about the goodness of God the more He becomes famous in the hearts of men.This is important to note: Testimonies shared in the Church are to strengthen the faith of the brethren.Evil must not prevail. The next trending dance shouldn't be made famous.You have to go all out to announce the good news of Jesus to the world. 
Use your social media platforms to talk about Jesus and His finished work. 
Talk about God's goodness, His love and Salvation.Don't hesitate to joyfully share your miracles and testimonies.People must hear more about God's love and the things He has done more than the deceits of the adversary.Go out there and announce the fame of the Lord.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=thHz609A2wgDIG DEEPER(Psalm 148:13; Psalm 66:8; Psalm 68:11; Matthew 10:27; Acts 5:20; Isaiah 30:8) WE PRAYPray that we shall by no reason become ashamed to proclaim the glorious works of the Lord Jesus to the nations of the world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 47 - 49 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I make the Lord famous everywhere I go. - I am not ashamed to proclaim the glorious works of our Lord Jesus. - Through my social media platforms, the goodness is known unto all. - I refuse to sit on the fence, I am fully involved in announcing the fame of Lord. - Many hear of God's love and goodness from me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 726 - DON'T ENVY NOR BE INTIMIDATED BY THE WORLD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week. The grace of God is sufficient for you. Don’t give room to any limitation in your mind. You can have exceptional results as you exercise boldness in the Lord. Selah! Author Saturday,18th January, 2025 DON'T ENVY NOR BE INTIMIDATED BY THE WORLD 1“Don’t follow after the wicked ones or be jealous of their wealth. Don’t think for a moment they’re better off than you." Psalm 37:1 (TPT)Today we are going to take a look into the Song of Wisdom, Psalm 37 using the Passion Translation.In this Psalm, David reassures the people of God to continue to trust in the Lord and to refuse every desire or attempt to be like the people of the world.The success of the world is mostly built on selfishness, greed, ungodliness and dishonor to God. The ungodly doesn't pursue success to bring glory to God. The ungodly pursue success to satisfy their ambition and selfish desires.
As a child of God, your pursuit in life is to please God. Everything about you must be focused on expressing God's glory.
You live according to the principles and wisdom of God.You don't live for the applause of men but for God to say "well done". Whatever you do must be consistent with the will of God. When your success is not consistent with the will of God,  it will not be of faith and will not please God."And without faith it is impossible to please God..." (Hebrews 11:6)One of the mistakes most believers make is to compare their lives with others. And sadly, these people compare their lives with the people of the world. What they fail to remember is that the child of God and those of the world live by different sets of rules.
You don't have any business comparing your life with the world or the ungodly. God knows the plans He has for you (Jeremiah 29:11).
Your work is to fix your gaze on the Lord."Gaze upon him, join your life with his, and joy will come. Your faces will glisten with glory. You’ll never wear that shame-face again." Psalm 34:5 (TPT)There is no way you will wholeheartedly trust in the Lord and be put to shame. When you fix your gaze on the Lord you will not even be intimidated by the world or the ungodly. The ungodly will use ungodly means to attain success. The scripture says such successes are short-lived; they will shrivel up and fade away quickly.David, outlined a few wisdom keys to help you manifest God-centered success. We will look into the things he mentioned from verses 3 to 11 of Psalm 34 (The Passion Translation).- (Verse 3a) Keep trusting in the Lord and do what is right in His eyes.To do what is right before the Lord is to follow and act out the instructions of the word. This is not difficult because you have been made the righteousness of God in  Christ. (2 Corinthians 5:21). You don't do what is right to become righteous. Because you are righteous you have the ability of God in you to do what is right.  - (Verse 3b) Fix your heart on the promises of God and you will be secure, feasting on his faithfulness.This is a great key that establishes you to live confidently. The reality is this, "God is not a man that He should lie..." (Numbers 23:19). Whatever God says is the truth. To fix your heart on His promises is to set your spirit, mind, will and emotions on the word of God. This saturates your heart with the goodness of the Lord. It means you don't leave any space for other thoughts to occupy. 
The moment you move your heart away from what God has said, you give room for doubt and faithlessness. Fix your heart on the Lord's promises, for He is faithful.
- (Verse 4) Make God the utmost delight and pleasure of your life, and he will provide for you what you desire the most.You know David wasn't the only one that gave such a secret, our Lord Jesus also shared this same wisdom with His disciples."So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require? “So above all, constantly chase after the realm of God’s kingdom and the righteousness that proceeds from him. Then all these less important things will be given to you abundantly." Matthew 6:31-33 (TPT).This is the difference between the ungodly and the child of God. They first seek after things, but for the child of God, you have to make God your priority.What has consumed your heart?What has taken the central stage of your thoughts?That which becomes the delight, pleasure and pursuit of your heart rules or dominates your life. 
It is not possible for you to truthfully and sincerely walk with the Lord and be forsaken by the Lord.
As you walk with Him and demonstrate confidence in Him, He becomes your supply and provider.- (Verse 5) Give God the right to direct your life, and as you trust him along the way you’ll find he pulled it off perfectly!This is wisdom! Get this, it is one thing to trust the Lord with your plans and another thing to give the Lord the right to direct you. Sometimes people assume God is sovereign and He does what He wants.  That is not how God has set up His sovereignty in your life. He has given you a will. This gives you the legal right to rule your life. The reason is that God has made you to have dominion. How do you dominate the world, when you don't have the right to rule yourself?
So God doesn't automatically interfere in your affairs. Until you submit your life to Him, He doesn't force His rule in your life (though He can).
People plan and ask God to help them execute it. That is not giving God the right to direct you. To give God the right to direct you is to seek after His plans for you and then you follow with all your heart.  He is the master strategist. He knows your future and made you with an intention. When you trust Him and allow Him to direct you, He will perfectly bring you into a dimension of greatness beyond your wildest imagination.Take these wisdom keys and run with them.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9jt4Ue09SUDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 23:17; Psalm 37:7-9;  2 Corinthians 6:14-17; Psalm 73:1-3,16-17,23-26) WE PRAYPray that our hearts shall confidently be established in the faithfulness of the Lord and the wisdom of His counsel for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANGenesis 50Exodus 1 - 2 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in the wisdom of God's counsel for my life. - My heart is confidently established in the faithfulness of the Lord. - My life is for the glory of God. - My heart and gaze is consistently fixed on the Lord's promises. - I submit my mind, will and emotions daily to the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 727 - DON'T ENVY NOR BE INTIMIDATED BY THE WORLD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The difference between those that make great impact and those that struggle to make an impact is the condition of their heart. Beloved, the entire construction of your life is in your heart. You must give attention to the things you construct in your heart. Selah!
