Author Sunday, 19th January, 2024 DON'T ENVY NOR BE INTIMIDATED BY THE WORLD 2“Don’t follow after the wicked ones or be jealous of their wealth. Don’t think for a moment they’re better off than you." Psalm 37:1 (TPT)The scriptures provide you with the Wisdom of God for your living. It answers the deep questions of your heart. And when you submit your mind to its words your thoughts will be properly cultured and shaped.For example, this Song of Wisdom, Psalm 37, is able to redirect your mind towards the higher life God has given us.As I mentioned in the previous episode from this Psalm, David reassures the people of God to continue to trust in the Lord and to refuse every desire or attempt to be like the people of the world. It also emphasizes how the success of the wicked or the ungodly has no eternal value.He doesn't only conscientize you, on why you don't have to be intimidated by the accomplishment of the worldly, but also the things to do to experience the God-centered or God-kind of success.From verses 3 to 5 of Psalm 34 (The Passion Translation), we unravelled some few wisdom keys which David outlined in his Psalm.- (verse 3a) Keep trusting in the Lord and do what is right in his eyes.- (Verse 3b) Fix your heart on the promises of God and you will be secured, feasting on his faithfulness.- (Verse 4) Make God the utmost delight and pleasure of your life, and he will provide for you what you desire the most.- (Verse 5) Give God the right to direct your life, and as you trust him along the way you’ll find he pulled it off perfectly!David explains further that, when you give God the right to direct your life, He will not only pull it off perfectly but will also "...appear as your righteousness, as sure as the dawning of a new day. He will manifest as your justice, as sure and strong as the noonday sun." (verse 6).What this means is that the direction of the Lord makes you walk in light. There is no way your paths will be overwhelmed by any gorm darkness. And you will experience His righteousness, which is also the right-wiseness of God.There are more wisdom keys David shared in his Psalm:- (Verse 7a) Quiet your heart in his presence and pray;    keep hope alive as you long for God to come through for you.David now addresses the issue of meditation, spending time with God and prayer.You cannot trust in God and give Him the right to direct without being prayerful and also spending more time in His presence. 
You must have the habit of spending time alone with God.
 It is in that atmosphere that the Lord is able to open your eyes to see. It is in that atmosphere the Lord shows you the way to go. Concerning PRAYER I have shared more here and here. Please do well to read.- (Verse 7b) And don’t think for a moment that the wicked in their prosperity are better off than you.The moment you begin to think this way, you are clearly devaluing who God is to you and what He has accomplished for you. 
What you have received from God and the path He is leading you has more transcendent results and prosperity than all the prosperity of the world put together. 
Live in the confidence of God.- (Verse 8a) Stay away from anger and revenge. Keep envy far from you, for it only leads you to lies.David now gives an instructive wisdom key. This key prevents you from error. Anger, revenge, envy and lies are instruments of the devil to distract you from expressing the excellence of God. They are thorns which compete with the blessedness of God within you. These things make you live in the flesh and also contrary to your true identity.   When you cultivate these things in your heart, you give the devil the chance to exercise his rule. However, when you so learn Christ, you will not allow such inconsistent behaviors to govern your heart.
 Let the love of God rule in your heart.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 23:17; Psalm 37:7-9;  2 Corinthians 6:14-17; Psalm 73:1-3,16-17,23-26) WE PRAYPray that our hearts shall confidently established in faithfulness of the Lord and the wisdom of His counsel for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 3 – 5 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the wisdom of God’s counsel for my life.– My heart is confidently established in the faithfulness of the Lord. – My life is for the glory of God. – My heart and gaze is consistently fixed on the Lord’s promises. – I submit my mind, will and emotions daily to the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 728 - WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It is up to you to be intentional about your partnership with the Holy Spirit. Don’t just wake up to embark on your divine assignment without Him; you must work with the Holy Spirit. Selah! Author Monday, 20th January, 2025 WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 3“Don’t follow after the wicked ones or be jealous of their wealth. Don’t think for a moment they’re better off than you." Psalm 37:1 (TPT)How you live is governed by the training you have received through the word, which is the wisdom of God. Instead of living a life controlled by envy and intimidation of the wealth, prosperity, and success of the ungodly, David provided godly keys to God-kind results in his Wisdom Psalm.It is necessary to lay hold unto these keys because they set your feet on the right path. In the previous episode, I outlined about seven (7) practical items of wisdom from Psalm 37.(Read the part one and two of this series for these keys of wisdom).Within this Song of Wisdom, David also addressed the end of the wicked. Definitely the wicked will not have a glorious end as long as they reject the ways and wisdom of God. This discussion focuses on how the godly must operate.Note: Through this series, every verse of scripture quotation in Psalm 37, is taken from the Passion Translation, unless otherwise stated.As part of the wisdom keys from Psalm 37, David touched on a sensitive key which every believer must possess.- Humility "But the humble of heart will inherit every promise and enjoy abundant peace." Psalm 37:11Take a look a the example of Jesus:"He existed in the form of God, yet he gave no thought to seizing equality with God as his supreme prize. Instead he emptied himself of his outward glory by reducing himself to the form of a lowly servant. He became human! He humbled himself and became vulnerable, choosing to be revealed as a man and was obedient. He was a perfect example, even in his death—a criminal’s death by crucifixion! Because of that obedience, God exalted him and multiplied his greatness! He has now been given the greatest of all names" Philippians 2:6-9 (TPT)It took a lot of humility for Jesus to become a man. To take on a human form means, He became vulnerable and reduced Himself to the limitations of the physical body. By His humility, he's obedient even when He has to die a criminal's death of crucifixion. Now He has been given all authority, that now the authority of His name causes every knee to bow in reverence.
Pride limits you from enjoying grace. The humble attracts an abundance of grace and peace.
- (Verse 16) "It is much better to have little combined with much of God than to have the fabulous wealth of the wicked and nothing else."This part of Psalm 37 touched my heart. This verse uprooted every form of greed and covetousness in my heart. Why become fabulously wealthy and be without God? The equation is simple;All wealth minus God is equal to zero. Little combined with much God is equal to everything.Read the verse 16 in the Amplified Bible:"Better is the little of the righteous [who seek the will of God] Than the abundance (riches) of many wicked (godless)."Message Translation:"Less is more and more is less. One righteous will outclass fifty wicked" Did you get it?
The Less a righteous man with God possesses is MORE. While the more the godless possess without God is Less.
God multiplies the little in the hands of the righteous. Don't compromise your faith to make money. Follow the path of the Lord.It is unwise for the righteous to esteem their pursuit for more wealth above their relationship with God.Don't behave like those who despise and forsake God.These are people who mock the things of the Spirit, and disregard the gathering of the saints and Kingdom service. They profane and slander the sacrificial giving of believers. Get this: "God-despisers have had it; God’s enemies are finished— Stripped bare like vineyards at harvest time, vanished like smoke in thin air." Psalm 37:20 (Message Translation)These God-despisers are disadvantaged not because God punishes them. But are disadvantaged because they have made themselves enemies of God and rejected the goodness of God.The godly enjoy the goodness of God."For the Lord takes care of all His forgiven ones while the strength of the evil will surely slip away. Day by day the Lord watches the good deeds of the godly and he prepares for them his forever-reward. Even in a time of disaster he will watch over them, and they will always have more than enough no matter what happens." Psalm 37:17-19 (TPT)
Beloved make the Lord your satisfaction.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9jt4Ue09SUDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 23:17; Psalm 37:7-9;  2 Corinthians 6:14-17; Psalm 73:1-3,16-17,23-26) WE PRAYPray that your hearts shall be satisfied by the Lord and give no room for envy and greediness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 6 - 8 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the wisdom of God’s counsel for my life.– The Lord is my satisfaction. – My life is for the glory of God. – My heart and gaze is consistently fixed on the Lord’s promises. – I submit my mind, will and emotions daily to the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus!  [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 729 - WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 4 – You have Forgiveness
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your salvation ONLY depends on the good works of Jesus. It is not dependent on your works. Now, because you have been made righteous by Jesus, you live right unto God’s glory. Beloved, this is the gospel. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 21st January, 2025 WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 4 – You have forgiveness“For the Lord takes care of all his forgiven ones while the strength of the evil will surely slip away." Psalm 37:17 (TPT)Psalm 37 is rich with wisdom. The assurances and detailed counsel in each verse will help every believer to live a life of purpose and faith in God. It brings you into the consciousness of the satisfaction we enjoy in Christ. This wisdom Psalm uproots every form of envy, greed and covetousness. It prunes and establishes your heart in the certainty of God's faithfulness.If this is your first time reading this series, I would like you to patiently read through the previous episodes: Part 1, Part 2, and Part 3.Enjoy and rejoice in the Lord's provision for you."For the Lord takes care of all His forgiven ones while the strength of the evil will surely slip away. Day by day the Lord watches the good deeds of the godly and he prepares for them his forever-reward. Even in a time of disaster he will watch over them, and they will always have more than enough no matter what happens." Psalm 37:17-19 (TPT)- The Lord takes care of all His forgiven ones.Who are the forgiven ones?
The Psalm of David is also a prophetic message about what will be fulfilled in Christ. The revelation of Jesus is the central theme of the entire Bible.
During Peter's message at Pentecost, he repeatedly referred to different Psalms of David as prophecies. And even called David a Prophet."But as a prophet, he knew God’s faithful promise, made with God’s unbreakable oath, that one of his descendants would take his throne. So when peering into the future, David prophesied of the Messiah’s resurrection. And God revealed to him that the Messiah would not be abandoned to the realm of death, nor would his body experience decay." Acts 2:30-31 (TPT)What this means is that the words of David and other Psalms must not be treated as mere songs but deep prophetic utterances which carry the revelation-light of Christ.Thus, the understanding of the forgiven ones must be seen in the light of Christ. The forgiven ones weren't those who had offered animal sacrifices in the Old Covenant. They are those who have received Jesus as the Christ and forgiveness which He has obtained for mankind through his death and resurrection.As part of the many beautiful things Peter said to Cornelius, he said:"All the prophets testify about Him, that through His name everyone who believes in Him [whoever trusts in and relies on Him, accepting Him as Savior and Messiah] receives forgiveness of sins.” Acts 10:43 (Amplified Bible).The forgiven ones are believers in Christ. And the Lord takes care of them. Have this assurance precious saint in Christ, the Lord is interested in your well-being. He takes care of you.
To even have access to His forgiveness is proof that the Lord cares for you.
Take note of these:1. None received forgiveness by the self-efforts or any works of the flesh. The only requirement is for you to believe that Jesus has made His eternal forgiveness available for you. God's forgiveness in Christ is a gift of God to you."In Him we have redemption [that is, our deliverance and salvation] through His blood, [which paid the penalty for our sin and resulted in] the forgiveness and complete pardon of our sin, in accordance with the riches of His grace." Ephesians 1:7 (Amplified Bible)2. Forgiveness is eternalThe forgiveness we received does not have an expiration date. We received forgiveness through the blood of Jesus. The Lord's blood is not a temporal blood. Its efficacy transcends that of bulls and goats. His blood is an eternal sacred blood because He is eternal. And that forgiveness which His blood accomplishes is eternal. "And he has entered once and forever into the Holiest Sanctuary of All, not with the blood of animal sacrifices, but the sacred blood of his own sacrifice. And he alone has made our salvation secure forever." Hebrews 9:12 (TPT)
The forgiveness which we have is not a one-time experience but a continuous and endless rain which keeps us clean and pure.
3. You are not forgiven because you forgave others. You forgive others because you have freely been forgiven. You now have the ability to love and forgive others."Instead, be kind to each other, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as God through Christ has forgiven you." Ephesians 4:32 (NLT).Rejoice in this reality that the Lord has forgiven you."BLESSED is he whose transgression is forgiven and whose sin is blotted out." Psalm 32:1 (Lamsa Bible, Aramaic)
To be called a forgiven one is a great blessing of the Lord.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhW1NhFqGLIDIG DEEPER(Micah 7:18-19; Isaiah 43:25; Hebrews 8:12; Colossians 2:13-14; Psalm 103:12; 2 Corinthians 5:19) WE PRAYPray that we grow deeply in the understanding of the blessedness of the forgiveness which we have received in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 9 - 112 YEARS PLANGenesis 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have forgiveness in Christ. - The forgiveness I have received in Christ is eternal. - I grow daily in the understanding of the blessedness of the forgiveness I have in Christ. - I enjoy and rejoice in the Lord's provision for me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 730 - WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 5 – You have Eternal Rewards
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Hurray! Today is exactly 2 years I started this online platform to serve you with daily verities of Christ. We have journeyed a long way and we are even pressing deeper... I want to specially thank you for believing in this vision and being a committed student/reader of this great platform. Today, I want to hear from you personally on how this treasure chest has blessed you. I will be waiting to read your inspiring testimonies and experiences in the comments below. Shalom! Author Wednesday, 22nd January, 2025 WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 5 – You have Eternal Rewards“Day by day the Lord watches the good deeds of the godlyand he prepares for them his forever-reward." Psalm 37:18 (TPT)Do you get tired or feel weary for the good deeds you do?Sometimes you are tempted to feel the wicked does no good thing yet they have a smooth life.
Your good deeds will never go unrewarded. Don't get tired of doing good.
Don't learn from the wicked.You are designed by God for good works which are foreordained that you operate in them (Ephesians 2:10)."For God, the Faithful One, is not unfair. How can he forget the work you have done for him? He remembers the love you demonstrate as you continually serve his beloved ones for the glory of his name." Hebrews 6:10 (TPT)
God has bountiful rewards for those who do good deeds.
Also, a fellow who understands that in Christ we receive gifts of eternal life will begin to wonder if this part of the Psalm is for the forgiven ones.Beloved, it sure is.Through the finished work of Christ on the cross, we receive the gift of eternal life. By the good works of faith, we demonstrate the goodness of God to others.In the Church, there are people who assume there are no reward systems. But that is not true.
The rewards system of the Kingdom is not necessarily how you work hard to become righteous and receive Heavenly citizenship.
The matter of good deeds is a matter of serving God's purpose with the abilities He has invested in you.How you serve faithfully will determine how the Lord will honor you.Remember this is not about Salvation.Take note;Through God's saving grace you became born again. To be born again is to receive the life of Christ. At new birth, we all became kings and priests in the household of God.We all received a royal crown ("diadema" in Greek) for reigning.Nonetheless, the forever-rewards of the Lord for your good deeds are honoring crowns of reward. These crowns are different from "diadema", they are called "Stephanos".
This crown is a symbol of triumph.
God gives those who demonstrate great deeds of faith these victory-crowns as honor. This is not about obtaining salvation. Christ has already obtained eternal salvation for you. However, the LORD rewards you for the good things you do with the salvation which you have received.This is what Paul the apostle said about himself:"I admit that I haven’t yet acquired the absolute fullness that I’m pursuing, but I run with passion into his abundance so that I may reach the purpose that Jesus Christ has called me to fulfill and wants me to discover. I don’t depend on my own strength to accomplish this; however I do have one compelling focus: I forget all of the past as I fasten my heart to the future instead I run straight for the divine invitation of reaching the heavenly goal and gaining the victory-prize through the anointing of Jesus." Philippians 3:12-14 (TPT)No wonder he relentlessly laboured for the spread of the gospel.He then charged the saints including you with this:"And let us all advance together to reach this victory-prize, following one path with one passion." Philippians 3:16 (TPT).Don't sit on the fence, don't fold your arms and don't relent.Day by day the Lord watches your good deeds.
Serve and be a blessing to others. Do good that the Lord will be glorified.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 9:24-27; 2 Timothy 4:7-8; 1 Corinthians 15:58; 2 Corinthians 5:9-10; James 1:12; Galatians 6:9) WE PRAYPray that by the sustaining ability and the sufficient supply of God through His anointing we shall be effective and excel in the work of the Lord to obtain a price. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024 1 YEAR PLANExodus 12 – 142 YEARS PLANGenesis 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't relent in doing good. - I joyfully and diligently serve God's purpose with the abilities He has invested into me. - I refuse to sit on the fence. - Through His anointing, I am effective in the work of the Lord. - Through the sustaining ability and the sufficient supply of God, I excel in the work of the God. - I work the work of the Lord to obtain a price by the sustaining ability and the sufficient supply of God through His anointing. Oh Hallelujah!Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 731 - WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 6 – You Have a Peaceful Prosperous Future 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot access the riches of God’s wisdom when you don’t give yourself to personal Bible study. The absence of personal Bible study will make you live by fantasies. Selah. Author Thursday, 23rd January, 2025WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED 6 – You Have a Peaceful Prosperous Future 1“But you can tell who are the blameless and spiritually mature. What a different story with them! The godly ones will have a peaceful, prosperous future." Psalm 37:37 (TPT)Psalm 37 is a refreshing song of wisdom.
Every believer must glean and feast on the virtues dispensed by the prophetic Psalmist.
He addressed critical issues and established the certainty of hope for the godly.He emphasized that a child of God must not in any way envy the wicked.The wicked plot and use evil means to attain momentary, short-lived success and happiness. All they gather withers away. Those who do evil have no value and their seeming glory fades away. You will see them trending everywhere and celebrated by the ignorant, don't envy them. These people when they don't turn to God will be gone tomorrow. (See verse 20)For this reason, "...don’t think for a moment that the wicked in their prosperity are better off than you" (Psalm 37:1)Some believers invest time and energy desiring to have the success of the wicked. Interestingly, these people invest time in plotting against the godly with all their sneers and arrogant jeers. These people take advantage of the helpless and will go to any extent to slaughter those who do right. (Verse 12-14)
Don't waste time admiring them. Your life is even a threat to their schemes. Deal with them according to knowledge. 
They admire and spy on the godly ones, stalking them to find something they could use to accuse them. They’re out for the kill! But God foils all their plots. (See verse 32,33)The good news is, their evil deeds have an expiry date and their weapons of wickedness turn against them. Their own deeds pierce their pride-filled hearts and render them helpless. (See verse 15)These wicked and ungodly men develop hatred for God and set themselves up as enemies of God. Definitely, they rather set themselves up to perish. For a fish to deny water is to set itself up for suicide. All these who make themselves enemies of God set themselves up for eternal destruction. 
No one rises against the Lord, and embarks on a journey to destroy God's program on earth, ever lives to fulfill his evil worthless dreams (verse 20).
As a believer, you don't have to envy these worldly and ungodly men. Follow God's plan for your life, and labour in wisdom to create wealth. Yet, trust in the Lord as your source. Be content and patiently grow the blessings of the Lord in your life.These wicked ones ride on deception to create wealth. They break their promises, borrow money but never pay it back. They have no sense of integrity and dignity. Don't be like them. Be content, and as a godly man, it's your duty of excellence to return what you owe, even with interest.  (Verse 21)What David was sharing in this Psalm wasn't a hypothesis. These are practical and proven wisdom.Observe what he said in verses 35 - 38:"I’ve already seen this happen. Once I saw a wicked and violent man overpower all who were around him, a domineering tyrant with his pride and oppressive ways. Then he died and was forgotten. Now no one cares that he is gone forever. But you can tell who are the blameless and spiritually mature. What a different story with them! The godly ones will have a peaceful, prosperous future with a happy ending. Every evil sinner will be destroyed, and obliterated. They’ll be utter failures with no future"Beloved, don't get distracted and discouraged by the challenges confronting you today. Don't assume God has forsaken you. Don't conclude that your present condition is the defining factor of your tomorrow. 
You have a beautiful future, just remain patient and faithful to the Lord.
Refuse to imitate the wicked. Their end is bitter and sad. Follow and imitate the Lord.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Matthew 6:33; Jeremiah 29:11; Philippians 1:6; Romans 15:13; Proverbs 3:5-6; 1 Peter 1:3-4; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18; Proverbs 16:1-4) WE PRAYPray that the God of hope fill our hearts with all joy and peace as we trust in him, so that we may overflow with hope and certainty of the future by the power of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 15– 172 YEARS PLANGenesis 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't envy the wicked. - I follow after God's plan for my life. - With the Lord as my source, I labour diligently in wisdom to create wealth. - I am content. - I patiently grow the blessings of the Lord in my life. - I have Peaceful Prosperous Future. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 732 - WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON'T ENVY THE WICKED – You have a Peaceful Prosperous Future 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There are times any direction you turn to, you may face opposition or limitations. Sometimes the pressure and the challenges may seem insurmountable. But cheer up! You can do all things through Christ who strengthens you. Hallelujah! Author Friday, 24th January, 2025  WISDOM KEYS FROM PSALM 37 — DON’T ENVY THE WICKED 7 – You Have a Peaceful Prosperous Future 2“But you can tell who are the blameless and spiritually mature. What a different story with them! The godly ones will have a peaceful, prosperous future." Psalm 37:37 (TPT) Psalm 37 doesn't only address the short-lived success and eroding happiness of the wicked. It establishes the advantage of the godly. No wonder this wisdom Psalm begins with clear instructions for the godly. "Don’t follow after the wicked ones or be jealous of their wealth. Don’t think for a moment they’re better off than you." Psalm 37:1 (TPT) As I mentioned in the previous episode, you don't have to envy these worldly and ungodly men. Follow God's plan for your life, labour in wisdom to create wealth. Yet, trust in the Lord as your source. Be content and patiently grow the blessings of the Lord in your life. The moment you set your focus on the "success" of the wicked, you turn away from exercising confidence in God. Instead of trusting God's leadership in your life, you will be doubting how your future is going to be.
The best thing to ever happen to you is to constantly and continuously trust the Lord.
When things seem thought don't be crying asking, "Why me?".  Maintain strong faith in the Lord. For in a time of disaster the Lord will watch over those who trust in Him and they will always have more than enough no matter what happens. (Psalm 37:19). Even when the godly stumble badly they will still survive, because the Lord has a stronger grip on them and lifts them up with his hands. (Verse 24) When all things consummate, you will realize the wicked and ungodly have nothing to show, yet the Lord’s blessed ones receive it all in the end. (Verse 22) Why then do you make the success of the wicked your benchmark? The Lord's delight is that you firmly follow His steps. Your blissful future is determined by how you take God-centered steps. (Verse 23) In this chapter of Psalm, David gave two examples to prove and establish his points. I mentioned one yesterday, on how the wicked, prideful domineering tyranny's life ended; without being remembered. (Verse 36-36). As a beloved of God, you have a different story! You have a peaceful, prosperous future with a happy ending. Look at the witness of David: "I was once young, but now I’m old. Not once have I found a lover of God forsaken by him, nor have any of their children gone hungry. Instead, I’ve found the godly ones to be the generous ones who give freely to others. Their children are blessed and become a blessing." (Verse 25-26) As the forgiven beloved ones of God, we are also His righteousness. We have now been brought into God's presence and made partakers of His eternal fellowship. Therefore we have the ability to live right. There is no fellowship between you and evil.
Don't give room for evil to germinate in your heart. You are godly. 
"The Lord loves it when he sees us walking in his justice.He will never desert his devoted lovers; they will be kept forever in his faithful care. But the descendants of the wicked will be banished." (Verse 28) Further advantages and realities of the godly or lovers of God: - The faithful lovers of God will inherit the earth and enjoy every promise of God’s care, dwelling in peace forever. (Verse 29) - God-lovers are also lovers of His word. Therefore their words possess wisdom and are right and trustworthy. These make the best counselors. (Verse 30)    - The ways of God are in their hearts and they won’t swerve from the paths of steadfast righteousness. (Verse 31). - As a lover of God don't be impatient for the Lord to act. Keep moving forward steadily in His ways because He will exalt you at the right time. And when He does, you will manifest every promise, including your full inheritance. (Verse 34)
There is no way you must envy the wicked with these benefits.
Why draw back away from the Lord and doubt when the Lord is your Savior?In your time of trouble, God will live in you as strength. (Verse 39) Maintain your faith in the Lord for the daily portion of great faith is the Father’s help and deliverance from evil. (Verse 40) This is true for all who turn to hide themselves in the Lord. I believe these gleanings from Psalm 37 have established your heart in the certainty of hope in God.
Your future is blessed, remain a blessing.
 Selah.DIG DEEPER(Matthew 6:33; Jeremiah 29:11; Philippians 1:6; Romans 15:13; Proverbs 3:5-6; 1 Peter 1:3-4; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18; Proverbs 16:1-4) WE PRAYPray that your focus and confidence will not be moved away from God but will increase stronger and stronger even as you walk in the manifestation of His grace and blessings. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 18– 202 YEARS PLANGenesis 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t envy the wicked. – I follow after God’s plan for my life. – With the Lord as my source, I labour diligently in wisdom to create wealth. – I am content. – I patiently grow the blessings of the Lord in my life. – I have Peaceful Prosperous Future. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 733 - GREATNESS RESPONDS TO GREAT CAPACITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved God is not expecting you to fall or faint when you are under pressure or confronted by adversity. He has given you all that you need to live above challenges. Selah! Author Saturday, 25th January, 2025GREATNESS RESPONDS TO GREAT CAPACITY “There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God”.2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)There is no divine assignment which doesn’t require divine capacity, no matter how little it may seem.
If it is of God, then it is great!
See what David said, when he was preparing materials for building the temple.“And King David said to all the assembly, “My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is still young and inexperienced and the work is great; for the temple is not for man but for the Lord God.“ 1 Chronicles 29:1 (Amplified)Now after all the materials needed were supplied for the building David now unveiled how:“Now therefore, our God, we thank You, and praise Your glorious name. “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to offer as generously as this? For all things come from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You… O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy Name, it is from Your hand, and is all Your own.” 1 Chronicles 29:13-14,16. (Amplified).It will always take God Himself to partner with you to do what He inspires or assigns you to do.To have Christ in you is to have God’s partnership for any good work.The spiritual capacity of God in you transcends your physical abilities.
The spiritual capacity is not only the ability to contain but also God’s supply of ability within you to produce.
The Apostles acknowledged that all that they did was according to certain capacities. However, those capacities were supplied by God. (2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT).The Greek word for Capacity is “hikanotés”, it also means sufficiency, competence, ability, power, qualification, or fitness.Though the capacity to do great things for God is supplied by the unlimited power of God, we have the responsibility to consistently increase in the capacity of God supplied.Until you decide to take advantage of the unlimited supply of God within you to increase your spiritual capacity you will not see unlimited results.Every Kingdom’s achievement is greatly backed by divine capacity.
Greatness responds to great capacity.
Your level of capacity will determine the size of the city or sphere you can take.To increase in Spiritual capacity is to be a consistent follower of Jesus.The Lord teaches and trains you through certain men He has set in the Church. These men equip the saints for the work of the ministry. (Ephesians 4:11-12)You also build capacity through intense focus on God’s work and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.Focus gives direction to divine energies. Whatever has your attention, attracts the resources of God within you.
Don’t scatter divine resources, FOCUS!
And the more you fellowship with the Lord, the more you submit to Him for great help and supply.You must also have the habit of praying in the Holy Spirit. As you pray in the spirit and meditate on the Word, you also build up yourself in faith and increase your inner capacity (Jude 1:20).God has made you for big things; don’t settle for less, therefore, increase in capacity.Are you imbuing focus?Are you meditating on the word?Are you fellowshipping with the Holy Spirit?How consistently do you speak in tongues?Beloved, enlarge your tents, lengthen your chords and strengthen your stakes. The season of great results and harvest is here!Hallelujah!!! DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]; Luke 16:10 [NLT]) WE PRAYThat our inner capacity will be enlarged by the Supply of the Spirit for greater works.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 21– 232 YEARS PLANGenesis 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I imbue focus. – With God, I go beyond my strength. – The Lord is with me therefore I do great things. – Through the study of the word and Prayer, I increase in capacity to take on my city. – By the strength of the Spirit at work in me, I increase in capacity to do great things. Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 734 - THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The evidence of their spiritual immaturity was how they were DOMINATED BY THE MIND-SET OF THE FLESH. The more you grow in the spirit, the less you are influenced or dominated by the flesh. Selah! Author Sunday, 26th January, 2025 THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 1“How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him." Acts 10:38 (KJV)There are people who assume they will automatically accomplish great things just because there is an anointing on their lives.
The anointing of God doesn't work automatically.
In reality, those who do great things in the Kingdom did not receive greater anointing than those who do nothing."Now, it is God Himself who has anointed us. And He is constantly strengthening both you and us in union with Christ" 2 Corinthians 1:21 (TPT)The anointing is of God's Spirit."But you have an anointing from the Holy One [you have been set apart, specially gifted and prepared by the Holy Spirit], and all of you know [the truth because He teaches us, illuminates our minds, and guards us from error]." 1 John 2:20 (Amplified Bible)Every believer has the Holy Spirit."And because of Him, when you who are not Jews heard the revelation of truth, you believed in the wonderful news of salvation. Now we have been stamped with the seal of the promised Holy Spirit" Ephesians 1:13 (TPT)From the above verses, we can conclude that all believers have received the same measure of the anointing through salvation. The anointing is given even as the Holy Spirit indwells a believer.  Now then does it seem others are more anointed?It is simply how every believer cultivates the anointing in them. The anointing in you doesn't work automatically. The anointing of the Holy Spirit must be nurtured and put to work.
You cultivate the anointing in you through prayer and also through service.
Another crucial medium through which the anointing will find expression is your MINDSET.Your mindset is the means by which you convey the verities of God within your Spirit.The impact you make is not just about the anointing in you but the mindset you possess. The anointing will respond to your mindset.The limitations in your mind are the limitations on the anointing in you. The anointing is subject to your mindset. Whatever you are not conceiving, the anointing will not do.
It's one thing to be anointed and it's another thing to use the anointing to produce results.
You can be heavily anointed and will not be able to achieve anything big.You will never achieve great things until you have the mindset for great things.Whatever you think you cannot do, the anointing will not do.You cannot have the mindset of impossibility and expect the anointing to automatically do the impossible with you.The anointing operates at the frequency of your mindset and consciousness. You will not see greater manifestations of healing anointing when you don't have the mindset to heal the sick.Jesus went about doing good because He knew what the anointing could do. There are even believers who are not conscious of the anointing in them.
If you are not conscious of the anointing you cannot take advantage of it.
Jesus knew how He was anointed.He knew what the anointing could do.He knew how to put the anointing to work.And He was confident about the anointing.See this:"When he came to Nazareth, where he had been raised, he went into the synagogue, as he always did on the Sabbath day. When Jesus came to the front to read the Scriptures, they handed him the scroll of the prophet Isaiah. He unrolled the scroll and read where it is written, “The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, and he has anointed me to be hope for the poor, freedom for the brokenhearted, and new eyes for the blind, and to preach to prisoners, ‘You are set free!’ I have come to share the message of Jubilee, for the time of God’s great acceptance has begun.”After he read this he rolled up the scroll, handed it back to the minister, and sat down. Everyone stared at Jesus, wondering what he was about to say. Then he added, “These Scriptures came true today in front of you.” Luke 4:16-21 (TPT).Such an audacious mindset.No wonder he went about doing good.
Beloved, have the consciousness of the anointing of the Spirit in you. Don't limit the anointing of God's Spirit. This anointing is in you to accomplish great things.
The question is not whether the anointing works or not. The question is what is your mindset?What do you intend to do more with the anointing?Selah! DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:3-4; Acts 3:27; Psalm 23:5; Isaiah 61:1; John 10:38; John 3:34; John 5:36) WE PRAY Pray that we shall be enlightened to understand the richness of the anointing of the Holy Spirit in us and will know how to put it to effectual workings. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 24– 262 YEARS PLANGenesis 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the right mindset that allows the anointing to find expression. - I produce great results by the anointing. - I am conscious daily of the anointing at work in me. - The anointing finds free expression through me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 735 - THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is no place for your self-efforts or works when it comes to justification or salvation. It solely depends on the finished work of Christ in His death and resurrection. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 27th January, 2025 THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 2“The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound" Isaiah 61:1 (KJV)Beloved in Christ, as you received salvation through faith in Christ, you were also stamped with the Holy Spirit. There is no believer in Christ who is not anointed by God through the Holy Spirit.
In as much as every born-again is anointed by God, it doesn't mean every believer will automatically achieve greatness.
You must maintain the mindset which makes things happen.Those who do great things in the Kingdom did not receive greater anointing than those who do nothing.They were simply intentional about the anointing.There is no doubt that no believer will be able to accomplish any great thing without the anointing of God's Spirit. The anointing of God's Spirit is the ability of God which enables you to do what He has called you to do.Yesterday's discussion is to help you understand these three things:1. You received the anointing as you got saved and received the Holy Spirit.2. Every believer received the same capacity of the anointing.3. The anointing doesn't work automatically. This point has even been reaffirmed at the beginning of this episode.As an anointed one, you must also have the mindset that the anointing of God is for service. The anointing is not just for personal gain but to fulfill God's purpose.This is how you experience the manifestation of the anointing. Jesus, when He entered the synagogue read a scripture from the book of Isaiah (Luke 4:16-19).He actually read from Isaiah 61:"The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound; To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn; To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified. And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations." Isaiah 61:1-4 (KJV)From these verses, you will notice some key items of the anointing.These things the Prophet Isaiah mentioned give clarity on the impact of the anointing:- The operation of the anointing of the Lord through you gives evidence of the Lord's Spirit upon you. In as much as Jesus came on earth as the Son of God, He ministered through the anointing. - One of the key impacts you make with the anointing is preaching the glorious gospel of Jesus. Jesus was also clear on this when He asked His disciples to tarry. He said; "But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth." Acts 1:8 (KJV)This wasn't an instruction to some special people. It's an instruction to every disciple of Jesus.There are some who think the preaching of the Gospel is not for them. That is a wrong mindset. As long as you are anointed of the Lord, you must be a witness of Jesus no matter your career or professional pursuit.Everyone who believes in Jesus, shares in the outpouring of the Spirit. Peter said to the multitudes on the day of Pentecost:"For God’s promise of the Holy Spirit is for you and your families, for those yet to be born and for everyone whom the Lord our God calls to Himself.” Acts 2:39 (TPT)What this means is that anyone who believes in Christ receives the Spirit. And anyone who receives the Spirit must be a witness. 
You must be a preacher of good tidings or the goodness of Jesus.
You can be anointed and not be involved in the preaching of the gospel. Such people make the anointing irrelevant. Thus, they also become irrelevant in God's Kingdom.- The anointing makes you a healer or a binder of the broken hearted, or those who are inwardly crashed in pieces. In this crooked and broken generation, there is a need for you (the anointed of the Lord) to take a stand to supply healing to the wounded, depressed and those who are shattered. And this is what the gospel or good news of Jesus does to people. It heals their brokenness.Also, Jesus came to fulfill this same mandate (Luke 4:21)And as the Father sent Him, even so, He sends us. (John 20:21).
He has anointed you through the Spirit and sent you into the world in the same capacity the Father sent Him.
Let this be your mindset.It's time to bless your world through the anointing of God's Spirit. Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhW1NhFqGLIDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:3-4; Acts 3:27; John 10:38; John 17:18; Luke 24:46-49; Acts 13:47; Romans 10:15) WE PRAYPray that through the anointing of God's Spirit, we shall become witnesses of the good news of Jesus and heal the broken hearted just as Jesus did. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 27– 292 YEARS PLANGenesis 27DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the right mindset that allows the anointing to find expression. – I produce great results by the anointing. – I am conscious daily of the anointing at work in me. – The anointing finds free expression through me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 736 - THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Have you prayed today? Are you in touch with your military command base? Have you received an instruction from God through prayer? Or you are running by your own strength, strategy and plan. Get into prayer; get God involved. Author Tuesday, 28th January, 2025 THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 3“The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound" Isaiah 61:1 (KJV) Every born again in Christ must think like Christ. Just as Jesus knew He was anointed for service, even so must you know that you are anointed for service. In Luke 4:16-19, Jesus didn't just read the words of the prophet Isaiah, and talk about how those words were fulfilled, to prove how He is powerful. Jesus spoke those words to announce the responsibility and the impact He's going to make by the anointing. As we began to look at Isaiah 61 in the previous episode we noticed some key items. "The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound; To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn; To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified. And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations." Isaiah 61:1-4 (KJV) - The operation of the anointing of the Lord through you gives evidence of the Lord's Spirit upon you.  - One of the key impacts you make with the anointing is preaching the glorious gospel of Jesus.  - The anointing makes you a healer, a binder of the brokenhearted, or those who are inwardly crashed in pieces.  Clearly from the verses we are looking into in Isaiah 61, you will notice that there are more items which show the impact one can make with the anointing: - To proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound. 
The preaching of the gospel doesn't only bind up the brokenhearted. It breaks every spiritual, mental and emotional slavery.
"And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” John 8:32 (NKJV). How can they know? Unless a preacher. See this: "But how can people call on him for help if they’ve not yet believed? And how can they believe in one they’ve not yet heard of? And how can they hear the message of life if there is no one there to proclaim it?" Romans 10:14 (TPT). - To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD and the day of vengeance of our God; The acceptable year of the Lord points to the season of God's grace and favor.  - To comfort all that mourn; To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified. The impact the anointing brings when put to work, subdues sorrows and creates an unquenchable atmosphere of joy. - And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations. Though this speaks of how the Jews shall rebuild Jerusalem. However, it also points to the work of the believer in today's world through the anointing.   Today's world have been dominated by deception and corruption. The mindset of the anointed doesn't seek for "already made". It is to build or rebuild. The anointing doesn't escape from such responsibilities but trusts in the Lord to repair and reorganize every ruin. In Genesis 1, when the earth was void and without form, God set things in order.
This is the mindset of the anointed. The anointed seek to serve the next generation than to seek their own comfort.
We have the mandate to fulfill, and the transgenerational impact to make, because of the anointing.  This is the time to make a difference. This is the time to be the light of God to the world and every sphere of influence you find yourself.
The anointing breaks the yoke!
Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NgF67AF7Z9MDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 10:20-27; John 10:38; John 17:18; Luke 24:46-49; Acts 13:47; Romans 10:15) WE PRAYPray that: - By the anointing you shall build the old wastes, repair the waste and desolations in your cities and of many generations. - That many lives shall be delivered and all who are kept in bondage or yoke shall be made free through the power of God in you. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 30 - 32 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Through me, many are delivered and all who are kept in bondage or yoke are made free.- I have the right mindset that allows the anointing to find expression. - I produce great results by the anointing. - I am conscious daily of the anointing at work in me. - The anointing finds free expression through me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 737 - THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 4 — MISSION ORIENTED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency How can you carry the light and the glory of God in you and struggle to demonstrate excellence in what you do? When the people of the world feel God is too far away, the way you live and love must be the magnification of God. Selah! Author Wednesday, 29th January, 2025 THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 4 — MISSION ORIENTED“The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound" Isaiah 61:1 (KJV) What are you doing with the anointing?  Are you just living for yourself or taking steps to transform your society with the anointing in you?
The anointing is God's supply to enable you to do what He has called you.
To be anointed is to be empowered for the Lord's service and impact in people's lives. Every anointed person must have the mindset of a sent-man. Anyone who achieves more with the anointing has a mission-oriented mentality. When you begin to live with the mindset of a sent-man you will know your life is not for yourself. A life lived for God is reckoned as a fruitful life in the Kingdom. A life lived for self is a fruitless life in the Kingdom.
To live for God is to live above your self-interest. You don't use the deposits of God for self-gain.
"Jesus said to them again, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, even so I am sending you.” John 20:21 (ESV) How did the Father send the Lord Jesus? What was His mission? See this: "God did not send his Son into the world to judge and condemn the world, but to be its Savior and rescue it!" John 3:17 (TPT) And this: "Moreover, we have seen with our own eyes and can testify to the truth that Father God has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world." 1 John 4:14 (TPT) Now the Lord has appointed you to go into the world to save it. Until you go out there to preach the gospel men will not be able to believe and to be saved. As part of the vision of the Prophet Obadiah, he saw this: "Then saviors shall come to Mount Zion To judge the mountains of Esau, And the kingdom shall be the LORD’s." Obadiah 1:21 (NKJV) This was fulfilled in Christ Jesus: "And then God will bring all of Israel to salvation! The prophecy will be fulfilled that says:“Coming from Zion will be the Savior, and he will turn Jacob away from evil. For this is my covenant promise with themwhen I forgive their sins.” Romans 11:26-27 (TPT) Our Lord Jesus came as the Savior of the world and has given us the responsibility to carry the message of salvation to the nations of the world. The Psalmist declared this: "Send us around the world with the news of your saving power and your eternal plan for all mankind." Psalm 67:2 (TLB) This is the necessity of the anointing of the Spirit upon your life. The anointing of God's Spirit is the empowering presence of the Lord, which has made us adequate to carry out the responsibility of reconciling many to God.
Every anointed person must operate with the mindset that they are sent to the world to live as a representation of Christ and the mission to bring many into the saving grace of Jesus.33
Don't waste the anointing on your personal gain. This is the time to bless others. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fk1d7-sHLJcDIG DEEPER(Romans 10:15; Acts 13:47; John 17:18; Luke 24:46-49; Isaiah 49:6) WE PRAYPray that our hearts will be stirred more and more to take the gospel of His salvation to the people around us and to the ends of the world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 33 - 35 2 YEARS PLANGenesis 29 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't use the deposits of God for my self-gain. - I am a sent-man to the world. - I live as a representation of Christ. - I have the mission to bring many into the saving grace of Jesus. - I have the right mindset that allows the anointing to find expression. - I produce great results by the anointing. - I am conscious daily of the anointing at work in me. - The anointing finds free expression through me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 738 - THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 5 — FOCUS MINDED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, there are big things God wants to achieve through you. He is always ordering your steps into an environment where you will step into that great purpose. Don’t allow anyone to make you doubt what God is inspiring you to do. Don’t allow anyone to make you think you are not meant to do big things. Don’t allow anyone to make you think you have to remain small, hidden and irrelevant. Selah! Author Thursday, 30th January, 2025 THE MINDSET OF THE ANOINTED 5 — FOCUS MINDED“Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess." Hebrews 3:1 (Berean Standard Bible)Through this discussion (from previous episodes), we have looked at the anointing, the purpose of the anointing and the mission of the anointing.Jesus said, "As the Father has sent me, even so I am sending you." (John 20:21).
He lived as a sent man and wants you to also live with the mindset of a sent man. He anointed you to set you also on His mission.
All that Jesus did was by the anointing and the presence of God which was with Him."The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him." (John 3:2)When the Lord is with a person in the fullness of the anointing, he or she doesn't do ordinary things. Such, will do things which only the Lord's anointed can do.To have the Lord's presence and anointing requires that you do the extraordinary.
The anointing is not just upon you for you; you are anointed to execute the Lord's purpose.
As we have seen in the previous episodes, when you preach good tidings to the meek, heal the brokenhearted, proclaim liberty for the oppressed, comfort all that mourn; give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning and the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD. And ultimately, the Father might be glorified. (See Isaiah 61:2-3)Every mission of the anointed must ultimately bring glory to God.Jesus said, "Your lives light up the world. Let others see your light from a distance, for how can you hide a city that stands on a hilltop?So don’t hide your light! Let it shine brightly before others, so that the commendable things you do will shine as light upon them, and then they will give their praise to your Father in heaven.” Matthew 5:14,16 (TPT)Understand that, the pursuit of God's purpose through the anointing will definitely attract challenging times. Jesus was confronted with challenges. He was wrongly accused, and religious leaders sought to kill him on several occasions, they even called Him Beelzebub, ruler of demons Read Matthew 12:22-28). But none of those things deterred Him.He was mission-focused and purpose-driven. When you allow challenges or situations to discourage or distract you, it will be difficult to fulfill the mandate of the Lord for your life. As the anointed of the Lord, you must have a focused-mindset.When David's brother Eliab attempted to talk down at him, he didn't even flinch. He responded saying "...Is there not a cause?"That was the mindset of the anointing. His response was mission-focused, and not centered on emotions. He wasn't offended by whatever his brother said; he was focused on the assignment.
As the anointed of the Lord, one of the means you can maintain focus on the Lord's purpose and mission for your life is to set your mind on the Lord Jesus.
When you look at yourself, you will be discouraged; because you may see a lot of weaknesses. When you look at others you will be discouraged; because they seem to be better than you. But when you look unto Jesus your heart will be encouraged and delighted.The more you look unto Jesus, the more you remain focused. All that you need to fulfill your purpose is in Him and Him. When you look at Jesus you see your mission and purpose; you see your supply and grace; you see the anointing and strength; you see the true meaning of life and how to live.As you can see in the opening verse:"...holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess".Don't look at the storm. Don't allow the challenges to discourage you. When you fix your gaze on the sun, you don't see shadows. Jesus is the sun of righteousness. Let Him be the focus of your mind.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5H5q-UaYoh4DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:1; Hebrews 12:2-3; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18; Isaiah 26:3) WE PRAY Pray that our hearts shall remain focused on God's mission and purpose which was revealed in Christ Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 36 - 382 YEARS PLANGenesis 30 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t use the deposits of God for my self-gain. – I am a sent-man to the world. – I live as a representation of Christ. – I have the mission to bring many into the saving grace of Jesus. – I have the right mindset that allows the anointing to find expression. – I produce great results by the anointing. – I am conscious daily of the anointing at work in me. – The anointing finds free expression through me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 739 - PRAY FOR OTHER SAINTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must lay aside bitter words, temper tantrums, revenge, profanity, and insults towards the saints and others. Be an example of Christ’s loveliness to your world. Beloved, let humility describe who you are as you dearly love one another. Author Friday 31st, January, 2025 PRAY FOR OTHER SAINTS“Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints”Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)No believer or saint in Christ is an Island. Every individual is part of the community of the saints.We are strong as saints when we stand together in this fight of faith. We defend, support and strengthen one another to enforce our victory in Christ and prevail over every situation.The Lord knows the believer is not called to stand alone, thus, He incorporates everyone who becomes born again into Himself.“For by [means of the personal agency of] one [Holy] Spirit we were all, whether Jews or Greeks, slaves or free, baptized [and by baptism united together] into one body, and all made to drink of one [Holy] Spirit.” 1 Corinthians 12:13 (AMPC)In Christ Jesus, there is no individualism. Your well-being is not enough when the well-being of other saints is compromised.This is why you don’t only pray for yourself but you must also become an intercessor.
You must be intentional about making prayers and supplication for other saints.
All believers or saints in Christ Jesus are of one body. When the hand is in pain, the whole body is in pain. You can’t have pain in your leg, and have the lungs rejoice.The discomfort of one body part is the discomfort of the whole body.This is why you must pray for one another. You must pray for the saints.To make supplication simply means, to humbly make a request or petition.
To make supplication for the saints is to humbly and earnestly make a request for the saints.
Praying for the saints must be done with all perseverance. Don’t quietly watch your fellow saints go through pain and challenges. Instead of sitting back to complain about the failures of others, you can make supplications for them.Read Ephesians 6:18 in the Amplified:“With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people.” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified Bible)
This is one of the signs of spiritual maturity: Praying for God’s people!
Selflessness is a sign of maturity.The “babe” in Christ doesn’t pray for others. He or she is only concerned about himself (or herself).The more you pray for others, the less you get troubled or anxious about your challenges. Praying for others also means looking away from your situation and entrusting it to the hands of Jesus.When you spend time to make supplication for others, all you are saying is, “Lord, please take care of my situation, as I stand in the gap for others”.
Let God handle your business as you make supplication for others.
Think about fellow saints in your community or city. Pray for their growth, their effectiveness in serving the Lord, and their strength and focus in the gospel of Jesus.Set a time aside today and pray for the brethren.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fk1d7-sHLJc&t=5sDIG DEEPER(Acts 12:5-14; 2 Thessalonians 3:1; 1 Timothy 2:1; 2 Corinthians 9:14) WE PRAYWe pray for all saints that amidst all the distractions and pressures of this postmodern society, they shall not grow weary in faith, love and in doing the Lord’s work. We pray that all the saints shall grow in the consciousness of our oneness in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANExodus 39 – 40Leviticus 12 YEARS PLANGenesis 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to live isolated and selfish.– I seek for the well-being of all the saints.– I grow in love for the saints.– I make supplication for the saints as my habit.– I see every believer as a brother and I make supplication for them.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 740 - DON'T LIVE AS AN IMPERFECT VESSEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever you do, look beyond yourself interest, or satisfaction. Whatever you do must not be according to your will or desire but unto God’s glory and honor. Selah! Author Saturday, 1st February, 2025DON'T LIVE AS AN IMPERFECT VESSEL“And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.”John 2:6-7 (KJV)In the first chapter of John’s Gospel, he revealed Jesus as the one who has come to reveal the fullness of God.He said, “No one has ever gazed upon the fullness of God’s splendor except the uniquely beloved Son,who is cherished by the Father and held close to his heart. Now he has unfolded to us the full explanation of who God truly is!” John 1:18 (TPT)Though it is said, that God spoke to Moses face to face or mouth to mouth, it was still in shadows. God was fully revealed in Christ.
The law was given through Moses, but Christ came as the embodiment of grace and truth. He came to show us God’s true person.
Jesus came to express the glory of the Father.Now look at what happened when He turned water into wine.“And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now. This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.” John 2:10 -11 (KJV).
The miracle of turning water into wine was to reveal His glory (which is the GLORY and REVELATION OF GOD).
Every miracle Jesus did was a sign to show us the Person of God.Some are of the opinion that God doesn’t take an interest in everything that happens in our lives. But that is not the case. Jesus at the wedding ceremony reveals that God attends weddings.In everything you do, don’t be shy to let God in. He is interested in your affairs.The interest of God is not to just sit on His throne as the MIGHTY, ALL-POWERFUL GOD, who controls men and weighs their worship and sacrifices.
The interest of God is to love you, to be in you, live through you and be part of all you do.
You cannot explain the fullness of God through Moses.In Moses, we see water turned into blood, but in Christ, water is turned into wine.For water to be turned into blood points to death. However, Jesus showed us the essence of life, by turning water into wine. He came not to produce death. He came to produce life, gladness and eternal satisfaction.
The goodness of God was seen through Jesus.
The goodness of God always abound.Mary came to Jesus saying, “There is no wine”.Jesus made them fill the six waterpots to the brim.  Each water pot takes 30 gallons. Thus, Jesus produced 180 more gallons for the wedding. They had more than enough, because of Jesus.I mentioned in the previous post that the number six is the number of Man and also the number of imperfection (seven is also the number of perfection).Man was made on the sixth day (he will always have something to do with the number 6). And also man who was good became imperfect. This is not to force an interpretation to churn “deeper” revelation. This is a basic symbolism to help appreciate the poetic whispers of the scriptures.The waterpots are also vessels which can be imperfect because they are breakable.
The best wine Jesus produced didn’t come out of golden vessels with extraordinary water.
Out of this imperfect religious jar came a new fine wine.“We are like common clay jars that carry this glorious treasure within, so that the extraordinary overflow of power will be seen as God’s, not ours.” 2 Corinthians 4:7 (TPT)Now, the waterpots were not for the main event. They were used by strict Jewish religious leaders for their religious cleansing as they got on to the main event (Read Mark 7:3-4).Because of how these waterpots have been used for religious activities, they needed to be refilled with fresh water. And it was filled to the brim. Water is mainly used by John as the symbol of the Spirit-life (John 4, John 7).For the Lord to bring a perfect wine out of your imperfection, He has to transfuse His overflowing life into you.As a new creation in Christ, the Lord has filled you with His Spirit-Life. That is an eternal treasure in you.
There is a treasure of God in you. Stop judging yourself by the imperfections. Look inside.
Within you is God’s refreshing answer to the world.Don’t live as an imperfect vessel. Live according to the treasure of the Spirit within you.For out of you the Lord is brewing a perfect wine to satisfy the world.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:6-7; 1 Corinthians 1:28; Psalm 104:14-15; Psalm 34:8; Judges 9:13) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the treasure of the Spirit within us and making us vessels of the overflowing Spirit-Life in our worldIn the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 2 - 42 YEARS PLANGenesis 32DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in obedience to the word of God. – I dish out the best of God in me to bless and satisfy the nations. – It doesn’t matter what may seem to be an imperfection or ordinary in my life, I remain conscious of this certainty that out of me flows the best wine. – The best of God is seen and experienced through me. – I am a blessing to my world. – I shine the light of God in dark places. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 741 - SUBMIT TO YOUR SHEPHERD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you have any challenge in your body, RECEIVE YOUR HEALING NOW! Be it infirmity in your kidney, lungs, intestines, stomach, eyes, bones and joints, heart, head, brain, or any other part of your body, YOU ARE HEALED whiles reading. Celebrate your testimony NOW! Hallelujah! (Share your testimony with me in the comments) Author Sunday, 2nd February, 2025SUBMIT TO YOUR SHEPHERD “And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will guide you with knowledge and understanding.”Jeremiah 3:15 (NLT)There are some within the Church who don’t see their Pastors as the visible shepherds, our Lord Jesus has given them.They go like, “THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD, therefore I don’t need any man to be my physical shepherd.”That is ignorance; total ignorance. Those with such mentality don’t know how the system of God works.The Lord God was the Shepherd of Israel (Genesis 49:24; Psalm 80:1; Psalm 23:1).Yet the Lord gave them shepherds.“And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will guide you with knowledge and understanding.” Jeremiah 3:15 (NLT)
Through Moses (as Shepherd) the Lord God (who is the chief Shepherd), led Israel out of Egypt (Hosea 12:13).
The Lord chose David to be a shepherd of Israel.“He also chose David His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds; From following the ewes that had young He brought him, To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance. So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.” Psalm 78:70-72 (NKJV)The word Pastor is from the Greek word “Poimēn”, which means shepherd. Our Lord Jesus is the “Chief Shepherd” (from the Greek word "Archipoimēn"). The Lord Himself gave some to be Pastors (Ephesians 4:11).The Lord has put the saints (as flocks) under each shepherd. There is no fellow in Christ who is not entrusted to a shepherd (Pastor).“Care for the flock that God has entrusted to you…” 1 Peter 5:2 (NLT)He has given to the Church, Pastors who are to Shepherd the saints.They have the authority and responsibility to:– watch over you and care for you with Christ as their example.– feed you and teach you with knowledge and understanding.– lead you by their own good example of faith and love.– instruct, direct and build you through the word.And this is your responsibility:“In the same way, you must accept the authority of the leaders set over you. And all of you, dress yourselves in humility as you relate to one another. “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.” (1 Peter 5:5).
You are not to be isolated from the fold the Lord has placed you.
Enjoy the Leadership of the Good Shepherd (through the personal relationship with the Lord Jesus) and submit to the authority the Lord has entrusted you to, as you are nurtured and equipped for the work of the ministry.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5H5q-UaYoh4DIG DEEPER(Acts 20:28; Jeremiah 23:4; Ezekiel 34:2,23; 1 Samuel 13:14) WE PRAYWe engage the Wisdom of God to rightly submit with humility to the authority of the Shepherds He has set over us. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 5 – 72 YEARS PLANGenesis 33 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I remain in the fold (Christ Commonwealth – Community) the Lord has placed me. – I have found my place and I refuse to isolate myself from the fold. – Through humility, I submit to the authority of my shepherd (). – I take heed to the leadings of my shepherd (). – I enjoy rest and joy through the guidance of the Shepherd the Lord has given me. – I don’t wander around like one without a Shepherd. – I follow diligently to every instruction. Oh Gloreey! Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 742 - LAVISHNESS OF GOD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t assume your life will move towards the right direction. Divine direction will always require your obedience of faith. Selah! Author Monday, 3rd February, 2025 LAVISHNESS OF GOD 1“See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him." 1 John 3:1 (NIV)In as much as God is economical He is extravagant with His kindness.For God to be economical, doesn't mean He is stingy. To be economical is to instill the value of what you highly esteem. He is economical especially with His words; this means, God's speaking in the scriptures were chosen with care to concisely administer intense deep, and impactful thoughts.
No word spoken by God becomes redundant. Every word chosen possesses rich divine intelligence, significant weight, eternal intention and purpose.
This is why it takes patience and deep repetitive thinking or meditation to squeeze out every ounce of virtue in God's speaking. You cannot rush through the thoughts of God. It requires a valuable investment of time and deep cooperation of your heart and being to fetch wisdom in His words .The wisdom of God is unsearchable unless you journey through His word."Who could ever wrap their minds around the riches of God, the depth of his wisdom, and the marvel of his perfect knowledge? Who could ever explain the wonder of his decisions or search out the mysterious way he carries out his plans?" Romans 11:33 (TPT)God is rich and extravagant. The richness of God is unsearchable and unending. Anytime humans hear of riches, they first think about abundance of currency, silver or gold. The riches of God transcends money. The richness of God is not in the resources He has but the reality of Himself.
There is no scarcity nor shortage in God. He is superabounding in essence and expression.
Whatever God gives to you doesn't have the potential to erode, or to be utterly drained and dried up, for He is the source of what He gives.This is the reason to have God as your inheritance is the most treasured possession. To have God is to have an unending satisfaction. To be content in God is great gain because what God gives cannot expire."Even the strong and the wealthy grow weak and hungry, but those who passionately pursue the Lord will never lack any good thing." Psalm 34:10 (TPT).Read it also in the Message Translation:"Young lions on the prowl get hungry, but God-seekers are full of God." Oh, glory to God.To be full of God is not to lack any good thing.No wonder our Lord Jesus said, "Steep your life in God-reality, God-initiative, God-provisions. Don’t worry about missing out. You’ll find all your everyday human concerns will be met." Matthew 6:33 (Message Translation).God is more than enough and He is lavishing.He doesn't dispense Himself in smaller percentages. He gives super-abundantly.Now Paul the apostle in his exaltation of God to the brethren in Ephesus, made some profound statements about God:He said, "Now to Him who is able to [carry out His purpose and] do superabundantly more than all that we dare ask or think [infinitely beyond our greatest prayers, hopes, or dreams], according to His power that is at work within us, to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations forever and ever. Amen." Ephesians 3:20-21 (Amplified Bible).This is refreshing.
God is lavishing or superabounding, He supplies answers beyond your greatest prayer requests and wildest dreams.
Your heavenly Father gives beyond what you can even take.When you grow in the consciousness of how lavishing God is, you wouldn't be limited in your thinking.Enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 9:8; 2 Peter 1:3; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35; Romans 8:32) WE PRAYPray that the eyes of your understanding be enlightened; that you may know what is the hope of His calling, what are the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 8 – 102 YEARS PLANGenesis 34DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't lack any good thing because the Lord lavishes me even beyond what I could ask or think of. - I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. - There's no scarcity or shortage in my life because, there's no such in God. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 743 - LAVISHNESS OF GOD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Irrespective of what you think of yourself or your history, the Lord knows you by name precious one. You matter to Him and He values you. The Lord has engraved you in the palm of His hand. And takes delight in your personal matters. You are not ordinary. Hallelujah!
