Author Tuesday, 4th February, 2025 LAVISHNESS OF GOD 2“See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him." 1 John 3:1 (NIV)The richness of God transcends the abundance of currency, silver or gold. The richness of God is not in the resources He has but in the reality of Himself. He is superabounding in essence and expression. He is the source of what He gives and He is what He gives. Thus to have God is to have an unending satisfaction.He is lavishing. He doesn't dispense Himself in smaller percentages. He gives super-abundantly.
God doesn't hold back. He generously lavishes all He has and yet doesn't run out of what He gives.
When you have God, you have Him in all of His richness.This is why you shouldn't have God and then lack any good thing. God is not a Father who holds back good things from His children.He gives lavishly!When men walked in unbelief, lived without Christ, were sinners, condemned because of unbelief, were like corpses, dead in sins and offenses. When they were controlled by religion, man-made customs, and selfish values of this world, dominated by the dark ruler of the earthly realm who fills the atmosphere with his authority and works diligently in the hearts of those who are disobedient to the truth of God. They lived out the rebellious and corruption of unbelief that was sown in them from birth through the deeds and desires or deadly cravings of their selfish-life.God still loved us with such great love. Because He is so rich in compassion and mercy. (See Ephesians 2:1-6)
No degree of our wrongs was able to stop God from fulfilling His compassionate plan of salvation.
Though men saw themselves as God's enemies, this didn't stop God from being faithful. His steadfast love remains immovable, and the flow of His Mercies continues endlessly.Are there times when you look at yourself, and feel you have made so many mistakes, disappointed God and hit the bottom of the ocean?Always remember His mercy is unending.Even in the Lamentation of the Prophet, he said:"my soul is bereft of peace; I have forgotten what happiness is; so I say, “My endurance has perished; so has my hope from the Lord.” Remember my affliction and my wanderings, the wormwood and the gall! My soul continually remembers it and is bowed down within me.But this I call to mind, and therefore I have hope:The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; His mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness. “The Lord is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in him.” Lamentation 3:17-24 (ESV)No matter how the adversary reminds you of the trouble, the utter lostness, the taste of ashes or defeat, the feeling of depression and hitting the bottom.Set your mind on the lavishness of God's love and Mercy. Set your hope and grip on God. His love is loyal and cannot run out, the rivers or well of his mercifulness cannot dry up. A day wouldn't end without the unceasing flow of His mercies. He will always and at all times lavish and soak you with His compassionate love.
He doesn't hold back His kindness and care; He abundantly overwhelms you with His mercies.
Enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ifWIKbUIZgMDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 9:8; 2 Peter 1:3; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35; Romans 8:32) WE PRAYPray that our hope will be gripped on God's compassionate loyal love and the lavishness of His endless mercies no matter the situation we find ourselves. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 11 – 132 YEARS PLANGenesis 35DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God's love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love. – The Lord doesn't withhold His kindless and care on me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 744 - LAVISHNESS OF GOD 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are reading this, know that the Lord has released you into a season of daring faith. Don’t take no for an answer, nor settle for less. Hold on to the Word of God, knowing that you walk in answers. Hallelulah! Author Wednesday, 5th February, 2025 LAVISHNESS OF GOD 3“See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him." 1 John 3:1 (NIV)Whatever you think you lack, God is more. Thus to have God is to lack nothing.
No child of God must operate with the mindset of scarcity. The purpose of God for your life is resourced according to the provision of God.
Just as God is rich in mercy He is rich in anything He supplies to you. As I have emphasized in previous episodes, there are no shortages in God. God doesn't run out of time, He doesn't run out of mercy, He doesn't run out of Grace, He doesn't run out of wisdom.And because He has an endless abundance of what He  supplies, He gives lavishly.Whatever you have received in Christ, was lavishly given to you.Is it Salvation? It is eternal.Is it God's forgiveness? It flows as a waterfall.Is it mercy and compassion? It never ceases.How about the love and grace of God?John the apostle in his first epistle drew the attention of His readers to the wonder of the Father’s love. As you can see in the opening verse.Read it from the Passion Translation:"Look with wonder at the depth of the Father’s marvelous love that he has lavished on us! He has called us and made us his very own beloved children. The reason the world doesn’t recognize who we are is that they didn’t recognize him." 1 John 3:1 (TPT)
To lavish is to cause to super abound, to richly pour out or to give in a large measure.
The Greek word is "Perisseuo", it carries the idea of exceeding the requirements; it means to exceed or be above a fixed or certain number of measures. It is overflowing or overdoing  above a certain number or measure. It means to have or to be more than enough, to be extremely rich or abundant, to be in affluence.An imagery of perisseuo, is when a river overflows out of its banks, to overwhelm or submerge a city.God has extravagantly or excessively dispensed His love and grace on you. Every believer in Christ is submerged with the riches of His grace."In Him we have redemption [that is, our deliverance and salvation] through His blood, [which paid the penalty for our sin and resulted in] the forgiveness and complete pardon of our sin, in accordance with the riches of His grace which He lavished on us. In all wisdom and understanding [with practical insight]" Ephesians 1:7-8 (Amplified Bible)The question therefore is not "How much grace has God given?"Rather the question is, "How much grace can you take and how much are you willing to utilize?"There is more than enough grace for you.
You cannot be in Christ and be insufficient!
Paul writes, "OUR SUFFICIENCY IS OF GOD"I'm sure people looked at them and thought, yes these apostles have everything they need to do what God has called them to do. And he wants everyone to know that what they have is not self-generated but God's lavish supply.You have more than enough to accomplish what God has called you to do even beyond expectation. 
You can reach beyond the level you have imagined, because you have God's extravagant supply.
You can enjoy the salvation which you have received and live above any force of condemnation and darkness because God has lavished you with His eternal saving grace and forgiveness.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 9:8; 2 Peter 1:3; 2 Corinthians 3:4-6; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35; Romans 8:32) WE PRAYPray that we shall take advantage of God's lavished, extravagant, immeasurable supply of Grace to fulfill that which He has called us to do this year. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Leviticus 14 – 162 YEARS PLANGenesis 36DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God’s love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love. – The Lord doesn’t withhold His kindness and care from me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 745 - LAVISHNESS OF GOD 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the adversary desires to sift you, however, you must yield to prayer and not your self-confidence. Selah! Author Thursday, 6th February, 2025 LAVISHNESS OF GOD 4"Look with wonder at the depth of the Father’s marvelous love that he has lavished on us! He has called us and made us his very own beloved children. The reason the world doesn’t recognize who we are is that they didn’t recognize him." 1 John 3:1 (TPT)There was a story about a lady traveling with her boss (it was her first time travelling on an aircraft). And in the flight, they sat at separate seats with some distance between them. When they got to their destination, her boss got to know the lady was feeling hungry. The boss was a bit surprised considering how they were served on the flight. So she asked the lady if what was served on the flight wasn't enough for her.The lady replied to her boss, "Ma, I didn't accept any of the food they tried serving because I was nearing enough money and didn't want to bother you. I didn't even visit the washroom because I didn't want you to incur other costs""What?" The boss exclaimed, "Your flight ticket covered all the bills! Your way to enjoy everything". She continued. Is this not the situation with most believers in Christ?The ignorance of what God has lavished on them makes them live like beggars.They judge what they have and what they can do through their natural strength.
Don't judge the supply of God with the limitation of your natural ability.
God is rich in wisdom and blessings; He lavishly and richly pours out His blessings in large measure.The lavishness of God is not just in the demonstration of His love through spiritual blessings in Salvation. God also lavishes His children with material blessings. To experience material blessing is not necessarily being materialistic.Materialism in theology is the concept of being obsessed or preoccupied (spiritually, mentally, emotionally and physically) with material things rather than the spiritual reality of God."Stay away from the love of money; be satisfied with what you have. For God has said, “I will never, never fail you nor forsake you.” Hebrews 13:5 (TLB)In the above verse, the author of Hebrews instructs his readers to stay free from the love of money and to shun financial greed.Does that mean the child of God doesn't experience material blessings?Certainly not! The contrast of not being greedy or obsessed as a child of God with material things is contentment with what you have. This is transcending. The author was specific with what you need to be content with. He said "...be content with what you have"Amazing! (Just feel like shouting)
To be content with what you have is not in reference to the material things you have been able to amass through your struggle and sweat.
What you have in this context is not what you gained through your natural labor.What do you have?You have GOD!Who has said, "I will never [under any circumstances] desert you [nor give you up nor leave you without support, nor will I in any degree leave you helpless], nor will I forsake or let you down or relax My hold on you [assuredly not]"Did you read that?You cannot have God and lack support. He doesn't just give you support, God is the support and the supply.Most believers who love a greedy life, live as the people of the world. They are not conscious they have the greatest treasure.Jesus said, "So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require" Matthew 6:31-32 (TPT)No child of God should be greedy and materialistic. No child of God should be obsessively chasing after money or material things.
You have GOD'S PRESENCE, where every blessing finds expression.
Concerning your physical needs or material blessings, take note of this:"And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity." 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)How much do you need to do what God has called you to do?God is able to lavish you with every earthly blessing so that you will be sufficient enough for every good work.
Don't doubt nor limit the wisdom of God.
Continue to behold and trust Him as your shepherd; He will make you lie down in green pastures.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:3; 2 Corinthians 3:4-6; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35; Deuteronomy 28:11-14) WE PRAYPray to thank the Lord for His abundant supply of every earthly blessing we need to execute His assignments. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 17 - 192 YEARS PLANGenesis 37DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God’s love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love. – The Lord doesn’t withhold His kindness and care from me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISDOE 746 - LAVISHNESS OF GOD 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Act quickly on the ideas the Lord is putting in your heart. The things the Lord is inspiring you to do are the things He wants to do. Be the body and the person the Lord will use to accomplish His task quickly. Don’t hesitate! Don’t make excuses! Don’t think it is not yet time! The time is now! Author Friday, 7th February, 2025 LAVISHNESS OF GOD 5"And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity." 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)
It is not consistent with the revelation of scriptures to think God's lavishness is not demonstrated through material blessings.
The "earthly blessing" you read in the opening verse also means material blessing. And God causes grace to lavishly abound.And just as God lavished His love and grace through the redemptive and life-dispensing work in Christ, He also makes grace overflow abundantly so that there will be more than enough favor and material blessing for His good works.God never withholds good things from His people.This is who He has always been. He is a good God."God will lavish you with good things: children from your womb, offspring from your animals, and crops from your land, the land that God promised your ancestors that he would give you. God will throw open the doors of his sky vaults and pour rain on your land on schedule and bless the work you take in hand. You will lend to many nations but you yourself won’t have to take out a loan." Deuteronomy 28:11-12 (Message Bible)
God doesn't take any pleasure in making life hard. You have to take advantage of His supply to bear great fruits.
The overflowing ability of God is within us as believers. "Everything we could ever need for life and complete devotion to God has already been deposited in us by his divine power. For all this was lavished upon us through the rich experience of knowing him who has called us by name and invited us to come to him through a glorious manifestation of his goodness" 2 Peter 1:3 (TPT)You don't have to wait for God to supply you with overflowing grace. He has already lavished you with the superabundance of grace. The more you intimately commune with Him in knowledge, the more you overflow with His grace.This overflowing grace cannot be limited by lack. Even in the wilderness, God's lavishness was demonstrated through our Lord Jesus. The disciples of Jesus said, "It’s going to be dark soon and the people are hungry, but there’s nothing to eat here in this desolate place. You should send the crowds away to the nearby villages to buy themselves some food.”Jesus responded, “They don’t need to leave, You can give them something to eat.”Jesus' response was to make them look beyond the situation and think according to the lavishness of God. Yet His disciples were still scarcity conscious. They answered, “But all we have is five barley loaves and two fish.”Jesus replied “Let me have them,” Then He had everyone sit down on the grass as he took the five loaves and two fish. He looked up into heaven, gave thanks to God, and broke the bread into pieces. He then gave it to His disciples, who in turn gave it to the crowds. And everyone ate until they were satisfied, for the food was multiplied in front of their eyes! They picked up the leftovers and filled up twelve baskets full! There were about five thousand men who were fed, in addition to many women and children!" (See Matthew 14:15-21, TPT).
Jesus proved God's lavishness of provision, as the multitudes ate till they were satisfied and yet there were leftovers.
Say this loud to yourself: I don't experience scarcity. I enjoy God's unlimited and immeasurable lavishness of Grace.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 3:4-6; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35) WE PRAYPray to declaring that God's lavishness is expressed through every favor and material blessing so that we will have more than enough to accomplish great things and bear glorious fruits for the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 20 – 222 YEARS PLANGenesis 38DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not scarcity conscious. – I don't experience scarcity. – I enjoy God's unlimited and immeasurable lavishness of Grace. – The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God’s love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love. – The Lord doesn’t withhold His kindness and care from me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life.Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 747 - GO FOR THE KNOWLEDGE OF THE WORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are in Christ, you are justified and you have peace with God. You don’t need a strange regalia to walk in the corridors of the Spirit. As you have been justified, you have the right standing with God. You can walk in the corridors of Heaven as Jesus, for you have His righteousness. Hallelujah! Author GO FOR THE KNOWLEDGE OF THE WORD"But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ" 2 Peter 2:5-8 (NKJV) In 2 Peter, the apostle used different words for knowledge. Though each of these words may have some similarities, they have unique rich meanings. Though he used the word, knowledge about five (5) or more times, he chose a specific word in Greek.See these: 2 Peter: a. 1:2“… through the knowledge (epignōsis) of God and of Jesus our Lord.”b. 1:3“… through our knowledge (epignōsis) of him….”c. 1:5-6“For this very reason, make every effort to add … to goodness, knowledge (gnōsis)…”d. 1:8“… keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge (epignōsis) of our Lord Jesus Christ.”e. 1:12“… even though you know (oida) them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.”f. 1:14“because I know (oida) that I will soon put [my body] aside….”You will see that, the word knowledge, gnōsis, used in the opening verse (1 Peter 1:5-6, ) is different from the word knowledge, epignōsis, used in 1 Peter 1:8. Few people have some subtle resentment towards the word “gnosis”, more because of the “Gnostic movement” (which considered material existence flawed or evil and held the principal element of salvation to be direct knowledge of the hidden divinity, attained via mystical or esoteric insight.  Many Gnostic texts deal not with concepts of sin and repentance, but with illusion and enlightenment.) Peter, the apostle, in his epistle was speaking of knowledge, gnōsis, as, “experientially know”; functional (“working”) knowledge gleaned from first-hand (personal) experience, connecting theory to the application; “application-knowledge,” gained in (by) a direct relationship. (Strong’s Bible Dictionary) This knowledge, gnosis, is the possession of information of what is known. Gnosis describes the comprehension or intellectual grasp of something.  It refers to knowledge gained by experience. Gnosis is an “experiential knowledge”. It speaks of an intellectual possession of scriptures, both by the study of the Bible and scriptural experience through situations.This is more of knowing God’s word and His ways. Grasp the knowledge of the scriptures on a daily basis. Knowledge is an indispensable element in your fruit bearing. Apply the scriptures in every situation, and don’t assume there are situations, you don’t need the word of God. Put God’s word to work in your daily life. Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; Colossians 3:16; 2 Timothy 2:15; Titus 2:10; Ephesians 5:8) WE PRAYThat we will grow richly and demonstrate the experiential knowledge of Christ in all situations, according as God has produced in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 23 – 252 YEARS PLANGenesis 39DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the experiential knowledge of the word of God. – I give no room for ignorance. – I function as a man of knowledge. -I have great insight into the ways of the Lord. – I am full of divine light. – I supply the experiential knowledge of Christ in all matters. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 748 - THE MATTER OF SONSHIP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Grow in the accurate knowledge of God which in Christ, through continuous meditation on the word of His grace. Don’t just walk in the awareness or intellectual perception of the Word; be drenched or participate or become one with the reality of Jesus. Selah! Author Sunday, 9th February, 2025THE MATTER OF SONSHIP“And it was a happy day for him when he gave us our new lives through the truth of his Word, and we became, as it were, the first children in his new family.”James 1:18 (The Living Bible)The greatest thing God achieved was not when He created the heavens, the stars, the moon, and the sun. The greatest thing God accomplished was not when He made Adam. 
The greatest thing He achieved was when He INDWELT MAN, through Christ, and this is how he gained Sons. 
Beloved, your sonship is the evidence of His Fatherhood. The matter of God having sons was for the satisfaction of His Fatherhood. It has been the Father’s heartbeat even before Sin entered the world.He intended to indwell us through the Spirit, to become one with us that we might be His sons. The matter of sonship is unto expression.Fatherhood is for birthing. He is our Father to reproduce Himself in Us, and we are His sons to express (and reveal) Him. The focus of our Lord Jesus was on the birthing of the Corporate (many) Sons. The desire of God as a Father was not to have Jesus as the only begotten Son, but that through Him, He will have many sons. 
Jesus came as the seed of the Father to be sown that through Him there will be the germination of many sons. 
The Lord Himself said, “Verily, verily, I say unto you, except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it dies, it bringeth forth much fruit.” John 12:24 (KJV)As many that have received Him are legally Sons of God. We are God-begotten.“But whoever did want him, who believed he was who he claimed and would do what he said, He made to be their true selves, their child-of-God selves. These are the God-begotten, not blood-begotten, not flesh-begotten, not sex-begotten.” John 1:12-13 (The MessageBible)Now, we are the sons of God by Faith (See 1 John 3:1-2; Galatians 3:26). Jesus is no longer the only begotten; He is the firstborn among many brethren, and He sees us as His brothers.“For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.” Romans 8:29 (KJV)“Jesus, the Holy One, makes us holy. And as sons and daughters, we now belong to his same Father, so he is not ashamed or embarrassed to introduce us as his brothers and sisters!” Hebrews 2:11 (The Passion Translation)
It is the joy of the Father to bring us into sonship, and this was His predestined plan before time began. 
“For He foreordained us (destined us, planned in love for us) to be adopted (revealed) as His own children through Jesus Christ, in accordance with the purpose of His will [because it pleased Him and was His kind intent]” Ephesians 1:5Glory to God! This is amazing!He didn’t just reveal us as His children through Jesus Christ, and He gave us the Holy Spirit to be a seal and a witness that we are His forever.We have the Holy Spirit as the testimony within us that God is not only God to us. He is not just a Judge unto us, but He is also our Eternal Father. We call Him Daddy! Daddy! (Abba Father) with joy.“For you have not received a spirit of slavery leading again to fear [of God’s judgment], but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons [the Spirit producing sonship] by which we [joyfully] cry, “Abba Father! The Spirit Himself testifies and  confirms together with our spirit [assuring us] that we [believers] are children of God” Romans 8:15-16 (Amplified Bible)"And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father." (Galatians4:6)The essence of the Gospel of our Lord Jesus is to point you to YOUR SONSHIP IN CHRIST, and this reality delights the Father’s heart. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1ME&t=614sDIG DEEPER(1 John 3:1-2; Romans 8:15-16; John 1:12; Galatians 3:26) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship in Christ Jesus. And by the ability of God’s Spirit within us, we shall express the nature of the Father as he has intended. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANLeviticus 26 – 27Numbers 12 YEARS PLANGenesis 40DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the joy of the Father. – I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. – I am born of God. – As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. – I express the quality of God’s life. Oh Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 749 - SHOW FORTH THE EXCELLENCIES OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do what God has called you to do. You can be inspired by what others do. However, you must do what you do not to impress anyone. You do what you do because God has inspired and affirmed that you do it. What has God called you to do? Where has God called you to be? Beloved take heed! Author Monday, 10th February, 2025SHOW FORTH THE EXCELLENCIES OF GOD"But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge," 2 Peter 1:5 (NKJV). VIRTUE is from the greek word, "aretē" which means, "Moral excellence". This refers to any preeminence (moral, intellectual, military power). It speaks of whatever procures preeminent estimation for a person or thing; hence, “intrinsic eminence, moral goodness, virtue," (see Vine, W E: Vine’s Complete Expository Dictionary of Old and New Testament Words. 1996. Nelson). To add VIRTUE means to: 1. Show forth Excellence. To be excellent is to demonstrate eminence or superiority of achievement and mastery in a sphere. It denotes consummate quality. The world is in the dark (spiritually), and does not know the "excellencies of God". However, God has called us to be His chosen generation, royal priests and peculiar people, to display His marvelous light or glory in this dark and chaotic world. (See 1 Peter 2:9) 2. It means to emit MORAL QUALITY.True virtue in Christ is not merely the modification of human qualities. It is producing divine qualities that make the person more like Jesus Christ. It is to exhibit the purity of Christ in your thoughts, speech, and conduct. We exhibit the character of Christ because we are “partakers of the divine nature” (2 Peter 1:4). We have the nature of Christ as our actual disposition within. 3. To exude COURAGE and MANLINESS.The word virtue depicts Valour or spiritual might.Areté often means courage.Plutarch (a Greek historian and biographer) says that: “God is a hope of aretē, not an excuse for cowardice”.
Moral uprightness is real manliness. It is true courage. It is the boldness to stand up for what is true and excellent.
The three Hebrew boys stood up for the only true God. They said, to King Nebuchadnezzar, our God will deliver us from your hands, even if he doesn't we will still not bow (Daniel 3). Such audacity of virtue! Joseph said to Potiphar’s wife, I will not sin against God and your husband. (Study Genesis 39).  “Virtue issues in the courage to show whose it is and whom it serves.” How firm do you stand in Faith and truth in the face of corruption? 4. Virtue, Aretē, means To be Purposeful. To the Greek philosophers, Virtue meant, the fulfillment of a thing. It is what we might call operative or efficient, excellence.An example of its usage can be seen in fertile land. When anything in nature properly fulfills its purpose, that fulfillment is referred to as "virtue". Land that produces crops is “excellent” because it is fulfilling its purpose.God has designed us as His workmanship (creative masterpiece) for a specific purpose. “We have become his poetry, a re-created people that will fulfill the destiny he has given each of us, for we are joined to Jesus, the Anointed One. Even before we were born, God planned in advance our destiny and the good works we would do to fulfill it!” Ephesians 2:10 (TPT)
When you walk in the fulfillment of God’s eternal purpose for your life, you demonstrate VIRTUE (Excellence).
Is your life radiating or repressing the excellencies of God? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUUw65cgGRgDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:8; 1 Peter 4:11; 1 Peter 2:9; 12; Isaiah 43:21; Isaiah 60:1-3; Philippians 1:27 ) WE PRAYThat we will show forth the excellencies of our Lord Jesus according to His life and nature at work in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 2 - 42 YEARS PLANGenesis 41DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I demonstrate virtue and honor.– I am an example of God’s excellence and glory.– I emit courage and moral excellence in the face of opposition. – I walk in the fulfillment of my purpose. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 750 - TRUE GODLINESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Jesus did not come to this world only as a Prophet and a great Teacher. Neither was Jesus a religious leader who came to establish another religion. Jesus is God who became man to bring men into eternal life and divine living. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 11th February, 2025 TRUE GODLINESS"For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;"  Titus 2:11-12 (KJV)The matter of Godliness is not a legalistic message but rather essential for the born again in Christ. It is not a religious practice because it transcends religion. Neither is it an application of an outward list of rules and regulations.
Godliness is simply the expression of divinity.
Godliness ("eusebeia" from "eú" which means well and "sébomai" also means worship, venerate, pay homage); literally “well worship”. This reflects an attitude of one’s life to live with a sense of God’s presence. Godliness is a sacred reverence exhibited especially in actions. The consecrating presence of God is conveyed into all the experiences of life by godliness. We see the picture of godliness through Christ; how that, He made all behold the inexplicable reality of the divine life. "No one has seen God [His essence, His divine nature] at any time; the [One and] only begotten God [that is, the unique Son] who is in the intimate presence of the Father, He has explained Him [and interpreted and revealed the awesome wonder of the Father]." John 1:18 (Amplified) How did Jesus demonstrate, interpret and reveal the awesome wonder of the Father?See what Brother Luke said here in Acts 1v1: “To Theophilus, the lover of God.I write to you again, my dear friend, to give you further details about the life of our Lord Jesus and all the things that he did and taught.” Through all the things that our Lord and Saviour Jesus did and taught, many beheld the glory of God.
Godliness is basically the demonstration of God’s nature, love, glory, joy and power to others. By this, we live a life pleasant to the Lord.
You speak like God and act as God. This is basically living as Christ in your sphere. Do many see Christ in you? Godliness is not living out your life. It is living out the quality of God’s life. It is the outflow of the increased life of God in you.Until you decrease for Christ to increase in you; many will not see Christ. Godliness is seen when you lay down your life for Christ to only spring forth and blossom in you. You cannot fake true godliness.
True godliness is lived by the power of the transfused life of Christ.
Many ostensibly very “religious” people have an appearance of godliness, going through the motions of religion, but they don’t have the power to truly lay down their lives for Christ to blossom in them (See 2 Timothy 3:5). By human standards, (just as the Pharisees and the Sadducees), there is a boxed-up interpretation of God and His expressions. However, in Christ Jesus, we see that the revelation of God is beyond our human imagination. Thus, you can truly see God and express Him only by the power and revelation of Jesus Christ in you.
Until you behold and handle Christ Jesus, you cannot declare or express His life.
“We saw him with our very own eyes. We gazed upon him and heard him speak. Our hands actually touched him, the one who was from the beginning, the Living Expression of God. This Life-Giver was made visible and we have seen him. We testify to this truth: the eternal Life-Giver lived face-to-face with the Father and has now dawned upon us. So we proclaim to you what we have seen and heard about this Life-Giver so that we may share and enjoy this life together. For truly our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus, the Anointed One.” 1 John 1:1-3 (TPT). Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AmdpjoDOaWw&t=2sDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:11; Genesis 5:24; 1 Timothy 4:8; 2 Timothy 3:12; Psalm 1:1-3; Micah 6:8; Titus 2:11-14) WE PRAYWe pray that by the empowering ability of God’s Spirit we shall live and walk as godly on this earth, bearing Godly fruits unto God’s glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 5 – 72 YEARS PLANGenesis 42DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I decrease that Christ will increase in me. – I am empowered to demonstrate the God kind of life in every situation. – I carry the presence of God in all places. – I don’t just have the form of Godliness, I have the power to express God in all things. – I walk with God according as He has designed. – Many see God in my speech and conducts. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 751 - KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE GOAL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Stop holding on to all your anxieties, all your worries, and all your concerns, once and for all. Turn to God in prayer. Make all your requests with faith (absolute confidence in God) in your heart that the Lord will answer you completely. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 12th February, 2025KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE GOAL"But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge, to knowledge self-control, to self-control perseverance, to perseverance godliness, to godliness brotherly kindness, and to brotherly kindness love. For if these things are yours and abound, you will be neither barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ"2 Peter 1:5-8 (NKJV).
 Before the season to bear fruits, there may be a season of storm.
 As a branch, you need to hang on to the vine. You may see other branches bearing fruits, while you are also receiving the same amount of nutrients from the vine. And this may stir some level of frustration and anxiety, especially when there is no understanding of how things work. The experiential knowledge of God’s work, enables you to supply God’s restraining force. This then makes it possible for you to exercise perseverance in the face of adversity. You will not be in haste to prove yourself or to bear fruits.Understand that fruit-bearing is a matter of expression. And when you grow deep in this knowledge of God’s work, you demonstrate “patience-endurance”. Your desires and appetites are already under the influence of God’s power. Therefore you easily remain resolute and maintain an undisturbed composure.
The heart of endurance is the focus of glory.
Our Lord Jesus pressed on to the end because He kept His eyes on the goal. Perseverance is a product of tested faith.Don’t throw in the towel when you are confronted with huge challenges. The more challenges persist, the more you also persist.
“Tough times never last, tough people do” Robert Schuller.
You are built more and more into maturity as you practice perseverance in the face of challenges. “Knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience. But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing” James 1:3-4 (NKJV). You practice perseverance through the joy of the Spirit (James 1:2)In Acts 5, we see how the apostles, led by Peter were bearing great Kingdom fruits. They worked great signs and wonders, sick people and those tormented by unclean spirits were healed in the streets and believers were increasingly added to the Lord in their multitudes. (see verses, 12-16). These were glorious times. There was so much supply of the Power of the Holy Spirit. Then the high priest and his council laid their hands on the apostles and put them in prison. These apostles were taken out by an angel of the Lord. And yet they continued to preach in the temple as they were instructed.They could have decided to leave for the sake of their lives.  But because they are yielded to the restraining force of the Spirit, their desire is what the Lord wants them to do. They were arrested again, beaten and warned or commanded not to preach the name of the Lord. Beloved, see the reaction of the apostles: “So they brought the apostles back in and had them severely beaten. They ordered them never again to speak in the name of Jesus and then let them go. The apostles left there rejoicing, thrilled that God had considered them worthy to suffer disgrace for the name of Jesus. And nothing stopped them! They kept preaching every day in the temple courts and went from house to house, preaching the gospel of Jesus, God’s Anointed One!” Acts 5:40-42 (TPT). This is the meaning of PERSEVERANCE!!!This is the meaning of UNDISTURBED COMPOSURE. Beloved we are not of they that draw back. God is pleased with us, as we persevere and refuse to draw back. (Hebrews 10:38) No persecution should be enough to stop you. Don’t allow the success of others to make you think you have failed. Continue in doing what the Lord has instructed you to do.
Don’t stop here, neither should you turn to the left nor to the right; KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE GOAL.
Let these words of Paul (the apostle) to Timothy, be your words to yourself:“The confidence of my calling enables me to overcome every difficulty without shame, for I have an intimate revelation of this God. And my faith in him convinces me that he is more than able to keep all that I’ve placed in his hands safe and secure until the fullness of his appearing” 2 Timothy 1:12 (TPT). Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 5:12-42; 1 Peter 4:12-19; James 1:2-4; Romans 5:3-5) WE PRAYThat the Lord shall strengthen us more and more that we may remain resolute to boldly endure the pressures of this world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 8 – 102 YEARS PLANGenesis 43DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have divine capacity. -I refuse to stagger. -I endure to the end. -I don’t fret nor faint. -I maintain an undisturbed composure. -I have the grace to persevere in the midst of opposition. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 752 - BE CONTROLLED FROM WITHIN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you are called by the Lord into His greatness. Think greatness and take great steps. Whatever the Lord tells you to do is great! Esteem the Lord’s assignment for you. It is a great thing to serve the Lord. Hallelujah! Author Thursday, 13th February, 2025BE CONTROLLED FROM WITHIN"But the fruit of the Spirit [the result of His presence within us] is love [unselfish concern for others], joy, [inner] peace, patience [not the ability to wait, but how we act while waiting], kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such things, there is no law." Galatians 5:22-23 (AMP)Did you read the opening scripture well?Kindly go back, read it again and focus on the latter part.Did you see it?What I wanted you to see was self-control. Many have disregarded this subject as a mere activity of the mind, but this is contextually incorrect. Stay glued to this discussion and follow through as we unravel the true meaning and understanding of self-control. When we hear of self-control we first think of subjecting our thoughts and emotions under our own control. However, it doesn’t work that way.
To bring things under your control will still make you lose control.
It is always difficult to bear burdens on our own. To exercise SELF-CONTROL according to the scriptures, is to subject your emotions, thoughts, and desires or cravings to our Lord Jesus. The Greek word is ("egkrateia"/"enkrateia") from the word, "enkratos" (“en” means in and “kratos” means dominion, mastery, power to rule). It also stems from the word “krat” which speaks of power or lordship. It literally means dominion within.
It is the ability or idea to take a grip on oneself or hold oneself.
For you in Christ, self-control proceeds out from within you, but not by yourself. This is because it is only possible by depending on the power of the indwelling Spirit. With self-control, you hold your passions and desires in hand, as you are enabled by the Lord. You cause God’s word to master your desires and passions, especially your sensual appetites. The Greeks used “self-control” for one who had his sex passions under control.
It speaks of the ability to make the will of God get a grip on yourself.
Egkrateia has reference to restraining passions and appetites. It points to the inner power of God, to control one’s own desires and appetites. To have self-control, you function like Jesus. He never became a victim of the tricks of the adversary. (Matthew 4:1-11). He was never found doing or saying anything that was not consistent with His Father’s will and divine nature. Jesus said, “…I seek not mine own will, but the will (or desires) of the Father which hath sent me.” John 5:30. This is the simplicity of self-control. It is not just about having a restraining force, it is God’s will becoming your restraining force. Get this, you are not a machine, God has made you an organism or a free moral agent. Thus, you exercise self-control by a free act of will. Until you make a personal decision to submit to God’s restraining ability within you, God won’t force His will on you.
When you yield your cravings to God, you exercise self-control in the energy which the Holy Spirit supplies.
This is a glorious interworking of your will and the grace of God.There is a price of fruitfulness, therefore live as an athlete who disciplines and restrains himself; beating his body into submission ( 1Co 9:27). A good top-level athlete will abstain from rich foods, wine, and sexual activities to focus all his strength and attention on training to be more efficient. Beloved, practice self-control by yielding your thoughts, emotions, and desires to the instructions of the Word and the Spirit. Do you want to bear more fruits? Don’t sleep when you are to be praying. Be diligent in praying and fasting and not be controlled by your appetite for food.
Be disciplined and diligent to share the gospel of Christ with others no matter how you feel. 
Refrain from sexual immorality. Don’t frustrate the grace of God.Take advantage of the strength of the Holy Spirit to do more. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:22-23; Acts 24:25; 2Peter 1:3; 1 Corinthians 9:25;) WE PRAY– That we shall increase in the strength of the Spirit to exercise self-control or temperance in all things. – That all our cravings and desires are governed by the will of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 11 – 132 YEARS PLANGenesis 44DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am disciplined by the word of God. – I don’t do as I desire. I exercise the strength of God in my dealings. – I do the will of God. – Christ is my strength. – My longings, cravings, pleasures are submitted to the good pleasure of the Father’s will. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 753 - GOD DOESN'T PUSH YOU AROUND
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t hide the grace which the Lord has given you. Go and produce mighty results with the grace which you have received. Shalom! Author Friday, 14th February, 2025 GOD DOESN'T PUSH YOU AROUND 1"If he works severely, he also works tenderly. His stockpiles of loyal love are immense. He takes no pleasure in making life hard, in throwing roadblocks in the way" Lamentation 3:33 (MESSAGE)How do you think God makes things hard for you to get?God doesn't deal with you based on the principle of "suffer to gain".
God doesn't try to make life hard or make you struggle before you attain success.
He doesn't make someone's life easy and the other difficult.God created both the rich person and the poor person but didn't create their condition. God doesn't bring poverty to one and riches to the other. There is no poverty in God.God didn't create suffering.He takes no pleasure in making anyone's life hard.And he doesn't make anyone's life hard."For everything God made is good..." (1 Timothy 4:4)The desire of God for you is that you prosper. God doesn't set limitations in your life.
He doesn't make things difficult for you before He allows you to access the expected success.
"God can do anything, you know—far more than you could ever imagine or guess or request in your wildest dreams! He does it not by pushing us around but by working within us, His Spirit deeply and gently within us." Ephesians 3:20 (Message)He works His power through you.It's important to understand how God works out His plan for you.Let's take the story of Joseph as an example.Through dreams, Joseph saw the future God had planned for him. He knew what he was going to become and was excited about it.Now, was it God's plan for Joseph to be sold as a slave?Was it God's plan for Joseph to be thrown into prison?God's plan was for Joseph to become a ruler for the preservation of His ultimate plan in Christ (which was wrought in Abraham).
In the working of His plan, there are no crooked paths, neither are there "ups and downs".
The path the Lord has set for you is smooth.This is proven by God's work in creation. God did not create any difficulty for man. All that God did was good and for man's enjoyment. (Genesis 1:31)In reality, the first day man saw after the day of his creation (6th day) was the seventh day. The day of rest. This means God didn't design man for struggle. God designed man to live from His rest.
Thus, man's pursuit of God's purpose and living must be according to the REST OF GOD.
However, through the corruption of man in Eden, evil found its way into the hearts and affairs of men.The day Adam believed in the deception of the adversary, he gave the adversary access to the affairs of men. He now found ways to always corrupt, oppose, and contend with the purpose of God in the people of God.He always opposes God's purposes and plans in the lives of God's people through his evil schemes and plots; which he executes through men who allow their hearts to become breeding grounds for evil.Nonetheless God in His wisdom takes advantage of the evil plots of men to still execute His purpose. 
All that God expects from those who are His, is their obedience to His wisdom and counsel.
See what Joseph said to his brothers:"You plotted evil against me, but God turned it into good, in order to preserve the lives of many people who are alive today because of what happened." Genesis 50:20 (Good News Translation)Did you read that well?I believe you did. If not read the verse again.You see, God did not plot evil against Joseph in His plan. It was the brothers of Joseph who did. God did not plot that Joseph was to be taken to prison. It was Potipher and his wife who did.
Yet in God's grand scheme as long as Joseph walked in the obedience of His Word, the evil plots were turned to the advantage of Joseph.
All that Joseph did was trust and walk in the obedience of God's word. And that was a great demonstration of faith. This gave God continuous legal access to execute His plan in Joseph's life.This is what God is doing with you and through you. No matter the negative plots of the enemy to stop you from manifesting God's great plan for you, He is graciously leading you into the fulfillment of His great purpose. Maintain trust in Him through the process.He is working it out for your good.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AmdpjoDOaWw&t=2sDIG DEEPER(Romans 8:28; Isaiah 55:8-9; Jeremiah 29:11; Ephesians 1:11; Isaiah 46:10) WE PRAYPray that no matter what happens around you, you shall remain firmly confident in God's word and counsel of His wisdom for your life. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 14 – 162 YEARS PLANGenesis 45DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The path the Lord has set for me is smooth. - God didn't design me to struggle. - God designed man to live continually from His rest. - I live in obedient to the wisdom and counsel of God. - The Lord has a great plan for my life and I maintain my trust in Him through the process. - God is working His power through me to manifest His glorious purpose for my life. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 754 - HIS GOAL IS NOT FOR YOUR REVERENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you can’t put God’s kingdom assignment off till tomorrow. Seize the day and get to work. Refuse to be distracted. Author Saturday, 15th February, 2025HIS GOAL IS NOT FOR YOUR REVERENCE“For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but in order that the world might be saved through him” John 3:17 (ESV) You don’t define God’s relationship with man with your head.Your understanding of God’s relationship with man must be according to the heart of God. God doesn’t define situations by how we feel, but according to His purpose and grace. Since a lot of people have not experienced the truth of God’s love, they interpret the things of God with their selfish lenses. For example, some people think that the death of Jesus is in contest for their reverence. Jesus didn’t die for you because He wants you to revere Him by trembling before Him. Listen, you cannot stand before God in the fullness of His glory and not revere Him.
His goal is not for your reverence, His goal is that you shall have His life and become His expression.
The idea that Jesus died for God to have many worshippers, is not really God’s goal. Yes, when one beholds God’s love and glory, you cannot than to respond in worship. Worship is our response to who God is. It is not the demand of God. Also, God wants to have many sons. However, to be a son of God is essentially for the benefit of those who are adopted into sonship. You become an heir of God and enjoy God’s eternal inheritance.  And this is God sharing His life and glory with you.Jesus didn’t die as sin on the cross to demand your reverence. Though He deserves your reverence, He doesn’t demand it. His love is not saying “My dear if you don’t reverence me, I will strike you with sickness and diseases. Or I will take My Holy Spirit away from you.” The loving expression of Christ is not in competition with and for your works and efforts. All you’ve got to do is acknowledge and believe in His finished work, which was achieved through His death and resurrection. Am I attempting to say, “It is not necessary to revere God?” Far from it! I want you to see the motive of God concerning you.You are the focus of His love. God esteems His plans and purposes because they are designed to benefit you in all eternity. God is not looking for the opportunity to condemn you. He wants you to experience His love and saving grace.In truth, when you come to appreciate His love, you will unforcefully and restfully reverence and express His Love. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(John 6:40; Ephesians 1:3-12; Luke 1:74-75; Philippians 2:12-13) WE PRAYThat our motive of service and relationship with God will be according to His love and not the fear of condemnation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 17 – 192 YEARS PLANGenesis 46DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God loves me.– I relate with God in the light of His love. – I don’t relate with God in fear. – My reverence to God is not in fear and forcefulness but in the purity of His love and grace. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 755 - YOU ARE NOT POOR
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency As a Steward of God, you must be faithful and committed to utilizing God’s blessings or resources to bring honor and glory to Him. Don’t just be a steward of God’s resources, be a faithful steward of God’s resources. Selah. Author Sunday, 16th February, 2025YOU ARE NOT POOR"There must be no poor people among you because God is going to bless you lavishly in this land…" Deuteronomy 15:4 (MSG) Do you really have the desire to do great things for God? Do you want to be part of the spread of the gospel in all places? Do you want to see people transformed? If your answer is “YES!” then you don’t have to think poor, be poor, or remain poor!The gospel is free but not cheap. Spreading it to the nations of the world requires a lot of resources.
Understand that being poor will limit you from achieving the dreams of God in your heart.
You cannot spread the gospel and become a giant in the expansion of the Kingdom with poverty. This is not to demean any poor person, but to establish you in the consciousness that GOD DOESN’T WANT YOU TO BE POOR, therefore STOP THINKING POOR! Did you read the opening verse? "There must be no poor people among you  because God is going to bless you lavishly in this land…" Deuteronomy 15:4 (MSG)Why must there not be poor people among them?Because poverty is an error!Poverty is not of God!Poverty is not a blessing from God! Anything that is not of God must not be part of your life.The blessing of the Lord makes rich. (Proverbs 10:22). You may ask,“Why then am I poor because I know I am blessed of the Lord, through Christ Jesus?”
Get this, you can carry the Lord’s blessing and still live poor. The reality is that anyone blessed by the Lord is not poor but can live poor.
Poverty is not first the absence of money. However, when you live poor, you will walk in lack. Poverty is essentially a mindset problem. Until you correct your mindset, you may have all the resources in the universe and still live poorly. Your thought is what define how you demonstrate abundance. You have to stop thinking of yourself as poor because you are not. Not having a physical currency note or a good bank balance doesn’t mean you are poor. You are blessed of the Lord, therefore you are rich!Don’t think poor, don’t live poor, don’t respond to life situations as a poor person. 
Don’t speak the language of the poor. Refuse to declare lack.
The poor think he or she doesn’t have enough. But the blessed of the Lord knows whatever he or she has can be multiplied. One with a poverty mindset thinks of impossibilities and sees and speaks lack. One with a poverty mindset, cannot imagine a life lavished with abundance. Such people are quick to declare how they don’t have money. To even think and say,“My money is finished” is a poverty mentality.Why do you think your money is finished? Why do you think you don’t have money? Beloved, as the blessed of the Lord, you are lavished by the Lord with super-abundance. 
You have the capacity and ability to generate resources.
Refuse to think POOR! ShalomDIG DEEPER(Psalm 35:27; 2 Chronicles 25:9; Genesis 12:2; Deuteronomy 8:18; Proverbs 10:22) WE PRAYThat we will increase in the wisdom to maximize the resources that the Lord has given to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 20 – 222 YEARS PLANGenesis 47DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the blessed of the Lord. – I have super- abundance. – I am blessed in all things. – All grace abounds towards me in all that I do. – I am so rich. – I give bountifully and joyously into the spread of the gospel. – The gospel prospers in my hands through my finances. – I refuse to think poor no matter what. – I refuse to be defined by what I have in my pocket or bank account at any time. – I am defined by the riches in Christ Jesus and I walk in this consciousness everyday. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 756 - BREAK OUT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t just live normal as everyone. Don’t be satisfied with the level you are in your relationship with Jesus. Avoid double-mindedness! Set your eyes on Jesus and crave more for the sweet intimacy with Jesus. You will soon begin to reflect and reveal God in all you do. Don’t stay at the level you are. Selah. Author Monday, 17th February, 2024 BREAK OUT“For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited." Isaiah 54:3 (KJV)God didn't create limitations for man. He brought man forth to a place where everything was good.
The goodness of God revealed in His creation is not just about how perfect the created things are, but how they are to be perfect for the benefit of man.
Everything God made was good to serve man. Nothing was to be a disadvantage to man. Everything made by God was to serve man and be beneficial to man's living.God did not create the earth to be desolate.God blessed man with the ability to be fruitful, multiply, replenish the earth, subdue it and have dominion over all created things.God entrusted the flourishing of the earth to man. He gave man the governing right to determine what happens here on earth.The corruption which entered the world through man's disobedience (unbelief), did not only affect man's spirituality but also allowed an opposing force of limitations to invade creation.
The fall made it possible for man to experience struggle. The root of man's fall is unbelief, which causes one to live out of God's satisfaction and restfulness.
This explains why even the Israelites could not enter their rest."So we see that they were not able to enter [into His rest], because of their unwillingness to adhere to and trust in and rely on God [unbelief had shut them out]." Hebrews 3:19 (AMPC)The moment you receive Christ by faith, you have entered His rest. Nonetheless, as to touching the matter of your unlimited living, you have to decide to take advantage of Christ's accomplishment in you. Christ has brought you into His rest positionally; and transfused His life, nature and power into you for your daily living. You will continue to live in limitation until you exude the rich items of Christ within you in a practical way.The accomplishment of Christ did not mean we would automatically live limitlessly. What Christ did give us was the power to determine the unlimited living of His life in us.What does this say to you?
Beloved, the limitations in your life today are a result of how you have not taken advantage of the reality of Christ which is in you.
You can expand, you can grow, you can multiply, you can achieve glorious things according to His power which works in you.Take advantage of all that Christ has accomplished to break out from every limitation you are experiencing.Refuse to remain where you are.
Advance! March on! Achieve Greatness.
You have to break out from every limitation you see around you.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f71Z9uEFPkkDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 4:18; Isaiah 52:9; Micah 2:13; Isaiah 43:19; Luke 1:37) WE PRAYPray that you shall go forth this season in the strength of the Spirit and knowledge of the riches of Christ to live above every limitation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 23 – 252 YEARS PLANGenesis 48DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have entered into the rest of Christ therefore, I live above every limitation. - I take advantage of Christ's accomplishment  in me to live an unlimited life. - I refuse to remain where I am, I take advantage of the riches of Christ within my Spirit to advance and achieve greatness. - I break out from every limitation I see around me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 757 - BE HELPFUL 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When people refuse to read the scriptures to know God, they read your life. The way you live must be a reflection of the reality of God. Selah! Author Tuesday, 18th February, 2025 BE HELPFUL 1“If anyone sees a fellow believer in need and has the means to help him, yet shows no pity and closes his heart against him, how is it even possible that God’s love lives in him" 1 John 3:17 (TPT)The love of God is practical and intentional. You cannot say you have God's love in you without an action.
God's love for you is an action.
For God to demonstrate His love, He gave His only begotten Son to die for us.Love doesn't specialize in accusing and condemning others. Love focuses on demonstrating kindness to others.As a child of God, you have the capacity of God to love others, just as God loves you through Christ.No believer in Christ lacks the ability to Love; "...God’s love has been abundantly poured out within our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us." (Romans 5:5)The love of God is increasingly at work in you.Your first response to every situation must be according to God's love in you. His love in you enables you to live above selfishness. The Newness of life is not a self-centred life. It is love-dispensing and life-giving.There are some believers of the Kingdom fold who are genuinely overwhelmed by needs. It is not that they lack faith but through situations which confront them, they may find themselves in some need within a period. And as part of strengthening these brethren in faith, we must supply help to them in love.
Believers must not gossip and talk down on other believers.
We must not join the world in pointing fingers towards others. There are times you make conclusions about people and judge them wrongly. Instead of making conclusions about people, patiently find out what is going on with them.There are times you assume a fellow brother has ignored you, yet this fellow may be battling with depression.There are people struggling with hidden tears and untold stories. There are people who feel alone and are crushing inside. They keep contending with suicidal thoughts. Instead of sitting somewhere to castigate people, make a decision you are going to be helpful at all times.
Don't be misled by the smiles of others. Don't allow the beautiful pictures they keep posting on social media make you think everything is perfectly fine with them.
There are people who are choked by debts, it is not that they are stingy. Be a consolation.Be discerning and think as a helper. Instead of persecuting people with your words and complaints. Spend time in prayer for them. Love does not assume. Love is intentional.When you have the capacity to help others, don't hold back. Just as God loves you, go to any extent of love to help others also.
Be HELPFUL AT ALL TIMES.
 Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zwTiogewnADIG DEEPER(1 John 4:7-8, 11-13; Colossians 3:12-14; Philippians 2:2-4; 1 John 3:16-18) WE PRAYPray that:1. Through the wisdom of the Holy Spirit, you will be able to perceive and discern how you can help the brethren who genuinely need your help.2. All the brethren who need help and are struggling in secret will find help this day. In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 26 – 282 YEARS PLANGenesis 49DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a helper unto many.- I demonstrate the love of God unto all. - I don't hold back in helping others. - I go every extent to extend help unto others. - My words brings healing to the broken hearted. - I don't talk people down, I rather uplift others. - I don't accuse and condemn others. - Many find comfort and peace through me. - I bring joy to others wherever I go.- The love of God is increasingly at work in me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 758 - BE HELPFUL 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and a bear fruit unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Wednesday, 19th February, 2025 BE HELPFUL 2"Abandon every display of selfishness. Possess a greater concern for what matters to others instead of your own interests" Philippians 2:4 (TPT)The Newness of life is not a self-centred life. It is love-dispensing and life-giving.The world places emphasis on  self-care and self-love. The explanation of these concepts may seem highly reasonable, but that is not the Kingdom's way.Jesus speaking to His disciples said, "The greatest among you will be the one who always serves others from the heart." (Matthew 23:11 ~ TPT).
There is no greatness in the Kingdom without genuine service.
A genuine servant-heart is a selfless heart. No selfish person can serve genuinely. And such a person cannot consistently make a difference in the lives of others.You cannot be helpful when you are occupied with yourself. You wouldn't even be able to identify or perceive the need to help someone who is in need of help until you look beyond yourself.
Your relevance will always be connected to the selfless help you give to others.
 A helper is selfless!Does that mean you don't have needs to attend to?You do!And it's the reason being a helper will not always be convenient. That is what love represents. True love is proven when there is sacrifice.You may do good things out of convenience, but the true state of your love is proven when you have to move out of your convenience to make a sacrifice.Understand that, to be helpful wouldn't always be convenient. However, you will be able to help others with ease, because the love of God is at work in you.In this dimension of love, faith finds greater expression.   While looking beyond yourself to demonstrate love to others, you maintain strong faith in God that He will keep you from falling and supply your personal needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus.Maybe you are reading this and feel tired of doing good or helping others because people seem to be appreciative.
Do not let the wrongs of others redefine the goodness of God in you.
Continue doing good for others, whether they appreciate it or not. God, who made this whole universe for the benefit of men, is not appreciated by men. People whose entire existence depends on God still conceive hatred towards God in their hearts.This has not changed the goodness of God towards mankind. He still loves us."So let’s not get tired of doing what is good. At just the right time we will reap a harvest of blessing if we don’t give up." Galatians 6:9 (NLT).The scriptures charged us not to get tired in doing, because one may definitely get tired. Set your mind on the harvest of the Lord. There is nothing good you do which shall be in vain.
Just in case you feel tired, confused and discouraged in helping others, don't continue listening to what you feel, turn to the Lord. Talk to the Holy Spirit, He is your ULTIMATE HELP.
Don't feel discouraged and say "I am not God." It's a wrong utterance. Yes, you are not GOD, but you are the expression of God. You are the man God has chosen to work though. It's a privilege!Be HELPFUL AT ALL TIMES.SELAH.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yc3Sm7YDWjQDIG DEEPER(1 John 4:7-8, 11-13; Colossians 3:12-14; 1 John 3:16-18; 1 Corithians 15:58; 2 Thessalonians 3:13) WE PRAYPray that the Holy Spirit will supply us with fresh strength to continue to help others without getting weary. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 29 – 322 YEARS PLANGenesis 50DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a helper unto many.– I demonstrate the love of God unto all.– I don’t hold back in helping others. – I go every extent to extend help unto others. – My words bring healing to the broken hearted. – I don’t talk people down, I rather uplift others. – I don’t accuse and condemn others. – Many find comfort and peace through me. – I bring joy to others wherever I go.– The love of God is increasingly at work in me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 759 - EDIFY YOURSELF 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The believer in Christ is not trying to enter rest. The man in Christ is seated in rest. This is not the restoration of Adam experiencing rest on God’s sabbath. This is the tangible transcendent manifestation of God’s sabbath in wholeness. Beloved, your relationship with God is not a strive to enter rest. Your relationship with God is the eternal enjoyment of God’s rest. Hallelujah! Author Thursday, 20th February, 2025 EDIFY YOURSELF"He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church." 1 Corinthians 14:4 (NKJV)In the previous episodes, I admonished you to BE HELPFUL to others.As I explained, being helpful is being selfless; that is how God's love works.Furthermore, every helper must be strengthened to continue to be a consolation of help to others. This sometimes is the reason people emphasize self-love.The way of the kingdom doesn't emphasize self-love. The concept of self-love is with an ungodly motive of putting your self-interest ahead of others.
In the Kingdom, even your "self-interest" must be focused on being a blessing to others. By the way, in love, whatever you do for yourself is essentially for the benefit of others.
You consider your well-being because of others. Did you get it?Your well-being is not for your selfish interest. Your personal well-being is for you to be in a good state to continue to help others. Don't fall for the world's subtle way of nurturing you to be self-occupied and self-pleasing.The moment you submitted your life to Jesus, you made a choice to also live beyond your personal interest.This matter I am discussing with you is not a complex phenomenon, but the reality of the love of God.God is more interested in your well-being and wholeness than you are in yourself. To ensure you are enabled with the resources to continue being a blessing to others, the Lord gave you the Holy Spirit and the gift of tongues-speaking.There are some people who have refused to accept the reality of tongues-speaking. Some of these people even make a mockery of this special gift of the Spirit given to all believers.Some think because the tongues believers speak are not understandable they are useless and mere gimmicks.There are people who think the prophecy is more important than tongues-speaking.None of these two is more important than the other. Prophecy benefits the Church. Most of the time, these Prophecies are (direct or indirect) interpretations of a tongue spoken.
Tongues-speaking helps the individual believer.
Read the opening verse again:"He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church."From the verse we see the clarity of the difference:1. Prophecies edify or build up the Church. It benefits all the saints. It is for others."But [on the other hand] the one who prophesies speaks to people for edification [to promote their spiritual growth] and [speaks words of] encouragement [to uphold and advise them concerning the matters of God] and [speaks words of] consolation [to compassionately comfort them]" 1 Corinthians 14:3 (Amplified Bible)2. While tongues speaking edifies the one who speaks.Tongues speaking is the communion between the one speaking and God. To speak in tongues is to speak mysteries."For one who speaks in an unknown tongue does not speak to people but to God; for no one understands him or catches his meaning, but by the Spirit he speaks mysteries [secret truths, hidden things]." 1 Corinthians 14:2 (Amplfied Bible).Those who argue that tongues speaking is merely speaking another language must cut out this chapter from the Bible. In 1 Corinthians 14, the Apostle Paul's main concern was that the believers should pray and speak in their understanding when they are among the congregation. Or interpret the tongues through prophecy because tongues speaking will be understood, unless interpreted. He even calls tongues speaking gibberish or unknown language. Whenever you speak in tongues, it may sound as a coded language to those who will hear you.But you must speak it because it is for your personal edification.In recent times, Churches have encouraged members to speak in tongues more in Church meetings because believers must be conscientize to pray in tongues for personal edification. Most declarations or prophetic utterances which are made during tongues speaking in the Church are summaries or interpretations of these tongues. (It is just that Churches must be intentional about having a session of tongues interpretation during public meetings).When all believers meet and speak in tongues in a meeting, they are actually edifying themselves individually.These mysteries, when spoken release spiritual currents of power and unleash energies from the Spirit to the entire being of the one speaking in tongues.
Tongues speaking is one of the quickest means by which a believer experiences personal edification.
Don't ever undermine the benefits of tongues speaking.Paul the apostle said, "I thank God that I speak in [unknown] tongues more than all of you" 1 Corinthians 14:18 (Amplified Bible).Awesome!If tongues speaking wasn’t beneficial to Paul, why would he speak in tongues more than his spiritual children?"So, my fellow believers, long to be prophets so that you can preach God’s message plainly; and never say it is wrong to “speak in tongues” 1 Corinthians 14:39 (TLB).Did you see that instruction from Paul?Never say it is wrong to speak in tongues.
Don't go a day without speaking in tongues.
Get to it now!DIG DEEPER(Acts 2:4; 1 Corinthians 14:14,26; Jude 1:20) WE PRAYPray thanking the Lord for the ability of the Spirit to pray in tongues.(Spend some hours praying in tongues)BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANNumbers 33 – 352 YEARS PLANExodus 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My self interest is to be a satisfaction unto many. – I am a helper. – I dont't trviliase the precious gift of tongues speaking. – Under all circumstaces and at all times, I have the strength to carry out the assignment God has given unto me. – I don’t lack strength, I edify myself by praying in tongues. – I don’t consider oppositions or pressures, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– Through the precious gift of tongues speaking, I edify myself to be a blessing unto many. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 760 - HE HAS GIVEN YOU HIS REST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Nothing should stop you from standing in the Truth, which is Christ. Don’t think the people of the world are ahead of you. Remember the adversary is the father of lies. He is always playing catch-up. Focus on the mandate the Lord has entrusted to you. Shalom! Author Friday, 21st, February, 2025 HE HAS GIVEN YOU HIS REST“Then Jesus said, “Come to me, all of you who are weary and carry heavy burdens, and I will give you rest.”Matthew 11:28 (NLT)From previous episodes,  we’ve been discussing BE HELPFUL and yesterday we looked at EDIFY YOURSELF.Which have been a refreshing daily feast.Today I want your heart to be fully settled on this reality that:
The victory that Christ has brought us is rich with His rest!
You don’t have to feel pressured and overwhelmed to help others.Glory to God!Whenever people get to think about their relationship with God, they first think of what they have to do for the Lord, or what they think the Lord has to do for them.
Most believers are work-oriented and self-oriented.
Jesus who is God manifested in the flesh, came to show us the delight of God.God is not essentially interested in what you want to do for Him or what you want. Through Christ Jesus, we see that God wants you to ENJOY HIM!To enjoy God is to focus on what He SUPPLIES to you.Read the opening verse again:Jesus said, “… I will GIVE you REST”.
Jesus didn’t invite you to Himself primarily because of what you will do for Him, but what He will give to you.
“Are you weary, carrying a heavy burden? Then come to me. I will refresh your life, for I am your oasis. Simply join your life with mine. Learn my ways and you’ll discover that I’m gentle, humble, easy to please. You will find refreshment and rest in me. For all that I require of you will be pleasant and easy to bear” Matthew 11:28-30 (TPT)
You cannot genuinely share in the delight of the Father when you have not enjoyed what He SUPPLIES to you.
His glory is expressed through you when you enjoy His gifts.When Jesus said, “I WILL GIVE YOU REST”. He meant it!The reality is this, as you have already come to Christ, HE HAS GIVEN YOU REST.
When you came into Christ, He didn’t only give you rest; YOU ENTERED HIS REST.
