“For the one who has once entered His rest has also rested from [the weariness and pain of] his [human] labors, just as God rested from [those labors uniquely] His own.” Hebrews 4:10 (Amplified)Whatever you do with the Lord and how you daily live must be rooted and established in the reality of the REST which CHRIST has given to you.Are you running or waging war in anxiety or the REST OF JESUS?We are in the rest of Jesus, therefore enjoy His rest!
His yoke is easy and His burden is light. He is not difficult to please.
Whatever He tells you to do, He is in it with you. He is the loving Father who bears your burdens.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_--SnHZsxbQDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 1:3; Hebrews 10:12; Luke 15:20-22; 1 John 5:3; Proverbs 3:17; John 16:33) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for the rest that He has given us in Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2024Numbers 36Deuteronomy 1 - 22 YEARS PLANExodus 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have entered into His rest.– I have seized from all my struggles and works.– I am not anxious about the future.– I have absolute dependence in the supply of the Lord.– I trust and enjoy the voice of God.– The Lord leads me daily in the oasis of peace by His voice.– The Lord is my satisfaction and enjoyment.– I am not need conscious.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 761 - DON'T BE DULL IN SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It is a wonder to be sorrowful in our Kingdom. Our strength is the JOY OF THE LORD. Beloved, do not be sorrowful no matter the situation or challenge, PRACTICE JOY! Author Saturday, 22nd February, 2025 DON'T BE DULL IN SPIRIT“so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV) The adversary doesn’t stop until he is resisted. Your resistance to the devil is not what brings you victory. To resist the devil is to enforce the victory that Christ has obtained for you.
Victory is your inheritance in Christ. Your responsibility is to enjoy that victory and not permit any force of darkness to derail you.
The goal of the devil is to disrupt your enjoyment of Christ’s victory for you, by using all his schemes to shipwreck your faith. Most believers don’t think it’s possible they can find themselves in this state. Which is understandable, considering what Christ has achieved for the new creation. The reality of the Born Again is this: “that even though we were dead because of our sins, he gave us life when he raised Christ from the dead. (It is only by God’s grace that you have been saved!)” Ephesians 2:5 (NLT) The life which the born again received is the New creation life or the Newness of Life. But until the saving grace of Jesus, the man who got saved was dead in sin.  This was also your state. Until you were saved in Christ, you were dead in sin. It was by the grace of God that you have been quickened or made alive in Christ. This was not the quickening of your mind. It was the quickening of your spirit. When you got born again, the life of God was transfused into your spirit. And by the continuous culturing and nurturing of your mind through the Word of God and the intimacy of the Holy Spirit, you experience transformation through the renewal of your mind. “Stop imitating the ideals and opinions of the culture around you, but be inwardly transformed by the Holy Spirit through a total reformation of how you think. This will empower you to discern God’s will as you live a beautiful life, satisfying and perfect in his eyes.” Romans 12:2 (TPT)
The more you experience the renewal of mind the more you experience transformation and inwardly become effective in the things of Christ.
When you are not experiencing a renewal of mind, you will start becoming dull in the things pertaining to Christ. Instead of growing in the knowledge of Christ and becoming more fervent in spirit, your mind rather imitates the ideals and opinions of the culture around you.  This leads to the deadness of your mind. The deadness of your mind is to lose interest in the things of Christ. To be dead in the mind is to be saved but think like an unbeliever. These are people who behave like unsaved.  There are some Christians who are not just dull in spirit but dead in their minds. Yes, they are born again; baptised in the Holy Spirit but are carnal. “For to be carnally minded is death, but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.” Romans 8:6 (KJV)
Dullness in spirit will always lead to carnality or deadness of mind when not corrected immediately.
When the adversary succeeds at luring you into this phase or state of mind, he doesn’t have to suggest thoughts any more to you. You will oppose the things of God by your own imagination and pride.  At this stage, you will esteem your thoughts above the truth of the scriptures. The way out of such a state is to decide to humble yourself before the Lord. 
If you are in this state where you are governed by your flesh and pride, you must turn to Jesus and submit to the authority of the Word.
Are you beginning to act contrary to the word of God? Are you losing interest in the things of Christ? You don’t even see the usefulness of Church meetings? Are you esteeming the activities of this world above the study of the Word and staying patiently to be taught in Church? It’s time to make a decision to be yielded and submissive to the instructions of Christ. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:2; Galatians 6:8; Galatians 5:16-17; Proverbs 14:12; John 6:63; 1 Corinthians 2:14) WE PRAYHeavenly Father,Thank you for the opportunity to grow in your word and be renewed in my mind unto total transformation. I pray that through the training of your word, I will always live in accordance with the revelation of the Newness of life in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 3 – 52 YEARS PLANExodus 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am fervent in Spirit. – My heart is always alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. – I refuse to be dominated by the flesh. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief, distraction and double-mindedness, deception, dullness and deadliness. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 762 - MAKE THE MOST OF EVERY OPPORTUNITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency God doesn’t direct your life without your involvement. God only shows you which way to go and how to steer the rudder of your life. You must make a decision that you are going to be a skillful captain to move your life in the way of the Lord. Shalom! Author Sunday, 23rd February, 2025 MAKE THE MOST OF EVERY OPPORTUNITY“Surprise us with love at daybreak; then we’ll skip and dance all the day long. Make up for the bad times with some good times; we’ve seen enough evil to last a lifetime”Psalm 90:14-15 (The Message)God has never designed life to be full of defeats and failures. God has never designed life to be backward. Life is to be lived forward. God never designed your life to be stagnant.It’s His joy that you advance and increase as you become fruitful by the day.
There is no glory in stagnation. The glory of God is manifested in your progress.
Everything about God and things made by Him are designed to become fruitful, advance lives, and express His glory.You don’t have to accept stagnation in any way. Don’t ever assume that God makes anyone’s life stagnant for any reason.Stagnation is not of God. Therefore, don’t live every day waiting or watching on without taking determined steps towards advancement.Time doesn’t stop or wait. You may think the seconds or hour ahead may not yet come, but suddenly you look back and ask or wonder, “Where did those seconds go?”As much as you don’t have to live a rushed life or allow delay to create anxiety, you shouldn’t live any day without taking steps towards your progress or advancement.
God has never intended that anyone’s life should be wasted, delayed, stagnant, slow and fruitless.
Though Abraham indeed experienced some delays, and David became relevant as early as 17, why must you not have early success?God doesn’t endorse delay. Delay and stagnation have their cause. When those factors that cause delays are properly addressed, there can be tangible progress.God desires that you redeem the times (Ephesians 5:16). To redeem the times is to make the most of every opportunity or to improve every opportunity.Read it in the Amplified:“making the very most of your time [on earth, recognizing and taking advantage of each opportunity and using it with wisdom and diligence], because the days are [filled with] evil.”
God wants you to experience restoration from wasted years.
“So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten…” Joel 2:25God wants you to live your days and years in prosperity and glory. (Job 36:11)He wants you to have early success and satisfaction.The Psalmist having this understanding prayed to the Lord saying:  “Surprise or satisfy us early with your mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days” (Psalm 90:14).This means it is possible for one not to be satisfied early in his days. And it is also possible for one not to be glad all his days.It is not normal to keep having “ups” and “downs”. You can have your whole life flooded with peace and prosperity. You can have a life full of progress and fruitfulness.What you accept as your revelation becomes the definition of your estate. Refuse stagnation, refuse failure, refuse unfruitfulness.
Make a decision today that you are redeeming the times.
Make the most of every opportunity now, to experience early success.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12-17; Romans 13:11; Psalm 37:18-19; Ecclesiastes 9:12; Job 36:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall incline our hearts to the wisdom of God, and that we improve every opportunity and have early success BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 6 – 82 YEARS PLANExodus 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I incline my heart to the wisdom of God. – Through the wisdom of God, I make the most of every opportunity to have early success. – I make daily progress and success. – I make each day count. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 763 - REFUSE TO FEAR ANY EVIL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When the vicissitudes seem to submerge or suffocate you, don’t respond with a struggle, train your mind and heart to trust in the Lord. That is how you refuse to struggle. To trust in the Lord is to be in a position of rest. In this position, you float on the challenges of life. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 24th February, 2025  REFUSE TO FEAR ANY EVIL “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.”  Psalm 23:4 (NKJV) To walk in the valley of the shadow of death, is to be overwhelmed or hedged in and surrounded by some dark experience intended to create fear of destruction.  This “valley of the shadow of death” is not the dwelling or destination of the believer. When you find yourself in such situations, know that you are not dwelling there. You walk through it! The “shadow of death” speaks of the “grave” (figuratively calamity). Well, in the midst of such situations, you have a greater assurance. You are under the care of the Good Shepherd. His presence with you is your confidence and audacity.
Don’t get troubled and feel threatened because you are confronted by a difficult situation. Yours is to trust the GOOD SHEPHERD. 
In your most difficult moments, who do you speak to? From the first verses of Psalm 23, the Psalmist was addressing his readers, and referred to the Shepherd as the third person – “HE”. But from verse 4, David begins to refer to the Shepherd in the second person – “YOU”. He was no longer addressing his readers, he was now addressing his Shepherd.This reveals how David turned to his Shepherd in his most difficult times.
He makes the Lord his consciousness.
The Lord’s presence does not necessarily eradicate the challenges and the dangers of the adversary. However, the Lord’s presence is the haven of care and defense for you in the midst of the most evil situation. You may definitely be faced with some challenges and situations which seem difficult, DON’T FEAR ANY EVIL. The adversary may even attempt to cast thoughts of a worse scenario on your mind; but refuse to accept those thoughts.  Refuse to be discouraged. 
Refuse to be afraid for the LORD IS WITH YOU.
Maybe the Lord leads you into a marriage, or to start a business or ministry, and suddenly everything seems to go bad. Refuse to fear evil.  In your family, marriage, business, finances, ministry, career pursuit and journey of success, REMAIN RESOLUTE WITH THIS CERTAINTY THAT THE LORD IS WITH YOU. You cannot end up as a failure. Don’t accept those thoughts of fear. You will come out of that valley of the shadow of death as a victor! Remember the RESURRECTION ABILITY OF CHRIST is at WORK IN YOU. Jesus defeated death for you to enjoy the fullness of His life.
You have conquered all powers of death.
Walk in victory! DON’T FEAR ANY EVIL! Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 20:1; 2 Samuel 22:19; Psalm 3:6; Psalm 27:1) WE PRAYI pray declaring the victory of the Lord and the manifestation of the power of His presence in the midst of every evil situation. I overcome every challenge by the power of the Lord’s presence.  In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 9 – 11 2 YEARS PLANExodus 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be discouraged. – I refuse to be afraid for the LORD IS WITH ME. – I trust in the GOOD SHEPHERD therefore I fear no evil. – I walk through everyday of my life with this consciousness. – I have conquered all powers of death. – I remain absolute in this certainty. – I walk in victory everyday. Oh Glory to God! Hallelujah! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 764 - EDIFY YOURSELF 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency In this year of Kingdom Priesthood, maintain a deeper intimate relationship with the Lord Jesus, through the Word and the communion of the Holy Spirit; and your impact will be matchless. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 25th February, 2025 EDIFY YOURSELF 2"He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the54 church." 1 Corinthians 14:4 (NKJV)As I explained in the first part of this topic, tongues speaking is not some religious gimmick.Tongues speaking is the communion between the one speaking and God. To speak in tongues is to speak mysteries.
Whereas prophecies edify or build up the Church or benefit all the saints; tongues speaking builds up the individual believer.
"But [on the other hand] the one who prophesies speaks to people for edification [to promote their spiritual growth] and [speaks words of] encouragement [to uphold and advise them concerning the matters of God] and [speaks words of] consolation [to compassionately comfort them]" 1 Corinthians 14:3 (Amplified Bible)Tongues speaking is one of the quickest means by which a believer experiences personal edification. The apostle Paul said, "I thank God that I speak in [unknown] tongues more than all of you" 1 Corinthians 14:18 (Amplified Bible).Take note of this in the opening verse:"He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself..."The word edify is from the Greek word, "oikodomēo", which means to construct a house or to be a house builder. It is also an expression which connotes the strengthening of a great or huge building.And when you speak in tongues (note what he said), "EDIFIES HIMSELF".Paul didn't say, he who speaks in tongues edifies only his spirit. He said HIMSELF. This has to do with your entire being. Through tongues speaking you build your spirit, your soul and your body.
Through tongues speaking, you make supplication of power to your body. This deals with anxiety and fear.
Anxiety leads to depression and also triggers your flight-or-fight stress response. It releases a flood of adrenaline into your system.The moment anxiety persists within you, it will lead to chronic stress, and even when the stress moment passes your body remains in that state where the system is flooded with adrenaline chemicals. That may lead to weakness in the immune system. The moment your immune system becomes weak, it becomes vulnerable to prevent infections and viruses.This is how people who are often stressed get sick easily. Do you now understand why you become weak after you have been overwhelmed with sorrow and sadness for a long time?"A joyful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones" Proverbs 17:22 (ESV).That is why the Apostle Paul charged the brethren in Philippi:"do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God." Philippians 4:6 (ESV)
Instead of worry and sorrow, pray. And most importantly to build up your entire being, pray in tongues.
When a believer in Christ speaks in tongues, he releases spiritual currents of power and unleashes energies from the Spirit to his entire being (spirit, soul and body). You receive endowment in your spirit, and also in your mind to make decisions, to direct your emotions, to be refreshed and quickened in the body.Don't go a day without speaking in tongues.Get to it now!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JL35LOW-LHIDIG DEEPER(Acts 2:4; 1 Corinthians 14:14,26; Jude 1:20) WE PRAYPray thanking the Lord for the ability of the Spirit to pray in tongues.(Spend some hours praying in tongues).BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 12 – 142 YEARS PLANExodus 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I dont’t trviliase the precious gift of tongues speaking. – Under all circumstaces and at all times, I have the strength to carry out the assignment God has given unto me. – I don’t lack strength, I edify myself by praying in tongues. – I don’t consider oppositions or pressures, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– Through the precious gift of tongues speaking, I edify myself to be a blessing unto many. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 765 - BE FULLY CHARGED AND RECHARGED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God. What are you waiting for? Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT. Author Wednesday, 26th February, 2025 BE FULLY CHARGED AND RECHARGED"He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church." 1 Corinthians 14:4 (NKJV)In this century people appreciate the need for electrical power. Every form of machinery and technology designed to make living easy for mankind depends on electrical power. This electrical power is indicated by the flow or current of electric charge or energy transferred through a circuit.Most of the gadgets we use require electrical energy or power to be charged for use.As believers in Christ, "... we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us" Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified Bible)We cannot be useful to God according to our own power or ability. The work of God requires the power of God. And God's power is within every believer in Christ. When you become born again, you receive the Holy Spirit.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have power in you.
This was what Jesus said:"But I promise you this—the Holy Spirit will come upon you and you will be filled with power. And you will be my messengers to Jerusalem, throughout Judea, the distant provinces—even to the remotest places on earth!” Acts 1:8 (TPT)The power of God in you must always be intensified in you. To do what the Lord has called you to do you must be fervent in Spirit (Romans 12:11).Tongues speaking is God's special technology for the believer to be always charged and recharged for good works.As Paul the apostle said, "...He who speaks in tongues edifies himself..."This edification as explained in the previous episode, is to build yourself as a strong edifice.It also means advancing your spiritual progress and always being recharged with divine energies.Your inward man doesn't run low in the transmission of the power of God. Tongues speaking stirs you up and cause you to remain fervent.
You cannot speak in tongues and remain dull. Tongues speaking sets you up on fire for greater works.
Just as you keep your gadgets fully charged for use, that is how you must fully keep yourself charged through the Spirit.You have to be intentional about it. You don't have to always wait for the Holy Spirit to move you or prompt you to pray in the Spirit. Don't wait to hear a voice or be confronted with a challenge before you speak in tongues. Make it your habit to pray in the Spirit consistently and spontaneously. "But you, beloved, build yourselves up on [the foundation of] your most holy faith [continually progress, rise like an edifice higher and higher], pray in the Holy Spirit" Jude 1:20 (AMP)Pray long in the Spirit as you go about your daily activities. Speak in tongues often to be charged up for greater action.This is how you set yourself up to shine.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(Acts 2:4; 1 Corinthians 14:14,15, 26; 1 Timothy 2:8; Romans 12:11; Ephesians 6:18) WE PRAYPray declaring that the quickening power of God in you will permeate your entire being as you step out and shine the light of God in every place you go.(Spend some hours praying in tongues).BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 15 – 172 YEARS PLANExodus 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t trviliase the precious gift of tongues speaking.– Under all circumstaces and at all times, I have the strength to carry out the assignment God has given unto me. – I don’t lack strength, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– I don’t consider oppositions or pressures, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– Through the precious gift of tongues speaking, I edify myself to be a blessing unto many. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 766 - ABOVE ALL ELSE GUARD YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the secrets of God are not hidden from you. The secrets of God and His universe are within your heart. Hallelujah! Author  ABOVE ALL ELSE GUARD YOUR HEART“Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life” Proverbs 4:23 (NLT) The instruction of the Lord is always to our advantage. God knows your constitution and how you can best walk in the consummation of your divine call. And the interesting thing is, whatever God instructs man on, the adversary goes after it. So in Eden, when God instructed man concerning the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, the adversary went after it. Whatever God is interested in regarding your life, the adversary develops an interest in it.  Don’t give him access! One of the crucial things the adversary takes interest in is the heart of man.
The heart of man is the seat of all thoughts and all feelings.
The complexity of man’s constitution is intriguing beyond what has been accumulated. Man’s entire being is as a universe. And that is how God sees man. If eternity can be assimilated into man who lives in time, that should let you know the extent of man’s wonder.  The Bible says, “….He has set eternity in the heart of man…..” Ecclesiastes 3:11 It means man has the capacity to travel into “eternal future and eternal past.” So you can consider the Prophet Moses, he was inspired by God to write the book of Genesis. He articulated the creative work of God, as though he was walking with God side by side, whiles He was creating the universe. How was it possible? It was through the influence of God’s vision in his heart.
In all of man’s constitution, the center of his being is THE HEART!
A man’s heart is as a womb or a haven of conception. Nothing happens in a man’s life or world without first beginning as a seed in the heart of man. Thoughts are first cultivated in the heart of man.
Life is predictable.
There is nothing like unpredictable events in life. Anything that happens within time results from a man’s thought and action.  Whatever you want to see manifest in your life, you must take conceptualized and predictable steps. That is the role of the heart. The difference between those who make a great impact and those who struggle to make an impact is the condition of their heart. “Listen carefully, my dear child, to everything that I teach you, and pay attention to all that I have to say. Fill your thoughts with my words until they penetrate deep into your spirit. Then, as you unwrap my words, they will impart true life and radiant health into the very core of your being. So above all, guard the affections of your heart, for they affect all that you are. Pay attention to the welfare of your innermost being, for from there flows the wellspring of life.  Avoid dishonest speech and pretentious words. Be free from using perverse words no matter what!”Proverbs 4:20-24(TPT)
Beloved, the entire construction of your life is in your heart. 
You must give attention to the things you construct in your heart. So what then is in your heart? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(Luke 6:45; Deuteronomy 4:9; Matthew 15:18-19) WE PRAYThat we will keep our hearts and minds stayed on the word God as we delight deeply in it. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 18 – 202 YEARS PLANExodus 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:–  I guard my heart with all diligence. – I don’t give room for toxic thoughts. – I delight my heart in the word of God. – I keep my heart and mind stayed on the word of God. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. – I am a doer of the word. – I don’t entertain the company of mockers. OH Hallelujah, Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 767 - PRAY FOR YOUR LEADER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved the Lord has need of you; avail yourself for His use, not because of your selfish gains. Be motivated and inspired by His Lordship, His love, and the impact of others. Selah. Author Friday, 28th, February 2025 PRAY FOR YOUR LEADER“and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel”Ephesians 6:19 (NKJV)The gap between God’s plan and the fulfilment of that plan is God’s people.
Anything God has accomplished on Earth, He did it through His people.
God will always appoint a man among His people to become a voice, a leader and a lighthouse. This is not to create an impression that others are better. This is by the workings of God’s grace.Those leaders God appoints become conduits of His greater works.God has set leaders in the church to be responsible for the growth of each saint and to equip the saints for the spread of the gospel according to the power of the Holy Spirit.
The mindset of the spiritual leaders, will affect the mindset of the people and influence the climate of the Church within a locality.
These leaders in the Church mostly labour for the spread of the gospel. Sometimes most believers assume their leaders are strong in faith and don’t need prayers.It is important you understand that, through prayers, you make the abundant supply of divine grace, strength and provisions in the spirit to your leader. There are many ways the adversary wants to destroy and distract their focus and pursuit of God’s plan.
In the labour of the gospel, people risk their lives and come close to death.
To do the work of the ministry and to spread the gospel is true warfare. And the adversary seeks every opportunity to attack and destroy not only the saints, but mainly the shepherds or those who lead the saints.“…Strike the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered…” (Zechariah 13:7)Epaphroditus was a leader who was assisting Paul on behalf of the saints in Philippi, at the frontline of the ministry, even as Paul was in prison.Paul in his epistles referred to Epaphroditus as “fellow soldier” (Philippians 2:25).This characterizes the nature of the work they were doing. They worked or laboured as fellow soldiers because the work of the ministry is a spiritual warfare.“However, I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, [who has been] my brother and companion and fellow soldier, who was also sent as your messenger to take care of my needs. For he has been longing for all of you and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick. He certainly was sick and close to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow. So I have sent him all the more eagerly so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned about you. Welcome him home in the Lord with great joy, and appreciate and honor men like him; because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me [which distance prevented you from rendering personally].” Phillipians 2:25-3 (Amplified Bible)This is the reason Paul’s prayer request in Ephesians 6:19-20, unveils the objective of spiritual warfare.
This spiritual warfare against the forces of darkness is mainly to ensure that the gospel of Jesus shall prevail in all places.
This is war.The adversary is plotting against the Church and the leaders.And for your Church leaders to firmly stand to continue in the labour of the gospel, you must make supplication for them daily.This is to your advantage.Has this with blessed you in any way?Then you must pray for me as well.
There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy.
Beloved, pray and honor those who labour in the gospel of Jesus.Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F2ptPfOwsCA&t=12sDIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:3; Romans 15:30; 2 Corinthians 1:11; Philippians 1:19) WE PRAYPray for your leader, Pastor or shepherd and Teacher of the gospel, that he or she will stand strong in the faith and remain focus in labour of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 21 – 232 YEARS PLANExodus 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel.– The Lord is making them increase in boldness.– They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord.– They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power.– They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil.– The faith of the Leaders shall not grow cold. They will increase in the Lord’s zeal and in great faith. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 768 - DESIRE TO GROW IN KNOWLEDGE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It will take the attitude of humility to make a difference. Don’t trust in your intelligence above the knowledge of God’s word. Don’t be big-headed, be humble at all times. Shalom! Author Saturday, 1st March, 2025 DESIRE TO GROW IN KNOWLEDGE“The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.”Proverbs 15:14 (KJV)HELLOO!I WELCOME YOU TO THE NEW MONTH OF MARCH.This month shall be a special month with glorious blessings for you. Enjoy every grace and favor of God which shall be supplied to you this month.You have to decide that you will live and express the full life of God in you.The greatest challenge of every believer is not first the devil, with his cohorts and deceptive operations. The greatest challenge of the believer is IGNORANCE.
Ignorance simply means lack of knowledge.
And as the Lord said to the leaders of Israel “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge…” Hosea 4:6 (ESV).The nation Israel was called out by God to serve the Lord’s purpose as a Priestly nation. Yet these men often turned away from the knowledge of the Lord to kowtow to idols and found themselves afflicted.The knowledge these Israelites lacked wasn’t scientific knowledge or military understanding. The knowledge which they lacked was the true knowledge of God.Let’s read it in the Amplified Bible and the New Living Translation to have some clarity:“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge [of My law, where I reveal My will]. Because you [the priestly nation] have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you from being My priest. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.” (Amplified Bible)However, the wisdom here can be applied to other areas of life. The scripture is specifically pointing to the knowledge of the revelation of God’s will.The Lord is not speaking to the Prophet about some generic knowledge. You can have knowledge in all science and still be destroyed. 
Your salvation and walk in glory is according to the revelation of the knowledge of God which is at work in you.
Take a look at the New Living Translation:“My people are being destroyed because they don’t know me. Since you priests refuse to know me, I refuse to recognize you as my priests. Since you have forgotten the laws of your God, I will forget to bless your children.”A practical example was when Goliath came out each morning to challenge and taunt the Israelites and the Lord God Almighty. None of these trained soldiers had the audacity to confront Goliath.These soldiers were skilful and trained for battle. They knew how to wield every weapon in their possessions yet they couldn’t dare to confront Goliath. Their military knowledge wasn’t enough.It took a young boy, David, who understood the covenant and the power of the Name of the LORD.He said to Goliath, “You come to me with sword, spear, and javelin, but I come to you in the name of the LORD of Heaven’s Armies—the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.” (1 Samuel 17:45). The audacity of David was by the knowledge of God which was in him. He was one who passionately longed after God and desired to share in His intimate knowledge.He said, “Lord, I passionately love you and I’m bonded to you! I want to embrace you, for now you’ve become my power!” Psalm 18:1 (TPT).
You don’t perish by the lack of knowledge in science. You perish when you lack the knowledge of God.
The knowledge of God in you brings you into the full understanding and possession of the glorious inheritance in Christ Jesus.When you become born again, you don’t automatically grow into the full knowledge of God. As I always say, you must be intentional about your growth in the knowledge of God.You have to intentionally seek after the knowledge of God. To know God is not a one-time experience, but a lifetime journey.
The more you grow in knowledge and understanding of God, the more you develop the desire and longing to know Him more. 
Those who don’t see the need to pursue the knowledge of God are those who have not yet come to the place of understanding.The opening verse says the mouth of fools pursues foolishness. It takes a heart of understanding to seek after God’s knowledge.“Lovers of God hunger after truth, but those without understanding feast on foolishness and don’t even realize it.” Proverbs 15:14 (TPT).You can see how Paul, even in his maturity, still desired and remained committed in his pursuit to know God. (Philippians 3:10).
Make it a priority to seek after the knowledge of God in this new month.
Remain blessed!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(John 8:31-32; Proverbs 18:15; Hosea 6:3,6; Isaiah 5:13; Jeremiah 5:4; Proverbs 20:15) WE PRAYWe pray that our hunger for the knowledge of God shall be kindled at all times BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 24 – 262 YEARS PLANExodus 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of God. – I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. – As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. – I am full of the knowledge of Christ. Oh Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 769 - LIVE IN HIS REST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do you think you have badly dishonored God, wickedly lived and opposed God’s purpose or doubted God’s power and love? Well, God’s arms are still open to receive you. He is your greatest help, don’t turn away from Him. Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 2nd March, 2025LIVE IN HIS REST“But now, after that, ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?” Galatians 4:9  (KJV)One of the key things you must understand is that, when you came into Christ, you were brought into a life of Rest and not under another yoke of religion.Jesus is not a religious leader. He is God who became flesh to bring us into the reality of life. (1 Timothy 3:16)
God’s intention for man has always been to make His Life germinate in man, that man will be His expression.
When you cultivate the Life of God in you, you will live in REST.The REST I am talking about here is not how you cease from work or movement in order to relax or sleep.
When you come into Christ, you are brought into Rest.
This rest is living according to the divine essence in you. It is living above the anxiety, burden, fear and condemnation of the Old Covenant law and the demands you place upon yourself through other worthless religious principles and philosophies.In the opening verse, Galatians 4:9, Paul spoke of weak and beggarly elements; the question is what are these weak and beggarly elements Paul was speaking of?These weak and beggarly elements are the worthless principles of religion and philosophies.These include paganism, the bondage of Jewish rituals and ordinances, and also baseless or empty scientific philosophies designed by men to oppose the reality of God.If you are reading this and you are not born again, understand Jesus came not to introduce you to a new religion called “Christianity”. This is how most people see Christianity. They assume it’s one of the religious groups. They are not to be blamed, some ecclesiastical caucus have made religion out of what should be the dispensing of life.
Jesus came to translate you into the reality of the Kingdom life of God.
Read what He said and He is saying the same thing to you now:“Are you tired? Worn out? Burned out on religion? Come to me. Get away with me and you’ll recover your life. I’ll show you how to take a real rest. Walk with me and work with me—watch how I do it. Learn the unforced rhythms of grace. I won’t lay anything heavy or ill-fitting on you. Keep company with me and you’ll learn to live freely and lightly.” Matthew 11:28-30 (Message)Jesus came to bring you rest from all your efforts to be righteous or justified. He came to take off the burdens or entrapments of superstitions, taboos and regulations of religion.
Jesus came to usher you into a new – living way of peace and fulfilment of life.
If you are reading this and you are born again, rejoice and remain confident in the reality of Jesus. He has brought you into true rest.
Don’t be lured to think living by grace is not enough. Don’t place any yoke of religious duties upon yourself.
Just as Paul said to the brethren in Colosse:“See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception [pseudo-intellectual babble], according to the tradition [and musings] of mere men, following the elementary principles of this world, rather than following [the truth—the teachings of] Christ.” Colossians 2:8 (Amplified)
Remain resolute in the teachings of Christ. Set your mind and affection on the revelation of Jesus. Refused to be swayed by some pseudo-intellectual babble.
Enjoy your true and intimate relationship with the Father, which is founded on His unconditional love and not religious regulations and deceptive philosophies.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:1; Acts 15: 6-11; Matthew 23:4; Galatians 4:1-5,9; Galatians 2:3-5) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be given to any pseudo-intellectual babble, but will remain established in the revelation of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 27 – 292 YEARS PLANExodus 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am free from any yoke of religion.  – I walk daily in the liberty that Christ has given me. – I live a life of rest daily. – I have been translated into the reality of the Kingdom life of God. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 770 - FOLLOW HIS EXAMPLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you are made complete in Christ. Stop looking at things you think you lack or don’t have. Look inside, you have God’s greatest treasure. Selah! Author Monday, 3rd March, 2025FOLLOW HIS EXAMPLE“Whether you eat or drink, live your life in a way that glorifies and honors God.” 1 Corinthians 10:31 (TPT) Our Lord Jesus is the ultimate model and pattern of our Faith. Our true identity is in Christ. Jesus came to unveil the mystery of godliness (1 Timothy 3:16). The mystery of godliness is the expression of the GOD-MAN (Jesus was revealed as fully God and fully man).  Thus the mystery of godliness is not just the revelation of God to man; it is also the revelation of man’s originality to man.
Man’s renaissance of identity and purpose can only be found in Christ Jesus.
That is why we are charged through the scriptures to continue to behold Jesus.As you behold Jesus you begin to live and function like Him.  “…As He is, so are we in this world” (1 John 4:17). To function like Jesus is to live the life God has predestined you to be conformed to His image and live like He did (Romans 8:29). When you became born again, you received His life and nature. His purpose also became your purpose.
In Salvation, we were created to be in the likeness and image of Jesus.
“…Nevertheless I live yet not I but it is Christ that lives in me. The life that I live now in the flesh  I live by the faith of the Son of God…” (Galatians 2:20). All that Jesus did was unto the glory of God. What else must be the purpose of your living and what you do?
It must be unto the glory of God just as Jesus lived.
Jesus lived to honor the Father above Himself. We also have to live to honor the Father above ourselves. We don’t honor God just to win favor from Him. We honor the Father for who He is.
We don’t live like ordinary men, for they have no thoughts of God and don’t live to acknowledge Him nor glorify Him.
“For since the creation of the world, His invisible attributes are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even His eternal power and Godhead, so that they are without excuse, because, although they knew God, they did not glorify Him as God, nor were thankful, but became futile in their thoughts, and their foolish hearts were darkened.” Romans 1:20-21 (NKJV).
However, as you are in Christ, the Prophecy of Isaiah is your reality.
“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.“ The hearts of men are darkened and they walk in the futility of their thoughts because they have not acknowledged and glorified God; even though they see His attributes through creation. But for us, our reality is different, when we beheld and received Jesus, the glorious light of the knowledge of God shone in our hearts. Therefore, we live daily to glorify and honor God.
Whatever you do, look beyond your self-interest, or satisfaction. Whatever you do must not be according to your will or desire but unto God’s glory and honor. 
You don’t do things just to please yourself. You don’t do things just because it is a sin or not. The question is: How does it GLORIFY GOD?
How is your daily life, your speech, your conduct bringing glory to God and honoring Him?
This is how you emulate the example of Jesus. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; 1 Peter 4:11; Psalm 97:6; Isaiah 35:2; John 7:18; Isaiah 43:1,7) WE PRAYThat we shall not live according to the futile thoughts and darkened hearts of men. But we will live everyday emulating Jesus (who glorified the Father in everything). In the glorious name of Jesus BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 30 – 322 YEARS PLANExodus 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t live unto my own interest. – I live unto God’s glory and honour. – My life honours the Lord. – I live to glorify the Lord. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 771 - THE PRIMARY ASSIGNMENT 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved the work of Christ on the cross is God’s ultimate work to make salvation available for all men. Don’t be deceived by any false doctrine. No animal sacrifice can produce eternal salvation. Your eternal salvation is in Christ Jesus. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 4th March, 2025 THE PRIMARY ASSIGNMENT"Jesus called out to them and said, “Come and follow me, and I will transform you into men who catch people for God." Matthew 4:19 (TPT)When our Lord Jesus called His disciples, He was specific, direct, clear and blunt on what He was going to turn them into.He was not going to produce "marketplace apostles". He would not make them lawyers, accountants, successful medical doctors, politicians, Phd holders, international economists, CEOs of multinational empires, engineers, programmers, etc.
Jesus was going to make them new kinds of fishermen. He was going to turn them into men who catch people for God.
Jesus did not call His disciples to essentially improve their fishing business. He called them with the primary intention of transforming them into men who catch people for God.This doesn't mean our Lord devalue our individual careers or professions. Neither does it mean that He doesn't bless our work. The Lord is interested in our career success, because He loves us. He instructs us to work and not be lazy through His word.However, some believers have redefined the primary assignment of the believer. These people become disciples of Jesus with the perception that the Lord is going to help them succeed in their career or professional ambitions.Did Jesus not help Peter to catch more fish?The Lord did help Peter and his friends (Luke 5:4-11), and He continues to help those who believe in Him and respond to the instructions of the Spirit to succeed at what they do.Irrespective of your career or occupation, your primary assignment as a disciple of Jesus is to make more disciples.Jesus said, "...I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit..." John 15:16 (NLT)
This is the primary purpose of being a disciple of Jesus; to be like Christ and to become a fisher of men.
As a disciple of Jesus, you are brought into His fellowship and followership, so that through you God will bring many more men into His fellowship and followership."Then Jesus came close to them and said, “All the authority of the universe has been given to me. Now go in my authority and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. And teach them to faithfully follow all that I have commanded you. And never forget that I am with you every day, even to the completion of this age.” Matthew 28:19-20 (TPT)No matter what you do, you must find yourself catching men for God. That is God's desire.
He desires that all men shall be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth.
Be the medium by which the Lord's desire will be fulfilled.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ddVEYpXXiW8DIG DEEPER(Acts 1:8; Philippians 1:11; John 20:21; 1 Corinthians 9: 16-17) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds will be settled on the fulfilment of the Lord's primary assignment for us as His disciples. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 33 – 34Joshua 12 YEARS PLANExodus 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My mind is set on fulfilling the Lord's primary assignment for me. - I don't replace the primary asignment of winning men unto the Lord with any other thing. - Through me, many are experiencing the knowledge of the truth. - I daily avail myself as the medium by which the Lord's desire will be fulfilled.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 772 - THE PRIMARY ASSIGNMENT 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter how you think you have offended or disappointed God, He will not withhold His love from you when you call. No matter how deep you have drowned in defeat, God’s unfailing love will sustain you. Trust in the love of God for you, it never fails! Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 5th March, 2025 THE PRIMARY ASSIGNMENT 2"Jesus called out to them and said, “Come and follow me, and I will transform you into men who catch people for God." Matthew 4:19 (TPT)God desires that all men will be saved. People are His desire and pleasure.He made the earth for man, and made man for the expression of Himself. God never designed man to perish. He made man for His glory.He's always had good intentions for man. God's goal for man is to indwell man and become man's satisfaction. It has always been His pleasure to bring man into His union and fellowship.To fully achieve this, He sent His Son Jesus in the fullness of time, to deal with the problem of sin (which caused the separation of man from God). Through Jesus' finished work in His death, burial and resurrection, all men had access to salvation.
Christ died for our offenses, and for our justification He was raised (Romans 4:25).
God's work through the ages is to set man free from the bondage of sin and to bring man into His eternal fellowship, which was completed through the resurrection of Jesus.By what Christ Jesus our Lord has done, we have peace with God.This is the glorious news of salvation to all men. And through the system of discipleship, as many who come to receive this truth and come into this glorious fellowship with God have the primary assignment to spread this good news of Jesus to others."And God has made all things new, and reconciled us to Himself, and given us the ministry of reconciling others to God." 2 Corinthians 5:18 (TPT) God's primary assignment through Christ was to bring us into Himself. And the moment we came into Christ, He entrusted us with this wonderful assignment of reconciliation.
Wherever you find yourself as a believer, you must joyously prioritize this primary assignment of bringing many to God through Christ.
As many as are reconciled to God through Christ, begin to enjoy God's glorious life in Christ.The assignment of reconciliation translates men from darkness into light and from slavery into sonship.It gives meaning and hope to the hopeless.This is the Lord's commission for every believer.Don't look away, to pursue your own selfish interest. Don't invest all your time into what makes you happy or pleases you. Set your affection on this assignment of soul winning or ministry of reconciliation. 
Make the Lord's mission your mission and passion.
Don't procrastinate, get to work now!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Acts 1:8; Philippians 1:11; John 20:21; 1 Corinthians 9: 16-17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall diligently remain committed to the Lord's assignment and mission every day of our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJoshua 2 - 42 YEARS PLANExodus 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My mind is set on fulfilling the Lord’s primary assignment for me.– I don’t replace the primary asignment of winning men unto the Lord with any other thing. – Through me, many are experiencing the knowledge of the truth.– I daily avail myself as the medium by which the Lord’s desire will be fulfilled.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 773 - DON'T TAKE "NO" AS AN ANSWER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency What is God’s testimony of you? God is not raising you for yourself and your family. God is raising you for His WILL. You can’t also serve God and at the same time serve your own purpose and the purposes of the world. You can’t have two masters. Selah! Author Thursday, 6th March, 2025 DON'T TAKE "NO" AS AN ANSWER“Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences” 2 Corinthians 5:11 (NKJV) To PERSUADE (Peitho) signifies “to apply persuasion, to prevail upon or win over, to persuade,” bringing about a change of mind by the influence of reason or moral considerations. It is to induce one by words to cause belief in a thing (which one sets forth), to make friends of, win one’s favor, gain one’s goodwill, or to seek or strive to win one. (See Vine Expository and Strong’s Dictionary). In a parable, Jesus shared in Luke 14 a certain man invited many to join him in a great feast. But one by one they all made excuses, on the day of the feast. Yet see what the master said to his servant: “And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled” Luke 14:23 After the previous excuses, the master changed his approach or instruction. It was no longer about invitation, it is now a matter of COMPELLING/ PERSUADING (Anagkazó). This is how we have to think towards God’s work. Until we compel men we will not see God’s work done as He wants it done. 
Anagkazó means to put constraint upon whether by threat, entreaty, force or persuasion.
 Men will always choose the “self” or their own selfish desires. Men will struggle to choose Christ and the things of Christ. They already see themselves as enemies of God in their minds. (Colossians 1:21) But we have the duty to make many turn to the Lord and to see His Love. We have a duty to snatch men from darkness. “and some save, snatching them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh” Jude 1:23 (American Standard Version) Will you stand to watch a friend or another man commit suicide while you can help? When you see someone walking by a roadside and don’t see an oncoming vehicle, you will find a way to save that fellow if you truly care. This is how it is. Many are heading towards destruction. Some knowingly and others unknowingly. To reject Christ is to commit eternal suicide. 
For one to reject Christ means he or she has denied his or her eternal security.
 Are you going to look on for others to perish? Certainly not! Have you heard this before?“Being born again is not a necessity, everyone has the right to choose his or her own path of religion and salvation”. What did you think about it? And this:“If they will not attend the Church meeting it is not by force.” Interesting… Listen, apart from Jesus, “Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved” Acts 4:12. Salvation is only in JESUS. And when they reject Jesus they perish. (John 3:16)
Men who have not received the Lord, don’t know they need salvation and how to get saved. The God of this world has blinded their minds (2 Corinthians 4:4)
Others have their lives controlled by demons. Therefore, until they are persuaded through God’s Spirit and our relentless pursuit, they cannot decide to receive Jesus nor be involved in ministry. Most excuses people make are by selfish, demonic, ungodly influences. Some people may want to attend a Church meeting, but the forces controlling them prevent them from deciding. So, they find excuses. Though those excuses are untrue, they will try to stand by them. Thus, we must be relentless, since we know what they need. Understand that we are not wrestling just with their choices but the forces governing their thoughts. Therefore, we PERSUADE THEM. We also don’t take “NO” as an answer, no matter how polite or hostile they sound. SNATCH THEM OUT OF THE FIRE. SNATCH THEM OUT OF DARKNESS.
The Lord has given you power through the Spirit to do this.
 Do it at all cost! Because the LOVE of CHRIST IS AT WORK IN YOU, you will take steps to see others saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth. This is God’s desire (1 Timothy 2:4) GO OUT THERE TO SAVE MEN AND DON’T TAKE “NO” AS AN ANSWER. COMPEL THEM, SNATCH THEM, AND PERSUADE THEM TO COME IN, SO THE LORD’S HOUSE MAY BE FULL. YOU ARE THE MAN FOR THE JOB. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:1-2; Luke 14:15-24; Romans 1:16; 1 Corinthians 9:12; 2 Corinthians 5:11-21) WE PRAYThat we increase in the wisdom to strategically get men saved no matter the hostility and hindrances. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJoshua 5 – 72 YEARS PLANExodus 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I relentlessly persuade men to be saved. – I have a strong heart and genuine passion of love for the unreached souls. – I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ. – As a light bearer I cannot be intimidated by darkness. – I get many saved at all cost. – I am the man for the job. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 774 - RUN TOWARDS YOUR GOAL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you begin to recognise, understand and become conscious that God is your Father, you will always attempt to use mechanisms to connect to God. Prayer will become a mechanic method and not an organic expression of your relationship with God. Selah! Author Friday, 7th March, 2025 RUN TOWARDS YOUR GOAL"It's not that I've already reached the goal or have already completed the course. But I run to win that which Jesus Christ has already won for me." Philippins 3:12 (God's Word Translation)The finished work of Christ, through His death, burial, and resurrection, does not mean that we have no work or task as believers in Christ.
The finished work of Christ has produced the goodness of God in every believer.
The Lord has made every new creation in Christ His workmanship unto good works (Ephesians 2:10). Interestingly, these good works were foreordained in God before the foundation of the world.God planned in advance our destiny and the good works we would do to fulfill it.Which means by Christ's finished work, we have access through faith into God and have been established in Him to execute His plans by our good works of faith.The life of every believer is to be the execution of God's eternal purpose. The original goal and purpose of your life is not for you to live and accomplish your personal ambition.The goal of your life is to execute God's purpose.All that you need to accomplish God's purpose and plan for your life are fully supplied to you by God, through His Spirit. However, you will still not automatically accomplish God's goal for your life.
To achieve God's goal for your life, you have to be intentional, you have to be determined, and you have to make a decision you are going to diligently work towards the goal or target.
Paul the apostle said, "I run to win..."To run in this context also means to press on or to explode with determination towards your goal. It is to act in commitment to a course till you reach the finish line.There is a level God wants you to reach, an impact God wants you to make, and a glorious purpose to fulfill. There is a target God has woven into your heart.No matter how you will accomplish those personal ambitions of yours, you will only find true satisfaction when you pursue and accomplish God's purpose and goal for your life.This then requires that you set your heart and mind towards God's goal for your life.
Live every day of your life by running towards the goal the Lord has set before you.
Don't run away from purpose, run towards the purpose of God for you.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/FXXfkBuNfgsDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 12:1-2; 1 Corinthians 9:24-27; Psalm 119:32; Colossians 1:29;  2 Peter 1:10-11; 1 Timothy 6:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we will enjoy more and more grace as we run towards the goal the Lord has set before us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJoshua 8 – 102 YEARS PLANExodus 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I run diligently towards my goal. - I am intentional, determined and committed to reach the finishline. - I will never stop at my goal halfway. - I run to win and reach my goal. - I don't run away from purpose. - I enjoy more and more grace as I run towards the goal that the Lord has set before me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 775 - ARE YOU STRIVING FOR HUMAN APPLAUSE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You don’t have to entertain sorrow around you no matter the situation. You have to maintain your joy. It is your daily charge to keep. If you think there is nothing to rejoice in or to be joyful about, then you have to reconsider your mindset about Salvation. Your salvation is the greatest thing that has ever happened to you. REJOICE IN IT. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 8th March, 2025ARE YOU STRIVING FOR HUMAN APPLAUSE?"For am I now seeking the favor of people, or of God? Or am I striving to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a bond-servant of Christ." Galatians 1:10 (New American Standard Bible)Have you ever felt unappreciated for your service?Do you seem to be discouraged because people are not impressed by your sacrifice?Are you afraid to take steps to do the things God has called you to do because you are careful not to displease the people around you?Are you careful to preach the gospel because you don't want to get people offended?
Though we are sons of God, we also have a duty to serve the eternal purpose of God's Kingdom in our generation.
Our duty to serve the eternal purpose of God, is essentially a service to honor Him. As part of serving God's eternal purpose, we also serve men or people. Your service to God brings honor to God and also blessing to people.In a more practical way, every service to God benefits people. God doesn't need your service for Himself, your service to God is to serve people. That makes your life and living a blessing of God to people.When God calls a man and sends him as a missionary to a rural or an unreached community, the mission assignment will be a service which will benefit and transform the people within that community; and it will cause many to praise and honor God.What this means is that the missionary's life and living to the community he reached out to, is a blessing of God to the people. Such a person's service to the people is a service to God.
The intention is not to please them and to get them to praise him. He must seek to please God by doing what God wants him to do.
And this is how greatness in the Kingdom is determined.Just as Jesus said, "The greatest among you will be the one who always serves others from the heart" Matthew 23:11 (TPT)Your service must be an act from your heart to please God and to cause people to honor Him. Your service must not be an attempt to strive to please people.People will definitely be blessed, impressed, refreshed and inspired by your act of service. You will have people celebrating you for the impact you make in their lives through your service. However, your goal is not to win the applause of men. Your goal and intention have to be that you shall complete the assignment God has entrusted to you.There is nothing wrong with being honored or appreciated for your service in the Church or the kingdom.Paul the apostle in his epistle to the Church in Thessalonica instructed the brethren to honor their leaders."Dear brothers and sisters, honor those who are your leaders in the Lord’s work. They work hard among you and give you spiritual guidance" 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (NLT)
In as much as it is important to be honored and acknowledged for your service, never make that your goal.
Don't strive for the appreciation of men. When that becomes your goal, you will end up striving to please men, instead of God. And that may affect the integrity of your service and cause you to compromise the instructions of the Lord.People who always strive for the applause of men, end up feeling discouraged and discontented.God has called you out that you show forth His praise and not for you to strive for the praise of men.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDYDIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 2:4; 1 Corinthians 10:33; Colossians 3:23; 2 Corinthians 5:9; Ephesians 6:6) WE PRAYWe pray that our motives shall be kept pure and sanctified from every self-pleasing ambition and desire. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJoshua 11 – 132 YEARS PLANExodus 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't make the applause of men my focus.- I don't strive for the appreciation of men. - My goal and focus is to complete the assignment God has entrusted to me. - My motive is kept pure and sanctified from every self-pleasing ambition and desire. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 776 - GO ALL OUT FOR JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. You cannot resist the devil when you are proud. To resist the devil, you must first humble yourself before the Lord. Selah! Author Sunday, 9th, March 2025   GO ALL OUT FOR JESUS “Master,” said David, “don’t give up hope. I’m ready to go and fight this Philistine.” 1 Samuel 17:32 (The Message) Whatever God wants to do in time, He does it through a people He has called out and sent. Though Jesus is the head of the Church, He has also raised leaders, or shepherds, to the Churches for the administration of His word and His purpose. The will and counsel of God are established in this world through His Church. And by His eternal counsel and wisdom, He has set leaders or shepherds (apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers), to equip, instruct and guide the saints to work and achieve God’s goal. The adversary attacks leaders of the various churches or ministries to disturb the work of God. He also uses cunning means to distract the focus and interest of the believers. He drifts them away from the Lord’s assignment to their personal ambitions. Some have conformed their minds to the ideas, cultures and systems of this world. Others have gradually lost their confidence and zeal in the Lord. They find it difficult to show up for Jesus and stand with their leaders in the work of the ministry. They make excuses whenever they have to take up responsibility in the Church.
They are gradually drawing back from getting involved in the war for souls.
The bold step David took to confront Goliath is an example of faith for every believer in Christ. Many are within the Church but will hardly take a stand for the Church amid opposition. In this post-modern era of social media, there is the abuse of freedom of speech and most people have cheaply become influencers. And they use their platforms to bastardize the glorious Church of Jesus. Everyone is throwing a jab at the Church and making the Church the focus of their attacks. Even believers who are in the Church, have subtly turned against the Church. Many have also become lovers of themselves, lovers of money, scoffers of God and pursue their own interests, as Paul mentioned in his letter to Timothy. “For people will love only themselves and their money. They will be boastful and proud, scoffing at God, disobedient to their parents, and ungrateful. They will consider nothing sacred.” 2 Timothy 3:2 (NLT).
People who love themselves cannot stand with God or show up with Jesus. They are not available for the Kingdom assignment.
Only a few believers are ready to go all out for Jesus. They become frightened and feel hopeless at the slightest confrontation. They are like Saul’s army: “The Israelites, to a man, fell back the moment they saw the giant—totally frightened…” 1 Samuel 17:24 (Message)
Are you part of those who fall back and are frightened by the opposition of this world?
Or are you among those who show up with Jesus in all places? Are you an encouragement to your Pastor? Can your Church leader set gospel outreach goals with you standing with him or her? Are you controlled by the systems of this world or you are shining forth the light of the gospel? Among the army of Israel were the senior brothers of David, who were trained for war; yet, they hid themselves in the camp or within the lines on the battlefield. They were not able to step forward or take a stand for the Lord. Are you hiding among the crowds like the other brothers of David?Or you are ready to stand out like David? Can your Pastor or Leader share this testimony about you: “There is no one like Timothy. What sets him apart from others is his deep concern for you and your spiritual journey. This is rare, my friends, for most people only care about themselves, not about what is dear to the heart of Jesus the Anointed. You know Timothy is genuine in the Lord’s ways. He has been a faithful partner to me as we express the good news, as much as my own flesh and blood would have been.” Philippians 2:20-22 (Voice) Are you labouring with your leader in the gospel like Timothy did with Paul?
This is the time to GO ALL OUT FOR JESUS, for the advancement of the Kingdom of God.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F2ptPfOwsCA&t=12sDIG DEEPER (1 Samuel 17; Jeremiah 1:8-9; 51:20-23; Philippians 4:7-18; Romans 16:1-10)   WE PRAY We pray that we shall increase in grace, wisdom, strength and zeal to stand and labour with our leaders in the spread of the gospel of Jesus in all places.   BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJoshua 14 – 16 2 YEARS PLANExodus 18 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase in grace, wisdom, strength an zeal to stand and labour with my leaders in the spread of the gospel of Jesus in all places. – I show up everywhere with the confidence of God. – Through me, many are turning from darkness to light. – I am a burden bearer.   – I am a son of consolation.   – I am an encouragement to my Pastor and leaders. – I am a helper of the war. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for enabling me. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 777 - THE CALMNESS OF THE LORD’S COMING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are in Christ, you are justified and you have peace with God. You don’t need a strange regalia to walk in the corridors of the Spirit. As you have been justified, you have the right standing with God. You can walk in the corridors of Heaven as Jesus, for you have His righteousness. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 10th March, 2025 THE CALMNESS OF THE LORD’S COMING"But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief." 1 Thessalonians 5:4 (KJV)Within certain circles, the coming of the Lord is seen as a day of doom and sudden destruction upon all men.Most people read the first few verses of 1 Thessalonians 5, and jump into quick conclusions without the patience of understanding the crust of Paul's message.
The first epistle of Paul the apostle to the Thessalonians was mainly written to encourage, establish, instruct and to inspire hope in the heart of the saints.
It wasn't an epistle that had any determination to communicate doom and destruction.A proper look at the verses 2 and 3 (within the context of the chapter) will help you understand what those words meant. While you read the verse 3, take note of the pronoun "they"."For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night. For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape." 1 Thessalonians 5:2-3 (KJV)To help you understand, "they" is the third-person plural subject pronoun. It is used in the subject position to refer to a group of two or more people or things.When Paul the apostle wrote that, "For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape"The pronoun used clearly indicated that he wasn't referring to the saints. He was talking about the unbelieving ones. Their peace and safety are in themselves or their self-efforts and the systems they have created. Meanwhile, true and perfect peace is only found in Christ. Any seemingly peace outside Christ is no peace at all. It is only in Christ we enjoy living hope.
This also means that the day of the Lord will surely come as a thief to those not of the faith. The day of the Lord shall not come to those who are of faith as a thief.
Paul the apostle was clear on this, read the verse 4-5:"But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief. Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness." 1 Thessalonians 5:4-5 (KJV)Jesus is truly coming again, and to those who are in darkness they shall be overtaken unexpectedly, as a thief.However, to the believer in Christ, it's going to be peaceful. It's going to be the full realization of our hope, which is Christ.When you got born again in Christ, you were translated by God from the power of darkness to the Kingdom of His dear Son. It was a translation from the influence of darkness into the domain of light. When you came into light, you were illuminated and also became a light being."But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself." Ephesians 5:13 (Berean Standard Bible)As you are of the light, the thoughts of the coming of the Lord must not create chaos and fear in your heart.
It must be a glorious moment, you look up to see. Your heart must be calm and comforted on this matter.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 1:13; Ephesians 5:8; Romans 16:15; Matthew 24:37-39; Romans 13:12) WE PRAY- That we shall grow and live in the consciousness of our reality as people of the light.- That those who are in darkness shall turn to the Lord that their hearts shall be illuminated.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJoshua 17 – 192 YEARS PLANExodus 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am of the light and I grow and live daily in this consciousness. - The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. - Through me many that are in darkness are turning to the Lord that their hearts will be illuminated. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 778 - BE WATCHFUL AS THE LORD COMES 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The goal of the word of God is to make you fruitful in your walk with Him. This begins with the infusion of faith. Anytime God’s word comes to you, it produces faith in you. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 11th March, 2025 BE WATCHFUL AS THE LORD COMES 1"Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober." 1 Thessalonians 5:6 (KJV)Beloved in Christ, understand that our Lord Jesus shall surely come. His coming is not to the disadvantage of the believer. His coming is a day of celebration for His Church.
Every believer in Christ must set their affection on the coming of Christ.
As we discussed in the previous episode, the coming of Jesus is not to overtake you (the new creation) as a thief attacks at night. The reason the day of the Lord wouldn't be like a thief creeping on you to steal is not because you have diligently followed the Mosaic Law. It is not because by your own self-effort you have achieved some self-righteousness which is at par with the righteousness of God in Christ. Well that is not even possible in any way. Your self-efforts can not bring you into the righteousness of God in Christ. Your self-righteousness is no righteousness at all, before the  Lord. "We are all infected and impure with sin. When we display our righteous deeds, they are nothing but filthy rags. Like autumn leaves, we wither and fall, and our sins sweep us away like the wind." Isaiah 64:6 (NLT)
The coming of the Lord will not be to you (the born again) as a thief pounces on the innocent; not because of your good deeds.
Whatever you enjoy in Christ as a believer, is not essentially because of your self-effort. It is first according to what Christ has accomplished for you. You received all that Christ has accomplished for you through your faith in Him and His finished work through His death, burial and resurrection.Your faith in Christ brings you into an eternal reality of life. This reality determines what you enjoy and how you function. Whatever you enjoy in the Lord, and whatever He instructs you to do is according to what He has supplied into you and how He has positioned you.Take note of Paul's admonition in 1 Thessalonians 5.He said, "But you, beloved brothers and sisters, are not living in the dark, allowing that day to creep up on you like a thief coming to steal. For you are all children of the light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night nor to darkness. This is why we must not fall asleep, as the rest do, but keep wide awake and clearheaded" 1 Thessalonians 5:4-6 (TPT).Did you see that?Two crucial matters are stated here:1. A benefit — that day shall not creep on you like a thief coming to steal.2. Instruction — therefore keep awake or be alert or be watchful.And these above matters I have mentioned are because of:- The believers' identity and disposition in Christ — We are children of light and the day- The believer's position and possession — You are not living in the dark, but in the light. You don't belong to darkness. You belong to the day and your source is the Father in whom there is no darkness neither is there a shadow of turning (James 1:17).This then puts Paul's instruction, "be watchful..." into proper perspective. The Apostle Paul's instruction is not to create any sense of trepidation. Clearly,  from the first few verses of chapter 5 of 1 Thessalonians he quashed every idea of fear, anxiety and hopelessness at the thought of the Lord's coming.Therefore Paul's instruction to believers to be watchful cannot be because of the Lord's coming. But to be watchful because you are in the light and must not live under the influence of deception and spiritual blindness as the people in darkness.He was admonishing the Church that because we are in the light, we must stay awake in the spirit and alert with our eyes fixed on the truth.
Refuse to live in the fear and anxiety as of those who are in the darkness. Refuse to be unconcerned and ignorant about the coming of the Lord.
When you are watchful or alert of the Lord's coming, you will live in the consciousness and care of shining forth the light of the Lord in a crooked and perverse generation.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_yy4rMSPywDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 16:13; Matthew 24:4-5; 1 Peter 5:8; Hebrews 2:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall walk daily in the consciousness of our identity, disposition and position in Christ, even as to touching the matters of His coming. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJoshua 20-222 YEARS PLANExodus 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am of the light and I grow and live daily in this consciousness. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – Through me many that are in darkness are turning to the Lord that their hearts will be illuminated. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 779 - BE WATCHFUL AS THE LORD COMES 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency A true friend doesn’t take pride in the failure of others. A true friend is a shield of strength.
