Maintain a company of friends who inspire you with the vision of God and direct your passion towards the Lord. Shalom! Author Wednesday, 12th March, 2025 BE WATCHFUL AS THE LORD COMES 2"Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober." 1 Thessalonians 5:6 (KJV)The apostle Paul wasn't admonishing the brethren to be watchful because the coming of the Lord was going to be a day of terror for the believers.As we have discussed previously, the coming of the Lord will not be as a thief creeps upon his target.As a believer you are in the light and not in darkness.This is your advantage.Which means every believer must look forward to the coming of the Lord with great joy and hope.To be "watchful" is from the Greek word, "grēgoreō", “must stay alert.” To "not sleep". It can also mean to stay awake and be vigilant.
This is mainly about your spiritual awareness and consciousness. To be this alert or vigilant also means to remain active and not be complacent.
To be watchful is not about looking on without doing nothing till the Lord comes.The proof that you are watchful involves being actively engaged in the pursuit of God's purpose and living a life which causes men to glorify Him.To sleep is to be in active in the things of the Spirit, to be complacent and uninterested in the things of Christ. As believers in Christ, we have a mandate to live a life of purpose and with a sense of urgency.Beloved in Christ, the key items which distinguish you from the children of darkness includes:- The New life you have received in Christ- Your identity in Christ- Your position in Christ- Your disposition in ChristAnd that is not all.The practical living of the life you have received also distinguishes you from the people of the world.
As children of light, how we live is what makes people see the light we carry.
As part of we living the faith life, our demonstration of readiness for the day of the coming of Lord, distincts us from the world. In contrasts with those who belong to the night and darkness, Paul the apostle urges believers through his epistle to live in a manner that reflects their true identity.You don't have to be spiritually asleep like the rest of the world who are in darkness.Utilize every resource God has given you to execute His purpose for you here on Earth. Make everyday count, spread the goodnews of Jesus to all men.Get men saved and transformed through the knowledge of Christ.Intercede in prayer for the salvation of souls.
Jesus is coming and get busy for His coming. Don't fold your arms, make a difference in someone's life.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 16:13; Matthew 24:4-5; 1 Peter 5:8; Hebrews 2:1) WE PRAYThat we shall remain actively focused on the assignment of the Lord and live the life which honors Him as evidence of our watchfulness and readiness for His coming. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025Joshua 23 - 24Judges 12 YEARS PLANExodus 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am of the light and I grow and live daily in this consciousness. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – Through me many that are in darkness are turning to the Lord that their hearts will be illuminated. – I don't fold my arms, I make a difference in the lives of many. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISDOE 780 - THE BELIEVER'S SOBRIETY 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Everything you do must be unto the glory of God. It was not just in songs and words that Jesus glorified and honored the Lord. Jesus did all things to bring glory to God. Is your life bringing glory and honor to God? Author Thursday, 13th March, 2025 THE BELIEVER'S SOBRIETY 1"Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober." 1 Thessalonians 5:6 (KJV)One of the practical ways every believer can be watchful (as discussed previously) is to be sober-minded.Being watchful is like a soldier in a military or defence duty on a city wall. The soldier must look on with vigilance to ensure the city is not under any possible threat of siege. It is like a shepherd who watches over the flock.
There are divine treasures and inheritance dispensed unto the Church, and every believer must be watchful to guard all the riches of Christ.
This must be done with sober-mindedness.The believer's sobriety is a great treasure which keeps him from losing focus among this corrupt and perverse generation.The apostle Paul was clear on his instructions to the brethren in Thessalonica;"Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober. For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night. But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:6-8 (KJV)1 Thessalonians chapter 5 is such a loaded chapter in the Bible. It serves the saints with all that is needed as we behold the coming of the Lord. Anyone who loves the appearing of Jesus must love to glean further verities dispensed in 1 Thessalonians chapter 5. It shapes your mind and heart to function consistently as one who is of the light.The word "sober" is from the Greek word "nēphō", meaning to completely abstain from wine, wineless, or unmixed with wine.  Relatively, it also means to be discreet or to have temperance. It is to remain resolute not to be intoxicated. It is in the sense of having total freedom from the influence of intoxicants.
Its figurative meaning is basically to be free from every intoxication of your being (mentally and spiritually).  
This doesn't mean to be soberly minded is to be empty headed.A believer is not empty. As believers in Christ we have the Spirit and live in the Spirit. Thus, to be sober is not just to be calm and collected in the Spirit; it is also to be possessed by the Spirit. This is how to experience self-control.To exercise self-control is to live according to the influence of the Spirit and the Word of God. It is a part of the fruit of walking in the Spirit.Being sober minded doesn't begin with your self-effort but with the saturation of the Holy Spirit in your heart. When a man is saturated and full of the Holy Spirit, he will be sober (well-balanced, clear headed, circumspective, free from evil passions and desire, and fully enabled by the Spirit to have self-restraint)
Most believers become discouraged in their walk with God and nurture distractions, easily get tired in the walk of faith, feel pressured and mentally drained because they refuse to live in the reality of their sobriety.
You find them praying, attending Church meetings, demonstrating commitment, but all of it can be swallow efforts when they are centered on their own ability. Whatever we do as believers must first be rooted in the Spirit. We must have the mindset of Spirit or God dependence and not self-dependence.This is how to demonstrate true sobriety in the faith as we behold the coming of the King of Glory.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8lIBGrahXoUDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16, 22-24; Ephesians 5:14-18; 1 Peter 5:8; Titus 2:2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall continue to be sober-minded through the enabling ability of the Spirit in this perverse generation, even as we behold the coming of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJudges 2-42 YEARS PLANExodus 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:- Through the enabling ability of the Spirit, I remain sober-minded in this perverse generation. - I have total and abosulte dependence on God. - I am deeply rooted in the Spirit. - I have no confidence in my flesh. - By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 781 - THE BELIEVER'S SOBRIETY 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t just walk in the awareness or intellectual perception of the Word; be drenched or participate or become one with the reality of Jesus. Selah. Author Friday, 14th March, 2025 THE BELIEVER'S SOBRIETY 2"Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober." 1 Thessalonians 5:6 (KJV)The Believer's sobriety is not a matter of self-enabled control. To be sober begins with the choice to be fully yielded to the dominance of the Holy Spirit.
The self-control of a believer is a quality of his sobriety, which is also an expression of the fruit of the Spirit.
"But the fruit of the Spirit [the result of His presence within us] is love [unselfish concern for others], joy, [inner] peace, patience [not the ability to wait, but how we act while waiting], kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such things there is no law." Galatians 5:22-23 (Amplified Bible)A fruit is an outcome of a rooted life. A fruit is not a source but a result. The fruit of the Spirit is the result of the presence and the life of the Spirit.Being sober is not an activity or a posture isolated from the Holy Spirit. You cannot be soberly minded without the Holy Spirit. The present society creates an atmosphere of anxiety and discouragement. It will only take a person who is fully saturated by the Holy Spirit to remain mentally and spiritually composed. There are many things which will attempt to intoxicate your mental stability even as you pursue the assignment of the Lord and behold the Lord's coming.Our Lord speaking to his disciples was clear on this:"...without me you can do nothing...""I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless" John 15:5 (TPT).
You cannot become fruitful in your walk of faith without the supply of our Lord.
This is why He gave us the Holy Spirit as a means to which we can continuously commune intimately with the Lord.Take note of this illustration of Paul in 1 Thessalonians 5:"Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober. For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night. But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:6-8 (KJV)He talks about sleeping and being drunk in the night.What does it signify?It unveils the influence and effect of the night. It is to be drunk (intoxicated with wine). To come under the influence of toxic desires for the flesh. It is to have your beautiful heart mixed with thoughts of doubts and unbelief.And instead of being drunk, Paul admonishes the brethren not to be like the others who are in the night, and under the influence of darkness. He charges them to sober. As I explained the meaning of being sober ("nēphō"), it is to be wineless or totally free from mental and spiritual intoxication.Paul gave another similar illustration to the brethren in Ephesus;"And don’t get drunk with wine, which is rebellion; instead be filled with the fullness of the Holy Spirit." Ephesians 5:18 (TPT)To the Thessalonians he admonished them not to be as others who sleep and get drunk at night. But they should be sober-minded because they are of the light. Then he admonished the Ephesians to not be drunk with wine (to be wineless, sober and self-control); and be continuously filled and saturated with the Holy Spirit.Did you get it?Let's go over it briefly again:
To be sober-minded is literally to be wineless or free from intoxication. However, this sobriety is not being empty headed, but fully saturated with the Holy Spirit.
Thus, as you behold the coming of the Lord you must be fully saturated by the Holy Spirit. Moreover, understand that the Holy Spirit is given as the guarantee that we are the Lord's.This is then the testimony that when the Lord comes, He is coming for you because you are His.Don't be distracted and dominated by the deception of the adversary. Live daily under the influence of the Holy Spirit and you shall graciously demonstrate sobriety Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16, 22-24; Ephesians 5:14-18; 1 Peter 5:8; Titus 2:2) WE PRAYWe pray that as we have been sealed by the Holy Spirit and received Him as a guarantee that we are the Lord's, we shall consistently live each day in union with Him and according to His influence and not how we feel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANJudges 5-72 YEARS PLANExodus 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Through the enabling ability of the Spirit, I remain sober-minded in this perverse generation. – I have total and abosulte dependence on God. – I am deeply rooted in the Spirit. – I have no confidence in my flesh. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 782 - STAY ALERT AND DON'T GIVE IN!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Are you of God’s household? Then you are part of men who function by faith. You don’t have to permit defeat and failure in your sphere because you are born of God. You don’t speak failure and defeat. You have the faith of God in you, function in that capacity. Selah. Author Saturday 15th, March 2025 STAY ALERT AND DON'T GIVE IN! “Eliab, his older brother, heard David fraternizing with the men and lost his temper: “What are you doing here! Why aren’t you minding your own business, tending that scrawny flock of sheep? I know what you’re up to. You’ve come down here to see the sights, hoping for a ringside seat at a bloody battle!”1 Samuel 17:28 (Message)Have you ever been inspired to do something for the Lord, given His green light, and suddenly, an older respected fellow calls you over to his office to advise you of how you are wasting your time doing something for the Lord?For a moment it will make you look back at yourself to wonder if you are doing the right thing.
There are many great destinies the adversary aborted using the pessimistic opinions of influencers in their lives.
Sometimes the people who discourage the purpose of God in your life may be “prayer warriors” in their churches, lecturers, punctual in Church and spiritual. But don’t share in the burdens of the Kingdom.Some of these people are in Church but don’t know the purpose of God for the Church and the saints.Even our Lord Jesus had a similar experience with Peter.In Matthew 16, Peter by supernatural revelation confessed Jesus as the Christ, the Son of the living God. Jesus affirmed that Peter’s knowledge of Him was not according to flesh and blood. (Matthew 16:17)Later, Peter interrupted Jesus when He was speaking of His death and resurrection.“From that time Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and on the third day be raised. And Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This shall never happen to you.” But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a hindrance to me. For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man.” Matthew 16: 21-23 (ESV)This doesn’t suggest that Peter was satan but spoke by the deceptive influence of satan. Jesus knew those words were from satan. (Read more about the Deception of the adversary here).Peter’s words to Jesus were harmless. They were a genuine concern for Jesus. But that wasn’t God’s plan. The death of Jesus was to our advantage. Later, Peter preached concerning the death and resurrection of Jesus, and about 5,000 people were saved.When Eliab saw David, he didn’t take the time to find out about David’s mission on the battlefield. Because David didn’t make a personal choice to be out there. He was there because he obeyed his father Jesse. But David being sent to the battlefield was according to the plan and purpose of God.
Eliab’s first reaction to David was to lose his temper. Perhaps, he thought David was about his usual curiosity.
Eliab also thought all that David was meant for was to tend the scrawny or unattractive tiny flock of sheep.He felt David was only there to sit on the ringside to watch a bloody battle like a spectator in a boxing or mixed martial arts arena.
But NO! DAVID WAS ON GOD’S MISSION.
Beloved, there are big things God wants to achieve through you. He is always ordering your steps into an environment where you will step into that great purpose.Don’t allow anyone to make you doubt what God is inspiring you to do. Don’t allow anyone to make you think you are not meant to do big things. Don’t allow anyone to make you think you have to remain small, hidden and irrelevant.Stay alert and discerning to the voice of God and any voice that contradicts the voice of God. Submit to a leader who understands and is burdened by God’s vision; and also sees you as God sees you.
Set your mind on the things of God, and not on the things of man. That is the only way you can do the things of God.
You have what it takes to do what God has called you to do. Don’t be afraid to take responsibilities in Church.You are the man for the job!Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_yy4rMSPywDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:8-9; 1 Samuel 17; Jeremiah 51:20-26; Psalm 60:12). WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be hindered by the negative voices of influencers in our lives but remain focused on the things the Lord inspires us to do BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJudges 8-102 YEARS PLANExodus 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am on God’s mission therefore I don’t give in to the negative voices of influencers in my life.– I am mindful of my association.– I am discerning at all times.– I don’t give in to distractions,  I remain focused on the things the Lord inspires me to do.– I am the man for the job!Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 783 - STAY LONG, DON'T RUSH!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your identity as a child of God is a threat to the adversary. He has always been after your identity. You cannot be a slave to the devil and his worldly systems when you are fully conscious of your identity in Christ through salvation. Beloved, walk in the confidence of who you are in Christ Jesus. Author Sunday, 16th March, 2025 STAY LONG, DON'T RUSH!“God’s wisdom is something mysterious that goes deep into the interior of his purposes. You don’t find it lying around on the surface. It’s not the latest message, but more like the oldest—what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene.” 1 Corinthians 2:8 (MSG)A man who communes with the Holy Spirit has access to the riches of the Wisdom of God.
No one immersed in God and His wisdom struggles to make the right decisions at any point in life.
There is no confusion in a man who has handled the depths of divine wisdom. Deep understanding is granted to a man who continues to behold the Lord.You will never find God’s wisdom by surfing around. You access God’s wisdom in the depths of His heart.
You must develop the habit of staying long in your communion with God.
The more you continue to stay longer, the more you are enriched with the influences of the Spirit.STAY LONG! DON’T RUSH.To some, staying long in the place of prayer and communion with the Lord is tedious work.Whatever and whoever you love takes your time and attention effortlessly.As you are struggling to stay in the place of prayer and ministering to the Lord, are you sure the Love of God is kindled in your heart?
Communing with God is an unforceful rhythm when it is centered on the love of God.
The Holy Spirit is the best partner for the fulfilment of your destiny.And even “the Spirit of God, not content to flit around on the surface, dives into the depths of God, and brings out what God planned all along” 1 Corinthians 2:10 (MSG).He searches all things diligently, even the profound depths of God.This means, having the Holy Spirit in you doesn’t mean you automatically handle the depths of God. You must also dive and search deeply into the heart of the Spirit, to glean the riches of His wisdom.There are things concerning your life which God has set in Himself long before you arrived on the scene. And as you commune with the Spirit, He grants you access and mastery into things God has already designed for you.
Stop being satisfied with the sand bathing. Go beyond the shores of the Spirit, and dive deep into the ocean of the Spirit to experience and enjoy the wisdom of God.
No king can rule and exercise dominion without a dimension of wisdom.“God conceals the revelation of his word in the hiding place of his glory. But the honor of kings is revealed by how they thoroughly search out the deeper meaning of all that God says. The heart of a king is full of understanding, like the heavens are high and the ocean is deep.” Proverbs 25:2-3 (TPT)You are called to lead your generation and, therefore increase in understanding.“Like the horizons for breadth and the ocean for depth, the understanding of a good leader is broad and deep.” Proverbs 25:3 (MSG).There are divine depths of wisdom which may not be understood by books. You only come to the understanding of it by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit.“We don’t have to rely on the world’s guesses and opinions. We didn’t learn this by reading books or going to school; we learned it from God, who taught us person-to-person through Jesus, and we’re passing it on to you in the same firsthand, personal way.” 1 Corinthians 2:13 (MSG).
There is an understanding that comes to you only in communion with the Lord.
Dive deeper into the Lord through fellowship with the Holy Spirit.Glory to God.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88Gs4aHpiTIDIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29; Ezekiel 8:2-3; Daniel 2:16-30) WE PRAYThat our hearts will delve deep into God and access the depths of wisdom and understanding concerning all that is needed for the fulfilment of purpose and the refulgence of His kingdom BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJudges 11-132 YEARS PLANExodus 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow deeper in my communication with the Holy Spirit. – I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 784 - DON'T STAY AT THE LEVEL YOU ARE
content:

There was a glory of the law or of the Old Covenant. However, it is nowhere near the glory which we have in Christ Jesus.
In comparison to the glory we have in Christ, the glory of the Old Covenant is no glory at all.
Have a good read to grasp what I’m saying: “He is the one who has helped us tell others about his new agreement to save them. We do not tell them that they must obey every law of God or die; but we tell them there is life for them from the Holy Spirit. The old way, trying to be saved by keeping the Ten Commandments, ends in death; in the new way, the Holy Spirit gives them life.Yet that old system of law that led to death began with such glory that people could not bear to look at Moses’ face. For as he gave them God’s law to obey, his face shone out with the very glory of God—though the brightness was already fading away. Shall we not expect far greater glory in these days when the Holy Spirit is giving life? If the plan that leads to doom was glorious, much more glorious is the plan that makes men right with God. So if the old system that faded into nothing was full of heavenly glory, the glory of God’s new plan for our salvation is certainly far greater, for it is eternal. 2 Corinthians 3:6-11 (TLB) As you are in Christ, you don’t pray for glory. This is because you have been brought into the overwhelming glory of the New Testament. By your new nature in Christ, you don’t only have the overwhelming glory of God. You have now become the glory of God. You are now the expression of God. However, you have to nurture the nature of glory in you.

The more you behold the Lord, the more you advance in the glory of God. As you advance you don’t first look out for things around you to be beautified. Avoid double-mindedness! Set your eyes on Jesus and crave more for the sweet intimacy with Jesus. You will soon begin to reflect and reveal God in all you do.
Don’t stay at the level you are.
Beloved, you advance in glory by growing deeply in your relationship with Jesus. Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_yy4rMSPywDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 4:23-24; 2 Corinthians 4:4-6; Psalm 84:7; James 1:23) WE PRAY– For the wisdom of the Spirit to nurture the nature of God’s overwhelming glory in us. – That we will not be double-minded but maintain our focus on the Lord Jesus. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJudges 14-162 YEARS PLANExodus 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the glory of God. – I am the very expression of God. – I reflect and reveal God in all that I do. – I maintain my focus on the Lord Jesus. Oh Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 785 - THE BELIEVER'S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved Jesus is not a god, He is God. Jesus is not just showing you the way to the Father, He is not some sort of signpost. He is the means and the destination. This is not some mere religious clichè, it is the REALITY. Selah! Author Tuesday, 18th March, 2025 THE BELIEVER'S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR"But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (KJV)The coming of the Lord is inevitable, and His coming is to be a glorious news for every believer.
The believer is not supposed to walk in fear and uncertainty about Christ's coming.
Every believer in Christ is a child of light; therefore, the born-again is not of the night but of the day.Though the day of the Lord will not be as how a thief unexpectedly breaks into a home, Paul the apostle, admonished the believers to maintain and live with a sense of responsibility in their daily walk.The people of the world live blindly in darkness. But as children of light, we are to be watchful and sober. Concerning the believer's watchfulness and sobriety, I have extensively addressed them here and here.As I explained, being sober is intentionally yielding your mind and heart to the influence of the Holy Spirit.
The matter of watchfulness and sobriety are qualities of a trained soldier.
As believers, we live in this world as men at war. Our warfare is not to obtain victory but to enforce the victory that Christ has obtained. It is a warfare between light and deception.Some believers are excited to celebrate the reality of their sonship, and the glorious inheritance we have in Christ, but assume the reality of the believers' military mandate is for those called into the five-fold ministry and the "prayer warriors" in their Church.Paul the apostle writing to the saints in Ephesus, charged them to put on the whole complete set of the armor of God .He wasn't just speaking to the leaders of the Church but to the whole brethren in the Churches.To the brethren in Ephesus, he outlined all the armor pieces needed. However, to the Thessalonians, he mentioned three key items and two armor pieces.The armor pieces he referred to in chapter 5 of 1 Thessalonians are breastplate and helmet.These armor pieces are representations of three spiritual verities:1. Faith2. Love3. HopeAgain Paul mentioned these three items in 1 Corinthians 13:13:"Three things will last forever—faith, hope, and love—and the greatest of these is love." 1 Corinthians 13:13 (NLT)These three items are crucial for the living of the Newness of life.These are the believer's threefold cord armor pieces for the victorious life in Christ.Paul explains that faith and love serve as the breastplate which protects the heart of the believer. While the hope of salvation protects the mind and thoughts of the believer as a helmet.
You cannot live above the condition of your heart and thoughts. 
These are the two parts of man the adversary targets. If he can invade your mind and heart with his deception, he can create doubt and anxiety which will disrupt the conviction of your faith.To live effectively as children of light and not as people of darkness, stay alert and clearheaded by placing the breastplate of faith and love over your heart, and a helmet of the hope of salvation over your thoughts.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/88Gs4aHpiTIDIG DEEPER(Romans 13:12; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17; Isaiah 61:10) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds will be protected by the hope of salvation in Christ and our hearts by the faith and love which we have received in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJudges 17-192 YEARS PLANExodus 27DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am of the light and I grow and live daily in this consciousness. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. – My mind is protected by the hope of salvation in Christ. – By the faith and love which I have received in Christ, my heart is protected from the deception of the adversary. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"][pff-paystack id="37534"]

title: EPISODE 786 - THE BREASTPLATE OF FAITH AND LOVE - THE BELIEVER'S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Submit your thoughts to the thoughts of God through the study of the scriptures. Refuse to yield to wrong thoughts and emotions. Stand firm and set your gaze on the Lord. Selah! Author Wednesday, 19th March, 2025 THE BREASTPLATE OF FAITH AND LOVE - THE BELIEVER'S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 2"But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (KJV)Paul the apostle, mentioned three spiritual verities but just two armor.Faith and love function as breastplate for the believer, as they walk in the light. Whiles the hope of salvation achieves the same result for the believer as helmet does for a good soldier.Remember, as believers we are in combat against the deceptive schemes of the adversary. The adversary's deception gets more intense as the coming of the Lord is near.The coming of the Lord is inevitable, and His coming is to be a glorious news for every believer.
We fight from the place of victory enforcing what the Lord has accomplished for us.
To have clear purpose of the armour as mentioned in 1 Thessalonians 5, take note of Paul's statement:"For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night. But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation. For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ" 1 Thessalonians 5:7-9 (KJV)He admonished that we put on the armour for God has not appointed us to wrath. These armor brings you into the certainty of heart that God didn't bring you into salvation and then later turn to condemn you.The deception of the adversary is to make you doubt your salvation and relationship with the Lord so that you will live in fear and doubt.
The breastplate of love and faith protects your heart from fear, anxiety and sorrow.
The heart here is not essentially the physcial organ which pumps blood. The heart consist of the innermost or core part of your being.Jesus calls the heart a field (Luke 8:15). Whatever God wants to produce in your life must first be planted in your heart. Your innermost being is the place where your entire being is nurtured. The Newness of life in Christ germinates from your heart."Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from it." Proverbs 4:23 (GOD'S WORD® Translation)You cannot use a physcial metal as was used in the medieval times to guard your innermost (heart). Neither can a modern day military vest save your heart from the deceptive projectiles of the adversary.
It will take a spiritual virtue to preserve the heart of the believer.
It's called the breastplate of faith and love. In Paul's epistle to the Ephesians, he mentioned, the breastplate of righteousness. The breastplate of righteousness is not different from the breastplate of faith and love. They are the same. You received righteousness through the demonstration of God's love and supply of faith in your heart.You are made righteous by faith in Christ Jesus (Romans 3:22). And the righteousness of God in Christ which we have received is a demonstration of God's love towards us.
You must have the persuasion that God has fully made you righteous in Christ. 
And this persuasion or consciousness gives you the assurance that you shall not come under any wrath at the coming of the Lord.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(Romans 13:12; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17; Isaiah 61:10) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds will be protected by the hope of salvation in Christ and our hearts by the faith and love which we have received in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJudges 20-21Ruth 12 YEARS PLANExodus 28DECLARE THESE WORDS:– By the faith and love which I have received in Christ, my heart is protected from fear, anxiety and sorrow. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 787 - THE BREASTPLATE OF FAITH AND LOVE 2 - THE BELIEVER'S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No challenge has the power to break you until you are weak. Challenges must become stepping stones for your next level of success. Selah. Author Thursday, 20th March, 2025 THE BREASTPLATE OF FAITH AND LOVE 2 - THE BELIEVER'S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 3"But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (KJV)The deceptive strategy of the devil is to weaken the confidence of your heart towards the Lord's coming.
He has never changed his strategy, because that is his greatest and most effective weapon.
However, God has given us more abounding gears for our defense. Yours is to put them on.God has given you faith and love (which produces His righteousness) as breastplate. Some believers are waiting for God to dress them up with this defensive armor.As God has made provision for this armor, your responsibility is only to put them on.Clearly, the misconceived thoughts of the Lord's coming may create anxiety or fear. Paul the apostle didn't want the saints to live in fear. He didn't want their heart to be troubled. This is why he admonished them to remain sober and to put on the breastplate of faith and love.
To put on the breastplate of faith and love is to walk in the confidence of God's grace and love towards you.
Jesus before His death and ascension, spoke these words to His disciples:"Do not let your heart be troubled (afraid, cowardly). Believe [confidently] in God and trust in Him, [have faith, hold on to it, rely on it, keep going and] believe also in Me." John 14:1 (Amplified Bible)The solution to a troubled heart or fear is faith in the Lord.Instead of being worried or surrendering to your fear of the times, live in the confidence of Jesus' love towards you.You came to Christ and received His righteousness by faith in Him. You continue to walk in the consciousness of faith by faith and love towards God. Your love towards God is also a result of the richness of His love towards you."In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son to be the propitiation [that is, the atoning sacrifice, and the satisfying offering] for our sins [fulfilling God’s requirement for justice against sin and placating His wrath]." 1 John 4:10 (Amplified Bible)
Your life in Christ should be lived according to the supply of God to you and not according to your self-engineered efforts.
The daily happenings around you are designed to engender anxiety in your heart. However, you become insulated when faith and love abound in your heart.The love of God in your heart is the greatest force that protects you and resists every projectile of the adversary.Don't live by what you feel. Live a life of faith towards God and according to the expression of His love.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88Gs4aHpiTI&pp=0gcJCU8JAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Romans 13:12; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17; Isaiah 61:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in faith towards Christ and continuously set our hearts on the love of God which we have received in Christ.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANRuth 2-42 YEARS PLANExodus 29DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the confidence of God's grace and love towards me. – By the faith and love which I have received in Christ, my heart is protected from fear, anxiety and sorrow. – I live daily according to the supply of God. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 788 - THE HOPE OF SALVATION - THE BELIEVER’S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Salvation is not dependent on how you feel about yourself; Salvation is dependent on what Christ achieved for you through His death and resurrection. Selah. Author Friday, 21st March, 2025 THE HOPE OF SALVATION - THE BELIEVER’S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 4"But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (KJV)Apart from putting on the breastplate of faith and love, another important armor Apostle Paul mentioned was the hope of salvation as a helmet.To the soldier, the helmet is an amour piece that protects his head. The head has the mouth, nose, face, skull, and brain. Both the breastplate and the helmet protect the most essential organs of the human body (though all the parts of the human body are important); the heart and the head (brain, eyes, mouth, face, ear) respectively.To delve more into the subject matter, let me help you grasp this:Most extensive studies in cardiology and neuroscience touch on the relationship between a man's spirituality and his brain-heart connection (or neurocardiology).In biblical language, the word "heart" means more than the cardiac organ of the human body. However, the cardiac organ and the encephalon (or brain) are the physical seats of the constitution of the heart.The heart consists of the soul (mind, will, and emotions) and the spirit. These essential parts of man cannot be physically touched. However, their activities or functions can be felt through the brain-heart connection of the human body. Through neurocardiology, we can identify the influences of the innerman on the body.If you are an avid reader of with , you can tell how countless times you will be reading an episode or listening to a teaching from our platforms, or be reading a Bible verse and your heart (cardiac organ) will literally be experiencing some sensations of joy. What happens is that the aggregation of the divine thoughts or the ministration of the Spirit-word induces the illumination of your mind, which transmits light into your being. This transmits signals between your neuron and other bodily cells. It also sends electrical signals (impulses) which spread throughout the heart (cardiac organ) along its electrical pathways.(NB: It is the reason one will be hearing the message and the fellow senses a vibration of power throughout the body, and may not be able to sit or stand and sometimes a person may fall with a burning sensation of fire, all through the body).This also happens when one continuously exposes his or her mind to wrong information. It corrupts and crushes his inner being and literally affects the neurocardiac system.Words carry spiritual influences which create some physical effects.
Your brain and heart (cardiac organ) are physical organs that also serve as the seats of your mind, will emotions, and spirit.
You don't first find or experience the impulse of your will, emotions, and mind in your knee or leg. You experience the impulse of your emotions and thoughts, through your brain and heart (cardiac organ).This gives a deep explanation as to why Paul the apostle will instruct the brethren to put on the breastplate of faith and love and a helmet of the hope of salvation.The benefits of these armor pieces are not just spiritual. They are also physical. The spiritual always affects the physical (and the process recycles).When your heart or inner man is saturated with the consciousness of faith, love, and the hope of salvation, you will walk through this world in sobriety. You will not live feeling discouraged, broken, and mentally drained. This is why a man who is fully influenced by the revelation of Jesus, will not live in anxiety, suffer from a "heart attack" or struggle with mental health. The gospel is the dynamic ability of God which brings deliverance from darkness to light, safety, soundness of heart, wholeness of health, and eternal joy (Romans 1:16).
When the revelation of God's salvation in Christ permeates your mind, you cannot live a sad life. 
You live and look into the future with so much hope. You also enjoy the living hope in your daily life. This is what Isaiah the Prophet declared:"Let me tell you how happy God has made me! For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and draped about me the robe of righteousness. I am like a bridegroom in his wedding suit or a bride with her jewels." Isaiah 61:10 (TLB)Oh, glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88Gs4aHpiTIDIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 6:41; Psalm 149:9; Romans 13:12; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall submit our minds to the glorious gospel of Jesus, which adorns our minds with the beautiful news of salvation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 1-32 YEARS PLANExodus 30  DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit my mind to the glorious gospel of Jesus. - Through the gospel of Jesus, my mind is adorned with the beautiful news of salvation. - I cannot live a sad life, I enjoy the living hope in my life daily. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 789 - THE HOPE OF SALVATION 2 – THE BELIEVER’S THREEFOLD CORD ARMOR 5
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Have and maintain your strong confidence in the power of God’s Word, that He will do what He says He will do. You can have exceptional results as you exercise boldness in the Lord. Hallelujah Author Saturday, 22nd March, 2025 THE HOPE OF SALVATION 2 - THE BELIEVERS THREEFOLD CORD 5"But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope ~f salvation." 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (KJV)To put on the hope of salvation is to guard your thoughts with the glorious news of the saving grace of Jesus.The hope of salvation is not just what you will have or what shall happen to you in the future.The hope of salvation is not essentially the reward of your good works.
To put on the hope of salvation is not to have an expectation of a salvation that is separated from the salvation we have received in Christ.
The hope of salvation is Christ Jesus and what He has accomplished for all who have received Him.The Psalmist said, "The Lord is my salvation..." (Psalm 27:1).Salvation is not just a thing. Salvation is a person and He is Jesus.There is no salvation of God outside Christ."And there is salvation in no one else; for there is no other name under heaven that has been given among people by which we must be saved [for God has provided the world no alternative for salvation].” Acts 4:12 (Amplified Bible)To be saved is to be delivered from the power of darkness, and be translated into the Kingdom of His dear Son (Colossians 1:13).Through salvation you are begotten anew into God and his life is transfused into you. This is a spiritual experience and this you obtained through faith in Christ Jesus and not by your works or self-efforts (Ephesians 2:8-9).Some conclude that the hope of salvation in the verse is only about the future salvation of our bodies from this mortality. Definitely, there is going to be this glorious experience of immortality. However, this "future salvation" is a dimensional experience or the fruit of the salvation that we have received in Christ.The ultimate Salvation is Christ. Christ transcends immortality. Immortality is a quality or an expression of the quality of His life. As we have His life we have the hope that we shall experience the glory of God through His coming.
The Hope we have must be centered on the all-encompassing reality of the salvation we have received in Christ Jesus.
This hope is living.A man without Christ is estranged from the household of God. Such a person has no hope and is without God (Ephesians 2:12).The new creation or born again, is begotten into an inheritance of great hope. According to God's extravagant fountain of mercy which He has shown through Christ, we are reborn to experience a living, energetic hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead. (1 Peter 1:3).This hope shall not diminish and not perish or be defiled. This hope is living because the life of Christ is its source. The hope that we have in Christ is built and depends on the life of Christ.It is therefore an error to be born again and be thinking and living as one who is hopeless. To be hopeless is to live in the confidence of your own effort. To be hopeless is to be faithless.
When you set your confidence on what Christ has accomplished through His death and resurrection, you will not just have hope; you will have a living hope.
This makes the future exciting. Because we don't look forward to a day of doom. We don't look forward to a season of rejection, denial, pain, sorrow wrath, and condemnation.  As we have put on the hope of salvation as our helmet, we rejoice at His coming.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88Gs4aHpiTIDIG DEEPER(1 John 3:1-3; Romans 5:3-5; Colossans 1:5; Titus 3:5-7; Hebrews 10:23; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds shall be saturated with the glorious revelation of our eternal inheritance in Christ as the helmet of the hope of Salvation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 4-62 YEARS PLANExodus 31DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I submit my mind to the glorious gospel of Jesus. – Through the gospel of Jesus, my mind is adorned with the beautiful news of salvation. – I cannot live a sad life, I enjoy the living hope in my life daily. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 790 - YIELD TO PRAYER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is a way a man who is immersed in the Spirit daily, thinks and lives. You live according to the power of God. You demonstrate love according to the influence of the Spirit. Selah Author Sunday, 23rd March, 2025 YIELD TO PRAYER“And the Lord said, “Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you as wheat.”Luke 22:31 (NKJV)As you can see in the opening verse, Beloved, what the Lord Jesus said to Peter wasn’t some hoax or a mock alert.Now since it wasn’t the interest of the Lord not to divulge such information from Peter, then you should know it was going to happen. But the good news is that the Lord showed us how He intercepted.The devil would have achieved his intention if not for the Lord’s interception. You will later find out how within a few hours after these words of the Lord, Peter denied being a disciple of Jesus.“Then they seized him and led him away, bringing him into the high priest’s house, and Peter was following at a distance. And when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them. Then a servant girl, seeing him as he sat in the light and looking closely at him, said, “This man also was with him.” But he denied it, saying, “Woman, I do not know him.” And a little later someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.” And after an interval of about an hour still another insisted, saying, “Certainly this man also was with him, for he too is a Galilean.” But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you are talking about.” And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed. And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the saying of the Lord, how he had said to him, “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny me three times.” And he went out and wept bitterly.” Luke 22:54-62 (ESV)Peter denied his association with Jesus in front of a servant girl. Just in case you don’t know, it was this same Peter who when Jesus was being arrested by the men from the high priest, drew his sword and cut off the ear of Malchus (a servant of the high priest).Peter was actually trying to prove his loyalty to Jesus. When Jesus told Peter how the adversary had plotted to sift him, he thought it would take the strength of the flesh to withstand against the devil.Even when Jesus had said he had prayed for him, Peter still thought it would take his self-generated ability to stand in the Lord. His confidence was in himself and not the Lord.This was what Peter told the Lord:“Peter said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death.” Jesus said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me.” Luke 22:33-34 (ESV)Peter’s confidence failed. He denied the Lord three times and after He realized the words of Jesus, he felt disappointed and wept bitterly.Nevertheless in the resurrection, Jesus sent a message to the disciples specifically to Peter, for him to know that He the Lord wasn’t disappointed in him but still took interest in him.“And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.” James 4:7 (KJV).

title: EPISODE 791 - THE HOPE OF SALVATION FROM THE SLAVERY OF CORRUPTION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are in Christ, you are justified and you have peace with God. You don’t need a strange regalia to walk in the corridors of the Spirit. As you have been justified, you have the right standing with God. You can walk in the corridors of Heaven as Jesus, for you have His righteousness. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 24th March, 2025 THE HOPE OF SALVATION FROM THE SLAVERY OF CORRUPTION"For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus"  1 Thessalonians 5:9 (KJV) Faith, love, and hope are the three basic structures of the Newness of life in Christ. As I have previously discussed, these three items, or basic structures, are armors to protect our hearts and thoughts. As the coming of the Lord draws near, we are to remain watchful as soldiers at war and be sober even as we put on the three basic structures of the Newness of life as our armor and safeguard, amidst the toxic projectiles of the world.
As people of the day and of the light we are instructed to live this way to have a practical experience of the Lord's intentions at His coming.
Paul the apostle, doesn't want the believers to assume that, because they are in the light they can live according to their own terms. The people who are of darkness don't know what to do to be ready for the enjoyment of the Lord's coming. The comfort of being in the light is to understand what Christ has accomplished for you and to have the instructions which will safeguard your heart and thoughts from the deception of this world, as you behold the Lord's coming. From the earlier verses of 1 Thessalonians 5, it is clearly stated that those who are in darkness shall experience sudden destruction. (Verse 3). The coming of the Lord will definitely not be a time of comfort for those in darkness. It's a time when the judgment of condemnation becomes a practical experience for them. It is not the dream of the Lord that all men will perish.  The Lord rather wants all men to be saved. However, those who remain in darkness are those who reject the Lord and expose themselves to the wrath of condemnation and destruction by their unbelief. All those who believe in the Lord Jesus have received eternal salvation which cannot be lost. This salvation is the deliverance of the Lord from eternal condemnation or perdition (John 3:16). And we received this Salvation through the Lord's death and resurrection.
The gospel preached by the apostles of our Lord Jesus was emphatic and loud on the reality that once we are saved by the Lord Jesus, we have been forever saved for eternity and shall never perish or be condemned.
Therefore, through Christ's finished work in His death, and resurrection we have obtained a glorious salvation, which is eternally secured by His faithfulness. Since we have obtained this Salvation in Christ, why are we appointed to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ? (as you read again from the opening verse above) The coming of the Lord saves us (who are already saved in Him) from the coming destruction and the slavery of corruption. What is the slavery of corruption? When God completed His work in creation, everything was good. Nothing was corrupted. "God saw everything that He had made, and behold, it was very good and He validated it completely. And there was evening and there was morning, a sixth day." Genesis 1:31 (Amplified Bible) However, corruption crept into the world through the sin of unbelief. Even as of the days of Adam, every deposit of God into man began to decay (or experience oldness), even in the natural creation, including the human body. Through the sin of unbelief, man subjected all that God has entrusted to him to corruption. This is how the principle or second law of thermodynamics came into being. The law of thermodynamics states that "when energy is being transformed from one state to another, some of it is turned into heat energy which cannot be converted back into useful form." See this: "And he called him Lord, saying, “Lord, you formed the earth in the beginning and with your own hands you crafted the cosmos. They will both one day disappear, but you will remain forever! They will all fade like a worn-out garment, And they will be changed like clothes, and you will fold them up and put them away. But you are ‘I AM.’ You never change, years without end!” Hebrews 1:10-12 (TPT). Apostle Paul explains this further in his epistle to the Romans: "The entire universe is standing on tiptoe, yearning to see the unveiling of God’s glorious sons and daughters! For against its will,l the universe itself has had to endure the empty futility resulting from the consequences of human sin. But now, with eager expectation, all creation longs for freedom from its slavery to decay and to experience with us the wonderful freedom coming to God’s children. To this day we are aware of the universal agony and groaning of creation, as if it were in the contractions of labor for childbirth. And it’s not just creation. We who have already experienced the firstfruits of the Spirit also inwardly groan as we passionately long to experience our full status as God’s sons and daughters—including our physical bodies being transformed.  For this is the hope of our salvation.But hope means that we must trust and wait for what is still unseen. For why would we need to hope for something we already have? So because our hope is set on what is yet to be seen, we patiently keep on waiting for its fulfillment." Romans 8:19-25 (TPT) Oh, glory to God. We have this hope that at the coming of the Lord Jesus, the glory of our sonship shall fully manifest. In that, just as through the sin of unbelief, creation and the entire universe were subjected to vanity and corruption, creation shall be freed from the slavery of corruption at the coming of our Lord Jesus. It is not only the stars, the moon, the plants, and all creation that are groaning together. Even the saved ones groan that we shall experience the glorious transfiguration in our natural bodies.
Though there is anxiety in creation, those who have received eternal salvation, have a living hope in our Lord Jesus, knowing that at His coming we shall be changed.
Beloved, as we are eternally saved through our faith in the finished work of our Lord Jesus, we also look forward to obtaining a glorious salvation of our physical body completely from every corruption, at the coming of our Lord Jesus. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bQFfAUDHFkM&t=3033sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 102:25-27; 1 Corinthians 15; 1 John 3:1-3; Romans 5:3-5) WE PRAYWe pray that our hope shall not be moved no matter what we face physically but shall remain strong in the hope of glorification of our bodies at the coming of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 10-122 YEARS PLANExodus 33DECLARE THESE WORDS:- No matter what I face in this present world, my hope will not be moved. - I remain strong in the hope of glorification of my body at the coming of Jesus. - I live daily in the certainty of hope in the Lord Jesus. - The salvation which I have recieved in Christ is eternal and cannot be lost.  - I have been forever saved for eternity and I will never perish or be condemned.  Thank you Lord Jesus for this so great salvation. [pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 793 - THE CLIMAX OF SALVATION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, until you speak forth the Word, you shall not see a performance. No matter the matter, don’t speak your fears, don’t speak your challenges, SPEAK THE RHEMA OF GOD IN YOUR HEART! Selah. Author Wednesday, 26th March, 2025 THE CLIMAX OF SALVATION 1"For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him." 1 Thessalonians 9-10 (KJV)
The hope of Salvation from slavery of corruption and the coming destruction is not rooted in the self-effort of the believer but in the finished work of Jesus through His death.
From the opening verse, you can see that Paul the apostle didn't want the saints to assume that the Salvation they have and that which they shall experience is dependent on their self-efforts.There are some who preach that, though we are saved (to become born again or new creation in Christ) through the death and resurrection of our Lord Jesus, at His coming, He will judge each man by their own works. And the saved shall lose their Salvation.They base their argument on:"Behold, I am coming quickly!    I bring my reward with me    to repay everyone according to their works." Revelaion 22:11 (TPT)The believer will be judged on the grounds of the works of Christ. The reward is according to the works of your faith in Christ. The Lord's judgment for the believer will be according to the works of faith. It is not a judgment unto condemnation (Romans 8:11). It is not a judgment according to the works of the flesh.
The salvation which we have in Christ is eternal.
"I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them away from me" John 10:28 (NLT)The salvation which we have in Christ is eternal because the value of the sacrifice which our Lord Jesus made is eternal.And that is why Paul the apostle has to remind the saints that the Salvation which we are appointed to obtain is not by our Lord Jesus, who DIED for us.The basis of your salvation is Christ's death, not your own worksSometimes when believers talk about the death of our Lord Jesus, we water down the torture. Anyone who understands the crucifixion of Jesus will understand that His death was a cruel and severe death of agony. It was a painful death that no natural person can sustain for even an hour. But Jesus did that for many more hours. He was nailed to the cross for approximately 6 hours and was scourged hours before His crucifixion. And definitely took some hours before He got to Golgotha.Yet the Lord endured these moments of torture. There was no way any human strength would be enough for such torture. Though it was rare for people to go through such a high degree of torture, people who are scourged in such a manner become unconscious and sometimes die. They never even make it to the crucifixion. But Jesus, with you on His mind, remained conscious and survived it to the crucifixion.The people in the first century understood what it meant to be scourged and crucified. They didn't need any further explanation for such a horrific ordeal.Through several laws of human rights, such torture has been stopped. And after many centuries, we have lost the true picture of what Jesus went through. This was so terrible and shameful that the Romans didn't even allow their most deadly criminals to go through such torture.
But Jesus had to go through it. He could have stopped Himself but kept the situation under control because of His love for you.
Jesus could have ordered thousands of angels to defend Him. He said to Peter:"Don’t you realize that I could ask my Father for thousands of angels to protect us, and he would send them instantly?" Matthew 26:53 (NLT).This touched my heart!Why did Jesus make the choice not to defend Himself?He was ready to suffer for the penalty of your sins. This was an eternal sacrifice that will bring those who will believe in Him into eternal salvation.Always remember this, you are appointed to obtain eternal salvation because our Lord Jesus DIED for your offenses and was raised for your JUSTIFICATION!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 5:8; 1 Peter 3:18; 1 Corinthians 15:3; 1 Peter 2:24; 1 John 2:2; Hebrews 9:28) WE PRAYWe pray, thanking the Lord for His love demonstrated towards us through His death. And we pray that we shall also walk in the consciousness of the victory which He obtained for us through His death and resurrection. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 16-182 YEARS PLANExodus 35DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The salvation which I have in Christ is eternal. - Thank you Lord for your love demonstrated towards me through your death. - I walk daily in the consciousness of the victory which Christ has obtained for me through His death and ressurrection. Oh, glory to God![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 794 - THE CLIMAX OF SALVATION 2 – HIS SUFFERING 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, as the blessed of the Lord, you are lavished by the Lord with super-abundance. You have the capacity and ability to generate resources. Refuse to think POOR! Author Thursday, 27th March, 2025 THE CLIMAX OF SALVATION 2 – HIS SUFFERING "For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him." 1 Thessalonians 5: 9-10 (KJV)The security of our Salvation is that our Lord Jesus DIED for us.The effect and impact of our Lord Jesus' death and resurrection were not temporal.
What our Lord Jesus accomplished through His death is eternal.
And at His coming, we shall be saved from the slavery of corruption and the coming destruction according to His death.As I mentioned in the previous episode, the matter of the death of our Lord Jesus and the method or process by which His crucifixion was executed was horrific.
Our Lord Jesus didn't just die for us, He also suffered for us. He wasn't just beaten and mocked, He was tortured and bruised for our transgressions.
"...the chastisement of our peace was upon Him..." (Isaiah 53:5)Pontius Pilate didn't want Jesus to be crucified. Therefore, he decided to scourge our Lord to appease the people.This scourge was a Roman torture which was so horrific and shameful that Roman citizens were not allowed to go through such torture.He wasn't just flogged, He was scourged with a rope whip called the flagrum or flagellum.This whip is more dreadful and terrific than the one referred to as a "cat o' nine tails" (which originated from ancient Egypt, but was made popular by the English Navy around the 1700s).As I said previously, a detailed description of Jesus' scourge wasn't necessary in the gospels, because anyone who heard of the Romans' scourge and crucifixion in the first century knew its dreadfulness.Usually, the victims of such horrific scourging will be stripped naked and strapped or shackled to a lower column or a pole, and skilled soldiers will each have a flagellum to take turns in beating the victim continuously until he's a step away from death.The flagrum is a whip with multiple pieces of metal or bones attached to the end, which lacerates and rips out chunks of flesh when wrenched, ripping small blood vessels, nerves, muscle, and bruising and exposing internal organs. FlagrumRead Scripture. (2022, March 29). Scourging. Retrieved from (https://read-scripture.com/scourging/) The soldiers scourge the victim from the upper torso, down to the back, including the chest area, up the back of the legs above the knees, calves, and up the arms, even around the neck and face.Josephus (a first-century historian) stated in his historical account that certain rebellious Jews were torn to pieces by the scourge before being crucified. Remains of scourge victims were found by archaeologists, and realized, these victims were scourged in the face and on top of the skull.According to Ecclesiastical History, victims who narrowly survive such torture live disfigured forever. They become a sign of caution to others that, “Don’t mess with Rome. If you defy the Romans, this is the consequence.”What does it remind you of?Isaiah the Prophet said concerning Jesus:"But many were amazed when they saw him. His face was so disfigured he seemed hardly human, and from his appearance, one would scarcely know he was a man." Isaiah 52:14 (NLT)This was exactly what our Lord Jesus suffered for us. He went up to Golgotha, carrying a cross of more than 200 pounds in weight, while His lungs were bruised, His intestines and inner organs were hanging out, His rib cage was visible on both sides, and the muscles around His spine were exposed. He was also losing about  125 millilitres of blood.  He wasn't just walking for miles to Golgotha carrying the heavy cross. Moments when he experienced tremors, seizures, and fainted, he was still beaten. With thorns piercing and stabbing the facial nerves and causing traumatic shock even through the skull, He did not complain.The steady loss of fluid caused the heart to be unable to pump blood to the body. His injured lungs caused pleural effusion (abnormal accumulation of fluids in the lungs and chest area). And this would definitely make breathing difficult. The ripped and fractured ribs would make breathing painful.Apart from suffering these physical tortures, He was verbally abused and mocked so that He would also be crushed and bruised emotionally or mentally.Don't attempt to imagine yourself in such a horrific state.Jesus chose to suffer these for you. He didn't just walk up for many miles to the cross to die for you.Even His suffering was to endure all infirmities of the body. It wasn't just for our Lord to heal or deliver you from eternal damnation. His suffering was proof that He has conquered all present physical infirmities as well.Every physical condition one may experience, Jesus experienced it on the cross. Is it a condition about lungs, heart, spine, bones, brain, kidneys, other internal organs, or what really will be the condition that you will not find Jesus enduring for you?He endured it all.
The salvation which you have obtained in Christ wasn't cheap. It was costly!
Walk in this consciousness and hope of this salvation, that is your helmet!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(Romans 5:8; 1 Peter 3:18; Isaiah 53:2-3; 1 Peter 2:24; Matthew 8:17; 1 John 2:2; Hebrews 9:28) WE PRAYWe pray, thanking the Lord for His love demonstrated towards us through His death. And we pray that we shall also walk in the consciousness of the victory which He obtained for us through His death and resurrection. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 19-212 YEARS PLANExodus 36DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The salvation which I have in Christ is eternal.– Thank you Lord for your love demonstrated towards me through your death. – I walk daily in the consciousness of the victory which Christ has obtained for me through His death and ressurrection. Oh, glory to God![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

content:
