title: EPISODE 796 - YOUR GIVING IS NOT IN VAIN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The word of God cannot germinate or become fruitful in a hardened heart. To harden your heart is to set yourself against what God has said. Beloved, don't harden your heart! Author Saturday, 29th March, 2025YOUR GIVING IS NOT IN VAIN"[Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings." 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) Giving into the Lord’s assignment cannot be overemphasised.And there are great blessings of giving.
Your giving in the Lord is also a labour of love. And nothing is done in the Lord, for the Lord and with the Lord which is in vain.
"Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain." 1 Cori thians 15:58 (ESV).See also: ”For God is not unjust to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name, in that you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.” Hebrews 6:10 (NKJV). It will be unjust for God to forget your labor of love.Which means whatever we do unto the Lord, there is a blessedness of the Lord that comes upon it. Your soul-winning is not in vain.Your service to the saints is not in vain.Your giving is not in vain. For every giving, there is a blessing or a harvest you will reap.I don’t disagree with the statement that “We don’t give to be blessed, we give because we are blessed and a blessing.” This is so true. Nevertheless, there is blessing in giving.Take a look at the opening verse again: ”[Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings.” 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). Clearly, we see that for every giving we will REAP or HARVEST its kind. Thus, giving is as seed-sowing and will attract a kind of harvest.As we discuss the blessing of giving, it will be expedient to look into this:THERE IS A WAY NOT TO GIVE!“That is why I thought it necessary to urge these brethren to go to you before I do and make arrangements in advance for this bountiful, promised gift of yours, so that it may be ready, not as an extortion [wrung out of you] but as a generous and willing gift.[Remember] this: he who sows sparingly and grudgingly will also reap sparingly and grudgingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to someone] will also reap generously and with blessings. Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].” 2 Corinthians 9:5-7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). – You don’t give as an extortion [wrung out of you].– You don’t give sparingly and grudgingly.– You don’t give reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion.The similitude in all these kinds of giving is the unwillingness to give. To give sparingly is basically to hold back your giving. You don’t give with the mindset of how much you want to keep for yourself, but rather how much you honor the Lord. 
To give in this way means you have developed the beautiful giving heart of God.
Look at this:Romans 8:32 (KJV) ”He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?” God did not spare (hold back), he did not give grudgingly, or reluctantly, under compulsion or sorrowfully. Such giving will not attract a bountiful harvest.The first blessing you attract is:
GOD IS ABLE TO MAKE ALL GRACE (every favor and earthly blessing) COME TO YOU IN ABUNDANCE
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bQFfAUDHFkM&t=3098sDIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18) WE PRAYThat no matter what confronts or happens around us, we shall not withhold our giving neither shall we become reluctant or sorrowful in our giving. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 25-272 YEARS PLANExodus 38DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 797 - GOD TAKES SPECIAL DELIGHTS IN GIVERS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is so much the meditation of the Word does to you, it brings the richness of the Word of God unto fruition in your life. Beloved, give yourself to the meditation of the word. Author Sunday, 30th March, 2025GOD DELIGHTS IN GIVERS“Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving]. 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition) There is something special about following God’s plan. A cheerful prompt to do it giver has a genuine heart for God. Having a huge amount of money in your bank account or as income doesn’t make you a giver automatically.Until you passionately love the Lord, you will not give in to His agenda. There is always something to do with money at a personal level. The more income you make, your bills will go up.The demands and needs keep increasing, whether you make more money or not.This is why giving into the spread of the gospel means a lot to God. Take a look at the opening verse again: “Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].“ 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition).
A cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving] is LOVED BY GOD.
We see a detailed explanation about this dimension of love.God esteems a cheerful (joyous prompt to do it) giver (whose heart is in his giving). Such a person is always on God’s mind for the next assignment. For God to love or esteem you in this light means He is always creating opportunities for you to give. Have you ever been in a place where you feel you are the only one giving big?Or do you feel you are always the one called upon by your Pastor or leader to give? That is a blessing! Though the saints in the Church must be inspired to give, make up your mind and purpose in your heart to be a giver. You don’t give because others are giving or not giving. You give because your heart is in your giving. This is not to propound the concept that “give till you are hurt“. That is why you must give as you have made up your mind and purposed in your own heart. The scripture says, God is unwilling to do without or abandon a cheerful prompt to do it giver. “ I know also, my God, that You test the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here to offer willingly to You.” 1 Chronicles 29:17 (NKJV)
The Lord doesn’t just receive our giving; He proves the heart of our giving, whether it is of faith or not.
This giving is not just money, but any form of valuable donation.Cheerful (joyous prompt to do it) giver is one who gives in faith.And the Lord takes pleasure in such a giver.The word PLEASURE is from the Hebrew word “râtsâh”. It means to be pleased with; specifically, be acceptable, be affectionate, delight in, be the favourite, liked the most. Awesome!
God loves the world and has an intimate relationship with those who are in Him. However, He takes special delight in those who give towards His work.
You know the lady who anointed Jesus at Bethany, became an eternal delight. Jesus declared her a memorial in the spread of the gospel. That is God taking special delight not just in your giving but in you. He prizes you above other things! Look at what she did:“Then Jesus went to Bethany, to the home of Simon, a man Jesus had healed of leprosy. A woman came into the house, holding an alabaster flask filled with fragrant and expensive oil. She walked right up to Jesus, and in a lavish gesture of devotion, she poured out the costly oil, and it cascaded over his head as he was at the table. When the disciples saw this, they were offended. “What a total waste!” they grumbled. “We could have sold it for a great deal of money and given it to the poor.” Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, “Why are you critical of this woman? She has done a beautiful act of kindness for me. You will always have someone poor whom you can help, but you will not always have me. When she poured the fragrant oil over me, she was preparing my body for burial. I promise you that as this wonderful gospel spreads all over the world, the story of her lavish devotion to me will also be mentioned in memory of her.” Now we are talking about this great act of giving that this lady did today, just as Jesus declared. Also, you will observe that the scriptures we clear about what she gave:It was not just any cheap oil or perfume.The scripture says, what she gave was an EXPENSIVE AND COSTLY OIL. The disciples thought it was a waste of money, but Jesus called it a LAVISH DEVOTION. Beloved, have you broken your alabaster box?THE LORD DELIGHTS IN SUCH GIVERS. Shalom! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bvI7IMIoIxA&pp=0gcJCb8Ag7Wk3p_UDIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; ; 2 Corinthians 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18; Matthew 26:6-13 ) WE PRAYWe pray that as we increase in grace, we give lavishly into the gospel of our Lord Jesus more and more. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 28-302 YEARS PLANExodus 39DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. – I always at any given time give. – I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation).  – I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work). – I am a self-sufficient giver by the grace of God.  – I possess enough and require no aid or support to give. – I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 798 - THE CLIMAX OF SALVATION 4 –  TOGETHER WITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tongues speaking is one of the quickest means by which a believer experiences personal edification. Don’t ever undermine the benefits of tongues speaking. Don’t go a day without speaking in tongues. Selah! Author Monday, 31st March, 2025 THE CLIMAX OF SALVATION 4 –  TOGETHER WITH THE LORD"For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him." 1 Thessalonians 5: 9-10 (KJV)The goal of Jesus' suffering was for us to be made whole through Him. Jesus didn't only suffer horrific scourging and die a shameful death on the cross.He was also raised from the dead according to the exceeding greatness of God's power and glory. The resurrection was the work of the Godhead (the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit).As we know, Jesus declared His authority to lay His life down and to raise it again (John 2:19; John 10:18).We also see in Galatians that Jesus was raised by the Father (Galatians 1:1).The matter of Jesus' resurrection was of great interest to the Godhead. Without His resurrection the salvation plan would have been incomplete. It is the bedrock of our faith in Christ.
Our Lord Jesus died for our offenses, and for our justification He was raised (Romans 4:25).
To be justified is to be declared not guilty or to be declared righteous. Through His resurrection, now we have the ability to stand in God's presence without any sense of guilt. Every born-again is in right standing with God because of our Lord Jesus.As we have right standing with God, we also have the ability of His life in us, so that we can walk in the Newness of Life."Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life." Romans 6:4 (KJV)When you believe and receive Jesus as your Lord, you are baptized into Him. This means when Christ died, you died with Him, buried with Him, and as He was raised, even so you have been given the ability to walk in the Newness of life.
The Newness of life is not a life lived in isolation from the Lord. The Newness of Life is the organic life in Christ. This life is lived in oneness with God.
This has always been the dream of God. It is His eternal dream or purpose that His will become one with Him. Through Christ's work on the cross, God brought all who believe into the communion and oneness of life with Him.At the appearing and coming of Jesus, we shall experience our oneness with the Lord in a more practical way.At the Lord's coming, we shall behold the full reality of oneness with the Lord. As it is now, when we speak of being seated together with Him (Ephesians 2:6) many see it as a mere imagination. However, it is a present truth fellowship with the Lord.The Lord established us with Himself to fulfill the climax of Salvation. Presently, people do not see us (the saints) as being together with the Lord.But when Christ comes, many shall see all the saints alive together with the Lord. As long as you are born again in Christ, your destination is secured through His death and resurrection.Your destination is that you shall be together with the Lord forever and ever.There is no need for you to be anxious and afraid at the coming of the Lord Jesus. 
His coming is to fully manifest the climax of salvation, which is all the saints being together with Him.
Comfort your heart with this truth of your salvation.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 6:5; 1 Thessalonians 4:15-17; 1 Corinthians 15:51-52; Colossians 3:4; 2 Thessalonians 2:1-6) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not be troubled, but we shall be comforted in this reality that the coming of our Lord Jesus shall be the climax revelation that we are together with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 312 Samuel 1-22 YEARS PLANExodus 40DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Thank you Lord for your love demonstrated towards me through your death. – I dont’ trivialise the precious salvation that Christ obtained for me through his sufferings. – I walk daily in the consciousness of the victory which Christ has obtained for me through His death and ressurrection. – I enjoy the salvation of the Lord. Oh, glory to God![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 799 - BE CONSCIOUS OF HIS PRESENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Blessed New Month to you! Did you know that a group of partners make it possible for us to reach you daily? You can join them for us to reach others also. (Kindly scroll down to the designated section which is conveniently located immediately after the declarations to give rightaway.) Thank you. You remain a blessing! Author Tuesday, 1st April, 2025BE CONSCIOUS OF HIS PRESENCE “Teach these new disciples to obey all the commands I have given you. And be sure of this: I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”Matthew 28:20 (NLT) The adversary rejoices when you are not conscious of the Lord’s presence in your life. The presence of the Lord with you makes the difference through your journey in time. The presence of the Lord in your life means you have all of the Kingdom of God backing you.
Don’t allow the adversary to use circumstances or situations to make you feel you are alone.
The challenges you face in this world doesn’t mean the Lord is not with you. The Lord being with you doesn’t suggest you have a challenge-free life. Challenges gives you the opportunity to see the mighty hand of the Lord in your life.
Your consciousness of the Lord’s presence in your life is a great threat to the adversary.
This is the promise of our Lord Jesus: “…I am with you always…” How did that happen? This was fulfilled through the indwelling of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the personal embodiment of the presence of God.
When the Holy Spirit came, the promise of our Lord was fulfilled.
Now get this, the birth of our Lord Jesus is God coming to tabernacle with man. He is Immanuel,“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and bear a Son, and they shall call His name Immanuel,” which is translated, “God with us.” Matthew 1:23 (NKJV). And was the fulfillment of Prophet Isaiah’s prophecy:“Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel.” Isaiah 7:14 Which means our Lord Jesus was the tangible presentation of God to man. He was the manifestation of God. And said, He will be with us always, through the Comforter — The Holy Spirit. “And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper (Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor—Counselor, Strengthener, Standby), to be with you forever” John 14:16 (Amplified).
Beloved, have this confidence that the Lord is always with you. 
You are never alone, and this has to be your consciousness.The Lord said to Joshua,“There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.” Joshua 1:5 This was David’s conviction:“Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.” Psalm 23:4 (KJV). The Lord is with you, and that must be your joy, your consciousness, and confidence!!! Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bvI7IMIoIxADIG DEEPER(Psalm 23; John 3:1-2; Genesis 39:1-4) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the consciousness of the reality that God is with us irrespective of what we face. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 3-52 YEARS PLANLeviticus 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Holy Ghost is my helper. – I remain conscious of the Lord’s presence daily. – All that I do prospers because the Lord is with me. – I cannot have a bad day because the Lord is with me. – I have all of the Kingdom of God backing me. – I am never alone. – I walk daily in the manifestation of the Lord’s presence. – I am joyful. Hallelujah!!!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 800 - PRACTICE HIS PRESENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency I want to specially thank you today. Yes, you dearly beloved reader. Thank you for your dedication and commitment to this rich platform. Thank you for believing in this great course. I don't cease in giving thanks to God for your sake. I love you permanently. Author Tuesday, 2nd March, 2025 PRACTICE HIS PRESENCE “If you love Me, you will keep My commandments. I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever; that is the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him, but you know Him because He abides with you and will be in you.”John 14:15-17 (NASB1995)  God didn’t just want to have an outward relationship with you. God wanted to have a deeper inward relationship with you. This is why He comes to indwell you through the Holy Spirit. The thing is, God didn’t come to dwell in you, with a plan or a condition to exit. He came to make His Home in you forever. Which means you are God’s residential address through the Holy Spirit.  God didn’t just indwell you, He made it possible legally. Through the death of Jesus, the old sin nature was terminated or crucified, so that you can receive the new life, which is Christ. (Galatians 2:20). Through Christ’s death and resurrection, you were justified, sanctified, and made Holy.
Your body has now become the temple of the Holy Spirit.
You were made pure in Christ, so that now God can dwell in you. This was not just achieved by God through Christ so that you will practice “religious worship”. God achieved this with the goal of intimacy.
God didn’t want you to know Him by mental assent. He wants you to be in Him, and He shall also be in you, to bring you into full experience of His love beyond utterance.
Through Christ’s death, God demonstrated His greatest love towards you. Now, by indwelling you through the Spirit, He seals His love for you.
The Holy Spirit in you is the consummate expression of all that God began in Christ.
Your recognition and engagement of the presence of the Holy Spirit in you is the most beautiful way to enjoy all that Christ has achieved for you. Through the Holy Spirit, God makes His love real to you daily. The Holy Spirit in you is the evidence that God didn’t come to show you love only once through Jesus’s earthly walk. He is in you now as the evidence that you can receive, enjoy, experience, and share in His love forever.
The Holy Spirit in you is also the continuous supply of the ability of God’s love in your heart.
This means He is in you not only for you to enjoy God’s love, but to make you a dispenser of the Love of God. Now you have the ability to love, to walk with God intimately, and to share the unfathomable, unconditional love with others. True intimacy with God doesn’t end when you stand in a “Church auditorium“, with your hands lifted, having tears in your eyes, and crying out how you love the Lord. That experience may be real as His love overwhelms your heart. Nevertheless, true intimacy with God is a daily walk. 
The Holy Spirit is not dwelling in you seasonally. He is in you FOREVER!
“…He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever…” John 14:16  You don’t enjoy the love of God annually or weekly. The Holy Spirit in you means you have a daily avalanche of the Love of God flowing in your heart forever. Now, to commune with God through prayer should be a restful flow. To fellowship with the Lord and to delight in Him should be expressed by you organically. To have deep moments of ministering to the Lord and receiving the ministrations of the Lord should be unforceable.
Beloved, the Holy Spirit is in you now. You have the living spring of life within you by which you can fellowship and worship the Lord in spirit and truth.
Worship no longer becomes an act of religious demand. Worship becomes a response to the revelation of God in your heart through the administration of the Holy Spirit. To have the Holy Spirit in you means you have the source of God’s loving ability. You have what it takes to demonstrate the love of God and the inward evidence to trust the Lord daily. Practide His presence today.  Glory to God! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:18-19; Ephesians 5:2; Jeremiah 31:3; Isaiah 49:15; Zephaniah 3:17; John 4:10-25) WE PRAYThat by the wisdom of God, we shall take advantage of the Holy Spirit in our heart, to demonstrate total trust in the Lord and to share His unfathomable unconditional love with others. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 6-82 YEARS PLANLeviticus 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the seal of the Lord upon me. – The love of God is in my heart, therefore, I have the ability to love. – I have an intimate relationship with God. – I enjoy and demonstrate the avalanche of God’s love. – I have a daily communion with God. Hallelujah!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 801 - NOW COMFORT AND EDIFY ONE ANOTHER WITH THIS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must get involved and be part of this glorious work of God. Be the reason and the medium by which the work of God will be accomplished. Don’t sit on the fence! Author Thursday, 3rd April, 2025NOW COMFORT AND EDIFY ONE ANOTHER WITH THIS 1"Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do." 1 Thessalonians 5:11 (KJV)The Church, from her inception, has suffered hostility, threats, political persecution, philosophical persecution, and both mental and physical torture.All these are attempts to crush and destroy the mission of the Church.Take note:The Church is the aggregation of all the saints in Christ.Therefore, don't think of the Church as an institution separated from you. You are part of the very constitution of the Church. The Church is the body of Christ, the herald of God's eternal purpose. The city is set on the hill, giving hope to a hopeless world. The Church is the torch of God in a world overwhelmed by gross darkness. It is the divine salt pack that preserves and gives taste to the earth.This is why the adversary has always seen the Church as a threat.There have been attempts to destroy the Church through heretical and deceptive doctrines.Matters that are to bring hope to the Church were diluted with error. And it's with the intention to corrupt the hope of the saints and produce fear in their hearts.Over the centuries, the news of Jesus's coming has been seen as news of doom for all mankind. 
However, the coming of Jesus is a day of hope, joy, and the full manifestation of glory for those in Christ.
If you have followed these episodes on 1 Thessalonians 5, you should be established in this certainty: the believer is not appointed for wrath but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, who died for us.Paul the apostle addressed the matter of the coming of our Lord Jesus to comfort the hearts of the saints.
No matter how the people of the world will mock, persecute,  or attack the Church, we must be comforted with the reality that our Lord cometh.
Take a look at verse 11 of 1 Thessalonians 5, again:"Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do."The sentence begins with "Wherefore", the Greek word is "dio", which simply means, "therefore", or for which cause or consequently.The word "dio" or "Wherefore" as used in the verse is a logical connector. It introduces an explanation that emphasizes the logical outcome or necessity of an action or belief.Paul the apostle used "wherefore" in the verse to draw an inference from what he had previously stated.This explains that as believers we are to comfort and edify one another on the grounds of this truth that:- God has not appointed us to wrath.- He has appointed us to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, who died for us.- And that whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with the Lord Jesus.
 No believer is to threaten another believer with the coming of Jesus. 
Instead, we are instructed through the epistles to comfort one another with the news of the coming of Jesus.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F2ptPfOwsCA&t=12sDIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 4:18; Hebrews 10:24-25; Ephesians 4:29; Colossians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 13:11) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not be troubled, but we shall be comforted in this reality that the coming of our Lord Jesus shall be the climax revelation that we are together with Him.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 9-112 YEARS PLANLeviticus 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God has not appointed me unto wrath. – I have been appointed to obtain salvation by the Lord Jesus who died for me. – Whether I wake or sleep, I will live together with the Lord Jesus. – I comfort the brethren with the news of the coming of Jesus. – I rejoice daily in the reality that my Lord is coming again. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 802 - NOW COMFORT AND EDIFY ONE ANOTHER WITH THIS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your understanding of Christ through His word grants you access to the depths of God’s wisdom and the hidden secrets of life. Beloved, grow in the understanding of Christ. Author Friday, 4th April, 2025 NOW COMFORT AND EDIFY ONE ANOTHER WITH THIS 2"Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do." 1 Thessalonians 5:11 (KJV)The news of the coming of Jesus has always been news of encouragement and comfort to the Church.In this same first epistle to the Thessalonians, Paul the apostle used the news of the coming of Jesus as comfort to those whose loved ones had fallen asleep (or died in Christ).Those who die without Christ have no hope. And this is not the same with the believers. For those who fall asleep in Christ have hope. Therefore, as believers, we don't become sorrowful as the people are without hope. We comfort one another with this glorious news of the coming of Jesus. (See 1 Thessalonians 4:13-18).
The ultimate good news of the coming of Jesus is that all believers shall be together with the Lord in a more palpable and experiential way.
The continuous reminder of the coming of the Lord must be comfort to the believers, knowing that we have far greater moments of glorious manifestations of the divine life ahead.The coming of our Lord is the news that we shall live forever, both those who are alive and those who are asleep in the Lord.The right testimony and understanding of the blessedness of the coming of our Lord Jesus comforts and edifies the believer.This comfort and edification are necessary because they strengthen the faith of the believer.More than ever, believers in today's world need to have clarity of the testimony of the coming of Jesus. Amidst the increase in deception, spiritual, physical, and psychological attacks against the faith, believers must set their hope not only in the news of the resurrection of Jesus. Believers must be comforted that, as we were made alive and raised together with Christ, even so shall we live together with Him in all eternity.This is our hope!And this is our comfort.In 1 Thessalonians 5, you will find two Greek words translated as comfort.- "Parakaleō"and- "Paramutheomai"In verse 11, Paul the apostle chose the Greek word "Parakaleō".Parakaleō (translated as comfort) means more than to soothe.It's made up of two words, "Kaleō" (to call) and "Para" (side of or alongside).The word literally means to call alongside or to call or summon a person to your side.The meanings of "parakaleo" include to entreat, to appeal to, to summon, to comfort, to exhort, or to encourage. It means to urge someone to take an action. At the root of this word, conveys the idea of enabling a person to meet some difficult situation with gallantry and confidence.When Paul the apostle chose this word, in 1 Thessalonians 5:11, he didn't mean to say as believers, we should soothe one another on the grounds of what the Lord has accomplished.He was charging the believers to urge one another to act according to the glorious hope of what our Lord Jesus has accomplished and the glorious news of the great day of His coming.We are to march on through the storms of this world with great confidence of hope. The same word translated as comfort was also translated as "beseech" in Romans 12:1 (King James Version).Which means to comfort one another is also to beseech one another to take a strong stand in the hope of the coming of our Lord Jesus.
The knowledge of the coming of our Lord Jesus supplies an impenetrable strength as that of a great army to a believer.
These things we have been discussing make you unwavering in your journey of faith. Set your heart on them.Jesus is coming again, and be comforted (urged) as you continuously shine forth the light of the glory of our Lord Jesus in your sphere.To believe and walk with the Lord is not an empty fable.To believe and give attention to fulfill the ministry the Lord has entrusted to you is not shadow boxing. This is the manifestation of your destiny; remain resolute.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 4:18; Hebrews 10:24-25; Ephesians 4:29; Colossians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 13:11) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not faint in this journey of faith but shall be gallant in faith on the grounds of the glorious hope we have as we behold the coming of our Lord Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 12-142 YEARS PLANLeviticus 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God has not appointed me unto wrath. – I have been appointed to obtain salvation by the Lord Jesus who died for me. – Whether I wake or sleep, I will live together with the Lord Jesus. – I comfort the brethren with the news of the coming of Jesus. – I rejoice daily in the reality that my Lord is coming again. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

To edify one another is to embolden one another by helping them to stand strongly and be sturdy. The glorious news of our Lord Jesus' death, burial, resurrection, ascension, and return should strengthen, inspire, encourage, urge, embolden, and enlarge the faith of every believer.The first-century Church found joy in the Lord Jesus. They were often instructed to rejoice in the Lord.Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice (Philippians 4:4).They looked forward to His coming with great hope."...we look forward with hope to that wonderful day when the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, will be revealed." Titus 2:13 (NLT)They knew that the coming and appearing of the Lord Jesus shall also be for his glorification.This has to be your confidence and hope as well."Look with wonder at the depth of the Father’s marvelous love that he has lavished on us! He has called us and made us his very own beloved children. The reason the world doesn’t recognize who we are is that they didn’t recognize him. Beloved, we are God’s children right now; however, it is not yet apparent what we will become. But we do know that when it is finally made visible, we will be just like him, for we will see him as he truly is. title: EPISODE 804 - BURN WITH ZEAL FOR GOD'S ASSIGNMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Most at times it is not what is happening to you that matters, rather it is the VOICE you are hearing that matters. The voice you hear and respond to is what influences your life. Do you hear the voice of your fears, worry, pain and struggle or you hear the voice of the Lord? Selah. Author Sunday, 6th April, 2025 BURN WITH ZEAL FOR GOD'S ASSIGNMENT“For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.”Psalm 69:9 (KJV)Beloved, your zeal defines the intensity with which you handle Kingdom responsibilities.Your zeal towards God’s work is intensified when you train yourself to commune with the Lord and to immerse your emotions, will and mind in the Lord.
You cannot be effective in your service of the Kingdom without the zeal of the Lord.
“Be enthusiastic to serve the Lord, keeping your passion toward Him boiling hot! Radiate with the glow of the Holy Spirit and let Him fill you with excitement as you serve Him”. Romans 12:11 (TPT)The level at which you are immersed in the zeal of the Lord will determine how you pursue the excellence of God’s will.There is a way God wants His work to be done. When your heart is boiling with the passion to see Kingdom success, you cannot entertain complacency.There are some who think they don’t have a burning passion or zeal for anything at all.That’s not really true.Everyone has a zeal for something.There is no one without zeal.Some have a zeal towards someone they want to marry. Others have a zeal for drugs. Some have an unquenchable zeal towards the football club they support.Some have zeal for the religious group they belong.People can zealously kill for something.[pff-paystack id="37534"]Zeal is the boiling passion within a man’s heart. Zeal in itself doesn’t know what is right or wrong.
Zeal gravitates towards the interest or focus of your heart.
Paul persecuted the Church because of his assumed zeal for God and the Jewish traditions. He didn’t know he was using his zeal to persecute God’s people. (Philippians 3:6).There are people who are zealous towards their family interests, academic interests, and the interests of their company and care little about the Kingdom of God.Is it wrong to genuinely care for your family, academic, and company interests?Certainly not.However, as one who is in the Kingdom, the interest of the Kingdom must come first.  Your zeal must gravitate towards the refulgence and spreading of the Kingdom.
What can you sacrifice for the Kingdom of God?
When your zeal burns towards the growth and excellence of the Kingdom, you will not be complacent in any way. You will not procrastinate, nor will you sit on the fence. You will take the initiative. The zeal of the Lord will drive you not only to have a sense of responsibility, but to take responsibility.When the Jews had lost their sense of zeal towards the purpose of the temple, they allowed the temple to become a religious shopping mall instead of what it was meant to be.“As he went into the temple courtyard, he noticed it was filled with merchants selling oxen, lambs, and doves for exorbitant prices, while others were overcharging as they exchanged currency behind their counters. So Jesus found some rope and made it into a whip. Then he drove out every one of them and their animals from the courtyard of the temple, and he kicked over their tables filled with money, scattering it everywhere! And he shouted at the merchants, “Get these things out of here! Don’t you dare make my Father’s house into a center for merchandise!” That’s when his disciples remembered the Scripture: “I am consumed with a fiery passion to keep your house pure!” John 2:14-17 (TPT).The Jewish leaders didn’t care what was done with the temple. They were complacent in seeing to the fulfilment of the purpose of God. However, Jesus felt otherwise.He couldn’t stand to watch the corruption of the purpose of the temple.He had a burning passion for God’s house. He was ready to put His life on the line just to enforce the will of God.
Culture your heart to burn with zeal towards God’s assignment. 
You remain blessed.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJbu7z5oV64DIG DEEPER(Acts 18:25; Colossians 4:12-13; John 2:17; Psalm 119:139; 2 Corinthians 8:16; 2 Corinthians 7:7,12; Acts 22:3; Acts 20:24) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that our hearts and actions will be consumed by the boiling passion or earnest zeal of the Lord to accomplish our assignment in Christ.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 18-202 YEARS PLANLeviticus 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord.– My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit.– I set my affection on the Lord and His vision. – I dare to do great things for the Lord. – I give my mind to the meditation of the word. – I am not led by my emotions. – I am zealous about doing great things for the Lord. – I am zealous about my divine mandate. – I am zealous about the salvation of others. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

Author Tuesday, 8th April, 2025 APPRECIATE AND HONOR YOUR LEADERS 1 "And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you" 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (KJV)Whiles Paul the apostle was admonishing the saints concerning how they are to cooperate and conduct themselves as they behold the coming fo the Lord, he included the need for the saints to have a deep appreciation for their leaders who labour in ministry for them.It may seem as though the discussion from verses 1 to 11 and verse 12 (of 1 Thessalonians 5) have no logical connection.
There is a lot of deep practical connection between being watchful, sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and hope and honoring your leaders.
Remember your watchfulness and sobriety are matters of spiritual warfare as well. And if we are asked to put on the breastplate of faith and hope, then we are being reminded that our walk of faith is a military service. As soldiers of our Lord Jesus we don't fight disorderly for the interest of Christ. Within every military system honor or respect is a strong code, which must not be broken.No army can succeed when they don't honor their leaders. As we behold the coming of the Lord we must be a people who honor and appreciate our Leaders. The Lord's army will not be able to fight the fight of faith properly when they have no respect, for the Kingdom officers or the leaders appointed by the Lord Jesus (who is our Chief Commander).
As you are in the Lord’s army, you must first learn to respect your leaders in order to fight well.
At the new believers' class, they must be taught to respect, honor, and appreciate their Leaders.In this disorderly generation who have no regard for order and authority, believers are tempted to think and live without honor. Most believers act like people of the world and abuse or disrespect their leaders just because of "freedom of speech".Kingdom Leadership is deeply rooted in God's love and has nothing to do with selfishness.Anyone appointed to lead God's people has a primary responsibility to serve the purpose of the Lord Jesus for His people.It is a journey of impact and transformation, characterized by the labour of God's unconditional love, relentless selfless sacrifices, pursuit of God's will and purpose for His people.For one to fulfill his assignment as a true Kingdom Leader, there is a kind of mindset and understanding that such a person must possess and demonstrate:- A True Kingdom leader does not live for himself but for the Lord and those the Lord has sent him to serve."So, being affectionately desirous of you, we were ready to share with you not only the gospel of God but also our own selves, because you had become very dear to us." 1 Thessalonians 2:8 (ESV)
The life of every true Kingdom leader is spent for God's people.
- A true Kingdom Leader has sacrificed his life on the altar of service. He doesn't esteem his life above any other, his joy is that others are transformed and blessed. And that is the example our Lord Jesus, whom we follow, came to show us."But my life is worth nothing to me unless I use it for finishing the work assigned me by the Lord Jesus—the work of telling others the Good News about the wonderful grace of God." Acts 20:24 (NLT)- The labour of a true Kingdom Leader is as the pain of parturition until the lives of the people they lead becomes as Christ."You are my dear children, but I agonize in spiritual 'labor pains' once again, until the Anointed One will be fully formed in your hearts!" Galatians 4:19 (TPT)Beloved, such a person who agonizes for your spiritual growth must be appreciated and honored. Some people don't honor or appreciate their leaders because they don't see the importance of their spiritual life. They belittle and refuse to acknowledge the spiritual investment their leaders make in them.Be different!
Be a true New Testament believer who appreciates and honors his or her leaders as they behold the coming of the Lord.

title: EPISODE 807 - APPRECIATE AND HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency In this year of Kingdom Priesthood, maintain a deeper intimate relationship with the Lord Jesus, through the Word and the communion of the Holy Spirit; and your impact will be matchless. Author Wednesday, 9th April, 2025 APPRECIATE AND HONOR YOUR LEADERS 2"And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you" 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (KJV)Some believers are orphaned in doctrinal truth concerning New Testament leadership, believers' character or conduct, and even consistent revelation of Jesus.On matters of leadership, some jump into conclusion that, since we are in the New Testament, there is nothing like higher leadership rank. They conclude that:- Jesus has made all believers equal in Him, therefore, no one is set higher or above the saints.- And also, Jesus is the only Shepherd we submit to as believers and not to any other fellow saints.Such teachings are propagated by people who are rebellious or those who wish to rule over others but never got the opportunity. These people are like Korah, Dathan, and Abiram (Numbers 16; Jude 1:11). Because they are not appointed to lead, they become rebellious and attempt to mock the concept of spiritual authority. Meanwhile, these are people who prefer to follow their own desires and live without submission (Jude 1:8). Don't follow such scoffers.Some of the people who uphold such thoughts are also people who are trapped in bitterness. These people were either victims or witnesses of toxic leadership.People can be warned and taught to identify toxic leaders. But, toxic leaders must not be the reason to propagate a campaign against a clear leadership system in the New Testament.Toxic leaders don't really "labour"; they would rather want to enjoy the labour of others.
There are people who, through their genuine labour, are engraced and given a rank to spearhead a divine course in a generation.
Some are leaders set over you within your assembly, and others within the body of Christ.Pay attention to the words of Paul the apostle again:"And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you" 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (KJV)The expression "ARE OVER" is from the Greek word "PROISTĒMI".Proistēmi is a strong expression of responsibility or authority.It means "to care for" or "give attention to".Is that all there is?Proistēmi also means "to set or "place before". This means "to be set over", "to preside over", "to be in charge over", "to stand in rank over", "to rule over", and "to be a protector" or "guardian", or "to give aid".The word "KNOW" also means "to look on", "be concerned with", "behold", "acknowledge", and to "appreciate".Any teaching that makes you feel you are your own authority and don't have to submit to anyone apart from Jesus, is nurturing your heart not to acknowledge and appreciate those the Lord has set to be ranked, to preside, to rule, and to guide you.The leaders set over the saints by the Lord are equal with the saints in life and nature. Yet they are first in the administration of God's work. Though the leaders set over you are your brothers as to the enjoyment of grace, yet as to touching service, they are the most slaves.And Jesus was clear on this, "he that is greatest (meizōn, larger) among you shall by your servant"
The leading ones are the most serving ones, and must be greatly appreciated for their service.
Have you appreciated your leader today?Appreciating and honoring your leaders is an obedience to the wisdom of God.Selah. Have you been blessed by any episode of with ? No matter the matter, don’t speak your fears, don’t speak your challenges, SPEAK THE RHEMA OF GOD IN YOUR HEART! Live in peace with one another." 1 Thessalonians 5:13 (Amplified Bible)To address the practical ways to honour your leader, you should first know its importance. Most people don't see why or the need to appreciate their leaders.

The Church is established by our Lord Jesus. The Leaders who are set in the Church are appointed by the Lord. They don't serve themselves or their interest. They serve the interest and the purpose of the Lord. These leaders are accountable to God. Therefore, to dishonour these leaders is a dishonour to God's authority. You cannot truly say that you honour the Lord and will dishonour those He has sent to you. If you honour the Lord, you must honour His messengers.
- Leaders must be honoured because honour allows them or gives them reason to lead with joy and not with grief. (Hebrews 13:17).
To be a leader in the Kingdom is to serve. It already comes with alot of sacrifice to be in a position of leadership within the Church. Therefore when your leaders are not leading you with joy, it gives you no advantage or benefits. You cannot benefit or gain any profit from an uninspired and griefed leader. Your honour is part of the things which motivates a leader to express himself to you with joy. Nobody takes delight in teaching a person who is disrespectful and insubmissive or insubordinative.How can a spiritual leader guide you into God's agenda when you have refused to submit to his leadership?When you don't honour your leaders, you despise their ability to lead and minister to you. This then means you are not going to enjoy edification within the Church. Don't increase the difficulty of their work.
- Honouring your leaders is proof of humility.
"Likewise, you younger men [of lesser rank and experience], be subject to your elders [seek their counsel]; and all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another [tie on the servant’s apron], for GOD IS OPPOSED TO THE PROUD [the disdainful, the presumptuous, and He defeats them], BUT HE GIVES GRACE TO THE HUMBLE." 1 Peter 5:5 (Amplified Bible)Leaders enjoy more grace as they humble themselves in service. As you also submit and humble yourself to your leaders you also enjoy increased grace. To be proud is to set yourself up against the supply of God's grace.
You have to train your mind to walk in honour.

title: EPISODE 809 - PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS – Esteem Your Leader Highly 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Maintain an open heart to know the Lord through the scriptures. The knowledge of the revelation of Jesus is what launches you into the enjoyment of your freedom to participate in the inheritance of the saints in the light. Hallelujah! Author Friday, 11th April, 2025 PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS – Esteem Your Leader Highly 1"and [we ask that you appreciate them and] hold them in the highest esteem in love because of their work [on your behalf]. Live in peace with one another." 1 Thessalonians 5:13 (Amplified Bible) You don't honour your leaders by doing what pleases you or what you claim to be right. You don't honour your leaders by doing your best. The Bible provides practical things to do to appreciate and honour your leaders. From previous episodes, I explained the necessity of appreciating and honouring your leaders. We also touched on the benefits of honouring your leaders.To appreciate and honour your leader is a demonstration of the character of the Spirit. And it's essential for the edification and growth of the Church, even for the expansion of the Kingdom.These are practical ways to demonstrate honour: 1. Highly Esteem Your Leaders in Love. Sometimes people make assertions that members (or the flock) overly esteem their leaders. Their leaders are not God and should not be idolized. 
Get this, members whose hearts are knitted to God will not make idols out of their leaders. Leaders whose interest is to serve the purpose of God for His people wouldn't seek such idolization.
However, Apostle Paul's words in 1 Thessalonians 5:13 explain the extent leaders must be honoured. This is how it's put in the King James version: "And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you; and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves." 1 Thessalonians 5:12-13 (KJV) "...and to esteem them very highly in love..." This expression is greatly enthusiastic and overwhelming in Greek. The words (esteem, very, and highly), as translated from the Greek language, are rich in their individual meanings; much more when they are all put together in one sentence. When you get to understand the meaning of each word, you may think it's a repetition of an idea in Greek. However, Paul the apostle usually puts similar words in the same sentence, not just as emphasis, but to help explain the extent or degree of the point he is making. To "esteem them very highly in love" is as Paul the apostle being verbose in the phrase "...exceedingly abundantly above all..." Remember, I said, Paul the apostle writes in such a manner to explain the depths of the inspiration he has received. - The word "esteem" (hēgeomai) means to consider the influence of a leader. This word is only used for high-ranking leaders or rulers.  - These four-letter words "Very" have been watered down by some people in their daily usage. But it means more than "exact, actual or precise".  Very is an emphasis of a high degree or an exceedingly high degree of a matter.  The Greek word for "Very" is "huper", which means to place above, to go beyond or across or that which is superior to more than. Anything above more than. It suggests superiority or excess. The root word for hype or hyper can be traced to the Greek word "huper". Have you ever been told "you Hype your leader too much?". Interestingly, no one speaks against the idea that you over hype your favourite footballer or movie character or politician. Yet the moment you begin to "hype" your Church leader, they call you names. I suppose, so far, you have an idea of what Paul the apostle is saying about honouring your leader. - Now look at the word, "HIGHLY".It's from the Greek word "perissos". It also means superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); It means preeminence, exceeding, abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, very highly, vehemently beyond, measure more, superfluous. Do you now get the degree at which you must demonstrate honor to your leader? How well do you honor your leader? Now you don't honour your leader because of his or her age. You don't honour your leader because of his title or position.  Paul the Apostle was clear on this: you honour your leader because of the work and sacrifice they make for you.  You don't honour your leader because of his or her financial status or intellectual capacity.
A leader whose business is the welfare of your spirit and soul must be vehemently and superabundantly esteemed, and hyped beyond the degree the people of the world have set.
The people of the world feel agitated when the saints exceedingly esteem their spiritual leaders. Don't be shy to highly esteem your leader, especially in this time and age where people are looking down on Church Leaders. There are genuine Church leaders who have sacrificed their interests for the edification of the Church. Selah.  Stay glued for tomorrow's episode. title: EPISODE 810 - PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS – Esteem Your Leader Highly In Love 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever you do, look beyond yourself interest, or satisfaction. Whatever you do must not be according to your will or desire but unto God’s glory and honor. You don’t do things just to please yourself. You don’t do things just because it is a sin or not. The question is: How does it GLORIFY GOD? Author Saturday, 12th April, 2025 PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS – Esteem Your Leader Highly In Love 2"and [we ask that you appreciate them and] hold them in the highest esteem in love because of their work [on your behalf]. Live in peace with one another." 1 Thessalonians 5:13 (Amplified Bible)The first practical way to appreciate and honour your leaders is to hold them in the highest esteem, in love.From yesterday's episode, I explained the degree or magnitude to which God wants you to esteem your leaders.I used the three key words (esteem, very and highly) in the expression, "...and to esteem them very highly in love..." If you haven't read it, I want you to read it. If you have, it will be great if you re-read it.Appreciating and honouring your leaders is an important item for building up the Church of our Lord Jesus Christ.Though leaders must not accept to be worshipped, they should wholeheartedly accept to be honoured. Spiritual leaders must not just be the ones responsible for magnifying their office. The saints must also magnify the office of their leaders.
To esteem your Spiritual leaders very highly is part of the instructions Paul the apostle gave to the Church even as they look forward to the appearing and coming of the Lord Jesus.
To esteem your spiritual leaders very highly is to:exceedingly, vehemently, more abundantly above, beyond measure, place above or super hype or highly rank your leaders' degree of influence and impact.You may be reading this, and probably only a few people within your village know your leader in a small house Church. It doesn't matter; the Lord expects you to highly esteem that leader.Having said that, you should understand that leaders are not esteemed very highly just because of their title or intellectualism. The scriptures are clear on this:"And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you; and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves." 1 Thessalonians 5:12-13 (KJV)Did you see it? Your leaders:
Labour, rule, guide, admonish and care for you.
Therefore, you esteem them very highly because of their work.This also doesn't mean you should walk in dishonour because they don't work at the level of expectation.  Nonetheless, leaders must not be lazy or bossy. Leaders must put their heart and hands into the assignment the Lord has given them as people who will give an account to Him (Hebrews 13:17).To esteem your leaders very highly means:- To honour in a most extraordinary degree of love.You will notice Paul the apostle didn't just say "...esteem them very highly..."He said, "...esteem them very highly IN LOVE".This defines the context of honour and sets the tone of difference between idolizing and highly esteeming leaders.
The foundation of idolization is fear, intimidation, terror and sensuality.
The foundation of honour in the New Testament Church is LOVE (agape).You don't esteem your leaders because you are afraid of them. You honourably think of them in love and genuine affection. You must regard and magnify your leaders with a special love and not with hypocrisy. The work, impartation and effort of your leaders to bring transformation in your life and to serve the purpose of God in you should also fuel your love and genuine honour for them.Do you love your leader?When was the last time you celebrated your leader?Do you appreciate their efforts?Do you acknowledge your leader for his or her selflessness?Do you celebrate your football club more than what the Lord is doing in your assembly and also through your Leader?Are you celebrating your spiritual leader or the one trending?How do you honour your leader?These are questions for your heart.
This conversation inspires the heart of your leader, strengthens the Church,  and benefits you as a person.

title: EPISODE 811 - PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 3 – Obey them 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You are seated with Christ, refuse to be intimidated by any dominion or rule which is under the feet of Christ. As members of His body, anything under His feet is under our feet. Walk in this consciousness of authority. Author Sunday, 13th April, 2025 PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 3 – Obey Them 1"Obey your spiritual leaders, and do what they say. Their work is to watch over your souls, and they are accountable to God. Give them reason to do this with joy and not with sorrow. That would certainly not be for your benefit." Hebrews 13:17 (NLT)The Lord has appointed Spiritual Leaders to function as shepherds.They have the responsibility to:- Lead and guide you unto God's agenda.- To care for and feed you as a shepherd feeds his flock.
To think that you don't need a shepherd is to act contrary to the wisdom of God's word.
Our Lord Jesus is the great good Shepherd-King (Hebrews 13:20; John 10:11; 1 Peter 5:4), and He has appointed leaders within the various assemblies of saints to shepherd the saints as He does.Your Pastor or Church leader has the work or spiritual task to watch over your souls as shepherds watch over a flock."...I urge my fellow elders among you to be compassionate shepherds who tenderly care for God’s flock and who feed them well, for you have the responsibility to guide, protect, and oversee. Consider it a joyous pleasure and not merely a religious duty. Lead from the heart under God’s leadership..." 1 Peter 5:1-2 (TPT).This was Peter the apostle's instruction to the Church elders as Jesus instructed him.Jesus asked Peter at three different times if he loved Him, and He instructed Peter more than once to feed His lambs:"... Jesus said to Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you burn with love for me more than these?”Peter answered, “Yes, Lord! You know that I have great affection for you!”“Then take care of my lambs,”“Then take care of my sheep,”  Jesus replied, “Then feed my lambs." John 21:15-17 (TPT)Again, Paul the apostle also instructed the elders of the Church in Ephesus:"So guard your hearts. Be true shepherds over all the flock and feed them well. Remember, it was the Holy Spirit who appointed you to guard and oversee the churches that belong to Jesus, the Anointed One, which he purchased and established by his own blood." Acts 20:28 (TPT).The obedience in Hebrews 13:17 is not just to respond to a command as one under authority, but also to have confidence in a person. The Greek word is "peithō", which means "to yield" or "have inner conviction".To obey your leader is not a mere outward display of conformity. It is not acting properly in the presence of the leader. It is assenting in your heart to yield to the guidance of your spiritual leader.There are people who act in obedience only when they are in the presence of their leader and do otherwise or speak contrary in his absence.It is not a display of honour. It is a display of the hypocrisy of your heart. This kind of evidence wouldn't last for long. Soon you will be exposed, or you will showcase your lack of commitment and unyieldingness.This is Paul the apostle writing :"So then, my dear ones, just as you have always obeyed [my instructions with enthusiasm], not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation [that is, cultivate it, bring it to full effect, actively pursue spiritual maturity] with awe-inspired fear and trembling [using serious caution and critical self-evaluation to avoid anything that might offend God or discredit the name of Christ]." Philippians 2:12 (Amplified Bible)The Greek word for obedience in this verse is "hupakouō", which means "to heed", "hearken or conform to a command or authority".These people conformed with conviction to Apostle Paul's instruction with enthusiasm in his presence. Now he urged them that it is more important for them to obey him in his absence.
This is a true demonstration of honour to your spiritual leader.
This is proof that you are not obeying your leader because you are afraid or being hypocritical, but you honour the Lord and honour the shepherd He has set over you.Hallelujah!I believe you are blessed by these episodes.CLICK HERE TO SEND YOUR PARTNERSHIP. title: EPISODE 812 - PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 4 – Receive them with Joy
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency All that God has said in His word is the revelation of His life and eternal counsel to mankind. Your revelation of God must be according to the word of God. For the Word of God to be useful to you, you need to know and own the Word. You must personalise it. Selah. Author Monday, 14th April, 2025 PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 4 – Receive them with Joy"Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such men in esteem" Philippians 2:29 (KJV)The practical things you must do to honour your leaders according to the scriptures include:1. Esteeming Your Leaders Very Highly in Love. — This is also to honour and hype vehemently, superabundantly and in the most extraordinary degree of love.2. Obeying Them with sincerity of heart.— Leaders are your shepherds appointed and ordained by the Holy Spirit to guide you and care for your spiritual and total well-being. How will you be led rightly if you don't obey and hear their voice?3. The next practical way to honour your leader is to RECEIVE THEM IN LOVE.To receive your leaders is to:- Always welcome them with great and special hospitality because of their reputation.As believers, we must always receive or be hospitable to the saints. We are all equal in Christ according to what we have obtained. But we are not all equal in the reputation of labour.
Those who labour must be received at the level of their reputation.
You demonstrate a special hospitality to these leaders because they deserve it.We must all be honoured as saints. But Paul the apostle said something different when he instructed the Philippians to warmly welcome Epaphroditus."So warmly welcome him home in the Lord, with joyous love, and esteem him highly, for people like him deserve it" Philippians 2:29 (TPT)Did you see the last phrase in the sentence?"...for people like him deserve it."This kind of hospitality is for people labouring and making sacrifices as Epaphroditus. You can identify such people by how Paul the apostle calls them:– A companion and fellow soldier.– He risked his life and came close to death for the work of Christ.Paul the apostle mentioned a few others, like Epaphroditus:In the same chapter, we see the example of Timothy as well.– One with a kindred spirit who will be genuinely concerned for your spiritual welfare.– One who doesn't seek to advance his own interests.– One who is tested and proven to serve the interests of Jesus Christ. – One who labours to advance the gospel of our Lord Jesus.Concerning the example of Phoebe:"Now, let me introduce to you our dear and beloved sister in the faith, Phoebe, a shining minister of the church in Cenchrea. I am sending her with this letter and ask that you shower her with your hospitality when she arrives. Embrace her with honor, as is fitting for one who belongs to the Lord and is set apart for him. I am entrusting her to you, so provide her whatever she may need, for she’s been a great leader and champion for many—I know, for she’s been that for even me!" Romans 16:1-2 (TPT).The brethren in Rome were to shower Deaconess Phoebe with their hospitality. And they were asked to embrace her with honour. Not just any kind of honour but one which is befitting for the one who belongs to the Lord and one who is set apart for him.The hospitality of a believer is clearly distinct from the hospitality of the world. 
As believers, we must demonstrate hospitality and honour according to the character of our Lord Jesus.
We must love, share kindness and provide comfort extravagantly. The people we receive must experience great faith and hope, which the Lord supplies.They must have first-hand experience and enjoyment that God does not forget our labour of love, and He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.Through the hospitality of the saints, people must have their burdens lifted and their pain uprooted.By the wisdom of God at work in the saints, their hospitality must dispense encouragement, which will inspire those selflessly labouring to continue with great hope.Receive your Leaders!Selah.Click HERE TO SEND YOUR PARTNERSHIP. title: EPISODE 813 - PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 5 – Receive them with Joy 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whether you are conscious of it or not, you are always involved in some level of meditation. The issue has always been what you are meditating on daily. If you want to see the results of the Word of God, you must meditate on the Word. Selah. Author Tuesday, 15th April, 2025 PRACTICAL WAYS TO HONOUR YOUR LEADERS 5 – Receive them with Joy 2"Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such men in esteem" Philippians 2:29 (KJV)Receiving your leaders through a great and special hospitality because of their reputation is one practical way. There is another practical way of receiving your leaders that you must give attention to; receiving them in the name of the one who sent them.
Your Leaders are not Jesus Christ our Lord, but they are specially appointed, ordained and sent men of the Lord Jesus Christ.
These leaders did not send themselves; they were sent by the Lord with a special grace to fulfill His assignment."Those who welcome you are welcoming me. And when they welcome me they are welcoming God who sent me. If you welcome a prophet because he is a man of God, you will be given the same reward a prophet gets. And if you welcome good and godly men because of their godliness, you will be given a reward like theirs." Matthew 10:40-41 (TLB)These words of Jesus point out two crucial things:- How you receive a leader the Lord has sent to you, is how you have received the Lord. The Lord sees your hospitality towards your leaders as hospitality towards Him. This means you must see the leaders God has set over you as men from God who must be given special reception.- The second item is that you must acknowledge, accept, welcome and receive your leader in the capacity of his commission or calling. The commission or assignment of the Lord entrusted to a man has a reward which shall benefit or serve for your advantage. Every mandate comes with a reward, and so receive them in the capacity of their mandate. As part of receiving the leaders sent by God to you, you must listen to the words of the Lord.
When you don't receive or even reject them, you have rejected the Lord (See Luke 10:16).
"Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God." 1 Corinthians 4:1 (Amplified Bible).This was how Paul the apostle was instructing the saints in Corinth to regard himself and Apollos. Paul the apostle did not expect the brethren to regard them as mere men preaching the gospel but as ministers or servants of Christ. They are to see them as stewards, custodians or administrators of the mysteries of Christ.You will always receive and honour your leaders by how you see their mandate to you.
Though we are equal by what Christ has obtained for us, we are not equal in the administration of God's grace.
Honour those the Lord has set over you. Submit your mind to the nurturing of your leaders.How do you see the commission or assignment of your leader?Until you see the extraordinary grace of God at work in him and recognize him as a man sent from God, you will connect with or regard him as an ordinary person.
The special anointing to carry out a divine assignment distinguishes men.
 Honour them!Selah.Click HERE TO SEND YOUR PARTNERSHIP. SUPPORT WHAT GOD IS DOING WITH ANY AMOUNT.SPECIAL APPRECIATION TO ALL WHO KEEP PARTNERING WITH US. title: EPISODE 814 - ATTEMPT SOMETHING GREAT FOR THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency How is your daily life, your speech, your conduct bringing glory to God and honoring Him? This is how you emulate the example of Jesus. Shalom! Author Wednesday, 16th April, 2025ATTEMPT SOMETHING GREAT FOR THE LORD“Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:” 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV) The Lord’s assignment has never been small. Even the things which seem little are the embodiment of great seeds.When Jesus told His disciples to go into all the nations, he didn’t consider the ratio of His disciples to the world's population. It is estimated that the world’s population at the time of Jesus was around 300 million. And Jesus asked that they take the gospel of the Kingdom to all nations. The assignment was unto generations yet unborn. He wanted to see all men saved, as He worked through His disciples. It was a great task, so the Lord asked them to tarry until they were imbued with power. For God to call you into fellowship or partnership with Him (1 Corinthians 1:9) means He has also invited you to share in His great burdens. He made you and created you for His foreordained good works (Ephesians 2:10). And He doesn’t leave you to yourself, He works with you to do great things. “With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot.” Psalm 108:13 (BBE) To do great things with God, you must first learn to channel your desires correctly. What is your desire?What takes the attention of your heart?
Until you set your affection towards the Lord, you will not be able to do great things with God.
David the king showed us how he was able to give his best towards the building of the Lord’s house: "Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:” 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV). To set your affection on something means you have made it your delight, or it has overwhelmed your mind and pleasure.This is the first thing to consider in attempting something great for the Lord;SET YOUR AFFECTION ON THE LORD AND HIS VISION.Whatever overwhelms your affection or desire has your attention and resources. Desire is the primary fuel that causes you to do great things for the Lord. To increase in desire for the Lord;1. Spend time meditating on the Word of God and beholding great things others have done for the Lord.2. See God’s heartbeat. See how the Lord wants to give hope to a hopeless, clueless generation.3. Understand the meaning and purpose of life. See that the meaning of life transcends the portrait of the world. The life of Christ is the picture of the true meaning of life.4. Make it your meditation, think about it, talk about it and train your heart to rejoice in it.5. Spend time with people who share in the new desires you cultivate. Be in the right company of people sharing in your burdens and desires.6. Attempt something great for the Lord and be determined to do more.7. Make time to pray and fellowship with the Holy Spirit.The more you follow these things, the more you intensify your affection towards the Lord’s assignment.Where is your desire?Selah.Click HERE TO SEND YOUR PARTNERSHIP.
