title: EPISODE 815 - BE DETERMINED TO RUN TO FINISH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Let no man force you or threaten you into doing things the Lord has not instructed you to do. Let no man lure you to go where God has not called you to go. Don’t compromise! BE INSPIRED BY THE LORD! Selah! Author Thursday, 17th April, 2025 BE DETERMINED TO RUN TO FINISH“It’s not that I’ve already reached the goal or have already completed the course. But I run to win that which Jesus Christ has already won for me.” Philippians 3:12 (God’s Word Translation)The finished work of Christ, through His death, burial, and resurrection, does not mean we have no work or task as believers in Christ.
The finished work of Christ has produced the goodness of God in every believer.
The Lord has made every new creation in Christ His workmanship unto good works (Ephesians 2:10). Interestingly, these good works were foreordained in God before the foundation of the world.God planned our destiny and the good works we would do to fulfill it.This means that through Christ’s finished work, we have access through faith to God and have been established in Him to execute His plans by our good works of faith.The life of every believer is to be the execution of God’s eternal purpose. The original goal and purpose of your life is not for you to live and accomplish your ambition.The goal of your life is to execute God’s purpose.All that you need to accomplish God’s purpose and plan for your life is fully supplied to you by God through His Spirit. However, you will still not automatically accomplish God’s goal for your life.
To achieve God’s goal for your life, you have to be intentional, you have to be determined, and you have to make a decision you are going to diligently work towards the goal or target.
Paul the apostle said, “I run to win…”To run in this context also means to press on or to explode with determination towards your goal. It is to act in commitment to a course till you reach the finish line.There is a level God wants you to reach, an impact God wants you to make, and a glorious purpose to fulfill. There is a target God has woven into your heart.No matter how you accomplish those personal ambitions of yours, you will only find true satisfaction when you pursue and accomplish God’s purpose and goal for your life.This then requires that you set your heart and mind towards God’s goal for your life.
Live every day of your life by running towards the goal the Lord has set before you.
Don’t run away from purpose, run towards the purpose of God for you.Beloved, at all cost and against all odds be strongly determined that you will run to finish!Click HERE TO SEND YOUR PARTNERSHIP. SUPPORT WHAT GOD IS DOING WITH ANY AMOUNT.SPECIAL APPRECIATION TO ALL WHO KEEP PARTNERING WITH US. YOU MAKE IT POSSIBLE AND EASY TO COME YOUR WAY EACH DAY.As part of our journey to Episode 1000 there will be a SPECIAL CONFERENCE for all PARTNERS. Watch out!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJbu7z5oV64&t=62s&pp=0gcJCX4JAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 12:1-2; 1 Corinthians 9:24-27; Psalm 119:32; Colossians 1:29;  2 Peter 1:10-11; 1 Timothy 6:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we will enjoy more and more grace as we run towards the goal the Lord has set before us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20252 Kings 3-42 YEARS PLANLeviticus 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I run diligently towards my goal. – I am intentional, determined and committed to reach the finishline. – I will never stop at my goal halfway. – I run to win and reach my goal. – I don’t run away from purpose. – I enjoy more and more grace as I run towards the goal that the Lord has set before me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 816 - WHERE IS YOUR STRENGTH?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, to be counted worthy of the Lord’s presence in your life, or to have right standing with God without any sense of guilt by Christ Jesus, is a great privilege. Learn to acknowledge the sure mercies and grace of God. Selah. Author WHERE IS YOUR STRENGTH?“For I am Yahweh your God, who strongly takes hold of your right hand, Who says to you, ‘Do not fear, I will help you.”Isaiah 41:13 (Legacy Standard Bible)One of the greatest signs of maturity is dependence on God.In the society we find ourselves today, most people see dependence as weakness and others also see it as immaturity.But that is not the situation in God.The more you grow in your relationship with God or as you mature in Him, the more you realise you have to depend on Him.The immatured ones don’t depend on God.
Dependence on God is not a sign of weakness. Dependence on God is a quality of wisdom and humility.
It takes a lot of pride to think you don’t need God.Such people don’t pray.They do everything with their own strength and understanding.The wise in Christ trust in God’s strength. They don’t try to use their own strength. They depend and utilize the strength of God’s resources.Just think about it, trying to use your limited resources to accomplish an assignment of the Limitless God?A man who has accomplished great things with God and made an impact which has shaped culture, is a man who has absolute dependence on God.Paul the apostle showed us the secret to His great accomplishments.“…by the grace of God I have laboured more than they all…” (1 Corinthians 15:10).The Lord who made you, knows the weight of the assignment He has entrusted to you; therefore He has made abundance of resources and grace available for your benefits. Yours is to take advantage of these resources.David said to Goliath,  “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied” 1 Samuel 17:45 (NKJV)
Don’t confront any assignment or task or life situation by your strength.
Deploy the tools of God.Let your confidence be in the Lord. As you spend time in prayer and the meditation of the word, He will show you what to do.
Where is your strength?
Just as the Lord spoke through the Prophet Isaiah (as quoted in the opening verse), He is still speaking to you today;“For I am Yahweh your God, who strongly takes hold of your right hand,Who says to you, ‘Do not fear, I will help you.”
Beloved, don’t be afraid. The Lord knows what is at stake. He will not leave you. He is strongly holding your hand and is with you as your helper. Depend on Him at all times.
Don’t be like the people of the world.Let this be your testimony:“Some find their strength in their weapons and wisdom, but my miracle deliverance can never be won by men. Our boast is in the Lord our God, who makes us strong and gives us victory!” Psalm 20:7 (TPT)Praise the Lord.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJbu7z5oV64&t=62sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 20:1-9; Isaiah 42:6; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 27:1; 121:1-2; John 15:5) WE PRAYWe pray that the Help and supply of divine strength will abound towards us to accomplish great things unto His glory. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20252 Kings 5-72 YEARS PLANLeviticus 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute dependence on God. – My strength is in the Lord. – I depend on God in all things. – I don’t confront any assignment or task by my our strength but by the enabling strength of God which is at work in me. – By the supply of the divine strength of God, I accomplish great things unto His glory. Oh Hallelujah![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 817 - ARE YOU INTENTIONAL ABOUT YOUR GROWTH IN THE LORD?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, as long as you are in Christ and have set your focus to intensively serve His course, you will face opposition and tribulation. But tribulation should not break you. You are designed and built by Christ, to glory in Tribulation. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 19th April, 2025ARE YOU INTENTIONAL ABOUT YOUR GROWTH IN THE LORD?“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)Your growth in Christ is not an ACCIDENT, it is an intentional process. Your individual growth contributes to the building up of Christ’s body.This makes your growth essential in the increase of the body of Christ. Doubtlessly, your personal growth in Christ is your responsibility, however, it essentially depends on the Lord’s supply. This means your growth in Christ shouldn’t be in isolation, though you have a crucial role to play in it. Remember, you can do nothing without the Lord (John 15:5).  This should be the underlying reality of your growth in Christ. Take responsibility for your growth by taking advantage of your partnership with the Lord in the Holy Spirit.
There is a point you have to genuinely look at yourself through the Word of Grace, to see if you are a true expression of your true self in Christ.
There is a point in your walk in Christ, where you should know you have to manifest or express Christ in a greater measure. There is a point you have to emit greater light and exude far exceeding glory by the power of God, which is at work in you. There is a point where you have to be an example of great faith, which works in love. “You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again the basic things about God’s word. You are like babies who need milk and cannot eat solid food.” Hebrews 5:12 (NLT) Are you growing?Are you being an example of faith?Are you an example of the love of Christ?
Your growth in Christ is predictable. 
There are specific things which contribute to your growth. These are intentional habits of grace or spiritual disciplines. Cultivate the habits of: 1. fellowshipping with the Word. This trains you to hear the Lord’s voice. 2. consistent and spontaneous prayer. You develop your spiritual ear and sharpen your ability to see right visions in the Lord. 3. being an effective member or belonging to the body of Christ (through a local church) 4. becoming an expression of love every day and in all things. 5. uniquely sharing Christ with others.
Christ Jesus should be the central focus of these habits, not our self-efforts and self-gratification.
You practice them without stress when you make the goodness and the enjoyment of Christ the goal. As you practice these habits, you may not really feel you are growing; however, as you repeat them over a period of time, you will realise you have matured and become fruitful. You begin to see transformation in your thoughts, speech, conduct and manner of life. When you are growing, you become an example of Christ to the saints and the world.
The focus is not on you becoming superior to the other saints.
The focus must always be, as Paul said, “THAT I MAY KNOW HIM” (Philippians 3:10) How have you cultivated the habits of growth? Are you intentional about your growth in the Lord? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJbu7z5oV64&t=62sDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Proverbs 4:18; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAY– That we will increase in the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding. – That we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, increasing in the knowledge of God, and demonstrating the love of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20252 Kings 8-102 YEARS PLANLeviticus 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an example of faith. – I demonstrate the love of Christ in all that I do. – I make time daily to fellowship with the Lord. – I don’t settle for less, I press deeper daily to manifest Christ in a greater measure. – My heart and mind is cultivated in the love of God daily as I feast on the word. – I set my affection on the Lord.  – The love of God dominates my heart and influences my actions. – I am directed and instructed daily by the word of God. – Envy, bitterness and offenses have no place in my heart because I am deeply rooted in the love of Christ. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 818 - INCREASE IN WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter the negative plots of the enemy to stop you from manifesting God’s great plan for you, He is graciously leading you into the fulfillment of His great purpose. Maintain trust in Him through the process. He is working it out for your good. Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 20th April, 2025 INCREASE IN WISDOM“I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just.” Proverbs 8:15 (TPT)It will only take Wisdom to curb the overwhelming burdens of leadership.
Great leadership is not demonstrated when everything is convenient. Great leaders emerge when there is opposition or a challenge.
You are not a great leader just because you command people to serve you. You are a great leader when you provide answers or solutions.People will be loyal to those who solve problems and inspire them to also become problem-solvers.Leaders are light-bearers who shine in the darkest situations. You influence your world greatly by shining forth the light of Wisdom in the darkest places.Be the light of the world (John 5:14).
To be the light of the world is to be a dispenser of wisdom.
As born-again, you must shine the light of God in your world.Decide to increase in Wisdom.As Kings and Priests in Christ, you can only lead by wisdom.This was why Solomon requested Wisdom and understanding.
No matter how genuine you are, you cannot lead people with great vision without Wisdom and understanding.
“And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of David my father, although I am but a little child. I do not know how to go out or come in. And your servant is in the midst of your people whom you have chosen, a great people, too many to be numbered or counted for multitude. Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, that I may discern between good and evil, for who is able to govern this your great people?” 1 Kings 3:7-9 (ESV)
The capacity of a king to lead great people is not in the size of his muscles or his age. The capacity of a king is in his level of wisdom and understanding.
A man of Wisdom is a man of influence.“Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your radiance.” Isaiah 60:3 (Holman Christian Standard Bible)Wisdom is radiant and attracts the great.Kings travelled to meet Solomon because of His Wisdom.“And people of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.” 1 Kings 4:34 (ESV)The results of Wisdom are its splendour.
When you love and esteem wisdom you shall be honored.
 “If you exalt wisdom, she will exalt you. Hold her fast, and she will lead you to great honor; she will place a beautiful crown upon your head.” Proverbs 4:8-9 (TLB)Beloved, increase in Wisdom to reign in life and to influence your world.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJbu7z5oV64&t=62sDIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 9:23; Isaiah 2:2; Ecclesiastes 8:1; 1 Kings 3:9-14;16-28; Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 8:18-19; Proverbs 3:3:14-24) WE PRAYWe pray that the radiance of the Wisdom of God in us shall spread greatly and attract great kings without fading.In the name of Jesus!BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20252 Kings 11-132 YEARS PLANLeviticus 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I reign and rule in life by wisdom. – I love and esteem wisdom. – Through wisdom, I build every aspect of my life. – The desires of my heart is glued to wisdom. – As I fellowship daily with the Word of God, I increase in wisdom. – I am full of wisdom. – I do all things in wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 819 - ARE YOU A MIGHTY MAN?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do not let the wrongs of others redefine the goodness of God in you. Continue doing good for others, whether they appreciate it or not. Author Monday, 21st April, 2025   ARE YOU A MIGHTY MAN? “Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you”  John 15:16 (ASV) It is one thing to see yourself as the man for the job. And another thing altogether to become part of God’s mighty men within a generation. To be a mighty man is to be a person with exceptional and extraordinary results. To be a mighty man is to bear bountiful fruits or produce extra results. It is to dare to do what others run from. When Jesus was ascending, He entrusted His Church mandate into the hands of His disciples. These were young but had the hearts of mighty men. As Peter and John healed the cripple and were preaching about the power of Jesus, the Jewish leaders were angered. And they were even left astonished, as they witnessed the bold courage of these disciples of Jesus. (Acts 4:13). As you study the scriptures, you will notice how many people were added to the Church in Jerusalem, Samaria, Antioch, etc. Yet there were people who became outstanding and were noticed. These people became the mighty men who led the course of Christ in their generation. God has not designed for some to bear more fruits or have greater results than others. 
God has given each of us the measure of grace for our unique assignments.
“Yet grace [God’s undeserved favor] was given to each one of us [not indiscriminately, but in different ways] in proportion to the measure of Christ’s [rich and abundant] gift.” Ephesians 4:7 (Amplified Bible). God does not discriminate. He doesn’t give more grace to one than the other. We all have grace according to the same measure of Christ’s gift.
You become a mighty man in the Kingdom by what you accomplish with the grace of God which you received.
Take note of Apostle Paul’s testimony: “Yes, I am the most insignificant of all the apostles, unworthy even to be called an apostle, because I hunted down believers and persecuted God’s church. But God’s amazing grace has made me who I am! And his grace to me was not fruitless. In fact, I worked harder than all the rest, yet not in my own strength but God’s, for his empowering grace is poured out upon me.“ 1 Corinthians 15:9-10 (TPT). According to Paul the Apostle;–  he was the least, the most insignificant among the Apostles. – and also received the same grace which these apostles and leaders of the Church were given. – Yet he decided to be fruitful with the grace of God. He didn’t receive this grace to remain fruitless. – to become fruitful or to get results with the grace of God, he worked harder by the empowering grace of God. – he specifically stated that he worked harder than the rest, though they were empowered with the same grace. God sees each of us as His mighty men. Therefore He empowers us with grace to work. What you accomplish is what ushers you into the reality of a mighty man of God in your generation. Are you laboring with the grace of God or you are making excuses? Which steps are you taking? Are you acting out the ideas God has given you? Or do you keep procrastinating? Just as the mighty men of David were recognised by their bold or courageous accomplishments, even so, are you recognised to be part of God’s mighty men in your generation by the extraordinary results you produce. The first three elite squads of David’s mighty men were not named because of how good-looking they were. These men were named in that elite squad because of their extraordinary accomplishments (See 2 Samuel 23:8-11). – Adino the Eznite, was included because he had killed eight hundred men at one time. – Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, was one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel had retreated. He arose and attacked the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand stuck to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day, and the people returned after him only to plunder. – And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a piece of ground full of lentils. So the people fled from the Philistines. But he stationed himself in the middle of the field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. So the Lord brought about a great victory. These men were not automatically named mighty men of David. They demonstrated courage and went the extra mile to attain a place in David’s military set-up. What are you known for in God’s Kingdom? What comes to mind when your name is mentioned? In Paul’s loving greetings, as he concludes his epistle to the Romans, he mentions some names and you will notice what those people mean in the Kingdom by the things Paul the apostle said about them. “Now, let me introduce to you our dear and beloved sister in the faith, Phoebe, a shining minister of the church in Cenchrea. I am sending her with this letter and ask that you shower her with your hospitality when she arrives. Embrace her with honor, as is fitting for one who belongs to the Lord and is set apart for him. I am entrusting her to you, so provide her whatever she may need, for she’s been a great leader and champion for many—I know, for she’s been that for even me!“ Romans 16:1-2 (TPT) This is the record of Phoebe in the Kingdom. – She’s a shining minister of the Church.– A great leader and champion of many, including Paul the apostle.– One amazing thing is that it was Phoebe who went to deliver this amazing life-transforming epistle to the Romans.  What a mighty lady of God. Imagine she was scared to deliver the Epistle to the Romans.Imagine she got distracted, didn’t deliver this epistle and misplaced it.We would have lost rich revelations of the Spirit. Take a look at this couple as well: “Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, my partners in ministry serving the Anointed One, Jesus, for they’ve risked their own lives to save mine. I’m so thankful for them, and not just I, but all the congregations among the non-Jewish“ Romans 16:3-4 (TPT) Beloved, refuse to be an ordinary member of the body. Make a decision to achieve great things for the Lord. 
Don’t hide the grace which the Lord has given you. Go and produce mighty results with the grace which you have received.
Through your courageous results, the Kingdom of God will expand, and your sphere will experience great transformation. Glory to God! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1ME&t=614sDIG DEEPER (2 Samuel 23:8-23; Romans 16:5:15; Philippians 2:19-20; Colossians 4:7-18)   WE PRAY Pray that I will diligently take advantage of the grace of God to produce relevant results in the Kingdom, unto God’s glory.   BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025 2 Kings 14-16 2 YEARS PLANLeviticus 20 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I diligently take advantage of the grace of God to produce Kingdom relevant results.   – I refuse to hide the grace of God given to me.   – Through my courageous results, the Kingdom of God will expand.   – I am fruitful.   – I achieve great things for the Lord.   Thank you Lord Jesus! title: EPISODE 820 - MANIFEST HIS GLORY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Dear Disciple of Jesus, do what the Lord tells you to do through His word, not what the world informs. Selah. Author Tuesday, 22nd April, 2025MANIFEST HIS GLORY“And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit.”2 Cor. 3:18 (Amplified)When you were born again, the Lord made you a partaker of His glory.
The glory of God is in you.
The glory of God is the beauty and excellence of God revealed in your life.The manifestation of God’s glory is to be seen in every aspect of your life.Wherever Jesus went and whatever He did, there was the manifestation of the glory of God.John said, “…we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.” John 1:14 (NKJV)Whatever you share with Christ becomes the reality of who you are. As you share in the glory of God in Christ Jesus, you also become the glory of God.
As a partaker of the glory of God, you are also designed to show forth or make known His glory in all things.
“But you are God’s chosen treasure—priests who are kings, a spiritual “nation” set apart as God’s devoted ones. He called you out of darkness to experience his marvelous light, and now he claims you as his very own. He did this so that you would broadcast his glorious wonders throughout the world.” 1 Peter 2:9 (TPT).As a partaker of the glory of God, you are mandated to broadcast or announce, or showcase the glory which you have received.This is the purpose of your calling.
He called you out of darkness, corruption, defeat, failure and brought you into His marvellous light (to make you a light being) that His glory will be seen in you.
You have a duty to bring many to the knowledge of the classic grandeur of God.The wisdom of God is an expression of God’s glory. The love of God, His goodness, prosperity, peace, healing virtues and power are all expressions of God’s glory.
Remember, the glory of God is the expression of God.
God’s glory or excellence, and beauty must be seen in how you love, speak, and handle situations or responsibilities.God, who is Spirit and invisible, can be seen and experienced through you. As the embodiment of the glory of God, anyone who interacts with you must behold the majestic excellence of God.Your words must be full of wisdom and grace. Your work ethic at the office must be a reflection of God’s creativity and excellence.
Anyone who sees you must see the effulgence of Christ.
Get this:You don’t manifest the glory of God just by shouting “Gloryyyyyy!!!”It’s great to celebrate the glory of God and rejoice in it.However, you manifest the glory of God by showcasing the beautiful heart of God to your world.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(1 Peter 4:11; Isaiah 43:21; Isaiah 60:1 -3; Romans 11:36; Psalm 33:3) WE PRAY– That we shall have the mindset and consciousness that our lives are showcase of the glory of God to all men.– That in everything we do and everywhere we go, the tangible manifestation of God’s glory will be seen.– And that every aspect of our lives will be saturated in the beauty and excellence of God.In the glorious name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Kings 17-192 YEARS PLANLeviticus 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The glory of God is seen in me. – I have been called out of darkness, failure, corruption and brought you into God’s marvelous light. –  As men interacts with me, they behold the majestic excellence of God. – My words are full of wisdom and grace. – Anyone who sees me, sees the effulgence of Christ. – I manifest the glory of God. – I am a blessing to my world. Oh glory to God!!! Hallelujah!!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 821 - IT STARTS FROM YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency YOU DON’T HAVE ETERNITY TO CARRY OUT GOD’S ASSIGNMENT. You have eternity to enjoy the reward of what you did in time. You must always remember that the time you have will not be forever. Can’t you see how each day of the week doesn’t exist forever? Beloved, make the most of your time! Author Wednesday, 23rd April, 2025IT STARTS FROM YOUR HEART"Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart" Job 22:22 (NKJV) What you have in your heart is what distinguishes you.
The difference between those who are bringing change to their world and those who are struggling to make an impact is what they have in their heart.
Your heart is the governing seat of the Spirit.  God cannot do anything through you beyond the condition of your heart. The state of your heart defines the extent to which you go with God. A wicked heart will produce wickedness. A merry heart will produce joy in his or her sphere. Whatever we see happen in our world is the product of the condition of the hearts of men who influence society. One cannot manifest what one has not conceived in his heart. When you conceive evil, you will produce evil. When you conceive blessings and beauty, you will produce blessings and beauty. ” Peter asked Him, “Explain this parable [about what defiles a person] to us.” And He said, “Are you still so dull [and unable to put things together]? Do you not understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is eliminated? But whatever [word] comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what defiles and dishonors the man. For out of the heart come evil thoughts and plans, murders, adulteries, sexual immoralities, thefts, false testimonies, slanders (verbal abuse, irreverent speech, blaspheming).” Matthew 15:16-19 (Amplified Bible) See this also: “For the godless are barren: they can produce nothing truly good. God’s fire consumes them with all their possessions. The only thing they can ‘conceive’ is sin, and their hearts give birth only to wickedness.” Job 15:34-35 (TLB)
When you conceive failure, defeats, poverty, wickedness, hatred, envy and afflictions in your heart, that is what you will manifest or express.
Men, by their nature and their culturing without the word of God, are selfish at heart. And a selfish heart breeds envy, hatred, anger, wicked thoughts, etc. “The human heart is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked. Who really knows how bad it is?” Jeremiah 17:9 (NLT). See also: Genesis 6:5; 8:21; Ephesians 4:22.This is why at your new birth in Christ, God took away the stony heart to give you the new heart of grace.The Lord declared this through the Prophet Ezekiel, “Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. Your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols. And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.“ Ezekiel 36:25-26 (NLT). See also 2 Corinthians 3:3; Jeremiah 24:7; Psalm 51:10.Now in as much as at new birth the Lord gave you a responsive heart, your heart must be cultivated and nurtured with the Word of God. The Word of God is the revelation of God’s wisdom, His goodness and character.
To demonstrate and express the character of God, you need the Word in your heart.
"How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word. With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments! I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.” Psalm 119:9-11 (ESV) When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory.STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413s&pp=0gcJCX4JAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:6;11:18; Psalm 37:31; Matthew 13:15; Colossians 3:16; 1 Timothy 4:15; Psalm 1:1-3) WE PRAY– That we will give heed to the instructions of the word of God BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Kings 20-222 YEARS PLANLeviticus 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have invested the word of God in my heart, therefore none of my steps will slide. – I stay my mind and heart on God’s word. – My heart is a fertile and fruitful land for the word of God. – I give my mind daily to the mediation of the word. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 822 - WHAT ARE YOU DOING WITH YOUR FAITH?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The believer in Christ doesn’t first need material blessings as their satisfaction. The believer in Christ has the Lord as their inheritance and satisfaction. To have the Lord is to have all things because all things are His. Beloved you are a ROYAL PRIEST, and you have the LORD AS YOUR SPECIAL POSSESSION. Oh Hallelujah! Author Thursday, 24th April, 2025 WHAT ARE YOU DOING WITH YOUR FAITH?“Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions” Hebrews 11:33 (KJV) Have you thought of the greatest achievement of faith? Through scriptures, we see people experience great healings and miracles by faith. These personal miracles and healings are not necessarily the greatest accomplishments of faith. Am I saying this to undermine these results of faith? Not at all. The scriptures are clear: “The just shall live by faith!” Which means the entirety of our lives must be an expression of faith. Nevertheless, the accomplishment of our lives (which is by faith) shouldn’t be limited to our personal needs and experiences. The accomplishment of our faith must be the great things the Lord wants us to achieve. Your faith shouldn’t be reduced to excelling in exams, getting a job, buying things, or satisfying other personal interests. It must be focused on achieving great things for the Lord.
The greatest thing you can do with your faith is to serve the Lord’s great purpose.
At the end of all things, this shall be the greatest day in the history of the universe and all eternities: “Then the seventh angel sounded [his trumpet]; and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, “The kingdom (dominion, rule) of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ; and He will reign forever and ever” Revelation 11:15 (Amplified Bible). Though Christ has been made the head of all things in essence (Ephesians 1:22), in the dispensation of the consummation of time, all things, all nations and Kingdoms shall be fully subdued and engrafted into the GLORIOUS REIGN OF CHRIST. 
This is the great agenda of the Lord. And you must be involved.
 This must be the ultimate engagement of your faith. Even the heroes of faith made it their mandate to subdue Kingdoms by faith. “Through faith they subdued Kingdoms, wrought righteousness and shut the mouth of lions.” What are you doing with your faith?GET INTO THE BUSINESS OF SUBDUING KINGDOMS! Understand that all kingdoms are aggregated and governed by the hearts of men.To fully subdue Kingdoms is to subdue every heart for Christ. And this requires GREAT FAITH.
Unleash your faith to conquer hearts in your immediate sphere for Jesus.
Many more hearts must be taken for Jesus. And God wants to work with you. Start now!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 2:1-12;Joshua 14:6-15; Daniel 2:44; Daniel 7:14,27; Exodus 15:18; Psalm 146:10; Psalm 82:8) WE PRAYThat the  Lord shall help us take the nations and Kingdoms for Him and unto His glory.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Kings 23-252 YEARS PLANLeviticus 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am involved in the great agenda of the Lord.– Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfire.– I invest my life in serving the Lord’s purpose.– Through me, many are coming to believe in Jesus.– Multitudes are coming to the faith through me.– I saturate and dominate my sphere and city with the goodnews of Jesus.– I take my city with the gospelHallelujah!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 823 - YOUR COMMUNICATION MATTERS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t just walk in the awareness or intellectual perception of the Word; be drenched or participate or become one with the reality of Jesus. Selah. Author  YOUR COMMUNICATION MATTERS“He who loves purity of heart, and whose speech is gracious, will have the king as his friend” Proverbs 22:11 (ESV)This is the code to walk in greatness.
It takes a man who loves the purity of heart and is gracious in speech to have the king as his friend.
The king will associate himself with the mature. And it is the direction of your thoughts and the dexterity of speech which defines your maturity.“For we all stumble in many ways. And if anyone does not stumble in what he says, he is a perfect man, able also to bridle his whole body.” James 3:2 (ESV)To be a perfect man in this context means to be a matured man. Anyone who has mastery of the tongue and knows how to speak or tame the tongue will excel in every place.
You must be intentional about how you think and also your words.  Let the Word (Wisdom) of God saturate your mind or heart and your speech.
Don’t speak as you feel, speak what is right.Truth is not how you think, truth is how God wants you to think.There are people whose speeches are full of ungraciousness, impoliteness, arrogance, pride, and dishonour, and will claim they are being truthful. Truth is always spoken in humility of heart and speech.If you are truly humble at heart, you will speak with humility. If you are gracious at heart your speech will be gracious.
Your words are the description of your mindset. The mouth will speak what is in the heart.
As we looked at the Psalm 45:2: “You are the most handsome of all. Gracious words stream from your lips. God himself has blessed you forever” (NLT)David as a king did not use his royalty to become rude and boastful in his speech. He was gracious.To speak graciously, also means to speak kindly and politely. It means to speak an attractive speech that is impressively articulated and fitting for the occasion.This is not about making a faith declaration but knowing how to address situations and people through wisdom.When you learn to speak right, you avoid unnecessary conflicts and even stagnation. Some people have lost great opportunities because of how they think and how impolite they are in speech.
Let grace be poured on your lips.
Even our Lord, Jesus, was gracious in His speech.“Everyone spoke well of him and was amazed by the gracious words that came from his lips. “How can this be?” they asked. “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?” Luke 4:22 (NLT)Jesus at every given time had the right answers to the most difficult questions.
Beloved, let gracious words proceed out of your mouth. Let your tongue be soaked with wisdom.
“The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with a word him who is weary. Morning by morning he awakens; he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.” Isaiah 50:4 (ESV)It is not only your mind which must be given to training. Your tongue must be taught to be skilled at speech.The Lord through His Word and the voice of the Holy Spirit teaches you to speak before kings.The Lord said to Moses, “Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say” (Exodus 4:12)
Your communication (speech or writing) skills will enable you to harness relationships and accomplish success.
Think right, and speak graciously.This is how you steer your life to glorious accomplishments.Hallelujah!!!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(Matthew 10:19; Proverbs 22:12; Ecclesiastes 10:12; Proverbs 16:13; Luke 21:15; Zephaniah 3:9) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall train our hearts to reason his thoughts and our lips shall be equipped with wisdom to know what to say at any given point of time. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 1-32 YEARS PLANLeviticus 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My tongue is saturated with grace, therefore I only speak gracious words.– I excel in speech with the right words in and out of season. – It doesn’t matter the challenge at a particular time, I speak right. – My tongue is soaked with wisdom.– Only gracious words proceed out of my mouth.– I think right and I speak graciously.Oh Hallelujah![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 824 - BE HUMBLE AT ALL TIMES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, no challenge is bigger than you. Always see yourself as one with blessed hands. The more you think this way, the more all things align for your good. Hallelujah! Author Saturday 26th, April 2025 BE HUMBLE AT ALL TIMES“Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.”Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)
Pride is one of the strong weapons of the enemy against your faith and fulfilment of purpose.
The adversary knows that “Pride goes before destruction” (Proverbs 16:18).Therefore to destroy any beautiful destiny, he sows and cultivates pride in the hearts of men.A proud person is resisted and cannot increase in grace.Pride makes a person disrespect, disdain, and act arrogantly towards others. It makes one over esteem himself above others.Pride makes you self-centered and unruly. You always want things to go your way and pay no attention to anyone. Pride makes you do what you feel and despises wise counsel.Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. You cannot resist the devil when you are proud. To resist the devil, you must first humble yourself before the Lord. James said, “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you” (James 4:7).David didn’t confront Goliath in the might of the flesh or his strength and intelligence but in the name of the Lord.
Pride will not make you submit your mind, thoughts, and emotions to the Lord.
The adversary was the first in God’s universe to demonstrate pride. He began to exalt himself above the Lord. That was the cause of his fall.God has exalted His word, so when you begin to esteem your opinions above the word of God, you are already on the path of the devil. The end will surely be destruction.“for the day is coming when your proud looks will be brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted. On that day the Lord Almighty will move against the proud and haughty and bring them to the dust. All the tall cedars of Lebanon and all the mighty oaks of Bashan shall bend low, and all the high mountains and hills, and every high tower and wall, and all the proud ocean ships and trim harbor craft—all shall be crushed before the Lord that day. All the glory of mankind will bow low; the pride of men will lie in the dust, and the Lord alone will be exalted.” Isaiah 2:11-17 (TLB)
The adversary sets you up for failure and disgrace through pride. Intentionally deal with pride.
True faith towards God is humble. It takes humility to look away from your challenges and to exercise confidence in what God has said.“God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble.” Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you” (1 Peter 5:5-7)It will take the attitude of humility to walk in the fulfilment of God's purpose. Don’t trust in your intelligence above the knowledge of God’s word. 
Don’t be big-headed, be humble at all times.
Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&t=426s&pp=0gcJCYQJAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Micah 6:8; Isaiah 3:16-26; Colossians 3:12; 2 Chronicles 7:14; Luke 14:11; Proverbs 3:34) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be helped by the Holy Spirit to consciously walk in the humility of heart at all times and in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 4-62 YEARS PLANLeviticus 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I submit my will, emotions, thoughts and body to the Lord. – The word of God directs my life. – There’s no place for pride in my heart.– By the help of the Holy Spirit, I walk in humility at all times in all things.Oh thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 825 - WHAT ARE YOU BOILING FOR?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must develop the habit of staying long in your communion with God. The more you continue to stay longer, the more you are enriched with the influences of the Spirit. STAY LONG! DON’T RUSH. Author Sunday, 27th April, 2025 WHAT ARE YOU BOILING FOR?“For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.” Psalm 69:9 (KJV)How far do you want to see the work of God prosper?The fulfilment of God’s vision is not by how you wish to see it happen but by how you are determined to see its accomplishment.Most people think of zeal as a religious posture. However, the great visions of God are not realised without zeal.Some think zeal is not needed. They conclude that zeal does not bring salvation. Salvation is in believing and receiving Jesus. Thus, one can have zeal and not be saved.Nevertheless, everyone saved in Christ needs the zeal of God to execute divine assignments.
The Lord performs His plans according to His zeal.
“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.Of the increase of his government and peace, there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even forever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.” Isaiah 9:6-7 (KJV)Zeal basically means a strong burning passion. It is the agreed energy of the emotions, the will and the mind to accomplish a task. In Greek, zeal is derived from the word “zelos”, which means to be zealous. This means to have an “ardour or fervour of spirit.” It is an energy and enthusiasm about one’s conviction.It is the same word for fervency. The word fervent is from the Latin word “fervens”, which means to BOIL.This was the difference between Paul, the apostle, and some other believers. A man with a strong zeal will accomplish more than one who is lagging.No wonder he said to the brethren in Rome:“Do not be slothful in zeal, be fervent in spirit, serve the Lord” Romans 12:11 (ESV)Read it in The Passion Translation:“Be enthusiastic to serve the Lord, keeping your passion toward Him boiling hot! Radiate with the glow of the Holy Spirit and let Him fill you with excitement as you serve Him”.
 To have the zeal or to be fervent is to be quickened with a burning passion or to boil for something.
What are you boiling for?Don’t be boiling for fornication.Don’t be boiling to steal that jewel which doesn’t belong to you.Don’t be boiling for the nude video.Channel that passion or strong desire towards the LORD’S WORK.Have that burning desire to please the Lord. Channel your passionate ardour towards the pursuit of the expansion of the Kingdom of God.Beloved, to have zeal is to have an eagerness or desire to accomplish or obtain something.
Don’t use that zeal to please your selfish interest. Use it to accomplish that task which brings glory to God.
What are you burning for?What has consumed your boiling desire?When you make Jesus and His Kingdom the focus of your boiling desire, you will do extraordinary things for the Lord.You may not be doing great things for the Lord because your boiling desire is not towards the Lord.Selah.https://youtu.be/88Gs4aHpiTIDIG DEEPER(Acts 18:25; Colossians 4:12-13; John 2:17; Psalm 119:139; 2 Corinthians 8:16; 2 Corinthians 7:7,12; Acts 22:3; Acts 20:24) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that our hearts and actions will be consumed by the boiling passion or earnest zeal of the Lord to accomplish our assignment in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 7-92 YEARS PLANLeviticus 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – I set my affections on the Lord and His vision. – I dare to do great things for the Lord. – I give my mind to the meditation of the word. – I am not led by my emotions. – I am zealous about doing great things for the Lord. – I am zealous about my divine mandate. – I am zealous about the salvation of others. Oh Hallelujah![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 826 - YOU ARE A BLESSED MAN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Prayer is essential in this spiritual warfare. It is an advanced technology given to us by God, to stay in touch with the military command post or control center. Have you prayed today? Are you in touch with your military command base? Have you received an instruction from God through prayer? Or you are running by your own strength, strategy and plan. Get into prayer; get God involved. Author Monday, 28th April, 2025YOU ARE A BLESSED MAN“The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands” Deuteronomy 28:12 (NIV)It’s easy to feel less blessed when you’re overwhelmed with challenges. Sometimes, when it seems like nothing seems to work, you will feel like God’s promises aren’t for you.You look at others and feel they are blessed, and everything works successfully in their lives.You may also wonder if it is possible for a person to have:– Beautiful marriage and blessed children– Prosperous career or profession, and business– Outstanding Ministry– A dignified and peaceful life.Beloved, this is God’s design for your life.You can enjoy a life more beautiful and glorious than it was in “Eden”.
 Let this sink deep in your heart, the outcome of your life is what you believe with your heart.
 Do you believe that you can have a life full of glory and beauty?Hear this, all things are possible to them that believe (Mark 9:23).“All things” here means all things. Whether you read it in Hebrew, Greek, Latin, French, English, etc.ALL THINGS MEANS ALL THINGS!Whatever you believe will gravitate towards you.Do not accept the idea that your life is full of struggle.Hold on to the word of God.As you act in complete obedience of faith to the word of God, you will see the manifested glory of the word. The blessing of the word of God is not for some limited people.It is for those who believe!
 Maintain this strong mentality of faith that you are a blessed man.
 Let it be your consciousness that your hands are so blessed that everything you touch will turn to gold. Wherever you go and whatever you do is prosperous because God is with you. No matter the challenge, you will emerge strong, with mighty testimonies“When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; And through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you will not be scorched, Nor will the flame burn you.” Isaiah 43:2 (AMP)No challenge is bigger than you. Whatever you come in contact with, you will become the center of attraction. 
Always see yourself as one with blessed hands.
The more you think this way, the more all things align for your good.Oh Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91Q&pp=0gcJCYQJAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 28:1-14; Job 23:10; Deuteronomy 30:9; Genesis 39:3) WE PRAYThat we will grow deep in the consciousness that whatsoever our hands touch will turn into gold. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 10-122 YEARS PLANLeviticus 27DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Whatever I touch turns to Gold. – I am a blessed man. – Wherever I go and whatever I do is prosperous because God is with me. – No matter the challenge, I will emerge strong with mighty testimonies. – No challenge is bigger than me. – Whatever comes in contact with me will become the center of attraction. – I have blessed hands. Oh Hallelujah, glory![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 827 - YOUR SEASON OF EXALTATION IS HERE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your due season is already here! That is why you are reading today’s with . REMAIN EXPECTANT FOR YOUR TESTIMONY. I will be so excited to read your testimony in the comments. Shalom Aleichem! Author Tuesday, 29th April, 2025YOUR SEASON OF EXALTATION IS HERE“Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.”1 Peter 5:6 – 7 (NKJV)The adversary wants you to lose your confidence in God. He wants you to feel distressed or discouraged about how things have not gone in the direction you expected. And to think God is not caring and the promises of the scriptures are not true.
 His goal is to force or push you to a level where you become angry with God.
He wants you to deny the reality of God’s kindness in your heart. He keeps reminding you of your failures and the negative experiences you’ve had, though you have been serving the Lord.He keeps sowing thoughts of doubts or posing doubtful questions in your mind.For example:“After you gave that amount to the Kingdom gospel, has your life become better?”“You had hoped to see your dad or mum healed of that infirmity, what has happened?” “And you think the healing power of God is real?”“Do you even think the Gospel message of Jesus is real?”“Don’t you think these things are mere lies or fables?”“Look at your family, your siblings; do you remember your friend who also lost their parents?”, “How about your uncle who served God but has lost everything?” “Don’t you think the stories of the Bible are mere fiction?”“You don’t need God to be better, take your own life into your own hands. And forget about this God”Listen, when the adversary comes after your faith and exaltation, he tries to hit you hard at your weakest state. He will shamelessly and persistently inject more questions and thoughts to break you down.Have you had questions like these also:“Where was God when you failed your exams?” “Where was God when you got raped?” “Where was God when you were robbed?” “Where was God when you lost that money?” “Where was God when everyone left you?” “Where was God when you were abused, maltreated, cheated, scammed?” “Where was God when the lady or gentleman you loved left you or abandoned you?” etcThese questions are targeted by the adversary to establish enmity between you and God.All of a sudden, you forget the goodness of God. You forget your testimonies, and you continue to brood over these thoughts of the devil.You even begin to forget that the very air you breathe is a gift from God.You suddenly become so arrogant and proud before the Lord.Get this, such thoughts are attacks of the devil, to build strongholds of pride in your heart. Such thoughts are programmed by the adversary to make you doubt God’s help and to shipwreck your faith.Such thoughts become stronger when you are close to your season of exaltation.The adversary knows that the more you humble yourself before the Lord, the more you increase in faith to receive from the Lord.
He knows the more you submit to the power of the word of God, the stronger your expectation for your miracle and exaltation.
“Surely there is a future [and a reward], And your hope and expectation will not be cut off” Proverbs 23:18 (Amplified Bible).He doesn’t want you to have any expectation or hope in the Lord. He makes you think you can’t predict or expect anything glorious.That is a lie!Beloved, you have to maintain your expectation in God. Your season of exaltation is here. Don’t allow your past to distract you.“Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward” Hebrews 10:35A life lived by the word of God is predictable. When you live by the word, you can have expectations of glory.There is nothing like uncertainty in the Word of God. This doesn’t mean you will not face opposition. You may face the worst of challenges. But the counsel of the Lord for your life shall stand.Joseph, who was a promised child, was sold into slavery by his brothers, and he was taken to prison by his master Potipher (whose house prospered because of Joseph, Genesis 39:2-5). He chose to honour God, and he was imprisonedWhat?Where was God?Listen, the Lord was with Joseph all through. Though those seasons were challenging times for Joseph, everything was playing out perfectly for him. The slave who became a prisoner rose to become the Prime Minister.
Beloved, don’t give up, refuse the doubts and remain humble before the Lord, for the season of your exaltation is here!
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91Q&pp=0gcJCYQJAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 24:14; Psalm 37:37; Jeremiah 29:11; James 4:10; Job 36:22) WE PRAYThat our confidence expectation in God shall not be cast away, no matter the opposition.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 13-152 YEARS PLANNumbers 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– This is my season of exaltation and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary. – I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 828 - DON'T FORGET
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To work with God and experience true fulfillment, you must willingly make a decision to function according to His WILL. God doesn’t force you to live and function according to His will. The choice is with you. Selah. Author Wednesday, 30th April, 2025 DON'T FORGET"Get wisdom! Get understanding! Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth." Proverbs 4:5 (NKJV)God does nothing without His word. He created the Heavens and the earth by His word. (Genesis 1:3).Even the worlds were framed by His Word (Hebrews 11:3).He spoke forth the promise of Salvation through the seed of the woman.Salvation came to mankind through the Word. The Word became flesh so He could complete and fulfil God's Salvation plan. (John 1:1,14, 29).Even the new birth of incorruptibility is by the word of God (1 Peter 1:23)God's word is powerful (Hebrews 4:12), and it is the wisdom of God (1 Corinthians 1:24).The word of God has the ability to quicken your soul (Psalm 119:25,50)
The Word of God doesn't fail.
"For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it."Isaiah 55:10-11 (KJV)You will find these three things;1. God's word is fruit-bearing.2. God's word accomplishes God's pleasure.3. God's word prospers.Every word of God concerning you shall not fail, just as the prophetic word of our Lord Jesus did not fail. Peter the apostle said, "We have a more sure word of prophecy" (2 Peter 1:19).
You have a responsibility to know the sure word of prophecy and to continuously walk in the remembrance of the word.
The reality is this: whatever God has said about you will bear fruit. You don't have to forget. You don't have to let it slip out of your mind or heart. Stay glued to the word. The more you set your heart on it through meditation, the more you become courageous and increase in faith for the manifestation of the Word.The adversary knows that when you forget, you will not be able to experience or enjoy the prosperity of the Word. He labours to get your heart distracted from what God has said, so that you will walk in faithlessness.
Your greatest disadvantage has always been how you become forgetful of what God has said.
Don't allow failures, mammon, self-gratification, challenges, or negative situations to make you forget or doubt the word of the Lord.What is the word you have received? Know that the word of God which you have received shall prosper, be accomplished and produce fruits.Therefore, don't forget!If only you would not forget, you would see the manifestation of the word.
Put yourself into remembrance every day.
There's blessing in not forgetting the word of the Lord.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(James 1:22-25; Joshua 1:8; Psalm 1:2-3; Proverbs 2:1-12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain resolute at heart, and our minds will always be set on what the Lord has said, irrespective of the adversities. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 16-182 YEARS PLANNumbers 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't forget the glorious word of God I have received.- I stick to the word no matter. - I have this strong consciousness that the word of God works.- My heart and mind are continually set on what God has said, irrespective of the adversities. - I refuse to forget. - I don't forget. - I put myself in remembrance daily. - Until I see the result of the word thereof, I will not forget. - I don't permit anything past, present or future to make me forget or doubt the word of God. - I have absolute confidence in the word of God. - The word of God has power over me. - I believe in the word of God to the core.  Oh Hallelujah!Thank you Lord Jesus, for the gift of your word.[pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 829 - LEAD YOUR SPHERE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency HURRAAAAY! BLESSED NEW MONTH. THIS MONTH OF MAY WILL BE A SEASON WHERE THE WISDOM OF GOD WILL EXPAND YOUR INFLUENCE. _________________________________________________________________ Maybe you are looking forward to what to do specifically this month and what to focus on. I have a word for you. Yes, you, take advantage of the special grace of God dispensed to increase your influence. Let your impact be felt within your sphere. It can be your school, your home, your workplace, your city among your peers, etc. Author Thursday, 1st May, 2025LEAD YOUR SPHERE 1"But we will not boast beyond our measure, but within the measure of the area of influence which God apportioned to us as a measure, to reach even as far as you." 2 Corinthians 10:13 (Legacy Standard Bible)There are many people who assume they are not called to lead. And some of these thought patterns stem from an age long philosophy.Which simply emphasises the concept that "Not all are born to lead..."The question is, can we confirm this concept as the concept and ideology of God?Did God create some people to be leaders and others to be followers?Before the creation of man, God communicated His concept of who man is:"Then God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness. And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the heavens and over the livestock and over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.” Genesis 1:26 (ESV)
Man was not made to be inferior. Man was made to lead, to rule and to have dominion.
God is not just a creator, He is also the King of the universe.To be made in the image and likeness of God is to have the quality or capacity to function as a leader.If you are reading this now, I want you to know that God designed you to be a leader.You may not have all the qualities to function as a high-level leader or a great leader, but you must understand that you have the ability to lead. And if you have the ability to lead, then you can become a great leader or rise to a high level of leadership when you are able to strengthen your weaknesses and sharpen your strengths.Every human being has a certain level of capacity to lead. However, the moment you develop faith in God and submit your heart to Him, you begin to journey into true Kingdom leadership.You can fully operate or function according to God's design, to the degree to which you respond to Him in faith.
When God looks at you, He sees one with the capacity to lead.
Abraham lived all his life as an ordinary man until God called him out of his kindred. That call of God moved Abraham from his comfort zone and limited thoughts to become a great patriarch and a leader of many generations. Gideon never saw himself as a mighty man or as a leader. But when God looked at him, He saw a mighty leader (Judges 6:12).The disciples of Jesus lived as ordinary youths, but within them is the capacity to function as Kingdom leaders. Through an effective discipleship program for three years, Jesus nurtured His disciples to become conduits of a great global and transgenerational movement. He was able to establish an eternal mandate (the Church) on earth through these young men. He sent them out to go forth into all the world (every sphere of influence) to make disciples and transform them into transformational leaders. (Matthew 28:19).This is the charge for every believer: we are called into Christ and mandated to function as transgenerational leaders, raising more Kingdom leaders and making an eternal impact.Jesus calls you the light of the world, a city set on a hill.This is who you are!As a light, you have to shine and illuminate the very place you find yourself.Your sphere is your world, and God has designed and deposited into you the ability to lead in the sphere He has placed you in.
You are not called to lead tomorrow, you have the mandate to lead now. You are not going to become a leader, you are a leader now.
Take a stand today and lead your world.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91Q&pp=0gcJCYQJAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(1 Peter 2:9; Matthew 5:13-16; Isaiah 60:1-3; Isaiah 9:2; Matthew 4:16) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow and be sharpened to function as true Kingdom leaders in our world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 19-212 YEARS PLANNumbers 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been called to lead my generation. – I have the capacity to lead. – I am conscious of this calling. – I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call. – I refuse to be distracted. – I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth. – Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement. – I am the centre of attraction in my generation. – I am a satisfaction to many. – I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world. – I am a Leader today. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 830 - BE THOU AN EXAMPLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Christ’s hard-won freedom wasn’t partial. It doesn’t need your self-effort to make it complete. For it is completely wonderful and eternally established. Selah. Author BE THOU AN EXAMPLE"Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity." 1 Timothy 4:12 (NKJV) One of the major challenges you find in our society today is true leadership. Leaders define the state and direction of the society.  The lack of godly leadership, even from the family level, determines the state of the society. Leaders help the community or society find the right strategic compass. In Jesus, we saw the true meaning and essence of Kingdom Leadership. And Kingdom-centred leadership was what our Lord knew the society needed. It was part of His heartbeat. “And seeing the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and downcast like sheep without a shepherd“ Matthew 9:36 (Legacy Standard Bible).
When Jesus saw the multitudes, He knew their challenge was the lack of Kingdom leaders who would truly care for their state.
Ultimately, Jesus came not just as the Life-giver, but also as the true and great Kingdom shepherd (leader) who will bring us into fulfilment of the eternal purpose of God. And before His ascension, He mandated the saints to make disciples of all the nations (Matthew 28:19). This was a call to leadership. As the true meaning of Kingdom leadership, He made disciples (students) and now, He mandated His disciples to go forth to also demonstrate true Kingdom leadership, by making disciples. He sent His disciples to go into the world to lead the nations. When you come into Christ, you have a CALL TO LEAD YOUR GENERATION. Very few people are conscious and determined to fulfill this great call to leadership. I love what the author of Hebrews has to say:“You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again…“ Hebrews 5:12 (NLT).
As believers, we have to mature and take up the responsibility to LEAD.
This was what Paul said to Timothy:“Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.“ 1 Timothy 4:12 (KJV). The keyword is EXAMPLE, it’s from the Greek word,"TUPOS", which means, style or resemblance; specifically a sampler (type) that is a model (for imitation), a fashion, figure, form, or a pattern. (See Strong’s Bible Dictionary). This points to the function of true Kingdom Leadership. Thus, to be an example is to be a kingdom leader. You don’t have to allow anyone to despise you as a youth. Instead, be their leader, be the one everyone will look up to.
Be a leading example in word, in manner of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and purity. 
No wonder Jesus said, You are the light of the world and the salt of the earth. You have a call of God on your life to LEAD YOUR GENERATION, take a STEP TO MAKE IT HAPPEN. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Matthew 5:13-16;Ezra 7:10; 1 Peter 2:9; Psalm 78:72; Romans 12:3-8) WE PRAY– Thanking the Lord for the privilege to lead our generation unto His Kingdom agenda.– That we will yield ourselves to the training that will make us effective and productive Kingdom leaders. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 22-242 YEARS PLANNumbers 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been called to lead my generation.– I am conscious of this calling. – I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call. – I refuse to be distracted. – I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth. – Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement. – I am the centre of attraction in my generation. – I am a satisfaction to many. – I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 831 - LIVE AS ONE SENT BY GOD TO LEAD HIS GENERATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is a treasure of God in you. Stop judging yourself by the imperfections. Look inside. Within you is God’s refreshing answer to the world. Don’t live as an imperfect vessel. Live according to the treasure of the Spirit within you. For out of you the Lord is brewing a perfect wine to satisfy the world. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 3rd May, 2025LIVE AS ONE SENT BY GOD TO LEAD HIS GENERATION“Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest” Matthew 9:38 (Legacy Standard Bible) As a New Creation in Christ, you have the mandate to lead your generation. 
God has called and chosen you to lead many into purpose.
This call to leadership is an answered prayer. Let’s take a look at what Jesus said: “And seeing the crowds, He felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and downcast like sheep without a shepherd. Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest.“ Matthew 9:36-38 (LSB) When Jesus saw the multitudes, He saw the deep challenge of divine leadership. They were as sheep without a shepherd. And asked that prayers be made to the Lord of the harvest so that more workers or labourers could be sent. These workers are going to serve as shepherds to give direction and purpose to the multitudes. However, they have to be sent by the Lord of the harvest.Now, as many of us in Christ have been appointed by the Lord to be Kingdom ministers or kingdom leaders to lead the nations unto God’s agenda. That is why in Christ:1. You have been made a king and a Priest (Revelation 1:6).2. A light bearer (Matthew 5:15, MSG).3. You are made righteous. To be made the righteousness of God in Christ is not only for you to have right standing with God. To be made righteous is for you to reign as a king. Righteousness is the scepter of the Kingdom. (Hebrews 1:8).As many that receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life as Kings (Romans 5:17).Leadership is a core element of your newness of life. You are not called to live for yourself and to satisfy your own desires. You are called into Christ, given authority, to function as a Kingdom Leader, where you influence many unto divine purpose.
Beloved, you didn’t choose the Lord; He chose you and appointed you to go forth and bear fruit.
Live as one sent by God to lead His generation. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Matthew 5:13-16;Ezra 7:10; 1 Peter 2:9; Psalm 78:72; Romans 12:3-8) WE PRAYThat we will give ourselves wholly to whichever assignment or task the Lord has assigned unto us to lead our generation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 25-272 YEARS PLANNumbers 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been called to lead my generation. – I am conscious of this calling. – I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call. – I refuse to be distracted. – I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth. – Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement. – I am the centre of attraction in my generation. – I am a satisfaction to many. – I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 832 - DON'T MAKE EXCUSES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The Word of God works and does not fail. And the unfailing potency of the Word is demonstrated by UTTERANCE. You don’t work the Word by being silent, you work the Word by speaking. Beloved, don't be silent speak the word forth. Author Sunday, 4th May, 2025DON'T MAKE EXCUSES"I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus" Philippians 3:14 (KJV)Do you know why very few people are doing great things for God?Most people easily settle for less and also choose the easy path. Most people are not willing to share in the desire of the Lord. They live with the mantra:“Whatever will be, will be”. Therefore, there is no need to press on when things seem impossible.But that is not faith-living. Have you ever failed to do what you are instructed to do in Church, and do you think God understands that you failed? Or did you fail to act on the Word of God and think He still understands? Sometimes, even before you make that mistake or decide not to honour that instruction, you yield to the idea that God will understand your choice. Is it to comfort yourself for that wrong, or use that to affirm your excuses? How do you think God understands? And what do you mean by “God understands”? As in, God is ready to go against His Word and the governing light of His economy? There is nothing you can do in God without a bold step of faith. David didn’t automatically defeat Goliath. He has to take a bold step. Complacency has no space in the Kingdom. You have to press on to the price of high calling.
Whenever God entrust a target into your heart, you have to invest in prayer without excuses.
When you fail to pray, don’t make the excuse that, “Oh, though I have failed to pray, God understands my situation”. “Oh God understands if I don’t preach in the bus, or don’t win a soul in the school.” “God understands if I don’t excel in the workplace.” “There is always another time, if I failed today, I will get it right tomorrow, and God understands”. The more you think this way, the more you keep procrastinating.Yes, God understands, right? So you justify your failure and laziness with:“Don’t try too hard to complete the task you are expected to do, after all, you can’t do everything till you depart from Earth.” “Take it easy, God understands your situation. It is not by force to wake up early to pray or start your day with prayer.” “If you miss Church meetings, there is no harm; God understands”. “Just live your life and do what you feel you can do. God understands, and He will not kill you for not doing it.” “God knows your heart. What you are able to do and not able to do doesn’t really matter to God, but the condition of your heart.”Does God truly understand things the way we claim He understands?Does God water down His plans and assignments for us because of our situations or challenges? Does God even have standards, and does He uphold His standards? Some of these thoughts may seem justifiable, but understand that in as much as,GOD LOVES YOU, HE ESTEEMS HIS WORD, HIS PLANS AND PURPOSES.
God will not change His plans because of your excuses, challenges and situations.
God will not pause His eternal plan to wait for you to resolve your challenges. Though our walk with God is not mechanical but essentially organic, it is not without a well-established system. Don’t be quick to quote this: “This High Priest of ours understands our weaknesses…” Hebrews 4:15 (NLT) “For we do not have a high priest incapable of sympathizing with our weaknesses…” (NET Bible) And then arrive at this conclusion:“You see, there it goes, our High Priest sympathises with our weaknesses. Don’t trouble yourself, if you can you can, if you can’t you can’t.”“Everyone has a weakness and God understands.”Really? Is that the implication of this verse?Don’t be too quick to end there. Get this, the LORD TRULY understands our weaknesses! Glory to God.However, get it in perspective.“Inasmuch then as we [believers] have a great High Priest who has [already ascended and] passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession [of faith and cling tenaciously to our absolute trust in Him as Savior]. For we do not have a High Priest who is unable to sympathize and understand our weaknesses and temptations, but One who has been tempted [knowing exactly how it feels to be human] in every respect as we are, yet without [committing any] sin.Therefore let us [with privilege] approach the throne of grace [that is, the throne of God’s gracious favor] with confidence and without fear, so that we may receive mercy [for our failures] and find [His amazing] grace to help in time of need [an appropriate blessing, coming just at the right moment]. for he faced all of the same testings we do, yet he did not sin.” Hebrews 4:14-16 (AMP) SURE, contextually, this chapter has an extensive matters discussed than what we are looking into here. Nevertheless, the above verses provide the answer that puts our thoughts in the right perspective. Jesus being our High Priest:a. Sympathises and understands our weaknesses and temptations.b. He is able to sympathise and understand because He faced what we face as men.c. And He did not fail when He faced these temptations or challenges.d. He doesn’t just understand your weaknesses and failures, He also doesn’t want you to remain in that failure. He wants you to advance beyond the realm of that failure and weakness.c. He wants us to also enjoy the victory He had over all the things He faced.d. He didn’t just “correct” your failures, but supplies you with the richness of Himself for your living.e. He has made a provision for you to have limitless access to the rich supplies He had. He has given you limitless access to the throne of Grace. Not just GRACE but to the source and governing realm of GRACE for your continued supply and enjoyment of GRACE as much as you need or will take.f. Therefore, hold fast, cling tenaciously to Him in an absolute trust.Beloved, because God understands your weaknesses and incapabilities, He has provided or supplied you with all the grace and help you need for exercising yourself unto godliness.
Don’t settle for less with many excuses.
