The LORD’S DELIGHT IS THAT YOU LIVE THE FULLNESS OF THE LIFE HE HAS GIVEN YOU NOW.When it feels like you just can’t do it, don’t give up and don’t settle for less. PRESS ON! Be tenacious in the Lord, for He is YOUR STRENGTH.DON’T DO WHAT YOU CAN, DO WHAT GOD WANTS YOU TO DO BY TAKING ADVANTAGE OF GRACE.Press on! Enlarge the scope of your vision and desire. The extra mile is for those who dare to be EXTRA.YOU ARE SUPPLIED WITH ALL YOU NEED BY THE LORD.
You have the Holy Spirit in you for the EXTRAORDINARY, don’t make excuses.
Have the mindset of a KINGDOM CHAMPION. Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 9:24; Hebrews 3:1; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18; 1 Thessalonians 2:12) WE PRAYThat we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing to remain resolute in pressing on with any target or assignment He has committed to our trust. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 282 Chronicles 1-22 YEARS PLANNumbers 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling. – I don’t give excuses, I get the job done. – Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on. – I don’t stop halfway, I press on. – I go the extra mile. – I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord. – I do the extraordinary. – I am a Champion. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 833 - THERE IS NO SUCCESS IN PROCRASTINATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be a faithful steward of money. Don’t just use money only for your interests and the satisfaction of personal needs, which doesn’t benefit God’s kingdom plan. At the end of all things, you are going to make an account of how you serve God’s purpose with the resources He entrusted to you. Do Kingdom business with God’s resources. Selah. Author Monday, 5th May, 2025THERE IS NO SUCCESS IN PROCRASTINATION“Herald and preach the Word! Keep your sense of urgency [stand by, be at hand and ready], whether the opportunity seems to be favorable or unfavorable…”2 Timothy 4:2 (AMPC) Beloved, you can’t be a world changer or a global icon by mouth. In as much as what you confess is important to your success, you must understand that your choice of action will determine the extent to which you may lead your generation. Every great leader has a sense of urgency every day.
Consistent impact is born through a consistent routine.
It is not the Father’s will that you experience one-time success. He wants you to have daily success. To make a difference in your generation, take daily steps to make the dream of God in your heart a reality. You can’t be one who procrastinates, wastes or spends time on non-essentials or things that don’t directly contribute to your target and vision.
You have to be disciplined to work towards your goal.
Until you maintain a strong sense of urgency concerning your goals, you may not be disciplined, diligent and consistent. This is one of the great secrets to prosperity and greatness. Be prompt to do it! Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste. Procrastination is a destroyer of destiny and fulfilment. Laziness is the act of the poor. And being lazy and wasting time doesn’t mean you are doing nothing. You can spend time doing something which doesn’t contribute to your action plan. You have no sense of urgency when you spend time surfing the internet and watching funny clips when you should be praying.
Anything you do with your time must be an intentional step to contribute to your progress.
Refuse to be lazy. The lazy have no sense of urgency. They do things on their own time and not according to the standard of the assignment. Your routine must represent the level of greatness. ”The soul of a lazy man desires and has nothing, but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.” Proverbs 13:4 Don’t just desire or wish to be successful and great. Be diligent in working towards your greatness. ”Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.” Proverbs 12:24. Diligence with a sense of urgency is a characteristic of all prosperous leaders who lead and transform their generation.The Bible says that David rose early in the morning and went to the camp as his father had commanded. (1 Samuel 17:20).And Abraham got up early in the morning to do what the Lord had instructed (Genesis 22:3-4). You will find this sense of urgency, promptness and diligence with these great men in the scriptures. They knew their success was in how they urgently acted on the instructions they received.
There is no success in procrastination.
How urgent are you working towards your goals for today, for the week, for the month and the upcoming year? You can reach your target and maintain a sense of urgency!!! Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 2:6-7; Romans 12:11-12;Ecclesiastes 10:18; Proverbs 12:11; Proverbs 10:4-5; Deuteronomy 24:19) WE PRAYThat we will be enabled with the grace to be diligent in all that our hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 3-52 YEARS PLANNumbers 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Whatever the Lord requires me to do, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In giving, I give with a sense of urgency. – In soul winning, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In prayer and the study of the word, I do it with a sense of urgency. – I refuse to procrastinate. – I get the job done on time. – I get the results. – I diligently act on the word of God. – I make each day count. – I make daily progress and success. – Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof. – I win everyday. – I am not a waster of resources. – Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me. – I am a success. Hallelujah!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 834 - EVERY LEADER MUST LEARN TO FIGHT 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your emotions to lead you. Your emotion or the deep seat of your desire has been exposed to the corruptibility of the flesh before you got born again. This is why God is interested in the focus of your emotions or your heart’s delight. Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires. Selah. Author Tuesday, 6th May, 2025 EVERY LEADER MUST LEARN TO FIGHT 1"Afterwards, Jacob went back and spent the rest of the night alone. A man came and fought with Jacob until just before daybreak." Genesis 32:24 (CEV)Every man has the inherent potential to lead in any course they set for themselves. However, the born-again in Christ has the direct call of the Lord into His Kingdom leadership.The new creation in Christ is made a king and priest (Revelation 1:6, 1 Peter 2:9).This means every believer is designed and sent to lead in his or her sphere.  As mentioned in previous episodes, if you are born again, see yourself as a leader.To be a leader means you have an assignment to inspire, influence, and direct people toward God's agenda. Jesus Our Lord calls His disciples (which includes you) as the salt of the earth and the light of the world (Matthew 5:13-16).Which means you provide guidance, illumination and preservation of destinies. Destinies depend on you.As a leader, your life is not for your self-gratification but for divine glorification. The more you shine as a light in your sphere, men glorify God because of your impact.
As a leader, your decisions, choices, plans, actions, and results affect the lives of people in your sphere. 
Your failure is the failure of many. Your victory gives opportunity to many others to also experience a victorious life.This doesn't come by chance. There are many factors which may serve as a resistance or limitation, but you must be daring to exercise your victory.Thankfully, every born-again operates from the place of victory because of the victory of Christ.The victory of Jesus doesn't mean you will not face opposition and resistance.Paul the apostle referred to Epaphroditus as a brother, fellow worker and a fellow soldier (Philippians 2:25). He told Timothy to endure suffering along with him as a good soldier of Christ (2 Timothy 2:3).Why would Paul the apostle call you a soldier in Christ if there is nothing to fight for?During the final days of his ministry, Apostle Paul himself said, "I have fought a good fight" (2 Timothy 4:7).
So, a son of God in Christ, you are also a soldier of Christ.
There is no destiny which is fulfilled without a fight. This fight is not an ordinary fight. It is a fight of faith. The fulfilment of your destiny in Christ is the fulfilment of a purpose which is foreordained by God.If the adversary can prevent you from fulfilling your purpose, then he has attempted to disrupt a divine plot. And this also affects others whose destinies are connected to yours.Most believers assume that as long as they have entered the rest of Christ, there is nothing to fight for.There is a whole lot more to fight for; as believers, we fight from the place of rest or faith:-  to enforce our victory which we have obtained in Christ Jesus.- to liberate others from the power of darkness and to bring them into the light.- to cause the glory of God to manifest in our world.- to ensure that the Lord's vision is fulfilled in our sphere.As you can see from the opening verse, Jacob, who has the birthright and the blessing, had to still wrestle to enter the full manifestation of His blessedness as a nation.It was after he prevailed that he fully matured as a nation (corporate man). Until then, Jacob was just an individual man and a family man. He was not yet Israel, though he was the custodian of the blessings and promise of Abraham and Isaac.
No believer is called by God to live an ordinary life. Every believer is a custodian of a divine vision and mandate.
To expand the scope of your impact, you must learn to prevail. And if you want to prevail, you must learn to fight.Don't allow the challenges or limitations of your background to bully you. Don't bow to the systems of this world. Be a fighter.Don't allow anything to reduce you to ordinariness.You are not ordinary; you are of God. Therefore, don't live an ordinary life; live as a leading victorious soldier.David said, "The Lord trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze" (2 Samuel 22:35)Be a fighter.Learn to fight!Learn to prevail.Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 6:12; Hosea 12:3-4; Psalm 144:1; Psalm 18:34,39; Exodus 15:3) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall teach our hands to fight and to prevail as we pursue the fulfilment of His purpose in our generation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 6-82 YEARS PLANNumbers 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't live uto myself rather for God's divine glorification. - Many destinies depends on me and I will not fail, I fight till the end. - I will not stop my journey halfway, I fight till I reach my goal. - I am daring in exercing my victory. - I am a soldier of Christ and I fight. - I refuse to live an ordinary, I fight to enforce the victory of Christ in living an extraordinary life. - I am a fighter. - I prevail. - I refuse to allow anything to reduce me to ordinariness. - I am not ordinary, I am of God. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 835 - BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you can accomplish great things by the immeasurable grace of God. Have the Faith that God has supplied you with abundance of grace (ability, favor and earthly blessings) to do what He has ordained you to do. Glory to God Author Wednesday, 7th May, 2025 BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 1"And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck." Genesis 27:40 (KJV)After Jacob had received all his father's blessings, Esau returned to receive his father's blessings, and there was nothing left for him.After much tears and pleading, Isaac spoke these words over Esau:"And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck." Genesis 27:39-40 (KJV)Though Jacob has taken all the blessings and shall be lord over Esau, and Esau will also be a servant to Jacob, Isaac left Esau with a little window of hope."and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck"Isaac showed Esau how he can break the yoke of limitations or slavery:When you shall have the dominion.Very few people have focused on these words of Isaac to Esau.Obviously, Esau's decisions contributed to how he lost the blessing of the birthright. He technically traded his birthright as a firstborn for a single meal.Esau took the future for granted and focused on the present gratification. He lived carnally. The scriptures referred to him as godless because he sold his birthright.And the consequence was now to make him a slave to his brother.Esau lost the blessing and inheritance of his birthright. But now, to continue to live forever as a slave to his brother, it was up to the choices he was going to make.The word "dominion" in the phrase "...when you shall have the dominion" as used in the King James Translation is not the same Hebrew word "râdâh" (rule, subjugate, reign, tread down, overtake) as used in Genesis 1:26, 28.The word dominion used in Genesis 27:40 is from the Hebrew word "rûd", which means "to disconsolate".It speaks of a person becoming discomforted in a place or being restless in a way of thinking.Esau's past mistakes and choices had consequentially placed him in this position of slavery. His background and past have created a limitations for his future. But if only he shall awaken himself from anything keeping him in that position, he will have to break the yoke from his neck and live free.Esau had the choice to remain bitter, crushed, defeated, disappointed, and enslaved, or he would shake himself out of such a state to carve a path into blessings for himself.
And all that Esau needed to break free was to forgive and love Jacob.
Esau wasn't to live in the pain of the past. The more he envied and lived bitterly towards Jacob, the more he subjected himself to the yoke of his brother.Esau did forgive Jacob and continued to prosper, and they both flourished as well (Genesis 33:4-16). It was the descendants of Esau (Edomites) who continued in the foolishness of bitterness and envy of Israel (descendants of Jacob) that led to their destruction.However, the point basically is this: if even Esau had a way of escape from his past failure, much more you?Living in limitation and struggle is a choice. You have to make a decision to take advantage of the power and victory of Christ at work in you.He has supplied great faith into you so that you will walk in the reality of an overcomer.Don't settle for the limitations around you. Don't think according to your background or where you live. Don't make decisions according to how you feel.
Jesus came to break all limitations! And greater is He that is in you than He that is in the world.
Shake yourself from every yoke of the mind and of the heart. Live above all limitations.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXXfkBuNfgsDIG DEEPER(Luke 4:18; Psalm 147:5; Luke 21:15; 2 Corinthians 12:9) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to our destiny. But we shall live by the limitless ability of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 9-112 YEARS PLANNumbers 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to allow myself to settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to my destiny. - I live by the limitless ability of God. - I refuse to make decisions according to how I feel, I am led by the Lord. - I shake myself from every yoke of the mind and heart. - I live above all limitations. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 836 - BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When people see you, they must know you as a bearer of the gospel of peace; or as one who is always poised with the gospel of peace. How you live must be a practical evidence and announcement of our oneness with God. Selah. Author Thursday, 8th May, 2025 BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 2"For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God]." 1 John 5:4 (Amplified Bible)Beloved in Christ, it is not a mistake you are reading today's with .This is a special message to you.You have no reason to feel hopeless, tired and defeated.No matter the reasons you have, none of them surmount the victory which Christ has wrought for you.You may have the whole world against you, and all systems opposing your advancement, but none of them can surmount your faith in Christ Jesus.
No matter the limitations you may feel, see or experience around you, faith in Christ gives you the superior advantage.
What are the limitations you see in your pursuit of purpose?Do you think they are too big for you?Do you feel or think you are too small and lack the strength to prevail in life?Do you think your family setup and academic failures are limitations to your progress?Even Esau, who lost his birthright and blessings, had an opportunity to prevail. Read here.Do you even think you have wasted time and cannot achieve your dreams?See, Sarah, who was barren, old in years, and long past the age of childbearing, received strength to conceive a child. (Genesis 18:11; Hebrews 11:11).
Don't doubt the Lord!
And if you have ever doubted, today marks a new beginning. Don't think that because you doubted, there is no hope for you.Abraham laughed when he was first told he was going to give birth to a son."Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?” (Genesis 17:17)Sarah also laughed within herself, saying, "After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?" (Genesis 18:12).Their laughter was based on biological facts. Biologically or scientifically, both Abraham and Sarah have passed the stage of childbirth.Sarah, at 90, meant her reproductive system had entered and even gone beyond menopause.Menopause is a natural decline in reproductive hormones. At this stage, the ovaries stop releasing eggs for fertilisation (which is the loss of ovarian follicular function).When the menstrual cycles and egg production cease, natural pregnancy is impossible.Also, the uterus and other reproductive organs experience age-related changes that can make pregnancy more difficult or impossible.But amidst all these limitations, faith activated will cause the limitless word of God to prevail over every limitation."And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son." Genesis 18:13-14 (KJV)Oh glory!One powerful question which should be your faith for every challenge was what the Lord asked Abraham.IS ANYTHING TOO HARD FOR THE LORD?From then on, Abraham and Sarah chose to exercise themselves in the faith of God.Abraham, against hope, believed in hope that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken.Your set time to take the stand of faith is now. As you are born of God, live in the confidence of the faith of God.
As you are born of God, you have the faith to conquer and overcome the world (with its systems, limitations and oppositions).
By faith, Sarah prevailed over the limitations of childbearing in old age.Refuse to be limited!!!Don't settle for the limitations around you. Don't think according to your background or where you live. Don't make decisions according to how you feel.In Christ Jesus, there are no limitations. All limitations are mental illusions.Walk in the reality of the Word of God.Shake yourself from every yoke of the mind and of the heart. Live above all limitations.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXXfkBuNfgsDIG DEEPER(Romans 8:37; 1 Corinthians 15:57; Luke 4:18; Psalm 147:5; Luke 21:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall live above every limitation of the mind and of the heart. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 12-142 YEARS PLANNumbers 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow myself to settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to my destiny. – I live by the limitless ability of God. – I refuse to make decisions according to how I feel, I am led by the Lord. – I shake myself from every yoke of the mind and heart. – I live above all limitations. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 837 - BREAK FREE FROM LOW SELF-REGARD AND INSECURITIES 1 — BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency God sees you; no matter your guilt and shame; you are His son and He loves you with an everlasting love. Focus on the Love of the Father and not your imperfection. Hallelujah! Author Friday, 9th May, 2025 BREAK FREE FROM LOW SELF-REGARD AND INSECURITIES 1 — BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 3"For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God]." 1 John 5:4 (Amplified Bible)Sarah conquered and overcame biological limitations by faith in God.Laughter of doubt was her initial response to the message of the Lord that she was going to give birth to a son. Even her husband Abraham had that same response."Then Abraham bowed down to the ground, but he laughed to himself in disbelief. “How could I become a father at the age of 100?” he thought. “And how can Sarah have a baby when she is ninety years old?” (Genesis 17:17)But the Lord brought them to the consciousness of His power.He asked them, "Is anything too hard for the Lord?..." (Genesis 18:14).Is your answer "yes" to the above question?I doubt you will even think that way.Nothing is too hard for the Lord.This gives you the advantage.The initial response of Abraham and Sarah wasn’t just based on doubt, but the display of their self-doubt, low self-regard or low self-esteem and insecurities. Their laughter was the voice of their low self-esteem and insecurities. These are also limitations to greatness.
Low self-esteem, self-regard, and insecurities have limited people from receiving and enjoying their blessings.
Are you struggling with low self-esteem?Has that also become your limitation?Faith is your way out of that limitation. People don't think low self-esteem is a limitation. They think that's how they are and their way of adjusting to society. No one is born with low self-esteem. People are cultured into that state of mind.Break free from it!You are reading this now, and you are really struggling with low self-esteem or low self-regard and insecurities. These have influenced you not to dare to step into your purpose and calling. It makes you undermine your potential and prefer to hide or dim your light.Because of your sense of insecurity, you are afraid to be corrected. You take every correction as an attack. You are afraid to make mistakes because of the thoughts of others. And how you were a target of bullying and mockery. You are not growing into the best version of yourself because you are scared to be in the limelight. You live caged and reduced, yet cry for liberation in your soul and don't know how!You feel intimidated when you meet others doing great things. All you do in secret is to cry, cuddle the feeling of worthlessness, nurture envy whenever you see what others are achieving.Do you know you increase your low self-regard and insecurities as you continue to think and live that way?
Low self-regard and insecurities are proof that you have not allowed the Word of God to influence your heart, thus, you are not living by faith.
You may not be the one responsible for the development of that low self-esteem, but it is your responsibility to continue in it or to step out of it.Make a decision that you are going to live free from these projectiles of darkness.Maybe growing up as a child:- you were ridiculed by almost everyone.- you didn't receive love, affection, family warmth and positive affirmations.- you were traumatised, abused and neglected. - you couldn't fit into your sphere, or the circles you found yourself and were bullied by your peers.- you were constantly criticised and compared to others.- poor academic performance from early childhood education to basic school.Even Now:- you experience poor academic performance and poor work performance.- you feel isolated by society.- you are always criticised by others, including family, friends, employers and mentors.Maybe you are even struggling with:- abusive relationships- not meeting expectations- societal pressures- social media "troll" and comparison- stage fright, anxiety or fear and chronic stress.These things erode self-regard or self-esteem and induce a sense of inner worthlessness. It leads to a feeling of inadequacy. It amplifies mental disorders.
Instead of allowing yourself to be continuously brandished and decimated or pulverised by these experiences, take a stand on the word of God.
The word of God builds you up as an edifice and makes you rise above these inner limitations by faith.Faith is living out the dominion of light. And faith is produced in you through the revelational light of the Word.When the light of the Word shone in the heart of Abraham and Sarah, they rose from the mental limitation of barrenness into the possibility of becoming the source of many nations.Make a decision today that you are going to break free from every limitation.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXXfkBuNfgsDIG DEEPER(Romans 8:37; 2 Corinthians 12:9; Ephesians 3:12; Psalm 27:3; Hebrews 13:6; Joshua 1:9) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall boldly set our minds on the revelation of the word of God, so that we will live fully liberated from all negative feelings of worthlessness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 15-172 YEARS PLANNumbers 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow myself to settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to my destiny. – I live by the limitless ability of God. – I refuse to make decisions according to how I feel, I am led by the Lord. – I shake myself from every yoke of the mind and heart. – I live above all limitations. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 838 - BREAK FREE FROM LOW SELF-REGARD AND INSECURITIES 2 — BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot impact your sphere, when you don’t see the people as God sees them. You will deal with people based on your assumptions and history with them when you don’t see the best in them. Deal with people based on what the Holy Spirit wants to produce in them. Selah! Author Saturday, 10th May, 2025 BREAK FREE FROM LOW SELF-REGARD AND INSECURITIES 2 — BREAK FREE FROM ALL LIMITATIONS 4"For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God]." 1 John 5:4 (Amplified Bible)Low self-esteem or self-regard and insecurities have limited people from walking into the fulfilment of their purpose.As I mentioned previously, faith is your way out of that limitation. Remember, faith operates by the revelational light of the Word of God.While talking about the "heroes of faith", the author of the book of Hebrews mentioned Gideon."How much more do I need to say? It would take too long to recount the stories of the faith of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and all the prophets." Hebrews 11:32 (NLT)To have Gideon's name among "heroes of faith" is an evidence that you are only celebrated and remembered for your victory and not your limitations.No one will celebrate your insecurities and low self-regard.No one will remember you for feeling worthless. Without God's intervention, Gideon would have remained subjugated by his mental limitations. And Israel wouldn't have experienced him as a great leader and deliverer.
Until you stop the self-pity party, destinies are going to be destroyed.
Awakening from the "worthlessness" feelings will make you a blessing to many.Gideon did struggle with an inferiority complex. He defined himself by his family status. He struggled with insecurity, self-doubt, and worthlessness.When God came to him, He referred to him as "...a mighty man of valor".His trauma, self-doubt, low self-regard and the fear of the Midianites made him question even the thought that God was with the Israelites. Gideon also doubted that he was a mighty man.While the Lord saw him as a mighty man of valor, a man of great strength to save or deliver Israel, he saw himself as insignificant."But Gideon said to Him, “Please Lord, how am I to rescue Israel? Behold, my family is the least [significant] in Manasseh, and I am the youngest (smallest) in my father’s house.” Judges 6:15 (Amplified Bible)This Gideon, who disregarded himself, felt to be the weakest among the weak (considering his family background), irrelevant, insignificant and worthless to lead Israel, became a hero of faith. Even his faith became a testimony for those of the New Testament (and generations yet unborn).Gideon would have remained worthless if he had not yielded to the word of the Lord.
It is not how you feel about yourself, it is what God says about you.
The word of God is the mirror of God, which brings you to the knowledge of your true self.Gideon was able to break free from his insecurities and low self-regard because of the revelational light of God.Don't think you are the first to have self-doubt. You have seen Abraham and Sarah, and also Gideon. Even Jeremiah the Prophet had insecurities. Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.…" Jeremiah 1:6-8 (Berean Study Bible)Moses doubted his eloquence to speak before Pharaoh. He disregarded himself because he was slow of speech and tongue. (Exodus 4:10-12). Later, when he submitted his thoughts to the word of the Lord, he led Israel out of captivity.
