No matter the insecurities, the doubts and the weakness you feel, this is what the Lord is saying to you: "My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” (2 Corinthians 12:9).Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Exodus 3:11-12; Exodus 4:10-13; Isaiah 41:14; 1 Samuel 9:21; Genesis 32:10; 1 Corinthians 15:9; 1 Corinthians 1:27-29) WE PRAYWe pray that the sufficiency of God's superabounding grace shall strengthen and perfect our weaknesses. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 18-20 2 YEARS PLANNumbers 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow myself to settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to my destiny. – I live by the limitless ability of God. – I refuse to make decisions according to how I feel, I am led by the Lord. – I shake myself from every yoke of the mind and heart. – I live above all limitations. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 839 - HONOUR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To lead your generation you must see the best of Hope in people. When you start seeing the best of God in others, you will go to every extent to bring out the beauty you see in them. Dearly beloved Leader, learn to see the best in people. Author Sunday, 11th May, 2025 HONOUR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER"Honour thy father and mother,” which is the first commandment with promise" Ephesians 6:2 (KJV)As part of the many commandments God gave His people, He specifically commanded that they honour their fathers and mothers.
It was the first commandment which had a blessing directly connected to it.
"Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee." Exodus 20:12 (KJV)Get this, God transmitted the gift of life and gave you the opportunity to exist through the union of your father and mother. Without them (whether by intention or mistake), you wouldn't have entered time.Honouring your father and mother is not a mere regulation but a principle of wisdom that gives you an advantage for a long life.It wasn't a commandment scripted by fathers and mothers to bully their children. It is an age-long commandment designed by God to give children an advantage or a long life. And it remains relevant with its blessings even today.
One of the key things to do to lengthen your days in time is to honour your father and mother.
This commandment is a cheat code for long life. And those who take heed to it shall enjoy the satisfaction thereof.This commandment doesn't come with any "if clause". The Lord did not say honour your father and mother, if they are born again or "Christians".He didn't say honour your father and mother, if they are rich or wealthy and popular.He didn't say honour your father and mother, if only they always agree with you and do your bidding.The Lord didn't say honour father and mother if they are not wicked or ungodly.The matter of honouring your father and mother is constant, irrespective of what or who they are.To honour is also not the same as to obey. To obey your parents is to carry out their instructions. However, in the order of hierarchy, it is always important to obey the Lord first. Thus, in obeying your parents, you don't just do anything at all, which wouldn't bring glory and praise to God.And if you are to obey the Lord first, then you must diligently and intentionally honour your parents because it is a command of God which you must obey!When it comes to honouring your parents, there are no exemptions.
The commandment is to HONOUR YOUR FATHER AND MOTHER...
You have to honour your father and mother irrespective of your age, beliefs or religiousity, social status, and class. It doesn't matter whether you are 50 years, 30 years, 80 years, or one with many children, you must still honour your father and mother.This demonstration of honour brings harmony and peace within the family set up.Your father and mother may not only be biological, but also those who nurtured you to advance or flourish in age and gave meaning to your existence.These kinds of fathers and mothers are life-sustainers and God's investments.
To honour is to value as precious.
Read the opening verse in the Amplified Bible:"HONOR [esteem, value as precious] YOUR FATHER AND YOUR MOTHER [and be respectful to them]—this is the first commandment with a promise" Ephesians 6:2 (Amplified Bible)How do you esteem your father and mother?How do you value your father and mother?How do you care for your father and mother?How precious are they to you?How do you make them enjoy the satisfaction of life?Do you speak evil of them?Do you give the opportunity for others to disrespect and dishonour them?
Go to every extent to make them feel honoured.
Until you learn to esteem your father and mother, you have not yet proven yourself to be wise.Selah.(NOTE: PLEASE READ ALL THE DIG DEEPER SCRIPTURES)https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Mark 7:10; Matthew 19:19; Leviticus 19:3; Proverbs 23:22; Proverbs 20:20; Deuteronomy 5:16) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall exercise ourselves in the wisdom of honouring our fathers and mothers. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 21-232 YEARS PLANNumbers 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in honour towards my Father and Mother. - I go every extent to honour my parents. - I am a person of honour. - I refuse to keep malice, bitterness or hate in my heart towards my parents. - I walk in love towards them and I honour them genuinely. - I refuse to give anyone the opportunity to dishounour them. Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 840 - ARE YOU ASHAMED OF THE GOSPEL OF CHRIST?
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency What will be your testimony at the climax of your days here on earth? What will be said of you in that city, institution, or nation? Will it be said that you served the purpose of God in your time in that school, that company, that institution and that city? Selah. Author Monday, 12th May, 2025 ARE YOU ASHAMED OF THE GOSPEL OF CHRIST?"For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God to salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first and also for the Greek." Romans 1:16 (NKJV) The gospel is not a religious declaration. The term “gospel” itself has become a common usage in the Church and the world at large. Some see it as an “act of preaching”.  In that sense, when one makes any statement or writes a song with “Jesus, or God”, most refer to it as “Gospel”. However, the term “gospel” is not just to preach but essentially the content preached. A message preached is not necessarily the gospel. “Gospel” in Greek is “euangelion”, originally denoted as a reward for good tidings. Later, the idea of reward dropped, and the word stood for “THE GOOD NEWS”. Thus, gospel means “good tidings” or “good message”.The Gospel of Grace is good news, which unfolds God’s eternal plan of becoming one with man, in life and nature. And man becomes His very expression without any limitation. It is the complete package of God’s grand design to dispense Himself into all things, fill all in all and gather all things into Himself through Christ. This gospel is not an afterthought; it was the original plan of God, which was concealed in Him before time began.Now it has been revealed or unfolded to us. This Gospel of Grace is the mystery of God demystified, which is Christ in you. Having access to this unfolded glorious message of grace, we have to testify, shout it, announce it, share it, preach it and sing it.We have the responsibility to make all men hear about this Goodnews. God wants all people to know this truth, which is Christ Jesus. When Paul the apostle wrote about not being ashamed of the gospel, he wasn’t just talking about the “act of preaching”; he was basically talking about the content of the message. Some people preach, but are ashamed to preach the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ. Some think that when they preach the gospel, people will continue in error. But from the opening verse, Paul said, the gospel of Christ is the power of God unto Salvation. (Romans 1:16). Which means, people can only experience Salvation only by the preaching of the gospel of our Lord Jesus. Preaching the gospel is not necessarily a message with the name of God. When someone is reading and talking about verses from the Bible, it doesn’t mean he is preaching the gospel.Beloved, there are no two gospels. The Gospel is ONE, and it’s the GOODNEWS of Our Lord Jesus. The content and the essence of the Gospel is CHRIST.This is the ONLY message entrusted to us.This Gospel is completely balanced. It does not need any supplements. It is the foundation of all teachings, prophecies and the manner of life or conduct of the saints in Christ. Paul (the apostle of Jesus) in his epistle to the Galatians was not sentimental about this reality. He sharply and clearly established the divine thought on this matter of the gospel when he noticed how the brethren were drifting away. They were beginning to take heed to other teachings apart from this Gospel of Christ: “I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel— not that there is another one, but there are some who trouble you and want to distort the gospel of Christ. But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed. As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed.” Galatians 1:6-9 (ESV) To preach another gospel is not just the message that says, “Jesus is not God”, not just the belief that “There’s no God”.To preach another gospel is to preach and teach:– anything with the impression that the finished work of Christ is incomplete.– any message that takes the focus of the brethren away from Christ. And promotes “the self”, is not the Gospel.– any message that promotes dead works.A message that makes people feel they have to “do something to earn something” from God, including His love, is not the Gospel.– Any message like “Heaven help those who help themselves” is not the gospel. Christ came for the helpless.– The Gospel is not “do good for good”. Through the Gospel, we receive and enjoy God’s goodness.– Any message which does not point you to Righteousness by Faith in Christ is not the gospel– Any message that makes you feel you have to work hard to maintain, manage, preserve and keep your Salvation is not the gospel. Your salvation is eternal.Beloved, the preaching of the gospel is not that Jesus justified fornication, envy, adultery, robbery, killing and any evil acts.Well, He didn’t even come to justify the good things you do.Jesus came to JUSTIFY YOU. To be justified is to be declared not guilty! It’s the declaration that in Him you are righteous.This is the GOSPEL OF CHRIST! Preach with all audaciousness and strong conviction. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_--SnHZsxbQDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 15:1-11, 2 Corinthians 5:17-19, 2 Corinthians 11:1-4, Galatians 3:1-14;Ephesians 2:8-9; Romans 1:16-17; Galatians 1:6-9; Galatians 2:16; 2 Timothy 1:7-10; Colossians 1:21-29; Ephesians 1:1- 12) WE PRAYThat we will grow in the knowledge of the gospel and demonstrate the boldness of the Spirit in preaching the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 24-262 YEARS PLANNumbers 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ.– I am righteous by faith in Christ.– My salvation is eternal.– I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus. – I preach the gospel of Christ with boldness.– I give no room for any other gospel.– I grow in the overflowing understanding of the gospel.– I tell everyone about this glorious gospel.– I testify of the gospel.– My life is a glorious testimony of the gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 841 - UNDERSTANDING THE GOSPEL 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t give room for pride, don’t allow the adversary to push you away from your blessed life. Set your eyes on the Lord. Your season of abundance is here! Author Tuesday, 13th May, 2025 UNDERSTANDING THE GOSPEL 1“Paul, a bond-servant of Christ Jesus, called as an apostle (special messenger, personally chosen representative), set apart for [preaching] the gospel of God [the good news of salvation]" Romans 1:1 (Amplified Bible)There is nothing like the newness of life ( or "Christianity") without the gospel of Jesus.From the previous episode of with , I explained that the word gospel simply means good news or good message or good tidings. When you see the expression, the gospel of Jesus Christ (Mark 1:1) or the Gospel of God (Romans 1:1), they simply mean the Goodnews of Jesus Christ or the Goodnews of God. These are not two different things; they mean the same thing.
Some also claim that the Gospel of Jesus Christ is the same as the Gospel of the Kingdom, but not the same as the Gospel of the Grace of God.
They assume Jesus in His earthly walk did not preach the Gospel (Goodnews) of Grace, but rather preached the Gospel (Goodnews) of the Kingdom of God.They built their argument on:"And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease among the people." Matthew 4:23 (NKJV)It is clear most people don't understand the Gospel (Goodnews) of our Lord Jesus.Don't be confused, the Gospel of Jesus, the Gospel of Grace, the Gospel of God and the Gospel of the Kingdom of God are the same GOODNEWS. They don't mean anything different.God's Kingdom is not separated from God. Jesus is the express image of the invisible God (Colossians1:15). He is also the embodiment of the fullness of Grace  (John 1:14) and the embodiment of the Kingdom (Romans 14:17).
The Goodnews of the Kingdom, or the Goodnews (Gospel) of Grace or the Gospel of God, is that God has demonstrated His love towards mankind by the full revelation of His saving plan for man, through Jesus Christ (2 Timothy 1:9-10).
Through the sin of unbelief, man became corrupted, was legally condemned, and eternally separated from God. However, God, who is rich in mercy, manifested His loving kindness through Christ Jesus. He came to suffer and die for the offence of mankind, and was resurrected to justify all who shall believe in Him. Thus, as many as believe in Him shall be delivered from condemnation, be justified (not by their own works) and become partakers of God's eternal life and the inheritance of His Kingdom (Colossians 1:12-13).The Gospel of Jesus (or the Gospel of Grace) is that you are saved by grace through faith in Jesus and His finished work of His painful death and His glorious resurrection (Ephesians 2:8-9). This is the goodnews of Jesus or the Gospel of Grace.- Some assume that the Gospel of Grace is only to usher you into "christianity", but it takes a different message to finish.- Some also accept that they are saved by Grace, but cannot stay saved by grace. They remain saved by their own self-efforts and not by grace. To them, the means by which they got saved is not the same means they must remain saved.- They think the Gospel of Grace leads men to salvation, and the Gospel of the Kingdom is what keeps men in salvation and brings men into attaining great heights in Christ.
What they fail to understand is that anyone saved by grace is also kept or sustained by grace.
"As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him" Colossians 2:6 (NKJV)There are others also who claim that no man is saved by grace alone. They are saved by grace and works. Which means their salvation is not complete by the finished work of Jesus, but by their own efforts. When you ask such a person, "Are you saved?", he will say, "I am not saved yet; it is at the end of my life that I will know, because my works will determine my salvation".These people are only ignorant of the reality of the gospel of Jesus.
To think that you are not saved by the grace of Jesus alone but also by your works means that you are saved by both Jesus and your name.
That is contrary to the reality of the scriptures."This Jesus is the STONE WHICH WAS DESPISED and REJECTED by you, THE BUILDERS, but WHICH BECAME THE CHIEF CORNERSTONE. And there is salvation in no one else; for there is no other name under heaven that has been given among people by which we must be saved [for God has provided the world no alternative for salvation].” Acts 4:11-12 (Amplified Bible)Any salvation outside Jesus and what God has provided through Him is not salvation at all. If men can be saved by their own efforts, then Jesus wouldn't have come to die.This was Paul the apostle's response to those who felt they had to use their self-efforts to finish or complete salvation:"Your new life in the Anointed One began with the Holy Spirit giving you a new birth. Why then would you so foolishly turn from living in the Spirit by trying to finish by your own works?"Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Mattew 9:35; Romans 16:25; 5:1-2; Titus 3:5-7; Galatians 2:16) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the understanding of the glorious gospel of our Lord Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 27-292 YEARS PLANNumbers 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow in the understanding of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.– I am saved by grace through through faith in Jesus and His finished work.– I am kept and sustained by grace.– I am saved absolutely by the grace of Jesus.– My salvation is eternal.– I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus.– I give no room for any other gospel.– I grow in the overflowing understanding of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.– I tell everyone about this glorious gospel.– My life is a glorious testimony of the gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 842 - UNDERSTANDING THE GOSPEL 2 — THE COMMUNICATION OF GOD'S ETERNAL INTENTION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When we gather as saints, the Lord inspires deep spiritual rhythms in the heart of the congregation and we minister unto Him and also to one another. Beloved, don’t miss any moment to join a gathering where all saints are ministering in the oneness of heart to the Lord. Let your voice be heard in the rhythms of the just men. Selah. Author Wednesday, 14th May, 2025 UNDERSTANDING THE GOSPEL 2 — THE COMMUNICATION OF GOD'S ETERNAL INTENTION“Paul, a bond-servant of Christ Jesus, called as an apostle (special messenger, personally chosen representative), set apart for [preaching] the gospel of God [the good news of salvation]" Romans 1:1 (Amplified Bible)The gospel is the foundational revelation of God's thoughts.This gospel is the explanation of God's intention, plans, purpose and strategy.Every truth of God is built on the Gospel.
Any revelation which is not consistent with the Gospel is not consistent with God.
God is good (Psalm 100:5) and all that He does can only be good (1 Timothy 4:4). Therefore, any news which comes out of Him is GOODNEWS!The Gospel is the explanation of God's mindset and character. It is the articulation of God's love and the expression of His truth.The reality of God was communicated as a mystery from the foundation of times.  And was announced plainly at the appearing of our Lord Jesus. Thus, the Gospel is not just an announcement of what the Lord has done, but also the demystification of God's eternal truth. "[It is that purpose and grace] which He now has made known and has fully disclosed and made real [to us] through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, Who annulled death and made it of no effect and brought life and immortality (immunity from eternal death) to light through the Gospel." 2 Timothy 1:10 (Amplified Classics)The content of the Gospel is an age-long truth. It is the truth which has been in God from the eternal past and not a new trend.The reality of the Gospel is as old as God's intentions. The intentions of God are as old as Himself.It is ETERNAL!!!
This Gospel shall never expire!
That is why you don't treat it as one of the messages. It is not the message to be preached just at evangelistic meetings or crusades. It is not a message to be preached at Easter Conventions. The Gospel is not only about the sufferings of Christ, His death and His Glorious resurrection. The Gospel includes the impact, effect, and results of the resurrection of Jesus. It is the packaged news of all that God has conceptualised from "eternal past", wrought in time and harvested in "eternal future". It is the unravelling of our precious inheritance in His Kingdom.The Gospel is JESUS!"For the gospel is all about God’s Son. As a man he descended from David’s royal lineage,  but as the mighty Son of God he was raised from the dead and miraculously set apart with a display of triumphant power supplied by the Spirit of Holiness. And now Jesus is our Lord and our Messiah" Romans 1:3-4 (TPT)He is the declaration of the unsearchable riches of God's wisdom and the limitlessness of His power.God is the first preacher of the Gospel. He preached the Gospel through His handiwork in creation. (Psalm 19:1-2).
The imprints of His glory in creation are proofs of His majestic graciousness.
Even after the adversary in Genesis 3 attempted to corrupt God's creation, God announced His good news, saying, "the seed of the woman shall crush the head of the serpent..." (Genesis 3:15)The Lord God called out to Abraham and preached the Gospel to him.God foretold the Gospel to Abraham (Galatians 3:8), that he might know His ultimate intention.Even in the days of Noah, God presented the Gospel to him through the building of the ark.Listen to my teaching on Noah's ark.The sacrifices, offerings, ceremonies or festivals, blessings, Prophecies, and etc, were testimonies of the glorious news of God. God was preaching the gospel or announcing His good news all throughout the scriptures.God announced His intention even before the appearing of Jesus. So all the utterances of God in the scriptures (Old Testament portion of the Bible) pointed to the appearing of Christ. When Christ came, the goodnews of God was fully manifested.
The intentions of God have been unveiled through Christ.
Now any message preached or proclaimed as the Gospel is to enlighten and culture the saints to walk in the manifestation and fulfilment of God's eternal intention.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Romans 16:25; Romans 1:1- 6; Galatians 1:3-10; Acts 13:32-33; Hebrews 1:1-2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow in the understanding of the glorious gospel of our Lord Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 30-322 YEARS PLANNumbers 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow in the understanding of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.– I am saved by grace through through faith in Jesus and His finished work.– I am kept and sustained by grace.– I am saved absolutely by the grace of Jesus.– My salvation is eternal.– I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus.– I give no room for any other gospel.– I grow in the overflowing understanding of the gospel of our Lord Jesus.– I tell everyone about this glorious gospel.– My life is a glorious testimony of the gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 843 - UNDERSTANDING THE GOSPEL 3 - THE GOSPEL IS THE REVELATION OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency A man of faith has an awareness of the facts but doesn’t allow the power of the facts to rule over him. As you now walk in the word by faith, you no longer accept the facts. You continue confidently in the word of God. Beloved, live above the facts by faith. Hallelujah! Author Thursday, 15th May, 2025 UNDERSTANDING THE GOSPEL 3 - THE GOSPEL IS THE REVELATION OF JESUS“For the gospel is all about God’s Son..." Romans 1:3 (TPT)As I have explained in previous posts, the gospel is Jesus and all that He attained for the saints.God's present message or news to the world is revealed through Jesus.
All of God's glorious message is fully fulfilled and expressed through our Lord Jesus.
The appearing of Jesus, is the fulfilment of the scriptures concerning God's saving plan and the expression of His Kingdom inheritance.All that God declared through the scriptures were testimonies of Jesus. They all pointed to His appearing (John 5:39). Now in God's eternal plan there is nothing which will manifest without being founded on the revelation of Jesus.Whiles Paul and Barnabas were ministering to the Jews and non-Jews in Antioch, they patiently pointed out God's prophetic dealings with the Israelites, and how that now Jesus is the fulfilment of the Prophecies of the scriptures."So here we are to share with you some wonderful news! The promise God made to our forefathers has now been fulfilled for us, their children. For God has raised Jesus from the dead, as it says in Psalms: ‘Today I reveal you as my Son, and I as your Father." Acts 13:32-33 (TPT)
There is no good news above God's news. And our Lord Jesus is the goodnews of God to the world.
This is exactly what the Angel who announced the birth of our Lord Jesus, said to the shepherds."In that country there were shepherds lying in the open fields, taking their turns to watch the stock in the night; when all of a sudden an angel of the Lord appear'd to them, and a heavenly light shone about them, at which they were greatly affrighted. but the angel said to them, be not afraid, I am only come to bring you great news, which will be matter of joy to you and to the whole world. for the Lord Messiah your saviour is this day born, in the city of David" Luke 2:8-11 (Mace New Testament)The birth of Jesus was a proclamation of great joy to the whole universe (see Aramaic Bible in Plain English).It was a goodnews or good tidings to all people everywhere.The gospel of our Lord is a news of hope and joy. The gospel of our Lord Jesus is not a message of doom and destruction. It is the news of God's deliverance and salvation to those who believe.It is the goodnews of God's peace, His goodness and loving kindness.
Until you grow in the knowldge of the gospel of our Lord Jesus, you will not walk in total victory.
The gospel is not a message which points to your self efforts or attempts and struggle to obey the law of Moses. The gospel is the revelation of Jesus and the salvation which He brings to mankind through Him.The gospel does not point you to your weakness, failures and defeats. The gospel is the proclamation of Jesus and all He has accomplished for you. Whenever the gospel is preached you see Jesus in His glory.Are you hearing the Gospel (Goodnews) of Jesus or you are hearing other news which are not consistent with the revelation of Jesus?Set your mind on the revelation of Jesus which establishes you in the satisfaction of peace.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 12:2;  Romans 16:25; Romans 1:1- 6; Galatians 1:3-10; Acts 13:32-33; Hebrews 1:1-2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be enlightened with the Gospel of our Lord Jesus that we can enjoy the inheritance we have in the Kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 33-352 YEARS PLANNumbers 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I set my mind on the revelation of Jesus which establishes me in the satisfaction of peace. - I don't give my attention to any other news which is not consistent with the revelation of Jesus. - I grow in the understanding of the gospel. - Through the rich understanding of the gospel, I walk in total victory everyday.- I tell everyone about this glorious gospel.- My life is a glorious testimony of the gospel.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 844 - THE GOSPEL TRANSFORMS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you make time to speak to God, He will show you things you do not know. As a result, making time to pray and ministering unto the Lord cannot be overemphasised. Selah. Author Friday, 16th May, 2025 THE GOSPEL TRANSFORMS"For I am not ashamed of this Good News about Christ. It is the power of God at work, saving everyone who believes—the Jew first and also the Gentile" Romans 1:16 (NLT) It is not any message at all that brings salvation.Salvation is in the gospel of Jesus. When you see and hear the evil and the wrongs going on with people in this generation, you may be tempted to think it is the preaching of condemnation, which will get people saved from their evil ways.
Telling people how wrong and evil they are is not what brings salvation.
This is not to say, you may not have to help people realise their wrongs and their need for salvation. There are people whose eyes have been blinded, and they easily justify and defend their wrongs and evil ways. Truly, Jesus did not justify any wrongs. Jesus made justification available for all men who believe.  However, you need to get this, the message which brings salvation is not the declaration of the wrongs of people. The message which brings true Salvation is not telling people about the horror of hell. Nobody has to receive Jesus on the grounds of fear. He came to bring Salvation on the grounds of love (John 3:16).The gospel is not the declaration of the wrongs you see.The gospel (goodnews) is what God has done for us through Christ Jesus. I heard someone tell another fellow concerning the preaching of the gospel.And was like, “it is not about the message you preach, it is how you get someone saved by all means.”No, that is wrong.Beloved in Christ, the Lord did not just give us the ministry of reconciliation; He also gave the message of reconciliation. "Now all things are of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given us the ministry of reconciliation, that is, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and has committed to us the word of reconciliation “. 2 Corinthians 5:18-19 (NKJV) Alright, see how 2 Corinthians 5:18-19 is presented in the Living Bible:"All these new things are from God who brought us back to himself through what Christ Jesus did. And God has given us the privilege of urging everyone to come into his favor and be reconciled to him. For God was in Christ, restoring the world to himself, no longer counting men’s sins against them but blotting them out. This is the wonderful message he has given us to tell others.” You didn’t come into a relationship with God or experience Sonship in Christ, by your self efforts. 
You were not saved by your self-efforts or what you did by the works of legalism.
It was what Jesus did in His death and resurrection that got you saved. He died as the lamb of God for the forgiveness of your sins. The message is Christ and His work through His death and resurrection. (Read more on this from previous episodes) The gospel is the light of the knowledge of God in the face of Jesus. Why then do you proclaim darkness if men are yearning and are in need of LIGHT? The gospel is the reality of Jesus whom we preach. Preaching and teaching the goodnews of Jesus is the ministry of Righteousness. It points men to JESUS and not to their defeated and beaten past and corruptibility. The ministry of condemnation points men to their weaknesses.
It is more revealing and life-transforming to preach Christ than to preach the crisis of the now.
When you come to the true knowledge of the gospel of Christ and your mind is saturated with the grace of God, you will live right. Right living is the product of the reality of Christ’s goodnews in your heart. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Romans 2:3-4; Romans 1:15-17; Luke 2:10-11; 1 Corinthians 2:1-2) WE PRAYThat doors shall be opened for the teaching and preaching of the transforming power of the gospel in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles 36Ezra 1-22 YEARS PLANNumbers 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I experience the transforming power of the gospel. – I walk in the consciousness of all that Christ achieved for me. – I boast in the finished work of Christ on the cross and not in my self-efforts. – The gospel of Jesus spreads through me. – I make the goodnews of Jesus my focus. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 845 - YOUR CUP WILL NEVER RUN DRY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Precious one, PRAYER CHANGES YOU! The glory of God in you is revealed as you spend time in prayer. Your consistent prayer life is a threat to the devil. The devil is more scared of what prayer will do to you than the answers you will receive. Selah. Author Saturday, 17th May, 2025YOUR CUP WILL NEVER RUN DRY“You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.”Psalm 23:5 (NKJV)The anointing brings healing and comfort to your wounds. To be anointed is to be consecrated by God for His divine purposes and protection.The anointing of the Lord upon you is a demonstration of how much He values and honours you.The quality of oil your host pours on you reveals the degree of value he places on you.Our Lord anointed you with His Spirit. The anointing of the Holy Spirit is the immeasurable quality of the Spirit dispensed into you. 
The anointing is not only poured on you; it is also transfused into you as a divine quality.
This makes your life a rich, anointed life for the glory of the Lord.I don’t know how you see yourself, precious one in Christ. However, from the day you believed in Jesus and received the Holy Spirit into you, you received a gushing fountain, which springs up as life. It is not only designed to nourish you, but to make you a fountain to nourish others.Your cup is too small to contain all that the Lord has poured into you. And you know what?He is not stopping, THE LORD KEEPS POURING MORE!It is a gushing fountain overflowing into every aspect of your life, and to nourish the multitudesGlory to God!The reality is that whatever the Lord serves you with, He serves it superabundantly. One may think it is wrong to say Our Lord serves. He is King, and we must serve Him. That is the irony here. Our Lord is not the King who demands service. He serves you, and any service you may render to Him, He does it with you. For without Him, you can do nothing. (John 15:5).“For even the Son of Man did not come expecting to be served by everyone, but to serve everyone, and to give his life as the ransom price in exchange for the salvation of many.” Mark 10:45 (TPT).
The Lord serves you with His best. 
Whatever He serves you with dispenses the life (which has an eternal value) into you. He gives water, and it becomes a gushing fountain of the Holy Spirit, springing up and flooding you with endless life!The term or word “Cup” in Psalm 23:5 has been given several meanings. Considering the various figurative meanings of “Cup” throughout scriptures.This word is used in scriptures both figuratively and literally. Literally, it is a usual cup (either of horn or some precious metal); it is used for drinking during meals or ceremonies. It is used during a family or a solemn, sacred meal.At such sacramental meals, the head or father of the family pronounced certain blessings over the cup. That makes the cup a cup of blessing. Depending on the pronouncement made over the cup (These cups are mostly filled with wine). After tasting it, the head or father passes it around to the company and his whole family, who will also partake of it. (Just as it happened during the “Lord’s supper“).All through the scriptures, you will find expressions such as:The “cup of salvation” (Psalm 116:13), the “cup of consolation” (Jeremiah 16:7). There is also the cup of death, the cup of trembling, and the cup of wrath.These are figurative expressions.In ancient East and even Egypt, there was also an art of divining by means of a cup (Genesis 44:2-17)The concept of the cup in a figurative or metaphoric sense depicts an individual’s fate, destiny, and satisfaction with time and life.For example,In Psalm 16, the Psalmist said,“O Lord, You are the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You maintain my lot.” Psalm 16:5 (NKJV).Read it in The Passion Translation:“Lord, I have chosen you alone as my inheritance. You are my prize, my pleasure, and my portion. I leave my destiny and its timing in your hands.”However, Psalm 23:5 emphasises an abundant life with an overflowing cup (portion of blessings and satisfaction). This is an overwhelming or mighty picturesque in an arid or semiarid topography.From the above point, I want you to know that YOUR CUP, which runs over, is not merely an object you have in your hand.
It is your LIFE.
The Psalmist said, “MY CUP“. This points to “HIS LIFE AND LIVING“.The Lord doesn’t put an object or cup into your hand just for you to receive His precious wine. His LIFE becomes your LIFE (John 10:10; Colossians 3:4). And this LIFE is the CUP which overflows with HIS RICH ABUNDANT SUPPLY of His drink.“Now on the last and most important day of the feast, Jesus stood and called out [in a loud voice], 'If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink! He who believes in Me [who adheres to, trusts in, and relies on Me], as the Scripture has said, ‘From his innermost being will flow continually rivers of living water.” John 7:37-38 (Amplified Bible).Beloved in Christ, let this reality settle deeply in you that your cup (your life and living, which is the life of God in you) will never run dry.ENJOY THE OVERFLOWING, GRACIOUS BLESSINGS OF THE LORD.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 34 – 37; 2 Corinthians 3 – 4; John 7:38-39; Isaiah 58:11; Isaiah 12:3; Isaiah 35:6; Psalm 16 [TPT]) WE PRAY- We shall be conscious of the anointing within us as the gushing fountain of the Holy Spirit, springing up and flooding us and our sphere with endless life. - That every aspect of our lives and destinies shall overflow with the gracious blessing of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEzra 3-52 YEARS PLANNumbers 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the quality of God’s life in me as a fountain.– I am not dry, I have the anointing of the Holy Spirit.– The anointing of the Holy Spirit gushes forth in me as a fountain.– The anointing in me springs up as life.– Many lives are blessed by the overflowing of the Lord’s anointing in me.– I enjoy the overflow of God’s Spirit.– I don’t limit the flow of the anointing in my life.– I walk in the consciousness of the anointing and the overflowing blessings of the Lord.– My destiny is flooded with the Lord’s gracious blessings.– My cup overflows with the good pleasures of God.– There is no limitation in my life. I am graciously blessed with abundance.Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 846 - PERSEVERE IN PRAYER FOR RESULTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Are you making good use of all of God’s resources for His Kingdom mission or your selfish ambition? This is the set time to become a faithful Steward. Can God trust you with His resources for His mission? Selah! Author Sunday, 18th, May 2025PERSEVERE IN PRAYER FOR RESULTS“Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints“Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)While looking at praying all prayer and supplication, Paul pauses momentarily to address the attitude every believer should have as we pray.Remember, Paul was still talking about the items needed to withstand the schemes of the rulers of darkness.
To enforce your victory in Christ, you must not seek a holiday. Though we entered our rest in Christ, we fight the fight of faith in rest.
There is a designated time for a holiday. We confront the forces of darkness while we are at rest.The adversary though defeated and rendered powerless, is still deploying and projecting his deceptive scheme. Believers must have the attitude that puts them ahead of the strategies of the evil one.
We must be WATCHFUL and exercise PERSEVERANCE.
You cannot enforce your victory when you go into slumber. You must remain alert with your eyes open. Don’t be ignorant of the schemes of the enemy.To be watchful enables you to persevere. The more you are alert to see the plots of the enemy the more you remain firm and constant in prayer.Most believers go on vacation because they are ignorant of the schemes of the devil.He is a defeated enemy who never accepts defeat (though he knows he cannot win). You must be watchful to put him in his place.
It takes perseverance to do anything or accomplish any great feat in life.
Jesus instructed His disciples to “watch and pray…”You are a good soldier on the battlefield; therefore, stay alert in prayer.You don’t also have to get tired to pray. You may have many genuine reasons to be lackadaisical or reasons not to pray, but you must persevere.This is war!And you cannot stay out of touch with the Lord. You must earnestly stay in prayer.
To be sincere, prayer isn’t always easy. But the secret is that, the more you stay consistent in prayer, the easier it gets.
When you stay out of prayer for a while, it will always be a struggle to get into the habit of prayer. You must be determined to be prayerful. You have to make a choice that you shall press on in prayer.You don’t become effective in prayer by only reading about prayer. You can be reading this episode of with , and still not be praying. You may know the benefits of prayer and still not be praying.
The only way to be prayerful is to continue in prayer daily.
And also don’t make prayer the last option of what to do to get results. Prayer must always be your first strategy.You also don’t have to rush through prayer. To get the best of prayer, stay long in prayer and be consistent with it daily.PERSEVERE IN PRAYER FOR RESULTS!Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8DIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:17; Acts 1:4; Colossians 4:2,12; Mark 13:33; Luke 18:1; Colossians 1:9; Colossians 2:7) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not lack the ability and discipline to stay resolute, watchful and devoted in prayer. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEzra 6-82 YEARS PLANNumbers 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the grace to persevere in prayer in the midst of opposition.– I refuse to stagger, I pray. – I endure to the end, I pray. – I don’t fret nor faint, I pray. – Through perseverance in prayer, I maintain an undisturbed composure.Thank you Lord Jesus!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 847 - THE GOODNEWS OF GRACE IN AN EVIL WORLD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency How can you use what you don’t know? This is where the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord becomes essential. The moment you come into this perfect knowledge you can recognize and understand how to enjoy all that God has given you in Christ. Don’t underestimate the need to increase in knowledge. Selah. Author Monday, 19th May, 2025 THE GOODNEWS OF GRACEIN AN EVIL WORLD 1“But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD" Genesis 6:8 (KJV)God is just and has no agreement with evil. His goodness exposes and displaces evil. The judgment of God against evil is also the work of His goodness and righteousness to uproot destruction. His judgment also includes deliverance by faith and not by works.The present world or today's society has evil, corruption and sufferings breeding rapidly.Parents and families feel hopeless about the possible outcomes for the future generation.Most people are talking about how the entire society is heading towards total destruction.Fear, anxiety and depression have abounded in hearts.Perversion of hearts, greed, and acts of wickedness have occupied news headlines. Acts of kindness have become rare and a jaw-dropping experience in most circles.This shouldn't be surprising. The scriptures have foretold these happenings."Don’t be naive. There are difficult times ahead. As the end approaches, people are going to be self-absorbed, money-hungry, self-promoting, stuck-up, profane, contemptuous of parents, crude, coarse, dog-eat-dog, unbending, slanderers, impulsively wild, savage, cynical, treacherous, ruthless, bloated windbags, addicted to lust, and allergic to God. They’ll make a show of religion, but behind the scenes they’re animals. Stay clear of these people." 2 Timothy 3:1-5 (Message Bible)The Prophet Isaiah also gave a picture of the happenings on the earth:"The whole earth is wrapped in darkness, all people sunk in deep darkness, But God rises on you, his sunrise glory breaks over you" Isaiah 60:2 (Message Bible)
Amidst the chaotic situation of darkness in this world, there is the shining forth of God's light over those who trust in Him.
The present happenings in today's world are not new. From the day corruption entered time, the hearts of men have conceptualised evil and wickedness.And God's news of salvation and deliverance has always been the goodnews of light which shines in an evil world.This is the reality of the Goodnews of Grace; it is the shining forth of God's light in a hopeless world.Sometimes we think of God's grace as an afterthought, but God has always been gracious. The fullness of His Grace manifested at the appearing of Jesus. However, this is how God has always operated before time began. Paul the apostle explains this in his second epistle to Timothy:"He gave us resurrection life and drew us to himself by his holy calling on our lives. And it wasn’t because of any good we have done, but by his divine pleasure and marvelous grace that confirmed our union with the anointed Jesus, even before time began! This truth is now being unveiled by the revelation of the anointed Jesus, our life-giver, who has dismantled death, obliterating all its effects on our lives, and has manifested his immortal life in us by the gospel." 2 Timothy 1:9-10 (TPT)Grace and love are the flow or rhythm and nature of God's economy. The Kingdom of God, which is the household of God, functions or is administered by GRACE.
God's graciousness is His emission of light in a dark world.
Grace is glory began. One cannot experience the glory of God without the administrative work of His Grace.When you understand God's grace as the economy of God's Kingdom, you will know when God said, "let there be light", He was proclaiming and administering the goodness of His grace."Let there be light" wasn't a mere work of creation but the manifestation of God's goodnews to a chaotic and formless earth."The earth was formless and void or a waste and emptiness, and darkness was upon the face of the deep [primeval ocean that covered the unformed earth]. The Spirit of God was moving (hovering, brooding) over the face of the waters. And God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light" Genesis 1:2-3 (AMP)This is the message this present world needs to hear. The Goodnews of Jesus is the only message of grace which will cause the light of God to shine over evil and empty souls.
It is the only message that will deliver this generation from a void and hopelessness. It is the news of God's life.
Beloved, take heed to the Goodnews of Jesus and not the news of this world. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Genesis 6:5-8; Matthew 4:16; 2 Corinthians 4:6; Acts 26:18; John 8:12; Luke 1:78-79) WE PRAYWe pray that the light of the gospel of Jesus will shine in every heart and prevail in generation and the generations yet unborn through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEzra 9-10Nehemiah 12 YEARS PLANNumbers 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to the goodnews of Jesus. - Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of the goodnews of Jesus. - Through my participation, the gospel will shine in every heart, and prevail in every generation and the generations yet unborn. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 848 - THE GOODNEWS OF GRACE IN AN EVIL WORLD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency In as much as it is important to be honored and acknowledged for your service, never make that your goal. God has called you out that you show forth His praise and not for you to strive for the praise of men. Selah. Author Tuesday, 20th May, 2025 THE GOODNEWS OF GRACE IN AN EVIL WORLD 2“But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD" Genesis 6:8 (KJV)There are many people who think there is no hope for today's world. When they think of the perversion of this world, the only thing that comes to mind is a judgement of condemnation.You may wonder how the gospel reconciles the concept of a loving God with the existence of evil and chaos in the world.Understand that God is not through with this world and does not give up on His creation.
His response to the disobedience, disorderliness and wickedness in the heart of men, has always been a provision of Grace.
God is just and has no agreement with evil. His goodness exposes and displaces evil. The judgement of God against evil is mainly the work of His goodness and righteousness to uproot destruction.It's interesting how people don't see God's judgement against evil as a demonstration of His goodness. The goal of every evil work is to destroy. Judgement against evil stops the destructive work of evil.God's judgement also includes deliverance by Grace through faith and not by works. This is because man's "works" or self-righteousness are not enough to save him.If man's self-effort is enough to save him, then he doesn't need the help of a loving God. Therefore, he must have faith in God's provision.God always make a provision of salvation according to His purpose and grace. And as men exercise faith in His provision, they enjoy His grace.The grace of God is sufficient, no matter the degree of weakness or limitations. (2 Corinthians 12:9).After the fall of man through unbelief, corruption entered the world (see Genesis 3). And when men muliplied on earth, their corruption and wickedness also multiplied. What men deserve was condemnation, yet God made provision of Grace. "The Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually. And the Lord regretted that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him to his heart. So the Lord said, “I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the land, man and animals and creeping things and birds of the heavens, for I am sorry that I have made them.” But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord." Genesis 6:5-8 (ESV).Did you see the Goodnews amidst the evil and wickedness of men?When you read the above verses, you may conclude that the focus is the plan of God to destroy man. Please pause for a moment and put on the lens of Jesus.To grasp the full revelation of the scriptures, read them through the lens of Jesus.The above verses gave us the opportunity to witness the process of God's unconditional love. God's provision of love and grace is not demonstrated only in comfort. If it is only demonstrated in comfort then it is not unconditional.
To know it is the love of God, you must see the degree of pain.
The death of Jesus is the greatest demonstration of God's love. Was it comfortable? Was it cheap? Was it without a burden? Was it in the absence of pain?Click here to read more about the sufferings of Jesus on the cross.The focus of Genesis 6 was not the wickedness of men and the flood. The focus of Genesis 6 is the Graciousness of God's love.The thoughts which preceded, "But Noah..." were not the focus of the conversation. They only helped us understand and value the degree of God's love.It shows clearly that by the wickedness of man's heart, all men were to be destroyed completely. But because of the graciousness of God, He made provision of salvation for mankind. Now, by God's provision of grace, man was no longer going to be condemned because of their evil intentions and wickedness. It is now about their faith. The question was no longer, are they going to be destroyed because they are wicked?The question now is, are they going to have faith in God to escape the coming destruction?It was no longer about their character or conduct. It was now based on who God is?It is now based on their faith in God."Faith opened Noah’s heart to receive revelation and warnings from God about what was coming, even things that had never been seen. But he stepped out in reverent obedience to God and built an ark that would save him and his family. By his faith the world was condemned, but Noah received God’s gift of righteousness that comes by believing." Hebrews 11:7 (TPT).Noah was not delivered because of His conduct or goodness of character. Noah and his family were delivered because he had faith in God.
No matter the present day evil, God's provision of grace is superabounding. As many as will turn to God and have faith in Him shall be satisfied by God grace.
Beloved, this is the gospel (the Goodnews) of Jesus!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8&t=3sDIG DEEPER(Romans 4:18-22; Genesis 7:1-5; Psalm 84:11; Isaiah 54: 9; Genesis 19:18-23) WE PRAYWe pray that our hope and faith in the glorious news of God in Christ Jesus shall not faint. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANNehemiah 2 - 42 YEARS PLANNumbers 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to the goodnews of Jesus. - Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of the goodnews of Jesus. - Through my participation, the gospel will shine in every heart, and prevail in every generation and the generations yet unborn. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 849 - TURN TO GOD — AND BEHOLD HIS HELP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your salvation only depends on the good works of Jesus. It is not dependent on your works. Now, because you have been made righteous by Jesus, you live right unto God’s glory. This is the gospel. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 21st May, 2025 TURN TO GOD — AND BEHOLD HIS HELP“Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God" Hebrews 12:2 (Berean Standard Bible)God's heart towards His people is never to destroy them but to bring them to His Salvation.That is the focus of the entire Bible. He desires that all men shall be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. (1 Timothy 2:3-4).However, God doesn't force His provision of Grace or Salvation on mankind. He only supplies His grace. But it is only by His supply of Grace that men shall be saved.
To reject God's Salvation is to reject your deliverance from destruction.
What this means is that, to enjoy what the Lord supplies, one has to turn to Him by faith.That is exactly what Noah did.Noah built an ark because He had faith in God. If the people believed the testimony of Noah, they would have also been delivered from the flood.When you turn to God, you receive and enjoy His supply of Grace by faith. The Exodus of the Israelites from Egypt ultimately began after their first passover experience.Read here to understand the revelation of the Passover.Their obedience to the instruction of Moses concerning the passover was an action of faith towards God's provision. This act of faith delivered them from death. Their journey through the wilderness was also to be a continuous demonstration of faith towards God.And that was what God kept teaching them all through their journey in the wilderness. In our journey through this perverse, corrupt and evil world, God wants us to set our gaze on Him. No matter the wrongs you make, your way out is to turn to the Lord and to behold Him.When the Israelites were attacked by fierce serpents in the wilderness (because of their disobedience), God's answer was for them to behold the revelation of His Salvation."And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived." Serpent is also a symbol of deception and corruption in the scriptures.(Matthew 12:4; Revelation 12:9)Brass (or bronze) is a symbol of judgement. The brazen altar (of the temple, see Exodus 27:1-8; Exodus 29:38) was a typology of the cross of Jesus, where the judgement of sin was executed.The brazen serpent was a typology of God's salvation for mankind through Jesus.As long as the people beheld the brazen serpent, they were healed. The brazen serpent was a testimony to them that the penalty of their transgression had been paid, so they must be healed and live.
Jesus on the cross was made sin (2 Corinthians 5:21), and took upon Himself the judgement of sin. 
He said concerning His death, "And just as Moses in the desert lifted up the brass replica of a snake on a pole for all the people to see and be healed, so the Son of Man is ready to be lifted up, so that those who truly believe in him will not perish but be given eternal life" John 3:13-14 (TPT)This is the goodnews to all mankind.Jesus has paid for your sins; look away from your weaknesses and failures. Turn to God and behold His Salvation.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsCc24YCIy8&t=3sDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 46:22; John 12:32; John 8:28; John 6:40; Isaiah 53:5; Hebrews 9:28) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not waver in doubt but shall continue in faith as we behold the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANNehemiah 5 - 72 YEARS PLANNumbers 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to allow my heart to waver in doubt. - I continue in faith as I behold the Lord. - I look away from my weakness and failures, I turn to God and behold His salvation. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 850 - YOU HAVE TO MAKE A DECISION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, You must HEAR AND RESPOND to the Voice of the LORD always and in all things. The instructions of the Lord will lead you to prosperity. Don’t choose your emotions and assumptions over the Voice of the Lord. Get into prayer NOW. Author Thursday, 22nd May, 2025YOU HAVE TO MAKE A DECISION“Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.” Luke 22:42 (Berean Standard Bible) Beloved, by the revelation of scriptures, man has a crucial role to enact in the fulfillment of God’s eternal plan and purpose. God as the creator has an intention for His creation. Just as every inventor has an intention for his or her invention.
God made us to be His workmanship unto good works (Ephesians 2:10).
He also designed man to have an organic partnership with Him. God didn’t make man just to exhibit His creative ability.  When He made man: – He gave man a spirit (Zechariah 12:1; Ecclesiastes 12:7; Isaiah 42:5; Numbers 26:22), so that man will be able to relate with Him. Remember, God is a Spirit (John 4:24). – He made man a living soul. Genesis 2:7 (which includes the mind, the will and the emotions). – God gave man a mind (Psalm 139:13-16) to be able to reason.  – He gave man a will to make decisions and choices (Genesis 2:16-17; John 1:12-13). – He gave man emotions to feel and interpret his or her experiences and He also gave man a body to function in this physical world. (See also 1 Thessalonians 5:23)
These items reveal how God designed man in other to have a well structured partnership with him.
By these items it becomes possible for God to work together with man to achieve His eternal purpose through time. These also reveal how man can choose to live independent of God. Though man can only achieve God’s intention when He has an interdependence with Him. Surely, God made you to partner with Him to achieve His purpose.  “For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.” Ephesians 2:10 (NKJV) God doesn’t force you to live and function according to His will.To work with God and experience true fulfillment, you must willingly make a decision to function according to His WILL. Noah had to make a choice to believe in God’s word to build an ark before the flood. Others had the opportunity to join him, but they refused. Abraham had to willingly leave his father’s house to a land God will show him. And through that step of faith, all nations were blessed through him. Joseph had to make a decision to honour God and to reject Potipher’s wife. David had to make a choice to stand with the Lord and to stand up for His people. Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah decided to stand with God and not to bow to any other God, irrespective of the threat and danger. Despite the persecutions, the apostles and disciples of Jesus did not turn away, but continued to preach and spread the gospel of our Lord.
You can decide to do things according to your will or according to the will of God.
The choice is with you. It is time to say, LORD not my will BUT YOUR WILL! Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kU&pp=0gcJCY0JAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Matthew 26:39; Matthew 6:10; Psalm 40:8; John 4:34; John 5:30; Proverbs 19:20-22) WE PRAYThat in all things we will yield ourselves to walk in the ultimate WILL of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANNehemiah 8 - 102 YEARS PLANNumbers 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I choose to walk in the will of God.  – I refuse to yield to my will. – Through prayer and the study of the word, I am strengthened to walk in the ultimate Will of God for my life. – I walk in agreement with God in all things. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 851 - UNDERSTANDING SALVATION AND REPENTANCE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Faith is not how you feel. Faith is not waiting for a change. Faith is believing without a doubt in your heart that the change has happened and you have received it. The faith of God in your heart cannot fail. Selah. Author Friday, 23rd May, 2025 UNDERSTANDING SALVATION AND REPENTANCE 1"Or do you despise the riches of His goodness, forbearance, and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?" Romans 2:4 (NKJV)Salvation is not the same as repentance. And don't be confused about the difference between Salvation and Repentance.
Salvation is the work of God. Repentance is what God's work produces in you.
In the New Testament, repentance is not, first of all, a change of moral behaviour.Until Jesus came, men had to change from their wicked ways before they could experience and enjoy the kindness of God. Under the Old Covenant System, repentance was a requirement for deliverance. There was no deliverance available until there was total repentance.Their sins and transgressions cut them off from enjoying God's goodness.The prayer of Solomon the king (during the dedication of the temple) exposed the understanding of the Jews under the Old Covenant."If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near; Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness; And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause, And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them" 1 Kings 8:46-50 (KJV)The picture they had was that, until they repent (turn from their wicked ways) God will not forgive them.That was the Old Covenant requirement. But they couldn't completely turn from their wicked ways. 
They kept living in disobedience of the law because they lacked the ability to walk in obedience.
The Jews kept returning to captivity every time they transgressed. This was exactly as Solomon the king addressed in his prayer.Even after the Israelites or the Jews were delivered and brought back to their lands, they were taken back into captivity whenever they transgressed. They couldn't live as the law demanded because, the law doesn't supply ability for what it demands. Their repentance was never able to usher them into eternal Salvation.However, in the New Testament, when you receive Salvation according to the Goodness of God's Grace, the ability of God is supplied to you to live right.Now the Old Covenant is obsolete. In Christ Jesus, God has established a better Covenant."But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises. For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second. For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord." Hebrews 8:6-9 (KJV)
God's forgiveness is not dependent on your repentance. 
Unlike the Old Covenant, where repentance leads to accessing God's goodness, in the New Testament, it is God's goodness that leads to repentance.Hallelujah!(Read more in tomorrow's episode)https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWsm09KI7kUDIG DEEPER(Joel 2:13; 2 Peter 3:9; Titus 3:4-5; Ephesians 1:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall honour and take advantage of the goodness of God towards us, that we may live out His life and righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANNehemiah 11-132 YEARS PLANNumbers 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take advantage of the goodness of God towards me. - I have received the ability of God to live right. - I enjoy the goodness of God. - I live out His Life and righteousness. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 852 - UNDERSTANDING SALVATION AND REPENTANCE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t cower or recoil simply because you have not seen any answer yet. Be persistent! Continue shamelessly in prayer to God, until you see the change you are looking for or the manifestation of the word! Remember being persistent is not faithlessness but rather a consistent attitude of faith. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 24th May, 2025 UNDERSTANDING SALVATION AND REPENTANCE 2"Or do you despise the riches of His goodness, forbearance, and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?" Romans 2:4 (NKJV)From the previous episode, I explained that:- Repentance is not the same as Salvation.- Salvation is God's work, while repentance is what Salvation produces in you.- Under the Old Covenant, Repentance was the requirement for God's goodness and deliverance. - However, in the New Testament, it is God's goodness that leads to repentance.There are many who think that preaching the gospel of Jesus is to preach repentance. The preaching of the gospel is not a message of repentance. The gospel is a message of God's salvation. And when the gospel is preached, people demonstrate repentance.Some claim the primary message of Jesus is repentance.
No please! Jesus' message was not essentially a message of repentance.
"...Jesus began to preach and to say, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.” Matthew 4:17 (NKJV)Does this make "REPENTANCE" the central theme of Jesus' message?Get this, the central theme of Jesus' message wasn't what you will do. The central theme of Jesus' message was Himself. Jesus came to show forth God's Salvation.He is the Salvation of the Lord.He said, the scriptures testify of me. (John 5:39).You are not saved eternally by your repentance. You are saved eternally by believing in Jesus. In the New Testament, the words "repentance" and "repent" are not necessarily the same. Though they share the same root word.Today, let's dive into the word "REPENT". The word "REPENT" is from the Greek word, "metanoeō", which means "to think differently" or to have a change of mind.So why did Jesus announce that they REPENT?The Jews didn't see Jesus as their Salvation. They still believed in their old traditions and works of the law as a way to Salvation.They didn't know the presence of Jesus was the manifestation of the Kingdom and their Salvation.
The preaching of Jesus was to shift the Jewish minds from the Old Covenant to the fulfilment of the New Covenant in Him.
He was announcing to them to turn away from their self-efforts, and believe in Him unto Salvation.Jesus was not announcing a change in their behaviour or character, or moral conduct. Because they cannot be upright or live out the righteousness of God until they have received Him as the life of God.Here is what Jesus said about Himself:"God did not send his Son into the world to judge and condemn the world, but to be its Savior and rescue it!  So now there is no longer any condemnation for those who believe in him, but the unbeliever already lives under condemnation because they do not believe in the name of God’s beloved Son." John 3:17-18 (TPT)Again, He said:“I am the bread of life. Come every day to me and you will never be hungry. Believe in me and you will never be thirsty."John 6:35 (TPT).Do you see that?
He preached Himself as the way to eternal Salvation.
After Peter the apostle had preached the goodnews of Jesus on the day of Pentecost, they asked, "...what shall we do?""Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost." Acts 2:38 (KJV)Was Peter demanding a change of behaviour or a change of mind about Jesus?If it's about a change of behaviour, then how long did it take Peter to determine that they have changed?Look at what happened?"Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls." Acts 2:41 (KJV)How did they receive the word or message Peter preached? They did have a change of mind about their previous rejection of Jesus. The message Peter preached made them understand that the Jesus who was crucified was their Saviour and His death and resurrection were for their Salvation.God's Salvation has already been made available to all men through Jesus. 
The preaching of the gospel is able to cause the hearers to have a change of mind (to repent). 
This then makes them believe and receive the goodnews of the gospel unto Salvation.Now, maybe you are already saved while reading this with devotional, but don't have the understanding that the Salvation you have received in Christ is eternal.What you need is to REPENT (to have a change of mind) about this great Salvation you have received.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7yqbx_Vj6pYDIG DEEPER(Acts 26:20; 2 Peter 3:9; Titus 3:4-5; Ephesians 1:7-8; Acts 11:18) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall honour and take advantage of the goodness of God towards us, that we may live out His life and righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEsther 1 - 32 YEARS PLANNumbers 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take advantage of the goodness of God towards me. – I have received the ability of God to live right. – I enjoy the goodness of God. – I live out His Life and righteousness. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 853 - WHAT DO YOU HAVE THAT GOD DID NOT GIVE YOU?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Faith is daring and doesn’t kowtow to negative news, nor to challenges and situations which contradict God’s word. Be daring in faith, knowing that God will do what He says He will do. Don’t doubt the word of God. Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 25th May, 2025WHAT DO YOU HAVE THAT GOD DID NOT GIVE YOU?"The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine,’ says the LORD of hosts" Haggai 2:8 (NKJV) It is an opportunity or privilege to be a financial partner of the gospel. Giving towards the advancement of the gospel and the Kingdom isn’t for everyone.  And that is why you don’t listen or pay attention to anyone who vehemently speaks against giving in to the gospel.Giving into the Kingdom is for those who have:1. Set their affection on the Lord and have given themselves to the Lord2. Consciously increased in the giving grace, and give with joy and willingness.3. Recognised themselves as stewards of God’s finances.
As a steward of God’s finances, you acknowledge that whatever you give is not from you but of God.
You acknowledge God as your supply.That was exactly the mindset of Abraham. When God asked Abraham to offer his son Isaac, Abraham didn’t see himself as the provider of the sacrifice. When Isaac asked where the lamb for the sacrifice was, Abraham told him, God will provide for Himself a lamb for the sacrifice.Now the question is, did God really make provision for the sacrifice? Of course! (See Genesis 22:1-18) This is for you to understand that, whatever God tells you to do, He supplies you with the resources to do. When God tells you to go out there to preach, teach and heal the sick, He supplies you with the grace to do. God doesn’t place demands on you. He supplies you with the grace and resources you need to do what He wants you to do. When it comes to financing Kingdom assignment, the first thing to do is to look to God, not your pocket nor bank account.
Your bank balance will always be too small for the great things God wants you to do.
David said, “…I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver: 1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV) Which means he gave beyond what he had saved (prepared).At this level of giving, you are operating on the frequency of God’s supply. Giving by faith is giving with the mindset that the Lord is your supply, and that is stewardship. On the matter of stewardship, you acknowledge that all that you have is from God and it belongs to Him. When that becomes your consciousness, you don’t struggle to give greatly towards the advancement of His Kingdom.
Remember, whatever we do for God must be great.
It was this mindset David had. He saw himself as a steward of God’s resources. And that was how he trained his people to think. "Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand it is to make great. And to give strength to all. “Now therefore, our God, We thank YouAnd praise Your glorious name. But who am I, and who are my people,  that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You. For we are aliens and pilgrims before You, As were all our fathers; Our days on earth are as a shadow, And without hope. “O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name is from Your hand, and is all Your own." 1 Chronicles 29:12-16 (NKJV). David and His people gave greatly towards the Lord’s work because they recognised that the work of God is great and must be greatly financed.  And above all, they gave cheerfully and willingly because they knew all that they had was from God. And also, it was God who enabled them to give. They saw their walk with God as greater than their earthly engagements. Beloved, whatever you have is of God, therefore, you are only a steward of God’s resources. Your giving into God’s work is God sponsoring and advancing His Kingdom mandate through you.What can you give into God’s assignment that He didn’t give to you? Refusing to be a radical giver is failing to be a faithful steward. This is the secret of giving willingly. ARE YOU A FAITHFUL KINGDOM FINANCIAL STEWARD? Selah.As a faithful steward, become a partner of this massive kingdom agenda today.Send your partnership to 0532400655.You remain a blessing. DIG DEEPER(Psalm 50:8-11; Haggai 2:7-9; 1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10) WE PRAYThat we will be obedient to the promptings of the Lord each time in giving to His work. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEsther 4-62 YEARS PLANNumbers 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have set my affection on the Lord.– I am a faithful steward. – I give with joy. – I don’t withhold whatever the Lord asks me to give. – I give willingly and bountifully. – My finances are for the gospel. – I give in and out of necessity. – I don’t only give according to my ability, I give beyond. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 854 - UNDERSTANDING SALVATION AND REPENTANCE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, let your thoughts be flooded by the word of God. No matter the situation persistently and confidently stick to the word. In this kind of environment of the word, you exercise a dimension of faith which cannot fail. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 26th May, 2025 UNDERSTANDING SALVATION AND REPENTANCE 3"Or do you despise the riches of His goodness, forbearance, and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?" This is not just a change of thinking. It includes both a change of thinking and a state of moral action.
The Biblical difference between Repent (metanoeō, which is a noun) and Repentance (metanoia, which is a verb) is more than what they are in part of speech (noun and verb). Their Biblical meaning helps give clarity to their place in the concept of Salvation.I have already explained that Jesus didn't come to preach repentance; His message was Himself. However, it was recorded that He announced that the Jews should repent, because His teachings were to produce a radical mind shift.Until they repent, that is, change their thinking from the Old covenant belief system and to believe in Him, they cannot experience Eternal Salvation. You always resist the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you." Acts 7:51 (NKJV)
The preaching of Jesus was to radically shift the Jewish minds from the Old Covenant to the fulfilment of the New Covenant in Him.
He was announcing to them to turn away from their self-efforts, and believe in Him unto Salvation.What this means is that those who believed in Jesus repented from their old way of thinking. They had a change of mind to see Jesus as their saviour.Do you get the clarity now?Whenever the message of Jesus is preached and you believe, it means you have changed your thinking. To repent is to have a shift in your worldview. Instead of seeing your salvation in animal sacrifices and works of the law, you now see your salvation in Jesus. The moment a believer receives the Salvation of God's goodness, he begins to demonstrate or walk in true repentance.This is the gospel.You demonstrate a change in direction of living. You no longer live according to your own way. You now begin to live according to God's way.Repentance in the New Testament is not a feeling that one is sorry for something or a confession of wrongs.
