title: EPISODE 856 - UNDERSTANDING GODLY SORROW IN REPENTANCE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot be daring in faith without the word of God. Your confidence in the word of God in you is what makes you bold. Anyone without the word is defenseless. Selah. Author Wednesday, 28th May, 2025UNDERSTANDING GODLY SORROW IN REPENTANCE"For [godly] sorrow that is in accord with the will of God produces a repentance without regret, leading to salvation; but worldly sorrow [the hopeless sorrow of those who do not believe] produces death." 2 Corinthians 7:10 (Amplified Bible)WHAT IS GODLY SORROW?How is it necessary in Salvation?What is the connection between Godly Sorrow and Repentance?What is the difference between Godly Sorrow and worldly sorrow?What Paul the apostle said in 2 Corinthians 7 was a follow-up response to the Church in Corinth, after the report he received from Titus concerning the outcome of his first epistle to them.To get into this, I want you to take another look at the concept of Repentance and also to understand the mindset of Paul the apostle.The Concept of repentance as we have looked at from previous episodes, is essentially a change of mind.When Jesus said to the people to "...repent..." He was basically admonishing them to have a change of mind about what they believe. Repentance is essentially turning away from the self to faith in Christ Jesus.God's supply of forgiveness and salvation is according to the riches of His grace and not dependent on your repentance.Your repentance is as a result of the forgiveness which God has already supplied.
True repentance is produced by the revelation of God in Christ Jesus.
Paul the apostle understood this, he was on his way to Damascus in the business of persecuting the saints in Christ. He believed in the Jewish traditions and was zealously defending it and also attacked any believe system which was contrary to his belief. To him, "Christianity" was ungodly and should be stopped. The teaching that Jesus is the Messiah and all must believe in Him to be saved was blasphemous, therefore anyone with such faith must be persecuted.He was stiff-necked, uncircumcised in heart and resisted the Holy Spirit. As Stephen described the Sanhedrin (Acts 7:51).Paul's encounter with Jesus on his way to Damascus, changed his mind. He realized he was not working for God but against God. He had a change of heart, turned from his wicked way and turned to God.Most people only think repentance is turning away from your wicked ways. But turning away from your wicked ways is not all that there is. When you turn away from your wicked ways what do you turn to?That is the most important matter here.Turning away from your wicked ways is not the complete reality of Repentance. Turning away from sin or your wicked ways does not mean you are going to live by God's supply and according to God's will.You can turn from your wicked ways, to live by your own effort, which will only result in death and not God's salvation.
Total repentance is turning to God!
Paul turned away from the Jewish legalistic system and traditions, and turned to the glorious revelation of God in Christ Jesus. (Philippians 3:5-13). Considering how he contributed to the persecution and displacement of the saints, He didn't clap and celebrate his actions. He felt discomfort and sorrow.But this sorrow wasn't without hope. It was with hope and joy of what he has found in Christ Jesus.No wonder he said,"To truly know him meant letting go of everything from my past and throwing all my boasting on the garbage heap. It’s all like a pile of manure to me now, so that I may be enriched in the reality of knowing Jesus Christ and embrace him as Lord in all of his greatness" Philippians 3:8 (TPT)He threw away his old belief system on the garbage heap. title: EPISODE 857 - UNDERSTANDING GODLY SORROW IN REPENTANCE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Learn to acknowledge the sure mercies and grace of God. Just because you are now a son of God, a brother of Jesus, and have a mingled life with Christ doesn’t mean you are also a master on your own. Jesus is your MASTER. The more you see Him as your Master, the more you submit to Him, and your faith finds genuine expressions through Him. Selah. Author Thursday, 29th May, 2025  UNDERSTANDING GODLY SORROW IN REPENTANCE 2"For [godly] sorrow that is in accord with the will of God produces a repentance without regret, leading to salvation; but worldly sorrow [the hopeless sorrow of those who do not believe] produces death." 2 Corinthians 7:10 (Amplified Bible)There are some who think true repentance is determined by how you put on a sackcloth and cry your eyes out in sorrow.
It is erroneous to think that people only show repentance when they grieve or are in painful anguish.
This does not necessarily prove repentance. Repentance is a change in mindset about what sin is, who God is and what He has produced through the death and resurrection of Jesus.WHAT IS GODLY SORROW?Godly Sorrow is basically the genuine regret, pain and discomfort you feel when you realise how you have fizzled out or fallen short. But it is not the regret or discomfort which makes it godly. It is what is produced out of the discomfort.Godly sorrow is determined when the regret doesn't move you away from God but rather makes you turn to the Lord in repentance through the supply of His grace.Also, don't assume it is the Holy Spirit who wreaks pain and anguish in your heart. The Holy Spirit only shines the light of truth in your heart. And you come into the realisation of the will and the way of the Lord.It is this realisation that influences how you feel.It doesn't necessarily lead to tears and sorrow all the time. The focus is that you will have a total mind shift or change of mind when the light of the Spirit shines in your heart.Godly Sorrow is not a feeling of condemnation. It is a feeling that comes from understanding who you are in Christ and how you have failed to live in that reality. You lift your hands to God for Him to pick you and set you up to continue in the reality of who you are in Christ.Paul the apostle received a report about the various sins of the saints in Corinth. He then sent them a letter to rebuke, correct and address them. One such sin was the case of a man living in sexual sin with his stepmother. (1 Corinthians 5:1).Paul the apostle showed displeasure at the various misconducts in the Church. And even instructed that they keep no company with such within the Church (1 Corinthians 5). Was Paul condemning such a person? No!He was condemning the deeds. Remember I have said before that God did not justify immorality, idolatry, extortion, but justified the believer (see 1 Corinthians 6:11).In Chapter 6 of 1st Corinthians, Paul takes his time to expound on the reality of the believer. He didn't just demand that they change their behaviour. He cultivated the consciousness of who they are in their minds. He didn't just show displeasure. He didn't zoom in on condemning them. He condemns the wrongfulness or sins and brings them to the realisation of who they are.Take a look at what Paul said:"Have you forgotten that your body is now the sacred temple of the Spirit of Holiness, who lives in you? You don’t belong to yourself any longer, for the gift of God, the Holy Spirit, lives inside your sanctuary. You were God’s expensive purchase, paid for with tears of blood, so by all means, then, use your body to bring glory to God!" 1 Corinthians 6:19-20 (TPT) He was just demanding a behaviour change. Paul the apostle knew that without the shining forth of God's revelational light, there cannot be true repentance.Just as he was drawn to the Lord by the revelation of Jesus, he drew the Corinthian brethren from their weaknesses by reminding them of the fellowship they have with God.
Did this work? Yes, it did.
Read this from the second epistle Paul wrote to the Corinthians:"And now, isn’t it wonderful all the ways in which this distress has goaded you closer to God? You’re more alive, more concerned, more sensitive, more reverent, more human, more passionate, more responsible. Looked at from any angle, you’ve come out of this with purity of heart. And that is what I was hoping for in the first place when I wrote the letter. My primary concern was not for the one who did the wrong or even the one wronged, but for you—that you would realize and act upon the deep, deep ties between us before God. That’s what happened—and we felt just great." 2 Corinthians 7:11-13 (MSG)Oh, glory to God.Godly Sorrow or distress does not drive you away from God. It turns you around from the path of defeat and leads you to enjoy the Salvation which you have in Christ.Some decide to stay away from Church meetings (assembly of the saints), refuse to pray or read their Bibles because of their weaknesses or sins.But that is not consistent with the word of God.
When your distress or sorrow, or remorse leads you away from God or keeps you hiding from God's presence, it is ungodly.
God is a loving Father whose interest is that you continue in the reality of His life at work in you, through the supply of His grace.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 51:17; Isaiah 66:2; Romans 6:21-23; James 4:9-10) WE PRAYWe pray that no mistake will draw us away from the Lord, but we shall continuously turn to the Lord to enjoy His grace to live out His righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 3-52 YEARS PLANNumbers 29DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I turn away from pride unto God. – My life and living is by the revelation of God in Christ Jesus. – I surrender daily to the love of God in my thoughts and deeds. – I remain submitted to the gracious power of God. Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 859 - ARE YOU HIDING FROM GOD?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Esteem God’s HELP above your challenges. No matter how deep you have sunk into negative addictions, the defeats, the pains, the failures, debts and the ocean of troubles the hand of the Lord is not too short to save you. Selah. Author Saturday, 31st May, 2025 ARE YOU HIDING FROM GOD?"And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden." Genesis 3:8 (KJV)As a born-again in Christ, how do you respond to sin?Does it make you hide yourself from God?Does it move you away from the things which are of Christ?Do you feel discouraged from even praying because of your sins?
Your response to sin will determine whether you will walk out of its influence or remain in its snare.
Usually, when people (or legalistic folks) read a statement like: "God doesn't want you to hide from him. He loves you and has forgiven you of all your sins."What they hear is that "God loves your sins. He sees nothing wrong with your sin.  Keep doing wrongs and He will always forgive you."When they read a statement like "Don't feel God condemns you. You are eternally saved. You have the righteousness of God in Christ. Stop crying and turn to God's saving grace."What the legalistic will hear is, "God entertains your sins. You don't have to feel any regret for your mistakes or sins."They hear what is in their mind rather than what they are reading. They don't read to learn, they read to criticise. It's not surprising because these people read their imagination and thoughts into scriptures.They don't pay attention to what the scripture says. They don't read to understand the scriptures, they read their understanding into the scriptures. They find it difficult to see what God is saying, they only see what they want God to say or how they want God to speak. They read what they feel and not the reality of God.Beloved, you don’t have to respond to sins or mistakes based on what you feel. The adversary, who is the accuser of the brethren, takes delight in such a state of guilt. Every genuine believer will have a feeling of sorrow, regret, and discomfort when they slip into a sinful act. This is because of the love of God at work in them. They understand that their sins and erroneous conduct affect the people around them and don't represent the character of Christ. Hence, the regret and discomfort.
However, having regret and a feeling of guilt shouldn't move you away from God's presence.
To hide from God is the way of Adam.Adam decided to try his own way of being right and hid himself from God. It's happening today! Register here; https://forms.gle/upo8i3b55kyNEiur7Become a partner of this massive kingdom agenda today.Send your partnership to 0532400655.You remain a blessing!This usually happens when you sin or act in error; you become ashamed even to open the scriptures or get into prayer.You may beat yourself up and sometimes make a promise or vow that you will live right.This doesn't mean you have turned to God.Adam, to cover his nakedness and shame, made a covering from leaves. Leaves?Without shedding of blood is no remission. (Hebrews 9:22)No sin can be covered or dealt with by human efforts. Man-made religion teaches righteousness by self-efforts.But sin and sins are dealt with by blood. This was why Jesus came to die for you. His death dealt with the problem and penalty of sin and became the grounds for the continuous enjoyment of forgiveness.
The emphasis on behaviour or moral conduct doesn't supply a solution.
There are those who make the excuse that they will spend time to work on themselves, and after they are perfect in their ways, they will get back to God. This is a trap!Such a decision will move you away from enjoying God, and you will never get back on track."Distress that drives us to God does that. It turns us around. It gets us back in the way of salvation. We never regret that kind of pain. But those who let distress drive them away from God are full of regrets, end up on a deathbed of regrets." 2 Corinthians 7:10 (MSG)You can only turn away from your sins when you turn to God.You cannot make things right on your own. This is why you don't have to hide from God. God is your Salvation. Your best solution is in God and is God.Jesus did not come to die for you when you were perfect. He came to die for all men, even when we were in sin.
Don't turn from God; call upon Him no matter the situation.
"Call upon Me in the day of distress; I shall rescue you, and you will glorify Me.” Psalm 50:15 (Legacy Standard Bible)Don’t listen to the voice saying:"Stay away from God, don't pray, don't attend Church meetings. Because you have erred" Don't listen to the voice of the Accuser; listen to Jesus!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 5:8-10; 2 Corinthians 5:19; Titus 3:4-5; Jeremiah 31:25; Matthew 11:28) WE PRAYWe pray that no mistake will draw us away from the Lord, but we shall continuously turn to the Lord to enjoy His grace to live out His righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 9-112 YEARS PLANNumbers 31DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I turn to the Lord at all times and in all circumstances. - I enjoy God's grace. - Through His unfailing grace, I live out His righteuosness.- I don't permit any mistake or challenge to draw me away from the Lord. - Nothing will ever make me hide from God. - I refuse to give heed to the voice of the Accuser. - No matter the situation, I will call upon the Lord. - The Lord is my refuge and strength, and I run to him in the day of trouble. - The Lord is the strength of my life. Thank you Lord Jesus for your love.[mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 860 - "SEEK YE FIRST"
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The most secured place is the Kingdom of God. And through Christ we are translated into this unshakable kingdom. Jesus established His Church to be the organic expression of God’s Kingdom. The best place to consistently access Truth is Christ’s Church. Let not the world distract you. ENJOY A BLESSED NEW MONTH! Author Sunday, 1st June, 2025"SEEK YE FIRST""But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you" Matthew 6:33 (KJV) When you read the above verse of the Bible, what comes to mind? Interestingly, some only see “and all these things shall be added”. It is not God they seek first; it is the "all things which shall be added" they seek.Which is wrong! The focus of Matthew 6:33 is God and not the other things. Make Him your focus and motive. 
Don’t pretend to be serving God, yet deep within your motive of action is the desire for things to be added to you and not God and His Kingdom.
Another group of people have a different understanding of the phrase,“SEEK YE FIRST”.To them, it means starting your life with God, so that when a time comes when you are too busy to be available for His Kingdom assignment, He will understand. So at the beginning of their lives, they pursue God. You will find them in the Church, serving and participating in Kingdom activities. They are involved in personal prayers and Bible studies.  As they grow in business, grow in their finances, get married, start having children, etc, then they shift their attention to the family, business, etc.  Their sincere idea is that they now have to focus on what God has given them, because they have made the necessary contribution in God’s Kingdom or the Church. That is ignorance or a misconception of our relationship with God. Others also have a list of priorities. To them, God first means, “Make God number one”. Thus, on their priority list, they have:1. God (His Kingdom and Righteousness) first.2. Academics (if they are students)3. Family4. Work etcOthers have also:1. God first2. Marriage/Spouse3. Family4. Work etc…Whatever way they will outline their priority list, I want you to know that God doesn’t need to be there as Number One.As a born-again, God has to be involved in every aspect of your life. He is not merely part of your list, He is your life and essence, that is the reality.
For God to be the first, means He has to be the Chief of your life.
He must be the first in every aspect of your life.This verse of scripture below should change your entire worldview:  “In everything you do, put God first, and He will direct you and crown your efforts with success” Proverbs 3:6 (TLB) God must be the first in your ministry. People can do ministry for themselves and not for the Lord. He must be the first in your family and marriage. He must be the first in your academics, career or profession and work.  In everything you do, God has to be the center of it all. For God to be the first means He is the reason you do what you do. 
Don’t just make Him Number 1 on your list. 
Nothing comes before Him, and nothing comes after Him. He is the essence of all you do. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOocDIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 28:9; Provers 16:3,9; 1 Kings 8:61) WE PRAYLord, I commit all [mention them] that concerns me into your hands, please direct my steps. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 12-142 YEARS PLANNumbers 32DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God is the essence of all that I do.– I involve God in everything I do. – I am in partnership with God. – The Lord directs my steps. – None of my steps will ever slide, because I have committed all that concerns me to the Lord. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 861 - BE SATISFIED BY THE LORD JESUS HIMSELF
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It is time to act in great faith. It doesn’t matter the challenge or ministry project, make a decision to honor the Lord, recognize His power and authority and be confident that the word works; thus, it will do as it says. Selah. Author Monday, 2nd June, 2025 BE SATISFIED BY THE LORD JESUS HIMSELF"Why would you strive for food that is perishable and not be passionate to seek the food of eternal life, which never spoils? I, the Son of Man, am ready to give you what matters most, for God the Father has destined me for this purpose.” John 6:27 (TPT)Why do you attend Church meetings?Why are you a "Christian"?Why do you follow the Lord?Why do you serve the Lord?There are many who once professed Jesus as their Lord and are no longer following the Lord.Such people followed the Lord because of a miracle they wanted or a material possession.This explains why people turn away from the Lord when they are uncomfortable.The first-century believers suffered persecution, torture, and discomfort, yet they remain resolute in their walk with the Lord. They couldn't deny their faith in Jesus and boldly proclaimed His goodnews. They testified to Jesus even in hostile situations.What was their secret?These people found an unquenchable satisfaction in the Lord.Though they knew the Lord Jesus heals, raises the dead, makes provision for their needs and preserves them from evil, their walk with the Lord was essentially built on His person.
Until you focus on the Lord as your inward satisfaction, you will be easily distracted when confronted by challenges.
After Jesus had multiplied bread to feed the multitudes, He departed from them. And yet they went looking for Him at Capernaum. After they found Jesus, He made a profound statement to them."When they finally found him, they asked him, “Teacher, how did you get here?”Jesus replied, “ Let me make this very clear, you came looking for me because I fed you by a miracle, not because you believe in me. Why would you strive for food that is perishable and not be passionate to seek the food of eternal life, which never spoils? I, the Son of Man, am ready to give you what matters most, for God the Father has destined me for this purpose.” John 6:25-27 (TPT)Jesus' goal was to teach them to believe in Him and to focus on Him as their satisfaction. He didn't want them to settle only for the miracles. The miracles Jesus gave them was a sign to them that He is their true satisfaction. Yet these people couldn’t take their eyes off the miracles. They proved it over and over again that they would rather want the miracles and not a deeper relationship with Jesus. The Lord Jesus wanted them to believe in Him and enjoy Him as their eternal satisfaction. But they were looking for temporal enjoyment.Let's get into their dialogue after He said these things to them (this dialogue is taken from the Passion Translation):"They replied, “So what should we do if we want to do God’s work?” verse 28.The response of the multitudes was as though they were ready to receive the words of Jesus."Jesus answered, “The work you can do for God starts with believing in the One he has sent.” verse 29.Jesus was still pointing them to Himself. But take note of their reply again:"They replied, “Show us a miracle so we can see it, and then we’ll believe in you." verse 30.These people were still interested in the miracle than the miracle worker. Meanwhile, Jesus wants them to have Him, so that they shall become custodians of what He gives. They even made reference to Moses as the one who fed their ancestors in the multitudes, therefore, Jesus should also show a sign. (See verse 31). But if they truly wanted a sign before they would believe, didn't they see a sign a day before, when Jesus multiplied bread to feed them? (See John 6:1-14).In fact, "All the people were astounded as they saw with their own eyes the incredible miracle Jesus had performed! They began to say among themselves, “He really is the One—the true prophet we’ve been expecting!” John 6:14 (TPT)The thing is this: no matter the miracles you receive, you shall never be completely satisfied. Your true satisfaction is not in the miracles. 
Your true and complete satisfaction is in your relationship with the Lord Jesus.
When they ate the bread Jesus multiplied, they were satisfied (John 6:12). But that satisfaction was not the true satisfaction Jesus wanted to give them. The true satisfaction was Jesus Himself, who was giving them the bread.Jesus told them, the bread which Moses gave the Israelites (their ancestors) was from His Father. Jesus explained further that the bread which was given to their ancestors was a dramatic sign, and now He is the bread from Heaven, to give His life to feed the world.Look at their response once again:"Then please, sir, give us this bread every day,” they replied." (Verse 34).This is exactly how most people (both Christians and non-Christians) are living their lives. They want what will satisfy their outward interests. They are not interested in enjoying the Lord as their satisfaction.They look for their satisfaction in temporal things.Jesus is more than the miracles, the opportunities, the material blessings, and the success stories.He is life.
He wants you to relate to Him beyond the physical or material blessings you enjoy in Him.
He said:“I am the Bread of Life. Come every day to me and you will never be hungry. Believe in me and you will never be thirsty" John 6:35 (TPT).What is your pursuit?Are you striving for the perishable, or are you focused on the Lord, who is your true satisfaction?Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOoc&t=1630sDIG DEEPER(Ecclessiastis 6:7; Isaiah 55:2; John 4:13-14; Colossians 3:1-2) WE PRAYWe pray that our affection will be set on the Lord, and we shall focus and enjoy Him as our eternal satisfaction. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 15-172 YEARS PLANNumbers 33DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord is my eternal satisfaction. - The pursuit of my life is focused on the Lord Himself. - I refuse to keep my gaze on perishable things. - I refuse to be distracted by challenges, because the Lord is my true satisfaction. - My true and complete satisfaction is in my relationship with the Lord Jesus. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 862 - STAY WITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t try to be like everybody. Don’t try to fit into the society. Don’t compromise and let no man lure you to go where God has not called you to go. Beloved, don’t be scared of the outcome of your commitment to what the Lord has instructed you to do. Selah. Author Tuesday, 3rd June, 2025 STAY WITH THE LORD"Peter spoke up and said, “But Lord, where would we go? No one but you gives us the revelation of eternal life." John 6:68 (TPT)Until you understand and appreciate who the Lord Jesus is and what defines your relationship with Him, you will not be consistent in your relationship with Him.You may not be consistent in your relationship with the Lord because you assume there are other alternatives or options. You may think that whatever the Lord may supply to you can be supplied through other means.You don't stick to the Lord because He says what makes you happy. You must stay with the Lord, whether what He says is what you want or not. The thoughts of Jesus are not to fit into your worldview. It comes to cause a shift in your mind to correct your belief system and worldview. 
The words of Jesus don't agree with your way of thinking, it changes the way you think.
Most people who followed the Lord Jesus turned away from Him because of His teachings. He wasn't telling them what they wanted, He was telling them what they needed."And when many of Jesus’ followers heard these things, it caused a stir. “That’s disgusting!” they said. “How could anybody accept it?” Without anyone telling him, Jesus knew they were outraged and told them, “Are you offended over my teaching?" "And so from that time on many of the disciples turned their backs on Jesus and refused to be associated with him" John 6:60-61,66 (TPT)Jesus then turned to the twelve (12) disciples and asked, "Do you also want to leave?"Peter's response must be the response of every believer, no matter the storm or questions posed to your faith."Peter spoke up and said, “But Lord, where would we go? No one but you gives us the revelation of eternal life. We’re fully convinced that you are the Anointed One, the Son of the Living God, and we believe in you!” John 6:60-68 (TPT).Maintain a strong conviction about the revelation of Jesus; especially within a time and age where you meet people who mock the reality of Jesus, and cast doubt around the historical accuracy of the incarnation, divinity, the meaning of the death of Jesus and His resurrection. The response of Peter wasn't only about what Jesus does, but mainly about who He is!- Peter didn't talk about any temporal experience. He addressed Jesus as the source of eternal blessings.- And clearly stated their conviction and why they believe in Him. They don't believe in Him just because of what He does for them, but because of who He is. They believed in Him because He is the Anointed One, the Son of the Living God.When you have this kind of conviction about the Lord, nothing moves you away from Him. That explains the faith the three Hebrew boys had in God. They never yielded to the pressure to bow to Baal, not just because they believed the Lord God would save them, but because of who the Lord God is to them.
They even believed in the LORD to the extent that they knew if He didn't save them, He was still right.
Always maintain the consciousness of who the Lord Jesus is, rather than just what He does. The multitudes left because they didn't fix their focus on who the Lord is; they were only interested in the miracles of Jesus.You enjoy the perfect peace of the now when you focus on the peace He gives. You enjoy the perfect peace of the Lord when your mind stays on Him.What this means is that you don't demonstrate confidence in the Lord only when things look good around you. You stay with the Lord and set your affection towards Him even when you go through the valleys and the shadows of death.
No matter what confronts you, stay with the LORD.
Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(Acts 4:12; John 14:6; 1 John 5:11-12;  Hebrews 11:6; Psalm 73:25) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain focused on the revelation of the Lord Jesus and be immovable no matter the storm. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 18-202 YEARS PLANNumbers 34DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I remain focused on the revelation of the Lord Jesus. - I am immovable no matter the storm. - No matter what confronts me, I stay with the Lord. - I enjoy the perfect peace of the Lord because my mind is stayed on Him. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 863 - YOU ARE CALLED INTO FELLOWSHIP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever or whoever is born of God, into the household of God has overcome the world through Faith! You don’t have to permit defeat and failure in your sphere because you are born of God. You don’t speak failure and defeat. You have the faith of God in you, function in that capacity. Selah. Author Wednesday, 4th June, 2025YOU ARE CALLED INTO FELLOWSHIP“God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.” 1 Corinthians 1:9 (NKJV) When you believed and received Jesus, you did not merely escape hell. The Lord brought you into sonship. (John 1:12-13).In your new birth, you were called into the fellowship of Jesus by God. The word, fellowship is from the Greek word "Koinonia", which means partnership, participation, communication, communion, distribution and intercourse.
By God’s own faithfulness, not by your self-effort, God called you into the participation, communion and partnership of His Son Jesus.
To come into fellowship or participation in His Son also means you share in the reality of the Sonship of Jesus.In the fellowship of sonship, you are no longer an alien but also a son. “Beloved, now are we the sons of God…” 1 John 3:2 (KJV) In that call unto fellowship with Jesus the Lord also justified you.This was not an afterthought; it was God’s age-long plan and intention to bring you into sonship. It was His predestined plan to call you, justify you and bring you into His glory. (Romans 8:30).
Justification is a crucial reality for your calling into sonship.
The term justification is a legal term. To be justified is to be declared not guilty or declared righteous. You were not justified cheaply. God did not overlook your wrongs to justify you. Jesus died as a penalty for your wrongs and trespasses. "He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification" Romans 4:25(BSB) Now, from the above verse, you can see the essence of the resurrection of Jesus. By the resurrection of Jesus, you were justified.The born-again in Christ is the justified. As He has called you, He has justified you.  The justification came with His resurrection, and by that, God legally called you into the fellowship of sonship. God purposed this before the foundation of the earth. The Lord desires that all will experience salvation and become His very expression and manifestation. God didn’t want to be hidden. He wanted to be touched and experienced. He wanted His love to be seen by all. God predestined that man would be His expression before the foundation of the world and come into adoption as sons. Sonship is for expression. The son expresses the father. Great is the mystery of Godliness; God manifested in the flesh [see 1st Timothy 3:16]. "No man has ever seen God but the son who is in the bosom of the father has expressed Him" [John 1:18]. The Son expressed the Father by becoming flesh. God becoming man through Jesus was His manifestation. Godliness is the expression of divinity.
The essence of man is that he will be the expression of life, which is God. 
Man is to be the very expression of God.God has predestined that you will be hewn out of Him, possessing His LIFE. It is His plan for all.God made it available for all men to experience adoption of sonship. Yet not all have come into this sonship. Those who receive Him are brought into sonship.The saddest thing is not receiving eternal life, and the gladdest thing is to receive eternal life by believing (John 1:11-12).Whosoever has the son has life. This means the son is the life (1 John 5:11-12) Beloved, let this settle within you: your participation in sonship is not dependent on your faithfulness. It is dependent on the faithfulness of God. Not that we first loved him, but that he first loved us [1st John 4:10]. By this, you came into a participation, a fellowship, and equal sharing in Christ. You don’t have a ‘part share’, you have a full share as son.Wherefore are we partakers of the divine nature (2 Peter 1:4). You share in all of that which is in God.
Anytime you feel discouraged and it seems the vicissitudes of life kick you about, remember you are a son of God.
Anytime you feel like all hope is lost, remember you have a living hope which is incorruptible. (1 Peter 1:3). We are not of this world. We are not in agreement with this world.You are not a sinner. You are a son of God. You are in fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ, our Lord. GLORY TO GOD!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-M&pp=0gcJCbEJAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:3-6; 2 Timothy 1:9-10; Romans 8:14-17;28-30) WE PRAYThat as sons we shall demonstrate and express the reality of God in our world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 21-232 YEARS PLANNumbers 35DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Now I am a son of God and I have His very life. – I share in the inheritance of the sons of God in the light. – I express God to my world, through the supply of God’s Spirit. – I am born with the life of God, therefore I have His nature. – I don’t live as a slave of this world, for I am a son of God. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 864 - IT IS BY THE STRENGTH OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is something special about following God’s plan. A cheerful prompt to do it giver has a genuine heart for God. Having a huge amount of money in your bank account or as income doesn’t make you a giver automatically. Until you passionately love the Lord, you will not give in to His agenda. Beloved, do you passionately love the Lord? Author Thursday, 5th June, 2025IT IS BY THE STRENGTH OF GOD"For they all were trying to make us afraid, saying, 'Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done.' Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands" Nehemiah 6:9 (NKJV) One of the greatest causes of weakness in the pursuit of God’s purpose is FEAR. The moment you become afraid that you will fail or will not be able to complete the task, you weaken yourself from doing what God wants you to do.
The more you exercise confidence that with God you shall do valiantly, the more you increase in strength.
When you consider the seemingly overwhelming pressure or the opposition you face or may face in the pursuit of purpose, you will stagger in faith. There will be times you may not have support from your best friends or the people you trust. But that shouldn’t derail you. Look at Paul's (the apostle’s) testimony: ”At my first defense no one stood with me, but all forsook me. May it not be charged against them. But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that the message might be preached fully through me, and that all the Gentiles might hear. Also I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.” 2 Timothy 4:16-17 (NKJV) Glory to God!!! This is the certainty of our faith!!! No matter the pressure or opposition, beloved, we turn to God. It is by the strength of God that you will prevail, not your human strength nor intelligence.
When you turn away from the pressure and you turn to God, you increase in strength.
Just as Nehemiah did: "For they all were trying to make us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done.” Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands" Nehemiah 6:9 (NKJV) Nehemiah chose to pray to God for strength. That was all he needed to complete the work. Now look at what happened: "So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days. And it happened, when all our enemies heard of it, and all the nations around us saw these things, that they were very disheartened in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was done by our God" Nehemiah 6:15-16 (NKJV)
When the strength of God is supplied to you, you can only have the God-kind of results.
Increase in strength!!!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOoc&t=1630sDIG DEEPER(Psalm 138:3; Psalm 28:7; Psalm 46:1; Daniel 10:19) WE PRAYOh Lord, strengthen our hands for this work you have committed to us that we will not stagger no matter the opposition or pressure that will confront us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 24-262 YEARS PLANNumbers 36DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t stagger in faith. – By the strength of God, I prevail. – With God I do valiantly. – I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day. – I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 865 - WHAT A JOY AND PRIVILEGE!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot say you have faith and be silent. Faith speaks! To act in faith is to act according to God’s word, and God is not silent. Even in His silence, there is a message. Do you believe what God says? Then you must speak forth His word with boldness. Author Friday, 6th June, 2025WHAT A JOY AND PRIVILEGE!“Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever”Psalm 23:6 (NKJV)The beautiful thing we see about this Psalm is the revelation of the Father and His family.To dwell is from the Hebrew word, "yâshab", which means "to sit down; to remain; to settle to marry; make to abide continually; to be established; make to inhabit; to remain; to settle or tarry".The word “house“, "bayith", depicts the concept of family. It doesn’t just mean a building structure. It means a home you were born in; a household. Bayith also has the idea of a steward. It also means a temple or tabernacle, a palace, a court, an inner chamber or the presence of a King.Now, how do you settle, abide, or settle down in the inner chamber of a King forever when you are not a true son?
To dwell in the house of the Lord is to have a deeper relationship with the Lord. 
This must be the dream and desire of every man.To dwell in the Lord’s presence is to be established in your true home, where you can commune with the Lord.Look at David’s deepest longing:“Here’s the one thing I crave from God, the one thing I seek above all else: I want the privilege of living with him every moment in his house, finding the sweet loveliness of his face, filled with awe, delighting in his glory and grace. I want to live my life so close to him that he takes pleasure in my every prayer.” Psalm 27:4 (TPT).
Deep within the heart of every man is the silent cry to experience the Lord’s presence or to dwell in the court of our God.
God designed man to abide with Him. And it has always been His dream to bring man into that intimate relationship with Him. All through time, man couldn’t fully have access to dwell and enjoy the Lord’s presence in its fullness.So He decided to tabernacle among men so that He would assimilate as many as believe in Him, into Himself.This is why God came to dwell among us through the WORD (who is Jesus the Word made flesh).“The Word became flesh and dwelt among us…” John 1:14.To dwell among us means the Word made His HOME among us. It also means He TABERNACLED among us. This is for us to have access to the Lord.“How greatly to be envied are those you have chosen to come and live with you within the holy tabernacle courts! What joys await us among all the good things there.” Psalm 65:4 (TLB)
Now we have access to the Lord’s presence or inner chamber through Christ Jesus.
What a joy!BELOVED, don’t permit anything to distract you from enjoying the glorious things in the Lord’s presence.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(Psalm 84:1-4,10; Psalm 42:1-4; Psalm 122:1; Isaiah 25:6-9; Psalm 43:3) WE PRAYThat our delight and passionate longings will always be that we will continue to enjoy our place in the house of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 27-292 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a son and the good Shepherd is my Father.– I enjoy the privilege of sonship in my Father’s family.– I shall not be expelled from my Father’s house.– I walk in the consciousness of my dwelling place– I belong to my Father’s house. Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 866 - DO YOU HAVE THE RIGHT MOTIVE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your mark of discipleship is TO CONTINUALLY REMAIN FAITHFUL TO THE WORD (or teaching of Christ). It is not how long you have been a disciple of Jesus, it is how long you will continue to be a disciple of Jesus. Beloved, you must intentionally imbue focus in the teachings of Christ. Author Saturday, 7th June, 2025DO YOU HAVE THE RIGHT MOTIVE?“And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you loosing it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Lord has need of it.” Luke 19:31 (NKJV)Motives make a lot of difference. They determine the extent you go for the Lord.
The right motives dispel any idea of disappointment.
Some people make themselves available and useful to the Lord because of what they will gain.You may be easily discouraged when your motives are centered on fame, power, social standing, and financial gain.The owners of the donkey didn’t need to be convinced with many words.As they heard that the Master was in need of it, they didn’t argue or ask further questions.Which means, their motive for giving out the young donkey was the LORD.
The only reason you must give your resources or even yourself to the Lord must be the LORD!
Doubtlessly, there is honour in serving the Lord.But we must not serve the Lord because we want to be honoured or have an elevated social standing.Your joy should be that through your service to the Lord, many lives have been blessed, and the Lord has been glorified.Our service to the Lord blesses people.It is not to use people as stepping stones on a ladder for your personal levitation to towering applause, validation, and prosperity.From Luke 19, we see how a donkey became a Kingdom celebrity because it was useful to the Lord. And there have been times when the emphasis has moved to how the lonely donkey became honourable.However, we must know that the owners’ motive was not their personal honour and fame, nor that of the donkey."…Because the Lord…" Luke 19:31 (NKJV)Nobody celebrated the donkey, it was the Lord who was celebrated.“So they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it for him to ride on.As he rode along, the crowds spread out their garments on the road ahead of him. When he reached the place where the road started down the Mount of Olives, all of his followers began to shout and sing as they walked along, praising God for all the wonderful miracles they had seen.” Luke 19:35-37Nobody thought of the donkey, it was all about the Lord.
Your joy of service to the Lord should be that He is seen, celebrated, praised, and honoured.
John the Baptist said,"He must increase in importance, while I must decrease in importance", John 3:30 (Names of God Bible)In John 6:1-15, we see a little boy who selflessly gave his lunch to Jesus, and it fed more than 5,000 people. The young boy didn’t consider himself. His motive was this:Jesus needs it, and I will trust Him with it.
The joy of our service and giving to the Lord is for the impact of the Lord in the lives of others.
In 2 Corinthians 12:15, Paul said,"And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?" (Berean Standard Bible)From the Message Bible:” I’d be most happy to empty my pockets, even mortgage my life, for your good. So how does it happen that the more I love you, the less I’m loved?”Amplified:“But I will very gladly spend [my own resources] and be utterly spent for your souls. If I love you greatly, am I to be loved less [by you]?”And then The Passion Translation:“ I am glad to give you myself and all I have for your spiritual good, even though it seems that the more I love you, the less you love me.”
Beloved, the Lord needs you; avail yourself for His use, not because of your selfish gains.
Be motivated and inspired by His Lordship, His love, and the impact of others.” People may be pure in their own eyes, but the LORD examines their motives” Proverbs 16:2 (NLT)Selah.DIG DEEPER(John 6:5-13; 2 Corinthians 1:6,14; James 4:3; 1 Samuel 2:3; 16:7; Proverbs 21:2; Philippians 2:20-22; Colossians 3:23) WE PRAYThat we shall increase in the understanding of the Lord’s intention to rightly correct our motives so that our service may not be of our selfish interests. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 30-322 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I serve the Lord with all of my heart.– Whatever I do, I do as unto the Lord.– I decrease that Christ may increase in me.– I serve the Lord with the right motive; not for fame nor any personal interest.– Many glorify God in me.Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 867 - BE CONSCIOUS OF YOUR PROSPERITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency As you take a step to spread the gospel, you will have confrontations, but don’t tremor. Maintain your bold confidence in God because He is with you. Take advantage of every opportunity to spread the gospel. Shalom! Author Sunday, 8th June, 2025BE CONSCIOUS OF YOUR PROSPERITY"Let them shout for joy and be glad, Who favour my righteous cause; And let them say continually, 'Let the Lord be magnified, Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant.” Psalm 35:27 (NKJV) It’s interesting how some people assume God loves them but doesn’t get involved in their prosperity. God is not only involved in your prosperity, purpose and spiritual growth.
God is involved in the prosperity of your health and finances.
It is the Father’s delight that you prosper financially. Your financial prosperity is a great gain to the expansion and spread of the gospel. The Lord desires that all men shall be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. God’s course is that the earth will be filled with the knowledge of His glory, as the waters cover the sea. (Habakkuk 2:14). When you get involved in the preaching of the gospel in all nations, you will know that money plays an important role in taking the gospel to the ends of the world. Poverty is not an option at all if you want to reach many with the gospel. God doesn’t want anyone to perish (2 Peter 3:9), and beloved, it is costly to reach out to the multitudes in all nations.Paul was able to preach the gospel in many cities and nations because he was financed. (Philippians 4:16-18).
Your prosperity is for the advancement of the gospel, and that is the more reason God is interested in your prosperity.
Again, I admonish you to make prosperity your consciousness. Don’t accept thoughts of poverty. A man who thinks poor cannot do more for the Lord. Be conscious of your prosperity. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(Psalm 1:3; Psalms 35:27; 2 Chronicles 25:9; Genesis 12:2; Deuteronomy 8:18; Proverbs 10:22) WE PRAYThat we will increase in the wisdom to maximize the resources that the Lord has given to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 33-352 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I honour the Lord with my best. – I don’t make excuses as the Lord deserves to have my possessions for His kingdom work. – The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement. – I am excited to give unto the Lord, because it is the greatest privilege. – Whenever the Lord is in need of me, I avail myself with promptness. – Whatever the Lord will request from me, I give with joy. –  I am the blessed of the Lord. – I have super- abundance. – I am blessed in all things. – All grace abounds towards me in all that I do. – I am so rich.– I give bountifully and joyously into the spread of the gospel.– The gospel prospers in my hands through my finances.– I refuse to think poor no matter what.– I refuse to be defined by what I have in my pocket or bank account at any time.– I am defined by the riches in Christ Jesus and I walk in this consciousness everyday.Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 868 - DARKNESS CANNOT PUT OUT THE BLAZING LIFE-LIGHT!
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Where there is doubt there is no faith. Where there is no faith, there cannot be the enjoyment of God’s inheritance. Beloved, refuse to walk in doubt. Author Monday, 9th June, 2025DARKNESS CANNOT PUT OUT THE BLAZING LIFE-LIGHT!"For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries" 1 Corinthians 16:9 (KJV)  Beloved, you should not be surprised when you are confronted by challenges because of the gospel.
Men whose eyes have been blinded by the adversary will always oppose God’s Kingdom plan.
The more you see darkness in a place, the more there is the need for the spread of the gospel wherever you go or move to, identify opportunities to share the gospel.This was something Jesus and the early saints utilised a lot. And even in our day, those who are doing well with the gospel have sharpened their skills to identify doors of opportunity, to spread the gospel. Look at this:"And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people. But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd. Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few" Matthew 9:35-37 (KJV) Do you see it, the moment our Lord Jesus saw the multitudes, He saw the opportunity or the need to get souls saved. When you see people, you must identify the need and the opportunity to spread the gospel. Wherever you go or find yourself, there are opportunities to get many saved. Don’t be threatened by an impending opposition when you identify a door of opportunity.
Be determined to make the most of such opportunities, as the Holy Spirit inspires you.
You will see from the opening verse that Paul did not fret; he was ready to stay in order to utilise the great door which was opened unto him. "Regardless, I will remain in Ephesus until the feast of Pentecost. There’s an amazing door of opportunity standing wide open for me to minister here, even though there are many who oppose and stand against me." 1 Corinthians 16:8-9 (TPT). He decided to stay for more days in Ephesus, to minister there, even though there were many who opposed and stood against him. We will later find out that the gospel grew so much in the city of Ephesus and prevailed. (See Acts 19:1-20) Always have this in mind:DARKNESS CANNOT PUT OUT THE BLAZING LIFE-LIGHT! (John 1:5, Message Bible).
Light doesn’t automatically shine in dark places; you must intentionally cause it to shine.
Jesus said, “Let your light so shine” (Matthew 5:16). The purpose of light is to shine in the darkness. Greater lights are needed to shine in the darkest places. The dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty, thus, we must invade and saturate such places with the blazing life-light. We don’t crawl backwards just because of the violence of darkness. The life-light is the love-light, and it is the greatest force of victory.
Beloved, take advantage of every opportunity to spread the gospel without fear of opposition, for the Lord is with you.
Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 66:5; Luke 6:22; John 15:21; Acts 19:8; 1 Corinthians 15:2; 2 Corinthians 1:8-10) WE PRAYThat no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 36-382 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a terror to the forces of darkness. – I conquer and win more territories for the Lord. – The Lord is with me therefore I fear no evil. – I don’t walk in fear. – No matter the oppositions I face, I refuse to give in. – I remain strong in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 869 - LET NOTHING MOVE YOU AWAY FROM THE CHURCH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t ever think you are not qualified to achieve Kingdom results. Don’t hide in the crowd. God has made you special and given you a special grace for the good works which He has foreordained. God has made you special for His assignment. Yes, you! Beloved, you are the man for the job! Get to work! Author Tuesday, 10th June, 2025LET NOTHING MOVE YOU AWAY FROM THE CHURCH“but if I am delayed, I write so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth” 1 Timothy 3:15 (NKJV)The best place to run to, amidst the uncertainties of this world, is the Church. For the Church is the organic expression of the unshakable Kingdom of God. The people of the world who see the Church as a threat would definitely have a different opinion about this. Nevertheless, the essence and the impact of the Church in the world cannot be denied. From the revelation of the scriptures, there is the affirmation of this truth of the Church and its purpose in this world. The Church is the herald of the glorious news of the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus. Apart from the Church, there is no other community of people anywhere in this world which presents and represents God’s Kingdom.You might have experienced some people within the Church who act contrary to the reality of the Kingdom of our Lord. But that doesn’t deny what the Church is – THE PILLAR OF TRUTH! Selfish men will always look for ways to creep into places and then attempt to make waste of gullible people. However, the light of the truth cannot be comprehended by any dimension of darkness. 
Don’t allow your experiences of some people within the Church to corrupt your love for the Lord, and then move you away from the community of the Church. 
Don’t allow your heart to be steered away from the glorious essence of the Church.The people within the True Church of our Lord Jesus are being nurtured and built-up unto the measure and the stature of the fullness of Christ (Ephesians 4:13). Because of the truth of our Lord Jesus and the work of the Holy Spirit within the Church (the Body of Christ), there is no doubt that in the consummation of all things, the Church will be a spotless community.“Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her, that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word, so that he might present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing, that she might be holy and without blemish.” Ephesians 5:25-27 (ESV)
 There is no single institution in this world which is built on the foundation of the cravings of men that will not sink.
Christ is the foundation of the Church, and He is the Truth. This means the Church is built on Truth and remains solidly strong beyond the end of time.“For no one can lay a foundation other than the one which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.” 1 Corinthians 3:11 (Legacy Standard Bible)Jesus Christ is the chief cornerstone of the Church (Ephesians 2:20).Knowing that Jesus Christ is the foundation and the chief cornerstone of the Church, we must have this unwavering assurance that to be built in the Church is to be built in the bastion of truth. Talking about the Church, I am not speaking of your denomination. I am speaking of the community of Christ, the corporate body of all the saints who stand and walk in the sound doctrine and unadulterated gospel of our Lord Jesus. I am not talking about denominations where the gospel of our Lord Jesus is peddled and don’t esteem sound doctrine.Go for what the Word of God says, and enjoy the revelation of Jesus.
Don’t give your mind to empty traditions and human philosophies, which end up in endless arguments. 
“My counsel for you is simple and straightforward: Just go ahead with what you’ve been given. You received Christ Jesus, the Master; now live him. You’re deeply rooted in him. You’re well constructed upon him. You know your way around the faith. Now do what you’ve been taught. School’s out; quit studying the subject and start living it! And let your living spill over into thanksgiving. Watch out for people who try to dazzle you with big words and intellectual double-talk. They want to drag you off into endless arguments that never amount to anything. They spread their ideas through the empty traditions of human beings and the empty superstitions of spirit beings. But that’s not the way of Christ. Everything of God gets expressed in him, so you can see and hear him clearly. You don’t need a telescope, a microscope, or a horoscope to realize the fullness of Christ, and the emptiness of the universe without him. When you come to him, that fullness comes together for you, too. His power extends over everything.” Colossians 2:6-9 (Message Bible)The fullness of Christ is revealed through His Body, which is the Church.
The Church remains the only Bastion of Truth in this world; therefore, let nothing move you away from the Church!
Be unwaveringly involved or part of what God is doing in His Church.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 28:16; Acts 4:11-12; Ephesians 5:6; Colossians 2:20; Romans 1:21,22; Hebrews 10:25) WE PRAYThat nothing shall sway us of the course of Christ established for us in the Church. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 39-412 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am immovable and eternally part of the body of Christ.- I cannot be deceived by the philosophies and traditions of men.- I am secured in the Kingdom of God.- I am deeply rooted in the truth of God, which is Christ.- I continue in this truth I have received.- I don’t give my hearing to any other voice aside Christ.- I refuse to conform to this world.- I belong to the unshakable Kingdom.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 870 - MAKE MINISTRY SMOOTH FOR YOUR MAN OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter how you think you have offended or disappointed God, He will not withhold His love from you when you call. No matter how deep you have drowned in defeat, God’s unfailing love will sustain you. Trust in the love of God for you, it never fails! Author Wednesday, 11th June, 2025MAKE MINISTRY SMOOTH FOR YOUR MAN OF GOD“Then God who cheers those who are discouraged refreshed us by the arrival of Titus.” 2 Corinthians 7:6 (TLB) Some people don’t make it their priority to be a blessing. And don’t even think they have to make it their priority to support their Leaders or Pastors (Shepherds) in the Church. Some people are dedicated and committed to their “bosses” or employers and even their office supervisors because they esteem their job.
Our participation in the Church will bring us to the fulfillment of God’s eternal purpose.
Your Kingdom relevance is first measured by your relevance in your Local Church. The Holy Spirit will first share the burden of God’s vision and assignment for your Local Church with your Pastor or Shepherd. In the same way, when the adversary wants to attack the vision of the ministry, he will first attack your Pastor or Shepherd. If there should be any discouragement, pain, burden, attacks, persecutions, and threats, your Pastor is the first to take the shots.
Leading and raising the saints could be burdensome.
There are a lot of Pastors who are daily overwhelmed by the task of pastoral care. While some members refuse to be consistent in adhering to instructions and practising the word, others are busily seeking their own interests. Some are also holding grudges and creating conflicts within the Church through lies.  Pastors don’t only deal with the spiritual and numerical growth of the Church. They are also dealing with external confrontations and distractions. Handling every single individual member of the Church with their challenges and also ensuring each of them experiences their victories in Christ. These things don’t just happen weekly or monthly. These are things he is bearing up with every day.
What is your role in all these?
Are you the one who makes ministry easy? Or you are the one who adds to the “pressure”. This is not to say you don’t have to share challenges with your shepherd. However, what difference are you making in your Pastor’s life? Are you the reason he is encouraged and joyful, or are you the reason he has more load of tasks? Or are you making his efforts and labour worthless? Are his visitations, counselling, and prayers for you becoming a waste? He invests all this time and effort, and then you just decide to leave the ministry, not for any divine reason? BE LIKE TITUS! “For even when we arrived in Macedonia our bodies had no rest, but we were oppressed at every turn—conflicts and disputes without, fears and dread within. But God, who comforts and encourages the depressed and the disquieted, comforted us by the arrival of Titus.” 2 Corinthians 7:5-6 (TLB)
Your presence and participation in the Church should be an encouragement to your Pastor.
You have to decide to be a burden bearer and a supply of the Lord’s encouragement to your setman.  Choose to make ministry smooth for your Man of God. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 16:17; 2 Corinthians 7:13; 1 Thessalonians 3:2) WE PRAYThat through the grace of God we will be God’s supply of encouragement to our pastor. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJob 42Psalm 1-22 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a burden bearer. – I am a son of consolation. – I refuse to make it difficult for my Pastor to lead me. – I choose to be the Lord’s supply of encouragement to my Pastor. – I give heed to every instruction given by my man of God. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 871 - NEVER FORGET THESE HEADLINES OF THE GOSPEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To know or perceive God’s voice you must consistently fellowship with the scriptures and also commune with Him in prayer. The speaking of God in your heart is through the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit will only speak what God says. Beloved, Hear His voice today! Author Thursday, 12th June, 2025 NEVER FORGET THESE HEADLINES OF THE GOSPEL"I have told you these things so that you will be filled with my joy. Yes, your joy will overflow!" John 15:11 (NLT)You don't have to hear the gospel and cry in sorrow. The gospel of Jesus produces overflowing joy.The words of Jesus give hope and life.
Remember the Gospel simply means Goodnews!
Every news report has headlines. And God's news also has headlines. As part of the many headlines in God's news, I want you to never forget these three goodnews headlines.1. "JESUS WILL NEVER LEAVE YOU NOR FORSAKE YOU""Let your conduct be without covetousness; be content with such things as you have. For He Himself has said, “I will never leave you nor forsake you." Hebrews 13: 5 (NKJV)This changes everything. To know that the Lord Jesus is with you is the greatest advantage you will ever have. And the adversary is interested in making you feel the Lord has forsaken you. No matter the challenge you go through, maintain this confidence that the Lord will never forsake you. Don't ever ask the question, "Lord, why had thou forsaken me?" Well, Jesus asked such a question because He took on your sins. And now in resurrection, He has declared, "...And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.” Matthew 28:20 (ESV).This is goodnews!Look at Hebrews 13:5 from the Amplified:"Let your character [your moral essence, your inner nature] be free from the love of money [shun greed—be financially ethical], being content with what you have; for He has said, “I WILL NEVER [under any circumstances] DESERT YOU [nor give you up nor leave you without support, nor will I in any degree leave you helpless], NOR WILL I FORSAKE or LET YOU DOWN or RELAX MY HOLD ON YOU [assuredly not]!”Keep this in your heart.2. NO ONE CAN SNATCH YOU OUT OF THE LORD’S HANDS.This is something to shout about!"My own sheep will hear my voice and I know each one, and they will follow me. I give to them the gift of eternal life and they will never be lost and no one has the power to snatch them out of my hands. My Father, who has given them to me as his gift, is the mightiest of all, and no one has the power to snatch them from my Father’s care. The Father and I are one.” John 10:27-30 (TPT)This is an eternal breaking news. This is our LORD showing off His authority and care over those who believe in Him.The Lord Jesus is declaring an eternal assurance of your preservation in Him. He did not mince words. He meant what He said.
Your salvation is eternal.
Whenever you begin to doubt your eternal salvation and security, remember this headline of the Gospel.You are eternally kept in His hands; no one is mightier to snatch you. Why are you living insecurely? You cannot lose any war! You are in the Lord’s hands. Hallelujah!3. YOU ARE IN THE LORD AND HE IS IN YOUIn Colossians 1, Paul the apostle was loud on this goodnews item. When you were born again, you were translated from the power of darkness INTO the Kingdom of His dear Son."He has rescued us completely from the tyrannical rule of darkness and has translated us into the kingdom realm of his beloved Son", Colossians 1:13 (TPT).You are in Him! You are no longer in darkness.In Him you move and have your being.And you are not only in Him, this is the biggest:HE IS IN YOU.Can you imagine what the angels are thinking now?How possible!The fullness of God in you?Well, it was a mystery. It looked impossible, but now God has manifested that dream. It's His heartbeat to indwell you forever. It is no longer a mystery. He is in you now."There is a divine mystery—a secret surprise that has been concealed from the world for generations, but now it’s being revealed, unfolded and manifested for every holy believer to experience. Living within you is the Christ who floods you with the expectation of glory! This mystery of Christ, embedded within us, becomes a heavenly treasure chest of hope filled with the riches of glory for his people, and God wants everyone to know it!" Colossians 1:26-27 (TPT)
This is the news which has sent an eternal shockwave in the entire spiritual and physical universe.
Beloved, rejoice in these realities.Keep this Goodnews in your heart and never let it slip out of your hands. This is your victorious faith, which overcomes the world.Glory to God.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOoc&t=1630sDIG DEEPER(John 17:13; Isaiah 62:4; Jude 1:24; 1 Corinthians 1:8-9; Hebrews 7:25; Ephesians 1:13-14) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall continue in the reality and goodnews of Jesus and not be troubled by the deception of the world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 3-52 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I continue daily in the reality and goodnews of Jesus. - No matter the challenge, I always have this confidence that the Lord will never forsake me. - I am fully convinced that the Lord is with me at all times. - No hand is mightier enough to snatch me away from my Lord's hands. - I cannot lose any war because I am in the Lord's hands. - I am no longer in darkness because I am in Him. - God in His fullness is in me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 872 - GOD IS FAITHFUL TO KEEP YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Many lives will not be impacted or transformed when you keep doubting yourself and what God has called you to do. No matter the insecurities, the doubts and the weakness you feel, stick to what the word says. Shalom! Author Friday, 13th June, 2025 GOD IS FAITHFUL TO KEEP YOU"He will keep you strong to the end so that you will be free from all blame on the day when our Lord Jesus Christ returns." 1 Corinthians 1:8 (NLT)God did not save you to leave you halfway. The salvation of our Lord Jesus is not partial. He did a complete work. Jesus satisfied all the demands of justice in His death, and He brought forth the Newness of life.
The salvation which you received in Christ is always dependent on God's faithfulness.
The faithfulness of God is God upholding the integrity of His words. It is the demonstration of His trustworthiness.Your salvation is eternal and shall not be lost or erased at the coming of the Lord, because God is faithful.He is a good keeper! What is with Him or in His hands shall not be lost.The Lord Jesus said:"My own sheep will hear my voice and I know each one, and they will follow me. I give to them the gift of eternal life and they will never be lost, and no one has the power to snatch them out of my hands. My Father, who has given them to me as his gift, is the mightiest of all, and no one has the power to snatch them from my Father’s care. The Father and I are one.” John 10:27-30 (TPT)When God says He will keep you to the end, it is His personal commitment. Nothing can take you out of His hands.Paul the apostle reiterated the words of Jesus:"He will keep you strong to the end so that you will be free from all blame on the day when our Lord Jesus Christ returns. God will do this, for He is faithful to do what he says, and he has invited you into partnership with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord." 1 Corinthians 1:8-9 (NLT). Glory to God!
God's word does not return to Him void. Whatever He says is true and shall come to pass.
The moment He said, "...whosoever believe in Him shall not perish but have everlasting life", His faithfulness was activated in that word. The moment you believed in the Lord Jesus, God has no choice but to be faithful to His word. He will keep you to the end.This was Paul's confidence:"being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus." (Philippians 1:6).The first-century believers also had this same confidence:"Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy" (Jude 1:24)You must have this same confidence in God. He is faithful to keep you to the end.
You are not to be afraid of the future; the Lord is faithful.
He is faithful, therefore, "before you do anything, put your trust totally in God and not in yourself. Then every plan you make will succeed." Proverbs 16:3 (TPT)Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/Xq_hyl_FOocDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 5:27; Thessalonians 3:3; 1 Peter 1:5; 2 Timothy 1:12; Hebrews 10:23) WE PRAYWe pray, thanking the Lord for the faithfulness of His word and His wisdom to keep us from falling.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 6-82 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:- None of my steps will slide because I am kept by the Lord.- No hand is mightier enough to snatch me away from my Lord’s hands. - I have no fear of the future because the Lord is faithful. - I am fully convinced in this reality that the Lord is faithful to keep me to the end. - I have received an eternal salvation which shall not be lost or erased. - My future is secure because the Lord is faithful. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 873 - DON'T WORRY ABOUT YOUR FUTURE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t settle for the limitations around you. Don’t think according to your background or where you live. Don’t make decisions according to how you feel. In Christ Jesus, there are no limitations. Beloved, all limitations are mental illusions. Walk in the reality of the Word of God. Shake yourself from every yoke of the mind and of the heart. Live above all limitations. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 14th June, 2025DON'T WORRY ABOUT YOUR FUTURE"For I know the plans and thoughts that I have for you,’ says the Lord, ‘plans for peace and well-being and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope"Jeremiah 29:11 (Amplified) Sometimes, when you look at your past, family, and the challenges confronting you, the future seems gloomy. 
The thing is, if you are of God and moving in the direction of God’s word, you don’t have to be afraid.
The gloomy pictures of your future are not real. You don’t have to make it your meditation. Give your mind and heart to the meditation of the word of God. It is what God has said, not how you feel.The Jews found themselves in a situation where they were afraid of the outcome of their lives. Their future seems scary and unpleasant in their minds. And the Lord had to comfort them with these words: "For I know the plans and thoughts that I have for you,’ says the Lord, ‘plans for peace and well-being and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope." Jeremiah 29:11 (Amplified Bible). Now these are not just words to the Jews only. The Lord has good plans for His people. Only good and perfect gifts come from God. (See James 1:17). His thoughts of you and your future are great and glorious.You don’t have to trust the systems of this world than God.Whatever God says is true and forever.
Today, I want you to know that your future is already blessed because God is the designer of your life.
Yours is to trust the process of His eternal counsel for your life. "The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generation" Psalm 33:11 The word of the Lord is the counsel of the Lord. Your future is secured by the counsel of the Lord, stand on it!!! Selah.DIG DEEPER(Lamentations 3:26; Psalm 40:5; Isaiah 55:12) WE PRAYThanking God for His eternal counsel and thought concerning us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 9-112 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My future is secured by the counsel of the Lord. – I trust the process of God’s eternal counsel for my life. – God is the designer of my life. – I have set my gaze on the word of God so I don’t spend time worrying. – My life is as a shinning light that shines brighter and brighter unto a perfect day. – My life is for the glory of God. Hallelujah !!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 874 - THIS IS THE WAY OUT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You are seated with Christ, refuse to be intimidated by any dominion or rule which is under the feet of Christ. As members of His body, anything under His feet is under our feet. Walk in this consciousness of authority. Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 15th June, 2025 THIS IS THE WAY OUT“He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church.” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (NKJV)Some people have refused to accept the reality of tongues-speaking. Some of these people even make a mockery of this special gift of the Spirit given to all believers.Some think that because the tongues believers speak are not understandable, they are useless and mere gimmicks.Tongues speaking is the communion between the one speaking and God. To speak in tongues is to speak mysteries.
Whereas prophecies edify or build up the Church or benefit all the saints; tongues speaking builds up the individual believer.
“But [on the other hand] the one who prophesies speaks to people for edification [to promote their spiritual growth] and [speaks words of] encouragement [to uphold and advise them concerning the matters of God] and [speaks words of] consolation [to compassionately comfort them]” 1 Corinthians 14:3 (Amplified Bible)Tongues speaking is one of the quickest means by which a believer experiences personal edification. The apostle Paul said, “I thank God that I speak in [unknown] tongues more than all of you” 1 Corinthians 14:18 (Amplified Bible).Take note of this in the opening verse:“He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself…”The word edify is from the Greek word “oikodomēo”, which means to construct a house or to be a house builder. It is also an expression which connotes the strengthening of a great or huge building.And when you speak in tongues (note what he said), “EDIFIES HIMSELF”.Paul didn’t say, he who speaks in tongues edifies only his spirit. He said HIMSELF. This has to do with your entire being. Through tongues-speaking, you build your spirit, your soul and your body.
Through tongues-speaking, you make supplication of power to your body. This deals with anxiety and fear.
Anxiety leads to depression and also triggers your flight-or-fight stress response. It releases a flood of adrenaline into your system. The moment anxiety persists within you, it will lead to chronic stress, and even when the stressful moment passes, your body remains in that state where the system is flooded with adrenaline chemicals.That may lead to weakness in the immune system. The moment your immune system becomes weak, it becomes vulnerable to prevent infections and viruses.This is how people who are often stressed get sick easily. Do you now understand why you become weak after you have been overwhelmed with sorrow and sadness for a long time?“A joyful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones” Proverbs 17:22 (ESV).That is why the Apostle Paul charged the brethren in Philippi:“do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.” Philippians 4:6 (ESV)
Instead of worry and sorrow, pray. And most importantly to build up your entire being, pray in tongues.
