When a believer in Christ speaks in tongues, he releases spiritual currents of power and unleashes energies from the Spirit to his entire being (spirit, soul and body). You receive endowment in your spirit, and also in your mind to make decisions, to direct your emotions, to be refreshed and quickened in the body.Don’t go a day without speaking in tongues.Get to it now!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOoc&t=1630sDIG DEEPER(Acts 2:4; 1 Corinthians 14:14,26; Jude 1:20) WE PRAYPray thanking the Lord for the ability of the Spirit to pray in tongues.(Spend some hours praying in tongues).BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 12-142 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I dont’t trviliase the precious gift of tongues speaking. – Under all circumstaces and at all times, I have the strength to carry out the assignment God has given unto me. – I don’t lack strength, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– I don’t consider oppositions or pressures, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– Through the precious gift of tongues speaking, I edify myself to be a blessing unto many. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 875 - RELEASE SWEETNESS TO YOUR SOUL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be discerning and think as a helper. Instead of persecuting people with your words and complaints. Spend time in prayer for them. Love does not assume. Love is intentional. Be HELPFUL AT ALL TIMES. Selah! Author Monday, 16th June, 2025 RELEASE SWEETNESS TO YOUR SOUL"Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones." Proverbs 16:24 (KJV)Words are carriers of atmospheres and change factors.Things don't just happen to people. People don't just swing into moods. Your state of mind doesn't just happen.
How you think about life, others, and even yourself is a result of the words you think on.
Your present state of mind is a result of words. You cannot separate words from the existence of men.At His speaking, He commanded light into the chaotic universe. All that God created in His universe was by words.By His words, the oceans' depths were poured out, all glorious fountains overflowed with water, the subterranean fountains began to flow strongly, and spoke the decrees of the seas, commanding the waves so that they wouldn’t overstep their boundaries.His words sculpted the mountains and raised up the hills. The fields, even the first atom of dust, came by His word. His words hung the tapestry of the heavens and stretched out the horizon of the earth.His words set the clouds and skies in place and also set in place the pillars of the earth.Before God formed man, He spoke forth His intentions."And God said, "Let us make man..." (Genesis 1:26).After creating man, He blessed (programmed) man with words."And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth." Genesis 1:28 (KJV)
Everything you see around you came into being by words and responds to words.
Your life is a product of words. You cannot live above the words you keep uttering."Words kill, words give life; they’re either poison or fruit—you choose" Proverbs 18:21 (The Message) Choose words that give life. Be intentional or mindful of the words you speak. Don't speak doubt, defeat, or discouraging words. Speak forth the reality of God concerning you. Speak the Goodnews of Jesus. "Nothing is more appealing than speaking beautiful, life-giving words. For they release sweetness to our souls and inner healing to our spirits." Proverbs 16:24 (TPT)Jesus is a life-giving spirit. To speak life-giving words means you are speaking words which are consistent with the testimony of Jesus about you.Don't speak of incapability. His grace is sufficient for you.This is why you must grow in the revelation of the gospel of Jesus.
To speak sweetness to your soul, say what God has said to you.
"How sweet are Your words to my taste—sweeter than honey in my mouth" (Psalm 119:103)By the life-giving words you speak, you release sweetness into your soul. This is the secret:- to have a sound mind.- to be established and certain in your choices. It means your will is strengthened and subdued by the perfect will of God.- to possess well-guided and Holy Spirit influenced will.- to have a healthy life.Don't allow chaos and distress to germinate in your soul. Release sweetness into your soul by speaking life-giving words.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 15:4; Proverbs 25: 11; Proverbs 12:18; Ephesians 4:29; Colossians 4:6; James 3:17-18) WE PRAYWe pray that the wisdom of God shall flood our thoughts and lips, that we may speak life in all things.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 15-172 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My words are consistent with the testimony of Jesus concerning me. - I don't speak discouraging words. - My words edifies and build others. - I don't allow chaos and distress to germinate in my soul. - I speak life-giving words at all times.  Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 876 - YOUR VALUE NEVER DECREASES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Are you struggling with low self-esteem? Has that also become your limitation? Faith is your way out of that limitation. The word of God builds you up as an edifice and makes you rise above these inner limitations by faith. Beloved, make a decision today to walk in faith. Author Tuesday, 17th June, 2025 YOUR VALUE NEVER DECREASES"Look at all the birds—do you think they worry about their existence? They don’t plant or reap or store up food, yet your heavenly Father provides them each with food. Aren’t you much more valuable to your Father than they?" Matthew 6:26 (TPT)The death of Jesus for you and your participation in His Newness of life, which was dispensed through His resurrection, provides the extent of your value before God. You were bought with a price (1 Corinthians 6:20)Your cost price is Jesus Himself.
Even when you were a sinner, you were valuable before God.
"But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." Romans 5:8 (Berean Standard Bible)Your value never decreases before God's love. He proved His value to you by how He saved you.By which standard do you think you have no value?The challenges you have gone through, your defeats, failures, and terrible mistakes do not change or diminish your value before the Lord.If your value doesn't decrease or diminish before the Lord, is it the negative report of men that matters to you?
Since you are still valuable even by God's standard, why are you subjecting yourself to the negative standards of men?
Between God and men, who has higher standards? Whose verdict of you matters the most?"So, what does all this mean? If God has determined to stand with us, tell me, who then could ever stand against us? For God has proved his love by giving us his greatest treasure, the gift of his Son. And since God freely offered him up as the sacrifice for us all, he certainly won’t withhold from us anything else he has to give. Who then would dare to accuse those whom God has chosen in love to be his? God himself is the judge who has issued his final verdict over them—“Not guilty!”Stop judging yourself wrongly.Stop devaluing yourself with negative words.Speak sweetness to yourself.
Whenever you stand in front of a mirror, speak forth the value God has placed on you.
You are not ordinary.Why worry about your existence when you have great value before the Lord?Walk in this consciousness every day of your life, no matter your experiences and the judgment of men.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e73Aam9JWYYDIG DEEPER(Luke 12:6-7,24; Matthew 10:29-31; Isaiah 43:4; Matthew 20:28; Psalm 139:13-14; Ephesians 2:10) WE PRAYThank you, Lord, for making me a person of value and your treasured possession. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 18-202 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am valuable to God. - I don't subject myself to the negative standards of men. - The verdict of God about my worth is what matters to me. - I am not ordinary. - I am the beloved of God. - I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. - I walk daily in the consciousness of my worth before God. - I have been bought with the precious blood of Jesus therefore I am precious before God. - My cost price is God Himself. - I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 877 - HIS LOVE FOR YOU IS UNFAILING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter how little or how big the matter is, trust the Lord. The Lord will always deliver, protect, defend, preserve, provide, and prosper you. Refuse to limit His ability in you. Author Wednesday, 18th June, 2025   HIS LOVE FOR YOU IS UNFAILING “Praise the Lord! He is good. God’s love never fails. Praise the God of all gods. God’s love never fails. Praise the Lord of lords. God’s love never fails.”  Psalm 136:1-3 (CEV) You cannot live insecure when you understand God’s love for you.Everything God has done for you is first according to his love. His love is unconditional; it is not dependent on what you do. Your faith only helps you position yourself to enjoy the unlimited flow of His love.This is it, no matter how you are loved, you must receive that love to experience its full manifestation.
No matter how God loves you unconditionally, His love wouldn’t have great transformational impact on you when you don’t receive it.
God’s lovingkindness enforces the wielding of His power. Just as I mentioned yesterday, Jehoshaphat went to war with the army of Judah, led by the musicians. And all they kept declaring through singing was that “His love endures forever!”.No storm, no limitation, and no evil can withstand the love of God. And that is the light Psalm 136 brings to us.The chapter outlines some examples of things we enjoy because of His love. The Psalmist used God’s dealings with Israel as the case study.“Praise the Lord! He is good.God’s love never fails.Praise the God of all gods.God’s love never fails.Praise the Lord of lords.God’s love never fails.” Verses 1-3 provide a description of who God is, His authority and the Supremacy of his love above all other gods and lords.These verses are to establish the incomparable status of God and the lifeless gods. As His love never fails and endures forever, the gods cannot love at all.Which means it makes no sense to claim to be of God and still have confidence in other gods.From the subsequent verses ( 4 — 26), we see the mighty workings of His love.“Only God works great miracles. God’s love never fails.” (verse 4)Did you notice the first two words in this verse? ONLY GOD…You cannot find mighty or great miracles elsewhere. It is ONLY God who does great miracles. And it is according to His steadfast love, which cannot fail.Now the Psalmist zooms in on the detailed examples of God’s creative or mighty workings. Psalm 136 reveals that God’s creative work was not only by His wisdom. It was by the partnership of His wisdom and unfailing love.
The goal is for you to see that, God’s steadfast and unfailing love cannot be separated. 
All of  God’s essential qualities find expression through His love. “With wisdom He made the sky. God’s love never fails. The Lord stretched the earthover the ocean. God’s love never fails. He made the bright lights in the sky. God’s love never fails. He lets the sun rule each day. God’s love never fails. He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God’s love never fails.” (Verses 5 – 9)No other god can function in the wisdom which God exudes in His creation. God’s steadfast and unfailing love is at the center of His creative power. The steadfast love of God not only partners with God’s wisdom to demonstrate His creative power. The steadfast love of God also partners with God’s power to preserve, protect or defend His people (those who receive His love). See verses 10 – 24:“God struck down the first-bornin every Egyptian family. God’s love never fails. He rescued Israel from Egypt. God’s love never fails. God used his great strength and his powerful arm.God’s love never fails. He split the Red Sea[b] apart. God’s love never fails. The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea.God’s love never fails. He destroyed the Egyptian kingand his army there. God’s love never fails. The Lord led his people through the desert. God’s love never fails. Our God defeated mighty kings. God’s love never fails. And he killed famous kings. God’s love never fails. One of them was Sihon,king of the Amorites. God’s love never fails. Another was King Og of Bashan. God’s love never fails. God took away their land. God’s love never fails. He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God’s love never fails. God saw the trouble we were in. God’s love never fails. He rescued us from our enemies. God’s love never fails.”Some assume God’s love is defenseless. That is never true. God can go to any extent by His righteousness to preserve His people against wickedness.“He gives food to all who live. God’s love never fails.” (Verse 25)
God’s unfailing and steadfast love partners with God’s wisdom to create. It partners with God’s power to preserve, protect and also to provide.
“Praise God in heaven! God’s love never fails.” (Verse 26).When you acknowledge and focus on God’s unfailing and steadfast love, your heart will be full of praise. His unconditional love remains steadfast on earth, in heaven and all eternity.God’s steadfast and unfailing love is proclaimed twenty-six (26) times in Psalm 136.The consistent repetition of “God’s love never fails” works the truth deeply into our hearts and makes it our conviction, consciousness and confidence.When you make the testimony of God’s steadfast love your meditation, it will always echo in your heart when there is a storm or any form of uproar or challenge around your life.
Beloved let this be woven in your heart that in all things at all times, GOD’S LOVE NEVER FAILS!
He satisfies you with His love each morning.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F2ptPfOwsCA&t=12sDIG DEEPER (Hosea 11:4; Deuteronomy 7:8;   Psalm 36:7; Psalm 90:14; Lamentation 3:22; 1 John 4:16; Hosea 14:4; Psalm 103:8)   WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall be established in God’s unfailing love and we shall walk in the confidence that God’s love shall never fail no matter the challenge.   BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025 1 YEAR PLANPsalm 21-23 2 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 13 DECLARE THESE WORD— I enjoy God’s love every morning.— I grow in the understanding of the Love of God— I live in the confidence of the love of God .—  I step out every day knowing that God’s lovingkindness abounds towards me— I walk in the consciousness of the unlimited and inexhaustible flow of God’s love in my life and all I do.   Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 878 - BE A HELPER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, don’t give the adversary a lot of credence. He is not ahead of you, he is far behind schedule. Be in tune with God and follow His plan for your life. Act fast when the Lord instructs. Selah! Author Thursday, 19th June, 2025 BE A HELPER“Abandon every display of selfishness. Possess a greater concern for what matters to others instead of your own interests”Philippians 2:4 (TPT)The Newness of life is not a self-centred life. It is love-dispensing and life-giving.The world emphasises self-care and self-love. The explanation of these concepts may seem highly reasonable, but that is not the Kingdom’s way.Jesus, speaking to His disciples said, “The greatest among you will be the one who always serves others from the heart.” (Matthew 23:11 ~ TPT).
There is no greatness in the Kingdom without genuine service.
A genuine servant-heart is a selfless heart. No selfish person can serve genuinely. And such a person cannot consistently make a difference in the lives of others.You cannot be helpful when you are occupied with yourself. You wouldn’t even be able to identify or perceive the need to help someone who needs help until you look beyond yourself.Your relevance will always be connected to the selfless help you give to others.
 A helper is selfless!
Does that mean you don’t have needs to attend to?You do!And it’s the reason being a helper will not always be convenient. That is what love represents. True love is proven when there is sacrifice.You may do good things out of convenience, but the true state of your love is proven when you have to move out of your convenience to make a sacrifice.Understand that being helpful wouldn’t always be convenient. However, you will be able to help others with ease, because the love of God is at work in you.In this dimension of love, faith finds greater expression.  While looking beyond yourself to demonstrate love to others, you maintain strong faith in God that He will keep you from falling and supply your personal needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus. Maybe you are reading this and feel tired of doing good or helping others because people seem to be unappreciative.
Do not let the wrongs of others redefine the goodness of God in you.
Continue doing good for others, whether they appreciate it or not.God, who made this whole universe for the benefit of men, is not appreciated by men. People whose entire existence depends on God still conceive hatred towards God in their hearts.This has not changed the goodness of God towards mankind. He still loves us.“So let’s not get tired of doing what is good. At just the right time we will reap a harvest of blessing if we don’t give up.” Galatians 6:9 (NLT).The scriptures charged us not to get tired of doing good, because one may definitely get tired. Set your mind on the harvest of the Lord. There is nothing good you do which shall be in vain.
Just in case you feel tired, confused and discouraged in helping others, don’t continue listening to what you feel, turn to the Lord. Talk to the Holy Spirit, He is your ULTIMATE HELP.
Don’t feel discouraged and say, “I am not God.” It’s a wrong utterance. Yes, you are not GOD, but you are the expression of God. You are the man God has chosen to work through. It’s a privilege!Be HELPFUL AT ALL TIMES.SELAH.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-MDIG DEEPER(1 John 4:7-8, 11-13; Colossians 3:12-14; 1 John 3:16-18; 1 Corithians 15:58; 2 Thessalonians 3:13) WE PRAYPray that the Holy Spirit will supply us with fresh strength to continue to help others without getting weary. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 24-262 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a helper unto many.– I demonstrate the love of God unto all.– I don’t hold back in helping others. – I go every extent to extend help unto others. – My words bring healing to the broken hearted. – I don’t talk people down, I rather uplift others. – I don’t accuse and condemn others. – Many find comfort and peace through me. – I bring joy to others wherever I go.– The love of God is increasingly at work in me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 879 - PROFIT FROM TRIALS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Amidst the chaotic situation of darkness in this world, there is the shining forth of God’s light over those who trust in Him. Beloved, take heed to the Goodnews of Jesus and not the news of this world. Author Friday, 20th June, 2026 PROFIT FROM TRIALS"Instead, be glad that you are in the very thick of what Christ experienced. This is a spiritual refining process, with glory just around the corner." 1 Peter 4:13 (Message Bible)No evil comes from God, because there is no evil in Him."They will declare, “The LORD is just! He is my rock! There is no evil in him!” Psalm 92:15 (NKJV)Every good and perfect gift comes from God (James 1:17). The plans of God for you are plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future (Jeremiah 29:11).Though you will face divers trials in this journey of faith, God doesn't manufacture trials for you. God only takes advantage of these trials to help you produce patience. As a believer, don't turn your back on God because of the challenges you go through. Don't conclude that God has left you. God is on the job behind the scenes to make you profit.
When you are confronted by challenges, don't be drawn away from God. Learn to remain resolute in the word of God.
You profit from challenges. All things work together for your good. "Friends, when life gets really difficult, don’t jump to the conclusion that God isn’t on the job. Instead, be glad that you are in the very thick of what Christ experienced. This is a spiritual refining process, with glory just around the corner." 1 Peter 4:12-13 (The Message Bible)Don't let life challenges break you! See the trials and challenges as a spiritual refining process. And have the conviction that your glory and celebration are around the corner. Therefore, you must have an attitude of joy when you are going through trials. To maintain an attitude of joy means that you have the assurance that glory is coming!Don't just go through the trials. Don't just go through the challenges. Do you feel devastated because of the trials? 
Because you are with God and He is working behind the scenes, know that you shall make bountiful profit of patience and glory through these trials.
Take a look at Paul's conviction:"I want you to know, dear ones, what has happened to me has not hindered, but helped my ministry of preaching the gospel, causing it to expand and spread to many people. For now the elite Roman guards and government officials overseeing my imprisonment have plainly recognized that I am here because of my love for the Anointed One. And what I’m going through has actually caused many believers to become even more courageous in the Lord and to be bold and passionate to preach the Word of God, all because of my chains." Philippians 1:12-14 (TPT)Oh hallelujah!Beloved, as you are in Christ, no challenge has the capacity to destroy you. Stand in the word and you shall make more profit of glory.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOoc&t=1630sDIG DEEPER(James 1:2-4; Romans 5:3-5; 1 Peter 1:6-7; Hebrews 12:11; Acts 5:41; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be trained to profit in the midst of trials and not rather fainted by trials. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 27-292 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to draw back from God no matter the situation I face. - I remain resolute in the word of God at all seasons of my life. - All things work together for my good. - No challenge has what it takes to break me. - No matter the challenge I face, I continually remain convinced that there is glory and celebration around the corner. [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 880 - LIVE BY THE DOMINION OF RIGHTEOUSNESS IN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do you know the number of times the adversary has plotted against your life and destiny? Yet God’s Mercy has always protected and sustained you. That is why your boast must not be in anything of your effort. Your boast and confidence should be in God who is rich in Mercy. Hallelujah! Author Saturday, 21st June, 2025LIVE BY THE DOMINION OFRIGHTEOUSNESS IN YOU"What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?"  Romans 6:1 (NKJV) The question in the opening verse is one of the most asked questions concerning the gospel of the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. Most people ask this question because they doubt the power of the gospel. Some also ask such questions because they think people will take advantage of the goodness of the gospel to sin. This is it, anyone who decides to use the liberty of the gospel as an occasion to sin did not truly hear the gospel, nor did such a person receive the love of Christ. The gospel of our Lord Jesus is the revelation of the love of God. Sin is influenced by selfishness. Sin is anything that is not of faith. “But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because he does not eat from faith; for whatever is not from faith is sin.” Romans 14:23 (NKJV) And faith works in love. “For when we place our faith in Christ Jesus, there is no benefit in being circumcised or being uncircumcised. What is important is faith expressing itself in love.” Galatians 5:6 (NLT). Nowhere did the gospel suggest that we should continue to sin because of the grace of God. And most people who ask the question, “Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?” seek a reason to accuse the gospel. However, Paul asked the question rhetorically to bring to his readers the hardcore truth of the gospel. After explaining the participation of those who are saved in the death, burial and resurrection of Jesus, he established the reality that as you are saved, you should reckon yourself dead to sin. You don’t reckon yourself dead to sin because you first lived right. You don’t reckon yourself dead to sin according to your good works.
You reckon yourself dead to sin on the grounds of how Christ died to sin and defeated sin once and for all.
Jesus did not only die FOR you. He also died WITH you.This is the testimony for all men, that Christ died for them. Therefore, salvation is available for all men. However, when one comes to believe in Jesus and receives salvation, he or she is identified with Christ.The testimony of the saved is that his or her old man and nature died with Christ. And now in Christ, he or she is a new creation. Now see these two verses:2 Corinthians 5:17 and Galatians 2:20.2 Corinthians 5:17 (Amplified). "Therefore if anyone is in Christ [that is, grafted in, joined to Him by faith in Him as Savior], he is a new creature [reborn and renewed by the Holy Spirit]; the old things [the previous moral and spiritual condition] have passed away. Behold, new things have come [because spiritual awakening brings a new life]."See Galatians 2:20 (TPT): "My old identity has been co-crucified with Messiah and no longer lives; for the nails of his cross crucified me with him. And now the essence of this new life is no longer mine, for the Anointed One lives his life through me— we live in union as one! My new life is empowered by the faith of the Son of God who loves me so much that he gave himself for me, and dispenses his life into mine" So when you got saved, you were united with Christ. And the old man was crucified with Christ on the cross. The old, wretched nature of sin died with Christ. Let’s also take a look at Romans 6:5-13; "For if we have been united together in the likeness of His death, certainly we also shall be in the likeness of His resurrection, knowing this, that our old man was crucified with Him, that the body of sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves of sin"(vv 5-6) You can see here again that as you were united together in the death of Jesus, your old man, who was the embodiment of sin, was crucified with Christ.
Now, if you are in Christ, you don’t have the nature of sin in your spirit.
You are a new creation, and you share in the likeness of the resurrection of Jesus. You have the new life of Christ. This life is not a slave controlled by sin. "For he who has died has been freed from sin. Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him, knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over Him. For the death that He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life that He lives, He lives to God. Likewise you also, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord" (vv 7-11) Now, from the revelation of scriptures, you understand that Jesus died to sin once and for all and lives unto God forever. Therefore, because you are identified with Christ in His death, you are also alive to God in Christ once and for all. When you were made alive in God in Christ, it was not with the nature of sin. The nature of sin was terminated in the death of Jesus. Therefore, you are dead to sin and alive to God in Christ Jesus, with the nature of righteousness. You did not become alive to yourself and the legalism of Moses.You were made alive to God in Christ with the nature of righteousness. It means now you must live according to the dominion of righteousness in you. 
You are no longer under the influence of sin, because the power of His resurrection has produced the righteousness of God in Christ in you.
Live every day of your life with the consciousness that you are a new man. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xq_hyl_FOoc&t=1630sDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:1; Romans 7:8; Romans 8:2; Romans 6:15; Galatians 2:19-21; 2 Corinthians 5:16-17,21; Romans 6:1-15; Galatians 2:17-21; Ephesians 2:1-6) WE PRAYThat we will live according to the dominion of righteousness in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 30-322 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am crucified with Christ. – The life of Christ is at work in me. – I am dead to sin and its power. – I can’t continue in sin because I am dead to sin and alive to God in Christ. – I am now quickened unto life. – The life of Christ is at work in me. – I am dead to sin and alive unto God. – Sin has no dominion over me. I am the righteousness of God in Christ. – I live above every negative addiction. – I cannot be influenced by the lust of sin, because I am a slave of righteousness. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 881 - YOU ARE FAR ABOVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you learn to speak right, you avoid unnecessary conflicts and even stagnation. Beloved, let gracious words proceed out of your mouth. Let your tongue be soaked with wisdom. Author Sunday, 22nd June, 2025YOU ARE FAR ABOVE"And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus"Ephesians 2:6 (KJV)The new man in Christ is not a fallen man. The new man in Christ is risen with Christ.
The consequence of sin is death.
“but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die.” Genesis 2:17 (NKJV)Again, we see this affirmed in Romans 6:23:“For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.” (KJV)Jesus' death was a payment of the penalty of sin. And this is the twofold reality of the death of Jesus:– Jesus DIED FOR all men (Substitutionary sacrifice). Jesus didn’t only die for those who believed in Him. He died for both those who reject Him and those who receive Him.– Jesus DIED WITH all those who received Him (Identification). The thing is, until you receive Christ, you don’t share in the benefits of His death, even though He died for you. When you receive Jesus, you become a participant in the reality of His death, burial and resurrection.The climax of Jesus’ death and resurrection was in His exaltation. Jesus, who is God, became flesh and humbled Himself even unto the death of shame. By this demonstration of obedience, He multiplied His authority and greatness in resurrection and ascension. (Philippians 2:6-10).
To be seated with Christ simply means to be alive with Christ and to share in His authority.
The believer is seated in Christ through faith. This faith is dependent on all that Christ achieved through His work and resurrection. Through Christ’s work, the believer is legally qualified to share in the authority of Jesus.The believer in Christ has come into union with Christ. All believers or saints in Christ are members of His body of His flesh and His bones. (Ephesians 5:30)As members of His body, we also exude His authority. Jesus is seated far above all rule and authority and power and dominion [whether angelic or human], and eternally [far above] every name that is named [above every title that can be conferred]. Since we are seated with Christ, we share with Him in this greatness of authority, for Christ demonstrates His rule through His Church (Ephesians 1:19-23).You are seated with Christ, refuse to be intimidated by any dominion or rule which is under the feet of Christ. As members of His body, anything under His feet is under our feet.
Walk in this consciousness of authority.
Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-M&pp=0gcJCb4JAYcqIYzvDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:19-23; Ephesians 2:13; Colossians 2:12; Romans 6:4-5) WE PRAYWe pray that the authority of Jesus will be demonstrated in this generation through His Church according to the boldness of the Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 33-352 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am seated in glory.– I don’t live as a fallen man. – I live daily in the consciousness of my seated position of glory in Christ. – My present location is far above in glory. – I live a glorious life. – I have the mind of Christ because I am far above all. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 882 - STAND IN THE GAP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Unforgiveness or holding on to an offence is a destructive weapon of the enemy. You may think you are doing the right thing by giving a forensic look at the situation. But beloved listen, that is a snare of the adversary. Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Author Monday, 23rd June, 2025STAND IN THE GAP"The people then cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD…" Numbers 11:2 (New American Standard Bible) As the light of the world, the Lord has called you and sent you to give direction and meaning to lives. As a New Creation in Christ, you have the mandate to lead your generation. You are called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose.
The first step in fulfilling the assignment of leadership is to entrust the assignment to God.
The core element of every leader’s assignment is people. Every leader is sent out by God to provide answers to the people, irrespective of their condition or needs. However, kingdom leaders are sent men, and are not to be GOD to the people. Leaders must therefore see themselves as intercessors. You shape the destinies of people by first praying to the One who has FOREORDAINED THEIR DESTINIES. Whenever the people of Israel turned away from God or blamed Moses for their condition (instead of taking responsibility for their fears and anxiety), Moses’ reaction was to intercede for the people. Moses didn’t lead the people of Israel by his own strength. He led Israel through the power of Intercession.
To intercede is to commit the burdens of your community, or the institution of people you are leading, to God.
The adversary sought to destroy lives and destinies, and your strategy is to go into prayer of intercession and also take up intercessory projects which shall help shape the lives entrusted to you.Jesus said: "And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren" Luke 22:31-32 (KJV).
As a leader, instead of complaining, you stand in the gap for the people entrusted to you by the Lord.
To lead your generation is not to lord yourself over them, but to serve. And the first step you have to take in the service of others is to intercede for them.BE AN INTERCESSOR TODAY.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q61zOXi28-8DIG DEEPER(Matthew 5:13-16; Numbers 21:7; Numbers 11:1-2; Romans 1:8-10; 1 Thessalonians 1:2-3; Philippians 1:3-4) WE PRAYThat we will continually stand in the gap for the people the Lord has entrusted to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 36-392 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose. – I don’t complain about the people the Lord has entrusted to me, rather I intercede for them. – I serve my generation first through intercession. – I don’t lead by my own strength, I lead by the strength of the Lord. – Through my intercession for the people the Lord has entrusted to me, their lives are directed and shaped unto purpose. – I am an intercessor. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 883 - ARE YOU AN ETERNAL SHINING STAR IN THE KINGDOM?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you humble yourself before the Lord, you will not be able to take advantage of His supply to prevail. Beloved, the adversary desires to sift you, however, you must yield to prayer and not your self-confidence. Selah! Author Tuesday, 24th June, 2025 ARE YOU AN ETERNAL SHINING STAR IN THE KINGDOM?“Those who manifest wisdom will shine like the brightness of the expanse of heaven, and those who turn many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.” Daniel 12:3 (ISV)
A true shining star in the Kingdom is the one who turns many unto righteousness.
From the opening verse, you will realise there is no ending to the shining and brightness of those who turn many unto righteousness.The verse points to what shall be when all things have been consummated. It is a prophetic scripture which brings us to the realisation of events at the end of things.“And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book. And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt. And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars forever and ever.” Daniel 12:1-3 (KJV)The wise are those who will receive the Lord. And those who will shine eternally as stars have not only turned to righteousness or received the Lord, but have also laboured to turn many to righteousness.
The assignment is clearly defined: TURN MANY UNTO RIGHTEOUSNESS.
This is what Jesus came to do, to get many saved (to turn them unto righteousness); and now He has entrusted this assignment unto our care. “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new. And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation; To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.” 2 Corinthians 5:17-19 (KJV).We have been given the mandate and the message to reconcile many unto God.
It doesn’t matter your profession or social responsibility, you have a kingdom mandate to turn many unto righteousness.
This is the role of the wise in the Kingdom (Proverbs 11:30).God desires that all men may be saved and come to the knowledge of Christ ( 1 Timothy 2:4).
You are the light of the world, let your light shine; get many saved unto the glory of God.
Are you an eternal shining star in the Kingdom?How are you involved in turning many unto righteousness?Step out of your comfort zone and get someone saved today.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUUw65cgGRgDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 53:11; Luke 1:77; Luke 24:47; Habakkuk 2:14; Isaiah 49:6; Matthew 18:11; John 17:3; Matthew 13:43; Matthew 19:28; Luke 5:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be diligent in the business of our Lord, which is to turn many to righteousness and shine eternally as stars of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 40-422 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an eternal shining star in the Kingdom. – I turn many unto righteousness. – It doesn’t matter where I find myself, I shine brightly as the light of the world. – Many coming to the knowledge of Christ because of me. – I step out , I don’t sit on the fence.  – I spare none. – I am bold and confident about this. – I shine eternally! Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 884 - THIS SHOULD ALWAYS BE YOUR RESPONSE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t treat the work of the ministry as an assignment which will go on forever. You must be committed to this work because a time will come when no work shall be done. In God’s calendar the end of all things is at hand. We are close to the finish line of the work more than ever. Run that you will finish. Selah! Author Wednesday, 25th June, 2025THIS SHOULD ALWAYS BE YOUR RESPONSE"Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church." Acts 12:5 (NKJV) What is your first response to challenges or pressure from opposition? Time and time again in scriptures, you will find God’s people responding to challenging situations with prayer.
Don’t give anyone room to underestimate the effectual workings of prayer.
One of the evidence that you have confidence in God’s ability is how you respond to situations through prayer. Did you take time to pay attention to the opening verse? Look at the full story: "Now about that time Herod the king stretched out his hand to harass some from the church. Then he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to seize Peter also. Now it was during the Days of Unleavened Bread. So when he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of soldiers to keep him, intending to bring him before the people after Passover. Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church. And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were [keeping the prison. Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, “Arise quickly!” And his chains fell off his hands. Then the angel said to him, “Gird yourself and tie on your sandals”; and so he did. And he said to him, “Put on your garment and follow me.” So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision. When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him. And when Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.” Acts 12:1-11 (NKJV)— Herod decided to harass the Church, so he killed James, the brother of John.— He saw the people were pleased, so he arrested Peter, and purposed to kill him after Passover.— Nevertheless, the Church responded to this situation differently.We didn’t see the response of the Church when James was arrested. It was likely they reacted in fear and only went to hide.But when Peter was arrested, the Church responded with earnest, constant PRAYERS.The earnest prayers of the brethren dispatched an angel to release Peter from prison. Considering the soldiers assigned to guard Peter in the prison and even outside the prison, it will only take a supernatural hand to deliver him.No matter the challenge, get into prayer.  In the place of prayer:— You will receive strength.— Your faith will be strengthened.— You will receive direction as to what to do.— You will see visions— The great help and answers of God will be released.Paul said to the Philippians:"Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus" Philippians 4: 6-7 (NKJV).
Don’t cry, don’t be anxious, don’t worry, don’t fret, ONLY PRAY!
Nehemiah, when he was opposed, prayed to God.When Daniel and his friends’ lives were under threat, they prayed to receive understanding of the King’s dream. David prayed when he was under threat.Jesus prayed when He was overwhelmed by the burden of His crucifixion, and He received strength. It took prayer for Esther, Mordecai and the Jews to reverse Haman’s plot against them. Beloved, refuse to be troubled; get into prayer.The saints were together praying until they saw Peter at home. "And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying" Acts 12:12 Pray earnestly until you have really prayed. Pray until you are fully convinced in your spirit that it is settled. 
Pray until you see the victory, not until you feel tired.
It means you may feel tired, but you have to continue earnestly in prayer.GET INTO PRAYER!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g4M88bC9VxMDIG DEEPER(Matthew 18:19; Isaiah 62:6-7; Esther 4:16; Daniel 2:15-18; Luke 22:39-46) WE PRAYThat by the mighty hand of the Lord we shall see great victory in all situations, no matter the pressure and opposition. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 43-452 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t stagger in faith. – By the strength of God, I prevail. – With God I do valiantly. – I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day. – I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 885 - THE LORD IS WILLING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must know the season you are in and get serious with this ministry task. Make the most of this opportunity, for the time comes when there will be no such opportunity. Beloved, don’t delay with that giving. Don’t delay with the outreach plan. Don’t delay with those great ideas. Author Thursday, 26th June, 2025 THE LORD IS WILLING"Then Jesus put out His hand and touched him, saying, “I am willing; be cleansed.” Immediately, his leprosy was cleansed." Matthew 8:3 (NKJV)How many times have you found yourself in a situation and thought it's the Lord who is punishing you?It is wrong to think that the Lord afflicts you with infirmities or negative experiences.It is also wrong to think that the Lord is not interested in your healing, your challenge and the situation which goes on in your family.
The Lord is not just interested in what goes on in your life and family; He is willing to help you out of that challenge.
 Don't sit back in sorrow or feel helpless; cast your cares to the Lord.That was what the leper did:"When He had come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed Him. And behold, a leper came and worshiped Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.” Then Jesus put out His hand and touched him, saying, “I am willing; be cleansed.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed." Matthew 8:1-3 (NKJV)He didn't assume the Lord would automatically heal him. He let the Lord in on his situation.And the Lord Jesus didn't just heal him by speaking a word; before He would declare His willingness to heal the leper, the Lord was already in the process of making the leper whole.He touched the leper.Oh dear Lord Jesus!To be a leper is to be unclean and must be quarantined or be separated from the city to dwell alone."He shall be unclean. All the days he has the sore he shall be unclean. He is unclean, and he shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp." Leviticus 13:46 (NKJV) And the unclean must not be touched. (Leviticus 5:3)Leprosy was seen to be contagious and spread through contact. However, our Lord Jesus was willing to touch the man to spread healing.
Understand that, the leper was healed not just by the touch of Jesus, but the WILLINGNESS OF JESUS to touch the leper.
In another instance from the same chapter 8 of Matthew, our Lord Jesus showed His willingness to always heal and deliver."Now when Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, pleading with Him, saying, 'Lord, my servant is lying at home paralyzed, dreadfully tormented.” Matthew 8:5-6 (NKJV)Now pay attention to the response of Jesus:"And Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”Did you see the WILLINGNESS OF THE LORD?
No matter the challenge going on with you, the LORD is willing to heal, deliver, and help!
Turn to Him and trust Him.Cast all your cares unto the Lord.Don't be afraid or careful to talk to the Lord about all that concerns you.He is the good Shepherd-King!Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aUUw65cgGRgDIG DEEPER(Mark 1:41; Luke 5:13; Isaiah 50:6; Matthew 11:28; John 6:37; Matthew 4:19; John 14:16-18) WE PRAYWe pray, thanking the Lord for His willingness to bring change in our lives.(Because the Lord is willing, pray, talking to Him about the help you need from Him according to His word)BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 46-482 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord is interested in all that concerns me. - I don't wallow in sorrow or feel helpless; instead, I cast all my cares to the Lord. - I trust the Lord in all things. - I refuse to be afraid and careful to talk to the Lord about all that concerns me. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 886 - TAKE THE WORD AS IT IS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency IS ANYTHING TOO HARD FOR THE LORD? Beloved, Don’t doubt the Lord! Selah. Author Friday, 27th June, 2025TAKE THE WORD AS IT IS"Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?" John 11:40 (TPT) Until you learn to esteem God’s Word in your life, your focus towards God may be impaired. There are times, because you may feel disappointed that God didn’t do things as you expected, you begin to doubt His word.
God always has a bigger picture for your life; therefore, you don’t put Him in a box or set boundaries for Him.
No challenge should be big enough to move you away from God. No challenge should be big enough to make you doubt God. From the beginning of John 11, we can see that Jesus received a message concerning Lazarus’ health condition. And knowing how Jesus loved Mary, Martha and Lazarus, they were expecting a different response from Jesus than what happened. "One day Lazarus became very sick to the point of death. So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, our brother Lazarus, the one you love, is very sick. Please come!”When he heard this, he said, “This sickness will not end in death for Lazarus, but will bring glory and praise to God. This will reveal the greatness of the Son of God by what takes place.” Now even though Jesus loved Mary, Martha, and Lazarus, he remained where he was for two more days. Finally, on the third day, he said to his disciples, “Come. It’s time to go to Bethany". John 11:2-7 (TPT). Now, when Jesus arrived, His friend Lazarus had been dead and buried for four days.Now, clearly, Mary and Martha were disappointed that Jesus didn’t come early. And they all expressed their disappointment uniquely. But let me draw your attention to a similar situation.The story of the Roman Centurion, he had a servant who was sick and requested Jesus to speak a word instead of visiting him. (See Matthew 8:5-13). Mary and Martha could have demonstrated similar faith to see their brother healed. Well, they were disappointed instead, and we see Martha responding wrongly to Jesus.
Don’t allow your experiences (which may also include your disappointments), assumptions, and limited knowledge, define your response to God’s word.
To exercise absolute confidence in God’s Word, take God’s Word as it is. Don’t read your preconceived motive into His word.Martha went to meet Jesus when He was approaching their village: "Martha said to Jesus, “My Lord, if only you had come sooner, my brother wouldn’t have died. But I know that if you were to ask God for anything, he would do it for you.” Jesus told her, “Your brother will rise and live.” She replied, “Yes, I know he will rise with everyone else on resurrection day." John 11:21-24 (TPT). Martha believed in Jesus at the level of what she had experienced, not according to the Word of the Lord.She has seen and heard that Jesus healed the sick. However, she didn’t know Jesus as the resurrection and the life.When Jesus said, your brother shall rise, she responded with head knowledge: “Yes, I know he will rise with everyone else on resurrection day.”.
However, to walk in absolute confidence in God’s word, you must respond to God with your heart.
This was why even after Jesus had explained that He is the resurrection and the life, Martha had to make an argument about the decomposition of Lazarus’ body. She was still responding to Jesus according to her head knowledge. Faith is responding to God according to His word and not by how you feel. Stand and act consistently according to the WORD and not your mere experience. Selah.DIG DEEPER(John 11; Hebrews 11) WE PRAYThat we will not allow our experiences, assumptions, and limited knowledge, define our response to God’s word and the manifestation of God’s word in our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 49-512 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My time of harvest is here and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary. – I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 887 - HIS LOVE COMPELS US
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot be effective in your service of the Kingdom without the zeal of the Lord. Culture your heart to burn with zeal towards God’s assignment. You remain blessed. Author Saturday, 28th June, 2025HIS LOVE COMPELS US“With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don’t hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort.”1 Corinthians 15:58 (The Message) Why are we so committed to the course of Christ? Why are we pushing beyond our comfort and self-interest, just to see lives saved and transformed, no matter the cost involved? Are we wasting our time?
Certainly Not!!!
Don’t we have anything else to use our money for?What is more worth our money than this?What is more worth our time than this?What is more worth our skill, intelligence, and resources than this? Read the opening verse again: “With all this going for us, my dear, dear friends, stand your ground. And don’t hold back. Throw yourselves into the work of the Master, confident that nothing you do for him is a waste of time or effort.”1 Corinthians 15:58 (The Message) God has been about this business since.He desires that all men will be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth (1 Timothy 2:4). Our Lord first made a great sacrifice to get this to unfold.  “Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: [And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.” Philippians 2:6-8 (Amplified Bible).
Beloved, Jesus being fully God, He lowered Himself to become man and humbled Himself to suffer the death of the cross.
It wasn’t for nothing! He sacrificed all He is and all that He’s got, just to die this death of shame for mankind. There must be something more important about His death for Him to leave all that glory to become man and to die for man. It is this same thing that moved Jesus to the cross, which is moving us to do all we have to do according to the grace given to us.
We are not giving space for the adversary. This generation and beyond deserve our sacrifices.
How beautiful it is that young people like us will stand up for the course of Christ. This same ministry of God is our ministry today. (2 Corinthians 5:17-18). Every single contribution is important and needful unto satisfying God’s dream.We leave no stone unturned. We take advantage of this Holy Spirit-inspired and directed ability within us to set the divine course for many. There are certain people; if we don’t step out, they won’t be reached out to, and the Lord will demand their blood from us. “If I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, in order to save his life, that wicked person shall die for his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand.” Ezekiel 3:18 (ESV)
We will not sit to watch a generation be destroyed.
Until YOU get involved, a particular soul will not be reached.They can only hear to receive the Lord, only when you preach. “For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?” (Romans 10:13-14) There are many more depending on our sacrifices, bold steps, relentless decisions, uncompromising choices, and unconditional Love of Christ. The LOVE that moved Jesus to the cross is COMPELLING US TO REACH MANY UNSAVED.  The Love of Christ is compelling us!!!… Don’t only preach, put your money into GOD’S AGENDA. God’s AGENDA will be financed through GOD’S OWN PEOPLE. Be a faithful steward of God and partner in the spreading of the gospel of our Lord Jesus. Pray also for the salvation of souls in your community, in your city, in your town, in your school, in your workplace, in your family, in your country and your continent and the whole world.  Don’t go on your knees in prayer only for your personal needs. You are a royal priest in Christ. Fulfil that priestly mandate. We get the job done unto the Glory of God. There is a great company publishing the gospel. Are you part of it? Shalom Aleichem!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0i_UvjC1ME&t=614sDIG DEEPER(1 Peter 1:4-9; Ruth 1:18; Psalm 78:8,37; Col. 2:7; Acts 20:24; Hebrews 12:1; 1 Corinthians 9:24-27) WE PRAYThat our hands will not relenting in the service of the Lord. And that we will labour to the end, knowing the value of what God has entrusted to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 52-542 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I finish my race. – I value this kingdom mandate more than my necessary needs. – I am fully persuaded about the call of God. – My service to God is unto a glorious end. – I am involved in God’s great work. And this is a worthy course. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 888 - PRACTICE YOUR GRATITUDE TOWARDS THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever He tells you to do, He is in it with you. He is the loving Father who bears your burdens. Therefore , refuse to fear and act boldly on the word of God. Selah. Author Sunday, 29th June, 2025PRACTICE YOUR GRATITUDE TOWARDS THE LORD“Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.”1 Chronicles 16:29 (KJV)Being thankful or showing gratitude to God is a practical thing.And you must be intentional with it.You spend hours praying for a miracle and not be thankful at all. Most people are not able to maintain a consistent habit of Thanksgiving because they don’t know how.
Thanksgiving also brings you into the consciousness of God’s presence.
Through the Word of God, we are not only instructed to be thankful; we are also instructed on how to give thanks to God.There are three major things I will share with you in your practice of Thanksgiving. These are practical things that will help you develop the habit of Thanksgiving.1. Sing songs of Praise to the Lord. “Sing out your thanks to Him; sing praises to our God” Psalm 147:7 (TLB)
Singing spiritual songs of thanksgiving is also a practice of the Spirit.
It doesn’t matter how you feel or the lack of words, just start your day with songs of praise. As you sing praises to the Lord, you speak in tongues and rejoice in the Holy Spirit. You can take some time to write down a list of songs focused only on thanksgiving or praise. And minister those songs to the Lord.There are times when you have to take a posture of gratitude. You can either be on your knees, lift your hands or prostrate yourself before the Lord.This will tune your heart and mind to the thoughts of divine wonders.2. Offer the Sacrifice of Praise by the fruit of your lips.“Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.” Hebrews 13:15 (NKJV)The fruit of your lips are the words you speak. And your words must be full of thanksgiving. Just in case you cannot spontaneously remember the right words of praise to speak, go through the scriptures and write out the thanksgiving verses which resonate with your heart. (You can find a lot through the Psalms).And then read them out or vocalize them with a genuine heart of gratitude. While you are engaged in this, the anointing of the Holy Spirit will begin to increase in your life.3. Give a gift or money to support the Lord’s work.Reread the opening verse:“Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.” 1 Chronicles 16:29 (KJV) This offering is different from the fruit of your lips. This is the fruit of your heart.Our Lord Jesus said,“For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also,” (Matthew 6:21).
Your money is your treasure. To give your money sacrificially to the Lord’s work is great evidence that you value the Lord.
How you spend your money reveals your priorities. And your money is a symbol of your desire. Therefore, to say you are greatly thankful to God, you must follow it up with a financial gift towards His work.This is a sacrificial giving of gratitude to the Lord.It is a demonstration of honor.The scripture says, “Honor the Lord with your substance” (Proverbs 3:9).
This month give a sacrificial gift to the Lord’s work.
GO AHEAD TO PRACTICE YOUR GRATITUDE TOWARDS THE LORD.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(Daniel 6:10; Colossians 3:17; 1 Chronicles 29:10-20; Psalm 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13; Psalm 103:2) WE PRAYThank the Lord for the glorious graces He has released unto you and the opportunity to be relevant in the Kingdom, through your local Church.In the name of JesusBIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 55-572 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.– In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.– I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.– I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.– My mouth is full of thanksgiving.– Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 889 - FUNCTION IN WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You have to set a time for the reading of the Word of God. It will shape your thinking and refresh your heart. You realize you can make the right life choices, and also live with clarity because you have activated Wisdom. Selah. Author Monday, 30th June, 2025 FUNCTION IN WISDOM“So be careful how you live. Don’t live like fools, but like those who are wise.”Ephesians 5:15 (NLT)You can have the impartation of Wisdom and not walk in Wisdom.A perfect example is Solomon. Solomon, who was well known as the wisest man, walked in foolishness at a point in his life.To live by Wisdom is an intentional thing, though Wisdom is imparted. You must make a decision to function in Wisdom.Christ is the Wisdom of God, this means that anyone who has received Christ has the Wisdom of God mingled in his or her spirit.
The born again in Christ has the Wisdom of God.
When Jesus came, He exuded a dimension of Wisdom no man had ever seen. His words and deeds were the demonstration of True Wisdom.To walk in True Wisdom, follow the example or pattern of Jesus.Any expression of Wisdom which doesn’t depict Christ is not complete. Christ is the only complete manifestation of Wisdom.The more you live as Christ, the more you function in Wisdom.
Don’t esteem the wisdom of men above the wisdom of Christ. For the wisdom of men always have a limitation.
There was a poor wise man who used his wisdom to save a city and was not remembered. (Ecclesiastes 9:14-16)The question I know you may ask is, “How can a wise man be poor?” The issue is not whether he was remembered or not. The issue is why was he poor?It is the limitation of his wisdom. The wise man had the wisdom to save a city, but might not know how to save himself from poverty.But also being rich does not mean you cannot be seen as a fool before God. Having riches doesn’t mean you are wise (Luke 12:20)
The Wisdom of God is able to help you make the right decisions in all things.
This is why you should behold Jesus, who is the embodiment of True Wisdom.Our Lord Jesus exudes the mastery of Wisdom in all things. He lacked nothing because, by His Wisdom, He knew how to make things respond to Him.The more the life of Christ finds expression through you, the greater Wisdom is seen in you.To practice True Wisdom is to live as Christ.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4814hk6ceqwDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 5:1; Proverbs 9:10; Colossians 1:1-19; Proverbs 8; Proverbs 15:21; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that through the abundant supply of God’s grace, we increase in capacity to function as Christ who is the Wisdom of God.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 58-602 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The true wisdom of God is mingled in my spirit. – I am full of the wisdom of God. – I function by wisdom. – I increase in capacity to function as Christ daily. – I make the right decisions in all things at all times. – I refuse to walk in foolishness. – I don’t entertain the company of fools. – I am so wise. – I walk in wisdom every day of my life. – By the wisdom of God, I am preserved. Oh Hallelujah!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 890 - MATURE INTO CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You may have big dreams and great plans for this new month; however, without being immersed in the Spirit, you can do nothing. Get intimate with the Holy Spirit and enjoy His overwhelming presence this month. Shalom Aleichem! Author Tuesday, 1st, July, 2025MATURE INTO CHRIST“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)There are things you cannot achieve in Christ until you grow.  Our heavenly Father is interested in your growth and maturity; thus, He has made every provision for you to grow spiritually. He didn’t just give you His word, He granted you access (Ephesians 2:18) for you to commune with Him (through prayer and fellowship with the Holy Spirit).
He planted you in His Church for you to be nurtured and gave you gifted men to equip you.
See how the apostle puts it: “And [His gifts to the church were varied and] He Himself appointed some as apostles [special messengers, representatives], some as prophets [who speak a new message from God to the people], some as evangelists [who spread the good news of salvation], and some as pastors and teachers [to shepherd and guide and instruct], [and He did this] to fully equip and perfect the saints (God’s people) for works of service, to build up the body of Christ [the church]; until we all reach oneness in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, [growing spiritually] to become a mature believer, reaching to the measure of the fullness of Christ [manifesting His spiritual completeness and exercising our spiritual gifts in unity]. So that we are no longer children [spiritually immature], tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine, by the cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men, by the deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit]. But speaking the truth in love [in all things—both our speech and our lives expressing His truth], let us grow up in all things into Him [following His example] who is the Head—Christ.” Ephesians 4:11-15 (Amplified) From the above verses, we see the organic assignment of the gifted men. God’s intention for these gifted men (apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers) is to: 1. Fully equip and perfect the saints for service (or the work of the ministry).To equip and perfect the saints, furnishes them with the necessary spiritual tools and dexterous skills and mastery for service.  2.  To build up the body of Christ [the church]. Your growth and maturity contribute to the building up of the body of Christ. Which means, your immaturity can be a deficiency in the body. These gifted men equip and perfect the saints to build up the body until:  3. We all reach oneness in the faith.   4. We all reach oneness in the knowledge of the Son of God. 5. Growing spiritually to become a mature believer. 6. Reaching the measure of the fullness of Christ [manifesting His spiritual completeness]  7. Exercising our spiritual gifts in unity.  8. As we step into the above reality of our growth in the spirit or maturity; WE ARE NO LONGER CHILDREN [SPIRITUALLY IMMATURE].
The spiritually immature are tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine. 
When you are not maturing or growing spiritually, you become a victim of: – every cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men.  – deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit].  However, from these verses we see the matter of LOVE. "Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head". Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) We grow up into Christ by LOVE. And the reality is, apart from love, there is no other way to genuinely grow up into Christ.
Your growth is not into yourself or personal desires. Your growth is into Christ; who is the ultimate example of love.
Our Heavenly Father has made these provisions of gifted men to bring us to the place of MATURING INTO CHRIST in the perfection of His Love. Submitting to the training of the gifted men God has given you in your “local Church” is your reception and enjoyment of God’s provision for your growth in the spirit. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVZ7ah7OTEwDIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 3:14-16; 23:3-4; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2) WE PRAYDear Lord, please teach me how to humbly submit to the nurturing and training of my man of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 61-632 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I humbly submit to training. – I take heed to every instruction given by my man of God. – I am not dull in hearing the word of God. – I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. – I don’t lazy about my spiritual development. – I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit. – I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 891 - ENJOY DIVINE INTERVENTION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter the matter, don’t speak your fears, don’t speak your challenges, SPEAK THE RHEMA OF GOD IN YOUR HEART! Beloved, until you speak forth the Word, you shall not see a performance. Selah. Author Wednesday, 2nd July, 2025 ENJOY DIVINE INTERVENTION"The LORD will protect you from all evil; He will keep your life." Psalm 121:7 (Amplified Bible)Until you are conscious of a reality, you may not fully take advantage of it or enjoy it.This is why spiritual maturity is important. Your maturity gives you an edge to fully enjoy all the things the Lord has made available for you.
Your spiritual maturity is basically your increase in knowledge and understanding of your relationship with God and the inheritance you have in Him.
Many believers pray wrongly and even subject themselves to emotional distress because of their ignorance.Fear is a product of negative thoughts. Understanding what the Lord has done and provided for you gives you restfulness even amidst the most chaotic seasons.How you react when things seem difficult or challenging is dependent on your level of understanding of God's provision for you.Are you afraid of failure?Are you troubled by a negative experience?Do you feel all alone and think nothing good will come out of your situation?Are you caught up in a loop of pain and disappointment?If your answer is "Yes" to these questions, then it's time to intentionally set your mind on the Lord's intervention.The intervention of the Lord is God's act of stepping into an endangering situation to deliver you and also to support you greatly for your progress or your miraculous advancement.
The Lord's intervention is not in your future. The Lord is not looking forward to a day to intervening in your life before He makes His attempt.
Understand that He is not waiting for your toughest moments before He sends you help. He is not waiting for your difficult season to send you help.The Lord's intervention has always been with you. He has set things in place to preserve you.As you can see from the opening verse, "The LORD will protect you from all evil; He will keep your life."Now understand that the willingness of the Lord has gone forth, and has set in place all that is needed for your protection from evil. He has set things in place for the preservation of your life.You don't just have to hope for His help or expect that things will get better.
You have to know that the Lord has set things in place for your preservation and progress.
YOU HAVE TO ENJOY! You have to take advantage!Now, prayer for divine intervention must be with the understanding that the Lord has already made provisions for you.Therefore, you pray to take advantage of the systems the Lord has put in place for your enjoyment.The author of Hebrews gave us an example as to how we can take advantage of God's intervention:"... For hasn’t he promised you, “I will never leave you alone, never! And I will not loosen my grip on your life!” So we can say with great confidence:“I know the Lord is for me and I will never be afraid of what people may do to me!” Hebrews 13:5-6 (TPT)Whatever the Lord has said in His word about your situation is what He has done and is doing. 
To enjoy the manifestation of the word is for you to take a confident stand on what He has said and make it your declaration in prayer and your speech.
Don't be troubled!Enjoy the Lord's intervention today and all the days of your life.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRlrvecLgeMDIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:14; 2 Thessalonians 3:3; Psalm 34:19; Jude 1:24; Isaiah 43:2) WE PRAYWe pray according to the word of the Lord, that our lives and that which is precious to us are preserved from the evil one.The Lord of hosts is keeping our lives and all that He has entrusted into our care.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 64-662 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 27DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I refuse to fear. - All that concerns me is preserved from the evil one. - My mind is set continually on the Lord's intervention in my life and on all that concerns me. - I am always conscious that the Lord has set things in place for my preservation and progress. - I enjoy the Lord's intervention at all times.Oh, thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 892 - VALUE THE WORD OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Thursday, 3rd July, 2025 VALUE THE WORD OF GOD"For whoever has [spiritual wisdom because he is receptive to God’s word], to him more will be given, and he will be richly and abundantly supplied; but whoever does not have [spiritual wisdom because he has devalued God’s word], even what he has will be taken away from him." Matthew 13:12 (Amplified Bible)You cannot enjoy divine intervention without the word of God.The word of God is given to us as our advantage. 
You cannot enjoy your inheritance in the Lord without the knowledge of the word. 
The word of God contains all that the Lord has accomplished for you.Not to commit yourself to the word is to expose yourself to deception and error."Your word is a lamp to guide my feet and a light for my path." Psalm 119:195 (NLT)With the word, you cannot miss your way through the journey of life.The word of God works; however, it profits those who value it.
Anyone who doesn't value the word of God doesn't value his or her life.
When you pray to God for help, the first thing He will send you is His word. So as you are devaluing the word of the Lord, you are turning away from your help.To value the word is to listen and take heed of the word with an open, teachable heart.To value the word is to esteem the word of God as life. This means that the word becomes your priority and the driving force of your decisions or choices.When you stand and act by the word, you can make a greater harvest no matter the challenge which confronts you. Anyone who doesn't place value on the word will not make it a priority to understand and grasp the word. When you don't understand the word, you will not have a strong grip on it; thus, the evil one comes and snatches it away.
When you value the word, you will make it your meditation and get the word deeply rooted in your heart.
Until the word is deeply rooted in your heart, the pressure or persecution will cause you to stumble and fall.When you value the word, it will be so fruitful that the worries and distractions of the world and the deceitfulness [the superficial pleasures and delight] of riches cannot choke it or stop it from yielding fruits.
Do you value or devalue the word?
Your response must be according to the measure of your heart.Your response determines how the word will profit you.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=thHz609A2wgDIG DEEPER(Psalm 1:1-3; Psalm 43:3; Psalm 119;11; Psalm 19:7-11; Colossians 3:16) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall grasp the word of God to us, so that we shall enjoy the package of the Lord's intervention. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 67-692 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 28DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I value the word of God. - The word of God works in my life. - The word of God is deeply rooted in my heart. - I make the word of God my meditation daily. - I enjoy God's intervention in my life. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 893 - YOU WILL BE CONFRONTED BY TRIAL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Get this, God did not make you a King and a Priest (Revelation 1:6), just for you to enjoy the luxury and extravagance of divine royalty and Christ’s love.
