We are made Kings and Priests in Christ to be involved in the assignment of the Kingdom. But the question is, HOW ARE YOU INVOLVED? Author Friday, 4th July, 2025 YOU WILL BE CONFRONTED BY TRIAL“Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you”John 15:16 (ASV)No matter how much you wish to achieve great Kingdom results, you may still not produce them until you act or take consistent steps towards them.From the revelation of the scriptures, you will realize fruit-bearing is not an option. The goal of discipleship in God’s Kingdom is for you to produce fruits consistent with the good pleasure of His will.See what Jesus said, “Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.” (John 15:8)In your fruit-bearing or Kingdom results, your Heavenly Father is glorified.This doesn’t happen automatically, simply because you are a disciple of Jesus.  You can be a disciple of Jesus and still not bear fruits. To produce results there are specific things to do:1. You have to make a decision you are going to do much more as a disciple of Jesus.2. Be Consumed with the Success of the Kingdom.
Until you become interested in and passionate about the kingdom’s success, you will not be willing to take steps to make it happen.
God and His Kingdom must become your priority. Until God is your priority you cannot invest in Him. Your heart must be after God.One question you must always ask yourself is this:How deep is my love and jealousy for God?When you don’t love the Lord, you will not be willing to go the extra mile for His course. You will always make excuses and seek self-pleasure.Challenges may arise to hinder your efforts to produce results. You don’t have to give up or drawback. There is something important you need to do:3. Contend for results.Results require a relentless posture of faith. Because of the adversary’s resistance, your results will always come with a fight. This is not a fight to obtain victory; it is a fight to unleash and enforce the victory that you have obtained in Christ. You don’t have to fake or pretend that you have the results, you must contend for it. To have results is a faith thing. You must contend and release your faith.
IT IS CALLED THE GOOD FIGHT OF FAITH!
Paul the apostle in his last epistle to Timothy made an affectionate heartthrob statement:“I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.” 2 Timothy 4:7 (NKJV)
This fight of faith is a good, worthy and noble fight. It is to contend earnestly the glorious contest to guard the faith.
In Paul’s first epistle to Timothy, he instructed him to,“Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you were also called and have confessed the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.” 1 Timothy 6:12As we have seen in the second epistle, Paul the apostle was instructing Timothy to do exactly what he was also doing. To have a fruitful experience of the faith, you must fight to express it. You must contend in faith.Again he said, as part of his epistle to the Church in Philippi, “I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.” Philippians 3:14 (NKJV)He has to press toward the goal because there were many things which may serve as limitations.To press on and to contend for the results means you are not holding anything back. You have to fight, run and strive for the results.
In your attempt to achieve results, you may be confronted by trial.
“Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.” (James 1:12).You have to persevere as a good soldier.As you are taking steps, you must remain resolute and daring. You have to press on against all odds to produce consistent Kingdom results.Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9jt4Ue09SUDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:12-13; Colossians 1:29; Galatians 6:9; 1 Corinthians 15:58) WE PRAYPray that as we labour in the faith, we shall strive with all of the Lord’s energy working powerfully within us, and be steadfast, immovable and always excel in the work of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 70-722 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 29DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I produce kingdom Kingdom results. – I am blessed by the Lord to be fruitful. – My fruits glorify the Father. – I am a true disciple of Jesus because I bear much fruits. Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 894 - YOUR LOVE-LIFE IN CHRIST MAKES ALL THE DIFFERENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. Beloved, STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART! Author Saturday, 5th, July, 2025YOUR LOVE-LIFE IN CHRIST MAKES ALL THE DIFFERENCE“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)There are some fellow saints in Christ, who are interested in growing their finances, their businesses, their families, and their relationships. They feed their minds with information which helps them in their career pursuits. However, you must know that a person is sustained by how he has built his inner man. “The spirit of a man sustains him in sickness, But as for a broken spirit, who can bear it?” Proverbs 18:14 (Amplified) If you are not well built in your spiritual life, you don’t carry any weight. When your life is hit by a raging storm, your spiritual weight and foundation will determine whether you will be shaken, moved or immovable.
The strength of your life is dependent on how rooted you are in God.
How deep are you growing in Christ? You don’t have to live a shallow life in Christ. Grow deeper in Him, for He is the strength of your life. The greatest evidence of your growth into Christ in every way is how you practice and express the love of Christ.
The expressions of the love of Christ are the fruits of love.
A plant which doesn’t grow, cannot bear good fruits. The good fruits you bear are the evidence of your maturity. There are people who measure their spiritual growth by the gifts of the spirit they demonstrate. Meanwhile, the gifts of the Spirit are gifts. You can have the gift of word of knowledge or the gift of prophecy and not necessarily be mature in Christ. 
A gift of the spirit does not determine your growth in Christ. 
Your growth in Christ is determined by the Fruits of the Spirit you bear. Look at what Paul said about gifts of the Spirit and love: “If I were to speak with eloquence in earth’s many languages, and in the heavenly tongues of angels, yet I didn’t express myself with love, my words would be reduced to the hollow sound of nothing more than a clanging cymbal. And if I were to have the gift of prophecy with a profound understanding of God’s hidden secrets, and if I possessed unending supernatural knowledge, and if I had the greatest gift of faith that could move mountains, but have never learned to love, then I am nothing. And if I were to be so generous as to give away everything I owned to feed the poor, and to offer my body to be burned as a martyr, without the pure motive of love, I would gain nothing of value.” 1 Corinthians 13:1-3 (TPT) The Lord does not measure your maturity by the mighty gifts of the spirit you demonstrate. Your maturity or growth in Christ is measured ultimately by LOVE.
Your love-life in Christ makes all the difference.
I ask you again, are you growing in Christ? Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhW1NhFqGLIDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAYTHAT WE WILL GROW MORE INTO THE LOVE OF CHRIST WHICH SURPASSES KNOWLEDGE. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 73-752 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 30DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take heed to every instruction and training. – I am not dull in hearing the word of God. – I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. – I don’t lazy about my spiritual development. – I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit. – I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 895 - THE LORD IS HERE TO HELP YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Maintain a company of friends who inspire you with the vision of God and direct your passion towards the Lord. Friends who overwhelm you with wise counsel of the Lord are treasures. Selah! Author Sunday, 6th July, 2025THE LORD IS HERE TO HELP YOU“For I hold you by your right hand— I, the LORD your God. And I say to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I am here to help you” Isaiah 41:13 (NLT)The adversary greatly opposes anyone called by God to do great things for the Kingdom. As long as you are a child of God, the devil will not go on a picnic with you. As a child of God, you are a threat to the works of darkness. If the devil can stop you from shining, he can oppress more people. This is because every child of God is a saviour. He knows the success of your business is to the advantage of the Kingdom of God. He knows the stability of your family and the peace you enjoy is a threat to him. The more you enjoy peace, the more focused you become on doing what God has called you to do.
The more joyful you are, the more you engage in the anointing of the Holy Spirit.
The adversary wants you to doubt your future, walk in fear, live in confusion and be distressed. Don’t be troubled by your present condition; for it is a mere mirage. Don’t give in to it. Stand firm on the Word of the Lord. Hear the Word of the Lord to you this day: “Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be discouraged, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you. I will hold you up with my victorious right hand.” Isaiah 41:10 (NLT)
The moment you begin to feel discouraged, remember that the LORD IS WITH YOU.
He will strengthen you and help you! In the Berean Standard Bible, it says: …I WILL SURELY HELP YOU… (Isaiah 41:10). Beloved it is a surety deal with God. See the verse 13 of Isaiah 41: “For I hold you by your right hand— I, the LORD your God. And I say to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I am here to help you.” No matter what the challenge is, the Lord will not only strengthen you, He holds you by His right hand, directs you and assures you that HE IS HERE TO HELP YOU. Refuse to cry!Refuse to be broken.Refuse to be discouraged.Don’t give up.
THE LORD IS HERE TO HELP YOU.
Make this your meditation.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ah-sLxo8pDIDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 41:8-20; Genesis 15:1; Deuteronomy 20:1; Genesis 31:4-5; Romans 8:31) WE PRAYTHANKING THE LORD FOR HIS MIGHTY HELP, STRENGTH AND DIRECTION AS WE WALK IN VICTORY IN THE MIDST OF OPPOSITION. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 76-782 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 31DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to give up. – I refuse to be broken. – I refuse to be discouraged. – I refuse to cry. – I maintain an undisturbed composure. – The Lord is my helper. – I choose to be joyful always. – I refuse to look at my current situation. – I stand firm on the word of God. Oh Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 896 - ...BY THE LOVE OF CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do not let the wrongs of others redefine the goodness of God in you. Continue doing good for others, whether they appreciate it or not. Author Monday, 7th July, 2025...BY THE LOVE OF CHRIST“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)Your growth determines your manifestation. You are able to handle situations and impact your world according to your inward growth.
Your growth in your understanding of Christ and consciousness of who you are in Him is your growth in the Spirit.
It is your growth into Christ (in all things, mainly His love) by which you become the complete expression of Him in this world.  You cannot express Christ beyond your level of maturity of growth in the spirit. The highest proof of your growth or maturity in the Spirit is how you walk in Love. Your love towards God and towards others reveals how you are deeply rooted in Christ. The more your roots grow deep into the love of Christ, the more you mature or grow in the Spirit. You can be born again for 10 years and not be mature.
Growing in the Spirit is not automatic, it is intentional.
Organisms don’t just grow healthy. It takes the right nutrients and the supply of other needful elements. Your mind and heart must be cultivated in the love of God.One who is growing in the spirit has his/her affection set on the Lord and not on his/her own interests. The love of God dominates your heart and influences your actions. How consistently do you fellowship with the Spirit and the Word? Or you must be convinced to have a consistent fellowship with the Spirit and the Word? How excited are you in your heart concerning the things of God? How do you love the brethren?Are you bitter, envious, angry and holding on to an offense? When you are deeply rooted in the love of God,  bitterness, envy and offenses cannot have any place in your heart (because they are fruits or expressions of the self).
The more you grow or mature in the Lord, the more the self is subdued by the love of Christ.
Selahhttps://youtu.be/YtRS05-j4XoDIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Proverbs 4:18; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAY– That we will increase in the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding. – That we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, increasing in the knowledge of God, and demonstrating the love of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 79-812 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 32DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart and mind is cultivated in the love of God daily as I feast on the word. – I set my affection on the Lord.  – The love of God dominates my heart and influences my actions. – I am directed and instructed daily by the word of God. – Envy, bitterness and offenses have no place in my heart because I am deeply rooted in the love of Christ. Oh Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 897 - THE REALITY OF GREATNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Unforgiveness or holding on to an offence is a destructive weapon of the enemy. One of the devices of Satan is to use or take advantage of unforgiveness. As you forgive others as Christ has forgiven you, you learn to SHIELD UP BY FAITH against the arrows of bitterness, offences, anger and sorrow. Selah. Author Tuesday, 8th July, 2025THE REALITY OF GREATNESS"But he who is greatest among you shall be your servant" Matthew 23:11 (NKJV) Sincerely everyone wants to experience greatness or manifest greatness. Though each person would want to be great for his or her unique reason, it could be for selfless reasons or selfish reasons. You don’t judge your greatness by the standards of the world.To be great is not how you control or lord yourself over others. It is not how others bow to you.
Greatness in the kingdom is essentially service.
You don’t serve to be great. Because you serve you are great!Those who do great things for God, serve selflessly. If it is not selfless, then it is not service. God is not with you to do great things for yourself. God is with you to accomplish great things to bless others.
The extent of your greatness is measured by the extent of your service. 
The more people you stretch yourself through the sufficient ability of God to bless or serve, the more you demonstrate the greatness of God in you. Look at what Jesus said to his disciples: “Hearing this, the [other] ten became indignant with James and John. Calling them to Himself, Jesus said to them, “You know that those who are recognized as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them; and their powerful men exercise authority over them [tyrannizing them]. But this is not how it is among you; instead, whoever wishes to become great among you must be your servant, and whoever wishes to be first and most important among you must be slave of all. For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a [f]ransom for many.” Mark 10:41-45 (Amplified) God has called us unto greatness, and He is with us to do great things.
Now if you are thinking of where to start from, our Lord Jesus has given the obvious answer: SERVE!
From Mark 10:42-45, you can see the contrast between the greatness of this world and the greatness of the Kingdom. To serve in the Kingdom is to selflessly make sacrifices which will bless others. This doesn’t deny the idea that the Lord exalts those who serve in the Kingdom. He surely rewards those who labour in the Kingdom. Yet, the motive of our service is to be a satisfaction unto others.
Beloved, attempt to do something great for your generation through service.
And it takes humility and genuine heart for God, to serve others.David didn’t become great because he wanted to “lord over others”. He became great because he saw an opportunity to serve his nation Israel. Who else will you find in the Kingdom who did great things without service? Even our Lord came to serve and not to be served. This is the reality of greatness. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ah-sLxo8pDIDIG DEEPER(Luke 22:26-27; Matthew 20:26-27; Acts 13:22,36; Hebrews 6:10; John 12:26) WE PRAYThat we will selflessly serve our generation in doing great things for the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 82-842 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 33DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a satisfaction unto others. – I am a blessing unto others. – When people encounter me, they encounter love unfeigned. – In which ever capacity the Lord has given me, I still serve my generation. – I serve in and out of season. – I am not proud. – I don’t lord over others. – I serve! – I love to serve. – I am a man of service. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 898 - STAY IN THE CHURCH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. The adversary sets you up for failure and disgrace through pride. Beloved, intentionally deal with pride. Author Wednesday, 9th July, 2025STAY IN THE CHURCH“And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.”1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)In the Church (or the Body of Christ), God has designed each member or part of the body with a unique function.
There is no unwanted part of the body of Christ according to God’s setup or creative design.
Just as there is no unwanted part in the human body.It doesn’t matter your ethnicity, race, or background; when you were born again, you were spontaneously baptised into the one body of Christ.“For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and have all been made to drink into one Spirit.” 1 Corinthians 12:13 (NKJV)The body of Christ, which is the Church, is spiritual and universal. It is also the aggregation of all the saints. It takes all the body's parts or members to make up one whole body.All the saints together are the universal Church. And the universal Church finds expression through the Churches within a locality.As a born-again in Christ, you are a member with a special function or assignment in the body of Christ.
The relevance of your special function in the body is seen through your “local Church“.
It is God who sets you in the Church with that special grace for your relevance in His Kingdom.“And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.” 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV) Whatever gift or ability God has given you is for the benefit of the Body of Christ, through the assembly He has placed you.You don’t have to think you are in the Church by mistake. He placed you in a unique assembly for the growth of the entire body. You are positioned in that specific place in the Body for you to be useful as God has intended.There is a reason God did not place the toes on the shoulders. How will the toes on the shoulder be useful to the body?God placed each unique part of the body at its right place for effective use and relevance.
God has set you up in your “Local Church” or within a unique “Ministry Assembly” for your effective function.
All that God has made you and given you are for His use within the Church.There are some whom God has made to be apostles, prophets, or teachers in the Church. Others are also set up by the Lord to be helpers, administrators, and a gift of healings.These are expressions of grace and must be for the glory of God.“For everything comes from God and exists by His power and is intended for his glory…” Romans 11:36 (NLT).
The whole body depends on that gift or grace given to you to function effectively.
Don’t complain and be tired of the needs which gravitate towards you. You are set up in the body at such a time to be an answer to those needs.It is by God’s design that you always have the desire to HELP. You are an answer to the financial needs of the Church. Keep giving!Your special grace for administration is to create an organised system for the growth of the Church. Be diligent with it.God did not set everyone in the Church to be an apostle or prophet or special teacher (though everyone must teach, every teacher needs one with a special teaching grace).You are in the body of Christ at such a time as this, to serve through your “local Church” or “Ministry Assembly“. Your various service or unique functions contributes to the growth and expansion of the Kingdom of God.
Don’t get tired or stop. You are at the right place at the right time.
Use all that God has given you for His glory.Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DoYi17mtafs&t=3380sDIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 12:12-30; Romans 12:3-8; 1 Peter 4:10-11; 1 Timothy 4:12-14; Colossians 3:17) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the revelation and consciousness of the gift or grace given to us  in other to function effectively in the local church He has placed us into. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 85-872 YEARS PLANDeuteronomy 34DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an effective member of the body of Christ. – I have a unique function and a special assignment in the body. – I am a nourishment to the entire body. – I have been set in the church, therefore I take advantage of my place to be a blessing to many.  Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 899 - A GREAT SECRET TO MULTIPLY GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, what do you SEE? Which results are you seeing now? These are not some words of encouragement. I am talking to you about a divine principle that works. You cannot accomplish beyond what you have SEEN. Author Thursday, 10th July, 2025 A GREAT SECRET TO MULTIPLY GRACE"...God resists you when you are proud but multiplies grace and favor when you are humble." 1 Peter 5:5 (TPT)Paul the apostle was clear on this: "I am what I am by the grace of God."He knew he couldn't achieve anything without the supply of God. Grace is God's supply to you. (To read more on Grace, get  my new COMPENDIUM OF ETERNAL Verities, PHOTIZO ALPHA EDITION)Jesus, as the embodiment of Grace, said, Without me you can do nothing.
The grace of God is essential for living out God's purpose and fulfilling ministry.
Grace is the economy of God's household. It is the substance of God's dealings with men. While faith is the substance of our dealings with God.Though every believer has access to the enjoyment of grace, it takes more than being born again to enjoy the multiplication of grace.From the opening verse, you will see that pride is a hindrance to the multiplication of grace. God multiplies grace and favour to the humble.Humility is one of the greatest secrets to the enjoyment of multiplied grace. It takes humility to submit to God's supply.
To be proud towards God is to subtly esteem yourself above God's graciousness.
Thus, the pride-filled person sets himself up as a resistance to the grace of God. In his writing to the saints in Philippi, Paul the apostle addressed how satisfied he would be to see the brethren work together in love. However, the possibility of that togetherness is dependent on how they walk in humility.Paul explained how one can exercise himself or herself in humility.Please take a look at these scriptures:"So I’m asking you, my friends, that you be joined together in perfect unity—with one heart, one passion, and united in one love. Walk together with one harmonious purpose and you will fill my heart with unbounded joy.Be free from pride-filled opinions, for they will only harm your cherished unity. Don’t allow self-promotion to hide in your hearts, but in authentic humility put others first and view others as more important than yourselves. Abandon every display of selfishness. Possess a greater concern for what matters to others instead of your own interests. And consider the example that Jesus, the Anointed One, has set before us. Let his mindset become your motivation" Philippians 2:2-5 (TPT)Here are a few characteristics of the humble reading through the verses:- The humble is compassionate.- The humble lives under God's Leadership.- The humble surrenders to God.- The humble knows how to communicate in love. He's a master communicator.- The humble is obedient.- The humble has a thankful heart.- The humble is wise and demonstrates wisdom by following the example of Jesus.
Walk in humility to unlock the supply of multiplied grace in your life.
Shalom!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YtRS05-j4Xo&t=2759sDIG DEEPER(James 4: 6-10; Philippians 2:3-10; Proverbs 22:4; Matthew 23:12) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be free from every prideful thought and seed. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 88-902 YEARS PLANJoshua 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is free from every prideful thought and seed. - I walk in the humility of heart at all times. - I humbly submit to the supply of God. - I enjoy the supply of multiplied grace in my life. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 900 - THE GREAT EXAMPLE OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Percept upon percept, here a little and there a little, we have dived into many rich realities of faith. Episode 900 is here. Beloved, this journey has been so refreshing, edifying and insightful. I know you've been equipped within these past years. For today, I want to know how this rich platform has sincerely blessed you in the comments. Author Friday, 11th July, 2025 THE GREAT EXAMPLE OF JESUS"And consider the example that Jesus, the Anointed One, has set before us. Let his mindset become your motivation" Philippians 2:5 (TPT)As Paul the apostle was admonishing the Church in Philippi to walk and work in oneness, he pointed out the need for humility to make that a reality.In his admonishment, he shared the greatest example of Jesus.The example of Jesus brings clarity to how a believer has to express the divine reality.He is the embodiment of the Godhead and the express image and portrait of the invisible God. (Colossians 1:15)
This means that the example of Jesus is the ultimate expression of divine humility.
The greatest model of divine humility is Jesus. When you emulate the example of Jesus, you live the true Kingdom life."And consider the example that Jesus, the Anointed One, has set before us. Let his mindset become your motivation. He existed in the form of God, yet he gave no thought to seizing equality with God as his supreme prize. Instead he emptied himself of his outward glory by reducing himself to the form of a lowly servant. He became human! He humbled himself and became vulnerable, choosing to be revealed as a man and was obedient. He was a perfect example, even in his death—a criminal’s death by crucifixion! Because of that obedience, God exalted him and multiplied his greatness! He has now been given the greatest of all names!" Philippians 2:5-9 (TPT)It wasn't a high thing for Jesus to become a human. It was a demonstration of His humility.
For Jesus to live humbly means humility is a great thing and a precious quality in the Kingdom.
Humility was a precious thing in God's saving plan. In truth, if not for the humility of Jesus, the eternal plan of God wouldn't have been executed. The greatest work of God in the universe was accomplished when the WORD (Jesus) humbly became flesh.Jesus, being God, humbled himself to the form of a lowly servant. Yes, Jesus was given because God loved the world. However, He was able to be given because He humbled Himself.Being humble is a great mystery unto greatness and increased authority.The crucifixion of Jesus was God's demonstration of wisdom to bring salvation to mankind. And it took the humility of Jesus for Him to exercise obedience even unto death. Thus, humility is a demonstration of God's wisdom."He humbled himself and became vulnerable, choosing to be revealed as a man and was obedient. He was a perfect example, even in his death—a criminal’s death by crucifixion!" (Verse 8)Jesus' humility was so great at a point when He could have commanded legions of Angels to fight for Him (Matthew 26:53), He chose the sufferings of the cross.Read more about the crucifixion of Jesus here.It is clear that the greatest demonstration of God's love was through the humility of Christ. And He attained and obtained a name which exudes the greatest authority in the entire universe of God.
It takes a humble heart to serve under authority, to exercise great authority.
Choose the example of Jesus!Walk in Humility!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DoYi17mtafs&t=3380sDIG DEEPER(James 4: 6-10; Philippians 2:3-10; Proverbs 22:4; Matthew 23:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall walk and live consistently after the pattern of Jesus' humility at all times and in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 91-932 YEARS PLANJoshua 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I live and walk consistently after the pattern of Jesus' humility. - I walk in the humility of heart daily at all places. - I am humble to the core. - I don't entertain pride in any form. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 901 - WHAT DO YOU SEEK TO ADVANCE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Of the many things the Lord supplies you for your advantage, one crucial item is GRACE. Grace is for your BEING and it is also for your DOING. Beloved, you must take advantage of the empowerment of Grace to do more for the Lord. Selah. Author Saturday, 12th July, 2025 WHAT DO YOU SEEK TO ADVANCE?"For it seems as though everyone else is busy seeking what is best for themselves instead of the things that are most important to our Lord Jesus Christ"  Philippians 2:21 (TPT)Being born again does not mean you automatically have the interest of the Lord's Kingdom at heart.
Some people were born again because they only want to enjoy the goodness of the Lord.
Some were born again to escape Hell and condemnation.To be born again is more than escaping Hell or condemnation. To be born again is more than being delivered from the power of darkness.To be born again is also to be translated into the Kingdom of the Son of God. (Colossians 1:13).You are not translated into the Kingdom to be a spectator. You are translated into the Kingdom to be a participant.We are not in the Kingdom to only live in the glory of the Kingdom. We are in the Kingdom to also partake in the labour and the afflictions which come with the gospel.Paul said to his Son Timothy, "Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God" 2 Timothy 1:8 (KJV)You are not in the Kingdom to serve your selfish interest. You are in the Kingdom to serve the purpose of the Lord.Though the Lord wouldn't force or coerce you to serve His interest, He expects you to make His interest your interest.
You have the choice to advance your interest or to advance the interests of Christ.
Advancing the interest of Christ may attract persecution and some discomfort. And not many are willing to make the necessary sacrifices. They want to satisfy their belly and not discomfort themselves.They will choose sleep over intercession. They will choose hangouts with friends over preaching the gospel.They will esteem their career over being carriers of the glorious gospel of Jesus. They will prefer to be politically correct to save their jobs, rather than to shine as the light of the gospel in their communities. Such people attend Church meetings for the miracles and not for the interest in Christ. They sit in Church to hear about what the Lord will do for them. The material blessings they want to enjoy are more important than the salvation of souls.They are interested in their academic success, promotion in the workplace, travelling opportunities, marriage, and increased bank balance, and are willing to do whatever it takes to advance these interests. This is why they even pray.Don't be quick to look away from your heart. Don't point fingers at anyone. Take a moment and consider your walk with God.
When you stand before the Lord, will you be able to boldly say that you have lived this year or this month serving His interest?
I am not asking you to think about how you served Him two years ago or even last year.I am asking you to think about how you have served or advanced the Lord's interest this month.At the end of this week and this month, what will you be able to say you achieved for the Lord?Read Paul's testimony of Timothy's example:"For I have no one like him [no one of so kindred a spirit] who will be so genuinely interested in your welfare and devoted to your interests. For the others all seek [to advance] their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ (the Messiah). But Timothy’s tested worth you know, how as a son with his father he has toiled with me zealously in [serving and helping to advance] the good news (the Gospel)". Philippians 2:20-22 (AMPC)
What do you seek to advance?
Your interests or the interests of Jesus (which is the advancement of the gospel)?Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YtRS05-j4XoDIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 3:2; 2 Timohty 4:10; 1 Corinthians 10:24; 2 Corinthians 5:15; Matthew 6:33) WE PRAYWe pray that beginning from today, all our focus and pursuit will be set on the advancement of the gospel of Jesus and all interests of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 94-962 YEARS PLANJoshua 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am not in the Kingdom to serve my selfish interest. - I serve the Lord's purpose. - I set all my focus and pursuit on the advancement of the gospel of Jesus and all interests of the Lord. - I esteem the will and purpose of God- I don’t serve my interests. I serve all of God’s purposes for me in my generation.-  I don’t give my mind to the things of this world.– God’s testimony of me is that I am a man after his heart and will serve all His will.Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 902 - FOCUS ON THE KINGDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God. What are you waiting for? Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT. Author Sunday, 13th July, 2025FOCUS ON THE KINGDOM“But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.” Matthew 6:33 (KJV)In the present Church, many have relegated the core mandate of the Church and made the additional benefits of our relationship with God their priority.
Churches today in their bid to help society, have become need-centered rather than Christ-centered.
This has made the present-age, average believer in Christ become focused on his or her individual needs rather than the purpose of Christ.God is more interested in our individual needs than we are. However, God has a bigger picture and wants us to uphold that picture rather than our personal needs or interests.Some people attend Church meetings today, not with the same goal as the first-century Church.The gathering of the saints is not primarily to meet the self-centred needs of the saints. The gathering of the saints is mainly to equip the saints for the work of the ministry.“Now these are the gifts Christ gave to the church: the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, and the pastors and teachers. Their responsibility is to equip God’s people to do his work and build up the church, the body of Christ.” Ephesians 4:11-12 (NLT)
To do the work of the ministry is to reconcile many to Christ and to disciple them to become the expression of Christ.
As this is achieved, the Kingdom of God expands in the hearts of many.The goal of the adversary transcends you. The goal of the adversary is to attack your accomplishments in the Kingdom.He knows that when he can get you depressed, afraid, troubled, and wearied, you will not be able to do the things God wants you to do. When you are not able to stand against his evil schemes and enforce your victory in Christ, you will not be able to shine the glorious light of the Kingdom in the dark places.The adversary knows that if he could make you live occupied with your personal needs, you will not have the focus on the Kingdom.
When the satisfaction of your personal needs becomes your goal and cravings, Christ will not be at the center of your heart.
Let God (who is your loving Father) take care of your needs, as you set your affection and focus on His assignment for your life.This was one of the key secrets of King Solomon. He set his focus on his assignment as Israel’s king. He didn’t request personal things but the wisdom to rule God’s people, and God blessed him with wealth and riches. “Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.” 1 Kings 3:13 (Berean Standard Bible).Pay attention to what Jesus said:“So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require?“So above all, constantly chase after the realm of God’s kingdom and the righteousness that proceeds from him. Then all these less important things will be given to you abundantly.” Matthew 6:31-33 (TPT)
We are at war with the forces of darkness to enforce our victory in Christ and to fulfill God’s kingdom plan.
Have a bigger perspective on spiritual warfare.You are not wrestling against the evil strategies of the accuser (including all his highest evil principalities and authorities operating in rebellion under the heavenly realms) because of your personal needs.
You are wrestling against powerful class of demon-gods and evil spirits that hold this dark world in bondage, because of the mandate of the Kingdom.
The expansion of God’s Kingdom in the hearts of men and the dark places of the earth should be your focus.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 6:19-33; 1 Kings 3:7-14; Matthew 19:27-29; 2 Corinthians 10:3-5) WE PRAYWe pray that the expansion of the Kingdom of God will be the burning desire and imbued focus of every believer at all times and in all they do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 97-992 YEARS PLANJoshua 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I set my focus on God’s will and set my mind on things above.– I esteem the will and purpose of God– I don’t serve my interests. I serve all of God’s purposes for me in my generation– I don’t give my mind to the things of this world.– I have no other master apart from God.– God’s testimony of me is that I am a man after his heart and will serve all His will.Oh, Hallelujah![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 903 - KINGDOM REPUTATION 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved in Christ, your cup (your life and living, which is the life of God in you) will never run dry. ENJOY THE OVERFLOWING, GRACIOUS BLESSINGS OF THE LORD. This is a blessed week! Author Monday, 14th July, 2025 KINGDOM REPUTATION"You already know about his excellent reputation, since he has served alongside me as a loyal son in the work of ministry" Philippians 2:22 (TPT)No matter how you operate (whether in secret or openly), the impact of your actions cannot be hidden.
Consistent impact is tangible and visible.
To make an impact is to have a marked effect or influence on someone or a people. The consistency of your impact forms part of the body of your reputation.Wherever you find yourself, people will remember you according to your reputation.There are people who have a great reputation in their workplaces or schools, but have no great reputation in the Kingdom.What are you known for in the Kingdom?Will you call it an excellent reputation?Is it worth celebrating?Does your reputation inspire faith?Does your reputation reflect the things which interest the Lord?As a Kingdom person, your reputation must be that you serve the purpose of the Lord.You cannot be serving your interests and expect to be applauded by the Lord.Some claim they do God’s work, but not in the open. The work of the Lord cannot be hidden. Like I said from the beginning, no matter how you operate, your great impact cannot be hidden.
Thus, if you are truly making an impact, your reputation will be known by the Lord and by the saints.
You are a city set on a hill that cannot be hidden (Matthew 5:14). It is prideful to think that the saints are not to determine whether you have an excellent reputation or not. You cannot make an excuse that you are making an impact, and it is only the Lord that knows.In case you didn't read the opening verse well, read again:"You already know about his excellent reputation, since he has served alongside me as a loyal son in the work of ministry"They knew the reputation of Timothy because his service to the Lord and impact were tangible.You cannot serve the Lord directly without serving in partnership with the saints. You cannot serve the Lord outside His Church. You serve the Lord through His Church (precisely, the ministry in which He has planted you).Timothy had the opportunity to serve the Lord and to achieve an excellent reputation through the ministry of Paul the apostle. His reputation was built over time as he followed instructions and served diligently.
Your genuine and excellent reputation in your local Church is recognised as a reputation in the Kingdom.
How are you handling responsibilities entrusted to you?Do you execute the assignment of the Kingdom given to you with excellence?How is your reputation advancing the Kingdom?Do you have a reputation for sitting on the fence?Do you have a reputation for not being available or consistent?What is the testimony of your Pastor or Leader about you?
Your Kingdom reputation is according to the big things you dare to do for the Lord through your local Church.
And that is a determinant of your heavenly crowns and rewards.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:7-9; 2 Timothy 4:11; 1 Corinthians 4:17; Matthew 5:16; Acts 16:1-2; 2 Corinthians 8:18) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will supply us with more grace and stir our hearts to attempt great things which will make many glorify Him through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 100 - 1022 YEARS PLANJoshua 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:- By the supply of grace, I attempt great things for the Lord. - I don't live to serve my interests. - Through me, many will glorify the Lord. - Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of Christ. - I make consistent impact in the Kingdom. - I am a trailblazer in the Kingdom. - My impacts are tangible and visible. - I am known for mighty works in my local church. - I execute every kingdom assignment with excellence. - My reputation is advancing the Kingdom. - I don't sit on the fence, I get myself involved at all times. - I am in and never out. - I am available at all times.Thank you Lord Jesus for the supply of more grace!Oh, thank you Lord for stirring up my heart to attempt great things for you![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 904 - KINGDOM REPUTATION 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To do big things for God, you must have tough skin. Be God-occupied. Don’t yield to challenges. Nothing has the capacity to work against you. Beloved, focus on the mandate the Lord has entrusted to you. Author Tuesday, 15th July, 2025KINGDOM REPUTATION 2"You already know about his excellent reputation, since he has served alongside me as a loyal son in the work of ministry" Philippians 2:22 (TPT)To have an excellent reputation in the Kingdom means to have a proven and tested worth.
It is not a gift; it is what you faithfully do with the gift of grace at work in you.
It is the consistent impact you make through your consistent labour.You don't gain this reputation through a one-time event. You are marked with an excellent reputation by the great impact you make over a period of time.The Kingdom recognises giant steps. You cannot distinguish yourself in the Kingdom when you don't participate in a great and distinguished Kingdom assignment.Don't be shy to make a visible impact. Until men see your impact, they will not glorify your Heavenly Father.
An excellent Kingdom reputation is not an attempt to please men, but the genuine act of faith to transform lives unto the glory of the Father.
We are called by God from darkness into light to show forth His excellence.People will always see your impact. No matter how long it takes, consistent impact cannot go unnoticed.What is your testimony in the body of Christ?Do people praise the Lord when they hear your name?What are you doing for the Lord that is worthy of great praise? When your leader remembers your name or thinks of you, does he or she thank the Lord for your life?"Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, my partners in ministry serving the Anointed One, Jesus, for they’ve risked their own lives to save mine. I’m so thankful for them, and not just I, but all the congregations among the non-Jewish people respect them for their ministry" Romans 16:3-4 (TPT)
If you are truly making an impact, your reputation will be known by the Lord and by the saints.
Be interested in making a tangible impact. Be interested in being the reason the Kingdom expands and lives are transformed in all places. Don't be selfish and don't live for your own interest. Live for Christ.What are you known for in the Kingdom? Will you call it an excellent reputation?This is a testimony of a brother, Paul the apostle, sent along with Titus:"With him we are sending the brother who is highly respected in all the churches for his work in preaching the gospel." 2 Corinthians 8:18 (Goodnews Translation).The scripture you just read is one of the scriptures which inspired my heart with joy.How are you celebrated in the Churches for your work in the gospel?Does your reputation reflect the things which interest the Lord?
As a Kingdom person, your reputation must be that you serve the purpose of the Lord.
Don't settle for less.Don't sit on the fence.Be part of those daring to achieve glorious things for the Kingdom.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:7-9; 2 Timothy 4:11; 1 Corinthians 4:17; Matthew 5:16; Acts 16:1-2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall exercise diligence, the boldness and courage of the Spirit to attempt great things in the spread of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 103-1052 YEARS PLANJoshua 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– By the supply of grace, I attempt great things for the Lord.– I don’t live to serve my interests. – Through me, many will glorify the Lord. – Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of Christ. – I make consistent impact in the Kingdom. – I am a trailblazer in the Kingdom. – My impacts are tangible and visible. – I am known for mighty works in my local church. – I execute every kingdom assignment with excellence. – My reputation is advancing the Kingdom. – I don’t sit on the fence, I get myself involved at all times. – I am in and never out. – I am available at all times.Thank you Lord Jesus for the supply of more grace!Oh, thank you Lord for stirring up my heart to attempt great things for you![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 905 - GOD HAS CALLED YOU FOR THIS REASON
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is nothing you need to remain strong in the Lord and the power of His might which the Lord has not given to you. Don’t break down, and don’t live as one who is defenseless. Selah. Author Wednesday, 16th July, 2025 GOD HAS CALLED YOU FOR THIS REASON“…Yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants. He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD’s good plan will prosper in his hands.“ Isaiah 53:10 (NLT)
God has great plans for His Kingdom, mankind, you, and all His creation.
God’s great intention or plan is that His glory will be expressed in fullness. To achieve this, God has ordained you to be the conduit for fulfilling His glorious plan. As a conduit or a steward of God’s great plan, you can determine the extent to which the work of God will be done. The things you desire to do were put in your heart by God. “For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases Him” Philippians 2:13 (NLT) Yours is to nurture the Lord’s desire in your heart; through prayer, meditation and the steps you take.
The more you take steps to act out God’s desire in your heart, the greater it becomes. 
God sees the need to entrust more to you, as you become faithful with the little He entrusts to you. The Lord enables you to do more; however, when you are not determined to work out what the Lord has purposed in your heart, you may fail. “The sons of Ephraim were armed as archers and carrying bows, Yet they turned back in the day of battle.” Psalm 78:9 (Amplified). These sons of Ephraim were armed and well equipped, yet turned back in the day of battle. You can be resourced and still turn away from the pursuit of purpose.
Make it your determination that the purpose and plan of the Lord shall prosper in your hands.
This was what the Prophet Isaiah declared concerning Jesus; “…He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD ’s good plan will prosper in his hands.” Isaiah 53:10 (NLT).
Beloved, God has called you for this reason; that His purpose and good plan will prosper in your hands.
Don’t settle for less; go for the ultimate plan of God. You are enabled for this purpose. Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 30:12; 1 Corinthians 12:6; I Corinthians 15:10; Ephesians 1:5) WE PRAYThat we will faithfully work on that which the Lord has entrusted to us for the good plan of the Lord to prosper in our hands. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 106-1082 YEARS PLANJoshua 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling. – I don’t give excuses, I get the job done. – Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on. – I don’t stop halfway, I press on. – I go the extra mile. – I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord. – I do the extraordinary. – I am a Champion. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 906 - DON'T WATER DOWN THE GOSPEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Thursday, 16th July, 2025 DON'T WATER DOWN THE GOSPEL"For unlike so many, we are not peddlers of God’s Word who water down the message. We are those sent from God with pure motives, who speak in the sight of God from our union with Christ." 2 Corinthians 2:17 (TPT)The gospel is the goodnews of Jesus. In the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus, there are no two gospels; the gospel is one.
There is no goodnews in the universe which is as good as the glorious news of Jesus.
The gospel of our Lord Jesus is the consistent revelation of God in Christ Jesus.It is the declaration of the supply of God's love and demonstration of His graciousness.The gospel unveils how God has justified all who received Jesus and has made them righteous in Christ. It is the communication of God's eternal forgiveness.The gospel says, you are not saved by your works or self-efforts. But you are saved by grace through faith in Christ Jesus. "For it was only through this wonderful grace that we believed in him. Nothing we did could ever earn this salvation, for it was the gracious gift from God that brought us to Christ! So no one will ever be able to boast, for salvation is never a reward for good works or human striving." Ephesians 2:8-9 (TPT)To preach that we are saved by grace, however, we need our works to preserve our salvation, is to water down the good news of Jesus.
The moment the security of our salvation is preached on the grounds of our self-efforts, we should know that the Gospel is peddled.
Peddlers of the gospel portray God's love demonstrated on the condition of our good self-efforts.But that is not what the love of God is; the love of God is unconditional. Jesus did not die for you because you were righteous. He died for all men when we were yet sinners.The only price which was paid for the salvation of men was the blood of Jesus. Though salvation is not cheap, God has freely made it available for us through Christ Jesus.To preach the gospel for self-gain or selfish interest is to peddle or water down the gospel of Jesus.That which the Lord has done is complete!It does not need additives or your sentiments to make it whole.Jesus did a finished work through His death and resurrection.
When your goal of preaching the gospel is also to enrich your selfish ambition, you may have to preach a mixed gospel which also another gospel.
When you preach the gospel of Jesus, people will focus on the Lord and not on the preacher.Don't water down what the Lord has accomplished because of how you feel.Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:2; 1 Thessalonians 2:3-5; 2 Peter 2:3; Titus 1:11; Galatians 1:10; Acts 20:29-30) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall greatly esteem the glorious gospel of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 109-1112 YEARS PLANJoshua 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I esteem the glorious gospel of Jesus. - I don't water down what the Lord has accomplished. - I don't peddle the gospel. - My salvation is eternal. - I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus.  - I preach the gospel of Christ with boldness. - I give no room for any other gospel. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 907 - DON'T MOVE AWAY FROM THE GOSPEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow the challenges or limitations of your background to bully you. Don’t bow to the systems of this world. Be a fighter. Don’t allow anything to reduce you to ordinariness. You are not ordinary; you are of God. Therefore, don’t live an ordinary life; live as a leading victorious soldier. Shalom! Author Friday, 18th July, 2025 DON'T MOVE AWAY FROM THE GOSPEL “But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ”2 Corinthians 11: 3 (NKJV)What do you think was Paul’s greatest concern for the Churches he planted and the people he raised?
It is that they will not be moved away from the gospel of Jesus.
And that is the same concern of all the Apostles of Jesus.Today’s Church has a different understanding of who a False Teacher, False Prophet and False Apostle is in their midst.Most Teachers, Prophets and Apostles who will be called false are now celebrated by “Christians” as True teachers.The Church doesn’t know the difference between another gospel and the true gospel of Jesus.Paul instructed the leaders in Ephesus to be watchful of false teachers and prophets.He called these false teachers ferocious wolves. And he said they will speak perverse and distorted things (Acts 20:29-30).These things they speak are contrary to the gospel of Jesus. Remember, there are no two gospels. The gospel of Jesus is the gospel of Grace.See Paul’s commendation:“And now I commend you to God [placing you in His protective, loving care] and [I commend you] to the word of His grace [the counsel and promises of His unmerited favor]. His grace is able to build you up and to give you the [rightful] inheritance among all those who are sanctified [that is, among those who are set apart for God’s purpose–all believers].” Acts 20:32 (Amplified). Falsehood has always been in contrast to the revelation or the gospel (the goodnews) of Jesus.Look at the opening verse in context:“I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all.”  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)
The simplicity of Jesus is the gospel of Jesus. Your commitment to the gospel is your pure and simple devotion to Jesus.
Stand strong in the glorious revelation of Jesus.Also, note that not all false gospel is preached by fake Pastors or Teachers or Apostles. Some people are genuinely called of God and sent by Christ, yet may find themselves teaching another gospel.It doesn’t mean the people are false, but their message or aspects of their teachings may be false.For example:One will teach that, “You are saved only by grace through faith in Christ Jesus and not by works”.That is the true gospel.However, after this person gets people saved, he begins to teach the saints another gospel, saying, “Though you are now saved, you can lose your salvation. Your salvation is not forever; it depends on your good works”.Beloved, this is a clear example of false teaching.To say one will lose his salvation is to say that the blood of Jesus is not enough to satisfy the demand of Justice. (I gave over 50 reasons you cannot lose your Salvation, click here to watch).To understand Justification, read the following: - Justification 1 – 3- Justified by Faith- Christ’s won freedom wasn’t partial- The Case is closed- What shall separate you?
Your salvation only depends on the good works of Jesus. It is not dependent on your works. (Ephesians 2:9).
Now, because you have been made righteous by Jesus, you live right unto God’s glory.This is the gospel.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Galatians 1:6-12; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we will not be given to another gospel but will consciously remain strong in the simplicity of the gospel and not swallow any other teaching at all. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 112-1142 YEARS PLANJoshua 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ. – I am righteous by faith in Christ. – My salvation is eternal. – I give no room for any other gospel. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 908 - ESTEEM THIS ABOVE ANY OTHER CALLING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Instead of worry and sorrow, pray. And most importantly to build up your entire being, pray in tongues. Don’t go a day without speaking in tongues. Get to it now! Author Saturday, 19th, July, 2025 ESTEEM THIS ABOVE ANY OTHER CALLING“How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”Isaiah 52:7 (NKJV)
The assignment to proclaim or herald the good news of Jesus is a high calling.
During a time of war, the only news the people in the city look forward to is good news. The people esteem the coming of the messengers.Just as David, the king was waiting for the news from the pursuit of Absalom. (2 Samuel 18). David positioned the watchman of the tower to look forward to the coming of a messenger.The people of antiquity eagerly looked forward to the messengers from the battlefield. The news from a messenger can determine the stability and instability of a people, which made the responsibility of a messenger during those times a high calling.“Look, a messenger is coming over the mountains with good news! He is on his way to announce the victory! People of Judah, celebrate your festivals and give God what you solemnly promised him. The wicked will never invade your land again. They have been totally destroyed!” Nahum 1:15 (Good News Translation)How a messenger is seen running gives the impression of victory or goodnews from the battlefield.  
As heralds of the gospel, you must have an attitude of victory. You must proclaim the goodnews of Jesus with joy.
Another prophetic item we see in all these prophetic scriptures about the coming of the messenger is the MOUNTAINS. Though the mountains in these verses give an idea of the landscape of Jerusalem, they also provide imagery of the coming of the messenger.Jerusalem is situated on a mountain.“… Solomon began to build the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David…” 2 (Chronicles 3:1)And Jerusalem is also surrounded by mountains. “Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abides forever. As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people from this time forth and forever.” (Psalm 125:1-2)Thus, as the messengers come to Jerusalem with their good news, they will be seen coming down the mountains. Nevertheless, mountains also have deeper meanings in the scriptures. Mountains depict exaltation, greatness and higher experience.Get this, though mountains surround Jerusalem, there are plains in between Jerusalem and the mountains, since Jerusalem is also on a mountain.So why didn’t the prophet speak of the messengers running in the valley?The Prophet used the mountains not to show the landscape around Jerusalem, but used the landscape around Jerusalem to show the HIGH CALLING of the messenger with beautiful feet.
Your calling and commission to publish or herald the good news of Jesus is as one with beautiful feet upon the mountains; because it is a high calling.
Don’t belittle the responsibility of heralding or preaching the glorious gospel of Jesus. Esteem it above any other calling.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:9; Isaiah 41:27; Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20-23; Songs of Solomon 2:8) WE PRAYWe pray that all believers shall see and highly esteem the assignment to preach and teach the gospel of Jesus as the High Calling of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 115-1172 YEARS PLANJoshua 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have a high calling to herald the good news of Jesus.– I herald this good news of Jesus with joy. – Many are hearing the good news of Jesus through me. – I refuse to sit on the fence, I preach Christ everywhere. – I am bold and daring about this glorious good news. – I have beautiful feet. Oh thank you Lord!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 909 - INCREASE THE INFLUENCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT OVER YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You can decide to do things according to your will or according to the will of God. The choice is with you. Author Sunday, 20th July, 2025INCREASE THE INFLUENCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT OVER YOU“There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God.”2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)All that God has put in you is not for you; it is to be a blessing to the nations. The impartation of God’s blessings in you is to cause you to make IMPACT on others.
Whenever God wants to bless a people, He sends a man.
While Joseph was living a challenging life from slavery to prison, God was preparing him to be the escape for Jacob in the days of famine (Genesis 45:7). When Israel agonised with pain in Egypt, God raised Moses and sent him as their deliverer.However, God gave a word that He would go down to Egypt to save His people Israel. Which means God sending Moses to Egypt was God Himself going to Egypt to save Israel. (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10; Acts 7:33-35).There are men whom God raised to be channels or conduits of blessings to their generation. And you (reading this with today) are one of the blessings God has sent to bless this generation.The grace and abilities of God within you are part of the answers God is sending to this generation at such a time as this.Nevertheless, you cannot fulfill this great mandate without God. To affect many lives positively, you have to enlarge your capacity.“Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.” Isaiah 54:2-3 (KJV)To enlarge your capacity, you must stretch your inner man through consistent and persistent long, intense prayers.To begin with, I want you to know it is wrong to think short, quick prayers are not prayers. Every prayer is a prayer. The quality of prayer is not really how long you’ve prayed. The quality of prayer is how well it is founded on the word of God.
Every prayer rooted in the Word is effective!
 THEREFORE, NO MATTER WHAT, PRAY! So then, if even short, quick prayers can be effective, much more so when you give yourself to consistent, long, intense prayers?The idea of consistent, long intense prayers is not about God expecting you to beg Him for long before He does something for you. Consistent, long, intense prayers are about having quality time with the Spirit.
The longer you spend time with the Spirit of the Lord in prayer, the stronger His influence on you becomes.
The Spirit of God enlarges your spirit and strengthens your inner man. The anointing of the Holy Spirit on you becomes stronger.Are you wondering what to say or pray about?Cheer up!There is the gift of praying in the spirit. To pray in the Spirit includes praying in other tongues.Get this:“The one who speaks in tongues advances his own spiritual progress…” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (TPT)Since tongues speaking will cause you to advance your spiritual progress, or edify (embolden, build or construct your inner man), then do it more to make more spiritual progress!Beloved, even ten minutes of tongues speaking will build your spirit. Therefore, make time to pray in tongues for 30 or 60 minutes; then grow it to 2 hours, and then 6 hours.
The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God.
What are you waiting for?Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:30-31; Luke 18:1; Genesis 26:2; Isaiah 26:15; Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]) WE PRAYWe pray that against all odds and hindrances, we shall break forth in our spirit and maintain intense consistency in prayer.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 118-1202 YEARS PLANJoshua 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Rather than worrying about the size of the assignment, I pray. – I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.  – Through my effective prayers, I increase in capacity to do more. – I don’t settle for less, I persist long in prayers. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 910 - HOLD ON TO THE WORD OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your faith is governed by your personal revelation. When you have a personal revelation of the Word, you can have personal daily victories of faith. Selah. Author Monday, 21st July, 2025HOLD ON TO THE WORD OF GOD"Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?” John 11:40 (TPT) There is a reason the Lord keeps reminding you of things pertaining to your faith walk with Him.
Anytime the Lord bring admonishments your way, He is establishing a certain consciousness in you.
If you have been reading with , you must know that your time of harvest is here. When the children of Israel were in slavery, the only message they needed was “DELIVERANCE”. But that wasn’t the message they needed when they were entering the promised land.  At that point, they needed to be Conscious of the presence of the Lord and be strong and courageous. And that was the message the Lord was administering to Joshua. Whenever the adversary sees you stepping into greater heights, he attempts to weaken your confidence in God.Understand that God doesn’t bring challenges your way to prove your faith. God only inspires you to do great things. 
The adversary uses challenges or negative situations to distract or stop you from doing the things God wants you to do.
This is why you must maintain absolute confidence in God. No challenge should be big enough to move you away from God. No challenge should be big enough to make you doubt God. Hold on strongly to what God have said. In the story of Jesus raising Lazarus from the dead, you will see two instances of faith. Remember, faith is your response to God’s Word. We are going to look at how two sisters (Martha and Mary) responded to Jesus. One day, Lazarus (a brother of Martha and Mary, and a loving friend to Jesus) became very sick to the point of death. “So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, our brother Lazarus, the one you love, is very sick. Please come!”When He (Jesus) heard this, he said, “ This sickness will not end in death for Lazarus, but will bring glory and praise to God. This will reveal the greatness of the Son of God by what takes place.” (See John 11:3-4) This was the foundational word that Lazarus raised from the dead. Jesus said this sickness is not unto death but unto the glory and praise of God. Again, it doesn’t mean God afflicts people with sickness and diseases to show His glory, but rather, when the adversary strikes people with any infirmities, because of God’s healing power, many see God’s glory and give praise to Him. Now, Mary and Martha were to hold on to that message and allow it to define their composure. Nevertheless, Martha, for example, argued and doubted the decision of Jesus to roll away Lazarus’ tomb.Look at this, John 11:38-40 (TPT):”Then Jesus, with intense emotions, came to the tomb—a cave with a stone placed over its entrance. Jesus told them, “Roll away the stone.” Then Martha said, “But Lord, it’s been four days since he died—by now his body is already decomposing!” Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?” I believe Jesus had to look at her with astonishment, because before this time, He had said a lot to Martha and Mary about being the resurrection and the life. Martha was not holding on to the Words of Jesus. 
Until you hold on to the Word of God, you will not demonstrate absolute confidence in God.
“So they rolled away the heavy stone. Jesus gazed into heaven and said, “Father, thank you that you have heard my prayer, for you listen to every word I speak. Now, so that these who stand here with me will believe that you have sent me to the earth as your messenger, I will use the power you have given me.” Then with a loud voice Jesus shouted with authority: “Lazarus! Come out of the tomb!” Then in front of everyone, Lazarus, who had died four days earlier, slowly hobbled out—he still had grave clothes tightly wrapped around his hands and feet and covering his face! Jesus said to them, “Unwrap him and let him loose.” From that day forward many of those who had come to visit Mary believed in him, for they had seen with their own eyes this amazing miracle! John 11:41-45 (TPT). Oh Hallelujah. Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. 
Don’t look at the challenges to doubt God. 
Make the Word of the Lord your focus, and you will see the manifestation of His glory. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(John 11; Hebrews 11) WE PRAYThat no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 121-1232 YEARS PLANJoshua 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My time of harvest is here and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary. – I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 911 - STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency God wants you to be saturated and soaked with His Word, and that you can handle the personal Word for warfare. Be saturated and soaked with the Lord through meditation. Beloved, don’t keep quiet! Talk the word! Author Tuesday, 22nd July, 2025STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART"Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart" Job 22:22 (NKJV)What you have in your heart is what distinguishes you. The difference between those who bring change to their world and those who struggle to make an impact lies in what they have in their heart. Your heart is the governing seat of the Spirit. 
God cannot do anything through you beyond the condition of your heart.
The state of your heart defines the extent you go with God.A wicked heart will produce wickedness. A merry heart will produce joy in his or her sphere. Whatever we see happen in our world is essentially the product of the condition of the hearts of men who have influence in the society. One cannot manifest what he has not conceived in his heart. When you conceive evil, you will produce evil. When you conceive blessings and beauty, you will produce blessings and beauty. ”Peter asked Him, “Explain this parable [about what defiles a person] to us.” And He said, “Are you still so dull [and unable to put things together]? Do you not understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is eliminated? But whatever [word] comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what defiles and dishonors the man. For out of the heart come evil thoughts and plans, murders, adulteries, sexual immoralities, thefts, false testimonies, slanders (verbal abuse, irreverent speech, blaspheming).” Matthew 15:16-19 (Amplified Bible) See this also: “For the godless are barren: they can produce nothing truly good. God’s fire consumes them with all their possessions. The only thing they can ‘conceive’ is sin, and their hearts give birth only to wickedness” Job 15:34-35 (TLB) When you conceive failure, defeats, poverty, wickedness, hatred, envy and afflictions in your heart, that is what you will manifest or express.
Men, by their nature and their culturing without the word of God, are selfish at heart. 
And a selfish heart breeds envy, hatred, anger, wicked thoughts etc. “The human heart is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked. Who really knows how bad it is?” Jeremiah 17:9 (NLT). See also: Genesis 6:5; 8:21; Ephesians 4:22.This is why at your new birth in Christ, God took away the stony heart to give you the new heart of grace.The Lord declared this through the Prophet Ezekiel, “Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. Your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols. And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.“ Ezekiel 36:25-26 (NLT). See also 2 Corinthians 3:3; Jeremiah 24:7; Psalm 51:10.Now in as much as at new birth the Lord gave you a responsive heart, your heart must be cultivated and nurtured with the Word of God.The Word of God is the revelation of God’s wisdom, His goodness and character.
To demonstrate and express the character of God, you need the Word in your heart.
"How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word. With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments! I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you" Psalm 119:9-11 (ESV) When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:6;11:18; Psalm 37:31; Matthew 13:15; Colossians 3:16; 1 Timothy 4:15; Psalm 1:1-3) WE PRAYThat we will give heed to the instructions of the word of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 124-1262 YEARS PLANJoshua 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have invested the word of God in my heart, therefore none of my steps will slide. – I stay my mind and heart on God’s word. – My heart is a fertile and fruitful land for the word of God. – I give my mind daily to the mediation of the word. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 912 - BE INSPIRED BY FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Focus gives direction to divine energies. Whatever has your attention, attracts the resources of God within you. Don’t scatter divine resources, FOCUS! Author Wednesday, 23rd July, 2025 BE INSPIRED BY FAITH"With this in mind, we constantly pray that our God will empower you to live worthy of all that he has invited you to experience. And we pray that by his power all the pleasures of goodness and all works inspired by faith would fill you completely" 2 Thessalonians 1:11 (TPT)Faith is a great deal in our walk with God.The scriptures are clear, without faith it is impossible to please God (Hebrews 11:6).Faith is a divine response in our hearts to God's supply. It is the present and confident possession of Grace.
Whatever you do as a believer must be by grace through faith.
Faith is demonstrated through your deeds or actions of the word (James 2:18).Your works must not be according to what you feel.Anything you do only by how you feel is limited to moments or moods.It will take your response of faith in God's gracious supply to do more for Him without any limitation.All you do for the Lord is reckoned as works.
