But these works are only credited to God's goodness when they are Works done by Him.Whatever you do for the Lord must be what the Lord has already supplied grace for. This then means that the Works you do for the Lord are of Him, because He has already worked them into you.Thus, your works are not merely works for God but works of God.
The works of God, which are demonstrated through you, are works inspired by faith.
The works which are inspired by faith will always oppose the feeling of the natural mind.Works inspired by faith are greater works of the Holy Spirit. ANTICIPATE! EPISODE 0 Our works must be inspired by faith.When your works are inspired by faith, they produce eternal value.Works which are inspired by faith are not things done according to the comfort of men. Works inspired by faith will discomfort your natural self.Your service to God, your soul winning, your participation in discipleship, your giving into God's work, your expression of godliness and demonstration of love must be according to the inspiration of faith.You are inspired by faith through:- The communication of the word.Seeing the glorious things men do for the Lord by faith will challenge your heart to do more for the Lord. (Read Hebrews 11)- Also, the instructions of the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit will inspire you to do greater things with boldness and faith (Acts 4:31). Whatever the Holy Spirit inspires in your heart is consistent with the revelation and purpose of Jesus. The Holy Spirit will not inspire you to do anything which is not consistent with the purpose of Christ.- And through men the Lord has set over you. Leaders whose hearts burn for the accomplishments of God's purpose will inspire you to only do the things which are of Christ (Philippians 2:22).What you attempt to do for the Lord must be according to the faith He has inspired in your heart.Selah. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:10; 2 Corinthians 5:7; 1 Thessalonians 1:3; James 2:26) WE PRAYWe pray that by his power, all the pleasures of goodness and all works inspired by faith would fill you completely. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 127-292 YEARS PLANJoshua 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My works are inspired by faith. - All the pleasures of goodness and all works inspired by faith fills me completely. - All that I do are according to the faith the Lord has inspired in my heart. - My works produce eternal value. - I work the works of God by faith. - I am a man of faith and I live by faith. - The flesh has no voice in my works. - My heart is knitted together with the Lord in carrying out the assignment He has entrusted to me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 913 - ALLOW THE SCRIPTURES TO TRAIN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You are not and shall never be hated by God. You are God’s beloved and He has loved you with an everlasting (unending) love. Walk in this confidence all the days of your life. Selah. Author Thursday, 24th July, 2025 ALLOW THE SCRIPTURES TO TRAIN YOU"All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness" 2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV) At new birth, you received the life of God and full capacity.Jesus said, “…I came that they may have life, and have it in abundance [to the full, till it overflows].” John 10:10 (Amplified)
However, for life to have full expression in you, it is dependent on how you have been cultivated.
The life of God is in your spirit. God does not live in your mind; He lives in your spirit. And your mind has to be cultured to become conscious with the reality of God in your spirit-man. This is what spiritual maturity is to a certain degree. Spiritual maturity is basically your growth in consciousness. It is your mind, your will and emotions being cultivated to operate according to the reality of God in your spirit. For example:“God has not given you the spirit of fear” This is the reality of your spirit. However, you may find yourself living in fear. Why? Your mind, emotions and will have not been trained to practice the reality of fearlessness.
The more you give yourself to the training of the Word, the more you live according to God’s reality in your spirit.
You have to consciously submit your consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. When you don’t submit yourself to the teachings of the Word, you must know that other thought patterns are cultivating you. Whether you are intentional about it or not, you are cultivated or trained to live by some thought patterns. If your life is not influenced by the Word of God, you will be influenced by some other information. It is just like having bare land, with no intentional vegetation.The land will not remain bare forever because weeds will germinate on that land. Weeds grow anywhere there is room. Just because there’s no visible activity on a piece of land doesn’t mean nothing is growing there Our Lord Jesus likened the heart to a field and the word to a seed. (Mark 4:16-20).
When you don’t intentionally cultivate or train your heart with the Word, weeds will germinate.
Even while you are cultivating your heart with the word (as the seed), you have to consistently use the word to uproot wrong seeds, which will germinate in the field. Usually, when you are cultivating a field and weeds also begin to germinate on that field, they compete with the plants over nutrients. The word of God as a seed is profitable for:”…doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness” 2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV) The scriptures are God’s course for your living. They are designed to cultivate your heart and also to uproot or correct any wrong teachings of the world. To word instruct is the Greek word, “paideia”, which means to educate or train and to correct or discipline and chastise.
The word of God trains you to live according to God’s design and thought.
It sharpens your mind, emotions and will to live in conformity to God’s will publicly and privately. Don’t allow weeds of thoughts from the news, the society, friends, school, workplace etc germinate in your heart. Guard your heart with the Word of God. Be intentional about what grows in your heart. Envy, pride, hatred, fear, pain, bitterness, etc, can germinate in your heart without your permission, if you don’t intentionally give yourself to the training of the Word. As you study the Word, it corrects negative imaginations and thoughts which are not in conformity with the mind of God. BE A STUDENT OF THE WORD This is how you can be equipped for every good work. Beloved, allow the word to train you. Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qbIBGgu1BWsDIG DEEPER(Romans 15:4; Zephaniah 3:4; Psalm 119:11; Proverbs 6:23; Proverbs 15:10,31) WE PRAYThat we will consciously submit our consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 130-1322 YEARS PLANJoshua 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I intentionally give myself to the training of the word.– I guard my heart with the word of God. – I don’t permit negative thoughts. – I allow the word of God to cultivate my heart. – As I fellowship with the word of God daily, it sharpens my mind, will and emotions to live in conformity to God’s will. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 914 - ARE YOU HELPING OR ARE YOU MAKING THINGS WORSE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter how little or how big the matter is, trust the Lord. The Lord will always deliver, protect, defend, preserve, provide, and prosper you. Beloved, refuse to limit His ability in you. Selah! Author Friday, 25th July, 2025ARE YOU HELPING OR ARE YOUMAKING THINGS WORSE?“Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.”1 Chronicles 12:1 (KJV)Jesus is not building His Church for funfair.Jesus established the Church to prevail against the gates of hades.The Church is the light of God in this world.“And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.” Matthew 16:18 (ESV).Our Lord communicates how the gates of hell will wage war against the Church. The good news is that the gates of hades SHALL NOT PREVAIL AGAINST THE CHURCH. Darkness cannot subdue the light of God.Which means the Church is a formidable force. It is an army with well-armed soldiers (2 Timothy 2:3; Ephesians 6:11-13).As a Church, we have the responsibility to tear down and subdue anything that exalts itself above the knowledge of Christ (2 Corinthians 10:5).This is a war over the salvation of souls. The Church has the mandate to bring deliverance to the nations.
This is WAR! And you must be involved.
PLEASE READ THE VERSE BELOW PATIENTLY:“This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you’re not on my side, you’re the enemy; if you’re not helping, you’re making things worse” Matthew 12:30 (MSG).Okay, just read the verse above again. And give it a deep thought.With this war between the Church (light) and darkness, there are no neutral grounds.If you are born again, you are part of the Victorious Church. God has set you in the Church at such a time as this, to make enviable contributions for the advancement of the course of Christ. “And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.” 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)
He has set you in the Church for you to be a HELPER OF THE WAR.
Just as certain men came to David to Ziklag, and they were among the mighty men, helpers in the war. These helpers of the war were they who fought side by side with David.Beloved, God has set you in the local Church or Ministry Assembly for you to labour side by side with your Pastor or Setman to spread the gospel of Jesus.This is the time to take many hearts for Jesus. You must finance the gospel to villages, cities, schools, institutions and nations.You must be a helper of the War. The Lord has put desires in your heart for greater works. Don’t relent nor sit back.Do something now!Be a HELPER OF THE WAR through;– Your radical giving of your resources or financial partnership.– Your involvement in evangelism and soul-winning.– Your service in the local Church.
When you are not helping in this war, you are making things worse.
BE A HELPER of the War today.Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Matthew 12:29-30; Luke 11:23; Matthew 6:24; Joshua 5:13; Joshua 24:15; 1 Chronicles 12:1-40) WE PRAYThat the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps in our local churches which will make us get ministerial results. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 133-1352 YEARS PLANJoshua 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am sharpened by the Lord for His great work this year. – I am a helper of the war. – I conquer and win territories for the Lord. – I shall be immovable as steel post. – By the relentless power of God I am enabled to subdue kingdoms. – I topple and crush the systems of this world. – The Lord is with me, therefore I fear no evil. – I don’t sit on the fence. – I labour through faith. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 915 - TAKE YOUR PLACE AND BE A BLESSING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow anything or anyone who did not die for you on the cross, to separate you from the Lord who died for you. Don’t allow the evil, people do to you to change you! Selah. Author Saturday, 26th July, 2025 TAKE YOUR PLACE AND BE A BLESSING  “And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.” 1 Corinthians 12:28 (KJV)The Church which is the body of Christ, is the agency or the conduit established by God to fulfill His mandate or agenda.
The building of the Church is essentially the work of our Lord Jesus.
However, for the Lord to build His Church (which is His body), He has to set functional members into the body. There is no well-built and healthy body without effective and healthy members.When you look at the human body, it has many parts, which are members that make the body function effectively according to God’s design.Imagine a body without hands, or legs, lungs, kidneys, and heart. The body will not be a healthy one.
God set or placed each of the various body parts to make the body function effectively.
Each member or part of the body has a unique duty. And God dexterously designed it to be so.“For the body does not consist of one limb or organ but of many. If the foot should say, Because I am not the hand, I do not belong to the body, would it be therefore not [a part] of the body? If the ear should say, Because I am not the eye, I do not belong to the body, would it be therefore not [a part] of the body? If the whole body were an eye, where [would be the sense of] hearing? If the whole body were an ear, where [would be the sense of] smell? But as it is, God has placed and arranged the limbs and organs in the body, each [particular one] of them, just as He wished and saw fit and with the best adaptation. But if [the whole] were all a single organ, where would the body be?” 1 Corinthians 12:14-19 (AMPC)Beloved, the Body of Christ (the Church) is as well designed to function just as the human body is. The Body of Christ (the Church) has many parts or members. These members have unique functions in the body according to God’s design, desire, and purpose.
 When you became born again, God set you in the body of Christ as a member with a unique function.
You have a special assignment in the body of Christ; take your place and be a blessing.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 12:12-30; Romans 12:3-8; 1 Peter 4:10-11; 1 Timothy 4:12-14; Colossians 3:17) WE PRAY–  Thanking the Lord for this precious opportunity to be set in the church with a unique function.– That we will walk in the revelation and consciousness of this placement.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 136-1382 YEARS PLANJoshua 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an effective member of the body of Christ. – I have a unique function and a special assignment in the body. – I am a nourishment to the entire body. – I have been set in the church, therefore I take advantage of my place to be a blessing to many.  Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 916 - DO YOU PRAY FOR YOUR LEADER?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t look away, to pursue your own selfish interest. Don’t invest all your time into what makes you happy or pleases you. Set your affection on this assignment of soul winning or ministry of reconciliation. Make the Lord’s mission your mission and passion. Don’t procrastinate, get to work now! Author Sunday, 27th, July, 2025 DO YOU PRAY FOR YOUR LEADER?“and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel”Ephesians 6:19 (NKJV)The gap between God’s plan and the fulfilment of that plan is God’s people.
Anything God has accomplished on Earth, He did it through His people.
God will always appoint a man among His people to become a voice, a leader and a lighthouse. This is not to create an impression that others are better. This is by the workings of God’s grace.Those leaders God appoints become conduits of His greater works.God has set leaders in the church to be responsible for the growth of each saint and to equip the saints for the spread of the gospel according to the power of the Holy Spirit.The mindset of the spiritual leaders, will affect the mindset of the people and influence the climate of the Church within a locality.These leaders in the Church mostly labour for the spread of the gospel. Sometimes most believers assume their leaders are strong in faith and don’t need prayers.It is important you understand that, through prayers, you make the abundant supply of divine grace, strength and provisions in the spirit to your leader. There are many ways the adversary wants to destroy and distract their focus and pursuit of God’s plan.
In the labour of the gospel, people risk their lives and come close to death.
To do the work of the ministry and to spread the gospel is true warfare. And the adversary seeks every opportunity to attack and destroy not only the saints, but mainly the shepherds or those who lead the saints.“…Strike the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered…” (Zechariah 13:7)Epaphroditus was a leader who was assisting Paul on behalf of the saints in Philippi, at the frontline of the ministry, even as Paul was in prison.Paul in his epistles referred to Epaphroditus as “fellow soldier” (Philippians 2:25).This characterizes the nature of the work they were doing. They worked or laboured as fellow soldiers because the work of the ministry is a spiritual warfare. “However, I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, [who has been] my brother and companion and fellow soldier, who was also sent as your messenger to take care of my needs. For he has been longing for all of you and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick. He certainly was sick and close to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow. So I have sent him all the more eagerly so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned about you. Welcome him home in the Lord with great joy, and appreciate and honor men like him; because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me [which distance prevented you from rendering personally].” Philippians 2:25-3 (Amplified Bible)This is the reason Paul’s prayer request in Ephesians 6:19-20, unveils the objective of spiritual warfare.
This spiritual warfare against the forces of darkness is mainly to ensure that the gospel of Jesus shall prevail in all places.
This is war.The adversary is plotting against the Church and the leaders. And for your Church leaders to firmly stand to continue in the labour of the gospel, you must make supplication for them daily.This is to your advantage.Has this with blessed you in any way?Then you must pray for me as well.
There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy.
Beloved pray and honor those who labour in the gospel of Jesus.Glory to God.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:3; Romans 15:30; 2 Corinthians 1:11; Philippians 1:19) WE PRAYPray for your leader, Pastor or shepherd and Teacher of the gospel, that he or she will stand strong in the faith and remain focus in labour of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 139-1412 YEARS PLANJoshua 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel.– The Lord is making them increase in boldness.– They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord.– They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power.– They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil.– The faith of the Leaders shall not grow cold. They will increase in the Lord’s zeal and in great faith. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 917 - ARE YOU SHARING IN GOD'S DESIRE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved no matter the accusation or mockery, have this conviction in your heart that you have found the greatest treasure of faith. Your faith is not built on dead hope. Don’t turn away from this precious revelation of Jesus. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 28th July, 2025 ARE YOU SHARING IN GOD'S DESIRE?“Jesus called out to them and said, “Come and follow me, and I will transform you into men who catch people for God.”Matthew 4:19 (TPT)When our Lord Jesus called His disciples, He was specific, direct, clear and blunt on what He was going to turn them into.He was not going to produce “marketplace apostles”. He would not make them lawyers, accountants, successful medical doctors, politicians, Phd holders, international economists, CEOs of multinational empires, engineers, programmers, etc.
Jesus was going to make them new kinds of fishermen. He was going to turn them into men who catch people for God.
Jesus did not call His disciples to improve their fishing business, essentially. He called them with the primary intention of transforming them into men who catch people for God.This doesn’t mean our Lord devalues our individual careers or professions. Neither does it mean that He doesn’t bless our work. The Lord is interested in our career success because He loves us. He instructs us to work and not be lazy through His word.However, some believers have redefined the primary assignment of the believer. These people become disciples of Jesus, often with the perception that the Lord will help them succeed in their careers or professional ambitions. Did Jesus not help Peter catch more fish?The Lord did help Peter and his friends (Luke 5:4-11), and He continues to help those who believe in Him and respond to the instructions of the Spirit to succeed at what they do.Irrespective of your career or occupation, your primary assignment as a disciple of Jesus is to make more disciples.Jesus said, “…I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit…” John 15:16 (NLT)
This is the primary purpose of being a disciple of Jesus; to be like Christ and to become a fisher of men.
As a disciple of Jesus, you are brought into His fellowship and followership, so that through you God will bring many more men into His fellowship and followership.“Then Jesus came close to them and said, “All the authority of the universe has been given to me. Now go in my authority and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. And teach them to faithfully follow all that I have commanded you. And never forget that I am with you every day, even to the completion of this age.” Matthew 28:19-20 (TPT)No matter what you do, you must find yourself catching men for God. That is God’s desire.
He desires that all men shall be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth.
Be the medium by which the Lord’s desire will be fulfilled.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Acts 1:8; Philippians 1:11; John 20:21; 1 Corinthians 9: 16-17) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds will be settled on the fulfilment of the Lord’s primary assignment for us as His disciples. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 142-1442 YEARS PLANJoshua 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My mind is set on fulfilling the Lord’s primary assignment for me. – I don’t replace the primary asignment of winning men unto the Lord with any other thing. – Through me, many are experiencing the knowledge of the truth.– I daily avail myself as the medium by which the Lord’s desire will be fulfilled.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 918 - BE SOBER-MINDED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, as the blessed of the Lord, you are lavished by the Lord with super-abundance. You have the capacity and ability to generate resources. Refuse to think POOR! Selah! Author Tuesday, 29th July, 2025 BE SOBER-MINDED“Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.”1 Thessalonians 5:6 (KJV)The Believer’s sobriety is not a matter of self-enabled control. To be sober begins with the choice to be fully yielded to the dominance of the Holy Spirit.
The self-control of a believer is a quality of his sobriety, which is also an expression of the fruit of the Spirit.
“But the fruit of the Spirit [the result of His presence within us] is love [unselfish concern for others], joy, [inner] peace, patience [not the ability to wait, but how we act while waiting], kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such things there is no law.” Galatians 5:22-23 (Amplified Bible)A fruit is an outcome of a rooted life. A fruit is not a source but a result. The fruit of the Spirit is the result of the presence and the life of the Spirit.Being sober is not an activity or a posture isolated from the Holy Spirit. You cannot be sober-minded without the Holy Spirit. The present society creates an atmosphere of anxiety and discouragement. It will only take a person who is fully saturated by the Holy Spirit to remain mentally and spiritually composed.There are many things which will attempt to intoxicate your mental stability even as you pursue the assignment of the Lord and behold the Lord’s coming.Our Lord speaking to his disciples was clear on this:“…without me you can do nothing…”“I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless” John 15:5 (TPT).
You cannot become fruitful in your walk of faith without the supply of our Lord.
This is why He gave us the Holy Spirit as a means to which we can continuously commune intimately with the Lord.Take note of this illustration of Paul in 1 Thessalonians 5:“Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober. For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night. But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.” 1 Thessalonians 5:6-8 (KJV)He talks about sleeping and being drunk at night.What does it signify?It unveils the influence and effect of the night. It is to be drunk (intoxicated with wine). To come under the influence of toxic desires for the flesh. It is to have your beautiful heart mixed with thoughts of doubts and unbelief. And instead of being drunk, Paul admonishes the brethren not to be like the others who are in the night, and under the influence of darkness. He charges them to be sober. As I explained the meaning of being sober (“nēphō”), it is to be wineless or totally free from mental and spiritual intoxication.Paul gave another similar illustration to the brethren in Ephesus;“And don’t get drunk with wine, which is rebellion; instead be filled with the fullness of the Holy Spirit.” Ephesians 5:18 (TPT)To the Thessalonians he admonished them not to be as others who sleep and get drunk at night. But they should be sober-minded because they are of the light. Then he admonished the Ephesians to not be drunk with wine (to be wineless, sober and self-control); and to be continuously filled and saturated with the Holy Spirit.Did you get it?Let’s go over it briefly again:
To be sober-minded is literally to be wineless or free from intoxication. However, this sobriety is not being empty headed, but fully saturated with the Holy Spirit.
Thus, as you behold the coming of the Lord you must be fully saturated by the Holy Spirit. Moreover, understand that the Holy Spirit is given as the guarantee that we are the Lord’s.This is then the testimony that when the Lord comes, He is coming for you because you are His.Don’t be distracted and dominated by the deception of the adversary. Live daily under the influence of the Holy Spirit and you shall graciously demonstrate sobrietyHallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ah-sLxo8pDI&pp=ygUdY2hyaXN0IGNvbW1vbndlYWx0aCBjb21tdW5pdHk%3DDIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16, 22-24; Ephesians 5:14-18; 1 Peter 5:8; Titus 2:2) WE PRAYWe pray that as we have been sealed by the Holy Spirit and received Him as a guarantee that we are the Lord’s, we shall consistently live each day in union with Him and according to His influence and not how we feel.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 145-1472 YEARS PLANJoshua 20DECLARE THESE WORDS– Through the enabling ability of the Spirit, I remain sober-minded in this perverse generation. – I have total and abosulte dependence on God. – I am deeply rooted in the Spirit. – I have no confidence in my flesh. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 919 - DON'T ISOLATE YOUR EMOTIONS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Where there is doubt there is no faith. Where there is no faith, there cannot be the enjoyment of God’s inheritance. Beloved, refuse to doubt the Word. Author Wednesday, 30th July, 2025 DON'T ISOLATE YOUR EMOTIONS“Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart”.Psalm 37:4 (NKJV)Mostly when it comes to our relationship with God, the focus has always been on the “spirit of a man”. You hear people make statements like “To connect deeply to God, it is not about your emotions…”
Our relationship with God involves our entire being.
God wants you to be soaked and saturated in all of your being.God didn’t design your emotions for earthly activities; He gave you emotions as tools to express His impressions.The focus of your emotion or desire exposes the pleasure of your heart.God is interested in the focus of your emotions or the delight of your heart. And you have to train your emotions or desires to be focused on the Lord.
Don’t isolate your emotions or desires from the Lord.
Delight yourself in the Lord! David said, “Here’s the one thing I crave from God, the one thing I seek above all else: I want the privilege of living with him every moment in his house, finding the sweet loveliness of his face, filled with awe, delighting in his glory and grace. I want to live my life so close to him that he takes pleasure in my every prayer.” Until you also set your desire on the Lord, your fellowship will not be organic.What you crave after is a deep-seated impression of your emotions.
Don’t disconnect your emotions or desires from the Lord. 
In your communion with the Lord carry your emotions along.Until your emotions consistently gravitate towards the Lord, you will not be wholly addicted to the fellowship of the Spirit.There is no absolute immersion in the Spirit when the treasures of your desires are focused on the pleasures of this world.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Mark 12:30; Job 22:26; Job 27:10; Psalm 69:9; John 2:17; Psalm 73:25; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYThat our desires shall be saturated with the intense desire of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalm 148-1502 YEARS PLANJoshua 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t isolate my emotions from the Lord. – My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – My delight is in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 920 - DON'T HARDEN YOUR HEART TO THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy. Don’t sit on the fence. Strive with your leader through prayers to God for the spread of the gospel. Selah. Author Thursday, 31st July, 2025 DON'T HARDEN YOUR HEART TO THE WORD“I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly” Psalm 85:8 (NKJV)The word canon is from the Greek word “kanōn” which means the “standard” or “rule”.The collected books of the Bible, which were canonized were taken through a standardized process of testing. The canonization of the books of the Bible went through several processes. It was done not just by an individual but by Jewish Rabbis and scholars around and then later by the early Church fathers in the first century.Jesus, our Lord recognized several books of the “Old Testament” portion of the Bible as scriptures or the Word of God. He made references to these books. He acknowledged all the present books of the Old Testament as the scriptures. The Apostles also did the same. They recognized and made references from the various books of the Old Testament. They treated the scriptures as the Word of God.They also did the same with the writings of the other Apostles. Paul’s writings were recognized by Peter and the other saints as scriptures (2 Peter 3:15-16).The epistles of the Apostles were read by the Churches as they do read the Old Testament scriptures. (Colossians 4:16; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Nehemiah 8:1-6).
These books of the Bible are scriptures and are all the outbreathing of God.
“All Scripture is God-breathed [given by divine inspiration] and is profitable for instruction, for conviction [of sin], for correction [of error and restoration to obedience], for training in righteousness [learning to live in conformity to God’s will, both publicly and privately—behaving honorably with personal integrity and moral courage]” 2 Timothy 3:16 (Amplified Bible).All sixty-six (66) books of the Bible are the outbreathings of God. They are the articulation of the wisdom of God for our nourishment. They are the accepted, standardized canonized books which utter the statutes and ordinances of God. These men who authored the scriptures did not do it to seek their own interests; they were moved by the Holy Spirit (2 Peter 1:21).
The Bible is the Word of God.
The book of Hebrews opens with a summary of what the Bible contains:“God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds.” Hebrews 1:1-2 (KJV)The entire Bible contains the relevant revelation of God to mankind. And this revelation was progressively comprehended by the Fathers and the Prophets.And God finally made His revelation plain and fully comprehensible through Christ Jesus. Jesus came as God’s final Word to mankind. And this final revelation or ultimate message of God to mankind has been given to us in the New Testament. The mysteries of God in the Old Testament have now been revealed in the New Testament.This then makes the question asked valid:God’s full and complete word to man has been spoken to us through Christ Jesus, and this message has been revealed fully in the Bible. So then does God still speak to Christians/believers?What this should help you understand is that, since God has spoken in these last days through Jesus Christ, to even hear God, you must hear what He has said through Christ.
You must turn to what God has said in Christ, because, God’s final and ultimate means of speaking is Christ.
Jesus is the voice of God for mankind.And how will you know what He has said through Christ? Beloved, it is only by His word. Therefore, when you hear His voice through the word, do not harden your heart. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ah-sLxo8pDI&t=3701sDIG DEEPER(Romans 4:23; Romans 15:4; 1 Corinthians 10:11; Habakkuk 2:2; John 5:39; Hebrews 2:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall continually grow in the understanding of the revelation of God in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 1 - 32 YEARS PLANJoshua 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is not harden to the voice of God. – I grow in the understanding of the revelation of God in Christ Jesus. – I hear the voice of God and I obey. Thank you Lord for the gift of your voice![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 921 - BE DARING IN FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Anyone who is not fully established in Truth will be tossed by every wind of doctrine. Such a person lacks the readiness of mind to function according to divine purpose. Beloved, get rooted and established in Truth (which is the revelation of Jesus). Selah. Author Friday, 1st August, 2025 BE DARING IN FAITH“Abraham never wavered in believing God’s promise. In fact, his faith grew stronger, and in this he brought glory to God.”Romans 4:20 (NLT)To be daring in faith is not to have vim or be enthusiastic. To have a daring faith or to be daring in faith is to act on the word of God.Until you act on God’s word, you have no faith. Faith doesn’t stand without the word. The reality is that without God’s word, there is no faith.The faith which Abraham had was based on God’s word. David’s audacious decision to confront Goliath was based on the covenant relationship between God and Israel.You cannot be daring in faith without the word of God. Your confidence in the word of God in you is what makes you bold. 
Anyone without the word is defenseless.
When you step out there in faith, you are not afraid to fall because you know the Lord will help you from falling. When the storm comes ,you are not threatened because you know you are planted in the Lord and you shall not be moved.When the need arises, you are not perturbed because you know the Lord takes care of you.Most people don’t think that Abraham had to be daring to accept the name God gave him. To accept the name means he was going to announce that he is going to have many sons against all odds.“We call Abraham “father” not because he got God’s attention by living like a saint, but because God made something out of Abraham when he was a nobody. Isn’t that what we’ve always read in Scripture, God saying to Abraham, “I set you up as father of many peoples”? Abraham was first named “father” and then became a father because he dared to trust God to do what only God could do: raise the dead to life, with a word make something out of nothing. When everything was hopeless, Abraham believed anyway, deciding to live not on the basis of what he saw he couldn’t do but on what God said he would do. And so he was made father of a multitude of peoples. God himself said to him, “You’re going to have a big family, Abraham!” Romans 4:17-18 (Message).
Faith dares to believe that God will do what He says He will do even when everything seems to be hopeless.
Abraham did not doubt God, wasn’t skeptical and did not give up even though they had had decades of infertility. Abraham stood on God’s word and had confidence that God had all the power to do or fulfill His promises.This is how daring faith acts out the word of God.Daring faith caused mothers to receive back their dead children.Consider the example of the Shunammite; when her son died, she didn’t go about announcing. She remains composed in faith. Even when the husband asked about the child, she said “ALL IS WELL”.Don’t water down that phrase, ALL IS WELL. It wasn’t a remark of hopelessness. All is well is a bold remark of faith in the face of adversity.She went to the Prophet Elisha with great confidence that her child would be restored to life. (2 Kings 4:18-37)
Faith is daring and doesn’t kowtow to negative news, nor to challenges and situations which contradict God’s word.
Be daring in faith, knowing that God will do what He says He will do. Don’t doubt the word of God.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qbIBGgu1BWsDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAYWe pray that as we boldly act out the Word of God we shall see the fulfillment of all that God has said to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 4-62 YEARS PLANJoshua 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strong and courageous. – My faith works. – I am audacious in faith. – I dare to stand on God’s word no matter the storm. – I am daring. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 922 - CHRIST STRENGTHENS YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Faith dares to believe that God will do what He says He will do even when everything seems to be hopeless. Beloved be daring in faith, knowing that God will do what He says He will do. Don’t doubt the word of God. Author Saturday, 2nd August, 2025 CHRIST STRENGTHENS YOU“I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.” Philippians 4:13 (KJV)The influx of divine strength is the rich secret to doing all things which Christ has called you to do.To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace. It is to be empowered with the ability of God. It is also to become self-sufficient in the sufficiency of Christ for every good work.
The strength of Christ in you enables you to exercise mastery in all things.
When it feels like you cannot pursue or do the assignment of the Lord with limited resources, remember, the secret:THE LORD GIVES YOU STRENGTH.The strength of the Lord in you is not only effective in you when you have abundance.Take a look at this:“I know what it means to lack, and I know what it means to experience overwhelming abundance. For I’m trained in the secret of overcoming all things, whether in fullness or in hunger. And I find that the strength of Christ’s explosive power infuses me to conquer every difficulty.” Philippians 4:12-13 (TPT)Did you see that? When you exercise the strength of God to triumph amidst “little -difficult” moments, you train yourself to continuously triumph over huge challenges.
The strength of Christ in you is Christ’s explosive power which infuses you to conquer every difficulty.
The more you press on to carry out God’s assignment for you, the more the adversary also opposes you. His interest is in preventing you from fulfilling your calling. You don’t have to feel incapable at any given time.There are times when, no matter which direction you turn, you may face opposition or limitations. Sometimes the pressure and the challenges may seem insurmountable.But cheer up!
You can do all things through Christ who strengthens you.
“Since His power is so glorious, may you be strengthened with strength of every kind, and be prepared for cheerfully enduring all things with patience and long-suffering” Colossians 1:11 (Weymouth New Testament)As the Lord invigorates you with His strength, you are empowered by Him to cheerfully endure every form of hardship as you fulfill His purpose.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zJbu7z5oV64&t=62sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall strengthen us more and more to triumph in His assignment amidst all the deepest devastations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 7-92 YEARS PLANJoshua 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. – I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. – I have the ability to achieve every task the Lord sets on  my heart to achieve. – I don’t waste the strength of Christ on things the Lord has not called me to do. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 923 - YOU HAVE THE STRENGTH OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, find out what God has said in His word concerning your health, your finances, your ministry, your family, your destiny, your work, your marriage and your society. Believe it and boldly declare it. Halleluljah! Author Sunday, 3rd August, 2025 YOU HAVE THE STRENGTH OF GOD“But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.” Isaiah 40:31 (KJV) To have the strength of God, you must turn to Him and receive Him as life.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strength in you.
The Holy Spirit dispenses and distributes all of the virtues of God into you. “O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.” Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV) The Prophet Isaiah explains the extensiveness and limitlessness of the strength of God (Isaiah 40:12-28). Now, you see in verses 29 – 31, the Prophet Isaiah explains how God supplies strength to those who are His. Because God’s strength doesn’t faint, those who faint are strengthened by Him.  “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength. Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.” Isaiah 40:29-31 (KJV) The phrase, “even the youth shall faint”, is a depiction of how the strongest shall faint even in their prime. The youthful season is the prime season of every natural thing.  It is normal to faint in old age. It may even seem normal to grow weak after you have been pressed by challenges. It may seem normal to grow tired and become exhausted.
Yet the testimony of those who WAIT upon the Lord is different. Those who WAIT upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
Now the Lord gives power to the faint and causes strength and ability to abound towards those who lack might. It doesn’t matter how the vicissitudes have beaten you up and crushed you; the moment you turn and open up to the LORD, strength is dispensed and distributed to you. You cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength you must have God. As a believer in Christ, you have the advantage; God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
You can accomplish more with the strength of God when it is RENEWED. To RENEW the strength of God, you must learn to WAIT UPON THE LORD.
To wait upon the Lord is not just an imagery of a “Waiter” in a restaurant. The word WAIT is from the Hebrew word, “qâvâh . The primitive root for “qâvâh” means “TO BIND TOGETHER”. To wait upon the Lord means to look patiently to the Lord, to expect and to be tied to the Lord. It means you are knitted and plaited with and to the LORD. Jesus said, “I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless.” John 15:5 (TPT) Inasmuch as it is good to be a tree, it is far greater and better to be a branch. The strength and fruitfulness of a branch are dependent on the tree. You must be knitted to the Lord as a fruitful branch is to a great tree. Don’t be separated and be distracted or moved away from the Lord.
The more you remain in the Lord, the more you are renewed in strength.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DoYi17mtafs&t=3380sDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 27:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted nor become prideful but will always remain rooted and established in the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 10-122 YEARS PLANJudges 1-3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my strength. – I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. – The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. – I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"] Section Title EPISODE 925 – REFUSE TO BE DISCOURAGED  ByApostle August 5, 2025 Faith, with “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of... title: EPISODE 924 - GREAT FAITH ACKNOWLEDGES THE POWER AND AUTHORITY OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The love of God in your heart is the greatest force that protects you and resists every projectile of the adversary. Don’t live by what you feel. Live a life of faith towards God and according to the expression of His love. Selah. Author Monday, 4th August, 2025 GREAT FAITH ACKNOWLEDGES THE POWER AND AUTHORITY OF JESUS“When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.” Matthew 8:10 (KJV) Though there are different levels or dimensions of faith, there are also different kinds of faith. One of them is to have “GREAT FAITH“.
To have great faith is determined by how you act and function in the revelation of Jesus.
There are only two instances where FAITH was described as GREAT by Jesus. They were seen in two none Jews: A Roman centurion and a Canaanite.(Matthew 8:10, Luke 7:9 and Matthew 15:28). In both scenarios, the people involved broke certain walls of limitation to demonstrate great faith. In places where Jesus may not have expected faith, He found great faith. From the opening verse, you will see how Jesus marvelled at the Faith of the Roman Centurion. That wasn’t the only time Jesus marvelled; He also marvelled at how He found no faith in His own people of Nazareth. To marvel is from the Greek word “thaumazō“. Which means to admire, to be astonished or to stand amazed. It also means to step back and say “Wow!“. In a situation or place where Jesus thought there should be great faith, He witnessed a great level of faithlessness. He stepped back and was negatively “wowed” or dumbfounded.
Faith is of great concern to the Lord. Wherever great faith is found, there is the manifestation of great power.
To exercise great faith, the first item is to demonstrate a great level of reverence and humility towards GOD. Sometimes, we are tempted to subtly boast more of our rights in Christ instead of the Lord who gave us those rights. We enjoy great results of faith not only because of who we are, but mainly because of who He is. 
Our faith shouldn’t be in who we are, but first, who He is. We are what we are because of Jesus. And at all times, we have to submit to Him first.
Look at how the Roman Centurion demonstrated great faith. “And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.When Jesus heard it, He marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.” Matthew 8:5-10 (KJV Despite the credentials of this Roman centurion, His humility before the Lord was overwhelming.  Beloved, to be counted worthy of the Lord’s presence in your life, or to have right standing with God without any sense of guilt by Christ Jesus, is a great privilege. 
Learn to acknowledge the sure mercies and grace of God.
Just because you are now a son of God, a brother of Jesus, and have a mingled life with Christ doesn’t mean you are also a master on your own. He says, “Without Me you can do nothing” (John 15:5). Jesus is your MASTER. The more you see Him as your Master, the more you submit to Him, and your faith finds genuine expressions through Him.
Remember, pride is the greatest limitation of Faith. 
Secondly, the Roman Centurion ACKNOWLEDGED THE AUTHORITY OF JESUS Not only did he humble himself and show how he revered the Lord, but He also acknowledged the greatness of Jesus’ power and authority. Beloved, understanding is everything!
Your life will always be governed by your level of light. 
His understanding of authority made him know how he could get results. He knew the health condition of his servant was caused by a great spiritual force, and to deal with that condition, he needed greater authority and force.The centurion couldn’t think there was any authority greater than that of Jesus. All Jesus had to do for him was to speak a word. 
Great faith acknowledges the power and authority of Jesus.
Are you sure there is a situation in your life which is above the authority of Jesus? Great faith cannot doubt the power and authority of Jesus, no matter the situation. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ah-sLxo8pDI&t=3701sDIG DEEPER(Luke 7:9; Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY– That our minds will be established in the consciousness of the universal power and the authority of Jesus. – That in all matters we will acknowledge and esteem the authority of Jesus.In the name of Jesus. – Pray to address any challenge, by declaring the solution you want to see as you stand in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus and His name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 13-152 YEARS PLANJudges 4-6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I recognise the Lordship of Jesus in my life and every situation. – I walk in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus. –  I exercise great faith according to the revelation of Jesus and not according to any efforts of mine. – I refuse to be proud and egoistic. I walk in the humility to the Lord Jesus and His commandments. I take steps according to the ability of God.  – I am conscious of the universal Lordship, power and authority of Jesus. – I declare that my Jesus is the Lord of all. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 925 - REFUSE TO BE DISCOURAGED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t compromise your faith to make money. Follow the path of the Lord. It is unwise for the righteous to esteem their pursuit for more wealth above their relationship with God. Selah. Author Tuesday, 5th August, 2025 REFUSE TO BE DISCOURAGED “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)Most people acknowledge that bitterness is a poisonous attack of the enemy. However, not all view discouragement as a poisonous attack by the enemy.Most assume that to feel discouraged is a mere emotional condition. However, feeling discouraged is the collapse of your convictions in God’s ability to help you.The adversary will use your failures, seeming stagnation, disappointments and spiteful utterances from people around you.
When you continue to allow people to talk down on the impact of God and His word in your life, they break your confidence and leave you discouraged.
“Their wounding words pierce my heart over and over while they say, “Where is this God of yours?” So I say to my soul, “Don’t be discouraged. Don’t be disturbed. For I know my God will break through for me.” Then I’ll have plenty of reasons to praise him all over again. Yes, living before his face is my saving grace!” Psalm 42:10-11 (TPT)There are words or certain utterances which are designed to pierce and wound your heart. The goal is to leave you discouraged.Don’t keep quiet to allow negative words to ruin your courage.Boldly vocalize your faith in God.The Psalmist said in the above verse, “So I say to my soul”.Oh, glory!
In the face of discouraging situations, what do you say to your soul?
Do you amplify your discouragements, or do you speak forth the word of God?When Goliath saw David, he despised him. He spoke denigrating words, just to discourage and destroy the defenses of David.But that didn’t work with David. David geared up his spiritual arsenal.“As the Philistine paced back and forth, his shield bearer in front of him, he noticed David. He took one look down on him and sneered—a mere boy, apple-cheeked and peach-fuzzed. The Philistine ridiculed David. “Am I a dog that you come after me with a stick?” And he cursed him by his gods. “Come on,” said the Philistine. “I’ll make roadkill of you for the buzzards. I’ll turn you into a tasty morsel for the field mice.” 1 Samuel 17:41-44 (Message)Was David moved by these threats of Goliath?Not at all.Was he discouraged by Goliath’s ridicule and curses?Not at all. David answered, “You come at me with sword and spear and battle-ax. I come at you in the name of God-of-the-Angel-Armies, the God of Israel’s troops, whom you curse and mock. This very day God is handing you over to me. I’m about to kill you, cut off your head, and serve up your body and the bodies of your Philistine buddies to the crows and coyotes. The whole earth will know that there’s an extraordinary God in Israel. And everyone gathered here will learn that God doesn’t save by means of sword or spear. The battle belongs to God—he’s handing you to us on a platter!” 1 Samuel 17:45-47 (Message)The battle between David and Goliath gives us a pictorial view of our spiritual warfare. Though Goliath was physically armoured, he confronted David by invoking the presence of the Philistine gods (Or demonic entities).
It was a spiritual warfare.
David showed us how to win and exercise our victory.He vocalized his confidence in God. The boldness of David in God was all that he needed to exercise victory over Goliath, the Philistines and their gods.David knew the victory over Goliath and the armies of the Philistines was to show forth the extraordinary power and glory of God.David didn’t just demonstrate his confidence and courage in God through words. He demonstrated it through his actions. He never backed out at any time. Even when Goliath charged at him, he charged even more, running at Goliath and the Philistines.
What a young man of faith!
He gave no chance for intimidation.“That roused the Philistine, and he started toward David. David took off from the front line, running toward the Philistine. David reached into his pocket for a stone, slung it, and hit the Philistine hard in the forehead, embedding the stone deeply. The Philistine crashed, facedown in the dirt. That’s how David beat the Philistine—with a sling and a stone. He hit him and killed him. No sword for David! Then David ran up to the Philistine and stood over him, pulled the giant’s sword from its sheath, and finished the job by cutting off his head. When the Philistines saw that their great champion was dead, they scattered, running for their lives.” 1 Samuel 17:48 – 51 (Message).
Beloved, learn to stay strong on the word. Give no place to the devil and his cohorts.
James said, “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you” (James 4:7).Just as David did, he didn’t confront Goliath in the might of the flesh, but in the name of the Lord.Submit your mind, thoughts, and emotions to the Lord. Act according to who God is and not by the threats of the devil.David was aware of the devices of Goliath; therefore, he didn’t depend on the weapons of men but deployed the ability of the Lord Almighty as his armour.
REFUSE TO BE DISCOURAGED AND AFRAID.
SHIELD UP IN FAITH!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YtRS05-j4XoDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:8-9; 1 Peter 5:7; Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:10-11; Isaiah 40:31) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall continue to exercise confidence in the word of God and enforce our victory in Christ, no matter the confrontations of darkness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 16-182 YEARS PLANJudges 7-9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I give no place to the devil and his cohorts.– My heart is focused daily on the ability of God. – I do not live in discouragement. – I refuse to be discouraged and afraid.  – I am full of faith. – I am a blessing to others. – I have absolute confidence in the word of God.– I stay my mind and heart on the word of God.– I refuse to look away from the word.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 926 - DARE TO BE COURAGEOUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t feel helpless when you are overwhelmed by situations. There is a way forward: PRAY IN THE SPIRIT. Get to it now. Author Wednesday, 6th August, 2025DARE TO BE COURAGEOUS"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go" Joshua 1:9 (NKJV) Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith. It is by faith we live and walk with God.
Faith is our reality.
The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them.Anything that brings glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith). Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said. It is knowing without any tittle of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do. Faith is audacious in its dealings. When you act in faith, courage is seen. This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life.And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness.Serving others is greatness; however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation. A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss.Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father’s house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh.He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites, but felt enervated. Maybe you are reading this and feel you don’t have what it takes to do great things.When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community, you can’t do anything great for the Lord.
Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!!
God specialises in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations.That is God. He will always use what seems depleted to reveal His glory. He used a young man who was the least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory in Israel. He made mighty men out of men that were distressed, indebted, and discontented (1 Samuel 22:2). Why must God use a young 17 years old David, with no military experience, to defeat Goliath with just a sling and a stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53)? To feed five thousand people, He used a little boy's lunch pack of five bread and two fish.This is audacity!!!
God doesn’t choose the easy paths; He creates greatness out of what seems impossible.
To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord. "Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus."Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward. You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room. You will look for places to show forth His glory and power.Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you.
Until you take a step to do something great, you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord.
God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary! Selah. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLkDIG DEEPER(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAYLord, I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 19-212 YEARS PLANJudges 10-12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work. – I am strong and courageous. – I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary. – I live above this world. – I do the unimaginable. – I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me. – I am audacious. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 927 - EXERCISE BOLDNESS IN THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you can accomplish great things by the immeasurable grace of God. Have the Faith that God has supplied you with abundance of grace (ability, favor and earthly blessings) to do what He has ordained you to do. Walk daily in this consciousness. Shalom! Author Thursday, 7th August, 2025 EXERCISE BOLDNESS IN THE LORD“But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.”Numbers 11:23 (ERV)The greatest limitation of God’s power and grace is unbelief.
Whatever God will do will first be by His word. When you doubt God’s word, His power and grace won’t find expression.
We know God’s grace is immeasurable, unlimited and infinite. You can manifest an abundance of God’s grace and ability as much as you can exercise faith.Faith acts according to the immeasurable ability of God’s power and grace.Faith acts on what God has said.There are things the Lord has determined to do in your life and through you, yet you can limit the extent God will work His word through unbelief.Though God is all-powerful, He doesn’t force the manifestation of His power in the affairs of men (no matter how much he loves to help them). Therefore, the extent to which you can see the flow of God’s power is dependent on your Faith in His Word.Unbelief, though it has a spiritual root, finds expression in your mind. Your mind can see or imagine what you believe. 
Until your mind can see or imagine the manifestation of what God has said, the hands cannot handle it.
While the Israelites were in the wilderness, they incontinently cried out to God for meat. That was probably to either mock God, prove their doubt or establish their argument that being in Egypt was better than leaving Egypt (Psalm 78:18).God accepted the challenge and asked Moses to tell them He would send them meat in the wilderness.Moses, for a moment, couldn’t imagine how it was going to be possible for God to supply the Israelites with meat. He even gave a logical concern about how impossible it was.See what Moses said to God:“Moses said, “There are 600,000 soldiers here, and you say, ‘I will give them enough meat to eat for a whole month!’ If we were to kill all the sheep and cattle, that would still not be enough to feed this many people for a month. And if we caught all the fish in the sea, it would not be enough for them!”Numbers 11:21-22 (ERV)By human wisdom, Moses was right and had his facts correctly stated. Moses' assertion made more sense by human wisdom.However, “God’s nonsense is wiser than human wisdom, and God’s weakness is stronger than human strength.” (1 Corinthians 1:25 – ISV)The Amplified Bible gives further clarity:“This is because the foolishness of God [is not foolishness at all and] is wiser than men [far beyond human comprehension], and the weakness of God is stronger than men [far beyond the limits of human effort].” 1 Corinthians 1:25.
The limit or boundary of man’s highest strength is the beginning of God’s strength.
You don’t use your limitations to define God. God’s capacity transcends man’s wisest calculations. God’s priceless response to Moses is all you need to hear or read today:“But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.” Numbers 11:23 (ERV)Beloved, what has God said to you?Don’t doubt Him.
Don’t limit the workings of His power in your life through unbelief.
Sometimes when you look at the money in your hand and all the savings or investments you have made or going to make for the next ten (10) years, you will still not have enough for the task ahead. But cheer up!The supply of the Lord is not dependent on your bank balance. The supply of the Lord is according to His own riches and grace. Oh, glory to God.That project is possible if you can only trust and obey the Lord’s word.
Nothing is impossible with God. Stop doubting Him. Stop acting according to your strength.
Take hold of faith and stand in God. The time when it seems impossible is the time you must increase in boldness. Don’t turn back! Don’t run from the battle. Don’t drop your weapons. Faith has no reverse gear. March forward and don’t settle for less.You can get the job done.
Have and maintain your strong confidence in the power of God’s Word, that He will do what He says He will do.
Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week.The grace of God is sufficient for you.Don’t give room to any limitation in your mind.
You can have exceptional results as you exercise boldness in the Lord.
HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Genesis 18:14; Psalm 78:41; Numbers 23:19; Daniel 6:16-23) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not faint, but we shall remain resolute and continue to trust in the limitless immeasurable ability of God and His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 22-242 YEARS PLANJudges 13-15DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don’t define God’s capacity by my limitations- I don’t reduce God’s grace to my human calculation.-  I have confidence in God’s limitless supply.- I believe without any iota of doubt, that God will always do what He says He will do.-  I don’t limit God’s power in my thoughts and imagination. I have strong faith in seeing the mighty workings of God in all things. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 928 - THIS IS THE MESSAGE WE PREACH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 8th August, 2025 THIS IS THE MESSAGE WE PREACH“But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD”Genesis 6:8 (KJV)God is just and has no agreement with evil. His goodness exposes and displaces evil. The judgment of God against evil is also the work of His goodness and righteousness to uproot destruction. His judgment also includes deliverance by faith and not by works.The present world or today’s society has evil, corruption and sufferings breeding rapidly.Parents and families feel hopeless about the possible outcomes for the future generation.Most people are talking about how the entire society is heading towards total destruction.Fear, anxiety and depression have abounded in hearts.Perversion of hearts, greed, and acts of wickedness have occupied news headlines. Acts of kindness have become rare and a jaw-dropping experience in most circles.This shouldn’t be surprising. The scriptures have foretold these happenings.“Don’t be naive. There are difficult times ahead. As the end approaches, people are going to be self-absorbed, money-hungry, self-promoting, stuck-up, profane, contemptuous of parents, crude, coarse, dog-eat-dog, unbending, slanderers, impulsively wild, savage, cynical, treacherous, ruthless, bloated windbags, addicted to lust, and allergic to God. They’ll make a show of religion, but behind the scenes they’re animals. Stay clear of these people.” 2 Timothy 3:1-5 (Message Bible)The Prophet Isaiah also gave a picture of the happenings on the earth:“The whole earth is wrapped in darkness, all people sunk in deep darkness, But God rises on you, his sunrise glory breaks over you” Isaiah 60:2 (Message Bible)
Amidst the chaotic situation of darkness in this world, there is the shining forth of God’s light over those who trust in Him.
The present happenings in today’s world are not new. From the day corruption entered time, the hearts of men have conceptualised evil and wickedness.And God’s news of salvation and deliverance has always been the goodnews of light which shines in an evil world.This is the reality of the Goodnews of Grace; it is the shining forth of God’s light in a hopeless world.Sometimes we think of God’s grace as an afterthought, but God has always been gracious. The fullness of His Grace manifested at the appearing of Jesus. However, this is how God has always operated before time began. Paul the apostle explains this in his second epistle to Timothy:“He gave us resurrection life and drew us to himself by his holy calling on our lives. And it wasn’t because of any good we have done, but by his divine pleasure and marvelous grace that confirmed our union with the anointed Jesus, even before time began! This truth is now being unveiled by the revelation of the anointed Jesus, our life-giver, who has dismantled death, obliterating all its effects on our lives, and has manifested his immortal life in us by the gospel.” 2 Timothy 1:9-10 (TPT)Grace and love are the flow or rhythm and nature of God’s economy. The Kingdom of God, which is the household of God, functions or is administered by GRACE.
God’s graciousness is His emission of light in a dark world.
Grace is glory begun. One cannot experience the glory of God without the administrative work of His Grace.When you understand God’s grace as the economy of God’s Kingdom, you will know that when God said, “let there be light”, He was proclaiming and administering the goodness of His grace.“Let there be light” wasn’t a mere work of creation but the manifestation of God’s goodnews to a chaotic and formless earth.“The earth was formless and void or a waste and emptiness, and darkness was upon the face of the deep [primeval ocean that covered the unformed earth]. The Spirit of God was moving (hovering, brooding) over the face of the waters. And God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light” Genesis 1:2-3 (AMP)This is the message that the present world needs to hear. The Goodnews of Jesus is the only message of grace which will cause the light of God to shine over evil and empty souls.
It is the only message that will deliver this generation from a void and hopelessness. It is the news of God’s life.
Beloved, take heed to the Goodnews of Jesus and not the news of this world. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DoYi17mtafs&t=3380s DIG DEEPER(Genesis 6:5-8; Matthew 4:16; 2 Corinthians 4:6; Acts 26:18; John 8:12; Luke 1:78-79) WE PRAYWe pray that the light of the gospel of Jesus will shine in every heart and prevail in generation and the generations yet unborn through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 25-272 YEARS PLANJudges 16-18DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I take heed to the goodnews of Jesus. - Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of the goodnews of Jesus. - Through my participation, the gospel will shine in every heart, and prevail in every generation and the generations yet unborn. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 929 - PRAYER IS AN ENFORCEMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Let humility describe who you are as you dearly love one another. Reach out to a brother or a sister today and demonstrate these acts of patience and kindness. This is the real you. Go and right the wrongs. Love tenderly! Author Saturday, 9th, August, 2025 PRAYER IS AN ENFORCEMENT“With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified)The scriptures emphasize the need for prayer. We see the importance of prayer through the life and testimonies of the Biblical patriarchs, prophets, priests, kings, servants, soldiers, wives, husbands, widows, the rich, the poor, the distressed, the victorious, farmers, physicians, craftsmen, builders, fishermen, prime ministers, scribes, prisoners, eunuchs, sinners, apostles, the youths and the adults or the old.
Prayer is not for some specific people. Both the small and the great are all called to prayer.
From the scriptures and the epistles, we are charged to pray at all times, in every place or everywhere and without ceasing.Jesus shared a parable to this end, “men ought always to pray and not faint” (Luke 18:1).Prayer is a demonstration of faith and confidence in God.Prayer is essential in this spiritual warfare. It is an advanced technology given to us by God to stay in touch with the military command post or control center.
Unceasing prayer gives access to unceasing mission plans and strategies.
This was David’s main battle strategy. He was always in touch with God at every battle. Therefore, he always knew what to do on the battlefield. While the enemies were strategising, David was in touch with God, who knows and sees all things.You don’t fight against unseen evil forces, principalities, powers, or rulers of dark places and not be consistent in prayer at all times. It is a dangerous thing to be a soldier and not be in touch with your military headquarters.In ancient times, Roman soldiers were always in communication with their command base.Orders were given via horns, drums, movement of flags and riders on horseback.Not staying in touch with military orders can be disastrous for a soldier.
How are you waging spiritual warfare without praying at all times?
You must also understand that prayer is one of the mediums we prove that we are submitted to God.Anything you are not praying about is not under God’s rule and dominion.When you pray, you bring everything or situation under God’s rule.
You must pray all prayers and pray always in the Spirit.
Have you prayed today?Have you received an instruction from God through prayer?Or you are running by your own strength, strategy and plan.
Get into prayer; get God involved.
This is how you walk into possibilities!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qbIBGgu1BWsDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:6; Psalm 116:2; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will give us direction this day so that we will know what to do and the steps to take to accomplish His assignment for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 28-302 YEARS PLANJudges 19-21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 930 - WISDOM IS THE PRINCIPAL THING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Sunday, 10th August, 2025 WISDOM IS THE PRINCIPAL THING“I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just.” Proverbs 8:15 (TPT)The born-again in Christ is translated from the power of darkness into the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus.
In His Kingdom, we are all made Kings and Priests.
“and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler over the kings of the earth.To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood, and has made us kings and priests to His God and Father, to Him be glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.” Revelation 1:5-6 (NKJV)Our reign as kings in Christ doesn’t begin after this present world has come to an end. Our reign as kings in Christ is not for the future. It is a NOW responsibility.The scripture says “He has made us…”, which means He is not now trying or planning to make us kings and priests.Concerning the saved ones, God says:“But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, His own special people, that you may proclaim the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light” 1 Peter 2:9 (NKJV)You are part of the Lord’s nation of kinging-priests. You have the mandate to reign or rule in your sphere, and how you reign is a display of God’s glory.
As kings in Christ, we are to lead our generation with WISDOM.
If, in case you are still wondering why you must love Wisdom, this is it:Wisdom empowers Kings to reign.Hear what Wisdom says:“I empower kings to reign and rulers to make laws that are just. I empower princes to rise and take dominion, and generous ones to govern the earth.” Proverbs 8:15-16 (TPT)How well do you want to influence your world? How do you want to manifest God’s glory?How do you want to lead your generation?
Wisdom is the principal thing!
