content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Thursday, 28th August, 2025 FRUIT OF GENEROSITY 3"I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward" Philippians 4:17 (TPT)Though your generosity blesses lives, it is also to your advantage. The fruit of your generosity brings reward to you. Whenever you are asked to give or there is a conversation about your generosity, don't just think it's because your gift is needed. See the opportunity to receive a bountiful supply.Let this sink deep in your heart, generosity or giving into God's Kingdom is not something God demands from us. Giving or generosity is something God wants for us.The giver benefits far more than the receiver."I’ve left you an example of how you should serve and take care of those who are weak. For we must always cherish the words of our Lord Jesus, who taught, ‘Giving brings a far greater blessing than receiving." Acts 20:35 (TPT)From the previous episode, we addressed one of the rewards of the generosity of the saints:- Your Generosity Leads to the Increase of ResourcesAnother benefit or profit of generosity is:- The Love for God and His Kingdom is deepened in Your HeartThis is the great growth of the saint.Generosity doesn't only give you the opportunity to participate in the spread and impact of the gospel.
Giving into the spread of the Gospel or the work of the ministry imparts and transforms your heart.
As I previously mentioned, whatever the Lord inspires you to do for the advancement of His Kingdom builds and enriches your heart.Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also. (Matthew 6:21).When you genuinely give towards the Lord's Kingdom, you become more interested in things which pertain to God.Your desire and affection gravitate towards the Lord more and more.You always want to see the Kingdom win. What a joy!
Thinking about you and yourself doesn't bless many lives.
Think about it again, do you think this boy will withhold his hand from being generous? Certainly not!Definitely, what he witnessed will cause a transformation in his heart.The impact of his generosity will stir up more love for God and His Kingdom.Giving is not according to the condition of your bank account, but the condition of your heart.There are people who cannot give into any Kingdom assignment but can easily spend millions (in a year) on tickets for a football match.There are many whose love for God has become cold because they have not exercised themselves in generosity towards the Lord's Kingdom.The more you give unto the Lord, the more your love is deepened.
Giving is a continuous demonstration of love for God.

title: EPISODE 949 - FRUIT OF GENEROSITY 4
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. Shalom! Author Friday, 29th August, 2025 FRUIT OF GENEROSITY 4"I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward" Philippians 4:17 (TPT)There are people who don't understand the benefit of giving in the New Testament, and others assume giving has no benefits.If you have followed our conversation so far, you will have clarity of heart concerning giving.Your giving is not a help you give to God; it is God giving you the opportunity to demonstrate effective stewardship and a partaker of His Kingdom agenda.From the previous episode, these are some benefits or profits of generosity:- Your Generosity Leads to the Increase of Resources.- The Love for God and His Kingdom is deepened In Your Heart. This love for God and His Kingdom:- Makes you live above yourself. Giving makes you fully circumcise the self. You don't become stingy. A stingy heart shrinks and soon becomes empty. However, a giving heart is happier and attracts many.
Another thing giving does to your heart is that it produces contentment in your heart.
You will not die or become a slave to anything you have been able to give. Giving trains your heart to value impact above acquisition. This is what makes you have mastery over things.Anything you cannot give out has dominion over you.Those who find it difficult to give esteem to their acquisition above the transformation of others.Selflessness leads to contentment. Most people who are not content are selfish. They want everything to keep.Paul the apostle said, "Godliness with Contentment is great gain" (1 Timothy 6:6)
When you learn to share or give what you have, it crushes every sense of greediness and envy in you.
Anything you can submit to God doesn't control your heart.A rich man came to Jesus and asked, “Good Teacher, what good thing shall I do that I may have eternal life?” Jesus said to him, “Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God." (Here he was pointing him to His Divinity). Jesus continued by answering his question, saying, "But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”The rich man said to Jesus, “Which ones?”Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder,’ ‘You shall not commit adultery,’ ‘You shall not steal,’ ‘You shall not bear false witness,’ ‘Honour your father and your mother,’ and, ‘You shall love your neighbour as yourself.’ ”The young man said to Jesus, “All these things I have kept from my youth. What do I still lack?”Now the young was claiming righteousness by his self efforts. He was to turn to Jesus for Life instead of exercising confidence in his own works.However, this is the main matter: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.” But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful, for he had great possessions." (See Matthew 19:16-22)This is interesting, the young man couldn't obey even the first commandment:"You shall have no other gods before Me.”This commandment tells us to put God first. And the young rich man couldn't put God first. He esteemed his possession, than eternal life.Which litmus test did Jesus use?GIVING!
Get this: giving proves the condition of the heart.
Remember Abraham, God gave him Isaac and still asked him to sacrifice him.  What was the goal?To prove the faith of Abraham.Has God instructed you to give? Understand that He is giving you the opportunity to demonstrate how you ESTEEM HIM above your possession.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=42__y6ItR5A&t=1sDIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 8:1-5;  Genesis 22:1-14: 2 Corinthians 8:24; 1 John 3:17-18; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be submitted to the Lord and enjoy more grace to demonstrate our love towards God through our generosity. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 37-392 YEARS PLANRuth 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is submitted to the Lord daily. - I enjoy more grace to demonstrate my love towards the Lord. - Through my generosity, I exercise dominion over money. - Through my generous giving, I esteem the Lord above all of my possessions. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 950 - YOU ARE A CHILD OF OBEDIENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To have the Holy Spirit in you means you have the source of God’s loving ability. You have what it takes to demonstrate the love of God and the inward evidence to trust the Lord daily. Practice His presence today. Author Saturday, 30th August, 2025 YOU ARE A CHILD OF OBEDIENCE“so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)Disobedience to God is not automatic. One demonstrates disobedience when doubt, disbelief, and deception have fully germinated.The adversary contributes to your disobedience through deception. He knows your disobedience will distract you from manifesting God’s glory.To disobey is to act outside the faith. Obedience is to hear under faith. When one obeys God's word, it is an act of faith. Obedience to God is proof of honour.
The adversary knows when you walk in disobedience you will walk outside the will of God for your life.
Men don’t always attribute their disobedience to God as anything wrong or evil. And even some acts of disobedience to God in some contexts may seem to be a good thing in others. It may be something all men celebrate or will applaud you for, but it will be disobedience to God.King Saul’s decision to disobey the Lord’s instruction on how to handle the battle with the Amalekites cost him his throne. He was a man after His own desires, but not the counsel of the Lord. He decided to keep the animals which were to be destroyed as spoils of war and for sacrificial offerings. He even spared the life of King Agag as a showcase of his victory. But that wasn’t what God wanted. Even though, in the natural and religious sense, it looks like Saul did the right thing. Because offering sacrifices to the Lord was the right thing to do. But God’s response through Prophet Samuel wasn’t what Saul expected:“But Samuel replied,“What is more pleasing to the LORD: your burnt offerings and sacrifices or your obedience to his voice? Listen! Obedience is better than sacrifice, and submission is better than offering the fat of rams. Rebellion is as sinful as witchcraft, and stubbornness as bad as worshipping idols. So because you have rejected the command of the LORD, he has rejected you as king.” 1 Samuel 15:22-23 (NLT)Saul did what he did to satisfy his own interest. But that was a demonstration of ego and arrogance. 
Always see your obedience to God, as an act of faith.
Saul (Paul the Apostle), acted differently with the Lord’s instruction. He said, “Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision” Acts 26:19 (KJV).This was his response to the instructions he received from the Lord Jesus as he encountered Him on his way to Damascus to persecute the believers.When you were born again, you came into the obedience of faith. Christ’s obedience became your obedience. And you were supplied with the ability of God to continue in the reality of His obedience. To obey the Lord is no longer mechanical but organic because God works in you both to will and to do (Philippians 2:13).As a born-again, you don’t live under the rule of the devil. You are not his servant. Therefore, you don’t yield and obey his voice. You are no longer part of the children of disobedience.
It is the unsaved who is referred to as the son of disobedience.
“in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the sons of disobedience” Ephesians 2:2 (NKJV) You are now an obedient child of God because of Jesus Christ’s obedience.Look at what Peter the Apostle  said:“As obedient children, do not be conformed to the passions of your former ignorance” 1 Peter 1:14 (ESV).
Don’t believe in the deception of the devil that you are not an obedient child of God.
The spirit of disobedience doesn’t have any authority over you. You are an obedient child of God and have the capacity to respond rightly to the Lord’s instructions.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88Gs4aHpiTI&t=969sDIG DEEPER(John 14:17; 1 Corinthians 3:16-17; 1 Corinthians 6:19-20; 2 Corinthians 6:16; Ephesians 2:21-22; 1 Peter 2:5; 1 Peter 1:15-16) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for making us obedient children and giving us the ability to organically walk according to His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 40-422 YEARS PLANRuth 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in obedience to God. – I am not disobedient to the word of God. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – I live daily above disobedience. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 951 - MORE AND MORE GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, don’t be afraid. The Lord knows what is at stake. He will not leave you. He is strongly holding your hand and is with you as your helper. Depend on Him at all times. Shalom! Author Sunday, 31st August, 2025MORE AND MORE GRACE“So now we come freely and boldly to where love is enthroned, to receive mercy’s kiss and discover the grace we urgently need to strengthen us in our time of weakness.” Hebrews 4:16 (TPT) You will always need God in all situations, for any assignment He will give you.The assignments of the Lord will require more than your human intelligence, strength and resources.
The Heavenly mandate or vision will require Heavenly provision.
This is why God gives more Grace.To receive more and more of the grace which God supplies, you must:1. Exercise faith. It takes faith to receive the Grace of our Lord Jesus.2. Be Humble. God resists the proud and gives grace to the humble. Until you submit to the Lord, you have not permitted His supply to flow to you.3. Draw near to God through Prayer.This is the third item I would like to bring to your attention.Before you conclude that we are already in God as believers in Christ and don’t need to draw near to Him, take your time to glean from this perspective.Indeed, we have already been drawn into God through Christ; however, we can continue to journey deeper and deeper into God.
By Christ’s finished work through His death and resurrection, all who were afar off are now brought near to God.
“But now [at this very moment] in Christ Jesus you who once were [so very] far away [from God] have been brought near by the blood of Christ.” Ephesians 2:13 (Amplified Bible)This is glorious news.We are not strangers to God. We belong to God and are part of Him. Through the blood of Jesus, we have free access to God. Now we have fellowship with the Father. We are no longer as they who were of the Old Covenant, for through Christ’s obedience, we have been drawn into God. We can confidently enjoy communion with the Lord without any sense of condemnation.
Irrespective of this access the believer has in God, it doesn’t automatically translate into MORE AND MORE GRACE.
For example:Having access to a free restaurant doesn’t mean you will be satisfied automatically. You can enter the restaurant, take your seat, gist with the Chief restaurant and still not be full. You must intentionally place your order, and then eat your meal before you will be satisfied.
The Lord has brought us into Himself, where grace is enthroned. Yet you must intentionally take grace.
This is why most believers in Christ remain helpless and weak. They think being born again grants them automatic enjoyment of Grace. Being born again gives you free access to grace; however, to enjoy the grace, you must receive it.Prayer is a means of Grace.
Prayer is the confident enjoyment of your access to God, through communion and communication with God.
You have been drawn into God; however, until you draw near in prayer to take grace, you will not receive more and more grace.The more you exercise confidence of faith through prayer, the more grace you receive.
Prayer is both the means of asking and the means of creating.
In times of need, what you must receive is more grace for that specific need.Take note of what the Psalmist said:“Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; listen to my plea for grace.” Psalm 86:6 (ESV).See verse 5 of this Psalm in the Passion Translation:“Lord, you are so good to me, so kind in every way and ready to forgive, for your grace-fountain keeps overflowing, drenching all your lovers who pray to you.” Psalm 86:5 (TPT)Oh, glory to God.
The Grace of God shall drench, wet thoroughly, or soak and saturate those who pray.
When you seem to be limited in Grace, observe not only your faith and humility. Observe your consistency in prayer.
Little prayer, little grace; more prayer, more grace
It is through prayer that you cast all your cares to the Lord, for He cares for you (1 Peter 5:7).And to even be consistent in prayer is evidence of humility. When God’s people humble themselves, they pray to Him (2 Chronicles 7:14).“You do not have because you do not ask God.” (James 4:2)Beloved, stay up long in prayer!Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(Matthew 7:7,11;  Habakkuk 3:19; Philippians 4:13,19; Psalm 84:11; Psalm 34:9-10) WE PRAYWe pray that:1. We shall increase in desire to pray and be obedient to the prompting of the Holy Spirit to pray consistently irrespective of the hindrances.2. The Lord shall send us a great abundance of grace (the favor, and all resources needed) to achieve His plans and purpose in our generation.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 43-452 YEARS PLANRuth 8DECLARE THESE WORD— I submit to the Lord in prayer.— I am consistent in prayer—  I take more and more grace through prayer.— MORE grace is supplied to me as I pray.— I have the discipline to pray consistently— I esteem the place of prayer in my daily life. Oh glory to God!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 952 - THE LIBERATING POWER OF READING THE WORD
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Dependence on God is not a sign of weakness. Dependence on God is a quality of wisdom and humility. Don’t confront any assignment or task or life situation by your strength. Deploy the tools of God. Shalom! Author Monday, 1st September, 2025 THE LIBERATING POWER OF READING THE WORDDuring the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, learned from reading the word of the LORD, as revealed to Jeremiah the prophet, that Jerusalem must lie desolate for seventy years Daniel 9:2 (NIV)God created the world by speaking words. Therefore, it takes understanding and knowledge of the words of God to effectively interact with the universe of God. God inspired men to properly document His words for the benefit of those who will read and believe. These men did not write the scriptures by their own will. "No part of the Holy Writings came long ago because of what man wanted to write. But holy men who belonged to God spoke what the Holy Spirit told them." 2 Peter 1:21 (NLV) Which means any one who communes with the writings of the scriptures, will grow in the understanding of God's thoughts and principles. The scriptures have what it takes to make you wise (2 Timothy 3:15), because they articulate the wisdom of God. God doesn't want you to be ignorant. He wants you to be established in the understanding of His truth. By that, you shall not be decieved as the first couple (Adam and Eve) were decieved by the serpent.  The only way the adversary can stop you from fulfilling God's purpose for your life is by means of deception. And the way to escape the deception of the adversary is by the understanding and knowledge of the truth. You cannot grow in knowledge without accessing the knowledge of God.  In his writing, Luke said, "Dear friend,I am writing for you, mighty lover of God, an orderly account of what Jesus, the Anointed One, accomplished and fulfilled among us. Several eyewitness biographies have already been written, using as their source material the good news preached among us by his early disciples, who became loving servants of the Living Expression. But now I am passing on to you this accurate compilation of my own meticulous investigation based on numerous eyewitness interviews and thorough research of the story of his life. It is appropriate for me to write this, for he also appeared to me so that I would reassure you beyond any shadow of a doubt the reliability of all you have been taught of him." Luke 1:1-4 (TPT) Though Luke was inspired to write the gospel, he first gained understanding by reading other accounts. And one major means by which you can access the rich knowledge of God, is by reading the word of God. One of the best things which can happen to you is to have the ability to read; precisely reading the scriptures. Anyone who reads and understands the scriptures walks in liberty. The knowledge of the truth makes you free. Whiles the Israelites were in captivity, Daniel the prophet was interested in knowing when the captivity and desolation of Israel will end. Though he was a prophet and a prime minister, Daniel committed himself to thorough study and reading of the divine oracles. He understood by books (which was mainly the compilations of the prophetic writings of the Prophet Jeremiah). The prophet Jeremiah wrote concerning the captivity, desolation of Jerusalem and the number of years by which the desolation of Jerusalem will be completed. (See Jeremiah 5:9,11-12; 29:10) The understanding he received by reading the prophetic writings influenced the intercession he had to make for the deliverance of Israel and Jerusalem. Daniel could have prayed wrongly if he had not received understanding. People pray and don't receive answers because they pray amiss. It is only by ignorance will a person pray amiss. (James 4:3). Reading the scriptures exposes you to the rich realities which the Lord has already given to you. Definitely, there are some matters in scriptures which may require explanation by those who are equipped with understanding.  An example of it was the Ethiopian Eunuch who didn't understand the writing of the Prophet Isaiah and needed Philip to help him with what he was reading (Acts 8:27-38).  The Lord has also equipped sound teachers of the word in this generation to provide detail exposition of the scriptures to illuminate the hearts of believers. Just as you now have access to with . Reading this devotional will usher you into perfect understanding of the word of God.  Amazingly we are close to 1000 EPISODES. Each episode is saturated with divine depths to establish you in the understanding of your rich inheritance and function in Christ. As you diligently commit yourself to thoroughly read each episode, delve into the dig deeper scriptures, follow the Bible reading plan, pray the prayers and repeat the confessions throughout the day, your heart will be saturated with light.  How then can there be darkness in your life as your heart is illuminated by the light of the Word? Beloved, commit yourself to reading. Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Matthew 24:15; 1 Timothy 4:13; 2 Timothy 3:15; Romans 15:4; Acts 17:11; Matthew 4:4; Psalm 19:7) WE PRAYWe pray that the light of the Word shall shine upon our hearts and cause us to walk in total liberty as understanding is granted us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 46-482 YEARS PLANRuth 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With an open mind and heart, I search the scriptures diligently. – I grow by the word. – I continue daily in the study of the word. – I prove every teaching I hear with God’s word. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 953 - WHAT ARE YOU HEARING?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, understanding is everything! Your life will always be governed by your level of light. Selah! Author Tuesday, 2nd September, 2025WHAT ARE YOU HEARING?"This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?" Galatians 3:2 (KJV)Your perspective on life is a result of the knowledge you carry. Your knowledge is a result of what you hear.
You cannot be better than the things you hear. 
Your thought patterns and life are a reflection of the information you keep absorbing.Paul the apostle, writing to the brethren in Galatia, asked rhetorically, If they received the Spirit by the works of the law or by the hearing of faith?He asked a similar question in his epistle to the Romans, "But how can people call on him for help if they’ve not yet believed? And how can they believe in one they’ve not yet heard of? And how can they hear the message of life if there is no one there to proclaim it?" Romans 10:14 (TPT)You cannot believe it until you hear. What you hear influences how you live.
If you hear words of faith, you live consistently by faith.
When you hear words of doubt and fear, you will constantly live in doubt and fear. You will not be able to take steps or make bold decisions. You will always be afraid.But the knowledge you receive will influence your confidence.When Daniel received understanding through the reading of the scriptures, it influenced his prayers. (Read on the Liberating Power of Reading).We hear by what we read or watch and what we listen to. And what you hear determines your level of knowledge.God doesn't just want you to be saved; he wants you to grow in knowledge (1 Timothy 2:4).
You can only have the right knowledge when you give your mind to the right truth. 
Be intentional about what you hear.In my book Photizo (A Compendium of Eternal Verities) Alpha Edition, I explained the need to go for accurate knowledge. You must become a student of the word, be like the Bereans, who didn't just give their minds to anything at all they heard. They committed themselves to studying. They decided to be sure that whatever they heard was consistent with the scriptures.As a new creation in Christ, give your mind to the revelation of Jesus. Anything you hear must be consistent with the testimony of Jesus.
The revelation of Jesus will shift and shape your mindsets.
You will live victoriously when you keep hearing the glorious things Christ has victoriously accomplished for you through His death and resurrection.Paul was able to see faith in a man in Lystra who had never walked from birth. Where did the faith come from? By hearing the preaching of Paul. The man's heart was so much flooded with the word of faith that when Paul asked him to stand on his feet, in the name of Jesus, he instantly jumped to his feet for the first time and walked (Acts 14:8-10).
What a transformation!
You are reading this now, and may be thinking your life has come to an end, and nothing good will come out of your situation. Precious one, your thoughts are a result of what you are hearing. Stop hearing your pain, stop hearing your challenges, stop hearing the doubts, stop hearing the projections of fear and guilt from the adversary.Turn away from the negative words and projections of the devil. Set your eyes on the might and awesomeness of the Lord.Give your ears and heart to the transformational word of faith. Hear what the Lord is saying through His word. The word of the Lord is the glorious gospel. The gospel means goodnews.
This goodnews of Jesus will set the direction of your life towards the experience and enjoyment of grace, glory and manifold blessings.
Beloved, choose to hear right!!!Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vrTHnP_y91QDIG DEEPER(Mark 4:24; Romans 10:17; Luke 11:28; John 8:47; John 10:27; Proverbs 28:9) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall access and hear the truth of the word, which shall properly shape our minds and lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 49-512 YEARS PLANRuth 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I give my ears and heart to the transformational word of faith. - I am intentional about what I hear. - I hear only that which is consistent with the testimony of Jesus. - I live victorously everyday because I keep hearing all that Christ accomplished for me. - I refuse to give my hearing to pain, challenges, doubts, fear and guilt. - I set my eyes continually on the might and awesomeness of the Lord. - I hear right. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 955 - WORK THE WORD INTO YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter the situation you find yourself, or the project you have to undertake, you will not be afraid. You know you will enjoy divine supply and divine help, because the Lord is your Shepherd. Beloved, go forth with this consciousness. Shalom! Author Thursday, 4th September, 2025 WORK THE WORD INTO YOU“This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success.” Joshua 1:8 (ESV)Meditation is not a mere religious cliché. It is a proven divine method for good success.This statement to Joshua in our opening verse is repeatedly affirmed in the scriptures.Take a look at another verse:“But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in His law he meditates day and night. He shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also shall not wither; and whatever he does shall prosper.” Psalm 1:2-3 (NKJV)This is exciting.There is so much the meditation of the Word does to you; it brings the richness of the Word of God unto fruition in your life.Some struggle to be diligent in meditating on the Word of God because they have not made it their delight.This is the point:Whether you are conscious of it or not, you are always involved in some level of meditation. The issue has always been what you are meditating on daily. If you want to see the results of the Word of God, you must meditate on the Word. 
Until the Word of God becomes your delight, you will not make it your object of meditation.
Therefore, delight in the Word.These are basic steps for effective meditation.1. Read the Word (and also listen to the teachings of the Word of Grace).You have access to the Word of God through the reading of the Bible. The Bible addresses every situation. Be an avid reader of the Bible to know what God has said about your situation. The Word of God also comes to you through sound teachings (therefore listen to tapes and be present at Church meetings. God always has a word for you).2. Intentionally memorize the scriptures. Don’t be forgetful.The word doesn’t manifest just because you are aware of the scriptures. This doesn’t suggest you don’t have to be aware of the scriptures. What it means is that memorizing or being aware of the scriptures is not the end in itself. Memorizing the scriptures is useful for meditation. When you memorize a specific scripture, it becomes easy to regurgitate.3. Continue daily, at every given time, to think upon or mull over the Word in your heart over and over again. And then mutter, speak those words to yourself, till it becomes your bold and loud joyful confessions.This brings you to the state where you are not only aware of the Word, but you personalize and exercise ownership of the revelation of the Word for your manifestation.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5U9DNiDruDY&t=413sDIG DEEPER(James 1:22-25; Psalm 119:11, Deuteronomy 6:5-6; 29:9; Isaiah 46:10; Luke 6:45; Isaiah 55:8-13) WE PRAYWe pray that:We will have the discipline and diligence to continuously set our hearts on the meditation of the Word.In the name of Jesus!BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 55-572 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am given to the meditation of the Word – Through meditation, I set my heart and mind on the Word of God. – I have the discipline and diligence to continuously meditate on the Word. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 956 - DON'T DELAY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, this is a fruitful week for you. Step out with that conviction and bear fruits unto Christ. Shalom Aleichem! Author Friday, 5th September, 2025DON'T DELAY“We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work.” John 9:4 (NLT)Beloved God has trusted you with His glorious gospel.To carry out the assignment to spread the gospel is to carry out God’s great plan. Though God’s plan is eternal, it is to be accomplished in time. God’s eternal plan of salvation has been programmed to be accomplished in time. God, who has been in all eternity, entered time (which is a spot in eternity) and was revealed (as Jesus) to fulfil the eternal purpose and plan. Our Lord Jesus said: “We need to be energetically at work for the One who sent me here, working while the sun shines. When night falls, the workday is over.” John 9:4 (MSG)
Every saint must have this mind-attitude set of Jesus.
There is a time bound to this work. It is not going to continue forever.  A day is going to come when soul-winning will end.
There is an expected time in God’s eternal calendar when the gospel must reach all men, then the end shall come.
And day by day, the end of this work draws close. You can’t afford to procrastinate. You have to get up and be about the Father’s business. We are in the harvest season for souls. This season will be over soon. The question at the end will be: HOW MANY SOULS DID YOU GATHER FOR THE LORD? This is why you are here, beloved, to accomplish the task of saving men. This is the harvest time, ACT QUICKLY AND ENERGETICALLY. During our Bible reading plan last two years, Proverbs 10:5 caught my attention again. “A wise youth harvests in the summer, but one who sleeps during harvest is a disgrace” Proverbs 10:5 (NLT)
Are you wise, or are you a disgrace?
You must know the season you are in and get serious with this ministry task. Make the most of this opportunity, for the time comes when there will be no such opportunity. Look at the same verse in the Passion Translation: “Know the importance of the season you’re in and a wise son you will be. But what a waste when an incompetent son sleeps through his day of opportunity!” Proverbs 10:5 (TPT)
Act quickly on the ideas the Lord is putting in your heart.
The things the Lord is inspiring you to do are the things He wants to do. Be the body and the person the Lord will use to accomplish His task quickly. Don’t hesitate! Don’t make excuses! Don’t think it is not time yet! The time is now.
You are in the body of Christ at such a time to accomplish your purpose.
Get to work quickly and energetically. Don’t delay with that giving. Don’t delay with the outreach plan. Don’t delay with those great ideas. Shalom.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YtRS05-j4XoDIG DEEPER(Philippians 3:13-14; 2 Timothy 4:7-8; John 4:34-36; Romans 13:11-12; 1 John 2:18) WE PRAY– The grace to be diligent in work the Lord has entrusted unto us.  – That we will not cast away our confidence in the work of ministry, rather hold on steadfastly till the end working diligently with a strong sense of urgency. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to procrastinate what the Lord has instructed me to do. – I don’t give excuses. – I don’t hesitate. – I act now. – I get the job done on time. – Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. – I am a faithful laborer. – I labour in and out season. – I get myself busy with the Lord’s assignment. – I don’t waste the grace of God bestowed unto me. – I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. – I go every length to get the job done. – I keep a sense of urgency in all things. Ohh Hallelujah!!! title: EPISODE 957 - LET NOTHING KEEP YOU AT A DISTANCE FROM GOD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, learn to stay strong on the word. Give no place to the devil and his cohorts. Selah. Author Saturday, 6th September, 2025 LET NOTHING KEEP YOU AT A DISTANCE FROM GOD 1"we come closer to God and approach him with an open heart, fully convinced by faith that nothing will keep us at a distance from him. For our hearts have been sprinkled with blood to remove impurity and we have been freed from an accusing conscience and now we are clean, unstained, and presentable to God inside and out!" Hebrews 10:22 (TPT) God made man and planted Him in His presence for eternal communion. Man was not made to live outside God's presence. However, after Adam turned away from God's instructions, he became guilty at heart and couldn't approach God's presence.
He hid himself from the presence of the Lord because of guilt and the sense of condemnation.
That has always been the challenge of man after sin entered the world. The matter of sin, guilt, and a sense of condemnation is rooted in unbelief. But the only way man can commune with God is by faith. To commune with God by faith is to live by the word of God. All things came into being by the word. Man's relationship with God was according to the speaking of God.  Man is only able to approach God on the grounds of faith. This faith is a confident assurance in who God is and what He has supplied to man. Under the Old Covenant, God established the Aaronic Priesthood as a means to usher man into His presence.  God never wanted to be distanced from His people. No matter the corruption of man, He still made provisions to reach out to man and to bring him into fellowship with Him. When the Israelites left Egypt, the Lord instructed Moses to build a tabernacle, that He might be in their midst. The tabernacle had the outer court, where animal sacrifices were made.  It also had the holy place (which had the seven lampstands, the table of shewbread, and the altar of incense) and then the most Holy Place.  The Holy Place was not made accessible to everyone. It was only the High Priest who had the consecration to enter the Most Holy Place. It was there in the Holy Place, God's glory manifested.  The ark of the covenant was kept in the Most Holy Place. A special veil separated the most holy place from the other parts of the tabernacle.  Now understand that, though God made Moses to consecrate the High Priest to be the only person to legally enter the Most Holy Place, God in His wisdom made provision to commune with the entire nation of Israel in the Most Holy Place. Aaron, as a high priest was a representative of God to the people and the people to God. He was to wear a special garment that distinguished and separated him for his assignment. This high priest's garment had shoulder pieces that held the breastplate and the ephod (which we will discuss further later). The shoulder pieces were made of two onyx stones (one on each shoulder), and upon each of the onyx stones will be engraved with six names of the twelve tribes of Israel. (Exodus 28:2-12) Meaning Aaron was adorned in this gracious garment to be a representation of the children of Israel before the Lord. "You shall put the two stones on the [two] shoulder pieces of the ephod [of the high priest], as memorial stones for Israel; and Aaron shall bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD." Exodus 28:12 (Amplified Bible) Whenever the High Priest stood before the Lord in the most Holy place, it was a memorial before the Lord that the entire nation of Israel was before Him. God fellowshiped with the whole nation through the High Priest. But the High Priest couldn't just draw close or enter the Most Holy Place. Before he could enter the Most Holy Place, there were some specific things which have to be in place. Apart from the burning of incense (Leviticus 16:12-13), another crucial thing he needed was an unblemished blood (Leviticus 16:3; Hebrews 9:7). With these things in place, the High Priest enters the Holy place or draws close to the presence of the Lord with confidence.
The High Priest approaching God's presence with confidence was the entire nation approaching God with confidence.
Everything in and about the tabernacle is a prophetic and typographical representation of Jesus, His redemptive work and what He accomplished through His life, death and resurrection. Jesus has a better Priesthood than that of Aaron. Aaron's Priesthood produced a temporal experience of God's presence; however, Jesus did an eternal work and ushered all who shall believe in Him into an eternal fellowship with God without any sense of guilt. Under the Aaronic Priesthood, there were yearly sacrifices made. But Jesus, who is the perfect High Priest, made a perfect, eternal sacrifice once and for all. "And by his one perfect sacrifice he made us perfectly holy and complete for all time!" Hebrews 10:14 (TPT). Now we are not like Adam, who had to hide himself from the presence of God. We are not like the Israelites, who needed yearly offerings before they gained some temporal confidence before the Lord. And then after some limited time, they become guilty of sin. We are saved through Christ's perfect and eternal sacrifice. Now through Christ's sacrifice, we have eternal access into God's presence. We dwell and enjoy His presence every day, not because of our self-righteousness, but by the perfection of Jesus. Adam hid from God because of guilt and a sense of condemnation through the sin of unbelief. We boldly approach and enjoy the Lord because of the blood of Jesus. Refuse to distance yourself from the Lord.
Don't allow any guilt or wrong to draw you away from God.
Live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DoYi17mtafs&t=3380sDIG DEEPER(Hebrews 7:19; Romans 5:1-2; 1 John 3:19-21; Ephesians 3:12; Hebrews 4:16; Psalm 73:28) WE PRAYThank the Lord for granting you access into eternal fellowship with Him through His Son, Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 61-632 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don't permit anything to keep me at distance from God. - I dont' allow any guilt or wrong to draw me away from God. - I live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. - I don't distance myself from God. - Thank you Lord for the access of eternal fellowship with you through Jesus. Oh blessed be God!Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 958 - DON'T ALLOW YOUR EMOTIONS TO LEAD YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Let this sink deep in your heart, the outcome of your life is what you believe with your heart. Selah. Author Sunday, 7th September, 2025 DON'T ALLOW YOUR EMOTIONS TO LEAD YOU“Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart”.Psalm 37:4 (NKJV)The Lord did not give you your emotions to guide you. Your emotions are measuring instruments of your soul. It helps you ascertain the frequency of your impressions of a matter.
Don’t allow your emotions to lead you.
Your emotion or the deep seat of your desire has been exposed to the corruptibility of the flesh before you got born again.The flesh has always had its way of governing or influencing the soul of a man. A man’s soul includes the will, the mind and the emotions. For you to express God, your mind must be renewed by the word, your will must submit to God’s will and your emotions must be immersed and trained with the deep desires of God.This is the work of the Holy Spirit and the Word of God.“For the Word that God speaks is alive and full of power [making it active, operative, energizing, and effective]; it is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating to the dividing line of the breath of life (soul) and [the immortal] spirit, and of joints and marrow [of the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and sifting and analyzing and judging the very thoughts and purposes of the heart.” Hebrews 4:12 (AMPC)Every part of your being has its own intelligence. From your spirit, through to your soul, to the physical parts of your body and even to the smallest cell within you has its own intelligence.
When the word of God permeates your entire being as you continuously meditate on it, it nourishes and also cultivates the intelligence of your entire being.
This is why meditation is important. Meditation is not just a matter of thinking about something. Through meditation, you are immersed into a particular thought pattern. Meditation creates within you a deep and lasting impression.
Through meditation, you are able to repeat a certain line of thought in your heart.
“Repetition is the law of deep and lasting impressions.”
Every single person is involved in meditation one way or the other.
There is always a line of thought you are repeatedly exposing your mind, your will and emotions to. And the more you expose your heart to these thoughts, the more they become the impressions of your emotions. And the more you exercise or give yourself to certain passions the more they rule and drive your reactions.This is why God is interested in the focus of your emotions or your heart’s delight.
The more you meditate on the love of God and cultivate your heart to express that love, the more it dominates your passions.
The reason most people are quick to spend time watching a Hollywood movie, Bollywood movie or an African movie is how they have trained the desires of their heart.The more you give your time and attention to something the more you create deep cravings for it in your heart.This is why when you have to pray, there is always a fight within your entire being. Deep within your spirit, there is the prompting to pray. Your mind is aware of the benefits of prayer, yet your will is struggling between the craving of your flesh and the prompting of your spirit.
It will amaze you to know that the craving of your flesh travels through the impressions of your emotions. Your flesh uses the force of the desires hewn from your emotions to influence your actions.
Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires.Selah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSFQ3PUmB-M&t=473sDIG DEEPER(Mark 12:30; Job 22:26; Job 27:10; Psalm 69:9; John 2:17; Psalm 73:25; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYWe pray declaring our emotions to be expressed according to the light of the word of God. And not by the passions of the flesh. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANIsaiah 64-662 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t isolate my emotions from the Lord. – My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – I am not led by my emotions. – My delight is in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 959 - YOU HAVE A BLESSED LIFE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Stop being satisfied with the sand bathing. Go beyond the shores of the Spirit, and dive deep into the ocean of the Spirit to experience and enjoy the wisdom of God. Author Monday, 8th September, 2025YOU HAVE A BLESSED LIFE“The Lord will open the heavens, the storehouse of his bounty, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands” Deuteronomy 28:12 (NIV)It’s easy to feel less blessed when you’re overwhelmed with challenges. Sometimes, when it seems like nothing seems to work, you will feel like God’s promises aren’t for you.You look at others and feel they are blessed, and everything works successfully in their lives.You may also wonder if it is possible for a person to have:– Beautiful marriage and blessed children– Prosperous career or profession, and business– Outstanding Ministry– A dignified and peaceful life.Beloved, this is God’s design for your life.You can enjoy a life more beautiful and glorious than it was in “Eden”.
 Let this sink deep in your heart; the outcome of your life is what you believe with your heart.
 Do you believe that you can have a life full of glory and beauty?Hear this, all things are possible to them that believe (Mark 9:23).“All things” here means all things. Whether you read it in Hebrew, Greek, Latin, French, English, etc.ALL THINGS MEANS ALL THINGS!Whatever you believe will gravitate towards you.Do not accept the idea that your life is full of struggle.Hold on to the word of God. As you act in complete obedience of faith to the word of God, you will see the manifested glory of the word. The blessing of the word of God is not for some limited people.It is for those who believe!
 Maintain this strong mentality of faith that you are a blessed man.
 Let it be your consciousness that your hands are so blessed that everything you touch will turn to gold. Wherever you go and whatever you do is prosperous because God is with you.No matter the challenge, you will emerge strong, with mighty testimonies“When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; And through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you will not be scorched, Nor will the flame burn you.” Isaiah 43:2 (AMP)No challenge is bigger than you. Whatever you come in contact with, you will become the center of attraction. 
Always see yourself as one with blessed hands.
The more you think this way, the more all things align for your good.Oh Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_yy4rMSPyw&t=2063sDIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 28:1-14; Job 23:10; Deuteronomy 30:9; Genesis 39:3) WE PRAYThat we will grow deep in the consciousness that whatsoever our hands touch will turn into gold. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 1-32 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Whatever I touch turns to Gold. – I am a blessed man. – Wherever I go and whatever I do is prosperous because God is with me. – No matter the challenge, I will emerge strong with mighty testimonies. – No challenge is bigger than me. – Whatever comes in contact with me will become the center of attraction. – I have blessed hands. Oh Hallelujah, glory![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 960 - TRUE DISCIPLESHIP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must be intentional about making prayers and supplication for other saints. This is one of the signs of spiritual maturity: Praying for God’s people! Let God handle your business as you make supplication for others. Selah. Author Tuesday, 9th September, 2023 TRUE DISCIPLESHIP“Jesus said to the people who believed in him, “You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teachings.” John 8:31 (NLT) We are in a generation where there is an abundance of information and pluralism of thoughts, concepts of life and teachings.
There have been more teachers in our time than ever.
This is because of the several media platforms available now. This wasn’t the case in few years back. Some people lack the integrity and skill to be teachers. Yet now, with internet data and a smartphone, everyone wants to create content and to share their opinions or assumptions as authentic knowledge. And you will have some gullible people running after those thoughts.
Every disciple of Jesus must give attention to only the teachings of Christ.
Your mark of discipleship is TO CONTINUALLY REMAIN FAITHFUL TO THE WORD (or teaching of Christ). It is not how long you have been a disciple of Jesus, it is how long you will continue to be a disciple of Jesus. You must intentionally imbue focus in the teachings of Christ. It is interesting how some believers turn to the myths and old fables of this world.
The people of the world cannot teach you the reality of the Kingdom.
For example, your unbelieving lecturer doesn’t have the spiritual understanding of the kingdom life. Therefore, he/she doesn’t have the authority to teach you how to fellowship with God. He is not the one to tell you how you should be attending Church meetings. The people of this world have their terms, and as you are in Christ, you function by a different set of rules.  
You cannot be in Christ and think like the world. 
You must uphold and esteem the teachings of Christ in your heart. A true disciple of Jesus, is a deviation to the systems of this world. He/she doesn’t live by the thought patterns of this world; but delights in the Word of Christ. He/she doesn’t interpret love as the people of this world do. A true disciple of Jesus walks in the unconditional love of Christ. A true disciple is a doer of the word of Christ and not a hearer only. He/she follows and continues in Christ no matter the storm, suffering or persecution. The persuasion of a true disciple is that nothing can separate him/her from the love of Christ.
Dear Disciple of Jesus, do what the Lord tells you to do through His word, not what the world informs.
ARE YOU A TRUE DISCIPLE OF JESUS? Selahhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bvI7IMIoIxADIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:16; John 15:8; John 13:35; Romans 8:37-39; Colossians 1:28-29; 2 John 1:9; John 15:7-8) WE PRAY– That the delight and persuasion of the word of God shall be intensified in our hearts more and more; to make us doers of the word and not hearers. – That he word of Christ shall deeply dwell in our hearts and we shall not yield our minds to the old fables and false teachings of this world.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 4-62 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t patten my life according to the standards of this world.– I walk in the unconditional love of Christ. – I delight myself daily with the word of Christ. – Nothing can separate me from the love of Christ. – I continue in Christ no matter the storm, sufferings and persecutions. – I am a true disciple of Christ. Hallelujah!!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 961 - DON'T BE QUIET, SPEAK FORTH THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t be afraid or careful to talk to the Lord about all that concerns you. He is the good Shepherd-King! Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 10th September, 2025DON'T BE QUIET, SPEAK FORTH THE WORD“And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God…Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.” Mark 11:22, 24 (ESV)Have you ever been in a moment when you felt so much faith but didn’t see the results of your prayer?Well, sometimes, during such moments, you may not be acting in faith. You may be acting confidently in your own efforts.There are times people believe in their efforts made in prayer rather than in the ability of God. You will always be disappointed if you look at yourself.
To have faith is to have confidence in God and His saving ability. Faith is not vim!
Faith is not how you feel. Faith is not waiting for a change. Faith is believing without a doubt in your heart that the change has happened and you have received it.The faith of God in your heart cannot fail.Jesus didn’t have any doubt in His heart when He spoke to the fig tree. The fig tree didn’t shrivel up simply because Jesus is the Saviour of the world or because He is God. If that was the case then there was no need for Jesus to tell His disciples, “let the faith of God be in you.”With such a response, Jesus was explaining to the disciples the secret to causing changes.Jesus went on to make the disciples understand that they can speak to anything at all by the faith of God.As He spoke to the fig tree, they can also speak to the mountains.How is it possible to speak to the mountain to move?It is by believing in your heart that whatever you say will happen because you have the faith of God.“Jesus replied, “Let the faith of God be in you! Listen to the truth I speak to you: If someone says to this mountain with great faith and having no doubt, ‘Mountain, be lifted up and thrown into the midst of the sea,’ and believes that what he says will happen, it will be done. Mark 11:22-23 (TPT)For Jesus to use this example that the disciples can say to a mountain be lifted and thrown into the sea, it means they can speak to change every situation. If you can have the faith of God in your heart, you can speak to that infirmity in your body to be moved and be lifted into the sea.If a mountain will disappear at the word spoken in faith, then that kidney condition will disappear from your body; the cancer in the breast will leave; the growth in your brain will disappear, the health condition in your lungs will disappear as you will not doubt in your heart.To doubt is to be uncertain or to be afraid that what you have said will not happen. And mostly people doubt because they esteem the situation rather than the power of God. Others also doubt because they look at themselves and their incapabilities rather than the ability of God.All things were made by the word of God. Therefore, when you speak forth God’s word and you believe in your heart, the change will happen!
Don’t keep quiet to watch the mountains before you. You can speak to it now according to the word of the Lord.
That heart disease or cancer, or tumour of any kind can desiccate completely or wither from the root.Speak forth the word of God in faith without any doubt in your heart!Hallelujah.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=42__y6ItR5ADIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Psalm 62:8; Psalm 50:15) WE PRAYWe speak to any mountain in our lives to be removed and lifted into the sea. We speak to any unwanted condition in our lives to be uprooted in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 7-92 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute confidence in God.– I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. – I have the faith of God. – I don’t doubt the word of God. – The faith of God in my heart cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 962 - PRAYING FOR GOD'S PEOPLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Giving is a continuous demonstration of love for God. Enjoy more and more grace to give more and more into the spread of the gospel. Shalom Aleichem. Author Thursday 11th, September, 2025 PRAYING FOR GOD'S PEOPLE“Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints”Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)No believer or saint in Christ is an Island. Every individual is part of the community of the saints.Though individual skill and strength were important, they won battles by their battle formations. The Testudo shield formation was one of their exceptional strategies to withstand the attacks of the enemy and advance towards the enemy’s gates.Paul instructed that as soldiers in Christ, we must take up the shield of faith. And when each believer takes up their shield, they fight individually and corporately.We are strong as saints when we stand together in this fight of faith. We defend, support and strengthen one another to enforce our victory in Christ and prevail over every situation.The Lord knows the believer is not called to stand alone; thus, He incorporates everyone who becomes born again into Himself.“For by [means of the personal agency of] one [Holy] Spirit we were all, whether Jews or Greeks, slaves or free, baptized [and by baptism united together] into one body, and all made to drink of one [Holy] Spirit.” 1 Corinthians 12:13 (AMPC)In Christ Jesus, there is no individualism. Your well-being is not enough when the well-being of other saints is compromised.This is why you don’t only pray for yourself, but you must also become an intercessor.
You must be intentional about making prayers and supplication for other saints.
All believers or saints in Christ Jesus are of one body. When the hand is in pain, the whole body is in pain. You can’t have pain in your leg, and have the lungs rejoice.The discomfort of one body part is the discomfort of the whole body.This is why you must pray for one another. You must pray for the saints.To make supplication simply means to humbly make a request or petition.
To make supplication for the saints is to humbly and earnestly make a request for the saints.
Praying for the saints must be done with all perseverance. Don’t quietly watch your fellow saints go through pain and challenges. Instead of sitting back to complain about the failures of others, you can make supplication for them.Read Ephesians 6:18 in the Amplified:“With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people.” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified Bible)
This is one of the signs of spiritual maturity: Praying for God’s people!
Selflessness is a sign of maturity.The “babe” in Christ doesn’t pray for others. He or she is only concerned about himself (or herself).The more you pray for others, the less you get troubled or anxious about your challenges. Praying for others also means looking away from your situation and entrusting it to the hands of Jesus.When you spend time making supplication for others, all you are saying is, “Lord, please take care of my situation, as I stand in the gap for others”.
Let God handle your business as you make supplication for others.
Think about fellow saints in your community or city. Pray for their growth, their effectiveness in serving the Lord, and their strength and focus in the gospel of Jesus.Set a time aside today and pray for the brethren.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88Gs4aHpiTIDIG DEEPER(Acts 12:5-14; 2 Thessalonians 3:1; 1 Timothy 2:1; 2 Corinthians 9:14) WE PRAY- We pray for all saints that amidst all the distractions and pressures of this postmodern society, they shall not grow weary in faith, love and in doing the Lord’s work. - We pray that all the saints shall grow in the consciousness of our oneness in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 10-122 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to live isolated and selfish.– I seek for the well-being of all the saints.– I grow in love for the saints.– I make supplication for the saints as my habit.– I see every believer as a brother and I make supplication for them.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 963 - OUR CORE MANDATE IS RECONCILIATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Instead of allowing yourself to be continuously brandished and decimated or pulverised by these experiences, take a stand on the word of God. Make a decision today that you are going to break free from every limitation through God's word. Shalom! Author Friday, 12th, September, 2025OUR CORE MANDATE IS RECONCILIATION“But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.” Matthew 6:33 (KJV)In the present Church, many have relegated the core mandate of the Church and made the additional benefits of our relationship with God their priority.
Churches today in their bid to help society, have become need-centered rather than Christ-centered.
This has made the present-age, average believer in Christ become focused on his or her individual needs rather than the purpose of Christ.God is more interested in our individual needs than we are. However, God has a bigger picture and wants us to uphold that picture than our personal needs or interests.Some people go to Church meetings today, not with the same goal as the first-century Church.
The gathering of the saints is not primarily to meet the self-centred needs of the saints. The gathering of the saints is primarily to equip the saints for the work of the ministry.
“Now these are the gifts Christ gave to the church: the apostles, the prophets, the evangelists, and the pastors and teachers. Their responsibility is to equip God’s people to do his work and build up the church, the body of Christ.” Ephesians 4:11-12 (NLT)
To do the work of the ministry is to reconcile many to Christ and to disciple them to become the expression of Christ.
As this is achieved, the Kingdom of God expands in the hearts of many.The goal of the adversary transcends you. The goal of the adversary is to attack your accomplishments in the Kingdom.He knows that when he can get you depressed, afraid, troubled, and wearied, you will not be able to do the things God wants you to do. When you are not able to stand against his evil schemes and enforce your victory in Christ, you will not be able to shine the glorious light of the Kingdom in the dark places.The adversary knows that if he could make you live occupied with your personal needs, you will not have the focus of the Kingdom.
When the satisfaction of your personal needs becomes your goal and cravings, Christ will not be at the center of your heart.
Let God (who is your loving Father) take care of your needs, as you set your affection and focus on His assignment for your life. This was one of the key secrets of King Solomon. He set his focus on his assignment as Israel’s king. He didn’t request personal things but the wisdom to rule God’s people, and God blessed him with wealth and riches.“Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.” 1 Kings 3:13 (Berean Standard Bible).Pay attention to what Jesus said:“So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require?“So above all, constantly chase after the realm of God’s kingdom and the righteousness that proceeds from him. Then all these less important things will be given to you abundantly.” Matthew 6:31-33 (TPT)
We are at war with the forces of darkness to enforce our victory in Christ and to fulfill God’s kingdom plan.
Have a bigger perspective on this spiritual warfare.You are not wrestling against the evil strategies of the accuser (including all his highest evil principalities and authorities operating in rebellion under the heavenly realms) because of your personal needs.
You are wrestling against powerful class of demon-gods and evil spirits that hold this dark world in bondage, because of the mandate of the Kingdom.
The expansion of God’s Kingdom in the hearts of men and the dark places of the earth should be your focus.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=btuVKENGKIkDIG DEEPER(Matthew 6:19-33; 1 Kings 3:7-14; Matthew 19:27-29; 2 Corinthians 10:3-5) WE PRAYWe pray that the expansion of the Kingdom of God will be the burning desire and imbued focus of every believer at all times and in all they do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 13-152 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I set my focus on God’s will and set my mind on things above.– I esteem the will and purpose of God– I don’t serve my interests. I serve all of God’s purposes for me in my generation– I don’t give my mind to the things of this world.– I have no other master apart from God.– God’s testimony of me is that I am a man after his heart and will serve all His will.Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 694 - BE FULL OF THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you hold on to the Word of God, you will not demonstrate absolute confidence in God. Beloved, hold on to the word! Author Saturday, 13th, September, 2025 BE FULL OF THE WORD“And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God” Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)The thoughts that run through your mind and the words you speak will always affect your living.The kind of thoughts you entertain will shape your words, and your words will define your world.When the adversary wants to attack your world, he exposes your mind to wrong thoughts. If he wants you to live defeated, he invades your mind with thoughts of weakness, failure, doubt, and negativity.This is why you must become intentional with the meditation of the word of God.You are not like a tree planted by the rivers of water simply because you are born again. It is not that automatic.You can only be like a tree planted by the rivers of water when you make the word of God your delight and meditation (Psalm 1:1-3)
You cannot wage good warfare when you are not full of the word of God.
Imagine a soldier going to war without a sword.How is he going to have an offensive advantage?And the Word of God in your mouth is the Sword of the Spirit. Until you are full of the Word in all situations, you will not be sharp enough to address every opposing thought.Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly. (Colossians 3:16)The greatest deceptive strategy of the adversary against you (as a believer in Christ) is to attack your thoughts by casting shadows on your mind, using the scriptures.
He cast shadows by misquoting or misrepresenting the true meaning of the word.
 He mainly attacks your identity in Christ.That was how he attacked Adam and Eve in Eden. He attacked their identity.“Of course we may eat it,” the woman told him. “It’s only the fruit from the tree at the center of the garden that we are not to eat. God says we mustn’t eat it or even touch it, or we will die.” “That’s a lie!” the serpent hissed. “You’ll not die! God knows very well that the instant you eat it you will become like him, for your eyes will be opened—you will be able to distinguish good from evil.” Genesis 3:3-4 (TLB)Meanwhile, God created man in His own image and after His own likeness (Genesis 1:26).Again, after the Father had declared these words during the baptism of Jesus, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!” (Matthew 3:17)The devil came to tempt Jesus, saying, “ If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become loaves of bread.” (Matthew 4:3)Do you see it?He came attacking what the voice said concerning Jesus.The moment he used the phrase “If you are the Son of God”, he was subtly creating uncertainty in the mind of Jesus.He now wants Jesus to think he is not yet the son of God, but will only become one by doing what he tells him to do. And if Jesus had done what the adversary was deceptively asking for, he might have lived in doubt of who He is and been ruled by the thoughts of the devil. Beloved, do not be ignorant of the devices of the enemy.
The adversary will always attack what God says about you!
Jesus knew the devil’s devices and deployed the word of God.“But Jesus told him, “No! The Scriptures say, ‘People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.” (Matthew 4:4)Did the devil stop there?Not at all. He kept using various means in an attempt to make Jesus act contrary to his reality. Yet, Jesus consistently addressed the situation with the word, till He finally and sternly cast the devil out using the word as a weapon. Jesus didn’t just quote the scripture; He had to use it as a weapon.This time, Jesus didn’t just say it is written, He said:“Get out of here, Satan,” Jesus told him. “For the Scriptures say, ‘You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ (Matthew 4:10)This was similar to what David did when he confronted Goliath.
Beloved, what is the challenge confronting you? Take hold of the word of God concerning that situation and use the word as a weapon to enforce your victory.
Get hold of the word, be full of the word of God, that you may be ready in all seasons; with your mouth full of the right words to be used to wage war.Hallelujah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLk&t=12sDIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17:41-51; Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow in the revelation of the Word, to know how to rightly use the word in the relevant situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 16-182 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am full of the word. – I am established in the certainty of my identity in Christ. – I speak forth the word of God at all times. – I have the right word for every season and circumstance of my life. – I wage war with the word of God given to me. Thank you Lord Jesus![pff-paystack id="37534"][mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 965 - HE IS YOUR STRENGTH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your enjoyment of the glorious inheritance in Christ, is dependent on Christ and your position in Him and not on your self-efforts. Beloved, you belong to the Kingdom of His Son, therefore you are qualified to enjoy the inheritance of the Kingdom. Selah. Author Monday, 15th September, 2025 HE IS YOUR STRENGTH“But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.” Isaiah 40:31 (KJV) To have the strength of God, you must turn to Him and receive Him as life.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strength in you.
The Holy Spirit dispenses and distributes all of the virtues of God into you. “O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.” Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV) The Prophet Isaiah explains the extensiveness and limitlessness of the strength of God (Isaiah 40:12-28). Now, you see in verses 29 – 31, the Prophet Isaiah explains how God supplies strength to those who are His. Because God’s strength doesn’t faint, those who faint are strengthened by Him.  “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength. Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.” Isaiah 40:29-31 (KJV) The phrase, “even the youth shall faint”, is a depiction of how the strongest shall faint even in their prime. The youthful season is the prime season of every natural thing.  It is normal to faint in old age. It may even seem normal to grow weak after you have been pressed by challenges. It may seem normal to grow tired and become exhausted.
Yet the testimony of those who WAIT upon the Lord is different. Those who WAIT upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
Now the Lord gives power to the faint and causes strength and ability to abound towards those who lack might. It doesn’t matter how the vicissitudes have beaten you up and crushed you; the moment you turn and open up to the LORD, strength is dispensed and distributed to you. You cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength, you must have God. As a believer in Christ, you have the advantage; God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
You can accomplish more with the strength of God when it is RENEWED. To RENEW the strength of God, you must learn to WAIT UPON THE LORD.
To wait upon the Lord is not just an imagery of a “Waiter” in a restaurant. The word WAIT is from the Hebrew word, “qâvâh . The primitive root for “qâvâh” means “TO BIND TOGETHER”. To wait upon the Lord means to look patiently to the Lord, to expect and to be tied to the Lord. It means you are knitted and plaited with and to the LORD. Jesus said, “I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless.” John 15:5 (TPT) Inasmuch as it is good to be a tree, it is far greater and better to be a branch. The strength and fruitfulness of a branch are dependent on the tree. You must be knitted to the Lord as a fruitful branch is to a great tree. Don’t be separated and be distracted or moved away from the Lord.
The more you remain in the Lord, the more you are renewed in strength.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qbIBGgu1BWsDIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 27:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted nor become prideful but will always remain rooted and established in the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 19-212 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my strength.– I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. – The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. – I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 966 - REFUSE TO REMAIN WHERE YOU ARE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. Don’t look at the challenges to doubt God. Make the Word of the Lord your focus, and you will see the manifestation of His glory. Shalom! Author Tuesday, 16th September, 2025 REFUSE TO REMAIN WHERE YOU ARE“For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.”Isaiah 54:3 (KJV)God didn’t create limitations for man. He brought man forth to a place where everything was good.
The goodness of God revealed in His creation is not just about how perfect the created things are, but how they are to be perfect for the benefit of man.
Everything God made was good to serve man. Nothing was to be a man disadvantage. Everything made by God was to serve man and be beneficial to man’s living.God did not create the earth to be desolate.God blessed man with the ability to be fruitful, multiply, replenish the earth, subdue it and have dominion over all created things.God entrusted the flourishing of the earth to man. He gave man the governing right to determine what happens here on earth.The corruption which entered the world through man’s disobedience (unbelief), did not only affect man’s spirituality but also allowed an opposing force of limitations to invade creation.
The fall made it possible for man to experience struggle. The root of man’s fall is unbelief, which causes one to live out of God’s satisfaction and restfulness.
This explains why even the Israelites could not enter their rest.“So we see that they were not able to enter [into His rest], because of their unwillingness to adhere to and trust in and rely on God [unbelief had shut them out].” Hebrews 3:19 (AMPC) The moment you receive Christ by faith, you have entered His rest.Nonetheless, as to touching the matter of your unlimited living, you have to decide to take advantage of Christ’s accomplishment in you.Christ has brought you into His rest positionally, and transfused His life, nature and power into you for your daily living. You will continue to live in limitation until you exude the rich items of Christ within you in a practical way.The accomplishment of Christ did not mean we would automatically live limitlessly. What Christ did give us was the power to determine the unlimited living of His life in us.What does this say to you?
Beloved, the limitations in your life today are a result of how you have not taken advantage of the reality of Christ which is in you.
You can expand, you can grow, you can multiply, you can achieve glorious things according to His power, which works in you.Take advantage of all that Christ has accomplished to break out from every limitation you are experiencing.Refuse to remain where you are.
Advance! March on! Achieve Greatness.
You have to break out from every limitation you see around you.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/t_RzunrXgk4?t=8294DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 4:18; Isaiah 52:9; Micah 2:13; Isaiah 43:19; Luke 1:37) WE PRAYPray that you shall go forth this season in the strength of the Spirit and knowledge of the riches of Christ to live above every limitation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 22-242 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have entered into the rest of Christ therefore, I live above every limitation. – I take advantage of Christ’s accomplishment  in me to live an unlimited life. – I refuse to remain where I am, I take advantage of the riches of Christ within my Spirit to advance and achieve greatness. – I break out from every limitation I see around me. Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 967 - PESERVERE AS A GOOD SOLDIER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your ability to do more begins with what you see and how you see what you see. Selah!
