Author Wednesday, 17th September, 2025 PESERVERE AS A GOOD SOLDIER “Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you”John 15:16 (ASV)No matter how much you wish to achieve great Kingdom results, you may still not produce them until you act or take consistent steps towards them.From the revelation of the scriptures, you will realise fruit-bearing is not an option. The goal of discipleship in God’s Kingdom is for you to produce fruits consistent with the good pleasure of His will.See what Jesus said, “Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.” (John 15:8)In your fruit-bearing or Kingdom results, your Heavenly Father is glorified. This doesn’t happen automatically, simply because you are a disciple of Jesus.  You can be a disciple of Jesus and still not bear fruit. To produce results, there are specific things to do:1. You have to make a decision that you are going to do much more as a disciple of Jesus.2. Be Consumed with the Success of the Kingdom.
Until you become interested in and passionate about the kingdom’s success, you will not be willing to take steps to make it happen.
God and His Kingdom must become your priority. Until God is your priority, you cannot invest in Him. Your heart must be after God.One question you must always ask yourself is this:How deep is my love and jealousy for God?When you don’t love the Lord, you will not be willing to go the extra mile for His course. You will always make excuses and seek self-pleasure.Challenges may arise to hinder your efforts to produce results. You don’t have to give up or draw back. There is something important you need to do:3. Contend for results.Results require a relentless posture of faith. Because of the adversary’s resistance, your results will always come with a fight. This is not a fight to obtain victory; it is a fight to unleash and enforce the victory that you have obtained in Christ. You don’t have to fake or pretend that you have the results; you must contend for them. To have results is a faith thing. You must contend and release your faith.
IT IS CALLED THE GOOD FIGHT OF FAITH!
Paul the apostle, in his last epistle to Timothy, made an affectionate heartthrob statement:“I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.” 2 Timothy 4:7 (NKJV)
This fight of faith is a good, worthy and noble fight. It is to contend earnestly the glorious contest to guard the faith.
In Paul’s first epistle to Timothy, he instructed him to,“Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you were also called and have confessed the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.” 1 Timothy 6:12As we have seen in the second epistle, Paul the apostle was instructing Timothy to do exactly what he was also doing. To have a fruitful experience of the faith, you must fight to express it. You must contend in faith.Again he said, as part of his epistle to the Church in Philippi, “I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.” Philippians 3:14 (NKJV)He has to press toward the goal because there are many things which may serve as limitations.To press on and to contend for the results means you are not holding anything back. You have to fight, run and strive for the results.
In your attempt to achieve results, you may be confronted by trial.
“Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.” (James 1:12).You have to persevere as a good soldier.As you are taking steps, you must remain resolute and daring. You have to press on against all odds to produce consistent Kingdom results.Glory to God!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t_RzunrXgk4&t=9060sDIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:12-13; Colossians 1:29; Galatians 6:9; 1 Corinthians 15:58) WE PRAYPray that as we labour in the faith, we shall strive with all of the Lord’s energy working powerfully within us, and be steadfast, immovable and always excel in the work of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 25-272 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I produce kingdom Kingdom results.– I am blessed by the Lord to be fruitful. – My fruits glorify the Father. – I am a true disciple of Jesus because I bear much fruits. Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 968 - DON'T SETTLE FOR LESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Humility is one of the greatest secrets to the enjoyment of multiplied grace. It takes humility to submit to God’s supply. Beloved, walk in humility to unlock the supply of multiplied grace in your life. Selah! Author Thursday, 18th September, 2025DON'T SETTLE FOR LESS“There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God”.2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)There is no divine assignment which doesn’t require divine capacity, no matter how little it may seem.
If it is of God, then it is great!
See what David said when he was preparing materials for building the temple.“And King David said to all the assembly, “My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is still young and inexperienced and the work is great; for the temple is not for man but for the Lord God.“ 1 Chronicles 29:1 (Amplified)Now, after all the materials needed were supplied for the building, David now unveiled how:“Now therefore, our God, we thank You, and praise Your glorious name. “But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to offer as generously as this? For all things come from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You… O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy Name, it is from Your hand, and is all Your own.” 1 Chronicles 29:13-14,16. (Amplified).It will always take God Himself to partner with you to do what He inspires or assigns you to do.To have Christ in you is to have God’s partnership for any good work.The spiritual capacity of God in you transcends your physical abilities.
The spiritual capacity is not only the ability to contain, but also God’s supply of ability within you to produce.
The Apostles acknowledged that all that they did was according to certain capacities. However, those capacities were supplied by God. (2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT).The Greek word for Capacity is “hikanotés”, it also means sufficiency, competence, ability, power, qualification, or fitness. Though the capacity to do great things for God is supplied by the unlimited power of God, we have the responsibility to consistently increase in the capacity of God's supplies.Until you decide to take advantage of the unlimited supply of God within you to increase your spiritual capacity, you will not see unlimited results.Every Kingdom’s achievement is greatly backed by divine capacity.
Greatness responds to great capacity.
Your level of capacity will determine the size of the city or sphere you can take.To increase Spiritual capacity is to be a consistent follower of Jesus.The Lord teaches and trains you through certain men He has set in the Church. These men equip the saints for the work of the ministry. (Ephesians 4:11-12)You also build capacity through intense focus on God’s work and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit.Focus gives direction to divine energies. Whatever has your attention attracts the resources of God within you.
Don’t scatter divine resources, FOCUS!
And the more you fellowship with the Lord, the more you submit to Him for great help and supply.You must also have the habit of praying in the Holy Spirit. As you pray in the spirit and meditate on the Word, you also build up yourself in faith and increase your inner capacity (Jude 1:20).God has made you for big things; don’t settle for less, therefore, increase in capacity.Are you imbuing focus?Are you meditating on the word?Are you fellowshipping with the Holy Spirit?How consistently do you speak in tongues?Beloved, enlarge your tents, lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes. The season of great results and harvest is here!Hallelujah!!!https://youtu.be/t_RzunrXgk4?t=10138DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]; Luke 16:10 [NLT]) WE PRAYThat our inner capacity will be enlarged by the Supply of the Spirit for greater works.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 28-302 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I imbue focus. – With God, I go beyond my strength. – The Lord is with me therefore I do great things. – Through the study of the word and Prayer, I increase in capacity to take on my city. – By the strength of the Spirit at work in me, I increase in capacity to do great things. Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 969 - EXPECT OPPOSITIONS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you focus on the Lord as your inward satisfaction, you will be easily distracted when confronted by challenges. Author Friday, 19th September, 2025EXPECT OPPOSITIONS“For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries” 1 Corinthians 16:9 (KJV)Beloved, you should not be surprised when you are confronted by challenges because of the gospel.
Men whose eyes have been blinded by the adversary will always oppose God’s Kingdom plan.
The more you see darkness in a place, the greater the need to spread the gospel wherever you go or move to, and identify opportunities to share the gospel.This was something Jesus and the early saints frequently utilised. And even in our day, those who are doing well with the gospel have sharpened their skills to identify doors of opportunity, to spread the gospel. Look at this:“And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people. But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd. Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few” Matthew 9:35-37 (KJV) Do you see it? The moment our Lord Jesus saw the multitudes, He saw the opportunity or the need to get souls saved. When you see people, you must identify the need and the opportunity to spread the gospel. Wherever you go or find yourself, there are opportunities to get many saved. Don’t be threatened by an impending opposition when you identify a door of opportunity.
Be determined to make the most of such opportunities, as the Holy Spirit inspires you.
You will see from the opening verse that Paul did not fret; he was ready to stay in order to utilise the great door which was opened unto him. “Regardless, I will remain in Ephesus until the feast of Pentecost. There’s an amazing door of opportunity standing wide open for me to minister here, even though there are many who oppose and stand against me.” 1 Corinthians 16:8-9 (TPT). He decided to stay for more days in Ephesus, to minister there, even though there were many who opposed and stood against him. We will later find out that the gospel grew so much in the city of Ephesus and prevailed. (See Acts 19:1-20) Always have this in mind:DARKNESS CANNOT PUT OUT THE BLAZING LIFE-LIGHT! (John 1:5, Message Bible).
Light doesn’t automatically shine in dark places; you must intentionally cause it to shine.
Jesus said, “Let your light so shine” (Matthew 5:16). The purpose of light is to shine in the darkness. Greater lights are needed to shine in the darkest places. The dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty; thus, we must invade and saturate such places with the blazing life-light. We don’t crawl backwards just because of the violence of darkness. The life-light is the love-light, and it is the greatest force of victory.
Beloved, take advantage of every opportunity to spread the gospel without fear of opposition, for the Lord is with you.
Shalom!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t_RzunrXgk4&t=9060sDIG DEEPER(Isaiah 66:5; Luke 6:22; John 15:21; Acts 19:8; 1 Corinthians 15:2; 2 Corinthians 1:8-10) WE PRAYThat no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 31-332 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a terror to the forces of darkness. – I conquer and win more territories for the Lord. – The Lord is with me therefore I fear no evil. – I don’t walk in fear. – No matter the oppositions I face, I refuse to give in. – I remain strong in the Lord. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 970 - THE BEST COMES OUT OF YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Jesus is more than the miracles, the opportunities, the material blessings, and the success stories. He is life. He wants you to relate to Him beyond the physical or material blessings you enjoy in Him. Selah. Author Saturday, 20th September, 2025 THE BEST COMES OUT OF YOU"Believe in me so that rivers of living water will burst out from within you, flowing from your innermost being, just like the Scripture says!” John 7:38 (TPT) To be born again is to receive the divine life and to be a partaker of God's nature.
At the New birth, God indwell you through the Spirit. To have God in you means you are enriched with glory.
This then means that anyone in Christ must not assume they are empty or void of glory. Some people in Christ don't walk in the consciousness of what Christ has produced in them. They judge and measure the value of their lives by their outward circumstances. They judge themselves by some characteristics they used to exude before they got born again. For example, one will claim that "She has temper issues and lacks patience." But how can you lack patience when the endless love of God has cascaded into your hearts through the Holy Spirit who lives in you!
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the capacity to express God.
To have the Holy Spirit in you means you cannot be void and worthless. In Genesis 1:2, it was clear that the earth was without form and was void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. However, the moment there was the presence of the Spirit of God upon the face of the waters. The word of God brought forth light amidst this dark situation. It doesn't matter how badly your character has been; when you have the Holy Spirit in you, His character saturates your being and gives you the capacity to express His quality. From the opening verse, we see Jesus making a profound statement: He said, When you believe in Him, rivers of living water will burst out from within you. This speaks of the Holy Spirit in you. Flowing from your innermost being is the refreshing substance of the Spirit. Wastage doesn't come out of you. Dead things don't come out of you.
The only thing which comes out of you is that which is full of life and living.
Live and walk daily in the consciousness of the quality of the Holy Spirit in you. No matter how bad or worse you have been in the past, the Holy Spirit in you causes you to express the best of God. This is your reality. Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/t_RzunrXgk4DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 15:45; John 4:14; Proverbs 10:11; Luke 6:45; John 1:4) WE PRAYWe pray, declaring the demonstration of the substance and quality of the Spirit in all things we do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 34-362 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a partaker of God's nature. - I am enriched with glory. - I have the capacity to express God. - I cannot be void or worthless because the Holy Spirit is in me. - Dead things cannot come out of me. - Only that which is life and living comes out of me. - I express the best of God at all times. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 971 - YOU ARE A LIFE DISPENSER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency What you do must be according to the Lord’s due order of greatness. Don’t just do things for God and call them great. It is the things which God has designed you to do that must be done. Whatever God has called you to do, the intention and purposes has been foreordained. Selah. Author Sunday, 21st September, 2025 YOU ARE A LIFE DISPENSER"The Scriptures tell us, “The first man, Adam, became a living person.” But the last Adam—that is, Christ—is a life-giving Spirit" 1 Corinthians 15:45 (NLT)As I wrote in the previous episode, "The Best Comes Out of You",  I explained that the born again has the divine life as his or her life. And he is also a partaker of God's nature.God dwells in you through the Spirit. The Holy Spirit in you also means you have the capacity to express God, just as Jesus did.The expression of God is the reality of the believer as one brought into sonship.
To express God is to demonstrate and dispense His life.
Jesus said, "...I am come that you have life and have it abundantly." (John 10:10).Jesus didn't come to dispense death nor darkness because He is LIFE. And His Life is the light of men.He said to Martha, "I am the resurrection, and the Life"Anything that comes out of Jesus is LIFE.He is not as the first Adam who is a living soul. Paul the Apostle refers to him as the Life-giving Spirit."The Scriptures tell us, “The first man, Adam, became a living person.” But the last Adam—that is, Christ—is a life-giving Spirit" 1 Corinthians 15:45 (NLT)And the beautiful thing is this, as the Lord is so are you.As He is Light, so has He made us Light (John 8:12; Matthew 5:14). As He is righteous, even so has He made us the righteousness of God in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21). As He is a King, He has made us kings and priests (Revelation 1:6).
Therefore as He is a Life-giving Spirit, He has also made us life-giving spirits.
As a born again, you don’t only have the life of God, you have the capacity of God to shine forth His light and show forth His glory!You have the capacity and the mandate to bring many into the participation of His life.As one whose spirit is mingled with the life-giving Spirit, you have the ability to dispense the life of God in every place.Which means darkness and anything of death cannot prevail in your sphere.Go forth this day as a distributor of the Life of God.Hallelujah!https://youtu.be/e73Aam9JWYY?si=vL9zAEYlEc9idX0fDIG DEEPER(John 6:63; 1 John 1:1-4; Proverbs 10:11; Luke 6:45; John 1:4) WE PRAY We pray that by the wisdom of God we shall exercise ourselves in dispensing the life of God in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 37-392 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I dispense the life of God. - I have the capacity to express God. - I am a partaker of God's nature. - I shine forth the life of God. - Darkness cannot prevail in my sphere. - I'm a distributor of the life of God. - I express the best of God at all times. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 973 - DISPENSE LIFE THROUGH YOUR WORDS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Christ has brought you into His rest positionally, and transfused His life, nature and power into you for your daily living. You will continue to live in limitation until you exude the rich items of Christ within you in a practical way. Selah. Author Wednesday, 22nd September, 2025 DISPENSE LIFE THROUGH YOUR WORDS"The words of the godly are a life-giving fountain; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions." Proverbs 10:11 (NLT)The life which is in Christ is in you. Therefore as He is a Life-giving Spirit, even so are you a life-giving spirit.You have the capacity to dispense life unto others just as Jesus did.How did Jesus dispense life unto others?Jesus dispensed His life through the communication of the Word.His words were not mere utterances of vocabulary. His words were not mere sounds of aggregated alphabets.His words were soaked and saturated with the Spirit and Life.They were actually the embodiment of His Life and His Spirit."It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life." John 6:63 (NKJV)
You cannot have fellowship with His life without the communication of His word.
As He spoke words His disciples encountered life. At point when He asked His disciples if they will also leave as others left, Peter replied saying, "... Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life." (John 6:68)You became born again through the work of the Spirit and the communication of the word of God. The born again is begotten by the Word of God."For through the eternal and living Word of God you have been born again. And this “seed” that he planted within you can never be destroyed but will live and grow inside of you forever." 1Peter 1:23 (TPT)The word of God is your  substance and essence. And the more you fellowship with the scriptures, the more the reality of the word comes alive in your heart. And it becomes life on your tongue. The word in you, conditions your mind with wisdom. Every word you speak blesses lives. As you can see in the opening verse:"The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life and his words of wisdom are a source of blessing, But the mouth of the wicked conceals violence and evil." Proverbs 10:11 (Amplified Bible)
Don't just speak words, speak wisdom. Live as a life-giver. Don't speak death or defeat.
As you speak forth God's word, you are speaking forth the substance of the Spirit and Life unto men.You are a life-giver, therefore walk in this truth!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ah-sLxo8pDI&t=2273s&pp=ygUdY2hyaXN0IGNvbW1vbndlYWx0aCBjb21tdW5pdHk%3DDIG DEEPER(Proverbs 13:14; John 7:38; James 3:10-12; Luke 6:45; Ephesians 4:29; Proverbs 18:4) WE PRAY We pray that by the wisdom of God's Word shall saturate our hearts and speech at all times no matter the circumstances, that many may receive life when they hear us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 40-422 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have the capacity to dispense life unto others just as Jesus did. - My words are soaked and saturated with the Spirit and Life. - The word of God is life on my tongue. - Every word I speak blesses lives. - I don't just speak words, I speak wisdom. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus!  [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 974 - SPEAK BLESSINGS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency If you are born again, you are part of the Victorious Church. God has set you in the Church at such a time as this, to make enviable contributions for the advancement of the course of Christ. Selah. Author Wednesday, 24th September, 2025 SPEAK BLESSINGS"The words of the godly are a life-giving fountain; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions." Proverbs 10:11 (NLT)The mindset of a new creation is shaped by the word of God. The new creation cannot live above the reality of the word. Whatever we do in speech and deeds must be consistent with the reality of the word of God.You dispense life through the word of God on your tongue.The speaking or utterance of the word of God is blessing to the hearers. 
As a child of God every word you speak must bless lives.
"Do not let unwholesome [foul, profane, worthless, vulgar] words ever come out of your mouth, but only such speech as is good for building up others, according to the need and the occasion, so that it will be a blessing to those who hear [you speak]."Any word which doesn't bless your hearers is unwholesome and worthless.You don't speak your emotions, or feelings, or assumptions or speak out of wrath. Speak life and blessings. No matter the situation, communicate with the intention to build up. Whether you are correcting, reacting, responding or explaining a thought, it should be done with grace. You shouldn't be known as one who speaks blessing and curses."We use our tongue to praise God our Father and then turn around and curse a person who was made in his very image! Out of the same mouth we pour out words of praise one minute and curses the next. My brothers and sister, this should never be!" James 3:9-10 (TPT)
Guard and guide your tongue to communicate the excellence of God. Don't speak curses and violence. Let not poisonous words gush forth from your lips.
From the opening verse, you can see that it is the mouth of the wicked which conceals violence intentions. There is no life and hope on the tongue of the wicked. But for the righteous, his words are a source of blessing and their mouth are the fountain of life.It means when anyone should listen to you they shall enjoy unending flow of wisdom and life.Make a decision today that you are going to be intentional about speaking blessings. Don't just speak words, speak wisdom. Let your hearers rejoice at your words.As they said concerning Jesus, "where did this man get this wisdom?...", people around you should say such about you.No matter how complex a situation is, know that the wisdom of God is at work in you. And your words will produce blessing and life in your hearers.If they don't produce blessings, don't speak!Selahhttps://youtu.be/vrTHnP_y91Q?si=CrvriFuQ2jOfCLGsDIG DEEPER( Colossians 4:6; Proverbs 15:4; Proverbs 18:21; Psalm 45:2; Luke 6:45) WE PRAY We pray that we shall daily walk in the consciousness and intentionality of communicating blessings to our hearers at all times and in all circumstances. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 43-452 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I speak life and blessings no matter the situation. - I guard and guide my tongue to communicate the excellence of God. - My words are a source of blessing - I am intentional about speaking blessings. - My hearers rejoice at my words. - The wisdom of God is at work in me. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 975 - GUARD YOUR WORDS AS A SKILFUL POET
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The present message of God to mankind is not a mystery. God had made Himself visible through Christ. Selah. Author Friday, 26th September, 2025GUARD YOUR WORDS AS A SKILFUL POET"Let no unwholesome word come out of your mouth, but if there is any good word for edification according to the need of the moment, say that, so that it will give grace to those who hear."  Ephesians 4:29 (New American Standard Bible)God framed the universe with words. Exactly what He spoke was what came into being. When God looked at all that He has created, He said it was good (See the whole chapter of Genesis 1)Take a look at this as well:  "Faith empowers us to see that the universe was created and beautifully coordinated by the power of God’s words! He spoke and the invisible realm gave birth to all that is seen." Hebrews 11:3 (TPT)These verses establish a secret concept and principle of the manifestation of things. The present world you see is a product of thoughts and words. Therefore, you must understand that the words you speak take form in your life and in the lives of others."The tongue can bring death or life; those who love to talk will reap the consequences." Proverbs 18:21 (NLT)
Spirit beings or entities act on words which are spoken.
This is why you must be intentional about your words.Paul was emphatic with his apostolic instruction to the saints in Ephesus:"Do not let unwholesome [foul, profane, worthless, vulgar] words ever come out of your mouth, but only such speech as is good for building up others according to the need and the occasion, so that it will be a blessing to those who hear [you speak]." One way you can exercise the intentionality in speaking the right words of blessings, is to guard and guide your words. You guard your words also by guarding and guiding your tongue. Don't just let your tongue loose, put it in submission to the right thoughts."If anyone thinks himself to be religious [scrupulously observant of the rituals of his faith], and does not control his tongue but deludes his own heart, this person’s religion is worthless (futile, barren)." James 1:26 (Amplified Bible).Most people got into trouble because of the words they spoke. The tongue directs the course of your life. And you have to guard and guide it to articulate life.What comes out of your mouth is what defines and defiles you (Matthew 15:11).
Choose your words carefully with wisdom as a dexterous master poet.
As the Psalmist said, "To the Chief Musician; set to the [tune of] “Lilies.” A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A skillful song, or a didactic or reflective poem. A Song of Love. My heart overflows with a good theme; I address my psalm to the King. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer." Psalm 45:1 (Amplified Bible)Your words must paint a beautiful picture of blessings and grace to those who hear you. The unnecessary joke, that unintentional comment, the rebuke hewn out of wrath, and the unloving criticism, has the potential to lead someone to commit suicide, to destroy ones confidence, it can crush the heart of a great vision and dry enthusiasm.Poets don't just make utterances. Their words are reflections of their deep thoughts. The speak to paint the right pictures they want their hearers to see and to feel. You are not an ordinary poet. You are a poet soaked with the spirit-ink. Your life is a poem (Ephesians 2:10) written by the Lord Himself. Bring your sphere into the satisfaction of this reality of the Lord in you. Don't just speak!Let your words uplift destinies and stir fresh passion and hope.Be a builder through your words. Don't only specialize in speaking right words to yourself, train your lips to speak glorious words to your hearers.The Spirit of the Lord is not upon you to curse a generation or destroy lives. The Spirit of the Lord is upon you to influence your heart and tongue to dispense blessings.The Spirit of the Lord is on you to preach good news to the poor; to proclaim liberty to the captives (which cause recovery of sight to the blind, release the oppress) and to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor!Oh glory to God.Beloved guard and guide your words!Selah!https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9g5XbgbJHLk&pp=ygUdY2hyaXN0IGNvbW1vbndlYWx0aCBjb21tdW5pdHk%3DDIG DEEPER( Colossians 4:6; Isaiah 54:10-11; Deuteronomy 32:2; Job 29:22-23;  Proverbs 21:23; Proverbs 25:11; Psalm 141:3) WE PRAY We pray that the wisdom of the Lord shall be set upon our mouth and the Spirit of grace shall keep watch at the door of our lips. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJeremiah 46-482 YEARS PLAN1 Samuel 27DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am intentional about my words. - I guard and guide my tongue to communicate the excellence of God. - My words are a source of blessing - I am intentional about speaking blessings. - My hearers rejoice at my words. - The wisdom of God is at work in me. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 991 - THE RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GOD REVEALED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 10th, October 2025 THE  RIGHTEOUSNESS OF GOD REVEALEDFor the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start top finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.” Romans 1:17 (Berean Standard Bible)When corruption entered man’s heart, man lost the confidence to stand in the presence of God without any sense of guilt.“And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.” Genesis 3:8 (KJV)Because of their unbelief, corruption entered them and they felt condemned and imperfect to stand in God’s presence.He asked, “Adam, where are you?” (Genesis 3:9).
God is interested in where you are. He wants you to be in His presence.
He made man to commune with him. God is expecting you in the place of deep fellowship with Him.And you can only stand in God’s presence by the supply of His righteousness. To reject God is to reject His righteousness. Unbelief doesn’t make you receive what God supplies.
To have fellowship or intimacy with God is according to the dispensing of His life and your faith in Him.
From the corruption of man, until Jesus came, man’s challenge has mainly been “how to attain the righteousness of God”.When the law of Moses was given, the Jews thought the righteousness of God would come by the law.Rather, the law unmasked their weaknesses, imperfections and sins.They were only righteous in their own sight but had a sense of guilt before God.“Now do you see it? No one can ever be made right in God’s sight by doing what the law commands. For the more we know of God’s laws, the clearer it becomes that we aren’t obeying them; his laws serve only to make us see that we are sinners.” Romans 3:21 (TLB)
The righteousness which is of God can only come by faith through Christ Jesus.
This is why the reality of the Gospel is the greatest gift of God to mankind.The Gospel simply means GOOD NEWS; there are no two Gospels.
The Gospel reveals the righteousness of God which comes by faith. Which means, it unveils or declares how God makes you right in His sight.
The Gospel doesn’t declare the list of things you have to do to become righteous. It doesn’t point you to your works, it points you to Christ’s finished work in terms of your justification.
There is nothing you can do outside what Christ has done which will make you righteous.
The righteousness of God is not revealed by the law, the righteousness of God is revealed by the Gospel of Grace.The more you give attention to the Gospel of Jesus, the more your heart is empowered with the confidence of what God has done for and made you.
When you received Jesus into your heart by faith, you received God’s righteousness. You are now the righteous of God in Christ.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 3:1-31; Romans 3:21; 2 Corinthians 5:17; Habakkuk 2:4; Romans 9:30; Romans 10:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we grow in the understanding of what God has done for us through Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEzekiel 44-46 2 YEARS PLAN2 Samuel 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ.– My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 992 - GROW IN THE SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 11th October, 2025GROW IN THE SPIRIT“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head.” Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) Imagine seeing a 20-year-old lady crying for the mother’s breast milk like a 3-month-old baby. Clearly, you will know there is a big problem.
Each kind of life has its own designed growth system.
Every organism is expected to grow. Every plant or crop has an expected season to grow. A yam farmer expects to harvest his crop between 4 to 6 months. It becomes a challenge when it is not ready for harvest within a year or more. If you have been born again for a while, you may have heard the term “Spiritual Growth“. People have some strange understanding of Spiritual growth. They perceive spiritual growth as the completeness of your spirit.
There is no incomplete spirit in Christ.
For you have been made complete in Him (Colossians 2:10). Some assume Spiritual growth means you receive more righteousness, salvation, the life of Christ, holiness, power, and qualification to be a son of God and a citizen of heaven. Others conclude that you are not a king and a priest until you grow spiritually. When you come into Christ you are made righteous (2 Corinthians 5:21). You don’t grow your righteousness neither can it be improved. You can receive more grace, but you cannot receive more righteousness. You receive righteousness as a gift (Romans 5:17).  It is the same with your salvation. You are made Holy in Christ, no saint in Christ is more holy than the other. We all have the holiness of Christ. You only have the responsibility to express that Holiness.  By the obedience of Christ we have been made royal priests (1 Peter 2:9). Now are we the sons of God (1 John 3:2). And as sons, we have equal citizenship in God’s Kingdom and equal access to the Father.
Beloved, your spiritual growth is about your growth in the understanding and consciousness of Christ and who you are in Him. 
“Spiritual growth” is not the growth OF your spirit, it is your growth IN THE SPIRIT. It is your growth into Christ in all things, by which you become the complete expression of Him in this world. It includes the renewal of your mind (Romans 12:2).
To grow in the Spirit is to mature and develop mastery in the expressions of love.
This is when your heart is enriched with the knowledge of Christ and is deeply rooted in His love. ARE YOU GROWING IN THE SPIRIT? Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Proverbs 4:18; Galatians 4:1) WE PRAYThat we will grow in the consciousness of Christ and who he has made us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANEzekiel 47-48Daniel 1  2 YEARS PLAN2 Samuel 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As I feast on the word daily, I grow deeper in the consciousness of Christ and my identity in Him. – I don’t take my spirituality for granted. – As I feast daily on the word,  I mature and develop mastery in the expressions of love. – I demonstrate Christ in all that I do. – I am complete in Christ. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. Oh Hallelujah!! Gloreeeey!!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 993 - YOU ARE CULTIVATED BY YOUR COMMUNION WITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 12th, October, 2025YOU ARE CULTIVATED BY YOUR COMMUNION WITH THE LORD“Behold, I’m standing at the door, knocking. If your heart is open to hear my voice and you open the door within, I will come in to you and feast with you, and you will feast with me.”‭‭Revelation‬ ‭3:20‬ ‭(TPT‬‬) There’s a higher level God has designed for you to operate; but your greatest limitation is your mind. Your mind has to be cultivated.  When God made man, He first placed man in a garden, meaning man must be cultivated.
You are cultivated by the communion with the Lord.
And the more you commune or dine with the Lord, the more you grow to contact deeper realms in GOD. The greatest invitation is the invitation to dine with the LORD in a particular realm. When for example, you have the promptings to pray or read the word don’t take it for granted because it is an invitation to dine with the LORD. It is the LORD calling you to higher and deeper realms. He’s calling you to “come up hither”. Anytime GOD invites you, He invites you to His voice. His voice is not static, it is mobile.
Did you know that GOD is always speaking? 
Yes He is. GOD is NEVER silent. Even when it seem He is silent, that silence is still a communication. He speaks to you of His plans for you and the specific steps you ought to take at every time. He’s always speaking.However, the challenge is the consistent practice of your communion with the Lord. The LORD speaks to you when you commune with Him. [Please read more on “Communing with the Holy Spirit” here] Most at times it is not what is happening to you that matters, rather it is the VOICE you are hearing that matters. The voice you hear and respond to is what influences your life. Do you hear the voice of your fears, worry, pain and struggle or you hear the voice of the Lord? Jesus said, “My sheep hear My voice” John 10:27
Beloved, You must HEAR AND RESPOND to the Voice of the LORD always and in all things.
The instructions of the Lord will lead you to prosperity. Don’t choose your emotions and assumptions over the Voice of the Lord. “Remember what it says: “Today when you hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts as Israel did when they rebelled.” Hebrews 3:15 (NLT)
Have you heard from the LORD concerning the steps you want to take?
Hear His voice now. He’s still speaking. Shalom Aleichem!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 55:3; Hebrews 3:7-15; Hebrews 4:7; Psalm 95:7) WE PRAYThat we will take to the instructions and counsel of the Lord either through the written word, our man of God or to us directly. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANDaniel 2-4 2 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I hear the voice of the Lord at all times. – I don’t lean on my own understanding. – In all things, I decide to hear from the Lord first. – The path of my life like a shining light that shines brighter and brighter unto a perfect day. – Whatever God instructs me to do, I do with all urgency. – I walk in partnership with the Holy Spirit. Oh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 994 - DON'T EVER STOP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency God doesn’t direct your life without your involvement. God only shows you which way to go and how to steer the rudder of your life. Selah. Author Monday, 13th October, 2025DON’T EVER STOP“Woe to you who are complacent in Zion…” Amos 6:1 (NIV) As part of being diligent, and immovable you must intentionally continue in what the Lord has tasked you to do. God didn’t design you to have one time success.It is not enough to be diligent yesterday and complacent today. Complacency is self-satisfaction, which will make you assume you have arrived. It leads to luke-warm and sluggishness.Most people become complacent and think they have arrived by how they compare themselves with others. Being ahead of others in spirituality and results doesn’t mean you have reached the finished line. "For we dare not class ourselves or compare ourselves with those who commend themselves. But they, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise." 2 Corinthians 10:12 (NKJV) Don’t stop half-way to boast about yesterday’s results.There are people who only dwell and boast with their past glory.
It is important to acknowledge every good thing you’ve achieved.
However, when all you have to show to the world tomorrow is what you achieved yesterday, then you wasted today. Yesterday’s success is to inspire you to do more today, and that becomes your testimony and inspiration for tomorrow. Your relevance today is not in the things you used do and achieve. How have you built on what you’ve done and achieved? What more have you done since yesterday? Apostle Paul did not press on because of past glory. He pressed on towards the goal. Goals are not in your past. Goals are ahead of you. If you reached yesterday’s goal, then set new goals and start working towards them today.
How you succeeded yesterday, is not enough for your success today.
You must grow deeper in knowledge and understanding.  You must understand the things you have to put aside from yesterday and the things you must carry along today.  You must know the new things you need to add to what you already have, to achieve more today. It is not how many hours you used to pray. It’s how many hours you pray now. It is not how you used to reach out to win souls. It’s how many souls you are winning now. It is not how many days you used to fast and pray. It’s how you do them better now. It is not how many Churches you have planted and helped. It’s how many new churches you’re planting today. It is not how many people you used to raise for the Lord. It’s how many people you are raising now. It’s not how you used to give into kingdom assignment. It’s how much more grace you have received to give today. It is not how you used to be consistent with ministerial instructions. It’s how consistent you are today in ministry. Not the testimonies you used to see in your life. However, the more testimonies you are seeing now.
Beloved, you must be committed to make progress today.
PRESS ON! BE THE BEST GOD WANTS YOU TO BE TODAY!DON’T EVER STOP! "No, dear brothers and sisters, I have not achieved it, but I focus on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead, I press on to reach the end of the race and receive the heavenly prize for which God, through Christ Jesus, is calling us." Philippians 3:13-14 (NLT) Shalom!DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 9:24-27; Revelation 2:4; Revelation 3:1-22; Hebrews 6:12; Joshua 14:6-15) WE PRAYWe pray that we won’t trade our fervency to do more for the Lord with anything. We take grace to press on to the finished line as the Lord has determined. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANDaniel 5-7 2 YEARS PLAN2 Samuel 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t boast in the past. – I press on towards the goal. – I achieve new goals set before me by the Lord. – I celebrate yesterday’s success but i don’t dwell there. – I press on to produce more fruits today. – Everyday is a new season to achieve new goals. – I don’t stop here. Hallelujah! Oh glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 995 - DON'T ENTERTAIN DISCOURAGEMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 14th  October, 2025 DON’T ENTERTAIN DISCOURAGEMENT “so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.”2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)The teaching of God’s word is one of His defense systems for the faith of the believer.You are established in God’s word and protected from the schemes of the adversary through teaching.“Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.“ Philippians 3:1 (KJV)Ignorance is the major challenge of most believers. And through this discussion, you shall receive light to continuously exercise your victory. I write these things to keep you reminded of ways to enforce your victory and not become prey to the enemy.
The level of your mindset is a reflection of your knowledge and understanding.
A believer must not be ignorant of the devices or schemes of the devil. These projectiles we are discussing will help you identify the subtle workings of the devil so that you can rightly resist him.After David and his men returned to Ziklag, they were disappointed to see the place invaded and the women who were there captured by the Amalekites.David and His mighty soldiers wept till they had no power to weep. This disappointment led to discouragement, great distress and grief. As I mentioned in the previous episode, disappointment may seem harmless but can destroy a believer’s confidence. No matter the disappointment and discouragement, the solution is still the same — TURN TO THE LORD.Discouragement is the adversary’s weapon. It weakens your strength and makes the ability of God at work in you ineffective. Discouragement tames your enthusiasm, momentum, and strength to pursue a great course.Discouragement blinds you from seeing possibility. It makes you give up and leave you to wallow in defeat. This is where the devil wants you.
Refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. Learn to encourage yourself in the Lord.
“And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the Lord his God.” 1 Samuel 30:6 (KJV)One way to deal with discouragement is to look away from the challenge or disappointment and look unto the Lord. Set your mind on the reality that the Lord is with you and all things are possible with Him.Now instead of weeping, David enquired of the Lord and had great victory.“And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David. And David enquired at the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all” 1 Samuel 30:7-8 (KJV)This word of the Lord stirred up more confidence in David’s heart and he had great victory.“And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives. And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all. And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David’s spoil.” 1 Samuel 30:18-20 (KJV)Beloved, you have a greater life than those disappointments. Get up, be encouraged and get to work. Enforce the victory you have in the Lord.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10; John 16:32; Psalm 28:8; Romans 15:13; 1 Thessalonians 5:11; 1 Corinthians 15:18) WE PRAY We pray that our confidence in the Lord shall increase through the ministry of the Word and the impartation of the Holy Spirit. And we shall be encouraged at all times as we journey into purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been made victorious through Christ Jesus. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – I refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above discouragements. – I strengthen myself daily in the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus!  [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 996 - LOOK AT JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 15th October, 2025LOOK AT JESUS“Christ is the visible image of the invisible God.He existed before anything was created and is supreme over all creation” Colossians 1:15 (NLT) Until the appearing of Jesus, God was a mystery. Many people didn’t have rich understanding of God, who He is and how He loves to relate with us. And even now there are people who lack the understanding of who God truly is. You don’t have to travel to the moon to understand God.You don’t have to wait till you depart from this earth to see God. God has revealed Himself explicitly to us.God came to man in the form of man (Jesus, yet He was fully God) to make Himself visible to us. “And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the Spirit, Seen by angels, Preached among the Gentiles, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory.”1 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV). Through Christ Jesus, God is revealed in a clear and detailed manner, without any ambiguity, or leaving no room for confusion or doubt.
When you focus on Jesus you see God in His full reality in life and nature.
Jesus is the perfect picture of God.When you truly behold Jesus, you don’t need to ask of the Father. Look at what Jesus Himself told Philip: ” Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you so long, and yet you have not known Me, Philip? He who has seen Me has seen the Father; so how can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?” John 14:9 Why?The author of Hebrews explains:” His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance…” Hebrews 1:3 (WEB) When you see Jesus, you have seen God’s express image.To understand God’s character, glory, love, nature, plans, intentions and thought patterns, look at Jesus. Our Lord Jesus brings us the perfect picture of God’s love.Man lost the true picture of God and failed to see God in His true essence and expression. Jesus came to change or correct man’s wrong picture of God. He did not come to change God’s picture of man.God has the original picture of us. He always had a perfect picture of Love. Man created a wrong picture about God. They thought of a condemning God but God saw a people He can make righteous in Christ. He saw a people He has to make perfect despite their imperfection. God was not looking for a people He will condemn. He saw a people He must save.While men were yet sinners Christ saved them. (Romans 5:8). For God so loved the world that He gave Himself.(John 3:16). God has no hatred towards man. He never condemns man. He always makes His salvation available. It’s the nature of sin and consciousness of sin that leaves man in condemnation, NOT GOD
Any man that believes in God’s provision of Grace is not condemned but JUSTIFIED.
GOD WANTS YOU TO RECEIVE HIS GIFT WITHOUT YOUR SELF-EFFORT. Your labour (Self-effort) to please God is as a result of your “condemnation consciousness”; but His Grace-received is as a result of His Perfect Love you’ve beheld. (John 3:16-18). ShalomDIG DEEPER(Colossians 1:14-16; John 1:1-18; 2 Corinthians 4:4; 1 John 5:20; John 8:19; 12:45; John 10:30). WE PRAY That we may grow more and more in the knowledge of Christ, that we may understand the perfect love of Christ BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025Judges 11-13  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God loves me.– I see His love in Christ.– I grow in the perfect understanding of God through Christ.– I enjoy the love of God in Christ.– God sees me in His love.– I am not hated by God, I am not condemn by God. I am not an enemy of God. I am loved by God.– Jesus showed me how God loves me.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 997 - YOU CANNOT FULFILL THIS GREAT MANDATE WITHOUT GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 16th October, 2025YOU CANNOT FULFILL THIS GREAT MANDATE WITHOUT GOD“There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God.”2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)All that God has put in you are not for you; they are to bless nations. The impartation of God’s blessings in you is to cause you to make IMPACT in others.
Whenever God wants to bless a people, He sends a man.
While Joseph was living a challenging life from slavery to prison, God was preparing him to be the escape for Jacob in the days of famine (Genesis 45:7). When Israel agonised with pain in Egypt, God raised Moses and sent him as their deliverer.However, God gave a word that He would go down to Egypt to save His people Israel. This means God sending Moses to Egypt was Himself going to Egypt to save Israel. (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10; Acts 7:33-35).There are men whom God raised to be channels or conduits of blessings to their generation.And you (reading this with today) are one of the blessings God has sent to bless this generation.The grace and abilities of God within you are part of the answers God is sending to this generation at such a time as this.Nevertheless, you cannot fulfill this great mandate without God. To affect many lives positively you have to enlarge your capacity.“Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.” Isaiah 54:2-3 (KJV)
To enlarge your capacity, you have to stretch your inner man through consistent and persistent long intense prayers.
To begin with, I want you to know it is wrong to think short quick prayers are not prayers. Every prayer is prayer. The quality of prayer is not really how long you’ve prayed. The quality of prayer is how well it is founded on the word of God.Every prayer rooted in the word is effective!THEREFORE NO MATTER WHAT, PRAY!So then, if even short quick prayers can be effective, much more when you give yourself to consistent long intense prayers?The idea of consistent long intense prayers is not about God expecting you to beg Him for long before He does something for you. Consistent long intense prayers are about having quality time with the Spirit.The longer you spend time with the Spirit of the Lord in prayer, the stronger His influence on you becomes.The Spirit of God enlarges your Spirit and strengthens your inner man. The anointing of the Holy Spirit on you becomes stronger.Are you wondering what to say or pray about?Cheer up!There is the gift of praying in the Spirit. Praying in the spirit includes praying in other tongues.Get this:“The one who speaks in tongues advances his own spiritual progress…” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (TPT)Since tongues speaking will cause you to advance your spiritual progress, or edify (embolden, build or construct your inner man), then do it more to make more spiritual progress!Beloved, even ten minutes of tongues speaking will build your spirit. Therefore make time to pray in tongues for 30 or 60 minutes; then grow it to 2 hours, and then 6 hours.
The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God.
What are you waiting for?Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:30-31; Luke 18:1; Genesis 26:2; Isaiah 26:15; Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]) WE PRAY We pray that against all odds and hindrances, we shall break forth in our spirit and maintain intense consistency in prayer.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20241 YEAR PLANHOSEA 2-4 2 YEARS PLAN2 SAMUEL 20  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Rather than worrying about the size of the assignment, I pray.– I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers.– I am given to prayer.– I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.– Through my effective prayers, I increase in capacity to do more.– I don’t settle for less, I persist long in prayers.OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!   [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 998 - PREVAIL BY THE STRENGTH OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 17th October, 2025PREVAIL BY THE STRENGTH OF GOD“For they all were trying to make us afraid, saying, ‘Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done.’ Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands”Nehemiah 6:9 (NKJV)One of the greatest causes of weakness in the pursuit of God’s purpose is FEAR.The moment you become afraid that you will fail or will not be able to complete the task, you weaken yourself from doing what God wants you to do.The more you exercise confidence that with God you shall do valiantly, the more you increase in strength.When you consider the seemingly overwhelming pressure or the opposition you face or may face in the pursuit of purpose, you will stagger in faith.
There will be times you may not have support from your best friends or the people you trust. But that shouldn’t derail you.
Look at Paul’s (the apostle’s) testimony:”At my first defense no one stood with me, but all forsook me. May it not be charged against them. But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, so that the message might be preached fully through me, and that all the Gentiles might hear. Also I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.” 2 Timothy 4:16-17 (NKJV)Glory to God!!!This is the certainty of our faith!!!No matter the pressure or opposition, beloved, we turn to God.It is by the strength of God that you will prevail, not your human strength nor intelligence.When you turn away from the pressure and you turn to God, you increase in strength.Just as Nehemiah did:“For they all were trying to make us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will not be done.” Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands” Nehemiah 6:9 (NKJV)
Nehemiah chose to pray to God for strength. That was all he needed to complete the work.
Now look at what happened:“So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days. And it happened, when all our enemies heard of it, and all the nations around us saw these things, that they were very disheartened in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was done by our God” Nehemiah 6:15-16 (NKJV)When the strength of God is supplied to you, you can only have the God-kind of results.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 138:3; Psalm 28:7; Psalm 46:1; Daniel 10:19) WE PRAY Oh Lord, strengthen our hands for this work you have committed to us that we will not stagger no matter the opposition or pressure that will confront us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025 1 YEAR PLANHOSEA 5-7 2 YEARS PLAN2 SAMUEL 21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t stagger in faith.– By the strength of God, I prevail.– With God I do valiantly.– I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day.– I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!Increase in strength!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 999 - THE TIME IS NOW
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 18th October, 2025THE TIME IS NOW“We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work.”John 9:4 (NLT)Beloved God has trusted you with His glorious gospel.To carry out the assignment to spread the gospel is to carry out God’s great plan.Though God’s plan is eternal, it is to be accomplished in time. God’s eternal plan of salvation has been programmed to be accomplished in time.God, who has been in all eternity, entered time (which is a spot in eternity) and was revealed (as Jesus) to fulfil the eternal purpose and plan.Our Lord Jesus said:“We need to be energetically at work for the One who sent me here, working while the sun shines. When night falls, the workday is over.” John 9:4 (MSG)Every saint must have this mind-attitude set of Jesus.There is a time bound to this work. It is not going to continue forever.
A day is going to come when soul-winning will end.
There is an expected time in God’s eternal calendar when the gospel must reach all men, then the end shall come.And day by day, the end of this work draws close.You can’t afford to procrastinate. You have to get up and be about the Father’s business.We are in the harvest season for souls. This season will be over soon. The question at the end will be: HOW MANY SOULS DID YOU GATHER FOR THE LORD?
This is why you are here, beloved, to accomplish the task of saving men.
This is the harvest time, ACT QUICKLY AND ENERGETICALLY.During our Bible reading plan last two years, Proverbs 10:5 caught my attention again.“A wise youth harvests in the summer, but one who sleeps during harvest is a disgrace” Proverbs 10:5 (NLT)Are you wise, or are you a disgrace?You must know the season you are in and get serious with this ministry task. Make the most of this opportunity, for the time comes when there will be no such opportunity.Look at the same verse in the Passion Translation:“Know the importance of the season you’re in and a wise son you will be. But what a waste when an incompetent son sleeps through his day of opportunity!” Proverbs 10:5 (TPT)Act quickly on the ideas the Lord is putting in your heart.The things the Lord is inspiring you to do are the things He wants to do. Be the body and the person the Lord will use to accomplish His task quickly.Don’t hesitate!Don’t make excuses!Don’t think it is not time yet!
The time is now.
You are in the body of Christ at such a time to accomplish your purpose.Get to work quickly and energetically.During our Bible reading plan last two years, Proverbs 10:5 caught my attention again. Proverbs 10:5 (NLT)Don’t delay with that giving. Don’t delay with the outreach plan. Don’t delay with those great ideas.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 3:13-14; 2 Timothy 4:7-8; John 4:34-36; Romans 13:11-12; 1 John 2:18) WE PRAY– The grace to be diligent in the work the Lord has entrusted unto us.– That we will not cast away our confidence in the work of ministry, rather hold on steadfastly till the end, working diligently with a strong sense of urgency. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN Hosea 8-10 2 YEARS PLAN2 Samuel 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to procrastinate what the Lord has instructed me to do.– I don’t give excuses.– I don’t hesitate.– I act now.– I get the job done on time.– Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof.– I am a faithful laborer.– I labour in and out season.– I get myself busy with the Lord’s assignment.– I don’t waste the grace of God bestowed unto me.– I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me.– I go every length to get the job done.– I keep a sense of urgency in all things.Ohh Hallelujah!!! Gloreeeey! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1000 - THE NEW WAY OF LIFE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Gloreeeey! Today marks thousand episodes of light, truth, and transformation. Thank you for journeying with us daily in the word. Author    Sunday, 19th October, 2025 THE NEW WAY OF LIFE “A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another. By this all will know that you are My disciples, if you have love for one another.” John 13:34-35 Jesus did not leave His disciples without clear instructions. The instructions of Jesus are life.  He didn’t come to die for us, resurrect and ascend to Heaven without giving us clear commandments. 
Beloved, He gave us the Holy Spirit (of whom we will be discussing much about later) and He also gave us His commandments.
Most at times we hear people say, we are not “UNDER A LAW…”Then we begin to think we have no Law and commandments. That is not entirely true. Because the Bible never said that. Of course we are not “UNDER THE LAW OF MOSES” Whenever the Bible says, we are not under the law, it is referring to the LAW OF MOSES. That law couldn’t bring us into the full expression of God. In Christ, we have A NEW LAW OF LIFE (Romans 8:2). This law is also the law of Christ (Galatians 6:2). The commandments of Jesus are not the Commandments of Moses. The commandments of Jesus are not merely demands. The commandments of Jesus also supply us with life and ability.  The truth is, His commandments are the dispensing of Himself. Let me talk to You:
Whatever, Jesus tells you to do is what He has become to you and what He has made you.
He doesn’t just demonstrate what He tells you to do. He becomes what He tells you to do in you. Our Lord Jesus doesn’t show you how to live His life externally. He has indwelt you through the Holy Spirit to do what He tells you to do, with you. You don’t walk in the obedience of His commandments alone. You walk in obedience of His commandments with Him. Paul said, “Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God” 2 Corinthians 3:5 See The Passion Translation: “Yet we don’t see ourselves as capable enough to do anything in our own strength, for our true competence flows from God’s empowering presence” This is what it is when I say, “The commandments of Jesus are Life”. He says, “without me you can do nothing” (John 15:5). The golden rule of the commandments of Moses is, “Love your neighbour as yourself” This is demanding and limited. It means the ability to love is issuing out of your love for yourself. And you can only love as far as you love yourself. How far can you love with this limited ability of love in you? And even until Jesus came, we had not seen the full expression of love. Through Jesus, we saw a whole new civilization of love.  Paul says, “to know the love of Christ which surpasses all knowledge…” Ephesians 3:19. Which means Moses’ commandment of love cannot bring you into full expression of the love of God. And till today, many are still living by “love your neighbour as yourself”. But Jesus is inviting us to a higher dimension of love. He said, a “New” Commandment I give. It means from now onwards you don’t operate by the Mosaic law.  The Lord is saying, I bring you something new. The word for new is “Kainos”, it means freshness, recently made, unused, unworn, unprecedented, uncommon, unheard of. It is not “new” in terms of time, but “new” as to form or quality, of different nature from what is contrasted as old. It relates to being not previously present; as set over against that which is outworn, the effete or burnt-out through age.
Beloved, this New Commandment of love Jesus gave was beyond any human comprehension and experience.
It is a supernatural commandment. The new commandment of Jesus says: "…as I have loved you, that you also love one another".  This love is beyond the domain of men. It is beyond the standard of men. This is a higher standard of love.  And no man can meet its demand. This is why God designed it to only be supplied to you by Himself. This love doesn’t work just by utterance. It works by life.
You cannot wake up one day to just start loving as He has loved you. Unless you have received Him into you.
The greatest mind couldn’t imagine this love. He Himself has to be the picture of this love. To walk in this love, you must know more and more the extent by which He has loved you. “All this is proceeding along lines planned all along by God and then executed in Christ Jesus. When we trust in him, we’re free to say whatever needs to be said, bold to go wherever we need to go. So don’t let my present trouble on your behalf get you down. Be proud!My response is to get down on my knees before the Father, this magnificent Father who parcels out all heaven and earth. I ask him to strengthen you by his Spirit—not a brute strength but a glorious inner strength—that Christ will live in you as you open the door and invite him in. And I ask him that with both feet planted firmly on love, you’ll be able to take in with all followers of Jesus the extravagant dimensions of Christ’s love. Reach out and experience the breadth! Test its length! Plumb the depths! Rise to the heights! Live full lives, full in the fullness of God.” Ephesians 3:11-19 (The Message) Glory to God!DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:9-10; John 15:12,13,17) WE PRAYThat we will comprehend the love of Christ which surpasses knowledge. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANHosea 11-132 YEARS PLAN2 Samuel 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The love of Christ floods my heart.  - I have Christ’s ability to love.  - I walk in love.  - I grow in the incomprehensible love of Christ.  - I experience the fullness of God’s love in all matters.  - My understanding is deepened in the love of Christ. Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1001 - BE "MARY" IN A "MARTHA'S" WORLD 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t treat the work of the ministry as an assignment which will go on forever. There is an end to this work. Selah. Author Monday, 20th October, 2025BE "MARY" IN A "MARTHA'S" WORLD 1"But the Lord replied to her, “Martha, Martha, you are worried and bothered and anxious about so many things" Luke 10:41 (Amplified Bible)It is only the wisdom and glory of God's word which will always be relevant and abide for ever."Human beings are frail and temporary, like grass, and the glory of man fleeting like blossoms of the field. The grass dries and withers and the flowers fall off, but the Word of the Lord endures forever! And this is the Word that was announced to you!" 1 Peter 1:24-25 (TPT)
The word of God is the substance of the wisdom of God. It is eternal, thus transcends all civilizations. 
There is no time in human advancement or progress of civilization and systems where the word of God shall become irrelevant.The word of God provides answers to every human situation or challenge. The study and understanding of the scriptures will give you perfect hindsight, insight, foresight, and empower you to have proper oversight at all times.This means that, the present world is not new to the eternal wisdom of God which is embodied in the scriptures. Whichever direction the world is facing and the ideologies human activities orbits have clearly been foretold in the scriptures. When you go for the word you shall know how to handle and walk in time.This present postmodern world is not a strange world to the wisdom of God. When you submit to the scriptures you shall enjoy rich answers and not be overwhelmed by its burdens.In Luke 10, Jesus and his disciples visited Martha's home, who also had a sister named Mary.In preparation for her guests, Martha became exasperated by finishing the numerous household chores.
She was more drenched in household activities and couldn't even make time to be available for the Lord.
Clearly, anyone reading this may think for a moment that Martha was doing the right thing to set her house in order for her guests. The kind of focus she had on her to-do list, in performing a good deed, is a reflection of the experiences of many believers in this postmodern world.This present world is as a Martha's world. It is woven with a culture of constant activity. Family obligations, social commitments and unending financial burdens have dominated people. When people are seen to be busy it's equated as being successful.This postmodern world cannot be discussed without this digital distractions which blur commitment towards true personal well-being. The barrage of notifications keep eroding the attention of people towards the most important things.Most people are burning out, being shoved off into fatigue and anxiety due to the pressure of gratification and competition with overwhelming bills and human expectations.The demands of this postmodern world make times spent with the Lord appear to be time wasting. Believers feel though it is good to commune with the Lord and be present at the feet of Jesus, there are other urgent matters which they have to give their time to instead.They see people making time for the Lord to be lazy and useless. Exactly Martha's reaction when she saw Mary giving attention to the Lord."She had a sister named Mary, who seated herself at the Lord’s feet and was continually listening to His teaching. But Martha was very busy and distracted with all of her serving responsibilities; and she approached Him and said, “Lord, is it of no concern to You that my sister has left me to do the serving alone? Tell her to help me and do her part.” But the Lord replied to her, “Martha, Martha, you are worried and bothered and anxious about so many things; but only one thing is necessary, for Mary has chosen the good part [that which is to her advantage], which will not be taken away from her.” Luke 10:39-42 (Amplified Bible)You can be a Mary in a Martha's world. Refuse to be caught up in this postmodern chaos and demands. 
Make intentional effort to utilize the advantage of being at the feet of Jesus. 
It's at the feet of Jesus you find true peace, total well-being, rest and refreshment.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 26:3; Proverbs 3:5-6;Hebrews 12:1-2; Colossians 3:2) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts will be guided and be set in the fellowship which we have with the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANHosea 14Joel 1-22 YEARS PLAN2 Samuel 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is guided and set in my fellowship with the Lord. - I delight in staying long at the feet of Jesus. - I refuse to be persuaded and caught up into this postmodern chaos and demands. - I stay with the Lord. - I don’t undermine the privilege of staying at the feet of Jesus. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1002 - BE "MARY" IN A "MARTHA'S" WORLD 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Commit your mind and heart to the prophetic word that you have received and run with it. Beloved, the word never fails. Shalom! Author Tuesday, 21st October, 2025 BE "MARY" IN A "MARTHA'S" WORLD 2"But the Lord replied to her, “Martha, Martha, you are worried and bothered and anxious about so many things" Luke 10:41 (Amplified Bible) Beloved, let your life be guided by the word.You don't have to be born again and be controlled by the world.You can be in this postmodern world and not be controlled or become a victim of its systems and demands. Those who are caught up in the exasperation of this world may think it's not necessary or most important to spend time with the Lord.Being as Mary was in Martha's world is the most important thing.
To live as Mary in Martha's world is to live and enjoy the Lord as Mary did.
Mary wasn't swept off by the burdens and endless demands of society. She wasn't trying to impress Jesus. She genuinely understood the need to be with Him. Martha was infuriated when she saw Mary at the feet of Jesus. While Martha thought Mary should be busy with chores, Jesus saw Mary at His feet as the most important thing.In Martha's world, it's all about the work you do and how you are putting in all your self-effort to succeed. In Martha's world, activity comes first before intimacy.Those caught up in this postmodern chaos and demands will think of being in Church for only 1hour and 30 minutes at most, or not being present at all, so that they can attend to the next work schedule. They think that being available for discipleship is a waste of time. Like I said previously, you can be a Mary in a Martha's world when you decide to utilise the advantage of being at the feet of Jesus. 
It's at the feet of Jesus you find true peace, total well-being, rest and refreshment.
" ...Mary sat down attentively before the Master, absorbing every revelation He shared." (Verse 39 of Luke 10)This experience of Mary must be your daily experience while you find yourself in "a Martha's world"."But Martha became exasperated by finishing the numerous household chores in preparation for her guests, so she interrupted Jesus and said, “Lord, don’t you think it’s unfair that my sister left me to do all the work by myself? You should tell her to get up and help me.” Luke 10:40 (TPT)Martha didn't think intimacy with the Lord was more important than the activities.
To have intimacy with the Lord is to absorb the blessings of Him and be saturated by His presence.
While intimacy with the Lord enriches your heart, activities in "Martha's world" leave you exhausted and drained.Pay attention to the response of Jesus to the demand of Martha (who is a replica of this postmodern world):"The Lord answered her, “Martha, my beloved Martha. Why are you upset and troubled, pulled away by all these many distractions? Are they really that important? Mary has discovered the one thing most important by choosing to sit at my feet. She is undistracted, and I won’t take this privilege from her.”Luke 10:41-42 (Amplified Bible)The control and demands of this world make you:- distracted - pulled away from the Lord- live upset and troubledJesus called Martha, "my beloved Martha", what a reminder!While she was to enjoy the love of Jesus towards her as His beloved, she was drawn to being busy to impress the Lord.As part of the things Jesus said to Martha, He asked her if the things which has taken her attention are really the most important?This is the question you should ask yourself each day. 
Don't go through each day or live in this "Martha-like world" without making time for the most important thing — INTIMACY WITH THE LORD.
Don't spend the entire 24 hours without making time for the most important thing. Recognise "sitting at the feet of Jesus" as a non-negotiable moment on your schedule.Learn to spend time to have personal intimacy with the Lord and be present for corporate fellowship. Every day of your life must have hours where you yield to the Lord.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 26:3; Proverbs 3:5-6; Hebrews 12:1-2; Colossians 3:2) WE PRAYWe pray that we will not be distracted but will always see the importance of enjoying the Lord's presence above any other thing. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJoel 3Amos 1-22 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is guided and set in my fellowship with the Lord. – I delight in staying long at the feet of Jesus. – I refuse to be persuaded and caught up into this postmodern chaos and demands. – I stay with the Lord. – I don’t undermine the privilege of staying at the feet of Jesus. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1003 - BE "MARY" IN A "MARTHA'S" WORLD 3
