content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 22nd October, 2025 BE "MARY" IN A "MARTHA'S" WORLD 3"Mary has discovered the one thing most important by choosing to sit at my feet. She is undistracted, and I won’t take this privilege from her.” Luke 10:42 ( Amplified Bible)To live as "Mary in Martha's world", is to live and enjoy the Lord as Mary did. Take advantage of your access to the Lord.Whatever you can do for the Lord is in what He has given to you and His grace which He unceasingly supplies you.
The best thing that can ever happen to you is to make the most of the privilege to be at the Lord's feet.
This is the burden of this series.Are there believers who don't see the value of being at the Lord’s feet?These are those who live in the exasperation of this world trying to catch up with the speed of postmodernism.  One may clap for someone working from 8am to 10pm (Monday to Friday) in two different international organizations with huge salaries, and be upset with one who makes time for the Lord on some days after work (at 5pm). People only think of making time for the Lord in personal prayers and also attend Church service to see a Pastor when they need a breakthrough or a miracle.These ones are easily led into falsehood and deception because they have not learnt to spend time to deepen their fellowship with Jesus.Mary genuinely understood the need to be with Him.
Nothing is more important than being at the feet of Jesus, and let nothing take that privilege from you.
Jesus saw Mary at His feet as the most important thing.In Martha's world, it's all about the work you do and how you are putting in all your self-effort to succeed. In Martha's world activity comes first before intimacy.Mary was living with Martha, but first esteemed the Lord's presence above Martha's demands.Martha will later learn the effect of not taking advantage of the Lord's presence.You find true peace, total well-being, rest and refreshment when you stay intimate with the Lord.It's one thing to be loved by the Lord, it's another thing to intentionally enjoy the Love of Jesus and to express it.To effectively live as Mary in a Martha's world, you must prioritize the one thing that matters most, INTIMACY WITH THE LORD.Why wake up in a morning to rush out to work without giving focus to this one thing which builds you up?Until you become intentional about your intimacy with the Lord you cannot become consistent.Make your quiet time an important moment of your day. Set times in each day for quiet reflection or meditation on a scripture and prayer. 
Learn to say "no" to non-essential commitments.
Why attend a party when you have not been available to meditate on a scripture? Planning your schedules can prevent busyness from taking over your life.These will help you remain established amid the chaos.Here is the secret:"What delight comes to those who follow God’s ways! They won’t walk in step with the wicked, nor share the sinner’s way, nor be found sitting in the scorner’s seat. Their pleasure and passion is remaining true to the Word of “I Am,” meditating day and night in his true revelation of light. They will be standing firm like a flourishing tree planted by God’s design, deeply rooted by the brooks of bliss, bearing fruit in every season of their lives. They are never dry, never fainting, ever blessed, ever prosperous . " Psalm 1:1-3 (TPT)
Your faith level for manifestation is dependent on your intimacy with the Lord.
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Luke 10:38-42; Isaiah 26:3; Proverbs 3:5-6; Hebrews 12:1-2; Colossians 3:2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall learn to esteem every moment with Jesus and shall exercise the wisdom to take advantage of the privilege to spend time with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANAmos 3-52 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is guided and set in my fellowship with the Lord. – I delight in staying long at the feet of Jesus. – I refuse to be persuaded and caught up into this postmodern chaos and demands. – I stay with the Lord. – I don’t undermine the privilege of staying at the feet of Jesus. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus! [mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1004 - LET YOUR HEART INDITE A GOOD MATTER 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday, 23rd October, 2025LET YOUR HEART INDITE A GOOD MATTER 1"My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer." Psalm 45:1 (KJV)The heart in this context refers to the innermost intentions, emotions and being. It is the innerself or deepest part of a person.Your heart is the source or the origination of your actions."Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from" Proverbs 4:23 (GOD'S WORD Translation)
Your heart is the seat of your deepest thoughts and emotions.
To guard your heart with all diligence means to guard it with all vigilance. Your entire life is centered and built on the condition of your heart.Let's read the verse from the Goodnews Translation:"Be careful how you think; your life is shaped by your thoughts." (Proverbs 4:23)Before you start blaming the devil, and others for the outcome of your life, first consider how you think.Many things which goes on in your life are rooted in the cogitation of your heart.There is nothing that happens to you, which first doesn't go through your heart. The possibilities of your life are framed within the walls of your heart.There are two core items which influences your manifestations:1. The condition of your heart.2. The words of your lips.
What is in your heart controls your lips.
The mouth will articulate the abundance of your heart.As Jesus said, "People are known in this same way. Out of the virtue stored in their hearts, good and upright people will produce good fruit. But out of the evil hidden in their hearts, evil ones will produce what is evil. For the overflow of what has been stored in your heart will be seen by your fruit and will be heard in your words." Luke 6:45 (TPT)No matter how long you pretend, anyone who pays attention to your words will know what is in your heart because your words exposes what is in your heart.In the realms of the spirit, words are determinants. Your weight and depths are measured by the words you speak.The afflictions or affluence of men are influenced by their words and deepest thoughts.
Your words will always reflect the meditation of your heart.
To indite a good matter is to set a good theme in your heart. The word indite means to gush out, well up or boil up."My heart is on fire, boiling over with passion. Bubbling up within me are these beautiful lyrics..." (Psalm 45:1; TPT)The words you meditate on in your heart are flames which burn in your heart. This is why when you feel angry or even joyful, you feel a burning sensation.Because there is a fire in your heart. But the kind of fire which burns within you is determined by the theme of your heart.For the afflictions of the adversary to limit you, he sets themes of discouragement, failure and defeat in your heart.
Let your heart boil or bubble with a beautiful theme.
Set the right themes or good news on your heart everyday.Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:2; Proverbs 16:23; Psalm 49:3; Job 32:18-20; Job 33:3; Matthew 12:35) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall set His beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon our hearts, that we shall only speak words which are consistent of His grace towards us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANAmos 6-82 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The Lord has set the beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon my heart.  - My words are consistent with the grace of God towards me. - My heart boils with a beautiful theme of grace. - I give no place for discouragement, failure and defeat in my heart. - My heart indite a good matter. Oh Glory to God![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1005 - LET YOUR HEART INDITE A GOOD MATTER 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 24th October, 2025LET YOUR HEART INDITE A GOOD MATTER 2"My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer." Psalm 45:1 (KJV)From the previous episode I explained that your heart is the source or the origination of your actions."Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from" Proverbs 4:23 (GOD'S WORD Translation)Since the adversary knows your heart is the seat of your deepest thoughts and emotions, he does anything possible to project deceptive thoughts into your heart.
He knows the moment your heart begins to absorb those thoughts, they will definitely germinate and manifest in your life.
That was how the adversary corrupted the pure hearts of Adam and Eve.Look at what Paul the apostle said to the brethren in Corinth:"But now I’m afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s clever lies, your thoughts may be corrupted and you may lose your single-hearted devotion and pure love for Christ." 2 Corinthians 11:3 (TPT)Reading from the above verse, how did Satan deceive Eve?He used his clever lies to deceive Eve's thoughts. And Paul the apostle posits that the devil's strategy has not changed. He may corrupt the hearts or thoughts of the saints by his clever lies.Through the deceptive thoughts of the devil, he poisons or corrupts your heart and disables you from believing or from exercising yourself in faith.When he succeeds at deceiving your heart, he practically takes away the word of the Lord from your heart so that you may not believe or have faith (See Luke 8:12).How can you live the victorious life in Christ without faith? For the just shall live by faith. (Romans 1:17).The adversary comes after your heart. Whatever he wants to achieve on earth begins with the seed of thoughts he sows in the hearts of men. When he wants to destroy your family, distract your miracle, collapse your business, he makes you doubt the reality of God.
He overwhelms your heart with negative and discouraging themes.
The evil and wickedness of men we see today began with the imagination or intents of the heart of men."Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time." Genesis 6:5 (Berean Standard Bible).Once the adversary is able to invade the meditation of your heart with his deceptive lies, he has achieved the plotted coup to dethrone the manifestion of your testimony.This is why more than anything else you must guard your heart. Every thought of your heart must be consistent with the glorious news of Jesus.Job said, "For the thing I feared has overtaken me, and what I dreaded has befallen me." Job 3:25 (Berean Study Bible)
Fear is the outcome of the control and influence of doubts and anxiety of failure in your heart.
Job was easily afflicted because he allowed the theme of fear in his heart.Sometimes for the enemy to control and even affirm the theme of your heart, he begins to attack your peripherals. He deceive people to become your enemies, he attempts to resist your business, tries to cripple your finances, projects infirmities to afflict your body with symptoms. Whiles your heart settles and accepts these happenings the challenges now gain root.So brother James charged us to "count it all joy when you encounter various trials" (James 1:2)"To count" is from the Greek word, "hēgeomai" which means to esteem, think as a ruler or a governor over a matter, or have rule over the situation in your heart.Don't breakdown or accept defeat. Instead of allowing the challenge to take root in your heart, look unto Jesus, make His victory the meditation and theme of your heart.
Let your heart absorb and be occupied with the victory of Jesus.
There are many more things the Lord has achieved for you. Focus on the victory of the Lord concerning your challenge, think on it, speak it, shout about it, sing it, and dance to it.What is the theme of your heart this day?Are you thinking about debt, death, defeat, failure, loss, sickness, limitations, lack or you are thinking of the abundance of the Lord, the life of God, the victory of the Lord, his success, the profits, good health, limitlessness, and overflowing grace?Beloved, let your heart indite a good matter.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:2; Proverbs 16:23; Psalm 49:3; Job 32:18-20; Job 33:3; Matthew 12:35) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be deceived by the cleverly lies of the devil, but the theme and thoughts of our hearts shall be saturated and soaked with God's wisdom and grace. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANAmos 9Obadiah 1Jonah 12 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord has set the beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon my heart.  – My words are consistent with the grace of God towards me. – My heart boils with a beautiful theme of grace. – I give no place for discouragement, failure and defeat in my heart. – My heart indite a good matter. Oh Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1006 - LET YOUR HEART INDITE A GOOD MATTER 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 25th October, 2025 LET YOUR HEART INDITE A GOOD MATTER 3"My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer." Psalm 45:1 (KJV)Have you read the recent 5 episodes of with ?If you haven't done so, then click on them to have a great feast.Recently, someone asked me, "Apostle, I have really been confessing the word of God, but I don't see its manifestation in my life"Beloved, from previous episodes, you will find the clear answer to this question. You see, the manifestation of the word of God doesn't first begin with confession. Though it is a great thing to speak forth the word, one has to first set the word up in his or her heart.
The scriptures did charge every believer to guard his or her tongue.
"He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress." Proverbs 21:23 (Berean Standard Bible)However, as we have seen previously, you speak according to the meditations of your heart. What goes on in your heart comes out of your mouth.  When you attempt to make positive confessions, the real challenge of life will hit your heart, and you may speak wrongly.Thus, you can truly guard your tongue when you are able to properly guard your heart. Confessions made with deep convictions will produce courageous steps.Beloved, "Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from" Proverbs 4:23 (GOD'S WORD Translation)Your mouth is the channel by which life flows out of you from your heart. What comes out of your mouth is brewed in your heart.Take a look at the opening verse again:"My heart is on fire, boiling over with passion. Bubbling up within me are these beautiful lyrics as a lovely poem to be sung for the King. Like a river bursting its banks, I’m overflowing with words, spilling out into this sacred story" Psalm 45:1 (TPT)
The words which shall overflow from your heart are the thoughts or the theme bubbling up within you.
When your heart is set on the theme of past failures, such will overflow out of your mouth and will influence your actions.No one is designed to have a stronger mind than the other. It is what we choose to set our minds on that determines the strength of our minds.David never had fear of what his enemies would do to him because the theme of his heart is this, "The Lord is my light and my Salvation..."There is no way you will walk in fear or be afraid of what others plot against you, when the theme of your heart is that "The Lord is the strength of my life..."David didn't just make such an utterance in Psalm 27:1; it was the meditation of his heart.The songs of David are songs of confidence in God. The reflections of his meditation.
No matter the challenges he faced and the moments of despair, you will find his boast in the Lord.
His words and songs were utterances of the Lord's theme on his heart. Songs are the communication and reflections of deep impressions of the heart."And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence."Instead of the theme of sickness and death, set your heart on the revelation of Jesus' stripes.
Don't allow the devil to make you feel you are afflicted because of your transgressions. 
He is a deciever and accuser of the brethren. When your heart accepts that you don’t deserve healing because of your wrongs, you allow the affliction to gain root.The devil has no legal right to afflict until your heart accepts it. Refuse to accept that you cannot be healed because you once lived a wicked life. You are no longer a wicked child if you are in Christ."But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was crushed for our wickedness [our sin, our injustice, our wrongdoing]; The punishment [required] for our well-being fell on Him, And by His stripes (wounds) we are healed." Isaiah 53:5 (Amplified Bible)Jesus legally attained your well-being. He achieved every requirement needed for you to walk in wholeness.For every infirmity you may be experiencing in your body, see in your heart that the Lord paid for it. 
The manifestation of your wholeness is rooted in the revelation of Jesus as a theme in your heart.
What is the theme of your heart this day?DIG DEEPERPlease read these SCRIPTURES and meditate on them:(2 Samuel 23:2; Proverbs 16:23; Psalm 49:3; Job 32:18-20; Job 33:3; Matthew 12:35) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not be deceived by the clever lies of the devil, but the theme and thoughts of our hearts shall be saturated and soaked with all that the Lord is and what He has achieved for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJonah 2-42 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be deceived by the clever lies of the devil. – The Lord has set the beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon my heart.  – My words are consistent with the grace of God towards me. – My heart boils with a beautiful theme of grace. – I give no place for discouragement, failure and defeat in my heart. – My heart indite a good matter. Oh Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1007 - YOU ARE SPECIAL IN GOD'S SIGHT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 26th October, 2025YOU ARE SPECIAL IN GOD’S SIGHT“to all who are beloved of God in Rome, called as saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Romans 1:7 (Legacy Standard Bible) When was the last time you thought of your relationship with God? And how do you think God sees you? The reality is this God doesn’t see you as His enemy. And this is not a reformed or changed mindset of God about you.
He has never seen you as His enemy even before you got born again.
The thought that you are nobody, and worthless before God is not consistent with God’s word. Don’t define yourself according to your feelings nor circumstances. If you want to know who you truly are, find out what God says about you. God’s original thought of you is seen or revealed through Christ. In Paul’s epistle to Rome, he addressed the brethren, according to who they truly are in Christ: “[I am writing] to all who are beloved of God in Rome, called to be saints (God’s people) and set apart for a sanctified life, [that is, set apart for God and His purpose]: Grace to you and peace [inner calm and spiritual well-being] from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ” Romans 1:7 (Amplified) Now, though he mentioned that the epistle was to all who are the Beloved of God in Rome, it doesn’t suggest Rome is the only place to find those who are God’s beloved. Anyone in Christ is the beloved of God.
To be the Lord’s beloved means to be specially, intimately and greatly loved by God.
This reveals God’s special relationship with His chosen people, who are set apart unto Him. “See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are…” 1 John 3:1 You are not and shall never be hated by God. You are God’s beloved and He has loved you with an everlasting (unending) love. Walk in this confidence all the days of your life. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 31:3; Romans 8:39; Deuteronomy 33:12) WE PRAYThanking God for His unfeigned love and unchangeable thought about us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMicah 1-32 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the beloved of God. – I am special in God’s sight. – God loves me with an everlasting love. – I am the thought that fills God’s mind all the time. – God’s mind about me can never change. – I am confident of this very thing, that irrespective of my circumstances or feeling, I know that I am loved by God. – I walk daily in the consciousness of this reality. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1008 - RULE OVER ADVERSITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 27th October, 2025 RULE OVER ADVERSITY"My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations" James 1:2 (KJV)We have often heard expressions which seem to be similar to what is in the opening verse, "be joyful in trouble"; others assume that "to be joyful in trouble or challenge is to accept your situation or pain as a trial from God".But that is not what it is!To count it all joy is not to accept a predicament with joy. It is not to accept that sour pain is an affliction from God.
God doesn't need to afflict you to train you. His word is rich enough to train your heart.
To walk with God is to live by faith, and you don't live by faith through experiences; you live by faith in the word. Any experience which inspires faith is built on the word of God.Any training God will give to you shall be by the revelation of His word of Grace.God doesn't need to afflict you with sickness, diseases, or disappointment to train you. Most afflictions are a result of living outside the counsel of God's word or the deceptive work of the adversary.However, the challenges a believer may go through can be conquered by the word of God. What we learn from challenges or afflictions is how the word works. When you fail to glean the wisdom of the word of God to address your challenge, you may not know how to deal with a similar challenge in the future.To "count it all joy" is not just to go through all challenges with joy. The keyword in James 1:2 is "COUNT IT", it's from the Greek word, "hēgeomai", which means:- strengthened- to lead that is command (with official authority)- figuratively to deem, that is to consider or account or esteem and think- to be a governor, judge or have the rule over.To "count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations" is not to accept the temptations, but to deem or account it with joy. It means you don't make the challenge the account of your life. 
You don't define your present state by the trials or the troubles you face.
You have to rule over adversity or the troubles with joy. Joy is the instrument by which you exercise the divine rule over challenges.You don't allow challenges to overwhelm your heart. Instead, you set your heart up with joy. Instead of accounting for or esteeming your heart by the negative news or the limitations, set the estimation of your heart with the joy of the Lord.Being joyful is not an act of pretense. It is not acting as though you don't have a challenge; it is basically dominating the challenge with the word of the Lord in your heart.Challenges or trials dominate hearts with sorrow, agony, anxiety, and depression. However, you must dominate your heart with the joy of the word of the Lord.
Let the joy of what the Lord has said, overtake your heart or rule over your heart, and you shall walk in total victory.
Don't make the trials the condition of your thought. Let your thoughts be ruled by the impact of the word of God.Jesus said, "these words have I spoken unto you that my joy may be fulfilled in you".The word of the Lord brings the fulfilment of His joy in your heart. So instead of giving your focus to the trials, turn and look unto the word of the Lord.This is how you count it all joy.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:4; Isaiah 41:10; 1 Thessalonians 5:16-17; John 15:11) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be ruled and dominated by the joy of the Lord and not by trials. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMicah 4-62 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My heart is ruled and dominated by the joy of the Lord at all times. - I refuse to allow my heart to be dominated by trials. - I maintain my joy at all times. - I rule over every adversity with joy. - No challenge can overhelm my heart. - My thoughts are ruled by the impact of the word of God. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1009 - GOD DEALS WITH YOUR CORE CHALLENGE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Tuesday, 28th October, 2025 GOD DEALS WITH YOUR CORE CHALLENGE"Do not be anxious or worried about anything, but in everything [every circumstance and situation] by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, continue to make your [specific] requests known to God." Philippians 4:6 (Amplified Bible)Have you ever given attention to this verse of scripture?What do you see as your biggest challenge?Is it the circumstance you find yourself in or the state of your heart?Get this, the enemy is not after your money, health, house, education, children and anything external.
The adversary is after your heart.
Paul's instruction to the Philippians unveils what God is very concerned about concerning you.The challenges you face can never be permanent.Most matters which made you anxious at one time are things you may laugh over when you look back in time.You can remember how anxious you were while going to write your first Basic Education Examination.What about the times you were anxious and couldn't even check your examination results?Do you remember how you felt while going for the job interview? How does such a moment matter to you now?Do you remember those tears because you felt you wouldn't be able to have children?How about the anxiety when you were looking forward to receiving a visa? Now, whether you received good news or not during those times, what do you really think was your challenge?Get this, God doesn't see the interview, examination, the debt, the unemployment, the dismissal, the rejection, the failure, the marriage dispute, the betrayals, the financial limitations, the business struggle, the delay of miracles etc, as your core challenge.What God sees as your challenge is how you react amidst the challenge. 
God is interested in the condition of your heart than the challenge confronting you.
Those challenges shall definitely pass away, but how they affect your heart shall remain forever and shall continue.One great man, Robert Schuller said, "Tough times never last, but tough people do"While the adversary knows those tough times you face will not last, he wants to use such times to weaken your heart. However, God wants you to take advantage of such moments to build yourself in His strength. God wants you to exercise yourself in faith.So instead of God saying, "I will give you the money", "I will give you the children", "I will give you the success", "I will give you the appointment". He rather instructs the saints, saying, "Do not be anxious or worried about anything."Beloved, God doesn't want you to worry or be anxious. The core challenge is the state of your heart. Being anxious weakens your heart.Paul instructs the saints to pray and to continually make supplications (or petitions) of specific requests to God with thanksgiving. Take a look at the effect of the prayer:See verse 7:"And the peace of God [that peace which reassures the heart, that peace] which transcends all understanding, [that peace which] stands guard over your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus [is yours]." Philippians 4:7 (Amplified Bible)
The greatest answer you need is the STATE OF PEACE amidst the challenges.
God is your loving Father. His plans for you are greater than your expectations. Being at peace guards your heart to patiently walk with God into His greater purposes for you.Therefore, He first deals with the anxiety and worry. You cannot hear the Lord and not even be able to trust His direction when you are anxious. Anxiety and worry move you into faithlessness and doubt. God knows that when He is able to establish your heart in His peace, you can prevail over every challenge which comes your way.
No matter the challenge confronting you, let the PEACE OF GOD rule over your heart.
The enemy is not going to stop attacking your mind and heart. Even after you have dealt with your previous challenge, there is another challenge that is going to come your way. What the adversary wants is for you to live in worry, anxiety and sorrow. This is how he gets you distracted in the pursuit of destiny.
You walk in constant victory and are not moved by challenges when you allow His PEACE to permanently take over your heart. 
This is the main reason you have to pray.DIG DEEPER(Job 22:21; Psalm 29:11; 2 Thessalonians 3:16; John 16:33; Isaiah 26:3; Colossians 3:15) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord of peace Himself shall give you peace at all times and in every way. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANNahum 1-32 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The peace of God saturates my heart at all times. - I refuse to be anxious about anything. - I am tough on the inside; therefore, I remain calm at all times. - No situation has what it takes to change my composure. - I walk in constant victory.  Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1010 - LIFE IS SPIRITUAL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 29th, October, 2025 LIFE IS SPIRITUAL “For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places” Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)Basically, there are two realms of life. There is the spiritual realm and also the physical realm. The spiritual realm is the root of life’s essence and the physical is for the expression of life. The physical realm is the “seen realm”, while the spiritual realm is the “unseen realm”.By forensic observation of the material world, one may find the fingerprint of an unseen creator — God. Such fingerprint gives an idea of a realm which transcends this physical or material realm.“Opposition to truth cannot be excused on the basis of ignorance, because from the creation of the world, the invisible qualities of God’s nature have been made visible, such as his eternal power and transcendence. He has made his wonderful attributes easily perceived, for seeing the visible makes us understand the invisible. So then, this leaves everyone without excuse.” Romans 1:20 (TPT).This physical world came out of the Spiritual realm.
There is nothing you see in this world which doesn’t have its roots in the spirit.
“By faith we understand that the entire universe was formed at God’s command, that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen.”  Hebrews 11:3 (NLT)Therefore you must understand that things don’t just happen in this physical realm. There are spiritual forces which govern the affairs of men.And that explains why God didn’t make man to only be a physical being without spiritual essence. God designed man to have the ability to function both in the spirit and in this physical realm.“…Thus says the LORD, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him“. Zechariah 12:1 (NKJV)See this also:“Now, may the God of peace and harmony set you apart, making you completely holy. And may your entire being—spirit, soul, and body—be kept completely flawless in the appearing.” 1 Thessalonians 5:23 (TPT)
The spirit of man is the innermost or deepest part of man. It is designed for divine contact and divine consciousness.
It is mainly to have rich intimacy with God, for God is Spirit (John 4:24).Man has a body which serves as the vessel by which he can contact the material or tangible realm and also commune in it. It contains the outward organs of man’s being.However, God gave man a SOUL for man to effectively function in the spirit and in the physical realm.The Greek word for soul is “psuche”, from it, we have the English word psychology.
It is the conduit for our psychological perception. It is within your soul that you have your self-consciousness.
It contains your will, intellect (mind) and emotions. It serves as the intermediary between the spirit (which is for contacting God) and the body (which communicates with the outside world).Your spirit is for Divine or God consciousness, your soul possesses your self-consciousness and the body is for the physical consciousness.However, the spirit, the soul and the body have their roots and influences in the spirit; because all things issued out of the spirit. As physical as the body is, it also has a level of spiritual intelligence.
Also, you have to know that, anything that will find expression in your body must first take root in your spirit and soul.
Since all created things issued out of the spirit realm, whatever you contact in the physical realm through your body doesn’t just exist in the physical, they have their roots also in the spirit.For example:You watched a video clip; which may seem like a mere physical activity. But the video clip has a spiritual influence. Thus, before what you watched in the video will impact your life, it first travels into you to take root in your soul and spirit.The moment it takes root in your spirit and your soul, it will begin to have a strong influence in you and begin to bear its kind of fruits through you.Until you understand these, you will not be able to determine how to operate effectively in this physical world.Be conscious of what influences your life.
Beloved, LIFE IS SPIRITUAL!
Selah.DIG DEEPER(Genesis 1:2; Matthew 16:17; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; John 3:6; Mark 9:25; John 4:19-26 WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in the understanding of the function of our spiritual essence in this physical world.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANHabakkuk 1-32 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live my life from the realm of the spirit. – I am conscious of my spiritual essence. – I am a spirit led man. – I live an extraordinary life. – I increase daily in the understanding of the function of my spirituality. Oh Hallelujah![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1011 - HOW TO BE WHOLE OF ANY PLAGUE 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency  Thursday, 30th October, 2025 HOW TO BE WHOLE OF ANY PLAGUE 1"And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague." Mark 5:34 (KJV)Did you read the previous episode, LIFE IS SPIRITUAL?From the previous episode I wrote, you will understand that nothing just happens in this physical realm. The spiritual realm is the root and essence of all physical manifestation."...that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen.” Hebrews 11:3 (NLT)
The spiritual realm rules the physical realm.
Don't take your spirituality for granted.There are no accidents in this physical world which are not orchestrated by men (who are essentially spiritual) or other spiritual forces. Natural disasters are not as natural as people think. Activities and events in the physical realm are manipulated through the realm of the Spirit.Nothing just happens, from wars to plagues, festivals, advancements, infirmities, successes, buildings, etc, have their deep foundations in the spirit.And as children of God, we are given all the necessary tools to exercise ourselves in the spirit.
We are also given faith as the principle of God by which we are able to engage spiritual realities in the physical.
Faith is both objective and subjective. The objective of Faith is the person of Jesus. He is "the author and finisher of our faith" (Hebrews 12:2). This means faith is not first generated by us but is supplied to us as we received Jesus, who is the word of God. You operate in this physical realm by the faith which the Lord has supplied unto you. So Paul said, "...the life that I live now in the flesh, I live by the faith OF THE SON OF GOD..." (Galatians 2:20).Though your operation in the physical realm is by the faith of our Lord Jesus, you operate with this faith of Him according to the depths of your understanding of Him. It is this dimension of understanding of Him that is referred to as subjective faith. This was what Habakkuk spoke of in his prophetic writings:"...the just shall live by his faith" (Habakkuk 2:4)(To understand this matter of Objective Faith and Subjective Faith, GET YOUR COPY OF PHOTIZO, A Compendium of Eternal Verities). The subjective faith is your personal faith built on the supplied faith of God. This subjective faith is basically your personal level of understanding of what God has produced in you.When Jesus said to the woman with the issue of blood, "your faith has made you whole", he was speaking of her action based on the understanding she had in her heart concerning His person and ability.
Your spiritual understanding determines how you live and walk with God. Your understanding is your growth in faith.
You live whole of every plague by the faith at work in you or your growth in faith. And your faith is determined by your level of understanding. It is the revelational-light in you that determines how you walk in victory.The adversary will always exploit your ignorance.Any infirmity you have not been able to conquer is evidence of an unravelled mystery. This is why challenges and infirmities are operations of darkness. 
The moment you receive light and act in that light, the situation is demystified, darkness disappears, and you walk in wholeness.
That plague in your life cannot be uprooted by your anxiety. It is the steps you take with understanding that will usher you into wholeness.Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 John 5:20; Hebrews 11:3; Proverbs 3:5-6; Daniel 9:1-2; Exodus 33:13; Psalm 103:7; 1 Corinthians 2:12-14) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall gain a deep understanding of God and His way. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANHaggai 1-2Zechariah 12 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I walk in understanding. - I refuse to walk in the ignorance of the word. - I am a man of understanding. - My heart is deeply rooted in the understanding of God and His ways. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1012 - HOW TO BE WHOLE OF ANY PLAGUE 2
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 31st October, 2025 HOW TO BE WHOLE OF ANY PLAGUE 2"And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague." Mark 5:34 (KJV)You escape affliction or plague of the enemy and enjoy wholeness when you know what to do.Israel escaped the final plague of Egypt when they acted out God's instructions to mark their doorposts with the blood of a sacrificial lamb during the first Passover (which is Christ, click here to understand more).They were delivered because of the word of the Lord and the Mystery of Christ as the Lamb of God. The communication of God's word brings light.Every challenge is a wisdom problem. When understanding is granted solution is provided.Anytime Jesus spoke of anyone's faith, you will find these people demonstrating a deep understanding of a spiritual truth.
There is no manifestation of faith without spiritual understanding.
"When Jesus entered the village of Capernaum, a captain in the Roman army approached him, asking for a miracle. “Lord,” he said, “I have a son who is lying in my home, paralyzed and suffering terribly.”Jesus responded, “I will go with you and heal him.”But the Roman officer interjected, “Lord, who am I to have you come into my house? I understand your authority, for I too am a man who walks under authority and have authority over soldiers who serve under me. I can tell one to go and he’ll go, and another to come and he’ll come. I order my servants and they’ll do whatever I ask. So I know that all you need to do is to stand here and command healing over my son and he will be instantly healed.”Jesus was astonished when he heard this and said to those who were following him, “He has greater faith than anyone I’ve encountered in Israel!" Matthew 8:5-10 (TPT)Clearly from this story, Jesus was ready to go to the house of this Roman captain. However, this captain didn't think the terrible plague afflicting his son was higher than the authority of Jesus. His faith wasn't just that he believed Jesus could heal his son. He didn't see Jesus as another great physician. His faith was centered on the revelation of the person of Jesus. 
His understanding of the person of Jesus helped him understand the greatness of Jesus' authority.
The Lord sees anyone who is able to recognize His Divine and Messianic Authority as one with great faith. He is not amazed when you think he can heal the sick. He acknowledges every understanding of the revelation of His person as a deep spiritual understanding.Whenever people didn't see the revelation of His person, He was also astonished and saw it as great unbelief. It is not about being aware that He heals the sick, it's always about seeing, understanding and honouring the reality of His person.In Mark 5, Jesus worked a great miracle among those who saw the revelation of His person. Later in chapter 6 of Mark, He left Capernaum and returned with his disciples to Nazareth, his hometown. On the Sabbath, he went to teach in the synagogue. These people were overwhelmed and astonished by Jesus' teachings, wisdom and mighty miracles.But they did not acknowledge the true revelation of His person. They only saw an ordinary human being or Jew. They didn't see the Messiah, but saw a son of Mary who is the carpenter, the brother of Jacob, Joseph, Judah, and Simon, and the one whose sisters all live with them in Nazareth. These people despised Jesus and even took offense at him. (See Mark 6:1-3)Jesus said to them, “A prophet is treated with honor everywhere except in his own hometown, among his relatives, and in his own house.” He was unable to do any great miracle in Nazareth, except to heal a few sick people by laying his hands upon them. He was amazed at the depth of their unbelief!" Mark 6:4-6 (TPT)Not seeing the true revelation of the person of Jesus is a great depth of unbelief. Anyone who has a deeper understanding of the revelation of Jesus is seen as one with great faith.
No plague can withstand your deepest understanding of the revelation of Jesus.
The revelation of Jesus brings you into the consciousness of your participation with God. It makes you take advantage of His authority and all that He has supplied to you. Your pursuit shouldn't be centered on the answers you need, but the understanding of His person. For in this understanding, you enjoy the fullness of Him.Pay attention to Jesus' response to the Roman Captain in Matthew 8:"Jesus was astonished when he heard this and said to those who were following him, “He has greater faith than anyone I’ve encountered in Israel! Listen to what I am about to tell you. Multitudes of non-Jewish people will stream from the east and the west, to enter into the banqueting feast with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the heavenly kingdom...Then Jesus turned to the Roman officer and said, “Go home. All that you have believed for will be done for you!” And his son was healed at that very moment." Matthew 8:10-1, 13 (TPT)What was the greater faith of the Roman captain? It was His revelation of the person and authority of Jesus.And that spiritual understanding was the grounds for the wholeness of his son from that terrible affliction.
Beloved, your understanding of Jesus must grow deep.
The depths of your understanding of who He is will set you up in the heights of greater manifestations.When the revelation of Jesus is treated as a common thing, you will run around for many external devices. And anyone who treats the revelation of Jesus as a common thing has not yet received a deeper understanding of Him.
You live whole of every plague by the depths of understanding of the revelation of Jesus.
Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 John 5:20; Exodus 33:13; John 6:26; Luke 18:35-43; 1 Corinthians 2:12-14) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall behold the deeper revelation of the person of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANZechariah 2-42 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in understanding. – I refuse to walk in the ignorance of the word. – I am a man of understanding. – My heart is deeply rooted in the understanding of God and His ways. – I behold the deeper revelation of the person of Jesus. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1013 - FAITH REQUIRES AN AUDACIOUS POSTURE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Saturday, 1st November, 2025 FAITH REQUIRES AN AUDACIOUS POSTURE“Abraham never wavered in believing God’s promise. In fact, his faith grew stronger, and in this he brought glory to God.” Romans 4:20 (NLT)To have faith is to have absolute confidence in God. Faith doesn’t doubt!This is why faith cannot fail. It is not confidence in things; it is confidence in the source and creator of all things—GOD!
The faith that works is not self-confidence. The faith of God is confidence in God.
It is not merely about being enthusiastic or having vim. It is to be bold or audacious. The confidence in God makes you dare to take steps the normal mind wouldn’t dare to take.The word of God is supernatural. Whatever God says is not limited to the optics. The word of God produces extraordinary results. 
To act on the word requires an audacious or daring posture.
Abraham didn’t automatically walk in the fulfillment of the word of God. He acted in faith. Abraham dared to believe what God said.“We call Abraham “father” not because he got God’s attention by living like a saint, but because God made something out of Abraham when he was a nobody. Isn’t that what we’ve always read in Scripture, God saying to Abraham, “I set you up as father of many peoples”? Abraham was first named “father” and then became a father because he dared to trust God to do what only God could do: raise the dead to life, with a word make something out of nothing. When everything was hopeless, Abraham believed anyway, deciding to live not on the basis of what he saw he couldn’t do but on what God said he would do. And so he was made father of a multitude of peoples. God himself said to him, “You’re going to have a big family, Abraham!” Romans 4:17-18 (Message).Faith has to be daring because it is to act on what God has said against every hopeless situation. Whatever God says contradicts what you may see, experience or feel. God’s word contradicts your present situation; thus, you must dare to act on it, so that you can lay hold on the miracle.Against every opposing or contradicting voice, you must remain resolute and confident in what God has said.
Faith dares to stand on God’s word no matter the storm.
BE DARING!Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAYWe pray that our confidence in God shall increase by the day so that we dare to believe what God says and act it out. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANZechariah 5-72 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strong and courageous. – My faith works. – I am audacious in faith. – I dare to stand on God’s word no matter the storm. – I am daring. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1014 - LIVING UNTO HIS GLORY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Sunday, 2nd November, 2025 LIVING UNTO HIS GLORY“Whether you eat or drink, live your life in a way that glorifies and honors God.”1 Corinthians 10:31 (TPT)For some days now I have been drumming this matter of faith into your heart (that is, if you have been consistent with the with ).And today I want to admonish you on this reality of living unto the glory of God.
As you are in Christ, it is imperative for you to live beyond your interest or satisfaction. Whatever you do must not be according to your will or desire but unto God’s glory and honor.
 The question is:How does what you do GLORIFY GOD?As you are in Christ you must emulate Him.Your daily life, your speech, and your conduct must bring glory to God and honor to Him, just as Jesus did.How do you Honor or bring Glory to God?1. SET YOUR HEART ON GODWhatever you do for the Lord must be inspired by your inward devotion, and accompanied by purity of heart. True honor and glory begin from within. Jesus addressing the hypocritical Jews said:“You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you, for he wrote: “‘These people honor me with their lips, but their heart is far from me;” Matthew 15:7-8 (NLT).Don’t attempt to just honor the Lord with your lips and deep in your heart, you are far from Him. This means genuine honor to God begins with your personal relationship with God.
Until you set your heart right towards the Lord anything you do will be of the flesh and will not be reckoned as honor to the Lord.
Whatever you do must be hewn out of your love for the Lord. Your love for the Lord must be with all of your heart.“And he said to him, Have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind. This is the first and greatest rule” (Matthew 22:37-38)2.  THROUGH OBEDIENCE TO GOD’S COMMANDJesus honored and glorified God by obeying the Lord.Through Christ Jesus, we have the ability to walk in obedience. You don’t obey God by your efforts. You walk in obedience to God’s word and command according to His ability which is in you.
God is in you to work through you unto His glory.
“For it is [not your strength, but it is] God who is effectively at work in you, both to will and to work [that is, strengthening, energizing, and creating in you the longing and the ability to fulfill your purpose] for His good pleasure.“ Philippians 2:13 (AMP)This is why you must understand the will of God. The will of God is encapsulated in the scriptures. The word of God embodies His will.To obey God is to act according to His word. This is not a difficult task; for you are born of the word in Christ (1 Peter 1:23).
Your obedience to God is also a product of God’s worth in your heart. And this demonstrates how you glorify Him.
One of the key commandments Jesus gave to every believer is in Mark 16:15:“And then he told them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to everyone” (NLT)This is not a suggestion, but a command from Jesus.To obey this commandment of Jesus is to honor and glorify God. That was how Jesus demonstrated the glory of the Father. He preached and got many saved. Jesus called it the work of the Father (John 9:4).
It is the desire of God to get many saved (1 Timothy 2:4). And as you participate in this great desire of the Father, you honor and glorify Him.
Beloved, Jesus said, “If you love me, you will keep my commandment” (John 14:15). This brings glory and honor to the Father.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:17; 1 Peter 4:11; Hebrews 13:21; 1 Samuel 15:22; Psalm 19:14; Psalm 119:60) WE PRAY– That we shall glorify and honor the Lord through our obedience to His word and will with the integrity of our hearts.– That by the wisdom of God we shall know how to honor the Lord through our obedience to the command of the Lord to preach the gospel to many and get them saved.In the glorious name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANZechariah 8-102 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live beyond my interest and satisfaction.– Whatever I do, I do unto the glory and honor of God. – My life is for the glory of God. – I do all things with the love for God. –  I walk in obedience to God’s word. Oh Hallelujah!!![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1015 - HOW TO BE WHOLE OF ANY PLAGUE 3
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Monday, 3rd November, 2025 HOW TO BE WHOLE OF ANY PLAGUE 3"And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague." Mark 5:34 (KJV)From previous episodes of this series, I mentioned that your growth in faith is dependent on your understanding.Your understanding of the revelation of Jesus determines your manifestation of faith.Your understanding of the Lord must grow deep. The depths of your understanding of who He is will set you up in the heights of glory.
Anyone whose faith was spoken of by Jesus had a deeper understanding of the revelation of His person.
We already looked at the faith of the Roman captain (in Matthew 8), whose faith was built on his revelation of who Jesus is and His authority. Jesus was astonished by the faith of this Roman captain.Always remember that there is no faith without the knowledge and understanding of God's revelation. Even the patriarchs, as mentioned in Hebrews 11, didn't generate faith out of nothing, but exercised their faith according to God's revelation.This is how you step out of a crisis, challenge or plague. It doesn't matter what the situation is; the level of your revelation will influence your faith and will bring forth the miracle.There is an amazing reality about the woman with the issue of blood."Now there was a woman who had been suffering from chronic bleeding for twelve years. Although she had endured a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all of her money, she had not been helped at all, but rather grew worse. Since she had heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his robe, because she had been saying, “If I can just touch his robe, I will get well.” Her bleeding stopped at once, and she felt in her body that she was healed from her illness. Immediately Jesus became aware that power had gone out of him. So he turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?” His disciples asked him, “You see the crowd jostling you, and yet you ask, ‘Who touched me?’” But he kept looking around to look at the woman who had done this. So the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came forward fearfully, fell down trembling in front of him, and told him the whole truth. He told her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace and be healed from your illness.” Mark 5:25-34 (International Standard Version)The healing miracle of this lady wasn't just about touching Jesus' garment. Her faith was according to a certain understanding of the revelation of Jesus in her heart.There were many others who were also touching Jesus' garment, yet the scriptures didn't record anyone receiving a miracle at that moment. This lady knew something the others didn't overlook.She understood Malachi 4:2, "But for you who fear my name, the Sun of Righteousness will rise with healing in his wings. And you will go free, leaping with joy like calves let out to pasture." (New Living Translation)The prophetic language in Malachi wasn't new to the Jews. They understood that it wasn't about the literal sun, but about the Messiah. And the wings, as mentioned in the verse, weren't literal wings, and neither was it just about the picture of the wings of a bird stretched across the sky.The word "wings" is from the Hebrew word "kânâph", which means an edge or extremity or borders, specifically of a bird or army, which is a wing. Now it is also the word for the edge or borders of a garment or bedclothing.What is referred to as the fringe of a garment is also known as the wing of a garment.Take note of the Lord's instruction to the Jews concerning their garments:"Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:"And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:" Numbers 15:38-39 (KJV)From Numbers 15:38, you will find two words, "fringes" and "borders". The word "fringes" is from the Hebrew word "tsîytsith", which also means a floral or wing-like projection that is a forelock of hair, or a tassel. And the word "borders" is the same Hebrew word, "kânâph", as used in Malachi 4:2.Thus, the Lord instructed that at the borders (wings) or edge or hem of every Jew's garments, they are to make fringes. And interestingly, in verse 39 of Numbers 15, when the Israelites look upon the fringes of their garments, they shall remember His commandments.Now in Malachi 4:2, the prophet pointed out that the Sun of Righteousness, who is the Messiah, shall have HEALING or medicine in the fringes of His garment, and it shall set people who revere Him free, and they shall go forth with joy.The woman with the issue of blood didn't just touch Jesus. She specifically touches the fringe of His garment. Definitely, she understood something. Did she touch just the fringe of every man's garment? No!She recognized and revered Jesus as the Sun of Righteousness. She had in her heart the revelation of Jesus as the Messiah and knew that as long as He is the Messiah (the Sun of Righteousness), His wings, the fringes or tassel of His garments, will have healing."And behold, a woman who had suffered from a discharge of blood for twelve years came up behind him and touched the fringe of his garment" Matthew 9:20 (ESV)Every miracle unveiled the revelation of Jesus as the Messiah.Within your present challenge and crisis, just set your heart on the Lord. And His rays shall shine on you as the rays of the Sun at its rising.No matter the plague you are afflicted with, set your eyes on the Lord. This does not fail, no matter the circumstances in and around your life.
The goal of the adversary is to shift your focus away from the Lord and to make your heart faint through His false and evil projections.
When the Israelites were afflicted by serpents in the wilderness, God's response to Moses' prayer was a revelation of Jesus.Who is the Lord to you?What revelation of Him do you have in your heart?It is His revelation that will bring you into the abundant joy of liberty.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Numbers 21:4-9; 1 John 5:20; Exodus 33:13; John 6:26; Luke 18:35-43; 1 Corinthians 2:12-14) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall receive the right revelation and understanding of the Lord, which shall cause us to walk in total victory and freedom from every matter or challenge confronting us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANZechariah 11-132 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in understanding. – I refuse to walk in the ignorance of the word. – I am a man of understanding. – My heart is deeply rooted in the understanding of God and His ways. – I behold the deeper revelation of the person of Jesus. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1016 - LIVE ABOVE FACTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency One of the greatest causes of weakness in the pursuit of God’s purpose is FEAR. The moment you become afraid that you will fail or will not be able to complete the task, you weaken yourself from doing what God wants you to do. Beloved, refuse to FEAR as you submit to the Lord for Strength. Selah. Author Tuesday, 4th October, 2025 LIVE ABOVE FACTS“In spite of being nearly one hundred years old when the promise of having a son was made, his faith was so strong that it could not be undermined by the fact that he and Sarah were incapable of conceiving a child.” Romans 4:19 (TPT)To be born again is to be born from above. Which means you live a higher life. Every life is governed by a law. The higher life of God or the life from above is lived by faith. Faith is the law that causes you to live in the frequency of God.Thus, without faith, it is impossible to please God (Hebrews 11:6).Though faith is a spiritual law it is lived in the natural.The life of faith lived in the natural is the supernatural life.“…the life that I live now in the flesh, I live by the faith of the son of God…” (Galatians 2:20).
The believer in Christ lives by faith in the natural realm.
You should note that the natural realm also has its own laws. These laws rule and determine how things work. When you know and understand these natural laws you can use them to your advantage.It is God who sets these laws in place. The law of thermodynamics, the law of sound and light, the law of motion, electricity and gravity, etc. serve mankind.These laws also come with limitations. Thus, to operate above these laws you must know how to activate a higher law. Sometimes the understanding of laws can cause another law to even work in your favor instead of limiting you.Though there is the law of gravity, the law or force of buoyancy causes hot-air balloons or blimps to float in the air.The law of faith is a higher law which operates above natural laws. It also causes other laws to work together to produce the expected results.The law of faith doesn’t deny the facts. The reason faith has to be released is because of the facts. 
A man of faith has an awareness of the facts but doesn’t allow the power of the facts to rule over him.
As you can see in the opening verse, Abraham had awareness of their physical condition and limitations but did not allow their condition to undermine the word of God.So you may have a health challenge in your body, don’t first assume or pretend the challenge doesn’t exist. 
Faith doesn’t pretend but rather faces the challenge with the word of God.
You may feel a sudden sharp pain in your leg. Don’t say by faith I don’t feel any pain.The first thing you have to do is to first release your faith through words. You speak to the challenge or speak to the pain, by commanding its cause to get out of your body.Now speaking to it means, you are aware that the pain is there but the pain and its cause don’t have power over you.You must continue to speak the word of God to it till you have the full conviction that the pain is gone by faith. At this level, you may still feel the pain, but because you have first released the word and addressed it you can now say the pain is gone.This was what God did with Abraham and Sarah. God was aware that Abraham and Sarah were childless. He didn’t first ignore the situation. He first released His word to Abraham that He shall have a child and be a father of many nations.After the word was released Abraham now settled his heart and mind on the word of the Lord. He made the word his victory note and stood on that word that he is a father of many nations. He continued to live in it daily till the manifestation of the word.Do you feel sick in your body?Identify the situation and then release the word of God to it and begin to walk in the word. As you now walk in the word by faith, you no longer accept the facts. You continue confidently in the word of God.
Beloved, live above the facts by faith.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 11; 2 Chronicles 20:16-24 (NCV); Matthew 21:21) WE PRAYWe pray and release the word of God into that troubling situation that by the power of God there will be total change in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANZechariah 14Malachi 1-22 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live by faith against all odds. – I refuse to allow the power of any fact to have rule over me, rather I walk in the word of God. – I live by faith. – My confidence is in the word of God. – The word of God has power over me. Oh! Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1017 - GREAT FAITH IS BY THE REVELATION OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Wednesday, 5th, November, 2025 GREAT FAITH IS BY THE REVELATION OF JESUS“For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed, both springing from faith and leading to faith [disclosed in a way that awakens more faith]. As it is written and forever remains written, “The just and upright shall live by faith.” Romans 1:17 (Amplified)Faith is only imparted through the knowledge of God.
Any other body of knowledge which contradicts the knowledge of God does not produce faith.
Every word of God to you is to dispense faith into your heart.Precisely, the complete knowledge of God was revealed through Jesus.Thus, the Gospel of our Lord Jesus awakens and imparts great faith into your heart.
The Gospel or the Goodnews of Jesus is the revelation of the rich knowledge and unsearchable wisdom of God.
For example:One of the glorious realities of Christ the Gospel announces is that: You are the righteousness of God in Christ.“For God made the only one who did not know sin to become sin for us, so that we who did not know righteousness might become the righteousness of God through our union with him.” 2 Corinthians 5:21 (TPT).The Goodnews concerning you, being made the righteousness of God in Christ establishes you in the fullness of faith. The knowledge of the righteousness of Christ in you, dismantles and disables every thought of fear and condemnation.As we have seen in the opening verse, the Goodnews of Jesus dispensed faith into you to believe and receive His life. This also brings you into the participation of the righteousness of God in Christ. The more you behold this Goodnews of being made the righteousness of God in Christ, the more you awaken and advance in faith.So, whiles the law of Moses unveils your weakness and unrighteousness, the Gospel unveils how God has made you righteous in Christ.The law of Moses brings you to the consciousness of how you cannot become righteous. It makes you see the emptiness of your self effort.
Through the Gospel, you become conscious of what God has done for you in Christ; and this causes you to increase and advance in faith.
“if indeed you continue to advance in faith, assured of a firm foundation to grow upon. Never be shaken from the hope of the gospel you have believed in. And this is the glorious news I preach all over the world.” Colossians 1:23 (TPT)Your faith is as a result of what you keep hearing. Your faith in Christ is dependent on the hearing of the Gospel; and you continue to increase and advance in faith when you remain resolute on the hope of the Gospel. The moment you turn away from the hope of the Gospel you create space for doubt.
Set your heart and mind on the revelation of Jesus, and you will walk in great faith.
HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Romans 3:21; 2 Corinthians 5:17; Habakkuk 2:4; Ephesians 4:21; Colossians 2:7; Hebrews 13:9) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will continue to remain resolute on the hope of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMalachi 3-52 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:–  My faith is rooted in the knowledge of God’s word. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ. – My mind and heart is set on the revelation of Jesus. – I walk in great faith. – I walk daily in the consciousness of this reality. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1018 - THE FOUNDATION OF THE CHURCH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Thursday 6th, November 2025 THE FOUNDATION OF THE CHURCH “…I will build my Church and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.”Matthew 16:18The Church is the Lord’s legislative assembly and victorious army to establish the order of the Kingdom and confront the helm of darkness.The Church is not called to hide in the pews hoping that the habitations of darkness will automatically be saturated with light. The Church is mandated to march on towards the dark places of the earth. And every believer must be involved.Though the adversary is defeated and rendered powerless, he utilizes his deceptive schemes to wage war against the Church. He keeps plotting and strategizing to prevent the invasion of the Church in dark places. Part of his schemes is to attack the saints with demonic projectiles.These projectiles target the faith of the saints.
The adversary uses flammable arrows or spears which are deceptive thoughts, to crush the confidence of the saints in who God is, His love and what He has accomplished for the saints in Christ Jesus.
But God who is a master strategist has given the Church, the SHIELD OF FAITH. And as we looked at it yesterday, the Church has to march forward towards the gates of darkness, with the testudo shield formation.We must march forward in the unity of faith which is built on the revelation of Jesus.“Meanwhile, live in such a way that you are a credit to the Message of Christ. Let nothing in your conduct hang on whether I come or not. Your conduct must be the same whether I show up to see things for myself or hear of it from a distance. Stand united, singular in vision, contending for people’s trust in the Message, the good news, not flinching or dodging in the slightest before the opposition. Your courage and unity will show them what they’re up against: defeat for them, victory for you – and both because of God.“ Philippians 1:27-28 (Message).
The unity of the spirit and faith are not slogans but functional strategies of the Lord for His Church.
We must stand together with oneness of vision and purpose for the Lord’s Kingdom. The more the saints live by a singular vision, the more we stand united to contend for the faith of others. The courage to shield up together in faith is a great threat to the schemes of the enemy.Don’t weigh in on things that bring division among the saints. Don’t set your gaze on your self-gratification or interests. 
The adversary will use your self-interests or self-centered pleasures and displeasure as weapons against the harmony of the Church. 
Uphold the revelation of Jesus (above your opinions and interests), for it is the foundation upon which the Church is built.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:1-9; Philippians 2:1-5; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that anything which amplifies the self above the revelation of Jesus shall be quenched. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 2-42 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I stand together in the oneness of heart with the brethren as conquerors in the faith of the gospel. – I build strength in faith together with the brethren to extinguish every fiery dart of the enemy. – I don’t fail to hold on to my shield of faith. – I take a stand with the saints in the word and prayer as we enforce our victory in Christ. – I don’t isolate myself from the brethren no matter the challenge which confronts me. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your victory.

title: EPISODE 1019 - STOP ACTING LIKE A CIVILIAN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Friday, 7th November, 2025STOP ACTING LIKE A CIVILIAN “This is war, and there is no neutral ground. If you’re not on my side, you’re the enemy; if you’re not helping, you’re making things worse.” Matthew 12:30 (Message Bible) When you became born again, you were not only conveyed into the Kingdom of the Son of His love (Colossians 1:13); you were also made a king and a priest (Revelation 1:6), through Christ Jesus.
You have the mandate to dispel the influence of darkness in all places, by shining out the light of the gospel.
And you must do this with a mindset of a soldier. God made you a king-priest and enlisted you to be a soldier in His army. This assignment is war, and you cannot approach it with the mindset of a civilian. Observe Paul’s statement to Timothy:“Thou, therefore, endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” 2 Timothy 2:3-4 (KJV). There are some few items to outline from these two verses:i. You are chosen by God as a good (Victorious) soldier of Jesus Christ.ii. As a soldier you must endure hardships.The Passion translation puts it this way:” Overcome every form of evil as a victorious soldier of Jesus the Anointed One“.Which means we overcome or endure because we already have the victory in Christ Jesus. We are waging war from the victory we have received in Christ Jesus.iii. As a man of war, you don’t live as a civilian.“No man that warreth; entangleth himself with the affairs of this life” And that is how you will please the Lord who enlisted you.As you are called to active duty of a soldier, you have to divorce yourself from the distractions and ordinary business of this life.Concentrate on carrying out divine orders.
As a soldier of Christ in the Lord’s army, your first priority is the mandate of the kingdom.
You are a kinging soldier and God’s weapon of war against the kingdoms and the systems which set themselves against the Lord. Beloved, you are part of the Lord’s army. These are the Lord’s words to you dearly beloved; “You are my battle-ax and sword,” says the LORD. “With you I will shatter nations and destroy many kingdoms. With you I will shatter armies— destroying the horse and rider, the chariot and charioteer” Jeremiah 51:20-21 (NLT).
As a soldier in the Lord’s army and weapon of war, you don’t function by your selfish cravings; submit yourself to His will.
He works in you both to will and to do. You don’t operate by your strength in the flesh. The Lord supplies you with His strength unto His ordained good works. Therefore, live your life empowered by God’s free-flowing grace, which is your true strength, found in the anointing of Jesus and your union with Him! (2 Timothy 2:1) Live daily with this ultimate consciousness that you are part of the Lord’s army as you enjoy the supply of His strength in doing great things. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:8-39; Judges 7; 1 Corinthians 9:19-27; 2 Timothy 4:5; 1 Timothy 1:18) WE PRAYThat the Lord will teach our hands to make war and the skill to take strategic steps which will make us get ministerial results. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 5-72 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am enlisted in the Lord’s army. Therefore, I don’t function as a civilian. – I am God’s weapon of war. – I am committed to the mandate of the kingdom. – I discipline myself to live as a victorious soldier of Christ. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1020 - DESIRE TO KNOW THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Get to work quickly and energetically. Don’t delay with that giving. Don’t delay with the outreach plan. Don’t delay with those great ideas. Shalom. Author Saturday, 8th November, 2025DESIRE TO KNOW THE LORD“The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.”Proverbs 15:14 (KJV)To a carnal mind or a natural man, the pursuit of general or scientific knowledge seems not to be as tedious as pursuing the knowledge of God.
To attempt to seek the knowledge of God through sensual efforts is as attempting to get blood from stone.
When you attempt to use your natural comprehensive ability, the knowledge of God remains mystical. It is like attempting to inject the complex data of the universe with its estimated trillion galaxies of stars and atoms in the cerebrum of a child.No amount of surfing on the internet or even the use of artificial intelligence will bring you into the knowledge of God.In as much as God’s wisdom and knowledge are deep and His ways are unfathomable and untraceable (Romans 11:33), He wants to be known and enjoyed by His children.You don’t know God by the flesh, for God is Spirit.
To seek after the knowledge of God requires the passionate diligence of the heart.
God wants to be known and to be made known. He doesn’t want to remain mystical, thus, He revealed Himself through His Son, Jesus.The knowledge of God is the answer to man’s quandary.The true knowledge of God in you is the germination of the Divine LIFE.“Eternal life means to know and experience you as the only true God, and to know and experience Jesus Christ, as the Son whom you have sent” John 17:3 (TPT)If there should be anything you will desire in life, it should be that you will intimately know the Lord and behold Him in His splendor. Your personal knowledge of God launches you into the mastery of life.To intimately know the Lord you must first DESIRE to enjoy His presence. It is in your communion with Him that brings you into His unsearchable riches of wisdom and knowledge.
You cannot know God outside His person.
See what the Psalmist said:“One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.” Psalm 27:4 (KJV)Let’s look at it in the Message Translation:“I’m asking God for one thing, only one thing:To live with him in his house my whole life long. I’ll contemplate his beauty; I’ll study at his feet.” Oh glory to God.Your personal and intimate relationship with God, grants you opportunity to study at His feet. The Lord will show you hidden things. The life of the scriptures will come alive in your heart.
The good news is that, we have access to God through Christ. God now lives in us and we live in Him by Christ Jesus.
Your challenge is not to access God. Your challenge is to intentionally commune with the Lord.This is how you journey into the knowledge of God.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 10:42; Psalm.27:8; Psalm.24:5-6; 1 Chronicles 16:11; John 8:31-32; Proverbs 18:15) WE PRAY We pray our hearts shall always burn to dwell and enjoy the Lord’s presence. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase daily in the desire to grow in the deep rich knowledge of God.– I grow daily in the knowledge of Jesus as I feast on the word. – As I behold and know the Lord Jesus through the scriptures, I experience the transcending glory of God. – I am full of the knowledge of Christ.  Oh thank you Lord Jesus![mailpoet_form id="1"]

title: EPISODE 1021 - THE CODE OF PRIESTHOOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency God is not looking for the opportunity to condemn you. He wants you to experience His love and saving grace. Beloved, when you come to appreciate His love, you will unforcefully and restfully reverence and express His Love. Shalom! Author Sunday, 9th November, 2025 THE CODE OF PRIESTHOOD “With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified)The scriptures emphasize the need for prayer. We see the importance of prayer through the life and testimonies of the Biblical patriarchs, prophets, priests, kings, servants, soldiers, wives, husbands, widows, the rich, the poor, the distressed, the victorious, farmers, physicians, craftsmen, builders, fishermen, prime ministers, scribes, prisoners, eunuchs, sinners, apostles, the youths and the adults or the old.
Prayer is not for some specific people. Both the small and the great are all called to prayer.
From the scriptures and the epistles, we are charged to pray at all times, in every place or everywhere and without ceasing.Jesus shared a parable to this end, “men ought always to pray and not faint” (Luke 18:1).Prayer is a demonstration of faith and confidence in God.Prayer is essential in this spiritual warfare as a Priest. It is an advanced technology given to us by God, to stay in touch with the military command post or control center.
