Unceasing prayer gives access to unceasing mission plans and strategies.
This was David’s main battle strategy. He was always in touch with God at every battle, so he always knew what to do on the battlefield. While the enemies were strategizing, David was in touch with God, who knows and sees all things.You don’t fight against unseen evil forces, principalities, powers, or rulers of dark places and not be consistent in prayer at all times.It is dangerous to be a soldier and not be in touch with your military headquarters.In ancient times, Roman soldiers were always in communication with their command base.Orders were given via horns, drums, movement of flags and riders on horseback.Not staying in touch with military orders can be disastrous for a soldier.
How are you waging spiritual warfare without praying at all times?
You must also understand that prayer is one of the mediums we prove that we are submitted to God.Anything you are not praying about is not under God’s rule and dominion.When you pray, you bring everything or situation under God’s rule.
You must pray all prayers and pray always in the Spirit.
Beloved, your priesthood in Christ is a matter of your communion with the High Priest (Jesus).Therefore, you cannot execute your duties and mandate a Priest without Prayer.This is how you walk in possibilities!Selah.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:6; Psalm 116:2; 1 Thessalonians 5:17; Psalm 86:3; Romans 12:12; Colossians 4:2) WE PRAY We pray that the Lord will give us the direction this day so that we will know what to do and the steps to take to accomplish His assignment for us as Priests. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 11-132 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As a Priest, I wage spiritual warfare through prayer. – I pray always in the spirit. – Through prayer I see possibilities. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1022 - NO MATTER THE STORM, TAKE HOLD OF THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter the negative plots of the enemy to stop you from manifesting God’s great plan for you, He is graciously leading you into the fulfillment of His great purpose. Maintain trust in Him through the process. He is working it out for your good. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 10th November, 2025 NO MATTER THE STORM, TAKE HOLD OF THE LORD“And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.”1 Samuel 30:6 (English Standard Version)Dear avid reader, I appreciate your consistency in following and fellowshipping with this Christ-centered online devotional.The messages shared here (on  with ) are to help you know the application of the word of God in your daily life. You don’t just get to know what to do, but you are also taught how to do what to do.It is important for every believer to know and understand the word of God. Your understanding of the word of God helps you live victoriously.You have to take this teaching to heart and commit everything shared to action. You wouldn’t see its potency until you begin to act out the word.I want to admonish you today on the reality of Strengthening yourself in the Lord.
To strengthen yourself in the Lord is not burdensome nor is it legalistic.
To strengthen yourself in the Lord is to take advantage of the resources of the Lord to mount up high above the challenge confronting you.It is turning to the Lord and not turning to oneself. In David’s situation, he was already in distress but decided to strengthen himself in the LORD.Sometimes you may feel your situation is worse and you have already sunk deep in discouragement or depression and defeat where nothing could be done.The scripture says, “For “WHOEVER CALLS ON THE NAME OF THE LORD [in prayer] WILL BE SAVED.” Romans 10:13 (Amplified Bible).It is not only those who are yet to be defeated or yet to fall deeply into depression that the Lord saves. It is whosoever or everyone who calls upon the Lord.
It doesn’t matter your situation, when you call upon the Lord, you shall be saved.
David was already in distress, yet he made a decision to strengthen Himself in the Lord.Now let me put it right:David was GREATLY DISTRESSED.That’s what the scriptures say. David wasn’t just distressed. Which means he was utterly shattered.“David was in even worse trouble” (Message Translation).In fact, David and his men burst out in loud wails—wept and wept until they were exhausted with weeping.“David was greatly distressed…” (AMPC).“David was in desperation” (CEV)‘David wasn’t in shallow situation, he “was in deep trouble” (Common English Bible).“David too was in anguish” (VOICE)“David was seriously worried, for in their bitter grief for their children, his men began talking of killing him. But David took strength from the Lord.” (TLB)Just in case you find yourself in a worse situation you can still trust the Lord. You can draw strength from the Lord. Don’t assume there is no faith in you or you are faithless because you wept or felt distressed. Not all men have faith, but all those in Christ have faith. There is the faith of God in you. By that faith no matter how small you think it is, you can take hold of God’s hand. All that God is looking for is for you to stretch forth your hand for His help.As Peter noticed he was drowning or sinking, he shouted master save me.
Beloved there is help for you. Strengthen yourself in the Lord.
The word STRENGTHEN as used in 1 Samuel 30:6, is from the Hebrew word “CHÂZAQ” (Pronounced as khaw-zak’)The primitive root of this Hebrew word means, “to fasten upon; to bind or restrain”. It also means to “cleave, catch or lay hold or take hold and also to seize”.Which means to strengthen yourself in the Lord is to bind or fasten yourself to the Lord. Don’t allow the flood of your challenge to drown you. Fasten yourself to the Lord who is the solid Rock.
No matter the storm, take hold of the Lord.
The word “châzaq”, to be strengthened in Hebrew also means, “to cure, to repair, to amend or mend”. This implies that, sometimes the challenge may break you, but when you turn to the Lord, you can repair all the broken pieces.To châzaq also means to have a calker.To be strengthened by the Lord is like a ship which has skilled shipwrights or calkers, who repair or stop the seams of a deck.In the ancient Gebal or Byblos (a city in Phoenicia, located in what is now modern-day Lebanon) they had shipwrights or master shipbuilders, who when employed on a ship, serve as calkers. They are furnished mariners who skilfully service all the various furniture in a vessel. (Ezekiel 27:9). They repair and help damaged ships to sail successfully.These ancients of Gebal are also called “stoppers of chinks” or “strengtheners”.Which means the strength of the Lord, serves as a shipwright. It stops all chinks or repairs every form of damage.
To strengthen yourself in the Lord also means to be strong in the Lord, taking advantage of all the mighty power of God. It is to amass the military might of God to your favor.
That was what David did.He was in distress because of the attack by the Amalekites, and he reminded himself that He has God.There is this courage and valiant posture you take on when you know what it means to have help from the Lord.David paused and would have thought to himself: “Why am I in tears? Is the God who helped me defeat Goliath, not my God any more? Why am I dismayed?”David thought of what the torrent flow of God’s power can do.He was encouraged. It was these moments that inspired David to sing Psalm 18:1-50.
When you fasten yourself to the Lord you become courageous and fortified.
That is what châzaq also means. To be strengthened in the Lord is to wax mightily, to be programmed to conquer, and to have a restraining force for victory.No matter the pressure you remain firm or obstinate in the Lord. You become too hard to break and maintain an undisturbed composure.
Beloved, strengthen or fortify yourself in the Lord.
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 18; Ephesians 6:10; Psalm 28:8; Psalm 18:2; 1 Samuel 23:16) WE PRAYPray:1. that every damage or leakage caused by the pressures of life within your emotions and mind will be mended by the strengthening ability of the Lord.2. calling upon the Lord for His mighty help even as you feel distressed. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 14-162 YEARS PLAN1 Kings 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God in my inner man at all times.– I have the strength to surmount every challenge. – No challenge or situation can dominate my life. – Through the supply of the strength of God, I sail through every challenge victoriously. – I don’t loose strength. – Greater is He that is in me, than any challenge that is in the world. – Through prayer, I engage the energies of God within me. – I have strength! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for enabling me with strength in my inner man.

title: EPISODE 1023 - NONE OF THESE THINGS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The adversary will not relent from attempting to exploit you. He will always come at you till you believe he is more powerful, the victory of the Lord is not true and you are powerless. Meanwhile, his goal is to use you as an instrument against the Lord and His purpose. Don’t fall for it! Author Tuesday 11th, November, 2025 NONE OF THESE THINGS“And David said, “What have I done now? Is there not a cause?” 1 Samuel 17:29 (NKJV)We are in times where the forces and entities of darkness are strategically advancing their cause in every place. They know the appearing of the Lord is near and their time of destruction is at hand as the world is coming to an end.All things are consummating.
God is wrapping up His eternal plan. Therefore, the devil is moving faster ahead of his time to sway off many believers and to destroy more destinies.
The devil knows he can’t win and he has no chance, however, he knows he can deceive many into error and self-destruction. He is strategically opposing the truth of God’s word, by casting shadows upon the understanding of the saints. 
The devil is focused on places the saints are not taking urgent steps to invade. He is expanding the territories or the habitation of darkness.  
These are the gates of hades in the schools, offices, digital space (which includes social media) and society as a whole. They are advancing their cause.And the Church must not fall back with fear as the army of Israel did at the sight of Goliath.Unfortunately, many in the Church think like Eliab. They have no sense of urgency yet have occupied great positions in the Church.They keep despising the efforts of the saints. And don’t see the need for other saints to be busy with the gospel.If you are reading this now, then God is talking to you. Yes, You!Don’t live like there is no cause!
Don’t spend your time, your thoughts, money, attention, and energy on the things of men like there is no cause.
Jesus said to Peter, “You are a hindrance to me. For you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of man” [ Matthew 16:23 (ESV)Beloved, be committed to the great course of Christ. Don’t be a hindrance or the reason big things cannot be done.
Don’t yield to the voices of “Eliab”.
Whoever thinks you are taking Church too seriously, or you are going out for soul-winning too much or giving into Kingdom assignments is not necessary, doesn’t understand the urgency of the times.
What are you making money for?
Is it not to spread the gospel?You will not be told you are too young to get a gadget for yourself or spend on comedy shows or attend a movie premiere or even host a birthday party.But you will be questioned for giving into a gospel project because you are a student or young.Sometimes people will wonder why we organize outreaches, host camp meetings, invest in discipleship and go to unreached places to proclaim Jesus. They think we are being too fanatic about Jesus.Some think it’s a mere youthful exuberance.Others think we simply have nothing to do with time.But No! It is none of these things.We do what we do and take the steps we take because there is a cause.The impact of the Church through history cannot be overemphasized. Many have found total salvation, true transformation and hope through the preaching of the gospel. And those who laboured through the gospel risked their lives to get the light of the gospel into dark places.“But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus–the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.” (Acts 20:24)
It is now your time to go all out for Jesus!
It is your time to finish the course of Christ.Israel would have been defeated and plundered if David had not taken a stand against Goliath. Perhaps the coming of the Messiah would have been corrupted. Since he had to come through the Jews.Get involved in what God is doing, for there is a cause!
Be part of the salvation of souls. Contribute to the expansion of the Church!
Start by taking part in the mission of the Lord in your local Church.If there are no Christ-centered missions in your local Church, find a place where you can be inspired to do more for the Lord.Beloved, don't allow anyone to move you away from getting involved in this great mandate of God.Don't allow any discouraging thought or word to move you.Let none of these things move you. This is the time to go all out for the Lord!
THERE IS A CAUSE!!!
Selah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:8-9; 1 Samuel 17;  Jeremiah 51:20-26; Philippians 2:10; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Romans 16) WE PRAYWe pray that our eyes shall open to see the need to be involved in the cause of Christ and identify how we can strategically participate in the work of the ministry. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 17-192 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take daring steps, I don’t sit on the fence.– I don’t yield myself to any voice of “Eliab” in my life. – I am actively involved in the course of Christ. – I go all out for Jesus. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1024 - WHAT ARE YOU KNOWN FOR?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever you have was first given to you by the Lord. Which means your giving to the Lord is an honour to the Lord. Selah! Author Wednesday, 12th November, 2025WHAT ARE YOU KNOWN FOR?“You already know about his excellent reputation, since he has served alongside me as a loyal son in the work of ministry” Philippians 2:22 (TPT)To have an excellent reputation in the Kingdom means to have a proven and tested worth.
It is not a gift; it is what you faithfully do with the gift of grace at work in you.
It is the consistent impact you make through your consistent labour.You don’t gain this reputation through a one-time event. You are marked with an excellent reputation by the great impact you make over a period of time.The Kingdom recognises giant steps. You cannot distinguish yourself in the Kingdom when you don’t participate in a great and distinguished Kingdom assignment.Don’t be shy to make a visible impact. Until men see your impact, they will not glorify your Heavenly Father.
An excellent Kingdom reputation is not an attempt to please men, but the genuine act of faith to transform lives unto the glory of the Father.
We are called by God from darkness into light to show forth His excellence.People will always see your impact. No matter how long it takes, consistent impact cannot go unnoticed.What is your testimony in the body of Christ?Do people praise the Lord when they hear your name?What are you doing for the Lord that is worthy of great praise?When your leader remembers your name or thinks of you, does he or she thank the Lord for your life?“Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, my partners in ministry serving the Anointed One, Jesus, for they’ve risked their own lives to save mine. I’m so thankful for them, and not just I, but all the congregations among the non-Jewish people respect them for their ministry“ Romans 16:3-4 (TPT)
If you are truly making an impact, your reputation will be known by the Lord and by the saints.
Be interested in making a tangible impact. Be interested in being the reason the Kingdom expands and lives are transformed in all places. Don’t be selfish and don’t live for your own interest. Live for Christ.What are you known for in the Kingdom? Will you call it an excellent reputation?This is a testimony of a brother, Paul the apostle, sent along with Titus:“With him we are sending the brother who is highly respected in all the churches for his work in preaching the gospel.” 2 Corinthians 8:18 (Goodnews Translation).The scripture you just read is one of the scriptures which inspired my heart with joy.How are you celebrated in the Churches for your work in the gospel?Does your reputation reflect the things which interest the Lord?
As a Kingdom person, your reputation must be that you serve the purpose of the Lord.
Don’t settle for less.Don’t sit on the fence.Be part of those daring to achieve glorious things for the Kingdom.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:7-9; 2 Timothy 4:11; 1 Corinthians 4:17; Matthew 5:16; Acts 16:1-2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall exercise diligence, the boldness and courage of the Spirit to attempt great things in the spread of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 20-222 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– By the supply of grace, I attempt great things for the Lord. – I don’t live to serve my interests. – Through me, many will glorify the Lord. – Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of Christ. – I make consistent impact in the Kingdom. – I am a trailblazer in the Kingdom. – My impacts are tangible and visible. – I am known for mighty works in my local church. – I execute every kingdom assignment with excellence. – My reputation is advancing the Kingdom. – I don’t sit on the fence, I get myself involved at all times. – I am in and never out. – I am available at all times.Oh, thank you Lord for stirring up my heart to attempt great things for you!

title: EPISODE 1025 - HOW MUCH GRACE CAN YOU TAKE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter your weaknesses, and overwhelming challenge, trust in God’s unfailing mercies. At a point when your faith seems to fail, turn to God’s mercies. His MERCIES ENDURES FOREVER! Author Thursday, 13th November, 2025 HOW MUCH GRACE CAN YOU TAKE?“And God is able to make every grace abound to you, so that in everything at every time having every sufficiency, you may have an abundance for every good deed” 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Legacy Standard Bible)Grace is the ability and influence of God within your spirit, to carry out divine assignment. “Through him a joy-producing grace cascaded into us, empowering us with the gift of apostleship, so that we can win people from every nation into a faithful commitment to Jesus, to bring honor to his name.” Romans 1:5 (TPT) Paul the apostle unveils the secret to their impact all around the world. It was a joy producing grace cascaded into them and empowered them with the apostolic mandate of winning the nations to Christ.
God abundantly supplies His grace. Thus, the grace of God is immeasurable, infinite, unlimited and inexhaustible.
“[and He did this] so that in the ages to come He might [clearly] show the immeasurable and unsurpassed riches of His grace in [His] kindness toward us in Christ Jesus [by providing for our redemption].” Ephesians 2:7 (Amplified Bible) This Grace which the Lord supplies is super-abundant and overly sufficient for every good work. It is not essentially about how much grace God has available for you. Rather, it is about
HOW MUCH GRACE YOU CAN TAKE!
There is more than enough grace available to be supplied to you. One may ask, how then do I enjoy super abundance of Grace? Whiles Grace is God’s ability supplied to you, faith is your ability to receive Grace. Thus, faith is the present possession of Grace.
YOU ENJOY THE SUPPLY OF GRACE BY FAITH!
Faith brings you into the enjoyment of Grace. “Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace…” Romans 4:16 (KJV) Faith is as a hand which collects or receives and takes hold on the immeasurable supply of God’s ability to carry out a great task. Whiles Grace is God’s righteous right hand stretched to you, faith is your hand stretched to receive from God.– Faith is the confident trust in the unseen God and His immeasurable kindness and power.– Faith has the conviction, the consciousness and the confidence that God supplies Grace abundantly for greater works.– Faith has the conviction, consciousness and confidence that whatever God tells you to do He supplies you with the blessed ability to get it done.– Faith has absolute unbending believe that God makes all provision for His vision, therefore you can make claim.– Faith is the strong believe that God gives grace (which includes favor and earthly blessings), therefore, you can take much more grace.I know beyond every doubt what this teaching is doing to you. It is generating faith in your heart, that you will go on to take hold of grace for that assignment ahead of you. As you are reading this episode, your Faith must be stirred to turn to God to receive more and more grace.
Faith doesn’t doubt God’s supply. Faith instead rests on God’s supply. Faith is God centered, Grace is God dispensed.
Through faith you assimilate and appropriate the distribution of God’s grace.Faith is the action of God in your heart, to manifest God’s word through Grace.Beloved, you can accomplish great things by the immeasurable grace of God. Have the Faith that God has supplied you with abundance of grace (ability, favor and earthly blessings) to do what He has ordained you to do. Glory to God!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 12:9; Hebrews 4:16; Philippians 2:13; Habakkuk 3:19; Psalm 18:32-33) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in faith and boldly take possession of the supply of grace (God’s immeasurable ability, favor and earthly blessings) to do what God has instructed and inspired us to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 23-252 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the faith of God in me.  – I take hold of grace by faith. – No matter the assignment, I have abundance of grace to get the job done. – The Lord is my present help and strength. – I have divine provision for His vision committed to me. – I do much more by the abundance of Grace. Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1026 - FIGHT FOR THE INTEREST OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Humility is one of the greatest secrets to the enjoyment of multiplied grace. It takes humility to submit to God’s supply. Walk in humility to unlock the supply of multiplied grace in your life. Shalom! Author Friday, 14th November, 2025 FIGHT FOR THE INTEREST OF GOD“For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus” 1 Thessalonians 5:9 (KJV)It is not the dream of the Lord that all men will perish. The Lord rather wants all men to be saved (1 Timothy 2:4). This is why He came to die for the sins of men, so that He will make His salvation available for all men.All those who believe in the Lord Jesus have received eternal salvation which cannot be lost. 
To be saved is also to be delivered by the Lord from eternal condemnation or perdition (John 3:16).
However, those who remain in darkness are those who reject the Lord and, through their unbelief, expose themselves to the wrath of condemnation and destruction.The coming of the Lord saves us (who are already saved in Him) from the slavery of corruption. Though the coming of the Lord brings us salvation from the slavery of corruption, in 1 Thessalonians 5, Paul the apostle focuses mainly on the Salvation from the coming destruction.The verse 3 of 1 Thessalonians 5, clearly stated that those who are in darkness shall experience sudden destruction.The coming of the Lord will definitely not be a time of comfort for those in darkness. It’s a time when the judgment of condemnation becomes a practical experience for them.  This coming destruction is God’s judgment of this rebellious world. God’s interest is not really to judge the world or to judge men. That is why I began this discussion by stating expressly that God wants every man to be saved. God’s interest is to judge rebellion.
As part of God’s desire not to judge men, He compels many believers to go out there into all the world to teach and persuade men with the gospel of our Lord and Savior Jesus.
The rebellion God wants to destroy is the devil and His cohorts. The coming of the Lord is also part of God’s program and appointed time to fully destroy the devil. He destroys His works through His death and resurrection. But now God wants to ultimately bring evil to its end.To walk in unbelief is to take the sides of the adversary. Why would you want to be on the losing side?Why won’t you be part of those who are fighting for the interest of God?Satan takes delight in destroying the world. He doesn’t want to go down alone. No one should take the side of Satan.All those who are on God’s side shall experience salvation also from the coming destruction.Beloved, refuse to be deceived by the adversary. His interest is your destruction and the destruction of the world. God’s desire is your experience of salvation from the coming destruction.
He has not appointed you to wrath but to the gaining of Salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for you.
If you are in Christ, you are not designed to be the object of God’s displeasure. The Salvation of the Lord is your stronghold.Remain watchful and sober in this consciousness. Beloved, the interest of God is not just for you to be saved from the coming destruction. Rather, His interest is for all men to be saved.And he has appointed you to teach and persuade all men into this great salvation.Will you take up this course and fight for His interest or you will fight for your own interest?Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Peter 1:3-5; Titus 2:11-14; Hebrews 9 :28;  Psalm 18:2; 1 Thessalonians 1:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain focused, watchful, and sober in the saving grace of the Lord as we await His coming. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMatthew 26-282 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I remain focused watchful, and sober in the saving grace of the Lord as we await His coming. – The salvation of the Lord is my stronghold. – The Lord greatly delights in me. – The salvation which I have recieved in Christ is eternal and cannot be lost.  Thank you Lord Jesus for this so great salvation.

title: EPISODE 1027 - DON’T STAY AWAY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To be proud towards God is to subtly esteem yourself above God’s graciousness. Thus, the pride-filled person sets himself up as a resistance to the grace of God. Selah. Author Saturday, 15th November, 2025 DON'T STAY AWAY“we come closer to God and approach him with an open heart, fully convinced by faith that nothing will keep us at a distance from him. For our hearts have been sprinkled with blood to remove impurity and we have been freed from an accusing conscience and now we are clean, unstained, and presentable to God inside and out!”Hebrews 10:22 (TPT) God made man and planted Him in His presence for eternal communion. Man was not made to live outside God’s presence. However, after Adam turned away from God’s instructions, he became guilty at heart and couldn’t approach God’s presence.
He hid himself from the presence of the Lord because of guilt and the sense of condemnation.
That has always been the challenge of man after sin entered the world. The matter of sin, guilt, and a sense of condemnation is rooted in unbelief. But the only way man can commune with God is by faith. To commune with God by faith is to live by the word of God. All things came into being by the word. Man’s relationship with God was according to the speaking of God.  Man is only able to approach God on the grounds of faith. This faith is a confident assurance in who God is and what He has supplied to man. Under the Old Covenant, God established the Aaronic Priesthood as a means to usher man into His presence.  God never wanted to be distanced from His people. No matter the corruption of man, He still made provisions to reach out to man and to bring him into fellowship with Him. When the Israelites left Egypt, the Lord instructed Moses to build a tabernacle, that He might be in their midst. The tabernacle had the outer court, where animal sacrifices were made.  It also had the holy place (which had the seven lampstands, the table of shewbread, and the altar of incense) and then the most Holy Place.  The Holy Place was not made accessible to everyone. It was only the High Priest who had the consecration to enter the Most Holy Place. It was there in the Holy Place, God’s glory manifested.  The ark of the covenant was kept in the Most Holy Place. A special veil separated the most holy place from the other parts of the tabernacle.  Now understand that, though God made Moses to consecrate the High Priest to be the only person to legally enter the Most Holy Place, God in His wisdom made provision to commune with the entire nation of Israel in the Most Holy Place. Aaron, as a high priest was a representative of God to the people and the people to God. He was to wear a special garment that distinguished and separated him for his assignment. This high priest’s garment had shoulder pieces that held the breastplate and the ephod (which we will discuss further later). The shoulder pieces were made of two onyx stones (one on each shoulder), and upon each of the onyx stones will be engraved with six names of the twelve tribes of Israel. (Exodus 28:2-12) Meaning Aaron was adorned in this gracious garment to be a representation of the children of Israel before the Lord. “You shall put the two stones on the [two] shoulder pieces of the ephod [of the high priest], as memorial stones for Israel; and Aaron shall bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.“ Exodus 28:12 (Amplified Bible) Whenever the High Priest stood before the Lord in the most Holy place, it was a memorial before the Lord that the entire nation of Israel was before Him. God fellowshiped with the whole nation through the High Priest. But the High Priest couldn’t just draw close or enter the Most Holy Place. Before he could enter the Most Holy Place, there were some specific things which have to be in place. Apart from the burning of incense (Leviticus 16:12-13), another crucial thing he needed was an unblemished blood (Leviticus 16:3; Hebrews 9:7).With these things in place, the High Priest enters the Holy place or draws close to the presence of the Lord with confidence.
The High Priest approaching God’s presence with confidence was the entire nation approaching God with confidence.
Everything in and about the tabernacle is a prophetic and typographical representation of Jesus, His redemptive work and what He accomplished through His life, death and resurrection. Jesus has a better Priesthood than that of Aaron. Aaron’s Priesthood produced a temporal experience of God’s presence; however, Jesus did an eternal work and ushered all who shall believe in Him into an eternal fellowship with God without any sense of guilt. Under the Aaronic Priesthood, there were yearly sacrifices made. But Jesus, who is the perfect High Priest, made a perfect, eternal sacrifice once and for all. “And by his one perfect sacrifice he made us perfectly holy and complete for all time!” Hebrews 10:14 (TPT). Now we are not like Adam, who had to hide himself from the presence of God. We are not like the Israelites, who needed yearly offerings before they gained some temporal confidence before the Lord. And then after some limited time, they become guilty of sin. We are saved through Christ’s perfect and eternal sacrifice. Now through Christ’s sacrifice, we have eternal access into God’s presence. We dwell and enjoy His presence every day, not because of our self-righteousness, but by the perfection of Jesus. Adam hid from God because of guilt and a sense of condemnation through the sin of unbelief. We boldly approach and enjoy the Lord because of the blood of Jesus. Refuse to distance yourself from the Lord.
Don’t allow any guilt or wrong to draw you away from God.
Live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 7:19; Romans 5:1-2; 1 John 3:19-21; Ephesians 3:12; Hebrews 4:16; Psalm 73:28) WE PRAYThank the Lord for granting you access into eternal fellowship with Him through His Son, Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMark 1-32 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t permit anything to keep me at distance from God. – I dont’ allow any guilt or wrong to draw me away from God. – I live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. – I don’t distance myself from God. – Thank you Lord for the access of eternal fellowship with you through Jesus. Oh blessed be God!Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1028 - BE INTIMATE WITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you have the Holy Spirit in you and with you; be immersed in Him through prayer and fellowship; your heart will be inspired with understanding into unsearchable verities. Glory to God. Author Sunday, 16th November, 2025BE INTIMATE WITH THE LORD “He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk just as He walked.”1 John 2:6 (NKJV)Are you born again?If your answer is yes, then you are in Christ.When you received Jesus, you became born again. The born again is also the new creation.The new creation is the man in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:17)
To be in Christ is to be in the Spirit.
Thus, if you are in Christ, you must live as Christ.When you are thinking of being immersed in the Spirit, don’t adopt human techniques and religious methods. As you are in Christ you follow the example of Christ.
The matter of being immersed in the Spirit is not a matter of methods but a new living way.
To be immersed in the Spirit is an organic experience and not mechanical.That is why you follow the example of Christ.Christ brought to light the reality of being soaked and saturated by the Spirit.During Jesus’ Earth Walk, the Pharisees or the religious leaders were demonstrating spirituality according to their self-gratification, man-made rules, religious traditions and legalism.Everyone saw them as men who were enriched with divine understanding and had high-level experience in the Spirit.But Jesus said to them, “Making the word of God of no effect through your tradition which you have handed down. And many such things you do” Mark 7:13 (NKJV)
The word of God is organic and cannot find its full expression when mixed with mechanical methods.
To have a real organic experience of the Spirit, you don’t follow religious methods.Indisputably, one of the crucial items to make one continuously experience the saturation of the Spirit is PRAYER.However, your understanding and interpretation of prayer really matter.When prayer is only to prove how spiritual one is, the motives become wrong.
The principle of prayer is the principle of intimate communication. Your understanding of this will help you remain consistent in PRAYER.
The Pharisees and the religious leaders prayed to prove their superiority over others. Prayer was showmanship to them.However, Jesus showed us that prayer is basically a communion with God.In most of the recorded prayers of Jesus, you will notice He often referred to God as Father. That was to establish the kind of relationship we are to have with God.God is your Father and you must commune with Him as such. This is the example of Jesus to us. He showed us to walk consistently in the Spirit by maintaining a consistent relationship and communion with God as our Father.
Until you begin to recognise, understand and become conscious that God is your Father, you will always attempt to use mechanisms to connect to God.
Prayer will become a mechanic method and not an organic expression of your relationship with God.You will spend more time with your loving Father, and freely share your burdens with Him. The more you spend time with the Father through prayer (intimate communication), the more the Father’s love and presence overwhelm, saturate and soak your heart.
The more you spend time with Him, the more you are immersed into His person and mindset.
Pray to the Father as Jesus did.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Galatians 5:16; Matthew 3:11-12; Acts 1:4-5; Colossians 3:1-4; Ephesians 5:18-19) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts and minds will be set on the example of Jesus, and that our walk in the Spirit will be according to His light and not religious methods BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMark 4-62 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart and mind is set on the example of Jesus.– My walk in the spirit is according to His light and not any religious methods. – I live a continuous saturated life of the Holy Spirit. – I am not ordinary. – I walk daily in this consciousness. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1029 - MAINTAIN INTENSE CONSISTENCY IN PRAYER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You cannot become fruitful in your walk of faith without the supply of our Lord. This is why He gave us the Holy Spirit as a means to which we can continuously commune intimately with Him. Beloved, don't take your communion with the Lord lightly. Selah. Author Monday, 17th November, 2025MAINTAIN INTENSE CONSISTENCY IN PRAYER  “There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God.”2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)All that God has put in you are not for you; they are to bless nations. The impartation of God’s blessings in you is to cause you to make IMPACT in others.
Whenever God wants to bless a people He sends a man.
While Joseph was living a challenging life from slavery to prison, God was preparing him to be the escape for Jacob in the days of famine (Genesis 45:7). When Israel agonized with pain in Egypt, God raised Moses and sent him as their deliverer.However, God gave a word that He would go down to Egypt to save His people Israel. This means God sending Moses to Egypt was Himself going to Egypt to save Israel. (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10; Acts 7:33-35).There are men whom God raised to be channels or conduits of blessings to their generation. And you (reading this with today) are one of the blessings God has sent to bless this generation.The grace and abilities of God within you are part of the answers God is sending to this generation at such a time as this.Nevertheless, you cannot fulfill this great mandate without God. To affect many lives positively you have to enlarge your capacity.“Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.” Isaiah 54:2-3 (KJV)To enlarge your capacity, you have to stretch your inner man through consistent and persistent long intense prayers.To begin with, I want you to know it is wrong to think short quick prayers are not prayers. Every prayer is prayer. The quality of prayer is not really how long you’ve prayed. The quality of prayer is how well it is founded on the word of God.
Every prayer rooted in the word is effective!
 THEREFORE, NO MATTER WHAT, PRAY!So then, if even short, quick prayers can be effective, much more when you give yourself to consistent long intense prayers?The idea of consistent long intense prayers is not about God expecting you to beg Him for long before He does something for you. Consistent long intense prayers are about having quality time with the Spirit.
The longer you spend time with the Spirit of the Lord in prayer, the stronger His influence on you becomes.
The Spirit of God enlarges your Spirit and strengthens your inner man. The anointing of the Holy Spirit on you becomes stronger.
Are you wondering what to say or pray about?
Cheer up!There is the gift of praying in the Spirit. Praying in the spirit includes praying in other tongues.Get this:“The one who speaks in tongues advances his own spiritual progress…” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (TPT)Since tongues speaking will cause you to advance your spiritual progress, or edify (embolden, build or construct your inner man), then do it more to make more spiritual progress!Beloved, even ten minutes of tongues speaking will build your spirit. Therefore make time to pray in tongues for 30 or 60 minutes; then grow it to 2 hours, and then 6 hours.
The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God.
What are you waiting for?Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:30-31; Luke 18:1; Genesis 26:2; Isaiah 26:15; Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]) WE PRAYWe pray that, against all odds and hindrances, we shall break forth in our spirit and maintain intense consistency in prayer.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMark 7-92 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Rather than worrying about the size of the assignment, I pray. – I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.  – Through my effective prayers, I increase in capacity to do more. – I don’t settle for less, I persist long in prayers. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1030 - DARE TO DO THE EXTRAORDINARY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the Lord needs you; avail yourself for His use, not because of your selfish gains. Be motivated and inspired by His Lordship, His love, and the impact of others. Selah. Author Tuesday, 18th November, 2025DARE TO DO THE EXTRAORDINARY"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go” Joshua 1:9 (NKJV) Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith. It is by faith we live and walk with God. Faith is our reality.
The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them.
Anything that has to bring glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith). Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said.  It is knowing without any tittle of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do. Faith is audacious in its dealing. When you act in faith courage is seen. This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life.And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness.
Serving others is greatness, however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation.
A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss. Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father’s house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh. He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites, but felt enervated. Maybe you are reading this and feels you don’t have what it takes to do great things. When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community you can’t do anything great for the Lord. Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!! God specialises in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations. That is God.
He will always use what it seem depleted to reveal His glory.
He used, a young man who is least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory in Israel. He made mighty men out of men that were distresses, indebted, and discontented (1Samuel 22:2). Why must God use young 17 years old David, with no military experience to defeat Goliath with just a sling and stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53). To feed five thousand people, He used a little boys lunch pack of five bread and two fishes. This is audacity!!!
God doesn’t choose the easy paths, He creates greatness out of what seem impossible.
To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord. "Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus.”Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward. You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room. You will look for places to show forth His glory and power.
Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you.
Until you take a step to do something great you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord. God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary! Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAYLord, I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMark 10-122 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work. – I am strong and courageous. – I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary. – I live above this world. – I do the unimaginable. – I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me. – I do the extraordinary. – I am audacious. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1031 - ARE YOU A FAITHFUL STEWARD?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The born-again must submit his mind and thoughts to be renewed by the Spirit of the Lord and the revelation of the Scriptures. When your mind is renewed by the word of God, your imagination will not become a hindrance to what God is saying to you. A mind shaped by the Word of God becomes a pathway for the voice of the Lord. Selah. Author Wednesday, 19th November, 2025 ARE YOU A FAITHFUL STEWARD?“Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.” 1 Corinthians 4:2 (KJV)Holman Bible Dictionary explains that a Steward is one who has the responsibility “to utilize and manage all resources God provides for His glory and the betterment of His creation.”
A steward is one trusted with the resources of his Master.
Joseph in the house of Potiphar was a steward over his master’s resources and affairs. The success of Joseph wasn’t his personal gains. His success was the prosperity of Potiphar’s household.The moment you are trusted with God’s resources, your success is not in your personal gains. Your success is in how faithful you utilize God’s resources for His glory.When God blessed man, He practically entrusted His resources to man. However, men began to use God’s resources for their own pleasures, instead of using them to bring glory to God.The new creation in Christ is to live as Christ. To live as Christ is to bring glory to God and not to satisfy your own interests.A faithful Steward doesn’t use God’s resources for His personal gains. A faithful Steward uses God’s resources for God’s glory. Your true success is not in what you possess. Your true success is how you use the possessions given to you by God to serve God’s Kingdom mission.
Which means to be faithful is crucial, for stewards of God.
To be faithful is to be trustworthy. The Greek word is “pistos”; which means “trustful, true and sure”.A faithful person is disciplined and diligent with tasks entrusted to him or her. A faithful Steward doesn’t only fulfill responsibility when it is convenient. A faithful person remains diligent even when it is inconvenient. He or she is driven by conviction.To be a faithful steward of God’s resources is also to be committed and loyal to God. It is to remain firm and consistent with your commitment or promise to God.“When you make a vow or a pledge to God, do not put off paying it; for God takes no pleasure in fools [who thoughtlessly mock Him]. Pay what you vow” Ecclesiastes 5:4 (Amplified Bible)
A faithful Steward doesn’t break promises or commitments made to God.
God channels resources to you based on the commitment you make to Him.The vision of God never lacks provision. Thus, God entrusts His kingdom business and resources to anyone who makes a decision or a vow or commitment to make the vision of God their focus.As a Steward of God, you must be faithful and committed to utilizing God’s blessings or resources to bring honor and glory to Him.Don’t just be a steward of God’s resources, be a faithful steward of God’s resources.Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 4:17; 2 kings 12:18;22:7; 1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAY We pray that by the continuous supply of God’s grace, we shall remain faithful stewards of God’s resources no matter the inconvenience; that God’s kingdom mission will be fulfilled and He will be glorified through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMark 13-152 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1032 - DON’T LIVE BEGGING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It will take the attitude of humility to walk in the fulfilment of God’s purpose. Don’t trust in your intelligence above the knowledge of God’s word. Selah. Author Thursday, 20th November, 2025DON’T LIVE BEGGING “Don’t just listen to the Word of Truth and not respond to it, for that is the essence of self-deception. So always let His Word become like poetry written and fulfilled by your life!”James 1:22 (TPT)All things were made by the word of God (Hebrews 11:3). The universe was created and beautifully coordinated by the power of God’s words.
The word of God is the constitution and the Wisdom of  God. It is actively full of energy.
The word of God is designed to accomplish its purpose when God sends it forth. However, the word of God in your life will not work automatically. The word of God will not be fulfilled or manifest in your life without your participation.The word of God is a seed of God which is sown in your heart as you read or hear it preached and taught.You have a responsibility to guard that seed, nurture it, water it, and prune it for better growth till the season of great harvest.
When you find yourself in a tough situation where everything seems not to work, you must go for God’s word.
Understand that, everything in God works by the word. And though nothing works without the word of God, the word of God doesn’t work by itself. You have to put the word to work.There are certain tough situations which may press you so hard that you begin to doubt whether you can have solutions. Sometimes you may think you have tried all that you can to get out of it, and nothing seems to work. It may even leave you in a state where you begin to beg for a solution.The word of God always works when you work it out. Becoming beggarly wouldn’t bring you out of your challenges.
You stand tall above challenges when you persistently stand on the word and act it out.
Be determined to become a doer of the word.The word is given to you to become your action. You don’t just have to be a good hearer. The word doesn’t work for you when you don’t do it.That is what it means to live by faith. You must have confidence in the word and act on it without doubt.
Let your life become the fulfillment of what God has said.
After Jesus had taught the people from Peter’s boat. The Lord asked Peter and his friends to row out their boat to deep waters to cast their nets and they will have a great catch. (See Luke 5:4-7)Not long before the Lord Jesus used their boat, Peter and his friends returned from all night fishing and they didn’t catch a thing. But this time, Peter and his friends decided to still go out again to let down their nets only because of the WORD OF THE LORD.According to the facts based on Peter’s experience, it will be another waste of time to roll out his boat for fishing again.But this time, he was not acting based on his professional experience in fishing. He was acting on the word of the Lord.Look at what Peter said himself:“But Simon answered and said to Him, “Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net.” Luke 5:5 (NKJV)Peter let down his net according to the WORD OF JESUS!And see what happened:“When they pulled up their nets, they were shocked to see a huge catch of fish, so much that their nets were ready to burst!” Luke 5:6 (TPT).The word of God always works when you act on it.
Don’t live begging. Live acting out the Word of God!
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 7:24; Matthew 12:50; Jeremiah 11:6) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall have the promptness of heart to confidently carry out or act out God’s word irrespective of the challenge.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANMark 16Luke 1-22 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t beg, I act on the word.– I act out the word of God irrespective of challenges. – My life is a fulfillment of the word of God. – I am a doer of the word. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1033 - DON’T RECEIVE THE GRACE OF GOD IN VAIN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 21st November, 2025 DON’T RECEIVE THE GRACE OF GOD IN VAIN“I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward”Philippians 4:17 (TPT)The generosity of the saints or giving of the saints towards God’s Kingdom mission is an opportunity God gives to the saints to demonstrate their love towards His Kingdom.Giving into the spread of the Gospel or the work of the ministry imparts your heart and gives you the opportunity to participate in the impact of the gospel.
Whatever the Lord inspires you to do for the advancement of His Kingdom, builds and enrich your heart.
There is a reward or profit which abounds for you because of your generosity.This is part of the reasons your giving is an opportunity or privilege.Today, I want to re-echo one very crucial benefit of giving (or the generosity of the saints).Your Generosity Leads to the Increase of Resources.Read Philippians 4:17 from the GOOD WORD Translation:“It’s not that I’m looking for a gift. The opposite is true. I’m looking for your resources to increase.”
 Though your generosity blesses lives, it is also to your advantage. The fruit of your generosity brings reward to you.
Whenever you are asked to give or whenever there is a conversation about your generosity, don’t just think it’s because your gift is needed.  See the opportunity to receive a bountiful supply.This was the situation with the Church in Philippi. They saw their giving to the ministry of Paul as an opportunity.Paul didn’t just appreciate their giving; his heart was filled with joy and was greatly satisfied by their giving.“My heart overflows with joy when I think of how you showed your love to me by your financial support of my ministry. For even though you have so little, you still continue to help me at every opportunity. I’m not telling you this because I’m in need, for I have learned to be satisfied in any circumstance”Philippians 4:10-11 (TPT)These saints didn’t give just because they had an abundance of resources. But even with the little they had, they were determined to give bountifully.Paul again wrote on this to the Church in Corinth concerning the Churches in Macedonia (which includes Phillipi, Thessalonica, Berea and etc). Philippi is a prominent city in Macedonia. This means, when Paul wrote about the generosity of the saints in Macedonia, he was also talking about the Philippians.“Beloved ones, we must tell you about the grace God poured out upon the churches of Macedonia. For even during a season of severe difficulty and tremendous suffering, they became even more filled with joy. From the depths of their extreme poverty, super-abundant joy overflowed into an act of extravagant generosity. For I can verify that they spontaneously gave, not only according to their means but far beyond what they could afford.” 2 Corinthians 8:1-3 (Amplified Bible).These Macedonians love the Lord so much that they were not hindered by the outward limitations but took advantage of the grace of God to give by conviction.No wonder Paul the apostle desired for their resources to increase. It is not just Paul who had this desire; it is a Kingdom principle:“He that is faithful in little, is faithful in much” (Luke 16:10)
You are entrusted with more when you demonstrate faithful stewardship in the little things.
When you receive more, you increase your giving capacity. And the more you give, the more you enjoy the increase of generosity.“Now [remember] this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to others] will also reap generously [and be blessed].” 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible)There are some who conclude that the increase of resources or the fruit of generosity is only in the supply of grace. However, it is important to know that the supply of grace is not only an inward capacity; it is also:  – Every favour and earthly blessing.Earthly blessing is the outward manifestation (material resources produced) of the inward blessings. Though ministry is spiritual, it requires material resources to execute its workings.“And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.” 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)– More enrichment to have more to give.” You will be enriched in every way so that you may be generous, and this [generosity, administered] through us is producing thanksgiving to God [from those who benefit” 2 Corinthians 9:11 (Amplified Bible)Learn to take advantage of every giving opportunity to demonstrate love towards the Lord and to increase in more and more grace. 
Every giving is a demonstration of your faithfulness towards the spread and advancement of the gospel.
Don’t receive the grace of God in vain. Be like the Macedonians who took advantage of the giving-grace to support the ministry of Paul.Shalom Aleichem!DIG DEEPER(Job 41:11; Proverbs 3:9-10; Deuteronomy 8:17-18; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not withhold our resources from the Lord’s work, but shall enjoy more and more grace to demonstrate our generosity in every way. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 3-52 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. – The Lord is my provider and multiplies my resources. – I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation).  – I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work) – I am a self-sufficient giver by the grace of God.  – I possess enough and require no aid or support to give. – I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1034 - BE A PERSON OF HONOR
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Just because you are now a son of God, a brother of Jesus, and have a mingled life with Christ doesn’t mean you are also a master on your own. Jesus is your MASTER. The more you see Him as your Master, the more you submit to Him, and your faith finds genuine expressions through Him. Selah! Author Saturday, 22nd November, 2025 BE A PERSON HONOR“Recognize the value of every person and continually show love to every believer. Live your lives with great reverence and in holy awe of God. Honor your rulers.” 1 Peter 2:17 (TPT) Day by day as each generation grows deep into “postmodernism“, people become more interested in pleasing themselves and satisfying their ego.  Men are drifting away from the very concept that helps bridge one generation to the other. Blessings of one generation are distributed through a system of honour and humility.
There is no generation that can accurately and fully reach its potential without the impartations of the previous generation.
In the Kingdom of God, to walk in honor and humility is a code of greatness. To honor is to have great value and respect for others and to highly esteem those who have authority over you. Though the younger generation may seem to gradually lose the true sense of honor, it doesn’t change its authentic essence among the great. As you saw in the opening verse (1 Peter 2:17): To honor is to: 1. Recognize the value of every person. 2. Continually show love to every believer.  3. Live with great reverence and in holy awe of God.  4. Acknowledge the authority of your rulers.
Let’s quickly look at those you must honor, according to the counsel of God’s wisdom:
1. Honor God  “the twenty-four Elders fell down before him and worshiped him, the Eternal Living One, and cast their crowns before the throne, singing, “O Lord, you are worthy to receive the glory and the honor and the power, for you have created all things. They were created and called into being by your act of will.” Revelation 4:10-11 (TLB) I have previously explained how you can honor and glorify God. And to add a few thoughts to it: Understand that you can also honor the Lord with:  a. Your treasure and time. Time is one of the most precious treasures and assets we have.  Invest your time and anything you value into your relationship with God and His vision.  “Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also” (Matthew 6:21).  b. Honor God with your body. You were bought with a price by God, therefore honor Him in your body, which is His temple. (1 Corinthians 6:18-20). c. Honor God with your finances, wealth, or possessions. “Honor the Lord with your possessions, and with the firstfruits of all your increase” Proverbs 3:9 (NKJV).The Message translation says, “…give Him the first and the best.” d. With your hands and heart lifted in worship and thanksgiving. (Psalm 34:1-3) Interestingly as you honor the Lord, you enjoy honor from Him (1 Samuel 2:30). And He also shares secrets with those who revere Him. “Friendship with God is reserved for those who reverence him. With them alone, he shares the secrets of his promises” Psalm 25:14 (TLB)
Beloved, understand that you can fully honor the Lord through Christ Jesus.
2. Honor Your Leaders in the Church (1 Thessalonians 5:12). 3. Honor your Parents (Ephesians 6:2). 4. Honor Your Spouse (1 Peter 3:7; Ephesians 5:33). 5. Honor the Elderly (Leviticus 19:32). 6. Honor Rulers or Government officials(Romans 13:1-2; 7). 7. Honor Your senior Colleagues at work or employers (1 Peter 2:18). 8. Honor one another above yourselves. (Romans 12:10). This includes parents also honoring their children. Ephesians 6:4 (nevertheless children must not use that against their parents. Yours is to honor your parents). I will take time to explain the above points.
Where there is honor and humility, there is abundance release of grace, and peace. (James 4:6; 1 Peter 5:5-6).
When you truly love the Lord you will honor others with the humility and integrity of heart. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Revelation 5:13; Psalm 22:23; John 5:23; 1 Peter 1:22) WE PRAYThat we shall take hold of the counsel of the word of the Lord and walk in honor towards God and men according to the wisdom of God. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 6-82 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in honor and humility. – I walk in honor towards God and all men according to the wisdom of God. – I  don’t dishonor the authorities set over me. – I honor the Lord with my body. – I honor the Lord with my treasure, time and finances. – I demonstrate honor in all things. Oh Hallelujah!! Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1035 - DIVE DEEPER INTO THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you have the capacity to help others, don’t hold back. Just as God loves you, go to any extent of love to help others also. Be HELPFUL AT ALL TIMES. Selah! Author Sunday, 23rd November, 2025 DIVE DEEPER INTO THE LORD “God’s wisdom is something mysterious that goes deep into the interior of his purposes. You don’t find it lying around on the surface. It’s not the latest message, but more like the oldest—what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene.” 1 Corinthians 2:8 (MSG)A man who communes with the Holy Spirit has access to the riches of the Wisdom of God.
No one immersed in God and His wisdom struggles to make the right decisions at any point in life.
There is no confusion in a man who has handled the depths of divine wisdom. Deep understanding is granted to a man who continues to behold the Lord.You will never find God’s wisdom by surfing around. You access God’s wisdom in the depths of His heart.
You must develop the habit of staying long in your communion with God.
The more you continue to stay longer, the more you are enriched with the influences of the Spirit.STAY LONG! DON’T RUSH.To some, staying long in the place of prayer and communion with the Lord is tedious work.Whatever and whoever you love takes your time and attention effortlessly.As you are struggling to stay in the place of prayer and ministering to the Lord, are you sure the Love of God is kindled in your heart?
Communing with God is an unforceful rhythm when it is centered on the love of God.
The Holy Spirit is the best partner for the fulfilment of your destiny.And even “the Spirit of God, not content to flit around on the surface, dives into the depths of God, and brings out what God planned all along” 1 Corinthians 2:10 (MSG).He searches all things diligently, even the profound depths of God.This means, having the Holy Spirit in you doesn’t mean you automatically handle the depths of God. You must also dive and search deeply into the heart of the Spirit, to glean the riches of His wisdom.There are things concerning your life which God has set in Himself long before you arrived on the scene. And as you commune with the Spirit, He grants you access and mastery into things God has already designed for you.
Stop being satisfied with the sand bathing. Go beyond the shores of the Spirit, and dive deep into the ocean of the Spirit to experience and enjoy the wisdom of God.
No king can rule and exercise dominion without a dimension of wisdom.“God conceals the revelation of his word in the hiding place of his glory. But the honor of kings is revealed by how they thoroughly search out the deeper meaning of all that God says. The heart of a king is full of understanding, like the heavens are high and the ocean is deep.” Proverbs 25:2-3 (TPT)You are called to lead your generation and, therefore increase in understanding.“Like the horizons for breadth and the ocean for depth, the understanding of a good leader is broad and deep.” Proverbs 25:3 (MSG).There are divine depths of wisdom which may not be understood by books. You only come to the understanding of it by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit.“We don’t have to rely on the world’s guesses and opinions. We didn’t learn this by reading books or going to school; we learned it from God, who taught us person-to-person through Jesus, and we’re passing it on to you in the same firsthand, personal way.” 1 Corinthians 2:13 (MSG).
There is an understanding that comes to you only in communion with the Lord.
Dive deeper into the Lord through fellowship with the Holy Spirit.Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29; Ezekiel 8:2-3; Daniel 2:16-30) WE PRAYThat our hearts will delve deep into God and access the depths of wisdom and understanding concerning all that is needed for the fulfilment of purpose and the refulgence of His kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 9-112 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow deeper in my communication with the Holy Spirit. – I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1036 - HOW TO DEAL WITH DISAPPOINTMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When everyone fell back at the presence of Goliath, David showed up with God and was an encouragement to Saul. Amid this hostile pluralistic post-modern world, show up everywhere with Jesus, and be an encouragement to your Pastor, leaders, and other faithful brethren in Christ. Selah. Author Monday, 24th November, 2025 HOW TO DEAL WITH DISAPPOINTMENT “so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)As believers, we have been made victorious through Christ Jesus.The scriptures referred to believers in Christ as “More than conquerors” (Romans 8:37). This means to have a decisive victory. The Greek word is “hupernikaō”, which also means to vanquish beyond.Through His work on the cross Jesus, “stripped all the spiritual tyrants in the universe of their sham authority and marched them naked through the streets.” (Colossians 2:15).When Jesus died, He did not become a prisoner but defeated all the cohorts of darkness and made them His prisoners. This earned victory of Jesus was for our benefit. In Christ and through Christ we have triumphed over the evil one.The adversary knows he has no power over you. Though he is a defeated foe and rendered powerless, he still has his deceptive methods and schemes or designs. And as people of light, we are not to be ignorant of the designs of the devil. 
The devil cannot have any victory over the believer in any close combat, because of the victory of Christ. 
Thus he uses secrets and projectiles which seem harmless yet deadly, to attack and destroy the faith of the saints.In today’s episode, I want to emphasize one of the deadly missiles within the devil’s schemes. He uses this to shipwreck the faith of the brethren and to disrupt them from fulfilling God’s purpose for their lives.Ignorance is the major challenge of most believers. And through this discussion, you shall receive light to continuously exercise your victory. I write these things to keep you reminded of ways to enforce your victory and not become prey to the enemy.Disappointments.This seems harmless but can destroy the confidence of a believer. Most disappointments are basically high expectations not met. The adversary takes advantage of this feeling of displeasure to steal and crush your joy.By how God wires the believer’s faith through His Word, a believer shouldn’t give room for any form of disappointment. By the knowledge of God’s word, a believer must never see disadvantage in any situation. Whether an expectation wasn’t fulfilled because of your mistake or failure or that of others, you must remain composed. Understand that, sadness is not of God. Disappointment is a sad feeling. Such feelings may come, but shouldn’t be given a seat.  As it rises within, you must quickly send it off. To resist the feeling of disappointment is to also resist the devil.
No matter the worst situation that happens, there is a divine appointment which can be activated.
This is not just to motivate or stimulate your mind. This is the reality of God’s word. This is how you have to think. And this doesn’t suggest you live to allow any wrong or evil thing to happen around you. This is to help you set your heart on the stability of the word.When an unexpected situation happens around you, don’t allow its wind to move you. Stay strong on the word of God.Always remember this:“So we are convinced that every detail of our lives is continually woven together to fit into God’s perfect plan of bringing good into our lives, for we are his lovers who have been called to fulfill his  designed purpose” Romans 8:28 (TPT)
As a believer, you should have great expectations, but your confidence should be in the glorious plan of God for your life.
There are people who focus more on their expectations than how God is building them up. When things don’t play out as you expect, refuse to be broken. Pay attention to what God is saying to you and set your heart on it.Trust God’s training! Focus on God’s plan for your life and His goodness, then you will always live above disappointments.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 16:9; Deuteronomy 8:16; Romans 5:3-5; Isaiah 40:28-31; Psalm 42:11; Proverbs 3:5) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be established in the direction and the perfect plan of God for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 12-142 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been made victorious through Christ Jesus. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – No matter how worse a situation may be, there is a divine appointment which will be activated for my favor. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above disappointments. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1037 - LET NOTHING OFFEND YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency A proud person is resisted and cannot increase in grace. Intentionally deal with pride. Selah! Author Tuesday, 25th November, 2025 LET NOTHING OFFEND YOU “A further reason for forgiveness is to keep from being outsmarted by Satan, for we know what he is trying to do.” (2 Corinthians 2:11).The schemes of the adversary are his weapons designed to shipwreck the faith of the saints. His schemes are mainly to exploit the weaknesses or the inconsistencies of the brethren. He also takes advantage of the voice of every individual’s flesh to manipulate their thoughts and actions.The arrows of the adversary may be subtle and may start as harmless thoughts or through a harmless incidence, but when they are not intentionally or promptly and explosively extinguished, they will gradually creep into your heart and cause an emotional breakdown.
Sometimes things you will laugh about in the heat of a moment will later become the reason you feel hurt and offended.
How does it happen?The adversary subtly begins to whisper and induce a perspective you didn’t consider. Suddenly, you begin to feel angry and offended over something you initially laughed over. He draws your attention and causes the new negative perspective to become your meditation. The more you meditate on it, the more you become offended and bitter.You may think you are doing the right thing by giving a forensic look at the situation. But that is not what is really happening. The adversary is attacking your heart using the situation.
Such attacks from the adversary are poisonous and can even crush your bones physically.
Sometimes you may think it is your right not to forgive. You may even say “I have forgiven” but you know deep within you haven’t forgiven. Or will even tell yourself, “How many times should I forgive?; Am I the only one to forgive?”.
Unforgiveness or holding on to an offence is a destructive weapon of the enemy.
Look at what Paul the Apostle had to say to the Church in Corinth:“So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow. Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him. To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ; Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.” 2 Corinthians 2:7-11 (KJV)From the above verses, we see Paul asking the brethren to forgive a fellow who had done some wrong. He then explained the reason for forgiving:One of the devices of Satan is to use or take advantage of unforgiveness.When you are unforgiving, the adversary will outsmart you with his devices. He finds an opportunity to attack the saints when they are offended, bitter and unforgiving.
Don’t see any of these reactions or emotional trouble you keep having as natural consequences. They are arrows of the adversary shot at you.
Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Even when He hanged naked on the cross, before His death (while the soldiers gambled for His clothes); He said, “Father forgive them…” (Luke 23:34)Faith works through love (Galatians 5:6)As you forgive others as Christ has forgiven you, you learn to SHIELD UP BY FAITH against the arrows of bitterness, offences, anger and sorrow.
SHIELD UP!
Selah.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 4:32; Proverbs 19:11; Matthew 18:33; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11) WE PRAY We pray that we will not hold on to offences and bitterness but will continue to forgive and love one another. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 15-172 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to hold on to offences and bitterness. – I demonstrate the love of God towards all men in all things. – Nothing can offend me. – The love of God gains full expression through me by the day – I am full of love. – The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1038 - ABSOLUTE “GOD-FIDENCE”
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you continue to allow people to talk down on the impact of God and His word in your life, they break your confidence and leave you discouraged. Don’t keep quiet to allow negative words to ruin your courage. REFUSE TO BE DISCOURAGED AND AFRAID. Author ABSOLUTE  “GOD-FIDENCE”“Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?” John 11:40 (TPT) There is a reason the Lord keeps reminding you of things pertaining to your faith walk with Him. Anytime the Lord brings admonishments your way, He is establishing a certain consciousness in you. If you have been reading with , you must know that your time of harvest is here. When the children of Israel were in slavery, the only message they needed was “DELIVERANCE”. But that wasn’t the message they needed when they were entering the promise land. At that point they needed to be Conscious of the presence of the Lord and be strong and courageous. And that was the message the Lord was administering to Joshua. Whenever the adversary sees you stepping into greater heights, he attempts to weaken your confidence in God. Understand that God doesn’t bring challenges your way to prove your faith.
