God only inspires you to do great things. The adversary uses challenges or negative situations to distract or stop you from doing the things God wants you to do. This is why you must maintain absolute “God-fidence”(confidence in God).
No challenge should be big enough to move you away from God.
No challenge should be big enough to make you doubt God. Hold on strongly to what God have said. In the story of Jesus raising Lazarus from dead, you will see two instances of faith. Remember faith is your response to God’s Word.We are going to look at how two sisters (Martha and Mary) responded to Jesus. One day Lazarus (a brother of Martha and Mary, and a loving friend to Jesus) became very sick to the point of death. “So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, our brother Lazarus, the one you love, is very sick. Please come!”When He (Jesus) heard this, he said, “ This sickness will not end in death for Lazarus, but will bring glory and praise to God. This will reveal the greatness of the Son of God by what takes place.” (See John 11:3-4) This was the foundational word which got Lazarus raised from the dead. Jesus said this sickness is not unto death but unto the glory and praise of God. Again, it doesn’t mean God afflicts people with sickness and diseases to show His glory, but rather, when the adversary strikes people with any infirmities, because of God’s healing power, many sees God’s glory and give praise to Him. Now Mary and Martha were to hold on to that message and allow it to define their composure. Nevertheless, Martha for example argued and doubted the decision of Jesus to roll away Lazarus’ tomb. Look at this, John 11:38-40 (TPT):” Then Jesus, with intense emotions, came to the tomb—a cave with a stone placed over its entrance. Jesus told them, “Roll away the stone.”Then Martha said, “But Lord, it’s been four days since he died—by now his body is already decomposing!”Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?” I believe Jesus had to look at her with astonishment, because prior to this time He had said a lot to Martha and Mary about He being the resurrection and the life. Martha was not holding on to the Words of Jesus.
Until you hold on to the Word of God, you will not demonstrate absolute confidence in God.
“So they rolled away the heavy stone. Jesus gazed into heaven and said, “Father, thank you that you have heard my prayer, for you listen to every word I speak. Now, so that these who stand here with me will believe that you have sent me to the earth as your messenger, I will use the power you have given me.” Then with a loud voice Jesus shouted with authority: “Lazarus! Come out of the tomb!”Then in front of everyone, Lazarus, who had died four days earlier, slowly hobbled out—he still had grave clothes tightly wrapped around his hands and feet and covering his face! Jesus said to them, “Unwrap him and let him loose.” From that day forward many of those who had come to visit Mary believed in him, for they had seen with their own eyes this amazing miracle! John 11:41-45 (TPT). Oh hallelujah! Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. Don’t look at the challenges to doubt God. Make the Word of the Lord your focus and you will see the manifestation of His glory. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(John 11; Hebrews 11) WE PRAYThat no matter the opposition which will confront us, we shall not cast away our confidence in God and that we will remain resolute and indefatigable to work towards the Kingdom goals or targets given us.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 18-202 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My time of harvest is here and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary.– I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1039 - LABOUR IN PRAYER FOR YOUR PASTOR
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No child of God must operate with the mindset of scarcity. The purpose of God for your life is resourced according to the provision of God. Selah. Author Thursday, 27th, November, 2025 LABOUR IN PRAYER FOR YOUR PASTOR“But I beg of you my brethren, by our Lord Yeshua the Messiah and by the love of The Spirit, that you labor with me in prayer to God for me.”Romans 15:30 (ABPE)The gap between God’s plan and the fulfilment of that plan is God’s people.
Anything God has accomplished on Earth, He did it through His people.
God will always appoint a man among His people to become a voice, a leader and a lighthouse. This is not to create an impression that others are better. This is by the workings of God’s grace.Those leaders God appoints become conduits of His greater works.God has set leaders in the church to be responsible for the growth of each saint and to equip the saints for the spread of the gospel according to the power of the Holy Spirit.
The mindset of the spiritual leaders, will affect the mindset of the people and influence the climate of the Church within a locality.
These leaders in the Church mostly labour for the spread of the gospel. Sometimes most believers assume their leaders are strong in faith and don’t need prayers.It is important you understand that, through prayers, you make the abundant supply of divine grace, strength and provisions in the spirit to your leader. There are many ways the adversary wants to destroy and distract their focus and pursuit of God’s plan.
In the labour of the gospel, people risk their lives and come close to death.
To do the work of the ministry and to spread the gospel is true warfare. And the adversary seeks every opportunity to attack and destroy not only the saints, but mainly the shepherds or those who lead the saints.“…Strike the shepherd and the sheep will be scattered…” (Zechariah 13:7)Epaphroditus was a leader who was assisting Paul on behalf of the saints in Philippi, at the frontline of the ministry, even as Paul was in prison.Paul in his epistles referred to Epaphroditus as “fellow soldier” (Philippians 2:25).This characterizes the nature of the work they were doing. They worked or laboured as fellow soldiers because the work of the ministry is a spiritual warfare.“However, I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, [who has been] my brother and companion and fellow soldier, who was also sent as your messenger to take care of my needs. For he has been longing for all of you and was distressed because you had heard that he was sick. He certainly was sick and close to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, so that I would not have sorrow upon sorrow. So I have sent him all the more eagerly so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less concerned about you. Welcome him home in the Lord with great joy, and appreciate and honor men like him; because he came close to death for the work of Christ, risking his life to complete what was lacking in your service to me [which distance prevented you from rendering personally].” Phillipians 2:25-30 (Amplified Bible)This is the reason Paul’s prayer request in Romans 15:30, unveils the objective of spiritual warfare.
This spiritual warfare against the forces of darkness is mainly to ensure that the gospel of Jesus shall not prevail in all places.
This is war.The adversary is plotting against the Church and the leaders.And for your Church leaders to firmly stand to continue in the labour of the gospel, you must make supplication for them daily.This is to your advantage.Has this with blessed you in any way?Then you must pray for me as well.
There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy.
Beloved, pray and honor those who labour in the gospel of Jesus.Glory to God!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:3; Ephesians 6:19; 2 Corinthians 1:11; Philippians 1:19) WE PRAYPray for your leader, Pastor or shepherd and Teacher of the gospel, that he or she will stand strong in the faith and remain focus in labour of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 21-232 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel.– The Lord is making them increase in boldness.– They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord.– They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power.– They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil.– The faith of the Leaders shall not grow cold. They will increase in the Lord’s zeal and in great faith. Oh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1040 - DON’T DESECRATE YOURSELF
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t waste time on things which don’t contribute to your success. Set daily goals and targets so that you can measure your success and impact. Selah. Author Friday, 28th November, 2025 DON’T DESECRATE YOURSELF“Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?” 1 Corinthians 3:16 (KJV)Most born-agains are not conscious of how sacred they have been made in Christ. To be born again is not only to be justified (declared not guilty or declared righteous). To be born again is to be separated unto God and declared holy. You are holy because God lives in you. As you are made righteous in Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21) and holy, you must live out this righteousness and holiness.“And to be transformed as you embrace the glorious Christ-within as your new life and live in union with him! For God has re-created you all over again in his perfect righteousness, and you now belong to him in the realm of true holiness.” Ephesians 4:24 (TPT)When you became born again, God indwelt you through Christ. Now your body is not just a physical structure which contains the organs and various biological systems. 
Your body is also a vessel which hosts God’s presence.
“Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?” 1 Corinthians 3:16 (KJV)To be God’s temple is to be God’s inner sanctuary. In the Old Covenant, the physical temple hard the outer court, the Holy place and the Most Holy Place. The Most Holy Place was the inner court. And was referred to as the Holiest Place on Earth.The presence of God is no longer in the temple made of hands (Acts 7:48). The veil which separates the Most Holy Place from the Holy Place and the rest of the world was torn in twain, as Jesus hanged on the cross (Luke 23:43-47).Now the Holiest Place on Earth is not in Jerusalem. 
The new creation in Christ is God’s inner sanctuary and the Holiest Place on Earth.
As your body is now the inner sanctuary of God, don’t defile yourself with the activities of this world.You were designed by God to be a vessel of honor. Your operations must be consistent with this reality. Though you are God’s temple you can become a vessel unto dishonor by how you function.There should be no fellowship between you and the world. The more you allow the worldly thought patterns, evil desires, and acts of dishonesty to find expressions through you, the adversary also finds it as an occasion to whisper thoughts of condemnation and guilt.
You are a saint in Christ and made Holy. Refuse to be defiled by this world.
As God’s temple you are God’s property. Let your life and living become a demonstration of His glory.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(John 14:17; 1 Corinthians 3:16-17; 1 Corinthians 6:19-20; 2 Corinthians 6:16; Ephesians 2:21-22; 1 Peter 2:5; 1 Peter 1:15-16) WE PRAYWe pray that by the empowering ability of the Holy Spirit we will daily live the sacred and Holy life of God within us and not permit our hearts to be defiled by this world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANLuke 24John 1-22 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to defile myself with the activities of this world.– I am the temple of God. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – I live above desecration. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1041 - …UNSTABLE IN ALL HIS WAYS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t let life challenges break you! See the trials and challenges as a spiritual refining process. And have the conviction that your glory and celebration are around the corner. Gloreeey! Author Saturday, 29th November, 2025 … UNSTABLE IN ALL HIS WAYS“A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.” James 1:8 (KJV)One term which also has great significance in the New Testament is “Dipsuchos”. This is the Greek word for Double-mindedness.This word “dipsuchos” is generated from the combined words, “di” or “dis” (which means two or twice respectively) and “psuche” (which means soul or mind). It is an adjective which literally describes one who has two minds or one who is two-souled.This is a dangerous projectile that attacks the faith of the believer. Many believers have also had their faith affected by this dangerous virus, which is the cause of spiritual instability.
As James (the apostle) mentioned in his epistle, a double-minded person or two-souled man is unstable in all his ways.
The word unstable is from the Greek word, “akatastatos” which means to be “inconstant”, “restless”, “unsettled” and “disorderly”.This concept of instability can be related to these two Hebrew words:♦ nadad – which means to wander about or to flee from the post.♦ tohu – which also means formlessness and confusion.How can a believer thrive in faith when he is in such a state of mind or soul?To be two-souled is to create two or double will within you. Such a person cannot advance into maturity and cannot be trustworthy.
When you become two-souled, you vacillate in the pursuit of purpose.
Clearly, James (the just apostle) had a poignant tone in this admonishment of double-mindedness.Take a look at the verse in the Passion Translation:“Just make sure you ask empowered by confident faith without doubting that you will receive. For the ambivalent person believes one minute and doubts the next. Being undecided makes you become like the rough seas driven and tossed by the wind. You’re up one minute and tossed down the next. When you are half-hearted and wavering it leaves you unstable. Can you really expect to receive anything from the Lord when you’re in that condition?” James 1:6-8 (TPT)Are you wondering why, you have been a believer for many years and not seeing the growth and stability of life?Wondering why today you are joyful in the Lord, and another time you are overwhelmed in discouragement?Wondering why today you make a decision to go the extra mile for the Lord, and another time you don’t feel motivated?Listen beloved, you have allowed yourself to become two-faced minded. You need to train your mind through the teaching of Christ, to be focused and single-minded.
The adversary takes delight in pushing you into that state of “two-souled” through contrary winds of doctrine.
He uses doctrines which oppose the revelation of Jesus, to forge a different opinion within your heart.You have to see this as warfare, and make a decision to:“…demolish every deceptive fantasy that opposes God and break through every arrogant attitude that is raised up in defiance of the true knowledge of God… capture, like prisoners of war, every thought and insist that it bow in obedience to the Anointed One” 2 Corinthians 10:5 (TPT).This is not something you do tomorrow. It’s a stand you have to take today and must act out, stand firm on the knowledge of Jesus in your heart.“Then we will no longer be like children, forever changing our minds about what we believe because someone has told us something different or has cleverly lied to us and made the lie sound like the truth.” Ephesians 4:14 (TLB)
Beloved, refuse every form of double-mindedness.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:13; Matthew 6:24; 1 Kings 18:21; Matthew 7:24-27; Hebrews 10:23; Galatians 5:17; 1 Corinthians 10:21) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall remain stable in the true knowledge of God in Christ and not be tossed or drifted away by any deceptive and contrary wind. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJohn 3-52 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart remains stable in the true knowledge of God in Christ. – I refuse to be tossed or drifted away by any deceptive and contrary wind. – I maintain and imbue focus on that which the Lord has called me unto. – I refuse to let myself get distracted. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above double-mindedness. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1042 - DON’T WITHHOLD YOUR RESOURCES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Refuse to worry and to look down on yourself. Refuse to accept that it cannot be done. Make a decision to increase in Grace. Turn to God for more grace! Beloved, GOD GIVES GRACE! Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 30th November, 2025DON’T WITHHOLD YOUR RESOURCES “I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward” Philippians 4:17 (TPT)Some saints within the Church easily frown at every conversation which has to do with giving or generosity towards the spread of the gospel. These are untrained men.Some don’t want any conversation about giving or the generosity of the saints because they feel they don’t have the resources to give. But that is a mere demonstration of immaturity or lack of understanding.Others refuse to give because they assume their giving makes the Church leaders rich. These people don’t know the cost of the spread of the gospel.Especially in today’s world, the resources needed to spread the gospel are more costly.When a Church or a ministry desires to massively spread the gospel, they will need to massively commit their resources, because it will cost more. But what is more costly than the blood of Jesus? To reach every soul and to effectively disciple every saint, we must be willing to commit more resources.Nothing about the spread of the gospel comes cheap; from the time needed, the cost of venue, setting up the meeting place according to the requirements of the government, dealing with harsh weather conditions, equipment, supporting the needs of the saints, paying bills and etc, will not come cheap.The generosity of the saints or giving of the saints towards God’s Kingdom mission is an opportunity God gives to the saints to demonstrate their love towards His Kingdom.
Every saint in Christ must take advantage of such an opportunity to demonstrate their participation and love in God’s Kingdom.
The generosity of the saints is the joyful sharing of their treasures (valuable resources) for the advancement of the gospel.The beautiful thing about God’s wisdom in this is that, as you give generously towards the Lord’s work, your love towards the success of His work is deepened.“for where your treasure is, there your heart [your wishes, your desires; that on which your life centers] will be also.” Matthew 6:21 (Amplified Bible)This then means, generosity is not what God demands or wants from you. Generosity is what God wants for you.God is not in need of money. He only wants faithful stewards. He wants men He can trust more and more with His Kingdom resources. Men who will not receive His grace in vain but will faithfully serve His purpose with His grace.This is why, concerning the generosity of the saints, Paul the apostle doesn’t address God’s need but first points out the grace God wants to supply.
Your generosity is first for your benefit. And you must see it as a privilege whenever you have the opportunity to give.
When people think about generosity in the gospel, they first think of it as a means to “increase money” as though it’s another form of lottery.There are fruits which abound towards you. And since there are fruits of generosity, it means there is a principle of multiplication. However, these fruits of multiplication of generosity transcend the idea of coming with little money and taking more money home.There are greater fruits which abound towards you because of your generosity.From the opening verse, you will find that the fruit of generosity brings you abundant reward.These are the things we will explore further as we continue this conversation.Your giving doesn’t make God rich. Get this: God’s blessings make you rich. The giving by God’s people is the means by which God executes His kingdom mandate and dispenses His abundance.After David and His people had given towards His work, He said to the LORD, “But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able thus to offer willingly? For all things come from you, and of your own have we given you.” 1 Chronicles 29:14 (ESV)
You don’t give into God’s work to complete God. You give into God’s work as a demonstration of faithfulness towards Him.
Do you love the Lord?Are you interested in the expansion of the Kingdom?Are you interested in the growth of the saints?Demonstrate your love through your generosity?The LORD has given you grace.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Job 41:11; 2 Corinthians 9:10-11; Proverbs 3:9-10; Deuteronomy 8:17-18; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not withhold our resources from the Lord’s work, but shall enjoy more and more grace to demonstrate our generosity in every way.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJohn 6-82 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1043 - DO YOU FEEL OVERWHELMED?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. Don’t look at the challenges to doubt God. Make the Word of the Lord your focus, and you will see the manifestation of His glory. Shalom! Author Monday, 1st December, 2025DO YOU FEEL OVERWHELMED?"For when I was desperate, overwhelmed, and about to give up, you were the only one there to help. You gave me a way of escape from the hidden traps of my enemies." Psalm 142:3 (TPT)A new month is here, and today marks the beginning of the last month in the year 2025 (in most parts of the world).You might have started this day recounting the plans you had at the beginning of the year. And may feel there is more you could have done. You may also be appreciative of some success.Whether you have seen great success or not, refuse to be overwhelmed.These recent times, the phrase, "I feel overwhelmed or this thing is overwhelming" has become  one of the common phrases . However, no matter how you can justify your reason for feeling overwhelmed, that feeling exposes a state of mind.
To be overwhelmed simply means, you are not working with God. It means you have relied on your own strength.
"Trust in and rely confidently on the LORD with all your heart. And do not rely on your own insight or understanding. In all your ways know and acknowledge and recognize Him, And He will make your paths straight and smooth [removing obstacles that block your way]." Proverbs 3:5-6 (Amplified Bible)Though there may be obstacles and rough paths in your life journey, the Lord straightens, making your paths smooth and removed obstacles as you trust in Him.It is not God's desire that you will be overwhelmed by challenges and discomforting situations. He wants you to have His peace, in the midst of these challenging times.To be overwhelmed means you have allowed your mind to be disarranged or cluttered by wrong thoughts of the adversary.He makes you feel tired and accept weakness. Don't white-wash the concept or idea of being overwhelmed. It is not normal, neither is of God.To be overwhelmed doesn't mean you are doing alot of things. It means you are fighting without God. It means you are doing things without God's sufficient supply.Mental fatigue, confusion and anxiety are not items in God. Paul said to the church in Philippi, "Be anxious for nothing...!" (Philippians 4:6)He didn't just instruct the saints not to be anxious, he gave them the solution and the outcome of the solution.- Be anxious for nothing...Solution: PRAY, supplication with thanksgiving.The outcome: The PEACE of God shall garrison your heart.God's peace settles your mind to prevail, even when you are encircled by daunting tasks.He wants to be your rest amidst the storm.Jesus said, "Peace I leave with you; *my peace I give you*. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid" John 14:27 (NIV)David made a profound statement about the Lord:"He refreshes and restores my soul (life); He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name’s sake. Even though I walk through the [sunless] valley of the shadow of death I fear no evil, for You are with me..."Each day of your life becomes onerous when you don't focus on the Lord's peace.The more your mind settles on the vicissitudes, the more you feel overwhelmed, desperate and crushed. Don't allow your thoughts to obstructs or wreck  your mind. You enjoy perfect peace when your mind stays on the Lord (Isaiah 26:). Love on and meditate on the goodnews of Jesus.Lay your hands on your head and declare, my mind is anointed with the Lord's goodness. Thoughts of grace saturate my mind. And I enjoy the help of the LORD.HallelujahDIG DEEPER:(Psalm 119:165; Colossians 3:15; 2 Thessalonians 3:16; Matthew 11:28-30; Psalm 18:6) WE PRAYWe pray that our thoughts will serve the Lord and not become channels of wreck to our minds. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJohn 9-112 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:- My thoughts are settled on the Lord.- I don’t allow my thoughts to obstructs my mind.- I enjoy the peace of God daily.- I am anxious for nothing.- I don’t permit any situation to disturb my peace.- My mind is anointed with the Lord’s goodness.- Thoughts of grace saturate my mind.- I enjoy the help of God.Oh Gloreeey! Thank you Lord Jesus

title: EPISODE 1044 - YOUR SEASON IS HERE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be a leading example in word, in manner of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and purity. No wonder Jesus said, You are the light of the world and the salt of the earth. You have a call of God on your life to LEAD YOUR GENERATION, take a STEP TO MAKE IT HAPPEN. Selah. Author Tuesday, 2nd December, 2025YOUR SEASON IS HERE“Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.” 1 Peter 5:6 – 7 (NKJV) The Lord does not forsake His own. The scriptures are divine scripts which outline your beautiful future. There is nothing about your destiny which is not prophetically illustrated in the scriptures.
Your life may seem to be a mystery in the natural, but scripturally it is decoded.
Don’t allow the limitations of your senses and experiences to define your life. Sink your thoughts in the word of God. The more you pay attention to your challenges, the more you distract yourself from what God is doing with you.  “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end” Jeremiah 29:11 (KJV). There is an expected end the Lord has for you. And you must make that your focus. 
One of the expectations you must have as you humble yourself to make the Lord your focus is EXALTATION.
Don’t spend time feeding your mind with doubts. When the doubts come, cast it off. Learn to doubt your doubts. Your humility before the Lord is the secret to enjoying divine exaltation. It is not that God demands your humility before He exalts you. It is because humility is a principle of faith which produces exaltation. To humble yourself before the Lord is explained in the opening verse. “…casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.” I Peter 5: 7 (NKJV)
To humble yourself under the mighty hand of God is basically to cast all your cares upon Him; with the conviction of heart that He cares for you.
When you don’t humble yourself under the mighty hand of God, you have exalted yourself above the mighty hand of God. What you are saying is, you don’t need the mighty hand of God to lift you and sustain you. You rather want to trust in your own strength. You don’t need God’s supernatural help. You trust in your own ability rather than the ability of God. It is as simple as that! But come to think of it, what more can your strength achieve? Begin to train your heart to exercise absolute confidence in God by acknowledging the glorious things He has done. “Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us–none can compare to You–if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.” (Psalm 40:5) Instead of counting your failures which will make you turn away from God, consider His goodness according to His power. It will cause you to humble yourself patiently under His mighty hand for your exaltation. Beloved, what are the things troubling your heart?
Cast all your cares unto the Lord and patiently stay under His mighty hand with humility. For the Lord shall exalt you in due season.
Do you know the good news? The due season is already here! That is why you are reading today’s with .  REMAIN EXPECTANT FOR YOUR TESTIMONY Shalom Aleichem. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 24:14; Psalm 37:37; Jeremiah 29:11; James 4:10; Job 36:22) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for the wisdom to stay humble under the mighty hand of the Lord and for this glorious new season of exaltation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJohn 12-142 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– This is my time of exaltation and I don’t permit any distraction from the adversary. – I refuse to doubt God, I hold on strongly to what God has said. – No challenge is big enough to move me away from God. – I don’t permit any voice to distract me from the sure word of God. – I imbue focus to maintain absolute confidence in God. – Through prayer and the study of the word I build more absolute confidence in God. – I don’t give my mind to the negative situations around me, I make the word of God my focus. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1045 - REFUSE TO BE DISTRACTED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t give your heart to the hearing of negative words. These words are possessed by the Spirit of fear, condemnation, lust, greediness and envy. Be soaked with the presence of the Holy Spirit as you set your heart on the hearing of faith! Selah. Author Wednesday 3rd, December, 2025 REFUSE TO BE DISTRACTED “Eliab, his older brother, heard David fraternizing with the men and lost his temper: “What are you doing here! Why aren’t you minding your own business, tending that scrawny flock of sheep? I know what you’re up to. You’ve come down here to see the sights, hoping for a ringside seat at a bloody battle!”1 Samuel 17:28 (Message)Eliab as an older brother to David may have genuine concern about the well-being of David. And sometimes such concern can be a limitation to your advancement into greatness.However, a careful observation of Eliab’s words to David also exposed Eliab’s mindset concerning David. Apart from his mindset concerning David, other details also exposed his mindset about challenges.The presence of Goliath was the boundary or the end of Eliab’s boldness. He was part of the army of Israel which fell back and was frightened at the appearance of Goliath.Eliab had an attractive appearance but was a coward at heart. He looked more like a real man on the outside but was a crying vulnerable baby at heart.
He lacked what it takes to go for the lion’s share.
David was different. Outwardly he didn’t look like a strong tough soldier, but he had the heart of God. David was full of “God-fidence”(the confidence of God).Each morning, Goliath cursed and threatened the Israelites and none of them spoke back at him. They were rather frightened and fell back at his presence.Instead of confronting the challenge they rather talk among themselves:“…The talk among the troops was, “Have you ever seen anything like this, this man openly and defiantly challenging Israel? The man who kills the giant will have it made. The king will give him a huge reward, offer his daughter as a bride, and give his entire family a free ride.” 1 Samuel 17:24-25 (Message)See David’s first reaction to Goliath:“David, who was talking to the men standing around him, asked, “What’s in it for the man who kills that Philistine and gets rid of this ugly blot on Israel’s honor? Who does he think he is, anyway, this uncircumcised Philistine, taunting the armies of God-Alive?” 1 Samuel 17:26 (Message)At no point was he intimidated by the presence of Goliath.
The boldness of David was bigger than the whole army of Israel.
Now comes in Eliab; the fine handsome gentleman. The big brother who thought he knew better and understood the destiny and the place of David than God:“Eliab, his older brother, heard David fraternizing with the men and lost his temper: “What are you doing here! Why aren’t you minding your own business, tending that scrawny flock of sheep? I know what you’re up to. You’ve come down here to see the sights, hoping for a ringside seat at a bloody battle!” 1 Samuel 17:28 (Message)Eliab didn’t think, the business of Israel is also the business of David. He wondered why this little boy David, poked his nose into matters “greater” than him.By fact, Eliab may be right.David was just a shepherd boy. And also was not at the age to be enlisted for war.He has to be at least 20 years old or older (Numbers 1:3)
Nevertheless, the capacity to show up with God and stand with your leader is not in age, but in the condition of heart.
Eliab was judging David by his own perception and state of heart. But it was God who was working in David.Sometimes by all the standards of men, you don’t seem to be qualified to do the things God has called you to do.You may have a Christian big brother or sister, a prayerful relative, a lecturer, a colleague, or a seemingly God-fearing boss at work; who may take up the position of Eliab in your life.
He or she may have good intentions for you but can become the voice of discouragement in your life.
He or she may even ask or tell you:– “The way you have taken ministry and kingdom matters seriously, are you Jesus Christ?”– “Every day you are involved in ministry. Do you think you are the only born again?”– “Do you know how long I have served the Lord, and the things I have done for the Lord? If there is a reward will I be at this level?”– “Do you think you have what it takes to do big things? You are wasting time, just find somewhere to sit and mind your own business.”
Don’t be disrespectful, just do as David did; see it as a distraction, turn away and focus on the goal.
The thing is, the devil will not inspire you to show up with Jesus and stand with the Kingdom assignment.The devil will not inspire you to take bold steps for the Lord.Whatever you are inspired to do, it is God who is working in you both to will and to do for His good pleasure. (Philippians 2:13).
Refuse to be distracted.
Selah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17;  Romans 16:1-10; 2 Timothy 4:14-17; 1 Thessalonians 5:14; Matthew 16:21-23) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain resolute to show up with Jesus at all times and not yield to any voice of discouragement. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJohn 15-172 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I maintain my focus on the goal as I gaze my eyes on Jesus who is my example of faith. – I run the race set before me with all conviction and passion of heart. – I am not coward at heart. – I take daring steps. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1046 - GOD IS MERCIFUL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, don’t be afraid. The Lord knows what is at stake. He will not leave you. He is strongly holding your hand and is with you as your helper. Depend on Him at all times. Shalom! Author Thursday, 4th December, 2025GOD IS MERCIFUL“So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who shows mercy”Romans 9:16 (NKJV)Are you already beating yourself up for your failures?You seem to think you have tried all you can, and nothing beautiful seems to happen?Are you already discouraged about the outcome of the year?Are you thinking the year will end with you as a failure?Do you think your mistakes are too huge for God to help you?Or do you think all that God is plotting is how to destroy you?Before you throw in the towel.Before you give up. Before you think there is no help for you and it is all over.PAUSE TO PONDER on this:
GOD IS MERCIFUL!
It is not how good or smart you think you are.It is not how well you are connected.It is not your effort or your plans.It is not the size of your offense.Turn to God to RECEIVE HIS MERCY!The concept of God’s mercy has not really been understood and esteemed by most brethren in Christ.Others even think since they are now in Christ, they don’t need the mercy of God. Some also think the Grace of God is greater than the Mercy of God.The concept of God’s Mercy is not limited to the Old Testament.
The concept of God’s Mercy is a picture of His heart.
GOD IS MERCIFUL!“But the Lord our God is merciful and forgiving…” Daniel 9:9 (NLT).All that God is, is Eternal or forever and ever. Therefore, God’s Mercy is not temporal. God’s Mercy is the attitude of His heart. His MERCY IS FOREVER (Jeremiah 33:11).Understand that the entire work of Salvation began with the Mercy of God. The eternal work of salvation is not only by grace. It is also according to the richness of God’s Mercy.Even though your new birth in Christ is by grace through faith, it is according to the great Mercy of God.“Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead” 1 Peter 1:3 (ESV)The Mercy of God is the game changer; it showed up for man to make the difference (when by corruptibility, all hope was lost for man).In the most hopeless situation, God’s Mercy brings new hope to you.In the New Testament, we see the fullness of God’s Mercy.
He is IMMENSE IN MERCY. For God to be immense in Mercy means He is full and rich in Mercy.
“But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us, even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;) And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus” Ephesians 2:4-6 (KJV)The opening verses of Ephesians 2 (see verse 1 – 3) points out the hopeless state of Man before Salvation, BUT God’s richness in Mercy made the difference:– Dead in trespasses and sins. BUT GOD…– Walked according to or controlled by the course of this world, the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience. BUT GOD!…– Lived in the lusts of their flesh. BUT GOD!…– Fulfilling the desires of the flesh and the mind. BUT GOD!– Were by nature the children of wrath and destined for eternal condemnation and punishment. BUT GOD!
You may currently look at yourself and feel your faith has become weak. BUT GOD!
No matter your present state and how worse things are, the answer has always been in Ephesians 2:4…“BUT GOD, WHO IS RICH IN MERCY…”It is not “but your hard work and strength”.
IT IS BUT GOD WHO IS IMMENSE IN MERCY.
The blind man, when he heard of Jesus passing by, cried out, saying, “Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me”. (Luke 18:38).Precious one, it is not how high you always think your faith is. Maybe you may think you have not increased much in faith, so there is no hope for you. Cheer up!JESUS IS MERCIFUL. Praise and thank Him for HIS SURE MERCIES on your life.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 80:14; Psalm 136; Lamentations 3:22-24; Hebrews 4:16; 1 Peter 5:10; Psalm 30:10) WE PRAYThat we shall experience the rich mercies of God every day of our lives and in all matters. In Jesus’ glorious name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANJohn 18-202 YEARS PLAN2 Kings 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be proud in my efforts.– I receive the mercies of God in all I do.– God is merciful to me at all times.– I humbly rejoice in the richness of God’s Mercy. Thank you Lord Jesus for your SURE MERCIES!

title: EPISODE 1049 - TIME STEWARDSHIP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The born-again must submit his mind and thoughts to be renewed by the Spirit of the Lord and the revelation of the Scriptures. When your mind is renewed by the word of God, your imagination will not become a hindrance to what God is saying to you. A mind shaped by the Word of God becomes a pathway for the voice of the Lord. Selah. Author Sunday, 7th December, 2025 TIME STEWARDSHIP “So then each of us shall give account of himself to God.”Romans 14:16 (NKJV)Time is a spot in eternity, however, whatever is done in time has a lot of impact in eternity.It is one of the resources of God given to each person.Nobody has more done 24 hours or less than 24 hours.Every single individual has the same quantity of time each day. The quality of time each person will have is dependent on their diligence as faithful stewards.
Whatever you will accomplish on Earth is also determined by how you effectively use time.
In as much as it may seem there is not enough time, time is really enough for each day. It is God who determined the day and the night. He knew we can make the most of the time we have if only we are not going to be wasteful.When it comes to the pursuit of purpose, we must always have a sense of urgency and a consciousness to utilize time wisely. Time is not to be wasted; it has to be managed properly.So the Psalmist said:“Teach us to use wisely all the time we have” Psalm 90:12 (Contemporary English Version)As stewards of God’s resources, we must also know that all the time we have is also given to us by God.Time is part of God’s possession and He has graciously given it to us to manage as stewards. Your faithful management of time will also determine whether you are a faithful steward or not.When people talk about time management they don’t think of it in the light of stewardship. They think of using time to accomplish personal goals.
Time management is not proper management until it is seen in the light of stewardship.
To manage time is not just how you use time to satisfy your personal goals which doesn’t bring glory to God.To manage time is to first know that you don’t own time and you are only a steward of the original owner – God.He has given you the gift of time to carry out His task assigned to you.
When all you use your time for is what pleases you, you are not managing time faithfully.
Your walk must be pleasing to the Lord, including how you use time.“So as to walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him: bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God” Colossians 1:10 (ESV)To manage time is still time wastage when it is not seen as time stewardship.“Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, making the best use of the time, because the days are evil. Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is“ Ephesians 5:15-17 (ESV)
The understanding of the will of God will cause you to wisely make the best use of your time.
Selah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 39:4-5; Ecclesiastes 3:11;  Proverbs 12:11; Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAYWe pray that asking that the Lord will teach us to use wisely all the time we have. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 6-82 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. – I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. – I keep a sense of urgency in all things.– I am a faithful steward.– I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1050 - A CRUCIAL ASSET FOR RELEVANCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency It is not possible to follow the Lord and be controlled by challenges. The beautiful thing is that your walk with the Lord makes you bold. To follow the Lord is to be conquered by the presence and power of the Lord. No matter where you find yourself fear will not conquer you. You just know the Lord is with you. SELAH. Author Monday, 8th December, 2025 A CRUCIAL ASSET FOR RELEVANCE “So then each of us shall give account of himself to God.” Romans 14:16 (NKJV)God’s goal for this physical world or earth is for the expression of Himself and His Kingdom. 
One of the most important assets given to man for the fulfillment of God’s purpose and vision is TIME.
Though God is eternal and has also set eternity in our hearts, He has set a determined time for each person to accomplish His assignment on Earth.With the things God has entrusted to us to accomplish we don’t have eternity to fulfill it; though we have eternity to enjoy all that we will accomplish. Our operation on earth is time-bound.Jesus said, “We must quickly carry out the tasks assigned us by the one who sent us. The night is coming, and then no one can work.” John 9:4 (NLT)The time you have, is to carry out God’s task assigned to you.Time is an asset available for every person whether born again or not. However, what each person will achieve within time will be with the person for eternity.This is what makes time a sensitive asset or resource for man. It must not be wasted or misused since whatever you do with time will be an impression of you all through eternity. As I have explained before, time is a spot in eternity. However, whatever is done in time has a lot of impact in eternity.Jesus stepped into time and all that which He accomplished within the space of about 33 years, produced and established a nonpareil impact in eternity.All men are by themselves God’s investment and all men also have the gift of time. What you do with time determines your relevance in the Kingdom of God.Now also, as you may know, no single person has more time than the other. Everyone has the same quantity of 60 seconds, 60 minutes and 24 hours each day. No one has 26 hours a dayThe quality of your time or the day is by the investment you make with it.
How are you using your time to serve God and fulfill His purpose?
Your entire being is the first and the most important investment of God for His Kingdom. And the time you have is a resource given to you by God to carry out your mission.When the time to carry out God’s purpose is consummated, you will one day make an account to God, as to how you lived your life and how you used the time given you to serve His purpose.Sometimes people assume that the days to work will not come to an end.The Psalmist knowing this asked of the Lord:“Help us to remember that our days are numbered, and help us to interpret our lives correctly. Set your wisdom deeply in our hearts so that we may accept your correction.” Psalm 90:12 (TPT)Let me resound this to you; YOU DON’T HAVE ETERNITY TO CARRY OUT GOD’S ASSIGNMENT. You have eternity to enjoy the reward of what you did in time.You must always remember that the time you have will not be forever. Can’t you see how each day of the week doesn’t exist forever?If you patiently participate in the Bible reading plan and even fellowship with each episode of with , you will observe that the days are not waiting.Read Psalm 90:12 from the Contemporary English Version:“Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.”What are you doing with all the time you have?How is God glorified in each day of your life?How are you urgently carrying out God’s assignment in your life?When all of time has consummated will God celebrate you as a good and faithful steward?Will you be reckoned as good and faithful steward?Beloved, make the most of your time!Selah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 39:4-5; Ecclesiastes 3:11; Ephesians 5:15-16; Proverbs 12:11; Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAYWe pray that asking that the Lord will teach us to use wisely all the time we have. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 9-112 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – Whatever the Lord has entrusted into my hands to do, I do it with all diligence and I see the results thereof. – I make each day count for the assignment the Lord has entrusted unto me. – I keep a sense of urgency in all things.– I am a faithful steward.– I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1051 - YOUR LIFE IS GOD’S INVESTMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t spend your time, your thoughts, money, attention, and energy on the things of men like there is no cause. It is now your time to go all out for Jesus! It is your time to finish the course of Christ. SELAH. Author Tuesday, 9th December, 2025 YOUR LIFE IS GOD’S INVESTMENT “So then each of us shall give account of himself to God.” Romans 14:16 (NKJV)There are many who want to be known as faithful stewards by how they manage other resources of God. They don’t consider themselves as God’s resource to be managed.
You have to know that your life is an investment of God for the expansion of His Kingdom.
You will find true meaning in life when you use your life to serve God’s Kingdom mission and to express His glory.The concept of God’s stewardship is not only how you take care of things and also utilize these things for the purpose of God; the concept of God’s Stewardship first begins with how you take care of yourself and also live to serve His purpose.You belong to God and He has graciously made you a steward of your life.Your entire being is the first and the most important investment of God for His Kingdom. And as a steward, you will one day make an account to God, as to how you lived your life to serve His purpose. “For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us].” Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified Bible)As a steward of the life God has given you, it is important to walk according to the path God has set for you. You can’t live contrary to what God has ordained for you and be counted as a faithful steward.Just as God’s resources must be used for His purpose as He has prearranged, even so must you live according to what the Lord has prearranged.The arrangement of God for your life is to bring you to a successful end. God has designed your life for His glory.
Whatever you do must bring glory to Him. He made your entire being for His service.
After God brought Israel out of Egypt and led them further to possess the promised land (through the investment of His power or enormous strength and wisdom), Moses stood before the assembly of Israel and addressed them saying:“So now Israel, what do you think God expects from you? Just this: Live in his presence in holy reverence, follow the road he sets out for you, love him, serve God, your God, with everything you have in you“ Deuteronomy 10:12 (The Message)To serve God with everything you have in you is also to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul. It is to serve Him with every potential the Lord has deposited inside you.Moses the Prophet of God, went on to explain to the congregation of Israel why they have to serve the LORD with everything in them:“Look around you: Everything you see is God’s—the heavens above and beyond, the Earth, and everything on it.” Deuteronomy 10:14 (The Message)
Whatever you have belongs to God, including your life and must be used for God’s glory.
Never be part of those who make claims like; “My life is mine and can decide to do whatever I want to do with it”.Some also go like, “My money is mine and can spend it how I want”.Whether you live diligently as a steward or not, a time will come when you will definitely give an account of yourself to God.Will you be reckoned as a good and faithful steward?Selah.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 22:37; Romans 12:1; Colossians 3:23; 1 Corinthians 4:17;  1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall apply our hearts to wisdom and live according to the Lord’s prearranged path set before us.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 12-142 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I apply my heart to wisdom to live according to the Lord’s prearranged path set before me. – I serve as a faithful steward.– I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1052 - BUILD SPIRITUAL MASTERY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must have a great sense of responsibility to make a difference in your world. Let this character of exceptionalism be in you; because you are destined for greatness. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 10th December, 2025 BUILD SPIRITUAL MASTERY “For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places” Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)The things which dominate the affairs of men are spiritual.
 No one exercises dominion among men without first building spiritual mastery.
The quest for supremacy is more spiritual than physical. Fulfilling your divine purpose and impacting your generation will involve more than physical activities.There are unseen forces which will oppose your vision and your plans.
See your pursuit of purpose as war!
People don’t just walk in manifestations of glory. Every glory you see first begins as grace. The disposition of grace on your innermost being will determine the manifestation of glory. The adversary distracts your disposition through deceptive thoughts (2 Corinthians 11:3). The Lord also builds you up through the revelation of His Word (Acts 20:32).After Jesus had asked the disciples, “Who do men say I am?“, and also asked His disciples to share who they believe He is; look at Jesus’ response to Peter:“Simon Peter answered and said, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”Jesus answered and said to him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but My Father who is in heaven“ Matthew 16:16-17 (NKJV)Jesus acknowledged how the unseen realm can influence our thoughts and what we do.None of the people around understood how Peter was able to rightly utter the revelation of Jesus. But Jesus having the understanding of how things happen behind the scenes was able to tell the supernatural involvement in Peter’s revelation.It was not by flesh and blood!
It was by the supernatural influence of God.
Precious one, there are unseen influences in this world. Stop trying to deal with matters only by how you see things in the physical. Allow your heart to be cultured and to develop mastery in dealing with issues from the unseen.This is the work of the Word of God in your life. 
The word of God cultures and empowers you to exercise dominion in the unseen realm according to the knowledge of Christ.
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Matthew 16:16-17, 21 – 23; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Mark 9:25; Romans 13:12; Ephesians 4:14; Acts 5:3; John 13:2; James 4:7; Philippians 2:13) WE PRAY We pray that we shall be prompt to the supernatural influence of the Holy Spirit in our hearts. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 15-172 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live my life from the realm of the spirit. – I guard my heart with all diligence against every evil or negative thought of the adversary. – I am conscious of my spiritual essence. – I am a spirit led man. – I don’t take my spirituality for granted. – I live an extraordinary life. – I increase daily in the understanding of the function of my spirituality. Oh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1053 - EXCUSES ARE FOR THE UNTRAINED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Pray long in the Spirit as you go about your daily activities. Speak in tongues often to be charged up for greater action. This is how you set yourself up to shine. Shalom! Author Thursday, 11th December, 2025EXCUSES ARE FOR THE UNTRAINED “I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus” Philippians 3:14 (KJV)Do you know why very few people are doing great things for God?Most people easily settle for less and also choose the easy path. Most people are not willing to share in the desire of the Lord. They live with the mantra:“Whatever will be, will be”. Therefore, there is no need to press on when things seem impossible.But that is not faith-living. Have you ever failed to do what you are instructed to do in Church, and do you think God understands that you failed? Or did you fail to act on the Word of God and think He still understands? Sometimes, even before you make that mistake or decide not to honour that instruction, you yield to the idea that God will understand your choice. Is it to comfort yourself for that wrong, or use that to affirm your excuses? How do you think God understands? And what do you mean by “God understands”? As in, God is ready to go against His Word and the governing light of His economy? There is nothing you can do in God without a bold step of faith. David didn’t automatically defeat Goliath. He has to take a bold step. Complacency has no space in the Kingdom. You have to press on to the price of high calling.
Whenever God entrust a target into your heart, you have to invest in prayer without excuses.
When you fail to pray, don’t make the excuse that, “Oh, though I have failed to pray, God understands my situation”. “Oh God understands if I don’t preach in the bus, or don’t win a soul in the school.” “God understands if I don’t excel in the workplace.” “There is always another time, if I failed today, I will get it right tomorrow, and God understands”. The more you think this way, the more you keep procrastinating.Yes, God understands, right? So you justify your failure and laziness with:“Don’t try too hard to complete the task you are expected to do, after all, you can’t do everything till you depart from Earth.” “Take it easy, God understands your situation. It is not by force to wake up early to pray or start your day with prayer.” “If you miss Church meetings, there is no harm; God understands”. “Just live your life and do what you feel you can do. God understands, and He will not kill you for not doing it.” “God knows your heart. What you are able to do and not able to do doesn’t really matter to God, but the condition of your heart.”Does God truly understand things the way we claim He understands?Does God water down His plans and assignments for us because of our situations or challenges? Does God even have standards, and does He uphold His standards? Some of these thoughts may seem justifiable, but understand that in as much as,GOD LOVES YOU, HE ESTEEMS HIS WORD, HIS PLANS AND PURPOSES.
God will not change His plans because of your excuses, challenges and situations.
God will not pause His eternal plan to wait for you to resolve your challenges. Though our walk with God is not mechanical but essentially organic, it is not without a well-established system. Don’t be quick to quote this: “This High Priest of ours understands our weaknesses…” Hebrews 4:15 (NLT) “For we do not have a high priest incapable of sympathizing with our weaknesses…” (NET Bible) And then arrive at this conclusion:“You see, there it goes, our High Priest sympathises with our weaknesses. Don’t trouble yourself, if you can you can, if you can’t you can’t.”“Everyone has a weakness and God understands.”Really? Is that the implication of this verse?Don’t be too quick to end there. Get this, the LORD TRULY understands our weaknesses! Glory to God.However, get it in perspective.“Inasmuch then as we [believers] have a great High Priest who has [already ascended and] passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession [of faith and cling tenaciously to our absolute trust in Him as Savior]. For we do not have a High Priest who is unable to sympathize and understand our weaknesses and temptations, but One who has been tempted [knowing exactly how it feels to be human] in every respect as we are, yet without [committing any] sin.Therefore let us [with privilege] approach the throne of grace [that is, the throne of God’s gracious favor] with confidence and without fear, so that we may receive mercy [for our failures] and find [His amazing] grace to help in time of need [an appropriate blessing, coming just at the right moment]. for he faced all of the same testings we do, yet he did not sin.” Hebrews 4:14-16 (AMP) SURE, contextually, this chapter has an extensive matters discussed than what we are looking into here. Nevertheless, the above verses provide the answer that puts our thoughts in the right perspective. Jesus being our High Priest:a. Sympathises and understands our weaknesses and temptations.b. He is able to sympathise and understand because He faced what we face as men.c. And He did not fail when He faced these temptations or challenges.d. He doesn’t just understand your weaknesses and failures, He also doesn’t want you to remain in that failure. He wants you to advance beyond the realm of that failure and weakness.c. He wants us to also enjoy the victory He had over all the things He faced.d. He didn’t just “correct” your failures, but supplies you with the richness of Himself for your living.e. He has made a provision for you to have limitless access to the rich supplies He had. He has given you limitless access to the throne of Grace. Not just GRACE but to the source and governing realm of GRACE for your continued supply and enjoyment of GRACE as much as you need or will take.f. Therefore, hold fast, cling tenaciously to Him in an absolute trust.Beloved, because God understands your weaknesses and incapabilities, He has provided or supplied you with all the grace and help you need for exercising yourself unto godliness.
Don’t settle for less with many excuses.
The LORD’S DELIGHT IS THAT YOU LIVE THE FULLNESS OF THE LIFE HE HAS GIVEN YOU NOW.When it feels like you just can’t do it, don’t give up and don’t settle for less. PRESS ON! Be tenacious in the Lord, for He is YOUR STRENGTH.DON’T DO WHAT YOU CAN, DO WHAT GOD WANTS YOU TO DO BY TAKING ADVANTAGE OF GRACE.Press on! Enlarge the scope of your vision and desire. The extra mile is for those who dare to be EXTRA.YOU ARE SUPPLIED WITH ALL YOU NEED BY THE LORD.
You have the Holy Spirit in you for the EXTRAORDINARY, don’t make excuses.
Excuses are for the untrained. Beloved, have the mindset of a KINGDOM CHAMPION. Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 9:24; Hebrews 3:1; 2 Corinthians 4:17-18; 1 Thessalonians 2:12) WE PRAY That we will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing to remain resolute in pressing on with any target or assignment He has committed to our trust. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 18-202 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling. – I don’t give excuses, I get the job done. – Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on. – I don’t stop halfway, I press on. – I go the extra mile. – I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord. – I do the extraordinary. – I am a Champion. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1054 - HAVE I NOT COMMANDED YOU?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The scriptures says, Samson achieved more in his death than his entire life. When God’s mercy showed up, Samson achieved more in a day than what he did in 20 years. Beloved, “IT IS NOT OVER YET!!” Hallelujah! Author Friday, 12th December, 2025HAVE I NOT COMMANDED YOU?“Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go” Joshua 1:9 (NKJV)Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith. It is by faith we live and walk with God.
Faith is our reality.
The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them.Anything that brings glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith). Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said. It is knowing without any tittle of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do. Faith is audacious in its dealings. When you act in faith, courage is seen. This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life.And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness.Serving others is greatness; however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation. A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss.Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father’s house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh.He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites, but felt enervated. Maybe you are reading this and feel you don’t have what it takes to do great things.When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community, you can’t do anything great for the Lord.
Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!!
God specialises in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations.That is God. He will always use what seems depleted to reveal His glory.He used a young man who was the least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory in Israel. He made mighty men out of men that were distressed, indebted, and discontented (1 Samuel 22:2). Why must God use a young 17 years old David, with no military experience, to defeat Goliath with just a sling and a stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53)? To feed five thousand people, He used a little boy’s lunch pack of five bread and two fish.This is audacity!!!
God doesn’t choose the easy paths; He creates greatness out of what seems impossible.
To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord. “Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus.”Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward. You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room. You will look for places to show forth His glory and power.Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you.
Until you take a step to do something great, you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord.
God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary! Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAY Lord, I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 21-232 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work. – I am strong and courageous. – I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary. – I live above this world. – I do the unimaginable. – I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me. – I am audacious. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1055 - YOUR IMAGINATION INFLUENCES YOUR POSSESSION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Jesus had a burning passion for God’s house. He was ready to put His life on the line just to enforce the will of God. Culture your heart to burn with zeal towards God’s assignment. You remain blessed. Selah. Author Saturday, 13th December, 2025YOUR IMAGINATION INFLUENCES YOUR POSSESSION “And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.” Joshua 6:2 (NKJV)To fulfill ministry and accomplish great things, may seem to be challenging. Others are sometimes discouraged by the magnitude of the task.God doesn’t just want you to move into action.Accomplishing great things for the Lord doesn’t just come by trying to do something.You must have the right vision if you want to accomplish your task or hit your target.
Your ability to do more begins with what you see and how you see what you see.
Oftentimes the Lord charges His people to see.This is because you cannot experience what you have not seen with your heart or the spirit of your mind.To take over a city or win a town for Jesus through the gospel, you must first SEE!You cannot transform lives and bless your school, institution, or workplace until you see with the spirit of your mind.You must see your healing testimony. You must see the growth of your business. You must see your new level of impact.Look at what God said to Joshua:“And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.” Joshua 6:2 (NKJV).This was a charge to Joshua to activate the power of his imagination.  
Your imagination influences your possession.
This was the same thing God said to Abraham and Moses:“I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession.” Genesis 13:15 (NLT).Oh, glory!Abraham’s possession was dependent on His vision. If Abraham had seen just a small portion, that was what he would have had. If Abraham had seen the whole world, that was what He was going to have.“See, I have set the land before you; go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—to give to them and their descendants after them.” Deuteronomy 1:8 (NKJV)
Beloved, what do you SEE?
Which results are you seeing now?These are not some words of encouragement. I am talking to you about a divine principle that works. You cannot accomplish anything beyond what you have SEEN.Jesus said, “…lift up your eyes, and see that the fields are white for harvest.” John 4:35
 Train your mind to see the right results.
When you begin to see images you don’t want, shift your mind from them and redirect your imagination to the glorious pictures and results the Lord has deposited in your spirit.This is why you must study the Word and pray in tongues. When you pray, the Lord shows you visions. He unveils to your heart great and mighty things (Jeremiah 33:3)Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:10-12; Isaiah 28:16; Joshua 8:1; Deut. 1:6-8) WE PRAYThat we will not be overwhelmed by the challenges that confront us but rather we will be strengthened with the grace to see the right results with our hearts at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 24-262 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to see the challenges, I see possibilities. –  I see my new level. – I refuse to look away from what I have seen with my heart. – That which I have seen my hands will handle. – I keep my gaze on the right pictures in my heart. – I see a way out of that challenge (specify the challenge confronting you). – Through the study of the word of God and prayer, I train my mind to see the right results. – I refuse to see failure and defeat, I see possibilities. Oh Hallelujah!!  Gloreeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1056 - THE WISDOM OF HIS COUNSEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever you are inspired to do, it is God who is working in you both to will and to do for His good pleasure. Refuse to be distracted. Selah! Author Sunday, 14th December, 2025 THE WISDOM OF HIS COUNSEL“Don’t follow after the wicked ones or be jealous of their wealth. Don’t think for a moment they’re better off than you.” Psalm 37:1 (TPT)The scriptures provide you with the Wisdom of God for your living. It answers the deep questions of your heart. And when you submit your mind to its words your thoughts will be properly cultured and shaped.For example, this Song of Wisdom, Psalm 37, is able to redirect your mind towards the higher life God has given us.David reassures the people of God to continue to trust in the Lord and to refuse every desire or attempt to be like the people of the world. It also emphasizes how the success of the wicked or the ungodly has no eternal value.He doesn’t only conscientize you, on why you don’t have to be intimidated by the accomplishment of the worldly, but also the things to do to experience the God-centered or God-kind of success.From verses 3 to 5 of Psalm 34 (The Passion Translation), we unravelled some few wisdom keys which David outlined in his Psalm.– (verse 3a) Keep trusting in the Lord and do what is right in his eyes.– (Verse 3b) Fix your heart on the promises of God and you will be secured, feasting on his faithfulness.– (Verse 4) Make God the utmost delight and pleasure of your life, and he will provide for you what you desire the most.– (Verse 5) Give God the right to direct your life, and as you trust him along the way you’ll find he pulled it off perfectly!David explains further that, when you give God the right to direct your life, He will not only pull it off perfectly but will also “…appear as your righteousness, as sure as the dawning of a new day. He will manifest as your justice, as sure and strong as the noonday sun.” (verse 6).What this means is that the direction of the Lord makes you walk in light. There is no way your paths will be overwhelmed by any gorm darkness. And you will experience His righteousness, which is also the right-wiseness of God.There are more wisdom keys David shared in his Psalm:– (Verse 7a) Quiet your heart in his presence and pray;    keep hope alive as you long for God to come through for you.David now addresses the issue of meditation, spending time with God and prayer.You cannot trust in God and give Him the right to direct without being prayerful and also spending more time in His presence. 
You must have the habit of spending time alone with God.
 It is in that atmosphere that the Lord is able to open your eyes to see. It is in that atmosphere the Lord shows you the way to go.– (Verse 7b) And don’t think for a moment that the wicked in their prosperity are better off than you.The moment you begin to think this way, you are clearly devaluing who God is to you and what He has accomplished for you. 
What you have received from God and the path He is leading you has more transcendent results and prosperity than all the prosperity of the world put together. 
Live in the confidence of God.– (Verse 8a) Stay away from anger and revenge. Keep envy far from you, for it only leads you to lies.David now gives an instructive wisdom key. This key prevents you from error. Anger, revenge, envy and lies are instruments of the devil to distract you from expressing the excellence of God. They are thorns which compete with the blessedness of God within you. These things make you live in the flesh and also contrary to your true identity.When you cultivate these things in your heart, you give the devil the chance to exercise his rule. However, when you so learn Christ, you will not allow such inconsistent behaviors to govern your heart.
 Let the love of God rule in your heart.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 23:17; Psalm 37:7-9;  2 Corinthians 6:14-17; Psalm 73:1-3,16-17,23-26) WE PRAYPray that our hearts shall confidently established in faithfulness of the Lord and the wisdom of His counsel for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANActs 27-28Romans 12 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in the wisdom of God’s counsel for my life.– My heart is confidently established in the faithfulness of the Lord. – My life is for the glory of God. – My heart and gaze is consistently fixed on the Lord’s promises. – I submit my mind, will and emotions daily to the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1057 - THE WAY OF FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Monday, 15th December, 2025 THE WAY OF FAITH“Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ” Ephesians 5:20 (Webster’s Bible Translation) Thanksgiving is essential in our walk of faith.
A thankful heart is a faithful heart.
Thanksgiving is not just our response to what God has done. Thanksgiving is also part of honoring God. There are some who have no clue of the details of giving thanks to God. The thing is, as simple as thanksgiving or gratitude seems to be, it doesn’t come to people naturally.  One has to be intentional to live a life of gratitude.
To show gratitude is an attitude of gratefulness.
An attitude of gratefulness towards God is dependent on how valuable God is to you. It is not first about what God has done for you, but who He is to you and how you honor Him. The knowledge of who God is will definitely bring to light the reality of His lovingkindness. “Throughout human history the fingerprints of God were upon them, yet they refused to honor him as God or even be thankful for his kindness…” Romans 1:21 (TPT). The more you fail to recognize who God is and be thankful for His lovingkindness, the more you expose your mind to corrupt thoughts.
When you fail to see God’s goodness in your life, you will only entertain thoughts of defeat, discontentment, failure and disappointment.
See the latter part of Romans 1:21, “…Instead, they entertained corrupt and foolish thoughts about what God was like. This left them with nothing but misguided hearts, steeped in moral darkness.” (TPT).
Thanksgiving or showing gratitude to God supplies guidance and light to your heart.
“Sincere gratitude is said to be the healthiest of all human emotions” Dr. Hans Selye (1907-82), Hungarian-Canadian endocrinologist. Learn to practice thanksgiving. We find our Lord Jesus showing us the way of thanksgiving. At different times we see the Lord being thankful for many things.
