Even before a miracle happens Jesus is already full of thanks and gratitude. Jesus was full of praise or thanksgiving before He fed the 4000 (Mt 15:36) and the 5000 (Jn 6:11). At the tomb of Lazarus, He gave thanks before raising him from the dead (Jn 11:41). Even at the Passover meal, our Lord Jesus gave thanks before sharing wine and breaking bread (Lk 22:17-19). 
Learn to express gratitude to God and the people around you. A grateful heart is attractive and peaceful. 
The adversary doesn’t want you in that state. He wants you to look all stressed and troubled. And you know what, miracles don’t abound in that state. David said, in Psalm 107,  “Let everyone give all their praise and thanks to the Lord! Here’s why—he’s better than anyone could ever imagine.Yes, he’s always loving and kind, and his faithful love never ends.” (TPT). The King James makes it simple: “Give thanks to the Lord for He is good and His mercy endureth forever.” This is the way of faith. How many times have you given thanks to God already? Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Daniel 6:10; Colossians 3:17; 2 Thessalonians 1:3; Psalm 136:1; 2 Chronicles 5:13; Psalm 103:2) WE PRAYThank the Lord for who He is, and His benefits to you and all men (including your family and your local Church). In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANRomans 2-42 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With a faith-filled heart, I give thanks.– In all seasons and circumstances, I give thanks.– I give thanks in seasons when I’m expecting abundance.– I give thanks in seasons, when there’s abundance.– My mouth is full of thanksgiving.– Go ahead and thank the Lord on specific matters.Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1058 - A DESTROYER OF DESTINY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow chaos and distress to germinate in your soul. Release sweetness into your soul by speaking life-giving words. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 16th December, 2025A DESTROYER OF DESTINY“Herald and preach the Word! Keep your sense of urgency [stand by, be at hand and ready], whether the opportunity seems to be favorable or unfavorable…”2 Timothy 4:2 (AMPC) Beloved, you can’t be a world changer or a global icon by mouth. In as much as what you confess is important to your success, you must understand that your choice of action will determine the extent to which you may lead your generation. Every great leader has a sense of urgency every day.
Consistent impact is born through a consistent routine.
It is not the Father’s will that you experience one-time success. He wants you to have daily success. To make a difference in your generation, take daily steps to make the dream of God in your heart a reality. You can’t be one who procrastinates, wastes or spends time on non-essentials or things that don’t directly contribute to your target and vision.
You have to be disciplined to work towards your goal.
Until you maintain a strong sense of urgency concerning your goals, you may not be disciplined, diligent and consistent. This is one of the great secrets to prosperity and greatness. Be prompt to do it! Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste. Procrastination is a destroyer of destiny and fulfilment. Laziness is the act of the poor. And being lazy and wasting time doesn’t mean you are doing nothing. You can spend time doing something which doesn’t contribute to your action plan. You have no sense of urgency when you spend time surfing the internet and watching funny clips when you should be praying.
Anything you do with your time must be an intentional step to contribute to your progress.
Refuse to be lazy. The lazy have no sense of urgency. They do things on their own time and not according to the standard of the assignment. Your routine must represent the level of greatness. ”The soul of a lazy man desires and has nothing, but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.” Proverbs 13:4 Don’t just desire or wish to be successful and great. Be diligent in working towards your greatness. ”Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.” Proverbs 12:24. Diligence with a sense of urgency is a characteristic of all prosperous leaders who lead and transform their generation.The Bible says that David rose early in the morning and went to the camp as his father had commanded. (1 Samuel 17:20).And Abraham got up early in the morning to do what the Lord had instructed (Genesis 22:3-4). You will find this sense of urgency, promptness and diligence with these great men in the scriptures. They knew their success was in how they urgently acted on the instructions they received.
There is no success in procrastination.
How urgent are you working towards your goals for today, for the week, for the month and the upcoming year? You can reach your target and maintain a sense of urgency!!! Selah. DIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 2:6-7; Romans 12:11-12;Ecclesiastes 10:18; Proverbs 12:11; Proverbs 10:4-5; Deuteronomy 24:19) WE PRAYThat we will be enabled with the grace to be diligent in all that our hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANRomans 5-72 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Whatever the Lord requires me to do, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In giving, I give with a sense of urgency. – In soul winning, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In prayer and the study of the word, I do it with a sense of urgency. – I refuse to procrastinate. – I get the job done on time. – I get the results. – I diligently act on the word of God. – I make each day count. – I make daily progress and success. – Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof. – I win everyday. – I am not a waster of resources. – Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me. – I am a success. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1059 - DISTRACTION IS COSTLY; STAY FOCUSED AND UNDAUNTED
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you submit your will to the Lord, you cannot live according to God’s original, glorious design for you. Submission to God is a sign of a mature life in Christ. Selah. Author Wednesday, 17th December, 2025DISTRACTION IS COSTLY; STAY FOCUSED AND UNDAUNTED “So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless” 1 Corinthians 15:58 (NLT) I will sincerely not deny the challenges which may confront you, just because of your stand in Christ. Our Lord declared this: ”for you get enough hate from the world! But then, it hated me before it hated you. The world would love you if you belonged to it; but you don’t—for I chose you to come out of the world, and so it hates you. Do you remember what I told you? ‘A slave isn’t greater than his master!’ So since they persecuted me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to me, they would listen to you! The people of the world will persecute you because you belong to me, for they don’t know God who sent me.” John 15:18-21 (TLB)
The events and activities of this world are not designed to favour your faith walk.
They are skillfully and subtly designed to oppose, crush and cripple your faith in Christ. The systems of this world were structured by men, to redirect your desire, distract your focus, and impair your emotions, thoughts and conviction in Christ. And many fellow saints have become victims of the strategy of the systems of this world. Many make excuses in their service to God and become dull. Instead of serving or laboring with much enthusiasm and steadfastness, they become complacent and make the pursuit of their own interest their focus.
Don’t be like them. Don’t be a slave to this world.
Many are being used by their institutions as slaves and they waste their call on perishable things. We are to work but not to be wasted by the world.Through the building up of the Word of Grace, you become impregnable and immunized to the strategies of this world.
Beloved, as long as you are in Christ and have set your focus to intensively serve His course, you will face opposition and tribulation.
But tribulation should not break you.You are designed and built by Christ, to glory in Tribulation. “By whom (Jesus Christ) also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; (Romans 5:2-3 KJV emphasis added)  The Greek word used for Tribulation in this verse is “Thlipsis”, which means a pressing or pressing together pressure, oppression, affliction, or distress.
To be afflicted or face tribulation, or to be oppressed or distressed is to be pressed.
However, when you are pressed what issues out is your content?When you are pressured the divine virtues within, must issue out.God has filled you with Himself. Hence, when you are pressed, the best of God will come out of you. Get your inward substances well-built, and refuse to be broken no matter the afflictions that come your way. The word of His Grace builds us up. (Acts 20:32). It dispelled fear. “Jesus said, ” I have told you these things, so that in Me you may have [perfect] peace and confidence. In the world you have tribulation and trials and distress and frustration; but be of good cheer [take courage; be confident, certain, undaunted]! For I have overcome the world. [I have deprived it of power to harm you and have conquered it for you.]” (John 16:33 AMPC) Be undaunted! Be confident! Be certain! Be determined!Have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. They may push you, press you together yet they are deprived of the power to harm you. Maintain an undisturbed composure. Through the knowledge of Christ, take on courage. Be toughened, and develop hard skin through the building up of the Word.
To do big things for God, you must have tough skin.
Be God-occupied. Don’t yield to challenges. Nothing has the capacity to work against you.  Anything that comes in contact with you must work for your good. You were designed that way. You were not designed to be broken. Don’t coil in at the sight of challenges, accusations, mockery and afflictions. Take advantage of the situations and challenges to resound the goodness of the Lord. Nothing should stop you from standing in the Truth, which is Christ. Don’t think the people of the world are ahead of you. Remember the adversary is the father of lies. He is always playing catch-up. 
Focus on the mandate the Lord has entrusted to you.
 Even if the whole world comes against you, YOU ARE BIGGER THAN THE WORLD. ”But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world.“ 1 John 4:4 REMAIN IMMOVABLE, UNABASHED AND DEADLY COMMITTED TO THE VISION OF THE LORD!!! DIG DEEPER(Romans 15:13; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Galatians 6:9; Philippians 2:30; Proverbs 21:21; Colossians 2:7; Psalm 43; John 16:33; 2 Corinthians 4:8-17; Romans 8:31-39) WE PRAY– We pray, that in the midst of persecution, distress and challenge “the God of hope fill all the saints with all joy and peace as we trust in Him, so that we shall overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. – We pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, (for not everyone has faith But the Lord is faithful) and the Lord should strengthen us and protect us from the evil one. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANRomans 8-102 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am undaunted and confident! – I have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. Therefore I have overcome the world. – I may be push and pressed together yet they are deprived of the power to harm me. – I maintain an undisturbed composure.– Through the knowledge of Christ, I take on courage. – I am toughened and I have hard skin through the building up of the Word and prayer. – I do big things for God. – I am God-occupied. – I don’t yield to challenges. – Nothing has the capacity to work against me. – Anything that comes in contact with me must work for my good. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1060 - IT’S A WISDOM PROBLEM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, your understanding of Jesus must grow deep. The depths of your understanding of who He is will set you up in the heights of greater manifestations. Selah. Author Thursday, 18th December, 2025 IT’S A WISDOM PROBLEM “Say to wisdom, “I love you,” and to understanding, “You’re my sweetheart.” Proverbs 7:4 (TPT)The glorious function of your life is according to the dimension of your wisdom.Every great thing revolves around wisdom.In the same way, every problem is a wisdom problem.
The absence of wisdom is not only the manifestation of foolishness but also the very collapse of a life system.
The very substance of living is hewn out of Wisdom.Nothing finds meaning without Wisdom.By faith we know that the world was framed by the Word of God (Hebrews 11:3), however, the Word of God is the package of Wisdom.Wisdom is embodied by the Word of God.
Thus, the universe came forth by the Wisdom of God. God created all things by Wisdom.
“O LORD, how many and varied are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; The earth is full of Your riches and Your creatures.” Psalm 104:24 (Amplified)God laid the foundation of the Earth by Wisdom.“By wisdom the LORD laid the earth’s foundations, and by understanding he set the heavens in place.” Proverbs 3:19 (ISV).No wonder the scriptures reveal Wisdom as the PRINCIPAL THING.“Wisdom is the principal thing; Therefore get wisdom. And in all your getting, get understanding.” Proverbs 4:7 (NKJV)
To say Wisdom is the principal thing is not an overstatement; for Wisdom is the key which unlocks all treasures.
When you ascend into the Summit or Peak of God, what you will find is the highest dimension of Wisdom. Wisdom is Supreme and the bedrock of life. Light is great yet, the greatest light you will behold is still an offspring of Wisdom.Therefore, LOVE WISDOM!Whatever you love has your attention and desire. Whatever you love you honor.Until you set your mind and desire on Wisdom, the intention to become her expression will not gravitate towards you.
When Wisdom is activated in you, you will know how to build your life and destiny.
For by Wisdom a house is built (Proverbs 24:3). Anyone that builds, does it by Wisdom.Even God created and built the universe by Wisdom.
 Everything that has to do with you, every aspect of your life can only be built gloriously by Wisdom.
Therefore say to Wisdom, “I LOVE YOU” and to Understanding, “YOU ARE MY SWEET HEART”.Beloved, Love Wisdom!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 4:5; Ecclesiastes 7:12; Proverbs 8:18-19; Proverbs 3:3:14-24) WE PRAYWe pray that:– the desires or affection of our hearts will be glued to wisdom.– we will develop a strong love for Wisdom and understandingIn the name of Jesus!BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANRomans 8-102 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I love wisdom. – I function by wisdom. – Through wisdom, I build every aspect of my life. – The desires of my heart is glued to wisdom. – As I fellowship daily with the Word of God, I develop a develop a strong love for wisdom and understanding. – I am full of wisdom. – I act in wisdom. – I do all things in wisdom. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!!

title: EPISODE 1061 - OBEY THEM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 19th December, 2025 OBEY THEM“Obey your spiritual leaders, and do what they say. Their work is to watch over your souls, and they are accountable to God. Give them reason to do this with joy and not with sorrow. That would certainly not be for your benefit.” Hebrews 13:17 (NLT)The Lord has appointed Spiritual Leaders to function as shepherds.They have the responsibility to:– Lead and guide you unto God’s agenda.– To care for and feed you as a shepherd feeds his flock.
To think that you don’t need a shepherd is to act contrary to the wisdom of God’s word.
Our Lord Jesus is the great good Shepherd-King (Hebrews 13:20; John 10:11; 1 Peter 5:4), and He has appointed leaders within the various assemblies of saints to shepherd the saints as He does.Your Pastor or Church leader has the work or spiritual task to watch over your souls as shepherds watch over a flock.“…I urge my fellow elders among you to be compassionate shepherds who tenderly care for God’s flock and who feed them well, for you have the responsibility to guide, protect, and oversee. Consider it a joyous pleasure and not merely a religious duty. Lead from the heart under God’s leadership…” 1 Peter 5:1-2 (TPT).This was Peter the apostle’s instruction to the Church elders as Jesus instructed him.Jesus asked Peter at three different times if he loved Him, and He instructed Peter more than once to feed His lambs:“… Jesus said to Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you burn with love for me more than these?”Peter answered, “Yes, Lord! You know that I have great affection for you!”“Then take care of my lambs,”“Then take care of my sheep,”  Jesus replied, “Then feed my lambs.” John 21:15-17 (TPT)Again, Paul the apostle also instructed the elders of the Church in Ephesus:“So guard your hearts. Be true shepherds over all the flock and feed them well. Remember, it was the Holy Spirit who appointed you to guard and oversee the churches that belong to Jesus, the Anointed One, which he purchased and established by his own blood.” Acts 20:28 (TPT).The obedience in Hebrews 13:17 is not just to respond to a command as one under authority, but also to have confidence in a person. The Greek word is “peithō”, which means “to yield” or “have inner conviction”.To obey your leader is not a mere outward display of conformity. It is not acting properly in the presence of the leader. It is assenting in your heart to yield to the guidance of your spiritual leader.There are people who act in obedience only when they are in the presence of their leader and do otherwise or speak contrary in his absence.It is not a display of honour. It is a display of the hypocrisy of your heart. This kind of evidence wouldn’t last for long. Soon you will be exposed, or you will showcase your lack of commitment and unyieldingness.This is Paul the apostle writing :“So then, my dear ones, just as you have always obeyed [my instructions with enthusiasm], not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation [that is, cultivate it, bring it to full effect, actively pursue spiritual maturity] with awe-inspired fear and trembling [using serious caution and critical self-evaluation to avoid anything that might offend God or discredit the name of Christ].” Philippians 2:12 (Amplified Bible)The Greek word for obedience in this verse is “hupakouō”, which means “to heed”, “hearken or conform to a command or authority”.These people conformed with conviction to Apostle Paul’s instruction with enthusiasm in his presence. Now he urged them that it is more important for them to obey him in his absence.
This is a true demonstration of honour to your spiritual leader.
This is proof that you are not obeying your leader because you are afraid or being hypocritical, but you honour the Lord and honour the shepherd He has set over you.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 5:17; 1 Corinthians  16:15-16; Philippians 2:28-30; 1 Peter 5:5) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall have a genuine attitude of honouring our Leaders through obedience to their instructions, Love and sincerity, whether in their presence or their absence. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANRomans 14-162 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I set my heart right to practically honour my leaders today. - I walk in honor towards my Leader. - I  don’t dishonor the authorities God has set over me. - I refuse to be ungrateful towards my leader. - I honor my Leader with my treasure, time and finances. - I demonstrate honor towards my leader in all things. Thank you Lord for my Leader.

title: EPISODE 1062 - WHAT IS MORE PRECIOUS THAN WISDOM?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your faith shouldn’t just be reduced towards your excellence in exams, acquiring a job, acquisition of things, and other personal interests. Your faith must be focused on achieving great things for the Lord. The greatest thing you can do with your faith is to serve the Lord’s great purpose. Selah. Author Saturday, 20th December, 2025 WHAT IS MORE PRECIOUS THAN WISDOM?“As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her.” Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)When you decide to turn away from the Word of God and also devalue your relationship with God, you are turning away from True and Pure Wisdom.
When you set your heart to walk in the Wisdom of God, she will honor and exalt you.
Daniel was honored by Wisdom. (Daniel 2:48-49). Look at Joseph who became a Prime Minister in Egypt because of the workings of God’s wisdom.This is the preeminence of God’s Wisdom.
Nothing compares to God’s Wisdom.
The Wisdom of God is preeminent:1. Wisdom was in existence before all things were made.“In the beginning I was there, for God possessed me even before he created the universe. From eternity past I was set in place, before the world began. I was anointed from the beginning.” Proverbs 8:22-23 (TPT).2. God made the earth by His Wisdom.“The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens” Proverbs 3:19 (ESV).There is nothing which shall emerge from the earth that is more greater than Wisdom. Wisdom is the principal thing, by which you unlock all treasuries.3. Wisdom is greater than the might of men.Wisdom is the strength of the wise and her strength exceeds the strongest of men.“Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.” Ecclesiastes 7:19 (KJV).4. The Wisdom of God is greater than money and more precious than gold.Is money valuable? Yes, but not more valuable than Wisdom.Wisdom is a defence and money is a defence, however, the transcending reality is that Wisdom gives life. (Ecclesiastes 7:12).There was a point when money failed in Egypt, it was the Wisdom of God in Joseph, that sustained the economy of Egypt. (Genesis 47:15).
It is great to make money, but first, pursue the expression of Wisdom. A man of True Wisdom and understanding is a man of great wealth.
Take another look at the opening verse:“As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her.” Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)It is worthless to go after the wisdom of men. What is more precious than Wisdom?What will you ever desire that can be compared to God’s Wisdom?
The Wisdom which is from above is above all.
Get Wisdom and get understanding.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 8; Job 28; Daniel 2:1-49; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall maintain our focus on Wisdom and not esteem the highest intelligence of men above True Wisdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Corinthians 1-32 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the wisdom which is from above therefore I am above all. – I esteem the true wisdom of God beyond every highest intelligence of men.  – I cease to be ordinary. – I walk in wisdom. – I am so wise. Oh Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1064 - HOW DO YOU RESPOND TO CHALLENGES?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Monday, 22nd December, 2025HOW DO YOU RESPOND TO CHALLENGES?“Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church.” Acts 12:5 (NKJV) What is your first response to challenges or pressure from opposition? Time and time again in scriptures, you will find God’s people responding to challenging situations with prayer.
Don’t give anyone room to underestimate the effectual workings of prayer.
One of the evidence that you have confidence in God’s ability is how you respond to situations through prayer. Did you take time to pay attention to the opening verse? Look at the full story: “Now about that time Herod the king stretched out his hand to harass some from the church. Then he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to seize Peter also. Now it was during the Days of Unleavened Bread. So when he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of soldiers to keep him, intending to bring him before the people after Passover. Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church. And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were [keeping the prison. Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, “Arise quickly!” And his chains fell off his hands. Then the angel said to him, “Gird yourself and tie on your sandals”; and so he did. And he said to him, “Put on your garment and follow me.” So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision. When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him. And when Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.” Acts 12:1-11 (NKJV)— Herod decided to harass the Church, so he killed James, the brother of John.— He saw the people were pleased, so he arrested Peter, and purposed to kill him after Passover.— Nevertheless, the Church responded to this situation differently.We didn’t see the response of the Church when James was arrested. It was likely they reacted in fear and only went to hide.But when Peter was arrested, the Church responded with earnest, constant PRAYERS.The earnest prayers of the brethren dispatched an angel to release Peter from prison. Considering the soldiers assigned to guard Peter in the prison and even outside the prison, it will only take a supernatural hand to deliver him.No matter the challenge, get into prayer. In the place of prayer:— You will receive strength.— Your faith will be strengthened.— You will receive direction as to what to do.— You will see visions— The great help and answers of God will be released.Paul said to the Philippians:“Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus” Philippians 4: 6-7 (NKJV).
Don’t cry, don’t be anxious, don’t worry, don’t fret, ONLY PRAY!
Nehemiah, when he was opposed, prayed to God.When Daniel and his friends’ lives were under threat, they prayed to receive understanding of the King’s dream. David prayed when he was under threat.Jesus prayed when He was overwhelmed by the burden of His crucifixion, and He received strength. It took prayer for Esther, Mordecai and the Jews to reverse Haman’s plot against them. Beloved, refuse to be troubled; get into prayer.The saints were together praying until they saw Peter at home. “And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying” Acts 12:12 Pray earnestly until you have really prayed. Pray until you are fully convinced in your spirit that it is settled. 
Pray until you see the victory, not until you feel tired.
It means you may feel tired, but you have to continue earnestly in prayer.GET INTO PRAYER!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 18:19; Isaiah 62:6-7; Esther 4:16; Daniel 2:15-18; Luke 22:39-46) WE PRAYThat by the mighty hand of the Lord we shall see great victory in all situations, no matter the pressure and opposition. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Corinthians 7-92 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t stagger in faith. – By the strength of God, I prevail. – With God I do valiantly. – I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day. – I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1065 - DEALING WITH FEAR AND ANXIETY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency One of the devices of Satan is to use or take advantage of unforgiveness. When you are unforgiving, the adversary will outsmart you with his devices. Beloved, you need to learn to SHIELD UP BY FAITH against the arrows of bitterness, offences, anger and sorrow. SELAH! Author Tuesday, 23rd December, 2025DEALING WITH FEAR AND ANXIETY “He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church.” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (NKJV)Some people have refused to accept the reality of tongues-speaking. Some of these people even make a mockery of this special gift of the Spirit given to all believers.Some think that because the tongues believers speak are not understandable, they are useless and mere gimmicks.Tongues speaking is the communion between the one speaking and God. To speak in tongues is to speak mysteries.
Whereas prophecies edify or build up the Church or benefit all the saints; tongues speaking builds up the individual believer.
“But [on the other hand] the one who prophesies speaks to people for edification [to promote their spiritual growth] and [speaks words of] encouragement [to uphold and advise them concerning the matters of God] and [speaks words of] consolation [to compassionately comfort them]” 1 Corinthians 14:3 (Amplified Bible)Tongues speaking is one of the quickest means by which a believer experiences personal edification. The apostle Paul said, “I thank God that I speak in [unknown] tongues more than all of you” 1 Corinthians 14:18 (Amplified Bible).Take note of this in the opening verse:“He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself…”The word edify is from the Greek word “oikodomēo”, which means to construct a house or to be a house builder. It is also an expression which connotes the strengthening of a great or huge building.And when you speak in tongues (note what he said), “EDIFIES HIMSELF”.Paul didn’t say, he who speaks in tongues edifies only his spirit. He said HIMSELF. This has to do with your entire being. Through tongues-speaking, you build your spirit, your soul and your body.
Through tongues-speaking, you make supplication of power to your body. This deals with anxiety and fear.
Anxiety leads to depression and also triggers your flight-or-fight stress response. It releases a flood of adrenaline into your system.The moment anxiety persists within you, it will lead to chronic stress, and even when the stressful moment passes, your body remains in that state where the system is flooded with adrenaline chemicals.That may lead to weakness in the immune system. The moment your immune system becomes weak, it becomes vulnerable to prevent infections and viruses.This is how people who are often stressed get sick easily. Do you now understand why you become weak after you have been overwhelmed with sorrow and sadness for a long time?“A joyful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones” Proverbs 17:22 (ESV).That is why the Apostle Paul charged the brethren in Philippi:“do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.” Philippians 4:6 (ESV)
Instead of worry and sorrow, pray. And most importantly to build up your entire being, pray in tongues.
When a believer in Christ speaks in tongues, he releases spiritual currents of power and unleashes energies from the Spirit to his entire being (spirit, soul and body). You receive endowment in your spirit, and also in your mind to make decisions, to direct your emotions, to be refreshed and quickened in the body.Don’t go a day without speaking in tongues.Get to it now!DIG DEEPER(Acts 2:4; 1 Corinthians 14:14,26; Jude 1:20) WE PRAYPray thanking the Lord for the ability of the Spirit to pray in tongues. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Corinthians 10-122 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t trivialize the precious gift of tongues speaking. – Under all circumstaces and at all times, I have the strength to carry out the assignment God has given unto me. – I don’t lack strength, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– I don’t consider oppositions or pressures, I edify myself by praying in tongues.– Through the precious gift of tongues speaking, I edify myself to be a blessing unto many. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1066 - HE IS THE CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your understanding of Christ through His word grants you access to the depths of God’s wisdom and the hidden secrets of life. The word of God is the constitution of the wisdom of God. SELAH. Author Wednesday, 24th December, 2025 HE IS THE CHRIST“Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.”Acts 17:3 (KJV)As part of the many beautiful revelations of Jesus, the knowledge of Him as CHRIST is the all-encompassing prophetic revelation and fulfilment.The word “Christ” is not a new age thought of as a “chi” or a synonymous expression for a yogic higher force.
Christ is not a figment satisfaction of one’s personal imagination.
The word Christ is not Jesus’ surname or last name. My surname is “Ansah”, thus you can refer to me as Mr. Ansah. And that is how some consider  “Christ”. They assume He is Mr. CHRIST.Christ is not necessarily His name. Christ is His title. The proper understanding of the Christ will help you appreciate the passionate tone in Paul’s statement, “and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ”. He made this statement as a logical conclusion of what the scriptures teach.“Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures “ Acts 17:1-2 (KJV)In His preaching, Paul the apostle, systematically reasoned with His audience using the scriptures to make thoughtful arguments to persuade them of the revelation of Jesus as the Christ.This term meant and still means something profound to the Jews. Christ was one they looked forward to for many centuries. Some believe Jesus is Christ, others are still looking forward to a coming Christ.The word Christ is a transliteration of the Greek word Christos, meaning “anointed” or “anointed one”. In Hebrew, it is the equivalent of the word Messiah or mashiach (which is from the verb mashach). So, to be the Christ or Messiah is to be “the anointed one”.The anointing or sacred oil was poured on people specially chosen for the Lord’s assignment. These are mainly prophets, priests and kings. The phrase “anointed one” or “the Lord anointed” is mostly used for kings. (See 1 Samuel 24:6)See these verses as well:“He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed (mashach) him to consecrate him.” (Lev. 8:12)“So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed (mashach) him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David. Samuel then went to Ramah.” (1 Sam. 16:13)“Also, anoint (mashach) Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint (mashach) Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.” (1 Kings 19:16)Though the expression “anointed” or “Mashiach” is used in several places in the Old Testament portion of the Bible, the anointed one is mainly a term for the Messiah.The Messiah is the prophetic title given to the King who is to come, by the prophets of old.The prophets gave revelatory hints or codes of the coming King who would deliver his people and also rule the whole world.By prophecy, the Messiah shall shoot forth from Israel and amidst the Jewish people.Jacob while blessing his sons, made this prophetic declaration to Judah concerning the Messiah.“Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up? The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be“. Genesis 49:9-10 (KJV)Balak the king of the Moabites requested that Balaam should curse the people of Israel as they pitched in the plains of Moab. One of the prophetic visions Balaam had was the revelation of the Messiah.“How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel! As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters. He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted. God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows. He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee… He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.” Numbers 24:5-9,16-17 (KJV)When Jesus was born His star appeared in the east and wise men went to bow to Him as the new King.“Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem, Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.““When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was. When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy. And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.” Matthew 2:1-2,9-11 (KJV)In ancient times when a King arose, people of stature would go and pay homage to the new king to renew or establish a relationship with the King. Though Jesus was born as a baby, He wasn’t an ordinary child. He was the prophetic King or Messiah who was born in Bethlehem. Just as it was declared that a royal star would come out of Jacob, the Wisemen saw the royal star of Jesus and rejoiced.Beloved the birth of Jesus was the beginning of the fulfilment of His Messianic Prophecies. This Jesus whom we preach is the Christ or the Messiah who was spoken of by the prophets and the scriptures.To believe in Jesus is to receive the Christ.We have not believed in empty fables but in a sure word of prophecy.
 Celebrate Jesus who is the King of Kings at all times.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 61:1-7; Luke 4:18,41; Isaiah 9:6-7; Matthew 1:23; Matthew 16:1; Mark 8:29; Luke 9:20; John 11:27) WE PRAYWe pray that our eyes shall open to the full revelation of Jesus as the true Messiah and our hearts shall be established in that certainty. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Corinthians 13-152 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have not believed in empty fables, Jesus is the Christ.– I have received the Christ. – My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1067 - THE TESTIMONY OF OUR LORD AND SAVIOR JESUS CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your revelation of God is rooted in your communion with Him. In your intimate communion with Jesus, you produce greater results. Selah! Author Thursday, 25th November, 2025 THE TESTIMONY OF OUR LORD AND SAVIOR JESUS CHRIST “Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.” Acts 17:3 (KJV)The revelation of Jesus is not a fairy tale neither is it an old fable.Peter the apostle of Jesus, was passionate about this he said:“For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty. For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount. We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts” 2 Peter 1:16-19 (KJV)
The revelation of the reality of Jesus is not a cunningly devised fable but a more sure word of prophecy.
The blessing of Jacob upon his son Judah, was a Messianic prophetic utterance which was fulfilled by Jesus.Balaam saw the revelation of Jesus when he saw the people of Israel pitched at the valley of Moab.“How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel…  his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted. God brought him forth out of Egypt… I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel“ Numbers 24:5,7-8,17 (KJV)The wise men saw the star of Jesus appear in the east and went to bow to Him as the new King. This was the fulfillment of what Balaam saw and also what the Psalmist said concerning the Messiah.“Distant kings will surrender and come with their gifts from every continent and coastland; they will offer their tribute to you. O King of kings, they will all bow before you. O King of kings, every nation will one day serve you.” Psalm 72:10-11 (TPT)When Matthew was writing the Bethlehem account of Jesus, he had some Messianic Prophecies in mind.To those around the baby Jesus, it was just a child enjoying blessings. But in the mind of Matthew, it was ancient oracles playing out.Yes, to Isaiah the Prophet, he was speaking over Jerusalem.Matthew saw the fulfilment of those words in the lives of Jesus.“Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee. For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee. And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising. Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side. Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee. The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.” Isaiah 60:1-6 (KJV)Oh, glory to God!Beloved, this is not to put words on the lips of the gospel account of Matthew.Before the wise men saw the child, they first went to Herod’s palace, thinking the child was born there, since they knew he was the new King.These wise men were asked to return to Herod when they found the child. But the intention was for Herod to kill the child.He later commanded a mass killing of every baby boy two years old and younger, since the wise men did not return with the news of the child’s location. Jesus’ parents escaped to Egypt with Him. According to Matthew’s account, this was for the scriptures to be fulfilled.“So that very night he got up and took Jesus and his mother and made their escape to Egypt and remained there until Herod died. All of this fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through his prophet: I summon my Son out of Egypt “ Matthew 2:14-15 (TPT)The prophet Hosea prophesied, “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.” And Jesus came as the fulfilment of this prophecy.No wonder the Lord said,“You are busy analyzing the Scriptures, frantically poring over them in hopes of gaining eternal life. Everything you read points to me” John 5:39 (TPT)When you genuinely study the scriptures, they will bring you to the Person of Jesus.Many read and still look forward to the first coming of the Messiah. Yet they did not know that the Messiah walked among them and now He will be appearing in His full glory. This is the best time to believe in Jesus as LORD. And if you do, this is the best time to express His life and light to the world.This Jesus is not merely another prophet. This Jesus is the CHRIST!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 61:1-7; Luke 4:18,41; Isaiah 9:6-7; Matthew 1:23; Matthew 16:1; Mark 8:29; Luke 9:20; John 11:27) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in the boldness of the Spirit to declare the testimony of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN1 Corinthians 162 Corinthians 1-22 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have not believed in empty fables, Jesus is the Christ.– I have received the Christ. – My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus! Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1068 - REJOICE AT THE REVELATION OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Decide to be a blessing to someone today with a special gift. Demonstrate your love for God by loving the saints. Shalom! Author Friday, 26th December, 2025 REJOICE AT THE REVELATION OF JESUS “Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.” Acts 17:3 (KJV)Whenever the scriptures are unfolded you must see Jesus. He is the meaning of the scriptures.Jesus Christ is the story told in the Old Testament. When you understand that all that was communicated in the Old Testament is to bring every reader to Christ, you will see the oneness of the entire Bible.Different men, in different historical timeliness and with distinct experiences were inspired by the Holy Spirit to write God’s thoughts with their unique styles of expressions, and had one central theme of thought, Jesus Christ.These may not have necessarily grasped the full revelation of what they wrote. They might have thought of writing about the situation around them and the possible things which might come, but every bit of it was part of the beautiful story of this Jesus who is the Christ.
He is the central theme of Genesis as the Creator, the Life and the Promised seed.  
“In the beginning God created…” (Genesis 1:1).“All things were made by Him and without Him was not anything made that was made” (John 1:3).The entire events we witnessed in Genesis through the scriptures, were the unfolding of this utterance of God, “the seed of the woman shall bruise the head of the serpent” (Genesis 3:15).The goal of the adversary was to destroy the coming of this seed. But God encrypted the appearing of the seed. By a careful study of the scriptures, you will realize that all that the devil was doing from the time Adam and Eve were out of the Garden of Eden, even through Abraham and his descendants even to the time Jesus was born (or the Word became flesh), was to destroy the seed before it germinates.God was giving His people, hints of the coming of the Seed. Through the writings of the Prophets, the Priests, the Kings, the Judges, and the Psalmists, the Lord was announcing the manifestation of the Seed. The adversary realized through observation that, the seed was going to come from the descendants of Abraham and Jacob, but was many centuries behind what God was doing.While the devil thought Isaac and his descendants were the Promised Seed, God’s original Seed was encrypted.The adversary arrived at this conclusion when he heard this:“And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.” Genesis 12:7 (KJV).What the adversary didn’t hear was this:“Now to Abraham and his Seed were the promises made. He does not say, “And to seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “And to your Seed,” who is Christ.” Galatians 3:16 (NKJV)All that happened from Genesis to the time Jesus was born were testimonies of Him.“Then he carefully unveiled to them the revelation of himself throughout the Scripture. He started from the beginning and explained the writings of Moses and all the prophets, showing how they wrote of him and revealed the truth about himself.” Luke 24:27 (TPT)Beloved this is the reason you must rejoice in this season.“The shepherds returned to their flock, ecstatic over what had happened. They praised God and glorified him for all they had heard and seen for themselves, just like the angel had said.” Luke 2:20 (TPT).When you see Jesus, you must rejoice. And that is what the scriptures help you to do. To have a picture and accurate revelation of Jesus. 
The revelation of Jesus brings you into the reality of God.
 Abraham saw Jesus and rejoiced at His coming.“Your father Abraham rejoiced as he looked forward to my coming. He saw it and was glad” John 8:56 (ESV)Look at the testimony of Moses:“By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter; Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.” Hebrews 11:24-26 (KJV)Moses saw the hope of the Messiah, believed in the coming of the Anointed one and treasured it or held it dear than the treasures of Egypt.The birth of Jesus wasn’t an event that just happened out of the blue.Like Matthew said:“All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had spoken by the prophet.” (Matthew 1:22)The entire life of Jesus was the fulfillment of the Prophecies. The prophetic words were the articulation of the plan and purposes of God.Beloved rejoice at the revelation of Jesus!Two things you should glean:1. Jesus is the Christ and He is the Lord of all.2. The word of God or the Prophecies of the scriptures are true and sure.Jesus as the fulfilment of Prophecies is the evidence that all that the scriptures had said about the saints or the believers in Christ are true and shall fully be manifested.
Your life is the fulfillment of Prophecies as Jesus. For as He is so are you in this world.
And if you are of Christ, then you are also a seed of Abraham!You are a prophetic child.DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 61:1-7; Luke 4:18,41; Jeremiah 31:15; Matthew 2:18;  Micah 5:2; John 7:42) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will be established in the certainty of the scriptures as God’s prophetic revelation of our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Corinthians 3-52 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have not believed in empty fables, Jesus is the Christ.– I have received the Christ. – My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus! Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1069 - HE HAS DESTROYED THE DOMINION OF THE DEVIL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To work with God and experience true fulfillment, you must willingly make a decision to function according to His WILL. You can decide to do things according to your will or according to the will of God. Selah. Author Saturday, 27th December, 2025 HE HAS DESTROYED THE DOMINION OF THE DEVIL“Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.” Acts 17:3 (KJV)Though Jesus is the revelation of God’s consistent true character and reality, He also lived as the fulfilment of Messianic Prophecies.All believers in Christ acknowledge Jesus as the lamb of God who died for the Salvation of men. Yet few of them are conscious of the Messianic reality of Jesus.Most Jews didn’t see Jesus as the Promised Messiah because instead of looking at the scriptures, they were looking at the limited worldview and perception of how they think a Messiah should be.
Jesus’ birth, ministry, death, resurrection, His role in the church and His everlasting reign, are clearly articulated in the scriptures.
In this season as people are celebrating “Christmas” as the celebration of the birth of Jesus, they must have the consciousness that His birth was the fulfillment of the birth of the Messiah.The Jewish people were waiting for a Messiah who would act as a rebel deliverer against the Romans.They didn’t know his way of Salvation and establishment of His kingdom was through the dispensing of life through His death and resurrection.
Jesus didn’t come to destroy men, He came to destroy the works of the devil.
The first hint of His coming was with a clear mission, to destroy the dominion of the devil.“And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.” Genesis 3:15 (KJV)Most people think Jesus is going to achieve that in the future. Not at all. He’s done that already.“He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.“ 1 John 3:8 (KJV)
Jesus came to destroy the sin problem the devil created through his deceptive work.
Look at what was said about Jesus:“Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost. Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily. But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost. And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.“ Matthew 1:18-21(KJV)The Salvation of people from their sins was destroying the works of the devil and the crushing of his authority through the cross.Through the deception of the adversary, sin entered man, he became corrupt and dead.
Jesus was born to destroy the works of the devil, deliver man from the corruption of sin and quicken him with life from death.
” And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses; Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross; And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.“ Colossians 2:13-15 (KJV)These verses explain how Jesus destroyed the works of the devil.Oh hallelujah!No wonder when Jesus was born, the devil worked through Herod to kill the child. The moment he realized the promised seed was born, he thought of eliminating the child to abort God’s eternal plan.“Then Herod, when he realized that he had been tricked by the magi, was extremely angry, and he sent [soldiers] and put to death all the male children in Bethlehem and in all that area who were two years old and under, according to the date which he had learned from the magi.” Matrew 2:16 (Amplified Bible).However, the Prophets gave a hint of this event and God’s escape plan for the Messiah. You know sometimes you assume the devil is omniscient.Do you think he knows everything about you and your future?
Listen, he may have an assumption of a glorious thing God is up to with you but doesn’t know how God is going to do it.
Don’t give him a lot of credence. He is not ahead of you, he is far behind schedule. Be in tune with God and follow His plan for your life. Act fast when the Lord instructs.The devil didn’t know the King was born. But God knew how the devil was going to react and went ahead to work out His escape plan for the child.And the Prophet Jeremiah said:“This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”(Jeremiah 31:15)The Prophet Hosea saw God’s preserving plan:“When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son” (Hosea 11:1)
The preservation of Jesus was the preservation of the promised seed that shall destroy the works of the devil or crush his head.
The goal of the devil was to destroy the seed. All through the life of Jesus and public ministry, people in authority sought to kill him.“Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him” (Matthew 12:14, See also,  Mark 3:6, 11:18; Luke 6:11; John 11:53)What they didn’t know was that they were doing the work of the devil. However, as part of God’s eternal plan, Jesus must die at a time to destroy the works of the devil.As much as they sought to kill Jesus, His time had not yet come so they couldn’t.Finally, when the time was right, Jesus gave Himself up to die. They didn’t know the one they were seeking to kill was their Messiah. However, the devil also didn’t know that the death of Jesus was for his works to be destroyed and for Salvation to be made available unto all men.“but the precious blood of Christ—who like a spotless, unblemished lamb was sacrificed for us. This was part of God’s plan, for he was chosen and destined for this before the foundation of the earth was laid, but he has been made manifest in these last days for you”1 Peter 1:19-20 (TPT).OH THANK YOU JESUS!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 2:1-3; Acts 4:27-28; Psalm 109:4; Jeremiah 11:19; Isaiah 53:2-5) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall enjoy the full reality of Christ’s work on the cross which destroyed the works of the devil. And we shall not live as victims of the dominion of the devil. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Corinthians 6-82 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I enjoy the full reality of Christ’s work.– I am not a victim of the devil.– I have dominion over the devil.– My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1070 - …WITH AN OPEN HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Sunday, 28th December, 2025 …WITH AN OPEN HEART“Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.” Acts 17:3 (KJV) In the present day Israel, and other Jewish communities around the world, some Jewish leaders have forbidden their fellow Jews from reading the New Testament (Brit Hadashah). Even with the reading of the Tanakh in their synagogues, some exclude certain Messianic scriptures.The Tanakh is the Jewish sacred book, just as we have the Bible as a sacred book. The TaNaKH is an acronym, it refers to the three sections of their shared text. The Tanakh (or TaNaKH) consist of: – Torah (the Law and the Pentateuch) – Nevi’im (the prophets)– Ketuvim (the writings) The Tanakh is what Bible Translators refer to as the “Old Testament” in the Bible. Note: As I have explained, the Old Testament is not Genesis to Malachi. The Old Testament refers to the Covenant which was wrought at Sinai (Exodus 19-20). The Old Testament is not a book of the Bible. The Old Testament is an arrangement of a dispensation at Sinai. The Jewish people must know that the covenant which was initiated at Sinai was not part of God’s promise to Abraham. Thus, that covenant at Sinai was not in God’s plan and was a parenthesis. The real deal was what God established with Abraham. God did not deal with Abraham according to the Old Testament or the “Old Covenant”. He dealt with Abraham according to the Covenant of Promise (See Galatians 3). It is called “Old” because its effect and function are now obsolete. There is now a New Covenant or Testament. Just as the Prophet Jeremiah declared: “The day is coming,” says the LORD, “when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah. This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and brought them out of the land of Egypt. They broke that covenant, though I loved them as a husband loves his wife,” says the LORD. “But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel after those days,” says the LORD. “I will put my instructions deep within them, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people” Jeremiah 31:31-33 (NLT) These Jews only restrict themselves to the reading of the Tanakh and don’t even attempt to open the New Testament. They don’t know that the New Testament was written to them as well. The first words in the New Testament portion of the Bible unveil the very core root of the New Testament. The New Testament has its roots in two major covenants: 1. The Covenant of Promise which God established with Abraham.2. And the Everlasting Kingdom Covenant God established with David. “This is the scroll of the lineage and birth of Jesus, the Anointed One, the son of David and descendant of Abraham.” Matthew 1:1 (TPT). These covenants were not only limited to Israel or Jews (to be precise) but to all people. 
The Anointed One did not come only for the household of Israel but also as the lamb of God that takes away the sin of the world. 
The New Testament authors were able to comprehend the concealed reality of God in the Tanakh (Old Testament portion of the Bible), by the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit of God gives understanding. It’s the Holy Spirit who moved the prophets to write about Jesus Christ (Messiah) even before His days. Which means it will take the Holy Spirit to decrypt the words of the Prophets and the scriptures. The Tanakh (Old Testament) doesn’t contradict the New Testament. Neither does the New Testament contradict the “Old Testament”.  The New Testament portion of the Bible is the unveiling of the mysteries in the scriptures. Most Jews refuse to open the New Testament and it is also a deceptive strategy of the adversary to keep them blinded and their minds veiled from the true revelation of Jesus.
When one turns to the Lord with an open heart, his or her heart and mind will be flooded with the glorious light of truth.
“We are not like Moses, who used a veil to hide the glory to keep the Israelites from staring at him as it faded away. Their minds were closed and hardened, for even to this day that same veil comes over their minds when they hear the words of the former covenant. The veil has not yet been lifted from them, for it is only eliminated when one is joined to the Messiah. So until now, whenever the Old Testament is being read, the same blinding comes over their hearts. But the moment one turns to the Lord with an open heart, the veil is lifted and they see. Now, the “Lord” I’m referring to is the Holy Spirit, and wherever He is Lord, there is freedom.”  2 Corinthians 3:13-17 (TPT) When you genuinely study the scriptures, it will not move you away from Jesus. A study of the scriptures with an open heart will lead you to Jesus Christ. The Lord was not exaggerating when He said, “… But the scriptures point to me” John 5:39 (NLT). The Psalmist said: “I long for Your salvation, O LORD, And Your law is my delight.” Psalm 119:174 (NKJV). The law doesn’t give Salvation, the law will lead you to Salvation. Those who truly delight in Salvation will be led to the Lord. Because the Lord is Salvation.  
Maintain an open heart to know the Lord through the scriptures. 
The knowledge of the revelation of Jesus is what launches you into the enjoyment of your freedom to participate in the inheritance of the saints in the light. OH THANK YOU JESUS!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 25:5; Psalm 86:11; Psalm 143:10; 2 Chronicles 16:9; Romans 1:20; Isaiah 61:1) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall bring us into the knowledge of Himself into our hearts through His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Corinthians 9-112 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is opened to the knowledge of Jesus. – My eyes are opened to the full revelation of Jesus as the True Messiah. – Jesus is the CHRIST. – Jesus is the King of Kings. Oh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1071 - YOU ARE SUSTAINED FROM WITHIN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t settle for the limitations around you. Don’t think according to your background or where you live. Don’t make decisions according to how you feel. In Christ Jesus, there are no limitations. All limitations are mental illusions. Hallelujah! Author Monday, 29th December, 2025 YOU ARE SUSTAINED FROM WITHIN “But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.”Isaiah 40:31 (KJV)On a normal day, you know you are healthy, and you have the physical strength or energy to go about your business or daily tasks. But even though you are physically strong, there are certain tasks you realize you are not able to execute because you feel weak inwardly.Though being healthy and physically fit is good, people who accomplish big things don’t do it because they have physical strength. It doesn’t take men with big muscles to do big things. Mental strength is always powerful than physical strength. 
A man with super mental strength will rule over a man who has more  physical strength.
Take good care of your body, so that it can carry your strong mind. However don’t just build muscles, without building your mind.While mental strength is great, there is such a thing as divine strength, which is greater.Have you heard a healthy person saying, “I don’t have the strength to continue this task”, before?Such people do not mean that they are sick or weak. What they mean is that they lack the inner capacity or vigor for the task.Every task or assignment requires a special capacity for execution.
A man is sustained by the inward strength he has built.
“If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small” Proverbs 24:10 (KJV)The strength you have determines what you can withstand and conquer. There are some tasks or challenges, your physical strength wouldn’t be able to help you conquer. There are others your mental strength wouldn’t be enough to sustain you.“He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.“ 1 Samuel 2:9 Berean Standard Bible).To prevail is to be great or exceedingly mighty. And there is a certain degree of greatness which your own strength cannot sustain.We find the solution here:“Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.“ Zechariah 4:6 (ESV)Beyond the self-generated might or power, there is the might and power of the Spirit.
The strength of the Spirit produces in you an unceasing flow of divine strength to do anything God has called you to do.
As part of the promise of the Holy Spirit, Jesus outlines the function of the Holy Spirit in the believer:“And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper (Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor—Counselor, Strengthener, Standby), to be with you forever” John 14:16 (Amplified Bible)From the above verse, you will find that the function or role of the Holy Spirit in a believer is who He is in you forever.The Holy Spirit is not just in you to comfort and strengthen you. The Holy Spirit is in you forever as the Strengthener and comforter.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strengthen in you.
Whenever people think of the need to receive strength or to have strength they think of the outward activities they can engage.The kind of strength the Prophet Isaiah wrote about in chapter 40 of his prophetic book wasn’t about physical strength. He was writing about divine strength.And to have this divine strength is to behold and have the LORD.“O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.” Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV)
You don’t separate what God supplies or gives to you from Him.
Whatever God gives you and makes you become, that is who He is. Thus, whatever God gives to you, is who He is. God doesn’t just give you things He gives you Himself.God gives you wisdom because He is Wisdom. He brings you Salvation because He is Salvation. He brings you righteousness because He is Righteousness. He brings you strength because He is Strength.People try to look for divine strength without God. You cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength you must have God.
As believer in Christ you have the advantage, God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; John 15:5; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for being our strength and also the supply of strength within us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLAN2 Corinthians 12-13Galatians 12 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my strength. – I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. – The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. – I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1072 - WAIT ON THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To know the voice of God, you must know the word of God. The word of God communicates the character, the mind and the life of God. The Word of God is God explaining Himself. To know God’s voice is not a mystery. To know God’s voice is to know the word of God. Selah. Author Tuesday, 30th December, 2025 WAIT ON THE LORD “But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.” Isaiah 40:31 (KJV) To have the strength of God, you must turn to Him and receive Him as life. As I mentioned in the previous episode, whatever God is, He dispenses into you.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strength in you.
The Holy Spirit dispenses and distributes all of the virtues of God into you. “O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.” Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV) The Prophet Isaiah explains the extensiveness and limitlessness of the strength of God (Isaiah 40:12-28). Now you see in verses 29 – 31, the Prophet Isaiah explains how God supplies strength to those who are His. Because God’s strength doesn’t faint, those who faint are strengthened by Him.  “He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength. Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.” Isaiah 40:29-31 (KJV) The phrase, “even the youth shall faint”, is a depiction of how the most strongest shall faint even in their prime. The youthful season is the prime season of every natural thing.  It is normal to faint in old age. It may even seem normal to grow weak after you have been pressed by challenges. It may seem normal to grow tired and become exhausted.
Yet the testimony of those who WAIT upon the Lord is different. Those who WAIT upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
Now the Lord gives power to the faint and causes strength and ability to abound towards those who lack might. It doesn’t matter how the vicissitudes have beaten you up and crushed you, the moment you turn and open up to the LORD, strength is dispensed and distributed to you. As I have mentioned, you cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength you must have God.As a believer in Christ, you have the advantage, God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
You can accomplish more with the strength of God when it is RENEWED. To RENEW the strength of God, you must learn to WAIT UPON THE LORD.
To wait upon the Lord is not just an imagery of a “Waiter” in a restaurant. The word WAIT is from the Hebrew word, “qâvâh . The primitive root for “qâvâh” means “TO BIND TOGETHER”. To wait upon the Lord means to look patiently to the Lord, to expect and to be tied to the Lord. It means you are knitted and plaited with and to the LORD. Jesus said, “I am the sprouting vine and you’re my branches. As you live in union with me as your source, fruitfulness will stream from within you—but when you live separated from me you are powerless.” John 15:5 (TPT) In as much as it is good to be a tree, it is far greater and better to be a branch. The strength and fruitfulness of a branch is dependent on the tree. You must be knitted to the Lord as a fruitful branch is to a great tree. Don’t be separated and be distracted or moved away from the Lord.
The more you remain in the Lord, the more you are renewed in strength.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God!DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10; Psalm 27:1) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted nor become prideful but will always remain rooted and established in the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANGalatians 2-42 YEARS PLAN1 Chronicles 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my strength. – I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. – The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. – I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1079 - YOU HAVE HIS FULLNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 6th January, 2026YOU HAVE HIS FULLNESS“But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us” 2 Corinthians 4:7 (NKJV)There are some thoughts which control our mindsets and how we think about our lives.For example: You might have heard people make statements like:“We came to this world empty, and we will all leave empty”
How can this be true?
Some people have really made this thought pattern their consciousness. They think they came to this world empty, so their lives are empty.These thoughts even control the mindsets of certain saints in Christ.
A man in Christ cannot be empty. A man without God has an empty life.
When you become born again, you receive the treasure of God into you.This treasure is the fullness of the life of God in you.You can’t carry this life and be empty.The thoughts of emptiness are not of God.“For His divine power has bestowed on us [absolutely] everything necessary for [a dynamic spiritual] life and godliness, through true and personal knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.” 1 Peter 1:3 (Amplified)In your relationship with God, you are supplied with EVERYTHING about life and godliness (the expression of divinity).Some feel empty because they don’t feel satisfied, or complete.
If you are unsatisfied, you are looking at the wrong places.
Beloved, you are made complete in Christ. Stop looking at things you think you lack or don’t have. Look inside, you have God’s greatest treasure.Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:2-4; Matthew 13:44-46; Colossians 2:9-10) WE PRAYThat we will grow and increase in the knowledge of the fullness of this rich reality.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEphesians 6Philippians 1-22 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not empty.– I carry the fullness of the life of God in me.– I am made complete in Christ.– I carry God’s greatest treasure in me.– My life is not empty.–  I am supplied with EVERYTHING pertaining to life and godliness.Oh Gloreeey! Hallelujah

title: EPISODE 1080 - MAINTAIN A STRONG COMPOSURE
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 7th January, 2026MAINTAIN A STRONG COMPOSURE“And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise”. Philippians 4:8 (NLT) In this present age, mental health has become one of the common troubling conditions.And this is not only with the aged. Most young people are struggling with mental health issues. Most people seem to go through a lot of mental torture and struggle. This includes people who are born again in Christ. People who should put on the shield of faith, have been dominated or swamped by fear and troubles.These things are caused by little distractions and then they grow into unbearable conditions. Some steer off from their faith in Christ and the good works the Lord has ordained for them to walk in; by some seeds of uncertainty and distractions. In this present age of avalanche information and pluralistic worldviews.
