People are easily distracted and lack the stamina to maintain a strong composure. Most people don’t know which the right way to think.They have become students of social media and not ardent disciples of Christ.  Instead of being raised in the school of the Word and the Spirit, people are schooled by comedians and content creators who are interested in creating traffic on their platforms. You cannot function in faith beyond what you think, see with your mind, hear and speak. The adversary is after your faith. One of the things to do to maintain great faith is to imbue focus. The greatest strategy of the adversary is to distract your faith. The adversary distracts the focus of your faith with thoughts which are contrary to the word of God. This is why it is essential to fix your mind on the word of God and not what happens around you or how you feel. For the adversary to attack the faith of Job, he went after the things which he loved or are connected to him (his family, his livestock etc). For the adversary to attack you, he can even use the negative comments from family relatives, lecturers or teachers. Past negative and hurtful experiences, including social media trends, can sweep you off your joy. Until you intentionally imbue focus you will be a slave to the peripherals. You have a mandate to fulfill. Don’t give room for any distractions, IMBUE FOCUS! Set your mind or heart, your thoughts and imaginations on:– what is true and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable.– Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise.Where else can you access these beautiful things except the GOSPEL OF JESUS.Apart from the WORD OF GOD, you cannot access TRUTH. Don’t start looking for bad reports and negative experiences in your life.  Don’t allow the experiences of some public figures define your life. None of their experiences qualifies to be an example for you. You are of God.If it is not praise worthy don’t give your mind to it. There are more glorious things Christ has done for you, make them your meditation. Remember:that the sharing of your faith may become effective by the acknowledgment of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus. Philemon 1:6 (NKJV) Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 3:18; 10:4-5; 1 Peter 1:13; 5:8; Proverbs 4:25; Hebrews 3:1; 12:1-2; Colossians 3:1; Philippians 3:12-14) WE PRAYIn the name of Jesus, that nothing shall be strong enough to distract us. That by the supply of grace, we imbue divine focus in the midst of all distractions in this present age. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 20-222 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I fix my mind on the word of God. – I don’t give room for any distraction, I imbue focus. – I don’t allow the experiences of others to define my life, my life is defined by the word of God. – I don’t pay attention to the peripherals. – I maintain my heart and mind on my mandate irrespective of staggering oppositions.– I maintain a strong composure of faith. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1081 - MAKE EACH DAY COUNT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you maintain a strong sense of urgency concerning your goals, you may not be disciplined, diligent and consistent. Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste. SELAH! Author Thursday, 8th January, 2026MAKE EACH DAY COUNT “…because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that you will be altogether joyful” Deuteronomy 16:15b (ESV) Why do you see people who are blessed of the Lord, yet are not manifesting that blessing? Beloved, laziness is one of the reasons people don’t see the manifestation of their blessings. The Lord does not bless your laziness; the Lord blesses the work of your hands and your produce. There is nothing the lazy produce. And that is one of the major causes of failure.
People fail, live poor and struggle to make any advancement because they are lazy.
You can have great potential and not manifest any greatness.To be lazy is to be slothful, sluggish or indolent. A lazy person avoids exertion or productive activity. Unproductive activity is no activity when it comes to diligence. The lazy are not diligent and cannot rule.“Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends on forced labor.” Proverbs 12:24 A disciple of Jesus cannot be relevant in the kingdom when you remain lazy. Our Lord rewards faithfulness. And laziness cannot make you faithful.
God ordained work and expects you to be diligent with the work or the task He inspires or instructs you to do.
The lazy person can desire greatness and still not experience it. ”A sluggard’s appetite is never filled, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied” Proverbs 13:4 Greatness may begin with your desire; however, your desire must translate into consistent action, which will birth the greatness. “The soul of the lazy man desires and has nothing; but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich” (Proverbs 13:4 KJV). Having desire is one thing, and being diligent to work towards it is what makes the desire a reality. Such a person will speak of great ideas or plans, yet will not take any action. And even when they begin to take a step towards their plans, they lack the discipline to complete the task.
The lazy person makes excuses and amplifies challenges because he or she hates to work. 
A lazy person will give exaggerated reasons they couldn’t start or complete a task. “The lazy one [manufactures excuses and] says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets [if I go out to work]!” Proverbs 22:13 (Amplified Bible). A sluggard person wastes time and destroys great plans or success. (Proverbs 18:9) God designed you for productivity.“For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.” Ephesians 2:10 (ESV).
Through your diligence, you bring honour to God and fulfill divine purpose.
Get up and get to work.Don’t waste time on sleep.  Don’t waste time on things which don’t contribute to your success. Set daily goals and targets so that you can measure your success and impact. Don’t sit thinking of why you were not blessed, while you know clearly what to do to manifest blessings. The LORD BLESSES THE INCREASE OF YOUR PRODUCE AND THE WORK OF YOUR HANDS.Avoid any reason or anything that leads to idleness or unproductivity.Beloved, deal with laziness and rise.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 16:10; Proverbs 10:4-5; Proverbs 6:6-12; 12:11; Proverbs 14:23; 19:15; 20:4; 24:30-34; Matthew 25:24-29; 2 Thessalonians 3:6-10) WE PRAYOh Lord, grant me the grace to be diligent in whatever my hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 23-252 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I make each day count. – I make daily progress and success. – Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof. – I win everyday. – I am not a waster of resources. – Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me. – I am a diligent man. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1082 - DON’T RUN AWAY FROM PURPOSE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Many have delayed the plan and purpose of God for their lives because they failed to be prompt with an assignment. Beloved, learn to be prompt. Author Friday, 9th January, 2026 DON’T RUN AWAY FROM PURPOSE “It’s not that I’ve already reached the goal or have already completed the course. But I run to win that which Jesus Christ has already won for me.” Philippins 3:12 (God’s Word Translation)The finished work of Christ, through His death, burial, and resurrection, does not mean that we have no work or task as believers in Christ.
The finished work of Christ has produced the goodness of God in every believer.
The Lord has made every new creation in Christ His workmanship unto good works (Ephesians 2:10). Interestingly, these good works were foreordained in God before the foundation of the world.God planned in advance our destiny and the good works we would do to fulfill it.Which means by Christ’s finished work, we have access through faith into God and have been established in Him to execute His plans by our good works of faith.The life of every believer is to be the execution of God’s eternal purpose. The original goal and purpose of your life is not for you to live and accomplish your personal ambition.The goal of your life is to execute God’s purpose.All that you need to accomplish God’s purpose and plan for your life are fully supplied to you by God, through His Spirit. However, you will still not automatically accomplish God’s goal for your life.
To achieve God’s goal for your life, you have to be intentional, you have to be determined, and you have to make a decision you are going to diligently work towards the goal or target.
Paul the apostle said, “I run to win…”To run in this context also means to press on or to explode with determination towards your goal. It is to act in commitment to a course till you reach the finish line.There is a level God wants you to reach, an impact God wants you to make, and a glorious purpose to fulfill. There is a target God has woven into your heart.No matter how you accomplish those personal ambitions of yours, you will only find true satisfaction when you pursue and accomplish God’s purpose and goal for your life.This then requires that you set your heart and mind towards God’s goal for your life.
Live every day of your life by running towards the goal the Lord has set before you.
Don’t run away from purpose, run towards the purpose of God for you.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 12:1-2; 1 Corinthians 9:24-27; Psalm 119:32; Colossians 1:29;  2 Peter 1:10-11; 1 Timothy 6:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we will enjoy more and more grace as we run towards the goal the Lord has set before us  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 26-282 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I run diligently towards my goal. – I am intentional, determined and committed to reach the finishline. – I will never stop at my goal halfway. – I run to win and reach my goal. – I don’t run away from purpose. – I enjoy more and more grace as I run towards the goal that the Lord has set before me. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1084 - GOD REWARDS DILIGENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Sunday, 11th January, 2026GOD REWARDS DILIGENCE “The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance and advantage, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty.” Proverbs 21:5 (AMP)It’s amazing to have great potentials and ideas, but they do not automatically make you successful. Fruit-bearing also requires another key ingredient – DILIGENCE! It is essential to be a person of diligence and prompt to follow the Lord’s plans and instructions. One of the core differences between those who prosper and those who don’t are diligence and promptness.It is important to take a step towards a goal. However, taking a “one time” step and being inconsistent will not put you at the end of the goal. Diligence is a consistent working habit one should cultivate. God’s grace to produce increase must be concurrent with your diligence. Until then the grace to increase will not manifest.
To be diligent is to be consistent and committed with a working plan or to an instruction of the Lord.
It is doing what has been entrusted to you exactly as you were instructed to do and at the expected time. A diligent person does not procrastinate and does not entertain slothfulness. “The lazy person craves, yet receives nothing, but the desires of the diligent are satisfied”. Proverbs 13:4 (ISV). You can have all the desire to be a great man of God, to win millions of souls, to establish a great company to support the spread of the gospel, and etc. But without diligence they will grow into mere wish.Until you take a diligent step nothing will happen. This is the secret to many unsatisfied living.The spiritually lazy man can never move forward in the things of the spirit. The same in all phases of our living.
Diligence is going the extra mile, to do things consistently and beyond the limit of others to increase results.
At this level, when the blessings of the Lord’s increase come upon what you do, people see an exponential increase.God rewards diligence. “Now without faith it is impossible to please God, for whoever comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who diligently seek him“.Hebrews 11:6.. How diligent are you in your Bible reading? How diligent are you in prayer and acting the Word? Are you diligently listening to the teachings of the word? Sometimes, you don’t even share in the grace of the ministry you are established; because you are not consistent with the instructions of the Word. A man of diligence brings growth in the ministry of the Lord. The more diligent you are in devouring and meditating on the teachings, the more fresh ability is released.  “I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find me.” Proverbs 8:17 There is an anointing that backs every message and when you diligently meditate, you come into the experience of the message. Are you praying at the time, you are asked to pray? (1 Thessalonians 5:16-18). The Lord doesn’t just instruct us to pray, He sees far and knows the capacity we need to build before time. How diligent are you with your soul winning activity, your business and academics?
People who are slothful are always stagnant. No amount of complain can move you forward.
You must be diligent to do. All these years of laziness, complaining, making excuses not being prompt and consistent are the root of your stagnation and failure. Dare to be diligent. Be determined to move from the place of complaining, inconsistency, making excuses, being distracted, laziness and cultivate the habit of diligence. Be diligent to do things differently this year and see the difference you will make. Remain diligent in all things irrespective of opposition. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 12:24; 11:27; Romans 12:11; 1 Corinthians 15:58; Hebrews 6:11) WE PRAYThat the Lord shall empower us to be diligent in all we do for the Kingdom, in our relationship with Him, in business, at the workplace and in our academics. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 32-342 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am diligent in all things. – I diligently do what the Lord has entrusted into my hands. – I move forward because I am spiritually diligent. – I diligently go the extra mile to achieve greater results. – I am committed to do that which the Lord has set before me to do. – As a diligent person, my plans surely lead to abundance. – I refuse to lag behind. – I fervently and diligently serve. – I don’t stop halfway, I am diligent to the end. – As remain diligent, I rule and my desires are satisfied. – I am the favored of the Lord. – I am diligent in prayer and in my fellowship with the Lord. – I am diligent in meditating on God’s Word. – I am empowered by God to demonstrate diligence in all I do. – I am outstanding in my service to God. – I am diligent in doing what my Man of God instructs me to do. – I see prosperity in all I do. In the name of Jesus. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1085 - TAKE THESE CRUCIAL ITEMS SERIOUS
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your words must be full of wisdom and grace. Your work ethic at the office must be a reflection of God’s creativity and excellence. As the embodiment of the glory of God, anyone who interacts with you must behold the majestic excellence of God. SELAH! Author Monday, 12th January, 2026TAKE THESE CRUCIAL ITEMS SERIOUSThe new year has began and you don’t need to wait till the ending of the year before you make the most of every opportunity. You must be intentional with your decisions andchoices. This is why I am sharing these four crucial items with you today:1. Write down your plans plainly“And the LORD answered me: “Write the vision; make it plain on tablets, so he may run who reads it.” Habbakuk 2:2Yes, it’s good to keep Divine inspirations to heart. However, you should also write them plainly. Write plainly the things the Lord has inspired you todo in His Kingdom and Ministry, Business and Finance, Academics or Education and Family. Don’t assume you will remember all theinspirations of the Spirit. Whiles you pray or fellowship with the Spirit keep your notes by you. As you read, study and meditate on the scriptures, keep a writing material.2. Get into Prayer.“Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established”. Proverbs 16:3 (NASB)Prayer is not just to be done in January. Prayer must be your daily habit. It must be part of your life and living. Don’t just have one good day of prayer.“Men always ought to pray” (Luke 18:1), “Pray without ceasing” (1 Thess. 5:17).Understand that Prayer is not just to have God to answer your requests; through Prayer you are supplied with grace and ability to do.“We plan the way we want to live, but only Godmakes us able to live it” Proverbs 16:9 (MSG)Through prayer you receive clarity of purpose and also submit the totality of God’s inspirations and ideas to you, back to Him. You put God in charge.(Read Proverbs 16:3 Message Translation).3. Get into Action.“Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action! ” Ezra 10:4 (Berean Study Bible)Those ideas and plans were not to be locked up in your notes as prayer topics. Plans are to be executed. You have to act on the plans as the Lord has given you grace and ability to do. You must act with a sense of urgency. “Now that you know these things, you will beblessed if you do them.” John 13:17 (NIV)4. Maintain Consistency.“And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up” Galatians 6:9Consistently plan, write the ideas, pray and move into action. It takes discipline and diligence to be consistent. This year is a great year for you.Remain Blessed.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 1:6-8; Psalm 119:60; 1 Peter 1:13) WE PRAYThat the Lord will guide our steps as we execute allthat He has inspired us to do. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 35-372 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I put God’s plans and ideas to work.– I have freshability to do what God inspires me to do.– I actdiligently and consistently.Shalom!

title: EPISODE 1086 - A PREREQUISITE FOR GREATNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency A man of faith has an awareness of the facts but doesn’t allow the power of the facts to rule over him. SELAH! Author Tuesday, 13th, January, 2026 A PREREQUISITE FOR GREATNESS“So David rose early in the morning, left the sheep with a keeper, and took the things and went as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the camp as the army was going out to the fight and shouting for the battle .”1 Samuel 17:20 (NKJV)No one makes a great impact without possessing virtues for greatness.
Being anointed doesn’t automatically bring you to the fulfilment of purpose.
It takes virtue, character with anointing to become relevant in the Kingdom.Joseph did not just wake up to the fulfilment of his dream. He went through a process where his character and virtue were tested. Those processes established his character and virtue, and that enriched his rule as the Prime Minister of Egypt.He demonstrated absolute confidence and honor towards God, a heart of servitude, self-control, patience, humility, mastery of his gift, and readiness in season and out of season.David was also anointed by the Prophet Samuel to be King (1 Samuel 16:1,13).
But David didn’t just rise to the throne. He has to go through a process to prove the consistency of his character.
David was recommended to King Saul, because of his exceptional skill on the harp. He found favor and was privileged to serve the king in the palace. (1 Samuel 16:16-23).However, David’s rise to serve in the palace did not stop him from being humble towards his father. He occasionally visited his father to run errands for him.“But David occasionally went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.” 1 Samuel 17:15 (NKJV).David didn’t think that because he was now serving in the king’s palace and he would soon become the King of Israel, he didn’t have to continue to tend sheep and run errands for his father.As part of the many excellent virtues David demonstrated, I want us to give attention to this seemingly little but profound quality of exceptionalism.Let’s read the opening verse in context:“Then Jesse said to his son David, “Take now for your brothers an ephah of this dried grain and these ten loaves, and run to your brothers at the camp. And carry these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers fare, and bring back news of them.” Now Saul and they and all the men of Israel were in the Valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.So David rose early in the morning, left the sheep with a keeper, and took the things and went as Jesse had commanded him. And he came to the camp as the army was going out to the fight and shouting for the battle.” 1 Samuel 17:17-20 (NKJV)David didn’t hesitate nor procrastinate. He rose early in the morning with a sense of responsibility.The Message Translation puts it this way:“David was up at the crack of dawn and, having arranged for someone to tend his flock, took the food and was on his way just as Jesse had directed him. He arrived at the camp just as the army was moving into battle formation, shouting the war cry. Israel and the Philistines moved into position, facing each other, battle-ready”. (1 Samuel 17:20-21)Now because of David’s promptness, he got the battlefield at the right time (of his destiny).
Many have delayed the plan and purpose of God for their lives because they failed to be prompt with an assignment.
Don’t miss this other little detail as well:Though David was prompt with his father’s new task, he was attentive to all his responsibilities. He handed over the sheep he was tending to a keeper. The young man David had a sense of responsibility. And was not overwhelmed by his multi-task. You must have a great sense of responsibility to make a difference in your world.Let this character of exceptionalism be in you; because you are destined for greatness.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17; Proverbs 20:4; Genesis 22:1-3; Ecclesiastes 3:1; Revelation 3:11; Revelation 22:12; Philippians 4:7-18; Romans 16:1-10) WE PRAY We pray that we shall be prompt, consistently diligent and humble with the assignment the Lord has given to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 38-402 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I cultivate the right virtues for greatness. – I am prompt with every  assignment the Lord has entrusted into my hands. – I am empowered by God to be demonstrate consistence diligence in all I do. – I am exceptional in all that I do. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1087 - THE PRAYER OF SUPPLICATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. Don’t look at the challenges to doubt God. Make the Word of the Lord your focus and you will see the manifestation of His glory. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 14th, January, 2026THE PRAYER OF SUPPLICATION “Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints”Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)Paul the apostle sets SUPPLICATION as the linchpin in this verse. Thus, in verse 18, he mentions supplication twice.
Supplication simply means prayer of request or petition.
It is to humbly and earnestly make a specific request from the Lord.“With all prayer and petition pray [with specific requests] at all times [on every occasion and in every season] in the Spirit, and with this in view, stay alert with all perseverance and petition [interceding in prayer] for all God’s people.” Ephesians 6:18 (Amplified Bible)
Praying the prayer of request or supplication at all times is consistent with the knowledge of Christ.
And the beautiful thing about prayer is that God, who is our heavenly Father is a prayer-answering God.It doesn’t matter the details of your request, you must have faith in your heart that, when you pray He hears you and has abundant provisions for you.You pray about everything and for everything you need, focusing on Christ’s purpose in your heart.
No matter the need you have, it must not be the ultimate focus of your heart.
However, with confidence in who your heavenly Father is, and the humility of heart, make your request.When you seem to be feeling anxious about anything, pray!Are there some specific burdens or worries on your heart, about any issue at all?Here is your answer:“Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell God what you need, and thank Him for all He has done.” Philippians 4:6 (NLT)And this will be the outcome:“Then you will experience God’s peace, which exceeds anything we can understand. His peace will guard your hearts and minds as you live in Christ Jesus.” Philippians 4:7 (NLT)It is to humbly and earnestly make a specific request concerning something you want or need.
Asking the Lord for your needs or wants doesn’t mean those needs are the center of your life.
 When the Lord becomes the focus of your life, your requests or needs are influenced by His will.This is important because God is not a “genie”, who does as you wish. He is your Father, who has a perfect plan for your life.“For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the LORD, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.” Jeremiah 29:11 (NIV)Therefore, you have to make requests according to His will or purpose and plans.
Any request made according to the will of God is not of the flesh. Any request made according to the will of God glorifies Him.
Never make requests according to jealousy, envy or desire to live above others.Whatever you do must be unto the Lord’s glory.“And if you ask, you won’t receive it for you’re asking with corrupt motives, seeking only to fulfill your own selfish desires.” James 4:3 (TPT)Beloved, make supplication to the Lord about everything you need.“You jealously want what others have so you begin to see yourself as better than others. You scheme with envy and harm others to selfishly obtain what you crave—that’s why you quarrel and fight. And all the time you don’t obtain what you want because you won’t ask God for it!” James 4:2 (TPT)You can make specific requests about your finances, academics, family, health, career or business without esteeming those needs above the Lord. When you esteem the Lord above all things, you will acknowledge the things you need as means to the end and not the end itself.
Instead of being anxious, take your needs to God in prayer.
It doesn’t matter what it is, talk to God about it and His peace shall garrison your heart.Take what God has said in His word and use it as a basis to make your request to Him.“Now this is the confidence that we have in Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.” 1 John 5:14 (NKJV)Don’t surrender to anxiety and fear; instead, practice the prayer of supplication.Release all your burdens, care, and worries from your heart and mind. Cast them unto the Lord.
Do you find yourself troubled or afflicted, pray!
Beloved, what are you waiting for?Get up or get on your knees or get into a humble heartfelt prayer posture and make supplication, now.
Pray about that situation and enjoy divine answers.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Mark 11:24; Matthew 7:7-11; Psalm 145:19; John 14:13) WE PRAYWe pray forth the burdens on our hearts, declaring the great help of the Lord for each day and for the tasks He has given us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 41-432 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t surrender to anxiety and fear. – I pray in all things and about everything. – I refuse to worry about anything. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1088 - MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR THE SAINTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t give room to any limitation in your mind. You can have exceptional results as you exercise boldness in the Lord. Hallelujah! Author Thursday, 15th, January 2026 MAKE SUPPLICATION FOR THE SAINTS “Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints” Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)To make supplication for all the saints is an essential contribution to the growth of the whole body of Christ.Prayer in itself makes tremendous power available to cause changes.Thus, through your prayer of supplication for the saints, the Holy Spirit supplies divine energies for change.
God will always step into situations when men submit that situation to Him in prayer.
There was a point when Herod arrested and executed James the brother of John with a sword. When he noticed it pleased the people, he proceeded to arrest Peter. When Peter was imprisoned, the Church decided to change the situation.This time, the saints didn’t sit to look on, assuming that God would automatically step into the situation. They made a decision to pray.“Thus Peter was kept in the prison, but prayer was fervently being made to God by the church for him.” Acts 12:5 (Lexham English Bible).The Church continued earnestly in prayer until Peter returned to them.Through the prayers of the saints, an angel was deployed to bring deliverance to Peter.Sometimes some saints may have a challenge and become helpless not knowing what to do. As you consistently and earnestly pray for the saints, you deliver them from helpless situations.
The adversary is looking for every opportunity to ensnare and destroy the people of God, therefore, we must make supplications for one another.
Jesus said to Peter:“Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has demanded to sift you like wheat, but I have prayed for you, that your faith may not fail. And you, when once you have turned back, strengthen your brothers” Luke 22:31-32 (Lexham English Bible).Satan has not refrained from finding an opportunity to sift the brethren like wheat.Don’t join the world to criticize and condemn the Church and weak saints.Pray for your Pastor or Church leader and all the other saints that their faith will not faint.
Please get into prayer now.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Acts 12:5-14; 2 Thessalonians 3:1; 1 Timothy 2:1; 2 Corinthians 9:14) WE PRAYWe pray for all saints that they will not faint in their faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 44-462 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I seek for the well-being of all the saints. – I grow in love for the saints.– I make supplications for the saints my habit.– I see every believer as a brother and I make supplication for them.– None of the saints shall fail nor faint in their faith.– We are a people of prayer. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1089 - UNLOCK THE SECRET TO THE SUPPLY OF MULTIPLIED GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. Beloved, STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART! Author Friday, 16th January, 2026 UNLOCK THE SECRET TO THE SUPPLY OF MULTIPLIED GRACE“…God resists you when you are proud but multiplies grace and favor when you are humble.”1 Peter 5:5 (TPT)Paul the apostle was clear on this: “I am what I am by the grace of God.”He knew he couldn’t achieve anything without the supply of God. Grace is God’s supply to you.(To read more on Grace, get  my new COMPENDIUM OF ETERNAL Verities, PHOTIZO ALPHA EDITION)Jesus, as the embodiment of Grace, said, Without me you can do nothing.
The grace of God is essential for living out God’s purpose and fulfilling ministry.
Grace is the economy of God’s household. It is the substance of God’s dealings with men. While faith is the substance of our dealings with God.Though every believer has access to the enjoyment of grace, it takes more than being born again to enjoy the multiplication of grace.From the opening verse, you will see that pride is a hindrance to the multiplication of grace. God multiplies grace and favour to the humble.Humility is one of the greatest secrets to the enjoyment of multiplied grace. It takes humility to submit to God’s supply.
To be proud towards God is to subtly esteem yourself above God’s graciousness.
Thus, the pride-filled person sets himself up as a resistance to the grace of God.In his writing to the saints in Philippi, Paul the apostle addressed how satisfied he would be to see the brethren work together in love. However, the possibility of that togetherness is dependent on how they walk in humility.Paul explained how one can exercise himself or herself in humility.Please take a look at these scriptures:“So I’m asking you, my friends, that you be joined together in perfect unity—with one heart, one passion, and united in one love. Walk together with one harmonious purpose and you will fill my heart with unbounded joy.Be free from pride-filled opinions, for they will only harm your cherished unity. Don’t allow self-promotion to hide in your hearts, but in authentic humility put others first and view others as more important than yourselves. Abandon every display of selfishness. Possess a greater concern for what matters to others instead of your own interests. And consider the example that Jesus, the Anointed One, has set before us. Let his mindset become your motivation” Philippians 2:2-5 (TPT)Here are a few characteristics of the humble reading through the verses:– The humble is compassionate.– The humble lives under God’s Leadership.– The humble surrenders to God.– The humble knows how to communicate in love. He’s a master communicator.– The humble is obedient.– The humble has a thankful heart.– The humble is wise and demonstrates wisdom by following the example of Jesus.
Walk in humility to unlock the supply of multiplied grace in your life.
Shalom!Selah.DIG DEEPER(James 4: 6-10; Philippians 2:3-10; Proverbs 22:4; Matthew 23:12) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be free from every prideful thought and seed. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 47-492 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is free from every prideful thought and seed. – I walk in the humility of heart at all times. – I humbly submit to the supply of God. – I enjoy the supply of multiplied grace in my life. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1090 - PURSUE THE LION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Saturday, 17th January, 2026PURSUE THE LION"There was also Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant warrior from Kabzeel. He did many heroic deeds, which included killing two champions of Moab. Another time, on a snowy day, he chased a lion down into a pit and killed it." 1 Chronicles 11:22 (NLT)The beautiful outcomes you see in the scriptures weren't magical nor automatic.They were as a result of great demonstrations of faith.
There is no beautiful story without intentional processes.
You may read the wondrous testimonies in the scriptures and assume you cannot have the capacity to produce such results.However, the scriptures did not just list the inevitable outcomes of these patriarchs. A careful study of the scriptures will bring you to the understanding of the processes. When you give your mind to the scriptures, you will not be pinned to uncertainties.Paul the apostle said, "for whatever was written in earlier times was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope and overflow with confidence in His promises." Romans 15:4 (Amplified Bible)One of the great characters in the scriptures is one of the mighty men of David, Benaiah.You can read the opening verse for this episode again (just in case you didn't pay attention whiles reading).I believe you've done that right?What you just read in the opening verse about Benaiah wasn't a fluke. The story of Benaiah wasn't a myth or an old fable. God took his time to introduce in scriptures, the story of Benaiah. His exploit were recorded in the scriptures to inspire faith in the hearts of every reader.The story of Benaiah unveils a model of the daring man of faith.For a man to chased or pursue a lion shows the posture and attitude you need to have for the Lord's call on your life. This man did not defend himself by running away from the lion. He went after the lion.Beniah's exploit of faith got him to be appointed as a special guard to David and later became a commander in chief under King Solomon (1 Kings 2:35).
Beloved PURSUE THE LION.
When Benaiah was confronted by a lion he had the option of fight or flight. And he chose to fight.You may think this had nothing to do with faith but was just a skill he had. He did have skill, but took an exceptional task because he had faith.He did not pursue a lion by skill, he pursue the lion by faith."And what more shall I say? For time would fail me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets— who through faith conquered kingdoms, enforced justice, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, were made strong out of weakness, became mighty in war, put foreign armies to flight." Hebrews 11:33-34 (ESV)Oh glory to God.When you are confronted by a challenge you have the option to fight or flight.But they that are of faith don't take the option of flight. By faith you confront the target and task. You may only choose the option of flight because of fear.Don't allow fear to dictate your decision. Fear produces death, but faith to boldly confront those fear will cause you to experience life.
Don't let fear dominate your heart.
"...through faith... they put the armies to flight."God’s dream in your heart for the year maybe as fierce as a lion. It may be as heavy as a lion is to man. But don't allow the size of your dreams to intimidate you. Big dreams shouldn't scare you. You can't have a big God and be afraid to pursue big dreams; if you are afraid of big dreams then you doubt the greatness of God.Your audacity to confront challenges to prevail influences the steps you take.
Go after God-size dreams.
What dream has God put in your heart? What LION do you need to pursue this year?Don't run away. Don't doubt God's dream in your heart. Don't wait to be fully ready before you pursue that dream.Step forward in faith as the Lord inspires your heart and you will know the LORD has been getting you ready for the dream. Exercise yourself in faith and you will unlearn your fears.To exercise yourself in faith is mainly obedience to God. It is not whether you will fail or succeed; it is mainly about your obedience to God.People don't take steps to execute God’s vision because they are afraid to fail. Why will you allow fear of failure make you walk in disobedience?
Choose obedience over failure or success. Take the first step of faith and it will be a giant step of glory.
The Kingdom you belong to in christ, we don't run from big dreams, we confront them.God wants to write His story through your life. Exercise the courage to pursue your LION this year. The set time is now, dare to manifest greater results.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17:34-36; 1 Samuel 23:20-23; Romans 4:20-21; Psalm 18:29) WE PRAY We pray that our hearts shall be saturated with the possibilities of God to confront any target or dreams of the Lord and not run away in fear.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANGenesis 50Exodus 1-32 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I go after the God-size dreams. - I don’t run away. - As the Lord inspires my heart, I step forward in faith. - No target is too great for me to achieve. - No dream is too big for me to achieve. - I exercise my faith to go after every dream and target that God has placed in my heart.- I am not a coward. - I am a man of faith. - I am full of faith. - I don’t run away from challenges. - I don’t  allow fear to dictate my decision. - I refuse to allow fear dominate my heart. - I refuse to be intimated by big dreams. - Fear has no grip on me. - I confront challenges and fear. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1091 - YOU HAVE A DIFFERENT SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The adversary takes delight in pushing you into that state of “two-souled” through contrary winds of doctrine. Beloved, refuse every form of double-mindedness. Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 18th January, 2026YOU HAVE A DIFFERENT SPIRIT"But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it" Numbers 14:24 (ESV)In today's world, there are most people who have embellished their heart with their self-centered desires. Most people are running away from the inspirations of God, and running after the lies of the systems.Instead of living as champions they have become slaves of the systems. They see their fears instead of the faithful word of God.Don't be like the masses. Be what God has called you to be.
Don't run away from the tasks ahead. Pursue after the lion before you.
You cannot walk into the manifestation of God's purpose for your life, until you boldly act out God's word.The word of God processes your heart, to bring you into your full possession. All the children of Israel who didn't allow the word of God to process their heart, couldn't possess the land.Whenever your heart becomes overwhelmed by the challenges or the assignment of the Lord for you, know that you have turned away from His word.Take note of what the Lord said to the children of Israel and His testimony of Caleb:"But truly, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord, none of the men who have seen my glory and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have put me to the test these ten times and have not obeyed my voice, shall see the land that I swore to give to their fathers. And none of those who despised me shall see it. But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it" Numbers 14:21-24 (ESV)There were people who couldn't possess the land because they turned away from the Lord. These people did not obey the Lord's voice though they witnessed His glorious signs in Egypt.They had every reason to be valiant in faith, yet chose to despise the Lord.But Caleb was different!He had a different spirit contrary to theirs.
To have a different spirit is simply to have a different attitude.
However, one’s attitude is always connected to the condition of the heart. Caleb's attitude was as a result of how the word of the Lord had conditioned his heart.There twelve spies (12) sent to spy out the promised land, and 10 came with negative news which made the hearts of the people melt. They even saw themselves as grasshoppers.  These other ten (10) allowed fear to dominate their hearts. They couldn't think there were any possibilities for the word of the Lord to come to pass.But Caleb and Joshua didn't allow their hearts to fail. They demonstrated an attitude of faith. They stood upon the word of the Lord.Whiles others saw giants and limitations, they saw the giants as bread.
Beloved in Christ, God has not given you the spirit of fear.
You don't have the spirit of the world, therefore you don't think nor act as they do.You have another spirit or a different attitude. Your inward disposition is of power, love and a sound mind. (2 Timothy 1:7).You take steps as inspired by the Lord with boldness.You have the attitude that wins and prevails.You have the attitude of taking, conquering and possessing mountains.
Go through each day of the year with a different attitude.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Numbers 13:25-33; Numbers 14:6-9; Romans 4:20-21; Psalm 18:29; Psalm 27:3) WE PRAY We pray that in all things we shall demonstrate the attitude of the spirit of faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 4-72 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have a different Spirit. – There is no fear in me. – As the Lord inspires my heart, I step forward in faith. – No target is too great for me to achieve. – No dream is too big for me to achieve. – I exercise my faith to go after every dream and target that God has placed in my heart.– I am not a coward. – I am a man of faith. – I am full of faith. – I have the attitude that wins and prevails. – I don’t  allow fear to dictate my decision. – I refuse to allow fear dominate my heart. – Fear has no grip on me. – I have the attitude of taking, conquering and possessing. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1092 - EXUDE EXCELLENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your generosity is first for your benefit. And you must see it as a privilege whenever you have the opportunity to give. SELAH! Author Monday, 19th January, 2026 EXUDE EXCELLENCE “But also for this very reason, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue, to virtue knowledge,” 2 Peter 1:5 (NKJV). VIRTUE is from the greek word, “aretē” which means, “Moral excellence”. This refers to any preeminence (moral, intellectual, military power). It speaks of whatever procures preeminent estimation for a person or thing; hence, “intrinsic eminence, moral goodness, virtue,” (see Vine, W E: Vine’s Complete Expository Dictionary of Old and New Testament Words. 1996. Nelson). To add VIRTUE means to: 1. Show forth Excellence. To be excellent is to demonstrate eminence or superiority of achievement and mastery in a sphere. It denotes consummate quality. The world is in the dark (spiritually), and does not know the “excellencies of God”. However, God has called us to be His chosen generation, royal priests and peculiar people, to display His marvelous light or glory in this dark and chaotic world. (See 1 Peter 2:9) 2. It means to emit MORAL QUALITY.True virtue in Christ is not merely the modification of human qualities. It is producing divine qualities that make the person more like Jesus Christ. It is to exhibit the purity of Christ in your thoughts, speech, and conduct. We exhibit the character of Christ because we are “partakers of the divine nature” (2 Peter 1:4). We have the nature of Christ as our actual disposition within. 3. To exude COURAGE and MANLINESS.The word virtue depicts Valour or spiritual might.Areté often means courage.Plutarch (a Greek historian and biographer) says that: “God is a hope of aretē, not an excuse for cowardice”.
Moral uprightness is real manliness. It is true courage. It is the boldness to stand up for what is true and excellent.
The three Hebrew boys stood up for the only true God. They said, to King Nebuchadnezzar, our God will deliver us from your hands, even if he doesn’t we will still not bow (Daniel 3). Such audacity of virtue! Joseph said to Potiphar’s wife, I will not sin against God and your husband. (Study Genesis 39).  “Virtue issues in the courage to show whose it is and whom it serves.” How firm do you stand in Faith and truth in the face of corruption? 4. Virtue, Aretē, means To be Purposeful. To the Greek philosophers, Virtue meant, the fulfillment of a thing. It is what we might call operative or efficient, excellence.An example of its usage can be seen in fertile land. When anything in nature properly fulfills its purpose, that fulfillment is referred to as “virtue”. Land that produces crops is “excellent” because it is fulfilling its purpose.God has designed us as His workmanship (creative masterpiece) for a specific purpose. “We have become his poetry, a re-created people that will fulfill the destiny he has given each of us, for we are joined to Jesus, the Anointed One. Even before we were born, God planned in advance our destiny and the good works we would do to fulfill it!” Ephesians 2:10 (TPT)
When you walk in the fulfillment of God’s eternal purpose for your life, you demonstrate VIRTUE (Excellence).
Is your life radiating or repressing the excellencies of God? Selah.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:8; 1 Peter 4:11; 1 Peter 2:9; 12; Isaiah 43:21; Isaiah 60:1-3; Philippians 1:27) WE PRAY That we will show forth the excellencies of our Lord Jesus according to His life and nature at work in us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 8-102 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I demonstrate virtue and honor.– I am an example of God’s excellence and glory.– I emit courage and moral excellence in the face of opposition. – I walk in the fulfillment of my purpose. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1093 - LOVE NEVER FAILS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author  LOVE NEVER FAILS“Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails…“1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV) The knowledge of Christ is the communication of the truth of God. Anything in God you want to experience and enjoy is packaged in Christ.
The only way to demonstrate God, is to receive Christ. Christ in you, is all of God’s essence dispensed into you.
You cannot demonstrate the love of God outside Christ. Christ is the embodiment and the revelation of the love of God. The love of God which is fully revealed through Christ is poured into our hearts, by the Holy Spirit (Romans 5:5). Now with the love of Christ in your heart, you have the endless stream of love within you, to nourish others. You don’t have to try to be patient, kind, bear all things, believe all things and hope all things. You don’t have to attempt not to envy, not to parade yourself, not to behave rudely, not to think evil, not to be easily provoked and not to behave rudely. You practically demonstrate these things because the love of God is already in your heart. Any kind of love apart from the Love of God fails. The only kind of love which cannot fail is the GOD-KIND OF LOVE.
To say love never fails, means, it cannot be inefficient and it is endless.
After all things have ended, the greatest thing, which will remain is LOVE. (1 Corinthians 13:13). This God-kind of Love exists as perpetual as God is; for God is LOVE (1 John 4:8). You can only love by the empowering ability of the God-kind of love poured into you.  Your self-generated love is imperfect. It’s just like that of Peter, who denied Jesus. He boasted in his love for Jesus. He said, “Lord I will lay down my life for your sake”. But that love was not an outflow of the love of Christ. It was his “selfish-love” which couldn’t stand the test of time. Yep! He denied Jesus three times. (John 13:30-38; John 18:25-27). This was even after Jesus had spoken of the new commandment, “…as I have loved you, love one another” (John 13:34). Right there in John 13, we see the difference between the Love of God revealed in Christ and the love of man revealed in Peter. But after the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, on the day of Pentecost; Peter stood before the multitudes who were mocking their experience of the Spirit, ministered to them and got 3000 people saved. He declared the love and the power of Jesus to these multitudes, yet before the death of Jesus, he denied the Lord Jesus, three times. This is the compelling force of love of God in Christ. The only love which cannot fail is the love of God in Christ. Thanks be to God that now we have the ability to love as Christ loves us.
God has poured His love into us through the Spirit, that, He can spill-out His love through us unto others.
The question is, are you loving others as you love yourself?That will fail…!!!
What cannot fail is, LOVING OTHERS AS CHRIST HAS LOVED YOU.
You don’t love people by what you like or don’t like. You don’t love people according to your own preference. You love others according to the LOVE OF CHRIST IN YOU. This is the love which cannot and never fails. The most significant thing, dear one in the Lord, is not your talent, your gift nor skill. The most significant thing in your life in Christ is THE LOVE OF GOD. How do you receive and enjoy His love? How do you love the Lord? And how are you demonstrating His love towards others?
This love of God in Christ is supernatural, high-level love which never fails.
This divine love is already in you as a life-changing river of love; allow it to flow forth from you to others.Glory to God. “Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain” (1 Corinthians 15:58) Shalom!DIG DEEPER(John 13:30-38; John 18:25-27; Psalm 118:1-29; Psalm 136; Lamentations 3:22-24) WE PRAY- Lord thank you that your love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things, and that your love never fails in us. - That we may be steadfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord and the expression of His love in us towards others. - Our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God, even our Father, which has loved us, and given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace, comfort our hearts, and establish us in the consistency of demonstrating His love towards one another no matter the burdens. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 11-132 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:- This love of God that has been shed abroad in my heart never quits, never surrenders, and never gives up on other people. - I bear all things, believe all things, hope all things, and endure all things! - The love of God in my heart compels me to strain forward with all the might of Christ in me, to believe the very best in every situation and the best about every person. Oh Hallelujah.Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1094 - ARE YOU ROOTED IN THESE EXPRESSIONS OF LOVE?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week. The grace of God is sufficient for you. Don’t give room to any limitation in your mind. SELAH! Author   ARE YOU ROOTED IN THESE EXPRESSIONSOF LOVE?“Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy; love does not parade itself, is not puffed up; does not behave rudely, does not seek its own, is not provoked, thinks no evil; does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails…“1 Corinthians 13:4-8 (NKJV) When you set your delight and affection on the Lord, you are easily compelled by the Lord to practice and demonstrate His love in every situation. You do it according to the capacity of His love poured into you.
Beloved, the love of God is more than a choice or decision. The love of God is a strong force within you.
1. Love does not rejoice in iniquity, but rejoices in truth.Just as love keeps no record of wrong; love does not rejoice in the iniquity of others. It means love takes no delight in wrong, whether it is found in others or in us. As you are induced with the love of God, yours is to continually foster the victory of truth in a world full of malignant pleasure. Beloved, it is in apposition of the truth of God in us, to rejoice over a trouble or negative situation which happens to someone you don’t like.  Firstly, why should there be someone you don’t like? You may not like what people do wrongly, but there should be no one you don’t like. You may not keep company with the wicked, but don’t create any space in your heart where there is someone you don’t like. Love and like all men. Nevertheless, rejoice only over what is honest. Don’t seek for evil to happen to others. If there should be anything you rejoice over, rejoice over what is true, good and honest. Don’t rejoice when people who hurt you or wrong you are also wronged. Our Lord Jesus never sought for evil to happen to those who acted wickedly towards Him.  2. Love bears all things.“To bear” means, to roof over, the Greek word is stegō; it also means to cover silently and endure patience. It means to protect. Love is a safe place of shelter. You must be a haven of rest to anyone that comes in contact with you. You carry the burdens of others without giving up.
Love doesn’t say I have done enough. It endures patiently to remain as a shelter and to provide protection to others. 
“Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, since love covers a multitude of sins” 1 Peter 4:8 (ESV). Love does not promulgate the imperfections, mistakes, wrongs, faults, and negativity of others. Love conceals the wrongs of others and provides needed help of change without making noise. 3. Love believes all thingsGreek word for believe is, pisteuō, which means to trust in something. This is a practice of love. The usage of believe is not a one time thing.
To believe is a continuous  entrusting of one’s faith or confidence in the other.
It’s like you never stop believing in the best of others and in every situation. Even when people give up on themselves, you maintain a strong believe in them and you supply relentless encouragement. This is the love of Christ. The love of God is not to be blind, ignorant and stupid. The love of God sees all the wrongs and the negativity in situations. However, it sees a better way to terminate the wrongs and to bring to life, the beauty and the glory in others. 4. Love hope all thingsHope is the backbone of our believe, the Greek word is, elpizō, it depicts the expectation of good things. It is to maintain the anticipation that glorious things are going to happen. This is the God kind of love. This is the stretch of love.  Someone asked, didn’t God know that man may betray and disobey Him? God knew, yet He trusted man with His dominion. Look at Jesus (who is God made flesh), ate with Judas even though He knew he was going to betray Him.  Jesus knew Peter was going to deny Him as well, yet He never gave up on Him.  Interestingly, a lot of people think Jesus was going to give up on Judas. NO PLEASE! If Judas was alive, Jesus would have gone to show Himself to Him and touched Him with His love. Jesus reached out to Peter specifically, and touched Him with His love. (Mark 16:7). These things I write to you are not things I have not experienced.  To some degree both as a born again, and as a servant of my Lord Jesus, called into this ministry of the Lord, I have been stretched and tested on this path of love several times. I write these with tears of joy. Hallelujah. Knowing that, by the empowering ability of the love of Christ, I have become a shelter of love to many, refused to rejoice in the defeats of those who wronged me, believed and had great hope in those I lead despite their faults. 
Love people even as they speak evil of you. Be like Jesus, for His love is poured out into you.
There were times I was accused of contributing to “evil” by trusting in some leaders who made some mistakes. Meanwhile, those making accusations also had their wrongs and were still roofed in the ministry. Even our Lord was accused of eating with sinners. (Matthew 9:10-17; Mark 2:15-22; Luke 5:29-39). Beloved, Jesus showed us how to love no matter the wrongs.  This, you should continue to do as you have also been loved by the Lord. Glory to God. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 1:9; Psalm 45:7; Galatians 6:1-10; Acts 20:35; John 21:20-25) WE PRAY– That that Lord supplies with great help that our hearts will not rejoice in the failures of others who wrong us.   – That we will relentlessly believe in others, see beyond their errors and continue to be a haven of hope irrespective of their faults. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 14-162 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 17DECLARE THESE WORDS:- The love of God is relentlessly at work in me. - I am a home of love to many.  - I expect good things in people.  - I believe and encourage people no matter their mistakes.  - I don’t promulgate bad news of others.  - I am empowered by the love of Christ daily.  - I am an example of hope to many.  Thank you Lord for making me an expression of love to all men. Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1095 - THE PROFIT OF WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Every prayer rooted in the Word is effective! THEREFORE, NO MATTER WHAT, PRAY! Author Thursday, 22nd January, 2026THE PROFIT OF WISDOM“Wisdom and money can get you almost anything, but only wisdom can save your life.” Ecclesiastes 7:12 (NLT)The execution of great dreams requires resources. The basic resources are time and people.There are many who begin a year with great goals or dreams but begin to draw back from the execution of such dreams because of resources.People consider how much money they have acquired to determine the possibilities of achieving a goal.Many have ignored some God-inspired dreams or goals because they feel they don’t have enough resources, and also money.Of course, “money is the answer to everything” (Ecclesiastes 10:19); however, these are material things and systems. But you must understand that money is not the only thing needed to execute the divine vision.From the opening verse, you can tell that one can achieve more with wisdom and money. Yet the advantage of wisdom exceeds.Why quit because you don’t have enough money for the project?Was this assignment or dream not that which God inspired you to pursue?
Whatever is inspired by God is backed by God’s provision.
If there are no systems in place to achieve the dream, understand that God’s wisdom is at work.This is why a believer in Christ cannot be stopped and also limited.The wisdom of God brings profit for success. By wisdom, you can harness the available or limited resources to achieve a project which requires bigger resources. What may require 1 million dollars to execute can be executed with 100,000 dollars because of wisdom.“If the axe is dull and he does not sharpen its edge, then he must exert more strength; but wisdom [to sharpen the axe] helps him succeed [with less effort].” Ecclesiastes 10:10 (Amplified Bible)No matter the task, take advantage of God’s wisdom in you to produce results.Don’t conclude that you don’t have the money to achieve your goals.
Always know, WISDOM IS A DEFENCE. Tap into the wells of God’s wisdom within.
The word of God is able to shape your mind to operate in wisdom. The more you act in faith, which comes by the word, the more you are operating according to God’s wisdom (for the word of God is the wisdom of God).Selah.DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 3:13–14; Ephesians 5:15–16; 1 Corinthians 1:24; Genesis 41:33–39; Proverbs 8:10–11; Proverbs 16:16) WE PRAYWe pray that through the supply of the Spirit, we can take advantage of God’s wisdom to execute His purpose for our lives. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 17-192 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 18DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I can neither be stopped nor limited because I take advantage of God’s wisdom. - I take advantage of God’s wisdom to produce results. - The wisdom of God is my defence. - No matter the task or challenge, I tap into the wells of God’s wisdom for answers to produce results. - I act according to the word of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1096 - LIVE IN REMEMBRANCE OF THESE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Glory to God!!! Beloved, today marks exactly 3 YEARS OF INSPIRING your heart with this transformational daily words. It’s been all by the Supply and graciousness of God from day 1… Author Friday, 23rd January, 2026LIVE IN REMEMBRANCE OF THESE“Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His benefits”Psalm 103:2 (KJV)This Psalm of David is a rich and interesting Psalm. It unveils one crucial thing you should do daily as a believer in Christ: remembering and exhorting yourself with the things which the LORD has done.Whilst Job was afflicted by the adversary to curse God, David was speaking to himself to BLESS THE LORD.David didn’t live his entire life without challenges. He had victories in all his battles. However, he failed in moral battles; experienced betrayals; he was always on the run in his youth. Some years into David’s reign, his own son Absalom conspired and rose against him. His life was always threatened and attacked.From being a wanted hero or soon-to-be king on the run, he later became the wanted king.
Yet in his reflective moments, he exhorts himself to BLESS THE LORD and not FORGET HIS BENEFITS.
He didn’t invest time in recounting defeats.Firstly, you must learn to exhort or speak right to yourself. And just in case you may be wondering what to speak to yourself about, get into Psalm 103.And this devotional, with , is here to bring you into the understanding of the word. Every episode draws your attention to the rich realities you have in God through Christ.As you seem to be overwhelmed by challenges, failures and pains, you are likely to forget the glorious things the Lord has done. There are believers who don’t even recall anything good from God when they look into their lives.They even live with a conclusive mindset that God is the source or cause of their sufferings. The adversary takes delight in this.He wants you to think and accept that God doesn’t want anything good for your life. That is how he attacks the faith of the believer.Meanwhile these are God’s own words to you:“For I know the plans I have for you,” says the LORD. “They are plans for good and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope.” Jeremiah 29:11 (NLT)In your most reflective moments what do you set your heart on?Do you spend time thinking about the mistakes you’ve made, your failures, disappointments and defeats?
Beloved, in all your reflective moments, BLESS THE LORD!
You have to intentionally talk to yourself to BLESS THE LORD. You have to saturate your mind, will and emotions with the reality of who God is and all that He has done.David didn’t only speak to himself to BLESS the Lord, he also conscientised his heart of the things he has to set on his mind.To exhort his soul not to forget the benefits of the Lord shows David’s intentionality.The biggest challenge and limitation in your faith walk is forgetfulness of the Lord’s benefits.Until you begin to walk in the remembrance of the Lord’s benefits, you will be robbed by the adversary.“Bless the Lord, O my soul,And forget not all His benefits:”In this Psalm of David, he went on to articulate the specific benefits he must not forget.
He kept his heart in the remembrance of all that the Lord has done.
And penned them for us to have such remembrance. This was why the second verse ended with a colon (:). He further listed the benefits:No matter the happenings around you, REMEMBER that the LORD:•  forgives all your iniquities,•  heals all your diseases,•  redeems your life from destruction,•  crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies,•  satisfies your mouth with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.•  executes righteousness and justice for all who are oppressed. (See verses 3–6)This means you are not to accept in your heart that the Lord is angry with you and does not forgive you.In verse 8, he painted a picture of God’s person: “the Lord is MERCIFUL and GRACIOUS, Slow to anger, and ABOUNDING IN MERCY.”This is the consciousness you must have about God.
Don’t allow your heart to forget who He is and all His benefits.
The more you walk in the remembrance of these things, the more your heart will be delighted in blessings instead of murmuring.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:3; Psalm 68:19; Psalm 9:1; Psalm 103:10; Psalm 136:1; Psalm 116:12; 1 Sam 106:7; Deuteronomy 6:12) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not forget, but always be settled in the remembrance of the Graciousness of the LORD. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 20-222 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I don’t forget the graciousness of the Lord towards me. - The Lord is gracious and kind to me at all times. - I enjoy the benefits of the Lord each day. - No matter the circumstance or challenge, I don’t allow my heart to forget all the benefits of the Lord. - The Lord redeems my life daily from destruction. - The Lord heals all my diseases. - The Lord forgives all my iniquities. - The Lord crowns me with loving kindness and tender mercies. - The Lord satisfies my mouth with good things. - I am deeply loved by the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1097 - THIS IS HOW MERCY WORKS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you begin to see images you don’t want, shift your mind from them and redirect your imagination to the glorious pictures and results the Lord has deposited in your spirit. SELAH! Author Sunday, 25th January, 2026THIS IS HOW MERCY WORKS“So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who shows mercy”Romans 9:16 (NKJV)Most people have not really understood and esteemed the concept or matter of God’s mercy.Others even think since they are now in Christ, they don’t need the mercy of God. Some also think the Grace of God is greater than the Mercy of God.
Both the Mercy and Grace of God are the expression of God’s benevolence.
The concept of God’s Mercy is not a temporal reaction of God towards your rebellion. Mercy is a picture of God’s heart.The Greek word for Mercy is “ELEEO”, which means kindness or goodwill towards the miserable and afflicted. It also means to have compassion for someone.
Mercy is not just related to sin. Mercy is God’s benevolence towards all failure.
The man in Christ does or achieves all things by (his or her personal (subjective) Faith. Faith is your receptive ability to God’s grace. However, at a point when it seems you have not increased in the understanding of God’s word concerning a particular situation, where it seems your personal revelation is limited, and you have not increased in the faith for results, GOD’S MERCY WILL MAKE THE DIFFERENCE.The Mercy of God completes your obedience of Faith.
God’s Mercy steps in when it seems your faith cannot conduct your miracle.
In Matthew 8, we saw the Great faith of the Roman Centurion. He had a rich understanding of the authority and power of Jesus. By this understanding, even Jesus marvelled at his.Bartimaeus (who was blind) turned to Jesus and cried out, “Jesus, son of David, have mercy on me!”.Jesus reckoned this also as faith. Bartimaeus may not have declared the authority of the Word of God with boldness, just like the Roman Centurion.Turning to God’s Mercy completes your faith.In the most hopeless situation, God’s Mercy brings new hope to you.Mercy and Grace are used interchangeably. Though there are some similarities between Mercy and Grace, these are unique concepts of God’s heart. There are a few distinctions between Mercy and Grace.God abounds in Grace and is rich in Mercy. He is the God of all grace and all mercies.Grace is the embodiment of God’s truth and goodness. While Mercy is the embodiment of God’s compassion. These two items go before the Lord’s face.“Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; Mercy and truth go before Your face.” Psalm 89:14 (NKJV).They both express God’s benevolence.Mercy is often seen as God not giving you what you deserve. While Grace speaks of God giving you what you don’t deserve.
Grace is bringing the undeserving to the realm where he can legally deserve. Mercy is the compassion of God towards us when we fall short.
The Grace of God was dispensed through the death and resurrection of Jesus. However, this work of salvation was wrought by God according to His Mercy.What man really deserved was eternal condemnation. However, God’s mercy (compassion) withheld the judgement of condemnation.For God to give you what you don’t deserve (which is Grace), He must first NOT give you what you deserve (that is Mercy).As grace gives you freedom from the power of sin and the law. Mercy deals with the consequences or negative effects of your sins and transgressions of the law.
Grace is also God’s activity within you to nourish you with His life. God’s Mercy delivers you from judgement.
By grace, we enjoy all that Christ has done. By Mercy, we don’t drink of the cup of wrath and destruction of our disobedience.Mercy is not receiving the outcome of your wrong choices. It is God giving you fresh or new chances every day.Mercy works like a Presidential pardon.  This is a constitutional clause which effectively allows the president of a country to say, on behalf of this country, ‘We forgive you.’ It means that the person can’t be prosecuted, or even if they’ve already been prosecuted and convicted, that conviction will be set aside.This is when a rule is bent in your favor, by a legal power. The president chooses who he wants to pardon.
Beloved, this is how Mercy works. Mercy is God bending the rule in your favor.
It is legal and just for God to apply Mercy.Mercy is not necessarily God strengthening your weakness; rather, it is Grace. Mercy is God making up for the failures or effects and negative consequences of your weakness.It may seem you have had many shortcomings and your life has not been up to the standards or your best. Everyone may expect the worst to happen to you, but God, who is merciful, will be merciful to you. Which means by His Mercy, you don’t get the bad things you deserve. You don’t get the condemnation, poverty, failure, loss and even death.
It takes great humility to turn to God’s mercy.
Receive God’s mercy today!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 80:14; Psalm 136; Lamentations 3:22-24; Hebrews 4:16; 1 Peter 5:10; Psalm 30:10) WE PRAYWe pray, thanking the Lord for His rich mercy in our lives.We thank Him for His help and sustainability from the consequences of our mistakes. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 23-252 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be proud in my efforts.– I receive the mercies of God in all do.– God is merciful to me at all times.– I humbly rejoice in the richness of God’s Mercy. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES!

title: EPISODE 1098 - DO YOU VALUE THE WORD?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you pay attention to the Word (and prayer), it fertilizes your heart to have enough nutrients, to experience the workings of the Word. The more you meditate on (ponder, mutter, masticate and speak) the Word, the more you bear the fruits of the Word. Author Sunday, 25th January, 2026 DO YOU VALUE THE WORD?“For whoever has [spiritual wisdom because he is receptive to God’s word], to him more will be given, and he will be richly and abundantly supplied; but whoever does not have [spiritual wisdom because he has devalued God’s word], even what he has will be taken away from him.” Matthew 13:12 (Amplified Bible)You cannot enjoy divine intervention without the word of God.The word of God is given to us as our advantage. 
You cannot enjoy your inheritance in the Lord without the knowledge of the word. 
The word of God contains all that the Lord has accomplished for you.Not to commit yourself to the word is to expose yourself to deception and error.“Your word is a lamp to guide my feet and a light for my path.” Psalm 119:195 (NLT)With the word, you cannot miss your way through the journey of life.The word of God works; however, it profits those who value it.
Anyone who doesn’t value the word of God doesn’t value his or her life.
When you pray to God for help, the first thing He will send you is His word. So as you are devaluing the word of the Lord, you are turning away from your help.To value the word is to listen and take heed of the word with an open, teachable heart.To value the word is to esteem the word of God as life. This means that the word becomes your priority and the driving force of your decisions or choices.When you stand and act by the word, you can make a greater harvest no matter the challenge which confronts you.Anyone who doesn’t place value on the word will not make it a priority to understand and grasp the word.When you don’t understand the word, you will not have a strong grip on it; thus, the evil one comes and snatches it away.
When you value the word, you will make it your meditation and get the word deeply rooted in your heart.
Until the word is deeply rooted in your heart, the pressure or persecution will cause you to stumble and fall.When you value the word, it will be so fruitful that the worries and distractions of the world and the deceitfulness [the superficial pleasures and delight] of riches cannot choke it or stop it from yielding fruits.
Do you value or devalue the word?
Your response must be according to the measure of your heart.Your response determines how the word will profit you.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 1:1-3; Psalm 43:3; Psalm 119;11; Psalm 19:7-11; Colossians 3:16) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall grasp the word of God to us, so that we shall enjoy the package of the Lord’s intervention. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 27-302 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I value the word of God. – The word of God works in my life. – The word of God is deeply rooted in my heart. – I make the word of God my meditation daily. – I enjoy God’s intervention in my life. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1099 - THE SUPPLY CENTER OF STRENGTH IS IN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week. The grace of God is sufficient for you. Selah! Author Monday, 26th January, 2026 THE SUPPLY-CENTER OF STRENGTH IS IN YOU “But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.”Isaiah 40:31 (KJV)On a normal day, you know you are healthy, and you have the physical strength or energy to go about your business or daily tasks. But even though you are physically strong, there are certain tasks you realize you are not able to execute because you feel weak inwardly.Though being healthy and physically fit is good, people who accomplish big things don’t do it because they have physical strength. It doesn’t take men with big muscles to do big things.Mental strength is always powerful than physical strength. 
A man with super mental strength will rule over a man who has more  physical strength.
Take good care of your body, so that it can carry your strong mind. However don’t just build muscles, without building your mind.While mental strength is great, there is such a thing as divine strength, which is greater.Have you heard a healthy person saying, “I don’t have the strength to conitnue this task”, before?Such people do not mean that they are sick or weak. What they mean is that they lack the inner capacity or vigor for the task.Every task or assignment requires a special capacity for execution.
A man is sustained by the inward strength he has built.
“If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small” Proverbs 24:10 (KJV)The strength you have determines what you can withstand and conquer.There are some tasks or challenges, your physical strength wouldn’t be able to help you conquer.
