There are others your mental strength wouldn’t be enough to sustain you.“He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.“ 1 Samuel 2:9 Berean Standard Bible).To prevail is to be great or exceedingly mighty. And there is a certain degree of greatness which your own strength cannot sustain.We find the solution here:“Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.“ Zechariah 4:6 (ESV)Beyond the self-generated might or power, there is the might and power of the Spirit.
The strength of the Spirit produces in you an unceasing flow of divine strength to do anything God has called you to do.
As part of the promise of the Holy Spirit, Jesus outlines the function of the Holy Spirit in the believer:“And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper (Comforter, Advocate, Intercessor—Counselor, Strengthener, Standby), to be with you forever” John 14:16 (Amplified Bible)From the above verse, you will find that the function or role of the Holy Spirit in a believer is who He is in you forever.The Holy Spirit is not just in you to comfort and strengthen you. The Holy Spirit is in you forever as the Strengthener and comforter.
To have the Holy Spirit in you is to have the supply-center of strengthen in you.
Whenever people think of the need to receive strength or to have strength they think of the outward activities they can engage.The kind of strength the Prophet Isaiah wrote about in chapter 40 of his prophetic book wasn’t about physical strength. He was writing about divine strength.And to have this divine strength is to behold and have the LORD.“O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God! Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.” Isaiah 40:9-10 (KJV)
You don’t separate what God supplies or gives to you from Him.
Whatever God gives you and makes you become, that is who He is. Thus, whatever God gives to you, is who He is. God doesn’t just give you things He gives you Himself.God gives you wisdom because He is Wisdom. He brings you Salvation because He is Salvation. He brings you righteousness because He is Righteousness. He brings you strength because He is Strength.People try to look for divine strength without God. You cannot find divine strength outside God. To have divine strength you must have God.
As believer in Christ you have the advantage, God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you.
Oh glory to God, you have the strength of God.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:13; John 15:5; 1 John 4:4; Isaiah 11:2; Isaiah 40:29-31; Isaiah 41:10) WE PRAYWe pray thanking the Lord for being our strength and also the supply of strength within us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 31-332 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my strength. – I have the strength to do whatever God has called me to do. – The Holy Spirit is the supply-center of strength in me. – I have the strength of God at work in me. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1100 - SUPPLY STRENGTH TO YOUR LEADER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you came into Christ, He didn’t only give you rest; YOU ENTERED HIS REST. Beloved, how you daily live must be rooted and established in the reality of the REST which CHRIST has given to you. Author Tuesday, 27th, January, 2026 SUPPLY STRENGTH TO YOUR LEADER“and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel”Ephesians 6:19 (NKJV) In every army, there are commanders and captains. And Christ is the Chief Commander and Captain of His army.  Nonetheless, the Lord has set men over the various groupings of His army. These men have the assignment to equip, nurture and build up the saints to function effectively.Just as no believer can exercise or enforce victory without the armor pieces, a believer may not be effective in the Kingdom by being isolated from the saints and without a Kingdom leader.
God has set leaders in the church to tend his flock. These leaders or shepherds (Pastors) and teachers are responsible for the growth of each saint.
These bring the saints to the place of knowledge and understanding.How do you think the Church would know the function of the armor pieces without the teaching of Paul?How were the brethren going to be equipped without the labour of Paul the apostle?Pastors and Teachers determine the growth of the saints in Christ. Therefore, the adversary makes them a target. When men who opposed the gospel wanted to stop the spread of the gospel, they persecuted the leaders of the church.When leaders faint in their faith, many other brethren will faint in their faith. The Church leaders are ambassadors who determine how effectively every Church within a locality will operate.
The mindset of the spiritual leaders will affect the mindset of the people.
This was why Paul in almost all his epistles requested that prayers will be made for him.Paul didn’t only instruct that prayers will be made for all the saints, he also requested that prayers will be made for him also. He was specific and precise. Though he is also one of the saints or the brethren, he had to be sure that they would focus on prayer for him.His request unveiled the objective of this spiritual warfare.
This spiritual warfare against the forces of darkness is mainly to ensure that the gospel of Jesus shall prevail in all places.
Who are those leading the spread of the gospel if not your Pastors or Shepherds and Teachers?“And [pray] also for me, that [freedom of] utterance may be given me, that I may open my mouth to proclaim boldly the mystery of the good news (the Gospel), For which I am an ambassador in a coupling chain [in prison. Pray] that I may declare it boldly and courageously, as I ought to do.” Ephesians 6:19-20 (AMPC)If the knowledge of the glory of God shall cover the earth as the waters cover the sea, our leaders must be bold about the gospel of Jesus.
If all the saints will also be inspired to be bold about Jesus, then the leaders must be examples of great boldness of speech.
You have to pray for your leader to be bold in articulating the good news of Jesus.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:3; Romans 15:30; 2 Corinthians 1:11; Philippians 1:19) WE PRAY Pray for your leader, Pastor or shepherd and Teacher of the gospel, that he or she will be given the message to speak and that he or she may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news of Jesus, at all times and in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 34-362 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Utterance is given to all the leaders and sound teachers of the gospel– The Lord is making them increase in boldness. – They abound in knowledge and love for the Lord. – They are strengthened in the Lord and the fullness of power. – They enjoy divine insight and are protected by the power of the Lord from every evil. – The faith of the Leaders shall not grow cold. They will increase in the Lord’s zeal and in great faith. In the name of Jesus!Thank you Lord!

title: EPISODE 1101 - YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 28th January, 2026 YOU CAN DO ALL THINGS“I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.” Philippians 4:13 (KJV)The influx of divine strength is the rich secret to doing all things which Christ has called you to do.To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace. It is to be empowered with the ability of God. It is also to become self-sufficient in the sufficiency of Christ for every good work.
The strength of Christ in you enables you to exercise mastery in all things.
When it feels like you cannot pursue or do the assignment of the Lord with limited resources, remember, the secret:THE LORD GIVES YOU STRENGTH.The strength of the Lord in you is not only effective in you when you have abundance.Take a look at this:“I know what it means to lack, and I know what it means to experience overwhelming abundance. For I’m trained in the secret of overcoming all things, whether in fullness or in hunger. And I find that the strength of Christ’s explosive power infuses me to conquer every difficulty.” Philippians 4:12-13 (TPT)Did you see that?When you exercise the strength of God to triumph amidst “little -difficult” moments, you train yourself to continuously triumph over huge challenges.
The strength of Christ in you is Christ’s explosive power which infuses you to conquer every difficulty.
The more you press on to carry out God’s assignment for you, the more the adversary also opposes you. His interest is in preventing you from fulfilling your calling. You don’t have to feel incapable at any given time.There are times when, no matter which direction you turn, you may face opposition or limitations. Sometimes the pressure and the challenges may seem insurmountable.But cheer up!
You can do all things through Christ who strengthens you.
“Since His power is so glorious, may you be strengthened with strength of every kind, and be prepared for cheerfully enduring all things with patience and long-suffering” Colossians 1:11 (Weymouth New Testament)As the Lord invigorates you with His strength, you are empowered by Him to cheerfully endure every form of hardship as you fulfill His purpose.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall strengthen us more and more to triumph in His assignment amidst all the deepest devastations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 37-392 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. – I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. – I have the ability to achieve every task the Lord sets on  my heart to achieve. – I don’t waste the strength of Christ on things the Lord has not called me to do. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1102 - THE SPIRIT OF MIGHT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 29th January, 2026THE SPIRIT OF MIGHT“The Spirit of the LORD shall rest upon Him, The Spirit of wisdom and understanding, The Spirit of counsel and might, The Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.”Isaiah 11:2 (NKJV)As part of the constellation of prophecies about the Messiah by the Prophet Isaiah, he mentioned the Spirit of Might as one of the qualities of the Holy Spirit which the Messiah shall possess.Understand that the:•  The Spirit of wisdom•  The Spirit of understanding•  The Spirit of counsel•  The Spirit of might•  The Spirit of knowledge•  The Spirit of the fear of the LORD,are apparent unique manifestations of the Holy Spirit. These are not separate beings or entities.Though the Prophet Isaiah was contextually speaking of the Messiah (in chapter 11:2), the Lord has also poured out His Spirit upon all that shall believe on His name.“He who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.” But this He spoke concerning the Spirit, whom those believing in Him would receive…” John 7:38-39b (NKJV)“Listen carefully: I am sending the Promise of My Father [the Holy Spirit] upon you…” Luke 24:49 (Amplified Bible)
The Holy Spirit upon you and in you means you have the spiritual capacity to manifest these crucial items.
In previous episodes of with , I explained the reality of the Holy Spirit as the supply centre.To have the Holy Spirit is to have His unique manifestations. Now through your intentional engagements with the Holy Spirit, you demonstrate all His unique manifestations appropriately.These unique manifestations of the Spirit are not just items supplied to you by the Holy Spirit. They are also the Lord dispensing Himself in you and through you.As I have mentioned previously, whatever God gives you and makes you become, that is who He is. Thus, whatever God gives to you, is who He is. God doesn’t just give you things; He gives you Himself.God has not just given you the Spirit of Wisdom, or the Spirit of Understanding or the Spirit of Might, He has given you Himself.To have the Spirit of Might doesn’t mean you have a portion of might. It means you have God’s might in you.The Spirit of Might is not just strength.
The Spirit of Might produces in the saints power, forcefulness and strength to execute divine assignment.
To have spiritual strength is mostly for internal working.For example, when a fellow faces hardships, he needs personal capacity to endure. The inward workings of the Spirit enable you to overcome weaknesses.And to have might is to have the outward showcase of the power and the force of the Holy Spirit.Take a look at this:“Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.” Ephesians 6:10 (KJV)To be strong in the Lord in the verse is from the Greek word “endunamoō”, which means to empower: to enable, increase in strength, to be made strong. It is mainly for personal usage.However, the word “power” in this verse doesn’t mean “dunamis”; Paul the apostle chose the word “kratos”, which means great vigour and dominion might.And the word “might” in the verse is from the Greek word “ischus”, meaning divine force or forcefulness, ability, mighty power.Though all these expressions are also conditions of the inner man, they are for outward workings. They are not for inward disposition. They are for outward display of God’s ability.You may exercise divine strength in your inner man to withstand pressure from the vicissitudes of life. However, might and power are for the showcasing of God. They provide physical affirmation of the presence of divine ability.
When you are strengthened, you exercise composure.
However, that is not what is needed to showcase the miraculous ability of God. To exercise the miraculous you must demonstrate might, power and divine force.Don’t only exercise divine strength. To have the Spirit of Might, you must exude divine strength, and demonstrate His might, force and power in all situations.
To have the Holy Spirit means you are a carrier of God’s might.
Demonstrate God to your world.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 42:1; Isaiah 61:1; John 14:17; 1 Samuel 16:13; Acts 10:38) WE PRAYWe pray that the might of the SPIRIT shall increase in our daily demonstration of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANExodus 40Leviticus 1-22 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am a carrier of God’s might. - I demonstrate God to my world. - I exude divine strength in all situations. - I demonstrate the might, force and power of God daily in all situations. - I increase daily in the demonstration of God. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1103 - THE ARM OF FLESH FAILS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 30th January, 2026THE ARM OF FLESH FAILS“With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.” 2 Chronicles 32:8 (KJV)Beloved, understand that God is not an alternative choice. He is your first and only choice. No matter the progress you make and resources accessible to you, acknowledge God as your confidence and source. (Proverbs 3:26; Psalm 23:1).Use the resources available to you as divine tools. Let God work with you through the resources available to you.
Don’t make the resources available to you gods.
Progress in human civilization and technological advancement shouldn’t replace God and the advantage of His dealings. No advancement of any civilization outwits God’s intelligence and wisdom.To trust human methods and systems above God is to entrap your heart from enjoying an unceasing flow of possibilities.This is not to sympathise with the demonisation of technology or any intellectual contribution to human development. God made man to replenish the earth. (Genesis 1:28). He designed the human intellect not only to reason theological discourse, but to also harness and construct various frameworks of human development for the fulfilment of His purpose.Clearly, human intellect is God’s blessing and gift. Yet without it being cultured by God’s wisdom, it wouldn’t serve God’s intention.
Every single thing we find within God’s universe is His unique investment to achieve His purpose.
Nothing was designed to be isolated from God. Every single thing finds true meaning and fulfilment when it operates within God’s government.Right from when corruption entered the heart of men, independence from God became the pursuit of men. (Psalm 2:1-3). Thus, they made for themselves gods through created things and even systems they have created. (Jeremiah 16:20).Instead of culturing their hearts to trust in God, the enmity in their mind towards God (Colossians 1:21) has made them seek an existence outside God.But where can you go from God? (Psalm 139:7-12).They have trusted in their philosophies, technological advancements or scientific prowess, rather than God Himself.They have set their efforts and systems as their arm of strength. But as long as a concept, strategy, system or technique isn’t hewn out of God, it is subject to the weakness of the flesh.The arm of flesh refers to relying or depending on human intelligence, skills, strategy, resources etc., in lieu of God.The arm of flesh always fails. Don’t be like Sennacherib the Assyrian king. He trusted in his gods and military might. However, King Hezekiah had absolute confidence in God.To be clear, it wasn’t as though King Hezekiah sat in his palace doing nothing.“And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem, he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him. So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance. And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city…” 2 Chronicles 32:2-6 (KJV)Hezekiah took strategic steps. He cut the water supply to the Assyrian army, strengthened his military equipment, revamped his defences, and set offensive machinery in place. He did have the available warfare technology. But his confidence was in the LORD.Take note of the words he spoke to his people, nothing about their technological resources, strategy and military might:“And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying, Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.” 2 Chronicles 32:6-8 (KJV)Now the people didn’t rest on their military systems, but on the words of King Hezekiah concerning the DIVINE HELP.Whatever God has called you to do; plan, strategise, act out ideas and above all don’t trust in them. Have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 17:5; Isaiah 30:1-3; Isaiah 31:3; Psalm 146:3-4; Proverbs 3:5-6; 1 Corinthians 2:5) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not be lured to make gods out of our efforts, but shall exercise confidence in the LORD. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 3-52 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 26DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I have no confidence in the flesh. - I exercise confidence in the Lord daily. - I don’t permit my heart to be lured to make gods out of my efforts. - I have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD! Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1104 - YOU CAN GET THE JOB DONE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Saturday, 31st January, 2026 YOU CAN GET THE JOB DONE“But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.”Numbers 11:23 (ERV)The greatest limitation of God’s power and grace is unbelief.
Whatever God will do will first be by His word. When you doubt God’s word, His power and grace won’t find expression.
We know God’s grace is immeasurable, unlimited and infinite. You can manifest an abundance of God’s grace and ability as much as you can exercise faith.Faith acts according to the immeasurable ability of God’s power and grace.Faith acts on what God has said.There are things the Lord has determined to do in your life and through you, yet you can limit the extent God will work His word through unbelief.Though God is all-powerful, He doesn’t force the manifestation of His power in the affairs of men (no matter how much he loves to help them). Therefore, the extent to which you can see the flow of God’s power is dependent on your Faith in His Word.Unbelief, though it has a spiritual root, finds expression in your mind. Your mind can see or imagine what you believe. 
Until your mind can see or imagine the manifestation of what God has said, the hands cannot handle it.
While the Israelites were in the wilderness, they incontinently cried out to God for meat. That was probably to either mock God, prove their doubt or establish their argument that being in Egypt was better than leaving Egypt (Psalm 78:18).God accepted the challenge and asked Moses to tell them He would send them meat in the wilderness.Moses, for a moment, couldn’t imagine how it was going to be possible for God to supply the Israelites with meat. He even gave a logical concern about how impossible it was.See what Moses said to God:“Moses said, “There are 600,000 soldiers here, and you say, ‘I will give them enough meat to eat for a whole month!’ If we were to kill all the sheep and cattle, that would still not be enough to feed this many people for a month. And if we caught all the fish in the sea, it would not be enough for them!”Numbers 11:21-22 (ERV)By human wisdom, Moses was right and had his facts correctly stated. Moses’ assertion made more sense by human wisdom.However, “God’s nonsense is wiser than human wisdom, and God’s weakness is stronger than human strength.” (1 Corinthians 1:25 – ISV)The Amplified Bible gives further clarity:“This is because the foolishness of God [is not foolishness at all and] is wiser than men [far beyond human comprehension], and the weakness of God is stronger than men [far beyond the limits of human effort].” 1 Corinthians 1:25.
The limit or boundary of man’s highest strength is the beginning of God’s strength.
You don’t use your limitations to define God. God’s capacity transcends man’s wisest calculations.God’s priceless response to Moses is all you need to hear or read today:“But the Lord said to Moses, “Don’t limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.” Numbers 11:23 (ERV)Beloved, what has God said to you?Don’t doubt Him.
Don’t limit the workings of His power in your life through unbelief.
Sometimes when you look at the money in your hand and all the savings or investments you have made or going to make for the next ten (10) years, you will still not have enough for the task ahead. But cheer up!The supply of the Lord is not dependent on your bank balance. The supply of the Lord is according to His own riches and grace. Oh, glory to God.That project is possible if you can only trust and obey the Lord’s word.
Nothing is impossible with God. Stop doubting Him. Stop acting according to your strength.
Take hold of faith and stand in God. The time when it seems impossible is the time you must increase in boldness. Don’t turn back! Don’t run from the battle. Don’t drop your weapons. Faith has no reverse gear. March forward and don’t settle for less.You can get the job done.
Have and maintain your strong confidence in the power of God’s Word, that He will do what He says He will do.
Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week.The grace of God is sufficient for you.Don’t give room to any limitation in your mind.
You can have exceptional results as you exercise boldness in the Lord.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Genesis 18:14; Psalm 78:41; Numbers 23:19; Daniel 6:16-23) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not faint, but we shall remain resolute and continue to trust in the limitless immeasurable ability of God and His word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 6-92 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 27DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t define God’s capacity by my limitations– I don’t reduce God’s grace to my human calculation.–  I have confidence in God’s limitless supply.– I believe without any iota of doubt, that God will always do what He says He will do.–  I don’t limit God’s power in my thoughts and imagination. I have strong faith in seeing the mighty workings of God in all things. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1105 - IT TAKES FIRE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author IT TAKES FIRE“Do not quench the Spirit”1 Thessalonians 5:19Our Lord Jesus didn’t only come to die for your sins; He also brought you His life. He translates you from darkness into the Kingdom of light and transfuses His life into you through the administrative force of the Holy Spirit.As part of transfusing His life into you, the Lord baptizes you with the Holy Spirit and with fire. To be baptized with the Holy Spirit is to be immersed or submerged into union with the Holy Spirit and with His fire.You come under the influence of the person of the Holy Spirit and His operative ability.
The impact and influence of the Holy Spirit in your heart is as fire.
Get this: the Holy Spirit is not fire; fire only depicts the character of His influence and operation. Fire is a universal language; everything responds to fire, and nothing denies its impact. No one rejects the benefits of fire. That also gives a picture of the operative influence of the Holy Spirit.At your new birth, the Lord ignited the kingdom life within you, a fire within you, the Holy Spirit within you, changing you from the inside out. (See Matthew 3:11, Message Translation).This was what happened to the disciples of Jesus on the day of Pentecost. As they obeyed the instruction of Jesus to tarry:“On the day Pentecost was being fulfilled, all the disciples were gathered in one place. Suddenly, they heard the sound of a violent blast of wind rushing into the house from out of the heavenly realm. The roar of the wind was so overpowering it was all anyone could bear!  Then all at once a pillar of fire appeared before their eyes. It separated into tongues of fire that engulfed each one of them. They were all filled and equipped with the Holy Spirit and were inspired to speak in tongues—empowered by the Spirit to speak in languages they had never learned!” Acts 2:1-3 (TPT)The impartation of the Holy Spirit happened to them as of the experience of fire. The influence of the Holy Spirit in your heart will always be as of fire. This is how one can articulate the burning influence of the Spirit.IT IS AS OF FIRE!
This fire of the Holy Spirit must burn in you if you want to saturate your sphere with the gospel.
It takes the Holy Spirit and fire to be a witness of Jesus.“But you will receive power and ability when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses [to tell people about Me] both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and Samaria, and even to the ends of the earth.” Acts 1:8 (AMP).When the Holy Spirit came upon you, you received:1. Power and ability.2. You were made a witness of Jesus.God doesn’t send anyone out without His fire burning in him/her.For Moses to bring deliverance to Israel from Egypt, he encountered the fire of God (Exodus 3).As part of the Priest’s ministry to God, He has to keep the fire of God’s presence burning on the altar. (Leviticus 6:12)The fire of God in you is an eternal fire; however, its glow must be intense.
To continue to bless lives and spread the gospel, you must continue to burn.
“Don’t burn out; keep yourselves fueled and aflame…” Romans 12:11 (MSG)You have to continue glowing with fire, and everyone will respond to you.It takes the fire of the Spirit burning in you to ignite the Kingdom life within others.
A man of fire is the one who can boldly saturate His sphere with the power of the gospel.
As a beacon of light, you must burn like wildfire!You glow as you continue to:–  Pray in the Holy Spirit. Your prayers burn as an incense (Psalm 141:2; Revelation 8:4).– Meditate on the word of God.“…HIS WORD was in my heart like a BURNING FIRE shut up in my bones; I was weary of holding it back, and I could not…” (Jeremiah 20:9)When this truly happens, you just can’t keep quiet or stop speaking what you have beheld of the Lord. (Acts 4:20)If you want hearts to burn for Jesus, your heart must always burn for and with Him!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 3:11; Ephesians 5:18; Luke 4:14; Micah 3:8; Acts 4:31; Acts 11:23-24) WE PRAYThat our hearts shall glow with the unquenchable fire of the Holy Spirit and with power so that we can saturate many hearts with the power of the gospel. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 10-132 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 28DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is soaked and saturated with the fire of the word.– I can’t keep quiet; I burn and glow more and more with fire.– I have the fire of the Holy Spirit burning in me– I don’t grow cold. God’s fire cannot be quenched in me.– Through me, the gospel spreads in my city like a wildfireHallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1106 - WHAT ARE YOU BURNING FOR?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The greatest thing you can do with your faith is to serve the Lord’s great purpose. Many more hearts must be taken for Jesus. And God wants to work with you. Start now! Author Monday, 2nd February, 2026 WHAT ARE YOU BURNING FOR?“For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.” Psalm 69:9 (KJV)How far do you want to see the work of God prosper?The fulfilment of God’s vision is not by how you wish to see it happen but by how you are determined to see its accomplishment.Most people think of zeal as a religious posture. However, the great visions of God are not realised without zeal.Some think zeal is not needed. They conclude that zeal does not bring salvation. Salvation is in believing and receiving Jesus. Thus, one can have zeal and not be saved.Nevertheless, everyone saved in Christ needs the zeal of God to execute divine assignments.
The Lord performs His plans according to His zeal.
“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.Of the increase of his government and peace, there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even forever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.” Isaiah 9:6-7 (KJV)Zeal basically means a strong burning passion. It is the agreed energy of the emotions, the will and the mind to accomplish a task. In Greek, zeal is derived from the word “zelos”, which means to be zealous. This means to have an “ardour or fervour of spirit.” It is an energy and enthusiasm about one’s conviction.It is the same word for fervency. The word fervent is from the Latin word “fervens”, which means to BOIL.This was the difference between Paul, the apostle, and some other believers. A man with a strong zeal will accomplish more than one who is lagging.No wonder he said to the brethren in Rome:“Do not be slothful in zeal, be fervent in spirit, serve the Lord” Romans 12:11 (ESV)Read it in The Passion Translation:“Be enthusiastic to serve the Lord, keeping your passion toward Him boiling hot! Radiate with the glow of the Holy Spirit and let Him fill you with excitement as you serve Him”.
 To have the zeal or to be fervent is to be quickened with a burning passion or to boil for something.
What are you boiling for?Don’t be boiling for fornication.Don’t be boiling to steal that jewel which doesn’t belong to you.Don’t be boiling for the nude video.Channel that passion or strong desire towards the LORD’S WORK.Have that burning desire to please the Lord. Channel your passionate ardour towards the pursuit of the expansion of the Kingdom of God.Beloved, to have zeal is to have an eagerness or desire to accomplish or obtain something.
Don’t use that zeal to please your selfish interest. Use it to accomplish that task which brings glory to God.
What are you burning for?What has consumed your boiling desire?When you make Jesus and His Kingdom the focus of your boiling desire, you will do extraordinary things for the Lord.You may not be doing great things for the Lord because your boiling desire is not towards the Lord.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 18:25; Colossians 4:12-13; John 2:17; Psalm 119:139; 2 Corinthians 8:16; 2 Corinthians 7:7,12; Acts 22:3; Acts 20:24) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that our hearts and actions will be consumed by the boiling passion or earnest zeal of the Lord to accomplish our assignment in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 14-162 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 29DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My emotions and desires are focused on the Lord. – My whole being is soaked and saturated deeply into the Holy Spirit. – I set my affections on the Lord and His vision. – I dare to do great things for the Lord. – I give my mind to the meditation of the word. – I am not led by my emotions. – I am zealous about doing great things for the Lord. – I am zealous about my divine mandate. – I am zealous about the salvation of others. Oh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1107 - FERVENT IN SPIRIT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 3rd February, 2026 FERVENT IN SPIRIT “not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;”‭‭Romans‬ ‭12‬:‭11‬ ‭(NKJV‬‬)Spiritual fervency is needful in the service of the Lord. To be spiritually fervent is not only about how active you are in prayer and how enthusiastic you are in performing spiritual duty. It is also about your ability to comprehend deep spiritual thoughts. 
Dullness in spirit in understanding spiritual things is a dangerous virus. 
No one in such state will be able to grow effectively. To mature in the Lord is to work on your activeness in the spirit. Those who suffer dullness in spirit, are not receptive to the message of the Lord. Their minds become active with carnal things, they are immature.This is what Paul (the apostle) said, “Brothers and sisters, when I was with you I found it impossible to speak to you as those who are spiritually mature people, for you are still dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. And because you are immature infants in Christ, I had to nurse you and feed you with “milk,” not with the solid food of more advanced teachings, because you weren’t ready for it. In fact, you are still not ready to be fed solid food, for you are living your lives dominated by the mind-set of the flesh. Ask yourselves: Is there jealousy among you? Do you compare yourselves with others? Do you quarrel like children and end up taking sides? If so, this proves that you are living your lives centered on yourselves, dominated by the mind-set of the flesh, and behaving like unbelievers. For when you divide yourselves up in groups—a “Paul group” and an “Apollos group”—you’re acting like people without the Spirit’s influence.” 1 Corinthians 3:1-4 (TPT)Paul the apostle in the verse above goes on further to address a certain characteristic of a person who is dull in spirit.
Dullness in the spirit makes you live a life dominated by the flesh. You even behave like an unbeliever.
This doesn’t only affect you, it also affects the assembly of the saints.When you are spiritually dull, you cannot receive nor draw out from the wells of wisdom.“We have much to say about this topic although it is difficult to explain, because you have become too dull and sluggish to understand.” Hebrews 5:11 (TPT).Your activeness in the Spirit begins with how your promptly respond to instructions and the training of the word.
The more you humble yourself to be adequately trained the more your spiritual senses are able to perceive and enjoy heavenly matters.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Revelation 22:16-19; 2 Thessalonians 2:8-12; Hebrews 5:11-14) WE PRAY Heavenly Father,I thank you for your word and for the opportunity to be trained and nurtured in truth, that my heart will always be alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. In the Name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 17-192 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 30DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am fervent in Spirit. – My heart is always alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. – I refuse to be dominated by the flesh. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above dullness. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1108 - OUR LORD COMETH…
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency God’s full and final message is not just given through Christ; His complete and final revelation is CHRIST HIMSELF. Author Wednesday, 4th February, 2026OUR LORD COMETH…“Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.” 1 Thessalonians 5:11 (KJV)The Church, from her inception, has suffered hostility, threats, political persecution, philosophical persecution, and both mental and physical torture.All these are attempts to crush and destroy the mission of the Church.Take note:The Church is the aggregation of all the saints in Christ.Therefore, don’t think of the Church as an institution separated from you. You are part of the very constitution of the Church. The Church is the body of Christ, the herald of God’s eternal purpose. The city is set on the hill, giving hope to a hopeless world. The Church is the torch of God in a world overwhelmed by gross darkness. It is the divine salt pack that preserves and gives taste to the earth.This is why the adversary has always seen the Church as a threat.There have been attempts to destroy the Church through heretical and deceptive doctrines.Matters that are to bring hope to the Church were diluted with error. And it’s with the intention to corrupt the hope of the saints and produce fear in their hearts.Over the centuries, the news of Jesus’s coming has been seen as news of doom for all mankind. 
However, the coming of Jesus is a day of hope, joy, and the full manifestation of glory for those in Christ.
The believer is not appointed for wrath but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, who died for us.Paul the apostle addressed the matter of the coming of our Lord Jesus to comfort the hearts of the saints.
No matter how the people of the world will mock, persecute,  or attack the Church, we must be comforted with the reality that our Lord cometh.
Take a look at verse 11 of 1 Thessalonians 5, again:“Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.”The sentence begins with “Wherefore”, the Greek word is “dio”, which simply means, “therefore”, or for which cause or consequently.The word “dio” or “Wherefore” as used in the verse is a logical connector. It introduces an explanation that emphasizes the logical outcome or necessity of an action or belief.Paul the apostle used “wherefore” in the verse to draw an inference from what he had previously stated.This explains that as believers we are to comfort and edify one another on the grounds of this truth that:– God has not appointed us to wrath.– He has appointed us to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus, who died for us.– And that whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with the Lord Jesus.
 No believer is to threaten another believer with the coming of Jesus. 
Instead, we are instructed through the epistles to comfort one another with the news of the coming of Jesus.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 4:18; Hebrews 10:24-25; Ephesians 4:29; Colossians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 13:11) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not be troubled, but we shall be comforted in this reality that the coming of our Lord Jesus shall be the climax revelation that we are together with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025 1 YEAR PLANLeviticus 20-222 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 31DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God has not appointed me unto wrath. – I have been appointed to obtain salvation by the Lord Jesus who died for me. – Whether I wake or sleep, I will live together with the Lord Jesus. – I comfort the brethren with the news of the coming of Jesus. – I rejoice daily in the reality that my Lord is coming again. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1109 - SET THE RIGHT THEME
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 5th February, 2026 SET THE RIGHT THEME“My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.” Psalm 45:1 (KJV)Recently, someone asked me, “Apostle, I have really been confessing the word of God, but I don’t see its manifestation in my life”Beloved, from previous episodes, you will find the clear answer to this question. You see, the manifestation of the word of God doesn’t first begin with confession. Though it is a great thing to speak forth the word, one has to first set the word up in his or her heart.
The scriptures did charge every believer to guard his or her tongue.
“He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.” Proverbs 21:23 (Berean Standard Bible)However, as we have seen previously, you speak according to the meditations of your heart. What goes on in your heart comes out of your mouth.  When you attempt to make positive confessions, the real challenge of life will hit your heart, and you may speak wrongly.Thus, you can truly guard your tongue when you are able to properly guard your heart. Confessions made with deep convictions will produce courageous steps.Beloved, “Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from” Proverbs 4:23 (GOD’S WORD Translation)Your mouth is the channel by which life flows out of you from your heart. What comes out of your mouth is brewed in your heart.Take a look at the opening verse again:“My heart is on fire, boiling over with passion. Bubbling up within me are these beautiful lyrics as a lovely poem to be sung for the King. Like a river bursting its banks, I’m overflowing with words, spilling out into this sacred story” Psalm 45:1 (TPT)
The words which shall overflow from your heart are the thoughts or the theme bubbling up within you.
When your heart is set on the theme of past failures, such will overflow out of your mouth and will influence your actions.No one is designed to have a stronger mind than the other. It is what we choose to set our minds on that determines the strength of our minds.David never had fear of what his enemies would do to him because the theme of his heart is this, “The Lord is my light and my Salvation…”There is no way you will walk in fear or be afraid of what others plot against you, when the theme of your heart is that “The Lord is the strength of my life…”David didn’t just make such an utterance in Psalm 27:1; it was the meditation of his heart.The songs of David are songs of confidence in God. The reflections of his meditation.
No matter the challenges he faced and the moments of despair, you will find his boast in the Lord.
His words and songs were utterances of the Lord’s theme on his heart. Songs are the communication and reflections of deep impressions of the heart.“And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.”Instead of the theme of sickness and death, set your heart on the revelation of Jesus’ stripes.
Don’t allow the devil to make you feel you are afflicted because of your transgressions. 
He is a deciever and accuser of the brethren. When your heart accepts that you don’t deserve healing because of your wrongs, you allow the affliction to gain root.The devil has no legal right to afflict until your heart accepts it. Refuse to accept that you cannot be healed because you once lived a wicked life. You are no longer a wicked child if you are in Christ.“But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was crushed for our wickedness [our sin, our injustice, our wrongdoing]; The punishment [required] for our well-being fell on Him, And by His stripes (wounds) we are healed.” Isaiah 53:5 (Amplified Bible)Jesus legally attained your well-being. He achieved every requirement needed for you to walk in wholeness.For every infirmity you may be experiencing in your body, see in your heart that the Lord paid for it. 
The manifestation of your wholeness is rooted in the revelation of Jesus as a theme in your heart.
What is the theme of your heart this day?DIG DEEPERPlease read these SCRIPTURES and meditate on them:(2 Samuel 23:2; Proverbs 16:23; Psalm 49:3; Job 32:18-20; Job 33:3; Matthew 12:35) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not be deceived by the clever lies of the devil, but the theme and thoughts of our hearts shall be saturated and soaked with all that the Lord is and what He has achieved for us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 23-252 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 32DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be deceived by the clever lies of the devil. – The Lord has set the beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon my heart.  – My words are consistent with the grace of God towards me. – My heart boils with a beautiful theme of grace. – I give no place for discouragement, failure and defeat in my heart. – My heart indite a good matter. Oh Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1110 - TWIN FLAMES OF MANIFESTATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You are a saint in Christ and made Holy. Refuse to be defiled by this world. As God’s temple you are God’s property. Let your life and living become a demonstration of His glory. Shalom! Author Thursday, 23rd October, 2025TWIN FLAMES OF MANIFESTATION “My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.”Psalm 45:1 (KJV)The heart in this context refers to the innermost intentions, emotions and being. It is the innerself or deepest part of a person.Your heart is the source or the origination of your actions.“Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from”Proverbs 4:23 (GOD’S WORD Translation)
Your heart is the seat of your deepest thoughts and emotions.
To guard your heart with all diligence means to guard it with all vigilance. Your entire life is centered and built on the condition of your heart.Let’s read the verse from the Goodnews Translation:“Be careful how you think; your life is shaped by your thoughts.” (Proverbs 4:23)Before you start blaming the devil, and others for the outcome of your life, first consider how you think.Many things which goes on in your life are rooted in the cogitation of your heart.There is nothing that happens to you, which first doesn’t go through your heart. The possibilities of your life are framed within the walls of your heart.There are twin flames that influences your manifestations:1. The condition of your heart.2. The words of your lips.
What is in your heart controls your lips.
The mouth will articulate the abundance of your heart.As Jesus said, “People are known in this same way. Out of the virtue stored in their hearts, good and upright people will produce good fruit. But out of the evil hidden in their hearts, evil ones will produce what is evil. For the overflow of what has been stored in your heart will be seen by your fruit and will be heard in your words.” Luke 6:45 (TPT)No matter how long you pretend, anyone who pays attention to your words will know what is in your heart because your words exposes what is in your heart.In the realms of the spirit, words are determinants. Your weight and depths are measured by the words you speak.The afflictions or affluence of men are influenced by their words and deepest thoughts.
Your words will always reflect the meditation of your heart.
To indite a good matter is to set a good theme in your heart. The word indite means to gush out, well up or boil up.“My heart is on fire, boiling over with passion. Bubbling up within me are these beautiful lyrics…” (Psalm 45:1; TPT)The words you meditate on in your heart are flames which burn in your heart. This is why when you feel angry or even joyful, you feel a burning sensation.Because there is a fire in your heart. But the kind of fire which burns within you is determined by the theme of your heart.For the afflictions of the adversary to limit you, he sets themes of discouragement, failure and defeat in your heart.
Let your heart boil or bubble with a beautiful theme.
Set the right themes or good news on your heart everyday.Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:2; Proverbs 16:23; Psalm 49:3; Job 32:18-20; Job 33:3; Matthew 12:35) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall set His beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon our hearts, that we shall only speak words which are consistent of His grace towards us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANLeviticus 26-282 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 33DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord has set the beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon my heart.  – My words are consistent with the grace of God towards me. – My heart boils with a beautiful theme of grace. – I give no place for discouragement, failure and defeat in my heart. – My heart indite a good matter. Oh Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1111 - LIFE IS PREDICTABLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Saturday, 7th February, 2026LIFE IS PREDICTABLE “Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life” Proverbs 4:23 (NLT) The instruction of the Lord is always to our advantage. God knows your constitution and how you can best walk in the consummation of your divine call. And the interesting thing is, whatever God instructs man on, the adversary goes after it. So in Eden, when God instructed man concerning the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, the adversary went after it. Whatever God is interested in regarding your life, the adversary develops an interest in it.  Don’t give him access! One of the crucial things the adversary takes interest in is the heart of man.
The heart of man is the seat of all thoughts and all feelings.
The complexity of man’s constitution is intriguing beyond what has been accumulated. Man’s entire being is as a universe. And that is how God sees man. If eternity can be assimilated into man who lives in time, that should let you know the extent of man’s wonder.  The Bible says, “….He has set eternity in the heart of man…..” Ecclesiastes 3:11 It means man has the capacity to travel into “eternal future and eternal past.” So you can consider the Prophet Moses, he was inspired by God to write the book of Genesis. He articulated the creative work of God, as though he was walking with God side by side, whiles He was creating the universe. How was it possible? It was through the influence of God’s vision in his heart.
In all of man’s constitution, the center of his being is THE HEART!
A man’s heart is as a womb or a haven of conception. Nothing happens in a man’s life or world without first beginning as a seed in the heart of man. Thoughts are first cultivated in the heart of man.
Life is predictable.
There is nothing like unpredictable events in life. Anything that happens within time results from a man’s thought and action.  Whatever you want to see manifest in your life, you must take conceptualized and predictable steps. That is the role of the heart. The difference between those who make a great impact and those who struggle to make an impact is the condition of their heart. “Listen carefully, my dear child, to everything that I teach you, and pay attention to all that I have to say. Fill your thoughts with my words until they penetrate deep into your spirit. Then, as you unwrap my words, they will impart true life and radiant health into the very core of your being. So above all, guard the affections of your heart, for they affect all that you are. Pay attention to the welfare of your innermost being, for from there flows the wellspring of life.  Avoid dishonest speech and pretentious words. Be free from using perverse words no matter what!”Proverbs 4:20-24(TPT)
Beloved, the entire construction of your life is in your heart. 
You must give attention to the things you construct in your heart. So what then is in your heart? Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 6:45; Deuteronomy 4:9; Matthew 15:18-19) WE PRAYThat we will keep our hearts and minds stayed on the word God as we delight deeply in it.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNumbers 2-52 YEARS PLAN2 Chronicles 34DECLARE THESE WORDS:–  I guard my heart with all diligence. – I don’t give room for toxic thoughts. – I delight my heart in the word of God. – I keep my heart and mind stayed on the word of God. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. – I am a doer of the word. – I don’t entertain the company of mockers. OH Hallelujah, Glory to God!!!

title: EPISODE 1114 - YOU HAVE THE BACKING OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 10th February, 2026YOU HAVE THE BACKING OF GOD“Therefore know that the Lord your God, He is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations with those who love Him and keep His commandments”Deuteronomy 7:9 (NKJV)God’s Mercy is not temporal. The MERCY of God is everlasting.From Psalm 136 we see the phrase “His Mercy endures forever” about 26 times. This is more than a strong affirmation.
God’s Mercy is perpetual or without end.
It can never be over with Mercy. Mercy will always come through, as long as you turn to the Lord.Have you come to a point in your life where you feel you have failed completely and it is over with you?The Lord’s Mercy endures forever.There are times you think all you deserve is punishment and disgrace. You may find yourself in that state where nothing glorious might happen. Cheer up! And turn to God one more time, for His Mercy endures forever!At that time when the Philistines were in control of the Israelites for about 40 years; the Lord raised Samson to deliver Israel from the hands of their enemies. Sampson was the greatest threat to the Philistines at the time.The birth of Samson was the demonstration of God’s Mercy to the Israelites.They had done so much evil in the sight of God, that they turned away from Him and were greatly oppressed by the Philistines.The only help God gave them was the birth of Samson. (Judges 13:1-5).Samson’s mandate was to begin to deliver Israel out of the hands of the Philistines.Most teachers of the word refer to Samson as “a physically strong man but morally weak”.They often conclude that Samson failed.Was that really the case?Did Samson fail?No please!Samson fulfilled His purpose. And his life was a beautiful picture of God’s Mercy!Samson had a glorious beginning with so much hope for the Israelites. However, he made many mistakes and made some huge mistakes.The latter part of Samson’s story was filled with hopeless scenes.Samson slayed a lion with his bare hands (Judges 14:5-9), and with only a jawbone of an ass, he defeated and massacred an entire Philistines (they were about 1000 in number).The Philistines had been fighting Samson for 20 years and not once did they defeat him. They couldn’t defeat him when they tied him up, they couldn’t defeat him when they surrounded him at night in Gaza.Yet this man, Samson was finally arrested after they got his hair shaved completely. In his weakest moment, they quickly bound him and gouged out his eyes. He was thrown into prison where they bound him in shackles and made him grind grain.This was not just a hopeless situation for Samson, but the entire nation of Israel.No matter how you find yourself at the lowest state of life, don’t feel despised by God. Don’t assume God has left you. Even when it was obvious your mistakes and disobedience contributed to your downfall, trust in God’s mercy to give you a hand.You may be mocked or become an object of amusement, but continue to trust in God’s mercy. Be rest assured that you will not fail, according to His mercy.The Philistines thought it was over with Samson.
But Mercy said, “IT IS NOT OVER YET!”
They didn’t know his hair was growing and there is such a thing as the Mercy of God.Sometimes it may seem you have lost all your strength, dexterity and grace. You just need to trust in God, who is the source of all grace and strength.The most beautiful and inspiring scene in the entire story of Samson was this:“Then Samson prayed to the Lord, “Sovereign Lord, remember me again. O God, please strengthen me just one more time. With one blow let me pay back the Philistines for the loss of my two eyes.” Then Samson put his hands on the two center pillars that held up the temple. Pushing against them with both hands, he prayed, “Let me die with the Philistines.” And the temple crashed down on the Philistine rulers and all the people. So he killed more people when he died than he had during his entire lifetime.” Judges 16:28-30 (NLT).
Samson knew the Lord was with him. He understood the perpetuity of God’s Mercy. And also understood the need to fulfill his purpose.
The scriptures says, Samson achieved more in his death than his entire life. When God’s mercy showed up, Samson achieved more in a day than what he did in 20 years.Beloved, “IT IS NOT OVER YET!!”Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 136; Psalm 62:11-12; Ephesians 2:2-6; Psalm 40:11; Psalm 69:13,16; Psalm 23:6) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be rejuvenated and strengthened by God according to His rich Mercy so that we shall accomplish or complete His plans and purpose for our lives.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNumbers 16-182 YEARS PLANEzra 1DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am sustained in faith according to the great mercies of God. – God has got my back. – My boast and confidence is in God who is rich in Mercy. – The mercy of God is the backing of my life. Thank you Lord for your SURE MERCIES!

title: EPISODE 1115 - PURE WISDOM
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your present condition or challenge to make you back down. Step out and step up in faith today and this week. The grace of God is sufficient for you. Author Wednesday, 11th February, 2026 PURE WISDOM“For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.” Proverbs 2:6 (KJV)
Until you understand the value of Pure Wisdom you may not know how impossible it is to access it outside God.
You are being reminded and concientized through these episodes, that you will fully understand this truth that Pure Wisdom can only be accessed in God.There are times when people hear or read things like this and only see it as a mere form of religious fanatism.The created things depict the creative handiwork of Wisdom but not the embodiment of Wisdom.Just as all things have their original source, God is the originality of True Wisdom.
The Wisdom of God is transfused into you when you fully set your heart on God.
Because men have cultured their minds toward religious mysticism, they don’t embrace the simplicity of divine things. They will rather prefer complex rituals through complex means to attain great Wisdom. Yet God through His Word has revealed the root and embodiment of His Wisdom.Take a look at how Job establishes the reality that, you can enjoy the fellowship of Wisdom only in God, for He alone is the source of Wisdom.See Job 28 (NKJV):“Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place where gold is refined.” v 1“That path no bird knows, nor has the falcon’s eye seen it. The proud lions have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed over it.” v 7-8“Man does not know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.The deep says, ‘It is not in me’; and the sea says, ‘It is not with me.’It cannot be purchased for gold, nor can silver be weighed for its price.It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.Neither gold nor crystal can equal it, nor can it be exchanged for jewelry of fine gold.No mention shall be made of coral or quartz,For the price of wisdom is above rubies.The topaz of Ethiopia cannot equal it, nor can it be valued in pure gold.” v 13 – 19“It is hidden from the eyes of all living, and concealed from the birds of the air.Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a report about it with our ears.’” v. 21 – 22So now we see that all the created things men would boast of as sources of Wisdom have never had a grip on what Wisdom is at all.Now twice in Job 28 (verses 12 and 20), Job asks:“But where can wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?” v. 12“From where then does wisdom come? And where is the place of understanding?” v. 20The point Job kept making is this:
The most complex and mysterious places of men are not the embodiment of True Wisdom.
Jobs answer to his rhetoric question was this:“God understands its way, and He knows its place.” v. 23” Then He saw wisdom and declared it;He prepared it, indeed, He searched it out.” v 27.Now after Job brings his readers to the realization of God as the source of Wisdom, he gives man the code by which he can fellowship with Wisdom:“And to man He said,‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom…” v. 28
Wisdom is the fear of the Lord. The same thing is also said in Proverbs 9:10:
“Fear of the LORD is the foundation of wisdom. Knowledge of the Holy One results in good judgment.” (NLT).
The fear of the Lord is the acknowledgement, submission and honor of God’s authority. It is a deep godly reverence which determines how God’s counsel influences the way you live.
This is the beginning of Wisdom.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Job 28; James 1:5-6; Proverbs 1:7; Ecclesiastes 2:26; 1 Corinthians 1:25; James 3:17) WE PRAY– our hearts will be trained to deeply and highly revere the authority and person of God.– the counsel of God will strongly influence our lives and affect the way we live unto His purpose and glory.In the name of Jesus!BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNumbers 19-212 YEARS PLANEzra 2DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to esteem any created thing above God who is the source of true wisdom. – I esteem the Word of God in my life. – I walk in wisdom. – I cease to be ordinary. – My understanding is opened as I fellowship daily with the Word of God. – I am wise. Oh Glory to God!!

title: EPISODE 1116 - THE DANGER OF ISOLATION 1
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you make time to speak to God, He will show you things you do not know. SELAH! Author Thursday, 12th February, 2026THE DANGER OF ISOLATION 1“Not forsaking our meeting together [as believers for worship and instruction], as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another; and all the more [faithfully] as you see the day [of Christ’s return] approaching.” Hebrews 10:25 (Amplified Bible)The term isolate is fundamentally derived from the Latin “insulatus” — which literally denotes the act of being “made into an island” or “placed upon an island”. The term conveys the deliberate detachment of an entity from its broader and organic environment.One of the greatest threats to your consistent walk of faith and growth in the Lord is the desire to be isolated from the Church (which is Christ’s body).It is an error and a trap of the adversary for you to be isolated from the Body of Christ. You are a member of the body, together with the saints.“Now you [collectively] are Christ’s body, and individually [you are] members of it [each with his own special purpose and function].” 1 Corinthians 12:27 (Amplified Bible)How well will a kidney thrive when it is isolated from the body?We are called to be isolated from the world because we are not of this world (John 15:19). However, we live together within the body for the benefit (service) of one another.This post-COVID pandemic world disclosed isolation as a more dangerous epidemic within the Church community.The very first warning in creation was that it is “not good for man to be alone” (Genesis 2:18).Ironically, many isolate themselves from the Church under the guise of pursuing a deeper spiritual life, only to become fixated on digital distractions. Under the pretext of seeking the Holy Spirit, they succumb to endless surfing, using isolation to escape accountability or to indulge in misguided, self-focused philosophies.These philosophies are void of true satisfaction.One of the key factors contributing to this isolation is the propounded concept of self-love.Self-love has become the new chant in this generation. Most motivational speeches, online content, campus lectures, post-modernistic mental health campaigns promote this concept of self-love.They talk about “self-care”, “soul strolls”, “solo-dating”, “self-parenting” or “mothering” oneself, or “your inner child” and “unapologetic” living (as in no longer apologising for being yourself).Beyond pampering, “self-love” has evolved into deeper emotional, mental, and boundary-focused practices.It has been brandished as a more intentional, fierce practice of mental health and autonomy or personal sovereignty.This does not birth organic stability and peace.The word of God holds the definitive answers to the mysteries of the soul and the complexities of human nature.As a new creation in Christ, your thoughts must align with the truth of the word.The recent pandemic served as a catalyst for an agenda designed to isolate believers and shipwreck their faith, with the destructive doctrine of self-love at its epicenter.But is that not a fulfilment of the Apostle Paul’s apostolic prophecy?Here is what he said:“But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, proud, arrogant…” 2 Timothy 3:1–2 (ESV)Beloved, we are at the deeper end of the last days. The enemy has also deployed all his arsenals to prevent the saints from taking heed to execute their divine ordination.You become exposed to the wiles of the devil when you are isolated from the fold.Let nothing draw you away from the brethren. Do not become a prey. Within the fold, you are safe. Attending church meetings and being actively involved in the Church is not an option but a necessary necessity for your nourishment and consistent participation in God’s agenda.Remain knitted with Christ and with the saints.Refuse to be isolated.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 2:42; Matthew 18:20; Psalm 122:1; Ecclesiastes 4:9-12; Hebrews 3:13) WE PRAY We pray that we shall not fall into the trap to desire isolation from the saints, but shall daily be active in the community of the saints. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNumbers 22-242 YEARS PLANEzra 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I shall not fail into the trap of desiring isolation from the saints. - I remain knitted with Christ and the saints. - I allow nothing to draw me away from the brethren. - I refuse to allow myself become a prey to the adversary. - I remain active in the community of the saints. - I refuse to be isolated. Oh glory to Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1117 - LIVE DAILY IN THIS CONFIDENCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 13th February, 2026 LIVE DAILY IN THIS CONFIDENCE “we come closer to God and approach him with an open heart, fully convinced by faith that nothing will keep us at a distance from him. For our hearts have been sprinkled with blood to remove impurity and we have been freed from an accusing conscience and now we are clean, unstained, and presentable to God inside and out!”Hebrews 10:22 (TPT) God made man and planted Him in His presence for eternal communion. Man was not made to live outside God’s presence. However, after Adam turned away from God’s instructions, he became guilty at heart and couldn’t approach God’s presence.
He hid himself from the presence of the Lord because of guilt and the sense of condemnation.
That has always been the challenge of man after sin entered the world. The matter of sin, guilt, and a sense of condemnation is rooted in unbelief. But the only way man can commune with God is by faith. To commune with God by faith is to live by the word of God. All things came into being by the word. Man’s relationship with God was according to the speaking of God.  Man is only able to approach God on the grounds of faith. This faith is a confident assurance in who God is and what He has supplied to man. Under the Old Covenant, God established the Aaronic Priesthood as a means to usher man into His presence.  God never wanted to be distanced from His people. No matter the corruption of man, He still made provisions to reach out to man and to bring him into fellowship with Him. When the Israelites left Egypt, the Lord instructed Moses to build a tabernacle, that He might be in their midst. The tabernacle had the outer court, where animal sacrifices were made.  It also had the holy place (which had the seven lampstands, the table of shewbread, and the altar of incense) and then the most Holy Place.  The Holy Place was not made accessible to everyone. It was only the High Priest who had the consecration to enter the Most Holy Place. It was there in the Holy Place, God’s glory manifested.  The ark of the covenant was kept in the Most Holy Place. A special veil separated the most holy place from the other parts of the tabernacle.  Now understand that, though God made Moses to consecrate the High Priest to be the only person to legally enter the Most Holy Place, God in His wisdom made provision to commune with the entire nation of Israel in the Most Holy Place. Aaron, as a high priest was a representative of God to the people and the people to God. He was to wear a special garment that distinguished and separated him for his assignment. This high priest’s garment had shoulder pieces that held the breastplate and the ephod (which we will discuss further later). The shoulder pieces were made of two onyx stones (one on each shoulder), and upon each of the onyx stones will be engraved with six names of the twelve tribes of Israel. (Exodus 28:2-12) Meaning Aaron was adorned in this gracious garment to be a representation of the children of Israel before the Lord. “You shall put the two stones on the [two] shoulder pieces of the ephod [of the high priest], as memorial stones for Israel; and Aaron shall bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.“Exodus 28:12 (Amplified Bible) Whenever the High Priest stood before the Lord in the most Holy place, it was a memorial before the Lord that the entire nation of Israel was before Him. God fellowshiped with the whole nation through the High Priest. But the High Priest couldn’t just draw close or enter the Most Holy Place. Before he could enter the Most Holy Place, there were some specific things which have to be in place. Apart from the burning of incense (Leviticus 16:12-13), another crucial thing he needed was an unblemished blood (Leviticus 16:3; Hebrews 9:7).With these things in place, the High Priest enters the Holy place or draws close to the presence of the Lord with confidence.
The High Priest approaching God’s presence with confidence was the entire nation approaching God with confidence.
Everything in and about the tabernacle is a prophetic and typographical representation of Jesus, His redemptive work and what He accomplished through His life, death and resurrection. Jesus has a better Priesthood than that of Aaron. Aaron’s Priesthood produced a temporal experience of God’s presence; however, Jesus did an eternal work and ushered all who shall believe in Him into an eternal fellowship with God without any sense of guilt. Under the Aaronic Priesthood, there were yearly sacrifices made. But Jesus, who is the perfect High Priest, made a perfect, eternal sacrifice once and for all. “And by his one perfect sacrifice he made us perfectly holy and complete for all time!” Hebrews 10:14 (TPT). Now we are not like Adam, who had to hide himself from the presence of God. We are not like the Israelites, who needed yearly offerings before they gained some temporal confidence before the Lord. And then after some limited time, they become guilty of sin. We are saved through Christ’s perfect and eternal sacrifice. Now through Christ’s sacrifice, we have eternal access into God’s presence. We dwell and enjoy His presence every day, not because of our self-righteousness, but by the perfection of Jesus. Adam hid from God because of guilt and a sense of condemnation through the sin of unbelief. We boldly approach and enjoy the Lord because of the blood of Jesus. Refuse to distance yourself from the Lord.
Don’t allow any guilt or wrong to draw you away from God.
Live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 7:19; Romans 5:1-2; 1 John 3:19-21; Ephesians 3:12; Hebrews 4:16; Psalm 73:28) WE PRAYThank the Lord for granting you access into eternal fellowship with Him through His Son, Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNumbers 25-272 YEARS PLANEzra 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t permit anything to keep me at distance from God. – I dont’ allow any guilt or wrong to draw me away from God. – I live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. – I don’t distance myself from God. – Thank you Lord for the access of eternal fellowship with you through Jesus. Oh blessed be God!Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1120 - PUT YOURSELF INTO REMEMBRANCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Cast all your cares unto the Lord and patiently stay under His mighty hand with humility. For the Lord shall exalt you in due season. Selah! Author Monday, 16th February, 2026 PUT YOURSELF INTO REMEMBRANCE “Get wisdom! Get understanding! Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.” Proverbs 4:5 (NKJV)God does nothing without His word. He created the Heavens and the earth by His word. (Genesis 1:3).Even the worlds were framed by His Word (Hebrews 11:3).He spoke forth the promise of Salvation through the seed of the woman.Salvation came to mankind through the Word. The Word became flesh so He could complete and fulfil God’s Salvation plan. (John 1:1,14, 29).Even the new birth of incorruptibility is by the word of God (1 Peter 1:23)God’s word is powerful (Hebrews 4:12), and it is the wisdom of God (1 Corinthians 1:24).The word of God has the ability to quicken your soul (Psalm 119:25,50)
The Word of God doesn’t fail.
“For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.”Isaiah 55:10-11 (KJV)You will find these three things;1. God’s word is fruit-bearing.2. God’s word accomplishes God’s pleasure.3. God’s word prospers.Every word of God concerning you shall not fail, just as the prophetic word of our Lord Jesus did not fail. Peter the apostle said, “We have a more sure word of prophecy” (2 Peter 1:19).
You have a responsibility to know the sure word of prophecy and to continuously walk in the remembrance of the word.
The reality is this: whatever God has said about you will bear fruit.You don’t have to forget. You don’t have to let it slip out of your mind or heart. Stay glued to the word. The more you set your heart on it through meditation, the more you become courageous and increase in faith for the manifestation of the Word.The adversary knows that when you forget, you will not be able to experience or enjoy the prosperity of the Word. He labours to get your heart distracted from what God has said, so that you will walk in faithlessness.
Your greatest disadvantage has always been how you become forgetful of what God has said.
Don’t allow failures, mammon, self-gratification, challenges, or negative situations to make you forget or doubt the word of the Lord.What is the word you have received?Know that the word of God which you have received shall prosper, be accomplished and produce fruits.Therefore, don’t forget!If only you would not forget, you would see the manifestation of the word.
Put yourself into remembrance every day.
There’s blessing in not forgetting the word of the Lord.Selah.DIG DEEPER(James 1:22-25; Joshua 1:8; Psalm 1:2-3; Proverbs 2:1-12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain resolute at heart, and our minds will always be set on what the Lord has said, irrespective of the adversities. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNumbers 36Deuteronomy 1-22 YEARS PLANEzra 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t forget the glorious word of God I have received. – I stick to the word no matter. – I have this strong consciousness that the word of God works.– My heart and mind are continually set on what God has said, irrespective of the adversities. – I refuse to forget. – I don’t forget. – I put myself in remembrance daily. – Until I see the result of the word thereof, I will not forget. – I don’t permit anything past, present or future to make me forget or doubt the word of God. – I have absolute confidence in the word of God. – The word of God has power over me. – I believe in the word of God to the core.  Oh Hallelujah!Thank you Lord Jesus, for the gift of your word.

title: EPISODE 1121 - DON’T PERMIT ANYONE TO CORRUPT YOU AGAINST THE CHURCH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 17th February, 2026DON’T PERMIT ANYONE TO CORRUPT YOU AGAINST THE CHURCH “but if I am delayed, I write so that you may know how you ought to conduct yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth” 1 Timothy 3:15 (NKJV)The best place to run to, amidst the uncertainties of this world, is the Church. For the Church is the organic expression of the unshakable Kingdom of God. The people of the world who see the Church as a threat would definitely have a different opinion about this. Nevertheless, the essence and the impact of the Church in the world cannot be denied.
