From the revelation of the scriptures, there is the affirmation of this truth of the Church and its purpose in this world. The Church is the herald of the glorious news of the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus. Apart from the Church, there is no other community of people anywhere in this world which presents and represents God’s Kingdom.You might have experienced some people within the Church who act contrary to the reality of the Kingdom of our Lord. But that doesn’t deny what the Church is – THE PILLAR OF TRUTH! Selfish men will always look for ways to creep into places and then attempt to make waste of gullible people. However, the light of the truth cannot be comprehended by any dimension of darkness. 
Don’t allow your experiences of some people within the Church to corrupt your love for the Lord, and then move you away from the community of the Church. 
Don’t allow your heart to be steered away from the glorious essence of the Church.The people within the True Church of our Lord Jesus are being nurtured and built-up unto the measure and the stature of the fullness of Christ (Ephesians 4:13). Because of the truth of our Lord Jesus and the work of the Holy Spirit within the Church (the Body of Christ), there is no doubt that in the consummation of all things, the Church will be a spotless community.“Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her, that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word, so that he might present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing, that she might be holy and without blemish.” Ephesians 5:25-27 (ESV)
 There is no single institution in this world which is built on the foundation of the cravings of men that will not sink.
Christ is the foundation of the Church, and He is the Truth. This means the Church is built on Truth and remains solidly strong beyond the end of time.“For no one can lay a foundation other than the one which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.” 1 Corinthians 3:11 (Legacy Standard Bible)Jesus Christ is the chief cornerstone of the Church (Ephesians 2:20).Knowing that Jesus Christ is the foundation and the chief cornerstone of the Church, we must have this unwavering assurance that to be built in the Church is to be built in the bastion of truth.Talking about the Church, I am not speaking of your denomination. I am speaking of the community of Christ, the corporate body of all the saints who stand and walk in the sound doctrine and unadulterated gospel of our Lord Jesus. I am not talking about denominations where the gospel of our Lord Jesus is peddled and don’t esteem sound doctrine.Go for what the Word of God says, and enjoy the revelation of Jesus.
Don’t give your mind to empty traditions and human philosophies, which end up in endless arguments. 
“My counsel for you is simple and straightforward: Just go ahead with what you’ve been given. You received Christ Jesus, the Master; now live him. You’re deeply rooted in him. You’re well constructed upon him. You know your way around the faith. Now do what you’ve been taught. School’s out; quit studying the subject and start living it! And let your living spill over into thanksgiving. Watch out for people who try to dazzle you with big words and intellectual double-talk. They want to drag you off into endless arguments that never amount to anything. They spread their ideas through the empty traditions of human beings and the empty superstitions of spirit beings. But that’s not the way of Christ. Everything of God gets expressed in him, so you can see and hear him clearly. You don’t need a telescope, a microscope, or a horoscope to realize the fullness of Christ, and the emptiness of the universe without him. When you come to him, that fullness comes together for you, too. His power extends over everything.” Colossians 2:6-9 (Message Bible)The fullness of Christ is revealed through His Body, which is the Church.
The Church remains the only Bastion of Truth in this world; therefore, let nothing move you away from the Church!
Be unwaveringly involved or part of what God is doing in His Church.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 28:16; Acts 4:11-12; Ephesians 5:6; Colossians 2:20; Romans 1:21,22; Hebrews 10:25) WE PRAYThat nothing shall sway us of the course of Christ established for us in the Church. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 3-52 YEARS PLANEzra 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am immovable and eternally part of the body of Christ.– I cannot be deceived by the philosophies and traditions of men.– I am secured in the Kingdom of God.– I am deeply rooted in the truth of God, which is Christ.– I continue in this truth I have received.– I don’t give my hearing to any other voice aside Christ.– I refuse to conform to this world.– I belong to the unshakable Kingdom.Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1122 - BE LIKE TITUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 18th February, 2026BE LIKE TITUS“Then God who cheers those who are discouraged refreshed us by the arrival of Titus.” 2 Corinthians 7:6 (TLB) Some people don’t make it their priority to be a blessing. And don’t even think they have to make it their priority to support their Leaders or Pastors (Shepherds) in the Church. Some people are dedicated and committed to their “bosses” or employers and even their office supervisors because they esteem their job.
Our participation in the Church will bring us to the fulfillment of God’s eternal purpose.
Your Kingdom relevance is first measured by your relevance in your Local Church. The Holy Spirit will first share the burden of God’s vision and assignment for your Local Church with your Pastor or Shepherd. In the same way, when the adversary wants to attack the vision of the ministry, he will first attack your Pastor or Shepherd. If there should be any discouragement, pain, burden, attacks, persecutions, and threats, your Pastor is the first to take the shots.
Leading and raising the saints could be burdensome.
There are a lot of Pastors who are daily overwhelmed by the task of pastoral care. While some members refuse to be consistent in adhering to instructions and practising the word, others are busily seeking their own interests. Some are also holding grudges and creating conflicts within the Church through lies.  Pastors don’t only deal with the spiritual and numerical growth of the Church. They are also dealing with external confrontations and distractions. Handling every single individual member of the Church with their challenges and also ensuring each of them experiences their victories in Christ. These things don’t just happen weekly or monthly. These are things he is bearing up with every day.
What is your role in all these?
Are you the one who makes ministry easy? Or you are the one who adds to the “pressure”. This is not to say you don’t have to share challenges with your shepherd.However, what difference are you making in your Pastor’s life? Are you the reason he is encouraged and joyful, or are you the reason he has more load of tasks? Or are you making his efforts and labour worthless? Are his visitations, counselling, and prayers for you becoming a waste? He invests all this time and effort, and then you just decide to leave the ministry, not for any divine reason? BE LIKE TITUS! “For even when we arrived in Macedonia our bodies had no rest, but we were oppressed at every turn—conflicts and disputes without, fears and dread within. But God, who comforts and encourages the depressed and the disquieted, comforted us by the arrival of Titus.” 2 Corinthians 7:5-6 (TLB)
Your presence and participation in the Church should be an encouragement to your Pastor.
You have to decide to be a burden bearer and a supply of the Lord’s encouragement to your setman.  Choose to make ministry smooth for your Man of God. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 16:17; 2 Corinthians 7:13; 1 Thessalonians 3:2) WE PRAYThat through the grace of God we will be God’s supply of encouragement to our pastor. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 6-82 YEARS PLANEzra 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a burden bearer. – I am a son of consolation. – I refuse to make it difficult for my Pastor to lead me. – I choose to be the Lord’s supply of encouragement to my Pastor. – I give heed to every instruction given by my man of God. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!!

title: EPISODE 1123 - …ONLY THE TEACHINGS OF CHRIST
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you stand before the Lord, will you be able to boldly say that you have lived this year or this month serving His interest? Selah! Author Thursday, 19th February, 2026 …ONLY THE TEACHINGS OF CHRIST“Jesus said to the people who believed in him, “You are truly my disciples if you remain faithful to my teachings.” John 8:31 (NLT) We are in a generation where there is an abundance of information and pluralism of thoughts, concepts of life and teachings.
There have been more teachers in our time than ever.
This is because of the several media platforms available now. This wasn’t the case in few years back. Some people lack the integrity and skill to be teachers. Yet now, with internet data and a smartphone, everyone wants to create content and to share their opinions or assumptions as authentic knowledge. And you will have some gullible people running after those thoughts.
Every disciple of Jesus must give attention to only the teachings of Christ.
Your mark of discipleship is TO CONTINUALLY REMAIN FAITHFUL TO THE WORD (or teaching of Christ). It is not how long you have been a disciple of Jesus, it is how long you will continue to be a disciple of Jesus. You must intentionally imbue focus in the teachings of Christ. It is interesting how some believers turn to the myths and old fables of this world.
The people of the world cannot teach you the reality of the Kingdom.
For example, your unbelieving lecturer doesn’t have the spiritual understanding of the kingdom life.Therefore, he/she doesn’t have the authority to teach you how to fellowship with God. He is not the one to tell you how you should be attending Church meetings. The people of this world have their terms, and as you are in Christ, you function by a different set of rules.  
You cannot be in Christ and think like the world. 
You must uphold and esteem the teachings of Christ in your heart. A true disciple of Jesus, is a deviation to the systems of this world. He/she doesn’t live by the thought patterns of this world; but delights in the Word of Christ. He/she doesn’t interpret love as the people of this world do. A true disciple of Jesus walks in the unconditional love of Christ. A true disciple is a doer of the word of Christ and not a hearer only. He/she follows and continues in Christ no matter the storm, suffering or persecution. The persuasion of a true disciple is that nothing can separate him/her from the love of Christ.
Dear Disciple of Jesus, do what the Lord tells you to do through His word, not what the world informs.
ARE YOU A TRUE DISCIPLE OF JESUS? Selah.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:16; John 15:8; John 13:35; Romans 8:37-39; Colossians 1:28-29; 2 John 1:9; John 15:7-8) WE PRAY– That the delight and persuasion of the word of God shall be intensified in our hearts more and more; to make us doers of the word and not hearers. – That he word of Christ shall deeply dwell in our hearts and we shall not yield our minds to the old fables and false teachings of this world.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 9-112 YEARS PLANEzra 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t pattern my life according to the standards of this world. – I walk in the unconditional love of Christ. – I delight myself daily with the word of Christ. – Nothing can separate me from the love of Christ. – I continue in Christ no matter the storm, sufferings and persecutions. – I am a true disciple of Christ. Hallelujah!!!!

title: EPISODE 1124 - WHOSE VERDICT OF YOU MATTERS THE MOST?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 19th February, 2026 WHOSE VERDICT OF YOU MATTERS THE MOST?“Look at all the birds—do you think they worry about their existence? They don’t plant or reap or store up food, yet your heavenly Father provides them each with food. Aren’t you much more valuable to your Father than they?”Matthew 6:26 (TPT)The death of Jesus for you and your participation in His Newness of life, which was dispensed through His resurrection, provides the extent of your value before God.You were bought with a price (1 Corinthians 6:20)Your cost price is Jesus Himself.
Even when you were a sinner, you were valuable before God.
“But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” Romans 5:8 (Berean Standard Bible)Your value never decreases before God’s love. He proved His value to you by how He saved you.By which standard do you think you have no value?The challenges you have gone through, your defeats, failures, and terrible mistakes do not change or diminish your value before the Lord.If your value doesn’t decrease or diminish before the Lord, is it the negative report of men that matters to you?
Since you are still valuable even by God’s standard, why are you subjecting yourself to the negative standards of men?
Between God and men, who has higher standards?Whose verdict of you matters the most?“So, what does all this mean? If God has determined to stand with us, tell me, who then could ever stand against us? For God has proved his love by giving us his greatest treasure, the gift of his Son. And since God freely offered him up as the sacrifice for us all, he certainly won’t withhold from us anything else he has to give. Who then would dare to accuse those whom God has chosen in love to be his? God himself is the judge who has issued his final verdict over them—“Not guilty!”Stop judging yourself wrongly.Stop devaluing yourself with negative words.Speak sweetness to yourself.
Whenever you stand in front of a mirror, speak forth the value God has placed on you.
You are not ordinary.Why worry about your existence when you have great value before the Lord?Walk in this consciousness every day of your life, no matter your experiences and the judgment of men.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 12:6-7,24; Matthew 10:29-31; Isaiah 43:4; Matthew 20:28; Psalm 139:13-14; Ephesians 2:10) WE PRAYThank you, Lord, for making me a person of value and your treasured possession. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 12-142 YEARS PLANEzra 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am valuable to God. – I don’t subject myself to the negative standards of men. – The verdict of God about my worth is what matters to me. – I am not ordinary. – I am the beloved of God. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I walk daily in the consciousness of my worth before God. – I have been bought with the precious blood of Jesus therefore I am precious before God. – My cost price is God Himself. – I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1125 - BE YIELDED AND SUBMISSIVE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Nothing is impossible with God. Stop doubting Him. Stop acting according to your strength. SELAH! Author Saturday, 21st February, 2026 BE YIELDED AND SUBMISSIVE “so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV) The adversary doesn’t stop until he is resisted. Your resistance to the devil is not what brings you victory. To resist the devil is to enforce the victory that Christ has obtained for you.
Victory is your inheritance in Christ. Your responsibility is to enjoy that victory and not permit any force of darkness to derail you.
The goal of the devil is to disrupt your enjoyment of Christ’s victory for you, by using all his schemes to shipwreck your faith. Most believers don’t think it’s possible they can find themselves in this state. Which is understandable, considering what Christ has achieved for the new creation. The reality of the Born Again is this: “that even though we were dead because of our sins, he gave us life when he raised Christ from the dead. (It is only by God’s grace that you have been saved!)” Ephesians 2:5 (NLT) The life which the born again received is the New creation life or the Newness of Life. But until the saving grace of Jesus, the man who got saved was dead in sin.  This was also your state. Until you were saved in Christ, you were dead in sin. It was by the grace of God that you have been quickened or made alive in Christ. This was not the quickening of your mind. It was the quickening of your spirit. When you got born again, the life of God was transfused into your spirit. And by the continuous culturing and nurturing of your mind through the Word of God and the intimacy of the Holy Spirit, you experience transformation through the renewal of your mind. “Stop imitating the ideals and opinions of the culture around you, but be inwardly transformed by the Holy Spirit through a total reformation of how you think. This will empower you to discern God’s will as you live a beautiful life, satisfying and perfect in his eyes.” Romans 12:2 (TPT)
The more you experience the renewal of mind the more you experience transformation and inwardly become effective in the things of Christ.
When you are not experiencing a renewal of mind, you will start becoming dull in the things pertaining to Christ. Instead of growing in the knowledge of Christ and becoming more fervent in spirit, your mind rather imitates the ideals and opinions of the culture around you.  This leads to the deadness of your mind. The deadness of your mind is to lose interest in the things of Christ. To be dead in the mind is to be saved but think like an unbeliever. These are people who behave like unsaved.  There are some Christians who are not just dull in spirit but dead in their minds. Yes, they are born again; baptised in the Holy Spirit but are carnal. “For to be carnally minded is death, but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.” Romans 8:6 (KJV)
Dullness in spirit will always lead to carnality or deadness of mind when not corrected immediately.
When the adversary succeeds at luring you into this phase or state of mind, he doesn’t have to suggest thoughts any more to you. You will oppose the things of God by your own imagination and pride.  At this stage, you will esteem your thoughts above the truth of the scriptures. The way out of such a state is to decide to humble yourself before the Lord. 
If you are in this state where you are governed by your flesh and pride, you must turn to Jesus and submit to the authority of the Word.
Are you beginning to act contrary to the word of God? Are you losing interest in the things of Christ? You don’t even see the usefulness of Church meetings? Are you esteeming the activities of this world above the study of the Word and staying patiently to be taught in Church? It’s time to make a decision to be yielded and submissive to the instructions of Christ. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Colossians 3:2; Galatians 6:8; Galatians 5:16-17; Proverbs 14:12; John 6:63; 1 Corinthians 2:14) WE PRAYHeavenly Father,Thank you for the opportunity to grow in your word and be renewed in my mind unto total transformation. I pray that through the training of your word, I will always live in accordance with the revelation of the Newness of life in the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 15-182 YEARS PLANNehemiah 2-3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am fervent in Spirit.– My heart is always alive and sensitive to the wisdom of God. – I refuse to be dominated by the flesh. – I remain humble at all times to be trained and nurtured by the word. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I live daily above  dullness. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1127 - FAITH SPEAKS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The greatest limitation of faith is pride. Exercising great faith always begins with having reverence for God and submitting to Him. SELAH! Author Monday, 23rd February, 2026 FAITH SPEAKS“We have the same Spirit of faith that is described in the Scriptures when it says, “First I believed, then I spoke in faith.”2 Corinthians 4:13(TPT)One of the important principles you must know about faith is the expressiveness of faith. Faith is the evidence or the proof of what you have received.
You cannot say you have faith and be silent. Faith speaks!
To act in faith is to act according to God’s word, and God is not silent. Even in His silence, there is a message.“For God speaks again and again” Job 33:14 (TLB)
As believers in Christ, we have the life of God and also we are to live His life by imitating Him.
“Imitate God, therefore, in everything you do, because you are his dear children.” Ephesians 5:1(NLT)As imitators of God, we also speak as God speaks.Please understand that to say faith is not silent doesn’t mean faith speaks unnecessarily. Faith doesn’t speak anything at all that comes to mind. To speak in faith is not to be idle chatter. Faith speaks or vocalizes the revelation of the word of God.Faith germinates in your heart, through the meditation of the Word of God spoken or declared to you. The Word of God in you is a seed which grows to be faith.When the word matures as faith in your heart (through meditation) it also comes forth as the “rhema-word” which produces the results or the miracle you have conceptualized.Some people assume to meditate on the word is to be quiet or silent like yoga practitioners.Meditation to the believer in Christ, is not the emptying of the mind. 
God-centred meditation is the filling and saturation of the mind with the truth or word of God. 
And as the mind absorbs the revelation of the word, it begins to mutter the words and then as faith increases, you shout the word with boldness.The first demonstration of faith is in the words you speak. You cannot speak doubt and act in faith. You will consistently act in faith when you think and speak faith.You can only speak the word when you are full of the word of God.In Genesis 1, God spoke light, life and matter into the formless and empty earth. By speaking He created everything that is needed to make existence on earth comfortable.You must not continue to watch on to the discomfort around you. You must not assume that things will change around you automatically. You must be intentional about the speaking of the word.
Create the miracle and result you want to see by speaking in faith.
Do you believe what God says?Then you must speak forth His word with boldness.He has said, that you may boldly say!Jesus in every circumstance spoke and acted out the word.Jesus said to the disciples, if you have faith you will SAY to the mountain be moved (Mark 11:23).Beloved, find out what God has said in His word concerning your health, your finances, your ministry, your family, your destiny, your work, your marriage and your society.Believe it and boldly declare it.
God is a speaking God, His faith in you is a speaking faith. Don’t be quiet.
Glory to God.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Mark 16:20; Matthew 21:21; Mark 9:23; Psalm 19:14; Hebrews 13:5-6) WE PRAYWe pray that the revelation of God’s word shall saturate our minds and tongues with the life of the word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 23-252 YEARS PLANNehemiah 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have absolute confidence in God.– I live by the word of God amidst all confutative opinions. – I have the faith of God. – I don’t doubt the word of God. – The faith of God in my heart cannot fail. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1128 - DEALING WITH LOW SELF-ESTEEM AND INSECURITIES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, the word of the Lord is true and absolute. Make the Word of the Lord your focus, and you will see the manifestation of His glory. Shalom! Author Tuesday, 24th February, 2026 DEALING WITH LOW SELF-ESTEEM AND INSECURITIES“For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God].”1 John 5:4 (Amplified Bible)Low self-esteem or self-regard and insecurities have limited people from walking into the fulfilment of their purpose.Faith is your way out of that limitation. Remember, faith operates by the revelational light of the Word of God.While talking about the “heroes of faith”, the author of the book of Hebrews mentioned Gideon.“How much more do I need to say? It would take too long to recount the stories of the faith of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and all the prophets.” Hebrews 11:32 (NLT)To have Gideon’s name among “heroes of faith” is an evidence that you are only celebrated and remembered for your victory and not your limitations.No one will celebrate your insecurities and low self-regard.No one will remember you for feeling worthless.Without God’s intervention, Gideon would have remained subjugated by his mental limitations. And Israel wouldn’t have experienced him as a great leader and deliverer.
Until you stop the self-pity party, destinies are going to be destroyed.
Awakening from the “worthlessness” feelings will make you a blessing to many.Gideon did struggle with an inferiority complex. He defined himself by his family status. He struggled with insecurity, self-doubt, and worthlessness.When God came to him, He referred to him as “…a mighty man of valor”.His trauma, self-doubt, low self-regard and the fear of the Midianites made him question even the thought that God was with the Israelites.Gideon also doubted that he was a mighty man.While the Lord saw him as a mighty man of valor, a man of great strength to save or deliver Israel, he saw himself as insignificant.“But Gideon said to Him, “Please Lord, how am I to rescue Israel? Behold, my family is the least [significant] in Manasseh, and I am the youngest (smallest) in my father’s house.” Judges 6:15 (Amplified Bible)This Gideon, who disregarded himself, felt to be the weakest among the weak (considering his family background), irrelevant, insignificant and worthless to lead Israel, became a hero of faith. Even his faith became a testimony for those of the New Testament (and generations yet unborn).Gideon would have remained worthless if he had not yielded to the word of the Lord.
It is not how you feel about yourself, it is what God says about you.
The word of God is the mirror of God, which brings you to the knowledge of your true self.Gideon was able to break free from his insecurities and low self-regard because of the revelational light of God.Don’t think you are the first to have self-doubt. You have seen Abraham and Sarah, and also Gideon. Even Jeremiah the Prophet had insecurities.Here is his personal testimony:“Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!” But the LORD told me: “Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak. Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.…” Jeremiah 1:6-8 (Berean Study Bible)Moses doubted his eloquence to speak before Pharaoh. He disregarded himself because he was slow of speech and tongue. (Exodus 4:10-12). Later, when he submitted his thoughts to the word of the Lord, he led Israel out of captivity.
Many lives will not be impacted or transformed when you keep doubting yourself and what God has called you to do.
No matter the insecurities, the doubts and the weakness you feel, this is what the Lord is saying to you: “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” (2 Corinthians 12:9).Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Exodus 3:11-12; Exodus 4:10-13; Isaiah 41:14; 1 Samuel 9:21; Genesis 32:10; 1 Corinthians 15:9; 1 Corinthians 1:27-29) WE PRAYWe pray that the sufficiency of God’s superabounding grace shall strengthen and perfect our weaknesses. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 26-282 YEARS PLANNehemiah 7DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow myself to settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to my destiny. – I live by the limitless ability of God. – I refuse to make decisions according to how I feel, I am led by the Lord. – I shake myself from every yoke of the mind and heart. – I live above all limitations. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1129 - DON’T ALLOW DARKNESS TO PREVAIL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Where there is honor and humility, there is the abundant release of grace, and peace. SELAH! Author Wednesday, 25th February, 2026DON’T ALLOW DARKNESS TO PREVAIL“For the earth will be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea.”Habakkuk 2:14 (NKJV) This Prophetic word of the Lord in the opening verse was not a suggestion nor a mere wish. It was the Lord declaring what was going to happen. The intensity of this prophecy is in the certainty of its tone; that it shall fully come to pass no matter the resistance. God’s word or what He says is prophetic! His prophetic word is living, active, and full of power; which makes it operative, energizing, and effective. This means the Lord’s prophetic word (what He says) comes to pass in its full force. The prophetic word is sharper than any two-edged and cuts deep on every side. (See Hebrews 4:12 – Amplified Bible and Message Translation). Certain prophetic words in the Old Testament portion of the Bible were not only fulfilled within a historical context or by historical events but were fully fulfilled in the Gospel or revelation of Jesus. For example: Historically, God’s prophetic word of the promised land to Abraham was Canaan (Genesis 12; 15:18-21). In Genesis 15:18-21, you will find the determined borders of the physical promised land. However, by revelation of scriptures, the true promised land is Christ and the Kingdom of God. When Abraham got to the promised land, He looked forward to an eternal city. (Hebrews 11:10,16). Again, God didn’t only promise Abraham a land. He also promised Abraham a seed (Genesis 12:7). This seed is both physical and spiritual. The Jews were the fulfilment of the promised seed through Isaac and Jacob. (John 8:33). And by the revelation of the gospel, we have the absolute fulfilment of the prophetic word; the true Seed of Abraham is Christ and all who belong to Christ are Abraham’s seed through Faith (Galatians 3:16; 29) Not just in these examples, but Christ is the goal of all prophecies. Though it may seem the prophetic word by Prophet Habakkuk was concerning the Lord’s judgement against the Chaldeans or Babylon, the fulfilment of this prophecy unveils God’s transcending and universal plan.
The plan is to fill the whole Earth with the knowledge of His glory as the waters cover the sea.
This prophecy and plan cannot fail; for the Word of the Lord does not return to Him empty until it has fulfilled its purpose (Isaiah 55:11). Through Christ Jesus, God has given forth the light of the Knowledge of His glory. (2 Corinthians 4:6). This light of the knowledge of His glory is burning within our hearts; just as our Lord made a bold utterance concerning Himself that: “As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world” John 9:5. He said this also: “The people who dwell in darkness have seen a great light…” Matthew 4:16. This is the fulfillment of the prophecy by the Prophet Isaiah: “The people who walk in darkness will see a great light. For those who live in a land of deep darkness, a light will shine.” Isaiah 9:2 (ESV). Now we are made the light of the world to show forth God’s glory (1 Peter 2:9). We have the mandate to reach out to many who are in darkness and fill or saturate them with the knowledge of the glory of God. Look at how this prophecy is repeated in Isaiah (the New Living Translation provides vivid detail): “…for as the waters fill the sea, so the earth will be filled with people who know the LORD” Isaiah 11:9 (NLT).
To cover the earth is to reach all men and fill them with the knowledge of the glory of God.
Wherever there are people we must take the glorious gospel of light there. We must take it to the offices, to the companies, the schools, the streets, families, the communities, cities, villages, towns, and the internet (including all social media platforms). You must get involved and be part of this glorious work of God. Be the reason and the medium by which the work of God will be accomplished.
Don’t sit on the fence!
Beloved, don’t allow evil to prevail. COVER THE EARTH!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:4; 2 Peter 1:19; Numbers 14:21; Psalm 22:27; Isaiah 40:5) WE PRAY1. We pray for the opening of doors and opportunities in places where there are people who will be granted us and we will exercise the wisdom to saturate every person with the glorious gospel of Jesus. 2. We pray that we shall maintain the focus, diligence, and discipline to spread the goodnews of Jesus and train many men for the move to cover the earth with God’s glorious knowledge. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 29-312 YEARS PLANNehemiah 8DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I increase in the knowledge of the glory of God (which is the revelation of Jesus). – I share in the prophetic vision of God to cover the earth, with His glory. – I am involved in preaching the gospel everywhere I go. – I don’t keep quiet. I don’t allow darkness and ignorance to prevail. I shine the glory of God upon every heart. – I cover the earth! I cover the earth! I cover the earth! – I refuse to procrastinate!!! – I don’t sit on the fence. Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1130 - GREAT FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow the experiences of some public figures define your life. None of their experiences qualifies to be an example for you. You are of God. If it is not praise worthy don’t give your mind to it. SELAH! Author Thursday, 26th February, 2026GREAT FAITH“When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.” Matthew 8:10 (KJV) Though there are different levels or dimensions of faith, there are also different kinds of faith. One of them is to have “GREAT FAITH“.
To have great faith is determined by how you act and function in the revelation of Jesus.
There are only two instances where FAITH was described as GREAT by Jesus. They were seen in two none Jews: A Roman centurion and a Canaanite.(Matthew 8:10, Luke 7:9 and Matthew 15:28). In both scenarios, the people involved broke certain walls of limitation to demonstrate great faith. In places where Jesus may not have expected faith, He found great faith. From the opening verse, you will see how Jesus marvelled at the Faith of the Roman Centurion. That wasn’t the only time Jesus marvelled; He also marvelled at how He found no faith in His own people of Nazareth. To marvel is from the Greek word “thaumazō“. Which means to admire, to be astonished or to stand amazed. It also means to step back and say “Wow!“. In a situation or place where Jesus thought there should be great faith, He witnessed a great level of faithlessness. He stepped back and was negatively “wowed” or dumbfounded.
Faith is of great concern to the Lord. Wherever great faith is found, there is the manifestation of great power.
To exercise great faith, the first item is to demonstrate a great level of reverence and humility towards GOD. Sometimes, we are tempted to subtly boast more of our rights in Christ instead of the Lord who gave us those rights. We enjoy great results of faith not only because of who we are, but mainly because of who He is. 
Our faith shouldn’t be in who we are, but first, who He is. We are what we are because of Jesus. And at all times, we have to submit to Him first.
Look at how the Roman Centurion demonstrated great faith. “And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.When Jesus heard it, He marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.” Matthew 8:5-10 (KJV Despite the credentials of this Roman centurion, His humility before the Lord was overwhelming. Beloved, to be counted worthy of the Lord’s presence in your life, or to have right standing with God without any sense of guilt by Christ Jesus, is a great privilege. 
Learn to acknowledge the sure mercies and grace of God.
Just because you are now a son of God, a brother of Jesus, and have a mingled life with Christ doesn’t mean you are also a master on your own. He says, “Without Me you can do nothing” (John 15:5). Jesus is your MASTER. The more you see Him as your Master, the more you submit to Him, and your faith finds genuine expressions through Him.
Remember, pride is the greatest limitation of Faith. 
Secondly, the Roman Centurion ACKNOWLEDGED THE AUTHORITY OF JESUS Not only did he humble himself and show how he revered the Lord, but He also acknowledged the greatness of Jesus’ power and authority. Beloved, understanding is everything!
Your life will always be governed by your level of light. 
His understanding of authority made him know how he could get results. He knew the health condition of his servant was caused by a great spiritual force, and to deal with that condition, he needed greater authority and force.The centurion couldn’t think there was any authority greater than that of Jesus. All Jesus had to do for him was to speak a word. 
Great faith acknowledges the power and authority of Jesus.
Are you sure there is a situation in your life which is above the authority of Jesus? Great faith cannot doubt the power and authority of Jesus, no matter the situation. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Luke 7:9; Matthew 8:26; Mark 11:22; Habakkuk 2:4; Galatians 2:20; Hebrews 11) WE PRAY– That our minds will be established in the consciousness of the universal power and the authority of Jesus. – That in all matters we will acknowledge and esteem the authority of Jesus.In the name of Jesus. – Pray to address any challenge, by declaring the solution you want to see as you stand in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus and His name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDeuteronomy 32-342 YEARS PLANNehemiah 9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I recognise the Lordship of Jesus in my life and every situation. – I walk in the revelation of the power and authority of Jesus. –  I exercise great faith according to the revelation of Jesus and not according to any efforts of mine. – I refuse to be proud and egoistic. I walk in the humility to the Lord Jesus and His commandments. I take steps according to the ability of God.  – I am conscious of the universal Lordship, power and authority of Jesus. – I declare that my Jesus is the Lord of all. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1131 - GIVE NO PLACE TO BITTERNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 27th, February, 2026 GIVE NO PLACE TO BITTERNESS “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.”Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)There are things and situations the adversary uses as means for his demonic projectiles.For example, a person maltreats you and cruelly relates with you. He or she oppresses you and tortures you mentally, emotionally and even spiritually. This makes you vow that you will never forgive him or her. It even makes you bitter because of the pain you feel and sometimes wish he or she should suffer the same or worse throes.At this point, you should know the adversary has invaded your emotions with his fiery venom.When you come to the point where you strongly crave the destruction of other lives irrespective of their crime and offence, you should know you have become a guest on the table of the devil.
The adversary takes delight in your pain, offences, bitterness, and anger.
When someone hurts you, you may hold a grudge but deal with the situation quickly. It may grow into bitterness, and bitterness is a poison.Bitterness doesn’t only affect those who hurt you. Bitterness first destroys you and those around you.“Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good.” (Job 21:25)
Bitterness gives you a reason to attack God.
One can be so bitter and even blame God, saying, “If God loves me so much, why did He watch me become a victim or go through that situation? Why didn’t He protect me?”When you ask such questions, the devil dances to his “bingo” tune.I am not asking you to just blame the devil for your pain. All I want you to know is, the devil will take advantage or exploit the situation to collapse your defenses and fully crush you. Don’t be like Job, who became bitter towards God (Job 10:1,3)
Fight bitterness with the word of God.
Don’t give place to bitterness.Sometimes when the adversary wants bitterness to thrive, he isolates you from the Church and your relationship with the Lord.Let me tell you:
Don’t allow anything or anyone who did not die for you on the cross, to separate you from the Lord who died for you.
Don’t allow the evil, people do to you to change you!This world is an evil world, the only refuge is the Lord Jesus. Some people become the means and instruments for which the devil uses to creep into the Church to attack the faith of innocent ones. Don’t allow such to win in the Church.
Stand your ground together with the faithful saints and let truth prevail over evil.
SHIELD UP!Give no place to bitterness.Don’t be quickly or easily provoked or angered. Anger is in the bosom of fools (Ecclesiastes 7:9), and you are not one of them.Don’t brood or continuously meditate on your pain; it will rather fuel it. Don’t keep talking to yourself or others about the pain. Remember, “repetition is the law of deep and lasting impression”.See the Wisdom here: “Whoever covers an offence seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates close friends.” (Proverbs 17:9)Talk about the solutions, talk and focus on the Love of God towards you.“Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don’t yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ” Ephesians 4:31-32 (Contemporary English Version)
Rehearse the virtue of being gracious to others!
This is how you SHIELD UP against the blazing arrow of bitterness.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 14:10; Proverbs 19:11; Matthew 18:33; Colossians 3:8,13; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11) WE PRAYWe pray that the word of God and the love of God shall saturate our hearts and minds to flush out every form of bitterness within us.In the Merciful name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJoshua 1-32 YEARS PLANNehemiah 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to hold on to offences and bitterness. – I demonstrate the love of God towards all men in all things. – Nothing can offend me. – The love of God gains full expression through me by the day – I am full of love. – The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1134 - YOU HAVE GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Monday, 2nd March, 2026 YOU HAVE GOD“Look with wonder at the depth of the Father’s marvelous love that he has lavished on us! He has called us and made us his very own beloved children. The reason the world doesn’t recognize who we are is that they didn’t recognize him.”1 John 3:1 (TPT)There was a story about a lady traveling with her boss (it was her first time travelling on an aircraft). And in the flight, they sat at separate seats with some distance between them. When they got to their destination, her boss got to know the lady was feeling hungry. The boss was a bit surprised considering how they were served on the flight. So she asked the lady if what was served on the flight wasn’t enough for her.The lady replied to her boss, “Ma, I didn’t accept any of the food they tried serving because I was nearing enough money and didn’t want to bother you. I didn’t even visit the washroom because I didn’t want you to incur other costs”“What?” The boss exclaimed, “Your flight ticket covered all the bills! Your way to enjoy everything”. She continued.Is this not the situation with most believers in Christ?The ignorance of what God has lavished on them makes them live like beggars.They judge what they have and what they can do through their natural strength.
Don’t judge the supply of Godwith the limitation of your natural ability.
God is rich in wisdom and blessings; He lavishly and richly pours out His blessings in large measure.The lavishness of God is not just in the demonstration of His love through spiritual blessings in Salvation. God also lavishes His children with material blessings. To experience material blessing is not necessarily being materialistic.Materialism in theology is the concept of being obsessed or preoccupied (spiritually, mentally, emotionally and physically) with material things rather than the spiritual reality of God.“Stay away from the love of money; be satisfied with what you have. For God has said, “I will never, never fail you nor forsake you.”Hebrews 13:5 (TLB)In the above verse, the author of Hebrews instructs his readers to stay free from the love of money and to shun financial greed.Does that mean the child of God doesn’t experience material blessings?Certainly not! The contrast of not being greedy or obsessed as a child of God with material things is contentment with what you have. This is transcending. The author was specific with what you need to be content with. He said “…be content with what you have”Amazing! (Just feel like shouting)
To be content with what you have is not in reference to the material things you have been able to amass through your struggle and sweat.
What you have in this context is not what you gained through your natural labor.What do you have?You have GOD!Who has said, “I will never [under any circumstances] desert you [nor give you up nor leave you without support, nor will I in any degree leave you helpless], nor will I forsake or let you down or relax My hold on you [assuredly not]”Did you read that?You cannot have God and lack support. He doesn’t just give you support, God is the support and the supply.Most believers who love a greedy life, live as the people of the world. They are not conscious they have the greatest treasure.Jesus said, “So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require” Matthew 6:31-32 (TPT)No child of God should be greedy and materialistic. No child of God should be obsessively chasing after money or material things.
You have GOD’S PRESENCE, where every blessing finds expression.
Concerning your physical needs or material blessings, take note of this:“And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.” 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)How much do you need to do what God has called you to do?God is able to lavish you with every earthly blessing so that you will be sufficient enough for every good work.
Don’t doubt nor limit the wisdom of God.
Continue to behold and trust Him as your shepherd; He will make you lie down in green pastures.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:3; 2 Corinthians 3:4-6; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35; Deuteronomy 28:11-14) WE PRAYPray to thank the Lord for His abundant supply of every earthly blessing we need to execute His assignments. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJoshua 12-142 YEARS PLANNehemiah 15DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God’s love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love.– The Lord doesn’t withhold His kindness and care from me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life.Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1135 - YOU ARE GOD’S RESOURCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 3rd March, 2026 YOU ARE GOD’S RESOURCE “So then each of us shall give account of himself to God.” Romans 14:16 (NKJV)There are many who want to be known as faithful stewards by how they manage other resources of God. They don’t consider themselves as God’s resource to be managed.
You have to know that your life is an investment of God for the expansion of His Kingdom.
You will find true meaning in life when you use your life to serve God’s Kingdom mission and to express His glory.The concept of God’s stewardship is not only how you take care of things and also utilize these things for the purpose of God; the concept of God’s Stewardship first begins with how you take care of yourself and also live to serve His purpose.You belong to God and He has graciously made you a steward of your life.Your entire being is the first and the most important investment of God for His Kingdom. And as a steward, you will one day make an account to God, as to how you lived your life to serve His purpose. “For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us].” Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified Bible)As a steward of the life God has given you, it is important to walk according to the path God has set for you. You can’t live contrary to what God has ordained for you and be counted as a faithful steward.Just as God’s resources must be used for His purpose as He has prearranged, even so must you live according to what the Lord has prearranged.The arrangement of God for your life is to bring you to a successful end. God has designed your life for His glory.
Whatever you do must bring glory to Him. He made your entire being for His service.
After God brought Israel out of Egypt and led them further to possess the promised land (through the investment of His power or enormous strength and wisdom), Moses stood before the assembly of Israel and addressed them saying:“So now Israel, what do you think God expects from you? Just this: Live in his presence in holy reverence, follow the road he sets out for you, love him, serve God, your God, with everything you have in you“ Deuteronomy 10:12 (The Message)To serve God with everything you have in you is also to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul. It is to serve Him with every potential the Lord has deposited inside you.Moses the Prophet of God, went on to explain to the congregation of Israel why they have to serve the LORD with everything in them:“Look around you: Everything you see is God’s—the heavens above and beyond, the Earth, and everything on it.” Deuteronomy 10:14 (The Message)
Whatever you have belongs to God, including your life and must be used for God’s glory.
Never be part of those who make claims like; “My life is mine and can decide to do whatever I want to do with it”.Some also go like, “My money is mine and can spend it how I want”.Whether you live diligently as a steward or not, a time will come when you will definitely give an account of yourself to God.Will you be reckoned as a good and faithful steward?Selah.DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:5; 5:33; Matthew 22:37; Romans 12:1; Colossians 3:23; 1 Corinthians 4:17;  1 Peter 4:10; Matthew 25:14-30) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall apply our hearts to wisdom and live according to the Lord’s prearranged path set before us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJoshua 15-172 YEARS PLANNehemiah 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I apply my heart to wisdom to live according to the Lord’s prearranged path set before me. – I serve as a faithful steward.– I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use God’s resources for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize God’s resources to fulfill His purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1136 - CHOOSE THE EXAMPLE OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The knowledge of the revelation of Jesus is what launches you into the enjoyment of your freedom to participate in the inheritance of the saints in the light. SELAH! Author Wednesday, 4th March, 2026 CHOOSE THE EXAMPLE OF JESUS“And consider the example that Jesus, the Anointed One, has set before us. Let his mindset become your motivation” Philippians 2:5 (TPT)As Paul the apostle was admonishing the Church in Philippi to walk and work in oneness, he pointed out the need for humility to make that a reality.In his admonishment, he shared the greatest example of Jesus.The example of Jesus brings clarity to how a believer has to express the divine reality.He is the embodiment of the Godhead and the express image and portrait of the invisible God. (Colossians 1:15)
This means that the example of Jesus is the ultimate expression of divine humility.
The greatest model of divine humility is Jesus. When you emulate the example of Jesus, you live the true Kingdom life.“And consider the example that Jesus, the Anointed One, has set before us. Let his mindset become your motivation. He existed in the form of God, yet he gave no thought to seizing equality with God as his supreme prize. Instead he emptied himself of his outward glory by reducing himself to the form of a lowly servant. He became human! He humbled himself and became vulnerable, choosing to be revealed as a man and was obedient. He was a perfect example, even in his death—a criminal’s death by crucifixion! Because of that obedience, God exalted him and multiplied his greatness! He has now been given the greatest of all names!” Philippians 2:5-9 (TPT)It wasn’t a high thing for Jesus to become a human. It was a demonstration of His humility.
For Jesus to live humbly means humility is a great thing and a precious quality in the Kingdom.
Humility was a precious thing in God’s saving plan. In truth, if not for the humility of Jesus, the eternal plan of God wouldn’t have been executed.The greatest work of God in the universe was accomplished when the WORD (Jesus) humbly became flesh.Jesus, being God, humbled himself to the form of a lowly servant.Yes, Jesus was given because God loved the world. However, He was able to be given because He humbled Himself.Being humble is a great mystery unto greatness and increased authority.
The crucifixion of Jesus was God’s demonstration of wisdom to bring salvation to mankind.
And it took the humility of Jesus for Him to exercise obedience even unto death. Thus, humility is a demonstration of God’s wisdom.“He humbled himself and became vulnerable, choosing to be revealed as a man and was obedient. He was a perfect example, even in his death—a criminal’s death by crucifixion!” (Verse 8)Jesus’ humility was so great at a point when He could have commanded legions of Angels to fight for Him (Matthew 26:53), He chose the sufferings of the cross.Read more about the crucifixion of Jesus here.It is clear that the greatest demonstration of God’s love was through the humility of Christ.And He attained and obtained a name which exudes the greatest authority in the entire universe of God.
It takes a humble heart to serve under authority, to exercise great authority.
Choose the example of Jesus!Walk in Humility!DIG DEEPER(James 4: 6-10; Philippians 2:3-10; Proverbs 22:4; Matthew 23:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall walk and live consistently after the pattern of Jesus’ humility at all times and in all places. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJoshua 18-202 YEARS PLANEsther 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live and walk consistently after the pattern of Jesus’ humility. – I walk in the humility of heart daily at all places. – I am humble to the core. – I don’t entertain pride in any form. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1137 - CONCERNING DIVINE HELP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 5th March, 2026CONCERNING DIVINE HELP“With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.”2 Chronicles 32:8 (KJV)Beloved, understand that God is not an alternative choice. He is your first and only choice.No matter the progress you make and resources accessible to you, acknowledge God as your confidence and source. (Proverbs 3:26; Psalm 23:1).Use the resources available to you as divine tools. Let God work with you through the resources available to you.
Don’t make the resources available to you gods.
Progress in human civilization and technological advancement shouldn’t replace God and the advantage of His dealings. No advancement of any civilization outwits God’s intelligence and wisdom.To trust human methods and systems above God is to entrap your heart from enjoying an unceasing flow of possibilities.This is not to sympathise with the demonisation of technology or any intellectual contribution to human development. God made man to replenish the earth. (Genesis 1:28). He designed the human intellect not only to reason theological discourse, but to also harness and construct various frameworks of human development for the fulfilment of His purpose.Clearly, human intellect is God’s blessing and gift. Yet without it being cultured by God’s wisdom, it wouldn’t serve God’s intention.
Every single thing we find within God’s universe is His unique investment to achieve His purpose.
Nothing was designed to be isolated from God. Every single thing finds true meaning and fulfilment when it operates within God’s government.Right from when corruption entered the heart of men, independence from God became the pursuit of men. (Psalm 2:1-3).Thus, they made for themselves gods through created things and even systems they have created. (Jeremiah 16:20).Instead of culturing their hearts to trust in God, the enmity in their mind towards God (Colossians 1:21) has made them seek an existence outside God.But where can you go from God? (Psalm 139:7-12).They have trusted in their philosophies, technological advancements or scientific prowess, rather than God Himself.They have set their efforts and systems as their arm of strength. But as long as a concept, strategy, system or technique isn’t hewn out of God, it is subject to the weakness of the flesh.The arm of flesh refers to relying or depending on human intelligence, skills, strategy, resources etc., in lieu of God.The arm of flesh always fails. Don’t be like Sennacherib the Assyrian king. He trusted in his gods and military might. However, King Hezekiah had absolute confidence in God.To be clear, it wasn’t as though King Hezekiah sat in his palace doing nothing.“And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem, he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him. So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance. And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city…” 2 Chronicles 32:2-6 (KJV)Hezekiah took strategic steps. He cut the water supply to the Assyrian army, strengthened his military equipment, revamped his defences, and set offensive machinery in place. He did have the available warfare technology. But his confidence was in the LORD.Take note of the words he spoke to his people, nothing about their technological resources, strategy and military might:“And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying, Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.” 2 Chronicles 32:6-8 (KJV)Now the people didn’t rest on their military systems, but on the words of King Hezekiah concerning the DIVINE HELP.Whatever God has called you to do; plan, strategise, act out ideas and above all don’t trust in them. Have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 17:5; Isaiah 30:1-3; Isaiah 31:3; Psalm 146:3-4; Proverbs 3:5-6; 1 Corinthians 2:5) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not be lured to make gods out of our efforts, but shall exercise confidence in the LORD. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2025  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have no confidence in the flesh. – I exercise confidence in the Lord daily. – I don’t permit my heart to be lured to make gods out of my efforts. – I have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD! Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1142 - …HE HIMSELF CARES FOR YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 10th March, 2026 …HE HIMSELF CARES FOR YOU “Throw the whole of your anxiety upon Him, because He Himself cares for you.”1 Peter 5:7 (Weymouth New Testament)No matter the level you get to in your walk with God, the adversary won’t stop to oppose you with challenges.
The corruption of this world creates waves of anxiety and distress. 
And many believers become victims of such circumstances.Whether you operate from your comfort zone or out of your comfort zone, there is always going to be something which may create anxiety around you.You may be in some form of distress even as you are reading this episode of with . You may be feeling afraid about the future, about your relationship and even about your job.Maybe you are in some debt and are troubled about how things will turn up.The more you find yourself in this state of worry or anxiety, the more you draw back in faith.
The adversary always wants to find the believer in a state of anxiety and worry.
No matter the weight of your challenge or how bad your situation is, do you know God doesn’t want you to be anxious?Paul the apostle admonished the Church in Philippi:“Be anxious for nothing…” (Philippians 4:6)Though you may be confronted by challenges or some tough times, it is possible to live without worry, anxiety and distress.The secret is this: amid your challenges, you can outsource your anxiety.When you learn to outsource your anxiety, you walk in peace and joy.Most parents will understand this better. Though children have needs, they don’t even know they do have needs.All they think about is, their parents will make provision for them. Have you ever seen a child anxious about what he or she will eat the next day?A child worried about such responsibility is probably born to irresponsible parents. But no baby has such luxury of time to worry.In fact, they don’t even have the intelligence to worry about how to meet their needs. They just know they have to demand for what they want. Babies outsource their anxiety.When it comes to your needs be like a child. You have a heavenly Father who cares for you more than you care about yourself.As you can see in the opening verse:“Throw the whole of your anxiety upon Him, because He Himself cares for you.”
Stop being anxious and start throwing or casting all your cares and anxiety on the Lord.
This is how the Amplified Bible puts it:“casting all your cares [all your anxieties, all your worries, and all your concerns, once and for all] on Him, for He cares about you [with deepest affection, and watches over you very carefully]” 1 Peter 5:7 (Amplified Bible).Wow!See, your Heavenly Father cares about you [with deepest affection, and watches over you very carefully].Why then do you hold on to your cares? He doesn’t even want you to share your worries and concerns. He wants you to cast all to Him. He wants to bear you up. He wants you to outsource it to Him.Let God take care of your worry, as you enjoy His love and satisfaction.
Stop holding on to all your anxieties, all your worries, and all your concerns, once and for all.
Turn to God in prayer. Make all your requests with faith (absolute confidence in God) in your heart that the Lord will answer you completely.This was the posture of David:“The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.” (Psalm 34:15)The cry of the righteous is not a mere emotional breakdown as a result of overwhelming worries and anxiety. This cry is a confident call unto God for help. It is to turn all your worries to God in prayer.“The eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer” Psalm 34:15 (Brenton Septuagint Translation)
Stop worrying and start praying. Pray over everything no matter how little it may seem to be.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 1:10-18; 1 Samuel 30:6; Psalm 18:6; Matthew 6:25-33) WE PRAYWe pray outsourcing every worry, burden and concern to the Lord; that He will supply His help and satisfy our hearts in the midst of the storms. In the Name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I enjoy the Lord’s help in every circumstance.– The Lord satisfies my heart in the midst of storms.– I don’t hold on to anxiety.– I refuse to be anxious about anything, rather in all situations and at all times through prayer and supplication I cast all my burdens, cares, worries and concerns unto the Lord.Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your great help.

title: EPISODE 1143 - STAND STRONG IN THE GLORIOUS REVELATION OF JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever you have belongs to God, including your life and must be used for God’s glory. SELAH! Author Wednesday, 11th March, 2026 STAND STRONG IN THE REVELATION OF JESUS“But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ”2 Corinthians 11: 3 (NKJV)What do you think was Paul’s greatest concern for the Churches he planted and the people he raised?
It is that they will not be moved away from the gospel of Jesus.
And that is the same concern of all the Apostles of Jesus.Today’s Church has a different understanding of who a False Teacher, False Prophet and False Apostle is in their midst.Most Teachers, Prophets and Apostles who will be called false are now celebrated by “Christians” as True teachers.The Church doesn’t know the difference between another gospel and the true gospel of Jesus.Paul instructed the leaders in Ephesus to be watchful of false teachers and prophets.He called these false teachers ferocious wolves. And he said they will speak perverse and distorted things (Acts 20:29-30).These things they speak are contrary to the gospel of Jesus. Remember, there are no two gospels. The gospel of Jesus is the gospel of Grace.See Paul’s commendation:“And now I commend you to God [placing you in His protective, loving care] and [I commend you] to the word of His grace [the counsel and promises of His unmerited favor]. His grace is able to build you up and to give you the [rightful] inheritance among all those who are sanctified [that is, among those who are set apart for God’s purpose–all believers].” Acts 20:32 (Amplified). Falsehood has always been in contrast to the revelation or the gospel (the goodnews) of Jesus.Look at the opening verse in context:“I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all.”  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)
The simplicity of Jesus is the gospel of Jesus. Your commitment to the gospel is your pure and simple devotion to Jesus.
Stand strong in the glorious revelation of Jesus.Also, note that not all false gospel is preached by fake Pastors or Teachers or Apostles. Some people are genuinely called of God and sent by Christ, yet may find themselves teaching another gospel.It doesn’t mean the people are false, but their message or aspects of their teachings may be false.For example:One will teach that, “You are saved only by grace through faith in Christ Jesus and not by works”.That is the true gospel.However, after this person gets people saved, he begins to teach the saints another gospel, saying, “Though you are now saved, you can lose your salvation. Your salvation is not forever; it depends on your good works”.Beloved, this is a clear example of false teaching.To say one will lose his salvation is to say that the blood of Jesus is not enough to satisfy the demand of Justice. (I gave over 50 reasons you cannot lose your Salvation, click here to watch).To understand Justification, read the following: – Justification 1 – 3– Justified by Faith– Christ’s won freedom wasn’t partial– The Case is closed– What shall separate you?
Your salvation only depends on the good works of Jesus. It is not dependent on your works. (Ephesians 2:9).
Now, because you have been made righteous by Jesus, you live right unto God’s glory.This is the gospel.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Galatians 1:6-12; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we will not be given to another gospel but will consciously remain strong in the simplicity of the gospel and not swallow any other teaching at all.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJudges 17-192 YEARS PLANJob 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ. – I am righteous by faith in Christ. – My salvation is eternal. – I give no room for any other gospel. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1144 - YOUR LEVEL OF IMPACT IS DEPENDENT ON YOUR LEVEL OF MATURITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter the challenge confronting you, let the PEACE OF GOD rule over your heart. SELAH! Author Thursday, 12th, March, 2026YOUR LEVEL OF IMPACT IS DEPENDENT ON YOUR LEVEL OF MATURITY “Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)You must take interest in your growth in Christ. Take responsibility of your growth; make practical and effective use of the gracious things the Lord has supplied to you. You have the Holy Spirit as your HELPER. You are given shepherds to train, build and equip you through God’s Word in your ‘Local Church’.
How are you taking advantage of the sound teachings and trainings to grow?
If you are struggling to pray, you are not growing in the Lord. Your consistency in prayer contributes to your spiritual maturity. Are you dull of hearing the Word of God? Do you need to be reminded every time to read and study the Bible daily?  You have interest in surfing social media pages and entertainment than making time to listen to the teaching of the Word. You easily feel lazy and procrastinate when it comes to your spiritual development in Christ? When these things persist  you must know you are gradually having growth deficiency. It will then become difficult for you to make tangible impact in your world. Your level of impact is dependent on your level of maturity.
The greatest evidence of your growth in Christ is how you practice and express the love of Christ (1 Corinthians 13:13).
Understand this, you were given the ability to love, the moment you received the Holy Spirit. For the Love of God is shared abroad in your heart by the Holy Spirit. (Romans 5:5). You grow more and more in the practice and expression of love as you grow in the knowledge of Christ.
The more you see Christ, the more you behold His love and get rooted and grounded in His love.
The burning flames of His love becomes the intention and the administration of your study of the word and the consistency of your prayers. You begin to relate or commune with the saints and become gracious to others because of the workings of the love of Christ within you. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16-18; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2; Galatians 4:1 WE PRAYThat we will grow more and more in the practice of the expression of love as we grow in the knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJudges 20-21Ruth 12 YEARS PLANJob 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take heed to every instruction and training. – I am not dull in hearing the word of God. – I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. – I don’t lazy about my spiritual development. – I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit. – I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!!

title: EPISODE 1145 - IS THE WORD IN YOUR HEART?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The more you grow in the spirit, the less you are influenced or dominated by the flesh. Are you growing? To which extent are you dominated by the flesh? Selah. Author Friday, 13th March, 2026IS THE WORD IN YOUR HEART?“Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart” Job 22:22 (NKJV) What you have in your heart is what distinguishes you.
The difference between those who are bringing change to their world and those who are struggling to make an impact is what they have in their heart.
Your heart is the governing seat of the Spirit. God cannot do anything through you beyond the condition of your heart. The state of your heart defines the extent to which you go with God. A wicked heart will produce wickedness. A merry heart will produce joy in his or her sphere. Whatever we see happen in our world is the product of the condition of the hearts of men who influence society. One cannot manifest what one has not conceived in his heart. When you conceive evil, you will produce evil. When you conceive blessings and beauty, you will produce blessings and beauty. ” Peter asked Him, “Explain this parable [about what defiles a person] to us.” And He said, “Are you still so dull [and unable to put things together]? Do you not understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is eliminated? But whatever [word] comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what defiles and dishonors the man. For out of the heart come evil thoughts and plans, murders, adulteries, sexual immoralities, thefts, false testimonies, slanders (verbal abuse, irreverent speech, blaspheming).” Matthew 15:16-19 (Amplified Bible) See this also: “For the godless are barren: they can produce nothing truly good. God’s fire consumes them with all their possessions. The only thing they can ‘conceive’ is sin, and their hearts give birth only to wickedness.” Job 15:34-35 (TLB)
When you conceive failure, defeats, poverty, wickedness, hatred, envy and afflictions in your heart, that is what you will manifest or express.
Men, by their nature and their culturing without the word of God, are selfish at heart. And a selfish heart breeds envy, hatred, anger, wicked thoughts, etc. “The human heart is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked. Who really knows how bad it is?” Jeremiah 17:9 (NLT). See also: Genesis 6:5; 8:21; Ephesians 4:22.This is why at your new birth in Christ, God took away the stony heart to give you the new heart of grace.The Lord declared this through the Prophet Ezekiel, “Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. Your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols. And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.“ Ezekiel 36:25-26 (NLT). See also 2 Corinthians 3:3; Jeremiah 24:7; Psalm 51:10.Now in as much as at new birth the Lord gave you a responsive heart, your heart must be cultivated and nurtured with the Word of God. The Word of God is the revelation of God’s wisdom, His goodness and character.
To demonstrate and express the character of God, you need the Word in your heart.
“How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word. With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments! I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.” Psalm 119:9-11 (ESV) When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory.STORE UP THE WORD IN YOUR HEART!DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:6;11:18; Psalm 37:31; Matthew 13:15; Colossians 3:16; 1 Timothy 4:15; Psalm 1:1-3) WE PRAYThat we will give heed to the instructions of the word of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANRuth 2-42 YEARS PLANJob 5DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have invested the word of God in my heart, therefore none of my steps will slide. – I stay my mind and heart on God’s word. – My heart is a fertile and fruitful land for the word of God. – I give my mind daily to the mediation of the word. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1146 - THE ADVERSARY TAKES ADVANTAGE OF YOUR IGNORANCE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your words will always reflect the meditation of your heart. Let your heart boil or bubble with a beautiful theme.SELAH! Author Saturday, 14th March, 2026 THE ADVERSARY TAKES ADVANTAGE OF YOUR IGNORANCE “bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ”2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)The greatest weapon of the adversary is deception.Deception is the seed and mother of doubts and unbelief. The adversary leads people astray and makes them rebel against the Lord by systematically and patiently exposing their minds and imaginations to corruptible ideas.
The adversary never comes to directly and forcefully impose his deceptive ideas and thoughts in the imaginations of men; he cunningly evades your thoughts.
