When the adversary wants to set up a generation (or yourself or your family) against God, he consistently, patiently and subtly devices deceptive schemes to corrupt their imaginations.The adversary is not all-knowing, yet poses himself as such. He only knows the power of the mind and the force of human imagination. The hard-core deceptive thoughts of the adversary begin with questions.The more questions he introduces to your mind, the more he triggers your imagination.
People are able to imagine vain things through the deceptive thoughts of the adversary.
And the goal of such imagination is to set people against God.“Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying, Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” Psalm 2:1-3 (KJV)The adversary knows your advantage is your intimate relationship with God. Thus, if he can set you up against the Lord, it will be to your disadvantage.The Lord is your source; therefore when you are cut off from your source, where is your fulfilment?
The goal of his deception is to bring you to the point of unbelief and to finally turn you against God.
It is this deceptive method the adversary deployed in Eden, to corrupt the nature of man.“But now I’m afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s clever lies, your thoughts may be corrupted and you may lose your single-hearted devotion and pure love for Christ.” 2 Corinthians 11:3 (TPT)In Eden, the adversary asked, “Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Has God indeed said, ‘You shall not eat of every tree of the garden’?” Genesis 3:1 (NKJV).You see, he didn’t start by attacking God directly or attacking man. Also, he didn’t have a clear idea of God’s instructions to man in Eden. He always begins his deception by indulging your imagination. He also makes you feel he is concerned about you and knows something you don’t know.
Beloved, the adversary knows nothing! He only knows his weapon, which is, deception. He is the father of lies and deceit (John 8:44; Acts 13:10).
The adversary takes advantage of your ignorance to lead you astray.Anytime you realise you are asking yourself questions which make you doubt the reality of Christ, you must know the adversary is stimulating and steering your imaginations away from God.
This is why you must give your heart to the word of God. Until you esteem the word of God in your heart, you will not increase in Knowledge.
You must increase in the knowledge of Christ so that you can wage war and make captive of any thought which exalts itself above the knowledge of Christ. Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; John 8:44; Ephesians 4:14; Hosea 14:9; Ecclesiastes 9:3; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not become victims of the deceptive schemes of the adversary in our generation. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 1-42 YEARS PLANJob 6-7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I give my mind and heart to the word of God. – I refuse to be a victim of the deceptive schemes of the adversary. – I increase in the knowledge of Christ. – I esteem the word of God in my heart therefore I cannot be given to deception. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you, Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1147 - FOCUS ON THE VICTORY OF THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must get involved and be part of this glorious work of God. Be the reason and the medium by which the work of God will be accomplished. Beloved, don’t allow evil to prevail. SELAH! Author Sunday, 15th March, 2026FOCUS ON THE VICTORY OF THE LORD“Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from”Proverbs 4:23 (GOD’S WORD Translation)Since the adversary knows your heart is the seat of your deepest thoughts and emotions, he does anything possible to project deceptive thoughts into your heart.
He knows the moment your heart begins to absorb those thoughts, they will definitely germinate and manifest in your life.
That was how the adversary corrupted the pure hearts of Adam and Eve.Look at what Paul the apostle said to the brethren in Corinth:“But now I’m afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s clever lies, your thoughts may be corrupted and you may lose your single-hearted devotion and pure love for Christ.“ 2 Corinthians 11:3 (TPT)Reading from the above verse, how did Satan deceive Eve?He used his clever lies to deceive Eve’s thoughts. And Paul the apostle posits that the devil’s strategy has not changed. He may corrupt the hearts or thoughts of the saints by his clever lies.Through the deceptive thoughts of the devil, he poisons or corrupts your heart and disables you from believing or from exercising yourself in faith.When he succeeds at deceiving your heart, he practically takes away the word of the Lord from your heart so that you may not believe or have faith (See Luke 8:12).How can you live the victorious life in Christ without faith? For the just shall live by faith. (Romans 1:17).The adversary comes after your heart. Whatever he wants to achieve on earth begins with the seed of thoughts he sows in the hearts of men.When he wants to destroy your family, distract your miracle, collapse your business, he makes you doubt the reality of God.
He overwhelms your heart with negative and discouraging themes.
The evil and wickedness of men we see today began with the imagination or intents of the heart of men.“Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.” Genesis 6:5 (Berean Standard Bible).Once the adversary is able to invade the meditation of your heart with his deceptive lies, he has achieved the plotted coup to dethrone the manifestion of your testimony.This is why more than anything else you must guard your heart. Every thought of your heart must be consistent with the glorious news of Jesus.Job said, “For the thing I feared has overtaken me, and what I dreaded has befallen me.” Job 3:25 (Berean Study Bible)
Fear is the outcome of the control and influence of doubts and anxiety of failure in your heart.
Job was easily afflicted because he allowed the theme of fear in his heart.Sometimes for the enemy to control and even affirm the theme of your heart, he begins to attack your peripherals.He deceive people to become your enemies, he attempts to resist your business, tries to cripple your finances, projects infirmities to afflict your body with symptoms.Whiles your heart settles and accepts these happenings the challenges now gain root.So brother James charged us to “count it all joy when you encounter various trials” (James 1:2)“To count” is from the Greek word, “hēgeomai”which means to esteem, think as a ruler or a governor over a matter, or have rule over the situation in your heart.Don’t breakdown or accept defeat. Instead of allowing the challenge to take root in your heart, look unto Jesus, make His victory the meditation and theme of your heart.
Let your heart absorb and be occupied with the victory of Jesus.
There are many more things the Lord has achieved for you. Focus on the victory of the Lord concerning your challenge, think on it, speak it, shout about it, sing it, and dance to it.What is the theme of your heart this day?Are you thinking about debt, death, defeat, failure, loss, sickness, limitations, lack or you are thinking of the abundance of the Lord, the life of God, the victory of the Lord, his success, the profits, good health, limitlessness, and overflowing grace?Beloved, let your heart indite a good matter.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(2 Samuel 23:2; Proverbs 16:23; Psalm 49:3; Job 32:18-20; Job 33:3; Matthew 12:35) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be deceived by the cleverly lies of the devil, but the theme and thoughts of our hearts shall be saturated and soaked with God’s wisdom and grace. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 5-82 YEARS PLANJob 8-9DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord has set the beautiful thoughts of grace as the theme upon my heart.  – My words are consistent with the grace of God towards me. – My heart boils with a beautiful theme of grace. – I give no place for discouragement, failure and defeat in my heart. – My heart indite a good matter. Oh Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1148 - …THE WEAPON IS DECEPTION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must increase in the knowledge of Christ so that you can wage war and make captive of any thought which exalts itself above the knowledge of Christ. Selah. Author Monday, 16th March, 2026 …THE WEAPON IS DECEPTION “bringing down reasonings, and every high thing lifted up against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of the Christ” 2 Corinthians 10:5 (Literal Standard Version)Though the adversary has always been against God, the focus of his deceptive scheme has been man. This is because of the role and the value of man in God’s eternal purpose and plan.
The greatest mystery of God in the universe is God’s intimate relationship with man.
Jesus’ death for man, is God’s immeasurable investment in man.No wonder all through the universe this question was asked:“Compared to all this cosmic glory, why would you bother with puny, mortal man…?” Psalm 8:4 (TPT).The adversary is envious of man.He wonders, how God has made man a focus of His creation.Seeing how God values man, the adversary wants to get back at God, by setting man against God.
And to him it is war and the weapon is deception.
He knows his days are numbered, yet, he has decided not to go down without a fight.The deceptive schemes of the adversary are his weaponry of war.To the adversary, he is at war with the Kingdom of God. The goal of his war is to bring you to the point of unbelief, turn you against God and just draw you to himself through deception. His goal is to go down with all men. While God’s desire is to bring salvation to all men.There is a clear prophetic word as to how deception will increase in these last days.“The Holy Spirit has explicitly revealed: At the end of this age, many will depart from the true faith one after another, devoting themselves to spirits of deception and following demon-inspired revelations and theories.” 1 Timothy 4:1 (TPT).The adversary is busily using cunning means to deceive God’s people.
Anytime you realise you are asking yourself questions which make you doubt the reality of Christ, you must know the adversary is stimulating and steering your imaginations away from God.
The adversary is not interested in your well-being at all. Thus, you shouldn’t fall for his deception.The adversary always begins his deception by indulging your imagination through questions or vain opinions.  He also makes you feel he is concerned about you and knows something you don’t know.The moment you fail an exam, he comes subtly, “Can’t you see you have to put a hold on your 1 hour daily Bible reading and 1 hour daily prayers, to focus on your books? You need to pass your exams. What do you think?”He poses questions like:“If God truly loves you why did he watch your family member die?” “Look at how your whole family serves the Lord, yet there is no prosperity. Are you sure the teachings of the word are true?”“Can you see the evil going on in this world? Where is the all-powerful and loving God you believe in?”“Do you know there is a footballer called Jesus, so what if the Jesus you believe in is also an average person?”“Don’t make it a matter of faith, sickness is normal. Everyone will be sick and everyone will die one day, so just accept your fate. What can quoting scriptures do?”“Since you have been absent from Church, has anyone visited you? The church family is a scam. Just live your life the way you want.”“Why are you labouring to win souls and giving your resources? What if there is no heaven and all the scriptures you believe in are lies?”
Beloved, don’t normalize thoughts as these which creep into your mind or heart. They are arrows of deception shot at you.
When such thoughts are coming to your heart, quickly search the scriptures for answers. Don’t also keep your thoughts to yourself, seek Christ-centered answers from the Pastor the Lord has set over you.Take note: You are not the first to experience such arrows. Even Jesus, the adversary attempted to deceive Him.Take hold and meditate on the Word of Grace, as a good soldier.SelahDIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; John 8:44; Ephesians 4:14; Hosea 14:9; Ecclesiastes 9:3; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall set our thoughts on the teaching of the word and not the vain imaginations of the flesh. In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 9-112 YEARS PLANJob 10DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I give my mind and heart to the word of God. – I don’t allow any deceptive thought in my mind and heart. – I don’t doubt the reality of Christ. – I refuse to be a victim of the deceptive schemes of the adversary. – I increase in the knowledge of Christ. – I esteem the word of God in my heart therefore I cannot be given to deception. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you, Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1149 - GIRD UP YOUR LOINS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No one will celebrate your insecurities and low self-regard. No one will remember you for feeling worthless. Until you stop the self-pity party, destinies are going to be destroyed. WAKE UP and walk in the consciousness of how God sees you. SELAH! Author Tuesday, 17th, March 2026 GIRD UP YOUR LOINS “Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness” Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)Paul the Apostle wasn’t the first to use a military equipment to describe how we are to gear up for spiritual warfare.The Prophet Isaiah gave a prophetic word concerning our Lord Jesus, the Kingdom Army Commander in Chief:“For He put on righteousness as a breastplate, And a helmet of salvation on His head; He put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, And was clad with zeal as a cloak.” Isaiah 59:17 (NKJV)This reveals the consistency of the concept that the things which the Lord has supplied to us are spiritual gears we must uphold for spiritual warfare.This is not surprising that the adversary attacks your conviction of the truth in Christ; your understanding of righteousness and salvation.He knows they are equipment which protects you from his attacks.
Put on the Belt of Truth.
A Roman soldier’s loins is girt about with a belt called “Cingulum millitaire”. This belt is an essential gear in a Roman soldier’s outfit.Without the belt, a Roman soldier may not be balanced in strength.
The belt of Truth is the foundational or essential armor for a Roman Soldier.
The Belt of Truth depicts how the Truth of Christ is the anchor on which your thoughts and imaginations are held.Let’s take another look at the function of a soldier’s belt:Most ancient battles were fought in close combat. It was mainly hand- to- hand, therefore, the usual draped loose Roman tunic worn by a soldier will endanger him during a fight.In these ancient times, men wore tunics or skirts that came down to the knees, or even to their ankles. For their readiness, swiftness and flexibility, they roll up the skirt or the tunic, set it up and tucked it into the belt.Which means the belt doesn’t only give support to the body due to the weight of the breastplate. It also helps the soldier to be ready for battle.When God was preparing the Israelites to leave Egypt, He instructed them to gird their loins. (Exodus 12:11)The Israelites ate with their loose outfits tucked up into their belts.Apostle Peter in his first epistle also admonished that we gird up the loins of our minds for action (1 Peter 1:13).
To gird up your loins is a symbol of readiness for action.
You are prepared and made ready for action by the revelation of Jesus. The truth of Christ gets you ready to live the divine life of God.Anyone who is not fully established in Truth will be tossed by every wind of doctrine. Such a person lacks the readiness of mind to function according to divine purpose.
Get rooted and established in Truth (which is the revelation of Jesus).
Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 10:3-6; Exodus 12:11; 1 Peter 1:13; Luke 12:35 Romans 13:12; John 1:14,17 1 John 5:21; Ephesians 4:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we will receive with meekness the revelation of Jesus (which is the Truth of God) as we are prepared and perfected for His appearing. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 12-142 YEARS PLANJob 11DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With meekness of heart, I receive the revelation of Jesus. – My life is guided by the truth of God which is the word of God. – I maintain my balance by the belt of truth. – I don’t give my hearing to any doctrine which contradicts the knowledge of Christ. – I grow in the understanding of the person and revelation of Jesus. – I esteem the revelation of Jesus in my heart. – Nothing can take away or sway me off from the revelation of Jesus in my heart. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!!

title: EPISODE 1150 - OBEY THEM THAT HAVE RULE OVER YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency No matter the present day evil, God’s provision of grace is superabounding. As many as will turn to God and have faith in Him shall be satisfied by God grace. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 18th March, 2026 OBEY THEM THAT HAVE RULE OVER YOU“Obey your spiritual leaders, and do what they say. Their work is to watch over your souls, and they are accountable to God. Give them reason to do this with joy and not with sorrow. That would certainly not be for your benefit.” Hebrews 13:17 (NLT)The Lord has appointed Spiritual Leaders to function as shepherds.They have the responsibility to:– Lead and guide you unto God’s agenda.– To care for and feed you as a shepherd feeds his flock.
To think that you don’t need a shepherd is to act contrary to the wisdom of God’s word.
Our Lord Jesus is the great good Shepherd-King (Hebrews 13:20; John 10:11; 1 Peter 5:4), and He has appointed leaders within the various assemblies of saints to shepherd the saints as He does.Your Pastor or Church leader has the work or spiritual task to watch over your souls as shepherds watch over a flock.“…I urge my fellow elders among you to be compassionate shepherds who tenderly care for God’s flock and who feed them well, for you have the responsibility to guide, protect, and oversee. Consider it a joyous pleasure and not merely a religious duty. Lead from the heart under God’s leadership…” 1 Peter 5:1-2 (TPT).This was Peter the apostle’s instruction to the Church elders as Jesus instructed him.Jesus asked Peter at three different times if he loved Him, and He instructed Peter more than once to feed His lambs:“… Jesus said to Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you burn with love for me more than these?”Peter answered, “Yes, Lord! You know that I have great affection for you!”“Then take care of my lambs,”“Then take care of my sheep,”  Jesus replied, “Then feed my lambs.” John 21:15-17 (TPT)Again, Paul the apostle also instructed the elders of the Church in Ephesus:“So guard your hearts. Be true shepherds over all the flock and feed them well. Remember, it was the Holy Spirit who appointed you to guard and oversee the churches that belong to Jesus, the Anointed One, which he purchased and established by his own blood.” Acts 20:28 (TPT).The obedience in Hebrews 13:17 is not just to respond to a command as one under authority, but also to have confidence in a person. The Greek word is “peithō”, which means “to yield” or “have inner conviction”.To obey your leader is not a mere outward display of conformity. It is not acting properly in the presence of the leader. It is assenting in your heart to yield to the guidance of your spiritual leader.There are people who act in obedience only when they are in the presence of their leader and do otherwise or speak contrary in his absence.It is not a display of honour. It is a display of the hypocrisy of your heart. This kind of evidence wouldn’t last for long. Soon you will be exposed, or you will showcase your lack of commitment and unyieldingness.This is Paul the apostle writing:“So then, my dear ones, just as you have always obeyed [my instructions with enthusiasm], not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation [that is, cultivate it, bring it to full effect, actively pursue spiritual maturity] with awe-inspired fear and trembling [using serious caution and critical self-evaluation to avoid anything that might offend God or discredit the name of Christ].” Philippians 2:12 (Amplified Bible)The Greek word for obedience in this verse is “hupakouō”, which means “to heed”, “hearken or conform to a command or authority”.These people conformed with conviction to Apostle Paul’s instruction with enthusiasm in his presence. Now he urged them that it is more important for them to obey him in his absence.
This is a true demonstration of honour to your spiritual leader.
This is proof that you are not obeying your leader because you are afraid or being hypocritical, but you honour the Lord and honour the shepherd He has set over you.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 5:17; 1 Corinthians  16:15-16; Philippians 2:28-30; 1 Peter 5:5) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall have a genuine attitude of honouring our Leaders through obedience to their instructions, Love and sincerity, whether in their presence or their absence. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 15-172 YEARS PLANJob 12DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I set my heart right to practically honour my leaders today. – I walk in honour towards my Leader. – I  don’t dishonour the authorities God has set over me. – I refuse to be ungrateful towards my leader. – I honour my Leader with my treasure, time and finances. – I demonstrate honour towards my leader in all things. Thank you Lord for my Leader.

title: EPISODE 1151 - LOOK AWAY FROM YOUR WEAKNESSES AND FAILURES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 19th March, 2026LOOK AWAY FROM YOUR WEAKNESSES AND FAILURES“Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God”Hebrews 12:2 (Berean Standard Bible)God’s heart towards His people is never to destroy them but to bring them to His Salvation.That is the focus of the entire Bible. He desires that all men shall be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth. (1 Timothy 2:3-4).However, God doesn’t force His provision of Grace or Salvation on mankind. He only supplies His grace. But it is only by His supply of Grace that men shall be saved.
To reject God’s Salvation is to reject your deliverance from destruction.
What this means is that, to enjoy what the Lord supplies, one has to turn to Him by faith.That is exactly what Noah did.Noah built an ark because He had faith in God. If the people believed the testimony of Noah, they would have also been delivered from the flood.When you turn to God, you receive and enjoy His supply of Grace by faith. The Exodus of the Israelites from Egypt ultimately began after their first passover experience.Read here to understand the revelation of the Passover.Their obedience to the instruction of Moses concerning the passover was an action of faith towards God’s provision. This act of faith delivered them from death. Their journey through the wilderness was also to be a continuous demonstration of faith towards God.And that was what God kept teaching them all through their journey in the wilderness. In our journey through this perverse, corrupt and evil world, God wants us to set our gaze on Him. No matter the wrongs you make, your way out is to turn to the Lord and to behold Him.When the Israelites were attacked by fierce serpents in the wilderness (because of their disobedience), God’s answer was for them to behold the revelation of His Salvation.“And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.” Serpent is also a symbol of deception and corruption in the scriptures.(Matthew 12:4; Revelation 12:9)Brass (or bronze) is a symbol of judgement. The brazen altar (of the temple, see Exodus 27:1-8; Exodus 29:38) was a typology of the cross of Jesus, where the judgement of sin was executed.The brazen serpent was a typology of God’s salvation for mankind through Jesus.As long as the people beheld the brazen serpent, they were healed. The brazen serpent was a testimony to them that the penalty of their transgression had been paid, so they must be healed and live.
Jesus on the cross was made sin (2 Corinthians 5:21), and took upon Himself the judgement of sin. 
He said concerning His death, “And just as Moses in the desert lifted up the brass replica of a snake on a pole for all the people to see and be healed, so the Son of Man is ready to be lifted up, so that those who truly believe in him will not perish but be given eternal life” John 3:13-14 (TPT)This is the goodnews to all mankind.Jesus has paid for your sins; look away from your weaknesses and failures. Turn to God and behold His Salvation.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 46:22; John 12:32; John 8:28; John 6:40; Isaiah 53:5; Hebrews 9:28) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts will not waver in doubt but shall continue in faith as we behold the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 18-202 YEARS PLANJob 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow my heart to waver in doubt. – I continue in faith as I behold the Lord. – I look away from my weakness and failures, I turn to God and behold His salvation. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1152 - ACCORDING TO THE ORDER OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 20th March, 2026ACCORDING TO THE ORDER OF GOD“With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot.” Psalm 108:13 (BBE)We have this calling to do great things because, God does great things. You may have the desire to do great things in this world.
However, you are not called to do great things according to the standard of the world.
There are many things people may do, which the world will applaud as great feat, and will not be reckoned as Kingdom relevance. Or you may attempt to do something great with your strength which may seem relevant in the kingdom, but will not be recognized as such by God. What you do must be according to the Lord’s due order of greatness. Don’t just do things for God and call them great. It is the things which God has designed you to do that must be done.
Whatever God has called you to do, the intention and purposes has been foreordained.
“For we are His workmanship [His own master work, a work of art], created in Christ Jesus [reborn from above—spiritually transformed, renewed, ready to be used] for good works, which God prepared [for us] beforehand [taking paths which He set], so that we would walk in them [living the good life which He prearranged and made ready for us].” Ephesians 2:10 (Amplified) There are paths which the Lord has set. He has shown us through scriptures the level impact we must make. Becoming a great athlete, accountant, mathematician, etc may seem great before men in this world, but there is a greatness of impact you are ordained by God to make.Jesus showed us the pattern of greatness. “I assure you and most solemnly say to you, anyone who believes in Me [as Savior] will also do the things that I do; and he will do even greater things than these [in extent and outreach], because I am going to the Father.” John 14:12 (Amplified). There are great things the Lord did and now He has empowered us to step out there to do even greater.
Anything great you envision to do, it must be that which will contribute to the expansion of the Kingdom.
People shouldn’t just applaud you for what you do.They shouldn’t just applaud you as an outstanding student. Or an excellent business man.  Those avenues must be used to influence the multitudes with the light of the Kingdom.Don’t just be a celebrated philanthropist, be a Kingdom financier.  Be a part of the sponsors of the spread of the gospel. Be a mighty soul winner. Take daring steps to draw many to Christ. You can be a lawyer and still demonstrate great healing power, win thousands of souls, give into the spread of the gospel across the nations of the world. Hallelujah!!DIG DEEPER(Philippians 2:15; Proverbs 4:18; Isaiah 42:6) WE PRAYThat we shall increase in the understanding of the intention of the Lord and to rightly correct our motives so that our exploits will be according to God’s due order of greatness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 21-232 YEARS PLANJob 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I decrease that Christ may increase in me. – Whatever I do, I do according to God’s due order of greatness. – Whatever the Lord will request from me, I give with joy. – All that I have is the Lord’s and for His kingdom advancement. – My family, my house, money, intelligence, time, all resources and life are for the Lord’s use. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1153 - DON’T BE A SLAVE TO THIS WORLD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Saturday, 21st March, 2026DON’T BE A SLAVE TO THIS WORLD“So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless” 1 Corinthians 15:58 (NLT) I will sincerely not deny the challenges which may confront you, just because of your stand in Christ.Our Lord declared this: ” for you get enough hate from the world! But then, it hated me before it hated you.The world would love you if you belonged to it; but you don’t—for I chose you to come out of the world, and so it hates you. Do you remember what I told you? ‘A slave isn’t greater than his master!’ So since they persecuted me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to me, they would listen to you! The people of the world will persecute you because you belong to me, for they don’t know God who sent me.” John 15:18-21 (TLB)
The events and activities of this world are not designed to favour your faith walk.
They are skillfully and subtly designed to oppose, crush and cripple your faith in Christ. The systems of this world were structured by men, to redirect your desire, distract your focus, impair your emotions, thoughts and conviction in Christ. And many fellow saints have become victims of the strategy of the systems of this world.Many make excuses in their service to God and become dull. Instead of serving or laboring with much enthusiasm and steadfastness, they become complacent and make the pursuit of their own interest their focus. Don’t be like them.Don’t be a slave to this world.Many are being used by their institutions as slaves and they waste their call on perishable things. We are to work but not to be wasted by the world.Through the building up of the Word of Grace, you become impregnable and immunized to the strategies of this world. Beloved, as long as you are in Christ and have set your focus to intensively serve His course, you will  face opposition and tribulation.But tribulation should not break you.
You are designed and built by Christ, to glory in Tribulation.
“By whom (Jesus Christ) also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;(Romans 5:2-3 KJV emphasis added)  Greek word used for Tribulation in this verse is Thlipsis, which means a pressing or pressing together pressure, oppression, affliction, distress. To be afflicted or face tribulation, or to be oppressed or distressed is to be pressed.However, when you are pressed what issues out is your content.
When you are pressured the divine virtues within, must issue out.
God has filled you with Himself. Hence, when you are pressed, the best of God will come out of you. Get your inward substances well built, refuse to be broken no matter the afflictions that come your way. The word of His Grace builds us up. (Acts 20:32).It dispelled fear. Jesus said, ” I have told you these things, so that in Me you may have [perfect] peace and confidence. In the world you have tribulation and trials and distress and frustration; but be of good cheer [take courage; be confident, certain, undaunted]! For I have overcome the world. [I have deprived it of power to harm you and have conquered it for you.]” (John 16:33 AMPC) Be undaunted! Be a confident! Be certain! Have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. They may push you, press you together yet they are deprived of the power to harm you. Maintain an undisturbed composure. Through the knowledge of Christ, take on courage.  Be toughened, develop hard skin through building up of the Word.
To do big things for God, you must have tough skin.
Be God-occupied. Don’t yield to challenges. Nothing has the capacity to work against you.  Anything that comes in contact with you must work for your good. You were designed that way. You were not designed to be broken. Don’t coil in at the sight of challenges, accusations, mockery and afflictions.Take advantage of the situations and challenges to resound the goodness of the Lord. Nothing should stop you from standing in the Truth, which is Christ. Don’t think the people of the world are ahead of you. Remember the adversary is the father of lies. He is always playing catch up.
Focus on the mandate the Lord has entrusted to you.
Even if the whole world comes against you, YOU ARE BIGGER THAN THE WORLD. “But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world.” 1 John 4:4 REMAIN IMMOVABLE, UNABASHED AND DEADLY COMMITTED TO THE VISION OF THE LORD!!! DIG DEEPER(Romans 15:13; 1 Corinthians 16:10; Galatians 6:9; Philippians 2:30; Proverbs 21:21; Colossians 2:7; Psalm 43; John 16:33; 2 Corinthians 4:8-17; Romans 8:31-39) WE PRAY– We pray, that in the midst of persecution, distress and challenge “the God of hope fill all the saints with all joy and peace as we trust in Him, so that we shall overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. – We pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people, (for not everyone has faith But the Lord is faithful) and the Lord should strengthen us and protect us from the evil one. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 24-272 YEARS PLANJob 15-16DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am undaunted and confident.- I have this knowing that, Our Lord has overcome the world. Therefore I have overcome the world. - I may be push and pressed together yet they are deprived of the power to harm me. - I maintain an undisturbed composure. - Through the knowledge of Christ, I take on courage. - I am toughened and I have hard skin through the building up of the Word and prayer. - I do big things for God. -I am God-occupied. - I don’t yield to challenges. - Nothing has the capacity to work against me. - Anything that comes in contact with me must work for my good. Ohh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1154 - LOVE AND FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency To live effectively as children of light and not as people of darkness, stay alert and clearheaded by placing the breastplate of faith and love over your heart, and a helmet of the hope of salvation over your thoughts. Hallelujah! Author Sunday, 22nd March, 2026 FAITH AND LOVE “But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.” 1 Thessalonians 5:8 (KJV)Paul the apostle, mentioned three spiritual verities but just two armor.Faith and love function as breastplate for the believer, as they walk in the light. Whiles the hope of salvation achieves the same result for the believer as helmet does for a good soldier.Remember, as believers we are in combat against the deceptive schemes of the adversary. The adversary’s deception gets more intense as the coming of the Lord is near.The coming of the Lord is inevitable, and His coming is to be a glorious news for every believer.
We fight from the place of victory enforcing what the Lord has accomplished for us.
To have clear purpose of the armour as mentioned in 1 Thessalonians 5, take note of Paul’s statement:“For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night. But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation. For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ” 1 Thessalonians 5:7-9 (KJV)He admonished that we put on the armour for God has not appointed us to wrath. These armor brings you into the certainty of heart that God didn’t bring you into salvation and then later turn to condemn you.The deception of the adversary is to make you doubt your salvation and relationship with the Lord so that you will live in fear and doubt.
The breastplate of love and faith protects your heart from fear, anxiety and sorrow.
The heart here is not essentially the physcial organ which pumps blood. The heart consist of the innermost or core part of your being.Jesus calls the heart a field (Luke 8:15). Whatever God wants to produce in your life must first be planted in your heart. Your innermost being is the place where your entire being is nurtured. The Newness of life in Christ germinates from your heart.“Guard your heart more than anything else, because the source of your life flows from it.” Proverbs 4:23 (GOD’S WORD® Translation)You cannot use a physcial metal as was used in the medieval times to guard your innermost (heart). Neither can a modern day military vest save your heart from the deceptive projectiles of the adversary.
It will take a spiritual virtue to preserve the heart of the believer.
It’s called the breastplate of faith and love. In Paul’s epistle to the Ephesians, he mentioned, the breastplate of righteousness. The breastplate of righteousness is not different from the breastplate of faith and love. They are the same. You received righteousness through the demonstration of God’s love and supply of faith in your heart.You are made righteous by faith in Christ Jesus (Romans 3:22). And the righteousness of God in Christ which we have received is a demonstration of God’s love towards us.
You must have the persuasion that God has fully made you righteous in Christ. 
And this persuasion or consciousness gives you the assurance that you shall not come under any wrath at the coming of the Lord.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 13:12; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17; Isaiah 61:10) WE PRAYWe pray that our minds will be protected by the hope of salvation in Christ and our hearts by the faith and love which we have received in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Samuel 28-312 YEARS PLANJob 17-18DECLARE THESE WORDS:– By the faith and love which I have received in Christ, my heart is protected from fear, anxiety and sorrow. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1155 - LIVE FROM VICTORY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Do not be deceived, uphold God, His Word and the Church, so that you can rightly walk in Truth. SELAH! Author Monday, 23rd, March 2026 LIVE FROM VICTORY“For you were included in the death of Christ and have died with him to the religious system and powers of this world. Don’t retreat back to being bullied by the standards and opinions of religion” Colossians 2:20 (TPT)The death and resurrection of Jesus stripped away from the adversary and his cohorts every power and authority or legal right to accuse or condemn you.
The adversary has no legal right to condemn you.
Now, since he has no right to accuse you, he still tries to find a voice through the religious standards and rules kept by men to bully you.You have to make a personal decision to walk in the victory of Christ. Don’t subject the glorious life you have in Christ to religious opinions.The victory of Jesus over the powers and principalities of darkness is your victory as well.The death of Jesus was and is a corporate death. He didn’t die for Himself, He died for all men.As many that received Jesus are partakers of His death. When you receive Christ, you become part of Him through baptism in the Spirit.“But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name” John 1:12 (KJV)“For by one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free—and have all been made to drink into one Spirit.” 1 Corinthians 12:13 (NKJV)“For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus. For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ” Galatians 3:26-27 (KJV)We can see from the above verses that, all who believe in Christ are made the sons of God through faith, And all who have received Christ are baptized into Christ through the Spirit.
As you are baptized into Christ, you are also partakers of His death and resurrection.
So though Jesus died for you, He also died with you. You were included in the death of Christ and have died with him to the religious system and powers of this world.
Legally, the conquest of Jesus is your conquest because you died with Him.
It is not only Christ Jesus who has defeated the adversary and also subdued the systems of the world. You have also defeated the adversary and cannot be a slave to the religious systems of this world.Live constantly in the victory of Christ. Don’t allow yourself to be bullied by religious standards, rituals, and myths.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Romans 13:12; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Peter 1:13; 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17; Isaiah 61:10) WE PRAY We pray that our minds will be protected by the hope of salvation in Christ and our hearts by the faith and love which we have received in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 1-32 YEARS PLANJob 19DECLARE THESE WORDS:– By the faith and love which I have received in Christ, my heart is protected from fear, anxiety and sorrow. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – The coming of the Lord does not create fear and chaos in my heart, rather joy and gladness. – By the strength of the Spirit, I am enabled daily to live in true sobriety. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1156 - DON’T DO THE ORDINARY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The spirit of disobedience doesn’t have any authority over you. You are an obedient child of God and have the capacity to respond rightly to the Lord’s instructions. Selah. Author Tuesday, 24th March, 2026DON’T DO THE ORDINARY“Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go”Joshua 1:9 (NKJV) Whatever God tells you to do will take Faith. It is by faith we live and walk with God. Faith is our reality.
The things we need to do by faith will always take faith for us to do them.
Anything that has to bring glory to God must be done in faith. (It is impossible to please God without faith). Faith is an unflinching confidence in who God is and what He has said. It is knowing without any tittle of doubt that the Lord is with you and He will help you achieve what He has sent you to do. Faith is audacious in its dealing. When you act in faith courage is seen. This is why you must have the consciousness of the presence of the Lord in your life.And be inoculated with the word of God. God commanded Joshua to be strong and courageous. For that is an essential element to demonstrate greatness.
Serving others is greatness, however, it takes great faith and courage to serve your generation.
A person called to fulfill greatness and to serve His generation can live as a wuss. Look at Gideon, a mighty man of valour, yet saw himself as the least in his father’s house and of the poorest or weakest family in Manasseh. He had the potential to save the nation of Israel from the Midianites, but felt enervated. Maybe you are reading this and feels you don’t have what it takes to do great things. When you consider your family history, your experiences through school and even in your community you can’t do anything great for the Lord. Beloved, the LORD SEES YOU AS A MIGHTY MAN!!! God specialises in doing the unimaginable. Faith thrives in impossible situations. That is God.
He will always use what it seem depleted to reveal His glory.
He used, a young man who is least in his family and from the weakest clan to bring great victory in Israel. He made mighty men out of men that were distresses, indebted, and discontented (1Samuel 22:2). Why must God use young 17 years old David, with no military experience to defeat Goliath with just a sling and stone (1 Samuel 17:50-53). To feed five thousand people, He used a little boys lunch pack of five bread and two fishes. This is audacity!!!
God doesn’t choose the easy paths, He creates greatness out of what seem impossible.
To exercise the audacity of faith, learn to be with the Lord. “Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus.”Acts 4:13 (ESV) You cannot maintain consistent fellowship with the Lord Jesus and remain a coward. You will not just serve the Lord and show how you love him during church meetings and in your room. You will look for places to show forth His glory and power.
Take a daring step, knowing that the Lord is with you.
Until you take a step to do something great you will not see the mighty hand of the Lord. God is with you, dare to do the extraordinary! Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 4:29,31; Acts 9:27; Joshua 1:7-9; Deuteronomy 1:21; Genesis 28:15) WE PRAYLord, I receive more grace that my hands will be strengthened with the Spirit of boldness, that I may do valiantly through you. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 4-62 YEARS PLANJob 20DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take daring steps towards God’s Kingdom work. – I am strong and courageous. – I remain conscious of the reality that God is with me, therefore I dare to do the extraordinary. – I live above this world. – I do the unimaginable. – I don’t consider the size of the assignment or challenge because God is with me. – I do the extraordinary. – I am audacious. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1157 - HE IS ETERNALLY DISARMED AND POWERLESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When the satisfaction of your personal needs becomes your goal and cravings, Christ will not be at the center of your heart. SELAH! Author Wednesday, 25th, March 2026 HE IS ETERNALLY DISARMED AND POWERLESS “Having disarmed principalities and powers, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them in it.” Colossians 2:15 (NKJV)The weapons of warfare given to us by the Lord, or the whole armor of God are not geared towards attaining victory.They are for the enforcement and enjoyment of the victory we have received in Christ Jesus.
Beloved in Christ, be established in this certainty that the Lord has made you more than a conqueror.
“Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.” Romans 8:37 (KJV).You are not now trying to conquer the adversary; the Lord conquered for you so that you will be overwhelmed by His conquest.And this wasn’t as though the adversary was directly in a fight against the Lord. He can’t stand a chance.The adversary has always used the legalistic rules, the wrong deeds or sins and the imperfection of man to oppress and keep man under condemnation.But the Lord through His death on the cross and His resurrection, disarmed the adversary completely of any legal document he used against man.“He canceled out every legal violation we had on our record and the old arrest warrant that stood to indict us. He erased it all—our sins, our stained soul—he deleted it all and they cannot be retrieved! Everything we once were in Adam has been placed onto his cross and nailed permanently there as a public display of cancellation. Then Jesus made a public spectacle of all the powers and principalities of darkness, stripping away from them every weapon and all their spiritual authority and power to accuse us. And by the power of the cross, Jesus led them around as prisoners in a procession of triumph. He was not their prisoner; they were his!” Colossians 2:14-15 (TPT)The adversary has no legal right to accuse or condemn you. Don’t give space for any of his deceptive schemes. He is eternally disarmed and powerless.
He has no power or authority to condemn and to accuse you.
Remain conscious of the triumph of our Lord Jesus through the cross.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(John 12:32; John 19:30; Romans 8:1,31-39; 2 Corinthians 2:14; Colossians 2:10) WE PRAYWe pray that as Christ has conquered and made us victorious, we shall experience and celebrate the triumph of the Lord in all that we do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 7-92 YEARS PLANJob 21DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am more than a conqueror. – The adversary has no power or authority to condemn and accuse me. – I am seated far all principalities and powers in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus. – I cannot be defeated. – I remain conscious of the triumph of our Lord Jesus through the cross. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1158 - GO THE EXTRA MILE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Irrespective of what you think of yourself or your history, the Lord knows you by name precious one. You matter to Him and He values you. SELAH! Author Thursday, 26th March, 2026 GO THE EXTRA MILE“…Yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants. He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD’s good plan will prosper in his hands.“ Isaiah 53:10 (NLT)
God has great plans for His Kingdom, mankind, you, and all His creation.
God’s great intention or plan is that His glory will be expressed in fullness. To achieve this, God has ordained you to be the conduit for fulfilling His glorious plan. As a conduit or a steward of God’s great plan, you can determine the extent to which the work of God will be done. The things you desire to do were put in your heart by God. “For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases Him” Philippians 2:13 (NLT) Yours is to nurture the Lord’s desire in your heart; through prayer, meditation and the steps you take.
The more you take steps to act out God’s desire in your heart, the greater it becomes. 
God sees the need to entrust more to you, as you become faithful with the little He entrusts to you. The Lord enables you to do more; however, when you are not determined to work out what the Lord has purposed in your heart, you may fail. “The sons of Ephraim were armed as archers and carrying bows, Yet they turned back in the day of battle.” Psalm 78:9 (Amplified).These sons of Ephraim were armed and well equipped, yet turned back in the day of battle. You can be resourced and still turn away from the pursuit of purpose.
Make it your determination that the purpose and plan of the Lord shall prosper in your hands.
This was what the Prophet Isaiah declared concerning Jesus; “…He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD ’s good plan will prosper in his hands.” Isaiah 53:10 (NLT).
Beloved, God has called you for this reason; that His purpose and good plan will prosper in your hands.
Don’t settle for less; go for the ultimate plan of God. You are enabled for this purpose. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 30:12; 1 Corinthians 12:6; I Corinthians 15:10; Ephesians 1:5) WE PRAYThat we will faithfully work on that which the Lord has entrusted to us for the good plan of the Lord to prosper in our hands. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 10-122 YEARS PLANJob 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling. – I don’t give excuses, I get the job done. – Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on. – I don’t stop halfway, I press on. – I go the extra mile. – I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord. – I do the extraordinary. – I am a Champion. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1159 - BE ARMED IN THIS CONSCIOUSNESS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 27th, March 2026  BE ARMED IN THIS CONSCIOUSNESS “Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth,and having on the breastplate of righteousness“Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)What kind of damage do you think will be caused when an arrow is shot directly at a soldier’s chest or rib area?Such an attack may lead to death or serious injury. This is why the soldier’s breastplate is essential.
The breastplate is a defensive armor.
We are in a warfare against principalities and evil rulers of darkness; and at every given time, these evil forces would want to attack you in areas where they will cause you a lot of damage.
The adversary is interested in destroying the core of your being.
And this is why apart from the belt of truth you also need the breastplate of righteousness.A good soldier armed and ready for battle will put on his breastplate.The breastplate is an armor gear which covers the soldier from the neck to the waist. It also covers both the front and the back of a soldier.
The breastplate protects the vital areas of a soldier’s body, like the heart, lungs etc.
You have to understand that this warfare is not physical but spiritual. Though the adversary may afflict a person’s physical body with sicknesses and diseases, such afflictions or infirmities begin in the spirit.
It is not a fight against flesh and blood, but unseen forces.
The list of God’s armor we are looking into is not physical armor. This is a spiritual armor given to us by the Lord.This is not an armor created by believers. It is the Lord who has provided us with this armor. Our role is to put it on intentionally.
This warfare mainly takes place in the spirit and the soul.
The wiles and schemes of the devil are deceptive thoughts.The belt of truth girds your mind against every deceptive thought of the devil against the reality and revelation of Christ.
The breastplate of righteousness also defends your heart against every arrow of condemnation.
One of the strong deceptive arrows of the adversary is condemnation. Condemnation is the root of most believers’ challenges.Condemnation makes you walk in fear. It makes you feel undeserving and worthless. Condemnation makes you lose confidence to commune with the Lord.Most believers are not able to exercise the authority given to them in Christ because of condemnation and guilt.Most believers are conscious of their sins or wrongs and imperfections.When you commune with most believers, and ask them about their righteousness, they will boldly tell you, “I am not righteous, no man is righteous and no man can be righteous”.
The truth is that no man can be righteous by his or her efforts. Therefore Jesus legally gave us His righteousness.
The righteousness which we have in Christ is not our self-made righteousness. The righteousness which we have in Christ is the righteousness of God.“For God made the only one who did not know sin to become sin for us, so that we who did not know righteousness might become the righteousness of God through our union with him.” 2 Corinthians 5:21 (TPT)
You are not made righteous by your own works or efforts. You are made righteous in Christ through your union with Christ.
To put on the breastplate of righteousness is not to put on your righteousness. Remember, the armor is called the armor of God.“Put on God’s complete set of armor provided for us…” Ephesians 6:11 (TPT).
The armor is not your self-generated armor. The breastplate of righteousness is the righteousness of God.
When the adversary comes at you with thoughts of condemnation and guilt, refuse to see your weakness and wrongs. Instead, acknowledge how Christ has made you the righteousness of God in Him through His obedience.To put on the breastplate of righteousness is to walk daily in the consciousness of how Christ has made you righteous through your union with Him.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Isaiah 59:12-17; Jeremiah 23:6; 1 Corinthians 1:30 ) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall always behold and walk in the consciousness of our righteousness in Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Samuel 13-152 YEARS PLANJob 23DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1163 - …WITH THE PREPARATION OF GOSPEL OF PEACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste. Author Tuesday 31st, March 2026 …WITH THE PREPARATION OF THE GOSPEL OF PEACE “And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace”Ephesians 6:15The above verse reveals one of the two items in the armor which focuses on the readiness of a soldier.1. The Belt of Truth2. Shoding your feet.However, to go into the readiness of a soldier, we have to look at the instrument involved, which is the Gospel of Peace.In the armor there is:The belt of Truth — it focuses on the Word of God, which is the Logos of God. The Logos of God is the expression of God’s thought. It is both the generic sense of the written and spoken word of God. It is the Word of God given to us as Truth.The Gospel of Peace may also be seen as the Word of God or the Word of Truth. However, there is a precise view of the Word Paul the apostle is referring to in this chapter.The Gospel of Peace is not necessarily pointing to the Word of God as Truth.
The Gospel of Peace unveils the achievement of the Word of Truth. It is about what Truth has accomplished.
The Gospel of Peace means the Goodnews of Peace. The Goodnews of Peace is not the same as the peace which men seem to find in this world. The true peace which men long for cannot be found in the world. The true peace which men seek can only be found in Christ and as Christ.Jesus came to bring us Peace.
The Peace which we received in Christ is Christ Himself.
“For He Himself is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of separation.” Ephesians 2:14 (NKJV)This peace transcends life without opposition. The peace which we have in Christ and as Christ is the reality of our oneness with God. It is Christ in us as LIFE.This Goodnews says, there is no enmity with God. There is no distance nor is there a dividing wall between us and God. There are no divided classes of people in God. We have all been brought into oneness with God as one family.This is the glorious news you must carry to the nations of the world.
To get your feet shod with the preparation of the Gospel of peace, includes your going forth with the testimony of our oneness with God in Christ.
This is how you also enforce your victory in Christ amidst the opposition or deceptive schemes of the rulers of darkness.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20; Isaiah 52:7; Romans 10:15; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15; Psalm 68:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow more and more in the consciousness of our Peace in Christ, which is the access and Oneness of fellowship we have in and with God through Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Kings 3-52 YEARS PLANJob 28DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow daily in the consciousness of my peace in Christ. – Christ is my peace. – I have access and oneness of fellowship in and with God through Christ. – I carry this glorious news of the oneness with God in Christ to my world. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1164 - IT IS NOT ACCORDING TO YOUR WORKS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You are no longer under the influence of sin, because the power of His resurrection has produced the righteousness of God in Christ in you. Live every day of your life with the consciousness that you are a new man. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 1st, April 2026 IT IS NOT ACCORDING TO YOUR WORKS“Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness“Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)
To put on the breastplate of righteousness is to put on the Lord Jesus who is your righteousness.
The Lord sustained Himself by His own righteousness. However, you cannot sustain yourself against the arrow of condemnation of the adversary with yourself-righteousness.If many had been taught this, they wouldn’t have committed suicide.Many have given up the call of God upon their lives because they think they are not worthy or righteous.They judged themselves by their weaknesses and mistakes. They also couldn’t stand the legalistic fingers pointing at them.
When you know you are sustained by the righteousness of Jesus and not by your self-righteousness, you will rise to set the record straight, live above condemnation and not become a slave to any addiction.
No matter the awareness you have of Christ’s righteousness in you, when you remain a slave to sin, then you are not conscious of the righteousness of God in you.You have to live conscious of Christ as your righteousness. That is how you put on the breastplate of righteousness.
The breastplate of righteousness is dependent on the obedience of Christ not your deeds.
No man’s works or deeds will make him or her righteous.“We are all infected and impure with sin. When we display our righteous deeds, they are nothing but filthy rags. Like autumn leaves, we wither and fall, and our sins sweep us away like the wind” Isaiah 64:6 (NLT)The righteous deeds of man without Christ’s righteousness are as filthy rags or polluted garments. It is not reliable and dependent enough for the attacks of the adversary.The righteousness which you have in Christ is a gift.“For if, because of one man’s trespass, death reigned through that one man, much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the free gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man Jesus Christ.”Romans 5:17 (ESV)As I previously mentioned, when you received the Lord unto salvation, you didn’t only receive Him as life. You also received Him as your righteousness. Your righteousness is no longer your deeds. Your righteousness is a person and He is Jesus.“You are partners with Christ Jesus because of God. Jesus has become our wisdom sent from God, our righteousness, our holiness, and our ransom from sin.” 1 Corinthians 1:30 (God’s Word Translation)The Lord Himself has been given to you who believe in Him as your righteousness.This is the fulfilment of the prophetic word:“And this will be his name: ‘The LORD Is Our Righteousness.’ In that day Judah will be saved, and Israel will live in safety” Jeremiah 23:6 (NLT)
The righteousness of God in you is not first what you do but who Christ is, what He has done and who He is in you.
This is not according to your works, this is the Lord giving Himself to you as a gift.Until you see your righteousness as a gift because you’ve received Christ, you will be depending on your self-efforts.If your works and self-efforts are the determinant of your righteousness, then they are counted as debt. (Romans 4:4).
You don’t live right to become righteous; you live right because you have been made the righteousness of God in Christ.
This consciousness is your breastplate!Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Jeremiah 33:16; Jeremiah 23:5; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; Romans 8:1) WE PRAYWe pray that our boast of righteousness will only be who the LORD IS TO US AND IN US. Our boast and confidence will not be our deeds. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Kings 6-82 YEARS PLANJob 29DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ.– I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. – I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1165 - YOUR DEFENSE AGAINST GUILT AND CONDEMNATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you see the LORD as your Shepherd, you have MORE THAN ENOUGH; because the LORD is YOUR SUPER IMMEASURABLE, LIMITLESS, ABUNDANCE of SUPPLY. SELAH! Author Thursday, 2nd April 2026YOUR DEFENSE AGAINST GUILT AND CONDEMNATION “Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness” Ephesians 6:14 (KJV)To put on the breastplate of righteousness is essential in your daily living as a believer in Christ.
The breastplate of righteousness defends you against one of the most deadly arrows or weapons of the devil — which is Condemnation.
Even our Lord, who is the Commander in Chief of His great army, adorned Himself with the breastplate of righteousness.This was how He was qualified to bring salvation to us.Did the adversary attempt to find faults or wrongdoings in Christ Jesus?Certainly!Through the Jewish leaders, the adversary always tried to ensnare our Lord Jesus. Through their questions, misinterpretation or misrepresentation of the Mosaic laws, and legalistic demands.Even when they did not find fault with Him after His arrest, they took Him to Herod Antipas and even Pontius Pilate (the governor of the Roman province of Judea). And none of these authorities found fault with and in Jesus.For the Lord to bring Salvation to us, He must be perfectly righteous and holy.
It was by the perfection of His righteousness that they found no sin or guilt in Him.
The Prophet Isaiah spoke of it:“For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities: rebellion and treachery against the Lord, turning our backs on our God, inciting revolt and oppression, uttering lies our hearts have conceived. So justice is driven back, and righteousness stands at a distance; truth has stumbled in the streets, honesty cannot enter. Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The Lord looked and was displeased that there was no justice.” Isaiah 59:12-15 (NKJV)Now from verses 12 to 15, we see the Prophet describing the state of those who have not received the salvation of the Lord. This prophecy doesn’t only point to the situation in Israel but extensively describes the state of man without Christ.The offenses of man without Christ are many and sin testified against men.There was a need for a solution; and because there was no one qualified to intervene, the Lord’s own arm (Christ Jesus) had to achieve the Salvation plan.“He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene so his own arm achieved salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him. He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak” Isaiah 59: 16 – 17All through the trial of Jesus, He was sustained by His own righteousness. And this was because He put on His righteousness as His breastplate.In your daily walk, the adversary seeks ways to attack you with guilt and condemnation. Yours is to continually stand in the confidence of the righteousness of Jesus.
Jesus was sustained by His righteousness. Your self-righteousness cannot sustain you.
When you received the Lord unto salvation, you didn’t only receive Him as life. You also received Him as your righteousness. Your righteousness is no longer your deeds.
Your righteousness is a person and He is Jesus.
“You are partners with Christ Jesus because of God. Jesus has become our wisdom sent from God, our righteousness, our holiness, and our ransom from sin.” 1 Corinthians 1:30 (God’s Word Translation)The Lord Himself has been given to us who believe in Him as our righteousness. To put on the Lord’s breastplate of righteousness is to walk in the consciousness of Christ as your righteousness.
Stand in the consciousness of the righteousness of Christ.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:10-18; Jeremiah 23:6; Jeremiah 23:5; Romans 3:21-27; Romans 5:21; Romans 8:1) WE PRAYWe pray our minds will not drift away from the Lord who is our righteousness to our self-righteousness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Kings 9-112 YEARS PLANJob 30DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. – I am justified by the finished work of Christ. – My confidence and boast are not in my self-effort but in the finished work of Christ. – I am justified by faith. – I have no sense of guilt and condemnation, I am justified. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1171 - DON’T FALL FOR IT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 8th May 2026 DON’T FALL FOR IT“Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Ephesians 6:16 (KJV) The adversary takes delight in the ignorance of the saints. Ignorance is basically the lack of knowledge.And God’s word is clear on this:“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge…” (Hosea 4:6)
As many who lack the true knowledge of God, His character and the things He has achieved for us in Christ, can easily become victims of the devices of the enemy.
This is why you must take a stand putting on the whole armor of God.“so that we would not be exploited by the adversary, Satan, for we know his clever schemes.“ (2 Corinthians 2:11)The schemes of the adversary are his weapons designed to shipwreck the faith of the saints, to distract them from their communion with the Lord and to cause them to live as mere men and not according to the purpose of God.“so that we would not be exploited by the adversary, Satan, for we know his clever schemes.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (TPT)You must have the intelligence and understanding of how the enemy operates. This will guide and guard you from living in continuous defeat. He will not relent from attempting to exploit you. He will always come at you till you believe he is more powerful, the victory of the Lord is not true and you are powerless.
Meanwhile, his goal is to use you as an instrument against the Lord and His purpose.
Don’t fall for it!The adversary will always aim at areas or points in your life where you are most vulnerable. The fiery darts of the enemy are poisonous and distractive.None of it is harmless.The Greek word for the “fiery darts” is belos. It is a specially made arrow with a tiny drilled hole, containing flammable fluids. When the arrows are projected, they seem harmless but upon impact on their target, they explode into raging flames; to burn their enemies.These flammable arrows may be subtle, such as bitterness, little offences, unforgiveness, displeasure, disappointment, genuine fears, lies, mistakes, failures, absence of testimonies, self-esteem, jealousy, etc.These may start through harmless situations or incidents, but when they are not intentionally or promptly and explosively extinguished, they will gradually creep into your heart and start by causing a systematic emotional breakdown. The attacks of the adversary are poisonous.But thank God for the shield of faith! With the shield of faith, “you shall be able” to quench the fiery darts.The word “able” is from the Greek word “dunamai” which means the might of power. Dunamai has its root in the word, “dunamis”; it means a dynamic ability to cause changes. It also denotes the explosion or explosiveness of power.With the SHIELD OF FAITH, you are empowered to explode.
The SHIELD OF FAITH speaks of your spiritual and mental disposition by the word of God, our formation or strategy, and our explosive attitude towards the fiery darts of the enemy.
The fiery darts are assaults of the enemy, and the shield of faith makes you fortified and impregnable.This is what the Prophet meant:No weapon formed or forged or fashioned against you shall hurt you, prosper or succeed. This is your heritage in the Lord. (Isaiah 54:17)
Be always alert with your shield of faith to defend yourself against the attacks of the enemy.
Selah.DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that no weapon of the enemy fashioned or rage against us, under any circumstance shall prosper.In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to become a victim of the devices of the enemy. – With the shield of faith, I extinguish any fiery dart of the adversary shot at me. – I am always alert with my shield of faith to defend myself against any attack of the enemy. – No weapon formed or fashioned against me under any circumstance prospers. – I live by faith. – I walk daily in the consciousness of faith. – I am a man of faith. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1172 - DON’T BE IN A HURRY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There are moments and situations where you may feel weak, discouraged, and even dull in faith. However, you can constantly and progressively build yourself up: PRAY IN THE SPIRIT! Author Thursday, 9th April, 2026 DON’T BE IN A HURRY“Now at this time Jesus went off to the mountain to pray, and He spent the whole night in prayer to God.” Luke 6:12 (Amplified)Whatever God has put in your heart to achieve will be done according to His own ability.Your human strength is insufficient for what God has called you to do.The Angel said to Mary, “For with God nothing is ever impossible and no word from God shall be without power or impossible of fulfillment.” Luke 1:37 (AMPC)The projects ahead of you which seem impossible, become possible when God is with you.
As a man in Christ, God is with you, however, you must intentionally be with God as well in all you do.
Make intentional decisions to pray and to minister unto the Lord.Though God loves you and wants to partner with you to achieve His dreams for you, He wouldn’t force His partnership on you. You have to intentionally engage the Lord.He may put desires in your heart to draw you close to Himself, and He will put subtle longings of fellowship into your heart.This is to lead you into times of fellowship with Him. And when you become prompt to respond and to be consistent with it, your inward capacity and abilities expand for big things.
Develop the habit of spending time with God patiently. Don’t rush out of the place of prayer and fellowship with the Spirit.
You can only have the best of each relationship when you are willing to invest time.Jesus our Lord, showed us the need for consistent communion with the Father.Jesus started His ministry by first staying in fellowship with the Father, for 40 days and 40 nights.What was He doing?Praying and communing with the Father.
Jesus didn’t start His ministry without first having a long session of communion with the Father.
Don’t leave things to chance, spend long hours of fellowship with the Spirit. He has the master plan for the year and each month. He knows the steps you have to take and the people you have to meet.He knows the resources you need to do what He has destined you to do. Stay long with Him.The vision of God was made clear and also intensified in the heart of Moses after he separated himself to be with the Lord for 40 days and 40 nights.When Moses returned He was soaked with a dimension of God’s glory to the extent that the skin of his face changed.“But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and whenever he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded, the sons of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone. So Moses would replace the veil over his face until he went in to speak with Him.” (Exo 34:34-35 NAS)
The more you stay long with God, the more you are immersed in His presence and His word shines in your heart.
It is great to have quality time with the Lord. However, to have a long quantity and quality of time with the Lord is the most treasured moment in your life.In this present age of speed, everyone is in haste. They want to get into prayer, blast in 5-minute tongues and expect to receive or download immeasurable eternal virtues.In a world of fast food, fast internet, video reels, shorts, recaps, quick rise to fame, highly fast vehicles, fast computers, and swift money transfer mediums, people have become more impatient.People easily get offended and displeased, when they are not seeing answers to prayers as fast as they want. They become agitated and tensed easily.Frowns at God and the spiritual principles, just as they frown and hit on their mobile devices when an app doesn’t open between a microsecond to 2 seconds.Everyone is interested in fast-charging cables for their batteries.Thus, to stay 5 hours or 16 hours in prayers and communion with the Lord, seems to be a waste of time to most people of this generation. Everyone seems to be in a hurry.People are in haste to please the world and not in haste to please the Father.Beloved, take your time, and patiently stay in communion with the Holy Spirit.This is how you can mount up high with wings as an Eagle. 
If you don’t want to faint in the journey of your destiny, learn to stay long in fellowship with the Lord.
Glory to God!DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29) WE PRAYWe pray to increase in patience to stay and enjoy divine virtues and verities in the Lord’s presence, as we commune with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Kings 10-122 YEARS PLANJob 38DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1173 - LEARN TO SAY “NO” TO NON-ESSENTIAL COMMITMENTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t give anyone room to underestimate the effectual workings of prayer. Don’t cry, don’t be anxious, don’t worry, don’t fret, ONLY PRAY! Author Friday, 10th April, 2026 LEARN TO SAY “NO” TO THE NON-ESSENTIALS “Mary has discovered the one thing most important by choosing to sit at my feet. She is undistracted, and I won’t take this privilege from her.”Luke 10:42 ( Amplified Bible)Whatever you can do for the Lord is in what He has given to you and His grace which He unceasingly supplies you.
The best thing that can ever happen to you is to make the most of the privilege to be at the Lord’s feet.
