This is the burden of this series.Are there believers who don’t see the value of being at the Lord’s feet?These are those who live in the exasperation of this world trying to catch up with the speed of postmodernism.  One may clap for someone working from 8am to 10pm (Monday to Friday) in two different international organizations with huge salaries, and be upset with one who makes time for the Lord on some days after work (at 5pm). People only think of making time for the Lord in personal prayers and also attend Church service to see a Pastor when they need a breakthrough or a miracle.These ones are easily led into falsehood and deception because they have not learnt to spend time to deepen their fellowship with Jesus.Mary genuinely understood the need to be with Him.
Nothing is more important than being at the feet of Jesus, and let nothing take that privilege from you.
Jesus saw Mary at His feet as the most important thing.In Martha’s world, it’s all about the work you do and how you are putting in all your self-effort to succeed. In Martha’s world activity comes first before intimacy.Mary was living with Martha, but first esteemed the Lord’s presence above Martha’s demands.Martha will later learn the effect of not taking advantage of the Lord’s presence.You find true peace, total well-being, rest and refreshment when you stay intimate with the Lord.It’s one thing to be loved by the Lord, it’s another thing to intentionally enjoy the Love of Jesus and to express it.To effectively live as Mary in a Martha’s world, you must prioritize the one thing that matters most, INTIMACY WITH THE LORD.Why wake up in a morning to rush out to work without giving focus to this one thing which builds you up?Until you become intentional about your intimacy with the Lord you cannot become consistent.Make your quiet time an important moment of your day. Set times in each day for quiet reflection or meditation on a scripture and prayer. 
Learn to say “no” to non-essential commitments.
Why attend a party when you have not been available to meditate on a scripture? Planning your schedules can prevent busyness from taking over your life.These will help you remain established amid the chaos.Here is the secret:“What delight comes to those who follow God’s ways! They won’t walk in step with the wicked, nor share the sinner’s way, nor be found sitting in the scorner’s seat. Their pleasure and passion is remaining true to the Word of “I Am,” meditating day and night in his true revelation of light. They will be standing firm like a flourishing tree planted by God’s design, deeply rooted by the brooks of bliss, bearing fruit in every season of their lives. They are never dry, never fainting, ever blessed, ever prosperous . “Psalm 1:1-3 (TPT)
Your faith level for manifestation is dependent on your intimacy with the Lord.
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Luke 10:38-42; Isaiah 26:3; Proverbs 3:5-6; Hebrews 12:1-2; Colossians 3:2) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall learn to esteem every moment with Jesus and shall exercise the wisdom to take advantage of the privilege to spend time with Him. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Kings 13-152 YEARS PLANJob 39DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is guided and set in my fellowship with the Lord. – I delight in staying long at the feet of Jesus. – I refuse to be persuaded and caught up into this postmodern chaos and demands. – I stay with the Lord. – I don’t undermine the privilege of staying at the feet of Jesus. Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1176 - THE ADVERSARY TAKES DELIGHT IN THIS…
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Monday, 13th, April, 2026 THE ADVERSARY TAKES DELIGHT IN THIS…“Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.”Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)There are things and situations the adversary uses as means for his demonic projectiles.For example, a person maltreats you and cruelly relates with you. He or she oppresses you and tortures you mentally, emotionally and even spiritually. This makes you vow that you will never forgive him or her. It even makes you bitter because of the pain you feel and sometimes wish he or she should suffer the same or worse throes.At this point, you should know the adversary has invaded your emotions with his fiery venom.When you come to the point where you strongly crave the destruction of other lives irrespective of their crime and offence, you should know you have become a guest on the table of the devil.
The adversary takes delight in your pain, offences, bitterness, and anger.
When someone hurts you, you may hold a grudge but deal with the situation quickly. It may grow into bitterness, and bitterness is a poison.Bitterness doesn’t only affect those who hurt you. Bitterness first destroys you and those around you.“Another dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good.” (Job 21:25)
Bitterness gives you a reason to attack God.
One can be so bitter and even blame God, saying, “If God loves me so much, why did He watch me become a victim or go through that situation? Why didn’t He protect me?”When you ask such questions, the devil dances to his “bingo” tune.I am not asking you to just blame the devil for your pain. All I want you to know is, the devil will take advantage or exploit the situation to collapse your defenses and fully crush you. Don’t be like Job, who became bitter towards God (Job 10:1,3)
Fight bitterness with the word of God.
Don’t give place to bitterness.Sometimes when the adversary wants bitterness to thrive, he isolates you from the Church and your relationship with the Lord.Let me tell you:
Don’t allow anything or anyone who did not die for you on the cross, to separate you from the Lord who died for you.
Don’t allow the evil, people do to you to change you!This world is an evil world, the only refuge is the Lord Jesus. Some people become the means and instruments for which the devil uses to creep into the Church to attack the faith of innocent ones. Don’t allow such to win in the Church.
Stand your ground together with the faithful saints and let truth prevail over evil.
SHIELD UP!Give no place to bitterness.Don’t be quickly or easily provoked or angered. Anger is in the bosom of fools (Ecclesiastes 7:9), and you are not one of them.Don’t brood or continuously meditate on your pain; it will rather fuel it. Don’t keep talking to yourself or others about the pain. Remember, “repetition is the law of deep and lasting impression”.See the Wisdom here: “Whoever covers an offence seeks love, but he who repeats a matter separates close friends.” (Proverbs 17:9)Talk about the solutions, talk and focus on the Love of God towards you.“Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don’t yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ” Ephesians 4:31-32 (Contemporary English Version)
Rehearse the virtue of being gracious to others!
This is how you SHIELD UP against the blazing arrow of bitterness.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 14:10; Proverbs 19:11; Matthew 18:33; Colossians 3:8,13; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11) WE PRAY We pray that the word of God and the love of God shall saturate our hearts and minds to flush out every form of bitterness within us.In the Merciful name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Kings 24-251 Chronicles 12 YEARS PLANPsalms 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to hold on to offences and bitterness. – I demonstrate the love of God towards all men in all things. – Nothing can offend me. – The love of God gains full expression through me by the day – I am full of love. – The strength of the self is broken because I walk in the fullness of the love of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1177 - STAND WITH THE SAINTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Beloved, you are called by the Lord into His greatness. Think greatness and take great steps. Whatever the Lord tells you to do is great! Author Tuesday, 14th April 2026 STAND WITH THE SAINTS “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)During ancient times, military gears contributed to battle strategies. New types of military gears were made to suit the strategy for a specific battle. There were times when new strategies or tactics were mapped during a battle, incorporating the number of soldiers, the landscape (the hills or mountains, the valleys, the water bodies, rocks and type of soil) the weather conditions, and even the military strength or strategies of the enemy.They don’t go to war without military tactics or strategies. The military formations are carefully chosen by the military leaders.The Lord inspired Paul the apostle, to write about the believers’ warfare and the armor pieces to use. These armor pieces also unveil the warfare tactics or strategies the Lord has given to his army.
The armor pieces of the Lord were not given to believers for fashion but for function.
Let me reemphasis this:We are at war with darkness over the salvation of souls and the continuous exercising of our victory in Christ.The day you stop thinking, seeing and living as a soldier of the Lord is the day you expose yourself to the attacks of the enemy.Live vigilantly as a soldier of Christ. Take up the whole armor of God. This means don’t leave any armor behind.The Shield of Faith is an armor piece which has a direct contribution to the battle strategy the Lord has given us.Paul the apostle used the imagery of a Roman soldier and army to explain the set-up and the tactics of the Lord’s army.During antiquity, the Greeks and Romans did not emphasize the strength of an individual soldier but won battles through strategic formations.The Greeks had the phalanx shield formation, while the Romans also introduced the Testudo shield formation. Both shield formations were defensive tactics formation.The Romans used the Testudo formation (which is like the shape of a shelled turtle) to defend and protect themselves against enemy arrows or archer fire.In the Testudo formation, the Roman soldiers work and stand together as they create a defensive cover on all sides. The soldiers would come together in a tight group or compact rectangular shape. Those on the first line of the formation would hold their shields vertically in front of them. Those on the other sides of the formation would use their shield to also form a shield wall to cover the whole unit (on the left and right sides and even from behind depending on the anticipation of the attack).Even those inside the lines held their shields horizontally above to cover the spaces between their lines and most importantly their heads and that of those around them.No soldier leaves the shield wall or breaks the lines. This Testudo formation allowed the soldiers to defend each other and to work together to stand their ground against attacks of the enemy.They then march forward towards the enemy to attack amidst fiery darts thrown at them.For the Church, the Lord’s army to put on the shield of faith is crucial as we daily advance against the gates of Hades.As we see the Roman Testudo shield formation, we must jointly take up the shield of faith.We must function in the uniformity of love through the diversity of abilities we possess as individuals.
The unity of faith is not a slogan, but a functional strategy of the Lord for His Church.
Though every believer must learn to stand alone, we must not be isolated no matter the challenge which confronts us. You must be within the lines or the formation holding up your shield of faith depending on where you are positioned.
Your failure to hold on to your shield of faith will also affect the defensive strength or tactics of the Lord’s army.
The adversary takes delight when the brethren are not functioning in oneness of heart, mind and faith. This is because he can attack when we are individualistic.
God is an extraordinary strategist, and He has given us the shield of faith for our corporate function.
Take a stand with the saints in the word and prayer as we enforce our victory in Christ. Don’t stay out of Church, build strength in faith with the brethren to extinguish every fiery dart of the enemy.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:1-9; Philippians 2:1-5; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall stand together in the oneness of heart as conquerors in the faith of the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 2-42 YEARS PLANPsalms 3DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I stand together in the oneness of heart with the brethren as conquerors in the faith of the gospel. – I build strength in faith together with the brethren to extinguish every fiery dart of the enemy. – I don’t fail to hold on to my shield of faith. – I take a stand with the saints in the word and prayer as we enforce our victory in Christ. – I don’t isolate myself from the brethren no matter the challenge which confronts me. Oh thank you Lord Jesus for your victory.

title: EPISODE 1178 - THE SHIELD IS FOR DAILY ENGAGEMENT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 15th, April, 2026 THE SHEILD IS FOR DAILY ENGAGEMENT “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)Don’t take up your shield of faith once in a while or only when you sense an attack of the enemy.
Take up the shield of faith at all times.
The adversary is not backing out on launching his attacks at you.He doesn’t want to see you fulfill your mandate in the Lord.He doesn’t want you to be a blessing to your generation.He doesn’t want to see the shining forth of the light of God in you.He doesn’t want you to be a city set on a hill. He wants you to be a desolate city.Apart from launching fiery darts of bitterness, rage and unforgiveness, he also attacks you with arrows of doubts and feelings of discouragement or despair.
The devil chooses his weapons with the cunning skill of a war tactician.
He doesn’t rush his methods. He carefully and patiently chooses his spiritual arsenals.The adversary knows feelings are inevitable. How you feel what you feel is according to the culturing of your emotions. Your emotions are designed by God to help you to be prompt, to connect and to experience your world.It is to serve as gauges to help you interpret your experiences. Your emotions are not to serve as a guide but to provide reports of your environment so that you can willingly make inspired decisions.
Your emotions can be educated or nurtured to become instruments of faith.
Though faith is not a feeling, faith can nurture how you feel to help aid you act out God’s word. Your emotions or how you feel, can be according to the deep impressions in your heart. But faith is deeper, richer and stronger than your emotions. Faith is the deepest conviction, consciousness and courage in the word of God.
When your emotions are not nurtured to submit to Faith, they can become familiar spiritual projectiles of the devil.
This is when the feelings of guilt, desperation, anxiety, disappointments, discouragement or despair begin to thrive. These feelings are fearsome arrows against the fulfilment of your calling. These feelings are the mother of suicidal thoughts.
No discouraged heart can make a difference in this world.
Don’t take it lightly, when you feel discouraged at any time towards the good course of the Lord. No matter the reason you have to justify your discouragement, you have to intercept it with faith.True faith is your ability to remain resolute and firmly rooted in the revelation of God’s word, no matter the negative fleeting spark of emotions.No matter the darts the enemy will launch at you, know that they can be quenched. You have the shield of faith.
To take up the shield of faith is to exercise confidence in the word of God, rather than in the negative voices of discouragement.
The Psalmist in a discouraged state, did not hold back. He did not allow himself to be overwhelmed by his situation.He showed us how we have to shake ourselves out of discouraged moments.“Their wounding words pierce my heart over and over while they say, “Where is this God of yours?” So I say to my soul, “Don’t be discouraged. Don’t be disturbed. For I know my God will break through for me.” Then I’ll have plenty of reasons to praise him all over again. Yes, living before his face is my saving grace!” Psalm 42:10-11 (TPT)
When you live every day with your heart focused on the ability of God, you cannot live in discouragement.
Don’t look at yourself and what you are not able to do. Look more unto Jesus, see His grace and ability. The Lord didn’t start with you to leave you to fail.Sometimes, it will feel as though you have done so much and nothing seems to work. This sends waves of discouragement through your heart, and makes you chilled to the bone about the future.
Beloved, refuse to be weary and don’t stop being a blessing to others.
See this;“And don’t allow yourselves to be weary or disheartened in planting good seeds, for the season of reaping the wonderful harvest you’ve planted is coming! Take advantage of every opportunity to be a blessing to others, especially to our brothers and sisters in the family of faith!” Galatians 6:9-10 (TPT)Put on the Armor of God! Take up the shield of faith.BE ENCOURAGED BY THE LORD!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 1:3-4; 1 Peter 5:7; Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11) WE PRAY1. We pray that the Lord, who is the author of our faith, will replenish our joy, strengthen our faith, and keep us strong in Himself, amidst all the winds of discouragement.2. We pray that our hearts will remain firm in the word and draw waters of encouragement as we live daily to exercise our victory in Christ Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 5-72 YEARS PLANPsalms 4DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take up the shield of faith at all times. – My heart is focused daily on the ability of God. – I do not live in discouragement. – I am a blessing to others. – I have absolute confidence in the word of God.– I stay my mind and heart on the word of God.– I refuse to look away from the word.Thank you Lord Jesus!!!

title: EPISODE 1179 - SHIELD UP IN FAITH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 16th April, 2026 SHIELD UP IN FAITH“Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)Knowing about the devices of the enemy will put you in a position to appreciate the armor of God, and also help you take effective defensive and offensive positions.Most people acknowledge that bitterness is a poisonous attack of the enemy. But not all see discouragement as a poisonous attack of the enemy.Most assume that, to feel discouraged is a mere emotional condition. But to feel discouraged is the collapse of your convictions in God’s ability to help you.The adversary will use your failures, seeming stagnation, disappointments and spiteful utterances from people around you.
When you continue to allow people to talk down on the impact of God and His word in your life, they break your confidence and leave you discouraged.
“Their wounding words pierce my heart over and over while they say, “Where is this God of yours?” So I say to my soul, “Don’t be discouraged. Don’t be disturbed. For I know my God will break through for me.” Then I’ll have plenty of reasons to praise him all over again. Yes, living before his face is my saving grace!” Psalm 42:10-11 (TPT)There are words or certain utterances, which are designed to pierce and wound your heart. The goal is to leave you discouraged.But you see, the shield of faith is a product of the Word of God in your heart.
Don’t keep quiet to allow negative words to ruin your courage.
Boldly vocalize your faith in God.The Psalmist said in the above verse, “So I say to my soul”.Oh, glory!
In the face of discouraging situations, what do you say to your soul?
Do you amplify your discouragements or do you speak forth the word of God?When Goliath saw David, he despised him. He spoke denigrating words, just to discourage and destroy the defenses of David.But that didn’t work with David. David geared up his spiritual arsenals.“As the Philistine paced back and forth, his shield bearer in front of him, he noticed David. He took one look down on him and sneered—a mere boy, apple-cheeked and peach-fuzzed. The Philistine ridiculed David. “Am I a dog that you come after me with a stick?” And he cursed him by his gods. “Come on,” said the Philistine. “I’ll make roadkill of you for the buzzards. I’ll turn you into a tasty morsel for the field mice.” 1 Samuel 17:41-44 (Message)Was David moved by these threats of Goliath?Not at all.Was he discouraged by Goliath’s ridicules and curses?Not at all.David answered, “You come at me with sword and spear and battle-ax. I come at you in the name of God-of-the-Angel-Armies, the God of Israel’s troops, whom you curse and mock. This very day God is handing you over to me. I’m about to kill you, cut off your head, and serve up your body and the bodies of your Philistine buddies to the crows and coyotes. The whole earth will know that there’s an extraordinary God in Israel. And everyone gathered here will learn that God doesn’t save by means of sword or spear. The battle belongs to God—he’s handing you to us on a platter!” 1 Samuel 17:45-47 (Message)The battle between David and Goliath gives us a pictorial view of our spiritual warfare. Though Goliath was physically armored, he confronted David by invoking the presence of the Philistine gods (Or demonic entities).
It was a spiritual warfare.
David showed us how to win and exercise our victory.He vocalized his confidence in God. The boldness of David in God was all that he needed to exercise victory over Goliath, the Philistines and their gods.David knew the victory over Goliath and the armies of the Philistines was to show forth the extraordinary power and glory of God.David didn’t just demonstrate his confidence and courage in God through words. He demonstrated it through his actions. He never backed out at any time. Even when Goliath charged at him, he rather charged even more running at Goliath and the Philistines.
What a young man of faith!
He gave no chance for intimidation.“That roused the Philistine, and he started toward David. David took off from the front line, running toward the Philistine. David reached into his pocket for a stone, slung it, and hit the Philistine hard in the forehead, embedding the stone deeply. The Philistine crashed, facedown in the dirt. That’s how David beat the Philistine—with a sling and a stone. He hit him and killed him. No sword for David! Then David ran up to the Philistine and stood over him, pulled the giant’s sword from its sheath, and finished the job by cutting off his head. When the Philistines saw that their great champion was dead, they scattered, running for their lives.” 1 Samuel 17:48 – 51 (Message).
Beloved, learn to stay strong on the word. Give no place to the devil and his cohorts.
James said, “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you” (James 4:7).Just as David did, he didn’t confront Goliath in the might of the flesh, but in the name of the Lord.Submit your mind, thoughts, and emotions to the Lord. Act according to who God is and not by the threats of the devil.David was aware of the devices of Goliath, therefore he didn’t depend on the weapons of men but deployed the ability of the Lord almighty as his armor.
REFUSE TO BE DISCOURAGED AND AFRAID.
SHIELD UP IN FAITH!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:8-9; 1 Peter 5:7; Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:10-11; Isaiah 40:31) WE PRAY We pray that we shall continue to exercise confidence in the word of God and enforce our victory in Christ, no matter the confrontations of darkness. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 8-102 YEARS PLANPsalms 6DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I give no place to the devil and his cohorts. – My heart is focused daily on the ability of God. – I do not live in discouragement. – I refuse to be discouraged and afraid.  – I am full of faith. – I am a blessing to others. – I have absolute confidence in the word of God.– I stay my mind and heart on the word of God.– I refuse to look away from the word.Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1184 - CULTIVATE HUMILITY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 21st April, 2026 CULTIVATE HUMILITY  “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.”Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)We cannot discuss the fiery darts of the enemy, without the mention of pride.
Pride is one of the strong weapons of the enemy against your faith and fulfilment of purpose.
The adversary knows that “Pride goes before destruction” (Proverbs 16:18).Therefore to destroy any beautiful destiny, he sows and cultivates pride in the hearts of men.
A proud person is resisted and cannot increase in grace.
Pride makes a person disrespect, disdain and act arrogantly towards others. It makes one, overly esteem himself above others.Pride makes you self-centered and unruly. You would always want things to go your way and give no attention to anyone. Pride makes you do what you feel and despise wise counsel.Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. You cannot resist the devil when you are proud. To resist the devil, you must first humble yourself before the Lord. James said, “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you”(James 4:7).David didn’t confront Goliath in the might of the flesh or his strength and intelligence but in the name of the Lord.
Pride will not make you submit your mind, thoughts, and emotions to the Lord.
The adversary was the first in God’s universe to demonstrate pride. He began to exalt himself above the Lord. That was the cause of his fall.God has exalted His word, so when you begin to esteem your opinions above the word of God, you are already on the path of the devil. The end will surely be destruction.“for the day is coming when your proud looks will be brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted. On that day the Lord Almighty will move against the proud and haughty and bring them to the dust. All the tall cedars of Lebanon and all the mighty oaks of Bashan shall bend low, and all the high mountains and hills, and every high tower and wall, and all the proud ocean ships and trim harbor craft—all shall be crushed before the Lord that day. All the glory of mankind will bow low; the pride of men will lie in the dust, and the Lord alone will be exalted.” Isaiah 2:11-17 (TLB)
The adversary sets you up for failure and disgrace through pride. Intentionally deal with pride.
True faith towards God is humble. It takes humility to look away from your challenges and to exercise confidence in what God has said.“God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble.” Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you” (1Peter 5:5-7)It will take the attitude of humility to take up the shield of faith. Don’t trust in your intelligence above the knowledge of God’s word. 
Don’t be big-headed, be humble at all times.
SHIELD UP IN FAITH!DIG DEEPER(Micah 6:8; Isaiah 3:16-26; Colossians 3:12; 2 Chronicles 7:14; Luke 14:11; Proverbs 3:34) WE PRAY We pray that we shall be helped by the Holy Spirit to consciously walk in the humility of heart at all times and in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 25-272 YEARS PLANPsalms 13DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I submit my will, emotions, thoughts and body to the Lord. – The word of God directs my life. – There’s no place for pride in my heart. – By the help of the Holy Spirit, I walk in humble at all times in all things.Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1185 - ANYTHING GOD TELLS YOU TO DO IS GREAT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 22nd April, 2026 ANYTHING GOD TELLS YOU TO DO IS GREAT“Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.” 1 Chronicles 29:1 (KJV). Some saints in Christ esteem their education, job, and self-centered interests more than the assignment of the Lord. How do you see what the Lord tells you to do?
Anything God tells you to do is great!
The assignments of the Lord benefit generations.You have to see the Lord’s work with the eyes of your spirit and look into generations ahead. David the king said, “the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.” What makes the assignment great is who the work is for.
You don’t value or esteem what you do for man than what you do for the Lord.
Imagine being invited and tasked to represent the President of a country you esteem. You will see it as a great task.
Whatever the Lord tells you to do, is a representation of Him.
The tasks given to you by God are things He had desired to do, and He is entrusting you with them.
Don’t belittle His assignment for you or the dreams He has put in your heart.
Your Heavenly Father’s joy is to see you do something great for Him. I remember one time, during my teens, I woke up excited about a Church excursion. While getting ready the Holy Spirit told me not to be too excited about the excursion and the funfair. He told me that He is calling me to do great things for the Kingdom. And that is also the call of every saint.  He has not called us to do what the people of the world can do. (This is not to deny the importance of social or societal responsibilities or engagements). However, I realised the Lord was redirecting my desires and how I perceive my walk with Him. That morning, the Lord prompted me to read the book of Isaiah. Interestingly, I started with Isaiah 49. I don’t think it was a coincidence: See what I found: ”The LORD said to me, “I have a greater task for you, my servant. Not only will you restore to greatness the people of Israel who have survived, but I will also make you a light to the nations so that all the world may be saved.” Isaiah 49:6 (GNT) Oh, dear Lord. This scripture opened my heart.The moment I saw “I HAVE A GREATER TASK FOR YOU”, I was moved into prayer.  My heart began to burn with fresh passion and my mindset about God’s Kingdom assignment was stretched or expanded.
All through the scriptures, anyone God called was made great. 
They were made great because the Lord did great things with or through them. Beloved, you are called by the Lord into His greatness. Think greatness and take great steps. Whatever the Lord tells you to do is great!
Esteem the Lord’s assignment for you.
It is a great thing to serve the Lord. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:10; 1 Thessalonians 1:3; Hebrews 11:6; Psalm 108:13 (BBE); Genesis 26:13) WE PRAYWe are praying and declaring that with God we do great things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN1 Chronicles 28-292 Chronicles  12 YEARS PLANPsalms 14DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the workmanship of God created in Christ Jesus unto good works. – Through God, I do valiantly. – I increase in capacity and grace as I labour with the Lord. – I esteem the Lord’s assignment for me than any self-centered desires. – I take bold steps towards my kingdom assignment. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1187 - FIGHT THE GOOD FIGHT
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency As believer in Christ you have the advantage, God lives in you, therefore His strength is inside you. Oh Hallelujah! Author Friday, 24th April 2026 FIGHT THE GOOD FIGHT“And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God” Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)As you may know, the adversary is also busily looking for ways to deceive the beloved ones of the Lord. I have already explained here that, the only major weapon of the adversary is DECEPTION.This is why the armor pieces are given to us by God to enforce our victory in Christ Jesus.One crucial thing you must understand is that your life in Christ began in victory.
The whole armor of God, is not given to you to bring you to victory. You already stepped into victory and have the victory, when you received Jesus!
The newness of life in Christ began in the resurrection of Jesus (Romans 6:4); and after Christ had defeated all the forces of darkness and ripped them of all their powers.“Christ stripped the spiritual rulers and powers of their authority [ disarmed/despoiled the rulers and authorities]. With the cross, He won the victory and showed the world that they were powerless.” Colossians 2:15 (Expanded Bible)He publicly shamed them; and made a public spectacle of them, like a triumphant general displaying his captives in a victory parade.
The resurrection of Jesus was His testimony to all who believe in Him that, He has conquered darkness.
He said “All Hail”! (Matthew 28:9), which also means REJOICE!How do you rejoice if you have been conquered or defeated? You announce to others to rejoice because you have the victory.
He has all authority in heaven, on earth and under the earth.
“And having come to them, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “All authority in heaven and on the earth has been given to Me.” Matthew 28:18 (Berean Literal Bible)“That in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven and things on earth and things under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.”Philippians 2:10-11 (ESV)This means as a saint (born again in Christ), your present life is a continuous expression of the victory of Jesus.
This doesn’t mean the adversary is going to take a nap for you to continue in your victory parade.
He is busy with his deceptive schemes to make you doubt your victory in Christ, and feel discouraged, depressed, and distracted from fulfilling your God-given purpose.This is why you are admonished through the epistle (to the Ephesians) that you put on the whole armor of God.The Helmet of Salvation is an important armor piece for the believer.
The Salvation which you have in Christ protects you from every mental assault of the devil.
This armor does not suggest that you have to fight to earn your salvation. It is to establish you in the consciousness of your salvation in Christ. To put on the helmet of salvation is to walk in the understanding of the revelation that, Jesus paid the price of your salvation in full and you now don’t have to try to earn it.This is the good fight of faith.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 59:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8; 2 Samuel 22:36; Acts 4:12; Ephesians 2:8-9) WE PRAYWe pray declaring that we shall consciously walk in the victory that we have in Christ Jesus at all times and not fall victims to the deceptive schemes of the devil. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles  5-72 YEARS PLANPsalms 16DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk daily in the consciousness of my victory in Christ Jesus. – I refuse to fall victim to the deceptive schemes of the adversary. – I fight the good fight of faith from the place of victory. – I increase in the understanding of the revelation of the finished works of Christ. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1191 - IS THE SPIRIT-WORD IN YOUR MOUTH?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 28th April, 2026 IS THE SPIRIT-WORD IN YOUR MOUTH?“And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God” Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)Until the word is declared or vocalized it is not yet used as a sword.
The belt of truth is not the same as the Sword of the Spirit.
Though they are both in direct connection to the Word of God these two words reveal two different aspects and functions of the Word of God.The Belt of Truth points directly to the person and personality of the Word. It addresses the reality substance of the Word of God.The Sword of the Spirit doesn’t necessarily point to the substance and essence of the Word; it focuses on the active workings of the Word. The Sword of the Spirit, reveals the word as an instrument and not as a person.There are two key words in the Bible translated as “Word”:1. Logos2. RhemaLOGOS is the expression of divine thoughts, and thoughts are expressed by writing or speaking. So both the written word and the spoken word can be referred to as Logos. On the other hand, Rhēma is simply the utterance of a specific personal Word of God to an individual or a collective group of people addressing a present situation, to cause an effective change or transformation.
While Logos is the objective word of God; Rhēma is the subjective Word for the now.
It is through the Logos one can access the Rhēma (the specific personal word of God for the now).Without the Logos of God, one cannot receive the Rhēma word.Rhēma is hewn out of your spirit through the meditation of the Logos of God.What you declare or vocalize (the Greek word is hāgāh) is the Rhēma.
Rhēma is not merely articulating a scripture you have memorized. It is declaring the revelation of the Word.
It is that vocalized word (rhēma) Paul, the apostle, referred to as the SWORD OF THE SPIRIT! “…And take the mighty razor-sharp Spirit-sword of the spoken Word of God.” Ephesians 6:17 (TPT).
Until you meditate on the scriptures to handle divine revelation to avow, the scriptures will not be useful weapons.
Look at this closely: “For the word of God is living and active and full of power [making it operative, energizing, and effective]. It is sharper than any two-edged sword, penetrating as far as the division of the soul and spirit [the completeness of a person], and of both joints and marrow [the deepest parts of our nature], exposing and judging the very thoughts and intentions of the heart.” Hebrews 4:12 (Amplified Bible) Get this, the Word of God is not merely a historical writing which has no relevance in our day.Peter, the apostle, says it abides forever. (1 Peter 1:23).The Word of God is living, active and full of power. It’s effectively operative with fresh energy. It has the ability to quicken you unto an effective living.The Word of God is not only sharp; IT IS SHARPER than any two-edged sword.The expression any two-edged sword is from the Greek;“DISTOMOS ”The Greek word distomos, has a greater meaning than just a two-edged sword.In the original Greek, Di means two and stomo means mouth. So, in other words, distomos means a two-mouthed sword.
God declaring the Word out of His mouth is as a cutting-edge of a weapon in operation.
 Mouth, in Greek, is “stoma”, which means the front or edge of a weapon.Beloved your mouth is also a weapon.
The Word in your mouth is as a razor of a deadly dagger which cuts deep into every matter.
God’s Word spoken by Him and written down is one sharp side of the dagger, and the other sharp side of the deadly dagger is when you speak the revelation of His Word in your situation. “He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came from his mouth. And his face was like the sun in all its brilliance.” Revelation 1:16 (NLT)
God’s word spoken out of your mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine light and energy!
 “He made my words of judgment as sharp as a sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. I am like a sharp arrow in his quiver.”Isaiah 49:2 (NLT)A word soaked and saturated by divine understanding is sharper than a double-edged dagger which has the ability to cause changes.OH, GLORY TO GOD!Read this also from the MESSAGE BIBLE: “He gave me a speech that would cut and penetrate. He kept his hand on me to protect me. He made me his straight arrow and hid me in his quiver.” Isaiah 49:2 (MSG).
Have you now seen why you don’t have to keep quiet?
God wants you to be saturated and soaked with His Word, and that you can handle the personal Word for warfare.This is why you must make it a priority to read and meditate on both the “Dig Deeper scriptures” and the “BIBLE READING PLAN”.Don’t keep quiet!Declare the RHĒMA OF GOD IN THAT SITUATION!!
THE WORD OF GOD IS A SWORD IN YOUR MOUTH SPEAK THE WORD AND NOT YOUR FEARS!
It doesn’t matter the arrows or attacks of the enemy, with the Spirit-word in your mouth, you can cause double-edged damage to his demonic operations.
Take hold of the Word of God through meditation and wage war with it!
Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYThat we will take hold of every rhema word we will receive.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles  19-212 YEARS PLANPsalms 22DECLARE THESE WORDS:– God’s word spoken out of my mouth by revelation is backed and infused by divine energy. – I speak the word at all times. – I don’t walk in confusion or fear because I have rhema for every situation. – The word of God spoken out of my mouth is sharper than any two edged word. – When I speak the word (rhema) things happen. – I am seasoned by the word. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1192 - BE SETTLED ON THIS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 29th April 2026 BE SETTLED ON THIS“And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God”Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)The helmet of a Roman soldier has two functions:1. Identification2. Protection of the head.The second function of the helmet is the most crucial and essential.The idea that Paul linked helmet to Salvation, gives a clue to the role of the Salvation we have received in Christ, how we have to engage this salvation, how the adversary or the enemy attacks the believer and how salvation protects the believer from such attacks.
To put on the helmet of salvation doesn’t suggest a list of things you must do to be saved.
Neither does it suggest that the believer will slide in and out of salvation.To put on the helmet of salvation is not about receiving salvation.Until you are saved, you have no fellowship with the Father.The armor pieces are not for the unsaved.The wiles and fiery darts of the devil are targeted at the saints or the saved.
Putting on the helmet does not produce your salvation. You put it on because you are saved.
The helmet of salvation is not about how you have to fight to earn your salvation.“Because of his kindness, you have been saved through trusting Christ. And even trusting is not of yourselves;[a] it too is a gift from God. Salvation is not a reward for the good we have done, so none of us can take any credit for it.” Ephesians 2:8-9 (TLB)
If Salvation is not dependent on your self-effort, why are you asked to put it on as the helmet?
You are saved through faith in Christ. However, the adversary attacks you, by projecting arrows of doubt. Doubt is the adversary’s strategy to assault you mentally and to break your confidence in God.Though you are saved, the adversary schemes to make you doubt your salvation. And that affects the confidence you have in your relationship with God. When you begin to doubt your salvation through Christ, you will live in uncertainty.
The adversary makes you doubt your salvation and also makes you feel discouraged by amplifying your wrongs and imperfections.
When you should be enjoying the reality of your salvation you will be struggling with the feeling of not being saved.Salvation is not dependent on how you feel about yourself; Salvation is dependent on what Christ achieved for you through His death and resurrection.
The salvation which you received in Christ, is irreversible. It can only be reversed when Jesus’ finished work on the cross and His resurrection can be reversed.
But that can’t be possible.To put on the helmet of salvation is to have your mind established in the consciousness of your salvation in Christ.It is to walk in the understanding of the revelation that, Jesus paid the price of your salvation in full and you now don’t have to try to earn it.
The salvation which you have received in Christ is the basis of your relationship with God.
And because the adversary is interested in disrupting your relationship with God, he goes all out to attack the conviction of your salvation.Let your mind be settled on this truth:“Because of God’s oath, Christ can guarantee forever the success of this new and better arrangement. Under the old arrangement there had to be many priests so that when the older ones died off, the system could still be carried on by others who took their places.But Jesus lives forever and continues to be a Priest so that no one else is needed. He is able to save completely all who come to God through him. Since he will live forever, he will always be there to remind God that he has paid for their sins with his blood.” Hebrews 7:22-25 (TLB)PUT ON THE HELMET OF SALVATION; WALK IN THE CONSCIOUSNESS, CONVICTION AND CONFIDENCE OF THE SALVATION YOU HAVE RECEIVED IN CHRIST.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 John 5:11-13; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8; 2 Samuel 22:36; Acts 4:12) WE PRAYWe pray that our mind will be established in the conviction, consciousness and confidence of the salvation we have received in Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles  22-242 YEARS PLANPsalms 23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk daily in the consciousness of my victory in Christ Jesus. – I refuse to fall victim to the deceptive schemes of the adversary. – I fight the good fight of faith from the place of victory. – I increase in the understanding of the revelation of the finished works of Christ. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1193 - SUBMIT TO THE TRAINING OF THE WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 30th April  2026 SUBMIT TO THE TRAINING OF THE WORD “And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God” Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)Of all the armor pieces mentioned in Ephesians 6, it takes a lot of skill and mastery for a soldier to use the (the sword or sharp-razor dagger).Before the introduction of the Chinese fire-spurting lances (around the 9th century, which later led to the invention of the hand cannon in the 15th century and then the matchlock guns), one of the most lethal weapons for close combat was the or a sword.From antiquity, all through to the medieval era, there were different kinds of swords which were invented. Some of these swords were believed to possess ancient powers or supernatural forces and the swordsmen who wielded them were considered legendary.Right from the First World War, the usage of swords declined drastically. It became a ceremonial weapon. Most people born in the 20th and 21st centuries don’t know the prestige of being known as a skillful swordsman.This is the point, a few weeks or months of training at a military camp, will turn lower-class soldiers into a capable gunner. But that is different from becoming a highly skilled swordsman or archer. To become one who wields a sword, required lifelong devotion.To become an exceptional swordsman in battle requires absolute dedication to training.You cannot become one who effectively wields the sword of the Spirit, without a consistent daily devotion with the Spirit and the word.The sword of the Spirit is crafted from the Holy Spirit and not with a metal.The word of God is used as a sword when you speak them forth. The speaking forth of the word is not only when you quote verses of scriptures.It must be scriptures, spoken by the spirit of revelation, understanding, spiritual conviction, consciousness and confidence of faith.Jesus said, “The words that I speak to you are spirit and they are life” (John 6:63).When you are saturated by the Holy Spirit and the knowledge of the word, you don’t merely quote the scriptures, you speak them forth as life.
It takes intentional devotion to the Holy Spirit and the study of the scriptures to skillfully wield the word of God.
When you are trained to wield the word skillfully, you will know what to say in the face of opposition or adversity.An evil day may come, but you can withstand all pressures, evil schemes and the wiles of the devil when you have submitted yourself to the training of the word.This is why the adversary doesn’t launch attacks on you until he succeeds in moving you away from reading the word. In effect, the adversary begins his attacks by making you feel too busy to commune with the Holy Spiritand takes your attention away from meditating on the scriptures.
The adversary will subtly work to move you far away from Bible study meetings, Church meetings, special word conferences, sound teachers of the word etc.
These things the adversary prevents you from, are the things which will make you skillful to wield the word of God.Though Jesus was the word of God made flesh, He also gave Himself to the studying of the scriptures. (Luke 2:47).
You don’t submit to the training of the word just to win arguments; the training of the word builds you up for victorious living.
Be committed to a lifelong devotion to the Spirit-word.SelahDIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 3:14-17; 2 Timothy 2:15; 1 Samuel 17:41-51; Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray that we will develop the discipline and diligence to be committed to a lifelong devotion to the study, meditation and training of the Word and the communion of the Holy Spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles  25-272 YEARS PLANPsalms 24DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am full of the word. – I am established in the certainty of my identity in Christ. – I speak forth the word of God at all times. – I have the right word for every season and circumstance of my life. – I wage war with the word of God given to me. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1194 - WAGE WAR WITH THE WORD OF GOD GIVEN TO YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Blessed New Month to you, dearly beloved. This is your month of SUPERNATURAL GRACE. You will be overwhelmed by the Supernatural in this month. Maintain this strong consciousness. Shalom! Author Friday, 1st May 2026 WAGE WAR WITH THE WORD OF GOD GIVEN TO YOU “And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God” Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)Thoughts and words are crucial items in spiritual warfare.
Even the thoughts that run through your mind and the words you speak will always affect your living.
The kind of thoughts you entertain will shape your words, and your words will define your world.When the adversary wants to attack your world, he exposes your mind to wrong thoughts. If he wants you to live defeated, he invades your mind with thoughts of weakness, failure, doubt, and negativity.This is why you must become intentional with the meditation of the word of God.You are not like a tree planted by the rivers of water simply because you are born again. It is not that automatic.You can only be like a tree planted by the rivers of water when you make the word of God your delight and meditation (Psalm 1:1-3)
You cannot wage good warfare when you are not full of the word of God.
Imagine a soldier going to war without a sword.How is he going to have an offensive advantage?And the Word of God in your mouth is the Sword of the Spirit. Until you are full of the Word in all situations, you will not be sharp enough to address every opposing thought.Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly. (Colossians 3:16)The greatest deceptive strategy of the adversary against you (as a believer in Christ) is to attack your thoughts by casting shadows on your mind, using the scriptures.
He cast shadows by misquoting or misrepresenting the true meaning of the word.
 He mainly attacks your identity in Christ.That was how he attacked Adam and Eve in Eden. He attacked their identity.“Of course we may eat it,” the woman told him. “It’s only the fruit from the tree at the center of the garden that we are not to eat. God says we mustn’t eat it or even touch it, or we will die.” “That’s a lie!” the serpent hissed. “You’ll not die! God knows very well that the instant you eat it you will become like him, for your eyes will be opened—you will be able to distinguish good from evil.” Genesis 3:3-4 (TLB)Meanwhile, God made man in His image and after His likeness (Genesis 1:26).Again, after the Father had declared these words during the baptism of Jesus “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!” (Matthew 3:17)The devil came to tempt Jesus saying, “ If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become loaves of bread.” (Matthew 4:3)Do you see it?He came attacking what the voice said concerning Jesus.The moment he used the phrase “If you are the Son of God”, he is subtly creating uncertainty in the mind of Jesus.He now wants Jesus to think he is not yet the son of God but will only become by doing what he tells him to do. And if Jesus had done what the adversary was deceptively asking for, he might have lived in doubt of who He is and be ruled by the thoughts of the devil.Beloved do not be ignorant of the devices of the enemy.
The adversary will always attack what God says about you!
Jesus knew the devil’s devices and deployed the word of God.“But Jesus told him, “No! The Scriptures say, ‘People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.” (Matthew 4:4)Did the devil stop there?Not at all. He kept using various means in an attempt to make Jesus act contrary to his reality. Yet, Jesus consistently addressed the situation with the word, till He finally and sternly cast the devil out using the word as a weapon. Jesus didn’t just quote the scripture, He had to use it as a weapon.This time Jesus didn’t just say it is written, He said:“Get out of here, Satan,” Jesus told him. “For the Scriptures say, ‘You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ (Matthew 4:10)This was similar to what David did when he confronted Goliath.
Beloved, what is the challenge confronting you? Take hold of the word of God concerning that situation and use the word as a weapon to enforce your victory.
Get hold of the word, be full of the word of God, that you may be ready in all season; with your mouth full of the right words to be used to wage war.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17:41-51; Isaiah 49:2; Hebrews 4:12; Revelation 1:16; 2:16; 19:15; Deuteronomy 33:29) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow in the revelation of the Word, to know how to rightly use the word in the relevant situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles  28-302 YEARS PLANPsalms 25DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am full of the word. – I am established in the certainty of my identity in Christ. – I speak forth the word of God at all times. – I have the right word for every season and circumstance of my life. – I wage war with the word of God given to me. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1195 - YOUR IDENTITY IS A THREAT TO THE ADVERSARY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow the challenges or limitations of your background to bully you. Don’t bow to the systems of this world. Be a fighter. Author Saturday, 2nd May 2026 YOUR IDENTITY IS A THREAT TO THE ADVERSARY “And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God” Ephesians 6:17 (KJV)To put on the helmet of salvation is to live in the conviction, consciousness and confidence of the salvation which you have received in Christ.Legionaries and centurions usually wore helmets (typically called galea) and these were topped with cristas or crests (made of horsehair which were sometimes dyed red).The patent model of their helmets made identification of these soldiers during a battle easy.The identification indicates whose side you belong to.The helmet of salvation is also your identification of whose you are.The only reason you are a soldier of Christ is that you are saved.
If you are saved you are Christ’s.
Through faith in Christ Jesus, you are saved by grace (Ephesians 2:8).To be saved by grace, through faith in Christ, is not merely to escape hell or damnation. To be saved is essentially to be born of God, which means you become a child of God.“For you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus. And all who have been united with Christ in baptism have put on Christ, like putting on new clothes. There is no longer Jew or Gentile, slave or free, male and female. For you are all one in Christ Jesus. And now that you belong to Christ, you are the true children of Abraham. You are his heirs, and God’s promise to Abraham belongs to you” Galatians 3:26-29 (NLT)
Your identity now is that you are a child of God.
And that is one of the works of the Holy Spirit in your heart. He is in you to bear witness and to testify with your spirit that you are God’s child. (Romans 8:16).
Your identity as a child of God is the reality of your testimony that you have overcome the world.
“Every God-born person conquers the world’s ways. The conquering power that brings the world to its knees is our faith. The person who wins out over the world’s ways is simply the one who believes Jesus is the Son of God.” 1 John 5:4-5 (The Message).Do you now see why the adversary is after your conviction and consciousness of the Salvation you have received in Christ?He wants you to doubt your identity.
Your identity as a child of God is his threat.
He has always been after your identity. You cannot be a slave to the devil and his worldly systems when you are fully conscious of your identity in Christ through salvation.
Put on the helmet of salvation and walk in the confidence of who you are in Christ Jesus.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 John 5:11-13; Isaiah 59:17; 1 Thessalonians 5:8; 2 Samuel 22:36; Acts 4:12) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall always maintain the focus of our identity in Christ and rejoice in the reality of the eternal salvation which we have freely received in Christ Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN2 Chronicles  31-342 YEARS PLANPsalms 26-27DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I belong to Christ. – I walk daily in the consciousness, conviction and confidence of the salvation which I have received in Christ. – I am a child of God. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1197 - BE AN INTERCESSOR
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t waste time on sleep. Don’t waste time on things which don’t contribute to your success. Set daily goals and targets, so that you can measure your success and impact. Author Monday, 4th May, 2026BE AN INTERCESSOR “The people then cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD…” Numbers 11:2 (New American Standard Bible) As the light of the world, the Lord has called you and sent you to give direction and meaning to lives. As New Creation in Christ, you have the mandate to lead your generation. You are called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose. The first step in fulfilling the assignment of leadership, is to entrust the assignment to God.The core element of every leader’s assignment is people. Every leader is sent out by God to provide answers to the people, irrespective of their condition or needs. However, kingdom leaders are sent men, and are not to be GOD to the people. Leaders must therefore see themselves as intercessors. You shape the destinies of people by first praying to the One who hasFOREORDAINED THEIR DESTINIES.Whenever the people of Israel turned away from God, or blamed Moses for their condition (instead of taking responsibility for their fears and anxiety); Moses’ reaction was to intercede for the people. Moses didn’t lead the people of Israel by his own strength. He led Israel through the power of Intercession.To intercede is to commit the burdens of your community, or the institution of people you are leading to God. The adversary sought to destroy lives and destinies, and your strategy is to go into prayer of intercession and also take up intercessory projects which shall help shape the lives entrusted to you.Jesus said: “And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren” Luke 22:31-32 (KJV). As a leader, instead of complaining, you stand in the gap for the people entrusted to you by the Lord. To lead your generation, is not to lord yourself over them, but to serve. And the first step you have to take in the service of others is to intercede for them.BE AN INTERCESSOR TODAY.YOU ARE A GLOBAL ICON…Selah.DIG DEEPER(Matthew 5:13-16; Numbers 21:7; Numbers 11:1-2; Romans 1:8-10; 1 Thessalonians 1:2-3; Philippians 1:3-4) WE PRAY– That we will continually stand in the gap for the people the Lord has entrusted to us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEzra 3-52 YEARS PLANPsalms 30DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been called and chosen by God to lead many into purpose. – I don’t complain about the people the Lord has entrusted to me, rather I intercede for them. – I serve my generation first through intercession. – I don’t lead by my own strength, I lead by the strength of the Lord. – Through my intercession for the people the Lord has entrusted to me, their lives are directed and shaped unto purpose. – I am an intercessor. – I AM A GLOBAL ICON. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1198 - DON’T BE SATISFIED WITH THE SAND BATHING; DELVE DEEPER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Be a leading example in word, in manner of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and purity. You have the call of God on your life to LEAD YOUR GENERATION, take a STEP TO MAKE IT HAPPEN. Selah. Author Tuesday, 5th May, 2026DON’T BE SATISFIED WITH THE SAND BATHING; DELVE DEEPER“God’s wisdom is something mysterious that goes deep into the interior of his purposes. You don’t find it lying around on the surface. It’s not the latest message, but more like the oldest—what God determined as the way to bring out his best in us, long before we ever arrived on the scene.” 1 Corinthians 2:8 (MSG)A man who communes with the Holy Spirit has access to the riches of the Wisdom of God.
No one immersed in God and His wisdom struggles to make the right decisions at any point in life.
There is no confusion in a man who has handled the depths of divine wisdom. Deep understanding is granted to a man who continues to behold the Lord.You will never find God’s wisdom by surfing around. You access God’s wisdom in the depths of His heart.
You must develop the habit of staying long in your communion with God.
The more you continue to stay longer, the more you are enriched with the influences of the Spirit.STAY LONG! DON’T RUSH.To some, staying long in the place of prayer and communion with the Lord is tedious work.Whatever and whoever you love takes your time and attention effortlessly.As you are struggling to stay in the place of prayer and ministering to the Lord, are you sure the Love of God is kindled in your heart?
Communing with God is an unforceful rhythm when it is centered on the love of God.
The Holy Spirit is the best partner for the fulfilment of your destiny.And even “the Spirit of God, not content to flit around on the surface, dives into the depths of God, and brings out what God planned all along” 1 Corinthians 2:10 (MSG).He searches all things diligently, even the profound depths of God.This means that having the Holy Spirit in you doesn’t mean you automatically understand the depths of God. You must also dive and search deeply into the heart of the Spirit to glean the riches of His wisdom.There are things concerning your life which God has set in Himself long before you arrived on the scene. And as you commune with the Spirit, He grants you access and mastery of things God has already designed for you.
Stop being satisfied with the sand bathing. Go beyond the shores of the Spirit, and dive deep into the ocean of the Spirit to experience and enjoy the wisdom of God.
No king can rule and exercise dominion without a dimension of wisdom.“God conceals the revelation of his word in the hiding place of his glory. But the honor of kings is revealed by how they thoroughly search out the deeper meaning of all that God says. The heart of a king is full of understanding, like the heavens are high and the ocean is deep.” Proverbs 25:2-3 (TPT)You are called to lead your generation and, therefore, increase in understanding.“Like the horizons for breadth and the ocean for depth, the understanding of a good leader is broad and deep.” Proverbs 25:3 (MSG).There are divine depths of wisdom which may not be understood by books. You only come to the understanding of it by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit.“We don’t have to rely on the world’s guesses and opinions. We didn’t learn this by reading books or going to school; we learned it from God, who taught us person-to-person through Jesus, and we’re passing it on to you in the same firsthand, personal way.” 1 Corinthians 2:13 (MSG).
There is an understanding that comes to you only in communion with the Lord.
Dive deeper into the Lord through fellowship with the Holy Spirit.Glory to God.DIG DEEPER(Exodus 34:27-29; Psalm 32:6; Exodus 24:18; Luke 9:29; Ezekiel 8:2-3; Daniel 2:16-30) WE PRAYThat our hearts will delve deep into God and access the depths of wisdom and understanding concerning all that is needed for the fulfilment of purpose and the refulgence of His kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEzra 6-82 YEARS PLANPsalms 31DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow deeper in my communication with the Holy Spirit.– I don’t entertain any habit or association that stirs up prayerlessness. – I have the patience to stay long in prayers. – I don’t compromise and give excuses, I make time for prayer. – I am given to prayer.  – I stay long in prayers. – I am a man of prayer. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1199 - BE DEVOTED TO PRAYER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 6th May 2026BE DEVOTED TO PRAYER “Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints“Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)To enforce your victory in Christ, you must not seek for a holiday. Though we entered our rest in Christ, we fight the fight of faith in rest.There is a designated time for a holiday. We confront the forces of darkness while we are at rest.The adversary though defeated and rendered powerless, is still deploying and projecting his deceptive scheme. Believers must have the attitude that puts them ahead of the strategies of the evil one.
We must be WATCHFUL and exercise PERSEVERANCE.
You cannot enforce your victory when you go into slumber. You must remain alert with your eyes open. Don’t be ignorant of the schemes of the enemy.To be watchful enables you to persevere. The more you are alert to see the plots of the enemy the more you remain firm and constant in prayer.Most believers go on vacation because they are ignorant of the schemes of the devil.He is a defeated enemy who never accepts defeat (though he knows he cannot win). You must be watchful to put him in his place.
It takes perseverance to do anything or accomplish any great feat in life.
Jesus instructed His disciples to “watch and pray…”You are a good soldier on the battlefield, therefore, stay alert in prayer.You don’t also have to get tired to pray. You may have many genuine reasons to be lackadaisical or reasons not to pray, but you must persevere.This is war!And you cannot stay out of touch with the Lord. You must earnestly stay in prayer.
To be sincere, prayer isn’t always easy. But the secret is that, the more you stay consistent in prayer, the easier it gets.
When you stay out of prayer for a while, it will always be a struggle to get into the habit of prayer. You must be determined to be prayerful. You have to make a choice that you shall press on in prayer.You don’t become effective in prayer by only reading on prayer. You can be reading this episode of with , and still not be praying. You may know the benefits of prayer and still not be praying.
The only way to be prayerful is to continue in prayer daily.
And also don’t make prayer the last option of what to do to get results. Prayer must always be your first strategy.You also don’t have to rush through prayer. To get the best of prayer, stay long in prayer and be consistent with it daily.PERSEVERE IN PRAYER!Selah!DIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:17; Acts 1:4; Colossians 4:2,12; Mark 13:33; Luke 18:1; Colossians 1:9; Colossians 2:7) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not lack the ability and discipline to stay resolute, watchful and devoted in prayer. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEzra 9-10Nehemiah 12 YEARS PLANPsalms 32DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the grace to persevere in prayer in the midst of opposition.– I refuse to stagger, I pray. – I endure to the end, I pray. – I don’t fret nor faint, I pray. – Through perseverance in prayer, I maintain an undisturbed composure.Thank you Lord Jesus!!

title: EPISODE 1200 - THE FOCAL BENEFIT OF PRAYER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Did you know that today’s episode is 1200? Oh what a journey of sound doctrine and deep spiritual understanding. If you have been following this rich realities consistently then I have a special gift for you. Click on this link to claim your gift. [https://forms.gle/rrDUpGpEuyratgTg8] Shalom! Author Thursday, 7th May, 2026 THE FOCAL BENEFIT OF PRAYER “Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints” Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)Are you persevering in prayer?Or do you already seem to be tired of prayer?Apart from the reality that we pray for God’s answers, the benefits of prayer are not limited to God answering our requests.
One of the most transcending benefits of prayer is that it changes you.
The more you persevere in prayer, the more you develop and intensify your connection with God. The more your connection with God strengthens, the more you are changed and transformed.“About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James up on a mountain to pray. And as he was praying, the appearance of his face was transformed, and his clothes became dazzling white. Suddenly, two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared and began talking with Jesus. They were glorious to see. And they were speaking about his exodus from this world, which was about to be fulfilled in Jerusalem.” Luke 9:28-31 (NLT) Precious one, PRAYER CHANGES YOU!
The glory of God in you is revealed as you spend time in prayer.
Your consistent prayer life is a threat to the devil. The devil is more scared of what prayer will do to you than the answers you will receive.Sometimes you get discouraged when it seems the answers are delayed. But that discouragement is an arrow of the adversary.
When you feel discouraged to pray, that is when you must persevere more in prayer!
To persevere in prayer is to endure patiently in prayer. You don’t have to rush out of the place of prayer; neither do you have to become impatient through the process of prayer.As you endure patiently in prayer and the transforming process of prayer, you increase in spiritual capacity.
The best answer to prayer is the impartation you receive from the place of prayer. The longer you stay in prayer, the stronger the impartation of the Holy Spirit.
Perseverance enables you to build character.“And endurance develops strength of character, and character strengthens our confident hope of salvation.” Romans 5:4 (NLT)The only way to be prayerful is to continue in prayer daily.Beloved, the focal benefit of prayer is that PRAYER CHANGES YOU.PERSEVERE IN PRAYER.Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Thessalonians 5:17; Acts 1:4; Colossians 4:2,12; Mark 13:33; Luke 18:1; Colossians 1:9; Colossians 2:7) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be strengthened by the Holy Spirit to remain steadfast in prayer. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNehemiah 2-4 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 33 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am steadfast in prayer.– I daily give my mind and my heart to prayer.– I maintain focus in prayer.– As I pray, I am transformed from glory to glory.– I develop attention through prayer.– I am addicted to prayer. Thank you, Sweet Holy Ghost!

title: EPISODE 1202 - ENJOYING DAILY VICTORIES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Saturday, 9th May, 2026  ENJOYING DAILY VICTORIES “Look at the proud one, His soul is not right within him, But the righteous will live by his faith [in the true God].” Habakkuk 2:4 (Amplified) The goal of the word of God is to make you fruitful in your walk with Him. This begins with the infusion of faith. Anytime God’s word comes to you, it produces faith in you. Faith comes by hearing the Word of God. (Romans 10:17).
Faith is the absolute confidence in God and what He says. It is the substance of the reality which is beyond the optics.
When the word of God comes to you concerning a matter, it opens your heart to God’s revelation on that matter or situation; and reprograms your mind on how to deal with that matter or situation according to God’s wisdom. This is how faith works! Four times in the Bible, you can see the phrase:“The just shall live by faith” or “The righteous shall live by faith” (Habakkuk 2:4; Romans 1:17; Galatians 3:11 and Hebrews 10:38;) It is mentioned three times in the New Testament portion of the Bible and once in the Old Testament portion of the Bible. The opening verse, Habakkuk 2:4, is the original or the first time that phrase was used.  What makes Habakkuk 2:4, unique is the expression, “…HIS FAITH“. This focuses on how we appropriate or engage the revelation of Jesus in our personal lives. That is the subjective Faith.In the New Testament, the focus of the other three verses is on the OBJECT of Faith (which is the revelation of Jesus). 
Jesus is the object and substance of our confidence in God.
Which means Faith is Jesus and all that He has done for us. Jesus is the substance or embodiment of our confidence and assurance in God unto salvation. Now to continue to live by faith and manifest the fullness of the life which you have in Christ, you must have a personal revelation of the Word of God.
To have a personal revelation of the word of God is not to have your personal interpretation of the word of God. (2 Peter 1:20)
The word of God (or every scripture) is prophetic and there is a complete interpretation of every scripture in the Bible. There are three methods the Word of God was given: 1. The Word of God or the scriptures were given by revelation; which is from God to His holy men. (See Amos 3:7; Hebrews 1:1-2; Daniel 2:22,28; Galatians 1:11-12). 2. And by inspiration these holy men wrote the scriptures. Which is from heart to “paper”. (See 2 Peter 1:21; 2 Timothy 3:16).  3. The third method is illumination. This is from “Paper” to heart (See Psalm 119:18,130; Ephesians 1:18). This happens through the teaching and the study of the Word. As all scripture is inspired by God, we should understand that we are not inspired to rewrite the scriptures. The dimension of inspiration we enjoy now, involves how God has revealed spiritual truth to us through His word (which is already inspired by God). It happens through accurate interpretation which is your study of spiritual truth, in God’s word. This is what it means to, “RIGHTLY DIVIDE THE WORD OF GOD”. (2 Timothy 2:15). It is by this you can handle the truth of the word of God for yourself. All that God has said in His word is the revelation of His life and eternal counsel to mankind.  Your revelation of God must be according to the word of God. For the Word of God to be useful to you, you need to know and own the Word. You must personalise it. 
The knowledge of the word of God must not just be another increase in information but increased revelation.
Your faith is governed by your personal revelation.  To have a personal revelation is not to have a new revelation (which has never been before). The revelation of the word of God in the scriptures is complete. Christ is the completeness of God’s revelation (Hebrews 1:1-2).
To have a personal revelation is to have an absolute and accurate understanding of what God has said through the scriptures.
It is to personally behold and capture the light or the reality of God through His Word. Personal revelation is the illumination of the word of God in your heart. The illumination of the Word involves your understanding of spiritual truth which is in the Word, by the administration of the Holy Spirit (through a sound teacher of the Word, and Bible study materials). This is what “The with ” does to you. It makes you an illumined believer.
You are trained to personally recognize the truthfulness of what you read in the Bible and to apprehend its beauty. 
Illumination of the scriptures enlightens you to recognize the authority and significance of what is said in the word, for your daily victories. It means you are not merely living by what someone says he or she has found in the Scriptures. But you live by what you have personally seen and handled in the Scriptures. This makes your faith effective and you live the reality of your overcoming life. “For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God]” 1 John 5:4 (Amplified) When you have a personal revelation of the Word, you can have personal daily victories of faith. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 2; 1 John 1:1-3; Job 42:5; Acts 26:18; 2 Corinthians 4:6; Isaiah 6:10; Philippians 3:10; Luke 1:1-4) WE PRAYLord, open our eyes and hearts to your word that we will be enlightened and built in our Faith for personal daily victories which will bring glory to your name. In the glorious name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNehemiah 8-11 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 35-36 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I grow in my personal faith in Jesus. – My heart and mind are illuminated by the Word of God. – I don’t live by assumptions. I live by revelation. – I walk in the reality of the Word of God. – I see truth in the word of God. – I recognise the authority of the word of God in every situation of my life. – I am richly enlightened by the word for the increase of my faith. Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1204 - THE INFLUX OF DIVINE STRENGTH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you value the word, it will be so fruitful that the worries and distractions of the world and the deceitfulness [the superficial pleasures and delight] of riches cannot choke it or stop it from yielding fruits. Beloved, value the word! Author Monday, 11th May, 2026 THE INFLUX OF DIVINE STRENGTH “I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.” Philippians 4:13 (KJV)The influx of divine strength is the rich secret to doing all things which Christ has called you to do.To be strengthened with Christ is to be infused with confidence and peace. It is to be empowered with the ability of God. It is also to become self-sufficient in the sufficiency of Christ for every good work.
The strength of Christ in you enables you to exercise mastery in all things.
When it feels like you cannot pursue or do the assignment of the Lord with limited resources, remember, the secret:THE LORD GIVES YOU STRENGTH.The strength of the Lord in you is not only effective in you when you have abundance.Take a look at this:“I know what it means to lack, and I know what it means to experience overwhelming abundance. For I’m trained in the secret of overcoming all things, whether in fullness or in hunger.
