And I find that the strength of Christ’s explosive power infuses me to conquer every difficulty.” Philippians 4:12-13 (TPT)Did you see that?When you exercise the strength of God to triumph amidst “little -difficult” moments, you train yourself to continuously triumph over huge challenges.
The strength of Christ in you is Christ’s explosive power which infuses you to conquer every difficulty.
The more you press on to carry out God’s assignment for you, the more the adversary also opposes you. His interest is in preventing you from fulfilling your calling. You don’t have to feel incapable at any given time.There are times when, no matter which direction you turn, you may face opposition or limitations. Sometimes the pressure and the challenges may seem insurmountable.But cheer up!
You can do all things through Christ who strengthens you.
“Since His power is so glorious, may you be strengthened with strength of every kind, and be prepared for cheerfully enduring all things with patience and long-suffering” Colossians 1:11 (Weymouth New Testament)As the Lord invigorates you with His strength, you are empowered by Him to cheerfully endure every form of hardship as you fulfill His purpose.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord shall strengthen us more and more to triumph in His assignment amidst all the deepest devastations. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEsther 3-5 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 39 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. – I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. – I have the ability to achieve every task the Lord sets on  my heart to achieve. – I don’t waste the strength of Christ on things the Lord has not called me to do. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1205 - BEING ENABLED BY THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Soul winning is a great practice of Wisdom. Demonstrate Wisdom by winning souls for the Kingdom. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 12th May, 2026 BEING ENABLED BY THE LORD “I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.” Philippians 4:13 (KJV)This opening verse is one of the most quoted scriptures by Christians worldwide. The truth is that it gives much hope and confidence to the saints.It has supplied motivation to many believers in different fields or spheres, such as, those in sports, academia or students embarking on an academic pursuit, medical personnel entering the surgical ward, the nurse assigned to a difficult patient, a pregnant lady in labour, the inexperienced young man or lady assigned to a new top leadership role in an organization, the software developer who is feeling overwhelmed with just three days to complete a complex project.
Many sincerely can testify how they felt rejuvenated by this verse of scripture to complete a task given to them.
Bible teachers and scholars have debated the misuse of this scripture verse.Some are of the opinion that when Paul the apostle said, “I can do all things…” he wasn’t talking about the ability to run in a race, play football, or basketball, perform gymnastics or even win a boxing fight. Neither was he talking about the ability to study and pass exams, or to lead a business organization.Clearly, the Apostle Paul listed the things he was referring to as the All THINGS he can do.Take a look at the verse in context:“But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly that now at last your care for me has flourished again; though you surely did care, but you lacked opportunity. Not that I speak in regard to need, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content: I know how to be abased, and I know how to abound. Everywhere and in all things I have learned both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. Nevertheless, you have done well that you shared in my distress.” Philippians 4:10-14 (NKJV)From the context of this verse, Paul the apostle was sharing with the saints in Philippi, how he has been enabled by the Lord to live in contentment as he preaches the gospel. He was expressing how he had learnt not to be greedy but to continue in the ministry of the Lord even when he has abundance or when he lacks.Some people are only able to do what God has called them to do, only when they have all their needs met. You will not find these people involved in the ministry of the Lord when they are in need. They will rather abandon their ministerial duty to pursue the satisfaction of their personal needs than to continue to labor in lack. These people only serve the Lord when things seem to be convenient.But Paul the apostle had a different testimony. His service to God is not only when it’s convenient. He doesn’t get busy with the gospel only when he has everything he needs. He is strengthened to continue in the business of the gospel even in hunger.
Christ supplies His strength to you to accomplish all the assignments He has given to you no matter the situation at hand.
Though you can draw inspiration or motivation from the verse to carry out a project or pursue a career, the focus of Christ’s strength is not to satisfy your personal interests or ambitions.Many people will only use this verse to address their interests and neglect the assignment given to them by the Lord.The strength of Christ is not for your selfish desire. Christ supplies you with His strength to carry out His purpose.Whenever you declare that “I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me”, you must be sure the “all things” you are doing will bring glory to God.
Irrespective of the situation or the challenge you face in your pursuit of God’s purpose, you must take advantage of the strength of God to be content.
Selah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:16; 2 Corinthians 12:9; 1 Timothy 1:12; Colossians 1:11) WE PRAYWe pray that the strength of God will abound towards us even in the toughest moments of our lives, as we carry out God’s purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEsther 6-8 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 40 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God to accomplish all the assignments He has given to me no matter the situation at hand. – I take advantage of the strength of God to be content at all times irrespective of any challenge or situation. – I do not lack strength. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1206 - STRENGTH FROM WITHIN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 13th May, 2026 STRENGTH FROM WITHIN“And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.”1 Samuel 30:6 (English Standard Version)Your first reaction to challenges determines your manifestation.The assumption that you will not face challenges when you become born again is wrong.Challenges will come, but you don’t have to allow it to dominate your life. Your duty is to sail through those challenges by the grace of God.
Your level of faith or confidence in God is exposed by the challenges you face.
Challenges though are orchestrations of the adversary and wickedness, none of them has enough ability to break you. If a challenge breaks you then you are weak in strength.“If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small” Proverbs 24:10 (NKJV)Beloved God is not expecting you to fall or faint when you are under pressure or confronted by adversity.
He has given you all that you need to live above challenges.
Paul the apostle said, “In every way we’re troubled, but we aren’t crushed by our troubles. We’re frustrated, but we don’t give up.” 2 Corinthians 4:8 (GOD’S WORD Translation)David, while he was out with his men to join the Philistines in battle, the Amalekites made a raid against Ziklag, the city (where the families of David and his men live). The Amalekites had overcome Ziklag and burned it with fire and taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They killed no one but carried them off and went their way.When David and his men came to the city, they found it burned with fire, and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive. Then David and the people who were with him raised their voices and wept until they had no more strength to weep. (See 1 Samuel 30:1-5)The situation in which David and his men found themselves was discouraging. Now it was so intense that his people thought of stoning him. That was even worse.Because it wasn’t just the people who lost their family members. David’s wives and children were also taken. Now these people turn to blame David.
That is the burden of leadership. Everyone may blame you.
Beloved, you may feel disappointed or distressed, but pick yourself up in faith. Always remember whom you have believed. In the day of adversity strengthen yourself in the Lord. Don’t rely on your strength.That was what David did:“And David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because all the people were bitter in soul, each for his sons and daughters. But David strengthened himself in the LORD his God.” 1 Samuel 30:6 (ESV).He went on to inquire of the Lord as to what He should do next.
Beloved you gain more strength in the place of prayer.
You must always practice the Pauline prayers.“May He grant you out of the riches of His glory, to be strengthened and spiritually energized with power through His Spirit in your inner self, [indwelling your innermost being and personality]” Ephesians 3:16 (Amplified Bible)No matter the situation you find yourself in, strengthen yourself in the Lord. And don’t wait for challenges before you strengthen yourself, be ready in the strength of the Lord at all times!Selah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 12:9; Ephesians 6:10; Psalm 28:8; Psalm 18:2; 1 Samuel 23:16) WE PRAYPray that the Lord would unveil within you the unlimited riches of His glory and favor until supernatural strength floods your innermost being with His divine might and explosive power. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEsther 9-10Job 1 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 41 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am strengthened by God in my inner man at all times. – I have the strength to surmount every challenge. – No challenge or situation can dominate my life. – Through the supply of the strength of God, I sail through every challenge victoriously. – I don’t loose strength. – Greater is He that is in me, than any challenge that is in the world. – Through prayer, I engage the energies of God within me. – I have strength! Oh thank you Lord Jesus for enabling me with strength in my inner man.

title: EPISODE 1207 - TAKE A STAND TODAY AND LEAD YOUR WORLD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Don’t allow your emotions to lead you. Channel your emotions towards the Lord. Allow the word of God to saturate your desires. Selah. Author Thursday, 14th May, 2026TAKE A STAND TODAY AND LEAD YOUR WORLD“But we will not boast beyond our measure, but within the measure of the area of influence which God apportioned to us as a measure, to reach even as far as you.”2 Corinthians 10:13 (Legacy Standard Bible)There are many people who assume they are not called to lead. And some of these thought patterns stem from an age long philosophy.Which simply emphasises the concept that “Not all are born to lead…”The question is, can we confirm this concept as the concept and ideology of God?Did God create some people to be leaders and others to be followers?Before the creation of man, God communicated His concept of who man is:“Then God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness. And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the heavens and over the livestock and over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.” Genesis 1:26 (ESV)
Man was not made to be inferior. Man was made to lead, to rule and to have dominion.
God is not just a creator, He is also the King of the universe.To be made in the image and likeness of God is to have the quality or capacity to function as a leader.If you are reading this now, I want you to know that God designed you to be a leader.You may not have all the qualities to function as a high-level leader or a great leader, but you must understand that you have the ability to lead.And if you have the ability to lead, then you can become a great leader or rise to a high level of leadership when you are able to strengthen your weaknesses and sharpen your strengths.Every human being has a certain level of capacity to lead. However, the moment you develop faith in God and submit your heart to Him, you begin to journey into true Kingdom leadership.You can fully operate or function according to God’s design, to the degree to which you respond to Him in faith.
When God looks at you, He sees one with the capacity to lead.
Abraham lived all his life as an ordinary man until God called him out of his kindred. That call of God moved Abraham from his comfort zone and limited thoughts to become a great patriarch and a leader of many generations.Gideon never saw himself as a mighty man or as a leader. But when God looked at him, He saw a mighty leader (Judges 6:12).The disciples of Jesus lived as ordinary youths, but within them is the capacity to function as Kingdom leaders. Through an effective discipleship program for three years, Jesus nurtured His disciples to become conduits of a great global and transgenerational movement. He was able to establish an eternal mandate (the Church) on earth through these young men. He sent them out to go forth into all the world (every sphere of influence) to make disciples and transform them into transformational leaders. (Matthew 28:19).This is the charge for every believer: we are called into Christ and mandated to function as transgenerational leaders, raising more Kingdom leaders and making an eternal impact.Jesus calls you the light of the world, a city set on a hill.This is who you are!As a light, you have to shine and illuminate the very place you find yourself.Your sphere is your world, and God has designed and deposited into you the ability to lead in the sphere He has placed you in.
You are not called to lead tomorrow, you have the mandate to lead now. You are not going to become a leader, you are a leader now.
Take a stand today and lead your world.DIG DEEPER(1 Peter 2:9; Matthew 5:13-16; Isaiah 60:1-3; Isaiah 9:2; Matthew 4:16) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall grow and be sharpened to function as true Kingdom leaders in our world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 2-4 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 42 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have been called to lead my generation. – I have the capacity to lead. – I am conscious of this calling. – I have a determined mind and heart to always walk in the fulfillment of this call. – I refuse to be distracted. – I refuse to allow anyone or anything despise me as a youth. – Many look up to me for inspiration, hope and encouragement. – I am the centre of attraction in my generation. – I am a satisfaction to many. – I partner with God in lifting up many from the negatives influences of this world. – I am a Leader today. Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1208 - DON’T BE IGNORANT OF HIS SCHEMES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 15th May, 2026 DON’T BE IGNORANT OF HIS SCHEMES“so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV)Though Christ has obtained victory for every believer through His death and resurrection, it is necessary to enforce that victory at all times.
Until you enforce your victory, you will not enjoy its fullness.
This is the summary of what is known as the Spiritual warfare of the Believer.We are not at war with the devil to conquer him — he has already been conquered. We are at war to enforce our victory in Christ Jesus.“For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;) Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ” 2 Corinthians 10:3-5 (KJV)This is war on the grounds of knowledge. It is not a fight over power, it is a fight over whether you will enjoy your victory and inheritance in Christ or doubt all that Christ has accomplished for you.And that is the focus of the deadly weapons or projectiles of the devil against the believer.Don’t be ignorant of his schemes.The adversary knows, that what takes your attention influences your direction. And what you focus on becomes your goal.When he wants to move the direction of your life away from the course of the Lord and the purpose of God for your life, he must redefine your attention. This is one of the most subtle bad deadly weapons of the devil.There are many who have looked back on their lives with regrets because they lost focus. They started off life with great potential and a desire to accomplish so much for the Lord. Yet in their pursuit of purpose, they lost focus and steered their love away from God’s intention for them.
The devil doesn’t distract you with evil. Knowing the condition of your heart, he will first distract you with what also seems to be good.
What do you think is the enemy of the best?The enemy of the best is the “good” and not the “worst”.Genuine family situations or career choices move people away from the pursuit of God’s perfect will for their lives. Nobody got distracted by reasons that first appeared foolish. People get distracted from God’s purpose for their lives by reasons which seem genuine.A lady who had great potential and was marked as one going to do great things in the Kingdom lost focus because she was asked to spend more time with “Study group” friends in school than friends from Church. That was how her desires were redirected from the matters pertaining to God. Her desires for the Lord were watered down and became wayward. She lost her bearing of hope.Some withdrew from a specific Church Assembly for petty reasons or reasons which were not inspired by the Holy Spirit and could not grow spiritually any more. There are places God plants you, so that He may usher you into greater manifestations. God doesn’t want you to be ordinary, so He ushers you into a company of believers, who dare to do extraordinary things. The adversary will do whatever it takes to distract you from such company.There are people who think, all Churches are the same. And you can become what God has called you to be irrespective of where you find yourself. That is not true. Not every company of believers have a tailored system to nurture your greatness.“Don’t be fooled by those who say such things, for “bad company corrupts good character.” 1 Corinthians 15:33 (NLT)When Peter decided to look at the storm instead of Jesus, he began to sink (Matthew 14:30). Don’t make decisions because of challenges. Make choices which are consistent with the revelation of Jesus.
It is a trap to think you have to withdraw from your engagements with the Lord, so that you can focus on a family challenge, employment situation or a financial concern. 
The adversary is luring you away from your mandate. He doesn’t want you to take and be consistent with what the Lord has begun in you. He may even use family members, a fellow believer or a close friend to distract you. Always pay attention to the voice of the Lord.Stay alert, maintain and imbue focus.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:8; Luke 10:41-42; Proverbs 4:25-27; Colossians 3:2; Isaiah 26:3) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not be distracted even by the most beautiful things. Our hearts and minds shall remain focused on the best intentions and perfect will of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 5-7 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 43 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not a victim of the adversary. – I maintain and imbue focus on that which the Lord has called me unto. – I pay attention to the voice of God. – I give no room for the adversary in my life. – I refuse to be discouraged no matter the situation. – My confidence is in the glorious plan of God for my life. – I trust God’s training. – I live daily above disappointment, discouragement, despair, doubt and unbelief. – I refuse to let myself get distracted. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1209 - DON’T WASTE TIME
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author  DON’T WASTE TIME“Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!” Psalm 90:14 (NKJV)You can be satisfied in your labour at the dawn or morning of your life.You don’t have to struggle through life till old age before you experience success. You can have the God-kind of success early.Take note, God centered success or God kind of success, is not necessarily about the possession of material things. It is not the car you drive, the house you’ve bought, or the amount of money in your bank account. The God-kind of success is basically achieving God’s plan for you within a particular season.To have early success is to step into the fullness of your calling or purpose. It is making tangible impact in the lives of people through the mandate the Lord has given you.Most people who don’t experience early success in the Kingdom, are often people who were busy with the pursuit of their own desires until they finally find the need to turn to God and follow His direction.
If you want to experience God early then you must seek Him early.
“O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary. Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name. My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips“ Psalm 63:1-5 (KJV)Your early season to seek God is now. It takes a lot of steadfastness to grow into the assignment of God for your life. There are no “short cuts”, you can’t jump process. There is no sudden success.Jesus didn’t just wake up to use the last three (3) years of His life to accomplish these great results. He spent the first 30 years of His life to be prepared and built up into His purpose.There are about 11 years between Paul’s conversion (in Acts 9:1-9) and when he and Barnabas were separated by the Holy Spirit to their unique assignment the Lord has set for them.Paul the apostle didn’t just step into the scene to accomplish the things which he did.David didn’t just receive boldness overnight to defeat Goliath. According to the testimony of David to Saul, just as Goliath has been trained for war since childhood, he (David) was also prepared by God through several experiences as a shepherd boy. David’s learnt early in his life to deliver any of his lamb from a lion or bear as a shepherd. Therefore He had that same confidence that the Lord will help him deliver Israel out of the hands of Goliath and the army of the Philistines. (1 Samuel 17:34-36).Before these moment, David had learnt to defend what has been entrusted to him. He was always ready for the victory against Goliath.
You cannot have early success when you don’t know how to make the most of every opportunity the Lord bring your way.
Don’t waste time!Set your affection on the Lord.Set your focus on the Lord and His assignment for your life. Stay committed to it now. Continue to serve the Lord’s purpose for your life. Be determined and diligent to accomplish the targets or goals given to you by the Lord.And you will begin to see the satisfaction of success.Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 90:12-17; Romans 13:11; Psalm 37:18-19; Ecclesiastes 9:12; Job 36:11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall make the Lord our focus and pursue His purpose now, so that we shall experience early success. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 8-11 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 44-45 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I incline my heart to the wisdom of God. – Through the wisdom of God, I make the most of every opportunity to have early success. – I make daily progress and success. – I make each day count. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1211 - BUILD YOURSELF UP
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Monday, 18th May, 2026BUILD YOURSELF UP“But you, my delightfully loved friends, constantly and progressively build yourselves up on the foundation of your most holy faith by praying every moment in the Spirit.” Jude 1:20 (TPT) If you have been following the for sometime now, you will find this statement very common:We do what God tells us to do by faith! You will stagger, give up or maintain a strong confidence in God according to your faith. We win and exercise our victory in Christ amidst opposition by Faith.  (1 John 5:4). We grow and increase in faith through the ministry of the word. (Romans 10:17). And faith operates by the word of God not by vim or some philosophy.
Without the word of God, there is no potent faith. To act in faith is to act on the Word.
“And since we have the same spirit of faith, according to what is written, “I believed and therefore I spoke,” we also believe and therefore speak,” 2 Corinthians 4:13 (NKJV). What you have believed is what God have said, and what God have said is His WORD. Faith only speaks what God have said. However, from Jude 20, we see how you have to build yourself up on your most holy faith: “But you, my delightfully loved friends, constantly and progressively build yourselves up on the foundation of your most holy faith by praying every moment in the Spirit” Jude 1:20 (TPT). There are moments and situations where you may feel weak, discouraged, and even dull in faith. However, you can constantly and progressively build yourself up by:PRAYING IN THE SPIRIT!To pray in the spirit is also to pray in other tongues.It’s interesting how people who don’t pray in tongues mock the effectual workings of praying in the spirit.
Beloved, it builds you up in faith, when you pray in tongues every moment.
As you pray in tongues you pray to God and speak mysteries. You decode spiritual things in the spirit as you pray in the spirit. When there is a moment where you feel so much pressure, and it seems you don’t have the right words to speak; BELOVED, don’t cry nor complain. Don’t feel helpless when you are overwhelmed by situations. There is a way forward:PRAY IN THE SPIRIT.As you pray you make supply of spiritual strength and you stir up the anointing of the Holy Spirit in you.
You also charge up yourself in faith.
Your spirit rises higher and higher in faith, like an edifice.The more you pray in the spirit, the more the Spirit of the Lord supplies your spirit with the right words to declare. As you pray in the spirit, the Holy Spirit through your spirit broods over your mind, will and emotions. Therefore, the more you pray, the more you take hold of the present word of God.
And as the present word or the rhema of God, wells up in your spirit, it saturates your mind, aligns your will to God, and channels your emotions and desires.
Because the rhema has soaked your entire being, it comes forth without doubt. At this point, the present word or the rhema of God, will gush forth with a force and the ability of God to produce effectual results.COME ON!WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?SEIZE THIS MOMENT TO PRAY IN TONGUES NOW.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 14:2, 14-15, 18; Ephesians 6:18; Acts 10:44-46) WE PRAY That our hearts will catch the very present word of God concerning every situation as we pray in the spirit. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 16-18 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 48 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t complain nor cry, I pray. – I give no place to the adversary. – As I pray in the spirit, I catch the very present word of God for my situation. – I don’t walk in doubt, fear or anxiety because through praying in the spirit I receive rhema. – Through praying in the spirit, I align my heart, will, mind, emotions and desires to the Will of God for me. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1212 - CAN YOU SEE THE RESULTS?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency What the adversary wants is for you to live in worry, anxiety and sorrow. This is how he gets you distracted in the pursuit of destiny. This is the main reason you have to pray. Author Tuesday, 19th, May, 2026CAN YOU SEE THE RESULTS?“And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.” Joshua 6:2 (NKJV)To fulfill ministry and accomplish great things, may seem to be challenging. Others are sometimes discouraged by the magnitude of the task.God doesn’t just want you to move into action.Accomplishing great things for the Lord doesn’t just come by trying to do something.You must have the right vision if you want to accomplish your task or hit your target.
Your ability to do more begins with what you see and how you see what you see.
Oftentimes the Lord charges His people to see.This is because you cannot experience what you have not seen with your heart or the spirit of your mind.To take over a city or win a town for Jesus through the gospel, you must first SEE!You cannot transform lives and bless your school, institution, or workplace until you see with the spirit of your mind.You must see your healing testimony. You must see the growth of your business. You must see your new level of impact.Look at what God said to Joshua:“And the LORD said to Joshua: “See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.” Joshua 6:2 (NKJV).This was a charge to Joshua to activate the power of his imagination.  
Your imagination influences your possession.
This was the same thing God said to Abraham and Moses:“I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession.” Genesis 13:15 (NLT).Oh, glory!Abraham’s possession was dependent on His vision. If Abraham had seen just a small portion, that was what he was going to have. If Abraham had seen the whole world, that was what He was going to have.“See, I have set the land before you; go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—to give to them and their descendants after them.” Deuteronomy 1:8 (NKJV)
Beloved, what do you SEE?
Which results are you seeing now?These are not some words of encouragement. I am talking to you about a divine principle that works. You cannot accomplish beyond what you have SEEN.Jesus said, “…lift up your eyes, and see that the fields are white for harvest.” John 4:35
 Train your mind to see the right results.
When you begin to see images you don’t want, shift your mind from them and redirect your imagination to the glorious pictures and results the Lord has deposited in your spirit.This is why you must study the Word and pray in tongues. When you pray, the Lord shows you visions. He unveils to your heart great and mighty things (Jeremiah 33:3)Hallelujah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 1:10-12; Isaiah 28:16; Joshua 8:1; Deut. 1:6-8) WE PRAYThat we will not be overwhelmed by the challenges that confront us but rather we will be strengthened with the grace to see the right results with our hearts at all times. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 19-21 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 49 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to see the challenges, I see possibilities. –  I see my new level. – I refuse to look away from what I have seen with my heart. – That which I have seen my hands will handle. – I keep my gaze on the right pictures in my heart. – I see a way out of that challenge (specify the challenge confronting you). – Through the study of the word of God and prayer, I train my mind to see the right results. – I refuse to see failure and defeat, I see possibilities. Oh Hallelujah!!  Gloreeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1213 - PRAYER IS A LABOUR OF PERSISTENCY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Stop worrying and start praying. Pray over everything no matter how little it may seem to be. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 20th May, 2026PRAYER IS A LABOUR OF PERSISTENCY“There is nothing in us that allows us to claim that we are capable of doing this work. The capacity we have comes from God.”2 Corinthians 3:5 (GNT)All that God has put in you are not for you; they are to bless nations. The impartation of God’s blessings in you is to cause you to make IMPACT in others.
Whenever God wants to bless a people He sends a man.
While Joseph was living a challenging life from slavery to prison, God was preparing him to be the escape for Jacob in the days of famine (Genesis 45:7). When Israel agonized with pain in Egypt, God raised Moses and sent him as their deliverer.However, God gave a word that He would go down to Egypt to save His people Israel. This means God sending Moses to Egypt was Himself going to Egypt to save Israel. (Exodus 2:23-25; 3:7-10; Acts 7:33-35).There are men whom God raised to be channels or conduits of blessings to their generation. And you (reading this with today) are one of the blessings God has sent to bless this generation.The grace and abilities of God within you are part of the answers God is sending to this generation at such a time as this.Nevertheless, you cannot fulfill this great mandate without God. To affect many lives positively you have to enlarge your capacity.“Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes; For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.” Isaiah 54:2-3 (KJV)To enlarge your capacity, you have to stretch your inner man through consistent and persistent long intense prayers.To begin with, I want you to know it is wrong to think short quick prayers are not prayers. Every prayer is prayer. The quality of prayer is not really how long you’ve prayed. The quality of prayer is how well it is founded on the word of God.
Every prayer rooted in the word is effective!
 THEREFORE, NO MATTER WHAT, PRAY!So then, if even short, quick prayers can be effective, much more when you give yourself to consistent long intense prayers?The idea of consistent long intense prayers is not about God expecting you to beg Him for long before He does something for you. Consistent long intense prayers are about having quality time with the Spirit.
The longer you spend time with the Spirit of the Lord in prayer, the stronger His influence on you becomes.
The Spirit of God enlarges your Spirit and strengthens your inner man. The anointing of the Holy Spirit on you becomes stronger.
Are you wondering what to say or pray about?
Cheer up!There is the gift of praying in the Spirit. Praying in the spirit includes praying in other tongues.Get this:“The one who speaks in tongues advances his own spiritual progress…” 1 Corinthians 14:4 (TPT)Since tongues speaking will cause you to advance your spiritual progress, or edify (embolden, build or construct your inner man), then do it more to make more spiritual progress!Beloved, even ten minutes of tongues speaking will build your spirit. Therefore make time to pray in tongues for 30 or 60 minutes; then grow it to 2 hours, and then 6 hours.
The longer you pray in the spirit, the stronger you are built and enlarged by the Spirit of God.
What are you waiting for?Come on, start speaking in tongues. EDIFY YOURSELF! INCREASE CAPACITY FOR GREATER IMPACT.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:30-31; Luke 18:1; Genesis 26:2; Isaiah 26:15; Isaiah 54:2; Psalm 143:10 [NLT]; 1 Peter 4:10 [TLB]) WE PRAYWe pray that, against all odds and hindrances, we shall break forth in our spirit and maintain intense consistency in prayer.In the name of Jesus.BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 22-24 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 50 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Rather than worrying about the size of the assignment, I pray. – I make intercession and supplication through the Spirit in my prayers. – I am given to prayer. – I pray and continue steadfastly in prayer.  – Through my effective prayers, I increase in capacity to do more. – I don’t settle for less, I persist long in prayers. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1214 - THE ATTITUDE THAT WINS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 21st May, 2026THE ATTITUDE THAT WINS“But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it”Numbers 14:24 (ESV)In today’s world, there are most people who have embellished their heart with their self-centered desires.Most people are running away from the inspirations of God, and running after the lies of the systems.Instead of living as champions they have become slaves of the systems. They see their fears instead of the faithful word of God.Don’t be like the masses. Be what God has called you to be.
Don’t run away from the tasks ahead. Pursue after the lion before you.
You cannot walk into the manifestation of God’s purpose for your life, until you boldly act out God’s word.The word of God processes your heart, to bring you into your full possession.All the children of Israel who didn’t allow the word of God to process their heart, couldn’t possess the land.Whenever your heart becomes overwhelmed by the challenges or the assignment of the Lord for you, know that you have turned away from His word.Take note of what the Lord said to the children of Israel and His testimony of Caleb:“But truly, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord, none of the men who have seen my glory and my signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and yet have put me to the test these ten times and have not obeyed my voice, shall see the land that I swore to give to their fathers. And none of those who despised me shall see it. But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it” Numbers 14:21-24 (ESV)There were people who couldn’t possess the land because they turned away from the Lord. These people did not obey the Lord’s voice though they witnessed His glorious signs in Egypt.They had every reason to be valiant in faith, yet chose to despise the Lord.But Caleb was different!He had a different spirit contrary to theirs.
To have a different spirit is simply to have a different attitude.
However, one’s attitude is always connected to the condition of the heart. Caleb’s attitude was as a result of how the word of the Lord had conditioned his heart.There twelve spies (12) sent to spy out the promised land, and 10 came with negative news which made the hearts of the people melt. They even saw themselves as grasshoppers.  These other ten (10) allowed fear to dominate their hearts. They couldn’t think there were any possibilities for the word of the Lord to come to pass.But Caleb and Joshua didn’t allow their hearts to fail. They demonstrated an attitude of faith. They stood upon the word of the Lord.Whiles others saw giants and limitations, they saw the giants as bread.
Beloved in Christ, God has not given you the spirit of fear.
You don’t have the spirit of the world, therefore you don’t think nor act as they do.You have another spirit or a different attitude. Your inward disposition is of power, love and a sound mind. (2 Timothy 1:7).You take steps as inspired by the Lord with boldness.You have the attitude that wins and prevails.You have the attitude of taking, conquering and possessing mountains.
Go through each day of the year with a different attitude.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Numbers 13:25-33; Numbers 14:6-9; Romans 4:20-21; Psalm 18:29; Psalm 27:3) WE PRAYWe pray that in all things we shall demonstrate the attitude of the spirit of faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 25-27 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 51 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have a different Spirit. – There is no fear in me. – As the Lord inspires my heart, I step forward in faith. – No target is too great for me to achieve. – No dream is too big for me to achieve. – I exercise my faith to go after every dream and target that God has placed in my heart.– I am not a coward. – I am a man of faith. – I am full of faith. – I have the attitude that wins and prevails. – I don’t  allow fear to dictate my decision. – I refuse to allow fear dominate my heart. – Fear has no grip on me. – I have the attitude of taking, conquering and possessing. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1215 - WILL THE GOOD PLAN OF GOD PROSPER IN YOUR HANDS?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency DARE TO DO SOMETHING GREAT FOR GOD today, this week, this month and this year. This is the TIME! Author Friday, 22nd May, 2026 WILL THE GOOD PLAN OF GOD PROSPER IN YOUR HANDS?“…Yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants. He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD’s good plan will prosper in his hands.“ Isaiah 53:10 (NLT)
God has great plans for His Kingdom, mankind, you, and all His creation.
God’s great intention or plan is that His glory will be expressed in fullness.To achieve this, God has ordained you to be the conduit for fulfilling His glorious plan. As a conduit or a steward of God’s great plan, you can determine the extent to which the work of God will be done. The things you desire to do were put in your heart by God. “For God is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases Him” Philippians 2:13 (NLT) Yours is to nurture the Lord’s desire in your heart; through prayer, meditation and the steps you take.
The more you take steps to act out God’s desire in your heart, the greater it becomes. 
God sees the need to entrust more to you, as you become faithful with the little He entrusts to you. The Lord enables you to do more, however, when you are not determined to work out what the Lord had purposed in your heart, you may fail. “The sons of Ephraim were armed as archers and carrying bows, Yet they turned back in the day of battle.” Psalm 78:9 (Amplified). These sons of Ephraim were armed and well equipped, yet turned back in the day of battle. You can be resourced and still turn away from the pursuit of purpose.
Make it your determination that the purpose and plan of the Lord shall prosper in your hands.
This was what the Prophet Isaiah declared concerning Jesus; “…He will enjoy a long life, and the LORD ’s good plan will prosper in his hands.” Isaiah 53:10 (NLT).
Beloved, God has called you for this reason; that His purpose and good plan will prosper in your hands.
Don’t settle for less, go for the ultimate plan of God. You are enabled for this purpose. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(2 Chronicles 30:12; 1 Corinthians 12:6; I Corinthians 15:10; Ephesians 1:5) WE PRAYThat we will faithfully work on that which the Lord has entrusted to us for the good plan of the Lord to prosper in our hands. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 28-30 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 52 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to be complacent, I press on to the mark of the high calling. – I don’t give excuses, I get the job done. – Through prayer, I take advantage of grace to press on. – I don’t stop halfway, I press on. – I go the extra mile. – I enlarge my scope and desire to do more for the Lord. – I do the extraordinary. – I am a Champion. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1218 - GIVE YOURSELF TO PRAYER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When you understand the intensity of this spiritual warfare, and the need to enforce the victory of Christ, you will always appreciate prayer as a battlefield transceiver. You are at war, stay alert and in touch with the Lord, through PRAYER. Selah. Author Sunday, 25th May, 2026 GIVE YOURSELF TO PRAYER“And the Lord said, “Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you as wheat.”Luke 22:31 (NKJV)As you can see in the opening verse, Beloved, what the Lord Jesus said to Peter wasn’t some hoax or a mock alert.Now since it wasn’t the interest of the Lord not to divulge such information from Peter, then you should know it was going to happen. But the good news is that the Lord showed us how He intercepted.The devil would have achieved his intention if not for the Lord’s interception. You will later find out how within a few hours after these words of the Lord, Peter denied being a disciple of Jesus.“Then they seized him and led him away, bringing him into the high priest’s house, and Peter was following at a distance. And when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them. Then a servant girl, seeing him as he sat in the light and looking closely at him, said, “This man also was with him.” But he denied it, saying, “Woman, I do not know him.” And a little later someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.” And after an interval of about an hour still another insisted, saying, “Certainly this man also was with him, for he too is a Galilean.” But Peter said, “Man, I do not know what you are talking about.” And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed. And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the saying of the Lord, how he had said to him, “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny me three times.” And he went out and wept bitterly.” Luke 22:54-62 (ESV)Peter denied his association with Jesus in front of a servant girl. Just in case you don’t know, it was this same Peter who when Jesus was being arrested by the men from the high priest, drew his sword and cut off the ear of Malchus (a servant of the high priest).Peter was actually trying to prove his loyalty to Jesus. When Jesus told Peter how the adversary had plotted to sift him, he thought it would take the strength of the flesh to withstand against the devil.Even when Jesus had said he had prayed for him, Peter still thought it would take his self-generated ability to stand in the Lord. His confidence was in himself and not the Lord.This was what Peter told the Lord:“Peter said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death.” Jesus said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me.” Luke 22:33-34 (ESV)Peter’s confidence failed. He denied the Lord three times and after He realized the words of Jesus, he felt disappointed and wept bitterly.Nevertheless in the resurrection, Jesus sent a message to the disciples specifically to Peter, for him to know that He the Lord wasn’t disappointed in him but still took interest in him.“And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him. But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.” Mark 16:7 (KJV).You can tell the joy that will be on Peter’s face hearing those lovely words.You don’t have to assume that the adversary wouldn’t attempt to sift you. And you don’t have to think you can remain strong in the Lord by the efforts of the flesh.James in his epistles gave a secret to the brethren:“Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.” James 4:7 (KJV).
Until you humble yourself before the Lord, you will not be able to take advantage of His supply to prevail.
And when you humble yourself you will be prayerful at all times. It takes humility to be prayerful (2 Chronicles 7:14).Jesus knew it would take the strength of God received through prayer to resist the plotting of the devil. So He prayed for Peter.Beloved, the adversary desires to sift you, however, you must yield to prayer and not your self-confidence.Selah!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 13:19; 1 Corinthians 10:13; Ephesians 6:11; James 4:7; Ephesians 4:27) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall remain deeply rooted and established in the Lord to the end and fulfillment of God’s purpose. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJob 39-41 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 61-63 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am given to prayer. – I have absolute confidence in the Lord who is able to keep me from falling. – I remain strong in the sufficient ability of God. – I will not fall. – None of my steps will slide. – I remain submitted to the Lord. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1226- PRAY FOR OTHERS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 2nd June, 2026PRAY FOR OTHERS “Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints” Ephesians 6:18 (KJV)To make supplication for all the saints is an essential contribution to the growth of the whole body of Christ.Prayer in itself makes tremendous power available to cause changes.Thus, through your prayer of supplication for the saints, the Holy Spirit supplies divine energies for change.
God will always step into situations when men submit that situation to Him in prayer.
There was a point when Herod arrested and executed James the brother of John with a sword. When he noticed it pleased the people, he proceeded to arrest Peter. When Peter was imprisoned, the Church decided to change the situation.This time, the saints didn’t sit to look on, assuming that God would automatically step into the situation. They made a decision to pray.“Thus Peter was kept in the prison, but prayer was fervently being made to God by the church for him.” Acts 12:5 (Lexham English Bible).The Church continued earnestly in prayer until Peter returned to them.Through the prayers of the saints, an angel was deployed to bring deliverance to Peter.Sometimes some saints may have a challenge and become helpless not knowing what to do. As you consistently and earnestly pray for the saints, you deliver them from helpless situations.
The adversary is looking for every opportunity to ensnare and destroy the people of God, therefore, we must make supplications for one another.
Jesus said to Peter:“Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has demanded to sift you like wheat, but I have prayed for you, that your faith may not fail. And you, when once you have turned back, strengthen your brothers” Luke 22:31-32 (Lexham English Bible).Satan has not refrained from finding an opportunity to sift the brethren like wheat.Don’t join the world to criticize and condemn the Church and weak saints.Pray for your Pastor or Church leader and all the other saints that their faith will not faint.
Please get into prayer now.
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Acts 12:5-14; 2 Thessalonians 3:1; 1 Timothy 2:1; 2 Corinthians 9:14) WE PRAYWe pray for all saints that they will not faint in their faith. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026  DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I seek for the well-being of all the saints. – I grow in love for the saints.– I make supplications for the saints my habit.– I see every believer as a brother and I make supplication for them.– None of the saints shall fail nor faint in their faith.– We are a people of prayer. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1227 - ARE YOU RUNNING IN THIS COMMAND?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Live every day of your life by running towards the goal the Lord has set before you. Don’t run away from purpose, run towards the purpose of God for you. Hallelujah! Author Wednesday, 3rd June, 2026 ARE YOU RUNNING IN THIS COMMAND?“I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.”Psalm 119:32 (Berean Standard Bible) At the beginning of this year, the word of the Lord came to you. This word of the Lord to you is God’s direction for your life and instructions for your future.
It is important to give it your focus and commit your mind to it.
Within the Christ Commonwealth Global (Love-Life Agency), the Lord has given us a word which is the focus of our Personal lives and Corporate expression. Our year 2026 is the year of: FULLNESS - Our Year of Fullness of the Spirit!- Our Year of Fullness of the Blessings of the Gospel!- Our Year of Fullness of Joy!- Our Year of Fullness of Faith!- Our Year of Fullness of Hope!- Our Year of Fullness of Power!- Our Year of Fullness of the Earth!- Our Year of Fullness of the Sea! This is the commandment of the Lord to you. It is one thing to receive the Word of the Lord, it is another thing to run with the Word of the Lord. Every Word of the Lord to you has its established path. The more you walk in the direction or path of the Word, the more your understanding is deepened and enlarged.
The path of the Word includes the instruction of the Word.
The path of the Word is what brings you into the fulfilment of the Word. By the Word of the Lord to you for the year, you know you have to change your prayer habit, establish better associations and avoid wrong ones. The instruction of the Word also came with an inspiration to give yourself to reading some materials and work towards some daily ministry targets. Are you running in this command?
Beloved, you have to esteem those instructions and run by them.
We are in the last of the first half of the year. Intentionally realign yourself with this command and run in it. The best is yet to come. Take advantage of this and work out the command for the year.  Great grace abounds towards you. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:31-33; Hebrews 12:1; Psalm 18:36) WE PRAYWe pray that we will grow and increase in understanding the paths of the Lord’s command. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 26-28 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 72DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take heed to the instructions of God for the year. – I focus and run in the path of the Lord’s command. – I consecrate my heart and mind to the word of the Lord for the year. – I don’t turn away from the instructions no matter the matter. – I stand firmly by the Word and lay aside every weight. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1228 - BE DILIGENT WITH THE WORK COMMITTED TO YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Thursday, 4th June, 2026BE DILIGENT TO THE WORK COMMITTED TO YOU“Herald and preach the Word! Keep your sense of urgency [stand by, be at hand and ready], whether the opportunity seems to be favorable or unfavorable…”2 Timothy 4:2 (AMPC) Beloved, you can’t be a world changer or a global icon by mouth. In as much as what you confess is important to your success, you must understand that your choice of action will determine the extent to which you may lead your generation. Every great leader has a sense of urgency every day.
Consistent impact is born through a consistent routine.
It is not the Father’s will that you experience one-time success. He wants you to have daily success. To make a difference in your generation, take daily steps to make the dream of God in your heart a reality. You can’t be one who procrastinates, wastes or spends time on non-essentials or things that don’t directly contribute to your target and vision.
You have to be disciplined to work towards your goal.
Until you maintain a strong sense of urgency concerning your goals, you may not be disciplined, diligent and consistent. This is one of the great secrets to prosperity and greatness. Be prompt to do it! Whatever the Lord inspires or instructs you to do, do it with urgency. There is no time to waste. Procrastination is a destroyer of destiny and fulfilment. Laziness is the act of the poor. And being lazy and wasting time doesn’t mean you are doing nothing. You can spend time doing something which doesn’t contribute to your action plan. You have no sense of urgency when you spend time surfing the internet and watching funny clips when you should be praying.
Anything you do with your time must be an intentional step to contribute to your progress.
Refuse to be lazy. The lazy have no sense of urgency. They do things on their own time and not according to the standard of the assignment. Your routine must represent the level of greatness. ”The soul of a lazy man desires and has nothing, but the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.” Proverbs 13:4 Don’t just desire or wish to be successful and great. Be diligent in working towards your greatness. ”Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.” Proverbs 12:24. Diligence with a sense of urgency is a characteristic of all prosperous leaders who lead and transform their generation.The Bible says that David rose early in the morning and went to the camp as his father had commanded. (1 Samuel 17:20).And Abraham got up early in the morning to do what the Lord had instructed (Genesis 22:3-4). You will find this sense of urgency, promptness and diligence with these great men in the scriptures. They knew their success was in how they urgently acted on the instructions they received.
There is no success in procrastination.
How urgent are you working towards your goals for today, for the week, for the month and the upcoming year? You can reach your target and maintain a sense of urgency!!! Selah. DIG DEEPER(2 Timothy 2:6-7; Romans 12:11-12;Ecclesiastes 10:18; Proverbs 12:11; Proverbs 10:4-5; Deuteronomy 24:19) WE PRAYThat we will be enabled with the grace to be diligent in all that our hands finds to do. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 29-31 2 YEARS PLANPsalms 73 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Whatever the Lord requires me to do, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In giving, I give with a sense of urgency. – In soul winning, I do it with a sense of urgency. – In prayer and the study of the word, I do it with a sense of urgency. – I refuse to procrastinate. – I get the job done on time. – I get the results. – I diligently act on the word of God. – I make each day count. – I make daily progress and success. – Whatever my hands finds to do, I do it with diligence and I see the results thereof. – I win everyday. – I am not a waster of resources. – Through wisdom and diligent hands I maximize every resource the Lord has entrusted to me. – I am a success. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1233 - DON’T FALL FOR THE TRAP
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 9th June, 2026DON’T FALL FOR THE TRAP“Not forsaking our meeting together [as believers for worship and instruction], as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another; and all the more [faithfully] as you see the day [of Christ’s return] approaching.”Hebrews 10:25 (Amplified Bible)The term isolate is fundamentally derived from the Latin “insulatus” — which literally denotes the act of being “made into an island” or “placed upon an island”. The term conveys the deliberate detachment of an entity from its broader and organic environment.One of the greatest threats to your consistent walk of faith and growth in the Lord is the desire to be isolated from the Church (which is Christ’s body).It is an error and a trap of the adversary for you to be isolated from the Body of Christ. You are a member of the body, together with the saints.“Now you [collectively] are Christ’s body, and individually [you are] members of it [each with his own special purpose and function].” 1 Corinthians 12:27 (Amplified Bible)How well will a kidney thrive when it is isolated from the body?We are called to be isolated from the world because we are not of this world (John 15:19). However, we live together within the body for the benefit (service) of one another.This post-COVID pandemic world disclosed isolation as a more dangerous epidemic within the Church community.The very first warning in creation was that it is “not good for man to be alone” (Genesis 2:18).Ironically, many isolate themselves from the Church under the guise of pursuing a deeper spiritual life, only to become fixated on digital distractions. Under the pretext of seeking the Holy Spirit, they succumb to endless surfing, using isolation to escape accountability or to indulge in misguided, self-focused philosophies.These philosophies are void of true satisfaction.One of the key factors contributing to this isolation is the propounded concept of self-love.Self-love has become the new chant in this generation. Most motivational speeches, online content, campus lectures, post-modernistic mental health campaigns promote this concept of self-love.They talk about “self-care”, “soul strolls”, “solo-dating”, “self-parenting” or “mothering” oneself, or “your inner child” and “unapologetic” living (as in no longer apologising for being yourself).Beyond pampering, “self-love” has evolved into deeper emotional, mental, and boundary-focused practices.It has been brandished as a more intentional, fierce practice of mental health and autonomy or personal sovereignty.This does not birth organic stability and peace.The word of God holds the definitive answers to the mysteries of the soul and the complexities of human nature.As a new creation in Christ, your thoughts must align with the truth of the word.The recent pandemic served as a catalyst for an agenda designed to isolate believers and shipwreck their faith, with the destructive doctrine of self-love at its epicenter.But is that not a fulfilment of the Apostle Paul’s apostolic prophecy?Here is what he said:“But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, proud, arrogant…” 2 Timothy 3:1–2 (ESV)Beloved, we are at the deeper end of the last days. The enemy has also deployed all his arsenals to prevent the saints from taking heed to execute their divine ordination.You become exposed to the wiles of the devil when you are isolated from the fold.Let nothing draw you away from the brethren. Do not become a prey. Within the fold, you are safe. Attending church meetings and being actively involved in the Church is not an option but a necessary necessity for your nourishment and consistent participation in God’s agenda.Remain knitted with Christ and with the saints.Refuse to be isolated.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Acts 2:42; Matthew 18:20; Psalm 122:1; Ecclesiastes 4:9-12; Hebrews 3:13) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not fall into the trap to desire isolation from the saints, but shall daily be active in the community of the saints. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 46–482 YEARS PLANPsalms 80DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I shall not fail into the trap of desiring isolation from the saints. – I remain knitted with Christ and the saints. – I allow nothing to draw me away from the brethren. – I refuse to allow myself become a prey to the adversary. – I remain active in the community of the saints. – I refuse to be isolated. Oh glory to Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1234 - SOMETHING MORE THAN RELIGION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 10th June, 2026 SOMETHING MORE THAN RELIGION “so that it is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me. This life that I live now, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me” Galatians 2:20 (GNT) Undoubtedly, there are many religions or religious groups in the world. However, true Christianity is not one of these religions; though over a period of time some have created a religion out of the true Christian faith. Those who believed in Jesus were referred to as Christians in Antioch, because of the life they exuded. They were not called Christians because of their religious activities. “…It was in Antioch that the followers of Jesus were first revealed as “anointed ones”. Acts 11:26 (TPT) From the King James Bible, the word used was “called” instead of “revealed”.
The word “called” is from the Greek word, “Chrematizo” which means to utter an oracle or to divinely intimate; it is to reveal and to constitute a certain reality.
In Antioch, the believers in Christ were not just called “Christians” as a term. They spoke of them as Christians, by supernatural revelation.  Christ, (Christos in Greek) means the anointed. True Christians are:– followers of Christ– a people who are in oneness of fellowship with Christ – and also the anointed ones by supernatural revelation.
True Christianity is not following Christ by trying to obey some external rules. It is living an organic life.
It is great to know that Jesus rose from the dead and ascended into Heaven. (Acts 1:9-12); yet you may not experience the reality of His life. The glorious mystery of God revealed is that, Christ is in you (Colossians 1:27). To know True Christianity is to know that the Christ who ascended, now lives in you through the Spirit. This is not religion. This is life!
True Christianity is the expression of God’s life in you.
Please take a look at the opening verse in the Passion Translation: “My old identity has been co-crucified with Messiah and no longer lives; for the nails of his cross crucified me with him. And now the essence of this new life is no longer mine, for the Anointed One lives his life through me—we live in union as one! My new life is empowered by the faith of the Son of God who loves me so much that he gave himself for me, and dispenses his life into mine“ Galatians 2:20 (TPT)
Beloved, True Christianity is Christ living in you. It is functioning by faith in Christ. This transcends religion. 
Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:17; 2 Thessalonians 1:10; Colossians 3:4; Romans 8:10; Galatians 4:19) WE PRAYWe pray that we will live out our true life which is Christ and not function merely according to religious systems. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalms 49–512 YEARS PLANPsalms 81DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the life of God at work in me. – I function by faith in Christ and not by religious systems. – Christ is in me.  Oh Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1235 - HOW TO ENFORCE GREAT VICTORY IN ALL SITUATIONS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency You must have the habit of spending time alone with God. It is in that atmosphere that the Lord is able to open your eyes to see. It is in that atmosphere the Lord shows you the way to go. Shalom! Author Thursday, 11th June, 2026HOW TO ENFORCE GREAT VICTORY IN ALL SITUATIONS “Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church.” Acts 12:5 (NKJV) What is your first response to challenges or pressure from opposition? Time and time again in scriptures, you will find God’s people responding to challenging situations with prayer.
Don’t give anyone room to underestimate the effectual workings of prayer.
One of the evidence that you have confidence in God’s ability is how you respond to situations through prayer. Did you take time to pay attention to the opening verse? Look at the full story: “Now about that time Herod the king stretched out his hand to harass some from the church. Then he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to seize Peter also. Now it was during the Days of Unleavened Bread. So when he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of soldiers to keep him, intending to bring him before the people after Passover. Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church. And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were [keeping the prison. Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, “Arise quickly!” And his chains fell off his hands. Then the angel said to him, “Gird yourself and tie on your sandals”; and so he did. And he said to him, “Put on your garment and follow me.” So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision. When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him. And when Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.” Acts 12:1-11 (NKJV)— Herod decided to harass the Church, so he killed James, the brother of John.— He saw the people were pleased, so he arrested Peter, and purposed to kill him after Passover.— Nevertheless, the Church responded to this situation differently.We didn’t see the response of the Church when James was arrested. It was likely they reacted in fear and only went to hide.But when Peter was arrested, the Church responded with earnest, constant PRAYERS.The earnest prayers of the brethren dispatched an angel to release Peter from prison. Considering the soldiers assigned to guard Peter in the prison and even outside the prison, it will only take a supernatural hand to deliver him.No matter the challenge, get into prayer. In the place of prayer:— You will receive strength.— Your faith will be strengthened.— You will receive direction as to what to do.— You will see visions— The great help and answers of God will be released.Paul said to the Philippians:“Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God; and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus” Philippians 4: 6-7 (NKJV).
Don’t cry, don’t be anxious, don’t worry, don’t fret, ONLY PRAY!
Nehemiah, when he was opposed, prayed to God.When Daniel and his friends’ lives were under threat, they prayed to receive understanding of the King’s dream. David prayed when he was under threat.Jesus prayed when He was overwhelmed by the burden of His crucifixion, and He received strength. It took prayer for Esther, Mordecai and the Jews to reverse Haman’s plot against them. Beloved, refuse to be troubled; get into prayer.The saints were together praying until they saw Peter at home. “And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying” Acts 12:12 Pray earnestly until you have really prayed. Pray until you are fully convinced in your spirit that it is settled. 
Pray until you see the victory, not until you feel tired.
It means you may feel tired, but you have to continue earnestly in prayer.GET INTO PRAYER!DIG DEEPER(Matthew 18:19; Isaiah 62:6-7; Esther 4:16; Daniel 2:15-18; Luke 22:39-46) WE PRAYThat by the mighty hand of the Lord we shall see great victory in all situations, no matter the pressure and opposition. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 52–542 YEARS PLANPsalms 82DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I don’t stagger in faith. – By the strength of God, I prevail. – With God I do valiantly. – I don’t lack strength, I increase in strength by the day. – I don’t consider the opposition or pressure, I turn to God. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1239 - ESTEEM THIS GOSPEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency There is something special about giving into God’s agenda. A cheerful prompt to do it giver has a genuine heart for God. And the Lord takes pleasure in such giver. Beloved, dare to be a radical giver! Author Monday, 15th June, 2026 ESTEEM THIS  GOSPEL“For unlike so many, we are not peddlers of God’s Word who water down the message. We are those sent from God with pure motives, who speak in the sight of God from our union with Christ.”2 Corinthians 2:17 (TPT)The gospel is the goodnews of Jesus. In the Kingdom of our Lord Jesus, there are no two gospels; the gospel is one.
There is no goodnews in the universe which is as good as the glorious news of Jesus.
The gospel of our Lord Jesus is the consistent revelation of God in Christ Jesus.It is the declaration of the supply of God’s love and demonstration of His graciousness.The gospel unveils how God has justified all who received Jesus and has made them righteous in Christ. It is the communication of God’s eternal forgiveness.The gospel says, you are not saved by your works or self-efforts. But you are saved by grace through faith in Christ Jesus.“For it was only through this wonderful grace that we believed in him. Nothing we did could ever earn this salvation, for it was the gracious gift from God that brought us to Christ! So no one will ever be able to boast, for salvation is never a reward for good works or human striving.” Ephesians 2:8-9 (TPT)To preach that we are saved by grace, however, we need our works to preserve our salvation, is to water down the good news of Jesus.
The moment the security of our salvation is preached on the grounds of our self-efforts, we should know that the Gospel is peddled.
Peddlers of the gospel portray God’s love demonstrated on the condition of our good self-efforts.But that is not what the love of God is; the love of God is unconditional.Jesus did not die for you because you were righteous. He died for all men when we were yet sinners.The only price which was paid for the salvation of men was the blood of Jesus. Though salvation is not cheap, God has freely made it available for us through Christ Jesus.To preach the gospel for self-gain or selfish interest is to peddle or water down the gospel of Jesus.That which the Lord has done is complete!It does not need additives or your sentiments to make it whole.Jesus did a finished work through His death and resurrection.
When your goal of preaching the gospel is also to enrich your selfish ambition, you may have to preach a mixed gospel which also another gospel.
When you preach the gospel of Jesus, people will focus on the Lord and not on the preacher.Don’t water down what the Lord has accomplished because of how you feel.Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 4:2; 1 Thessalonians 2:3-5; 2 Peter 2:3; Titus 1:11; Galatians 1:10; Acts 20:29-30) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall greatly esteem the glorious gospel of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 66–682 YEARS PLANPsalms 88DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I esteem the glorious gospel of Jesus. – I don’t water down what the Lord has accomplished. – I don’t peddle the gospel. – My salvation is eternal. – I am bold about the gospel of Our Lord Jesus.  – I preach the gospel of Christ with boldness. – I give no room for any other gospel. Oh, thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1240 - REMAIN IN THE SIMPLICITY OF THE GOSPEL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Your calling and commission to publish or herald the good news of Jesus is as one with beautiful feet upon the mountains; because it is a high calling. Beloved, don’t belittle the responsibility of heralding or preaching the glorious gospel of Jesus. Esteem it above any other calling. Hallelujah! Author Tuesday, 16th June, 2026 REMAIN IN THE SIMPLICITY OF THE GOSPEL “But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ”2 Corinthians 11: 3 (NKJV)What do you think was Paul’s greatest concern for the Churches he planted and the people he raised?
It is that they will not be moved away from the gospel of Jesus.
And that is the same concern of all the Apostles of Jesus.Today’s Church has a different understanding of who a False Teacher, False Prophet and False Apostle is in their midst.Most Teachers, Prophets and Apostles who will be called false are now celebrated by “Christians” as True teachers.The Church doesn’t know the difference between another gospel and the true gospel of Jesus.Paul instructed the leaders in Ephesus to be watchful of false teachers and prophets.He called these false teachers ferocious wolves. And he said they will speak perverse and distorted things (Acts 20:29-30).These things they speak are contrary to the gospel of Jesus. Remember, there are no two gospels. The gospel of Jesus is the gospel of Grace.See Paul’s commendation:“And now I commend you to God [placing you in His protective, loving care] and [I commend you] to the word of His grace [the counsel and promises of His unmerited favor]. His grace is able to build you up and to give you the [rightful] inheritance among all those who are sanctified [that is, among those who are set apart for God’s purpose–all believers].” Acts 20:32 (Amplified). Falsehood has always been in contrast to the revelation or the gospel (the goodnews) of Jesus.Look at the opening verse in context:“I am anxious for you with the deep concern of God himself—anxious that your love should be for Christ alone, just as a pure maiden saves her love for one man only, for the one who will be her husband.  But I am frightened, fearing that in some way you will be led away from your pure and simple devotion to our Lord, just as Eve was deceived by Satan in the Garden of Eden. You seem so gullible: you believe whatever anyone tells you even if he is preaching about another Jesus than the one we preach, or a different spirit than the Holy Spirit you received, or shows you a different way to be saved. You swallow it all.”  2 Corinthians 11:2-4 (TLB)
The simplicity of Jesus is the gospel of Jesus. Your commitment to the gospel is your pure and simple devotion to Jesus.
Stand strong in the glorious revelation of Jesus.Also, note that not all false gospel is preached by fake Pastors or Teachers or Apostles. Some people are genuinely called of God and sent by Christ, yet may find themselves teaching another gospel.It doesn’t mean the people are false, but their message or aspects of their teachings may be false.For example:One will teach that, “You are saved only by grace through faith in Christ Jesus and not by works”.That is the true gospel.However, after this person gets people saved, he begins to teach the saints another gospel, saying, “Though you are now saved, you can lose your salvation. Your salvation is not forever; it depends on your good works”.Beloved, this is a clear example of false teaching.To say one will lose his salvation is to say that the blood of Jesus is not enough to satisfy the demand of Justice. (I gave over 50 reasons you cannot lose your Salvation, click here to watch).To understand Justification, read the following: – Justification 1 – 3– Justified by Faith– Christ’s won freedom wasn’t partial– The Case is closed– What shall separate you?
Your salvation only depends on the good works of Jesus. It is not dependent on your works. (Ephesians 2:9).
Now, because you have been made righteous by Jesus, you live right unto God’s glory.This is the gospel.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Galatians 1:6-12; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 4:3-4; Hebrews 3:7 -19; Ephesians 4:11- 15; Acts 20:28-32) WE PRAYWe pray that we will not be given to another gospel but will consciously remain strong in the simplicity of the gospel and not swallow any other teaching at all. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 69–712 YEARS PLANPsalms 89DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am justified eternally by the finished work of Christ. – I am righteous by faith in Christ. – My salvation is eternal. – I give no room for any other gospel. Oh Hallelujah! Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1241 - DEMONSTRATE GENEROSITY IN EVERY WAY
content:
