CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 17th June, 2026DEMONSTRATE IN EVERY WAY“I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward” Philippians 4:17 (TPT)Some saints within the Church easily frown at every conversation which has to do with giving or generosity towards the spread of the gospel. These are untrained men.Some don’t want any conversation about giving or the generosity of the saints because they feel they don’t have the resources to give. But that is a mere demonstration of immaturity or lack of understanding.Others refuse to give because they assume their giving makes the Church leaders rich. These people don’t know the cost of the spread of the gospel.Especially in today’s world, the resources needed to spread the gospel are more costly.When a Church or a ministry desires to massively spread the gospel, they will need to massively commit their resources, because it will cost more. But what is more costly than the blood of Jesus? To reach every soul and to effectively disciple every saint, we must be willing to commit more resources.Nothing about the spread of the gospel comes cheap; from the time needed, the cost of venue, setting up the meeting place according to the requirements of the government, dealing with harsh weather conditions, equipment, supporting the needs of the saints, paying bills and etc, will not come cheap.The generosity of the saints or giving of the saints towards God’s Kingdom mission is an opportunity God gives to the saints to demonstrate their love towards His Kingdom.
Every saint in Christ must take advantage of such an opportunity to demonstrate their participation and love in God’s Kingdom.
The generosity of the saints is the joyful sharing of their treasures (valuable resources) for the advancement of the gospel.The beautiful thing about God’s wisdom in this is that, as you give generously towards the Lord’s work, your love towards the success of His work is deepened.“for where your treasure is, there your heart [your wishes, your desires; that on which your life centers] will be also.” Matthew 6:21 (Amplified Bible)This then means, generosity is not what God demands or wants from you. Generosity is what God wants for you.God is not in need of money. He only wants faithful stewards. He wants men He can trust more and more with His Kingdom resources. Men who will not receive His grace in vain but will faithfully serve His purpose with His grace.This is why, concerning the generosity of the saints, Paul the apostle doesn’t address God’s need but first points out the grace God wants to supply.
Your generosity is first for your benefit. And you must see it as a privilege whenever you have the opportunity to give.
When people think about generosity in the gospel, they first think of it as a means to “increase money” as though it’s another form of lottery.There are fruits which abound towards you. And since there are fruits of generosity, it means there is a principle of multiplication. However, these fruits of multiplication of generosity transcend the idea of coming with little money and taking more money home.There are greater fruits which abound towards you because of your generosity.From the opening verse, you will find that the fruit of generosity brings you abundant reward.These are the things we will explore further as we continue this conversation.Your giving doesn’t make God rich. Get this: God’s blessings make you rich. The giving by God’s people is the means by which God executes His kingdom mandate and dispenses His abundance.After David and His people had given towards His work, He said to the LORD, “But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able thus to offer willingly? For all things come from you, and of your own have we given you.” 1 Chronicles 29:14 (ESV)
You don’t give into God’s work to complete God. You give into God’s work as a demonstration of faithfulness towards Him.
Do you love the Lord?Are you interested in the expansion of the Kingdom?Are you interested in the growth of the saints?Demonstrate your love through your generosity.The LORD has given you grace.Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Job 41:11; 2 Corinthians 9:10-11; Proverbs 3:9-10; Deuteronomy 8:17-18; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAY We pray that we shall not withhold our resources from the Lord’s work, but shall enjoy more and more grace to demonstrate our generosity in every way. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 72–742 YEARS PLANPsalms 90DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1242 - TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE GIVING-GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency When your TARGET is not your INNER REALITY; you cannot MANIFEST. Anything you think it cannot be done or is too difficult to do wouldn't manifest through. God will only do according to the POWER IN YOU. Which POWER have you generated for the divine agenda? Set your mind on it and see the possibiliy in your spirit. SELAH! Author Thursday, 18th June, 2026 TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE GIVING-GRACE“I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward”Philippians 4:17 (TPT)The generosity of the saints or giving of the saints towards God’s Kingdom mission is an opportunity God gives to the saints to demonstrate their love towards His Kingdom.Giving into the spread of the Gospel or the work of the ministry imparts your heart and gives you the opportunity to participate in the impact of the gospel.
Whatever the Lord inspires you to do for the advancement of His Kingdom, builds and enrich your heart.
There is a reward or profit which abounds for you because of your generosity.This is part of the reasons your giving is an opportunity or privilege.Let’s look into some of the benefits of giving (or the generosity of the saints), without following any order of importance.Your Generosity Leads to the Increase of Resources.Read Philippians 4:17 from the GOOD WORD Translation:“It’s not that I’m looking for a gift. The opposite is true. I’m looking for your resources to increase.”
 Though your generosity blesses lives, it is also to your advantage. The fruit of your generosity brings reward to you.
Whenever you are asked to give or whenever there is a conversation about your generosity, don’t just think it’s because your gift is needed.  See the opportunity to receive a bountiful supply.This was the situation with the Church in Philippi. They saw their giving to the ministry of Paul as an opportunity.Paul didn’t just appreciate their giving; his heart was filled with joy and was greatly satisfied by their giving.“My heart overflows with joy when I think of how you showed your love to me by your financial support of my ministry. For even though you have so little, you still continue to help me at every opportunity. I’m not telling you this because I’m in need, for I have learned to be satisfied in any circumstance”Philippians 4:10-11 (TPT)These saints didn’t give just because they had an abundance of resources. But even with the little they had, they were determined to give bountifully.Paul again wrote on this to the Church in Corinth concerning the Churches in Macedonia (which includes Phillipi, Thessalonica, Berea and etc). Philippi is a prominent city in Macedonia. This means, when Paul wrote about the generosity of the saints in Macedonia, he was also talking about the Philippians.“Beloved ones, we must tell you about the grace God poured out upon the churches of Macedonia. For even during a season of severe difficulty and tremendous suffering, they became even more filled with joy. From the depths of their extreme poverty, super-abundant joy overflowed into an act of extravagant generosity. For I can verify that they spontaneously gave, not only according to their means but far beyond what they could afford.” 2 Corinthians 8:1-3 (Amplified Bible).These Macedonians love the Lord so much that they were not hindered by the outward limitations but took advantage of the grace of God to give by conviction.No wonder Paul the apostle desired for their resources to increase. It is not just Paul who had this desire; it is a Kingdom principle:“He that is faithful in little, is faithful in much” (Luke 16:10)
You are entrusted with more when you demonstrate faithful stewardship in the little things.
When you receive more, you increase your giving capacity. And the more you give, the more you enjoy the increase of generosity.“Now [remember] this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and he who sows generously [that blessings may come to others] will also reap generously [and be blessed].” 2 Corinthians 9:6 (Amplified Bible)There are some who conclude that the increase of resources or the fruit of generosity is only in the supply of grace. However, it is important to know that the supply of grace is not only an inward capacity; it is also:  – Every favour and earthly blessing.Earthly blessing is the outward manifestation (material resources produced) of the inward blessings. Though ministry is spiritual, it requires material resources to execute its workings.“And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.” 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)– More enrichment to have more to give.“You will be enriched in every way so that you may be generous, and this [generosity, administered] through us is producing thanksgiving to God [from those who benefit” 2 Corinthians 9:11 (Amplified Bible)Learn to take advantage of every giving opportunity to demonstrate love towards the Lord and to increase in more and more grace. 
Every giving is a demonstration of your faithfulness towards the spread and advancement of the gospel.
Don’t receive the grace of God in vain. Be like the Macedonians who took advantage of the giving-grace to support the ministry of Paul.Shalom Aleichem!DIG DEEPER(Job 41:11; Proverbs 3:9-10; Deuteronomy 8:17-18; Hebrews 6:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not withhold our resources from the Lord’s work, but shall enjoy more and more grace to demonstrate our generosity in every way. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 75–772 YEARS PLANPsalms 91DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. – The Lord is my provider and multiplies my resources. – I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation).  – I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work) – I am a self-sufficient giver by the grace of God.  – I possess enough and require no aid or support to give. – I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Friday, 19th June, 2026 EXERCISE GENEROSITY TOWARDS THE LORD“I mention this not because I’m requesting a gift, but so that the fruit of your generosity may bring you an abundant reward” Philippians 4:17 (TPT)Though your generosity blesses lives, it is also to your advantage. Giving or generosity is something God wants for us.The giver benefits far more than the receiver.“I’ve left you an example of how you should serve and take care of those who are weak. For we must always cherish the words of our Lord Jesus, who taught, ‘Giving brings a far greater blessing than receiving.” Acts 20:35 (TPT)From the previous episode, we addressed one of the rewards of the generosity of the saints:– Your Generosity Leads to the Increase of ResourcesAnother benefit or profit of generosity is:– The Love for God and His Kingdom is deepened in Your HeartThis is the great growth of the saint.Generosity doesn’t only give you the opportunity to participate in the spread and impact of the gospel.

title: EPISODE 1254 - TRUE FAITH TOWARDS GOD IS HUMBLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 30th June 2026 TRUE FAITH TOWARDS GOD IS HUMBLE “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.”Ephesians 6:16 (KJV)Pride is one of the strong weapons of the enemy against your faith and fulfilment of purpose.The adversary knows that “Pride goes before destruction” (Proverbs 16:18).Therefore to destroy any beautiful destiny, he sows and cultivates pride in the hearts of men.
A proud person is resisted and cannot increase in grace.
Pride makes a person disrespect, disdain and act arrogantly towards others. It makes one, overly esteem himself above others.Pride makes you self-centered and unruly. You would always want things to go your way and give no attention to anyone. Pride makes you do what you feel and despise wise counsel.Whenever you esteem your opinions above the wisdom of God’s word, know that pride has taken root in your heart. You cannot resist the devil when you are proud. To resist the devil, you must first humble yourself before the Lord. James said, “Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you”(James 4:7).As we discussed concerning David yesterday, he didn’t confront Goliath in the might of the flesh or his strength and intelligence but in the name of the Lord.
Pride will not make you submit your mind, thoughts, and emotions to the Lord.
The adversary was the first in God’s universe to demonstrate pride. He began to exalt himself above the Lord. That was the cause of his fall.God has exalted His word, so when you begin to esteem your opinions above the word of God, you are already on the path of the devil. The end will surely be destruction.“for the day is coming when your proud looks will be brought low; the Lord alone will be exalted. On that day the Lord Almighty will move against the proud and haughty and bring them to the dust. All the tall cedars of Lebanon and all the mighty oaks of Bashan shall bend low, and all the high mountains and hills, and every high tower and wall, and all the proud ocean ships and trim harbor craft—all shall be crushed before the Lord that day. All the glory of mankind will bow low; the pride of men will lie in the dust, and the Lord alone will be exalted.” Isaiah 2:11-17 (TLB)
The adversary sets you up for failure and disgrace through pride. Intentionally deal with pride.
True faith towards God is humble. It takes humility to look away from your challenges and to exercise confidence in what God has said.“God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble.” Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time, casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you” (1Peter 5:5-7)It will take the attitude of humility to take up the shield of faith. Don’t trust in your intelligence above the knowledge of God’s word. 
Don’t be big-headed, be humble at all times.
Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Micah 6:8; Isaiah 3:16-26; Colossians 3:12; 2 Chronicles 7:14; Luke 14:11; Proverbs 3:34) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall be helped by the Holy Spirit to consciously walk in the humility of heart at all times and in all things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANPsalms 115–1172 YEARS PLANPsalms 107DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I submit my will, emotions, thoughts and body to the Lord. – The word of God directs my life. – There’s no place for pride in my heart.– By the help of the Holy Spirit, I walk in humble at all times in all things.Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1255 - THE BLOOD OF THE PASSOVER LAMB
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Are you bruised and pained by the rising floods and the vicissitudes of "life storm"? Do not let weariness overtake you. Earthly systems may fail, yet the power remains within you to rise and stand strong. It is in our darkest moments that the brightest light of God breaks forth.These challenging times shall be for your deeper growth. Be refreshed in your spirit and illuminated with an enduring, great light. GLORIOUS NEW MONTH TO YOU. You are a GLOBAL ICON; Lead Your Generation See you at GLOBAL ICONS. Author Wednesday, 1st July, 2026 THE BLOOD OF THE PASSOVER LAMB “And he made clear to them all the things in the Writings, from Moses and from all the prophets, which had to do with himself”.Luke 24:27 (BBE) There is only one message we have which is CHRIST.
The gospel and revelation of our Lord Jesus is the centricity of the message of the Church.
In the Gospel of Jesus:– The victory of the New Creation is unveiled.– You will behold your success.– You will embrace the love of God and His eternal forgiveness.– You will become conscious of the higher life God has called you to live.– Believers will enjoy the life God has intended for them and be relevant in the Kingdom business.It’s important to comprehend the truth of God about you in Christ.For the truth about you is Christ.Only a few people have got into serious study of the Word. And have made it their intention to commit themselves to the ministration of the Word through the Spirit. Even some Teachers and Pastors are finding it difficult to rightly divide the word because, they have not given themselves to the Spirit of the Word.
The Church meetings ought to be times where believers are trained into maturity in the knowledge of Christ.
It is not the sharing of the knowledge of human idealism and philosophies. “See to it that no one takes you captive by philosophy and empty deceit, according to human tradition, according to the elemental spirits of the world, and not according to Christ” Colossians 2:8 (ESV) “And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God. For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.” 1 Corinthians 2:1 ( KJV). Teachers of the Word are not to fix their interests in the peddling of the truth (2 Corinthians 2:17) but should administer the mind of God. Those whom Christ died for deserve to receive and enjoy the treasures of the Lord.
Believers shouldn’t engage themselves in activities and celebrations without understanding.
Whatsoever is written in the Word has its purpose and should be understood. Every year in the month of Nisan, the Jews had their Passover Celebration. This Celebration is focused on God’s powerful message to the world. This was when God delivered the children of Israel from Egypt through the BLOOD OF THE PASSOVER LAMB. Now we have Jesus, who is the substance of the sacrifices and the Jewish festivals. “Therefore let no one judge you in regard to food and drink or in regard to [the observance of] a festival or a new moon or a Sabbath day. Such things are only a shadow of what is to come and they have only symbolic value; but the substance [the reality of what is foreshadowed] belongs to Christ.” Colossians 2:16-17 (Amplified) The Passover lamb in Exodus 12 foreshadowed Jesus who is the PERFECT PASSOVER. The triumphal entry was a preparation for Passover Week and for the death and resurrection of Jesus. The very day that Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the colt of a donkey was the 10th day of Nisan (See both Exodus 12 and John 12).That day is known among Jews as the “Lamb Selection Day”. Wow! It was on this day that the lamb that was going to be used in the Temple for the Passover were brought into Jerusalem. At the first Passover which took place in Egypt, God instructed the Israelites to take each lamb into each home to be inspected or scrutinized. The lamb was scrutinized for 4 days. This was to check if the lamb is suitable for the sacrifice. It should be blameless and also be a male in the first year. (See Exodus 12:1-5). The lamb with no blemish will be slain on the 14th day of Nisan. This is beautiful! Beloved, Jesus rode into Jerusalem on the Lamb Selection Day, which is the 10th Day of Nisan. He rode into His household. He was scrutinized by them even unto the 14th day. In Exodus 12 it was stated that the Passover lamb had to be examined.
Jesus who is the Perfect lamb of God that takes away the sin of the world (John 1:29) was scrutinized or examined by the highest authorities in the land.
Herod (the king) scrutinized Him, Caiaphas (the High Priest), and even Pontius Pilate. Pontius Pilate represented the entire body of Gentiles and the whole world. Remember Rome was ruling the world by then. Jesus was without blemish at all levels of laws, regulations and scrutiny.
Jesus really died for all sins.
He satisfied all laws. He was even judged beyond the law of Moses and was still blameless. Oh, what a perfect lamb the Father prepared for us to satisfy all the demands of Justice. Yet on the 14th day of Nisan, at exactly 9 am, Jesus was nailed to the cross. As the animals were taken into the temple to be sacrificed. Exactly the time set for the last lamb to be killed by the High Priest, at 3pm, Jesus cried out “IT IS FINISHED” and He gave up His Spirit.  Nobody took His Spirit from Him. You see just as the High Priest was the one to kill the last lamb, the same happened with Jesus. It was Caiaphas who initiated His death; and on the cross, Jesus who is also our High Priest, gave up His Spirit. Hallelujah!
Jesus is the Perfect lamb that was CONDEMNED ONCE and for ALL.
My dear in Christ, you should know that as the lamb of God was judged for you; God CANNOT CONDEMN You. SHALOM!DIG DEEPER(Exodus 12; John 12; Luke 24:27; Hebrews 8:5; Hebrews 9:9; 1 Corinthians 5:6-8) WE PRAYThanking the Lord for our Lord Jesus who bore all our iniquities and justified us through His blood. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANPsalms 118–1202 YEARS PLANPsalms 108DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am perfected by the blood of the perfect lamb of God. – I focus on Christ who is the substance of truth. – Christ is God’s perfect sacrifice for me, therefore I am justified. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1268 - THE CARE AND COMFORT OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Tuesday, 14th July, 2026THE CARE AND COMFORT OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD“He refreshes and restores my soul (life); He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name’s sake” Psalm 23:3 (Amplified) Most sheep easily go astray when they are without a shepherd. They live scattered, wearied, cast away and hopeless. That is the state of the world today.  “When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.” Matthew 9:36 (CEV)
Our Lord Jesus is the true shepherd who gives direction, comfort and total refreshment to His sheep.
There are those who don’t stay in the fold or submit to the voice or pathways of the Shepherd. They look away from the Lord and begin to wander in the wilderness of this world. They become prey to wild beasts and are destroyed. “They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts” (Ezekiel 34:5) Now if you can be a sheep, understand also that there are certain people out there in the world, who are as wild beasts looking for strayed sheep to prey on. Some sheep also turn away from the Voice of the Good Shepherd to yield to other shepherds who lead them astray, and make them feel helpless. “My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray, causing them to roam the mountains. They have wandered from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place“ (Jeremiah 50:6). The first phrase in the chapter 23 of Psalms: “THE LORD IS MY SHEPHERD…” is also a matter of decision or choice. Our Lord is the Good Shepherd who will not abuse His Royal Sovereignty. He wants you to make an intentional decision to submit to Him as your Shepherd.
When you acknoweledge the Lord as the Good Shepherd of your life, you will hear His Voice.
His beautiful and tender caring Voice will lead you into His luxurious love, rest and oasis of peace. This rejuvinates, refreshes and restores the heart of the sheep. 
The Lord restores your soul, your entire being and life because He is the GOOD SHEPHERD OF YOUR SOUL.
“For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.” 1 Peter 2:25 (BSB) Look at how He does it again: “He offers a resting place for me in his luxurious love. His tracks take me to an oasis of peace, the quiet brook of bliss.That’s where he restores and revives my life. He opens before me pathways to God’s pleasure…” Psalm 23:2-3 (TPT)    The “RESTORE” in verse 3, is from the Hebrew word, SHÛB, which means to refresh, revive, strengthen, quicken, make to rejoice, to return home, to re-treat, to relieve, retrieve, compensate and to rescue or deliver. This is not necessarily with the idea to return to your starting point. It is to experience the organic design of comfort by the Good shepherd. It is to live the real life the Lord has intended for you. The Shepherd brings you into a life above distress, helplessness and insecurity. Again let me ask you, is the LORD YOUR SHEPHERD? Trust in the comfort of the GOOD SHEPHERD! SELAH DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 40:11; Isaiah 53:6; John 10:11,16; Micah 7:14; Hebrews 13:20; Revelation 7:17) WE PRAYWe pray that: WE SHALL EXPERIENCE TOTAL STRENGTH AND RESTORATION IN ALL ASPECTS OF OUR LIVES THROUGH THE CARE AND COMFORT OF THE GOOD SHEPHERD. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANProverbs 8–102 YEARS PLANPsalms 124DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I submit to the voice of the shepherd.- I do not live scattered, wearied, cast away and hopeless. - I acknowledge the Lord as the good shepherd of my life. - My soul, entire being is restored because the Lord is my good shepherd. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1269 - BE ANXIOUS FOR NOTHING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Wednesday, 15th July, 2026BE ANXIOUS FOR NOTHING “For when I was desperate, overwhelmed, and about to give up, you were the only one there to help. You gave me a way of escape from the hidden traps of my enemies.”Psalm 142:3 (TPT)You might have started this day recounting the plans you had at the beginning of the year. And may feel there is more you could have done. You may also be appreciative of some success.Whether you have seen great success or not, refuse to be overwhelmed.These recent times, the phrase, “I feel overwhelmed or this thing is overwhelming”has become  one of the common phrases . However, no matter how you can justify your reason for feeling overwhelmed, that feeling exposes a state of mind.
To be overwhelmed simply means, you are not working with God. It means you have relied on your own strength.
“Trust in and rely confidently on the LORD with all your heart. And do not rely on your own insight or understanding. In all your ways know and acknowledge and recognize Him, And He will make your paths straight and smooth [removing obstacles that block your way].” Proverbs 3:5-6 (Amplified Bible)Though there may be obstacles and rough paths in your life journey, the Lord straightens, making your paths smooth and removed obstacles as you trust in Him.It is not God’s desire that you will be overwhelmed by challenges and discomforting situations. He wants you to have His peace, in the midst of these challenging times.To be overwhelmed means you have allowed your mind to be disarranged or cluttered by wrong thoughts of the adversary.He makes you feel tired and accept weakness. Don’t white-wash the concept or idea of being overwhelmed. It is not normal, neither is of God.To be overwhelmed doesn’t mean you are doing alot of things. It means you are fighting without God. It means you are doing things without God’s sufficient supply.Mental fatigue, confusion and anxiety are not items in God. Paul said to the church in Philippi, “Be anxious for nothing…!” (Philippians 4:6)He didn’t just instruct the saints not to be anxious, he gave them the solution and the outcome of the solution.– Be anxious for nothing…Solution: PRAY, supplication with thanksgiving.The outcome: The PEACE of God shall garrison your heart.God’s peace settles your mind to prevail, even when you are encircled by daunting tasks.He wants to be your rest amidst the storm.Jesus said, “Peace I leave with you; *my peace I give you*. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid“ John 14:27 (NIV)David made a profound statement about the Lord:“He refreshes and restores my soul (life); He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name’s sake. Even though I walk through the [sunless] valley of the shadow of death I fear no evil, for You are with me…”Each day of your life becomes onerous when you don’t focus on the Lord’s peace.The more your mind settles on the vicissitudes, the more you feel overwhelmed, desperate and crushed. Don’t allow your thoughts to obstructs or wreck  your mind. You enjoy perfect peace when your mind stays on the Lord (Isaiah 26:). Love on and meditate on the goodnews of Jesus.Lay your hands on your head and declare, my mind is anointed with the Lord’s goodness. Thoughts of grace saturate my mind. And I enjoy the help of the LORD.HallelujahDIG DEEPER(Psalm 119:165; Colossians 3:15; 2 Thessalonians 3:16; Matthew 11:28-30; Psalm 18:6) WE PRAY We pray that our thoughts will serve the Lord and not become channels of wreck to our minds. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANProverbs 14–162 YEARS PLANPsalms 126DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My thoughts are settled on the Lord.– I don’t allow my thoughts to obstructs my mind.– I enjoy the peace of God daily.– I am anxious for nothing.– I don’t permit any situation to disturb my peace.– My mind is anointed with the Lord’s goodness.– Thoughts of grace saturate my mind.– I enjoy the help of God.Oh Gloreeey! Thank you Lord Jesus

title: EPISODE 1270 - GOD'S UNLIMITED AND IMMEASURABLE LAVISHNESS OF GRACE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever God has called you to do; plan, strategise, act out ideas and above all don’t trust in them. Have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD. Selah. Author Thursday, 16th July, 2026 GOD'S UNLIMITED AND IMMEASURABLE LAVISHNESS OF GRACE“And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.”2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)
It is not consistent with the revelation of scriptures to think God’s lavishness is not demonstrated through material blessings.
The “earthly blessing” you read in the opening verse also means material blessing. And God causes grace to lavishly abound.And just as God lavished His love and grace through the redemptive and life-dispensing work in Christ, He also makes grace overflow abundantly so that there will be more than enough favor and material blessing for His good works.God never withholds good things from His people.This is who He has always been. He is a good God.“God will lavish you with good things: children from your womb, offspring from your animals, and crops from your land, the land that God promised your ancestors that he would give you. God will throw open the doors of his sky vaults and pour rain on your land on schedule and bless the work you take in hand. You will lend to many nations but you yourself won’t have to take out a loan.” Deuteronomy 28:11-12 (Message Bible)
God doesn’t take any pleasure in making life hard. You have to take advantage of His supply to bear great fruits.
The overflowing ability of God is within us as believers.“Everything we could ever need for life and complete devotion to God has already been deposited in us by his divine power. For all this was lavished upon us through the rich experience of knowing him who has called us by name and invited us to come to him through a glorious manifestation of his goodness” 2 Peter 1:3 (TPT)You don’t have to wait for God to supply you with overflowing grace. He has already lavished you with the superabundance of grace. The more you intimately commune with Him in knowledge, the more you overflow with His grace.This overflowing grace cannot be limited by lack. Even in the wilderness, God’s lavishness was demonstrated through our Lord Jesus.The disciples of Jesus said, “It’s going to be dark soon and the people are hungry, but there’s nothing to eat here in this desolate place. You should send the crowds away to the nearby villages to buy themselves some food.”Jesus responded, “They don’t need to leave, You can give them something to eat.”Jesus’ response was to make them look beyond the situation and think according to the lavishness of God. Yet His disciples were still scarcity conscious. They answered, “But all we have is five barley loaves and two fish.”Jesus replied “Let me have them,” Then He had everyone sit down on the grass as he took the five loaves and two fish. He looked up into heaven, gave thanks to God, and broke the bread into pieces. He then gave it to His disciples, who in turn gave it to the crowds. And everyone ate until they were satisfied, for the food was multiplied in front of their eyes! They picked up the leftovers and filled up twelve baskets full! There were about five thousand men who were fed, in addition to many women and children!” (See Matthew 14:15-21, TPT).
Jesus proved God’s lavishness of provision, as the multitudes ate till they were satisfied and yet there were leftovers.
Say this loud to yourself:I don’t experience scarcity.I enjoy God’s unlimited and immeasurable lavishness of Grace.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 3:4-6; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35) WE PRAYPray to declaring that God’s lavishness is expressed through every favor and material blessing so that we will have more than enough to accomplish great things and bear glorious fruits for the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANProverbs 17–192 YEARS PLANPsalms 127 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am not scarcity conscious. – I don’t experience scarcity. – I enjoy God’s unlimited and immeasurable lavishness of Grace. – The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God’s love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love. – The Lord doesn’t withhold His kindness and care from me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life.Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1271 - GOD IS ABLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Irrespective of the situation or the challenge you face in your pursuit of God’s purpose, you must take advantage of the strength of God to be content. Selah! Author Friday, 17th July, 2026 GOD IS ABLE“Look with wonder at the depth of the Father’s marvelous love that he has lavished on us! He has called us and made us his very own beloved children. The reason the world doesn’t recognize who we are is that they didn’t recognize him.”1 John 3:1 (TPT)I’ve told this story before but I want to tell you again. There was a lady traveling with her boss (it was her first time traveling on an aircraft). And in the flight, they sat at separate seats with some distance between them. When they got to their destination, her boss got to know the lady was feeling hungry. The boss was a bit surprised considering how they were served on the flight. So she asked the lady if what was served on the flight wasn’t enough for her.The lady replied to her boss, “Ma, I didn’t accept any of the food they tried serving because I was nearing enough money and didn’t want to bother you. I didn’t even visit the washroom because I didn’t want you to incur other costs”“What?” The boss exclaimed, “Your flight ticket covered all the bills! Your way to enjoy everything”. She continued.Is this not the situation with most believers in Christ?The ignorance of what God has lavished on them makes them live like beggars.They judge what they have and what they can do through their natural strength.
Don’t judge the supply of Godwith the limitation of your natural ability.
God is rich in wisdom and blessings; He lavishly and richly pours out His blessings in large measure.The lavishness of God is not just in the demonstration of His love through spiritual blessings in Salvation. God also lavishes His children with material blessings. To experience material blessing is not necessarily being materialistic.Materialism in theology is the concept of being obsessed or preoccupied (spiritually, mentally, emotionally and physically) with material things rather than the spiritual reality of God.“Stay away from the love of money; be satisfied with what you have. For God has said, “I will never, never fail you nor forsake you.”Hebrews 13:5 (TLB)In the above verse, the author of Hebrews instructs his readers to stay free from the love of money and to shun financial greed.Does that mean the child of God doesn’t experience material blessings?Certainly not! The contrast of not being greedy or obsessed as a child of God with material things is contentment with what you have. This is transcending. The author was specific with what you need to be content with. He said “…be content with what you have”Amazing! (Just feel like shouting)
To be content with what you have is not in reference to the material things you have been able to amass through your struggle and sweat.
What you have in this context is not what you gained through your natural labor.What do you have?You have GOD!Who has said, “I will never [under any circumstances] desert you [nor give you up nor leave you without support, nor will I in any degree leave you helpless], nor will I forsake or let you down or relax My hold on you [assuredly not]”Did you read that?You cannot have God and lack support. He doesn’t just give you support, God is the support and the supply.Most believers who love a greedy life, live as the people of the world. They are not conscious they have the greatest treasure.Jesus said, “So then, forsake your worries! Why would you say, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What will we wear?’ For that is what the unbelievers chase after. Doesn’t your heavenly Father already know the things your bodies require” Matthew 6:31-32 (TPT)No child of God should be greedy and materialistic. No child of God should be obsessively chasing after money or material things.
You have GOD’S PRESENCE, where every blessing finds expression.
Concerning your physical needs or material blessings, take note of this:“And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.” 2 Corinthians 9:8 (Amplified Bible)How much do you need to do what God has called you to do?God is able to lavish you with every earthly blessing so that you will be sufficient enough for every good work.
Don’t doubt nor limit the wisdom of God.
Continue to behold and trust Him as your shepherd; He will make you lie down in green pastures.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Peter 1:3; 2 Corinthians 3:4-6; Philippians 4:19; John 6:35; Deuteronomy 28:11-14) WE PRAYPray to thank the Lord for His abundant supply of every earthly blessing we need to execute His assignments. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANProverbs 20–222 YEARS PLANPsalms 128DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord is my supply.– I don’t lack any good thing because I have received of the Lord in all of His richness.– I enjoy the abundant supply of God in this new season. – My mind is set on the lavishness of God’s love and Mercy. – His love for me is loyal and it can never run out. – The Lord will always and at all times lavish and soak me with His compassionate love.– The Lord doesn’t withhold His kindness and care from me.– He abundantly overhelms me with His mercies everyday of my life.Oh, Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1272 - DO KINGDOM BUSINESS WITH GOD’S RESOURCES
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Whatever you have access to, no matter how little, is enough for you to prove your faithfulness as a steward. SELAH! Author Saturday, 18th July, 2026 DO KINGDOM BUSINESS WITH GOD’S RESOURCES “Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand it is to make great And to give strength to all. “Now therefore, our God, We thank You And praise Your glorious name. But who am I, and who are my people, That we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You.” 2 Chronicles 29:12‐14 (NKJV)Until you use the things made by God to serve God’s purpose, such things will not find meaning.The silver, the gold and money as a whole will only find meaning when used to serve God’s purpose.You don’t have to assume that the money you make is only by your sweat and hard work, thus, you will use it just for your interest.
As people of God, we must acknowledge God as the source of our wealth.
What do you have that you did not receive? (1 Corinthians 4:7)For all things come from God (see the opening verse again).“If you start thinking to yourselves, “I did all this. And all by myself. I’m rich. It’s all mine!”—well, think again. Remember that God, your God, gave you the strength to produce all this wealth so as to confirm the covenant that he promised to your ancestors—as it is today.” Deuteronomy 8:18 (MSG)
As people of God all that you have is not all yours. Your life is for God’s glory, and all that you have must be used for God’s glory.
Others also think they don’t have enough money to give towards the Lord’s vision. But when your heart is towards the Lord you will always love to give towards His course.The believers in Macedonia gave generously towards the Lord’s work among the saints. Even with their limited resources.“Now, friends, I want to report on the surprising and generous ways in which God is working in the churches in Macedonia province. Fierce troubles came down on the people of those churches, pushing them to the very limit. The trial exposed their true colors: They were incredibly happy, though desperately poor. The pressure triggered something totally unexpected: an outpouring of pure and generous gifts. I was there and saw it for myself. They gave offerings of whatever they could—far more than they could afford! —pleading for the privilege of helping out in the relief of poor Christians.This was totally spontaneous, entirely their own idea, and caught us completely off guard. What explains it was that they had first given themselves unreservedly to God and to us. The other giving simply flowed out of the purposes of God working in their lives. That’s what prompted us to ask Titus to bring the relief offering to your attention, so that what was so well begun could be finished up. You do so well in so many things—you trust God, you’re articulate, you’re insightful, you’re passionate, you love us—now, do your best in this, too.” 2 Corinthians 8:1-7 (MSG)
As long as you have not given yourself to the Lord you wouldn’t even see the need to commit your other resources to his course.
And the more you commit your resources, money or treasure to the Lord, the more your heart is set on Him.“for where your treasure is, there your heart [your wishes, your desires; that on which your life centers] will be also” Matthew 6:21 (Amplified Bible)If you want to know where your heart and desires gravitate to, see where you commit the resources at your disposal.Be a faithful steward of money. Don’t just use money only for your interests and the satisfaction of personal needs, which doesn’t benefit God’s kingdom plan. Use money and other resources to serve God’s Kingdom mandate within your sphere.At the end of all things, you are going to make an account of how you serve God’s purpose with the resources He entrusted to you.
Do Kingdom business with God’s resources.
Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 4:7; Matthew 25:14-30; Matthew 6:19-21; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:6, 9-11) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall become more diligent in serving the purpose of God with our wealth or every financial blessing and that His name shall be glorified in our sphere. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANProverbs 23–262 YEARS PLANPsalms 129–130DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement. – I am always excited to give unto the Lord, because it’s the greatest privilege. – I am a prompt to do it giver. – All that I have is the Lord’s and for His kingdom advancement including my money. – I am a faithful steward. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1273 - BE CONSCIOUS OF WHAT INFLUENCES YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Author Sunday, 19th, July, 2026 BE CONSCIOUS OF WHAT INFLUENCES YOU “For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places” Ephesians 6:12 (NLT)Basically, there are two realms of life. There is the spiritual realm and also the physical realm. The spiritual realm is the root of life’s essence and the physical is for the expression of life. The physical realm is the “seen realm”, while the spiritual realm is the “unseen realm”.By forensic observation of the material world, one may find the fingerprint of an unseen creator — God. Such fingerprint gives an idea of a realm which transcends this physical or material realm.“Opposition to truth cannot be excused on the basis of ignorance, because from the creation of the world, the invisible qualities of God’s nature have been made visible, such as his eternal power and transcendence. He has made his wonderful attributes easily perceived, for seeing the visible makes us understand the invisible. So then, this leaves everyone without excuse.” Romans 1:20 (TPT).This physical world came out of the Spiritual realm.
There is nothing you see in this world which doesn’t have its roots in the spirit.
“By faith we understand that the entire universe was formed at God’s command, that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen.”  Hebrews 11:3 (NLT)Therefore you must understand that things don’t just happen in this physical realm. There are spiritual forces which govern the affairs of men.And that explains why God didn’t make man to only be a physical being without spiritual essence. God designed man to have the ability to function both in the spirit and in this physical realm.“…Thus says the LORD, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him“. Zechariah 12:1 (NKJV)See this also:“Now, may the God of peace and harmony set you apart, making you completely holy. And may your entire being—spirit, soul, and body—be kept completely flawless in the appearing.” 1 Thessalonians 5:23 (TPT)
The spirit of man is the innermost or deepest part of man. It is designed for divine contact and divine consciousness.
It is mainly to have rich intimacy with God, for God is Spirit (John 4:24).Man has a body which serves as the vessel by which he can contact the material or tangible realm and also commune in it. It contains the outward organs of man’s being.However, God gave man a SOUL for man to effectively function in the spirit and in the physical realm.The Greek word for soul is “psuche”, from it, we have the English word psychology.
It is the conduit for our psychological perception. It is within your soul that you have your self-consciousness.
It contains your will, intellect (mind) and emotions. It serves as the intermediary between the spirit (which is for contacting God) and the body (which communicates with the outside world).Your spirit is for Divine or God consciousness, your soul possesses your self-consciousness and the body is for the physical consciousness.However, the spirit, the soul and the body have their roots and influences in the spirit; because all things issued out of the spirit. As physical as the body is, it also has a level of spiritual intelligence.
Also, you have to know that, anything that will find expression in your body must first take root in your spirit and soul.
Since all created things issued out of the spirit realm, whatever you contact in the physical realm through your body doesn’t just exist in the physical, they have their roots also in the spirit.For example:You watched a video clip; which may seem like a mere physical activity. But the video clip has a spiritual influence. Thus, before what you watched in the video will impact your life, it first travels into you to take root in your soul and spirit.The moment it takes root in your spirit and your soul, it will begin to have a strong influence in you and begin to bear its kind of fruits through you.Until you understand these, you will not be able to determine how to operate effectively in this physical world.Be conscious of what influences your life.
Beloved, LIFE IS SPIRITUAL!
Selah.DIG DEEPER(Genesis 1:2; Matthew 16:17; 2 Corinthians 10:3-6; John 3:6; Mark 9:25; John 4:19-26) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall increase in the understanding of the function of our spiritual essence in this physical world.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANProverbs 27–302 YEARS PLANPsalms 131–132DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I live my life from the realm of the spirit. – I am conscious of my spiritual essence. – I am a spirit led man. – I live an extraordinary life. – I increase daily in the understanding of the function of my spirituality. Oh Hallelujah!

title: EPISODE 1274 - GO AFTER GOD-SIZE DREAMS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Are you esteeming the activities of this world above the study of the Word and staying patiently to be taught in Church? It’s time to make a decision to be yielded and submissive to the instructions of Christ. Shalom! Author Monday, 20th July, 2026GO AFTER GOD-SIZE DREAMS “There was also Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant warrior from Kabzeel. He did many heroic deeds, which included killing two champions of Moab. Another time, on a snowy day, he chased a lion down into a pit and killed it.“1 Chronicles 11:22 (NLT)The beautiful outcomes you see in the scriptures weren’t magical nor automatic.They were as a result of great demonstrations of faith.
There is no beautiful story without intentional processes.
You may read the wondrous testimonies in the scriptures and assume you cannot have the capacity to produce such results.However, the scriptures did not just list the inevitable outcomes of these patriarchs. A careful study of the scriptures will bring you to the understanding of the processes. When you give your mind to the scriptures, you will not be pinned to uncertainties.Paul the apostle said, “for whatever was written in earlier times was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope and overflow with confidence in His promises.” Romans 15:4 (Amplified Bible)One of the great characters in the scriptures is one of the mighty men of David, Benaiah.You can read the opening verse for this episode again (just in case you didn’t pay attention whiles reading).I believe you’ve done that right?What you just read in the opening verse about Benaiah wasn’t a fluke. The story of Benaiah wasn’t a myth or an old fable. God took his time to introduce in scriptures, the story of Benaiah. His exploit were recorded in the scriptures to inspire faith in the hearts of every reader.The story of Benaiah unveils a model of the daring man of faith.For a man to chase or pursue a lion shows the posture and attitude you need to have for the Lord’s call on your life. This man did not defend himself by running away from the lion. He went after the lion.Benaiah’s exploit of faith got him to be appointed as a special guard to David and later became a commander in chief under King Solomon (1 Kings 2:35).
Beloved, PURSUE THE LION.
When Benaiah was confronted by a lion he had the option to fight or flight. And he chose to fight.You may think this had nothing to do with faith but was just a skill he had. He did have skill, but took an exceptional task because he had faith.He did not pursue a lion by skill, he pursued the lion by faith.“And what more shall I say? For time would fail me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, of David and Samuel and the prophets— who through faith conquered kingdoms, enforced justice, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, were made strong out of weakness, became mighty in war, put foreign armies to flight.“ Hebrews 11:33-34 (ESV)Oh glory to God.When you are confronted by a challenge you have the option to fight or flight.But they that are of faith don’t take the option of flight. By faith you confront the target and task. You may only choose the option of flight because of fear.Don’t allow fear to dictate your decision. Fear produces death, but faith to boldly confront those fear will cause you to experience life.
Don’t let fear dominate your heart.
“…through faith… they put the armies to flight.”God’s dream in your heart for the year maybe as fierce as a lion. It may be as heavy as a lion is to man. But don’t allow the size of your dreams to intimidate you. Big dreams shouldn’t scare you.You can’t have a big God and be afraid to pursue big dreams; if you are afraid of big dreams then you doubt the greatness of God.Your audacity to confront challenges to prevail influences the steps you take.
Go after God-size dreams.
What dream has God put in your heart? What LION do you need to pursue this year?Don’t run away. Don’t doubt God’s dream in your heart.Don’t wait to be fully ready before you pursue that dream.Step forward in faith as the Lord inspires your heart and you will know the LORD has been getting you ready for the dream. Exercise yourself in faith and you will unlearn your fears.To exercise yourself in faith is mainly obedience to God. It is not whether you will fail or succeed; it is mainly about your obedience to God.People don’t take steps to execute God’s vision because they are afraid to fail. Why will you allow fear of failure make you walk in disobedience?
Choose obedience over failure or success. Take the first step of faith and it will be a giant step of glory.
In the Kingdom you belong to in Christ, we don’t run from big dreams, we confront them.God wants to write His story through your life. Exercise the courage to pursue your LION this year. The set time is now, dare to manifest greater results.Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 Samuel 17:34-36; 1 Samuel 23:20-23; Romans 4:20-21; Psalm 18:29) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be saturated with the possibilities of God to confront any target or dreams of the Lord and not run away in fear.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20251 YEAR PLANProverbs 31, Ecclesiastes 1–22 YEARS PLANPsalms 133DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I go after God-size dreams.– I don’t run away. – As the Lord inspires my heart, I step forward in faith. – No target is too great for me to achieve. – No dream is too big for me to achieve. – I exercise my faith to go after every dream and target that God has placed in my heart.– I am not a coward. – I don’t run away from challenges. – I don’t  allow fear to dictate my decisions. – I refuse to allow fear dominate my heart. – I refuse to be intimated by big dreams. – I confront challenges and fear. – Fear has no grip on me. – I am a man of faith. – I am full of faith. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1275 - WHAT IS YOUR REPUTATION?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The words you meditate on in your heart are flames which burn in your heart. This is why when you feel angry or even joyful, you feel a burning sensation. Beloved, let your heart boil or bubble with a beautiful theme. Shalom! Author Tuesday, 21st July, 2026 WHAT IS YOUR REPUTATION?“You already know about his excellent reputation, since he has served alongside me as a loyal son in the work of ministry” Philippians 2:22 (TPT)No matter how you operate (whether in secret or openly), the impact of your actions cannot be hidden.
Consistent impact is tangible and visible.
To make an impact is to have a marked effect or influence on someone or a people. The consistency of your impact forms part of the body of your reputation.Wherever you find yourself, people will remember you according to your reputation.There are people who have a great reputation in their workplaces or schools, but have no great reputation in the Kingdom.What are you known for in the Kingdom?Will you call it an excellent reputation?Is it worth celebrating?Does your reputation inspire faith?Does your reputation reflect the things which interest the Lord?As a Kingdom person, your reputation must be that you serve the purpose of the Lord.You cannot be serving your interests and expect to be applauded by the Lord.Some claim they do God’s work, but not in the open. The work of the Lord cannot be hidden. Like I said from the beginning, no matter how you operate, your great impact cannot be hidden.
Thus, if you are truly making an impact, your reputation will be known by the Lord and by the saints.
You are a city set on a hill that cannot be hidden (Matthew 5:14).It is prideful to think that the saints are not to determine whether you have an excellent reputation or not. You cannot make an excuse that you are making an impact, and it is only the Lord that knows.In case you didn’t read the opening verse well, read again:“You already know about his excellent reputation, since he has served alongside me as a loyal son in the work of ministry”They knew the reputation of Timothy because his service to the Lord and impact were tangible.You cannot serve the Lord directly without serving in partnership with the saints. You cannot serve the Lord outside His Church. You serve the Lord through His Church (precisely, the ministry in which He has planted you).Timothy had the opportunity to serve the Lord and to achieve an excellent reputation through the ministry of Paul the apostle. His reputation was built over time as he followed instructions and served diligently.
Your genuine and excellent reputation in your local Church is recognised as a reputation in the Kingdom.
How are you handling responsibilities entrusted to you?Do you execute the assignment of the Kingdom given to you with excellence?How is your reputation advancing the Kingdom?Do you have a reputation for sitting on the fence?Do you have a reputation for not being available or consistent?What is the testimony of your Pastor or Leader about you?
Your Kingdom reputation is according to the big things you dare to do for the Lord through your local Church.
And that is a determinant of your heavenly crowns and rewards.Selah.DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:7-9; 2 Timothy 4:11; 1 Corinthians 4:17; Matthew 5:16; Acts 16:1-2; 2 Corinthians 8:18) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord will supply us with more grace and stir our hearts to attempt great things which will make many glorify Him through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEcclesiastes 3–52 YEARS PLANPsalms 134 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– By the supply of grace, I attempt great things for the Lord. – I don’t live to serve my interests. – Through me, many will glorify the Lord. – Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of Christ. – I make consistent impact in the Kingdom. – I am a trailblazer in the Kingdom. – My impacts are tangible and visible. – I am known for mighty works in my local church. – I execute every kingdom assignment with excellence. – My reputation is advancing the Kingdom. – I don’t sit on the fence, I get myself involved at all times. – I am in and never out. – I am available at all times.Thank you Lord Jesus for the supply of more grace!Oh, thank you Lord for stirring up my heart to attempt great things for you!

title: EPISODE 1276 - DEMONSTRATE YOUR LOVE THROUGH YOUR GENEROSITY
EPISODE 1277 - “I HAVE A GREATER ASSIGNMENT FOR YOU” SAITH THE LORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency The truth is that no man can be righteous by his or her efforts. Therefore Jesus legally gave us His righteousness. The righteousness which we have in Christ is not our self-made righteousness. The righteousness which we have in Christ is the righteousness of God. Oh Hallelujah! Author Thursday, 23rd July, 2026 “I HAVE A GREATER ASSIGNMENT FOR YOU” SAITH THE LORD “Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.” 1 Chronicles 29:1 (KJV). Some saints in Christ esteem their education, job, and self-centered interests more than the assignment of the Lord. How do you see what the Lord tells you to do?
Anything God tells you to do is great!
The assignments of the Lord benefit generations.You have to see the Lord’s work with the eyes of your spirit and look into generations ahead. David the king said, “the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.” What makes the assignment great is who the work is for.
You don’t value or esteem what you do for man than what you do for the Lord.
Imagine being invited and tasked to represent the President of a country you esteem. You will see it as a great task.
Whatever the Lord tells you to do, is a representation of Him.
The tasks given to you by God are things He had desired to do, and He is entrusting you with them.
Don’t belittle His assignment for you or the dreams He has put in your heart.
Your Heavenly Father’s joy is to see you do something great for Him. I remember one time, during my teens, I woke up excited about a Church excursion. While getting ready the Holy Spirit told me not to be too excited about the excursion and the funfair. He told me that He is calling me to do great things for the Kingdom. And that is also the call of every saint.  He has not called us to do what the people of the world can do. (This is not to deny the importance of social or societal responsibilities or engagements). However, I realised the Lord was redirecting my desires and how I perceive my walk with Him. That morning, the Lord prompted me to read the book of Isaiah. Interestingly, I started with Isaiah 49. I don’t think it was a coincidence: See what I found: ”The LORD said to me, “I have a greater task for you, my servant. Not only will you restore to greatness the people of Israel who have survived, but I will also make you a light to the nations so that all the world may be saved.” Isaiah 49:6 (GNT) Oh, dear Lord. This scripture opened my heart.The moment I saw “I HAVE A GREATER TASK FOR YOU”, I was moved into prayer.  My heart began to burn with fresh passion and my mindset about God’s Kingdom assignment was stretched or expanded.
All through the scriptures, anyone God called was made great. 
They were made great because the Lord did great things with or through them. Beloved, you are called by the Lord into His greatness. Think greatness and take great steps. Whatever the Lord tells you to do is great!
Esteem the Lord’s assignment for you.
It is a great thing to serve the Lord. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:10; 1 Thessalonians 1:3; Hebrews 11:6; Psalm 108:13 (BBE); Genesis 26:13) WE PRAY We are praying and declaring that with God we do great things. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEcclesiastes 9–112 YEARS PLANPsalms 136DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the workmanship of God created in Christ Jesus unto good works. – Through God, I do valiantly. – I increase in capacity and grace as I labour with the Lord. – I esteem the Lord’s assignment for me than any self-centered desires. – I take bold steps towards my kingdom assignment. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1278 - INCREASE IN THIS GRACE ALSO
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Until you make a personal decision to submit to God’s restraining ability within you, God wouldn’t force His will on you. When you yield your cravings to God, you exercise self-control in the energy which the Holy Spirit supplies. Selah! Author Friday, 24th July, 2026INCREASE IN THIS GRACE ALSO”But just as you excel in everything, [and lead the way] in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in genuine concern, and in your love for us, see that you excel in this gracious work [of giving] also” 2 Corinthians 8:7 (Amplified Bible) As a saint in Christ, you are made a steward of God. Your living is not unto yourself, but Christ.
Whatever you do, do as unto the Lord’s glory.
And there is nothing God tells you to do without supplying you with grace. He makes His grace available for you, yours is to take hold of grace and increase in it.
There is nothing done in the Kingdom without the supply of God’s grace.
One may have a lot of resources at his or her disposal and will not be a cheerful bountiful giver.It takes grace to be a giver!! It is one thing to know that whatever you have to give is from God, and it’s another thing to have the grace to give big. Therefore, Paul, the apostle speaking to the Church in Corinth mentioned that they should excel or increase in the giving-grace as well. Read the opening verse above again.I hope you just did that, right?If not please go up to read again. You see, in as much as the Church in Corinth:– excelled in the grace to exercise and lead in faith– excelled in utterance or speech.– excelled in knowledge– excelled in genuine passion– excelled in love for the apostles and even in every giftHe admonished them to excel in the GIVING-GRACE. (2 Corinthians 8:7).This means the brethren in Corinth didn’t lack grace for the various items mentioned, yet they did not excel in the grace to be great givers. And for the apostle to get them to excel in this grace he has to teach them. We grow in grace through the knowledge of our Lord Jesus (2 Peter 1:2).  This knowledge is not just awareness, it is the acknowledgement and oneness into reality through the participation of that reality.This means as you acknowledge the wisdom of God in Christ concerning giving and you become a doer of this knowledge, you increase in the giving-grace.
You don’t excel in the giving grace by “wishing to give”. You increase in this grace by giving consistently with joy. 
And as you continue to give, you stretch your faith to give beyond your ability. That is how you increase your capacity of grace.Look at the testimony of the Churches in Macedonia: ”Beloved ones, we must tell you about the grace God poured out upon the churches of Macedonia. For even during a season of severe difficulty and tremendous suffering, they became even more filled with joy. From the depths of their extreme poverty, super-abundant joy overflowed into an act of extravagant generosity. For I can verify that they spontaneously gave, not only according to their means but far beyond what they could afford.” 2 Corinthians 8:1-3 (TPT). You could see that, they didn’t give their surplus to support God’s work (which includes ministering to the saints), they extravagantly gave beyond their ability. This is fully the work of grace.
However, they didn’t just give extravagantly by grace, they first gave themselves to the Lord.
Just as David said, “…because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared…” This is the kind of environment giving-grace finds true expression. You have to first set your affection on the Lord and give yourself to Him; where you don’t live according to your self-interest. “Not only [did they give materially] as we had hoped, but first they gave themselves to the Lord and to us [as His representatives] by the will of God [disregarding their personal interests and giving as much as they possibly could]“ 2 Corinthians 8:5 (Amplified Bible).
Until you set your affection on the Lord you cannot give towards His work. 
And the giving-grace will not find full expression to excel.Where you put your money or your treasure (which includes your time, attention and valuable resources) is where your heart is.Our Lord made it clear: ”Wherever your treasure is, there the desires of your heart will also be.” Matthew 6:21 (NLT) And when your heart gravitates towards the Kingdom, you activate the grace of God to do more in the Kingdom.
The time to increase in this giving grace is now. 
How do you see the Lord’s assignment?How do you esteem the Lord’s work?What is the direction of your desire, affection or interests? God doesn’t just supply grace. More grace is given to the doers of the word. How true? Look at this: ”And God is able to make all grace [every favor and earthly blessing] come in abundance to you, so that you may always [under all circumstances, regardless of the need] have complete sufficiency in everything [being completely self-sufficient in Him], and have an abundance for every good work and act of charity.” You know, people often shout “I receive it” and “Amen” when there is the declaration of the above gracious blessing.However, most people don’t pay attention to verse 7, before verse 8.In verse 7, Paul instructed the brethren in Corinth: ”Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].” 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). Is your heart in your giving?Are you a cheerful giver?Do you purpose in your heart to give according to the desires God has put in your heart? Grace is supplied abundantly to a cheerful prompt to do it giver.And God:– takes pleasure in,– prizes above other things– and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].BE AN EXTRAVAGANT, CHEERFUL, JOYOUS – PROMPT TO DO IT GIVER TODAY!Shalom.DIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; Deuteronomy 15:10; 2 Corinthians 8:1-15; 9:1-11) WE PRAY– That as our desires have been stirred towards giving, we shall be cheerful prompt to do it givers. – And that we shall increase in superabounding grace to extravagantly give ourselves and our resources to the expansion of the kingdom. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEcclesiastes 12, Song of Solomon 1–22 YEARS PLANPsalms 137 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1287 - THE GOODNEWS OF JESUS
EPISODE 1288 - YOU NEED THE WORD IN YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Beloved, God has called you for this reason; that His purpose and good plan will prosper in your hands. Apostle Bennie Author Monday, 3rd August, 2026YOU NEED THE WORD IN YOUR HEART“Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, And lay up His words in your heart”  Job 22:22 (NKJV) What you have in your heart is what distinguishes you. The difference between those who bring change to their world and those who struggle to make an impact lies in what they have in their heart. Your heart is the governing seat of the Spirit. 
God cannot do anything through you beyond the condition of your heart.
The state of your heart defines the extent you go with God.A wicked heart will produce wickedness. A merry heart will produce joy in his or her sphere. Whatever we see happen in our world is essentially the product of the condition of the hearts of men who have influence in the society. One cannot manifest what he has not conceived in his heart. When you conceive evil, you will produce evil. When you conceive blessings and beauty, you will produce blessings and beauty. ”Peter asked Him, “Explain this parable [about what defiles a person] to us.” And He said, “Are you still so dull [and unable to put things together]? Do you not understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is eliminated? But whatever [word] comes out of the mouth comes from the heart, and this is what defiles and dishonors the man. For out of the heart come evil thoughts and plans, murders, adulteries, sexual immoralities, thefts, false testimonies, slanders (verbal abuse, irreverent speech, blaspheming).” Matthew 15:16-19 (Amplified Bible) See this also: “For the godless are barren: they can produce nothing truly good. God’s fire consumes them with all their possessions. The only thing they can ‘conceive’ is sin, and their hearts give birth only to wickedness” Job 15:34-35 (TLB)When you conceive failure, defeats, poverty, wickedness, hatred, envy and afflictions in your heart, that is what you will manifest or express.
Men, by their nature and their culturing without the word of God, are selfish at heart. 
And a selfish heart breeds envy, hatred, anger, wicked thoughts etc. “The human heart is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked. Who really knows how bad it is?” Jeremiah 17:9 (NLT). See also: Genesis 6:5; 8:21; Ephesians 4:22.This is why at your new birth in Christ, God took away the stony heart to give you the new heart of grace.The Lord declared this through the Prophet Ezekiel, “Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. Your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols. And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.“ Ezekiel 36:25-26 (NLT). See also 2 Corinthians 3:3; Jeremiah 24:7; Psalm 51:10.Now in as much as at new birth the Lord gave you a responsive heart, your heart must be cultivated and nurtured with the Word of God.The Word of God is the revelation of God’s wisdom, His goodness and character.
To demonstrate and express the character of God, you need the Word in your heart.
“How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word. With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments! I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you” Psalm 119:9-11 (ESV) When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Deuteronomy 6:6;11:18; Psalm 37:31; Matthew 13:15; Colossians 3:16; 1 Timothy 4:15; Psalm 1:1-3) WE PRAYThat we will give heed to the instructions of the word of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN Isaiah 26–282 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 1 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have invested the word of God in my heart, therefore none of my steps will slide. – I stay my mind and heart on God’s word. – My heart is a fertile and fruitful land for the word of God. – I give my mind daily to the mediation of the word. – I am cultured daily by the word of God. OH HALLELUJAH! GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1289 - THE OPERATIVE INFLUENCE OF GOD’S WORD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday, 4th August, 2026 THE OPERATIVE INFLUENCE OF GOD’S WORD“For God’s Message is full of life and power, and is keener than the sharpest two-edged sword. It pierces even to the severance of soul from spirit, and penetrates between the joints and the marrow, and it can discern the secret thoughts and purposes of the heart.”Hebrews 4:12 (Weymouth New Testament) God takes great interest in His purpose and plan.Though Christ is the center of God’s purpose and plan, man has been mingled into Christ through the regeneration of life. As man (specifically, the regenerated man in Christ) plays a key role in the fulfillment of God’s eternal purpose and plan, God has taken interest in the well-being of man.
God didn’t place man into time to suffer. God placed man into time for the manifestation of His glory.
From the revelation of scriptures, we see that all things began through God’s creative work. And all that God made was good. He made all things by His creative material (The Word), backed by His creative force (the Spirit). In Genesis 3, we saw the corruptible attempt of the adversary. The adversary’s initiative was focused on corrupting God’s purpose and plan, by corrupting man. However, God has always worked through these two proceeding agents to fulfilling His plan and purpose through man:The Word and The SpiritWithout these two divine elements, no one can fulfill purpose. You need to understand that the Word of God is indispensable in the fulfillment of God’s intention for you. The Word brings you into the realm of manifestation.The Word of God is a brutal offensive weapon given to you by God. There are situations orchestrated by the adversary to prevent you from advancing in purpose.
You don’t sit to wait for that situation to overwhelm and cripple you. Engage the sword of the Spirit – which is the Word in your mouth.
Beloved this is WAR!We also have the Word as God’s elixir for our health. Get this, in the field of medicine, there are other special methods in dealing with certain health obstruction. Some conditions require intense surgical procedure.This is to remove an obstruction or repair diseased tissues.
