Surgical procedures reposition structures to their normal position. Beloved, God is not just a creator, He is also the original surgeon. Just as the Word is His creative material; He also has the Word as the surgical scalpel. The Word of God as a sword of the spirit, is not only effective in the hands of a skillful soldier of Christ. It is also operative in the hands of God and His trained teachers of the Word. “God means what he says. What he says goes. His powerful Word is sharp as a surgeon’s scalpel, cutting through everything, whether doubt or defense, laying us open to listen and obey.” Hebrews 4:12 (MSG). When God speaks His word to you, it cuts deep as a skillful surgeon using the surgical scalpel in an operating theatre.
The Word has the ability to cut through you to remove every “doubtful tissues” in your imagination and thoughts.
It removes all obstructions of the adversary in your heart. Surgeons only use the scalpel to heal or mend what is broken. That is what the Word of God does in you.  It heals your diseases, mends what is broken, removes cancerous cells in your system. It is so sharp that when it pierce through you it will cut off pride, selfishness and divide thoughts which are of God (spirit) from your intellect (soul:mind, emotions and will). God as the great surgeon desires to heal us through His word.He corrects our thought patterns and give us the right mindset to fulfill His purpose and plan. Oh Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 10:4; Jeremiah 1:10; 2 Timothy 2:15; 3:15-17) WE PRAYThat we will continually give ourselves to the operative influence of God’s word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 29–312 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 2 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– Every obstruction of the adversary in my heart is removed as I fellowship with God’s word. – I commit myself daily to the study of the word. – The word has power over my body. – With the revelation light of God’s word, every disorder in my body is corrected. – As I fellowship with the word daily, I experience the healing power thereof. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1290 -  PROVE EVERY TEACHING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Live every day of your life by running towards the goal the Lord has set before you. Don’t run away from purpose, run towards the purpose of God for you. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday, 5th August, 2026PROVE EVERY TEACHING“These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.” Acts 17:11 (NKJV)  Are you making time to search the scriptures? Or you take anything you hear in? Like the Bereans referred in the opening verse, every Born-Again in Christ should have the same attitude towards the teaching of the Word.• We need first to have the readiness of mind to receive illumination through the Word.• Secondly, have reverence and confidence that the Word possesses a transforming ability.• Third, we need to have genuine respect for the teachers of the Word.However, we cannot just take in every piece of information without proving the teaching with God’s Word.
We all have access to God’s Word that we may grow in the accurate, correct and precise knowledge of Christ.
These Bereans, though, had respect for Paul (the Apostle), considering how they readily received the message he preached.  They went ahead to search and examine the scriptures (the scriptures here refer to the ones in the Old Testament portion of the Bible); to see whether the things they heard were so. They didn’t assume! When it comes to studying, we must maintain open-mindedness. It was how they believed the truth; they saw the teachings for themselves. They didn’t have to struggle to believe.
Some people find it difficult to believe and receive the word of Grace because of their religious bigotry.
The attitude of the Bereans shows the proclivity of the wise. They grow in what they hear or receive through continuous learning. “A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:” Proverbs 1:5 (NKJV)
Beloved, you must have the genuine desire to grow in understanding.
It is not merely what you have heard that brings you into accurate Knowledge. It is the truth of God’s Word that gets you into perfect Knowledge and understanding. Therefore, precious saints receive the Word with an open mind and search the scriptures for growth in the rightness of truth. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Proverbs 9:9; Psalm1:2,3; Romans 15:4; Psalms 119:15-16; 2Timothy 3:14-15; 2Timothy 2:15) WE PRAYThat we will diligently continue in the study of the word to grow thereby in the knowledge of Christ. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 32–342 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 3 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– With an open mind and heart, I search the scriptures diligently. – I grow by the word. – I continue daily in the study of the word. – I prove every teaching I hear with God’s word. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1291 - THE MIRROR PRINCIPLE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Beloved, your relationship with God is not a strive to enter rest. Your relationship with God is the eternal enjoyment of God’s rest. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 6th August, 2026THE MIRROR PRINCIPLE“And we all, with unveiled face, continually seeing as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are progressively being transformed into His image from [one degree of] glory to [even more] glory, which comes from the Lord, [who is] the Spirit” 2 Corinthians 3:18 (AMP)  Beloved, you are metamorphosed or transformed into (one degree of glory to another degree of) the image of the glory of the Lord as you meditate on the scriptures. As you behold or meditate on the revelation of the glory of the Lord in the scriptures, you are transformed into a greater dimension of glory. This explains the meaning of this scriptures to some degree: “But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.”Proverbs 4:18 (KJV) And we see also how the path of the righteous shines: “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path” Psalm 119:105 (KJV). The more you meditate or behold the glory of the Word of God, the more you brightly shine forth.
The Word of God as a mirror, brings us to the consciousness of who we are in Christ.
As a new creation in Christ, you didn’t receive the Life of Christ as you behold the Word of God. When you received Christ, you received His life. “He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life. These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.” 1 John 5:12-13 (KJV) Now you can clearly see that, though you are born by the seed of the Word of God, the Word of God as a mirror doesn’t introduce a new life into you. The mirror principle of the Word of God is that:As you look, you come to the true consciousness of who you are in Christ Jesus. If you defined yourself as a sinner or by any false image created by religion, you begin to experience the renewal of mind as you behold the glory of God in the Word. As you are born of the Word, you can only see your true picture, your God begotten self as you look into the Word. A mirror doesn’t add nor change who you are or what you are.A mirror brings you to the realization and consciousness of who you are.
Anytime you behold yourself in the mirror of the Word, it reveals your true essence and quality.
You can only live in the capacity of that revelation, as you continue in the consciousness of that revelation through meditation. James the apostle, explains how the mirror principle works:James 1:21-25 (TPT)“So this is why we abandon everything morally impure and all forms of wicked conduct. Instead, with a sensitive spirit we absorb God’s Word, which has been implanted within our nature, for the Word of Life has power to continually deliver us. James 1:21 (TPT) Now you can see that, the verse 21 reveals that though one with a sensitive spirit absorbs the Word of God, the Word of God has already been implanted to our new nature in Christ. And it has continuous work to deliver by its power.In some other translations it uses the phrase, “which is able to save your souls”. This could mean the saving of ones soul through the new birth experience and the saving of your soul (will, mind, emotions) from the affections of the world, through the renewal of the mind. He then brings the mirror principle of the Word to light in these subsequent verses: “Don’t just listen to the Word of Truth and not respond to it, for that is the essence of self-deception. So always let his Word become like poetry written and fulfilled by your life! If you listen to the Word and don’t live out the message you hear, you become like the person who looks in the mirror of the Word to discover the reflection of his face in the beginning. You perceive how God sees you in the mirror of the Word, but then you go out and forget your divine origin. But those who set their gaze deeply into the perfecting law of liberty are fascinated by and respond to the truth they hear and are strengthened by it—they experience God’s blessing in all that they do!” James 1:22-25 (TPT).– Not responding to the Word is a self-deception, because it is the unfolding of your originality.– Let the word be like a poetry written and fulfilled by your life. It means your life has to be the reflection and expression of the Word.– As you hear the Word, live out the message. Keep it in your heart, meditate on it until it soaks your consciousness.– When you look into the mirror of the Word you will discover the reflection of your face, you will have the right perception of how God sees you and your divine origin.– You will not forget it when you set your gaze deeply into the perfecting law of liberty (which is the revelation of Jesus in the Word).– The consciousness of the word produces fresh strength in you as an unshakable edifice and causes you to experience God’s blessing in all that you do!Look into the Word daily to see your true-self and enjoy your true inheritance in Christ. Selah.DIG DEEPER(1 Corinthians 13:12; Psalm 84:7; John 17:24; 2 Corinthians 4:4,6; Romans 8:29) WE PRAYThat we will give ourselves wholly to the influence of the word.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 35–372 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– As I look into the mirror of the word, I see my true essence and quality. – I continue in the consciousness of what I see in the mirror of the word through meditation. – I increase the more in strength and grace, the more I look into the mirror of the word. – My mind is transformed daily as I look into the mirror of the word. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1292 - THE WORD OF GOD IS A DETOXIFIER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF You are seated with Christ, refuse to be intimidated by any dominion or rule which is under the feet of Christ. As members of His body, anything under His feet is under our feet. Walk in this consciousness of authority. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Friday, 7th August, 2026THE WORD OF GOD IS A DETOXIFIER“How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping watch [on himself] according to Your word [conforming his life to Your precepts]” Psalm 119:9 (Amplified Bible) Though at new birth we became citizens of Heaven, and were translated into the Kingdom of light, we are not taken out of the world. The Lord placed us in this world for the fulfillment of His eternal purpose. There is a mandate of the Kingdom in this world, and we are co-labourers with God in fulfilling His eternal assignment.
We have a mandate to show forth the glory of the Lord, who called us out of darkness (1 Peter 2:9).
Whiles we are in this world, our minds are still exposed to the corruptibility of the world and its systems. We are instructed through the epistles, not to be conformed to this world (Romans 12:2). As we are in this world, we may be confronted by thoughts and imaginations which can corrupt our hearts. However, the Lord did not only begat us anew by His Word, He also gave us His Word to inoculate us from the negative influences of the world. The Lord has complete provisions to keep us from failing and falling. Just because you are born again doesn’t mean the adversary wouldn’t throw arrows of doubts and lies towards you. You have to grow in the knowledge of Christ and be conformed to His image.
The word of God is a detoxifier. It inoculates and detoxifies your mind from error.
At new birth you were made clean by the Word and the Spirit. However, there is a continuous work of cleansing by the Word. “…For he died for us, sacrificing himself to make us holy and pure, cleansing us through the showering of the pure water of the Word of God. All that he does in us is designed to make us a mature church for his pleasure, until we become a source of praise to him—glorious and radiant, beautiful and holy, without fault or flaw. Ephesians 5:25-27 (TPT). The cleansing of the Word is not a one time thing. It is a daily work of cleansing by the word of God. There are things you hear and see from different family settings, interaction with friends at school, work colleagues, and even your communities; which subtly cultivates your mind with toxic thought patterns and concept of life. Instead of thinking in conformity with the Word of Christ, you develop contradicting imagination.This is why you must intentionally give your mind to the Word.
The Word in you, cleanses your heart and mind from poisonous utterances which may shipwreck your faith.
The Word can build an automatic rejection mechanism in your heart, preventing any thought of darkness. And also before you got born again, your mind was exposed to different concepts of life, teachings and diverse culturing which contradicts the reality of the Kingdom.  Thus, you must give yourself to the Word to continuously purify your mind. “How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping watch [on himself] according to Your word [conforming his life to Your precepts]” Psalm 119:9 (Amplified). The Word of God purifies your mind and inoculates your heart from thoughts which cultivates fear, pride, sinfulness, selfishness, envy and doubts. Sit under the waterfall of the Word everyday. Have you fellowshipped with the WORD TODAY? Selah.DIG DEEPER(John 17:17-19; John 15:3; Psalm 19:7-11; Psalm 119:11; Psalm 17:4) WE PRAY That we will take heed and continue in the rich verities and virtues of the word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 38–402 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I sanctify and purify my mind daily by the word. – I am immune from the negative influences of the world. – I enjoy a worry-free life. – Satan has nothing in me. – My heart is free from any thoughts which cultivates fear, pride, sinfulness, selfishness, envy and doubts. – I am in this world but I am not of this world. – I live my life with the revelation of a greater light. – I live from a higher realm of life. – I live above this world. – I live above sickness disease, fear, anxiety, depression, pain, sorrow and any weakness of this world. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!

title: EPISODE 1293 - LET THE WORD CULTIVATE YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Don’t treat the Word as another opinion from your mere thoughts. The word of God is not one of the philosophical thoughts. The Word of God is the best counsel of God to man. Shalom! Apostle Bennie Author Saturday, 8th August, 2026 LET THE WORD CULTIVATE YOUR HEART“All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness”  2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV)  At new birth, you received the life of God and full capacity.Jesus said, “…I came that they may have life, and have it in abundance [to the full, till it overflows].” John 10:10 (Amplified)
However, for life to have full expression in you, it is dependent on how you have been cultivated.
The life of God is in your spirit. God does not live in your mind; He lives in your spirit. And your mind has to be cultured to become conscious with the reality of God in your spirit-man. This is what spiritual maturity is to a certain degree. Spiritual maturity is basically your growth in consciousness. It is your mind, your will and emotions being cultivated to operate according to the reality of God in your spirit. For example:“God has not given you the spirit of fear” This is the reality of your spirit. However, you may find yourself living in fear. Why? Your mind, emotions and will have not been trained to practice the reality of fearlessness.
The more you give yourself to the training of the Word, the more you live according to God’s reality in your spirit.
You have to consciously submit your consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. When you don’t submit yourself to the teachings of the Word, you must know that other thought patterns are cultivating you. Whether you are intentional about it or not, you are cultivated or trained to live by some thought patterns. If your life is not influenced by the Word of God, you will be influenced by some other information. It is just like having bare land, with no intentional vegetation.The land will not remain bare forever because weeds will germinate on that land. Weeds grow anywhere there is room. Just because there’s no visible activity on a piece of land doesn’t mean nothing is growing there Our Lord Jesus likened the heart to a field and the word to a seed. (Mark 4:16-20).
When you don’t intentionally cultivate or train your heart with the Word, weeds will germinate.
Even while you are cultivating your heart with the word (as the seed), you have to consistently use the word to uproot wrong seeds, which will germinate in the field. Usually, when you are cultivating a field and weeds also begin to germinate on that field, they compete with the plants over nutrients. The word of God as a seed is profitable for:”…doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness” 2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV) The scriptures are God’s course for your living. They are designed to cultivate your heart and also to uproot or correct any wrong teachings of the world. To word instruct is the Greek word, “paideia”, which means to educate or train and to correct or discipline and chastise.
The word of God trains you to live according to God’s design and thought.
It sharpens your mind, emotions and will to live in conformity to God’s will publicly and privately. Don’t allow weeds of thoughts from the news, the society, friends, school, workplace etc germinate in your heart. Guard your heart with the Word of God. Be intentional about what grows in your heart. Envy, pride, hatred, fear, pain, bitterness, etc, can germinate in your heart without your permission, if you don’t intentionally give yourself to the training of the Word. As you study the Word, it corrects negative imaginations and thoughts which are not in conformity with the mind of God. BE A STUDENT OF THE WORD This is how you can be equipped for every good work. Beloved, allow the word to train you. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Romans 15:4; Zephaniah 3:4; Psalm 119:11; Proverbs 6:23; Proverbs 15:10, 31) WE PRAYThat we will consciously submit our consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 41–442 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 6–7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I intentionally give myself to the training of the word.– I guard my heart with the word of God. – I don’t permit negative thoughts. – I allow the word of God to cultivate my heart. – As I fellowship with the word of God daily, it sharpens my mind, will and emotions to live in conformity to God’s will. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeeey!

title: EPISODE 1294 - THE FATHERHOOD OF GOD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF The Church of our Lord Jesus is not only the body of Christ, the Church is also the family of God. It is the bedrock of divine civilization. As a new creation you are not an Island, you are born into God’s family to be cultured with the light of God, through the Church. True civilization is in the Family of God, identified on earth as the Church. Selah. Apostle Bennie Author Sunday, 9th August, 2026  THE FATHERHOOD OF GOD “… So the father raced out to meet him. He swept him up in his arms, hugged him dearly, and kissed him over and over with tender love.” Luke 15:20 (TPT) The Holy Bible is flooded with countless refreshing scriptures. And they convey the character, the essence and the wisdom of God.
The goal of the word of God is that all men may be fully satisfied in God, through the knowledge and understanding of Him.
Jesus (who is God made flesh) came to bring us into that eternal experience. The people who have been abused by religion and controlled by the rulers of darkness have a wrong mindset and doubts about the Bible. Some also have the wrong picture of God. And even think that Jesus came to change God’s mind about us. The image which has been painted over the period is that an angry hot-tempered God, wanted to destroy mankind and Jesus came to make Him change His mind.
This picture which has been painted over the centuries is not consistent with the word of God.
Get this: – God is good. (Nahum 1:7) – God is unchanging! (Malachi 3:6) – God is Love. (1 John 4:8)
Jesus didn’t come to change God’s mind about us, He came to change our mindset about God.
Jesus is God made flesh. He came to show mankind the true picture of God. “For God so loved the world…” (John 3:16). “God spared not His son, but gave Him up for us all…” (Romans 8:32) Glory to God… Until Jesus came, no one related to God as Father.
He came to show us the Fatherhood of God.
“I have revealed to them who you are and I will continue to make you even more real to them, so that they may experience the same endless love that you have for me, for your love will now live in them, even as I live in them!” John 17:26 (TPT) Through Jesus, the Fatherhood of God is revealed and the experience of His love is made real. Without Him, you cannot perfectly know the Father in a real way and may not experience His endless love for you. He said, “You are my righteous Father, but the unbelieving world has never known you in the perfect way that I know you!…” John 17:25 (TPT)
You will have a perfect knowledge of God when you behold Jesus.
One time as the disciples of Jesus were asking him about the Father: “Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father, and we will be satisfied.” John 14:8 (NLT) Wow!  Don’t mistake this satisfaction as the “satisfaction of their curiosity”. There is a longing for a deep relationship with God. There is no relationship with God which transcends, His Father-son relationship with us. You experience an immeasurable satisfaction when you come into the reality that, God is your Father. There is nothing more you need, nothing more satisfying, nothing that is enough for you, than the revelation of the Father.
The revelation of the Father is what makes you have a real experience of His love.
Jesus replied, “Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and yet you still don’t know who I am? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father! So why are you asking me to show him to you?” John 14:9 (NLT)
You don’t need to look too far to see the Father; Jesus is the Father!
To see the heart, care, kindness, sacrifice, mercy, forgiveness and graciousness of Jesus, is to see the heart and character of the Father. Just as the Father is unchanging, Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, and today and forever. (Hebrews 13:8), He is unchanging!
He brought to light the fullness of the Father’s goodness and love.
When the Father looks at you, He doesn’t see a prodigal son. He doesn’t want you to focus on yourself and your weakness. He wants you to focus on His love; for that is how you are most satisfied. The Father rejoices over you, He wants you to experience the warmth of His tender love, each day. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Hebrews 1:1-3; Colossians 1:15; John 1:14,18; John 10:30-38; Psalm 103:13; 1 John 3:1; Matthew 7:11-12) WE PRAYThat we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship in Christ Jesus. And by the ability of God’s Spirit within us, we shall express the nature of the Father as he has intended.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 45–482 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 8–9 DECLARE THESE WORDS:- I am the joy of the Father. - I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. - I am born of God. - As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. - I express the quality of God’s life. OH Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1295 - SONSHIP IN CHRIST JESUS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apply the scriptures in every situation, and don’t assume there are situations, you don’t need the word of God. Put God’s word to work in your daily life. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Monday, 10th August, 2026SONSHIP IN CHRIST JESUS“And it was a happy day for him when he gave us our new lives through the truth of his Word, and we became, as it were, the first children in his new family.” James 1:18 (The Living Bible) The greatest thing God achieved was not when He created the heavens, the stars, the moon, and the sun. The greatest thing God accomplished was not when He made Adam. 
The greatest thing He achieved was when He INDWELT MAN, through Christ, and this is how he gained Sons. 
Beloved, your sonship is the evidence of His Fatherhood. The matter of God having sons was for the satisfaction of His Fatherhood. It has been the Father’s heartbeat even before Sin entered the world. He intended to indwell us through the Spirit, to become one with us that we might be His sons.  The matter of sonship is unto expression. Fatherhood is for birthing. He is our Father to reproduce Himself in Us, and we are His sons to express (and reveal) Him.  The focus of our Lord Jesus was on the birthing of the Corporate (many) Sons. The desire of God as a Father was not to have Jesus as the only begotten Son, but that through Him, He will have many sons. 
Jesus came as the seed of the Father to be sown that through Him there will be the germination of many sons. 
The Lord Himself said, “Verily, verily, I say unto you, except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it dies, it bringeth forth much fruit.” John 12:24 (KJV) As many that have received Him are legally Sons of God. We are God-begotten. “But whoever did want him, who believed he was who he claimed and would do what he said, He made to be their true selves, their child-of-God selves. These are the God-begotten, not blood-begotten, not flesh-begotten, not sex-begotten.” John 1:12-13 (The MessageBible) Now, we are the sons of God by Faith (See 1 John 3:1-2; Galatians 3:26). Jesus is no longer the only begotten; He is the firstborn among many brethren, and He sees us as His brothers. “For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.” Romans 8:29 (KJV) “Jesus, the Holy One, makes us holy. And as sons and daughters, we now belong to his same Father, so he is not ashamed or embarrassed to introduce us as his brothers and sisters!” Hebrews 2:11 (The Passion Translation)
It is the joy of the Father to bring us into sonship, and this was His predestined plan before time began. 
“For He foreordained us (destined us, planned in love for us) to be adopted (revealed) as His own children through Jesus Christ, in accordance with the purpose of His will [because it pleased Him and was His kind intent]” Ephesians 1:5 Glory to God! This is amazing! He didn’t just reveal us as His children through Jesus Christ, and He gave us the Holy Spirit to be a seal and a witness that we are His forever. We have the Holy Spirit as the testimony within us that God is not only God to us. He is not just a Judge unto us, but He is also our Eternal Father. We call Him Daddy! Daddy! (Abba Father) with joy. “For you have not received a spirit of slavery leading again to fear [of God’s judgment], but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons [the Spirit producing sonship] by which we [joyfully] cry, “Abba Father! The Spirit Himself testifies and  confirms together with our spirit [assuring us] that we [believers] are children of God” Romans 8:15-16 (Amplified Bible) “And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.” (Galatians4:6) The essence of the Gospel of our Lord Jesus is to point you to YOUR SONSHIP IN CHRIST, and this reality delights the Father’s heart. Hallelujah!DIG DEEPER(1 John 3:1-2; Romans 8:15-16; John 1:12; Galatians 3:26) WE PRAY That we will walk in the consciousness of our sonship in Christ Jesus. And by the ability of God’s Spirit within us, we shall express the nature of the Father as he has intended. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 49–512 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 10 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am the joy of the Father. – I live in the consciousness of my sonship in Christ. – I am born of God. – As a son of God, I am the evidence of His Fatherhood. – I express the quality of God’s life. Oh Hallelujah, GLORY TO GOD!!!

title: EPISODE 1296 - EXPRESS THE REALITY OF GOD IN YOUR WORLD
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Beloved, God doesn’t take any pleasure in making life hard. You have to take advantage of His supply to bear great fruits. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday, 11th August, 2026EXPRESS THE REALITY OF GOD IN YOUR WORLD“God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.”  1 Corinthians 1:9 (NKJV)  When you believed and received Jesus, you did not merely escape hell. The Lord brought you into sonship. (John 1:12-13). In your new birth, you were called into the fellowship of Jesus by God. The word, fellowship is from the Greek word “Koinonia”, which means partnership, participation, communication, communion, distribution and intercourse.
By God’s own faithfulness, not by your self-effort, God called you into the participation, communion and partnership of His Son Jesus.
To come into fellowship or participation in His Son also means you share in the reality of the Sonship of Jesus.In the fellowship of sonship, you are no longer an alien but also a son. “Beloved, now are we the sons of God…” 1 John 3:2 (KJV) In that call unto fellowship with Jesus the Lord also justified you.This was not an afterthought; it was God’s age-long plan and intention to bring you into sonship. It was His predestined plan to call you, justify you and bring you into His glory. (Romans 8:30).
Justification is a crucial reality for your calling into sonship.
The term justification is a legal term. To be justified is to be declared not guilty or declared righteous. You were not justified cheaply. God did not overlook your wrongs to justify you. Jesus died as a penalty for your wrongs and trespasses. “He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification” Romans 4:25(BSB) Now, from the above verse, you can see the essence of the resurrection of Jesus. By the resurrection of Jesus, you were justified.The born-again in Christ is the justified. As He has called you, He has justified you.  The justification came with His resurrection, and by that, God legally called you into the fellowship of sonship. God purposed this before the foundation of the earth. The Lord desires that all will experience salvation and become His very expression and manifestation.  God didn’t want to be hidden. He wanted to be touched and experienced. He wanted His love to be seen by all. God predestined that man would be His expression before the foundation of the world and come into adoption as sons. Sonship is for expression. The son expresses the father. Great is the mystery of Godliness; God manifested in the flesh [see 1st Timothy 3:16]. “No man has ever seen God but the son who is in the bosom of the father has expressed Him” [John 1:18]. The Son expressed the Father by becoming flesh. God becoming man through Jesus was His manifestation. Godliness is the expression of divinity.
The essence of man is that he will be the expression of life, which is God. 
Man is to be the very expression of God.God has predestined that you will be hewn out of Him, possessing His LIFE. It is His plan for all.God made it available for all men to experience adoption of sonship. Yet not all have come into this sonship. Those who receive Him are brought into sonship.The saddest thing is not receiving eternal life, and the gladdest thing is to receive eternal life by believing (John 1:11-12). Whosoever has the son has life. This means the son is the life (1 John 5:11-12) Beloved, let this settle within you: your participation in sonship is not dependent on your faithfulness. It is dependent on the faithfulness of God. Not that we first loved him, but that he first loved us [1st John 4:10]. By this, you came into a participation, a fellowship, and equal sharing in Christ. You don’t have a ‘part share’, you have a full share as son.Wherefore are we partakers of the divine nature (2 Peter 1:4). You share in all of that which is in God.
Anytime you feel discouraged and it seems the vicissitudes of life kick you about, remember you are a son of God.
Anytime you feel like all hope is lost, remember you have a living hope which is incorruptible. (1 Peter 1:3). We are not of this world. We are not in agreement with this world. You are not a sinner. You are a son of God. You are in fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ, our Lord. GLORY TO GOD!DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:3-6; 2 Timothy 1:9-10; Romans 8:14-17;28-30) WE PRAY That as sons we shall demonstrate and express the reality of God in our world. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 52–542 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 11 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – Now I am a son of God and I have His very life. – I share in the inheritance of the sons of God in the light. – I express God to my world, through the supply of God’s Spirit. – I am born with the life of God, therefore I have His nature. – I don’t live as a slave of this world, for I am a son of God. Oh Hallelujah, Glory to God!!!

title: EPISODE 1297 - PRESS ON AGAINST ALL ODDS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Don’t give up! Don’t doubt! Don’t draw back! Maintain your composure of faith. Keep declaring the word of God. Keep shouting the victory you have received concerning your health, your finances, your purpose, your family, and your ministry. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday, 12th August, 2026 PRESS ON AGAINST ALL ODDS “Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: [so] that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, He may give it [to] you” John 15:16 (ASV) In your fruit-bearing or Kingdom results, your Heavenly Father is glorified. This doesn’t happen automatically, simply because you are a disciple of Jesus.   You can be a disciple of Jesus and still not bear fruits. To produce results there are specific things to do.
Until you become interested in and passionate about the kingdom’s success, you will not be willing to take steps to make it happen.
God and His Kingdom must become your priority. Until God is your priority you cannot invest in Him. Your heart must be after God. One question you must always ask yourself is this: How deep is my love and jealousy for God? When you don’t love the Lord, you will not be willing to go the extra mile for His course. You will always make excuses and seek self-pleasure. Challenges may surface to resist your attempts to produce results. You don’t have to give up or drawback. There is something important you need to do: Contend for results. Results require a relentless posture of faith. Because of the adversary’s resistance, your results will always come with a fight. This is not a fight to obtain victory; it is a fight to unleash and enforce the victory that you have obtained in Christ. You don’t have to fake or pretend that you have the results, you must contend for it. To have results is a faith thing. You must contend and release your faith.
IT IS CALLED THE GOOD FIGHT OF FAITH!
Paul the apostle in his last epistle to Timothy made an affectionate heartthrob statement: “I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.” 2 Timothy 4:7 (NKJV)
This fight of faith is a good, worthy and noble fight. It is to contend earnestly the glorious contest to guard the faith.
In Paul’s first epistle to Timothy, he instructed him to, “Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you were also called and have confessed the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.” 1 Timothy 6:12 As we have seen in the second epistle, Paul the apostle was instructing Timothy to do exactly what he was also doing. To have a fruitful experience of the faith, you must fight to express it. You must contend in faith. Again he said, as part of his epistle to the Church in Philippi, “I press toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.” Philippians 3:14 (NKJV) He has to press toward the goal because there were many things which may serve as limitations. To press on and to contend for the results means you are not holding anything back. You have to fight, run and strive for the results.
In your attempt to achieve results, you may be confronted by trial.
“Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.” (James 1:12). You have to persevere as a good soldier. As you are taking steps, you must remain resolute and daring. You have to press on against all odds to produce consistent Kingdom results. Glory to God. DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 6:12-13; Colossians 1:29; Galatians 6:9; 1 Corinthians 15:58) WE PRAYPray that as we labour in the faith, we shall strive with all of the Lord’s energy working powerfully within us, and be steadfast, immovable and always excel in the work of the Lord. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 55–572 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I produce kingdom results. – I am blessed by the Lord to be fruitful. – My fruits glorify the Father. – I am a true disciple of Jesus because I bear much fruits. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1298 - SUBMIT TO THE TRAINING OF YOUR LEADER
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF There is nothing done for the spread of the gospel, which the adversary has not attacked or attempted to destroy. Beloved pray and honor those who labour in the gospel of Jesus. Glory to God. Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 13th August, 2026SUBMIT TO THE TRAINING OF YOUR LEADER“Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head.  Ephesians 4:15 (GNT)  There are things you cannot achieve in Christ until you grow.  Our heavenly Father is interested in your growth and maturity, thus, He has made every provision for you to grow spiritually. He didn’t just give you His word, He granted you access (Ephesians 2:18) for you to commune with Him (through prayer and fellowship with the Holy Spirit).
He planted you in His Church for you to be nurtured and gave you gifted men to equip you.
See how the apostle puts it: “And [His gifts to the church were varied and] He Himself appointed some as apostles [special messengers, representatives], some as prophets [who speak a new message from God to the people], some as evangelists [who spread the good news of salvation], and some as pastors and teachers [to shepherd and guide and instruct], [and He did this] to fully equip and perfect the saints (God’s people) for works of service, to build up the body of Christ [the church]; until we all reach oneness in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, [growing spiritually] to become a mature believer, reaching to the measure of the fullness of Christ [manifesting His spiritual completeness and exercising our spiritual gifts in unity]. So that we are no longer children [spiritually immature], tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine, by the cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men, by the deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit]. But speaking the truth in love [in all things—both our speech and our lives expressing His truth], let us grow up in all things into Him [following His example] who is the Head—Christ.”Ephesians 4:11-15 (Amplified) From the above verses we see the organic assignment of the gifted men. God’s intention for these gifted men (apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers) is to: 1. Fully equip and perfect the saints for service (or the work of the ministry). To equip and perfect the saints, furnishes them with the necessary spiritual tools and dexterous skills and mastery for service.  2.  To build up the body of Christ [the church]. Your growth and maturity contributes to the building up of the body of Christ. Which means, your immaturity can be a deficiency in the body. These gifted men equip and perfect the saints to build up the body until:  3. We all reach oneness in the faith.   4. We all reach oneness in the knowledge of the Son of God. 5. Growing spiritually to become a mature believer. 6. Reaching to the measure of the fullness of Christ [manifesting His spiritual completeness]  7. Exercising our spiritual gifts in unity.  8. As we step into these above reality of our growth in the spirit or maturity; WE ARE NO LONGER CHILDREN [SPIRITUALLY IMMATURE].
The spiritually immature are tossed back and forth [like ships on a stormy sea] and carried about by every wind of [shifting] doctrine. 
When you are not maturing or growing spiritually you become a victim of: – every cunning and trickery of [unscrupulous] men.  – deceitful scheming of people ready to do anything [for personal profit].  However from these verses we see  again the the matter of LOVE. Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head. Ephesians 4:15 (GNT) We grow up into Christ by LOVE. And the reality is, apart from love there is no other way you can genuinely grow up into Christ.
Your growth is not into your self or personal desires. Your growth is into Christ; who is the ultimate example of love.
Our Heavenly Father has made these provisions of gifted men to bring us to the place of MATURING INTO CHRIST in the perfection of His Love. Submitting to the training of the gifted men God has given you in your “local Church” is your reception and enjoyment of God’s provision for your growth in the spirit. Selah.DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 3:14-16; 23:3-4; Ephesians 3:16-18; 1 Corinthians 13; Galatians 5:22-23; 2 Peter 3:18; 2 Peter 1:8; Hebrews 5:12-13; 1 Peter 2:2) WE PRAY Dear Lord, please teach me how to humbly submit to the nurturing and training of my man of God. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 58–602 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 13 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I humbly submit to training. – I take heed to every instruction given by my man of God. – I am not dull in hearing the word of God. – I make time daily to fellowship with the scriptures. – I don’t lazy about my spiritual development. – I don’t trivialize my fellowship with the Holy Spirit. – I demonstrate the love of Christ in all things. Oh Hallelujah!!! Glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1299 - UNTIL THE SPIRIT IS POURED UPON YOU FROM ON HIGH…
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Don’t go a day without having intense fellowship with Him. The Holy Spirit will make something beautiful out of your life; be conscious of His presence in your life. SELAH! Apostle Bennie Author Friday, 14th August, 2026UNTIL THE SPIRIT IS POURED UPON YOU FROM ON HIGH…“Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is valued as a forest.” Isaiah 32:15 (Amplified Bible)  Working hard to be fruitful is great. However, there is no fruitfulness without the Spirit. Wherever the Spirit of the Lord is there is blossoming.God’s desire is that you become fruitful.  However your fruitfulness is by the Spirit. The scriptures liken the fruitfulness or flourishing of one who has experienced the outpouring of the Spirit to a forest. This reveals the extent by which a spirit-life can flourish.Without the outflow of the Spirit you may experience dryness.  When there is the overflowing of the Spirit in your life, you shall not experience dryness. “I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.” Isaiah 41:18 This is why you have to commune with the Holy Spirit. You cannot have a consistent communion with the Holy Spirit and remain dry. When the spirit is poured out to you, your ‘dry life’, becomes a fruitful life and then grows to become a forest.  The Holy Spirit supplies your life with rivers of living waters, which causes you to blossom in all things. Do you want to flourish beyond measure? Let the Holy Spirit take over your soul. Shalom. DIG DEEPER(Psalm 107:35; Isaiah 44:3; Isaiah 29:17) WE PRAYThat we will enjoy the sufficient supply of God’sSpirit and grace to bear and multiply our fruits. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 61–63 2 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 14 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I bear fruits by the ability of the Supply of Christ. – I am made competent by the empowering presence of God. – I don’t operate by my own strength. – I am strengthened by the grace of God to do more.  – I refuse to be separated from the Lord. – I live in the union of Christ. – Fruitfulness streams from within me because the Lord is my source. – Every weakness in me is perfected by the Grace of God. – I am greatly helped and resourced by the Lord. – I blossom as a forest. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1300 - CAN GOD COUNT ON YOU?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Living a life beyond your needs or personal interest is the beginning of greatness. The steps you are willing to take today shows whether you will do valiantly or not. Shalom! Apostle Bennie Author Saturday, 15th August, 2026CAN GOD COUNT ON YOU?Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:  1 Chronicles 29:3 (NKJV)  A United Nations publication of 1998 “Economic and Social Consequences of Drug Abuse and Illicit drugs states that: a total estimation of $400 billion is spent on illicit drugs per annum in the world. According to Statista Research Department, the total costs from terrorism in the world amounted to 115.8 billion U.S. dollars in 2014. In 2016, the economic cost of terrorism in Africa was US$15.5 billion. These terrorism activities are funded by some institutions and even some individuals.And interestingly most of these terrorism activities are with religious intentions. Do you have an idea how much people spend to attend night clubs and entertainment events?
Beloved, what more is too much to spend on the spread of the glorious gospel of our Lord Jesus.
David said, ” because I have set my affection on the house of my God, I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house, my own special treasure of gold and silver“ The spread of the gospel is a great work.Remember anything that is of God is great.
No amount of money is too big for the gospel.
Though the preaching of the gospel is free, it is not cheap.Just as the salvation which our Lord brought is free, but was not cheap. It took the sacrifice of the eternal blood of God (Our Lord Jesus) to make salvation available. To go forth with the gospel to get many saved; will cost you time, attention, energy, passion and MONEY. The Holy Spirit is the greatest help for the salvation of souls. However, there are things you will need to use for the spread of the gospel. And it will take money to make such possible.
Where are you putting your money?
Don’t you think it is a glorious thing to be involved in the financing of the gospel? Don’t you think it is more blessing to see thousands and millions of people transformed, just because you gave into a gospel mission? If others take delight in sponsoring terrorism, then you shouldn’t sit back when there is a need to finance the gospel. Join the shining forth of the light of the gospel through your giving. Your money can make more impact in the lives of others through the gospel. What you have in your hand can bless thousands of people, don’t just spend on yourself.
You learn to live for others when you partner into the gospel.
That is how your life begins to find meaning and expression. Do you remember the little boy whose five loaves and two fishes fed the multitudes? The gospel must spread and your money should be involved. Selah.DIG DEEPER(2 Corinthians 9:6-11; Genesis 8:22; Matthew 14:15-21) WE PRAY – That we will be empowered with the blessings of the Lord to create wealth in every single opportunity to give bountifully into the spread of the gospel. – That we will be empowered to financially multiply all that the Lord has entrusted into our hands to finance the gospel. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANIsaiah 64–66, Jeremiah 12 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 15–16 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The gospel prospers in my hands. – I am a prompt to do it giver. – Through my finance, the gospel reaches the far ends of the world. – The Lord can depend on me for His kingdom advancement. – I am excited to give unto the Lord, because it is the greatest privilege. – Whatever the Lord will request from me, I give with joy. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1309 - THE BEDROCK OF TRUE CIVILIZATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF To live by faith is not a suggestion; it is the identity of those born into God’s household. The Church which is the embodiment of God’s family, is a household of faith. It is the aggregation of men who are cultured, live, think, speak, and function by faith. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Monday, 24th August, 2026 THE BEDROCK OF CIVILIZATION“God decided in advance to adopt us into his own family by bringing us to himself through Jesus Christ. This is what he wanted to do, and it gave him great pleasure.” Ephesians 1:5 (MSG)God’s salvation plan is to bring man into His family. The essence of our sonship is to reveal the Fatherhood of God. God takes delight in His Fatherhood.
His desire to have a family wasn’t because He was lonely; it was because He wanted to share His love and inheritance of glory with others.
A family is a group of people related by blood, birth, marriage, or adoption. It is also a group of things related by common characteristics and nature or a group of people united by a unique conviction. Interestingly, a family also functions as a womb, where lives and destinies are nurtured, cultured, nourished, preserved, and equipped until one is ready to be delivered.
A person’s civilization is deeply rooted in the family system. A family has a key role to play in shaping the mindset of people.
And that is why the adversary takes an interest in destroying families, just to destroy society. The prosperity of every society and civilization can be traced to the success of families as one of the key ingredients.
It is a bedrock of future excellence or failures.
Most children who grew up in broken or disintegrated homes or families are most likely to experience rejection, anxiety, depression lack of confidence, and develop hatred. The family unit is God’s strategic wisdom for effective discipleship. It is a development center for every member of the kingdom. Through the family unit, children get to experience true love, care and discipline. God said to Abraham: “In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.” Genesis 22:18 (NKJV) Now we can see also how God had confidence in Abraham: “For I have chosen him, that he may command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing righteousness and justice, so that the LORD may bring to Abraham what he has promised him.” Genesis 18:19 (ESV) What God said concerning Abraham and how he will command his household reveals God’s intention about every household or family. Each household or family is a womb or bedrock of a certain civilization. A divine family will produce a divine civilization.
God brought us into His family so that He will bring us into His civilization. It is only in the family of God we are raised and nurtured to think according to the divine light.
Every level of civilization is defined by the degree of light at work. God’s family is a household of light. It is also the household of faith. As sons of God, we are not to function according to the systems of this world. We are to operate in the light of divine revelation. The civilization of God’s Kingdom can only be manifested on earth through the family of God.
The Church of our Lord Jesus is not only the body of Christ, the Church is also the family of God. It is the bedrock of divine civilization.
As a new creation you are not an Island, you are born into God’s family to be cultured with the light of God, through the Church. True civilization is in the Family of God, identified on earth as the Church. And this is God’s strategic wisdom for effective discipleship. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 1:11; Romans 8:29; John 1:12; Psalm 145:4) WE PRAYThat we will yield ourselves to the true civilization of God’s Family on earth which is the Church BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLAN Jeremiah 29–312 YEARS PLAN Proverbs 28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I belong to the eternal incorruptible Family of God.– I am deeply rooted in Christ. – I am nourished and enriched by Christ. – I am the focus of the love of God. – I am made whole and holy by His love. – I am a partner together with God. Oh Hallelujah, GLOREEEEY!!!

title: EPISODE 1317 - BUT NOAH… 1
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Glorious New Month to you beloved, this month be intentional about demonstrating the glory of the life at work in you. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday, 1st September, 2026 BUT NOAH... 1“But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD” Genesis 6:8 (KJV) God is just and has no agreement with evil. His goodness exposes and displaces evil. The judgment of God against evil is also the work of His goodness and righteousness to uproot destruction. His judgment also includes deliverance by faith and not by works. The present world or today’s society has evil, corruption and sufferings breeding rapidly. Parents and families feel hopeless about the possible outcomes for the future generation. Most people are talking about how the entire society is heading towards total destruction. Fear, anxiety and depression have abounded in hearts. Perversion of hearts, greed, and acts of wickedness have occupied news headlines. Acts of kindness have become rare and a jaw-dropping experience in most circles. This shouldn’t be surprising. The scriptures have foretold these happenings. “Don’t be naive. There are difficult times ahead. As the end approaches, people are going to be self-absorbed, money-hungry, self-promoting, stuck-up, profane, contemptuous of parents, crude, coarse, dog-eat-dog, unbending, slanderers, impulsively wild, savage, cynical, treacherous, ruthless, bloated windbags, addicted to lust, and allergic to God. They’ll make a show of religion, but behind the scenes they’re animals. Stay clear of these people.” 2 Timothy 3:1-5 (Message Bible) The Prophet Isaiah also gave a picture of the happenings on the earth: “The whole earth is wrapped in darkness, all people sunk in deep darkness, But God rises on you, his sunrise glory breaks over you” Isaiah 60:2 (Message Bible)
Amidst the chaotic situation of darkness in this world, there is the shining forth of God’s light over those who trust in Him.
The present happenings in today’s world are not new. From the day corruption entered time, the hearts of men have conceptualised evil and wickedness. And God’s news of salvation and deliverance has always been the goodnews of light which shines in an evil world. This is the reality of the Goodnews of Grace; it is the shining forth of God’s light in a hopeless world. Sometimes we think of God’s grace as an afterthought, but God has always been gracious. The fullness of His Grace manifested at the appearing of Jesus. However, this is how God has always operated before time began. Paul the apostle explains this in his second epistle to Timothy: “He gave us resurrection life and drew us to himself by his holy calling on our lives. And it wasn’t because of any good we have done, but by his divine pleasure and marvelous grace that confirmed our union with the anointed Jesus, even before time began! This truth is now being unveiled by the revelation of the anointed Jesus, our life-giver, who has dismantled death, obliterating all its effects on our lives, and has manifested his immortal life in us by the gospel.” 2 Timothy 1:9-10 (TPT) Click here to register Grace and love are the flow or rhythm and nature of God’s economy. The Kingdom of God, which is the household of God, functions or is administered by GRACE.
God’s graciousness is His emission of light in a dark world.
Grace is glory began. One cannot experience the glory of God without the administrative work of His Grace. When you understand God’s grace as the economy of God’s Kingdom, you will know when God said, “let there be light”, He was proclaiming and administering the goodness of His grace. “Let there be light” wasn’t a mere work of creation but the manifestation of God’s goodnews to a chaotic and formless earth. “The earth was formless and void or a waste and emptiness, and darkness was upon the face of the deep [primeval ocean that covered the unformed earth]. The Spirit of God was moving (hovering, brooding) over the face of the waters. And God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light” Genesis 1:2-3 (AMP) This is the message this present world needs to hear. The Goodnews of Jesus is the only message of grace which will cause the light of God to shine over evil and empty souls.
It is the only message that will deliver this generation from a void and hopelessness. It is the news of God’s life.
Beloved, take heed to the Goodnews of Jesus and not the news of this world. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Genesis 6:5-8; Matthew 4:16; 2 Corinthians 4:6; Acts 26:18; John 8:12; Luke 1:78-79) WE PRAYWe pray that the light of the gospel of Jesus will shine in every heart and prevail in generation and the generations yet unborn through us. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLAN Lamentations 3–5 2 YEARS PLAN Ecclesiastes 7 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I take heed to the goodnews of Jesus. – Through me, many are coming into the full knowledge of the goodnews of Jesus. – Through my participation, the gospel will shine in every heart, and prevail in every generation and the generations yet unborn. Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1325 - SERVE YOUR GENERATION WITH EVERY ABILITY OF GOD IN YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Beloved, refuse to doubt the Word of His Grace for it is the legal chronicle of the bequeathed inheritance. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday, 8th September, 2026  SERVE YOUR GENERATION WITH EVERY ABILITY OF GOD IN YOU “As each one has received a gift, minister it to one another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.” 1 Peter 4:10 (NKJV) You don’t only serve God with supernatural gifts or what is known as Spiritual Gifts.
Every talent and gift or abilities come from God, therefore it must be used to serve His purpose.
There are times people assume the skills they develop are by their own diligence thus, those talents and skills are self-generated and cannot be God centered. All of these are of God: – Natural Talents. These are inherent or innate talents and abilities which people possess through the genetic material of their families. These are passed down from one generation to the next generation. Some families are mostly athletic, others are good at playing musical instruments, and some have a voice for singing but are not good at playing musical instruments. Some are good with artisanship and also technical skills because they inherited the genetic code which brings the skills naturally to them. – Nurtured or developed Interest. If one has to become exceptional with their natural or innate talent, he or she has to nurture it through hard work, discipline and consistent training. No matter how talented you are, you have to develop it to the highest level of dexterity.        Now there are people with certain skills which weren’t innate. They just developed an interest in those skills through association or the kind of environment they found themselves. For example, there are people who developed an interest in playing musical instruments simply because they found themselves among instrumentalists. They then begin to nurture their interests, through constant training till they become skillful at it. By the latent power of the mind, anyone can develop any skill he or she sets his or her mind on, whether it’s innate talent or not. Though the nurtured interest in a skill, may seem not to be directly from God, the latent power of the mind, is of God. And also remember, as a believer, it is God who works in you both to will and to do (Philippians 2:13).
Both the unsaved and the saved have natural talents and nurtured interests. Yet know that those abilities are to be used to glorify God.
– Supernatural gifts or Spiritual Gifts. These are the gifts distributed to the saved in Christ by the Holy Spirit. These gifts are given according to the will of God. And as people mature in their relationship with God, they are imparted by the Holy Spirit with special spiritual gifts. These gifts enable the believer to serve the Lord, His Kingdom and the saints. “Now there are [distinctive] varieties of spiritual gifts [special abilities given by the grace and extraordinary power of the Holy Spirit operating in believers], but it is the same Spirit [who grants them and empowers believers]. And there are [distinctive] varieties of ministries and service, but it is the same Lord [who is served]. And there are [distinctive] ways of working [to accomplish things], but it is the same God who produces all things in all believers [inspiring, energizing, and empowering them]. But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit [the spiritual illumination and the enabling of the Holy Spirit] for the common good. To one is given through the [Holy] Spirit [the power to speak] the message of wisdom, and to another [the power to express] the word of knowledge and understanding according to the same Spirit; to another [wonder-working] faith [is given] by the same [Holy] Spirit, and to another the [extraordinary] gifts of healings by the one Spirit; and to another the working of miracles, and to another prophecy [foretelling the future, speaking a new message from God to the people], and to another discernment of spirits [the ability to distinguish sound, godly doctrine from the deceptive doctrine of man-made religions and cults], to another various kinds of [unknown] tongues, and to another interpretation of tongues.  All these things [the gifts, the achievements, the abilities, the empowering] are brought about by one and the same [Holy] Spirit, distributing to each one individually just as He chooses.“ 1 Corinthians 12: 4 -11 (Amplified Bible) Through verses 8 to 10, Paul the Apostle outlined different spiritual gifts. But that is not all that there is, He also mentioned other Spiritual Gifts in Romans 12: The gift of serving others, the gift of teaching, the gift of preaching, the gift of being generous, the gift of administration or special administrative ability and the gift of comfort or encouragement. ( See Romans 12:7-8). When for example someone is exceptional in administration or has a special ability in comforting others, you may think it’s just natural. But there is a supernatural ability which is supplied even for administration. You can develop administrative skills through education or may have administrative skills through an innate ability.   However, when the special grace of God comes upon you, it amplifies the administrative ability you possess. 
No matter the ability you have, when you become born again, the anointing of the Holy Spirit finds expression through it to serve the Lord’s purpose.
“God has given each of us the ability to do certain things well…” Romans 12:6 (TLB) You are a steward of the talents and the gifts in you. Your stewardship is demonstrated when you use every ability in you to advance the Lord’s Kingdom, honor the Lord and serve others. 
Don’t limit the usefulness of your gifts and talents to satisfy self-gratification.
Are you a faithful steward? Selah. DIG DEEPER(Romans 12:6-8; 1 Corinthians 12: 4-31; Exodus 31:3-5; Exodus 35:10) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall exercise the wisdom to serve our generation with every ability of God in us to bring glory to His name. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANEzekiel 21–232 YEARS PLAN Song of Solomon 4 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I use all my gifts and talents to honor God and advance His Kingdom. – All of my gifts and talents are of God and they are for His glory. – I am a faithful steward. – I use my time wisely for the fulfillment of the Lord’s purpose. – I live to fulfill God’s divine purpose. – I don’t use my gifts and talents for my interest. – I increase daily in understanding to know how to harness and utilize my gifts and talents to fulfill the Lord’s purpose. – I live to serve God’s purpose. – My life is for the glory of God. Thank you Heavenly Father!

title: EPISODE 1326 - REFUSE INGRATITUDE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Beloved, find out what God has said in His word concerning your health, your finances, your ministry, your family, your destiny, your work, your marriage and your society. Believe it and boldly declare it. Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday, 9th September, 2026 REFUSE INGRATITUDE  “And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you” 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (KJV) Some believers are orphaned in doctrinal truth concerning New Testament leadership, believers’ character or conduct, and even consistent revelation of Jesus. On matters of leadership, some jump into conclusion that, since we are in the New Testament, there is nothing like higher leadership rank. They conclude that: – Jesus has made all believers equal in Him, therefore, no one is set higher or above the saints. – And also, Jesus is the only Shepherd we submit to as believers and not to any other fellow saints. Such teachings are propagated by people who are rebellious or those who wish to rule over others but never got the opportunity. These people are like Korah, Dathan, and Abiram (Numbers 16; Jude 1:11). Because they are not appointed to lead, they become rebellious and attempt to mock the concept of spiritual authority. Meanwhile, these are people who prefer to follow their own desires and live without submission (Jude 1:8). Don’t follow such scoffers. Some of the people who uphold such thoughts are also people who are trapped in bitterness. These people were either victims or witnesses of toxic leadership. People can be warned and taught to identify toxic leaders. But, toxic leaders must not be the reason to propagate a campaign against a clear leadership system in the New Testament. Toxic leaders don’t really “labour”; they would rather want to enjoy the labour of others.
There are people who, through their genuine labour, are engraced and given a rank to spearhead a divine course in a generation.
Some are leaders set over you within your assembly, and others within the body of Christ. Pay attention to the words of Paul the apostle again: “And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you” 1 Thessalonians 5:12 (KJV) The expression “ARE OVER” is from the Greek word “PROISTĒMI”. Proistēmi is a strong expression of responsibility or authority. It means “to care for” or “give attention to”. Is that all there is? Proistēmi also means “to set or “place before”. This means “to be set over”, “to preside over”, “to be in charge over”, “to stand in rank over”, “to rule over”, and “to be a protector” or “guardian”, or “to give aid”. The word “KNOW” also means “to look on”, “be concerned with”, “behold”, “acknowledge”, and to “appreciate”. Any teaching that makes you feel you are your own authority and don’t have to submit to anyone apart from Jesus, is nurturing your heart not to acknowledge and appreciate those the Lord has set to be ranked, to preside, to rule, and to guide you. The leaders set over the saints by the Lord are equal with the saints in life and nature. Yet they are first in the administration of God’s work. Though the leaders set over you are your brothers as to the enjoyment of grace, yet as to touching service, they are the most slaves. And Jesus was clear on this, “he that is greatest (meizōn, larger) among you shall by your servant”
The leading ones are the most serving ones, and must be greatly appreciated for their service.
Have you appreciated your leader today? Appreciating and honoring your leaders is an obedience to the wisdom of God. Selah. DIG DEEPER(1 Timothy 5:17; 1 Corinthians  16:15-16; Hebrews 13:17; Philippians 2:28-30; 1 Peter 5:5) WE PRAY We pray that seeds of rebellion, bitterness, selfishness, and arrogance shall not germinate in our hearts towards the leading ones, but the counsel of God’s word shall have full preeminence, even as we appreciate our Leaders who labour with integrity. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN Ezekiel 24–262 YEARS PLAN Song of Solomon 5 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I walk in honor towards my Leader. – I  don’t dishonor the authorities God has set over me. – I refuse to be ungrateful towards my leader. – I honor my Leader with my treasure, time and finances. – I demonstrate honor towards my leader in all things. Thank you Lord for my Leader.

title: EPISODE 1327 - IS ANYTHING TOO HARD FOR THE LORD?
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Just in case you feel tired, confused and discouraged in helping others, don’t continue listening to what you feel, turn to the Lord. Talk to the Holy Spirit, He is your ULTIMATE HELP. Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 10th September, 2026  IS THERE ANYTHING TOO HARD FOR THE LORD? “For everyone born of God is victorious and overcomes the world; and this is the victory that has conquered and overcome the world—our [continuing, persistent] faith [in Jesus the Son of God].”  1 John 5:4 (Amplified Bible) Beloved in Christ, it is not a mistake you are reading today’s Machaira with Apostle Bennie. This is a special message to you. You have no reason to feel hopeless, tired and defeated. No matter the reasons you have, none of them surmount the victory which Christ has wrought for you. You may have the whole world against you, and all systems opposing your advancement, but none of them can surmount your faith in Christ Jesus.
No matter the limitations you may feel, see or experience around you, faith in Christ gives you the superior advantage.
What are the limitations you see in your pursuit of purpose? Do you think they are too big for you? Do you feel or think you are too small and lack the strength to prevail in life? Do you think your family setup and academic failures are limitations to your progress? Even Esau, who lost his birthright and blessings, had an opportunity to prevail. Read here. Do you even think you have wasted time and cannot achieve your dreams? See, Sarah, who was barren, old in years, and long past the age of childbearing, received strength to conceive a child. (Genesis 18:11; Hebrews 11:11).
Don’t doubt the Lord!
And if you have ever doubted, today marks a new beginning. Don’t think that because you doubted, there is no hope for you. Abraham laughed when he was first told he was going to give birth to a son. “Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?” (Genesis 17:17) Sarah also laughed within herself, saying, “After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?” (Genesis 18:12). Their laughter was based on biological facts. Biologically or scientifically, both Abraham and Sarah have passed the stage of childbirth. Sarah, at 90, meant her reproductive system had entered and even gone beyond menopause. Menopause is a natural decline in reproductive hormones. At this stage, the ovaries stop releasing eggs for fertilisation (which is the loss of ovarian follicular function). When the menstrual cycles and egg production cease, natural pregnancy is impossible. Also, the uterus and other reproductive organs experience age-related changes that can make pregnancy more difficult or impossible. But amidst all these limitations, faith activated will cause the limitless word of God to prevail over every limitation. “And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old? Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.” Genesis 18:13-14 (KJV) Oh glory! One powerful question which should be your faith for every challenge was what the Lord asked Abraham. IS ANYTHING TOO HARD FOR THE LORD? From then on, Abraham and Sarah chose to exercise themselves in the faith of God. Abraham, against hope, believed in hope that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken. Your set time to take the stand of faith is now. As you are born of God, live in the confidence of the faith of God.
As you are born of God, you have the faith to conquer and overcome the world (with its systems, limitations and oppositions).
By faith, Sarah prevailed over the limitations of childbearing in old age. Refuse to be limited!!! Don’t settle for the limitations around you. Don’t think according to your background or where you live. Don’t make decisions according to how you feel. In Christ Jesus, there are no limitations. All limitations are mental illusions. Walk in the reality of the Word of God. Shake yourself from every yoke of the mind and of the heart. Live above all limitations. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Romans 8:37; 1 Corinthians 15:57; Luke 4:18; Psalm 147:5; Luke 21:15) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall live above every limitation of the mind and of the heart.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLANEzekiel 27–292 YEARS PLAN Song of Solomon 6 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to allow myself to settle or be comforted under any force of limitation to my destiny. – I live by the limitless ability of God. – I refuse to make decisions according to how I feel, I am led by the Lord. – I shake myself from every yoke of the mind and heart. – I live above all limitations. Oh glory to God. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1328 - THE WORD OF GOD IS TRUE AND ABSOLUTE
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF When your heart is cultivated by the Word of God through meditation, you conceptualise God’s goodness, prosperity, good success and glory. Shalom! Apostle Bennie Author Friday, 11th September, 2026 THE WORD OF GOD IS TRUE AND ABSOLUTE“Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?”  John 11:40 (TPT)  There is a reason the Lord keeps reminding you of things pertaining to your faith walk with Him.
Anytime the Lord bring admonishments your way, He is establishing a certain consciousness in you.
If you have been reading Machaira with Apostle Bennie, you must know that your time of harvest is here. When the children of Israel were in slavery, the only message they needed was “DELIVERANCE”. But that wasn’t the message they needed when they were entering the promised land.  At that point, they needed to be Conscious of the presence of the Lord and be strong and courageous. And that was the message the Lord was administering to Joshua. Whenever the adversary sees you stepping into greater heights, he attempts to weaken your confidence in God.Understand that God doesn’t bring challenges your way to prove your faith. God only inspires you to do great things. 
The adversary uses challenges or negative situations to distract or stop you from doing the things God wants you to do.
This is why you must maintain absolute confidence in God. No challenge should be big enough to move you away from God. No challenge should be big enough to make you doubt God. Hold on strongly to what God have said. In the story of Jesus raising Lazarus from the dead, you will see two instances of faith. Remember, faith is your response to God’s Word. We are going to look at how two sisters (Martha and Mary) responded to Jesus. One day, Lazarus (a brother of Martha and Mary, and a loving friend to Jesus) became very sick to the point of death. “So his sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, our brother Lazarus, the one you love, is very sick. Please come!”When He (Jesus) heard this, he said, “ This sickness will not end in death for Lazarus, but will bring glory and praise to God. This will reveal the greatness of the Son of God by what takes place.” (See John 11:3-4) This was the foundational word that Lazarus raised from the dead. Jesus said this sickness is not unto death but unto the glory and praise of God. Again, it doesn’t mean God afflicts people with sickness and diseases to show His glory, but rather, when the adversary strikes people with any infirmities, because of God’s healing power, many see God’s glory and give praise to Him. Now, Mary and Martha were to hold on to that message and allow it to define their composure. Nevertheless, Martha, for example, argued and doubted the decision of Jesus to roll away Lazarus’ tomb.Look at this, John 11:38-40 (TPT):”Then Jesus, with intense emotions, came to the tomb—a cave with a stone placed over its entrance. Jesus told them, “Roll away the stone.” Then Martha said, “But Lord, it’s been four days since he died—by now his body is already decomposing!” Jesus looked at her and said, “Didn’t I tell you that if you will believe in me, you will see God unveil his power?” I believe Jesus had to look at her with astonishment, because before this time, He had said a lot to Martha and Mary about being the resurrection and the life. Martha was not holding on to the Words of Jesus. 
Until you hold on to the Word of God, you will not demonstrate absolute confidence in God.
