title: EPISODE 1340 - DON'T BE ISOLATED
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Refuse to distance yourself from the Lord. Don’t allow any guilt or wrong to draw you away from God. Live daily in the confidence of the eternal sacrifice of Jesus. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday, 23rd September, 2026 DON'T BE ISOLATED“Not forsaking our meeting together [as believers for worship and instruction], as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another; and all the more [faithfully] as you see the day [of Christ’s return] approaching.” Hebrews 10:25 (Amplified Bible) The term isolate is fundamentally derived from the Latin “insulatus” — which literally denotes the act of being “made into an island” or “placed upon an island”. The term conveys the deliberate detachment of an entity from its broader and organic environment. One of the greatest threats to your consistent walk of faith and growth in the Lord is the desire to be isolated from the Church (which is Christ’s body). It is an error and a trap of the adversary for you to be isolated from the Body of Christ. You are a member of the body, together with the saints. “Now you [collectively] are Christ’s body, and individually [you are] members of it [each with his own special purpose and function].” 1 Corinthians 12:27 (Amplified Bible) How well will a kidney thrive when it is isolated from the body? We are called to be isolated from the world because we are not of this world (John 15:19). However, we live together within the body for the benefit (service) of one another. This post-COVID pandemic world disclosed isolation as a more dangerous epidemic within the Church community. The very first warning in creation was that it is “not good for man to be alone” (Genesis 2:18). Ironically, many isolate themselves from the Church under the guise of pursuing a deeper spiritual life, only to become fixated on digital distractions. Under the pretext of seeking the Holy Spirit, they succumb to endless surfing, using isolation to escape accountability or to indulge in misguided, self-focused philosophies. These philosophies are void of true satisfaction. One of the key factors contributing to this isolation is the propounded concept of self-love. Self-love has become the new chant in this generation. Most motivational speeches, online content, campus lectures, post-modernistic mental health campaigns promote this concept of self-love. They talk about “self-care”, “soul strolls”, “solo-dating”, “self-parenting” or “mothering” oneself, or “your inner child” and “unapologetic” living (as in no longer apologising for being yourself). Beyond pampering, “self-love” has evolved into deeper emotional, mental, and boundary-focused practices. It has been brandished as a more intentional, fierce practice of mental health and autonomy or personal sovereignty. This does not birth organic stability and peace. The word of God holds the definitive answers to the mysteries of the soul and the complexities of human nature. As a new creation in Christ, your thoughts must align with the truth of the word. The recent pandemic served as a catalyst for an agenda designed to isolate believers and shipwreck their faith, with the destructive doctrine of self-love at its epicenter. But is that not a fulfilment of the Apostle Paul’s apostolic prophecy? Here is what he said: “But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, proud, arrogant…” 2 Timothy 3:1–2 (ESV) Beloved, we are at the deeper end of the last days. The enemy has also deployed all his arsenals to prevent the saints from taking heed to execute their divine ordination. You become exposed to the wiles of the devil when you are isolated from the fold. Let nothing draw you away from the brethren. Do not become a prey. Within the fold, you are safe. Attending church meetings and being actively involved in the Church is not an option but a necessary necessity for your nourishment and consistent participation in God’s agenda. Remain knitted with Christ and with the saints. Refuse to be isolated. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Acts 2:42; Matthew 18:20; Psalm 122:1; Ecclesiastes 4:9-12; Hebrews 3:13) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall not fall into the trap to desire isolation from the saints, but shall daily be active in the community of the saints. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN Hosea 10–12 2 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 15 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I shall not fall into the trap of desiring isolation from the saints. – I remain knitted with Christ and the saints. – I allow nothing to draw me away from the brethren. – I refuse to allow myself become a prey to the adversary. – I remain active in the community of the saints. – I refuse to be isolated. Oh glory to Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1340 - MASTER YOUR WORDS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF The Lord has engraved you in the palm of His hand. And takes delight in your personal matters. You are not ordinary. Hallelujah! Apostle Bennie Author Sunday, 20th September, 2026MASTER YOUR WORDS“Let no unwholesome word come out of your mouth, but if there is any good word for edification according to the need of the moment, say that, so that it will give grace to those who hear.”  Ephesians 4:29 (New American Standard Bible) God framed the universe with words. Exactly what He spoke was what came into being. When God looked at all that He has created, He said it was good (See the whole chapter of Genesis 1) Take a look at this as well:  “Faith empowers us to see that the universe was created and beautifully coordinated by the power of God’s words! He spoke and the invisible realm gave birth to all that is seen.” Hebrews 11:3 (TPT) These verses establish a secret concept and principle of the manifestation of things. The present world you see is a product of thoughts and words. Therefore, you must understand that the words you speak take form in your life and in the lives of others. “The tongue can bring death or life; those who love to talk will reap the consequences.” Proverbs 18:21 (NLT)
Spirit beings or entities act on words which are spoken.
This is why you must be intentional about your words. Paul was emphatic with his apostolic instruction to the saints in Ephesus: “Do not let unwholesome [foul, profane, worthless, vulgar] words ever come out of your mouth, but only such speech as is good for building up others according to the need and the occasion, so that it will be a blessing to those who hear [you speak].”One way you can exercise the intentionality in speaking the right words of blessings, is to guard and guide your words. You guard your words also by guarding and guiding your tongue. Don’t just let your tongue loose, put it in submission to the right thoughts. “If anyone thinks himself to be religious [scrupulously observant of the rituals of his faith], and does not control his tongue but deludes his own heart, this person’s religion is worthless (futile, barren).” James 1:26 (Amplified Bible). Most people got into trouble because of the words they spoke. The tongue directs the course of your life. And you have to guard and guide it to articulate life. What comes out of your mouth is what defines and defiles you (Matthew 15:11).
Choose your words carefully with wisdom as a dexterous master poet.
As the Psalmist said, “To the Chief Musician; set to the [tune of] “Lilies.” A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A skillful song, or a didactic or reflective poem. A Song of Love. My heart overflows with a good theme; I address my psalm to the King. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.” Psalm 45:1 (Amplified Bible) Your words must paint a beautiful picture of blessings and grace to those who hear you. The unnecessary joke, that unintentional comment, the rebuke hewn out of wrath, and the unloving criticism, has the potential to lead someone to commit suicide, to destroy ones confidence, it can crush the heart of a great vision and dry enthusiasm. Poets don’t just make utterances. Their words are reflections of their deep thoughts. The speak to paint the right pictures they want their hearers to see and to feel. You are not an ordinary poet. You are a poet soaked with the spirit-ink. Your life is a poem (Ephesians 2:10) written by the Lord Himself. Bring your sphere into the satisfaction of this reality of the Lord in you. Don’t just speak! Let your words uplift destinies and stir fresh passion and hope. Be a builder through your words. Don’t only specialize in speaking right words to yourself, train your lips to speak glorious words to your hearers. The Spirit of the Lord is not upon you to curse a generation or destroy lives. The Spirit of the Lord is upon you to influence your heart and tongue to dispense blessings. The Spirit of the Lord is on you to preach good news to the poor; to proclaim liberty to the captives (which cause recovery of sight to the blind, release the oppress) and to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor! Oh glory to God. Beloved guard and guide your words! Selah! DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:6; Isaiah 54:10-11; Deuteronomy 32:2; Job 29:22-23;  Proverbs 21:23; Proverbs 25:11; Psalm 141:3) WE PRAYWe pray that the wisdom of the Lord shall be set upon our mouth and the Spirit of grace shall keep watch at the door of our lips.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANDaniel 12Hosea 1–32 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 11–12 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am intentional about my words. – I guard and guide my tongue to communicate the excellence of God. – My words are a source of blessing – I am intentional about speaking blessings. – My hearers rejoice at my words. – The wisdom of God is at work in me. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1341 - DO YOU WANT TO FLOURISH BEYOND MEASURE?
content: CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Friday, 14th August, 2026DO YOU WANT TO FLOURISH BEYOND MEASURE?“Until the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is valued as a forest.” Isaiah 32:15 (Amplified Bible)  Working hard to be fruitful is great. However, there is no fruitfulness without the Spirit. Wherever the Spirit of the Lord is there is blossoming.God’s desire is that you become fruitful. However your fruitfulness is by the Spirit. The scriptures liken the fruitfulness or flourishing of one who has experienced the outpouring of the Spirit to a forest. This reveals the extent by which a spirit-life can flourish.Without the outflow of the Spirit you may experience dryness. When there is the overflowing of the Spirit in your life, you shall not experience dryness. “I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.” Isaiah 41:18 This is why you have to commune with the Holy Spirit. You cannot have a consistent communion with the Holy Spirit and remain dry.When the spirit is poured out to you, your ‘dry life’, becomes a fruitful life and then grows to become a forest. The Holy Spirit supplies your life with rivers of living waters, which causes you to blossom in all things. Do you want to flourish beyond measure? Let the Holy Spirit take over your soul. Shalom.DIG DEEPER(Psalm 107:35; Isaiah 44:3; Isaiah 29:17) WE PRAYThat we will enjoy the sufficient supply of God’sSpirit and grace to bear and multiply our fruits. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLANHosea 13–14, Joel 12 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 16 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I bear fruits by the ability of the Supply of Christ. – I am made competent by the empowering presence of God. – I don’t operate by my own strength. – I am strengthened by the grace of God to do more.  – I refuse to be separated from the Lord. – I live in the union of Christ. – Fruitfulness streams from within me because the Lord is my source. – Every weakness in me is perfected by the Grace of God. – I am greatly helped and resourced by the Lord. – I blossom as a forest. Hallelujah!!!

title: EPISODE 1342 - THE SCRIPTURES ARE FOR YOUR TRAINING
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Apostle Bennie Author Friday, 25th September, 2026 THE SCRIPTURES ARE FOR YOUR TRAINING “All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness”  2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV)  At new birth, you received the life of God and full capacity.Jesus said, “…I came that they may have life, and have it in abundance [to the full, till it overflows].” John 10:10 (Amplified)
However, for life to have full expression in you, it is dependent on how you have been cultivated.
The life of God is in your spirit. God does not live in your mind; He lives in your spirit. And your mind has to be cultured to become conscious with the reality of God in your spirit-man. This is what spiritual maturity is to a certain degree. Spiritual maturity is basically your growth in consciousness. It is your mind, your will and emotions being cultivated to operate according to the reality of God in your spirit. For example:“God has not given you the spirit of fear” This is the reality of your spirit. However, you may find yourself living in fear. Why? Your mind, emotions and will have not been trained to practice the reality of fearlessness.
The more you give yourself to the training of the Word, the more you live according to God’s reality in your spirit.
You have to consciously submit your consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. When you don’t submit yourself to the teachings of the Word, you must know that other thought patterns are cultivating you. Whether you are intentional about it or not, you are cultivated or trained to live by some thought patterns. If your life is not influenced by the Word of God, you will be influenced by some other information. It is just like having bare land, with no intentional vegetation.The land will not remain bare forever because weeds will germinate on that land. Weeds grow anywhere there is room. Just because there’s no visible activity on a piece of land doesn’t mean nothing is growing there Our Lord Jesus likened the heart to a field and the word to a seed. (Mark 4:16-20).
When you don’t intentionally cultivate or train your heart with the Word, weeds will germinate.
Even while you are cultivating your heart with the word (as the seed), you have to consistently use the word to uproot wrong seeds, which will germinate in the field. Usually, when you are cultivating a field and weeds also begin to germinate on that field, they compete with the plants over nutrients. The word of God as a seed is profitable for:”…doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness” 2 Timothy 3:16 (NKJV) The scriptures are God’s course for your living. They are designed to cultivate your heart and also to uproot or correct any wrong teachings of the world. The word instruct is the Greek word, “paideia”, which means to educate or train and to correct or discipline and chastise.
The word of God trains you to live according to God’s design and thought.
It sharpens your mind, emotions and will to live in conformity to God’s will publicly and privately. Don’t allow weeds of thoughts from the news, the society, friends, school, workplace etc germinate in your heart. Guard your heart with the Word of God. Be intentional about what grows in your heart. Envy, pride, hatred, fear, pain, bitterness, etc, can germinate in your heart without your permission, if you don’t intentionally give yourself to the training of the Word. As you study the Word, it corrects negative imaginations and thoughts which are not in conformity with the mind of God. BE A STUDENT OF THE WORD This is how you can be equipped for every good work. Beloved, allow the word to train you. Shalom!DIG DEEPER(Romans 15:4; Zephaniah 3:4; Psalm 119:11; Proverbs 6:23; Proverbs 15:10,31) WE PRAYThat we will consciously submit our consciousness, mind, will and emotions to the teachings of the Word. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJoel 2–3, Amos 12 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 17 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I intentionally give myself to the training of the word. – I guard my heart with the word of God. – I don’t permit negative thoughts. – I allow the word of God to cultivate my heart. – As I fellowship with the word of God daily, it sharpens my mind, will and emotions to live in conformity to God’s will. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeeey!

title: EPISODE 1343 - THE SECRETS OF GOD ARE NOT HIDDEN FROM YOU
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF You may receive a word of the Lord through dreams. But judge every dream with the scriptures. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Saturday 26th September, 2026 THE SECRETS OF GOD ARE NOT HIDDEN FROM YOU “It is the glory of God to conceal things, but the glory of kings is to search things out” Proverbs 25:2 (ESV) Is God mysterious? Does He have mysteries?
God remains a mystery dependent on your position and lens.
It is not the intention of God to remain a mystery. It is not His intention to conceal things and even to conceal Himself. God wants to be known and experienced. He wants men to access His reality and principles. Principles and laws are God’s investment in the cosmic universe. They harmonize the systems within the universe to help sustain its course. The person of God is no longer a mystery because of Christ.
Jesus Christ came to unveil God to mankind.
“No one has ever yet seen God. The only begotten God, the One being in the bosom of the Father, He has made Him known.” John 1:18 (Berean Literal Bible) Yet the scriptures state that when Jesus, who is the word, manifested Himself in the flesh, those who thought they knew the word did not know Him and could not receive Him as God (See John 1:11). The Prophet Isaiah declared: “From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.” (Isaiah 64:4) Now Paul the apostle revealed that this scripture has been fulfilled: “No, the wisdom we speak of is the mystery of God—His plan that was previously hidden, even though He made it for our ultimate glory before the world began. But the rulers of this world have not understood it; if they had, they would not have crucified our glorious Lord. That is what the Scriptures mean when they say, “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no mind has imagined what God has prepared for those who love him.” 1 Corinthians 2:7-9 (NLT) God was revealed through Christ yet they couldn’t comprehend that reality. They shouted crucify Him. But didn’t know it was GOD. Until you put on Christ, you will not know about God and He will still be a mystery to you. God is only demystified in Christ. This is why life and living remain a mystery to many. The true understanding of God, the essence and frame of life is decoded through the lens of Christ.
Your understanding of Christ through His word grants you access to the depths of God’s wisdom and the hidden secrets of life.
The word of God is the constitution of the wisdom of God. All that is concealed is revealed in the word of God through the lens of Christ. Get this, secrets are conceptions deployed to harness or manipulate principles and systems to work for one’s advantage. These conceptions are developed through a person’s measure of understanding. Your measure of understanding determines the secrets you unravel. Every believer accesses secrets in the secret place. The secret place is not just a room, but the active moments of communion with God. You have deep communion with God through: – The process of meditation of the Word (which is the mind of God) – Through prayer and fellowship with the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the Spirit of God. And He searches all things, even the deep things of God. When you commune with Him, He brings to your heart the deep thoughts of God’s word.
He brings to heart the hidden secrets the Jewish rulers couldn’t apprehend.
“But it was to us that God revealed these things by his Spirit. For his Spirit searches out everything and shows us God’s deep secrets. No one can know a person’s thoughts except that person’s own spirit, and no one can know God’s thoughts except God’s own Spirit. And we have received God’s Spirit (not the world’s spirit), so we can know the wonderful things God has freely given us.” 1 Corinthians 2:10-12 (NLT). Jesus said of the Holy Spirit, He is the Spirit of Truth who will lead the sons of God into all TRUTH (John 16:13). Beloved, the secrets of God are not hidden from you. The secrets of God and His universe are within your heart. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 3:5; Jeremiah 33:3; Daniel 2:21-23; Job 11:22) WE PRAYWe pray that the Holy Spirit will guide us daily into accessing and comprehending the revealed secrets of God in Christ.  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLAN Amos 2–5 2 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 18–19 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The secrets of God are not hidden from you. – The secrets of God and the universe are within my heart. – The Holy Spirit teaches and guides me daily to access and comprehend the revealed secrets of God in Christ. – I have access into the secrets of God now. Thank you Lord for the gift of your word!

title: EPISODE 1344 - ONLY BLESSINGS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Don’t look at others or the world. Look only at Jesus. Whoever leads you must express or reveal Christ to you. He is the Heavenly Pattern; the express image of the Father. SELAH! Apostle Bennie Author Sunday, 27th September, 2026 ONLY BLESSINGS“The words of the godly are a life-giving fountain; the words of the wicked conceal violent intentions.” Proverbs 10:11 (NLT) The mindset of a new creation is shaped by the word of God. The new creation cannot live above the reality of the word. Whatever we do in speech and deeds must be consistent with the reality of the word of God. You dispense life through the word of God on your tongue. The speaking or utterance of the word of God is blessing to the hearers. 
As a child of God every word you speak must bless lives.
“Do not let unwholesome [foul, profane, worthless, vulgar] words ever come out of your mouth, but only such speech as is good for building up others, according to the need and the occasion, so that it will be a blessing to those who hear [you speak].” Any word which doesn’t bless your hearers is unwholesome and worthless. You don’t speak your emotions, or feelings, or assumptions or speak out of wrath. Speak life and blessings. No matter the situation, communicate with the intention to build up. Whether you are correcting, reacting, responding or explaining a thought, it should be done with grace.S CCCscS s  okokook dp You shouldn’t be known as one who speaks blessing and curses. “We use our tongue to praise God our Father and then turn around and curse a person who was made in his very image! Out of the same mouth we pour out words of praise one minute and curses the next. My brothers and sister, this should never be!” James 3:9-10 (TPT)
Guard and guide your tongue to communicate the excellence of God. Don’t speak curses and violence. Let not poisonous words gush forth from your lips.
From the opening verse, you can see that it is the mouth of the wicked which conceals violence intentions. There is no life and hope on the tongue of the wicked. But for the righteous, his words are a source of blessing and their mouth are the fountain of life. It means when anyone should listen to you they shall enjoy unending flow of wisdom and life. Make a decision today that you are going to be intentional about speaking blessings. Don’t just speak words, speak wisdom. Let your hearers rejoice at your words. As they said concerning Jesus, “where did this man get this wisdom?…”, people around you should say such about you. No matter how complex a situation is, know that the wisdom of God is at work in you. And your words will produce blessing and life in your hearers. If they don’t produce blessings, don’t speak! Selah DIG DEEPER(Colossians 4:6; Proverbs 15:4; Proverbs 18:21; Psalm 45:2; Luke 6:45) WE PRAYWe pray that we shall daily walk in the consciousness and intentionality of communicating blessings to our hearers at all times and in all circumstances. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANAmos 6–92 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 20–21 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I speak life and blessings no matter the situation. – I guard and guide my tongue to communicate the excellence of God. – My words are a source of blessing – I am intentional about speaking blessings. – My hearers rejoice at my words. – The wisdom of God is at work in me. Oh glory to God.Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1345 - A LAVISH DEVOTION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF When you have the capacity to help others, don’t hold back. Just as God loves you, go to any extent of love to help others also. Be HELPFUL AT ALL TIMES. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Monday, 28th September, 2026A LAVISH DEVOTION “Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving]. 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition)  There is something special about giving in to God’s agenda. A cheerful prompt to do it giver has a genuine heart for God. Having a huge amount of money in your bank account or a substantial income doesn’t automatically make you a giver.
Until you passionately love the Lord, you will not give into His agenda.
There is always something to do with money at a personal level. The more income you make, it is likely your bills will also go up. The demands and needs keep increasing, whether you make more money or not. This is why giving in to the spread of the gospel means a lot to God. This brings me to another benefit of giving in to the gospel. Take a look at the opening verse again: “Let each one [give] as he has made up his own mind and purposed in his heart, not reluctantly or sorrowfully or under compulsion, for God loves (He takes pleasure in, prizes above other things, and is unwilling to abandon or to do without) a cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving].“ 2 Corinthians 9:7 (Amplified Bible, Classic Edition). A cheerful (joyous, “prompt to do it”) giver [whose heart is in his giving] is LOVED BY GOD. We see a detailed explanation about this dimension of love.
God esteems a cheerful (joyous prompt to do it) giver (whose heart is in his giving).
Such a person is always on God’s mind for the next assignment. For God to love or esteem you in this light means, He is always creating opportunities for you to give. Have you ever been in a place where you feel you are the only one giving big?Or do you feel you are always the one called upon by your Pastor or leader to give? That is a blessing! Though the saints in the Church must be inspired to give, make up your mind and purpose in your heart to be a giver.  You don’t give because others are giving or not giving. You give because your heart is in your giving. This is not to propound the concept that “give till you are hurt“. That is why you must give, as you have made up your mind and purposed in your own heart. The scripture says, God is unwilling to do without or abandon a cheerful prompt to do it giver. “I know also, my God, that You test the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here to offer willingly to You.” 1 Chronicles 29:17 (NKJV)
The Lord doesn’t just receive our giving; He proves the heart of our giving, whether it is of faith or not.
This giving is not just money, but in any form of valuable donation. Cheerful (joyous prompt to do it) giver, is one who gives in faith.And the Lord takes pleasure in such a giver. The word PLEASURE is from the Hebrew word, “râtsâh”. It means to be pleased with; specifically, be acceptable, be affectionate, delight in, be the favourable, be liked the most. Awesome! God loves the world and has an intimate relationship with those who are in Him. However, He takes special delight in those who give towards His work. You know the lady who anointed Jesus at Bethany, became an eternal delight. Jesus declared her a memorial in the spread of the gospel. That is God taking special delight not just in your giving but in you. He prizes you above other things! Look at what she did:“Then Jesus went to Bethany, to the home of Simon, a man Jesus had healed of leprosy. A woman came into the house, holding an alabaster flask filled with fragrant and expensive oil. She walked right up to Jesus, and in a lavish gesture of devotion, she poured out the costly oil, and it cascaded over his head as he was at the table. When the disciples saw this, they were offended. “What a total waste!” they grumbled. “We could have sold it for a great deal of money and given it to the poor.” Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, “Why are you critical of this woman? She has done a beautiful act of kindness for me. You will always have someone poor whom you can help, but you will not always have me. When she poured the fragrant oil over me, she was preparing my body for burial. I promise you that as this wonderful gospel spreads all over the world, the story of her lavish devotion to me will also be mentioned in memory of her.” Now we are talking about this great act of giving that this lady did today, just as Jesus declared. Also, you will observe that the scriptures were clear about what she gave: It was not just any cheap oil or perfume. The scripture says, what she gave was an EXPENSIVE AND COSTLY OIL.
The disciples thought it was a waste of money, but Jesus called it a LAVISH DEVOTION.
Beloved, have you broken your alabaster box? Shalom.  DIG DEEPER(1 Chronicles 29:2-20; Luke 16:9-11; Proverbs 3:9-11; ; 2 Corinthians 9:1-11; Deuteronomy 8:18; Matthew 26:6-13) WE PRAY We pray that as we increase in grace, we give lavishly into the gospel of our Lord Jesus more and more. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANObadiah 1, Jonah 1–2 2 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 22 DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I am an extravagant giver. – I don’t give grudgingly, I give cheerfully. – I am a prompt to do it giver and my heart is in my giving. – I give greatly into the Lord’s work. – I am a son of consolation. – Because of me the work of God is done with ease. – I increase in the grace to give day by day. – I don’t withhold my money. I give out joyously as the Lord inspires me. – I have the heart and the mind of a giver. – This week I give greatly into the Lord’s assignment. – The Lord has engraced and enabled me to give more. – I increase and abound in this giving grace massively. – I always at any given time give. – I give under all circumstances (no matter the situation).  – I am willing to give whatever the need (the obligation, requirement, task, project, burden, mission, the necessity, irrespective of the size or greatness of the work). – I am a self-sufficient giver by the grace of God.  – I possess enough and require no aid or support to give. – I am furnished in abundance for every good work and charitable donation. Oh Hallelujah, Gloreeeey!!!

title: EPISODE 1346 - BE A CONSOLATION
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF To enjoy the manifestation of the word is for you to take a confident stand on what He has said and make it your declaration in prayer and your speech. Don’t be troubled! Apostle Bennie Author Tuesday, 29th September, 2026 BE A CONSOLATION  “If anyone sees a fellow believer in need and has the means to help him, yet shows no pity and closes his heart against him, how is it even possible that God’s love lives in him” 1 John 3:17 (TPT) The love of God is practical and intentional. You cannot say you have God’s love in you without an action. God’s love for you is an action.
For God to demonstrate His love, He gave His only begotten Son to die for us.
Love doesn’t specialize in accusing and condemning others. Love focuses on demonstrating kindness to others. As a child of God, you have the capacity of God to love others, just as God loves you through Christ. No believer in Christ lacks the ability to Love; “…God’s love has been abundantly poured out within our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.” (Romans 5:5) The love of God is increasingly at work in you. Your first response to every situation must be according to God’s love in you. His love in you enables you to live above selfishness. The Newness of life is not a self-centred life. It is love-dispensing and life-giving. There are some believers of the Kingdom fold who are genuinely overwhelmed by needs. It is not that they lack faith but through situations which confront them, they may find themselves in some need within a period. And as part of strengthening these brethren in faith, we must supply help to them in love.
Believers must not gossip and talk down on other believers.
We must not join the world in pointing fingers towards others. There are times you make conclusions about people and judge them wrongly. Instead of making conclusions about people, patiently find out what is going on with them. There are times you assume a fellow brother has ignored you, yet this fellow may be battling with depression. There are people struggling with hidden tears and untold stories. There are people who feel alone and are crushing inside. They keep contending with suicidal thoughts. Instead of sitting somewhere to castigate people, make a decision you are going to be helpful at all times.
Don’t be misled by the smiles of others. Don’t allow the beautiful pictures they keep posting on social media make you think everything is perfectly fine with them.
There are people who are choked by debts, it is not that they are stingy. Be a consolation. Be discerning and think as a helper. Instead of persecuting people with your words and complaints. Spend time in prayer for them.
Love does not assume. Love is intentional.
When you have the capacity to help others, don’t hold back. Just as God loves you, go to any extent of love to help others also. Be a CONSOLATION AT ALL TIMES.  Selah! DIG DEEPER(1 John 4:7-8, 11-13; Colossians 3:12-14; Philippians 2:2-4; 1 John 3:16-18) WE PRAYPray that:1. Through the wisdom of the Holy Spirit, you will be able to perceive and discern how you can help the brethren who genuinely need your help. 2. All the brethren who need help and are struggling in secret will find help this day. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANJonah 3–4, Micah 12 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 23 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am a consolation unto many.– I demonstrate the love of God unto all.  – I don’t hold back in helping others. – I go every extent to extend help unto others. – My words brings healing to the broken hearted. – I don’t talk people down, I rather uplift others. – I don’t accuse and condemn others. – Many find comfort and peace through me. – I bring joy to others wherever I go. – The love of God is increasingly at work in me. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1347 - MESSENGERS WITH BEAUTIFUL FEET
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Don’t allow the challenges or limitations of your background to bully you. Don’t bow to the systems of this world. Be a fighter. Don’t allow anything to reduce you to ordinariness. You are not ordinary; you are of God. Therefore, don’t live an ordinary life; live as a leading victorious soldier. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Wednesday, 30th, September, 2026  MESSENGERS WITH BEAUTIFUL FEET “And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!“ Romans 10:15 (KJV) The opening verse is a continuation of a discussion on how everyone (both Jews and Gentiles) can receive Salvation. Paul the apostle asked systematic rhetorical questions which were to explain the steps to salvation. 1. Salvation is for all —both Jews and Gentiles. (Romans 10:12) 2. Anyone who shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. (Romans 10:13). 3. To call upon the name of the Lord you must first believe in the Lord. (Romans 10:14) 4. You can only believe in the Lord when you have the good news of the Lord. (Romans 10:14) 5. To hear the good news of the Lord there must be a preacher. (Romans 10:14) 6. Therefore a preacher is sent to a people with the goodnews of Jesus so that many can believe. (Romans 10:15). When Paul the apostle said, “it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!”, he was referring to Isaiah 52:7. He established the reality that the prophecy of Isaiah was fulfilled in Christ and His disciples (take note, the disciples of Jesus are not only the early apostles. The disciples of Jesus include every saved one in Christ).
The glorious Salvation plan of God was fulfilled in Christ, and we (who are in Christ) are now the publishers of this good news of Salvation.
“How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good things, Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!” Isaiah 52:7 (NKJV) The Prophet Isaiah used the imagery of a messenger running from a distant city or even a battlefield bearing either good news from a king to a people, or good news from a king to another king or his people or good news from an army to their king. Mostly when there is a battle, the fate of the people depends on the outcome of the battle. It is either the king and his people will lose their kingdom and lands or they will expand their territory or remain unconquered. Definitely, a messenger running from a distant field will come with dirty and tattered feet. But that isn’t what matters to the people. What the people are interested in is the news the messenger is bearing.
The beauty of a messenger’s feet is in the message he bears.
When Jesus died, he didn’t slightly escape from the claws of death in the grave, He defeated death! He rose from the grave as the Lord of all. “Then Jesus made a public spectacle of all the powers and principalities of darkness, stripping away from them every weapon and all their spiritual authority and power to accuse us. And by the power of the cross, Jesus led them around as prisoners in a procession of triumph. He was not their prisoner; they were his!” Colossians 2:15 (TPT).
He has sent us to go forth into all the world to herald this glorious news of conquest.
The Lord has made you a bearer of good news. This is what it means to have beautiful feet. In every place, people must hear and experience the victory of Jesus. There is the goodnews of how Jesus has defeated the accuser of the brethren and destroyed all the handwritings of condemnation against you. By the resurrection of Jesus, the Lord has brought justification to all who believe in Him. There is the provision for healing, perfect reconciliation and peace with God. This is good news! Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Ephesians 2:14-22; Isaiah 9:6; Colossians 1:20-23; Songs of Solomon 2:8; Nahum 1:15) WE PRAYWe pray that in every place we go, many shall see us as heralds of good tidings (messengers with beautiful feet)  BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 2026 1 YEAR PLAN Micah 2–4 2 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 24DECLARE THESE WORDS: – I am a publisher of the glorious goodnews of salvation. – Many are hearing the goodnews of Jesus through me. – I am a bearer of the gospel of the most glorious and greatest news in the universe. – I am bold and daring about this glorious gospel of peace. – I announce the goodnews of Jesus to my world. – I refuse to sit on the fence, I take a stand today. Thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1348 - YOU ARE KNOWN
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF In this month of October, whatever God has called you to do; plan, strategise, act out ideas and above all don’t trust in them. Have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD. Selah. Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 1st October, 2026 YOU ARE KNOWN“To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out”  John 10:3-5 (NKJV)Have you ever walked in a community new to you and suddenly you meet someone you don’t recognize, calls you by your own name?
How was the feeling?
It’s likely you will be surprised or feel accepted. You step into a new beautiful office with a lot of respected people seated and some standing around. Then the boss walks in, calls you by name and ask you to follow him. You can tell that special feeling right? Look, currently there are more than 8 billion people on Earth. There are innumerable company of angels and many more spirits of just men. Each of these people have their own name. Of all these multitudinous people, the Lord walks to you and calls you by name. The Lord knows you personally and intimately. In ancient times, names were not given to people by impulse. Names were given to people according to their destiny or how they are destined to achieve. Thus, to know someone’s name is to understand the person’s mandate.
God knows your name; He knows you personally and your unique identity. You are not just a number in the midst of the multitudes.
When the Lord comes to His sheepfold, He calls each of His own sheep by name (John 10:3). In several occasions, the LORD GOD called people by name. He also gives names to people or change their names to suit the destiny He has foreordained for them. Interestingly, you will find other instances where the Lord did not just call the names of the people, but called their names twice.
That is an affirmation to the reality that, He doesn’t call you by chance. It is by a personal knowledge of you.
On his way to Damascus,  our Lord Jesus, called Saul twice. He didn’t just call Saul by his name, he also spoke in his dialect. “And when we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew dialect, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.” Acts 26:14 (NASB). See also Acts 9:4. The Lord also called Abraham by name (Genesis 22:11-13), Jacob (Genesis 46:1-4); Moses (Exodus 3:1-10); Samuel (1 Samuel 3:1-10) Martha (Luke 10:38-42) and many others.
Irrespective of what you think of yourself or your history, the Lord knows you by name precious one. You matter to Him and He values you.
“But now thus says the Lord, he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: “Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine.” Isaiah 43:1 (ESV) The Lord has engraved you in the palm of His hand. And takes delight in your personal matters. You are not ordinary. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 49:1; Isaiah 41:9;  Genesis 17:5; Isaiah 43:1-2) WE PRAYThank you Lord for the privilege to be known and valued by you. Thank you for placing your identity on me and establishing a personal relationship with me. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANMicah 5–72 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 25 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I am known and valued by the Lord.– I am not ordinary. – I matter to the Lord. – The Lord takes delight in my matters. – I walk daily in the consciousness of this blessed reality. Thank you Lord Jesus! Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1349 - HAVE NO CONFIDENCE IN THE FLESH
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Faith has no reverse gear. March forward and don’t settle for less. You can get the job done. Apostle Bennie Author Friday, 2nd October, 2026 HAVE NO CONFIDENCE IN THE FLESH“With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.” 2 Chronicles 32:8 (KJV) Progress in human civilization and technological advancement shouldn’t replace God and the advantage of His dealings. No advancement of any civilization outwits God’s intelligence and wisdom. Beloved, understand that God is not an alternative choice. He is your first and only choice. No matter the progress you make and resources accessible to you, acknowledge God as your confidence and source. (Proverbs 3:26; Psalm 23:1). Use the resources available to you as divine tools. Let God work with you through the resources available to you.
Don’t make the resources available to you gods.
To trust human methods and systems above God is to entrap your heart from enjoying an unceasing flow of possibilities. This is not to sympathise with the demonisation of technology or any intellectual contribution to human development. God made man to replenish the earth. (Genesis 1:28). He designed the human intellect not only to reason theological discourse, but to also harness and construct various frameworks of human development for the fulfilment of His purpose. Clearly, human intellect is God’s blessing and gift. Yet without it being cultured by God’s wisdom, it wouldn’t serve God’s intention.
Every single thing we find within God’s universe is His unique investment to achieve His purpose.
Nothing was designed to be isolated from God. Every single thing finds true meaning and fulfilment when it operates within God’s government. Right from when corruption entered the heart of men, independence from God became the pursuit of men. (Psalm 2:1-3). Thus, they made for themselves gods through created things and even systems they have created. (Jeremiah 16:20). Instead of culturing their hearts to trust in God, the enmity in their mind towards God (Colossians 1:21) has made them seek an existence outside God. But where can you go from God? (Psalm 139:7-12). They have trusted in their philosophies, technological advancements or scientific prowess, rather than God Himself. They have set their efforts and systems as their arm of strength. But as long as a concept, strategy, system or technique isn’t hewn out of God, it is subject to the weakness of the flesh. The arm of flesh refers to relying or depending on human intelligence, skills, strategy, resources etc., in lieu of God. The arm of flesh always fails. Don’t be like Sennacherib the Assyrian king. He trusted in his gods and military might. However, King Hezekiah had absolute confidence in God. To be clear, it wasn’t as though King Hezekiah sat in his palace doing nothing. “And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem, he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him. So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water? Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance. And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city…” 2 Chronicles 32:2-6 (KJV) Hezekiah took strategic steps. He cut the water supply to the Assyrian army, strengthened his military equipment, revamped his defences, and set offensive machinery in place. He did have the available warfare technology. But his confidence was in the LORD. Take note of the words he spoke to his people, nothing about their technological resources, strategy and military might: “And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying, Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.” 2 Chronicles 32:6-8 (KJV) Now the people didn’t rest on their military systems, but on the words of King Hezekiah concerning the DIVINE HELP. Whatever God has called you to do; plan, strategise, act out ideas and above all don’t trust in them. Have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Jeremiah 17:5; Isaiah 30:1-3; Isaiah 31:3; Psalm 146:3-4; Proverbs 3:5-6; 1 Corinthians 2:5) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall not be lured to make gods out of our efforts, but shall exercise confidence in the LORD. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANNahum 1–32 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 26 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have no confidence in the flesh. – I exercise confidence in the Lord daily. – I don’t permit my heart to be lured to make gods out of my efforts. – I have absolute trust in the STRONG ARM OF GOD! Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1350 - BE GRACIOUS WITH YOUR WORDS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF People don’t take steps to execute God’s vision because they are afraid to fail. Why will you allow fear of failure make you walk in disobedience? Choose obedience over failure or success. Take the first step of faith and it will be a giant step of glory. SELAH! Apostle Bennie Author Saturday, 3rd October, 2026  BE GRACIOUS WITH YOUR WORDS  “In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, yet it can boast of great achievements. A huge forest can be set on fire by a little flame”  James 3:5 (International Standard Version) The evidence of your thoughts is in your words. No one knew what was on the mind of God until He gave His word. The word of God brings us into the understanding of His thoughts.
The mouth will speak “out of” the abundance of the heart. When you want your thoughts to be understood, you must exercise the maturity of speaking.
How you speak is also proof of your maturity. Anyone who has mastery of the tongue and knows how to speak or tame the tongue will excel in every place. Many destinies have been crushed because of the tongue. The utterances of the tongue can cause you to advance or to become stagnant. The tongue is like a little spark of flame which can set a huge forest on fire. It is like the rudder which directs a huge ship towards a destination.
You must become intentional about your words. To speak the mind of God you must learn to speak His word.
God said to Joshua, “Let the words from the book of the law be always on your lips…”Joshua 1:8 (VOICE) This is not merely about “Talking Positive”, this is mainly about Speaking the Word of God. The Word of God is more than being positive. The Word of God is being creative. The Word of God creates. The universe was created, framed, repaired, properly and perfectly joined together by the Word of God. Your life will only head towards God’s designed destination when you master the wisdom to speak God’s inspired Word. Don’t speak your fear, worry or anxiety, doubt, limitation, failures and disappointments.
Speak that which is pure, true, honorable, worthy of note and glorious.
When you learn to meditate on the Word of God you will definitely speak forth the Word. The meditation of your heart and the words of your mouth must be consistent with the mind of God. “Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer”(Psalm 19:14)
Words that are consistent with the thoughts of God and are acceptable by God, cause the Lord’s blessings to increase in your life.
“You are the most handsome of all. Gracious words stream from your lips. God himself has blessed you forever” Psalm 45:2 (NLT) This is a poetic Psalm written to celebrate David the King. This Psalm unveils the skillfulness of David through words. The King’s gracious words contribute to how he was endued with blessings. He always knew what to say to the Lord and the people he led.
To speak graciously also means to speak kindly and politely.
 This is not about making a faith declaration but knowing how to address situations and people through wisdom. Some people are always overwhelmed by conflicts because of the utterances they make. Such must practice the habit of speaking graciously. This means to speak an attractive speech that is impressively articulated and fitting for the occasion.
Until you consistently have a genuine testimony that your words at every given time are full of grace and excellence, you have not yet matured.
Let grace be poured on your lips. Hallelujah! DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 50:4; Proverbs 17:27; Proverbs 15:28; Proverbs 23:15-16; Zephaniah 3:9) WE PRAY We pray that we shall have the tongue of the learned and that our tongue or lips will be saturated with grace so that we will excel in speech with the right words in season and out of season no matter the situation. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANHabakkuk 1–3Zephaniah 12 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 27–28 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I have the tongue of the learned. – My tongue is saturated with grace, therefore I only speak gracious words. – I excel in speech with the right words in and out of season. – It doesn’t matter the challenge at a particular time, I speak right. – I speak that which is pure, true honorable, worthy of note and glorious. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1351 - THE ADVERSARY IS AFTER YOUR HEART
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Let the joy of what the Lord has said, overtake your heart or rule over your heart, and you shall walk in total victory. SELAH! Apostle Bennie Author Sunday, 4th October, 2026 THE ADVERSARY IS AFTER YOUR HEART“Do not be anxious or worried about anything, but in everything [every circumstance and situation] by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, continue to make your [specific] requests known to God.”  Philippians 4:6 (Amplified Bible) Have you ever given attention to this verse of scripture? What do you see as your biggest challenge? Is it the circumstance you find yourself in or the state of your heart? Get this, the enemy is not after your money, health, house, education, children and anything external.
The adversary is after your heart.
Paul’s instruction to the Philippians unveils what God is very concerned about concerning you. The challenges you face can never be permanent. Most matters which made you anxious at one time are things you may laugh over when you look back in time. You can remember how anxious you were while going to write your first Basic Education Examination. What about the times you were anxious and couldn’t even check your examination results? Do you remember how you felt while going for the job interview? How does such a moment matter to you now? Do you remember those tears because you felt you wouldn’t be able to have children? How about the anxiety when you were looking forward to receiving a visa?  Now, whether you received good news or not during those times, what do you really think was your challenge? Get this, God doesn’t see the interview, examination, the debt, the unemployment, the dismissal, the rejection, the failure, the marriage dispute, the betrayals, the financial limitations, the business struggle, the delay of miracles etc, as your core challenge. What God sees as your challenge is how you react amidst the challenge. 
God is interested in the condition of your heart than the challenge confronting you.
Those challenges shall definitely pass away, but how they affect your heart shall remain forever and shall continue. One great man, Robert Schuller said, “Tough times never last, but tough people do” While the adversary knows those tough times you face will not last, he wants to use such times to weaken your heart. However, God wants you to take advantage of such moments to build yourself in His strength. God wants you to exercise yourself in faith. So instead of God saying, “I will give you the money”, “I will give you the children”, “I will give you the success”, “I will give you the appointment”. He rather instructs the saints, saying, “Do not be anxious or worried about anything.” Beloved, God doesn’t want you to worry or be anxious. The core challenge is the state of your heart. Being anxious weakens your heart. Paul instructs the saints to pray and to continually make supplications (or petitions) of specific requests to God with thanksgiving. Take a look at the effect of the prayer: See verse 7: “And the peace of God [that peace which reassures the heart, that peace] which transcends all understanding, [that peace which] stands guard over your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus [is yours].” Philippians 4:7 (Amplified Bible)
The greatest answer you need is the STATE OF PEACE amidst the challenges.
God is your loving Father. His plans for you are greater than your expectations. Being at peace guards your heart to patiently walk with God into His greater purposes for you. Therefore, He first deals with the anxiety and worry.  You cannot hear the Lord and not even be able to trust His direction when you are anxious.  Anxiety and worry move you into faithlessness and doubt.  God knows that when He is able to establish your heart in His peace, you can prevail over every challenge which comes your way.
No matter the challenge confronting you, let the PEACE OF GOD rule over your heart.
The enemy is not going to stop attacking your mind and heart. Even after you have dealt with your previous challenge, there is another challenge that is going to come your way.  What the adversary wants is for you to live in worry, anxiety and sorrow. This is how he gets you distracted in the pursuit of destiny.
You walk in constant victory and are not moved by challenges when you allow His PEACE to permanently take over your heart. 
This is the main reason you have to pray.DIG DEEPER(Job 22:21; Psalm 29:11; 2 Thessalonians 3:16; John 16:33; Isaiah 26:3; Colossians 3:15) WE PRAYWe pray that the Lord of peace Himself shall give you peace at all times and in every way. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANZephaniah 2–3Haggai 1–22 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 29–30 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– The peace of God saturates my heart at all times. – I refuse to be anxious about anything. – I am tough on the inside; therefore, I remain calm at all times. – No situation has what it takes to change my composure. – I walk in constant victory.  Oh thank you Lord Jesus!

title: EPISODE 1352 - COUNT IT ALL JOY
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF You are not and shall never be hated by God. You are God’s beloved and He has loved you with an everlasting (unending) love. Walk in this confidence all the days of your life. Selah. Apostle Bennie Author Monday, 5th October, 2026 COUNT IT ALL JOY “My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations” James 1:2 (KJV) We have often heard expressions which seem to be similar to what is in the opening verse, “be joyful in trouble”; others assume that “to be joyful in trouble or challenge is to accept your situation or pain as a trial from God”. But that is not what it is! To count it all joy is not to accept a predicament with joy. It is not to accept that sour pain is an affliction from God.
God doesn’t need to afflict you to train you. His word is rich enough to train your heart.
To walk with God is to live by faith, and you don’t live by faith through experiences; you live by faith in the word. Any experience which inspires faith is built on the word of God. Any training God will give to you shall be by the revelation of His word of Grace. God doesn’t need to afflict you with sickness, diseases, or disappointment to train you. Most afflictions are a result of living outside the counsel of God’s word or the deceptive work of the adversary. However, the challenges a believer may go through can be conquered by the word of God. What we learn from challenges or afflictions is how the word works. When you fail to glean the wisdom of the word of God to address your challenge, you may not know how to deal with a similar challenge in the future. To “count it all joy” is not just to go through all challenges with joy. The keyword in James 1:2 is “COUNT IT”, it’s from the Greek word, “hēgeomai”, which means: – strengthened – to lead that is command (with official authority) – figuratively to deem, that is to consider or account or esteem and think – to be a governor, judge or have the rule over. To “count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations” is not to accept the temptations, but to deem or account it with joy. It means you don’t make the challenge the account of your life. 
You don’t define your present state by the trials or the troubles you face.
You have to rule over adversity or the troubles with joy. Joy is the instrument by which you exercise the divine rule over challenges. You don’t allow challenges to overwhelm your heart. Instead, you set your heart up with joy. Instead of accounting for or esteeming your heart by the negative news or the limitations, set the estimation of your heart with the joy of the Lord. Being joyful is not an act of pretense. It is not acting as though you don’t have a challenge; it is basically dominating the challenge with the word of the Lord in your heart. Challenges or trials dominate hearts with sorrow, agony, anxiety, and depression. However, you must dominate your heart with the joy of the word of the Lord.
Let the joy of what the Lord has said, overtake your heart or rule over your heart, and you shall walk in total victory.
Don’t make the trials the condition of your thought. Let your thoughts be ruled by the impact of the word of God. Jesus said, “these words have I spoken unto you that my joy may be fulfilled in you”. The word of the Lord brings the fulfilment of His joy in your heart. So instead of giving your focus to the trials, turn and look unto the word of the Lord. This is how you count it all joy. Selah. DIG DEEPER(Philippians 4:4; Isaiah 41:10; 1 Thessalonians 5:16-17; John 15:11) WE PRAYWe pray that our hearts shall be ruled and dominated by the joy of the Lord and not by trials. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANZechariah 1–32 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 31 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– My heart is ruled and dominated by the joy of the Lord at all times. – I refuse to allow my heart to be dominated by trials. – I maintain my joy at all times. – I rule over every adversity with joy. – No challenge can overhelm my heart. – My thoughts are ruled by the impact of the word of God. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1353 - QUENCH ALL FIERY DARTS
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF Make it your priority to walk in love as Jesus loved all men. Even when He hanged naked on the cross, before His death. Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 6th October, 2026   QUENCH ALL FIERY DARTS “Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.” Ephesians 6:16 (KJV) The adversary takes delight in the ignorance of the saints. Ignorance is basically the lack of knowledge.And God’s word is clear on this: “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge…” (Hosea 4:6)
As many who lack the true knowledge of God, His character and the things He has achieved for us in Christ, can easily become victims of the devices of the enemy.
This is why you must take a stand putting on the whole armor of God. “so that we would not be exploited by the adversary, Satan, for we know his clever schemes.“ (2 Corinthians 2:11) The schemes of the adversary are his weapons designed to shipwreck the faith of the saints, to distract them from their communion with the Lord and to cause them to live as mere men and not according to the purpose of God. “so that we would not be exploited by the adversary, Satan, for we know his clever schemes.” 2 Corinthians 2:11 (TPT) You must have the intelligence and understanding of how the enemy operates. This will guide and guard you from living in continuous defeat. He will not relent from attempting to exploit you. He will always come at you till you believe he is more powerful, the victory of the Lord is not true and you are powerless.
Meanwhile, his goal is to use you as an instrument against the Lord and His purpose.
Don’t fall for it! The adversary will always aim at areas or points in your life where you are most vulnerable. The fiery darts of the enemy are poisonous and distractive. None of it is harmless. The Greek word for the “fiery darts” is belos. It is a specially made arrow with a tiny drilled hole, containing flammable fluids. When the arrows are projected, they seem harmless but upon impact on their target, they explode into raging flames; to burn their enemies. These flammable arrows may be subtle, such as bitterness, little offences, unforgiveness, displeasure, disappointment, genuine fears, lies, mistakes, failures, absence of testimonies, self-esteem, jealousy, etc. These may start through harmless situations or incidents, but when they are not intentionally or promptly and explosively extinguished, they will gradually creep into your heart and start by causing a systematic emotional breakdown. The attacks of the adversary are poisonous. But thank God for the shield of faith! With the shield of faith, “you shall be able” to quench the fiery darts. The word “able” is from the Greek word “dunamai” which means the might of power. Dunamai has its root in the word, “dunamis”; it means a dynamic ability to cause changes. It also denotes the explosion or explosiveness of power. With the SHIELD OF FAITH, you are empowered to explode.
The SHIELD OF FAITH speaks of your spiritual and mental disposition by the word of God, our formation or strategy, and our explosive attitude towards the fiery darts of the enemy.
The fiery darts are assaults of the enemy, and the shield of faith makes you fortified and impregnable. This is what the Prophet meant: No weapon formed or forged or fashioned against you shall hurt you, prosper or succeed. This is your heritage in the Lord. (Isaiah 54:17)
Be always alert with your shield of faith to defend yourself against the attacks of the enemy.
Selah DIG DEEPER(Isaiah 45:24; Isaiah 41:11; Genesis 15:1 Exodus 15:2-3; Psalm 28:7-8) WE PRAYWe pray that no weapon of the enemy fashioned or rage against us, under any circumstance shall prosper. In the name of Jesus. BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANZechariah 4–62 YEARS PLAN Isaiah 32 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to become a victim of the devices of the enemy. – With the shield of faith, I extinguish any fiery dart of the adversary shot at me. – I am always alert with my shield of faith to defend myself against any attack of the enemy. – No weapon formed or fashioned against me under any circumstance prospers. – I live by faith. – I walk daily in the consciousness of faith. – I am a man of faith. Oh glory to God!

title: EPISODE 1355 - THE WISDOM FROM ABOVE IS ABOVE ALL
content:
CHRIST COMMONWEALTH-COMMUNITY The Love-Life Agency Download PDF In the working of His plan, there are no crooked paths, neither are there “ups and downs”. The path the Lord has set for you is smooth. Selah! Apostle Bennie Author Thursday, 8th October, 2026 THE WISDOM FROM ABOVE IS ABOVE ALL “As wisdom increases, a great treasure is imparted, greater than many bars of refined gold. It is a more valuable commodity than gold and gemstones, for there is nothing you desire that could compare to her.” Proverbs 3:14-15 (TPT)The more you grow and increase in God, the more you will continue to behold True Wisdom in the highest peak of God. It is a great error to assume that the wisdom and intelligence of men are in the same league as the Wisdom of God.
True Wisdom is God’s unfathomable essence and has no limitation.
The people of the world have built their lives on their own wisdom. But the wisdom of the wise (in this world) is foolishness unto God. “Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, let him become a fool [discarding his worldly pretensions and acknowledging his lack of wisdom], so that he may become [truly] wise. For the wisdom of this world is foolishness (absurdity, stupidity) before God; for it is written [in Scripture], “[He is] The one who catches the wise and clever in their craftiness;” and again, “The Lord knows the thoughts of the [humanly] wise, that they are useless.”  1 Corinthians 3:18-21 Some do acknowledge God’s Wisdom as a superior Wisdom. However, assume that the measure of God’s Wisdom begins from the highest Wisdom of men. That is a mere assumption. 
The foundation and beginning of the Wisdom of God is godly reverence and devotion of love to God.
The highest wisdom of the world or men is foolishness to God. God reckon the Wisdom of men as useless. There is no way God’s wisdom will begin from foolishness. In Daniel 2, King Nebuchadnezzar demanded that the wisest men in Babylon should tell his dream before he could trust their interpretation (Daniel 2:1-9). These wise men in Babylon were considered the wisest men on earth then, yet couldn’t demonstrate Wisdom. The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on earth who can tell the king this matter, for no king, lord or ruler has ever asked such a thing as this of any magician or enchanter or Chaldean.” Daniel 2:10 (Amplified) Their response was a shred of evidence of the limitation of the wisdom of men. These wise men of Babylon also demonstrate their intelligence and wisdom through accumulated information or knowledge. However, through Daniel, we will see that True Wisdom is imparted from above by God.
One of the key preeminence of the Wisdom of God is that it cannot be accessed or accumulated through human intelligence.
Daniel accessed the solution to the king’s demand through the Wisdom imparted by God. For Daniel to pray to God for an answer means he reveres and acknowledges God as his source. Observe his prayer after God revealed the secret of the king to him. “Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night, and Daniel blessed the God of heaven. Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, For wisdom and power belong to Him. “It is He who changes the times and the seasons; He removes kings and establishes kings. He gives wisdom to the wise and [greater] knowledge to those who have understanding! “It is He who reveals the profound and hidden things; He knows what is in the darkness, And the light dwells with Him. “I thank You and praise You, O God of my fathers, For You have given me wisdom and power; Even now You have made known to me what we requested of You, For You have made known to us [the solution to] the king’s matter.” Daniel 2:19-23 (Amplified). Daniel was not wise in his own eyes (Proverbs 3:7). He did not lean on his own understanding but trusted the Wisdom of God.
No matter the challenge which confronts you, don’t turn to the wisdom of men; for it is not wisdom at all.
Trust in the superior or preeminent wisdom of God through His Word. Selah! DIG DEEPER(Job 28; Daniel 2:1-49; 1 Corinthians 3:18-21; 1 Corinthians 1:18-21; James 3:17) WE PRAYWe pray that through us the preeminence or superiority of the Wisdom of God shall be made manifest.  In the name of Jesus! BIBLE READING IN THE YEAR 20261 YEAR PLANZechariah 10-12 2 YEARS PLANIsaiah 34 DECLARE THESE WORDS:– I refuse to esteem any created thing above God who is the source of true wisdom. – I esteem the Word of God in my life. – I walk in wisdom. – I cease to be ordinary. – My understanding is opened as I fellowship daily with the Word of God. – I am wise. Oh Glory to God!!
